translation_verse: Esa kama nɛ e beta mbe kusɔ deseso ŋko kusɔ chenaso nɛ e dese so ŋko n chena so daga fanɛ e fɔr mbe asɔbuuso nseŋ bɛr nchu, ama mo alɛ kraa beeŋ baa wɔ eyurpi to n ya fo kaaseso.

english_verse: Any man who has sex with her during this time becomes unclean for seven days, and anything he rests on is also unclean.
translation_verse: Nɛ enyɛn di eche nɛ e bee lar ntaman, eche na be eyurpi na suse enyɛn na nna na. Enyɛn na gba beeŋ baa wɔ eyurpi to nchɛ ashunu nɛ kusɔ kama nɛ e dese so gba a wora eyurpi.

english_verse: Any woman who has a flow of blood outside her regular monthly period is unclean until it stops, just as she is during her monthly period.
translation_verse: Nɛ eche bee shile ŋklaŋ nɛ jemanɛ nɛ e bee lar ntaman maŋ naŋ fo ŋko kachɛ nɛ ŋklaŋ na daga e ka kuu na baŋ so, e kraa wɔ eyurpi to nna n ya fo fanɛ ŋklaŋ na ka beeŋ ku fanɛ kananɛ e bee wora eyurpi kufɔl kikɛ to na.

english_verse: Anything that she rests on or sits on during this time is also unclean, just as it would be during her period.
translation_verse: Kusɔ kama nɛ e dese so ŋko n chena so loŋ be jemanɛ na wora eyurpi nna na.

english_verse: If you touch either of these, you must wash your clothes and take a bath, but you still remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Esa kama nɛ e beta kusɔ deseso ŋko kusɔ chenaso na gba wora eyurpi nseŋ daga fanɛ e fɔr mbe asɔbuuso nseŋ bɛr nchu, ama mo alɛ kraa beeŋ baa wɔ eyurpi to n ya fo kaaseso.

english_verse: Seven days after the woman gets well, she will be considered clean.
translation_verse: Eche na be ŋklaŋ na baŋ kuu, k beeŋ ta mo nchɛ ashunu pɔɛŋ nɛ e nyalɛ so.

english_verse: On the eighth day, she must bring either two doves or two pigeons to the front of my sacred tent and give them to a priest.
translation_verse: Kachɛ burwasopo na e ta elepɔ anyɔ ŋko ali anyɔ n ya sa bɔrɛmatapo na ashi wajɛbu na be kabuna ase.

english_verse: He will offer one of the birds as a sacrifice for sin and the other as a sacrifice to please me; then I will consider the woman completely clean.
translation_verse: Bɔrɛmatapo na beeŋ ta mbuibi na be eko n lara kulubi be sarga nseŋ ta emo nɛ e ka na malɛ n lara sarga chɔɔso. Kananɛ e beeŋ wora eche na be kenyalɛso be kesheŋ wora nna na.

english_verse: When any of you are unclean, you must stay away from the rest of the community of Israel. Otherwise, my sacred tent will become unclean, and the whole nation will die.
translation_verse: Ade kikɛ be kaman, nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ Mosis fanɛ e kpele Israɛl be basa na kusoe a laŋɛ bumo be eyurpisheŋ be kaplɛa so, saŋɛ na so b maaŋ ta eyurpi m pɛ wajɛbu nɛ k wɔ keeyi na be nferinto na. Nɛ b ta eyurpi m pɛ kumo, efuli na kikɛ beeŋ wu.”

english_verse: Two of Aaron's sons had already lost their lives for disobeying the Lord, so the Lord told Moses to say to Aaron: I, the Lord, appear in a cloud over the place of mercy on the sacred chest, which is behind the inside curtain of the sacred tent. And I warn you not to go there except at the proper time. Otherwise, you will die!
translation_verse: “Kaŋɛ fo da Ɛɛrɔn fanɛ jemanɛ nɛ k daga nawule nɛ e beeŋ tiŋ n luri acheembiana to be kakpa cheembi nɛ k wɔ patisa na be kaman na to, ŋkpal manɛ so, ndoŋ nɛ mee bɔla kuwɔlpa nɛ k buu kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre be deka na so a lara ma kumu a ŋini. Nɛ mannɛ aloŋ, e beeŋ wu.

english_verse: Before entering this most holy place, you must offer a bull as a sacrifice for your sins and a ram as a sacrifice to please me.
translation_verse: Pɔɛŋ nɛ e luri acheembiana to be kakpa cheembi na, a daga fanɛ e ta gbolu fɔlbi n lara kulubi be sarga nɛ kpakpafɔlbi malɛ n lara sarga chɔɔso.

english_verse: You will take a bath and put on the sacred linen clothes, including the underwear, the robe, the sash, and the turban.
translation_verse: E beeŋ bɛr nchu pɔɛŋ nseŋ ta mbe kabɔrɛmata be epiŋi tenteŋ m buu n deŋi kumo be danshiki so nseŋ ta wajɛchɛbi be kreso paŋgelambi na ŋ kre so nseŋ naŋ ta neemu m mɛa kumu.

english_verse: Then the community of Israel will bring you a ram and two goats, both of them males. The goats are to be used as sacrifices for sin, and the ram is to be used as a sacrifice to please me.
translation_verse: Israɛl be basa na kikɛ beeŋ sa Ɛɛrɔn mboenyɛn anyɔ nɛ e ta n lara kulubi be sarga nseŋ sa mo kpakpa malɛ nɛ e ta n lara sarga chɔɔso.

english_verse: Aaron, you must offer the bull as a sacrifice of forgiveness for your own sins and for the sins of your family.
translation_verse: E beeŋ ta gbolu n lara mo nɛ mbe kanaŋ be alubi be ketampaŋ be sarga.

english_verse: Then you will lead the two goats into my presence at the front of the sacred tent,
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ e ta mboe anyɔ na n yɔ wajɛbu na be kabuna to.

english_verse: where I will show you which goat will be sacrificed to me and which one will be sent into the desert to the demon Azazel.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nɛ meeŋ ŋini mo kusɔ nɛ e beeŋ wora. E beeŋ ta ajembu anyɔ n to beri n lara mboe anyɔ na to be kumo nɛ k beeŋ baa la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na peya nɛ kumo nɛ baaŋ yige n lɛ kupuŋ to nɛ k baa yɔ na.

english_verse: After you offer the first goat as a sacrifice for sin,
translation_verse: Ɛɛrɔn beeŋ mɔ kaboe nɛ e to beri n lara n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na n lara kulubi be sarga

english_verse: the other one must be presented to me alive, before you send it into the desert to take away the sins of the people.
translation_verse: nseŋ ta kenyɔsopo keniso na n lara sarga n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nseŋ yige mo n lɛ kiyi to nɛ k ta basa na be alubi n yɔ.

english_verse: You must offer the bull as a sacrifice to ask forgiveness for your own sins and for the sins of your family.
translation_verse: Ɛɛrɔn kaŋ ta gbolu na n lara mo nɛ mbe kanaŋ be alubi be sarga n loge,

english_verse: Then you will take a fire pan of live coals from the bronze altar, together with two handfuls of finely ground incense, into the most holy place.
translation_verse: e beeŋ ta kadɛtɔl nɛ k bɔlɔ ajanwulɛ nɛ edɛ na ashi bɔrɛsure na ase, nɛ duwu be enɔ be ebɔlɔ anyɔ n luri m ba acheembiana to be kakpa cheembi na to.

english_verse: There you will present them to me by placing the incense on the coals, so that the place of mercy will be covered with a cloud of smoke. Do this, or you will die right there!
translation_verse: E beeŋ ta duwu na n wɔtɔ edɛ na to ashi Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be anishito ndoŋ nɛ duwu na be edishi a buu kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre be deka na be buuso na so, saŋɛ na so e maaŋ wu kumo kenishiso nseŋ wu.

english_verse: Next, use a finger to sprinkle some of the blood on the place of mercy, which is on the lid of the sacred chest; then sprinkle blood seven times in front of the chest.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ e suse ŋklaŋ na be ako n ta mbe keshilbi n nyɔ amo to ŋ ŋmenyaŋ kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre be deka na be buuso so nseŋ wora amo ŋ ŋmenyaŋ kumo be anishito ale shunu.

english_verse: Aaron, you must next sacrifice the goat for the sins of the people, and you must sprinkle its blood inside the most holy place, just as you did with the blood of the bull.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ e mɔ basa na be kulubi be sarga be kaboe na nseŋ suse ŋklaŋ na n luri m ba acheembiana to be kakpa cheembi na to nseŋ ba wora amo ŋ ŋmenyaŋ kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre be deka na be buuso so nɛ kumo be anishito, fanɛ kananɛ e daŋ ta gbolu na be ŋklaŋ n wora na.

english_verse: By doing this, you will take away the sins that make both the most holy place and the people of Israel unclean. Do the same for the sacred tent, which is here among the people.
translation_verse: Kananɛ e beeŋ wora nɛ acheembiana to be kakpa cheembi na e nyalɛ so ŋkpal Israɛl be basa na be eyurpisheŋ nɛ alubi nɛ b wora na so nna na. Aloŋ e daga fanɛ e wora wajɛbu na gba, ŋkpal manɛ so, k wɔ keeyi nɛ bumo be eyurpisheŋ wɔ kumo to na be nferinto nna.

english_verse: After leaving the tent, you will purify the bronze altar by smearing each of its four corners with some of the blood from the bull and from the goat.
translation_verse: e beeŋ lar m ba lara sarga chɔɔso n lɔŋɛ bɔrɛsure nɛ k yil Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be anishito na so. A daga e wora gbolu na nɛ kaboe na be ŋklaŋ na be ako ŋ gbiti bɔrɛsure na be alambɛ ana na be nnɔso so.

english_verse: Use a finger to sprinkle the altar seven times with the blood, and it will be completely clean from the sins of the people.
translation_verse: E beeŋ ta mbe keshilbi n nyɔ ŋklaŋ na to ŋ ŋmenyaŋ bɔrɛsure na so ale ashunu. Kananɛ e beeŋ wora nɛ bɔrɛsure na e nyalɛ so ashi Israɛl be basa na be alubi to nseŋ shin nɛ k ki cheembi nna na.

english_verse: After you have purified the most holy place, the sacred tent, and the bronze altar, you must bring the live goat to the front of the tent.
translation_verse: Ɛɛrɔn kaŋ wora acheembiana to be kakpa cheembi na nɛ wajɛbu na nɛ bɔrɛsure na be kenyalɛso be kesheŋ wora n loge, e beeŋ bar kaboe keniso nɛ baaŋ yige n lɛ nɛ k yɔ kiyi to na Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be anishito.

english_verse: There you will lay your hands on its head, while confessing every sin the people have committed, and you will appoint someone to lead the goat into the desert, so that it can take away their sins.
translation_verse: E beeŋ ta mbe enɔana n deŋi kaboe na be kumu so nseŋ malga kumukpakpaso nɛ kesheŋ kini be asheŋ lubi nɛ Israɛl be basa na wora kikɛ n laŋɛ amo kikɛ n deŋi kaboe na be kumu so. Kumo be kaman nɛ e shin nɛ esa ko e gberge kaboe na n yɔ kiyi to n ya lɛ nɛ k ta basa na be alubi a yɔ.

english_verse: Finally, this goat that carries the heavy burden of Israel's sins must be released deep in the desert.
translation_verse: Esa na kaŋ ya fo kiyi na to nɛ e saŋɛ kaboe na n lɛ nɛ k sulɔ bumo be alubi kikɛ n yɔ kakpa nɛ esa kikɛ maŋ wɔ.

english_verse: Aaron, after this you must go inside the sacred tent, take a bath, put on your regular priestly clothes, and leave there the clothes you put on before entering the most holy place. Then you will come out and offer sacrifices to please me and sacrifices for your sins and for the sins of the people.
translation_verse: A daga e yili kakpa cheembi na nna m bɛr nchu pɔɛŋ nseŋ ta mbe asɔbuuso gbagba m buu. Kumo be kaman nɛ e lar m ba lara sarga chɔɔso nɛ k beeŋ kpra mo nɛ basa na kikɛ be alubi na.

english_verse: The fat from these sacrifices for sin must be sent up in smoke on the bronze altar.
translation_verse: E beeŋ chɔɔ kusɔbɔya na be nfɔ bɔrɛsure na so n lara kulubi be sarga.

english_verse: The one who led the goat into the desert and sent it off to the demon Azazel must take a bath and wash his clothes before coming back into camp.
translation_verse: Esa nɛ e keta kaboe na n ya lɛ kiyi to na daga fanɛ e fɔr mbe asɔbuuso nseŋ bɛr nchu nna pɔɛŋ nseŋ bɛta m ba keeyi na to.

english_verse: The remains of the bull and the goat whose blood was taken into the most holy place must be taken outside the camp and burned.
translation_verse: Baaŋ ta gbolu nɛ kaboe nɛ b ta n lara alubi keyigempaŋ be sarga nseŋ suse amo be ŋklaŋ n luri acheembiana to be kakpa cheembi na be nwɔl nɛ eblaŋ nɛ apuntosɔ kikɛ n lar keeyi na to n ya chɔɔ.

english_verse: And whoever does this must take a bath and change clothes before coming back into camp. The Lord told Moses to say to the people:
translation_verse: Esa nɛ e beeŋ chɔɔ amo na daga fanɛ e fɔr mbe asɔbuuso nseŋ bɛr nchu pɔɛŋ nseŋ bɛta m ba keeyi na to.

english_verse: On the tenth day of the seventh month of each year, you must go without eating to show sorrow for your sins, and no one, including foreigners who live among you, is allowed to work.
translation_verse: Mbraana ere daga fanɛ a baa dese nna nɛ b baa bɛ amo so mbaanaayɔ. Kufɔl shunusopo to be kachɛ kudusopo kikɛ, Israɛlebi nɛ befɔ kama nɛ b tu bumo n chena na kikɛ daga b kishi nsaa maŋ shuŋ kushuŋ kikɛ loŋ be kachɛ na.

english_verse: This is the day on which the sacrifice for the forgiveness of your sins will be made in my presence,
translation_verse: K la kachɛ nɛ baaŋ ta n lara alubi be keyigempaŋ be sarga nseŋ nya alubi be kefɔrso n lar ashi Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kutɔ nna.

english_verse: and from now on, it must be celebrated each year. Go without eating and make this a day of complete rest just like the Sabbath.
translation_verse: Kachɛ na daga k baa la kachɛ cheembi ga nɛ baaŋ kishi nsaa maŋ shuŋ shɛŋ nna. Mbraana ere wɔtɔ nna nɛ b baa bɛ amo so hale mbaanaayɔ.

english_verse: He will offer these sacrifices for the most holy place, the sacred tent, the bronze altar, all the priests, and for the whole community.
translation_verse: nseŋ ya lara sarga nɛ k beeŋ shin nɛ acheembiana to be kakpa cheembi na nɛ wajɛbu na nɛ bɔrɛsure na nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana na nɛ kade na to ebi kikɛ e nyalɛ so.

english_verse: You must celebrate this day each year—it is the Great Day of Forgiveness for all the sins of the people of Israel. Moses did exactly as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Mbraana ere wɔtɔ nna mbaanaayɔ nɛ b baa bɛ amo so jemanɛ kikɛ. Alubi be keyigempaŋ be sarga ere daga kelara kela koŋwule kafɛ kikɛ nna nɛ Israɛlebi na e baa nya bumo be alubi be ketampaŋ.” Ndoŋ nna nɛ Mosis wora kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ mo na kikɛ.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ Mosis le:

english_verse: to tell Aaron, his sons, and everyone else in Israel:
translation_verse: “Kaŋɛ Ɛɛrɔn nɛ mbe mbinyɛnsobi nɛ Israɛlebi na kikɛ kusɔ nɛ mee sha fanɛ b baa wora.

english_verse: Whenever you kill any of your cattle, sheep, or goats as sacrifices to me, you must do it at the entrance to the sacred tent. If you don't, you will be guilty of pouring out blood, and you will no longer belong to the community of Israel.
translation_verse: Israɛl be esa kama nɛ e mɔ kena ŋko kubolpɔ ŋko kaboe n lara sarga n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ashi kaplɛkama nɛ k maŋ la wajɛbu na be kabuna ase, kumo ere amodoŋwura wora n de mbra na so nna na. E shin nɛ ŋklaŋ wurge nna nseŋ daga b lara mo Ebɔrɛ be basa to.

english_verse: but in front of the sacred tent. Then a priest can splatter its blood against the bronze altar and send its fat up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Bɔrɛmatapo na beeŋ suse ŋklaŋ na ŋ ŋmenyaŋ bɔrɛsure nɛ k wɔ wajɛbu cheembi na be kabuna to na so nseŋ chɔɔ nfɔ nɛ amo be efɛa bee par Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.

english_verse: Remember! No one in Israel, including foreigners, is to offer a sacrifice anywhere
translation_verse: Men baa nyiŋi fanɛ Israɛl be esa kikɛ ŋko efɔ kama nɛ e chena bumo to nseŋ lara sarga chɔɔso ŋko sarga be yiri kikɛ

english_verse: except at the entrance to the sacred tent. If you do, you will no longer belong to my people. Do Not Eat Blood The Lord said:
translation_verse: n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ashi kaplɛkama nsaa maŋ bar kumo wajɛbu na be kabuna to, daga fanɛ b lara mo Ebɔrɛ be basa to.

english_verse: I will turn against any of my people who eat blood. This also includes any foreigners living among you.
translation_verse: Israɛl be esa kikɛ ŋko bumo to be efɔ kikɛ baŋ ji eblaŋ nɛ ŋklaŋ kraa wɔ kumo to, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ pal kaman n sa amodoŋwura nseŋ lara mo ashi mbe basa to.

english_verse: Even if you should hunt and kill a bird or an animal, you must drain out the blood and cover it with soil.
translation_verse: Nɛ Israɛl be esa kikɛ ŋko efɔ kama nɛ e chena bumo to ya ji kekpaŋ m mɔ kusɔbɔya ŋko kabuibi nɛ k daga keji, amodoŋwura e ku kumo be kubɔto n chulgi kumo be ŋklaŋ n wurge kasawule nseŋ wora eshishɛr m buu amo so.

english_verse: The life of every living creature is in its blood. That's why I have forbidden you to eat blood and why I have warned you that anyone who does will no longer belong to my people.
translation_verse: Kusɔ keniso kikɛ be ŋkpa wɔ kumo be ŋklaŋ to nna, amoso nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ Israɛl be basa na fanɛ b sa maŋ kaŋ ji eblaŋ nɛ ŋklaŋ kraa wɔ kumo to na. Esa kama malɛ nɛ e ji loŋ be eblaŋ maŋ naŋ ti mbe basa so.

english_verse: If you happen to find a dead animal and eat it, you must take a bath and wash your clothes, but you are still unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Israɛl be esa kikɛ ŋko efɔ kama nɛ e we kusɔbɔya nɛ e wu kpi ŋko kusɔbɔya nɛ kupuŋ to be kusɔ pɛ, daga fanɛ e fɔr mbe asɔbuuso nseŋ bɛr nchu, ama e kraa beeŋ baa wɔ eyurpi to n ya fo kaaseso.

english_verse: If you don't take a bath, you will suffer for what you did wrong.
translation_verse: E kaŋ kini kefɔr mbe asɔbuuso nseŋ bɛr nchu e beeŋ nya kumo be kasogberge.”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ Mosis fanɛ

english_verse: to tell the people of Israel: I am the Lord your God!
translation_verse: e kaŋɛ Israɛl be basa le: “Ma e la Enyɛnpe, men be Ebɔrɛ na.

english_verse: So don't follow the customs of Egypt where you used to live or those of Canaan where I am bringing you.
translation_verse: Men sa maa wora asheŋ nɛ Ijipt nɛ men daa wɔ jemanɛ ko na be basa bee wora na ŋko kananɛ basa nɛ b wɔ Keenan be efuli nɛ ŋ kɔ menyi a yɔ kumo so na be basa bee wora na.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and you must obey my teachings.
translation_verse: Men baa nu nsaa wora a bɛ ma mbraana so. Ma e la Enyɛnpe, men be Ebɔrɛ na.

english_verse: And don't disgrace him by having sex with any of his other wives.
translation_verse: A maŋ daga fo tu fo tuto be eche kama n di keche nɛ kenyɛn m bar ŋaba mo so.

english_verse: And don't have sex with the daughter or granddaughter of any woman that you have earlier had sex with. You will be having sex with her closest relatives, and that would make you unclean.
translation_verse: Sa maŋ kaŋ di eche nɛ mo pibiche ŋko mo nanabi cheso n wea abarto kikɛ, ŋkpal manɛ so, b la mo kekurge koŋwule to ebi gbagba nna. Kumo be loŋ la mbushu nna.

english_verse: As long as your wife is alive, don't cause trouble for her by taking one of her sisters as a second wife.
translation_verse: Sa maŋ kaŋ ta fo eche mo sipo ŋ ki fo eche nɛ mo nɛ mo da e ki kechamana jemanɛ nɛ fo eche kraa wɔ ŋkpa to.

english_verse: When a woman is having her monthly period, she is unclean, so don't have sex with her.
translation_verse: Sa maŋ kaŋ di eche jemanɛ nɛ e bee lar ntamaŋ, ŋkpal manɛ so, e wɔ eyurpi to nna na.

english_verse: Don't have sex with another man's wife—that would make you unclean.
translation_verse: Sa maŋ kaŋ di fo barkasa be eche, k beeŋ shin nɛ fo wora eyurpi.

english_verse: Don't sacrifice your children on the altar fires to the god Molech. I am the Lord your God, and that would disgrace me.
translation_verse: Sa maŋ kaŋ ta fo pibi kama n sa nɛ b lara sarga n sa kegbir nɛ baa tre Mɔlɛk na, ŋkpal manɛ so, k beeŋ ŋaba men Nyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be ketre.

english_verse: It is disgusting for a man to have sex with another man.
translation_verse: Sa maŋ kaŋ di fo barkasa enyɛn keche nɛ kenyɛn kikɛ. K la ekishi nna n sa Ebɔrɛ.

english_verse: Don't make yourselves unclean by any of these disgusting practices of those nations that I am forcing out of the land for you. They made themselves
translation_verse: Sa maŋ kaŋ wora ekishisheŋ ere be kekama nseŋ wora eyurpi, ŋkpal manɛ so, kusɔ nɛ k ba nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee shin nɛ e ju efuliana na so be basa n lɛ nseŋ ta menyi n chena ndoŋ nna na. B wora loŋ be eyurpisheŋ nna ashi Ebɔrɛ kutɔ.

english_verse: and the land so unclean, that I punished the land because of their sins, and I made it vomit them up.
translation_verse: Bumo be asheŋ woraso e shin nɛ bumo be kasawule wora eyurpi nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee gberge bumo kusoe nɛ k wora fanɛ kasawule na ka kini bumo na.

english_verse: Then the land won't become sick of you and vomit you up, just as it did them.
translation_verse: nɛ kasawule na e sa maŋ kini menyi fanɛ kananɛ k kini nnyamase nɛ b daa wɔ kumo so na.

english_verse: If any of you do these vulgar, disgusting things, you will be unclean and no longer belong to my people. I am the Lord your God, and I forbid you to follow their sickening way of life.
translation_verse: Ade kikɛ be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ: “Men wora asɔ nɛ n yili n sa menyi ere kasonu nsaa maŋ wora mbushusheŋ nɛ basa nɛ b daa wɔ kasawule na so na wora na. Men sa maŋ kaŋ wora amo nseŋ luri eyurpi to. Ma e la Enyɛnpe, men be Ebɔrɛ na.”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ Mosis fanɛ

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: I am the Lord your God. I am holy, and you must be holy too!
translation_verse: e kaŋɛ Israɛlebi na le: “Men baa du cheembi, ŋkpal manɛ so, ma Enyɛnpe, men be Ebɔrɛ na du cheembi nna.

english_verse: Respect your father and your mother, honor the Sabbath, and don't make idols or images. I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Men sa maŋ kaŋ kplaŋ ma so n ya shuŋ agbir. Men sa maŋ ta abɛlso ŋko kusɔ kama n wora kapɔrduli be yiri kikɛ ŋ ki agbir a shuŋ kumo. Ma e la Enyɛnpe, men be Ebɔrɛ na.

english_verse: When you offer a sacrifice to ask my blessing, be sure to follow my instructions.
translation_verse: Nɛ men baŋ mɔ kusɔbɔya nɛ men lara kɔnɔkoŋwule be sarga, men bɛ mbraana nɛ n yili n sa menyi na so nɛ n sɔ menyi be sarga na.

english_verse: You may eat the meat either on the day of the sacrifice or on the next day, but you must burn anything left over on the third day.
translation_verse: Kachɛ nɛ men mɔ kusɔbɔya na ŋko kumo be ŋklade, e daga fanɛ men we eblaŋ na. Eblaŋ kama nɛ a beeŋ ka kachɛ sasopo na daga kechɔɔ nna,

english_verse: If you eat any of it on the third day, the sacrifice will be disgusting to me, and I will reject it.
translation_verse: ŋkpal manɛ so, a maaŋ naa walɛ so daŋkare be ekpa so. Nɛ esa kama ji amo, m maaŋ naŋ sɔ sarga na.

english_verse: In fact, you will be punished for not respecting what I say is holy, and you will no longer belong to the community of Israel.
translation_verse: Esa kama nɛ e ji amo wora n de so nna na, ŋkpal manɛ so, e ka maŋ ta bunyaŋ n sa kusɔ nɛ k du cheembi, mo alɛ maaŋ naŋ ti ma basa so.

english_verse: When you harvest your grain, always leave some of it standing along the edges of your fields and don't pick up what falls on the ground.
translation_verse: Nɛ menyee teŋi menyi be adɔjibi, men sa maŋ kaa teŋi ekarso peya na ŋko m bɛta n ya shishi amo nɛ a beeŋ ka ndɔ na to na.

english_verse: Don't strip your grapevines clean or gather the grapes that fall off the vines. Leave them for the poor and for those foreigners who live among you. I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Men sa maŋ bɛta n yɔ menyi be asɔrso be adɔ to n naŋ ya chuge asɔrso nɛ men maŋ wu n chuge ŋko n ya tise amo nɛ amo gbagba tɔr to na. Men yige amo n sa betirpo nɛ befɔ. Ma e la Enyɛnpe, men be Ebɔrɛ na.

english_verse: Do not steal or tell lies or cheat others.
translation_verse: Sa maŋ kaŋ yuri ŋko m puni ŋko ŋ ku efɛ.

english_verse: Do not misuse my name by making promises you don't intend to keep. I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Sa maŋ kaŋ ta ma ketre n nase kɔnɔ nɛ fo maŋ kre ketia, saŋɛ na so, fo maaŋ ŋaba ma ketre. Ma e la Enyɛnpe, men be Ebɔrɛ na.

english_verse: Do not steal anything or cheat anyone, and don't fail to pay your workers at the end of each day.
translation_verse: Sa maŋ kaŋ ji fo barkasa durmu ŋko n suge mo. Sa maŋ kaŋ mɔn esa nɛ fo ber paa mbe kakɔka, sa maŋ shin nɛ kare a chɛ kumo so gba.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and I command you not to make fun of the deaf or to cause a blind person to stumble.
translation_verse: Sa maŋ kaŋ shoduu kpawu ŋko n ta kusɔ ko n yili tanpo be ekpa to nɛ e ber kumo to. Men baa wora ma kasonu. Ma e la Enyɛnpe, men be Ebɔrɛ na.

english_verse: Be fair, no matter who is on trial—don't favor either the poor or the rich.
translation_verse: Men baa kɔ kashenteŋji nsaa ji asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so ashi men be demuji kikɛ to. Men sa maa kpɛa betirpo to ŋko a ŋana damawuraana.

english_verse: Don't be angry or try to take revenge. I am the Lord, and I command you to love others as much as you love yourself.
translation_verse: Sa maŋ kaŋ wora n tal esa kikɛ to ŋkpal kulubi so ŋko n nya yurkishi fo kagbene to n sa esa, ama baa sha fo barkasa fanɛ fo kumu. Ma e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.

english_verse: Breed your livestock animals only with animals of the same kind, and don't plant two kinds of seed in the same field or wear clothes made of different kinds of material.
translation_verse: Men baa wora ma mbraana kasonu. Men sa maŋ shin nɛ asɔbɔya pɔtɛ a baa dii asɔbɔya pɔtɛ a kurge. Men sa maa duu asɔduuso pɔtɛ a wea abar to kasawule koŋwule so. Men sa maa buu asɔbuuso nɛ b ta achɛbi pɔtɛana n wea abar to m ba.

english_verse: If a man has sex with a slave woman who is promised in marriage to someone else, he must pay a fine, but they are not to be put to death. After all, she was still a slave at the time.
translation_verse: Nɛ enyɛn di kenyache nɛ enyɛn ko bee sha keta mo ŋ kii mbe eche, ama b maŋ naŋ ka n lara kenyache na ashi kenyaya to, a daga kenyache na nɛ enyɛn nɛ e di mo na ka nya kasogberge. Ama b maŋ daga luwu ŋkpal eche na ka kraa la kenya so.

english_verse: The man must bring a ram to the entrance of the sacred tent and give it to a priest, who will then offer it as a sacrifice to me, so the man's sins will be forgiven.
translation_verse: Bɔrɛmatapo na beeŋ ta kpakpa na n wora kenyalɛso be kewora n lara enyɛn na be kulubi na nɛ Ebɔrɛ e ta mbe alubi m paŋ mo.

english_verse: After you enter the land, you will plant fruit trees, but you are not to eat any fruit from them for the first three years.
translation_verse: Men kaŋ luri Keenan be kasawule so nseŋ duu ndibi nɛ a bee sɔr, nfɛ asa nɛ a juŋkpar na to be asɔrso na maŋ walɛ so. Men sa maŋ kaŋ ji amo.

english_verse: In the fourth year the fruit must be set apart, as an expression of thanks
translation_verse: Men ta kafɛ nasopo na to be asɔrso na kikɛ n lara sarga nɛ a baa la men be kapandi n sa ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.

english_verse: to me, the Lord God. Do this, and in the fifth year, those trees will produce an abundant harvest of fruit for you to eat.
translation_verse: Ama menyeeŋ tiŋ n ji kafɛ nusopo na to be asɔrso na. Nɛ men wora ade kikɛ bre, men be ndibi sɔrso beeŋ baa sɔr nɛnɛ ga. Ma e la Enyɛnpe, men be Ebɔrɛ na.

english_verse: Don't eat the blood of any animal. Don't practice any kind of witchcraft.
translation_verse: Men sa maŋ kaŋ ji eblaŋ nɛ ŋklaŋ kraa wɔ kumo to. Men sa maŋ kaa kpal ŋko a wora kegbaya be asheŋ kikɛ.

english_verse: I forbid you to shave any part of your head or beard or to cut and tattoo yourself as a way of worshiping the dead.
translation_verse: Men sa maa wora ndulgi men be eyur so ŋko a ku nchule men be eyur so ŋkpal bubuni so. Ma e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.

english_verse: I command you to respect the Sabbath and the place where I am worshiped.
translation_verse: Men baa ta Kewushiachɛ na fanɛ kachɛ cheembi nsaa sa kakpa nɛ baa shuŋ ma na bunyaŋ. Ma e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ.

english_verse: I command you to show respect for older people and to obey me with fear and trembling.
translation_verse: Men baa sa basakpar bunyaŋ nsaa maŋkura bumo. Men baa nu a sa ma bunyanso, ŋkpal manɛ so, ma e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.

english_verse: Don't mistreat any foreigners who live in your land.
translation_verse: Men sa maa mɛaŋ befɔ nɛ b chena men be kasawule so na.

english_verse: Instead, treat them as well as you treat your own people and love them as much as you love yourself. Remember, you were once foreigners in the land of Egypt. I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Men baa keta bumo fanɛ men braana Israɛl be basa nsaa sha bumo fanɛ men gbagba be amu. Men baa nyiŋi fanɛ menyi alɛ gba daa la befɔ nna ashi Ijipt be efuli so. Ma e la Enyɛnpe, men be Ebɔrɛ na.

english_verse: Use honest scales and don't cheat when you weigh or measure anything. I am the Lord your God. I rescued you from Egypt,
translation_verse: Men baa ta asɔ karga asɔ nɛ a daga a karga asɔ a sa basa. Ma e la Enyɛnpe, men be Ebɔrɛ na. Ma alɛ e lara menyi Ijipt be efuli so m ba.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ naŋ kaŋɛ Mosis

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: Death by stoning is the penalty for any citizens or foreigners in the country who sacrifice their children to the god Molech.
translation_verse: fanɛ e kaŋɛ Israɛlebi na le: “Israɛl be esa kama ŋko efɔ kama nɛ e wɔ Israɛl be efuli so nseŋ ta mbe kebia n lara sarga n sa kegbir Mɔlɛk, daga fanɛ kade na to ebi kikɛ ka kpa mo ajembu m mɔ.

english_verse: They have disgraced both the place where I am worshiped and my holy name, and so I will turn against them and no longer let them belong to my people.
translation_verse: Esa kikɛ nɛ e ta mbe kebia n sa kegbir Mɔlɛk na jija ma nshɛrbu nseŋ ŋaba ma ketre cheembi na nna na. Ŋkpal loŋ so, meeŋ pal kaman n sa amodoŋwura nɛ e maaŋ naa la ma basa Israɛl ebi to be eko.

english_verse: Some of you may let them get away with human sacrifice,
translation_verse: Ama nɛ kade na to ebi kplaŋ kusɔ nɛ e wora na so nsaa maŋ mɔ mo,

english_verse: but not me. If any of you worship Molech, I will turn against you and your entire family, and I will no longer let you belong to my people.
translation_verse: meeŋ pal kaman n sa esa na nɛ mbe kanaŋ kikɛ nɛ bekama nɛ b ti mo so a maŋ ji kashenteŋ n sa ma nseŋ ya kaa shuŋ kegbir Mɔlɛk na. B maaŋ naa ti ma basa so.

english_verse: I will be your enemy if you go to someone who claims to speak with the dead, and I will destroy you from among my people.
translation_verse: Esa kama nɛ e beeŋ yɔ ekpalpo kutɔ n ya bishi so, meeŋ pal kaman n sa mo nɛ e maaŋ naa ti ma basa so.

english_verse: Dedicate yourselves to me and be holy because I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Men lara menyi be amu n yili a du cheembi n sa ma, ŋkpal manɛ so, ma e la Enyɛnpe, men be Ebɔrɛ na.

english_verse: I have chosen you as my people, and I expect you to obey my laws.
translation_verse: Men baa wora ma mbraana kasonu nsaa bɛ amo so, ŋkpal manɛ so, ma e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na. Ma alɛ bee sha fanɛ men baa du cheembi nna.”

english_verse: If any of you men have sex with another man's wife, both you and the woman will be put to death.
translation_verse: Nɛ enyɛn di mo barkasa be eche, mo nɛ eche na kikɛ ji kubojua nna na nseŋ daga luwu.

english_verse: Having sex with one of your father's wives disgraces him. So both you and the woman will be put to death, just as you deserve.
translation_verse: Nɛ enyɛn di mo tuto be eche, e ŋaba mo tuto nna na nɛ a daga fanɛ b mɔ mo nɛ eche na kikɛ. Bumo alɛ be luwu be turju beeŋ baa bɛ bumo.

english_verse: It isn't natural to have sex with your daughter-in-law, and both of you will be put to death, just as you deserve.
translation_verse: Nɛ enyɛn di mo pibinyɛn be eche, a daga fanɛ b mɔ bumo benyɔ na kikɛ. Kusɔ nɛ b wora na la ekishi nna nɛ bumo alɛ be luwu be turju beeŋ baa bɛ bumo.

english_verse: It's disgusting for men to have sex with one another, and those who do will be put to death, just as they deserve.
translation_verse: Nɛ enyɛn di mo barkasa enyɛn keche nɛ kenyɛn, kusɔ nɛ b wora na la mbushu nna na. A daga fanɛ b mɔ bumo. Bumo alɛ be luwu be turju beeŋ baa bɛ bumo nna.

english_verse: It isn't natural for a man to marry both a woman and her daughter, and so all three of them will be burned to death.
translation_verse: Nɛ enyɛn ta eche nɛ mo nio kikɛ a kil, k la nyɔmɔ be kesheŋ nna. A daga fanɛ b ka chɔɔ bumo basa asa na kikɛ m mɔ, saŋɛ na so le be nyɔmɔ be kesheŋ ere maaŋ naŋ wora menyi to kikɛ.

english_verse: If any of you have sex with an animal, both you and the animal will be put to death, just as you deserve.
translation_verse: Nɛ eche ya tu kusɔbɔya n di keche nɛ kenyɛn, a daga fanɛ b mɔ eche na nɛ kusɔbɔya na kikɛ. Eche na malɛ be luwu be turju beeŋ baa bɛ mo.

english_verse: If you marry one of your sisters, you will be punished, and the two of you will be disgraced by being openly forced out of the community.
translation_verse: Nɛ enyɛn ta mo nio pibiche ŋko mo tuto pibiche a kil nɛ mo nɛ mo di, k la ŋaba nna. A daga fanɛ b yili ekama be anishito n ju bumo n lɛ. Enyɛn na ŋaba mo sipoche na nna na nseŋ daga fanɛ e ji kumo be tɔrɔ.

english_verse: If you have sex with a woman during her monthly period, both you and the woman will be cut off from the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Nɛ enyɛn di eche jemanɛ nɛ eche na bee lar ntamaŋ, a daga fanɛ b ju bumo benyɔ na kikɛ n lar kade na to, ŋkpal manɛ so, b wora n da kebaawalɛ so ashi Ebɔrɛ be anishi be mbra so nna na.

english_verse: The sisters of your father and mother are your own relatives, and you will be punished for having sex with any of them.
translation_verse: Nɛ enyɛn di mo tana ŋko mo niokar ŋko mo niogboŋ, k la ŋaba n sa kanaŋ na nna nɛ a daga fanɛ bumo benyɔ na kikɛ ka nya kusɔ nɛ b wora na be kasogberge.

english_verse: If you have sex with your uncle's wife, neither you nor she will ever have any children.
translation_verse: Nɛ enyɛn di mo tutokar be eche, e ŋaba mo tutokar na nna na nɛ mo nɛ eche na kikɛ daga kumo be kasogberge. Bumo be ekama beeŋ wu nɛ b maaŋ nya ebi.

english_verse: If you claim to receive messages from the dead, you will be put to death by stoning, just as you deserve.
translation_verse: Esa kama nɛ e yɛ mo ere bee tiŋ a malga bubuni kutɔ a kpal nna, e daga fanɛ b kpa mo ajembu m mɔ nɛ mbe luwu be turju a baa bɛ mo.”

english_verse: The Lord gave Moses these instructions for Aaron's sons, the priests: Touching a dead body will make you unclean. So don't go near a dead relative,
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ Mosis fanɛ e kaŋɛ Ɛɛrɔn be mbinyɛnsobi nɛ b la bɔrɛmatapoana na le: “Bɔrɛmatapo kikɛ e sa maŋ kpal ekurgepo ko be keeliwora so a ta mbe kumu a wɔtɔ eyurpisheŋ to,

english_verse: Don't make yourself unclean by attending the funeral of someone related to you by marriage.
translation_verse: A maŋ daga e ka yɔ esa nɛ mo nɛ mo bee ji kekurge ŋkpal kakil so be keelibuna n ya wora eyurpi nsaa maŋ naa walɛ so.

english_verse: Don't shave any part of your head or trim your beard or cut yourself to show that you are mourning.
translation_verse: Bɔrɛmatapo maŋ daga fanɛ e she mbe kumu ŋko n digi mbe katɔl so ŋko ŋ ku mbe eyur be kaplɛkama a ŋini fanɛ e bee shu keeli nna.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and I have chosen you alone to offer sacrifices of food to me on the altar. That's why you must keep yourselves holy.
translation_verse: A daga fanɛ e baa du cheembi nna nsaa maa ŋaba ma ketre. Ŋkpal e ka la esa nɛ e bee ta ayu be sargajibi m ba kaa sa ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na so, a daga fanɛ e baa du cheembi.

english_verse: Don't marry a divorced woman or a woman who has served as a temple prostitute. You are holy,
translation_verse: A maŋ daga bɔrɛmatapo ka ta eche nɛ e ji kesakalea ŋ ku so ŋko eche nɛ e teŋ pin enyɛn ŋko eche nɛ mo kul kini mo, ŋkpal manɛ so, e la esa cheembi nna.

english_verse: because I am holy. And so, you must be treated with proper respect, since you offer food sacrifices to me, the God of holiness.
translation_verse: A daga basa na ka wu bɔrɛmatapo na fanɛ esa cheembi, ŋkpal e kaa bee ta ayu be sargajibi m ba kaa sa ma so. Ma e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na. N du cheembi nna, ma alɛ bee sha fanɛ ma basa e baa du cheembi nna.

english_verse: If any of you priests has a daughter who disgraces you by serving as a temple prostitute, she must be burned to death.
translation_verse: Nɛ bɔrɛmatapo pibiche jija mbe kumu ŋkpal e ka ki sakaleche so, e ŋaba mo tuto nna na nɛ a daga fanɛ b chɔɔ mo m mɔ.

english_verse: If you are the high priest, you must marry only a virgin
translation_verse: Bɔrɛmatapo Nimuso daga fanɛ e ta eche nɛ e maŋ nyi enyɛn nna,

english_verse: from your own tribe. Don't marry a divorced woman or any other woman who has already had sex, including a temple prostitute.
translation_verse: mannɛ ekulpoche ŋko eche nɛ mo kul kini mo ŋko eche nɛ e daŋ ji kesakalea ŋ ku so. Eche nɛ e maŋ nyi enyɛn nseŋ shi mbe kanaŋ to a daga fanɛ e ta a kil.

english_verse: In this way, your descendants will be qualified to serve me. Remember—I am the Lord, and I have chosen you.
translation_verse: Nɛ mannɛ aloŋ, mbe mbia nɛ b daga fanɛ b baa du cheembi na, maaŋ baa la basa cheembi nseŋ tiŋ n shuŋ ma. Ma e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na. Ma alɛ e lara mo n yili fanɛ Bɔrɛmatapo Nimuso.”

english_verse: Moses told all of this to Aaron, his sons, and the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Kusɔ nɛ Mosis daŋ kaŋɛ Ɛɛrɔn nɛ mbe mbinyɛnsobi nɛ Israɛl be basa kikɛ nna na.

english_verse: to say to Aaron and his sons: I am the Lord God, and I demand that you honor my holy name by showing proper respect for the offerings brought to me by the people of Israel.
translation_verse: fanɛ e kaŋɛ Ɛɛrɔn nɛ mbe mbinyɛnsobi le: “Men baa ta bunyaŋ a sa esarga cheembi nɛ Israɛl be basa bee lara a sa ma na nsaa maa ŋaba ma ketre cheembi na. Ŋkpal manɛ so, ma e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.

english_verse: None of you may take part in the sacred meals while you have a skin disease or an infected penis, or after you have been near a dead body or have had a flow of semen,
translation_verse: Ɛɛrɔn be kaman be esa kama nɛ e kɔ achuu nɛ e bee lar nchu ŋko nɛ nchu bee lar mbe kenyɛnsɔ to maŋ daga keji esarga cheembi na, ama e nyalɛ so daŋkare be ekpa so nna pɔɛŋ. Bɔrɛmatapo kama nɛ e beta kusɔ kama nɛ k maŋ walɛ so ŋko n luri ebuni so ŋko mbe kenyɛnsɔ bee lar nchu

english_verse: or if you have touched an unclean creature of any sort, including an unclean person.
translation_verse: ŋko m beta kusɔbɔya ŋko dimɛdi nɛ e maŋ walɛ so, wora eyurpi nna na.

english_verse: Once you are unclean, you must take a bath, but you still cannot eat any of the sacred food until evening.
translation_verse: Epeŋi baŋ tɔr na pɔɛŋ nɛ e beeŋ nyalɛ so nseŋ tiŋ n ji esarga cheembi na, ŋkpal manɛ so, a la mbe ajibi jiso nna.

english_verse: I command you not to eat anything that is killed by a wild animal or dies a natural death. This would make you unclean.
translation_verse: Bɔrɛmatapo maŋ daga fanɛ e ji kusɔbɔya nɛ k wu kpi ŋko kusɔbɔya nɛ kupuŋ to be kusɔ pɛ. Ŋkpal manɛ so k beeŋ shin nɛ e wora eyurpi. Ma e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.

english_verse: Obey me, or you will die on duty for disgracing the place of worship. Remember—I am the Lord, the one who makes a priest holy.
translation_verse: Bɔrɛmatapoana kikɛ daga b bɛ mbraana nɛ n nase na kikɛ so, saŋɛ na so b maaŋ tɔr ntaŋ nseŋ wu ŋkpal b ka maŋ wora amo kasonu so. Ma e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nɛ mee sha fanɛ ma bɔrɛmatapoana e baa du cheembi.

english_verse: Only you priests and your families may eat the food offerings; these are too sacred for any of your servants.
translation_verse: Bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ bumo be nnaŋ to be basa nawule e naŋ tiŋ n ji esarga cheembi na. Bɔrɛmatapo be efɔ ŋko mbe eshumpo nɛ e ber paa gba maaŋ tiŋ n ji amo.

english_verse: However, any slave that you own, including those born into your household, may eat this food.
translation_verse: Ama bɔrɛmatapo be kenya nɛ e ta mbe amansherbi n tɔ ŋko kenya nɛ b kurge mbe laŋ to bre beeŋ tiŋ n ji amo.

english_verse: If your daughter marries someone who isn't a priest, she can no longer have any of this food.
translation_verse: Bɔrɛmatapo pibiche nɛ e bee kil enyɛn nɛ e maŋ la bɔrɛmatapo, maaŋ tiŋ n ji esarga cheembi na.

english_verse: But if she returns to your home, either widowed or divorced, and has no children, she may join in the meal. Only members of a priestly family can eat this food,
translation_verse: Ama mo pibiche nɛ e la ekulpoche ŋko emo nɛ mo kul kini nɛ e maŋ kɔ mbia nseŋ bɛta m ba mo tuto be laŋ to nɛ mo tuto bee bela mo, bre beeŋ tiŋ n ji mo tuto be ajibi nɛ a la bɔrɛmatapo be kachige na.

english_verse: must have nothing wrong with them, or else I won't accept them. Bulls or rams or goats are the animals to be used for these sacrifices.
translation_verse: Nɛ men bar kusɔbɔya nɛ e kɔ ndulgi, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na maaŋ sɔ kumo.

english_verse: I warn you not to treat lightly the offerings that are brought by the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Bɔrɛmatapoana na maŋ daga fanɛ b keni esarga cheembi nɛ Israɛl be basa na lara n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na jiga

english_verse: Don't let them become guilty of eating this sacred food. Remember—I am the Lord, the one who makes these offerings holy. Acceptable Sacrifices
translation_verse: nseŋ shin nɛ basa nɛ b maŋ daga keji amo e ji amo. Kumo be loŋ beeŋ shin nɛ b wora n da so nseŋ nya kasogberge. Ma e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na. Ma alɛ e naa shin nɛ esarga na bee ki cheembi.”

english_verse: When you offer a sacrifice to ask my blessing, there must be nothing wrong with the animal. This is true, whether the sacrifice is part of a promise or something you do voluntarily.
translation_verse: Esa kama nɛ e bee shin nɛ e lara kɔnɔkoŋwule be sarga n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ n tia kɔnɔ ŋko n ta ŋ kɛ mo, daga fanɛ e bar kusɔbɔya nɛ k maŋ kɔ ndulgi.

english_verse: If one of your cattle or lambs has a leg that is longer or shorter than the others, you may offer it voluntarily, but not as part of a promise.
translation_verse: Menyeeŋ tiŋ n ta kena ŋko kubolpɔ nɛ kumo be aya maŋ sasa abar n lara kakɛ be sarga, ama mannɛ kɔnɔ be ketia be sarga bre.

english_verse: And don't bring me animals you bought from a foreigner. I won't accept them, because they are no better than one that has something wrong with it.
translation_verse: Men sa maŋ kaŋ sɔ efɔ be kusɔbɔya kikɛ n lara ajibi be sarga n sa men be Ebɔrɛ. M maaŋ sɔ amo, ŋkpal manɛ so, loŋ be asɔbɔya na maŋ kɔr asɔbɔya nɛ e kɔ ndulgi to.”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses to say:
translation_verse: Ade kikɛ be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ Mosis le:

english_verse: Newborn cattle, sheep, or goats must remain with their mothers for seven days, but on the eighth day, you may send them up in smoke to me, and I will accept the offering.
translation_verse: “Nɛ kena ŋko kubolpɔ ŋko kaboe kurge, a daga fanɛ k ka ji nchɛ ashunu mo nio kutɔ pɔɛŋ nɛ b chuge kumo enio na so. Yili kachɛ burwasopo na a yɔ, baaŋ tiŋ n ta amo be kekama n lara sarga chɔɔso n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nɛ e sɔ.

english_verse: Don't sacrifice a newborn animal and its mother on the same day.
translation_verse: Men sa maŋ ta kena nɛ kumo pibi ŋko kubolpɔ nɛ kumo pibi ŋko kaboe nɛ kumo pibi kikɛ n lara sarga kachɛ koŋwule.

english_verse: When you offer a sacrifice to give thanks to me, you must do it in a way that is acceptable.
translation_verse: Nɛ menyee lara kapandi be sarga a sa ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na, men lara kumo ekpa nɛ k beeŋ shin nɛ n sɔ kumo so.

english_verse: Eat all of the meat that same day and don't save any for the next day. I am the Lord your God!
translation_verse: A daga men we kumo be eblaŋ kachɛ koŋwule nsaa maŋ shin nɛ k yili ŋklade.”

english_verse: I demand respect from the people of Israel, so don't disgrace my holy name. Remember—I am the one who chose you to be priests and rescued all of you from Egypt, so that I would be your Lord.
translation_verse: Ma e lara menyi ashi Ijipt be efuli so m baa ki menyi be Ebɔrɛ. Ma e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.”

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: I have chosen certain times for you to come together and worship me.
translation_verse: e kaŋɛ Israɛl be basa na le: “Nchɛgboŋ nɛ menyeeŋ baa shɛr a bunyaŋ ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nde:

english_verse: You have six days when you can do your work, but the seventh day of each week is holy because it belongs to me. No matter where you live, you must rest on the Sabbath and come together for worship. This law will never change. Passover and the Festival of Thin Bread (Numbers
translation_verse: Nchɛnshe nɛ menyeeŋ ta n shuŋ menyi be ashuŋ, ama men baa nyiŋi fanɛ kachɛ shunusopo na bre la Kewushiachɛ nna. Loŋ be kachɛ nɛ menyeeŋ ta n shɛr abar so m bunyaŋ ma Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na. Kaplɛkama nɛ men wɔ, Kewushiachɛ na la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be kachɛ nna.

english_verse: No one is to work on that day—it is the Great Day of Forgiveness, when sacrifices will be offered to me, so that I will forgive your sins.
translation_verse: Men sa maŋ kaŋ shuŋ shɛŋ loŋ be kachɛ na, ŋkpal manɛ so, k la kachɛ nɛ baa nyiŋi Alubi be Ketampaŋ be daŋkare na nna. Loŋ be kachɛ nɛ baa yili menyi be katelamu to a kule Enyɛnpe men be Ebɔrɛ na alubi be ketampaŋ a sa menyi.

english_verse: to say to the people of Israel: The first day of the seventh month must be a day of complete rest. Then at the sound of the trumpets, you will come together to worship and to offer sacrifices on the altar. The Great Day of Forgiveness (Numbers
translation_verse: Men sa maŋ kaŋ shuŋ menyi be karechɛ kikɛ be ashuŋ nɛ menyee kaa shuŋ na be kekama loŋ be kachɛ na, ama kelara sarga n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nawule. Alubi be ketampaŋ be kasheŋwora be asheŋ (Nɔmbɛs

english_verse: Passover is another time when you must come together to worship me, and it must be celebrated on the evening of the fourteenth day of the first month of each year.
translation_verse: Kebansonchoŋ be kachɛ na la kachɛ nɛ menyeeŋ shɛr nna m bunyaŋ ma. K bee fara kufɔl juŋkparso na be kachɛ kudu ana na be kaaseso yululu nna.

english_verse: Each day of this festival you must offer sacrifices. Then on the final day you must once again rest from your work and come together for worship. Offering the First Part of the Harvest
translation_verse: Nchɛnshunu na malɛ be kachɛ kikɛ menyeeŋ lara ajibi be sarga n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nseŋ shɛr kachɛ shunusopo na m bunyaŋ mo nsaa maŋ shuŋ kushuŋ kikɛ.”

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: After you enter the land I am giving you, the first bundle of wheat from each crop must be given to me. So bring it to a priest
translation_verse: e kaŋɛ Israɛl be basa na le: “Men kaŋ luri kasawule nɛ mee sha keta n sa menyi na to nseŋ ya dɔ n teŋi, men lara asɔ nɛ menyeeŋ juŋkpar n teŋi na be kuyu pati m ba sa bɔrɛmatapo na.

english_verse: and two kilograms of your finest flour mixed with olive oil. Then he will place these on the bronze altar and send them up in smoke with a smell that pleases me. Together with these, you must bring a liter of wine as a drink offering.
translation_verse: Menyi alɛ beeŋ ta nyifu fanɛ kurwa anyɔ n wora ɔlif be ŋku m baga amo n lara ayu be sargajibi. Le be sarga ere be efɛa e naa par Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na. Menyeeŋ naŋ ta yabra belbelso fanɛ ekɔlba anyɔ n ti so n lara sarga na.

english_verse: I am your God, and I forbid you to eat any new grain or anything made from it until you have brought these offerings. This law will never change. The Harvest Festival (Numbers
translation_verse: Men sa maŋ kaŋ ji ajibi popɔr na kebumbuŋ to ŋko atɔso ŋko n ta amo n wora bodobodo n we, ama men juŋkpar m bar amo m ba lara sarga n sa Ebɔrɛ na nna pɔɛŋ. Kede la mbra nna a dese n sa menyi nɛ men be mbia ashi kaplɛkama nɛ men wɔ mbaanaayɔ. Kasɔteŋi be kachɛgboŋ be asheŋ (Nɔmbɛs

english_verse: None of my people are ever to do any work on that day—not now or in the future. And I will wipe out those who do!
translation_verse: Le be mbra ere dese nna n sa menyi be kaman to ebi kikɛ ashi kaplɛkama nɛ b wɔ.

english_verse: Seven weeks after you offer this bundle of grain, each family must bring another offering of new grain.
translation_verse: Men yili Kewushiachɛ na be ŋklade na be kachɛ nɛ men lara ayu pati be sarga n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ŋ karga ebɔkwe lelemu ashunu.

english_verse: Bring two loaves of bread to be lifted up in dedication to me. Each loaf is to be made with yeast and with two kilograms of the finest flour from the first part of your harvest.
translation_verse: Kanaŋ kikɛ beeŋ bar ebodobodo anyɔ m ba sa bɔrɛmatapo na nɛ e ta amo m ba sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na fanɛ kakɛgboŋ. A daga b ta nyifu kurwa koŋwule nna n wɔtɔ yiisi n wora bodobodo koŋwule kama nɛ a baa la asɔ nɛ b juŋkpar n teŋi na be sarga n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.

english_verse: At this same time, the entire community of Israel must bring seven lambs that are a year old, a young bull, and two rams. These animals must have nothing wrong with them, and they must be offered as a sacrifice to please me. You must also offer the proper grain and wine sacrifices with each animal.
translation_verse: Israɛlebi kikɛ daga fanɛ b ta ekpakpa nɛ a ji nfɛ koko ashunu nɛ gbolu koŋwule nɛ ekpakpa anyɔ nɛ amo be kekama maŋ kɔ ndulgi n ti ajibi na nɛ yabra belbelso na so n lara sarga chɔɔso n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na. Le be sarga ere be efɛa e naa par Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ.

english_verse: Offer a goat as a sacrifice for sin, and two rams a year old as a sacrifice to ask my blessing.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ men ta kaboenyɛn koŋwule n lara kulubi be sarga nseŋ ta ekpakpafɔlbi anyɔ nɛ a fo nfɛ koko n lara kɔnɔkoŋwule be sarga.

english_verse: The priest will lift up the rams together with the bread in dedication to me. These offerings are holy and are my gift to the priest.
translation_verse: Bɔrɛmatapo na beeŋ ba maŋ ajibi na nɛ ekpakpafɔlbi anyɔ na so ashi Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be anishito a ŋini fanɛ a la kakɛgboŋ nna n sa mo nsaa la bɔrɛmatapoana be kachige. Le be esarga du cheembi nna.

english_verse: This is a day of celebration and worship, a time of rest from your work. You and your descendants must obey this law.
translation_verse: Men sa maŋ kaŋ shuŋ kushuŋ kikɛ loŋ be kachɛ na, ama keshɛr m bunyaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nawule. Kaplɛkama nɛ men wɔ, a daga fanɛ men be kaman to ebi ka bee bɛ mbraana ere so hale mbaanaayɔ.

english_verse: When you harvest your grain, always leave some of it standing around the edges of your fields and don't pick up what falls on the ground. Leave it for the poor and for those foreigners who live among you. I am the Lord your God! The Festival of Trumpets (Numbers
translation_verse: Men baŋ teŋi men be adɔjibi, men sa maŋ kaŋ teŋi amo nɛ a yil dɔkar na. Menyi alɛ e sa maŋ naŋ bɛta n ya buri ŋko n teŋi amo; men yige amo n sa betirpo nɛ befɔ. Ma e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ men be Ebɔrɛ na.” Kafɛ popɔr be nchɛgboŋ be asheŋ (Nɔmbɛs

english_verse: The tenth day of the seventh month is the Great Day of Forgiveness. It is a solemn day of worship; everyone must go without eating to show sorrow for their sins, and sacrifices must be burned.
translation_verse: Kufɔl shunusopo na to be kachɛ kudusopo na e la kafɛ kikɛ be kebaanyiŋi Alubi be Ketampaŋ be Kachɛgboŋ be daŋkare na. Men sa maŋ kaŋ ji shɛŋ loŋ be kachɛ na. Men shɛr m bunyaŋ Ebɔrɛ nseŋ lara sargajibi n sa mo.

english_verse: This is a time of complete rest just like the Sabbath, and everyone must go without eating from the evening of the ninth to the evening of the tenth. The Festival of Shelters (Numbers
translation_verse: Yili kufɔl na be kachɛ kpanusopo na be kaaseso n ya fo kachɛ kudusopo na be kaaseso la ewushi gbagba be jemanɛ nna n sa menyi, nɛ a daga men ka wushi nsaa maŋ kaŋ ji shɛŋ loŋ be kachɛ na. Abuu to be Kachɛgboŋ be daŋkare be asheŋ (Nɔmbɛs

english_verse: Pick the best fruit from your trees and cut leafy branches to use during the time of this joyous celebration in my honor.
translation_verse: Men ta men be ndibi sɔrso be asɔrso lela nɛ abii be ayabi nɛ ndibi nɛ a kɔ afantaŋ ga be ayabi n ji eyur m maŋkura Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na kachɛ juŋkparso.

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: Beginning on the fifteenth day of the seventh month, and continuing for seven days, everyone must celebrate the Festival of Shelters in honor of me.
translation_verse: Abuu to be Kachɛgboŋ be daŋkare na bee fara kufɔl shunusopo na to be kachɛ kuduanusopo na n ji nchɛnshunu.

english_verse: No one is to do any work on the first day of the festival—it is a time when everyone must come together for worship.
translation_verse: Men shɛr kachɛ sososo na m bunyaŋ Ebɔrɛ nsaa maŋ kaŋ shuŋ menyi gbagba be ashuŋana be kekama.

english_verse: For seven days, sacrifices must be offered on the altar. The eighth day is also to be a day of complete rest, as well as a time of offering sacrifices on the altar and of coming together for worship.
translation_verse: Nchɛnshunu na kikɛ to menyeeŋ baa lara esargajibi karechɛ kikɛ. Kachɛ burwasopo na nɛ men shɛr m bunyaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nseŋ lara sargajibi n sa mo, ŋkpal manɛ so, k la kabɔrɛshuŋ be kachɛ nna nɛ a maŋ daga fanɛ men shuŋ shɛŋ.

english_verse: I have chosen these festivals as times when my people must come together for worship and when animals, grain, and wine are to be offered on the proper days.
translation_verse: (Nchɛgboŋ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na yili n sa fanɛ men ta a bunyaŋ mo nsaa lara esargajibi nɛ esarga chɔɔso nɛ ajibi weato be esarga nɛ asɔbɔya be esarga nɛ yabra belbelso be esarga nɛ a daga karechɛ kikɛ a sa mo na nna na.

english_verse: These festivals must be celebrated in addition to the Sabbaths and the times when you offer special gifts or sacrifices to keep a promise or as a voluntary offering.
translation_verse: Nchɛgboŋ ere kikɛ ti jemanɛ kikɛ be kewushiachɛana na so nna. Esarga ere gba ti jemanɛ kikɛ be ŋkɛ nɛ nnɔ naseso nɛ men tia nɛ menyi be ŋgbene to be ŋkɛ nɛ men kɔ a sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kikɛ so nna.)

english_verse: Remember to begin the Festival of Shelters on the fifteenth day of the seventh month after you have harvested your crops. Celebrate this festival for seven days in honor of me and don't do any work on the first day or on the day following the festival.
translation_verse: Jemanɛ kikɛ nɛ men dɔ n teŋi, men ji Abuu to be Kachɛgboŋ ere m bunyaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na. Menyeeŋ fara kufɔl shunusopo na be kachɛ kuduanusopo na n ji kumo nchɛnshunu. Kachɛ sososo na la kewushiachɛ nna nɛ kachɛ burwasopo na gba la kewushiachɛ.

english_verse: I command you and all of your descendants to celebrate this festival during the seventh month of each year.
translation_verse: Men ji kachɛgboŋ ere nchɛnshunu. K la mbra nna a dese n sa menyi nɛ men be kaman to ebi hale mbaanaayɔ.

english_verse: For seven days every Israelite must live in a shelter,
translation_verse: Israɛl be basa kikɛ beeŋ chena abuu to n ya fo nchɛnshunu na,

english_verse: so future generations will know that I made their ancestors live in shelters when I brought them out of Egypt. I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: saŋɛ na so menyi be kaman to ebi beeŋ pin fanɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na daŋ shin nɛ Israɛl be basa chena ewajɛbu to nna jemanɛ nɛ e juŋkpar bumo n lar Ijipt be efuli so na. Ma e la Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na.”

english_verse: It's possible to pay the owner for an animal that has been killed, but death is the penalty for murder.
translation_verse: Esa kama nɛ e mɔ kusɔbɔya beeŋ ka kusɔbɔya nna n tal kumo to, ama nɛ esa baŋ mɔ dimɛdi bre, baaŋ mɔ mo alɛ gba.

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: You must supply the purest olive oil for the lamps in the sacred tent, so they will keep burning.
translation_verse: e ta mbraana n sa Israɛl be basa na. E yɛ: “Men bar ɔlif be ŋku gbagba nɛ a walɛ nɛnɛ m ba wɔtɔ efitilatɔl nɛ a wɔ wajɛbu na to na nɛ a baa chɔɔ a fulto jemanɛ kikɛ.

english_verse: Aaron will set up the gold lampstand in the holy place of the sacred tent. Then he will light the seven lamps that must be kept burning there in my presence, every night from now on. This law will never change. The Sacred Bread The Lord said:
translation_verse: Ɛɛrɔn e naaŋ baa keni efitila nɛ a yil shuwa gbagba be efitilatɔl na so nsaa shin nɛ b baa chɔɔ amo so kanyɛso kikɛ ashi Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be anishito. Ebodobodo nɛ baa ta a lara sarga a sa Ebɔrɛ na be asheŋ

english_verse: Use your finest flour to bake twelve loaves of bread about two kilograms each,
translation_verse: Men ta nyifu fanɛ kurwa ashe n wora ebodobodo kudu anyɔ.

english_verse: then take them into the sacred tent and lay them on the gold table in two rows of six loaves.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ men ta ebodobodo na n ya nase amo egbaŋ anyɔ n deŋi shuwa be teebɔl nɛ k wɔ Ebɔrɛ be wajɛbu na to na so. Menyeeŋ nase ebodobodo ashe gbaŋ kikɛ so.

english_verse: Alongside each row put some pure incense that will be sent up by fire in place of the bread as an offering to me.
translation_verse: Men ta duwu lela n nase ebodobodo na be egbaŋ be kekama to nseŋ chɔɔ duwu na n lara sarga n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.

english_verse: Aaron must lay fresh loaves on the table each Sabbath, and priests in all generations must continue this practice as part of Israel's agreement with me.
translation_verse: Kewushiachɛ kikɛ, a daga fanɛ men baa chɛrga ebodobodo na Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be anishito ashi nshɛr be wajɛbu na to. Kushuŋ nɛ k dese n sa Israɛl be basa hale mbaanaayɔ nna na.

english_verse: This bread will always belong to Aaron and his family; it is very holy because it was offered to me, and it must be eaten in a holy place. Punishment for Cursing the Lord
translation_verse: Ebodobodo na la Ɛɛrɔn nɛ mbe kaman to ebi be kachige nna. Ŋkpal a ka la asɔ cheembi ashi esargajibi nɛ baa lara a sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na so, a daga fanɛ b baa ji amo kaboŋ cheembi nna.” Kesho Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kɔnɔ be kasogberge be asheŋ

english_verse: Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri from the tribe of Dan, had married an Egyptian, and they had a son. One day their son got into a fight with an Israelite man in camp and cursed the name of the Lord. So the young man was dragged off to Moses,
translation_verse: Kanyɛn ko nɛ mo tuto shi Ijipt e daa wɔtɔ. Mo nio nɛ baa tre Shɛlomit nɛ e la Dibri nɛ e shi Dan be yiri to na pibiche nseŋ shi Israɛl be efuli so na. Kachako nɛ kolu tɔr kanyɛn na nɛ Israɛl be esa ko so ashi keeyi to nɛ e malga ŋ gbiti Ebɔrɛ. Ndoŋ nna nɛ b pɛ mo m ba Mosis kutɔ,

english_verse: who had him guarded while everyone waited for the Lord to tell them what to do.
translation_verse: nɛ Mosis shin nɛ baa kuŋ mo a jo kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ kaŋɛ a laŋɛ kusɔ nɛ baaŋ wora mo be kaplɛa so.

english_verse: Finally, the Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ Mosis:

english_verse: This man has cursed me! Take him outside the camp and tell the witnesses to lay their hands on his head. Then command the whole community of Israel to stone him to death.
translation_verse: “Ta kanyɛn na n lar keeyi na to. Bekama nɛ b nu e kaa malga ŋ gbiti Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ ta bumo be enɔana n deŋi kanyɛn na be kumu so nseŋ ji shɛda fanɛ e wora n da so, kumo be kaman nɛ kade na kikɛ ebi e kpa mo ajembu m mɔ.

english_verse: And warn the others that everyone else who curses me will die in the same way, whether they are Israelites by birth or foreigners living among you.
translation_verse: Israɛl be esa kikɛ ŋko efɔ kama nɛ e wɔ Israɛl be efuli so nɛ e malga ŋ gbiti Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na, kade na ebi kikɛ beeŋ kpa mo ajembu m mɔ.

english_verse: but the killing of an animal that belongs to someone else requires only that the animal be replaced.
translation_verse: Esa kama malɛ nɛ e lara mo barkasa be kusɔbɔya be efute daga fanɛ e ka kusɔbɔya na n sa kumo wura.

english_verse: Personal injuries to others must be dealt with in keeping with the crime—
translation_verse: Nɛ esa ko doro mo barkasa dimɛdi, kusɔ kama nɛ e wora mo barkasa na a daga b wora mo alɛ gba loŋ.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and I demand equal justice both for you Israelites and for those foreigners who live among you.
translation_verse: Mbra ere wɔtɔ nna n sa menyi Israɛlebi nɛ befɔ nɛ b wɔ men to na kikɛ, ŋkpal manɛ so, ma e la Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na.”

english_verse: When Moses finished speaking, the people did what the Lord had told Moses, and they stoned to death the man who had cursed the Lord.
translation_verse: Mosis ka kaŋɛ Israɛlebi na mbraana na n loge, nɛ b keta kanyɛn nɛ e malga ŋ gbiti Ebɔrɛ na n lar keeyi na to n ya kpa mo ajembu m mɔ. Kananɛ Israɛl be basa na daŋ wora kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ Mosis na nna na.

english_verse: So when you buy or sell farmland, the price is to be determined by the number of crops it can produce before the next Year of Celebration. Don't try to cheat.
translation_verse: Nɛ menyee ji kudɔsawule be yawu men baa nyiŋi nfɛ nɛ a ka pɔɛŋ nɛ kelaŋɛ n sa be kafɛ na e fo na.

english_verse: When Moses was on Mount Sinai, the Lord told him
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ Mosis ashi Sainai be kebee na so fanɛ

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: After you enter the land that I am giving you, it must be allowed to rest one year out of every seven.
translation_verse: e ta mbraana ere n sa Israɛl be basa na. “Men kaŋ luri kasawule nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee sa menyi ere to, menyeeŋ ta kemaŋkura n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nsaa maŋ nase adɔ kafɛ shunusopo kikɛ to.

english_verse: However, you and your slaves and your hired workers, as well as any domestic or wild animals, may eat whatever grows on its own. The Year of Celebration The Lord said to his people:
translation_verse: nɛ men be asɔbɔya nɛ kupuŋ to be asɔbɔya kikɛ ajibi jiso. Menyeeŋ tiŋ n ji asɔ kama nɛ a beeŋ kɔr kumo so na. Kamooji be Kafɛ be asheŋ

english_verse: or uncle or cousin, or some other family member. In fact, if you ever get enough money, you may buy your own freedom
translation_verse: ŋko mo tutokar ŋko mo tutogboŋ ŋko bumo be ekama pibi ŋko mbe kanaŋ to gbagba be esa ko beeŋ tiŋ n tɔ mo n yige. Nɛ mo alɛ gbagba nya amansherbi nɛnɛ, e beeŋ tiŋ n tɔ mbe kumu n yige.

english_verse: on the tenth day of the seventh month, which is also the Great Day of Forgiveness, trumpets are to be blown everywhere in the land.
translation_verse: Nfɛ adena nɛ akpanu na to be kufɔl shunusopo na be kachɛ kudusopo na nɛ b foŋ kabel awɔrso efuli na kikɛ to. Alubi be Ketampaŋ be Kachɛ nna na.

english_verse: In this time of sacred celebration you may eat only what grows on its own.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, kafɛ na la kamooji be jemanɛ nna nsaa la kafɛ cheembi n sa menyi, amoso asɔ nɛ nsawule na gbagba wora na nɛ menyeeŋ ji.

english_verse: If it is a long time before the next Year of Celebration, the price will be higher, because what is really being sold are the crops that the land can produce.
translation_verse: Nɛ nfɛ na kraa shi, kumo ere kasawule na be yawu malɛ gba beeŋ baa shi, ama nɛ nfɛ na maŋ naa shi bre, kumo be yawu na beeŋ ba kaseto, ŋkpal manɛ so, adɔjibi nɛ e beeŋ lar kasawule na to na be kukɔ nɛ esa na bee ka.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, so obey me and don't cheat anyone.
translation_verse: Sa maŋ kaŋ puni fo barkasa Israɛl be esa, ama baa ŋana Ebɔrɛ. Ŋkpal manɛ so, ma e la Enyɛnpe fo Ebɔrɛ.

english_verse: If you obey my laws and teachings, you will live safely in the land and enjoy its abundant crops.
translation_verse: Kasawule na beeŋ wora adɔjibi nɛnɛ nɛ fo nya asɔ nɛ fee sha kikɛ a ji yɛlyɛla nsaa wɔ kayurwushi to.

english_verse: Don't ever worry about what you will eat during the seventh year when you are forbidden to plant or harvest.
translation_verse: Ama esa ko beeŋ baa fɛ le: ‘Manɛ nɛ anyeeŋ baa ji kafɛ shunusopo nɛ anyee maa dɔ a du shɛŋ, anyi alɛ maa teŋi shɛŋ na to?’

english_verse: I will see to it that you harvest enough in the sixth year to last for three years.
translation_verse: Ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ nɛfa kasawule na kafɛ shesopo na to, saŋɛ na so adɔjibi nɛ a beeŋ wora na beeŋ tiŋ n ji menyi n fo nfɛ asa.

english_verse: In the eighth year you will live on what you harvested in the sixth year, but in the ninth year you will eat what you plant and harvest in the eighth year.
translation_verse: Menyeeŋ baa kraa ji adɔjibi nɛ men du n teŋi kafɛ shesopo na to na nna pɔɛŋ nseŋ dɔ n du kafɛ burwasopo na to, ama menyi alɛ kraa beeŋ baa kɔ ajibi a ji hale n ya fo jemanɛ nɛ menyeeŋ teŋi amo nɛ men du na.

english_verse: No land may be permanently bought or sold. It all belongs to me—it isn't your land, and you only live there for a little while.
translation_verse: A maŋ daga men ka fa kasawule n sa esa nɛ e baa kɔ kuraa, ŋkpal manɛ so, k maŋ la menyeya nna, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e wɔ kumo nɛ menyi alɛ du fanɛ befɔ nɛ e sa ekpa nɛ men baa ji kumo so be tɔnɔ.

english_verse: When property is being sold, the original owner must be given the first chance to buy it.
translation_verse: Nɛ esa bee sha fanɛ e fa kasawule, a daga fanɛ e juŋkpar n shin nɛ esa nɛ e daŋ tɔ kumo mo kutɔ na e pin pɔɛŋ nɛ e fa kumo.

english_verse: If any of you Israelites become so poor that you are forced to sell your property, your closest relative must buy it back,
translation_verse: Nɛ ketir pɛ Israɛl be esa nɛ e bee sha nɛ e fa mbe kasawule, mo kurgepo gbagba e daga fanɛ e fa kasawule na n sa.

english_verse: you must pay enough to make up for what the present owner will lose on it before the next Year of Celebration, when the property would become yours again.
translation_verse: Ama a daga fanɛ e ka esa nɛ e fa kumo n sa na amansherbi nɛ a beeŋ fo nfɛ nɛ a kraŋ ka pɔɛŋ nɛ Kelaŋɛ n sa be Kafɛ e fo na. Aloŋ e naaŋ shin nɛ e naŋ nya mbe kasawule.

english_verse: But if you don't have the money to pay the present owner a fair price, you will have to wait until the Year of Celebration, when the property will once again become yours.
translation_verse: Ama nɛ e maŋ kɔ amansherbi nɛ e naaŋ sɔ kumo n tɔ, k kraa beeŋ baa la esa nɛ e fa kumo n sa na peya nna hale nɛ Kelaŋɛ n sa be Kafɛ na e fo. Loŋ be kafɛ na to nɛ kasawule na beeŋ naŋ laŋɛ kumo wura gbagba be enɔ to.

english_verse: If you don't buy it back before that year is up, it becomes the permanent property of the one who bought it, and it will not be returned to you in the Year of Celebration.
translation_verse: Ama nɛ e maŋ tiŋ n tɔ kumo kafɛ koŋwule be jemanɛ na to, e maŋ naa kɔ ekpa nɛ e naŋ laŋɛ n tɔ kowu nna. K beeŋ ki esa nɛ e tɔ kumo na nɛ mbe kaman to ebi be kapetɛ hale mbaanaayɔ. B maaŋ naŋ bɛta kumo n sa mo Kelaŋɛ n sa be Kafɛ na to.

english_verse: But a house out in a village may be bought back at any time just like a field. And it must be returned to its original owner in the Year of Celebration.
translation_verse: Ama nwu nɛ a wɔ nde karso nɛ b maŋ pɔr egbal ŋ kulti amo na bre kraa du fanɛ adɔsawule nna. Esa nɛ e fa na kraa beeŋ tiŋ n laŋɛ n tɔ mbe kusɔ. Ama a daga fanɛ b naaŋ bɛta amo n sa amo wura Kelaŋɛ n sa be Kafɛ na to.

english_verse: And any houses that they do not buy back will be returned to them in the Year of Celebration, because these homes are their permanent property among the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Kowu kama nɛ Livai be esa beeŋ fa ashi Livaiebi be kade to nsaa maŋ tiŋ n laŋɛ n tɔ kumo, k daga fanɛ b laŋɛ kumo n sa mo Kelaŋɛ n sa be Kafɛ na, ŋkpal manɛ so, nwu nɛ a wɔ Livaiebi be nde to na la bumo gbagba peya nna ashi bumo braana Israɛlebi to.

english_verse: No pastureland owned by the Levi tribe can ever be sold; it is their permanent possession. Help for the Poor The Lord said:
translation_verse: Ama nsawule nɛ Livaiebi be asɔbɔya bee ji so na bre maŋ daga kefa kikɛ, ŋkpal manɛ so, a la bumo be mpetɛsɔ nna mbaanaayɔ. Betirpo be kechɛto be asheŋ

english_verse: If any of your people become poor and unable to support themselves, you must help them, just as you are supposed to help foreigners who live among you.
translation_verse: Nɛ ketir pɛ men barkasa Israɛl be esa nɛ e wɔ menyi to nɛ e maa tiŋ a keni mbe kumu, a daga men ka keni mo so fanɛ kananɛ menyee keni befɔ so na, saŋɛ na so, e beeŋ tiŋ a wɔ menyi to.

english_verse: Don't take advantage of them by charging any kind of interest or selling them food for profit. Instead, honor me by letting them stay where they now live.
translation_verse: Men sa maŋ kaa wɔtɔ amansherbi kama nɛ b paŋ menyi nchu. Menyi alɛ e sa maŋ kaa fin tɔnɔ ashi ajibi nɛ menyeeŋ fa to.

english_verse: Remember—I am the Lord your God! I rescued you from Egypt and gave you the land of Canaan, so that I would be your God.
translation_verse: Kusɔ nɛ ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, nɛ n la menyi be Ebɔrɛ nɛ n lara menyi Ijipt be efuli so nɛ m ba ta Keenan be kasawule n sa menyi na yili nna na.

english_verse: Suppose some of your people become so poor that they have to sell themselves and become your slaves.
translation_verse: Nɛ ketir pɛ men barkasa Israɛl be esa nɛ e ta mbe kumu n fa n sa fo fanɛ kenya gba, sa maŋ kaŋ shin nɛ e shuŋ kenya be kushuŋ.

english_verse: Then you must treat them as servants, rather than as slaves. And in the Year of Celebration they are to be set free,
translation_verse: Shin nɛ e baa wɔ fo kutɔ fanɛ paawura a shuŋ fo n ya fo Kelaŋɛ n sa be Kafɛ nɛ k baa ba na nɛ e nya mbe kumu.

english_verse: so they and their children may return home to their families and property.
translation_verse: Loŋ be kafɛ na mo nɛ mbe mbia beeŋ lar fo kutɔ m bɛta n yɔ mbe kanaŋ nɛ mbe kabunabi to.

english_verse: I brought them out of Egypt to be my servants, not to be sold as slaves.
translation_verse: Israɛl be basa na la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be anya nna nɛ e shi Ijipt be efuli so m bar bumo. A maŋ daga b fa n tɔ bumo anya.

english_verse: So obey me, and don't be cruel to the poor.
translation_verse: Men sa maŋ kaa mɛaŋ bumo, ama men baa ŋana menyi be Ebɔrɛ na nsaa nu a sa mo.

english_verse: You can own them, and even leave them to your children when you die, but do not make slaves of your own people or be cruel to them.
translation_verse: Menyeeŋ tiŋ n yige bumo ere n sa menyi be mbia fanɛ mpetɛsɔ nɛ b baa shuŋ bumo fanɛ anya hale n ya wu. Ama men sa maŋ kaa mɛaŋ men braana Israɛlebi na bre be ekama.

english_verse: you still have the right to be set free by a relative, such as a brother
translation_verse: ekpa wɔtɔ nɛ b tɔ Israɛl be esa na n yige. Mo niopibiana na be eko

english_verse: And even while you are the slaves of foreigners in your own country, your people must make sure that you are not mistreated.
translation_verse: A daga fanɛ b ta mo fanɛ esa nɛ baa ber paa kafɛ kikɛ nna. A maŋ daga fanɛ mo nyɛnpe na e baa mɛaŋ mo.

english_verse: If you cannot gain your freedom in any of these ways, both you and your children will still be set free in the Year of Celebration.
translation_verse: Nɛ fanɛ e maŋ nya kesɔnyige akpaana ere be kekama so, a daga fanɛ mo nɛ mbe mbia kikɛ ka nya bumo be amu Kelaŋɛ n sa be Kafɛ nɛ k baa ba na to.

english_verse: Respect the Sabbath and honor the place where I am worshiped, because I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Men baa ta Kewushiachɛ na fanɛ nchɛ cheembi nsaa sa kakpa nɛ baa shuŋ ma Ebɔrɛ na bunyaŋ. Ma e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.

english_verse: and I will send rain to make your crops grow and your trees produce fruit.
translation_verse: meeŋ shin nɛ bɔrɛ e baa ba menyi jemanɛ nɛ k daga, saŋɛ na so adɔjibi beeŋ baa wora nɛnɛ nɛ ndibi e baa sɔr nɛnɛ kasawule na so.

english_verse: I will bless your country with peace, and you will rest without fear. I will wipe out the dangerous animals and protect you from enemy attacks.
translation_verse: Meeŋ sa menyi kayurwushi menyi be kasawule so, nɛ men baa dese a di nsaa maa lɔ kufu ŋkpal esa kikɛ so. Meeŋ mur asɔbɔya lubi kikɛ kasawule na so, nseŋ shin nɛ kena maaŋ naa wɔ ndoŋ.

english_verse: You will chase and destroy your enemies,
translation_verse: Menyeeŋ kɔ m pɔɔ men doŋana so.

english_verse: I will treat you with such kindness that your nation will grow strong, and I will also keep my promises to you.
translation_verse: Meeŋ nɛfa menyi nseŋ sa menyi mbia damta. Ma alɛ beeŋ bɛ kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre nɛ ma nɛ menyi kre na so.

english_verse: I will live among you and never again look on you with disgust.
translation_verse: Meeŋ baa wɔ ma wajɛbu na to ashi menyi to, ma alɛ maa lar menyi be kaman kikɛ.

english_verse: I will walk with you—I will be your God, and you will be my people.
translation_verse: Meeŋ baa wɔ menyi to nsaa la men be Ebɔrɛ, nɛ menyi alɛ e baa la ma basa.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and I rescued you from Egypt, so that you would never again be slaves. I have set you free; now walk with your heads held high. Punishment for Disobeying the Lord The Lord said:
translation_verse: Ma Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na e lara menyi ashi Ijipt be efuli so m ba saŋɛ na so menyi maaŋ naa la anya. Ma e kɔ m pɔɔ eleŋ kama nɛ k daa ji menyi so na so, saŋɛ na so, menyi maŋ naa fɔŋ shɛŋ so na.” Kusoe kpakpaso be kasogberge be asheŋ

english_verse: If you disobey me and my laws, and if you break our agreement,
translation_verse: Nɛ men kini kewora ma mbraana kasonu nsaa maŋ wora m bɔla ma nɛ menyi be kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre na so,

english_verse: I will punish you terribly, and you will be ruined. You will be struck with incurable diseases and with fever that leads to blindness and depression. Your enemies will eat the crops you plant,
translation_verse: meeŋ gberge menyi kusoe. Meeŋ shin nɛ tɔrɔgboŋ e ba menyi so, fanɛ alɔ nɛ a maŋ kɔ kechɛ nɛ ebeldɛ nɛ a beeŋ shin nɛ men tan nɛ menyi be kebaawɔtɔ e ki jiga. Menyi doŋana e naaŋ ji adɔjibi nɛ menyeeŋ dɔ n duu na.

english_verse: and I will turn from you and let you be destroyed by your attackers. You will even run at the very rumor of attack.
translation_verse: Ma alɛ beeŋ lar menyi kaman, saŋɛ na so, men doŋana beeŋ pɔɔ menyi so. Basa nɛ b kishi menyi beeŋ ji menyi so kuwura nɛ kufu e pɛ menyi nɛ men baa chicha a shile jemanɛ nɛ ekama maŋ ju a buu menyi so.

english_verse: Then, if you still refuse to obey me, I will punish you seven times for each of your sins,
translation_verse: Ade kikɛ be kaman, nɛ men kraa maŋ wora ma kasonu, meeŋ shin nɛ menyi be kasogberge e ti so ale shunu.

english_verse: until your pride is completely crushed. I will hold back the rain, so the sky above you will be like iron, and the ground beneath your feet will be like copper.
translation_verse: Meeŋ shin nɛ men be kumukpakpaso be kamoowu e ki fuloŋ. Ma alɛ beeŋ pɛ bɔrɛ nɛ kasawule na a wɔl ŋ ki kpakpa fanɛ kebelso.

english_verse: All of your hard work will be for nothing—and there will be no harvest of grain or fruit.
translation_verse: Menyi maaŋ nya shɛŋ ashi kushuŋ kpakpaso kama nɛ menyeeŋ shuŋ to, ŋkpal manɛ so, menyi be adɔjibi nɛ ndibi sɔrso maaŋ wora kasawule na so.

english_verse: If you keep rebelling against me, I'll punish you seven times worse, just as your sins deserve!
translation_verse: Nɛ men kraa maa sa ma kashuli nseŋ kini kenu n sa ma, ŋ kraa beeŋ shin nɛ men be kasogberge e naaŋ ti so ale shunu.

english_verse: I'll send wild animals to attack you, and they will gobble up your children and livestock. So few of you will be left that your roads will be deserted.
translation_verse: Meeŋ shin nɛ asɔbɔya lubi e luri menyi to m mɔ menyi be mbia nseŋ mur menyi be asɔbɔya. Menyi be basa gbrɛbi ko e naaŋ ka, saŋɛ na so nɛ menyi be agbembi e dese fuloŋ.

english_verse: You will have such a shortage of bread, that ten women will be able to bake their bread in the same oven. Each of you will get only a few crumbs, and you will go hungry.
translation_verse: Meeŋ ti ekpa nɛ menyee bɔla so a nya ajibi na, saŋɛ na so beche kudu beeŋ baa tɔ bumo be ebodobodo ashi ebodobodo be ebu koŋwule to. Baŋ baa karga amo nna a sa ekama, nɛ men we amo n loge gba, men kraa maaŋ moɛ.

english_verse: In fact, you will be so desperate for food that you will eat your own children.
translation_verse: Akoŋ nɛ k beeŋ pɛ menyi na beeŋ wora alegai n shin nɛ men we menyi gbagba be mbia be eblaŋ.

english_verse: I'll wipe out your towns and your places of worship and will no longer be pleased with the smell of your sacrifices.
translation_verse: Meeŋ shin nɛ menyi be ndegboŋana e ki alambure nɛ m mur mboŋ nɛ menyee shuŋ agbirana na. Menyi be esarga be efɛa maaŋ naa par ma.

english_verse: Your land will become so desolate that even your enemies who settle there will be shocked when they see it.
translation_verse: Meeŋ mur kusɔ kama menyi be kasawule na so nɛ kechinchiŋ men doŋana nɛ b wɔ ndoŋ na gba.

english_verse: After I destroy your towns and ruin your land with war, I'll scatter you among the nations.
translation_verse: Meeŋ bar kena menyi so n shin nɛ men pesaŋ to n yɔ efuli pɔtɛana so. Menyi be kasawule beeŋ dese fuloŋ nɛ menyi be ndegboŋ a ki alambure.

english_verse: While you are prisoners in foreign lands, your own land will enjoy years of rest and refreshment, as it should have done each seventh year when you lived there.
translation_verse: Aloŋ nɛ kasawule na beeŋ nya ewushi nɛ menyi maŋ naŋ sa kumo kikɛ na. K beeŋ dese fuloŋ a wushi jemanɛ nɛ menyeeŋ baa wɔ kenyaya to ashi men doŋana be efuli so na.

english_verse: In the land of your enemies, you will tremble at the rustle of a leaf, as though it were a sword. And you will become so weak that you will stumble and fall over each other, even when no one is chasing you.
translation_verse: Menyeeŋ fiti abar n lar n tɔr jemanɛ nɛ esa kama maŋ ju a buu menyi so. Menyi maaŋ naŋ tiŋ ŋ kɔ edoŋ kikɛ.

english_verse: Many of you will die in foreign lands,
translation_verse: Menyeeŋ wu ashi efuli pɔtɛ so nɛ b puli menyi men doŋana be kasawule so.

english_verse: and others of you will waste away in sorrow as the result of your sins and the sins of your ancestors.
translation_verse: Menyi to be basa gbrɛbi nɛ baaŋ ka na malɛ gba, beeŋ mur ashi men doŋana be kasawule so, ŋkpal menyi gbagba be alubi nɛ men nananyɛnana be alubi so.

english_verse: Then suppose you realize that I turned against you and brought you to the land of your enemies because both you and your ancestors had stubbornly sinned against me. If you humbly confess what you have done and start living right,
translation_verse: nɛ ma alɛ gba kilgi n tu bumo nseŋ shin nɛ b pɛ bumo anya n yɔ bumo doŋana be efuli so na. To, nɛ b chɛrga bumo be ŋgbene nseŋ fara a wora kusɔ nɛ k daga bre,

english_verse: I'll keep the promise I made to your ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. I will bless your land
translation_verse: meeŋ nyiŋi ma nɛ Jeekɔb nɛ Aizek nɛ Eebraham be kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre na nseŋ naŋ tiŋi ma kɔnɔ nɛ n nase fanɛ meeŋ sa ma basa kasawule na to.

english_verse: and let it rest during the time that you are in a foreign country, paying for your rebellion against me and my laws.
translation_verse: Ama, pɔɛŋ nɛ loŋ e wora, a daga fanɛ kasawule na e dese jiga n wushi nɛnɛ, nɛ bumo alɛ e ka bumo kekini ma mbraana nɛ atandeana na be kukɔ kikɛ.

english_verse: No matter what you have done, I am still the Lord your God, and I will never completely reject you or become absolutely disgusted with you there in the land of your enemies.
translation_verse: Asheŋ nɛ b wora ere kikɛ be kaman, m maa ba nɛ m ba kplaŋ bumo so ŋko m mur bumo kuraa jemanɛ nɛ b wɔ bumo doŋana be efuli so na. Nɛ n wora loŋ k beeŋ shin nɛ ma nɛ bumo be kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre na e ba ekar. Ma e la Enyɛnpe bumo be Ebɔrɛ na.

english_verse: While nations watched, I rescued your ancestors from Egypt so that I would be their God. Yes, I am your Lord, and I will never forget our agreement.
translation_verse: Meeŋ tiŋi kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre nɛ ma nɛ bumo nanaana daŋ kre jemanɛ nɛ n daŋ lara ma basa ashi Ijipt be efuli so m ba nɛ efuliana na kikɛ wu ma eleŋgboŋ na to. Ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ baa la bumo be Ebɔrɛ.”

english_verse: Moses was on Mount Sinai when the Lord gave him these laws and teachings for the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Mbraana nɛ atande nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na yili n sa Mosis ashi Sainai be kebee so fanɛ e ta n sa Israɛlebi na nna na.

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: If you ever want to free someone who has been promised to me,
translation_verse: e kaŋɛ Israɛlebi na le: “Nɛ b ta dimɛdi a tia kɔnɔ naseso a sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na, le be amansherbi nɛ baaŋ tiŋ ŋ ka n sɔ esa na n yige.

english_verse: Ten percent of everything you harvest is holy and belongs to me, whether it grows in your fields or on your fruit trees.
translation_verse: Adɔjibi kama, fanɛ ayu ŋko asɔrso nɛ e beeŋ shi kasawule na so be kudu kudusopo kikɛ la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na peya nna.

english_verse: If you try to substitute any other animal, no matter how good, for the one you promised, they will both become holy and must be sacrificed.
translation_verse: A maŋ daga esa na ka naŋ ta kusɔbɔya pɔtɛ n tal kumo to. E baaŋ wora loŋ, asɔbɔya anyɔ na kikɛ beeŋ ki Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na peya.

english_verse: If you have promised to give someone to me and can't afford to pay the full amount for that person's release, you will be taken to a priest, and he will decide how much you can afford.
translation_verse: Nɛ esa nɛ e nase kɔnɔ na la etirpo nna nsaa maaŋ tiŋ ŋ ka kukɔ nɛ k dese na n tia kɔnɔ naseso na, bɔrɛmatapo na beeŋ ku kukɔ na so kananɛ amodoŋwura beeŋ tiŋ ŋ ka.

english_verse: If you promise to sacrifice an animal to me, it becomes holy, and there is no way you can set it free.
