english_verse: If you promise part of your family's land to me, its value must be determined by the amount of seed needed to plant the land, and the rate will be ten pieces of silver for every
translation_verse: Nɛ esa ko ku mbe kanaŋ be kasawule be kaba n nase kɔnɔ n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na, k ki kusɔ cheembi nna na. Bɔrɛmatapo na beeŋ yili aduuso nɛ a beeŋ fo n duu kasawule na so nna ŋ ku kumo be yawu. Yawu na malɛ beeŋ baa la fanɛ ayu duuso kurwa adunyɔ kikɛ la gbiti be ndarbi kudu nna.

english_verse: When the Year of Celebration comes, the land becomes holy because it belongs to me, and it will be given to the priests.
translation_verse: Kelaŋɛ n sa be Kafɛ na malɛ baaŋ fo, loŋ be kasawule na beeŋ ki kusɔ cheembi a la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na peya mbaanaayɔ. Saŋɛ na so, k ki bɔrɛmatapoana na be kapetɛsawule nna na.

english_verse: its value will be decided by a priest, according to the number of years before the next Year of Celebration, and the money you pay will be mine.
translation_verse: Bɔrɛmatapo na beeŋ yili nfɛ nɛ a ka nɛ b ji Kelaŋɛ n sa be Kafɛ na so n shin nɛ esa na e ka kumo be kukɔ loŋ be kachɛ na kikɛ. Ŋkpal manɛ so, amansherbi na la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na peya nna.

english_verse: However, on the next Year of Celebration, the land will go back to the family of its original owner.
translation_verse: Kelaŋɛ n sa be Kafɛ na to nɛ baaŋ naŋ bɛta kasawule na n sa esa nɛ e daa wɔ kumo pɔɛŋ nɛ esa na tɔ kumo na ŋko mbe kaman to ebi.

english_verse: Every price will be set by the official standards. Various Offerings The Lord said:
translation_verse: Bɔrɛmatapo na e naŋ yili kusɔ kama be yawu ashi wajɛbu na to.

english_verse: If you want to buy back this part of your harvest, you may do so by paying what it is worth plus an additional
translation_verse: Nɛ esa bee sha kelaŋɛ n tɔ amo be kekama, a daga fanɛ e ka kumo be yawu na nɛ kumo be ntuŋ anu so be katuŋ koŋwule n ti so.

english_verse: The people of Israel had left Egypt and were living in the Sinai Desert. Then on the first day of the second month of the second year, when Moses was in the sacred tent the Lord said:
translation_verse: Israɛlebi na ka lar Ijipt be efuli so na be kafɛ nyɔsopo to be kufɔl nyɔsopo be kachɛ juŋkparso na, nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ malga Mosis kutɔ ashi Enyɛnpe be wajɛbu na to ashi Sainai be keshishɛrsawule na so ŋ kaŋɛ le:

english_verse: I want you and Aaron to find out how many people are in each of Israel's clans and families. And make a list of all the men
translation_verse: Men sibɛ bekama nɛ b fo nfɛ adunyɔ ŋko m baŋ so nsaa beeŋ tiŋ ŋ kɔ kena na kikɛ be atre.

english_verse: Moses and Aaron, together with these twelve tribal leaders,
translation_verse: Kufɔl nyɔsopo na be kachɛ juŋkparso nɛ le be bejuŋkparpo kudu anyɔ ere chɛ Mosis nɛ Ɛɛrɔn to

english_verse: called together the people that same day. They were counted according to their clans and families. Then Moses and the others listed the names of the men twenty years and older,
translation_verse: n tre Israɛlebi kikɛ n shɛr n shin nɛ b ŋini mbuna mbuna nɛ nnaŋ nɛ b shi to nɛ b sibɛ benyɛn nɛ b fo nfɛ adunyɔ ŋko m baŋ so na kikɛ be atre kukoko to.

english_verse: The people of Israel did everything the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Israɛlebi na daŋ wora kusɔ kama nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ daŋ kaŋɛ Mosis na nna.

english_verse: But the Levites will camp around the sacred tent to make sure that no one goes near it and makes me furious with the Israelites.
translation_verse: Ama Livaiebi na bre beeŋ yuu bumo be ewajɛbuana n chena ŋ kulti Enyɛnpe be wajɛbu na a kuŋ kumo, saŋɛ na so, esa kama maaŋ taga kumo to n shin nɛ n nya agbo ga n wɔtɔ Israɛlebi kikɛ.”

translation_verse: ŋkpal manɛ so, le nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ daŋ kaŋɛ Mosis:

english_verse: When you count the Israelites, do not include those from the Levi tribe.
translation_verse: “Sa maŋ karga Livaiebi nɛ b fo kena be kekɔ na bre n ti Israɛlebi na so.

english_verse: Instead, give them the job of caring for the sacred tent, its furnishings, and the objects used for worship. They will camp around the tent, and whenever you move, they will take it down, carry it to the new camp, and set it up again. Anyone else who tries to go near it must be put to death.
translation_verse: Saŋkama nɛ men baŋ chɛrga echenakpa, Livaiebi na e naaŋ baa bɔɔ Enyɛnpe be wajɛbu na. Bumo koŋwule na malɛ e naaŋ baa yuu kumo kaplɛkama nɛ men ya chena. Esa pɔtɛ kama malɛ nɛ e yili n taga Enyɛnpe be wajɛbu na to b mɔ mo.

english_verse: The rest of the Israelites will camp in their own groups and under their own banners.
translation_verse: Israɛlebi nɛ b ka na malɛ e chena ntuŋ ntuŋ so n ta bumo gbagba be etuuta n dulgi bumo be echenakpa.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses and Aaron
translation_verse: Le nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ daŋ kaŋɛ Mosis nɛ Ɛɛrɔn:

english_verse: how the Israelites should arrange their camp: Each tribe must set up camp under its own banner and under the flags of its ancestral families. These camps will be arranged around the sacred tent, but not close to it.
translation_verse: “A daga Israɛlebi na ka feŋ n chena kanaŋ kanaŋ so ntuŋ so ŋ kulti nshɛr be wajɛbu na nɛ kanaŋ kikɛ e yuu bumo be tuta bumo be keeyi to.”

english_verse: Judah and the tribes that march with it must set up camp on the east side of the sacred tent, under their own banner. The
translation_verse: Juda be kanaŋ to ebi nɛ bumo be ejuŋkparpo e la Aminadab pibinyɛn Naashɔn, nɛ e bee juŋkpar bumo be kanaŋ to be benapo ŋgboŋ adushunu nɛ ana nɛ alfa ashe na, beeŋ yuu bumo be tuta n chena Enyɛnpe be wajɛbu na be epeŋilarkpa be kaba so.

translation_verse: Nɛ Isaaka be kanaŋ to ebi nɛ Zuwa pibinyɛn Nataniɛl bee juŋkpar bumo be kanaŋ to be benapo ŋgboŋ adunu nɛ ana nɛ alfa ana na, e chena m bɛ bumo so.

english_verse: On the other side will be the tribe of Zebulun, with Eliab son of Helon as the leader of its
translation_verse: Nɛ Zebulun be kanaŋ to ebi nɛ Hɛlɔn pibinyɛn Eliab bee juŋkpar bumo be benapo ŋgboŋ adunu nɛ ashunu nɛ alfa ana na, malɛ e chena m bɛ bumo so.

english_verse: Reuben and the tribes that march with it must set up camp on the south side of the sacred tent, under their own banner. The
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ Ruben be kanaŋ to ebi nɛ Shedur pibinyɛn Elizur bee juŋkpar bumo be benapo ŋgboŋ adena nɛ ashe nɛ alfa anu na, e yuu bumo be tuta n chena nshɛr be wajɛbu na be kelargato be kaseto be kaba so.

english_verse: On one side of Reuben will be the tribe of Simeon, with Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai as the leader of its
translation_verse: Nɛ Simiɔn be kanaŋ to ebi nɛ Zurishaddai pibinyɛn Shelumiɛl bee juŋkpar bumo be benapo ŋgboŋ adunu nɛ akpanu nɛ alfa asa na, e chena m bɛ so.

english_verse: On the other side will be the tribe of Gad, with Eliasaph son of Deuel as the leader of its
translation_verse: Nɛ Gad be kanaŋ to ebi nɛ Duwɛl pibinyɛn Eliazaf bee juŋkpar bumo be benapo ŋgboŋ adena nɛ anu nɛ alfa ashe nɛ adunu na, malɛ e chena m bɛ so.

english_verse: Marching behind Reuben will be the Levites, arranged in groups, just as they are camped. They will carry the sacred tent and their own banners.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ Livaiebi na malɛ e sulɔ nshɛr be wajɛbu na nseŋ keta bumo be tuta m bɛ nnaŋ nɛ Ruben bee juŋkpar na so fanɛ kananɛ b chena kebɛso kebɛso na.

english_verse: Ephraim and the tribes that march with it must set up camp on the west side of the sacred tent, under their own banner. The
translation_verse: Nɛ Efreim be kanaŋ to ebi nɛ Amihuud pibinyɛn Elishama bee juŋkpar bumo be benapo ŋgboŋ adena nɛ alfa anu na, malɛ e yuu bumo be tuta n chena epeŋitɔrkpa be kaba so.

english_verse: On one side of Ephraim will be the tribe of Manasseh, with Gamaliel son of Pedahzur as the leader of its
translation_verse: Nɛ Manase be kanaŋ to ebi nɛ Pɛdazur pibinyɛn Gamaliɛl bee juŋkpar bumo be benapo ŋgboŋ adesa nɛ anyɔ nɛ alfa anyɔ na, malɛ e chena m bɛ so.

english_verse: So all the Israelites in the camp were counted according to their ancestral families. The troops were arranged by divisions and totaled
translation_verse: Fo baŋ ta Israɛlebi be benyɛn nɛ b fo kena to be keyɔ na kikɛ m ber abar so mbuna mbuna nɛ kananɛ b chena ntuŋso ntuŋso na kikɛ, b daa wɔ basa ŋgboŋ alfa ashe nɛ asa nɛ alfa anu nɛ adunu.

english_verse: Dan and the tribes that march with it must set up camp on the north side of the sacred tent, under their own banner. The

translation_verse: Nɛ Ashɛr be kanaŋ to ebi nɛ Okran pibinyɛn Pagiɛl bee juŋkpar bumo be benapo ŋgboŋ adena nɛ kako nɛ alfa anu na, e chena m bɛ so.

english_verse: On the other side will be the tribe of Naphtali with Ahira son of Enan as the leader of its

english_verse: The only Israelites not included were the Levites, just as the Lord had commanded Moses.
translation_verse: Livaiebi na nawule nɛ b daa maŋ karga n ti Israɛlebi na so ŋkpal kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ Mosis na so.

english_verse: Israel did everything the Lord had told Moses. They arranged their camp according to clans and families, with each tribe under its own banner. And that was the order by which they marched into battle.
translation_verse: Kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ daŋ kaŋɛ Mosis na gbagba chap nɛ Israɛlebi na daŋ wora. Kabuna kama to ebi daŋ wora bumo be echenakpa nna n chena bumo be eyiri to be tuta ase. Bumo alɛ daa bɛ abar so mbuna mbuna nɛ nnaŋ so nna a nite.

english_verse: But the Lord killed Nadab and Abihu in the Sinai Desert when they used fire that was unacceptable in their offering to the Lord. And because Nadab and Abihu had no sons, only Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests with their father Aaron. The Duties of the Levites
translation_verse: Ama Nadab nɛ Abihu bre daŋ wu, saŋɛ nɛ b daŋ ta edɛ nɛ a maŋ daga n chɔ sarga nɛ b lara n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ashi Sainai be keshishɛrsawule na so nna. english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ Mosis le:

english_verse: who have been appointed to be priests. Anyone else who tries to perform the duties of a priest must be put to death.
translation_verse: Lara Ɛɛrɔn nɛ mbe bibinyɛn nɛ b baa la bɔrɛmatapoana. Esa pɔtɛ kama nɛ e pɛl n shuŋ bɔrɛmatapo be kushuŋ b mɔ mo.”

english_verse: Moses, I have chosen these Levites from all Israel, and they will belong to me in a special way. But now I accept these Levites in place of the first-born sons of the Israelites. The Levites Are Counted
translation_verse: “Ŋ ka daŋ mɔ Ijiptebi na be ewurkoŋnyɛn na, n daŋ yili kumo nna fanɛ Israɛlebi be ewurkoŋnyɛn kikɛ nɛ bumo be asɔbɔya be ewurkoŋnyɛn la meya nna. english_verse: In the Sinai Desert the Lord said to Moses,
translation_verse: Le nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ naŋ kaŋɛ Mosis ashi Sainai be keshishɛrsawule na so:

english_verse: “Now I want you to count the men and boys in the Levi tribe by families and by clans. Include every one at least a month old.”
translation_verse: “Karga Livaiebi na be benyɛn kikɛ nɛ b fo kufɔl ŋko m baŋ so mbuna mbuna so nɛ kanaŋ kanaŋ so.”

english_verse: So Moses obeyed and counted them.
translation_verse: Nɛ Mosis wora loŋ.

english_verse: Levi's three sons, Gershon, Kohath, and Merari, had become the heads of their own clans.
translation_verse: Livai daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi asa nna. Bumo e daa la Gɛshɔn nɛ Kohaf nɛ Mɛrari. Bumo e daŋ ki bumo be mbuna be benimu.

english_verse: Gershon's sons were Libni and Shimei.
translation_verse: Gɛshɔn be mbinyɛnsobi e daa la Libni nɛ Shimei.

english_verse: Kohath's sons were Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
translation_verse: Kohaf malɛ be mbinyɛnsobi e daa la Amram nɛ Izha nɛ Hibrɔn nɛ Uziɛl.

english_verse: And Merari's sons were Mahli and Mushi. These were the sons and grandsons of Levi, and they had become the leaders of the Levite clans.
translation_verse: Nɛ Mɛrari malɛ be mbinyɛnsobi daa la Maali nɛ Muushi. Bede e daa la Livai be mbinyɛnsobi nɛ mo nanabinyɛnsoana. Bumo alɛ e daŋ ba ki Livai be kaman to ebi.

english_verse: The two Gershon clans were the Libnites and Shimeites,
translation_verse: Libni nɛ Shimei be nnaŋ e la Gɛshɔn be kabuna ebi na.

english_verse: the curtains hanging inside the courtyard around the tent, as well as the curtain and ropes for the entrance to the courtyard and its altar. The Gershonites were responsible for setting these things up and taking them down.
translation_verse: Bumo be kushuŋ e la kebaakeni Enyɛnpe be wajɛbu na gbagba so nɛ asɔ nɛ baa ta a yuu kumo nɛ amo nɛ baa ta a yuu a kulti kumo nɛ kumo be epatisa nɛ efɔlana nɛ asɔ kama nɛ a ti amo so na.

english_verse: The four Kohath clans were the Amramites, Izharites, Hebronites, and the Uzzielites,
translation_verse: Amramebi nɛ Izaaebi nɛ Hibrɔnebi nɛ Uziɛlebi e la Kohaf be kabuna ebi na.

english_verse: Their duties at the tent included taking care of the sacred chest, the table for the sacred bread, the lampstand, the altars, the objects used for worship, and the curtain in front of the most holy place. The Kohathites were responsible for setting these things up and taking them down.
translation_verse: Bumo e naa keni ŋkre be deka nɛ k wɔ acheembiana to be kakpa cheembi na so, nɛ teebɔl na nɛ kefitilatɔl na nɛ ebɔrɛsureana na nɛ ntishaŋ nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana na bee ta a wora asheŋ ashi Enyɛnpe be wajɛbu na to nɛ patisa nɛ k wɔ acheembiana to be kakpa cheembi na be kabuna to na kikɛ so. Bumo e naa bela le be asɔ ere a yili mboŋ nseŋ naa bela amo ashi to.

english_verse: Eleazar son of Aaron was the head of the Levite leaders, and he made sure that the work at the sacred tent was done.
translation_verse: Bɔrɛmatapo nimuso Ɛɛrɔn pibinyɛn Eliaza e daa la Livaiebi na be enimu. Mo nɛ b daŋ lara fanɛ e baa la basa nɛ baa shuŋ Enyɛnpe be wajɛbu na to na be ejuŋkparpo.

english_verse: The two Merari clans were the Mahlites and the Mushites,
translation_verse: Maali nɛ Muushi la nnaŋ nɛ ashi Mɛrari be kabuna ebi nna.

english_verse: The Merarites, under the leadership of Zuriel son of Abihail, were to camp on the north side of the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Mɛrari be kabuna ebi na beeŋ wora bumo be echenakpa ashi wajɛbu na be kelargato be esoso be kaba so nɛ Abihail pibinyɛn Zuriɛl e baa la kabuna na be enimu.

english_verse: Moses, Aaron, and his sons were to camp in front of the sacred tent, on the east side, and to make sure that the Israelites worshiped in the proper way. Anyone else who tried to do the work of Moses and Aaron was to be put to death.
translation_verse: Mosis nɛ Ɛɛrɔn nɛ Ɛɛrɔn be mbia beeŋ wora bumo be echenakpa ashi wajɛbu na be anishito a laŋɛ epeŋilarkpa be kaba so. Bumo e naaŋ baa juŋkpar Israɛlebi na nɛ b baa bunyaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ. Esa pɔtɛ kama malɛ nɛ e pɛl n sɔ Mosis ŋko Ɛɛrɔn be kushuŋ a shuŋ, b mɔ mo.

english_verse: So Moses and Aaron obeyed the Lord and counted the Levites by their clans. The total number of Levites at least one month old was
translation_verse: Benyɛn nɛ b fo kufɔl ŋko m baŋ so nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ daŋ kaŋɛ Mosis nɛ Ɛɛrɔn fanɛ b karga ashi Livai be kabuna na kikɛ daa wɔ basa ŋgboŋ adunyɔ nɛ anyɔ. Livaiebi na ka yili ewurkoŋnyɛn be katelamu to be asheŋ

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses, “Make a list and count the first-born sons at least one month old in each of the Israelite families.
translation_verse: Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ naŋ kaŋɛ Mosis le: “Sibɛ Israɛlebi be ewurkoŋnyɛn nɛ b fo kufɔl ŋko m baŋ so be atre n wɔtɔ kawɔl to.

english_verse: They belong to me, but I will accept the Levites as substitutes for them, and I will accept the Levites' livestock as substitutes for the Israelites' first-born livestock.”
translation_verse: Shin nɛ Livaiebi na e yili Israɛlebi na be ewurkoŋnyɛn be katelamu to n shin nɛ Livaiebi na be asɔbɔya e yili Israɛlebi na be asɔbɔya be ewurkoŋ be katelamu to n sa ma. Ŋkpal manɛ so, b la meya nna.”

english_verse: Then the Lord said,
translation_verse: Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ naŋ kaŋɛ Mosis le:

english_verse: “The Levites will belong to me and will take the place of the first-born sons; their livestock will take the place of the Israelites' first-born livestock.
translation_verse: “Shin nɛ Livaiebi na e yili Israɛlebi be ewurkoŋnyɛn be katelamu to nɛ Livaiebi na be asɔbɔya malɛ e tal Israɛlebi na be asɔbɔya be ewurkoŋ to.

english_verse: For each one, you are to collect five pieces of silver, weighed according to the official standards.
translation_verse: Shin nɛ b tɔ bumo be ekama gbiti be ndarbi anu fanɛ kananɛ baa karga amansherbi wajɛbu na to na.

english_verse: This money must then be given to Aaron and his sons.”
translation_verse: A daga fanɛ b ta le be amansherbi ere n sa Ɛɛrɔn nɛ mbe mbinyɛnsobi.”

english_verse: Then he gave it to Aaron and his sons, just as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Mosis daŋ ta amo nna n sa Ɛɛrɔn nɛ mbe mbinyɛnsobi fanɛ kananɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ mo na.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses and Aaron:
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ daŋ kaŋɛ Mosis nɛ Ɛɛrɔn nna fanɛ

english_verse: The Kohathites will be responsible for carrying the sacred objects used in worship at the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Kohafebi na be kushuŋ e la kebaakeni asɔ cheembi nɛ a wɔ Enyɛnpe be wajɛbu na to so.

english_verse: When the Israelites are ready to move their camp, Aaron and his sons will enter the tent and take down the curtain that separates the sacred chest from the rest of the tent. They will cover the chest with this curtain,
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ daŋ kaŋɛ Mosis nna fanɛ nɛ b kaa shin nɛ b kaa bumo be keeyi to, b shin nɛ Ɛɛrɔn nɛ mbe mbinyɛnsobi e luri n saŋɛ patisa nɛ k kuŋ ŋkre be deka nɛ k wɔ kakpa cheembi na nɛ wajɛbu to na nseŋ ta kumo m buu deka na so.

english_verse: and then with a piece of fine leather, and cover it all with a solid blue cloth. After this they will put the carrying poles in place.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ b ta kusɔbɔya be kawɔl lela m parga m buu kumo so, nseŋ parga wajɛ nɛ k la buru gbagba n deŋi so n ti so pɔɛŋ nseŋ ta ndibi nɛ baa pɛ to a sulɔ kumo na n yisi n wɔtɔ amo be kakpa.

english_verse: Next, Aaron and his sons will use another blue cloth to cover the table for the sacred bread. On the cloth they will place the dishes, the bowls for incense, the cups, the jugs for wine, as well as the bread itself.
translation_verse: Kede be kaman nɛ Ɛɛrɔn nɛ mbe mbinyɛnsobi na e naŋ ta wajɛ nɛ k la buru m parga m buu Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be teebɔl nɛ baa ta bodobodo cheembi nɛ duwu be ntishaŋ, nɛ ntishaŋ nɛ baa ta sarga be asɔ a wɔtɔ na, nɛ ekɔlba nɛ baa ta sarga be yabra belbelso a wɔtɔ a bɛ so na so. A daga fanɛ bodobodo e baa wɔ loŋ be teebɔl na so saŋkikɛ.

english_verse: With another blue cloth they will cover the lampstand, along with the lamps, the lamp snuffers, the fire pans, and the jars of oil for the lamps.
translation_verse: A daga fanɛ b ta wajɛ buru m buu kefitilatɔl na nɛ kumo be ayabi nɛ asɔ nɛ baa ta a lɔŋɛ kefitilatɔl na so nɛ epelɛlɛ, nɛ ɔlif be ŋku be ekɔlba na so.

english_verse: All of this will then be covered with a piece of fine leather and placed on a carrying frame.
translation_verse: Kede be kaman nɛ b ta kusɔbɔya be kawɔl lela m buu amo kikɛ nyam so nseŋ ta kumo n deŋi kusɔ sulɔ asɔ so.

english_verse: The gold incense altar is to be covered with a blue cloth, and then with a piece of fine leather, before its carrying poles are put in place.
translation_verse: Kumo alɛ be kaman nɛ b parga wajɛ buru n deŋi shuwa be bɔrɛsure na so nseŋ ta kusɔbɔya be kawɔl lela m parga m buu kumo so n ti so pɔɛŋ nseŋ ta ndibi nɛ baa ta a sulɔ kumo na n wɔtɔ amo be kakpa.

english_verse: Next, Aaron and his sons will take blue cloth and wrap all the objects used in worship at the sacred tent. These will need to be covered with a piece of fine leather, then placed on a carrying frame.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ b ta wajɛ buru m buu asɔjito nɛ b kɔ a shuŋ kakpa cheembi na to na so nseŋ ta kusɔbɔya be kawɔl lela m buu so n ti so pɔɛŋ n ta amo n deŋi kusɔ sulɔ asɔ na so.

english_verse: They are to remove the ashes from the bronze altar and cover it with a purple cloth.
translation_verse: A daga fanɛ b muu nsunɔ na ashi danyaŋ be bɔrɛsure na so pɔɛŋ nseŋ ta wajɛ peper kunɔkunɔ m parga m buu kumo so.

english_verse: On that cloth will be placed the utensils used at the altar, including the fire pans, the meat forks, the shovels, and the sprinkling bowls. All of this will then be covered with a piece of fine leather, before the carrying poles are put in place.
translation_verse: Ade kikɛ be kaman nɛ b ta asɔ nɛ b kɔ a chɔɔ edɛ na, nɛ anyembi chule eblaŋ na, nɛ shabɔl nɛ ntishaŋgboŋ nɛ b kɔ a shuŋ bɔrɛsure na ase na kikɛ n deŋi wajɛ peper na so, nseŋ ta kusɔbɔya be kawɔl lela m parga m buu amo so pɔɛŋ nseŋ ta ndibi nɛ baa ta a wɔtɔ kumo to a sulɔ na n wɔtɔ amo be kakpa.

english_verse: When the camp is ready to be moved, the Kohathites will be responsible for carrying the sacred objects and the furnishings of the sacred tent. But Aaron and his sons must have already covered those things so the Kohathites won't touch them and die.
translation_verse: Saŋɛ baŋ fo fanɛ b kaa keeyi to, Kohafebi na e daga fanɛ b sulɔ asɔ cheembi na nɛ wajɛbu na be asɔ kikɛ. Ama Ɛɛrɔn nɛ mbe mbinyɛnsobi e daga fanɛ b ta asɔ m buu asɔ cheembi na so nɛnɛ pɔɛŋ nɛ b ta amo n sulɔ, saŋɛ na so b maaŋ beta amo nseŋ wu. Amoso saŋkama nɛ b kaa keeyi to, wajɛbu na nɛ kumo to be asɔ kikɛ be kesulɔ be kushuŋ la Kohaf be kabuna ebi peya nna.

english_verse: Eleazar son of Aaron the priest will be in charge of the oil for the lamps, the sweet-smelling incense, the grain for the sacrifices, and the olive oil used for dedications and ordinations. Eleazar is responsible for seeing that the sacred tent, its furnishings, and the sacred objects are taken care of.
translation_verse: Bɔrɛmatapo nimuso Ɛɛrɔn pibinyɛn, Eliaza e daga fanɛ e baa keni ŋku nɛ baa ta a wɔtɔ efitila na to nɛ eduwu nɛ esargajibi nɛ ŋku nɛfaso nɛ kusɔ kama nɛ k wɔ wajɛbu na to nsaa la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na peya na so.

english_verse: The Kohathites must not go near or even look at the sacred objects until Aaron and his sons have covered those objects. If they do, their entire clan will be wiped out. So make sure that Aaron and his sons go into the tent with them and tell them what to carry. The Duties of the Gershonite Clans
translation_verse: Hale nɛ Kohafebi na luri wajɛbu na to n ya tu bɔrɛmatapoana na nɛ b kraa buu asɔ cheembi na gba, baaŋ wu.” Gɛshɔn be kabuna ebi nɛ b ti Livaiebi na so be kushuŋ be asheŋ

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ naŋ kaŋɛ Mosis fanɛ

english_verse: for carrying the curtains of the sacred tent, its two outer coverings, the curtain for the entrance to the tent,
translation_verse: wajɛbu na nɛ kumo be kabuna to be patisa na nɛ acheembiana to be kakpa cheembi na be kabuna to be patisa na nɛ kusɔbɔya be kawɔl lela nɛ baa yuu a kulti kumo na

english_verse: the curtains hanging around the courtyard of the tent, and the curtain and ropes for the entrance to the courtyard. The Gershonites are to do whatever needs to be done to take care of these things,
translation_verse: nɛ kelɔnɛ na be epatisa nɛ a chambɔ wajɛbu na, nɛ bɔrɛsure na nɛ kumo be efɔlana nɛ kelɔnɛ na be kabuna to be patisa na, nɛ asɔ kama nɛ baa ta a wora kumo be asheŋ na kikɛ. Gɛshɔn be kabuna ebi na e naaŋ baa shuŋ le be ashuŋ ere kikɛ.

english_verse: These are the duties of the Gershonites at the sacred tent, and Ithamar son of Aaron will make sure they do their work. The Duties of the Merarite Clans
translation_verse: Bɔrɛmatapo nimuso Ɛɛrɔn pibinyɛn Itama e naaŋ baa keni Gɛshɔnebi na so nɛ b baa shuŋ le be ashuŋ ere ashi wajɛbu na to. Mɛrari be kabuna ebi nɛ b ti Livaiebi na so be kushuŋ be asheŋ

english_verse: The Merarites will be responsible for carrying the frames of the tent and its other pieces, including the bars, the posts, and the stands,
translation_verse: Bumo e naaŋ baa sulɔ wajɛbu na be ndibi yuuso nɛ amo be atɔl nɛ adeŋiso nɛ alargato

english_verse: as well as the posts that support the courtyard, together with their stands, tent pegs, and ropes. The Merarites are to be told exactly what objects they are to carry,
translation_verse: nɛ wajɛbu na be kelɔnɛ nɛ k kulti kumo na be ndibi yuuso nɛ amo be atɔl nɛ ayirbi nɛ efɔlana. Mɛrariebi na be ekama daga fanɛ e baa nyi kusɔ nɛ e bee sulɔ.

english_verse: and Ithamar son of Aaron will make sure they do their work. The Levites Are Counted Again
translation_verse: Bɔrɛmatapo nimuso Ɛɛrɔn pibinyɛn, Itama e baa keni bumo so nɛ b baa shuŋ bumo be ashuŋ nɛnɛ. B ka karga Livaiebi na be asheŋ

english_verse: Moses, Aaron, and the other Israelite leaders obeyed the Lord and counted the Levi tribe by families and clans, to find out how many men there were between the ages of
translation_verse: Kananɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ baŋ kaŋɛ Mosis na gbagba chap nɛ e daŋ shin nɛ b karga basa na nseŋ shin nɛ b sa ekama malɛ mbe kushuŋ.

english_verse: to say to the people of Israel, “Put out of the camp everyone who has leprosy or a bodily discharge or who has touched a dead body. Now that I live among my people, their camp must be kept clean.”
translation_verse: Men ju benyɛn nɛ beche kama nɛ b wora eyurpi daŋkare be ekpa so, saŋɛ na so b maaŋ jija keeyi mo nɛ ma nɛ menyi kikɛ wɔ kumo to na.”

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: If any of you commit a crime against someone, you have sinned against me.
translation_verse: e kaŋɛ Israɛlebi na fanɛ, esa kama nɛ e wora n da mo barkasa so wora n da mo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na gba so nna na.

english_verse: You must confess your guilt and pay the victim in full for whatever damage has been done, plus a fine of
translation_verse: Amoso amodoŋwura daga fanɛ e bugi to ŋ kaŋɛ mbe kulubi nseŋ ka esa nɛ e wora n da so na be kusɔ kama nɛ e jija nɛ kumo kalfa to be adunyɔ so n ti so na n tal to.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ naŋ kaŋɛ Mosis fanɛ

english_verse: If the victim has no relative who can accept this money, it belongs to me and will be paid to the priest. In addition to that payment, you must take a ram for the priest to sacrifice so your sin will be forgiven.
translation_verse: Ama nɛ esa nɛ b wora n da so na wu nna nsaa maa kɔ ekurgepo kama nɛ baaŋ ka kukɔ na n sa, kumo ere asɔ na ki Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ peya na nna na nseŋ daga fanɛ b ta kpakpa nɛ baaŋ ta n lara alubi be ketampaŋ be sarga n ti amo so ŋ ka n sa bɔrɛmatapo na pɔɛŋ nɛ esa na e nya alubi be ketampaŋ.

english_verse: When you make a donation to the sacred tent, that money belongs only to the priest, and each priest will keep what is given to him. A Suspicious Husband
translation_verse: Kakɛ kama malɛ nɛ b ta n sa bɔrɛmatapo kikɛ na la mo gbagba peya nna. Beche nɛ bumo kulana maŋ yirda bumo be asheŋ

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ naŋ kaŋɛ Mosis kenishipereso fanɛ

english_verse: to say to the people of Israel: Suppose a man becomes jealous and suspects that his wife has been unfaithful, but he has no proof.
translation_verse: e kaŋɛ Israɛlebi na fanɛ nɛ k ba fanɛ enyɛn maŋ wora mbe eche yirda ŋkpal e ka bee fɛ fanɛ eche na bee ji kubojua nna so,

english_verse: He must take his wife to the priest, together with one kilogram of ground barley as an offering to find out if she is guilty. No olive oil or incense is to be put on that offering.
translation_verse: kumo ere, k daga enyɛn na ka keta eche na nseŋ ta aboyunyifu kurwa koŋwule n ti so n yɔ bɔrɛmatapo kutɔ n ya sulge eche na so. Ama a maŋ daga e ka ta ɔlif be ŋku ŋko duwu n ti amo so, ŋkpal manɛ so, kukɔrkɔ be kesulge be sarga nna.

english_verse: The priest will lead the woman to my altar and make her stand there.
translation_verse: Bɔrɛmatapo na beeŋ shin nɛ eche na e ba yili bɔrɛsure na be anishito

english_verse: He will then pour sacred water into a clay jar and stir in some dust from the floor of the sacred tent.
translation_verse: nseŋ chulgi nchu cheembi n wɔtɔ kaba to nseŋ jɔ wajɛbu na to be shishɛr n wɔtɔ nchu na to nɛ a ki kekra.

english_verse: Next, he will remove her veil, then hand her the barley offering, and say, “If you have been faithful to your husband, this water won't harm you. But if you have been unfaithful, it will bring down the Lord's curse—you will never be able to give birth to a child, and everyone will curse your name.” Then the woman will answer, “If I am guilty, let it happen just as you say.”
translation_verse: Nchu ere e naŋ shin nɛ fo epun e tiŋ nɛ fo ki egbentepo malɛ gba n ti so.” Ndoŋ nna nɛ eche na e shuli so ŋ kaŋɛ le: “Mm, ma alɛ gba shuli loŋ.”

english_verse: The priest will write these curses on special paper and wash them off into the bitter water,
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ bɔrɛmatapo na e sibɛ kawɔl so nseŋ fɔr nsibɛ na n wɔtɔ nchu kekra na to,

english_verse: so that when the woman drinks this water, the curses will enter her body.
translation_verse: nseŋ shin nɛ eche na e nuu nchu na nɛ kɔnɔsho na e pɛ mo nɛ e ji ebesa ga.

english_verse: He will take the barley offering from her and lift it up in dedication to me, the Lord. Then he will place it on my altar
translation_verse: Nɛ bɔrɛmatapo e sɔ aboyunyifu be sarga na ashi kache na be enɔ to m maŋ amo so ŋ ŋini Ebɔrɛ nseŋ ta amo m bɛ bɔrɛsure na so.

english_verse: and burn part of it as a sacrifice. After that, the woman must drink the bitter water.
translation_verse: Kede be kaman nɛ e jɔ aboyunyifu na enɔ be bɔlɔ n deŋi bɔrɛsure na so n chɔɔ nseŋ shin nɛ eche na e nuu nchu na.

english_verse: But if she is innocent, her body will not be harmed, and she will still be able to have children.
translation_verse: Ama nɛ fanɛ eche na maŋ jija ebu bre, kumo ere shɛŋ shɛŋ maaŋ wora mo. Mo alɛ beeŋ kurge mbia.

english_verse: This is the ceremony that must take place at my altar when a husband suspects that his wife has been unfaithful. The priest must tell the woman to stand in my presence and carefully follow these instructions.
translation_verse: Mbra nɛ k dese n sa enyɛn kama nɛ e maŋ yirda mbe eche nsaa fɛ fanɛ eche na bee ji kubojua nna na. Bɔrɛmatapo na beeŋ shin nɛ eche na e ba yili bɔrɛsure na be anishito nɛ e wora le be daŋkaresheŋ ere.

english_verse: If the husband is wrong, he will not be punished; but if his wife is guilty, she will be punished.
translation_verse: Nɛ enyɛn na wora loŋ, kumo be kulubi maŋ bɛ mo so, ama nɛ fanɛ eche na wora n da so nna e beeŋ nya kumo be kasogberge.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ daŋ kaŋɛ Mosis nna fanɛ

english_verse: to say to the people of Israel: If any of you want to dedicate yourself to me by vowing to become a Nazirite,
translation_verse: e kaŋɛ Israɛl be basa le: “Benyɛn ŋko beche kama nɛ baa sha keta bumo be amu m bɔɔ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ enɔ a wɔtɔ n sa Ebɔrɛ nawule ŋ ki ‘Nazarin’ na,

english_verse: you must no longer drink any wine or beer or use any kind of vinegar. Don't drink grape juice or eat grapes or raisins—
translation_verse: maŋ daga fanɛ b nuu nsa kpakpaso be yiri kikɛ fanɛ amo nɛ b ta asɔrso nɛ baa tre greep n wora na. Bumo alɛ e sa maŋ kaŋ ji asɔrso nɛ baa tre greep na be awushiso ŋko amo be awɔlso gba.

english_verse: The hair of a Nazirite is sacred to me, and as long as you are a Nazirite, you must never cut your hair.
translation_verse: Baŋ yili jemanɛ nɛ b nase nnɔ fanɛ baaŋ baa wɔtɔ n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nawule na n ya fo kumo be ekar, a maŋ daga fanɛ b she bumo be emin. B yige emin na nɛ a daŋ nteŋ.

english_verse: not even that of your father, mother, brother, or sister. That would make you unclean. Your hair is the sign that you are dedicated to me, so remain holy.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, jemanɛ nɛ b lara bumo be amu n yili fanɛ b wɔtɔ nna n sa Ebɔrɛ nawule na, b la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na peya nna.

english_verse: Then on the next day, bring two doves or two pigeons to the priest at the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Kumo be kachɛ burwasopo na nɛ e ta elepɔ anyɔ ŋko ali anyɔ m ba sa bɔrɛmatapo na ashi Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be wajɛbu na be kabuna to.

english_verse: He will offer one of the birds as a sacrifice for sin and the other as a sacrifice to please me. You will then be forgiven for being too near a dead body, and your hair will again become sacred.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ bɔrɛmatapo na e ta mbuibi na be eko n lara kulubi be sarga nseŋ ta eko malɛ n lara sarga chɔɔso ŋ kule kulubi be ketampaŋ n sa bumo, ŋkpal esa ka wu mbe anishito so. Kumo be kamɔnchɛ kikɛ nɛ e naŋ ta mbe amu n yili cheembi n sa Ebɔrɛ,

english_verse: But the dead body made you unacceptable, so you must make another vow to become a Nazirite and be dedicated once more. Finally, a year-old ram must be offered as the sacrifice to make things right.
translation_verse: nseŋ naŋ ta mbe kumu n yili fanɛ esa nɛ e wɔtɔ n sa Ebɔrɛ nawule. Kumo be kaman nɛ e ta kpakpa nɛ k fo kafɛ m ba lara kejintɔr be sarga ŋkpal e ka daŋ barga mbe amu Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kutɔ jemanɛ ko so.

english_verse: When you have completed your promised time of being a Nazirite, go to the sacred tent
translation_verse: Jemanɛ nɛ e nase nnɔ fanɛ e baa wɔtɔ n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nawule na baŋ fo ekar e beeŋ yɔ Enyɛnpe be wajɛbu na be kabuna to

english_verse: and offer three animals that have nothing wrong with them: a year-old ram as a sacrifice to please me, a year-old female lamb as a sacrifice for sin, and a full-grown ram as a sacrifice to ask my blessing.
translation_verse: n ya ta asɔbɔya asa nɛ a maŋ kɔ ndulgi amo so n lara sarga n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ. Baaŋ ta kpakpafɔlbi nɛ k fo kafɛ n lara sarga chɔɔso, n ta kubolpɔche nɛ k fo kafɛ n lara alubi be ketampaŋ be sarga nseŋ ta kpakpa nɛ k daŋ n yili n lara kɔnɔkoŋwule be sarga.

english_verse: Wine offerings and grain sacrifices must also be brought with these animals. Finally, you are to bring a basket of bread made with your finest flour and olive oil, but without yeast. Also bring some thin wafers brushed with oil.
translation_verse: A daga fanɛ b ta bodobodo nɛ a maŋ kɔ yiisi nɛ b ta nyifu nɛ ɔlif be ŋku n wora na kelantaŋɛ be bɔlɔ nɛ ekrakashi nɛ amo alɛ gba maŋ kɔ yisi na nɛ ayu nɛ asɔnuuso n ti asɔbɔya na so n lara sarga na.

english_verse: The priest will take these gifts to my altar and offer them, so that I will be pleased and will forgive you.
translation_verse: Bɔrɛmatapo na beeŋ ta kpakpafɔlbi na nɛ kebolpɔche na n lara alubi be ketampaŋ be sarga nɛ sarga chɔɔso n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ.

english_verse: After that, you will stand at the entrance to the sacred tent, shave your head, and put the hair in the fire where the priest has offered the sacrifice to ask my blessing.
translation_verse: Ade kikɛ be kaman nɛ esa nɛ e ta mbe kumu n yili n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nawule na e she mbe kumu ashi Enyɛnpe be wajɛbu na be kabuna to nseŋ ta emin na n wɔtɔ kɔnɔkoŋwule be sarga be edɛ na to n chɔɔ.

english_verse: Once the meat from the ram's shoulder has been boiled, the priest will take it, along with one loaf of bread and one wafer brushed with oil, and give them to you.
translation_verse: B baaŋ daŋɛ kpakpa na be keba nɛ k bel, nɛ bɔrɛmatapo na e ta kumo nseŋ lara bodobodo nɛ krakashi koŋwule ashi kelantaŋɛ na to m bɔɔ esa nɛ e ta mbe kumu n yili n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na enɔ.

english_verse: You will hand them back to the priest, who will lift them up in dedication to me. Then he can eat the meat from the ram's shoulder, its choice ribs, and its hind leg, because this is his share of the sacrifice. After this, you will no longer be a Nazirite, and you will be free to drink wine.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ bɔrɛmatapo na e sɔ amo n ya sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ fanɛ kakɛ lela nɛ k ki sarga cheembi na, nseŋ ta amo n ti kpakpa na be kagbene nɛ kebɛaŋ nɛ a la bɔrɛmatapo peya mbra be ekpa so na so. Kede be kaman, e maaŋ naa la esa nɛ e ta mbe kumu n yili n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nawule nsaa beeŋ tiŋ a nuu nsa.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses,
translation_verse: Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ naŋ kaŋɛ Mosis

english_verse: “When Aaron and his sons bless the people of Israel, they must say:
translation_verse: fanɛ e kaŋɛ Ɛɛrɔn nɛ mbe mbinyɛnsobi fanɛ

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will bless and protect you,
translation_verse: b baa kule le be kabɔrɛkule a sa Israɛlebi na: “Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e nɛfa menyi nsaa kuŋ menyi.

english_verse: and that he will show you mercy and kindness.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be kelela nɛ mbe kuwɔr be kakɛ e baa wɔ menyi so.

english_verse: May the Lord be good to you and give you peace.”
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be kuwɔr nɛ mbe kagbenewushi e baa wɔ menyi so.”

english_verse: Then the Lord said, “If Aaron and his sons ask me to bless the Israelites, I will give them my blessing.”
translation_verse: “Ŋkpal manɛ so, b baŋ ta ma ketre ŋ kule nɛfa n sa Israɛlebi na, ma alɛ beeŋ nɛfa bumo.”

english_verse: When Moses had finished setting up the sacred tent, he dedicated it to the Lord, together with its furnishings, the altar, and its equipment.
translation_verse: Mosis ka yuu Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be wajɛbu na n loge, nɛ e duga ŋku n do kumo so nseŋ ta kumo nɛ kumo be asɔ nɛ b kɔ a yuu kumo na nɛ bɔrɛsure na nɛ kumo be asɔ kikɛ m bɔɔ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na enɔ.

english_verse: Then the twelve tribal leaders of Israel, the same men who had been in charge of counting the people, came to the tent
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Israɛl be yiri kuduanyɔ na be mbuna mbuna be bejuŋkparpoana nɛ b daŋ chɛ to ŋ karga basa na,

english_verse: with gifts for the Lord. They brought six strong carts and twelve oxen—one ox from each leader and a cart from every two.
translation_verse: bar eturko ashe nɛ egbolufɛlso kuduanyɔ. Bumo be ekama daŋ bar gbolu fɛlso nna nɛ bumo be benyɔ nyɔ malɛ chɛ abar m bar eturko koko nɛ a la bumo be kakɛ m ba sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ashi Enyɛnpe be wajɛbu na ase.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses,
translation_verse: Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ Mosis le:

english_verse: “Accept these gifts, so the Levites can use them here at the sacred tent for carrying the sacred things.”
translation_verse: “Sɔ ŋkɛ ere n yili kushuŋ nɛ baa shuŋ so m barga amo to n sa Livaiebi na nɛ b baa ta amo a sulɔ wajɛbu na nɛ asɔ cheembi nɛ a wɔ kumo to na.”

english_verse: Then Moses took the carts and oxen and gave them to the Levites,
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Mosis barga eturko na nɛ egbolufɛlso na to n sa Livaiebi na.

english_verse: who were under the leadership of Ithamar son of Aaron. Moses gave two carts and four oxen to the Gershonites for their work, and four carts and eight oxen to the Merarites for their work.
translation_verse: nseŋ ta eturko ana nɛ egbolufɛlso aburwa malɛ n sa Mɛrariebi na. Ɛɛrɔn pibinyɛn, Itama e daa keni bumo kikɛ so.

english_verse: But Moses did not give any to the Kohathites, because they were in charge of the sacred objects that had to be carried on their shoulders.
translation_verse: Ama Mosis daa maŋ sa Kohafebi na bre asɔ na be kekama, ŋkpal manɛ so, abatimu so e daga fanɛ bumo ere e baa sulɔ asɔ cheembi nɛ baa keni so na.

english_verse: On the day the altar was dedicated, the twelve leaders brought offerings for its dedication.
translation_verse: Kachɛ nɛ baa ta bɔrɛsure na a bɔɔ Ebɔrɛ enɔ na, bejuŋkparpoana na daŋ bar bumo be ŋkɛ nna nɛ b wora kumo.

english_verse: So each leader brought the following gifts: a silver bowl that weighed one and a half kilograms and a silver sprinkling bowl weighing almost a kilogram, both of them filled with flour and olive oil as grain sacrifices and weighed according to the official standards; a small gold dish filled with incense; a young bull, a full-grown ram, and a year-old ram as sacrifices to please the Lord; a goat as a sacrifice for sin; and two bulls, five full-grown rams, five goats, and five rams a year old as sacrifices to ask the Lord's blessing. The tribal leaders brought their gifts and offerings in the following order: On the first day Nahshon from Judah, on the second day Nethanel from Issachar, on the third day Eliab from Zebulun, on the fourth day Elizur from Reuben, on the fifth day Shelumiel from Simeon, on the sixth day Eliasaph from Gad, on the seventh day Elishama from Ephraim, on the eighth day Gamaliel from Manasseh, on the ninth day Abidan from Benjamin, on the tenth day Ahiezer from Dan, on the eleventh day Pagiel from Asher, on the twelfth day Ahira from Naphtali.
translation_verse: Le nɛ bejuŋkparpoana na daŋ ta bumo be ŋkɛ m ba kebɛso kebɛso so: Aminadab pibinyɛn Naashɔn nɛ e shi Juda be yiri to na e daŋ bar mbe kakɛ kachɛ juŋkparso na. Nɛ Zuwa pibinyɛn Nataniɛl nɛ e shi Isaaka be yiri to na bar mo peya kachɛ nyɔsopo na. Nɛ Hɛlɔn pibinyɛn Eliab nɛ e shi Zebulun be yiri to na bar mo peya kachɛ sasopo na. Nɛ Shedur pibinyɛn Elizur nɛ e shi Ruben be yiri to na bar mo peya kachɛ nasopo na. Nɛ Zurishaddai pibinyɛn Shelumiɛl nɛ mo alɛ shi Simiɔn be yiri to na bar mo peya kachɛ nusopo na. Nɛ Duwɛl pibinyɛn Eliazaf nɛ e shi Gad be yiri to na bar mo peya kachɛ shesopo na. Nɛ Amihuud pibinyɛn Elishama nɛ e shi Efreim be yiri to na bar mo peya kachɛ shunusopo na. Nɛ Pɛdazur pibinyɛn Gamaliɛl nɛ e shi Manase be yiri to na bar mo peya kachɛ burwasopo na. Nɛ Gidiɔni pibinyɛn Abidan nɛ e shi Bɛnjamin be yiri to na bar mo peya kachɛ kpanusopo na. Nɛ Amishadai pibinyɛn Ahieza nɛ e shi Dan be yiri to na bar mo peya kachɛ kudusopo na. Nɛ Okran pibinyɛn Pagiɛl nɛ e shi Ashɛr be yiri to na bar mo peya kachɛ kudukakosopo na. Nɛ Eenan pibinyɛn Ahira nɛ mo alɛ shi Naftali be yiri to na bar mo peya kachɛ kudu anyɔsopo na. Ŋkɛ nɛ bumo be ekama daŋ bar na daŋ duli abar nna. Amo be ako e la gbiti be katishaŋ nɛ kumo be egbɛ la kilo nɛ bargato nɛ gbiti be katishaŋgboŋ nɛ kumo alɛ be egbɛ sa fanɛ kilo koŋwule na, nseŋ karga nyifu n ta ŋku ŋ gbiti amo n wɔtɔ ntishaŋ anyɔ na to n lara ayu be sargajibi n ta shuwa be katishambi nɛ kumo be egbɛ maŋ fo kilo be bargato gba nɛ duwu bɔlɔ kumo nɛ gbolu fɔlbi nɛ kpakpa nɛ k daŋ n yili nɛ kpakpafɔlbi nɛ k fo kafɛ nseŋ ta amo kikɛ n lara sarga chɔɔso. Kumo be kaman nɛ b ta kaboe n lara alubi be sarga nseŋ ta egbolu anyɔ nɛ ekpakpa anu nɛ mboe anu nɛ ekpakpafɔlbi nɛ b fo nfɛ koko anu n lara kɔnɔkoŋwule be sarga.

english_verse: Whenever Moses needed to talk with the Lord, he went into the sacred tent, where he heard the Lord's voice coming from between the two winged creatures above the lid of the sacred chest.
translation_verse: Mosis ka yɔ wajɛbu na to nɛ mo nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e ya malga abar kutɔ, nɛ e nu Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be ebɔl ka shi mpɔrduli nɛ baa tre Chɛrubim nɛ b pɔr n yili ŋkre be deka be buuso na so na be nferinto a malga mo kutɔ.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses,
translation_verse: Le nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ daŋ kaŋɛ Mosis,

english_verse: “Tell Aaron to put the seven lamps on the lampstand so they shine toward the front.”
translation_verse: “Kaŋɛ Ɛɛrɔn fanɛ e kaŋ chɔɔ efitila ashunu na so, e ta amo n yili kefitilatɔl na so nɛ a baa fulto kumo be anishito.”

english_verse: Aaron obeyed and placed the lamps as he was told.
translation_verse: Nɛ Ɛɛrɔn chɔɔ efitila na so n yili kefitilatɔl na so n shoŋi anishito fanɛ kananɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ na.

english_verse: The lampstand was made of hammered gold from its base to the decorative flowers on top, exactly like the pattern the Lord had described to Moses. Instructions for Ordaining the Levites
translation_verse: Kananɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ daŋ kaŋɛ Mosis na gbagba chap nɛ e ta shuwa m bɛl n lɔŋɛ kefitilatɔl na kikɛ. Livaiebi na b keta m bɔɔ Ebɔrɛ enɔ be asheŋ

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ naŋ kaŋɛ Mosis le:

english_verse: The Levites must be acceptable to me before they begin working at the sacred tent. So separate them from the rest of the Israelites
translation_verse: “K daga fo ka lara Livaiebi na ashi Israɛlebi na to ŋ kɔr nseŋ shin nɛ b fɔr bumo be amu so daŋkare be ekpa so.

english_verse: They are to bring a bull and its proper grain sacrifice of flour mixed with olive oil. And they must bring a second bull as a sacrifice for sin.
translation_verse: Kede be kaman nɛ fo shin nɛ b bar egbolu fɔlbi anyɔ nɛ ayu nyifu nɛ b ta ɔlif be ŋku m baga amo.

english_verse: Then you, Moses, will call together all the people of Israel and send the Levites to my sacred tent,
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ fo tre Israɛlebi na kikɛ n shɛr nseŋ shin nɛ Livaiebi na e lar n yili ma Enyɛnpe be wajɛbu na be anishito,

english_verse: where the people will place their hands on them.
translation_verse: nɛ Israɛlebi na kikɛ e ta bumo be enɔana n deŋi n deŋi Livaiebi na be amu so.”

english_verse: Aaron will present the Levites to me as a gift from the people, so that the Levites will do my work.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ Ɛɛrɔn e ta Livaiebi na fanɛ kakɛ lela m bɔɔ ma enɔ nɛ b baa shuŋ ma kushuŋ.

english_verse: After this, the Levites are to place their hands on the heads of the bulls. Sacrifice one of the bulls for the forgiveness of sin, and the other to make sure that I am pleased. Then the Levites will be acceptable to me.
translation_verse: Nɛ Livaiebi na e ta bumo be enɔana n deŋi deŋi egbolu anyɔ na so, kumo be kaman nɛ b ta kuko n lara alubi be ketampaŋ be sarga nseŋ ta kuko malɛ n lara sarga chɔɔso, saŋɛ na so Livaiebi na beeŋ fɔr so n lar daŋkare be ekpa so.

english_verse: They will stand at my altar in front of Aaron and his sons, who will dedicate the Levites to me.
translation_verse: “Shin nɛ Livaiebi na e yili Ɛɛrɔn nɛ mbe mbinyɛnsobi na be anishito nɛ b ta bumo m bɔɔ ma enɔ.

english_verse: This ceremony will show that the Levites are different from the other Israelites and belong to me in a special way.
translation_verse: Kumo be loŋ e naaŋ ŋini fanɛ Livaiebi la meya nna nsaa kɔr Israɛlebi nɛ b ka na to.

english_verse: After they have been made acceptable and have been dedicated, they will be allowed to work at my sacred tent.
translation_verse: Fo baŋ fɔr Livaiebi na so nseŋ ta bumo m bɔɔ ma enɔ n loge na pɔɛŋ, nɛ baaŋ tiŋ a shuŋ ashi wajɛbu na to.

english_verse: They are mine and will take the place of the first-born Israelite sons.
translation_verse: Bumo e naaŋ baa la ma peya, ŋkpal manɛ so, bumo e naaŋ yili Israɛlebi be ewurkoŋnyɛn na be katelamu to n sa ma.

english_verse: When I killed the oldest sons of the Egyptians, I decided that the first-born sons in each Israelite family would be mine, as well as every first-born male from their flocks and herds.
translation_verse: Ŋ ka daŋ mɔ Ijiptebi be ewurkoŋnyɛn na, nɛ n yili kumo fanɛ Israɛlebi na be ewurkoŋnyɛn nɛ bumo be asɔbɔya be ewurkoŋnyɛn kikɛ la ma peya nna.

english_verse: But now I have chosen these Levites as substitutes for the first-born sons,
translation_verse: Ama naniere bre Livaiebi na nɛ n lara n yili Israɛl be ewurkoŋnyɛn na be katelamu.

english_verse: and I have given them as gifts to Aaron and his sons to serve at the sacred tent. I will hold them responsible for what happens to anyone who gets too close to the sacred tent. The Levites Are Dedicated to the Lord
translation_verse: Ma alɛ lara Livaiebi nna fanɛ kakɛ ashi Israɛlebi na to n sa Ɛɛrɔn nɛ mbe mbinyɛnsobi na nɛ b yili Israɛlebi na be katelamu to a shuŋ Enyɛnpe be wajɛbu na to saŋɛ na so Israɛlebi na maaŋ ba kumo ase nɛ aleblawu e ba bumo so.”

english_verse: Moses, Aaron, and the other Israelites made sure that the Levites did everything the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Mosis nɛ Ɛɛrɔn nɛ Israɛlebi na kikɛ ta Livaiebi na n bɔɔ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ enɔ fanɛ kananɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ Mosis na gbagba.

english_verse: The Levites sprinkled themselves with the water of forgiveness and washed their clothes. Then Aaron brought them to the altar and offered sacrifices to forgive their sins and make them acceptable to the Lord.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ Livaiebi na fɔrso n lar daŋkare be ekpa ŋ ki cheembi nseŋ fɔr bumo be asɔbuuso. Ndoŋ nna nɛ Ɛɛrɔn ta bumo m bɔɔ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na enɔ fanɛ kakɛ lela nɛ b nya alubi be ketampaŋ.

english_verse: The Lord also told Moses,
translation_verse: Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ naŋ kaŋɛ Mosis le:

english_verse: During the first month of Israel's second year in the Sinai Desert, the Lord had told Moses
translation_verse: Israɛlebi na ka lar Ijipt be efuli so na be kafɛ nyɔsopo be kufɔl juŋkparso to nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ malga Mosis kutɔ ashi Sainai be keshishɛrsawule so ŋ kaŋɛ mo le:

english_verse: in the evening of the fourteenth day of this month and do it by following all the regulations.”
translation_verse: “Kufɔl juŋkparso ere be kachɛ kuduanasopo na be kaaseso a daga Israɛlebi na ka nyiŋi kebansonchoŋ be kejigboŋ na be mbraana kikɛ nseŋ m bɛ amo so n ji kumo.”

english_verse: Moses told the people what the Lord had said, and they celebrated Passover there in the desert in the evening of the fourteenth day of the first month.
translation_verse: Amoso kananɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ daŋ kaŋɛ Mosis na gbagba chap nɛ b daŋ ji kumo kufɔl juŋkparso na be kachɛ kuduanasopo na ashi Sainai be keshishɛrsawule na so.

english_verse: Some people in Israel's camp had touched a dead body and had become unfit to worship the Lord, and they could not celebrate Passover. But they asked Moses and Aaron,
translation_verse: Basa na be beko daŋ wora eyurpi nna daŋkare be ekpa so ŋkpal b ka beta ebuni so. Amoso b daa maŋ tiŋ n ji kebansonchoŋ be kejigboŋ na loŋ be kachɛ na. Ndoŋ nna nɛ b yɔ Mosis nɛ Ɛɛrɔn kutɔ

english_verse: “Even though we have touched a dead body, why can't we celebrate Passover and offer sacrifices to the Lord at the same time as everyone else?”
translation_verse: n ya kaŋɛ bumo le: “An wora eyurpi ŋkpal an ka beta ebuni so nna, ama manɛ nna nɛ anyi maaŋ tiŋ n ji kebansonchoŋ be kejigboŋ na nseŋ lara anyi be esarga m ba sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ loŋ be kachɛ na fanɛ kananɛ an braana Israɛlebi na wora na?”

english_verse: Moses said, “Wait here while I go into the sacred tent and find out what the Lord says about this.”
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Mosis kaŋɛ bumo le: “Men jo n ya fo saŋɛ nɛ meeŋ nu kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kɔ nɛ e kaŋɛ a laŋɛ menyi be kaplɛa so.”

english_verse: The Lord then told Moses
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ Mosis

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: If any of you or your descendants touch a dead body and become unfit to worship me, or if you are away on a long journey, you may still celebrate Passover.
translation_verse: fanɛ e kaŋɛ Israɛlebi na le: “Nɛ fanɛ menyi to be eko ŋko menyi be kaman to ebi ko wora eyurpi ŋkpal b ka beta ebuni so ŋko b wɔ ekpa wɔfɔ be enite to, bumo alɛ nsaa sha keji kebansonchoŋ be kejigboŋ na,

english_verse: But it must be done in the second month, in the evening of the fourteenth day. Eat the Passover lamb with thin bread and bitter herbs,
translation_verse: kumo ere b ji kumo kufɔl nyɔsopo na to be kachɛ kuduanasopo na be kaaseso. Kumo alɛ daga b ka ta bodobodo nɛ a maŋ kɔ yiisi nɛ afantaŋ nɛ a du kekra n ti kebansonchoŋ be kpakpafɔlbi na so nna ji n kumo.

english_verse: and don't leave any of it until morning or break any of the animal's bones. Be sure to follow these regulations.
translation_verse: Ajibi na maŋ daga keyili ŋklade. Bumo alɛ e sa maŋ kaŋ bure kpakpafɔlbi na be kuwibi kama to. K daga fanɛ b bɛ kebansonchoŋ be mbra na so.

english_verse: But if any of you are fit to worship me, and yet refuse to celebrate Passover when you are not away on a journey, you will no longer belong to my people. You will be punished because you did not offer sacrifices to me at the proper time.
translation_verse: Ama nɛ fanɛ esa walɛ so daŋkare be ekpa so mo alɛ nsaa maa wɔ enite to nseŋ kini kebansonchoŋ be kejigboŋ na be keji, kumo ere m maŋ naa ber mo a ti ma basa so, ŋkpal e ka kini kelara sarga n sa ma saŋɛ nɛ k daga so. Mo alɛ beeŋ nya mbe kulubi be kasogberge

english_verse: Anyone, including foreigners who live among you, can celebrate Passover, if they follow all the regulations. The Cloud over the Sacred Tent (Exodus
translation_verse: Kadetobia ŋko efɔ kama nɛ e wɔ menyi to nsaa sha keji kebansonchoŋ be kejigboŋ na daga fanɛ e bɛ kumo be mbraana kikɛ so nɛnɛ nna n ji kumo.”

english_verse: As soon as the sacred tent was set up, a thick cloud appeared and covered it. The cloud was there each day, and during the night, a fire could be seen in it.
translation_verse: Kachɛ nɛ b yuu Enyɛnpe be wajɛbu na, awɔlpa daŋ ba buu kumo kikɛ so nna a wɔ ndoŋ. Kanyɛ baŋ biri kuwɔlpa na bee kilgi nna n duli fanɛ edɛ na.

english_verse: The Lord used this cloud to tell the Israelites when to move their camp and where to set it up again. As long as the cloud covered the tent, the Israelites did not break camp. But when the cloud moved, they followed it, and wherever it stopped, they camped and stayed there,
translation_verse: Nchɛ kama nɛ kuwɔlpa na beeŋ yili Enyɛnpe be wajɛbu na be esoso n ya fo, Israɛlebi na malɛ bee wora Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kasonu nna n chena ndoŋ.

english_verse: whether it was only one night, a few days, a month, or even a year. As long as the cloud remained over the tent, the Israelites stayed where they were. But when the cloud moved, so did the Israelites.
translation_verse: Hale nchɛ anyɔ ŋko kufɔl ŋko kafɛ gba nɛ kuwɔlpa na buu wajɛbu na so, bumo alɛ gba baa wɔ keeyi na to nna. Ama k baŋ tia, bumo alɛ gba bee kaa nna m bɛ kumo so.

english_verse: They obeyed the Lord's commands and went wherever he directed Moses.
translation_verse: Kaplɛkama malɛ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ baŋ ŋini Mosis fanɛ b yɔ, ndoŋ nɛ baa yɔ.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses:
translation_verse: Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ Mosis le:

english_verse: Have someone make two trumpets out of hammered silver. These will be used to call the people together and to give the signal for moving your camp.
translation_verse: “Ta gbiti m bɛl mbel anyɔ nɛ baaŋ baa foŋ a tre basa na a shɛr abar so ŋko a shin nɛ b baa kaa keeyi to.

english_verse: If both trumpets are blown, everyone is to meet with you at the entrance to the sacred tent.
translation_verse: B baŋ foŋ mbel anyɔ na, basa na kikɛ daga fanɛ b shɛr fo anishito ashi Enyɛnpe be wajɛbu na be kabuna to nna.

english_verse: But if just one is blown, only the twelve tribal leaders need to come together.
translation_verse: Ama nɛ b foŋ kabel koŋwule bre, kumo ere Israɛl be eyiri kuduanyɔ na be bejuŋkparpoana e daga fanɛ b shɛr fo anishito.

english_verse: Give a signal on a trumpet when it is time to break camp. The first blast will be the signal for the tribes camped on the east side, and the second blast will be the signal for those on the south.
translation_verse: B baŋ naŋ foŋ mbel na gbrɛbi kela nyɔsopo nseŋ yige, eyiri nɛ bumo alɛ chena kelargato be kaseto be kaba so na e naaŋ kaa m bɛ so. Amoso, mbel na be kefoŋ gbrɛbi nseŋ yige, bee ŋini nna fanɛ b kaa keeyi to na.

english_verse: But when you want everyone to come together, sound a different signal on the trumpet.
translation_verse: Ama nɛ fee sha basa na kikɛ ka shɛr abar so malɛ nna, kumo ere k daga fanɛ b foŋ mbel anyɔ na n chɛr.

english_verse: The priests of Aaron's family will be the ones to blow the trumpets, and this law will never change.
translation_verse: Ɛɛrɔn be kanaŋ to ebi be mbinyɛnsobiana nɛ b la bɔrɛmatapoana e daga fanɛ b baa foŋ mbel na. Loŋ malɛ nɛ k beeŋ ba la hale mbaanaayɔ.

english_verse: Whenever you go into battle against an enemy attacking your land, give a warning signal on the trumpets. Then I, the Lord, will hear it and rescue you.
translation_verse: Nɛ men doŋana kaŋ baa kaa kɔ menyi kena men gbagba be kasawule so nɛ men foŋ mbel na, ma Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ nu nseŋ ba mɔlga menyi.

english_verse: During the celebration of the New Moon Festival and other religious festivals, sound the trumpets while you offer sacrifices. This will be a reminder that I am the Lord your God. The Israelites Begin Their Journey
translation_verse: Nɛ men baa ji menyi be kufɔl popɔr be kejigboŋ nɛ kabɔrɛshuŋ be kejigboŋana ko, k daga men baa foŋ mbel na saŋɛ nɛ menyee lara sarga chɔɔso nɛ kɔnɔkoŋwuleso be esarga na nɛ ma nɛ n la men Nyɛnpe nɛ men be Ebɔrɛ na e chɛ menyi to.”

english_verse: On the twentieth day of the second month of that same year, the cloud over the sacred tent moved on.
translation_verse: Israɛlebi na ka lar Ijipt be kasawule so be kafɛ nyɔsopo to be kufɔl nyɔsopo to be kachɛ adunyɔsopo na nɛ kuwɔlpa nɛ k buu Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be wajɛbu na so na tia a yɔ,

english_verse: So the Israelites broke camp and left the Sinai Desert. And some time later, the cloud stopped in the Paran Desert.
translation_verse: nɛ Israɛlebi na malɛ gba lar Sainai be keshishɛrsawule na so nseŋ pɛ ekpa m bɛ kuwɔlpa na so hale nɛ k ya yili Paran be keshishɛrsawule so.

english_verse: This was the first time the Lord had told Moses to command the people of Israel to move on.
translation_verse: Kede e la Israɛlebi na be enite juŋkparso nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ bɔla Mosis so ŋ kaŋɛ bumo fanɛ b koso a yɔ.

english_verse: Judah and the tribes that camped alongside it marched out first, carrying their banner. Nahshon son of Amminadab was the leader of the Judah tribe,
translation_verse: Juda be yiri nɛ eyiri nɛ b chena m mata bumo na e daŋ ta bumo be etuuta n juŋkpar n lar. Aminadab pibinyɛn Naashɔn e daa la bumo be benapo be ejuŋkparpo.

english_verse: Nethanel son of Zuar was the leader of the Issachar tribe,
translation_verse: Zuwa pibinyɛn Nataniɛl e daa la Isaaka be yiri to be benapo be ejuŋkparpo

english_verse: and Eliab son of Helon was the leader of the Zebulun tribe.
translation_verse: nɛ Hɛlɔn pibinyɛn Eliab malɛ daa juŋkpar Zebulun be yiri to be benapo.

english_verse: The sacred tent had been taken down, and the Gershonites and the Merarites carried it, marching behind the Judah camp.
translation_verse: B ka bee kaa na nɛ b gboŋi wajɛbu na to nɛ Gɛshɔn nɛ Mɛrari be mbunaebi nɛ b la Livaiebi nɛ bumo be kushuŋ la wajɛbu na be kesulɔ na ta kumo n sulɔ a yɔ.

english_verse: Reuben and the tribes that camped alongside it marched out second, carrying their banner. Elizur son of Shedeur was the leader of the Reuben tribe,
translation_verse: Nɛ Ruben be yiri nɛ eyiri nɛ b chena m mata bumo na, ta bumo be etuuta m bɛ so a la katuŋ nyɔsopo a yɔ. Shedur pibinyɛn Elizur e daa la bumo be benapo be ejuŋkparpo.

english_verse: Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai was the leader of the Simeon tribe,
translation_verse: Zurishaddai malɛ pibinyɛn Shelumiɛl e daa la Simiɔn be yiri to be benapo be ejuŋkparpo,

english_verse: and Eliasaph son of Deuel was the leader of the Gad tribe.
translation_verse: nɛ Duwɛl pibinyɛn Eliazaf malɛ daa la Gad be yiri to be benapo be ejuŋkparpo.

english_verse: Next were the Kohathites, carrying the objects for the sacred tent, which was to be set up before they arrived at the new camp.
translation_verse: Kohaf be kabuna ebi nɛ b la Livaiebi na be kushuŋ e daa la asɔ cheembi nɛ baa ta a wora asheŋ wajɛbu na to be kebaasulɔ. Ama a daga b ka yuu wajɛbu na keeyi popɔr na to nna pɔɛŋ nɛ bumo kikɛ e fo ndoŋ.

english_verse: Ephraim and the tribes that camped alongside it marched next, carrying their banner. Elishama son of Ammihud was the leader of the Ephraim tribe,
translation_verse: Efreim be yiri nɛ eyiri nɛ b chena m mata bumo na malɛ e naaŋ baa la katuŋ sasopo ŋ keta bumo be etuuta m bɛ so. Amihuud pibinyɛn Elishama e daa la Efreim be yiri na to be benapo be ejuŋkparpo.

english_verse: Gamaliel son of Pedahzur was the leader of the Manasseh tribe,
translation_verse: Pɛdazur pibinyɛn Gamaliɛl e daa la Manase be yiri to be benapo be ejuŋkparpo,

english_verse: and Abidan son of Gideoni was the leader of the Benjamin tribe.
translation_verse: nɛ Gidiɔni Pibinyɛn Abidan malɛ la Bɛnjamin be yiri to be benapo be ejuŋkparpo.

english_verse: Dan and the tribes that camped alongside it were to protect the Israelites against an attack from behind, and so they marched last, carrying their banner. Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai was the leader of the tribe of Dan,
translation_verse: Dan be yiri nɛ eyiri nɛ a chena m mata bumo na e naaŋ baa la katuŋ lalalogesopo n ta bumo be etuuta a wɔ kaman a kuŋ. Amishadai pibinyɛn Ahieza e daa la Dan be yiri to be benapo be ejuŋkparpo.

english_verse: Pagiel son of Ochran was the leader of the Asher tribe,
translation_verse: Okran pibinyɛn Pagiɛl malɛ e daa la Ashɛr be yiri to be benapo be ejuŋkparpo,

english_verse: and Ahira son of Enan was the leader of the Naphtali tribe.
translation_verse: nɛ Eenan malɛ pibinyɛn Ahira daa la Naftali be yiri to be benapo be ejuŋkparpo.

english_verse: This was the order in which the Israelites marched each time they moved their camp.
translation_verse: Israɛlebi na baa kaa bumo be keeyi to, kananɛ baa nite kebɛso kebɛso so nna na.

english_verse: Hobab the Midianite, the father-in-law of Moses, was there. And Moses said to him, “We're leaving for the place the Lord has promised us. He has said that all will go well for us. So come along, and we will make sure that all goes well for you.”
translation_verse: B ka bee bela ase nɛ b kaa na, nɛ Mosis kaŋɛ Jetro pibinyɛn Hobab nɛ e la mo ere Mosis mo churo na le: “Anyee bela ase nna nɛ an yɔ kakpa nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nase kɔnɔ fanɛ e beeŋ sa anyi na. Mo e kaŋɛ fanɛ e beeŋ nɛfa Israɛl, amoso bɛ anyi so, asheŋ beeŋ ya nyalɛ n sa anyi kikɛ.”

english_verse: “No, I won't go,” Hobab answered. “I'm returning home to be with my own people.”
translation_verse: Nɛ Hobab kaŋɛ le: “M-m ma ere bee bɛta nna a yɔ ma efuli so, amoso m maaŋ yɔ.”

english_verse: “Please go with us!” Moses said. “You can be our guide because you know the places to camp in the desert.
translation_verse: Nɛ Mosis malɛ kaŋɛ mo le: “Jande, sa maŋ yige anyi, ŋkpal manɛ so, fo e nyi mboŋ nɛ a daga an baa wora anyi be keeyi to a yili saŋkama, amoso fo e naaŋ baa juŋkpar a ŋini anyi akpa.

english_verse: Besides that, if you go, we will give you a share of the good things the Lord gives us.”
translation_verse: Nɛ fo baŋ tu anyi n yɔ, nɛfa kama nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ beeŋ ta n nɛfa anyi na, fo alɛ gba beeŋ nya ako.” Basa na ka lar a yɔ be asheŋ

english_verse: The people of Israel began their journey from Mount Sinai. They traveled three days, and the Levites who carried the sacred chest led the way, so the Lord could show them where to camp.
translation_verse: Basa na ka lar kebeegboŋ cheembi nɛ baa tre Sainai na ase, nchɛ asa nɛ b wɔ enite to. Livaiebi na e daa sulɔ ŋkre be deka na a juŋkpar a fin kaboŋ nɛ k daga b wora bumo be keeyi to.

english_verse: Each day as the Israelites began their journey, Moses would pray, “Our Lord, defeat your enemies and make them run!”
translation_verse: Saŋkama nɛ Livaiebi na baŋ ta ŋkre be deka na n lar a yɔ, le nɛ Mosis daa kaŋɛ: “Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, koso ŋ kɔ fo doŋana n shin nɛ b pesaŋ to n shile.”

english_verse: And when they stopped to set up camp, he would pray, “Our Lord, stay close to Israel's thousands and thousands of people.”
translation_verse: Saŋkama malɛ nɛ b baŋ yili, e bee kaŋɛ le nna: “Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, naŋ bɛta n shin nɛ Israɛl be basa kikɛ e pin fanɛ fo wɔ anyi kutɔ.”

english_verse: One day the Israelites started complaining about their troubles. The Lord heard them and became so angry that he destroyed the outer edges of their camp with fire.
translation_verse: Israɛlebi na fara nna a fubel a bile asheŋ ŋkpal awurfoŋ nɛ b daa ji so. Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ka nu bumo be nfubel na nɛ e nya agbo nseŋ shin nɛ edɛ ba bumo to m ba chɔɔ bumo be keeyi na to be ekarso.

english_verse: When the people begged Moses to help, he prayed, and the fire went out.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ basa na shu ŋ ŋini Mosis fanɛ e chɛ bumo to, nɛ e kule Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ edɛ na duŋ.

english_verse: They named the place “Burning,” because in his anger the Lord had set their camp on fire. The People Grumble about Being Hungry
translation_verse: Amoso b daŋ nase kakpa na be ketre Tabera nna, ŋkpal Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be edɛ ka daŋ chɔɔ bumo be keeyi to ndoŋ so. Mosis ka lara bejuŋkparpo adushunu be asheŋ

english_verse: One day some foreigners among the Israelites became greedy for food, and even the Israelites themselves began moaning, “We don't have any meat!
translation_verse: Kachako nɛ befɔ nɛ b daŋ tu Israɛlebi na a yɔ na fara a yɛlga ajibi ko kenishipereso, ndoŋ nna nɛ Israɛlebi na gba fara a fubel a bile asheŋ a kaŋɛ le: “Anyi maŋ nya eblaŋ kikɛ nɛ an we!

english_verse: In Egypt we could eat all the fish we wanted, and there were cucumbers, melons, all kinds of onions, and garlic.
translation_verse: Ama an ka daa wɔ Ijipt na bre, an daa nya ekɔrɔtɔ kananɛ anyee sha nna a we jiga. Eŋampo nɛ asɔrso nɛ baa tre watamelɔŋ nɛ albasa be eyiri yiri kikɛ wɔ ndoŋ nna nɛ an daa ji anyi be kepar.

english_verse: But we're starving out here, and the only food we have is this manna.”
translation_verse: Ama naniere bre, akoŋ gbagba e naa mɔ anyi. Ajibi nɛ baa tre manna na nawule a baa wɔtɔ karechɛ kikɛ!”

english_verse: and tasted like something baked with sweet olive oil. It appeared at night with the dew. In the morning the people would collect the manna, grind or crush it into flour, then boil it and make it into thin wafers.
translation_verse: Kanyɛso nɛ a daa tɔr fanɛ bunyaŋ na nɛ b muu amo kachipurso nseŋ wuse amo nɛ a ki nyifu nɛ b daŋɛ amo ŋko n ta amo n wora ekrakashi. Amo alɛ wɔ ebel nna fanɛ bodobodo nɛ b ta ɔlif be ŋku n wora na.

english_verse: He prayed: I am your servant, Lord, so why are you doing this to me? What have I done to deserve this? You've made me responsible for all these people,
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ Mosis kule Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ŋ kaŋɛ le: “Manɛ nna nɛ fo shin nɛ le be asheŋ ere tu ma? Manɛ nna nɛ fo nya agbo n wɔtɔ ma loŋ? Manɛ nna nɛ fo ta basa ere be esulɔ kikɛ n sulɔ ma?

english_verse: but they're not my children. You told me to nurse them along and to carry them to the land you promised their ancestors.
translation_verse: Mannɛ ma e di bumo be kedampo ŋko ŋ kurge bumo! Nɛ mannɛ nna nɛ fee sha fanɛ ŋ keta bumo enɔ to fanɛ mbi popɔrbi n yɔ kasawule nɛ fo bɔ ntaŋ n nase kɔnɔ fanɛ feeŋ sa bumo nananyɛnana na so?

english_verse: They keep whining for meat, but where can I get meat for them?
translation_verse: Nnɛ nɛ meeŋ nya eblaŋ n sa basa damta nɛ baa ponte a cha awɔr fanɛ n sa bumo eblaŋ ere kikɛ?

english_verse: This job is too much for me. How can I take care of all these people by myself?
translation_verse: Kushuŋ ere bre du kpakpa ga n sa ma, m maaŋ tiŋ n sɔ basa ere kikɛ be esulɔ n sulɔ!

english_verse: If this is the way you're going to treat me, just kill me now and end my miserable life! Seventy Leaders Are Chosen To Help Moses
translation_verse: Nɛ le bre nɛ fee sha kewora ma, kumo ere wu ma kuwɔr nseŋ mɔ ma nɛ n wushi.”

english_verse: While I am talking with you there, I will give them some of your authority, so they can share responsibility for my people. You will no longer have to care for them by yourself.
translation_verse: Meeŋ gbelge m ba ndoŋ m ba malga menyi kutɔ, nseŋ sa bumo eleŋ nɛ n sa fo na, saŋɛ na so baaŋ baa chɛ fo to a keni ma basa so nɛ esulɔ na maaŋ naa la fo nawule peya.

english_verse: As for the Israelites, I have heard them complaining about not having meat and about being better off in Egypt. So tell them to make themselves acceptable to me, because tomorrow they will have meat.
translation_verse: Nɛ fo kaŋɛ basa na malɛ fanɛ b lara kulubi ashi bumo be ŋgbene to nseŋ ki cheembi m ba echefo m ba sɔ eblaŋ. Ŋkpal manɛ so, n nu b ka bee fubel a bile asheŋ fanɛ b maŋ nya eblaŋ nɛ b we, bumo alɛ ka daa wɔ Ijipt be efuli so na bɔ nfe. Naniere ma Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ sa menyi eblaŋ nɛ men we amo.

english_verse: . They turned against me and wanted to go back to Egypt. Now they will eat meat until they get sick of it.
translation_verse: ama kufɔl lelemu nɛ menyee we amo hale nɛ a fi menyi. Ŋkpal men ka kini ma nsaa fubel a bile asheŋ a kaŋɛ fanɛ men daa nyi gba nna, menyi maŋ lar Ijipt be efuli so so.”

english_verse: Even if we butchered all our sheep and cattle, or caught every fish in the sea, we wouldn't have enough to feed them.”
translation_verse: Hale nɛ an mɔ anyi be mbolpɔ nɛ ana kikɛ ŋko m pɛ teku to be ekɔrɔtɔ kikɛ gba, a kra maaŋ fo bumo.”

english_verse: The Lord answered, “I can do anything! Watch and you'll see my words come true.”
translation_verse: Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ le: “Kusɔ ko du ma Enyɛnpe na so kpakpa a? K maaŋ chɛr, menyeeŋ wu kusɔ nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ ere ka wora.”

english_verse: Eldad and Medad were two leaders who had not gone to the tent. But when the Spirit took control of them, they began shouting like prophets right there in camp.
translation_verse: Bejuŋkparpo adushunu na be benyɔ nɛ b da maŋ lar keeyi na to n yɔ wajɛbu na ase e daa la Eldad nɛ Mɛdad. Ama eleŋ na daŋ ba bumo alɛ gba so nna ashi keeyi na to nɛ b fara a malga a cha awɔr fanɛ anebiana na.

english_verse: A boy ran to Moses and told him about Eldad and Medad.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ kabrantiɛbia ko shile n ya kaŋɛ Mosis kusɔ nɛ Eldad nɛ Mɛdad bee wora ashi keeyi na to.

english_verse: Joshua was there helping Moses, as he had done since he was young. And he said to Moses, “Sir, you must stop them!”
translation_verse: Nɛ Nun pibinyɛn Joshuwa nɛ e la kabrantiɛbia a chɛ Mosis to na kaŋɛ mo le: “Jande n nyɛnpe, kaŋɛ Eldad nɛ Mɛdad nɛ b yige!”

english_verse: But Moses replied, “Are you concerned what this might do to me? I wish the Lord would give his Spirit to all his people so everyone could be a prophet.”
translation_verse: Nɛ Mosis malɛ kaŋɛ le: “Fee kɔ kukɔrkɔ nna a sa ma a? K daa beeŋ par ma ga fanɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ka beeŋ sa mbe basa kikɛ eleŋ nɛ b baa malga fanɛ anebiana!”

english_verse: Some time later the Lord sent a strong wind that blew quails in from the sea until Israel's camp was completely surrounded with birds, piled up about a meter high for many kilometers in every direction.
translation_verse: K maŋ chɛr ko nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ afu ber mbuibi ko nɛ baa tre kweels na ashi teku ase nɛ b ba kaa lɛa lɛa kasawule nseŋ tɔr n deŋi abar so n yɔ emayɛl damta ŋ kulti Israɛlebi be keeyi na to.

english_verse: The people picked up quails for two days—each person filled at least ten large baskets. Then they spread them out to dry.
translation_verse: Amoso nchɛ lelemu anyɔ nɛ basa na wɔtɔ a pɛ mbuibi na. Mbuibi nɛ ekama daŋ pɛ mbe kumu so be egbɛ kikɛ daa sa fanɛ kilo kagboŋ nna. B daŋ ta bumo nna n fata ŋ kulti keeyi na to kikɛ.

english_verse: But before the meat could be eaten, the Lord became angry and sent a deadly disease through the camp.
translation_verse: Ama pɔɛŋ nɛ b we eblaŋ na, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ daŋ nya agbo n wɔtɔ bumo nna nseŋ shin nɛ kulɔ be aleblawu tɔr bumo so.

english_verse: After they had buried the people who had been so greedy for meat, they called the place “Graves for the Greedy.”
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ b nase kakpa nɛ b puli basa nɛ kulɔ be aleblawu na mɔ na Kibrɔf Hataava. Kumo be kifito e la bejibishapo be nchaŋana.

english_verse: and told Moses, Aaron, and Miriam to come to the entrance of the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Epul na to nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ Mosis nɛ Ɛɛrɔn nɛ Miriam le: “Menyi besa kikɛ e ba Enyɛnpe be wajɛbu na ase.” Nɛ b lar n yɔ ndoŋ,

english_verse: There the Lord appeared in a cloud and told Aaron and Miriam to come closer.
translation_verse: nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bɔla kuwɔlpa to m ba yili wajɛbu na be kabuna to nseŋ tre Ɛɛrɔn nɛ Miriam awɔrso, nɛ bumo benyɔ na lar n yɔ anishito.

english_verse: Then after commanding them to listen carefully, he said: “I, the Lord, speak to prophets in visions and dreams.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ bumo le: “Men kaŋ kusoe n nu ma mmalga ere: Ma e naa bɔla kewuŋkaŋɛ so a lara ma kumu a ŋini anebiana nsaa bɔla edare so a malga bumo kutɔ.

english_verse: He sees me face to face, and everything I say to him is perfectly clear. You have no right to criticize my servant Moses.”
translation_verse: Ma nɛ mo ere bee wu abar nna nsaa malga abar kutɔ. Mannɛ aŋasa to nɛ mee malga mo kutɔ. E nyi kananɛ ma kapɔr du kikɛ! Amoso men maŋ kɔ ekpa nɛ men malga ŋ gbiti ma kayɛrbi Mosis!”

english_verse: The Lord became angry with Aaron and Miriam. And after the Lord left
translation_verse: Amoso Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ daŋ nya agbo nna n wɔtɔ Ɛɛrɔn nɛ Miriam, nseŋ lar ndoŋ n yɔ,

english_verse: and the cloud disappeared from over the sacred tent, Miriam's skin turned white with leprosy. When Aaron saw what had happened to her,
translation_verse: nɛ kuwɔlpa na gba lar kakpa nɛ wajɛbu na wɔ na. Ndoŋ nna nɛ keboti pɛ Miriam nɛ mbe kayurwule ki n fuli parr fanɛ ateebi. Ɛɛrɔn ka wu fanɛ keboti pɛ Miriam na,

english_verse: he said to Moses, “Sir, please don't punish us for doing such a foolish thing.
translation_verse: nɛ e kaŋɛ Mosis le: “Jande n nyɛnpe, sa maŋ gberge anyi kusoe ŋkpal kulubi nɛ an wora kawuliso ere so.

english_verse: But the Lord replied, “Miriam would be disgraced for seven days if her father had punished her by spitting in her face. So make her stay outside the camp for seven days, before coming back.”
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ Mosis le: “Nɛ fanɛ mo tuto e daŋ n tuu echɔl n fɛa mbe anishito, nchɛ ashunu nɛ kumo be anishinyɔr maŋ kraa kɔ mo a? Amoso, ju mo ashi keeyi na to n ya fo nchɛ ashunu pɔɛŋ nɛ e naŋ bɛta m ba ndoŋ.”

english_verse: The people of Israel did not move their camp until Miriam returned seven days later.
translation_verse: Amoso b daŋ lara Miriam keeyi na to nchɛ ashunu nna nɛ e nya alenfia m bɛta m ba pɔɛŋ nɛ Israɛlebi kaa ndoŋ n yɔ

english_verse: Then they left Hazeroth and set up camp in the Paran Desert.
translation_verse: Hazerɔf, n ya wora bumo be keeyi to ashi Paran be keshishɛrsawule so.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses,
translation_verse: Le nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ Mosis:

english_verse: In fact, we saw the Nephilim who are the ancestors of the Anakim. They were so big that we felt as small as grasshoppers.”
translation_verse: An ka wu basa tenteŋ gboŋgboŋi nɛ b shi Anak be kanaŋ to na, an ki fanɛ alonte nna ashi bumo be anishito.”

english_verse: “Choose a leader from each tribe and send them into Canaan to explore the land I am giving you.”
translation_verse: “Lara Israɛl be yiri kuduanyɔ na to be kekama be ejuŋkparpo n shuŋi bumo nɛ b ya dara Keenan be kasawule nɛ mee ta a sa Israɛlebi na.”

english_verse: So Moses sent twelve tribal leaders from Israel's camp in the Paran Desert
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Mosis nu kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ mo ashi Paran be keshishɛrsawule so na nseŋ shuŋi le be bejuŋkparpo ere:

english_verse: and find out what those regions are like. Be sure to remember how many people live there, how strong they are,
translation_verse: Men dara nɛnɛ ŋ keni kananɛ efuli na du nɛ kananɛ kumo be basa be keshi sa nɛ kananɛ bumo be eleŋ nɛ kapɔshi sa.

english_verse: and if they live in open towns or walled cities. See if the land is good for growing crops and find out what kinds of trees grow there. It's time for grapes to ripen, so try to bring back some of the fruit that grows there.
translation_verse: Men keni, kasawule na walɛ kudɔ ŋko k maŋ walɛ? K kɔ ndibi ŋko k maŋ kɔ? Men wora ania n chuge ndoŋ be asɔrso jiso a ba.” Asɔrso nɛ baa tre greep na be kesɔr be saŋɛ e daa la.

english_verse: The twelve men left to explore Canaan from the Zin Desert in the south all the way to the town of Rehob near Lebo-Hamath in the north.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ basa na ya yili Zin be keshishɛrsawule nɛ k wɔ kelargato be kaseto be kaba so na n dara kasawule na n ya fo kade nɛ baa tre Rehɔb nɛ k wɔ Lɛbo Hamaf be kepla so na.

english_verse: As they went through the Southern Desert, they came to the town of Hebron, which was seven years older than the Egyptian town of Zoan. In Hebron, they saw the three Anakim clans of Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai.
translation_verse: B ka bɔla kelargato be kaseto be kaba so a yɔ na nɛ b ya tu kade ko nɛ baa tre Hibrɔn. Ndoŋ nɛ b tu Ahiman nɛ Shishai nɛ Talmai nɛ b shi basa tenteŋ gboŋgboŋi nɛ baa tre Anakebi be kanaŋ to na. Hibrɔn daŋ chena nfɛ ashunu nna pɔɛŋ nɛ Zowan nɛ k wɔ Ijipt be efuli so na chena.

english_verse: After exploring the land of Canaan for
translation_verse: Bedarapo na ka dara kasawule na nchɛ adena n loge nɛ b bɛta
