translation_verse: Nɛ fanɛ mo tuto maŋ kɔ besiponyɛnso ŋko bewɔpa, kumo ere b ta kapetɛ na n sa kanaŋ na to be ekurgepo nɛ e mata mo ga. Ma mbra nna na nɛ k daga Israɛlebi kikɛ ka bee bɛ kumo so.” B ka lara Joshuwa fanɛ e sɔ Mosis so be asheŋ

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses, “One day you will go up into the Abarim Mountains, and from there you will see the land I am giving the Israelites.
translation_verse: Kachako nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ Mosis le: “Dii abeegboŋ nɛ baa tre Abarim na be esoso ŋ keni kasawule nɛ n ta n sa Israɛlebi na.

english_verse: After you have seen it, you will die, just like your brother Aaron,
translation_verse: Fo baŋ keni kasawule na n loge fo alɛ gba beeŋ wu fanɛ kananɛ fo da Ɛɛrɔn wu na.

english_verse: because both of you disobeyed me at Meribah near the town of Kadesh in the Zin Desert. When the Israelites insulted me there, you didn't believe in my holy power.”
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, Israɛlebi na ka fubel m bile asheŋ m malga ŋ gbiti ma ashi Mɛriba nɛ k mata Kadɛsh ashi Zin be keshishɛrsawule so na, kakpa nɛ n shin nɛ nchu lar kefalta to na, menyi basa anyɔ na daŋ maŋ yirda ma nseŋ kini keshin nɛ Israɛlebi na pin ma eleŋ.”

english_verse: “You are the Lord God, and you know what is in everyone's heart. So I ask you to appoint a leader for Israel.
translation_verse: “Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ kusɔ kikɛ be ŋkpa wɔ fo enɔ to, jande lara esa nɛ e beeŋ tiŋ n juŋkpar basa ere

english_verse: Your people need someone to lead them into battle, or else they will be like sheep wandering around without a shepherd.”
translation_verse: nsaa beeŋ tiŋ ŋ ŋini bumo kena be kekɔ saŋɛ na so fo basa maaŋ baa du fanɛ mbolpɔ nɛ b maŋ kɔ ekpapo na.”

english_verse: The Lord answered, “Joshua son of Nun can do the job. Place your hands on him to show that he is the one to take your place.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ Mosis le: “Lara Nun pibinyɛn Joshuwa nɛ kiyoyu na bɔlɔ mo to na nseŋ ta fo enɔana n deŋi mbe kumu so.

english_verse: Then go with him and tell him to stand in front of Eleazar the priest and the Israelites. Appoint Joshua as their new leader
translation_verse: Shin nɛ e yili bɔrɛmatapo Eliaza nɛ jimaŋ na kikɛ be anishito fanɛ esa nɛ e beeŋ sɔ fo so.

english_verse: and tell them they must now obey him, just as they obey you.
translation_verse: Ta fo kenimu be eleŋ n sa mo, saŋɛ na so Israɛl be basa kikɛ beeŋ baa nu n sa mo.

english_verse: But Joshua must depend on Eleazar to find out from me what I want him to do as he leads Israel into battle.”
translation_verse: Bɔrɛmatapowura Eliaza beeŋ baa ŋini mo kusɔ nɛ ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ bee sha e ka bee wora. Loŋ e naŋ shin nɛ e baa tiŋ a juŋkpar Israɛlebi na a yɔ a ba.”

english_verse: and one kilogram of flour mixed with oil must be offered with each of the young rams.
translation_verse: nseŋ ta ayunyifu kurwa koŋwule n ti nfɛ koko be ekpakpa na be kekama so n lara sarga na.

english_verse: and one kilogram of flour mixed with oil must be offered with each of the young rams. The smell of the smoke from these sacrifices will please me.
translation_verse: nɛ nyifu kurwa koŋwule n ti nfɛ koko be ekpakpa na be kekama malɛ so n lara esarga nɛ amo be efɛa bee wora Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ebel.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ Mosis

english_verse: to say to the people of Israel: Offer sacrifices to me at the appointed times of worship, so that I will smell the smoke and be pleased.
translation_verse: fanɛ e kaŋɛ Israɛlebi na kenishipereso nɛ b baa ta bumo be ajibi be esarga nɛ amo be efɛa bee wora Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ebel ga na m ba ka sa Ebɔrɛ saŋɛ nɛ k daga.

english_verse: Each day offer two rams a year old as sacrifices to please me. The animals must have nothing wrong with them;
translation_verse: B ta nfɛ koko be ekpakpa anyɔ nɛ a maŋ kɔ ndulgi kikɛ n lara karechɛ kikɛ be ajibi be sarga chɔɔso.

english_verse: Finally, along with each of these two sacrifices, a liter of wine must be poured on the altar as a drink offering.
translation_verse: B ta yabra belbelso kɔlba koŋwule n chulgi n wurge bɔrɛsure na so n ti ekpakpafɔlbi na be kekama so n lara sarga n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ.

english_verse: On the Sabbath, in addition to the regular daily sacrifices, you must sacrifice two rams a year old to please me. These rams must have nothing wrong with them, and they will be sacrificed with a drink offering and two kilograms of your finest flour mixed with olive oil. The Sacrifices on the First Day of the Month The Lord said:
translation_verse: B baa lara le be sarga chɔɔ so ere Kewushiachɛ kikɛ n ti karechɛ kama be ayu nɛ yabra be esarga na so. Kufɔl kikɛ to be kachɛ juŋkparso be sarga be asheŋ

english_verse: On the first day of each month, bring to the altar two bulls, one full-grown ram, and seven rams a year old that have nothing wrong with them. Then offer these as sacrifices to please me.
translation_verse: Kufɔl kikɛ be kachɛ juŋkparso men lara egbolu fɔlbi anyɔ nɛ b maŋ kɔ ndulgi, nɛ kpakpa koŋwule nɛ k maŋ kɔ ndulgi, nɛ nfɛ koko be ekpakpa ashunu nɛ a maŋ kɔ ndulgi m ba sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ.

english_verse: Three kilograms of your finest flour mixed with olive oil must be offered with each bull as a grain sacrifice. Two kilograms of flour mixed with oil must be offered with the ram,
translation_verse: B ta nyifu kurwa asa nɛ b ta ɔlif be ŋku m baga n ti gbolu kama so, nɛ nyifu kurwa anyɔ n ti kpakpa kama so,

english_verse: Celebrate Passover in honor of me on the fourteenth day of the first month of each year.
translation_verse: Kufɔl juŋkparso na be kachɛ kuduanasopo kikɛ b baa ji kebansonchoŋ be kejigboŋ na a maŋkura Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.

english_verse: The following day will begin the Festival of Thin Bread, which will last for a week. During this time you must honor me by eating bread made without yeast.
translation_verse: Nseŋ yili kufɔl na be kachɛ kuduanusopo n ji kachɛgboŋ na m bɛ abar so nchɛ ashunu nsaa ji bodobodo nɛ a maŋ kɔ yiisi loŋ be nchɛ na.

english_verse: On the first day of this festival, you must rest from your work and come together for worship.
translation_verse: Kachɛ juŋkparso nɛ baa ji kachɛgboŋ na, b sa maŋ shuŋ kushuŋ kikɛ ama b ba abar so m ba bunyaŋ Ebɔrɛ.

english_verse: Bring to the altar two bulls, one full-grown ram, and seven rams a year old that have nothing wrong with them. And then offer these as sacrifices to please me.
translation_verse: B ta egbolu fɔlbi anyɔ nɛ a maŋ kɔ ndulgi nɛ kpakpa koŋwule nɛ k maŋ kɔ ndulgi nɛ nfɛ koko be ekpakpa ashunu nɛ b maŋ kɔ ndulgi m ba lara sarga chɔɔso n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ.

english_verse: Three kilograms of your finest flour mixed with olive oil must be offered with each bull as a grain sacrifice. Two kilograms of flour mixed with oil must be offered with the ram,
translation_verse: B ta nyifu kurwa asa nɛ b ta ɔlif be ŋku m baga n ti gbolu kama so, n ta nyifu kurwa anyɔ n ti kpakpa kama malɛ so,

english_verse: and one kilogram of flour mixed with oil must be offered with each of the young rams.
translation_verse: nseŋ ta nyifu kurwa koŋwule n ti nfɛ koko be kpakpa kama malɛ so n lara esarga.

english_verse: All of these are to be offered each day of the festival in additional to the regular sacrifices, and the smoke from them will please me.
translation_verse: Loŋ koŋwule na e daga fanɛ b lara ajibi nɛ amo be efɛa wɔ ebel be sarga n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nchɛ ashunu nɛ a bɛ abar so na gba.

english_verse: Then on the last day of the festival, you must once again rest from work and come together for worship. The Sacrifices during the Harvest Festival (Leviticus
translation_verse: Men shɛr abar so kachɛ shunusopo na m bunyaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ. Menyi alɛ e sa maŋ kaŋ shuŋ kushuŋ kikɛ kumo be kamɔnchɛ. Kasɔteŋi be kejigboŋ be sarga be asheŋ (Levitikɔs

english_verse: On the first day of the Harvest Festival, you must rest from your work, come together for worship, and bring a sacrifice of new grain.
translation_verse: A daga fanɛ men be ekama ka wushi ashi mbe ashuŋ to kasɔteŋi be kachɛgboŋ na be kachɛ juŋkparso, nseŋ ta mbe ayu popɔr be sarga m ba sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na, nseŋ shɛr abar so m bunyaŋ mo.

english_verse: Three kilograms of your finest flour mixed with olive oil must be offered with each bull as a grain sacrifice. Two kilograms of flour mixed with oil must be offered with the ram,
translation_verse: Men ta ayunyifu kurwa asa nɛ b ta ɔlif be ŋku m baga n ti gbolu kama so, n ta ayunyifu kurwa anyɔ n ti kpakpa kama so,

english_verse: Also offer a goat as a sacrifice for sin.
translation_verse: Men ta kaboelote n ti so n lara alubi be sarga.

english_verse: On the first day of the seventh month, you must rest from your work and come together to celebrate at the sound of the trumpets.
translation_verse: “Kufɔl shunusopo to be kachɛ juŋkparso na, ekama e sa maŋ shuŋ kushuŋ kikɛ. Men shɛr n foŋ mbel m bunyaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kumo be kamɔnchɛ.

english_verse: Three kilograms of your finest flour mixed with olive oil must be offered with the bull as a grain sacrifice. Two kilograms of flour mixed with oil must be offered with the ram,
translation_verse: Men ta nyifu lela kurwa asa nɛ b ta ɔlif be ŋku m baga amo n ti gbolu na so, n ta nyifu kurwa anyɔ n ti kpakpa na so,

english_verse: and one kilogram of flour mixed with oil must be offered with each of the young rams.
translation_verse: nseŋ ta nyifu kurwa koŋwule n ti nfɛ koko be ekpakpa na be kekama so n lara sarga.

english_verse: You must also offer a goat as a sacrifice for sin.
translation_verse: Men ta kaboelote n ti amo so n lara alubi be sarga.

english_verse: These sacrifices will be made in addition to the regular daily sacrifices and the sacrifices for the first day of the month. The smoke from these sacrifices will please me. The Sacrifices on the Great Day of Forgiveness (Leviticus
translation_verse: Men lara amo n ti sarga chɔɔso nɛ menyee lara kufɔl kikɛ be kachɛ juŋkparso na nɛ karechɛ kama be esarga chɔɔso na nɛ amo be nyifu nɛ yabra be esarga nɛ amo be efɛa bee wora Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ebel na so. Alubi be ketampaŋ be esarga be asheŋ (Levitikɔs

english_verse: The tenth day of the seventh month is the Great Day of Forgiveness. On that day you must rest from all work and come together for worship. Show sorrow for your sins by going without food,
translation_verse: Men sa maŋ kaŋ shuŋ kushuŋ kikɛ ŋko n ji ajibi kufɔl shunusopo na be kachɛ kudusopo na. Men ba abar so m ba bunyaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kumo be kamɔnchɛ.

english_verse: and bring to the altar one young bull, one full-grown ram, and seven rams a year old that have nothing wrong with them. Then offer these as sacrifices to please me.
translation_verse: Men ta gbolu fɔlbi nɛ k maŋ kɔ ndulgi nɛ kpakpa nɛ k maŋ kɔ ndulgi nɛ nfɛ koko be ekpakpafɔlbi ashunu nɛ a maŋ kɔ ndulgi kikɛ m ba lara sarga nɛ kumo be efɛa wɔ ebel n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ.

english_verse: Three kilograms of your finest flour mixed with olive oil must be offered with the bull as a grain sacrifice. Two kilograms of flour mixed with oil must be offered with the ram,
translation_verse: Men ta nyifu lela kurwa asa nɛ b ta ɔlif be ŋku m baga amo n ti gbolu na so, n ta nyifu kurwa anyɔ n ti kpakpa na so,

english_verse: and one kilogram of flour mixed with oil must be offered with each of the young rams.
translation_verse: nseŋ ta nyifu kurwa koŋwule n ti ekpakpafɔlbi na be kekama so n lara sarga.

english_verse: A goat must also be sacrificed for the sins of the people. You will offer these sacrifices in addition to the sacrifice to ask forgiveness and the regular daily sacrifices. The Sacrifices during the Festival of Shelters (Leviticus
translation_verse: Men ta kaboelote n ti amo so n lara alubi be ketampaŋ be sarga. Men lara amo n ti kachɛ kama be esarga chɔɔso na so. Nwu be esarga be asheŋ (Levitikɔs

english_verse: Beginning on the fifteenth day of the seventh month and continuing for seven days, everyone must celebrate the Festival of Shelters in honor of me.
translation_verse: Men shɛr kufɔl shunusopo na be kachɛ kuduanusopo na n ji kachɛgboŋ m bɛ abar so nchɛnshunu m maŋkura Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ. Men sa maŋ shuŋ kushuŋ kikɛ loŋ be kachɛ na.

english_verse: Three kilograms of your finest flour mixed with olive oil must be offered with each bull as a grain sacrifice. Two kilograms of flour mixed with oil must be offered with each of the rams,
translation_verse: Men ta nyifu lela kurwa asa nɛ b ta ɔlif be ŋku m baga n ti gbolu na be kekama so, n ta nyifu kurwa anyɔ n ti kpakpa na be kekama so,

english_verse: and one kilogram of flour mixed with oil must be offered with each of the young rams.
translation_verse: nseŋ ta nyifu kurwa koŋwule n ti ekpakpafɔlbi na be kekama so n lara sarga.

english_verse: You must also offer a goat as a sacrifice for sin. These are to be offered in addition to the regular daily sacrifices.
translation_verse: Men ta kaboelote n lara alubi be sarga n ti amo nɛ kachɛ kama be esarga chɔɔso nɛ amo be yabra nɛ nyifu be esarga so.

english_verse: For the next six days of the festival, you will sacrifice one less bull than the day before, so that on the seventh day, seven bulls will be sacrificed. The other sacrifices and offerings must remain the same for each of these days.
translation_verse: Men ta nyifu nɛ yabra kananɛ k daga fanɛ b ta n ti kusɔbɔya kama so, nɛ kaboelote n ti asɔbɔya na so n lara sarga na.

english_verse: On the eighth day, you must once again rest from your work and come together for worship.
translation_verse: Kachɛ burwasopo na nɛ men shɛr abar so m bunyaŋ Ebɔrɛ. Menyi alɛ e sa maŋ kaŋ shuŋ loŋ be kachɛ.

english_verse: Bring to the altar one bull, one full-grown ram, and seven rams a year old that have nothing wrong with them. Then offer these as sacrifices to please me.
translation_verse: Men ta gbolu koŋwule nɛ kpakpa koŋwule nɛ nfɛ koko be ekpakpafɔlbi ashunu nɛ amo kikɛ maŋ kɔ ndulgi n lara sarga chɔɔso nɛ kumo be efɛa bee wora Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ebel n sa mo.

english_verse: And offer a goat as the sacrifice to ask forgiveness for the people. These sacrifices are made in addition to the regular daily sacrifices.
translation_verse: Men ta nyifu nɛ yabra nɛ asɔ nɛ a daga kikɛ fanɛ kananɛ men daŋ wora kachɛ juŋkparso na n ti asɔbɔya na so n lara sarga na.

english_verse: You must offer all these sacrifices to me at the appointed times of worship, together with any offerings that are voluntarily given or given because of a promise.
translation_verse: Men baa lara le be esarga ere kachɛgboŋ achɛ kikɛ n ti keparso ŋko kɔnɔ be ketia be esarga so.”

english_verse: Moses told the people of Israel everything the Lord had told him about the sacrifices.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Mosis kaŋɛ Israɛlebi na kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ mo na.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses to say to Israel's tribal leaders:
translation_verse: Le be keŋini ere nɛ Mosis daŋ ta n sa Israɛl be eyiri na be bejuŋkparpoana.

english_verse: Suppose a young woman who is still living with her parents makes a promise to the Lord.
translation_verse: Nɛ kasuŋgurbia nɛ e kraa wɔ mo tuto be laŋ to baŋ nase kɔnɔ n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na, ŋko n nase kɔnɔ fanɛ e beeŋ yige kusɔ ko be kewora,

english_verse: But if he hears about it and objects, then she no longer has to keep her promise. The Lord will forgive her, because her father did not agree with the promise.
translation_verse: Nɛ mo tuto ju mo fanɛ e sa maŋ wora m bɔlɔ mbe kɔnɔ naseso na so bre, kumo ere k maŋ daga fanɛ e wora m bɔlɔ kumo so. Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ malɛ beeŋ ta m paŋ mo ŋkpal mo tuto ka maŋ shuli fanɛ e wora m bɔlɔ kumo so so.

english_verse: Suppose a woman makes a promise to the Lord and then gets married. If her husband later hears about the promise but says nothing, she must do what she said, whether she meant it or not.
translation_verse: kumo ere a daga e ka wora m bɔlɔ kusɔ kama nɛ e nase kɔnɔ fanɛ e beeŋ wora na so, ama mo kul baŋ nu kumo nna nseŋ kini kumo.

english_verse: But if her husband hears about the promise and objects, she no longer has to keep it, and the Lord will forgive her.
translation_verse: Nɛ mo kul ju mo fanɛ e sa maŋ wora m bɔlɔ kɔnɔ naseso na so bre, kumo ere k maŋ naŋ daga fanɛ e wora m bɔlɔ kumo so. Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ malɛ beeŋ ta m paŋ mo.

english_verse: Suppose a married woman makes a promise to the Lord.
translation_verse: Nɛ fanɛ eche kilpo baŋ nase kɔnɔ ŋko ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ e beeŋ yige kusɔ ko be kebaawora,

english_verse: But if he hears about the promise and does object, she no longer has to keep it. The Lord will forgive her, because her husband would not allow her to keep the promise.
translation_verse: Nɛ mo kul nu kumo nseŋ ju mo fanɛ e sa maŋ wora m bɔlɔ kɔnɔ naseso na so bre, kumo ere k maŋ daga e ka wora m bɔlɔ kumo so. Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ malɛ beeŋ ta m paŋ mo ŋkpal mo kul ka ju mo na so.

english_verse: Her husband has the final say about any promises she makes to the Lord.
translation_verse: Mo kul kɔ ekpa nɛ e shuli ŋko ŋ kini kɔnɔ naseso kama nɛ e nase ŋko kusɔ kama nɛ e kaŋɛ fanɛ e beeŋ wora.

english_verse: If her husband hears about a promise and says nothing about it for a whole day, she must do what she said—since he did not object, the promise must be kept.
translation_verse: Ama nɛ mo kul nu kɔnɔ naseso na be asheŋ nsaa maŋ kaŋɛ shɛŋ hale nɛ epeŋi ya tɔr, kumo ere a daga e ka wora m bɔlɔ kusɔ kama nɛ e kaŋɛ na so ŋkpal manɛ so mo kul be kelato na bee ŋini fanɛ e shuli kumo nna na.

english_verse: But if he waits until the next day to stop her from keeping her promise, he is the one who must be punished.
translation_verse: Ama nɛ fanɛ mo kul na jo nchɛnnyɔ pɔɛŋ nseŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ e maŋ shuli eche na be kɔnɔ naseso na bre kumo ere mo kul na e naŋ nya kumo be kasogberge.

english_verse: These are the laws that the Lord gave Moses about husbands and wives, and about young daughters who still live at home.
translation_verse: Mbra nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ daŋ ta n sa Mosis a yɔ egbawuche nɛ b wɔ bumo tutoana be elaŋ to nɛ bechekilpoana nna na.

english_verse: “Before you die, make sure that the Midianites are punished for what they did to Israel.”
translation_verse: “Pɔɛŋ nɛ fo wu na, a daga fo ka gberge Midianebi na kusoe nɛnɛ ŋkpal kusɔ nɛ b wora Israɛlebi na so.”

english_verse: Then Moses told the people, “The Lord wants to punish the Midianites. So tell our men to prepare for battle.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Mosis kaŋɛ basa na le: “Men bela ase n ya kɔ Midianebi na kena ŋ gberge bumo kusoe ŋkpal kusɔ nɛ b wora Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na so.

english_verse: Twelve thousand men were picked from the tribes of Israel, and after they were prepared for battle,
translation_verse: Amoso benapo kagboŋ nɛ b daŋ lara eyiri na be kekama to nɛ bumo kikɛ ya yili benapo ŋgboŋ kuduanyɔ.

english_verse: Moses sent them off to war. Phinehas the son of Eleazar went with them and took along some things from the sacred tent and the trumpets for sounding the battle signal.
translation_verse: Nɛ Mosis shin nɛ Eliaza pibinyɛn Finihas ta Enyɛnpe be wajɛbu na to be asɔ cheembi nɛ mbel nɛ baaŋ ba ta a tre abar n tu bumo n yɔ kena na to.

english_verse: The Israelites fought against the Midianites, just as the Lord had commanded Moses. They killed all the men,
translation_verse: Kananɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ baŋ kaŋɛ Mosis na gbagba nɛ b bɛ so n ya kɔ Midianebi na kena m mɔ bumo be benyɛn kikɛ

english_verse: The Israelites captured every woman and child, then led away the Midianites' cattle and sheep, and took everything else that belonged to them.
translation_verse: Israɛlebi na daŋ pɛ Midianebi na be beche nɛ mbia nna n ta bumo be ana nɛ mbolpɔ nɛ bumo be asɔ kikɛ,

english_verse: They also burned down the Midianite towns and villages.
translation_verse: nseŋ chɔɔ bumo be ndeana nɛ bumo be nyi to kikɛ.

english_verse: Israel's soldiers gathered together everything they had taken from the Midianites, including the captives and the animals.
translation_verse: B daŋ ta asɔ na nɛ basa nɛ b pɛ na nɛ asɔbɔya na kikɛ nna

english_verse: and said, “I can't believe you let the women live!
translation_verse: nseŋ bishi bumo le: “Manɛ nna nɛ men maŋ mɔ beche na bre?

english_verse: You must put to death every boy and all the women who have ever had sex.
translation_verse: Naniere, men mɔ mbinyɛnsobi nɛ beche kama nɛ b nyi benyɛn na,

english_verse: But do not kill the young women who have never had sex. You may keep them for yourselves.”
translation_verse: ama men sa maŋ mɔ mbichesobi nɛ b maŋ nyi benyɛn na bre. Men ta bumo ŋ ki menyi be beche.

english_verse: Then Moses said to the soldiers, “If you killed anyone or touched a dead body, you are unclean and have to stay outside the camp for seven days. On the third and seventh days, you must go through a ceremony to make yourselves and your captives clean.
translation_verse: Menyi be ekama malɛ nɛ e mɔ esa ŋko m beta ebuni, e lar keeyi na to n yɔ kakpa ko nchɛ ashunu. Bumo nɛ basa nɛ b pɛ kena to na e fɔr bumo be eyur so daŋkare be ekpa so kachɛ sasopo nɛ kushunusopo na.

english_verse: Eleazar then explained, “If you need to purify something that won't burn, such as gold, silver, bronze, iron, tin, or lead, you must first place it in a hot fire. After you take it out, sprinkle it with the water that purifies. Everything else should only be sprinkled with the water. Do all of this, just as the Lord commanded Moses.
translation_verse: E yɛ: ‘Nɛ men baa sha kefɔr kusɔ nɛ k maa chɔɔ fanɛ shuwa ŋko gbiti ŋko danyaŋ ŋko kebɛlso ŋko epal so, daŋkare be ekpa so, kumo ere men ta kumo n wɔtɔ edɛ to. Kusɔ kama nɛ k bee chɔɔ bre men ta nchu n fɔr kumo so daŋkare be ekpa so.

english_verse: Wash your clothes on the seventh day, and after that, you will be clean and may return to the camp.” Everything Taken from the Midianites Is Divided
translation_verse: Men baŋ fɔr men be epiŋi kachɛ shunusopo na, menyeeŋ nyalɛ so daŋkare be ekpa so nseŋ nya ekpa m bɛta n yɔ keeyi to.’ ” B ka barga asɔ nɛ b muu kena to na be asheŋ

english_verse: The Lord told Moses:
translation_verse: Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ Mosis le:

english_verse: Make a list of everything taken from the Midianites, including the captives and the animals. Then divide them between the soldiers and the rest of the people. Eleazar the priest and the family leaders will help you.
translation_verse: nseŋ barga amo to ntuŋ anyɔ dede, n ta katuŋ koŋwule n sa benapo na nseŋ ta kukoŋwule malɛ n sa Israɛlebi nɛ b ka na.

english_verse: From the half that belongs to the soldiers, set aside for the Lord one out of every
translation_verse: Men ta amo n sa bɔrɛmatapo Eliaza fanɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be kachige.

english_verse: So we want to give the Lord all the gold jewelry we took from the Midianites. It's our gift to him for watching over us and our troops.”
translation_verse: Amoso an kɔ shuwa be abitasɔ nɛ enɔ to be mpinibi nɛ enɔ to be ashembi nɛ mpinibi nɛ akonde nɛ abɔtoshembi a ba nɛ an ba sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ŋkpal e ka kuŋ anyi ashi kena na to so.”

english_verse: Moses and Eleazar followed the Lord's instructions
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Mosis nɛ Eliaza wora kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ na kikɛ.

english_verse: The army commanders went to Moses
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ benapo na be benimuana na yɔ Mosis kutɔ

english_verse: and said, “Sir, we have counted our troops, and not one soldier is missing.
translation_verse: n ya kaŋɛ le: “Fo nyɛrbi ya karga benapo nɛ baa keni so na nseŋ wu fanɛ bumo be ekoŋwule gba maŋ foe.

english_verse: Moses and Eleazar accepted the jewelry from the commanders,
translation_verse: Nɛ Mosis nɛ Eliaza kikɛ sɔ shuwa be abitasɔ na ashi benapo na be benimu na kutɔ.

english_verse: This did not include the things that the soldiers had kept for themselves.
translation_verse: Benapo nɛ b daa maŋ la benimu na bre daŋ maŋ ta shuwa be abitasɔ nɛ b nya na n sa.

english_verse: So Moses and Eleazar placed the gold in the Lord's sacred tent to remind Israel of what had happened.
translation_verse: Mosis nɛ Eliaza daŋ ta shuwa na nna n yɔ wajɛbu na to, saŋɛ na so, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ beeŋ ba kraa kuŋ Israɛlebi na.

english_verse: then after the Lord helps Israel capture the land, you can return to your own land. You will no longer have to stay with the others.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ men bɛta n yɔ epe nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ e shin nɛ kasawule nɛ k wɔ Jɔɔdan be epeŋilarkpa be kaba so na e ki menyeya.

english_verse: The tribes of Reuben and Gad owned a lot of cattle and sheep, and they saw that the regions of Jazer and Gilead had good pastureland.
translation_verse: Ruben nɛ Gad be eyiriana nɛ b kɔ asɔbɔya ga na ka wu fanɛ Jeeza nɛ Giliad be kasawule na kɔ ana nɛ mbolpɔ nɛ mboe be ejikpa lela,

english_verse: So they went to Moses, Eleazar, and the other leaders of Israel and said,
translation_verse: nɛ b yɔ Mosis nɛ bɔrɛmatapo Eliaza nɛ Israɛlebi be bejuŋkparpoana na kutɔ n ya kaŋɛ bumo le:

english_verse: “The Lord has helped us capture the land around the towns of Ataroth, Dibon, Jazer, Nimrah, Heshbon, Elealeh, Sebam, Nebo, and Beon. That's good pastureland, and since we own cattle and sheep,
translation_verse: “Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ chɛ anyi to nɛ an sɔ Atarɔf nɛ Dibɔn nɛ Jeeza nɛ Nimra nɛ Hishbɔn nɛ Eliale nɛ Sibma nɛ Neebo nɛ Bɛɔn be ndeana be nsawule nɛ a walɛ n sa asɔbɔya be kebela. Anyi alɛ kɔ asɔbɔya ga.

english_verse: would you let us stay here east of the Jordan River and have this land as our own?”
translation_verse: Amoso jande ta kasawule ere n sa anyi nɛ k ki anyi be kapetɛ, saŋɛ na so, anyi ere maaŋ naŋ dii n yɔ Jɔɔdan be lɔr na be kaba ndoŋ n ya chena.”

english_verse: Moses answered: You mean you'd stay here while the rest of the Israelites go into battle?
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Mosis kaŋɛ le: “Menyee sha kebaawɔ nfe nna nɛ men braana Israɛlebi nɛ b ka na bre e baa yɔ kena to a?

english_verse: If you did that, it would discourage the others from crossing over into the land the Lord promised them.
translation_verse: Men wora loŋ, menyeeŋ shin nɛ Israɛlebi na be aba e pɔ nɛ b kini kedii Jɔɔdan be lɔr na n yɔ kasawule nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ta n sa bumo na so.

english_verse: This is exactly what happened when I sent your ancestors from Kadesh-Barnea to explore the land.
translation_verse: Loŋ nɛ men nananyɛnana gba daŋ wora saŋɛ so nɛ n daŋ yili Kadɛsh Bania n shuŋi bumo fanɛ b ya dara kasawule na.

english_verse: So Moses gave the Machirites the region of Gilead, and they settled there.
translation_verse: Amoso Mosis daŋ ta Giliad be kasawule na nna n sa Makiir be kabuna ebi nɛ b chena ndoŋ.

english_verse: Now you people of Reuben and Gad are doing the same thing and making the Lord even angrier.
translation_verse: Kusɔ nɛ men nananyɛnana daŋ wora na nɛ menyi Rubenebi nɛ Gadebi gba bee wora naniere a shin nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be agbo bee kaa Israɛlebi so.

english_verse: If you reject the Lord, he will once again abandon his people and leave them here in the desert. And you will be to blame!
translation_verse: Men baŋ kini kebɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ so, e beeŋ naŋ kplaŋ mbe basa so ashi keshishɛrsawule ere so nɛ bumo be alubi e baa bɛ menyi.”

english_verse: The men from Reuben and Gad replied: Let us build places to keep our sheep and goats, and towns for our wives and children,
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Rubenebi na nɛ Gadebi kaŋɛ Mosis le: “Shin nɛ an pɔr anyi be asɔbɔya be aluu nseŋ pɔr egbal ŋ kulti nde n sa anyi be beche nɛ mbia pɔɛŋ,

english_verse: We will stay with them until they have settled in their own tribal lands.
translation_verse: Anyi maaŋ bɛta n yɔ epe ama Israɛlebi na kikɛ baaŋ sɔ kasawule nɛ b ta n sa bumo na nna n chena so pɔɛŋ.

english_verse: The land on this side of the Jordan River will be ours, so we won't expect to receive any on the other side.
translation_verse: Anyi alɛ maaŋ tu bumo m barga kasawule nɛ k wɔ Jɔɔdan be lɔr na be kaba ndoŋ na to ŋkpal manɛ so, anyi ere tiŋ n nya anyi be kachige ashi Jɔɔdan be lɔr na be epeŋilarkpa be kaba so nfe.”

english_verse: You also agreed to cross the Jordan and stay with the rest of the Israelites, until the Lord forces our enemies out of the land. If you do these things,
translation_verse: Men be benapo kikɛ e dii Jɔɔdan be lɔr na be kaba ndoŋ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ e juŋkpar menyi n ju an doŋana kasawule na so n sɔ kumo.

english_verse: But if you don't keep your promise, you will sin against the Lord and be punished.
translation_verse: Ama nɛ men baa maŋ bɛ men be kɔnɔ naseso ere so bre, menyeeŋ wora alubi ŋ gbiti Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nsaa beeŋ nya kumo be kasogberge.

english_verse: Go ahead and build towns for your wives and children, and places for your sheep and goats. Just be sure to do what you have promised.
translation_verse: Amoso men pɔr egbalana ŋ kulti men be nde nseŋ wora men be asɔbɔya be aluu ama men wora kusɔ nɛ men nase kɔnɔ fanɛ menyeeŋ wora na.”

english_verse: The men from Reuben and Gad answered: Sir, we will do just what you have said.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Gad nɛ Ruben be benyɛn na kikɛ kaŋɛ le: “Anyeeŋ wora kusɔ kama nɛ an nyɛnpe kaŋɛ anyi.

english_verse: Our wives and children and sheep and cattle will stay here in the towns in Gilead.
translation_verse: Anyi be beche nɛ mbia nɛ anyi be ana nɛ mbolpɔ bre beeŋ baa wɔ Giliad be nde to nfe.

english_verse: But those of us who are prepared for battle will cross the Jordan and fight for the Lord.
translation_verse: Ama anyi alɛ kikɛ wora shiriya nɛ an bɛ kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ na so nseŋ dii Jɔɔdan be lɔr na be kaba ndoŋ n ya kɔ fanɛ kananɛ fo kaŋɛ na.”

english_verse: Then Moses said to Eleazar, Joshua, and the family leaders,
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Mosis kaŋɛ Eliaza nɛ Joshuwa nɛ Israɛl be bejuŋkparpoana na le:

english_verse: “Make sure that the tribes of Gad and Reuben prepare for battle and cross the Jordan River with you. If they do, then after the land is in your control, give them the region of Gilead as their tribal land.
translation_verse: “Nɛ Gad nɛ Ruben be benyɛn tu menyi n dii Jɔɔdan be lɔr na be kaba ndoŋ nɛ men ya kɔ n sɔ kasawule na, kumo ere men ta Giliad be kasawule na n sa bumo fanɛ bumo be kapetɛ.

english_verse: But if they break their promise, they will receive land on the other side of the Jordan, like the rest of the tribes.”
translation_verse: Ama nɛ b maŋ dii Jɔɔdan be lɔr na n ya chɛ menyi to ŋ kɔ bre, kumo ere baaŋ nya bumo be kasawule be kachige ashi Keenan be kasawule so nna fanɛ menyi.”

english_verse: The tribes of Gad and Reuben replied, “We are your servants and will do whatever the Lord has commanded.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Gad nɛ Ruben be benyɛn na kaŋɛ le: “Anyeeŋ wora kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ anyi ere.

english_verse: We will cross the Jordan River, ready to fight for the Lord in Canaan. But the land we will inherit as our own will be on this side of the river.”
translation_verse: Anyeeŋ bɛ mbe kamalga so nseŋ dii n yɔ Keenan be kasawule so n ya kɔ n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, ama kasawule nɛ k wɔ Jɔɔdan be lɔr na be epeŋilarkpa be kaba so na e naaŋ baa la anyi be kapetɛ.”

english_verse: So Moses gave the tribes of Gad, Reuben, and half of Manasseh the territory and towns that King Sihon the Amorite had ruled, as well as the territory and towns that King Og of Bashan had ruled.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Mosis ta ewura Sihɔn nɛ e la Amɔriebi be ewura na, nɛ ewura Ɔg nɛ e la Bashan be ewura na be nsawule nɛ efuli na so be nde nɛ a kulti ndoŋ na kikɛ n sa Manase be yiri be bargato nɛ Gad nɛ Ruben be eyiriana.

english_verse: The tribe of Gad rebuilt the towns of Dibon, Ataroth, Aroer,
translation_verse: Gad be yiri na daŋ lɔŋɛ nna m pɔr Dibɔn nɛ Atarɔf nɛ Arowa nɛ

english_verse: Atroth-Shophan, Jazer, Jogbehah,
translation_verse: Atrɔf Shofan nɛ Jeeza nɛ Jogbeha

english_verse: Beth-Nimrah, and Beth-Haran. They built walls around them and also built places to keep their sheep and goats.
translation_verse: nɛ Bɛf Nimra nɛ Bɛf Haran be nde nseŋ pɔr egbal ŋ kulti amo kikɛ.

english_verse: The tribe of Reuben rebuilt Heshbon, Elealeh, Kiriathaim,
translation_verse: Nɛ Ruben be yiri na malɛ lɔŋɛ m pɔr Hishbɔn Eliale nɛ Kiryatayim

english_verse: Sibmah, as well as the towns that used to be known as Nebo and Baal-Meon. They renamed all those places.
translation_verse: nɛ Sibma nɛ nde nɛ b daa tre Nebo nɛ Baal Miɔn na. B daŋ nase nde nɛ b pɔr egbal ŋ kulti na atre popɔr nna.

english_verse: The clan of Machir from the tribe of East Manasseh went to the region of Gilead, captured its towns, and forced out the Amorites.
translation_verse: Manase pibinyɛn Makiir e daŋ kɔ n sɔ Giliad be kasawule nseŋ ju Amɔriebi nɛ b wɔ ndoŋ na n sɔ kumo n chena so.

english_verse: Jair from the Manasseh tribe captured villages and renamed them “Villages of Jair.”
translation_verse: Jair nɛ e shi Manase be yiri to na e daŋ ya kɔ n sɔ ndewurbi ko nseŋ nase amo Jair be ndewurbi.

english_verse: Nobah captured the town of Kenath with its villages and renamed it Nobah.
translation_verse: Nooba e daŋ kɔ n sɔ Kenaaf nɛ ndewurbi nɛ a kulti kumo na nseŋ ta mbe ketre Nooba n nase amo.

english_verse: As Israel traveled from Egypt under the command of Moses and Aaron,
translation_verse: Mosis nɛ Ɛɛrɔn ka daŋ juŋkpar Israɛlebi na n lar Ijipt be efuli so a yɔ na,

english_verse: Moses kept a list of the places they camped, just as the Lord had instructed. Here is the record of their journey:
translation_verse: nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ Mosis kenishipereso fanɛ saŋkama nɛ b wora keeyi to, e sibɛ keeyi na to be ketre n nase.

english_verse: Israel left the Egyptian city of Rameses on the fifteenth day of the first month. This was the day after the Lord had punished Egypt's gods by killing the first-born sons in every Egyptian family. So while the Egyptians were burying the bodies, they watched the Israelites proudly leave their country.
translation_verse: Ijiptebi na daa puli bumo be ewurkoŋnyɛn nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ daŋ mɔ na nna nsaa keni Israɛlebi na nɛ baa yɔ. Kede e naa ŋini fanɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kɔ eleŋ a chɔ Ijiptebi na be agbirana.

english_verse: After the Israelites left Rameses, they camped at Succoth,
translation_verse: Israɛlebi na ka lar Rameses nɛ b ya wora bumo be keeyi to ashi Sukɔf.

english_verse: and from there, they moved their camp to Etham on the edge of the desert.
translation_verse: B ka lar Sukɔf nɛ b naŋ ya wora bumo be keeyi to ashi Etam nɛ k wɔ keshishɛrsawule na be ekarso na.

english_verse: They left Pi-Hahiroth, crossed the Red Sea, then walked three days into the Etham Desert and camped at Marah.
translation_verse: B ka koso Pii Hahirɔf nɛ b dii Teku Peper na n ya luri Shur be keshishɛrsawule na to n nite nchɛ asa pɔɛŋ nseŋ naŋ ya wora bumo be keeyi to ashi Mara.

english_verse: They left Elim and camped near the Red Sea,
translation_verse: B ka lar Elim, Teku peper na ase nɛ b naŋ ya wora bumo be keeyi to.

english_verse: then turned east and camped along the western edge of the Sinai Desert.
translation_verse: B ka naŋ koso ndoŋ malɛ Sin be keshishɛrsawule na ase nɛ b naŋ ya wora bumo be keeyi to.

english_verse: From there they went to Dophkah, Alush, and Rephidim, where they had no water.
translation_verse: B ka lar Aluush, Refidim nɛ b daŋ naŋ ya wora bumo be keeyi to. Ndoŋ nɛ b daa maŋ nya nchu nɛ b nuu na.

english_verse: It was then that the Canaanite king of Arad, who lived in the Southern Desert of Canaan, heard that Israel was headed that way.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nɛ Arad be ewura nɛ e wɔ Keenan be efuli so be kelargato be kaseto be kaba so na nu fanɛ Israɛlebi na bee ba.

english_verse: While Israel was camped in the lowlands of Moab across the Jordan River from Jericho, the Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Mowab be kepla nɛ k mata Jɔɔdan be lɔr nɛ Jɛriko wɔ kumo be kaba ndoŋ na so nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ Mosis

english_verse: to give the people of Israel this message: When you cross the Jordan River and enter Canaan,
translation_verse: fanɛ e kaŋɛ Israɛlebi na le: “Men baŋ dii Jɔɔdan be lɔr na n yɔ Keenan be kasawule so,

english_verse: Then settle in the land—I have given it to you as your own.
translation_verse: Men sɔ kasawule na kikɛ n chena so, ŋkpal manɛ so, ma e naa ta kumo a sa menyi.

english_verse: I will show you how to divide the land among the tribes, according to the number of clans in each one, so that the larger tribes will have more land than the smaller ones.
translation_verse: Men to beri n chige kasawule na to n sa eyiriana na be mbuna mbunaana na. Men ta kasawule nɛ k shibi ga n sa kabuna kama nɛ kumo be basa shibi nseŋ ta kasawule nɛ k maŋ shibi malɛ n sa kabuna kama nɛ kumo be basa maŋ shibi.

english_verse: If you don't force out all the people there, they will be like splinters in your eyes and thorns in your back. They will always be trouble for you,
translation_verse: Ama nɛ men baa maŋ ju basa nɛ b wɔ kasawule na so bre, baaŋ ki fanɛ ndubi a chute men be anishito ŋko ewi men be nle to a jɔ menyi. Baaŋ sa menyi tɔrɔ damta kasawule na so.

english_verse: and I will treat you as severely as I planned on treating them.
translation_verse: Men baa maŋ ju bumo, meeŋ mur menyi fanɛ kananɛ ŋ kre fanɛ meeŋ mur bumo na.”

english_verse: to tell the people of Israel that their land in Canaan would have the following borders:
translation_verse: fanɛ e sa Israɛlebi na: “Nɛ men baŋ luri Keenan be kasawule nɛ ŋ kɔ a sa menyi na to, kananɛ men be kasawule be egbaŋto egbaŋto beeŋ baa du nde:

english_verse: The southern border will be the Zin Desert and the northwest part of Edom. This border will begin at the south end of the Dead Sea.
translation_verse: Kumo be kelargato be kaseto be kaba so beeŋ yili Zin be keshishɛrsawule na nɛ Edɔm be kasawule be kelargato be esoso be epeŋitɔrkpa be kaba so. Kumo be ekar beeŋ fara Nfɔl be Teku na be kelargato be kaseto be kaba so be epeŋilarkpa be kaba so,

english_verse: It will go west from there, but will turn southward to include Scorpion Pass, the village of Zin, and the town of Kadesh-Barnea. From there, the border will continue to Hazar-Addar and on to Azmon.
translation_verse: nseŋ kilgi m bɔla kelargato be kaseto be kaba so a yɔ Akrabim be kepla be kaba so n ta m bɔla Zin n ya luri Kadɛsh Bania ashi kelargato be kaseto be kaba so. Nseŋ naŋ yili ndoŋ ŋ kilgi m bɔla kelargato be esoso be epeŋitɔrkpa be kaba so n yɔ Heeza Adar hale n ya fo Azmɔn.

english_verse: It will run along the Egyptian Gorge and end at the Mediterranean Sea.
translation_verse: Nseŋ naŋ yili ndoŋ ŋ kilgi m bɔla ketaŋɛ nɛ k dese Ijipt be kasawule be ekar n ta n ya fo Mɛditerenia be Teku na.

english_verse: The western border will be the Mediterranean Sea.
translation_verse: Kumo be epeŋitɔrkpa be ekar e naŋ baa la Mɛditerenia be Teku na.

english_verse: The northern border will begin at the Mediterranean, then continue eastward to Mount Hor.
translation_verse: Kumo be kelargato be esoso be kaba so beeŋ bɛ Mɛditerenia be Teku na so n ya fo kebeegboŋ nɛ baa tre Hɔɔr na,

english_verse: After that, it will run to Lebo-Hamath and across to Zedad, which is the northern edge of your land.
translation_verse: nseŋ yili ndoŋ n yɔ Hamaf be kepla na ŋ keta n ya fo Zedad

english_verse: From Zedad, the border will continue east to Ziphron and end at Hazar-Enan.
translation_verse: nɛ Zifrɔn n ta n ya tar Heeza Enaan.

english_verse: The eastern border will begin at Hazar-Enan in the north, then run south to Shepham,
translation_verse: Men be epeŋilarkpa be kaba so be kasawule be ekar bre beeŋ fara Heeza Enaan nna n ya fo Shefam,

english_verse: and on down to Riblah on the east side of Ain. From there, it will go south to the eastern hills of Lake Galilee,
translation_verse: nseŋ naŋ bɔla kelargato be kaseto be kaba so n ya fo Habeɛl nɛ k wɔ Ain be epeŋilarkpa be kaba so na, n ta n ya fo Tekugboŋ nɛ baa tre Galili na be epeŋilarkpa be kaba so,

english_verse: then follow the Jordan River down to the north end of the Dead Sea. The land within those four borders will belong to you.
translation_verse: nseŋ ta m bɛ Jɔɔdan be lɔr na so n ya tar Nfɔl be Teku na. Kananɛ kasawule na be abonfuana na be ekar beeŋ ba du nna na.”

english_verse: Then Moses told the people, “You will receive the land inside these borders. It will be yours, but the Lord has commanded you to divide it among the nine and a half tribes.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Mosis kaŋɛ Israɛlebi na le: “Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ta kasawule ere nna n sa eyiri akpanu nɛ bargato na. Men to beri m barga amo to n sa abar.

english_verse: The tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh have already been given their land
translation_verse: Ruben nɛ Gad be eyiri nɛ Manase be yiri be bargato na bre tiŋ n nya bumo be kasawule

english_verse: across from Jericho, east of the Jordan River.” The Leaders Who Will Divide the Land
translation_verse: ashi Jɔɔdan be lɔr nɛ Jɛriko wɔ kumo be kaba ndoŋ na be epeŋilarkpa na be kaba so.” Bejuŋkparpo nɛ baaŋ yilito nɛ b barga kasawule na to be asheŋ

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses,
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ Mosis le:

english_verse: “Eleazar the priest and Joshua son of Nun will divide the land for the Israelites.
translation_verse: “Bɔrɛmatapowura Eliaza nɛ Nun pibinyɛn Joshuwa e naŋ barga kasawule na to n sa basa na.

english_verse: One leader from each tribe will help them,
translation_verse: Ejuŋkparpo koŋwule ashi yiri kama to beeŋ chɛ bumo to m barga kumo to.”

english_verse: These are the men the Lord commanded to help Eleazar and Joshua divide the land for the Israelites.

translation_verse: Ade kikɛ be kaman, nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ anyi kikɛ le: ‘Menyi be mbia nɛ b kraa la mbiwurbi nsaa maŋ nyi kulubi nɛ kelela na, e naaŋ yɔ kasawule na so. Mbia nɛ men kaŋɛ fanɛ men doŋana beeŋ ya sɔ na, nɛ meeŋ ta kasawule na n sa nɛ b chena so.

english_verse: Then you told me, “We disobeyed the Lord our God, but now we want to obey him. We will go into the hill country and fight, just as he told us to do.” So you picked up your weapons, thinking it would be easy to take over the hill country.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ men kaŋɛ le: ‘Mosis, an wora alubi n da Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na so. english_verse: But the Lord said, “Moses, warn them not to go into the hill country. I won't help them fight, and their enemies will defeat them.”
translation_verse: Ama le nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na daŋ naŋ kaŋɛ ma: ‘Kpele bumo kusoe fanɛ b sa maŋ kaŋ yɔ n ya kɔ, ŋkpal manɛ so, m maaŋ tu bumo n yɔ. Bumo doŋana beeŋ pɔɔ bumo so.’

english_verse: I told you what the Lord had said, but you paid no attention. You disobeyed him and went into the hill country anyway. You thought you were so great!
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ menyi kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ, ama men daŋ maŋ nu. Men daŋ lar mo kaman nna nseŋ yɔ abeesawule na so kamoowuso.

english_verse: But when the Amorites in the hill country attacked from their towns, you ran from them as you would run from a swarm of bees. The Amorites chased your troops into Seir as far as Hormah, killing them as they went.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Amɔriebi nɛ b daa wɔ abee na so na gbelge m ba menyi so fanɛ emushoŋ n ju menyi hale n ya fo kakpa nɛ baa tre Hɔɔma nɛ k wɔ Edɔm be kebeesawule so n ya kɔ m pɔɔ menyi so ndoŋ.

english_verse: After we had been in Kadesh for a few months, we obeyed the Lord and headed back into the desert by way of Red Sea Road.
translation_verse: Amoso, nɛ an chena kakpa nɛ baa tre Kadɛsh na n chɛr na.

translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ ma

english_verse: We went past the territory that belonged to our relatives, the descendants of Esau. We followed Arabah Road that starts in the south at Elath and Ezion-Geber, then we turned onto the desert road that leads to Moab.
translation_verse: Amoso an ka wɔ enite na to na nɛ an ku Isɔɔ be kaman to ebi nɛ b la an kurgepoana na be kasawule n lɛ. An daŋ bɔla ekpa nɛ k dese nde nɛ baa tre Elaf nɛ Eziɔngɛba a yɔ Teku Wuso na ase na nna, nseŋ ya kilgi n sɔ keshishɛrsawule be ekpa nɛ k bee yɔ Mowab be kasawule so na.

english_verse: The Lord told me, “Don't try to start a war with Moab. Leave them alone, because I gave the land of Ar to them, and I will not let you have any of it.” Tribes That Lived near Canaan
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ ma le: “Men sa maŋ kaŋ tɔrɔ Mowab be basa nɛ b la Lɔt be kaman to ebi na ŋko n fara kena nɛ bumo. N teŋ ta kadegboŋ nɛ baa tre Ar na nna n sa bumo, ma alɛ maaŋ ta bumo be kasawule be kaba kama n sa menyi.”

english_verse: Before the Lord gave the Moabites their land, a large and powerful tribe lived there. They were the Emim, and they were as tall as the Anakim.

english_verse: The Moabites called them Emim, though others sometimes used the name Rephaim for both the Anakim and the Emim.
translation_verse: Mowabebi ere e daa tre bumo Emebi, ama bekama daa tre bumo Refaebi nna fanɛ kananɛ b daa tre Anakebi na nna.

english_verse: The Horites used to live in Seir, but the Edomites took over that region. They killed many of the Horites and forced the rest of them to leave, just as Israel did to the people in the land that the Lord gave them. Israel Crossed the Zered Gorge Moses said to Israel:

english_verse: When we came to the Zered Gorge along the southern border of Moab, the Lord told us to cross the gorge into Moab, and we did.
translation_verse: Kede be kaman, nɛ an dii Lɔr nɛ baa tre Zered na n luri Mowab be kasawule so fanɛ kananɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ fanɛ an wora na.

english_verse: Then the Lord told me,
translation_verse: nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ anyi le:

english_verse: into Ammon. But don't start a war with the Ammonites. I gave them their land, and I won't give any of it to Israel.” More Nations That Lived near Canaan
translation_verse: Menyeeŋ taga Ammɔnebi nɛ b la Lɔt be kaman to ebi na be kasawule to, ama men sa maŋ kaŋ tɔrɔ bumo ŋko n fara kena nɛ bumo; ŋkpal manɛ so, m maaŋ ta kasawule nɛ n ta n sa bumo na be kaba kama n sa menyi.”

english_verse: Before the Ammonites conquered the land that the Lord had given them, some of the Rephaim used to live there, although the Ammonites called them Zamzummim.
translation_verse: (Pɔɛŋ nɛ Ammɔnebi ba kɔ n sɔ kasawule nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ta n sa bumo na, yiri nɛ b daa tre Refaebi na be beko e daa wɔ ndoŋ, ama Ammɔnebi na bre daa tre bumo Zamzummim nna.

english_verse: The Lord helped them as he had helped the Edomites, who killed many of the Horites in Seir and forced the rest to leave before settling there themselves.
translation_verse: Loŋ koŋwule na nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na wora n sa Edɔmebi, nɛ bumo alɛ gba la Isɔɔ be kaman to ebi na gba. E daŋ mur Hɔɔebi na nna, saŋɛ na so Edɔmebi na beeŋ sɔ bumo be kasawule na n chena kakpa nɛ b kraa wɔ ere.

english_verse: A group called the Avvim used to live in villages as far south as Gaza, but the Philistines killed them and settled on their land. Israel Crossed the Arnon Gorge Moses said:
translation_verse: Katuŋ ko ebi nɛ baa tre Avvim na e daa wɔ ndekarso nɛ a dese hale n ya lar kadegboŋ nɛ baa tre Gaaza na ashi epeŋilarkpa kaba so ndoŋ, nɛ Filistiebi nɛ b daa wɔ kepla nɛ baa tre Kriit na ba m ba mɔ bumo nseŋ sɔ kasawule na n chena so.)

english_verse: After we went through Ammon, the Lord told us: Israel, pack up your possessions, take down your tents, and cross the Arnon River gorge. The territory of the Amorite King Sihon of Heshbon lies on the other side of the river, but I now give you his land. So attack and take it!
translation_verse: An ka bɔla Mowabebi be kasawule so n choŋ na be kaman, nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ naŋ kaŋɛ anyi le: “To, men fara n dii lɔr nɛ baa tre Aanɔn na. Mee ta Amɔriebi be ewura nɛ e wɔ Hɛshbɔn nɛ baa tre mo Sihɔn nɛ mbe efuli a bɔɔ menyi enɔ nna. Amoso, men yɔ n ya kɔ mo nseŋ sɔ kasawule na n chena so.

english_verse: Today I will start making all other nations afraid of you. They will tremble with fear when anyone mentions you, and they will be terrified when you show up. The Defeat of King Sihon of Heshbon (Numbers
translation_verse: Yili kabre a yɔ, meeŋ shin nɛ kaplɛkama be basa e baa ŋana menyi. Kufu beeŋ pɛ ekama nɛ e beeŋ nu b ka ti menyi be ketre nɛ e baa chicha.” Israɛlebi na ka kɔ m pɔɔ Ewura Sihɔn so be asheŋ

english_verse: After we had crossed the Arnon and had set up camp in the Kedemoth Desert, I sent messengers to King Sihon of Heshbon, telling him that his nation and ours could be at peace. I said:
translation_verse: An ka dii lɔr nɛ baa tre Aanɔn na nseŋ ya wora anyi be keeyi to ashi kakpa nɛ baa tre Kademɔt be keshishɛrsawule so na be kaman, nɛ n ta kayurwushi be kubɔya ere n shuŋi mbɔ ewura Sihɔn kutɔ ashi Hɛshbɔn:

english_verse: Please let Israel go across your country. We will walk straight through, without turning off the road.
translation_verse: “Jande, shin nɛ an bɔla fo efuli so n choŋ. Kegbembi so nɛ anyeeŋ bɔla n choŋ nɛ ekama maŋ yɔ bena so ŋko jisoso.

english_verse: You can even sell us food and water, and we will pay with silver. We need to reach the Jordan River and cross it, because the Lord our God is giving us the land on the west side. The Edomites and Moabites have already let us cross their land. Please let us cross your land as well.
translation_verse: hale nɛ an ya dii lɔr nɛ baa tre Jɔɔdan na n yɔ kasawule nɛ Enyɛnpe anyi be Ebɔrɛ na ta a sa anyi na so. Edɔmebi nɛ Mowabebi bre tiŋ n shin nɛ an bɔla bumo be nsawule so n choŋ.”

english_verse: But Sihon refused to let us go across his country, because the Lord made him stubborn and eager to fight us. The Lord told me, “I am going to help you defeat Sihon and take his land, so attack him!”
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ ma le: “Mee sha kechɛ menyi to nna nɛ men kɔ m pɔɔ Ewura Sihɔn so nseŋ sɔ mbe kasawule, amoso, men yɔ n ya kɔ mo!”

english_verse: and the Lord our God helped us defeat them. We killed Sihon, his sons, and everyone else in his army.
translation_verse: Ama Enyɛnpe anyi be Ebɔrɛ na daŋ chɛ anyi to nɛ an pɔɔ bumo so, nseŋ mɔ mo nɛ mbe mbinyɛnso nɛ mbe benapo na kikɛ.

english_verse: The Lord helped us capture every town from the Arnon River gorge north to the boundary of Gilead, including the town of Aroer on the edge of the gorge and the town in the middle of the gorge.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe anyi be Ebɔrɛ na daŋ shin nɛ an yili kade nɛ baa tre Arowa nɛ k wɔ Aanɔn be ketaŋɛ be ekarso na nɛ kadegboŋ nɛ k wɔ ketaŋɛ na to na nna ŋ kɔ n sɔ kasawule na kikɛ hale n ya fo Giliad be egbaŋ to. Ndeana na be kekama be egbalana be kebure daŋ maŋ du anyi so kpakpa.

english_verse: However, we stayed away from all the Ammonite towns, both in the hill country and near the Jabbok River, just as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Ama an daa maŋ yɔ Ammɔnebi be ndeana nɛ a wɔ kepreŋsawule na so, ŋko amo nɛ a wɔ lɔr nɛ baa tre Jabbɔk na ase, ŋko mboŋ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ anyi fanɛ an sa maŋ yɔ amo to na.

english_verse: But the Lord told me, “Moses, don't be afraid of King Og. I am going to help you defeat him and his army and take over his land. Destroy him and his people, just as you did with the Amorite King Sihon of Heshbon.”
translation_verse: Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ ma le: “Mosis, men sa maa ŋana mo. Meeŋ chɛ menyi to nɛ men kɔ m pɔɔ Ewura Ɔg nɛ mbe benapo so n suge bumo be kasawule. Men mur mo nɛ mbe basa kikɛ fanɛ kananɛ men wora Amɔriebi be ewura, Sihɔn, nɛ e daa ji kuwura ashi Hɛshbɔn na.”

english_verse: The Lord our God helped us destroy Og and his army and conquer his entire kingdom of Bashan, including the Argob region. His kingdom had lots of villages and
translation_verse: Nɛ an daŋ mur ndeana na kikɛ nseŋ mɔ benyɛn nɛ beche nɛ mbia na kikɛ fanɛ kananɛ an wora Ewura Sihɔn be ndeana na.

english_verse: but keeping the livestock and everything else of value.
translation_verse: An daŋ ta asɔbɔya na nna nseŋ sensaŋ ndeana na to n ta asɔ lela na kikɛ.

english_verse: Sihon and Og had ruled Amorite kingdoms east of the Jordan River. Their land stretched from the Arnon River gorge in the south to Mount Hermon in the north, and we captured it all.
translation_verse: “Kasawule nɛ k dese Lɔr nɛ baa tre Jɔɔdan na be epeŋilarkpa be kaba so na nɛ an daŋ suge ashi Amɔriebi be bewura anyɔ na kutɔ. english_verse: We captured all the towns in the highlands, all of Gilead, and all of Bashan as far as Salecah and Edrei, two of the towns that Og had ruled. Og's Coffin
translation_verse: Ewura Ɔg be nde nɛ a wɔ kepreŋsawule so na kikɛ nɛ amo nɛ a wɔ Giliad nɛ Bashan be efuli so kikɛ hale n ya fo nde nɛ a wɔ nde nɛ baa tre Saleka nɛ Edrei na be epeŋilarkpa be kaba so na kikɛ nɛ an daŋ kɔ n suge.”

english_verse: The Lord will let them defeat the enemy nations on the west side of the Jordan and take their land. Afterwards, you can come back here to the land I gave you.

english_verse: Then I told Joshua, “You saw how the Lord our God helped us destroy King Sihon and King Og. So don't be afraid! Wherever you go, the Lord will fight on your side and help you destroy your enemies.” God Refused To Let Moses Enter Canaan Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Amoso, men sa maa ŋana bumo, ŋkpal manɛ so, Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ chɛ menyi to ŋ kɔ bumo.” Mosis ka maŋ nya ekpa n luri Keenan be asheŋ

english_verse: At that time I prayed and begged,
translation_verse: Loŋ be jemanɛ na nɛ n daŋ kule Ebɔrɛ kenishipere so ŋ kaŋɛ le:

english_verse: “Our Lord, it seems that you have just begun to show me your great power. No other god in the sky or on earth is able to do the mighty things that you do.
translation_verse: “Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ, n nyi fanɛ asheŋgboŋ nɛ emamachisheŋ nɛ fee sha kewora na nɛ fo fara ŋ ŋini ma na. Ebɔrɛ kikɛ maŋ naa wɔ ebɔrɛso ŋko kasawule so nɛ e beeŋ tiŋ n wora asheŋgboŋ nɛ fo wora ere!

english_verse: The land west of the Jordan is such good land. Please let me cross the Jordan and see the hills and the Lebanon Mountains.”
translation_verse: Jande, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, shin nɛ ma alɛ gba e dii Jɔɔdan be lɔr na n ya wu kasawule lela nɛ k dese kaba ndoŋ na; kumo e la kepreŋsawule lela na, nɛ Lebanɔn be abeegboŋ na.”

english_verse: But the Lord was angry with me because of you people, and he refused to listen. “That's enough!” he said. “I don't want to hear any more.
translation_verse: Ama ŋkpal menyi basa ere so, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na daŋ nya agbo nna n wɔtɔ ma nsaa maŋ nu ma kekule. Kusɔ nɛ e kaŋɛ e la: “A kukwe loŋ! Sa maŋ naŋ malga le be kamalga ere n sa ma kikɛ!

english_verse: Climb to the top of Mount Pisgah and look north, south, east, and west. Take a good look, but you are not going to cross the Jordan River.
translation_verse: Dii n yɔ Pisga be kebeegboŋ na be awɔlto n ya to kenishi ŋ keni ŋ kulti. Keni kusɔ nɛ feeŋ wu kenishiso kikɛ nɛnɛ, ŋkpal manɛ so, fo maaŋ dii Jɔɔdan be lɔr na be kaba ndoŋ.

english_verse: Joshua will lead Israel across the Jordan to take the land, so help him be strong and brave and tell him what he must do.”
translation_verse: Ta mbraana ere n sa Joshuwa. Leŋ mo to nɛ e nya kagbene nɛ kenyɛn, ŋkpal manɛ so, mo e naaŋ juŋkpar basa na nɛ b dii lɔr na n ya chena kasawule nɛ fo wu na so.”

english_verse: Israel, listen to these laws and teachings! If you obey them, you will live, and you will go in and take the land that the Lord is giving you. He is the God your ancestors worshiped,
translation_verse: Ade kikɛ be kaman, nɛ Mosis kaŋɛ basa na le: “Nɛ menyee wora mbraana nɛ mee ŋini menyi ere kikɛ kasonu, menyeeŋ baa wɔtɔ nseŋ tiŋ n ya chena kasawule nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ men nananyɛnana shuŋ na, bee ta a sa menyi na so.

english_verse: and now he is your God. I am telling you everything he has commanded, so don't add anything or take anything away.
translation_verse: Men sa maŋ ta shɛŋ n ti asheŋ nɛ mee kaŋɛ menyi kenishipere so ere so ŋko n lara shɛŋ ashi amo to n lɛ. Men baa wora Enyɛnpe, menyi be Ebɔrɛ na be mbraana nɛ mee ta a sa menyi ere kasonu.

english_verse: But all of you that were faithful to the Lord your God are still alive today.

english_verse: You must be very careful not to forget the things you have seen God do for you. Keep reminding yourselves, and tell your children and grandchildren as well.
translation_verse: Amoso, men baa da so nɛ menyi maaŋ teŋ asheŋ nɛ men wu Ebɔrɛ ka wora n sa menyi ere so. Men baa nyiŋi menyi be amu nsaa kaŋɛ menyi be mbia nɛ benanabiana amo be asheŋ.

english_verse: Do you remember the day you stood in the Lord's presence at Mount Sinai? The Lord said, “Moses, bring the people of Israel here. I want to speak to them so they will obey me as long as they live, and so they will teach their children to obey me too.”
translation_verse: Menyi alɛ e baa nyiŋi kachɛ nɛ men daŋ yili Enyɛnpe, menyi be Ebɔrɛ na be anishito ashi kebeegboŋ nɛ baa tre Sainai na ase na jemanɛ nɛ e kaŋɛ ma le na: “Gama Israɛl be basa na abar so. english_verse: Mount Sinai was surrounded by deep dark clouds, and fire went up to the sky. You came to the foot of the mountain,
translation_verse: Men kaŋɛ menyi be mbia kananɛ men daŋ ya yili Sainai be kebeegboŋ nɛ bɔrɛwɔlpa lembir gbitigbiti nɛ edɛ daa nyɛkpɛ amo to a yɔ awɔlpa so daa buu kumo so na ase

english_verse: and the Lord spoke to you from the fire. You could hear him and understand what he was saying, but you couldn't see him.

english_verse: The Lord said he was making an agreement with you, and he told you that your part of the agreement is to obey the Ten Commandments. Then the Lord wrote these Commandments on two flat stones.
translation_verse: E daŋ kaŋɛ menyi kusɔ nɛ k daga fanɛ men wora, nɛ menyi nɛ mo be kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre na e yili. Kumo e la fanɛ, a daga fanɛ men baa wora mbra kudu nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na sibɛ n deŋi ajembu peŋgeleŋ peŋgelembi anyɔ so na kasonu.

english_verse: That's when the Lord commanded me to give you the laws and teachings you must obey in the land that you will conquer west of the Jordan River. Don't Worship Idols Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na daŋ kaŋɛ ma nna fanɛ ŋ ŋini menyi mbraana nɛ menyeeŋ wora kasonu ashi kasawule nɛ menyee yɔ nɛ men ya kɔ n suge ashi Jɔɔdan be lɔr na be epeŋitɔrkpa be kaba so na. Kefiɛso a laŋɛ kagbirshuŋ be kaplɛa so be asheŋ

english_verse: not to commit the sin of worshiping idols. Don't make idols to be worshiped, whether they are shaped like men, women,
translation_verse: nɛ menyi maaŋ ya luri kagbirshuŋ be kulubi to. Men sa maŋ kaŋ lɔŋɛ agbir nɛ a duli enyɛn ŋko eche,

english_verse: animals, birds,
translation_verse: ŋko kusɔbɔya ŋko kabuibi,

english_verse: And when you see the sun or moon or stars, don't be tempted to bow down and worship them. The Lord put them there for all the other nations to worship.
translation_verse: Men sa maŋ kaŋ shin nɛ kechɔŋkeni e ba menyi so nɛ men gbir m bunyaŋ epeŋi ŋko kufɔl ŋko achɛkpabi kikɛ. Enyɛnpe, menyi be Ebɔrɛ na nyi fanɛ efuli pɔtɛana so be basa bre beeŋ baa sha amo be kebunyaŋ.

english_verse: The Lord was angry with me because of what you said, and he told me that he would not let me cross the Jordan River into the good land that he is giving you.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal menyi so nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nya agbo n wɔtɔ ma, nseŋ bɔ ntaŋ fanɛ m maaŋ dii Jɔɔdan be Lɔr na n yɔ kasawule lela nɛ e ta a sa menyi na so.

english_verse: So I must stay here and die on this side of the Jordan, but you will cross the river and take the land.
translation_verse: Ma ere beeŋ wu kasawule ere so nfe nsaa maaŋ nya n dii lɔr na kikɛ, ama menyi ere beeŋ dii kumo n ya sɔ kasawule lela na n chena so.

english_verse: Always remember the agreement that the Lord your God made with you, and don't make an idol in any shape or form.
translation_verse: Amoso, men baa da so nɛ menyi maaŋ teŋ menyi nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre na so. Men baa wora mbe mbraana kasonu nsaa maŋ kaŋ shuŋ kegbir be yiri kikɛ,

english_verse: The Lord will be angry if you worship other gods, and he can be like a fire destroying everything in its path.
translation_verse: ŋkpal manɛ so, Enyɛnpe, menyi be Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ tiŋ a du fanɛ edɛ nɛ k bee ji a mur. E la Ebɔrɛ nɛ e maa sha kechamana nna.

english_verse: Only a few of you will survive, and the Lord will force you to leave the land and will scatter you among the nations.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ tintiŋ menyi n lar kasawule na so nseŋ pesaŋ menyi to n sɔ efuli pɔtɛana so, mboŋ nɛ menyi to be gbrɛbi beeŋ ya ji efute.

english_verse: There you will have to worship gods made of wood and stone, and these are nothing but idols that can't see or hear or eat or smell.
translation_verse: Menyi alɛ beeŋ ya shuŋ agbir nɛ edimɛdi ta ndibi nɛ ajembu n lɔŋɛ ashi efuli pɔtɛana na so ndoŋ. Amo alɛ maŋ la shɛŋ, a maa wu ŋko a nu ŋko a ji ajibi ŋko a nu efɛa.

english_verse: In all of your troubles, you may finally decide that you want to worship only the Lord. And if you turn back to him and obey him completely, he will again be your God.
translation_verse: Ashi menyi be etɔrɔ na kikɛ to, menyeeŋ ba chɛrga a sha kenaŋ n shuŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nawule. Nɛ menyi alɛ kaŋ bɛta m ba mo kutɔ nseŋ wora mo kasonu kashenteŋto, e beeŋ naa la menyi be Ebɔrɛ.

english_verse: The Lord your God will have mercy—he won't destroy you or desert you. The Lord will remember his promise, and he will keep the agreement he made with your ancestors.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe, menyi be Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ wu menyi kuwɔr nsaa maŋ mur menyi ŋko ŋ kini menyi n lɛ. E beeŋ nyiŋi mbe kɔnɔ naseso nseŋ wora m bɛ mo nɛ men nananyɛnana be kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre so.

english_verse: When the Lord your God brought you out of Egypt, you saw how he fought for you and showed his great power by performing terrifying miracles. You became his people, and at Mount Sinai you heard him talking to you out of fiery flames. And yet you are still alive! Has anything like this ever happened since the time God created humans? No matter where you go or who you ask, you will get the same answer. No one has ever heard of another god even trying to do such things as the Lord your God has done for you.
translation_verse: Kegbir ko malɛ daŋ ber kagbene fanɛ k beeŋ ya lara basa ko ashi efuli ko so m ba ki kumo gbagba be basa fanɛ kananɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na wora ashi Ijipt be efuli so na a? Menyi gbagba be anishito nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bɔla mbe yukugboŋ nɛ eleŋ so n shin nɛ alɔ mɔso nɛ kena nɛ emamachisheŋ be yiri yiri wora nseŋ naŋ shin nɛ asheŋ nɛ a bee keta kufu wora nɛ men wu amo.

english_verse: The Lord wants you to know he is the only true God, and he wants you to obey him. That's why he let you see his mighty miracles and his fierce fire on earth, and why you heard his voice from that fire and from the sky.
translation_verse: E daŋ shin nɛ mbe ebɔl shi ebɔrɛso m ba nɛ men nu, saŋɛ na so e beeŋ ŋini menyi asheŋ. Mo alɛ naŋ shin nɛ men wu mbe edɛ cheembi kasawule ere so nna nɛ e bɔla kumo to m malga n sa menyi.

english_verse: The Lord loved your ancestors and decided that you would be his people. So the Lord used his great power to bring you out of Egypt.
translation_verse: Kasha nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kɔ n sa men nananyɛnana na so nɛ e lara menyi nɛ men baa la mo gbagba be basa nseŋ bɔla mbe yukugboŋ so n lara menyi ashi Ijipt be efuli so m ba.

english_verse: Now you face other nations more powerful than you are, but the Lord has already started forcing them out of their land and giving it to you.
translation_verse: Men ka lar a ba malɛ, mo e daa ju efuliana nɛ b kɔ eleŋ ga a chɔ menyi na a lar nsaa ta bumo be nsawule a sa menyi fanɛ kananɛ e fara a wora ere.

english_verse: So remember that the Lord is the only true God, whether in the sky above or on the earth below.
translation_verse: Amoso men nyiŋi kabre fanɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e la Ebɔrɛ ashi ebɔrɛso nɛ kasawule so kikɛ. Ebɔrɛ kikɛ maŋ naa wɔtɔ n ti mo so.

english_verse: Today I am explaining his laws and teachings. And if you always obey them, you and your descendants will live long and be successful in the land the Lord is giving you. Safe Towns
translation_verse: Men baa wora mbe mbraana kikɛ nɛ mee sa menyi kabre ere kasonu, nɛ asheŋ a nyalɛ n sa menyi nɛ menyi be kaman to ebi kikɛ. Kumo be kaman nɛ men chena kasawule nɛ Enyɛnpe, menyi be Ebɔrɛ na bee ta a sa menyi na so mbaanaayɔ.” Nde nɛ esa beeŋ shile kena n yɔ be asheŋ

english_verse: Moses said, “People of Israel, you must set aside the following three towns east of the Jordan River as Safe Towns: Bezer in the desert highlands belonging to the Reuben tribe; Ramoth in Gilead, belonging to the Gad tribe; and Golan in Bashan, belonging to the Manasseh tribe. If you kill a neighbor without meaning to, and if you had not been angry with that person, you can run to one of these towns and find safety.” The Second Speech: Moses Tells What the Lord Demands Israel at Beth-Peor
translation_verse: Kade nɛ baa tre Bɛza nɛ k wɔ keshishɛrsawule be kepreŋ so na nɛ e daŋ lara n yili n sa Ruben be yiri to ebi, nseŋ lara kumo nɛ baa tre Ramɔf nɛ k wɔ Giliad be kasawule so na n yili n sa Gad be yiri to ebi, nseŋ naŋ lara kade nɛ baa tre Golan nɛ k wɔ Bashan be kasawule so na n yili n sa Manase be yiri to ebi. english_verse: The Israelites had come from Egypt and were camped east of the Jordan River near Beth-Peor, when Moses gave these laws and teachings. The land around their camp had once belonged to King Sihon of Heshbon. But Moses and the Israelites defeated him
translation_verse: Israɛl be basa na ka lar Ijipt be efuli so m ba fo ketaŋɛ nɛ k dese Jɔɔdan be lɔr na be epeŋilarkpa be kaba so m mata kakpa nɛ baa tre Bɛf Piyɔɔ na, nɛ Mosis ta mbraana ere n sa bumo. english_verse: and King Og of Bashan, and took their lands. These two Amorite kings had ruled the territory east of the Jordan River
translation_verse: nɛ Ewura Ɔg so nna n suge bumo be nsawule. Amɔriebi be bewura anyɔ ere e daa ji kuwura nsawule nɛ a dese Jɔɔdan be lɔr na be epeŋilarkpa be kaba so na nna.

english_verse: Moses called together the people of Israel and said: Today I am telling you the laws and teachings that you must follow, so listen carefully.
translation_verse: Mosis daŋ tre Israɛl be basa na kikɛ nna m ba kaŋɛ bumo le: “Israɛlebi, men kaŋ asoe n nu mbraana nɛ mee ta a sa menyi kabre ere. Men koya amo nseŋ wora amo kasonu.

english_verse: Do not murder.
translation_verse: Men sa maŋ kaŋ mɔ.

english_verse: but you were afraid of the fire and refused to go up the mountain. So I spoke with the Lord for you, then I told you that he had said:
translation_verse: N daa yil bumo nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be kefɛato nna a kute asheŋ nɛ e daa kaŋɛ na a sa bumo, ŋkpal manɛ so, b daa ŋana edɛ na nna nsaa maŋ shuli n dii kebee na so. Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ,

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, the one who brought you out of Egypt where you were slaves.
translation_verse: ‘Ma e la Enyɛnpe, menyi be Ebɔrɛ nɛ e kɔ n suge menyi ashi Ijipt, kakpa nɛ menyi daa la anya na.

english_verse: Do not worship any god except me.
translation_verse: Men sa maŋ kaa shuŋ Ebɔrɛ kikɛ n ti ma so.

english_verse: Do not make idols that look like anything in the sky or on earth or in the ocean under the earth.
translation_verse: Men sa maŋ lɔŋɛ kusɔ kikɛ nɛ k wɔ ebɔrɛso ŋko kasawule so ŋko nchu to ŋko kasawule be kaseto be kapɔrduli n sa menyi be amu.

english_verse: Don't bow down and worship idols. I am the Lord your God, and I demand all your love. If you reject me and worship idols, I will punish your families for three or four generations.
translation_verse: Men sa maŋ kaŋ gbir m bunyaŋ kegbir kikɛ ŋko n shuŋ kumo, ŋkpal manɛ so, ma e la Enyɛnpe, menyi be Ebɔrɛ nɛ m maa sha echamana na. Ma e naa gberge bekama nɛ b kishi ma nɛ bumo be kamanebi kusoe hale n ya fo bumo be kenanafofo nɛ kenana gbiramuli.

english_verse: But if you love me and obey my laws, I will be kind to your families for thousands of generations.
translation_verse: Ama mee sha bumo nɛ baa sha ma nsaa wora ma kasonu a bɛ ma mbraana so na nna hale n ya fo bumo be kekurge to be kenana kagboŋ.

english_verse: Do not misuse my name. I am the Lord your God, and I will punish anyone who misuses my name.
translation_verse: Men sa maŋ kaŋ ta ma ketre n wora asheŋ lubi kikɛ, ŋkpal manɛ so, ma Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ gberge ekama nɛ e beeŋ ta ma ketre n wora kusɔ nɛ k maŋ daga na kusoe.

english_verse: You have six days when you can do your work,
translation_verse: Nchɛ ashe nɛ men kɔ nɛ men ta n shuŋ menyi be ashuŋ,

english_verse: but the seventh day of the week belongs to me, your God. No one is to work on that day—not you, your children, your oxen or donkeys or any other animal, not even those foreigners who live in your towns. And don't make your slaves do any work.
translation_verse: ama bɔkwe to be kachɛ shunusopo na la kewushiachɛ nna nsaa la meya. Esa kama maŋ daga fanɛ e shuŋ loŋ be kachɛ na. english_verse: Do not steal.
translation_verse: Men sa maŋ kaŋ yuri.

english_verse: When we were gathered at the mountain, the Lord spoke to us in a loud voice from the dark fiery cloud. The Lord gave us these commands, and only these. Then he wrote them on two flat stones and gave them to me. The People Were Afraid (Exodus
translation_verse: Mbraana nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na daŋ ta n sa Israɛl be basa kikɛ jemanɛ nɛ men daa wɔ kebee na ase na nna na. Jemanɛ nɛ e daŋ bɔla awɔlpa lembir gbitigbiti nɛ edɛ daa lar amo to na to m malga awɔrso na, mbraana ere nɛ e daŋ ta n sa na nɛ mannɛ apɔtɛ ko. english_verse: When fire blazed from the mountain, and you heard the voice coming from the darkness, your tribal leaders came to me
translation_verse: Jemanɛ nɛ edɛ na daa suse wuloŋwuloŋ kebee na so nɛ baa nu ebɔl na tentembiri na to na, nɛ bejuŋkparpoana nɛ eyiriana na be benimuana na ba ŋ kutɔ

english_verse: and said: Today the Lord our God has shown us how powerful and glorious he is. He spoke to us from the fire, and we learned that people can live, even though God speaks to them.
translation_verse: m ba kaŋɛ: “Enyɛnpe, anyi be Ebɔrɛ na lara mbe keshi nɛ kemaŋkura ŋ ŋini kabre. E bɔla edɛ na to m malga nɛ an pin fanɛ Ebɔrɛ beeŋ tiŋ m malga basa kutɔ nɛ b nu nseŋ kraa wɔ ŋkpa to.

english_verse: But we don't want to take a chance on being killed by that terrible fire, and if we keep on hearing the Lord's voice, we will die.
translation_verse: Ama anyi maa sha kewora ewɔji nɛ edɛ gboŋgboŋi ere e mɔ anyi. An baa nyi geeŋ fanɛ nɛ Enyɛnpe, anyi be Ebɔrɛ na kraa malga anyi kutɔ, anyeeŋ wu.

english_verse: Has anyone else ever heard the only true God speaking from fire, as we have? And even if they have, would they live to tell about it?
translation_verse: Dimɛdi ko wɔtɔ nɛ e nu Ebɔrɛ, nɛ mo nawule la Ebɔrɛ ere, ka bɔla edɛ to m malga nseŋ ji efute a?

english_verse: Moses, go up close and listen to the Lord. Then come back and tell us, and we will do everything he says.
translation_verse: Amoso, Mosis, bɛta n yɔ n ya nu kusɔ kama nɛ Enyɛnpe, anyi be Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ nseŋ ba kaŋɛ anyi. Anyeeŋ nu nseŋ wora kusɔ kama nɛ e kaŋɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord heard you and said: Moses, I heard what the people said to you, and I approve.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ka nu loŋ nɛ e kaŋɛ ma le: “N nu kusɔ nɛ basa ere kaŋɛ fo, ma alɛ shuli m bɛ bumo so.

english_verse: I wish they would always worship me with fear and trembling and be this willing to obey me! Then they and their children would always enjoy a successful life.
translation_verse: Nɛ fanɛ baaŋ baa kɔ le be nfɛra nsaa bunyaŋ ma jemanɛ kikɛ nseŋ naa wora ma mbraana kasonu, kumo ere asheŋ beeŋ nyalɛ n sa bumo nɛ bumo be kamanebi hale mbaanaayɔ.

english_verse: Now, tell them to return to their tents,
translation_verse: To, yɔ n ya kaŋɛ bumo fanɛ b bɛta n yɔ bumo be ewajɛbu to.

english_verse: but you come back here to me. After I tell you my laws and teachings, you will repeat them to the people, so they can obey these laws in the land I am giving them. Moses said:
translation_verse: Ama fo ere, Mosis, e shir ma kutɔ nfe nɛ n ta ma mbraana kikɛ n sa fo nɛ fo ta amo n ya ŋini basa na, saŋɛ na so baaŋ baa wora amo kasonu ashi kasawule nɛ mee sa bumo na so.”

english_verse: Follow them, because they make a path that will lead to a long successful life in the land the Lord your God is giving you.
translation_verse: Men baa bɛ amo kikɛ so, saŋɛ na so, asheŋ beeŋ nyalɛ n sa menyi nɛ men tiŋ n chena kasawule nɛ Enyɛnpe, menyi be Ebɔrɛ na bee ta a sa menyi na so n chɛr.

english_verse: The Lord told me to give you these laws and teachings, so you can obey them in the land he is giving you. Soon you will cross the Jordan River and take that land.
translation_verse: “Mbraana nɛ Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na ta n sa ma fanɛ ŋ ŋini menyi nna na. Men ya kaa wora amo kasonu ashi kasawule nɛ menyee dii Jɔɔdan be lɔr na a yɔ nɛ men ya sɔ n chena so na.

english_verse: And if you and your descendants want to live a long time, you must always worship the Lord and obey his laws.
translation_verse: A daga fanɛ menyi nɛ menyi be kamanebi kikɛ ka bee bunyaŋ Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na nsaa wora mbe mbraana nɛ n ta a sa menyi ere kasonu menyi be kebaawɔtɔ kikɛ to, saŋɛ na so menyeeŋ chena kasawule na so n chɛr.

english_verse: Pay attention, Israel! Our ancestors worshiped the Lord, and he promised to give us this land that is rich with milk and honey. Be careful to obey him, and you will become a successful and powerful nation.
translation_verse: Israɛlebi, men nu amo nɛnɛ nseŋ wora amo kasonu! Aloŋ e naaŋ shin nɛ asheŋ e nyalɛ n sa menyi nɛ men ki efuligboŋ nseŋ naŋ tiŋ n chena kasawule lela nɛ k bee wora adɔjibi ga na so, fanɛ kananɛ Enyɛnpe, an nanaana be Ebɔrɛ na, nase kɔnɔ na.

english_verse: Listen, Israel! The Lord our God is the only true God!
translation_verse: Israɛlebi, men nu nfe! Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nawule e la anyi be Ebɔrɛ.

english_verse: So love the Lord your God with all your heart, soul, and strength.
translation_verse: Men baa ta menyi be ŋgbene kikɛ nɛ menyi be ayoyu kikɛ nɛ menyi be eleŋ kikɛ a sha Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na.

english_verse: and tell them to your children over and over again. Talk about them all the time, whether you're at home or walking along the road or going to bed at night, or getting up in the morning.
translation_verse: Men baa ŋini menyi be mbia amo. Men baa kute amo to jemanɛ nɛ men wɔ elaŋ to nɛ jemanɛ nɛ men wɔ ekpa so nɛ jemanɛ nɛ menyee wushi nɛ jemanɛ nɛ menyee shuŋ kikɛ.

english_verse: Write down copies and tie them to your wrists and foreheads to help you obey them.
translation_verse: Men baa kre amo menyi be mbre so nsaa chɛ amo a mata menyi be nsɔto nɛ e baa la kanyiŋi n sa menyi.

english_verse: Write these laws on the door frames of your homes and on your town gates. Worship Only the Lord Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Men baa sibɛ amo a deŋi menyi be nwu be mbuna so nɛ menyi be nde be mbunagboŋ so.” Kusoe kpakpaso be kasokpele be asheŋ

english_verse: The Lord promised your ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob that he would give you this land. Now he will take you there and give you large towns, with good buildings that you didn't build,
translation_verse: Ade be kaman nɛ Mosis naŋ kaŋɛ Israɛlebi na le: “Kananɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ e nase kɔnɔ n sa men nananyɛnana, Eebraham nɛ Aizek nɛ Jeekɔb, fanɛ e beeŋ ta kasawule nɛ nde gboŋgboŋi nɛ a kɔ nwu lela nɛ menyi gbagba maŋ pɔr amo

english_verse: and houses full of good things that you didn't put there. The Lord will give you wells that you didn't have to dig, and vineyards and olive orchards that you didn't have to plant. But when you have eaten so much that you can't eat any more,
translation_verse: nɛ nwu nɛ asɔ lela bɔlɔ amo to nɛ menyi gbagba maŋ ta amo n wɔtɔ ndoŋ na, n sa menyi. Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋ yɛr menyi kasawule ere so nɛ men ya nya asɔ nɛ menyee sha kikɛ a ji,

english_verse: don't forget it was the Lord who set you free from slavery and brought you out of Egypt.
translation_verse: men baa da so nɛ men maŋ teŋ so fanɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e kɔ n suge menyi kenyaya to ashi Ijipt be efuli so.

english_verse: Worship and obey the Lord your God with fear and trembling, and promise that you will be loyal to him.
translation_verse: Amoso men baa bunyaŋ Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na nsaa shuŋ mo nawule nseŋ naa nase nnɔ mo nawule be ketre to.

english_verse: Don't have anything to do with gods that are worshiped by the nations around you.
translation_verse: Men sa maŋ kaa shuŋ basa nɛ b kulti menyi na be agbirana kikɛ.

english_verse: If you worship other gods, the Lord will be furious and wipe you off the face of the earth. The Lord your God is with you,
translation_verse: Nɛ men kaŋ shuŋ agbirana, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be agbo beeŋ ba menyi so fanɛ edɛ m ba mur menyi cheche ashi durnya ere to. Ŋkpal manɛ so, Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ nɛ e wɔ menyi kutɔ na maa sha kechamana.

english_verse: so don't try to make him prove that he can help you, as you did at Massah.
translation_verse: Men sa maŋ kaŋ wora Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na ŋ keni, fanɛ kananɛ men daŋ wora ashi kakpa nɛ baa tre Massa na.

english_verse: Always obey the laws that the Lord has given you
translation_verse: Men baa wora mbraana nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na sa menyi na kikɛ kasonu.

english_verse: Someday your children will ask, “Why did the Lord give us these laws and teachings?”
translation_verse: Kachako menyi be mbia beeŋ ba bishi menyi le: ‘Manɛ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na sa anyi mbraana nɛ keŋini ere?’

english_verse: Then you will answer: We were slaves of the king of Egypt, but the Lord used his great power and set us free.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ men kaŋɛ bumo le: ‘An daa la Ijipt be ewura Fɛɛro be anya nna, ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ta mbe eleŋgboŋ ŋ kɔ n sɔ anyi n yige.

english_verse: We saw him perform miracles and make horrible things happen to the king, his officials, and everyone else.
translation_verse: Anyi gbagba wu e ka wora emamachisheŋ nseŋ shin nɛ alemaŋkarsheŋ ba Ijiptebi na nɛ bumo be ewura nɛ benimuana kikɛ so.

english_verse: The Lord rescued us from Egypt, so he could bring us into this land, as he had promised our ancestors.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e daŋ sɔ anyi n yige ashi Ijipt be efuli so nseŋ bar anyi nfe m ba ta kasawule ere n sa anyi, fanɛ kananɛ e nase kumo be kɔnɔ n sa an nananyɛnana na.’

english_verse: That's why the Lord our God demands that we obey his laws and worship him with fear and trembling. And if we do, he will protect us and help us be successful.
translation_verse: Nɛ fanɛ anyee wora kusɔ kama nɛ Enyɛnpe anyi be Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ kasonu kashenteŋto bre, mbe kagbene beeŋ baa fuli anyi so.”

english_verse: So be sure to obey his laws and teachings I am giving you today. The Lord Will Bless You if You Obey (Deuteronomy
translation_verse: Amoso men baa wora mbe mbraana nɛ keŋini nɛ n ta a sa menyi kabre ere kasonu. Kasonu be enɛfa be asheŋ (Ditɛronɔmi

english_verse: When the Lord helps you defeat your enemies, you must destroy them without pity! And don't get trapped into worshiping their gods.
translation_verse: A daga fanɛ men mur efuli kama nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na shin nɛ men pɔɔ kumo be basa so na cheche nsaa maŋ wu bumo kuwɔr. Men sa maŋ kaa shuŋ bumo be agbirana, ŋkpal manɛ so, loŋ beeŋ tiŋ m bar menyi luwu.

english_verse: the Lord will force them out of the land. Then you must destroy them without mercy. Don't make any peace treaties with them,
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ tintiŋ bumo n lar kasawule na so, nɛ menyi alɛ e mur bumo cheche nsaa maŋ wu bumo kuwɔr. Menyi alɛ nɛ bumo e sa maŋ kaa wora kayurwushi be kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre kikɛ.

english_verse: If you do, those people will lead your descendants to worship other gods and to turn their backs on the Lord. That will make him very angry, and he will quickly destroy Israel.
translation_verse: Nɛ mannɛ aloŋ baaŋ lara menyi be mbia ashi kushuŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na to n ya wɔtɔ agbir be kushuŋ to. Kumo loŋ malɛ beeŋ shin nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e nya agbo ga n wɔtɔ menyi nseŋ mur menyi epul to.

english_verse: So when you conquer these nations, tear down the altars where they worship their gods. Break up their sacred stones, cut down the poles that they use in worshiping the goddess Asherah, and throw their idols in the fire. The Lord's Chosen People Moses said:
