translation_verse: Amoso nɛ men kaŋ kɔ m pɔɔ efuliana na so, men bure m bure bumo be agbirsure nɛ agbirjembu nseŋ ku kegbir cheso nɛ baa tre Ashira na be ndibi nɛ b yuu a shuŋ mo na n lɛ. Kumo be kaman nɛ men chɔɔ bumo be agbirana na m mur.

english_verse: Israel, you are the chosen people of the Lord your God. There are many nations on this earth, but he chose only Israel to be his very own.
translation_verse: A daga fanɛ men wora loŋ ŋkpal manɛ so, men la Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na be basa gbagba nna. Efuli damtaana e wɔ durnya ere to, ama menyi Israɛl be basa nɛ e lara fanɛ men baa la mo gbagba be basa.

english_verse: but the Lord chose you because he loves you and because he had made a promise to your ancestors. Then with his mighty arm, he rescued you from the king of Egypt, who had made you his slaves.
translation_verse: Ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na lara menyi ŋkpal e ka bee sha menyi so nɛ ŋkpal e ka bee sha kewora m bɔlɔ mbe kɔnɔ naseso nɛ e nase n sa men nananyɛnana na so. Amoso nɛ e bɔla mbe eleŋgboŋ so n sɔ menyi n yige kenyaya to ashi Ijipt be efuli so na.

english_verse: You know that the Lord your God is the only true God. So love him and obey his commands, and he will faithfully keep his agreement with you and your descendants for a thousand generations.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal loŋ so, men baa nyiŋi fanɛ Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na nawule e la Kashenteŋ be Ebɔrɛ nsaa la Kashenteŋjipo. E beeŋ wora m bɛ mbe kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre so nseŋ lara mbe kasha nɛ k maa loge na ŋ ŋini basa nɛ baa sha mo nsaa wora mbe mbraana kasonu na, yili kenana ko n ya fo kenana ko loŋ be kagboŋ so.

english_verse: But if you turn against the Lord, he will quickly destroy you.
translation_verse: Ama e maa chɛr kegberge bumo nɛ b kishi mo na kusoe.

english_verse: The Lord will love you and bless you by giving you many children and plenty of food, wine, and olive oil. Your herds of cattle will have many calves, and your flocks of sheep will have many lambs.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ baa sha menyi nseŋ nɛfa menyi, saŋɛ na so menyeeŋ kurge mbia damta n salga to. Mo alɛ beeŋ naŋ nɛfa menyi be adɔsawule, saŋɛ na so, menyeeŋ nya ajibi damta nɛ yabra belbelso nɛ ɔlif be ŋku, nɛ menyi be ana nɛ mbolpɔ e kurge ga. Kasawule nɛ e nase kumo kɔnɔ n sa men nananyɛnana na so nɛ e beeŋ sa menyi enɛfa ere na.

english_verse: If you completely obey these laws, the Lord your God will be loyal and keep the agreement he made with you, just as he promised our ancestors.
translation_verse: Nɛ men nu nseŋ wora mbraana ere kasonu kashenteŋto, Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ baa bɛ menyi nɛ mo be kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre na so nseŋ ŋini menyi mbe kasha nɛ k maa loge na fanɛ kananɛ e nase men nananyɛnana kɔnɔ na.

english_verse: You will no longer suffer with the same horrible diseases that you sometimes had in Egypt. You will be healthy, but the Lord will make your enemies suffer from those diseases. Destroy the Nations and Their Gods Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e naaŋ baa kuŋ menyi ashi alɔ kikɛ to nsaa maŋ shin nɛ alɔ lubi nɛ a daa tɔrɔ menyi ashi Ijipt be efuli so na e ba menyi so, ama e beeŋ shin nɛ a pɛ men doŋana kikɛ.

english_verse: You may be thinking, “How can we destroy these nations? They are more powerful than we are.”
translation_verse: Men sa maŋ kaa fɛ fanɛ basa na shibi a chɔ menyi so menyi maaŋ tiŋ n ju bumo n lar kasawule na so.

english_verse: But stop worrying! Just remember what the Lord your God did to Egypt and its king.
translation_verse: Men sa maa ŋana bumo, ama men baa nyiŋi kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na wora Ijipt be ewura nɛ mbe basa na.

english_verse: You saw how the Lord used his tremendous power to work great miracles and bring you out of Egypt. And he will again work miracles for you when you face these enemies you fear so much.
translation_verse: Men baa nyiŋi alɔ lubi nɛ menyi gbagba wu anishi so nɛ emamachisheŋ nɛ yukugboŋ nɛ eleŋ nɛ Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na ta n sɔ menyi n yige na. Kananɛ e baŋ mur Ijiptebi na nɛ e beeŋ mur basa nɛ menyee ŋana naniere na gba.

english_verse: Some of them may try to survive by hiding from you, but the Lord will make them panic, and soon they will be dead.
translation_verse: E beeŋ shin nɛ keyeŋiyeŋi e tɔr bumo so nɛ e mur bumo nɛ baaŋ nya n shile n ya ŋana na gba.

english_verse: So don't be frightened when you meet them in battle. The Lord your God is great and fearsome, and he will fight at your side.
translation_verse: Amoso men sa maa ŋana basa ere jemanɛ nɛ menyi nɛ bumo beeŋ tu abar kena to. Menyi nɛ Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na e wɔtɔ. E la Ebɔrɛ gboŋgboŋi nɛ mbe asheŋ kɔ kufu nna.

english_verse: As you attack these nations, the Lord will force them out little by little. He won't let you get rid of them all at once—if he did, there wouldn't be enough people living in the land to keep down the number of wild animals.
translation_verse: Saŋɛ nɛ menyee kɔ a yɔ anishito na, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na malɛ beeŋ baa tintiŋ efuliana na be basa a lar kasawule na so gbrɛgbrɛbi. E maaŋ shin nɛ men mur bumo kikɛ kela koŋwule, ŋkpal manɛ so, nɛ men mur bumo kikɛ epul to, kupuŋ to be asɔbɔya lubi beeŋ wora keshi ŋ ki kabɔlar n sa menyi.

english_verse: But when you attack your enemies, the Lord will make them panic, and you will easily destroy them. You will defeat their kings one after another until they are gone, and no one will remember they ever lived.
translation_verse: Mo alɛ beeŋ naŋ sa menyi yuku bumo be bewura so nɛ men mɔ bumo nɛ esa maaŋ naa nyiŋi bumo be asheŋ gba kuraa. Esa kama maaŋ tiŋ ŋ kuŋ menyi be kemur bumo akpa.

english_verse: After you conquer a nation, burn their idols. Don't get trapped into wanting the silver or gold on an idol. Even the metal on an idol is disgusting to the Lord,
translation_verse: Nɛ men kaŋ pɔɔ efuli kama so, men chɔɔ bumo be agbirana. Men sa maŋ kaa yɛlga shuwa ŋko gbiti nɛ a beeŋ baa deŋ agbirana na so na. Menyi alɛ e sa maŋ ta amo ŋ ki menyeya. Nɛ men wora loŋ, k beeŋ tiŋ a la luwu n sa menyi, ŋkpal manɛ so, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kishi kagbirshuŋ nna.

english_verse: Israel, do you want to go into the land the Lord promised your ancestors? Do you want to capture it, live there, and become a powerful nation? Then be sure to obey every command I am giving you.
translation_verse: Mosis daŋ kaŋɛ le nna: “Men baa wora mbraana nɛ n ta a sa menyi kabre ere kikɛ kasonu kashenteŋto, saŋɛ na so menyeeŋ baa wɔ ŋkpa to nseŋ wora keshi n ti so nseŋ tiŋ ŋ kɔ n sɔ kasawule nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nase kumo be kɔnɔ n sa men nananyɛnana na n chena so.

english_verse: so he made you go hungry. Then he gave you manna, a kind of food that you and your ancestors had never even heard about. The Lord was teaching you that people need more than food to live—they need every word that the Lord has spoken.
translation_verse: Amoso nɛ e daŋ shin nɛ akoŋ pɛ menyi, kumo be kaman nɛ e sa menyi ajibi nɛ menyi nɛ men nananyɛnana maŋ naŋ ji ŋ ku so na. Ajibi na nɛ baa tre ‘manna’ na. Mo alɛ daŋ wora loŋ nna nɛ e ŋini menyi fanɛ a maŋ daga fanɛ men baa wɔtɔ ŋkpal ajibi nawule so, ama ŋkpal kusɔ kama nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ so.

english_verse: So keep in mind that the Lord has been correcting you, just as parents correct their children.
translation_verse: Menyi alɛ e naa nyiŋi fanɛ Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na e naa niŋi menyi nseŋ naa gberge menyi kusoe fanɛ kananɛ betuto nɛ benioana bee bela bumo be mbia na.

english_verse: Obey the commands the Lord your God has given you and worship him with fear and trembling.
translation_verse: Amoso men baa wora Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be mbraana na kasonu nsaa ta kufu nɛ kechicha chicha a bunyaŋ mo.

english_verse: The Lord your God is bringing you into a good land with streams that flow from springs in the valleys and hills.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, kasawule nɛ k kɔ mbombi nɛ achubu nɛ a bee bɔlɔ a shile a luri ataŋɛ to nɛ kepreŋsawule so kikɛ, nsaa wora adɔjibi ga na so nɛ Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na kɔ menyi a yɔ so na.

english_verse: You can dig for copper in those hills, and the stones are made of iron ore. And you won't go hungry. Wheat and barley fields are everywhere, and so are vineyards and orchards full of fig, pomegranate, and olive trees, and there is plenty of honey. Don't Forget the Lord Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Ajibi ŋko shɛŋ be asheŋ maŋ du kpakpa kasawule na so. Abɛlso kpakpaso gba wɔ kumo be ajembu to nɛ esa beeŋ tiŋ ŋ kur kumo be apreŋ so n nya danyaŋ amo to.

english_verse: After you eat and are full, give praise to the Lord your God for the good land he gave you.
translation_verse: Ade be kaman, menyeeŋ nya asɔ kama nɛ menyee sha n ji nseŋ ta kechɔrɔ n sa Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na ŋkpal e ka sa menyi kasawule lela so. Kasokpele a laŋɛ keteŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na so be asheŋ

english_verse: Make sure that you never forget the Lord or disobey his laws and teachings that I am giving you today. If you always obey them,
translation_verse: Men baa da so nɛ menyi maaŋ teŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na so ŋko n wora mbe mbraana nɛ n ta a sa menyi kabre ere kusoe kpakpaso.

english_verse: you will have plenty to eat, and you will build good houses to live in.
translation_verse: Nɛ men kaŋ ya nya n ji nɛnɛ nseŋ pɔr nwu lela n chena to,

english_verse: You will get more and more cattle, sheep, silver, gold, and other possessions.
translation_verse: nɛ menyi be ana nɛ mbolpɔ nɛ shuwa nɛ gbiti nɛ menyi be asɔ nɛ men kɔ kikɛ wora keshi n ti so n sa menyi,

english_verse: But when all this happens, don't be proud! Don't forget that you were once slaves in Egypt and that it was the Lord who set you free.
translation_verse: men baa da so nɛ kamoowu maaŋ luri menyi to nɛ men teŋ Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ nɛ e kɔ n suge menyi kenyaya to ashi Ijipt be efuli so na so.

english_verse: Remember how he led you in that huge and frightening desert where poisonous snakes and scorpions live. There was no water, but the Lord split open a rock, and water poured out so you could drink.
translation_verse: Men baa nyiŋi kananɛ e juŋkpar menyi keshishɛrsawule gboŋgboŋi nɛ awɔ lubi nɛ nna wɔ kumo so na to. Nchu daa maŋ wɔ ndoŋ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na shin nɛ kefalta baŋɛ nɛ nchu lar kumo to saŋɛ na so, menyeeŋ nya n nuu.

english_verse: He also gave you manna, a kind of food your ancestors had never even heard about. The Lord was testing you to make you trust him, so that later on he could be good to you.
translation_verse: Mo koŋwule na e sa menyi ajibi nɛ baa tre ‘manna’ na ashi keshishɛrsawule na so nɛ men ji. Ajibi nɛ men nananyɛnana maŋ naŋ ji ŋ ku so na nɛ e sa menyi. Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ daŋ shin nna nɛ etɔrɔbi ba menyi so nɛ e wora menyi ŋ keni nɛ men yirda mo, saŋɛ na so, e beeŋ nɛfa menyi nɛ asɔ lela.

english_verse: When you become successful, don't say, “I'm rich, and I've earned it all myself.”
translation_verse: Amoso men sa maŋ kaa fɛ fanɛ menyi gbagba be eleŋ nɛ ketiŋwora so nɛ men nyalɛ nseŋ dii dama na.

english_verse: Instead, remember that the Lord your God gives you the strength to make a living. That's how he keeps the promise he made to your ancestors.
translation_verse: Ama men baa nyiŋi fanɛ Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na e sa menyi eleŋ nɛ men ta n fin kedamaya na. Mo alɛ wora loŋ nna a ŋini fanɛ, e bee ji kashenteŋ a sa mo nɛ men nananyɛnana be kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre na nna hale nɛ mbre.

english_verse: But I'm warning you—if you forget the Lord your God and worship other gods, the Lord will destroy you, just as he destroyed the nations you fought.
translation_verse: Mee kpele menyi kusoe kabre nna, fanɛ men sa maŋ kaŋ teŋ Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na so ŋko n ya shuŋ agbir. Nɛ men kaŋ wora loŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ mur menyi fanɛ kananɛ e beeŋ mur efuliana nɛ menyeeŋ kɔ kena na.”

english_verse: Israel, listen to me! You will soon cross the Jordan River and go into the land to force out the nations that live there. They are more powerful than you are, and the walls around their cities reach to the sky.
translation_verse: Israɛlebi, men nu nfe! Menyee sha kedii lɔrgboŋ nɛ baa tre Jɔɔdan na nna n ya kɔ n sɔ efuliana nɛ amo be basa kɔ eleŋ a chɔ menyi be kasawule n chena so na. Bumo be ndegboŋ kɔ egbalana nɛ amo be jeŋgreŋ du fanɛ a kaa bee chute awɔlpa nna.

english_verse: Some of these nations are descendants of the Anakim. You know how tall and strong they are, and you've heard that no one can defeat them in battle.
translation_verse: Basa na gbagba wɔ nteŋ nsaa kɔ eleŋ a chɔ menyi, nɛ menyi alɛ bee nu fanɛ esa kama maŋ tiŋ n tu bumo ŋ kɔ m pɔɔ so.

english_verse: But the Lord your God has promised to go ahead of you, like a raging fire burning everything in its path. So when you attack your enemies, it will be easy for you to destroy them and take their land.
translation_verse: Ama menyi ere beeŋ wu naniere fanɛ Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ juŋkpar menyi fanɛ gbaŋgbaŋ to be edɛ na. E beeŋ pɔɔ bumo so n sa menyi jemanɛ nɛ menyeeŋ baa kɔ bumo na, saŋɛ na so, menyeeŋ mur bumo nseŋ suge bumo be kasawule, fanɛ kananɛ e nase kɔnɔ na.

english_verse: After the Lord helps you wipe out these nations and conquer their land, don't think he did it because you are such good people. You aren't good—you are stubborn! No, the Lord is going to help you, because the nations that live there are evil, and because he wants to keep the promise he made to your ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. When Israel Made an Idol (Exodus
translation_verse: A daga men baa nyi fanɛ Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na maa ta kasawule lela nɛ k bee wora adɔjibi ga na nna a sa menyi ŋkpal k ka daga menyi so. Mannɛ aloŋ nna, ŋkpal manɛ so, men kpeŋ nna.

english_verse: Don't ever forget how you kept rebelling and making the Lord angry the whole time you were in the desert. You rebelled from the day you left Egypt until the day you arrived here.
translation_verse: Men sa maŋ kaŋ teŋ kananɛ men daŋ shin nɛ Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na nya agbo ashi keshishɛrsawule na so na. Yili kachɛ nɛ men lar Ijipt be efuli so m ba fo nfe, men baa la basa nɛ menyee lar Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaman nna.

english_verse: At Mount Sinai you made the Lord so angry that he was going to destroy you.
translation_verse: Men daŋ shin nɛ e nya agbo hale n daa sha kemur menyi gba kuraa nna ashi Sainai be kebeegboŋ na ase.

english_verse: I've been watching the Israelites, and I've seen how stubborn and rebellious they are.
translation_verse: Kede be kaman, nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ ma le: “N nyi kananɛ Israɛl be basa ere kpeŋ nsaa beeŋ tiŋ n lar ma kaman.

english_verse: So don't try to stop me! I am going to wipe them out, and no one on earth will remember they ever lived. Then I will let your descendants become an even bigger and more powerful nation than Israel. Moses said:
translation_verse: Amoso sa maŋ kaŋ kuŋ ma akpa, ŋkpal manɛ so, mee sha kemur bumo nna nɛ esa kikɛ maaŋ naaŋ nyiŋi bumo be asheŋ kikɛ. Kumo be kaman nɛ n shin nɛ fo ki efuli nɛ k shi nsaa kɔ eleŋ a chɔ bumo ere kumo tuto.”

english_verse: Fire was raging on the mountaintop as I went back down, carrying the two stones with the commandments on them.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ ŋ keta ajembu peŋgeleŋ peŋgelembi anyɔ nɛ kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre na deŋ so na ŋ gbelge kebeegboŋ na so. Loŋ be jemanɛ na nɛ edɛ be adondulombi bee lar kebeegboŋ na so.

english_verse: I saw how quickly you had sinned and disobeyed the Lord your God. There you were, worshiping the metal idol you had made in the shape of a calf.
translation_verse: Ma alɛ daŋ wu fanɛ men daŋ maŋ wora Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na be mbraana nɛ e sa menyi na kasonu. Menyi alɛ daŋ lɔŋɛ kebɛlso be gbolu fɔlbi be kegbir n wora kulubi n da mo so.

english_verse: So I threw down the two stones and smashed them before your very eyes.
translation_verse: Amoso Israɛl be basa na gbagba be anishito nɛ n daŋ ta ajembu peŋgeleŋ peŋgelembi anyɔ na n lɛ nɛ a bure to.

english_verse: I bowed down at the place of worship and prayed to the Lord, without eating or drinking for
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na daŋ nya agbo ga nna n wɔtɔ Ɛɛrɔn gba nseŋ daa sha kemɔ mo nɛ ŋ kule n sa mo alɛ gba.

english_verse: It was a sin for you to make that idol, so I threw it into the fire to melt it down. Then I took the lump of gold, ground it into powder, and threw the powder into the stream flowing down the mountain.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ n ta kebɛlso be gbolu fɔlbi be kegbir nɛ b lɔŋɛ nɛ k la kulubi na n wɔtɔ edɛ to nseŋ bure kumo to. Kumo be kaman nɛ ŋ kɔr kumo to nseŋ muu amo n ya lɛ kabombi nɛ k bee shile kebeegboŋ na so a gbelge to na to.

english_verse: You also made the Lord angry when you were staying at Taberah, at Massah, and at Kibroth-Hattaavah.
translation_verse: Ade kikɛ be kaman, b daŋ naŋ shin nɛ Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na nya agbo jemanɛ nɛ b daa wɔ mboŋ nɛ baa tre Tabera nɛ Massa nɛ Kibrɔf Hattava na nna.

english_verse: Then at Kadesh-Barnea the Lord said, “I am giving you the land, so go ahead and take it!” But since you didn't trust the Lord, you rebelled and disobeyed his command.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman na, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na daŋ naŋ kaŋɛ bumo ashi Kadɛsh Bania nna fanɛ b yɔ n ya kɔ n sɔ kasawule nɛ e bee ta a sa bumo na, ama ŋkpal b ka maŋ yirda mo so, b lar mo kaman nna nseŋ kini kewora mbe mbraana kasonu.

english_verse: In fact, you've rebelled against the Lord for as long as he has known you.
translation_verse: Ma ere ka baa nyi menyi kikɛ, men baa la basa nɛ menyee lar Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaman nna.

english_verse: After you had made the idol in the shape of a calf, the Lord said he was going to destroy you. So I lay face down in front of the Lord for
translation_verse: Amoso nɛ n daŋ buu anishi so nseŋ kurgi kumu n yuu to ashi Enyɛnpe be wajɛbu na to nchɛ adena nɛ nnyɛ adena a kule Ebɔrɛ na, ŋkpal manɛ so, n daa nyi geeŋ fanɛ e daa kre kemur bumo nna.

english_verse: and prayed: Our Lord, please don't wipe out your people. You used your great power to rescue them from Egypt and to make them your very own.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ ŋ kule Ebɔrɛ ŋ kaŋɛ: “Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ, sa maŋ kaŋ mur fo gbagba be basa nɛ fo bɔla fo yuku nɛ eleŋgboŋ so ŋ kɔ n suge ashi Ijipt be efuli so na.

english_verse: Israel's ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob obeyed you faithfully. Think about them, and not about Israel's stubbornness, evil, and sin.
translation_verse: Baa nyiŋi Eebraham nɛ Aizek nɛ Jeekɔb nɛ b daa la fo nyɛrbi dra dra na be asheŋ, nsaa maŋ keni basa ere be ŋkpensheŋ nɛ kumukpakpaso nɛ kulubi nɛ b wora.

english_verse: If you destroy your people, the Egyptians will say, “The Lord promised to give Israel land, but he wasn't powerful enough to keep his promise. In fact, he hated them so much that he took them into the desert and killed them.”
translation_verse: Nɛ fo mur bumo, Ijiptebi na beeŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ fo maŋ tiŋ n ta fo basa na n yɔ kasawule nɛ fo nase bumo kumo be kɔnɔ na so nna nseŋ ya mɔ bumo keshishɛrsawule so ŋkpal fo ka kishi bumo so.

english_verse: But you, our Lord, chose the people of Israel to be your own, and with your mighty power you rescued them from Egypt.
translation_verse: Ama fo e lara Israɛl be basa ere fanɛ fo gbagba be basa nseŋ bɔla fo yuku nɛ eleŋgboŋ so n lara bumo Ijipt be efuli so m ba nfe.”

english_verse: The Lord told me to chisel out two flat stones, just like the ones he had given me earlier. He also commanded me to make a wooden chest, then come up the mountain and meet with him.
translation_verse: “Ade be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ ma le: ‘Shɛl ajembu peŋgeleŋ peŋgelembi anyɔ nɛ a baa du fanɛ sososo peya na nseŋ lɔŋɛ ndibi be deka. Kumo be kaman nɛ fo dii m ba ma kutɔ kebee na so

english_verse: He told me that he would write on the new stones the same words he had written on the ones I broke, and that I could put these stones in this sacred chest.
translation_verse: nɛ n sibɛ asɔ nɛ n daŋ sibɛ n deŋi ajembu nɛ fo bure na so n deŋi amo so. Kumo be kaman nɛ fo ta ajembu sibɛso na n wɔtɔ deka na to.’

english_verse: So I made a chest out of acacia wood, and I chiseled two flat stones like the ones I broke. Then I carried the stones up the mountain,
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ ŋ ku kedibi nɛ baa tre akasia na n lɔŋɛ deka n yili nseŋ shɛl ajembu peŋgeleŋ peŋgelembi fanɛ a dra na nseŋ ta amo n dii kebeegboŋ na so n yɔ.

english_verse: where the Lord wrote the Ten Commandments on them, just as he had done the first time. The commandments were exactly what he had announced from the fire, when you were gathered at the mountain. After the Lord returned the stones to me,
translation_verse: Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na sibɛ Mbra Kudu na n deŋi amo so fanɛ kananɛ e daŋ wora sososo na. Mbra kudu nɛ e daŋ bɔla edɛ to m malga jemanɛ nɛ an daŋ shɛr kebeegboŋ na ase na e daa la. Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ka bɛta amo n sa ma

english_verse: I took them down the mountainside and put them in the chest, just as he had commanded. And they are still there. Aaron Died (Numbers
translation_verse: nɛ n ta amo ŋ gbelge kebeegboŋ na so m ba wɔtɔ deka na to fanɛ kananɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ na. Amo alɛ kraa wɔ deka na to hale nɛ mbre.”

english_verse: Respect the Lord your God, be faithful, and serve only him, making promises in his name.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman, men baa sa Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na bunyaŋ nsaa shuŋ mo nawule. Men baa ji kashenteŋ a sa mo nsaa nase nnɔ ashi mo nawule be ketre to.

english_verse: Later we set up camp at the wells belonging to the descendants of Jaakan. Then we moved on and camped at Moserah, where Aaron died and was buried, and his son Eleazar became the priest.
translation_verse: (Kede be kaman nɛ Israɛlebi na koso kanyɛn nɛ baa tre Jaakan na be basa be atirbu ase n yɔ kakpa nɛ baa tre Mosera na n ya wora bumo be keeyi to ndoŋ. Ndoŋ nɛ Ɛɛrɔn wu nɛ b puli mo nɛ mo pibinyɛn Eliaza sɔ mo so ŋ ki bɔrɛmatapowura.

english_verse: Next, we camped at Gudgodah and then at Jotbathah, where there are flowing streams. The Levites Were Appointed To Carry the Chest Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: B ka koso Mosera nɛ b ta n yɔ kakpa nɛ baa tre Gudgoda na nseŋ naŋ koso ndoŋ malɛ n yɔ kakpa nɛ baa tre Jotbatta nɛ k kɔ mbombi damta na n ya wora bumo be keeyi to ndoŋ.

english_verse: After I put the two stones in the sacred chest, the Lord chose the tribe of Levi, not only to carry the chest, but also to serve as his priests at the place of worship and to bless the other tribes in his name. And they still do these things.
translation_verse: Ashi Sainai be kebeegboŋ na ase na nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na lara Livai be yiri to be basa ko fanɛ b baa keni kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre be deka na so nsaa shuŋ bɔrɛmatapoana be kushuŋ nseŋ naa nɛfa eyiri nɛ a ka na ashi mbe ketre to. Loŋ nɛ b kraa wora hale nɛ mbre.

english_verse: Instead, he told me, “Moses, get ready to lead the people into the land that I promised their ancestors.” What the Lord Wants Moses said:
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ e kaŋɛ ma fanɛ m ba juŋkpar menyi, saŋɛ na so menyeeŋ tiŋ n ya kɔ n sɔ kasawule nɛ e nase kumo be kɔnɔ n sa men nananyɛnana na nɛ k baa la menyeya. Kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee sha be asheŋ

english_verse: People of Israel, what does the Lord your God want from you? The Lord wants you to respect and follow him, to love and serve him with all your heart and soul,
translation_verse: To, Israɛl be basa, men nu kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na bee fin menyi kutɔ. Kumo e la fanɛ men bunyaŋ mo nseŋ bɛ mbe mbra kikɛ so nseŋ ta menyi be ŋgbene kikɛ n sha mo nseŋ shuŋ mo,

english_verse: and to obey his laws and teachings that I am giving you today. Do this, and all will go well for you.
translation_verse: nseŋ naŋ wora mbe mbraana nɛ mee ta a sa menyi kabre ere kikɛ kasonu. Nɛ men wora loŋ, asheŋ beeŋ nyalɛ n sa menyi.

english_verse: Everything belongs to the Lord your God, not only the earth and everything on it, but also the sky and the highest heavens.
translation_verse: Kusɔ kama la Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na peya nna, mannɛ kasawule ere nɛ asɔ nɛ a wɔ kumo to nawule ama awɔlpa nɛ ebɔrɛso kikɛ la mo peya nna.

english_verse: Yet the Lord loved your ancestors and wanted them to belong to him. So he chose them and their descendants rather than any other nation, and today you are still his people.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na daŋ sha men nananyɛnana na ga so nna nɛ e lara menyi nseŋ yige basa nɛ b ka na. Hale nɛ mbre men kraa la mbe basa laraso nna.

english_verse: Remember your agreement with the Lord and stop being so stubborn.
translation_verse: Amoso yili kabre a yɔ, men baa wora Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kasonu nseŋ yige menyi be ŋkpensheŋ na.

english_verse: The Lord your God is more powerful than all other gods and lords, and his tremendous power is to be feared. His decisions are always fair, and you cannot bribe him to change his mind.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na e la Ebɔrɛ nɛ e kɔ eleŋ a chɔ agbirana kikɛ nseŋ naa la benyɛnpe to be Enyɛnpe, Ebɔrɛ lempo nɛ mbe asheŋ shi nsaa kɔ kufu. Mo alɛ maa kpɛa to ŋko a tu basa a sɔ asɔ pɔɛŋ nsaa wora asheŋ a sa bumo.

english_verse: The Lord defends the rights of orphans and widows. He cares for foreigners and gives them food and clothing.
translation_verse: Mo ere Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e naa kuŋ amunibi nɛ bekulpoche nsaa keni befɔ nɛ b wɔ anyi be basa to so, a sa bumo ajibi nɛ asɔbuuso.

english_verse: Offer your praises to him, because you have seen him work such terrifying miracles for you.
translation_verse: Men baa kpaŋ mo, ŋkpal manɛ so, mo e la menyi be Ebɔrɛ nɛ menyi alɛ gbagba wu asheŋgboŋ nɛ a bee mɔ kɔnɔ nɛ e wora kenishiso.

english_verse: The Lord is your God, so you must always love him and obey his laws and teachings.
translation_verse: Men baa sha Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na nsaa wora mbe mbraana kikɛ kasonu.

english_verse: Remember, he corrected you and not your children. You are the ones who saw the Lord use his great power
translation_verse: Kabre men baa nyiŋi fanɛ menyi nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na daŋ ŋini ekpa mannɛ menyi be mbia. Menyi e wu Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ka bɔla mbe yukugboŋ so

english_verse: when he worked miracles in Egypt, making terrible things happen to the king and all his people.
translation_verse: n wora emamachisheŋ ashi Ijipt be efuli so. Menyi e wu kusɔ nɛ e wora Ijipt be ewura Fɛɛro nɛ mbe basa kikɛ.

english_verse: And when the Egyptian army chased you in their chariots, you saw the Lord drown them and their horses in the Red Sea. Egypt still suffers from that defeat!
translation_verse: Men wu kananɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na mur Ijipt be benapo nɛ bumo be egbaŋɛ nɛ egbaŋɛturko ashi Teku Peper na to jemanɛ nɛ b daa ju a buu menyi so na.

english_verse: You saw what the Lord did for you while you were in the desert, right up to the time you arrived here.
translation_verse: Menyi alɛ nyi kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na wora n sa menyi ashi keshishɛrsawule na so pɔɛŋ nɛ men fo nfe.

english_verse: And you saw how the Lord made the ground open up in the middle of our camp underneath the tents of Dathan and Abiram, who were swallowed up along with their families, their animals, and their tents.
translation_verse: Ade be kaman, men wu kusɔ nɛ e wora benyɛn anyɔ nɛ baa tre Datan nɛ Abiram nɛ b la kanyɛn nɛ baa tre Ɛliyab nɛ e shi Ruben be yiri to na be bibinyɛn. Ekama be anishito nɛ kasawule baŋɛ n ta bumo nɛ bumo be nnanto ebi nɛ ewajɛbu nɛ bumo be nyɛrbi nɛ asɔbɔya kikɛ m min.

english_verse: With your own eyes, you saw the Lord's mighty power do all these things.
translation_verse: Kashenteŋto, menyi gbagba e wu asheŋgboŋ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na wora ere kikɛ kenishiso.

english_verse: Soon you will cross the Jordan River, and if you obey the laws and teachings I'm giving you today, you will be strong enough to conquer the land
translation_verse: Amoso, men baa wora asheŋ nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ menyi kabre ere kikɛ kasonu. Aloŋ nɛ menyeeŋ tiŋ n dii Jɔɔdan be lɔr na n ya sɔ kasawule nɛ menyee sha keluri to ere n chena so.

english_verse: that the Lord promised your ancestors and their descendants. It's rich with milk and honey, and you will live there and enjoy it for a long time.
translation_verse: Nseŋ tiŋ n chena kasawule lela nɛ k bee wora adɔjibi ga, nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nase kumo be kɔnɔ n sa menyi nananyɛnana nɛ bumo kaman to ebi ere so n chɛr.

english_verse: It's better land than you had in Egypt, where you had to struggle just to water your crops.
translation_verse: Kasawule nɛ menyee yɔ nɛ men ya sɔ n chena so na walɛ a chɔ Ijipt be kasawule na, kakpa nɛ men daa wora ania a wurge menyi be asɔduuso so nchu na.

english_verse: But the hills and valleys in the promised land are watered by rain from heaven,
translation_verse: Ama kasawule nɛ menyee sha keluri to ere la abee nɛ ataŋɛ nna nɛ bɔrɛ bee ba kumo so nɛnɛ.

english_verse: because the Lord your God keeps his eye on this land and takes care of it all year long.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na gbagba e naa keni kasawule na so kafɛ kikɛ.

english_verse: The Lord your God commands you to love him and to serve him with all your heart and soul. If you obey him,
translation_verse: Amoso men baa wora mbraana nɛ n ta a sa menyi kabre ere kasonu. Men baa sha Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na nsaa ta menyi be ŋgbene kikɛ a shuŋ mo.

english_verse: he will send rain at the right seasons, so you will have more than enough food, wine, and olive oil, and there will be plenty of grass for your cattle.
translation_verse: nɛ menyi be asɔbɔya e baa nya afitiri lela damta a ji. Menyi alɛ gbagba beeŋ nya ajibi nɛ menyee sha.

english_verse: But watch out! You will be tempted to turn your backs on the Lord. And if you worship other gods,
translation_verse: Amoso, men baa da so nɛ menyi maaŋ lar Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaman nseŋ ya kaa shuŋ agbir.

english_verse: the Lord will become angry and keep the rain from falling. Nothing will grow in your fields, and you will die and disappear from the good land that the Lord is giving you.
translation_verse: Nɛ men wora loŋ, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ nya agbo n wɔtɔ menyi nseŋ pɛ bɔrɛ nɛ menyi be adɔsawule e wɔl nɛ menyi be adɔjibi e wora ŋ gben. Kumo be kaman k maŋ chɛr nɛ menyi gbagba e wu m mur kasawule lela nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee sa menyi na so.

english_verse: Memorize these laws and think about them. Write down copies and tie them to your wrists and your foreheads to help you obey them.
translation_verse: Men baa nyiŋi mbraana ere nseŋ ta amo n wɔtɔ menyi be nfɛra nɛ ŋgbene to. Men sibɛ amo n chɛ menyi be enɔana nɛ menyi be nsɔto nɛ a baa la kanyiŋi a sa menyi.

english_verse: Teach them to your children. Talk about them all the time—whether you're at home or walking along the road or going to bed at night, or getting up in the morning.
translation_verse: Men baa ŋini menyi be mbia amo nsaa malga amo be asheŋ jemanɛ kikɛ ashi menyi be elaŋ to nɛ jemanɛ nɛ men lar kowu a nite nɛ jemanɛ nɛ men ya dese kanyɛso nɛ jemanɛ nɛ men koso kachipurso.

english_verse: Write them on the door frames of your homes and on your town gates.
translation_verse: Menyi alɛ e sibɛ amo n deŋi menyi be nwu be mbuna nɛ menyi be nde be mbunagboŋana so.

english_verse: Then you and your descendants will live a long time in the land that the Lord promised your ancestors. Your families will live there as long as the sky is above the earth.
translation_verse: Aloŋ e naaŋ shin nɛ menyi nɛ menyi be mbia e chena kasawule nɛ Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na nase kumo be kɔnɔ n sa men nananyɛnana na so n chɛr. Menyeeŋ chena ndoŋ hale n ya fo durnya ere be lalaloge.

english_verse: Love the Lord your God faithfully and obey all the laws and teachings I'm giving you today. If you live the way the Lord wants,
translation_verse: Men baa sha Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na nsaa wora mbraana nɛ n ta a sa menyi kabre ere kasonu nɛnɛ. Men baa wora kusɔ kama nɛ e kaŋɛ menyi kenishipere so nsaa ji kashenteŋ a sa mo.

english_verse: he will help you take the land. And even though the nations there are more powerful than you, the Lord will force them to leave when you attack.
translation_verse: Aloŋ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ chɛ menyi to nɛ men sɔ kasawule na. Efuliana nɛ a wɔ ndoŋ na be basa shibi nsaa kɔ eleŋ a chɔ menyi, ama e beeŋ tintiŋ bumo n lar kasawule na so jemanɛ nɛ menyeeŋ baa kɔ bumo na.

english_verse: No one will be able to stand up to you. The Lord will make everyone terrified of you, just as he promised.
translation_verse: Kaplɛkama nɛ menyeeŋ yɔ kasawule na so, Enyɛnpe, menyi be Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ shin nɛ kufu a pɛ basa nɛ b wɔ ndoŋ na fanɛ kananɛ e nase kɔnɔ na. Esa kikɛ maaŋ tiŋ ŋ kuŋ menyi akpa.

english_verse: You have a choice—do you want the Lord to bless you, or do you want him to put a curse on you?
translation_verse: Nɛfa nɛ shoduu be ekpa nɛ mee bugi a sa menyi kabre na.

english_verse: Today I am giving you his laws, and if you obey him, he will bless you.
translation_verse: Nɛ fanɛ menyee wora Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na be mbraana kasonu, menyeeŋ nya nɛfa kabre,

english_verse: But if you disobey him and worship those gods that have never done anything for you, the Lord will put a curse on you.
translation_verse: ama nɛ fanɛ menyi maa wora mbe mbraana ere kasonu nseŋ ya kaa shuŋ agbirana nɛ men maŋ naŋ shuŋ ŋ ku so bre, kɔnɔsho beeŋ ba menyi so.

english_verse: After the Lord your God helps you take the land, you must have a ceremony where you announce his blessings from Mount Gerizim and his curses from Mount Ebal.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na kaŋ chɛ menyi to nɛ men sɔ kasawule na n chena so, a daga fanɛ men shɛr kebeegboŋ nɛ baa tre Gɛrizim na so m moli Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be enɛfa na kumo so nseŋ naŋ shɛr kebeegboŋ nɛ baa tre Ebal na so m moli mbe eshoduu na malɛ kumo so.

english_verse: You know that these two mountains are west of the Jordan River in land now controlled by the Canaanites living in the Jordan River valley. The mountains are west of the road near the sacred trees of Moreh on the other side of Gilgal.
translation_verse: Abeegboŋ anyɔ ere wɔ Keenanebi nɛ b tase ketaŋɛ nɛ baa tre Jɔɔdan be Ketaŋɛ na to na be kaba nɛ k dese Jɔɔdan be lɔr na be epeŋitɔrkpa be kaba so na nna. Abeegboŋana ere mata ekpa nɛ k dese n taga to kakpa nɛ baa tre Moriya be ndibi cheembi nɛ a wɔ kade nɛ baa tre Gilgaal na be kaba ndoŋ nna.

english_verse: Soon you will cross the Jordan River to conquer the land that the Lord your God is giving you. And when you have settled there,
translation_verse: Menyee dii Jɔɔdan be lɔr na nna nɛ men ya sɔ kasawule nɛ Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na bee ta a sa menyi nɛ men chena so na nna na. Nɛ men kaŋ ya sɔ kumo n chena ndoŋ,

english_verse: be careful to obey his laws and teachings that I am giving you today.
translation_verse: men baa da so nsaa wora mbraana nɛ n ta a sa menyi kabre ere kasonu.

english_verse: Now I'll tell you the laws and teachings that you have to obey as long as you live. Your ancestors worshiped the Lord, and he is giving you this land.
translation_verse: Mbraana nɛ a daga fanɛ men baa wora amo kasonu ashi kasawule nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ menyi nananyɛnana shuŋ na ta a sa menyi na so nna na. Men nu amo!

english_verse: But the nations that live there worship other gods. So after you capture the land, you must completely destroy their places of worship—on mountains and hills or in the shade of large trees.
translation_verse: Men ya jija abee jeŋgreŋ nɛ agoŋgulombi nɛ ndibigboŋ nɛ basa na ta ŋ ki bumo be agbirshuŋkpa na kikɛ.

english_verse: Wherever these nations worship their gods, you must tear down their altars, break their sacred stones, burn the sacred poles used in worshiping the goddess Asherah, and smash their idols to pieces. Destroy these places of worship so completely that no one will remember they were ever there.
translation_verse: Men bure bumo be agbirsure nɛ eshabɔrɛ nɛ b ta ajembu m pɔr na nseŋ chɔɔ asɔ kama nɛ a yili n sa kegbir cheso nɛ baa tre Ashira na, saŋɛ na so basa maaŋ naŋ shuŋ agbirana na ashi loŋ be mboŋ kikɛ.

english_verse: Don't worship the Lord your God in the way those nations worship their gods.
translation_verse: Kede be kaman, men sa maŋ kaa shuŋ Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na fanɛ kananɛ basa na bee shuŋ bumo be agbirana na.

english_verse: The Lord has promised that later on he will give Israel more land, and some of you may not be able to travel all the way from your homes to the place of worship each time you are hungry for meat. But the Lord will give you cattle, sheep, and goats, and you can butcher any of those animals at home and eat as much as you want.
translation_verse: Nɛ fanɛ kakpa koŋwule nɛ menyeeŋ baa shuŋ Ebɔrɛ na wɔ kufɔ, kumo ere jemanɛ kikɛ nɛ menyee sha menyeeŋ tiŋ m mɔ ana ŋko mbolpɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na sa menyi na be kekama n we ashi men peana fanɛ kananɛ ŋ kaŋɛ menyi na.

english_verse: It is the same as eating the meat from a deer or a gazelle that you kill when you go hunting. And in this way, anyone who is unclean and unfit for worship can have some of the meat.
translation_verse: Menyi to be bumo nɛ b walɛ so nɛ bumo nɛ b maŋ walɛ so daŋkare be ekpa so kikɛ beeŋ tiŋ n we eblaŋ na fanɛ kananɛ menyee we echibir ŋko eshantan be eblaŋ na.

english_verse: But don't eat the blood. It is the life of the animal, so let it drain out on the ground before you eat the meat.
translation_verse: Men sa maŋ kaa ta ŋklaŋ na fanɛ ajibi a ji amo, ama men baa chulgi amo a wurge kasawule fanɛ nchu.

english_verse: Do you want the Lord to make you successful? Do you want your children to be successful even after you are gone? Then do what pleases the Lord and don't eat blood.
translation_verse: Nɛ menyee wora mbra ere kasonu, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be kagbene beeŋ baa fuli menyi so nɛ asheŋ a nyalɛ n sa menyi nɛ menyi be kaman to ebi.

english_verse: All sacrifices and offerings to the Lord must be taken to the place where he chooses to be worshiped. If you offer a sacrifice to please the Lord, all of its meat must be burned on the altar. You can eat the meat from certain kinds of sacrifices, but you must always pour out the animal's blood on the altar.
translation_verse: Loŋ be kakpa na nɛ menyeeŋ baa lara esarga chɔɔso ashi Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be bɔrɛsure so nsaa lara esarga kama nɛ menyeeŋ baa mɔ a chulgi amo be ŋklaŋ a wurge bɔrɛsure na ase nsaa we amo be eblaŋ gba ashi ndoŋ.

english_verse: If you obey these laws, you will be doing what the Lord your God says is right and good. Then he will help you and your descendants be successful. Worship the Lord in the Right Way Moses said:
translation_verse: Nɛ fanɛ menyeeŋ wora mbraana nɛ mee kaŋɛ menyi ere kasonu kashenteŋto, asheŋ beeŋ nyalɛ n sa menyi nɛ menyi be kaman to ebi hale mbaanaayɔ. Ŋkpal manɛ so, menyeeŋ baa wora kusɔ nɛ k daga nsaa par Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na nna na.” Kusoe kpele a laŋɛ kagbirshuŋ be kaplɛa so be asheŋ

english_verse: Israel, as you go into the land and attack the nations that are there, the Lord will get rid of them, and you can have their land.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Mosis naŋ kaŋɛ le: “Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na e naaŋ baa mur efuliana nɛ menyeeŋ baa kɔ a sɔ bumo be nsawule na nɛ men nya n chena ndoŋ.

english_verse: Obey all the laws and teachings I am giving you. Don't add any, and don't take any away.
translation_verse: Men baa wora mbraana nɛ mee ta a sa menyi ere kikɛ kasonu nsaa maŋ ta shɛŋ n ti amo so ŋko n lara shɛŋ ashi amo to.”

english_verse: Someday a prophet may come along who is able to perform miracles or tell what will happen in the future. Then the prophet may say, “Let's start worshiping some new gods—some gods that we know nothing about.”
translation_verse: a fin kananɛ baaŋ nya menyi nɛ men shuŋ agbirana nɛ menyi maŋ naŋ shuŋ ŋ ku so. Nɛ k kaŋ ba loŋ

english_verse: If the prophet says this, don't listen! The Lord your God will be watching to find out whether or not you love him with all your heart and soul.
translation_verse: men sa maŋ kaa nu a sa bumo. Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na e naa bɔla bumo so a sha kewora menyi ŋ keni nseŋ pin fanɛ menyee sha mo nɛ menyi be ŋgbene kikɛ ŋko menyi maa sha mo.

english_verse: You must be completely faithful to the Lord. Worship and obey only the Lord and do this with fear and trembling,
translation_verse: Men baa bɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na so nsaa bunyaŋ mo. Menyi alɛ e baa wora mo nɛ mbe mbraana kasonu nsaa shuŋ mo nseŋ naa ji kashenteŋ a sa mo.

english_verse: And when the rest of Israel hears about it, they will be afraid, and no one else will ever do such an evil thing again.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman, Israɛl be basa kikɛ beeŋ nu kusɔ nɛ k wora na be asheŋ, nɛ kufu e pɛ bumo nɛ ekama maaŋ naŋ wora loŋ be kesheŋ lubi na kikɛ.

english_verse: After the Lord your God gives you towns to live in, you may hear a rumor about one of the towns.
translation_verse: Jemanɛ nɛ menyeeŋ ya kaa wɔ ndeana nɛ Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ sa menyi na to na, menyeeŋ nu

english_verse: You may hear that some worthless people have talked everyone there into worshiping other gods, even though these gods had never done anything for them.
translation_verse: fanɛ menyi be efuli so be basa jiga ko fule bumo be ndeana to be basa ko nɛ b shuŋ agbirana nɛ menyi maŋ naŋ shuŋ ŋ ku so kikɛ.

english_verse: You must carefully find out if the rumor is true. Then if the people of that town have actually done such a disgusting thing in your own country,
translation_verse: Nɛ menyi kaŋ nu loŋ be ŋkooko be kubɔya na, men keni to n fin kumo be kashenteŋ. Nɛ k kaa la fanɛ le be kulubi ere wora kashenteŋto nna,

english_verse: you must take your swords and kill every one of them, and their livestock too.
translation_verse: kumo ere men mɔ basa nɛ b wɔ loŋ be kade na to kikɛ nɛ bumo asɔbɔya gba kikɛ n ti so. Men mur kade na cheche.

english_verse: Gather all the possessions of the people who lived there, and pile them up in the marketplace, without keeping anything for yourself. Set the pile and the whole town on fire, and don't ever rebuild the town. The whole town will be a sacrifice to the Lord your God. Then he won't be angry anymore, and he will have mercy on you and make your nation stronger, just as he promised your ancestors.
translation_verse: Menyi alɛ e sa maŋ kaŋ ta kusɔ kama kade na to. Aloŋ e naaŋ shin nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be agbogboŋ e wushi nɛ e wu menyi kuwɔr. Kumo be kaman nɛ e shin nɛ men wora keshi n ti so fanɛ kananɛ e nase kumo be kɔnɔ n sa men nananyɛnana na.

english_verse: That's why you must do what the Lord your God says is right. I am giving you his laws and teachings today, and you must obey them.
translation_verse: Amoso nɛ a daga fanɛ men baa wora kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ fanɛ k walɛ na. Mee ta mbraana ere nna a sa menyi kabre nɛ men baa wora amo kasonu.”

english_verse: Out of all the nations on this earth, the Lord your God chose you to be his own. You belong to the Lord, so don't behave like those who worship other gods. Animals That Can Be Eaten (Leviticus
translation_verse: Menyi ere la basa nɛ Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na lara nna nɛ men baa la mo gbagba be basa ashi edimɛdi nɛ b wɔ durnya kikɛ to. Asɔbɔya nɛ e walɛ so nɛ amo nɛ e maŋ walɛ so be asheŋ

english_verse: You can eat any clean bird.
translation_verse: Menyeeŋ tiŋ n ji kabuibi kama nɛ k walɛ so.

english_verse: You may eat the meat of cattle, sheep, and goats; wild sheep and goats; and gazelles, antelopes, and all kinds of deer.
translation_verse: nɛ echibir nɛ kupuŋ to be asɔbɔya nɛ a duli mbolpɔ nɛ mboe nɛ eshantaŋ.

english_verse: It is all right to eat meat from any animals that have divided hoofs and also chew the cud.
translation_verse: Menyeeŋ tiŋ n ji asɔbɔya kama nɛ emo be alotobi barga to nɛ a bee gbu apla.

english_verse: And don't eat pork, since pigs have divided hoofs, but they do not chew their cud. Don't even touch a dead pig!
translation_verse: Men sa maŋ kaa ji epreku. Amo be alotobi barga to ama amo alɛ maa gbu apla, amoso a maŋ walɛ so. Men sa maa ji asɔbɔya ere be kekama ŋko m beta amo be kuwuso gba.

english_verse: You can eat any fish that has fins and scales. But there are other creatures that live in the water,
translation_verse: Menyeeŋ tiŋ n ji ekɔrɔtɔ nɛ baa kpaso be yiri kikɛ,

english_verse: and if they do not have fins and scales, you must not eat them. Treat them as unclean.
translation_verse: ama nchu to be asɔ keniso kikɛ nɛ b maa kpaso maŋ daga men ji amo. A maŋ walɛ so n sa menyi.

english_verse: But don't eat the meat of any of the following birds: eagles, vultures, falcons, kites, ravens, ostriches, owls, sea gulls, hawks, pelicans, ospreys, cormorants, storks, herons, and hoopoes. You must not eat bats.
translation_verse: Ama men sa maa ji le be mbuibi ere, kajɔnɔkoso nɛ jita nɛ jitamanchaŋ nɛ kɔlfɔɔti nɛ kɔl nɛ lambɛ nɛ margaati nɛ nyiŋgbeŋ be yiri kikɛ nɛ gbuŋgbula be yiri kikɛ nɛ tɔkɔrkɔ nɛ lambɛ be yiri kikɛ nɛ kelɛkelɛ nɛ luku nɛ mɔmɔ nɛ kɔɔŋkɔŋ.

english_verse: However, you are allowed to eat certain kinds of winged insects.
translation_verse: Ama menyeeŋ tiŋ n ji asɔ firgisobi ko fanɛ elotɔr nɛ epantɛ nɛ alonte.

english_verse: You belong to the Lord your God, so if you happen to find a dead animal, don't eat its meat. You may give it to foreigners who live in your town or sell it to foreigners who are visiting your town. Don't boil a young goat in its mother's milk. Give the Lord Ten Percent of Your Harvest Moses said:
translation_verse: Menyi ere la Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na be basa nna, amoso men sa maŋ kaa ji kusɔbɔya kikɛ nɛ k wu kpi. Menyeeŋ tiŋ n shin nɛ befɔ nɛ b chena menyi to na bre e ji kumo, ŋko menyeeŋ tiŋ n fa kumo n sa befɔ pɔtɛ. Men sa maŋ kaa daŋɛ kubolpɔbi ŋko kaboebi be eblaŋ kumo nio be kenyipochu to kikɛ. Kudu kudusopo be mbra be asheŋ

english_verse: People of Israel, every year you must set aside ten percent of your grain harvest.
translation_verse: Israɛlebi, kafɛ kikɛ men baa lara menyi be adɔjibi to be kudu kudusopo a yili.

english_verse: Also set aside ten percent of your wine and olive oil, and the first-born of every cow, sheep, and goat. Take these to the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped, and eat them there. This will teach you to always respect the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ men yɔ kakpa nɛ Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na lara n yili fanɛ kakpa nɛ menyeeŋ baa shuŋ mo na nseŋ ya ji menyi be ayu nɛ yabra belbelso nɛ ɔlif be ŋku be kudu kudusopoana nɛ ana nɛ mbolpɔ be ewurkoŋ na ndoŋ. Men baa wora le nseŋ koya kebaabunyaŋ Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na saŋkikɛ.

english_verse: But suppose you can't carry that ten percent of your harvest to the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped. If you live too far away, or if the Lord gives you a big harvest,
translation_verse: Ama nɛ fanɛ menyi be echenakpa nɛ kakpa nɛ menyeeŋ baa shuŋ Ebɔrɛ na wɔ kufɔ nɛ k du menyi so kpakpa nɛ ketiŋ n sulɔ adɔjibi nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ta n nɛfa menyi na be kudu kudusopo n yɔ ndoŋ,

english_verse: then sell this part and take the money there instead.
translation_verse: kumo ere men fa adɔjibi na nseŋ ta amansherbi na n yɔ kakpa nɛ menyee shuŋ Ebɔrɛ na.

english_verse: When you and your family arrive, spend the money on food for a big celebration. Buy cattle, sheep, goats, wine, beer, and if there are any other kinds of food that you want, buy those too.
translation_verse: Menyi nɛ menyi be laŋ to ebi kaŋ fo ndoŋ nɛ men ta amansherbi na n tɔ ajibi nɛ menyee sha nɛ ana nɛ mbolpɔ nɛ mboe nɛ yabra belbelso nɛ nsa n wora kejigboŋ n ji menyi be amu ashi Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na be anishito.

english_verse: And since people of the Levi tribe won't own any land for growing crops, remember to ask the Levites to celebrate with you.
translation_verse: Ama men sa maŋ kaa kplaŋ Livai be basa nɛ b wɔ menyi be nde to so jemanɛ nɛ menyee ji na, ŋkpal manɛ so, b maaŋ baa kɔ bumo gbagba be nsawule nɛ baaŋ baa dɔ amo so a nya ajibi.

english_verse: Every third year, instead of using the ten percent of your harvest for a big celebration, bring it into town and put it in a community storehouse.
translation_verse: Kafɛ sasopo kikɛ be lalaloge nɛ men chala menyi be adɔjibi kikɛ be kudu kudusopo a wɔtɔ ebu to a yili menyi be nde to nsaa maa ji amo.

english_verse: The Levites have no land of their own, so you must give them food from the storehouse. You must also give food to the poor who live in your town, including orphans, widows, and foreigners. If they have enough to eat, then the Lord your God will be pleased and make you successful in everything you do.
translation_verse: Le be ajibi ere la Livaiebi nɛ b maŋ kɔ bumo gbagba be nsawule na, nɛ befɔ, nɛ amunibi, nɛ bekulpoche, nɛ b wɔ menyi be nde to na peya nna. Saŋɛ na so, bumo alɛ gba beeŋ nya n ji yɛlayɛlaso. Men baa wora loŋ nɛ Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na e nɛfa menyi ashi kusɔ kama nɛ menyee wora to.

english_verse: After the Lord your God gives land to each of you, there may be poor Israelites in the town where you live. If there are, then don't be mean and selfish with your money.
translation_verse: Kede be kaman nɛ asheŋ tir Israɛl be basa ko nɛ b wɔtɔ menyi be ndeana to ashi kasawule nɛ Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na bee sa menyi ere so, kumo ere men sa maŋ kaa wora kejimuni nseŋ kini kechɛ bumo to.

english_verse: Every seven years you must announce, “The Lord says loans do not need to be paid back.” Then if you have loaned money to another Israelite, you can no longer ask for payment.
translation_verse: Kananɛ menyeeŋ baa wora kumo nde: Menyi to be ekama nɛ mo barkasa Israɛl be esa paŋ amansherbi mo kutɔ beeŋ kpra kukɔ na. E sa maŋ naŋ sɔ amansherbi na, ŋkpal manɛ so, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na gbagba e kpra kukɔ na.

english_verse: This law applies only to loans you have made to other Israelites. Foreigners will still have to pay back what you have loaned them.
translation_verse: Menyeeŋ tiŋ n shin nɛ efɔ bre e ka kukɔ nɛ e ji menyi, ama a maŋ daga fanɛ men shin nɛ menyi gbagba to bre be esa e ka kukɔ nɛ e ji menyi na.

english_verse: No one in Israel should ever be poor. The Lord your God is giving you this land, and he has promised to make you very successful, if you obey his laws and teachings that I'm giving you today. You will lend money to many nations, but you won't have to borrow. You will rule many nations, but they won't rule you.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ nɛfa menyi fanɛ kananɛ e nase kɔnɔ na, nɛ efuli damtaana so ebi e paŋ menyi amansherbi, ama menyi ere maaŋ ya paŋ efuli kama so ebi amansherbi. Menyi alɛ beeŋ ji kuwura efuli damta so, ama efuli kama maaŋ ji kuwura menyi ere so.

english_verse: Instead, be kind and lend them what they need.
translation_verse: Men baa bugi ŋgbene a paŋ bumo kanaŋkamaso nɛ ketir bumo.

english_verse: Be careful! Don't say to yourself, “Soon it will be the seventh year, and then I won't be able to get my money back.” It would be horrible for you to think that way and to be so selfish that you refuse to help the poor. They are your relatives, and if you don't help them, they may ask the Lord to decide whether you have done wrong. And he will say that you are guilty.
translation_verse: Men sa maa kini kepaŋ basa asɔ ŋkpal kafɛ nɛ baa yige basa be akɔ a kɛ bumo na ka taga to so. Men sa maŋ shin nɛ le be nfɛra lubi ere e ba menyi to gba kuraa. Nɛ menyi baŋ kini kesa betirpo na m paŋ, baaŋ shu ŋ ŋini Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nɛ kumo be kulubi e baa bɛ menyi.

english_verse: You should be happy to give the poor what they need, because then the Lord will make you successful in everything you do.
translation_verse: Amoso men baa wora betirpo be asheŋ tirso yɛlyɛla so a sa bumo, mannɛ kejimuni so. Saŋɛ na so nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e nɛfa menyi ashi kusɔ kama nɛ menyee wora to.

english_verse: But if the animal is lame or blind or has something else wrong with it, you must not sacrifice it to the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Ama nɛ fanɛ kusɔbɔya na buri to ŋko n tan nna ŋko doro ko wɔ kumo so nna, kumo ere men sa maŋ kaŋ ta kumo n lara sarga n sa Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na.

english_verse: And don't just tell them they are free to leave—
translation_verse: Nɛ menyi alɛ baŋ yige bumo fanɛ b baa yɔ, men sa maŋ shin nɛ b ta enɔfuloŋ a yɔ.

english_verse: give them sheep and goats and a good supply of grain and wine. The more the Lord has given you, the more you should give them.
translation_verse: Men bugi ŋgbene n sa bumo mbolpɔ nɛ ayu nɛ yabra belbelso nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ta n nɛfa menyi na be ako.

english_verse: But one of your slaves may say, “I love you and your family, and I would be better off staying with you, so please don't make me leave.”
translation_verse: Ashere fo kenya na maaŋ baa sha keyɔ ŋkpal e ka bee sha fo nɛ fo kanaŋ so nsaa sha kebaawɔ menyi kutɔ.

english_verse: Take the slave to the door of your house and push a sharp metal rod through one earlobe and into the door. Such slaves will belong to you for life, whether they are men or women.
translation_verse: Kumo ere fo keta mo n yɔ fo laŋ be kabuna to n ya futi mbe kusoe, nɛ e ki fo kenya mbaanaayɔ. Hale kenya cheso gba a loŋ a daga fanɛ fo wora mo alɛ gba.

english_verse: If the first-born animal of a cow or sheep or goat is a male, it must be given to the Lord. Don't put first-born cattle to work or cut wool from first-born sheep.
translation_verse: Kede be kaman, kusɔbɔya fanɛ kena ŋko kubolpɔ ŋko kaboe pibi wurkoŋ la Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na peya nna nɛ a maŋ daga fanɛ men ta loŋ be ana na a shuŋ ŋko ŋ kuya mbolpɔ na be afuibi n wora kusɔ ko.

english_verse: Instead, each year you must take the first-born of these animals to the place where the Lord your God chooses to be worshiped. You and your family will sacrifice them to the Lord and then eat them as part of a sacred meal.
translation_verse: Kafɛ kikɛ menyi nɛ menyi be laŋ to ebi beeŋ baa mɔ amo a lara sarga pɔɛŋ nseŋ we eblaŋ na ashi kakpa nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na lara n yili fanɛ men baa shɛr ndoŋ a shuŋ mo na.

english_verse: You can butcher it where you live, and eat it just like the meat of a deer or gazelle that you kill while hunting. Even those people who are unclean and unfit for worship can have some.
translation_verse: Menyeeŋ tiŋ m mɔ le be asɔbɔya ere n we ashi menyi be echenakpaana. Menyi to be bumo nɛ b walɛ so nɛ bumo nɛ b maŋ walɛ so kikɛ beeŋ tiŋ n we amo be eblaŋ fanɛ kananɛ menyee mɔ echibir nɛ eshantaŋ a we na.

english_verse: But you must never eat the blood of an animal—let it drain out on the ground.
translation_verse: Ama men sa maŋ kaa ji amo be ŋklaŋ bre. A daga fanɛ men chulgi amo n wurge kasawule.

english_verse: People of Israel, if you want to enjoy a long and successful life, make sure that everyone is treated with justice in the land the Lord is giving you. Don't Set Up Sacred Poles or Stones Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Nɛ menyi Israɛlebi bee sha kechena kayurwushi so n chɛr, kumo ere men ta kashenteŋji n chena abar so kasawule nɛ Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ bee sa menyi ere so.

english_verse: Eat all of the meat of the Passover sacrifice that same night. But don't serve bread made with yeast at the Passover meal. Serve the same kind of thin bread that you ate when you were slaves suffering in Egypt and when you had to leave Egypt quickly. As long as you live, this thin bread will remind you of the day you left Egypt. For seven days following Passover, don't make any bread with yeast. In fact, there should be no yeast anywhere in Israel.
translation_verse: A maŋ daga fanɛ esa kikɛ menyi be kasawule na so e baa kɔ yiisi mbe laŋ to nchɛnshunu na kikɛ to. A daga fanɛ men we kusɔbɔya nɛ menyeeŋ mɔ kaaseso n ji Kebansonchoŋ na be eblaŋ kikɛ kachɛ sososo na be kanyɛ na kikɛ.

english_verse: Eat thin bread for the next six days. Then on the seventh day, don't do any work. Instead, come together and worship the Lord. The Harvest Festival (Exodus
translation_verse: Nchɛnshe nɛ menyee we bodobodo nɛ a maŋ kɔ yiisi, kachɛ shunusopo na nɛ men shɛr m bunyaŋ Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na. Menyi alɛ e sa maŋ kaŋ shuŋ shɛŋ loŋ be kachɛ na. Kasɔteŋi be kachɛgboŋ be asheŋ (Ɛksodɔs

english_verse: The Passover sacrifice must be a cow, a sheep, or a goat, and you must offer it at the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped.
translation_verse: Kusɔbɔya nɛ menyeeŋ ta n lara sarga n sa Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na Kebansonchoŋ be kachɛgboŋachɛ na daga fanɛ k baa la kena ŋko kubolpɔ ŋko kaboe. Menyi alɛ beeŋ ya mɔ kumo ashi kakpa nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na lara n yili fanɛ men baa shuŋ mo ndoŋ na nna.

english_verse: Don't offer the Passover sacrifice in just any town where you happen to live.
translation_verse: Men sa maŋ kaŋ mɔ kebansonchoŋ be kusɔbɔya na n lara sarga ashi kade kama nɛ menyeeŋ baa wɔ na to.

english_verse: It must be offered at the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped. Kill the sacrifice at sunset, the time of day when you left Egypt.
translation_verse: A daga fanɛ men mɔ kumo ashi kakpa nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na lara n sa menyi fanɛ ndoŋ nɛ menyeeŋ baa shuŋ mo na nna. Saŋɛ nɛ epeŋi bee luri efar to na nɛ menyeeŋ mɔ kusɔbɔya na fanɛ kananɛ men daŋ wora pɔɛŋ nseŋ lar Ijipt be efuli so na.

english_verse: Then cook it and eat it there at the place of worship, returning to your tents the next morning.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ men daŋɛ kumo n we ashi kakpa nɛ menyeeŋ baa shuŋ Ebɔrɛ na. Kumo be ŋklade kachipurso nɛ men bɛta n yɔ epe.

english_verse: After you have finished the grain harvest and the grape harvest, take your sons and daughters and all your servants to the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped. Celebrate the Festival of Shelters for seven days. Also invite the poor, including Levites, foreigners, orphans, and widows. The Lord will give you big harvests and make you successful in everything you do. You will be completely happy, so celebrate this festival in honor of the Lord your God. Three Festivals at the Place of Worship (Exodus
translation_verse: Menyeeŋ ji kachɛgboŋ na m bɛ abar so nchɛnshunu ashi kakpa nɛ menyeeŋ baa shuŋ Ebɔrɛ na n ta kemaŋkura n sa Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na. Menyi alɛ e shin nɛ menyi be ŋgbene e fuli menyi ŋkpal Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ka nɛfa menyi be adɔ nɛ ashuŋ so.

english_verse: When you build the altar for offering sacrifices to the Lord your God, don't set up a sacred pole for the worship of the goddess Asherah.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ men baŋ pɔr Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na be bɔrɛsure, men sa maŋ kaŋ yuu kedibi tenteŋ nɛ k yili n sa kegbir cheso nɛ baa tre ‘Ashira’ na kumo ase.

english_verse: go to the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped and celebrate the Harvest Festival in honor of the Lord your God. Bring him an offering as large as you can afford, depending on how big a harvest he has given you. Be sure to take along your sons and daughters and all your servants. Also invite the poor, including Levites, foreigners, orphans, and widows.
translation_verse: Menyi nɛ menyi be mbia nɛ nyɛrbi nɛ Livaiebi nɛ befɔ nɛ amunibi nɛ bekulpoche nɛ b wɔ kade na to na beeŋ ji menyi be amu ashi Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be anishito ashi kakpa nɛ menyee shuŋ Ebɔrɛ na.

english_verse: The bigger the harvest the Lord gives you, the bigger your gift should be. Treat Everyone with Justice Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: nɛ e beeŋ tiŋ n nya ashi adɔjibi nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ta n nɛfa mo na to m ba sa Ebɔrɛ. Demujipoana be kushuŋ be asheŋ

english_verse: Each year there are three festivals when all Israelite men must go to the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped. These are the Festival of Thin Bread, the Harvest Festival, and the Festival of Shelters. And don't forget to take along a gift for the Lord.
translation_verse: Ela asa nɛ menyi be efuli so be basa kikɛ beeŋ ba shuŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ashi kakpa nɛ menyeeŋ baa shuŋ Ebɔrɛ na. Jemanɛ nɛ baaŋ baa wora loŋ e la Kebansonchoŋ be kejigboŋachɛ nɛ Kasɔteŋi be kejigboŋachɛ nɛ Abuu to be kebaawɔ be kejigboŋachɛ. Menyi to be ekama beeŋ bar kakɛ

english_verse: After you are settled in the towns that you will receive from the Lord your God, the people in each town must appoint judges and other officers. Those of you that become judges must be completely fair when you make legal decisions, even if someone important is involved. Don't take bribes to give unfair decisions. Bribes keep people who are wise from seeing the truth and turn honest people into liars.
translation_verse: K maŋ daga b baa ji durmu ŋko a kpɛa to ashi bumo be demujiana to. B sa maŋ kaa sɔ brɔbu basa kutɔ pɔɛŋ nsaa ji bumo demu, ŋkpal manɛ so ŋkɛ be kesɔ beeŋ tiŋ n shin nɛ enyiashempo e sa maŋ ji kashenteŋ nseŋ shin nɛ beshenteŋjipo e ki befɛpo, saŋɛ na so nɛ b baa ji asheŋ ekpa nɛ k maŋ daga so.

english_verse: If an ox or a sheep has something wrong with it, don't offer it as a sacrifice to the Lord your God—he will be disgusted! Put To Death People Who Worship Idols Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Men sa maŋ kaŋ ta kena ŋko kubolpɔ nɛ k kɔ doro kikɛ n lara sarga n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na, ŋkpal manɛ so, e kishi loŋ ga.

english_verse: So when you hear that someone in your town is committing this disgusting sin, you must carefully find out if that person really is guilty.
translation_verse: kumo ere men keni to n fin kumo be kashenteŋ. Nɛ k kaa la kashenteŋ fanɛ kulubi ere wora Israɛl be efuli so nna,

english_verse: But you will need two or three witnesses—one witness isn't enough to prove a person guilty. Get rid of those who are guilty of such evil. Take them outside your town gates and everyone must stone them to death. But the witnesses must be the first to throw stones. Difficult Cases Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Eshɛdajipoana na e naaŋ juŋkpar ŋ kpa bumo ajembu nɛ basa nɛ b ka na malɛ e chɛ to ŋ kpa bumo ajembu m mɔ. Kananɛ menyeeŋ wora n lara kulubi na ashi menyi to nna na.

english_verse: When other Israelites hear about it, they will be afraid and obey the decisions of the court. The King Moses said:
translation_verse: Aloŋ e naaŋ shin nɛ kufu e pɛ ekama nɛ e beeŋ nu kumo be asheŋ nɛ esa kikɛ maaŋ naŋ wora loŋ kikɛ. Ewura be asheŋ

english_verse: People of Israel, after you capture the land the Lord your God is giving you, and after you settle on it, you will say, “We want a king, just like the nations around us.”
translation_verse: Israɛlebi, men kaŋ ya kɔ n sɔ kasawule nɛ Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na bee sa menyi na n chena so, menyeeŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ menyee sha ewura fanɛ efuliana pɔtɛana nɛ a kulti menyi na.

english_verse: Go ahead and appoint a king, but make sure that he is an Israelite and that he is the one the Lord has chosen.
translation_verse: Nɛ k kaŋ ba loŋ, men lara esa nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na gbagba lara nɛ e ki menyi be ewura na. Mo alɛ daga fanɛ e baa la menyi to be esa gbagba, mannɛ efɔ.

english_verse: And the king must not have a lot of wives—they might tempt him to be unfaithful to the Lord. Finally, the king must not try to get huge amounts of silver and gold.
translation_verse: Ewura na maŋ daga fanɛ e baa kɔ beche damta, ŋkpal manɛ so, loŋ beeŋ shin nɛ e lar Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaman. Mo alɛ maŋ daga fanɛ e gbare shuwa nɛ gbiti n sa mbe kumu nseŋ dii kedama ga.

english_verse: The official copy of God's laws will be kept by the priests of the Levi tribe. So, as soon as anyone becomes king, he must go to the priests and write out a copy of these laws while they watch.
translation_verse: Esa nɛ e beeŋ ki ewura na beeŋ shin nɛ b keni Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be mbraana be kawɔl nɛ k wɔ bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ b shi Livai be yiri to na kutɔ na so n sibɛ kuko n sa mo nɛ e ta n yili mbe enɔ so.

english_verse: Each day the king must read and obey these laws, so that he will learn to worship the Lord with fear and trembling
translation_verse: Kawɔl ere beeŋ baa wɔ mo kutɔ nɛ e baa kraŋ kumo nsaa wora mbraana na kasonu karechɛ kikɛ, saŋɛ na so, e beeŋ koya kabɔrɛŋana nsaa sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bunyaŋ.

english_verse: So when I want to speak to them, I will choose one of them to be a prophet like you. I will give my message to that prophet, who will tell the people exactly what I have said.
translation_verse: Amoso meeŋ shuŋi anebi ko nɛ e du fanɛ fo nseŋ shi bumo gbagba be basa to nɛ e ba bumo kutɔ. Ma alɛ beeŋ baa ta ma kubɔya a sa mo nɛ mo alɛ e baa kaŋɛ bumo kusɔ kama nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ mo na gbagba chap.

english_verse: Some Levites may have money from selling family possessions, and others may not. But all Levites serving at the place of worship will receive the same amount of food from the sacrifices and gifts brought by the people. Don't Do Disgusting Things Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Livai be yiri to be esa beeŋ tiŋ n fa mbe kanaŋ to be asɔ n nya amansherbi, beko malɛ maaŋ wora loŋ. Ama Livaiebi kama nɛ baa shuŋ kakpa nɛ menyee shuŋ Ebɔrɛ na kikɛ beeŋ nya ajibi nɛ basa na bar m ba lara esarga ŋko m ba kɛ Ebɔrɛ na, a sasa. Ekishisheŋ be asheŋ

english_verse: The people of the Levi tribe, including the priests, will not receive any land. Instead, they will receive part of the sacrifices that are offered to the Lord,
translation_verse: Livai be yiri to be basa nɛ baaŋ baa la bɔrɛmatapoana na bre maaŋ nya kasawule na be kachige ashi Israɛl be efuli so. Ama esarga nɛ ŋkɛ nɛ basa beeŋ baa lara a sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be ako nɛ baaŋ baa nya.

english_verse: When you sacrifice a bull or sheep, the priests will be given the shoulder, the jaws, and the stomach.
translation_verse: Amoso jemanɛ kikɛ nɛ menyeeŋ mɔ kena ŋko kubolpɔ n lara sarga, kusɔbɔya na be keba nɛ ketaya nɛ apuntosɔ beeŋ baa la bɔrɛmatapoana na peya nna.

english_verse: In addition, they will receive the first part of your grain harvest and part of your first batches of wine and olive oil. You must also give them the first wool that is cut from your sheep each year.
translation_verse: Kede be kaman, menyeeŋ baa sa bumo ayu nɛ menyeeŋ juŋkpar n teŋi, nɛ yabra belbelso nɛ ɔlif be ŋku nɛ menyeeŋ juŋkpar n wora, nɛ mbolpɔ be afuibi nɛ menyeeŋ juŋkpar n she na kikɛ.

english_verse: Give these gifts to the priests, because the Lord has chosen them and their descendants out of all the tribes of Israel to be his special servants at the place of worship.
translation_verse: Menyeeŋ baa sa bumo ade kikɛ nna, ŋkpal manɛ so, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e lara bumo nɛ bumo be kaman to ebi ashi Israɛl be eyiriana na to nɛ b baa shuŋ mo fanɛ bɔrɛmatapoana mbaanaayɔ.

english_verse: Any Levite can leave his hometown, and go to the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped,
translation_verse: Livai be yiri to be esa kama nɛ e bee sha, beeŋ tiŋ n shi kade nɛ e wɔ ashi Israɛl be efuli so be kaplɛkama m ba kakpa nɛ menyee shuŋ Ebɔrɛ na

english_verse: and then be a special servant of the Lord there, just like all the other Levites.
translation_verse: m ba shuŋ fanɛ bɔrɛmatapo n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na fanɛ kananɛ Livai be yiri to be basa bee shuŋ ndoŋ na.

english_verse: Soon you will go into the land that the Lord your God is giving you. The nations that live there do things that are disgusting to the Lord, and you must not follow their example.
translation_verse: “Nɛ menyi kaŋ yɔ kasawule nɛ Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na ta a sa menyi na so, men sa maŋ kaa wora ekishisheŋ nɛ efuliana nɛ a wɔ ndoŋ na bee wora na.

english_verse: Don't sacrifice your son or daughter. And don't try to use any kind of magic or witchcraft to tell fortunes or to cast spells or to talk with spirits of the dead.
translation_verse: Men sa maŋ kaa chɔɔ menyi be mbia ebɔrɛsure so a lara esarga. Menyi alɛ e sa maŋ shin nɛ menyi be basa e baa kpal ŋko a kɔ mputi ŋko a to akprambi ŋko a kre mbre. Kumo be kaman men sa maŋ kaa malga bubuni kutɔ a bishi so a fin kenu kusɔ ko bumo kutɔ.

english_verse: The Lord is disgusted with anyone who does these things, and that's why he will help you destroy the nations that are in the land.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na kishi basa nɛ baa wora le be asheŋ ere nna, amoso nɛ e beeŋ chɛ menyi to n ju efuliana na n lar kasawule na so na.

english_verse: Never be guilty of doing any of these disgusting things! A Prophet like Moses Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Menyi ere daga fanɛ men baa ji kashenteŋ a sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ekpa kikɛ so nna nsaa maa wora ekishisheŋ ere.” Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ka nase kɔnɔ fanɛ e beeŋ shuŋi anebi be asheŋ

english_verse: You will go in and take the land from nations that practice magic and witchcraft. But the Lord your God won't allow you to do those things.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Mosis naŋ kaŋɛ le: “Kasawule nɛ menyee yɔ nɛ men ya sɔ n chena so ere so, basa bee nu nna a sa basa nɛ baa kpal nsaa bishi so. Ama Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na maŋ sa menyi ere akpa fanɛ men baa wora loŋ kikɛ.

english_verse: Instead, he will choose one of your own people to be a prophet just like me, and you must do what that prophet says.
translation_verse: Kusɔ nɛ e beeŋ wora e la fanɛ e beeŋ shuŋi anebi ko nɛ e du fanɛ ma nseŋ shi menyi gbagba be basa to nɛ e ba menyi kutɔ. A daga fanɛ men wora loŋ be anebi na kasonu.

english_verse: You were asking for a prophet the day you were gathered at Mount Sinai and said to the Lord, “Please don't let us hear your voice or see this terrible fire again—if we do, we will die!”
translation_verse: Kachɛ nɛ men daŋ shɛr ashi kebeegboŋ nɛ baa tre Sainai na ase na, men daŋ kule ma nna fanɛ menyi maŋ naa sha kenu Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be ebɔl ŋko n wu mbe edɛ gboŋ na kikɛ, ŋkpal manɛ so, menyi daa lɔ kufu nna fanɛ menyeeŋ wu.”

english_verse: Then the Lord told me: Moses, they have said the right thing.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ ma le: “Kashenteŋ nɛ b ji na.

english_verse: Since the message comes from me, anyone who doesn't obey the message will have to answer to me.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal kubɔya na ka beeŋ shi ma kutɔ so, esa kama nɛ e kaŋ kini kewora kumo kasonu, ŋ gbagba e naaŋ bishi amodoŋwura ŋko ŋ gberge mo kusoe.

english_verse: But if I haven't spoken, and a prophet claims to have a message from me, you must kill that prophet, and you must also kill any prophet who claims to have a message from another god. Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Ama nɛ fanɛ anebi ko sa kubɔya ko ashi ma ketre to nɛ k maŋ shi ŋ kutɔ, loŋ be anebi na beeŋ wu ŋkpal loŋ so. Kusɔ nɛ k beeŋ nya anebi kama nɛ e beeŋ sa kubɔya ashi agbir ko be atre to gba nna na.”

english_verse: You may be asking yourselves, “How can we tell if a prophet's message really comes from the Lord?”
translation_verse: Menyi beeŋ baa belsi nsaa bishi menyi be amu fanɛ nuso nɛ anyeeŋ wora m pin fanɛ anebi ere be kubɔya ere shi Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kutɔ nna.

english_verse: You will know, because if the Lord says something will happen, it will happen. And if it doesn't, you will know that the prophet was falsely claiming to speak for the Lord. Don't be afraid of any prophet whose message doesn't come from the Lord.
translation_verse: Nɛ fanɛ anebi baŋ sa kubɔya ko ashi Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be ketre to nɛ k maŋ ba kashenteŋ nseŋ wora m bɔlɔ so, kumo ere kubɔya na maŋ shi Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kutɔ nna na. Anebi na gbagba be nfɛra to nɛ kubɔya na shi nɛ a maŋ daga fanɛ men baa ŋana loŋ be anebi na.

english_verse: Israel, the Lord your God has promised that if you obey his laws and teachings I'm giving you, and if you always love him, then he will give you the land he promised your ancestors. When that happens, you must name three more Safe Towns in the new territory.
translation_verse: Nɛ menyeeŋ wora kusɔ kama nɛ mee kaŋɛ menyi kabre ere, nsaa sha Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na, nsaa wora asheŋ a bɛ mbe keŋini so, e beeŋ shin nɛ menyi be kasawule nɛ e nase kumo be kɔnɔ n sa menyi nananyɛnana na e kpalga to n ti so. Nɛ loŋ kaŋ wora, menyeeŋ naŋ lara nde asa n ti adra na so.

english_verse: Soon you will go into the land and attack the nations. The Lord your God will destroy them and give you their lands, towns, and homes. Then after you are settled,
translation_verse: Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋ mur basa nɛ e bee ta bumo be kasawule a sa menyi ere nɛ men sɔ bumo be ndegboŋana nɛ nwuana n chena,

english_verse: For example, suppose you and a friend go into the forest to cut wood. You are chopping down a tree with an ax, when the ax head slips off the handle, hits your friend, and kills him. You can run to one of the Safe Towns and save your life.
translation_verse: An ta fanɛ menyi to be benyɔ yɔ kupuŋ to nɛ b ya ku ndibi, nɛ jemanɛ nɛ baa ku ndibi na kekpanfu nɛ b kɔ a ku na be kumu pee ŋ ŋmɛa eko m mɔ, emo nɛ e keta kumo a ku na beeŋ tiŋ n shile n yɔ nde asa na be kuko to n ya ŋana nɛ b sa maŋ mɔ mo alɛ gba.

english_verse: You don't deserve to die, since you did not mean to harm your friend. But he did get killed, and his relatives might be very angry. They might even choose one of the men from their family to track you down and kill you. If it is too far to one of the Safe Towns, the victim's relative might be able to catch you and kill you.
translation_verse: E maŋ daga luwu, ŋkpal manɛ so e maŋ kre kemɔ mo barkasa na nna. Ama esa nɛ e wu na mo kurgepo beeŋ tiŋ n nya agbo ŋkpal e ka wu so. Bumo alɛ beeŋ tiŋ n lara bumo kanaŋ to be esa ko fanɛ e tɛ emo nɛ e mɔ bumo kurgepo na m mɔ mo. Nɛ fanɛ kade nɛ e beeŋ shile n ya ŋana nseŋ nya mo kumu na wɔ kufɔ nɛ kakpa nɛ e wɔ na, esa nɛ e wu na mo kurgepoana na beeŋ tiŋ n ju mo m pɛ nseŋ mɔ mo.

english_verse: You will need them, so innocent people won't be killed on your land while they are trying to reach a Safe Town that is too far away. You will be guilty of murder, if innocent people lose their lives because you didn't name enough Safe Towns in the land the Lord your God will give you.
translation_verse: Men wora loŋ, saŋɛ na so b maaŋ mɔ basa nɛ b maŋ wora n jija ashi kasawule nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ta a sa menyi na so nɛ kumo be kulubi a baa bɛ menyi.

english_verse: But what if you really do commit murder? Suppose one of you hates a neighbor. So you wait in a deserted place, kill the neighbor, and run to a Safe Town.
translation_verse: Ama nɛ fo kute m mɔ fo barkasa ŋkpal fo ka kishi mo so nseŋ shile n yɔ nde na be kekama to n ya ŋana.

english_verse: If that happens, the leaders of your town must send messengers to bring you back from the Safe Town. They will hand you over to one of the victim's relatives, who will put you to death.
translation_verse: Loŋ bre fo kade to be benimu beeŋ shuŋi nɛ b ya bar fo nɛ b ta fo m bɔ esa nɛ fo mɔ na mo kurgepoana enɔ nɛ bumo alɛ gba e mɔ fo n tal to.

english_verse: Israel, for the good of the whole country, you must kill anyone who murders an innocent person. Never show mercy to a murderer! Property Lines Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: B maaŋ wu fo kuwɔr. A daga fanɛ b lara basa mɔpo kikɛ ashi Israɛl be efuli so, saŋɛ na so asheŋ beeŋ baa nite nɛnɛ.

english_verse: In the land the Lord is giving you, there are already stones set up to mark the property lines between fields. So don't move those stones. Witnesses Must Tell the Truth Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Ekama be kapetɛsawule kɔ egbaŋ to be ndulgijembu nna a ŋini kumo be ekar ashi kasawule nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee sa menyi na so. Amoso men sa maŋ kaa firgi men braana be ndulgijembu.

english_verse: Before you are convicted of a crime, at least two witnesses must be able to testify that you did it.
translation_verse: Esa koŋwule be shɛda maaŋ tiŋ n shin nɛ esa e ji n tɔr ashi kulubi to. Kanaŋkama, basa anyɔ ŋko besa e daga fanɛ b ji shɛda pɔɛŋ nɛ esa e ji n tɔr ashi kulubi to.

english_verse: If you accuse someone of a crime, but seem to be lying,
translation_verse: Nɛ fanɛ menyi to be eko bee sha ketɔrɔ mo barkasa nseŋ ku efɛ n deŋi mo,

english_verse: then you will be punished without mercy. You will receive the same punishment the accused would have received if found guilty, whether it means losing an eye, a tooth, a hand, a foot, or even your life. Israel, the crime of telling lies in court must be punished. And when people hear what happens to witnesses that lie, everyone else who testifies in court will tell the truth.
translation_verse: Kasogberge nɛ k dese e la fanɛ nɛ esa baaŋ lara mo barkasa be efute ŋko kenishi ŋko kinyi ŋko ŋ ku mo barkasa be enɔ so ŋko keya so, b wora mo kananɛ e wora mo barkasa na gbagba chap. A maŋ daga fanɛ men baa wu kuwɔr ashi le be asheŋ to.

english_verse: If you have to go to war, you may find yourselves facing an enemy army that is bigger than yours and that has horses and chariots. But don't be afraid! The Lord your God rescued you from Egypt, and he will help you fight.
translation_verse: Nɛ men kaŋ yɔ nɛ men ya kɔ men doŋana kena nseŋ wu fanɛ bumo be egbaŋɛ nɛ egbaŋɛturko nɛ benapo shi a chɔ menyeya, men sa maa ŋana bumo. Ŋkpal manɛ so, Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ nɛ e kɔ n suge menyi ashi Ijipt be efuli so na beeŋ chɛ menyi to ŋ kɔ.

english_verse: Before you march into battle, a priest will go to the front of the army
translation_verse: Pɔɛŋ nɛ men fara kekɔ kena na, a daga fanɛ bɔrɛmatapo e ba yili benapo na be anishito nseŋ kaŋɛ bumo le:

english_verse: and say, “Soldiers of Israel, listen to me! Today when you go into battle, don't be afraid of the enemy, and when you see them, don't panic.
translation_verse: Israɛl be benapo, men nu nfe! Menyee yɔ kena to kabre nna na, ama men sa maŋ kpal men doŋana so a lɔ kufu ŋko a jija kenyɛn ŋko a chicha.

english_verse: The Lord your God will fight alongside you and help you win the battle.”
translation_verse: Menyi nɛ Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na e naa yɔ kena na to; mo alɛ beeŋ shin nɛ men kɔ m pɔɔ so.

english_verse: Then the tribal officials will say to the troops: If any of you have built a new house, but haven't yet moved in, you may go home. It isn't right for you to die in battle and for somebody else to live in your new house.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ benapo na be bejuŋkparpoana malɛ e malga n sa benapo na ŋ kaŋɛ bumo le: “Esa ko wɔ nfe nɛ e pɔr kowu popɔr, ama mo alɛ maŋ naŋ ta kumo m bɔɔ Ebɔrɛ enɔ nseŋ bela n luri kumo to a? Kumo ere e bɛta a yɔ epe. Nɛ mannɛ aloŋ e kaŋ ya wu kena to, esa pɔtɛ e naaŋ ta mbe kowu na m bɔɔ Ebɔrɛ enɔ nseŋ bela n luri kumo to.

english_verse: If any of you have planted a vineyard but haven't had your first grape harvest, you may go home. It isn't right for you to die in battle and for somebody else to enjoy your grapes.
translation_verse: Ŋko esa ko wɔ nfe nɛ kraŋ baŋ dɔ ndibi sɔrso be kudɔ, mo alɛ maŋ naŋ chuge amo be asɔrso a? Kumo ere e bɛta a yɔ epe. Nɛ mannɛ aloŋ e kaŋ n ya wu kena to, esa pɔtɛ e naaŋ ji asɔrso na be tɔnɔ.

english_verse: If any of you are engaged to be married, you may go back home and get married. It isn't right for you to die in battle and for somebody else to marry the woman you are engaged to.
translation_verse: Ŋko esa ko wɔ nfe nɛ e tiŋ n ji eche be kesha nsaa sha keta eche na a? Kumo ere e bɛta a yɔ epe. Nɛ mannɛ aloŋ e kaŋ ya wu kena to, esa pɔtɛ e naaŋ ta eche nɛ e kre keta na.”

english_verse: When the officials are finished giving these orders, they will appoint officers to be in command of the army.
translation_verse: Benimuana na kaŋ malga n sa benapo na n loge, baaŋ lara basa nɛ baaŋ baa juŋkpar benapo na ntuŋso.

english_verse: Whenever you capture towns in the land the Lord your God is giving you, be sure to kill all the people and animals.
translation_verse: Ama menyi kaŋ kɔ n sɔ ndegboŋ nɛ a wɔ kasawule nɛ Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na ta a sa menyi ere so bre, men mɔ basa na nɛ bumo be asɔbɔya kikɛ.

english_verse: He has commanded you to completely wipe out the Hittites, the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na teŋ yili kumo fanɛ men mur Hitebi nɛ Amɔriebi nɛ Keenanebi nɛ Pɛrizebi nɛ Hivebi nɛ Jebusiebi na kikɛ nna.

english_verse: If you allow them to live, they will persuade you to worship their disgusting gods, and you will be unfaithful to the Lord.
translation_verse: Nɛ menyi baŋ maŋ mɔ bumo nseŋ yige bumo, baaŋ fule menyi nɛ men baa wora ekishisheŋ nɛ baa wora ashi bumo be kagbirshuŋ to na n shin nɛ men wora kulubi ŋ gbiti Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na.

english_verse: When you are attacking a town, don't chop down its fruit trees, not even if you have had the town surrounded for a long time. Fruit trees aren't your enemies, and they produce food that you can eat, so don't cut them down.
