translation_verse: Nɛ menyi kaŋ ya kulti kade n wɔtɔ a sha kekɔ kumo to be basa kena, men sa maŋ ku bumo be ndibi sɔrso n lɛ. Hale nɛ men kulti kumo n chɛr gba, men sa maŋ wora loŋ. Ama men baa ji ndibi na be asɔrso na nsaa maŋ mur amo ere. Ŋkpal manɛ so, ndibi na bre maŋ la men doŋana.

english_verse: You may need wood to make ladders and towers to help you get over the walls and capture the town. But use only trees that you know are not fruit trees.
translation_verse: Menyeeŋ tiŋ ŋ ku ndibi pɔtɛ n lɔŋɛ nsakpar nɛ ajaŋ jeŋgreŋ m bɔla so n dii egbalana na so n luri kade na to ŋ kɔ n suge kumo.

english_verse: Suppose the body of a murder victim is found in a field in the land the Lord your God is giving you, and no one knows who the murderer is.
translation_verse: Nɛ fanɛ men wu b ka mɔ esa n nase kupuŋ to ashi kasawule nɛ Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na ta a sa menyi na so, ama menyi alɛ maŋ pin esa nɛ e mɔ mo na,

english_verse: The judges and other leaders from the towns around there must find out what town is the closest to where the body was found.
translation_verse: menyi to be benimuana nɛ demujipoana na beeŋ ya yili kakpa nɛ ebuni na dese na ŋ karga aya n yɔ nde nɛ a mata ndoŋ na be kekama to.

english_verse: The leaders from that town will go to their cattle herds and choose a young cow that has never been put to work.
translation_verse: Nɛ kade kama nɛ k mata ndoŋ ga na be benimu e lara kena fɔlbi nɛ b maŋ naŋ ta n shuŋ ŋ ku so,

english_verse: They and some of the priests will take this cow to a nearby valley where there is a stream, but no crops. Once they reach the valley, the leaders will break the cow's neck. The priests must be there, because the Lord your God has chosen them to be his special servants at the place of worship. The Lord has chosen them to bless the people in his name and to be judges in all legal cases, whether property or injury is involved.
translation_verse: Bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ b shi Livai be yiri to na gba beeŋ yɔ ndoŋ, ŋkpal manɛ so, bumo e naa ji asheŋ nɛ a bee bar kebagato nɛ nlusheŋ. Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na malɛ e lara bumo fanɛ b baa shuŋ mo nsaa bɔla mbe ketre so a nɛfa basa nsaa ji mpetɛ nɛ kebile n doro abar be asheŋ.

english_verse: and say, “We had no part in this murder, and we don't know who did it.
translation_verse: nseŋ kaŋɛ le: “Mannɛ anyi e mɔ esa ere, anyi alɛ maŋ nyi esa nɛ e mɔ mo.

english_verse: But since an innocent person was murdered, we beg you, our Lord, to accept this sacrifice and forgive Israel. We are your people, and you rescued us. Please don't hold this crime against us.” If you obey the Lord and do these things, he will forgive Israel. Marrying a Woman Taken Prisoner in War Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Nɛ men wora Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kasonu nseŋ wora kusɔ nɛ e kaŋɛ ere, e beeŋ ta esa nɛ b mɔ na be kulubi na m paŋ Israɛl be basa. Beche nɛ menyeeŋ pɛ kena to be asheŋ

english_verse: From time to time, you men will serve as soldiers and go off to war. The Lord your God will help you defeat your enemies, and you will take many prisoners.
translation_verse: Nɛ Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na kaŋ shin nɛ men yɔ kena to n ya kɔ m pɔɔ so nseŋ pɛ basa bedamta,

english_verse: One of these prisoners may be a beautiful woman, and you may want to marry her. But first you must bring her into your home, and have her shave her head, cut her nails, get rid of her foreign clothes, and start wearing Israelite clothes. She will mourn a month for her father and mother, then you can marry her.
translation_verse: Ade be kaman, nɛ e chena enyɛn na be laŋ to n shu mo nio nɛ mo tuto be keeli kufɔl lelemu pɔɛŋ nɛ enyɛn na e ta mo ŋ ki mbe eche.

english_verse: Later on, if you are not happy with the woman, you can divorce her, and she can go free. But you have slept with her as your wife, so you cannot sell her as a slave or make her into your own slave. Rights of a First-Born Son Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Nɛ jemanɛ ko ba fo nɛ Israɛl be enyɛn na maŋ naa sha kenyache na, e beeŋ tiŋ n yige mo nɛ e baa yɔ. Ŋkpal enyɛn na ka teŋ di eche na so, e maaŋ naŋ tiŋ n fa mo fanɛ mbe kenya. Ewurkoŋ nɛ kapetɛji be asheŋ

english_verse: Suppose a man has two wives and loves one more than the other. The first son of either wife is the man's first-born son, even if the boy's mother is the wife the man doesn't love. Later, when the man is near death and is dividing up his property, he must give a double share to his first-born son, simply because he was the first to be born. A Son Who Rebels Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: A daga fanɛ e ta mbe kapetɛ na be ntuŋ anyɔso nna n sa mbe wurkoŋnyɛn na, hale e ka maŋ la mbe eche shaso pibinyɛn ere gba. Enyɛn daga e baa keni mbe wurkoŋnyɛn nna a bɔlɔ kenishi nsaa sa mo mbe kapetɛ be kachige nɛ k la wurkoŋnyɛn peya mbra be ekpa so. Ebinyɛn nɛ e maŋ kɔ kasonu be asheŋ

english_verse: A father and a mother may have a stubborn and rebellious son who refuses to obey them even after he has been punished.
translation_verse: An ta fanɛ esa ko ka kɔ mo pibinyɛn kpeŋso nɛ e maa nu a sa mo nio nɛ mo tuto nɛ baa gberge mo kusoe nɛ e kraa maa chɛrga.

english_verse: If a son is like that, his parents must drag him to the town gate, where the leaders of the town hold their meetings.
translation_verse: Loŋ be kebia mo tuto nɛ mo nio daga fanɛ b yɛr mo kade nɛ b wɔ na be benimuana kutɔ nna nɛ b ya ji kebia na demu.

english_verse: The parents will tell the leaders, “This son of ours is stubborn and never obeys. He spends all his time drinking and partying.”
translation_verse: Kusɔ nɛ baaŋ ya kaŋɛ nde: “An pibinyɛn ere kpeŋ nna nsaa maa nu a sa anyi. E la esa nɛ e bee boo nsa nsaa jija amansherbi nna.”

english_verse: The men of the town will stone that son to death, because they must get rid of the evil he brought into the community. Everyone in Israel will be afraid when they hear how he was punished. The Body of a Criminal Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Saŋɛ na so nɛ kade na be benyɛn e kpa kebia na ajembu m mɔ, nɛ kumo be loŋ e lara le be kulubi ere ashi menyi to nɛ kufu e pɛ Israɛl be esa kama nɛ e nu kumo be asheŋ. Mbra be yiri yiri be asheŋ

english_verse: If a criminal is put to death, and you hang the dead body on a tree,
translation_verse: Nɛ fanɛ esa wora kulubi nɛ b kpal loŋ so n chɛ mo n shiga kedibi so m mɔ,

english_verse: you must not leave it there overnight. Bury it the same day, because the dead body of a criminal hanging on a tree will bring God's curse on the land. The Lord your God is giving this land to you, so don't make it unclean by leaving the bodies of executed criminals on display.
translation_verse: a maŋ daga kebuni na ka shiga kedibi na so hale nɛ kare a chɛ kumo so. A daga fanɛ b puli kumo kamɔnchɛ na kikɛ, ŋkpal manɛ so, kebuni be kebaasha kedibi so bee gberge Ebɔrɛ be kɔnɔsho a ba kasawule na so nna. Amoso men baa puli basa nɛ baa chɛ a shiga ndibi so a mɔ na, saŋɛ na so menyi maaŋ jija kasawule nɛ Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na ta a sa menyi na.

english_verse: If the owner lives too far away, or if you don't know who the owner is, take the animal home with you and take care of it. The owner will come looking for the animal, and then you can give it back.
translation_verse: Ama nɛ fanɛ esa nɛ e wɔ kumo na wɔ kakpa wɔfɔ nna ŋko fo maŋ nyi esa nɛ e wɔ kusɔbɔya na nna, kumo ere fo ta kumo n yɔ fo pe. Nɛ kusɔbɔyawura kaŋ baa kaa fin kumo nɛ fo ta n sa mo.

english_verse: That's what you should do if you find anything that belongs to someone else. Do whatever you can to help, whether you find a cow or sheep or donkey or some clothing.
translation_verse: Nɛ fanɛ fo wu fo barkasa Israɛl be esa be kurma ŋko kusɔbuuso ŋko kusɔ be yiri kikɛ nɛ k foe, kusɔ nɛ k daga fo wora nna na.

english_verse: Oxen and donkeys that carry heavy loads can stumble and fall, and be unable to get up by themselves. So as you walk along the road, help anyone who is trying to get an ox or donkey back on its feet. Don't Pretend To Be the Opposite Sex Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Nɛ fanɛ fo barkasa Israɛl be esa be kena ŋko kurma tɔr a dese nsaa maa sha kekoso n yili nɛ fo tu mo, sa maŋ kaŋ kplaŋ mo so, chɛ mo to nɛ e ŋin kusɔbɔya na to n yili kumo be aya so.

english_verse: Women must not pretend to be men, and men must not pretend to be women. The Lord your God is disgusted with people who do that. Don't Take a Mother Bird Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Beche maŋ daga kewɔtɔ benyɛn be asɔbuuso. Benyɛn malɛ gba maŋ daga kewɔtɔ beche be asɔbuuso, ŋkpal manɛ so, Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na kishi basa nɛ baa wora loŋ be asheŋ na nna.

english_verse: If you build a house, make sure to put a low wall around the edge of the flat roof. Then if someone falls off the roof and is killed, it won't be your fault. Laws against Mixing Different Things Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Nɛ fanɛ fo pɔr kowu popɔr, a daga fanɛ fo pɔr egbalshin kumo be kuchoŋi na so ŋ kulti, saŋɛ na so esa maaŋ shi kumo so n tɔr to n wu nɛ kumo be kulubi e bɛ fo.

english_verse: If you plant a vineyard, don't plant any other fruit tree or crop in it. If you do plant something else there, you must bring to the place of worship everything you harvest from the vineyard.
translation_verse: Nɛ fo baŋ dɔ asɔrso nɛ baa tre greep na be ndibi be kudɔ, sa maŋ naŋ duu shɛŋ n wea amo to. Nɛ fo wora loŋ, fo maŋ naa kɔ ekpa nɛ fo ji kudɔ na to be kusɔ kikɛ. A daga fanɛ fo bar adɔjibi na kikɛ kakpa nɛ menyeeŋ baa shuŋ Ebɔrɛ na.

english_verse: Don't hitch an ox and a donkey to your plow at the same time.
translation_verse: Men sa maŋ kaŋ ta kubɔ to be kebarga n deŋi gbolu nɛ kurma so nɛ amo anyɔ na kikɛ e baa gberge katekpa koŋwule a dɔ.

english_verse: When you weave cloth for clothing, you can use thread made of flax or wool, but not both together.
translation_verse: Men sa maa buu asɔbuuso nɛ b ta asisawa be kechɛbi m ba kikɛ.

english_verse: And when you make a coat, sew a tassel on each of the four corners. When a Husband Accuses His Wife Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Men baa ba ajolobi a chuge menyi be asɔbuuso be nnɔkar ana na kikɛ so. Kakil to be kewora n da so be asheŋ

english_verse: Suppose a man starts hating his wife soon after they are married.
translation_verse: An ta fanɛ enyɛn ka ta kasuŋgurbia nɛ k maŋ chɛr nɛ e kaŋɛ fanɛ e maŋ naa sha eche na,

english_verse: He might tell ugly lies about her, and say, “I married this woman, but when we slept together, I found out she wasn't a virgin.”
translation_verse: ŋkpal loŋ so ŋ ku efɛ n deŋi eche fanɛ e ka ta mo na e maŋ tu mo nɛ tumba.

english_verse: If this happens, the bride's father and mother must go to the town gate to show the town leaders the proof that the woman was a virgin.
translation_verse: Eche na mo kurgepoana beeŋ ta wajɛ nɛ enyɛn na nɛ eche na daŋ dese so bumo be kejafɔ achɛ nɛ ŋklaŋ gbiti kumo a ŋini fanɛ eche na maŋ nyi enyɛn nna pɔɛŋ nseŋ yɔ kakil to na n ya ŋini benimu nɛ baa ji demu na ashi demujikpa.

english_verse: Her father will say, “I let my daughter marry this man, but he started hating her
translation_verse: Nɛ eche na mo tuto e kaŋɛ benimu na le: “N ta m pibiche nna n sa kanyɛn ere, ama naniere e maŋ naa sha m pibiche,

english_verse: and accusing her of not being a virgin. But he is wrong, because here is proof that she was a virgin!” Then the bride's parents will show them the bed sheet from the woman's wedding night.
translation_verse: nseŋ ku efɛ n deŋi mo a kaŋɛ fanɛ e maŋ kɔ tumba. Ama kusɔ nɛ k bee ŋini fanɛ eche na daa kɔ tumba nde. Men keni ŋklaŋ nɛ a daŋ gbiti wajɛchɛbi nɛ b daŋ dese so bumo be kejafɔ achɛ na!”

english_verse: The town leaders will beat the man with a whip
translation_verse: Nɛ kade be benimuana na e shin nɛ b pɛ enyɛn na ŋ kuya so.

english_verse: But if the man was right and there is no proof that his bride was a virgin,
translation_verse: Ama nɛ fanɛ kusɔ nɛ enyɛn na kaŋɛ na la kashenteŋ nna nɛ shɛŋ malɛ maŋ wɔtɔ a ŋini fanɛ eche na daa kɔ tumba,

english_verse: the men of the town will take the woman to the door of her father's house and stone her to death. This woman brought evil into your community by sleeping with someone before she got married, and you must get rid of that evil by killing her. Laws about Illegal Sex Moses said:
translation_verse: kumo ere kade na to be benyɛn beeŋ keta eche na n yɔ mo tuto be laŋ be kabuna to n ya kpa mo ajembu m mɔ. Ŋkpal e ka pin enyɛn, jemanɛ nɛ e kraa wɔ mo tuto pe pɔɛŋ nseŋ ba kakil to so, nyɔmɔ be kesheŋ nɛ e wora ashi anyi be basa to na. Kananɛ menyeeŋ lara le be kulubi ere ashi menyi to nna na.

english_verse: People of Israel, if a man is caught having sex with someone else's wife, you must put them both to death. That way, you will get rid of the evil they have done in Israel.
translation_verse: Nɛ fanɛ b pɛ enyɛn nɛ e bee di mo barkasa be eche, a daga fanɛ b mɔ bumo benyɔ kikɛ. Kananɛ menyeeŋ lara le be kulubi ere ashi menyi to nna na.

english_verse: If a man is caught in town having sex with an engaged woman who isn't screaming for help, they both must be put to death. The man is guilty of having sex with a married woman. And the woman is guilty because she didn't call for help, even though she was inside a town and people were nearby. Take them both to the town gate and stone them to death. You must get rid of the evil they brought into your community.
translation_verse: menyeeŋ keta bumo benyɔ na kikɛ n lar kade na to n ya kpa bumo ajembu m mɔ. Eche na daga luwu ŋkpal e ka maŋ boŋ to n tre basa nɛ b ba chɛ mo to jemanɛ nɛ e wɔ kade to nɛ ekama daŋ beeŋ tiŋ n nu e ka bee boŋ to so. Enyɛn na malɛ daga luwu nna ŋkpal e ka di eche nɛ esa ko bee ji mbe kesha so. Kananɛ menyeeŋ wora n lara le be kulubi ere ashi menyi to nna na.

english_verse: If an engaged woman is raped out in the country, only the man will be put to death.
translation_verse: Ama nɛ fanɛ enyɛn ya pur eche nɛ esa ko bee ji mbe kesha kupuŋ to, kumo ere enyɛn na nawule e daga luwu.

english_verse: Do not punish the woman at all; she has done nothing wrong, and certainly nothing deserving death. This crime is like murder,
translation_verse: Men sa maŋ kaŋ wora eche na bre shɛŋ, ŋkpal manɛ so, e maŋ wora kulubi nɛ k daga luwu. Le be demu ere baa du fanɛ esa ka kre n ya mɔ mo barkasa nna.

english_verse: because the woman was alone out in the country when the man attacked her. She screamed, but there was no one to help her.
translation_verse: Kupuŋ to nɛ enyɛn na ya pur eche na. Hale e boŋ to a fin kechɛto gba, e maaŋ nya esa nɛ e chɛ mo to ndoŋ.

english_verse: Suppose a woman isn't engaged to be married, and a man forces her to have sex with him. If he is caught,
translation_verse: Nɛ fanɛ b pɛ enyɛn nɛ e bee pur eche nɛ b maŋ daa ji mbe kesha nɛ b ta mo,

english_verse: A man must not marry a woman who was married to his father. This would be a disgrace to his father.
translation_verse: Enyɛn kikɛ e sa maŋ kaŋ di mo tuto be beche to be ekama ŋko n ta eche kama nɛ mo tuto kil ŋ ku so kikɛ. Kumo loŋ la ŋaba nna n sa mo tuto na.

english_verse: If a man's private parts have been crushed or cut off, he cannot fully belong to the Lord's people.
translation_verse: Enyɛn kama nɛ b fɛl mo ŋko ŋ ku mbe kenyɛnsɔ so maŋ naŋ ti Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be basa so.

english_verse: No one born outside of a legal marriage, or any of their descendants for ten generations, can fully belong to the Lord's people.
translation_verse: Esa kama nɛ mo tuto nɛ mo nio maŋ kil pɔɛŋ nseŋ kurge mo nɛ mbe kaman to ebi n ya fo mbe kenana kudusopo kikɛ, maŋ naŋ ti Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be basa so.

english_verse: No Ammonites or Moabites, or any of their descendants for ten generations, can become part of Israel, the Lord's people.
translation_verse: Ammɔn ŋko Mowab be basa ŋko bumo be kamanebi n ya fo bumo be kenana kudusopo kikɛ maŋ ti Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be basa so.

english_verse: But the Lord your God loves you, so he refused to listen to Balaam and turned Balaam's curse into a blessing.
translation_verse: Ama Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na daŋ maŋ nu n sa Balaam. Kusɔ nɛ e daŋ wora e la fanɛ e kilgi shoduu na nna ŋ ki nɛfa ŋkpal e ka bee sha menyi so.

english_verse: Don't even think of signing a peace treaty with Moab or Ammon.
translation_verse: Amoso menyi nɛ Mowabebi ŋko Ammɔnebi e sa maŋ kaa wora kayurwushi be kebaawɔtɔ be kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre kikɛ.

english_verse: But Edomites are your relatives, and you lived as foreigners in the country of Egypt. Now you must be kind to Edomites and Egyptians
translation_verse: Ama Edɔmebi bre la men kurgepoana nna nɛ menyi alɛ daa la befɔ Ijipt be efuli so. Amoso men sa maa keni Edɔmebi nɛ Ijiptebi na jiga.

english_verse: and let their great-grandchildren become part of Israel, the Lord's people. Keep the Army Camp Acceptable Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Yili bumo be kenanafofo mbaanaayɔ, bumo be kaman to ebi ti Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be basa, Israɛlebi so. Benapo be keeyi to be farfarbi be asheŋ

english_verse: When you men go off to fight your enemies, make sure your camp is acceptable to the Lord.
translation_verse: Nɛ men yɔ kena to n ya wora menyi be keeyi to, men sa maa wora eyurpisheŋ kikɛ ashi keeyi to.

english_verse: For example, if something happens at night that makes a man unclean and unfit for worship, he must go outside the camp and stay there
translation_verse: Nɛ enyɛn ku edare nseŋ m ba eyur nɛ k shin nɛ e maŋ walɛ so daŋkare be ekpa so, a daga fanɛ e lar keeyi na to n ya kaa wɔ kumo be ekarso.

english_verse: until late afternoon. Then he must take a bath, and at sunset he can go back into camp.
translation_verse: Ta a ba kaaseso nɛ e bɛr nchu, nseŋ bɛta m ba keeyi na to saŋɛ nɛ kaboŋ bee pɛ anishi na.

english_verse: Set up a place outside the camp to be used as a toilet area.
translation_verse: Menyeeŋ fin kaboŋ ko ashi keeyi na be ekarso nɛ k baa la ejɔŋɛkpa.

english_verse: And make sure that you have a small shovel in your equipment. When you go out to the toilet area, use the shovel to dig a hole. Then, after you relieve yourself, bury the waste in the hole.
translation_verse: Nɛ menyee yɔ nɛ men ya jɔŋɛ malɛ, men baa ta ntɔkɔrɔ n ya kur a jɔŋɛ a puli.

english_verse: You must keep your camp clean of filthy and disgusting things. The Lord is always present in your camp, ready to rescue you and give you victory over your enemies. But if he sees something disgusting in your camp, he may turn around and leave. Runaway Slaves from Other Countries Moses said:
translation_verse: Ŋkpal menyi nɛ Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na ka wɔ keeyi na to nɛ e bee kuŋ menyi nsaa shin nɛ menyee kɔ a pɔɔ men doŋana so so, a daga fanɛ men baa keni keeyi na so nɛnɛ nɛ k baa du farfarbi nsaa walɛ so daŋkare be ekpa so. Amoso men sa maŋ kaa wora ekishisheŋ nɛ k beeŋ shin nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e pal kaman n sa menyi kikɛ. Mbra be yiri yiri be asheŋ

english_verse: When runaway slaves from other countries come to Israel and ask for protection, you must not hand them back to their owners.
translation_verse: Nɛ fanɛ efuli ko so be anya shile m ba buu menyi a fin kekuŋ, men sa maŋ bɛta bumo a sa bumo nyɛnpeana.

english_verse: Instead, you must let them choose which one of your towns they want to live in. Don't be cruel to runaway slaves. Temple Prostitutes Moses said:
translation_verse: Men shin nɛ b chena menyi be ndeana na be kekama nɛ baa sha to. Menyi alɛ e sa maa kɔrfɛ bumo.

english_verse: People of Israel, don't any of you ever be temple prostitutes.
translation_verse: Israɛl be kusɔnyɛn ŋko kusɔche kikɛ maŋ daga fanɛ e ki sakale ashi agbirlambu to kikɛ.

english_verse: The Lord your God is disgusted with men and women who are prostitutes of any kind, and he will not accept a gift from them, even if it had been promised to him. Interest on Loans Moses said:
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman, ekama nɛ e wora loŋ n nya amansherbi e sa maŋ ta amo m ba Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kutɔ nɛ e ba tia kɔnɔ naseso kikɛ. Ŋkpal manɛ so, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kishi agbirlambu to be esakale ga.

english_verse: When you lend money, food, or anything else to another Israelite, you are not allowed to charge interest.
translation_verse: Fo kama nɛ fo ta amansherbi ŋko ajibi ŋko kusɔ ko m paŋ fo barkasa Israɛl be esa, fo sa maŋ kaŋ wɔtɔ mo nchu.

english_verse: You can charge a foreigner interest. But if you charge other Israelites interest, the Lord your God will not let you be successful in the land you are about to take. Sacred Promises to the Lord Moses said:
translation_verse: Menyeeŋ tiŋ a wɔtɔ befɔ nɛ b paŋ menyi asɔ nchu, ama mannɛ men braana Israɛl be basa bre. Nɛ men wora mbra ere kasonu, Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ baa nɛfa kusɔ kama nɛ menyeeŋ baa wora ashi kasawule nɛ menyee yɔ nɛ men ya sɔ n chena so na.

english_verse: People of Israel, if you make a sacred promise to give a gift to the Lord, then do it as soon as you can. If the Lord has to come looking for the gift you promised, you will be guilty of breaking that promise.
translation_verse: Nɛ men baŋ nase Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na kɔnɔ, a daga fanɛ men wora kumo m bɔlɔ so manaŋ. Nɛ mannɛ aloŋ Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ bishi menyi kumo nɛ k ki kulubi n sa menyi.

english_verse: On the other hand, if you never make a sacred promise, you can't be guilty of breaking it.
translation_verse: Nɛ esa maŋ nase Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kɔnɔ k maŋ la kulubi n sa mo.

english_verse: You must keep whatever promises you make to the Lord. After all, you are the one who chose to make the promises. Eating Someone Else's Produce
translation_verse: Ama nɛ esa nase kɔnɔ mbe keparso, a daga fanɛ e tia kumo, ŋkpal manɛ so, mannɛ esa ko e tintiŋ mo nɛ e nase kɔnɔ na.

english_verse: If you go into a vineyard that belongs to someone else, you are allowed to eat as many grapes as you want while you are there. But don't take any with you when you leave.
translation_verse: Nɛ menyi be eko bɔla esa ko be ndibi sɔrso be kudɔ to a choŋ, e beeŋ tiŋ n chuge asɔrso na be ako n ji kanaŋkamaso nɛ e bee sha, ama e sa maŋ chuge amo n wɔtɔ kusɔ to n yɔ.

english_verse: In the same way, if you are in a grain field that belongs to someone else, you can pick heads of grain and eat the kernels. But don't cut down the stalks of grain and take them with you.
translation_verse: Nɛ esa bɔla esa pɔtɛ be ayu be kudɔ to a choŋ, e beeŋ tiŋ m buri amo n we kanaŋkamaso nɛ e bee sha, ama e sa maŋ teŋi ayu na n sulɔ n yɔ epe.

english_verse: Suppose a woman was divorced by her first husband because he found something disgraceful about her. He wrote out divorce papers, gave them to her, and sent her away.
translation_verse: Nɛ fanɛ enyɛn ta eche nseŋ wu fanɛ eche na kɔ kebaawɔtɔ ko nɛ e maa sha nɛ e kpal loŋ so n sibɛ kakilgboŋi be kawɔl ŋ kini eche na fanɛ e baa yɔ.

english_verse: Since she has slept with her second husband, she cannot marry her first husband again. Their marriage would pollute the land that the Lord your God is giving you, and he would be disgusted. Newlyweds Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: eche na maaŋ naŋ tiŋ m bɛta n ya kil mo kul dra na kikɛ, ŋkpal e ka tiŋ n tu enyɛn nyɔsopo na n di so. Bumo be kenaŋ kil abar beeŋ jija kasawule nɛ Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na ta a sa menyi na. Ŋkpal manɛ so, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kishi loŋ nna. Mbra be yiri yiri be asheŋ

english_verse: If a man and a woman have been married less than one year, he must not be sent off to war or sent away to do forced labor. He must be allowed to stay home for a year and be happy with his wife. Loans Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Nɛ enyɛn ta eche nɛ k maŋ naŋ fo kafɛ, kumo ere a maŋ daga enyɛn na ka yɔ kena to ŋko n yɔ kushuŋ nɛ k beeŋ barga mo nɛ mbe eche na to. Menyeeŋ sa enyɛn na kafɛ lelemu be ekpa nɛ e chena epe saŋɛ na so e beeŋ deŋi mbe eche na anishito.

english_verse: When you lend money to people, you are allowed to keep something of theirs as a guarantee that they will pay back the loan. But don't take one or both of their millstones, or else they may starve. They need these stones for grinding grain into flour to make bread. Kidnapping Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Nɛ menyi be ekama bee paŋ mo barkasa amansherbi e beeŋ tiŋ n sɔ kusɔ ko n yili tarma, ama e sa maŋ kaŋ sɔ amodoŋwura be kuboo kɔr nyifu ŋko kumo be ebi. K beeŋ shin nɛ akoŋ e mɔ esa na nɛ mbe kanaŋ, ŋkpal manɛ so kumo nɛ baa ta a kɔr ayu a wora ajibi a ji.

english_verse: If you are guilty of kidnapping Israelites and forcing them into slavery, you will be put to death to remove this evil from the community. Skin Diseases Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Menyi to be ekama nɛ e beeŋ pɛ mo barkasa Israɛl be esa ŋ ki mbe kenya ŋko n fa fanɛ kenya, a daga fanɛ men mɔ esa nɛ e fa mo barkasa na. Kananɛ menyeeŋ wora n lara le be kulubi ere efuli na so nna na.

english_verse: And remember what the Lord your God did to Miriam after you left Egypt. Loans Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Men baa nyiŋi kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na daŋ wora Miriam jemanɛ nɛ men daŋ shi Ijipt be efuli so a ba na.

english_verse: When you lend money to people, you are allowed to keep something of theirs as a guarantee that the money will be paid back. But you must not go into their house to get it.
translation_verse: Nɛ menyi to be ekama bee paŋ fo kusɔ ko, fo nɛ e bee paŋ fo na e sa maŋ sɔ esa na be wajɛ buuso n yili tarma.

english_verse: Wait outside, and they will bring out the item you have agreed on.
translation_verse: Fo jo kowushina nɛ esa na gbagba e ta kumo n lar m ba sa fo.

english_verse: Suppose someone is so poor that a coat is the only thing that can be offered as a guarantee on a loan. Don't keep the coat overnight.
translation_verse: Nɛ esa nɛ e bee paŋ na la etirpo nna, kumo ere fo nɛ e bee paŋ fo na e sa maŋ shin nɛ wajɛ buuso na e di fo kutɔ ŋ klade.

english_verse: Instead, give it back before sunset, so the owner can keep warm and sleep and ask the Lord to bless you. Then the Lord your God will notice that you have done the right thing. Poor People's Wages Moses said:
translation_verse: A daga fanɛ fo bɛta kumo n ya sa kumowura kaaseso, saŋɛ na so e beeŋ nya kumo m buu n dese nseŋ kule Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nɛ e nɛfa fo. Aloŋ nɛ Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na be kagbene beeŋ fuli fo so.

english_verse: If you hire poor people to work for you, don't hold back their pay, whether they are Israelites or foreigners who live in your town.
translation_verse: Men sa maa puni betirpo nɛ menyeeŋ ber paa. B la Israɛl be basa ŋko befɔ nɛ menyi nɛ bumo chena abar so menyi be ndeana to gba, a daga fanɛ men baa ka bumo kukɔ nɛ k daga bumo nna.

english_verse: Pay them their wages at the end of each day, because they live in poverty and need the money to survive. If you don't pay them on time, they will complain about you to the Lord, and he will punish you. The Death Penalty Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Ŋkpal b ka la betirpo n daga fanɛ b nya amansherbi pɔɛŋ nseŋ tiŋ n nya bumo be kusɔ jisoso, a daga fanɛ men ka bumo karechɛ kama be kushuŋ be kukɔ pɔɛŋ nɛ epeŋi e tɔr. Nɛ menyi maŋ ka bumo, baaŋ shu ŋ ŋini Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nɛ kumo be kulubi e baa bɛ menyi.

english_verse: Parents must not be put to death for crimes committed by their children, and children must not be put to death for crimes committed by their parents. Don't put anyone to death for someone else's crime. Don't Mistreat the Powerless Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: A maŋ daga fanɛ b mɔ betuto nɛ benio ŋkpal alubi nɛ bumo be mbia wora so. Kumo alɛ maŋ daga fanɛ b mɔ mbia ŋkpal alubi nɛ bumo tutoana nɛ bumo nioana wora so. Ekama daga fanɛ e wu nna ŋkpal mo gbagba be alubi nɛ e wora so.

english_verse: Make sure that orphans and foreigners are treated fairly. And if you lend money to a widow and want to keep something of hers to guarantee that she will pay you back, don't take any of her clothes.
translation_verse: Men sa maa mɔn befɔ nɛ amunibi kusɔ nɛ k daga bumo kikɛ. Menyi alɛ e sa maa sɔ ekulpoche be kusɔbuuso a yili tarma pɔɛŋ nsaa sa mo mpaŋ.

english_verse: You were slaves in Egypt until the Lord your God rescued you. That's why I am giving you these laws. Leave Some of Your Harvest for the Poor Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Men baa nyiŋi fanɛ men daa la anya ashi Ijipt be efuli so nna nɛ Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na sɔ menyi n yige. Amoso nɛ mee sa menyi mbra ere na.

english_verse: If you forget to bring in a stack of harvested grain, don't go back in the field to get it. Leave it for the poor, including foreigners, orphans, and widows, and the Lord will make you successful in everything you do.
translation_verse: Nɛ men teŋi menyi be adɔjibi n sulɔ amo m ba epe nseŋ teŋ ako so ashi ndɔ na to, men sa maŋ naŋ bɛta n ya ta amo. Men yige amo n sa befɔ nɛ amunibi nɛ bekulpoche, saŋɛ na so Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ nɛfa kusɔ kama nɛ menyee wora.

english_verse: When you harvest your olives, don't try to get them all for yourself, but leave some for the poor.
translation_verse: Nɛ menyee chuge menyi be ɔlif be asɔrso men sa maa chuge amo kikɛ ndibi na so, ama men baa yige ako a sa betirpo nɛ bumo alɛ e baa shishi amo a ji.

english_verse: You lived in poverty as slaves in Egypt until the Lord your God rescued you. That's why I am giving you these laws.
translation_verse: Men sa maŋ kaŋ teŋ so fanɛ menyi alɛ gba daa la befɔ nna ashi Ijipt be efuli so nna. Amoso nɛ mee sa menyi mbra ere na.

english_verse: Suppose you and someone else each accuse the other of doing something wrong, and you go to court, where the judges decide you are guilty. If your punishment is to be beaten with a whip, one of the judges will order you to lie down, and you will receive the number of lashes you deserve.
translation_verse: nɛ emo nɛ e ji n tɔr na be kasogberge la fanɛ b kuya mo so nna, demujipo na beeŋ shin nɛ e dese epun so nɛ b kuya mbe kaman so. Achuchɔ nɛ baaŋ kuya mo so na beeŋ ba shi kulubi nɛ e wora na to nna.

english_verse: Forty lashes is the most that you can be given, because more than that might make other Israelites think you are worthless. Don't Muzzle an Ox Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Baaŋ tiŋ n kuya mo so fanɛ achuchɔ adena, ama a maŋ daga fanɛ a baa chɔ loŋ. Nɛ achuchɔ na chɔso loŋ, k beeŋ baa la ŋaba n sa mo ekama be anishito.

english_verse: Don't muzzle an ox while it is threshing grain. A Son for a Dead Brother Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Men sa maa kre kena nɛ men kɔ a bri ayu be kɔnɔ so. Kusɔ nɛ feeŋ wora n sa ekurgepo nɛ e wu be asheŋ

english_verse: But suppose the brother refuses to marry the widow. She must go to a meeting of the town leaders at the town gate and say, “My husband died without having a son to carry on his name. And my husband's brother refuses to marry me so I can have a son.”
translation_verse: Ama nɛ fanɛ mo kul nɛ e wu na mo kurgepo kama maa sha keta mo a kil bre, ekulpoche na beeŋ yɔ kade be benimu kutɔ n ya kaŋɛ bumo le: “Ŋ kul e wu ŋ ka ma nɛ anyi alɛ maŋ kurge ebinyɛn nɛ e beeŋ shin nɛ mbe ketre maaŋ mur. Ŋ kul mo kurgepo malɛ kini keta ma ŋ kurge ebinyɛn.”

english_verse: The leaders will call the living brother to the town gate and try to persuade him to marry the widow. But if he doesn't change his mind and marry her,
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ benimu na malɛ e tre esa nɛ e wu na mo kurgepo na m malga n sa mo. Nɛ e kraŋ kini keta ekulpoche na ŋ kil,

english_verse: she must go over to him while the town leaders watch. She will pull off one of his sandals and spit in his face, while saying, “That's what happens to a man who won't help provide descendants for his dead brother.”
translation_verse: kumo ere ekulpoche na beeŋ yɔ mo kutɔ ashi kade be benimuana na be anishito n ya gbaŋ loŋ be ekurgepo na be kesebeta koŋwule, nseŋ tu echɔl n fɛa mbe anishito ŋ kaŋɛ le: “Kusɔ nɛ baa wora esa nɛ e kini kekurge kaman to ebi n sa mo kurgepo nna na.”

english_verse: From then on, that man's family will be known as “the family of the man whose sandal was pulled off.” When Two Men Fight Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Yili loŋ be jemanɛ na a yɔ esa kama ashi Israɛl beeŋ baa wu mbe kanaŋ fanɛ esa nɛ b gbaŋ mbe kesebeta be kanaŋ. Mbra pɔtɛ be asheŋ

english_verse: If two men are fighting, and the wife of one man tries to rescue her husband by grabbing the other man's private parts,
translation_verse: Nɛ benyɛn anyɔ bee bile nɛ ekoŋwule be eche ba chɛ mo kul to nseŋ to m pɛ enyɔsopo na be anyɛnsɔ to,

english_verse: you must cut off her hand. Don't have any mercy. Be Honest in Business Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: men ku eche na be enɔ so. Men sa maŋ kaŋ wu mo kuwɔr kikɛ.

english_verse: Don't try to cheat people by having two sets of weights or measures, one to get more when you are buying, and the other to give less when you are selling.
translation_verse: Men sa maa puni basa ashi menyi be kasɔkarga to, a ta asɔ nɛ a kɔr abar to a karga asɔ a sa basa nɛ beko e baa nya a chɔ beko, ashi menyi be kasɔfa nɛ kasɔto to.

english_verse: If you weigh and measure things honestly, the Lord your God will let you enjoy a long life in the land he is giving you.
translation_verse: Men baa ta asɔ nɛ a daga a karga asɔ be egbɛ ŋko amo be kananɛ a sa, saŋɛ na so menyi beeŋ chena kasawule nɛ Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na bee sa menyi na so n chɛr.

english_verse: But the Lord is disgusted with anyone who cheats or is dishonest. Wipe Out Amalek Moses said:
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kishi basa nɛ baa puni nsaa maa ji kashenteŋ nna. Kemur Amalɛkebi kikɛ be asheŋ

english_verse: People of Israel, do you remember what the Amalekites did to you after you came out of Egypt?
translation_verse: Ade kikɛ be kaman nɛ Mosis naŋ kaŋɛ le: Men baa nyiŋi kusɔ nɛ Amalɛkebi na wora menyi jemanɛ nɛ men daŋ shi Ijipt be efuli so a ba na.

english_verse: You were tired, and they followed along behind, attacking those who could not keep up with the others. This showed that the Amalekites have no respect for God.
translation_verse: B daa maŋ ŋana Ebɔrɛ nseŋ daŋ kre kena m bɛ menyi so m ba kɔ menyi jemanɛ nɛ men daŋ gben a chul to na nseŋ mɔ menyi to be bumo nɛ b daŋ shir kaman na.

english_verse: The Lord your God will help you capture the land, and he will give you peace. But when that day comes, you must wipe out Amalek so completely that no one will remember they ever lived.
translation_verse: Amoso, nɛ Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na kaŋ sa menyi kasawule na, nɛ men chena kumo so nɛ kayurwushi, a daga fanɛ men mur Amalɛkebi na kikɛ, saŋɛ na so, esa kama maaŋ naŋ nyiŋi bumo be asheŋ gba kuraa. Men sa maŋ kaa teŋ kesheŋ ere so kikɛ!

english_verse: The Lord is giving you the land, and soon you will conquer it, settle down,
translation_verse: Nɛ men kaŋ ya kɔ n sɔ kasawule nɛ Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na ta a sa menyi na n chena so n loge,

english_verse: and plant crops. And when you begin harvesting each of your crops, the very first things you pick must be put in a basket. Take them to the place where the Lord your God chooses to be worshiped,
translation_verse: menyi to be ekama daga fanɛ e ta mbe sososo be adɔjibi nɛ e beeŋ teŋi na n wɔtɔ kelantaŋɛ to n yɔ kakpa nɛ Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na lara n yili fanɛ men baa shuŋ mo na.

english_verse: and tell the priest, “Long ago the Lord our God promised our ancestors that he would give us this land. And today, I thank him for keeping his promise and giving me a share of the land.”
translation_verse: Men yɔ bɔrɛmatapo nɛ e wɔ kushuŋ to loŋ be jemanɛ na kutɔ n ya kaŋɛ mo le: “Kusɔ nɛ ŋ kɔ a chɔrɔ Enyɛnpe ma Ebɔrɛ a ŋini fanɛ n nya ekpa n luri kasawule nɛ e nase kumo be kɔnɔ n sa an nananyɛnana na dra dra na kikɛ na nna na.”

english_verse: The priest will take the basket and set it in front of the Lord's altar.
translation_verse: Saŋɛ na so bɔrɛmatapo na beeŋ sɔ kelantaŋɛ na mo kutɔ n ya yili Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na be bɔrɛsure na ase.

english_verse: Then, standing there in front of the place of worship, you must pray: My ancestor was homeless, an Aramean who went to live in Egypt. There were only a few in his family then, but they became great and powerful, a nation of many people.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ esa nɛ e bar kakɛ na e kaŋɛ le ashi Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be anishito, “N nananyɛn daa la esa nɛ e shi Aremiya be efuli so nna. Mo alɛ daa maa kɔ mo kumu so be kowu nseŋ daŋ ta mbe kanaŋ n yɔ Ijipt be efuli so n ya chena ndoŋ. B ka daŋ yɔ ndoŋ nɛ b daa maŋ shi, ama b daŋ m ba ki efuligboŋ nɛ k kɔ eleŋ ga.

english_verse: The Egyptians were cruel and had no pity on us. They mistreated our people and forced us into slavery.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ Ijiptebi na ba kaa nyaŋ anyi nɛ anyee shuŋ bumo fanɛ anya.

english_verse: We called out for help to you, the Lord God of our ancestors. You heard our cries; you knew we were in trouble and abused.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ an shu n fin Enyɛnpe an nananyɛnana be Ebɔrɛ na be kechɛto nɛ e nu anyi be kushu nseŋ wu awurfoŋ nɛ anyee ji nɛ kananɛ baa tɔrɔ anyi nɛ anyi be ŋgbenejija damta,

english_verse: You brought us here and gave us this land rich with milk and honey.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ e bar anyi nfe m ba ta kasawule nɛ k walɛ nsaa kɔ eleŋ a wora adɔjibi ere n sa anyi.

english_verse: Now, Lord, I bring to you the best of the crops that you have given me. After you say these things, place the basket in front of the Lord's altar and bow down to worship him.
translation_verse: Amoso nɛ ŋ kɔ ma sososo be adɔjibi nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na sa ma na a ba nɛ m ba sa mo.” E kaŋ malga le n loge nɛ e murgi m bunyaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ndoŋ.

english_verse: Then you and your family must celebrate by eating a meal at the place of worship to thank the Lord your God for giving you such a good harvest. And remember to invite the Levites and the foreigners who live in your town. Ten Percent of the Harvest Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Kede be kaman nɛ mo nɛ mbe kanaŋ nɛ Livai be yiri to ebi na, nɛ befɔ nɛ menyi nɛ bumo wɔtɔ na kikɛ e chɛ abar n di Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na epaŋ nseŋ ji bumo be amu ndoŋ.

english_verse: Every year you are to give ten percent of your harvest to the Lord. But every third year, this ten percent must be given to the poor who live in your town, including Levites, foreigners, orphans, and widows. That way, they will have enough to eat.
translation_verse: Nfɛ nsa kikɛ be lalaloge, menyeeŋ ta menyi be adɔjibi be kudu kudusopo n sa Livai be yiri to ebi nɛ befɔ nɛ amunibi nɛ bekulpoche, saŋɛ na so, bumo alɛ gba beeŋ nya asɔ nɛ baa sha kikɛ n ji ashi menyi be echenakpaana. Nɛ men wora loŋ n loge nɛ

english_verse: Then you must pray: Our Lord and our God, you have said that ten percent of my harvest is sacred. I have obeyed your command and given this to the poor, including the Levites, foreigners, orphans, and widows.
translation_verse: men kaŋɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na le: “An Nyɛnpe nɛ anyi be Ebɔrɛ, fo e kaŋɛ fanɛ anyi be adɔjibi be kudu kudusopo kikɛ la asɔ cheembi nna. N wora fo mbra kasonu nseŋ ta amo n sa Livai be yiri to ebi nɛ befɔ nɛ amunibi nɛ bekulpoche fanɛ kananɛ fo kaŋɛ na.

english_verse: I have not eaten any of this sacred food while I was in mourning; in fact, I never touched it when I was unclean. And none of it has been offered as a sacrifice to the spirits of the dead. I have done everything exactly as you commanded.
translation_verse: M maŋ ta amo be kekama n ji jemanɛ nɛ n daa wora keeli, ma alɛ daa maŋ lara amo be kekama kowu jemanɛ nɛ n daa maŋ walɛ so daŋkare be ekpa so gba na. Ade be kaman, m maŋ ta amo be kekama n nyina ebuni kikɛ. Ama kusɔ nɛ fo, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ na gbagba nɛ n ta kudu kudusopo na n wora.

english_verse: Our Lord, look down from your temple in heaven and bless us and our land. You promised our ancestors that you would give us this land rich with milk and honey, and you have kept your promise. The Lord Is Your God, and You Are His People Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Amoso yili fo kakpa cheembi ashi ebɔrɛso n nɛfa fo basa Israɛlebi nɛ kasawule lela nɛ k kɔ eleŋ a wora adɔjibi nɛ fo ta n sa anyi na gba, fanɛ kananɛ fo nase kumo be kɔnɔ n sa an nanaana na.” Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na gbagba be basa be asheŋ

english_verse: Today the Lord your God has commanded you to obey these laws and teachings with all your heart and soul.
translation_verse: “Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na bee kaŋɛ menyi kabre nna fanɛ men wora mbe mbraana ere kikɛ kasonu nseŋ ta menyi be ŋgbene kikɛ m bɛ amo so kashenteŋto.

english_verse: In response, you have agreed that the Lord will be your God, that you will obey all his laws and teachings, and that you will listen when he speaks to you.
translation_verse: Kabre, men shuli so fanɛ Enyɛnpe na e la menyi be Ebɔrɛ. Menyi alɛ bee nase kɔnɔ nna fanɛ menyeeŋ wora mbe mbraana kikɛ kasonu nseŋ bɛ kusɔ kama nɛ e kaŋɛ menyi so.

english_verse: Since you have agreed to obey the Lord, he has agreed that you will be his people and that you will belong to him, just as he promised.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal loŋ so, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na gba sɔ menyi fanɛ mo gbagba be basa nɛ e bee sha ga kabre, fanɛ kananɛ e nase kɔnɔ na. Mo alɛ bee kaŋɛ menyi nna fanɛ men baa wora mbe mbraana kikɛ kasonu.

english_verse: The Lord created all nations, but he will make you more famous than any of them, and you will receive more praise and honor. You will belong only to the Lord your God, just as he promised.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e to efuliana na kikɛ, ama e beeŋ shin nɛ men nya ketre, nɛ b kpaŋ nseŋ maŋkura menyi a chɔ amo kikɛ. Menyi alɛ beeŋ baa la Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na be basa gbagba nna, fanɛ kananɛ e nase kɔnɔ na.”

english_verse: Soon you will enter the land that the Lord your God is giving to you. He is the God your ancestors worshiped, and he has promised that this land is rich with milk and honey. After you cross the Jordan River, go to Mount Ebal. Set up large slabs of stone, then cover them with white plaster and write on them a copy of these laws.

english_verse: At this same place, build an altar for offering sacrifices to the Lord your God. But don't use stones that have been cut with iron tools.

english_verse: Look for stones that can be used without being cut. Then offer sacrifices to please the Lord, burning them completely on the altar.

english_verse: Next, offer sacrifices to ask the Lord's blessing, and serve the meat at a sacred meal where you will celebrate in honor of the Lord.
translation_verse: nɛ kɔnɔkoŋwule nɛ kapandi be esarga, nsaa ji amo kagbenefuliso ashi Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na be anishito a bunyaŋ mo nsaa kule mo enɛfa.

english_verse: Don't forget to write out a copy of these laws on the stone slabs that you are going to set up. Make sure that the writing is easy to read. Curses on Those Who Disobey
translation_verse: Menyi alɛ e sa maŋ teŋ so fanɛ menyeeŋ sibɛ Ebɔrɛ be mbraana ere kikɛ n deŋi ajembu nɛ menyeeŋ yuu nseŋ baga eshishɛr n la amo na so. Saŋɛ na so ekama beeŋ tiŋ a wu amo a kraŋ.”

english_verse: That same day, Moses gave them the following instructions:
translation_verse: Ade kikɛ be kaman nɛ Mosis naŋ kaŋɛ Israɛl be basa na le:

english_verse: After you cross the Jordan River, you will go to Mount Gerizim and Mount Ebal. The tribes of Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Ephraim, Manasseh, and Benjamin will go up on Mount Gerizim, where they will bless the people of Israel. The tribes of Reuben, Gad, Asher, Zebulun, Dan, and Naphtali will go up on Mount Ebal where they will agree to the curses.
translation_verse: nɛ Ruben nɛ Gad nɛ Ashɛr nɛ Zebulun nɛ Dan nɛ Naftali be eyiri to be basa malɛ e yili kebee nɛ baa tre Ebal na so ŋ kaŋɛ bumo eshoduu nɛ a wɔtɔ be asheŋ.

english_verse: The Lord will make your businesses and your farms successful.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ nɛfa menyi be ndeana nɛ adɔsawule.

english_verse: You will have many children. You will harvest large crops, and your herds of cattle and flocks of sheep and goats will produce many young.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ nɛfa menyi nɛ men nya mbia nɛ adɔjibi nɛ ana nɛ mbolpɔ damta.

english_verse: The Lord will make you successful in your daily work.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ nɛfa kusɔ kama nɛ menyeeŋ wora kikɛ.

english_verse: The Lord your God is giving you the land, and he will make sure you are successful in everything you do. Your harvests will be so large that your storehouses will be full.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ nɛfa menyi be ashuŋ nseŋ shin nɛ menyi be mpuro e bɔlɔ ayu ashi kasawule nɛ e ta a sa menyi ere so.

english_verse: If you follow and obey the Lord, he will make you his own special people, just as he promised.
translation_verse: Nɛ menyeeŋ wora Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na kasonu nseŋ wora kusɔ kama nɛ e kaŋɛ menyi, e beeŋ shin nɛ men baa kraa la mo gbagba be basa fanɛ kananɛ e nase kumo be kɔnɔ na.

english_verse: Then everyone on earth will know that you belong to the Lord, and they will be afraid of you.
translation_verse: Saŋɛ na so, durnya be basa kikɛ beeŋ wu fanɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e lara menyi nɛ men baa la mbe basa. Bumo alɛ beeŋ baa ŋana menyi.

english_verse: The Lord will give you a lot of children and make sure that your animals give birth to many young. The Lord promised your ancestors that this land would be yours, and he will make it produce large crops for you.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ sa menyi mbia nɛ asɔbɔya nɛ adɔjibi damta ashi kasawule nɛ e nase kumo be kɔnɔ n sa menyi nananyɛnana na so.

english_verse: The Lord will open the storehouses of the skies where he keeps the rain, and he will send rain on your land at just the right times. He will make you successful in everything you do. You will have plenty of money to lend to other nations, but you won't need to borrow any yourself.
translation_verse: Mo koŋwule na beeŋ bugi ebɔrɛso be mbuna n shin nɛ bɔrɛ e ba menyi jemanɛ nɛ k daga nseŋ nɛfa menyi be ashuŋ. Saŋɛ na so, efuli damtaana be basa beeŋ baa ba menyi kutɔ m ba ka paŋ menyi amansherbi ama menyi ere maaŋ yɔ efuli kikɛ so n ya paŋ shɛŋ.

english_verse: Obey the laws and teachings that I'm giving you today, and the Lord your God will make Israel a leader among the nations, and not a follower. Israel will be wealthy and powerful, not poor and weak.
translation_verse: Nɛ menyeeŋ baa wora Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na kasonu nsaa bɛ mbe mbraana nɛ n ta a sa menyi kabre ere kikɛ so kashenteŋto, e beeŋ shin nɛ men ki bejuŋkparpo durnya be efuliana kikɛ to.

english_verse: and no one will disturb the birds and wild animals while they eat your dead bodies.
translation_verse: Men kaŋ wu a dese, mbuibi nɛ kupuŋ to be asɔbɔya e naaŋ ji menyi nɛ esa kikɛ maaŋ baa wɔtɔ nɛ e ju bumo.

english_verse: Then everyone will look at you and your descendants and realize that the Lord has placed you under a curse.
translation_verse: Saŋɛ na so, nɛ ekama e wu menyi nɛ men be kaman to ebi nseŋ pin fanɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be kɔnɔsho e pɛ menyi.

english_verse: Israel, today I am giving you the laws and teachings of the Lord your God. And if you don't obey them all, he will put many curses on you.
translation_verse: Kede be kaman nɛ Mosis naŋ kaŋɛ: Ama nɛ men wora kusoe kpakpaso nsaa maŋ bɛ Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na mbraana nɛ n ta a sa menyi kabre ere so kashenteŋto, le be asheŋ lubi ere kikɛ e naaŋ wora menyi.

english_verse: You'll have only a few children, your crops will be small, and your herds of cattle and flocks of sheep and goats won't produce many young.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be kɔnɔsho beeŋ ba menyi nɛ menyi be mbia nɛ adɔjibi nɛ ana nɛ mbolpɔ so nɛ a maaŋ foo.

english_verse: The Lord will make you fail in everything you do.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be kɔnɔsho beeŋ ba kusɔ kama nɛ menyeeŋ wora so.

english_verse: No matter what you try to accomplish, the Lord will confuse you, and you will feel his anger. You won't last long, and you may even meet with disaster, all because you rejected the Lord.
translation_verse: Nɛ fanɛ men kini Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nseŋ wora kulubi, e beeŋ shin nɛ kumu lubi gboŋgboŋi nɛ kebagato nɛ etɔrɔ e ba kusɔ kama nɛ menyeeŋ wora so nɛ men mur cheche.

english_verse: He will send dust and sandstorms instead of rain, and you will be wiped out.
translation_verse: nɛ afugboŋ nɛ shishɛrpumpuŋ e sɔ kaplɛkama n ya fo fanɛ men ka beeŋ mur cheche.

english_verse: The Lord will make you suffer with diseases that will cause oozing sores or crusty itchy patches on your skin or boils like the ones that are common in Egypt. And there will be no cure for you!
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ shin nɛ asɔ puŋiso e tɔr menyi so fanɛ kananɛ e daŋ wora Ijiptebi na. E beeŋ shin nɛ achuubɔbɔ e to n to menyi be eyurana so, nɛ ajijeli a pɛ menyi nɛ men baa wule eyur, ama menyi alɛ maaŋ nya kechɛ kikɛ.

english_verse: that even in bright sunshine you will have to feel your way around like a blind person, who cannot tell day from night. For the rest of your life, people will beat and rob you, and no one will be able to stop them.
translation_verse: E beeŋ shin nɛ men baa nite a laa a laa kapiidi fanɛ etanpo na a maa wu ekpa a nite. Ade kikɛ be kaman, kusɔ kama nɛ menyeeŋ baa wora maaŋ nyalɛ n sa menyi. Basa pɔtɛ beeŋ ba kaa mɛaŋ menyi nsaa yuri menyi be asɔ nɛ esa kikɛ maaŋ baa wɔtɔ nɛ e chɛ menyi to.

english_verse: A man will be engaged to a woman, but before they can get married, she will be raped by enemy soldiers. Some of you will build houses, but never get to live in them. If you plant a vineyard, you won't be around long enough to enjoy the first harvest.
translation_verse: Menyi to be eko beeŋ ji eche be kesha nsaa sha keta mo, ama pɔɛŋ nɛ b wora kejafɔ, esa pɔtɛ e naaŋ pur eche na n jija mo. Beko beeŋ pɔr nwu, ama bumo alɛ maaŋ nya n chena amo to. Beko beeŋ dɔ ndibi sɔrso be adɔ, bumo alɛ maaŋ nya amo be asɔrso juŋkparso gba n ji.

english_verse: Your cattle will be killed while you watch, but you won't get to eat any of the meat. Your donkeys and sheep will be stolen from you, and no one will be around to force your enemies to give them back.
translation_verse: Baaŋ mɔ menyi gbagba be ana m bɛ amo menyi be anishito, ama menyi alɛ maaŋ nya amo be eblaŋ n we. Basa pɔtɛ beeŋ ba kaa kpa menyi be ekurma nɛ mbolpɔ a yɔ nɛ men baa keni, ama esa kikɛ maaŋ baa wɔtɔ nɛ e tintiŋ bumo nɛ b bɛta asɔbɔya na m ba sa menyi.

english_verse: Your sons and daughters will be dragged off to a foreign country, while you stand there helpless. And even if you watch for them until you go blind, you will never see them again.
translation_verse: Basa beeŋ ba pɛ menyi be mbia tintiŋ so n yɔ efuli pɔtɛ so nɛ men baa yil a keni, ama menyi alɛ maaŋ tiŋ n wora shɛŋ. Karechɛ kikɛ menyeeŋ baa mɛrge anishi a keni ekpa fanɛ menyi be mbia na beeŋ bɛta m ba hale nɛ menyi maaŋ naa wu nɛnɛ. Ama mbia na malɛ maaŋ naŋ bɛta m ba kikɛ.

english_verse: You will work hard on your farms, but everything you harvest will be eaten by foreigners, who will mistreat you and abuse you for the rest of your life.
translation_verse: Efuli pɔtɛ so be basa beeŋ ba suge menyi be adɔjibi nɛ men gben n dɔ n nya na. Menyi maaŋ naŋ nya shɛŋ ama kɔrfɛ nɛ kamɛaŋ nawule.

english_verse: The Lord will let you and your king be taken captive to a country that you and your ancestors have never even heard of, and there you will have to worship idols made of wood and stone.
translation_verse: Ade malɛ kikɛ be kaman, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ shin nɛ bedoŋ e pɛ menyi nɛ men be ewura tintiŋ so n yɔ efuli pɔtɛ so, kakpa nɛ menyi ŋko men nananyɛnana maŋ naŋ chena ŋ ku so na, nɛ men ya shuŋ agbirana nɛ b ta ndibi nɛ ajembu n lɔŋɛ.

english_verse: You will plant a lot of seed, but gather a small harvest, because locusts will eat your crops.

english_verse: You will plant vineyards and work hard at taking care of them, but you won't gather any grapes, much less get any wine, because the vines themselves will be eaten by worms.
translation_verse: Menyeeŋ dɔ ndibi sɔrso be adɔ nseŋ keni amo so nɛnɛ, ama menyi alɛ maaŋ nya amo be asɔrso n chuge ŋko n nya amo be yabra belbelso n nuu. Kumo be kaman nɛ ashushombi e ji ndibi na gbagba.

english_verse: Even if your olive trees grow everywhere in your country, the olives will fall off before they are ready, and there won't be enough olive oil for combing your hair.
translation_verse: Ɔlifs be ndibi beeŋ kɔr kaplɛkama ashi efuli na so, ama menyi alɛ maaŋ nya ɔlifs be ŋku ŋ gbiti menyi be amu to. Ŋkpal manɛ so, amo be asɔrso beeŋ chuge n tɔr nɛ a maŋ naŋ daŋ.

english_verse: Locusts will eat your crops and strip your trees of leaves and fruit.
translation_verse: Elotɔr beeŋ ba ji menyi be ndibi be afantaŋ nɛ asɔrso nɛ menyi be adɔjibi kikɛ m mur.

english_verse: You will be so short of money that you will have to borrow from those foreigners. They will be the leaders in the community, and you will be the followers. More Curses for Disobedience Moses said:
translation_verse: Befɔ na beeŋ nya amansherbi a paŋ menyi, ama menyi ere maaŋ nya shɛŋ m paŋ bumo. Kumo be lalaloge, baaŋ ba ji kuwura menyi so.

english_verse: Israel, if you don't obey the laws and teachings that the Lord your God is giving you, he will send these curses to chase, attack, and destroy you.
translation_verse: Nɛ menyi Israɛlebi baŋ maŋ wora Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na kasonu nseŋ bɛ mbe mbraana nɛ e ta a sa menyi ere so, e beeŋ shin nɛ nnɔsho ere a ba menyi so m mur menyi.

english_verse: If the Lord makes you wealthy, but you don't joyfully worship and honor him,

english_verse: he will send enemies to attack you and make you their slaves. Then you will live in poverty with nothing to eat, drink, or wear, and your owners will work you to death.
translation_verse: e beeŋ shuŋi bedoŋ menyi kutɔ nɛ men shuŋ bumo nɛ ketir e pɛ menyi nɛ men maaŋ nya ajibi n ji ŋko nchu n nuu ŋko asɔbuuso gba m buu. Men doŋana na beeŋ kɔrfɛ menyi hale n ya mur menyi.

english_verse: Foreigners who speak a strange language will be sent to attack you without warning, just like an eagle swooping down.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ shin nɛ efuli pɔtɛ be basa nɛ men maa nu bumo be ŋgbar e shi kufɔ kufɔ ŋ kre kena m ba purgi menyi fanɛ kusore ka ta koshi na.

english_verse: They won't show any mercy, and they will have no respect for old people or pity for children.
translation_verse: B maaŋ baa kɔ kushuso n sa ekama ŋko kuwɔrwu n sa enimu ŋko kebia.

english_verse: They will take your cattle, sheep, goats, grain, wine, and olive oil, then leave you to starve.
translation_verse: Baaŋ suge menyi be asɔbɔya nɛ adɔjibi kikɛ nɛ akoŋ a mɔ menyi. B maaŋ yige ayu ŋko yabra belbelso ŋko ɔlifs be ŋku ŋko ana ŋko mbolpɔ kama n sa menyi.

english_verse: All over the land that the Lord your God gave you, the enemy army will surround your towns. You may feel safe inside your town walls, but the enemy will tear them down,
translation_verse: Bumo alɛ beeŋ kre kena m ba kulti kade kama nɛ k wɔ kasawule nɛ Enyɛnpe, menyi be Ebɔrɛ na ta a sa menyi ere n wɔtɔ. Baaŋ bure egbal lempo jeŋgreŋana nɛ menyeeŋ pɔr ŋ kulti men be ndeana n ta men be yirda n deŋi amo so na.

english_verse: A woman may have grown up in such luxury that she never had to put a foot on the ground. translation_verse: Loŋ be jemanɛ na, menyi to be eche nɛ e du boeŋ nsaa la damawura nɛ e maŋ naŋ lar n nite aya so n yɔ kaboŋ ko ŋ ku so gba beeŋ ba kaa yɛla kenishi to a fin ajibi, hale n ya ŋana n ta mbe kebia popɔrbi nɛ kekurgesha kikɛ n we.
