english_verse: You must obey everything in The Book of God's Law. Because if you don't respect the Lord,
translation_verse: Nɛ men kini kewora Ebɔrɛ be mbraana nɛ b sibɛ n wɔtɔ kawɔl ere to ere kasonu kashenteŋto nseŋ kini kesa Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na be ketre nɛ k kɔ kemaŋkura na bunyaŋ,

english_verse: Remember! If the Lord decides to destroy your nation, he can use any disease or disaster, not just the ones written in The Book of God's Law.
translation_verse: Ade kikɛ be kaman, mo alɛ beeŋ naŋ shin nɛ alɔ be yiri yiri nɛ a bee suse manaŋ manaŋ nsaa maŋ wɔ Ebɔrɛ be mbra be kawɔl ere to gba a ba mur menyi.

english_verse: There are as many of you now as the stars in the sky, but if you disobey the Lord your God, only a few of you will be left.
translation_verse: Kananɛ men wora keshi a du fanɛ achɛkpabi ka wɔ awɔlpa so ere, nɛ men kaŋ kini kewora Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na kasonu, menyi to be basa gbrɛbi e naaŋ ka a wɔ ŋkpa to.

english_verse: The Lord is happy to make you successful and to help your nation grow while you conquer the land. But if you disobey him, he will be just as happy to pull you up by your roots.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na fuli kagbene nna n shin nɛ asheŋ bee nite nɛnɛ a sa menyi nseŋ shin nɛ men wora keshi n ti so. Ama nɛ men kini kewora mo kasonu, kumo ere e maaŋ naŋ tiŋ n wora shɛŋ, ama kemur menyi ashi kasawule nɛ menyee yɔ nɛ men ya chena so na.

english_verse: Those of you that survive will be scattered to every nation on earth, and you will have to worship stone and wood idols that never helped you or your ancestors.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ shin nɛ men pesaŋ to n sɔ durnya to be efuliana kikɛ so n ya shuŋ agbirana nɛ b ta ndibi nɛ ajembu n lɔŋɛ nɛ menyi nɛ men nananyɛnana maŋ naŋ shuŋ ŋ ku so na.

english_verse: You will be restless—always longing for home, but never able to return.
translation_verse: Menyi alɛ maaŋ nya kayurwushi kaplɛkama. Menyeeŋ baa yɛlga epe, ama menyi alɛ maaŋ tiŋ m bɛta n yɔ.

english_verse: Each morning you will wake up to such terrible sights that you will say, “I wish it were night!” But at night you will be terrified and say, “I wish it were day!”
translation_verse: Kusɔ kama nɛ menyeeŋ wu kenishi so beeŋ shin nɛ men be ŋgbene e baa ku menyi. Kachipurso kikɛ, le nɛ menyeeŋ baa kaŋɛ: “Kanyɛ daŋ biri gba, k bɔ!” Kanyɛ malɛ naŋ biri nɛ men naŋ kaŋɛ le: “Kare daŋ chɛ gba, k bɔ!”

english_verse: I told you never to go back to Egypt. But now the Lord himself will load you on ships and send you back. Then you will even try to sell yourselves as slaves, but no one will be interested.
translation_verse: N daŋ kaŋɛ menyi fanɛ men sa maŋ kaŋ bɛta n yɔ Ijipt be efuli so. Ama naniere Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na gbagba beeŋ bɛta menyi n wɔtɔ nchu so be ekuloŋgboŋ to n yɔ Ijipt, nɛ men ya kaa sha kefa menyi be amu fanɛ anya nɛ esa kikɛ maaŋ tɔ menyi ndoŋ.

english_verse: So Moses finished telling the Israelites what they had to do in order to keep the agreement the Lord was making with them in Moab, which was in addition to the one the Lord had made with them at Mount Sinai. The Third Speech: Israel Must Keep Its Agreement with the Lord The Lord Is Your God
translation_verse: Kananɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nɛ Israɛlebi na be kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre, nɛ e kaŋɛ Mosis kenishipere so ashi Mowab be kasawule so na, bee nite nde. Le be ŋkre ere gba ti amo nɛ bumo nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na daŋ kre ashi kebeegboŋ nɛ baa tre Sainai na ase na so nna.

english_verse: Moses called the nation of Israel together and told them: When you were in Egypt, you saw the Lord perform great miracles that caused trouble for the king, his officials, and everyone else in the country.
translation_verse: Menyi alɛ naŋ wu alɔ lubi nɛ emamachisheŋ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na wora ashi Ijipt be efuli so ndoŋ.

english_verse: Then we captured their land and divided it among the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh. Keep the Agreement Moses said:
translation_verse: nseŋ daŋ sɔ bumo be nsawule m barga to n sa Ruben nɛ Gad be yiri to ebi nɛ Manase be yiri be bargato ebi.

english_verse: Israel, the Lord has made an agreement with you, and if you keep your part, you will be successful in everything you do.
translation_verse: Amoso, men baa bɛ menyi nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre na be atande so nɛnɛ, nɛ kusɔ kama nɛ menyeeŋ wora e nite nɛnɛ n sa menyi.

english_verse: Today everyone in our nation is standing here in the Lord's presence, including leaders and officials, parents and children, and even those foreigners who cut wood and carry water for us. We are at this place of worship to promise that we will keep our part of the agreement with the Lord our God.
translation_verse: Men wɔ nfe kabre nna nɛ men nase kɔnɔ fanɛ menyeeŋ wora m bɔlɔ kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre nɛ menyi nɛ Enyɛnpe, men be Ebɔrɛ na bee kre na so,

english_verse: When we lived in Egypt, you saw the Egyptians worship disgusting idols of wood, stone, silver, and gold. Then as we traveled through other nations, you saw those people worship other disgusting idols.
translation_verse: Men daŋ wu bumo be agbirana nɛ b ta ndibi ŋko ajembu ŋko shuwa ŋko gbiti n lɔŋɛ. An ka daŋ wu amo kenishiso na gba k daa la ekishi nna n sa anyi.

english_verse: So make sure that everyone in your tribe remains faithful to the Lord and never starts worshiping gods of other nations. If even one of you worships idols, you will be like the root of a plant that produces bitter, poisonous fruit.
translation_verse: Men baa da so nɛ enyɛn ŋko eche ŋko kanaŋ ŋko yiri kikɛ nɛ k yil nfe kabre ere be kekama maaŋ lar Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na kaman nseŋ ya kaa shuŋ efuli pɔtɛana be agbirana. Loŋ kaŋ wora, k beeŋ baa du fanɛ kaliŋi ka kɔr n daŋ ŋ ki keya nɛ kumo be asɔrso du kekra nsaa kɔ kɔrtɔ nna.

english_verse: You may be an Israelite and know all about the Lord's agreement with us, but he won't bless you if you rebel against him. You may think you can get away with it, but you will cause the rest of Israel to be punished along with you.
translation_verse: Menyi alɛ e baa da so nɛ menyi to be esa kikɛ nɛ e wɔ nfe kabre nsaa nu kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre ere be atande ere maaŋ fɛ fanɛ hale nɛ e wora mbe aparsheŋ gba, asheŋ kraa beeŋ nite nɛnɛ n sa mo. Kumo be loŋ beeŋ tiŋ m mur basa lela nɛ basa lubi kikɛ.

english_verse: The Lord will be furious, and instead of forgiving you, he will separate you from the other tribes. Then he will destroy you, by piling on you all the curses in The Book of God's Law, and you will be forgotten forever.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na maaŋ ta m paŋ esa nɛ e beeŋ wora loŋ na. E beeŋ nya agbo ga n wora amodoŋwura nseŋ shin nɛ eshoduu nɛ a wɔ Ebɔrɛ na be mbra be kawɔl ere to a ba mo so nɛ e mur mo cheche. Saŋɛ na so, k beeŋ baa la kasokpele n sa Israɛl be eyiriana na kikɛ.

english_verse: has become a scorching desert of salt and sulfur, where nothing is planted, nothing sprouts, and nothing grows. It will be as lifeless as the land around the cities of Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboiim, after the Lord became angry and destroyed them.
translation_verse: Menyi be kasawule na beeŋ ki fanɛ Sodɔm nɛ Gomɔra nɛ Adma nɛ Zeboyim nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na daŋ nya agbo ga nseŋ mur amo jemanɛ ko na.

english_verse: People from other nations will ask, “Why did the Lord destroy this country? Why was he so furious?”
translation_verse: Efuli pɔtɛana so be basa kikɛ beeŋ bishi le: “Manɛ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na wora bumo be kasawule loŋ? Manɛ e bar mbe kanya agbo?”

english_verse: And they will be given this answer: Our ancestors worshiped the Lord, but after he brought them out of Egypt and made an agreement with them, they rejected the agreement
translation_verse: Kusɔ nɛ beko beeŋ kaŋɛ e la: “Basa ere ka lar bumo Nyɛnpe, nɛ e la bumo nananyɛnana be Ebɔrɛ na be kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre nɛ mo nɛ bumo kre jemanɛ nɛ e lara bumo Ijipt be efuli so kaman

english_verse: and decided to worship gods that had never helped them. The Lord had forbidden Israel to worship these gods,
translation_verse: nseŋ ya kaa shuŋ agbirana nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na daŋ kaŋɛ bumo fanɛ b sa maŋ kaŋ shuŋ na so

english_verse: and so he became furious and punished the land with all the curses in The Book of God's Law. Then he pulled up Israel by the roots and tossed them into a foreign country, where they still are today.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na daŋ nya agbo ga nna nseŋ lara bumo ashi bumo gbagba be kasawule so n ya lɛ efuli pɔtɛ nɛ b wɔ kumo so kabre ere so.”

english_verse: The Lord our God hasn't explained the present or the future, but he has commanded us to obey the laws he gave to us and our descendants.
translation_verse: Asheŋ ko wɔtɔ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe, anyi be Ebɔrɛ na, ta n yili ashiri to, ama e lara mbe mbraana bre ŋ ŋini anyi, saŋɛ na so, anyi nɛ anyi be kaman to ebi beeŋ baa wora amo kasonu mbaanaayɔ.

english_verse: I have told you everything the Lord your God will do for you, and I've also told you the curses he will put on you if you reject him. He will scatter you in faraway countries, but when you realize that he is punishing you,
translation_verse: “Naniere n ta nɛfa nɛ shoduu nna a nase menyi be anishito nɛ men keni to n lara kumo nɛ menyee sha. Nɛ asheŋ ere kikɛ kaŋ wora menyi nɛ k ba fanɛ men pesaŋ to n ya kaa wɔ efuli pɔtɛana so, menyeeŋ nyiŋi ekpa nɛ m bugi n sa menyi nɛ men keni to n lara kumo nɛ menyee sha na.

english_verse: return to him with all your heart and soul and start obeying the commands I have given to you today.
translation_verse: Nɛ fanɛ menyi nɛ men be kaman to ebi beeŋ bɛta m ba Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kutɔ, nseŋ ta menyi be ŋgbene kikɛ n wora mbe mbraana nɛ n ta a sa menyi kabre ere kasonu,

english_verse: Then he will stop punishing you and treat you with kindness. He may have scattered you to the farthest countries on earth, but he will bring you back
translation_verse: Hale nɛ men pesaŋ to n yɔ durnya be efuli kama nɛ k wɔ kufɔ kufɔ gba, Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ naŋ gama menyi abar so m bɛta menyi m ba;

english_verse: You and your descendants are stubborn, but the Lord will make you willing to obey him and love him with all your heart and soul, and you will enjoy a long life.
translation_verse: Ade be kaman, Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ sa menyi nɛ men be kaman to ebi ŋgbene nɛ a kɔ kasonu; saŋɛ na so, menyeeŋ tiŋ n sha mo nɛ menyi be ŋgbene kikɛ nseŋ naŋ chena kasawule na so.

english_verse: Then the Lord your God will remove the curses from you and put them on those enemies who hate and attack you.
translation_verse: Mo alɛ beeŋ laŋɛ eshoduu ere kikɛ n deŋi men doŋana nɛ b kishi menyi nseŋ mɛaŋ menyi na so.

english_verse: You will again obey the laws and teachings of the Lord,
translation_verse: Menyi alɛ beeŋ wora mo kasonu nsaa bɛ mbe mbraana nɛ n ta a sa menyi kabre ere so.

english_verse: and he will bless you with many children, large herds and flocks, and abundant crops. The Lord will be happy to do good things for you, just as he did for your ancestors.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman, Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ shin nɛ men nya mbia nɛ asɔbɔya damta nseŋ naŋ shin nɛ menyi be adɔjibi e wora ga. Kananɛ e daŋ fuli kagbene n shin nɛ asheŋ nite nɛnɛ n sa men nananyɛnana na, aloŋ nɛ e beeŋ fuli kagbene n shin nɛ asheŋ e nite nɛnɛ n sa menyi alɛ gba.

english_verse: But you must decide once and for all to worship him with all your heart and soul and to obey everything in The Book of God's Law. Choose Life, Not Death Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Ama a daga fanɛ men ka wora mo kasonu nsaa bɛ mbe mbraana nɛ a wɔ mbra be kawɔl to na so. A daga men ka ta menyi be ŋgbene kikɛ m bɛta m ba mo kutɔ.

english_verse: You know God's laws, and it isn't impossible to obey them.
translation_verse: Kusɔ nɛ mee kaŋɛ menyi kenishipere so kabre ere maŋ du kpakpa ga nɛ menyi maaŋ tiŋ n wora kumo kasonu.”

english_verse: His commands aren't in heaven, so you can't excuse yourselves by saying, “How can we obey the Lord's commands? They are in heaven, and no one can go up to get them, then bring them down and explain them to us.”
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be mbraana na maŋ wɔ ebɔrɛso nna nɛ men bishi le: “Wanɛ e naaŋ dii n yɔ esoso n ya sɔ amo ŋ gbelge to m ba sa anyi nɛ an nu amo nseŋ wora amo kasonu?”

english_verse: And you can't say, “How can we obey the Lord's commands? They are across the sea, and someone must go across, then bring them back and explain them to us.”
translation_verse: Amo alɛ maŋ naa wɔ teku be kaba ndoŋ nna nɛ men naŋ bishi fanɛ: “Wanɛ e naaŋ yɔ teku be kaba ndoŋ n ya bar amo m ba sa anyi nɛ an nu amo nseŋ wora amo kasonu?”

english_verse: No, these commands are nearby and you know them by heart. All you have to do is obey!
translation_verse: Ayai, mbraana na wɔ menyi kutɔ nna. Menyeeŋ tiŋ ŋ koya amo m pin amo a kute amo to. Amoso men baa wora amo kasonu naniere.

english_verse: Today I am giving you a choice. You can choose life and success or death and disaster.
translation_verse: “Kelela nɛ ŋkpa ŋko kulubi nɛ luwu nɛ mee ta a nase menyi be anishito kabre na, nɛ men keni to n lara kumo nɛ menyee sha.

english_verse: Now I call the sky and the earth to be witnesses that I am offering you this choice. Will you choose for the Lord to make you prosperous and give you a long life? Or will he put you under a curse and kill you? Choose life!
translation_verse: Ade kikɛ be kaman, luwu nɛ ŋkpa nɛ Ebɔrɛ be nɛfa nɛ mbe eshoduu nɛ n ta a nase menyi be anishito na. Ma alɛ bee ta ebɔrɛso nɛ kasawule so nna fanɛ a ji shɛda n sa amo be kumo nɛ menyeeŋ lara. Men lara ŋkpa, saŋɛ na so, menyi nɛ men be mbia beeŋ baa wɔ ŋkpa to.

english_verse: Be completely faithful to the Lord your God, love him, and do whatever he tells you. The Lord is the only one who can give life, and he will let you live a long time in the land that he promised to your ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
translation_verse: Men baa sha Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na a wora mo kasonu nsaa ji kashenteŋ a sa mo nɛ menyi nɛ men be kaman to ebi e chena kasawule nɛ e nase kumo be kɔnɔ n sa men nananyɛnana, Eebraham nɛ Aizek nɛ Jeekɔb, na so n chɛr.”

english_verse: Moses again spoke to the whole nation of Israel:
translation_verse: Ade be kaman nɛ Mosis naŋ kaŋɛ Israɛlebi na le:

english_verse: Be brave and strong! Don't be afraid of the nations on the other side of the Jordan. The Lord your God will always be at your side, and he will never abandon you.
translation_verse: Men nya kagbene a kɔ kenyɛn. Men sa maa ŋana bumo. Ŋkpal manɛ so, Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na gbagba beeŋ baa wɔ menyi kutɔ. Mo alɛ maaŋ lar menyi kaman ŋko ŋ kplaŋ menyi so kikɛ.”

english_verse: Then Moses called Joshua up in front of the crowd and said: Joshua, be brave and strong as you lead these people into their land. The Lord made a promise long ago to Israel's ancestors that this land would someday belong to Israel. That time has now come, and you must divide up the land among the people.
translation_verse: Ade be kaman, nɛ Mosis tre Joshuwa m ba kaŋɛ mo le ashi Israɛl be basa na kikɛ be anishito: “Nya kagbene a kɔ kenyɛn. Fo e naaŋ juŋkpar basa ere n ya sɔ kasawule nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nase kumo be kɔnɔ n sa bumo nananyɛnana na n chena so.

english_verse: The Lord will lead you into the land. He will always be with you and help you, so don't ever be afraid of your enemies. Read These Laws
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na gbagba beeŋ baa wɔ fo kutɔ a juŋkpar fo. Mo alɛ maaŋ lar fo kaman ŋko ŋ kplaŋ fo so kikɛ; amoso sa maa pɔ aba ŋko a lɔ kufu.” Kebaakraŋ mbra na nfɛ ashunu kikɛ be asheŋ

english_verse: Moses wrote down all of these laws and teachings and gave them to the priests and the leaders of Israel. The priests were from the Levi tribe, and they carried the sacred chest that belonged to the Lord.
translation_verse: Mosis daŋ sibɛ Ebɔrɛ be mbra na nna n wɔtɔ kawɔl to nseŋ ta kumo n sa Israɛl be bejuŋkparpoana na nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ b shi Livai be yiri to nsaa keni Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre be deka so na.

english_verse: Moses told these priests and leaders: Each year the Israelites must come together to celebrate the Festival of Shelters at the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped. You must read these laws and teachings to the people at the festival every seventh year, the year when loans do not need to be repaid.
translation_verse: Jemanɛ nɛ Israɛl be basa beeŋ ba gama abar so nɛ b shuŋ Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na ashi kakpa nɛ menyeeŋ baa shuŋ Ebɔrɛ na nɛ menyeeŋ kraŋ kumo n sa bumo.

english_verse: Everyone must come—men, women, children, and even the foreigners who live in your towns. And each new generation will listen and learn to worship the Lord their God with fear and trembling and to do exactly what is said in God's Law. Israel Will Reject the Lord
translation_verse: Ekpa nɛ men be kaman to ebi nɛ b maŋ naŋ nu Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na be mbra be asheŋ beeŋ bɔla so n nya kumo n nu nna na. Kumo be loŋ beeŋ shin nɛ b koya kebaawora mo kasonu bumo be kebaawɔtɔ to ashi kasawule nɛ menyee yɔ nɛ men ya sɔ n chena so ashi Jɔɔdan be lɔr na be kaba ndoŋ na.” Israɛl ka beeŋ lar Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaman be asheŋ

english_verse: The Lord told Moses, “You will soon die, so bring Joshua to the sacred tent, and I will appoint him the leader of Israel.” Moses and Joshua went to the sacred tent,
translation_verse: Ade kikɛ be kaman, nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ Mosis le: “Fo maaŋ naŋ chɛr nseŋ wu, amoso keta Joshuwa m ba wajɛbu cheembi na to; saŋɛ na so, meeŋ ŋini mo asheŋ ko nɛ e ki Israɛl be ejuŋkparpo. Ndoŋ nna nɛ Mosis nɛ Joshuwa kikɛ yɔ wajɛbu cheembi na to

english_verse: and the Lord appeared in a thick cloud right over the entrance to the tent.
translation_verse: nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bɔla kuwɔlpa nɛ k wɔ wajɛbu cheembi na be kabuna to na so n lara mbe kumu ŋ ŋini bumo.”

english_verse: The Lord said: Moses, you will soon die. But Israel is going into a land where other gods are worshiped, and Israel will reject me and start worshiping these gods. The people will break the agreement I made with them,
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ Mosis le: “Fo maaŋ naŋ chɛr nseŋ wu. Fo alɛ be luwu be kaman basa na maaŋ naa ji kashenteŋ a sa ma nseŋ lar kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre nɛ ma nɛ bumo kre na to. Baaŋ lar ma kaman n ya kaa shuŋ nnyamase be agbirana nɛ a wɔ kasawule nɛ baa yɔ na so.

english_verse: and I will be so furious that I will abandon them and ignore their prayers. I will send disasters and suffering that will nearly wipe them out. Finally, they will realize that the disasters happened because I abandoned them.
translation_verse: Nɛ b kaŋ wora loŋ malɛ, meeŋ nya agbo ga n wora bumo nseŋ kplaŋ bumo so nɛ b mur. Kumu lubi gboŋgboŋi beeŋ ba bumo so nɛ b pin fanɛ asheŋ ere kikɛ bee wora nna ŋkpal ma, bumo be Ebɔrɛ na, ka maŋ naa wɔ bumo kutɔ so.

english_verse: They will pray to me, but I will ignore them because they were evil and started worshiping other gods.
translation_verse: Ma alɛ beeŋ kini kechɛ bumo to, ŋkpal b ka ya kaa shuŋ agbirana n wora kulubi so.

english_verse: Moses and Joshua, I am going to give you the words to a new song. Write them down and teach the song to the Israelites. If they learn it, they will know what I want them to do, and so they will have no excuse for not obeying me.
translation_verse: To, sibɛ kashɛ ere n nase naniere, nseŋ ŋini Israɛl be basa na nɛ b baa boŋ kumo; saŋɛ na so, baaŋ pin kusɔ nɛ mee sha fanɛ b baa wora nsaa maaŋ nya kusɔ ko n yili so ŋ kini kewora ma kasonu.

english_verse: I am bringing them into the land that I promised their ancestors. It is a land rich with milk and honey, and the Israelites will have more than enough food to eat. But they will get fat and turn their backs on me and start worshiping other gods. The Israelites will reject me and break the agreement that I made with them.
translation_verse: Ma alɛ beeŋ keta bumo n yɔ kasawule nɛ k kɔ eleŋ a wora adɔjibi nɛnɛ na so fanɛ kananɛ n nase kumo be kɔnɔ n sa bumo nananyɛnana na. Baaŋ ya nya kusɔ kama nɛ baa sha n ji ndoŋ. Ama b kaŋ ya nya n ji n daŋ, baaŋ lar ma kaman n ya kaa shuŋ agbirana n jija ma nɛ bumo be kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre na.

english_verse: When I punish the Israelites and their descendants with suffering and disasters, I will remind them that they know the words to this song, so they have no excuse for not obeying me. I will give them the land that I promised, but I know the way they are going to live later on.
translation_verse: Kumo be loŋ beeŋ shin nɛ kumu lubi gboŋgboŋi e ba bumo nɛ bumo be kaman to ebi so. Ama b kraa beeŋ baa boŋ kashɛ ere nɛ k baa ji shɛda a gbiti bumo. Pɔɛŋ nɛ meeŋ keta bumo n yɔ kasawule nɛ n nase kumo be kɔnɔ n sa bumo na gba so, n tea nyi kusɔ nɛ baa fɛ.”

english_verse: Moses at once wrote down the words to the song, and he taught it to the Israelites.
translation_verse: Loŋ be kachɛ na gbagba nɛ Mosis sibɛ kashɛ na nseŋ ŋini Israɛlebi na kumo.

english_verse: then he went to the Levites who carried the sacred chest and said:
translation_verse: E ka sibɛ amo n loge nɛ e ya kaŋɛ bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ baa sulɔ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre be deka na le:

english_verse: This is The Book of God's Law. Keep it beside the sacred chest that holds the agreement the Lord your God made with Israel. This book is proof that you know what the Lord wants you to do.
translation_verse: “Men sɔ Ebɔrɛ be mbra be kawɔl ere n nase m mata Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na be kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre be deka na. K beeŋ baa wɔtɔ ndoŋ a ji shɛda fanɛ men nyi kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee sha fanɛ men baa wora.

english_verse: I know how stubborn and rebellious you and the rest of the Israelites are. You have rebelled against the Lord while I have been alive, and it will only get worse after I am gone.
translation_verse: N nyi kananɛ bumo be amu nɛ ŋgbene du kpakpa. Jemanɛ nɛ n wɔ bumo to gba, b lar Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaman. Ma luwu be kaman bre baaŋ wora kumo nɛ k chɔ loŋ.

english_verse: So call together the leaders and officials of the tribes of Israel. I will bring this book and read every word of it to you, and I will call the sky and the earth as witnesses that all of you know what you are supposed to do.
translation_verse: Amoso, shin nɛ Israɛl be eyiriana na be bejuŋkparpoana nɛ benimuana na e shɛr nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ bumo asheŋ ere nseŋ ta esoso nɛ kasawule ŋ ki eshɛdajipo fanɛ men kikɛ tea nyi kusɔ nɛ k daga fanɛ men baa wora.

english_verse: I am going to die soon, and I know that in the future you will stop caring about what is right and what is wrong, and so you will disobey the Lord and stop living the way I told you to live. The Lord will be angry, and terrible things will happen to you. The Song of Moses
translation_verse: Ade be kaman n nyi fanɛ ma luwu be kaman, basa na be amu beeŋ ki kpakpa nɛ b kini kusɔ nɛ ŋ ŋini bumo ere n lɛ nseŋ kini kewora Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kasonu. Kumo be loŋ malɛ beeŋ shin nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e nya agbo n wora bumo n shin nɛ kumu lubi gboŋgboŋi e ba bumo so.” Mosis be kashɛ be asheŋ

english_verse: Moses called a meeting of all the people of Israel, so he could teach them the words to the song that the Lord had given him. And here are the words:
translation_verse: Ade kikɛ be kaman, nɛ Mosis kute kusɔ nɛ kashɛ na bee kaŋɛ kikɛ n sa Israɛl be basa nɛ b shɛr ndoŋ na kikɛ nɛ b nu.

english_verse: Israel, I will teach you. My words will be like gentle rain on tender young plants, or like dew on the grass.
translation_verse: Ma keŋini beeŋ ba fanɛ bɔrɛchu nɛ kasawule e pɔ fanɛ bunyaŋ ka tɔr. Ma mmalga beeŋ tɔr to fanɛ bɔrɛ ka bee ba asɔduuso popɔrbi so ŋko fanɛ bɔrɛ ka bee furi afitiri wurbi so.

english_verse: Join with me in praising the wonderful name of the Lord our God.
translation_verse: Meeŋ fur Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be ketre, nɛ mbe basa e malga mbe keshi be asheŋ.

english_verse: But you lie and cheat and are unfaithful to him. You have disgraced yourselves and are no longer worthy to be his children.
translation_verse: Ama menyi ere maa ji kashenteŋ; menyi nɛ men la alubi nɛ efɛ be efuli so ebi ere; a maŋ daga fanɛ men baa la mbe basa gba.

english_verse: that God Most High gave land to every nation. He assigned a guardian angel to each of them,
translation_verse: Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na e naa sa efuli kama so ebi nsawule; mo e naa ŋini basa kakpa nɛ baaŋ chena.

english_verse: but the Lord himself takes care of Israel.
translation_verse: E lara Jeekɔb be kenana bre nna n sa mbe kumu.

english_verse: Israel, the Lord discovered you in a barren desert filled with howling winds. God became your fortress, protecting you as though you were his own eyes.
translation_verse: E wu bumo nɛ baa nite keshishɛrsawule so nna, kakpa nɛ k dese fuloŋ nɛ afu bee muu shishɛr a yɔ a ba na. Ndoŋ nna nɛ e kuŋ bumo ŋ keni bumo so nɛnɛ, fanɛ kananɛ e bee kuŋ mo gbagba be kumu na.

english_verse: The Lord was like an eagle teaching its young to fly, always ready to swoop down and catch them on its back.
translation_verse: Kananɛ kajɔnɔkoso bee ŋini kumo be bibi kefergi a parga kumo gbagba be aba to a suse bibi na to na, aloŋ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na daŋ suse Israɛlebi to nɛ b sa maŋ tɔr.

english_verse: Israel, the Lord led you, and without the aid of a foreign god,
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nawule e juŋkpar mbe basa, nɛ kegbir pɔtɛ kikɛ maŋ chɛ mo to.

english_verse: he helped you capture the land. Your fields were rich with grain. Olive trees grew in your stony soil, and honey was found among the rocks.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ e shin nɛ b ji kuwura abeesawule so, nseŋ naŋ shin nɛ b ji asɔ nɛ b dɔ n nya bumo be adɔ to. B daŋ nya emushoŋ ashi abee so n ji; bumo be ɔlifs be ndibi purge nɛnɛ kejasawule so.

english_verse: Your flocks and herds produced milk and yogurt, and you got choice meat from your sheep and goats that grazed in Bashan. Your wheat was the finest, and you drank the best wine.
translation_verse: Bumo be ana nɛ mboe sa bumo kenyipochu damta ga; Bashan be kasawule so nɛ bumo be mbolpɔ nɛ mboe nɛ ana daa ji. Bumo alɛ daŋ naa kɔ ayu lela nɛ yabra belbelso ga.

english_verse: You made God jealous and angry by worshiping disgusting idols and foreign gods.
translation_verse: Bumo be kagbirshuŋ daŋ shin nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be kukɔrkɔ koso nna; nɛ bumo be asheŋ lubi shin nɛ mbe kagbene kaa.

english_verse: You offered sacrifices to demons, those useless gods that never helped you, new gods that your ancestors never worshiped.
translation_verse: B daŋ lara esarga nna n sa agbirana nɛ a maŋ la Ebɔrɛ, agbir popɔr nɛ bumo nananyɛnana daa maŋ nyi, agbirana nɛ Israɛl daa maŋ naŋ wora kasonu ŋ ku so.

english_verse: You turned away from God, your Creator; you forgot the Mighty Rock, the source of your life.
translation_verse: B daŋ teŋ bumo be Ebɔrɛ, bumo be Emɔlgapo lempo nɛ e sa bumo ŋkpa na so nna.

english_verse: You were the Lord's children, but you made him angry. Then he rejected you
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ka wu loŋ nɛ e nya agbo nseŋ kini mbe mbia n lɛ.

english_verse: and said, “You are unfaithful and can't be trusted. So I won't answer your prayers; I'll just watch and see what happens to you.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ e kaŋɛ le: ‘M maaŋ naŋ chɛ bumo to kikɛ, nseŋ keni kusɔ nɛ k beeŋ wora ŋgbene kpakpasowuraana nɛ b maa ji kashenteŋ ere.

english_verse: You worshiped worthless idols, and made me jealous and angry! Now I will send a cruel and worthless nation to make you jealous and angry.
translation_verse: B daŋ bunyaŋ agbirana nɛ a maŋ kɔ tɔnɔ n shin nɛ ma kukɔrkɔ koso nɛ n nya agbo. Amoso meeŋ shin nɛ men be kukɔrkɔ nɛ agbo e koso, ŋkpal kusɔ nɛ meeŋ wora efuli nɛ k maa wu kuwɔr nsaa maa kɔ tɔnɔ be basa so.

english_verse: “My people, I will breathe out fire that sends you down to the world of the dead. It will scorch your farmlands and burn deep down under the mountains.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ ma agbo e suse fanɛ edɛ n chɔɔ kusɔ kama durnya to, n ta menyi be adɔ n ti so. Edɛ na beeŋ chɔɔ hale bubuni to ashi kasawule to nseŋ naŋ chɔɔ abeeana gba m mur.

english_verse: “I wanted to scatter you, so no one would remember that you had ever lived.
translation_verse: Meeŋ mur bumo kikɛ kuraa, nɛ esa maaŋ naŋ nyiŋi bumo gba.

english_verse: But I dreaded the sound of your enemies saying, ‘We defeated Israel with no help from the Lord.’ ”
translation_verse: Ama m maaŋ tiŋ n shin nɛ men doŋana e puchi fanɛ b tiŋ m pɔɔ ma basa so, saŋɛ nɛ k la fanɛ ŋ gbagba e pɔɔ bumo so.’

english_verse: People of Israel, that's what the Lord has said to you. But you don't have good sense, and you never listen to advice.
translation_verse: Israɛl be efuli so be basa maŋ kɔ nfɛra nna, b maŋ kɔ kanyiasheŋ kikɛ.

english_verse: How could one enemy soldier chase a thousand of Israel's troops? Or how could two of theirs pursue ten thousand of ours? It can only happen if the Lord stops protecting Israel and lets the enemy win.
translation_verse: Manɛ so nɛ esa koŋwule tiŋ m pɔɔ basa kagboŋ so, nɛ basa anyɔ malɛ tiŋ m pɔɔ basa ŋgboŋ kudu so? Enyɛnpe bumo be Ebɔrɛ na e kini bumo n lɛ. Bumo be Ebɔrɛ lempo na e ta bumo n sa bumo doŋana.

english_verse: Even our enemies know that only our God is a Mighty Rock.
translation_verse: Bumo doŋana na baa nyi fanɛ bumo be agbirana maŋ kɔ eleŋ; agbirana na be eleŋ maŋ fo Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ peya so.

english_verse: Our enemies are grapevines rooted in the fields of Sodom and Gomorrah. The grapes they produce are full of bitter poison;
translation_verse: Bumo doŋana nɛ b lubi fanɛ Sodɔm nɛ Gomɔra ebi na, du fanɛ afeelebi nɛ a bee sɔr asɔrso kekra nɛ kɔrtɔ wɔ amo to nna,

english_verse: their wine is more deadly than cobra venom.
translation_verse: ŋko yabra nɛ awɔ be kɔrtɔ wɔ amo to na nna.

english_verse: But the Lord has written a list of their sins and locked it in his vault.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nyiŋi kusɔ nɛ bumo doŋana wora nsaa jo saŋɛ nɛ k daga fanɛ e gberge bumo kusoe.

english_verse: Soon our enemies will get what they deserve— suddenly they will slip, and total disaster will quickly follow.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ sɔ bumo be kɔnɔ so ŋ gberge bumo doŋana na kusoe. Jemanɛ na kaŋ fo baaŋ fɛrge n tɔr; bumo be kemur be kachɛ taga to nna na.

english_verse: When only a few of the Lord's people remain, when their strength is gone, and some of them are slaves, the Lord will feel sorry for them and give them justice.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ kɔ n sɔ mbe basa, jemanɛ nɛ e beeŋ wu fanɛ bumo be eleŋ loge na. E beeŋ wu bumo nɛ baa shuŋ mo na kuwɔr, jemanɛ nɛ e beeŋ wu fanɛ b maaŋ tiŋ n wora shɛŋ n sa bumo be amu na.

english_verse: But first the Lord will say, “You ran for safety to other gods— couldn't they help you?
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e bishi mbe basa le: ‘Nnɛ nɛ agbirgboŋ nɛ men yirda na wɔ?

english_verse: You offered them wine and your best sacrifices. Can't those gods help you now or give you protection?
translation_verse: Men daŋ ta menyi be esarga be nfɔ nɛ eyabra nna n sa amo. Naniere men shin nɛ agbirana na a ba chɛ menyi to, nseŋ shile m ba kɔ n sɔ menyi n yige.

english_verse: Don't you understand? I am the only God; there are no others. I am the one who takes life and gives it again. I punished you with suffering. But now I will heal you, and nothing can stop me!
translation_verse: N nawule kpeŋ e la Ebɔrɛ. Ebɔrɛ kikɛ maŋ naa wɔtɔ n ti ma so. Ma e naa shin nɛ luwu bee ba, ma koŋwule na e naa sa ŋkpa. Ma e naa bar doro, ma alɛ e naa chɛ edoro. Esa maaŋ tiŋ ŋ kuŋ kusɔ kama nɛ mee wora akpa.

english_verse: “I make this solemn promise: Just as I live forever,
translation_verse: Ma e la Ebɔrɛ nɛ e bee sa ŋkpa; ma e maŋ ma enɔ so m bɔ ntaŋ

english_verse: I will take revenge on my hateful enemies. I will sharpen my sword and let it flash like lightning.
translation_verse: fanɛ meeŋ yee ma tokobi nɛ k baa nyɛkpɛ nseŋ shin nɛ kashenteŋji e dii efuli. Meeŋ ka n doŋana kukɔ nseŋ gberge bumo nɛ b kishi ma kusoe.

english_verse: My arrows will get drunk on enemy blood; my sword will taste the flesh and the blood of the enemy. It will kill prisoners, and cut off the heads of their leaders.”
translation_verse: Bumo be ŋklaŋ beeŋ baa chise ma atanyembi so, nɛ ma tokobi e mɔ bekama nɛ b maa shuli a sa ma na. M maaŋ shin nɛ ekama nɛ e bee kɔ ma e ta mbe kumu n ji; bumo nɛ b nya doro nɛ bumo nɛ b wɔ kabuti to kikɛ beeŋ wu.’

english_verse: Tell the heavens to celebrate and all gods to bow down to the Lord, because he will take revenge on those hateful enemies who killed his people. He will forgive the sins of Israel and purify their land.
translation_verse: Efuli pɔtɛana be basa, a daga fanɛ men tu Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be basa n ji eyur, ŋkpal manɛ so, e bee gberge bekama nɛ b mɔ mbe basa kusoe nna. Mo e naa bishi mo doŋana kuwule nsaa ta mbe basa be alubi a paŋ bumo na.”

english_verse: Moses spoke the words of the song so that all the Israelites could hear, and Joshua helped him. When Moses had finished,
translation_verse: Mosis ka kute kashɛ na be mmalga nɛ e la Ebɔrɛ be keŋini na to n sa basa na n loge

english_verse: he said, “Always remember this song I have taught you today. And let it be a warning that you must teach your children to obey everything written in The Book of God's Law.
translation_verse: nɛ e kaŋɛ le: “Men baa nyiŋi nsaa wora asheŋ nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ menyi kenishipere so kabre ere kasonu nɛnɛ. Men baa kute amo to a sa men be mbia, saŋɛ na so, bumo alɛ gba beeŋ wora kusɔ kama nɛ k wɔ Ebɔrɛ be mbra be kawɔl na to kasonu kashenteŋto.

english_verse: The Law isn't empty words. It can give you a long life in the land that you are going to take.” Moses Will See the Land
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ be mbraana na maŋ la mmalga fuloŋ nna. Amo e naaŋ sa menyi ŋkpa tenteŋ. Amoso, men baa wora amo kasonu nseŋ nya ŋkpa tenteŋ ashi kasawule nɛ k dese Jɔɔdan be lɔr na be kaba ndoŋ nɛ menyee yɔ nɛ men ya kɔ n sɔ n chena so na so.”

english_verse: Later that day the Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Loŋ be kachɛ na gbagba nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ Mosis le:

english_verse: Go up into the Abarim Mountain range here in Moab across the Jordan River valley from Jericho. And when you reach the top of Mount Nebo, you will be able to see the land of Canaan, which I am giving to Israel.
translation_verse: “Yɔ abee nɛ baa tre Abarim nɛ a wɔ Mowabebi be kasawule so nseŋ shoŋi kadegboŋ nɛ baa tre Jɛriko na so n ya dii kebeegboŋ nɛ baa tre Nebo na n yili kumo so n to kenishi ŋ keni kasawule nɛ mee sha keta n sa Israɛlebi na.

english_verse: Then you will die and be buried on the mountaintop, just as your brother Aaron died and was buried on Mount Hor.
translation_verse: Feeŋ wu kebeegboŋ na so nɛ b puli fo kumo so fanɛ kananɛ fo da Ɛɛrɔn wu kebeegboŋ nɛ baa tre Hɔɔ na so nɛ b puli mo kumo so na.

english_verse: Both of you were unfaithful to me at Meribah Spring near Kadesh in the Zin Desert. I am God, but there in front of the Israelites, you did not treat me with the honor and respect I deserve.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, menyi benyɔ na kikɛ daŋ maŋ ji kashenteŋ n sa ma ashi basa na be anishito. Jemanɛ nɛ men daa wɔ Meriba be nchu nɛ k mata kade nɛ baa tre Kadɛsh na ashi kiyi nɛ baa tre Zin so na ase, men daŋ maŋ maŋkura ma ashi basa na be anishito.

english_verse: So I will give the land to the people of Israel, but you will only get to see it from a distance.
translation_verse: Amoso kufɔ nɛ feeŋ yili ŋ keni kasawule nɛ mee ta a sa Israɛl be basa na, ama fo alɛ maaŋ yɔ kumo so.”

english_verse: Moses was a prophet, and before he died, he blessed the tribes of Israel by saying:
translation_verse: Mosis daa la anebi nna, amoso pɔɛŋ nɛ e wu na le nɛ e daŋ nɛfa Israɛl be eyiriana na ŋ kaŋɛ:

english_verse: The Lord came from Mount Sinai. From Edom, he gave light to his people, and his glory was shining from Mount Paran. Thousands of his warriors were with him, and fire was at his right hand.
translation_verse: “Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na daŋ shi Sainai be kebeegboŋ na so nna n nyaŋɛ fanɛ epeŋi n yuu Edɔm be kasawule so nɛ mbe kemaŋkura buu mbe basa so ashi Paran be kebeegboŋ na so. Emalaika ŋgboŋ kudu e daa wɔ mo kutɔ, nɛ edɛ daa suse wuloŋ wuloŋ mbe enɔjiso to.

english_verse: The Lord loves the tribes of Israel, and he protects his people. They listen to his words and worship at his feet. *
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee sha mbe basa nna, nsaa kuŋ bekama nɛ b la mo peya. Amoso anyeeŋ gbir m bunyaŋ mo nseŋ wora kusɔ nɛ e kaŋɛ kenishipere so na kasonu.

english_verse: I called a meeting of the tribes of Israel and gave you God's Law.
translation_verse: Anyeeŋ wora mbra nɛ Mosis ta n sa anyi na kasonu. Anyi be kapetɛgboŋ nɛ anyee sha ga nna na.

english_verse: The Lord will listen to you, tribe of Judah, as you beg to come safely home. You fought your enemies alone; now the Lord will help you.
translation_verse: Le nɛ Mosis kaŋɛ a laŋɛ Juda be yiri be kaplɛa so: “Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, nu Juda be yiri to ebi be kushu, nseŋ bɛta bumo nɛ eyiriana na kikɛ m ba abar so. Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, kɔ n sa bumo, chɛ bumo to ŋ kɔ bumo doŋana.”

english_verse: Protecting Israel's agreement with the Lord was more important to you than the life of your father or mother, or brothers or sisters, or your own children.
translation_verse: Fo nɛ baa nu a sa a chɔ bumo kurgepoana nɛ bumo niopibiana nɛ bumo be mbia. Kusɔ nɛ fo kaŋɛ kenishipere so na nɛ baa wora kasonu, nsaa ji kashenteŋ a sa fo kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre na.

english_verse: You teach God's laws to Israel, and at the place of worship you offer sacrifices and burn incense.
translation_verse: Bumo e naaŋ ŋini fo basa fo mbra nɛ b bɛ amo so. Bumo alɛ e naaŋ baa lara esarga fo bɔrɛsure so.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will bless everything you do, and make you strong enough to crush your enemies.
translation_verse: Amoso Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, chɛ bumo to nɛ b nya eleŋ. Shin nɛ b baa wora fo aparsheŋ. Fo e naŋ mur bumo doŋana kikɛ nsaa maŋ naŋ shin nɛ b koso kikɛ.”

english_verse: Descendants of Joseph, the Lord will bless you with precious water from deep wells and with dew from the sky.
translation_verse: Le nɛ Mosis kaŋɛ a laŋɛ Efreim nɛ Manase be eyiriana na be kaplɛa so: “Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e nɛfa bumo be nsawule n sa bumo bɔrɛchu lela, n shin nɛ kasawule na e baa kɔ kayul.

english_verse: You will have a rich harvest from the slopes of the ancient hills.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ e shin nɛ b baa dɔ nsaa teŋi nɛnɛ ashi bumo be abee nɛ a wɔtɔ dra dra kikɛ na ase.

english_verse: The sea will make you wealthy, and from the sandy beach you will get treasure. So invite the other tribes to celebrate with you and offer sacrifices to God.
translation_verse: Baa tre befɔ nna a ba bumo be abee so m baa kaa lara esarga nɛ a daga ashi amo so. Teku so nɛ baa bɔla a nya bumo be kedama; baa bɔla teku ase be eshishɛr so gba a dii dama.”

english_verse: Tribe of Gad, the Lord will bless you with more land. So shout his praises! Your tribe is like a lion ripping up its victim.
translation_verse: Le nɛ Mosis daŋ kaŋɛ a laŋɛ Gad be yiri be kaplɛa so: “Kemaŋkura e baa la Ebɔrɛ nɛ e kpalga bumo be kasawule to na peya. Gad bre wɔtɔ nna fanɛ buluŋ a jo, nɛ e kpa keba ŋko n fɔlge kumu be kawɔl.

english_verse: Your leaders met together and chose the best land for your tribe, but you obeyed the Lord and helped the other tribes.
translation_verse: Bumo ere ta kasawule na be alela akpa nna n sa bumo be amu; ejuŋkparpo be kachige nɛ b ta n sa bumo. B daŋ wora Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be mbraana kasonu jemanɛ nɛ Israɛl be bejuŋkparpoana daŋ gama abar so na.”

english_verse: The Lord is pleased with you, people of Naphtali. He will bless you and give you the land to the west and the south.
translation_verse: A laŋɛ Naftali be yiri be kaplɛa so le nɛ Mosis daŋ kaŋɛ: “Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be kuwɔrwu so, nɛ e nɛfa Naftali ga. Bumo be kasawule yili Galili be kepa na nna n ya fo kelargato be kaseto nna.”

english_verse: The Lord's greatest blessing is for you, tribe of Asher. You will be the favorite of all the other tribes. You will be rich with olive oil
translation_verse: A laŋɛ Asha be yiri be kaplɛa so, le nɛ Mosis daŋ kaŋɛ: “Asha nya nɛfa a chɔ eyiriana nɛ a ka na. Ebɔrɛ e shin nɛ mo niopibiana bee sha mo ga, nseŋ shin nɛ mbe kasawule so kɔ ɔlifs be ndibi damta.

english_verse: and have strong town gates with bronze and iron bolts. Your people will be powerful for as long as they live.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ e shin nɛ bumo be mbunagboŋ e baa la abɛlso a kuŋ bumo be ndeana jemanɛ kikɛ.

english_verse: Israel, no other god is like ours— the clouds are his chariot as he rides across the skies to come and help us.
translation_verse: Israɛl be basa, Ebɔrɛ kikɛ maŋ naa wɔtɔ fanɛ menyi be Ebɔrɛ na. Mo e naa lara mbe kemaŋkura a ŋini kuwɔlpa so, nsaa bɔla bɔrɛwɔlpa to a ba menyi be kechɛto to na.

english_verse: The eternal God is our hiding place; he carries us in his arms. When God tells you to destroy your enemies, he will make them run.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ nɛ e wɔtɔ mbaanaayɔ na e la menyi be ekumpo. Mo e kɔ menyi mbe enɔana to na. Mo koŋwule na e naa ju men doŋana ashi menyi so na. Mo e naa malga nɛ menyee mur men doŋana na.

english_verse: Israel, you will live in safety; your enemies will be gone. The dew will fall from the sky, and you will have plenty of grain and wine.
translation_verse: Amoso kayurwushi to nɛ Jeekɔb be kaman to ebi kikɛ wɔ. B maa ŋana shɛŋ ashi kasawule nɛ k kɔ ayu nɛ yabra ga na so; kakpa nɛ bunyaŋ gba bee wushi kasawule na.

english_verse: The Lord has rescued you and given you more blessings than any other nation. He protects you like a shield and is your majestic sword. Your enemies will bow in fear, and you will trample on their backs.
translation_verse: Israɛlebi, men be ŋgbene fuli pasaa! Ekama maŋ wɔtɔ e du fanɛ menyi. Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na mɔlga menyi be efuli nna. Mo gbagba e naa kuŋ menyi nsaa kɔ a sa menyi. Mo koŋwule na e naa chɛ menyi to a shin nɛ menyee kɔ a pɔɔ so. Men doŋana beeŋ ba gbir ŋ kule fanɛ men wu bumo kuwɔr, nɛ men chichi bumo so m mata kasawule.”

english_verse: Sometime later, Moses left the lowlands of Moab. He went up Mount Pisgah to the peak of Mount Nebo, which is across the Jordan River from Jericho. The Lord showed him all the land as far north as Gilead and the town of Dan.
translation_verse: Ade kikɛ be kaman nɛ Mosis shi Mowab be kasawule so n dii n yɔ kebeegboŋ nɛ baa tre Pisga nɛ k wɔ kade nɛ baa tre Jɛriko na be epeŋilarkpa be kaba so na be awɔlto nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ŋini mo kananɛ Giliad be yiri be kasawule dese n ya fo Dan be yiri be kasawule kikɛ ashi kelargato be esoso be kaba so.

english_verse: He let Moses see the territories that would soon belong to the tribes of Naphtali, Ephraim, Manasseh, and Judah, as far west as the Mediterranean Sea.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ e naŋ ŋini Mosis Naftali be yiri be kasawule nɛ Efreim nɛ Manase be eyiriana be nsawule nɛ Juda be yiri be kasawule n ya fo Teku nɛ baa tre Mɛditerenia na ashi epeŋitɔrkpa be kaba so.

english_verse: The Lord also showed him the land in the south, from the valley near the town of Jericho, known as The City of Palm Trees, down to the town of Zoar.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na daŋ naŋ ŋini mo kasawule nɛ k dese ketaŋɛ nɛ baa tre Abii be Ndibi be Kadegboŋ, nɛ k mata Jɛriko n dese n ya fo kade nɛ baa tre Zowa na ashi kelargato be kaseto be kaba so na.

english_verse: The Lord said, “Moses, this is the land I was talking about when I solemnly promised Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob that I would give land to their descendants. I have let you see it, but you will not cross the Jordan and go in.”
translation_verse: Ade be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ Mosis le: “Kasawule nɛ n nase kumo be kɔnɔ n sa Eebraham nɛ Aizek nɛ Jeekɔb fanɛ meeŋ ta n sa bumo be kaman to ebi na nna na. N shin nɛ fo wu kumo, ama fo alɛ maaŋ yɔ ndoŋ.”

english_verse: And so, Moses the Lord's servant died there in Moab, just as the Lord had said.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be kayɛrbi, Mosis, wu ashi Mowab be kasawule so ndoŋ fanɛ kananɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ na.

english_verse: The Lord buried him in a valley near the town of Beth-Peor, but even today no one knows exactly where.
translation_verse: Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na puli Mosis m mata kade nɛ baa tre Bɛf Piyɔɔ na, ashi Mowabebi be kasawule so. Ama hale nɛ mbre, esa kikɛ maŋ nyi kakpa nɛ Mosis be nchaŋ dese.

english_verse: The people of Israel stayed in the lowlands of Moab, where they mourned and grieved
translation_verse: Nchɛ adesa nɛ Israɛl be basa daŋ shu Mosis be keeli bumo be daŋkare be ekpa so ashi Mowab be kasawule so.

english_verse: Before Moses died, he had placed his hands on Joshua, and the Lord had given Joshua wisdom. The Israelites paid attention to what Joshua said and obeyed the commands that the Lord had given Moses. Moses Was a Great Prophet
translation_verse: Pɔɛŋ nɛ Mosis wu na, e daŋ lara Nun pibinyɛn, Joshuwa nna nɛ e sɔ mo ere Mosis so a juŋkpar basa na. Mosis daŋ ta mbe enɔana n deŋi Joshuwa so nna ŋ kule Ebɔrɛ n sa mo, nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na sa mo kanyiasheŋ ga. Israɛl be basa na malɛ daŋ wora Joshuwa kasonu nna nseŋ daa bɛ mbraana nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bɔla Mosis so n ta n sa bumo na so.

english_verse: There has never again been a prophet in Israel like Moses. The Lord spoke face to face with him
translation_verse: Anebi kikɛ maŋ naŋ lar Israɛl be efuli so a du fanɛ Mosis. Mo nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na daa malga, baa wu abar nna.

english_verse: No one else has ever had the power to do such great things as Moses did for everyone to see.
translation_verse: Anebi kikɛ malɛ maŋ naŋ wora asheŋgboŋ nɛ a bee keta kufu n fo amo nɛ Mosis wora ashi Israɛlebi na be anishito so.

english_verse: Moses, the Lord's servant, was dead. So the Lord spoke to Joshua son of Nun, who had been the assistant of Moses. The Lord said:
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be kayɛrbi Mosis ka wu be kaman, nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ Nun pibi Joshuwa nɛ b daa bela mo ase nɛ e sɔ Mosis so na le:

english_verse: My servant Moses is dead. Now you must lead Israel across the Jordan River into the land I'm giving to all of you.
translation_verse: “Naniere ma kayɛrbi Mosis wu, amoso fo nɛ Israɛlebi ere kikɛ e koso n dii Jɔɔdan be lɔr na n yɔ kasawule nɛ ŋ kɔ a sa bumo na so.

english_verse: It will reach from the Southern Desert to the Lebanon Mountains in the north, and to the northeast as far as the great Euphrates River. It will include the land of the Hittites, and the land from here at the Jordan River to the Mediterranean Sea on the west.
translation_verse: Menyi be kasawule beeŋ fara kelargato be kaseto be keshishɛrsawule na ase n ya fo Lebanɔn be abee so ashi kelargato be esoso, nɛ lɔrgboŋ nɛ baa tre Yufreetes na ashi epeŋilarkpa nseŋ bɔla Hitebi be efuli so n ya fo teku nɛ baa tre Mɛditerenia na ashi epeŋitɔrkpa.

english_verse: Joshua, I will always be with you and help you as I helped Moses, and no one will ever be able to defeat you.
translation_verse: Esa kama malɛ maaŋ tiŋ m pɔɔ fo so fo kebaawɔtɔ to kikɛ. Kananɛ n daa wɔ Mosis be kaman na, loŋ nɛ meeŋ baa wɔ fo alɛ gba be kaman. M maaŋ yige fo ŋko ŋ kplaŋ fo so kikɛ.

english_verse: Long ago I promised the ancestors of Israel that I would give this land to their descendants. So be strong and brave! Be careful to do everything my servant Moses taught you. Never stop reading The Book of the Law he gave you. Day and night you must think about what it says. If you obey it completely, you and Israel will be able to take this land.
translation_verse: Sa maŋ yige kebaamalga mbra be kawɔl ere be asheŋ. Baa koya kumo kapa nɛ kanyɛ kikɛ. Fo alɛ nsaa de so a bɛ kusɔ nɛ mbra na bee ŋini na kikɛ so. Saŋɛ na so feeŋ nya nɛfa nɛ fo asheŋ malɛ e baa nyalɛ a sa fo.

english_verse: I've commanded you to be strong and brave. Don't ever be afraid or discouraged! I am the Lord your God, and I will be there to help you wherever you go. The Eastern Tribes Promise To Help
translation_verse: Nyiŋi fanɛ n teŋ kaŋɛ fo fanɛ fo baa leŋ fo kumu to nsaa kɔ kagbene. Sa maŋ shin nɛ kufu e pɛ fo nɛ fo pɔ aba, ŋkpal manɛ so, kaplɛkama nɛ fo wɔ, ma, Enyɛnpe fo Ebɔrɛ na wɔ fo kaman.” Joshuwa ka malga n sa basa na be asheŋ

english_verse: to go through the camp and tell everyone: In a few days we will cross the Jordan River to take the land that the Lord our God is giving us. So prepare as much food as you'll need for the march into the land.
translation_verse: “Men nite keeyi na to ŋ kaŋɛ men be basa kikɛ fanɛ b bela ase n ta bumo be ajibi nɛ nchu, ŋkpal manɛ so nchɛ asa be kefɛato menyeeŋ dii Jɔɔdan be lɔr na n ya sɔ kasawule nɛ Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na kɔ a sa menyi na so.”

english_verse: Joshua told the men of the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh:
translation_verse: Ama Ruben nɛ Gad be yiri to ebi nɛ Manase be yiri to ebi be bargato na bre, le nɛ Joshuwa daŋ kaŋɛ bumo:

english_verse: conquer the land that the Lord is giving them. The Lord will give peace to them as he has given peace to you, and then you can come back and settle here in the land that Moses promised you.
translation_verse: n ya fo saŋkama nɛ Enyɛnpe na beeŋ sa bumo alɛ gba ewushi fanɛ kananɛ e sa menyi na. Kumo be kaman pɔɛŋ nɛ men bɛta n ya chena men be kasawule nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be kayɛrbi Mosis ta n sa menyi ashi Jɔɔdan be lɔr na be epeŋilarkpa na.”

english_verse: The men answered: We'll cross the Jordan River and help our relatives. We'll fight anywhere you send us.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ b shuli so ŋ kaŋɛ Joshuwa le: “Asɔ kama nɛ fo kaŋɛ anyi, anyeeŋ wora. Nɛ fo naŋ shuŋi anyi kaboŋ kama gba nna, anyeeŋ yɔ.

english_verse: If the Lord our God will help you as he helped Moses, and if you are strong and brave, we will obey you as we obeyed Moses. We'll even put to death anyone who rebels against you or refuses to obey you.
translation_verse: Ekama nɛ e kini kebɛ fo mmalga nɛ kusɔ kama nɛ fo kaŋɛ so, daga luwu nna. Kusɔ nɛ k wɔtɔ e la fanɛ baa leŋ fo kumu to nsaa kɔ kagbene.”

english_verse: Joshua chose two men as spies and sent them from their camp at Acacia with these instructions: “Go across the river and find out as much as you can about the whole region, especially about the town of Jericho.” The two spies left the Israelite camp at Acacia and went to Jericho, where they decided to spend the night at the house of a prostitute named Rahab.
translation_verse: Saŋɛ nɛ Israɛlebi na be keeyi to daa wɔ Shitim na nɛ Nun pibi Joshuwa shuŋi basa anyɔ fanɛ b dii Jɔɔdan be lɔr na be kaba ndoŋ n ya ŋana n dara Keenan be kasawule na, fɔnfɔŋ Jɛriko. Basa na ka fo Jɛriko be kade to nɛ b ya luri sakaleche ko nɛ baa tre Reehab be laŋ to.

english_verse: But someone found out about them and told the king of Jericho, “Some Israelite men came here tonight, and they are spies.”
translation_verse: Nɛ Jɛriko be ewura nu fanɛ Israɛlebi ko ba ndoŋ nɛ b ba ŋana n dara bumo be kasawule.

english_verse: Rahab went back up to her roof. The spies were still awake, so she told them:
translation_verse: Pɔɛŋ nɛ kanyɛ e biri nɛ befɔ na e dese na nɛ Reehab dii kuchoŋi na so ŋ kaŋɛ bumo le:

english_verse: We heard how the Lord dried up the Red Sea so you could leave Egypt. And we heard how you destroyed Sihon and Og, those two Amorite kings east of the Jordan River.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, an nu kananɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na shin nɛ teku peper na wɔlto saŋɛ nɛ men lar ljipt be efuli so a ba na, nɛ kananɛ men kɔ Sihɔn nɛ Ɔg nɛ b daa ji kuwura Amɔriebi be kasawule nɛ k wɔ Jɔɔdan be epeŋilarkpa na kena m mur bumo nɛ bumo be asɔ kikɛ na be asheŋ.

english_verse: We know that the Lord your God rules heaven and earth, and we've lost our courage and our will to fight.
translation_verse: An ka nu loŋ nɛ anyi be ŋgbene jija anyi ga nɛ ekama malɛ gba be aba pɔ mo ŋkpal menyi so. Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na e naa ji kuwura esoso nɛ kasawule so kikɛ.

english_verse: Please promise me in the Lord's name that you will be as kind to my family as I have been to you. Do something to show
translation_verse: Amoso men jande, men nase kɔnɔ n sa ma nseŋ bɔ ntaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be ketre to fanɛ menyeeŋ wora ma nɛ ma kanaŋ kikɛ kelela, ŋkpal ŋ ka wora menyi kelela so.

english_verse: that you won't let your people kill my father and mother and my brothers and sisters and their families.
translation_verse: Men nase kɔnɔ fanɛ menyi maaŋ wora n tuto nɛ n nio nɛ n siponyɛnana nɛ n sipocheana nɛ bumo be basa kikɛ shɛŋ nsaa beeŋ mɔlga anyi ashi luwu to.”

english_verse: “Rahab,” the spies answered, “if you keep quiet about what we're doing, we promise to be kind to you when the Lord gives us this land. We pray that the Lord will kill us if we don't keep our promise!”
translation_verse: Nɛ basa na yɛ: “Nɛ an baŋ maŋ wora kusɔ nɛ anyee shin nɛ an kaŋɛ fo ere, Ebɔrɛ e mɔ anyi. An nase kɔnɔ fanɛ nɛ fo baŋ maŋ kaŋɛ basa kusɔ nɛ anyee wora ere bre, kumo ere nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na baŋ ta kasawule ere n sa anyi bre, anyeeŋ wora menyi kelela.”

english_verse: Rahab's house was built into the town wall, and one of the windows in her house faced outside the wall. She gave the spies a rope, showed them the window, and said, “Use this rope to let yourselves down to the ground outside the wall.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Reehab ta efɔl n chɛ n chulgi mbe tokuro to nɛ basa na bɔla kumo so ŋ gbelge to, ŋkpal manɛ so mbe ebu daa yil egbal nɛ b pɔr ŋ kulti kade na so nna.

english_verse: Then hide in the hills. The men who are looking for you won't be able to find you there. They'll give up and come back after a few days, and you can be on your way.”
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ e kaŋɛ bumo le: “Men ya ŋana abee to, saŋɛ na so basa nɛ baa fin menyi na maaŋ wu menyi. Men ba wɔ abee na to n ya fo nchɛ nsa. B kaŋ fin menyi ŋ gben nseŋ bɛta m ba na pɔɛŋ nɛ men baa yɔ kakpa nɛ menyee yɔ.”

english_verse: “I'll do exactly what you said,” Rahab promised. Then she sent them on their way and tied the red rope to the window.
translation_verse: Nɛ Reehab kaŋɛ: “Mm, n shuli. Kanaŋ kama nɛ men baŋ yili kumo, k ba du loŋ.” Ndoŋ nna nɛ e shin nɛ basa na yɔ nɛ e ta efɔl peper n chɛ mbe tokuro.

english_verse: The spies hid in the hills for three days while the king's soldiers looked for them along the roads. As soon as the soldiers gave up and returned to Jericho,
translation_verse: Nɛ basa nɛ b ba nɛ b ba ŋana n dara efuli na lar n ya ŋana abee na to nchɛ asa nɛ basa nɛ baa fin bumo na fin bumo ŋ gben nseŋ bɛta n yɔ Jɛriko.

english_verse: the two spies went down into the Jordan valley and crossed the river. They reported to Joshua and told him everything that had happened.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ basa anyɔ nɛ b ba nɛ b ba ŋana n dara efuli na malɛ lar abee na to n ya yuu Jɔɔdan be lɔr na to n dii n ya kaŋɛ Nun pibi Joshuwa kusɔ kama nɛ k wora.

english_verse: “We're sure the Lord has given us the whole country,” they said. “The people there shake with fear every time they think of us.”
translation_verse: Le nɛ b kaŋɛ Joshuwa: “Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ta bumo be kasawule na kikɛ m bɔɔ anyi enɔ. Kufu daŋ pɛ basa na ga nna ŋkpal anyi so.”

english_verse: Early the next morning, Joshua and the Israelites packed up and left Acacia. They went to the Jordan River and camped there that night.
translation_verse: Kare ka chɛ kachipurdidi nɛ Israɛlebi na kikɛ lar Shitim be keeyi to n yɔ Jɔɔdan be lɔr na ase n ya wora bumo be keeyi to ndoŋ pɔɛŋ nseŋ dii lɔr na.

english_verse: shouting, “When you see some of the priests carrying the sacred chest, you'll know it is time to cross to the other side. You've never been there before, and you won't know the way, unless you follow the chest. But don't get too close! Stay about a kilometer back.”
translation_verse: Loŋ nɛ menyeeŋ pin ekpa na m bɔla so nɛnɛ, ŋkpal manɛ so, menyi maŋ naŋ bɔla ekpa ere ŋ ku so kikɛ. Ama men sa maa nite a taga Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be ŋkre be deka na to. Men barga kumo fanɛ ayadra ŋgboŋ asa.”

english_verse: Joshua told the people, “Make yourselves acceptable to worship the Lord, because he is going to do some amazing things for us.”
translation_verse: Kede be kaman nɛ Joshuwa kaŋɛ basa na le: “Men lara kulubi kikɛ ashi men be ŋgbene to nsaa du cheembi saŋkama ŋkpal manɛ so Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ ba menyi kutɔ echefo m ba wora emamachisheŋ.”

english_verse: Then Joshua turned to the priests and said, “Take the chest and cross the Jordan River ahead of us.” So the priests picked up the chest by its carrying poles and went on ahead.
translation_verse: Le nɛ Joshuwa daŋ kaŋɛ bɔrɛmatapoana na malɛ: “Men ta Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be ŋkre be deka na n juŋkpar basa na a yɔ.” Nɛ b ta kumo n juŋkpar bumo.

english_verse: The Lord told Joshua, “Beginning today I will show the people that you are their leader, and they will know that I am helping you as I helped Moses.
translation_verse: Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ Joshuwa le: “Kabre meeŋ maŋ fo so ashi Israɛlebi kikɛ be anishito, n shin nɛ b pin fanɛ kananɛ ma nɛ Mosis daa la na, loŋ nɛ ma nɛ fo alɛ gba beeŋ baa la.

english_verse: Now, tell the priests who are carrying the chest to go a little way into the river and stand there.”
translation_verse: Kaŋɛ bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ b sulɔ ŋkre be deka na fanɛ b baŋ fo Jɔɔdan be lɔr na be ekarso, b yuu nchu na to n yɔ anishito n ya yili.”

english_verse: Joshua spoke to the people: Come here and listen to what the Lord our God said he will do!
translation_verse: Nɛ Joshuwa kaŋɛ Israɛlebi na le: “Men shɛr n nu Enyɛnpe men be Ebɔrɛ na be kamalga.

english_verse: The Canaanites, the Hittites, the Hivites, the Perizzites, the Girgashites, the Amorites, and the Jebusites control the land on the other side of the river. But the living God will be with you and will force them out of the land when you attack. And now, God is going to prove that he's powerful enough to force them out.
translation_verse: Kananɛ menyeeŋ pin fanɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ e wɔ ŋkpa to na wɔ menyi kutɔ nde. E beeŋ ju Keenanebi nɛ Hitebi nɛ Hivebi nɛ Pɛrizebi nɛ Gɛgashebi nɛ Amɔriebi nɛ Jebusiebi nɛ b wɔ Jɔɔdan be lɔr be kaba ndoŋ na kikɛ.

english_verse: Just watch the sacred chest that belongs to the Lord, the ruler of the whole earth. As soon as the priests carrying the chest step into the Jordan, the water will stop flowing and pile up as if someone had built a dam across the river. The Lord has also said that each of the twelve tribes should choose one man to represent it.
translation_verse: Saŋɛ na so bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ b sulɔ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ e to durnya kikɛ na be ŋkre be deka na, be aya kaŋ baŋ yuu nchu na to, Jɔɔdan be lɔr na beeŋ ku to nɛ nchu nɛ a shil a ba e laŋɛ ŋ gbargbar n yili kaboŋ koŋwule fanɛ kebee na.”

english_verse: The Israelites packed up and left camp. The priests carrying the chest walked in front,
translation_verse: Basa na ka lar bumo be keeyi to nɛ b ya dii Jɔɔdan be lɔr na, nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana na sulɔ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be ŋkre be deka na n juŋkpar bumo.

english_verse: until they came to the Jordan River. The water in the river had risen over its banks, as it often does in springtime. But as soon as the feet of the priests touched the water,
translation_verse: Kasɔteŋi be jemanɛ e daa la nɛ Jɔɔdan be lɔr na bɔlɔ n to chuful. Ama bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ b sulɔ ŋkre be deka na be aya ka baŋ chichi nchu na to,

english_verse: the river stopped flowing, and the water started piling up at the town of Adam near Zarethan. No water flowed toward the Dead Sea, and the priests stood in the middle of the dry riverbed near Jericho while everyone else crossed over.
translation_verse: Bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ b sulɔ ŋkre be deka na daŋ yili kakpa wɔlso nna ashi Jɔɔdan be lɔr na be nferinto hale nɛ Israɛlebi na kikɛ nite kasawule wɔlso so n dii lɔr na n yɔ kumo be kaba ndoŋ.

english_verse: After Israel had crossed the Jordan, the Lord said to Joshua:
translation_verse: Israɛlebi na ka dii Jɔɔdan be lɔr na n loge nɛ Enyɛnpe kaŋɛ Joshuwa le:

english_verse: Tell one man from each of the twelve tribes to pick up a large rock from where the priests are standing. Then tell the men to set up those rocks as a monument at the place where you camp tonight.
translation_verse: e ta kejembu ashi Jɔɔdan be lɔr na be nferinto be kakpa nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana na yil na, ŋ keta amo n ya fo kaplɛkama nɛ kanyɛ beeŋ biri nɛ men dese na, nseŋ ta amo n nase ndoŋ.”

english_verse: Joshua chose twelve men; then he called them together
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Joshuwa tre Israɛl be basa kuduanyɔ nɛ b lara ashi kanaŋ kikɛ to na

english_verse: and said: Go to the middle of the riverbed where the sacred chest is, and pick up a large rock. Carry it on your shoulder to our camp. There are twelve of you, so there will be one rock for each tribe.
translation_verse: ŋ kaŋɛ bumo le: “Men be ekama e yɔ men Nyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be ŋkre be deka na ase ashi Jɔɔdan be lɔr na be nferinto n ya ta kejembu n deŋi mbe kebatemu so n yili katelamu n sa mbe kanaŋ ashi Israɛl be nnaŋ kuduanyɔ na to.

english_verse: Someday your children will ask, “Why are these rocks here?” Then you can tell them how the water stopped flowing when the chest was being carried across the river. These rocks will always remind our people of what happened here today.
translation_verse: nɛ men kaŋɛ bumo fanɛ Enyɛnpe be ŋkre be deka na ka daŋ bɔla Jɔɔdan be lɔr na to na nɛ k ku to anyɔ. Ajembu ere e la shɛda a nyiŋi anyi kusɔ nɛ k wora nfe ere mbaanaayɔ.”

english_verse: The men followed the instructions that the Lord had given Joshua. They picked up twelve rocks, one for each tribe, and carried them to the camp, where they put them down.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ basa na wora kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ Joshuwa na kikɛ nseŋ chala ajembu kuduanyɔ, nɛ a yili a sa Israɛl be nnaŋ kuduanyɔ na n nase bumo be keeyi to.

english_verse: Joshua set up a monument next to the place where the priests were standing. This monument was also made of twelve large rocks, and it is still there in the middle of the river. The People of Israel Set Up Camp at Gilgal
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ Joshuwa shin nɛ basa ko malɛ tise ajembu kuduanyɔ n deŋi abar so kakpa nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ b sulɔ Enyɛnpe be ŋkre be deka na yil na. Loŋ be ajembu na kraa dese ndoŋ hale kabre.

english_verse: It was the tenth day of the first month of the year when Israel crossed the Jordan River. They set up camp at Gilgal, which was east of the land controlled by Jericho.
translation_verse: Kafɛ to be kufɔl sososo be kachɛ kudusopo nɛ basa na daŋ dii Jɔɔdan be lɔr na n ya wora bumo keeyi ashi kade nɛ baa tre Gilgaal nɛ k wɔ Jɛriko be epeŋilarkpa be kaba so na.

english_verse: The men who had carried the twelve rocks from the Jordan brought them to Joshua, and they made them into a monument.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Joshuwa koli ajembu kuduanyɔ nɛ b tise ashi Jɔɔdan be lɔr na to na n deŋi abar so ashi Gilgaal,

english_verse: Then Joshua told the people: Years from now your children will ask you why these rocks are here.
translation_verse: nseŋ kaŋɛ Israɛlebi na le: “Men nanabiana kaŋ koso kachako so m bishi menyi le be ajembu ere be kifito,

english_verse: Tell them, “The Lord our God dried up the Jordan River so we could walk across. He did the same thing here for us that he did for our people at the Red Sea,
translation_verse: Nseŋ naŋ kaŋɛ bumo fanɛ Enyɛnpe nɛ e la bumo be Ebɔrɛ na, daŋ shin nɛ loŋ wora nna fanɛ kananɛ e daŋ shin nɛ Teku peper na ku to nɛ an daŋ nite kumo to n dii na.

english_verse: because he wants everyone on earth to know how powerful he is. And he wants us to worship only him.”
translation_verse: Ŋkpal le be kusɔ nɛ k wora ere so bomin kikɛ beeŋ pin eleŋ nɛ an Nyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ere kɔ nɛ kumo be loŋ e shin nɛ menyi alɛ e baa bunyaŋ mo saŋkama.”

english_verse: The Amorite kings west of the Jordan River and the Canaanite kings along the Mediterranean Sea lost their courage and their will to fight, when they heard how the Lord had dried up the Jordan River to let Israel go across. Israel Gets Ready To Celebrate Passover
translation_verse: Amɔriebi be bewura nɛ b wɔ Jɔɔdan be epeŋitɔrkpa na nɛ Keenan be bewura nɛ b chena m mata teku nɛ baa tre Mɛditerenia na kikɛ ka nu kananɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ Jɔɔdan be lɔr na ku to nɛ Israɛlebi na nite kumo to n dii na nɛ bumo ŋgbene fara a ku nɛ baa ŋana ketu Israɛlebi na ŋ kɔ.

english_verse: While Israel was camped at Gilgal, the Lord said, “Joshua, make some flint knives and circumcise the rest of the Israelite men and boys.”
translation_verse: Jemanɛ nɛ Israɛlebi na daa wɔ Gilgaal na nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ Joshuwa le: “Shil ajembu pɛlpɛlbi ŋ ku Israɛlebi na atutu.”

english_verse: On the seventh day, the army got up at daybreak. They marched slowly around Jericho the same as they had done for the past six days, except on this day they went around seven times.

english_verse: The people of Gibeon had also heard what Joshua had done to Jericho and Ai.
translation_verse: Ama Gibiɔnebi na ka nu kusɔ nɛ Joshuwa wora Jɛriko nɛ Ai na,

english_verse: So they decided that some of their men should pretend to be messengers to Israel from a faraway country. The men put worn-out bags on their donkeys and found some old wineskins that had cracked and had been sewn back together.
translation_verse: nɛ b kre fanɛ baaŋ fule mo. Ndoŋ nna nɛ b ya fin ajibi n wɔtɔ ebɔtɛ kpɛatoso to ŋ kre n deŋi ekurma so nseŋ ta nsaturbi nɛ a bure nɛ b baa amo n ti so.

english_verse: Their sandals were old and patched, and their clothes were worn out. They even took along some dry and crumbly bread.
translation_verse: B daŋ ta asɔbuuso kpɛatoso nna m buu nseŋ ta asɛbta wuso nɛ b tɛ amo n wɔtɔ. Bumo be bodobodo gba daŋ wɔlso nna nseŋ puu.

english_verse: Then they went to the Israelite camp at Gilgal, where they said to Joshua and the men of Israel, “We have come from a country that is far from here. Please make a peace treaty with us.”
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ b yɔ Israɛlebi na be keeyi to ashi Gilgaal n ya kaŋɛ Joshuwa le: “Kade wɔfɔ nɛ an shi, amoso anyee sha fanɛ anyi nɛ menyi e wora kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre nna.”

english_verse: The Israelites replied, “But maybe you really live near us. We can't make a peace treaty with you if you live nearby.” The Gibeonites said, “If you make a peace treaty with us, we will be your servants.” “Who are you?” Joshua asked. “Where do you come from?” They answered:
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ b kaŋɛ Joshuwa le: “An la fo nyɛrbi nna.” Nɛ Joshuwa malɛ bishi bumo: “Basa mo e la menyi? Nnɛ nɛ men shi?”

english_verse: We are your servants, and we live far from here. We came because the Lord your God is so famous. We heard what the Lord did in Egypt
translation_verse: Nɛ b kaŋɛ le: “An shi efuli wɔfɔ nna nseŋ nu Enyɛnpe, menyi be Ebɔrɛ na be asheŋ. An nu kusɔ kama nɛ e wora n sa menyi ashi Ijipt be kasawule so,

english_verse: and what he did to those two Amorite kings on the other side of the Jordan: King Og of Bashan, who lived in Ashtaroth, and King Sihon of Heshbon.
translation_verse: nɛ kusɔ nɛ e wora Amɔriebi be bewura anyɔ na ashi Jɔɔdan be lɔr na be epeŋilarkpa be kaba so na be asheŋ. Bewura na e la ewura Sihɔn nɛ e chena Hishbɔn n ji kuwura na nɛ ewura Ɔg nɛ e la Bashan be ewura nseŋ chena Ashterɔf na.

english_verse: Our leaders and everyone who lives in our country told us to meet with you and tell you that all of us are your servants. They said to ask you to make a peace treaty with our people. They told us to be sure and take along enough food for our journey.
translation_verse: Anyi be bejuŋkparpoana nɛ basa nɛ b wɔ anyi be kasawule so na kikɛ kaŋɛ anyi fanɛ an fin anyi be enite to be ajibi m ba menyi kutɔ m ba ta anyi be amu ŋ ki men be nyɛrbi. B yɛ: ‘Men shin nɛ anyi nɛ menyi e wora kɔnɔkoŋwule.’

english_verse: See this dry, crumbly bread of ours? It was hot out of the oven when we packed the food on the day we left our homes.
translation_verse: Men keni anyi be bodobodo. An ka lar epe a ba menyi kutɔ na nɛ a kra walɛ nna ama naniere amo e wɔlso nseŋ puu na.

english_verse: These cracked wineskins were new when we filled them, and our clothes and sandals are worn out because we have traveled so far.
translation_verse: Nsaturbi ere daa la apopɔr nna, ama naniere men keni kananɛ a ki adra. Anyi be asɔbuuso nɛ asɛbta gba kpɛa to nna ŋkpal an ka nite ekpa tenteŋ so.”

english_verse: The Israelites tried some of the food, but they did not ask the Lord if he wanted them to make a treaty.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Israɛlebi na sɔ bumo be ajibi na be ako n ji ŋ keni, ama b daŋ maŋ bishi Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kusɔ nɛ k daga fanɛ b wora pɔɛŋ.

english_verse: So Joshua made a peace treaty with the messengers and promised that Israel would not kill their people. Israel's leaders swore that Israel would keep this promise.
translation_verse: Nɛ Joshuwa nɛ Gibiɔn be basa na wora kagbenewushi be kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre nseŋ nase nnɔ n sa abar fanɛ Israɛlebi maaŋ mɔ bumo. Nɛ Israɛlebi be bejuŋkparpoana na shuli so fanɛ baaŋ bɛ kɔnɔ naseso na so.

english_verse: A couple of days later, the Israelites found out that these people actually lived in the nearby towns of Gibeon, Chephirah, Beeroth, and Kiriath-Jearim. So the Israelites left the place where they had camped and arrived at the four towns two days later.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ Israɛlebi na lar n ta nchɛ asa n ya fo basa na be nde to. Bumo be nde na e la: Gibiɔn nɛ Chefira nɛ Bɛɛrɔf nɛ Kiriaf Jearim.

english_verse: But they did not attack the towns, because the Israelite leaders had sworn in the name of the Lord that they would let these people live. The Israelites complained about their leaders' decision not to attack,
translation_verse: Ama Israɛlebi na daa maŋ kɔ bumo, ŋkpal manɛ so, bumo be bejuŋkparpoana na daŋ nase kɔnɔ kpakpaso nna n sa bumo ashi Enyɛnpe nɛ Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na be anishito. Ndoŋ nna nɛ Israɛlebi na kikɛ fubel n sa bumo be bejuŋkparpoana na.

english_verse: but the leaders reminded them, “We promised these people in the name of the Lord God of Israel that we would let them live, so we must not harm them. If we break our promise, God will punish us. We'll let them live, but we'll make them cut wood and carry water for our people.”
translation_verse: Kede be kaman nɛ bejuŋkparpoana na naŋ kaŋɛ le: “An sa maŋ mɔ bumo, ama an shin nɛ b baa ku ndibi nsaa saŋ nchu a sa anyi.”

english_verse: Joshua told some of his soldiers, “I want to meet with the Gibeonite leaders. Bring them here.” When the Gibeonites came, Joshua said, “You live close to us. Why did you lie by claiming you lived far away?
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ Joshuwa shin nɛ b bar Gibiɔn be benimu na mo kutɔ, nɛ e bishi bumo le: “Manɛ nna nɛ men fule anyi fanɛ men shi kufɔ nna, nɛ menyi alɛ chena m mata anyi?

english_verse: So now you are under a curse, and from now on your people will have to send workers to cut wood and carry water for the place of worship.”
translation_verse: Ŋkpal men ka wora le so, Ebɔrɛ be kɔnɔsho pɛ menyi. Menyi be basa beeŋ ki anya a kuya ndibi nsaa saŋ nchu a yɔ an be Ebɔrɛ be lambu to saŋkama.”

english_verse: The Gibeonites answered, “The Lord your God told his servant Moses that you were to kill everyone who lives here and take their land for yourselves. We were afraid you would kill us, and so we tricked you into making a peace treaty. But we agreed to be your servants,
translation_verse: Nɛ Gibiɔnebi na malɛ kaŋɛ Joshuwa le: “Fo nyɛrbi nu kananɛ Enyɛnpe, menyi be Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ mbe kayɛrbi Mosis fanɛ e ta kasawule na kikɛ n sa menyi nɛ men mɔ basa kama nɛ b tase kumo so na kikɛ. Kumo be kufu e daŋ pɛ anyi so nɛ an fule menyi na.

english_verse: and you are strong enough to do anything to us that you want. We just ask you to do what seems right.”
translation_verse: Naniere bre an wɔ menyi be enɔ to nna na, amoso menyeeŋ tiŋ n wora anyi kusɔ kama nɛ menyee fɛ fanɛ k walɛ n sa menyi.”

english_verse: Joshua did not let the Israelites kill the Gibeonites,
translation_verse: Amoso Joshuwa daŋ mɔlga bumo nna nsaa maŋ shin nɛ Israɛlebi na mɔ bumo.

english_verse: but he did tell the Gibeonites that they would have to be servants of the nation of Israel. They would have to cut firewood and bring it for the priests to use for burning sacrifices on the Lord's altar, wherever the Lord decided the altar would be. The Gibeonites would also have to carry water for the priests. And that is still the work of the Gibeonites.
translation_verse: Ama e daŋ ta Gibiɔnebi na ŋ ki anya nna nɛ baa kuya ndibi nsaa saŋ nchu a sa Israɛlebi na nɛ Enyɛnpe be bɔrɛsure na ekpa be beshumpo. Loŋ be kushuŋ nɛ b kraa wɔtɔ a shuŋ hale kabre ashi kaplɛkama nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ŋini fanɛ b baa shuŋ mo na.

english_verse: King Adonizedek of Jerusalem heard that Joshua had captured and destroyed the town of Ai, and then killed its king as he had done at Jericho. He also learned that the Gibeonites had signed a peace treaty with Israel.
translation_verse: Adonizɛdɛk nɛ e daa la Jerusalɛm be ewura na daŋ nu fanɛ Joshuwa pɔɔ Ai so m mur kumo kikɛ nseŋ mɔ bumo be ewura fanɛ kananɛ e daŋ wora Jɛriko nɛ kumo be ewura na, nseŋ naŋ nu gba fanɛ Gibiɔnebi na yɔ Israɛlebi kutɔ nɛ bumo nɛ bumo ya wora kagbenewushi be kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre, hale nɛ b chena Israɛlebi na to.

english_verse: This frightened Adonizedek and his people. They knew that Gibeon was a large town, as big as the towns that had kings, and even bigger than the town of Ai had been. And all of the men of Gibeon were warriors.
translation_verse: Nɛ kumo be loŋ shin nɛ kufu pɛ Jerusalɛmebi na ga, ŋkpal manɛ so, Gibiɔn gba daa la kadegboŋ nna fanɛ nde nɛ a kɔ bewura na. K daa shi a chɔ Ai nɛ kumo be basa malɛ daa la benapo lempo ga.

english_verse: So Adonizedek sent messages to the kings of four other towns: King Hoham of Hebron, King Piram of Jarmuth, King Japhia of Lachish, and King Debir of Eglon. The messages said,
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Adonizɛdɛk kaŋɛ Hohaam nɛ e la Hibrɔn be ewura na, nɛ Piiram nɛ mo alɛ la Jaamɔf be ewura, nɛ Jaafia nɛ e la Lakish be ewura, n ta Debir nɛ e la Iglɔn be ewura le:

english_verse: “The Gibeonites have signed a peace treaty with Joshua and the Israelites. Come and help me attack Gibeon!”
translation_verse: “Men ba chɛ ma to nɛ n ya kɔ Gibiɔn. Ŋkpal manɛ so kumo be basa nɛ Joshuwa nɛ Israɛlebi wora kagbenewushi be kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre.”

english_verse: the Gibeonites sent a message to the Israelite camp at Gilgal: “Joshua, please come and rescue us! The Amorite kings from the hill country have joined together and are attacking us. We are your servants, so don't let us down. Please hurry!”
translation_verse: Kubɔya nɛ Gibiɔnebi na daŋ shuŋi ŋ kaŋɛ Joshuwa ashi Gilgaal be keeyi to e daa la: “Men sa maŋ yige anyi n lɛ. Men ba mɔlga anyi manaŋ! Men ba naniere m ba chɛ anyi to, ŋkpal manɛ so, Amɔriebi be bewura nɛ b shi kebee so be efuli so na kikɛ chɛ abar nna a kɔ anyi kena.”

english_verse: “Joshua,” the Lord said, “don't be afraid of the Amorites. They will run away when you attack, and I will help you defeat them.”
translation_verse: Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ Joshuwa le: “Sa maa ŋana bumo. N teŋ ta bumo m bɔɔ fo enɔ. Bumo be ekama maaŋ tiŋ n tu fo ŋ kɔ.”

english_verse: Joshua marched all night from Gilgal to Gibeon and made a surprise attack on the Amorite camp.
translation_verse: Joshuwa nɛ mbe benapo na daŋ gal edi nna n shi Gilgaal n nite kanyɛ na kikɛ n yɔ Gibiɔn n ya kɔ Amɔriebi na kena purgiso.

english_verse: The Lord made the enemy panic, and the Israelites started killing them right and left. They chased the Amorite troops up the road to Beth-Horon and kept on killing them, until they reached the towns of Azekah and Makkedah.
translation_verse: Amɔriebi na ka wu Israɛl be benapo na nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ keyeŋiyeŋi tɔr bumo so, nɛ Israɛlebi na mɔ bumo ga ashi Gibiɔn, nseŋ ju m buu bumo so m bɔla kebee ase ashi Bɛf Hɔrɔn a mɔ bumo hale n ya fo kelargato be kaseto be kaba so ashi Azeka nɛ Makɛda kikɛ.

english_verse: And while these troops were going down through Beth-Horon Pass, the Lord made huge hailstones fall on them all the way to Azekah. More of the enemy soldiers died from the hail than from the Israelite weapons.
translation_verse: Amɔriebi na ka bɔla kebee na ase ashi Bɛf Hɔrɔn a shile a mɔlga bumo be amu Israɛl be benapo kutɔ na nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ abɔrɛjembu gboŋgboŋi shi awɔlpa to a tɔr bumo so a mɔ hale n ya fo Azeka. Bumo nɛ abɔrɛjembu na daŋ mɔ na daa chɔ bumo nɛ Israɛlebi na gbagba daŋ mɔ.

english_verse: The Lord was helping the Israelites defeat the Amorites that day. So about noon, Joshua prayed to the Lord loud enough for the Israelites to hear: “Our Lord, make the sun stop in the sky over Gibeon, and the moon stand still over Aijalon Valley.” So the sun and the moon stopped and stood still until Israel defeated its enemies. This poem can be found in The Book of Jashar. The sun stood still and didn't go down for about a whole day.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ epeŋi na yili dindiŋ, nɛ kufɔl malɛ kini ketɔr n ya fanɛ Israɛlebi ka pɔɔ bumo doŋana so na. Kumo be loŋ nɛ b sibɛ Jaasha be kawɔl to na fanɛ: “Epeŋi daŋ yili kumu to sirr nna a maŋ tɔr kachɛ lelemu.”

english_verse: Never before and never since has the Lord done anything like that for someone who prayed. The Lord was really fighting for Israel.
translation_verse: Pɔɛŋ nɛ loŋ wora na, nɛ loŋ ka wora na be kaman m ba fo kabre, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ maŋ naŋ wora loŋ n sa dimɛdi kikɛ. Kashenteŋto, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e daa kɔ a sa Israɛlebi na!

english_verse: After the battle, Joshua and the Israelites went back to their camp at Gilgal. Joshua Kills the Five Enemy Kings
translation_verse: Kede be kaman nɛ Joshuwa nɛ Israɛlebi na bɛta n yɔ Gilgaal be keeyi na to. Joshuwa ka mɔ Amɔriebi be bewura anu na be asheŋ

english_verse: While the enemy soldiers were running from the Israelites, the five enemy kings ran away and hid in a cave near Makkedah.
translation_verse: Saŋɛ nɛ b daa kɔ kena na, Amɔriebi be bewura anu na bre daŋ shile nna n ya ŋana Makɛda be kebeelaŋ to.

english_verse: Joshua's soldiers told him, “The five kings have been found in a cave near Makkedah.”
translation_verse: Esa ko e daŋ wu bumo nseŋ kaŋɛ Joshuwa kakpa nɛ b ŋana na,

english_verse: Joshua answered, “Roll some big stones over the mouth of the cave and leave a few soldiers to guard it.
translation_verse: nɛ Joshuwa kaŋɛ: Men gbelti ajembu gboŋgboŋi n ti kebeelaŋ na be kɔnɔ so n shin nɛ basa ko e baa keni kumo so,

english_verse: But you and everyone else must keep going after the enemy troops, because they will be safe if they reach their walled towns. Don't let them get away! The Lord our God is helping us get rid of them.”
translation_verse: ama menyi ere e sa maŋ shir a wɔ ndoŋ. Men bɛ men doŋana na so a kɔ bumo, nɛ b sa maŋ nya ekpa m bɛta n yɔ bumo be nde nɛ b pɔr egbal ŋ kulti na to. Ŋkpal manɛ so Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na shin nɛ men teŋ kɔ m pɔɔ so.

english_verse: The Israelite army returned to their camp at Makkedah, where Joshua was waiting for them. No one around there dared say anything bad about the Israelites.
translation_verse: Israɛl be benapo na bre daŋ bɛta nɛ alenfia nna m ba Joshuwa kutɔ ashi Makɛda be keeyi to. Basa nɛ b wɔ efuli na so na malɛ be ekama daa ŋana kenaŋ m malga kamalga lubi ŋ gbiti Israɛlebi na nna.

english_verse: Joshua told his soldiers, “Now, move the rocks from the entrance to the cave and bring those five kings to me.”
translation_verse: Kede be kaman nɛ Joshuwa kaŋɛ le: “Men ya bugi kebeelaŋ na n lara bewura anu na m bar ma.”

english_verse: The soldiers opened the entrance to the cave and brought out the kings of Jerusalem, Hebron, Jarmuth, Lachish, and Eglon.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ b ya bugi kebeelaŋ na n lara Jerusalɛm nɛ Hibrɔn nɛ Jaamɔf nɛ Lakish nɛ Iglɔn be bewura na

english_verse: After Joshua had called the army together, he forced the five kings to lie down on the ground. Then he called his officers forward and told them, “You fought these kings along with me, so put your feet on their necks.” The officers did this,
translation_verse: n yɛr bumo Joshuwa be anishito. Nɛ e shin nɛ b dese kasawule, nɛ e tre Israɛlebi na kikɛ m ba mo kutɔ nseŋ kaŋɛ benapo be benimu nɛ mo nɛ bumo daŋ yɔ kena na to na fanɛ b chichi bewura na be abɔ so. Nɛ b wora loŋ.
