english_verse: and Joshua continued, “Don't ever be afraid or discouraged. Be brave and strong. This is what the Lord will do to all your enemies.”
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ Joshuwa kaŋɛ benapo be benimuana na le: “Men sa maa lɔ kufu ŋko a pɔ aba. Men leŋ men be amu to nsaa kɔ kagbene, ŋkpal manɛ so le nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ wora men doŋana kikɛ.”

english_verse: he told some of his troops, “Take the bodies down and throw them into the cave where the kings were found. Cover the entrance to the cave with big rocks.” Joshua's troops obeyed his orders, and those rocks are still there. Joshua Continues the Fighting
translation_verse: Epeŋi ka bee tɔr nɛ Joshuwa ponte ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ b shiga bubuni na ndibi na so n ta bumo n ya lɛ kebeelaŋ nɛ b daŋ ŋana to na to, nseŋ gbelti ajembu gboŋgboŋi n ti kumo so. Loŋ be ajembu na kra wɔtɔ hale kabre. Joshuwa ka kɔ m pɔɔ Ammɔn be efuliana so be asheŋ

english_verse: Joshua and his army left Makkedah and attacked the town of Libnah.
translation_verse: Ade kikɛ be kaman nɛ Joshuwa nɛ mbe benapo shi Makɛda n yɔ Libna n ya kɔ kumo kena.

english_verse: The Lord let them capture the town and its king, and they killed the king and everyone else, just as they had done at Jericho.
translation_verse: Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ Israɛlebi naŋ kɔ m pɔɔ kumo malɛ nɛ kumo be ewura so. B daŋ mɔ ekama nna. Esa kikɛ daŋ maŋ ji efute. Kananɛ b daŋ wora Jɛriko be ewura na gbagba chap nɛ b wora ndoŋ be ewura na gba.

english_verse: Joshua then led his army to Lachish, and they set up camp around the town. They attacked,
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ Joshuwa nɛ mbe benapo na lar Libna n yɔ Lakish n ya kulti kumo n wɔtɔ ŋ kɔ bumo kena.

english_verse: King Horam of Gezer arrived to help Lachish, but Joshua and his troops attacked and destroyed him and his army.
translation_verse: Gɛza be ewura nɛ baa tre Horam na daŋ ba chɛ Lakishebi to nna ama Joshuwa daŋ pɔɔ mo nɛ mbe benapo so nna nseŋ mɔ bumo kikɛ.

english_verse: From Lachish, Joshua took his troops to Eglon, where they set up camp surrounding the town. They attacked,
translation_verse: Kede be kaman nɛ Joshuwa nɛ mbe benapo yili Lakish n yɔ Iglɔn n ya kulti kumo ale gba ŋ kɔ kumo kena.

english_verse: They captured the town and the nearby villages, then killed everyone, including the king. They destroyed Hebron in the same way they had destroyed Eglon.
translation_verse: m pɔɔ kumo so nseŋ mɔ kumo be ewura nɛ basa nɛ b wɔ kade na to nɛ ndewurbi nɛ a mata kumo na be basa kikɛ. Joshuwa daŋ mur kade na kikɛ nna fanɛ kananɛ e daŋ wora Iglɔn na. Esa kama daa maŋ ji efute kumo to.

english_verse: Joshua and the Israelite army turned and attacked Debir.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ Joshuwa nɛ mbe benapo kilgi n ya kɔ Debir

english_verse: They captured the town, and its nearby villages. Then they destroyed Debir and killed its king, together with everyone else, just as they had done with Hebron and Libnah.
translation_verse: m pɔɔ kumo nɛ kumo be ewura nɛ ndewurbi nɛ a kulti kumo na kikɛ so nseŋ mɔ basa nɛ b wɔ ndoŋ na kikɛ. Kananɛ Joshuwa daŋ wora Libna nɛ Hibrɔn nɛ amo be bewura na koŋwule nɛ e wora Debir gba nɛ kumo be ewura.

english_verse: Joshua captured towns everywhere in the land: In the central hill country and the foothills to the west, in the Southern Desert and the region that slopes down toward the Dead Sea. Whenever he captured a town, he would kill the king and everyone else, as the Lord God of Israel had commanded.
translation_verse: Joshuwa daŋ kɔ m pɔɔ efuli na kikɛ so nna. E daŋ pɔɔ bewura nɛ b wɔ abee be efuli nɛ k wɔ nferinto na so, nɛ bumo nɛ b wɔ epeŋilarkpa be kaba so na, nɛ bumo nɛ b wɔ abee nɛ a wɔ epeŋitɔrkpa be kaba so na, nɛ bumo nɛ b chena kelargato be kaseto be keshishɛrsawule so na kikɛ so nna. Ndoŋ be esa kama daa maŋ pete. Kupɔrso kikɛ daa maŋ ji efute, ŋkpal manɛ so, loŋ nɛ Enyɛnpe Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na daŋ kaŋɛ bumo fanɛ b wora.

english_verse: King Jabin of Hazor heard about Joshua's victories, so he sent messages to many nearby kings and asked them to join him in fighting Israel. He sent these messages to King Jobab of Madon, the kings of Shimron and Achshaph,
translation_verse: Haazɔ be ewura nɛ baa tre Jabin na ka nu fanɛ Israɛlebi na kɔ m pɔɔ so, nɛ e shuŋi ŋ kaŋɛ Madɔn be ewura nɛ baa tre Joobab na nɛ Shimrɔn nɛ Akshaf be bewura;

english_verse: the kings in the northern hill country and in the Jordan River valley south of Lake Galilee, and the kings in the foothills and in Naphath-Dor to the west.
translation_verse: nɛ bewura nɛ b chena kelargato be esoso be kaba so be abee ase na nɛ bumo nɛ b wɔ Jɔɔdan be ketaŋɛ nɛ k wɔ Galili be Tekugboŋ na be kelargato be kaseto na, nɛ bumo nɛ b wɔ apreŋ so nɛ bumo nɛ b wɔ teku be ekarso ashi Dɔɔ na.

english_verse: He sent messages to the Canaanite kings in the east and the west, to the Amorite, Hittite, Perizzite, and Jebusite kings in the hill country, and to the Hivite kings in the region of Mizpah, near the foot of Mount Hermon.
translation_verse: E daŋ sa Keenanebi nɛ b chena Jɔɔdan be lɔr na be mba anyɔ so na nɛ Amɔriebi nɛ Hitebi, nɛ Pɛrizebi nɛ Jebusiebi nɛ b wɔ abee be efuli so na, nɛ Hivebi nɛ b chena kebeegboŋ nɛ baa tre Hɛɛmɔn na be kaseto ashi Mispa be kasawule so na gba ebɔl.

english_verse: The kings and their armies went to Merom Pond, where they set up camp, and got ready to fight Israel. It seemed as though there were more soldiers and horses and chariots than there are grains of sand on a beach.
translation_verse: Le be bewura ere kikɛ daŋ wora kɔnɔkoŋwule nna n ya wora bumo keeyi to ashi Meerɔm be kepa ase ŋ kre kena nɛ b ya kɔ Israɛlebi.

english_verse: The Lord told Joshua: Don't let them frighten you! I'll help you defeat them, and by this time tomorrow they will be dead. When you attack, the first thing you have to do is to cripple their horses. Then after the battle is over, burn their chariots.
translation_verse: Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ Joshuwa le: “Men sa maa ŋana bumo ŋkpal manɛ so, echefo saŋɛ ere so, meeŋ ta bumo m bɔɔ menyi Israɛlebi enɔ nɛ men mɔ bumo kikɛ. Men wora m buri bumo be egbaŋɛ na be aya nseŋ chɔ bumo be egbaŋɛturko na.”

english_verse: Joshua and his army made a surprise attack against the enemy camp at Merom Pond
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Joshuwa nɛ benapo na kikɛ ba Meerɔm be kepa na ase m ba kɔ bumo kena purgiso.

english_verse: Up to this time, the king of Hazor had controlled the kingdoms that had joined together to attack Israel, so Joshua led his army back and captured Hazor. They killed its king
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ Joshuwa kilgi n yɔ Hazɔɔ n ya kɔ m pɔɔ bumo be Ewura na so m mɔ mo. Hazɔɔ e daa la efuli na kikɛ so be kade lempo.

english_verse: Joshua captured all the towns where the enemy kings had ruled. These towns were built on small hills, and Joshua did not set fire to any of these towns, except Hazor. The Israelites kept the animals and everything of value from these towns, but they killed everyone who lived in them, including their kings. That's what the Lord had told his servant Moses to do, that's what Moses had told Joshua to do, and that's exactly what Joshua did.
translation_verse: Kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ daŋ kaŋɛ mbe kayɛrbi Mosis na gbagba chap nɛ mo alɛ kaŋɛ Joshuwa, nɛ Joshuwa malɛ bɛ kumo gbagba so chap. E daŋ wora kusɔ kama nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ daŋ kaŋɛ Mosis na kikɛ. Efuli nɛ Joshuwa sɔ na be asheŋ

english_verse: Joshua and his army took control of the northern and southern hill country, the foothills to the west, the Southern Desert, the whole region of Goshen, and the Jordan River valley.
translation_verse: Joshuwa daŋ kɔ n sɔ efuli nɛ a wɔ abee nɛ a wɔ kelargato be esoso nɛ kaseto na kikɛ, nɛ Goshen be kasawule kikɛ, nɛ keshishɛrsawule nɛ k wɔ Goshen be kelargato be kaseto be kaba so na, n ta n ya fo Jɔɔdan be ketaŋɛ na kikɛ nna.

english_verse: They took control of the land from Mount Halak near the country of Edom in the south to Baal-Gad in Lebanon Valley at the foot of Mount Hermon in the north. Joshua and his army were at war with the kings in this region for a long time, but finally they captured and put to death the last king.
translation_verse: Kasawule na dese hale n ya fo Halak be kebeegboŋ nɛ k wɔ kelargato be kaseto be kaba so a mata Edɔm be efuli so na, n ta n ya fo Baal Gad nɛ k wɔ kelargato be esoso be kaba so ashi Lebanɔn be ketaŋɛ nɛ k wɔ Hɛɛmɔn be kebeegboŋ na be kelargato be kaseto be kaba so na. Joshuwa nɛ le be bewura ere daŋ kɔ abar kena n chɛr ga, ama e daŋ pɔɔ bumo so m mɔ bumo kikɛ.

english_verse: The Lord had told Moses that he wanted the towns in this region destroyed and their people killed without mercy. That's why the Lord made the people in the towns stubborn and determined to fight Israel. The only town that signed a peace treaty with Israel was the Hivite town of Gibeon. The Israelite army captured the rest of the towns in battle.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na gbagba e daŋ shin nɛ b yili bumo be ŋgbene kukoŋwule fanɛ baaŋ kɔ Israɛlebi na kena, saŋɛ na so Israɛlebi na maaŋ shu bumo ekama so, nseŋ mɔ bumo kikɛ m mur bumo fanɛ kananɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ Mosis na.

english_verse: During this same time, Joshua and his army killed the Anakim from the northern and southern hill country. They also destroyed the towns where the Anakim had lived, including Hebron, Debir, and Anab.
translation_verse: Loŋ be jemanɛ na so nɛ Joshuwa ya kɔ nseŋ mur basa tenteŋ gboŋgboŋi nɛ baa tre Anakebi nɛ b wɔ abee so ashi Hibrɔn nɛ Debir nɛ Anaab nɛ Juda be abee be fuliso kikɛ ashi Israɛl be kasawule so. Joshuwa daŋ kɔ mur bumo nɛ bumo be nde kikɛ nna.

english_verse: There were not any Anakim left in the regions where the Israelites lived, although there were still some in Gaza, Gath, and Ashdod.
translation_verse: Anakebi na be ekama daa maŋ naa wɔ Israɛl be efuli so. Gaaza nɛ Gaaf nɛ Ashdɔd nawule nɛ beko daa wɔ.

english_verse: That's how Joshua captured the land, just as the Lord had commanded Moses, and Joshua divided it up among the tribes. Finally, there was peace in the land.
translation_verse: Joshuwa daŋ sɔ kasawule na kikɛ nna fanɛ kananɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ daŋ kaŋɛ Mosis na, nseŋ barga kumo to n sa Israɛlebi na yiri yiri so nɛ k ki bumo be kapetɛ. Yili kumo be saŋɛ na so nɛ b wushi gbrɛbi ashi kena be kekɔ to.

english_verse: Before Moses died, he and the people of Israel had defeated two kings east of the Jordan River. These kings had ruled the region from the Arnon River gorge in the south to Mount Hermon in the north, including the eastern side of the Jordan River valley.
translation_verse: Bewura nɛ Israɛlebi na daŋ kɔ m pɔɔ so nseŋ sɔ bumo be nsawule nɛ a wɔ Jɔɔdan be lɔr na be epeŋilarkpa, nseŋ yili Aanɔn be ketaŋɛ to ashi kelargato be kaseto n ya fo kebeegboŋ nɛ baa tre Hɛɛmɔn na ashi kelargato be esoso na nde.

english_verse: The first king that Moses and the Israelites defeated was an Amorite, King Sihon of Heshbon. The southern border of his kingdom ran down the middle of the Arnon River gorge, taking in the town of Aroer on the northern edge of the gorge. The Jabbok River separated Sihon's kingdom from the Ammonites on the east. Then the Jabbok turned west and became his northern border, so his kingdom included the southern half of the region of Gilead.
translation_verse: Amɔriebi be ewura nɛ baa tre Sihɔn nɛ e daa ji Hishbɔn be kuwura na be efuli daŋ yili Giliad be kasawule be bargato ashi Arowa, nɛ k wɔ Aanɔn be ketaŋɛ na be ekarso na, nɛ kade nɛ k wɔ ketaŋɛ na be nferinto na, n ya fo Jabɔk be Lɔr ashi Ammɔn be kasawule be ekar.

english_verse: Sihon also controlled the eastern side of the Jordan River valley from Lake Galilee south to Beth-Jeshimoth and the Dead Sea. In addition to these regions, he ruled the town called Slopes of Mount Pisgah and the land south of there at the foot of the hill.
translation_verse: Mo koŋwule be kasawule e daa la Jɔɔdan be ketaŋɛ nɛ k yili Galili be Teku na ashi kelargato be kaseto n ya fo Bɛf Jeshimɔf ashi Nfɔl be Teku na be epeŋilarkpa, n ta n ya fo kebeegboŋ nɛ baa tre Pisga na be kifito.

english_verse: Next, Moses and the Israelites defeated King Og of Bashan, who lived in the town of Ashtaroth part of each year and in Edrei the rest of the year. Og was one of the last of the Rephaim.
translation_verse: N ta Ɔg nɛ e daa la Bashan be ewura na. Mo e daa la basa tenteŋ gboŋgboŋi nɛ baa tre Refaebi na be esa lalalogesopo nɛ e ji Ashterɔf nɛ Edrei be kuwura.

english_verse: His kingdom stretched north to Mount Hermon, east to the town of Salecah, and included the land of Bashan as far west as the borders of the kingdoms of Geshur and Maacah. He also ruled the northern half of Gilead.
translation_verse: Mbe efuli daŋ yili kebeegboŋ nɛ baa tre Hɛɛmɔn na, nɛ Saleka, nɛ Bashan be kasawule kikɛ nna n ya fo Gɛshur nɛ Maaka be nde be ekar, n ta Giliad be bargato hale n ya fo Hishbɔn be ewura Sihɔn be efuli so.

english_verse: Moses, the Lord's servant, had led the people of Israel in defeating Sihon and Og. Then Moses gave their land to the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh.
translation_verse: Mosis nɛ Israɛlebi na daŋ kɔ nna m pɔɔ le be bewura anyɔ ere so, nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be kayɛrbi Mosis barga bumo kasawule to n sa Ruben nɛ Gad be eyiri na nɛ Manase be yiri be bargato fanɛ k ki bumo be kapetɛ. Bewura nɛ Joshuwa kɔ m pɔɔ so na be asheŋ

english_verse: Later, Joshua and the Israelites defeated many kings west of the Jordan River, from Baal-Gad in Lebanon Valley in the north to Mount Halak near the country of Edom in the south. This region included the hill country and the foothills, the Jordan River valley and its western slopes, and the Southern Desert. Joshua and the Israelites took this land from the Hittites, the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites. Joshua divided up the land among the tribes of Israel. The Israelites defeated the kings of the following towns west of the Jordan River:
translation_verse: Loŋ be kasawule na e daa la abee be efuli so, nɛ epeŋitɔrkpa be abee so, nɛ Jɔɔdan be ketaŋɛ nɛ kumo be abee so, nɛ abee be agbelge nɛ a wɔ epeŋilarkpa na, nɛ keshishɛrsawule nɛ k wɔ kelargato be kaseto be kaba so na. A daa la Hitebi nɛ Amɔriebi nɛ Keenanebi nɛ Pɛrizebi nɛ Jebusiebi nɛ Hivebi be nsawule nna.

english_verse: Many years later, the Lord told Joshua: Now you are very old, but there is still a lot of land that Israel has not yet taken.
translation_verse: Joshuwa ka bel na nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ mo le: “Naniere bre fo bel ga, ama kasawule damta kraa wɔtɔ nɛ men sɔ.

english_verse: Moses had already given land east of the Jordan River to the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and half of Manasseh.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be kayɛrbi Mosis teŋ sa Ruben nɛ Gad be eyiri nɛ Manase be yiri to be basa ko bre kasawule nɛ k wɔ Jɔɔdan be lɔr na be epeŋilarkpa na.

english_verse: This region stretched north from the town in the middle of the Arnon River valley, and included the town of Aroer on the northern edge of the valley. It covered the flatlands of Medeba north of Dibon,
translation_verse: Bumo be kasawule na dese n ya fo Arowa nɛ k wɔ Aanɔn be ketaŋɛ be kɔnɔ na, nɛ kade nɛ k wɔ ketaŋɛ na be nferinto na hale n ya fo kedeŋiso be kasawule nɛ k dese Mɛdiba n ya fo Dibɔn na.

english_verse: and took in the towns that had belonged to Sihon, the Amorite king of Heshbon. Some of these towns were as far east as the Ammonite border.
translation_verse: K dese hale n ya fo Ammɔn nɛ kumo be nde nɛ Ammɔn be ewura Sihɔn nɛ e ji kuwura ashi Hishbɔn daa keni so na kikɛ.

english_verse: Geshur and Maacah were part of this region, and so was the whole territory that King Og had ruled, that is, Gilead, Mount Hermon, and all of Bashan as far east as Salecah. Og had lived in Ashtaroth part of each year, and he had lived in Edrei the rest of the year. Og had been one of the last of the Rephaim, but Moses had defeated Sihon and Og and their people and had forced them to leave their land.
translation_verse: Ɔg nɛ e daa la basa tenteŋ gboŋgboŋi nɛ baa tre Refaebi na be esa lalalogesopo nɛ e daŋ ji Ashterɔf nɛ Edrei be kuwura na be efuli gba daŋ ti so. Mosis e daŋ pɔɔ le be basa ere so nseŋ ju bumo ashi kasawule na so.

english_verse: However, the Israelites did not force the people of Geshur and Maacah to leave, and they still live there among the Israelites. Why Moses Did Not Give Land to the Levi Tribe
translation_verse: Israɛlebi na daa maŋ ju Gɛshur nɛ Maaka be basa bre. B kraa wɔ Israɛl be efuli so hale kabre.

english_verse: Moses did not give any land to the Levi tribe, because the Lord God of Israel had told them, “Instead of land, you will receive the sacrifices offered at my altar.” The Land Moses Gave to the Reuben Tribe
translation_verse: Mosis daa maŋ yige kasawule kikɛ n sa Livai be yiri na bre, ŋkpal manɛ so, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na daŋ kaŋɛ Mosis nna fanɛ bɔrɛsure so be sarga chɔɔso nɛ baa lara a sa Enyɛnpe nɛ e la Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na e la bumo be kapetɛ. Kasawule nɛ b daŋ ta n sa Ruben be yiri to ebi be asheŋ

english_verse: Moses gave land to each of the clans in the Reuben tribe.
translation_verse: Mosis daŋ barga kasawule na be kaba nna n sa Ruben be yiri to ebi fanɛ k ba la bumo be kapetɛ.

english_verse: Their land started in the south at the town in the middle of the Arnon River valley, took in the town of Aroer on the northern edge of the valley, and went as far north as the flatlands around Medeba.
translation_verse: Bumo be kasawule na dese n ya fo Arowa nɛ k wɔ Aanɔn be ketaŋɛ be kɔnɔ na, nɛ kade nɛ k wɔ ketaŋɛ na be kefɛato na hale n ya fo kedeŋiso be kasawule nɛ k dese Mɛdiba na,

english_verse: The Amorite King Sihon had lived in Heshbon and had ruled the towns in the flatlands. Now Heshbon belonged to Reuben, and so did the following towns in the flatlands: Dibon, Bamoth-Baal, Beth-Baal-Meon, Jahaz, Kedemoth, Mephaath, Kiriathaim, Sibmah, Zereth-Shahar on the hill in the valley, Beth-Peor, Slopes of Mount Pisgah, and Beth-Jeshimoth. Moses defeated Sihon and killed him and the Midianite chiefs who ruled parts of his kingdom for him. Their names were Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba.
translation_verse: N ta kepreŋ so be nde na kikɛ, nɛ Sihɔn nɛ e la Amɔriebi be ewura ashi Hishbɔn na gba be efuli kikɛ n ti so. Mosis daŋ kɔ m pɔɔ mo nɛ Midian be bewura ana kikɛ so nna. Bumo e la Evi, nɛ Rekɛm, nɛ Zur, nɛ Hur, nɛ Reba. Bumo kikɛ e daa la ewura Sihɔn be efuli so be bewurbi.

english_verse: The Israelites also killed Balaam the son of Beor, who had been a fortuneteller.
translation_verse: Basa nɛ Israɛlebi na daŋ mɔ na be eko e daa la lejipo nɛ baa tre Balaam nɛ e daa la Beyɔ pibinyɛn na.

english_verse: This region with its towns and villages was the land for the Reuben tribe, and the Jordan River was its western border. The Land Moses Gave to the Gad Tribe
translation_verse: Kasawule na be ndegboŋ nɛ awurbi kikɛ nɛ b daŋ ta n sa Ruben be yiri to ebi na fanɛ k ki bumo be kapetɛ. Kumo be epeŋitɔrkpa be kaba so be ekar e daa la Jɔɔdan be lɔr na. Kasawule nɛ b ta n sa Gad be yiri to ebi be asheŋ

english_verse: Moses also gave land to each of the clans in the Gad tribe.
translation_verse: Mosis daŋ barga kasawule na be kaba n sa Gad be yiri to ebi gba fanɛ k ki bumo be kapetɛ.

english_verse: It included the town of Jazer, and in the Gilead region their territory took in the land and towns as far east as the town of Aroer just west of Rabbah. This was about half of the land that had once belonged to the Ammonites.
translation_verse: Bumo alɛ be kasawule daŋ yili Jaza nɛ Giliad be kasawule so be ndegboŋ na kikɛ nɛ Ammɔn be kasawule be bargato n ya fo Arowa nɛ k wɔ Raaba be epeŋilarkpa be kaba so na nna.

english_verse: The land given to Gad stretched from Heshbon in the south to Ramath-Mizpeh and Betonim in the north, and even further north to Mahanaim and Lidebor.
translation_verse: Nseŋ naŋ yili Hishbɔn gba n ta n yɔ Ramaf Mispa nɛ Bɛtonim kikɛ, nseŋ naŋ yili Mahanaim gba hale n ya fo Lodiba be kasawule be ekar kikɛ,

english_verse: Gad also received the eastern half of the Jordan River valley, which had been ruled by King Sihon of Heshbon. This territory stretched as far north as Lake Galilee, and included the towns of Beth-Haram, Beth-Nimrah, Succoth, and Zaphon.
translation_verse: n ta Bɛf Haraam, nɛ Bɛfnimra, nɛ Sukɔf nɛ Zafɔn nɛ a wɔ Jɔɔdan be ketaŋɛ na to na, nɛ ewura Sihɔn ashi Hishbɔn be efuli be kaba nɛ k ka na. Bumo be epeŋitɔrkpa be kaba so be kasawule be ekar daŋ yili Jɔɔdan be lɔr na nna n ya fo kelargato be esoso ashi Galili be teku na.

english_verse: These regions with their towns and villages were given to the Gad tribe. The Land Moses Gave to Half the Manasseh Tribe
translation_verse: Le be ndegboŋ nɛ awurbi kikɛ nɛ b daŋ chige n sa Gad be yiri to ebi na fanɛ a ki bumo be kapetɛ. Kasawule nɛ b ta n sa Manase be yiri to be basa be bargato be asheŋ

english_verse: Moses gave land east of the Jordan River to half of the clans from the Manasseh tribe.
translation_verse: Mosis daŋ ta kasawule na be kaba nna n sa Manase be yiri to be basa be bargato fanɛ k ba la bumo be kapetɛ.

english_verse: Their land started at Mahanaim and took in the region that King Og of Bashan had ruled, including Ashtaroth and Edrei, the two towns where he had lived. The villages where the Jair clan settled were part of Manasseh's land, and so was the northern half of the region of Gilead. The clans of this half of Manasseh had
translation_verse: Giliad be kasawule na be bargato nɛ Ashterɔf nɛ Edrei nɛ a la Ɔg be efuli so be ndegboŋ ashi Bashan na kikɛ gba daŋ ti bumo be kasawule so nna. B daŋ ta amo kikɛ nna n sa Makiir nɛ e la Manase pibinyɛn na be yiri to be basa be bargato nɛ a ba la bumo be kapetɛ.

english_verse: That was how Moses divided up the Moab Plains to the east of Jericho on the other side of the Jordan River, so these two and a half tribes would have land of their own.
translation_verse: Kananɛ Mosis daŋ barga kasawule nɛ k wɔ Jɛriko be epeŋilarkpa nɛ Jɔɔdan be ketaŋɛ na to saŋɛ nɛ e daa wɔ Mowab be kasawule so na nna na.

english_verse: But Moses did not give any land to the Levi tribe, because the Lord had promised that he would always provide for them.
translation_verse: Ama Livai be yiri na bre, Mosis daa maŋ sa bumo kasawule. Esarga nɛ baa lara a sa Enyɛnpe Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na e daa la bumo be kapetɛ.

english_verse: One day while the Israelites were still camped at Gilgal, Caleb the son of Jephunneh went to talk with Joshua. Caleb belonged to the Kenaz clan, and many other people from the Judah tribe went with Caleb. He told Joshua: You know that back in Kadesh-Barnea the Lord talked to his prophet Moses about you and me.
translation_verse: Kachako nɛ basa ko nɛ b shi Juda be yiri to ba Joshuwa kutɔ ashi Gilgaal. Nɛ Jefune nɛ e la Keniz be esa na pibinyɛn Kalɛb kaŋɛ mo le: “Fo nyi kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ Mosis nɛ e la kebɔrɛnya na, a laŋɛ ma nɛ fo be kaplɛa so ashi Kadɛsh Bania.

english_verse: The other spies said things that made our people afraid, but I completely trusted the Lord God.
translation_verse: Basa nɛ ma nɛ bumo daŋ yɔ na daŋ ta kufu damta nna n wɔtɔ anyi be basa to. Ama ma ere daŋ wora Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kasonu nna kashenteŋto.

english_verse: The same day I came back, Moses told me, “Since you were faithful to the Lord God, I promise that the places where you went as a spy will belong to you and your descendants forever.”
translation_verse: Ŋkpal ŋ ka wora Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kasonu so nɛ Mosis nase kɔnɔ kamɔnchɛ n sa ma nɛ ma mbia fanɛ, kasawule nɛ n nite so na beeŋ ki anyi be kapetɛ.

english_verse: I'm just as strong today as I was then, and I can still fight as well in battle.
translation_verse: Eleŋ nɛ n daa kɔ saŋɛ nɛ Mosis shuŋi ma na nɛ ŋ kra kɔ kabre gba. Ŋ kra kɔ eleŋ nɛ meeŋ tiŋ n yɔ kena to n ya kɔ.

english_verse: So I'm asking you for the hill country that the Lord promised me that day. You were there. You heard the other spies talk about that part of the hill country and the large, walled towns where the Anakim live. But maybe the Lord will help me take their land, just as he promised.
translation_verse: Naniere ta kebeeso be efuli nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nase kɔnɔ kamɔnchɛ afanɛ e beeŋ sa ma na n sa ma. An teŋ kaŋɛ fo fanɛ basa tenteŋ gboŋgboŋi nɛ baa tre Anakebi na e wɔ ndegboŋ nɛ b pɔr egbal ŋ kulti na to ashi efuli na kikɛ so. Ashere Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ beeŋ yili ma kaman nɛ n ju bumo n lar fanɛ kananɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ na gbagba chap.”

english_verse: Joshua prayed that God would help Caleb, then he gave Hebron to Caleb and his descendants.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Joshuwa nɛfa Jefune pibi Kalɛb nseŋ ta Hibrɔn be kade na n sa mo fanɛ mbe kapetɛ.

english_verse: And Hebron still belongs to Caleb's descendants, because he was faithful to the Lord God of Israel.
translation_verse: Amoso Hibrɔn kraa la Kalɛb be kaman to ebi peya nna, ŋkpal e ka nu n sa Enyɛnpe nɛ e la Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na kagbene koŋwule so so.

english_verse: Hebron used to be called Arba's Town, because Arba had been one of the greatest of the Anakim. There was peace in the land.
translation_verse: Hibrɔn nɛ b daa tre Aba be kade. Ndoŋ nna nɛ kagbenewushi ba efuli na so.

english_verse: As it went west from there, it ran south of Scorpion Pass to Zin, and then came up from the south to Kadesh-Barnea. It continued past Hezron up to Addar, turned toward Karka,
translation_verse: nseŋ yili Akrabim be ekpa to m bɔla kelargato be kaseto be kaba so n ya fo keshishɛrsawule nɛ baa tre Zin na, n ta m bɔla Kadɛsh Bania be kelargato be kaseto be kaba so n ya bɔla Hezrɔn n ya fo Ada n ta m ba Karka,

english_verse: and ran along to Azmon. After that, it followed the Egyptian Gorge and ended at the Mediterranean Sea. This was also Israel's southern border.
translation_verse: n naŋ bɔla Azmɔn n ya bɛ kabombi nɛ k dese Ijipt be kasawule be ekar na so n ya tar teku nɛ baa tre Mɛditerenia na. Ndoŋ e daa la Juda be kelargato be kaseto be kaba so be kasawule be ekar.

english_verse: From there it went west up to Beth-Hoglah, continued north of Beth-Arabah, and went up to the Monument of Bohan, who belonged to the Reuben tribe.
translation_verse: K dese n yɔ Bɛf Hogla, nseŋ naŋ ta n ya bɔla Bɛf Araba be kelargato be esoso be kaba so n ya fo Bohan be kejembu na.

english_verse: From there, it went to Trouble Valley and Debir, then turned north and went to Gilgal, which is on the north side of the valley across from Adummim Pass. It continued on to Enshemesh, Enrogel,
translation_verse: K yili ketaŋɛ nɛ baa tre Ankɔ, nɛ baa tre kumo koŋwule na Tɔrɔ be ketaŋɛ na, n yɔ Dɛbia nseŋ naŋ kilgi n sɔ kelargato be esoso be kaba so a yɔ Gilgaal nɛ k wɔ Adummim be anishito ashi ketaŋɛ na be kelargato be kaseto be kaba so na. Ndoŋ nɛ k yili m bɛ Enshɛmɛsh be mbombi na so hale n ya paŋ m bɔl Enrogɛl,

english_verse: and up through Hinnom Valley on the land sloping south from Jerusalem. The city of Jerusalem itself belonged to the Jebusites. Next, the border went up to the top of the mountain on the west side of Hinnom Valley and at the north end of Rephaim Valley.
translation_verse: nseŋ naŋ bɔla Bɛn Hinnɔm be ketaŋɛ nɛ k dese kebee nɛ Jebusiebi be kade nɛ baa tre Jerusalɛm na tase so na be kelargato be kaseto be kaba so. Ndoŋ nɛ k yili n dii kebee nɛ k wɔ Hinnɔm be ketaŋɛ na be epeŋitɔrkpa be kaba so na be esoso ashi Refaebi be ketaŋɛ na be kelargato be esoso be kaba so,

english_verse: At the top of the mountain it turned and went to Nephtoah Spring and then to the ruins on Mount Ephron. From there, it went to Baalah, which is now called Kiriath-Jearim.
translation_verse: nseŋ naŋ yili ndoŋ m bɔla Nɛftowa be mbombi na to n ya lar ndegboŋ nɛ a mata Efrɔn be kebeegboŋ na, nseŋ yili ndoŋ ŋ kilgi n sɔ Baala nɛ baa tre Kiriaf Jearim na.

english_verse: From Baalah the northern border curved west to Mount Seir and then ran along the northern ridge of Mount Jearim, where Chesalon is located. Then it went down to Beth-Shemesh and over to Timnah.
translation_verse: Baala nɛ k yili ŋ kilgi n sɔ Edɔm be abee so be efuli so ashi epeŋitɔrkpa be kaba so n ta n ya fo kebeegboŋ nɛ baa tre Jearim nɛ kade baa tre Chisalɔn na wɔ na be kelargato be esoso be kaba so nseŋ bɔla Bɛf Shimish n ya fo Timna.

english_verse: It continued along to the hillside north of Ekron, curved around to Shikkeron, and then went to Mount Baalah. After going to Jabneel, the border finally ended at the Mediterranean Sea,
translation_verse: Kasawule na be ekar daŋ yili ndoŋ nna n yɔ Ekrɔn be kelargato be esoso be kaba so be kebee na so, n ta m bɔla Shikrɔn n ya choŋ kebeegboŋ nɛ baa tre Baala na so n ya fo Jaabnɛl. Teku nɛ baa tre Mɛditerenia na

english_verse: Next, Caleb started a war with the town of Debir, which at that time was called Kiriath-Sepher.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nɛ e yili n ya kɔ Debir be basa.

english_verse: Joshua gave Caleb some land among the people of Judah, as God had told him to do. Caleb's share was Hebron, which at that time was known as Arba's Town, because Arba was the famous ancestor of the Anakim.
translation_verse: Joshuwa daŋ bɛ kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ mo na so nna nseŋ ta Juda be kasawule na be kaba n sa Jefune pibi Kalɛb. E daŋ nya Hibrɔn nɛ k la Aba be kade na nna.

english_verse: towns with their surrounding villages: Eshtaol, Zorah, Ashnah, Zanoah, En-Gannim, Tappuah, Enam, Jarmuth, Adullam, Socoh, Azekah, Shaaraim, Adithaim, Gederah, and Gederothaim.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Kalɛb ju Anak be kaman to ebi na ashi Hibrɔn be kade to. Bumo e daa la Shishai nɛ Ahiman nɛ Talmai be mbuna na.

english_verse: towns with their surrounding villages: Zenan, Hadashah, Migdalgad, Dilan, Mizpeh, Joktheel, Lachish, Bozkath, Eglon, Cabbon, Lahmas, Chitlish, Gederoth, Beth-Dagon, Naamah, and Makkedah.
translation_verse: Loŋ be saŋɛ na nɛ Kalɛb kaŋɛ le: “Esa kama nɛ e ya kɔ m pɔɔ Kiriaf Sɛfa so, ma alɛ beeŋ ta ma pibiche Aksa n sa mo nɛ e kil.”

english_verse: Right after the wedding, Achsah started telling Othniel that he ought to ask her father for a field. She went to see her father, and while she was getting down from her donkey, Caleb asked her, “What's bothering you?”
translation_verse: Bumo be kejafɔ to nɛ Aksa kaŋɛ Otniɛl fanɛ e kaŋɛ mo tuto Kalɛb nɛ e sa bumo kasawule. Aksa ka yɔ nɛ e ya wu mo tuto nseŋ gbelge mbe kurma so nɛ Kalɛb bishi mo le: “Manɛ nɛ fee sha ŋ ka wora n sa fo.”

english_verse: She answered, “I need your help. The land you gave me is in the Southern Desert, so I really need some spring-fed ponds for a water supply.” Caleb gave her a couple of small ponds, named Higher Pond and Lower Pond. Towns in Judah's Land
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Aksa kaŋɛ mo le: “Mee sha kakpa nɛ nchu wɔ nna, ama kakpa nɛ fo sa ma ere la keshishɛrsawule nna.” Ndoŋ nna nɛ Kalɛb ta abuye anyɔ n sa mo. Kuko daa wɔ kepreŋ so nna nɛ kuko malɛ wɔ ketaŋɛ to. Juda be nde be asheŋ

english_verse: The following is a list of the towns in each region given to the Judah clans:
translation_verse: Kananɛ b daŋ barga kasawule na to n sa Juda be yiri to ebi na fanɛ bumo be kapetɛ nde.

english_verse: The first region was located in the Southern Desert along the border with Edom, and it had the following
translation_verse: Lebaɔf nɛ Shilhim nɛ Ain nɛ Rimɔna. Amo kikɛ daa la ndegboŋ adunyɔ nɛ akpanu, n ta amo be ndewurbiana n ti so.

english_verse: The second region was located in the northern part of the lower foothills, and it had the following
translation_verse: Sharaim nɛ Aditaim nɛ Gɛdera . Amo alɛ daa la ndegboŋ kudu ana, n ta amo be ndewurbi n ti so.

english_verse: The third region was located in the southern part of the lower foothills, and it had the following
translation_verse: Gɛdɛrɔf nɛ Bɛf Dagɔn nɛ Naama nɛ Makɛda. Amo alɛ daa la ndegboŋ kuduashe, n ta amo be ndewurbi n ti so.

english_verse: The fourth region was located in the central part of the lower foothills, and it had the following nine towns with their surrounding villages: Libnah, Ether, Ashan, Iphtah, Ashnah, Nezib, Keilah, Achzib, and Mareshah.
translation_verse: Keila nɛ Akzib nɛ Marɛsha. Amo alɛ daa la ndegboŋ akpanu. N ta amo be ndewurbi n ti so.

english_verse: The fifth region was located along the Mediterranean seacoast, and it had the following towns with their surrounding settlements and villages: Ekron and the towns between there and the coast, Ashdod and the larger towns nearby, Gaza, the towns from Gaza to the Egyptian Gorge, and the towns along the coast of the Mediterranean Sea.
translation_verse: n ta Ashdɔd nɛ Gaaza nɛ amo be ndegboŋ nɛ awurbi hale n ya fo kabombi nɛ k wɔ Ijipt be kasawule be ekar na, n ta nde nɛ a wɔ Mɛditerenia be Teku ase na kikɛ n ti so.

english_verse: The eleventh region was located in the northern part of Judah's hill country, and it had the following two towns with their surrounding villages: Rabbah, and Kiriath-Baal, which is also called Kiriath-Jearim.
translation_verse: N ta Kiriaf Baal nɛ baa tre Kiriaf Jearim na nɛ Raaba. Amo alɛ la nde anyɔ nɛ amo ndewurbi.

english_verse: The twelfth region was located in the desert along the Dead Sea, and it had the following six towns with their surrounding villages: Beth-Arabah, Middin, Secacah, Nibshan, Salt Town, and En-Gedi. The Jebusites
translation_verse: Nibshan nɛ k la nfɔl be kade na nɛ Engedi. Amo alɛ la ndegboŋ ashe nɛ amo be ndewurbi.

english_verse: The Jebusites lived in Jerusalem, and the people of the Judah tribe could not capture the city and get rid of them. That's why Jebusites still live in Jerusalem along with the people of Judah.
translation_verse: Judaebi na daŋ maŋ tiŋ n ju Jebusiebi nɛ b wɔ Jerusalɛm na bre. Ŋkpal loŋ so Jebusiebi nɛ Judaebi na e kraa tase hale kabre.

english_verse: The following is a description of the land that was divided among the clans of the Ephraim tribe. Their southern border started at Ataroth-Addar and went west to Upper Beth-Horon
translation_verse: Le be kasawule ere e daa la Efrayim be kanaŋ to ebi peya. Bumo be kasawule be ekar fara Atarɔf Ada ashi epeŋilarkpa be kaba so n ya fo Bɛf Hɔrɔn

english_verse: Ephraim also had some towns and villages that were inside Manasseh's tribal land.
translation_verse: B daŋ nya ndegboŋ nɛ ndewurbi ko gba nɛ a wɔ Manase be kasawule so n ti so.

english_verse: Ephraim could not force the Canaanites out of Gezer, so there are still some Canaanites who live there among the Israelites. But now these Canaanites have to work as slaves for the Israelites.
translation_verse: Ama b daa maŋ ju Keenanebi nɛ b daa wɔ Gɛza na. B daŋ yige bumo nna nɛ b chena Efrayim be kasawule so a shuŋ fanɛ anya a sa bumo.

english_verse: The land of the Manasseh tribe went from its northern border with the Asher tribe south to Michmethath, which is to the east of Shechem. The southern border started there, but curved even farther south to include the people who lived around Tappuah Spring.
translation_verse: Manase be kasawule daŋ yili Ashɛr nna n ya fo Mikmetaf nɛ k wɔ Shɛkɛm be epeŋilarkpa na. K daŋ yili ndoŋ nna n dese n ya fo kelargato be kaseto be kaba so be kakpa nɛ Entapuwa be basa wɔ na.

english_verse: The town of Tappuah was on Manasseh's border with Ephraim. Although the land around Tappuah belonged to Manasseh, the town itself belonged to Ephraim.
translation_verse: Kasawule nɛ k kulti Tapua na la Manase peya nna ama Tapua be kade gbagba nɛ k wɔ Manase be kasawule be ekar na bre la Efrayim be kaman to ebi peya nna.

english_verse: Then the border went west to the Kanah Gorge and ran along the northern edge of the gorge to the Mediterranean Sea. The land south of the gorge belonged to Ephraim. And even though there were a few towns that belonged to Ephraim north of the gorge, the land north of the gorge belonged to Manasseh. The western border of Manasseh was the Mediterranean Sea, and the tribe shared a border with the Asher tribe on the northwest and with the Issachar tribe on the northeast.
translation_verse: Efrayim e wɔ kelargato be kaseto be kaba so nɛ Manase malɛ wɔ kelargato be esoso be kaba so. Mɛditerenia be Teku na e daa la bumo kasawule be epeŋitɔrkpa be ekar. Ashɛr e daa wɔ Manase be kelargato be esoso a yɔ epeŋitɔrkpa be kaba so nɛ Isakar malɛ wɔ kumo be kelargato be esoso be epeŋilarkpa na be kaba so.

english_verse: Manasseh was supposed to have the following towns with their surrounding villages inside the borders of Issachar's and Asher's tribal lands: Beth-Shan, Ibleam, Endor, Taanach, Megiddo, and Dor, which is also called Naphath.
translation_verse: Bɛf Shan nɛ Iblim nɛ amo be nde nɛ a kulti amo na kikɛ, n ta Dɔɔ nɛ k wɔ teku ase na nɛ Endɔ nɛ Tanaak nɛ Meggiddo nɛ ndewurbi nɛ a kulti amo na kikɛ da wɔ Isakar nɛ Ashɛr be nsawule so nna nsaa la Manase peya.

english_verse: But the people of Manasseh could not capture these towns, so the Canaanites kept on living in them.
translation_verse: Ama Manase be yiri to ebi daŋ maŋ tiŋ ŋ ju basa nɛ b wɔ nde na to amoso Keenanebi na daŋ maŋ lar ndoŋ.

english_verse: When the Israelites grew stronger, they made the Canaanites in these towns work as their slaves, though they never did force them to leave. Joseph's Descendants Ask for More Land
translation_verse: Israɛlebi na ka sɔ eleŋ a ji gba, b daa maŋ ju Keenanebi na, ama b daa tintiŋ bumo nna nɛ b baa shuŋ a sa bumo. Efrayim nɛ Manase be epeŋitɔrkpa be kaba so ebi na ka bee fin kasawule damta be asheŋ

english_verse: One day the Joseph tribes came to Joshua and asked, “Why didn't you give us more land? The Lord has always been kind to us, and we have too many people for this small region.”
translation_verse: Josɛf be kaman to ebi na daŋ kaŋɛ Joshuwa na le: “Mannɛ nna nɛ fo ta kasawule na be kaba koŋwule nawule n sa anyi fanɛ anyi be kapetɛ? Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛfa anyi nna nɛ an shi.”

english_verse: Joshua replied, “If there's not enough room for you in the hill country of Ephraim, then go into the forest that belonged to the Perizzites and the Rephaim. Clear out the trees and make more room for yourselves there.”
translation_verse: Nɛ Joshuwa kaŋɛ le: “Nɛ Efrayim be kebee so be kasawule na du fimbi n sa menyi ŋkpal men ka shi so, kumo ere men ya lɔŋɛ kupo nɛ k wɔ Pɛrizebi nɛ Refaebi be kasawule so na n chena.”

english_verse: “Even if we do that,” they answered, “there still won't be enough land for us in the hill country. And we can't move down into Jezreel Valley, because the Canaanites who live in Beth-Shan and in other parts of the valley have iron chariots.”
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ b kaŋɛ: “Abee so be kasawule na maŋ shibi n sa anyi, Keenanebi nɛ b wɔ keplasawuleso na malɛ kɔ anyembi be egbaŋɛturko nna. Bumo be bumo nɛ b wɔ Bɛf Shan nɛ ndewurbi nɛ a mata kumo na nɛ bumo nɛ b wɔ Jizreel be ketaŋɛ to na kikɛ kɔ amo nna.”

english_verse: “Your tribes do have a lot of people,” Joshua admitted. “I'll give you more land. Your tribes are powerful,
translation_verse: Nɛ Joshuwa kaŋɛ Efrayim nɛ Manase be yiri to ebi na le: “Ŋkpal men ka shibi nsaa kɔ eleŋ so, menyi be kasawule be kachige beeŋ ba shibi.

english_verse: so you can have the rest of the hill country, but it's a forest, and you'll have to cut down the trees and clear the land. You can also have Jezreel Valley. Even though the Canaanites there are strong and have iron chariots, you can force them to leave the valley.”
translation_verse: Abee so be kasawule na be kaba so beeŋ baa la menyeya. K la kupo nna bre ama men ya lɔŋɛ ndoŋ n chena. Kashenteŋ nna fanɛ Keenanebi na kɔ anyembi be egbaŋɛturko nsaa kɔ eleŋ, ama menyeeŋ tiŋ n ju bumo kasawule na so.”

english_verse: After Israel had captured the land, they met at Shiloh and set up the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Israɛlebi na ka kɔ n sɔ kasawule na n loge, nɛ bumo kikɛ ya gama abar so ashi Shilo nseŋ yuu Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be nshɛr be wajɛbu ndoŋ.

english_verse: There were still seven tribes without any land,
translation_verse: Israɛlebi be eyiri ashunu e daŋ ka nsaa maŋ nya bumo be kasawule be kachige.

english_verse: Just before the men left camp, Joshua repeated their orders: “Explore the land and write a description of it. Then come back to Shiloh, and I will find out from the Lord how to divide the land.”
translation_verse: Pɔɛŋ nɛ basa na lar nɛ b ya wora kasawule na be ndulgi be nwɔl na, le nɛ Joshuwa daŋ kaŋɛ bumo: “Men ya keni kasawule na kikɛ nɛ kananɛ k dese nseŋ wora kumo be ndulgi be nwɔl pɔɛŋ nseŋ bɛta m ba ŋ kutɔ, nɛ n to beri ashi Shilo nfe m bishi Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kusɔ nɛ k wɔtɔ n sa menyi.”

english_verse: The men left and went across the land, dividing it into seven regions. They wrote down a description of each region, town by town, and returned to Joshua at the camp at Shiloh.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ benyɛn na ya nite kasawule na so kikɛ nseŋ wora kananɛ b barga kumo to mba ashunu na nɛ nde nɛ a wɔ kumo so kikɛ n wɔtɔ kawɔl to. B ka loge nɛ b bɛta n yɔ Joshuwa kutɔ ashi bumo be keeyi to ashi Shilo.

english_verse: Joshua found out from the Lord how to divide the land, and he told the tribes what the Lord had decided. Benjamin's Land
translation_verse: Nɛ Joshuwa to beri m bishi Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kusɔ nɛ k wɔtɔ nseŋ chige kasawule na to n sa Israɛl be eyiri nɛ a ka na. Bɛnjamin be kasawule be asheŋ

english_verse: Benjamin was the first tribe chosen to receive land. The region for its clans lay between the Judah tribe on the south and the Joseph tribes on the north.
translation_verse: Bɛnjamin be yiri to ebi nɛ b daŋ juŋkpar n chige kasawule na n sa. Bumo be kasawule dese Juda nɛ Josɛf be yiri to ebi be kefɛato nna.

english_verse: Benjamin's northern border started at the Jordan River and went up the ridge north of Jericho, then on west into the hill country as far as the Beth-Aven Desert.
translation_verse: Bumo be kasawule na be kelargato be esoso be kaba so be ekar fara Jɔɔdan be lɔr na to nna m gbelge to n yɔ Jɛriko be kelargato be esoso be kaba so nseŋ ya sɔ to epeŋitɔrkpa be kaba so m bɔla abee be efuli so hale n ya fo Bɛf Avɛn be keshishɛrsawule na,

english_verse: towns with their surrounding villages: Gibeon, Ramah, Beeroth, Mizpeh, Chephirah, Mozah, Rekem, Irpeel, Taralah, Zelah, Haeleph, Gibeah, Kiriath-Jearim, and Jerusalem, which is also called Jebusite Town. These regions are the tribal lands of Benjamin.
translation_verse: K ka fo kebeegboŋ na nɛ k yili kumo be epeŋitɔrkpa ŋ kilgi m bɔla kebee na be kelargato be kaseto be kaba so a yɔ Kiriaf Baal ŋko Kiriaf Jearim nɛ k la Juda be yiri to ebi peya na.

english_verse: Benjamin's southern border started at the edge of Kiriath-Jearim and went east to the ruins and on to Nephtoah Spring.
translation_verse: Kasawule na be kelargato be kaseto be kaba so be ekar fara Kiriaf Jearim be ekarso nna n ta n sɔ epeŋitɔrkpa hale n ya fo Nɛftowa be abuye na,

english_verse: From there it went to the bottom of the hill at the northern end of Rephaim Valley. The other side of this hill faces Hinnom Valley, which is on the land that slopes south from Jerusalem. The border went down through Hinnom Valley until it reached Enrogel.
translation_verse: nseŋ naŋ yili ndoŋ n yɔ kebee nɛ k shoŋi Bɛn Hinnɔm be ketaŋɛ, nsaa wɔ Refaebi be ketaŋɛ na malɛ be kelargato be esoso be ekarso na be kifito, nseŋ kilgi n sɔ kelargato be kaseto be kaba so m bɔla Hinnɔm be ketaŋɛ na to ashi Jebusiebi be kebee so a laŋɛ En Rogɛl be kaba so,

english_verse: At Enrogel the border curved north and went to Enshemesh and on east to Geliloth, which is across the valley from Adummim Pass. Then it went down to the Monument of Bohan, who belonged to the Reuben tribe.
translation_verse: nseŋ yili ndoŋ malɛ m bɔla Enshɛmɛsh ashi kelargato be esoso be kaba so n yɔ Gelilɔf nɛ k wɔ Adummim be kebee be anishito na, nseŋ bɔla ndoŋ n yɔ Bohan be kejembu na. Ruben pibi e daa la Bohan.

english_verse: The border ran along the hillside north of Beth-Arabah, then down into the Jordan River valley.
translation_verse: Kejembu na ase nɛ k yili ŋ kilgi m bɔla kebee nɛ k shoŋi Jɔɔdan be ketaŋɛ na be kelargato be esoso n ta m bɔla ketaŋɛ na to

english_verse: Inside the valley it went south as far as the northern hillside of Beth-Hoglah. The last section of the border went from there to the northern end of the Dead Sea, at the mouth of the Jordan River.
translation_verse: n sɔ Bɛf Hogla be kelargato be esoso be kaba so hale n ya fo nfɔl be teku na be kakpa nɛ Jɔɔdan be lɔr na bee luri kumo to na. Ndoŋ e daa la kasawule na be kelargato be kaseto be kaba so be ekar.

english_verse: The Jordan River itself was Benjamin's eastern border. These were the borders of Benjamin's tribal land, where the clans of Benjamin lived.
translation_verse: Jɔɔdan be lɔr na malɛ e daa la kumo epeŋilarkpa be kaba so be ekar. Kananɛ Bɛnjamin be yiri to ebi be kasawule nɛ b sa bumo fanɛ kapetɛ na dese nde:

english_verse: In one region of Simeon's tribal land there were the following
translation_verse: nɛ Bɛf Lebaɔf nɛ Sharuhɛm. A daa wɔ ndegboŋ kuduashe, n ta amo be ndewurbi n ti so.

english_verse: In another region, Simeon had the following four towns with their surrounding villages: Enrimmon, Tachan, Ether, and Ashan.
translation_verse: N ta Ain nɛ Rimmɔn nɛ Etta nɛ Ashaan. Amo alɛ daa wɔ ndegboŋ ana n ta amo be ndewurbi n ti so.

english_verse: Simeon's tribal land was actually inside Judah's territory. Judah had received too much land for the number of people in its tribe, so part of Judah's land was given to Simeon. Zebulun's Land
translation_verse: Ŋkpal Juda be kasawule ka daa shi ga a chɔ kumo be basa so so, b daŋ ku kumo be kaba nna n sa Simiɔn be yiri to ebi. Kasawule nɛ b ta n sa Zɛbyulɔn be yiri to ebi na be asheŋ

english_verse: Zebulun was the third tribe chosen to receive land. The southern border for its clans started in the west at the edge of the gorge near Jokneam. It went east to the edge of the land that belongs to the town of Dabbesheth, and continued on to Maralah and Sarid. It took in the land that belongs to Chislothtabor, then ended at Daberath. The eastern border went up to Japhia
translation_verse: Nseŋ yili Sarid be kaba nyɔsopo na n ta n sɔ to epeŋilarkpa be kaba so n ya fo Chislof Tabor be kasawule be ekar nseŋ keta loŋ n ya fo Daberaf nɛ Jafaya kikɛ.

english_verse: and became the northern border. Then it curved south around Hannathon and went as far west as Iphtahel Valley.
translation_verse: Nseŋ yili kelargato be esoso be kaba so ŋ kilgi n sɔ Hannatɔn be kaba so n ta n ya fo Ifta El be ketaŋɛ na,

english_verse: Zebulun had twelve towns with their surrounding villages. Some of these were Kattath, Nahalal, Shimron, Jiralah, and Bethlehem.
translation_verse: n ta Kattaf nɛ Nahalal nɛ Shimrɔn nɛ Idalah nɛ Bɛtlɛhɛm n ti so. B daa kɔ ndegboŋ kuduanyɔ nɛ amo be ndewurbi.

english_verse: towns with their surrounding villages: Jezreel, Chesulloth, Shunem, Hapharaim, Shion, Anaharath, Debirath, Kishion, Ebez, Remeth, En-Gannim, Enhaddah, Beth-Pazzez, Tabor, Shahazumah and Beth-Shemesh. Asher's Land
translation_verse: Le be ndegboŋ nɛ awurbi ere daa wɔ kasawule nɛ Zɛbyulɔn be yiri to ebi nya fanɛ bumo be kapetɛ na so nna. Kasawule nɛ b ta n sa Isakar be yiri to ebi na be asheŋ

english_verse: Issachar was the fourth tribe chosen to receive land. The northern border for its clans went from Mount Tabor east to the Jordan River. Their land included the following
translation_verse: Le be nde ere e daa wɔ kasawule nɛ Isakar be yiri to ebi nya fanɛ bumo be kapetɛ na. Kasawule nɛ b ta n sa Ashɛr be yiri to ebi na be asheŋ

english_verse: Asher was the fifth tribe chosen to receive land, and the region for its clans included the following towns: Helkath, Hali, Beten, Achshaph, Allammelech, Amad, and Mishal. Asher's southern border ran from the Mediterranean Sea southeast along the Shihor-Libnath River at the foot of Mount Carmel,
translation_verse: Alamelɛk nɛ Amad nɛ Mishaal. Bumo be epeŋitɔrkpa be kaba so be kasawule daŋ dese nna n ya fo Kamɛl nɛ Shihɔ Libnaf,

english_verse: then east to Beth-Dagon. On the southeast, Asher shared a border with Zebulun along the Iphtahel Valley. On the eastern side their border ran north to Beth-Emek, went east of Cabul, and then on to Neiel,
translation_verse: nseŋ yili ndoŋ ŋ kilgi n sɔ epeŋilarkpa be kaba so n ya fo Bɛfdagɔn, n ta loŋ n yɔ Zɛbyulɔn nɛ ketaŋɛ nɛ baa tre Iftahɛl na, nseŋ naŋ dese n yɔ Bɛtemɛk nɛ Neyɛl ashi kelargato be esoso be kaba so, n ta loŋ n ya fo Kabuul nɛ

english_verse: Abdon, Rehob, Hammon, Kanah, and as far north as the city of Sidon.
translation_verse: Ebrɔn nɛ Rehɔb nɛ Hamɔn nɛ Kaana hale n ya fo Sidɔn.

english_verse: Then it turned west to become the northern border and went to Ramah and the fortress-city of Tyre. Near Tyre it turned toward Hosah and ended at the Mediterranean Sea. Asher had a total of
translation_verse: Le be ndegboŋ nɛ awurbi ere kikɛ e daa wɔ kasawule nɛ Ashɛr be yiri to ebi nya fanɛ bumo be kapetɛ na so. Kasawule nɛ b ta n sa Naftali be yiri to ebi na be asheŋ

english_verse: Naphtali was the sixth tribe chosen to receive land. The southern border for its clans started in the west, where the tribal lands of Asher and Zebulun meet near Hukkok. From that point it ran east and southeast along the border with Zebulun as far as Aznoth-Tabor. From there the border went east to Heleph, Adami-Nekeb, Jabneel, then to the town called Oak in Zaanannim, and Lakkum. The southern border ended at the Jordan River, at the edge of the town named Jehudah. Naphtali shared a border with Asher on the west.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nɛ k yili ŋ kilgi n sɔ epeŋitɔrkpa be kaba so n yɔ Aznɔf Tabɔɔ n ta n ya bɔla Hukɔk n yɔ Zɛbyulɔn ashi kelargato be kaseto be kaba so nɛ Ashɛr ashi epeŋitɔrkpa be kaba so nɛ Jɔɔdan be lɔr na ashi epeŋilarkpa be kaba so.

english_verse: Its clans received this land and these towns with their surrounding villages. Later, when enemies forced them to leave their tribal land, they went to the town of Leshem. They attacked the town, captured it, and killed the people who lived there. Then they settled there themselves and renamed the town Dan after their ancestor. Joshua's Land
translation_verse: Le be ndegboŋ nɛ awurbi kikɛ e daa wɔ kasawule nɛ Dan be yiri to ebi nya fanɛ bumo be kapetɛ na so. Kasawule nɛ b ta n sa Joshuwa na be asheŋ

english_verse: The Israelites were still gathered in Shiloh in front of the sacred tent, when Eleazar the priest, Joshua, and the family leaders of Israel finished giving out the land to the tribes. The Lord had told the people to give Joshua whatever town he wanted. So Joshua chose Timnath-Serah in the hill country of Ephraim, and the people gave it to him. Joshua went to Timnath-Serah, rebuilt it, and lived there.
translation_verse: Bɔrɛmatapowura Eliaza nɛ Nun pibi Joshuwa, nɛ Israɛl be kanaŋ na to be eyiriana be benimu e daŋ to beri Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be nshɛr be wajɛbu na be kabunato Enyɛnpe na be anishito ashi Shilo m barga kasawule na to n sa basa na kikɛ. Loŋ nɛ b wora m barga kasawule na to.

english_verse: These Safe Towns were set up, so that if Israelites or even foreigners who lived in Israel accidentally killed someone, they could run to one of these towns. There they would be safe until a trial could be held, even if one of the victim's relatives came looking for revenge.
translation_verse: Le be nde ere e daa la kesɔnyige be nde nɛ b lara n sa Israɛlebi kikɛ nɛ befɔ nɛ b chena bumo to na. Esa kama nɛ e maŋ kute m mɔ esa beeŋ tiŋ n shile n yɔ nde ere to n ya nya kekuŋ ashi esa nɛ e bee fin kemɔ mo m bishi kuwule nɛ b maŋ naŋ ji mo demu ashi jimaŋ be anishito na kutɔ.

english_verse: One day the Lord told Joshua:
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ Joshuwa

english_verse: When Moses was still alive, I commanded him to tell the Israelites about the Safe Towns. Now you tell them that it is time to set up these towns.
translation_verse: fanɛ e kaŋɛ Israɛlebi na le: “Men lara kesɔnyige be nde nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ Mosis fanɛ e kaŋɛ menyi amo be asheŋ na.

english_verse: If a person accidentally kills someone and the victim's relatives say it was murder, they might try to take revenge. Anyone accused of murder can run to one of the Safe Towns and be safe from the victim's relatives. The one needing protection will stand at the entrance to the town gate and explain to the town leaders what happened. Then the leaders will bring that person in and provide a place to live in their town.
translation_verse: Loŋ be esa na beeŋ tiŋ n shile n yɔ kesɔnyige be nde na be kuko to n ya luri kumo be kabunagboŋ na be kakpa nɛ baa shɛr a ji demu na m bugi to ŋ kaŋɛ bejuŋkparpoana na kusɔ nɛ k wora. Saŋɛ na so, baaŋ shin nɛ e luri kade na to nɛ b sa mo kakpa nɛ e beeŋ baa wɔ nɛ e tu bumo n chena.

english_verse: One of the victim's relatives might come to the town, looking for revenge. But the town leaders must not simply hand over the person accused of murder. After all, the accused and the victim had been neighbors, not enemies.
translation_verse: Nɛ esa nɛ e bee fin kemɔ loŋ be esa n tal to na kaŋ bɛ emɔpo na so n yɔ ndoŋ, benimuana na e sa maŋ kaŋ yige emɔpo na n sa mo. K daga fanɛ b kuŋ emɔpo na nɛnɛ, ŋkpal manɛ so, e maŋ kute nna m mɔ esa na agbo so.

english_verse: The citizens of that Safe Town must come together and hold a trial. They may decide that the victim was killed accidentally and that the accused is not guilty of murder. Everyone found not guilty must still live in the Safe Town until the high priest dies. Then they can go back to their own towns and their homes that they had to leave behind.
translation_verse: K daga fanɛ e chena kade na to n ya fo saŋɛ nɛ baaŋ ji mo demu jimaŋ be anishito ŋko saŋɛ nɛ esa nɛ e la bɔrɛmatapo nimuso loŋ be saŋɛ na beeŋ wu. Kumo kaman pɔɛŋ nɛ e beeŋ tiŋ m bɛta n yɔ kade nɛ e daŋ shile kumo to na.”

english_verse: The Israelites decided that the following three towns west of the Jordan River would be Safe Towns: Kedesh in Galilee in Naphtali's hill country, Shechem in Ephraim's hill country, and Kiriath-Arba in Judah's hill country. Kiriath-Arba is now called Hebron.
translation_verse: Amoso nde nɛ b lara ashi Jɔɔdan be lɔr na be epeŋitɔrkpa e daa la Kadɛsh nɛ k wɔ Galili ashi Naftali be abee be efuli so na nɛ Shɛkɛm nɛ kumo alɛ wɔ Efrayim be abee be efuli so na, nɛ Hibrɔn nɛ k wɔ Juda be abee be efuli so na.

english_verse: The Israelites had already decided on the following three towns east of the Jordan River: Bezer in the desert flatlands of Reuben, Ramoth in Gilead, which was a town that belonged to Gad, and Golan in Bashan, which belonged to Manasseh.
translation_verse: Jɔɔdan be lɔr na be epeŋilarkpa be kaba so ashi keshishɛrsawule na so na malɛ b daŋ lara Beza nɛ k wɔ Ruben be kasawule so na nɛ Ramɔf nɛ k wɔ Giliad ashi Gad be kasawule so na nɛ Golan nɛ k wɔ Bashan ashi Manase be kasawule so na.

english_verse: While the Israelites were still camped at Shiloh in the land of Canaan, the family leaders of the Levi tribe went to speak to the priest Eleazar, Joshua, and the family leaders of the other Israelite tribes. The leaders of Levi said, “The Lord told Moses that you have to give us towns and provide pastures for our animals.”
translation_verse: ashi Shilo nɛ k wɔ Keenan be kasawule so na n ya kaŋɛ bumo le: “Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ e bɔla Mosis so ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ b sa anyi nde nɛ anyeeŋ baa wɔtɔ nɛ nsawule nɛ anyi be asɔbɔya beeŋ baa ji.”

english_verse: Since the Lord had said this, the leaders of the other Israelite tribes agreed to give some of the towns and pastures from their tribal lands to Levi.
translation_verse: Amoso kananɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ na gbagba nɛ Israɛlebi na ta bumo be nde ko nɛ asɔbɔya be ejikpa be nsawule ashi bumo mpetɛ to n sa Livaiebi na.

english_verse: The leaders asked the Lord to show them in what order the clans of Levi would be given towns, and which towns each clan would receive. The Kohath clans were first. The descendants of Aaron, Israel's first priest, were given
translation_verse: Kohaf be kabuna be yiri to ebi ashi Livai be kanaŋ to e daŋ juŋkpar n nya nde. Basa nɛ b shi bɔrɛmatapo Ɛɛrɔn be yiri to daŋ nya nde kuduasa nna ashi Juda nɛ Simiɔn nɛ Bɛnjamin be kasawule so.

english_verse: The Lord had told Moses that he would show the Israelites which towns and pastures to give to the clans of Levi, and he did. Towns from Judah, Simeon, Benjamin
translation_verse: Israɛlebi daŋ to beri nna pɔɛŋ nseŋ chige le be nde ere nɛ amo be asɔbɔya be ejikpa be nsawule n sa Livaiebi na fanɛ kananɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ Mosis fanɛ e wora na.

english_verse: The descendants of Aaron from the Kohath clans of Levi were priests, and they were chosen to receive towns first. They were given
translation_verse: Nde kuduasa nɛ amo be asɔbɔya be ejikpa be nsawule nɛ b daŋ ta n sa bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ b la Ɛɛrɔn be kaman to ebi na.

english_verse: The Lord gave the Israelites the land he had promised their ancestors, and they captured it and settled in it.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na daŋ ta kasawule nɛ e nase kɔnɔ kpakpaso fanɛ e beeŋ sa bumo nananyɛnana na nna n sa Israɛlebi na. B ka kɔ n sɔ kasawule na nɛ b chena kumo so.

english_verse: There still were enemies around Israel, but the Lord kept his promise to let his people live in peace. And whenever the Israelites did have to go to war, no enemy could defeat them. The Lord always helped Israel win.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ daŋ sa bumo kagbenewushi nna ashi efuli na kikɛ so, fanɛ kananɛ e nase kɔnɔ n sa bumo nananyɛnana na. Bumo doŋana be ekama daa maŋ tiŋ m pɔɔ bumo so, ŋkpal manɛ so, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ daŋ sa Israɛlebi na eleŋ nna nɛ b kɔ m pɔɔ bumo doŋana kikɛ so.

english_verse: The Lord promised to do many good things for Israel, and he kept his promise every time.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be nnɔ nɛ e daŋ nase n sa Israɛlebi na kikɛ daŋ bɔlɔ so nna.

english_verse: Joshua held a meeting with the men of the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh, and he told them:
translation_verse: Joshuwa daŋ tre Ruben nɛ Gad nɛ Manase be epeŋilarkpa be yiri to ebi nna

english_verse: You have obeyed every command of the Lord your God and of his servant Moses. And you have done everything I've told you to do. It's taken a long time, but you have stayed and helped your relatives.
translation_verse: Men maŋ kini kechɛ men niopibiana Israɛlebi to. Kusɔ kama malɛ nɛ Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ menyi, menyi bɛ kumo kikɛ so.

english_verse: The Lord promised to give peace to your relatives, and that's what he has done. Now it's time for you to go back to your own homes in the land that Moses gave you east of the Jordan River.
translation_verse: Naniere Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na ka sa men niopibiana Israɛlebi kagbenewushi fanɛ kananɛ e nase kɔnɔ na ere, men bɛta n yɔ menyi be kasawule nɛ k wɔ Jɔɔdan be lɔr na be epeŋilarkpa be kaba so nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be kayɛrbi Mosis ta n sa menyi na so.

english_verse: Moses taught you to love the Lord your God, to be faithful to him, and to worship and obey him with your whole heart and with all your strength. So be very careful to do everything Moses commanded.
translation_verse: Ama men baa da so nsaa bɛ mbra nɛ Mosis sa menyi, fanɛ: ‘Men baa sha men Nyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na, nsaa wora mbe aparsheŋ. Men baa bɛ mbe mbra so, a ji kashenteŋ a sa mo, nsaa shuŋ mo nɛ men be ŋgbene nɛ ayoyu kikɛ.’ ”

english_verse: You've become rich from what you've taken from your enemies. You have big herds of cattle, lots of silver, gold, bronze, and iron, and plenty of clothes. Take everything home with you and share with the people of your tribe. I pray that God will be kind to you. You are now free to go home. The tribes of Reuben and Gad started back to Gilead, their own land. Moses had given the land of Bashan to the East Manasseh tribe, so they started back along with Reuben and Gad. God had told Moses that these two and a half tribes should conquer Gilead and Bashan, and they had done so. Joshua had given land west of the Jordan River to the other half of the Manasseh tribe, so they stayed at Shiloh in the land of Canaan with the rest of the Israelites.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ basa nɛ b shi Ruben nɛ Gad be yiri to na nɛ Manase be yiri nɛ k wɔ epeŋilarkpa be kaba so na bɛta n yɔ bumo pe ana. B daŋ yige Israɛlebi be basa nɛ b ka na nna ashi Shilo nɛ k wɔ Keenan na nseŋ bɛta n yɔ bumo gbagba be kasawule so ashi Giliad nɛ b kɔ n sɔ fanɛ kananɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ bɔla Mosis so ŋ kaŋɛ bumo kenishipereso na.

english_verse: The tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh reached the western side of the Jordan River valley and built a huge altar there beside the river. When the rest of the Israelites heard what these tribes had done,
translation_verse: Israɛlebi nɛ b ka na ka nu fanɛ b pɔr bɔrɛsure gboŋgboŋi ko Keenan be kasawule so ashi Gelilɔf nɛ k wɔ Jɔɔdan be lɔr be kaba ndoŋ na,

english_verse: the Israelite men met at Shiloh to get ready to attack the two and a half tribes.
translation_verse: nɛ bumo kikɛ shɛr ashi Shilo nɛ b bela ase n ya kɔ epeŋilarkpa be kaba so be eyiri ana na kena,

english_verse: But first they sent a priest, Phinehas the son of Eleazar, to talk with the two and a half tribes.
translation_verse: nseŋ shuŋi bɔrɛmatapo Eliaza pibinyɛn Finihas, Ruben nɛ Gad be eyiri nɛ Manase be epeŋilarkpa be yiri na kutɔ ashi Giliad be kasawule so.

english_verse: Each of the ten tribes at Shiloh sent the leader of one of its families along with Phinehas.
translation_verse: Bejuŋkparpo kudu nɛ b la Israɛlebi nɛ b wɔ Jɔɔdan be lɔr na be epeŋitɔrkpa be kaba so be eyiri yiri to na be basa koko e daŋ tu Finihas n yɔ.

english_verse: Phinehas and these leaders went to Gilead and met with the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh. They said:
translation_verse: B ka yɔ Giliad be kasawule so n ya tu Ruben nɛ Gad nɛ Manase be epeŋilarkpa be kaba so be basa na nɛ

english_verse: All of the Lord's people have gathered together and have sent us to find out why you are unfaithful to our God. You have turned your backs on the Lord by building that altar. Why are you rebelling against him?
translation_verse: b yili Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be basa na kikɛ be katelamu to ŋ kaŋɛ le: “Manɛ nna nɛ men wora le be kulubi ere ŋ gbiti Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ? Men ka kini kenu n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na so nɛ men pɔr bɔrɛsure ere n sa menyi gbagba be amu na! Men maŋ naa bɛ mo so nna na.

english_verse: Wasn't our people's sin at Peor terrible enough for you? The Lord punished us by sending a horrible sickness that killed many of us, and we still suffer because of that sin.
translation_verse: Men nyiŋi aleblawu nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ daŋ shin nɛ k ba mbe basa so ashi Piɔr ŋkpal alubi so na. An kraa ji awurfoŋ nna ŋkpal kumo so hale kabre. Loŋ be kulubi na nawule maŋ kukwe anyi a?

english_verse: Now you are turning your backs on the Lord again. If you don't stop rebelling against the Lord at once, he will be angry with the whole nation.
translation_verse: Ŋko menyee sha nna nɛ men pal kaman n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ? Men baŋ kini kenu n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kabre, echefoso, mo alɛ beeŋ nya agbo n wɔtɔ Israɛlebi kikɛ.

english_verse: If you don't think your land is a fit place to serve God, then move across the Jordan and live with us in the Lord's own land, where his sacred tent is located. But don't rebel against the Lord our God or against us by building another altar besides the Lord's own altar.
translation_verse: Nɛ kasawule nɛ men nya na maaŋ naa walɛ nɛ men baa bunyaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kumo so gba, men ba kasawule nɛ Enyɛnpe be wajɛbu wɔ kumo so na m ba sɔ kasawule ashi anyi kutɔ ŋ ki menyeya. Ama, men sa maŋ kini kenu n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nseŋ pɔr bɔrɛsure popɔr n ti mo peya na so.

english_verse: Don't you remember what happened when Achan was unfaithful and took some of the things that belonged to God? This made God angry with the entire nation. Achan died because he sinned, but he also caused the death of many others.
translation_verse: Men nyiŋi kananɛ Zɛra pibinyɛn Eekan kini kenu n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nseŋ ta asɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ fanɛ b mur na, nɛ Israɛlebi kikɛ luri kasogberge to ŋkpal loŋ so. Mannɛ Eekan nawule e daŋ wu ŋkpal mbe kulubi nɛ e wora na so.”

english_verse: The Lord is the greatest God! We ask him to be our witness, because he knows whether or not we were rebellious or unfaithful when we built that altar. If we were unfaithful, then we pray that God won't rescue us today. Let us tell you why we built that altar,
translation_verse: “Enyɛnpetale na nawule e la Ebɔrɛ! Mo nawule e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ. Mo nawule e nyi kusɔ nɛ k ba nɛ an pɔr bɔrɛsure ere. Anyi alɛ bee sha fanɛ menyi alɛ gba e pin kumo be loŋ nna. Nɛ fanɛ an kini kenu n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nna ŋko n wora kusoe kpakpaso bre, kumo ere men sa maŋ shin nɛ an ji efute

english_verse: and we ask the Lord to punish us if we are lying. We didn't build it so we could turn our backs on the Lord. We didn't even build it so we could offer animal or grain sacrifices to please the Lord or ask his blessing.
translation_verse: Nɛ fanɛ an wora Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kusoe kpakpaso nna nseŋ pɔr anyi gbagba be bɔrɛsure nɛ an baa chɔɔ esarga kumo so ŋko a lara ajibi be esarga ŋko a lara kɔnɔkoŋwule be esarga kumo so bre, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e gberge anyi kusoe.

english_verse: We built that altar because we were worried. Someday your descendants might tell our descendants, “The Lord made the Jordan River the boundary between us Israelites and you people of Reuben and Gad. The Lord is Israel's God, but you're not part of Israel, so you can't take part in worshiping the Lord.” Your descendants might say that and try to make our descendants stop worshiping and obeying the Lord.
translation_verse: E daŋ shin nna nɛ Jɔɔdan be lɔr na ki anyi Israɛlebi nɛ menyi be egbaŋ to. Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na la Israɛlebi nawule be Ebɔrɛ nna.’ Nɛ kumo be loŋ e shin nɛ an nanabiana e yige kebaabunyaŋ Enyɛnpe na.

english_verse: That's why we decided to build the altar. It isn't for offering sacrifices, not even sacrifices to please the Lord.
translation_verse: Amoso nɛ an pɔr bɔrɛsure nɛ an maaŋ baa chɔɔ asɔbɔya ŋko a lara sarga kumo so na.

english_verse: Phinehas and the clan leaders were pleased when they heard the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh explain why they had built the altar. Then Phinehas told them, “Today we know that the Lord is helping us. You have not been unfaithful to him, and this means that the Lord will not be angry with us.”
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ bɔrɛmatapo Eliaza pibinyɛn Finihas kaŋɛ bumo le: “Naniere bre an pin fanɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e chɛ anyi to nɛ an lɔŋɛ abar na. Ŋkpal manɛ so menyi maŋ kini kenu n sa mo, amoso nɛ men mɔlga Israɛlebi ashi Enyɛnpe na be kasogberge to na.”

english_verse: Phinehas and the clan leaders left Gilead and went back to Canaan to tell the Israelites about their meeting with the Reuben and Gad tribes.
translation_verse: Kede be kaman nɛ Finihas nɛ bejuŋkparpoana na yige bumo ashi Giliad be kasawule so nseŋ bɛta n yɔ Keenan n ya bɔ baru na n sa Israɛlebi na.

english_verse: The Israelites were happy and praised God. There was no more talk about going to war and wiping out the tribes of Reuben and Gad.
translation_verse: Israɛlebi ka nu baru na, nɛ k wora bumo ebel nɛ b di Ebɔrɛ epaŋ. Bumo alɛ maŋ naŋ malga keyaa kɔ kena n jija kasawule nɛ Rubenebi nɛ Gadebi nɛ Manase be epeŋilarkpa be basa tase so na be asheŋ kikɛ.

english_verse: The people of Reuben and Gad named the altar “A Reminder to Us All That the Lord Is Our God.”
translation_verse: Nɛ Israɛlebi nɛ b wɔ Jɔɔdan be lɔr na be epeŋilarkpa be kaba so na kaŋɛ: “Bɔrɛsure ere la shɛda nna a nyiŋi anyi fanɛ Enyɛnpe na la anyi kikɛ be Ebɔrɛ nna.” Ndoŋ nna nɛ b nase kumo “Shɛd.”

english_verse: The Lord let Israel live in peace with its neighbors for a long time, and Joshua lived to a ripe old age.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na daŋ sa Israɛlebi na ewushi nfɛ damta nna ashi bumo doŋana kutɔ. Joshuwa malɛ daŋ bel ga nna.

english_verse: One day he called a meeting of the leaders of the tribes of Israel, including the old men, the judges, and the officials. Then he told them: I am now very old.
translation_verse: Kachako nɛ e tre Israɛlebi be bejuŋkparpo kikɛ, benimu nɛ demujipoana nɛ bumo be ekrachi m ba kaŋɛ bumo le: “Naniere bre m bel.

english_verse: You have seen how the Lord your God fought for you and helped you defeat the nations who lived in this land.
translation_verse: Menyi kikɛ wu kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na wora efuliana na ŋkpal menyi so. Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e kɔ n sa menyi.

english_verse: There are still some nations left, but the Lord has promised you their land. So when you attack them, he will make them run away. I have already divided their land among your tribes, as I did with the land of the nations I defeated between the Jordan River and the Mediterranean Sea.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na gbagba beeŋ shin nɛ b bɛta n shile nɛ e ju bumo saŋɛ nɛ menyee ba na. Menyeeŋ sɔ bumo be kasawule na ŋ ki menyi be kapetɛ fanɛ kananɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nase kɔnɔ n sa menyi na.

english_verse: Be sure that you carefully obey everything written in The Book of the Law of Moses and do exactly what it says.
translation_verse: Amoso men baa da so nsaa bɛ kusɔ kama nɛ b sibɛ n nase Mosis be mbra be kawɔl na to na a maa gal mbra na be kekama a lɛ.

english_verse: Don't have anything to do with the nations that live around you. Don't worship their gods or pray to their idols or make promises in the names of their gods.
translation_verse: Men sa maa ji a tir kasawule na so be basa nɛ b ka a wɔ menyi to na. Men sa maa nase nnɔ bumo be agbir to ŋko a bɔ amo. Men sa maa shuŋ agbir na ŋko a bunyaŋ amo.

english_verse: Be as faithful to the Lord as you have always been.
translation_verse: Ama men ba ji kashenteŋ a sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na fanɛ kananɛ men chɛr a wora na.

english_verse: When you attacked powerful nations, the Lord made them run away, and no one has ever been able to stand up to you.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ju basagboŋ lempoana saŋɛ nɛ menyee ba na nna, nɛ bumo be ekama maŋ naŋ tiŋ n tu menyi ŋ kɔ.

english_verse: Any one of you can defeat a thousand enemy soldiers, because the Lord God fights for you, just as he promised.
translation_verse: Menyi be ekama beeŋ tiŋ ŋ kɔ basa kagboŋ m pɔɔ bumo so ŋkpal men Nyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ka bee kɔ a sa menyi fanɛ kananɛ e nase kɔnɔ fanɛ e beeŋ wora na so.

english_verse: Don't ever turn your backs on him by marrying people from the nations that are left in the land. Don't even make friends with them. I tell you that if you are friendly with those nations, the Lord won't chase them away when you attack. Instead, they'll be like a trap for your feet, a whip on your back, and thorns in your eyes. And finally, none of you will be left in this good land that the Lord has given you.
translation_verse: kumo ere men baa nyi fanɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na maaŋ naŋ ju basa ere saŋɛ nɛ menyee ba ere. Kumo be loŋ malɛ beeŋ shin nɛ b lubi ŋ ki fanɛ kejigbelɛ ŋko kejamaŋ nsaa besa fanɛ kramɔsha ka duŋ esa be kaman ŋko ewi ka da esa be kenishito na. Loŋ malɛ beeŋ baa wora nna hale nɛ men kikɛ e ya mur kasawule lela nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na sa menyi ere so.

english_verse: I will soon die, as everyone must. But deep in your hearts you know that the Lord has kept every promise he ever made to you. Not one of them has been broken.
translation_verse: Naniere bre ma luwu fo. Menyi alɛ be ekama nyi mbe kagbene to fanɛ asɔ lela kama nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nase kɔnɔ fanɛ e beeŋ sa na, men nya amo. Kusɔ kama nɛ e nase kɔnɔ fanɛ e beeŋ wora na kikɛ bɔlɔ so nyam.

english_verse: Yes, when the Lord makes a promise, he does what he has promised. But when he makes a threat, he will also do what he has threatened. The Lord is our God. He gave us this wonderful land and made an agreement with us that we would worship only him. But if you worship other gods, it will make the Lord furious. He will start getting rid of you, and soon not one of you will be left in this good land that he has given you.
translation_verse: Nɛ men baŋ maŋ bɛ kɔnɔ naseso be ŋkre nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ sa menyi na so nsaa wɔtɔ a shuŋ nsaa bunyaŋ agbir bre, kumo ere e beeŋ gberge menyi kusoe agbo so nɛ men paŋ kasawule lela nɛ e ta n sa menyi ere gba.”

english_verse: Joshua called the tribes of Israel together for a meeting at Shechem. He asked the leaders, including the old men, the judges, and the officials, to come up and stand near the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Joshuwa tre Israɛl be eyiriana na kikɛ m ba Shɛchem. Bumo be benimuana nɛ bejuŋkparpo nɛ demujipoana nɛ ekrachiana nɛ e daŋ tre m ba Ebɔrɛ be anishito

english_verse: Then Joshua told everyone to listen to this message from the Lord, the God of Israel: Long ago your ancestors lived on the other side of the Euphrates River, and they worshiped other gods. This continued until the time of your ancestor Terah and his two sons, Abraham and Nahor.
translation_verse: m ba kaŋɛ bumo kikɛ le: “Enyɛnpe Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na yɛ: ‘Dra dra na men nananyɛnana daa wɔ lɔr nɛ baa tre Yufreetes na be kaba ndoŋ nna, a shuŋ agbir. Bumo be eko e daa la Tɛɛra nɛ e la Eebraham nɛ Nahɔɔ bumo tuto na.

english_verse: But I brought Abraham across the Euphrates River and led him through the land of Canaan. I blessed him by giving him Isaac, the first in a line of many descendants.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ n lara men nananyɛn Eebraham ashi Yufreetes be kaba ndoŋ n ya ta mo n nite Keenan be kasawule so kikɛ. N daŋ sa mo ebinyɛn nɛ baa tre mo Aizek nɛ e ki kanaŋ damtawura.

english_verse: Then I gave Isaac two sons, Jacob and Esau. I gave Esau the hill country of Mount Seir, but your ancestor Jacob and his children went to live in Egypt.
translation_verse: N sa Aizek malɛ mbinyɛnbi anyɔ nɛ baa tre Jeekɔb nɛ Isɔɔ na. Edɔm be abee be kasawule na be kaba so nɛ n ta n sa Isɔɔ fanɛ mbe kapetɛ, ama Jeekɔb bre nɛ mbe mbia daŋ yɔ Ijipt nna.

english_verse: Later I sent Moses and his brother Aaron to help your people, and I made all those horrible things happen to the Egyptians. I brought your ancestors out of Egypt, but the Egyptians got in their chariots and on their horses and chased your ancestors, catching up with them at the Red Sea.
translation_verse: Ŋ ka lara bumo Ijipt be efuli so na, Ijiptebi na daŋ dii egbaŋɛturko nɛ egbaŋɛ nna n ju m buu bumo so. Ama men nananyɛnana ka fo Teku Peper na ase nɛ

english_verse: Your people cried to me for help, so I put a dark cloud between them and the Egyptians. Then I opened up the sea and let your people walk across on dry ground. But when the Egyptians tried to follow, I commanded the sea to swallow them, and they drowned while you watched. You lived in the desert for a long time,
translation_verse: b shu ŋ ŋini ma fanɛ n chɛ bumo to. Nɛ n ta tentembiri n wɔtɔ bumo nɛ Ijiptebi na be kefɛato nseŋ shin nɛ teku na ba mur Ijiptebi na kikɛ. Menyi gbagba ere wu kusɔ nɛ n wora Ijiptebi na. Kumo be kaman nɛ men daŋ chena keshishɛrsawule so n chɛr ga.

english_verse: then I brought you into the land east of the Jordan River. The Amorites were living there, and they fought you. But with my help, you defeated them, wiped them out, and took their land.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ n lara menyi m ba Amɔriebi nɛ b wɔ Jɔɔdan be lɔr na be epeŋilarkpa na be kasawule so. B daŋ kɔ menyi kena nna ama n chɛ menyi to nɛ men pɔɔ bumo so. N daŋ mur bumo saŋɛ nɛ menyee ba na nna nɛ men sɔ bumo be nsawule.

english_verse: King Balak decided that his nation Moab would go to war against you, so he asked Balaam to come and put a curse on you.
translation_verse: Zippɔ pibinyɛn Balak nɛ e la Mowab be efuli so be ewura na ka daŋ wora shiriya nɛ e ya kɔ Israɛl kena, e daŋ shuŋi Biyɔɔ pibinyɛn Balaam nna fanɛ e ya sho menyi kɔnɔ.

english_verse: But I wouldn't listen to Balaam, and I rescued you by making him bless you instead of curse you.
translation_verse: Ama ma alɛ maŋ nu n sa Balaam nseŋ shin nɛ e kilgi n nɛfa menyi nɛ m mɔlga menyi ashi Balak be enɔ to.

english_verse: You crossed the Jordan River and came to Jericho. The rulers of Jericho fought you, and so did the Amorites, the Perizzites, the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Girgashites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites. I helped you defeat them all.
translation_verse: Men ka dii Jɔɔdan be lɔr na m ba Jɛriko, nɛ Jɛriko be basa na kɔ menyi kena. Loŋ gbagba nɛ Amɔriebi nɛ Pɛrizebi nɛ Keenanebi nɛ Hitebi nɛ Gɛgashebi nɛ Hivebi nɛ Jebusiebi daŋ kɔ menyi. Ama n shin nɛ men kɔ m pɔɔ bumo kikɛ so.

english_verse: Your enemies ran from you, but not because you had swords and bows and arrows. I made your enemies panic and run away, as I had done with the two Amorite kings east of the Jordan River.
translation_verse: Mannɛ menyi be etokobi nɛ ata nɛ men daŋ ta m pɔɔ bumo so. Kufu nɛ n daŋ ta n wɔtɔ bumo to fanɛ kananɛ n daŋ wora Amɔriebi be bewura anyɔ nɛ b wɔ Jɔɔdan be lɔr na be epeŋilarkpa na.

english_verse: You didn't have to work for this land—I gave it to you. Now you live in towns you didn't build, and you eat grapes and olives from vineyards and trees you didn't plant.
translation_verse: N sa menyi kasawule nɛ menyi maŋ dɔ, nɛ nde nɛ menyi maŋ pɔr. Naniere men wɔ ndoŋ a ji asɔrso nɛ baa tre greeps nɛ men maŋ du, nsaa chuge asɔrso nɛ baa tre ɔlifs ashi ndibi nɛ men maŋ du so.’ ”

english_verse: Then Joshua told the people: Worship the Lord, obey him, and always be faithful. Get rid of the idols your ancestors worshiped when they lived on the other side of the Euphrates River and in Egypt.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ Joshuwa naŋ kaŋɛ: “Amoso, men baa ŋana Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nsaa shuŋ mo nɛnɛ kashenteŋto. Men ta men nananyɛnana be agbir nɛ b daa shuŋ saŋɛ nɛ b daa wɔ Yufreetes be lɔr be kaba ndoŋ nɛ Ijipt be kasawule so na kikɛ n lɛ nsaa shuŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nawule.

english_verse: But if you don't want to worship the Lord, then choose here and now! Will you worship the same idols your ancestors did? Or since you're living on land that once belonged to the Amorites, maybe you'll worship their gods. I won't. My family and I are going to worship and obey the Lord!
translation_verse: Ama nɛ kushuŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na maa par menyi bre, kumo ere men lara esa nɛ menyeeŋ baa shuŋ kabre. Nɛ menyeeŋ baa shuŋ agbir nɛ men nananyɛnana daŋ shuŋ Yufreetes be lɔr na be kaba ndoŋ ŋko Amɔriebi nɛ men wɔ bumo be kasawule so ere be agbir nɛ menyeeŋ baa shuŋ, men baa shuŋ! Ma ere nɛ ma laŋ to ebi bre beeŋ shuŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.”

english_verse: The people answered: We could never worship other gods or stop worshiping the Lord.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ basa na kaŋɛ: “Anyi maaŋ yige keshuŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nseŋ ya kaa shuŋ agbir.

english_verse: The Lord is our God. We were slaves in Egypt as our ancestors had been, but we saw the Lord work miracles to set our people free and to bring us out of Egypt. Even though other nations were all around us, the Lord protected us wherever we went.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ka lara anyi nɛ an tutoana kenyaya to ashi Ijipt be kasawule so na, an wu emamachisheŋ nɛ e daŋ wora. Mo e daŋ kuŋ anyi ashi anyi be enite kikɛ to ashi efuli kama so nɛ an bɔla n choŋ.

english_verse: And when we fought the Amorites and the other nations that lived in this land, the Lord made them run away. Yes, we will worship and obey the Lord, because the Lord is our God.
translation_verse: An ka bee ba kasawule ere so na nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ju Amɔriebi nɛ b wɔ kumo so na kikɛ. Amoso anyi alɛ gba beeŋ shuŋ Enyɛnpe na. Mo e la an be Ebɔrɛ.”

english_verse: Joshua said: The Lord is fearsome; he is the one true God, and I don't think you are able to worship and obey him in the ways he demands. You would have to be completely faithful, and if you sin or rebel, he won't let you get away with it.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Joshuwa kaŋɛ basa na le: “Ashere menyi maaŋ tiŋ n shuŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na. E la Ebɔrɛ cheembi nna. Mo alɛ maaŋ ta menyi be alubi m paŋ menyi, ŋkpal manɛ so, e maa sha kechamana be asheŋ.

english_verse: If you turn your backs on the Lord and worship the gods of other nations, the Lord will turn against you. He will make terrible things happen to you and wipe you out, even though he had been good to you before.
