Fo alɛ gba daga luwu nna, ama ma alɛ maaŋ shin nɛ b mɔ fo naniere ŋkpal manɛ so, saŋɛ so nɛ fo daa wɔ n tuto Deevid kutɔ na, fo nɛ mo e daa ji mbe awurfoŋ kikɛ nɛ fo alɛ daŋ naa keni Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be ŋkre be deka na so.”

english_verse: But I won't let you be a priest of the Lord anymore. And so the promise that the Lord had made at Shiloh about the family of Eli came true. Joab Is Killed
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ ewura Sɔlɔmɔn ju Abiata ashi Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be kabɔrɛmata be kushuŋ to, nɛ kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ malga dra dra ashi Shilo a laŋɛ bɔrɛmatapo Eli nɛ mbe kaman to ebi be asheŋ na kikɛ e bɔlɔ so.

english_verse: Joab had not helped Absalom try to become king, but he had helped Adonijah. So when Joab learned that Adonijah had been killed, he ran to the sacred tent and grabbed hold of the corners of the altar for protection.
translation_verse: Adonija nɛ Jɔab daa chɛ to nɛ e ki ewura, mannɛ Absalɔm, amoso e ka nu fanɛ Adonija wu nɛ e shile n yɔ Enyɛnpe be wajɛbu na ase n ya pɛ bɔrɛsure na be abonfu to be asɔ nɛ a duli alambɛ na to ŋ keta nɛ e kuŋ mbe kumu.

english_verse: When Solomon heard about this, he sent someone to ask Joab, “Why did you run to the altar?” Joab sent back his answer, “I was afraid of you, and I ran to the Lord for protection.” Then Solomon shouted, “Benaiah, go kill Joab!”
translation_verse: B ka kaŋɛ ewura Sɔlɔmɔn fanɛ Jɔab shile n yɔ wajɛbu cheembi na to n ya yili bɔrɛsure na ase na, nɛ Sɔlɔmɔn shuŋi kabɔ fanɛ e ya bishi Jɔab kusɔ nɛ k ba nɛ e shile n yɔ bɔrɛsure na ase. Nɛ Jɔab kaŋɛ fanɛ ŋkpal e ka daa ŋana Sɔlɔmɔn na so nɛ e daŋ wora loŋ. Ndoŋ nna nɛ ewura Sɔlɔmɔn ponte ŋ kaŋɛ Bɛnaya fanɛ e ya mɔ Jɔab.

english_verse: Benaiah went to the sacred tent and yelled, “Joab, the king orders you to come out!” “No!” Joab answered. “Kill me right here.” Benaiah went back and told Solomon what Joab had said.
translation_verse: Nɛ Bɛnaya ya luri Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be wajɛbu na to ŋ kaŋɛ Jɔab le: “Ewura bee tre fo.” Nɛ Jɔab malɛ kaŋɛ le: “M-m, men yige ma nɛ n wu nfe.” Nɛ Bɛnaya bɛta n ya kaŋɛ Ewura na kusɔ nɛ Jɔab kaŋɛ.

english_verse: Solomon replied: Do what Joab said. Kill him and bury him! Then my family and I won't be responsible for what he did to Abner the commander of Israel's army and to Amasa the commander of Judah's army. He killed those innocent men without my father knowing about it. Both of them were better men than Joab. Now the Lord will make him pay for those murders.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal e ka mɔ Abna nɛ e la Israɛl be benapo be enimu nɛ Amasa nɛ mo alɛ la Juda be benapo be enimu nɛ n tuto ewura Deevid maŋ nyi na so, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ beeŋ gberge mo kusoe.

english_verse: Benaiah went back and killed Joab. His body was taken away and buried near his home in the desert.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Bɛnaya yɔ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be wajɛbu na to n ya mɔ Jɔab nɛ b ta mbe kebuni m puli keshishɛrsawule so ashi mbe kade to.

english_verse: Solomon put Benaiah in Joab's place as army commander, and he put Zadok in Abiathar's place as priest. Shimei Is Killed
translation_verse: Nɛ Ewura Sɔlɔmɔn ta Banaya n yili Jɔab be eyilikpa nɛ e ki mbe benapo be enimu, nseŋ ta bɔrɛmatapo Zadɔk malɛ n yili Abiata be eyilikpa nɛ e ki mbe bɔrɛmatapo. Shimei be luwu be asheŋ

english_verse: Solomon sent for Shimei and said, “Build a house here in Jerusalem and live in it. But whatever you do, don't leave the city!
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ ewura na shuŋi n tre Shimei ŋ kaŋɛ mo le: “Pɔr ebu Jerusalɛm nfe a wɔ kumo to. Sa maŋ kaŋ lar kade ere to kikɛ.

english_verse: If you ever cross Kidron Valley and leave Jerusalem, you will be killed. And it will be your own fault.”
translation_verse: Fo baŋ wora alefasha n lar kade ere to n dii ketaŋɛ nɛ baa tre Kidrɔn ere gba, feeŋ wu nɛ fo luwu malɛ be turju e baa bɛ fo.”

english_verse: “That's fair, Your Majesty,” Shimei answered. “I'll do that.” So Shimei lived in Jerusalem from then on.
translation_verse: Nɛ Shimei kaŋɛ: “K nyalɛ Yiramu! Meeŋ wora kusɔ nɛ fo kaŋɛ ere kikɛ.” Amoso e daŋ chena Jerusalɛm n chɛr ga.

english_verse: About three years later, two of Shimei's servants ran off to King Achish in Gath. When Shimei found out where they were,
translation_verse: Kumo be nfɛ asa be kaman nɛ Shimei be anya be benyɔ shile n yɔ Maaka pibinyɛn Akish nɛ e la kade nɛ baa tre Gaaf na be ewura na kutɔ,

english_verse: Someone told Solomon that Shimei had gone to Gath and was back.
translation_verse: Ewura Sɔlɔmɔn ka nu kusɔ nɛ Shimei wora,

english_verse: Solomon sent for him and said: Shimei, you promised in the name of the Lord that you would never leave Jerusalem. I warned you that you would die if you did. You agreed that this was fair, didn't you?
translation_verse: nɛ e shuŋi n tre mo nseŋ kaŋɛ mo le: “N daŋ shin nna nɛ fo nase kɔnɔ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be ketre to fanɛ fo maaŋ lar Jerusalɛm to. Ma alɛ kpele fo kusoe fanɛ fo kaŋ baŋ pɛl n lar kumo to feeŋ wu nɛ fo shuli so n sa ma.

english_verse: You have disobeyed me and have broken the promise you made to the Lord.
translation_verse: Nɛ manɛ e ba nɛ fo maŋ bɛ fo gbagba be kɔnɔ nɛ fo nase ashi Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be anishito na so nɛ ma mbra so?

english_verse: I know you remember all the cruel things you did to my father David. Now the Lord is going to punish you for what you did.
translation_verse: Fo gbagba ere nyi kulubi nɛ fo wora n tuto ewura Deevid. Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na malɛ beeŋ gberge fo kusoe n tal to.

english_verse: But the Lord will bless me and make my father's kingdom strong forever.
translation_verse: Ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ beeŋ nɛfa ma nseŋ lɔŋɛ n tuto ewura Deevid be kuwurji n yili to kpakpa hale mbaanaayɔ.”

english_verse: “Benaiah,” Solomon shouted, “kill Shimei.” So Shimei died. Solomon was now in complete control of his kingdom.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ Ewura Sɔlɔmɔn kaŋɛ Bɛnaya fanɛ e ya mɔ Shimei, nɛ e ya mɔ mo. Ndoŋ nna nɛ ewura Sɔlɔmɔn be kuwurji wora eleŋ n ti so.

english_verse: At that time, there was no temple for worshiping the Lord, and everyone offered sacrifices at the local shrines.
translation_verse: Kumo be saŋɛ na nɛ b maŋ naŋ pɔr bɔrɛlambu n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na, ŋkpal loŋ so abee so be mboŋ ko nɛ ekama daa yɔ n ya kaa bunyaŋ Ebɔrɛ nsaa lara sarga.

english_verse: I'll also give you what you didn't ask for. You'll be rich and respected as long as you live, and you'll be greater than any other king.
translation_verse: Meeŋ ta asɔ nɛ fo maŋ kule ma gba n ti fo so. Meeŋ sa fo kedamaya nɛ amansherbi nseŋ shin nɛ fo ketre e dii a chɔ bewura kama nɛ b juŋkpar fo nɛ bumo nɛ baaŋ ba fo kaman kikɛ.

english_verse: One night while Solomon was in Gibeon, the Lord God appeared to him in a dream and said, “Solomon, ask for anything you want, and I will give it to you.”
translation_verse: Kamɔnchɛ be kanyɛso gbagba nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ lara mbe kumu ŋ ŋini ewura Sɔlɔmɔn edare to m bishi mo le: “Manɛ nɛ fee sha ŋ ka wora n sa fo?”

english_verse: Solomon answered: My father David, your servant, was honest and did what you commanded. You were always loyal to him, and you gave him a son who is now king.
translation_verse: Nɛ ewura Sɔlɔmɔn kaŋɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ le: “Fo kasha nɛ fo kɔ n sa fo kayɛrbi, n tuto Ewura Deevid na maa chɛrga kikɛ. Mo alɛ daa la esa lela nna nsaa ji kashenteŋ a sa fo. Naniere fo shin nɛ mbe kebia yili mbe katelamu to ŋ ki ewura.

english_verse: Lord God, I'm your servant, and you've made me king in my father's place. But I'm very young and know so little about being a leader.
translation_verse: O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, fo shin nɛ n sɔ n tuto so n ji kuwura. Ama n du fanɛ kebibi nna nsaa maŋ nyi kananɛ kejuŋkpar basa be asheŋ du.

english_verse: And now I must rule your chosen people, even though there are too many of them to count.
translation_verse: Naniere, ma nɛ fo ta ŋ ki fo basa nɛ fo lara nɛ b shibi m baŋ so kekarga na be ewura,

english_verse: Please make me wise and teach me the difference between right and wrong. Then I will know how to rule your people. If you don't, there is no way I could rule this great nation of yours.
translation_verse: amoso jande sa ma kanyiasheŋ nɛ nfɛra nɛ meeŋ ta a pin kulubi nɛ kelela. Saŋɛ na so meeŋ tiŋ n ji bumo so kuwura nɛnɛ; nɛ mannɛ aloŋ, nuso nɛ meeŋ tiŋ n wora n ji fo basa damta ere kikɛ so kuwura?”

english_verse: God said: Solomon, I'm pleased that you asked for this. You could have asked to live a long time or to be rich. Or you could have asked for your enemies to be destroyed. Instead, you asked for wisdom to make right decisions.
translation_verse: Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ ewura Sɔlɔmɔn le: “Fo kule kusɔ nɛ k walɛ. Fo maŋ kule kedamaya ŋko amansherbi ŋko fo doŋana be luwu ŋko ŋkpa tenteŋ n sa fo kumu ama kanyiasheŋ nɛ nfɛra nɛ fo kule ma nɛ fo tiŋ n ji ma basa nɛ n ta fo ŋ ki bumo be ewura na so kuwura nɛnɛ.

english_verse: If you obey me and follow my commands, as your father David did, I'll let you live a long time.
translation_verse: Nɛ fo baa nu a sa ma nsaa bɛ ma mbra so fanɛ kananɛ fo tuto ewura Deevid daa bɛ ma so na bre, ma alɛ beeŋ teŋi fo ŋkpa so.”

english_verse: Solomon woke up and realized that God had spoken to him in the dream. He went back to Jerusalem and stood in front of the sacred chest, where he offered sacrifices to please the Lord and sacrifices to ask his blessing. Then Solomon gave a feast for his officials. Solomon Makes a Difficult Decision
translation_verse: Ewura Sɔlɔmɔn ka tiŋi edi to nɛ e pin fanɛ Ebɔrɛ e daŋ malga mo kutɔ edare to. Ndoŋ nna nɛ e yɔ Jerusalɛm n ya yili Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be ŋkre be deka na be anishito n lara sarga chɔɔso nɛ kɔnɔkoŋwuleso be sarga n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ. Kumo be kaman nɛ e wora kejigboŋ n sa mbe benimuana. Sɔlɔmɔn ka ji demu kpakpaso be asheŋ

english_verse: One day two women came to King Solomon,
translation_verse: Kachako nɛ beche anyɔ ko ba ewura Sɔlɔmɔn kutɔ.

english_verse: and one of them said: Your Majesty, this woman and I live in the same house. Not long ago my baby was born at home,
translation_verse: Nɛ bumo be eko kaŋɛ le: “Yiramu, ma nɛ kache ere e wɔ laŋ koŋwule to nɛ ŋ kurge ebinyɛn ndoŋ.

english_verse: One night while we were all asleep, she rolled over on her baby, and he died.
translation_verse: Kachako kanyɛso nɛ kache ere wora edeselɔ ŋ gbelti n dese mbe kebia so m mɔ.

english_verse: Then while I was still asleep, she got up and took my son out of my bed. She put him in her bed, then she put her dead baby next to me.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ e koso kiidiso saŋɛ nɛ n dese a di na m ba ta ma ere pibi na nseŋ ta mbe kebia nɛ e wu na m ba nase ma edesekpa.

english_verse: In the morning when I got up to feed my son, I saw that he was dead. But when I looked at him in the light, I knew he wasn't my son.
translation_verse: Kare ka chɛ kachipurso nɛ mee sha kesa ma kebia kenyipo, nseŋ keni nɛ e wu. Ŋ ka keni mo nɛnɛ nɛ n wu fanɛ mannɛ m pibinyɛn na nna.”

english_verse: “No!” the other woman shouted. “He was your son. My baby is alive!” “The dead baby is yours,” the first woman yelled. “Mine is alive!” They argued back and forth in front of Solomon,
translation_verse: Nɛ eche nyɔsopo na malɛ kaŋɛ le: “K maŋ la kashenteŋ! Kebia nɛ e maŋ wu na la meya nna, nɛ emo nɛ e wu na malɛ la feya!” Nɛ b yili ewura na be anishito a ji emɔrɔ.

english_verse: Someone bring me a sword.” A sword was brought, and Solomon ordered,
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ ewura Sɔlɔmɔn shin nɛ b ya fin tokobi m bar mo,

english_verse: “Please don't kill my son,” the baby's mother screamed. “Your Majesty, I love him very much, but give him to her. Just don't kill him.” The other woman shouted, “Go ahead and cut him in half. Then neither of us will have the baby.”
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ kuwɔr pɛ kebia na mo nio gbagba nɛ e kaŋɛ ewura na le: “Jande, Yiramu, sa maŋ mɔ kebia na! Ta mo n sa mbarkasa na.” Ama eche nyɔsopo na bre daŋ kaŋɛ le nna: “Sa maŋ ta kebia na n sa anyi be ekama; barga mo to anyɔ n sa anyi.”

english_verse: Solomon said, “Don't kill the baby.” Then he pointed to the first woman, “She is his real mother. Give the baby to her.”
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ ewura Sɔlɔmɔn kaŋɛ le: “Men sa maŋ naŋ mɔ kebia na! Men ta mo n sa eche sososo na, ŋkpal manɛ so, mo e la kebia na mo nio gbagba.”

english_verse: Everyone in Israel was amazed when they heard how Solomon had made his decision. They realized that God had given him wisdom to judge fairly.
translation_verse: Israɛl be basa ka nu kananɛ Ewura Sɔlɔmɔn ji asheŋ na nɛ b ta bunyaŋ gboŋgboŋi n sa mo ŋkpal b ka pin fanɛ Ebɔrɛ e sa mo loŋ be kanyiasheŋ nɛ e tiŋ n ji le be asheŋ kpakpaso ere nɛnɛ so.

english_verse: These were the twelve officers: The son of Hur was in charge of the hill country of Ephraim.
translation_verse: Benimu kuduanyɔ na nɛ abonfu nɛ baa keni so na be atre nde. Bɛnhur e daa keni kebee so be efuli nɛ k wɔ Efrayim na be kebonfu so.

english_verse: The son of Deker was in charge of the towns of Makaz, Shaalbim, Beth-Shemesh, and Elon-Beth-Hanan.
translation_verse: Bɛndɛka malɛ e daa keni kebonfu nɛ Maakaz nɛ Shaalbim nɛ Bɛf Shɛmɛsh nɛ Elɔn nɛ Bɛf Hanan be nde wɔ na so.

english_verse: The son of Abinadab was in charge of Naphath-Dor and was married to Solomon's daughter Taphath.
translation_verse: Bɛnabinadab nɛ e daŋ ta ewura Sɔlɔmɔn pibiche Taphaf na, e daa keni Nafaaf Dɔɔ be kebonfu be kaba na kikɛ so.

english_verse: The son of Geber was in charge of the town of Ramoth in Gilead and the villages in Gilead belonging to the family of Jair, a descendant of Manasseh. He was also in charge of the region of Argob in Bashan, which had
translation_verse: Bɛngeba e daa keni Ramɔf be kade nɛ k wɔ Giliad na, nɛ ndewurbi nɛ a wɔ kumo be kasawule so nsaa la Jair nɛ e la Manase be kaman to ebi na peya na so. Mo koŋwule na e daŋ naa keni Agob be kebonfu nɛ k wɔ Bashan be kasawule so nsaa kɔ nde adeshe nɛ b pɔr egbal ŋ kulti amo nseŋ ta danyaŋ n lɔŋɛ amo be akuloŋgboŋana na kikɛ so.

english_verse: Ahinadab son of Iddo was in charge of the territory of Mahanaim.
translation_verse: Ido pibinyɛn Ahinadab e daa keni Mahanayim be kebonfu na so.

english_verse: Ahimaaz was in charge of the territory of Naphtali and was married to Solomon's daughter Basemath.
translation_verse: Ahimaaz nɛ e daŋ ta ewura Sɔlɔmɔn pibiche Basmat na, e daa keni Naftali be kebonfu na so.

english_verse: Baana son of Hushai was in charge of the territory of Asher and the town of Bealoth.
translation_verse: Hushai pibinyɛn Baana e daa keni Asha be kebonfu nɛ Bialɔf be kade to so.

english_verse: Jehoshaphat son of Paruah was in charge of the territory of Issachar.
translation_verse: Paruwa pibinyɛn Jehoshafat e daa keni Issaka be kebonfu na so.

english_verse: Shimei son of Ela was in charge of the territory of Benjamin.
translation_verse: Ela pibinyɛn Shimei e daa keni Bɛnjamin be kebonfu na so.

english_verse: Geber son of Uri was in charge of Gilead, where King Sihon of the Amorites and King Og of Bashan had lived. And one officer was in charge of the territory of Judah. The Size of Solomon's Kingdom
translation_verse: Uri pibinyɛn Gɛba e daa keni Giliad be kakpa nɛ Amɔriebi be ewura Sihɔn nɛ Bashan be ewura Ɔg daa wɔ dra dra na so. Basa kuduanyɔ ere be kaman, b daa kɔ esa koŋwule nɛ e la kasawule na kikɛ so be gomena nna. Ewura Sɔlɔmɔn be efuli be asheŋ

english_verse: Everyone living in Israel, from the town of Dan in the north to Beersheba in the south, was safe as long as Solomon lived. Each family sat undisturbed beneath its own grape vines and fig trees.
translation_verse: Juda nɛ Israɛl be efuli nɛ k yili Dan nɛ k wɔ kelargato be esoso n ya fo Bɛshiba ashi kelargato be kaseto kikɛ daa kɔ kayurwushi nna saŋɛ nɛ ewura Sɔlɔmɔn wɔ ŋkpa to na. Ekama nɛ mbe kanaŋ daa chena mbe kefeelebi nɛ k bee sɔr asɔrso nɛ baa tre greep na nɛ figi be ndibi be afito kagbenewushiso nna.

english_verse: Each of the twelve regional officers brought food to Solomon and his household for one month of the year. They provided everything he needed,
translation_verse: Mbe benimu kuduanyɔ nɛ baa keni mbe efuli be abonfu so na be ekama daa bar mo nɛ mbe kanaŋ ajibi kufɔl kufɔl nna a ka sa abar hale nɛ kafɛ e ba chambɔ. B daa sa ewura Sɔlɔmɔn kusɔ kama nɛ e daa sha nna.

english_verse: as well as barley and straw for the horses. Solomon's Wisdom
translation_verse: B daa bar ayu nɛ afitiri nna m ba kaa sa egbaŋɛ na saŋɛ nɛ k daga.

english_verse: Solomon was brilliant. God had blessed him with insight and understanding.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ daŋ sa ewura Sɔlɔmɔn kanyiasheŋ nɛ asheŋ be kepinto nɛ nfɛra alegaiso nna.

english_verse: He was wiser than anyone else in the world, including the wisest people of the east and of Egypt. He was even wiser than Ethan the Ezrahite, and Mahol's three sons, Heman, Calcol, and Darda. Solomon became famous in every country around Judah and Israel.
translation_verse: E daa nyi asheŋ a chɔ esa kikɛ ashi durnya to. E daa nyi asheŋ a chɔ Eetan nɛ e shi Ɛzra be kanaŋ to na nɛ Heman nɛ Kalkol nɛ Daada nɛ b la Mahɔl be mbinyɛnsobi na. Mbe ketre daŋ dii ga n yɔ efuli nɛ a kulti Juda nɛ Israɛl na.

english_verse: He could talk about all kinds of plants, from large trees to small bushes, and he taught about animals, birds, reptiles, and fish.
translation_verse: E daŋ malga ndibigboŋana nɛ awurbi nɛ afitiri be yiri yiri be asheŋ, nseŋ ŋini asɔbɔya nɛ mbuibi nɛ asɔ gbeyeso nɛ ekɔrɔtɔ kikɛ be asheŋ.

english_verse: Kings all over the world heard about Solomon's wisdom and sent people to listen to him teach.
translation_verse: Durnya be bewura kikɛ nu mbe kanyiasheŋ be asheŋ nseŋ shuŋi basa nɛ b ya nu mbe kanyiasheŋ be mmalga.

english_verse: King Hiram of Tyre had always been friends with Solomon's father David. When Hiram learned that Solomon was king, he sent some of his officials to meet with Solomon.
translation_verse: Ewura Deevid mo teri kpakpaso e daa la Hiram nɛ e la Tayɛ be kade be ewura na, amoso e ka nu fanɛ Sɔlɔmɔn e sɔ mo tuto so n ji kuwura, nɛ e shuŋi mbe benimu fanɛ b ya chɔrɔ mo.

english_verse: The Lord God promised my father that when his son became king, he would build a temple for worshiping the Lord. So I've decided to do that.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ka nase kɔnɔ n sa n tuto ewura Deevid fanɛ mbe kebia e naaŋ ba ki ewura nseŋ pɔr bɔrɛlambu nɛ baaŋ baa bunyaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kumo to mbe kaman na so nɛ n yili kumo fanɛ meeŋ pɔr kumo nɛ b baa bunyaŋ Enyɛnpe ma Ebɔrɛ na kumo to.

english_verse: I'd like you to send your workers to cut down cedar trees in Lebanon for me. I will pay them whatever you say and will even have my workers help them. We both know that your workers are more experienced than anyone else at cutting lumber.
translation_verse: Amoso chɛ ma to nseŋ shuŋi fo basa nɛ b yɔ Lebanɔn n ya ku ndoŋ be ndibi gboŋgboŋi nɛ baa tre sida na m bar ma. Bumo nɛ ma basa beeŋ baa shuŋ nɛ ŋ ka fo basa na kanaŋkama nɛ feeŋ sɔ ma, ŋkpal manɛ so ma basa maŋ nyi ndibi be kushuŋ fanɛ fo basa.”

english_verse: Hiram was so happy when he heard Solomon's request that he said, “I am grateful that the Lord gave David such a wise son to be king of that great nation!”
translation_verse: Ewura Sɔlɔmɔn be kubɔya ere ka tu ewura Hiram, nɛ mbe kagbene fuli mo ga m baŋ so. Nɛ e kaŋɛ le: “Kemaŋkura e baa la Eyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na peya ŋkpal e ka sa ewura Deevid kebianyiashempo nɛ e sɔ mo so n ji efuli lempo ere be kuwura so.”

english_verse: My workers will carry them down from Lebanon to the Mediterranean Sea. They will tie the logs together and float them along the coast to wherever you want them. Then they will untie the logs, and your workers can take them from there. To pay for the logs, you can provide the grain I need for my household.

english_verse: You know what is in everyone's heart. So from your home in heaven answer their prayers, according to the way they live and what is in their hearts.

english_verse: Then your people will worship and obey you for as long as they live in the land you gave their ancestors.
translation_verse: saŋɛ na so fo basa beeŋ baa bunyaŋ fo nsaa nu a sa fo ashi kasawule nɛ fo ta n sa an nananyɛnana ere so.

english_verse: listen from your home in heaven and answer their prayers. Then everyone on earth will worship you, just like your people Israel, and they will know that I have built this temple to honor you.
translation_verse: kumo ere fo yili esoso n nu bumo be kekule nseŋ wora kusɔ nɛ baa sha n sa bumo, saŋɛ na so durnya be basa kikɛ beeŋ pin fo nsaa nu a sa fo fanɛ kananɛ fo basa Israɛlebi bee nu a sa fo na. Loŋ nɛ baaŋ pin fanɛ bɔrɛlambu nɛ m pɔr ere la kakpa nɛ k daga b ka bee bunyaŋ fo nna.

english_verse: Our Lord, sometimes you will order your people to attack their enemies. Then your people will turn toward this temple I have built for you in your chosen city, and they will pray to you.
translation_verse: Fo kaŋ kaŋɛ fo basa kenishipereso fanɛ b ya kɔ bumo doŋana kena nɛ b yili kaplɛkama ŋ kilgi bumo be anishito n shoŋi kade nɛ fo lara ere nɛ bɔrɛlambu nɛ m pɔr n sa fo ere ŋ kule fo,

english_verse: Answer their prayers from heaven and give them victory.
translation_verse: kumo ere fo yili esoso n nu bumo be kekule n shin nɛ b kɔ m pɔɔ so.

english_verse: Everyone sins. But when your people sin against you, suppose you get angry enough to let their enemies drag them away to foreign countries.
translation_verse: Ekama bee wora alubi, amoso hale nɛ fo basa wora alubi ŋ gbiti fo nɛ fo nya agbo n wɔtɔ bumo nseŋ ta bumo m bɔɔ bumo doŋana enɔ nɛ b pɛ bumo n yɔ efuli pɔtɛ wɔfɔ so gba,

english_verse: Forgive your people no matter how much they have sinned against you. Make the enemies who defeated them be kind to them.
translation_verse: n ta fo basa be alubi nɛ b wora ŋ gbiti fo kikɛ m paŋ bumo n shin bumo doŋana e baa wora bumo kelela.

english_verse: Remember, they are the people you chose and rescued from Egypt that was like a blazing fire to them.
translation_verse: Fo basa gbagba e la bumo nɛ b daa ji awurfoŋ ga nɛ fo lara bumo ashi Ijipt be kasawule so na.

english_verse: I am your servant, and the people of Israel belong to you. So listen when any of us pray and cry out for your help.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpetale, saŋkama nɛ fo mbia Israɛlebi nɛ bumo be ewura baŋ kule fo fanɛ fo chɛ bumo to, fo nu n sa bumo.

english_verse: When you brought our ancestors out of Egypt, you told your servant Moses to say to them, “From all people on earth, the Lord God has chosen you to be his very own.” Solomon Blesses the People
translation_verse: Fo ka lara an nananyɛnana ashi Ijipt be kasawule so na, nɛ fo kaŋɛ fo kayɛrbi Mosis fanɛ durnya ere kikɛ to, Israɛlebi nɛ fo lara fanɛ b baa la fo basa.” Lalaloge be kabɔrɛkule

english_verse: When Solomon finished his prayer at the altar, he was kneeling with his arms lifted toward heaven. He stood up,
translation_verse: Ewura Sɔlɔmɔn ka kule Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ n loge, nɛ e niŋito n yili bɔrɛsure nɛ e gbir kumo ase na be anishito

english_verse: turned toward the people, blessed them, and said loudly:
translation_verse: ŋ kule Ebɔrɛ be nɛfa awɔrso n sa basa nɛ b shɛr na ŋ kaŋɛ:

english_verse: Praise the Lord! He has kept his promise and given us peace. Every good thing he promised to his servant Moses has happened.
translation_verse: “Kemaŋkura e baa la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ e nase kɔnɔ fanɛ e beeŋ sa mbe basa kagbenewushi na peya. E daŋ bɔla mbe kayɛrbi Mosis so nna n shin nɛ mbe nnɔ naseso nɛ e nase n sa bumo na kikɛ bɔlɔ so.

english_verse: The Lord our God was with our ancestors to help them, and I pray that he will be with us and never abandon us.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe anyi be Ebɔrɛ na e baa wɔ anyi alɛ gba kutɔ fanɛ kananɛ e daa wɔ an nananyɛnana kutɔ na, nsaa maŋ yige anyi ŋko ŋ kplaŋ anyi so;

english_verse: May the Lord help us obey him and follow all the laws and teachings he gave our ancestors.
translation_verse: E chɛ anyi to n shin nɛ an baa nu a sa mo nsaa bɛ mbe mbra nɛ keŋini nɛ e ta n sa an nananyɛnana na so.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord our God will remember my prayer day and night. May he help everyone in Israel each day, in whatever way we need it.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe anyi be Ebɔrɛ na, e baa nu ma kabɔrɛkule saŋkama. E baa chɛ Israɛl be basa nɛ bumo be ewura to nsaa wora bumo karechɛ kama be asheŋ tirso a sa bumo.

english_verse: Then every nation will know that the Lord is the only true God.
translation_verse: Saŋɛ na so durnya kikɛ beeŋ pin fanɛ fo Enyɛnpe na nawule e la Ebɔrɛ. Ebɔrɛ kikɛ maŋ naa wɔtɔ.

english_verse: Obey the Lord our God and follow his commands with all your heart, just as you are doing today. Solomon Dedicates the Temple (
translation_verse: Men ta men be ŋgbene kikɛ a bɛ Enyɛnpe men be Ebɔrɛ na be mbra so fanɛ kananɛ menyee wora kabre ere.” Bɔrɛlambu na be keta m bɔɔ Ebɔrɛ enɔ be asheŋ (

english_verse: Solomon and the huge crowd celebrated the Festival of Shelters at the temple for seven days. There were people from as far away as the Egyptian Gorge in the south and Lebo-Hamath in the north.
translation_verse: Ewura Sɔlɔmɔn nɛ Israɛlebi na kikɛ daŋ ji abuu to be kebaawɔtɔ be kejigboŋ nchɛnshunu nna m bɛ abar so. Basa na daŋ shi efuli na be kaplɛkama nna. Bedamta daŋ shi Hamaf Paas ashi kelargato be esoso be kaba so nna nɛ beko malɛ shi Ijipt be kasawule be egbaŋ to ashi kelargato be kaseto be kaba so.

english_verse: Then on the eighth day, he sent everyone home. They said goodbye and left, very happy, because of all the good things the Lord had done for his servant David and his people Israel.
translation_verse: Kumo be kachɛ burwasopo na, nɛ ewura Sɔlɔmɔn shin nɛ basa na kikɛ yɔ bumo peana. Nɛ bumo be ŋgbeneana fuli bumo ga ŋkpal kananɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ daŋ nɛfa mbe basa Israɛlebi, nɛ mbe kayɛrbi ewura Deevid na so.

english_verse: I will no longer let my people Israel live in this land I gave them. I will desert this temple where I said I would be worshiped. Then people everywhere will think this nation is only a joke and will make fun of it.
translation_verse: kumo ere meeŋ lara ma basa Israɛlebi ashi kasawule nɛ n ta n sa bumo ere so, nseŋ lar bɔrɛlambu nɛ n nɛfa ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ meeŋ baa wɔ ndoŋ nɛ b baa bunyaŋ ma na to. Saŋɛ na so basa kikɛ beeŋ ba fɛl Israɛlebi nsaa keni bumo jiga.

english_verse: Solomon did not force the Israelites to do his work. They were his soldiers, officials, leaders, commanders, chariot captains, and chariot drivers. But he did make slaves of the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites who were living in Israel. These were the descendants of those foreigners the Israelites could not destroy, and they remained Israel's slaves.
translation_verse: Ewura Sɔlɔmɔn daa maa tintiŋ Israɛlebi na bre nɛ baa shuŋ ashuŋ kpakpaso ama e daŋ ta bumo be beko nna ŋ ki benapo n ta beko malɛ ki benapo be benimu n ta beko ŋ ki egbaŋɛturko be benimu nɛ beko malɛ bee dii egbaŋɛ a kɔ kena.

english_verse: You must obey me, as your father David did, and be honest and fair. Obey my laws and teachings,
translation_verse: Nɛ feeŋ baa kɔ kasonu n sa ma nsaa ji kashenteŋ fanɛ kananɛ fo tuto ewura Deevid daa du na, nsaa bɛ ma mbra nɛ ma keŋini so bre,

english_verse: and I will keep my promise to David that someone from your family will always be king of Israel.
translation_verse: kumo ere ma kɔnɔ nɛ n nase n sa fo tuto fanɛ mbe kanaŋ to be esa e naaŋ baa ji Israɛl be kuwura saŋkama na beeŋ bɔlɔ so.

english_verse: But if you or any of your descendants disobey my commands or start worshiping foreign gods,
translation_verse: Ama nɛ fo ŋko fo kaman to ebi be beko kini kebɛ ma mbra so nsaa shuŋ efuli pɔtɛana so be agbir bre,

english_verse: Then they will answer, “We know why the Lord did this. The people of Israel rejected the Lord their God, who rescued their ancestors from Egypt, and they started worshiping other gods.” Other Things Solomon Did (
translation_verse: Nɛ basa e kaŋɛ le: ‘Ŋkpal b ka kini Enyɛnpe bumo be Ebɔrɛ nɛ e lara bumo nanaana ashi Ijipt be kasawule so na, nseŋ ya kaa bunyaŋ efuli pɔtɛana so be agbir so nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ le be asheŋ ere ba bumo so na.’ ” Ewura Sɔlɔmɔn nɛ ewura Hiram be kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre be asheŋ (

english_verse: When Hiram went to see the towns, he did not like them.
translation_verse: Ewura Hiram ka ya wu nde na, amo be asheŋ daa maŋ par mo.

english_verse: He said, “Solomon, my friend, are these the kind of towns you want to give me?” So Hiram called the region Cabul because he thought it was worthless.
translation_verse: Nɛ e kaŋɛ ewura Sɔlɔmɔn le: “N niopibi, nde nɛ fo ta n sa ma nde a?” Amoso e daŋ nase loŋ be kebonfu na be kaba so Kabɔl nna ŋkpal k ka daa maŋ kɔ tɔnɔ so.

english_verse: After Solomon's workers had finished the temple and the palace, he ordered them to fill in the land on the east side of Jerusalem, to build a wall around the city, and to rebuild the towns of Hazor, Megiddo, and Gezer.
translation_verse: Ewura Sɔlɔmɔn daŋ tintiŋ basa nna nɛ b pɔr bɔrɛlambu na nɛ ewura be laŋ na nseŋ sulɔ ajembu m mata kade na be epeŋilarkpa be kaba so be egbal na. Kumo be kaman nɛ e shin nɛ b pɔr egbal ŋ kulti kade na kikɛ. E daŋ shin nɛ b lɔŋɛ m pɔr Hazɔɔ nɛ Majido nɛ Gaza be nde gba nna.

english_verse: Earlier, the king of Egypt had captured the town of Gezer; he burned it to the ground and killed the Canaanite people living there. Then he gave it to his daughter as a wedding present when she married Solomon.
translation_verse: Ijipt be ewura e daŋ ya kɔ Gɛza kena m pɔɔ so m mɔ basa nɛ b wɔ kumo to kikɛ nseŋ wɔtɔ kumo edɛ. Kumo be kaman nɛ e ta kumo n sa mo pibiche fanɛ mbe kejafɔ to be kakɛ saŋɛ so nɛ e ya kil ewura Sɔlɔmɔn na.

english_verse: So Solomon had the town rebuilt. Solomon ordered his workers to rebuild Lower Beth-Horon,
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Ewura Sɔlɔmɔn shin nɛ b naŋ lɔŋɛ kumo nɛ Bɛf Hɔrɔn nɛ k wɔ kaseto be kaba so na,

english_verse: They also built towns where he could keep his supplies and his chariots and horses. Solomon ordered them to build whatever he wanted in Jerusalem, Lebanon, and anywhere in his kingdom.
translation_verse: nseŋ pɔr nde nɛ e bee ta mbe ajibi nɛ egbaŋɛturko nɛ egbaŋɛ a yili to na. Ewura Sɔlɔmɔn daŋ shin nna nɛ mbe beshumpo pɔr asɔ nɛ e bee sha n yili Jerusalɛm nɛ Lebanɔn nɛ mbe efuli so be kaplɛkama.

english_verse: Solomon's wife, the daughter of the king of Egypt, moved from the older part of Jerusalem to her new palace. Then Solomon had the land on the east side of Jerusalem filled in.
translation_verse: Ewura Sɔlɔmɔn be eche nɛ e la Ijipt be ewura pibiche na, daŋ koso Jerusalɛm be kaba ko nɛ baa tre Deevid be kade to na nna n yɔ ewura be laŋ popɔr nɛ ewura Sɔlɔmɔn pɔr n sa mo na to.

english_verse: Three times a year, Solomon burned incense and offered sacrifices to the Lord on the altar he had built. Solomon had now finished building the Lord's temple.
translation_verse: Kafɛ kikɛ, ale asa nɛ ewura Sɔlɔmɔn daa chɔɔ duwu nsaa lara esarga chɔɔso nɛ kɔnɔkoŋwuleso be esarga a deŋi bɔrɛsure nɛ e pɔr n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na so, hale m ba pɔr bɔrɛlambu na n loge.

english_verse: He also had a lot of ships at Ezion-Geber, a town in Edom near Eloth on the Red Sea.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ ewura Sɔlɔmɔn yɔ Eziɔngɛba nɛ Elaf nɛ a wɔ teku peper na be kɔnɔ ase na n yaa wora ekuloŋgboŋana.

english_verse: King Hiram let some of his experienced sailors go to the country of Ophir with Solomon's own sailors, and they brought back about
translation_verse: Bumo nɛ ewura Sɔlɔmɔn be basa e daŋ bɔla nchu so n yɔ efuli nɛ baa tre Ɔfir na. B ka bɛta a ba, nɛ b bar ewura Sɔlɔmɔn shuwa nɛ amo be egbɛ sa fanɛ kilo ŋgboŋ kuduana.

english_verse: The Queen was amazed at Solomon's wisdom. She was breathless when she saw his palace, the food on his table, his officials, his servants in their uniforms, the people who served his food, and the sacrifices he offered at the Lord's temple.
translation_verse: E ka wu ajibi nɛ b chige n yili ewura Sɔlɔmɔn be teebɔl so na, nɛ ebuana nɛ mbe benimuana wɔtɔ na, nɛ kananɛ ewura be laŋ na to be beshumpo be asheŋ bee bɛ abar so nɛnɛ na, nɛ epiŋi nɛ nyɛrbi nɛ baa chige ajibi bee buu na, nɛ k chinchiŋ mo alegaiso.

english_verse: She said: Solomon, in my own country I had heard about your wisdom and all you've done.
translation_verse: Le nɛ ewurche na daŋ kaŋɛ ewura Sɔlɔmɔn: “Kusɔ nɛ n nu ma efuli so ashi fo kaplɛa so nɛ kanyiasheŋ nɛ fo kɔ na be asheŋ kikɛ la kashenteŋ nna!

english_verse: But I didn't believe it until I saw it with my own eyes! And there's so much I didn't hear about. You are wiser and richer than I was told.
translation_verse: N daa maŋ yirda kumo be loŋ ama ŋ gbagba ka ba wu kumo be kashenteŋ ere pɔɛŋ nɛ n yirda. N daŋ maŋ nu fo kanyiasheŋ nɛ fo kedamaya ere be asheŋ be bargato gba. Naniere kusɔ nɛ n nu ere chɔ kananɛ n nu kumo be asheŋ basa kutɔ na ga.

english_verse: Your wives and officials are lucky to be here where they can listen to the wise things you say.
translation_verse: Basa nɛ baa shuŋ fo nsaa wɔ fo kutɔ saŋkikɛ a nu fo kanyiasheŋ be mmalga na, nu ebel pasaa!

english_verse: He was the richest and wisest king in the world.
translation_verse: Ewura Sɔlɔmɔn daa kɔ kedamaya nɛ kanyiasheŋ a chɔ ewura kikɛ durnya to.

english_verse: The merchants and traders, as well as the kings of Arabia and rulers from Israel, also gave him gold.
translation_verse: Eyawujipo nɛ benitepo be kusɔ nɛ baa sa mo bre maŋ ti so. Areebia be efuli so be bewura nɛ Israɛl be efuli so be abonfu be gomena be benimu gba daŋ ba sa mo shuwa nna.

english_verse: His throne was made of ivory and covered with pure gold.
translation_verse: Kusɔlnyi nɛ b daŋ ta n lɔŋɛ mbe echenakpa nseŋ ta shuwa lela malɛ m mata mata kumo so.

english_verse: The back of the throne was rounded at the top, and it had armrests on each side. There was a statue of a lion on both sides of the throne, and there was a statue of a lion at both ends of each of the six steps leading up to the throne. No other throne in the world was like Solomon's.
translation_verse: Diiso nɛ baa dii a fo kuwurputi na be echenakpa na la ateŋgreŋ ashe nna, nɛ buluŋ be kapɔrduli yil kuwurputi na be kaba kama so. B daŋ ta shuwa nna m mata mbe aya ase nɛ echenakpa na be kakpa nɛ mbe aya bee deŋi so kikɛ la shuwa. Efuli kama be kuwurji maŋ naŋ ji eleŋ durnya ere to fanɛ kumo.

english_verse: Solomon had a lot of seagoing ships. Every three years he sent them out with Hiram's ships to bring back gold, silver, and ivory, as well as monkeys and peacocks.
translation_verse: Ewura Sɔlɔmɔn daa kɔ nchu so be ekuloŋgboŋ damta nna, nɛ amo nɛ ewura Hiram be nchu so be ekuloŋgboŋ bee nite nchu so. Nfɛ asa kikɛ mbe nchu so be ekuloŋgboŋ na daa sulɔ shuwa nɛ gbiti nɛ asɔlnyii nɛ enyare nɛ efɛate nna a ba.

english_verse: Solomon also worshiped Astarte the goddess of Sidon, and Milcom the disgusting god of Ammon.
translation_verse: Ewura Sɔlɔmɔn daa shuŋ Sidɔn be kade be kegbirche Astat nɛ Ammɔn be efuli so be kegbir Molɛk, nɛ Ebɔrɛ kishi amo be asheŋ ga na nna.

english_verse: Solomon's father had obeyed the Lord with all his heart, but Solomon disobeyed and did what the Lord hated.
translation_verse: E daŋ wora alubi nna ŋ gbiti Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nsaa maa bugi kagbene a shuŋ mo fanɛ kananɛ mo tuto ewura Deevid daŋ shuŋ mo na.

english_verse: Solomon built shrines on a hill east of Jerusalem to worship Chemosh the disgusting god of Moab, and Molech the disgusting god of Ammon.
translation_verse: Ewura Sɔlɔmɔn daŋ pɔr agbirlambu ashi Jerusalɛm be kebee na be epeŋitɔrkpa be kaba so nna nɛ baa shuŋ Mowab be efuli so be kegbir nɛ baa tre Chemɔsh na nɛ Ammɔn be efuli so be kegbir nɛ baa tre Mɔlɛk nɛ Ebɔrɛ kishi ga na.

english_verse: In fact, he built a shrine for each of his foreign wives, so all of them could burn incense and offer sacrifices to their own gods.
translation_verse: E daŋ pɔr agbir be mboŋ nɛ mbe beche nɛ b shi efuli pɔtɛana so na bee chɔɔ duwu nsaa lara esarga a sa bumo be agbirana gba nna.

english_verse: The Lord God of Israel had appeared to Solomon two times and warned him not to worship foreign gods. But Solomon disobeyed and did it anyway. This made the Lord very angry,
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na daŋ nya agbo nna n wɔtɔ ewura Sɔlɔmɔn ŋkpal e ka daŋ lara mbe kumu ŋ ŋini mo ale anyɔ kikɛ ŋ kaŋɛ mo fanɛ e sa maŋ kaŋ shuŋ efuli pɔtɛana so be agbir kikɛ, nɛ Sɔlɔmɔn kini so so.

english_verse: and he said to Solomon: You did what you wanted and not what I told you to do. Now I'm going to take your kingdom from you and give it to one of your officials.
translation_verse: Amoso le nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ daŋ kaŋɛ ewura Sɔlɔmɔn: “Ŋkpal fo ka kute ŋ kini ma nɛ fo be kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre na nɛ ma mbra na be kebɛso so, meeŋ sɔ kuwurji na fo kutɔ n sa fo benimuana na be eko.

english_verse: But because David was your father, you will remain king as long as you live. I will wait until your son becomes king, then I will take the kingdom from him.
translation_verse: Ama ŋkpal fo tuto ewura Deevid so, m maaŋ wora loŋ saŋɛ so nɛ fo kraa wɔ ŋkpa to ere. Jemanɛ nɛ fo pibi beeŋ ki ewura na nɛ meeŋ wora loŋ.

english_verse: When I do, I will still let him rule one tribe, because I have not forgotten that David was my servant and Jerusalem is my chosen city. Hadad Becomes an Enemy of Solomon
translation_verse: Ma alɛ maaŋ sɔ efuli na kikɛ mo kutɔ ŋkpal ma kayɛrbi ewura Deevid nɛ Jerusalɛm nɛ k la ma kade na so. Meeŋ yige efuli na be kaba ko n sa mo.” Sɔlɔmɔn mo doŋana be asheŋ

english_verse: Hadad was from the royal family of Edom, and here is how the Lord made him Solomon's enemy:
translation_verse: Ade kikɛ be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ ewura Hadad nɛ e shi Edɔm be efuli so be kuwurji be kanaŋ to na nɛ ewura Sɔlɔmɔn ki bedoŋ.

english_verse: Some time earlier, when David conquered the nation of Edom, Joab his army commander went there to bury those who had died in battle. Joab and his soldiers stayed in Edom six months, and during that time they killed every man and boy who lived there.
translation_verse: Dra dra na ewura Deevid daŋ kɔ Edɔm be efuli kena nna m pɔɔ kumo so nɛ mbe benapo be enimu Jɔab yɔ ndoŋ n ya puli basa nɛ b mɔ kena na to na kikɛ. Kumo be kaman nɛ mo nɛ mbe basa chena Edɔm afɔl ashe m mɔ enyɛn kikɛ nɛ e daa wɔ Edɔm.

english_verse: Hadad was a boy at the time, but he escaped to Midian with some of his father's officials. At Paran some other men joined them, and they went to the king of Egypt. The king liked Hadad and gave him food, some land, and a house, and even let him marry the sister of Queen Tahpenes.
translation_verse: Hadad be asheŋ daŋ par Ijipt be ewura na ga nna nɛ e ta mbe eche ewurche Tapenis mo sipo n sa Hadad nɛ e ki mbe eche.

english_verse: Hadad and his wife had a son named Genubath, and the queen let the boy grow up in the palace with her own children.
translation_verse: Hadad be eche na daŋ kurge ebinyɛn nna nɛ b nase mbe ketre Genubaf. Ewurche na e daŋ bela mo nɛ Ijipt be ewura na be mbia kikɛ laŋ koŋwule to.

english_verse: When Hadad heard that David and Joab were dead, he said to the king, “Your Majesty, please let me go back to my own country.”
translation_verse: Hadad ka wɔ Ijipt nseŋ nu fanɛ ewura Deevid nɛ Jɔab nɛ e la Israɛl be benapo be enimu na kikɛ wu, nɛ e kaŋɛ Ijipt be ewura na le: “Shin nɛ m bɛta n yɔ ma kade to.”

english_verse: “Why?” asked the king. “Do you want something I haven't given you?” “No, I just want to go home.” Rezon Becomes an Enemy of Solomon

translation_verse: Ahija ka nu mbe aya ka cha m ba fo kabuna to nɛ e kaŋɛ le: “Jeroboam be eche, luri m ba. Manɛ nna nɛ fee wora fanɛ mannɛ fo nna? Ŋ kɔ baru lubi nɛ n sa fo.

english_verse: Give your husband this message from the Lord God of Israel: “Jeroboam, you know that I, the Lord, chose you over anyone else to be the leader of my people Israel.
translation_verse: Ya kaŋɛ ewura Jeroboam fanɛ le nɛ Enyɛnpe nɛ e la Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na yɛ: ‘N lara fo ashi fo basa to nna nseŋ ta fo ŋ ki ma basa Israɛlebi na be ejuŋkparpo.

english_verse: I even took David's kingdom away from his family and gave it to you. But you are not like my servant David. He always obeyed me and did what was right.
translation_verse: N sɔ kuwurji na ashi ewura Deevid be kaman to ebi kutɔ nna n sa fo ama fo alɛ maŋ du fanɛ ma kayɛrbi Deevid nɛ e daa ji kashenteŋ a nu a sa ma, nsaa wora kusɔ kama nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ na.

english_verse: “You have made me very angry by rejecting me and making idols out of gold. Jeroboam, you have done more evil things than any king before you.
translation_verse: Fo alubi nɛ fo wora gba chɔ bewura kama nɛ b juŋkpar fo na be alubi, ŋkpal manɛ so fo kini ma nseŋ nyaŋɛ ma agbo to ŋkpal fo ka ya ka bunyaŋ agbir nɛ fo ta abɛlso n lɔŋɛ na so.

english_verse: “Because of this, I will destroy your family by killing every man and boy in it, whether slave or free. I will wipe out your family, just as fire burns up trash.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal kusɔ nɛ fo wora ere so meeŋ mur fo kuwurji nseŋ mɔ fo kaman to ebi nɛ b la benyɛn nɛ benimu nɛ mbia kikɛ. Meeŋ mur fo kanaŋ nɛ b ki fanɛ kananɛ anabin bee chɔɔ a mur na.

english_verse: Everyone in Israel will mourn at his funeral. But he will be the last one from Jeroboam's family to receive a proper burial, because he's the only one the Lord God of Israel is pleased with.
translation_verse: Israɛl be basa kikɛ beeŋ shu mbe keeli nseŋ puli mo. Mo nawule e naŋ nya kepuli lela ashi ewura Jeroboam be kanaŋ to kikɛ, ŋkpal manɛ so, mo nawule nɛ Enyɛnpe, Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na be kagbene fuli so ga.

english_verse: The Lord will soon choose a new king of Israel, who will destroy Jeroboam's family. And I mean very soon.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ lara esa popɔr nɛ e ji kuwura ashi Israɛl be efuli so nseŋ mur ewura Jeroboam be kanaŋ kikɛ. K maaŋ chɛr gba nɛ loŋ e wora.

english_verse: The people of Israel have made the Lord angry by setting up sacred poles for worshiping the goddess Asherah. So the Lord will punish them until they shake like grass in a stream. He will take them out of the land he gave to their ancestors, then scatter them as far away as the Euphrates River.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ beeŋ gberge Israɛlebi kusoe nɛ b baa chicha fanɛ kananɛ nchu bee shile a bɛr nchu to be afitiri nɛ a bee yigbuŋ to na. translation_verse: Nɛ Israɛlebi shu kebia na be keeli nseŋ ta mo n ya puli. Nɛ kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ bɔla mbe kayɛrbi anebi Ahija so ŋ kaŋɛ na kikɛ bɔlɔ so.

english_verse: They also built their own local shrines and stone images of foreign gods, and they set up sacred poles for worshiping the goddess Asherah on every hill and in the shade of large trees.

english_verse: After Rehoboam had been king for four years, King Shishak of Egypt attacked Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ewura Rehoboam ka ji kuwura be kafɛ nusopo to nɛ Shishak nɛ e la Ijipt be efuli so be ewura na ba kɔ Jerusalɛm ebi kena.

english_verse: Rehoboam had bronze shields made to replace the gold ones, and he ordered the guards at the city gates to keep them safe.
translation_verse: Ewura Rehoboam daŋ wora danyaŋ be asɔkuŋso nɛ baa keta a yɔ kena to na nna n tal shuwa peya na to nseŋ ta amo m bɔɔ bekumpo nɛ baa keni ewura be laŋ to be kabunagboŋ na so na enɔ.

english_verse: Whenever Rehoboam went to the Lord's temple, the guards carried the shields. But they always took them back to the guardroom as soon as he was finished.
translation_verse: Saŋkama nɛ ewura na baa yɔ bɔrɛlambu na to, bekumpo na bee ta asɔkuŋso na nna a keta. Ewura na baaŋ bɛta n yɔ epe nɛ b naŋ bɛta amo n ya wɔtɔ bekumpo be ebu na to.

english_verse: Everything else Rehoboam did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Judah.
translation_verse: B sibɛ ewura Rehoboam be kusɔ nɛ e wora kikɛ n wɔtɔ Juda be bewura be adrasheŋ be nwɔl to.

english_verse: Rehoboam's mother Naamah was from Ammon, but when Rehoboam died, he was buried beside his ancestors in Jerusalem. His son Abijam then became king.
translation_verse: Ewura Rehoboam ka wu, kakpa nɛ baa puli bewurbi ashi Jerusalɛm nɛ k la ewura Deevid be kade to na nɛ b puli mo. Ndoŋ nna nɛ mo pibinyɛn Abija sɔ mo so n ji kuwura.

english_verse: His own grandmother Maacah had made an idol of Asherah, and Asa took it and burned it in Kidron Valley. Then he removed Maacah from her position as queen mother.
translation_verse: Ewura Asa mo nanache Maaka daŋ yuu kedibi nna a shuŋ kegbirche nɛ baa tre Ashira na nɛ ewura Asa tia kumo ŋ kuya to n chɔɔ ashi Kidrɔn be ketaŋɛ nɛ k mata Jerusalɛm na. Ŋkpal kusɔ nɛ Maaka wora na so nɛ ewura Asa lara mo ashi eyilikpa nɛ e daa kɔ efuli na so fanɛ ewurche na.

english_verse: Abijam became king of Judah in Jeroboam's eighteenth year as king of Israel,
translation_verse: Nabat pibi ewura Jeroboam ka ji kuwura ashi Israɛl be efuli so be kafɛ kuduaburwasopo to nɛ Abija malɛ ki Juda be efuli so be ewura

english_verse: Asa ordered everyone in Judah to carry away the stones and wood Baasha had used to strengthen the town of Ramah. Then he used these same stones and wood to fortify the town of Geba in the territory of Benjamin and the town of Mizpah.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ ewura Asa tre Juda be efuli so be benyɛn n shɛr abar so ŋ kaŋɛ bumo fanɛ b muu ajembu nɛ ndibi nɛ ewura Baasha kɔ a shuŋ ashi Raama na. Ndoŋ nna nɛ b muu amo n ya pɔr egbalshin n sɔ egbal nɛ b pɔr ŋ kulti Gɛba nɛ k wɔ Bɛnjamin be efuli so na nɛ Mizpa be nde na to.

english_verse: Abijam did not truly obey the Lord his God as his ancestor David had done. Instead, he was sinful just like his father Rehoboam.
translation_verse: E daa maa ji kashenteŋ a sa Enyɛnpe mbe Ebɔrɛ na fanɛ kananɛ mo nananyɛn ewura Deevid daa wora na. E daa wora alubi nɛ mo tuto ewura Rehoboam daŋ wora na nna.

english_verse: David had always obeyed the Lord's commands by doing right, except in the case of Uriah. And since Abijam was David's great-grandson, the Lord kept Jerusalem safe and let Abijam have a son who would be the next king.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ daŋ wora loŋ nna ŋkpal ewura Deevid ka daa wora mbe aparsheŋ nsaa maa wora a da mbe mbra so so, ama kusɔ nɛ e daŋ wora Yuriya nɛ e la Hiti be esa na nawule.

english_verse: The war that had broken out between Rehoboam and Jeroboam continued during the time that Abijam was king. Everything else Abijam did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Judah.
translation_verse: B daŋ sibɛ kusɔ kama nɛ ewura Abija wora kikɛ nna n wɔtɔ Juda be bewura be adrasheŋ be nwɔl to.

english_verse: Abijam died and was buried in Jerusalem, and his son Asa became king. King Asa of Judah (

english_verse: He placed in the temple all the silver and gold objects that he and his father had dedicated to the Lord.
translation_verse: E daŋ ta asɔ nɛ mo tuto Abija daŋ ta m bɔɔ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ enɔ na nna, nɛ gbiti nɛ shuwa be asɔ nɛ mo alɛ gbagba ta m bɔɔ Ebɔrɛ enɔ na kikɛ n wɔtɔ bɔrɛlambu na to.

english_verse: Asa was always at war with King Baasha of Israel.
translation_verse: Juda be ewura Asa nɛ Israɛl be ewura Baasha daa kɔ abar kena nna saŋkama.

english_verse: Asa became king of Judah in the twentieth year of Jeroboam's rule in Israel,
translation_verse: Israɛl be ewura Jeroboam be kuwurji be kafɛ adunyɔsopo to nɛ Asa malɛ ki Juda be ewura,

english_verse: He forced the prostitutes at the shrines to leave the country, and he got rid of the idols his ancestors had made.
translation_verse: E daŋ ju esakalenyɛn nɛ esakaleche nɛ baa shuŋ kakpa nɛ nnyamase bee shuŋ agbir na nna nseŋ mur agbir nɛ mo nananyɛnana daŋ lɔŋɛ na kikɛ.

english_verse: As long as Asa lived, he was completely faithful to the Lord, even though he did not destroy the local shrines.
translation_verse: Kashenteŋ nna fanɛ ewura Asa daa maŋ tiŋ m mur agbir nɛ mboŋ nɛ baa shuŋ amo na ashi Israɛl be kasawule so kikɛ, ama e daŋ ji kashenteŋ nna n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na mbe ŋkpa to kikɛ.

english_verse: One time, Baasha invaded Judah and captured the town of Ramah. He started making the town stronger, so he could put troops there to stop people from going in and out of Judah.
translation_verse: Israɛl be ewura Baasha daŋ kɔ n sɔ kade nɛ baa tre Raama ashi Juda be efuli so na nna nseŋ fara a pɔr egbalshin a sɔ egbal nɛ b pɔr ŋ kulti kumo na to, saŋɛ na so k bee nya eleŋ n ti so, nseŋ kuŋ basa nɛ baa luri Juda to a lar na akpa.

english_verse: When Asa heard about this, he took the silver and gold from his palace and from the Lord's temple. He gave it to some of his officials and sent them to Damascus with this message for King Benhadad of Syria:
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ ewura Asa shin nɛ b lara gbiti nɛ shuwa kikɛ ashi bɔrɛlambu na to nɛ ewurape n ya sa Ewura Bɛnhadad nɛ e la Siriya be efuli so be ewura ashi Damaskɔs be kadegboŋ to na, nseŋ kaŋɛ mo le:

english_verse: “Our fathers signed a peace treaty. Why don't we do the same thing? This silver and gold is a present for you. So, would you please break your treaty with Baasha and force him to leave my country?”
translation_verse: “Shin nɛ anyi nɛ fo e wora kɔnɔkoŋwule fanɛ kananɛ an tutoana daŋ wora na. Gbiti nɛ shuwa ere bre la fo kakɛ nna. A daga fanɛ fo ku fo nɛ Israɛl be ewura Baasha be kɔnɔkoŋwule nɛ men kɔ na to, nɛ kumo be loŋ e shin nɛ e lara mbe benapo ashi ma kasawule so.”

english_verse: Everything else Asa did while he was king, including his victories and the towns he rebuilt, is written in The History of the Kings of Judah. When he got older, he had a foot disease.
translation_verse: B sibɛ Asa be kuwurji kikɛ be asheŋ nɛ nde nɛ e pɔr egbalana ŋ kulti na kikɛ n wɔtɔ Juda nɛ Israɛl be bewura be adrasheŋ be nwɔl to. Mbe mbel to nɛ kulɔ lubi ko pɛ mbe aya nɛ e ki bobi.

english_verse: Nadab son of Jeroboam became king of Israel in Asa's second year as king of Judah, and he ruled two years.
translation_verse: Ewura Asa ka ji Juda be kuwura be kafɛ nyɔsopo to nɛ ewura Jeroboam pibinyɛn Nadab malɛ ki Israɛl be ewura nseŋ ji Israɛl be kuwura nfɛ anyɔ.

english_verse: Nadab disobeyed the Lord by following the evil example of his father, who had caused the Israelites to sin.

english_verse: Baasha son of Ahijah was from the tribe of Issachar, and he made plans to kill Nadab. When Nadab and his army went to attack the town of Gibbethon in Philistia, Baasha killed Nadab there. So in the third year of Asa's rule, Baasha became king of Israel.
translation_verse: Juda be ewura Asa ka ji kuwura be kafɛ sasopo to nɛ le be kasheŋ ere daŋ wora. Kumo be kaman nɛ Baasha sɔ Naadab so n ji Israɛl be kuwura.

english_verse: The Lord's prophet Ahijah had earlier said, “Not one man or boy in Jeroboam's family will be left alive.” And, as soon as Baasha became king, he killed everyone in Jeroboam's family,
translation_verse: Baasha ka baŋ ji kuwura nɛ e mɔ Jeroboam be kanaŋ to be basa kikɛ, nɛ kusɔ nɛ anebi Ahija nɛ e shi Shilo na daŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ, Jeroboam be kanaŋ to be esa kama maaŋ pete na bɔlɔ so.

english_verse: because Jeroboam had made the Lord God of Israel angry by sinning and causing the Israelites to sin.

translation_verse: Jemanɛ nɛ Juda be ewura Asa nɛ Israɛl be ewura Baasha daa ji kuwura na, b daŋ baa kɔ abar kena nna saŋkama. Israɛl be Ewura Baasha be asheŋ

translation_verse: Juda be Ewura Asa ka ji Juda be kuwura be kafɛ sasopo to nɛ Ahija pibinyɛn Baasha malɛ ki Israɛl be ewura nseŋ ji kuwura nfɛ adunyɔ nɛ ana ashi Tiiza be kade to.

english_verse: Baasha also disobeyed the Lord by acting like Jeroboam, who had caused the Israelites to sin.
translation_verse: E daŋ wora kulubi nna ŋ gbiti Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ fanɛ kananɛ ewura Jeroboam daŋ shin nɛ Israɛl tɔr kulubi to na gbagba.

english_verse: Nobody knew who you were until I, the Lord, chose you to be the leader of my people Israel. And now you're acting exactly like Jeroboam by causing the Israelites to sin. What you've done has made me so angry
translation_verse: “Fo daa maŋ la shɛŋ nɛ n lara fo ashi fo basa to nseŋ ta fo ŋ ki ma basa Israɛlebi be ejuŋkparpo. Ama fo alɛ wora alubi fanɛ kananɛ ewura Jeroboam daŋ wora na nseŋ shin nɛ ma basa wora alubi nɛ ma agbo kaa.

english_verse: that I will destroy you and your family, just as I did the family of Jeroboam.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal loŋ so meeŋ mur fo nɛ fo kanaŋ kikɛ, fanɛ kananɛ n wora ewura Jeroboam nɛ mbe kanaŋ na.

english_verse: Dogs will eat the bodies of your relatives who die in town, and vultures will eat the bodies of those who die in the country.

translation_verse: Zimri daŋ mɔ Baasha be kanaŋ kikɛ nna, nɛ kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ daŋ bɔla anebi Jehu so n fiɛ Baasha so ŋ kaŋɛ na bɔla so.

english_verse: Baasha and Elah sinned and caused the Israelites to sin, and they made the Lord angry by worshiping idols.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na be agbo kaa ŋkpal Baasha nɛ mo pibinyɛn Ela ka daa shuŋ agbir nseŋ shin nɛ Israɛlebi wora alubi so.

translation_verse: B sibɛ kusɔ kama nɛ ewura Ela daŋ wora be asheŋ nna n wɔtɔ Israɛl be bewura be adrasheŋ be nwɔl to. Israɛl be ewura zimri be asheŋ

english_verse: Zimri became king of Israel in Asa's twenty-seventh year as king of Judah, but he ruled only seven days from Tirzah. translation_verse: B ka nu fanɛ Zimri kre ewura na kulubi nna nseŋ mɔ mo na, nɛ bumo kikɛ wora kɔnɔkoŋwule m buu bumo be benapo be enimu Omri Israɛl be kuwura.
