translation_verse: Ama e daŋ yige betirpo gbagba nɛ b maŋ kɔ kapetɛ kikɛ na bre nna ashi Juda be efuli so nɛ b baa shuŋ ndibi sɔrso nɛ adɔjibi be adɔana to.

english_verse: The Babylonian soldiers took the two bronze columns that stood in front of the temple, the ten movable bronze stands, and the large bronze bowl called the Sea. They broke them into pieces so they could take the bronze to Babylonia.
translation_verse: Babilɔn be benapo na daŋ bɛa danyaŋ be eshabɔrɛ nɛ eturko nɛ danyaŋ be katishaŋgboŋ nɛ baa tre Teku nɛ k daa wɔ bɔrɛlambu na to na to nna nseŋ lara amo be danyaŋ na kikɛ n yɔ Babilɔn.

english_verse: as well as the fire pans and the sprinkling bowls. Nebuzaradan ordered his soldiers to take everything made of gold or silver.
translation_verse: B daŋ ta asɔ kama nɛ b daŋ ta shuwa nɛ gbiti n lɔŋɛ na kikɛ nna n yɔ.

english_verse: The pile of bronze from the columns, the stands, and the large bowl that Solomon had made for the temple was too large to be weighed.
translation_verse: Danyaŋ be asɔ nɛ ewura Sɔlɔmɔn daŋ ta n lɔŋɛ bɔrɛlambu na be eshabɔrɛ na nɛ atɔl na nɛ katishaŋgboŋ na daa wɔ egbɛ nna ga nɛ b maŋ tiŋ ŋ karga amo be egbɛ.

english_verse: Then he arrested one of the army commanders, the king's five personal advisors, and the officer in charge of gathering the troops for battle. He also found
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ e pɛ benapo be enimu ko nɛ ewura na be asoetojipoana na be benu nɛ enimu nɛ e bee nite efuli na so a koli basa a yɔ kena to na nɛ benapo adeshe nɛ b kraa wɔ kadegboŋ na to na.

english_verse: When the army officers and troops heard that Gedaliah was their ruler, the officers met with him at Mizpah. These men were Ishmael son of Nethaniah, Johanan son of Kareah, Seraiah son of Tanhumeth from Netophah, and Jaazaniah from Maacah.
translation_verse: Nataniya Pibinyɛn Ishmaɛl nɛ Kariya pibinyɛn Johanan nɛ Tanhumɛf pibinyɛn Sɛriya nɛ b la Juda be efuli so be benapo be benimu n shin shile ŋ ŋana a maŋ bɛ Babilɔnebi na so n yɔ na ka nu loŋ na nɛ n shi Netofa be kade to n yɔ Gedaliya kutɔ ashi Mizpa.

english_verse: Gedaliah said to them, “Everything will be fine, I promise. We don't need to be afraid of the Babylonian rulers, if we live here peacefully and do what Nebuchadnezzar says.”
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Gedaliya leŋ bumo to ŋ kaŋɛ le: “Ma e kaŋɛ menyi na fanɛ men sa maa ŋana Babilɔn be efuli so be benapo na. Menyeeŋ tiŋ n chena nfe nsaa shuŋ Babilɔn be efuli so be ewura na nɛ asheŋ e baa nite nɛnɛ a sa menyi.”

english_verse: Ishmael was from the royal family. And about two months after Gedaliah began his rule, Ishmael and ten other men went to Mizpah. They killed Gedaliah and his officials, including those from Judah and those from Babylonia.
translation_verse: Kumo be kufɔl shunusopo to nɛ Ishmaɛl nɛ e la Netaniya pibinyɛn nɛ Ɛlshama mo nanabi nseŋ shi kuwurji be kanaŋ to na nɛ basa kudu ko yɔ Mizpa n ya mɔ Gɛdaliya nɛ mbe benimu nɛ b shi Juda nɛ Babilɔn na kikɛ. Ishmaɛl daŋ mɔ Israɛlebi nɛ Babilɔnebi be benapo nɛ b daa wɔ Gedaliya kutɔ ashi Mizpa ndoŋ na nna n ti so.

english_verse: After that, the army officers and all the people in Mizpah, whether important or not, were afraid of what the Babylonians might do. So they left Judah and went to Egypt. Jehoiachin Is Set Free (Jeremiah
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Israɛlebi na be bumo nɛ b la damawuraana nɛ betirpo kikɛ nɛ benapo be benimu na kikɛ shile n yɔ Ijipt be efuli so ŋkpal b ka daa ŋana Babilɔnebi na so. B ka lara ewura Jehowachin kabuti to be asheŋ (Jɛremaya

english_verse: Evil-Merodach was kind to Jehoiachin and honored him more than any of the other kings held prisoner there.
translation_verse: Ewura Evilmɛrodak daŋ shu Juda be ewura Jehowachin so n wora mo kelela nseŋ sa mo bunyaŋ a chɔ bewura kama nɛ b pɛ m ba Babilɔn be efuli so na kikɛ.

english_verse: Japheth was the father of Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras, and they were the ancestors of the kingdoms named after them.
translation_verse: Jafɛf be mbinyɛnsobi e daa la Gooma nɛ Magɔg nɛ Madai nɛ Javan nɛ Tubal nɛ Mɛshaak nɛ Tiras. Efuliana nɛ a bee ji bumo be atre ere be basa e la bumo be kenana.

english_verse: Abraham and his slave woman Keturah had six sons: Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah. Jokshan was the father of Sheba and Dedan.
translation_verse: Eebraham daa kɔ ejipoche ko nɛ baa tre mo Ketura, nɛ mo nɛ mo kurge mbinyɛnsobi ashe. Bumo e la Zimran nɛ Jɔkshan nɛ Medan nɛ Midian nɛ Ishbak nɛ Shuwa. Jɔkshan daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi anyɔ nna. Bumo e la Sheeba nɛ Dedan.

english_verse: Ethiopia was also the father of Nimrod, the world's first mighty warrior.
translation_verse: Kush pibinyɛn e daa la Nimrɔd. Nimrɔd e daa la durnya kikɛ be sososo be enapogboŋ.

english_verse: Egypt was the ancestor of Ludim, Anamim, Lehabim, Naphtuhim,
translation_verse: Ijipt malɛ be kaman to ebi e daa la Libiya nɛ Anaam nɛ Lehab nɛ Naftu be basa,

english_verse: Gomer was the ancestor of Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah.
translation_verse: Gooma be kaman to ebi e daa la Ashkenaz nɛ Rifaaf nɛ Togaama.

english_verse: Javan was the ancestor of Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.
translation_verse: Jaavan malɛ be kaman to ebi e daa la Elaisha nɛ Taashish nɛ Kitebi nɛ Rodanebi.

english_verse: Ham was the father of Ethiopia, Egypt, Put, and Canaan, and they were the ancestors of the kingdoms named after them.
translation_verse: Ham be mbinyɛnsobi e daa la Kush nɛ Ijipt nɛ Libiya nɛ Keenan. Efuliana nɛ a bee ji bumo be atre ere be basa e la bumo be kenana.

english_verse: Ethiopia was the ancestor of Seba, Havilah, Sabta, Raamah, and Sabteca. Raamah was the ancestor of Sheba and Dedan.
translation_verse: Kush be kaman to ebi e daa la Sɛba nɛ Havila nɛ Sɛbta nɛ Raama nɛ Sabteka be basa. Raama be kaman to ebi e daa la Sheba nɛ Dedan be basa.

english_verse: Shem was the ancestor of Elam, Asshur, Arpachshad, Lud, Aram, Uz, Hul, Gether, and Meshech; they were the ancestors of the kingdoms named after them.
translation_verse: Shɛm be mbinyɛnsobi e daa la Elaam nɛ Ashuur nɛ Apakshad nɛ Luud nɛ Araam nɛ Uz nɛ Huul nɛ Gɛda nɛ Mɛshɛk. Efuliana nɛ a bee ji bumo be atre ere be basa e daa la bumo be kenana.

english_verse: Arpachshad was Shelah's father and Eber's grandfather.
translation_verse: Apakshad pibi e daa la Shɛla nɛ Shɛla malɛ pibi la Heba.

english_verse: Shem's descendants included Arpachshad, Shelah, Eber, Peleg, Reu, Serug, Nahor, Terah, and Abram, later renamed Abraham. Abraham's Family (Genesis
translation_verse: nɛ Eebram nɛ e ki Eebraham na. Eebraham be kaman to ebi be asheŋ (Jɛnesis

english_verse: Abraham was the father of Isaac and Ishmael.
translation_verse: Eebraham daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi anyɔ nna. Bumo e daa la Aizek nɛ Ishmaɛl.

english_verse: Midian was the father of Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah. Esau's Family (Genesis
translation_verse: Midian daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi anu nna. Bumo e la: Efa nɛ Efɛ nɛ Hanɔk nɛ Abida nɛ Ɛlda. Isɔɔ be kaman to ebi be asheŋ (Jɛnesis

english_verse: Abraham's son Isaac was the father of Esau and Jacob.
translation_verse: Eebraham pibinyɛn Aizek be mbinyɛnsobi daa wɔ benyɔ. Bumo e la Isɔɔ nɛ Jeekɔb.

english_verse: Esau was the father of Eliphaz, Reuel, Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.
translation_verse: Isɔɔ be mbinyɛnsobi e daa la Elifas nɛ Ruwɛl nɛ Jewush nɛ Jalam nɛ Koora.

english_verse: Reuel was the father of Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah. The First Edomites and Their Kings (Genesis
translation_verse: Ruwɛl malɛ be mbia e daa la Nahaf nɛ Zera nɛ Shamaa nɛ Miiza. Basa nɛ b juŋkpar n chena Edɔm be asheŋ (Jɛnesis

english_verse: Lotan was the father of Hori and Homam; Lotan's sister was Timna.
translation_verse: Lotan be mbinyɛnsobi e daa la Hɔri nɛ Homam. Lotan mo sipoche e daa la Timna.

english_verse: Shobal was the father of Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shephi, and Onam. Zibeon was the father of Aiah and Anah.
translation_verse: Shobaal be mbinyɛnsobi e daa la Alvan nɛ Manahaf nɛ Ebal nɛ Shefo nɛ Onam. Zibiɔn be mbinyɛnsobi e daa la Aya nɛ Ana.

english_verse: Anah was the father of Dishon and the grandfather of Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.
translation_verse: Ana pibinyɛn e daa la Dishɔn. Dishɔn malɛ be mbinyɛnsobi e daa la Hamran nɛ Eshban nɛ Itran nɛ Cheran.

english_verse: Ezer was the father of Bilhan, Zaavan, and Jaakan. Dishan was the father of Uz and Aran.
translation_verse: Ezɛr be mbinyɛnsobi e daa la Bilhan nɛ Zaavan nɛ Jaakan. Dishan e daa la Uz nɛ Aran bumo tuto. Edɔm be bewura be asheŋ (Jɛnesis

english_verse: Oholibamah, Elah, Pinon,
translation_verse: nɛ Oholibama nɛ Ela nɛ Pinɔn

english_verse: Kenaz, Teman, Mibzar,
translation_verse: nɛ Keenaz nɛ Teman nɛ Mibza

english_verse: Magdiel, and Iram.
translation_verse: nɛ Magdiel nɛ Iram.

english_verse: Jacob was the father of twelve sons: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Zebulun, Dan, Joseph, Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.
translation_verse: nɛ Dan nɛ Josɛf nɛ Bɛnjamin nɛ Naftali nɛ Gad nɛ Ashɛr.

english_verse: Judah and his Canaanite wife Bathshua had three sons: Er, Onan, and Shelah. But the Lord had Er put to death, because he disobeyed and did what the Lord hated.
translation_verse: Juda nɛ mbe Keenanche nɛ baa tre Bafshuwa na daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi asa nna. Bumo e la Ɛr nɛ Onan nɛ Shɛla. Ɛr daa wora asheŋ lubi damta nna ŋkpal loŋ so nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ daŋ shin nɛ e wu.

english_verse: Judah and his daughter-in-law Tamar also had two sons: Perez and Zerah.
translation_verse: Juda nɛ mo pibinyɛn be eche Tamaa gba daŋ kurge mbinyɛnsobi anyɔ nna. Bumo e daa la Pɛrɛs nɛ Zɛra.

english_verse: Perez was the father of Hezron and Hamul.
translation_verse: Pɛrɛs be mbinyɛnsobi e daa la Hezrɔn nɛ Hamuul.

english_verse: Zerah was the father of Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Calcol, and Darda.
translation_verse: Zɛra malɛ be mbinyɛnsobi e daa la Zimri nɛ Etan nɛ Heman nɛ Kalkol nɛ Daada.

english_verse: Achan, who was a descendant of Zerah and the son of Carmi, caused trouble for Israel, because he kept for himself things that belonged only to the Lord.
translation_verse: Kaami nɛ e shi Zɛra be kanaŋ to na pibinyɛn Eekan e daŋ ta asɔ nɛ a la Ebɔrɛ peya, nɛ aleblawu tɔr Israɛl be efuli kikɛ so ŋkpal loŋ so na.

english_verse: Ethan's son was Azariah. The Ancestors of King David
translation_verse: Ebinyɛn koŋwule nɛ Etan daa kɔ, mo e la Azariya. Ewura Deevid be kaman to ebi be asheŋ

english_verse: Hezron was the father of Jerahmeel, Ram, and Caleb.
translation_verse: Mbinyɛnsobi asa nɛ Hɛzrɔn daa kɔ. Bumo e la Jeramiil nɛ Raam nɛ Kalɛb.

english_verse: Jesse also had two daughters: Zeruiah and Abigail. Zeruiah was the mother of Abishai, Joab, and Asahel.
translation_verse: Mbe mbichesobi daa wɔ benyɔ nna. Bumo e la Zeruwa nɛ Abigɛl. Jɛsi pibiche Zeruwa daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi asa. Bumo e daa la Abishai nɛ Jɔab nɛ Asahɛl.

english_verse: Abigail's husband was Jether, who was a descendant of Ishmael, and their son was Amasa. The Descendants of Hezron
translation_verse: Abigɛl mo kul be ketre e daa la Jɛta nɛ e daŋ shi Ishmaɛl be kanaŋ to. Bumo pibinyɛn be ketre e daa la Amasa. Hezrɔn be kaman to ebi be asheŋ

english_verse: Hezron's son Caleb married Azubah, and their daughter was Jerioth, the mother of Jesher, Shobab, and Ardon.
translation_verse: Hezrɔn pibinyɛn Kalɛb e daŋ ta Azuba ŋ kurge ebiche nɛ baa tre mo Jeriɔf. Jeriɔf be mbinyɛnsobi e daa la Jɛsha nɛ Shobab nɛ Adɔn.

english_verse: was the father of Uri and the grandfather of Bezalel.
translation_verse: Hur pibinyɛn e daa la Yuri nɛ Yuri malɛ pibinyɛn la Bazilɛl.

english_verse: After the death of Hezron, Caleb married Ephrath, his father's wife. Their son was Ashhur, who later settled the town of Tekoa. The Descendants of Jerahmeel
translation_verse: Hezrɔn ka wu be kaman, nɛ Kalɛb ta Efraf nɛ e daa la mo tuto be ekulpoche na a kil. Bumo pibinyɛn e daa la Ashuur nɛ e daŋ chena Tekua na. Jeramiil be kaman to ebi be asheŋ

english_verse: Jerahmeel had a second wife, Atarah, who gave birth to Onam.
translation_verse: Jeramiil daa kɔ eche nyɔsopo nɛ baa tre mo Atara nɛ mo nɛ mo kɔ ebinyɛn nɛ baa tre Onam.

english_verse: Ram was the father of Maaz, Jamin, and Eker.
translation_verse: Raam daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi asa nna. Bumo e daa la Maaz nɛ Jamin nɛ Eka.

english_verse: Onam was the father of Shammai and Jada. Shammai was the father of Nadab and Abishur.
translation_verse: Onam daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi anyɔ nna. Bumo e daa la Shammai nɛ Jaada. Shammai malɛ gba daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi anyɔ nna. Bumo e daa la Nadab nɛ Abishur.

english_verse: Abishur married Abihail, and their two sons were Ahban and Molid.
translation_verse: Abishur be eche e daa la Abiheel. B daŋ kurge mbinyɛnsobi anyɔ nna. Bumo e daa la Aban nɛ Mɔlid.

english_verse: Nadab was the father of Seled and Appaim. Seled had no children;
translation_verse: Nadab daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi anyɔ nna. Bumo e daa la Sɛlɛd nɛ Apayim, ama Sɛlɛd bre daa maŋ kurge.

english_verse: Appaim's son was Ishi, the father of Sheshan and the grandfather of Ahlai.
translation_verse: Apayim pibinyɛn e daa la Ishi nɛ Ishi malɛ pibi daa la Sheshan nɛ Sheshan malɛ pibinyɛn daa la Alai.

english_verse: Jada was the father of Jether and Jonathan. Jether had no children,
translation_verse: Jɛta nɛ Jonatan bumo tuto e daa la Jaada. Jɛta bre daa maŋ kurge.

english_verse: Sheshan had no sons, and so he let one of his daughters marry Jarha, his Egyptian slave. Their son was Attai,
translation_verse: Sheshan daŋ ta mo pibiche ko nna n sa mbe kayɛrbi na nɛ e kil nseŋ kurge ebinyɛn nɛ baa tre mo Attai.

english_verse: Zabad's descendants included Ephlal, Obed, Jehu, Azariah, Helez, Eleasah, Sismai, Shallum, Jekamiah, and Elishama. The Descendants of Caleb
translation_verse: Shalum, pibi e daa la Jekamaya nɛ Jekamaya malɛ pibi daa la Elishaama. Kalɛb be kaman to ebi be asheŋ

english_verse: and Hebron's four sons, Korah, Tappuah, Rekem, and Shema.
translation_verse: Hibrɔn daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi ana nna. Bumo e la Koora nɛ Tapua nɛ Rekɛm nɛ Shema.

english_verse: Shema was the father of Raham and the grandfather of Jorkeam. Rekem was the father of Shammai,
translation_verse: Shema pibi e daa la Raham nɛ Raham malɛ pibi daa la Jɔkiam nɛ Jɔkiam pibi daa la Rekɛm nɛ Rekɛm malɛ pibi la Shammai.

english_verse: the grandfather of Maon, and the great-grandfather of Bethzur.
translation_verse: Shammai pibi e daa la Moan nɛ Moan malɛ pibi daa la Bɛfzur.

english_verse: Ephah was one of Caleb's wives, and their sons were Haran, Moza, and Gazez. Haran named his son after his brother Gazez.
translation_verse: Kalɛb daa kɔ ejipoche ko nɛ baa tre mo Efa. Mo nɛ eche na daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi asa nna. Bumo e la Haran nɛ Moza nɛ Gazɛz. Haran gba daa kɔ ebinyɛn ko nɛ baa tre mo Gazɛz.

english_verse: Ephah was the daughter of Jahdai, who was also the father of Regem, Jotham, Geshan, Pelet, and Shaaph.
translation_verse: Jadai daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi ashe nna. Bumo e la, Regɛm nɛ Jotam nɛ Geshan nɛ Pɛlɛt nɛ Efa nɛ Shaaf.

english_verse: Maacah was another of Caleb's wives, and their sons were Sheber and Tirhanah.
translation_verse: Kalɛb be eche ko be ketre e daa la Maaka. Mo nɛ Maaka daŋ kurge mbinyɛnsobi anyɔ nna. Bumo e la Sheba nɛ Tirhana.

english_verse: Later, they had two more sons: Shaaph the father of Madmannah, and Sheva the father of Machbenah and Gibea. Caleb's daughter was Achsah.
translation_verse: K maŋ chɛr ko nɛ mo nɛ eche na naŋ kurge mbinyɛnsobi anyɔ. Bumo e la Shaaf nɛ e la Madmana mo tuto na, nɛ Sheeva nɛ mo alɛ la Makbeena mo tuto na nɛ Gibia. Kalɛb pibiche e daa la Aksa.

english_verse: All of these were Caleb's descendants. Hur, the oldest son of Caleb and Ephrath, had three sons: Shobal, Salma, and Hareph, who settled the town of Beth-Gader.
translation_verse: Mo pibinyɛn nyɔsopo nɛ baa tre Salma na, e daŋ juŋkpar n chena Bɛtlɛhɛm, nɛ mo pibinyɛn sasopo nɛ baa tre Harif na e daŋ juŋkpar n chena Bɛfgaada.

english_verse: Shobal, who settled the town of Kiriath-Jearim, was the ancestor of Haroeh, half of the Menuhoth clan,
translation_verse: Shobaal nɛ e juŋkpar n chena Kiriaf Jearim na b kenana e daa la Harowe be basa nɛ Menuhɔf be kabuna ebi na be bargato,

english_verse: and the clans that lived near Kiriath-Jearim; they were the Ithrites, the Puthites, the Shumathites, and the Mishraites. The Zorathites and the Eshtaolites were descendants of the Mishraites.
translation_verse: n ta Itriebi nɛ Putebi nɛ Shumebi nɛ Mishraebi be mbuna nɛ bumo alɛ gba daa wɔ Kiriaf Jearim na.

english_verse: Salma settled the town of Bethlehem and was the ancestor of the Netophathites, the people of Atroth-Bethjoab, half of the Manahathite clan, and the Zorites.
translation_verse: Salma nɛ e daŋ juŋkpar n chena Bɛtlɛhɛm na e daa la Netofa be basa nɛ Atrɔf Bɛf Jɔab nɛ Zorebi nɛ b daa la Manahaf be mbuna anyɔ na be kuko bumo nananyɛn.

english_verse: Salma was also the ancestor of the clans in Jabez that kept the court and government records; they were the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, and the Sucathites. These clans were the descendants of Hammath the Kenite, who was also the ancestor of the Rechabites.
translation_verse: Salma e daa la Jabez be kabuna ebi na bumo nananyɛn mo nɛ e daa sibɛ bumo be demuji be asheŋ nɛ abane be asheŋ kikɛ a nase. Bumo e daa la, Tirafebi nɛ Shimitebi nɛ Sukaebi. Bumo nɛ Rekabebi kikɛ daa la Haamaf nɛ e la Kɛn be esa na be kenana nna.

english_verse: Solomon's descendants included the following kings: Rehoboam, Abijah, Asa, Jehoshaphat, Jehoram, Ahaziah, Joash, Amaziah, Azariah, Jotham, Ahaz, Hezekiah, Manasseh, Amon, and Josiah and his four sons, Johanan, Jehoiakim, Zedekiah, and Jehoahaz.
translation_verse: Josaya daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi ana nna. Bumo e la Johanan nɛ Jehowakim nɛ Zɛdekaya nɛ Shallɔm.

english_verse: Jehoiachin, who was taken to Babylon as a prisoner, had seven sons: Shealtiel,
translation_verse: Ewura Jehowachin nɛ Babilɔnebi daŋ pɛ n yɔ bumo be efuli so na daa kɔ mbia ashunu nna. Bumo e la Shialtiɛl

english_verse: Malchiram, Pedaiah, Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.
translation_verse: nɛ Malchiram nɛ Pɛdaya nɛ Shenazza nɛ Jekamaya nɛ Hoshaama nɛ Nedabiya.

english_verse: Pedaiah had two sons: Zerubbabel and Shimei. Zerubbabel was the father of Meshullam, Hananiah, and Shelomith their sister.
translation_verse: Pɛdaya malɛ daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi anyɔ nna. Bumo e la Zerubabel nɛ Shimei. Zerubabel daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi anyɔ nna. Bumo e la Mɛshulam nɛ Hananiya. E daa kɔ kebichebi koŋwule ko nɛ baa tre mo Shelomif.

english_verse: He also had five other sons: Hashubah, Ohel, Berechiah, Hasadiah, and Jushabhesed.
translation_verse: Mbe mbinyɛnsobi anu ko e daa la Hashuba nɛ Ohɛl nɛ Bɛrekiya nɛ Hasadiya nɛ Jushab Hɛsɛd.

english_verse: Neariah was the father of Elioenai, Hizkiah, and Azrikam.
translation_verse: Neriya daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi asa nna. Bumo e la Elionai nɛ Hizkiya nɛ Azrikam.

english_verse: Elioenai was the father of Hodaviah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Delaiah, and Anani.
translation_verse: Elionai malɛ daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi ashunu nna. Bumo e la Hadoviya nɛ Eliashib nɛ Pelaya nɛ Akuub nɛ Johanan nɛ Delaya nɛ Anani.

english_verse: Judah was the father of five sons: Perez, Hezron, Carmi, Hur, and Shobal.
translation_verse: Juda be kaman to ebi na be beko e daa la Pɛrez nɛ Hezrɔn nɛ Kaami nɛ Hur nɛ Shobaal.

english_verse: Shobal was the father of Reaiah, the grandfather of Jahath, and the great-grandfather of Ahumai and Lahad. These men all belonged to the Zorathite clan.
translation_verse: Shobaal pibi e daa la Riya, nɛ Riya malɛ pibi daa la Jahaf, nɛ Jahaf malɛ be mbinyɛnsobi daa la Ahumai nɛ Lahad. Bumo e daŋ ki Zoraebi be mbuna mbuna na.

english_verse: Hur was the oldest son of Caleb and Ephrath. Some of his descendants settled the town of Bethlehem. Hur's other descendants included Etam, Penuel, and Ezer. Etam's sons were Jezreel, Ishma, and Idbash, and his daughter was Hazzelelponi. Penuel settled the town of Gedor, and Ezer settled the town of Hushah.
translation_verse: Kalɛb nɛ mbe eche Efraf pibinyɛn nimuso e daa la Hur. Hur be kaman to ebi e daŋ juŋkpar n chena Bɛtlɛhɛm. E daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi asa nna. Bumo e daa la Etam nɛ Pɛnuɛl nɛ Eza. Etan malɛ daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi asa nna. Bumo e daa la Jizreel nɛ Ishma nɛ Idbaash. Ebiche koŋwule nɛ e daa kɔ nɛ baa tre mo Hazelelfoni. Pɛnuɛl e daŋ juŋkpar n chena Gɛdɔ, nɛ Ezɛr malɛ juŋkpar n chena Huusha.

english_verse: Ashhur, who settled the town of Tekoa, had two wives: Helah and Naarah.
translation_verse: Ashuur nɛ e daŋ juŋkpar n chena Tekua na daa kɔ beche anyɔ nna. Bumo e daa la Hɛla nɛ Naara.

english_verse: daughters. But his brothers did not have as many children, so the Simeon tribe was smaller than the Judah tribe.
translation_verse: Ashuur nɛ Naara daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi ana nna. Bumo e daa la Ahuzaam nɛ Heefa nɛ Temeni nɛ Haahashtari.

english_verse: Ashhur and Helah were the parents of Zereth, Izhar, and Ethnan.
translation_verse: Ashuur nɛ Heela daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi asa nna. Bumo e daa la Zeref nɛ Iza nɛ Efnan.

english_verse: Koz, the father of Anub and Zobebah, was also the ancestor of the clans of Aharhel, the son of Harum.
translation_verse: Kooz nɛ mbe mbinyɛnsobi daa la Anuub nɛ Zobeba na be kabuna ebi e daa la Ahahɛl nɛ Harum.

english_verse: Jabez was a man who got his name because of the pain he caused his mother during birth. But he was still the most respected son in his family.
translation_verse: Kanyɛn ko malɛ daa wɔtɔ nɛ baa tre mo Jabez nɛ e daa kɔ bunyaŋ ga ashi mbe kanaŋ to. Mo nio daŋ nase mo ketre ere nna ŋkpal e kaŋ daŋ nu ebesa mbe kakurge to so.

english_verse: One day he prayed to Israel's God, “Please bless me and give me a lot of land. Be with me so I will be safe from harm.” And God did just what Jabez had asked.
translation_verse: Ama Jabez daŋ kule Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na nna ŋ kaŋɛ le: “Ebɔrɛ, nɛfa ma nseŋ shin nɛ ma kasawule e wora keshi ga. Baa wɔ ŋ kutɔ nsaa kuŋ ma ashi kulubi to, saŋɛ na so ebesa maaŋ ba ma so.” Nɛ Ebɔrɛ wora kusɔ nɛ e kule na gbagba n sa mo.

english_verse: Chelub was the brother of Shuhah and the father of Mehir. Later, Mehir had a son, Eshton,
translation_verse: Shuwa mo sipo Kelub pibinyɛn e daa la Mehiir. Eshtɔn malɛ mo tuto e daa la Mehiir.

english_verse: whose three sons were Bethrapha, Paseah, and Tehinnah. It was Tehinnah who settled the town of Nahash. These men and their families lived in the town of Recah.
translation_verse: Eshtɔn daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi asa nna. Bumo e la: Bɛtrafa nɛ Pasiya nɛ Tehinna. Tehinna e daŋ juŋkpar n chena Nahaash. Basa ere be kaman to ebi e daa la Reekaebi.

english_verse: Kenaz was the father of Othniel and Seraiah. Othniel had two sons: Hathath and Meonothai,
translation_verse: Keenaz daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi anyɔ nna. Bumo e la Ofniɛl nɛ Seraya. Ofniɛl malɛ gba daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi anyɔ nna. Bumo e daa la Hataaf nɛ Meonotai.

english_verse: who was the father of Ophrah. Seraiah was the father of Joab, who settled a place called “Valley of Crafts” because the people who lived there were experts in making things.
translation_verse: Meonotai pibi e daa la Ofra. Seraya pibi e daa la Jɔab. Seraya e daŋ juŋkpar n chena kepla nɛ baa tre enɔ to be kushuŋ be kenyi na ase. Basa nɛ b wɔ ndoŋ na kikɛ daa kɔ enɔ to be kushuŋ be kenyi nna ga.

english_verse: Caleb son of Jephunneh had three sons: Iru, Elah, and Naam. Elah was the father of Kenaz.
translation_verse: Jefune pibinyɛn Kalɛb daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi asa nna. Bumo e la: Iru nɛ Ela nɛ Naam. Keenaz mo tuto e daa la Ela.

english_verse: Ezrah was the father of Jether, Mered, Epher, and Jalon. Mered was married to Bithiah the daughter of the king of Egypt. They had a daughter named Miriam and two sons: Shammai and Ishbah. It was Ishbah who settled the town of Eshtemoa. Mered was also married to a woman from the tribe of Judah, and their sons were Jered, Heber, and Jekuthiel. Jered settled the town of Gedor; Heber settled the town of Soco; and Jekuthiel settled the town of Zanoah.
translation_verse: Ɛzra daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi ana nna. Bumo e daa la Jɛta nɛ Merɛd nɛ Efa nɛ Jaalɔn. Merɛd e daŋ ta Bitia nɛ e daa la Ijipt be ewura pibiche na ŋ kurge ebiche nɛ baa tre mo Miriam na. Miriam mo siponyɛnana e daa la Shammai nɛ Ishba. Ishba e daŋ juŋkpar n chena Eshtamɔa. Merɛd daŋ ta Juda be kanaŋ to be eche ko nɛ mo nɛ mo kurge mbinyɛnsobi asa. Bumo e daa la Jerɛd nɛ e daŋ juŋkpar n chena Gɛdɔ na, nɛ Hɛba nɛ mo alɛ juŋkpar n chena Soko na, nɛ Jekutiɛl nɛ e juŋkpar n chena Zanua na.

english_verse: A man named Hodiah was married to the sister of Naham. Hodiah's descendants included Keilah of the Garmite clan and Eshtemoa of the Maacathite clan.
translation_verse: Hodaya e daŋ ta Nahaam mo sipoche. Bumo be kaman to ebi e daa la Gaam be kabuna ebi nɛ b daa wɔ Keila na, nɛ Maaka be kabuna ebi, nɛ bumo alɛ daa wɔ Eshtamɔa be kade to na.

english_verse: Shimon was the father of Amnon, Rinnah, Benhanan, and Tilon. Ishi was the father of Zoheth and Benzoheth.
translation_verse: Shimɔn daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi ana nna. Bumo e daa la Amnɔn nɛ Rina nɛ Bɛnhanan nɛ Tilɔn. Ishi daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi anyɔ, bumo e daa la Zohɛf nɛ Bɛnzohɛf. Shɛla be kaman to ebi be asheŋ

english_verse: Judah also had a son named Shelah, whose descendants included Jokim and the people of the town of Cozeba, as well as Er who settled the town of Lecah and Laadah who settled the town of Mareshah. The people who lived in Beth-Ashbea were also descendants of Shelah, and they were experts in weaving cloth. Shelah was the ancestor of Joash and Saraph, two men who married Moabite women and then settled near Bethlehem—but these family records are very old.
translation_verse: Jokim nɛ basa nɛ b wɔ Koziba be kade to na, nɛ Jɔash nɛ Saraf, nɛ b daŋ ta Mowabebi be beche na, daŋ chena Bɛtlɛhɛm nna. B daŋ sibɛ le be asheŋ ere n nase la dra dra nna.

english_verse: The members of these clans were the potters who lived in the towns of Netaim and Gederah and worked for the king. The Descendants of Simeon
translation_verse: Bumo e daa pɔr mpuya nɛ mba nsaa wɔ Netaim nɛ Gɛdera be nde to a shuŋ a sa ewura na. Simiɔn be kaman to ebi be asheŋ

english_verse: Simeon had five sons: Nemuel, Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, and Shaul.
translation_verse: Simiɔn daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi anu nna. Bumo e la Nemuɛl nɛ Jamin nɛ Jarib nɛ Zɛra nɛ Shawul.

english_verse: The descendants of Shaul included his son Shallum, his grandson Mibsam, and his great-grandson Mishma.
translation_verse: Shawul pibinyɛn e daa la Shallɔm nɛ mo nanabinyɛnso malɛ la Mibsam nɛ mo kenanafofonyɛnso malɛ la Mishma.

english_verse: The descendants of Mishma included his son Hammuel, his grandson Zaccur, and his great-grandson Shimei.
translation_verse: Mishma pibinyɛn Hamuɛl nɛ mo nanabi Zakuur nɛ mbe kenanafofonyɛnso e daa la mbe kaman to ebi.

english_verse: They also lived in the five villages of Etam, Ain, Rimmon, Tochen, and Ashan,
translation_verse: B daŋ chena Etam nɛ Ayin nɛ Rimmɔn nɛ Tochɛn nɛ Ashan,

english_verse: as well as in the nearby villages as far as the town of Baal. These are the places where Simeon's descendants had settled, according to their own family records.
translation_verse: hale n ya fo Baalaf be kelargato be kaseto be kaba so a laŋɛ epeŋitɔrkpa be kaba so gba. Kusɔ nɛ Simiɔn be kaman to ebi sibɛ n nase a laŋɛ bumo be kaman to ebi nɛ bumo be echenakpaana be asheŋ be kaplɛa so nna na.

english_verse: When the people needed more pastureland for their flocks and herds, they looked as far as the eastern side of the valley where the town of Gerar is located,
translation_verse: amoso b daŋ salga to nna n sɔ Gɛra be epeŋilarkpa be kaba so a fin bumo be asɔbɔya be ejikpa.

english_verse: and they found a lot of good pastureland that was quiet and undisturbed. This had once belonged to the Hamites,
translation_verse: B daŋ wu asɔbɔya be ejikpa be kasawule gboŋgboŋi lela ko nna nɛ awɔr kikɛ maŋ wɔ ndoŋ nɛ ndoŋ kɔ kayurwushi ga. Hamebi e daŋ chena ndoŋ ŋ ku so.

english_verse: but when Hezekiah was king of Judah, the descendants of Simeon attacked and forced the Hamites and Meunites off the land, then settled there.
translation_verse: Saŋɛ so nɛ Hɛzekaya daa la Juda be ewura na, nɛ Simiɔn be kaman to ebi ko ya kɔ Hamebi nɛ Meuniebi kena n ju bumo n sɔ kasawule na n chena so ŋkpal asɔbɔya be ejikpa ka daa shibi ndoŋ ga so.

english_verse: They killed the last of the Amalekites and lived there from then on.
translation_verse: B daŋ mɔ Amalɛkebi nɛ b ka ndoŋ na kikɛ nna nseŋ sɔ kakpa na n chena hale kabre.

english_verse: Reuben was the oldest son of Jacob, but he lost his rights as the first-born son because he slept with one of his father's wives. The honor of the first-born son was then given to Joseph,
translation_verse: Ruben nɛ e la Jeekɔb pibinyɛn nimuso na daŋ paŋ mbe kuwurkoŋ be eyilikpa nna nɛ b ta kumo n sa Josɛf ŋkpal mo nɛ mo tuto be eche ko ka daŋ di keche nɛ kenyɛnso. Amoso bumo be kakurge to, b maa karga mo fanɛ wurkoŋ.

english_verse: The descendants of Joel included Shemaiah, Gog, Shimei, Micah, Reaiah, Baal, and Beerah, a leader of the Reuben tribe. Later, King Tiglath Pileser of Assyria took Beerah away as prisoner.
translation_verse: Jowɛl be kaman to ebi e daa la Shemaya nɛ Gɔg nɛ Shimei nɛ Mika nɛ Reya nɛ Baal nɛ Biira nɛ e daa la Ruben be yiri na be ejuŋkparpo na. Tiglaf Pilesa nɛ e daa la Asiriya be ewura na e daŋ kɔ m pɔɔ Biira so nseŋ pɛ mo n yɔ bumo be kasawule so.

english_verse: The family records also include Jeiel, who was a clan leader, Zechariah, and Bela son of Azaz and grandson of Shema of the Joel clan. They lived in the territory around the town of Aroer, as far north as Nebo and Baal-Meon,
translation_verse: Azaz pibinyɛn Bɛla nɛ mo nanabinyɛnso Shema nɛ e la Jowɛl pibinyɛn na. B daŋ chena Arowa nna hale n ya fo kelargato be esoso be kaba so ashi Nebo nɛ Baal Miɔn kikɛ.

english_verse: and as far east as the desert just west of the Euphrates River. They needed this much land because they owned too many cattle to keep them all in Gilead.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal b ka daa kɔ asɔbɔya damta ashi Giliad be kasawule so so, b daŋ chena nna hale n ya fo keshishɛrsawule nɛ k dese a laŋɛ Yufreetes be Lɔr na be epeŋilarkpa be kaba so na.

english_verse: When Saul was king, the Reuben tribe attacked and defeated the Hagrites, then took over their land east of Gilead. The Descendants of Gad
translation_verse: Jemanɛ nɛ Sɔɔl daa ji kuwura na, nɛ Ruben be yiri na ya kɔ Hagebi kena nseŋ mɔ bumo n sɔ bumo be kasawule nɛ k wɔ Giliad be epeŋilarkpa be kaba so na n chena. Gad be kaman to ebi be asheŋ

english_verse: The tribe of Gad lived in the region of Bashan, north of the Reuben tribe. Gad's territory extended all the way to the town of Salecah.
translation_verse: Gad be yiri na daŋ chena Baashan be kasawule so nna a yɔ Ruben be yiri na be kelargato be esoso be kaba so n ta n ya fo Saleka be epeŋilarkpa be kaba so.

english_verse: Some of the clan leaders were Joel, Shapham, Janai, and Shaphat.
translation_verse: Bumo be mbuna be bejuŋkparpo e daa la Jowɛl nɛ Shaafam nɛ Janai nɛ Shaafat.

english_verse: Their relatives included Michael, Meshullam, Sheba, Jorai, Jacan, Zia, and Eber.
translation_verse: Bumo kurgepoana ko e daa la Maikel nɛ Mɛshulam nɛ Sheeba nɛ Jorai nɛ Jaakan nɛ Ziya nɛ Heba.

english_verse: They were all descendants of Abihail, whose family line went back through Huri, Jaroah, Gilead, Michael, Jeshishai, Jahdo, and Buz.
translation_verse: B daa la Huuri nɛ mo nananyɛnana daa la Jarowa nɛ Giliad nɛ Maikel nɛ Jeshishai nɛ Jaado nɛ Buz pibinyɛn Abihail be kaman to ebi nna.

english_verse: Ahi, the son of Abdiel and the grandson of Guni, was the leader of their clan.
translation_verse: Abdiɛl pibinyɛn Ahi nɛ e la Guni mo nanabi na e daa la mbuna ere be enimu.

english_verse: The people of Gad lived in the towns in the regions of Bashan and Gilead, as well as in the pastureland of Sharon.
translation_verse: Bashan nɛ Giliad be kasawule so be nde to, nɛ kakpa nɛ Sharɔn be asɔbɔya bee ji nɛ Gad be basa daa wɔ.

english_verse: They fought against the Hagrites and the tribes of Jetur, Naphish, and Nodab.
translation_verse: B daŋ ya kɔ Hagebi nɛ Jetur nɛ Nafish nɛ Nadab be eyiriana na kena nna.

english_verse: Whenever these soldiers went to war against their enemies, they prayed to God and trusted him to help. That's why the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh defeated the Hagrites and their allies.
translation_verse: B daŋ ta bumo be yirda nna n deŋi Ebɔrɛ so ŋ kule mo fanɛ e chɛ bumo to. Nɛ Ebɔrɛ nu bumo be kekule nseŋ chɛ bumo to nɛ b kɔ m pɔɔ Hagebi nɛ basa nɛ b chɛ bumo to a kɔ kena na kikɛ so.

english_verse: Many of the Hagrites died in battle, because God was fighting this battle against them. The tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh lived in that territory until they were taken as prisoners to Assyria. The Tribe of East Manasseh
translation_verse: Hag be basa damta daŋ wu kena na to nna ŋkpal Ebɔrɛ ka daŋ chɛ to ŋ kɔ bumo so. Ndoŋ nna nɛ Ruben nɛ Gad nɛ Manase be epeŋilarkpa be kaba so be basa sɔ bumo be efuli na n chena so n ya fo jemanɛ nɛ b pɛ bumo n yɔ Asiriya be efuli so. Manase be yiri nɛ k wɔ epeŋilarkpa be kaba so na be asheŋ

english_verse: Epher, Ishi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremiah, Hodaviah, and Jahdiel were their clan leaders; they were well-known leaders and brave soldiers. The Tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh Are Defeated
translation_verse: Efa nɛ Ishi nɛ Elliɛl nɛ Azriɛl nɛ Jɛremaya nɛ Hodaviya nɛ Jadiɛl e daa la bumo be kabuna na be bejuŋkparpo. B daa la benapo lempo nna ashi bumo be kabuna na. B ka kɔ m pɔɔ epeŋilarkpa be eyiri na so be asheŋ

english_verse: The people of the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh were unfaithful to the God their ancestors had worshiped, and they started worshiping the gods of the nations that God had forced out of Canaan.
translation_verse: Ruben nɛ Gad nɛ Manase be epeŋilarkpa be eyiriana na daa maa ji kashenteŋ a sa bumo nananyɛnana be Ebɔrɛ na nseŋ shile mo n ya kaa shuŋ efuliana nɛ Ebɔrɛ ju ashi Keenan be kasawule so na be agbirana.

english_verse: So God sent King Tiglath Pileser of Assyria to attack these Israelite tribes. The king led them away as prisoners to Assyria, and from then on, he forced them to live in Halah, Habor, Hara, and near the Gozan River.
translation_verse: Amoso Ebɔrɛ daŋ shin nna nɛ Asiriya be ewura Puul nɛ mbe ketre ko bee ji Tiglaf Pilesa na, ya kɔ bumo be efuli na m pɔɔ bumo so. E daŋ pɛ Ruben nɛ Gad nɛ Manase be epeŋilarkpa be kaba so be basa nna n tintiŋ bumo n yɔ nde wɔfɔ nɛ baa tre Haala nɛ Haabɔ nɛ Haara nɛ a mata Gozan be Lɔr na n shin nɛ b chena ndoŋ hale kabre.

english_verse: Kohath was the father of Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
translation_verse: Kohaf daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi ana nna. Bumo e daa la Amram nɛ Izha nɛ Hibrɔn nɛ Uziɛl.

english_verse: Amram was the father of Aaron, Moses, and Miriam. Aaron had four sons: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
translation_verse: Amram malɛ daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi anyɔ nna. Bumo e la: Ɛɛrɔn nɛ Mosis nɛ ebicheso nɛ baa tre mo Miriam. Ɛɛrɔn daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi ana nna. Bumo e la Nadab nɛ Abihu nɛ Eliaza nɛ Itama.

english_verse: King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia took Jehozadak to Babylon as prisoner when the Lord let the people of Judah and Jerusalem be dragged from their land.
translation_verse: Ewura Nebukadneeza daŋ pɛ Jehozadak nna n tintiŋ mo n yɔ kade wɔfɔ nɛ baa tre Babilɔn saŋɛ so nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ b pɛ Juda nɛ Jerusalɛm be basa n yɔ efuli pɔtɛ so na. Livai be kaman to ebi ko be asheŋ

english_verse: Levi's three sons had sons of their own.
translation_verse: Livai daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi asa nna. Bumo e la Gɛshɔn nɛ Kohaf nɛ Mɛrari.

english_verse: Gershon was the father of Libni and Shimei.
translation_verse: Bumo be ekama daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi. Gɛshɔn be mbia e daa la Libni nɛ Shimei.

english_verse: Kohath was the father of Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
translation_verse: Kohaf malɛ be mbia e daa la Amram nɛ Iza nɛ Hibrɔn nɛ Uziɛl.

english_verse: Merari was the father of Mahli and Mushi. These descendants of Levi each became leaders of their own clans.
translation_verse: Mɛrari malɛ be mbia e daa la Maali nɛ Muushi.

english_verse: Kohath's descendants included Amminadab, Korah, Assir, Elkanah, Ebiasaph, Assir, Tahath, Uriel, Uzziah, and Shaul.
translation_verse: Tahaaf nɛ Yuriɛl nɛ Uziya nɛ Shawul.

english_verse: Elkanah was the father of Amasai and Ahimoth.
translation_verse: Ɛlkana daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi anyɔ nna. Bumo e la Amasai nɛ Ahimɔf.

english_verse: Ahimoth's descendants included Elkanah, Zophai, Nahath, Eliab, Jeroham, and Elkanah.
translation_verse: Eliab nɛ Jeroham nɛ Ɛlkana.

english_verse: Samuel was the father of Joel and Abijah, born in that order.
translation_verse: Samuɛl daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi anyɔ nna. Jowɛl e daa la mo pibi nimuso nɛ Abija malɛ la ebibiso.

english_verse: Merari's descendants included Mahli, Libni, Shimei, Uzzah, Shimea, Haggiah, and Asaiah. The Temple Musicians
translation_verse: Shimeya nɛ Hagiya nɛ Asaya. Bɔrɛlambu to be beshɛbompo be asheŋ

english_verse: After King David had the sacred chest moved to Jerusalem, he appointed musicians from the Levi tribe to be in charge of the music at the place of worship.
translation_verse: Saŋɛ so nɛ ewura Deevid shin nɛ b ta ŋkre be deka na n yɔ Jerusalɛm na, e daŋ lara basa ko nna fanɛ bumo e naŋ baa boŋ nshɛ nsaa laŋ alaŋsɔ ashi kakpa nɛ baa bunyaŋ Eyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.

english_verse: These musicians served at the sacred tent and later at the Lord's temple that King Solomon built.
translation_verse: B daa boŋ nshɛ ashi wajɛbu cheembi na ase nna pɔɛŋ nɛ ewura Sɔlɔmɔn ba pɔr bɔrɛlambu na.

english_verse: Ethan was also Heman's relative and served as his assistant. Ethan belonged to the Merari clan, and his ancestors included Kishi, Abdi, Malluch, Hashabiah, Amaziah, Hilkiah, Amzi, Bani, Shemer, Mahli, Mushi, Merari, and Levi.
translation_verse: nɛ Maali malɛ pibinyɛn daa la Shema nɛ Muushi malɛ pibinyɛn daa la Maali nɛ Mɛrari malɛ pibinyɛn daa la Muushi nɛ Livai malɛ pibinyɛn daa la Mɛrari.

english_verse: The rest of the Levites were appointed to work at the sacred tent. The Descendants of Aaron
translation_verse: Livaiebi nɛ b ka na bre, b daŋ lara bumo nna fanɛ b baa shuŋ wajɛbu cheembi na to. Ɛɛrɔn be kaman to ebi be asheŋ

english_verse: Only Aaron and his descendants were allowed to offer sacrifices and incense on the two altars at the sacred tent. They were in charge of the most holy place and the ceremonies to forgive sins, just as God's servant Moses had commanded.
translation_verse: Ɛɛrɔn nɛ mbe kaman to ebi nawule e daa lara duwu be sarga nɛ esarga chɔɔso bɔrɛsure na so. Bumo be kushuŋ e daa la kebaakeni acheembiana to be kakpa cheembi na be kabɔrɛshuŋ so nsaa yili Israɛlebi be katelamu to a lara alubi be ketampaŋ be sarga fanɛ kananɛ Ebɔrɛ be kayɛrbi Mosis kaŋɛ bumo na gbagba.

english_verse: Aaron's descendants included his son Eleazar, Phinehas, Abishua, Bukki, Uzzi, Zerahiah, Meraioth, Amariah, Ahitub, Zadok, and Ahimaaz. The Towns for the Levites (Joshua
translation_verse: nɛ Ahitub malɛ pibinyɛn daa la Zadɔk nɛ Zadɔk malɛ pibinyɛn daa la Ahimaaz. Livaiebi be nde be asheŋ

english_verse: Aaron's descendants belonged to the Levite clan of Kohath, and they were the first group chosen to receive towns to live in.
translation_verse: Mboŋ nɛ b daŋ ta n sa Ɛɛrɔn be kaman to ebi nɛ b shi Kohaf be kabuna nseŋ juŋkpar n nya kasawule be kachige nɛ b daŋ ta n sa Livaiebi na nde:

english_verse: They received the town of Hebron in the territory of Judah and the pastureland around it.
translation_verse: B daŋ ta Hibrɔn nɛ k wɔ Juda be efuli so na nɛ asɔbɔya be ejikpa nɛ a kulti kumo na kikɛ nna n sa bumo.

english_verse: But the farmland and villages around Hebron were given to Caleb son of Jephunneh.
translation_verse: Ama b daŋ ta kumo be adɔsawule nɛ ndewurbiana nɛ a chena ŋ kulti kumo na bre n sa Jefune pibinyɛn Kalɛb nna.

english_verse: From the Benjamin tribe they were given the towns of Geba, Alemeth, and Anathoth and the pastureland around them. Thirteen towns were given to Aaron's descendants.
translation_verse: B daŋ ta Gɛba nɛ Alemɛf nɛ Anatɔf nɛ amo be asɔbɔya be ejikpa be nsawule ashi Bɛnjamin be yiri to nna n sa Ɛɛrɔn be kaman to ebi. Nde nɛ b daŋ ta n sa Ɛɛrɔn be kaman to ebi kikɛ daa wɔ nde kuduasa.

english_verse: The rest of the Levite clan of Kohath received ten towns from West Manasseh.
translation_verse: B daŋ ta nde kudu nna ashi Manase be epeŋitɔrkpa be kaba so n sa Kohaf be kabuna nɛ k ka ashi Livai be yiri to na.

english_verse: The Levite clan of Gershon received thirteen towns from the tribes of Issachar, Asher, Naphtali, and East Manasseh in Bashan.
translation_verse: B daŋ ta nde kuduasa ashi Isaaka nɛ Ashɛr nɛ Naftali nɛ Manase nɛ k wɔ epeŋitɔrkpa be kaba so ashi Bashan be efuli so na nna n sa Gɛshɔn be kabuna nɛ b shi Livai be yiri to na.

english_verse: The Levite clan of Merari received twelve towns from the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and Zebulun.
translation_verse: Loŋ koŋwule na nɛ b ta nde kuduanyɔ nɛ a wɔ Ruben nɛ Gad nɛ Zɛbyulɔn be yiri be nsawule so na nna n sa Mɛrari be kabuna ebi.

english_verse: So the people of Israel gave the Levites towns to live in and the pastureland around them.
translation_verse: Kananɛ Israɛlebi na daŋ sa Livaiebi na nde nɛ asɔbɔya be ejikpa be nsawule nɛ a kulti ndoŋ nna na.

english_verse: All the towns were chosen with the Lord's help, including those towns from the tribes of Judah, Simeon, and Benjamin.
translation_verse: B daŋ to beri nna n fin Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be nfɛra pɔɛŋ nseŋ chige nde nɛ a wɔ Juda nɛ Simiɔn nɛ Bɛnjamin be eyiri to be nsawule so na.

english_verse: Some of the families of the Kohath clan received their towns from the tribe of Ephraim.
translation_verse: Kohaf be kanaŋ na be kabuna ko bre daŋ nya bumo be nde nɛ asɔbɔya be ejikpa nna ashi Efrayim be yiri na be kasawule so.

english_verse: The Gershonite clan received two towns from the tribe of East Manasseh: Golan in Bashan and Ashtaroth, including the pastureland around them.
translation_verse: B daŋ ta Manase be yiri to be epeŋilarkpa be kaba so be kade nɛ baa tre Golan nɛ k wɔ Bahan be kasawule so na nɛ Ashterɔf, nɛ amo be asɔbɔya be ejikpa be nsawule nna n sa Gɛshɔnebi.

english_verse: The Gershonites also received four towns from the tribe of Issachar: Kedesh, Daberath, Ramoth, and Anem, including the pastureland around them.
translation_verse: Kadɛsh nɛ Daberaf nɛ Ramɔf nɛ Anɛm ashi Isaaka malɛ be yiri to n ti bumo so.

english_verse: Finally, the Gershonites received three towns from the tribe of Naphtali: Kedesh in Galilee, Hammon, and Kiriathaim, including the pastureland around them.
translation_verse: Nde nɛ amo be asɔbɔya be ejikpa be nsawule nɛ Gɛshɔnebi na daŋ nya ashi Naftali malɛ be yiri na to e daa la Kadɛsh nɛ k wɔ Galili na nɛ Hammɔn nɛ Kiriataim.

english_verse: The rest of the Merari clan received the towns of Rimmono and Tabor and their pastureland from the tribe of Zebulun.
translation_verse: Nde nɛ Mɛrari malɛ be kabuna nɛ k ka na daŋ nya e daa la, Rimmɔn nɛ Tabo nɛ amo be asɔbɔya be ejikpa be nsawule nɛ a wɔ Zɛbyulɔn be yiri to be kasawule be kaba so na.

english_verse: And from the tribe of Gad the Merarites received the towns of Ramoth in Gilead, Mahanaim, Heshbon, and Jazer, including the pastureland around them.
translation_verse: nɛ Hishbɔn nɛ Jaaza n ta amo be asɔbɔya be ejikpa be nsawule n ti so.

english_verse: Issachar was the father of four sons: Tola, Puah, Jashub, and Shimron.
translation_verse: Isaaka daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi ana. Bumo e la Tola nɛ Puwa nɛ Jashub nɛ Shimrɔn.

english_verse: Ephraim mourned for his sons a long time, and his relatives came to comfort him.
translation_verse: Bumo tuto Efrayim daŋ shu bumo be keeli nchɛ damta nna nɛ mo kurgepoana ba lolo mo.

english_verse: Uzzi was the father of Izrahiah and the grandfather of Michael, Obadiah, Joel, and Isshiah, who were also family leaders.
translation_verse: Uzzi malɛ daa kɔ ebinyɛn koŋwule nna. Mo e la Izrahiya. Mbinyɛnsobi ana nɛ Izrahiya malɛ daa kɔ nɛ bumo kikɛ daa la bumo be nnaŋ na to be bejuŋkparpo. Bumo e la Maikel nɛ Obadaya nɛ Jowɛl nɛ Ishiya.

english_verse: Zophah was the father of Suah, Harnepher, Shual, Beri, Imrah,
translation_verse: Zofa be kaman to ebi e daa la Suwa nɛ Hanɛfa nɛ Shuwal nɛ Bɛri nɛ Imra nɛ

english_verse: Benjamin was the father of three sons: Bela, Becher, and Jediael.
translation_verse: Bɛnjamin daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi asa nna. Bumo e la Bɛla nɛ Bɛka nɛ Jediɛl.

english_verse: Bela was the father of Ezbon, Uzzi, Uzziel, Jerimoth, and Iri. They were all brave soldiers and family leaders in their father's clan. The number of soldiers in their clan was
translation_verse: Bɛla daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi anu nna. Bumo e la Ezbɔn nɛ Uzzi nɛ Uziɛl nɛ Jɛrimɔf nɛ Iri. Bumo kikɛ daa la bejuŋkparpo nɛ benapo lempo nna ashi bumo be kanaŋ na to. Bumo be kanaŋ na to be benapo nɛ b daŋ fo kena to be keyɔ daa wɔ benyɛn ŋgboŋ adunyɔ nɛ anyɔ nɛ adesa nɛ ana.

english_verse: Becher was the father of Zemirah, Joash, Eliezer, Elioenai, Omri, Jeremoth, Abijah, Anathoth, and Alemeth.
translation_verse: Bɛka daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi akpanu nna. Bumo e la Zimira nɛ Jɔash nɛ Elieza nɛ Elionai nɛ Omri nɛ Jɛrimɔf nɛ Abija nɛ Anatɔf nɛ Alemɛf.

english_verse: Ephraim was the father of Shuthelah and the ancestor of Bered, Tahath, Eleadah, Tahath,
translation_verse: Efrayim be kaman to ebi e daa la Shutɛla nɛ Bɛrɛd nɛ Tahaaf nɛ Elɛada nɛ

english_verse: Jediael was the father of Bilhan and the grandfather of Jeush, Benjamin, Ehud, Chenaanah, Zethan, Tarshish, and Ahishahar.
translation_verse: Jediɛl daa kɔ ebinyɛn koŋwule nna. Mo e la Bilhan. Mbinyɛnsobi ashunu nɛ Bilhan malɛ daa kɔ. Bumo e la Jewush nɛ Bɛnjamin nɛ Ehud nɛ Chenani nɛ Zeetan nɛ Tashish nɛ Ahishaha.

english_verse: Ulam was the father of Bedan. These were all descendants of Gilead, the son of Machir and the grandson of Manasseh.
translation_verse: Ulam malɛ pibinyɛn e daa la Bɛdan. Makiir pibinyɛn Giliad nɛ e la Manase mo nanabi na be kaman to ebi e daa la bumo.

english_verse: Ir was the father of Shuppim and Huppim, who also belonged to this clan. Dan was the father of Hushim. The Descendants of Naphtali
translation_verse: Shuppim nɛ Hupim bumo tuto e daa la Irr nɛ b la Aher be kaman to ebi. Dan daa kɔ ebinyɛn koŋwule nna. Mo e daa la Hushim. Naftali be kaman to ebi be asheŋ

english_verse: Naphtali's mother was Bilhah, and he was the father of Jahziel, Guni, Jezer, and Shallum. The Descendants of Manasseh
translation_verse: Naftali daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi ana. Bumo e daa la Jaziɛl nɛ Guni nɛ Jɛza nɛ Shallum. Naftali mo nio e daa la Bilha. Manase be kaman to ebi be asheŋ

english_verse: Manasseh and his Syrian wife were the parents of Asriel and Machir the father of Gilead.
translation_verse: Manase daŋ ta Aremiya be eche nna ŋ kurge mbinyɛnsobi anyɔ. Bumo e daa la Asriɛl nɛ Makiir. Makiir pibi e daa la Giliad.

english_verse: Machir found a wife for Huppim and one for Shuppim. Machir had a sister named Maacah. Zelophehad was also a descendant of Manasseh, and he had five daughters.
translation_verse: Makiir e daŋ fin eche n sa Huppim nɛ Shuppim. Mo sipoche be ketre e daa la Maaka. Makiir pibinyɛn nyɔsopo e daa la Zelofehad. Mbichesobi nawule nɛ Zelofehad daa kɔ.

english_verse: Machir and his wife Maacah were the parents of Peresh and Sheresh. Peresh was the father of Ulam and Rekem.
translation_verse: Makiir be eche Maaka daŋ kurge mbinyɛnsobi anyɔ nna nseŋ nase bumo be atre Pɛrɛsh nɛ Shɛrɛsh. Pɛrɛsh malɛ gba daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi anyɔ nna. Bumo e daa la Ulam nɛ Rakɛm.

english_verse: Gilead's sister Hammolecheth was the mother of Ishhod, Abiezer, and Mahlah.
translation_verse: Giliad mo sipoche Hamolɛchɛf daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi asa nna. Bumo e la Ishɔd nɛ Abieza nɛ Maala.

english_verse: Shemida, another descendant of Manasseh, was the father of Ahian, Shechem, Likhi, and Aniam. The Descendants of Ephraim
translation_verse: Shamida malɛ daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi ana nna. Bumo e la Ahian nɛ Shɛkɛm nɛ Likhi nɛ Aniam. Efrayim be kaman to ebi be asheŋ

english_verse: Zabad, and Shuthelah. Ephraim had two other sons, Ezer and Elead. But they were killed when they tried to steal livestock from the people who lived in the territory of Gath.
translation_verse: Zabad nɛ Shutɛla. Shutɛla be kaman, Efrayim daŋ naŋ kurge mbinyɛnsobi anyɔ nna. Bumo e la Eza nɛ Eliad nɛ b daa sha keyuri Gaaf be ndetobia be asɔbɔya nɛ b mɔ bumo na.

english_verse: Some time later his wife gave birth to another son, and Ephraim named him Beriah, because he was born during a time of misery.
translation_verse: Mo nɛ mbe eche ka di keche nɛ kenyɛn nɛ eche na di kedampo ŋ kurge ebinyɛn nɛ b nase mbe ketre Bɛriya ŋkpal asheŋ kraŋ kraŋ ka ba bumo be kanaŋ na to so.

english_verse: Ephraim's daughter was Sheerah. She built the towns of Lower Beth-Horon, Upper Beth-Horon, and Uzzen-Sheerah.
translation_verse: Efrayim pibiche e daa la Sheera. Mo e daŋ pɔr Bɛf Hɔrɔn be kelargato be esoso nɛ kaseto be kaba so be ndeana na nɛ Uzzen Sheera.

english_verse: Ephraim also had a son named Rephah, and his descendants included Resheph, Telah, Tahan,
translation_verse: Efrayim daŋ naa kɔ ebinyɛn ko nɛ baa tre mo Refa. Mbe kaman to ebi e daa la Reshɛf nɛ Tɛla nɛ Tehan nɛ

english_verse: Nun, and Joshua.
translation_verse: Nun nɛ Joshuwa.

english_verse: The descendants of Ephraim took over the territory as far south as Bethel, as far east as Naaran, and as far west as Gezer. Their territory included all the villages around these towns, as well as Shechem, Ayyah, and the nearby villages.
translation_verse: B daŋ sɔ Bɛtɛl nɛ kumo be ndewurbiana nɛ a kulti kumo n ya fo Naraan be epeŋilarkpa be kaba so nɛ Gɛza be epeŋitɔrkpa be kaba so nɛ nde nɛ a kulti amo na kikɛ nɛ amo be nsawule nna n chena so. Shɛkɛm nɛ Aya nɛ nde nɛ a kulti amo na kikɛ gba daŋ ti so.

english_verse: The descendants of Manasseh settled in the territory that included Beth-Shan, Taanach, Megiddo, Dor, and the nearby villages. The descendants of Joseph lived in these towns and villages. The Descendants of Asher
translation_verse: Manase be kaman to ebi na e daa ji Bɛf Shan nɛ Taanak nɛ Majido nɛ Dɔɔ nɛ nde nɛ a kulti kumo na kikɛ so eleŋ. Le be nde ere to nɛ Jeekɔb pibinyɛn Josɛf be kaman to ebi daa wɔ. Asha be kaman to ebi be asheŋ

english_verse: Asher had four sons, Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, and Beriah, and one daughter, Serah.
translation_verse: Ashɛr daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi ana nna. Bumo e la Imna nɛ Ishva nɛ Ishvi nɛ Bɛriya, nseŋ ta ebiche koŋwule nɛ baa tre mo Sɛra.

english_verse: Beriah was the father of Heber and Malchiel the father of Birzaith.
translation_verse: Bɛriya malɛ daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi anyɔ nna. Bumo e daa la Hɛba nɛ Malchiɛl. Malchiɛl e daŋ juŋkpar n chena Birzaf be kade to.

english_verse: Heber was the father of three sons, Japhlet, Shomer, and Hotham, and one daughter, Shua.
translation_verse: Hɛba daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi asa nna. Bumo e la Jaflɛt nɛ Shoma nɛ Hotam nɛ ebiche koŋwule nɛ baa tre mo Shuwa.

english_verse: Japhlet was the father of Pasach, Bimhal, and Ashvath.
translation_verse: Jaflɛt daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi asa nna. Bumo e la Pasak nɛ Bimhaal nɛ Ashvaf.

english_verse: Shomer was the father of Ahi, Rohgah, Hubbah, and Aram.
translation_verse: Shoma daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi ana nna. Bumo e la Ahi nɛ Rooga nɛ Jehuba nɛ Aram.

english_verse: And Japhlet's brother Hotham was the father of Zophah, Imna, Shelesh, and Amal.
translation_verse: Mo da Hotam daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi ana nna. Bumo e la Zofa nɛ Imna nɛ Shɛlɛsh nɛ Amal.

english_verse: Bezer, Hod, Shamma, Shilshah, Ithran, and Beera.
translation_verse: Bɛza nɛ Hɔɔd nɛ Shaama nɛ Shilsha nɛ Itran nɛ Beera.

english_verse: Jether was the father of Jephunneh, Pispa, and Ara.
translation_verse: Jɛta be kaman to ebi e daa la Jefune nɛ Pispa nɛ Ara.

english_verse: Ulla was the father of Arah, Hanniel, and Rizia.
translation_verse: Ulla malɛ be kaman to ebi e daa la Ara nɛ Haniɛl nɛ Riziya.

english_verse: These were the descendants of Asher, and they were all respected family leaders and brave soldiers. The tribe of Asher had a total of
translation_verse: Ashɛr be kaman to ebi kikɛ nna na. Bumo kikɛ daa la kanaŋ na to be bejuŋkparpo nɛ b kɔ bunyaŋ ga nɛ benapo lempo nna. Ashɛr be kaman to ebi na be bumo nɛ b fo kena to be keyɔ daa wɔ benapo ŋgboŋ adunyɔ nɛ ashe.

english_verse: Benjamin had five sons, who were born in the following order: Bela, Ashbel, Aharah,
translation_verse: Bɛnjamin daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi anu nna. Le nɛ b bɛ abar so kenimuso. Bɛla e daa la enimu n ta Ashbel m bɛ so nɛ Ahara nɛ

english_verse: Nohah, and Rapha.
translation_verse: Noha nɛ Raafa.

english_verse: Bela was the father of Addar, Gera, Abihud,
translation_verse: Bɛla be kaman to ebi e daa la Ada nɛ Gɛra nɛ Abihuud nɛ

english_verse: Abishua, Naaman, Ahoah,
translation_verse: Abishuwa nɛ Neeman nɛ Ahɔa nɛ

english_verse: Gera, Shephuphan, and Huram.
translation_verse: Gɛra nɛ Shɛfufan nɛ Huram.

english_verse: Ehud was the father of Naaman, Ahijah, and Gera. They were clan leaders in the town of Geba, but were later forced to move to the town of Manahath, and Gera led the way. He had two sons: Uzza and Ahihud.
translation_verse: Ehud be kaman to ebi e daa la Neeman nɛ Abija nɛ Gɛra. Bumo kikɛ daa la kanaŋ na to be bejuŋkparpoana nna nsaa wɔ Gɛba ama saŋko b daŋ ba tintiŋ bumo nna n lara bumo n yɔ Manahaf. B ka daa sha k lar na, Uzza mo tuto Gɛra nɛ Ahihuud e daŋ juŋkpar bumo.

english_verse: Elpaal was the father of Eber, Misham, and Shemed, who settled the towns of Ono and Lod, as well as the nearby villages.
translation_verse: Elpaal malɛ gba daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi asa nna. Bumo e la Eba nɛ Misham nɛ Shemɛd. Shemɛd e daŋ juŋkpar n chena Ono nɛ Lɔd nɛ ndewurbi nɛ a kulti amo na. Bɛnjaminebi nɛ b wɔ Gaaf nɛ Aijalɔn be asheŋ

english_verse: Beriah and Shema were family leaders in the clan that lived in the town of Aijalon and that forced out the people of Gath.
translation_verse: Bɛriya nɛ Shema e daa la kanaŋ nɛ b chena Aijalɔn na be benimu. Bumo e ju basa nɛ b wɔ Gaaf be kasawule so na.

english_verse: Beriah's descendants included Ahio, Shashak, Jeremoth, Zebadiah, Arad, Eder, Michael, Ishpah, and Joha.
translation_verse: Maikel nɛ Ishpa nɛ Joha. Bɛnjaminebi nɛ b wɔ Jerusalɛm na be asheŋ

english_verse: Jeroham's descendants included Shamsherai, Shehariah, Athaliah, Jaareshiah, Elijah, and Zichri.
translation_verse: Jaarashiya nɛ Elaija nɛ Zikri.

english_verse: These were the family leaders in their ancestor's clan, and they and their descendants lived in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Bumo kikɛ daa la kanaŋ to be benimu nna nɛ bumo nananyɛnana daŋ chena Jerusalɛm.

english_verse: Jeiel settled the town of Gibeon. He and his wife Maacah lived there
translation_verse: Gibiɔn mo tuto Jeɛl daa wɔ Gibiɔn be kade to nna. Mbe eche e daa la Maaka,

english_verse: along with their sons, who were born in the following order: Abdon, Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab,
translation_verse: nɛ mo pibi nimuso malɛ daa la Abdɔn. Mbe mbinyɛnsobi ko e daa la Zur nɛ Kish nɛ Baal nɛ Nɛrr nɛ Nadab nɛ

english_verse: Gedor, Ahio, Zecher,
translation_verse: Gɛdɔ nɛ Ahio nɛ Zeka nɛ

english_verse: and Mikloth the father of Shimeah. Some of them went to live in Jerusalem near their relatives. The Descendants of King Saul
translation_verse: Miklɔf nɛ mo pibi la Shimia na. Bumo be kenan to ebi ko daŋ yɔ Jerusalɛm nna n ya chena bumo kurgepoana kutɔ. Ewura Sɔɔl be kaman to ebi

english_verse: Ner was the father of Kish and the grandfather of King Saul. Saul had four sons: Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab, and Eshbaal.
translation_verse: Neer pibi e daa la Kish, nɛ Kish malɛ pibi daa la ewura Sɔɔl. Ewura Sɔɔl malɛ daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi ana nna. Bumo e la Jonatan nɛ Malchishuwa nɛ Abinadab nɛ Eshbaal.

english_verse: Jonathan was the father of Meribbaal, the grandfather of Micah,
translation_verse: Jonatan pibi e daa la Mɛribaal nɛ Mɛribaal malɛ pibi daa la Maika.

english_verse: and the great-grandfather of Pithon, Melech, Tarea, and Ahaz.
translation_verse: Maika daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi ana nna. Bumo e la Pitɔn nɛ Mɛlɛk nɛ Tariya nɛ Ahaz.

english_verse: as well as Azel's six sons: Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan.
translation_verse: Azɛl daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi ashe nna. Bumo e la Azrikam nɛ Bokɛru nɛ Ishmaɛl nɛ Sheriya nɛ Obadaya nɛ Hanan.

english_verse: Azel's brother Eshek was the father of Ulam, Jeush, and Eliphelet.
translation_verse: Azɛl mo daa Eshɛk da kɔ mbinyɛnsobi asa nna. Bumo e la Ulaam nɛ Jewush nɛ Elifelɛt.

english_verse: Ulam's sons were brave soldiers who were experts at using a bow and arrows. They had a total of
translation_verse: Ulaam be mbinyɛnsobi na daa la benapo nɛ bekpampogboŋ nɛ b kɔ kenyɛn ga nna. Mbe mbinyɛnsobi nɛ mo nanabinyɛnsoana kikɛ daa wɔ basa kalfa nɛ adunu. Bumo kikɛ daa la Bɛnjamin be kaman to ebi nna.

english_verse: People from the tribes of Judah, Benjamin, Ephraim, and Manasseh settled in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Bumo be basa nɛ b shi Juda nɛ Bɛnjamin nɛ Efrayim nɛ Manase be yiri to na daŋ ya chena Jerusalɛm nna.

english_verse: Here is a list of priests who settled in Jerusalem: Jedaiah; Jehoiarib; Jachin; Azariah, who was a temple official, and whose ancestors included Hilkiah, Meshullam, Zadok, Meraioth, and Ahitub; Adaiah son of Jeroham, whose ancestors included Pashhur and Malchijah; Maasai son of Adiel, whose ancestors included Jahzerah, Meshullam, Meshillemith, and Immer.
translation_verse: Bɔrɛmatopoana nɛ b daa wɔ Jerusalɛm na e la Jedaya nɛ Jehowarib nɛ Jakin, nɛ Hilkiya pibinyɛn Azariya nɛ e daa la bɔrɛlambu to be ekrachi be enimu na nɛ mo nananyɛnana daa la Mɛshulam nɛ Zadɔk nɛ Mɛrayɔf nɛ Ahitub na; nɛ Jeroham pibinyɛn Adaya nɛ mo nananyɛnana daa la Pashɔr nɛ Malkija na; nɛ Adiɛl pibinyɛn Maasai nɛ mo nananyɛnana daa la Jazera nɛ Mɛshulam nɛ Mɛshillemif nɛ Imma na.

english_verse: Here is a list of Levites who settled in Jerusalem: Shemaiah from the Merari clan, whose ancestors included Hasshub, Azrikam, and Hashabiah; Bakbakkar; Heresh; Galal; Mattaniah son of Mica, whose ancestors included Zichri and Asaph; Obadiah son of Shemaiah, whose ancestors included Galal and Jeduthun; Berechiah son of Asa and grandson of Elkanah, who had lived in the villages near the town of Netophah. The Temple Guards Who Settled in Jerusalem
translation_verse: Livaiebi nɛ b daa wɔ Jerusalɛm na e la Shemaya nɛ e shi Mɛrari be kabuna nɛ mo nananyɛnana daa la Hashuub nɛ Azrikam nɛ Hashabia na; n ta Bakbakar nɛ Hɛrɛs nɛ Galaal nɛ Mika pibinyɛn Mataniya nɛ mo nananyɛnana daa la Zikri nɛ Asaf na; n ta Shemaya pibinyɛn Obadaya nɛ mo nananyɛnana daa la Galaal nɛ Jedutum na; n ta Asa pibinyɛn Bɛrekaya nɛ mo nananyɛn daa la Elkana nɛ e daa wɔ efuli nɛ k wɔ Netofa be ndekarso na. Bɔrɛlambu na to be beshumpo nɛ b wɔ Jerusalɛm na be asheŋ

english_verse: Shallum, Akkub, Talmon, Ahiman, and their relatives were the guards at the temple gates. Shallum was the leader of this clan,
translation_verse: Bɔrɛlambu na be mbuna be bekumpo e daa la: Shallɔm nɛ Akuub nɛ Talmɔn nɛ Ahiman. Bumo be ejuŋkparpo e daa la Shallɔm.

english_verse: and for a long time they had been the guards at the King's Gate on the east side of the city. Before that, their ancestors guarded the entrance to the Levite camp.
translation_verse: B daŋ keni kakpa nɛ baa tre ewura be kabuna nɛ k wɔ epeŋilarkpa be kaba so na so na n chɛr. Sososo bre, bumo nananyɛnana daa keni Livaiebi na be echenakpaana be mbuna so.

english_verse: Shallum son of Kore, as well as the other men in the Korahite clan, guarded the entrance to the temple, just as their ancestors had guarded the entrance to the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Kɔr pibinyɛn Shallɔm nɛ mo nananyɛn daa la Ebiasaf na nɛ Koora be kabuna be basa ko e daa keni kabuna nɛ baa bɔla a luri bɔrɛlambu na to na so fanɛ kananɛ bumo nananyɛnana daa keni wajɛbu cheembi na be kabuna so na.

english_verse: Phinehas son of Eleazar had supervised their work because the Lord was with him.
translation_verse: Jemanɛ nɛ Eliaza pibinyɛn Finihas daa keni mbunakumpoana na so na, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na daa wɔ mo kutɔ nna.

english_verse: Zechariah son of Meshelemiah was also one of the guards at the temple.
translation_verse: Mɛshɛlemiya pibinyɛn Zakareya gba daa keni Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be wajɛbu na be mbuna na be kuko so nna.

english_verse: Their assistants lived in the villages outside the city, and every seven days a group of them would come into the city and take their turn at guard duty.
translation_verse: Mbunakenipoana be bekurgepoana daa shi bumo be nde nɛ a wɔ kadegboŋ na be ekarso na nna m ba kaa chɛ bumo to a shuŋ nchɛnshunu shunu pɔɛŋ nɛ beko malɛ e ba ka sɔ bumo so.

english_verse: The four full-time guards were Levites, and they supervised the other guards and were responsible for the rooms in the temple and the supplies kept there.
translation_verse: B daŋ ta ebuana nɛ a wɔ bɔrɛlambu na to na nɛ ekpanjawu nɛ a wɔ kumo to na kikɛ be kushuŋ nna n sa mbunakenipoana be benimu ana nɛ b la Livaiebi na nna.

english_verse: They guarded the temple day and night and opened its doors every morning. The Duties of the Levites
translation_verse: B daa keni bɔrɛlambu na so kapa nɛ kanyɛ kikɛ nna nsaa bugi kumo be mbuna na kachipurso kikɛ. Livaiebi nɛ b ka na be asheŋ

english_verse: Some of the Levites were responsible for the equipment used in worship at the temple, and they had to count everything before and after it was used.
translation_verse: Livaiebi na be beko be kushuŋ e daa la kebaakeni ntishaŋ nɛ b kɔ a shuŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be bɔrɛlambu to na so. Pɔɛŋ nɛ b ta amo n shuŋ, baa karga amo nna. B naŋ ta amo n shuŋ n loge, nɛ b naŋ karga amo pɔɛŋ nseŋ ta amo n ya yili.

english_verse: Mattithiah, Shallum's oldest son, was a member of the Levite clan of Korah, and he was in charge of baking the bread used for offerings.
translation_verse: Matatiya nɛ e la Shallɔm pibinyɛn nimuso nsaa la Livai nseŋ shi Koora be kabuna na be kushuŋ e daa la kebaawora bodobodo nɛ baa ta a lara sarga a sa Ebɔrɛ na.

english_verse: The Levites from the Kohath clan were in charge of baking the sacred loaves of bread for each Sabbath.
translation_verse: Livaiebi nɛ b shi Kohaf be kabuna na be kushuŋ e daa la kebaawora bodobodo cheembi a deŋi teebɔl na so kewushiachɛ kikɛ.

english_verse: The Levite family leaders who were the musicians also lived at the temple. They had no other responsibilities, because they were on duty day and night.
translation_verse: Livai be kanaŋ na to be bejuŋkparpo nɛ b la bɔrɛlambu na to be beshɛbompo na daa wɔ bɔrɛlambu na to nna. Bumo ere daa maŋ naa kɔ kushuŋ kikɛ a shuŋ ŋkpal manɛ so kapa nɛ kanyɛ kikɛ baa shuŋ bɔrɛlambu na to nna.

english_verse: All of these men were family leaders in the Levi tribe and were listed that way in their family records. They lived in Jerusalem. King Saul's Family (
translation_verse: Le be basa ere kikɛ daa la Livai be kanaŋ na to be bejuŋkparpo nna nɛ b sibɛ bumo be kekurge to be asheŋ n nase. Jerusalɛm nɛ bumo be bejuŋkparpoana na kikɛ daŋ chena. Ewura Sɔɔl be kanaŋ to ebi be asheŋ

english_verse: the father of Shimeam. Some of them went to live in Jerusalem near their relatives.
translation_verse: nɛ e la Shimiya mo tuto na. Bumo kikɛ daŋ chena m mata bumo be kabuna be basa nna ashi Jerusalɛm to.

english_verse: Jeiel had settled the town of Gibeon, where he and his wife Maacah lived.
translation_verse: Jeɛl e juŋkpar n chena Gibiɔn. Mbe eche be ketre e daa la Maaka.

english_verse: They had ten sons, who were born in the following order: Abdon, Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab,
translation_verse: Mo pibinyɛn nimuso e daa la Abdɔn nɛ mbe mbinyɛnsobiana ko malɛ daa la Zur nɛ Kish nɛ Baal nɛ Neer nɛ Nadab nɛ

english_verse: Gedor, Ahio, Zechariah, and Mikloth
translation_verse: Gɛdɔ nɛ Ahio nɛ Zakareya nɛ Miklɔf

english_verse: Ner was the father of Kish and the grandfather of King Saul. Saul had four sons: Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab, and Eshbaal.
translation_verse: Neer pibi e daa la Kish nɛ Kish malɛ pibi daa la Sɔɔl, nɛ e daŋ ba ki Israɛl be ewura na. Sɔɔl daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi ana nna. Bumo e daa la Jonatan nɛ Malkishuwa nɛ Abinadab nɛ Eshbaal.

english_verse: Jonathan was the father of Meribbaal, the grandfather of Micah, and the great-grandfather of Pithon, Melech, Tahrea, and Ahaz.
translation_verse: Maika daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi ana nna. Bumo e daa la Pitɔn nɛ Mɛlɛk nɛ Tariya nɛ Ahaz.

english_verse: The descendants of Ahaz included Jarah, Alemeth, Azmaveth, Zimri, Moza, Binea, Rephaiah, Eleasah, and Azel and his six sons: Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan.
translation_verse: Azɛl daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi ashe nna. Bumo e la Azrikam nɛ Bocheru nɛ Ishmaɛl nɛ Sheriya nɛ Obadaya nɛ Haran.

english_verse: The Philistines fought against Israel in a battle at Mount Gilboa. Israel's soldiers ran from the Philistines, and many of them were killed.
translation_verse: Kebeegboŋ nɛ baa tre Gilbɔa na so nɛ Filistiebi na daŋ yili a kɔ Israɛlebi na. B daŋ mɔ Israɛlebi na be bedamta kena na to nna nɛ bumo nɛ b ka na nɛ ewura Sɔɔl nɛ mbe mbinyɛnsobi shile.

english_verse: Saul died because he was unfaithful and disobeyed the Lord. He even asked advice from a woman who talked to spirits of the dead,
translation_verse: Sɔɔl ka daa maa ji kashenteŋ a sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ so nɛ e daŋ wu na. E daŋ kini kebɛ Ebɔrɛ be mbra so nna nsaa yɔ belejipo kutɔ n ya ka kpal.

english_verse: The Philistines closed in on Saul and his sons and killed three of them: Jonathan, Abinadab, and Malchishua.
translation_verse: Filistiebi na daŋ ju m buu Sɔɔl nɛ mbe mbia na so nna n ya mɔ Sɔɔl be mbinyɛnsobi asa, Jonatan nɛ Abinadab nɛ Malkishuwa.

english_verse: The fighting was fierce around Saul, and he was badly wounded by enemy arrows.
translation_verse: Kena na be kenishipere be kakpa nɛ Sɔɔl daa wɔ, ŋkpal loŋ so bedoŋ na be atanyembi daŋ da mo nna n doro mo alegaiso.

english_verse: Saul told the soldier who carried his weapons, “Kill me with your sword! I don't want those godless Philistines to torture and make fun of me.” But the soldier was afraid to kill him. Then Saul stuck himself in the stomach with his own sword and fell on the blade.
translation_verse: Nɛ Sɔɔl kaŋɛ enapo nɛ e bee sulɔ mbe akɔsɔ na le: “Pee fo tokobi m mɔ ma! M maa sha Filistiebi, nnyamase ere ka wora ma eyurto nseŋ mɔ ma.” Ama enapo na daŋ kini kewora loŋ nna ŋkpal kufu ka daŋ pɛ mo ga so. Ndoŋ nna nɛ Sɔɔl ta mo gbagba be tokobi be kumu ase n yuu kasawule nseŋ tɔr kumo so.

english_verse: When the soldier realized that Saul was dead, he killed himself in the same way.
translation_verse: Enapo nɛ e bee sulɔ Sɔɔl be akɔsɔ na ka wu fanɛ Sɔɔl wu na, nɛ mo alɛ gba wora kananɛ Sɔɔl wora na gbagba m mɔ mbe kumu.

english_verse: The Israelites who lived in Jezreel Valley learned that their army had run away and that Saul and his sons were dead. They ran away too, and the Philistines moved into the towns the Israelites left behind.
translation_verse: Israɛlebi nɛ b wɔ Jizreel be ketaŋɛ to na ka nu fanɛ Israɛl be benapo shile nɛ b mɔ Sɔɔl nɛ mbe mbinyɛnsobi, nɛ bumo alɛ gba shile ŋ ka bumo be nde, nɛ Filistiebi na ba sɔ amo n chena.

english_verse: The next day the Philistines came back to the battlefield to carry away the weapons of the dead Israelite soldiers. When they found the bodies of Saul and his sons on Mount Gilboa,
translation_verse: B ka kɔ kena na ŋ ŋklade na nɛ Filistiebi na yɔ nɛ b ya muu bubuni na be asɔ, nseŋ ya wu Sɔɔl nɛ mbe mbinyɛnsobi asa na nɛ b wu a dese kebeegboŋ nɛ baa tre Gilbɔa na so.

english_verse: they took Saul's weapons, pulled off his armor, and cut off his head. Then they sent messengers everywhere in Philistia to spread the news among their people and to thank the idols of their gods.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Filistiebi na ku Sɔɔl be kumu nseŋ gbaŋ mbe kenyɛnkale nseŋ shuŋi mbɔ fanɛ b nite Filisti be efuli so be agbirlambu to nɛ kaplɛkama nɛ bumo be basa wɔ m bɔ baru lela ere.

english_verse: They put Saul's armor in the temple of their gods and hung his head in the temple of their god Dagon.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ b ta mbe kena to be akɔsɔ na n ya yili bumo be agbir be lambu ko to nseŋ ta mbe kumu na malɛ n shiga bumo be kegbir Dagɔn be lambu to.

english_verse: When the people who lived in Jabesh in Gilead heard what the Philistines had done to Saul,
translation_verse: Jabesh be basa nɛ b wɔ Giliad na ka nu kusɔ nɛ Filistiebi na wora Sɔɔl na,

english_verse: some brave men went to get his body and the bodies of his three sons. The men brought the bodies back to Jabesh, where they buried them under an oak tree. Then for seven days, they went without eating to show their sorrow.
translation_verse: nɛ bumo be basa nɛ b kɔ kenyɛn ga na koso n ya ta Sɔɔl nɛ mbe mbinyɛnsobi na be kebuni n yɔ Jabesh n ya puli kedibi gboŋgboŋi ko be kifito, nseŋ kishi nchɛ ashunu a ŋini kananɛ bumo be ŋgbene daŋ jija bumo.

english_verse: instead of asking the Lord. So the Lord had Saul killed and gave his kingdom to David, the son of Jesse.
translation_verse: Loŋ so nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ daŋ shin nɛ e wu nɛ e ta mbe kuwurji n sa Jɛsi pibinyɛn Deevid na.

english_verse: The Jebusites said, “You won't be able to get in here!” But David captured the fortress of Mount Zion, which is now called the City of David.
translation_verse: Jebusiebi na daŋ kaŋɛ Deevid nna fanɛ e maaŋ tiŋ n luri bumo be kade na to kikɛ, ama Deevid daŋ ya tiŋ ŋ kɔ n sɔ kebeegboŋ nɛ baa tre Zayɔn na be kumɔlga be mboŋ lempo kikɛ nna nɛ kade na ki Deevid be kade to.

english_verse: Israel's leaders met with David at Hebron and said, “We are your relatives,
translation_verse: Israɛlebi na kikɛ daŋ ba Deevid kutɔ ashi Hibrɔn m ba kaŋɛ mo le: “Fo nio pibiana e la anyi.

english_verse: So we have come to crown you king of Israel.” David made an agreement with the leaders and asked the Lord to be their witness. Then the leaders poured olive oil on David's head to show that he was now king of Israel. This happened just as the Lord's prophet Samuel had said. David Captures Jerusalem (
translation_verse: Amoso Israɛlebi be bejuŋkparpoana nɛ b daŋ ba Deevid kutɔ ashi Hibrɔn na shin nɛ bumo nɛ mo wora kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre ashi Ebɔrɛ be anishito nna. Kumo be kaman nɛ b ta ŋku n do mbe kumu so m buu mo Israɛl be kuwura fanɛ kananɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ŋini anebi Samuɛl na gbagba.

english_verse: David had told his troops, “The first soldier to kill a Jebusite will become my army commander.” And since Joab son of Zeruiah attacked first, he became commander.
translation_verse: Ewura Deevid daŋ kaŋɛ mbe benapo nna le: “Ekama nɛ e baŋ juŋkpar m mɔ Jebusi be esa e naŋ ki ma benapo kikɛ be enimu!” Ndoŋ nna nɛ Jɔab nɛ mo nio la Zeruwa na, juŋkpar n yɔ kena na to nɛ b ta mo ŋ ki benapo na kikɛ be enimu.

english_verse: The Lord had promised that David would become king, and so everyone in Israel gave David their support. Certain warriors also helped keep his kingdom strong.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ daŋ nase kɔnɔ nna fanɛ Deevid beeŋ ki ewura nɛ Israɛlebi na kikɛ e yili mbe kaman. Mbe kuwurji daŋ ji eleŋ ga ŋkpal benapo lempo ko ka daŋ chɛ mo to so.

english_verse: Later, David moved to the fortress—that's why it's called the City of David.
translation_verse: Deevid daŋ ya chena kumɔlga be kakpa lempo na nna amoso nɛ b daa tre kumo “Deevid be kadegboŋ na.”

english_verse: David became a great and strong ruler, because the Lord All-Powerful was on his side. The Three Warriors (
translation_verse: Ŋkpal Enyɛnpetale ka daa wɔ Deevid kutɔ so, mbe kuwurji daŋ baa nya eleŋ nna a ti so saŋkikɛ. Deevid be benapo lempo be asheŋ (

english_verse: Another time he killed an Egyptian who was over two meters tall and was armed with a spear. Benaiah only had a club, so he grabbed the spear from the Egyptian and killed him with it.
translation_verse: E daŋ mɔ Ijipt be kanyɛn gboŋgboŋi ko nɛ mbe nteŋ du fanɛ ayadra ashunu nɛ bargato nɛ e daŋ keta kekpa gboŋgboŋi ko a kɔ mo, ama Bɛnaya bre daŋ ta kaprɛ nna ŋ kɔ mo nseŋ suge Ijipt be esa na be kekpa na ashi mbe enɔ to nseŋ mɔ mo.

english_verse: and he said, “I'm very thirsty. I wish I had a drink of water from the well by the gate to Bethlehem.”
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ achukoŋ pɛ Deevid nɛ e kaŋɛ le: “Nɛ esa ko daa beeŋ ya jɔ Bɛtlɛhɛm be kabunagboŋ na ase be ketirbu na be nchu m bar ma nɛ n nu nna, k daa beeŋ par ma ga!”

english_verse: The first of these warriors was Jashobeam the son of Hachmoni, the leader of the Three Warriors. In one battle he killed
translation_verse: Benapo lempo na be ejuŋkparpo e daa la Jashobiam nɛ e la Hachmɔn pibinyɛn na. Mo e daa la benapo lempo na to be bekpakpaso asa be enimu na. Mo e daŋ ta kekpa m mɔ benapo alfa asa ashi kena koŋwule to na.

english_verse: Another one of the Three Warriors was Eleazar son of Dodo the Ahohite.
translation_verse: Benapo lempo asa na to be emo nɛ e naŋ bɛ so e la Dodo pibinyɛn Eliaza nɛ e shi Aho be kabuna na.

english_verse: During a battle against the Philistines at Pas-Dammim, all the Israelite soldiers ran away,
translation_verse: E daŋ chɛ Deevid to nna ŋ kɔ Filistiebi na kena ashi Pas Dummin. Ayu be kudɔ to nɛ e daa wɔ nɛ Israɛlebi na fara a shile,

english_verse: except Eleazar, who stayed with David. They took their positions in a nearby barley field and defeated the Philistines! The Lord gave Israel a great victory that day.
translation_verse: ndoŋ nna nɛ mo nɛ mbe benapo yili kudɔ na be nferinto ŋ kɔ Filistiebi na kena nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ b kɔ m pɔɔ Filistiebi na so nɛnɛ.

english_verse: One time the Three Warriors went to meet David among the rocks at Adullam Cave. The Philistine army had set up camp in Rephaim Valley
translation_verse: Kachako nɛ benapo lempo adesa to be benapo asa yɔ Deevid kutɔ kefalta ko ase ashi Adulam be kebeelaŋ ase nɛ Filistiebi malɛ be benapo wora bumo be keeyi to ashi Refaebi be Ketaŋɛ to.

english_verse: and said, “Drinking this water would be like drinking the blood of these men who risked their lives to get it for me.” The Three Warriors did these brave deeds. The Thirty Warriors (
translation_verse: ŋ kaŋɛ le: “M maaŋ nuu nchu ere! M baŋ nuu amo, k beeŋ baa du fanɛ ŋ ka nuu basa nɛ b ta bumo be amu ŋ kpa kelara ere be ŋklaŋ nna!” Ndoŋ nna nɛ e kini amo be kenu. Benapo lempo asa na be kenyɛn nɛ b daŋ ji nna na.

english_verse: and was more famous than the rest of the Thirty Warriors. He was their commander, but he never became one of the Three Warriors.
translation_verse: Mbe ketre e daŋ dii ga ashi benapo adesa na to, hale nɛ e ki bumo be ejuŋkparpo ama k daa maŋ dii n fo benapo lempo asa na peya so.

english_verse: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was a brave man from Kabzeel who did some amazing things. One time he killed two of Moab's best fighters, and one snowy day he went into a pit and killed a lion.
translation_verse: Jehowada pibinyɛn Bɛnaya nɛ e shi Kabziil na daa la enapo lempo nna. E daŋ ji kenyɛn ekpa damta so ga hale m mɔ Mowab be benapo lempo anyɔ ko. Kachako nɛ e daŋ lar bɔrɛ nɛ abɔrɛjembubi to n ya gbelge kejamaŋ to m mɔ buluŋ.

english_verse: Benaiah did things like that; he was just as brave as the Three Warriors,
translation_verse: Le be kenyɛn nɛ Bɛnaya nɛ e daa la benapo lempo adesa na to be eko na daŋ ji.

english_verse: even though he never became one of them. And he was certainly as famous as the rest of the Thirty Warriors. So David made him the leader of his own bodyguard.
translation_verse: Mbe ketre daŋ dii ga ashi benapo adesa na kikɛ to ama mo alɛ daa maŋ fo benapo lempo asa na so. Mo nɛ ewura Deevid daŋ ta ŋ ki basa nɛ baa kuŋ mo na be enimu.

english_verse: Several of these warriors were from King Saul's own tribe of Benjamin. They were experts at using a bow and arrows, and they could shoot an arrow or sling a stone with either hand.
translation_verse: Benapo na daŋ shi Bɛnjamin be yiri nɛ Sɔɔl gba shi kumo to na nna. B daa nyi ata nɛ atababu be keto ga. B daa tiŋ a ta enɔjiso nɛ enɔ bena kikɛ a to ata.

english_verse: Men from the tribe of Gad also joined David at his fortress in the desert and served as his warriors. They were also brave soldiers—fierce as lions and quick as gazelles. They were always prepared to fight with shields and spears.
translation_verse: Gad be yiri na to be basa ko gba daŋ ya tu Deevid ashi mbe kumɔlga be kakpa lempo keshishɛrsawule na so nna nseŋ ki mbe benapo. Bumo alɛ gba daa la benapo lempo nna nsaa nyi kananɛ baa ta asɔ kuŋso nɛ ekpa a kɔ kena nsaa gbir kenishi fanɛ ebuluŋ nseŋ naa du wurɛwurɛbi malɛ fanɛ kebee so be chibir.

english_verse: There were eleven of them, ranked in the following order: Ezer the leader, then Obadiah, Eliab, Mishmannah, Jeremiah, Attai, Eliel, Johanan, Elzabad, Jeremiah, and Machbannai.
translation_verse: Kananɛ b bɛ abar so nde. Eza e daa la bumo be ejuŋkparpo, n ta Obadaya m bɛ so n ta Eliab nɛ Mishmana nɛ Jɛremaya nɛ Attai nɛ Eliɛl nɛ Johanan nɛ Elzabad nɛ Jɛremaya nɛ Makbanaya.

english_verse: All these men were army officers; some were high-ranking officers over a thousand troops, and others were officers over a hundred troops.
translation_verse: Gad be yiri to be basa ere be beko daa la benapo be benimugboŋ nɛ b daa keni benapo be katuŋ kagboŋ so nna nɛ beko malɛ la benimu nɛ baa keni benapo be katuŋ kalfa so.

english_verse: Earlier, they had crossed the Jordan River when it flooded, and they chased out the people who lived in the valleys on each side of the river. Warriors from the Benjamin and Judah tribes
translation_verse: Bumo e daŋ dii Jɔɔdan be lɔr na saŋɛ nɛ k bɔlɔ n lar apla kafɛ be kufɔl juŋkparso to na n ju basa nɛ b wɔ kumo be epeŋilarkpa nɛ epeŋitɔrkpa be kaba so be kepla so na nɛ b pesaŋ to. Deevid be bebɛsopo nɛ b shi Bɛnjamin nɛ Juda na be asheŋ

english_verse: One time a group of men from the tribes of Benjamin and Judah went to the fortress where David was staying.
translation_verse: Saŋko Bɛnjamin nɛ Juda be benapo be katuŋ ko daŋ yɔ Deevid kutɔ nna ashi kumɔlga be kakpa lempo na.

english_verse: David met them outside and said, “If you are coming as friends to fight on my side, then stay and join us. But if you try to turn me over to my enemies, the God our ancestors worshiped will punish you, because I have done nothing wrong.”
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Deevid daŋ lar n ya tu bumo nseŋ kaŋɛ bumo le: “Nɛ men la beteri nɛ baa ba nɛ b ba chɛ ma to ŋ kɔ nna bre, kumo ere mee wora menyi ansaŋ nɛ keba. Ama nɛ fanɛ men ba nna nɛ men ba debɔr ma ŋ ŋini ma doŋana saŋɛ nɛ m maŋ wora menyi kulubi kikɛ ere, an nananyɛnana be Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ gberge menyi kusoe.”

english_verse: Some of the warriors who joined David were from the tribe of Manasseh. They had earlier gone with David when he agreed to fight on the side of the Philistines against King Saul. But as soon as the Philistine rulers realized that David might turn against them and rejoin Saul, they sent David away to the town of Ziklag.
translation_verse: Manase be yiri to be benapo ko daŋ ya ti Deevid be benapo so nna saŋɛ nɛ e daŋ lar n ya tu Filistiebi na nɛ e kɔ ewura Sɔɔl kena na. english_verse: and brave soldiers, and so David made them officers in his army. They fought on his side when enemy troops attacked.

english_verse: Other Israelites from as far away as the territories of Issachar, Zebulun, and Naphtali brought cattle and sheep to slaughter for food. They also brought donkeys, camels, mules, and oxen that were loaded down with flour, dried figs and raisins, wine, and olive oil. Everyone in Israel was very happy.
translation_verse: Isaaka nɛ Zɛbyulɔn nɛ Naftali be eyiri nɛ b wɔ kufɔ na daŋ sulɔ ajibi nɛ nyifu nɛ asɔrso nɛ baa tre greep na be awɔlso nɛ asɔnuuso nɛ ɔlif be ŋku, ekurma nɛ enyɔma nɛ egbolufɛlso so nna.
