english_verse: David sent for his son Solomon and told him to build a temple for the Lord God of Israel.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ ewura Deevid shuŋi n tre mo pibinyɛn Sɔlɔmɔn ŋ kaŋɛ mo fanɛ e pɔr bɔrɛlambu n sa Enyɛnpe, Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na.

english_verse: He said: My son, I wanted to build a temple where the Lord my God would be worshiped.
translation_verse: Le nɛ Deevid kaŋɛ mo: “M pibinyɛn, n daa sha fanɛ m pɔr bɔrɛlambu nna m maŋkura Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.

english_verse: But some time ago, he told me, “David, you have killed too many people and have fought too many battles. That's why you are not the one to build my temple.
translation_verse: Ama Ebɔrɛ daŋ kaŋɛ ma nna fanɛ ŋkpal ŋ ka kɔ ana damta nseŋ mɔ basa ga na so, e maaŋ shin nɛ m pɔr bɔrɛlambu n sa mo.

english_verse: But when your son becomes king, I will give him peace throughout his kingdom. His name will be Solomon, because during his rule I will keep Israel safe and peaceful.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe na malɛ teŋ juŋkpar n nase le be kɔnɔ n sa ma: Fo pibi kaŋ ba ki ewura meeŋ shin nɛ kagbenewushi e baa wɔ mbe kasawule so. Kebia na be ketre e naŋ ba la Sɔlɔmɔn ŋkpal manɛ so mbe kuwurji be saŋɛ nɛ meeŋ kuŋ Israɛl nɛnɛ nɛ kagbenewushi e baa wɔ kumo to.

english_verse: Solomon will build my temple. He will be like a son to me, and I will be like a father to him. In fact, one of his descendants will always rule in Israel.”
translation_verse: Mo e naŋ pɔr bɔrɛlambu n sa ma. Meeŋ tre mo m pibi nɛ mo alɛ gba e tre ma mo tuto. Mbe mbia e naa baa ji Israɛl be kuwura a ka a sa abar mbaanaayɔ.”

english_verse: Solomon, my son, I now pray that the Lord your God will be with you and keep his promise to help you build a temple for him.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ Deevid yɛ: “M pibinyɛn Sɔlɔmɔn, Enyɛnpe fo Ebɔrɛ na e baa wɔ fo kutɔ n shin nɛ kɔnɔ nɛ e nase fanɛ e beeŋ chɛ fo to nɛ fo pɔr bɔrɛlambu n sa mo na e bɔlɔ so.

english_verse: May he give you wisdom and knowledge, so that you can rule Israel according to his Law.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe nɛ e la fo Ebɔrɛ na e sa fo kanyiasheŋ nɛ nfɛra nɛ fo baa wora asheŋ amo be ekpa so, nseŋ juŋkpar Israɛl ashi mbe mbra be ekpa so nɛnɛ.

english_verse: If you obey the laws and teachings that the Lord gave Moses, you will be successful. Be strong and brave and don't get discouraged or be afraid of anything.
translation_verse: Fo baa bɛ mbra nɛ keŋini nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ta n sa an nananyɛn Mosis dra dra na fanɛ e ta n sa Israɛlebi na so bre, asheŋ beeŋ nyalɛ n sa fo. Ama baa yil to kpakpa a leŋ fo kumu to nsaa maa lɔ kufu.

english_verse: I have also assigned men who will cut and lay the stone. And there are carpenters and people who are experts in working with
translation_verse: Men kɔ beshumpo damta. Basa nɛ baa bure ajembu to nɛ bepɔrpo nɛ ekapɛnta nɛ basa damta nɛ b nyi enɔ to be ashuŋ damta

english_verse: gold, silver, bronze, and iron. You have plenty of workers to do the job. Now get started, and I pray that the Lord will be with you in your work.
translation_verse: nsaa tiŋ a ta shuwa nɛ gbiti nɛ danyaŋ nɛ kebɛlso a lɔŋɛ asɔ. K daga fanɛ men fara kushuŋ na naniere nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e chɛ menyi to.”

english_verse: David then gave orders for the leaders of Israel to help Solomon.
translation_verse: Kede be kaman nɛ ewura Deevid kaŋɛ Israɛl be bejuŋkparpoana nna fanɛ b chɛ Sɔlɔmɔn to.

english_verse: David said: The Lord our God has helped me defeat all the people who lived here before us, and he has given you peace from all your enemies. Now this land belongs to the Lord and his people.
translation_verse: E yɛ: “Enyɛnpe men be Ebɔrɛ na e chɛ menyi to nseŋ sa menyi kagbenewushi ekpa kama so. E chɛ ma to nɛ ŋ kɔ m pɔɔ basa nɛ b daa wɔ kasawule na so nseŋ shin nɛ baa shuŋ ma nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.

english_verse: Obey the Lord your God with your heart and soul. Begin work on the temple to honor him, so that the sacred chest and the things used for worship can be kept there.
translation_verse: Men ta men be ŋgbene nɛ men be ayoyu kikɛ a shuŋ Ebɔrɛ. Men fara a pɔr bɔrɛlambu na saŋɛ na so menyeeŋ ta Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be ŋkre be deka na nɛ asɔ cheembi nɛ b kɔ a bunyaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na n ya yili kumo to.”

english_verse: David was old when he chose his son Solomon to be king of Israel.
translation_verse: Deevid ka bel, nɛ e ta mo pibinyɛn Sɔlɔmɔn ŋ ki Israɛl be ewura. Livaiebi na be kushuŋ be asheŋ

english_verse: Some time later, David called together all of Israel's leaders, priests, and Levites.
translation_verse: Saŋko ka ba fo, nɛ ewura Deevid shin nɛ Israɛlebi be bejuŋkparpoana na nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana na nɛ Livaiebi na kikɛ ba shɛr abar so.

english_verse: Every morning and evening, the Levites are to give thanks to the Lord and sing praises to him.
translation_verse: Bumo Livaiebi na e naaŋ baa chɔrɔ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nsaa boŋ nshɛ e di mo epaŋ kachipurso nɛ kaaseso kikɛ.

english_verse: David then divided the Levites into three groups according to the clans of Levi's sons, Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
translation_verse: Ewura Deevid daŋ barga Livaiebi na to mbuna ntuŋ asa nna. Amo e la Gɛshɔn be kabuna nɛ Kohaf be kabuna nɛ Mɛrari be kabuna.

english_verse: Gershon had two sons: Ladan and Shimei.
translation_verse: Ladan nɛ Shimei daŋ shi Gɛshɔn be kabuna nna.

english_verse: They were all family leaders among their father's descendants. Shimei was the father of Shelomoth, Haziel, and Haran.
translation_verse: Shimei malɛ daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi asa nna. Bumo e la Shelomɔf nɛ Haziɛl nɛ Haran.

english_verse: Later, Shimei had four more sons, in the following order: Jahath, Ziza, Jeush, and Beriah. But Jeush and Beriah didn't have many children, so their descendants were counted as one family.
translation_verse: Bede be kaman nɛ Shimei naŋ nya mbinyɛnsobi ana. Bumo e la Jahaf nɛ Zina nɛ Jewush nɛ Beriya. Jewush nɛ Beriya bre be mbia daa maŋ shi amoso b daŋ ta bumo nna m ber abar so fanɛ kanaŋ koŋwule be basa.

english_verse: Kohath had four sons: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
translation_verse: Kohaf daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi ana nna. Bumo e daa la Amram nɛ Izha nɛ Hibrɔn nɛ Uziɛl.

english_verse: Amram was the father of Aaron and Moses. Aaron and his descendants were chosen to be in charge of all the sacred things. They served the Lord by offering sacrifices to him and by blessing the people in his name.
translation_verse: Amram nɛ e daa la mo pibinyɛn nimuso na be mbia e daa la Ɛɛrɔn nɛ Mosis. Ɛɛrɔn nɛ mbe kaman to ebi nɛ b daŋ lara n yili fanɛ b baa keni asɔ cheembi na so mbaanaayɔ. Bumo alɛ e naaŋ baa chɔɔ duwu saŋɛ so nɛ baa bunyaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na, nsaa shuŋ mo a kule mo fanɛ e baa nɛfa mbe basa.

english_verse: Moses, the man of God, was the father of Gershom and Eliezer, and their descendants were considered Levites.
translation_verse: Mosis be mbinyɛnsobi e daa la Gɛshɔm nɛ Eliaza.

english_verse: Gershom's oldest son was Shebuel.
translation_verse: Gɛshɔm pibinyɛn nimuso e daa la Shebuwɛl.

english_verse: The second son born to Kohath was Izhar, and his oldest son was Shelomith.
translation_verse: Kohaf pibinyɛn nyɔsopo e daa la Izha nɛ Izha pibinyɛn nimuso daa la Shelomif.

english_verse: Hebron, the third son of Kohath, was the father of Jeriah, Amariah, Jahaziel, and Jekameam.
translation_verse: Hibrɔn nɛ e la Kohaf pibinyɛn sasopo na daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi ana nna. Bumo e la Jeriya nɛ Amariya nɛ Jehaziɛl nɛ Jekamiɛm.

english_verse: Merari had two sons: Mahli and Mushi. Mahli was the father of Eleazar and Kish.
translation_verse: Mɛrari daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi anyɔ nna. Bumo e la Maali nɛ Mushi. Maali gba daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi anyɔ nna. Bumo e daa la Eliaza nɛ Kish.

english_verse: Eleazar had no sons, only daughters, and they married their uncle's sons.
translation_verse: Eliaza bre daa maŋ kurge mbinyɛnsobi, mbichesobi nawule nɛ e daŋ kurge nɛ bumo alɛ kil bumo tutokar Kish be mbia.

english_verse: Mushi the second son of Merari, was the father of Mahli, Eder, and Jeremoth.
translation_verse: Mushi nɛ e la Mɛrari pibinyɛn nyɔsopo na daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi asa nna. Bumo e daa la Maali nɛ Eda nɛ Jerɛmɔf.

english_verse: David said: The Lord God of Israel has given his people peace, and he will live in Jerusalem forever.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so Deevid yɛ, Enyɛnpe Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na sa mbe basa kagbenewushi, mo alɛ Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ baa wɔ Jerusalɛm mbaanaayɔ.

english_verse: And so, the Levites won't need to move the sacred tent and the things used for worship from place to place.
translation_verse: Amoso Livaiebi na maaŋ naa sulɔ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be wajɛbu na nɛ asɔ nɛ b kɔ ashuŋ kumo to na a nite.

english_verse: will serve the Lord by helping Aaron's descendants do their work at the temple, by keeping the courtyards and rooms of the temple clean, and by making sure that everything used in worship stays pure.
translation_verse: Livaiebi na be kushuŋ e daa la kebaachɛ Ɛɛrɔn be kaman to ebi to ashi Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be bɔrɛlambu na be kushuŋ to. Bumo e naŋ baa lɔŋɛ kumo nsaa keni kumo be alɔnɛ nɛ ebuana nɛ asɔ cheembi na so nɛ a saa maa wora eyurpi.

english_verse: They will also be in charge of the sacred loaves of bread, the flour for the grain sacrifices, the thin wafers, any offerings to be baked, and the flour mixed with olive oil. These Levites will weigh and measure these offerings.
translation_verse: Bumo koŋwule na e naaŋ naa keni bodobodo nɛ b ta n lara sarga n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na, nɛ nyifu nɛ b kɔ a lara sarga na nɛ ekrakashi nɛ a maaŋ kɔ yiisi na so, nsaa wora bodobodo nɛ baa ta n lara sarga na. Bumo koŋwule na e naa karga kusɔ kama, nsaa ta duwu nɛ asɔ warabi nɛ nyifu nɛ ɔlif be ŋku a wea abar to a wora asɔ ashi bɔrɛlambu na to.

english_verse: They must also give thanks and sing praises when sacrifices are offered on each Sabbath, as well as during New Moon Festivals and other religious feasts. There must always be enough Levites on duty at the temple to do everything that needs to be done.
translation_verse: Bumo koŋwule na e naŋ baa ta kechɔrɔ a sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nsaa di mo epaŋ saŋkama nɛ baa lara kewushiachɛ nɛ kufɔl popɔr be nchɛgboŋ nɛ nchɛgboŋana kikɛ be esarga na. Kushuŋ nɛ b sa Livaiebi be katuŋ kama na e daga fanɛ b baa shuŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be anishito saŋkama.

english_verse: They were once in charge of taking care of the sacred tent; now they are responsible for the temple and for helping Aaron's descendants.
translation_verse: Saŋko bumo e daa keni Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be wajɛbu na so, ama naniere bre bumo e naa keni bɔrɛlambu na so nsaa chɛ Ɛɛrɔn be kanaŋ nɛ b shi kebɔrɛmata be kanaŋ na to na to a shuŋ Ebɔrɛ be bɔrɛlambu na to.

english_verse: Aaron's descendants were then divided into work groups. Aaron had four sons: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
translation_verse: B daŋ barga Ɛɛrɔn be kaman to ebi to ntuŋso nna. Ɛɛrɔn daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi ana nna. Bumo e daa la: Nadab nɛ Abihu nɛ Eliaza nɛ Itama.

english_verse: But Nadab and Abihu died long before their father, without having any sons. That's why Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests.
translation_verse: Nadab nɛ Abihu bre daŋ wu nna pɔɛŋ nɛ bumo tuto wu. Bumo alɛ daa maŋ kurge mbinyɛnsobi, amo so nɛ Eliaza nɛ Itama daŋ ki bɔrɛmatapoana na.

english_verse: David divided Aaron's descendants into groups, according to their assigned work. Zadok, one of Eleazar's descendants, and Ahimelech, one of Ithamar's descendants, helped David.
translation_verse: Ewura Deevid daŋ barga Ɛɛrɔn be kaman to ebi na to ntuŋso ntuŋso nna a laŋɛ bumo be kushuŋ be kaplɛa so. Eliaza mo nanabi Zadɔk nɛ Itama mo nanabi Ahimɛlɛk e daŋ chɛ Deevid to m barga bumo to.

english_verse: However, both families included temple officials and priests, and so to make sure the work was divided fairly, David asked God what to do.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal bɔrɛlambu na to be beshumpo nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana ka daa wɔ Eliaza nɛ Itama kikɛ be kaman to ebi to na so, b daa to beeri nna a fin Ebɔrɛ be nfɛra pɔɛŋ nsaa barga bumo be ashuŋ to.

english_verse: As each group was assigned their duties, Shemaiah the son of Nethanel the Levite wrote down the name of the family leader in charge of that group. The witnesses were David and his officials, as well as Zadok the priest, Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, and the family leaders from the clans of the priests and the Levites.
translation_verse: B ka daŋ barga ashuŋ na to n sa ntuŋana na, Natanɛl nɛ e la Livai be esa na pibinyɛn Shemaya e daŋ sibɛ kanaŋ na be ejuŋkparpo nɛ e bee keni katuŋ na so be ketre n nase. Ewura Deevid nɛ mbe benimuana nɛ bɔrɛmatapo Zadɔk nɛ Abiata pibinyɛn Ahimɛlɛk nɛ kabɔrɛmata be nnaŋ na be benimuana nɛ Livai be nnaŋ na kikɛ daa wɔ ndoŋ nna.

english_verse: These men were assigned their duties at the temple, just as the Lord God of Israel had commanded their ancestor Aaron. The Rest of the Levites Are Assigned Their Duties
translation_verse: Kananɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ e la Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na daŋ kaŋɛ bumo nananyɛn Ɛɛrɔn nɛ e yili bumo be ashuŋ ashi bɔrɛlambu na to nna na.

english_verse: Here is a list of the other descendants of Levi: Amram was the ancestor of Shubael and Jehdeiah.
translation_verse: Livai be kaman to ebi ko malɛ nde. Shebuwɛl nɛ Jedaya nɛ b la Amram be kaman to ebi na,

english_verse: Rehabiah was the ancestor of Isshiah, the oldest son in his family.
translation_verse: nɛ Isshaya nɛ e la Rehabiya be kaman to ebi na;

english_verse: Izhar was the father of Shelomoth and the grandfather of Jahath.
translation_verse: nɛ Shelomɔf nɛ mo tuto daa la Jahaf nɛ mo nananyɛn malɛ la Izha na;

english_verse: Hebron had four sons, in the following order: Jeriah, Amariah, Jahaziel, and Jekameam.
translation_verse: nɛ Hibrɔn be mbinyɛnsobi, Jeriya nɛ Amariya; nɛ Jahaziɛl nɛ Jakamiam nɛ b bɛ abar so kenimu kenimuso na;

english_verse: Uzziel was the father of Micah and the grandfather of Shamir.
translation_verse: nɛ Shamir nɛ mo tuto la Mika nɛ mo nananyɛn la Uziɛl na;

english_verse: Isshiah, Micah's brother, was the father of Zechariah.
translation_verse: nɛ Mika mo da la Isshaya nɛ mo tuto la Zakareya na,

english_verse: Merari was the father of Mahli, Mushi, and Jaaziah.
translation_verse: nɛ Maali nɛ Muushi nɛ Jazaya nɛ bumo tuto daa la Mɛrari na.

english_verse: Jaaziah had three sons: Shoham, Zaccur, and Ibri.
translation_verse: Jaazaya daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi asa nna. Bumo e la Shoham nɛ Zakuur nɛ Ibri.

english_verse: Mahli was the father of Eleazar and Kish. Eleazar had no sons, but Kish was the father of Jerahmeel.
translation_verse: Maali daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi anyɔ nna. Bumo e la Eliaza nɛ Kish. Eliaza bre daa maŋ kɔ bibinyɛn ama Kish bre daa kɔ ebinyɛn koŋwule, mo e daa la Jeramiil.

english_verse: Mushi had three sons: Mahli, Eder, and Jerimoth. These were the descendants of Levi, according to their clans.
translation_verse: Muushi daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi asa nna. Bumo e la Maali nɛ Eda nɛ Jerɛmɔf. Livai be kaman to ebi nɛ b sibɛ bumo be atre mbuna mbuna so nna na.

english_verse: Each one was assigned his duties in the same way that their relatives the priests had been assigned their duties. David, Zadok, Ahimelech, and the family leaders of the priests and Levites were the witnesses.
translation_verse: Kabuna kikɛ be enimu nɛ mo sipo daŋ to beri nna m bishi Ebɔrɛ be nfɛra a laŋɛ kushuŋ nɛ baaŋ baa shuŋ be kaplɛa so, fanɛ kananɛ bumo kurgepoana, bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ b shi Ɛɛrɔn be kanaŋ to daŋ wora na. Ewura Deevid nɛ Zadɔk nɛ Ahimɛlɛk nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ b shi Livai be kanaŋ to na be anishito nɛ b daŋ wora loŋ.

english_verse: David and the temple officials chose the descendants of Asaph, Heman, and Jeduthun to be in charge of music. They were to praise the Lord by playing cymbals, harps and other stringed instruments. Here is a list of the musicians and their duties:
translation_verse: Ewura Deevid nɛ Livaiebi be bejuŋkparpoana daŋ lara Asaf nɛ Heman nɛ Jedutum nna fanɛ b baa la bɔrɛlambu to be beshɛbompo. Bumo e naŋ baa laŋ ejaŋjilaŋ nɛ echakachaka nɛ egoji a maŋkura Ebɔrɛ nsaa juŋkpar basa a bunyaŋ Ebɔrɛ. Basa nɛ b lara fanɛ b baa juŋkpar basa a bunyaŋ Ebɔrɛ na be atre nde.

english_verse: Asaph's four sons, Zaccur, Joseph, Nethaniah, and Asarelah, were under the direction of their father and played music whenever the king told them to.
translation_verse: Asaf e daa juŋkpar mbe mbinyɛnsobi ana nɛ baa laŋ alaŋsɔ nsaa boŋ nshɛ saŋkama nɛ ewura na bee sha kashɛ be kenu. Bumo e daa la Zakuur nɛ Josɛf nɛ Netaniya nɛ Asharila.

english_verse: Heman was one of the king's prophets, and God honored Heman by giving him
translation_verse: Heman daa la ewura na be anebi ko nna nɛ Ebɔrɛ ta mbinyɛnsobi kuduana ere nɛ mbicheso asa n nɛfa mo.

english_verse: His sons were under his direction and played cymbals, harps, and other stringed instruments during times of worship at the temple. Asaph, Jeduthun, and Heman took their orders directly from the king.
translation_verse: Heman e daa juŋkpar mbe mbia kuduana na nɛ baa laŋ echakachaka nɛ ejaŋjilaŋ a bunyaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ashi bɔrɛlambu na to. Ama ewura Deevid gbagba e daa ŋini Asaf nɛ Jedutum nɛ Heman bre kusɔ nɛ k daga fanɛ b wora.

english_verse: David assigned them their duties by asking the Lord what he wanted. Everyone was responsible for something, whether young or old, teacher or student.
translation_verse: B daa to beri nna a lara ekama be kushuŋ a sa mo. K maŋ tir fanɛ fo la kebia ŋko enimu ŋko eŋinipo ŋko ekoyapo.

english_verse: Elam, Jehohanan, and Eliehoenai.
translation_verse: Elaam nɛ Jehohanan nɛ Eliehonaya.

english_verse: Eighteen descendants of Meshelemiah were chosen for this work.
translation_verse: Benyɛn kuduaburwa nɛ bumo alɛ gba nyi kushuŋ nɛnɛ e daŋ shi Mɛshɛlemiya be kabuna.

english_verse: Hosah, from the Merari clan, was the father of Shimri, Hilkiah, Tebaliah, and Zechariah. Hosah had made Shimri the family leader, even though he was not the oldest son. Thirteen men from Hosah's family were chosen to be temple guards.
translation_verse: Hoosa nɛ e shi Mɛrari be kabuna na daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi ana nna. Bumo e la Shimri nɛ Hilkiya nɛ Tebaliya nɛ Zakareya. Hoosa daŋ ta Shimri nna ŋ ki bumo be ejuŋkparpo, ama mannɛ mo e daa la mbe wurkoŋ. Basa kuduasa e daŋ shi Hoosa be kanaŋ to a kuŋ bɔrɛlambu na.

english_verse: The guards were divided into groups, according to their family leaders, and they were assigned duties at the temple, just like the other Levites.
translation_verse: B daŋ yili kanaŋ kanaŋ so nna mbarga bɔrɛlambu na to be bekumpo na to ntuŋ ntuŋ so nseŋ sa bumo ashuŋ fanɛ bumo braana Livaiebi nɛ b ka na.

english_verse: Each group, no matter how large or small, was assigned a gate to guard, and they let the Lord show them what he wanted done.
translation_verse: Kanaŋ kama daa to beri nna a pin kabuna nɛ baaŋ baa keni so. K maŋ tir kananɛ kanaŋ na sa.

english_verse: Shelemiah was chosen to guard the East Gate. Zechariah his son was a wise man and was chosen to guard the North Gate.
translation_verse: Shelemaya e daa keni epeŋilarkpa be kabuna na so nɛ mo pibinyɛn Zakareya nɛ e daa sa kasotoji lela na daa keni kelargato be esoso be kaba so be kabuna na so.

english_verse: Obed-Edom was then chosen to guard the South Gate, and his sons were chosen to guard the storerooms.
translation_verse: Kelargato be kaseto be kaba so be kabuna nɛ Obɛd Edɔm daa keni so nɛ mbe mbinyɛnsobiana malɛ bee keni ebuana nɛ bumo be asɔ bee yili to ashi loŋ be kabuna ase na so.

english_verse: Shuppim and Hosah were chosen to guard the West Gate and the Shallecheth Gate on the upper road. The guards were assigned the following work schedule:
translation_verse: Shuupim nɛ Hoosa nɛ b daŋ ta epeŋitɔrkpa be kabuna na nɛ Shalekɛf be kabuna nɛ k wɔ esoso be kubɔrbi na ase na n sa nɛ baa keni so. B daŋ barga kushuŋ na to nna n sa bekumpo na nɛ baa shuŋ kumo kebɛso kebɛso.

english_verse: Each day six guards were on duty on the east side of the temple, four were on duty on the north side, and four were on duty on the south side. Two guards were stationed at each of the two storerooms,
translation_verse: Karechɛ kama bekumpo ashe e daa keni bɔrɛlambu na be epeŋilarkpa be kaba so nɛ bena malɛ bee keni kumo be kelargato be esoso be kaba so nɛ bekumpo ana malɛ bee keni kelargato be kaseto be kaba so. Bekumpo ana malɛ e daa keni ebuana nɛ baa ta bumo be asɔ a yili to na so. Basa anyɔ anyɔ e daa keni ebu koŋwule so.

english_verse: four were stationed along the road leading to the west courtyard, and two guards stayed in the court itself.
translation_verse: Bekumpo ana e daa keni kubɔrbi nɛ k bee yɔ kelɔnɛ nɛ k dese epeŋitɔrkpa be kaba so na so nɛ benyɔ malɛ bee keni kelɔnɛ na gbagba so.

english_verse: These were the guard duties assigned to the men from the clans of Korah and Merari. Guards Are Assigned to the Treasury
translation_verse: Mbuna be kekeniso be kushuŋ nɛ b ta n sa Koora nɛ Mɛrari be mbunaebi nna na. Bɔrɛlambu to be ashuŋ nɛ a ka na be asheŋ

english_verse: The Levites who were relatives of the Korahites and the Merarites were in charge of guarding the temple treasury and the gifts that had been dedicated to God.
translation_verse: Livaiebi nɛ bumo kurgepoana la Koora nɛ Mɛrari be mbunaebi na e daa keni bɔrɛlambu na to be ebuana nɛ baa yili amansherbi nɛ asɔ nɛ b kɔ a shuŋ Ebɔrɛ amo to na so.

english_verse: Ladan was from the Gershon clan and was the father of Jehieli. Many of his other descendants were family leaders in the clan.
translation_verse: Ladan nɛ e shi Gɛshɔn be kabuna na pibinyɛn e daa la Jehiɛl. Mo alɛ be kaman to ebi be galenga daa la nnaŋ be benimuana nna ashi kabuna na.

english_verse: Jehieli was the father of Zetham and Joel, and they were responsible for guarding the treasury.
translation_verse: Jehiɛl be mbinyɛnsobi Zetam nɛ Jowɛl e daa keni bɔrɛlambu na be amansherbi nɛ asɔ be ebuana so.

english_verse: Other guards at the treasury were from the Kohathite clans of Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
translation_verse: Amram nɛ Iza nɛ Hibrɔn nɛ Uziɛl nɛ b shi Koha be kabuna na gba daŋ ti basa nɛ baa keni amansherbi nɛ asɔ be ebuana so na nna.

english_verse: Shebuel was a descendant of Gershom the son of Moses. He was the chief official in charge of the temple treasury.
translation_verse: Shebuwɛl daa la Mosis pibinyɛn Gɛshɔm be kenana nna. Mo e daa la bɔrɛlambu na to be amansherbi nɛ asɔ be ebuana be bekenipoana na be enimu.

english_verse: Shelomoth and his relatives were in charge of all the gifts that were dedicated to the Lord. These included the gifts that King David had dedicated, as well as those dedicated by the family leaders, army officers, and army commanders.
translation_verse: Shelomif nɛ mo kurgepoana e daa keni ŋkɛ kama nɛ ewura Deevid nɛ kanaŋ be benimuana nɛ mbuna be bejuŋkparpoana nɛ benapo be benimuana ta m ba sa Ebɔrɛ na so.

english_verse: And whenever valuable things were captured in battle, these men brought back some of them to make repairs to the temple.
translation_verse: Saŋkama nɛ b kɔ kena n sɔ asɔ, baa ta amo be alela nna m ba bɔrɛlambu na to m ba bɔɔ Ebɔrɛ enɔ.

english_verse: Shelomoth and his relatives were responsible for any gifts that had been given to the temple, including those from Samuel the prophet, King Saul the son of Kish, Abner the son of Ner, and Joab the son of Zeruiah. Other Officers Are Assigned Their Duties
translation_verse: Shelomif koŋwule na nɛ mo kurgepoana e naa keni ŋkɛ nɛ anebi Samuɛl nɛ ewura Sɔɔl nɛ Neer pibinyɛn Abna nɛ Zeruwa pibinyɛn Jɔab bar bɔrɛlambu na to na nɛ amo nɛ basa pɔtɛ bar na kikɛ gba so.

english_verse: Joab the son of Zeruiah had begun to count the people, but he stopped when the Lord began punishing Israel. So the total number was never included in David's official records. Officials in Charge of the King's Property
translation_verse: Jɔab nɛ mo nio daa la Zeruwa na, e daŋ fara a karga bumo ama e maŋ tiŋ n loge ŋkpal Ebɔrɛ ka daa gberge Israɛlebi kusoe ŋkpal kabasakarga na so so. Amoso b daa maŋ sibɛ kananɛ basa na sa n nase ewura Deevid be nwɔl to. Ekrachi nɛ baa keni ewurkpa be asɔ so be asheŋ

english_verse: Here is a list of the leaders of each tribe in Israel: Eliezer son of Zichri was over Reuben; Shephatiah son of Maacah was over Simeon; Hashabiah son of Kemuel was over the Levites, and Zadok the priest was over the descendants of Aaron; Elihu the brother of David was over Judah; Omri son of Michael was over Issachar; Ishmaiah son of Obadiah was over Zebulun; Jerimoth son of Azriel was over Naphtali; Hoshea son of Azaziah was over Ephraim; Joel son of Pedaiah was over West Manasseh; Iddo son of Zechariah was over East Manasseh; Jaasiel son of Abner was over Benjamin; Azarel son of Jeroham was over Dan.
translation_verse: Israɛl be eyiriana to be ekrachi nde: Zikri pibinyɛn Eliaza e daa la Ruben be yiri to be krachi nimuso. Maaka pibinyɛn Shefatiya e daa la Simiɔn be yiri to be krachi nimuso. Kemuɛl pibinyɛn Hashabia e daa la Livai be yiri to be ekrachi nimuso. Zadɔk e daa la Ɛɛrɔn be yiri to be krachi nimuso. Ewura Deevid mo da Elihu e daa la Juda be yiri to be krachi nimuso. Maikel pibinyɛn Omri e daa la Isaaka be yiri to be krachi nimuso. Obadaya pibinyɛn Ishmaya e daa la Zɛbyulɔn be yiri to be krachi nimuso. Azriɛl pibinyɛn Jɛrimɔf e daa la Naftali be yiri to be krachi nimuso. Azaziya pibinyɛn Hoshiya e daa la Efrayim be yiri to be krachi nimuso. Pɛdaya pibinyɛn Jowɛl e daa la Manase be epeŋitɔrkpa be kaba so be yiri to be krachi nimuso. Zakareya pibinyɛn Iddo e daa la Manase be epeŋilarkpa be kaba so be yiri to be krachi nimuso. Abna pibinyɛn Jaasiɛl e daa la Bɛnjamin be yiri to be krachi nimuso. Jeroham pibinyɛn Azarɛl e daa la Dan be yiri to be krachi nimuso.

english_verse: David's uncle Jonathan was a wise and intelligent advisor. He and Jehiel the son of Hachmoni taught David's sons.
translation_verse: Ewura Deevid mo wɔpa Jonatan daa la asoetojipo lela nɛ enyipo nna. Mo nɛ Hakmoni pibinyɛn Jehiɛl e daa ŋini ewura be mbinyɛnsobi.

english_verse: Jehoiada the son of Benaiah was the king's advisor after Ahithophel, and later, Abiathar was his advisor. Joab was commander of Israel's army.
translation_verse: Ahitofɛl ka wu be kaman, Abiata nɛ Bɛnaya pibinyɛn Jehowada e daŋ ki ewura na be besoetojipo. Jɔab malɛ e daa la ewura be benapo be enimu.

english_verse: David called a meeting in Jerusalem for all of Israel's leaders, including the tribal leaders, the government officials, the army commanders, the officials in charge of the royal property and livestock, the palace officials, and the brave warriors.
translation_verse: Pɔɛŋ nɛ b pɔr bɔrɛlambu na ewura Deevid daŋ tre Israɛl be bejuŋkparpoana nɛ eyiriana na be benimuana nɛ ekrachi nimuso nɛ benapo be benimuana nɛ benimu nɛ baa keni ewura na nɛ mbe mbia be asɔ nɛ asɔbɔya so na nɛ ewurkpa be benimuana nɛ benapo nɛ b kɔ kenyɛn ga na m ba shɛr Jerusalɛm nna.

english_verse: After everyone was there, David stood up and said: Listen to me, my people. I wanted to build a place where the sacred chest would be kept, so we could go there and worship the Lord our God. I have prepared all the supplies for building a temple,
translation_verse: Ewura Deevid daŋ niŋito nna n yili bumo be anishito nseŋ kaŋɛ bumo le: “Ma basa, men nu nfe. N daa sha kepɔr bɔrɛlambu nɛ ŋkre be deka na beeŋ baa wɔtɔ ndoŋ nna mbaanaayɔ, saŋɛ na so anyeeŋ baa yɔ ndoŋ n ya ka bunyaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na. N wora asɔ kama nɛ a daga fanɛ an ta m pɔr loŋ be bɔrɛlambu na be shiriya

english_verse: but the Lord has refused to let me build it, because he said I have killed too many people in battle.
translation_verse: ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ daa maŋ shuli fanɛ n wora loŋ ŋkpal ŋ ka la enapo nseŋ mɔ basa damta so.

english_verse: The Lord God chose Judah to be the leading tribe in Israel. Then from Judah, he chose my father's family, and from that family, he chose me to be the king of Israel, and he promised that my descendants will also rule as kings.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe nɛ e la Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na e lara ma nɛ ma kaman to ebi fanɛ an baa ji Israɛl be kuwura mbaanaayɔ. N tuto be kanaŋ ashi Juda be yiri na to nɛ e lara fanɛ b baa la bejuŋkparpo. Mbe keparso nɛ e keni n tuto be kanaŋ na kikɛ to n lara ma fanɛ ŋ ki Israɛl be ewura.

english_verse: The Lord has blessed me with many sons, but he chose my son Solomon to be the next king of Israel.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ta mbinyɛnsobi damta n nɛfa ma ama m pibinyɛn Sɔlɔmɔn nɛ e lara fanɛ e ki Israɛl be ewura ma kaman.

english_verse: The Lord said to me, “Your son Solomon will build my temple, and it will honor me. Solomon will be like a son to me, and I will be like a father to him.
translation_verse: Le nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ daŋ kaŋɛ ma: ‘Fo pibinyɛn Sɔlɔmɔn e naŋ pɔr ma bɔrɛlambu n sa ma. Ma e lara mo fanɛ e baa la ma kebia nɛ ma alɛ e baa la mo tuto.

english_verse: If he continues to obey my laws and commands, his kingdom will never end.”
translation_verse: Nɛ e beeŋ baa bɛ ma mbraana so nɛnɛ nsaa wora kusɔ nɛ mee kaŋɛ mo saŋkama bre, mbe kuwurji beeŋ baa wɔtɔ hale mbaanaayɔ.’ ”

english_verse: My friends, you are the Lord's people. And now, with God as your witness, I want you to promise that you will do your best to obey everything the Lord God has commanded us. Then this land will always belong to you and your descendants.
translation_verse: “Amoso mee kaŋɛ menyi nna ashi Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ Israɛlebi kikɛ nɛ b shɛr nfe ere be anishito fanɛ men baa de so nsaa bɛ kusɔ kama nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ anyi na so. Saŋɛ na so kasawule lela ere kraa beeŋ ba la menyi peya, nɛ menyi alɛ gba e ta kumo n sa men be kaman to ebi nɛ k ki bumo be kapetɛ mbaanaayɔ.”

english_verse: Solomon, my son, worship God and obey him with all your heart and mind, just as I have done. He knows all your thoughts and your reasons for doing things, and so if you turn to him, he will hear your prayers. But if you ignore him, he will reject you forever.
translation_verse: Ade kikɛ be kaman nɛ e kaŋɛ Sɔlɔmɔn malɛ le: “M pibinyɛn, ta fo kagbene nɛ fo nfɛra kikɛ a shuŋ fo tuto be Ebɔrɛ na. Mo e nyi anyi be nfɛra nɛ kusɔ nɛ anyee sha kikɛ. Nɛ fo ba mo kutɔ, e beeŋ sɔ fo, ama nɛ fo shile mo bre, mo alɛ beeŋ kplaŋ fo so mbaanaayɔ.

english_verse: The Lord has chosen you to build a temple for worshiping him. Be confident and do the work you have been assigned.
translation_verse: Baa nyi fanɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e lara fo fanɛ fo pɔr mbe bɔrɛlambu cheembi na n sa mo. Amoso a daga fo ka nya kagbene m pɔr kumo nɛnɛ.”

english_verse: After David finished speaking, he gave Solomon the plans for building the main rooms of the temple, including the porch, the storerooms, the rooms upstairs and downstairs, as well as the most holy place.
translation_verse: Ewura Deevid daŋ ŋini Sɔlɔmɔn kananɛ baŋ pɔr bɔrɛlambu na nɛ kumo be ebuana nɛ baa ta asɔwurbi a yili to na nɛ kumo be epunto be ebuana nɛ acheembiana to be kakpa cheembi nɛ baa ta alubi a paŋ na nna.

english_verse: He gave Solomon his plans for the courtyards and the open areas around the temple, and for the rooms to store the temple treasures and gifts that had been dedicated to God.
translation_verse: E daŋ ŋini mo kananɛ e beeŋ wora kumo be kelɔnɛ na nɛ ebuana nɛ a kulti kumo na nɛ kakpa nɛ baa ta bɔrɛlambu na to be amansherbi nɛ asɔ nɛ b kɔ a shuŋ Ebɔrɛ na nɛ ŋkɛ nɛ b ta m ba sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na a wɔtɔ na nna.

english_verse: David also gave Solomon his plans for dividing the priests and the Levites into groups, as well as for the work that needed to be done at the temple and for taking care of the objects used for worship.
translation_verse: Ewura Deevid daŋ naŋ ŋini mo kananɛ e beeŋ barga bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ Livaiebi na to ntuŋ ntuŋ so nɛ b baa shuŋ bumo be ashuŋ bɔrɛlambu na to nsaa keni bɔrɛlambu na to be asɔ nɛ b kɔ a shuŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na so na nna.

english_verse: He told Solomon how much gold and silver was to be used in making the sacred objects,
translation_verse: E daŋ ŋini mo shuwa nɛ gbiti nɛ a daga fanɛ b ta n lɔŋɛ asɔwurbi nɛ

english_verse: including the lampstands and lamps,
translation_verse: nɛ efitilatɔl na kikɛ,

english_verse: the gold table which held the sacred loaves of bread, the tables made of silver,
translation_verse: nɛ shuwa be teebɔl nɛ baaŋ baa ta bodobodo nɛ a la Ebɔrɛ peya na a deŋi so na nɛ gbiti be eteebɔl nɛ a ti so na nna.

english_verse: the gold incense altar, and the gold statue of a chariot for the winged creatures which were on the lid of the sacred chest.
translation_verse: nɛ shuwa nɛ baaŋ ta n lɔŋɛ bɔrɛsure nɛ baaŋ baa chɔɔ duwu kumo so na nɛ kananɛ e beeŋ lɔŋɛ asɔ nɛ a du fanɛ emalaika nɛ b parga bumo be aba m buu Enyɛnpe be ŋkre be deka na be buuso so na nna.

english_verse: David then said to Solomon: The Lord showed me how his temple is to be built.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ ewura Deevid naŋ kaŋɛ Sɔlɔmɔn le: “Kananɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ŋini ma bɔrɛlambu na be kananɛ k daga fanɛ b pɔr kumo nna na.”

english_verse: But you must see that everything is done according to these plans. Be confident, and never be afraid of anything or get discouraged. The Lord my God will help you do everything needed to finish the temple, so it can be used for worshiping him.
translation_verse: Kede be kaman nɛ ewura Deevid naŋ kaŋɛ mo pibinyɛn Sɔlɔmɔn le: “Sa maa lɔ kufu ŋko a pɔ aba, ŋkpal manɛ so Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ mee shuŋ na beeŋ chɛ fo to. E maaŋ kplaŋ fo so kikɛ, ama fo pɔr bɔrɛlambu na n loge nna.

english_verse: The priests and Levites have been assigned their duties, and all the skilled workers are prepared to do their work. The people and their leaders will do anything you tell them.
translation_verse: Bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ Livaiebi na tea nyi ashuŋ nɛ baaŋ shuŋ bɔrɛlambu na to. Basa kama nɛ b kɔ enɔ to be kushuŋ be kenyi na gba kikɛ wora shiriya fanɛ baaŋ chɛ to n shuŋ kushuŋ na. Kusɔ kama malɛ nɛ fo kaŋɛ basa na nɛ bumo be bejuŋkparpoana fanɛ b wora, baaŋ wora.”

english_verse: That's why I have done my best to get everything Solomon will need to build it—gold, silver, bronze, iron, wood, onyx, turquoise, colored gems, all kinds of precious stones, and marble.
translation_verse: Amoso nɛ n wora ania n fin shuwa nɛ gbiti nɛ danyaŋ nɛ abɛlso nɛ ndibi nɛ yawu kpakpaso be ajembu be yiri yiri nɛ abitasɔ nɛ ajembu kpakpaso lela nɛ baa ta a pɔr na, nɛ e beeŋ ta m pɔr kumo na.

english_verse: and to make the gold and silver objects. Now, who else will show their dedication to the Lord by giving gifts for building his temple?
translation_verse: nseŋ ta ako malɛ n sa basa nɛ b kɔ enɔ to be kushuŋ be kenyi nɛ b lɔŋɛ asɔ warabi. Naniere, wanɛ e naŋ bugi kagbene n sa kusɔ ko nɛ b ta m pɔr Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be bɔrɛlambu na?”

english_verse: After David finished speaking, the family leaders, the tribal leaders, the army commanders, and the government officials voluntarily gave gifts
translation_verse: Ewura Deevid ka malga n loge na, nɛ kanaŋ kanaŋ be bejuŋkparpoana nɛ eyiri to be benimuana nɛ benapo be benimuana nɛ ekrachi nimuso kikɛ bugi ŋgbene n sa asɔ.

english_verse: Everyone who owned precious stones also donated them to the temple treasury, where Jehiel from the Levite clan of Gershon guarded them.
translation_verse: Ekama nɛ e daa kɔ yawu kpakpaso be ajembu daŋ ta amo nna n yɔ bɔrɛlambu na be amansherbi nɛ asɔ be ebu nɛ Jehiɛl nɛ e la Livai be esa nsaa shi Gɛshɔm be kabuna na bee keni so na to nna.

english_verse: David and the people were very happy that so much had been given to the Lord, and they all celebrated. David Praises the Lord
translation_verse: Ewura Deevid nɛ basa na kikɛ be ŋgbene daŋ fuli bumo ga nna nɛ b ji eyur ŋkpal ŋkɛ nɛ b daŋ bugi ŋgbene n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na so. Ewura Deevid ka di Ebɔrɛ epaŋ be asheŋ

english_verse: Then, in front of everyone, David sang praises to the Lord: I praise you forever, Lord! You are the God our ancestor Jacob worshiped.
translation_verse: Ewura Deevid daŋ yili basa na kikɛ be anishito nna n di Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ epaŋ ŋ kaŋɛ le: “Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ fo la an nana Jeekɔb be Ebɔrɛ na, kapandi e baa la fo peya mbaanaayɔ!

english_verse: Your power is great, and your glory is seen everywhere in heaven and on earth. You are king of the entire world,
translation_verse: Fo kuwurgboŋ nɛ eleŋ nɛ kemaŋkura nɛ kuwurji wɔtɔ nna mbaanaayɔ. Fo e kɔ esoso nɛ kasawule so kikɛ be eleŋ nsaa ji kusɔ kama so kuwura.

english_verse: and you rule with strength and power. You make people rich and powerful and famous.
translation_verse: Fo e naa sa basa kedamaya nɛ eleŋ nɛ kemaŋkura. Fo gbagba be eleŋ nɛ yuku so nɛ fee ji kusɔ kama so kuwura.

english_verse: We thank you, our God, and praise you.
translation_verse: Anyi be Ebɔrɛ, kechɔrɔ nɛ kapandi e baa la fo peya.

english_verse: But why should we be happy that we have given you these gifts? They belong to you, and we have only given back what is already yours.
translation_verse: Ma nɛ ma basa maŋ kɔ ekpa nɛ an ji eyur ŋkpal ŋkɛ nɛ an sa fo ere so, ŋkpal manɛ so asɔ na kikɛ chɛr a la fo peya nna.

english_verse: We are only foreigners living here on earth for a while, just as our ancestors were. And we will soon be gone, like a shadow that suddenly disappears.
translation_verse: An la befɔ nna a wɔ durnya ere to fanɛ kananɛ an nananyɛnana gba daa wɔ kumo to na. Anyi be nchɛ du nna fanɛ kiyoyul na, k maa chɛr nsaa choŋ.

english_verse: Our Lord God, we have brought all these things for building a temple to honor you. They belong to you, and you gave them to us.
translation_verse: O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, asɔ damta nɛ an ta m ba nɛ an ba pɔr bɔrɛlambu m maŋkura fo ketre ere kikɛ la fo peya nna. Fo e wɔ amo nseŋ ta amo n sa anyi.

english_verse: But we are happy, because everyone has voluntarily given you these things. You know what is in everyone's heart, and you are pleased when people are honest.
translation_verse: N nyi fo ka nyi ekama be kagbene. Ma nɛ ma basa nɛ b wɔ nfe ere kikɛ bugi ŋgbene kagbenefuliso nna m bar asɔ ere kikɛ m ba sa fo.

english_verse: Always make us eager to give, and help us be faithful to you, just as our ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob faithfully worshiped you.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ fo la an nananyɛn Eebraham nɛ Aizek nɛ Jeekɔb be Ebɔrɛ na, shin nɛ fo basa e baa kɔ kakɛ be ŋgbene nsaa ji kashenteŋ a sa fo loŋ mbaanaayɔ.

english_verse: And give Solomon the desire to completely obey your laws and teachings, and the desire to build the temple for which I have provided these gifts.
translation_verse: Jande sa m pibinyɛn Sɔlɔmɔn kasonu be kagbene nseŋ shin nɛ e ta kenishipere m pɔr bɔrɛlambu nɛ n chala kumo be kepɔr be asɔ kikɛ ere.”

english_verse: David then said to the people, “Now it's your turn to praise the Lord, the God your ancestors worshiped!” So everyone praised the Lord, and they bowed down to honor him and David their king. Solomon Is Crowned King
translation_verse: Kede be kaman nɛ ewura Deevid kaŋɛ basa na kikɛ le: “Men di Enyɛnpe men nananyɛnana be Ebɔrɛ na epaŋ.” Ndoŋ nna nɛ basa na kikɛ di Ebɔrɛ epaŋ nseŋ jɔŋɛ ŋ kurgi bumo be amu n yuu to m bunyaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ ewura Deevid kikɛ.

english_verse: The people were very happy, and they ate and drank there at the Lord's altar. That same day, Solomon was again crowned king. The people celebrated and poured olive oil on Solomon's head to show that he would be their next king. They also poured oil on Zadok's head to show that he was their priest.
translation_verse: Kumo be kamɔnchɛ ekama be kagbene daŋ fuli mo ga nɛ b ji nseŋ nuu ashi Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be anishito. Ndoŋ nɛ b lara Sɔlɔmɔn kelɛ nyɔsopo fanɛ ewura nseŋ yili Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be ketre to n ta ŋku n do mo so n lara mo ŋ ki bumo be ewura nseŋ ta ŋku n do Zadɔk malɛ so n lara mo ŋ ki bumo be bɔrɛmatapo.

english_verse: Every official and every soldier, as well as all of David's other sons, were loyal to him.
translation_verse: Benimuana nɛ benapo na nɛ ewura Deevid be mbinyɛnsobi na kikɛ daŋ nase kɔnɔ fanɛ baaŋ baa nu a sa mo fanɛ bumo be ewura.

english_verse: The Lord made Solomon a great king, and the whole nation was amazed at how famous he was. In fact, no other king of Israel was as great as Solomon. David Dies
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ daŋ maŋ Sɔlɔmɔn so nna nseŋ shin nɛ mbe kuwurji daa kɔ kemaŋkura a chɔ Israɛl be ewura kama peya; nɛ kumo be loŋ daŋ chinchiŋ efuli na so ebi kikɛ ga. Ewura Deevid be lalaloge be asheŋ

english_verse: David the son of Jesse was king of Israel
translation_verse: Jɛsi pibinyɛn Deevid nɛ e la Sɔlɔmɔn mo tuto na e daa la Israɛl kikɛ be ewura.

english_verse: David was rich and respected and lived to be an old man. Then he died, and his son Solomon became king.
translation_verse: E daa la damawura nna nsaa kɔ kemaŋkura basa kutɔ, nseŋ bel pɔɛŋ n wu nɛ mo pibinyɛn Sɔlɔmɔn sɔ mo so n ji kuwura.

english_verse: Everything David did while he was king is included in the history written by the prophets Samuel, Nathan, and Gad.
translation_verse: Kusɔ kama nɛ Deevid wora saŋɛ so nɛ e daa la ewura na be asheŋ kikɛ daa wɔ anebi Samuɛl nɛ Neetan nɛ Gad be nwɔl to.

english_verse: They wrote about his powerful rule and about the things that happened not only to him, but also to Israel and the other nations.
translation_verse: Asheŋ nɛ b daŋ sibɛ n wɔtɔ nwɔl na to daa ŋini kananɛ e daŋ ji kuwura, nɛ kananɛ e ji eleŋ, nɛ asheŋ nɛ a tu mo nɛ Israɛl be efuli, nɛ efuliana nɛ a kulti kumo na kikɛ.

english_verse: While Solomon was king of Israel, there was silver and gold everywhere in Jerusalem, and cedar was as common as ordinary sycamore trees in the foothills.
translation_verse: Jemanɛ nɛ e daa ji kuwura na, shuwa nɛ gbiti bre daŋ gbigi nna fanɛ ajembu ashi Jerusalɛm be kade to, nɛ ndibi nɛ baa tre sida na malɛ daŋ gbigi fanɛ ndibi nɛ baa tre sikamɔɔ nɛ a wɔ Juda be abee be efuli so na.

english_verse: and there at the bronze altar, Solomon offered a thousand animals as sacrifices to please the Lord.
translation_verse: Ewura Sɔlɔmɔn ta asɔbɔya kagboŋ nna n chɔɔ n lara sarga danyaŋ be bɔrɛsure na so n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ.

english_verse: God appeared to Solomon that night in a dream and said, “Solomon, ask for anything you want, and I will give it to you.”
translation_verse: Kumo be kanyɛso na gbagba nɛ Ebɔrɛ lara mbe kumu ŋ ŋini Sɔlɔmɔn edare to nseŋ bishi mo le: “Manɛ nɛ fee sha nɛ n wora n sa fo?”

english_verse: Solomon answered: Lord God, you were always loyal to my father David, and now you have made me king of Israel.
translation_verse: Nɛ ewura Sɔlɔmɔn kaŋɛ Enyɛnpe na le: “Kasha nɛ fo kɔ n sa fo kayɛrbi, n tuto Deevid maa chɛrga kikɛ. Naniere fo alɛ ta ma n tal mbe katelamu to nɛ ŋ ki ewura.

english_verse: I am supposed to rule these people, but there are as many of them as there are specks of dust on the ground. So keep the promise you made to my father
translation_verse: O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, jande shin nɛ fo nnɔ nɛ fo nase n sa n tuto na e bɔlɔ so. Fo ta ma nna ŋ ki basa nɛ b shibi m baŋ so kekarga ere be ewura,

english_verse: God replied: Solomon, you could have asked me to make you rich or famous or to let you live a long time. Or you could have asked for your enemies to be destroyed. Instead, you asked for wisdom and knowledge to rule my people.
translation_verse: Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ malɛ kaŋɛ Sɔlɔmɔn le: “Fo kule kusɔ nɛ k walɛ. Fo maŋ kule kedamaya ŋko amansherbi ŋko fo ketre be kedii ŋko fo doŋana be luwu ŋko ŋkpa tenteŋ n sa fo kumu ama kanyiasheŋ nɛ nfɛra nɛ fo kule ma nɛ fo tiŋ n ji ma basa nɛ n ta fo ŋ ki bumo be ewura na so kuwura nɛnɛ.

english_verse: Solomon then left Gibeon and returned to Jerusalem, the capital city of Israel. Solomon's Wealth (
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ ewura Sɔlɔmɔn lar kakpa nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be wajɛbu na daa wɔ ashi Gibiɔn na m bɛta n yɔ Jerusalɛm n ya kaa ji Israɛl be kuwura.

english_verse: This will be a great temple, because our God is greater than all other gods.
translation_verse: Mee sha kepɔr bɔrɛlambu nɛ k shibi ga nna, ŋkpal manɛ so, anyi be Ebɔrɛ na kɔ eleŋ a chɔ kegbir kikɛ.

english_verse: Praise the Lord God of Israel who made heaven and earth! He has given David a son who isn't only wise and smart, but who has the knowledge to build a temple for the Lord and a palace for himself.
translation_verse: Kemaŋkura e baa la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ e la Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ nɛ esoso nɛ kasawule kikɛ be etopo na peya! Mo e sa ewura Deevid ebinyɛn nyiashempo nɛ e kɔ asheŋ be kepinto nɛ kasheŋwora be kenyi nsaa sha kepɔr bɔrɛlambu n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ ewura be laŋ n sa mbe kumu.

english_verse: I am building a temple where the Lord my God will be worshiped. Sweet-smelling incense will be burned there, and sacred bread will be offered to him. Worshipers will offer sacrifices to the Lord every morning and evening, every Sabbath, and on the first day of each month, as well as during all our religious festivals. These things will be done for all time, just as the Lord has commanded.
translation_verse: Mee pɔr lambu nna nɛ m maŋkura Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ. K beeŋ baa la kakpa cheembi nɛ ma nɛ ma basa beeŋ baa bunyaŋ Ebɔrɛ nsaa chɔɔ duwu nɛ a kɔ efɛa belbelso nsaa lara bodobodo cheembi be sarga a sa mo saŋkikɛ. Ndoŋ malɛ gba nɛ anyeeŋ baa lara sarga chɔɔso kachipurso nɛ kaaseso kikɛ nɛ kewushiachɛ kikɛ nɛ kufɔl popɔr to be kachɛ juŋkparso kikɛ nɛ ewushi be nchɛ a maŋkura an Enyɛnpe nɛ an be Ebɔrɛ na. english_verse: Send me a worker who can not only carve, but who can work with gold, silver, bronze, and iron, as well as make brightly colored cloth. The person you send will work here in Judah and Jerusalem with the skilled workers that my father has already hired.

english_verse: he assigned an army commander to each of them and stocked them with supplies of food, olive oil, and wine,
translation_verse: E daŋ shin nna nɛ baa kuŋ amo nɛnɛ nseŋ lara benapo be benimu nɛ baa keni nde na be kekama so nseŋ ta ajibi nɛ ɔlif be ŋku nɛ asɔnuuso,

english_verse: The priests and Levites from the northern tribes of Israel gave their support to King Rehoboam.
translation_verse: Bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ Livaiebi nɛ b shi Israɛl be kelargato be esoso be kaba so be eyiri to na kikɛ daa bɛ ewura Rehoboam so nna.

english_verse: And since Jeroboam and the kings of Israel that followed him would not allow any Levites to serve as priests, most Levites left their towns and pasturelands in Israel and moved to Jerusalem and other towns in Judah.
translation_verse: Livaiebi na yige bumo be asɔbɔya be ejikpa nɛ nsawule ko nna n lɛ nseŋ koso n yɔ Juda nɛ Jerusalɛm ŋkpal ewura Jeroboam nɛ e bee ji Israɛl be kuwura na nɛ bewura nɛ b bɛ mo so na kikɛ ka maŋ shuli fanɛ b baa shuŋ fanɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be bɔrɛmatapoana so.

english_verse: Jeroboam chose his own priests to serve at the local shrines in Israel and at the places of worship where he had set up statues of goat-demons and of calves.
translation_verse: Ewura Jeroboam daŋ lara mo gbagba be bɔrɛmatapoana nna fanɛ b baa shuŋ kakpa nɛ nnyamase na bee lɔŋɛ bumo be agbir na nsaa sha fanɛ b baa shuŋ ayoyu lubi nɛ egbolufɔlbi nɛ e lɔŋɛ fanɛ agbir na.

english_verse: But some of the people from Israel wanted to worship the Lord God, just as their ancestors had done. So they followed the priests and Levites to Jerusalem, where they could offer sacrifices to the Lord.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Israɛl be eyiriana na to be basa nɛ b daa sha kebaashuŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kashenteŋto na bɛ bɔrɛmatapoana na nɛ Livaiebi na so n yɔ Jerusalɛm, saŋɛ na so baaŋ tiŋ a lara esarga a sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ e la bumo nananyɛnana be Ebɔrɛ na.

english_verse: For the next three years, they lived in Judah and were loyal to Rehoboam and his kingdom, just as they had been loyal to David and Solomon. Rehoboam's Family
translation_verse: Ŋkpal loŋ so Juda be kuwurji na daŋ ji eleŋ ga nɛ b chɛ Sɔlɔmɔn Pibinyɛn Rehoboam to nfɛ asa, nɛ bumo nɛ mo chena fanɛ kananɛ bumo nɛ ewura Deevid nɛ ewura Sɔlɔmɔn daa wɔtɔ na.

english_verse: Rehoboam and Mahalath had three sons: Jeush, Shemariah, and Zaham.
translation_verse: Ewura Rehoboam nɛ Mahalaf daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi asa nna: Bumo e la, Jewush nɛ Shemariya nɛ Zaham.

english_verse: Then Rehoboam married Maacah the daughter of Absalom. Their sons were Abijah, Attai, Ziza, and Shelomith.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ Rehoboam ta Absalɔm pibiche Maaka. Mo nɛ Maaka daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi ana nna, bumo e daa la: Abija nɛ Attai nɛ Ziza nɛ Shelomif.

english_verse: Rehoboam was wise enough to put one of his sons in charge of each fortified city in his kingdom. He gave them all the supplies they needed and found wives for every one of them.
translation_verse: Ewura Rehoboam daŋ wora kanyiasheŋ nna n shin nɛ mbe mbinyɛnso na be ekama bee keni Juda nɛ Bɛnjamin be eyiriana be nde nɛ b pɔr egbal ŋ kulti na so. E daŋ sa bumo asɔ kama nɛ baaŋ ta a keni ndeana na so nna nseŋ ta beche damta n sa bumo n ti so.

english_verse: but he still did wrong and refused to obey the Lord.
translation_verse: E daŋ wora alubi nna ŋkpal e ka daa maa wora Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be aparsheŋ so.

english_verse: So in the fifth year of Rehoboam's rule, the Lord punished them for their unfaithfulness and allowed King Shishak of Egypt to invade Judah.
translation_verse: Rehoboam ka ji kuwura be kafɛ nusopo to, nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ gberge bumo kusoe n shin nɛ Ijipt be ewura Shishak ba kɔ n sɔ Jerusalɛm ŋkpal b ka maa wora Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kasonu so.

english_verse: He captured every one of the fortified cities in Judah and then marched to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: E daŋ kɔ n sɔ Juda be nde nɛ b pɔr egbal ŋ kulti na kikɛ nna hale n ya fo Jerusalɛm.

english_verse: Rehoboam and the leaders of Judah had gone to Jerusalem to escape Shishak's invasion. And while they were there, Shemaiah the prophet told them, “The Lord says that because you have disobeyed him, he has now abandoned you. The Lord will not help you against Shishak!”
translation_verse: Anebi Shemaya daŋ yɔ ewura Rehoboam nɛ Juda be bejuŋkparpoana nɛ b shile n ya ŋana Shishak so ashi Jerusalɛm na kutɔ nna n ya kaŋɛ bumo le: “Enyɛnpe be kubɔya nɛ e kɔ a sa menyi nde. E yɛ: ‘Ŋkpal men ka kini ma so, ma alɛ gba yige menyi m bɔɔ Shishak enɔ.’ ”

english_verse: Rehoboam and the leaders were sorry for what they had done and admitted, “The Lord is right. We have deserted him.”
translation_verse: Nɛ ewura na nɛ mbe bejuŋkparpoana shuli fanɛ b wora kulubi nseŋ kaŋɛ le: “Kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ wora na kɔ akpa.”

english_verse: When the Lord heard this, he told Shemaiah: The people of Judah are truly sorry for their sins, and so I won't let Shishak completely destroy them. But because I am still angry,
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ka nu loŋ, nɛ e kaŋɛ Shemaya le: “Ŋkpal b ka shuli fanɛ b wora kulubi so, m maaŋ mur bumo. Hale Shishak bee kɔ bumo gba, baaŋ pete. Ma agbo maaŋ naŋ ba Jerusalɛm so ga,

english_verse: he will conquer and rule them. Then my people will know what it's like to serve a foreign king instead of serving me.
translation_verse: ama Shishak beeŋ pɔɔ bumo so, loŋ nɛ baaŋ pin kebaashuŋ ma nɛ kebaashuŋ durnya ere to be bewura ere be mbarga.”

english_verse: Rehoboam had bronze shields made to replace the gold ones, and he ordered the guards at the city gates to keep them safe.
translation_verse: Ewura Rehoboam daŋ lɔŋɛ danyaŋ be asɔkuŋso nna n tal amo na to nseŋ ta amo n wɔtɔ bekumpo nɛ baa keni ewurkpa be mbunagboŋ so na be benimu be enɔ to.

english_verse: Whenever Rehoboam went to the Lord's temple, the guards carried the shields. But they always took them back to the guardroom as soon as he had finished worshiping.
translation_verse: Saŋkama nɛ ewura na baaŋ yɔ bɔrɛlambu na to, bekumpo na bee ta asɔkuŋso na nna a keta, ewura na baaŋ bɛta n yɔ epe nɛ b naŋ bɛta amo n ya wɔtɔ ebu nɛ baa kuŋ na to.

english_verse: Rehoboam turned back to the Lord, and so the Lord did not let Judah be completely destroyed, and Judah was prosperous again. Rehoboam's Rule in Judah (
translation_verse: Ŋkpal ewura Rehoboam ka naŋ bɛta m ba Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kutɔ so, Enyɛnpe na be agbo daa maŋ mur mo cheche, nɛ asheŋ naŋ nyalɛ ashi Juda be efuli so.

english_verse: Everything else Rehoboam did while he was king, including a history of his family, is written in the records of the two prophets, Shemaiah and Iddo. During Rehoboam's rule, he and King Jeroboam of Israel were constantly at war.
translation_verse: B sibɛ ewura Rehoboam be kusɔ nɛ e wora saŋɛ so nɛ e daa la ewura na nɛ mbe kanaŋ to be asheŋ kikɛ nna n wɔtɔ anebi Shemaya nɛ anebi Iddo be adrasheŋ be nwɔl to. Saŋɛ so nɛ Rehoboam daa la Juda be ewura na, mo nɛ Israɛl be ewura Jeroboam daa kɔ abar kena nna saŋkikɛ.

english_verse: Abijah became king of Judah in Jeroboam's eighteenth year as king of Israel,
translation_verse: Ewura Jeroboam ka ji kuwura ashi Israɛl be efuli so be kafɛ kuduaburwasopo be jemanɛ so nɛ Abija malɛ ki Juda be efuli so be ewura

english_verse: and the troops let out a battle cry. Then with Abijah leading them into battle, God defeated Jeroboam and Israel's army.
translation_verse: nɛ Judaebi na cha kena to be awɔr ga. Kede be kaman nɛ ewura Abija juŋkpar bumo n ya kɔ kena na nɛ Ebɔrɛ chɛ bumo to nɛ b pɔɔ Jeroboam nɛ Israɛlebi be benapo na so m mɔ bumo.

english_verse: Now you and your powerful army think you can stand up to the kingdom that the Lord has given to David's descendants. The only gods you have are those gold statues of calves that Jeroboam made for you.
translation_verse: Naniere, fee fɛ fanɛ feeŋ tiŋ ŋ kɔ m pɔɔ kuwurji nɛ Enyɛnpe ta n sa ewura Deevid be kaman to ebi ere so nna? Menyi alɛ kɔ benapo damta nɛ agbir nɛ Jeroboam ta shuwa n lɔŋɛ fanɛ egbolu fɔlbi na nna nɛ e baa la menyi be agbirana.

english_verse: and he ruled from Jerusalem for three years. His mother was Micaiah the daughter of Uriel from Gibeah. Some time later, Abijah and King Jeroboam of Israel went to war against each other.
translation_verse: nseŋ ji kuwura Jerusalɛm to nfɛ asa. Mo nio e daa la Yuriya nɛ e shi Gibia na pibiche Mikaya. Ndoŋ nna nɛ kena tɔr ewura Abija nɛ ewura Jeroboam so.

english_verse: The Lord God of Israel has made a solemn promise that every king of Israel will be from David's family.
translation_verse: Men maŋ nyi fanɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ e la Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na nase kɔnɔ kpakpaso n sa ewura Deevid fanɛ mo ere Ebɔrɛ na ta Israɛl be kuwurji nna n sa mbe kaman to ebi mbaanaayɔ a?

english_verse: But Jeroboam, you were King Solomon's official, and you rebelled.
translation_verse: Nebat pibinyɛn Jeroboam daŋ kini kenu n sa mbe ewura Sɔlɔmɔn nna.”

english_verse: Then right after Rehoboam became king, you and your bunch of worthless followers challenged Rehoboam, who was too young to know how to stop you.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ e chala befɛpo nɛ basa fuloŋ be katuŋ ko nɛ b tintiŋ Rehoboam nɛ e baa wora kusɔ nɛ baa sha ŋkpal e ka kra la kebia nsaa maaŋ tiŋ n yili asheŋ kananɛ a daga loŋ be saŋɛ na so.

english_verse: You don't even have descendants of Aaron on your side, because you forced out the Lord's priests and Levites. In their place, you appoint ordinary people to be priests, just as the foreign nations do. In fact, anyone who brings a bull and seven rams to the altar can become a priest of your so-called gods.
translation_verse: Fo ju Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ b la Ɛɛrɔn be kaman to ebi na nseŋ ju Livaiebi na gba. Fo lara basa pɔtɛ ko nna nɛ b sɔ bumo be kabɔrɛmata be kushuŋ be eyilikpa fanɛ kananɛ efuli pɔtɛ ko be basa bee wora na. Ekama malɛ nɛ e baŋ ta gbolu ŋko mbolpɔ ashunu m ba, fo shin nɛ e bee ki menyi be agbirana nɛ a maŋ la shɛŋ na be kegbirwura nna.

english_verse: But we have not turned our backs on the Lord God! Aaron's own descendants serve as our priests, and the Levites are their assistants.
translation_verse: “Ama anyi ere kraa shuŋ Enyɛnpe nɛ e la anyi be Ebɔrɛ na nna. Anyi alɛ maaŋ kini mo kikɛ. Ɛɛrɔn be kaman to ebi e kraa shuŋ kabɔrɛmata be kushuŋ na nɛ Livaiebi na malɛ bee chɛ bumo to.

english_verse: Two times every day they offer sacrifices and burn incense to the Lord. They set out the sacred loaves of bread on a table that has been purified, and they light the lamps in the gold lampstand every day at sunset. We follow the commands of the Lord our God—you have rejected him!
translation_verse: Kachipurso nɛ kaaseso kikɛ, baa chɔɔ duwu nɛ asɔbɔya be kechɔɔ m mur be esarga nna a sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ. Baa ta bodobodo be sarga na nna a deŋi teebɔl nɛ k du cheembi na so daŋkare be ekpa so nsaa chɔɔ efitila nɛ a yil shuwa be kefitilatɔl na malɛ so kaaseso kikɛ. Anyi ere bee bɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be mbra na so nna, ama menyi ere kini mo.

english_verse: That's why God is on our side and will lead us into battle when the priests sound the signal on the trumpets. It's no use, Israelites. You might as well give up. There's no way you can defeat the Lord, the God your ancestors worshiped.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ gbagba e la anyi be ejuŋkparpo nɛ mbe bɔrɛmatapoana malɛ wora shiriya nɛ b foŋ bumo be mbel n tre anyi nɛ anyi nɛ menyi e kɔ kena. Israɛlebi, men sa maŋ kaŋ kɔ an nananyɛnana be Ebɔrɛ na kena ŋkpal manɛ so menyi maaŋ pɔɔ so kikɛ!”

english_verse: But while Abijah was talking, Jeroboam had sent some of his troops to attack Judah's army from behind, while the rest attacked from the front.
translation_verse: Jemanɛ ere so nɛ ewura Jeroboam shin nɛ mbe benapo ko ya pugi Judaebi na be benapo na be kaman to nɛ bumo nɛ b ka na malɛ wɔ bumo be anishito a jo nɛ b kɔ bumo kena.

english_verse: Abijah kept up his attack on Jeroboam's army and captured the Israelite towns of Bethel, Jeshanah, and Ephron, as well as the villages around them.
translation_verse: Ewura Abija daŋ ju m buu Jeroboam be benapo na so nna hale n ya sɔ bumo be nde ko ana. Nde na e la Bɛtɛl nɛ Jeshana nɛ Efrɔn nɛ ndewurbi nɛ a kulti amo na kikɛ.

english_verse: Jeroboam never regained his power during the rest of Abijah's rule. The Lord punished Jeroboam, and he died, but Abijah became more powerful.
translation_verse: Jemanɛ nɛ Abija daa ji Juda be efuli so be kuwura na, Jeroboam daa maŋ naŋ nya eleŋ kikɛ. Amo kikɛ be lalaloge, nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ e wu.

english_verse: Everything Abijah said and did while he was king is written in the records of Iddo the prophet.
translation_verse: B daŋ sibɛ Abija be mmalga nɛ mbe aworbi kikɛ nna n wɔtɔ anebi Iddo be adrasheŋ be nwɔl to.

english_verse: Asa obeyed the Lord his God and did right.
translation_verse: Ewura Asa daŋ wora kusɔ nɛ k niŋi nsaa walɛ Enyɛnpe mbe Ebɔrɛ na be anishito nna.

english_verse: He destroyed the local shrines and the altars to foreign gods. He smashed the stone images of gods and cut down the sacred poles used in worshiping the goddess Asherah.
translation_verse: E daŋ bure efuli pɔtɛana so be ebɔrɛsureana nɛ mboŋ nɛ baa shuŋ bumo be agbirana kikɛ nna nseŋ bure agbirjembu nɛ eshabɔrɛ be mboŋ nɛ basa bee shuŋ kegbirche Ashira na ashi mbe efuli so.

english_verse: Then he told everyone in Judah to worship the Lord God, just as their ancestors had done, and to obey his laws and teachings.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ e kaŋɛ Juda be basa kenishipereso fanɛ b baa bɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ e la bumo nananyɛnana be Ebɔrɛ na be keŋini nɛ mbe mbra so.

english_verse: He said to the people, “Let's build walls and defense towers for these towns, and put in gates that can be locked with bars. This land still belongs to us, because we have obeyed the Lord our God. He has given us peace from all our enemies.” The people did everything Asa had suggested.
translation_verse: Le nɛ e daŋ kaŋɛ Juda be basa: “Men shin nɛ an pɔr atempreŋ jeŋgreŋ nseŋ pɔr egbalana ŋ kulti anyi be ndeana, nseŋ wɔtɔ amo ekuloŋgboŋ nɛ anyeeŋ baa ti nsaa ta ndibi gboŋgboŋi a laga amo to. An kɔ kasawule na so be eleŋ. Ŋkpal an ka bee wora Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be aparsheŋ so, E kuŋ anyi be ŋkpa ekpa kikɛ so.” Amoso b daŋ pere kenishi nna m pɔr ga nseŋ nya nɛfa malɛ ga.

english_verse: Asa prayed: Lord God, only you can help a powerless army defeat a stronger one. So we depend on you to help us. We will fight against this powerful army to honor your name, and we know that you won't be defeated. You are the Lord our God.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ ewura Asa kule Enyɛnpe mbe Ebɔrɛ na ŋ kaŋɛ le: “O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, fo nawule e naa tiŋ a chɛ benapo pɔshipo to nɛ baa tiŋ a kɔ a pɔɔ benapo lempo so. Amoso, an Nyɛnpe nɛ anyi be Ebɔrɛ, ba chɛ anyi to naniere, ŋkpal manɛ so, fo nɛ anyee fute a yige so. Fo ketre be eleŋ na malɛ to nɛ an ba nɛ an ba kɔ benapo damta ere na. Enyɛnpe, fo e la anyi be Ebɔrɛ. Esa kama malɛ maŋ wɔtɔ nɛ e beeŋ tiŋ m pɔɔ fo so.”

english_verse: The Lord helped Asa and his army defeat the Ethiopians. The enemy soldiers ran away,
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ daŋ chɛ Asa nɛ mbe benapo to nna nɛ b kɔ m pɔɔ Itiopiaebi na so nɛ bumo be benapo kikɛ shile,

english_verse: but Asa and his troops chased them as far as Gerar. It was a total defeat—the Ethiopians could not even fight back! The soldiers from Judah took everything that had belonged to the Ethiopians.
translation_verse: nɛ Asa nɛ mbe benapo ju m buu bumo so hale n ya fo Gɛra. B daŋ pɔɔ bumo so cheche nna hale Itiopiaebi na daa maŋ naŋ tiŋ nɛ b kɔ gba. B daŋ mɔ bumo be bedamta nna. Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e daŋ kɔ m pɔɔ bumo so n sa benapo na nɛ b muu Itiopiaebi na be asɔ kikɛ.

english_verse: The people who lived in the villages around Gerar learned what had happened and were afraid of the Lord. So Judah's army easily defeated them and carried off everything of value that they wanted from these towns.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ Asa be benapo na kɔ ndewurbi nɛ a kulti Gɛra na kena m pɔɔ amo kikɛ so ŋkpal Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be kusɔ nɛ e wora na ka shin nɛ kufu pɛ bumo ga so. Ndoŋ nna nɛ Juda be benapo na muu bumo be asɔ lela kikɛ n yɔ.

english_verse: They also attacked the camps where the shepherds lived and took a lot of sheep, goats, and camels. Then they went back to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: B daŋ yɔ mbolpɔkpapoana be echenakpaana nɛ a mata nde na gba to nna n ya kɔ bumo kena nseŋ pɛ bumo be mbolpɔ nɛ mboe nɛ enyɔma damta. Ade kikɛ be kaman nɛ b bɛta n yɔ Jerusalɛm.

english_verse: Some time later, God spoke to Azariah son of Oded.
translation_verse: Asheŋ ere ka wora n choŋ na, nɛ Ebɔrɛ be kiyoyu gbelge Odɛd pibinyɛn Azariya so,

english_verse: At once, Azariah went to Asa and said: Listen to me, King Asa and you people of Judah and Benjamin. The Lord will be with you and help you, as long as you obey and worship him. But if you disobey him, he will desert you.
translation_verse: nɛ e yɔ ewura Asa kutɔ n ya kaŋɛ mo le: “Ewura Asa nɛ Juda nɛ Bɛnjamin be basa, men kikɛ e nu nfe! Men baa nu a sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na, mo alɛ beeŋ baa wɔ menyi kutɔ saŋkikɛ. Men baa fin mo, menyeeŋ wu mo, ama nɛ men baŋ pal kaman n sa mo bre, mo alɛ beeŋ yige menyi to.

english_verse: For a long time, the people of Israel did not worship the true God or listen to priests who could teach them about God. They refused to obey God's Law.
translation_verse: Israɛlebi na daŋ yige keshuŋ kashenteŋ be Ebɔrɛ na n chɛr ga. B daa maŋ naa kɔ bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ baa ŋini bumo Ebɔrɛ be akpa. Amoso b daa maŋ naa bɛ Ebɔrɛ be mbra so.

english_verse: But whenever trouble came, Israel turned back to the Lord their God and worshiped him.
translation_verse: Ama saŋkama nɛ b luri tɔrɔ to baa fin Enyɛnpe Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na nna nsaa wu mo.

english_verse: There was so much confusion in those days that it wasn't safe to go anywhere in Israel.
translation_verse: Loŋ be jemanɛ na so, esa kikɛ daa maaŋ tiŋ n nite yɛlyɛla so ŋkpal manɛ so kena daŋ baa wɔ kaplɛkama nna.

english_verse: Nations were destroying each other, and cities were wiping out other cities, because God was causing trouble and unrest everywhere.
translation_verse: Efuliana kikɛ daŋ baa mɛaŋ abar nna nɛ ndegboŋana na gba bee mɛaŋ abar ŋkpal Ebɔrɛ ka daa bar awurfoŋ nɛ etɔrɔ bumo so na so.

english_verse: As soon as Asa heard what Azariah the prophet said, he gave orders for all the idols in Judah and Benjamin to be destroyed, including those in the towns he had captured in the territory of Ephraim. He also repaired the Lord's altar that was in front of the temple porch.
translation_verse: Ewura Asa ka nu kewuŋkaŋɛ nɛ Odɛd pibinyɛn Azariya kaŋɛ na, nɛ e nya keleŋto. E daŋ mur agbir nɛ a wɔ Juda nɛ Bɛnjamin be kasawule so nna nɛ amo nɛ a wɔ nde nɛ e kɔ n sɔ Efrayim be abee be efuli so na kikɛ. E daŋ lɔŋɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be bɔrɛsure nɛ k daa yil bɔrɛlambu na be kelɔnɛ so ashi Jerusalɛm na gba nna m pɔr.

english_verse: Asa called together the people from Judah and Benjamin, as well as the people from the territories of Ephraim, West Manasseh, and Simeon who were living in Judah. Many of these people were now loyal to Asa, because they had seen that the Lord was with him.
translation_verse: Basa damta nɛ b shi Efrayim nɛ Manase nɛ Simiɔn be kasawule so daŋ ba ka wɔ ewura Asa be kasawule so nna ŋkpal b ka wu Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ka wɔ mo kutɔ so. Ewura Asa daŋ tre bumo nɛ Juda nɛ Bɛnjamin be basa kikɛ nna m ba abar so.

english_verse: In the third month of the fifteenth year of Asa's rule, they all met in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Asa be kuwurji be kafɛ kuduanusopo be kufɔl sasopo to nɛ bumo kikɛ ba shɛr Jerusalɛm to.

english_verse: They made a solemn promise to faithfully worship the Lord God their ancestors had worshiped,
translation_verse: B daŋ nase nnɔ nna n sa abar a laŋɛ kananɛ baaŋ ta bumo be ŋgbene nɛ ayoyu kikɛ a bunyaŋ bumo nananyɛnana be Ebɔrɛ na.

english_verse: The crowd solemnly agreed to keep their promise to the Lord, then they celebrated by shouting and blowing trumpets and horns.

english_verse: He placed in the temple all the silver and gold objects that he and his father had dedicated to God.

english_verse: There was peace in Judah until the thirty-fifth year of Asa's rule.

english_verse: When Asa heard about this, he took the silver and gold from his palace and from the Lord's temple. Then he sent it to Damascus with this message for King Benhadad of Syria:
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ ewura Asa shin nɛ b lara gbiti nɛ shuwa ashi bɔrɛlambu na to nɛ ewurkpa n ya sa ewura Bɛnhadad nɛ e la Siriya be ewura na ashi Damaskɔs na, nseŋ kaŋɛ mo le:

english_verse: “I think we should sign a peace treaty, just as our fathers did. This silver and gold is a present for you. Would you please break your treaty with King Baasha of Israel and force him to leave my country?”
translation_verse: “Shin nɛ anyi nɛ fo e wora kɔnɔkoŋwule fanɛ kananɛ an tutoana daŋ wora na. Gbiti nɛ shuwa na bre la fo kakɛ nna. A daga fanɛ fo ku fo nɛ Israɛl be ewura Baasha be kɔnɔkoŋwule nɛ men kɔ na to, nɛ kumo be loŋ e shin nɛ e lara mbe benapo ashi ma kasawule so.”

english_verse: Benhadad did what Asa asked and sent the Syrian army into Israel. They captured the towns of Ijon, Dan, Abel-Maim, and all the towns in Naphtali where supplies were kept.
translation_verse: Nɛ ewura Bɛnhadad shuli kusɔ nɛ Asa kaŋɛ na nseŋ shuŋi mbe benapo nɛ bumo be benimu fanɛ b ya kɔ Israɛl be ndegboŋana na. B daŋ ya kɔ m pɔɔ Ijɔn nɛ Dan nɛ Abel Mayim nɛ Naftali be ndegboŋana nɛ b daa ta bumo be asɔ a yili to na kikɛ so nna.

english_verse: Asa ordered everyone in Judah to carry away the stones and wood Baasha had used to fortify Ramah. Then he fortified the towns of Geba and Mizpah with these same stones and wood. Hanani the Prophet Condemns Asa
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ ewura Asa tre Juda be efuli so be benyɛn n shɛr abar so ŋ kaŋɛ bumo fanɛ b muu ajembu nɛ ndibi nɛ Baasha kɔ a shuŋ ashi Raama na. Ndoŋ nna nɛ b muu amo m ya pɔr egbal ŋ kulti Gɛba nɛ Mizpa be nde. Anebi Hanani be asheŋ

english_verse: Soon after that happened, Hanani the prophet went to Asa and said: You depended on the king of Syria instead of depending on the Lord your God. And so, you will never defeat the Syrian army.
translation_verse: Loŋ be saŋɛ na nɛ anebi Hanani yɔ ewura Asa kutɔ n ya kaŋɛ mo le: “Ŋkpal fo ka ta fo yirda n deŋi Siriya be ewura so nseŋ kini keta fo yirda n deŋi Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ so so, fo maaŋ naŋ tiŋ m pɔ Siriya be benapo so kikɛ.

english_verse: Remember how powerful the Ethiopian and Libyan army was, with all their chariots and cavalry troops! You trusted the Lord to help you then, and you defeated them.
translation_verse: Etopiya be efuli so ebi nɛ Libiya be efuli so ebi kɔ benapo damta nɛ egbaŋɛturko nɛ egbaŋɛdiipo damta. Ama ŋkpal fo ka ta fo yirda n deŋi Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ so so nɛ e shin nɛ fo kɔ m pɔɔ bumo so na.

english_verse: The Lord is constantly watching everyone, and he gives strength to those who faithfully obey him. But you have done a foolish thing, and your kingdom will never be at peace again.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nyi kusɔ nɛ durnya to ebi kikɛ bee wora, nsaa sa bekama nɛ b kɔ kasonu a sa mo na eleŋ. Ama ŋkpal fo ka wora kawulisheŋ so, yili kabre a yɔ, feeŋ baa kɔ kena nna saŋkama.”

english_verse: Jehoshaphat son of Asa became king and strengthened his defenses against Israel.

english_verse: He assigned troops to the fortified cities in Judah, as well as to other towns in Judah and to those towns in Ephraim that his father Asa had captured.

english_verse: When Jehoshaphat's father had first become king of Judah, he was faithful to the Lord and refused to worship the god Baal as the kings of Israel did. Jehoshaphat followed his father's example and obeyed and worshiped the Lord. And so the Lord blessed Jehoshaphat
translation_verse: E daŋ shuŋ mo tuto be Ebɔrɛ nseŋ bɛ Ebɔrɛ be mbra so, a maŋ wora kananɛ Israɛl be bewuraana daŋ wora na.

english_verse: and helped him keep firm control of his kingdom. The people of Judah brought gifts to Jehoshaphat, but even after he became very rich and respected,
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ daŋ sa ewura Jehoshafat eleŋ nna nɛ Juda be efuli so be kusɔ kikɛ daa wɔ mbe kuwura be kaseto. Basa na kikɛ daŋ bar mo ŋkɛ nna nɛ e ki damawura nseŋ nya bunyaŋ n ya baŋ so.

english_verse: he remained completely faithful to the Lord. He destroyed all the local shrines in Judah, including the places where the goddess Asherah was worshiped.
translation_verse: E daŋ shuŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kashenteŋto ga nseŋ jija nnyamase na be ademaŋana nɛ kakpa nɛ baa shuŋ kegbirche nɛ baa tre Ashira ashi Juda be efuli so na kikɛ.

english_verse: Their assistants were the following nine Levites: Shemaiah, Nethaniah, Zebadiah, Asahel, Shemiramoth, Jehonathan, Adonijah, Tobijah, and Tob-Adonijah. Two priests, Elishama and Jehoram, also went along.
translation_verse: Livai be basa akpanu nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana anyɔ e daŋ shuŋi bumo n yɔ. Livai be basa na e daa la Shemaya nɛ Netanaya nɛ Zebadiya nɛ Asahɛl nɛ Shamiramɔf nɛ Jehonatan nɛ Adonija nɛ Tobija nɛ Tobadonija. Bɔrɛmatapoana na malɛ e daa la Elishaama nɛ Jehoram.

english_verse: They carried with them a copy of the Lord's Law wherever they went and taught the people from it.
translation_verse: B daŋ ta Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be mbra be kawɔl na nna n yɔ Juda be ndeana kikɛ to n ya ka ŋini basa na. Jehoshafat ka la esagboŋ be asheŋ

english_verse: The nations around Judah were afraid of the Lord's power, so none of them attacked Jehoshaphat.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe daŋ shin nɛ kufu pɛ efuli nɛ a kulti Juda na nna nɛ b maŋ tiŋ ŋ kɔ Ewura Jehoshafat kena.

english_verse: where he stored supplies. He also kept in Jerusalem some experienced soldiers
translation_verse: bumo be asɔ amo to, nseŋ shin nɛ benapo be benimu ko nɛ b nyi kena be kekɔ nɛnɛ chena Jerusalɛm.

english_verse: from the Judah and Benjamin tribes. These soldiers were grouped according to their clans. Adnah was the commander of the troops from Judah, and he had
translation_verse: Adna e daa la Juda be kabuna be benapo be enimu, nseŋ daa kɔ benapo ŋgboŋ alfa asa a keni so.

english_verse: Amasiah son of Zichri, who had volunteered to serve the Lord, was third in command, with
translation_verse: Enimu sasopo e daa la Zikri pibinyɛn Amaziya nɛ mo alɛ daa keni benapo ŋgboŋ alfa anyɔ so. Amaziya daŋ lara mbe kumu nna n yili fanɛ e beeŋ shuŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ.

english_verse: These were the troops who protected the king in Jerusalem, not counting those he had assigned to the fortified cities throughout the country.
translation_verse: Le be basa ere kikɛ daa shuŋ ewura na ashi Jerusalɛm nna, ama e daŋ naŋ ta benapo ko gba n chena nde nɛ b pɔr egbal ŋ kulti ashi Juda be efuli so na kikɛ nna.

english_verse: One day, Jehoshaphat went to visit Ahab in his capital city of Samaria. Ahab slaughtered sheep and cattle and prepared a big feast to honor Jehoshaphat and the officials with him. Ahab talked about attacking the city of Ramoth in Gilead,
translation_verse: B ka wɔtɔ n ya fo saŋko, nɛ ewura Jehoshafat yɔ Samɛria be kade to nɛ e ya bɔɔ Ahab so. Ewura Ahab daŋ mɔ mbolpɔ nɛ ana damta nna n wora kejigboŋ ŋ keta ewura Jehoshafat nɛ mbe basa kefɔ. E daa lɔlɔ Jehoshafat nna nɛ e tu mo n ya kɔ Ramɔfebi nɛ b wɔ Giliad be kasawule so na kena.

english_verse: and finally asked, “Jehoshaphat, would you go with me to attack Ramoth?” “Yes,” Jehoshaphat answered. “My army is at your command.
translation_verse: Le nɛ e daŋ bishi mo: “Feeŋ tu ma n ya kɔ Ramɔfebi kena a?” Nɛ ewura Jehoshafat kaŋɛ: “Saŋkama nɛ fo wora shiriya, ma alɛ gba wora shiriya, nɛ ma benapo gba wora shiriya. Anyeeŋ tu fo n yɔ.

translation_verse: Ama pɔɛŋ nɛ an wora loŋ, a daga an ka pin Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be nfɛra.”

english_verse: But Jehoshaphat said, “Just to make sure, is there another of the Lord's prophets we can ask?”
translation_verse: Nɛ Jehoshafat naaŋ bishi: “Ama anebi kama maŋ naa wɔtɔ nɛ an ya sɔ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be nfɛra mo kutɔ n ti so a?”

english_verse: “We could ask Micaiah son of Imlah,” Ahab said. “But I hate Micaiah. He always has bad news for me.” “Don't say that!” Jehoshaphat replied.
translation_verse: Nɛ ewura Ahab kaŋɛ le: “Ekoŋwule ko kraa wɔtɔ nɛ anyeeŋ tiŋ n wu mo, mo e la Imla pibinyɛn Mikaya ama ŋ kishi mbe asheŋ ga ŋkpal manɛ so kusɔ kama nɛ e wu ŋ kaŋɛ ma maa walɛ.” Nɛ ewura Jehoshafat kaŋɛ: “Sa maŋ kaŋ kaŋɛ loŋ!”

english_verse: All this time, Ahab and Jehoshaphat were dressed in their royal robes and were seated on their thrones at the threshing place near the gate of Samaria, listening to the prophets tell them what the Lord had said.
translation_verse: Bewura anyɔ na daŋ buu bumo be ewurpiŋi nna a tase bumo nwurputi so ashi kugooro nɛ baa bri asɔ nɛ k wɔ Samɛria be kabunagboŋ na be ekarso na so, nɛ anebiana na kikɛ yil bumo be anishito a kaŋɛ kusɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ.

english_verse: Zedekiah son of Chenaanah was one of the prophets. He had made some horns out of iron and shouted, “Ahab, the Lord says you will attack the Syrians like a bull with iron horns and wipe them out!”
translation_verse: Chinana pibinyɛn Zɛdikaya nɛ e la anebiana na be eko bre, daŋ bɛl abɛlso be alambɛ nna nseŋ kaŋɛ Ahab le: “Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ yɛ, le be kusɔ ere nɛ feeŋ ta ŋ kɔ Siriyaebi na kena m pɔɔ bumo so cheche.”

english_verse: All the prophets agreed that Ahab should attack the Syrians at Ramoth and promised that the Lord would help him defeat them.
translation_verse: Anebiana na kikɛ daŋ kaŋɛ le nna: “Men ya kɔ Ramɔf ebi; Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ shin nɛ men kɔ m pɔɔ so.”

english_verse: Meanwhile, the messenger who went to get Micaiah whispered, “Micaiah, all the prophets have good news for Ahab. Now go and say the same thing.”
translation_verse: Esa nɛ e daŋ yɔ Mikaya kutɔ na daŋ ya kaŋɛ mo nna le: “Anebiana na kikɛ daŋ wu ŋ kaŋɛ nna fanɛ ewura na beeŋ kɔ m pɔɔ so, amoso fo alɛ gba e ya kaŋɛ loŋ.”

english_verse: “I'll say whatever the living Lord my God tells me to say,” Micaiah replied.
translation_verse: Ama le nɛ Mikaya daŋ kaŋɛ: “Kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ e wɔ ŋkpa to na kaŋɛ ma nɛ meeŋ kaŋɛ!”

english_verse: Micaiah answered, “In a vision I saw Israelite soldiers wandering around, lost in the hills like sheep without a shepherd. The Lord said, ‘These troops have no leader. They should go home and not fight.’ ”
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Mikaya naŋ kaŋɛ le: “N wu Israɛl be benapo na ka pesaŋ to n sɔ abee so fanɛ mbolpɔ nɛ b maŋ kɔ ekpapo na.” Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ le: “Basa ere maŋ kɔ ejuŋkparpo, shin nɛ b ta kagbenewushi a yɔ epe.”

english_verse: Micaiah replied: I then saw the Lord seated on his throne with every creature in heaven gathered around him.
translation_verse: Nɛ Mikaya kraa malga nseŋ kaŋɛ le: “Nu! N wu Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ka chena mbe kuwurputi so nɛ mbe emalaika kikɛ kulti mo ashi ebɔrɛso,

english_verse: The Lord asked, “Who can trick Ahab and make him go to Ramoth where he will be killed?” They talked about it for a while,
translation_verse: nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ le: ‘Wanɛ e naaŋ tiŋ n shin nɛ Ahab e yɔ Ramɔf nɛ b ya mɔ mo ndoŋ?’ Nɛ emalaika na be beko malga asheŋ ko nɛ beko malɛ malga asheŋ pɔtɛ.

english_verse: “I'll make Ahab's prophets lie to him.” “Good!” the Lord replied. “Now go and do it. You will be successful.”
translation_verse: Nɛ kiyoyu na kaŋɛ: ‘Meeŋ ya shin nɛ Ahab be anebiana kikɛ e fule mo.’ Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ: ‘Ya wora loŋ. Feeŋ pɔɔ so.’

english_verse: Zedekiah walked over and slapped Micaiah on the face. Then he asked, “Do you really think the Lord would speak to you and not to me?”
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Anebi Zɛdikaya yɔ Mikaya kutɔ n ya kpa mo etaŋ anishito m bishi mo le: “Saŋɛ mo nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be kiyoyu yige ma n ya malga fo kutɔ?”

translation_verse: Nɛ Mikaya kaŋɛ mo le: “Kachɛ nɛ feeŋ shile ŋkpal fo doŋana so n ya ŋana ebu nɛ k wɔ ketamanto na, nɛ feeŋ pin kumo be kashenteŋ.”

english_verse: But the prophet Jehu son of Hanani met him and said: By helping that wicked Ahab, you have made friends with someone who hates the Lord. Now the Lord God is angry with you!
translation_verse: Nɛ anebi Jehu nɛ e la Hanani pibinyɛn na yɔ mo kutɔ n ya kaŋɛ mo le: “Fee fɛ fanɛ fo ka chɛ ewura Ahab esa lubi nɛ e kishi Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ to ere walɛ a? Kusɔ nɛ fo wora ere shin nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nya agbo n wɔtɔ fo ga.

english_verse: But not everything about you is bad. You destroyed the sacred poles used in worshiping the goddess Asherah—that shows you have tried to obey the Lord. Jehoshaphat Appoints Judges To Settle Cases
translation_verse: Ama amo nɛ amo kikɛ asheŋ lela ko wɔ fo to. Fo jija kegbirche Ashira be mpɔrduli nɛ basa bee shuŋ na kikɛ, fo alɛ gbagba nsaa wora ania a bɛ Ebɔrɛ be ekpa so.”

english_verse: Jehoshaphat lived in Jerusalem, but he often traveled through his kingdom, from Beersheba in the south to the edge of the hill country of Ephraim in the north. He talked with the people and convinced them to turn back to the Lord God and worship him, just as their ancestors had done.
translation_verse: Kashenteŋ nna fanɛ ewura Jehoshafat daa wɔ Jerusalɛm nna, ama e daa yili Bɛshiba nɛ k wɔ kelargato be kaseto be kaba so na nna a nite a bɔɔ basa na so n ya ka fo Efrayim be kebee be efuli na be kelargato be esoso be kaba so be ekarso saŋkama a leŋ bumo to fanɛ b naŋ bɛta a shuŋ bumo nananyɛnana be Ebɔrɛ na.

english_verse: and told them: Be careful when you make your decisions in court, because you are judging by the Lord's standards and not by human standards, and he will know what you decide.

english_verse: So do your work in honor of him and know that he won't allow you to be unfair to anyone or to take bribes.
