english_verse: Jehoshaphat also chose some Levites, some priests, and some of the family leaders, and he appointed them to serve as judges in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ewura Jehoshafat daŋ lara Livaiebi nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ nnaŋ be bejuŋkparpo malɛ nna ashi Jerusalɛm to fanɛ b baa ji basa nɛ baa kini kebaabɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be mbra be ekpa so na nɛ basa nɛ bumo nɛ bumo braana ndetobia kɔ asheŋ na demu.

english_verse: The people of Judah will bring you legal cases that involve every type of crime, including murder. You must settle these cases and warn the people to stop sinning against the Lord, so that he won't get angry and punish Judah. Remember, if you follow these instructions, you won't be held responsible for anything that happens.
translation_verse: Saŋkama nɛ men braana ndetobia na baŋ ta bumo be asheŋ fanɛ kamɔ ŋko kekini kenu n sa Ebɔrɛ be keŋini nɛ mbe mbra be asheŋ m ba menyi kutɔ, k daga men ka fɛa bumo so nɛ b sa maŋ kaŋ wora kulubi ŋ gbiti Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ saŋɛ na so mbe agbo maaŋ ba menyi nɛ bumo kikɛ so. Men baa wora loŋ bre, Ebɔrɛ maaŋ wu menyi kulubi.

english_verse: Amariah the high priest will have the final say in any religious case. And Zebadiah, the leader of the Judah tribe, will have the final say in all other cases. The rest of the Levites will serve as your assistants. Be brave, and I pray that the Lord will help you do right.
translation_verse: Bɔrɛmatapowura nimuso Amariya e naaŋ baa ji kabɔrɛshuŋ be kaplɛa so be asheŋ to, nɛ Zebadiya nɛ e la Ishmaɛl pibinyɛn nɛ e la Juda be gomena na malɛ e baa ji asheŋ nɛ a ka na to. Livaiebi na malɛ e naŋ baa keni nɛ kananɛ b nase asheŋ na a shuŋ. Men ba leŋ men be amu to nsaa bɛ keŋini ere so nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ e baa wɔ bekama nɛ b kɔ kashenteŋ be kaman!”

english_verse: Messengers told Jehoshaphat, “A large army from Edom east of the Dead Sea has invaded our country. They have already reached En-Gedi.”
translation_verse: Nɛ mbɔ ko ba kaŋɛ ewura Jehoshafat le: “Benapo damta ko nɛ b shi Edɔm be efuli so na lar Teku wuso na be kaba ndoŋ m ba nɛ b ba kɔ fo kena. B tiŋ n ya kɔ m pɔɔ Engedi bre so.”

english_verse: Jehoshaphat was afraid, so he asked the Lord what to do. He then told the people of Judah to go without eating to show their sorrow.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ kufu pɛ Jehoshafat ga nɛ e kule Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ fanɛ e ŋini mo kusɔ nɛ e beeŋ wora. Kumo be kaman nɛ e shin nɛ efuli na be basa kikɛ kishi ŋ kule Ebɔrɛ n sa mo.

english_verse: They immediately left for Jerusalem to ask for the Lord's help.
translation_verse: Amoso Juda be efuli so be basa daŋ ba shɛr Jerusalɛm nna nɛ b fin kechɛto ashi Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kutɔ.

english_verse: After everyone from Judah and Jerusalem had come together at the Lord's temple, Jehoshaphat stood in front of the new courtyard
translation_verse: Bumo kikɛ ka ba shɛr bɔrɛlambu na be kelɔnɛ popɔr na so nɛ ewura Jehoshafat ya yili bumo be anishito

english_verse: and prayed: You, Lord, are the God our ancestors worshiped, and from heaven you rule every nation in the world. You are so powerful that no one can defeat you.
translation_verse: nseŋ kule Ebɔrɛ le: “O Enyɛnpe nɛ fo la an nananyɛnana be Ebɔrɛ. Fo e naa ji ebɔrɛso nɛ durnya ere be efuli kikɛ so kuwura. Fo alɛ kɔ eleŋ ga nɛ esa kikɛ maŋ wɔtɔ nɛ e beeŋ tiŋ m pɔɔ fo so.

english_verse: Our God, you forced out the nations who lived in this land before your people Israel came here, and you gave it to the descendants of your friend Abraham forever.
translation_verse: Fo e la anyi be Ebɔrɛ. Fo basa Israɛlebi na ka koso m ba kasawule ere so na, fo e ju basa nɛ b daa wɔ nfe na nseŋ ta kasawule na n sa fo teri Eebraham be kaman to ebi nɛ k baa la bumo peya mbaanaayɔ.

english_verse: Our ancestors lived in this land and built a temple to honor you.
translation_verse: B chena kasawule ere so nna m ba pɔr bɔrɛlambu ere nɛ k baa la kemaŋkura n sa fo,

english_verse: They believed that whenever this land is struck by war or disease or famine, your people can pray to you at the temple, and you will hear their prayer and save them.
translation_verse: saŋɛ na so nɛ kena ŋko alɔ ŋko akoŋ be jɛrbi kaŋ ba bumo so, baaŋ tiŋ m ba kakpa nɛ baa bunyaŋ fo na ashi bɔrɛlambu ere be anishito m ba kule fo ashi bumo be etɔrɔ be jemanɛ nɛ fo nu nseŋ mɔlga bumo.

english_verse: You can see that the armies of Ammon, Moab, and Edom are attacking us! Those are the nations you would not let our ancestors invade on their way from Egypt, so these nations were not destroyed.
translation_verse: Naniere Ammɔn nɛ Mowab nɛ Edɔm be basa ba nɛ b ba kɔ anyi kena. An nananyɛnana ka lar Ijipt be efuli so a ba na, fo daa maŋ shuli nɛ b kɔ n sɔ loŋ be nsawule na, ŋkpal loŋ so an nananyɛnana daŋ maŋ mur bumo.

english_verse: Aren't you going to punish them? We won't stand a chance when this army attacks. We don't know what to do—we are begging for your help.
translation_verse: Fo e la anyi be Ebɔrɛ! Gberge bumo kusoe ŋkpal manɛ so anyi ere maŋ kɔ eleŋ nɛ an kɔ benapo damta nɛ baa ba nɛ b ba kɔ anyi kena ere. Anyi maŋ nyi kananɛ anyeeŋ wora ama anyee kule fo nna nɛ fo chɛ anyi to.”

english_verse: While every man, woman, and child of Judah was standing there at the temple,
translation_verse: Le be saŋɛ so nɛ Juda be benyɛn nɛ bumo be beche nɛ mbia yil bɔrɛlambu na ase.

english_verse: Then Jahaziel said: Your Majesty and everyone from Judah and Jerusalem, the Lord says that you don't need to be afraid or let this powerful army discourage you. God will fight on your side!
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Jahaziil kaŋɛ le: “Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ yɛ, fo nɛ Juda nɛ Jerusalɛm be basa kikɛ e sa maa lɔ kufu ŋko a pɔ aba ŋkpal benapo damta ere so. Mannɛ men gbagba e naŋ kɔ kena ere. Ebɔrɛ e naŋ kɔ n sa menyi.

english_verse: So here's what you must do. Tomorrow the enemy armies will march through the desert around the town of Jeruel. March down and meet them at the town of Ziz as they come up the valley.
translation_verse: Kusɔ nɛ menyeeŋ wora e la fanɛ, echefo nɛ men doŋana be benapo na kaŋ bɔla keshishɛrsawule nɛ k dese ŋ kulti Jeruwɛl be kade na a ba, menyi alɛ gba e ya tu bumo ashi Ziz be kade to saŋɛ so nɛ b bɔla ketaŋɛ na ase a ba na.

english_verse: You won't even have to fight. Just take your positions and watch the Lord rescue you from your enemy. Don't be afraid. Just do as you're told. And as you march out tomorrow, the Lord will be there with you.
translation_verse: Mannɛ menyi e naŋ kɔ kena ere. Menyi ere e bela ase a yil. Menyeeŋ wu kananɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ kɔ m pɔɔ so n sa menyi. Juda nɛ Jerusalɛmebi, men sa maa lɔ kufu. Men lar n yɔ kena na to, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ beeŋ ba wɔ menyi kutɔ!”

english_verse: Jehoshaphat bowed low to the ground and everyone worshiped the Lord.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ ewura Jehoshafat nɛ basa na kikɛ kurgi amu n yuu to, m bunyaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ.

english_verse: Then some Levites from the Kohath and Korah clans stood up and shouted praises to the Lord God of Israel.
translation_verse: Livaiebi nɛ b shi Kohaf nɛ Koora be kabuna na be beko daŋ koso n yili nna a cha awɔr a maŋkura Enyɛnpe nɛ e la Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na.

english_verse: Early the next morning, as everyone got ready to leave for the desert near Tekoa, Jehoshaphat stood up and said, “Listen my friends, if we trust the Lord God and believe what these prophets have told us, the Lord will help us, and we will be successful.”
translation_verse: Ŋklade kachipurdidi saŋɛ so nɛ ekama lar a yɔ keshishɛrsawule nɛ k mata Tekua na, nɛ ewura Jehoshafat niŋi to ŋ kaŋɛ jimaŋ na le: “Menyi Juda nɛ Jerusalɛm ebi! Men ta men be yirda n deŋi Enyɛnpe nɛ e la menyi be Ebɔrɛ na so nsaa yili to kpakpa. Men yirda kusɔ nɛ mbe anebiana na kaŋɛ menyi na saŋɛ na so asheŋ beeŋ nyalɛ n sa menyi.”

english_verse: Then he explained his plan and appointed men to march in front of the army and praise the Lord for his holy power by singing: “Praise the Lord! His love never ends.”
translation_verse: Ewura na ka malga basa na kutɔ n loge, nɛ e shin nɛ beshɛbompo ko ta epiŋi nɛ baa buu nchɛgboŋ achɛ na m buu n juŋkpar benapo na nsaa a boŋ nshɛ a kaŋɛ le, “Kemaŋkura e baa la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na peya! Mbe kasha wɔtɔ nna hale mbaanaayɔ!”

english_verse: so that the Ammonite and Moabite troops attacked and completely destroyed those from Edom. Then they turned against each other and fought until the entire camp was wiped out!
translation_verse: Ammɔnebi nɛ Mowabebi daŋ kilgi nna ŋ kɔ Edɔmebi na be benapo kena nna m mur bumo cheche. Kumo be kaman nɛ b kilgi a mɔ abar.

english_verse: When Judah's army reached the tower that overlooked the desert, they saw that every soldier in the enemy's army was lying dead on the ground.
translation_verse: Judaebi be benapo na ka fo ketempreŋ jeŋgreŋ nɛ k wɔ keshishɛrsawule na ase na, nɛ b wu kananɛ bumo doŋana kikɛ wu a dese kasawule. Bumo be ekoŋwule gba daa maŋ naŋ ka.

english_verse: Then on the fourth day, everyone came together in Beracah Valley and sang praises to the Lord. That's why that place was called Praise Valley.
translation_verse: Kumo be kachɛ nasopo na, nɛ b shɛr Bɛraka be ketaŋɛ na to nseŋ di Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ epaŋ ŋkpal kusɔ nɛ e wora so. Amoso nɛ baa tre ketaŋɛ na Bɛraka na. Kumo be kifito ashi Hibruwebi be ŋgbar to e la, kapandi.

english_verse: When the other nations heard how the Lord had fought against Judah's enemies, they were too afraid
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ kufu pɛ efuli kama nɛ k nu kananɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kɔ m pɔɔ Israɛlebi bumo doŋana so na ga.

english_verse: While Jehoshaphat was king, he signed a peace treaty with Ahaziah the wicked king of Israel.
translation_verse: Jemanɛ ko, Juda be ewura Jehoshafat nɛ Israɛl be ewura Ahaziya nɛ e daŋ wora asheŋ lubi damta ga na, daŋ wora kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre nna.

english_verse: Jehoshaphat obeyed the Lord, just as his father Asa had done,
translation_verse: Kananɛ ewura Jehoshafat mo tuto Asa daa kɔ kasonu n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na, loŋ nɛ mo alɛ gba daa du,

english_verse: but he did not destroy the local shrines. So the people still worshiped foreign gods, instead of faithfully serving the God their ancestors had worshiped.
translation_verse: ama e daa maŋ mur ndoŋ be mboŋ nɛ baa shuŋ agbir na kikɛ. Ŋkpal loŋ so basa na daa maŋ ta bumo be ŋgbene kikɛ m bɛ bumo nananyɛnana be Ebɔrɛ na so.

english_verse: Everything else Jehoshaphat did while he was king is written in the records of Jehu son of Hanani that are included in The History of the Kings of Israel.
translation_verse: B daŋ sibɛ kusɔ kama nɛ Jehoshafat daŋ wora saŋɛ so nɛ e daa la ewura na nna n wɔtɔ Hanani pibinyɛn Jehu be adrasheŋ be nwɔl nɛ amo alɛ gba ti Israɛl be bewura be adrasheŋ be nwɔl so na to.

english_verse: Jehoshaphat died and was buried beside his ancestors in Jerusalem, and his son Jehoram became king. King Jehoram of Judah (
translation_verse: Ewura Jehoshafat ka wu, kakpa nɛ baa puli bewura ashi ewura Deevid be kade to Jerusalɛm na, nɛ b puli mo alɛ gba, nɛ mo pibinyɛn Jehoram sɔ mo so n ji kuwura. Juda be ewura Jehoram be asheŋ (

english_verse: King Jehoshaphat had seven sons: Jehoram, Azariah, Jehiel, Zechariah, Azariah, Michael, and Shephatiah.
translation_verse: Ewura Jehoshafat pibinyɛn Jehoram daa kɔ besipo nyɛnso ashe nna. Bumo e daa la Azariya nɛ Jehiɛl nɛ Zakareya nɛ Azariahu nɛ Maikel nɛ Shefatiya.

english_verse: years from Jerusalem. He died, and no one even felt sad. He was buried in Jerusalem, but not in the royal tombs.
translation_verse: Saŋɛ so nɛ Jehoram daa la ewura na, Edɔm be basa na daa kini kebaanu a sa Judaebi na nna nsaa lara bumo gbagba be bewura.

english_verse: The Lord later caused the Philistines and the Arabs who lived near the Ethiopians to become angry with Jehoram.
translation_verse: Kede be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na shin nɛ Filistiebi nɛ Nlɔrbu nɛ b chena m mata Itiopiaebi na ya kɔ Jehoram kena.

english_verse: Jehoshaphat gave each of them silver and gold, as well as other valuable gifts. He also put them in charge of the fortified cities in Judah, but he had chosen his oldest son Jehoram to succeed him as king.
translation_verse: Bumo tuto, ewura Jehoshafat, daŋ ta shuwa nɛ gbiti damta nɛ asɔ lela ko gba n ti so n sa bumo nseŋ shin nɛ bumo be ekoŋwule kikɛ bee keni kade kama nɛ b pɔr egbal ŋ kulti kumo ashi Juda be efuli so so, ama Jehoram e daŋ sɔ mo tuto Jehoshafat so n ji kuwura ŋkpal e ka la mbe wurkoŋ so.

english_verse: After Jehoram had taken control of Judah, he had his brothers killed, as well as some of the nation's leaders.
translation_verse: Jehoram be kuwurji ka nya eleŋ, nɛ e shin nɛ b mɔ mo sipoana na kikɛ nɛ Israɛl be benimuana na be beko.

english_verse: Jehoram married Ahab's daughter and followed the sinful example of Ahab's family and the other kings of Israel. He disobeyed the Lord by doing wrong,
translation_verse: Ŋkpal ewura Jehoram ka ta ewura Ahab pibiche so e daa kɔ kumukpakpaso nna fanɛ ewura Ahab nɛ Israɛl be bewura ko nseŋ wora alubi ŋ gbiti Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,

english_verse: but because the Lord had made a solemn promise to King David that someone from his family would always rule in Judah, he refused to wipe out David's descendants.
translation_verse: ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na daa maa sha fanɛ e mur ewura Deevid be kaman to ebi na, ŋkpal mo nɛ ewura Deevid ka wora ŋkre nɛ e nase kɔnɔ fanɛ ewura Deevid be kaman to ebi e naaŋ baa ji kuwura mbaanaayɔ so.

english_verse: Jehoram, his officers, and his cavalry marched to Edom, where the Edomite army surrounded them. He escaped during the night,
translation_verse: Ŋkpal loŋ so ewura Jehoram nɛ mbe benapo be benimuana na daŋ ta egbaŋɛturko nna n ya kɔ Edɔmebi na kena nɛ Edɔmebi na kulti bumo n wɔtɔ. Kanyɛ ka biri, nɛ Judaebi na ŋana n shile.

english_verse: but Judah was never able to regain control of Edom. Even the town of Libnah rebelled at that time. Those things happened because Jehoram had turned away from the Lord, the God his ancestors had worshiped.
translation_verse: Yili loŋ be saŋɛ na, nɛ Edɔmebi sɔ bumo be amu ashi Judaebi be enɔ to. Kumo be saŋɛ nɛ Libna be kade to ebi gba kini kebaanu a sa ewura Jehoram ŋkpal e ka kini kebaanu a sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ e la mo nananyɛnana be Ebɔrɛ na so.

english_verse: Jehoram even built local shrines in the hills of Judah and let the people sin against the Lord by worshiping foreign gods.
translation_verse: Ewura Jehoram daŋ pɔr agbir be mboŋ ashi Juda be abee be efuli so nna nseŋ shin nɛ Juda nɛ Jerusalɛm be basa wora alubi ŋ gbiti Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ.

english_verse: One day, Jehoram received a letter from Elijah the prophet that said: I have a message for you from the Lord God your ancestor David worshiped. He knows that you have not followed the example of Jehoshaphat your father or Asa your grandfather.
translation_verse: Kachako nɛ Anebi Elaija sibɛ kawɔl n sa ewura Jehoram a kaŋɛ mo le: “Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ e la fo nananyɛn ewura Deevid be Ebɔrɛ na yɛ fo maŋ wora nɛnɛ ŋkpal fo ka maŋ bɛ fo tuto ewura Jehoshafat nɛ fo nananyɛn ewura Asa be ekpa so na so.

english_verse: Instead you have acted like those sinful kings of Israel and have encouraged the people of Judah to stop worshiping the Lord, just as Ahab and his descendants did. You even murdered your own brothers, who were better men than you.
translation_verse: Fo bɛ Israɛl be bewura na be ekpa so nna nseŋ shin nɛ Juda nɛ Jerusalɛm be basa maŋ naa ji kashenteŋ a sa Ebɔrɛ fanɛ kananɛ Ahab nɛ mbe kaman to ebi daŋ shin nɛ Israɛl be efuli so ebi maŋ ji kashenteŋ n sa Ebɔrɛ na. Fo mɔ fo sipo nyɛnsoana nɛ b bɔ fo na.

english_verse: Because you have done these terrible things, the Lord will severely punish the people in your kingdom, including your own family, and he will destroy everything you own.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal loŋ so, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ gberge fo basa nɛ fo kanaŋ to ebi kikɛ kusoe nseŋ mur fo asɔ kikɛ gba n ti so.

english_verse: You will be struck with a painful stomach disease and suffer until you die.
translation_verse: Fo alɛ gbagba beeŋ nya epunto be kulɔ kpakpaso nɛ k tɔrɔ fo hale nɛ fo ya wu.”

english_verse: They invaded Judah and stole the royal property from the palace, and they led Jehoram's wives and sons away as prisoners. The only one left behind was Ahaziah, his youngest son.
translation_verse: B daŋ kɔ nna n sɔ Juda nseŋ muu ewura be laŋ to be asɔ kikɛ, m pɛ mbe beche nɛ mbinyɛnsobi kikɛ n yɔ. Mbe pibinyɛn Ahaziya nɛ e la kaluge na nawule nɛ b daa maŋ pɛ.

english_verse: After this happened, the Lord struck Jehoram with an incurable stomach disease.
translation_verse: Ade kikɛ be kaman, nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ epunto be ebesa tɔr ewura na so.

english_verse: About two years later, Jehoram died in terrible pain. No bonfire was built to honor him, even though the people had done this for his ancestors.
translation_verse: Kumo be nfɛ anyɔ be kefɛato, nɛ mbe kulɔ na nyaŋɛto nɛ e wu ebesa damta to. Mbe beyaasepo daa maŋ puga edɛgboŋ mbe keelibuna m maŋkura mo fanɛ kananɛ b wora n sa mo nananyɛnana na.

english_verse: and while Jehu was doing that, he saw some of Judah's leaders and Ahaziah's nephews who had come with Ahaziah. Jehu killed them on the spot,
translation_verse: Jehu ka bee wora kusɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ mo na, nɛ e wu Juda be bejuŋkparpoana nɛ Ahaziya mo wɔpabiana nɛ b daŋ tu mo m ba nɛ b ba bɔ Joram so na. Nɛ Jehu mɔ Ahaziya mo wɔpabiana na nɛ benimuana na be beko

english_verse: then gave orders to find Ahaziah. Jehu's officers found him hiding in Samaria. They brought Ahaziah to Jehu, who immediately put him to death. They buried Ahaziah only because they respected Jehoshaphat his grandfather, who had done his best to obey the Lord. There was no one from Ahaziah's family left to become king of Judah. Queen Athaliah of Judah (
translation_verse: nseŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ b ya fin Ahaziya malɛ, nɛ b ya wu mo nɛ e ŋana Samɛria. Ndoŋ nna nɛ b pɛ mo n yɔ ewura Jehu kutɔ n ya mɔ. B daŋ puli Ahaziya nna ŋkpal b ka daa sa mo nananyɛn wura Jehoshafat bunyaŋ ŋkpal e ka daŋ wora ania n shuŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛnɛ so. Esa kikɛ malɛ daa maŋ naŋ ka Ahaziya be kanaŋ to nsaa kɔ eleŋ nɛ e tiŋ n ji kuwura na. Juda be ewurche Atalia be asheŋ (

english_verse: In fact, after his father's death, Ahaziah sinned against the Lord by appointing some of Ahab's relatives to be his advisors. Their advice led to his downfall.
translation_verse: Ahaziya mo tuto ka wu na be kaman, e daŋ wora kulubi nna ŋ gbiti Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ŋkpal e ka daŋ lara Ahab be kanaŋ na to be basa ko ŋ ki mbe asoetojipoana so. Bumo be kasotoji na malɛ e shin nɛ e tɔr.

english_verse: He listened to them and went with King Joram of Israel to attack King Hazael and the Syrian troops at Ramoth in Gilead. Joram was wounded in that battle,
translation_verse: E daŋ bɛ bumo be kasotoji so nna n tu Israɛl be ewura Joram n yɔ nɛ b ya kɔ Siriya be ewura Haziɛl kena. Ramɔf nɛ k wɔ Giliad na nɛ b daŋ tu abar ŋ kɔ kena na nɛ b doro Joram ashi kena na to.

english_verse: and he went to the town of Jezreel to recover. And Ahaziah later went there to visit him.
translation_verse: E ka doro na, nɛ e bɛta n yɔ Jezreel be kade to nɛ e ya chɛ mbe doro na, nɛ Ahaziya yɔ ndoŋ nɛ e ya bɔ mo so.

english_verse: It was during that visit that God had Ahaziah put to death. When Ahaziah arrived at Jezreel, he and Joram went to meet with Jehu grandson of Nimshi. The Lord had already told Jehu to kill every male in Ahab's family,
translation_verse: Ahaziya be keya bɔɔ Joram so na, e daŋ da mo n lɛ. E ka ba Joram kutɔ na, nɛ mo nɛ Joram ya tu Nimshi pibinyɛn Jehu nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ lara fanɛ e mur Ahab be kuwurji na.

english_verse: but Jehosheba rescued Joash son of Ahaziah just as the others were about to be murdered. Jehosheba, who was Jehoram's daughter and Ahaziah's half sister, was married to Jehoiada the priest. So she was able to hide her nephew Joash and his personal servant in a bedroom in the Lord's temple where he was safe from Athaliah.
translation_verse: Ahaziya daa kɔ esipoche nɛ baa tre mo Jehosheba nɛ e daa kil bɔrɛmatapo ko nɛ baa tre mo Jehowada. Mo e daŋ mɔlga Ahaziya pibinyɛn Jɔash nɛ e la Ahaziya be mbinyɛnsobi nɛ b daa sha kemɔ na be eko. E daŋ ta mo nna ŋ ŋana Enyɛnpe be bɔrɛlambuna be ebu deseto to. Ŋkpal loŋ so, Atalia daa maŋ nya mo m mɔ.

english_verse: As soon as Athaliah heard that her son King Ahaziah was dead, she decided to kill any relative who could possibly become king. She would have done just that,
translation_verse: Juda be Ewura Ahaziya mo nio Atalia ka nu fanɛ mo pibinyɛn wu nna, nɛ e kaŋɛ fanɛ b mɔ basa nɛ b shi Juda be ewura be kanaŋ to na kikɛ.

english_verse: Joash hid in the temple with them for six years while Athaliah ruled as queen of Judah.
translation_verse: Nfɛ ashe nɛ Jɔash ŋana bɔrɛlambu na to. Loŋ be jemanɛ na nɛ Atalia malɛ bee ji kuwurche ashi efuli na so.

english_verse: These five men went to the towns in Judah and called together the Levites and the clan leaders. They all came to Jerusalem
translation_verse: Basa ere kikɛ daŋ yɔ Juda be efuli so be nde kikɛ to nna n ya bar Livaiebi nɛ mbuna mbuna be bejuŋkparpoana na kikɛ ashi Jerusalɛm.

english_verse: Jehoiada and his sons brought Joash outside, where they placed the crown on his head and gave him a copy of the instructions for ruling the nation. Olive oil was poured on his head to show that he was now king, and the crowd cheered and shouted, “Long live the king!”
translation_verse: Ade kikɛ be kaman nɛ Jehowada nɛ mbe mbinyɛnsobi ya keta Jɔash n lar kowu nseŋ ta kuwurwuro m buu mo. Kumo be kaman nɛ b ta bewura be mbra be kawɔl n sa mo n ta mo ŋ ki ewura. Bɔrɛmatapo Jehowada nɛ mbe mbinyɛnsobi e daŋ duga ŋku n do Jɔash be kumu so n ta mo ŋ ki ewura, nɛ ekama cha awɔr ŋ kaŋɛ: “Ebɔrɛ e teŋi ewura be ŋkpa so!”

english_verse: Here is what we will do. Three groups of priests and Levites will be on guard duty on the Sabbath—one group will guard the gates of the temple,
translation_verse: Ama kusɔ nɛ k daga an ka wora nde. Bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ Livaiebi na kaŋ ba kushuŋ to kewushiachɛ ere, kananɛ b barga bumo to ntuŋ asa so na be katuŋ koŋwule e naaŋ baa keni bɔrɛlambu na be mbunaana so,

english_verse: Everyone celebrated because Athaliah had been killed and Jerusalem was peaceful again.
translation_verse: Basa na kikɛ be ŋgbene daŋ fuli bumo nna ga nɛ kade na kikɛ wora shruum ŋkpal ewurche Atalia ka wu na so.

english_verse: After Ahaziah's son Joash had hidden in the temple for six years, Jehoiada the priest knew that something had to be done. So he made sure he had the support of several army officers. They were Azariah son of Jeroham, Ishmael son of Jehohanan, Azariah son of Obed, Maaseiah son of Adaiah, and Elishaphat son of Zichri.
translation_verse: Ahaziya pibinyɛn Jɔash ka ŋana bɔrɛlambu na to nfɛ ashe na, nɛ bɔrɛmatapo Jehowada wu fanɛ k daga e ka wora kusɔ ko. Ndoŋ nna nɛ e ya fin benapo be benimu nɛ baaŋ yili mo kaman. Bumo e daa la Joram pibinyɛn Azariya nɛ Jehohanan pibinyɛn Ishmaɛl nɛ Obɛd pibinyɛn Azariya nɛ Adaya pibinyɛn Maaseia nɛ Zikri pibinyɛn Elishafat.

english_verse: and gathered at the temple, where they agreed to help Joash. Jehoiada said to them: Joash will be our next king, because long ago the Lord promised that one of David's descendants would always be king.
translation_verse: Bumo kikɛ daŋ ba shɛr bɔrɛlambu na to nna nɛ bumo nɛ ewura pibinyɛn Jɔash wora kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre. Ndoŋ nna nɛ Jehowada kaŋɛ bumo le: “Ewura nɛ e wu na pibinyɛn nde. Mo e naŋ ki ewura naniere ŋkpal manɛ so Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nase kɔnɔ nna fanɛ ewura Deevid be kaman to ebi e naaŋ baa ji kuwura saŋkikɛ.

english_verse: Only the priests and Levites who are on duty will be able to enter the temple, because they will be the only ones who have gone through the ceremony to make themselves clean and acceptable. The others must stay outside in the courtyards, just as the Lord has commanded.
translation_verse: Ekama maŋ kɔ ekpa nɛ e luri bɔrɛlambu na to ama bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ Livaiebi nɛ baa shuŋ kumo to kamɔnchɛ na nawule. Bumo ere beeŋ tiŋ ŋ luri ŋkpal b ka lara kulubi bumo be ŋgbene to nsaa du cheembi so. Ama menyi nɛ men ka ere bre daga fanɛ men bɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be keŋini so nseŋ yili kowushina.

english_verse: You Levites must protect King Joash. Don't let him out of your sight! And keep your swords ready to kill anyone who comes into the temple.
translation_verse: Livaiebi na beeŋ keta bumo be etokobi n wora shiriya n yili a kuŋ ewura na. Kaplɛkama nɛ ewura na bee yɔ nɛ b bɛ mo so. Ekama malɛ nɛ e pɛl n luri bɔrɛlambu na to daga luwu.”

english_verse: Jehoiada went into the temple and brought out the swords and shields that had belonged to King David, and he gave them to the commanders.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Jehowada ta ekpa nɛ abɛlso be asɔkuŋso nɛ a daa la ewura Deevid peya nsaa yil bɔrɛlambu na to na n sa benapo be benimu na.

english_verse: They gave the weapons to the guards, and Jehoiada then made sure that the guards took their positions around the temple and the altar to protect the king on every side.
translation_verse: E daŋ shin nna nɛ bekumpo na ta bumo be etokobi ŋ keta n yili ŋ kulti bɔrɛsure na ashi bɔrɛlambu na be anishito a kuŋ ewura na.

english_verse: As soon as Queen Athaliah heard the crowd cheering for Joash, she went to the temple.
translation_verse: Ewurche Atalia ka nu basa na ka bee dele ewura na, nɛ e nya manaŋ n yɔ kakpa nɛ jimaŋ na shɛr na ashi bɔrɛlambu na to.

english_verse: There she saw Joash standing by one of the columns near the entrance, which was the usual place for the king. The commanders and the trumpet players were standing next to him, and the musicians were playing instruments and leading the people as they celebrated and blew trumpets. Athaliah tore her clothes in anger and shouted, “You betrayed me, you traitors!”
translation_verse: E ka ya wu ewura popɔr na nɛ e yil eshabɔrɛ na ekpa ashi bɔrɛlambu na be kabuna be anishito be kakpa nɛ bewura bee chena na, nɛ benapo be benimu nɛ mbelfompoana yili ŋ kulti mo, nɛ basa na kikɛ bee cha awɔr kagbenefuliso nsaa foŋ mbel nɛ bɔrɛlambu to be beshɛbompoana bee juŋkpar kasheŋwora na kikɛ na, nɛ e kpɛa mbe asɔbuuso to kagbenejijaso nseŋ boŋto ŋ kaŋɛ le: “Menyi bedebɔrpo ere!”

english_verse: At once, Jehoiada said to the army commanders, “Don't kill her near the Lord's temple. Take her out in front of the troops, and be sure to kill all of her followers!”
translation_verse: Jehowada daa maa sha b ka mɔ ewurche Atalia bɔrɛlambu na ase, ŋkpal loŋ so, e daŋ tre benapo be benimuana na nna ŋ kaŋɛ bumo le: “Men ta mo m bɔla bekumpo na to n yɔ. Esa kama malɛ nɛ e kaŋ pɛl a sha k sɔ mo n yige, men mɔ amodoŋwura.”

english_verse: She tried to escape, but the commanders caught and killed her near the gate where horses are led into the palace.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ b pɛ mo n ta mo n yɔ ewura be laŋ to be kelɔnɛ so be kakpa nɛ baa tre Egbaŋɛ be Kabuna na, n ya mɔ mo ndoŋ. Jehowada ka chɛrga asheŋ

english_verse: Jehoiada asked King Joash and the people to join with him in being faithful to the Lord. They agreed,
translation_verse: Bɔrɛmatapo Jehowada daŋ shin nna nɛ mo nɛ ewura Jɔash nɛ basa na wora kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre fanɛ baaŋ baa ji kashenteŋ a sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ.

english_verse: then rushed to the temple of the god Baal and tore it down. They smashed the altars and the idols and killed Mattan the priest of Baal in front of the altars.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ b ya da Baal be lambu na n lɛ nseŋ bure kumo be ebɔrɛsure nɛ agbirana nɛ a wɔ ndoŋ na kikɛ nseŋ mɔ Maatan nɛ e la Baal be kegbirwura na ashi ebɔrɛsureana na ase gbagba.

english_verse: Jehoiada assigned the priests and Levites their duties at the temple, just as David had done. They were in charge of offering sacrifices to the Lord according to the Law of Moses, and they were responsible for leading the celebrations with singing.
translation_verse: Ewura Jehowada daŋ shin nna nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ Livaiebi na bee keni bɔrɛlambu na be kushuŋ so fanɛ kananɛ ewura Deevid yili n sa bumo na. Bumo be kushuŋ e la kebaachɔɔ esarga nɛ b lara n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ashi Mosis be mbra be ekpa so, nɛ kebaajuŋkpar a boŋ nshɛ kasheŋwora kikɛ to.

english_verse: Finally, Jehoiada called together the army commanders, the most important citizens of Judah, and the government officials. The crowd of people followed them as they led Joash from the temple, through the Upper Gate, and into the palace, where he took his place as king of Judah.
translation_verse: Ade kikɛ be kaman nɛ benapo be benimuana nɛ Juda be kade to be benimuana nɛ ekrachiana nɛ basa nɛ b ka na kikɛ ba ewura Jehowada kutɔ nɛ b bɛ abar so n ya keta ewura na bɔrɛlambu na to m ba ewura be laŋ to. Kabunagboŋ na to nɛ b daŋ bɔla n luri laŋ na to nɛ ewura na ya chena mbe kuwurputi so.

english_verse: While Jehoiada the priest was alive, Joash obeyed the Lord by doing right.
translation_verse: E daa wora kusɔ nɛ k walɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be anishito saŋɛ so nɛ bɔrɛmatapo Jehowada daa wɔ ŋkpa to na nna.

english_verse: Joash and Jehoiada turned the money over to the men who were supervising the repairs to the temple. They used the money to hire stonecutters, carpenters, and experts in working with iron and bronze.
translation_verse: Ewura na nɛ Jehowada e daa ta amansherbi na a sa basa nɛ baa keni bɔrɛlambu na be kelɔnɛ be kushuŋ so na, nɛ bumo alɛ e ta amo n haya bepɔrpo nɛ ekapɛnta nɛ ebɔyɛpo nɛ b ta abɛlso nɛ danyaŋ n lɔŋɛ asɔwurbi n wɔtɔ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be bɔrɛlambu na to.

english_verse: and he was buried in the royal tombs in Jerusalem, because he had done so much good for the people of Israel, for God, and for the temple. Joash Turns Away from the Lord
translation_verse: Kakpa nɛ baa puli bewura ashi ewura Deevid be kade to Jerusalɛm na, nɛ b daŋ puli mo alɛ gba ŋkpal kushuŋ lela nɛ e daŋ wora n sa Israɛl be basa nɛ kushuŋ nɛ e shuŋ ashi Ebɔrɛ be bɔrɛlambu na to so.

english_verse: And now we need it to repair the temple because the sons of that evil woman Athaliah came in and wrecked it. They even used some of the sacred objects to worship the god Baal.”
translation_verse: Ewurche Atalia nɛ e la kumu kpakpasowura na be mbinyɛnsobi e daŋ jija bɔrɛlambu na nseŋ ta kumo to be asɔ cheembi na a shuŋ kegbir nɛ baa tre Baal na.

english_verse: Jehoiada even chose two women for Joash to marry so he could have a family.
translation_verse: Jehowada daŋ ta beche anyɔ nna n sa ewura Jɔash nɛ mo nɛ bumo kurge bibinyɛn nɛ bibiche.

english_verse: Some time later, Joash decided it was time to repair the temple.
translation_verse: Jɔash ka ji kuwura n ya fo saŋko na, nɛ e yili kumo fanɛ e beeŋ lɔŋɛ bɔrɛlambu na nɛnɛ.

english_verse: He called together the priests and Levites and said, “Go everywhere in Judah and collect the annual tax from the people. I want this done at once—we need that money to repair the temple.” But the Levites were in no hurry to follow the king's orders.
translation_verse: E daŋ shin nna nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ Livaiebi na yɔ Juda be efuli so be nde to, n ya sɔ basa na kikɛ kafɛ kafɛ be lampo nɛ baa sɔ a lɔŋɛ bɔrɛlambu na. E kaŋɛ bumo nna fanɛ b wora kumo manaŋ ama Livaiebi na daa maŋ ta kumo to manaŋ.

english_verse: So he sent for Jehoiada the high priest and asked, “Why didn't you send the Levites to collect the taxes? The Lord's servant Moses and the people agreed long ago that this tax would be collected and used to pay for the upkeep of the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Amoso e daŋ shuŋi nna n tre Jehowada nɛ e la bɔrɛmatapo nimuso na m bishi mo le: “Manɛ nna nɛ fo maŋ shin nɛ Livaiebi na sɔ lampo ashi Juda nɛ Jerusalɛm be basa na kutɔ fanɛ kananɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be kenya Mosis daŋ shin nɛ baa ka nɛ baa ta a chɛ Enyɛnpe be Nshɛr be wajɛbu na be kushuŋ to na?”

english_verse: Joash gave orders for a wooden box to be made and had it placed outside, near the gate of the temple.
translation_verse: Ewura na daŋ kaŋɛ Livaiebi na nna fanɛ b lɔŋɛ amansherbi be kadekabi, nɛ baaŋ ta n yili bɔrɛlambu na be kabuna to a sɔ etoto.

english_verse: He then sent letters everywhere in Judah and Jerusalem, asking everyone to bring their taxes to the temple, just as Moses had required their ancestors to do.
translation_verse: E daŋ sa ebɔl Jerusalɛm nɛ Juda kikɛ to nna fanɛ b ta bumo be etoto m ba bɔrɛlambu nɛ k wɔ Jerusalɛm na to fanɛ kananɛ Ebɔrɛ be kenya Mosis daŋ yili kumo kiyi to fanɛ b baa sɔ Israɛlebi na kutɔ a sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.

english_verse: The people and their leaders agreed, and they brought their money to Jerusalem and placed it in the box.
translation_verse: Nɛ benimuana na nɛ basa na kikɛ shuli kumo be loŋ nseŋ ta bumo be amansherbi m ba kaa wɔtɔ deka na to hale nɛ k ya bɔlɔ.

english_verse: Each day, after the Levites took the box into the temple, the king's secretary and the high priest's assistant would dump out the money and count it. Then the empty box would be taken back outside. This happened day after day, and soon a large amount of money was collected.
translation_verse: Karechɛ kikɛ Livaiebi na bee ta deka na nna n yɔ ewura na be krachi nɛ esa nɛ e bɛ bɔrɛmatapo nimuso na so kutɔ nɛ b lara amansherbi na ŋ karga amo. Kumo be kaman nɛ b naŋ bɛta deka na n yɔ bɔrɛlambu na to. Ŋkpal b ka bee wora loŋ karechɛ kikɛ so, amansherbi damta nɛ b daŋ chala.

english_verse: These workers went right to work repairing the temple, and when they were finished, it looked as good as new.
translation_verse: Basa na daŋ shuŋ kenishipereso nna nseŋ lɔŋɛ bɔrɛlambu na fanɛ kananɛ k daa du sososo na gbagba, nɛ k naaŋ nya eleŋ ga n ti so.

english_verse: They did not use all the tax money for the repairs, so the rest of it was handed over to Joash and Jehoiada, who then used it to make dishes and other gold and silver objects for the temple. Sacrifices to please the Lord were offered regularly in the temple for as long as Jehoiada lived.
translation_verse: B ka lɔŋɛ bɔrɛlambu na n loge na, nɛ b ta amansherbi nɛ a ka na m ba sa ewura na nɛ Jehowada. Loŋ be amansherbi nɛ a ka na malɛ nɛ b ta n lɔŋɛ asɔwurbi nɛ shuwa nɛ gbiti be ntishaŋ nɛ b kɔ a wora asheŋ ashi Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be bɔrɛlambu na to. Bɔrɛmatapo Jehowada ka daa wɔ ŋkpa to na, b daa mɔ asɔbɔya nna a lara sarga chɔɔso bɔrɛlambu na to a sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ saŋkama.

english_verse: He died at the ripe old age of
translation_verse: Ewura Jehowada daŋ ji nfɛ kalfa nɛ adesa pɔɛŋ nseŋ wu.

english_verse: After the death of Jehoiada the priest, the leaders of Judah went to Joash and talked him into doing what they wanted.
translation_verse: Ewura Jehowada ka wu na be kaman nɛ Juda be bejuŋkparpoana na ya bunyaŋ ewura Jɔash nseŋ lɔlɔ mo nɛ e bee bɛ bumo be kasotoji so.

english_verse: The people of Judah soon stopped worshiping in the temple of the Lord God and started worshiping idols and the symbols of the goddess Asherah. These sinful things made the Lord God angry with the people of Judah and Jerusalem,
translation_verse: Basa na daa maŋ naa yɔ bɔrɛlambu na to n ya kaa bunyaŋ bumo nananyɛnana be Ebɔrɛ na. B daŋ naŋ fara nna a shuŋ agbir nɛ kegbirche Ashira be kegbir be kapɔrduli. Ŋkpal kulubi nɛ b wora ere so, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be agbo daŋ ba Juda nɛ Jerusalɛm be basa so nna.

english_verse: but he still sent prophets who warned them to turn back to him. The people refused to listen.
translation_verse: Amo nɛ amo kikɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na daŋ shuŋi anebiana nna fanɛ b ya kpele bumo kusoe n shin nɛ b bɛta m ba mo kutɔ nɛ b kini kenu.

english_verse: God's Spirit spoke to Zechariah son of Jehoiada the priest, and Zechariah told everyone that God was saying: “Why are you disobeying me and my laws? This will only bring punishment! You have deserted me, so now I will desert you.”
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Ebɔrɛ be kiyoyu ba bɔrɛmatapo Jehowada pibinyɛn Zakareya so. Nɛ e yili kakpa nɛ basa na beeŋ wu mo ŋ kaŋɛ le: “Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ yɛ, manɛ nna nɛ men kini kebɛ mbe mbra so nsaa kil kasogberge a sa menyi be amu loŋ! Men ka kini mo na so nɛ mo alɛ gba kini menyi na.”

english_verse: King Joash forgot that Zechariah's father had always been a loyal friend. So when the people of Judah plotted to kill Zechariah, Joash joined them and gave orders for them to stone him to death in the courtyard of the temple. As Zechariah was dying, he said, “I pray that the Lord will see this and punish all of you.” Joash Is Killed
translation_verse: Ewura Jɔash daŋ teŋ kelela nɛ Zakareya mo tuto Jehowada daŋ wora mo na so nna nseŋ ti bejuŋkparpo na so nɛ b kre fanɛ b mɔ Zakareya. Ewura na e daŋ sa ekpa nɛ b kpa Zakareya ajembu m mɔ ashi Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be bɔrɛlambu na be kelɔnɛ so. Zakareya ka bee wu nɛ e kaŋɛ le: “Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ wu kusɔ nɛ fee wora ere kikɛ. Mo alɛ beeŋ gberge fo kusoe n tal to!” Ewura Jɔash be kuwurji be lalaloge be asheŋ

english_verse: In the spring of the following year, the Syrian army invaded Judah and Jerusalem, killing all of the nation's leaders. They collected everything of value that belonged to the people and took it back to their king in Damascus.
translation_verse: Kpanchali be jemanɛ ka fo, nɛ Siriya be benapo yɔ Juda nɛ Jerusalɛm n ya kɔ bumo kena m mɔ bumo be bejuŋkparpoana kikɛ nseŋ muu bumo be asɔ damta kena na to n ya sa bumo be ewura ashi Damaskɔs.

english_verse: The Syrian army was very small, but the Lord let them defeat Judah's large army, because he was punishing Joash and the people of Judah for turning away from him.
translation_verse: Kashenteŋ nna fanɛ Siriya be benapo na daa maŋ shibi, ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ daŋ shin nna nɛ b kɔ m pɔɔ Juda be benapo damta na so ŋkpal b ka kini mo Enyɛnpe bumo nananyɛnana be Ebɔrɛ na so. Kananɛ Enyɛnpe na daŋ gberge ewura Jɔash kusoe nna na.

english_verse: Joash was severely wounded during the battle, and as soon as the Syrians left Judah, two of his officials, Zabad and Jehozabad, decided to revenge the death of Zechariah. They plotted and killed Joash while he was in bed, recovering from his wounds. Joash was buried in Jerusalem, but not in the royal tombs.
translation_verse: Basa nɛ b daŋ wora loŋ na, e daa la kache nɛ e shi Ammɔn be efuli so nɛ baa tre mo Shimish na pibinyɛn Zabad na nɛ Mowab be efuli so be kache nɛ baa tre mo Shimrif na pibinyɛn Jehozabad.

english_verse: The History of the Kings also tells more about the sons of Joash, what the prophets said about him, and how he repaired the temple. Amaziah son of Joash became king after his father's death.
translation_verse: Bewura be adrasheŋ gba bee malga Jɔash be mbinyɛnsobi be asheŋ nɛ kananɛ anebiana na malga mbe asheŋ nɛ kananɛ e lɔŋɛ bɔrɛlambu na nɛnɛ be asheŋ kikɛ. Jɔash ka wu, mo pibinyɛn Amaziya e sɔ mo so n ji kuwura.

english_verse: One of God's prophets said, “Your Majesty, don't let these Israelite soldiers march into battle with you. The Lord has refused to help anyone from the northern kingdom of Israel,
translation_verse: Ama Ebɔrɛ be anebi daŋ yɔ ewura na kutɔ nna n ya kaŋɛ mo le: “Yiramu, sa maŋ shin nɛ Israɛl be benapo ere e bɛ fo so n yɔ kena to, ŋkpal manɛ so, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ maŋ wɔ bekama nɛ b shi Israɛl be efuli so be kelargato be esoso be kaba so na be kaman.

english_verse: Amaziah replied, “What am I supposed to do about all the silver I paid those troops?” “The Lord will give you back even more than you paid,” the prophet answered.
translation_verse: Nɛ ewura Amaziya bishi anebi na le: “Nɛ gbiti nɛ n teŋ ta n sa bumo fanɛ bumo be kakɔka na malɛ a?” Nɛ anebi na malɛ kaŋɛ le: “Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ tiŋ n sa fo kusɔ nɛ k chɔ loŋ!”

english_verse: But before the prophet finished speaking, Amaziah interrupted and said, “You're not one of my advisors! Don't say another word, or I'll have you killed.” The prophet stopped. But then he added, “First you sinned and now you've ignored my warning. It's clear that God has decided to punish you!” Israel Defeats Judah (
translation_verse: Nɛ ewura Amaziya ku mbe kamalga na to ŋ kaŋɛ le: “Saŋɛ mo nɛ an ta fo ŋ ki ewura be asoetojipo? Lo fo kɔnɔ na pɔɛŋ nɛ n shin nɛ b ba mɔ fo ndoŋ!” Anebi na ka jo nɛ e malga n loge, nɛ mo alɛ kaŋɛ le: “Naniere nɛ m pin fanɛ Ebɔrɛ bee sha kemur fo nna ŋkpal fo ka kplaŋ ma kasotoji so nseŋ wora asheŋ ere kikɛ so.” B ka kɔ Israɛl kena be asheŋ (

english_verse: King Amaziah of Judah talked with his officials, then sent a message to King Jehoash of Israel: “Come out and face me in battle!”

english_verse: Jehoash sent back a reply that said: Once upon a time, a small thornbush in Lebanon arranged the marriage between his son and the daughter of a large cedar tree. But a wild animal came along and trampled the small bush.

english_verse: and said, “Your Majesty, this isn't right! You are not allowed to burn incense to the Lord. That must be done only by priests who are descendants of Aaron. You will have to leave! You have sinned against the Lord, and so he will no longer bless you.”

english_verse: Then he called the priests and Levites to the east courtyard of the temple
translation_verse: E daŋ shin nna nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana na, nɛ Livaiebi na shɛr bɔrɛlambu na be kelɔnɛ na be epeŋilarkpa be kaba so

english_verse: and said: It's time to purify the temple of the Lord God of our ancestors. You Levites must first go through the ceremony to make yourselves clean, then go into the temple and bring out everything that is unclean and unacceptable to the Lord.
translation_verse: nɛ e malga bumo kutɔ ndoŋ ŋ kaŋɛ le: “Livaiebi, men lara alubi men be ŋgbene to a du cheembi nseŋ luri Enyɛnpe nɛ e la men nananyɛnana be Ebɔrɛ na be bɔrɛlambu na to n lara kusɔ kama nɛ k wora eyurpi daŋkare be ekpa so ashi kumo to.

english_verse: Some of our ancestors were unfaithful and disobeyed the Lord our God. Not only did they turn their backs on the Lord, but they also completely ignored his temple.
translation_verse: An nananyɛnana daa maŋ ji kashenteŋ, bumo alɛ daa maŋ wora kasonu n sa Enyɛnpe an be Ebɔrɛ na. Mannɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nawule nɛ b daŋ kini, b daŋ kplaŋ mbe bɔrɛlambu na gba so nna.

english_verse: They locked the doors, then let the lamps go out and stopped burning incense and offering sacrifices to him.
translation_verse: B daŋ ti bɔrɛlambu na be akuloŋana so nna nseŋ duŋ kumo to be efitila nseŋ yige eduwu gba be kebaachɔɔ nɛ kebaalara sarga chɔɔso a sa Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na.

english_verse: The Lord became terribly angry with the people of Judah and Jerusalem, and everyone was shocked and horrified at what he did to punish them. Not only were
translation_verse: Ŋkpal le be asheŋ ere so, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ daŋ nya agbo nna ga n wɔtɔ Juda nɛ Jerusalɛm ebi nseŋ wora bumo kusɔ nɛ k pɛ ekama kufu nseŋ mɔ ekama kɔnɔ. Men gbagba ere nyi le be kesheŋ ere nɛnɛ.

english_verse: our ancestors killed in battle, but our own children and wives were taken captive.
translation_verse: B daŋ mɔ an tutoana ashi kena to nna nseŋ pɛ anyi be beche nɛ mbia kena to n yɔ efuli pɔtɛ so.

english_verse: So I have decided to renew our agreement with the Lord God of Israel. Maybe then he will stop being so angry with us.
translation_verse: Naniere bre ma nɛ Enyɛnpe nɛ e la Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ tiŋi ŋkre dra na to. Ashere nɛ n wora loŋ, mbe agbo maaŋ naa wɔ anyi so.

english_verse: Let's not waste any time, my friends. You are the ones who were chosen to be the Lord's priests and to offer him sacrifices.
translation_verse: Ma mbinyɛnsobi, men sa maa jija saŋɛ, ŋkpal manɛ so, menyi nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na lara fanɛ men baa chɔɔ duwu a sa mo nsaa juŋkpar basa nɛ b baa shuŋ mo.”

english_verse: When Hezekiah finished talking, the following Levite leaders went to work: Mahath son of Amasai and Joel son of Azariah from the Kohath clan; Kish son of Abdi and Azariah son of Jehallelel from the Merari clan; Joah son of Zimmah and Eden son of Joah from the Gershon clan; Shimri and Jeuel from the Elizaphan clan; Zechariah and Mattaniah from the Asaph clan; Jehuel and Shimei from the Heman clan; Shemaiah and Uzziel from the Jeduthun clan.
translation_verse: Livaiebi nɛ b daa wɔ kushuŋ na to e daa la Mahaf nɛ e la Amasai pibinyɛn na nɛ Jowɛl nɛ e la Azariya pibinyɛn na e daŋ shi Kohaf be kabuna. Kish nɛ e la Abdi pibinyɛn na nɛ Azariya nɛ e la Jehalelɛl pibinyɛn na e daŋ shi Mɛrari be kabuna. Jowanɛ e la Zimna pibinyɛn na nɛ Edɛn nɛ e la Jowa pibinyɛn na e daŋ shi Gɛshɔn be kabuna. Shimri nɛ Jeuɛl daa la Elizafan be kaman to ebi nna. Zakareya nɛ Mataniya daa la Asaf be kaman to ebi nna. Jehuɛl nɛ Shimei daa la Heman be kaman to ebi nna. Shemaya nɛ Uziɛl daa la Jedutum be kaman to ebi nna.

english_verse: These leaders gathered together the rest of the Levites, and they all went through the ceremony to make themselves clean. Then they began to purify the temple according to the Law of the Lord, just as Hezekiah had commanded.
translation_verse: Basa ere kikɛ daŋ tre bumo braana Livaiebi na nna n shɛr nɛ bumo kikɛ fɔr bumo be amu so daŋkare be ekpa so. Kumo be kaman nɛ b wora kusɔ nɛ ewura na kaŋɛ fanɛ b wora na nseŋ luri n ya lɔŋɛ bɔrɛlambu na to daŋkare be ekpa so fanɛ kananɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be mbra bee ŋini na.

english_verse: The priests went into the temple and carried out everything that was unclean. They put these things in the courtyard, and from there, the Levites carried them outside the city to Kidron Valley.
translation_verse: Bɔrɛmatapoana na ka luri bɔrɛlambu na to nɛ b ya lɔŋɛ kumo to daŋkare be ekpa so na, nɛ b lara kusɔ kama nɛ k maŋ walɛ so na kikɛ m ba kumo be kelɔnɛ so. Nɛ Livaiebi na malɛ ta amo ndoŋ n ya lɛ Kidrɔn be ketaŋɛ na to.

english_verse: The priests and Levites began their work on the first day of the first month. It took them one week to purify the courtyards of the temple and another week to purify the temple. So on the sixteenth day of that same month
translation_verse: Kufɔl juŋkparso na be kachɛ juŋkparso nɛ b fara kushuŋ na nseŋ ta nchɛ aburwa n lɔŋɛ bɔrɛlambu na be kelɔnɛ so n ta nchɛ aburwa malɛ n lɔŋɛ bɔrɛlambu na gbagba to, nɛ kushuŋ na kikɛ loge kachɛ kuduashesopo na.

english_verse: And we have brought back all the things that King Ahaz took from the temple during the time he was unfaithful to God. We purified them and put them back in front of the altar. Worship in the Temple
translation_verse: An naŋ bɛta asɔwurbi kama nɛ Ewura Ahaz daŋ ta saŋɛ so nɛ e daa maa ji kashenteŋ a sa Ebɔrɛ na kikɛ m ba bɔɔ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ enɔ. Amo kikɛ wɔ Enyɛnpe be bɔrɛsure na be anishito.”

english_verse: At once, Hezekiah called together the officials of Jerusalem, and they went to the temple.
translation_verse: Epul to nɛ ewura Hɛzekaya tre kade na to be benimuana na nɛ b yɔ bɔrɛlambu na to.

english_verse: They brought with them seven bulls, seven rams, seven lambs, and seven goats as sacrifices to take away the sins of Hezekiah's family and of the people of Judah, as well as to purify the temple. Hezekiah told the priests, who were descendants of Aaron, to sacrifice these animals on the altar.
translation_verse: B daŋ bar egbolu ashunu nɛ ekpakpa ashunu nɛ ekpakpafɔlbi ashunu nɛ mboe ashunu nna fanɛ b ta n lara Hɛzekaya nɛ mbe kanaŋ nɛ Juda be basa be alubi be ketampaŋ be sarga nseŋ fɔr bɔrɛlambu na gba so daŋkare be ekpa so. Kede be kaman nɛ Hɛzekaya kaŋɛ bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ b la Ɛɛrɔn be kaman to ebi na fanɛ b ta loŋ be asɔbɔya na n lara sarga bɔrɛsure na so.

english_verse: They took the goats to Hezekiah and the worshipers, and they laid their hands on the animals.
translation_verse: B daŋ ta mboe na bre nna n yɔ ewura na nɛ basa nɛ b wɔ ndoŋ a bunyaŋ Ebɔrɛ na kutɔ nɛ b ta bumo be enɔana n deŋi n deŋi bumo so.

english_verse: The priests then killed the goats and splattered the blood on the altar as a sacrifice to take away the sins of everyone in Israel, because Hezekiah had commanded that these sacrifices be made for all the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana na mɔ mboe na nseŋ chulgi amo be ŋklaŋ n wurge bɔrɛsure na so fanɛ alubi be ketampaŋ be sarga, ŋkpal manɛ so, ewura na kaŋɛ nna fanɛ b ta amo n lara Israɛl be efuli so ebi kikɛ be sarga chɔɔso nɛ alubi be ketampaŋ be sarga.

english_verse: The Levites were ready to play the instruments that had belonged to David; the priests were ready to blow the trumpets.
translation_verse: Livaiebi na daŋ bela ase nna nɛ b laŋ ewura Deevid be alaŋsɔ na, nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana malɛ wora shiriya nɛ b foŋ bumo be mbel.

english_verse: As soon as Hezekiah gave the signal for the sacrifices to be burned on the altar, the musicians began singing praises to the Lord and playing their instruments,
translation_verse: Ewura Hɛzekaya ka baŋ sa ekpa fanɛ b lara sarga chɔɔso na; nɛ basa na fara a boŋ nshɛ a di Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ epaŋ nɛ beshɛbompo na malɛ fara a foŋ bumo be mbel nsaa laŋ alaŋsɔ

english_verse: Then Hezekiah and his officials ordered the Levites to sing the songs of praise that David and Asaph the prophet had written. And so they bowed down and joyfully sang praises to the Lord.
translation_verse: Ewura na nɛ efuli na so be bejuŋkparpoana na daŋ kaŋɛ Livaiebi na nna fanɛ b baa boŋ nshɛ nɛ ewura Deevid nɛ anebi Asaf daŋ sibɛ n nase na. B ka bee boŋ amo nɛ ekama be kagbene fuli nɛ b gbir m bunyaŋ Ebɔrɛ.

english_verse: Hezekiah said to the crowd, “Now that you are once again acceptable to the Lord, bring sacrifices and offerings to give him thanks.” The people did this, and some of them voluntarily brought animals to be offered as sacrifices.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ ewura Hɛzekaya kaŋɛ basa na le: “Naniere bre men ka nyalɛ so daŋkare be ekpa so ere, men ta men be kabɔrɛchɔrɔ be esarga m ba sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ.” Nɛ basa na wora loŋ, nɛ bumo be beko malɛ bar asɔbɔya m ba lara sarga chɔɔso bumo be keparso nɛ esa kama maŋ bishi bumo.

english_verse: There were not enough priests to skin all these animals, because many of the priests had not taken the time to go through the ceremony to make themselves clean. However, since all the Levites had made themselves clean, they helped the priests until the last animal was skinned.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal bɔrɛmatapoana ka daa maŋ shibi nɛ b bɛ asɔbɔya na so, Livaiebi na e daŋ chɛ bumo to m bɛ asɔbɔya na kikɛ. Loŋ be jemanɛ na, nɛ Livaiebi damta tiŋ n fɔr bumo be amu so daŋkare be ekpa so nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana na bre be damta daa maŋ naŋ wora loŋ.

english_verse: Besides all the sacrifices that were burned on the altar, the fat from the other animal sacrifices was burned, and the offerings of wine were poured over the altar. So the temple was once again used for worshiping the Lord.
translation_verse: Kechɔɔ m mur be sarga na be buushi, bɔrɛmatapoana na be kushuŋ e daŋ naa la kebaachɔɔ sarga nɛ basa kɔ ekpa nɛ b ji na be nfɔ, nɛ kebaachulgi asɔnuuso nɛ a ti sarga chɔɔso so na a wurge bɔrɛsure na so. Amoso b daŋ naŋ fara kabɔrɛshuŋ nna ashi bɔrɛlambu to

english_verse: Hezekiah and the people of Judah celebrated, because God had helped them make this happen so quickly.
translation_verse: Ewura Hɛzekaya nɛ basa na kikɛ be ŋgbene daŋ fuli bumo nna ŋkpal Ebɔrɛ ka chɛ bumo to nɛ b wora loŋ be asheŋ na manaŋ manaŋ so.

english_verse: Everyone from Beersheba in the south to Dan in the north was invited. This was the largest crowd of people that had ever celebrated Passover, according to the official records.
translation_verse: B daŋ yili Dan be kasawule so be kelargato be esoso be kaba so nna n tre Israɛlebi na kikɛ n ya fo Bɛshiba be kelargato be kaseto be kaba so fanɛ b chala abar a chɔ kananɛ b daa chala abar na m ba Jerusalɛm m ba ji kebansonchoŋ be kejigboŋ na kananɛ mbra na ŋini na.

english_verse: Hezekiah's messengers went everywhere in Israel and Judah with the following letter: People of Israel, now that you have survived the invasion of the Assyrian kings, it's time for you to turn back to the Lord God our ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob worshiped. If you do this, he will stop being angry.
translation_verse: Ewura na nɛ mbe benimuana na daŋ shin nna nɛ mbɔ ta le be kubɔya ere n yɔ Juda nɛ Israɛl be efuli so kikɛ: “Menyi Israɛl be basa nɛ men nya men be amu saŋɛ so nɛ Asiriyaebi daŋ kɔ n sɔ kasawule ere na, e bɛta m ba Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ e la an nananyɛnana Eebraham nɛ Aizek nɛ Jeekɔb be Ebɔrɛ na kutɔ nɛ mo alɛ gba e sɔ menyi.

english_verse: Don't be stubborn like your ancestors. Decide now to obey the Lord our God! Come to Jerusalem and worship him in the temple that will belong to him forever. Then he will stop being angry,
translation_verse: Menyi ere e sa maŋ wora amu kpakpaso fanɛ kananɛ men nananyɛnana daŋ wora na, ama men baa nu a sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na. Men ba men Nyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be bɔrɛlambu cheembi nɛ k wɔ Jerusalɛm na to m ba bunyaŋ mo saŋɛ na so e maaŋ naŋ nya agbo n wɔtɔ menyi.

english_verse: and the enemies that have captured your families will show pity and send them back home. The Lord God is kind and merciful, and if you turn back to him, he will no longer turn his back on you.
translation_verse: Men baŋ bɛta m ba Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kutɔ, kumo ere basa kama nɛ b kɔ n sɔ men kurgepoana na beeŋ wu bumo kuwɔr nseŋ shin nɛ b naŋ bɛta m ba epe. Men Nyɛnpe men be Ebɔrɛ na la esa ga nsaa wu kuwɔr, amoso nɛ men baaŋ bɛta m ba mo kutɔ, mo alɛ gba beeŋ sɔ menyi.”

english_verse: Only a few people from the tribes of Asher, West Manasseh, and Zebulun were humble and went to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ama amo nɛ amo kikɛ, eyiri nɛ b daa shi Ashɛr nɛ Manase nɛ Zɛbyulɔn be kaba so na be basa ko bre daa sha keba Jerusalɛm nna.

english_verse: In the second month, a large crowd of people gathered in Jerusalem to celebrate the Festival of Thin Bread.
translation_verse: Basa damta daŋ ba shɛr Jerusalɛm kufɔl nyɔsopo na to nna nɛ b ji bodobodo nɛ a maŋ kɔ yiisi na be kejigboŋ na.

english_verse: They took all the foreign altars and incense altars in Jerusalem and threw them into Kidron Valley.
translation_verse: B daŋ lara efuli pɔtɛana so be ebɔrɛsure nɛ b daa lara esarga nsaa chɔɔ eduwu amo so na nna n lɛ Kidrɔn be ketaŋɛ na to.

english_verse: Most of the people that came from Ephraim, West Manasseh, Issachar, and Zebulun had not made themselves clean, but they ignored God's Law and ate the Passover lambs anyway. Hezekiah found out what they had done and prayed, “Lord God, these people are unclean according to the laws of holiness. But they are worshiping you, just as their ancestors did. So, please be kind and forgive them.”
translation_verse: E yɛ: “O! Enyɛnpe an nananyɛnana be Ebɔrɛ nɛ fo walɛ, ta bekama nɛ baa shuŋ fo nɛ kagbene koŋwule na be alubi m paŋ bumo, hale b ka maŋ walɛ so daŋkare be ekpa so kikɛ ere gba.”

english_verse: The worshipers in Jerusalem were very happy and celebrated the Festival for seven days. The Levites and priests sang praises to the Lord every day and played their instruments.
translation_verse: Basa nɛ b daŋ ba shɛr Jerusalɛm na daŋ ta nchɛ ashunu nna n ji bodobodo nɛ a maŋ kɔ yiisi be kejigboŋ na kagbenefuliso nɛ Livaiebi na nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana na bee boŋ nshɛ nsaa laŋ alaŋsɔ a di Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ epaŋ karechɛ kikɛ.

english_verse: Hezekiah thanked the Levites for doing such a good job, leading the celebration. The worshipers celebrated for seven days by offering sacrifices, by eating the sacred meals, and by praising the Lord God of their ancestors.
translation_verse: Ewura Hɛzekaya daŋ chɔrɔ Livaiebi na nna ŋkpal kenyi nɛ b daa kɔ a juŋkpar basa nɛ baa bunyaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na so. Kejigboŋ nyɔsopo na be asheŋ Nchɛ ashunu nɛ b ta n lara sarga n di Enyɛnpe bumo nananyɛnana be Ebɔrɛ na epaŋ na be kaman,

english_verse: Everyone was very happy, including those from Judah and Israel, the priests and Levites, and the foreigners living in Judah and Israel.
translation_verse: Amoso Judaebi na nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana na, nɛ Livaiebi na, nɛ Israɛlebi na, nɛ befɔ nɛ b wɔ Israɛl nɛ Juda be efuli so kikɛ be ŋgbene daŋ fuli bumo nna.

english_verse: It was the biggest celebration in Jerusalem since the days of King Solomon, the son of David.
translation_verse: Kagbenefuli daŋ baa wɔ Jerusalɛm kikɛ to nna, ŋkpal manɛ so yili ewura Deevid pibinyɛn, ewura Sɔlɔmɔn be jemanɛ so kikɛ, loŋ be asheŋ maŋ naŋ wora kikɛ.

english_verse: The priests and Levites asked God to bless the people, and from his home in heaven, he did.
translation_verse: Bɔrɛmatapoana na nɛ Livaiebi na daŋ kule Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be nɛfa nna n sa basa na, nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na shi esoso n nu bumo be kekule.

english_verse: Hezekiah divided the priests and Levites into groups, according to their duties. Then he assigned them the responsibilities of offering sacrifices to please the Lord and sacrifices to ask his blessing. He also appointed people to serve at the temple and to sing praises at the temple gates.
translation_verse: Ewura Hɛzekaya daŋ naŋ lɔŋɛ nna n yili bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ Livaiebi na be ntuŋ nɛ ashuŋ nɛ baa shuŋ. Ashuŋ na be ako e la kebaalara esarga chɔɔso nɛ kɔnɔkoŋwule be esarga nɛ kebaabunyaŋ Ebɔrɛ nɛ kebaadi Ebɔrɛ epaŋ nsaa juŋkpar kabɔrɛchɔrɔ ashi bɔrɛlambu na to.

english_verse: The official records also included their wives and children, because they had also been faithful in keeping themselves clean and acceptable to serve the Lord.
translation_verse: B daŋ sibɛ bumo nɛ bumo be beche nɛ mbia nɛ basa kama nɛ b wɔ bumo kutɔ kikɛ be atre nna nase, ŋkpal manɛ so bumo alɛ gba daga fanɛ b baa du cheembi nna nsaa beeŋ tiŋ n shuŋ loŋ be kushuŋ na saŋkikɛ.

english_verse: He told the people of Jerusalem to bring the offerings that were to be given to the priests and Levites, so that they would have time to serve the Lord with their work.
translation_verse: E daŋ kaŋɛ Jerusalɛm be basa nna fanɛ b baa ta esarga nɛ baa lara a sa bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ Livaiebi na n sa bumo, saŋɛ na so baaŋ nya saŋɛ nɛnɛ a shuŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be kushuŋ na.

english_verse: After the Festival, the people went to every town in Judah and smashed the stone images of foreign gods and cut down the sacred poles for worshiping the goddess Asherah. They destroyed all the local shrines and foreign altars in Judah, as well as those in the territories of Benjamin, Ephraim, and West Manasseh. Then everyone went home. Offerings for the Priests and Levites
translation_verse: Kejigboŋ na ka loge, nɛ Israɛlebi na yɔ Juda be efuli so be kade kikɛ to, n ya bure ndoŋ be ajembu be eshabɔrɛ nɛ kegbirche Ashira be mpɔrduli be ndibi n lɛ nseŋ mur ndoŋ be ebɔrɛsure nɛ kakpa nɛ nnyamase bee shuŋ bumo be agbirana na kikɛ. B daŋ wora loŋ nna ashi Juda be efuli so kikɛ nɛ Bɛnjamin nɛ Efrayim nɛ Manase be kaba so kikɛ. Kumo be kaman nɛ b bɛta n yɔ epe.

english_verse: Hezekiah provided animals from his own herds and flocks to use for the morning and evening sacrifices, as well as for the sacrifices during the Sabbath celebrations, the New Moon Festivals, and the other religious feasts required by the Law of the Lord.
translation_verse: Ewura na daa lara mo gbagba be mbolpɔ nɛ ana nna a sa nɛ baa lara sarga chɔɔso kachipurso nɛ kaaseso kikɛ, nɛ kewushiachɛ be sarga nɛ kufɔl popɔr be kejigboŋ nɛ kabɔrɛshuŋ kikɛ be kejigboŋ be esarga nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be mbra ŋini fanɛ b baa lara na.

english_verse: As soon as the people heard what the king wanted, they brought a tenth of everything they owned, including their best grain, wine, olive oil, honey, and other crops.
translation_verse: Israɛlebi na ka baŋ nu loŋ, epul to nɛ b ta ayu nɛ asɔnuuso nɛ ɔlif be ŋku nɛ mushoŋ nɛ sososo be adɔjibiana be ŋkɛana nɛ bumo be kudukudusopo m ba.

english_verse: The people from the other towns of Judah brought a tenth of their herds and flocks, as well as a tenth of anything they had dedicated to the Lord.
translation_verse: Basa nɛ b daa wɔ Juda be nde nɛ a ka na to gba daŋ ta bumo be ana nɛ mbolpɔ be kudukudusopo nɛ ŋkɛ damta ko nna m ba sa Enyɛnpe bumo be Ebɔrɛ na.

english_verse: The people started bringing their offerings to Jerusalem in the third month, and the last ones arrived four months later.
translation_verse: Kafɛ to be kufɔl sasopo na to nɛ basa na fara a bar bumo be ŋkɛana nseŋ kɛ le hale afɔl ana kikɛ nɛ baa koli bumo be ŋkɛ abar so.

english_verse: When Hezekiah and his officials saw these offerings, they thanked the Lord and the people.
translation_verse: Ewura Hɛzekaya nɛ mbe benimuana ka wu kananɛ basa na sa na, nɛ b di Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ epaŋ nseŋ chɔrɔ Israɛlebi gba.

english_verse: Hezekiah asked the priests and Levites about the large amount of offerings.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ ewura na bishi bɔrɛmatapoana na nɛ Livaiebi na ŋkɛ na be asheŋ

english_verse: The high priest at the time was Azariah, a descendant of Zadok, and he replied, “Ever since the people have been bringing us their offerings, we have had more than enough food and supplies. The Lord has certainly blessed his people. Look at how much is left over!”
translation_verse: nɛ bɔrɛmatapo nimuso Azariya nɛ e la Zadɔk be kaman to ebi be esa na kaŋɛ mo le: “Baŋ yili saŋɛ so nɛ basa na fara a bar bumo be ŋkɛ bɔrɛlambu to na, an bee nya ajibi nna a ji yɛlyɛla so. An daa nya amo kikɛ nna ŋkpal Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ka nɛfa mbe basa so. Keni amo be amo nɛ a ka.”

english_verse: So the king gave orders for storerooms to be built in the temple, and when they were completed,
translation_verse: Nɛ ewura na shin nɛ b pɔr ebuana nɛ baaŋ ba ta asɔ a yili to ashi bɔrɛlambu na be kelɔnɛ na be ekarso,

translation_verse: E daŋ wora kulubi nna ŋ gbiti Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nseŋ kini kebar mbe kumu kaseto n nu anebi Jɛremaya be kubɔya nɛ k shi Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kutɔ na.

english_verse: King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia had forced Zedekiah to promise in God's name that he would be loyal. Zedekiah was stubborn and refused to turn back to the Lord God of Israel, so he rebelled against Nebuchadnezzar.
translation_verse: Ewura Zɛdikaya daŋ kini kenu n sa ewura Nebukadneeza nɛ e daŋ tintiŋ mo nɛ e bɔ Ebɔrɛ fanɛ e beeŋ bugi kagbene a shuŋ mo na nna. E daa kɔ kumu kpakpaso nna nseŋ kini kechɛrga m bɛta m ba Enyɛnpe Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na kutɔ.

english_verse: The people of Judah and even the priests who were their leaders became more unfaithful. They followed the disgusting example of the nations around them and made the Lord's holy temple unfit for worship.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Juda be basa nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana na wora alubi damta nɛ Ebɔrɛ kishi ga na. B daa shuŋ efuli pɔtɛana nɛ a chena m mata bumo na be agbirana nna, nsaa wora eyurpisheŋ a gbiti Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be bɔrɛlambu cheembi nɛ k wɔ Jerusalɛm to na.

english_verse: But the Lord God felt sorry for his people, and instead of destroying the temple, he sent prophets who warned the people over and over about their sins.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ e la bumo nananyɛnana be Ebɔrɛ na daa shuŋi anebiana nna, nɛ baa kpele bumo kusoe ŋkpal e ka daa maa sha kemur mbe basa nɛ mbe bɔrɛlambu nɛ e wɔ kumo to na so.

english_verse: But the people only laughed and insulted these prophets. They ignored what the Lord God was trying to tell them, until he finally became so angry that nothing could stop him from punishing Judah and Jerusalem. Jerusalem Is Destroyed (
translation_verse: Ama b daŋ kplaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be kamalga so nna nsaa wora mbe mbɔ nɛ e daa shuŋi bumo kutɔ na amɔmɔshiasheŋ nsaa mushe mbe anebiana na, hale nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be agbo kaa alegaiso nɛ shɛŋ maŋ naa wɔtɔ nɛ k sɔ basa na.

english_verse: Nebuchadnezzar's troops burned down the temple and destroyed every important building in the city. Then they broke down the city wall.
translation_verse: Ewura Nebukadneeza daŋ chɔɔ bɔrɛlambu na nɛ ewura be laŋ nɛ kade na kikɛ nna nseŋ da kumo be egbal n lɛ.

english_verse: In the first year that Cyrus was king of Persia, the Lord had Cyrus send a message to all parts of his kingdom. This happened just as Jeremiah the Lord's prophet had promised.
translation_verse: Pɛshiya be ewurgboŋ nɛ baa tre Sairus na be kuwurji be kafɛ juŋkparso to nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ e sibɛ kubɔya ere n wɔtɔ nwɔl to nseŋ chige nwɔl na n sa mbe efuli so kikɛ ebi nɛ b kraŋ nwɔl na awɔrso, saŋɛ na so kusɔ nɛ e bɔlɔ anebi Jɛremaya so m malga na beeŋ bɔlɔ so.

english_verse: King Cyrus gave back the things that Nebuchadnezzar had taken from the Lord's temple in Jerusalem and had put in the temple of his own gods.
translation_verse: Ade kikɛ be kaman, nɛ ewura Sairus bɛta echeenshi nɛ ekurwa nuunchu nɛ ewura Nebukadneeza daŋ ta bɔrɛlambu na to ashi Jerusalɛm n ya wɔtɔ mbe agbir be ebu to na n sa bumo.

english_verse: Cyrus placed Mithredath, his chief treasurer, in charge of these things. Mithredath counted them and gave a list to Sheshbazzar, the governor of Judah.
translation_verse: Mitrɛdat nɛ e daa la basa nɛ baa keta ewura be amansherbi be enimu na nɛ e shin nɛ e karga amo m bɔɔ Shɛshbaza nɛ e daa la Juda be efuli so be gomena na enɔ.

english_verse: Here is how many people returned whose ancestors had come from the following towns:
translation_verse: Sɛnaa ebi daa la basa ŋgboŋ asa nɛ alfa ashe nɛ adesa.

english_verse: Here is a list of how many returned from each family of priests:
translation_verse: Hiram be kaman to ebi daa la basa kagboŋ nɛ kudu ashunu.

english_verse: Here is a list of Solomon's servants whose descendants returned: Sotai, Hassophereth, Peruda, Jaalah, Darkon, Giddel, Shephatiah, Hattil, Pochereth Hazzebaim, and Ami.
translation_verse: Shefatiya be kaman to ebi nɛ Hatil be kaman to ebi nɛ Pokerɛf Hazabeem nɛ Ami be kaman to ebi.

english_verse: The families of Habaiah, Hakkoz, and Barzillai could not prove that they were priests. The ancestor of the family of Barzillai had married the daughter of Barzillai from Gilead and had taken his wife's family name. But the records of these three families could not be found, and none of them were allowed to serve as priests.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal bumo be asheŋ ka maŋ wɔ nwɔl to fanɛ b shi bɔrɛmatapoana be kabuna so, b daŋ maŋ sɔ bumo fanɛ bɔrɛmatapoana. Amoso b daa maŋ sa bumo ekpa fanɛ b shuŋ bɔrɛmatapoana be kushuŋ.

english_verse: In fact, the governor told them, “You cannot eat the food offered to God until we find out if you really are priests.”
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna Juwebi be gomena yili fanɛ b maŋ kɔ ekpa nɛ b ji ajibi nɛ b ta n lara sarga n sa Ebɔrɛ na n ya fo fanɛ bɔrɛmatapoana ka beeŋ ba bishi Ebɔrɛ m pin fanɛ b la bɔrɛmatapoana nna ŋko b maŋ la.

english_verse: When the people came to where the Lord's temple had been in Jerusalem, some of the family leaders gave gifts so it could be rebuilt in the same place.
translation_verse: Basa na ka fo kakpa nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be bɔrɛlambu na daa yil ashi Jerusalɛm to na nɛ nnaŋ be benimuana na bugi ŋgbene n lara keparso be esarga n sa fanɛ b ta n lɔŋɛ bɔrɛlambu na m pɔr n yili kumo be epul dra na to.

english_verse: During the seventh month of the year, the Israelites who had settled in their towns went to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Israɛlebi na daŋ ta afɔl ashunu nna n chena bumo be ndeana to n loge. Kumo be kaman nɛ bumo kikɛ ba shɛr Jerusalɛm to.

english_verse: The priest Joshua son of Jozadak, together with the other priests, and Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel and his relatives rebuilt the altar of Israel's God. Then they were able to offer sacrifices there by following the instructions God had given to Moses, the man of God.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Jozadak pibinyɛn Joshuwa nɛ mo braana bɔrɛmatapoana na nɛ Shɛɛltiɛl pibinyɛn, Zerubabel, nɛ mo kurgepoana fara nɛ b pɔr Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na be bɔrɛsure, saŋɛ na so baŋ tiŋ a lara esarga kumo so fanɛ kananɛ Mosis be mbra bee ŋini na.

english_verse: And they built the altar where it had stood before, even though they were afraid of the people who were already living around there. Then every morning and evening they burned sacrifices and offerings to the Lord.
translation_verse: Kufu nɛ k daa wɔ bumo to ŋkpal basa nɛ b kulti bumo na kikɛ be kaman, b daŋ pɔr bɔrɛsure na n yili kumo be gbaltɔlase dra na so nna. Kapa nɛ kanyɛ kikɛ b daa lara esarga bɔrɛsure na so nna a sa Ebɔrɛ.

english_verse: The people followed the rules for celebrating the Festival of Shelters and offered the proper sacrifices each day.
translation_verse: B daŋ ji Abuu to be kachɛgboŋ na nna fanɛ kananɛ mbra na bee ŋini na gbagba chap. Esarga nɛ a daga b lara karechɛ kama be kachipurso nɛ kaaseso kikɛ na nɛ b daŋ lara.

english_verse: They offered sacrifices to please the Lord, sacrifices at each New Moon Festival, and sacrifices at the rest of the Lord's festivals. Every offering the people had brought voluntarily was also presented to the Lord.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ b lara sarga chɔɔso nɛ k daga na malɛ gba. Bumo alɛ daŋ naŋ lara kufɔl popɔr be esarga nɛ esarga kama nɛ a daga fanɛ b baa lara nchɛgboŋ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na yili n sa bumo na kikɛ.

english_verse: Although work on the temple itself had not yet begun, the people started offering sacrifices on the Lord's altar on the first day of the seventh month of that year. The Rebuilding of the Temple Begins
translation_verse: Kufɔl shunusopo na be kachɛ juŋkparso na nɛ b fara sarga chɔɔso be kelara n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na, ama loŋ be jemanɛ na nɛ b maŋ naŋ tɔl Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be bɔrɛlambu na be gbaltɔlase gba. Bɔrɛlambu na be kelɔŋɛ m pɔr be asheŋ

english_verse: King Cyrus of Persia had said the Israelites could have cedar trees brought from Lebanon to Joppa by sea. So they sent grain, wine, and olive oil to the cities of Tyre and Sidon as payment for these trees, and they gave money to the stoneworkers and carpenters.
translation_verse: Ade kikɛ be kaman, nɛ basa na sa bepɔrpo nɛ ekapɛnta amansherbi nseŋ ta ajibi nɛ asɔnuuso nɛ ɔlif be ŋku n shuŋi n ya sa Sidɔnebi nɛ Tayɛebi fanɛ b ku sida be ndibi n yili Lebanɔn n ta amo m bɔla teku so m bar bumo ashi Jɔpa fanɛ kananɛ Pɛshiya be ewura, Sairus, kaŋɛ na.

english_verse: During the second month of the second year after the people had returned from Babylonia, they started rebuilding the Lord's temple. Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, Joshua son of Jozadak, the priests, the Levites, and everyone else who had returned started working. Every Levite over
translation_verse: Kafɛ nɛ Israɛlebi na ba Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be lambu na ase ashi Jerusalɛm to na be kufɔl nyɔsopo to nɛ Shɛɛltiɛl pibinyɛn, Zerubabel nɛ Jozadak pibinyɛn, Joshuwa nɛ bumo kurgepoana, nɛ b la bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ Livaiebi nɛ bekama nɛ b bɛta m ba Jerusalɛm to na, fara bɔrɛlambu na be kepɔr. B daŋ lara Livaiebi nɛ b fo nfɛ adunyɔ m baŋ so na nna fanɛ b baa keni kushuŋ na so.

english_verse: The Levites in charge of the whole project were Joshua and his sons and relatives and Kadmiel and his sons from the family of Hodaviah. The family of Henadad worked along with them.
translation_verse: Joshuwa nɛ mo bibinyɛn nɛ mo kurgepoana nɛ Kadmiɛl nɛ mo bibinyɛn, nɛ b la Hodaviya be kaman to ebi na, n ta Hɛnadad nɛ mo bibinyɛn nɛ mo kurgepoana nɛ bumo kikɛ shi Livai be kabuna na e daŋ ber abar so a keni basa nɛ baa pɔr Ebɔrɛ be lambu na so.

english_verse: When the builders had finished laying the foundation of the temple, the priests put on their robes and blew trumpets in honor of the Lord, while the Levites from the family of Asaph praised God with cymbals. All of them followed the instructions given years before by King David.
translation_verse: Bepɔrpo na ka baŋ tɔl Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be lambu na be gbaltɔlase na n loge, nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana ta bumo be epiŋi m buu nseŋ ta mbel nɛ Asaf be mbinyɛnso nɛ b la Livaiebi na malɛ ta edawuro, nɛ bekama yili bumo be eyilikpa nseŋ fara a boŋ nshɛ a kpaŋ Ebɔrɛ. Ŋkpal manɛ so, ketande nɛ ewura Deevid nase n sa bumo nna na.

english_verse: They praised the Lord and gave thanks as they took turns singing: “The Lord is good! His faithful love for Israel will last forever.” Everyone started shouting and praising the Lord because work on the foundation of the temple had begun.
translation_verse: Le be kapandi be kashɛ nɛ b daa boŋ a fur Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na: “Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na walɛ; Kasha nɛ e kɔ n sa Israɛl na maŋ kɔ ekar.” Ndoŋ nna nɛ basa na kikɛ fara a kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na awɔrso, ŋkpal b ka tɔl mbe lambu na be gbaltɔlase so.

english_verse: Many of the older priests and Levites and the heads of families wept bitterly because they remembered seeing the first temple years before. But others were so happy that they celebrated with joyful shouts.
translation_verse: Basa kpar nɛ b daa la bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ Livaiebi nɛ nnaŋ be benimuana na be galeŋga ka daa nyi kananɛ lambu dra na daa du so, b ka wu kepopɔr ere be gbaltɔlase na nɛ b shu awɔrso; ama beko bre daa wora awɔr kagbenefuliso nna.

english_verse: The enemies of the tribes of Judah and Benjamin heard that the people had come back to rebuild the temple of the Lord God of Israel.
translation_verse: Juda nɛ Bɛnjamin ebi be bedoŋ ka nu fanɛ Israɛlebi na bɛta m ba nɛ b ba lɔŋɛ Enyɛnpe, Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na be lambu m pɔr,

english_verse: So they went to Zerubbabel and to the family leaders and said, “Let us help! Ever since King Esarhaddon of Assyria brought us here, we have worshiped your God and offered sacrifices to him.”
translation_verse: nɛ b yɔ Zerubabel nɛ mbuna mbuna be benimuana na kutɔ n ya kaŋɛ le: “Men shin nɛ an chɛ menyi to n pɔr. Ŋkpal manɛ so, anyi nɛ menyi kikɛ bee shuŋ Ebɔrɛ koŋwule nna. Yili jemanɛ nɛ Asiriya be ewura, Esahadɔn, bar anyi kasawule ere so hale m ba fo kabre; menyi be Ebɔrɛ ere nɛ anyi alɛ gba bee shuŋ nsaa lara sarga a sa.”

english_verse: But Zerubbabel, Joshua, and the family leaders answered, “You cannot take part in building a temple for the Lord our God! We will build it ourselves, just as King Cyrus of Persia commanded us.”
translation_verse: Nɛ Zerubabel nɛ Joshuwa nɛ Israɛl be mbunaana na be benimuana na malɛ kaŋɛ bumo: “Anyi maa sha menyi be kechɛto ashi bɔrɛlambu na be kepɔr n sa Enyɛnpe anyi be Ebɔrɛ na to. Anyi nawule beeŋ tiŋ m pɔr kumo fanɛ kananɛ Pɛshiya be ewura, Sairus yili na.”

english_verse: Then the neighboring people began to do everything possible to frighten the Jews and to make them stop building.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Judaebi be bechenashapoana na fara a funti bumo a fin kananɛ baaŋ wora m pɔ Judaebi na aba nseŋ shin nɛ kufu a pɛ bumo nɛ b yige lambu na be kelɔŋɛ m pɔr.

english_verse: In the first year that Xerxes was king, the neighboring people brought written charges against the people of Judah and Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Kafɛ nɛ ewurgboŋ Zɛɛzɛs ji kuwura na nɛ basa nɛ b daa wɔ Juda nɛ Jerusalɛm to na be bedoŋ sibɛ kawɔl ŋ ku bumo kɔnɔ.

english_verse: Later, Bishlam, Mithredath, Tabeel, and their advisors got together and wrote a letter to Artaxerxes when he was king of Persia. It was written in Aramaic and had to be translated.
translation_verse: Pɛshiya be ewurgboŋ Atazɛzɛs be jemanɛ to gba, Bishlam nɛ Mitrɛdat nɛ Tabil nɛ bumo braana sibɛ kawɔl nna n sa ewurgboŋ Atazɛzɛs. Aramaik be ŋgbar to nɛ b daŋ sibɛ kumo.

english_verse: This letter said: Your Majesty King Artaxerxes, we are your servants from everywhere in Western Province, and we send you our greetings.
translation_verse: Ewurgboŋ Atazɛzɛs, fo nyɛrbi nɛ fo basa nɛ b chena lɔrgboŋ nɛ baa tre Yufreetes na be epeŋitɔrkpa be kasawule so na e naa sibɛ fo kawɔl ere:

english_verse: You should know that the Jews who left your country have moved back to Jerusalem and are now rebuilding that rebellious city. In fact, they have almost finished rebuilding the walls and repairing the foundations.
translation_verse: ‘Yiramu, anyee sha fo pin fanɛ Juwebi nɛ b shi fo kutɔ m ba anyi kutɔ nfe na yɔ Jerusalɛm nna n ya kaa lɔŋɛ kade lubi nɛ k maŋ kɔ kasonu na a pɔr. B tiŋ n fara a pɔr kumo be egbalana nsaa lɔŋɛ kumo be gbaltɔlaseana gba. K maaŋ chɛr baaŋ pɔr kumo n loge.

english_verse: You should also know that if the walls are completed and the city is rebuilt, the Jews won't pay any kind of taxes, and there will be less money in your treasury.
translation_verse: Yiramu, nɛ basa ere baŋ lɔŋɛ kade ere m pɔr nɛ kumo be egbalana kikɛ yili, kumo ere b maaŋ naŋ ka lampo ŋko toto kikɛ n sa ewura. Loŋ malɛ beeŋ shin nɛ ewura be kpanjawu to be amansherbi a duga so.

english_verse: We are telling you this, because you have done so much for us, and we want everyone to respect you.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal fo ka wɔ anyi a keni so nɛ anyi alɛ maa sha ewura ka ji nyɔmɔ so nɛ anyee sibɛ fo kawɔl ere na

english_verse: If you look up the official records of your ancestors, you will find that Jerusalem has constantly rebelled and has led others to rebel against kings and provinces. That's why the city was destroyed in the first place.
translation_verse: nɛ fo shin nɛ b keni fo nananyɛnana nɛ fo tutoana be nwɔl nɛ a dese na to. Feeŋ wu fanɛ le be kade ere la kade lubi nna nɛ k bee bar etɔrɔ bewura so. Kusɔ nɛ k bar kumo be kemur nna na.

english_verse: If Jerusalem is rebuilt and its walls completed, you will no longer have control over Western Province.
translation_verse: Yiramu, anyee sha fo baa nyi fanɛ nɛ b baŋ lɔŋɛ kade ere m pɔr, kumo ere shɛŋ maaŋ naa shi Yufreetes be epeŋitɔrkpa a ba fo kutɔ.’ ”

english_verse: After your letter was translated and read to me,
translation_verse: B daŋ kraŋ nseŋ kilgi kawɔl nɛ men sibɛ n shoŋi na n sa ma.

english_verse: I had the old records checked. It is true that for years Jerusalem has rebelled and caused trouble for other kings and nations.
translation_verse: Nɛ n shin nɛ b keni asheŋ na to nseŋ wu fanɛ kashenteŋ nɛ kade na la kade lubi dra dra kikɛ. B daa maa sa bewura kashuli. Bumo alɛ daa kɔ keŋkenshi nɛ kagbene kpakpaso ga.

english_verse: I want you to command the people to stop rebuilding the city until I give further notice.
translation_verse: Men sa basa na ebɔl fanɛ b yige kade na be kelɔŋɛ m pɔr na n ya fo fanɛ ŋ ka beeŋ naŋ sa bumo ekpa.

english_verse: Do this at once, so that no harm will come to the kingdom.
translation_verse: Men baa de so nsaa maaŋ ta kesheŋ ere m pɛl n shin nɛ ewura e paŋ mbe kepar.

english_verse: As soon as this letter was read, Governor Rehum, Secretary Shimshai, and their advisors went to Jerusalem and forced everyone to stop rebuilding the city. Work on the Temple Starts Again
translation_verse: B ka kraŋ ewurgboŋ Atazɛzɛs be kawɔl na n sa Rehum nɛ Shimshayi nɛ bumo braana na nɛ b wora manaŋ n ya tintiŋ Juwebi nɛ b wɔ Jerusalɛm to na fanɛ b yige kade na be kelɔŋɛ m pɔr.

english_verse: The Jews were forced to stop work on the temple and were not able to do any more building until the year after Darius became king of Persia.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ bɔrɛlambu na be kapɔr na shir n yili loŋ hale n ya fo Pɛshiya be ewurgboŋ Dariɔs be kuwurji be kafɛ nyɔsopo to.

english_verse: Then the Lord God of Israel told the prophets Haggai and Zechariah to speak in his name to the people of Judah and Jerusalem. And they did.
translation_verse: Heegai nɛ Iddo pibinyɛn, Zakareya, nɛ b daa la anebiana na daŋ bɔla Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ nɛ e bee keni bumo so na be ketre so nna m malga n sa Juwebi nɛ b daa wɔ Juda be efuli so nɛ Jerusalɛm to na.

english_verse: So Zerubbabel the governor and Joshua the priest urged the people to start working on the temple again, and God's prophets encouraged them.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ Shɛɛltiɛl pibinyɛn, Zerubabel, nɛ Jozadak pibinyɛn, Joshuwa, naŋ fara Ebɔrɛ be lambu na be kelɔŋɛ m pɔr ashi Jerusalɛm to, nɛ anebiana na daa chɛ bumo to.

english_verse: Governor Tattenai of Western Province and his assistant Shethar Bozenai got together with some of their officials. Then they went to Jerusalem and said to the people, “Who told you to rebuild this temple?
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ lɔrgboŋ nɛ baa tre Yufreetes na be epeŋitɔrkpa be kasawule so be gomena, Tatɛnayi, nɛ Shɛta Bozenayi nɛ bumo braana yɔ bumo kutɔ n ya bishi bumo le: “Wanɛ e sa menyi ekpa fanɛ men lɔŋɛ bɔrɛlambu ere m pɔr?”

english_verse: Give us the names of the workers!”
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ b bishi basa nɛ baa pɔr lambu na be atre.

english_verse: But God was looking after the Jewish leaders. So the governor and his group decided not to make the people stop working on the temple until they could report to Darius and get his advice.
translation_verse: Ama ŋkpal Ebɔrɛ ka daa keni Israɛl be benimuana na so so, Pɛshiya be benimuana na daŋ maŋ tiŋ n ju bumo kapɔr na be kushuŋ to. B daa sha kesibɛ kawɔl nna n sa ewurgboŋ Dariɔs nseŋ nu kusɔ nɛ e beeŋ kaŋɛ pɔɛŋ.

english_verse: which said: King Darius, we wish you the best!
translation_verse: “Yiramu, anyi be bunyaŋ be kechɔrɔ nde!
