english_verse: We went to Judah, where the temple of the great God is being built with huge stones and wooden beams set in the walls. Everyone is working hard, and the building is going up quickly.
translation_verse: Yiramu, anyee sha nna nɛ fo pin fanɛ an yɔ Juda be efuli so n ya wu fanɛ basa na bee lɔŋɛ a pɔr Ebɔrɛ Ewurgboŋ na be bɔrɛlambu na. Ajembu gbɛgbɛso nɛ ndibi gbɛgbɛso nɛ b kɔ a pɔr kumo. Kenishipereso nɛ baa pɔr kumo, amoso kushuŋ na bee yɔ manaŋ manaŋ nna a sa bumo.

english_verse: We asked those in charge to tell us who gave them permission to rebuild the temple.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ an bishi benimuana na fanɛ wanɛ e sa bumo ekpa fanɛ b lɔŋɛ bɔrɛlambu na m pɔr?

english_verse: We also asked for the names of their leaders, so that we could write them down for you.
translation_verse: Anyi alɛ naŋ bishi m pin bumo be bejuŋkparpo be atre, saŋɛ na so anyeeŋ sibɛ amo n chise fo.

english_verse: They claimed to be servants of the God who rules heaven and earth. And they said they were rebuilding the temple that was built many years ago by one of Israel's greatest kings.
translation_verse: Ama kusɔ nɛ b kaŋɛ nde: ‘Anyi ere la Ebɔrɛ nɛ esoso nɛ kasawule kikɛ la mo peya na be anya nna. Bɔrɛlambu nɛ Israɛl be ewurgboŋ ko daŋ pɔr nfɛ damta nɛ a choŋ na nɛ anyee lɔŋɛ a pɔr.

english_verse: We were told that their people had made God angry, and he let them be captured by Nebuchadnezzar, the Babylonian king who took them away as captives to Babylonia. Nebuchadnezzar tore down their temple,
translation_verse: Ŋkpal an tutoana ka daŋ wora n da Ebɔrɛ nɛ e wɔ esoso na so so, e daŋ nya agbo nna nseŋ shin nɛ Babilɔn be Ewurgboŋ, Nebukadneeza, nɛ e shi Chaldian, ba kɔ m pɔɔ bumo so. Kumo be kaman nɛ Nebukadneeza pɛ bumo anya n yɔ Babilɔn be efuli so.

english_verse: took its gold and silver articles, and put them in the temple of his own god in Babylon. They also said that during the first year Cyrus was king of Babylonia, he gave orders for God's temple to be rebuilt in Jerusalem where it had stood before. So Cyrus appointed Sheshbazzar governor of Judah and sent these gold and silver articles for him to put in the temple.
translation_verse: E ka ta amo n sa Shɛɛshbaza na nɛ e kaŋɛ fanɛ e ta asɔ ere n ya wɔtɔ bɔrɛlambu nɛ k wɔ Jerusalɛm na to; nseŋ lɔŋɛ Ebɔrɛ be lambu na m pɔr n yili kumo be epul dra na gbagba to.

english_verse: Sheshbazzar then went to Jerusalem and laid the foundation for the temple, and the work is still going on.
translation_verse: Nɛ Shɛɛshbaza ba tɔl bɔrɛlambu na be gbaltɔlase. Yili loŋ be jemanɛ na m ba fo kabre, kapɔr na bee pɔr gbrɛgbrɛbi nna. K maŋ naŋ loge bre.

english_verse: Your Majesty, please order someone to look up the old records in Babylonia and find out if King Cyrus really did give orders to rebuild God's temple in Jerusalem. We will do whatever you think we should.
translation_verse: Yiramu, nɛ fee sha, fo shin nɛ b keni Babilɔn be bewura be adrasheŋ be nwɔl to, feeŋ wu fanɛ kashenteŋ nɛ ewurgboŋ Sairus daŋ sa ekpa fanɛ b lɔŋɛ Ebɔrɛ be lambu na m pɔr ashi Jerusalɛm to. Kumo be kaman nɛ ewura e shin nɛ an nu kusɔ nɛ e bee sha demu ere to.’ ”

english_verse: King Darius ordered someone to go through the old records kept in Babylonia.
translation_verse: Nɛ Ewurgboŋ Dariɔs kaŋɛ fanɛ b keni Babilɔn be bewura be adrasheŋ be nwɔl to, nɛ b wora loŋ.

english_verse: Finally, a scroll was found in Ecbatana, the capital of Media Province, and it said: This official record will show
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ b wu kawɔl ko ashi Midia be efuli so be kadegboŋ nɛ baa tre Ɛkbatana na. Kubɔya nɛ k daa wɔ kawɔl na to nde:

english_verse: Then the gold and silver things that Nebuchadnezzar took from the temple and brought to Babylonia are to be returned to their proper places. King Darius Orders the Work To Continue
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ b bɛta shuwa nɛ gbiti be asɔ nɛ ewura Nebukadneeza sulɔ n shi bɔrɛlambu nɛ k wɔ Jerusalɛm to n yɔ Babilɔn be efuli so na kikɛ n yɔ amo be mboŋ ashi bɔrɛlambu na to.” Ewura Dariɔs ka sa kɔnɔ fanɛ kushuŋ na e naŋ fara be asheŋ

english_verse: And don't fail to let the priests in Jerusalem have whatever they need each day so they can offer sacrifices to the God of heaven. Give them young bulls, rams, sheep, as well as wheat, salt, wine, and olive oil.
translation_verse: Karechɛ kikɛ, men baa sa bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ b wɔ Jerusalɛm to na asɔ fanɛ egbolu nɛ ekpakpa nɛ ekpakpafɔlbi nɛ ayu nɛ nfɔl nɛ yabra belbelso nɛ ɔlif be ŋku nɛ b kaŋɛ fanɛ baa sha nɛ b ta n lara sarga n sa Ebɔrɛ nɛ e wɔ ebɔrɛso na kikɛ.

english_verse: I want them to be able to offer pleasing sacrifices to God and to pray for me and my family.
translation_verse: Loŋ e naŋ shin nɛ b lara esarga nɛ a beeŋ par Ebɔrɛ nɛ mo alɛ e nɛfa ma nɛ ma kaman to ebi kikɛ.

english_verse: If any of you don't obey this order, a wooden beam will be taken from your house and sharpened on one end. Then it will be driven through your body, and your house will be torn down and turned into a garbage dump.
translation_verse: Ma, ewura, bee yili kumo nna fanɛ esa kama nɛ e chɛrga ma kamalga ere, meeŋ shin nɛ b pee mbe ebu be keyɔri nseŋ shɛl kumo n da mo n futi m bɔl. Kumo be kaman nɛ b bure mbe kowu na kikɛ nɛ k ki kelambure.

english_verse: I ask the God who is worshiped in Jerusalem to destroy any king or nation who tries either to change what I have said or to tear down his temple. I, Darius, give these orders, and I expect them to be followed carefully. The Temple Is Dedicated
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ nɛ mbe ketre deŋ Jerusalɛm be bɔrɛlambu na so na malɛ e mur ewura kama ŋko basa kama nɛ baaŋ chɛrga kusɔ nɛ n yili ere ŋko n fin bɔrɛlambu ere be kejija. Kusɔ nɛ ma, ewura Dariɔs yili nna na. Ekama daga fanɛ e nuu nseŋ bɛ kumo so.”

english_verse: With great success the Jewish leaders continued working on the temple, while Haggai and Zechariah encouraged them by their preaching. And so, the temple was completed at the command of the God of Israel and by the orders of kings Cyrus, Darius, and Artaxerxes of Persia.
translation_verse: Juwebi be bejuŋkparpo na daŋ wora asɔ ga ashi bɔrɛlambu na be kepɔr na to. Bumo alɛ daŋ naa nya keleŋto ashi anebi Heegai nɛ Zakareya, nɛ e shi Iddo be kanaŋ to na be keŋini to. Kananɛ Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ bɔla Pɛshiya be bewura fanɛ Sairus nɛ Dariɔs nɛ Atazɛzɛs so ŋ ŋini bumo kananɛ e bee sha bɔrɛlambu na gbagba chap nɛ b daŋ pɔr kumo.

english_verse: On the third day of the month of Adar in the sixth year of the rule of Darius, the temple was finished.
translation_verse: Ewurgboŋ Dariɔs ka ji kuwura be kafɛ shesopo be kufɔl nɛ Juwebi bee tre Ada na be nchɛ asa to nɛ b pɔr bɔrɛlambu na n loge. Ada la Hibruwebi be kafɛ to be kufɔl kuduanyɔsopo nna.

english_verse: The people of Israel, the priests, the Levites, and everyone else who had returned from exile were happy and celebrated as they dedicated God's temple.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ Israɛlebi na, bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ Livaiebi nɛ bekama nɛ b bɛta m ba na kikɛ, be ŋgbene fuli bumo ga nɛ b ta bɔrɛlambu na m bɔɔ Ebɔrɛ enɔ.

english_verse: One hundred bulls, two hundred rams, and four hundred lambs were offered as sacrifices at the dedication. Also twelve goats were sacrificed as sin offerings for the twelve tribes of Israel.
translation_verse: Kachɛ nɛ b ta bɔrɛlambu na m bɔɔ Ebɔrɛ enɔ na, egbolu kalfa nɛ ekpakpa alfa anyɔ nɛ mbolpɔ alfa ana nɛ b ta n lara sarga n sa Ebɔrɛ. B daŋ mɔ mboe kudu anyɔ nna n lara sarga ŋ kule alubi be ketampaŋ n sa Israɛl be nnaŋ kudu anyɔ na kikɛ.

english_verse: Then the priests and Levites were assigned their duties in God's temple in Jerusalem, according to the instructions Moses had written. The Passover
translation_verse: B daŋ ŋini bɔrɛmatapoana na nɛ Livaiebi na ashuŋ nɛ baŋ baa shuŋ bɔrɛlambu na to ashi Jerusalɛm to fanɛ kananɛ anebi Mosis be mbra bee ŋini na nna. Kebansonchoŋ be kejigboŋ na be asheŋ

english_verse: Everyone who had returned from exile celebrated Passover on the fourteenth day of the first month.
translation_verse: Juwebi be kebɛta m ba na be kufɔl juŋkparso na to be nchɛ kudu ana na nɛ b ji kebansonchoŋ be kejigboŋ na.

english_verse: The priests and Levites had gone through a ceremony to make themselves acceptable to lead in worship. Then some of them killed Passover lambs for those who had returned, including the other priests and themselves.
translation_verse: Bɔrɛmatapoana na nɛ Livaiebi na daŋ fɔr bumo be amu so daŋkare be ekpa so nna, nɛ kulubi kikɛ daŋ maŋ naŋ gbiti bumo. Nɛ Livaiebi na mɔ kebansonchoŋ be asɔbɔya na n sa bumo kurgepoana nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ bumo gbagba.

english_verse: The sacrifices were eaten by the Israelites who had returned and by the neighboring people who had given up the sinful customs of other nations in order to worship the Lord God of Israel.
translation_verse: Basa nɛ b chena m mata Israɛlebi na nseŋ lara bumo be amu ashi nnyamase nɛ bumo be agbirsheŋ to nseŋ ta bumo be amu n sa Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na e tu Israɛlebi na n ji kejigboŋ na.

english_verse: For seven days they celebrated the Festival of Thin Bread. Everyone was happy because the Lord God of Israel had made sure that the king of Assyria would be kind to them and help them build the temple.
translation_verse: Nchɛ ashunu nɛ baa ji bodobodo nɛ k maŋ kɔ yiisi na be kejigboŋ na kagbenefuliso Bumo be ŋgbene daŋ fuli bumo nna ŋkpal Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ka chɛrga Asiriya be ewura be kagbene nseŋ shin nɛ e chɛ bumo to nɛ b lɔŋɛ Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ be bɔrɛlambu na m pɔr so.

english_verse: Much later, when Artaxerxes was king of Persia, Ezra came to Jerusalem from Babylonia. Ezra was the son of Seraiah and the grandson of Azariah. His other ancestors were Hilkiah, Shallum, Zadok, Ahitub, Amariah, Azariah, Meraioth, Zerahiah, Uzzi, Bukki, Abishua, Phinehas, Eleazar, and Aaron, the high priest. Ezra was an expert in the Law that the Lord God of Israel had given to Moses, and the Lord made sure that the king gave Ezra everything he asked for.
translation_verse: Ɛzra daŋ shi Babilɔn be efuli so nna m ba Jerusalɛm. E daa la eŋinipo nɛ e daa nyi Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na be mbra nɛ e ta m bɔla Mosis so n sa mbe basa na ga nna. Ewura na daŋ sa Ɛzra kusɔ kama nɛ e daŋ kule mo na nna ŋkpal Ebɔrɛ be nɛfa ka daa wɔ mo so so.

english_verse: Other Jews, including priests, Levites, musicians, the temple guards, and servants, came to Jerusalem with Ezra. This happened during the seventh year that Artaxerxes was king.
translation_verse: Ewurgboŋ Atazɛzɛs ka ji kuwura be kafɛ shunusopo to nɛ Israɛlebi na nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana na nɛ Livaiebi na nɛ nshɛbompoana na nɛ mbunagboŋ kenipoana na nɛ bɔrɛlambu to be beshumpo na kikɛ shi Babilɔn be efuli so m bɛta m ba Jerusalɛm to.

english_verse: God helped Ezra, and he arrived in Jerusalem on the first day of the fifth month of that seventh year, after leaving Babylonia on the first day of the first month.
translation_verse: Kufɔl juŋkparso na be kachɛ juŋkparso na nɛ e daŋ koso Babilɔn be efuli so nseŋ ba fo Jerusalɛm kufɔl nusopo na be kachɛ juŋkparso. Ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ be kuwɔr wu be nɛfa daa wɔ anebi Ɛzra so nna.

english_verse: Ezra was a priest and an expert in the laws and commands that the Lord had given to Israel. One day King Artaxerxes gave Ezra a letter which said:
translation_verse: Kawɔl nɛ ewurgboŋ Atazɛzɛs sibɛ n ta m bɔɔ Ɛzra nɛ e daa la bɔrɛmatapo nɛ eŋinipo nsaa nyi Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be atande nɛ e ta n sa Israɛlebi na nde:

english_verse: Greetings from the great King Artaxerxes to Ezra the priest and expert in the teachings of the God of heaven.
translation_verse: “Ma, ewurgboŋ Atazɛzɛs, e naa sibɛ kawɔl ere a sa fo, Ɛzra, nɛ fo la bɔrɛmatapo nɛ Ebɔrɛ nɛ e wɔ ebɔrɛso na be mbra ŋinipo na. Fo kechɔrɔ nde!

english_verse: Any of the people of Israel or their priests or Levites in my kingdom may go with you to Jerusalem if they want to. My seven advisors and I agree that you may go to Jerusalem and Judah to find out if the laws of your God are being obeyed.
translation_verse: Ma, ewura nɛ ma ejinatopo ashunu, e naa shuŋi fo fanɛ fo ya keni Judiya nɛ Jerusalɛm be efuli so be asheŋ to a laŋɛ fo Ebɔrɛ be mbra nɛ e ta m bɔɔ fo enɔ na be kaplɛa so.

english_verse: When you go, take the silver and gold that I and my advisors are freely giving to the God of Israel, whose temple is in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Fo alɛ kaŋ yɔ fo ta shuwa nɛ egbiti nɛ ma nɛ ma ejinatopoana ta n sa Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ nɛ mbe lambu wɔ Jerusalɛm to na a yɔ.

english_verse: Take the silver and gold that you collect from everywhere in Babylonia. Also take the gifts that your own people and priests have so willingly contributed for the temple of your God in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ta shuwa nɛ egbiti nɛ baaŋ sa fo ashi Babilɔn be efuli so na nɛ esarga nɛ basa na nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana na beeŋ lara a laŋɛ bɔrɛlambu na be kaplɛa so na gba n ti so.

english_verse: Use the money carefully to buy the best bulls, rams, lambs, grain, and wine. Then sacrifice them on the altar at God's temple in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ya ta amansherbi na be ako n tɔ egbolu nɛ ekpakpa nɛ mbolpɔ nseŋ ta ako malɛ n tɔ ajibi nɛ asɔnuuso n lara sarga bɔrɛsure nɛ k wɔ Ebɔrɛ be lambu nɛ k wɔ Jerusalɛm na so.

english_verse: If any silver or gold is left, you and your people may use it for whatever pleases your God.
translation_verse: Amansherbi nɛ a beeŋ ka na malɛ, fo nɛ fo kurgepoana Juwebi na beeŋ ta amo n wora kusɔ kama nɛ k daga nsaa par men be Ebɔrɛ na.

english_verse: Give your God the other articles that have been contributed for use in his temple.
translation_verse: Asɔ kama nɛ b ta n sa fo fanɛ fo ta n ya shuŋ Ebɔrɛ ashi bɔrɛlambu na to na, daga fanɛ fo ta amo n ya wora loŋ.

english_verse: If you need to get anything else for the temple, you may have the money you need from the royal treasury.
translation_verse: Kusɔ kama nɛ k daga fanɛ fo nya a laŋɛ Ebɔrɛ be bɔrɛlambu na be kepɔr be kaplɛa so, feeŋ tiŋ ŋ keni ewura be kpanjawu to n fin kumo.

english_verse: Ezra, you are a priest and an expert in the laws of the God of heaven, and I order all treasurers in Western Province to do their very best to help you.
translation_verse: Ma, ewurgboŋ Atazɛzɛs, e naa sa bekama nɛ baa keni Yufreetes be epeŋitɔrkpa be efuli so be amansherbi so na ebɔl fanɛ kusɔ kama nɛ Ɛzra, nɛ e la bɔrɛmatapo nɛ Ebɔrɛ be mbra na be eŋinipo na bee sha, b sa mo.

english_verse: They must provide whatever the God of heaven demands for his temple, so that he won't be angry with me and with the kings who rule after me.
translation_verse: Kusɔ kama nɛ Ebɔrɛ nɛ e wɔ ebɔrɛso na baŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ e bee sha, a daga fanɛ b wora kumo kananɛ e bee sha na manaŋ manaŋ n sa mo. Men sa maŋ shin e nya agbo n wɔtɔ ma ŋko bekama nɛ baaŋ ba ma kaman na.

english_verse: We want you to know that no priests, Levites, musicians, guards, temple servants, or any other temple workers will have to pay any kind of taxes.
translation_verse: A maŋ daga fanɛ b tu bɔrɛmatapoana na nɛ Livaiebi na nɛ beshɛbompo na nɛ mbunagboŋ kenipoana na nɛ bekama nɛ baa shuŋ bɔrɛlambu na to na kikɛ n sɔ toto be yiri kikɛ.

english_verse: Ezra, use the wisdom God has given you and choose officials and leaders to govern the people of Western Province. These leaders should know God's laws and have them taught to anyone who doesn't know them.
translation_verse: Ɛzra, ta kanyiasheŋ nɛ Ebɔrɛ sa fo na ŋ keni to n lara sheriajipoana nɛ demujipoana nɛ b baa keni to a ji asheŋ ashi Yufreetes be epeŋitɔrkpa be efuli so ndoŋ. A daga fanɛ b baa la basa nɛ b nyi fo Ebɔrɛ na be mbra na. Fo alɛ e naaŋ baa ŋini bekama nɛ b maŋ nyi amo na.

english_verse: Everyone who fails to obey God's Law or the king's law will be punished without pity. They will either be executed or put in prison or forced to leave their country, or have all they own taken away. Ezra Praises God
translation_verse: Esa kama nɛ e kini kewora m bɛ fo Ebɔrɛ na be mbra so ŋko ewura be mbra so daga luwu ŋko keju n lar efuli na so ŋko kesuge mbe kapetɛ kikɛ ŋko n ti amodoŋwura ebu be kasogberge nna.”

english_verse: Because King Artaxerxes was so kind, Ezra said: Praise the Lord God of our ancestors! He made sure that the king honored the Lord's temple in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Ɛzra kaŋɛ le: “Kemaŋkura e baa la an nananyɛnana be Ebɔrɛ na peya. Mo e sa ewura na le be nfɛra nɛ e ta bunyaŋ n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be lambu nɛ k wɔ Jerusalɛm na.

english_verse: God has told the king, his advisors, and his powerful officials to treat me with kindness. The Lord God has helped me, and I have been able to bring many Jewish leaders back to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Mo, Ebɔrɛ koŋwule, na be katiŋ to so nɛ ewura nɛ mbe benimu nɛ basa gboŋana na kikɛ wu ma kuwɔr nseŋ shin nɛ n nya le be ekpa ere na. N nyɛnpe nɛ ma Ebɔrɛ na so nɛ n nya kagbene n ta kenyɛn m malga n sa Israɛl be benimu kpakpaso nɛ b nu nseŋ bɛ ma so n yɔ Jerusalɛm na.”

english_verse: Artaxerxes was king of Persia when I led the following chiefs of the family groups from Babylonia to Jerusalem:
translation_verse: Israɛl be nnaŋ nɛ b daa wɔ kenyaya to ashi Babilɔn be efuli so nseŋ bɛ Ɛzra so m bɛta m ba Jerusalɛm na be benimu e daa la:

english_verse: Gershom of the Phinehas family; Daniel of the Ithamar family; Hattush son of Shecaniah of the David family; Zechariah and
translation_verse: Utai nɛ Zakɔɔ nɛ b shi Bigvai be kabuna na nɛ basa adushunu malɛ e daŋ ba. Ɛzra ka fin Livaiebi nɛ baaŋ baa shuŋ bɔrɛlambu na to be asheŋ

english_verse: I said to the priests: You belong to the Lord, the God of your ancestors, and these things also belong to him. The silver and gold were willingly given as gifts to the Lord.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ bumo le: “Menyi nɛ asɔ ere kikɛ ki asɔ cheembi nna n sa Enyɛnpe men nanaana be Ebɔrɛ na. Shuwa nɛ gbiti na kikɛ la kagbene koŋwule so be sarga nna nɛ an lara n sa Enyɛnpe men tutoana be Ebɔrɛ na.

english_verse: I brought everyone together by the river that flows to the town of Ahava where we camped for three days. Not one Levite could be found among the people and priests.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ n shɛr basa na kikɛ kabombi nɛ k bee shile a yɔ kade nɛ baa tre Ahava na nɛ an daŋ ji nchɛ asa ndoŋ na ase. Ŋ ka keni basa na nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana na to n daa maŋ wu Livaiebi bumo to.

english_verse: So I sent for the leaders Eliezer, Ariel, Shemaiah, Elnathan, Jarib, Elnathan, Nathan, Zechariah, and Meshullam. I also sent for Joiarib and Elnathan, who were very wise counselors.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ n shuŋi n tre Eliaza nɛ Ariɛl nɛ Shemaya nɛ Ɛlnatan nɛ Jarib nɛ Ɛlnatan nɛ Netan nɛ Zakareya nɛ Mɛshulam nɛ b daa la bejuŋkparpo na. Ma alɛ daŋ naŋ tre Jowarib nɛ Ɛlnatan nɛ b daa la basa nɛ b koya nsaa kɔ kenyi ga na nna.

english_verse: Then I sent them to Iddo, the leader at Casiphia, and I told them to ask him and his temple workers to send people to serve in God's temple.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ n shuŋi bumo Kasifiya be efuli so be enimu nɛ baa tre Iddo nɛ mo braana, nɛ b la bɔrɛlambu na to be beshumpo na, kutɔ fanɛ b sa anyi basa nɛ baaŋ baa shuŋ Ebɔrɛ be kushuŋ ashi bɔrɛlambu na to.

english_verse: God was kind to us and caused them to send a skillful man named Sherebiah, who was a Levite from the family of Mahli. Eighteen of his relatives came with him.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal Ebɔrɛ be kuwɔrwu ka daa wɔ anyi so so, Livainyɛn ko nɛ e shi Maali be kabuna nɛ baa tre mo Shɛribiya na nɛ b daŋ lara n sa anyi. E daa shuŋ ga. Mo nɛ mbe mbinyɛnsobi nɛ mo siponyɛnsoana kuduaburwa e daŋ ba.

english_verse: We were also sent Hashabiah and Jeshaiah from the family of Merari along with
translation_verse: Bumo alɛ daŋ naŋ shin nɛ Hashabia nɛ Jeshaya nɛ b shi Mɛrari be kabuna malɛ nɛ bumo kurgepoana adunyɔ gba ba.

english_verse: Beside the Ahava River, I asked the people to go without eating and to pray. We humbled ourselves and asked God to bring us and our children safely to Jerusalem with all of our possessions.
translation_verse: Ahava be kabombi na ase nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ a daga an kikɛ ka kishi nseŋ bar anyi be amu kaseto ashi Ebɔrɛ be anishito nseŋ kule mo nɛ e juŋkpar anyi nseŋ keni anyi nɛ anyi be mbia nɛ anyi be asɔ kikɛ so ashi anyi be enite to.

english_verse: So we went without food and asked God himself to protect us, and he answered our prayers. The Gifts for the Temple
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ an kishi ŋ kule Ebɔrɛ fanɛ e kuŋ anyi nɛ mo alɛ nu anyi be kekule.

english_verse: I chose twelve of the leading priests—Sherebiah, Hashabiah and ten of their relatives.
translation_verse: Nɛ ŋ keni bɔrɛmatapoana na to n lara Shɛribiya nɛ Hashabia nɛ bumo kurgepoana kudu ko n ti bumo so.

english_verse: Then I weighed the gifts that had been given for God's temple, and I divided them among the twelve priests I had chosen. There were gifts of silver and gold, as well as the articles that the king, his advisors and officials, and the people of Israel had contributed. In all there were:
translation_verse: nɛ shuwa be echeenshi adunyɔ, nɛ amo be yawu beeŋ fo fanɛ pɔŋ kagboŋ, nseŋ ta danyaŋ be echeenshi anyɔ, nɛ amo nɛ shuwa be echeenshi be yawu sasa na, n ti so n sa bumo.

english_verse: Be sure to guard them and keep them safe until you reach Jerusalem. Then weigh them inside God's temple in the presence of the chief priests, the Levites, and the heads of the Israelite families.
translation_verse: Men baa de amo so nɛnɛ hale nɛ men ya fo Jerusalɛm nseŋ karga amo m bɔɔ bɔrɛmatapoana na enɔ ashi bɔrɛmatapo nimuso na nɛ Livaiebi nɛ Israɛlebi be nnaŋ be benimu na kikɛ be anishito ashi bɔrɛlambu na to.”

english_verse: The priests and Levites then took charge of the gifts that had been weighed, so they could take them to the temple of our God in Jerusalem. The Return to Jerusalem
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana na nɛ Livaiebi na sɔ gbiti nɛ shuwa be asɔ n ta n yɔ bɔrɛlambu na to ashi Jerusalɛm. Kebɛta n yɔ Jerusalɛm be asheŋ

english_verse: On the twelfth day of the first month, we left the Ahava River and started for Jerusalem. Our God watched over us, and as we traveled along, he kept our enemies from ambushing us.
translation_verse: Kufɔl juŋkparso na be kachɛ kudu anyɔsopo na nɛ an fara n shi Ahava be kabombi na ase a yɔ Jerusalɛm. Anyi nɛ anyi be Ebɔrɛ e daa la nɛ e daa kuŋ anyi nɛ an doŋana maaŋ kuŋ anyi ekpa n tu anyi ŋ kɔ ŋko beyu e kuŋ anyi ekpa n suge anyi be asɔ.

english_verse: After arriving in Jerusalem, we rested for three days.
translation_verse: An ka ya fo Jerusalɛm nɛ an wushi nchɛ nsa.

english_verse: Then on the fourth day we went to God's temple, where the silver, the gold, and the other things were weighed and given to the priest Meremoth son of Uriah. With him were Eleazar son of Phinehas and the two Levites, Jozabad son of Jeshua and Noadiah son of Binnui.
translation_verse: Kachɛ nasopo na nɛ an yɔ bɔrɛlambu na to n ya karga gbiti nɛ shuwa nɛ echeenshi na kikɛ m bɔɔ Uriya pibinyɛn, Mɛremɔf, nɛ e daa la bɔrɛmatapo na enɔ. Mo nɛ Finihas pibinyɛn, Eliaza, nɛ Joshuwa pibinyɛn, Jozabad, nɛ Binuyi pibinyɛn, Nowadiya nɛ b la Livaiebi na e daa la.

english_verse: goats were sacrificed for the sins of the people.
translation_verse: Hakatan pibinyɛn, Johanan, nɛ e shi Azgad be kabuna nɛ basa kalfa nɛ kudu e daŋ ba;

english_verse: Some of those who had returned took the king's orders to the governors and officials in Western Province. Then the officials did what they could for the people and for the temple of God.
translation_verse: Bumo alɛ daŋ naŋ ta kawɔl nɛ ewura na sibɛ n sa fanɛ b ta m ba sa Yufreetes be epeŋitɔrkpa be efuli so be gomena nɛ ndoŋ be benimu na nna n ya sa bumo. Nɛ bumo alɛ gba chɛ Israɛlebi na nɛ bɔrɛlambu na be kushuŋ to ga.

english_verse: Later the Jewish leaders came to me and said: Many Israelites, including priests and Levites, are living just like the people around them. They are even guilty of some of the horrible sins of the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Jebusites, the Ammonites, the Moabites, the Egyptians, and the Amorites.
translation_verse: Asheŋ ere kikɛ ka wora n loge be kaman, nɛ Israɛlebi be bejuŋkparpo na ba kaŋɛ ma fanɛ basa na nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana na nɛ Livaiebi na kra maŋ lara bumo be amu ashi basa nɛ b chena ŋ kulti bumo na be asheŋ woraso lubi to. B ta bumo be amu n wɔtɔ Keenanebi nɛ Hitebi nɛ Pɛrizebi nɛ Jebusiebi nɛ Ammɔnebi nɛ Mowabebi nɛ Ijiptebi nɛ Amɔriebi be mbushusheŋ nɛ b daa wora to nna.

english_verse: Some Israelite men have married foreign women and have let their sons do the same thing. Our own officials and leaders were the first to commit this disgusting sin, and now God's holy people are mixed with foreigners.
translation_verse: Juwebi be benyɛn nɛ bumo be bibinyɛnsobiana daa ta eyiri pɔtɛana be mbichesobi nna a kil nɛ loŋ nɛ Ebɔrɛ be basa maŋ naa du cheembi. Israɛlebi be benimuana na e daŋ sɔ kumo be kejuŋkpar.

english_verse: This news made me so angry that I ripped my clothes and tore hair from my head and beard. Then I just sat in shock
translation_verse: Ŋ ka nu loŋ be kubɔya na nɛ kpɛa ma piŋi to nseŋ gberge ma kumu so nɛ katɔl be emin n tia nseŋ chena kagbenejija to.

english_verse: until the time for the evening sacrifice. Many of our people were greatly concerned and gathered around me, because the God of Israel had warned us to stay away from foreigners. Ezra's Prayer
translation_verse: Kagbenejija na to nɛ n chena loŋ hale n ya fo jemanɛ nɛ baa lara kaaseso be sarga na. Ndoŋ nna nɛ basa nɛ kufu kɔ bumo ŋkpal kusɔ nɛ Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ a laŋɛ alubi be kaplɛa so na ba shɛr ŋ kulti ma.

english_verse: At the time of the evening sacrifice, I was still sitting there in sorrow with my clothes all torn. So I got down on my knees, then lifted my arms,
translation_verse: Kaaseso be sarga be kelara be jemanɛ ka fo, nɛ n ta kagbenejija nɛ ma asɔ kpɛatoso na loŋ ŋ koso n ya gbir nseŋ maŋ ma enɔana so kabɔrɛkule to ŋ ŋini Enyɛnpe ma Ebɔrɛ na

english_verse: and prayed: I am much too ashamed to face you, Lord God. Our sins and our guilt have swept over us like a flood that reaches up to the heavens.
translation_verse: nseŋ kule Ebɔrɛ ŋ kaŋɛ: “O ma Ebɔrɛ, k kɔ ma nyɔmɔ nɛ anishinyɔr nna fanɛ ŋ ka beeŋ maŋ ma enɔ so fo anishito, ŋkpal manɛ so, anyi be alubi shi m baŋ anyi so hale n dii n ya fo ebɔrɛso gba kuraa.

english_verse: Since the time of our ancestors, all of us have sinned. That's why we, our kings, and our priests have often been defeated by other kings. They have killed some of us and made slaves of others; they have taken our possessions and made us ashamed, just as we are today.
translation_verse: Baŋ yili an nananyɛnana be jemanɛ so m ba fo kabre, anyi be alubi baa shi ga nna. Ŋkpal alubi na so, anyi nɛ anyi be bewura nɛ anyi be bɔrɛmatapoana kikɛ ki anya nna n sa efuli pɔtɛ so ebi nɛ baa mɔ anyi nsaa suge anyi be asɔ nseŋ naa pɛ anyi a yɔ kenyaya to. K shin nɛ an ji anishinyɔr ga nseŋ kra ji kumo kabre.

english_verse: But for now, Lord God, you have shown great kindness to us. You made us truly happy by letting some of us settle in this sacred place and by helping us in our time of slavery.
translation_verse: Ama, O Enyɛnpe anyi be Ebɔrɛ, jemanɛ gbrɛbi nɛ k choŋ ere fo wu anyi kuwɔr nseŋ shin nɛ anyi be beko kra wɔ ŋkpa to ashi fo kakpa cheembi ere. Fo lara anyi kenyaya to nseŋ sa anyi ŋkpa popɔr.

english_verse: We are slaves, but you have never turned your back on us. You love us, and because of you, the kings of Persia have helped us. It's as though you have given us new life! You let us rebuild your temple and live safely in Judah and Jerusalem.
translation_verse: An daa la anya nna, ama fo maŋ yige anyi kenyaya na to. Fo shin nɛ Pɛshiya be bewura wu anyi kuwɔr nseŋ shin nɛ an kraa wɔ ŋkpa to hale nɛ m ba nya ekpa nɛ an ba lɔŋɛ m pɔr fo bɔrɛlambu nɛ k daŋ ki kelambure a dese na. Kumo be kaman, an naŋ nya anyi be amu a wɔ Juda be efuli so nɛ Jerusalɛm be kade to.

english_verse: Our God, what can we say now? Even after all this, we have disobeyed the commands
translation_verse: O Ebɔrɛ, asheŋ nɛ a wora ere kikɛ be kaman, manɛ nɛ anyeeŋ naŋ kaŋɛ? Ŋkpal manɛ so, anyi maŋ wora m bɛ fo

english_verse: And we were warned not to let our daughters and sons marry their sons and daughters. Your prophets also told us never to help those foreigners or even let them live in peace. You wanted us to become strong and to enjoy the good things in the land, then someday to leave it to our children forever.
translation_verse: Anebiana na daŋ kaŋɛ anyi fanɛ nɛ anyee sha kenu kasawule na be ebel nseŋ ji kumo ŋ ka n yili anyi be kaman to ebi bre, an sa maŋ ta bumo be beche, ŋko ŋ kil bumo be benyɛn. B yɛ anyi alɛ e sa maŋ kaŋ ji bumo keteri, ŋko n shin nɛ b ji eleŋ anyi so.

english_verse: You punished us because of our terrible sins. But you did not punish us nearly as much as we deserve, and you have brought some of us back home.
translation_verse: Kusogberge nɛ k ba anyi so ŋkpal anyi be alubi so ere kikɛ be kaman, an wu fanɛ fo, anyi be Ebɔrɛ na, kraŋ shu anyi so nna. Ŋkpal manɛ so, mannɛ kasogberge nɛ k daga anyi nɛ fo sa anyi na. Fo kraŋ shin nɛ anyi to be beko kraa wɔ ŋkpa to.

english_verse: Why should we disobey your commands again by letting our sons and daughters marry these foreigners who do such disgusting things? That would make you angry enough to destroy us all!
translation_verse: Nɛ manɛ so, nɛ anyeeŋ naŋ kini kebɛ fo mbra na so nseŋ ya ta ŋko ŋ kil le be basa nɛ b wɔ eyurpisheŋ to ere? Nɛ an wora loŋ feeŋ nya agbo n wora anyi nseŋ mur anyi gba kuraa. Fo alɛ maaŋ naŋ shin nɛ anyi to be ekoŋwule gba e baa wɔ ŋkpa to.

english_verse: Lord God of Israel, you have been more than fair by letting a few of us survive. But once again, our sins have made us ashamed to face you.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ, kashenteŋ jipo e la fo. Fo maŋ shin nɛ an mur, ama fo shin nɛ an ji ŋkpa. Anyee shuli kewora n jija fo anishito nsaa nyi fanɛ an daa maŋ kɔ ekpa nɛ an ba fo anishito gba kuraa.”

english_verse: While Ezra was down on his knees in front of God's temple, praying with tears in his eyes and confessing the sins of the people of Israel, a large number of men, women, and children gathered around him and cried bitterly.
translation_verse: Anebi Ɛzra ka wɔ nɛ alubi be ketampaŋ be kabɔrɛkule to nsaa shu ŋkpal bumo be alubi damta nɛ b wora na so na, nɛ Israɛlebi be benyɛn nɛ beche nɛ mbia damta ko ba yili ŋ kulti mo ŋ wɔtɔ a shu kenishipereso.

english_verse: Shecaniah son of Jehiel from the family of Elam said: Ezra, we have disobeyed God by marrying these foreign women. But there is still hope for the people of Israel,
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Jehiɛl pibinyɛn, Shekanaya, nɛ e shi Elam be kabuna kaŋɛ anebi Ɛzra: “Anyi maŋ ji kashenteŋ n sa Ebɔrɛ ŋkpal befɔche nɛ an ta a kil ere so. Ama tama kra wɔtɔ n sa Israɛlebi.

english_verse: if we follow your advice and the advice of others who truly respect the laws of God. We must promise God that we will divorce our foreign wives and send them away, together with their children.
translation_verse: To, men shin nɛ an nase kɔnɔ fanɛ anyeeŋ yige loŋ be beche na nseŋ lara bumo nɛ bumo be mbia be asheŋ ashi anyi be asheŋ to nseŋ wora asheŋ fanɛ kananɛ fo nɛ bekama nɛ baa ŋana Ebɔrɛ bee kaa ji anyi asoe to a kaŋɛ na, saŋɛ na so anyeeŋ wora asheŋ m bɛ Ebɔrɛ be mbra na so.

english_verse: Ezra, it's up to you to do something! We will support whatever you do. So be brave!
translation_verse: Kusɔ kama bɔɔ fo enɔ nna na, amoso, koso to nɛ an pɛ fo kashɛr to. Baa kɔ kenyɛn nɛ kusɔ kama e nyalɛ.”

english_verse: Ezra stood up and made the chief priests, the Levites, and everyone else in Israel swear that they would follow the advice of Shecaniah.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ anebi Ɛzra koso n shin nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana be bejuŋkparpo nɛ Livaiebi be bejuŋkparpo kikɛ nase nnɔ fanɛ baaŋ wora kusɔ nɛ Shekanaya kaŋɛ na.

english_verse: Then Ezra left God's temple and went to spend the night in the living quarters of Jehohanan son of Eliashib. He felt sorry because of what the people had done, and he did not eat or drink a thing.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ e lar bɔrɛlambu na to n yɔ Eliyashib pibinyɛn, Jehohanan, be ebu to n ya ka wɔ ekishi to. Ajibi nɛ nchu daa maŋ beta mbe kɔnɔ, ŋkpal basa na ka maŋ ji kashenteŋ n sa Ebɔrɛ na so.

english_verse: The officials and leaders sent a message to all who had returned from Babylonia and were now living in Jerusalem and Judah. This message told them to meet in Jerusalem within three days, or else they would lose everything they owned and would no longer be considered part of the people that had returned from Babylonia.
translation_verse: Nseŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ esa kama nɛ e kini keba nshɛr na to nchɛ asa be kefɛato, beeŋ paŋ mbe asɔ kikɛ. Kumo ba kaman nɛ an lara mo ashi anyi to nɛ e maaŋ naa la anyi to be eko.

english_verse: Three days later, on the twentieth day of the ninth month, everyone from Judah and Benjamin came to Jerusalem and sat in the temple courtyard. It was a serious meeting, and they sat there, trembling in the rain.
translation_verse: Nchɛ nsa na ka fo, kumo e la fanɛ, kufɔl kpanusopo na be kachɛ kudu anyɔsopo na nɛ Juda nɛ Bɛnjamin be efuliana so ebi kikɛ ba shɛr bɔrɛlambu na ase. Ŋkpal nshɛr na ka la kenishipere n sa bumo so b daŋ kplaŋ bɔrɛ so nna nɛ gboŋgboŋi ko bri bumo hale nɛ baa gbugbo.

english_verse: Ezra the priest stood up and said: You have broken God's Law by marrying foreign women, and you have made the whole nation guilty!
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Ɛzra, nɛ e la bɔrɛmatapo na, koso n yili nseŋ kaŋɛ bumo: “Men maŋ ji kashenteŋ n sa Ebɔrɛ, ŋkpal manɛ so men ta befɔche a kil n shin nɛ Israɛl be alubi naŋ wora keshi n ti so.

english_verse: Now you must confess your sins to the Lord God of your ancestors and obey him. Divorce your foreign wives and don't have anything to do with the rest of the foreigners who live around here.
translation_verse: Amoso, men tuba n lar men be alubi to ashi men nananyɛnana be Ebɔrɛ na be anishito nseŋ fara a wora mbe aparsheŋ. Men lar basa pɔtɛ nɛ b wea men to ere be asheŋ to nseŋ yige befɔche nɛ men ta a kil na.”

english_verse: Everyone in the crowd shouted: You're right! We will do what you say.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ basa na kikɛ boŋ to awɔrso ŋ kaŋɛ: “Kashenteŋ nɛ fo ji! Anyeeŋ wora kusɔ nɛ fo kaŋɛ na.

english_verse: But there are so many of us, and we can't just stay out here in this downpour. A lot of us have sinned by marrying foreign women, and the matter can't be settled in only a day or two.
translation_verse: Ama basa nɛ b shɛr nfe ere shi ga nɛ bɔrɛ malɛ naa ba ŋkpal loŋ so anyi maaŋ tiŋ a yil kowushina loŋ. Kumo be kaman, kesheŋ na maaŋ la kachɛ koŋwule ŋko nchɛ nyɔ be kesheŋ nna. Ŋkpal manɛ so, basa nɛ b wora alubi na shi ga.

english_verse: Why can't our officials stay on in Jerusalem and take care of this for us? Let everyone who has sinned in this way meet here at a certain time with leaders and judges from their own towns. If we take care of this problem, God will surely stop being so terribly angry with us.
translation_verse: Men shin nɛ anyi be bejuŋkparpo a shir Jerusalɛm ŋ keni demu na to n sa anyi. Kumo be kaman, nɛ an yili kachɛ nɛ bekama nɛ b kɔ befɔche a kil na nɛ bejuŋkparpo na nɛ demujipoana na kikɛ e shɛr Jerusalɛm to nfe. Loŋ e naŋ shin nɛ Ebɔrɛ be agbo e wushi nseŋ lar anyi so ŋkpal demu ere so.”

english_verse: Jonathan son of Asahel and Jahzeiah son of Tikvah were the only ones who objected, except for the two Levites, Meshullam and Shabbethai.
translation_verse: Asahɛl pibinyɛn, Jonatan, nɛ Tikva pibinyɛn, Jeezia nawule e daa maŋ shuli m bɛ kamalga na so; nɛ Mɛshulam nɛ Shabetayi, nɛ e shi Livai be kabuna na, malɛ daa yil bumo be kaman.

english_verse: Everyone else who had returned from exile agreed with the plan. So Ezra the priest chose men who were heads of the families, and he listed their names. They started looking into the matter on the first day of the tenth month,
translation_verse: Ŋkpal galeŋga ka daŋ shuli n sa kamalga na so, Ɛzra, bɔrɛmatapo na, daŋ lara bejuŋkparpo na be beko nna n shin nɛ b sibɛ bumo be atre n nase. Kufɔl kudusopo na be kachɛ juŋkparso na nɛ b fara a keni asheŋ na to.

english_verse: and they did not finish until the first day of the first month of the next year. The Men Who Had Foreign Wives
translation_verse: Afɔl asa nɛ b ta ŋ keni bumo nɛ b daŋ ta befɔche a kil na be asheŋ to. Benyɛn nɛ b kɔ eyiri pɔtɛ be beche a kil be asheŋ

english_verse: Here is a list of the priests who had agreed to divorce their foreign wives and to sacrifice a ram as a sin offering: Maaseiah, Eliezer, Jarib, and Gedaliah from the family of Joshua son of Jozadak and his brothers;
translation_verse: Bumo kikɛ daŋ nase nnɔ nna fanɛ baaŋ yige eyiri pɔtɛ nɛ b kɔ a kil na. Kumo be kaman nɛ bumo be ekama na ta kpakpa n lara sarga ŋ kule alubi be ketampaŋ.

english_verse: Here is a list of the others from Israel who had foreign wives: Ramiah, Izziah, Malchijah, Mijamin, Eleazar, Hashabiah, and Benaiah from the family of Parosh;
translation_verse: Basa nɛ b shi Israɛl be mbuna nɛ a ka na nseŋ daa kɔ eyiri pɔtɛ a kil na malɛ e daa la Ramiya nɛ Iziya nɛ Malkija nɛ Mijamin nɛ Eleyaza nɛ Malkija nɛ Bɛnaya nɛ b shi Parosh be kabuna.

english_verse: Mattaniah, Zechariah, Jehiel, Abdi, Jeremoth, and Elijah from the family of Elam;
translation_verse: Bumo nɛ b shi Elam be kabuna malɛ e daa la Mataniya nɛ Zakareya nɛ Jehiɛl nɛ Abdi nɛ Jerɛmɔf nɛ Elaija.

english_verse: Elioenai, Eliashib, Mattaniah, Jeremoth, Zabad, and Aziza from the family of Zattu;
translation_verse: Bumo nɛ b shi Zaatu be kabuna e daa la Ɛliyonayi nɛ Ɛliyashib nɛ Mataniya nɛ Jerɛmɔf nɛ Zabad nɛ Aziza.

english_verse: Jehohanan, Hananiah, Zabbai, and Athlai from the family of Bebai;
translation_verse: Bumo nɛ b shi Bebaye be kabuna e daa la Jehohanan nɛ Hananiya nɛ Zabai nɛ Atlai.

english_verse: Meshullam, Malluch, Adaiah, Jashub, Sheal, and Jeremoth from the family of Bani;
translation_verse: Bumo nɛ b shi Bani be kabuna e daa la Meshulam nɛ Maluk nɛ Adaya nɛ Jashub nɛ Shɛal nɛ Jerɛmɔf.

english_verse: Adna, Chelal, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattaniah, Bezalel, Binnui, and Manasseh from the family of Pahath Moab;
translation_verse: Bumo nɛ b shi Pahaf Mowab be kabuna e daa la Adena nɛ Kɛlal nɛ Bɛnaya nɛ Maaseia nɛ Mataniya nɛ Bɛzalɛl nɛ Binuyi nɛ Manase.

english_verse: Mattenai, Mattattah, Zabad, Eliphelet, Jeremai, Manasseh, and Shimei from the family of Hashum;
translation_verse: Bumo nɛ b shi Hashum be kabuna e daa la Matɛnayi nɛ Matata nɛ Zabad nɛ Ɛlifɛlɛt nɛ Jerɛmayi nɛ Manase nɛ Shimeyi.

english_verse: Jeiel, Mattithiah, Zabad, Zebina, Jaddai, Joel, and Benaiah from the family of Nebo.
translation_verse: Bumo nɛ b shi Nebo be kabuna e daa la Jeyɛl nɛ Matitiya nɛ Zabad nɛ Zebina nɛ Jadayi nɛ Jowɛl nɛ Benaya.

english_verse: I am Nehemiah son of Hacaliah, and in this book I tell what I have done. During the month of Chislev in the twentieth year that Artaxerxes ruled Persia, I was in his fortress city of Susa,
translation_verse: Ma e la Nehemaya Hakalia pibinyɛn. Asheŋ nɛ n wora nɛ amo nɛ m malga nɛ n sibɛ n wɔtɔ kawɔl ere to na. Ewurgboŋ Atazɛzɛs ka ji kuwura Pɛshiya be efuli so be kafɛ adunyɔ to nɛ ma, Nehemaya daa wɔ kadegboŋ lempo nɛ baa tre Susa nɛ k la efuli na be kadegboŋ na to nna. Juwebi be kufɔl nɛ baa tre Kislɛv na to e daa la.

english_verse: when my brother Hanani came with some men from Judah. So I asked them about the Jews who had escaped from being captives in Babylonia. I also asked them about the city of Jerusalem.
translation_verse: N sipoana to be eko nɛ baa tre Hanani na daŋ keta benyɛn be katuŋ ko nna n shi Juda be efuli so m ba ndoŋ. Nɛ m bishi bumo Jerusalɛm be kade to nɛ ŋ kurgepoana Juwebi nɛ b shi Babilɔn nfe m bɛta n yɔ na be asheŋ.

english_verse: They told me, “Those captives who have come back are having all kinds of troubles. They are terribly disgraced, Jerusalem's walls are broken down, and its gates have been burned.”
translation_verse: Nɛ b kaŋɛ ma fanɛ basa nɛ b bɛta n yɔ Jerusalɛm na wɔ tɔrɔ nɛ awurfoŋ to nna. B yɛ Jerusalɛm be egbal na bure n tɔr nɛ kumo be mbunagboŋana na malɛ gba ji edɛ.

english_verse: When I heard this, I sat down on the ground and cried. Then for several days, I mourned; I went without eating to show my sorrow, and I prayed:
translation_verse: Ŋ ka nu loŋ nɛ n chena n shu nchɛ damta ŋkpal kumo so nseŋ kishi ŋ kule Ebɔrɛ ŋ kaŋɛ le:

english_verse: Lord God of heaven, you are great and fearsome. And you faithfully keep your promises to everyone who loves you and obeys your commands.
translation_verse: “O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ fo wɔ ebɔrɛso, fo e kɔ eleŋ ga nɛ fo bunyaŋ shi m baŋ so. Fo alɛ e naa wora a bɛ fo nnɔ naseso so a sa bekama nɛ baa sha fo nsaa wora fo mmalga kasonu.

english_verse: I am your servant, so please have mercy on me and answer the prayer that I make day and night for these people of Israel who serve you. I, my family, and the rest of your people have sinned
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, keni ma so nseŋ nu ma kekule ŋkpal kananɛ mee kule fo kapa nɛ kanyɛ ere a sa fo nyɛrbi Israɛlebi na so. N shuli fanɛ anyi Israɛlebi nɛ an nanaana kikɛ wora alubi ŋ gbiti fo.

english_verse: by choosing to disobey you and the laws and teachings you gave to your servant Moses.
translation_verse: Anyi alɛ maŋ naŋ wora fo mbra nɛ fo ta n sa an nananyɛn Mosis fanɛ e ta n sa anyi na gba kasonu.

english_verse: Please remember the promise you made to Moses. You told him that if we were unfaithful, you would scatter us among foreign nations.
translation_verse: Jande nyiŋi kusɔ nɛ fo kaŋɛ fo kayɛrbi Mosis na, fanɛ nɛ anyi Israɛlebi maŋ ji kashenteŋ n sa fo, kumo ere feeŋ pesaŋ anyi to n yɔ efuli pɔtɛana ko so.

english_verse: But you also said that no matter how far away we were, we could turn to you and start obeying your laws. Then you would bring us back to the place where you have chosen to be worshiped.
translation_verse: Ama nɛ fanɛ an bɛta m ba fo kutɔ nseŋ wora kusɔ nɛ fo nase n sa anyi na bre, hale nɛ an pesaŋ to n sɔ durnya ere be efuli kikɛ so gba, feeŋ naŋ bɛta anyi m ba kakpa nɛ fo daŋ yili kumo fanɛ an baa shuŋ fo na.

english_verse: Our Lord, I am praying for your servants—those you rescued by your great strength and mighty power.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, fo nyɛrbi nɛ fo gbagba be basa nna na. Ŋkpal manɛ so, fo gbagba be eleŋgboŋ nɛ fo ta m mɔlga bumo nɛ b baa la fo basa.

english_verse: Please answer my prayer and the prayer of your other servants who gladly honor your name. When I serve the king his wine today, make him pleased with me and let him do what I ask.
translation_verse: O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, nu ma nɛ fo nyɛrbi nɛ b kɔ kasha n sa fo nsaa ŋana fo ketre na be kabɔrɛkule. Chɛ ma to nɛ n nya kusɔ nɛ mee tama kabre ere nseŋ shin nɛ ewura malɛ gba e wu ma kuwɔr.” Loŋ be jemanɛ nɛ ma e daa duga ewurgboŋ Atazɛzɛs be yabra a sa mo nɛ e bee nuu.

english_verse: During the month of Nisan in the twentieth year that Artaxerxes was king, I served him his wine, as I had done before. But this was the first time I had ever looked depressed.
translation_verse: Juwebi be kufɔl nɛ baa tre Nisan na to nɛ ewurgboŋ Atazɛzɛs ka ji kuwura be kafɛ adunyɔ na to nɛ n ta yabra nɛ n ya sa mo. Mo alɛ daŋ maŋ naŋ wu ma anishiakpa ka chɛrga n duli esa nɛ mbe kagbenejija mo kikɛ.

english_verse: So the king said, “Why do you look so sad? You're not sick. Something must be bothering you.” Even though I was frightened,
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ e bishi ma: “Manɛ nna nɛ fo anishiakpa chɛrga fanɛ esa nɛ mbe kagbenejija mo loŋ? Fo alɛ maa lɔ. N tama fanɛ fo kagbene e maŋ fuli fo?.” Kedaŋ shin nɛ kufu pɛ ma ga.

english_verse: I answered, “Your Majesty, I hope you live forever! I feel sad because the city where my ancestors are buried is in ruins, and its gates have been burned down.”
translation_verse: Nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ mo le: “Yiramu, Ebɔrɛ e teŋi fo efute so! Ma kagbene maŋ fuli ma, ŋkpal manɛ so, kadegboŋ nɛ b puli n nanaana na bure a dese nɛ kumo be mbunagboŋana kikɛ ji edɛ.”

english_verse: The king asked, “What do you want me to do?” I prayed to the God who rules from heaven.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ wura na naŋ bishi ma: “Manɛ nɛ fee sha fanɛ n wora n sa fo?” Nɛ ŋ kule Ebɔrɛ ma kagbene to.

english_verse: Then I told the king, “Sir, if it's all right with you, please send me back to Judah, so that I can rebuild the city where my ancestors are buried.”
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ ewura na le: “Yiramu, jande, nɛ k maaŋ tɔrɔ fo, sa ma ekpa nɛ n yɔ Juda be kasawule so n ya lɔŋɛ kadegboŋ nɛ b puli an nanaana kumo to na m pɔr.”

english_verse: The queen was sitting beside the king when he asked me, “How long will it take, and when will you be back?” The king agreed to let me go, and I told him when I would return.
translation_verse: Ewura na nɛ mbe eche e daa tase, nɛ e bishi ma le: “Nchɛ afanɛ nɛ feeŋ ta n lɔŋɛ m pɔr kumo n loge nseŋ bɛta m ba?” Nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ mo jemanɛ nɛ meeŋ bɛta m ba. Nɛ kumo be loŋ par ewura na, nɛ e shuli nseŋ sa ma akpa.

english_verse: I will need timber to rebuild the gates of the fortress near the temple and more timber to construct the city wall and to build a place for me to live. And so, I would appreciate a letter to Asaph, who is in charge of the royal forest.” God was good to me, and the king did everything I asked.
translation_verse: Ma alɛ daa beeŋ baa sha kawɔl nɛ meeŋ ta n ya sa kanyɛn nɛ baa tre Asaf nɛ e bee keni ewura be kupo so na, saŋɛ na so Asaf beeŋ sa ma ekpa nɛ ŋ ku ndibi be kupo na to n lɔŋɛ mbuna n wɔtɔ ebu lempo jeŋgreŋ nɛ a yil m mata bɔrɛlambu na nɛ kadegboŋ na gba to be egbalana na nɛ laŋ nɛ ŋ gbagba beeŋ ya kaa wɔtɔ to na. Ebɔrɛ ka daa wɔ ŋ kutɔ so, ewura na daŋ shuli nna n sa ma kusɔ kama nɛ n daŋ kule mo.

english_verse: The king sent some army officers and cavalry troops along with me, and as I traveled through the Western Provinces, I gave the letters to the governors.
translation_verse: Ewura na daŋ lara benapo nimuso nɛ benapo nɛ baa dii egbaŋɛ nɛ b baa kuŋ ma nna; nɛ b tu ma m bɔla Yufreetes be Lɔrgboŋ na be epeŋitɔrkpa be kaba so n ta nwɔl nɛ ewurgboŋ na sibɛ na n ya sa egomenaana nɛ b wɔ ekpa na so na.

english_verse: But when Sanballat from Horon and Tobiah the Ammonite official heard about what had happened, they became very angry, because they didn't want anyone to help the people of Israel. Nehemiah Inspects the Wall of Jerusalem
translation_verse: Ama kanyɛn nɛ baa tre Sanballat nɛ e shi kade nɛ baa tre Horɔn na nɛ Tobaya nɛ e la Ammɔn be efuli so be krachigboŋ ko na ka nu fanɛ m ba na, nɛ b nya agbo ga. Ŋkpal manɛ so, b maa sha fanɛ esa kikɛ e chɛ Israɛlebi to.” Nehemaya ka ya keni ŋ keni Jerusalɛm be egbalana na be asheŋ

english_verse: Three days after arriving in Jerusalem,
translation_verse: An ka fo Jerusalɛm na be nchɛ asa be kaman,

english_verse: I got up during the night and left my house. I took some men with me, without telling anyone what I thought God wanted me to do for the city. The only animal I took was the donkey I rode on.
translation_verse: nɛ ma nɛ basa gbrɛbi ko koso kanyɛso a yɔ. Jemanɛ na so nɛ ma alɛ daŋ maŋ naŋ kaŋɛ esa kikɛ kusɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ ta n deŋi ma kagbene so fanɛ n wora n sa Jerusalɛmebi. Kurma nɛ n daŋ dii na nawule e daa la kusɔbɔya nɛ an keta n yɔ.

english_verse: I went through Valley Gate on the west, then south past Dragon Spring, before coming to Garbage Gate. As I rode along, I took a good look at the crumbled walls of the city and the gates that had been torn down and burned.
translation_verse: Kabuna nɛ k wɔ epeŋitɔrkpa nɛ baa tre kumo Ketaŋɛ be kabunagboŋ na to nɛ m bɔla to n lar n sɔ kelargato be kaseto be kaba so n ya bɔla kechubu nɛ baa tre Dragɔn na ase n ya fo kabunagboŋ nɛ baa tre Epi be kabuna na ase. Jemanɛ nɛ n dii kurma a choŋ na nɛ mee dara egbalana nɛ e bure n tɔr nɛ mbunagboŋana nɛ e daŋ chɔɔ na kikɛ.

english_verse: On the east side of the city, I headed north to Fountain Gate and King's Pool, but then the trail became too narrow for my donkey.
translation_verse: Ŋ ka fo Kadegboŋ na be epeŋilarkpa na nɛ ŋ kilgi n yɔ kechubu be kabunagboŋ na ase nɛ ewura be Kepa na ase. Ama ekpa na daa maŋ naaŋ kpalga to a shi n sa kurma nɛ n daa dii na.

english_verse: None of the city officials knew what I had in mind. And I had not even told any of the Jews—not the priests, the leaders, the officials, or any other Jews who would be helping in the work.
translation_verse: Kadegboŋ na to be ekrachigboŋana na be ekama daa maŋ nyi kakpa nɛ n yɔ ŋko kusɔ nɛ mee wora. Le be jemanɛ ere kikɛ nɛ m maŋ naŋ kaŋɛ m braana Juwebi na shɛŋ, hale Bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ bejuŋkparpoana na nɛ ekrachigboŋana na nɛ Juwebi nɛ bumo alɛ gba bee chɛ to a shuŋ kushuŋ na kikɛ maŋ nu shɛŋ ŋ kutɔ.

english_verse: But when I got back, I said to them, “Jerusalem is truly in a mess! The gates have been torn down and burned, and everything is in ruins. We must rebuild the city wall so that we can again take pride in our city.”
translation_verse: Ama ŋ ka bɛta n yɔ na nɛ n ya kaŋɛ bumo le: “Menyi alɛ gba wu tɔrɔ nɛ an wɔ kumo to ŋkpal Jerusalɛm ka bure a dese nɛ kumo be mbunagboŋana kikɛ chɔɔ n tɔr nna na! Men wora ania n shin nɛ an pɔr kadegboŋ ere be egbalana nɛ a tɔr ere, saŋɛ na so anyi maaŋ naŋ ji anishinyɔr.”

english_verse: Then I told them how kind God had been and what the king had said. Immediately, they replied, “Let's start building now!” So they got everything ready.
translation_verse: Ma alɛ daŋ naŋ kaŋɛ bumo kananɛ Ebɔrɛ wɔ ma kutɔ nseŋ chɛ ma to nɛ kusɔ nɛ ewurgboŋ na gba kaŋɛ ma. Ndoŋ nna nɛ b kaŋɛ: “Men shin nɛ an fara kapɔr na naniere!” Ndoŋ nna nɛ b bela ase nɛ b fara kushuŋ na.

english_verse: When Sanballat, Tobiah, and Geshem the Arab heard about our plans, they started insulting us and saying, “Just look at you! Do you plan to rebuild the walls of the city and rebel against the king?”
translation_verse: Sanballat nɛ Tobaya nɛ kalɔrbunyɛn ko nɛ baa tre mo Gɛshem ka nu kusɔ nɛ an kre kewora na be asheŋ nɛ b mushe anyi ga nseŋ kaŋɛ: “Manɛ nɛ menyee fɛ fanɛ menyee wora ere? Menyee sha kelɔŋɛ kadegboŋ na be egbalana nna m pɔr nseŋ lar ewura kaman ŋ kɔ mo kena, ŋko?”

english_verse: I answered, “We are servants of the God who rules from heaven, and he will make our work succeed. So we will start rebuilding Jerusalem, but you have no right to any of its property, because you have had no part in its history.”
translation_verse: Nɛ n shuli ŋ kaŋɛ le: “Ebɔrɛ nɛ e wɔ ebɔrɛso na beeŋ chɛ anyi to nɛ an pɔɔ so, ŋkpal manɛ so, an la mbe nyɛrbi nna. Mo e naŋ shin nɛ an tiŋ n shuŋ kushuŋ na n loge nɛ shɛŋ maŋ wora. Amoso anyeeŋ fara Jerusalɛm be egbalana na be kepɔr. Ama menyi ere maŋ kɔ ekpa nɛ men nya kapetɛsɔ kikɛ ashi Jerusalɛm be kadegboŋ na to, ŋkpal manɛ so, menyi maŋ ti kumo be edaŋkaresheŋ so.”

english_verse: These are the people who helped rebuild the wall and gates of Jerusalem: The high priest Eliashib and the other priests rebuilt Sheep Gate and hung its doors. Then they dedicated Sheep Gate and the section of the wall as far as Hundred Tower and Hananel Tower.
translation_verse: Kananɛ b lɔŋɛ m pɔr Jerusalɛm be egbalana na nde. Bɔrɛmatapo nimuso Eliyashib nɛ mo braana bɔrɛmatapoana na e lɔŋɛ kakpa nɛ baa tre Mbolpɔ be Kabuna ekpa na m pɔr nseŋ wɔtɔ kumo akuloŋ. Kumo be kaman nɛ b yili ndoŋ n ta egbal na be mba nɛ baa tre Ebu jeŋgreŋ Kalfa nɛ Hanamɛl be Ebu jeŋgreŋ na kikɛ m bɔɔ Ebɔrɛ enɔ.

english_verse: The people of Jericho rebuilt the next section of the wall, and Zaccur son of Imri rebuilt the section after that.
translation_verse: Jɛriko be kadegboŋ na be basa malɛ e shi ndoŋ m ba lɔŋɛ m pɔr egbal na be kaba nɛ k bɛ so na. Zakuur nɛ e la Imri pibinyɛn e pɔr kaba nɛ kumo alɛ naŋ bɛ so na.

english_verse: Meremoth, son of Uriah and grandson of Hakkoz, completed the next section of the wall. Meshullam, son of Berechiah and grandson of Meshezabel, rebuilt the next section, and Zadok son of Baana rebuilt the section beside that.
translation_verse: Yuraya pibinyɛn, Mɛremɔf nɛ mo nananyɛn la Hakɔz na, e lɔŋɛ m pɔr egbal na be kaba nɛ k bɛ so na. Bɛrekaya pibinyɛn, Mɛshulam nɛ mo nananyɛn daa la Mɛshezabel na malɛ e lɔŋɛ m pɔr egbal na be kaba nɛ k bɛ so na nɛ Baana pibinyɛn Zadɔk malɛ lɔŋɛ m pɔr kaba nɛ k wɔ kumo alɛ be kekel to na.

english_verse: The next section was to be repaired by the men of Tekoa, but their town leaders refused to do the hard work they were assigned.
translation_verse: Tekua be kade to ebi e daŋ daga fanɛ b lɔŋɛ m pɔr kaba nɛ k bɛ so na, ama bumo be bejuŋkparpoana na bre kini fanɛ b maaŋ shuŋ kushuŋ kpakpaso nɛ benimu nɛ baa keni beshumpo na so na sa bumo na.

english_verse: Melatiah from Gibeon, Jadon from Meronoth, and the men from Gibeon and Mizpah rebuilt the next section of the wall. This section reached as far as the house of the governor of West Euphrates Province.
translation_verse: Melataya nɛ e shi Gibiɔn be kade to nɛ Jadon nɛ e shi Mɛronɔt be kade to na, n ta basa nɛ b shi Gibiɔn nɛ Mizpa be ndeana to na e lɔŋɛ m pɔr egbal na be kaba nɛ k bɛ so na. B daŋ pɔr hale n fo Yufreetes be epeŋitɔrkpa be kebonfu na be gomena be kowu ekpa nna.

english_verse: Uzziel son of Harhaiah the goldsmith rebuilt the next section. Hananiah the perfume maker rebuilt the section next after that, and it went as far as Broad Wall.
translation_verse: Haahaya pibinyɛn Uziɛl nɛ e la shuwa be bɔyɛpo na e lɔŋɛ m pɔr egbal na be kaba nɛ k bɛ so na. Hananaya nɛ e bee lɔŋɛ etulale na malɛ e lɔŋɛ m pɔr kaba nɛ k wɔ a yɔ egbal kpaŋgalaŋ na akpa.

english_verse: Rephaiah son of Hur ruled half of the Jerusalem District, and he rebuilt the next section of the wall.
translation_verse: Hur pibinyɛn Refaya nɛ e daa keni Jerusalɛm be kebonfu be bargato na so na malɛ e lɔŋɛ m pɔr egbal na be kaba nɛ k bɛ so na.

english_verse: The section after that was close to the home of Jedaiah son of Harumaph, and he rebuilt it. Hattush son of Hashabneiah constructed the next section of the wall.
translation_verse: Egbal na be kaba nɛ k bɛ so na daŋ mata Harumat pibinyɛn Jadaya be laŋ nna nɛ e lɔŋɛ m pɔr ndoŋ be egbal na. Hashabnaya pibinyɛn Hatush malɛ e lɔŋɛ m pɔr kaba nɛ k bɛ so na.

english_verse: Malchijah son of Harim and Hasshub son of Pahath Moab rebuilt the section after that, and they also built Oven Tower.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Harim pibinyɛn Malkija nɛ Pahaf Mowab pibinyɛn Hashuub malɛ lɔŋɛ m pɔr mba anyɔ nɛ a bɛ so na nɛ bodobodo be ebu Jeŋgreŋ na gba n ti so.

english_verse: Shallum son of Hallohesh ruled the other half of the Jerusalem District, and he rebuilt the next section of the wall. Shallum's daughters also worked with him.
translation_verse: Halohɛsh pibinyɛn Shalum, nɛ e daa keni Jerusalɛm be Kebonfu nyɔsopo na so na nɛ mbe mbichesobiana e lɔŋɛ m pɔr egbal na be kaba nɛ k bɛ so na.

english_verse: Shallum son of Colhozeh ruled the district of Mizpah, and he rebuilt Fountain Gate. He put a cover over the gateway, then hung the doors and added metal bolts and wooden beams as locks. He also rebuilt the wall at Shelah Pool. This section was next to the king's garden and went as far as the stairs leading down from David's City.
translation_verse: Kolhoze pibinyɛn Shalum, nɛ e daa keni Mizpa be kebonfu so na e daŋ lɔŋɛ m pɔr Kuchubu be Kabuna ekpa na. E daŋ ta kusɔ nna n ti mbuna na. Kumo be kaman nɛ e wɔtɔ akuloŋ nɛ amo be abɛlso be abersobi nseŋ ta ndibi gbɛgbɛso m ber amo so. Mo koŋwule na e daŋ lɔŋɛ m pɔr egbal nɛ k wɔ kakpa nɛ baa tre Shɛla be Kepa na. K daŋ mata ewura be kambɔl na nna nseŋ ta hale n ya fo atemprembi nɛ e dii a yɔ ewura Deevid be kadegboŋ na to na.

english_verse: Nehemiah son of Azbuk ruled half of the district of Beth-Zur, and he rebuilt the next section of the wall. It went as far as the royal cemetery, the artificial pool, and the army barracks. Levites Who Worked on the Wall
translation_verse: Azbuk pibinyɛn Nehemaya nɛ e daa keni Bet Zur be kebonfu na be bargato so na malɛ e lɔŋɛ m pɔr egbal nɛ k bɛ so na, hale n ya fo kakpa nɛ baa puli bewura nɛ baa tre ndoŋ ewura Deevid be nchaŋ ase nɛ kepa nɛ b kur na nɛ benapo be echenakpa na ase. Livaiebi nɛ b shuŋ egbal na be kushuŋ na be asheŋ

english_verse: The Levites who worked on the next sections of the wall were Rehum son of Bani; Hashabiah, who ruled half of the district of Keilah and did this work for his district;
translation_verse: Livaiebi nɛ b lɔŋɛ m pɔr egbal na n chɔga so na e daa la Bani pibinyɛn Rehum nɛ Hashabia nɛ e daa keni Keyila be kebonfu be bargato so na. Mo ere daŋ yili mbe kebonfu be katelamu to n shuŋ kushuŋ na nna.

english_verse: Ezer son of Jeshua, who ruled Mizpah, rebuilt the section of the wall that was in front of the armory and reached to the corner of the wall;
translation_verse: Joshuwa pibinyɛn Eza nɛ e daa keni Mizpa be kade so na e daŋ lɔŋɛ m pɔr kaba nɛ k wɔ kakpa nɛ b daa yili benapo be akɔsɔ na be anishito hale n ya fo kakpa nɛ b gbɛ egbal na.

english_verse: Baruch son of Zabbai eagerly rebuilt the section of the wall that went all the way to the door of the house of Eliashib the high priest;
translation_verse: Zabai pibinyɛn Baruk malɛ e pere kenishi n lɔŋɛ m pɔr egbal na be kaba nɛ k ka n ya fo bɔrɛmatapo nimuso Eliyashib be kowu ase na.

english_verse: Meremoth, son of Uriah and grandson of Hakkoz, built up to the far end of Eliashib's house. Priests Who Worked on the Wall
translation_verse: Yuraya pibinyɛn Mɛremɔf nɛ mo nananyɛn daa la Hakkoz na e lɔŋɛ m pɔr egbal na be kaba nɛ k niŋi teteri n ya fo Eliyashib be kowu be ekar na. Bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ b chɛ to m pɔr egbal na be asheŋ

english_verse: Here is a list of the priests who worked on the wall: Priests from the region around Jerusalem rebuilt the next section of the wall.
translation_verse: Bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ b chɛ to n lɔŋɛ m pɔr egbal na e daa la: Bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ b shi Kebonfu nɛ k kulti Jerusalɛm na e lɔŋɛ m pɔr egbal na be kaba nɛ k bɛ so na.

english_verse: Benjamin and Hasshub rebuilt the wall in front of their own houses. Azariah, who was the son of Maaseiah and the grandson of Ananiah, rebuilt the section in front of his house.
translation_verse: Nɛ Bɛnjamin nɛ Hashuub malɛ lɔŋɛ m pɔr egbal na be mba nɛ a bɛ so nsaa wɔ bumo elaŋ be anishito na. Maasaya pibinyɛn Azariya nɛ mo nananyɛn daa la Ananaya na malɛ e lɔŋɛ m pɔr egbal na be mba nɛ a bɛ so nsaa wɔ bumo be elaŋ be anishito na.

english_verse: Binnui son of Henadad rebuilt the section of the wall from Azariah's house to the corner of the wall.
translation_verse: Nɛ Henadad pibinyɛn Biniyu malɛ lɔŋɛ m pɔr egbal na be kaba nɛ k bɛ so nsaa wɔ yili Azariya be laŋ ase hale n ya fo kakpa nɛ b gbɛ egbal na.

english_verse: Palal son of Uzai rebuilt the next section, which began at the corner of the wall and the tower of the upper palace near the court of the guard. Pedaiah son of Parosh rebuilt the next section of the wall.
translation_verse: Uzaya pibinyɛn Palal e lɔŋɛ m pɔr egbal nɛ b gbɛ na n ya fo ewurkpa be ebu jeŋgreŋ nɛ k mata bekumpo be kelɔnɛ ase na. Parosh pibinyɛn Pɛdaya malɛ e lɔŋɛ m pɔr kaba nɛ k bɛ so na.

english_verse: He stopped at a place near the Water Gate on the east and the tower guarding the temple. This was close to a section in the city called Ophel, where the temple workers lived. Other Builders Who Worked on the Wall
translation_verse: E daŋ pɔr nna m ba fo kakpa nɛ k mata Nchu be kabuna nɛ k wɔ a laŋɛ epeŋilarkpa be kaba so nɛ ebu jeŋgreŋ nɛ k mata bɔrɛlambu na ase na nna. K mata kadegboŋ na be kaba nɛ baa tre Ofɛl nɛ bɔrɛlambu na be beshumpo na daa wɔ ndoŋ na nna. Bepɔrpoana na be beko be baru be asheŋ

english_verse: The men from Tekoa rebuilt the next section of the wall, and it was their second section. It started at a place across from the large tower that guarded the Temple, and it went all the way to the wall near Ophel.
translation_verse: Kade nɛ baa tre Tekua na be benyɛn malɛ e daŋ lɔŋɛ m pɔr egbal na be kaba nɛ k bɛ so na. Kaba nyɔsopo nɛ b daŋ pɔr nna na. B daŋ yili kakpa nɛ k wɔ ebu jeŋgreŋ gboŋ nɛ k bee kuŋ bɔrɛlambu na be anishito hale n ya fo egbal nɛ k mata Ofɛl na nna.

english_verse: Zadok son of Immer rebuilt the wall in front of his house. Shemaiah son of Shecaniah, who looked after the East Gate, rebuilt the section after that.
translation_verse: Imma pibinyɛn Zadɔk malɛ gba e lɔŋɛ m pɔr egbal nɛ k bɛ so a wɔ mbe laŋ be anishito na. Nɛ Shekanaya pibinyɛn Shemaya nɛ e daa keni Epeŋilarkpa be kabuna so na malɛ lɔŋɛ m pɔr kaba nɛ k naŋ bɛ so na.

english_verse: Hananiah and Hanun rebuilt the next section, which was the second section for them. Meshullam son of Berechiah rebuilt the next section, which happened to be in front of his house.
translation_verse: Shɛlemaya pibinyɛn Hananaya nɛ Hanun nɛ e la Zalaf pibi shesopo na malɛ e lɔŋɛ m pɔr egbal na be kaba nɛ k bɛ kumo so na. Kumo a ti so bumo be kakpa nyɔsopo nɛ b pɔr. Bɛrekaya pibinyɛn Mɛshulam e lɔŋɛ m pɔr kaba nɛ k bɛ kumo so so nsaa wɔ mo gbagba be laŋ be anishito na.

english_verse: Malchijah, a goldsmith, rebuilt the next section, as far as the house used by the temple workers and merchants. This area was across from Gathering Gate, near the room on top of the wall at the northeast corner.
translation_verse: Malkija nɛ e la shuwa be bɔyɛpo na e lɔŋɛ m pɔr kaba nɛ kumo alɛ bɛ kumo so na hale n ya fo laŋ nɛ bɔrɛlambu na be beshumpo nɛ eyawujipoana daa wɔtɔ to na ase. Kakpa ere daa wɔ kabuna nɛ baa tre Gama abar be Kabuna nɛ k mata ebu nɛ k wɔ egbal na so ashi kelargato be esoso be epeŋilarkpa be kebonfu na be anishito nna.

english_verse: The goldsmiths and merchants rebuilt the last section of the wall, which went from the corner room all the way to Sheep Gate.
translation_verse: Shuwa be ebɔyɛpo nɛ eyawujipoana na malɛ e lɔŋɛ m pɔr egbal na be kakpa lalaloge. Kumo alɛ yili ebu nɛ k wɔ kebonfu to be ebu na nna hale n ya fo kaboŋ nɛ baa tre Mbolpɔ be Kabuna na ase nna.

english_verse: When Sanballat, the governor of Samaria, heard that we were rebuilding the walls of Jerusalem, he became angry and started insulting our people.
translation_verse: Sanballat, nɛ e la Samɛria be efuli so be gomena na, ka nu fanɛ anyi Juwebi na fara a pɔr Jerusalɛm be egbalana na, nɛ e nya agbo nseŋ fara a wora anyi be basa eyurto.

english_verse: In front of his friends and the Samaritan army he said, “What is this feeble bunch of Jews trying to do? Are they going to rebuild the wall and offer sacrifices all in one day? Do they think they can make something out of this pile of scorched stones?”
translation_verse: Le nɛ e kaŋɛ mo braana nɛ Samɛria be benapo be anishito: “Manɛ nɛ Juwebi, basa pɔso be katuŋ ere bee fɛ fanɛ baa wora ere? Baa sha keta kachɛ koŋwule nna n lɔŋɛ egbal na m pɔr nseŋ lara esarga loŋ be kachɛ koŋwule na gbagba a? Baa fɛ fanɛ baaŋ tiŋ n ta ajembu nɛ a chɔɔ m biti abar so ere n lɔŋɛ kusɔ ko a?”

english_verse: Tobiah from Ammon was standing beside Sanballat and said, “Look at the wall they are building! Why, even a fox could knock over this pile of stones.”
translation_verse: Jemanɛ na so nɛ Tobaya nɛ e shi Ammɔn be efuli so na yil mo kutɔ, nseŋ kaŋɛ le: “Nuso bre be egbal nɛ baa sha kepɔr ere? Jiŋkaamu gba beeŋ tiŋ ŋ ŋin kumo n lɛ!”

english_verse: But I prayed, “Our God, these people hate us and have wished horrible things for us. Please answer our prayers and make their insults fall on them! Let them be the ones to be dragged away as prisoners of war.
translation_verse: Ama n daŋ kule Ebɔrɛ nna ŋ kaŋɛ: “O Ebɔrɛ, basa ere kishi anyi nna nsaa sha fanɛ asheŋ lubi e tu anyi. Jande nu anyi be kekule nseŋ shin nɛ bumo be katege na e laŋɛ bumo be amu so! Shin nɛ b baa la basa nɛ bumo doŋana beeŋ pɛ bumo kena to ŋ gberge bumo n yɔ kabuti to.

english_verse: Don't forgive the mean and evil way they have insulted the builders.”
translation_verse: Sa maŋ kaŋ ta bumo be alubi nɛ kekeni jiga nɛ b keni bepɔrpo na m paŋ bumo kikɛ.”

english_verse: The people worked hard, and we built the walls of Jerusalem halfway up again.
translation_verse: Beshumpo na daŋ shuŋ ga nɛ an naŋ pɔr Jerusalɛm be egbal na n fo nferinto.

english_verse: But Sanballat, Tobiah, the Arabs, the Ammonites, and the people from the city of Ashdod saw the walls going up and the holes being repaired. So they became angry
translation_verse: Sanballat nɛ Tobaya nɛ Nlɔrbu na nɛ Ammɔnebi na nɛ basa nɛ b shi kadegboŋ nɛ baa tre Ashdɔd na daŋ wu fanɛ egbal na daa dii nna a shin nɛ k shɛrto. Amoso b daŋ nya agbo nna,

english_verse: and decided to stir up trouble, and to fight against the people of Jerusalem.
translation_verse: nseŋ daŋ kre fanɛ baaŋ bar kebagato nseŋ kɔ Jerusalɛmebi na.

english_verse: But we kept on praying to our God, and we also stationed guards day and night.
translation_verse: Ama an kule anyi be Ebɔrɛ nseŋ lara benapo nɛ b baa keni so nsaa kuŋ egbal na kapa nɛ kanyɛ kikɛ.

english_verse: Our enemies were saying, “Before those Jews know what has happened, we will sneak up and kill them and put an end to their work.”
translation_verse: An doŋana malɛ daŋ naa kaŋɛ le nna: “Pɔɛŋ nɛ Jerusalɛm be basa ere e pin kusɔ nɛ k bee wora na, nɛ an ŋana n ya mɔ bumo kikɛ nɛ bumo be kushuŋ na e ba ekar.”

english_verse: On at least ten different occasions, the Jews living near our enemies warned us against attacks from every side,
translation_verse: Ama ale kudu kikɛ nɛ Jerusalɛm be basa nɛ b daŋ wea anyi doŋana to n chena na kpele anyi kusoe a laŋɛ kusɔ nɛ an doŋana na bee kre kewora anyi be kaplɛa so.

english_verse: and so I sent people to guard the wall at its lowest places and where there were still holes in it. I placed them according to families, and they stood guard with swords and spears and with bows and arrows.
translation_verse: Amoso nɛ n ta etokobi nɛ ekpa nɛ ata nɛ atanyembi n sa ma basa nseŋ gama bumo kakurge be ntuŋso a mata egbal na be kaba nɛ k maŋ naŋ pɔr n loge na nɛ b baa kuŋ.

english_verse: Then I looked things over and told the leaders, the officials, and the rest of the people, “Don't be afraid of your enemies! The Lord is great and fearsome. So think of him and fight for your relatives and children, your wives and homes!”
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ n wu fanɛ basa na be ŋgbene jija bumo, nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ bumo nɛ bumo be bejuŋkparpo nɛ ekrachi na le: “Men sa maa ŋana anyi doŋana ere. Men baa nyiŋi kananɛ Enyɛnpe na be eleŋ shi ga nɛ kananɛ mbe asheŋ bee keta kufu. Amoso men leŋ menyi be amu to nseŋ kɔ kenishipereso n sa menyi be basa nɛ mbia nɛ beche nɛ elantoebi!”

english_verse: Our enemies found out that we knew about their plot against us, but God kept them from doing what they had planned. So we went back to work on the wall.
translation_verse: An doŋana daŋ mige to m pin fanɛ an nyi ŋkre lubi nɛ baa kre a laŋɛ anyi be kaplɛa so na kikɛ. Ebɔrɛ malɛ daŋ jija bumo be ŋkre na nna. Amoso anyi kikɛ naŋ bɛta n yɔ egbal na be kelɔŋɛ m pɔr to nna.

english_verse: From then on, I let half of the young men work while the other half stood guard. They wore armor and had spears and shields, as well as bows and arrows. The leaders helped the workers
translation_verse: Yili loŋ be jemanɛ na mbrantiɛbia na be bargato bee shuŋ nna nɛ bargato malɛ e buu anyɛn kale gbɛgbɛso nseŋ keta ekpa nɛ abɛlso be asɔ kuŋ eyur so nɛ ata nɛ atanyembi a yil a kuŋ. Anyi be benapo be benimuana na malɛ daa yili bepɔrpo na be kaman nna.

english_verse: who were rebuilding the wall. Everyone who hauled building materials kept one hand free to carry a weapon.
translation_verse: Basa nɛ b daa sulɔ kapɔr be asɔ na be ekama daŋ keta kekɔsɔ enɔ koŋwule to nna nseŋ ta enɔ koŋwule malɛ m pɛ asɔ na to.

english_verse: Even the workers who were rebuilding the wall strapped on a sword. The worker who was to blow the signal trumpet stayed with me.
translation_verse: Bepɔrpo na malɛ ta etokobi nna n wɔtɔ efar to n chɛ bumo be nshɛr to. Esa nɛ e beeŋ foŋ kabel n juge anyi na bre daa wɔ ma kutɔ nna.

english_verse: I told the people and their officials and leaders, “Our work is so spread out, that we are a long way from one another.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ basa na nɛ bumo be ekrachi nɛ bejuŋkparpoana na le: “Ŋkpal anyi be kushuŋ na ka barga to a wɔ mboŋ damta so, an barga abar nna ga.

english_verse: If you hear the sound of the trumpet, come quickly and gather around me. Our God will help us fight.”
translation_verse: Men baŋ nu kabel na be kushu, men wora manaŋ m ba shɛr ŋ kulti ma. Anyi be Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ chɛ anyi to ŋ kɔ.”

english_verse: Every day from dawn to dark, half of the workers rebuilt the walls, while the rest stood guard with their spears.
translation_verse: Amoso anyi bee wule a koso kachipurdidi nna a shuŋ egbal na be kushuŋ hale nɛ kanyɛ e ya biri. Basa na be bargato bee shuŋ nna nɛ bargato malɛ e keta bumo be ekpa a yil a kuŋ.

english_verse: I asked the men in charge and their workers to stay inside Jerusalem and stand guard at night. So they guarded the city at night and worked during the day.
translation_verse: Loŋ be jemanɛ nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ basa nɛ baa keni beshumpo na so na nɛ bumo be beshumpo kikɛ fanɛ baa b wɔ Jerusalɛm be kadegboŋ na to kanyɛso kikɛ nsaa keni so a kuŋ kade na. Amoso b daa shuŋ kapaso nna nsaa keni kade na so a kuŋ kumo kanyɛso malɛ.

english_verse: I even slept in my work clothes at night; my relatives, the workers, and the guards slept in theirs as well. And we always kept our weapons close by.
translation_verse: Ma nɛ m braana nɛ beshumpo na nɛ bekumpo na kikɛ maa lara anyi be asɔbuuso kanyɛso nsaa dese. Anyi alɛ kikɛ maa shin nɛ anyi be akɔsɔ bee barga anyi kikɛ.

english_verse: Some of the men and their wives complained about the Jews in power
translation_verse: Jemanɛ ko ka fo nɛ benyɛn nɛ beche na be beko fara a fubel a bile asheŋ a malga a gbiti bumo braana.

english_verse: and said, “We have large families, and it takes a lot of grain merely to keep us alive.”
translation_verse: Le nɛ beko daa kaŋɛ: “Nnaŋgboŋ nɛ anyi be beko kɔ a bela. Ayu damta nɛ e daga fanɛ an nya a ji nseŋ tiŋ a wɔ ŋkpa to.”

english_verse: Others said, “During the famine we even had to mortgage our fields, vineyards, and homes to them in order to buy grain.”
translation_verse: Nɛ beko malɛ kaŋɛ le: “Akoŋ be jemanɛ na, anyi be adɔsawule nɛ ndibi sɔrso be adɔ nɛ nwu nɛ an daŋ ta n yili tarma nseŋ nya ayu n ji.”

english_verse: Then others said, “We had to borrow money from those in power to pay the government tax on our fields and vineyards.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ beko malɛ kaŋɛ le: “An paŋ amansherbi nna pɔɛŋ nseŋ tiŋ ŋ ka anyi be adɔsawule nɛ ndibi sɔrso be akɔ n sa ewura.

english_verse: We are Jews just as they are, and our children are as good as theirs. But we still have to sell our children as slaves, and some of our daughters have already been raped. We are completely helpless; our fields and vineyards have even been taken from us.”
translation_verse: Anyi alɛ gba la Juwebi nna, nɛ anyi be mbia nɛ bumo be mbia kikɛ la kukoŋwule. Ama anyi ere bee fa anyi be mbia nna nɛ baa ki anya. Naniere anyi maŋ naa kɔ kechɛto kikɛ be tama ŋkpal an ka ta anyi be adɔsawule nɛ ndibi sɔrso be adɔana ŋ n chɛr ayu so.”

english_verse: When I heard their complaints and their charges, I became very angry.
translation_verse: Ŋ ka nu b kaa bee fubel a bile asheŋ na nɛ agbo pɛ ma ga.

english_verse: So I thought it over and said to the leaders and officials, “How can you charge your own people interest?” Then I called a public meeting and accused the leaders
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ n fɛ kumo be asheŋ nseŋ kaŋɛ bejuŋkparpoana na nɛ ekrachiana na le: “Manɛ nna nɛ menyee paŋ menyi be basa gbagba amansherbi nsaa wɔtɔ bumo nchu? Kumo be kaman nɛ n tre ekama n shɛr nseŋ malga ŋ gbiti bejuŋkparpoana na ŋ kaŋɛ bumo le,

english_verse: by saying, “We have tried to buy back all of our people who were sold into exile. But here you are, selling more of them for us to buy back!” The officials and leaders did not say a word, because they knew this was true.
translation_verse: An wora ania n tɔ anyi be basa nɛ b pɛ anya n yɔ efuli pɔtɛana so na m bɛta m ba. Ama naniere menyi e naa fa bumo be bedamta na, nɛ an naŋ ya tɔ bumo!” Ekrachi na nɛ bejuŋkparpoana na daa maŋ kaŋɛ shɛŋ, ŋkpal b ka nyi k kaa la kashenteŋ so.

english_verse: I continued, “What you have done is wrong! We must honor our God by the way we live, so the Gentiles can't find fault with us.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ n naŋ kaŋɛ le: “Kusɔ nɛ men wora na maŋ daga kuraa! A daga fanɛ anyi be kebaawɔtɔ e baa sa Ebɔrɛ bunyaŋ, saŋɛ na so nnyamase na maaŋ wu kulubi anyi to.

english_verse: The leaders answered, “We will do whatever you say and return their property, without asking to be repaid.” So I made the leaders promise in front of the priests to give back the property.
translation_verse: Nɛ bejuŋkparpo na kaŋɛ le: “Kusɔ kama nɛ fo kaŋɛ, anyeeŋ wora loŋ. Anyi beeŋ ta bumo be mpetɛ n sa bumo, anyi alɛ maŋ naŋ bishi bumo anyi be akɔ nɛ b ji na gba.” Ndoŋ nna nɛ n tre bɔrɛmatapoana na nseŋ shin nɛ bejuŋkparpoana na nase kɔnɔ bumo be anishito saŋɛ na so baaŋ bɛ bumo be nnɔ nɛ b nase na so.

english_verse: I was governor of Judah from the twentieth year that Artaxerxes was king until the thirty-second year. And during these entire twelve years, my relatives and I refused to accept the food that I was allowed.
translation_verse: Atazɛzɛs ka ji kuwura be nfɛ adunyɔ n ya fo nfɛ adesa nɛ anyɔsopo to nɛ ma e la Juda be efuli so be gomena. Nfɛ kuduanyɔ nɛ n la gomena na kikɛ, ma ŋko ŋkurgepoana maŋ sɔ ajibi nɛ a daga ma fanɛ gomena na.

english_verse: Each governor before me had been a burden to the people by making them pay for his food and wine and by demanding forty silver coins a day. Even their officials had been a burden to the people. But I respected God, and I didn't think it was right to be so hard on them.
translation_verse: Egomena kama nɛ b juŋkpar na daa tɔrɔ basa na nna ga. B daa sɔ gbiti be ndarbi adena nna a tɔ ajibi nɛ asɔnuuso karechɛ kikɛ nna. Bumo be nyɛrbi gba daa tɔrɔ basa na nna, ama ŋkpal ma ere ka bee ŋana Ebɔrɛ na so nɛ ma kebaawɔtɔ daa kɔr bumo to na.

english_verse: Each day one ox, six of the best sheep, and lots of chickens were prepared. Then every ten days, a large supply of wine was brought in. I knew what a heavy burden this would have been for the people, and so I did not ask for my food allowance as governor.
translation_verse: Karechɛ kama mee sa kena koŋwule nɛ mbolpɔ lela ashe nɛ ŋkoshi damta nɛ ajibi nna, nsaa chige asɔnuuso popɔr nchɛ kudu kikɛ. Ama ade kikɛ be kaman n nyi asheŋ kpakpaso nɛ a beeŋ ba basa na so, amoso n daa maa sɔ gomena be kakɔka.

english_verse: I pray that God will bless me for everything I have done for my people.
translation_verse: O Ebɔrɛ, mee kule fo nna nɛ fo nyiŋi kusɔ nɛ n wora n sa basa ere nseŋ nɛfa ma.

english_verse: Sanballat, Tobiah, Geshem, and our other enemies learned that I had completely rebuilt the wall. All I lacked was hanging the doors in the gates.
translation_verse: Sanballat nɛ Tobaya, nɛ Geshɛm nɛ an doŋana nɛ b ka na be beko nu fanɛ an pɔr egbal na n loge. Kusɔ nɛ an daa maŋ wora e la akuloŋ na be keta n wɔtɔ mbunaana na to.

english_verse: Then Sanballat and Geshem sent a message, asking me to meet with them in one of the villages in Ono Valley. I knew they were planning to harm me in some way.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal Sanballat nɛ Geshɛm ka bee sha fanɛ b tɔrɔ ma so, b ta kubɔya nna n shoŋi ma fanɛ m ba nɛ ma nɛ bumo e wu abar ashi ndebiana nɛ e wɔ kakpa nɛ baa tre Ono be Ketaŋɛ na be kuko to.

english_verse: So I sent messengers to tell them, “My work is too important to stop now and go there. I can't afford to slow down the work just to visit with you.”
translation_verse: Nɛ ma alɛ shuŋi mbɔ ŋ kaŋɛ bumo le: “Ŋ kɔ kushuŋ kpakpaso nna a wora, amoso m maaŋ tiŋ n yɔ ndoŋ. M maaŋ tiŋ ŋkpal ma nɛ menyi be kewu abar so n yige kushuŋ ere.”

english_verse: They invited me four times, but each time I refused to go.
translation_verse: Ale ana nɛ b kela n tre ma, ama saŋkama kamalga koŋwule na nɛ ma alɛ bee kaŋɛ bumo.

english_verse: Finally, Sanballat sent an official to me with an unsealed letter,
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Sanballat naŋ shuŋi krachi ko fanɛ e ta kawɔl m ba sa ma.

english_verse: which said: A rumor is going around among the nations that you and the other Jews are rebuilding the wall and planning to rebel, because you want to be their king. And Geshem says it's true!
translation_verse: Le nɛ kawɔl na bee kaŋɛ: “Geshɛm kaŋɛ ma fanɛ basa bee kuli a malga asheŋ ko a kaŋɛ fanɛ fo nɛ fo basa bee kre anyi nia nna nɛ men lar Pɛshiya be efuli so be ewurgboŋ na kaman. Aloŋ malɛ so nɛ fee lɔŋɛ a pɔr egbal na. Mo alɛ naa kaŋɛ gba fanɛ fee sha keta fo kumu nna ŋ ki Jerusalɛm be ewura.

english_verse: I sent a message back to Sanballat, saying, “None of this is true! You are making it all up.”
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ ma alɛ sa mo ebɔl nseŋ kaŋɛ mo le: “Kashenteŋ maŋ wɔ kusɔ nɛ fee kaŋɛ ere to kikɛ. Fo gbagba be keblɔmbi nɛ fo wora na.”

english_verse: Our enemies were trying to frighten us and to keep us from our work. But I asked God to give me strength.
translation_verse: B daa sha fanɛ b funti anyi nna nɛ an sa maŋ tiŋ n loge kushuŋ na. Nɛ ŋ kule Ebɔrɛ ŋ kaŋɛ le: “Ebɔrɛ sa ma eleŋ naniere!”

english_verse: One day I went to visit Shemaiah. He wasn't supposed to leave his house, but he said, “Let's hurry to the holy place of the temple and hide there. We will lock the temple doors, because your enemies are planning to kill you tonight.”
translation_verse: Kachako nɛ n yɔ nɛ n ya bɔɔ Delai pibinyɛn Shemaya nɛ e la Mehetabel mo nanabi nyɛnso nɛ e daŋ shir a wɔ mbe laŋ to na so nɛ e kaŋɛ ma le: “A daga fanɛ ma nɛ fo ka ŋana bɔrɛlambu na be kakpa cheembi na nseŋ ti akuloŋ, ŋkpal fo doŋana kaa bee sha fanɛ b mɔ fo na so. Baŋ yili kanyɛ ere a yɔ baŋ ba mɔ fo.”

english_verse: I answered, “Why should someone like me have to run and hide in the temple to save my life? I won't go!”
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ: “Ma ere maŋ la basa nɛ baa shile a ŋana na be ako nna. Fee fɛ nna fanɛ meeŋ shile ŋ ŋana bɔrɛlambu ere to nna ŋkpal ma kumɔlga so a? M maaŋ wora loŋ kikɛ.”

english_verse: Suddenly I realized that God had not given Shemaiah this message. But Tobiah and Sanballat had paid him to trick me
translation_verse: Ŋ ka lɔŋɛ n fɛ kesheŋ ere be nfɛra nɛnɛ na nɛ n pin fanɛ Ebɔrɛ maŋ malga Shemaya kutɔ, ama Tobaya nɛ Sanballat e daŋ sa mo brɔbu nseŋ kaŋɛ mo fanɛ e kpele ma kusoe.

english_verse: and to frighten me into doing something wrong, because they wanted to ruin my good name.
translation_verse: B daŋ ber mo paa nna fanɛ e funti ma nɛ n wora kulubi, saŋɛ na so ma ketre beeŋ jija nɛ anishinyɔr e pɛ ma.

english_verse: Then I asked God to punish Tobiah and Sanballat for what they had done. I prayed that God would punish the prophet Noadiah and the other prophets who, together with her, had tried to frighten me. The Work Is Finished
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ ŋ kule Ebɔrɛ le: “Ebɔrɛ nyiŋi kusɔ nɛ Tobaya nɛ Sanballat wora nɛ anebiche nɛ baa tre Nodaya nɛ anebiana nɛ b ka na be kananɛ b fin ekpa nɛ b funti ma. Jande gberge bumo kikɛ kusoe n sa ma.” Kushuŋ na be lalaloge be asheŋ

english_verse: When our enemies in the surrounding nations learned that the work was finished, they felt helpless, because they knew that our God had helped us rebuild the wall.
translation_verse: Anyi doŋana nɛ b wɔ efuli pɔtɛ so na ka nu loŋ nɛ kufu pɛ bumo, ŋkpal ekama na ka pin fanɛ Ebɔrɛ be kechɛto so nɛ kushuŋ na tiŋ n loge.

english_verse: All this time the Jewish leaders and Tobiah had been writing letters back and forth.
translation_verse: Loŋ be jemanɛ na so Juda be bejuŋkparpoana na nɛ Tobaya e daa sibɛ nwɔl a shoŋi abar.

english_verse: Many people in Judah were loyal to Tobiah for two reasons: Shecaniah son of Arah was his father-in-law, and Tobiah's son Jehohanan had married the daughter of Meshullam son of Berechiah.
translation_verse: Basa damta daa yil Tobaya be kaman nna ŋkpal Ara pibinyɛn, Shekanaya ka la mo shanyɛn so. Kusɔ nɛ k naŋ ti so e la fanɛ mo pibinyɛn Jehohanan e ta Berekia pibinyɛn, Mɛshulam pibiche a kil.
