english_verse: The people would always tell me about the good things Tobiah had done, and then they would tell Tobiah everything I had said. So Tobiah kept sending letters, trying to frighten me.
translation_verse: Basa bee kaŋɛ ma ashuŋ lela nɛ Tobaya bee wora kikɛ nna saŋɛ na so baaŋ nu ma kɔnɔ to be kamalga n ya kaŋɛ mo. Saŋkama mo alɛ bee sibɛ nwɔl nna a funti ma.

english_verse: Although Jerusalem covered a large area, not many people lived there, and no new houses had been built.
translation_verse: Jerusalɛm daa la kade gboŋgboŋi nna, ama basa gbrɛbi ko e daa wɔ kumo to. Bumo alɛ daa maŋ naŋ lɔŋɛ m pɔr bumo be nwu ndoŋ.

english_verse: Here are the names of Solomon's servants whose descendants returned: Sotai, Sophereth, Perida, Jaala, Darkon, Giddel, Shephatiah, Hattil, Pochereth Hazzebaim, and Amon.
translation_verse: Ewura Sɔlɔmɔn be nyɛrbi be mbuna ebi nɛ bumo alɛ gba bɛta m ba nde. Sotai nɛ Sofɛrɛ nɛ Pɛrida be kabuna ebi nɛ Jaala nɛ Daakɔn nɛ Gidɛl be kabuna ebi nɛ Shefatiya nɛ Hatil nɛ Pokerɛf Hazebem nɛ Ammɔn be kabuna ebi.

english_verse: The families of Hobaiah, Hakkoz, and Barzillai could not prove they were priests. The ancestor of the family of Barzillai had married the daughter of Barzillai from Gilead and had taken his wife's family name. But the records of these three families could not be found, and none of them were allowed to serve as priests.
translation_verse: Bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ b daa maŋ tiŋ n nya kawɔl nɛ k bee ŋini kananɛ bumo be nnaŋ lar e la Hobia nɛ Hakɔz nɛ Bazilai. Bazilai nɛ e shi bɔrɛmatapoana be kabuna ere mo nananyɛn daŋ ta Giliad be kasawule so be Bazilai be kabuna be eche nna nseŋ ta mo shanyɛn be ketre n nase mbe kabuna na. Ŋkpal b k daa maŋ tiŋ ŋ ŋini kananɛ bumo kekurge to lar so, b daa maŋ sa bumo ekpa nɛ b ki bɔrɛmatapoana.

english_verse: And so, by the seventh month, priests, Levites, temple guards, musicians, workers, and many of the ordinary people had settled in the towns of Judah.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana na nɛ Livaiebi na nɛ bɔrɛlambu to be bekumpo na nɛ beshɛbompoana na nɛ basa na be beko nɛ bɔrɛlambu to be beshumpo na nɛ Israɛlebi na kikɛ chena bumo be ndeana to ashi Juda be efuli so kikɛ.

english_verse: From early morning till noon, he read the Law of Moses to them, and they listened carefully.
translation_verse: Yili kachipurdidi n ya fo kapiidi nɛ e yili kelɔnɛ nɛ k mata kabuna so a kraŋ mbra be kawɔl na a sa basa na nɛ baa nu kumo nɛnɛ.

english_verse: Ezra stood on a high wooden platform that had been built for this occasion. Mattithiah, Shema, Anaiah, Uriah, Hilkiah, and Maaseiah were standing to his right, while Pedaiah, Mishael, Malchijah, Hashum, Hash Baddanah, Zechariah, and Meshullam were standing to his left.
translation_verse: B daŋ ta ndibi n yuu kejaŋ nna nɛ Ɛzra yili kumo so loŋ be kachɛ nna. Basa nɛ b daa yil mbe jisoso a la Mattitia nɛ Shema nɛ Anaya nɛ Yuriya nɛ Hilkiya nɛ Maseya. Bumo nɛ bumo alɛ daa yil mbe bena so malɛ e daa la Pedaya nɛ Mishaal nɛ Malkiya nɛ Hashum nɛ Hash Badaana nɛ Zakareya nɛ Mɛshulam.

english_verse: Ezra was up on the high platform, where he could be seen by everyone, and when he opened the book, all the people stood up.
translation_verse: Ɛzra daŋ yili kejaŋ jeŋgreŋ na so nna a keni basa na kaseto nɛ bumo alɛ gba be anishi yuu mo so. E ka bugi kawɔl na to a kraŋ na kikɛ nɛ basa na kikɛ yil nna.

english_verse: After this, the Levites Jeshua, Bani, Sherebiah, Jamin, Akkub, Shabbethai, Hodiah, Maaseiah, Kelita, Azariah, Jozabad, Hanan, and Pelaiah went among the people, explaining the meaning of what Ezra had read.
translation_verse: B ka wora loŋ n loge nɛ b koso n yili nɛ Joshuwa nɛ Bani nɛ Sherebia nɛ Jamin nɛ Akkub nɛ Shebataya nɛ Hodia nɛ Maaseia nɛ Kɛlita nɛ Azariya nɛ Jozabad nɛ Hanan nɛ Pɛleeyaa nɛ b la Livaiebi na luri basa na to n ya kaa kute mbra nɛ Ɛzra kraŋ na be afito a ŋini bumo.

english_verse: The people started crying when God's Law was read to them. Then Nehemiah the governor, Ezra the priest and teacher, and the Levites who had been teaching the people all said, “This is a special day for the Lord your God. So don't be sad and don't cry!”
translation_verse: Basa na ka nu kusɔ nɛ mbra na bee kaŋɛ na nɛ k luri bumo to ga nɛ b fara a shu. Amoso Nehemaya nɛ e daa la gomena na nɛ bɔrɛmatapo Ɛzra nɛ e la mbra na be eŋinipo na nɛ Livaiebi nɛ baa kute mbra na be afito a sa basa na kaŋɛ: “Kabre la kachɛ cheembi nna n sa Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na. Amoso k maŋ daga fanɛ men baa shu a wora kuwɔr be asheŋ.”

english_verse: Nehemiah told the people, “Enjoy your good food and wine and share some with those who didn't have anything to bring. Don't be sad! This is a special day for the Lord, and he will make you happy and strong.”
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ Nehemaya kaŋɛ basa na: “Naniere men yɔ epe n ya wora kejigboŋ n ji menyi be nnɔ nseŋ ku ajibi na be ako n sa bumo nɛ b maŋ kɔ shɛŋ nɛ b ji na. Kabre la kachɛ cheembi nna n sa Enyɛnpe anyi be Ebɔrɛ na. Amoso men sa maŋ shin nɛ men be ŋgbene a baa jija menyi. Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ beeŋ sa menyi kagbenefuli nɛ k beeŋ sa menyi eleŋ.”

english_verse: The Levites encouraged the people by saying, “This is a sacred day, so don't worry or mourn!”
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Livaiebi na bee nite a kulti a leŋ basa na to fanɛ b yige kushu n saa maŋ shin nɛ bumo be ŋgbene e baa jija bumo kachɛ cheembi ere.

english_verse: When the people returned to their homes, they celebrated by eating and drinking and by sharing their food with those in need, because they had understood what had been read to them. Celebrating the Festival of Shelters
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ basa na kikɛ lar n yɔ bumo peana n ya ji nseŋ nuu kagbenefuliso Bumo alɛ daŋ chige ajibi nɛ asɔnuuso nna n sa beko, ŋkpal manɛ so, b pin kusɔ nɛ mbra nɛ b kraŋ n sa bumo na bee ŋini. Kebaawɔ Abuu to be Kachɛgboŋ na be asheŋ

english_verse: On the second day of the seventh month, the leaders of all the family groups came together with the priests and the Levites, so Ezra could teach them the Law
translation_verse: Kumo be ŋklade nɛ nnaŋ to be benimuana na kikɛ, nɛ bɔrɛmatopoana na nɛ Livaiebi na yɔ Ɛzra kutɔ nɛ e ya ŋini bumo mbra na.

english_verse: that the Lord had given to Moses. They learned from the Law that the people of Israel were to live in shelters when they celebrated the festival in the seventh month of the year.
translation_verse: B ba pin fanɛ mbra nɛ Ebɔrɛ bɔla bumo nananyɛn Mosis so n sa bumo na bee ŋini fanɛ jemanɛ kama nɛ baa ji Abuu to be Kachɛgboŋ na kufɔl shunusopo na to na, a daga fanɛ b baa yuu abuu nɛ a maa chɛr nsaa wɔ amo to hale nɛ kachɛgboŋ na e fo ekar.

english_verse: They also learned that they were to go into the woods and gather branches of leafy trees such as olives, myrtles, and palms for making these shelters.
translation_verse: Bumo alɛ daŋ naŋ koya fanɛ a daga fanɛ b ber kebomboŋ efuli na kikɛ so fanɛ b yɔ kupuŋ to n ya ku ndibi nɛ amo be afantaŋ maa gbaŋgbaŋ fanɛ ɔlifdibi nɛ ŋkubadibi be ayabi m ba yuu abuu na.

english_verse: So the people gathered branches and made shelters on the flat roofs of their houses, in their yards, in the courtyard of the temple, and in the open areas around the Water Gate and Ephraim Gate.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ basa na ya ku ndibi nɛ amo be afantaŋ maa gbaŋgbaŋ na be ayabi m ba yuu abuu bumo be achoŋiana so nɛ bumo be elaŋ to be alɔnɛ so nɛ bɔrɛlambu na be kelɔnɛ so nɛ alɔnɛ nɛ a dese m mata mbuna nɛ baa tre Nchu be Kabuna nɛ Efrayim be Kabuna ase na so.

english_verse: On each of the first seven days of the festival, Ezra read to the people from God's Law. Then on the eighth day, everyone gathered for worship, just as the Law had said they must.
translation_verse: Baŋ yili kachɛ nɛ b fara kachɛgboŋ na be keji n ya fo kumo be kachɛ shunusopo na, Ɛzra daa kraŋ mbra be kawɔl na nna a sa basa na karechɛ kikɛ. Kachɛ burwasopo na nɛ ekama gama abar so nɛ b bunyaŋ Ebɔrɛ, fanɛ kananɛ mbra na ŋini na.

english_verse: On the twenty-fourth day of the seventh month, the people of Israel went without eating, and they dressed in sackcloth and threw dirt on their heads to show their sorrow.
translation_verse: Kufɔl shunusopo na be kachɛ adunyɔ nɛ ana na nɛ Israɛlebi na shɛr ŋ kishi nseŋ buu nli be nle nseŋ wora eshishɛr ŋ gbiti bumo be amu to a ŋini bumo be ŋgbene ka jija bumo ŋkpal bumo be alubi so so.

english_verse: They refused to let foreigners join them, as they met to confess their sins and the sins of their ancestors.
translation_verse: B daŋ barga bumo amu ashi befɔ na kutɔ nna nseŋ ya yili m bugi to ŋ kaŋɛ bumo nɛ bumo nanaana be alubi nɛ b wora.

english_verse: For three hours they stood and listened to the Law of the Lord their God, and then for the next three hours they confessed their sins and worshiped the Lord.
translation_verse: Awa asa nɛ b yil a nu b ka bee kraŋ Enyɛnpe bumo be Ebɔrɛ na be mbra be kawɔl na. Kumo be kaman nɛ b naŋ ta awa asa malɛ ŋ kule Ebɔrɛ ŋ kaŋɛ bumo be alubi nseŋ bunyaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.

english_verse: Jeshua, Bani, Kadmiel, Shebaniah, Bunni, Sherebiah, Bani, and Chenani stood on the special platform for the Levites and prayed aloud to the Lord their God.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Joshuwa nɛ Kadmiɛl nɛ Bani nɛ Shebania nɛ Bunni nɛ Sherebia nɛ Bani nɛ Chenani dii n yili kejaŋ nɛ k yuu n sa Livaiebi na so ŋ kule Enyɛnpe bumo be Ebɔrɛ na awɔrso.

english_verse: You alone are the Lord, Creator of the heavens and all the stars, Creator of the earth and those who live on it, Creator of the ocean and all its creatures. You are the source of life, praised by the stars that fill the heavens.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ basa na kule Ebɔrɛ ŋ kaŋɛ: “Fo nawule e la Enyɛnpe anyi be Ebɔrɛ na. Fo e to ebɔrɛso nɛ achɛkpabi kikɛ, Fo e to kasawule nɛ asɔ nɛ e wɔ kumo so kikɛ. Fo e to teku nɛ kumo to be asɔ keniso kikɛ Ŋkpa kikɛ shi fo kutɔ nna, nɛ achɛkpabi nɛ a wɔ awɔlpa to kikɛ bee fur fo a kpaŋ fo.

english_verse: You are the Lord our God, the one who chose Abram— you brought him from Ur in Babylonia and named him Abraham.
translation_verse: Fo e la Enyɛnpe anyi be Ebɔrɛ Fo e lara an nananyɛn Eebram dra dra na ashi kade nɛ baa tre Ur nɛ k wɔ Babilɔn be efuli so nseŋ chɛrga mbe ketre ŋ ki Eebraham na.

english_verse: Because he was faithful, you made an agreement to give his descendants the land of the Canaanites and Hittites, of the Amorites and Perizzites, and of the Jebusites and Girgashites. Now you have kept your promise, just as you always do.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal e ka daa ji kashenteŋ a sa fo so fo nɛ mo daŋ wora kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre nna fanɛ feeŋ ta Keenanebi nɛ Hitebi nɛ Amɔriebi nɛ Pɛrizebi nɛ Jebusiebi nɛ Giigaebi be nsawule n sa mbe kaman to ebi. Naniere fo wora fo kɔnɔ naseso na m bɔlɔ so fanɛ kananɛ fee wora saŋkikɛ na.

english_verse: When our ancestors were in Egypt, you saw their suffering; when they were at the Red Sea, you heard their cry for help.
translation_verse: An nanaana ka daa wɔ Ijipt be efuli so na, fo daŋ wu awurfoŋ nɛ b daa ji. B ka ya fo Teku Peper na ase nɛ b shu a fin fo kechɛto, nɛ fo alɛ nu bumo be kushu nseŋ chɛ bumo to.

english_verse: You knew that the King of Egypt and his officials and his nation had mistreated your people. So you worked fearsome miracles against the Egyptians and earned a reputation that still remains.
translation_verse: Fo daa nyi kananɛ Ijipt be ewurgboŋ Fɛɛro nɛ mbe ekrachiana nɛ efuli na kikɛ be basa daŋ kɔrfɛ fo basa. Amoso fo daŋ wora emamachisheŋ nɛ e bee keta kufu nna ŋ gbiti Ijipt be efuli so be ewura Fɛɛro nɛ mbe basa nseŋ nya ketre lela nɛ k wɔtɔ hale nɛ mbre.

english_verse: You divided the deep sea, and your people walked through on dry land. But you tossed their enemies in, and they sank down like a heavy stone.
translation_verse: Fo e daŋ shin nɛ Teku chiŋgeliŋ na ku to nɛ fo basa nite kasawule wɔlso so m bɔla kumo to n dii n choŋ. Ama fo daŋ shin nna nɛ bumo doŋana bre mur nchu na to nna fanɛ kananɛ kejembu bee tɔr nchu to na.

english_verse: Each day you led your people with a thick cloud, and at night you showed the way with a flaming fire.
translation_verse: B ka dii teku na be kaman, karechɛ kikɛ fo daa bɔla awɔlpa to nna a juŋkpar fo basa kapaso, nsaa bɔla edɛ be kabɔlpi so a juŋkpar a ŋini bumo ekpa kanyɛso.

english_verse: At Sinai you came down from heaven, and you gave your people good laws and teachings that are fair and honest.
translation_verse: Fo daŋ shi ebɔrɛso nna ŋ gbelge m ba Sainai be kebee na so m ba sa fo basa mbra nɛ keŋini nɛ a walɛ ga n sa bumo.

english_verse: You commanded them to respect your holy Sabbath, and you instructed your servant Moses to teach them your laws.
translation_verse: Fo yili kumo n sa bumo fanɛ b baa ta fo kewushiachɛ na fanɛ kachɛ cheembi. Fo daŋ kaŋɛ fo kayɛrbi Mosis nna fanɛ e ŋini bumo fo mbraana na.

english_verse: When they were hungry, you sent bread from heaven, and when they were thirsty, you let water flow from a rock. Then you commanded them to capture the land that you had solemnly promised. *
translation_verse: Akoŋ ka daŋ pɛ bumo fo sa bumo ajibi nɛ a shi ebɔrɛso nna. Achukoŋ ka daa kɔ bumo, fo daŋ shin nɛ nchu lar kefalta to nna nɛ b nuu. Kumo be kaman nɛ fo kaŋɛ bumo fanɛ b kɔ n suge kasawule nɛ fo nase kumo be kɔnɔ na nna.

english_verse: not even when they made an idol shaped like a calf and insulted you by claiming, “This is the god who rescued us from Egypt.”
translation_verse: fo daa maŋ lar bumo kaman.” B daa tege fo nna a kaŋɛ: “Kegbir nɛ k kɔ n suge anyi ashi Ijipt be efuli so nna na.”

english_verse: Because of your great mercy, you never abandoned them in the desert. And you always guided them with a cloud by day and a fire at night.
translation_verse: “Ŋkpal fo kuwɔrwu ka shi ga so fo daa ŋini bumo ekpa nna saŋkikɛ, fo alɛ daa maŋ yige bumo n lɛ keshishɛrsawule so. Fo daa bɔla kuwɔlpa so nna a ŋini bumo ekpa kapaso nsaa bɔla edɛ be kabɔlpi so a juŋkpar bumo kanyɛso.

english_verse: You took good care of them, and for forty years they never lacked a thing. Their clothes didn't wear out, and their feet were never swollen.
translation_verse: Fo daŋ keni bumo so nɛnɛ, Nfɛ adena nɛ shɛŋ maŋ tir bumo. Bumo be asɔbuuso daa maŋ wu. Bumo be asɛbta daa maŋ ji, nɛ bumo be aya malɛ daa maŋ puŋi.

english_verse: You brought them into the land that you had promised their ancestors, and you blessed their nation with people that outnumbered the stars in the sky.
translation_verse: Fo daŋ bar bumo kasawule nɛ fo nase kumo be kɔnɔ n sa bumo nanaana na so nna. Kumo be kaman nɛ fo nɛfa bumo nɛ k wora fanɛ bumo be efuli so be basa ka daa shi a chɔ achɛkpabi nɛ e wɔ awɔlpa to na.

english_verse: They captured strong cities and rich farmland; they took furnished houses, as well as cisterns, vineyards, olive orchards, and numerous fruit trees. They ate till they were satisfied, and they celebrated your abundant blessings.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ b suge ndegboŋ nɛ egbalana kulti na nɛ adɔsawule nɛ e walɛ. B daŋ suge nwu nɛ basa daa wɔ amo to nɛ atirbu nɛ b kur n laa to a saŋ nchu, nɛ ndibi sɔrso be adɔana, nɛ ɔlifs be ndibi be adɔana nɛ ndibi sɔrso damtaana nna. B daa ji nna a moɛ nseŋ daa ji eyur ŋkpal fo enɛfa damta so.

english_verse: In spite of this, they rebelled and disobeyed your laws. They killed your prophets, who warned them to turn back to you, and they cursed your name.
translation_verse: Ade kikɛ be kaman b kraŋ lar fo kaman nseŋ kini kewora fo mbra kasonu. B daŋ mɔ fo anebiana nɛ b daŋ kpele bumo kusoe fanɛ b bɛta m ba fo kutɔ na nna. Kumo be kaman nɛ b shoduu fo ketre.

english_verse: So you handed them over to their enemies, who treated them terribly. But in their sufferings, they begged you to help. From heaven you listened to their prayers and because of your great mercy, you sent leaders to rescue them.
translation_verse: Amoso fo ta bumo nna m bɔɔ bumo doŋana enɔ, nɛ b kɔrfɛ bumo ga. Ama bumo be awurfoŋ na to, b daŋ kule fo fanɛ fo chɛ bumo to nna. Ebɔrɛso nɛ fo wɔ nseŋ nu bumo be kekule, ŋkpal fo kuwɔrwu ka shi ga so, fo daŋ shuŋi bejuŋkparpo nna nɛ b ba kɔ n suge bumo ashi bedoŋ be enɔ to.

english_verse: But when they were at peace, they would turn against you, and you would hand them over to their enemies. Then they would beg for help, and because you are merciful, you rescued them over and over again.
translation_verse: Ama b baŋ nya kayurwushi, baa kilgi nna a wora alubi a da fo so, nɛ fo naŋ ta bumo m bɔɔ bumo doŋana enɔ. Kumo be kaman nɛ b naŋ kule n fin fo kechɛto, ŋkpal fo kuwɔrwu ka shi ga so, fo naŋ laŋɛ m mɔlga bumo.

english_verse: You warned them to turn back and discover true life by obeying your laws. But they stubbornly refused and continued to sin.
translation_verse: Fo kpele bumo kusoe fanɛ b bɛ fo keŋini so ama ŋkpal bumo be kamoowuso, b kini kebɛ fo mbra na so amo nɛ esa beeŋ bɛ so nseŋ nya kebaawɔtɔ lela, ama ŋkpal bumo be ŋgbene kpakpaso so b kini kewora fo kasonu.

english_verse: For years, you were patient, and your Spirit warned them with messages spoken by your prophets. Still they refused to listen, and you handed them over to their enemies.
translation_verse: Nfɛ damta nɛ fo kpele bumo kusoe kanyitiso, fo Kiyoyu malɛ bɔla anebiana so m malga kenishipereso n sa bumo, ama b kini kenu n sa fo. Amoso nɛ fo ta bumo bɔɔ bumo doŋana enɔ na.

english_verse: But you are merciful and kind, and so you never forgot them or let them be destroyed.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal fo kuwɔrwu kaa shi ga so, fo maŋ pal kaman n sa bumo ŋko m mur bumo na, ŋkpal manɛ so, fo la kuwɔrwu be Ebɔrɛ nna.

english_verse: Our God, you are powerful, fearsome, and faithful, always true to your word. So please keep in mind the terrible sufferings of our people, kings, leaders, priests, and prophets, from the time Assyria ruled until this very day.
translation_verse: O, anyi be Ebɔrɛ mo nɛ eleŋ kikɛ bɔɔ fo enɔ, nɛ fo asheŋ kɔ kufu; fo maa lar fo kamalga kaman kikɛ, kasha malɛ bɔlɔ fo to kiŋkiŋ. Nyiŋi awurfoŋ nɛ k ba anyi nɛ anyi be bewura nɛ bejuŋkparpo nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ anebiana nɛ an nanaana nɛ anyi be basa kikɛ so, yili Asiriya be ewura be jemanɛ kikɛ so m ba fo kabre.

english_verse: You have always been fair when you punished us for our sins.
translation_verse: Fo kɔ ekpa nɛ fo tɔrɔ anyi ŋkpal fo kashenteŋ so, ama fo yige alubi nɛ an wora ere kikɛ m paŋ anyi.

english_verse: Our kings and leaders, our priests and ancestors have never obeyed your commands or heeded your warnings.
translation_verse: Anyi be bewura nɛ bejuŋkparpo nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ an nanaana maŋ bɛ fo mbra nɛ mmalga kpakpaso mo nɛ fo ŋini bumo fanɛ b bɛ so na so.

english_verse: You blessed them with a kingdom and with an abundance of rich, fertile land, but they refused to worship you or turn from their evil.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal fo nɛfa nɛ fo daŋ ta n sa fo basa so bewura e daa juŋkpar bumo. Loŋ be saŋɛ na, nɛ b daa wɔ kasawule nɛ fo ta n sa bumo na so, ama b kini nsaa wɔ kulubi to.

english_verse: Now we are slaves in this fruitful land you gave to our ancestors.
translation_verse: Kabre an ki anya ashi kasawule lela nɛ fo ta n sa an nanaana fanɛ b baa ji kumo be tɔnɔ na; an ki anya kashenteŋto.

english_verse: Its plentiful harvest is taken by kings you placed over us because of our sins. Our suffering is unbearable, because they do as they wish to us and our livestock. The People Make an Agreement
translation_verse: Kasawule na malɛ be asɔrso lela kikɛ ki bewura nɛ fo lara fanɛ b baa ji kuwura anyi so ŋkpal anyi be alubi so na peya nna; bumo alɛ naa ji eleŋ anyi nɛ anyi be asɔbɔya so, ŋkpal loŋ so an wɔ kagbenejija to nna.”

english_verse: And so, a firm agreement was made that had the official approval of the leaders, the Levites, and priests.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal le so an sibɛ ŋkre kpakpaso n nase, nɛ anyi be bejuŋkparpo nɛ Livaiebi nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana shuli so nɛ ŋkre na yili.

english_verse: As governor, I signed the agreement together with Zedekiah and the following priests:
translation_verse: Basa nɛ b daŋ yisi enɔ nɛ ŋkre na yili e la Hakalia pibinyɛn Nehemaya nɛ e la gomena na nɛ Zɛdikaya nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana

english_verse: Seraiah, Azariah, Jeremiah, Pashhur, Amariah, Malchijah, Hattush, Shebaniah, Malluch, Harim, Meremoth, Obadiah, Daniel, Ginnethon, Baruch, Meshullam, Abijah, Mijamin, Maaziah, Bilgai, and Shemaiah.
translation_verse: Seria nɛ Azariya nɛ Jɛremaya, nɛ Paasha nɛ Amariya nɛ Malkija nɛ Haatush nɛ Shebania nɛ Maluk nɛ Harim nɛ Meremɔf nɛ Obadaya nɛ Danɛl nɛ Ginetɔn nɛ Baruk nɛ Mɛshulam nɛ Abija nɛ Mijamin nɛ Mazia nɛ Bilgai nɛ Shemaya.

english_verse: The Levites who signed were: Jeshua son of Azaniah, Binnui from the clan of Henadad, Kadmiel,
translation_verse: Livaiebi nɛ bumo alɛ gba yisi enɔ e la, Azariya pibinyɛn Joshuwa nɛ Binui nɛ e shi Henadad Kadmiɛl be kabuna,

english_verse: Mica, Rehob, Hashabiah,
translation_verse: nɛ Maika nɛ Rehɔb nɛ Hashabia

english_verse: Zaccur, Sherebiah, Shebaniah,
translation_verse: nɛ Zakɔɔ nɛ Sherebia nɛ Shebania

english_verse: Hodiah, Bani, and Beninu.
translation_verse: nɛ Hodia nɛ Bani nɛ Beninu na.

english_verse: The leaders who signed were: Parosh, Pahath Moab, Elam, Zattu, Bani,
translation_verse: Bejuŋkparpo na malɛ e daa la Parosh nɛ Pahaf Mowab nɛ Elaa nɛ Zaatu nɛ Bani,

english_verse: Bunni, Azgad, Bebai,
translation_verse: nɛ Buuni nɛ Azgad nɛ Bebai,

english_verse: Adonijah, Bigvai, Adin,
translation_verse: nɛ Adonija nɛ Bigvai nɛ Adin,

english_verse: Ater, Hezekiah, Azzur,
translation_verse: nɛ Atɛr nɛ Hɛzekaya nɛ Azzu,

english_verse: Hodiah, Hashum, Bezai,
translation_verse: nɛ Hodia nɛ Haashum nɛ Bɛzai,

english_verse: Hariph, Anathoth, Nebai,
translation_verse: nɛ Harif nɛ Anatɔf nɛ Nebai,

english_verse: Magpiash, Meshullam, Hezir,
translation_verse: nɛ Magpiash nɛ Mɛshulam nɛ Heza,

english_verse: Meshezabel, Zadok, Jaddua,
translation_verse: nɛ Meshezabe nɛ Zadɔk nɛ Jadua,

english_verse: Pelatiah, Hanan, Anaiah,
translation_verse: nɛ Pelatia nɛ Hanan nɛ Anaya,

english_verse: Hoshea, Hananiah, Hasshub,
translation_verse: nɛ Hoshia nɛ Hananiya nɛ Hashuub,

english_verse: Hallohesh, Pilha, Shobek,
translation_verse: nɛ Halohɛsh nɛ Pilha nɛ Shobek,

english_verse: Rehum, Hashabnah, Maaseiah,
translation_verse: nɛ Rehum nɛ Hashabna nɛ Maaseia,

english_verse: Ahiah, Hanan, Anan,
translation_verse: nɛ Ahia nɛ Hanan nɛ Anan,

english_verse: Malluch, Harim, and Baanah. The Agreement
translation_verse: nɛ Maluk nɛ Harim nɛ Baana. Kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre be asheŋ

english_verse: All of us, including priests, Levites, temple guards, singers, temple workers and leaders, together with our wives and children, have separated ourselves from the foreigners in this land and now enter into an agreement with a complete understanding of what we are doing. And so, we now place ourselves under the curse of the Lord our God, if we fail to obey his laws and teachings that were given to us by his servant Moses.
translation_verse: Anyi Israɛlebi na kikɛ, ta bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ Livaiebi nɛ bɔrɛlambu to be bekumpo na nɛ beshɛbompoana na nɛ bɔrɛlambu to be beshumpo na nɛ bejuŋkparpoana na n ta anyi be beche nɛ mbia nɛ b daŋ kikɛ n ti so, barga anyi be amu ashi befɔ nɛ b wɔ kasawule ere so to nna. Naniere an wora kɔnɔkoŋwule nna fanɛ anyeeŋ pin kusɔ nɛ anyee wora to nɛnɛ. Amoso nɛ an baŋ maŋ naŋ wora Enyɛnpe anyi be Ebɔrɛ na be mbra nɛ keŋini nɛ e ta m bɔla mbe kayɛrbi Mosis so n sa anyi na kasonu, kumo ere Ebɔrɛ be kɔnɔsho e ba anyi so.

english_verse: We won't let our sons and daughters marry foreigners.
translation_verse: Anyi maaŋ shin nɛ anyi be mbicheso e kil befɔ.

english_verse: We won't buy goods or grain on the Sabbath or on any other sacred day, not even from foreigners. Every seven years we will let our fields rest, and we will cancel all debts.
translation_verse: Anyi alɛ maaŋ tɔ asɔ, hale ajibi jiso gba esa kikɛ kutɔ Kewushiachɛ na ŋko kachɛ cheembi kikɛ. Kafɛ shunusopo kikɛ, anyeeŋ shin nɛ anyi be adɔsawule e dese n wushi. Anyi alɛ beeŋ ta basa be akɔ nɛ b ji anyi ŋ kɛ bumo loŋ be jemanɛ na.

english_verse: Once a year we will each donate a small amount of silver to the temple of our God.
translation_verse: An yili kumo nna fanɛ kafɛ kikɛ anyeeŋ sa gbiti be ndarbi gbrɛbi n chɛ Ebɔrɛ be lambu to be kushuŋ to.

english_verse: This is to pay for the sacred bread, as well as for the daily sacrifices and special sacrifices such as those offered on the Sabbath and during the New Moon Festival and the other festivals. It will also pay for the sacrifices to forgive our sins and for all expenses connected with the worship of God in the temple.
translation_verse: Amansherbi na beeŋ chɛ to ŋ ka ebodobodo cheembi na nɛ karechɛ kikɛ be esarga chɔɔso nɛ ayu be esarga na nɛ esargagboŋ nɛ baa lara Kewushiachɛ nɛ Kufɔl Popɔr be Kachɛgboŋ nɛ nchɛgboŋ nɛ a ka na kikɛ be kukɔ. Amo alɛ beeŋ naŋ ka anyi be alubi be ketampaŋ be esarga nɛ kabɔrɛshuŋ be kukɔ kikɛ ashi bɔrɛlambu na to.

english_verse: We have decided that the families of priests, Levites, and ordinary people will supply firewood for the temple each year, so that sacrifices can be offered on the altar, just as the Lord our God has commanded.
translation_verse: Anyi alɛ naŋ yili kumo fanɛ kafɛ kikɛ bɔrɛmatapoana na nɛ Livaiebi nɛ basa na to be bebɔlpo na be nnaŋ to be basa beeŋ baa bar ndibi puga edɛ bɔrɛlambu na to nna, saŋɛ na so baaŋ tiŋ a lara esarga bɔrɛsure na so, fanɛ kananɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na yili kumo na.

english_verse: Each year we will bring to the temple the first part of our harvest of grain and fruit.
translation_verse: Kafɛ kikɛ anyeeŋ baa bar anyi be ayu nɛ asɔrso nɛ an juŋkpar n teŋi ŋko n chuge, bɔrɛlambu na to.

english_verse: We will bring our first-born sons and the first-born males of our herds and flocks and offer them to the priests who serve in the temple, because this is what is written in God's Law.
translation_verse: Anyi alɛ beeŋ naŋ bar an gbagba be ewurkoŋ nyɛnso nɛ anyi be ana nɛ mbolpɔ nɛ mboe be ewurkoŋ nyɛnso bɔrɛlambu na to m ba sa bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ baa shuŋ ndoŋ na nɛ b ta m bɔɔ Ebɔrɛ enɔ. Ŋkpal manɛ so, kusɔ nɛ k sibɛ a dese Ebɔrɛ be mbra to nna na.

english_verse: To the priests in the temple of our God, we will bring the bread dough from the first harvest, together with our best fruit, and an offering of new wine and olive oil. We will bring ten percent of our grain harvest to those Levites who are responsible for collecting it in our towns.
translation_verse: Anyi alɛ beeŋ naŋ bar aboyu nyifu nɛ an fara ŋ kɔr m ba sa bɔrɛmatapoana na ashi bɔrɛlambu na to. Amo nɛ asɔrso nɛ a walɛ ga na nɛ yabra popɔr nɛ ɔlif be ŋku. Anyeeŋ bar anyi be ayu teŋiso be kudu kudusopo m ba sa Livaiebi nɛ baa nite a sɔ asɔ ashi ndeana na to na.

english_verse: A priest from the family of Aaron must be there when we give this to the Levites. Then the Levites will put one tenth of this part in the temple storeroom,
translation_verse: A daga bɔrɛmatapo nɛ e shi Ɛɛrɔn be kanaŋ to ka wɔtɔ jemanɛ nɛ Livaiebi na beeŋ sɔ kudukudusopo na ashi nde nɛ baa shuŋ to na kikɛ. Kumo be kaman nɛ Livaiebi na gba e lara bumo be kudukudusopo m ba sa Ebɔrɛ ashi mbe bɔrɛlambu nɛ kumo be ebu nɛ baa yili bumo be ajibi nɛ asɔwurbi na to.

english_verse: which is also the place for the sacred objects used by the priests, the temple guards, and the singers. Levites and everyone else must bring their gifts of grain, wine, and olive oil to this room. We will not neglect the temple of our God.
translation_verse: Israɛl be basa nɛ Livaiebi na daga fanɛ b bar bumo be nyifu nɛ asɔnuuso, nɛ ɔlif be ŋku kakpa nɛ baa yili bɔrɛlambu na to be asɔ nɛ b kɔ a daŋɛ nɛ asɔ jito na. Bɔrɛlambu na be kakpa nɛ bekenipo nɛ beshɛbompoana nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana na wɔ na. Anyi maaŋ kplaŋ anyi be Ebɔrɛ na be bɔrɛlambu so kikɛ.

english_verse: The nation's leaders and their families settled in Jerusalem. But there was room for only one out of every ten of the remaining families, and so they asked God to show them who would live there.
translation_verse: Basa na be bejuŋkparpoana na daa wɔ Jerusalɛm to nna nɛ bumo nɛ b ka na malɛ to beri n lara basa kudu kikɛ to be esa koŋwule nɛ e ya chena Jerusalɛm nɛ k la kade cheembi na to nɛ bekpanu nɛ b ka na malɛ a ya chena nde mo nɛ a ka na to. Ŋkpal manɛ so nwu daa maŋ shi Jerusalɛm to.

english_verse: Then everyone else asked God to bless those who were willing to live in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ basa na nɛfa bekama nɛ b shuli fanɛ bumo ere beeŋ yɔ Jerusalɛm n ya chena na.

english_verse: Some of the people of Israel, the priests, the Levites, the temple workers, and the descendants of Solomon's servants lived on their own property in the towns of Judah. But the leaders of the province lived in Jerusalem with their families. The Judah Tribe
translation_verse: Bekama nɛ b wɔ nde nɛ a wɔ Juda be efuli so na daŋ chena bumo gbagba be nsawule so nna ashi bumo be nde to nsaa ji bumo be amu so. Bumo e daa la Israɛlebi na be beko nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana na nɛ Livaiebi na nɛ bɔrɛlambu na to be beshumpo na nɛ ewura Sɔlɔmɔn be nyɛrbi be kaman to ebi.

english_verse: From the Judah tribe, two leaders settled in Jerusalem with their relatives. One of them was Athaiah son of Uzziah. His ancestors were Zechariah, Amariah, Shephatiah, Mahalalel, and Perez, the son of Judah. From the descendants of Perez,
translation_verse: Pɛrez mo nanabiana nɛ b daŋ chena Jerusalɛm daa la basa lempo alfa ana nɛ adeshe nɛ aburwa nna.

english_verse: From the Benjamin tribe, three leaders settled in Jerusalem. The first was Sallu son of Meshullam, and the others were Gabbai and Sallai. Sallu's ancestors were Joed, Pedaiah, Kolaiah, Maaseiah, Ithiel, and Jeshaiah. Altogether, there were
translation_verse: Gabai nɛ Salai malɛ la basa nɛ bumo nɛ Sallu be kukurge mata abar nna nɛnɛ. Bumo be kanaŋ to ebi kikɛ la basa alfa akpanu nɛ adunyɔ aburwa nna.

english_verse: Joel son of Zichri was their leader, and Judah son of Hassenuah was second in command. Priests
translation_verse: Zikri pibinyɛn Jowɛl e daa la bumo be ejuŋkparpo nɛ Hassenua pibinyɛn Juda malɛ la bumo be krachigboŋ nyɔsopo mo nɛ e bee keni bumo be kadegboŋ na so.

english_verse: Four priests settled in Jerusalem. The first was Jedaiah; he was the son of Joiarib and the uncle of Jachin.
translation_verse: Bɔrɛmatapoana bena e chena Jerusalɛm to. Emo nɛ e juŋkpar e la Jedaya nɛ mo tuto la Joarib nɛ mo tutokar la Jakin na.

english_verse: The second priest to settle there was Seraiah son of Hilkiah. His ancestors were Meshullam, Zadok, Meraioth, and Ahitub, who had been a high priest.
translation_verse: Enyɔsopo e daa la Seria nɛ mo tuto la Hilkiya nɛ mo alɛ mo tuto la Mɛshulam nɛ mo alɛ mo tuto la Zadɔk nɛ mo alɛ mo tuto la Meriɔf nɛ mo tuto la Ahitub nɛ e daa la bɔrɛmatapo nimuso na.

english_verse: Several Levites settled in Jerusalem. First, there was Shemaiah son of Hasshub. His ancestors were Azrikam, Hashabiah, and Bunni.
translation_verse: Livaiebi damta e daŋ chena Jerusalɛm to. Emo nɛ ejuŋkparso e la Hashub pibinyɛn, Shemaya nɛ mo nananyɛnana la Azrikam nɛ Hashabia nɛ Buuni.

english_verse: Next, there were Shabbethai and Jozabad, the Levite leaders in charge of the work outside the temple.
translation_verse: Bumo nɛ b bɛ so e la Shabbeta nɛ Jozabad nɛ b daa la Livaiebi na be benimu nsaa keni bɔrɛlambu na be kowushina be ashuŋ so na.

english_verse: Then there was Mattaniah son of Mica. His ancestors were Zabdi and Asaph. Mattaniah led the temple choir in the prayer of praise. Bakbukiah, who also settled in Jerusalem, was his assistant. Finally, there was Abda son of Shammua; his grandfather was Galal, and his great-grandfather was Jeduthun.
translation_verse: Mika pibinyɛn Mataniya malɛ gba daŋ ti Livaiebi na so. Mo nananyɛnana e daa la Zaabdi nɛ Asaf. Mataniya e daa juŋkpar bɔrɛlambu na to be beshɛbompo be katuŋ nɛ baa bunyaŋ Ebɔrɛ na. Esa nɛ e daa sɔ Mataniya so e la Bakbukia. Shamua malɛ pibinyɛn Abda nɛ e la Galal mo nanabiana gba daa la Livaiebi nɛ b chena Jerusalɛm to na be eko nna. Le be Galal ere shi Jedutum be kanaŋ to nna.

english_verse: The rest of the Israelites, including priests and Levites, lived on their own property in the other towns of Judah.
translation_verse: Israɛlebi be basa nɛ b ka na nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ Livaiebi na kikɛ da chena bumo be amu so nna ashi Juda be efuli so be nde to.

english_verse: But the temple workers lived in the section of Jerusalem known as Ophel, and the two men in charge of them were Ziha and Gishpa.
translation_verse: Jerusalɛm to be kaba nɛ baa tre Ofɛl na, nɛ bɔrɛlambu na to be beshumpo kikɛ na daa wɔ. Ziha nɛ Gishpa malɛ e daa la bumo be bejuŋkparpo.

english_verse: Uzzi son of Bani was the leader of the Levites in Jerusalem. His grandfather was Hashabiah, his great-grandfather was Mattaniah, and his great-great-grandfather was Mica. He belonged to the Asaph clan that was in charge of the music for the temple services,
translation_verse: Bani pibinyɛn mo nɛ baa tre Uzzi nɛ e la Hashabia mo nanabi na e daa keni bumo so ashi Jerusalɛm. Mo nananyɛnana e la Mataniya nɛ Mika nɛ b shi Asaf be kanaŋ to nsaa la bɔrɛlambu na to be beshɛbompo be enimu.

english_verse: though the daily choice of music and musicians was decided by royal decree of the Persian king.
translation_verse: Ewura daŋ nase mbra nna n sa bumo a ŋini kananɛ baaŋ baa juŋkpar nshɛ kebɛso kebɛso ashi bɔrɛlambu na to karechɛ kama.

english_verse: The people of Israel were represented at the Persian court by Pethahiah son of Meshezabel from the Zerah clan of the Judah tribe. The People in the Other Towns and Villages
translation_verse: Mɛshezabel pibinyɛn Pethalia nɛ e shi Zeera be kanaŋ to nsaa la Juda be yiri to be esa na e daa yili Israɛlebi be katelamu to ashi Pɛshiya be efuli so be ewurgboŋ be lambu to. Basa nɛ b wɔ nde pɔtɛ to be asheŋ

english_verse: Some of the people of Judah lived in the following towns near their farms: Kiriath-Arba, Dibon, Jekabzeel,
translation_verse: Basa na be beko daa wɔ ndegboŋ nɛ a mata bumo be ndɔana to na nna. Juda be yiri to ebi daa wɔ Kiriaf Aba nɛ Dibɔn nɛ Jekabzeel nɛ

english_verse: Jeshua, Moladah, Beth-Pelet,
translation_verse: Joshuwa nɛ Molada nɛ Befpɛlɛt

english_verse: Ziklag, Meconah,
translation_verse: nɛ Ziklag nɛ Mɛkona

english_verse: Enrimmon, Zorah, Jarmuth,
translation_verse: nɛ Envimɔn nɛ Zora nɛ Jamaf

english_verse: Zanoah, Adullam, Lachish, and Azekah. In fact, they settled the towns from Beersheba in the south to Hinnom Valley in the north.
translation_verse: nɛ Zanua nɛ Adulam nɛ Lakish nɛ Azika. Ndeana ere kikɛ daa dese Bɛshiba nɛ k wɔ kelargato be kaseto be kaba so nna hale n ya lar Hinnɔm be ketaŋɛ nɛ k wɔ kelargato be esoso ashi Jerusalɛm be kekel to na.

english_verse: The people of Benjamin lived in the towns of Geba, Michmash, Aija, Bethel with its nearby villages,
translation_verse: Nde nɛ Bɛnjamin be yiri to ebi malɛ daa wɔ e la Geeba nɛ Mikmash nɛ Ai nɛ Bɛtɛl nɛ kumo be ndewurbi nɛ

english_verse: Anathoth, Nob, Ananiah,
translation_verse: Anatɔf nɛ Nɔb nɛ Anani

english_verse: Hazor, Ramah, Gittaim,
translation_verse: nɛ Hazɔɔ nɛ Rama nɛ Gitaɛm,

english_verse: Hadid, Zeboim, Neballat,
translation_verse: nɛ Hadid nɛ Zebotim nɛ Nebalaat

english_verse: Lod, and Ono, as well as in Craft Valley.
translation_verse: nɛ Lɔd nɛ Ono, nɛ ketaŋɛ nɛ baa tre Enɔto be beshumpo be Ketaŋɛ na.

english_verse: Several groups of Levites from the territory of Judah were sent to live among the people of Benjamin.
translation_verse: B daŋ yɛr Livaiebi nɛ b daa wɔ Juda be kebonfu to na be galeŋga nna nɛ b ya tu Bɛnjamin be basa na n chena.

english_verse: Many priests and Levites had returned from Babylonia with Zerubbabel and Joshua as their leaders. Those priests were Seraiah, Jeremiah, Ezra,
translation_verse: Bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ Livaiebi nɛ Shealtiɛl pibinyɛn, Zerubabel nɛ Joshuwa daŋ juŋkpar ŋ keta bumo n shi Babilɔn be efuli so kenyaya to m bɛta m ba na be atre nde.

english_verse: The Levites who returned were Jeshua, Binnui, Kadmiel, Sherebiah, Judah, and Mattaniah. They and their assistants were responsible for the songs of praise,
translation_verse: Livaiebi nɛ bumo alɛ gba bɛta m ba e la Joshuwa nɛ Binui nɛ Kadmiɛl nɛ Sherebia nɛ Juda nɛ Mataniya. Bumo nɛ bumo be bechɛtopo e daa juŋkpar a boŋ kapandi be nshɛ.

english_verse: while Bakbukiah and Unno, together with their assistants, were responsible for the choral responses. Descendants of Joshua the High Priest
translation_verse: Bakbukia nɛ Uno nɛ bumo be bechɛtopo malɛ e daa shuli nshɛ nɛ b daa boŋ na so a sa bumo. Bɔrɛmatapo Nimuso Joshuwa be kaman to ebi be asheŋ

english_verse: Joshua was the father of Joiakim, the grandfather of Eliashib, and the great-grandfather of Joiada.
translation_verse: Joshuwa e daa la Joikim mo tuto, nɛ Joikim malɛ daa la Eliashib mo tuto; nɛ Eliashib malɛ daa la Joida mo tuto

english_verse: Joiada was the father of Jonathan and the grandfather of Jaddua. Leaders of the Priestly Clans
translation_verse: nɛ Joida malɛ daa la Jonatan mo tuto; nɛ Jonatan malɛ daa la Jadua mo tuto. Bɔrɛmatapoana be mbuna be benimu be asheŋ

english_verse: When Joiakim was high priest, the following priests were leaders of their clans: Meraiah of the Seraiah clan, Hananiah of Jeremiah,
translation_verse: Saŋɛ so nɛ Joikim daa la bɔrɛmatapo nimuso na bɔrɛmatapoana ere e daa la bumo be mbuna be benimuana: Meeria e daa la Seiria be kabuna be benimu. Hanani malɛ e daa la Jɛremaya be kabuna be enimu.

english_verse: Hashabiah of Hilkiah, and Nethanel of Jedaiah. The Priestly and Levite Families
translation_verse: Hilkiya be kabuna be enimu e la Hashabia nɛ Jedaya malɛ be kabuna be enimu la Netanɛl. Bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ Livaiebi be nnaŋ be asheŋ

english_verse: During the time of the high priests Eliashib, Joiada, Johanan, and Jaddua, and including the time that Darius was king of Persia, a record was kept of the heads of the Levite and priestly families.
translation_verse: Jemanɛ nɛ Eliashib nɛ Joida nɛ Johanan nɛ Jadua daŋ ki bɔrɛmatapo nimusoana kebɛso kebɛso nɛ ewurgboŋ Dariɔs daa ji Pɛshiya be efuli so be kuwura na, b daŋ sibɛ Livaiebi nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana be benimuana be atre n wɔtɔ kawɔl to n nase nna.

english_verse: However, no official record was kept of the heads of the Levite clans after the death of Johanan, the grandson of Eliashib.
translation_verse: Ama Johanan be luwu be kaman, b maŋ naŋ sibɛ Livaiebi be benimuana na be atre n wɔtɔ kawɔl to n nase.

english_verse: Hashabiah, Sherebiah, Jeshua son of Kadmiel, and their assistants organized two choirs of Levites to offer praises to God, just as King David, the man of God, had commanded.
translation_verse: Hashabia nɛ Sherebia nɛ Kadmɛl pibinyɛn Joshuwa nɛ Binui nɛ basa nɛ baa sɔ bumo so a boŋ nshɛ na e daŋ juŋkpar Livaiebi na be ntuŋ anyɔ m boŋ kapandi be nshɛ m maŋkura Ebɔrɛ fanɛ kananɛ Ebɔrɛ be kayɛrbi ewura Deevid daŋ yili kumo na.

english_verse: Mattaniah, Bakbukiah, Obadiah, Meshullam, Talmon, and Akkub were responsible for guarding the storerooms near the temple gates.
translation_verse: Mataniya nɛ Bakbukia nɛ Obadaya nɛ Mɛshulam nɛ Talmɔn nɛ Akuub e daa la basa nɛ b daa keni ebuana nɛ baa yili asɔ amo to ashi bɔrɛlambu na be mbuna ase na so.

english_verse: All of these men lived during the time of Joiakim and during the time that I was governor and Ezra, a teacher of the Law of Moses, was priest. Nehemiah Dedicates the City Wall
translation_verse: Joshuwa pibinyɛn, ewura Jowakim nɛ mo nananyɛn daa la ewura Jozadak na be jemanɛ to kikɛ nɛ basa ere wɔtɔ. Loŋ be jemanɛ na ma e daa la gomena nɛ Ɛzra nɛ e daa ŋini Mosis be mbra na malɛ daa la bɔrɛmatapo. Nehemaya ka ta Jerusalɛm be egbal na m bɔɔ Ebɔrɛ enɔ be asheŋ

english_verse: When the city wall was dedicated, Levites from everywhere in Judah were invited to join in the celebration with songs of praise and with the music of cymbals, small harps, and other stringed instruments.
translation_verse: Jemanɛ nɛ b daa ta Jerusalɛm be egbal nɛ b lɔŋɛ m pɔr na a bɔɔ Ebɔrɛ enɔ na, b daŋ kela n tre Livaiebi nɛ b wɔ Juda be efuli kikɛ so nna nɛ b ba ta alaŋsɔ be yiri yiri m boŋ kapandi be nshɛ m maŋkura Ebɔrɛ.

english_verse: The Levite singers lived in villages around Jerusalem, and so they came from there, as well as from the villages around Netophah, Beth-Gilgal, Geba, and Azmaveth.
translation_verse: Livaiebi nɛ b la beshɛbompo na daa wɔ ndewurbi nɛ a kulti Jerusalɛm na nna. Amoso bumo be ndeana to nɛ ndewurbi nɛ a kulti Netofa nɛ Bɛf Gilgaal nɛ Gɛba nɛ Azmavɛf na nɛ b daŋ shi m ba kesheŋ wora na to.

english_verse: The priests and Levites held special ceremonies to make themselves holy, and then they did the same for the rest of the people and for the gates and walls of the city.
translation_verse: Bɔrɛmatapoana na nɛ Livaiebi na daŋ fɔrso daŋkare be ekpa so nna ŋ ki cheembi. Kumo be kaman nɛ b wora loŋ n sa basa nɛ b ka na nɛ mbunaana na nɛ kadegboŋ na be egbalana, nɛ amo alɛ gba ki cheembi.

english_verse: I brought the leaders of Judah to the top of the city wall and put them in charge of the two groups that were to march around on top of the wall, singing praises to God. One group marched to the right in the direction of Garbage Gate.
translation_verse: N daŋ shin nɛ Juda be bejuŋkparpoana na dii kadegboŋ na be egbal na so nna nɛ n ta beshɛbompo be ntuŋ anyɔ nɛ b bɛ abar so a nite egbal na so a boŋ nshɛ a di Ebɔrɛ epaŋ na be kekeni so m bɔɔ bumo enɔ. Katuŋ ko daŋ bɛ abar so a nite a yɔ Epi be Kabuna na be kaba so be jisoso nna.

english_verse: Hoshaiah and half of the leaders followed them.
translation_verse: Hoshiya malɛ nɛ bejuŋkparpoana na be bargato daŋ bɛ beshɛbompo na so a yɔ.

english_verse: Then came the priests Azariah, Ezra, Meshullam,
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ Azariya nɛ Ɛzra nɛ Mɛshulam nɛ b la bɔrɛmatapoana na

english_verse: and his relatives, Shemaiah, Azarel, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Nethanel, Judah, and Hanani. They played musical instruments like those that had been played by David, the man of God. And they marched behind Ezra, the teacher of the Law.
translation_verse: nɛ Shamaya nɛ Azarɛl nɛ Mikalai nɛ Gilalai nɛ Maai nɛ Netanɛl nɛ Juda nɛ Hanani kikɛ keta alaŋsɔ a laŋ a bɛ Ɛzra nɛ e la mbra ŋinipo na so. Alaŋsɔ na barkasa nɛ Ebɔrɛ be kenya ewura Deevid daŋ laŋ dra dra na.

english_verse: When they reached Fountain Gate, they climbed the steps to David's City and went past his palace, before stopping at the Water Gate near the eastern wall of the city.
translation_verse: B ka ta n ya fo Kechubu be Kabuna na ase nɛ b dii atemprembi nɛ baa diiso a yɔ ewura Deevid be Kadegboŋ na to na n ya baŋ mbe Lambu na so m bɛta n yɔ egbal nɛ k wɔ Nchu be Kabuna nɛ k wɔ kadegboŋ na be epeŋilarkpa be kaba so ase na.

english_verse: The second group of singers marched along the wall in the opposite direction, and I followed them, together with the other half of the leaders of Judah. We went past Oven Tower, Broad Wall,
translation_verse: Beshɛbompoana na be katuŋ nyɔsopo na malɛ bɛ abar so n sɔ bena so a nite egbal na so nna nɛ ma alɛ bɛ bumo so. Bumo nɛ Juda be bejuŋkparpoana na be bargato nɛ b ka na e daa nite a yɔ. An daŋ nite n ya baŋ Asure be Ebu jeŋgreŋ na so n ya fo Egbal Gboŋ na ase nna.

english_verse: as well as the priests Eliakim, Maaseiah, Miniamin, Micaiah, Elioenai, Zechariah, and Hananiah, who were blowing trumpets.
translation_verse: Bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ b daŋ ti anyi be katuŋ na so a foŋ mbel na e daa la Eliakim nɛ Maaseia nɛ Miniamin nɛ Mikaya nɛ Elionai nɛ Zakareya nɛ Hananiya.

english_verse: God had made the people very happy, and so on that day they celebrated and offered many sacrifices. The women and children joined in the festivities, and joyful shouts could be heard far from the city of Jerusalem. Preparation for Worship
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ daŋ shin nɛ basa na be ŋgbene fuli bumo nna ga, amoso b daŋ ji bumo be amu nna nseŋ lara esarga damta n sa Ebɔrɛ. Beche nɛ mbia kikɛ daŋ ti kayurji na so nna. Esa daa wɔ kufɔ nɛ Jerusalɛm be kadegboŋ na gba e daa beeŋ nu awɔr nɛ basa na daa wora kagbene fuli so na.

english_verse: On that same day, some leaders were appointed to be responsible for the safekeeping of gifts for the temple and to be in charge of receiving the first part of the harvest and the ten percent of the crops and livestock that was offered to God. These same leaders also collected the part of crops that the Law of Moses taught was to be given to the Levites. Everyone was pleased with the work of the priests and Levites,
translation_verse: Loŋ be kamɔnchɛ na b daŋ lara basa ko nna fanɛ b baa keni ebuana nɛ baa yili ajibi nɛ asɔ wurbi ashi bɔrɛlambu na to na so nna. Bumo alɛ e naaŋ baa sɔ adɔjibi nɛ b juŋkpar n teŋi na nɛ adɔjibi nɛ asɔbɔya be kudu kudusopo nɛ b lara m ba sa Ebɔrɛ na. Bumo koŋwule na e naaŋ baa sɔ adɔjibi nɛ Mosis be mbra bee ŋini fanɛ b baa bar m ba kaa sa bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ Livaiebi na gba.

english_verse: when they performed the ceremonies to make people acceptable to worship God. And the singers and the temple guards did their jobs according to the instructions given by David and his son Solomon.
translation_verse: Bɔrɛmatapoana na nɛ Livaiebi na be kushuŋ daŋ bɔlɔ ekama kenishi jemanɛ nɛ b daŋ wora edaŋkaresheŋ nɛ a shin nɛ basa na nyalɛ so nseŋ tiŋ n nya m bunyaŋ Ebɔrɛ na nna. Beshɛbompoana na nɛ bɔrɛlambu na to be bekumpo na daŋ shuŋ bumo be ashuŋ nɛnɛ nna fanɛ kananɛ ewura Deevid nɛ mo pibinyɛn ewura Sɔlɔmɔn daŋ yili kumo n sa bumo na.

english_verse: In fact, ever since the days of David and Asaph, there had been song leaders and songs of praise and worship.
translation_verse: Dra na kikɛ ashi ewura Deevid nɛ Asaf be jemanɛ to, beshɛbompo na e naa juŋkparpo basa na a boŋ nshɛ a di Ebɔrɛ epaŋ.

english_verse: On that day when the Law of Moses was read aloud to everyone, it was discovered that Ammonites and Moabites were forbidden to belong to the people of God.
translation_verse: Kachɛ nɛ b kraŋ Mosis be mbra na awɔrso n sa ekama na nɛ kelar efuli fanɛ Ammɔnebi nɛ Mowabebi maŋ daga fanɛ b ti Ebɔrɛ be basa so.

english_verse: Following the reading of the Law of Moses, the people of Israel started sending away anyone who had any foreign ancestors. Nehemiah Makes Other Changes
translation_verse: B ka kraŋ Mosis be mbra na nɛ Israɛlebi na nu so, b daŋ fara a ju basa kama nɛ bumo nanaana daa la befɔ ashi bumo to na nna. Nehemaya ka naŋ gama mbe basa abar so be asheŋ

english_verse: The priest Eliashib was a relative of Tobiah and had earlier been put in charge of the temple storerooms.
translation_verse: Bɔrɛmatapo Eliashib daa la Tobaya mo kurgepo nna nɛ e daŋ shin nɛ e daa keni bɔrɛlambu na to be ebuana nɛ baa yili asɔ amo to na so.

english_verse: So he let Tobiah live in one of these rooms, where all kinds of things had been stored—the grain offerings, incense, utensils for the temple, as well as the tenth of the grain, wine, and olive oil that had been given for the use of the Levites, singers, and temple guards, and the gifts for the priests.
translation_verse: E daŋ shin nna nɛ Tobaya daa wɔ ebuana na be kegboŋgboŋi nɛ baa yili asɔ be yiri yiri fanɛ esarga be aboyu nɛ duwu nɛ bɔrɛlambu na to be asɔ daŋɛso nɛ ashuŋsɔ nɛ ayu nɛ yabra nɛ ɔlif be ŋku be kudu kudusopo nɛ b bar m ba sa Livaiebi nɛ beshɛbompo na nɛ bɔrɛlambu na to be bekumpo na nɛ ŋkɛ nɛ b bar m ba sa bɔrɛmatapoana na kikɛ na to.

english_verse: to return to Jerusalem. Only then did I find out that Eliashib had done this terrible thing of letting Tobiah have a room in the temple.
translation_verse: Ŋ ka bɛta n yɔ na pɔɛŋ nɛ m pin kusɔ lubi nɛ Eliashib wora ŋkpal e ka shin nɛ Tobaya wɔ bɔrɛlambu na be ebu na to so.

english_verse: It upset me so much that I threw out every bit of Tobiah's furniture.
translation_verse: Kedaŋ nu ma agbo ga nna nɛ m bela Tobaya be asɔ kikɛ n lɛ kowu.

english_verse: Then I ordered the room to be cleaned and the temple utensils, the grain offerings, and the incense to be brought back into the room.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ b fɔr ebu na daŋkare be ekpa so nɛ k ki cheembi n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na pɔɛŋ nseŋ bɛta bɔrɛlambu na be asɔ daŋɛso na kikɛ nɛ esarga be ayu na nɛ duwu na n ya wɔtɔ kumo to.

english_verse: I also found out that the temple singers and several other Levites had returned to work on their farms, because they had not been given their share of the harvest.
translation_verse: Ma alɛ naŋ nu fanɛ bɔrɛlambu na to be beshɛbompo nɛ Livaiebi na be galeŋga lar Jerusalɛm to nna m bɛta n yɔ bumo be adɔana to, ŋkpal manɛ so, basa na daa maŋ naa sa bumo ajibi nɛ a bee fo bumo.

english_verse: I called the leaders together and angrily asked them, “Why is the temple neglected?” Then I told them to start doing their jobs.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ n tre bejuŋkparpoana na nseŋ malga agbo so m bishi bumo: “Manɛ nna nɛ men kplaŋ bɔrɛlambu na so?” Kumo be kaman nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ bumo fanɛ b fara a shuŋ bumo be ashuŋ.

english_verse: After this, everyone in Judah brought a tenth of their grain, wine, and olive oil to the temple storeroom.
translation_verse: Kede be kaman nɛ ekama ashi Juda be efuli so bar ayu nɛ yabra nɛ ɔlif be ŋku be kudu kudusopo m ba wɔtɔ bɔrɛlambu na be ebuana nɛ baa yili ajibi amo to na to.

english_verse: Finally, I appointed three men with good reputations to be in charge of what was brought there and to distribute it to the others. They were Shelemiah the priest, Zadok the teacher of the Law, and Pedaiah the Levite. Their assistant was Hanan, the son of Zaccur and the grandson of Mattaniah.
translation_verse: B ka bar amo n loge nɛ n lara basa asa nɛ bumo be kebaawɔtɔ walɛ nɛ esa beeŋ tiŋ n yirda bumo nseŋ shin nɛ baa keni asɔ nɛ basa na bar na so nsaa chige amo to a sa basa. Basa nɛ n lara na e la Shelemaya nɛ e la bɔrɛmatapo na, nɛ Zadɔk nɛ e la mbra ŋinipo na, nɛ Pedaya nɛ e la Livai be esa na. Esa nɛ e daa chɛ bumo to e la Zakku pibinyɛn Hanan nɛ mo nananyɛn daa la Mataniya na.

english_verse: I pray that my God will remember these good things that I have done for his temple and for those who worship there. The Sabbath
translation_verse: Ma, Nehemaya bee kule Ebɔrɛ nna fanɛ e nyiŋi ma ŋkpal asɔ lela nɛ mee wora a sa bɔrɛlambu ere nɛ basa nɛ baa bunyaŋ mo kumo to na so.

english_verse: I also noticed what the people of Judah were doing on the Sabbath. Not only were they trampling grapes to make wine, but they were harvesting their grain, grapes, figs, and other crops, and then loading these on donkeys to sell in Jerusalem. So I warned them not to sell food on the Sabbath.
translation_verse: Ma alɛ daŋ naŋ dara m pin kusɔ nɛ Juda be basa na bee wora Kewushiachɛ na. Mannɛ kebaachichi asɔrso nɛ baa tre greep na so a wora yabra nawule nɛ b daa wora ama b daa teŋi ayu, nsaa chuge egreep nɛ figi be asɔrso nɛ adɔjibi pɔtɛana kikɛ n ti so nna Kewushiachɛ na. Bumo alɛ daa naa ta ekurma a sulɔ amo nna a yɔ Jerusalɛm n ya ka fa. Amoso n daŋ kpele bumo kusoe nna fanɛ b sa maŋ naa fa ajibi Kewushiachɛ.

english_verse: People who had moved to Jerusalem from the city of Tyre were bringing in fish and other things to sell there on the Sabbath.
translation_verse: Basa nɛ b daŋ shi kadegboŋ nɛ baa tre Tayɛ nɛ b daa wɔ Jerusalɛm to na daa bar ekɔrɔtɔ nɛ asɔ pɔtɛana ko nna m ba ka fa ndoŋ Kewushiachɛ na.

english_verse: I got angry and said to the leaders of Judah, “This evil you are doing is an insult to the Sabbath!
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ n nya agbo n fɛa Juda be bejuŋkparpoana so ŋ kaŋɛ: “Kulubi nɛ menyee wora ere, Kewushiachɛ na nɛ menyee keni jiga na!

english_verse: Didn't God punish us and this city because our ancestors did these very same things? And here you are, about to make God furious again by disgracing the Sabbath!”
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ daa maŋ gberge anyi nɛ Jerusalɛm be kadegboŋ be basa ere kusoe nna ŋkpal an nanaana ka daŋ wora asheŋ nɛ anyee wora ere so a? To menyee sha keŋaba Kewushiachɛ na nɛ Ebɔrɛ be agbo e koso, ŋko?”

english_verse: I ordered the gates of Jerusalem to be closed on the eve of the Sabbath and not to be opened until after the Sabbath had ended. Then I put some of my own men in charge of the gates to make certain that nothing was brought in on the Sabbath.
translation_verse: N daŋ yili kumo nna fanɛ pɔɛŋ nɛ Kewushiachɛ na e fara kaaseso na, b ti Jerusalɛm be mbuna na kikɛ nsaa maŋ bugi amo hale nɛ Kewushiachɛ na e ji n choŋ pɔɛŋ. Kumo be kaman nɛ n ta mbuna na be kekeni so be kushuŋ m bɔɔ ŋ gbagba be benyɛn nɛ n lara fanɛ b sa maŋ shin nɛ sheŋ e luri kadegboŋ na to Kewushiachɛ na enɔ.

english_verse: Once or twice some merchants spent the night outside Jerusalem with their goods.
translation_verse: Beeŋ wora fanɛ kela koŋwule ŋko ale anyɔ nɛ eyawujipo ko nɛ bumo be asɔ faso dese Jerusalɛm be kadegboŋ na be kowushina ŋklade.

english_verse: But I warned them, “If you do this again, I'll have you arrested.” From then on, they did not come on the Sabbath.
translation_verse: Ama n daŋ fɛa bumo so nna ŋ kaŋɛ le: “Nɛ men naŋ wora loŋ, meeŋ shin nɛ b pɛ menyi n ti ebu. Yili loŋ be kachɛ na a yɔ, b maŋ naŋ ba Jerusalɛm to Kewushiachɛ kikɛ.

english_verse: I ordered the Levites to make themselves holy and to guard the gates on the Sabbath, so that it would be kept holy. God is truly merciful, and I pray that he will treat me with kindness and bless me for doing this. Mixed Marriages
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ Livaiebi na fanɛ b baa wora bumo be amu cheembi nsaa kuŋ Jerusalɛm be kadegboŋ na be mbuna na Kewushiachɛ kikɛ, saŋɛ na so basa beeŋ ta kumo ŋ ki kachɛ cheembi nsaa sa kumo bunyaŋ. Ebɔrɛ la ewɔrwupo nna, mee kule mo fanɛ e wu ma kuwɔr nseŋ nɛfa ma ŋkpal kusɔ nɛ mee wora ere so.

english_verse: I discovered that some Jewish men had married women from Ashdod, Ammon, and Moab.
translation_verse: Ma alɛ daŋ naŋ wu fanɛ Juwebi na be benyɛn ko daŋ ta beche ashi Ashdɔd be kadegboŋ to nɛ Ammɔn nɛ Mowab be efuliana so nna.

english_verse: About half of their children could not speak Hebrew—they spoke only the language of Ashdod or some other foreign language.
translation_verse: Bumo be mbia be bargato daa maa tiŋ a malga Hibruw be ŋgbar. Ashdɔd be ŋgbar nɛ ŋgbar pɔtɛana ko nɛ b daa gbar.

english_verse: So in my anger, I called down curses on those men. I had them beaten and even pulled out the hair of some of them. Then I made them promise: In the name of God we solemnly promise not to let our sons and daughters marry foreigners.
translation_verse: Amoso n daŋ shoduu loŋ be benyɛn agbo so nna nseŋ naŋ shin nɛ b bri beko nseŋ gberge bumo be emin gba n tia. Kumo be kaman nɛ n shin nɛ b nase kɔnɔ ŋ kaŋɛ: ‘An bɔ ntaŋ a nase kɔnɔ Ebɔrɛ be ketre to fanɛ anyi maaŋ shin nɛ anyi be mbinyɛnso ŋko mbicheso e ta ŋko ŋ kil befɔ.’

english_verse: God dearly loved King Solomon of Israel and made him the greatest king on earth, but Solomon's foreign wives led him into sin.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ daŋ sha Israɛl be ewura Sɔlɔmɔn ga nseŋ daŋ shin nɛ durnya to kikɛ be ewura kikɛ maŋ fo mo so, ama beche pɔtɛ nɛ e ta na daŋ shin nɛ e shuŋ agbir nseŋ tɔr kulubi to nna.

english_verse: So we will obey you and not rebel against our God by marrying foreign women.
translation_verse: Amoso anyeeŋ nu n sa fo nsaa maaŋ kil befɔ n lar anyi be Ebɔrɛ kaman n wora kulubi ŋ gbiti mo.”

english_verse: Jehoiada, the son of the high priest Eliashib, had a son who had married a daughter of Sanballat from Horon, and I forced his son to leave.
translation_verse: Joida nɛ mo tuto la bɔrɛmatapo nimuso Eliashib na pibinyɛn ko daŋ ta Sanballat nɛ e shi Bɛf Hɔrɔn na pibiche nna nɛ n ju mo pibinyɛn na n lar Jerusalɛm to.

english_verse: I pray that God will punish them for breaking their priestly vows and disgracing the Levi tribe.
translation_verse: Mee kule Ebɔrɛ nna fanɛ e gberge bumo kusoe ŋkpal b ka wora n da bumo be kabɔrɛmata be atande so nseŋ ŋaba Livai be yiri na so.

english_verse: Then I made sure that the people were free from every foreign influence, and I assigned duties for the priests and Levites.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ n wora ania fanɛ befɔ maaŋ naŋ nya ekpa a leŋ basa na to a wɔtɔ asheŋ lubi to nseŋ naŋ sa bɔrɛmatapoana na nɛ Livaiebi na ashuŋ nɛ baaŋ baa shuŋ jemanɛ kikɛ.

english_verse: I also arranged for the people to bring firewood to the altar each day and for them to bring the first part of their harvest to the temple. I pray that God will bless me for the good I have done.
translation_verse: Ma alɛ daŋ naŋ yili kumo nna fanɛ basa na beeŋ baa bar ndibi puga edɛ bɔrɛsure na ase karechɛ kikɛ nseŋ naa bar bumo be adɔjibi nɛ baaŋ teŋi sososo na bɔrɛlambu na to. Mee kule Ebɔrɛ nna fanɛ e nɛfa ma ŋkpal asɔ lela nɛ mee wora ere so.

english_verse: During the third year of his rule, Xerxes gave a big dinner for all his officials and officers. The governors and leaders of the provinces were also invited, and even the commanders of the Persian and Median armies came.
translation_verse: E ka ji kuwura be kafɛ sasopo to nɛ e wora kejigboŋ n sa mbe benimuana nɛ ekrachiana. Pɛshiya be efuli so nɛ Midia be efuli so be esoji be benimu, n ta bewura nɛ b wɔ efuli na so nɛ bejuŋkparpoana kikɛ e daŋ ba kejigboŋ na to.

english_verse: At the end of this time, King Xerxes gave another dinner and invited everyone in the city of Susa, no matter who they were. The eating and drinking lasted seven days in the beautiful palace gardens.
translation_verse: Afɔl ashe na be kaman, nɛ ewura na naŋ wora kejigboŋ m bɛ abar so nchɛ ashunu n sa Susa be kade to ebi kikɛ. Damawuraana nɛ betirpo kikɛ daŋ yɔ kejigboŋ na to nna ashi ewura na be laŋ nɛ b pɔr egbal ŋ kulti na be kelɔnɛgboŋ na so.

english_verse: The area was decorated with blue and white cotton curtains tied back with purple linen cords that ran through silver rings fastened to marble columns. Couches of gold and silver rested on pavement that had all kinds of designs made from costly bright-colored stones and marble and mother-of-pearl.
translation_verse: B daŋ ta ago be kechɛbi fuful parr nɛ kumo be kechɛbi nɛ k du fanɛ buru nna n wora patisa ŋ kulti kaboŋ na, nseŋ ta kechɛbi peper kunɔkunɔ m bɔla gbiti be mpinibi to n chɛ n chɛ patisa na m mata eshabɔrɛ nɛ b ta yawu kpakpaso be ajembu m pɔr na so. Shuwa nɛ gbiti be asɔ chenaso daa yil ndoŋ be mboŋ nɛ b ta yawu kpakpaso be ajembu nyɛkpɛso be yiri yiri n lɔŋɛ kasawule na so nna.

english_verse: While the men were enjoying themselves, Queen Vashti gave the women a big dinner inside the royal palace.
translation_verse: Jemanɛ nɛ benyɛn na nɛ ewura na bee ji na nɛ ewurche Vashti gba wora kejigboŋ n sa kade na to be beche kikɛ ashi ewura Sɛgsis be laŋ to.

english_verse: By the seventh day, King Xerxes was feeling happy because of so much wine. And he asked his seven personal servants, Mehuman, Biztha, Harbona, Bigtha, Abagtha, Zethar, and Carkas,
translation_verse: Kachɛ shunusopo na nɛ ewura na be kagbene fuli mo ga ŋkpal nsa nɛ e nuu na so, nɛ e tre mbe nyɛrbi ashunu nɛ b fɛl bumo nɛ b wɔ mo kutɔ saŋkikɛ a shuŋ mo na. Bumo e la Mehuman nɛ Bizta nɛ Harbona nɛ Bigta nɛ Abagta nɛ Zeta nɛ Kakas.

english_verse: to bring Queen Vashti to him. The king wanted her to wear her crown and let his people and his officials see how beautiful she was.
translation_verse: E daŋ shuŋi bumo fanɛ b ya shin nɛ ewurche Vashti e buu mbe kuwurwuro m ba mo kutɔ. Ewura na daa sha keta ewurche na nna n ji njɔŋ n ŋini ekrachiana na nɛ mbe befɔ nɛ b ba ndoŋ na kikɛ ŋkpal mbe kebita so.

english_verse: The king's servants told Queen Vashti what he had said, but she refused to go to him, and this made him terribly angry.
translation_verse: Ewura na be nyɛrbi na ka ya kaŋɛ ewurche Vashti kusɔ nɛ ewura na kaŋɛ na, nɛ e kini keba. Ndoŋ nna nɛ Ewura na nya agbo ga nseŋ tinto.

english_verse: The king called in the seven highest officials of Persia and Media. They were Carshena, Shethar, Admatha, Tarshish, Meres, Marsena, and Memucan. These men were very wise and understood all the laws and customs of the country, and the king always asked them what they thought about such matters.
translation_verse: Bumo e la Kashena nɛ Sheta nɛ Admata nɛ Tarshish nɛ Mɛrɛs nɛ Masena nɛ Memukan nɛ b la Pɛshiya nɛ Midia be efuli so be benimugboŋ ashunu nɛ e bee to jina saŋkikɛ na.

english_verse: The king said to them, “Queen Vashti refused to come to me when I sent my servants for her. What does the law say I should do about that?”
translation_verse: Le nɛ e daŋ kaŋɛ bumo: “Ma ewura Sɛgsis e shuŋi n tre ewurche Vashti nɛ e kini keba! Naniere nuso nɛ anyi be mbra bee ŋini fanɛ an wora mo?”

english_verse: Then Memucan told the king and the officials: Your Majesty, Queen Vashti has not only embarrassed you, but she has insulted your officials and everyone else in all the provinces.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Memukan kaŋɛ ewura na nɛ mbe benimuana na le: “Mannɛ ewura ere nawule nɛ ewurche Vashti keni jiga na, ama mbe benimuana nɛ mbe efuli so ebi kikɛ nɛ e keni jiga na.

english_verse: The women in the kingdom will hear about this, and they will refuse to respect their husbands. They will say, “If Queen Vashti doesn't obey her husband, why should we?”
translation_verse: Efuli ere so be beche baŋ nu kusɔ nɛ ewurche Vashti wora ere baaŋ fara a keni bumo kulana jiga. Baaŋ baa kaŋɛ le: ‘Ewura Sɛgsis tre ewurche Vashti nɛ e kini.’

english_verse: Before this day is over, the wives of the officials of Persia and Media will find out what Queen Vashti has done, and they will refuse to obey their husbands. They won't respect their husbands, and their husbands will be angry with them.
translation_verse: Pɛshiya nɛ Midia be benimuana be beche baŋ nu kusɔ nɛ ewurche ere wora, bumo alɛ gba beeŋ fara a wora bumo kulana loŋ kabre kikɛ. Kaplɛkama malɛ be beche beeŋ fara a fɛl bumo kulana, nɛ bumo kulana malɛ e baa nya agbo n wɔtɔ bumo.

english_verse: Your Majesty, if you agree, you should write for the Medes and Persians a law that can never be changed. This law would keep Queen Vashti from ever seeing you again. Then you could let someone who respects you be queen in her place.
translation_verse: Yiramu, nɛ k par fo bre, fo nase mbra nɛ baaŋ sibɛ n wɔtɔ Pɛshiya nɛ Midia be efuli so be mbra be nwɔl to nɛ esa kikɛ maaŋ tiŋ n chɛrga kumo, fanɛ Vashti e sa maŋ naŋ ta keya n cha ewura pe kikɛ. Kumo be kaman nɛ fo ta mbe kuwurche na n sa eche nɛ e bɔ mo.

english_verse: When the women in your great kingdom hear about this new law, they will respect their husbands, no matter if they are rich or poor.
translation_verse: Fo baŋ nase le be mbra ere n sa fo efuli gboŋgboŋi ere kikɛ so ebi bre, beche nɛ b wɔ efuli ere so kikɛ beeŋ baa sa bumo kulana bunyaŋ hale nɛ b la damawuraana ŋko betirpo gba.”

english_verse: and he sent letters to all of his provinces. Each letter was written in the language of the province to which it was sent, and it said that husbands should be in charge of their wives and children.
translation_verse: Ewura na daŋ sibɛ nwɔl yiri kikɛ be ŋgbarto nna n sa mbe efuli so ebi kikɛ fanɛ, k daga kowurnyɛn kikɛ be kamalga ka kɔ eleŋ mbe laŋ to.

english_verse: After a while, King Xerxes got over being angry. But he kept thinking about what Vashti had done and the law that he had written because of her.
translation_verse: Ewura Sɛgsis be agbo ka wushi na kikɛ, nɛ e kraa fɛ kusɔ nɛ Vashti wora na nɛ mbra nɛ mo alɛ nase a yɔ mbe kaplɛa so na be asheŋ.

english_verse: Then the king's personal servants said: Your Majesty, a search must be made to find you some beautiful young women.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ ewura na be besoetojipo nɛ e yirda ga na be beko kaŋɛ mo le: “Shin nɛ b luri to n fin besuŋgurbi nɛ b walɛ abita nsaa maŋ nyi benyɛn m ba sa ewura.

english_verse: You can select officers in every province to bring them to the place where you keep your wives in the capital city of Susa. Put your servant Hegai in charge of them since that is his job. He can see to it that they are given the proper beauty treatments.
translation_verse: Lara fo efuli ere be kaba kama so be ekrachi n shin nɛ b fin besuŋgurbi nɛ b walɛ abita m ba Susa m baa wɔtɔ ewura be laŋ to be kaboŋ nɛ baa wɔtɔ beche nawule na. Nseŋ ta bumo m bɔɔ Heegai nɛ b fɛl nɛ e bee keni beche so na enɔ, nɛ e ŋini bumo kananɛ baŋ baa lɔŋɛ bumo be amu nɛnɛ n lar kebita n ti so.

english_verse: Then let the young woman who pleases you most take Vashti's place as queen. King Xerxes liked these suggestions, and he followed them.
translation_verse: Saŋɛ na so feeŋ lara bumo to be emo nɛ fee sha nɛ e ki ewurche n tal Vashti to.” Ewura na ka nu le be kasotoji ere nɛ e wu fanɛ k walɛ nseŋ bɛ kumo so.

english_verse: At this time a Jew named Mordecai was living in Susa. His father was Jair, and his grandfather Shimei was the son of Kish from the tribe of Benjamin.
translation_verse: Jemanɛ ere so nɛ Juw be kanyɛn nɛ baa tre Mɔdikaya na wɔ Susa. Mo tuto e daa la Jaɛr nɛ mo nananyɛn Shimei malɛ la Kish nɛ e shi Bɛnjamin be kanaŋ to na pibinyɛn.

english_verse: Kish was one of the people that Nebuchadnezzar had taken from Jerusalem, when he took King Jeconiah of Judah to Babylonia.
translation_verse: Mɔdikaya daŋ ti basa nɛ ewura Nebukadneeza nɛ e la Babilɔn be ewura na daŋ pɛ fanɛ anya ashi Jerusalɛm nseŋ tintiŋ bumo n yɔ mbe efuli so, saŋɛ nɛ e daŋ pɛ Juda be ewura Jehowachin na so nna.

english_verse: When the king ordered the search for beautiful women, many were taken to the king's palace in Susa, and Esther was one of them. Hegai was put in charge of all the women,
translation_verse: Ewura na ka sa ebɔl nɛ b bar besuŋgurbi damta ewura be laŋ to be kakpa nɛ baa wɔtɔ beche nawule ashi Susa na, Ɛsta gba daŋ ti bumo so. B daŋ yɛr mo alɛ gba Heegai nɛ e bee keni ewurkpa be beche so na kutɔ nna.

english_verse: and from the first day, Esther was his favorite. He began her beauty treatments at once. He also gave her plenty of food and seven special maids from the king's palace, and they had the best rooms.
translation_verse: Ɛsta be asheŋ daŋ par Heegai ga. Ŋkpal loŋ so, e daa sa mo abitasɔ nɛ ajibi lela nna. Kaboŋ nɛ b wɔtɔ beche na be kakpa lela nɛ e daŋ shin nɛ b ta mo n wɔtɔ nseŋ lara ewurkpa be mbita ashunu nɛ baa shuŋ mo.

english_verse: Mordecai had warned Esther not to tell anyone that she was a Jew, and she obeyed him.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal Mɔdikaya ka ji Ɛsta asoeto so e daa maŋ lara mbe kumu efuli ŋ ŋini bumo fanɛ e la Juw be esa nna.

english_verse: He was anxious to see how Esther was getting along and to learn what had happened to her. So each day he would walk back and forth in front of the court where the women lived.
translation_verse: Karechɛ kama malɛ Mɔdikaya daa nite nna a kulti ewurkpa be kakpa nɛ beche na kikɛ wɔ na be anishito a fin kepin kananɛ Ɛsta du nɛ kusɔ nɛ k bee wora mo.

english_verse: The young women were given beauty treatments for one whole year. The first six months their skin was rubbed with olive oil and myrrh, and the last six months it was treated with perfumes and cosmetics. Then each of them spent the night alone with King Xerxes.
translation_verse: Kafɛ koŋwule nɛ b sa beche na fanɛ b ta n lɔŋɛ bumo be amu n nyalɛ kebita n ti so. Baaŋ ta ŋku nɛ baa tre mir na n lɔŋɛ bumo be eyur so afɔl ashe nseŋ ta etulale malɛ be ŋku n lɔŋɛ bumo be eyur afɔl ashe nɛ a ka na. Kumo be kaman nɛ b yɛr beche na be ekama ewura Sɛgsis be anishito kukoko to.

english_verse: When a young woman went to the king, she could wear whatever clothes or jewelry she chose from the women's living quarters.
translation_verse: Saŋkama nɛ beche na be ekama bee sha nɛ e yɔ ewura na be anishito, kusɔ kama nɛ k par eche na nɛ e bee buu a lar kakpa nɛ b wɔtɔ beche na a yɔ ewura na be anishito.

english_verse: In the evening she would go to the king, and the following morning she would go to the place where his wives stayed after being with him. There a man named Shaashgaz was in charge of the king's wives. Only the ones the king wanted and asked for by name could go back to the king.
translation_verse: Eche na beeŋ yɔ ewura na kutɔ kaaseso nseŋ ya bɛta m ba Shaashgaz nɛ b fɛl nɛ e bee keni ewura be beche so ashi kakpa nɛ beche nawule wɔ na kutɔ kachipurso. Mo alɛ maaŋ naŋ bɛta n yɔ ewura na kutɔ kikɛ ama mbe asheŋ baaŋ par Ewura na nna nɛ e ti mbe ketre n shuŋi n tre mo.

english_verse: Xerxes liked Esther more than he did any of the other young women. None of them pleased him as much as she did, and he immediately fell in love with her and crowned her queen in place of Vashti.
translation_verse: Ɛsta be asheŋ daŋ par ewura na ga nseŋ bɔlɔ mo kenishi nɛ e sha mo a chɔ beche na be ekama. Ŋkpal loŋ so nɛ e ta kuwurche be kuwurwuro n buu mo nɛ e ki ewurche n tal ewurche Vashti to.

english_verse: In honor of Esther he gave a big dinner for his leaders and officials. Then he declared a holiday everywhere in his kingdom and gave expensive gifts. Mordecai Saves the King's Life
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ ewura na shin nɛ b wora kejigboŋ n sa benimuana na nɛ ekrachiana na ŋkpal Ɛsta so. Nseŋ sa ebɔl fanɛ kumo be kachɛ e baa la kewushiachɛ n sa mbe efuli so be basa kikɛ. Ewura na daŋ sa basa ŋkɛ damta gba n ti so. Mɔdikaya ka mɔlga ewura na be ŋkpa be asheŋ

english_verse: When the young women were brought together again, Esther's cousin Mordecai had become a palace official.
translation_verse: Besuŋgurbi na ka naŋ ba gama abar so kela nyɔsopo na, nɛ ewura na teŋ ta Mɔdikaya ŋ ki ewurkpa be krachi.

english_verse: He had told Esther never to tell anyone that she was a Jew, and she obeyed him, just as she had always done.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal Mɔdikaya ka kaŋɛ Ɛsta fanɛ e sa maŋ kaŋɛ esa kama yiri nɛ k la mo so, Ɛsta daa maŋ kaŋɛ esa kikɛ yiri nɛ k la mo. Ɛsta daŋ wora loŋ nna ŋkpal e ka bee wora Mɔdikaya kasonu mbe kebia to kikɛ so.

english_verse: Bigthana and Teresh were the two men who guarded King Xerxes' rooms, but they got angry with the king and decided to kill him.
translation_verse: Jemanɛ nɛ Mɔdikaya daa la ewurkpa be krachi na, nɛ Bigtana nɛ Terɛsh nɛ b fɛl bumo nɛ baa keni ewura be ebu dese to so be kabuna so na, nya agbo n wɔtɔ ewura Sɛgsis nsaa kre mbe kemɔ ŋgbalanto.

english_verse: Mordecai found out about their plans and asked Queen Esther to tell the king what he had found out.
translation_verse: Mɔdikaya ka pin kumo be loŋ, nɛ e nya manaŋ n ya kaŋɛ ewurche Ɛsta nɛ mo alɛ kaŋɛ ewura na kusɔ nɛ Mɔdikaya kaŋɛ mo.

english_verse: King Xerxes learned that Mordecai's report was true, and he had the two men hanged. Then the king had all of this written down in his record book as he watched.
translation_verse: B ka lara basa nɛ b lege kesheŋ na to n ya wu fanɛ k la kashenteŋ nna nɛ b chɛ basa anyɔ na efɔl n shiga ndibi so. Ndoŋ nna nɛ ewura na shin nɛ b yili mbe anishi to n sibɛ loŋ be kesheŋ na n wɔtɔ bumo be adrasheŋ be nwɔl to nɛ k baa la kanyiŋi.

english_verse: Later, King Xerxes promoted Haman the son of Hammedatha to the highest position in his kingdom. Haman was a descendant of Agag,
translation_verse: Asheŋ ere be kaman nɛ ewura Sɛgsis ta kenimu nɛ k bɛ ewura na so na n sa kanyɛn ko nɛ baa tre mo Heman nɛ e la Hammedaata pibinyɛn nseŋ shi Agag be kanaŋ to na.

english_verse: and the king had given orders for his officials at the royal gate to honor Haman by kneeling down to him. All of them obeyed except Mordecai.
translation_verse: Ewura na daŋ tre mbe benimu nɛ baa shuŋ ewurkpa na kikɛ nna, ŋ kaŋɛ bumo fanɛ b baa bunyaŋ Heman nseŋ naa jɔŋɛ mo ase. Nɛ bumo kikɛ bɛ kusɔ nɛ e kaŋɛ na so ama Mɔdikaya nawule.

english_verse: he said, “Because I am a Jew.” They spoke to him for several days about kneeling down, but he still refused to obey. Finally, they reported this to Haman, to find out if he would let Mordecai get away with it.
translation_verse: Saŋkama nɛ b baŋ kaŋɛ Mɔdikaya fanɛ e jɔŋɛ Heman ase, e bee kini nna nseŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ mo ere la Juw be esa nna, amoso e maaŋ jɔŋɛ Heman ase. Ndoŋ nna nɛ b kaŋɛ Heman kumo be asheŋ nsaa keni ŋko e beeŋ yige Mɔdikaya ŋkpal e ka la Juw so.

english_verse: Haman was furious to learn that Mordecai refused to kneel down and honor him.
translation_verse: Heman ka pin fanɛ Mɔdikaya kini kejɔŋɛ mo ase ŋko m bunyaŋ mo, nɛ e nya agbo ga.

english_verse: And when he found out that Mordecai was a Jew, he knew that killing only Mordecai was not enough. Every Jew in the whole kingdom had to be killed.
translation_verse: E ka pin fanɛ Mɔdikaya la Juw be esa nna nɛ e yili kumo fanɛ e maaŋ tɔrɔ Mɔdikaya nawule, nsaa kre nia fanɛ e beeŋ mɔ Juw kama nɛ e wɔ Ewura Sɛgsis be efuli so.

english_verse: It was now the twelfth year of the rule of King Xerxes. During Nisan, the first month of the year, Haman said, “Find out the best time for me to do this.” The time chosen was Adar, the twelfth month.
translation_verse: Ewura Sɛgsis ka ji kuwura be kafɛ kuduanyɔsopo be kufɔl sososo nɛ baa tre Nisan na to, nɛ Heman shin nɛ b to beri a fin kachɛ nɛ k daga fanɛ e wora kusɔ nɛ e bee kre na. Nɛ beri na ya tɔr kufɔl kuduanyɔsopo nɛ baa tre Ada na be nchɛ kuduasa.

english_verse: Then Haman went to the king and said: Your Majesty, there are some people who live all over your kingdom and won't have a thing to do with anyone else. They have customs that are different from everyone else's, and they refuse to obey your laws. We would be better off to get rid of them!
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Heman kaŋɛ ewura Sɛgsis le: “Yiri ko ebi salga to m bɔlɔ fo efuli ere kikɛ so. Bumo alɛ be daŋkare kɔr basa kama peya to. B maa bɛ efuli ere be mbra gba so, amoso m baa nyi geeŋ fanɛ nɛ fo yige bumo, k maaŋ chɛ fo to.

english_verse: The king handed his official ring to Haman, who hated the Jews, and the king told him,
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ ewura na lara mbe kepinibi nɛ e kɔ a dulgi mbe nwɔl sibɛ so na n sa Hammedaata pibinyɛn Heman nɛ e la Juwebi bumo doŋ na

english_verse: “Do what you want with those people! You can keep their money.”
translation_verse: nseŋ kaŋɛ mo le: “Basa na nɛ bumo be amansherbi kikɛ la fo peya nna; amoso wora bumo kusɔ kama nɛ k par fo.”

english_verse: On the thirteenth day of Nisan, Haman called in the king's secretaries and ordered them to write letters in every language used in the kingdom. The letters were written in the name of the king and sealed by using the king's own ring. At once they were sent to the king's highest officials, the governors of each province, and the leaders of the different nations in the kingdom of Xerxes.
translation_verse: Amoso kufɔl sososo na to be kachɛ kuduasasopo na nɛ Heman tre ewura na be nwɔlsibɛpoana na ŋ kaŋɛ bumo fanɛ b kilgi mbe mbra nɛ e nase na n wɔtɔ bumo be efuli na so be ŋgbarana nɛ nsibɛ be yiriana to n chige to n sa bewurbi nɛ benimu nɛ ekrachiana nɛ b wɔ efuli na so na kikɛ. Ewura Sɛgsis be ketre so nɛ b daŋ bɔla n sibɛ nwɔl na nseŋ ta mbe kepinibi n dulgi amo.

english_verse: The letters were taken by messengers to every part of the kingdom, and this is what was said in the letters: On the thirteenth day of Adar, the twelfth month, all Jewish men, women, and children are to be killed. And their property is to be taken.
translation_verse: Mbɔ nɛ b kɔ eleŋ a shile ga na, nɛ b ta nwɔl na n shuŋi fanɛ b chige efuli na so kikɛ. Kusɔ nɛ kawɔl na bee kaŋɛ e la fanɛ b mɔ Juwebi na kikɛ kufɔl kuduanyɔsopo nɛ baa tre Ada na be kachɛ kuduasasopo na to. Kawɔl na bee ŋini fanɛ b mɔ mbia nɛ benimu nɛ beche nɛ mbiwurbi kikɛ kumo be kamɔnchɛ na nseŋ muu bumo be asɔ nɛ b kɔ kikɛ.

english_verse: King Xerxes gave orders for these letters to be posted where they could be seen by everyone all over the kingdom. The king's command was obeyed, and one of the letters was read aloud to the people in the walled city of Susa. Then the king and Haman sat down to drink together, but no one in the city could figure out what was going on.
translation_verse: Ewura Sɛgsis e daŋ shin nɛ b yili jimaŋ to n wora mbra na manaŋ manaŋ ashi Susa be kade to. Ewura na nɛ Heman daŋ chena nna a nuu nsa, nɛ Susa be kade to ebi malɛ be nfɛra bee baga bumo to ŋkpal mbra na so.

english_verse: When Mordecai heard about the letter, he tore his clothes in sorrow and put on sackcloth. Then he covered his head with ashes and went through the city, crying and weeping.
translation_verse: Mɔdikaya ka nu kusɔ nɛ ewura na wora na, nɛ e kpɛa mbe asɔbuuso to kagbenejijaso, nseŋ ta kagbenejijaso be kusɔbuuso m buu n wora nsunɔ n wurge mbe kumu so nsaa shu awɔrso ebesa so a na a kulti kade na to,

english_verse: But he could go only as far as the palace gate, because no one wearing sackcloth was allowed inside the palace.
translation_verse: hale m ba fo ewura na be lambu be kabuna ase. Mo alɛ daa maŋ nya ekpa n luri lambu na to ŋkpal manɛ so esa kama nɛ e buu kagbenejijaso be kusɔbuuso maŋ kɔ ekpa nɛ e luri ndoŋ.

english_verse: In every province where the king's orders were read, the Jews cried and mourned, and they went without eating. Many of them even put on sackcloth and sat in ashes.
translation_verse: Efuli na so be kaplɛkama malɛ nɛ b kraŋ kawɔl na jimaŋ to, Juwebi nɛ b wɔ ndoŋ bee teŋi keeli nna a boŋto a shu. B daŋ kishi nna nseŋ shu ga nɛ bumo be bedamta ta kagbenejijaso be asɔbuuso m buu nseŋ dese nsunɔ to.

english_verse: When Esther's servant girls and her other servants told her what Mordecai was doing, she became very upset and sent Mordecai some clothes to wear in place of the sackcloth. But he refused to take them.
translation_verse: Ɛsta be mbita nɛ benyɛn nɛ b fɛl nɛ baa shuŋ mo na ka kaŋɛ mo Mɔdikaya be asheŋ, nɛ mbe kagbenejija mo ga, nɛ e ta asɔbuuso lela n sa fanɛ b ya sa Mɔdikaya, saŋɛ na so e beeŋ lara kagbenejijaso be asɔbuuso na, nɛ Mɔdikaya kini.

english_verse: Esther had a servant named Hathach, who had been given to her by the king. So she called him in and said, “Find out what's wrong with Mordecai and why he's acting this way.”
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Ɛsta shin nɛ ewura na be benyɛn nɛ b fɛl e la Ɛsta be kayɛrbi, nɛ baa tre mo Hataak na, ya bishi Mɔdikaya kusɔ nɛ k kɔ mo.

english_verse: Hathach went to Mordecai in the city square in front of the palace gate,
translation_verse: Nɛ Hataak yɔ Mɔdikaya kutɔ ashi ewurkpa be kelɔnɛ so.

translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Ɛsta shuŋi ŋ kaŋɛ Mɔdikaya le:

translation_verse: “Shin nɛ Juwebi nɛ b wɔ Susa na kikɛ e ba abar so m ba kishi nchɛ asa nɛ nnyɛ asa ŋ kule Ebɔrɛ n sa ma. Ma alɛ gba nɛ ma mbita beeŋ luri loŋ be ekishi na to. Kumo be kaman, nɛ n yɔ ewura na kutɔ. Hale nɛ mbra maŋ sa ma ekpa gba, meeŋ wora loŋ. Nɛ k la luwu nɛ n wu.”

translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Mɔdikaya ya wora kusɔ kama nɛ Ɛsta kaŋɛ mo na kikɛ.

english_verse: Three days later, Esther dressed in her royal robes and went to the inner court of the palace in front of the throne. The king was sitting there, facing the open doorway.
translation_verse: Ekishi na be kachɛ sasopo nɛ Ɛsta ta mbe kuwurche be kale m buu nseŋ ya yili ewura na be lambubi na be kabuna to. Ewura na malɛ daa tase mbe kuwurputi so nna lambu na to a keni kabuna to.

english_verse: He was happy to see Esther, and he held out the gold scepter to her. When Esther came up and touched the tip of the scepter,
translation_verse: Ewura na ka wu ewurche Ɛsta ka yil kabuna to na, nɛ mbe asheŋ par mo ga, nɛ e teŋi mbe shuwa be kuwurkpabi na ŋ shoŋi mo. Nɛ Ɛsta ya pɛ kuwurkpabi na be kɔnɔso.

english_verse: the king said, “Esther, what brings you here? Just ask, and I will give you as much as half of my kingdom.”
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ ewura na bishi le: “Ewurche Ɛsta, manɛ e kɔ fo? Manɛ nɛ fee sha? Kaŋɛ ma kusɔ kama nɛ k tir fo. Hale ma efuli ere be bargato gba nɛ fee sha, meeŋ ta n sa fo.”

english_verse: Esther answered, “Your Majesty, please come with Haman to a dinner I will prepare for you later today.”
translation_verse: Nɛ Ɛsta kaŋɛ le: “Yiramu! Nɛ k par fo, kumo ere fo nɛ Heman e ba tu ma n ji kejigboŋ kabre kaaseso.”

english_verse: The king said to his servants, “Hurry and get Haman, so we can accept Esther's invitation.” The king and Haman went to Esther's dinner,
translation_verse: Nɛ ewura na shuŋi fanɛ b ya tre Heman manaŋ m ba nɛ b yɔ Ɛsta kutɔ. Nɛ Heman ba, nɛ mo nɛ ewura na yɔ Ɛsta be kejigboŋ na to.

translation_verse: Ama e daŋ ji kanyiti nna n yɔ epe n ya tre mo teriana nɛ mbe eche Zɛrɛsh n shɛr,
