english_verse: Let God All-Powerful force them to drink their own destruction from the cup of his anger.
translation_verse: Shin nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na be agbogboŋ na e ba alubiworapoana gbagba so nɛ b mur cheche.

english_verse: Because after they are dead, they won't care what happens to their children.” Who Can Tell God What To Do?
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, bumo be luwu be kaman kusɔ kama nɛ k beeŋ wora bumo be mbia be asheŋ maaŋ naa tir bumo.

english_verse: Who can tell God what to do? He judges powerful rulers. *
translation_verse: Wanɛ e naŋ tiŋ ŋ kaŋɛ Ebɔrɛ kusɔ nɛ e beeŋ wora? Mo e naa ji basa nɛ b yil eyilikpagboŋ demu.

english_verse: while others die in poverty, having known only pain.
translation_verse: Beko bre ketir nɛ ebesa to nɛ baa wu.

english_verse: But we all end up dead, beneath a blanket of worms.
translation_verse: Ama luwu koŋwule nɛ an kikɛ bee wu nɛ baa puli anyi nɛ ashushombi bee ji anyi.

english_verse: My friends, I know that you are plotting against me.
translation_verse: N nekpaana, n nyi fanɛ menyee kre ma ŋkre lubi nna.

english_verse: You ask, “Where is the home of that important person who does so much evil?”
translation_verse: Menyee bishi fanɛ: ‘Basa gboŋ nɛ baa wora alubi na be elaŋana nɛ b daa wɔ amo to na naa wɔ nnɛ naniere?’

english_verse: that those who do wrong never suffer disaster, when God becomes angry.
translation_verse: fanɛ Ebɔrɛ baŋ nya agbo, basa nɛ baa wora asheŋ lubi maa ji jɛrbi.

english_verse: No one points out their sin or punishes them.
translation_verse: Esa kikɛ maa kaŋɛ bumo alubi nɛ b wora, ŋko a gberge bumo kusoe ŋkpal amo so.

english_verse: Then at their funerals, they are highly praised;
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman, baa kpaŋ bumo ashi bumo be nlibuna nna.

english_verse: the earth welcomes them home, while crowds mourn.
translation_verse: Kasawule gba bee sɔ bumo nɛnɛ nna, nɛ basa damta damta bee shu bumo be nli.

english_verse: What use are we humans to God, even the wisest of us?
translation_verse: “Manɛ be tɔnɔ nɛ edimɛdi kɔ n sa Ebɔrɛ? Hale edimɛdi to be benyiashempo gba maŋ kɔ tɔnɔ n sa mo.

english_verse: If you were completely sinless, that would still mean nothing to God All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Nɛ fanɛ fo, Job, maŋ naŋ wora kulubi ŋ ku so gba, kumo be loŋ kraa maŋ kɔ tɔnɔ n sa Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na bre.

english_verse: No! It's because of your terrible and endless sins.
translation_verse: Ayai! Mannɛ a loŋ so nna. Fo asheŋ lubi so nɛ e bee wora loŋ.

english_verse: To guarantee payment of a debt, you have taken clothes from innocent people.
translation_verse: Fo shin nɛ fo niopibi ka fo kekɔ nɛ e ji fo, mbe asɔbuuso nɛ fo sɔ nɛ e maŋ naa kɔ shɛŋ a buu.

english_verse: And you refused bread and water to the hungry and thirsty,
translation_verse: Fo alɛ kini kesa basa nɛ akoŋ nɛ achukoŋ kɔ ajibi nɛ nchu nɛ b ji nseŋ nuu.

english_verse: You have turned away widows and have broken the arms of orphans.
translation_verse: Fo kini kechɛ bekulpoche to, nseŋ kɔrfɛ amunibi n suge bumo be asɔ n ti so.

english_verse: That's why you were suddenly trapped by terror,
translation_verse: Amoso nɛ kufugboŋ ki fanɛ ajigbelɛ ŋ kulti fo n wɔtɔ

english_verse: blinded by darkness, and drowned in a flood. God Lives in the Heavens
translation_verse: nɛ k wora fanɛ kaplɛkama ka biri to nɛ fo maa wu, nɛ nchu bɔlɔ ŋ kulti fo n wɔtɔ na.

english_verse: God lives in the heavens above the highest stars, where he sees everything.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ wɔ ebɔrɛso nɛ k wɔ awɔlto a chɔ achɛkpabi nɛ a wɔ esoso ga nna, nsaa wu kusɔ kama.

english_verse: Do you think the deep darkness hides you from God?
translation_verse: Fo tama fanɛ tentembiri plɔ beeŋ tiŋ n ta fo ŋ ŋana Ebɔrɛ so a?

english_verse: Do thick clouds cover his eyes, as he walks around heaven's dome high above the earth?
translation_verse: Awɔlpa nɛ a biri to maaŋ tiŋ m buu mbe anishi so nɛ e sa maa wu, saŋɛ nɛ e bee nite a kulti awɔlto ndoŋ na.

english_verse: although he had been kind to their families. The beliefs of these sinners are truly disgusting.
translation_verse: Ama Ebɔrɛ malɛ daŋ shin nɛ bumo be nnaŋ to ebi dii kedama nna. Ma ere maa pin alubiworapoana ere be kusɔ nɛ baa fɛ bumo be nfɛra to.

english_verse: saying, “Our enemies are gone, and fire has destroyed their possessions.” Surrender to God All-Powerful
translation_verse: ‘An doŋana maŋ naa wɔtɔ, edɛ malɛ mur bumo be asɔ kikɛ.’

english_verse: Listen to his teachings and take them to heart.
translation_verse: Sɔ keŋini kama nɛ e bee sa fo na, nseŋ ta mbe mmalga n wɔtɔ fo kagbene to.

english_verse: If you return to God and turn from sin, all will go well for you.
translation_verse: Nɛ fo baŋ bɛta m ba Ebɔrɛ kutɔ nseŋ lar alubi to, asheŋ beeŋ nite nɛnɛ n sa fo.

english_verse: and you will find happiness by worshiping him.
translation_verse: Aloŋ nɛ feeŋ nya kagbenefuli ashi kebaabunyaŋ mo to.

english_verse: God will answer your prayers, and you will keep the promises you made to him.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ beeŋ nu fo kabɔrɛkule, nɛ fo alɛ e wora m bɔlɔ nnɔ naseso nɛ fo nase n sa mo na so.

english_verse: When others are disgraced, God will clear their names in answer to your prayers.
translation_verse: Nɛ beko tɔr kebaawɔtɔ to gba, nɛ fo kule Ebɔrɛ n sa bumo e beeŋ nu fo kekule nseŋ maŋ bumo so.

english_verse: Even those who are guilty will be forgiven, because you obey God.
translation_verse: Hale basa nɛ b wora n jija gba beeŋ nya ketampaŋ, ŋkpal fo ka bee wora Ebɔrɛ kasonu so.”

english_verse: Today I complain bitterly, because God has been cruel and made me suffer.
translation_verse: “Hale nɛ kabre, ŋ kraa bile asheŋ kenishipereso nna, ŋkpal Ebɔrɛ ka tɔrɔ ma ga nseŋ shin nɛ n ji awurfoŋ so.

english_verse: Then I would discover what he wanted to say.
translation_verse: Aloŋ nɛ meeŋ pin kusɔ nɛ e kɔ nɛ e kaŋɛ ma.

english_verse: Would he overwhelm me with his greatness? No! He would listen
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ maaŋ kpal mbe eleŋgboŋ so ŋ kini kenu ma kamalga.

english_verse: because I am innocent, and he would say, “I now set you free!”
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, m maŋ wora kulubi kikɛ, mo alɛ beeŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ, kulubi kikɛ maŋ bɛ ma, nɛ n nya ma kumu n ji.

english_verse: I cannot find God anywhere— in front or back of me,
translation_verse: Ama ŋ keni epeŋilarkpa, nɛ Ebɔrɛ maŋ wɔ ndoŋ. Nɛ n naŋ keni epeŋitɔrkpa, ŋ kraa maŋ wu mo ndoŋ gba.

english_verse: to my left or my right. God is always at work, though I never see him.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ bee shuŋ kelargato be esoso nɛ kaseto kikɛ, ama ŋ kraa maa wu mo ndoŋana gba.

english_verse: But he knows what I am doing, and when he tests me, I will be pure as gold. *
translation_verse: Ama Ebɔrɛ bre nyi kusɔ kama nɛ mee wora, mo alɛ baŋ wora ma ŋ keni, e beeŋ wu ma fanɛ shuwa nɛ eyurpi maŋ wɔ kumo to.

english_verse: I have never refused to follow any of his commands,
translation_verse: M maŋ naŋ kini kebɛ mbe mbra kikɛ so, ma alɛ maa lar mbe ekpaana so kikɛ.

english_verse: But he alone is God, and who can oppose him? God does as he pleases,
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ maa chɛrga, esa kikɛ malɛ maaŋ tiŋ ŋ kɔ mo ŋko ŋ kuŋ mo ekpa nɛ e sa maŋ wora mbe kepar.

english_verse: and he will do exactly what he intends with me. *
translation_verse: Kusɔ nɛ e kre a laŋɛ ma kaplɛa so ashi mbe ŋkre damtaana to, kumo nɛ e beeŋ wora ma.

english_verse: God has covered me with darkness, but I refuse to be silent.
translation_verse: Ama ŋ kraa maaŋ lo ma kɔnɔ ŋkpal tentembiri plɔ nɛ k buu ma anishi so ere so.”

english_verse: Why doesn't God set a time for court? Why don't his people know where he can be found?
translation_verse: Manɛ nna nɛ Ebɔrɛ maŋ yili demuji be kachɛ? Manɛ nna nɛ basa nɛ b nyi mo maŋ nyi loŋ be kachɛ na?

english_verse: They cheat orphans and widows by taking their donkeys and oxen.
translation_verse: Baa suge amunibi be ekurma nsaa sɔ bekulpoche be ana a yili tarma nna.

english_verse: in the desert, where they and their children must live like wild donkeys and search for food.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal loŋ so, betirpo bee nite keshishɛrsawule so fanɛ kupuŋ to be ekurma nna a fin kusɔ jiso. Kaplɛkama maŋ naa wɔtɔ nɛ b nya ajibi n sa bumo be mbia.

english_verse: They sleep naked in the cold, because they have no cover,
translation_verse: Kanyɛso baa dese awo to nna nɛ b maŋ buu shɛŋ, ŋkpal b ka maŋ nya ewajɛbuuso so.

english_verse: and during a storm their only shelters are caves among the rocky cliffs.
translation_verse: Bɔrɛgboŋ baa ba, abeelaŋ to nɛ baa shile n ya kaa ŋana nɛ bɔrɛ na e sa maŋ bri bumo.

english_verse: They crush olives to make oil and grapes to make wine— but still they go thirsty.
translation_verse: Mbia na e naŋ kɔr ɔlif be bibi to n wora ŋku nseŋ nyaŋ greep be asɔrso malɛ to n wora yabra, ama achukoŋ e naa mɔ bumo.

english_verse: And along the city streets, the wounded and dying cry out, yet God does nothing. Some Reject the Light
translation_verse: Basa nɛ b doro nɛ bumo nɛ baa wu ashi ndegboŋana be agbembiana so na bee shu a fin kechɛto, ama Ebɔrɛ maa wora shɛŋ.

english_verse: Soon after sunset they murder the poor and the needy, and at night they steal.
translation_verse: Kakpa baŋ biri to, bemɔpo na bee koso nna n ya kaa mɔ betirpo nɛ betentaŋasepo. Kanyɛso saŋko malɛ nɛ b ya kaa yuri.

english_verse: Others wait for the dark, thinking they won't be seen if they sleep with the wife or husband of someone else.
translation_verse: Bumo nɛ baa ji kubojua na malɛ bee jo kaboŋ e biri to nna nɛ b bela asɔ m buu bumo be amu so saŋɛ na so ekama maaŋ pin bumo.

english_verse: Robbers hide during the day, then break in after dark because they reject the light.
translation_verse: Kanyɛso nɛ beyu bee bure a luri basa be elaŋ to, ama kare baŋ chɛ nɛ b shile ŋ ŋana, ŋkpal manɛ so, b maa sha kefulto be asheŋ.

english_verse: They prefer night to day, since the terrors of the night are their friends. Sinners Are Filthy Foam
translation_verse: Kanyɛso nɛ baa sha a chɔ kapaso, ŋkpal manɛ so, bumo nɛ kanyɛso be asɔ nɛ e bee keta kufu na ji abar keteri nna.

english_verse: Those sinners are filthy foam on the surface of the water. And so, their fields and vineyards will fall under a curse and won't produce.
translation_verse: Alubiworapo na du fanɛ kepɔpɔ nɛ e deŋ nchu so nɛ nchu na sulɔ amo a yɔ nna. Amoso Ebɔrɛ be shoduu beeŋ ba bumo be adɔjibi nɛ ndibi sɔrso be adɔana so nɛ a maŋ tiŋ n wora.

english_verse: Just as the heat of summer swallows the snow, the world of the dead swallows those who sin.
translation_verse: Kananɛ kenyɔlɔ maa chɛr epeŋi so na, aloŋ nɛ alubiworapoana gba maaŋ chɛr nseŋ wu n choŋ nɛ b maaŋ naŋ wu bumo.

english_verse: Forgotten here on earth, and with their power broken, they taste sweet to worms.
translation_verse: Bumo nioana gba maaŋ naŋ nyiŋi bumo, ashushombi beeŋ ji bumo m mur fanɛ kedibi ka bu n tɔr nɛ kaŋkaŋ muu kumo na.

english_verse: But God's mighty strength destroys those in power. Even if they seem successful, they are doomed to fail.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ be yuku na e naa mur basagboŋ na. Hale nɛ k wora fanɛ asheŋ bee nite nɛnɛ a sa bumo gba, asheŋ kraa beeŋ bri bumo nɛ b wora asheŋ ŋ gben.

english_verse: Great for a while; gone forever! Sinners are mowed down like weeds, then they wither and die.
translation_verse: Alubiworapoana beeŋ tiŋ n nyalɛ kabre, ama k maaŋ chɛr ko nɛ bumo be asɔ na e mur cheche. Baaŋ ba kaseto fanɛ b ka buse afitiri n lɛ na.

english_verse: God is the one to fear, because God is in control and rules the heavens.
translation_verse: “Ebɔrɛ shi ga nseŋ daga keŋana, ŋkpal manɛ so, mo e naa ji kuwura ebɔrɛso, nɛ kusɔ kama bee nite nɛnɛ ndoŋ.

english_verse: Who can count his army of stars? Isn't God the source of light?
translation_verse: Wanɛ e naŋ tiŋ ŋ karga emalaika nɛ bekama nɛ baa shuŋ mo ebɔrɛso na? Ebɔrɛ be kefulto bee nyaŋɛ kaplɛkama nna.

english_verse: How can anyone be innocent in the sight of God?
translation_verse: Esa kikɛ maaŋ tiŋ ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ mo ere maŋ wora n jija Ebɔrɛ be anishito.

english_verse: To him, not even the light of the moon and stars can ever be pure.
translation_verse: Kufɔl nɛ achɛkpabi gba maa fulto parr Ebɔrɛ bre be anishito.

english_verse: So how can we humans, when we are merely worms?
translation_verse: Nɛ nuso nɛ dimɛdi bomin, nɛ e du fanɛ kushushombi, bre du ga ashi Ebɔrɛ be anishito?”

english_verse: You have really been helpful to someone weak and weary.
translation_verse: “Fo la echɛtopo nna n sa ma, etirpo nɛ esa pɔso fanɛ ma le!

english_verse: You have given great advice and wonderful wisdom to someone truly in need.
translation_verse: Keni kasotojigboŋ nɛ fo ta n sa esa nɛ asheŋ tir ga fanɛ ma le!

english_verse: How can anyone possibly speak with such understanding?
translation_verse: Wanɛ e chɛ fo to nɛ fo tiŋ m malga nɛnɛ le ere? Bildad

english_verse: Remember the terrible trembling of those in the world of the dead below the mighty ocean.
translation_verse: Basa nɛ b wu be ayoyu wɔ bubuni to tekugboŋ be kaseto nna a chicha kenishipereso.

english_verse: Nothing in that land of death and destruction is hidden from God,
translation_verse: Kusɔ kama nɛ k wɔ bubuni to ŋko nɛ k mur maŋ ŋana Ebɔrɛ bre so.

english_verse: who hung the northern sky and suspended the earth on empty space.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ e parga awɔlpa nɛ k wɔ kelargato be esoso na to, nseŋ shin nɛ durnya shaso nɛ shɛŋ maŋ kɔ kumo to.

english_verse: and he wraps them around the face of the moon.
translation_verse: Mo koŋwule na e naa shin nɛ bɔrɛwɔlpa bee buu kufɔl lelemu so nɛ esa maa wu kumo na.

english_verse: On the surface of the ocean, God has drawn a boundary line between light and darkness.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ e chaŋ kefulto nɛ tentembiri be gbaŋfɔl n deŋi teku so.

english_verse: And columns supporting the sky tremble at his command.
translation_verse: Mo e naa ponte to nɛ awɔlpa be eshabɔrɛ bee gbuŋgbuŋ to na.

english_verse: The heavens became bright when he breathed, and the escaping sea monster died at his hands.
translation_verse: Mo e fute n shin nɛ esoso fulto, nɛ e ta mbe enɔana m mɔ kusɔkpaŋ nɛ k bee gbeye na.

english_verse: These things are merely a whisper of God's power at work. How little we would understand if this whisper ever turned into thunder!
translation_verse: Ade bre la Ebɔrɛ be eleŋgboŋ na be ashuŋ wurbi nna na. To, wanɛ e naŋ tiŋ m pin kananɛ Ebɔrɛ be keshi gbagba du?”

english_verse: I am desperate because God All-Powerful refuses to do what is right. As surely as God lives,
translation_verse: “Ma kenishi pere nna ŋkpal Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ ka kini kewora kusɔ nɛ k daga nseŋ shin nɛ kebaawɔtɔ ki kekera n sa ma so.

english_verse: Until the day I die, I will refuse to do wrong by saying you are right,
translation_verse: M maaŋ shuli fanɛ kusɔ nɛ men kaŋɛ na bɔla ekpa hale n ya fo kachɛ nɛ meeŋ wu.

english_verse: because each day my conscience agrees that I am innocent.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, karechɛ kikɛ ma nfɛra bee wora ma nna fanɛ m maŋ wora kulubi.

english_verse: I pray that my enemies will suffer no less than the wicked.
translation_verse: Mee kule Ebɔrɛ nna nɛ n doŋana e ji awurfoŋ ga fanɛ kumu kpakpasowuraana!

english_verse: Such people are hopeless, and God All-Powerful will cut them down,
translation_verse: Jemanɛ nɛ Ebɔrɛ beeŋ sɔ basa nɛ b kini mo na be ŋkpa na, tama kikɛ maaŋ naa wɔtɔ n sa bumo.

english_verse: without listening when they beg for mercy.
translation_verse: Tɔrɔ be jemanɛ baŋ ba, Ebɔrɛ maaŋ nu bumo be kekule.

english_verse: And that is what God should do, because they don't like him or ever pray.
translation_verse: Kusɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ beeŋ wora bumo nna. Ŋkpal manɛ so, b maa sha Ebɔrɛ ŋko kabɔrɛkule.

english_verse: Now I will explain in detail what God All-Powerful does.
translation_verse: Meeŋ ŋini menyi kananɛ Ebɔrɛ be yuku shi, nseŋ bugi to ŋ kaŋɛ menyi kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na kre.

english_verse: All of you have seen these things for yourselves. So you have no excuse. How God Treats the Wicked
translation_verse: Menyi gbagba wu asheŋ ere kenishiso, nɛ manɛ nna nɛ men naa malga asheŋ nɛ e maŋ kɔ kifi to? Zofa

english_verse: Here is how God All-Powerful treats those who are wicked and brutal.
translation_verse: Kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ bee wora amukpakpaso wuraana nɛ b maa shu basa so nde.

english_verse: They may have many children, but most of them will go hungry or suffer a violent death.
translation_verse: Baaŋ tiŋ ŋ kurge mbia damta ga, ama akoŋ ŋko kena e naŋ mɔ bumo be galeŋga.

english_verse: Others will die of disease, and their widows won't be able to weep.
translation_verse: Bumo be mbia nɛ baaŋ ji efute malɛ beeŋ lɔ nna n wu. Bumo be bekulpoche maaŋ nya n shu mbia na be nli gba.

english_verse: The wicked may collect riches and clothes in abundance as easily as clay.
translation_verse: Amukpakpaso wuraana beeŋ tiŋ a kɔ amansherbi nɛ asɔbuuso damta ga fanɛ b ka koli eshishɛr m biti abar so na.

english_verse: But God's people will wear clothes taken from them and divide up their riches.
translation_verse: Ama Ebɔrɛ be basa e naŋ sɔ asɔbuuso na m buu, nseŋ chige bumo be amansherbi damta na to n sa abar.

english_verse: No homes built by the wicked will outlast a cocoon or a shack.
translation_verse: Nwu nɛ amukpakpaso wuraana pɔr na maŋ chɛr kikɛ. A du fanɛ enansatata ŋko ndɔtobuuana nna.

english_verse: Those sinners may go to bed rich, but they will wake up poor.
translation_verse: Alubiworapo beeŋ tiŋ n dii kedama nseŋ ya dese kanyɛso, ŋklade kachipurso ŋ koso ŋ ki betirpo.

english_verse: Terror will strike at night like a flood or a storm.
translation_verse: Kufugboŋ beeŋ pɛ bumo kanyɛso fanɛ nchu ka bɔlɔ n sɔ kaplɛkama na, ŋko bɔrɛfugboŋ ka bee ber bumo na.

english_verse: Miners carry lanterns deep into the darkness to search for these metals.
translation_verse: Basa bee sulɔ efitila nna a luri kasawule chiŋgeliŋ to tentembiri to n ya kaa fin abɛlso ere.

english_verse: Far beneath the grain fields, fires are built to break loose those rocks
translation_verse: Adɔsawule be kaseto chilili nɛ baa ta edɛ a bure afalta

english_verse: With their own hands they remove sharp rocks and uproot mountains.
translation_verse: Enɔana nɛ dimɛdi kɔ a bure afalta kasawule to nsaa shin nɛ abee be epul to bee dii efuli.

english_verse: They dig through the rocks in search of jewels and precious metals.
translation_verse: Baa bure afalta na nna a fin yawu kpakpaso be ajembu nɛ abɛlso lela.

english_verse: They also uncover the sources of rivers and discover secret places. Where Is Wisdom Found?
translation_verse: Baa kuŋ kakpa nɛ elɔr bee shi a shile na to nna, nsaa nya a lara asɔ nɛ a ŋana to.

english_verse: Nor can it be discovered in the deepest sea. *
translation_verse: Kanyiasheŋ maŋ wɔ teku be kechimbi to gba.

english_verse: It is worth much more than silver or pure gold
translation_verse: Esa maaŋ tiŋ n ta shuwa ŋko gbiti nɛ k maŋ kɔ eyurpi n tɔ kumo.

english_verse: Death and destruction have merely heard rumors about where it is found.
translation_verse: Luwu nɛ kemur gba nu kumo be asheŋ, a maŋ nyi kakpa nɛ k wɔ.

english_verse: God is the only one who knows the way to wisdom;
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ nawule e nyi ekpa nɛ k bee yɔ kanyiasheŋ akpa. Mo nawule e nyi kakpa nɛ k wɔ.

english_verse: he alone sees everything beneath the heavens.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, mo e naa wu kusɔ kama nɛ k wɔ kasawule so.

english_verse: and when he decided the path for rain and lightning,
translation_verse: nseŋ naŋ yili kakpa nɛ bɔrɛ beeŋ baa ba nɛ ekpa nɛ bɔrɛ beeŋ baa bɔla so a nyɛkpɛ na

english_verse: God told us, “Wisdom means that you respect me, the Lord, and turn from sin.”
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ e kaŋɛ edimɛdi le: “Kanyiasheŋ e la keta bunyaŋ gboŋ n sa ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na. Nɛ kelar alubi to malɛ la asheŋ be kepin to.”

english_verse: I long for the past, when God took care of me,
translation_verse: “Mee yɛlga fanɛ ma kebaawɔtɔ e baa du fanɛ kumo nɛ n daa kɔ jemanɛ nɛ Ebɔrɛ daa keni ma so na.

english_verse: and the light from his lamp showed me the way through the dark.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ daa wɔ ma kutɔ nna jemanɛ kikɛ, nseŋ daa shin nɛ kakpa bee fulto a sa ma nɛ mee tiŋ a nite tentembiri to.

english_verse: I was in the prime of life, God All-Powerful was my closest friend,
translation_verse: Jemanɛ nɛ asheŋ daa nite nɛnɛ a sa ma na, Ebɔrɛ nɛ e la n teri kpakpaso na, e daa nɛfa ma laŋ to ebi kikɛ.

english_verse: My herds gave enough milk to bathe my feet, and from my olive harvest flowed rivers of oil. *
translation_verse: N daa nya kenyipochu damta ga nna ashi ma ana nɛ mboe to, nseŋ daa nya ŋku ga ashi ma ɔlif be ndibi be asɔrso to.

english_verse: When I sat down at the meeting of the city council,
translation_verse: Jemanɛ kikɛ nɛ kadegboŋ na be benimu shɛr kadegboŋ na be kabuna nɛ ma alɛ gba ya tu bumo n chena,

english_verse: Everyone was pleased with what I said and did.
translation_verse: Kusɔ kama nɛ n wora ŋko ŋ kaŋɛ daa par ekama nna nsaa fuli bumo be ŋgbene.

english_verse: When poor people or orphans cried out for help, I came to their rescue.
translation_verse: Jemanɛ kikɛ nɛ betirpo ŋko amunibi bee sha kechɛto, mee chɛ bumo to nna.

english_verse: And I was highly praised for my generosity to widows and others in poverty.
translation_verse: Bekama nɛ asheŋ pɔɔ so nɛ n chɛ bumo to na nɛfa ma, ma alɛ daŋ chɛ bekulpoche to nɛ bumo be ŋgbene fuli bumo.

english_verse: Kindness and justice were my coat and hat;
translation_verse: Jemanɛ kikɛ n daa wora kusɔ nɛ k daga nna, nsaa maa kpɛa esa kikɛ to.

english_verse: I was helpful to the blind and to the lame.
translation_verse: N daa wora etanpo nɛ ebobi kelela nna.

english_verse: I was a father to the needy, and I defended them in court, even if they were strangers.
translation_verse: N daa la fanɛ etuto nna n sa betirpo, nseŋ daa ji asheŋ a chɛ befɔ to ashi demujikpa.

english_verse: When criminals attacked, I broke their teeth and set their victims free.
translation_verse: Nɛ basa lubi ya nyaŋ basa n wɔtɔ a tɔrɔ bumo, mee kɔ a suge bumo nna nseŋ ju basa lubi na n lɛ.

english_verse: I felt certain that I would live a long and happy life, then die in my own bed.
translation_verse: N daa fɛ fanɛ meeŋ chɛr fanɛ jita nseŋ dese ŋ gbagba be ebu to n wu nɛ kayurwushi nna.

english_verse: In those days I was strong like a tree with deep roots and with plenty of water,
translation_verse: N daa kɔ eleŋ a yil to nna fanɛ kedibi nɛ k mur achin n yili m mata nchu nɛ bunyaŋ bee shi kumo be afantaŋ nɛ ayabi so a wurge kanyɛso nna.

english_verse: My words were eagerly accepted like the showers of spring,
translation_verse: B daa suse ma mmalga to nna fanɛ kananɛ bedɔpo bee suse dɔchubɔrɛ so be nchu na.

english_verse: Young people now insult me, although their fathers would have been a disgrace to my sheep dogs.
translation_verse: Naniere mbifɔlbi bee tege ma nna, ama bumo tutoana daa maŋ la basa nɛ meeŋ shin nɛ b ti ma njɔnɔ so a keni ma mbolpɔ so gba.

english_verse: They must claw the desert sand in the dark for something to satisfy their hunger.
translation_verse: B daa nite a kulti keshishɛrsawule so kanyɛso nna a fin kusɔ nɛ baaŋ ji, ŋkpal b ka la betirpo jalɛ so.

english_verse: and they are run out of towns, as though they were thieves.
translation_verse: Ekama malɛ ju bumo n lar kade na to nna nsaa ponte bumo so fanɛ b ka la beyu na.

english_verse: And like senseless donkeys they are chased away. Those Worthless Nobodies
translation_verse: B ki fanɛ basa fuloŋ nɛ b maŋ kɔ tɔnɔ nɛ b ju bumo n lar kasawule na so nna.

english_verse: Those worthless nobodies make up jokes and songs to disgrace me.
translation_verse: Naniere le be basa fuloŋ ere wora nshɛ nna a boŋ a wora ma eyur to.

english_verse: God has destroyed me, and so they don't care what they do.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal Ebɔrɛ ka shin nɛ awurfoŋ nɛ tɔrɔ ba ma so so, kusɔ kama nɛ baa sha, kumo nɛ baa wora ma.

english_verse: Terror has me surrounded; my reputation and my riches have vanished like a cloud. I Am Sick at Heart
translation_verse: Kufugboŋ gboŋi tɔr ma so; m paŋ ma bunyaŋ nɛ kedamaya kikɛ nna fanɛ kusɔ ka pante nɛ afu lar na.

english_verse: I am sick at heart! Pain has taken its toll.
translation_verse: Naniere mee shin nɛ n wu nna na. Shɛŋ maa sɔ ma ashi ma awurfoŋ to.

english_verse: and God has shrunk my skin, choking me to death.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ be enɔ lempo e pɛ ma kale to, ma piŋi be kubɔ to nɛ e nyaŋ ŋ keta.

english_verse: I have been thrown in the dirt and now am dirt myself.
translation_verse: E ta ma n lɛ edepɔ to nna, nɛ ŋ kikɛ ki fanɛ depɔ.

english_verse: I beg God for help, but there is no answer; and when I stand up, he simply stares.
translation_verse: Ŋ kule Ebɔrɛ fanɛ e chɛ ma to, nɛ e kini, e maŋ tuge ma gba. Nɛ ŋ koso n yili, ama e baa keni ma nna de.

english_verse: stirring up a windstorm to toss me about.
translation_verse: E shin nɛ bɔrɛfugboŋ ba fuu ma nna n lɛ, nɛ n tɔr a gbelti.

english_verse: Soon he will send me home to the world of the dead, where we all must go.
translation_verse: K maaŋ chɛr e beeŋ shin nɛ n wu n yɔ bubuni to, kakpa nɛ ekama beeŋ yɔ kachako na.

english_verse: No one refuses help to others, when disaster strikes.
translation_verse: Esa kikɛ maaŋ kini kechɛ basa nɛ b ji jɛrbi nsaa kule a fin kechɛto to.

english_verse: But when I beg for relief and light, all I receive are disaster and darkness.
translation_verse: Ama naniere ma ere ka bee fin kesɔnyige nɛ kefulto, jɛrbi nɛ tentembiri nɛ n nya.

english_verse: My stomach is tied in knots; pain is my daily companion.
translation_verse: Kafɔŋ nɛ ebesa shin nɛ ma apumbi to bee kii to, karechɛ kama malɛ, awurfoŋ to nɛ n wɔ.

english_verse: My days are dark and gloomy and in the city council I stand and cry out,
translation_verse: Awurfoŋ shin nɛ ma kayurwule kilgi m biri, mannɛ epeŋi. Nɛ ŋ koso n yili basa to a shu a fin kechɛto.

english_verse: making mournful sounds like jackals and owls.
translation_verse: N daa shu kuwɔr so fanɛ ejiŋkaamu ŋko egbuŋgbula nna.

english_verse: My skin is so parched, that it peels right off, and my bones are burning.
translation_verse: Ma eyur so kikɛ chɔɔ nna a fɔlge so nɛ ma eyur to bel edɛ a tushi fanɛ edɛ gbagba na.

english_verse: I promised myself never to stare with desire at a young woman.
translation_verse: Ma, Job bɔ ntaŋ n nase kɔnɔ fanɛ m maa ba nɛ ŋ keni eche kayɛlga so kikɛ.

english_verse: In fact, God sends disaster on all who sin,
translation_verse: Kashenteŋto, Ebɔrɛ bee shin nɛ bekama nɛ baa wora alubi bee ji jɛrbi nna.

english_verse: and he keeps a close watch on everything I do.
translation_verse: Mo alɛ nyi kusɔ kama nɛ mee wora, nsaa wu keya kama nɛ mee tia.

english_verse: and I beg God to prove my innocence.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ e wora ma ŋ keni, e beeŋ wu fanɛ kulubi maŋ wɔ ma to.

english_verse: then others can eat my harvest and uproot my crops.
translation_verse: kumo ere basa pɔtɛ e ji ma adɔjibi ŋko ma adɔjibi e mur kuraa.

english_verse: If I have desired someone's wife and chased after her,
translation_verse: Nɛ fanɛ n daŋ yɛlga esa ko be eche nseŋ ya ŋana n sha mo,

english_verse: then let some stranger steal my wife from me.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ e shin nɛ enyɛn pɔtɛ e suge ma eche ŋ kutɔ.

english_verse: If I took someone's wife, it would be a horrible crime,
translation_verse: Nɛ n daŋ ta esa ko be eche nna, k daa beeŋ baa la mbushu lubi lubi,

english_verse: sending me to destruction and my crops to the flames.
translation_verse: nɛ k beeŋ mur ma nseŋ shin nɛ ma adɔjibi e ji edɛ.

english_verse: Otherwise, what answer would I give to God when he judges me?
translation_verse: n daa maaŋ tiŋ n ya yili Ebɔrɛ be anishito nɛ e ji ma demu nɛ n ji n lar.

english_verse: After all, God is the one who gave life to each of us before we were born. I Have Never Cheated Anyone
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ koŋwule na e to ma nɛ ma nyɛrbi nɛ mbita na kikɛ.

english_verse: and I have always shared my food with orphans.
translation_verse: Ma alɛ maŋ naŋ ji m mɔɛ nɛ amunibi bre dese akoŋ kikɛ.

english_verse: Since the time I was young, I have cared for orphans and helped widows.
translation_verse: Ma kebrantiɛ to kikɛ nɛ mee bela amunibi nsaa chɛ bekulpoche to.

english_verse: I provided clothes for the poor,
translation_verse: M baŋ wu esa nɛ e maŋ kɔ asɔbuuso,

english_verse: If I have ever raised my arm to threaten an orphan when the power was mine,
translation_verse: Nɛ fanɛ n daŋ puni kumunibi ko, ŋkpal ŋ ka nyi fanɛ meeŋ tiŋ n ji m bri mo demujikpa so,

english_verse: I hope that arm will fall from its socket.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ e shin nɛ ma mbre e yili ma abatimu so ŋ ku so n tɔr.

english_verse: I could not have been abusive; I was terrified at the thought that God might punish me.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal ŋ kaa bee ŋana Ebɔrɛ be kasogberge so, m maaŋ shuli n wora le be asheŋ ere.

english_verse: I have never trusted the power of wealth,
translation_verse: Ma ere maŋ naŋ ta ma yirda n deŋi kedamaya so kikɛ,

english_verse: or taken pride in owning many possessions. *
translation_verse: ŋko a puchi ŋkpal asɔ damta nɛ ŋ kɔ so.

english_verse: I have never laughed when my enemies were struck by disaster.
translation_verse: Ma kagbene maŋ naŋ fuli ŋkpal n doŋana be awurfoŋ so, ŋko jemanɛ nɛ b ji jɛrbi so.

english_verse: Neither have I sinned by asking God to send down on them the curse of death.
translation_verse: Ma alɛ maŋ naŋ kule Ebɔrɛ n fin bumo be luwu nɛ kebaala kulubi n sa ma kikɛ.

english_verse: Many have attempted to hide their sins from others— but I refused.
translation_verse: Basa ko bee ta bumo be alubi a ŋana nna, ama nɛ ma ere wora kulubi m maaŋ ta kumo ŋ ŋana kikɛ.

english_verse: Why doesn't God All-Powerful listen and answer? If God has something against me, let him speak up or put it in writing!
translation_verse: Esa ko maaŋ nu kusɔ nɛ mee kaŋɛ ere nseŋ ji n chɛ ma to a? Nɛ fanɛ Ebɔrɛ wu kusɔ ko ma so gba nna, e malga ŋko n sibɛ kumo n sa ma.

english_verse: And with my head held high, I would tell him everything I have ever done.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman, meeŋ kaŋɛ Ebɔrɛ kusɔ nɛ n wora kikɛ nseŋ nya kagbene n yili mbe anishito.

english_verse: I have never mistreated the land I farmed and made it mourn.
translation_verse: Nɛ fanɛ n yuri kasawule nɛ mee dɔ so na nna, ŋko n suge kumo basa nɛ b wɔ kumo kutɔ nna,

english_verse: If I had, I would pray for weeds instead of wheat to grow in my fields. After saying these things, Job was silent.
translation_verse: kumo ere Ebɔrɛ e shin nɛ afitiri nɛ ewi a kɔr n sɔ kasawule na kikɛ so, mannɛ ayu ŋko aboyu. Job be kamalga be ekar nna na.

english_verse: Finally, these three men stopped arguing with Job, because he refused to admit he was guilty.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal Job ka wu mbe kumu fanɛ e maŋ wora kulubi so, mo nekpaana besa na yige mbe asheŋ nna n sa mo nsaa maŋ naa ji mo emɔrɔ.

english_verse: Elihu was younger than these three, and he let them speak first.
translation_verse: Elihu daŋ yige basa asa na nna nɛ b malga n sa Job ŋkpal e ka daa la kebibi bumo to so.

english_verse: and he said to them: I am much younger than you, so I have shown respect by keeping silent.
translation_verse: nseŋ kaŋɛ bumo le: “N la kebifɔlbi nna nɛ menyi alɛ la basakpar, amoso nɛ n sa menyi bunyaŋ nsaa maŋ kaŋɛ menyi kusɔ nɛ mee fɛ na.

english_verse: I once believed age was the source of wisdom;
translation_verse: Ma ere daa fɛ nna fanɛ basakpar e kɔ kanyiasheŋ.

english_verse: That's why I ask you to listen to me. I Eagerly Listened *
translation_verse: Amoso, men nu kusɔ nɛ ma alɛ kɔ nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ.

english_verse: You shouldn't say, “We know what's right! Let God punish him.”
translation_verse: Men sa maŋ kaŋɛ le: ‘Anyi ere nyi kusɔ nɛ k daga! Ebɔrɛ e naŋ gberge mo kusoe.’

english_verse: Job hasn't spoken against me, and so I won't answer him with your arguments.
translation_verse: Job daa malga a sa menyi nna, mannɛ ma, ama ma ere daa maaŋ malga kananɛ men malga ere n sa mo.

english_verse: All of you are shocked; you don't know what to say.
translation_verse: Job, fo mmalga na mɔ bumo kɔnɔ, b maŋ naa nyi kusɔ nɛ baŋ naŋ kaŋɛ fo.

english_verse: But am I to remain silent, just because you have stopped speaking?
translation_verse: Ama a daga fanɛ ma alɛ gba e lo ma kɔnɔ ŋkpal b ka maŋ naa kɔ shɛŋ nɛ b kaŋɛ fo so a?

english_verse: No! I will give my opinion,
translation_verse: Ayai! Meeŋ kaŋɛ fo kusɔ nɛ mee fɛ.

english_verse: because I have so much to say, that I can't keep quiet.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, asɔ damta nɛ ŋ kɔ nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ, amoso m maaŋ tiŋ n lo ma kɔnɔ.

english_verse: I am like a swollen wineskin, and I will burst
translation_verse: Nɛ m maŋ nya ekpa m malga, meeŋ pante fanɛ kasapuya nɛ k bɔlɔ nsa m pante na.

english_verse: I don't know how to be unfair or to flatter anyone—
translation_verse: M maaŋ malga ŋ kpɛa ekama to, ma alɛ maaŋ ku efɛ n fur esa ko.

english_verse: Job, listen to me! Pay close attention. *
translation_verse: Job, jande nu nfe nɛnɛ!

english_verse: just as surely as the Spirit of God All-Powerful gave me the breath of life.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na be Kiyoyu e to ma, nseŋ sa ma efute nɛ ŋkpa.

english_verse: We each were made from clay, and God has no favorites,
translation_verse: Ebɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ ta m pɔr ma nɛ fo kikɛ. Ashi mbe anishito, anyi maŋ kɔr abar to.

english_verse: so don't be afraid of me or what I might do. I Have Heard You Argue
translation_verse: Amoso, sa maa ŋana ma ŋko kusɔ nɛ meeŋ wora fo.

english_verse: I have heard you argue
translation_verse: Kusɔ nɛ n nu fo ka kaŋɛ nde:

english_verse: that you are innocent, guilty of nothing.
translation_verse: “Ma ere maŋ wora n jija. Kulubi kikɛ maŋ bɛ ma.

english_verse: You claim that God has made you his enemy,
translation_verse: Ama Ebɔrɛ bre e naa wu ma kulubi nsaa ta ma fanɛ mo doŋ.

english_verse: that he has bound your feet and blocked your path.
translation_verse: Mo e ta ŋgbɛlɛbi ŋ kre ma aya, nsaa dara aya kama nɛ mee tia.”

english_verse: But, Job, you're wrong— God is greater than any human.
translation_verse: Ama mee kaŋɛ fo, Job, nna fanɛ fo wora n foe. Ebɔrɛ e chɔ dimɛdi kikɛ.

english_verse: God speaks in different ways, and we don't always recognize his voice. *
translation_verse: Ekpa damta so nɛ Ebɔrɛ bee bɔla a malga, ama anyi e maa kaa nu kusɔ nɛ e bee kaŋɛ.

english_verse: God does this to make us turn from sin and pride
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ bee malga nna a sa bumo edare to nɛ k shin nɛ b lar alubi nɛ kamoowu to.

english_verse: and to protect us from being swept away to the world of the dead.
translation_verse: E maaŋ shin nɛ b mur. E bee mɔlga bumo luwu to nna.

english_verse: Sometimes we are punished with a serious illness and aching joints.
translation_verse: Jemanɛ ko Ebɔrɛ bee bɔla kulɔ nɛ eyur to be ebesa so nna a ŋini edimɛdi kusɔ nɛ k daga kebaawɔtɔ to.

english_verse: Merely the thought of our favorite food makes our stomachs sick,
translation_verse: Ajibi maa kaa yɛlga belɔpo, hale ajibi nɛ baa sha ga gba bee dufɛ bumo be mmuna so nna.

english_verse: and we become so skinny that our bones stick out.
translation_verse: Bumo alɛ bee kaa foe eyur to nna hale nɛ bumo be awibi bee lar.

english_verse: We feel death and the grave taking us in their grip.
translation_verse: Nɛ loŋ baŋ wora, baa taga to luwu nna na.

english_verse: One of a thousand angels then comes to our rescue by saying we are innocent.
translation_verse: Ashere Ebɔrɛ be emalaika ŋgboŋ to ŋgboŋ to nɛ baa nyiŋi edimɛdi kusɔ nɛ k daga na be eko e naaŋ ba chɛ bumo to.

english_verse: The angel shows kindness, commanding death to release us, because the price was paid.
translation_verse: Malaika na beeŋ wu bumo kuwɔr ŋ kaŋɛ luwu fanɛ e yige bumo, ŋkpal manɛ so, b teŋ ka alubi na be kukɔ.

english_verse: and we ask God to accept us. Then we joyfully worship God, and we are rewarded because we are innocent.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ b kule Ebɔrɛ nɛ e nu, nɛ b ta kagbenewushi m bunyaŋ Ebɔrɛ, nɛ e naŋ shin nɛ asheŋ e nyalɛ n sa bumo.

english_verse: When that happens, we tell everyone, “I sinned and did wrong, but God forgave me
translation_verse: Loŋ malɛ kaŋ wora, baaŋ kaŋɛ ekama le: “An daŋ wora alubi nseŋ foe Ebɔrɛ be ekpa so, ama Ebɔrɛ ta m paŋ anyi

english_verse: and rescued me from death! Now I will see the light.”
translation_verse: nseŋ sɔ anyi n yige ashi luwu to nɛ an kraa wɔ ŋkpa to.”

english_verse: God gives each of us chance after chance
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ bee bugi ekpa nna a sa anyi be ekama

english_verse: to be saved from death and brought into the light that gives life.
translation_verse: nɛ an nya kumɔlga ashi luwu to. E bee bar anyi mbe kefulto nɛ k bee sa ŋkpa na to nna.

english_verse: though I would gladly listen to anything you say that proves you are right.
translation_verse: Nɛ fo kɔ kusɔ ko nɛ fo kaŋɛ, meeŋ shuli kagbenefuliso fanɛ fo kɔ ekpa.

english_verse: Otherwise, listen in silence to my wisdom.
translation_verse: Nɛ mannɛ aloŋ, lo fo kɔnɔ nɛ ŋ ŋini fo kanyiasheŋ.

english_verse: You men think you are wise, but just listen to me!
translation_verse: “Menyi edimɛdi bee fɛ fanɛ men nyi asheŋ nna, ama men nu ŋ kutɔ!

english_verse: Then we can decide the case and give a just verdict.
translation_verse: K ka anyi kutɔ nna nɛ an keni demu na to nseŋ ji kumo nɛnɛ nɛ k yili kananɛ k daga.

english_verse: Job claims he is innocent and God is guilty of mistreating him.
translation_verse: Job bee ŋini fanɛ e maŋ wora kulubi, Ebɔrɛ bre e naa kini keji asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so n sa mo.

english_verse: Job also argues that God considers him a liar and that he is suffering severely in spite of his innocence.
translation_verse: Job malɛ naa kaŋɛ fanɛ Ebɔrɛ bee tre mo efɛpo nna. Mo alɛ maŋ wora kulubi kikɛ nsaa ji awurfoŋ damta na.

english_verse: But to tell the truth, Job is shameless!
translation_verse: Men daŋ wu esa nɛ e du fanɛ Job a? E maa sa Ebɔrɛ bunyaŋ kikɛ!

english_verse: He spends his time with sinners,
translation_verse: Mo nɛ alubiworapoana e naa tu abar a wora asheŋ.

english_verse: because he has said, “It doesn't pay to please God.” If Any of You Are Smart
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, e yɛ, esa baa wora Ebɔrɛ be aparsheŋ e maa nya tɔnɔ kikɛ.

english_verse: If any of you are smart, you will listen and learn that God All-Powerful does what is right.
translation_verse: Men nu nfe, menyi nɛ menyee pin asheŋ to ere! Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ beeŋ shuli n wora kusɔ nɛ k maŋ daga a?

english_verse: God always treats everyone the way they deserve,
translation_verse: Ekama be kusɔ nɛ e wora nɛ Ebɔrɛ bee keni so, nsaa ka amodoŋwura kukɔ.

english_verse: From the very beginning, God has been in control of all the world.
translation_verse: Sososo na kikɛ nɛ Ebɔrɛ kɔ yuku durnya kikɛ so nsaa keni kumo so.

english_verse: If God took back the breath that he breathed into us,
translation_verse: Nɛ Ebɔrɛ baŋ sɔ efute nɛ k sa anyi ŋkpa ere

english_verse: we humans would die and return to the soil.
translation_verse: anyi edimɛdi beeŋ wu nseŋ bɛta n yɔ eshishɛr to.

english_verse: The mighty God is the one who brings about justice, and you are condemning him.
translation_verse: Menyee ji a bri Ebɔrɛ nɛ e niŋi na nna, ŋkpal menyi ka bee fɛ fanɛ e kishi kebaaji asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so so.

english_verse: Indeed, God is the one who condemns unfair rulers.
translation_verse: Kashenteŋto, Ebɔrɛ e naa ji a bri bewura nɛ b maŋ kɔ tɔnɔ nsaa la kumukpakpaso wuraana.

english_verse: Even powerful rulers die in the darkness of night when they least expect it, just like the rest of us. God Watches Everything We Do
translation_verse: Bewura nɛ b ji eleŋ ga gba bee wu kanyɛso, tentembiri to, jemanɛ nɛ b maa fɛ fanɛ loŋ beeŋ wora, fanɛ anyi be ekama nna.

english_verse: God watches everything we do.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ bee wu kusɔ kama nɛ anyee wora.

english_verse: No evil person can hide in the deepest darkness.
translation_verse: Tentembiri plɔ gba maaŋ tiŋ n ta alubiworapo ŋ ŋana Ebɔrɛ so.

english_verse: And so, God doesn't need to set a time for judgment.
translation_verse: Amoso Ebɔrɛ maŋ lara kachɛ nɛ e beeŋ ji demu n yili.

english_verse: Without asking for advice, God removes mighty leaders and puts others in their place.
translation_verse: E maa kule esa ko ekpa nsaa lara bejuŋkparpogboŋ ashi kejuŋkpar to nseŋ naa ta beko e tal bumo to.

english_verse: He knows what they are like, and he wipes them out in the middle of the night.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, mo e nyi kusɔ nɛ baa wora, mo alɛ e naa lara bumo kiidiso nɛ baa tɔr kuraa.

english_verse: And while others look on, he punishes them because they were evil
translation_verse: E bee gberge bumo kusoe kakpa nɛ basa beeŋ wu bumo nna

english_verse: The persons they mistreated had prayed for help, until God answered their prayers.
translation_verse: Betirpo nɛ b daŋ shu ŋ ŋini Ebɔrɛ nɛ mo alɛ nu bumo be kushu nseŋ chɛ bumo to.

english_verse: When God does nothing, can any person or nation find fault with him?
translation_verse: Nɛ Ebɔrɛ baŋ maŋ wora shɛŋ gba, esa ko ŋko efuli ko beeŋ tiŋ n wu mo kulubi a?

english_verse: But still, he punishes rulers who abuse their people.
translation_verse: Ama e kraa gberge bewura nɛ baa kɔrfɛ bumo be basa kusoe.

english_verse: Job, you should tell God that you are guilty and promise to do better.
translation_verse: Job, a daga fo kaŋɛ Ebɔrɛ fanɛ fo wora n jija, nseŋ nase kɔnɔ fanɛ fo maaŋ naŋ wora kulubi kikɛ.

english_verse: Then ask him to point out what you did wrong, so you won't do it again.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ fo kule mo nɛ e shin nɛ fo pin kulubi nɛ fo wora, saŋɛ na so, fo maaŋ naŋ wora kumo kikɛ.

english_verse: Do you make the rules, or does God? You have to decide— I can't do it for you; now make up your mind.
translation_verse: Fo ka kini kewora kusɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ bee sha ere, fee sha fanɛ mo ere e wora kusɔ nɛ fee sha n sa fo a? Fo e daga fanɛ fo yili kusɔ ko n sa fo kumu, mannɛ ma. Naniere, kaŋɛ anyi kusɔ nɛ fee fɛ!

english_verse: Job, anyone with good sense can easily see
translation_verse: Job, esa kama nɛ e kɔ nfɛra lela beeŋ tiŋ m pin

english_verse: that you are speaking nonsense and lack good judgment.
translation_verse: fanɛ kawuli be mmalga nɛ fee malga na, a maŋ kɔ kanyiasheŋ kikɛ.

english_verse: So I pray for you to suffer as much as possible for talking like a sinner.
translation_verse: Amoso mee kule Ebɔrɛ nna fanɛ fo ji awurfoŋ ga, ŋkpal fo ka malga fanɛ alubiworapo so.

english_verse: Job, are you really innocent in the sight of God?
translation_verse: “Job, fo tama fanɛ fo maŋ wora kulubi kikɛ ashi Ebɔrɛ be anishito kashenteŋto a?

english_verse: Don't you honestly believe it pays to obey him?
translation_verse: Fo maŋ yirda kashenteŋto fanɛ kewora Ebɔrɛ kasonu kɔ tɔnɔ ga a?

english_verse: I will give the answers to you and your friends. *
translation_verse: Meeŋ sa asheŋ nɛ fo nɛ fo nekpaana bishi na be atuwebi.

english_verse: Look up to the heavens
translation_verse: Men keni kananɛ bɔrɛwɔlpa wɔ esoso kufɔ loŋ!

english_verse: Is any good you may have done at all helpful to him?
translation_verse: Nɛ fo la esa niŋiso, manɛ nɛ fee sa mo, ŋko manɛ nɛ Ebɔrɛ bee fin fo kutɔ?

english_verse: The evil or good you do only affects other humans.
translation_verse: Kulubi ŋko kelela kama nɛ fee wora na, fo braana edimɛdi nɛ fee wora amo.

english_verse: In times of trouble, everyone begs the mighty God to have mercy.
translation_verse: Etɔrɔ be jemanɛ ekama bee kule Ebɔrɛ gboŋgboŋi na nna nɛ e wu mo kuwɔr nseŋ mɔlga mo.

english_verse: But after their Creator helps them through hard times, they forget about him,
translation_verse: Ama Ebɔrɛ nɛ e to bumo na baŋ chɛ bumo to jemanɛ nɛ asheŋ ki kpakpa na be kaman baa teŋ mo so nna.

english_verse: God won't listen to the prayers of proud and evil people.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ maa nu kamoowu wuraana nɛ alubiworapoana be kabɔrɛkule.

english_verse: If God All-Powerful refuses to answer their empty prayers,
translation_verse: Nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na bee kini kenu kabɔrɛkule fuloŋ nɛ baa kule na bre,

english_verse: Be patient a while longer; I have something else to say in God's defense.
translation_verse: “Nya kanyiti gbrɛbi n sa ma. Ŋ kraa kɔ kusɔ ko nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ a laŋɛ Ebɔrɛ be kaplɛa so.

english_verse: God always does right— and this knowledge comes straight from God.
translation_verse: Kusɔ kama nɛ Ebɔrɛ wora niŋi nna. Ebɔrɛ gbagba kutɔ nɛ n nya le be kenyi ere.

english_verse: You can rest assured that what I say is true.
translation_verse: Baa nyi geeŋ fanɛ kusɔ kama nɛ mee kaŋɛ ere la kashenteŋ nna.

english_verse: God watches over good people and places them in positions of power and honor forever.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ e naa keni basa niŋiso so nsaa kuŋ bumo, mo alɛ nsaa shin nɛ baa wora asheŋ fanɛ bewura, nseŋ naa shin nɛ basa bee sa bumo bunyaŋ mbaanaayɔ.

english_verse: But when people are prisoners of suffering and pain, *
translation_verse: Ama nɛ fanɛ basa wɔ kabuti to a ji awurfoŋ ŋkpal kusɔ nɛ b wora so,

english_verse: And if they obey, they will be successful and happy from then on.
translation_verse: Nɛ b wora Ebɔrɛ kasonu nsaa shuŋ mo, asheŋ naa nite nɛnɛ nna a sa bumo nɛ b naŋ nya kayurwushi bumo be kebaawɔtɔ to.

english_verse: But if they foolishly refuse, they will be rewarded with a violent death. Godless People Are Too Angry
translation_verse: Ama nɛ b wora kawulisheŋ nseŋ kini kenu n sa mo bre, baaŋ wu luwu besaso n yɔ bubuni to.

english_verse: Hard times and trouble are God's way of getting our attention!
translation_verse: Awurfoŋ nɛ etɔrɔbi nɛ Ebɔrɛ bee bɔla so a bugi basa be anishi nsaa ŋini bumo asheŋ.

english_verse: And at this very moment, God deeply desires to lead you from trouble and to spread your table with your favorite food.
translation_verse: Le be jemanɛ ere Ebɔrɛ be kenishi pere nna nɛ e lara fo ashi tɔrɔ to nseŋ sa fo kusɔ kama nɛ fee sha yɛlyɛla so.

english_verse: Now that the judgment for your sins has fallen upon you,
translation_verse: Ama naniere fo kaa bee nya fo alubi be kakɔka ere,

english_verse: don't let your anger and the pain you endured make you sneer at God.
translation_verse: baa da so nɛ esa kikɛ maaŋ ta asɔ n fule fo ŋko kakɛ ko n lɔlɔ fo n wɔtɔ kulubi to.

english_verse: Your reputation and riches cannot protect you from distress,
translation_verse: Fo eyilikpa nɛ kedamaya maaŋ tiŋ ŋ kuŋ fo ashi awurfoŋ damta to.

english_verse: Be on guard! Don't turn to evil as a way of escape.
translation_verse: Baa de so nɛ fo maaŋ kilgi n yɔ alubi nɛ fee fɛ fanɛ amo a bɔ awurfoŋ nɛ fee ji na to.

english_verse: God's power is unlimited. He needs no teachers
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ be eleŋgboŋ maŋ kɔ ekar. Eŋinipo kikɛ maŋ naa wɔtɔ fanɛ mo.

english_verse: Others have praised God for what he has done, so join with them.
translation_verse: Beko kpaŋ Ebɔrɛ ŋkpal kusɔ nɛ e wora so, a daga fanɛ fo alɛ gba e kpaŋ mo.

english_verse: From down here on earth, everyone has looked up and seen
translation_verse: Edimɛdi kikɛ wu kusɔ nɛ e wora, ama kewora fanɛ kufɔ nɛ b yili n wu amo.

english_verse: how great God is— God is more than we imagine; no one can count the years he has lived. *
translation_verse: Anyi maaŋ tiŋ m pin Ebɔrɛ be keshi to, ŋko n tiŋ ŋ karga mbe nfɛ nɛ e ji.

english_verse: God gathers moisture into the clouds
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ e naa shin nɛ bunyaŋ bee gama a ki bɔrɛwɔlpa.

english_verse: And when God sends lightning, it can be seen at the bottom of the sea.
translation_verse: Mo e naa shin nɛ bɔrɛ bee nyɛkpɛ a fulto kaplɛkama, hale teku be kaseto gba.

english_verse: Each flash of lightning is one of his arrows striking its target,
translation_verse: Mo e kɔ bɔrɛ be kenyɛkpɛ mbe enɔana to, nsaa kaŋɛ kumo kakpa nɛ k beeŋ ya yuu nɛ k ya yu so ndoŋ.

english_verse: creating miracles too marvelous for us to understand.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ baŋ ponte ŋ kaŋɛ kesheŋ, emamachisheŋ nɛ e bee mɔ kɔnɔ e naa wora.

english_verse: and they force animals to seek shelter.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ asɔbɔya e shile n ya ŋana bumo be edikpaana to.

english_verse: Job, consider carefully the many wonders of God.
translation_verse: Job, fɛ Ebɔrɛ be emamachisheŋ damta nɛ e bee wora na be asheŋ nɛnɛ ŋ keni.

english_verse: of God who knows all things? Or how he hangs the clouds in empty space?
translation_verse: Fo nyi kusɔ nɛ k kɔ bɔrɛwɔlpa to awɔlto a? Ebɔrɛ nɛ e nyi kusɔ kikɛ na be emamachisheŋ nna.

english_verse: You almost melt in the heat of fierce desert winds when the sky is like brass.
translation_verse: Jemanɛ nɛ keshishɛrsawule so be afu daŋ ber kasawule na so na, kaboŋ na kikɛ daŋ bel edɛ nna nɛ kaplɛkama wora shruum.

english_verse: God can hammer out the clouds in spite of the oppressive heat, but can you?
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ bre beeŋ tiŋ n shin nɛ bɔrɛwɔlpa e parga to m buu so nɛ kakpa e wushi, ama fo alɛ beeŋ tiŋ n wora loŋ a?

english_verse: Tell us what to say to God! Our minds are in the dark, and we don't know how to argue our case.
translation_verse: To, kaŋɛ anyi kusɔ nɛ anyeeŋ kaŋɛ Ebɔrɛ, anyi ere be nfɛra wea to nna na. Anyi maŋ kɔ shɛŋ nɛ an naŋ kaŋɛ.

english_verse: Should I risk my life by telling God that I want to speak?
translation_verse: A daga ŋ kaŋɛ Ebɔrɛ fanɛ mee sha kemalga mo kutɔ nɛ e mur ma a?

english_verse: No one can stare at the sun after a breeze has blown the clouds from the sky.
translation_verse: Esa kikɛ maaŋ tiŋ n ta anishi fuloŋ ŋ keni epeŋi jemanɛ nɛ bɔrɛwɔlpa maŋ buu kumo so.

english_verse: Yet the glorious splendor of God All-Powerful is brighter by far.
translation_verse: Ama Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na be kemaŋkura fulto a nyɛkpɛ a chɔ epeŋi ga.

english_verse: God cannot be seen— but his power is great, and he is always fair.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ be eleŋgboŋ na shi ga, anyi alɛ maaŋ tiŋ n wu mo kenishiso. Ama mo alɛ niŋi nna nsaa maa kpɛa edimɛdi to.

english_verse: And so we humans fear God, because he shows no respect for those who are proud and think they know so much.
translation_verse: Amoso edimɛdi bee ŋana mo nsaa bunyaŋ mo nna, ŋkpal manɛ so, e maa keni kamoowu wuraana nɛ baa fɛ fanɛ b nyi asheŋ ga na a bɔlɔ kenishi.

english_verse: From out of a storm, the Lord said to Job:
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ bɔla bɔrɛfu so ŋ kaŋɛ Job le:

english_verse: Why do you talk so much when you know so little?
translation_verse: Manɛ nna nɛ fee malga ga loŋ, saŋɛ nɛ fo mmalga maŋ kɔ shɛŋ amo to?

english_verse: Now get ready to face me! Can you answer the questions I ask?
translation_verse: To, naniere wora shiriya nɛ ma nɛ fo e ji asheŋ! Meeŋ bishi fo asheŋ, nɛ fo sa ma amo be atuwebi.

english_verse: How did I lay the foundation for the earth? Were you there?
translation_verse: Ŋ ka daa nase durnya be gbaltɔlase na, nɛ fo daa wɔtɔ a?

english_verse: Doubtless you know who decided its length and width.
translation_verse: Wanɛ e chaŋ kumo be mparto nɛ nteŋ to? M maŋ tama fo ka nyi.

english_verse: When the ocean was born, I set its boundaries
translation_verse: Jemanɛ nɛ n to teku na, wanɛ e chaŋ kumo be egbaŋ ŋ kuŋ kumo?

english_verse: and said, “Your powerful waves stop here! They can go no farther.” Did You Ever Tell the Sun To Rise?
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ kumo le: “Kakpa nɛ feeŋ tiŋ m ba fo nna na sa maŋ kaŋ choŋ so ndoŋ. Kakpa nɛ fo atili lempo na daga e fo nna na.”

english_verse: Did you ever tell the sun to rise? And did it obey?
translation_verse: Job, fo daŋ kaŋɛ epeŋi fanɛ k pete kachipurdidi, nɛ k nu n sa fo a?

english_verse: Did it take hold of the earth and shake out the wicked like dust from a rug?
translation_verse: Fo daŋ kaŋɛ karechɛso fanɛ k ba nɛ kakpa fuli to n lara kumu kpakpaso wuraana efuli ashi bumo be eŋanakpa a?

english_verse: But its light is too much for those who are evil, and their power is broken.
translation_verse: Karechɛ be kefulto bee lara kumukpakpasowuraana be ashuŋ lubi efuli nna nɛ b maa nya a wora amo.

english_verse: Have you seen the gate to the world of the dead?
translation_verse: Fo daŋ wu kakpa nɛ bubuni wɔ na be kabuna kenishiso ŋ ku so a?

english_verse: And how large is the earth? Tell me, if you know!
translation_verse: Fo nyi kananɛ durnya be mparto sa a? Kaŋɛ ma, nɛ fo nyi nna na!

english_verse: Where is the home of light, and where does darkness live?
translation_verse: Fo nyi kakpa nɛ kefulto nɛ tentembiri kikɛ bee shi a ba a?

english_verse: I'm certain you must be able to, since you were already born when I created everything.
translation_verse: N nyi geeŋ fanɛ feeŋ tiŋ n wora loŋ, ŋkpal manɛ so, b kurge fo nna pɔɛŋ nɛ n to kusɔ kama.

english_verse: Have you been to the places where I keep snow and hail,
translation_verse: Fo daŋ yɔ mboŋ nɛ mee yili abɔrɛjembubi nɛ kunyɔlɔ a?

english_verse: until I use them to punish and conquer nations?
translation_verse: N yili amo nna a jo kebagato be jemanɛ nɛ jemanɛ nɛ meeŋ gberge efuliana na kusoe.

english_verse: From where does lightning leap, or the east wind blow?
translation_verse: Nnɛ nɛ bɔrɛ be kenyɛkpɛ bee shi a lar, ŋko nnɛ nɛ epeŋilarkpa be afu bee shi a ba?

english_verse: Who carves out a path for thunderstorms? Who sends torrents of rain
translation_verse: Wanɛ e chaŋ kubɔr n sa bɔrɛchugboŋ nseŋ bugi ekpa n sa bɔrɛfugboŋ?

english_verse: Rain that changes barren land to meadows green with grass.
translation_verse: Wanɛ e naa wurge kasawule wɔlso so nchu nɛ afitiri bumbuŋ bee kɔr kumo so?

english_verse: Who is the father of the dew and of the rain?
translation_verse: Wanɛ e la bunyaŋ nɛ bɔrɛ, amo tuto?

english_verse: that fall in winter, when streams and lakes freeze solid as a rock? Can You Arrange Stars?
translation_verse: Wanɛ e kurge abɔrɛjembubi be yiri kikɛ, nɛ a bee shin nɛ nchu bee ki fanɛ ajembu nɛ mbombi nɛ apa be nchu bee wushi a ki abɔrɛjembubi?

english_verse: Can you arrange stars in groups such as Orion and the Pleiades?
translation_verse: Feeŋ tiŋ n shin nɛ achɛkpabi e ba abar so fanɛ amo nɛ baa tre koshi nɛ mbe bibi nna a?

english_verse: Do you control the stars or set in place the Big Dipper and the Little Dipper?
translation_verse: Feeŋ tiŋ ŋ ŋini achɛkpabi kusɔ nɛ a beeŋ baa wora, ŋko n ta achɛkpabi nɛ baa tre Shishirigboŋ nɛ Shishiribi n yili amo be eyilikpa a?

english_verse: Do you know the laws that govern the heavens, and can you make them rule the earth?
translation_verse: Fo nyi mbra nɛ e wɔtɔ n sa awɔlpa to be asɔ a? Fo alɛ beeŋ tiŋ n shin nɛ mbra na e shuŋ kasawule so a?

english_verse: Can you order the clouds to send a downpour,
translation_verse: Feeŋ tiŋ ŋ kaŋɛ awɔlpa nɛ a shin nɛ bɔrɛgboŋ e ba a?

english_verse: Did you teach birds to know that rain or floods are on their way?
translation_verse: Fo e naa ŋini ebɔnbɔŋɛ kechali nɛ ketar be jemanɛ nɛ a bee ba nsaa yɔ a?

english_verse: Do you send an animal into their den?
translation_verse: Fo e naa kaŋɛ ebuluŋ nɛ a bee yɔ amo be edikpa a?

english_verse: And when starving young ravens cry out to me for food, do you satisfy their hunger?
translation_verse: Wanɛ e naa sa ejɔnɔkoso nɛ amo be bibi ajibi jemanɛ nɛ akoŋ kɔ amo nɛ a bee shu a tre ma a fin ajibi na?

english_verse: When do mountain goats and deer give birth? Have you been there when their young are born? *
translation_verse: Fo nyi jemanɛ nɛ kebee so be mboe nɛ echibir bee kurge a? Fo daŋ yili ŋ keni a kaa bee kurge amo be bibi a?

english_verse: Instead, they roam the hills, searching for pastureland.
translation_verse: Ama a bee nite a kulti abee so nna a fin afitiri bumbuŋ a ji.

english_verse: Would a wild ox agree to live in your barn and labor for you?
translation_verse: Kupuŋ to be kena beeŋ shuli m ba kaa wɔ fo kenalu to nsaa shuŋ a sa fo a?

english_verse: Could you force him to plow or to drag a heavy log to smooth out the soil?
translation_verse: Feeŋ tiŋ n ta kubɔ to be kebarga n wɔtɔ kumo n shin nɛ k dɔ a? Ŋko n shin nɛ k gberge katekpa m pumpuŋ kudɔ to a?

english_verse: Can you depend on him to use his great strength and do your heavy work?
translation_verse: Feeŋ shuli n to eyur n lɛ kumo so nɛ k ta eleŋgboŋ nɛ k kɔ na n shuŋ ashuŋ kpakpaso n sa fo a?

english_verse: Can you trust him to harvest your grain or take it to your barn from the threshing place? An Ostrich Proudly Flaps Her Wings
translation_verse: Feeŋ shuli n yirda kumo nɛ k sulɔ fo ayu teŋiso m bar fo nɛ fo wɔtɔ mpuro to a?

english_verse: An ostrich proudly flaps her wings, but not because she loves her young.
translation_verse: Nyiŋgbeŋ bee ber atɛ to manaŋ manaŋ ga, ama kumo alɛ maaŋ tiŋ n firgi n fo tɔkɔrkɔ so.

english_verse: She abandons her eggs and lets the dusty ground keep them warm.
translation_verse: Nyiŋgbeŋ bee yige kumo be afule nna a nase kasawule nɛ kasawule na e bel amo edɛ.

english_verse: And she doesn't seem to worry that the feet of an animal could crush them all.
translation_verse: K maŋ nyi fanɛ esa ŋko kusɔbɔya ko beeŋ tiŋ n chichi amoso m bure.

english_verse: She treats her eggs as though they were not her own, unconcerned that her work might be for nothing.
translation_verse: K bee wora nna fanɛ afule na ka maŋ la kumo peya na. Kumo alɛ be kegben jiga be asheŋ maŋ tir kumo.

english_verse: I myself made her foolish and without common sense.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, mee to kumo kusɔbɔya wulpo nɛ k maŋ nyi shɛŋ.

english_verse: But once she starts running, she laughs at a rider on the fastest horse. Did You Give Horses Their Strength?
translation_verse: Ama nɛ k baŋ fara a shile, k bee choŋ egbaŋɛdiipo so nna nsaa mushe bumo.

english_verse: Did you give horses their strength and the flowing hair along their necks?
translation_verse: Fo, Job e sa egbaŋɛ eleŋ ŋko amo be kubɔ so be afuibi na a?

english_verse: Did you make them able to jump like grasshoppers or to frighten people with their snorting?
translation_verse: Fo e shin nɛ a bee tiŋ a tɛ fanɛ abamber a, ŋko a fute eleŋso a funti basa na a?

english_verse: Before horses are ridden into battle, they paw at the ground, proud of their strength.
translation_verse: B baaŋ dii egbaŋɛ a yɔ kena to, a bee mur aya kasawule nna ŋ kpa eshishɛr, n shile eleŋso n luri kena na to.

english_verse: Laughing at fear, they rush toward the fighting,
translation_verse: A maŋ nyi kusɔ nɛ baa tre kufu, amo alɛ maa wu tokobi nsaa shile kumo.

english_verse: while the weapons of their riders rattle and flash in the sun.
translation_verse: Amo be bediipo be akɔsɔ bee kpla abar nna nsaa nyɛkpɛ epeŋi so.

english_verse: Unable to stand still, they gallop eagerly into battle when trumpets blast.
translation_verse: Egbaŋɛ bre maaŋ tiŋ n yili boeŋ. Kena to be mbel baŋ shu, a bee yarase a yɔ kena to nna.

english_verse: Stirred by the distant smells and sounds of war, they snort in reply to the trumpet.
translation_verse: Kabel baŋ shu, baa fute eleŋso nna. Baa nu kena be asheŋ kufɔ nna, nsaa nu amo be bediipoana be mmalga.

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful,
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ Job le:

english_verse: Job said to the Lord:
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Job kaŋɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ le:

english_verse: I did speak once or twice, but never again.
translation_verse: N daŋ malga kela koŋwule ŋko ale anyɔ ko nna, ama m maaŋ naŋ malga kikɛ.”

english_verse: Then out of the storm the Lord said to Job:
translation_verse: Kede be kaman nɛ bɔrɛfugboŋ ko ber m ba nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bɔla kumo to ŋ kaŋɛ Job le:

english_verse: Face me and answer the questions I ask!
translation_verse: “Kilgi fo anishito n shoŋi ma nseŋ sa ma asheŋ bishiso ere be atuwebi!

english_verse: Are you trying to prove that you are innocent by accusing me of injustice?
translation_verse: Fee sha nɛ fo ŋini fanɛ m maa ji asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so. Ma e maŋ wora n nyalɛ, fo ere e wora n nyalɛ, ŋko?

english_verse: Do you have a powerful arm and a thundering voice that compare with mine?
translation_verse: Fo eleŋ fo ma eleŋ so a? Fo ebɔl beeŋ tiŋ m ponte to fanɛ meya a?

english_verse: If so, then surround yourself with glory and majesty. *
translation_verse: Kumo ere shin nɛ ekama e wu kemaŋkura nɛ yukugboŋ nɛ fo kɔ na.

english_verse: Wrap them in grave clothes and bury them together in the dusty soil.
translation_verse: Ta kesaŋɛ ŋ ŋmea bumo be ekama nseŋ gama bumo n ya puli nchaŋ to!

english_verse: Do this, and I will agree that you have won this argument. I Created You
translation_verse: Nɛ fo tiŋ n wora ade kikɛ, ŋ gbagba beeŋ shuli so fanɛ fo e kɔ kashenteŋ.

english_verse: I created both you and the hippopotamus. It eats only grass like an ox,
translation_verse: Keni churu le. Ma e to kumo nɛ fo kikɛ. Ama afitiri nawule nɛ k bee ji fanɛ kena.

english_verse: but look at the mighty muscles in its body
translation_verse: Keni kananɛ k pɔl eyur to nsaa kɔ eleŋ aya ase loŋ.

english_verse: and legs. Its tail is like a cedar tree, and its thighs are thick.
translation_verse: Kumo be kodu yil nna fanɛ kakubadibi, nɛ kumo be ebɛaŋ malɛ pɔlto nɛnɛ.

english_verse: The bones in its legs are like bronze or iron.
translation_verse: Kumo be awibi be eleŋ du fanɛ danyaŋ peper ŋko kebɛlso nna.

english_verse: I made it more powerful than any other creature, yet I am stronger still.
translation_verse: Ma e to kumo nɛ k kɔ eleŋ a chɔ ma asɔ toso kikɛ, ama ŋ kraa chɔ kumo eleŋ.

english_verse: Undisturbed, it eats grass while the other animals play nearby. *
translation_verse: Abee to nɛ k bee nya afitiri a ji nɛ asɔbɔya nɛ a ka na malɛ e baa wɔ ndoŋ a pel.

english_verse: It remains calm and unafraid with the Jordan River rushing and splashing in its face.
translation_verse: Jɔɔdan be Lɔr na bee da nchu a buu kumo gba, k bee dese boeŋ nna a maa lɔ kufu.

english_verse: There is no way to capture a hippopotamus— not even by hooking its nose or blinding its eyes.
translation_verse: Wanɛ e naŋ tiŋ m buu kumo be anishi so m pɛ kumo? Ŋko n ta kusɔ ŋ kɔl kumo be kamuna to m pɛ kumo?”

english_verse: Can you catch a sea monster by using a fishhook? Can you tie its mouth shut with a rope?
translation_verse: Feeŋ tiŋ n ta kɔrɔtɔ be dariwa m pɛ kusɔbɔya gboŋ lubi nɛ k wɔ teku to nna a? Ŋko ŋ kre kumo be kɔnɔ afɔl n nase a?

english_verse: Can it be led around by a ring in its nose or a hook in its jaw?
translation_verse: Feeŋ tiŋ n futi kumo be kamuna n wɔtɔ kumo efɔl a? Ŋko n ta dariwa n da kumo be ketaya m bɔl a?

english_verse: Will it surrender as a slave for life?
translation_verse: K beeŋ shuli fanɛ k beeŋ baa la fo kenya mbaanaayɔ a?

english_verse: Can it be tied by the leg like a pet bird for little girls?
translation_verse: Feeŋ tiŋ n chɛ kumo afɔl fanɛ kabuibi n sa fo mbia nɛ b keta a pɛl a?

english_verse: Is it ever chopped up and its pieces bargained for in the fish-market?
translation_verse: Eyawujipo beeŋ shuli n ji kumo be kebɛ a? Baaŋ shuli ŋ kuya kumo to n fa a?

english_verse: Can it be killed with harpoons or spears?
translation_verse: Esa beeŋ tiŋ n da kumo kekpa ŋko n to kumo malfa m mɔ a?

english_verse: Wrestle it just once— that will be the end.
translation_verse: Fo baŋ tu kumo ŋ kɔ kela koŋwule, fo maaŋ naŋ shuli n tu kumo ŋ kɔ kikɛ.

english_verse: Merely a glimpse of this monster makes all courage melt.
translation_verse: Esa kama nɛ e wu kusɔkpaŋ lubi gboŋgboŋi na kenishiso bee paŋ mbe kenyɛn nna nseŋ tɔr kasawule.

english_verse: And if it is too fierce for anyone to attack, who would dare oppose me?
translation_verse: Nɛ esa kikɛ maŋ kɔ eleŋ nɛnɛ nɛ e tiŋ n tu kumo ŋ kɔ, kumo ere wanɛ e naŋ tiŋ n tu ma ŋ kɔ?

english_verse: I am in command of the world and in debt to no one.
translation_verse: Ma e naa yili asheŋ a sa durnya kikɛ, ma alɛ maŋ ji esa kikɛ be kukɔ.

english_verse: Who could strip off its armor or bring it under control with a harness?
translation_verse: Esa kikɛ maaŋ tiŋ n luu kumo be kawɔl, ŋko n ta kebarga n wɔtɔ kumo be kɔnɔ to.

english_verse: Who would try to open its jaws, full of fearsome teeth? *
translation_verse: Esa kikɛ maŋ shuli m bugi kumo be kɔnɔ, ŋkpal manɛ so, kumo be kɔnɔ to be anyi bee keta kufu nna.

english_verse: When this monster sneezes, lightning flashes, and its eyes glow like the dawn.
translation_verse: Kusɔkpaŋ lubi gboŋgboŋi ere baŋ kpa kamuna to, edɛ e naa lar. Kumo be anishi malɛ bee kpa edɛ nna fanɛ epeŋi ka pete na.

english_verse: And smoke spews from its nose like steam from a boiling pot,
translation_verse: Edishi malɛ bee lar kumo be kamuna to nna, fanɛ kapuliya fuloŋ ka bɛ asure so nɛ edishi bee kaa kumo to na.

english_verse: the weakest parts of its body are harder than iron,
translation_verse: Kumo be kawɔl be kaplɛkama maŋ du pɔtɔ pɔtɔ, kumo kikɛ baa du kpakpa nna fanɛ kebɛlso na.

english_verse: and its heart is stone.
translation_verse: Kumo be kagbene so du kpakpa ga nna fanɛ kuboo.

english_verse: When this noisy monster appears, even the most powerful turn and run in fear.
translation_verse: Kusɔkpaŋ lubi gboŋgboŋi ere baŋ lara kumo be kumu efuli kufu bee pɛ belempo gba nna nɛ b baa shile.

english_verse: No sword or spear can harm it,
translation_verse: Tokobi ŋko kekpa kikɛ maaŋ tiŋ n doro kumo kikɛ.

english_verse: and weapons of bronze or iron are as useless as straw or rotten wood.
translation_verse: Danyaŋ ŋko abɛlso be akɔsɔ du fanɛ agasa ŋko ndibi wuso nna n sa kumo. A maaŋ tiŋ n wora kumo shɛŋ.

english_verse: Rocks thrown from a sling cause it no more harm than husks of grain. This monster fears no arrows,
translation_verse: Atanyembi maa shin nɛ k bee shile, ŋkpal manɛ so, k maa ŋana amo. Ketababu be kejembu malɛ du fanɛ kuyu be kewabi nna n sa kumo.

english_verse: it simply smiles at spears, and striking it with a stick is like slapping it with straw.
translation_verse: Kaprɛ bre du fanɛ kegasa nna n sa kumo, basa baa kpa kumo akpa, k bee mushe bumo nna.

english_verse: As it crawls through the mud, its sharp and spiny hide tears the ground apart.
translation_verse: K baa gbeye depɔ to, kumo be epun so be afɔfɔ nɛ a du fanɛ mpɛlanfu na bee kori depɔ nna nsaa nase kubɔr.

english_verse: and it leaves behind a trail of shining white foam.
translation_verse: Nɛ kumo be kubɔr e baa nyɛkpɛ a bɛ kumo so nɛ teku be nchu na e ka kupɔpɔ.

english_verse: It is king of all proud creatures, and it looks upon the others as nothing.
translation_verse: Kumo e la ewura asɔbɔya ŋana so kikɛ to. Amoso k bee keni amo kikɛ jiga nna.

english_verse: No one can oppose you, because you have the power to do what you want.
translation_verse: “Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, n nyi fanɛ fo e la Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na. Ma alɛ nyi fanɛ feeŋ tiŋ n wora kusɔ kama nɛ fee sha.

english_verse: You asked why I talk so much when I know so little. I have talked about things that are far beyond my understanding.
translation_verse: Fee bishi kusɔ nɛ k ba nɛ mee malga ga, jemanɛ nɛ ma mmalga maŋ kɔ shɛŋ amo to. Kashenteŋto, asɔ nɛ a baŋ ma kepinto so ga be asheŋ nɛ m malga.

english_verse: I heard about you from others; now I have seen you with my own eyes.
translation_verse: Beko kutɔ nɛ n daŋ nu fo asheŋ, ama naniere bre ŋ gbagba wu fo kenishiso.

english_verse: The Lord said to Eliphaz: What my servant Job has said about me is true, but I am angry with you and your two friends for not telling the truth.
translation_verse: Job ka malga n loge nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ Job mo nekpa, Ɛlifaz nɛ e shi Teman be kadegboŋ to na le: “Kusɔ nɛ ma kayɛrbi Job kaŋɛ a laŋɛ ma kaplɛa so na la kashenteŋ nna, ama n nya agbo nna n wora fo nɛ fo nekpaana benyɔ na, ŋkpal men ka kini keji kashenteŋ na so.

english_verse: Then Job gave a feast for his brothers and sisters and for his old friends. They expressed their sorrow for the suffering the Lord had brought on him, and they each gave Job some silver and a gold ring.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ Job wora kejigboŋ n sa mo niopibiana kikɛ nɛ mo teri draana kikɛ ashi mbe laŋ to. B daŋ ba wushi mo kagbene nseŋ lolo mo nna a laŋɛ etɔrɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na daŋ sa ekpa nɛ a ba mo so na kikɛ be kaplɛa so nna. Bumo be ekama daŋ sa mo amansherbi nɛ shuwa be kepinibi nna.

english_verse: In addition to seven sons, Job had three daughters,
translation_verse: E daŋ naŋ sa Job bibinyɛn ashunu nɛ bibiche asa nna.

english_verse: They were the most beautiful women in that part of the world, and Job gave them shares of his property, along with their brothers.
translation_verse: Eche kikɛ daa maŋ wɔ kasawule na so nɛ e walɛ kebita n fo Job be bibiche asa na so. Bumo tuto malɛ daŋ yige kapetɛ nna n sa bumo nɛ bumo danyɛnsoana na.

english_verse: and when he finally died, he was very old.
translation_verse: E daŋ bel nɛnɛ nna pɔɛŋ nseŋ wu.

english_verse: God blesses those people who refuse evil advice and won't follow sinners or join in sneering at God.
translation_verse: Kagbenefuli la bekama nɛ b maa sɔ alubiworapoana be kasotoji, ŋko a kute alubiworapoana to a wora asheŋ, ŋko a tu basa nɛ b maŋ kɔ saŋɛ a sa Ebɔrɛ na peya nna.

english_verse: ) The Way to Happiness
translation_verse: ) Kashenteŋ be kagbenefuli be asheŋ

english_verse: Instead, they find happiness in the Teaching of the Lord, and they think about it day and night.
translation_verse: Bumo be kagbenefuli bee shi Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be keŋini be kebaawɔtɔ to nna; nɛ kumo be loŋ malɛ wɔ bumo be nfɛra to kapa nɛ kanyɛ.

english_verse: They are like trees growing beside a stream, trees that produce fruit in season and always have leaves. Those people succeed in everything they do.
translation_verse: Loŋ be basa du fanɛ boŋkarase be ndibi nɛ a bee sɔr asɔrso saŋɛ nɛ k daga na nna. Amo be afantaŋ maa gbaŋgbaŋ kikɛ. Kusɔ kama nɛ baa wora bee nite nɛnɛ nna a sa bumo.

english_verse: That isn't true of those who are evil— they are like straw blown by the wind.
translation_verse: Ama mannɛ loŋ nɛ k du n sa alubiworapoana bre. Bumo ere du fanɛ asɔ be afɔfɔ nɛ afu bee foŋ n ya kaa lɛ nna.

english_verse: Sinners won't have an excuse on the day of judgment, and they won't have a place with the people of God.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ be demujiachɛ na, alubiworapoana kikɛ beeŋ ji n tɔr. Ebɔrɛ beeŋ barga bumo ashi basa nɛ baa ŋana mo nsaa wora asheŋ nɛ a niŋi ekpa na kutɔ.

english_verse: The Lord protects everyone who follows him, but the wicked follow a road that leads to ruin.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e naa kuŋ loŋ be basa nsaa ŋini bumo ekpa. Ama alubiworapoana bre be ekpa kɔ bumo nna a yɔ kemur to.

english_verse: Why do the nations plot, and why do their people make useless plans?
translation_verse: Manɛ nna nɛ efuliana na bee kre ŋkre lubi loŋ? Manɛ nna nɛ amo be basa bee kre asheŋ fuloŋ?

english_verse: The kings of this earth have all joined together to turn against the Lord and his chosen king.
translation_verse: Nɛ manɛ nna nɛ amo be bewura nɛ bejuŋkparpoana bee wora kɔnɔ a kini kenu n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ mbe esa lara so na?

english_verse: In heaven the Lord laughs as he sits on his throne, making fun of the nations.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ tase mbe kuwurputi so esoso nna ŋ kplaŋ bumo so, nsaa mushe bumo.

english_verse: The Lord becomes furious and threatens them. His anger terrifies them as he says,
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ fɛa bumo so agbo so, nɛ kufu pɛ bumo ga, nɛ e kaŋɛ bumo le:

english_verse: I will tell the promise that the Lord made to me: “You are my son, because today I have become your father.
translation_verse: Nɛ ewura na kaŋɛ le: “Meeŋ bɔ kɔnɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nase n sa ma na be kubɔya.” E yɛ: “Fo e la m pibinyɛn na; kabre, ŋ ki fo tuto.

english_verse: Ask me for the nations, and every nation on earth will belong to you.
translation_verse: Amoso kule ma, nɛ n ta efuliana ere kikɛ n sa fo; nseŋ shin nɛ durnya ere kikɛ e ki feya.

english_verse: You will smash them with an iron rod and shatter them like dishes of clay.”
translation_verse: Feeŋ ta fo kebɛlso be kuwurkpabi n ji amo so kuwura. Fo alɛ beeŋ bure amo to fanɛ ebɔ be kapuya na

english_verse: Serve and honor the Lord; be glad and tremble.
translation_verse: Men ta kufu nɛ kechicha chicha a shuŋ Ebɔrɛ, nseŋ shin nɛ men be ŋgbene e fuli.

english_verse: Show respect to his son because if you don't, the Lord might become furious and suddenly destroy you. But he blesses and protects everyone who runs to him.
translation_verse: Men baa jɔŋɛ a bunyaŋ mo pibi na, nɛ mannɛ aloŋ e beeŋ nya agbo epul to m mur menyi. E bee nɛfa nsaa kuŋ bekama nɛ baa shile a yɔ mo kutɔ na nna.”

english_verse: I have a lot of enemies, Lord. Many fight against
translation_verse: N nyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, ŋ kɔ bedoŋ damta ga. Basa damta e naa kɔ ma.

english_verse: me and say, “God won't rescue you!”
translation_verse: Baa malga a gbiti ma nna a kaŋɛ le: “Ebɔrɛ maaŋ mɔlga mo.”

english_verse: I pray to you, and you answer from your sacred hill.
translation_verse: N shu n tre fo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na; nɛ fo nu ma kushu ashi fo kebee cheembi na so.

english_verse: I sleep and wake up refreshed because you, Lord, protect me.
translation_verse: Saŋkama nɛ n dese a di, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee keni ma so nna, a kuŋ ma kanyɛ na kikɛ.

english_verse: Ten thousand enemies attack from every side, but I am not afraid.
translation_verse: Hale bedoŋ kagboŋ kulti ma gba, m maa lɔ kufu.

english_verse: because you protect and bless your people.
translation_verse: Kekuŋ shi Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kutɔ nna. Enyɛnpe nɛfa fo basa.

english_verse: You are my God and protector. Please answer my prayer. I was in terrible distress, but you set me free. Now have pity and listen as I pray.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ fo la ma ekumpo, nu ma kekule. N daa wɔ tɔrɔ to nna nɛ fo chɛ ma to. Amoso wu ma kuwɔr nseŋ nu ma kekule.

english_verse: How long will you people refuse to respect me? You love foolish things, and you run after what is worthless.
translation_verse: Saŋɛ mo nɛ menyi basa ere beeŋ yige ma katege? Saŋɛ mo nɛ menyeeŋ yige asheŋ fuloŋ be kasha, nɛ kebaaju a buu efɛ so?

english_verse: The Lord has chosen everyone who is faithful to be his very own, and he answers my prayers.
translation_verse: Men nyi fanɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na, ta basa nɛ baa wora asheŋ niŋiso nna ŋ ki mbe mbia; saŋkama nɛ n shu n tre mo, e bee nu ma kekule nna.

english_verse: But each of you had better tremble and turn from your sins. Silently search your heart as you lie in bed.
translation_verse: Men ta kufu nɛ kechicha chicha n lar men be alubi to. Men keni men be ŋgbene to nɛnɛ, saŋɛ nɛ men nawule dese kelaŋ so na.

english_verse: Offer the proper sacrifices and trust the Lord.
translation_verse: Men lara sarga nɛ k daga n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na, nseŋ yirda mo.

english_verse: There are some who ask, “Who will be good to us?” Let your kindness, Lord, shine brightly on us.
translation_verse: Basa damta bee kule Ebɔrɛ nna a kaŋɛ le: “Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛfa anyi, nseŋ wu anyi kuwɔr.”

english_verse: You brought me more happiness than a rich harvest of grain and grapes.
translation_verse: Kagbenefuli nɛ fo sa ma na chɔ kumo nɛ aboyu damta be keburi ŋko nsa damta be kenya bee sa basa ga.

english_verse: I can lie down and sleep soundly because you, Lord, will keep me safe.
translation_verse: Mee dese nna a di nɛ kagbenewushi, ŋkpal manɛ so, fo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nawule e naa kuŋ ma.

english_verse: Listen, Lord, as I pray! Pay attention when I groan.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ; nu ma kekule; nɛ ma kushuto.

english_verse: You are my King and my God. Answer my cry for help because I pray to you.
translation_verse: Ma Ebɔrɛ nɛ ma ewura, nu ma kushu. Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, mee kule fo nna, chɛ ma to.

english_verse: Each morning you listen to my prayer, as I bring my requests to you and wait for your reply.
translation_verse: Kachipurso kikɛ fee nu ma kekule nna. Mee ta ma asheŋ tirso nna a ba kaa nase fo anishito, nsaa jo fo atuwebi.

english_verse: You are not the kind of God who is pleased with evil. Sinners can't stay with you.
translation_verse: Alubi maa par fo. Fo alɛ nɛ alubiworapo maaŋ tiŋ n chena abar so.

english_verse: No one who boasts can stand in your presence, Lord, and you hate evil people.
translation_verse: Ŋkpensheŋ wura maaŋ tiŋ n yili fo anishito. Fo kishi basa nɛ baa wora alubi ga.

english_verse: You destroy every liar, and you despise violence and deceit.
translation_verse: Feeŋ mur befɛpo kikɛ. Fo kishi kumukpakpaso nɛ kafule ga.

english_verse: Because of your great mercy, I come to your house, Lord, and I am filled with wonder as I bow down to worship at your holy temple.
translation_verse: Ama ŋkpal fo kuwɔrwu ka shi so, meeŋ tiŋ m ba fo bɔrɛlambu to; m ba gbir bunyanso, m maŋkura fo.

english_verse: You do what is right, and I ask you to guide me. Make your teaching clear because of my enemies.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, juŋkpar ma ŋkpal fo ka bee wora asheŋ niŋiso so. Ŋini ma fo ekpa niŋiso na, ŋkpal ŋ ka kɔ bedoŋ damta so.

english_verse: Nothing they say is true! They just want to destroy. Their words are deceitful like a hidden pit, and their tongues are good only for telling lies.
translation_verse: M maaŋ tiŋ n yirda kusɔ nɛ ma doŋana bee kaŋɛ. Esa be kejija nɛ baa fin. Efɛ e bɔlɔ bumo be mmalga to fanɛ kemaŋ chiŋgeliŋ nɛ asɔ buu so. Bumo be adonduloŋ malɛ bee ku efɛ nawule nna.

english_verse: Punish them, God, and let their own plans bring their downfall. Get rid of them! They keep committing crimes and turning against you.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, shin nɛ b ji n tɔr. Shin nɛ bumo gbagba be ŋkre e shin nɛ b mur. Ju bumo ashi fo anishito, ŋkpal bumo be alubi nɛ kumukpakpaso so.

english_verse: Let all who run to you for protection always sing joyful songs. Provide shelter for those who truly love you and let them rejoice.
translation_verse: Ama bumo nɛ baa fin kekuŋ ashi fo kutɔ na bre be ŋgbene bee fuli bumo nna, nɛ baa boŋ nshɛ kagbenefuliso saŋkama. Baa kuŋ bumo nɛ baa sha fo na; Shin nɛ bumo be ŋgbene e baa fuli bumo ŋkpal fo so.

english_verse: Our Lord, you bless those who live right, and you shield them with your kindness.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, fee nɛfa bekama nɛ baa wora fo kasonu nsaa wora asɔ nɛ niŋi nna. Fee kuŋ bumo nna fanɛ kananɛ kebɛlso be kusɔ kuŋso bee kuŋ benapo na.

english_verse: Don't punish me, Lord, or even correct me when you are angry!
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, sa maŋ nya agbo ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ n wora n jija, nseŋ gberge ma kusoe agbo so.

english_verse: Have pity on me and heal my feeble body. My bones tremble with fear,
translation_verse: Wu ma kuwɔr nseŋ sa ma eleŋ; ŋkpal manɛ so, ma eyur kikɛ chɛl ma nna

english_verse: and I am in deep distress. How long will it be?
translation_verse: nɛ mee shin nɛ n wu. Saŋɛ mo nɛ feeŋ chɛ ma to, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ?

english_verse: Turn and come to my rescue. Show your wonderful love and save me, Lord.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe, ba mɔlga ma. Wu ma kuwɔr, nseŋ mɔlga ma ashi luwu to.

english_verse: If I die, I cannot praise you or even remember you.
translation_verse: M baŋ wu, m maaŋ naŋ tiŋ n fur fo, ŋko n nyiŋi fo asheŋ.

english_verse: My groaning has worn me out. At night my bed and pillow are soaked with tears.
translation_verse: Kebɔltofinfin e naa mɔ ma. Kanyɛso kikɛ, ma anishichubi bee pɔ ma gedo nɛ kaputi nna.

english_verse: Sorrow has made my eyes dim, and my sight has failed because of my enemies.
translation_verse: N doŋana shin nɛ kagbenejija pɛ ma, nɛ n shu nɛ ma anishi puŋi a maŋ naa wu nɛnɛ.

english_verse: You, Lord, heard my crying, and those hateful people had better leave me alone.
translation_verse: Basa lubi, men shile ma so! Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na, nu ma kushu.

english_verse: You have answered my prayer and my plea for mercy.
translation_verse: E nu ma kekule nseŋ wu ma kuwɔr, n wora ma asheŋ tirso n sa ma.

english_verse: My enemies will be ashamed and terrified, as they quickly run away in complete disgrace.
translation_verse: Anishinyɔr beeŋ pɛ ma doŋana kikɛ nɛ kufu e pɛ bumo ga nɛ b wulto, nseŋ pal kaman n ta nyɔmɔ n shile n yɔ.

english_verse: You, Lord God, are my protector. Rescue me and keep me safe from all who chase me.
translation_verse: N nyɛnpe nɛ ma Ebɔrɛ, m ba fo kutɔ nna nɛ fo kuŋ ma, nseŋ mɔlga ma. Sɔ ma n yige ashi basa nɛ b ju a buu ma so na kutɔ.

english_verse: Or else they will rip me apart like lions attacking a victim, and no one will save me.
