translation_verse: Nɛ mannɛ aloŋ baaŋ kpɛa ma to fanɛ buluŋ ka kpɛa kusɔbɔya to na. Esa kama maaŋ tiŋ n sɔ ma ama fo nawule.

english_verse: I have not betrayed a friend or had pity on an enemy who attacks for no reason.
translation_verse: ŋko n lar nlɔpo kikɛ kaman, ŋko ŋ kɔ n sɔ n doŋ be asɔ nɛ e maŋ wora shɛŋ;

english_verse: If I have done any of this, then let my enemies chase and capture me. Let them trample me to death and leave me in the dirt.
translation_verse: nɛ n wora asɔ ere be kekama, kumo ere fo shin nɛ ma doŋana e ju ma n pɛ. Shin nɛ b chichi ma so m mɔ nseŋ yige ma n lɛ shishɛr to.

english_verse: Get angry, Lord God! Do something! Attack my furious enemies. See that justice is done.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, nya agbo ŋ kpa n niŋi to n tu ma doŋana nɛ b nya agbo ga na; yili to n shin nɛ kashenteŋji e di efuli.

english_verse: Make the nations come to you, as you sit on your throne above them all.
translation_verse: Shin nɛ basa kikɛ e shɛr fo anishito nɛ fo yili esoso n ji bumo so kuwura.

english_verse: Our Lord, judge the nations! Judge me and show that I am honest and innocent.
translation_verse: Fo e la durnya kikɛ be demujipo na. Amoso Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, shin nɛ n ji n lar; ŋkpal ŋ kaa bee ji kashenteŋ, a maŋ wora n jija so.

english_verse: You know every heart and mind, and you always do right. Now make violent people stop, but protect all of us who obey you.
translation_verse: Fo la Ebɔrɛ nɛ e bee wora asheŋ nɛ a niŋi nna, a nyi esa be kagbene to nɛ mbe nfɛra to be asheŋ kikɛ. Shin nɛ alubiworapo e yige alubi be kebaawora, nseŋ kuŋ basa lela ashi alubi to.

english_verse: You, God, are my shield, the protector of everyone whose heart is right.
translation_verse: Fo, Ebɔrɛ e la ma ekumpo. Fo e naa kuŋ kagbene koŋwulewurana kikɛ.

english_verse: You see that justice is done, and each day you take revenge.
translation_verse: Fee ji asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so nna, nsaa nya agbo karechɛ kikɛ ŋkpal alubi so.

english_verse: Whenever your enemies refuse to change their ways, you sharpen your sword and string your bow.
translation_verse: Nɛ alubiworapo maŋ tuba ashi mbe alubi to, fo yee fo tokobi nna nseŋ gberge fo keta to;

english_verse: Your deadly arrows are ready with flaming tips.
translation_verse: fo ta kudur lubi nna n daŋɛ fo atanyembi nɛ fo gberge alubiworapoana kusoe.

english_verse: An evil person is like a woman about to give birth to a hateful, deceitful, and rebellious child.
translation_verse: Basa di alubi be dampo, nseŋ bela ase nɛ b kurge kafulesheŋ nɛ kumukpakpaso.

english_verse: Such people dig a deep hole, then fall in it themselves.
translation_verse: Ama bumo gbagba e naŋ kilgi n tɔr amaŋ chiŋgeliŋ nɛ b kur n nase beko na to.

english_verse: The trouble they cause comes back on them, and their heads are crushed by their own evil deeds.
translation_verse: Bumo gbagba be alubi beeŋ laŋɛ n deŋi bumo be amu so, nɛ kananɛ baa tintiŋ basa a shin nɛ baa wora asheŋ na e laŋɛ bumo so.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord! You always do right. I will sing about you, the Lord Most High.
translation_verse: Mee chɔrɔ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ga ŋkpal e ka bee wora asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so so. Meeŋ boŋ kashɛ n di Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ nɛ e wɔ esoso na epaŋ.

english_verse: Our Lord and Ruler, your name is wonderful everywhere on earth! You let your glory be seen in the heavens above.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe, anyi be Ebɔrɛ, fo keshi nɛ fo mamachi be aworbi wɔ durnya ere be kaplɛkama; nɛ fo kemaŋkura wɔ esoso.

english_verse: With praises from children and from tiny infants, you have built a fortress. It makes your enemies silent, and all who turn against you are left speechless.
translation_verse: Hale mbi popɔrbi nɛ mbiwurbi kikɛ bee boŋ nshɛ a di fo epaŋ. Fo kuŋ fo kumu ashi fo doŋana be enɔ to. Fo alɛ maaŋ sa fo doŋ kikɛ kashuli.

english_verse: I often think of the heavens your hands have made, and of the moon and stars you put in place.
translation_verse: N baŋ keni awɔlpa nɛ fo to, nɛ kananɛ fo ta kufɔl nɛ achɛkpabi n yili amo be eyilikpa,

english_verse: Then I ask, “Why do you care about us humans? Why are you concerned for us weaklings?”
translation_verse: kusɔ nɛ mee bishi e la fanɛ: “Manɛ bre e baa la dimɛdi nɛ mbe asheŋ tir fo, nɛ fee fɛ mbe asheŋ loŋ?”

english_verse: You made us a little lower than you yourself, and you have crowned us with glory and honor.
translation_verse: Fo nawule e chɔ dimɛdi ashi fo asɔ toso kikɛ to. Fo alɛ e sa mo kemaŋkura nɛ bunyaŋ.

english_verse: You let us rule everything your hands have made. And you put all of it under our power—
translation_verse: Nseŋ shin nɛ e ki fo asɔ toso kikɛ to be ejuŋkparpo. Fo ta asɔ kikɛ fanɛ

english_verse: the sheep and the cattle, and every wild animal,
translation_verse: mbolpɔ nɛ ana nɛ kupuŋ to be asɔbɔya,

english_verse: the birds in the sky, the fish in the sea, and all ocean creatures.
translation_verse: nɛ mbuibi nɛ ekɔrɔtɔ nɛ teku to be asɔ kikɛ m bɔɔ mo enɔ nna.

english_verse: Our Lord and Ruler, your name is wonderful everywhere on earth!
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe anyi be Ebɔrɛ, fo keshi nɛ fo mamachi be aworbi wɔ durnya ere be kaplɛkama nna.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord, with all my heart and tell about the wonders you have worked.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, meeŋ bugi ma kagbene kikɛ n fur fo, nseŋ kaŋɛ etumasesheŋ nɛ fo wora kikɛ.

english_verse: God Most High, I will rejoice; I will celebrate and sing because of you.
translation_verse: Ma kagbene beeŋ fuli ma nɛ n ji eyur ŋkpal fo so. Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ, meeŋ boŋ kashɛ n di fo ketre epaŋ.

english_verse: When my enemies face you, they run away and stumble and are destroyed.
translation_verse: N doŋana baŋ wu fo, baa kilgi nna a shile, nsaa fiti a tɔr a wu.

english_verse: You take your seat as judge, and your fair decisions prove that I was in the right.
translation_verse: Eshenteŋjipo e la fo nɛ fee ji asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so. Fo ji ma asheŋ kashenteŋ be ekpa so n ŋini fanɛ n ji n lar.

english_verse: You warn the nations and destroy evil people; you wipe out their names forever and ever.
translation_verse: Fo fɛa efuliana so nseŋ shin nɛ alubiworapoana mur; nɛ fo bubɔ bumo be atre mbaanaayɔ.

english_verse: Our enemies are destroyed completely for all time. Their cities are torn down, and they will never be remembered again.
translation_verse: Ama doŋana mur cheche. Fo jija bumo be ndeana kikɛ, nɛ esa kikɛ maaŋ naŋ nyiŋi bumo hale mbaanaayɔ.

english_verse: You rule forever, Lord, and you are on your throne, ready for judgment.
translation_verse: Fo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ e naa ji kuwura durnya kikɛ so mbaanaayɔ, nsaa tase fo kuwurputi so a ji demu.

english_verse: You judge the world fairly and treat all nations with justice.
translation_verse: Feeŋ ji durnya ebi demu nɛ kumo be ekpa so, nseŋ ji basa so kuwura ekpa niŋiso so.

english_verse: The poor can run to you because you are a fortress in times of trouble.
translation_verse: Fo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kutɔ nɛ basa nɛ baa mɛaŋ beeŋ tiŋ n shile m ba nɛ fo kuŋ bumo. Fo e la ekuŋkpa lempo awurfoŋ be saŋɛ.

english_verse: Everyone who honors your name can trust you, because you are faithful to all who depend on you.
translation_verse: Bumo nɛ b nyi fo na beeŋ ta bumo be yirda n deŋi fo so; Ŋkpal manɛ so, fo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na maŋ naŋ pal kama n sa bekama nɛ baa fin fo kikɛ.

english_verse: You rule from Zion, Lord, and we sing about you to let the nations know everything you have done.
translation_verse: Men boŋ nshɛ n fur Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ e wɔ Zayɔn be kebee so a ji basa so kuwura na, n shin nɛ efuliana e nu kusɔ nɛ e wora.

english_verse: You did not forget to punish the guilty or listen to the cries of those in need.
translation_verse: Mo e maŋ teŋ kegberge alubiworapo kusoe so, mo alɛ maa kplaŋ kenu bumo nɛ b wɔ awurfoŋ to be kushu so.

english_verse: Please have mercy, Lord! My enemies mistreat me. Keep me from the gates that lead to death,
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, keni kananɛ ndoŋana shin nɛ mee ji awurfoŋ. Wu ma kuwɔr, m mɔlga ma ashi luwu to,

english_verse: and I will sing about you at the gate to Zion. I will be happy there because you rescued me.
translation_verse: nɛ n yili Jerusalɛmebi be anishito n fur fo ŋ kaŋɛ asɔ nɛ fo wora, nseŋ ji eyur ŋkpal fo kumɔlga so.

english_verse: Our Lord, the nations fell into their own pits, and their feet were caught in their own traps.
translation_verse: Efuli pɔtɛana so ebi tɔr amaŋ nɛ bumo gbagba kur to, nɛ ajigbelɛ nɛ b sho na kilgi m pɛ bumo.

english_verse: You showed what you are like, and you made certain that justice is done, but evil people are trapped by their own evil deeds.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be kebaaji asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so nɛ baa ta a pin mo. Ama alubiworapoana gbagba be alubi e naa kilgi a ji bumo.

english_verse: The wicked will go down to the world of the dead to be with those nations that forgot about you.
translation_verse: Belubiworapo bee yɔ luwu to nna, nɛ b ya tu efuli pɔtɛana so ebi nɛ b kini fo na.

english_verse: The poor and the homeless won't always be forgotten and without hope.
translation_verse: Ama fo maaŋ teŋ bekama nɛ asheŋ tir bumo na bre so mbaanaayɔ; ŋko n shin nɛ betentaŋasepo be tama e loge cheche.

english_verse: Do something, Lord! Don't let the nations win. Make them stand trial in your court of law.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, maŋ kumu so, sa maŋ shin nɛ dimɛdi e kini kebaanu a sa fo. Shin nɛ efuli pɔtɛana kikɛ so ebi e yili fo anishito nɛ fo ji bumo demu.

english_verse: Make the nations afraid and let them all discover just how weak they are.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, shin nɛ kufugboŋ e tɔr efuli pɔtɛana na so, nɛ b pin fanɛ b la edimɛdi nna ashi fo anishito.

english_verse: Why are you far away, Lord? Why do you hide yourself when I am in trouble?
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, Manɛ nna nɛ k du fanɛ fo ka kplaŋ ma so loŋ? Manɛ nna nɛ fee ta fo kumu a ŋana ma so saŋɛ nɛ n wɔ tɔrɔ to?

english_verse: Proud and brutal people hunt down the poor. But let them get caught by their own evil plans!
translation_verse: Ŋkpensheŋ e luri m bɔlɔ basa lubi to nɛ baa fin bebɔlpo nɛ b baa tɔrɔ saŋkama. Shin nɛ b tɔr ajigbelɛ nɛ bumo gbagba sho na to.

english_verse: The wicked brag about their deepest desires. Those greedy people hate and curse you, Lord.
translation_verse: Belubiworapo bee ji njɔŋ nna ŋkpal bumo be aparsheŋ lubi so. Nɛ kejimuniwuraana malɛ kishi fo nsaa shoduu fo.

english_verse: The wicked are too proud to turn to you or even think about you.
translation_verse: Belubiworapo be shɛŋ maŋ wɔ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ to. Bumo be kamoowu so, b maa fɛ Ebɔrɛ be asheŋ gba kuraa.

english_verse: They are always successful, though they can't understand your teachings, and they keep sneering at their enemies.
translation_verse: Ama saŋkikɛ asheŋ bee nite nɛnɛ nna a sa bumo. Bumo be shɛŋ maŋ wɔ fo mbra to; bumo alɛ naa keni bumo doŋana jiga nna saŋkikɛ.

english_verse: In their hearts they say, “Nothing can hurt us! We'll always be happy and free from trouble.”
translation_verse: Le nɛ baa kaŋɛ bumo be ŋgbene to: “Shɛŋ shɛŋ maaŋ tiŋ n wora anyi. Anyi be ŋgbene beeŋ baa fuli saŋkama. Asheŋ lubi maaŋ tu anyi kikɛ.”

english_verse: They curse and tell lies, and all they talk about is how to be cruel or how to do wrong.
translation_verse: Bumo be mmalga kikɛ la shoduu nɛ kafule nɛ kafunti nna, nɛ bumo be bare kikɛ malɛ yil asheŋ lubi nɛ alubi be kewora so.

english_verse: They are hungry lions hiding in the bushes, hoping to catch some helpless passerby. They trap the poor in nets and drag them away.
translation_verse: Baa jo bumo be eŋanakpa nna fanɛ buluŋ na, a tɛ basa nɛ b maaŋ tiŋ m mɔlga bumo be amu nɛ b tɔr bumo be ajigbelɛ to, nɛ b pɛ bumo.

english_verse: They crouch down and wait to grab a victim.
translation_verse: Baa nyaŋ basa nɛ baa pɛ na nna nɛ bumo be eleŋ kikɛ nɛ b suge ŋ gben.

english_verse: Do something, Lord God, and use your powerful arm to help those in need.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, wora kusɔ ko. Maŋ fo enɔ lempo na so n chɛ bumo nɛ b maaŋ tiŋ n chɛ bumo be amu to na to.

english_verse: The wicked don't respect you. In their hearts they say, “God won't punish us!”
translation_verse: Manɛ nna nɛ belubiworapo bee keni fo jiga nsaa kaŋɛ bumo be ŋgbene to le: “Ebɔrɛ maaŋ ji anyi demu ŋ gberge anyi kusoe”?

english_verse: But you see the trouble and the distress, and you will do something. The poor can count on you, and so can orphans.
translation_verse: Ama fo Ebɔrɛ na bee wu tɔrɔ nɛ awurfoŋ ere kikɛ, nseŋ wora shiriya nɛ fo chɛ to. Basa nɛ baa wu awurfoŋ na bɔɔ fo enɔ nna. Fo e naa chɛ amunibi to na.

english_verse: Now break the power of all merciless people. Punish them for doing wrong and make them stop.
translation_verse: Jija belubiworapo nɛ basa lubi be eleŋ. Gberge bumo kusoe ŋkpal bumo be alubi so, nseŋ shin nɛ b yige alubi be kebaawora.

english_verse: Our Lord, you will always rule, but every godless nation will vanish from the earth.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e naa ji kuwura kusɔ kama so mbaanaayɔ. Efuli pɔtɛana na beeŋ mur ashi mbe kasawule so.

english_verse: You listen to the longings of those who suffer. You offer them hope, and you pay attention to their cries for help.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, fo e naa nu bumo nɛ baa ji awurfoŋ be kekule. Feeŋ nu bumo be nfubel nseŋ leŋ bumo to.

english_verse: You defend orphans and everyone else in need, so that no one on earth can terrify others again.
translation_verse: Fo e naa kuŋ amunibi nɛ basa nɛ baa mɛaŋ na; saŋɛ na so, dimɛdi nɛ e la shishɛr na maaŋ naa tɔrɔ mo braana n shin nɛ kufu e baa pɛ bumo ga.

english_verse: You tell me, “Watch out! Those evil people have put their arrows on their bows, and they are standing in the shadows, aiming at good people.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal basa lubi ka ŋana ayoyul to ŋ gberge bumo be ata nɛ b to n da basa lela be ŋgbene to so,

english_verse: What can an honest person do when everything crumbles?”
translation_verse: manɛ nɛ basa lela beeŋ naŋ tiŋ n wora saŋɛ nɛ kusɔ kikɛ jija?

english_verse: The Lord is sitting in his sacred temple on his throne in heaven. He knows everything we do because he sees us all.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na wɔ mbe bɔrɛlambu cheembi na to. E tase mbe kuwurputi so ashi ebɔrɛso nna a keni basa kaplɛkama. E bee wu kusɔ nɛ ekama bee wora.

english_verse: The Lord tests honest people, but despises those who are cruel and love violence.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee wora basa lela nna a keni. Ama e kishi kumu kpakpasowuraana nɛ baa sha alubi be kebaawora nsaa maa wu kuwɔr na nna.

english_verse: He will send fiery coals and flaming sulfur down on the wicked, and they will drink nothing but a scorching wind.
translation_verse: E beeŋ ta ajanwulɛ tushiso nɛ edɛ wuloŋwuloŋ n lɛ basa lubi so nseŋ ta kawuliwuli tushiso ŋ gberge bumo kusoe.

english_verse: The Lord always does right and wants justice done. Everyone who does right will see his face.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee wora asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so nna nsaa sha kashenteŋji. Bumo nɛ baa wora asheŋ niŋiso e naŋ baa wɔ mo kutɔ.

english_verse: Please help me, Lord! All who were faithful and all who were loyal have disappeared.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, chɛ ma to. Basa nɛ baa ŋana Ebɔrɛ maŋ naa wɔtɔ. Beshenteŋjipo loge durnya to.

english_verse: Everyone tells lies, and no one is sincere.
translation_verse: Ekama bee fule mo barkasa nna. Mmalga belbelso nɛ b kɔ a fule abar.

english_verse: Won't you chop off all flattering tongues that brag so loudly?
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, shin nɛ kafule be mmalga belbelso na e ku, nɛ adonduloŋ nɛ a bee ji njɔŋ a kaŋɛ fanɛ

english_verse: But you, Lord, tell them, “I will do something! The poor are mistreated and helpless people moan. I'll rescue all who suffer.”
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ le: “Meeŋ koso, ŋkpal bepɔshipo be kamɛaŋ, nɛ basa nɛ asheŋ bee tɔrɔ be kushuto so. Meeŋ sɔ bumo n yige.”

english_verse: Our Lord, you are true to your promises, and your word is like silver heated seven times in a fiery furnace.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe be nnɔ naseso la kashenteŋ nna. A du fanɛ gbiti nɛ b ta n wɔtɔ edɛ to ale shunu n lara amo to be eyurpi kikɛ na nna.

english_verse: You will protect us and always keep us safe from those people.
translation_verse: O, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, feeŋ kuŋ anyi, n shin nɛ an nya kekuŋ ashi loŋ be basa kutɔ mbaanaayɔ.

english_verse: But all who are wicked will keep on strutting, while everyone praises their shameless deeds.
translation_verse: Belubiworapo bee feŋ ŋgbene a nite kamoowuso nna; a kpaŋ bumo be asheŋ woraso nsaa keni asɔ nɛ a daga kemaŋkura jiga.

english_verse: How much longer, Lord, will you forget about me? Will it be forever? How long will you hide?
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, feeŋ teŋ ma so mbaanaayɔ a? Feeŋ ŋana ma so n chɛr a?

english_verse: How long must I be confused and miserable all day? How long will my enemies keep beating me down?
translation_verse: Nchɛ afanɛ nɛ fee sha fanɛ ma nfɛra e sa maŋ dese ma? Nchɛ afanɛ nɛ fee sha fanɛ kagbenejija e baa wɔ ma to? Feeŋ shin nɛ n doŋana e pɔɔ ma so n chɛr a?

english_verse: Please listen, Lord God, and answer my prayers. Make my eyes sparkle again, or else I will fall into the sleep of death.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋ kusoe n nu ma kabɔrɛkule, nseŋ wora kusɔ nɛ mee kule fo ere n sa ma. Shin nɛ ma anishito e saŋɛ to; nɛ mannɛ aloŋ meeŋ wu,

english_verse: My enemies will say, “Now we've won!” They will be greatly pleased when I am defeated.
translation_verse: nɛ n doŋana e kaŋɛ fanɛ b kɔ m pɔɔ ma so nna, nɛ bumo be ŋgbene e fuli bumo ŋkpal ŋ ka tɔr so.

english_verse: I trust your love, and I feel like celebrating because you rescued me.
translation_verse: Ama ma tama deŋ fo kasha nɛ k maa loge na so nna. Ma kagbene beeŋ fuli ma ŋkpal fo ka beeŋ mɔlga ma so.

english_verse: You have been good to me, Lord, and I will sing about you.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, meeŋ boŋ kashɛ m maŋkura fo, ŋkpal fo ka wora ma kelela so.

english_verse: Only a fool would say, “There is no God!” People like that are worthless; they are heartless and cruel and never do right.
translation_verse: Ewulpo e naa kaŋɛ mbe kagbene to fanɛ Ebɔrɛ maŋ wɔtɔ. Loŋ be basa maa wora asheŋ nɛ a bee bɔla ekpa. Bumo be asheŋ woraso kikɛ la alubi nna. Bumo be ekama maa wora asheŋ lela.

english_verse: From heaven the Lord looks down to see if anyone is wise enough to search for him.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ wɔ ebɔrɛso a keni a fin fanɛ basa ko wɔtɔ a nyi asheŋ nsaa fin mo a?

english_verse: Won't you evil people learn? You refuse to pray, and you gobble up the Lord's people.
translation_verse: Ama alubiworapo maaŋ koya a? Menyee suge ma basa nna a ji, nsaa kini kekule Ebɔrɛ.

english_verse: But you will be frightened, because God is on the side of every good person.
translation_verse: Menyi alɛ nɛ kufu nɛ keyeŋiyeŋi nna, ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ wɔ basa nɛ baa wora asheŋ niŋiso kutɔ nna.

english_verse: You may spoil the plans of the poor, but the Lord protects them.
translation_verse: Menyi, alubiworapoana e naa jija betirpo be ŋkre. Ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ e naa kuŋ bumo.

english_verse: I long for someone from Zion to come and save Israel! Our Lord, when you bless your people again, Jacob's family will be glad, and Israel will celebrate.
translation_verse: Israɛl be kumɔlga beeŋ shi Zayɔn nna. Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e naŋ shin nɛ asheŋ e naa nite nɛnɛ n sa bumo; nɛ Israɛlebi be ŋgbene e fuli bumo ga.

english_verse: Who may stay in God's temple or live on the holy mountain of the Lord?
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, wanɛ e naŋ nya ekpa a wɔ fo bɔrɛlambu na to? Wanɛ e naŋ chena fo kebee cheembi na so?

english_verse: and don't spread gossip; they treat others fairly and don't say cruel things.
translation_verse: nsaa maa ku efɛ a deŋi bumo braana, ŋko a malga asheŋ lubi a gbiti bumo na; nɛ bumo nɛ baa sa basa bunyaŋ na,

english_verse: They hate worthless people, but show respect for all who worship the Lord. And they keep their promises, no matter what the cost.
translation_verse: nɛ bumo nɛ bumo nɛ alubiworapoana maŋ kɔ shɛŋ na. Bumo e naa sa basa nɛ baa ŋana Ebɔrɛ bunyaŋ nsaa wora a bɔlɔ bumo be nnɔ naseso so, hale k du kpakpa gba na.

english_verse: They lend their money without charging interest, and they don't take bribes to hurt the innocent. Those who do these things will always stand firm.
translation_verse: Bumo nɛ baa ta bumo be amansherbi a paŋ basa nsaa maa wɔtɔ nchu na; ŋko a sɔ brɔbu nsaa ji a chɛ alubiworapoana to na. Loŋ be basa bre maaŋ ji anishinyɔr kikɛ.

english_verse: Protect me, Lord God! I run to you for safety,
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, baa keni ma so; nsaa kuŋ ma.

english_verse: and I have said, “Only you are my Lord! Every good thing I have is a gift from you.”
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe, Fo e la ma Ebɔrɛ Asɔ lela nɛ ŋ kɔ kikɛ shi fo kutɔ nna.

english_verse: but worshipers of other gods will have much sorrow. I refuse to offer sacrifices of blood to those gods or worship in their name.
translation_verse: Ama bekama nɛ b shil a bɛ agbirana so na bre be etɔrɔ beeŋ wora keshi ga. M maaŋ tu bumo n lara bumo be agbir na be esarga. Ma alɛ maaŋ bunyaŋ amo.

english_verse: You, Lord, are all I want! You are my choice, and you keep me safe.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ fo nawule nɛ ŋ kɔ. Fo alɛ bee sa ma kusɔ kama nɛ k tir ma. Fo enɔ to nɛ ma echefoso be kebaawɔtɔ wɔ.

english_verse: You make my life pleasant, and my future is bright.
translation_verse: Ŋkɛ nɛ fo sa ma na walɛ nsaa a par ma ga.

english_verse: I praise you, Lord, for being my guide. Even in the darkest night, your teachings fill my mind.
translation_verse: Meeŋ chɔrɔ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ e bee ji ma asoeto na. E bee bɔla ma kagbene to nna a malga a sa ma kanyɛso gba.

english_verse: I will always look to you, as you stand beside me and protect me from fear.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be asheŋ deŋ ma kagbene so nna saŋkama. Ŋkpal e ka taga ma to so, shɛŋ shɛŋ maa keta ma kufu.

english_verse: With all my heart, I will celebrate, and I can safely rest.
translation_verse: Amoso ma kagbene fuli ma nna, nɛ mee ji eyur ŋkpal ŋ ka nya kekuŋ so.

english_verse: I am your chosen one. You won't leave me in the grave or let my body decay.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, fee kuŋ ma ashi luwu to. Fo maaŋ shin nɛ fo kenya e luri nchaŋ to; ŋko n shin nɛ fo esa cheembi e wu m bɛ.

english_verse: You have shown me the path to life, and you make me glad by being near to me. Sitting at your right side, I will always be joyful.
translation_verse: Fo shin nɛ m pin fo ŋkpa be ekpa na. Fo kebaawɔ ma kutɔ, e naa shin nɛ ma kagbene bee fuli ga saŋkama.

english_verse: I am innocent, Lord! Won't you listen as I pray and beg for help? I am honest! Please hear my prayer.
translation_verse: O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, nu ma kekule ere; ŋkpal ŋ ka maŋ wora n da so so, Nu ma kushu. Kaŋ kusoe n nu ma kabɔrɛkule. Mannɛ efɛ be kudonduloŋ to nɛ k shi.

english_verse: Only you can say that I am innocent, because only your eyes can see the truth.
translation_verse: Feeŋ ji n chɛ ma to; ŋkpal manɛ so, fo anishi e naa wu asheŋ niŋiso.

english_verse: You know my heart, and even during the night you have tested me and found me innocent. I have made up my mind never to tell a lie.
translation_verse: Fo nyi ma kagbene to. Fo wora ma ŋ keni kanyɛso n wu fanɛ maŋ wora n jija. N yili kumo ma kagbene to fanɛ m maaŋ ku efɛ kikɛ.

english_verse: I have followed you, without ever stumbling.
translation_verse: Saŋɛ kikɛ mee nite fo ekpa to nna. M maa kple kumo kikɛ.

english_verse: I pray to you, God, because you will help me. Listen and answer my prayer!
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, mee kule fo nna. Ŋkpal fo ka beeŋ chɛ ma to so. Kaŋ kusoe n nu ma kabɔrɛkule.

english_verse: Show your wonderful love. Your mighty arm protects those who run to you for safety from their enemies.
translation_verse: Ŋini fo mamachi be kasha na. Fo enɔ lempo na nɛ fee ta a mɔlga bumo nɛ baa shile a ba fo kutɔ ashi bumo doŋana be enɔ to.

english_verse: Protect me as you would your very own eyes; hide me in the shadow of your wings.
translation_verse: Kuŋ ma fanɛ fo kenishi na. Ta ma ŋ ŋana fo atɛ to

english_verse: They refuse to show mercy, and they keep bragging.
translation_verse: B maa wu kuwɔr nsaa ji njɔŋ.

english_verse: They have caught up with me! My enemies are everywhere, eagerly hoping to smear me in the dirt.
translation_verse: B ju ma m pɛ nseŋ kulti ma n wɔtɔ, a fin keŋin ma n lɛ nna.

english_verse: Do something, Lord! Attack and defeat them. Take your sword and save me from those evil people.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ koso ŋ kɔ m pɔɔ bumo so. Ta fo tokobi m mɔlga ma ashi amu kpakpasowuraana be enɔ to.

english_verse: Use your powerful arm and rescue me from the hands of mere humans whose world won't last. You provide food for those you love. Their children have plenty, and their grandchildren will have more than enough.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ta fo enɔ lempo na m mɔlga ma ashi loŋ be basa be enɔ to. Basa nɛ durnya ere be kebaawɔtɔ nawule la bumo be tɔnɔ. Fo e naa sa basa nɛ fee sha ajibi; bumo be mbia beeŋ nya n ji kanaŋkama so, nɛ bumo nanabiana gba e nya n ji kanaŋkama so.

english_verse: I am innocent, Lord, and I will see your face! When I awake, all I want is to see you as you are.
translation_verse: Meeŋ ba fo anishito, ŋkpal manɛ so, m maŋ wora kulubi kikɛ. M baŋ tiŋi nseŋ wu fanɛ fo wɔ ma kutɔ, ma kagbene beeŋ fuli nna.

english_verse: I love you, Lord God, and you make me strong.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ mee sha fo; fo kutɔ nɛ ma eleŋ bee shi.

english_verse: You are my mighty rock, my fortress, my protector, the rock where I am safe, my shield, my powerful weapon, and my place of shelter.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e la ma kefalta gboŋ; Mo kutɔ nɛ mee nya kekuŋ nɛ kumɔlga. Ma Ebɔrɛ na e la kefaltagboŋ nɛ mee ŋana mo to. Mo e du fanɛ benapo be kusɔ kuŋso a kuŋ ma. Mo e naa kɔ a mɔlga ma nsaa sa ma eleŋ.

english_verse: I praise you, Lord! I prayed, and you rescued me from my enemies.
translation_verse: Meeŋ di Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na epaŋ; ŋkpal e ka mɔlga ma ashi ma doŋana be enɔ to.

english_verse: Death had wrapped its ropes around me, and I was almost swallowed by its flooding waters.
translation_verse: Luwu be ŋgbɛlɛbi chambɔ ma nna; nɛ kemur be nchu kulti ma n wɔtɔ,

english_verse: Ropes from the world of the dead had coiled around me, and death had set a trap in my path.
translation_verse: nɛ luwu sho ma ajigbelɛ, nɛ kenishipere gboŋgboŋi tɔr ma so.

english_verse: I was in terrible trouble when I called out to you, but from your temple you heard me and answered my prayer.
translation_verse: Nɛ n ta kebɔltofinfin n shu n tre Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ. N shu n tre ma Ebɔrɛ fanɛ e chɛ ma to; nɛ ma kushu tɔr mbe asoe to nɛ e yili mbe bɔrɛlambu to n nu ma ebɔl.

english_verse: The earth shook and shivered, and the mountains trembled down to their roots. You were angry
translation_verse: Nɛ kasawule gbuŋgbuŋ to m baŋɛ, nɛ abeegboŋ be kaseto gbuŋgbuŋ. A gbuŋgbuŋ nna ŋkpal Ebɔrɛ ka nya agbo so.

english_verse: You opened the heavens like curtains, and you came down with storm clouds under your feet.
translation_verse: Nɛ esoso bugi nɛ e lar m ba nɛ awɔlpa jimajima wɔ mbe aya ase.

english_verse: You rode on the backs of flying creatures and swooped down with the wind as wings.
translation_verse: Nɛ e dii n chena asɔ firgiso nɛ baa tre chɛrubim na so n firgi afu to a ba.

english_verse: Darkness was your robe; thunderclouds filled the sky, hiding you from sight.
translation_verse: E ta tentembiri nna ŋ kulti mbe kumu, nɛ abɔrɛwɔlpa ta mo ŋ ŋana awɔlpa to.

english_verse: Hailstones and fiery coals lit up the sky in front of you.
translation_verse: Nɛ abɔrɛjembubi nɛ bɔrɛ be kenyɛkpɛ be edɛ juŋkpar mo n fulto ashi awɔlpa jimajima na to.

english_verse: Lord Most High, your voice thundered from the heavens, as hailstones and fiery coals poured down like rain.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ shi esoso m ponte, nɛ basa nu mbe ebɔl.

english_verse: You roared at the sea, and its deepest channels could be seen. You snorted, and the earth shook to its foundations.
translation_verse: Nɛ fo kaponte na shin nɛ teku be kasawulebi wɔlto a dese kpantaŋkpalaŋ, nɛ kasawule be gbaltɔlase lar n dese kpatokplo.

english_verse: You reached down from heaven, and you lifted me from deep in the ocean.
translation_verse: Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na shi esoso n to m pɛ ma to, ŋ gberge ma n chule ashi nchu chiŋgeliŋ na to.

english_verse: You rescued me from enemies, who were hateful and too powerful for me.
translation_verse: E mɔlga ma ashi bedoŋ lempoana na be enɔ to, nɛ bumo nɛ b kishi ma nsaa chɔ ma eleŋ na kutɔ.

english_verse: On the day disaster struck, they came and attacked, but you defended me.
translation_verse: Saŋɛ nɛ kenishipere tu ma na, nɛ b baa ka kɔ ma, nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kɔ n sɔ ma.

english_verse: When I was fenced in, you freed and rescued me because you love me.
translation_verse: Mo e lara ma ashi kenishipere na to, nseŋ mɔlga ma ŋkpal ma asheŋ ka bee bɔlɔ mo kenishi so.

english_verse: You are good to me, Lord, because I do right, and you reward me because I am innocent.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ wora loŋ nna n sa ma ŋkpal ŋ kaa bee wora asheŋ nɛ a niŋi so. Ŋ ka maa wora alubi na be kakɔka nna na.

english_verse: I keep your laws in mind and never look away from your teachings.
translation_verse: Mee bɛ mbe mbra kikɛ so nna. Ma alɛ maŋ naŋ kini kebɛ mbe keŋini so kikɛ.

english_verse: I obey you completely and guard against sin.
translation_verse: M maŋ naŋ wora n da mo so kikɛ. Saŋkama mee gelge alubi nna.

english_verse: You have been good to me because I do right; you have rewarded me for being innocent by your standards.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ wora ma kelela nna ŋkpal ŋ ka bee wora asheŋ nɛ a niŋi ekpa so. E wora loŋ nna ŋkpal e ka nyi ŋ kaa maa wora alubi so.

english_verse: You are always loyal to your loyal people, and you are faithful to the faithful.
translation_verse: Fee ji kashenteŋ nna a sa bekama nɛ baa ji kashenteŋ na. Fo alɛ maa pɔlɔ bumo nɛ b maŋ kɔ mpulɔ na.

english_verse: With all who are sincere, you are sincere, but you treat the unfaithful as their deeds deserve.
translation_verse: Fee ta kagbenekoŋwule nna a wora asheŋ a sa bumo nɛ b kɔ kagbenekoŋwule. Ama fee gberge alubiworapoana bre kusoe nna.

english_verse: You rescue the humble, but you put down all who are proud.
translation_verse: Fee mɔlga bumo nɛ b kɔ kamubrase nna, nsaa bar kamoowuwuraana kaseto.

english_verse: You, the Lord God, keep my lamp burning and turn darkness to light.
translation_verse: Fo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e naa ŋini ma kefulto be ekpa, nsaa ta tentembiri a ki kefulto a sa ma.

english_verse: Your way is perfect, Lord, and your word is correct. You are a shield for those who run to you for help.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ maa wora shɛŋ a foe. Mbe kamalga la kashenteŋ nna. E du fanɛ benapo be kusɔ kuŋ so gboŋ nna, a kuŋ ekama nɛ e bee shile a ba mo kutɔ.

english_verse: You alone are God! Only you are a mighty rock.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe na nawule e la Ebɔrɛ. Mo nawule e du fanɛ kefalta gboŋ a kuŋ.

english_verse: You give me strength and guide me right.
translation_verse: Mo e naa sa ma eleŋ, nsaa shin nɛ mee wora asheŋ niŋiso.

english_verse: You make my feet run as fast as those of a deer, and you help me stand on the mountains.
translation_verse: Mo e naa sa ma aya shileso fanɛ chibir na, a shin nɛ mee tiŋ a dii abee a maa fiti a tɔr.

english_verse: You teach my hands to fight and my arms to use a bow of bronze.
translation_verse: Mo e naa ŋini ma kananɛ baa kɔ kena; nsaa chɛ ma to nɛ mee tiŋ a ta danyaŋ be keta a kɔ kena.

english_verse: You alone are my shield. Your right hand supports me, and by coming to help me, you have made me famous.
translation_verse: Mo e naa kuŋ ma nsaa mɔlga ma. Mbe enɔ lempo na e naa pɛ ma to. Mbe kechɛto so nɛ e ki esagboŋ.

english_verse: You clear the way for me, and now I won't stumble.
translation_verse: Mo e naa lɔŋɛ ekpa a sa ma nɛ maa nite a fiti.

english_verse: I kept chasing my enemies, until I caught them and destroyed them.
translation_verse: N ju m bɛ ndoŋana so nna n ya pɔɔ bumo so. M maŋ bɛta kaman kikɛ; m mur bumo cheche nna.

english_verse: I stuck my sword through my enemies, and they were crushed under my feet.
translation_verse: Ŋ ŋmɛa bumo n lɛ nɛ b koso ŋ gben, nɛ n chichi bumo so n nase ma aya to.

english_verse: You helped me win victories, and you forced my attackers to fall victim to me.
translation_verse: Fo e sa ma eleŋ nɛ ŋ kɔ kena, nseŋ shin nɛ ŋ kɔ m pɔɔ ma doŋana so.

english_verse: They cried out for help, but no one saved them; they called out to you, but there was no answer.
translation_verse: B daa yɛla kenishi to nna a fin kechɛto; ama esa kama maŋ mɔlga bumo, nɛ b shu n tre Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ; ama e daa maŋ tuge bumo.

english_verse: I ground them to dust blown by the wind, and I poured them out like mud in the streets.
translation_verse: Nɛ n nɔkɔr bumo fanɛ kepumpuŋ nɛ afu bee ta na, nseŋ chichi bumo so fanɛ ekpa to be depɔ na.

english_verse: You rescued me from stubborn people, and you made me the leader of foreign nations, who are now my slaves.
translation_verse: Fo mɔlga ma ashi kumukpakpaso wuraana be enɔ to; nseŋ ta ma ŋ ki efuli pɔtɛana be ejuŋkparpo. Basa nɛ n daa maŋ tama fanɛ baaŋ shuli n sɔ ma ŋ ki bumo be ewura na.

english_verse: They have lost all courage, and from their fortresses, they come trembling.
translation_verse: Bumo be aba pɔ bumo, nɛ baa lar bumo be ekuŋkpa lempoana to a chicha kufuso a ba.

english_verse: You are the living Lord! I will praise you. You are a mighty rock. I will honor you for keeping me safe.
translation_verse: Fo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na wɔ ŋkpa to nna. Meeŋ fur fo, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, ma kefaltagboŋ nɛ fee kuŋ ma. Meeŋ maŋkura fo, ma emɔlgapo.

english_verse: You took revenge for me, and you put nations in my power.
translation_verse: Fo e bishi kuwule n sa ma nseŋ shin nɛ efuliana bee nu a sa ma.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord, and I will honor you among the nations.
translation_verse: Amoso, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, meeŋ fur fo ashi efuli pɔtɛana kikɛ be anishito to. Meeŋ boŋ nshɛ n di fo epaŋ.

english_verse: You give glorious victories to your chosen king. Your faithful love for David and for his descendants will never end.
translation_verse: Fo e shin nɛ fo ewura kɔ m pɔɔ so. Fo ŋini fo esa laraso, ewura Deevid, fo kasha nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na, nseŋ wu mo nɛ mbe kaman to ebi kuwɔr mbaanaayɔ.

english_verse: The heavens keep telling the wonders of God, and the skies declare what he has done.
translation_verse: Esoso bee di Ebɔrɛ be kemankura efuli nna, nɛ awɔlpa malɛ bee ŋini mbe asɔ toso.

english_verse: Each day informs the following day; each night announces to the next.
translation_verse: Karechɛ kikɛ bee shin nɛ mbe kemaŋkura nɛ kenyi malɛ bee di efuli nna, nɛ kanyɛso kikɛ malɛ gba bee wora loŋ.

english_verse: They don't speak a word, and there is never the sound of a voice.
translation_verse: A maa bugi kɔnɔ a malga ŋko a gbar ŋgbar kikɛ;

english_verse: Yet their message reaches all the earth, and it travels around the world. In the heavens a tent is set up for the sun.
translation_verse: ama durnya to ebi kikɛ bee wu kusɔ nɛ a bee ŋini saŋkama nna. Ebɔrɛ wora awɔlpa nna fanɛ wajɛbu n sa epeŋi.

english_verse: It rises like a bridegroom and gets ready like a hero eager to run a race.
translation_verse: Chipurso kikɛ k bee lar nna a ba fanɛ kejafɔ mo kul ka bee lar ebu to, ŋko fanɛ ekpampo ka bee lege kusɔbɔya be kubɔr na.

english_verse: The Law of the Lord is perfect; it gives us new life. His teachings last forever, and they give wisdom to ordinary people.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be mbra na bee niŋi ekpa nsaa sa ŋkpa nna. Asɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe be mbra bee ŋini na la asɔ nɛ esa beeŋ tiŋ n yirda nna. Amo alɛ bee sa bebɔlpo, kanyiasheŋ nna.

english_verse: The Lord's instruction is right; it makes our hearts glad. His commands shine brightly, and they give us light.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe be mbra na bee niŋi ekpa, nsaa sa basa nɛ baa bɛ amo so na kagbenefuli nna. Enyɛnpe be mbra na di efuli nna, a shin nɛ esa bee pin kebaawɔtɔ to nɛnɛ.

english_verse: Worshiping the Lord is sacred; he will always be worshiped. All his decisions are correct and fair.
translation_verse: Kabɔrɛŋana walɛ nna, nsaa beeŋ baa wɔtɔ mbaanaayɔ. Enyɛnpe be mbra na la kashenteŋ nna. Amo alɛ maa wora a foe ekpa.

english_verse: They are worth more than the finest gold and are sweeter than honey from a honeycomb.
translation_verse: A walɛ a chɔ shuwa lela kikɛ, hale shuwa nɛ k maŋ kɔ eyurpi gba. Enyɛnpe be mbra wɔ ebel a chɔ mushoŋchu, hale mushoŋchu nɛ a maŋ kɔ eyurpi gba.

english_verse: By your teachings, Lord, I am warned; by obeying them, I am greatly rewarded.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe be mbra na bee kpele basa kusoe nna. Basa nɛ baa bɛ amo so bee nya tɔnɔ gboŋgboŋi nna.

english_verse: None of us know our faults. Forgive me when I sin without knowing it.
translation_verse: Esa kikɛ maaŋ tiŋ m pin alubi nɛ e wora kikɛ. Ta ma alubi nɛ m maŋ kute n wora na m paŋ ma.

english_verse: Don't let me do wrong on purpose, Lord, or let sin have control over my life. Then I will be innocent, and not guilty of some terrible fault.
translation_verse: Nseŋ pete ma ashi alubi be kekute n wora to. Sa maŋ shin nɛ loŋ be alubi e pɔɔ ma so. Saŋɛ na so ma nfɛra maaŋ ji m bri ma nɛ n ji n lar alubi to.

english_verse: Let my words and my thoughts be pleasing to you, Lord, because you are my mighty rock and my protector.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ fo la ma kefaltagboŋ nɛ ma emɔlgapo. Shin nɛ ma kɔnɔ to be mmalga nɛ ma kagbene to be nfɛra, e baa bɔlɔ fo kenishi.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will listen when you are in trouble, and that the God of Jacob will keep you safe.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na, e nu fo kekule saŋɛ so nɛ kebaawɔtɔ ki fo so jiga na. An nananyɛn Jeekɔb be Ebɔrɛ na e baa kuŋ fo.

english_verse: May the Lord send help from his temple and come to your rescue from Mount Zion.
translation_verse: E shin nɛ kechɛto e shi mbe bɔrɛlambu to m ba fo kutɔ; nseŋ yili Zayɔn be kebeegboŋ na so ashi Jerusalɛm to m mɔlga fo.

english_verse: May he remember your gifts and be pleased with what you bring.
translation_verse: E nyiŋi fo esarga nɛ fo lara na kikɛ, nseŋ sɔ fo esarga chɔɔso.

english_verse: May God do what you want most and let all go well for you.
translation_verse: E shin nɛ fo nya fo kagbene be aparsheŋ kikɛ; nseŋ shin nɛ fo ŋkre kikɛ bɔlɔ so.

english_verse: Then you will win victories, and we will celebrate, while raising our banners in the name of our God. May the Lord answer all your prayers!
translation_verse: Nɛ asheŋ nite nɛnɛ n sa fo, anyeeŋ cha awɔr kagbenefuliso; nseŋ maŋ anyi be etuta so ashi anyi be Ebɔrɛ be ketre to. Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na e wora asɔ nɛ fee bishi na n sa fo.

english_verse: I am certain, Lord, that you will help your chosen king. You will answer my prayers from your holy place in heaven, and you will save me with your mighty arm.
translation_verse: N nyi geeŋ fanɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ mɔlga mbe ewura lara so. E beeŋ yili mbe ebɔrɛso cheembi na n nu ma kekule nseŋ ta mbe enɔ lempo na m mɔlga ma.

english_verse: Others will stumble and fall, but we will be strong and stand firm.
translation_verse: Loŋ be basa na beeŋ fiti n tɔr, ama anyi ere baa yil nna kiŋkiŋ. Shɛŋ shɛŋ maa gbuŋgbuŋ anyi.

english_verse: Give the king victory, Lord, and answer our prayers.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ, mɔlga anyi be ewura. Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, nu anyi be kekule.

english_verse: Our Lord, your mighty power makes the king glad, and he celebrates victories that you have given him.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, ewura be kagbene fuli nna ŋkpal fo ka sa mo eleŋ so. Kechɛto nɛ fo sa mo na e shin nɛ mbe kagbene fuli ga.

english_verse: You did what he wanted most and never told him “No.”
translation_verse: Fo wora mbe kagbene be aparsheŋ n sa mo. Fo maŋ kini kewora kusɔ nɛ e bishi fo na.

english_verse: You truly blessed the king, and you placed on him a crown of finest gold.
translation_verse: Fo nɛfa mo kashenteŋto, nseŋ ta shuwa be kuwurwuro m buu mo.

english_verse: He asked to live a long time, and you promised him life that never ends.
translation_verse: E kule fo ŋkpa tenteŋ nɛ fo sa mo ŋkpa nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar.

english_verse: The king is highly honored. You have let him win victories that have made him famous.
translation_verse: E nya bunyaŋ gboŋgboŋi ŋkpal kechɛto nɛ fo sa mo na so. Fo shin nɛ e nya ketre nɛ eleŋ.

english_verse: You have given him blessings that will last forever, and you have made him glad by being so near to him.
translation_verse: Kashenteŋto, fo sa mo nɛfa mbaanaayɔ; fo nɛ mo be kebaala na malɛ bee fuli mo kagbene nna.

english_verse: Lord Most High, the king trusts you, and your kindness keeps him from defeat.
translation_verse: Ewura na yirda Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nna. Ŋkpal Ebɔrɛ malɛ be kasha nɛ k maa loge na so, shɛŋ shɛŋ maa gbuŋgbuŋ mo.

english_verse: With your mighty arm, Lord, you will strike down all of your hateful enemies.
translation_verse: Fo ta fo enɔ lempo na ŋ ŋmɛa fo doŋana n lɛ. Fo enɔ jisa nɛ feeŋ ta m pɛ basa nɛ b kishi fo kikɛ.

english_verse: They will be destroyed by fire once you are here, and because of your anger, flames will swallow them.
translation_verse: Fo kaŋ ba, feeŋ ta edɛ fuful n chɔɔ bumo m mur, nɛ fo agbo e shin nɛ b ki fanɛ edɛ be kepa.

english_verse: You will wipe their families from the earth, and they will disappear.
translation_verse: Feeŋ mur bumo be kaman to ebi kasawule ere so cheche; nɛ b maaŋ naŋ nyiŋi bumo be asheŋ kuraa.

english_verse: All their plans to harm you will come to nothing.
translation_verse: Kanaŋkama so nɛ b kre fo ŋkre lubi gba; b maaŋ tiŋ m pɔɔ fo so kikɛ.

english_verse: You will make them run away by shooting your arrows at their faces.
translation_verse: Fo baŋ to bumo fo atanyembi, baaŋ pal kaman n shile.

english_verse: Show your strength, Lord, so that we may sing and praise your power.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, kemaŋkura e baa la fo peya. Anyeeŋ boŋ nshɛ m maŋkura fo ŋkpal fo eleŋgboŋ na so.

english_verse: My God, my God, why have you deserted me? Why are you so far away? Won't you listen to my groans and come to my rescue?
translation_verse: Ma Ebɔrɛ, manɛ nna nɛ fo kplaŋ ma so? Manɛ nna nɛ fo wɔ kufɔ loŋ? Fo maaŋ nu ma kebɔltofinfin be kushuto, nseŋ ba mɔlga ma a?

english_verse: I cry out day and night, but you don't answer, and I can never rest.
translation_verse: Ma Ebɔrɛ, mee shu a tre fo kapa nɛ kanyɛ nna, fo alɛ maa nu. Amoso ma kagbene maŋ dese ma.

english_verse: Yet you are the holy God, ruling from your throne and praised by Israel.
translation_verse: Ama fo la esa cheembi nna a tase fo kuwurputi so. Fo nɛ Israɛlebi bee kpaŋ.

english_verse: When they cried out for help, you saved them, and you did not let them down when they depended on you.
translation_verse: B shu n tre fo, nɛ fo lara bumo ashi tɔrɔ to. B yirda fo, nɛ fo alɛ maŋ shin nɛ b ji anishinyɔr.

english_verse: But I am merely a worm, far less than human, and I am hated and rejected by people everywhere.
translation_verse: Ama m maŋ naa du fanɛ dimɛdi. Ŋ ki fanɛ kushushombi nna nɛ basa bee keni ma jiga nsaa wora ma eyurto.

english_verse: Everyone who sees me makes fun and sneers. They shake their heads,
translation_verse: Ekama nɛ e wu ma bee wora ma shia nna. Baa fifi amu nna nsaa tege ma a kaŋɛ:

english_verse: and say, “Trust the Lord! If you are his favorite, let him protect you and keep you safe.”
translation_verse: “Fo yɛ fo yirda Ebɔrɛ nna, nɛ manɛ nna nɛ e maŋ mɔlga fo? Nɛ fo asheŋ bee bɔlɔ mo kenishi, manɛ nna nɛ e maŋ chɛ fo to.”

english_verse: You, Lord, brought me safely through birth, and you protected me when I was a baby at my mother's breast.
translation_verse: Ŋkeshin nɛ fo e shin nɛ b kurge ma. Fo e keni ma so saŋɛ so nɛ n la kebi nyiposo gba na.

english_verse: From the day I was born, I have been in your care, and from the time of my birth, you have been my God.
translation_verse: B ka kurge ma kikɛ fo enɔ to nɛ n wɔ; fo alɛ e la ma Ebɔrɛ saŋkikɛ.

english_verse: Don't stay far off when I am in trouble with no one to help me.
translation_verse: Sa maŋ barga ma n yɔ kufɔ; ŋkpal manɛ so, ma nɛ tɔrɔ maŋ wɔ kufɔ. Esa kama malɛ maŋ wɔtɔ nɛ e chɛ ma to.

english_verse: Enemies are all around like a herd of wild bulls. Powerful bulls from Bashan are everywhere.
translation_verse: Bedoŋ damta e kulti ma n wɔtɔ fanɛ apuntona. B kɔ eleŋ nna nseŋ lubi fanɛ Bashan be efuli so be egbolu.

english_verse: I have no more strength than a few drops of water. All my bones are out of joint; my heart is like melted wax.
translation_verse: Ma eleŋ kikɛ loge nna fanɛ nchu ka feeto na, nɛ ma echɛkpaana du fanɛ ma awibi ka maŋ naa chɔ abar so na. Ma kagbene malɛ ki fanɛ ŋku bumbuŋ ka ŋalga na nna.

english_verse: My strength has dried up like a broken clay pot, and my tongue sticks to the roof of my mouth. You, God, have left me to die in the dirt.
translation_verse: Ma eleŋ kikɛ loge fanɛ kusɔ nuunchu ka baŋɛ to na; nɛ ma kudonduloŋ wɔl m mata ma anyifar to. Fo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na yige ma nna nɛ n wu n tɔr shishɛr to a?

english_verse: Brutal enemies attack me like a pack of dogs, tearing at my hands and my feet.
translation_verse: Basa lubi be katuŋ kulti ma nna n wɔtɔ fanɛ njɔnɔ, a chɛ a far ma aya nɛ enɔana.

english_verse: I can count all my bones, and my enemies just stare and sneer at me.
translation_verse: Meeŋ tiŋ ŋ karga ma awibi kikɛ, nɛ ma doŋana mɛrge anishi n yuu ma so a keni nsaa mushe ma.

english_verse: They took my clothes and gambled for them.
translation_verse: B to beri nna m barga ma asɔbuuso to n sa abar.

english_verse: Don't stay far away, Lord! My strength comes from you, so hurry and help.
translation_verse: Ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, sa maŋ barga ma ga. Ma elempo, ba manaŋ m ba chɛ ma to.

english_verse: Rescue me from enemy swords and save me from those dogs.
translation_verse: N doŋana du fanɛ njɔnɔ nna. Mɔlga ma nɛ b sa maŋ mɔ ma.

english_verse: Don't let lions eat me. You rescued me from the horns of wild bulls,
translation_verse: Mɔlga ma ashi ebuluŋ na kutɔ. Sɔ ma n yige ashi apuntona na kutɔ.

english_verse: and when your people meet, I will praise you, Lord.
translation_verse: Meeŋ kaŋɛ ma basa kusɔ nɛ fo wora; nseŋ yili fo basa nɛ b shɛr to n fur fo.

english_verse: All who worship the Lord, now praise him! You belong to Jacob's family and to the people of Israel, so fear and honor the Lord!
translation_verse: Menyi nɛ menyee ŋana Ebɔrɛ na e fur mo. Menyi nɛ men la an nananyɛn Jeekɔb be kenana kikɛ e bunyaŋ mo. Israɛlebi, men shuŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bunyaŋ so.

english_verse: The Lord doesn't hate or despise the helpless in all of their troubles. When I cried out, he listened and did not turn away.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so e maŋ pal kaman n sa bumo nɛ b wɔ awurfoŋ to na. E maŋ kplaŋ bumo so saŋɛ so nɛ b shu n tre mo na. E nu bumo be kushu nna.

english_verse: When your people meet, you will fill my heart with your praises, Lord, and everyone will see me keep my promises to you.
translation_verse: Saŋɛ nɛ ma nɛ fo basa shɛr na, nɛ meeŋ fur fo ŋkpal kusɔ nɛ fo wora so; nseŋ tia nnɔ nɛ n nase n sa fo na ashi bumo be anishito.

english_verse: The poor will eat and be full, and all who worship you will be thankful and live in hope.
translation_verse: Betirpo beeŋ ji m moɛ, nɛ bekama nɛ baa bunyaŋ fo na e chɔrɔ fo. Shin nɛ asheŋ e baa nyalɛ a sa bumo saŋkama.

english_verse: Everyone on this earth will remember you, Lord. People all over the world will turn and worship you,
translation_verse: Efuliana kikɛ so ebi beeŋ nyiŋi Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na, nɛ basa e shi durnya be kaplɛkama, ŋ kilgi m bɛ mo so a bunyaŋ mo.

english_verse: because you are in control, the ruler of all nations.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ e naa ji kusɔ kama so eleŋ, nsaa ji efuliana kikɛ so kuwura.

english_verse: All who are rich and have more than enough will bow down to you, Lord. Even those who are dying and almost in the grave will come and bow down.
translation_verse: Durnya to be amansherbiwuraana nɛ b kɔ asɔ ga beeŋ bunyaŋ mo, nɛ bumo nɛ b gbar nchaŋ be kɔnɔ gba e fur mo.

english_verse: In the future, everyone will worship and learn about you, our Lord.
translation_verse: Echefosoebi kikɛ beeŋ bunyaŋ mo, nseŋ ji mbe asheŋ be shɛda n sa bumo be kaman to ebi.

english_verse: People not yet born will be told, “The Lord has saved us!”
translation_verse: Bumo nɛ b kurge kaman to gba beeŋ ba nu fanɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e mɔlga anyi.

english_verse: and you refresh my life. You are true to your name, and you lead me along the right paths.
translation_verse: Mo e naa sa ma eleŋ popɔr, nsaa ŋini ma kebaawɔtɔ niŋiso fanɛ kananɛ e nase kɔnɔ na.

english_verse: I may walk through valleys as dark as death, but I won't be afraid. You are with me, and your shepherd's rod makes me feel safe.
translation_verse: Hale nɛ n na tentembiri to mina gba, kufu maa pɛ ma. Ŋkpal manɛ so, fo wɔ ma kutɔ. Fo kuwurkpabi nɛ fo kuchuchɔ e naa kuŋ ma.

english_verse: You treat me to a feast, while my enemies watch. You honor me as your guest, and you fill my cup until it overflows.
translation_verse: N doŋana be anishito, nɛ fee wora kejigboŋ a yili ma. Fo sɔ ma fanɛ fo efɔgboŋ nna, a keta ma kananɛ k daga so.

english_verse: Your kindness and love will always be with me each day of my life, and I will live forever in your house, Lord.
translation_verse: Kashenteŋto, feeŋ baa wora ma kelela, nsaa ŋini ma kasha, jemanɛ nɛ n wɔ ŋkpa to kikɛ. Meeŋ chena Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be laŋ to hale mbaanaayɔ.

english_verse: The earth and everything on it, including its people, belong to the Lord. The world and its people belong to him.
translation_verse: Kasawule ere nɛ kusɔ kikɛ nɛ k wɔ kumo so, la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na peya nna. Basa nɛ b wɔ durnya ere to kikɛ, la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na peya nna.

english_verse: The Lord placed it all on the oceans and rivers.
translation_verse: Mo e ta kumo n yili, nseŋ ta teku nɛ nchuana n wɔtɔ kumo be kaseto.

english_verse: Only those who do right for the right reasons, and don't worship idols or tell lies under oath.
translation_verse: Basa nɛ bumo be ashuŋ shuŋso nɛ nfɛra fɛso niŋi ekpa, nɛ bumo alɛ maa shuŋ agbir, ŋko a bɔ ntaŋ a ku efɛ na.

english_verse: because they worship and serve the God of Jacob.
translation_verse: Loŋ be basa e naa fin Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be ekpa, nsaa shuŋ an nananyɛn Jeekɔb be Ebɔrɛ na.

english_verse: Open the ancient gates, so that the glorious king may come in.
translation_verse: Men bugi kadegboŋ na be mbuna dra na; nɛ ewura nɛ kemankura kulti mo na e luri to.

english_verse: Who is this glorious king? He is our Lord, a strong and mighty warrior.
translation_verse: Wanɛ e la le be kemankura be ewura ere? Mo e la an nyɛnpe nɛ e kɔ eleŋ nsaa kɔ ana a pɔɔ so saŋkama na.

english_verse: Open the ancient gates, so that the glorious king may come in.
translation_verse: Men bugi kadegboŋ na be mbuna dra na nɛ ewura nɛ kemankura kulti na e luri.

english_verse: Who is this glorious king? He is our Lord, the All-Powerful!
translation_verse: Wanɛ e la ewura nɛ kemankura kulti ere? Mo e la Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ, elempo na.

english_verse: I offer you my heart, Lord God,
translation_verse: Fo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nɛ mee kule.

english_verse: and I trust you. Don't make me ashamed or let enemies defeat me.
translation_verse: Ma Ebɔrɛ, fo nɛ n yirda. Sa maŋ shin nɛ n ji anishinyɔr, ŋko n shin nɛ ma doŋana e pɔɔ ma so.

english_verse: Don't disappoint any of your worshipers, but disappoint all deceitful liars.
translation_verse: Esa kama nɛ mbe tama deŋ fo so maaŋ ji anishinyɔr kikɛ. Ama bekama nɛ b kɔ kebɔrkɔnshi bre beeŋ ji anishinyɔr.

english_verse: Show me your paths and teach me to follow;
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe, ŋini ma fo ekpa na; nseŋ ŋini ma kananɛ meeŋ bɛ kumo so.

english_verse: guide me by your truth and instruct me. You keep me safe, and I always trust you.
translation_verse: Ta fo kashenteŋ na n ŋini ma ekpa. Ŋkpal manɛ so, fo e la Ebɔrɛ a mɔlga ma, nɛ ma tama deŋ fo so saŋkikɛ.

english_verse: Please, Lord, remember, you have always been patient and kind.
translation_verse: N nyɛnpe, nyiŋi fo kuwɔrwu nɛ fo kasha nɛ k maa loge, nsaa wɔtɔ dra dra na kikɛ na.

english_verse: Forget each wrong I did when I was young. Show how truly kind you are and remember me.
translation_verse: Ta ma kebiato be alubi nɛ kusoe kpakpaso be asheŋ woraso m paŋ ma, nseŋ nyiŋi ma ŋkpal fo kasha nɛ fo alelasheŋ so.

english_verse: You are honest and merciful, and you teach sinners how to follow your path.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ka walɛ nɛ mbe asheŋ woraso niŋi ekpa so, e bee ŋini alubiworapoana mbe ekpa nna nɛ b bɛ so.

english_verse: You lead humble people to do what is right and to stay on your path.
translation_verse: Nsaa ŋini basa nɛ b kɔ kamubrase malɛ mbe ekpa niŋiso nɛ kusɔ nɛ k daga na.

english_verse: In everything you do, you are kind and faithful to everyone who keeps our agreement with you.
translation_verse: E bee ji kashenteŋ nna nsaa kɔ kasha. E bee juŋkpar bekama nɛ baa wora asheŋ niŋiso nsaa wora mbe mbra kasonu nna.

english_verse: Be true to your name, Lord, by forgiving each one of my terrible sins.
translation_verse: O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, ta alubi damta nɛ n wora m paŋ ma, ŋkpal fo ketre so.

english_verse: Then they will have plenty, and their children will receive the land.
translation_verse: Asheŋ beeŋ baa nite nɛnɛ a sa bumo, nɛ bumo be mbia e ji bumo be kasawule be kapetɛ.

english_verse: Our Lord, you are the friend of your worshipers, and you make an agreement with all of us.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, fo nɛ basa nɛ baa ŋana fo bee ji keteri nna. Fo e naa shin nɛ baa pin kɔnɔ naseso be ŋkre nɛ fo nase dra na n sa fo basa na.

english_verse: I always look to you, because you rescue me from every trap.
translation_verse: Ma anishi yuu Enyɛnpe na so nna; ŋkpal manɛ so, mo e naa mɔlga ma ashi ajigbelɛ to.

english_verse: I am lonely and troubled. Show that you care and have pity on me.
translation_verse: Kenawule nɛ awurfoŋ kɔ ma nna; amoso Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, ba chɛ ma to.

english_verse: My awful worries keep growing. Rescue me from sadness.
translation_verse: Mɔlga ma ashi etɔrɔ nɛ ma kagbenejija gboŋgboŋi nɛ k bee ti so ere to.

english_verse: See my troubles and misery and forgive my sins.
translation_verse: Keni ma awurfoŋ nɛ kebɔltofinfin ere so, nseŋ ta ma alubi m paŋ ma.

english_verse: Look at all my enemies! See how much they hate me.
translation_verse: Keni kananɛ ma doŋana wora keshi, nɛ kananɛ b kishi ma alegaiso.

english_verse: I come to you for shelter. Protect me, keep me safe, and don't disappoint me.
translation_verse: Kuŋ ma nseŋ mɔlga ma. Sa maŋ shin nɛ n ji anishinyɔr, ŋkpal manɛ so, fo kutɔ nɛ mee fin kechɛto.

english_verse: I obey you with all my heart, and I trust you, knowing that you will save me.
translation_verse: Keni ma alelasheŋ nɛ aworbi nɛ a niŋi ekpa so, nseŋ kuŋ ma ŋkpa. Ŋkpal manɛ so, ma tama deŋ fo so nna.

english_verse: Our God, please save Israel from all its troubles.
translation_verse: O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, jande mɔlga Israɛlebi ashi bumo be awurfoŋ to.

english_verse: Show that I am right, Lord! I stay true to myself, and I have trusted you without doubting.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe shin nɛ n ji n lar; ŋkpal manɛ so, ma kebaawɔtɔ maŋ kɔ mpulɔ kikɛ. Ma yirda kikɛ deŋ fo so nna, ma alɛ maa wora shikashika kikɛ.

english_verse: Test my thoughts and find out what I am like.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, wora ma ŋ keni; mige ma asheŋ to ŋ keni ma nfɛra to.

english_verse: I never forget your kindness, and I am always faithful to you.
translation_verse: M maaŋ teŋ fo kasha nɛ k maa loge na so kikɛ. Fo kashenteŋji e naa juŋkpar ma saŋkikɛ.

english_verse: I wash my hands, Lord, to show my innocence, and I worship at your altar,
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, n fɔr ma enɔ n lar, nsaa kulti fo bɔrɛsure a bunyaŋ fo,

english_verse: I love the temple where you live, and where your glory shines.
translation_verse: Mee sha fo bɔrɛlambu na, nɛ kakpa nɛ fo kemaŋkura wɔ ga na.

english_verse: Don't sweep me away, as you do sinners. Don't punish me with death as you do those people who are brutal
translation_verse: Sa maŋ gama ma nɛ alubiworapo n ti abar so m mɔ. Ŋko n ta ma n ti bemɔpo,

english_verse: or full of meanness or who bribe others.
translation_verse: nɛ baa wora asheŋ lubi, nsaa sa basa brɔbu saŋkikɛ so.

english_verse: I stay true to myself. Be kind and rescue me.
translation_verse: Ma ere maŋ du fanɛ bumo. Ŋkpal manɛ so, ma kebaawɔtɔ niŋi nna. Amoso wu ma kuwɔr nseŋ mɔlga ma.

english_verse: Now I stand on solid ground! And when your people meet, I will praise you, Lord.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal fo ka wɔ ŋ kutɔ nsaa beeŋ chɛ ma to saŋɛ nɛ k daga so, meeŋ fur fo ashi fo basa be nshɛr to.

english_verse: You, Lord, are the light that keeps me safe. I am not afraid of anyone. You protect me, and I have no fears.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e la ma kefulto, mo alɛ e naa mɔlga ma; amoso maaŋ ŋana esa kikɛ. Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na du fanɛ ekuŋkpagboŋ nna a kuŋ ma; amoso maa lɔ kufu.

english_verse: Brutal people may attack and try to kill me, but they will stumble. Fierce enemies may attack, but they will fall.
translation_verse: Basa lubi baa fin ma nɛ b mɔ, ŋko nɛ bedoŋ bee kɔ ma gba, baaŋ fiti n tɔr.

english_verse: Armies may surround me, but I won't be afraid; war may break out, but I will trust you.
translation_verse: Hale benapo damta kulti ma n wɔtɔ gba, kufu maaŋ pɛ ma. Hale nɛ baa kɔ ma kena gba, ŋ kraa beeŋ yirda fo.

english_verse: I ask only one thing, Lord: Let me live in your house every day of my life to see how wonderful you are and to pray in your temple.
translation_verse: Kusɔ koŋwule nɛ mee fin Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kutɔ; Kumo e la fanɛ, ŋ ka beeŋ baa wɔ mbe laŋ to saŋɛ so nɛ n wɔ ŋkpa to ere; saŋɛ na so mbe alelasheŋ beeŋ baa bɔlɔ ma kenishi, nɛ m baa wɔ mo kutɔ ashi mbe bɔrɛlambu to.

english_verse: In times of trouble, Lord, you will protect me. You will hide me in your tent and keep me safe on top of a mighty rock.
translation_verse: Saŋɛ na so e beeŋ baa kuŋ ma tɔrɔ be jemanɛ; a ta ma a ŋana mbe bɔrɛlambu to. E beeŋ ta ma n yili kefaltagboŋ so, nɛ n nya kekuŋ.

english_verse: You will let me defeat all my enemies. Then I will celebrate, as I enter your tent with animal sacrifices and songs of praise.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ ŋ kɔ m pɔɔ n doŋana so nseŋ lara sarga ashi mbe bɔrɛlambu to; nseŋ cha awɔr kagbenefuliso m boŋ nshɛ m fur Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.

english_verse: Please listen when I pray! Have pity. Answer my prayer.
translation_verse: M baŋ shu n tre fo, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, jande nu ma ebɔl, nseŋ wu ma kuwɔr n nu ma kekule.

english_verse: My heart tells me to pray. I am eager to see your face,
translation_verse: N yili ma kagbene to nna fanɛ meeŋ fin fo; amoso nɛ m pere kenishi nɛ n wu fo na.

english_verse: so don't hide from me. I am your servant, Lord, and you have helped me. Don't turn from me in anger. You alone keep me safe. Don't reject or desert me.
translation_verse: Jande sa maŋ pal kaman n sa ma, sa maŋ nya agbo n ju fo kenya n lɛ. Fo e la ma echɛtopo, amoso, ma Ebɔrɛ nɛ ma emɔlgapo; sa maŋ kplaŋ ma so ŋko n yige ma.

english_verse: Even if my father and mother should desert me, you will take care of me.
translation_verse: Hale nɛ tuto nɛ n nio kini ma gba; Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bre beeŋ keni ma so.

english_verse: Teach me to follow, Lord, and lead me on the right path because of my enemies.
translation_verse: Ŋini ma ekpa lela nɛ fee sha fanɛ m baa bɔla so, nɛ ma doŋana maaŋ nya ma.

english_verse: Don't let them do to me what they want. People tell lies about me and make violent threats,
translation_verse: Sa maŋ yige ma n sa ma doŋana nɛ b ta efɛ nɛ kafunti a kɔ ma, nseŋ nya ma n wora kusɔ nɛ baa sha.

english_verse: but I know I will live to see how kind you are.
translation_verse: M baa nyi geeŋ fanɛ meeŋ ji efute, nseŋ wu fo alelasheŋ durnya ere to.

english_verse: Trust the Lord! Be brave and strong and trust the Lord.
translation_verse: Yirda Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na. Baa kɔ eleŋ nseŋ nya kagbene a keni mbe anishito.

english_verse: Only you, Lord, are a mighty rock! Don't refuse to help me when I pray. If you don't answer me, I will soon be dead.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, fo e la kefaltagboŋ a kuŋ ma. Amoso, nu ma kekule nsaa maŋ kplaŋ ma so. Fo baŋ kplaŋ ma so, k maaŋ chɛr nɛ n wu n yɔ nchaŋ to.

english_verse: Please listen to my prayer and my cry for help, as I lift my hands toward your holy temple.
translation_verse: Jande, nu ma kekule, saŋɛ so nɛ m maŋ ma enɔana so n shoŋi fo bɔrɛlambu cheembi na a bunyaŋ fo nsaa kule fo, a fin kechɛto ere.

english_verse: They don't pay any attention to your wonderful deeds. Now you will destroy them and leave them in ruin.
translation_verse: Bumo be shɛŋ maŋ wɔ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be asheŋ to. Amoso e beeŋ gberge bumo kusoe nseŋ mur bumo cheche.

english_verse: You are my strong shield, and I trust you completely. You have helped me, and I will celebrate and thank you in song.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e naa sa ma eleŋ nsaa kuŋ ma. N yirda mo kashenteŋto. E chɛ ma to n shin nɛ ma kagbene fuli ma. Amoso meeŋ ji eyur nseŋ boŋ nshɛ n di mo epaŋ.

english_verse: You give strength to your people, Lord, and you save and protect your chosen ones.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e naa sa mbe basa eleŋ. Mo e naa kuŋ nsaa mɔlga mbe ewura laraso.

english_verse: Come save us and bless us. Be our shepherd and always carry us in your arms.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, mɔlga fo basa; nɛfa fo basa laraso. Baa keni bumo so fanɛ kananɛ mbolpɔkpapo bee keni mbe mbɔlpo so na mbanaayɔ na.

english_verse: All you angels in heaven, honor the glory and power of the Lord!
translation_verse: Menyi emalaika nɛ men wɔ ebɔrɛso e di Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na epaŋ, ŋkpal mbe kemaŋkura nɛ eleŋ so.

english_verse: Honor the wonderful name of the Lord, and worship the Lord most holy and glorious.
translation_verse: Men di mbe ketre nɛ k kɔ kemaŋkura na epaŋ; nseŋ bunyaŋ mo ŋkpal e ka du cheembi nsaa kɔ kemaŋkura so.

english_verse: The voice of the Lord echoes over the oceans. The glorious Lord God thunders above the roar of the raging sea,
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be ebɔl bee gbri teku so nna fanɛ bɔrɛ ka bee ponte na.

english_verse: The voice of the Lord destroys the cedar trees; the Lord shatters cedars on Mount Lebanon.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be kamalga bee buri ndibi nɛ baa tre sida na to nna. K bee buri sida be ndibi nɛ a wɔ Lebanɔn be kebeegboŋ na so burburbi nna.

english_verse: God makes Mount Lebanon skip like a calf and Mount Hermon jump like a wild ox.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be kamalga e naa shin nɛ Lebanɔn be kebeegboŋ na bee tɛto fanɛ kenabi, nɛ Hɛɛmɔn be kebeegboŋ malɛ bee tɛto fanɛ gbolu fɔlbi.

english_verse: The voice of the Lord makes lightning flash
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be kamalga bee nyɛkpɛ nna fanɛ bɔrɛ ka nyɛkpɛ na.

english_verse: and the desert tremble. And because of the Lord, the desert near Kadesh shivers and shakes.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be kamalga bee shin nna nɛ keshishɛrsawule bee gbuŋgbuŋ to. Mbe kamalga e shin nɛ Kadɛsh be keshishɛrsawule gbuŋgbuŋ to.

english_verse: The voice of the Lord makes deer give birth before their time. Forests are stripped of leaves, and the temple is filled with shouts of praise.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be kamalga e naa shin nɛ ndibigboŋ bee gbuŋgbuŋ to; nɛ kupo to be ndibi be afantaŋ bee chuge a tɔr; nɛ basa nɛ b wɔ mbe bɔrɛlambu na to bee ponte a kaŋɛ fanɛ kemaŋkura e baa la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ peya.

english_verse: The Lord rules on his throne, king of the flood forever.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e naa ji kuwura nchuaana nɛ a wɔ nchiŋ gba so. E bee ji kuwura nna mbaanaayɔ.

english_verse: Pray that our Lord will make us strong and give us peace.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e naa sa mbe basa eleŋ, nsaa nɛfa bumo nɛ kagbenewushi.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord! You saved me from the grave and kept my enemies from celebrating my death.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, meeŋ fur fo; ŋkpal fo ka mɔlga ma nsaa maŋ shin nɛ ma doŋana ji eyur ŋkpal b ka pɔɔ ma so so.

english_verse: I prayed to you, Lord God, and you healed me,
translation_verse: N shu n tre fo Enyɛnpe ma Ebɔrɛ; nɛ fo chɛ ma to,

english_verse: Your faithful people, Lord, will praise you with songs and honor your holy name.
translation_verse: Menyi nɛ menyee ji kashenteŋ na e boŋ nshɛ n chɔrɔ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, ŋkpal asɔ lela nɛ e wora n sa anyi na so.

english_verse: Your anger lasts a little while, but your kindness lasts for a lifetime. At night we may cry, but when morning comes we will celebrate.
translation_verse: E maa nya agbo a chɛr; Mbe kelela bre wɔtɔ nna n sa esa saŋɛ nɛ e wɔ ŋkpa to kikɛ. Kushu beeŋ tiŋ m ba kanyɛso, ama kare tea ka chɛ nɛ kagbenefuli ba.

english_verse: You, Lord, were my friend, and you made me strong as a mighty mountain. But when you hid your face, I was crushed.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, fo daŋ wora ma kelela, n sa ma eleŋ fanɛ kebeegboŋ na. Ama fo ka pal kaman n sa ma nɛ kufu pɛ ma ga.

english_verse: I prayed to you, Lord, and in my prayer I said,
translation_verse: Fo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nɛ mee shu a tre, fanɛ fo wu ma kuwɔr.

english_verse: “What good will it do you if I am in the grave? Once I have turned to dust, how can I praise you or tell how loyal you are?
translation_verse: Manɛ be tɔnɔ nɛ ma luwu kɔ n sa fo? Manɛ nɛ ma keyɔ nchaŋ to beeŋ wora fo? Bubuni beeŋ tiŋ n fur fo a? Baaŋ tiŋ m malga fo kashenteŋji nɛ alelasheŋ be asheŋ a?

english_verse: You have turned my sorrow into joyful dancing. No longer am I sad and wearing sackcloth.
translation_verse: Fo e chɛrga ma kushu ŋ ki kayurji; nɛ m maŋ naŋ buu kagbenejijaso be asɔbuuso.

english_verse: I thank you from my heart, and I will never stop singing your praises, my Lord and my God.
translation_verse: Amoso m maaŋ lo ma kɔnɔ. Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, meeŋ fur fo, a di fo ketre epaŋ mbaanaayɔ.

english_verse: I come to you, Lord, for protection. Don't let me be ashamed. Do as you have promised and rescue me.
translation_verse: Fo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kutɔ nɛ m ba nɛ fo kuŋ ma. Sa maŋ shin nɛ n ji anishinyɔr. Enyɛnpe, jande, sɔ ma n yige; ŋkpal fo ka la esa niŋiso so.

english_verse: Listen to my prayer and hurry to save me. Be my mighty rock and the fortress where I am safe.
translation_verse: Nu ma kekule nseŋ mɔlga ma manaŋ. Baa la ma kefaltagboŋ, nɛ kumɔlga be kakpa lempo nɛ mee nya kumɔlga fo kutɔ.

english_verse: You, Lord God, are my mighty rock and my fortress. Lead me and guide me, so that your name will be honored.
translation_verse: Fo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na, e la ma kefaltagboŋ a kuŋ ma. Amoso baa juŋkpar a ŋini ma ekpa lela na; nɛ fo ketre e nya kemaŋkura.

english_verse: Protect me from hidden traps and keep me safe.
translation_verse: Kuŋ ma ashi ajigbelɛ nɛ ma doŋana sho ma to, n shin nɛ n nya kumɔlga.

english_verse: You are faithful, and I trust you because you rescued me.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, fo e naa keni ma so. Jande mɔlga ma ŋkpal fo ka la eshenteŋjipo so.

english_verse: I hate the worshipers of worthless idols, but I trust you, Lord.
translation_verse: Ŋ kishi basa nɛ baa shuŋ agbir nɛ a maŋ la shɛŋ na ga. Fo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nɛ n yirda.

english_verse: I celebrate and shout because you are kind. You saw all my suffering, and you cared for me.
translation_verse: Ma kagbene beeŋ fuli ma, nɛ n ji eyur ŋkpal fo kasha nɛ k maa loge na so. Fo wu ma etɔrɔ nɛ awurfoŋ nseŋ chɛ ma to.

english_verse: You kept me from the hands of my enemies, and you set me free.
translation_verse: Fo maŋ yige ma n wɔtɔ ma doŋana be enɔ to. Ama fo sɔ ma n yige, nɛ n nya ma kumu a ji.

english_verse: I have known only sorrow all my life long, and I suffer year after year. I am weak from sin, and my bones are limp.
translation_verse: Kagbenejija shin nɛ n bel katiŋso; nɛ kebɔltofinfin bee ku ma ŋkpa so. Awurfoŋ shin nɛ ŋ ki esa pɔso, nɛ ma awibi to maŋ naa kɔ eleŋ.

english_verse: My enemies insult me. Neighbors are even worse, and I disgust my friends. People meet me on the street, and they turn and run.
translation_verse: N doŋana nɛ ma bechenashapo kikɛ bee keni ma jiga nna. Ŋ ki kusɔ ŋana so n teriana kutɔ, nɛ baa wu ma nsaa shile.

english_verse: I am completely forgotten like someone dead. I am merely a broken dish.
translation_verse: B teŋ ma so nna fanɛ esa nɛ e wu, nɛ ŋ ki fanɛ kapɛlanfu na.

english_verse: I hear the crowds whisper, “Everyone is afraid!” They are plotting and scheming to murder me.
translation_verse: N nu basa ka bee kuli ma, nɛ kufu pɛ ma ga. B yɛ, baa kre ma ŋkre nna, a fin ma nɛ b mɔ.

english_verse: But I trust you, Lord, and I claim you as my God.
translation_verse: Ama ma yirda deŋ fo so nna. Enyɛnpe, fo e la ma Ebɔrɛ.

english_verse: My life is in your hands. Save me from enemies who hunt me down.
translation_verse: Ma ŋkpa wɔ fo enɔ to nna. Mɔlga ma ashi ma doŋana nɛ b ju a buu ma so saŋkama na kutɔ.

english_verse: Smile on me, your servant. Have pity and rescue me.
translation_verse: Wu fo kenya kuwɔr nseŋ mɔlga ma, ŋkpal fo kasha nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na so.

english_verse: I pray only to you. Don't disappoint me. Disappoint my cruel enemies until they lie silent in their graves.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, fo nɛ mee shu a tre. Sa maŋ shin nɛ anishinyɔr e ji ma. Ama shin nɛ basa lubi bre e ji anishinyɔr, hale n ya wu n yɔ nchaŋ to.

english_verse: Silence those proud liars! Make them stop bragging and insulting your people.
translation_verse: Shin nɛ befɛpo na e lo bumo be nnɔ. Bumo e naa wu bumo be amu nsaa keni basa niŋiso jiga na.

english_verse: You are wonderful, and while everyone watches, you store up blessings for all who honor and trust you.
translation_verse: Fo kelela shi m baŋ so; nɛ fee sha kebaawora basa nɛ baa ŋana fo kelela. Ekama nyi fo kelela nɛ kananɛ fee kuŋ basa nɛ b yirda fo.

english_verse: You are their shelter from harmful plots, and you are their protection from vicious gossip.
translation_verse: Fee kuŋ bumo ashi basa nɛ baa kre bumo ŋkre lubi be enɔ to nna, nsaa ta bumo a gelge katege nɛ asheŋ nɛ bedoŋ bee ku a deŋi bumo.

english_verse: I was terrified and thought, “They've chased me far away from you!” But you answered my prayer when I shouted for help.
translation_verse: Kufu daa kɔ ma nna, nɛ n daa fɛ fanɛ Ebɔrɛ ju ma ashi mbe anishito nna. Ama n shu n tre mo fanɛ e chɛ ma to, nɛ e nu ma kekule.

english_verse: All who belong to the Lord, show how you love him. The Lord protects the faithful, but he severely punishes everyone who is proud.
translation_verse: Menyi Ebɔrɛ be basa e baa sha Enyɛnpe na. Ŋkpal manɛ so, e bee kuŋ beshenteŋjipo nna, nsaa gberge kamoowuwuraana bre kusoe kananɛ k daga bumo.

english_verse: You bless them by saying, “You told me your sins, without trying to hide them, and now I forgive you.”
translation_verse: Kagbenefuli la esa nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ maŋ naa nyiŋi mbe alubi na peya nna. Mo e maŋ ta kulubi kikɛ ŋ ŋana mbe kagbene to na.

english_verse: Before I confessed my sins, my bones felt limp, and I groaned all day long.
translation_verse: Ŋ ka daa maŋ tuba ashi ma alubi to na; egbɛ ko daa deŋ ma so nna ŋkpal kare chɛ kikɛ be kushu so.

english_verse: Night and day your hand weighed heavily on me, and my strength was gone as in the summer heat.
translation_verse: Fo kasogberge daa wɔ ma so kapa nɛ kanyɛ nna; nɛ ma eleŋ kikɛ loge fanɛ ketarso be epeŋi ka shin nɛ nchu feeto na.

english_verse: So I confessed my sins and told them all to you. I said, “I'll tell the Lord each one of my sins.” Then you forgave me and took away my guilt.
translation_verse: Nɛ n tuba nseŋ kaŋɛ fo ma alubi kikɛ. M maŋ naŋ ta kulubi kikɛ n ŋana; nɛ fo ta ma alubi kikɛ m paŋ ma.

english_verse: We worship you, Lord, and we should always pray whenever we find out that we have sinned. Then we won't be swept away by a raging flood.
translation_verse: Amoso fo kama nɛ fee ŋana Ebɔrɛ, nsaa wɔ tɔrɔ to, fo kule mo. Saŋɛ na so, tɔrɔ be awɔrfoŋ nɛ k du fanɛ nchu ka to chufulgboŋ a ba eleŋso na maaŋ sulɔ fo n yɔ.

english_verse: You are my hiding place! You protect me from trouble, and you put songs in my heart because you have saved me.
translation_verse: Fo e la ma eŋanakpa. Fo alɛ beeŋ mɔlga ma ashi tɔrɔ to; nɛ m boŋ nshɛ awɔrso ŋkpal fo ka mɔlga ma so.

english_verse: You said to me, “I will point out the road that you should follow. I will be your teacher and watch over you.
translation_verse: Fo yɛ feeŋ ŋini ma ekpa nɛ meeŋ bɔla so. Feeŋ ji ma asoeto nseŋ keni ma so.

english_verse: Don't be stupid like horses and mules that must be led with ropes to make them obey.”
translation_verse: Amoso n sa maŋ wuli fanɛ gbaŋɛ ŋko kurma; nɛ baa wɔtɔ kebarga ŋko efɔl pɔɛŋ nɛ e bee shuli a sa mo nyɛnpe na.

english_verse: All kinds of troubles will strike the wicked, but your kindness shields those who trust you, Lord.
translation_verse: Belubiworapo beeŋ luri awurfoŋ be yiri yiri to. Ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ ta mbe kasha nɛ k maa loge na ŋ kuŋ basa nɛ b yirda mo na bre.

english_verse: Praise the Lord with harps! Use harps with ten strings to make music for him.
translation_verse: Men ta alaŋsɔ n fur mo. Men ta ejaŋjilaŋ n laŋ m boŋ nshɛ n dele mo.

english_verse: Sing a new song. Shout! Play beautiful music.
translation_verse: Men boŋ nshɛ popɔr n dele mo. Men laŋ ejaŋjilaŋ kenyiso, nseŋ cha awɔr kagbenefuliso.

english_verse: The Lord made the heavens and everything in them by his word.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be kamalga so nɛ e bɔla n to esoso. E malga nna nɛ epeŋi nɛ kufɔl nɛ achɛkpabi lar.

english_verse: Everyone in this world should worship and honor the Lord!
translation_verse: Kasawule so ebi kikɛ e shuŋ Enyɛnpe na, nɛ durnya to be basa kikɛ e bunyaŋ mo.

english_verse: As soon as he spoke the world was created; at his command, the earth was formed.
translation_verse: Mo e malga nɛ durnya fara. Mo e kaŋɛ nɛ kusɔ kama ba.

english_verse: The Lord destroys the plans and spoils the schemes of the nations.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e naa jija efuliana be ŋkre. Mo e naa kuŋ bumo be nfɛra lubiana ekpa.

english_verse: But what the Lord has planned will stand forever. His thoughts never change.
translation_verse: Kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe na kre bre wɔtɔ nna mbaanaayɔ. Kusɔ nɛ e yili maa chɛrga kikɛ.

english_verse: The Lord looks at the world
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na wɔ ebɔrɛso nna a wu basa kikɛ.

english_verse: The Lord gave us each a mind, and nothing we do can be hidden from him.
translation_verse: Mo e sa bumo nfɛra nɛ baa fɛ asheŋ. Amoso e nyi kusɔ kama nɛ baa fɛ.

english_verse: Mighty armies alone cannot win wars for a king; great strength by itself cannot keep a soldier safe.
translation_verse: Mannɛ ewura be benapo be eleŋ so, nɛ e bee tiŋ a kɔ a pɔɔ so. Mannɛ benapo gba be eleŋ so, nɛ baa tiŋ a kɔ kena a pɔɔ so.

english_verse: In war the strength of a horse cannot be trusted to take you to safety.
translation_verse: Egbaŋɛ nɛ b kɔ a kɔ kena be eleŋgboŋ na maaŋ tiŋ m mɔlga esa ŋko ŋ kuŋ mo.

english_verse: We depend on you, Lord, to help and protect us.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na to nɛ anyi be tama wɔ. Mo e la anyi be ekumpo nɛ echɛtopo.

english_verse: You make our hearts glad because we trust you, the only God.
translation_verse: Anyi be ŋgbene fuli anyi nna; ŋkpal an ka yirda mbe ketre so.

english_verse: I will always praise the Lord.
translation_verse: Meeŋ baa fur Enyɛnpe na saŋkama. M maaŋ yige mbe kechɔrɔ kikɛ.

english_verse: With all my heart, I will praise the Lord. Let all who are helpless, listen and be glad.
translation_verse: Meeŋ fur mo ŋkpal kusɔ nɛ e wora so, nɛ bekama nɛ baa ji awurfoŋ na e nu kumo be loŋ nɛ bumo be ŋgbene e fuli bumo.

english_verse: I asked the Lord for help, and he saved me from all my fears.
translation_verse: Ŋ kule Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nɛ e nu ma kekule, nseŋ sɔ ma n yige ashi asɔ nɛ a bee da ma kufu na to.

english_verse: Keep your eyes on the Lord! You will shine like the sun and never blush with shame.
translation_verse: Bekama nɛ bumo be anishi yuu mo so be ŋgbene bee fuli bumo nna. Bumo alɛ maaŋ ji nyɔmɔ kikɛ.

english_verse: I was a nobody, but I prayed, and the Lord saved me from all my troubles.
translation_verse: Mo nɛ betentaŋasepo bee shu a tre, nɛ e bee nu bumo be kushu, nsaa mɔlga bumo ashi bumo be etɔrɔ to na.

english_verse: If you honor the Lord, his angel will protect you.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe be emalaika bee kulti bekama nɛ baa bunyaŋ mo nna a wɔtɔ, nsaa mɔlga bumo ashi kenishipere to.

english_verse: Discover for yourself that the Lord is kind. Come to him for protection, and you will be glad.
translation_verse: Nɛ fo firgi n taga Enyɛnpe na to, feeŋ wu fanɛ e walɛ. Nɛfa la bekama nɛ baa nya kekuŋ ashi Enyɛnpe na to peya nna.

english_verse: Honor the Lord! You are his special people. No one who honors the Lord will ever be in need.
translation_verse: Bekama nɛ b la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be basa na e bunyaŋ mo. Ŋkpal manɛ so, e bee sa bumo nɛ b yirda mo na asɔ nɛ a tir bumo nna saŋkikɛ.

english_verse: Young lions may go hungry or even starve, but if you trust the Lord, you will never miss out on anything good.
translation_verse: Ebuluŋ gba bee kaa di akoŋ ama bekama nɛ baa wora Enyɛnpe na kasonu bre, maa fin kusɔ lela a gben.

english_verse: Come, my children, listen as I teach you to respect the Lord.
translation_verse: Ma mbia, men kaŋ kusoe n nu; nɛ n ŋini menyi kananɛ menyeeŋ baa bunyaŋ Enyɛnpe na.

english_verse: Do you want to live and enjoy a long life?
translation_verse: Menyeeŋ baa sha kenu kebaawɔtɔ to be ebel a? Menyeeŋ baa sha efute tenteŋ nɛ kagbenefuli a?

english_verse: Do good instead of evil and try to live at peace.
translation_verse: Men yige alubi be kebaawora nsaa wora alela; meeŋ baa kɔ a fin kagbenewushi ashi men be ŋgbene to.

english_verse: If you obey the Lord, he will watch over you and answer your prayers.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee keni basa nɛ baa wora asheŋ niŋiso so nsaa nu bumo be kekule nna.

english_verse: But God despises evil people, and he will wipe them all from the earth, till they are forgotten.
translation_verse: Ama e bee pal kaman nna a sa alubiworapo bre. Bumo alɛ baŋ wu e bee shin nɛ baa teŋ bumo so kuraa nna.

english_verse: When his people pray for help, he listens and rescues them from their troubles.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee nu esa nɛ e bee wora asheŋ niŋiso be kushu nna, nsaa mɔlga mo ashi mbe tɔrɔ to.

english_verse: The Lord is there to rescue all who are discouraged and have given up hope.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na taga basa nɛ bumo be aba pɔ bumo na to nna. E bee mɔlga bekama nɛ b maŋ naa kɔ tama na nna.

english_verse: The Lord's people may suffer a lot, but he will always bring them safely through.
translation_verse: Basa lela bee kaa nya etɔrɔ damta nna. Ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ mɔlga bumo ashi etɔrɔ na kikɛ to.

english_verse: Not one of their bones will ever be broken.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e naa kuŋ bumo. Bumo be kuwibi koŋwule gba maaŋ bu.

english_verse: Wicked people are killed by their own evil deeds, and if you hate God's people you will be punished.
translation_verse: Alubiworapoana be asheŋ lubi bee kilgi nna a ji bumo. Ebɔrɛ beeŋ gberge bekama nɛ b kishi mbe basa kusoe.

english_verse: The Lord saves the lives of his servants. Run to him for protection, and you won't be punished.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ mɔlga mbe basa. E beeŋ kuŋ bekama nɛ baa fin kekuŋ ashi mo kutɔ na.

english_verse: Shield me and help me.
translation_verse: Chɛ ma to nseŋ kuŋ ma.

english_verse: Let all who want to kill me be disgraced and put to shame. Chase away and confuse all who plan to harm me.
