translation_verse: Shin nɛ bekama nɛ baa fin ma nɛ b mɔ na e ji anishinyɔr nseŋ kɔ n tɔr. Shin nɛ bekama nɛ baa kre ma ŋkre lubi na kikɛ e wulto m bɛta kaman.

english_verse: Send your angel after them and let them be like straw in the wind.
translation_verse: Shin nɛ b ki fanɛ afɔfɔ nɛ afu bee foŋ a lɛ na, saŋɛ so nɛ Enyɛnpe be malaika bee ŋin bumo na.

english_verse: Make them run in the dark on a slippery road, as your angel chases them.
translation_verse: Shin nɛ bumo be ekpa to e ki tentembiri nsaa fɛrge, saŋɛ so nɛ Enyɛnpe be malaika ju a bɛ bumo so na.

english_verse: I did them no harm, but they hid a net to trap me, and they dug a deep pit to catch and kill me.
translation_verse: M maŋ wora bumo shɛŋ nɛ b fe ma kejigbelɛ; nseŋ kur kemaŋ chiŋgeliŋ n nase fanɛ n tɔr to.

english_verse: Surprise them with disaster! Trap them in their own nets and let them fall and rot in the pits they have dug.
translation_verse: Ama kemur beeŋ purgi bumo. Bumo gbagba be ajigbelɛ nɛ b fe na beeŋ kilgi m pɛ bumo. Baaŋ tur amaŋ nɛ bumo gbagba kur na to.

english_verse: I will celebrate and be joyful because you, Lord, have saved me.
translation_verse: Nɛ ma kagbene e fuli ma ŋkpal Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na so; nɛ n ji eyur ŋkpal e ka mɔlga ma so.

english_verse: Every bone in my body will shout: “No one is like the Lord!” You protect the helpless from those in power; you save the poor and needy from those who hurt them.
translation_verse: Nseŋ ta ma kagbene kikɛ ŋ kaŋɛ Enyɛnpe na le: “Esa kama maŋ du fanɛ fo. Fo e naa kuŋ bepɔshipo ashi belempo be enɔ to, nsaa mɔlga betirpo ashi basa lempo be kamɛaŋ to.”

english_verse: They repay evil for good, and I feel all alone.
translation_verse: Baa ta alubi nna a ka ma alela be kukɔ; nɛ kenawule nɛ kebɔltofinfin tɔr ma so.

english_verse: When they were sick, I wore sackcloth and went without food. I truly prayed for them,
translation_verse: Ama b ka bee lɔ, kagbenejijaso be asɔbuuso nɛ m buu; m mɔn ma kumu ajibi; m bar ma kumu ase ŋ kule Ebɔrɛ

english_verse: as I would for a friend or a relative. I was in sorrow and mourned, as I would for my mother.
translation_verse: fanɛ kananɛ meeŋ wora n sa n teri ŋko n niopibi na. N shu kagbenejijaso nna fanɛ ŋ ka bee shu n nio be keeli na.

english_verse: But all you do is watch! When will you do something? Save me from the attack of those vicious lions.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, feeŋ ba tase a keni nɛ b baa wora ma le a? Mɔlga ma ashi basa lubi ere be enɔ to. Mɔlga ma ŋkpa ashi basa nɛ b du fanɛ ebuluŋ ere be enɔ to.

english_verse: And when your people meet, I will praise you and thank you, Lord, in front of them all.
translation_verse: Saŋɛ na so meeŋ chɔrɔ fo ashi fo basa nɛ b shɛr be anishito; nseŋ yili bumo to n fur fo.

english_verse: Don't let my brutal enemies be glad because of me. They hate me for no reason. Don't let them wink behind my back.
translation_verse: Sa maŋ shin nɛ ma doŋana, befɛpo na, be ŋgbene e fuli bumo ŋkpal b ka pɔɔ ma so so. Sa maŋ shin nɛ bumo nɛ b kishi ma kenyanyaŋɛso na e mushe ma ŋkpal ŋ ka wɔ tɔrɔ to so.

english_verse: They say hurtful things, and they lie to people who want to live in peace.
translation_verse: B maa malga kelɔposo kikɛ. B wɔtɔ nna a ku efɛ a sa basa nɛ ma nɛ bumo wɔtɔ kagbenewushiso na.

english_verse: They are quick to accuse me. They say, “You did it! We saw you ourselves.”
translation_verse: Baa nya manaŋ a ku asheŋ a deŋi ma nna; nsaa ponte a kaŋɛ le: “An gbagba be kenishi e wu kusɔ nɛ fo wora.”

english_verse: You see everything, Lord! Please don't keep silent or stay so far away.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, fo gbagba wu kesheŋ ere. Amoso sa maŋ lo to. Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, sa maŋ yɔ kufɔ ŋ ka ma.

english_verse: and prove that I am right by your standards. Don't let them laugh at me
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, ŋkpal fo ka la esa niŋiso so, n shin nɛ b pin fanɛ m maŋ wora n foe. Sa maŋ shin nɛ ma doŋana e mushe ma.

english_verse: or say to each other, “Now we've got what we want! We'll gobble him up!”
translation_verse: Sa maŋ shin nɛ b kaŋɛ le: “Mannɛ mo nde a? An nya mo n wɔtɔ enɔ to a!”

english_verse: Disappoint and confuse all who are glad to see me in trouble; disgrace and embarrass my proud enemies who say to me, “You are nothing!”
translation_verse: Shin nɛ bumo nɛ bumo be ŋgbene bee fuli ŋkpal ma awurfoŋ so na be nfɛra e wea to nɛ b kɔ n tɔr cheche. Shin nɛ bumo nɛ baa kaŋɛ fanɛ b bɔ ma na e ji nyɔmɔ nseŋ sipa.

english_verse: Let all who want me to win be happy and joyful. From now on let them say, “The Lord is wonderful! God is glad when all goes well for his servant.”
translation_verse: Shin nɛ bumo nɛ baa fin fanɛ n ji n lar na e cha awɔr kagbenefuliso ŋ kaŋɛ le: “Kemaŋkura e baa la Enyɛnpe na peya, Mbe kagbene e naa fuli ŋkpal mbe kenya be nɛnɛ so na.”

english_verse: Then I will shout all day, “Praise the Lord God! He did what was right.”
translation_verse: Nɛ m malga kananɛ fee wora asheŋ niŋiso be asheŋ, nseŋ fur fo kachɛ lelemu.

english_verse: Sinners don't respect God; sin is all they think about.
translation_verse: Belubiworapo maa sa Ebɔrɛ bunyaŋ. Alubi nawule be asheŋ nɛ baa fɛ ashi bumo be ŋgbene to.

english_verse: They like themselves too much to hate their own sins or even to see them.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal b kaa bee sha bumo gbagba be amu ga so so; b maa wu alubi nɛ baa wora, hale nɛ baa kishi amo gba.

english_verse: They tell deceitful lies, and they don't have the sense to live right.
translation_verse: Kafulesheŋ nɛ efɛ e bɔlɔ bumo be nnɔ to. Bumo be nfɛra maa ŋini bumo kebaawɔtɔ lela; bumo alɛ maa wora kelela.

english_verse: Those people stay awake, thinking up mischief, and they follow the wrong road, refusing to turn from sin.
translation_verse: B dese bumo be edesekpa gba alubi be kewora be ŋkre nɛ baa kre. B maa wora asheŋ lela kikɛ. Kulubi kama malɛ maa choŋ bumo so.

english_verse: Your love is faithful, Lord, and even the clouds in the sky can depend on you.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, fo kashenteŋji nɛ kasha nɛ fo kɔ a sa basa shi ga. Kumo alɛ maa chɛrga; k bee fo kaplɛkama, hale esoso nɛ awɔlpa to kikɛ.

english_verse: Your decisions are always fair. They are firm like mountains, deep like the sea, and all people and animals are under your care.
translation_verse: Fo asheŋ woraso niŋi ekpa nna nsaa du fanɛ kebeegboŋ nɛ k maa gbuŋgbuŋ na. Kananɛ fee mige basa be asheŋ to a ji asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so du chiŋgeliŋ fanɛ teku nna. Fo enɔ to nɛ edimɛdi nɛ asɔbɔya kikɛ wɔ.

english_verse: Your love is a treasure, and everyone finds shelter in the shadow of your wings.
translation_verse: Fo kasha nɛ k maa chɛrga nsaa maa loge na du fanɛ shuwa nna; nɛ bebɔlpo nɛ basagboŋ kikɛ bee nya kekuŋ ashi fo kiyoyul to.

english_verse: You give your guests a feast in your house, and you serve a tasty drink that flows like a river.
translation_verse: Fee wora kejigboŋ nna a sa fo befɔ ashi fo laŋ to. Fo kasha nɛ fo kɔ a sa anyi na baŋ anyi be nfɛra so.

english_verse: The life-giving fountain belongs to you, and your light gives light to each of us.
translation_verse: Fo kutɔ nɛ ŋkpa kikɛ shi; nɛ fo kefulto bee bugi anyi be anishi nɛ anyee pin fo.

english_verse: Our Lord, keep showing love to everyone who knows you, and use your power to save all whose thoughts please you.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, baa ŋini bekama nɛ b nyi fo na kasha saŋkama; nsaa wora bumo nɛ baa wora asheŋ niŋiso na kelela.

english_verse: Don't let those proud and merciless people kick me around or chase me away.
translation_verse: Sa maŋ shin nɛ kanyishawuraana e baa kɔ ma, ŋko n shin nɛ kumukpakpasowuraana e ju ma n lɛ.

english_verse: Look at those wicked people! They are knocked down, never to get up again.
translation_verse: Keni kakpa nɛ belubiworapoana, tɔr a dese. Bumo alɛ maaŋ naŋ tiŋ n wora shɛŋ kikɛ.

english_verse: Trust the Lord and live right! The land will be yours, and you will be safe.
translation_verse: Yirda Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na, nsaa wora alelasheŋ. Saŋɛ na so feeŋ chena kasawule ere so n nya kekuŋ.

english_verse: Let the Lord lead you and trust him to help.
translation_verse: Shin nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e baa juŋkpar fo kusɔ kama to. Yirda fanɛ e beeŋ chɛ fo to.

english_verse: Be patient and trust the Lord. Don't let it bother you when all goes well for those who do sinful things.
translation_verse: Baa kɔ kanyiti a jo Enyɛnpe be saŋɛ. Sa maŋ shin nɛ k baa tɔrɔ fo ŋkpal asheŋ ka bee nite nɛnɛ a sa belubiworapo so.

english_verse: Don't be angry or furious. Anger can lead to sin.
translation_verse: Saa maa nya agbo ŋko a wora asheŋ agbo so. Agbo bee yɛra esa alubi to nna.

english_verse: All sinners will disappear, but if you trust the Lord, the land will be yours.
translation_verse: Alubiworapoana kikɛ beeŋ mur. Ama bekama nɛ b yirda Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bre beeŋ ji kasawule ere so be tɔnɔ.

english_verse: Sinners will soon disappear, never to be found,
translation_verse: K maaŋ chɛr nɛ alubiworapoana e mur, nɛ fo keni n fin bumo ŋ gben.

english_verse: but the poor will take the land and enjoy a big harvest.
translation_verse: Ama bebɔlpo bre beeŋ ji kasawule ere so be tɔnɔ; nseŋ nya kagbenewushi gboŋgboŋi.

english_verse: Merciless people make plots against good people and snarl like animals,
translation_verse: Belubiworapo bee kre basa lela asheŋ lubi nna, nsaa keni bumo yurkishiso.

english_verse: but the Lord laughs and knows their time is coming soon.
translation_verse: Ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee mushe belubiworapo nna, ŋkpal bumo be kasogberge be saŋɛ ka maaŋ chɛr nseŋ ba so.

english_verse: The wicked kill with swords and shoot arrows to murder the poor and the needy and all who do right.
translation_verse: Belubiworapo bee pe nsaŋɛ nna nsaa gberge bumo be ata to a fin betirpo nɛ betentaŋasepo nɛ basa nɛ baa wora asheŋ niŋiso nɛ b mɔ.

english_verse: But they will be killed by their own swords, and their arrows will be broken.
translation_verse: Ama bumo gbagba be nsaŋɛ na beeŋ kilgi n da bumo m mɔ, nɛ bumo be ata na e buri to.

english_verse: It is better to live right and be poor than to be sinful and rich.
translation_verse: Kebaa kɔ kebaawɔtɔ niŋiso nsaa la etirpo bɔ kebaala damawura nsaa la alubiworapo.

english_verse: The wicked will lose all of their power, but the Lord gives strength to everyone who is good.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ jija belubiworapo be eleŋ kikɛ; nseŋ sa bumo nɛ baa bɔla mbe ekpa niŋiso so na eleŋ.

english_verse: Those who obey the Lord are daily in his care, and what he has given them will be theirs forever.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e naa keni bekama nɛ baa wora mo kasonu so. Kusɔ kama nɛ mo alɛ sa bumo beeŋ baa la bumo peya mbaanaayɔ.

english_verse: They won't be in trouble when times are bad, and they will have plenty when food is scarce.
translation_verse: B maaŋ ji awurfoŋ jɛrbi be saŋɛ. Akoŋ be jemanɛ malɛ, bumo ere beeŋ baa kɔ ajibi yɛlyɛla so.

english_verse: Wicked people are enemies of the Lord and will vanish like smoke from a field on fire.
translation_verse: Ama belubiworapo, nɛ b la Ebɔrɛ mo doŋana na bre, beeŋ foe fanɛ kananɛ edishi bee shi edɛ to a lar a foe na.

english_verse: An evil person borrows and never pays back; a good person is generous and never stops giving.
translation_verse: Belubiworapo bee paŋ asɔ nna, nsaa kini keka. Ama basa nɛ baa wora asheŋ nɛ a niŋi na bre bee bugi kagbene nna a kɛ basa asɔ saŋkama.

english_verse: Everyone the Lord blesses will receive the land; everyone the Lord curses will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Basa nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛfa na, e naŋ ji kasawule ere so be tɔnɔ. Ama bekama nɛ Ebɔrɛ sho kɔnɔ na bre beeŋ mur.

english_verse: If you do what the Lord wants, he will make certain each step you take is sure.
translation_verse: Nɛ esa be asheŋ woraso baa fuli Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be kagbene; e bee ŋini mo kananɛ e beeŋ baa tia mbe aya nna.

english_verse: The Lord will hold your hand, and if you stumble, you still won't fall.
translation_verse: E fiti gba, e maaŋ tɔr; ŋkpal manɛ so, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ gbagba e naŋ pɛ mo to n yili.

english_verse: As long as I can remember, good people have never been left helpless, and their children have never gone begging for food.
translation_verse: Yili ma kebiato kikɛ m ba fo ma mbel to; m maŋ naŋ wu Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ka kplaŋ esa lela so; ŋko n wu esa lela be mbia ka ta kawie a na a kule ajibi.

english_verse: If you stop sinning and start doing right, you will keep living and be secure forever.
translation_verse: Yige asheŋ lubi be kebaawora; nseŋ fara a wora alelasheŋ. Saŋɛ na so fo kaman to ebi beeŋ nya kasawule ere so n chena mbaanaayɔ.

english_verse: The Lord loves justice, and he won't ever desert his faithful people. He always protects them, but destroys the children of the wicked.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee sha bekama nɛ baa wora asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so na nna. Mo alɛ maaŋ kplaŋ bekama nɛ baa ji kashenteŋ so. Enyɛnpe na beeŋ baa kuŋ bumo, ama e beeŋ mur belubiworapo bre be kaman to ebi.

english_verse: The wicked try to trap and kill good people,
translation_verse: Belubiworapo bre bee ŋana nna a fin basa lela nɛ b mɔ.

english_verse: but the Lord is on their side, and he will defend them when they are on trial.
translation_verse: Ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na wɔ basa lela kutɔ nna; nsaa beeŋ malga n sɔ bumo n yige; saŋɛ nɛ baŋ bar bumo demujikpa na.

english_verse: Trust the Lord and follow him. He will give you the land, and you will see the wicked destroyed.
translation_verse: Ta fo yirda n wɔtɔ Enyɛnpe na to, nsaa bɛ mo so. E beeŋ shin nɛ fo chena kasawule ere so n wu kananɛ belubiworapo beeŋ mur.

english_verse: I have seen brutal people abuse others and grow strong like trees in rich soil.
translation_verse: N wu amukpakpasowuraana ka puni basa n nyalɛ; fanɛ kananɛ ndibi bee daŋ a walɛ nɛnɛ ashi kasawule lela so na.

english_verse: Suddenly they disappeared! I looked, but they were gone and no longer there.
translation_verse: Ama k maaŋ chɛr ko nɛ b foe; nɛ ŋ keni nɛ b maaŋ naa wɔtɔ.

english_verse: Think of the bright future waiting for all the families of honest, innocent, and peace-loving people.
translation_verse: Keni, asheŋ lela bee jo basa nɛ baa ji kashenteŋ nsaa maa wora a foe; nsaa fin kayurwushi na be kaman to ebi nna.

english_verse: But not a trace will be left of the wicked or their families.
translation_verse: Ama alubiworapoana nɛ bumo be kaman to ebi kikɛ beeŋ mur.

english_verse: The Lord protects his people, and they can come to him in times of trouble.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e naa kuŋ mbe basa, nsaa mɔlga bumo tɔrɔ be saŋɛ.

english_verse: The Lord helps his people and saves them from the wicked because they run to him.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe na e naa mɔlga bumo; ashi alubiworapoana be enɔ to, ŋkpal b kaa bee fin kekuŋ ashi mo kutɔ so.

english_verse: When you are angry, Lord, please don't punish me or even correct me.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, sa maŋ nya agbo n fiɛ ma so, ŋko ŋ gberge ma kusoe.

english_verse: You shot me with your arrows, and you struck me with your hand.
translation_verse: Fo to ma fo atanyembi nseŋ ta fo enɔ ŋ ŋmɛa ma.

english_verse: My body hurts all over because of your anger. Even my bones are in pain, and my sins
translation_verse: Ma eyur kikɛ bee besa nna ŋkpal fo agbo so, nɛ mee nu ebesa ma awibi to,

english_verse: are so heavy that I am crushed.
translation_verse: nɛ ma alubi wora ma so egbɛ hale a buri ma to.

english_verse: Because of my foolishness, I am covered with sores that stink and spread.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal ma kawuli so, ma eyur kikɛ kɔ achuu nɛ a bɛ a dufɛ nna.

english_verse: My body is twisted and bent, and I groan all day long.
translation_verse: Ma eyur banto nna nɛ n nyɔŋ to a tekeŋto saŋkama.

english_verse: Fever has my back in flames, and I hurt everywhere.
translation_verse: Ma kaman bel edɛ nna a besa ma pelpelpel. Ma eyur kikɛ maŋ kɔ alenfia.

english_verse: I am worn out and weak, moaning and in distress.
translation_verse: Ma eyur kikɛ bɛa ma to nna, nɛ eleŋ fimbi kikɛ maŋ naa wɔ ma to.

english_verse: You, Lord, know every one of my deepest desires, and my noisy groans are no secret to you.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, fo nyi ma asheŋ tirso nɛ ma kushuto nɛ mee shuto kikɛ.

english_verse: My heart is beating fast. I feel weak all over, and my eyes are red.
translation_verse: Ma kagbene bee to nna pep pep pep, nɛ ma eleŋ kikɛ loge nɛ ma anishi ki m pere a maŋ naa wu.

english_verse: Because of my sickness, no friends or neighbors will come near me.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal ma achuu na so, n nekpaana nɛ ŋ kurgepoana bee gelge ma nna; hale n niopibiana gba maŋ naa taga ma to.

english_verse: All who want me dead set traps to catch me, and those who want to harm and destroy me plan and plot all day.
translation_verse: Bumo nɛ baa fin ma luwu bee sho ma ajigbelɛ nna; nɛ bumo nɛ baa fin ma nɛ b jija malɛ bee kre ma ŋkre lubi karechɛ kikɛ.

english_verse: I am not able to hear or speak a word;
translation_verse: Ŋ ki fanɛ kpawu nna, m maŋ naa nu. Ŋ ki fanɛ neemu nna, m maŋ naa tiŋ a malga.

english_verse: I am completely deaf and can't make a sound.
translation_verse: Ŋ ki kpawu nna nɛ ma kɔnɔ maaŋ naŋ tiŋ n tuge shɛŋ.

english_verse: I trust you, Lord God, and you will do something.
translation_verse: Fo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nɛ n yirda; amoso, jande wora kusɔ ko.

english_verse: I said, “Don't let them laugh or brag when I slip and fall.”
translation_verse: Sa maŋ shin nɛ b wora ma eyurto; ŋko a wu bumo be amu n wɔtɔ ma ŋkpal ŋ ka fɛrge n tɔr so.

english_verse: I am about to collapse from constant pain.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal ma eyur to be ebesa damta so, mee shin nɛ n lar n tɔr nna.

english_verse: I told you my sins, and I am sorry for them.
translation_verse: Ŋ kaŋɛ fo ma alubi kikɛ, nɛ kananɛ n tuba n lar amo to.

english_verse: Many deadly and powerful enemies hate me,
translation_verse: Bedoŋ lempo damta e kishi ma kenyanyaŋɛso.

english_verse: and they repay evil for good because I try to do right.
translation_verse: Baa ta kulubi nna a ka ma kelela be kukɔ, nsaa malga a gbiti ma ŋkpal ŋ kaa bee wora alela so.

english_verse: You are the Lord God! Stay nearby and don't desert me.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, sa maŋ kini ma n lɛ! N nyɛnpe, sa maŋ yɔ kufɔ ŋ ka ma.

english_verse: You are the one who saves me. Please hurry and help.
translation_verse: Fo e naa chɛ ma to saŋkama; Amoso jande wora manaŋ m mɔlga ma.

english_verse: I told myself, “I'll be careful not to sin by what I say, and I'll muzzle my mouth when evil people are near.”
translation_verse: Ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ meeŋ baa de so, nɛ ma kudonduloŋ maaŋ wora alubi. N yɛ, meeŋ kre ma kɔnɔ so, saŋɛ nɛ ma nɛ basa lubi wɔtɔ na.

english_verse: I kept completely silent, but it did no good, and I hurt even worse.
translation_verse: Ŋ ka loto n yili shruum a maa malga kelela na, nɛ ma eyur to be ebesa nɛ tɔrɔ na wora kishi n ti so.

english_verse: I felt a fire burning inside, and the more I thought, the more it burned, until at last I said:
translation_verse: Nɛ kewora fanɛ edɛ ka bee chɔɔ ma eyur to na. M baa fɛ kumo be asheŋ, k bee chɔɔ ma to ga nna. Ndoŋ nna nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ le:

english_verse: “Please, Lord, show me my future. Will I soon be gone?
translation_verse: “Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, jande ŋini ma kusɔ nɛ k beeŋ wora ma echefoso. Meeŋ wu naniere nna a?”

english_verse: You made my life short, so brief that the time means nothing to you. “Human life is but a breath,
translation_verse: Fo wora ma ŋkpa shiŋgblembi nna; nɛ nfɛ nɛ meeŋ ji maŋ la shɛŋ fo kutɔ. Dimɛdi be ŋkpa du fanɛ afu ka ber n choŋ nna.

english_verse: and it disappears like a shadow. Our struggles are senseless; we store up more and more, without ever knowing who will get it all.
translation_verse: K bee choŋ manaŋ manaŋ nna fanɛ kiyoyul na. Awurfoŋ nɛ anyee ji ere kikɛ la fuloŋ nna. Anyee fin asɔ nna a deŋi abar so a yili nsaa maŋ nyi esa nɛ e beeŋ ba ji amo be kapetɛ kachako so.

english_verse: “What am I waiting for? I depend on you, Lord!
translation_verse: Naniere, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, manɛ bre nɛ n naa fin? Ma tama deŋ fo so nna.

english_verse: Save me from my sins. Don't let fools sneer at me.
translation_verse: Mɔlga ma ashi ma alubi to. Jande, sa maŋ shin nɛ bewulpo e mushe ma.

english_verse: You treated me like this, and I kept silent, not saying a word.
translation_verse: Fo e shin nɛ n ji le be awurfoŋ n shin nɛ n loto a maŋ bugi kɔnɔ ŋ kaŋɛ shɛŋ na.

english_verse: “Won't you stop punishing me? You have worn me down.
translation_verse: Fo maaŋ yige kebaa gberge ma kusoe loŋ a? Ebɔl lar ma.

english_verse: You punish us severely because of our sins. Like a moth, you destroy what we treasure most. We are as frail as a breath.
translation_verse: Fee gberge dimɛdi kusoe alegaiso ŋkpal mbe alubi so nna. Fee jija anyi be asɔ lela nna fanɛ kananɛ elala bee jija asɔbuuso na. Dimɛdi du fanɛ afu ka ber n choŋ nna.

english_verse: “Listen, Lord, to my prayer! My eyes are flooded with tears, as I pray to you. I am merely a stranger visiting in your home as my ancestors did.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, jande, nu ma kekule. Nu ma kushu nseŋ chɛ ma to. Anishichubi e bɔlɔ ma anishi kikɛ to. N du fanɛ efɔ nna ashi fo kutɔ, fanɛ kananɛ n nananyɛnana daa la befɔ na.

english_verse: Stop being angry with me and let me smile again before I am dead and gone.”
translation_verse: Sa maŋ naŋ nya agbo n wɔtɔ ma, saŋɛ na so meeŋ nya kagbenefuli gbrɛbi pɔɛŋ nseŋ lar durnya ere to.

english_verse: I patiently waited, Lord, for you to hear my prayer. You listened
translation_verse: N ta kanyiti nna n jo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na fanɛ e chɛ ma to, nɛ e nu ma kekule nseŋ chɛ ma to.

english_verse: and pulled me from a lonely pit full of mud and mire. You let me stand on a rock with my feet firm,
translation_verse: K du fanɛ n daŋ tɔr kemaŋ chiŋgeliŋ nɛ depɔ bɔlɔ kumo to nna, nɛ e gberge ma n lara ashi kumo to. Nseŋ ta ma n yili kefalta so; kakpa nɛ m maaŋ naŋ nia.

english_verse: and you gave me a new song, a song of praise to you. Many will see this, and they will honor and trust you, the Lord God.
translation_verse: E sa ma kashɛ popɔr nna, nɛ m boŋ n fur mo, nɛ basa damta e wu kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na wora, nsaa ŋana mo; saŋɛ na so, baaŋ ta bumo be yirda n deŋi mo so.

english_verse: You bless all of those who trust you, Lord, and refuse to worship idols or follow false gods.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee nɛfa bekama nɛ b yirda mo nɛ bumo nɛ b maa shuŋ agbir nɛ a la asɔ fuloŋ na nna.

english_verse: You, Lord God, have done many wonderful things, and you have planned marvelous things for us. No one is like you! I would never be able to tell all you have done.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, fo wora emamachisheŋ damta. Ŋkre nɛ fo kɔ n sa anyi shi m pɔɔ anyi be nfɛra so. Esa kama maŋ du fanɛ fo. M maaŋ tiŋ ŋ kute fo asheŋ woraso kikɛ.

english_verse: Sacrifices and offerings are not what please you; gifts and payment for sin are not what you demand. But you made me willing to listen and obey.
translation_verse: Mannɛ basa be esarga nɛ ŋkɛ e naa bɔlɔ fo kenishi. Mannɛ esarga chɔɔso nɛ alubi be ketampaŋ be esarga nɛ amo be ŋkɛ nɛ fee fin. Ama kusɔ nɛ k tir fo kashenteŋto e la ŋ kaa beeŋ baa wora fo kasonu.

english_verse: And so, I said, “I am here to do what is written about me in the book, where it says,
translation_verse: Amoso nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ ma nde na. Meeŋ wora asheŋ nɛ b sibɛ n wɔtɔ fo mbra be kawɔl na to fanɛ m bɛ so na; Kumo e kaŋɛ le na:

english_verse: ‘I enjoy pleasing you. Your Law is in my heart.’ ”
translation_verse: “Kebaa wora fo aparsheŋ e naa fuli ma kagbene, amoso n ta fo mbra n wɔtɔ ma kagbene to nna.”

english_verse: When your people worshiped, you know I told them, “Our Lord always helps!”
translation_verse: Meeŋ kaŋɛ kananɛ fee mɔlga anyi saŋkama ashi fo basa be nshɛrgboŋ to. Enyɛnpe, fo nyi ŋ ka maaŋ lo ma kɔnɔ to kikɛ.

english_verse: When all your people met, I did not keep silent. I said, “Our Lord is kind. He is faithful and caring, and he saves us.”
translation_verse: M maŋ ta fo kumɔlga be asheŋ na n wɔtɔ n nawule be kagbene to nna na. Ŋ ji fo kumɔlga nɛ fo kashenteŋji nɛ fo kasha nɛ k maa chɛrga na be asheŋ be shɛda nna ashi fo basa be nshɛrgboŋ to.

english_verse: You, Lord, never fail to have pity on me; your love and faithfulness always keep me secure.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, n nyi fo ka maaŋ yige kebaawu ma kuwɔr. Fo kasha nɛ k maa chɛrga na nɛ fo kashenteŋji e naa kuŋ ma saŋkama.

english_verse: I have more troubles than I can count. My sins are all around me, and I can't find my way. My sins outnumber the hairs on my head, and I feel weak.
translation_verse: Ma etɔrɔsheŋ shi alegaiso nɛ ma alubi kulti ma n wɔtɔ kaplɛkama nɛ m maŋ naa nyi kusɔ nɛ meeŋ wora. Ma alubi shi a chɔ emin nɛ a wɔ ma kumu so gba, nɛ kumo be loŋ shin nɛ m pɔ aba.

english_verse: Please show that you care and come to my rescue. Hurry and help me!
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, jande, mɔlga ma. Ba chɛ ma to manaŋ.

english_verse: Disgrace and confuse all who want me dead; turn away and disgrace all who want to hurt me.
translation_verse: Wul basa nɛ baa fin ma nɛ b mɔ na be nfɛra to nseŋ shin nɛ b ji anishinyɔr. Shin nɛ bekama nɛ baa fin ma luwu na e sipa.

english_verse: Our Lord, let your worshipers rejoice and be glad. They love you for saving them, so let them always say, “The Lord is wonderful!”
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, shin nɛ bumo nɛ baa bunyaŋ fo na be ŋgbene e fuli bumo nɛ b ji eyur. Shin nɛ bekama nɛ baa sha fo kumɔlga na e baa kaŋɛ le saŋkama: “Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na shibi ga.”

english_verse: I am poor and needy, but, Lord God, you care about me, and you come to my rescue. Please hurry and help.
translation_verse: N la etirpo nɛ etentaŋasepo nna; m maaŋ tiŋ n wora shɛŋ. Ama ma asheŋ tir fo, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na. Fo e la ma emɔlgapo, amoso jande, nya manaŋ m ba mɔlga ma.

english_verse: You, Lord God, bless everyone who cares for the poor, and you rescue those people in times of trouble.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, fee nɛfa bekama nɛ baa chɛ betirpo to nna, nsaa mɔlga loŋ be basa tɔrɔ be saŋɛ so.

english_verse: You protect them and keep them alive. You make them happy here in this land, and you don't hand them over to their enemies.
translation_verse: Bumo be ŋkpa wɔ fo enɔ to nna nɛ fee kuŋ bumo saŋkikɛ. Fee shin nɛ bumo be ŋgbene bee fuli kasawule ere so nfe nna. Fo alɛ maa ta bumo a bɔɔ bumo doŋana enɔ.

english_verse: You always heal them and restore their strength when they are sick.
translation_verse: B baa lɔ fee leŋ bumo to nna nsaa chɛ bumo be alɔ.

english_verse: I prayed, “Have pity, Lord! Heal me, though I have sinned against you.”
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe, jande wu ma kuwɔr! Hale ŋ ka wora alubi n da fo so ere gba kikɛ, ta m paŋ ma.

english_verse: When visitors come, all they ever bring are worthless words, and when they leave, they spread gossip.
translation_verse: Bekama nɛ baa ba kaa bɔɔ ma so na, bee malga mmalga fuloŋ nawule nna. B baŋ naŋ laŋɛ a yɔ malɛ ŋkuli nɛ efɛ nɛ b kɔ a salga to a yɔ.

english_verse: My enemies whisper about me. They think the worst,
translation_verse: Bedoŋ baa kuli ma, nfɛra lubi nawule nɛ b kɔ a laŋɛ ma kaplɛa so;

english_verse: and they say, “You have some fatal disease! You'll never get well.”
translation_verse: a kaŋɛ fanɛ kulɔ mɔso e kɔ mo, amoso e maaŋ naŋ koso ashi kakpa nɛ e dese ere.

english_verse: My most trusted friend has turned against me, though he ate at my table.
translation_verse: Nteri kpakpasoana nɛ n yirda ga, nɛ b daa tu ma a ji gba pal kaman nna n sa ma.

english_verse: Have pity, Lord! Heal me, so I can pay them back.
translation_verse: Ama, Enyɛnpe, jande, fo ere e wu ma kuwɔr, n shin nɛ n niŋi to n wora bumo n tal to.

english_verse: Then my enemies won't defeat me, and I will know that you really care.
translation_verse: Sa maŋ shin nɛ ndoŋana e pɔɔ ma so, nɛ m pin fanɛ ma asheŋ bee bɔlɔ fo kenishi kashenteŋto.

english_verse: You have helped me because I am innocent, and you will always be close to my side.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal ŋ kaa bee wora asheŋ niŋiso so, feeŋ chɛ ma to, nseŋ shin nɛ m baa wɔ fo kutɔ saŋkama.

english_verse: You, the Lord God of Israel, will be praised forever! Amen and amen.
translation_verse: Kechɔrɔ e baa la Enyɛnpe Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na peya hale mbaanaayɔ. Amɛn.

english_verse: As a deer gets thirsty for streams of water, I truly am thirsty for you, my God.
translation_verse: Kananɛ achukoŋ bee pɛ chibir nɛ e bee yɛla kenishi to a fin eboŋ nɛ k kɔ nchu na, aloŋ nɛ mee fin fo Ebɔrɛ kenishipereso ashi ma kagbene to.

english_verse: In my heart, I am thirsty for you, the living God. When will I see your face?
translation_verse: Kananɛ achukoŋ bee pɛ esa nɛ e bee fin nchu na, aloŋ nɛ mee fin fo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ashi ma kagbene to. Saŋɛ mo nɛ meeŋ wu fo?

english_verse: Day and night my tears are my only food, as everyone keeps asking, “Where is your God?”
translation_verse: M ma anishichubi e ki ma kapa nɛ kanyɛ be ajibi. Nɛ saŋkama basa bee bishi ma fanɛ nnɛ nɛ fo Ebɔrɛ na wɔ.

english_verse: Sorrow floods my heart, when I remember leading the worshipers to your house. I can still hear them shout their joyful praises.
translation_verse: M baŋ nyiŋi kananɛ n daa juŋkpar basa nɛ baa bɛ abar so a yɔ fo bɔrɛlambu to nsaa cha awɔr a boŋ nshɛ kagbenefuliso a bunyaŋ fo na, ma kagbene bee jija alegaiso nna.

english_verse: Why am I discouraged? Why am I restless? I should trust you, Lord. I will praise you again because you help me,
translation_verse: Manɛ nna nɛ ma aba pɔ ma? Manɛ nna nɛ ma kagbene maŋ dese ma? Ŋ kraŋ yirda fo; ma alɛ kraŋ beeŋ di fo epaŋ ŋkpal fo ka chɛ ma to so.

english_verse: and you are my God. I am deeply discouraged, and so I think about you here where the Jordan begins at Mount Hermon and at Mount Mizar.
translation_verse: Fo e la ma Ebɔrɛ. M baŋ fɛ fo asheŋ ashi kakpa nɛ Jɔɔdan be lɔr na fara ashi abeegboŋ nɛ baa tre Hɛɛmɔn nɛ Miza na ase, ma aba bee pɔ ma nna.

english_verse: Your vicious waves have swept over me like an angry ocean or a roaring waterfall.
translation_verse: Fo agbo ba ma so nna fanɛ teku be nchu ka baga to m muni ma so na, ŋko nchu ka shi kebee be awɔlto a wurge waa waa na.

english_verse: Every day, you are kind, and at night you give me a song as my prayer to you, the God of my life.
translation_verse: Karechɛ kikɛ fee wora alela nna. Kanyɛso malɛ kikɛ fee sa ma kashɛ popɔr nna, a ŋini ma fo kasha nɛ k maa chɛrga na, nɛ k la ma kabɔrɛkule a yɔ fo kutɔ. Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, fo wɔ ŋkpa to nna.

english_verse: You are my mighty rock. Why have you forgotten me? Why must enemies mistreat me and make me sad?
translation_verse: Fo e du fanɛ kefalta a kuŋ ma. Manɛ nna nɛ fo teŋ ma so? Manɛ nna nɛ bedoŋ bee mɛaŋ ma, a shin nɛ ma kagbene maa fuli ma?

english_verse: Even my bones are in pain, while all day long my enemies sneer and ask, “Where is your God?”
translation_verse: Ma eyur to kikɛ bee besa ma nna nɛ bedoŋ bee wora ma eyurto a bishi fanɛ ma Ebɔrɛ na wɔ nnɛ?

english_verse: Why am I discouraged? Why am I restless? I trust you, Lord! And I will praise you again because you help me, and you are my God.
translation_verse: Manɛ nna nɛ ma aba pɔ ma? Manɛ nna nɛ ma kagbene maŋ dese ma? Ŋ kraŋ yirda fo; ma alɛ kraŋ beeŋ di fo epaŋ ŋkpal fo ka chɛ ma to so. Fo e la ma Ebɔrɛ.

english_verse: Show that I am right, God! Defend me against everyone who doesn't know you; rescue me from each of those deceitful liars.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe, ŋini fanɛ m maŋ wora n jija! Malga ŋ kuŋ ma ashi basa nɛ b maŋ nyi fo na kutɔ. Mɔlga ma ashi befɛpo nɛ b kɔ amu kpakpaso na kutɔ.

english_verse: I run to you for protection. Why do you turn me away? Why must enemies mistreat me and make me sad?
translation_verse: Fo e la ma ekumpo lempo; manɛ nna nɛ fee ju ma a lɛ? Sa maŋ shin bedoŋ e baa mɛaŋ ma n shin nɛ ma kagbene e baa jija.

english_verse: Then I will worship at your altar because you make me joyful. You are my God, and I will praise you. Yes, I will praise you as I play my harp.
translation_verse: Saŋɛ na so meeŋ ya bunyaŋ fo ashi fo bɔrɛsure na ase, ŋkpal fo ka sa ma kagbenefuli gboŋgboŋi so so. Meeŋ ta ma jaŋjilaŋ n laŋ m maŋkura fo, ma Ebɔrɛ na.

english_verse: Why am I discouraged? Why am I restless? I trust you, Lord! And I will praise you again because you help me, and you are my God.
translation_verse: Manɛ nna nɛ ma aba pɔ ma? Manɛ nna nɛ ma kagbene maŋ dese ma? Ŋ kraŋ yirda fo, ma alɛ kraŋ beeŋ di fo epaŋ ŋkpal fo ka chɛ ma to so. Fo alɛ e la ma Ebɔrɛ.

english_verse: Our God, our ancestors told us what wonders you worked and we listened carefully.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe anyi be Ebɔrɛ, an nananyɛnana kaŋɛ anyi kusɔ nɛ fo wora dra dra na. Nɛ anyi alɛ kaŋ asoe n nu,

english_verse: You chased off the nations by causing them trouble with your powerful arm. Then you let our ancestors take over their land.
translation_verse: kananɛ fo ta fo eleŋ n ju basa nɛ b daa wɔ efuli ere so dra dra na, nseŋ shin nɛ an nananyɛnana sɔ kasawule ere nɛ kananɛ fo shin nɛ asheŋ nite nɛnɛ n sa bumo.

english_verse: Their strength and weapons were not what won the land and gave them victory! You loved them and fought with your powerful arm and your shining glory.
translation_verse: Mannɛ bumo gbagba be eleŋ nɛ akɔsɔ e daŋ shin nɛ b sɔ kasawule ere, ŋko n shin nɛ b kɔ m pɔɔ so. Ama ŋkpal fo kagbene ka fuli bumo so so, nɛ fo chɛ bumo to nɛ b kɔ m pɔɔ bumo doŋana so.

english_verse: You are my God and King, and you give victory to the people of Jacob.
translation_verse: Fo e la ma Ebɔrɛ nɛ ma ewura; fo e shin nɛ Israɛlebi kɔ m pɔɔ so.

english_verse: By your great power, we knocked our enemies down and trampled on them.
translation_verse: Fo eleŋgboŋ na e shin nɛ an ŋmɛa an doŋana n lɛ nseŋ chichi bumo so.

english_verse: I don't depend on my arrows or my sword to save me.
translation_verse: M maŋ ta ma yirda n deŋi ma keta ŋko ma tokobi so, fanɛ amo e naŋ mɔlga ma ashi bedoŋ be enɔ to.

english_verse: But you saved us from our hateful enemies, and you put them to shame.
translation_verse: Fo nɛ n yirda fanɛ feeŋ shin nɛ ŋ kɔ m pɔɔ bedoŋ so n shin nɛ anishinyɔr e pɛ bumo nɛ b kishi anyi na.

english_verse: We boast about you, our God, and we are always grateful.
translation_verse: Fo anyi be Ebɔrɛ na so nɛ anyee ji njɔŋ nsaa fur fo ketre saŋkama.

english_verse: But now you have rejected us; you don't lead us into battle, and we look foolish.
translation_verse: Ama naniere, fo pal kaman n sa anyi n shin nɛ an ki bebɔlpo. Fo maŋ naa tu anyi be benapo a yɔ kena to.

english_verse: You made us retreat, and our enemies have taken everything we own.
translation_verse: Fo shin nɛ an bɛta n shile an doŋana be anishito nɛ b ba muu anyi be asɔ.

english_verse: You let us be slaughtered like sheep, and you scattered us among the nations.
translation_verse: Fo yige anyi nna nɛ an ki fanɛ asɔbɔya nɛ basa bee mɔ a ji, nseŋ pesaŋ anyi to n wɔtɔ efuli pɔtɛana to.

english_verse: You sold your people for little or nothing, and you earned no profit.
translation_verse: K du fanɛ fo maŋ fa fo basa yawu kpakpaso, amoso fo maŋ nya tɔnɔ kikɛ.

english_verse: You made us look foolish to our neighbors; people who live nearby insult us and sneer.
translation_verse: Fo shin nɛ an ki basa fuloŋ ashi an braana be anishito nna. Nseŋ shin nɛ anyi be bechenashapo bee wora anyi amɔmɔshiasheŋ nsaa keni anyi jiga.

english_verse: I am embarrassed every day, and I blush with shame.
translation_verse: Sipa wɔ ma so kachɛ kama nna, nɛ mee ji anishinyɔr saŋkama.

english_verse: But others mock and sneer, as they watch my enemies take revenge on me.
translation_verse: Bedoŋ bee bishi ma kuwule nna, nɛ basa bee jule a keni ma nsaa wora ma eyurto.

english_verse: All this happened to us, though we didn't forget you or break our agreement.
translation_verse: An maŋ teŋ fo so, ŋko n lar anyi nɛ fo be kɔnɔ koŋwule be ŋkre na to. Ama asheŋ ere kikɛ tu anyi.

english_verse: We always kept you in mind and followed your teaching.
translation_verse: An maŋ lar fo kaman, ŋko ŋ kplaŋ fo keŋini so.

english_verse: We did not forget you or lift our hands in prayer to foreign gods.
translation_verse: An daŋ teŋ fo so nna, nseŋ ya kaa bunyaŋ efuli pɔtɛana so be agbirana,

english_verse: You would have known it because you discover every secret thought.
translation_verse: fo daŋ beeŋ pin; ŋkpal manɛ so, fo nyi kagbene to be ashiri kikɛ.

english_verse: We face death all day for you. We are like sheep on their way to be slaughtered.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal fo so anyee luri luwu to nna saŋkikɛ. An du fanɛ mbolpɔ nɛ b gberge a yɔ nɛ b ya mɔ nna.

english_verse: Wake up! Do something, Lord! Why are you sleeping? Don't desert us forever.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, jande ba chɛ anyi to. Wora kusɔ ko. Sa maŋ kini anyi n lɛ.

english_verse: Why do you keep looking away? Don't forget our sufferings and all our troubles.
translation_verse: Manɛ nna nɛ fo ŋana anyi so, nseŋ teŋ anyi be awurfoŋ nɛ kamɛaŋ so?

english_verse: We are flat on the ground, holding on to the dust.
translation_verse: Bedoŋ pɔɔ anyi so cheche nɛ an tɔr kasawule a dese shishɛr to.

english_verse: Do something! Help us! Show how kind you are and come to our rescue.
translation_verse: Jande wora kusɔ ko n chɛ anyi to. Mɔlga anyi ŋkpal fo kasha nɛ k maa chɛrga na so.

english_verse: My thoughts are filled with beautiful words for the king, and I will use my voice as a writer would use pen and ink.
translation_verse: Ŋ kɔ mmalga lela ma nfɛra to nɛ n sa ewura. Meeŋ ta ma kudonduloŋ m boŋ amo fanɛ kananɛ esibɛpo lela bee ta kelembi a sibɛ na.

english_verse: No one is as handsome as you! Your words are always kind. That is why God will always bless you.
translation_verse: Enyɛn kikɛ maŋ walɛ keyɛrbi fanɛ fo. Mmalga belbelso nawule e naa shi fo kɔnɔ to. Amoso nɛ Ebɔrɛ bee nɛfa fo.

english_verse: and ride out in splendor! Win victories for truth and mercy and justice. Do fearsome things with your powerful arm.
translation_verse: Nseŋ dii fo kediiso bunyaŋ so ŋ kɔ m pɔɔ so a laŋɛ kashenteŋ nɛ kuwɔrwu nɛ keji asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so be kaplɛa so. Ta fo enɔjiso lempo na n wora asheŋ nɛ a bee mɔ kɔnɔ.

english_verse: Send your sharp arrows through enemy hearts and make all nations fall at your feet.
translation_verse: Shin nɛ fo atanyembi pelpelso na e da ewura mo doŋana be ŋgbene to. Shin nɛ efuli pɔtɛana so ebi e tɔr fo aya ase.

english_verse: You are God, and you will rule forever as king. Your royal power brings about justice.
translation_verse: Kuwurji nɛ Ebɔrɛ sa fo na beeŋ baa wɔtɔ mbaanaayɔ. Nɛ fo baa ji basa be asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so.

english_verse: You love justice and hate evil. And so, your God chose you and made you happier than any of your friends.
translation_verse: Fee sha asɔ nɛ a niŋi ekpa nna nseŋ ŋ kishi alubi. Amoso nɛ fo Ebɔrɛ lara fo, nseŋ sa fo kagbenefuli nɛ k chɔ fo braana peya na.

english_verse: The sweet aroma of the spices myrrh, aloes, and cassia covers your royal robes. You enjoy the music of harps in palaces decorated with ivory.
translation_verse: Etulale lela dufɛso nɛ baa tre mir nɛ alowe na be efɛa a wɔ fo asɔbuuso so, nɛ baa laŋ ejaŋjilaŋ nɛ alaŋsɔ a deŋi fo anishito ashi fo lambu nɛ b ta ejebotenyi n ji kumo kebita na to.

english_verse: Daughters of kings are here, and your bride stands at your right side, wearing a wedding gown trimmed with pure gold.
translation_verse: Bewura be mbichesobi e wɔ fo lambu to, nɛ eche nɛ fee shin nɛ fo ta na wɔtɔ shuwa be abitasɔ a yil fo kuwurputi be jisoso.

english_verse: Bride of the king, listen carefully to me. Forget your own people and your father's family.
translation_verse: Eche nɛ ewura bee shin nɛ e ta na, e kaŋ kusoe n nu. Teŋ fo basa nɛ fo tuto be laŋ to ebi so.

english_verse: with precious treasures. Your bride, my king, has inward beauty, and her wedding gown is woven with threads of gold.
translation_verse: Ma ewura, eche nɛ fee shin nɛ fo ta na be kebita shi mbe kagbene to nna. Shuwa be ejesebi nɛ b ta n jɔ mbe kejafɔ to be kale.

english_verse: Wearing the finest garments, she is brought to you, followed by her young friends, the bridesmaids.
translation_verse: Kale nɛ b jɔ nɛnɛ nɛ e buu, nɛ b keta mo m bar fo, nɛ mo teriana nɛ b la etumbache bɛ mo so m ba fo kutɔ.

english_verse: Everyone is excited, as they follow you to the royal palace.
translation_verse: Nɛ b ta kagbenefuli m bɛ fo so n luri ewura be laŋ to.

english_verse: Your sons and your grandsons will also be kings as your ancestors were. You will make them rulers everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Fo mbinyɛnsobi nɛ fo nanabiana beeŋ ba ki bewura fanɛ fo nananyɛnana. Feeŋ ta bumo ŋ ki bejuŋkparpo durnya be kaplɛkama.

english_verse: I will make your name famous from now on, and you will be praised forever and ever.
translation_verse: Yili kabre a yɔ meeŋ shin nɛ fo ketre e dii nɛ ekama e baa fur fo saŋkama mbaanaayɔ.

english_verse: God is our mighty fortress, always ready to help in times of trouble.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ e la anyi be ekumpogboŋ saŋkikɛ, nsaa sa anyi eleŋ. Mo e wɔtɔ saŋkama a chɛ anyi to tɔrɔ be jemanɛ.

english_verse: And so, we won't be afraid! Let the earth tremble and the mountains tumble into the deepest sea.
translation_verse: Amoso hale nɛ kasawule gbuŋgbuŋ to nɛ abeegboŋ tia n tɔr teku be kakpa chiŋgeliŋ gba, kufu maŋ kɔ anyi.

english_verse: Let the ocean roar and foam, and its raging waves shake the mountains.
translation_verse: Hale teku bee baga to a kaa apɔpɔ a gbuŋgbuŋ abeegboŋ a lɛ gba,

english_verse: A river and its streams bring joy to the city, which is the sacred home of God Most High.
translation_verse: eboŋ ko wɔtɔ nna a shile boeŋ boeŋ, a bar kagbenefuli ashi Ebɔrɛ be kadegboŋ cheembi nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na wɔ kumo be basa to na so.

english_verse: God is in that city, and it won't be shaken. He will help it at dawn.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal Ebɔrɛ ka wɔ kadegboŋ na to so, shɛŋ shɛŋ maa gbuŋgbuŋ kumo. Kachipurdidi kikɛ e bee chɛ kumo to nna.

english_verse: Nations rage! Kingdoms fall! But at the voice of God the earth itself melts.
translation_verse: Nɛ efuli pɔtɛana bee baga to, nɛ kuwurjiana bee tɔr, nɛ Ebɔrɛ ponte nɛ kasawule ŋalga gba,

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful is with us. The God of Jacob is our fortress.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na wɔ anyi kutɔ nna. Ebɔrɛ nɛ an nananyɛn Jeekɔb shuŋ na e la anyi be ekumpogboŋ.

english_verse: Come! See the fearsome things the Lord has done on earth.
translation_verse: Ba keni kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ wora. E wora asheŋ gboŋgboŋi ashi durnya to kikɛ.

english_verse: God brings wars to an end all over the world. He breaks the arrows, shatters the spears, and burns the shields.
translation_verse: E shin nɛ kena loge durnya to. E buri benapo be atanyembi nɛ akpa to nseŋ chɔɔ bumo be asɔ kuŋso kikɛ.

english_verse: Our God says, “Calm down, and learn that I am God! All nations on earth will honor me.”
translation_verse: E yɛ: “Wushi eyur boeŋ, feeŋ wu fanɛ ma e la Ebɔrɛ! Durnya to be efuliana so ebi kikɛ malɛ beeŋ maŋkura ma.”

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful is with us. The God of Jacob is our fortress.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na wɔ anyi kutɔ. An nananyɛn Jeekɔb be Ebɔrɛ na e la anyi be ekumpogboŋ.

english_verse: All of you nations, clap your hands and shout joyful praises to God.
translation_verse: Menyi efuliana na be basa kikɛ e kpla enɔ, nseŋ ponte kagbenefuliso n di Ebɔrɛ epaŋ.

english_verse: The Lord Most High is fearsome, the ruler of all the earth.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na be asheŋ woraso kɔ mamachi nɛ kufu nna. Mo e la ewurgboŋ, a ji durnya kikɛ so kuwura.

english_verse: God has put every nation under our power,
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ na e shin nɛ an pɔɔ efuli kikɛ so nsaa ji amo so eleŋ.

english_verse: and he chose for us the land that was the pride of Jacob, his favorite.
translation_verse: Mo e lara kasawule nɛ an nananyɛn Jeekɔb, nɛ e bee sha ga na bee puchi so na, n sa anyi.

english_verse: Sing praises to God our King,
translation_verse: Men boŋ nshɛ n di an be ewura Ebɔrɛ epaŋ.

english_verse: the ruler of all the earth! Praise God with songs.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so mo, e la durnya kikɛ be ewura nna. Amoso men boŋ nshɛ n di mo epaŋ.

english_verse: God rules the nations from his sacred throne.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ tase mbe kuwurputi cheembi so nna a ji durnya kikɛ so kuwura.

english_verse: Their leaders come together and are now the people of Abraham's God. All rulers on earth surrender their weapons, and God is greatly praised!
translation_verse: Durnya be bejuŋkparpo kikɛ ba abar so nna m ba ki an nananyɛn Eebraham be Ebɔrɛ na be basa. Durnya to be bewura kikɛ la Ebɔrɛ peya nna. Kemaŋkura e baa la Ebɔrɛ na peya.

english_verse: The Lord God is wonderful! He deserves all praise in the city where he lives. His holy mountain,
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na shi nseŋ daga an ka fur mo ga ashi kadegboŋ nɛ e wɔ kumo to nɛ k tase mbe kebeegboŋ cheembi nɛ baa tre Zayɔn na so na.

english_verse: beautiful and majestic, brings joy to all on earth. Mount Zion, truly sacred, is home for the Great King.
translation_verse: Mbe kebeegboŋ cheembi na du jeŋgreŋ nna nsaa walɛ. Nɛ Ebɔrɛ Ewurgboŋ nɛ e wɔ kumo so na bee sa durnya to be basa kikɛ kagbenefuli.

english_verse: God is there to defend it and has proved to be its protector.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ na e wɔ kumo so a kuŋ kumo. E shin nɛ basa pin fanɛ, mo Ebɔrɛ na e la kadegboŋ na be ekumpo.

english_verse: Kings joined forces to attack the city,
translation_verse: Bewura chala abar m ba nɛ b ba kɔ kadegboŋ na kena,

english_verse: but when they saw it, they were terrified and ran away.
translation_verse: ama b ka wu kumo nɛ kufu pɛ bumo ga nɛ b shile.

english_verse: We had heard about it, and now we have seen it in the city of our God, the Lord All-Powerful. This is the city that God will let stand forever.
translation_verse: An daŋ nu kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na wora, ama naniere an wu kumo ashi Enyɛnpetale anyi be Ebɔrɛ na be kadegboŋ nɛ baa tre Jerusalɛm na to. Mo alɛ beeŋ baa kuŋ kumo saŋkama.

english_verse: You are famous and praised everywhere on earth, as you win victories with your powerful arm.
translation_verse: Fo asheŋ woraso niŋi saŋkama nna, nɛ fo ketre dii nɛ basa bee fur fo ashi durnya ere be kaplɛkama.

english_verse: Mount Zion will celebrate, and all Judah will be glad, because you bring justice.
translation_verse: Amoso Jerusalɛm nɛ Juda be ndeana to ebi be ŋgbene fuli bumo nna ŋkpal fo kaa bee ji asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so so.

english_verse: Let's walk around Zion and count its towers.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ be basa, men nite ŋ kulti Jerusalɛm ŋ karga kumo be atempreŋ jeŋgreŋ.

english_verse: We will see its strong walls and visit each fortress. Then you can say to future generations,
translation_verse: Men keni kumo be egbal lempo nɛ kumo be ekuŋkpa lempoana na. Saŋɛ na so menyeeŋ tiŋ ŋ kaŋɛ men be kaman to ebi le:

english_verse: “Our God is like this forever and will always guide us.”
translation_verse: “Ebɔrɛ ere e la anyi be Ebɔrɛ mbaanaayɔ. Mo alɛ beeŋ baa juŋkpar anyi saŋkama.”

english_verse: Everyone on this earth, now listen to what I say!
translation_verse: Esa kama nɛ e wɔ durnya to, e kaŋ kusoe n nu kusɔ nɛ mee kaŋɛ ere.

english_verse: Listen, no matter who you are, rich or poor.
translation_verse: Kanaŋkama nɛ fo du, nɛ fo la etirpo ŋko damawura nna, fo kaŋ kusoe n nu.

english_verse: I speak words of wisdom, and my thoughts make sense.
translation_verse: Kanyiasheŋ be mmalga nɛ mee malga, nɛ kusɔ nɛ mee kaŋɛ malɛ kɔ kifito.

english_verse: I have in mind a mystery that I will explain while playing my harp.
translation_verse: Aŋasa nɛ mee shin nɛ m bɔ, ama meeŋ ŋini amo be afito saŋɛ nɛ mee laŋ jaŋjilaŋ na.

english_verse: Why should I be afraid in times of trouble, when I am surrounded by vicious enemies?
translation_verse: Saŋɛ nɛ kenishipere tu ma, ŋko saŋɛ nɛ bedoŋ fɛpo kulti ma n wɔtɔ na, m maaŋ baa lɔ kufu.

english_verse: They trust in their riches and brag about all their wealth.
translation_verse: Bumo ere yirda asɔ nɛ b kɔ nna nsaa puchi ŋkpal bumo be kedamaya so.

english_verse: It costs far too much to buy back your life. You can never pay God enough
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, ŋkpa be yawu du kpakpa ga. Esa maaŋ tiŋ ŋ ka Ebɔrɛ kumo be kukɔ,

english_verse: to stay alive forever and safe from death.
translation_verse: nseŋ nya a wɔ ŋkpa to mbaanaayɔ; ŋko nɛ e maaŋ wu kikɛ.

english_verse: We see that wise people die, and so do stupid fools. Then their money is left for someone else.
translation_verse: Anyee wu benyiashempo nɛ bewulpo kikɛ ka bee wu; nɛ basa pɔtɛ e ta bumo be asɔ.

english_verse: The grave will be their home forever and ever, although they once had land of their own.
translation_verse: Hale b daa kɔ bumo gbagba be nsawule gba, nchaŋ e naŋ ki bumo pe mbaanaayɔ, nɛ b baa wɔ ndoŋ saŋkama.

english_verse: Our human glory disappears, and, like animals, we die.
translation_verse: Anyi edimɛdi be eyilikpa maa chɛr nsaa loge nɛ an wu, fanɛ kananɛ kusɔbɔya bee wu na.

english_verse: Here is what happens to fools and to those who trust the words of fools:
translation_verse: Kusɔ nɛ k dese a jo bekama nɛ b yirda bumo gbagba be amu nɛ kusɔ nɛ bumo be beyaasepo bee kaŋɛ bumo na nna na.

english_verse: They are like sheep with death as their shepherd, leading them to the grave. In the morning God's people will walk all over them, as their bodies lie rotting in their home, the grave.
translation_verse: B du fanɛ mbolpɔ nna nɛ luwu bee kpa bumo a yɔ bumo be nchaŋ to. Ebɔrɛ be basa e naŋ ji bumo so kuwura chipurso nɛ bumo be eyurana e baa dese nchaŋ to a bɛ.

english_verse: But God will rescue me from the power of death.
translation_verse: Ama Ebɔrɛ beeŋ mɔlga ma ere ashi nchaŋ to n ta ma n yɔ mo kutɔ.

english_verse: Don't let it bother you when others get rich and live in luxury.
translation_verse: Saŋ maŋ shin nɛ beko be kebaala damawuraana, a ji bumo be amu na e tir fo.

english_verse: Soon they will die and all their wealth will be left behind.
translation_verse: K maaŋ chɛr nɛ b wu nseŋ yige bumo be asɔ na kikɛ.

english_verse: We humans are praised when we do well, and all of us are glad to be alive.
translation_verse: Nɛ dimɛdi baa kɔ ŋkpa, nɛ asheŋ bee nite nɛnɛ a sa mo nɛ basa bee fur mo, k bee wora mo ebel nna.

english_verse: But we each will go down to our ancestors, never again to see the light of day.
translation_verse: Ama an kikɛ beeŋ ya tu an nananyɛnana, nsaa maaŋ naŋ wu karechɛ be kefulto kikɛ.

english_verse: Our human glory disappears, and, like animals, we die.
translation_verse: Dimɛdi be eyilikpa kikɛ beeŋ choŋ, nɛ e wu fanɛ kusɔbɔya na.

english_verse: From east to west, the powerful Lord God has been calling together everyone on earth.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ, elempo na, bee tre durnya to be basa kikɛ nɛ b wɔ epeŋitɔrkpa nɛ epeŋilarkpa na nna fanɛ b shɛr.

english_verse: Our God approaches, but not silently; a flaming fire comes first, and a storm surrounds him.
translation_verse: Anyi be Ebɔrɛ na bee ba, nɛ an nu mbe egbri, nɛ edɛ be adondulombi juŋkpar mo, nɛ afugboŋ lempo kulti mo n wɔtɔ.

english_verse: God comes to judge his people. He shouts to the heavens and to the earth,
translation_verse: E tre esoso nɛ kasawule kikɛ fanɛ eshɛdajipo nna, nɛ b keni kananɛ e bee ji mbe basa demu.

english_verse: The heavens announce, “God is the judge, and he is always honest.”
translation_verse: Esoso bee ŋini anyi nna fanɛ Ebɔrɛ bee ji basa be asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so nna.

english_verse: My people, I am God! Israel, I am your God. Listen to my charges against you.
translation_verse: Ma basa, men nu. Israɛlebi, menyi be Ebɔrɛ na bee ji demu nna a gbiti menyi.

english_verse: I won't accept your offerings of bulls and goats.
translation_verse: Mannɛ men be egbolu nɛ mboe nɛ a shibi a wɔ men be aluu to nɛ mee sha.

english_verse: Every animal in the forest belongs to me, and so do the cattle on a thousand hills.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, kupuŋ to be kusɔbɔya kikɛ la meya nna, aloŋ e la ana nɛ a wɔ abee kagboŋ so na gba.

english_verse: I know all the birds in the mountains, and every wild creature is in my care.
translation_verse: N nyi mbuibi nɛ a wɔ abeegboŋ so kikɛ, nɛ kusɔ toso kikɛ la meya.

english_verse: If I were hungry, I wouldn't tell you, because I own the world and everything in it.
translation_verse: Nɛ akoŋ kɔ ma gba m maaŋ kaŋɛ menyi, ŋkpal manɛ so, durnya nɛ kusɔ kama nɛ k wɔ kumo to kikɛ la meya nna.

english_verse: I don't eat the meat of bulls or drink the blood of goats.
translation_verse: M maa we egbolu be eblaŋ ŋko a nuu mboe be ŋklaŋ.

english_verse: I am God Most High! The only sacrifice I want is for you to be thankful and to keep your word.
translation_verse: Ma e la Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na. Kechɔrɔ, nɛ k baa nase nnɔ nsaa bɛ amo so be esarga nɛ mee sha.

english_verse: Pray to me in time of trouble. I will rescue you, and you will honor me.
translation_verse: Men shu n tre ma ashi men be etɔrɔ to nɛ n mɔlga menyi, nɛ men bunyaŋ ma.

english_verse: But to the wicked I say: “You don't have the right to mention my laws or claim to keep our agreement!
translation_verse: Ama mee kaŋɛ alubiworapo bre nna fanɛ, e maŋ kɔ ekpa nɛ e malga ma mbra na be asheŋ ŋko n ji ma kɔnɔ naseso be ŋkre na be asheŋ.

english_verse: You refused correction and rejected my commands.
translation_verse: Men kini ma keŋini nsaa kplaŋ ma mbra so.

english_verse: You made friends with every crook you met, and you liked people who break their wedding vows.
translation_verse: Beyu nɛ basa lubi nɛ menyee ji keteri nsaa sha basa nɛ b maa bɛ bumo be kakil to be nnɔ naseso so.

english_verse: You talked only about violence and told nothing but lies;
translation_verse: Asheŋ lubi be kewora nawule be bare nɛ menyee bir; men be mmalga malɛ kikɛ la efɛ nna.

english_verse: you sat around gossiping, ruining the reputation of your own relatives.”
translation_verse: Men tase nna a kuli men kurgepoana nsaa jija men niopibiana gbagba be atre.

english_verse: When you did all this, I didn't say a word, and you thought, “God is just like us!” But now I will accuse you.
translation_verse: Men ka wora ade kikɛ, m maŋ bugi kɔnɔ, nɛ men fɛ fanɛ ma Ebɔrɛ gba du fanɛ menyi nna. Ama naniere bre meeŋ malga ŋ gbiti menyi ashi men be anishito.

english_verse: You have ignored me! So pay close attention or I will tear you apart, and no one can help you.
translation_verse: Men kplaŋ ma so, amoso men kaŋ kusoe n nu nfe, nɛ mannɛ aloŋ meeŋ mur menyi nɛ esa kama maaŋ chɛ menyi to.

english_verse: The sacrifice that honors me is a thankful heart. Obey me, and I, your God, will show my power to save.
translation_verse: Sarga nɛ k bee bar ma kemaŋkura e la kagbene nɛ k bee ji a chɔrɔ. Men wora ma kasonu nɛ ma, menyi be Ebɔrɛ na e ŋini menyi kumɔlga be ekpa.

english_verse: You are kind, God! Please have pity on me. You are always merciful! Please wipe away my sins.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, wu ma kuwɔr ŋkpal fo kasha nɛ k maa loge na so. Kpra ma alubi ŋkpal fo kuwɔrwu na so.

english_verse: Wash me clean from all of my sin and guilt.
translation_verse: Fɔr ma alubi nɛ ma kewora n da so kikɛ nɛ n nyalɛ so.

english_verse: I know about my sins, and I cannot forget the burden of my guilt.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, n nyi ma alubi kikɛ be asheŋ. Ma alɛ maaŋ teŋ asheŋ lubi nɛ n wora na so kikɛ.

english_verse: You are really the one I have sinned against; I have disobeyed you and have done wrong. So it is right and fair for you to correct and punish me.
translation_verse: Kashenteŋto, fo nɛ n wora n da so. N wora n jija ŋkpal ŋ ka kini kewora fo kasonu so. Amoso k daga nna nsaa walɛ fanɛ fo gberge ma kusoe n niŋi ma ekpa.

english_verse: I have sinned and done wrong since the day I was born.
translation_verse: Kachɛ nɛ b kurge ma na kikɛ nɛ n la alubiworapo.

english_verse: But you want complete honesty, so teach me true wisdom.
translation_verse: Kashenteŋ nawule nɛ fo ere bee sha. Amoso ŋini ma kashenteŋ be kanyiasheŋ.

english_verse: Wash me with hyssop until I am clean and whiter than snow.
translation_verse: Ta hisɔp n fɔr ma so nɛ n nyalɛ so n fuli fanɛ ateebi.

english_verse: Let me be happy and joyful! You crushed my bones, now let them celebrate.
translation_verse: Shin nɛ ma kagbene e fuli nɛ n ji eyur. Fo daŋ shin nɛ ma eyur buri ma nna ama naniere, shin nɛ n ji ma kumu.

english_verse: Turn your eyes from my sin and cover my guilt.
translation_verse: Kplaŋ ma alubi so nseŋ da m buu ma kewora n da so so.

english_verse: Create pure thoughts in me and make me faithful again.
translation_verse: Shin nɛ n nya nfɛra niŋiso nseŋ shin nɛ n naa ji kashenteŋ.

english_verse: Don't chase me away from you or take your Holy Spirit away from me.
translation_verse: Sa maŋ ju ma ashi fo anishito. Ŋko n lara fo kiyoyu cheembi na ashi ma to.

english_verse: Make me as happy as you did when you saved me; make me want to obey!
translation_verse: Shin nɛ ma kagbene e naŋ fuli ma fanɛ kananɛ k daa du saŋɛ so nɛ fo mɔlga ma na; nseŋ shin nɛ n naa sha kebaawora fo kasonu.

english_verse: I will teach sinners your Law, and they will return to you.
translation_verse: Nɛ n ŋini alubiworapoana fo mbra nɛ b bɛta m ba fo kutɔ.

english_verse: Keep me from any deadly sin. Only you can save me! Then I will shout and sing about your power to save.
translation_verse: Mɔlga ma ashi kamɔ be kulubi to. Ŋkpal manɛ so, fo nawule e naŋ tiŋ m mɔlga ma. Saŋɛ na so meeŋ boŋ kashɛ awɔrso ŋ kaŋɛ fo kumɔlga be eleŋ na be asheŋ.

english_verse: Help me to speak, and I will praise you, Lord.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, bugi ma kɔnɔ nɛ n fur fo.

english_verse: Offerings and sacrifices are not what you want.
translation_verse: Esarga nɛ etoto daa bɔlɔ fo kenishi nna, n daa beeŋ bar fo amo.

english_verse: The way to please you is to be truly sorry deep in our hearts. This is the kind of sacrifice you won't refuse.
translation_verse: Esa be kagbene be kejija mo ga ŋkpal alubi so e naa bɔlɔ fo kenishi.

english_verse: Please be willing, Lord, to help the city of Zion and to rebuild its walls.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, jande, shin nɛ asheŋ e nyalɛ Zayɔn to, nɛ b pɔr Jerusalɛm be egbal na.

english_verse: Then you will be pleased with the proper sacrifices, and we will offer bulls on your altar once again.
translation_verse: Saŋɛ na so baaŋ lara esarga cheembi nɛ esarga chɔɔso nɛ a bee par fo, nseŋ ta egbolu n lara sarga n sa fo.

english_verse: You people may be strong and brag about your sins, but God can be trusted day after day.
translation_verse: Feeŋ tiŋ a la elempo nsaa ji njɔŋ ŋkpal fo alubi so. Ama esa beeŋ tiŋ n yirda Ebɔrɛ saŋkama.

english_verse: You plan brutal crimes, and your lying words cut like a sharp razor.
translation_verse: Asheŋ lubi nɛ fee kre saŋkikɛ; fo kudonduloŋ fɛpo na bee ji fanɛ bɔrfɔ nna.

english_verse: You would rather do evil than good, and tell lies than speak the truth.
translation_verse: Fee sha asheŋ lubi a chɔ asheŋ lela; nsaa sha efɛ a chɔ kashenteŋ be keji.

english_verse: You love to say cruel things, and your words are a trap.
translation_verse: Asheŋ besaso nɛ fee sha kebaamalga, nɛ kafule bɔlɔ fo kudonduloŋ to.

english_verse: God will destroy you forever! He will grab you and drag you from your homes. You will be uprooted and left to die.
translation_verse: Kashenteŋto, Ebɔrɛ beeŋ jija fo mbaanaayɔ; E beeŋ to m pɛ fo to ŋ gberge fo n lar fo laŋ to. E beeŋ tia fo ashi basa keniso be kasawule so.

english_verse: When good people see this fearsome sight, they will laugh and say,
translation_verse: Nɛ basa cheembi e wu loŋ be kusɔ nɛ k bee keta kufu ere nseŋ mushe ŋ kaŋɛ le:

english_verse: “Just look at them now! Instead of trusting God, they trusted their wealth and their cruelty.”
translation_verse: “Men keni basa nɛ b kini keta bumo be yirda n deŋi Ebɔrɛ so, nseŋ ta bumo be yirda n deŋi bumo be kedamaya nɛ asheŋ lubi be kewora so na.”

english_verse: But I am like an olive tree growing in God's house, and I can count on his love forever and ever.
translation_verse: Ama ma ere du fanɛ ɔlif be kedibi nna, a daŋ nsaa walɛ saŋkama ashi Ebɔrɛ be laŋ to. Ma alɛ be yirda deŋ mbe kasha nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na so saŋkikɛ nna.

english_verse: I will always thank God for what he has done; I will praise his good name when his people meet.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal kusɔ nɛ fo wora so meeŋ baa fur fo saŋkikɛ. Ŋ kɔ tama ashi fo ketre to, ŋkpal manɛ so, fo ketre walɛ. Amoso meeŋ baa fur fo ashi fo basa cheembi be anishito.

english_verse: Only a fool would say, “There is no God!” People like that are worthless! They are heartless and cruel and never do right.
translation_verse: Ewulpo nawule e naa kaŋɛ mbe kagbene to fanɛ Ebɔrɛ maŋ wɔtɔ. Loŋ be basa la basa fuloŋ, nɛ b maa wu kuwɔr nna. Bumo alɛ maa wora asheŋ niŋiso kikɛ.

english_verse: From heaven God looks down to see if anyone is wise enough to search for him.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ wɔ esoso nna a keni kaseto a fin enyiashempo nɛ e bee fin mo ere Ebɔrɛ!

english_verse: But all of them are crooked and corrupt. Not one of them does right.
translation_verse: Ama esa kama maa wora asheŋ niŋiso. Ekama maa wora asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so. Esa koŋwule gba maŋ wɔtɔ a wora alela.

english_verse: Won't you lawbreakers learn? You refuse to pray, and you gobble up the people of God.
translation_verse: Menyi alubiworapoana maaŋ koya a? Menyi nɛ men maa kule Ebɔrɛ nsaa wɔtɔ a kpɛa ma basa to fanɛ b ka bee we bodobodo na.

english_verse: But you will be terrified worse than ever before. God will scatter the bones of his enemies, and you will be ashamed when God rejects you.
translation_verse: Kufu beeŋ pɛ menyi a chɔ kananɛ k daŋ pɛ menyi dra na. Ebɔrɛ beeŋ farnyaŋ mo doŋana be awibi to nɛ anishinyɔr e pɛ menyi ŋkpal Ebɔrɛ ka kini menyi so.

english_verse: I long for someone from Zion to come and save Israel! Our God, when you bless your people again, Jacob's family will be glad, and Israel will celebrate.
translation_verse: Mee jo saŋɛ nɛ esa ko beeŋ shi Zayɔn m ba mɔlga Israɛl nna. Anyi be Ebɔrɛ, fo baŋ naŋ nɛfa fo basa, Jeekɔb be kanaŋ to ebi be ŋgbene beeŋ fuli bumo, nɛ Israɛlebi e ji eyur.

english_verse: Save me, God, by your power and prove that I am right.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, ta fo eleŋ na m mɔlga ma, ŋ ŋini fanɛ m maŋ wora n jija.

english_verse: Listen to my prayer and hear what I say.
translation_verse: O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, jande, nu ma kekule; jande nu kusɔ nɛ mee kaŋɛ.

english_verse: Cruel strangers have attacked and want me dead. Not one of them cares about you.
translation_verse: Befɔ nɛ b la amukpakpasowuraana e naa kɔ ma. Bumo alɛ be ekama be shɛŋ maŋ wɔ fo to.

english_verse: You will help me, Lord God, and keep me from falling;
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ fo e naŋ chɛ ma to, ŋ kuŋ ma nɛ n sa maŋ tɔr.

english_verse: you will punish my enemies for their evil deeds. Be my faithful friend and destroy them.
translation_verse: Feeŋ gberge ma doŋana kusoe, ŋkpal bumo be alubi nɛ b wora so. Feeŋ mur bumo ŋkpal fo kashenteŋji so.

english_verse: I will bring a gift and offer a sacrifice to you, Lord. I will praise your name because you are good.
translation_verse: Meeŋ ber kagbene n lara sarga n sa fo. Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, meeŋ fur fo ketre, ŋkpal fo ka walɛ so.

english_verse: You have rescued me from all my troubles, and my own eyes have seen my enemies fall.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, fo mɔlga ma ashi ma awurfoŋ kikɛ to, nseŋ shin nɛ ŋ gbagba wu ma doŋana ka kɔ n tɔr.

english_verse: Listen, God, to my prayer! Don't reject my request.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, nu ma kekule. Jande, sa maŋ kplaŋ kusɔ nɛ mee bishi fo ere so.

english_verse: Please listen and help me. My thoughts are troubled, and I keep groaning
translation_verse: Wora ania n nu ma kekule ere; ŋkpal manɛ so, ma kagbene jija nna ga;

english_verse: because my enemies attack with loud shouts. They treat me terribly and hold angry grudges.
translation_verse: ŋkpal bedoŋ ka bee cha awɔr nsaa ponte to a kɔ ma agboso so.

english_verse: My heart is racing fast, and I am afraid of dying.
translation_verse: Ma kagbene bee to nna pep pep pep, nɛ mee lɔ kufu fanɛ meeŋ wu.

english_verse: I wish I had wings like a dove, so I could fly far away and be at peace.
translation_verse: N daa kɔ atɛ fanɛ keli nna, n daa beeŋ firgi n yɔ kakpa nɛ meeŋ nya kagbenewushi.

english_verse: I would go and live in some distant desert.
translation_verse: N daa beeŋ ya kaa wɔ keshishɛrsawule so kufɔ kufɔ.

english_verse: I would quickly find shelter from howling winds and raging storms.
translation_verse: N daa beeŋ nya manaŋ n yɔ kakpa nɛ meeŋ nya kekuŋ ashi afugboŋ nɛ atiligboŋ so.

english_verse: Confuse my enemies, Lord! Upset their plans. Cruelty and violence are all I see in the city,
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, shin nɛ ma doŋana e wulto to. Jija bumo be ŋkre kikɛ. Kumukpakpaso nɛ kebaamaashu basa so nawule nɛ mee wu, ashi kadegboŋ na to.

english_verse: and they are like guards on patrol day and night. The city is full of trouble, evil,
translation_verse: B du nna fanɛ bekumpo ka kulti kumo be egbal n wɔtɔ kapa nɛ kanyɛ na. Asheŋ lubi nɛ tɔrɔ e bɔlɔ kadegboŋ na to.

english_verse: My enemies are not the ones who sneer and make fun. I could put up with that or even hide from them.
translation_verse: Nɛ bedoŋ e daa tege ma nsaa wora ma eyurto, n daa beeŋ tiŋ n nyiti ŋko n shile ŋ ŋana bumo so.

english_verse: But it was my closest friend, the one I trusted most.
translation_verse: Ama nteri kpakpaso nɛ n yirda,

english_verse: We enjoyed being together, when we went with others to your house, our God.
translation_verse: nɛ ma nɛ mo bee ji kakurge, nsaa tu m braana a yɔ anyi be Ebɔrɛ be lambu to na e naa wora ma loŋ.

english_verse: All who hate me are controlled by the power of evil. Sentence them to death and send them down alive to the world of the dead.
translation_verse: Alubi e naa ji bekama nɛ b kishi ma na so eleŋ. Amoso shin nɛ luwu e purgi bumo nɛ b yɔ nchaŋ to nɛ b kraa keni.

english_verse: I ask for your help, Lord God, and you will keep me safe.
translation_verse: Ama n shu n tre Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ e mɔlga ma.

english_verse: Morning, noon, and night you hear my concerns and my complaints.
translation_verse: Chipurso nɛ kapaso nɛ kanyɛso kikɛ, e bee nu ma nfubel nna.

english_verse: I am attacked from all sides, but you will rescue me unharmed by the battle.
translation_verse: Bedoŋ bee kɔ ma kaba kama so nna; ama e beeŋ mɔlga ma ashi kena na to nɛ m maaŋ nya doro kikɛ.

english_verse: You have always ruled, and you will hear me. You will defeat my enemies because they won't turn and worship you.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ nɛ e bee ji kuwura saŋkama mbaanaayɔ na beeŋ nu ma kushu. E beeŋ shin nɛ m pɔɔ bedoŋ so ŋkpal manɛ so, b maa bunyaŋ mo.

english_verse: My friend turned against me and broke his promise.
translation_verse: N teri pal kaman n sa mbe kɔnɔ naseso nsaa kɔ ma.

english_verse: His words were smoother than butter, and softer than olive oil. But hatred filled his heart, and he was ready to attack with a sword.
translation_verse: Mbe kamalga wɔ ebel nna fanɛ mushoŋ; ama kekishi e bɔlɔ mbe kagbene to nɛ e wora shiriya nɛ e ta tokobi ŋ kɔ ma.

english_verse: Our Lord, we belong to you. We tell you what worries us, and you won't let us fall.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, an la fo basa nna nsaa kaŋɛ fo asheŋ nɛ a tir anyi. Fo alɛ maaŋ shin nɛ an kɔ n tɔr.

english_verse: But what about those people who are cruel and brutal? You will throw them down into the deepest pit long before their time. I trust you, Lord!
translation_verse: Ama fo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ beeŋ ta basa nɛ b maa shu basa so na bre n lɛ kemaŋ chiŋgeliŋ nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na to, pɔɛŋ nɛ bumo be saŋɛ e fo. Ma ere yirda fo nna.

english_verse: Many of them are pursuing and attacking me,
translation_verse: Bumo be bedamta baa yuu ma so nna, a kɔ ma kamoowuso.

english_verse: but even when I am afraid, I keep on trusting you.
translation_verse: Ama hale kufu kɔ ma gba ŋ kraa beeŋ yirda fo.

english_verse: I praise your promises! I trust you and am not afraid. No one can harm me.
translation_verse: Meeŋ fur fo ŋkpal fo kɔnɔ naseso so. N yirda fo, amoso kufu maŋ kɔ ma. Manɛ nɛ dimɛdi beeŋ tiŋ n wora ma?

english_verse: Enemies spend the whole day finding fault with me; all they think about is how to do me harm.
translation_verse: Karechɛ kikɛ bedoŋ bee wu ma kulubi nna. Bumo be nfɛra e baa la kananɛ baaŋ wora n doro ma.

english_verse: They attack from ambush, watching my every step and hoping to kill me.
translation_verse: Baa ŋana a pugi nna a kɔ ma. Baa dara keya kama nɛ n tia nna, a fin kananɛ baa nya ma m mɔ.

english_verse: They won't get away with these crimes, God, because when you get angry, you destroy people.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, sa maŋ shin nɛ b ta bumo be amu n ji kikɛ. Ŋkpal manɛ so, fo baaŋ nya agbo, fee mur efuliana na nna.

english_verse: You have kept record of my days of wandering. You have stored my tears in your bottle and counted each of them.
translation_verse: Awurfoŋ nɛ mee ji kikɛ be asheŋ bɔɔ fo enɔ nna, nɛ fo nyi ma anishichubi nɛ a lar be asheŋ. Amo kikɛ maŋ belaŋ fo so.

english_verse: When I pray, Lord God, my enemies will retreat, because I know for certain that you are with me.
translation_verse: Saŋkama nɛ m baŋ kule fo ndoŋana bee bɛta kaman nna. Kumo be loŋ e shin nɛ m pin fanɛ fo wɔ ma kutɔ.

english_verse: I trust you and am not afraid. No one can harm me.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ n yirda fo, amoso kufu maŋ kɔ ma. Manɛ nɛ dimɛdi beeŋ tiŋ n wora ma?

english_verse: I will keep my promises to you, my God, and bring you gifts.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe ma Ebɔrɛ, meeŋ bɛ kɔnɔ nɛ n nase n sa fo na so. Meeŋ ta ma kechɔrɔ be kakɛ m bar fo.

english_verse: You protected me from death and kept me from stumbling, so that I would please you and follow the light that leads to life.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, fo mɔlga ma ashi luwu to, a maŋ shin nɛ n fiti n tɔr. Amoso meeŋ baa wora fo aparsheŋ nsaa na fo kefulto nɛ k bee yɛra esa ŋkpa to na to.

english_verse: God Most High, have pity on me! Have mercy. I run to you for safety. In the shadow of your wings, I seek protection till danger dies down.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, jande wu ma kuwɔr. Wu ma kuwɔr, ŋkpal manɛ so fo kutɔ nɛ mee nya kekuŋ. Fo aba to nɛ mee shile a ŋana nɛ kenishipere e choŋ pɔɛŋ nɛ n lar.

english_verse: You will send help from heaven and save me, but you will bring trouble on my attackers. You are faithful, and you can be trusted.
translation_verse: Feeŋ shin nɛ kechɛto e shi ebɔrɛso m ba sɔ ma n yige. Nseŋ shin nɛ tɔrɔ e tɔr bumo nɛ baa kɔ ma kenishipereso na bre so. Fo la eshinteŋjipo nɛ esa beeŋ tiŋ n yirda nna.

english_verse: My enemies are fierce, much worse than lions! They have spears and arrows instead of teeth, and they have sharp swords instead of tongues.
translation_verse: N wɔ bedoŋ nɛ b du fanɛ ebuluŋ, nɛ baa kpɛa basa to na to nna. Bumo be anyii du fanɛ atanyembi nɛ akpa nna. Nɛ bumo be adonduloŋ bee ji fanɛ etokobi.

english_verse: May you, my God, be honored above the heavens; may your glory be seen everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Shin nɛ basa e wu fo aworbigboŋ ashi awɔlpa to, nɛ fo kemaŋkuragboŋ ashi kasawule so kikɛ.

english_verse: Enemies set traps for my feet and struck me down. They dug a pit in my path, but fell in it themselves.
translation_verse: Bedoŋ bee fe ma ajigbelɛ nna a da ma a lɛ. Baa kur amaŋ chiŋgeliŋ ma ekpa to nna, nsaa kilgi a tɔr amo to bumo gbagba.

english_verse: I am faithful to you, and you can trust me. I will sing and play music for you, my God.
translation_verse: Mee ji kashenteŋ nna a sa fo, nɛ feeŋ tiŋ n yirda ma. Meeŋ boŋ kashɛ nseŋ laŋ alaŋsɔ n sa fo ma, Ebɔrɛ na.

english_verse: I feel wide awake! I will wake up my harp and wake up the sun.
translation_verse: Edi maŋ wɔ ma anishi to, meeŋ laŋ ma jaŋjilaŋ hale nɛ kare e ya chɛ.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord, for everyone to hear, and I will sing hymns to you in every nation.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, meeŋ fur fo nɛ ekama e nu. Nseŋ boŋ kabɔrɛshuŋ be nshɛ ashi basa kikɛ be anishito.

english_verse: Your love reaches higher than the heavens; your loyalty extends beyond the clouds.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, fo kasha baŋ esoso so, nɛ fo kemankura choŋ awɔlpa so.

english_verse: May you, my God, be honored above the heavens; may your glory be seen everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ fo keshi e choŋ so esoso so nɛ fo kemankura e baa wɔ durnya be kaplɛkama.

english_verse: Do you mighty people talk only to oppose justice? Don't you ever judge fairly?
translation_verse: Menyi bejuŋkparpo, bee ji asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so a? Menyee ji basa be asheŋ kananɛ k daga so a?

english_verse: You have done wrong and lied from the day you were born.
translation_verse: Yili men be kakurgeachɛ kikɛ m ba fo mbre, men wɔtɔ nna a wora alubi nsaa ku efɛ.

english_verse: Your words spread poison like the bite of a cobra
translation_verse: Men be mmalga du fanɛ kuwɔ ka duŋ esa nna,

english_verse: that refuses to listen to the snake charmer.
translation_verse: nɛ e kini kenu esa nɛ e kɔ awɔ be kudur be ebɔl nna.

english_verse: My enemies are fierce as lions, Lord God! Shatter their teeth. Snatch out their fangs.
translation_verse: Mee ŋana bedoŋ nna fanɛ ebuluŋ na. Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, buri bumo anyii nɛ a du fanɛ ebuluŋ be anyii na.

english_verse: Let them dry up like snails or be like a child that dies before seeing the sun.
translation_verse: Shin nɛ b wɔlso fanɛ konte nseŋ shin nɛ b sa maŋ wu epeŋi fanɛ kebia nɛ e laŋɛ.

english_verse: Wipe them out quicker than a pot can be heated by setting thorns on fire.
translation_verse: Pɔɛŋ nɛ kapuliya nɛ k bɛ edɛ wuloŋwuloŋ so beeŋ bel edɛ, nɛ fo teŋ m mur bumo.

english_verse: Good people will be glad when they see the wicked getting what they deserve, and they will wash their feet in their enemies' blood.
translation_verse: Nɛ belelaworapo baŋ wu alubiworapoana ka nya bumo be alubi be kasogberge, bumo be ŋgbene beeŋ fuli bumo nɛ b fɔr bumo be aya ashi bumo doŋana na be ŋklaŋ to.

english_verse: Everyone will say, “It's true! Good people are rewarded. God does indeed rule the earth with justice.”
translation_verse: Nɛ basa e kaŋɛ: “Kashenteŋ, basa cheembi kraa nya bumo be kakɔka. Kashenteŋ, Ebɔrɛ kraa ji asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so ashi durnya to.”

english_verse: Save me, God! Protect me from enemy attacks!
translation_verse: Mɔlga ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, kuŋ ma ashi bedoŋ nɛ baa kɔ ma na kutɔ.

english_verse: Keep me safe from brutal people who want to kill me.
translation_verse: Kuŋ ma ashi kumukpakpasowuraana nɛ baa fin ma nɛ b mɔ na kutɔ.

english_verse: Merciless enemies, Lord, are hiding and plotting, hoping to kill me. I have not hurt them in any way at all.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, keni kananɛ b ŋana m pugi a jo ma. Basa lubi bee kre ma ŋkre lubi nna, a fin ma nɛ b mɔ. Ma alɛ maŋ wora bumo shɛŋ, ŋko n wora kulubi ko n da bumo so.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, you are the God of Israel. Punish the other nations and don't pity those terrible and rebellious people.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpetale Israɛlebi be Ebɔrɛ, niŋi to ŋ gberge efuli pɔtɛana na be basa kikɛ kusoe. Sa maŋ wu basa lubi, nɛ baa mɔ basa na kuwɔr.

english_verse: My enemies return at evening, growling like dogs roaming the city.
translation_verse: Baa bɛta a ba kaaseso kikɛ nna m ba kaa na kade to a gbu fanɛ njɔnɔ na.

english_verse: You, Lord, laugh at them and sneer at the nations.
translation_verse: Ama fo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bre bee mushe bumo nna, nsaa wora efuliana na eyurto.

english_verse: You are my mighty fortress, and I depend on you.
translation_verse: Fo e la ma ekumpogboŋ nɛ ma tama deŋ fo so.

english_verse: You love me and will let me see my enemies defeated.
translation_verse: Ma Ebɔrɛ nɛ e bee sha ma na beeŋ chɛ ma to, n shin nɛ n wu bedoŋ ka kɔ n tɔr.

english_verse: Don't kill them, or everyone may forget! Just use your mighty power to make them tremble and fall. You are a shield for your people.
translation_verse: Ama sa maŋ mɔ bumo. Mannɛ aloŋ ekama beeŋ teŋ so. Ta fo eleŋgboŋ na n shin nɛ b chicha n tɔr. Fo e la kusɔ kuŋsogboŋ a kuŋ fo basa.

english_verse: My enemies are liars! So let them be trapped by their boastful lies.
translation_verse: Bedoŋ na la befɛpo nna, amoso shin nɛ bumo be njɔŋ fuloŋ nɛ baa ji na e kilgi m pɛ bumo.

english_verse: Get angry and destroy them. Leave them in ruin. Then all the nations will know that you rule in Israel.
translation_verse: Nya agbo m mur bumo cheche. Saŋɛ na so efuli pɔtɛana na kikɛ beeŋ pin fanɛ fo e naa ji Israɛl so kuwura.

english_verse: Those liars return at evening, growling like dogs roaming the city.
translation_verse: Baa bɛta a ba kaaseso kikɛ nna, m ba kaa na kade to a gbu fanɛ njɔnɔ na.

english_verse: They search for scraps of food, and they snarl until they are stuffed.
translation_verse: Baa nite nna a gbu a yɛla kenishi to a fin ajibi, ama b baŋ moɛ nna pɔɛŋ nseŋ yɔ.

english_verse: But I will sing about your strength, my God, and I will celebrate because of your love. You are my fortress, my place of protection in times of trouble.
translation_verse: Ama ma ere beeŋ boŋ kasha a laŋɛ fo Ebɔrɛ be eleŋgboŋ na be kaplɛa so. Chipurso kikɛ, meeŋ boŋ kashɛ a laŋɛ fo kasha be kaplɛa so. Ŋkpal manɛ so, fo e la ma ekumpo, kakpa nɛ mee shile a ŋana ashi tɔrɔ be jemanɛ.

english_verse: I will sing your praises! You are my mighty fortress, and you love me.
translation_verse: Meeŋ boŋ nshɛ n fur fo. Fo e la ma ekumpogboŋ nsaa sha ma.

english_verse: You, God, are angry with us! We are rejected and crushed. Make us strong again!
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, fo nya agbo nna n wɔtɔ anyi nseŋ kini anyi, n shin nɛ an tɔr m buri to. Naniere naaŋ sa anyi eleŋ.

english_verse: You made the earth shake and split wide open; now heal its wounds and stop its trembling.
translation_verse: Fo shin nɛ kasawule gbuŋgbuŋ to m baŋɛ to m bugi to. Naniere shin nɛ kasawule na e cha abar so nseŋ yige kebaa gbuŋgbuŋ to.

english_verse: You brought hard times on your people, and you gave us wine that made us stagger.
translation_verse: Fo shin nɛ saŋɛ kpakpaso tu fo basa, nɛ afu bee ber anyi nɛ anyee lente.

english_verse: You gave a signal to those who worship you, so they could escape from enemy arrows.
translation_verse: Ama fo sa basa nɛ baa ŋana fo bre tɔɔnɛ nɛ b bɔla kumo so ŋ gelge bedoŋ be atanyembi.

english_verse: Answer our prayers, God! Use your powerful arm and give us victory. Then the people you love will be safe.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, nu anyi be kekule nseŋ ta fo enɔ lempo na m mɔlga anyi nɛ an la fo basa shaso na.

english_verse: Our God, you solemnly promised, “I would gladly divide up the city of Shechem and give away Succoth Valley piece by piece.
translation_verse: An Nyɛnpe nɛ anyi be Ebɔrɛ, fo nase kɔnɔ fanɛ feeŋ barga kadegboŋ nɛ baa tre Shɛkim na to, nseŋ chige ketaŋɛ nɛ baa tre Sukɔf na to.

english_verse: The lands of Gilead and Manasseh are mine. Ephraim is my war helmet, and Judah is the symbol of my royal power.
translation_verse: Fo yɛ Giliad nɛ Manase la feya nna, nɛ Efrayim la fo kebɛlso be kuwuro, nɛ Juda malɛ la fo kekpabi.

english_verse: Moab is merely my washbasin. Edom belongs to me, and I shout in triumph over the Philistines.”
translation_verse: Nɛ Mowab la fo kusɔ fɔr enɔ, nɛ fee ta fo asɛbta malɛ a deŋi Edɔm so, nsaa yili Filisti malɛ so a cha kekɔmpɔɔso be awɔr.

english_verse: Our God, who will bring me to the fortress, or lead me to Edom?
translation_verse: Wanɛ e naaŋ yɛr ma kadegboŋ nɛ b pɔr egbal ŋ kulti na to? Wanɛ e naaŋ juŋkpar ma n yɔ Edɔm be efuli so?

english_verse: Have you rejected us and deserted our armies?
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, fo kini anyi kashenteŋto nsaa maaŋ naŋ juŋkpar anyi be benapo nna a?

english_verse: Help us defeat our enemies! No one else can rescue us.
