translation_verse: Chɛ anyi to nɛ an kɔ m pɔɔ an doŋana so, ŋkpal manɛ so, dimɛdi bre be kechɛto maŋ la shɛŋ.

english_verse: Please listen, God, and answer my prayer!
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, jande nu ma kushu nɛ ma kabɔrɛkule!

english_verse: I feel hopeless, and I cry out to you from a faraway land. Lead me to the mighty rock high above me.
translation_verse: Ma tama kikɛ loge nɛ n wɔ efuli wɔfɔ so a shu a tre fo. Juŋkpar ma n yɔ kefalta gboŋ nɛ k du jeŋgreŋ a chɔ ma na so.

english_verse: You are a strong tower, where I am safe from my enemies.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, fo e la ma ekuŋkpa lempo, nɛ mee shile n ya kaa ŋana to ashi ma doŋana so.

english_verse: Let me live with you forever and find protection under your wings, my God.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe, ma Ebɔrɛ, shin nɛ m baa wɔ fo kutɔ mbaanaayɔ, saŋɛ na so meeŋ nya kekuŋ ashi fo aba to.

english_verse: You heard my promises, and you have blessed me, just as you bless everyone who worships you.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, fo nu ma kɔnɔ naseso na nseŋ nɛfa ma fanɛ kananɛ fo nɛfa bumo nɛ baa bunyaŋ fo na.

english_verse: Let the king have a long and healthy life.
translation_verse: Sa fo ewura ŋkpa tenteŋ nɛ eyur be alenfia.

english_verse: May he always rule with you, God, at his side; may your love and loyalty watch over him.
translation_verse: Shin nɛ e baa ji kuwura fo anishito mbaanaayɔ nɛ fo kasha nɛ kashenteŋji e baa kuŋ mo.

english_verse: I will sing your praises forever, God, and will always keep my promises.
translation_verse: Saŋɛ na so meeŋ baa di fo ketre epaŋ saŋkama nsaa wora a bɔlɔ ma kɔnɔ naseso so saŋkama.

english_verse: Only God can save me, and I calmly wait for him.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na to nɛ ma kiyoyu bee nya ewushi. Mo nawule e naa mɔlga ma.

english_verse: God alone is the mighty rock that keeps me safe and the fortress where I am secure.
translation_verse: Mo e la kefaltagboŋ nɛ emɔlgapo. Mo e la ma ekuŋkpa lempo a kuŋ ma.

english_verse: I feel like a shaky fence or a sagging wall. How long will all of you attack and assault me?
translation_verse: Nchɛ afanɛ nɛ menyeeŋ ta m bri esa? Menyeeŋ yili egbal nɛ k kulti ere so n ta mo n lɛ to a?

english_verse: You want to bring me down from my place of honor. You love to tell lies, and when your words are kind, hatred hides in your heart.
translation_verse: Menyee fin kananɛ menyee lara mo ashi mbe kemaŋkura be eyilikpa nna. Efɛ nawule nɛ menyee kuu. Nɛ mmalga lela lar menyi be nnɔ to gba, kekishi nɛ shoduu e bɔlɔ men be ŋgbene bre to.

english_verse: Only God gives inward peace, and I depend on him.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nawule e naa sa kagbenewushi; amoso mo so nɛ ma tama yil so.

english_verse: God alone is the mighty rock that keeps me safe, and he is the fortress where I feel secure.
translation_verse: Mo nawule e la ma kefaltagboŋ nɛ ma emɔlgapo. Mo e la maa ekuŋkpagboŋ, amoso ma lɔ kufu.

english_verse: God saves me and honors me. He is that mighty rock where I find safety.
translation_verse: Mo e naa mɔlga ma nsaa sa ma kemaŋkura. Mo e la kefaltagboŋ nɛ mee nya kekuŋ ashi kumo so na.

english_verse: Trust God, my friends, and always tell him each of your concerns. God is our place of safety.
translation_verse: Basa, men yirda Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nsaa kaŋɛ mo men be asheŋ tirso saŋkama. Ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ na nawule e la anyi be ekumpo.

english_verse: We humans are only a breath; none of us are truly great. All of us together weigh less than a puff of air.
translation_verse: Anyi edimɛdi baa du fanɛ esa ka fute afu nna. Anyi be ekama maŋ la shɛŋ. Anyi kikɛ be egbɛ maŋ fo esa be efute be egbɛ so.

english_verse: and I am very kind.” The Lord rewards each of us according to what we do.
translation_verse: nsaa kɔ kasha. Kashenteŋto malɛ nɛ feeŋ yili kusɔ kama nɛ esa wora so ŋ ka mo kumo be kukɔ.

english_verse: You are my God. I worship you. In my heart, I long for you, as I would long for a stream in a scorching desert.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe, fo e la ma Ebɔrɛ. Mee fin fo ma kagbene to kashenteŋto; fanɛ kananɛ meeŋ pere kenishi n fin nchu ketarso kpantaŋkpalaŋ ashi keshishɛrsawule so na.

english_verse: I have seen your power and your glory in the place of worship.
translation_verse: N wu fo eleŋ nɛ fo kemaŋkura ashi fo bɔrɛlambu to.

english_verse: Your love means more than life to me, and I praise you.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal fo kasha ka shi a chɔ kebaawɔtɔ so meeŋ di fo epaŋ.

english_verse: I will sing joyful praises and be filled with excitement like a guest at a banquet.
translation_verse: Meeŋ boŋ kapandi be nshɛ kagbenefuliso; nɛ ma eyur e saŋɛ ma to n shin nɛ m moɛ, fanɛ b ka wora kejigboŋ nɛ n ji na.

english_verse: I think about you, God, before I go to sleep, and my thoughts turn to you during the night.
translation_verse: Kanyɛso nɛ m baŋ dese gedo so mee nyiŋi fo nna, a fɛ fo asheŋ ashi ma edesekpa saŋkama.

english_verse: You have helped me, and I sing happy songs in the shadow of your wings.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal fo ka la ma echɛtopo so, meeŋ chena fo aba be kiyoyul to, m boŋ kagbenefuli be nshɛ.

english_verse: I stay close to you, and your powerful arm supports me.
translation_verse: M baa mar fo nna, nɛ fo enɔ lempo na, e baa kɔ ma to.

english_verse: All who want to kill me will end up in the ground.
translation_verse: Bekama nɛ baa fin ma ŋkpa be kelara na, beeŋ wu n yɔ nchaŋ to.

english_verse: Swords will run them through, and wild dogs will eat them.
translation_verse: Etokobi nɛ baaŋ ta m mɔ bumo, nɛ kupuŋ to be njɔnɔ e ji bumo.

english_verse: Because of you, our God, the king will celebrate with your faithful followers, but liars will be silent.
translation_verse: Ama ewura na nɛ bumo nɛ b yirda fo na bre beeŋ ji eyur, ŋkpal fo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na so. Ama befɛpo bre beeŋ lo bumo be nnɔ.

english_verse: Listen to my concerns, God, and protect me from my enemies' threats.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, nu ma nfubel, nseŋ kuŋ ma ashi bedoŋ be enɔ to.

english_verse: Keep me safe from secret plots of corrupt and evil gangs.
translation_verse: Jande, kuŋ ma ashi kumukpakpaso wuraana nɛ basa lubi be katuŋ na be ŋkre nɛ baa kre ma na to.

english_verse: Their words cut like swords, and their cruel remarks sting like sharp arrows.
translation_verse: Bumo be atuwebi bee besa nna fanɛ b ka ŋe esa kasaŋɛ na, nɛ bumo be mmalga du fanɛ b ka da esa ketanyembi na.

english_verse: They are determined to do evil, and they tell themselves, “Let's set traps! No one can see us.”
translation_verse: Baa leŋ abar to nna a wɔtɔ alubi be kewora to, nsaa malga kananɛ baaŋ sho bumo be ajigbelɛ ŋ ŋana, nsaa kaŋɛ fanɛ esa kikɛ maaŋ wu bumo.

english_verse: They make evil plans and say, “We'll commit a perfect crime. No one knows our thoughts.”
translation_verse: Baa kre asheŋ nɛ a maŋ niŋi be kewora nna, a kaŋɛ fanɛ kusɔ nɛ b kre na walɛ ga. Kashenteŋto dimɛdi be kagbene nɛ mbe nfɛra lubi ga.

english_verse: But God will shoot his arrows and quickly wound them.
translation_verse: Ama Ebɔrɛ gbagba beeŋ to bumo atanyembi n doro bumo.

english_verse: They will be destroyed by their own words, and everyone who sees them will tremble with fear.
translation_verse: Bumo gbagba be mmalga beeŋ kilgi n ji bumo, nɛ kufu e pɛ bekama nɛ b wu bumo, nɛ b fifi amu n chicha.

english_verse: They will be afraid and say, “Look at what God has done and keep it all in mind.”
translation_verse: Kufu beeŋ pɛ basa, nɛ b ji Ebɔrɛ be ashuŋ shuŋso be asheŋ be shɛda, nsaa fɛ kusɔ nɛ e wora na be asheŋ.

english_verse: May the Lord bless his people with peace and happiness and let them celebrate.
translation_verse: Basa nɛ baa wora asheŋ niŋiso na beeŋ ji eyur ŋkpal kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe na wora so; nseŋ ta bumo be amu ŋ ŋana Enyɛnpe na to.

english_verse: Our God, you deserve praise in Zion, where we keep our promises to you.
translation_verse: Anyi be Ebɔrɛ, k daga fanɛ an fur fo ashi Zayɔn to. Ndoŋ nɛ anyeeŋ bɛ nnɔ nɛ an nase n sa fo na so.

english_verse: Everyone will come to you because you answer prayer.
translation_verse: Ekama beeŋ ba fo kutɔ ŋkpal fo ka bee nu kekule so.

english_verse: When our sins get us down, you forgive us.
translation_verse: Anyi be alubi pɔɔ anyi so, nɛ fo ta anyi be aworandeso m paŋ anyi.

english_verse: You bless your chosen ones, and you invite them to live near you in your temple. We will enjoy your house, the sacred temple.
translation_verse: Fo nɛfa bekama nɛ fo lara na nna, n shin nɛ b chena n sha fo ashi fo bɔrɛlambu to. Anyeeŋ ji anyi be amu ashi fo laŋ to nɛ fo bɔrɛlambu cheembi na to.

english_verse: You are strong, and your mighty power put the mountains in place.
translation_verse: Fo e kɔ eleŋ nɛ yuku n ta abeegboŋ n yili amo be eyilikpa.

english_verse: You silence the roaring waves and the noisy shouts of the nations.
translation_verse: Fo e naa shin nɛ teku be awɔr bee lo. Fo e yɔɔ nchu be atili nɛ efuliana na be awɔr nɛ baa cha.

english_verse: People far away marvel at your fearsome deeds, and all who live under the sun celebrate and sing because of you.
translation_verse: Fo aworbi nɛ a bee keta kufu na bee chinchiŋ basa nɛ b wɔ kufɔ kufɔ gba. Durnya ere to ebi kikɛ bee boŋ nshɛ nsaa ji eyur nna ŋkpal fo so.

english_verse: You take care of the earth and send rain to help the soil grow all kinds of crops. Your rivers never run dry, and you prepare the earth to produce abundant grain.
translation_verse: Fo e naa keni kasawule ere so nsaa shin nɛ bɔrɛ bee ba a wushi kumo nɛ asɔ duuso be yiri yiri kikɛ bee wora kumo so. Fo eboŋana maa wɔlto kikɛ; fo alɛ e naa shin nɛ kasawule bee wora ajibi nɛnɛ.

english_verse: You water all its fields and level the lumpy ground. You send showers of rain to soften the soil and help the plants sprout.
translation_verse: Fo e naa wurge adɔana so nchu a shin kasawule bee wushi a ki pɔtɔ pɔtɔ nɛ asɔ bee tiŋ a kɔr.

english_verse: Wherever your footsteps touch the earth, a rich harvest is gathered.
translation_verse: Fo e naa shin nɛ adɔjibi bee wora nɛnɛ nɛ mpuro bee bɔlɔ a wurge.

english_verse: Meadows are filled with sheep and goats; valleys overflow with grain and echo with joyful songs.
translation_verse: Fo shin nɛ asɔbɔya sɔ kaplɛkama nɛ ataŋɛ to be ajibi bee wora alegaiso; nɛ amo kikɛ bee boŋ nshɛ awɔrso kagbenefuliso.

english_verse: Tell everyone on this earth to shout praises to God!
translation_verse: Menyi basa nɛ men wɔ kasawule ere so kikɛ e cha awɔr n fur Ebɔrɛ.

english_verse: Sing about his glorious name. Honor him with praises.
translation_verse: Men boŋ nshɛ m maŋkura mbe ketre nseŋ ta kapandi n fur mo.

english_verse: Say to God, “Everything you do is fearsome, and your mighty power makes your enemies come crawling.
translation_verse: Men kaŋɛ Ebɔrɛ fanɛ mbe aworbi kikɛ kɔ kufu nna, nɛ mbe eleŋgboŋ na bee shin nɛ mo doŋana bee chicha a jɔŋɛ mo ase kufuso.

english_verse: You are worshiped by everyone! We all sing praises to you.”
translation_verse: Durnya ere to be esa kikɛ bee bunyaŋ fo nsaa fur fo.

english_verse: Come and see the fearsome things our God has done!
translation_verse: Ba keni kusɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ wora; nɛ ashuŋ nɛ a bee keta kufu nɛ e shuŋ dimɛdi be kaplɛa so.

english_verse: When God made the sea dry up, our people walked across, and because of him, we celebrated there.
translation_verse: Mo e shin nɛ teku wɔlto ŋ ki kasawule, nɛ an nananyɛnana nite kumo to n dii, nɛ an ji eyur ŋkpal kusɔ nɛ e wora na so.

english_verse: His mighty power rules forever, and nothing the nations do can be hidden from him. So don't turn against God.
translation_verse: E kɔ mbe eleŋgboŋ nna a ji kuwura mbaanaayɔ, nɛ efuliana na maaŋ tiŋ n wora shɛŋ shɛŋ ŋ ŋana mo so. Amoso, amukpakpasowuraana maaŋ tiŋ ŋ kre kena ŋ kɔ mo.

english_verse: All of you people, come praise our God! Let his praises be heard.
translation_verse: Basa, men kikɛ e ba nɛ an fur anyi be Ebɔrɛ na. Men fur mo nɛ basa e nu.

english_verse: God protects us from death and keeps us steady.
translation_verse: Mo e kuŋ anyi be ŋkpa n shin nɛ an nya a wɔtɔ.

english_verse: Our God, you tested us, just as silver is tested.
translation_verse: Anyi be Ebɔrɛ, fo wora anyi ŋ keni, fanɛ kananɛ baa wora gbiti a keni na.

english_verse: You trapped us in a net and gave us heavy burdens.
translation_verse: Fo shin nɛ an tɔr kashewu to; fo sulɔ anyi esulɔ gbɛgbɛso.

english_verse: You sent war chariots to crush our skulls. We traveled through fire and through floods, but you brought us to a land of plenty.
translation_verse: Fo shin nɛ an doŋana pɔɔ anyi so nɛ an luri edɛ nɛ nchu to, ama fo bar anyi kasawule nɛ k kɔ asɔ damta so.

english_verse: I will sacrifice my best sheep and offer bulls and goats on your altar.
translation_verse: Meeŋ ta mbolpɔ lela n lara sarga n sa fo, nseŋ mɔ egbolu nɛ mboe n lara sarga chɔɔso ashi fo bɔrɛsure so.

english_verse: All who worship God, come here and listen; I will tell you everything God has done for me.
translation_verse: Menyi nɛ menyee bunyaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kikɛ e ba, nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ menyi kusɔ kama nɛ Ebɔrɛ wora n sa ma.

english_verse: I prayed to the Lord, and I praised him.
translation_verse: N shu n tre Enyɛnpe na nseŋ fur mo.

english_verse: If my thoughts had been sinful, he would have refused to hear me.
translation_verse: Alubi daa wɔ ma kagbene to, e daa maaŋ nu ma kekule.

english_verse: Let's praise God! He listened when I prayed, and he is always kind.
translation_verse: Meeŋ di Ebɔrɛ epaŋ; ŋkpal e ka bee nu ma kekule nsaa wora ma kelela saŋkikɛ so.

english_verse: Then everyone on earth will learn to follow you, and all nations will see your power to save us.
translation_verse: nɛ ekama durnya ere to e pin fo ekpa na, nɛ efuliana na kikɛ be basa e wu fo kumɔlga na.

english_verse: Make everyone praise you and shout your praises.
translation_verse: Shin nɛ basa kikɛ e fur fo awɔrso.

english_verse: Make everyone praise you, God, and shout your praises.
translation_verse: Shin nɛ ekama e fur fo awɔrso.

english_verse: Our God has blessed the earth with a wonderful harvest!
translation_verse: Anyi be Ebɔrɛ na nɛfa kasawule n shin nɛ k wora ajibi n sa anyi.

english_verse: Pray for his blessings to continue and for everyone on earth to worship our God.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ beeŋ nɛfa anyi, nɛ durnya to be basa kikɛ e bunyaŋ mo.

english_verse: Do something, God! Scatter your hateful enemies. Make them turn and run.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ koso, n shin nɛ fo doŋana e pesaŋ to n shile.

english_verse: Scatter them like smoke! When you come near, make them melt like wax in a fire.
translation_verse: Shin nɛ b pesaŋ to fanɛ edishi. Shin nɛ b ŋalga fo anishito fanɛ kananɛ kemushoŋmar bee ŋalga edɛ to na.

english_verse: But let your people be happy and celebrate because of you.
translation_verse: Ama shin nɛ basa nɛ baa wora asheŋ niŋiso na bre be ŋgbene e fuli bumo, nɛ b ji eyur fo anishito.

english_verse: Our God, you are the one who rides on the clouds, and we praise you. Your name is the Lord, and we celebrate as we worship you.
translation_verse: Men boŋ nshɛ n sa Ebɔrɛ, men boŋ nshɛ n fur mbe ketre. Mo e dii n chena awɔlpa so, amoso men maŋkura mo. Mbe ketre e la Enyɛnpe na, nɛ anyee tiŋ n ji eyur nseŋ maŋkura mo.

english_verse: Our God, from your sacred home you take care of orphans and protect widows.
translation_verse: Mo e wɔ mbe kakpa cheembi, nsaa la amunibi bumo tuto a kuŋ bekulpoche na.

english_verse: You set your people free, and you led them through the desert.
translation_verse: Fo e sa fo basa kamooji, nseŋ juŋkpar bumo m bɔla keshishɛrsawule so,

english_verse: God of Israel, the earth trembled, and rain poured down. You alone are the God who rules from Mount Sinai.
translation_verse: nɛ kasawule gbuŋgbuŋ nɛ bɔrɛ chulgi. Fo nawule e la Ebɔrɛ, nsaa tase kebee nɛ baa tre Sainai na so a ji kuwura.

english_verse: When your land was thirsty, you sent showers to refresh it.
translation_verse: Kasawule ka wɔl nɛ fo shin nɛ bɔrɛ ba nɛ kaboŋ wushi.

english_verse: Your people settled there, and you were generous to everyone in need.
translation_verse: Nɛ fo basa chena kumo so, nɛ fo sa bumo to be bumo nɛ b maŋ kɔ shɛŋ na kusɔ jiso.

english_verse: You gave the command, Lord, and a chorus of women told what had happened:
translation_verse: Fo e sa mbra na, nɛ beche damta cha awɔr, ŋ kaŋɛ kusɔ nɛ k wora.

english_verse: “Kings and their armies retreated and ran, and everything they left is now being divided.
translation_verse: Bewura, nɛ bumo be benapo kilgi n shile, nɛ b chige asɔ nɛ b shile ŋ ka na to n sa abar.

english_verse: And for those who stayed back to guard the sheep, there are metal doves with silver-coated wings and shiny gold feathers.”
translation_verse: Abɛlso be ali nɛ b ta gbiti m mata amo be aba so nseŋ ta shuwa nɛ a bee kpa edɛ n wora amo be atɛ e ki basa nɛ b shir kaman a keni mbolpɔ so na peya.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, Bashan is a mighty mountain covered with peaks.
translation_verse: Bashan be kebeegboŋ na shi nna nseŋ lar n lar ayabi.

english_verse: Why is it jealous of Zion, the mountain you chose as your home forever?
translation_verse: Kebeegboŋ, manɛ nna nɛ fee besa Zayɔn be kebeegboŋ nɛ Enyɛnpe na lara fanɛ mbe echenakpa nsaa wɔ kumo so saŋkama na eyur?

english_verse: When you, Lord God, appeared to your people at Sinai, you came with thousands of mighty chariots.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, egbaŋɛturko lempo ŋgboŋto ŋgboŋto nɛ fo ta n shi Sainai be kebeegboŋ na so m ba fo lambu cheembi na to.

english_verse: When you climbed the high mountain, you took prisoners with you and were given gifts. Your enemies didn't want you to live there, but they gave you gifts.
translation_verse: Fo keta basa nɛ b ti ebu nna n dii n yɔ kebeegboŋ na be esoso. Ndoŋ nɛ basa ya kɛ fo asɔ. Fo doŋana nɛ b daa maa sha fanɛ fo baa wɔ ndoŋ gba sa fo ŋkɛ.

english_verse: We praise you, Lord God! You treat us with kindness day after day, and you rescue us.
translation_verse: Anyee fur fo Enyɛnpe nɛ anyi be Ebɔrɛ nɛ fee mɔlga anyi nsaa wora anyi kelela karechɛ kikɛ na.

english_verse: You always protect us and save us from death.
translation_verse: Saŋkikɛ fee kuŋ anyi nna, nsaa mɔlga anyi ashi luwu to.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, your terrible enemies are ready for war, but you will crush their skulls.
translation_verse: Kashenteŋto, Ebɔrɛ beeŋ bure mo doŋana be amu to; bumo nɛ b kini kelar bumo be alubi to na be amu.

english_verse: You promised to bring them from Bashan and from the deepest sea.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na yɛ, e beeŋ lara bumo ashi Bashan be kebeegboŋ na so nɛ teku chiŋgeliŋ to m ba.

english_verse: Then we could wash our feet in their blood, and our dogs could chew on their bones.
translation_verse: Saŋɛ na so anyeeŋ chichi bumo be ŋklaŋ to nɛ an be njɔnɔ malɛ e bure bumo be awibi to.

english_verse: We have seen crowds marching to your place of worship, our God and King.
translation_verse: An Nyɛnpe nɛ anyi be Ebɔrɛ, an wu basa damta ka bɛ abar so a yɔ fo bɔrɛlambu to.

english_verse: Singers come first, and then the musicians, surrounded by young women playing tambourines.
translation_verse: Beshɛbompo e juŋkpar nɛ bumo nɛ baa laŋ alaŋsɔ bɛso nɛ besuŋgurbi bee laŋ echakachaka a chaŋ bumo.

english_verse: They come shouting, “People of Israel, praise the Lord God!”
translation_verse: Le nɛ baa ponte a kaŋɛ: “Men fur Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ashi mbe basa Israɛlebi be nshɛr to.”

english_verse: The small tribe of Benjamin leads the way, followed by the leaders from Judah. Then come the leaders from Zebulun and Naphtali.
translation_verse: Bɛnjamin be yiri to ebi nɛ b maŋ shi na e juŋkpar n ta Juda be yiri to be benimu m bɛso. Nɛ Zɛbyulɔn nɛ Naftali malɛ bɛ benimu bɛso.

english_verse: Our God, show your strength! Show us once again.
translation_verse: Anyi be Ebɔrɛ, ŋini fo eleŋ; naaŋ ŋini anyi fo eleŋ na.

english_verse: Then kings will bring gifts to your temple in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Nɛ bewura e ta ŋkɛ m ba fo bɔrɛlambu to ashi Jerusalɛm.

english_verse: Punish that animal that lives in the swamp! Punish that nation whose leaders and people are like wild bulls. Make them come crawling with gifts of silver. Scatter those nations that enjoy making war.
translation_verse: Gberge kusɔbɔya nɛ k wɔ ketaŋɛ to na kusoe. Gberge efuliana na be basa nɛ bumo be bejuŋkparpo du fanɛ apuntona na kusoe, n shin nɛ b ta gbiti be ŋkɛ ŋ gbeye amuli so m ba. Shin nɛ efuliana nɛ amo be basa bee sha kebaa ku kena na e pesaŋ to.

english_verse: Now sing praises to God! Every kingdom on earth, sing to the Lord!
translation_verse: Men boŋ nshɛ n fur Ebɔrɛ. Durnya to be efuli kikɛ so ebi e boŋ nshɛ n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.

english_verse: Praise the one who rides across the ancient skies; listen as he speaks with a mighty voice.
translation_verse: Men fur emo nɛ e yili dra na kikɛ a dii awɔlpa na. Men kaŋ kusoe n nu mbe ebɔl nɛ k bee gbri fanɛ bɔrɛ ka bee ponte na.

english_verse: Tell about God's power! He is honored in Israel, and he rules the skies.
translation_verse: Men kaŋɛ basa Ebɔrɛ be eleŋgboŋ na be asheŋ. Mbe kemaŋkura e buu Israɛl so nɛ e wɔ awɔlpa to a ji kuwura na.

english_verse: The God of Israel is fearsome in his temple, and he makes us strong. Let's praise our God!
translation_verse: O, Ebɔrɛ, fo asheŋ woraso bee keta kufu ashi fo bɔrɛlambu to nna, nɛ fee sa fo basa eleŋ nɛ yuku. Men shin nɛ an fur anyi be Ebɔrɛ na!

english_verse: I am sinking deep in the mud, and my feet are slipping. I am about to be swept under by a mighty flood.
translation_verse: Mee nia depɔ to nna nɛ ma aya maŋ naa mur efar. N fo kakpa chiŋgeliŋ nɛ nchu na bee muni ma so.

english_verse: I am worn out from crying, and my throat is dry. I have waited for you till my eyes are blurred.
translation_verse: N shu n tre fo hale ma eleŋ kikɛ loge, nɛ ma ebɔl to wɔl. N mɛrge anishi ŋ keni fo ekpa, hale ma anishi bee kurge.

english_verse: There are more people who hate me for no reason than there are hairs on my head. Many terrible enemies want to destroy me, God. Am I supposed to give back something I didn't steal?
translation_verse: Basa nɛ b kishi ma kenyanyaŋɛso shibi a chɔ ma kumu so be emin. Ebɔrɛ, bedoŋ lubi nɛ baa fin ma nɛ b jija na shi alegaiso. Baa tintiŋ ma nna nɛ ŋ ka kusɔ nɛ m maŋ yuri be kukɔ.

english_verse: You know my foolish sins. Not one is hidden from you.
translation_verse: Fo nyi ma kawuliso be alubi kikɛ. Amo be kukoŋwule kama maŋ ŋana fo so.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, ruler of Israel, don't let me embarrass anyone who trusts and worships you.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpetale Ewurgboŋ, nɛ fee ji Israɛlebi so kuwura, sa maŋ shin nɛ ekama nɛ e bee bunyaŋ fo e ji anishinyɔr ŋkpal ma so.

english_verse: It is for your sake alone that I am insulted and blush with shame.
translation_verse: Fo nawule so nɛ mee sɔ katege nsaa ji nyɔmɔ na.

english_verse: I am like a stranger to my relatives and like a foreigner to my own family.
translation_verse: Ŋ ki fanɛ efɔ ashi ŋ kurgepoana kutɔ nna; nsaa du fanɛ esa nɛ e shi efuli pɔtɛ so ashi n niopibiana to.

english_verse: My love for your house burns in me like a fire, and when others insult you, they insulted me as well.
translation_verse: Kasha nɛ ŋ kɔ n sa fo bɔrɛlambu na bee chɔ ma to nna fanɛ edɛ, nɛ basa baa tege fo, k bee lɛa ma alɛ gba nna.

english_verse: I cried and went without food, but they still insulted me.
translation_verse: Mee kishi nsaa shu; ama b kraa tege ma.

english_verse: They sneered at me for wearing sackcloth to show my sorrow.
translation_verse: M buu kagbenejijaso be asɔbuuso gba basa bee wora ma eyurto nna.

english_verse: Rulers and judges gossip about me, and drunkards make up songs to mock me.
translation_verse: Bejuŋkparpo nɛ demujipoana bee kuli ma nna, nɛ basa nɛ baa nuu nsa a boo, bee boŋ nshɛ a wora ma eyurto.

english_verse: But I pray to you, Lord. So when the time is right, answer me and help me with your wonderful love.
translation_verse: Ama fo Enyɛnpe na nɛ mee shu a tre. Nu ma kekule saŋɛ nɛ k par fo nseŋ yili fo kashagboŋ na so m mɔlga ma.

english_verse: Don't let me sink in the mud, but save me from my enemies and from the deep water.
translation_verse: Sa maŋ shin nɛ n nia depɔ to. Mɔlga ma ashi bedoŋ nɛ nchu nɛ a bee shin nɛ a mur ma na to.

english_verse: Don't let me be swept away by a flood or drowned in the ocean or swallowed by death.
translation_verse: Sa maŋ shin nɛ chuful e sulɔ ma n yɔ, ŋko n shin nɛ teku e mur ma, ŋko n shin nɛ luwu e ta ma m min.

english_verse: Answer me, Lord! You are kind and good. Pay attention to me! You are truly merciful.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, nu ma kekule, ŋkpal fo ka walɛ nsaa la esa so. Chɛ ma to, ŋkpal fo kuwɔrwu gboŋgboŋi na so.

english_verse: Don't turn away from me. I am your servant, and I am in trouble. Please hurry and help!
translation_verse: Saŋ maŋ pal kaman n sa fo kenya. Jande nu ma kekule manaŋ, ŋkpal manɛ so, n wɔ tɔrɔ to nna.

english_verse: Come and save me from my enemies.
translation_verse: Ba mɔlga ma ashi bedoŋ be enɔ to.

english_verse: You know how I am insulted, mocked, and disgraced; you know every one of my enemies.
translation_verse: Fo nyi kananɛ baa wora ma eyurto, a tege ma nsaa wɔtɔ ma nyɔmɔ to. Fo nyi n doŋana na be ekama.

english_verse: I am crushed by insults, and I feel sick. I had hoped for mercy and pity, but there was none.
translation_verse: Ma kagbenejija ŋkpal katege so, n shin nɛ ŋ ki elɔpo katinso. N daa fɛ fanɛ baaŋ wu ma kuwɔr nna; ma alɛ maŋ nya loŋ.

english_verse: Enemies poisoned my food, and when I was thirsty, they gave me vinegar.
translation_verse: Baa ta kɔrtɔ nna a wɔtɔ ma ajibi to nsaa sa ma nsa nyaŋnyaŋso fanɛ nchu nuuso.

english_verse: Make their table a trap for them and their friends.
translation_verse: Shin nɛ bumo be ejikpa e ki ajigbelɛ n sa bumo nɛ bumo teriana.

english_verse: Blind them with darkness and make them tremble.
translation_verse: Shin nɛ tentembiri e tan bumo nɛ b baa chicha.

english_verse: Show them how angry you are! Be furious and catch them.
translation_verse: Shin nɛ b pin fo ka nya agbo ga, nseŋ shin nɛ fo agbo e ba bumo so.

english_verse: Destroy their camp and don't let anyone live in their tents.
translation_verse: Jija bumo be echenakpa. Sa maŋ shin nɛ esa koŋwule gba e ka a wɔ bumo be keeyi to.

english_verse: They cause trouble for people you have already punished; their gossip hurts those you have wounded.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, baa malga nna a gbiti basa nɛ fo gberge kusoe na; nɛ bumo be ŋkuli bee tɔrɔ basa nɛ fo doro na.

english_verse: Wipe their names from the book of the living; remove them from the list of the innocent.
translation_verse: Bubɔ bumo be atre ashi basa nɛ b wɔ ŋkpa to na be atre be kawɔl na to. Lara bumo ashi bumo nɛ b maŋ wora n jija to.

english_verse: I am mistreated and in pain. Protect me, God, and keep me safe!
translation_verse: B maa keta ma nɛnɛ nɛ ebesa kɔ ma. Ebɔrɛ kuŋ ma nseŋ mɔlga ma.

english_verse: I will praise the Lord God with a song and a thankful heart.
translation_verse: Meeŋ boŋ kashɛ n fur Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na, nseŋ chɔrɔ mo ma kagbene to.

english_verse: This will please the Lord better than offering an ox or a full-grown bull.
translation_verse: Kumo be loŋ beeŋ par Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na a chɔ keta gbolu fɛlso ŋko gbolu danso n lara sarga n sa mo.

english_verse: When those in need see this, they will be happy, and the Lord's worshipers will be encouraged.
translation_verse: Betirpo beeŋ wu kumo be loŋ nɛ bumo be ŋgbene e fuli bumo. Saŋɛ na so basa nɛ baa bunyaŋ Enyɛnpe na beeŋ nya keleŋto.

english_verse: The Lord will listen when the homeless cry out, and he will never forget his people in prison.
translation_verse: Bumo nɛ b maŋ kɔ epe baŋ shu n tre Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na, e beeŋ nu. Mo alɛ maaŋ teŋ mbe basa nɛ b wɔ kabuti to na so.

english_verse: Heaven and earth will praise our God, and so will the oceans and everything in them.
translation_verse: Esoso nɛ kasawule nɛ teku nɛ asɔ nɛ a wɔ amo to kikɛ beeŋ fur anyi be Ebɔrɛ na.

english_verse: God will rescue Jerusalem, and he will rebuild the towns of Judah. His people will live there on their own land,
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ beeŋ sɔ Jerusalɛm n yige nseŋ lɔŋɛ m pɔr Juda be ndeana, nɛ mbe basa e baa wɔ amo to ashi bumo gbagba be kasawule so.

english_verse: and when the time comes, their children will inherit the land. Then everyone who loves God will also settle there.
translation_verse: Kasawule na beeŋ ki bumo be mbia be kapetɛ kachako. Nɛ esa kama nɛ e bee sha Ebɔrɛ e chena kumo so.

english_verse: Save me, Lord God! Hurry and help.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, jande, mɔlga ma. Ba chɛ ma to manaŋ.

english_verse: Disappoint and confuse all who want to kill me. Turn away and disgrace all who want to hurt me.
translation_verse: Wul basa nɛ baa fin ma nɛ b mɔ na be nfɛra to, nseŋ shin nɛ anishinyɔr e pɛ bumo. Shin nɛ bekama nɛ baa fin ma nɛ luwu na e sipa.

english_verse: Embarrass and shame those who say, “We told you so!”
translation_verse: Shin nɛ anishinyɔr nɛ nyɔmɔ e ji bekama nɛ baa kaŋɛ ma le na: “Men keni kananɛ e ki.”

english_verse: Let your worshipers celebrate and be glad because of you. They love your saving power, so let them always say, “God is wonderful!”
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, shin nɛ bumo nɛ baa bunyaŋ fo na be ŋgbene e fuli bumo nɛ b ji eyur. Shin nɛ bekama nɛ baa sha fo kumɔlga na e baa kaŋɛ saŋkama fanɛ Enyɛnpe na shibi.

english_verse: I am poor and needy, but you, the Lord God, care about me. You are the one who saves me. Please hurry and help!
translation_verse: N la etirpo nɛ etentaŋasepo nna, a maaŋ tiŋ n wora shɛŋ shɛŋ, ama Enyɛnpe, ma asheŋ tir fo. Fo e la ma emɔlgapo, amoso jande, ba mɔlga ma manaŋ.

english_verse: Save me, Lord God! Hurry and help.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, jande, mɔlga ma. Ba chɛ ma to manaŋ.

english_verse: Disappoint and confuse all who want to kill me. Turn away and disgrace all who want to hurt me.
translation_verse: Wul basa nɛ baa fin ma nɛ b mɔ na be nfɛra to, nseŋ shin nɛ anishinyɔr e pɛ bumo. Shin nɛ bekama nɛ baa fin ma nɛ luwu na e sipa.

english_verse: Embarrass and shame those who say, “We told you so!”
translation_verse: Shin nɛ anishinyɔr nɛ nyɔmɔ e ji bekama nɛ baa kaŋɛ ma le na: “Men keni kananɛ e ki.”

english_verse: Let your worshipers celebrate and be glad because of you. They love your saving power, so let them always say, “God is wonderful!”
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, shin nɛ bumo nɛ baa bunyaŋ fo na be ŋgbene e fuli bumo nɛ b ji eyur. Shin nɛ bekama nɛ baa sha fo kumɔlga na e baa kaŋɛ saŋkama fanɛ Enyɛnpe na shibi.

english_verse: I am poor and needy, but you, the Lord God, care about me. You are the one who saves me. Please hurry and help!
translation_verse: N la etirpo nɛ etentaŋasepo nna, a maaŋ tiŋ n wora shɛŋ shɛŋ, ama Enyɛnpe, ma asheŋ tir fo. Fo e la ma emɔlgapo, amoso jande, ba mɔlga ma manaŋ.

english_verse: I run to you, Lord, for protection. Don't disappoint me.
translation_verse: Fo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kutɔ nɛ m ba, nɛ fo baa kuŋ ma. Sa maŋ shin nɛ n ji anishinyɔr.

english_verse: You do what is right, so come to my rescue. Listen to my prayer and keep me safe.
translation_verse: Jande Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, sɔ ma n yige; ŋkpal fo ka la esa niŋiso so. Nu ma kekule nseŋ mɔlga ma manaŋ.

english_verse: Be my mighty rock, the place where I can always run for protection. Save me by your command! You are my mighty rock and my fortress.
translation_verse: Baa la ma kefaltagboŋ, ma ekuŋkpagboŋ nɛ mee nya kumɔlga fo kutɔ. Fo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e la ma kefaltagboŋ a kuŋ ma. Amoso baa juŋkpar ma a ŋini ma ekpa lela na, nɛ fo ketre e nya kemaŋkura.

english_verse: Come and save me, Lord God, from vicious and cruel and brutal enemies!
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, ba mɔlga ma ashi kumukpakpaso wuraana nɛ basa nɛ baa mɛaŋ ma be enɔ to.

english_verse: I depend on you, and I have trusted you since I was young.
translation_verse: O Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ, fo e la ma tama kikɛ, ma kebifɔlbi to kikɛ nɛ n ta yirda n deŋi fo so.

english_verse: I have relied on you from the day I was born. You brought me safely through birth, and I always praise you.
translation_verse: Ma kebiato kikɛ nɛ n ta ma kumu n to fo so hale m ba fo mbre. Fo e shin nɛ b kurge ma nɛ kayurwushi; ma alɛ beeŋ baa kpaŋ fo mbaanaayɔ.

english_verse: Many people think of me as something evil. But you are my mighty protector,
translation_verse: Ma kebaawɔtɔ ki tɔɔnɛ nna n sa basa damta ŋkpal fo ka la ma ekumpo lempo so.

english_verse: and I praise and honor you all day long.
translation_verse: Meeŋ kpaŋ fo nsaa ber fo kemaŋkura be kebomboŋ karechɛ kikɛ.

english_verse: Don't throw me aside when I am old; don't desert me when my strength is gone.
translation_verse: Mee kule fo nna, nɛ fo sa maŋ pal kaman n sa ma jemanɛ nɛ m bel ŋko ŋ kini ma n lɛ jemanɛ nɛ ma eleŋ loge.

english_verse: My enemies are plotting because they want me dead.
translation_verse: Bedoŋ bee malga a gbiti ma nna; b shɛr nna a kre ma kemɔ be nia.

english_verse: They say, “Now we'll catch you! God has deserted you, and no one can save you.”
translation_verse: B yɛ: “Ebɔrɛ kini mo n lɛ; men shin nɛ an ju m bɛ so n ya pɛ mo, ŋkpal manɛ so, esa kikɛ maŋ wɔtɔ nɛ e kɔ m mɔlga mo.”

english_verse: Embarrass and destroy all who want me dead; disgrace and confuse all who want to hurt me.
translation_verse: Shin nɛ basa nɛ baa fin ma nɛ luwu na e kɔ n tɔr nseŋ mur. Nseŋ shin nɛ basa nɛ baa kɔrfɛ ma e ŋaba n ji anishinyɔr.

english_verse: I will never give up hope or stop praising you.
translation_verse: Ma ere beeŋ ta ma tama n wɔtɔ fo to; ma alɛ maaŋ yige kebaakpaŋ fo kikɛ.

english_verse: All day long I will tell the wonderful things you do to save your people. But you have done much more than I could possibly know.
translation_verse: Karechɛ kikɛ meeŋ baa malga fo alelasheŋ nɛ fo kumɔlga be asheŋ; ŋkpal manɛ so, fo wora asheŋgboŋ nɛ a baŋ ma kepinto so.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord God, for your mighty deeds and your power to save.
translation_verse: O Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ, fo nawule be asheŋgboŋ nɛ kebaawɔtɔ niŋiso be kubomboŋ nɛ meeŋ baa ber.

english_verse: You have taught me since I was a child, and I never stop telling about your marvelous deeds.
translation_verse: Ma kebiato kikɛ nɛ fo ŋini ma asheŋ; hale nɛ mbre, ŋ kraa malga fo emamachisheŋ be asheŋ a sa basa.

english_verse: Don't leave me when I am old and my hair turns gray. Let me tell future generations about your mighty power.
translation_verse: Naniere, nɛ m bel n fuli kumu, sa maŋ pal kaman n sa ma, O Ebɔrɛ. Shin nɛ m baa kraa wɔtɔ a malga fo eleŋgboŋ be asheŋ a sa kaman to ebi nɛ baa ba na.

english_verse: Your deeds of kindness are known in the heavens. No one is like you!
translation_verse: O Ebɔrɛ, fo kebaawɔtɔ niŋiso shi ga, k salga to hale n ya fo awɔlpa to. Fo e wora asheŋgboŋ ga, esa kikɛ maŋ du fanɛ fo.

english_verse: You made me suffer a lot, but you will bring me back from this deep pit and give me new life.
translation_verse: Fo shin nɛ n ji awurfoŋ damta, ama fo naŋ wɔtɔ ma eleŋ; nseŋ kuŋ ma nɛ m maŋ wu n yɔ nchaŋ to.

english_verse: You will make me truly great and take my sorrow away.
translation_verse: Fo naŋ shin nɛ n nya kemaŋkura n ti so, nseŋ naŋ lolo ma nɛ ma kagbene dese ma.

english_verse: I will praise you, God, the Holy One of Israel. You are faithful. I will play the harp and sing your praises.
translation_verse: Meeŋ ta jaŋjilaŋ m boŋ nshɛ ŋ kpaŋ fo; meeŋ kpaŋ fo ma Ebɔrɛ, ŋkpal fo kashenteŋji so. Meeŋ laŋ jaŋjilaŋ m boŋ nshɛ belbelso n sa fo, Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ cheembi na.

english_verse: You have rescued me! I will celebrate and shout, singing praises to you with all my heart.
translation_verse: Meeŋ ta kagbenefuli m boŋ nshɛ awɔrso ŋ kpaŋ fo, ŋkpal fo ka mɔlga ma so.

english_verse: All day long I will announce your power to save. I will tell how you disgraced and disappointed those who wanted to hurt me.
translation_verse: Meeŋ malga fo kebaawɔtɔ niŋiso be asheŋ kachɛ lelemu. Ŋkpal manɛ so, basa nɛ baa kɔrfɛ ma na kɔ n tɔr nseŋ ji anishinyɔr.

english_verse: Please help the king to be honest and fair just like you, our God.
translation_verse: O Ebɔrɛ, shin nɛ ewura e baa ji kashenteŋ; nsaa ji asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so fanɛ fo.

english_verse: Let him be honest and fair with all your people, especially the poor.
translation_verse: Saŋɛ na so, e beeŋ baa ji fo basa demu ekpa niŋiso so, nsaa keni basa nɛ b wɔ tɔrɔ to ekpa nɛ k daga so.

english_verse: Let the king defend the poor, rescue the homeless, and crush everyone who hurts them.
translation_verse: Shin nɛ ewura na e baa kɔ a sa betirpo, nsaa kɔ a suge betentaŋasepo nseŋ naa kɔ a pɔɔ bekama nɛ baa kɔrfɛ bumo na so.

english_verse: Let the king live forever like the sun and the moon.
translation_verse: Shin nɛ ewura e baa wɔtɔ mbaanaayɔ fanɛ kananɛ epeŋi nɛ kufɔl wɔtɔ na.

english_verse: Let him be as helpful as rain that refreshes the meadows and the ground.
translation_verse: Shin nɛ e baa kɔ kechɛto a sa basa fanɛ kananɛ bɔrɛchu bee sa adɔsawule kayul na.

english_verse: Let the king be fair with everyone, and let there be peace until the moon falls from the sky.
translation_verse: Shin nɛ ewura na e baa ji asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so a sa ekama, nseŋ shin nɛ kayurwushi nɛ kedamaya e sɔ kaplɛkama hale nɛ kufɔl e ya wu.

english_verse: Force the desert tribes to accept his rule, and make his enemies crawl in the dirt.
translation_verse: Saŋɛ na so keshishɛrsawule so be basa beeŋ ba jɔŋɛ mo ase m bunyaŋ mo. Nɛ b tintiŋ mo doŋana nɛ b ba dese kasawule ashi mbe anishito.

english_verse: Force the rulers of Tarshish and of the islands to pay taxes to him. Make the kings of Sheba and of Seba bring gifts.
translation_verse: Speen be efuli so nɛ mplasawule so be bewuraana beeŋ bar bumo be ŋkɛ m ba sa mo; nɛ Areebia nɛ Itiopia be bewuraana gba e bar bumo be ŋkɛ m ba sa mo.

english_verse: Make other rulers bow down and all nations serve him.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ bewura kikɛ e ba jɔŋɛ mo ase. Nɛ efuliana na be basa kikɛ e shuŋ mo.

english_verse: Do this because the king rescues the homeless when they cry out, and he helps everyone who is poor and in need.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, e beeŋ kɔ n suge betentaŋasepo nɛ bekama nɛ b wɔ tɔrɔ to nseŋ shu n tre mo na n yige.

english_verse: The king has pity on the weak and the helpless and protects those in need.
translation_verse: Ewura na kɔ kushuso n sa bepɔshipo nɛ betirpo nna, mo alɛ e naa mɔlga betentaŋasepo ashi luwu to.

english_verse: He cares when they hurt, and he saves them from cruel and violent deaths.
translation_verse: Mo e naa mɔlga bumo ashi kamɛaŋ nɛ awurfoŋ to, ŋkpal manɛ so, bumo be ŋkpa be asheŋ tir mo nna.

english_verse: Long live the king! Give him gold from Sheba. Always pray for the king and praise him each day.
translation_verse: Shin nɛ ewura na be ŋkpa e teŋi so! N shin nɛ e nya Areebia be kasawule so be shuwa. Shin nɛ basa e baa kule Ebɔrɛ a sa mo jemanɛ kikɛ nsaa nɛfa mo karechɛ kama.

english_verse: May the glory of the king shine brightly forever like the sun in the sky. Let him make nations prosper and learn to praise him.
translation_verse: Shin nɛ basa e baa nyiŋi ewura na be ketre mbaanaayɔ, n shin nɛ mbe kemaŋkura e baa fulto fanɛ epeŋi. Shin nɛ efuliana na be basa e bɔla mo so n dii kedama nseŋ kule Ebɔrɛ be nɛfa n sa mo.

english_verse: Lord God of Israel, we praise you. Only you can work miracles.
translation_verse: Anyee kpaŋ fo, Enyɛnpe, Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na nna. Fo nawule e naa tiŋ a wora emamachisheŋ.

english_verse: We will always praise your glorious name. Let your glory be seen everywhere on earth. Amen and amen.
translation_verse: Anyeeŋ baa kpaŋ fo ketre nɛ k kɔ kemaŋkura na jemanɛ kikɛ. Shin nɛ fo kemaŋkuragboŋ na e dii efuli durnya ere be kaplɛkama. Amɛn! Amɛn!

english_verse: This ends the prayers of David, the son of Jesse.
translation_verse: Jɛsi pibinyɛn, Ewura Deevid, be kabɔrɛkule be ekar nna na.

english_verse: ) God Is Good
translation_verse: ) Ebɔrɛ ka walɛ be asheŋ

english_verse: God is truly good to Israel, especially to everyone with a pure heart.
translation_verse: Kashenteŋto, Ebɔrɛ walɛ n sa Israɛl nɛ bekama nɛ baa bunyaŋ mo nɛ ŋgbene fuful na.

english_verse: But I almost stumbled and fell,
translation_verse: Ama ma ere, a daŋ ka gbrɛ nɛ n fɛrge n tɔr.

english_verse: because it made me jealous to see proud and evil people and to watch them prosper.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, ŋ ka daŋ wu kamoowuwuraana ka dii kedama na, n daa besa bumo eyur nna.

english_verse: They never have to suffer, they stay healthy,
translation_verse: B maa ji awurfoŋ ŋko ebesa kikɛ; b baa kɔ eyur be alenfia nɛ eleŋ nna.

english_verse: Their pride is like a necklace, and they commit sin more often than they dress themselves.
translation_verse: Amoso kamoowu ki fanɛ kubɔtoshembi ashi bumo be ebɔ to nna, nɛ kebaanyaŋɛto a wora asheŋ malɛ ki fanɛ bumo be asɔbuuso.

english_verse: Their eyes bulge with fat, and their minds are flooded with foolish thoughts.
translation_verse: Asheŋ lubi nawule e naa shi bumo be ŋgbene to a lar, nɛ ŋkre lubi malɛ bɔlɔ bumo be nfɛra to.

english_verse: They sneer and say cruel things, and because of their pride, they make violent threats.
translation_verse: Baa tege basa nna nsaa malga mmalga jiga, nseŋ naa kre beko be kamɛaŋ kamoowuso.

english_verse: They dare to speak against God and to order others around.
translation_verse: Baa malga mmalga lubi a gbiti Ebɔrɛ nna, nsaa malga ŋkpensheŋ so ekama kutɔ durnya to.

english_verse: God will bring his people back, and they will drink the water he so freely gives.
translation_verse: Amoso Ebɔrɛ be basa gba maŋ naa fɛ bumo be mmalga na be asheŋ pɔɛŋ nsaa yirda bumo.

english_verse: Only evil people would say, “God Most High cannot know everything!”
translation_verse: Le nɛ baa kaŋɛ: “Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na maaŋ tiŋ m pin kusɔ kikɛ!”

english_verse: Yet all goes well for them, and they live in peace.
translation_verse: Kananɛ kumukpakpasowuraana du nna na. B maŋ ta asheŋ lubi fanɛ asheŋ lubi; bumo alɛ bee dii kedama a ti so nna.

english_verse: What good did it do me to keep my thoughts pure and refuse to do wrong?
translation_verse: Manɛ be tɔnɔ nɛ n nya ashi ma kebaakɔ nfɛra lela, nɛ kekini kewora asheŋ lubi to bre?

english_verse: I am sick all day, and I am punished each morning.
translation_verse: O Ebɔrɛ, fo shin nɛ n ji awurfoŋ kachɛ lelemu. Kachipurso kikɛ fee gberge ma kusoe nna.

english_verse: If I had said evil things, I would not have been loyal to your people.
translation_verse: Nɛ n daŋ malga mmalga lubi nna, ndafanɛ n daa beeŋ ki edebɔrpo fo basa to.

english_verse: It was hard for me to understand all this!
translation_verse: Kedaa du kpakpa n sa ma nɛ n tiŋ m pin asheŋ ere kikɛ to.

english_verse: Then I went to your temple, and there I understood what will happen to my enemies.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ be bɔrɛlambu to nɛ n yɔ pɔɛŋ nseŋ ya pin kusɔ nɛ k beeŋ tu kumukpakpasowuraana.

english_verse: You will make them stumble, never to get up again.
translation_verse: Abaanaaworasheŋ feeŋ shin nɛ b fɛrge n tɔr nsaa maŋ naŋ tiŋ ŋ koso kikɛ.

english_verse: They will be terrified, suddenly swept away and no longer there.
translation_verse: Baaŋ mur epul to nɛ kufu e pɛ bumo nɛ b baa chicha. Bumo be lalaloge beeŋ lubi pasaa!

english_verse: I was stupid and ignorant, and I treated you as a wild animal would.
translation_verse: kawulisheŋ nɛ kebaamaŋ nyi asheŋ e daa kɔ ma, nɛ n daa wora asheŋ fo anishito fanɛ kusɔbɔya na.

english_verse: But I never really left you, and you hold my right hand.
translation_verse: Ama amo nɛ amo kikɛ ŋ kraa wɔ fo kutɔ jemanɛ kikɛ. Fo daa kɔ ma to fo enɔ jisa to nna.

english_verse: Your advice has been my guide, and later you will welcome me in glory.
translation_verse: Fo kasotoji e daa ŋini ma kananɛ meeŋ baa wora asheŋ, kumo be lalaloge nɛ fo ba ta ma n yɔ kemaŋkura to.

english_verse: In heaven I have only you, and on this earth you are all I want.
translation_verse: M maŋ naa kɔ esa kikɛ ebɔrɛso n naŋ ti fo so. Ŋ ka baa kɔ fo ere, m maŋ naa sha shɛŋ durnya ere to.

english_verse: My body and mind may fail, but you are my strength and my choice forever.
translation_verse: Ma eyur nɛ nfɛra beeŋ tiŋ n wora asheŋ ŋ gben, ama Ebɔrɛ e la ma eleŋ ashi ma kagbene to. Mo alɛ be asheŋ a tir ma jemanɛ kikɛ.

english_verse: All-Powerful Lord God, those who stay far from you will be lost, and you will destroy those who are unfaithful.
translation_verse: O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, bekama nɛ b kplaŋ fo so beeŋ mur cheche. Fo alɛ beeŋ mur bekama nɛ b maŋ ji kashenteŋ n sa fo.

english_verse: It is good for me to be near you. I choose you as my protector, and I will tell about your wonderful deeds.
translation_verse: Ama k walɛ ga ŋkpal ma ere ka taga fo, Ebɔrɛ na, to so. N ta fo, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na, fanɛ ma ekumpo nna. Ma alɛ beeŋ baa bɔ fo emamachisheŋ na be kubɔya.

english_verse: Our God, why have you completely rejected us? Why are you so angry with the ones you care for?
translation_verse: O Ebɔrɛ, manɛ nna nɛ fo kplaŋ anyi so loŋ? Feeŋ baŋ nya agbo n wɔtɔ fo basa mbaanaayɔ a?

english_verse: walk over to the temple left in ruins forever by those who hate us.
translation_verse: Naŋ bɛta m ba bɔla fo bɔrɛlambu nɛ k bure a dese na ase; kakpa nɛ an doŋana jija kusɔ kama nyam na.

english_verse: Your enemies roared like lions in your holy temple, and they have placed their banners there.
translation_verse: Fo doŋana daŋ yili bɔrɛlambu na to n ji njɔŋ nseŋ yuu bumo be etuta a ŋini fanɛ b kɔ m pɔɔ so nna.

english_verse: They said to themselves, “We'll crush them!” Then they burned every one of your meeting places all over the country.
translation_verse: Le nɛ an doŋana na daŋ kaŋɛ ashi bumo be ŋgbene to: “Anyeeŋ mur bumo cheche!” B daŋ chɔɔ kaplɛkama nɛ basa bee bunyaŋ Ebɔrɛ na ashi kasawule na kikɛ so nna m mur cheche.

english_verse: There are no more miracles and no more prophets. Who knows how long it will be like this?
translation_verse: Emamachisheŋ maŋ naa wɔtɔ, anebiana na gba maŋ naa wɔtɔ. Ekama malɛ maŋ nyi saŋɛ nɛ asheŋ na beeŋ fo amo be ekar.

english_verse: Our God, how much longer will our enemies sneer? Won't they ever stop insulting you?
translation_verse: O Ebɔrɛ, saŋɛ mo nɛ an doŋana beeŋ yige kebaa tege anyi nɛ kebaawora fo eyur to?

english_verse: Why don't you punish them? Why are you holding back?
translation_verse: Manɛ nna nɛ fo kini kechɛ anyi to? Manɛ nna nɛ fo maaŋ gberge bumo kusoe?

english_verse: Our God and King, you have ruled since ancient times; you have won victories everywhere on this earth.
translation_verse: O Ebɔrɛ, sososo na kikɛ, fo e la anyi be ewura; fo alɛ e bar kumɔlga durnya kikɛ be basa to.

english_verse: By your power you made a path through the sea, and you smashed the heads of sea monsters.
translation_verse: Fo eleŋgboŋ nɛ fo ta n nase ekpa teku peper na to, nseŋ bure nchu to be asɔ keniso lubi gboŋgboŋi na be amu to.

english_verse: You crushed the heads of the monster Leviathan, then fed him to wild creatures in the desert.
translation_verse: Fo e daŋ bure teku to be kusɔbɔya lubi gboŋgboŋi nɛ baa tre Liviatan na be kumu to. Nseŋ shin nɛ k ki keji n sa keshishɛrsawule so be asɔbɔya.

english_verse: You rule the day and the night, and you put the moon and the sun in place.
translation_verse: Fo e to kapa nɛ kanyɛ kikɛ, nseŋ taŋɛ epeŋi nɛ kufɔl; nɛ kekama kɔ kumo be eyilikpa.

english_verse: You made summer and winter and gave them to the earth.
translation_verse: Fo e yili durnya be egbaŋ kikɛ, nseŋ to kechali nɛ ketar.

english_verse: Remember your enemies, Lord! They foolishly sneer and won't respect you.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, baa nyiŋi kananɛ fo doŋana wora fo eyurto a mushe fo na, nɛ kananɛ bewulpo keni fo ketre jiga na.

english_verse: You treat us like pet doves, but they mistreat us. Don't keep forgetting us and letting us be fed to those wild animals.
translation_verse: Sa maŋ yige fo basa nɛ b du fanɛ alepɔ na n sa bedoŋ nɛ b du fanɛ kupuŋ to be asɔbɔya lubi na. Fo alɛ e sa maŋ teŋ basa nɛ baa ji awurfoŋ na so.

english_verse: Remember the agreement you made with us. Violent enemies are hiding in every dark corner of the earth.
translation_verse: Baa nyiŋi kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre nɛ anyi nɛ fo wora na. Ŋkpal manɛ so, kebagato e sɔ durnya be kukɔlɔbi kikɛ to, n shin nɛ tentembiri sɔ kaplɛkama.

english_verse: Don't disappoint those in need or make them turn from you, but help the poor and homeless to shout your praises.
translation_verse: Sa maŋ shin nɛ anishinyɔr a ji basa nɛ baa ji awurfoŋ. Ama fo shin nɛ betirpo nɛ betentaŋasepo e kpaŋ fo ketre na.

english_verse: Do something, God! Defend yourself. Remember how those fools sneer at you all day long.
translation_verse: O Ebɔrɛ, koso ŋ kɔ n sa fo kumu! Baa nyiŋi kananɛ bewulpo na wora fo eyurto kachɛ lelemu kikɛ na.

english_verse: Our God, we thank you for being so near to us! Everyone celebrates your wonderful deeds.
translation_verse: O Ebɔrɛ, anyee di fo epaŋ, ŋkpal fo ka taga anyi to so! Ekama bee ji eyur nna a malga fo mamachisheŋ be asheŋ.

english_verse: The earth trembles, and its people shake; you alone keep its foundations firm.
translation_verse: Nɛ kasawule gbuŋgbuŋ nɛ basa bee chicha gba, ma e kraa kɔ kumo be gbaltɔlase to a yil dindiŋ.

english_verse: You tell every bragger, “Stop bragging!” And to the wicked you say, “Don't boast of your power!
translation_verse: Ma e naa kaŋɛ kumukpakpasowura fanɛ e sa maa kpeŋ a wu mbe kumu.

english_verse: Stop bragging! Quit telling me how great you are.”
translation_verse: Ma e naa kaŋɛ bumo fanɛ b yige kebaapuchi a malga bumo be keshi be asheŋ.”

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, victory doesn't come from the east or the west or from the desert.
translation_verse: Esa kikɛ maŋ wɔ epeŋilarkpa ŋko epeŋitɔrkpa ŋko durnya be kaplɛkama nɛ e tiŋ n ta esa n yili eyilikpagboŋ.

english_verse: You are the one who judges. You can take away power and give it to others.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ e naa ji kusɔ kama demu. Mo e naa bar eko kaseto nsaa maŋ eko so!

english_verse: You hold in your hand a cup filled with wine, strong and foaming. You will pour out some for every sinful person on this earth, and they will have to drink until it is gone.
translation_verse: K du fanɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ka kɔ kawiebi mbe enɔ to nna, nɛ mbe agbo du fanɛ yabra kpakpaso a wɔ kawiebi na to. E bee duga mbe agbo na nna a sa durnya to be amukpakpasowuraana, nɛ baa chise amo kikɛ nyam a nuu.

english_verse: But I will always tell about you, the God of Jacob, and I will sing your praise.
translation_verse: Ama ma ere beeŋ baa malga fo, Jeekɔb be Ebɔrɛ na, be asheŋ, nsaa boŋ nshɛ a kpaŋ fo mbaanaayɔ.

english_verse: Our Lord, you will destroy the power of evil people, but you will give strength to those who are good.
translation_verse: O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, feeŋ mur basa lubi be eleŋ, nseŋ shin nɛ basa niŋiso bre be eleŋ e ti so.

english_verse: You, our God, are famous in Judah and honored in Israel.
translation_verse: Ekama nyi Ebɔrɛ be asheŋ ashi Juda be efuli so, nɛ mbe ketre malɛ bee nya kemaŋkura Israɛl to.

english_verse: Your home is on Mount Zion, the city of peace.
translation_verse: Zayɔn be kebee nɛ k wɔ Jerusalɛm to na e la kakpa nɛ e wɔ.

english_verse: There you destroyed fiery arrows, shields, swords, and all the other weapons.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nɛ e buri m buri edompo na be atanyembi nɛ etokobi nɛ abɛlso be asɔkuŋso to.

english_verse: Brave warriors were robbed of what they had taken, and now they lie dead, unable to lift an arm.
translation_verse: Bedoŋ tiŋ n suge benapo lempo nɛ b kɔ dama na gba be asɔ; ama naniere bumo alɛ gba wu n dese a di nchaŋ to nɛ bumo be eleŋ nɛ kenyi kikɛ to jiga.

english_verse: God of Jacob, when you roar, enemy chariots and horses drop dead in their tracks.
translation_verse: Jeekɔb be Ebɔrɛ, fo ka ponte to, egbaŋɛ nɛ bumo be bediipo kikɛ tɔr nna n wu a dese shruum.

english_verse: Our God, you are fearsome, and no one can oppose you when you are angry.
translation_verse: Fo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e daga fanɛ ekama e baa ŋana fo. Fo baŋ nya agbo, esa kikɛ maaŋ tiŋ n yili fo anishito.

english_verse: From heaven you announced your decisions as judge! And all who live on this earth were terrified and silent
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛso nɛ fo wɔ nseŋ bɔ fo demuji be kubɔya; nɛ kufu tɔr durnya so, nɛ kakpa kikɛ wora shruum.

english_verse: when you took over as judge, ready to rescue everyone in need.
translation_verse: Jemanɛ nɛ fo kpa n niŋi to nɛ fo fara demuji m mɔlga basa nɛ baa ji awurfoŋ durnya to nna na.

english_verse: Even the most angry people will praise you when you are furious.
translation_verse: Kashenteŋto nɛ fo baŋ nya agbo, basa nɛ b nya agbo n wɔtɔ fo gba bee kpaŋ fo nna.

english_verse: Everyone, make your promises to the Lord your God and do what you promise. The Lord is fearsome, and all his servants should bring him gifts.
translation_verse: Men nase nnɔ n sa Enyɛnpe, menyi be Ebɔrɛ na. Menyi alɛ e wora m bɔlɔ men be nnɔ naseso na so. Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e daga keŋana, mo e daga fanɛ efuli pɔtɛana nɛ a kulti anyi na kikɛ be basa ka bar ŋkɛ m ba sa mo.

english_verse: God destroys the courage of rulers and kings and makes cowards of them.
translation_verse: Mo e naa bar bewura kama nɛ baa boo kenyɛn na kaseto; a shin nɛ baa ki befupo.

english_verse: I pray to you, Lord God, and I beg you to listen.
translation_verse: N shu n tre Ebɔrɛ nna a fin kechɛto. Ŋ ka shu n tre mo, nɛ e nu ma kushu na.

english_verse: In days filled with trouble, I search for you. And at night I tirelessly lift my hands in prayer, refusing comfort.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nɛ mee kule tɔrɔ be jemanɛ; mee maŋ ma enɔana so kanyɛ na kikɛ nna ashi kabɔrɛkule to, ama n daa maŋ nya kagbenewushi.

english_verse: When I think of you, I feel restless and weak.
translation_verse: N daŋ nyiŋi fo Ebɔrɛ na nna, nseŋ tekeŋto; n fɛ nfɛra ga, nɛ aba pɔ ma.

english_verse: Because of you, Lord God, I can't sleep. I am restless and can't even talk.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal fo, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na so, m maŋ tiŋ nɛ n di. Ewushi kikɛ maŋ wɔ ma to, m maŋ tiŋ nɛ m malga gba.

english_verse: I think of times gone by, of those years long ago.
translation_verse: Mee fɛ nchɛ nɛ a choŋ na nɛ nfɛ dra na be asheŋ nna.

english_verse: “Have you rejected me forever? Won't you be kind again?
translation_verse: “Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kini anyi nna n lɛ le mbaanaayɔ a? E maaŋ naŋ wu anyi kuwɔr a?

english_verse: Have you forgotten how to have pity? Do you refuse to show mercy because of your anger?”
translation_verse: Ama Ebɔrɛ teŋ so kananɛ baa wu kuwɔr nna a? E kpal agbo so m pɛ mbe kuwɔrwu be kasha nna ere a?”

english_verse: Then I said, “God Most High, what hurts me most is that you no longer help us with your mighty arm.”
translation_verse: Ade be kaman nɛ n fɛ le: “Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ, kusɔ nɛ k baa tɔrɔ ma ga e la fo ka maŋ naa ta fo eleŋgboŋ na a chɛ anyi to na.

english_verse: Our Lord, I will remember the things you have done, your miracles of long ago.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, meeŋ baa nyiŋi fo asheŋgboŋ nɛ emamachisheŋ nɛ fo wora dra dra na be asheŋ.

english_verse: I will think about each one of your mighty deeds.
translation_verse: Meeŋ baa fɛ asheŋ tumase nɛ fo wora na kikɛ be asheŋ.

english_verse: Everything you do is right, and no other god compares with you.
translation_verse: O Ebɔrɛ, kusɔ kama nɛ fee wora du cheembi nna. Kegbir kikɛ maŋ shi nsaa kɔ eleŋ fanɛ fo.

english_verse: You alone work miracles, and you have let nations see your mighty power.
translation_verse: Fo nawule e la Ebɔrɛ nɛ e bee wora emamachisheŋ; nsaa ŋini fo eleŋgboŋ ashi efuliana na be basa to.

english_verse: With your own arm you rescued your people, the descendants of Jacob and Joseph.
translation_verse: Fo eleŋgboŋ na nɛ fo ta m mɔlga fo basa nɛ b la Jeekɔb nɛ Josɛf be kaman to ebi na.

english_verse: The ocean looked at you, God, and it trembled deep down with fear.
translation_verse: O Ebɔrɛ, kewora fanɛ teku be nchu na ka wu fo, kufu pɛ amo nna nɛ kumo be kechimbi to baga to m pulgi to kufuso.

english_verse: Water flowed from the clouds. Thunder was heard above as your arrows of lightning flashed about.
translation_verse: Abɔrɛwɔlpa daŋ chulgi bɔrɛchu nna n wurge to; nɛ bɔrɛ nyɛkpɛ awɔlpa to nseŋ ponte to.

english_verse: Your thunder roared like chariot wheels. The world was made bright by lightning, and all the earth trembled.
translation_verse: Bɔrɛ na ka nyɛkpɛ m ponte to nɛ kusɔ kikɛ nu kumo. K ka nyɛkpɛ na nɛ durnya kikɛ fulto. K ka ponte to na nɛ kasawule gbuŋgbuŋ to fanɛ k kaa bee chicha na.

english_verse: You walked through the water of the mighty sea, but your footprints were never seen.
translation_verse: Fo daŋ nase ekpa teku be nchugboŋ na to nna, nɛ k wora fanɛ fo ka bɔla kumo to n choŋ; ama esa maŋ wu fo aya ka dese.

english_verse: You guided your people like a flock of sheep, and you chose Moses and Aaron to be their leaders.
translation_verse: Fo daŋ bɔla Mosis nɛ Ɛɛrɔn so nna n juŋkpar fo basa fanɛ mbolpɔkpapo na.”

english_verse: My friends, I beg you to listen as I teach.
translation_verse: Ma basa, men nu ma keŋini ere, nseŋ nu kusɔ nɛ mee kaŋɛ ere nɛnɛ.

english_verse: I will give instruction and explain the mystery of what happened long ago.
translation_verse: Meeŋ ta kanyiasheŋ be mmalga m bugi wulo to be mmalga nɛ a choŋ na to.

english_verse: and we will tell them to the next generation. We won't keep secret the glorious deeds and the mighty miracles of the Lord.
translation_verse: Anyi maaŋ ta amo ŋ ŋana anyi be mbia so. Anyeeŋ malga Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be eleŋgboŋ nɛ mbe asheŋgboŋ nɛ emamachisheŋ nɛ e wora na be asheŋ n sa anyi be mbia nɛ baaŋ ba anyi be kaman na.

english_verse: God gave his Law to Jacob's descendants, the people of Israel. And he told our ancestors to teach their children,
translation_verse: Mo e ta mbe mbraana n sa Israɛl be basa nɛ b la Jeekɔb be kaman to ebi na. Mo e kaŋɛ an nanaana fanɛ b baa ŋini bumo be mbia mbe mbraana na;

english_verse: so that each new generation would know his Law and tell it to the next.
translation_verse: saŋɛ na so mbia nɛ baaŋ ba kaman to na beeŋ koya amo nseŋ ŋini bumo alɛ be mbia amo.

english_verse: The warriors from Ephraim were armed with arrows, but they ran away when the battle began.
translation_verse: Kena be kachɛ ka fo, Efrayimebi nɛ b daa kɔ ata nɛ atanyembi to na daŋ lara keya nna n shile.

english_verse: They broke their agreement with God, and they turned their backs on his teaching.
translation_verse: B daa maŋ wora m bɔlɔ bumo nɛ Ebɔrɛ be kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre na so. B daŋ kini kewora mbe mbraana kasonu nna.

english_verse: God made a path in the sea and piled up the water as he led them across.
translation_verse: E daŋ shin nɛ teku na ku to nna, nseŋ shin nɛ nchu na ki fanɛ egbal a yil, nɛ e juŋkpar bumo m bɔla kumo to n choŋ.

english_verse: He guided them during the day with a cloud, and each night he led them with a flaming fire.
translation_verse: E daa bɔla kuwɔlpa so nna a ŋini bumo ekpa kapaso, nseŋ daa bɔla edɛ be kabulpi so a ŋini bumo ekpa kanyɛso malɛ.

english_verse: God made water flow from rocks he split open in the desert, and his people drank freely, as though from a lake.
translation_verse: E daŋ shin nɛ afalta pante a lar nchu a shile fanɛ mbombi nna ashi keshishɛrsawule so nɛ b nya nchu n nuu bumo be kepar.

english_verse: He made streams gush out like rivers from rocks.
translation_verse: Mo e daŋ shin nɛ nchu shi kefalta to n lar a shile fanɛ lɔr na.

english_verse: But in the desert, the people of God Most High kept sinning and rebelling.
translation_verse: Ama b kraŋ wora alubi n da Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ so; nseŋ lar mbe kaman ashi keshishɛrsawule na so.

english_verse: They challenged God by saying, “Can God provide food out here in the desert?
translation_verse: B daŋ malga nna ŋ gbiti Ebɔrɛ ŋ kaŋɛ le: “Ebɔrɛ beeŋ tiŋ n sa anyi ajibi kiyi ere to nfe nna ere a?

english_verse: It's true God struck the rock and water gushed out like a river, but can he give his people bread and meat?”
translation_verse: E ka daŋ shin nɛ kefalta na pante na, nchu daŋ lar a shile fanɛ mbombi na. Ama e kraa beeŋ tiŋ n sa anyi ajibi nna ere a? E beeŋ tiŋ n sa mbe basa eblaŋ nna ere a?”

english_verse: When the Lord heard this, he was angry and furious with Jacob's descendants, the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ka nu kusɔ nɛ b kaŋɛ na, nɛ e nya agbo ga nseŋ shin nɛ mbe edɛ suse so ashi mbe basa nɛ b la Jeekɔb be kaman to ebi to,

english_verse: They had refused to trust him, and they had doubted his saving power.
translation_verse: ŋkpal b ka daa maŋ yirda mo nseŋ daŋ ji mbe kumɔlga be eleŋ emɔrɔ so.

english_verse: But God gave a command to the clouds, and he opened the doors in the skies.
translation_verse: Ama e daŋ naŋ malga n sa awɔlpa nseŋ daŋ bugi esoso be mbuna

english_verse: He gave them more than enough, and each one of them ate this special food.
translation_verse: Amoso emalaika be ajibi nɛ b daŋ nya n ji; Ebɔrɛ daŋ sa bumo ajibi kama nɛ baaŋ tiŋ n ji nna.

english_verse: and it brought birds that covered the ground, like sand on the beach.
translation_verse: Afu na daŋ sulɔ mbuibi ko nna m ba sɔ kasawule na kikɛ so fanɛ teku ase be eshishɛr na.

english_verse: Then God made the birds fall in the camp of his people near their tents.
translation_verse: Basa na be keeyi to gbagba nɛ Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ mbuibi na tɔr ŋ kulti bumo be ewajɛbu n wɔtɔ.

english_verse: God became angry and killed the strongest and best from the families of Israel.
translation_verse: nɛ Ebɔrɛ be agbo koso bumo so, nɛ e shin nɛ bumo to be belempo wu. Israɛl be efuli so be mbifɔlbi e daŋ wu na.

english_verse: But the rest kept on sinning and would not trust God's miracles.
translation_verse: Ama amo nɛ amo kikɛ, b kraa wora alubi nna. Emamachisheŋ nɛ Ebɔrɛ wora na kikɛ be kaman, b kraa maŋ yirda mo.

english_verse: So he cut their lives short and made them terrified.
translation_verse: Amoso e daŋ shin nɛ bumo be ŋkpa ku so nna, nseŋ daŋ shin nɛ kufugboŋ ko tɔr bumo so.

english_verse: After he killed some of them, the others turned to him with all their hearts.
translation_verse: Jemanɛ kikɛ nɛ Ebɔrɛ baŋ shin nɛ bumo be beko wu, bumo nɛ b ka na bee tuba nna nsaa kule mo kenishipere so.

english_verse: They remembered God Most High, the mighty rock that kept them safe.
translation_verse: B daŋ nyiŋi fanɛ Ebɔrɛ la bumo be ekumpo nna, nseŋ daŋ naŋ nyiŋi fanɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ e la bumo be emɔlgapo.

english_verse: But they tried to flatter God, and they told him lies;
translation_verse: Ama bumo be nnɔ to be mmalga kikɛ la efɛ nna. Asheŋ kama nɛ baa malga maa shi bumo be ŋgbene to.

english_verse: Yet God was kind. He kept forgiving their sins and didn't destroy them. He often became angry, but never lost his temper.
translation_verse: Ama Ebɔrɛ kraa wu mbe basa kuwɔr. E daŋ ta bumo be alubi m paŋ bumo nna, nsaa maŋ mur bumo. Ale damta nɛ e pɛ mbe kagbene, a maŋ shin nɛ mbe agbo koso bumo so alegaiso.

english_verse: God remembered that they were made of flesh and were like a wind that blows once and then dies down.
translation_verse: E daŋ nyiŋi fanɛ b la eyur nɛ ŋklaŋ nna. B du fanɛ afu nɛ k bee ber a yɔ a maŋ naa laŋɛ nna.

english_verse: While they were in the desert, they often rebelled and made God sad.
translation_verse: Jemanɛ nɛ b daa wɔ keshishɛrsawule na so na, ale damta nɛ b daŋ lar Ebɔrɛ kaman n jija mbe kagbene!

english_verse: They kept testing him and caused terrible pain for the Holy One of Israel.
translation_verse: B daŋ baa wɔtɔ nna a wora mo a keni, nsaa wɔtɔ Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ cheembi na ebesa to.

english_verse: They forgot about his power and how he had rescued them from their enemies.
translation_verse: B daa maa nyiŋi mbe eleŋ nɛ e kɔ, bumo alɛ daa maa nyiŋi kachɛ nɛ e mɔlga bumo ashi bumo doŋana be enɔ to na gba.

english_verse: God showed them all kinds of wonderful miracles near Zoan in Egypt.
translation_verse: B daŋ teŋ emamachisheŋ nɛ e wora ashi Zowan be kebonfu so ashi Ijipt be efuli so na nna.

english_verse: He turned the rivers of Egypt into blood, and no one could drink from the streams.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ e daŋ shin nɛ Ijipt be elɔrana be nchu kilgi ŋ ki ŋklaŋ nɛ b daa maŋ nya nchu nuuso na.

english_verse: He sent swarms of flies to pester the Egyptians, and he sent frogs to cause them trouble.
translation_verse: E daŋ shin nɛ ashushombi ba sɔ kaplɛkama a tɔrɔ bumo nna; nɛ ebɔl lar bumo. E daŋ shin nɛ epulo ba ta kenishi m pere bumo ashi kasawule na so nna ga.

english_verse: He destroyed their grapevines and their fig trees with hail and floods.
translation_verse: E daŋ shin nɛ abɔrɛjembubi ba mur bumo be ndibi sɔrsoana nna, nseŋ shin nɛ kunyɔlɔ malɛ mur bumo be figi be ndibi kikɛ.

english_verse: Then he killed their cattle with hail and their other animals with lightning.
translation_verse: Mo e shin nɛ abɔrɛjembubi bri bumo be ana m mɔ, nseŋ shin nɛ bɔrɛ nyɛkpɛ m mɔ bumo be asɔbɔya nɛ a ka na.

english_verse: God was so angry and furious that he went into a rage and caused them great trouble by sending swarms of destroying angels.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ daŋ nya agbo nna nɛ mbe kagbene koso bumo so ga, fanɛ luwu be mbɔ damta ka mel abar so na.

english_verse: He killed the first-born son of each Egyptian family.
translation_verse: E daŋ shin nɛ Ijipt be efuli so be ewurkoŋnyɛn kikɛ wu nna.

english_verse: Then God led his people out of Egypt and guided them in the desert like a flock of sheep.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ Ebɔrɛ juŋkpar mbe basa fanɛ mbolpɔkpapo n lar Ijipt be efuli so m bɔla keshishɛrsawule so n choŋ.

english_verse: He led them safely along, and they were not afraid, but their enemies drowned in the sea.
translation_verse: E ka daa juŋkpar bumo so, kufu daa maa kɔ bumo; ama Teku Peper na daŋ mur bumo doŋana bre nna.

english_verse: God brought his people to the sacred mountain that he had taken by his own power.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ daŋ juŋkpar mbe basa nna n yɔ kepreŋsawule nɛ e bɔla mbe eleŋgboŋ so n suge n sa bumo na so.

english_verse: He made nations run from the tribes of Israel, and he let the tribes take over their land.
translation_verse: E daŋ ju efuli pɔtɛana na be basa nna n lar nseŋ barga kasawule na nɛ bumo be nwuana to n sa Israɛl be eyiri yiri nɛ b la mbe basa na.

english_verse: But the people tested God Most High, and they refused to obey his laws.
translation_verse: Ama b daŋ lar Ebɔrɛ kaman nseŋ wora Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na ŋ keni nna. B daa maŋ bɛ mbe mbraana so.

english_verse: God demanded all their love, but they made him angry by worshiping idols.
translation_verse: B daŋ pɔr agbirana nna n yili agurɔŋgu so a shuŋ; n shin nɛ Ebɔrɛ be kukɔrkɔ koso nɛ e nya agbo ga.

english_verse: So God became furious and completely rejected the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal kusɔ nɛ b wora na so, Ebɔrɛ daŋ nya agbo nna nseŋ kini Israɛl be basa na n lɛ.

english_verse: Then he deserted his home at Shiloh, where he lived here on earth.
translation_verse: E daŋ kini mbe wajɛbu nɛ e daa wɔ kumo to ashi mbe basa to ashi Shilo be kade to nna n lɛ.

english_verse: God took out his anger on his chosen ones and let them be killed by enemy swords.
translation_verse: E daŋ nya agbo nna n wɔtɔ mo gbagba be basa nseŋ shin nɛ bumo doŋana mɔ bumo.

english_verse: Fire destroyed the young men, and the young women were left with no one to marry.
translation_verse: Edɛ e daŋ mur bumo be mbrantiɛbia, nɛ bumo be besuŋgurbi maŋ nya benyɛn nɛ b kil.

english_verse: Priests died violent deaths, but their widows were not allowed to mourn.
translation_verse: Bɔrɛmatapoana na daŋ wu luwu nyaŋgraŋ nna, bumo be bekulpoche maŋ nya n shu bumo be nli gba.

english_verse: Finally the Lord woke up, like a soldier startled from a drunken sleep.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kpa niŋi to fanɛ esa ka tiŋi edi to, ŋko enapo ka diewu ŋ koso na.

english_verse: God scattered his enemies and made them ashamed forever.
translation_verse: E daŋ bri mo doŋana nna n ju, n shin nɛ b ji nyɔmɔ mbaanaayɔ.

english_verse: Instead he chose the tribe of Judah, and he chose Mount Zion, the place he loves.
translation_verse: Juda be yiri to ebi nɛ Zayɔn be kebee nɛ e daa sha ga ashi Jerusalɛm to na nɛ e daŋ lara n yili n sa mbe kumu.

english_verse: There he built his temple as lofty as the mountains and as solid as the earth he made to last forever.
translation_verse: Kumo be awɔlto, nɛ e daŋ pɔr mbe bɔrɛlambu nɛ kumo be gbaltɔlase daa kɔ eleŋ fanɛ kasawule nɛ e to n yili mbaanaayɔ na.

english_verse: The Lord God chose David to be his servant and took him from tending sheep
translation_verse: Ewura Deevid nɛ e daa kpa mbolpɔ na nɛ e daŋ lara fanɛ mbe kayɛrbi.

english_verse: David treated the people fairly and guided them with wisdom.
translation_verse: Ewura Deevid malɛ daŋ ta kagbene koŋwule n juŋkpar bumo nseŋ wora asheŋ kanyiasheŋ so ashi bumo to nna.

english_verse: They have fed the bodies of your servants to flesh-eating birds; your loyal people are food for savage animals.
translation_verse: B ta fo basa nɛ b wu na n sa ejita nɛ kupuŋ to be asɔbɔya nɛ e bee ji.

english_verse: All Jerusalem is covered with their blood, and there is no one left to bury them.
translation_verse: B chulgi ŋklaŋ n wurge nɛ e bee shile fanɛ nchu ashi Jerusalɛm to. Esa kikɛ maŋ wɔtɔ nɛ e puli bubuni na.

english_verse: Every nation around us sneers and makes fun.
translation_verse: Efuliana nɛ a kulti anyi na be basa bee mushe nsaa wora anyi eyurto nna.

english_verse: Our Lord, will you keep on being angry? Will your angry feelings keep flaming up like fire?
translation_verse: O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, fo nya agbo n wɔtɔ anyi nna mbaanaayɔ a? Fo agbo kraa beeŋ baa suse fanɛ edɛ nna a?

english_verse: Get angry with those nations that don't know you and won't worship you!
translation_verse: Laŋɛ fo agbo na n deŋi efuli pɔtɛana nɛ b maa bunyaŋ fo ŋko a shu a tre fo ketre na so,

english_verse: They have gobbled up Jacob's descendants and left the land in ruins.
translation_verse: ŋkpal b ka mɔ Jeekɔb be kaman to ebi nseŋ mur fo efuli na so.

english_verse: Don't make us pay for the sins of our ancestors. Have pity and come quickly! We are completely helpless.
translation_verse: Sa maŋ gberge anyi kusoe ŋkpal an nanaana be alubi so. Wu anyi kuwɔr naniere. Ŋkpal manɛ so, anyi maŋ naa kɔ tama kikɛ.

english_verse: Our God, you keep us safe. Now help us! Rescue us. Forgive our sins and bring honor to yourself.
translation_verse: O Ebɔrɛ nɛ fo la anyi be emɔlgapo, chɛ anyi to! Ŋkpal fo ketre be kemaŋkura so, mɔlga anyi nseŋ ta anyi be alubi m paŋ anyi.

english_verse: Why should nations ask us, “Where is your God?” Let us and the other nations see you take revenge for your servants who died a violent death.
translation_verse: Manɛ nna nɛ efuli pɔtɛana na bee bishi anyi fanɛ, nnɛ nɛ menyi be Ebɔrɛ na wɔ? Shin nɛ an wu kasogberge nɛ k bee ba efuliana na so, ŋkpal b ka chulgi basa nɛ b shuŋ fo be ŋklaŋ n wurge so.

english_verse: Listen to the prisoners groan! Let your mighty power save all who are sentenced to die.
translation_verse: Kaŋ kusoe n nu basa nɛ b wɔ kabuti to be kushu. Ta fo eleŋgboŋ na n sɔ basa nɛ baa shin nɛ b mɔ na n yige.

english_verse: Each of those nations sneered at you, our Lord. Now let others sneer at them, seven times as much.
translation_verse: O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, fo e naaŋ ka efuli pɔtɛana nɛ a kulti anyi ere kukɔ ale shunu so; ŋkpal b ka tege fo na so.

english_verse: Then we, your people, will always thank you. We are like sheep with you as our shepherd, and all generations will hear us praise you.
translation_verse: Saŋɛ na so anyi nɛ an la fo basa, a du fanɛ fo mbolpɔ ere, beeŋ baa di fo epaŋ nsaa kpaŋ fo mbaanaayɔ.

english_verse: Shepherd of Israel, you lead the descendants of Joseph, and you sit on your throne above the winged creatures. Listen to our prayer and let your light shine
translation_verse: O Israɛl be ekenipo, nu anyi be kekule! Fo nɛ fee juŋkpar Josɛf be kaman to ebi fanɛ mbolpɔ nseŋ chena fo kuwurputi so ashi asɔ pɔrso nɛ baa tre chɛrubim na be nferinto na,

english_verse: for the tribes of Ephraim, Benjamin, and Manasseh. Save us by your power.
translation_verse: lara fo kumu ŋ ŋini Efrayim nɛ Bɛnjamin nɛ Manase be eyiri to ebi. Ŋini fo eleŋ nseŋ ba mɔlga anyi!

english_verse: Our God, make us strong again! Smile on us and save us.
translation_verse: O Ebɔrɛ, naŋ shin nɛ an nya eleŋ! Mushe n wɔtɔ anyi nseŋ mɔlga anyi.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, how much longer will the prayers of your people make you angry?
translation_verse: O Enyɛnpetale Ewurbɔrɛ, jemanɛ mo nɛ fo basa be kabɔrɛkule maaŋ naa nu fo agbo?

english_verse: You gave us tears for food, and you made us drink them by the bowlful.
translation_verse: Fo shin nɛ anishichubi ki bumo be ajibi jiso nɛ nchu nuuso.

english_verse: Our God, make us strong again! Smile on us and save us.
translation_verse: O Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ, naŋ mushe n wɔtɔ anyi, nɛ an naŋ nya kumɔlga.

english_verse: Shade from this vine covered the mountains. Its branches climbed the mighty cedars
translation_verse: Nɛ kumo be kayul e daŋ m buu abeeana na so nɛ kumo be ayabi malɛ e daŋ m buu sida be ndibigboŋ so.

english_verse: and stretched to the sea; its new growth reached to the river.
translation_verse: Nseŋ daŋ n ya fo Mɛditerenia be teku na ase, n ta n ya fo Yufreetes be lɔr na ase gba.

english_verse: Our Lord, why have you torn down the wall from around the vineyard? You let everyone who walks by pick the grapes.
translation_verse: Manɛ nna nɛ fo buri kunji nɛ k bee kuŋ kumo na to, nɛ ekama nɛ e bɔla ndoŋ a choŋ bee nya kumo be asɔrso a chuge?

english_verse: Now the vine is gobbled up by pigs from the forest and other wild animals.
translation_verse: Kupuŋ to be asɔbɔya alubi gba bee nya amo be asɔrso a ji.

english_verse: God All-Powerful, please do something! Look down from heaven and see what's happening to this vine.
translation_verse: O Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ, naŋ bɛta m ba anyi kutɔ! Shi ebɔrɛso n to kenishi ŋ keni anyi nseŋ ba mɔlga fo basa!

english_verse: With your own hands you planted its roots, and you raised it as your very own.
translation_verse: Ba mɔlga kefeelebi popɔrbi nɛ fo gbagba fɛa nseŋ shin nɛ k daŋ n nya eleŋ ga na.

english_verse: Enemies chopped the vine down and set it on fire. Now show your anger and destroy them.
translation_verse: Bedoŋ ba ku kefeelebi na n lɛ nseŋ nya edɛ n wɔtɔ kumo to. Naniere shin nɛ fo agbo e ba mur bedoŋ na.

english_verse: But help the one who sits at your right side, the one you raised to be your very own.
translation_verse: Chɛ esa nɛ e chena fo enɔ jisa so na to. Mo e la nyiŋgbasa pibinyɛn nɛ fo bela mo n sa fo kumu na.

english_verse: Then we will never turn away. Put new life into us, and we will worship you.
translation_verse: Anyi maaŋ naŋ lar fo kaman kikɛ. Sa anyi ŋkpa popɔr nɛ an baa bunyaŋ fo.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, make us strong again! Smile on us and save us.
translation_verse: O Enyɛnpetale Ewurbɔrɛ, naŋ bɛta anyi m ba fo kutɔ! Mushe n wɔtɔ anyi n shin nɛ an nya kumɔlga.

english_verse: Be happy and shout to God who makes us strong! Shout praises to the God of Jacob.
translation_verse: Men boŋ nshɛ kagbenefuliso n sa Ebɔrɛ nɛ e bee sa anyi eleŋ na! Men boŋ nshɛ ŋ kpaŋ an nananyɛn Jeekɔb be Ebɔrɛ na!

english_verse: Sing as you play tambourines and the lovely sounding stringed instruments.
translation_verse: Men fara a boŋ nshɛ nsaa laŋ echakachaka a wɔtɔ; men baa laŋ ejaŋjilaŋ nɛ egoji a boŋ nshɛ belbelso.

english_verse: Sound the trumpets and start the New Moon Festival. We must also celebrate when the moon is full.
translation_verse: Men foŋ mbel n fara kufɔl popɔr be kejigboŋ be kasheŋwora na kufɔl kikɛ be kachɛ sososo nɛ kumo be kachɛ baŋɛto na.

english_verse: This is the law in Israel, and it was given to us by the God of Jacob.
translation_verse: Mbra nɛ k dese Israɛl be efuli so nna na; an nananyɛn Jeekɔb be Ebɔrɛ na e yili kumo.

english_verse: The descendants of Joseph were told to obey it, when God led them out from the land of Egypt. In a voice unknown to me, I heard someone say:
translation_verse: Mo e ta kumo n sa Israɛl be basa, nɛ b la Josɛf be kaman to ebi na, jemanɛ nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ juŋkpar bumo n lar Ijipt be efuli so na. N daŋ nu esa ko ka kaŋɛ ma ashi ŋgbar nɛ m maŋ nyi to le:

english_verse: “I lifted the burden from your shoulder and took the heavy basket from your hands.
translation_verse: “Ma e daŋ bɛge esulɔ gbɛgbɛso na ashi menyi so, nseŋ sɔ nlantaŋɛ gbɛgbɛso na menyi be enɔana to.

english_verse: When you were in trouble, I rescued you, and from the thunderclouds, I answered your prayers. Later I tested you at Meribah Spring.
translation_verse: Men ka daa wɔ etɔrɔ to, ma nɛ men shu n tre, nɛ m mɔlga menyi. Abɔrɛwɔlpa to nɛ n daa wɔ nseŋ nu menyi be kushu. Kumo be kaman nɛ n wora menyi ŋ keni ashi Mɛriba be kebuye na ase.

english_verse: “Listen, my people, while I, the Lord, correct you! Israel, if you would only pay attention to me!
translation_verse: O ma basa, men nu ma kasokpele ere. Israɛlebi, n daa beeŋ baa sha fanɛ men nu n sa ma!

english_verse: Don't worship foreign gods or bow down to gods you know nothing about.
translation_verse: Men sa maŋ kaŋ shuŋ efuli pɔtɛ kikɛ be kegbir, ŋko kegbir kikɛ nɛ menyi maŋ nyi shɛŋ a laŋɛ kumo kaplɛa so!

english_verse: I am the Lord your God. I rescued you from Egypt. Just ask, and I will give you whatever you need.
translation_verse: Ma e la Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ nɛ e lara menyi ashi Ijipt be efuli so m ba na. Menyi ere e bugi kɔnɔ ŋ kaŋɛ ma kusɔ nɛ menyee sha de, nɛ n wora kumo n sa menyi.

english_verse: “But, my people, Israel, you refused to listen, and you would have nothing to do with me!
translation_verse: Ama ma basa maa nu a sa ma; Israɛl be basa na maa wora ma kasonu.

english_verse: So I let you be stubborn and keep on following your own advice.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal loŋ so nɛ n yige bumo n sa bumo be ŋkpensheŋ be kebaawɔtɔ nɛ b wɔtɔ a wora asheŋ nɛ baa sha.

english_verse: “My people, Israel, if only you would listen and do as I say!
translation_verse: Ma basa, Israɛlebi, daa beeŋ nu n sa ma nseŋ bɛ ma ekpaana so nna,

english_verse: I, the Lord, would quickly defeat your enemies with my mighty power.
translation_verse: ndafanɛ ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na daa beeŋ nya manaŋ n ta ma eleŋgboŋ na m pɔɔ bumo doŋana kikɛ so n sa bumo.

english_verse: Everyone who hates me would come crawling, and that would be the end of them.
translation_verse: Bekama nɛ b kishi ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na, beeŋ ta kufu m ba jɔŋɛ ma ase; bumo alɛ be kasogberge beeŋ baa wɔtɔ mbaanaayɔ.

english_verse: But I would feed you with the finest bread and with the best honey until you were full.”
translation_verse: Ama menyi ere, ayu lela nɛ abee to be mushoŋchu nɛ meeŋ ta m bela menyi nɛ men ji m moɛ.”

english_verse: When all the other gods have come together, the Lord God judges them and says:
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ e naa juŋkpar ebɔrɛso be nshɛrgboŋ na; mo e naa ji agbirana na demu a kaŋɛ amo le:

english_verse: “How long will you keep judging unfairly and favoring evil people?
translation_verse: “A maŋ daga men baa ji demu a kpɛa beko to; men sa maa ji a chɛ kumukpakpaso wuraana to!

english_verse: Be fair to the poor and to orphans. Defend the helpless and everyone in need.
translation_verse: Men baa ji asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so a sa bepɔshipo nɛ amunibi nɛ betentaŋasepo nɛ basa nɛ b maŋ kɔ echɛtopo kikɛ na.

english_verse: Rescue the weak and homeless from the powerful hands of heartless people.
translation_verse: Men baa kɔ a suge bepɔshipo nɛ betentaŋasepo ashi kumukpakpasowuraana be enɔ to.

english_verse: “None of you know or understand a thing. You live in darkness, while the foundations of the earth tremble.
translation_verse: Menyi be ekama maŋ nyi shɛŋ ŋko a pin asheŋ to! Tentembiri to nɛ men wɔ a nite a kulti; saŋɛ so nɛ durnya kikɛ be gbaltɔlase bee gbuŋgbuŋ.
