english_verse: “I, the Most High God, say that all of you are gods and also my own children.
translation_verse: Ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na e kaŋɛ fanɛ men kikɛ la agbirana nna nsaa la ŋ gbagba be asɔ toso.

english_verse: But you will die, just like everyone else, including powerful rulers.”
translation_verse: Ama menyeeŋ baa wu fanɛ edimɛdi; menyi alɛ be ŋkpa beeŋ baa loge fanɛ ewurjipo kama peya.”

english_verse: Do something, God! Judge the nations of the earth; they belong to you.
translation_verse: O Ebɔrɛ, koso n ji durnya demu, ŋkpal manɛ so, efuliana na kikɛ la fo peya nna.

english_verse: Our God, don't just sit there, silently doing nothing!
translation_verse: O Ebɔrɛ, sa maŋ wora shruum, n lo to a maa wora shɛŋ!

english_verse: Your hateful enemies are turning against you and rebelling.
translation_verse: Keni, fo doŋana e lar fo kaman nseŋ koso a kɔ fo na.

english_verse: They say, “Let's wipe out the nation of Israel and make sure that no one remembers its name!”
translation_verse: B yɛ: “Men ba nɛ an ya mur bumo be efuli na, nɛ esa maaŋ naa nyiŋi Israɛl be asheŋ hale mbaanaayɔ.”

english_verse: All of them fully agree in their plans against you, and among them are
translation_verse: B wora kɔnɔkoŋwule nna ŋ kre fanɛ baaŋ chɛ abar ŋ kɔ fo.

english_verse: Our Lord, punish all of them as you punished Midian. Destroy them, as you destroyed Sisera and Jabin at Kishon Creek
translation_verse: Wora bumo kusɔ nɛ fo wora Midianebi nɛ basa nɛ baa tre Sisɛra nɛ Jabin, ashi Kishɔn be lɔr na ase na.

english_verse: Our God, scatter them around like dust in a whirlwind.
translation_verse: O anyi be Ebɔrɛ, shin nɛ b ki fanɛ eshishɛr ŋko amimi nɛ afu foŋ n ya lɛ na.

english_verse: Just as flames destroy forests on the mountains,
translation_verse: Kananɛ edɛ baa ji kupo na, ŋko a suse abee so na,

english_verse: Make them blush with shame, until they turn and worship you, our Lord.
translation_verse: O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, shin nɛ b ji anishinyɔr, saŋɛ na so basa beeŋ yɛla kenishi to n fin fo.

english_verse: Let them be forever ashamed and confused. Let them die in disgrace.
translation_verse: Shin nɛ b kɔ n tɔr nɛ kufu e pɛ bumo mbaanaayɔ, nseŋ shin nɛ b wu ŋaba be luwu.

english_verse: Make them realize that you are the Lord Most High, the only ruler of earth!
translation_verse: Shin nɛ b pin fanɛ fo e la Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ. Fo alɛ nawule e naa ji kuwura durnya kikɛ so.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, your temple is so lovely!
translation_verse: O Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ, fo bɔrɛlambu na walɛ pasaa!

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, my King and my God, sparrows find a home near your altars; swallows build nests there to raise their young.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ nɛ fo la ma Ewura nɛ ma Ebɔrɛ. Etitibi nɛ abɔrɛpɔpɔbi kikɛ tɔ bumo be asha nna m mata fo bɔrɛsure nsaa to a bure ndoŋ.

english_verse: You bless everyone who lives in your house, and they sing your praises.
translation_verse: Kagbenefuli la bekama nɛ b wɔ fo bɔrɛlambu to a boŋ nshɛ jemanɛ kikɛ e kpaŋ fo na peya nna.

english_verse: You bless all who depend on you for their strength and all who deeply desire to visit your temple.
translation_verse: Kagbenefuli la bekama nɛ baa nya eleŋ fo kutɔ nsaa pere kenishi a yɔ Zayɔn be kebee so n ya kaa shuŋ fo na peya nna.

english_verse: Your people grow stronger, and you, the God of gods, will be seen in Zion.
translation_verse: Fo basa bee nya eleŋ nna a ti so, n ya fo fanɛ ekama ka beeŋ baa tiŋ a ba Ebɔrɛ na be anishito ashi Zayɔn be kebee na so.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, the God of Jacob, please answer my prayer!
translation_verse: O Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ, nu ma kabɔrɛkule; O Jeekɔb be Ebɔrɛ, kaŋ kusoe n nu ŋ kutɔ!

english_verse: You are the shield that protects your people, and I am your chosen one. Won't you smile on me?
translation_verse: O Ebɔrɛ, nɛfa anyi be ewura, nɛ fo gbagba lara n sa fo kumu na.

english_verse: One day in your temple is better than a thousand anywhere else. I would rather serve in your house, than live in the homes of the wicked.
translation_verse: Keji kachɛ koŋwule ashi fo bɔrɛlambu to bɔ keji nchɛ kagboŋ ashi kakpa pɔtɛ. Ŋ ka yili ma Ebɔrɛ be lambu be kabuna to bɔ ŋ ka wɔ kumukpakpasowura pe.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, you are like the sun and also like a shield. You treat us with kindness and with honor, never denying any good thing to those who live right.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na du fanɛ epeŋi nɛ kebɛlso be kusɔ kuŋso nna. Mo e naa wu kuwɔr nsaa ta bunyaŋ a buu esa so, mo alɛ maa ta kusɔ lela a ŋana basa niŋiso so.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, you bless everyone who trusts you.
translation_verse: O Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ, kagbenefuli la esa kama nɛ e yirda fo na peya nna!

english_verse: Our Lord, you have blessed your land and made all go well for Jacob's descendants.
translation_verse: O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, fo e nɛfa fo kasawule nseŋ shin nɛ kusɔ kama nite nɛnɛ n sa Israɛlebi nɛ b la Jeekɔb be kaman to ebi na.

english_verse: You have forgiven the sin and taken away the guilt of your people.
translation_verse: Fo e ta fo basa be alubi m paŋ bumo nɛ kejimbri maŋ naa wɔ bumo so.

english_verse: Your fierce anger is no longer aimed at us.
translation_verse: Fo daŋ kaa kagbene nna, n nya agbo n wɔtɔ bumo.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, you save us! Please bring us back home and don't be angry.
translation_verse: O Ebɔrɛ nɛ fo la anyi be emɔlgapo, naŋ bɛta anyi m ba fo kutɔ, nsaa maŋ nya agbo n wɔtɔ anyi!

english_verse: Will you always be angry with us and our families?
translation_verse: Feeŋ nya agbo n wɔtɔ anyi nɛ anyi be nnaŋ to ebi mbaanaayɔ a?

english_verse: Won't you give us fresh life and let your people be glad because of you?
translation_verse: Naŋ sa anyi eleŋ nɛ anyi, nɛ an la fo basa na be ŋgbene e baa fuli fo so nɛ an baa kpaŋ fo.

english_verse: I will listen to you, Lord God, because you promise peace to those who are faithful and no longer foolish.
translation_verse: Mee kaŋ kusoe a nu kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee kaŋɛ nna. E nase kayurwushi be kɔnɔ n sa anyi, mbe basa; nɛ anyi maŋ naŋ bɛta n yɔ anyi be kawulisheŋ to nna.

english_verse: You are ready to rescue everyone who worships you, so that you will live with us in all your glory.
translation_verse: Kashenteŋto e wora shiriya nɛ e mɔlga bekama nɛ baa ŋana mo na nna; saŋɛ na so mo gbagba be kemaŋkura beeŋ baa wɔ anyi be kasawule so.

english_verse: Love and loyalty will come together; goodness and peace will unite.
translation_verse: Kasha nɛ kashenteŋji beeŋ ba abar so, nɛ alelasheŋ nɛ kayurwushi malɛ e ki kukoŋwule.

english_verse: Loyalty will sprout from the ground; justice will look down from the sky above.
translation_verse: Edimɛdi be kashenteŋji beeŋ shi kasawule so nna; nɛ Ebɔrɛ be kebaawɔtɔ niŋiso bee shi ebɔrɛso.

english_verse: Our Lord, you will bless us; our land will produce wonderful crops.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ nɛfa anyi nɛ anyi be kasawule e wora adɔjibi nɛnɛ.

english_verse: Justice will march in front, making a path for you to follow.
translation_verse: Kebaawɔtɔ niŋiso beeŋ juŋkpar a lɔŋɛ akpa a sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nɛ e baa bɛ so.

english_verse: Please listen, Lord, and answer my prayer! I am poor and helpless.
translation_verse: O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, kaŋ kusoe n nu ma kekule, ŋkpal manɛ so, etirpo nɛ etentaŋasepo e la ma.

english_verse: Protect me and save me because you are my God. I am your faithful servant, and I trust you.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal ŋ kaa bee nu a sa fo so, mɔlga ma ashi luwu to. Ŋkpal ŋ ka la fo kayɛrbi nseŋ yirda fo so, baa kuŋ ma.

english_verse: Be kind to me! I pray to you all day.
translation_verse: O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, wu ma kuwɔr! Kachɛ lelemu nɛ mee shu a tre fo.

english_verse: Make my heart glad! I serve you, and my prayer is sincere.
translation_verse: Shin nɛ fo kayɛrbi be kagbene e fuli mo; ŋkpal ŋ ka shi ma kagbene to a kule fo so.

english_verse: You willingly forgive, and your love is always there for those who pray to you.
translation_verse: O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, fo la esa lela nɛ fee ta alubi a paŋ nna. Fo alɛ kɔ kasha damta n sa bumo nɛ baa shu a tre fo na nna.

english_verse: When I am in trouble, I pray, knowing you will listen.
translation_verse: M baa wɔ tɔrɔ to, fo nɛ mee shu a tre; ma alɛ nyi fanɛ fee nu ma kabɔrɛkule.

english_verse: You created each nation, and they will all bow down to worship and honor you.
translation_verse: Efuliana nɛ fo to ere be basa beeŋ ba jɔŋɛ fo ase m bunyaŋ fo n shin nɛ fo ketre e nya kemaŋkura.

english_verse: You perform great wonders because you alone are God.
translation_verse: Fo ka la Ebɔrɛ so, fo nawule e naa wora emamachisheŋ nɛ e bee mɔ kɔnɔ.

english_verse: With all my heart I thank you. I praise you, Lord God.
translation_verse: O Enyɛnpe ma Ebɔrɛ, meeŋ bugi ma kagbene to ŋ kpaŋ fo, nseŋ maŋkura fo ketre mbaanaayɔ.

english_verse: Your love for me is so great that you protected me from death and the grave.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, kasha nɛ fo kɔ n sa ma na shi alegaiso! Fo mɔlga ma ashi luwu gbagba to.

english_verse: Proud and violent enemies, who don't care about you, have ganged up to attack and kill me.
translation_verse: O Ebɔrɛ, kamoowuwuraana koso ma so nna; nɛ basa lubi cha abar a fin ma nɛ b mɔ. Bumo alɛ kikɛ maŋ ta fo n tre shɛŋ.

english_verse: But you, the Lord God, are kind and merciful. You don't easily get angry, and your love can always be trusted.
translation_verse: Ama fo, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na, la ewɔrwupo nɛ kasha be Ebɔrɛ nna. Fo la esa nna nsaa kɔ kanyiti, a wu kuwɔr jemanɛ kikɛ.

english_verse: I serve you, Lord, and I am the child of one of your servants. Look on me with kindness. Make me strong and save me.
translation_verse: Keni ma nseŋ wu ma kuwɔr! Sa fo kayɛrbi fo gbagba be eleŋ na nseŋ mɔlga fo kenyache pibinyɛn.

english_verse: Zion was built by the Lord on the holy mountain,
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na pɔr mbe kadegboŋ n yili kebee cheembi na so nna.

english_verse: and he loves that city more than any other place in all of Israel.
translation_verse: Mo alɛ bee sha kadegboŋ na a chɔ kade kikɛ ashi Israɛl be efuli na kikɛ so.

english_verse: Zion, you are the city of God, and wonderful things are told about you.
translation_verse: Jerusalɛm la Ebɔrɛ be kadegboŋ nna, nɛ baa malga asheŋ lela damta ga a laŋɛ kumo be kaplɛa so.

english_verse: God Most High will strengthen the city of Zion. Then everyone will say, “We were born here too.”
translation_verse: Kashenteŋto, kusɔ nɛ baaŋ baa kaŋɛ a laŋɛ Jerusalɛm be kaplɛa so nde: “Jerusalɛm to nɛ b kurge kuti nɛ kuti. Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na malɛ e naa sa kumo eleŋ.”

english_verse: The Lord will make a list of his people, and all who were born here will be included.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ shin nɛ b sibɛ mbe basa be atre n nase nseŋ ta bekama nɛ b kurge ndoŋ gba be atre n ti so fanɛ b ka la Jerusalɛm to be ndetobia na;

english_verse: You keep me safe, Lord God. So when I pray at night,
translation_verse: O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ fo la ma emɔlgapo, kapa nɛ kanyɛ, fo nɛ mee shu a tre.

english_verse: please listen carefully to each of my concerns.
translation_verse: Jande nu ma kabɔrɛkule nseŋ kaŋ kusoe n nu ma kushu.

english_verse: I am deeply troubled and close to death;
translation_verse: Etɔrɔ damta e ba ma so, hale nɛ n taga to luwu.

english_verse: You have put me in the deepest and darkest grave;
translation_verse: Fo ta ma n lɛ nchaŋ chiŋgeliŋ nɛ k biri to mina to nna.

english_verse: your anger rolls over me like ocean waves.
translation_verse: Fo kanya agbo muni ma so nna fanɛ nchu ka muni esa so na.

english_verse: You have made my friends turn in horror from me. I am a prisoner who cannot escape,
translation_verse: Fo shin nɛ nteriana kini ma n lɛ, nɛ ma asheŋ bee nu bumo agbo. M baŋ nyaŋto nna a wɔtɔ, a maaŋ naŋ tiŋ n suge ma kumu.

english_verse: and I am almost blind because of my sorrow. Each day I lift my hands in prayer to you, Lord.
translation_verse: Ma alɛ shu nna m puŋi anishi, ŋkpal awurfoŋ nɛ kagbenejijaso. O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, fo nɛ mee maŋ ma enɔana so a shu a tre karechɛ kikɛ.

english_verse: Do you work miracles for the dead? Do they stand up and praise you?
translation_verse: Fo maa wora emamachisheŋ a sa bubuni. Bumo alɛ maa koso a kpaŋ fo.

english_verse: Are your love and loyalty announced in the world of the dead?
translation_verse: B maa malga fo kasha nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na ŋko fo kashenteŋji be asheŋ ashi bubuni to.

english_verse: Do they know of your miracles or your saving power in the dark world below where all is forgotten?
translation_verse: B maa wu fo emamachisheŋ ashi kakpa nɛ k biri to mina; ŋko a nyi fo alelasheŋ be asheŋ ashi kakpa nɛ b maŋ naa nyiŋi shɛŋ be asheŋ.

english_verse: Why do you reject me? Why do you turn from me?
translation_verse: O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, manɛ nna nɛ fee kini ma a lɛ, nsaa ta fo kumu a ŋana ma so?

english_verse: Ever since I was a child, I have been sick and close to death. You have terrified me and made me helpless.
translation_verse: Ma kebia to kikɛ nɛ n ji awurfoŋ, hale a taga to luwu gba kuraa. Fo kasogberge shin nɛ kufugboŋ tɔr ma so, hale ma aba pɔ ma ga.

english_verse: Your anger is like a flood! And I am shattered by your furious attacks
translation_verse: Fo agbo ki fanɛ nchu nna m muni ma so; nɛ fo etɔrɔ malɛ mur ma cheche.

english_verse: that strike each day and from every side.
translation_verse: Karechɛ kikɛ a kulti ma n wɔtɔ kaba kama so nna.

english_verse: My friends and neighbors have turned against me because of you, and now darkness is my only companion.
translation_verse: Fo shin nɛ nteri kpakpasoana nɛ ma beshapo kikɛ kini ma n lɛ nseŋ kplaŋ ma so, nɛ k wora fanɛ tentembiri e ki nteri kpakpaso.

english_verse: Our Lord, I will sing of your love forever. Everyone yet to be born will hear me praise your faithfulness.
translation_verse: O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, meeŋ baa boŋ nshɛ a laŋɛ fo kasha nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na be kaplɛa so jemanɛ kikɛ. Ma alɛ beeŋ naa ber fo kashenteŋji na be kebomboŋ mbaanaayɔ.

english_verse: I will tell them, “God's love can always be trusted, and his faithfulness lasts as long as the heavens.”
translation_verse: Meeŋ kaŋɛ ekama fanɛ fo kasha wɔtɔ nna mbaanaayɔ, nɛ fo kashenteŋji malɛ wɔ ebɔrɛso jemanɛ kikɛ.

english_verse: You said, “David, my servant, is my chosen one, and this is the agreement I made with him:
translation_verse: Fo yɛ: “Ma nɛ esa nɛ n lara na wora kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre nna. Ma alɛ nase kɔnɔ nna n sa ma kayɛrbi Deevid fanɛ

english_verse: Our Lord, let the heavens now praise your miracles, and let all your angels praise your faithfulness.
translation_verse: O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, shin nɛ asɔ nɛ a wɔ ebɔrɛso e baa kpaŋ fo emamachisheŋ, nseŋ shin nɛ fo emalaika e baa kpaŋ fo kashenteŋji.

english_verse: You are the most fearsome of all who live in heaven; all the others fear and greatly honor you.
translation_verse: Fo nɛ ekama bee ŋana ga ashi ebɔrɛso ndoŋ. Fo asheŋ malɛ bee keta kufu nsaa kɔ bunyaŋ ga a chɔ bekama nɛ b wɔ ebɔrɛso.

english_verse: You are Lord God All-Powerful! No one is as loving and faithful as you are.
translation_verse: Fo e la Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na. Ekama maŋ naa kɔ kasha nsaa ji kashenteŋ fanɛ fo.

english_verse: The heavens and the earth belong to you. And so does the world with all its people because you created them
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛso nɛ kasawule so kikɛ la feya nna; fo e to durnya nɛ kusɔ kama nɛ k wɔ kumo to.

english_verse: You are strong and mighty!
translation_verse: Fo shibi nsaa kɔ eleŋ pasaa!

english_verse: Your kingdom is ruled by justice and fairness with love and faithfulness leading the way.
translation_verse: Fee ji kuwura ekpa niŋiso so, nsaa ji asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so nna. Kasha nɛ kashenteŋji bee dii efuli kusɔ kama nɛ fee wora to nna.

english_verse: Our Lord, you bless those who join in the festival and walk in the brightness of your presence.
translation_verse: O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, kagbenefuli la bekama nɛ baa bugi ŋgbene to a bunyaŋ fo nsaa wɔ fo kefultogboŋ na to na peya nna.

english_verse: We are happy all day because of you, and your saving power brings honor to us.
translation_verse: Baa ji eyur nna ashi fo ketre to karechɛ lelemu kikɛ, nsaa kpaŋ fo ŋkpal fo alelasheŋ so.

english_verse: Your own glorious power makes us strong, and because of your kindness, our strength increases.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, bumo be kemaŋkura nɛ eleŋ shi fo kutɔ nna, nɛ fo kuwɔrwu malɛ bee shin nɛ anyee nya eleŋ a ti so.

english_verse: Our Lord and our King, the Holy One of Israel, you are truly our shield.
translation_verse: Kashenteŋto, anyi be kekuŋ bee shi Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kutɔ nna. Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ cheembi na e la anyi be ewura.

english_verse: In a vision, you once said to your faithful followers: “I have helped a mighty hero. I chose him from my people and made him famous.
translation_verse: Le nɛ fo daŋ bɔla bɔrɛdare to ŋ kaŋɛ fo bebɛsopo nɛ baa ji kashenteŋ a sa fo na: “Ma e naa sa enapo eleŋ. Ma alɛ e ta kuwurputi na n sa esa nɛ ŋ gbagba lara ashi ma basa to.

english_verse: David, my servant, is the one I chose to be king,
translation_verse: Ma e lara ma kayɛrbi Deevid nseŋ duga ma ŋku cheembi n do mbe kumu so n ta mo ŋ ki ewura.

english_verse: and I will always be there to help and strengthen him.
translation_verse: Jemanɛ kikɛ ma eleŋ beeŋ baa wɔ mo so, nɛ ma eleŋgboŋ na e baa sa mo eleŋ.

english_verse: “No enemy will outsmart David, and he won't be defeated by any hateful people.
translation_verse: Mo doŋana maaŋ tiŋ m pɔɔ mo so kikɛ, kumukpakpasowuraana gba beeŋ kɔ mo ŋ gben.

english_verse: I will strike down and crush his troublesome enemies.
translation_verse: Meeŋ tɔrɔ mo doŋana ga nseŋ mɔ ekama nɛ e kishi mo.

english_verse: He will always be able to depend on my love, and I will make him strong with my own power.
translation_verse: Ma kashenteŋji be kasha na beeŋ baa wɔ mo so; ma alɛ beeŋ shin nɛ e baa kɔ a pɔɔ so jemanɛ kikɛ.

english_verse: He will say to me, ‘You are my Father and my God, as well as the mighty rock where I am safe.’
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ e kaŋɛ ma le: ‘Fo e la n tuto nɛ ma Ebɔrɛ; Fo e la ma ekumpo nɛ ma emɔlgapo.’

english_verse: “I have chosen David as my first-born son, and he will be the ruler of all kings on earth.
translation_verse: Meeŋ shin nɛ e ki ma wurkoŋnyɛn, nseŋ ki esagboŋ a chɔ durnya to be bewura kikɛ.

english_verse: My love for him will last, and my agreement with him will never be broken.
translation_verse: Jemanɛ kikɛ meeŋ baa wora a bɔlɔ ma nnɔ nɛ n nase a sa mo; nɛ ma nɛ mo be kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre na e baa wɔtɔ mbaanaayɔ.

english_verse: “One of David's descendants will always be king, and his family will rule until the sky disappears.
translation_verse: Meeŋ shin nɛ mbe kabuna ebi e baa ji kuwura mbaanaayɔ; mbe kanaŋ to be esa e naaŋ baa ji kuwura jemanɛ kikɛ.

english_verse: Suppose some of his children should reject my Law and refuse my instructions.
translation_verse: Ama nɛ fanɛ mbe kaman to ebi kini kewora ma mbraana kasonu, nseŋ kini kewora m bɔlɔ ma atande so,

english_verse: Or suppose they should disobey all of my teachings.
translation_verse: ŋko nɛ b kplaŋ ma keŋini so nsaa maŋ bɛ ma mbraana so,

english_verse: But I will always love David and faithfully keep all of my promises to him.
translation_verse: Ama m maaŋ yige kebaasha Deevid, ŋko ŋ kini kebɛ nnɔ nɛ n nase n sa mo na so.

english_verse: I have sworn once and for all by my own holy name, and I won't lie to David.
translation_verse: Kelekoŋwule pati nɛ n ta ma Ketre cheembi na m bɔ ntaŋ fanɛ, m maaŋ ku efɛ n sa Deevid kikɛ.

english_verse: His family will always rule. I will let his kingdom last as long as the sun
translation_verse: Mbe kanaŋ to ebi e naaŋ baa ji kuwura jemanɛ kikɛ. Kananɛ epeŋi nɛ kufɔl baa lar awɔlpa so ere, aloŋ nɛ mbe kuwurji gba beeŋ baa wɔtɔ mbaanaayɔ.

english_verse: You are now angry, Lord, and you have turned your back on your chosen king.
translation_verse: Ama naniere fo, Ebɔrɛ na nya agbo nna n wɔtɔ ewura nɛ fo lara na nseŋ kini mo n lɛ, nseŋ pal kaman n sa mo.

english_verse: You broke off your agreement with your servant, the king, and you completely destroyed his kingdom.
translation_verse: Fo lar fo nɛ fo kayɛrbi be kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre na kaman kuraa nseŋ shin nɛ mbe kuwura terge m paŋ kumo be kemaŋkura kikɛ.

english_verse: The walls of his city have been broken through, and every fortress now lies in ruins.
translation_verse: Fo shin nɛ egbal nɛ a kulti kadegboŋ na kikɛ bure nɛ kumo be mboŋ lempoana na kikɛ ki alambure a dese.

english_verse: All who pass by take what they want, and nations everywhere joke about the king.
translation_verse: Bekama nɛ b bɔla kumo ase a choŋ nya ewura na be asɔ ko n ta, nɛ mbe bechenashapoana bee mushe mo nsaa wora mo eyurto.

english_verse: You made his enemies powerful and let them celebrate.
translation_verse: Fo shin nɛ mo doŋana sɔ kelempo mo so, nɛ bumo kikɛ be ŋgbene fuli bumo.

english_verse: But you forced him to retreat because you did not fight on his side.
translation_verse: Fo shin nɛ mbe akɔsɔ kikɛ ki asɔ jiga, nseŋ shin nɛ e kɔ kena n tɔr.

english_verse: You took his crown and threw his throne in the dirt.
translation_verse: Fo suge mbe kuwurwuro n shin nɛ mbe kuwura paŋ kumo be kemaŋkura.

english_verse: You made an old man of him and put him to shame.
translation_verse: Fo shin nɛ e bel katinso nɛ e kraa la kebifɔlbi, nseŋ ta anishinyɔr be piŋi m buu mo nɛ nyɔmɔ pɛ mo.

english_verse: How much longer, Lord? Will you hide forever? How long will your anger keep burning like fire?
translation_verse: O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, feeŋ ta fo kumu ŋ ŋana mbaanaayɔ a? Jemanɛ mo nɛ fo agbo nɛ k bee suse fanɛ edɛ na beeŋ wushi?

english_verse: Remember, life is short! Why did you empty our lives of all meaning?
translation_verse: Baa nyiŋi fanɛ ma ŋkpa maŋ wɔ nteŋ. Fo to anyi nna nɛ an baa wɔ ŋkpa to gbrɛbi nseŋ wu!

english_verse: No one can escape the power of death and the grave.
translation_verse: Dimɛdi kikɛ maaŋ tiŋ n suge mbe kumu ashi luwu nɛ nchaŋ be eleŋana to.

english_verse: Our Lord, where is the love you have always shown and that you promised so faithfully to David?
translation_verse: O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, nnɛ nɛ kashagboŋ nɛ fo daa kɔ na wɔ? Nnɔ nɛ fo nase kashenteŋ be ekpa so n sa Deevid na wɔ nnɛ?

english_verse: Remember your servant, Lord! People make jokes about me, and I suffer many insults.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ baa nyiŋi kananɛ basa tege ma nseŋ wora fo kayɛrbi eyurto, nɛ n ta amo kikɛ n wɔtɔ kagbene to na be asheŋ.

english_verse: Our Lord, we praise you forever. Amen and amen.
translation_verse: Men baa kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na mbaanaayɔ! Amɛn! Amɛn!

english_verse: ) God Is Eternal
translation_verse: ) Mosis be kabɔrɛkule be asheŋ

english_verse: Our Lord, in all generations you have been our home.
translation_verse: O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, fo kutɔ e la anyi pe, jemanɛ kikɛ.

english_verse: You have always been God— long before the birth of the mountains, even before you created the earth and the world.
translation_verse: Pɔɛŋ nɛ fo to abeeana nɛ kasawule nɛ durnya kikɛ na, nɛ fo la Ebɔrɛ nna nsaa wɔtɔ mbaanaayɔ.

english_verse: At your command we die and turn back to dust,
translation_verse: Fo e yili kumo fanɛ an baa wu nsaa bɛta a yɔ eshishɛr to.

english_verse: but a thousand years mean nothing to you! They are merely a day gone by or a few hours in the night.
translation_verse: Nfɛ kagboŋ du fanɛ kachɛ koŋwule fo kutɔ nna, ŋko kanyɛso be jemanɛ gbrɛbi ko ka choŋ nna.

english_verse: You bring our lives to an end just like a dream. We are merely tender grass
translation_verse: Fo e naa shin nɛ anyi be ŋkpa bee ba ekar fanɛ edare na. An du fanɛ kachipurso be afitiri nɛ a purge a walɛ nna.

english_verse: that sprouts and grows in the morning, but dries up by evening.
translation_verse: Kachipurso, afitiri bee daŋ nna a purge a walɛ; ama ta a ba kaaseso nɛ a bolo nseŋ wu n wɔl.

english_verse: Your furious anger frightens and destroys us,
translation_verse: Fo kanya agbo bee ta kufu nna a da anyi nsaa mur anyi kuraa.

english_verse: and you know all our sins, even those we do in secret.
translation_verse: Fo alɛ nyi anyi be alubi kikɛ be asheŋ; hale amo nɛ an ŋana n wora ashiri to gba.

english_verse: Your anger is a burden each day we live, then life ends like a sigh.
translation_verse: Anyi be nchɛ bee ku so nna ŋkpal fo agbo so, nfubel damta malɛ e bɔlɔ nfɛ nɛ anyee ji kikɛ to.

english_verse: We can expect seventy years, or maybe eighty, if we are healthy, but even our best years bring trouble and sorrow. Suddenly our time is up, and we disappear.
translation_verse: Nfɛ nɛ anyee ji kikɛ la nfɛ adushunu nna, nɛ an baa kɔ eleŋ malɛ nɛ an ji nfɛ aduburwa; Ama etɔrɔ wurbi nɛ kagbenejija damta e wɔ amo to, ŋkpal manɛ so, a maa chɛr nsaa choŋ fanɛ afu.

english_verse: No one knows the full power of your furious anger, but it is as great as the fear that we owe to you.
translation_verse: Esa kikɛ maŋ nyi kananɛ fo agbo be eleŋ sa. Ŋkpal manɛ so, k shi alegaiso, nseŋ daga fanɛ an baa ŋana fo ŋkpal kumo so.

english_verse: Teach us to use wisely all the time we have.
translation_verse: Ŋini anyi kananɛ anyi be nchɛ sa, saŋɛ na so, anyeeŋ baa wora asheŋ kanyiasheŋ so.

english_verse: When morning comes, let your love satisfy all our needs. Then we can celebrate and be glad for what time we have left.
translation_verse: Kachipurso kikɛ, shin nɛ fo kasha nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na e kukwe anyi, saŋɛ na so, anyeeŋ baa ta kagbenefuli a boŋ nshɛ anyi be kebaawɔtɔ kikɛ to.

english_verse: Make us happy for as long as you caused us trouble and sorrow.
translation_verse: Shin nɛ an nya kagbenefuli n tal nchɛ nɛ anyi be ŋgbene jija anyi na to.

english_verse: Do wonderful things for us, your servants, and show your mighty power to our children.
translation_verse: Wora emamachisheŋ n sa anyi, fo nyɛrbi, nseŋ shin nɛ anyi be mbia e wu fo eleŋgboŋ na.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, treat us with kindness and let all go well for us. Please let all go well!
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe anyi be Ebɔrɛ, shin nɛ fo nɛfa e baa wɔ anyi so, nseŋ shin nɛ asheŋ e baa nite nsaa loge to nɛnɛ a sa anyi!

english_verse: Live under the protection of God Most High and stay in the shadow of God All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Esa kama nɛ e shile n ya mata Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na e naŋ nya mbe kekuŋ.

english_verse: Then you will say to the Lord, “You are my fortress, my place of safety; you are my God, and I trust you.”
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ e kaŋɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na le: “Fo nɛ mee shile n ya kaa mata nɛ fee kuŋ ma, fo e la ma Ebɔrɛ nɛ n yirda fo.”

english_verse: The Lord will keep you safe from secret traps and deadly diseases.
translation_verse: Kashenteŋto, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ kuŋ fo ashi ajigbelɛ nɛ alɔ mɔso kikɛ to.

english_verse: He will spread his wings over you and keep you secure. His faithfulness is like a shield or a city wall.
translation_verse: E beeŋ parga mbe atɛ m buu fo so a kuŋ fo nɛ fo nya fo kumu, Mbe kashenteŋji du fanɛ kebɛlso be kusɔ kuŋkumuso ŋko egbal nɛ k bee kuŋ kade nna.

english_verse: You won't need to worry about dangers at night or arrows during the day.
translation_verse: Fo maaŋ naa ŋana kanyɛso be asɔ nɛ a bee keta kufu ŋko kapaso be kelantokɔ kikɛ,

english_verse: And you won't fear diseases that strike in the dark or sudden disaster at noon.
translation_verse: ŋko tentembiri to be alɔ mɔso ŋko kapiidi be kayurnyaŋ lubi kikɛ.

english_verse: And with your own eyes you will see the punishment of the wicked.
translation_verse: Fo anishi nɛ feeŋ ta n wu kasogberge nɛ kumukpakpasowuraana beeŋ nya.

english_verse: The Lord Most High is your fortress. Run to him for safety,
translation_verse: Nɛ fo ta Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na fanɛ esa nɛ fee shile n ya kaa mata nɛ e baa kuŋ fo,

english_verse: and no terrible disasters will strike you or your home.
translation_verse: kumo ere alɔ lubi maaŋ ba fo so, ŋko ŋ bɔla fo kowu ase n choŋ gba.

english_verse: God will command his angels to protect you wherever you go.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ beeŋ shin nɛ mbe emalaika e baa kuŋ fo ashi kusɔ kama nɛ fee wora to.

english_verse: They will carry you in their arms, and you won't hurt your feet on the stones.
translation_verse: Baaŋ ta bumo be enɔana n suse fo to, nɛ fo maaŋ doro fo anashibi kejembu so.

english_verse: You will overpower the strongest lions and the most deadly snakes.
translation_verse: Feeŋ pɔɔ ebuluŋ lempo so nseŋ chichi awɔ lubi gba so, nɛ e maaŋ tiŋ n wora fo shɛŋ.

english_verse: The Lord says, “If you love me and truly know who I am, I will rescue you and keep you safe.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ yɛ: “Nɛ fee sha ma nsaa nyi esa nɛ e la ma kashenteŋto, meeŋ mɔlga fo nsaa kuŋ fo.

english_verse: When you are in trouble, call out to me. I will answer and be there to protect and honor you.
translation_verse: Nɛ fo luri asheŋ to nseŋ shu n tre ma, meeŋ nu fo kekule m ba mɔlga fo nseŋ ta kemaŋkura m buu fo so.

english_verse: You will live a long life and see my saving power.”
translation_verse: Meeŋ sa fo ŋkpa tenteŋ nseŋ ŋini fo ma kumɔlga.”

english_verse: It is wonderful to be grateful and to sing your praises, Lord Most High!
translation_verse: Kekpaŋ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na nɛ keboŋ nshɛ n dele mo walɛ ga.

english_verse: It is wonderful each morning to tell about your love and at night to announce how faithful you are.
translation_verse: Keber mbe kasha be asheŋ be kebomboŋ kachipurso, nɛ mbe kashenteŋji be asheŋ kanyɛso gba walɛ ga.

english_verse: I enjoy praising your name to the music of harps,
translation_verse: Keta alaŋsɔ be yiri kikɛ a boŋ nshɛ a kpaŋ fo ketre bee wora ma ebel nsaa par ma ga.

english_verse: because everything you do makes me happy, and I sing joyful songs.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, fo asheŋ woraso bee wushi ma kagbene nna, a shin nɛ mee tiŋ a boŋ nshɛ kagbenefuliso, O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ.

english_verse: You do great things, Lord. Your thoughts are too deep
translation_verse: O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, fee wora asheŋgboŋ pasaa, fo nfɛra fɛso malɛ du chiŋgeliŋ alegaiso!

english_verse: Though the wicked sprout and spread like grass, they will be pulled up by their roots.
translation_verse: kumukpakpasowura beeŋ tiŋ m purge fanɛ afitiri, nɛ belubiworapoana e nya asɔ nseŋ dii dama. E maŋ nyi fanɛ bumo kikɛ beeŋ mur cheche mbaanaayɔ.

english_verse: But you will rule over all of us forever,
translation_verse: Fo, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e naŋ baa ji kuwura kusɔ kama so mbaanaayɔ.

english_verse: and your hateful enemies will be scattered and then destroyed.
translation_verse: An nyi fanɛ fo doŋana beeŋ mur kashenteŋto, nɛ alubiworapoana kikɛ e pesaŋ to.

english_verse: You have given me the strength of a wild ox, and you have chosen me to be your very own.
translation_verse: Fo shin nɛ n nya eleŋ fanɛ kupuntona nna, nɛ fo lara ma n yili n sa fo gbagba be kumu.

english_verse: My eyes have seen, and my ears have heard the doom and destruction of my evil enemies.
translation_verse: Ŋ gbagba be anishi wu, nɛ ma asoe nu kumulubi nɛ kemur nɛ a ba bedoŋ so.

english_verse: Good people will prosper like palm trees, and they will grow strong like the cedars of Lebanon.
translation_verse: Basa lela beeŋ dii dama fanɛ ŋkubadibi ka purge na; baaŋ daŋ n yili fanɛ Lebanɔn be ndibi nɛ baa tre sida na.

english_verse: They will take root in your house, Lord God, and they will do well.
translation_verse: Baaŋ mur achin ashi fo, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be laŋ to, nseŋ nyalɛ ashi anyi be Ebɔrɛ na be bɔrɛlambu to.

english_verse: They will be like trees that stay healthy and fruitful, even when they are old.
translation_verse: Baaŋ baa du fanɛ ndibi nɛ e bel nseŋ kraa kɔ eleŋ a sɔr asɔrso.

english_verse: And they will say about you, “The Lord always does right! God is our mighty rock.”
translation_verse: Saŋɛ na so nɛ b baa kaŋɛ le: “Kusɔ kama nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na wora niŋi nna! Ebɔrɛ e la anyi be kefaltagboŋ a kuŋ anyi, kulubi kikɛ maŋ wɔ mo to.”

english_verse: Our Lord, you are King! Majesty and power are your royal robes. You put the world in place, and it will never be moved.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e la ewura. Kemaŋkuragboŋ nɛ eleŋ buu mo nna fanɛ kuwurpiŋi. Mo e tɔl durnya n yili kpakpa, nɛ shɛŋ shɛŋ maaŋ tiŋ n fifir kumo.

english_verse: You have always ruled, and you are eternal.
translation_verse: Dra na kikɛ nɛ fee ji kuwura, fo alɛ wɔtɔ nna mbaanaayɔ.

english_verse: Its mighty waves are majestic, but you are even more majestic, and you rule over all.
translation_verse: Teku so be atili bee wora awɔr nna nsaa kɔ eleŋ ga, ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be eleŋ shi a chɔ amo be eleŋana.

english_verse: Your decisions are firm, and your temple will always be beautiful and holy.
translation_verse: O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, fo mbraana wɔtɔ nna mbaanaayɔ, jemanɛ kikɛ fo bɔrɛlambu na du cheembi nna nsaa walɛ kebita.

english_verse: Lord God, you punish the guilty. Show what you are like and punish them now.
translation_verse: O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ fee gberge basa nɛ b wora n jija kusoe; ŋini bumo esa nɛ e la fo nseŋ gberge bumo kusoe!

english_verse: You judge the earth. Come and help us! Pay back those proud people for what they have done.
translation_verse: Fo e naa ji durnya kikɛ demu. Ba chɛ anyi to! Ka kamoowuwuraana kukɔ, ŋkpal kusɔ nɛ b wora so.

english_verse: How long will the wicked celebrate and be glad?
translation_verse: O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, saŋɛ mo nɛ kumukpakpasowuraana be kagbenefuliso be kamooji ere beeŋ fo ekar?

english_verse: All of those cruel people strut and boast,
translation_verse: Basa lubi ere bee nite nna a puchi bumo be asheŋ lubi so.

english_verse: and they crush and wound your chosen nation, Lord.
translation_verse: O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, baa mɛaŋ basa nna a pira bumo; fo gbagba be basa laraso nɛ baa mɛaŋ.

english_verse: Then they say, “The Lord God of Jacob doesn't see or know.”
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ b kaŋɛ le: “Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na maa wu anyi. Jeekɔb be Ebɔrɛ na be shɛŋ maŋ wɔ anyi to.”

english_verse: God gave us ears and eyes! Can't he hear and see?
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ nɛ e to anyi be asoe nɛ anishi na, maŋ kɔ asoe a nu nɛ anishi a wu nna a?

english_verse: The Lord knows how useless our plans really are.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nyi dimɛdi kikɛ be nfɛra ka la nfɛra fuloŋ a maŋ kɔ tɔnɔ.

english_verse: Our Lord, you bless everyone that you instruct and teach by using your Law.
translation_verse: Kagbenefuli la ekama nɛ fo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee bela nsaa ŋini mo fo mbra na peya nna!

english_verse: You give them rest from their troubles, until a pit can be dug for the wicked.
translation_verse: Fo e naa wushi mo kagbene ashi mbe tɔrɔ to, n ya fo jemanɛ nɛ baaŋ kur kemaŋ n nase nɛ kumukpakpasowura e tɔr to.

english_verse: Justice and fairness will go hand in hand, and all who do right will follow along.
translation_verse: Demujipoana beeŋ baa ji asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so, nɛ basa niŋiso malɛ e yili bumo be kaman.

english_verse: Who will stand up for me against those cruel people?
translation_verse: Wanɛ e naŋ yili ma kaman n tu ma ŋ kɔ basa lubi ere?

english_verse: If you had not helped me, Lord, I would soon have gone to the land of silence.
translation_verse: Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na daa maŋ chɛ ma to, ndafanɛ n wu n yɔ bubuni to.

english_verse: And when I was burdened with worries, you comforted me and made me feel secure.
translation_verse: Jemanɛ kikɛ nɛ kafɔŋ damta baŋ tɔr ma so, fo e naa lolo ma a wushi ma kagbene.

english_verse: You, Lord God, are my fortress, that mighty rock where I am safe.
translation_verse: Ama fo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e ki kakpa lempo nɛ kefaltagboŋ a kuŋ ma.

english_verse: You will pay back my enemies, and you will wipe them out for the evil they did.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ beeŋ gberge kumukpakpasowuraana kusoe nseŋ mur bumo ŋkpal bumo be asheŋ lubi so. Enyɛnpe anyi be Ebɔrɛ na e naŋ mur bumo.

english_verse: Sing joyful songs to the Lord! Praise the mighty rock where we are safe.
translation_verse: Men ba nɛ an boŋ kagbenefuli be nshɛ n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ e bee kuŋ anyi na.

english_verse: Come to worship him with thankful hearts and songs of praise.
translation_verse: Men shin nɛ an ta kapandi m ba boŋ nshɛ ŋ kpaŋ mo.

english_verse: The Lord is the greatest God, king over all other gods.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e la Ewurgboŋ; agbirana maŋ la shɛŋ mbe anishito.

english_verse: He holds the deepest part of the earth in his hands, and the mountain peaks also belong to him.
translation_verse: Asɔ nɛ a wɔ kasawule be kechimbi to nɛ abee be awɔlto kikɛ be eleŋ bɔɔ mbe enɔ nna.

english_verse: The ocean is the Lord's because he made it, and with his own hands he formed the dry land.
translation_verse: Teku la mo peya nna, ŋkpal manɛ so, mo e to kumo. Mo gbagba be enɔana nɛ e ta n tɔl kasawule.

english_verse: Bow down and worship the Lord our Creator!
translation_verse: Men ba nɛ an jɔŋɛ m bunyaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ e to anyi na!

english_verse: The Lord is our God, and we are his people, the sheep he takes care of in his own pasture. Listen to God's voice today!
translation_verse: Mo e la anyi be Ebɔrɛ, nɛ anyi alɛ la mbe basa. An du fanɛ mbe mbolpɔ nɛ e bee keni so nna. Men baŋ nu mbe ebɔl kabre,

english_verse: Don't be stubborn and rebel as your ancestors did at Meribah and Massah out in the desert.
translation_verse: men sa maŋ wora menyi be ŋgbene kpakpa, fanɛ kananɛ men nanaana daŋ wora ashi mboŋ nɛ baa tre Mɛriba nɛ Maasa ashi keshishɛrsawule so na.

english_verse: For forty years they tested God and saw the things he did.
translation_verse: Asheŋ nɛ b daŋ wu Ebɔrɛ ka wora na kikɛ be kaman, b daŋ chɔ mo nseŋ wora mo ŋ keni ndoŋana nna.

english_verse: Then God got tired of them and said, “You never show good sense, and you don't understand what I want you to do.”
translation_verse: Nfɛ adena nɛ bumo be asheŋ daa nu Ebɔrɛ agbo, nɛ e kaŋɛ le: “Saŋkikɛ basa ere bee wora a foe ekpa nna; bumo alɛ maa pin ma asheŋ woraso to.”

english_verse: In his anger, God told them, “You people will never enter my place of rest.”
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ daŋ nya agbo nna nseŋ bɔ ntaŋ ŋ kaŋɛ le: “B maaŋ luri ma kewushi na to kikɛ!”

english_verse: Sing a new song to the Lord! Everyone on this earth, sing praises to the Lord,
translation_verse: Ekama nɛ e wɔ durnya to, e boŋ kashɛ popɔr n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na!

english_verse: sing and praise his name. Day after day announce, “The Lord has saved us!”
translation_verse: Men boŋ kashɛ n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na, nseŋ kpaŋ mbe ketre na. Karechɛ kama men baa ber mbe kumɔlga na be asheŋ be kubomboŋ.

english_verse: Tell every nation on earth, “The Lord is wonderful and does marvelous things!
translation_verse: Men baa malga mbe kemaŋkura nɛ asheŋgboŋ be asheŋ a sa basa nɛ b wɔ efuliana kikɛ so.

english_verse: The Lord is great and deserves our greatest praise! He is the only God worthy of our worship.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ shi ga, nseŋ daga fanɛ ekama e baa kpaŋ mo nsaa ŋana mo a chɔ agbirana kikɛ.

english_verse: Other nations worship idols, but the Lord created the heavens.
translation_verse: Efuli pɔtɛana so ebi bee shuŋ agbirana nna; ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e to ebɔrɛso.

english_verse: Give honor and praise to the Lord, whose power and beauty fill his holy temple.”
translation_verse: E kɔ kemaŋkura nɛ bunyaŋgboŋ, nɛ eleŋgboŋ nɛ kela bɔlɔ mbe bɔrɛlambu to.

english_verse: Tell everyone of every nation, “Praise the glorious power of the Lord.
translation_verse: Durnya to be basa kikɛ e kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na, nseŋ shuli so fanɛ kemaŋkura nɛ eleŋ la mo peya nna.

english_verse: He is wonderful! Praise him and bring an offering into his temple.
translation_verse: Men kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be ketre nɛ k kɔ kemaŋkura na; nseŋ ta esarga m ba mbe bɔrɛlambu to.

english_verse: Announce to the nations, “The Lord is King! The world stands firm, never to be shaken, and he will judge its people with fairness.”
translation_verse: Men kaŋɛ efuliana na so ebi le: “Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e la Ewura! Mo e tɔl durnya na n yili dindiŋ nɛ k maa fifir; mo alɛ e naaŋ ji basa kikɛ demu nɛ e maŋ puni eko.”

english_verse: Tell the heavens and the earth to be glad and celebrate! Command the ocean to roar with all its creatures
translation_verse: Kaŋɛ esoso nɛ kasawule so ebi fanɛ b shin nɛ bumo be ŋgbene e wushi bumo nɛ b baa ji eyur! Shin nɛ teku nɛ kumo to be asɔ keniso kikɛ e baa wora awɔr,

english_verse: and the fields to rejoice with all their crops. Then every tree in the forest will sing joyful songs
translation_verse: nseŋ shin nɛ adɔsawule nɛ adɔjibi nɛ a wɔ amo so na gba e ji eyur. Kumo be kaman nɛ kupo to be ndibi kikɛ e boŋ nshɛ kagbenefuliso

english_verse: to the Lord. He is coming to judge all people on earth with fairness and truth.
translation_verse: n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na. E bee ba nɛ e ba bɔla ekpa niŋiso nɛ kashenteŋ so nna n ji basa nɛ b wɔ durnya to demu.

english_verse: The Lord is King! Tell the earth to celebrate and all islands to shout.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e la Ewura! Shin nɛ durnya kikɛ e ji eyur nɛ mplasawule kikɛ e wora awɔr.

english_verse: Fire leaps from his throne, destroying his enemies,
translation_verse: Edɛ e naa juŋkpar mo a chɔɔ mo doŋana kaba kama so a mur.

english_verse: and his lightning is so bright that the earth sees it and trembles.
translation_verse: Mo e naa shin nɛ bɔrɛ bee nyɛkpɛ nɛ durnya bee fulto, nɛ kasawule so ebi bee wu kumo a chicha.

english_verse: Mountains melt away like wax in the presence of the Lord of all the earth.
translation_verse: Abee bee ŋalga fanɛ kemar ashi Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ e la durnya kikɛ be Enyɛnpe na be anishito nna.

english_verse: The heavens announce, “The Lord brings justice!” Everyone sees God's glory.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛso bee ber mbe kebaawɔtɔ niŋiso be kebomboŋ nna, nɛ efuliana na kikɛ be basa bee wu mbe kemaŋkura.

english_verse: Those who brag about the useless idols they worship are terribly ashamed, and all the false gods bow down to the Lord.
translation_verse: Bekama nɛ baa shuŋ agbirana ŋko a puchi amo so na bee ŋaba nna; ŋkpal manɛ so, agbirana kikɛ maŋ la shɛŋ Ebɔrɛ be anishito.

english_verse: When the people of Zion and of the towns of Judah hear that God brings justice, they will celebrate.
translation_verse: O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, Jerusalɛm to nɛ Juda be efuli so be ndeana to be basa be ŋgbene fuli nna, nɛ baa ji eyur ŋkpal fo demuji so.

english_verse: The Lord rules the whole earth, and he is more glorious than all the false gods.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, fo, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e naa ji kuwura durnya kikɛ ebi so. Fo alɛ shi ga a chɔ agbirana kikɛ.

english_verse: If you obey and do right, a light will show you the way and fill you with happiness.
translation_verse: Kefulto bee nyaŋɛ a yuu basa niŋiso so nna, nɛ ŋgbenefufulwuraana malɛ bee nya kagbenefuli.

english_verse: Sing a new song to the Lord! He has worked miracles, and with his own powerful arm, he has won the victory.
translation_verse: Men boŋ kashɛ popɔr n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na! Mo e ta mbe enɔ lempo cheembi na n wora emamachisheŋ ŋ kɔ m pɔɔ so na.

english_verse: The Lord has shown the nations that he has the power to save and to bring justice.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na lara mbe kumɔlga nɛ kebaawɔtɔ niŋiso ŋ ŋini efuli pɔtɛana so be basa.

english_verse: God has been faithful in his love for Israel, and his saving power is seen everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: E nyiŋi mbe kasha nɛ kashenteŋji nɛ e kɔ n sa Israɛlebi na be asheŋ. Bekama nɛ b wɔ kasawule so be kaplɛkama wu anyi be Ebɔrɛ na be kumɔlga.

english_verse: Tell everyone on this earth to sing happy songs in praise of the Lord.
translation_verse: Durnya to be basa kikɛ e boŋ nshɛ kagbenefuliso ŋ kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.

english_verse: Make music for him on harps. Play beautiful melodies!
translation_verse: Men laŋ ejaŋjilaŋ m boŋ nshɛ belbelso n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.

english_verse: Sound the trumpets and horns and celebrate with joyful songs for our Lord and King!
translation_verse: Men foŋ mbel m boŋ nshɛ n ji eyur kagbenefuliso; ŋkpal manɛ so, Enyɛnpe anyi be Ebɔrɛ na e la ewura!

english_verse: Command the ocean to roar with all its creatures, and the earth to shout with all its people.
translation_verse: Shin nɛ teku nɛ kumo to be asɔ keniso kikɛ, nɛ kasawule nɛ kumo so be basa kikɛ e baa wora awɔr a kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.

english_verse: Let them worship the Lord! He is coming to judge everyone on the earth, and he will be honest and fair.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, mo e naa ba nɛ e ba ji kuwura kasawule so. E beeŋ ba bɔla ekpa niŋiso so n ji esa kama nɛ e wɔ kasawule so demu nɛ e maŋ kpɛa ekama to.

english_verse: Our Lord, you are King! You rule from your throne above the winged creatures, as people tremble and the earth shakes.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e la ewura! Efuliana kikɛ so be basa e baa chicha. E chena mbe kuwurputi nɛ emalaika nɛ b kɔ aba wɔ kumo be kaseto na so nna; nɛ kasawule bee gbuŋgbuŋ.

english_verse: You are praised in Zion, and you control all nations.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na la esagboŋ nna ashi Jerusalɛm to; mo e kɔ eleŋ efuliana na kikɛ so.

english_verse: Only you are God! And your power alone, so great and fearsome, is worthy of praise.
translation_verse: Ekama beeŋ kpaŋ mbe ketregboŋ nɛ k kɔ eleŋ ga na. Ŋkpal manɛ so, e du cheembi nna.

english_verse: You are our mighty King, a lover of fairness, who sees that justice is done everywhere in Israel.
translation_verse: Ewura na la esagboŋ nna, nsaa sha kebaaji asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so. Mo e yili keji asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so ashi Israɛl be efuli so be kaplɛkama.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, we praise you and kneel down to worship you, the God of holiness!
translation_verse: Men baa maŋ Enyɛnpe anyi be Ebɔrɛ na so, nsaa bunyaŋ mo ashi mbe kuwurputi ase. Ŋkpal manɛ so, e du cheembi nna.

english_verse: Moses and Aaron were two of your priests. Samuel was also one of those who prayed in your name, and you, our Lord, answered their prayers.
translation_verse: Mosis nɛ Ɛɛrɔn daa la mbe bɔrɛmatapoana nna, nɛ anebi Samuɛl malɛ daa la esa nɛ e daa bɔla Ebɔrɛ be ketre to a kule mo. Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nɛ bumo kikɛ daa shu a tre, nɛ e daa nu a sa bumo.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, you answered their prayers and forgave their sins, but when they did wrong, you punished them.
translation_verse: O Enyɛnpe anyi be Ebɔrɛ, fo e daŋ nu bumo be kekule, nseŋ ta bumo be alubi m paŋ bumo. Ama b ka naŋ wora kusɔ nɛ k maŋ daga na, fo gberge bumo kusoe nna.

english_verse: We praise you, Lord God, and we worship you at your sacred mountain. Only you are God!
translation_verse: Anyee kpaŋ fo, Enyɛnpe anyi be Ebɔrɛ na, nsaa bunyaŋ fo ashi fo kebee cheembi na ase. Ŋkpal manɛ so, Enyɛnpe anyi be Ebɔrɛ na du cheembi nna.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord, everyone on this earth.
translation_verse: Durnya to be basa kikɛ, e baa kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na!

english_verse: Be joyful and sing as you come in to worship the Lord!
translation_verse: Men baa bunyaŋ mo kagbenefuliso, nsaa boŋ kagbenefuli be nshɛ a sa mo.

english_verse: You know the Lord is God! He created us, and we belong to him; we are his people, the sheep in his pasture.
translation_verse: Men baa nyi fanɛ Enyɛnpe na e la Ebɔrɛ! Mo e to anyi nɛ an la mbe basa; an du fanɛ mbe mbolpɔ nna nɛ e bee keni so.

english_verse: Be thankful and praise the Lord as you enter his temple.
translation_verse: Men bɔla mbe bɔrɛlambu na be mbunagboŋ to n luri mbe kelɔnɛ so m ba di mo epaŋ, nseŋ kpaŋ mo.

english_verse: The Lord is good! His love and faithfulness will last forever.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na walɛ ga! Mbe kasha nɛ k maa loge na, nɛ mbe kashenteŋji malɛ wɔtɔ nna mbaanaayɔ.

english_verse: I will sing to you, Lord! I will celebrate your kindness and your justice.
translation_verse: O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, meeŋ boŋ kashɛ a laŋɛ fo kasha nɛ keji asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so be kaplɛa so.

english_verse: Please help me learn to do the right thing, and I will be honest and fair in my own kingdom.
translation_verse: Jande, chɛ ma to nɛ ŋ koya kebaawora asheŋ niŋiso; saŋɛ na so meeŋ baa ji kashenteŋ nsaa maa kɔ ŋkpɛato ashi ma kuwurji to.

english_verse: I refuse to be corrupt or to take part in anything crooked,
translation_verse: Ma alɛ beeŋ kishi kusɔ nɛ basa nɛ b pal kaman n sa Ebɔrɛ bee wora na kikɛ.

english_verse: I will find trustworthy people to serve as my advisors; only an honest person will serve as an official.
translation_verse: Basa nɛ b kɔ kashenteŋji nɛ meeŋ shin nɛ b baa wɔ ŋ kutɔ a ji ma asoe to. Basa nɛ b maŋ kɔ amoso malɛ e naŋ ki ma ekrachi a shuŋ a sa ma.

english_verse: No one who cheats or lies will have a position in my royal court.
translation_verse: Esa kama nɛ e bee puni ŋko a fule kikɛ maaŋ nya ma lambu to n chena.

english_verse: Each morning I will silence any lawbreakers I find in the countryside or in the city of the Lord.
translation_verse: Karechɛ kikɛ, m maaŋ sa kumukpakpasowuraana kashuli ashi anyi be kasawule so. Meeŋ ju basa lubi kikɛ ashi Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be kadegboŋ na to.

english_verse: I pray to you, Lord! Please listen.
translation_verse: Mee kule fo nna, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ! Jande, nu ma kekule.

english_verse: Don't hide from me in my time of trouble. Pay attention to my prayer and quickly give an answer.
translation_verse: Sa maŋ ŋana ma so jemanɛ nɛ n wɔ tɔrɔ to. Kaŋ kusoe n nu ma kekule, nseŋ tuge ma manaŋ manaŋ.

english_verse: My days disappear like smoke, and my bones are burning as though in a furnace.
translation_verse: Ma nchɛ bee choŋ nna fanɛ edishi nɛ ma awibi to bee chɔɔ ma to fanɛ edɛ.

english_verse: I am wasting away like grass, and my appetite is gone.
translation_verse: M baa wɔl fanɛ afitiri nna, ajibi kikɛ malɛ maa yɛlga ma.

english_verse: My groaning never stops, and my bones can be seen through my skin.
translation_verse: M baa shu to awɔrso a tekeŋ nna, nseŋ nyɔr ŋ ki fanɛ awibi nawule.

english_verse: I am like a lonely owl in the desert
translation_verse: M baŋ ki fanɛ gbuŋgbula koŋko ashi keshishɛrsawule so nna.

english_verse: My enemies insult me all day, and they use my name for a curse word.
translation_verse: N doŋana bee tege ma karechɛ kikɛ nna; nɛ bumo nɛ baa wora ma eyurto malɛ bee ti ma ketre fanɛ shoduu be kusɔ na.

english_verse: My life fades like a shadow at the end of day and withers like grass.
translation_verse: Ma kebaawɔtɔ bee choŋ nna fanɛ kaaseso be kiyoyul; nɛ ŋ gbagba malɛ bee wɔl fanɛ afitiri na.

english_verse: You will show pity to Zion because the time has come.
translation_verse: Fo e naaŋ shu Jerusalɛmebi so, ŋkpal manɛ so, jemanɛ fo nɛ feeŋ wu bumo kuwɔr.

english_verse: We, your servants, love each stone in the city, and we are sad to see them lying in the dirt.
translation_verse: Anyi fo anya bee sha kejembu kama nɛ k wɔ kadegboŋ na to nna; amoso kumo be kebure a dese loŋ na shin nɛ kagbenejija tɔr anyi so ga.

english_verse: Our Lord, the nations will honor you, and all kings on earth will praise your glory.
translation_verse: Efuli pɔtɛana so be basa beeŋ ŋana fo, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na, be ketre na. Nɛ durnya to be bewuraana kikɛ e ta bunyaŋ gboŋ gboŋi n sa fo.

english_verse: You will rebuild the city of Zion. Your glory will be seen,
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ lɔŋɛ Jerusalɛm be kadegboŋ na m pɔr nseŋ shin nɛ mbe kemaŋkura e dii efuli.

english_verse: and the prayers of the homeless will be answered.
translation_verse: E beeŋ wu betentaŋasepo kuwɔr nseŋ nu bumo be kabɔrɛkule.

english_verse: “From his holy temple, the Lord looked down at the earth.
translation_verse: “Ebɔrɛso nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na wɔ nsaa to kenishi a keni kasawule so.

english_verse: He listened to the groans of prisoners, and he rescued everyone who was doomed to die.”
translation_verse: E daŋ nu basa nɛ b wɔ kabuti to ka bee shu to nna, nseŋ sɔ bumo nɛ b daŋ daga luwu na n yige.

english_verse: when people from every nation meet to worship you.
translation_verse: jemanɛ nɛ efuli pɔtɛana nɛ kuwurjiana kikɛ be basa beeŋ shɛr abar so m bunyaŋ mo na.

english_verse: I should still be strong, but you, Lord, have made an old person of me.
translation_verse: Kebifɔlbi e kraa la ma, ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na shin nɛ ŋ ki esa pɔso nɛ ma nchɛ duga so.

english_verse: You will live forever! Years mean nothing to you. Don't cut my life in half!
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ le: O ma Ebɔrɛ, sa maŋ ta ma, nɛ ma nchɛ maŋ naŋ fo. Fo ere wɔtɔ nna mbaanaayɔ.

english_verse: In the beginning, Lord, you laid the earth's foundation and created the heavens.
translation_verse: Sososo na kikɛ nɛ fo to durnya n yili kumo be gbaltɔlase so. Fo gbagba be enɔ nɛ fo ta n to ebɔrɛso gba.

english_verse: They will all disappear and wear out like clothes. You change them, as you would a coat, but you last forever.
translation_verse: Amo kikɛ beeŋ choŋ fanɛ asɔbuuso ka wu na. Fee chɛrga amo nna fanɛ esa ka bee chɛrga mbe asɔbuuso dra nsaa kini amo na.

english_verse: You are always the same. You are God for all time.
translation_verse: Ama fo ere maa chɛrga kikɛ; fo alɛ maa bel kikɛ.

english_verse: Every generation of those who serve you will live in your presence.
translation_verse: Basa nɛ baa shuŋ fo be mbia beeŋ baa wɔ fo kutɔ, nɛ fo baa kuŋ bumo nɛ bumo be kaman to ebi kikɛ.”

english_verse: With all my heart I praise the Lord, and with all that I am I praise his holy name!
translation_verse: Meeŋ ta ma kagbene kikɛ n fur Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na, nseŋ ta ma kebaawɔtɔ kikɛ ŋ kpaŋ mbe ketre cheembi na!

english_verse: With all my heart I praise the Lord! I will never forget how kind he has been.
translation_verse: Meeŋ ta ma kagbene kikɛ ŋ kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na! Ma alɛ maaŋ teŋ asheŋ lela nɛ e wora ma na kikɛ so.

english_verse: The Lord forgives our sins, heals us when we are sick,
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e naa ta anyi be alubi a paŋ anyi. Mo alɛ e naa chɛ anyi be alɔana kikɛ,

english_verse: and protects us from death. His kindness and love are a crown on our heads.
translation_verse: nsaa kuŋ anyi ashi luwu to. Mbe kuwɔrwu nɛ kasha malɛ shi anyi so ga.

english_verse: Each day that we live, he provides for our needs and gives us the strength of a young eagle.
translation_verse: Karechɛ kikɛ e bee sa anyi asɔ nɛ a tir anyi nna, nsaa shin nɛ anyee nya eleŋ a ti so fanɛ kusore fɔlbi na.

english_verse: He taught his Law to Moses and showed all Israel what he could do.
translation_verse: Mo e daŋ juŋkpar an nananyɛn Mosis dra dra na n wora asheŋ, nseŋ shin nɛ Israɛl be basa wu mbe asheŋgboŋ nɛ e wora na.

english_verse: The Lord is merciful! He is kind and patient, and his love never fails.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na la ewɔrwupo nna, nsaa kɔ kanyiti; mbe kasha malɛ maa chɛrga kikɛ.

english_verse: The Lord won't always be angry and point out our sins;
translation_verse: E maa wu basa kulubi jemanɛ kikɛ; mo alɛ maa nya agbo mbaanaayɔ.

english_verse: How great is God's love for all who worship him? Greater than the distance between heaven and earth!
translation_verse: Kasha nɛ e kɔ n sa basa nɛ baa bunyaŋ mo na shi ga; k shi a chɔ yili kasawule so n ya fo awɔlpa so.

english_verse: How far has the Lord taken our sins from us? Farther than the distance from east to west!
translation_verse: Kananɛ epeŋilarkpa nɛ epeŋitɔrkpa barga abar a wɔ kufɔ na, aloŋ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na lara anyi be alubi ashi anyi so.

english_verse: Just as parents are kind to their children, the Lord is kind to all who worship him,
translation_verse: Kananɛ bekurgepo bee sha bumo be mbia ga na, aloŋ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ gba bee sha bekama nɛ baa bunyaŋ mo na ga.

english_verse: because he knows we are made of dust.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, e nyi fanɛ eshishɛr nɛ e ta m pɔr anyi.

english_verse: We humans are like grass or wild flowers that quickly bloom.
translation_verse: Anyi edimɛdi be nchɛ du fanɛ afitiri ŋko kupuŋ to be atoto nɛ a bee purge manaŋ manaŋ nna;

english_verse: God has set up his kingdom in heaven, and he rules the whole creation.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ taŋɛ mbe kuwurji ebɔrɛso nna, mo alɛ nsaa ji kuwura asɔ toso kikɛ so.

english_verse: All of you mighty angels, who obey God's commands, come and praise your Lord!
translation_verse: Menyi emalaika lempoana, nɛ menyee nu Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be kɔnɔ nsaa wora mo kasonu na kikɛ e kpaŋ mo!

english_verse: All of you thousands who serve and obey God, come and praise your Lord!
translation_verse: Menyi ebɔrɛso be apɔrso nɛ menyee shuŋ a sa Ebɔrɛ nsaa wora mo kasonu na kikɛ e baa kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ!

english_verse: All of God's creation and all that he rules, come and praise your Lord! With all my heart I praise the Lord!
translation_verse: Menyi, Ebɔrɛ be asɔ toso kikɛ, nɛ e bee ji kuwura menyi so na, e baa kpaŋ men Nyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na! Ma ere be kagbene kikɛ nɛ ŋ kɔ a kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na!

english_verse: I praise you, Lord God, with all my heart. You are glorious and majestic, dressed in royal robes
translation_verse: Ma kagbene kikɛ nɛ n ta a kpaŋ fo, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na, ŋkpal manɛ so, kemaŋkuragboŋ nɛ kela kikɛ buu fo fanɛ kuwurpiŋi nna,

english_verse: and surrounded by light. You spread out the sky like a tent,
translation_verse: nɛ kefulto kulti fo n wɔtɔ kaplɛkama. Fo e parga kuwɔlpa to n sɔ kaplɛkama fanɛ wajɛbu, a wɔ kumo to.

english_verse: and you built your home over the mighty ocean. The clouds are your chariot with the wind as its wings.
translation_verse: Fo alɛ e pɔr fo kowu n shin nɛ tekugboŋ wɔ kumo be kaseto. Bɔrɛwɔlpa nɛ k bee bɔla afu so a nite na du fanɛ gbaŋɛturko nna n sa fo.

english_verse: The winds are your messengers, and flames of fire are your servants.
translation_verse: Fo e ta afuana fanɛ fo mbɔ nsaa ta bɔrɛ be kenyɛkpɛ malɛ fanɛ fo nyɛrbi.

english_verse: You built foundations for the earth, and it will never be shaken.
translation_verse: Fo e to durnya n yili kumo be gbaltɔlase so, nɛ k maaŋ tiŋ ŋ gbuŋgbuŋ na.

english_verse: You covered the earth with the ocean that rose above the mountains.
translation_verse: Fo alɛ e to eteku chiŋgeliŋana nɛ e bee bɔlɔ a dii abee so, nsaa buu durnya so fanɛ piŋi na.

english_verse: Then your voice thundered! And the water flowed
translation_verse: Ama nɛ fo baŋ ponte, nchuana kikɛ bee shile nna

english_verse: down the mountains and through the valleys to the place you prepared.
translation_verse: a gbelge abee so a bɔla ataŋɛ to a yɔ kakpa nɛ fo bela ase n yili amo na.

english_verse: Now you have set boundaries, so that the water will never flood the earth again.
translation_verse: Fo e yili amo be egbaŋ n sa amo nɛ a sa maŋ bɔlɔ n dii kepla m buu kasawule na kikɛ so.

english_verse: You provide streams of water in the hills and valleys,
translation_verse: Fo e shin nɛ abuye bee pete ataŋɛ to a ki elɔr a shile abee to a choŋ,

english_verse: so that the donkeys and other wild animals can satisfy their thirst.
translation_verse: saŋɛ na so ekurma nɛ kupuŋ to be asɔbɔya beeŋ baa nya nchu a nuu a tuge achukoŋ.

english_verse: From your home above you send rain on the hills and water the earth.
translation_verse: Fo e naa shin nɛ bɔrɛchu bee shi awɔlpa so a ba abee so nɛ kasawule bee nya kayul nɛnɛ.

english_verse: Our Lord, your trees always have water, and so do the cedars you planted in Lebanon.
translation_verse: An Nyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, fo ndibi bee nya nchu nna jemanɛ kikɛ, aloŋ nɛ ndibigboŋ nɛ baa tre sida nɛ fo duu Lebanɔn be efuli so na gba bee nya nchu.

english_verse: Birds nest in those trees, and storks make their home in the fir trees.
translation_verse: Ndibi na so nɛ mbuibi bee tɔ bumo be asha; nɛ etɔkɔrkɔ malɛ gba bee tɔ bumo be asha ashi ndibi tenteŋ nɛ baa tre fir na so.

english_verse: Wild goats find a home in the tall mountains, and small animals can hide between the rocks.
translation_verse: Kupuŋ to be mboe wɔ abee jeŋgreŋ so nna, nɛ asɔbɔya wurbi fanɛ eshiboe malɛ wɔ abee na be afalta to.

english_verse: You created the moon to tell us the seasons. The sun knows when to set,
translation_verse: Fo e to kufɔl nɛ k bee ŋini anyi kananɛ jemanɛ bee ba a yɔ; nɛ epeŋi malɛ nyi saŋɛ nɛ k bee tɔr.

english_verse: and you made the darkness, so the animals in the forest could come out at night.
translation_verse: Fo e to tentembiri nɛ kanyɛ bee biri, nɛ kupuŋ to be asɔbɔya bee nya lar a nite a kulti a fin kusɔ jiso a ji.

english_verse: Lions roar as they hunt for the food you provide.
translation_verse: Ebuluŋ bee munto a shu nna a fin keji, nɛ Ebɔrɛ beeŋ sa bumo.

english_verse: But when morning comes, they return to their dens,
translation_verse: Epeŋi baŋ pete, nɛ b naŋ bɛta n yɔ bumo be edesekpaana.

english_verse: then we go out to work until the end of day.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ edimɛdi e koso n yɔ ashuŋ to n ya shuŋ n tɔr epeŋi.

english_verse: Our Lord, by your wisdom you made so many things; the whole earth is covered with your living creatures.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, kanyiasheŋ so nɛ fo bɔla n to asɔ damta. Fo asɔ to so nɛ e kɔ ŋkpa sɔ kasawule so kikɛ nna.

english_verse: But what about the ocean so big and wide? It is alive with creatures, large and small.
translation_verse: Asɔ keniso be yiri yiri damta e wɔ teku nɛ k shi a dese palɛlɛ na to; Asɔgboŋ nɛ asɔwurbi kikɛ e wɔ kumo to.

english_verse: And there are the ships, as well as Leviathan, the monster you created to splash in the sea.
translation_verse: Teku so nɛ ekuloŋgboŋ bee nite a yɔ a ba; Kubɔya lubi gboŋgboŋi nɛ baa tre Liviatan na gba wɔ teku to nna.

english_verse: All of these depend on you to provide them with food,
translation_verse: Le be asɔ keniso ere kikɛ bee keni fo anishito nna nɛ fo sa amo kusɔ jiso jemanɛ nɛ k daga.

english_verse: and you feed each one with your own hand, until they are full.
translation_verse: Fo alɛ bee bugi enɔ to nna a sa amo kusɔ jiso nɛ a bee nya a ji a moɛ.

english_verse: You created all of them by your Spirit, and you give new life to the earth.
translation_verse: Fo Kiyoyu so nɛ fo bɔla n to amo be ekama nsaa shin nɛ ŋkpa popɔr bee ba kasawule so.

english_verse: Our Lord, we pray that your glory will last forever and that you will be pleased with what you have done.
translation_verse: An Nyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, anyee kule nna fanɛ fo kemaŋkura e baa wɔtɔ mbaanaayɔ; saŋɛ na so, fo kagbene beeŋ baa fuli kusɔ kama nɛ fo wora so.

english_verse: You look at the earth, and it trembles. You touch the mountains, and smoke goes up.
translation_verse: Fo baŋ to kenishi ŋ keni kasawule, k bee gbuŋgbuŋ nna. Fo alɛ baŋ beta abee, e bee kaa edishi nna.

english_verse: As long as I live, I will sing and praise you, the Lord God.
translation_verse: Meeŋ boŋ nshɛ ŋ kpaŋ fo Enyɛnpe ma Ebɔrɛ na, ashi ma kebaawɔtɔ kikɛ to.

english_verse: I hope my thoughts will please you, because you are the one who makes me glad.
translation_verse: Mee tama fanɛ ma nfɛra fɛso beeŋ baa par fo, ŋkpal manɛ so, ma kagbene fuli fo so.

english_verse: Destroy all wicked sinners from the earth once and for all. With all my heart I praise you, Lord! I praise you!
translation_verse: Shin nɛ alubiworapoana kikɛ e mur ashi kasawule ere so, n shin nɛ kumukpakpasowuraana e sa maŋ naa wɔtɔ kuraa. Meeŋ kpaŋ fo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ashi ma kagbene to kikɛ.

english_verse: Praise the Lord and pray in his name! Tell everyone what he has done.
translation_verse: Men baa di Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na epaŋ nsaa kule Ebɔrɛ ashi mbe ketre to! Men baa kaŋɛ efuli kikɛ so ebi kusɔ nɛ e wora be asheŋ.

english_verse: Sing praises to the Lord! Tell about his miracles.
translation_verse: Men baa boŋ nshɛ a kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na; nsaa malga emamachisheŋ nɛ e wora be asheŋ.

english_verse: Celebrate and worship his holy name with all your heart.
translation_verse: Men baa ji eyur nsaa bunyaŋ mbe ketre cheembi na ashi men be ŋgbene to kikɛ.

english_verse: when he said, “I'll give you the land of Canaan.”
translation_verse: E yɛ: “Meeŋ ta Keenan be kasawule n sa fo nɛ k baa la feya mbaanaayɔ.”

english_verse: At the time there were only a few of us, and we were homeless.
translation_verse: Loŋ be jemanɛ na nɛ Ebɔrɛ be basa na daa maŋ shi, bumo alɛ daa la befɔ ashi Keenan be kasawule so nna.

english_verse: We wandered from nation to nation, from one country to another.
translation_verse: B daa nite nna a kilgi to ashi efuli pɔtɛana so nɛ bewuraana be nsawule so.

english_verse: God did not let anyone mistreat our people. Instead he protected us by punishing rulers
translation_verse: Ama Ebɔrɛ daa maŋ shin nɛ ekama mɛaŋ bumo. E daŋ fɛa bewurjipo so nna ŋkpal e ka daa kuŋ mo basa so.

english_verse: and telling them, “Don't touch my chosen leaders or harm my prophets!”
translation_verse: E yɛ: “Men sa maŋ kaa tɔrɔ bejuŋkparpo nɛ n lara na, ŋko ma anebiana!”

english_verse: God kept crops from growing until food was scarce everywhere in the land.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na daŋ shin nɛ ewule ba efuli na so nna nɛ bumo be adɔjibi kikɛ mur.

english_verse: But he had already sent Joseph, sold as a slave into Egypt,
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ e shin nɛ bumo kurgepo Josɛf, nɛ b daŋ fa fanɛ kenya na, juŋkpar n yɔ Ijipt be efuli so.

english_verse: with chains of iron around his legs and neck.
translation_verse: B daŋ wɔtɔ Josɛf be aya nɛ mbe kubɔ to ŋgbɛlɛbi nna, nɛ e pɛge so;

english_verse: Joseph remained a slave until his own words had come true, and the Lord had finished testing him.
translation_verse: nɛ kusɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ na bɔlɔ so. Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be kamalga e shin nɛ kusɔ nɛ Josɛf kaŋɛ na ki kashenteŋ.

english_verse: and put him in charge of everything he owned.
translation_verse: Ewura na daŋ shin nna nɛ e bee keni mbe laŋ nɛ asɔ kikɛ so.

english_verse: Joseph was in command of the officials, and he taught the leaders how to use wisdom.
translation_verse: Josɛf e daa keni ekrachiana na so nsaa ŋini benimuana na kasheŋwora.

english_verse: Jacob and his family came and settled in Egypt as foreigners.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ Jeekɔb nɛ mbe kanaŋ ya ki befɔ n chena Ijipt be efuli so.

english_verse: They were the Lord's people, so he let them grow stronger than their enemies.
translation_verse: B ka la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be basa so, e daŋ shin nna nɛ b salga to nseŋ nya eleŋ a chɔ bumo doŋana.

english_verse: They served the Lord, and he made the Egyptians plan hateful things against them.
translation_verse: E daŋ shin nna nɛ Ijiptebi na kishi mbe basa nsaa kre bumo asheŋ lubi be nia.

english_verse: God sent his servant Moses. He also chose and sent Aaron
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ e shuŋi mbe kayɛrbi Mosis nɛ Ɛɛrɔn nɛ mo gbagba daŋ lara na mbe basa kutɔ.

english_verse: to his people in Egypt, and they worked miracles and wonders there.
translation_verse: B daŋ wora emamachisheŋ nɛ asheŋ tumase gboŋ ashi Ijipt be efuli so nna.

english_verse: Moses and Aaron obeyed God, and he sent darkness to cover Egypt.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ daŋ shin nɛ tentembiri ba buu efuli na kikɛ so nna, ama Ijiptebi na daa maŋ nu n sa Ebɔrɛ.

english_verse: God turned their rivers into streams of blood, and the fish all died.
translation_verse: E daa naŋ shin nɛ bumo be elɔrana be nchuana kilgi ŋklaŋ nɛ ekɔrɔtɔ kikɛ wu nna.

english_verse: When God gave the command, flies and gnats swarmed all around.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ daŋ malga nna nɛ ashushombi firgiso nɛ asɔ duŋso fanɛ epini ba mel efuli na kikɛ so.

english_verse: In place of rain, God sent hailstones and flashes of lightning.
translation_verse: Ade be kaman nɛ e shin nɛ bumo be bɔrɛchu ki abɔrɛjembu nɛ bɔrɛ bee nyɛkpɛ kasawule na kikɛ so;

english_verse: He destroyed their grapevines and their fig trees, and he made splinters of all the other trees.
translation_verse: e daŋ mur bumo be greep be afeelebi nɛ ndibi nɛ baa tre figi na nɛ ndibi nɛ a ka na kikɛ gba nna.

english_verse: God gave the command, and more grasshoppers came than could be counted.
translation_verse: E daŋ malga gba nna nɛ elotɔr ŋgboŋto ŋgboŋto ba sɔ efuli na kikɛ so.

english_verse: They ate every green plant and all the crops that grew in the land of Egypt.
translation_verse: Elotɔr ere daŋ ji afitiri bumbuŋ kikɛ nɛ asɔ nɛ b duu ndɔana kikɛ to nna m mur.

english_verse: Then God took the life of every first-born son.
translation_verse: Ade kikɛ nyam be kaman nɛ Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ Ijiptebi be ewurkoŋnyɛn kikɛ nyam wu.

english_verse: God hid them under a cloud and guided them by fire during the night.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ daa bɔla kuwɔlpa so kapaso nɛ edɛ be kabulpi so kanyɛso nna a ŋini bumo ekpa ashi bumo be enite na to.

english_verse: God even split open a rock, and streams of water gushed into the desert.
translation_verse: E daŋ shin nɛ kefalta pante nɛ nchu lar kumo to eleŋso, a shile keshishɛrsawule na so fanɛ lɔr na nna.

english_verse: God never forgot his sacred promise to his servant Abraham.
translation_verse: E daa nyiŋi mbe nnɔ naseso cheembi nɛ e nase n sa mbe kayɛrbi Eebraham na nna.

english_verse: When the Lord rescued his chosen people from Egypt, they celebrated with songs.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ka kɔ n suge mbe basa laraso ashi Ijipt be efuli so na, b daŋ boŋ nshɛ n ji eyur kagbenefuliso nna.

english_verse: The Lord gave them the land and everything else the nations had worked for.
translation_verse: E daŋ suge efuli pɔtɛana ko be nsawule nɛ asɔ kama nɛ b gben n nya nna n sa Israɛlebi na.

english_verse: He did this so that his people would obey all his laws. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: E wora loŋ nna nɛ mbe basa e baa wora mbe mbraana kasonu. Men kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na!

english_verse: We will celebrate and praise you, Lord! You are good to us, and your love never fails.
translation_verse: Men kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na! Men ta kechɔrɔ n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, ŋkpal manɛ so, e walɛ nna nɛ mbe kasha malɛ maa chɛrga hale mbaanaayɔ.

english_verse: No one can praise you enough for all the mighty things you have done.
translation_verse: Esa kikɛ maaŋ tiŋ m malga mbe asheŋgboŋ be asheŋ n ya loge kikɛ. Esa kikɛ malɛ maaŋ tiŋ ŋ kpaŋ mo gba n ya loge.

english_verse: You bless those people who are honest and fair in everything they do.
translation_verse: Kagbenefuli la bekama nɛ baa ji asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so nsaa wora asheŋ niŋiso jemanɛ kikɛ na peya nna.

english_verse: Remember me, Lord, when you show kindness by saving your people.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, baa nyiŋi ma, jemanɛ nɛ fee chɛ fo basa to nsaa mɔlga bumo na.

english_verse: Let me prosper with the rest of your chosen ones, as they celebrate with pride because they belong to you.
translation_verse: Shin nɛ n ti fo basa laraso so n nyalɛ, saŋɛ na so ma alɛ gba beeŋ ji eyur fanɛ kananɛ baa ji eyur kagbenefuliso ŋkpal b ka la fo basa so na.

english_verse: We and our ancestors have sinned terribly.
translation_verse: Anyi nɛ an nanaana kikɛ wora asheŋ lubi ga.

english_verse: When they were in Egypt, they paid no attention to your marvelous deeds or your wonderful love. And they turned against you at the Red Sea.
translation_verse: An nanaana ka daa wɔ Ijipt be efuli so na, bumo be lakal daa maa wɔ Ebɔrɛ be mamachi be asheŋ woraso so; ŋko kasha so. Jemanɛ nɛ b daa dii teku peper na, b daŋ pal kaman nna n sa mo.

english_verse: But you were true to your name, and you rescued them to prove how mighty you are.
translation_verse: Ama e daŋ mɔlga bumo, fanɛ kananɛ e nase kɔnɔ na; nseŋ ŋini bumo mbe eleŋgboŋ.

english_verse: You said to the Red Sea, “Dry up!” Then you led your people across on land as dry as a desert.
translation_verse: E daŋ kaŋɛ teku peper na nna fanɛ k ku to, nɛ k ku to. Ndoŋ nna nɛ e juŋkpar bumo kasawule wɔlso so m bɔla kumo to n choŋ.

english_verse: But they soon forgot what you had done and rejected your advice.
translation_verse: Ama k maŋ chɛr ko nɛ b naŋ teŋ kusɔ nɛ e wora so nsaa maŋ naa sɔ mbe kasotoji.

english_verse: They became greedy for food and tested you there in the desert.
translation_verse: Ajibi be kayɛlgagboŋ daŋ pɛ bumo ashi keshishɛrsawule na so nna nɛ b wora Ebɔrɛ ŋ keni.

english_verse: So you gave them what they wanted, but later you destroyed them with a horrible disease.
translation_verse: Amoso e daŋ sa bumo kusɔ nɛ b daa sha na nna, ama e daŋ ta kulɔ lubi nna ŋ gberge bumo kusoe.

english_verse: Then fire broke out and destroyed all of their followers.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ edɛ suse n chɔɔ kumukpakpasowuraana nɛ b daa bɛ bumo so na kikɛ m mur.

english_verse: You worked powerful miracles to save them from Egypt, but they forgot about you
translation_verse: B daŋ teŋ Ebɔrɛ nɛ e daŋ wora asheŋgboŋ ashi Ijipt be efuli so m mɔlga bumo na so nna.

english_verse: and the fearsome things you did at the Red Sea.
translation_verse: Bumo alɛ daŋ naŋ teŋ alemaŋkarsheŋ nɛ e wora ashi teku peper na ase na be asheŋ so nna.

english_verse: You were angry and started to destroy them, but Moses, your chosen leader, begged you not to do it.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ daŋ nya agbo nna ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ e beeŋ mur mbe basa na; ama Mosis nɛ e lara nɛ e baa la mbe kayɛrbi na, e mata mo nɛ e maŋ naŋ mur bumo.

english_verse: They would not obey you, and they grumbled in their tents.
translation_verse: B daŋ kini kewora Ebɔrɛ kasonu nna, nseŋ daa munto a bile asheŋ ashi bumo be ewajɛbu to.

english_verse: So you threatened them by saying, “I'll kill you out here in the desert!
translation_verse: Amoso e daŋ kpele bumo kusoe kenishipereso nna fanɛ e beeŋ shin nɛ b wu n tɔr keshishɛrsawule na so.

english_verse: Your people became followers of a god named Baal Peor, and they ate sacrifices offered to the dead.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ be basa na be beko daŋ ya kaa bɛ kegbir nɛ baa tre Baal Piyɔɔ na so nna, nseŋ daa ji agbir be nlɔŋɛjibi.

english_verse: They did such terrible things that you punished them with a deadly disease.
translation_verse: B daŋ wora asheŋ lubi ga nna nɛ Ebɔrɛ be kagbene kaa, nɛ e shin nɛ kulɔ lubi ko ba bumo so.

english_verse: Now he will always be highly honored.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal loŋ so, baa nyiŋi mo nna jemanɛ kikɛ nsaa sa mo bunyaŋ ga.

english_verse: Then Moses got into trouble for speaking in anger.
translation_verse: B daŋ shin nɛ kabɔlar pɛ Mosis nna nɛ e nya agbo a malga.

english_verse: Instead they were friendly with those foreigners and followed their customs.
translation_verse: Ama b daŋ ji bumo keteri nna hale a wora asheŋ nnyamase na be edaŋkare be ekpa so.

english_verse: Then they fell into the trap of worshiping idols.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ be basa na daŋ shuŋ agbirana nna, nɛ kumo be loŋ shin nɛ kemur ba bumo so.

english_verse: They sacrificed their sons and their daughters to demons
translation_verse: B daŋ ta bumo be mbia n lara esarga nna n sa ayoyu lubi.

english_verse: and to the gods of Canaan. Then they poured out the blood of these innocent children and made the land filthy.
translation_verse: Bumo be mbia nɛ b maŋ nyi kulubi nɛ kelela na be ŋklaŋ nɛ b daŋ ta n lara esarga n sa Keenan be efuli so be agbirana n jija kasawule na.

english_verse: Finally, Lord, you were angry and terribly disgusted with your people.
translation_verse: Amoso Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na daŋ nya agbo n wora mbe basa nna nseŋ daŋ kishi bumo be asheŋ.

english_verse: So you put them in the power of nations that hated them.
translation_verse: E daŋ kplaŋ bumo so nna nseŋ yige bumo n sa efuli pɔtɛana so be basa; nɛ bumo doŋana daa ji kuwura bumo so.

english_verse: They were mistreated and abused by their enemies,
translation_verse: Bumo doŋana daŋ kɔrfɛ bumo nseŋ ji eleŋ bumo so ga.

english_verse: but you saved them time after time. They were determined to rebel, and their sins caused their downfall.
translation_verse: Ale damta nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na daŋ mɔlga mbe basa; ama b daŋ kute n lar mo kaman a wora asheŋ gela m bɔla amo so n tɔr alubi damta to.

english_verse: You answered their prayers when they were in trouble.
translation_verse: Ama b ka shu n tre Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kagbenejijaso, e daŋ nu bumo be kushu na nna.

english_verse: that their enemies had pity on them.
translation_verse: E daŋ shin nɛ bumo doŋana shu bumo so nna.

english_verse: Save us, Lord God! Bring us back from among the nations. Let us celebrate and shout in praise of your holy name.
translation_verse: O Enyɛnpe anyi be Ebɔrɛ, mɔlga anyi, nseŋ lara anyi efuli pɔtɛana so m bɛta m ba epe. Saŋɛ na so anyeeŋ di fo epaŋ nseŋ kpaŋ fo ketre cheembi na.

english_verse: Lord God of Israel, you deserve to be praised forever and ever. Let everyone say, “Amen! Shout praises to the Lord!”
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe, Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ, fo e daga esa ka kpaŋ fo mbaanaayɔ. Shin nɛ ekama e kaŋɛ, “Amɛn!” Men kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na!

english_verse: ) The Lord Is Good to His People
translation_verse: ) Ebɔrɛ ka la esa n sa mbe basa be asheŋ

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! He is good to us, and his love never fails.
translation_verse: Men di Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na epaŋ, ŋkpal manɛ so, e walɛ, nɛ mbe kasha nɛ k maa chɛrga na, malɛ wɔtɔ mbaanaayɔ.

english_verse: Everyone the Lord has rescued from trouble should praise him,
translation_verse: Basa kama nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ mɔlga bumo ashi bumo doŋana be enɔ to na e kpaŋ mo.

english_verse: everyone he has brought from the east and the west, the north and the south.
translation_verse: Bekama nɛ b shi efuli pɔtɛana nɛ a kulti na so m bɛta m ba na kikɛ, e kpaŋ mo nseŋ di mo epaŋ.

english_verse: You were hungry and thirsty and about to give up.
translation_verse: Akoŋ nɛ achukoŋ e daa mɔ menyi, nɛ men daa shin nɛ men wu.

english_verse: You were in serious trouble, but you prayed to the Lord, and he rescued you.
translation_verse: Men ka daa wɔ kenishipere be tɔrɔ to nseŋ shu n tre Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na, e daŋ nu nna nseŋ mɔlga menyi.

english_verse: At once he brought you to a town.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ e juŋkpar menyi tinini m ba chena kadegboŋ na to.

english_verse: You should praise the Lord for his love and for the wonderful things he does for all of us.
translation_verse: A daga fanɛ men di Ebɔrɛ epaŋ ŋkpal mbe kasha nɛ k maa chɛrga, nɛ emamachisheŋ nɛ e bee wora a sa edimɛdi kikɛ na so.

english_verse: To everyone who is thirsty, he gives something to drink; to everyone who is hungry, he gives good things to eat.
translation_verse: E bee sa ekama nɛ achukoŋ kɔ kusɔnuuso nna nɛ e bee nuu. Ekama malɛ nɛ akoŋ kɔ, e bee sa mo kusɔ jiso lela nna.

english_verse: Some of you were prisoners suffering in deepest darkness and bound by chains,
translation_verse: Menyi be beko daa wɔ kabuti to nna, a ji awurfoŋ tentembiri mina to nɛ ŋgbɛlɛbi kre menyi,

english_verse: because you had rebelled against God Most High and refused his advice.
translation_verse: ŋkpal men ka daŋ kini Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na n lɛ, nseŋ kplaŋ mbe kasotoji so na so.

english_verse: You were worn out from working like slaves, and no one came to help.
translation_verse: Amoso nɛ men daŋ shuŋ fanɛ anya ŋ gben a chul to, nɛ esa kikɛ maŋ chɛ menyi to na.

english_verse: You were in serious trouble, but you prayed to the Lord, and he rescued you.
translation_verse: Men ka daa wɔ kenishipere be tɔrɔ to nseŋ shu n tre Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na, e daŋ nu nna nseŋ mɔlga menyi.

english_verse: He brought you out of the deepest darkness and broke your chains.
translation_verse: Tentembiri mina to nɛ e lara menyi nseŋ tuge menyi be ŋgbɛlɛbi nɛ men nya menyi be amu a ji.

english_verse: You should praise the Lord for his love and for the wonderful things he does for all of us.
translation_verse: A daga fanɛ men di Ebɔrɛ epaŋ ŋkpal mbe kasha nɛ k maa loge nɛ emamachisheŋ nɛ e bee wora a sa edimɛdi kikɛ so.

english_verse: He breaks down bronze gates and shatters iron locks.
translation_verse: Mo e naa bure danyaŋ be mbunagboŋ to, nsaa buri abɛlso be abersobi to cheche na.

english_verse: Some of you had foolishly committed a lot of sins and were in terrible pain.
translation_verse: Menyi to be beko wora alubi kawuliso nna nsaa ji awurfoŋ.

english_verse: The very thought of food was disgusting to you, and you were almost dead.
translation_verse: Men daa maa sha kewu ajibi kenishiso gba, a daŋ ka gbrɛ nɛ men wu gba.
