english_verse: You were in serious trouble, but you prayed to the Lord, and he rescued you.
translation_verse: Men ka daa wɔ kenishipere be etɔrɔ to nseŋ shu n tre Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na, e daŋ nu nna nseŋ mɔlga menyi.

english_verse: By the power of his own word, he healed you and saved you from destruction.
translation_verse: Mo gbagba be kamalga be eleŋ to nɛ e daŋ bɔla so n chɛ menyi to, m mɔlga menyi ashi kemur to.

english_verse: You should praise the Lord for his love and for the wonderful things he does for all of us.
translation_verse: A daga fanɛ men di Ebɔrɛ epaŋ ŋkpal mbe kasha nɛ k maa loge nɛ emamachisheŋ nɛ e bee wora a sa edimɛdi kikɛ na so.

english_verse: You should celebrate by offering sacrifices and singing joyful songs to tell what he has done.
translation_verse: A daga fanɛ men lara esarga n di mo epaŋ a boŋ nshɛ kagbenefuliso a kaŋɛ asheŋ nɛ e wora be asheŋ.

english_verse: and you saw the miracles the Lord performed there.
translation_verse: Menyi alɛ wu emamachisheŋ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na wora ashi teku na so.

english_verse: At his command a storm arose, and waves covered the sea.
translation_verse: Mo e daŋ malga kenishipereso n sa afugboŋ nɛ k ku atili teku so na.

english_verse: You were tossed to the sky and to the ocean depths, until things looked so bad that you lost your courage.
translation_verse: Atili na daa kpata nchu so be ekuloŋgboŋ na a yɔ esoso nɛ kaseto nna, nɛ kenishipere tu menyi nɛ men paŋ tama.

english_verse: You were in serious trouble, but you prayed to the Lord, and he rescued you.
translation_verse: Men ka daa wɔ kenishipere be tɔrɔ to, nseŋ shu n tre Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na, e daŋ nu nna nseŋ mɔlga menyi.

english_verse: He made the storm stop and the sea be quiet.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ e shin nɛ afugboŋ na yige kebaa ber eleŋso nɛ atili na lo dindiŋ.

english_verse: You were happy because of this, and he brought you to the port where you wanted to go.
translation_verse: Menyi be ŋgbene daŋ fuli menyi, ŋkpal loŋ so, e keta menyi nna n yɔ kakpa nɛ men daa sha keyɔ na.

english_verse: You should praise the Lord for his love and for the wonderful things he does for all of us.
translation_verse: A daga fanɛ men di Ebɔrɛ epaŋ, ŋkpal mbe kasha nɛ k maa loge nɛ emamachisheŋ nɛ e bee wora a sa edimɛdi kikɛ na so.

english_verse: If you start doing wrong, the Lord will turn rivers into deserts,
translation_verse: E shin nɛ elɔr wɔlto ŋ ki keshishɛrsawule, nɛ achubu malɛ ki nsawule wɔlso,

english_verse: flowing streams into scorched land, and fruitful fields into beds of salt.
translation_verse: nɛ adɔsawule lela ki nsawule wuso a dese, ŋkpal basa nɛ b wɔ ndoŋ be amu kpakpaso so.

english_verse: But the Lord can also turn deserts into lakes and scorched land into flowing streams.
translation_verse: Ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kraa beeŋ tiŋ n shin nɛ keshishɛrsawule e kilgi kubuye a bul nchu, nɛ kasawule wɔlso e ki kabombi a shile.

english_verse: If you are hungry, you can settle there and build a town.
translation_verse: Nɛ akoŋ pɛ menyi, menyeeŋ tiŋ n yuu menyi be nde n chena mbombi na ase n dɔ n ji.

english_verse: You can plant fields and vineyards that produce a good harvest.
translation_verse: Menyeeŋ tiŋ n dɔ n duu asɔduuso nɛ ndibi sɔrso, nɛ a wora nɛnɛ nɛ men teŋi ŋko n chuge amo ga.

english_verse: The Lord will bless you with many children and with herds of cattle.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ nɛfa menyi, nseŋ shin nɛ menyi be mbia e wora keshi; mo alɛ maaŋ shin nɛ menyi be ana e duga so.

english_verse: Sometimes you may be crushed by troubles and sorrows, until only a few of you are left to survive.
translation_verse: Jemanɛ ko beeŋ ba nɛ tɔrɔ nɛ awurfoŋ nɛ bedoŋ be kamɛaŋ e shin nɛ men duga so ŋ ki basa gbrɛbi.

english_verse: But the Lord will take revenge on those who conquer you, and he will make them wander across desert sands.
translation_verse: Ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ sɔ menyi be kɔnɔ so ŋ kɔ basa nɛ b daŋ pɔɔ menyi so na n shin nɛ b baa nite cham cham keshishɛrsawule so.

english_verse: When you are suffering and in need, he will come to your rescue, and your families will grow as fast as a herd of sheep.
translation_verse: Nɛ asheŋ baŋ tir menyi nɛ menyee ji awurfoŋ, e beeŋ ba mɔlga menyi nseŋ shin nɛ menyi be nnaŋ e salga fanɛ mboe nɛ mbolpɔ.

english_verse: You will see this because you obey the Lord, but everyone who is wicked will be silenced.
translation_verse: Menyeeŋ wu le be asheŋ ere nɛ menyi be ŋgbene e fuli, ŋkpal men ka bee wora Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kasonu so. Ama kumukpakpasowuraana bre maaŋ nya nnɔ bugi gba.

english_verse: Be wise! Remember this and think about the kindness of the Lord.
translation_verse: Ekama nɛ e kɔ kanyiasheŋ, e baa nyiŋi asheŋ ere nsaa fɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be kasha nɛ k maa loge na be asheŋ.

english_verse: Our God, I am faithful to you with all my heart, and you can trust me. I will sing and play music for you with all that I am.
translation_verse: O Ebɔrɛ, ma kagbene kikɛ nɛ ŋ kɔ a ji kashenteŋ a sa fo. Meeŋ boŋ nshɛ nseŋ ta ma kagbene kikɛ ŋ kpaŋ fo.

english_verse: I will start playing my harps before the sun rises.
translation_verse: Meeŋ fara a laŋ ma ejaŋjilaŋ a sa fo pɔɛŋ nɛ epeŋi e pete.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord, for everyone to hear; I will sing hymns to you in every nation.
translation_verse: O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, meeŋ di fo epaŋ nɛ ekama e nu fo asheŋ ashi efuli kikɛ so. Meeŋ boŋ nshɛ ŋ kpaŋ fo ashi basa to.

english_verse: Your love reaches higher than the heavens, and your loyalty extends beyond the clouds.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, k du fanɛ fo kasha, nɛ k maa loge na, choŋ ebɔrɛso nna; fo kashenteŋji malɛ bee chute awɔlpa nna.

english_verse: Our God, may you be honored above the heavens; may your glory be seen everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: O Ebɔrɛ, shin nɛ fo asheŋgboŋ e dii efuli ashi awɔlpa so kikɛ, nseŋ shin nɛ basa e wu fo kemaŋkura ashi kasawule ere kikɛ so.

english_verse: Answer my prayers and use your powerful arm to give us victory. Then the people you love will be safe.
translation_verse: Nu anyi be kekule nseŋ chɛ anyi to; ta fo eleŋgboŋ na m mɔlga anyi, nɛ an tiŋ ŋ kɔ m pɔɔ so. Saŋɛ na so fo basa shaso beeŋ nya bumo be amu.

english_verse: Our God, from your holy place you made this promise: “I will gladly divide up the city of Shechem and give away Succoth Valley piece by piece.
translation_verse: O Ebɔrɛ, fo nase kɔnɔ ashi fo kakpa cheembi na fanɛ feeŋ barga kadegboŋ nɛ baa tre Shɛkɛm na to nseŋ chige Sukɔf be Ketaŋɛ na to n sa fo basa kagbenefuliso.

english_verse: The lands of Gilead and Manasseh are mine. Ephraim is my war helmet, and Judah is my symbol of royal power.
translation_verse: Fo yɛ, Giliad nɛ Manase be nsawule la feya nna; nɛ Efrayim la fanɛ fo kebɛlso be kusɔ kuŋkumuso, nɛ Juda malɛ la fanɛ fo kuwurkpabi.

english_verse: Our God, who will bring me to the fortress or lead me to Edom?
translation_verse: O Ebɔrɛ, wanɛ e naŋ keta ma m ba kadegboŋ lempo na to; ŋko n juŋkpar ma n yɔ Edɔm be kasawule so?

english_verse: Have you rejected us? You don't lead our armies.
translation_verse: Fo maŋ naa juŋkpar anyi be benapo; fo kini anyi nna n lɛ a?

english_verse: Destructive and deceitful lies are told about me,
translation_verse: Kumukpakpasowuraana nɛ befɛpo bee kɔ ma nna a ku efɛ a deŋi ma,

english_verse: and hateful things are said for no reason.
translation_verse: nsaa malga asheŋ lubi a laŋɛ ma kaplɛa so; nɛ m maŋ wora bumo shɛŋ.

english_verse: I had pity and prayed for my enemies, but their words to me were harsh and cruel.
translation_verse: Ma ere ta bumo fanɛ nteriana nna, a kule Ebɔrɛ a sa bumo, ama b kraa malga mmalga lubi nna a gbiti ma.

english_verse: For being friendly and kind, they paid me back with meanness and hatred.
translation_verse: Kulubi nɛ baa ta a ka ma kelela be kukɔ, nsaa ta yurkishi a tal ma kasha to.

english_verse: My enemies said, “Find some worthless fools to accuse him of a crime.
translation_verse: N doŋana yɛ: “Fin esa lubi ko nɛ e wu mo kulubi ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ e wora kulubi ko nna.

english_verse: Try him and find him guilty! Consider his prayers a lie.
translation_verse: Ji mo demu ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ e ji n tɔr nna! Wu mbe kabɔrɛkule fanɛ efɛ nɛ e bee ku.

english_verse: Cut his life short and let someone else have his job.
translation_verse: Ku mbe ŋkpa so nseŋ shin nɛ esa ko e sɔ mo so ashi mbe eshuŋkpa.

english_verse: Make orphans of his children and a widow of his wife;
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ e shin nɛ mbe mbia e ki amunibi, nɛ mbe eche e ki ekulpoche,

english_verse: Don't let anyone be kind to him or have pity on the children he leaves behind.
translation_verse: Sa maŋ shin nɛ mbe asheŋ e baa tir esa kikɛ, ŋko n shin nɛ esa ko e sɔ mbe amunibi m bela kikɛ.

english_verse: Bring an end to his family, and from now on let him be a forgotten man.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ e shin nɛ mbe kanaŋ nɛ kaman to ebi kikɛ e mur kuraa; nseŋ shin nɛ b teŋ bumo be atre so hale mbaanaayɔ.

english_verse: “Don't let the Lord forgive the sins of his parents and his ancestors.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ e sa maŋ ta mo tutoana nɛ mo nanaana be alubi m paŋ bumo kikɛ.

english_verse: Don't let the Lord forget the sins of his family, or let anyone remember his family ever lived.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na e baa nyiŋi mbe kanaŋ kikɛ be alubi; nsaa maŋ naŋ shin nɛ esa kikɛ e nyiŋi bumo be asheŋ kikɛ kuraa!

english_verse: He was so cruel to the poor, homeless, and discouraged that they died young.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, e daa maŋ la esa kikɛ; e daa kɔrfɛ betirpo nɛ bematako nɛ betentaŋasepo nna a mɔ bumo.

english_verse: “He cursed others. Now place a curse on him! He never wished others well. Wish only trouble for him!
translation_verse: E daa sha kebaasho basa kɔnɔ nna; amoso shin nɛ kɔnɔsho e pɛ mo alɛ gba. E daŋ kishi basa ga; amoso mo alɛ gba maaŋ nya nɛfa!

english_verse: He cursed others more often than he dressed himself. Let his curses strike him deep, just as water and olive oil soak through to our bones.
translation_verse: Kananɛ e bee buu mbe epiŋi a chɛrga ale damta na, aloŋ nɛ e bee shoduu basa. Ebɔrɛ e shin nɛ mbe shoduu na e laŋɛ mo gbagba so!

english_verse: Let his curses surround him, just like the belt and clothes he wears each day.”
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ e shin nɛ mbe eshoduu na e ki fanɛ epiŋi nɛ e bee buu karechɛ kikɛ m buu mo kikɛ so.”

english_verse: Those are the cruel things my enemies wish for me. Let it all happen to them!
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e naŋ ka bedoŋ nɛ baa wu ma kulubi nsaa malga a gbiti ma na kukɔ.

english_verse: Be true to your name, Lord God! Show your great kindness and rescue me.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ, chɛ ma to, fanɛ kananɛ fo nase kɔnɔ na; nseŋ mɔlga ma ŋkpal fo kasha nɛ k maa loge na so.

english_verse: I am poor and helpless, and I have lost all hope.
translation_verse: N la etirpo nɛ etentaŋasepo nɛ ebesa damta bɔlɔ ma kagbene to nna.

english_verse: I am fading away like an evening shadow; I am tossed aside like a crawling insect.
translation_verse: Ma kebaawɔtɔ bee choŋ fanɛ kaaseso be kiyoyul nna; ŋko fanɛ afu ka bee kpata kusɔ firgisobi nna.

english_verse: I have gone without eating, until my knees are weak, and my body is bony.
translation_verse: Ma amuli bee yɔɔ nna ŋkpal akoŋ so; nɛ ma kikɛ nyɔr ŋ ki awibi.

english_verse: When my enemies see me, they say cruel things and shake their heads.
translation_verse: Bedoŋ baŋ wu ma gba, baa mushe nna nsaa fifi amu.

english_verse: Please help me, Lord God! Come and save me because of your love.
translation_verse: O n Nyɛnpe nɛ ma Ebɔrɛ, chɛ ma to nseŋ mɔlga ma ŋkpal fo kasha nɛ k maa loge na so.

english_verse: Let others know that you alone have saved me.
translation_verse: Shin nɛ bedoŋ e pin fanɛ fo, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na, e la ma emɔlgapo.

english_verse: I don't care if they curse me, as long as you bless me. You will make my enemies fail when they attack, and you will make me glad to be your servant.
translation_verse: Bumo ere beeŋ tiŋ n shoduu ma, ama fo ere bee nɛfa ma nna. Nɛ bedoŋ bee kɔ ma gba, fo maaŋ shuli nɛ b pɔɔ ma so; fo alɛ beeŋ shin nɛ ma, nɛ n la fo kayɛrbi na, be kagbene e fuli ma.

english_verse: You will cover them with shame, just as their bodies are covered with clothes.
translation_verse: Fo e naŋ shin nɛ anishinyɔr e ki fanɛ asɔbuuso m buu basa nɛ baa wu ma kulubi na.

english_verse: I will sing your praises and thank you, Lord, when your people meet.
translation_verse: O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, meeŋ boŋ nshɛ ŋ kpaŋ fo nseŋ di fo epaŋ ga ashi fo basa be nshɛrana to.

english_verse: The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at my right side, until I make your enemies into a footstool for you.”
translation_verse: Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ n nyɛnpe, ewura na le: “Chena ma jisa so hale nɛ n ya shin nɛ fo ji eleŋ fo doŋana so.”

english_verse: The Lord will let your power reach out from Zion, and you will rule over your enemies.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ n shin nɛ fo kuwurji be eleŋ e shi Jerusalɛm n salga to, hale nɛ fo ji kuwura fo doŋana so.

english_verse: Your glorious power will be seen on the day you begin to rule. You will wear the sacred robes and shine like the morning sun in all of your strength.
translation_verse: Kachɛ nɛ feeŋ kɔ fo doŋana kena na, fo basa gbagba e naŋ shuli n tu fo ŋ kɔ bumo. Fo mbrantiɛfɔlbi beeŋ ba fo kutɔ fanɛ kachipurdidi be bunyaŋ.

english_verse: The Lord has made a promise that will never be broken: “You will be a priest forever, just like Melchizedek.”
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nase kɔnɔ nɛ k maaŋ chɛrga kikɛ. E yɛ: “Feeŋ baa la bɔrɛmatapo mbaanaayɔ, fanɛ Mɛlkizedɛk nɛ e daa la bɔrɛmatapo na.”

english_verse: The Lord is at your right side, and when he gets angry he will crush the other kings.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na wɔ fo jisa so nna; kachɛ nɛ e beeŋ nya agbo, e beeŋ pɔɔ bewura pɔtɛana so.

english_verse: He will judge the nations and crack their skulls, leaving piles of dead bodies all over the earth.
translation_verse: E beeŋ ji basa nɛ b wɔ efuli pɔtɛana so demu nseŋ shin nɛ bumo be basa e wu n deŋi abar so kasawule ere so.

english_verse: He will drink from any stream that he chooses, while winning victory after victory.
translation_verse: E beeŋ nuu kabombi nɛ k dese ekpakar na be nchu; E beeŋ baa nya eleŋ a kɔ a pɔɔ so jemanɛ kikɛ.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! With all my heart I will thank the Lord when his people meet.
translation_verse: Meeŋ kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ashi ma kagbene to. Ma alɛ beeŋ di mo epaŋ ashi mbe basa be nshɛr to.

english_verse: The Lord has done many wonderful things! Everyone who is pleased with God's marvelous deeds will keep them in mind.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na wora emamachisheŋ damta nna! Ekama nɛ amo be asheŋ bɔlɔ mo kenishi bee fɛ amo be asheŋ nna.

english_verse: Everything the Lord does is glorious and majestic, and his power to bring justice will never end.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be asheŋ woraso kikɛ kɔ bunyaŋ nɛ kemaŋkura nna. Kusɔ kama nɛ e bee wora malɛ niŋi nna mbaanaayɔ.

english_verse: The Lord God is famous for his wonderful deeds, and he is kind and merciful.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na maa shin nɛ anyee teŋ mbe emamachisheŋ so; Mo alɛ la esa nsaa wu kuwɔr nna.

english_verse: He gives food to his worshipers and always keeps his agreement with them.
translation_verse: E bee sa bekama nɛ baa bunyaŋ mo na ajibi nna. Mo alɛ nsaa nyiŋi mo nɛ bumo be kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre na hale mbaanaayɔ.

english_verse: He has shown his mighty power to his people and has given them the lands of other nations.
translation_verse: Mo e lara mbe eleŋgboŋ na ŋ ŋini mbe basa, jemanɛ nɛ e sɔ efuli pɔtɛana be nsawule n sa bumo na.

english_verse: God is always honest and fair, and his laws can be trusted.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ be kasheŋwora kikɛ to, e bee ji asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so nna. Esa beeŋ tiŋ n yirda mbe mbraana.

english_verse: They are true and right and will stand forever.
translation_verse: Amo alɛ wɔtɔ nna mbaanaayɔ. Kashenteŋ nɛ ekpa niŋiso so nɛ e bɔla so n sa mbraana na.

english_verse: God rescued his people, and he will never break his agreement with them. He is fearsome and holy.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ e sɔ mbe basa n yige; mo e wora mo nɛ bumo be kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre mbaanaayɔ. E la esa cheembi nɛ esa gboŋgboŋi nɛ e daga bunyaŋgboŋ nna.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! The Lord blesses everyone who worships him and gladly obeys his teachings.
translation_verse: Men kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na awɔrso! Kagbenefuli la bekama nɛ baa bunyaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nsaa wora mbe mbraana kasonu kagbenefuliso na peya nna.

english_verse: Their descendants will have great power in the land, because the Lord blesses all who do right.
translation_verse: Bumo be kaman to ebi beeŋ baa kɔ eleŋgboŋ ga kasawule so; ŋkpal manɛ so, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee nɛfa bekama nɛ baa wora asheŋ niŋiso na nna.

english_verse: They will get rich and prosper and will always be remembered for their fairness.
translation_verse: Baaŋ nyalɛ nseŋ dii dama; nɛ ekama malɛ e baa nyiŋi bumo ŋkpal bumo be aworbi ka niŋi so.

english_verse: They will be so kind and merciful and good, that they will be a light in the dark for others who do the right thing.
translation_verse: Basa nɛ baa wu kuwɔr nsaa la basa a wora asheŋ niŋiso na du fanɛ kefulto nna ashi tentembiri to.

english_verse: Life will go well for those who freely lend and are honest in business.
translation_verse: Kebaawɔtɔ bee nite nɛnɛ nna a sa bekama nɛ baa bugi epunto a ta asɔ a paŋ beko nsaa ji kashenteŋ ashi bumo be keyawuji to na.

english_verse: They won't ever be troubled, and the kind things they do will never be forgotten.
translation_verse: Shɛŋ maaŋ tiŋ n chɛrga bumo be kesheŋ wora; basa malɛ maaŋ teŋ bumo be alelasheŋ so kikɛ.

english_verse: Bad news won't bother them; they have decided to trust the Lord.
translation_verse: B maaŋ baa ŋana baru lubi ŋkpal manɛ so, bumo be ŋgbene baa yil kakpa koŋwule nna nɛ baa yirda Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.

english_verse: They are dependable and not afraid, and they will live to see their enemies defeated.
translation_verse: Shɛŋ maa fɔŋ bumo ŋko a da bumo kufu; b baa nyi geeŋ fanɛ bumo doŋana beeŋ ji n tɔr.

english_verse: They will always be remembered and greatly praised, because they were kind and freely gave to the poor.
translation_verse: Baa bugi ŋgbene nna a kɛ betentaŋasepo asɔ nɛ bumo be kelela be kewora malɛ maŋ kɔ ekar. Amoso basa bee nyiŋi bumo jemanɛ kikɛ nna.

english_verse: When evil people see this, they angrily bite their tongues and disappear. They will never get what they really want.
translation_verse: Basa lubi baŋ wu basa nɛ b kɔ le be kebaawɔtɔ ere, baa nya agbo nna a we anyi to yurkishi so nseŋ foe eyur to. B maaŋ nya bumo be kepar kikɛ.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! Everyone who serves him, come and praise his name.
translation_verse: Men kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na awɔrso! Menyi nɛ menyee shuŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na, e kpaŋ mbe ketre na.

english_verse: Let the name of the Lord be praised now and forever.
translation_verse: Men shin nɛ basa kikɛ e baa kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be ketre naniere hale mbaanaayɔ.

english_verse: From dawn until sunset the name of the Lord deserves to be praised.
translation_verse: Baŋ yili karechɛ kikɛ be kachipurso n ya fo kaaseso, ekama e baa kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be ketre!

english_verse: The Lord is far above all of the nations; he is more glorious than the heavens.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e naa ji kuwura efuliana na kikɛ so; mbe kemaŋkura shi a chɔ esoso be asɔ kikɛ peya.

english_verse: No one can compare with the Lord our God. His throne is high above,
translation_verse: Esa kikɛ maaŋ tiŋ n ta mbe kumu m ber Enyɛnpe anyi be Ebɔrɛ na. Mo e chena mbe kuwurputi so ebɔrɛso

english_verse: and he looks down to see the heavens and the earth.
translation_verse: nsaa kurgi kumu a keni awɔlpa nɛ kasawule nɛ a wɔ mbe kaseto na.

english_verse: God lifts the poor and needy from dust and ashes,
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ e naa lara betirpo nɛ betentaŋasepo ashi ketir nɛ ketentaŋase to

english_verse: and he lets them take part in ruling his people.
translation_verse: nsaa shin nɛ baa tu mbe basa nɛ be la bewurbi na a chena a ji kekurge.

english_verse: When a wife has no children, he blesses her with some, and she is happy. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Eche kilpo baa maa kɔ mbia, Ebɔrɛ e naa nɛfa mo nɛ e bee nya mbia nɛ mbe kagbene e fuli. Men kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na!

english_verse: God brought his people out of Egypt, that land with a strange language.
translation_verse: Jemanɛ nɛ Israɛl be basa lar basa nɛ baa gbar ŋgbar pɔtɛ ashi Ijipt be efuli so to na,

english_verse: When the sea looked at God, it ran away, and the Jordan River flowed upstream.
translation_verse: K daŋ wora fanɛ Teku Peper na ka wu Ebɔrɛ nna nseŋ ku to, nɛ Jɔɔdan be Lɔr na malɛ wu mo nseŋ shir n yili.

english_verse: The mountains and the hills skipped around like goats.
translation_verse: Nɛ kewora fanɛ abeegboŋ nɛ abeebi ka bee tɛto a kulti fanɛ mbolpɔbi na.

english_verse: Ask the sea why it ran away or ask the Jordan why it flowed upstream.
translation_verse: Bishi teku na kusɔ nɛ k ba nɛ k sa ekpa, ŋko Jɔɔdan be Lɔr na manɛ nna nɛ k maŋ naŋ tiŋ nɛ k shile?

english_verse: Ask the mountains and the hills why they skipped like goats!
translation_verse: Bishi abeegboŋ nɛ abeebi na, fanɛ, manɛ nna nɛ a bee tɛto a kulti fanɛ mbolpɔbi?

english_verse: Earth, you will tremble, when the Lord God of Jacob comes near,
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ men nananyɛn Jeekɔb shuŋ dra na baŋ firgi n taga to, kasawule bee gbuŋgbuŋ nna;

english_verse: We don't deserve praise! The Lord alone deserves all of the praise, because of his love and faithfulness.
translation_verse: Anyi ere maŋ daga fanɛ b kpaŋ anyi kuraa! Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nawule e daga fanɛ ekama nyam e kpaŋ mo; ŋkpal mbe kasha nɛ k maa chɛrga nɛ mbe kashenteŋji so.

english_verse: Why should the nations ask, “Where is your God?”
translation_verse: Manɛ e ba nɛ efuliana na be basa bee kaŋɛ le: “Men be Ebɔrɛ na wɔ nnɛ?”

english_verse: Our God is in the heavens, doing as he chooses.
translation_verse: Anyi be Ebɔrɛ na wɔ ebɔrɛso nna a wora kusɔ nɛ e bee sha.

english_verse: The idols of the nations are made of silver and gold.
translation_verse: Ama shuwa nɛ gbiti nɛ efuli pɔtɛana be basa bre ta n lɔŋɛ bumo be agbirana a shuŋ.

english_verse: They have a mouth and eyes, but they can't speak or see.
translation_verse: Agbirana na kɔ nnɔ, ama a maa malga, a kɔ anishi, ama a maa wu.

english_verse: Their ears can't hear, and their noses can't smell.
translation_verse: A kɔ asoe, ama a maa nu, nsaa kɔ mmuna, ama a maa nu efɛa.

english_verse: Their hands have no feeling, their legs don't move, and they can't make a sound.
translation_verse: Agbirana na kɔ enɔana, ama a maaŋ tiŋ m pɛ shɛŋ to, a kɔ aya, ama a maaŋ tiŋ n nite; a maaŋ tiŋ m malga ŋ kaŋɛ shɛŋ.

english_verse: Everyone who made the idols and all who trust them are just as helpless as those useless gods.
translation_verse: Bekama nɛ b lɔŋɛ agbirana na nɛ bumo nɛ b yirda amo na du jiga fanɛ agbirana na nna; b maŋ kɔ tɔnɔ kikɛ.

english_verse: People of Israel, you must trust the Lord to help and protect you.
translation_verse: Israɛl be basa, men yirda Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na, ŋkpal manɛ so, mo e naa chɛ menyi to nsaa kuŋ menyi.

english_verse: Family of Aaron the priest, you must trust the Lord to help and protect you.
translation_verse: Menyi nɛ men la Ɛɛrɔn be kanaŋ to ebi nsaa la bɔrɛmatapoana na, a daga fanɛ men yirda Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nɛ e baa chɛ menyi to nsaa kuŋ menyi.

english_verse: All of you worship the Lord, so you must trust him to help and protect you.
translation_verse: Menyi nɛ menyee bunyaŋ Ebɔrɛ na, a daga fanɛ menyi alɛ gba e yirda Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nɛ e baa chɛ menyi to nsaa kuŋ menyi.

english_verse: The Lord will not forget to give us his blessing; he will bless all of Israel and the family of Aaron.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ bee nyiŋi anyi be asheŋ; mo alɛ beeŋ nɛfa anyi. E beeŋ nɛfa Israɛl be basa kikɛ nɛ Ɛɛrɔn be kanaŋ to ebi kikɛ.

english_verse: All who worship the Lord, no matter who they are, will receive his blessing.
translation_verse: E beeŋ nɛfa bekama nɛ baa bunyaŋ mo na; bewurjipo nɛ bebɔlpo kikɛ.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will let your family and your descendants always grow strong.
translation_verse: Ma kabɔrɛkule e la fanɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ shin nɛ menyi nɛ men be kaman to ebi kikɛ e salga n wora keshi.

english_verse: May the Lord who created the heavens and the earth give you his blessing.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ e to esoso nɛ kasawule na e nɛfa menyi!

english_verse: The Lord has kept the heavens for himself, but he has given the earth to us humans.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛso la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nawule peya nna, ama e ta kasawule nna n sa anyi edimɛdi.

english_verse: The dead are silent and cannot praise the Lord,
translation_verse: Basa nɛ b teŋ wu n yɔ bubuni to maaŋ naŋ tiŋ ŋ kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.

english_verse: but we will praise him now and forevermore. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Anyi nɛ an wɔ ŋkpa to ere nawule e naŋ tiŋ a di mo epaŋ naniere hale mbaanaayɔ. Men kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na!

english_verse: You paid attention to me, and so I will pray to you as long as I live.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal e ka bee kaŋ kusoe a nu ma kekule so, meeŋ baa shu a tre mo jemanɛ kikɛ ashi ma kebaawɔtɔ to.

english_verse: Death attacked from all sides, and I was captured by its painful chains. But when I was really hurting,
translation_verse: Luwu daŋ kulti ma nna n wɔtɔ a funti ma; nɛ keyɔ nchaŋ to be kagbenejija daŋ tɔr ma so. Kufu nɛ kafɔŋ e daŋ bɔlɔ ma to.

english_verse: I prayed and said, “Lord, please don't let me die!”
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ n shu n tre Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na, fanɛ e jande e mɔlga ma!

english_verse: You are kind, Lord, so good and merciful.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee wu kuwɔr nsaa walɛ; Kashenteŋto Ebɔrɛ kɔ kushuso pasaa.

english_verse: and treated me so kindly that I don't need to worry anymore.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ka wora ma kelela so, shɛŋ be asheŋ maŋ naa fɔŋ ma ashi ma kagbene to.

english_verse: You, Lord, have saved my life from death, my eyes from tears, my feet from stumbling.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na daŋ mɔlga ma ashi luwu to nna; mo e daŋ kpra ma anishichubi, nseŋ kuŋ ma nɛ m maŋ fiti n tɔr.

english_verse: Now I will walk at your side in this land of the living.
translation_verse: Naniere ma nɛ mo e naŋ baa bɔ aya a nite ashi basa nɛ b wɔ ŋkpa to be kasawule so.

english_verse: though in my confusion I said, “I can't trust anyone!”
translation_verse: Jemanɛ nɛ kufu daa kɔ ma gba, m maŋ ta ma yirda n deŋi esa kikɛ so.

english_verse: What must I give you, Lord, for being so good to me?
translation_verse: Manɛ bre nɛ meeŋ ta ŋ ka Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kukɔ, ŋkpal alelasheŋ nɛ e bee wora a sa ma so?

english_verse: I will pour out an offering of wine to you, and I will pray in your name because you have saved me.
translation_verse: Meeŋ bar yabra belbelso be sarga m ba di Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na epaŋ, ŋkpal e ka mɔlga ma so.

english_verse: I will keep my promise to you when your people meet.
translation_verse: Jemanɛ nɛ mbe basa kikɛ beeŋ shɛr abar so na nɛ meeŋ tia nnɔ nɛ n nase n sa mo na kikɛ.

english_verse: You are deeply concerned when one of your loyal people faces death.
translation_verse: Basa nɛ baa shuŋ Ebɔrɛ nɛnɛ na be luwu be asheŋ tir ga n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.

english_verse: I worship you, Lord, just as my mother did, and you have rescued me from the chains of death.
translation_verse: O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, n la fo kayɛrbi kashenteŋto nna; kananɛ n nio shuŋ fo na nɛ ma alɛ gba bee shuŋ fo na. Fo e mɔlga ma ashi luwu to.

english_verse: I will offer you a sacrifice to show how grateful I am, and I will pray.
translation_verse: Meeŋ lara sarga n di fo epaŋ nseŋ shu n tre fo ashi ma kabɔrɛkule to.

english_verse: All of you nations, come praise the Lord! Let everyone praise him.
translation_verse: Menyi, efuli pɔtɛana so ebi, men baa di Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na epaŋ! Menyi, edimɛdi be yiri kikɛ, men di mo epaŋ!

english_verse: God's love for us is wonderful; his faithfulness never ends. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, kasha nɛ e kɔ n sa anyi na shi ga; nɛ mbe kashenteŋji malɛ maŋ kɔ ekar. Men kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na!

english_verse: Tell the Lord how thankful you are, because he is kind and always merciful.
translation_verse: Men di Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na epaŋ, ŋkpal manɛ so, e walɛ nɛ mbe kasha nɛ k maa chɛrga na malɛ wɔtɔ mbaanaayɔ.

english_verse: Let Israel shout, “God is always merciful!”
translation_verse: Shin nɛ Israɛl be basa e kaŋɛ le: “Mbe kasha wɔtɔ nna mbaanaayɔ.”

english_verse: Let the family of Aaron the priest shout, “God is always merciful!”
translation_verse: Shin nɛ Ɛɛrɔn be laŋ to ebi, nɛ b la bɔrɛmatapoana na e kaŋɛ le: “Mbe kasha wɔtɔ nna mbaanaayɔ.”

english_verse: Let every true worshiper of the Lord shout, “God is always merciful!”
translation_verse: Shin nɛ bekama nɛ baa bunyaŋ mo na e kaŋɛ le: “Mbe kasha wɔtɔ nna mbaanaayɔ.”

english_verse: When I was really hurting, I prayed to the Lord. He answered my prayer, and took my worries away.
translation_verse: Ma awurfoŋ nɛ ebesa to nɛ n shu n tre Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na, nɛ e nu ma kabɔrɛkule nseŋ lara kafɔŋ na ma so.

english_verse: The Lord is on my side, and I am not afraid of what others can do to me.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ka wɔ ŋ kutɔ so, m maaŋ naa ŋana kufu. Manɛ nɛ dimɛdi beeŋ tiŋ n wora ma?

english_verse: With the Lord on my side, I will defeat my hateful enemies.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ka la ma echɛtopo so, bedoŋ beeŋ kɔ n tɔr nɛ n wu bumo.

english_verse: It is better to trust the Lord for protection than to trust anyone else,
translation_verse: Keta fo yirda n to Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ so nɛ e baa kuŋ fo bɔ fo ka ta fo kumu n to nyiŋgbasa so

english_verse: including strong leaders.
translation_verse: ŋko edimɛdi be bejuŋkparpo lempoana so.

english_verse: Nations surrounded me, but I got rid of them by the power of the Lord.
translation_verse: Efuli damtaana e kulti ma n wɔtɔ, ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be eleŋgboŋ so, n tiŋ m mur bumo kikɛ nyam.

english_verse: They attacked from all sides, but I got rid of them by the power of the Lord.
translation_verse: B daa kɔ ma kaba kama so nna, ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be ketre to, n tiŋ m mur bumo.

english_verse: They swarmed around like bees, but by the power of the Lord, I got rid of them and their fiery sting.
translation_verse: B daŋ ba mel ma so fanɛ emushoŋ nna, ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be ketre to, b daŋ chɔɔ m mur nna fanɛ edɛ ka tɔr afitiri wɔlso so na.

english_verse: Their attacks were so fierce that I nearly fell, but the Lord helped me.
translation_verse: B daa kɔ ma kenishipereso nna; a daŋ ka gbrɛbi nɛ b pɔɔ ma so. Ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e daŋ chɛ ma to.

english_verse: My power and my strength come from the Lord, and he has saved me.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e wɔtɔ ma eleŋ to nseŋ sa ma kashɛ nɛ m boŋ; mo e mɔlga ma.

english_verse: From the tents of God's people come shouts of victory: “The Lord is powerful!
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ be basa bee chena bumo be elaŋana to nna a boŋ kekɔmpɔɔso be nshɛ awɔrso a kaŋɛ: “Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be eleŋgboŋ na e wora asheŋgboŋ!

english_verse: With his mighty arm the Lord wins victories! The Lord is powerful!”
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be eleŋgboŋ na e shin nɛ an kɔ m pɔɔ so. Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kɔ eleŋ pasaa!”

english_verse: And so my life is safe, and I will live to tell what the Lord has done.
translation_verse: Amoso m maaŋ wu, meeŋ baa wɔ ŋkpa to, a ber kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na wora be kubomboŋ.

english_verse: He punished me terribly, but he did not let death lay its hands on me.
translation_verse: E daŋ gberge ma kusoe kenishipereso, ama mo alɛ maŋ shin nɛ n wu.

english_verse: Open the gates of justice! I will enter and tell the Lord how thankful I am.
translation_verse: Men bugi kebaawɔtɔ niŋiso be mbunagboŋ n sa ma nɛ n luri to n di Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na epaŋ.

english_verse: Here is the gate of the Lord! Everyone who does right may enter this gate.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be kabunagboŋ na nɛ n da na; basa niŋiso nawule e naŋ tiŋ m bɔla kumo to n luri.

english_verse: I praise the Lord for answering my prayers and saving me.
translation_verse: Meeŋ di fo, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na epaŋ, ŋkpal fo ka nu ma kabɔrɛkule nseŋ shin nɛ ŋ kɔ m pɔɔ so so.

english_verse: The stone that the builders tossed aside has now become the most important stone.
translation_verse: Kejembu nɛ bepɔrpo kini n lɛ na e ki ebu na be kebonfu to be gbaltɔlase be kejembu lela na.

english_verse: The Lord has done this, and it is amazing to us.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e wora loŋ; anyi alɛ wu kumo fanɛ k la mamachi be kesheŋ nna.

english_verse: This day belongs to the Lord! Let's celebrate and be glad today.
translation_verse: Kabre la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be kachɛ nna, men shin nɛ anyi be ŋgbene e fuli, nɛ an ji eyur!

english_verse: We'll ask the Lord to save us! We'll sincerely ask the Lord to let us win.
translation_verse: O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, mɔlga anyi, nseŋ shin nɛ asheŋ a nyalɛ n sa anyi!

english_verse: God bless the one who comes in the name of the Lord! We praise you from here in the house of the Lord.
translation_verse: Nɛfa la esa nɛ e bee ba Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be ketre to na peya nna. Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, fo bɔrɛlambu na ase nɛ an yil a nɛfa fo.

english_verse: The Lord is our God, and he has given us light! Start the celebration! March with palm branches all the way to the altar.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e la Ebɔrɛ, mo e shin nɛ mbe kefulto nyaŋɛ n yuu anyi so! Men shin nɛ an ta abii be ayabi ŋ keta enɔ to nseŋ bɛ abar so a ji eyur a kulti bɔrɛsure na.

english_verse: The Lord is my God! I will praise him and tell him how thankful I am.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e la ma Ebɔrɛ, ma alɛ beeŋ di mo epaŋ nseŋ ber mbe keshi be kebomboŋ n sa basa kikɛ nɛ b nu.

english_verse: Tell the Lord how thankful you are, because he is kind and always merciful.
translation_verse: Men di Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na epaŋ, ŋkpal manɛ so, e walɛ nɛ mbe kasha nɛ k maa chɛrga na malɛ wɔtɔ mbaanaayɔ.

english_verse: You bless all those who follow your commands from deep in their hearts
translation_verse: Kagbenefuli la bekama nɛ baa bɛ mbe atande so, nsaa wora mo kasonu ashi bumo be ŋgbene to na peya nna.

english_verse: and who never do wrong or turn from you.
translation_verse: B maa wora asheŋ lubi, baa wora asheŋ nɛ a bɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be ekpa so nna.

english_verse: You have ordered us always to obey your teachings;
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, fo e sa anyi fo mbraana na, nsaa sha fanɛ an baa wora amo kasonu kashenteŋto.

english_verse: I don't ever want to stray from your laws.
translation_verse: Ekpa kikɛ so, n daa sha ketiŋ m bɛ fo mbraana so kashenteŋto nna!

english_verse: Thinking about your commands will keep me from doing some foolish thing.
translation_verse: M maaŋ ji anishinyɔr jemanɛ nɛ meeŋ baa bɛ fo mbraana so na.

english_verse: I will do right and praise you by learning to respect your perfect laws.
translation_verse: Ma kekoya fo mbra niŋiso na e naŋ shin nɛ ŋ kpaŋ fo kagbenefuliso.

english_verse: I will obey all of them! Don't turn your back on me.
translation_verse: Meeŋ wora fo mbraana kasonu, amoso sa maŋ kaŋ pal kaman n sa ma! Kewora Ebɔrɛ be mbra na kasonu be asheŋ

english_verse: Young people can live a clean life by obeying your word.
translation_verse: Kebaawora fo kamalga kasonu e naaŋ shin nɛ mbifɔlbi be kebaawɔtɔ e baa walɛ nseŋ niŋi.

english_verse: I worship you with all my heart. Don't let me walk away from your commands.
translation_verse: Meeŋ shuŋ fo nɛ ma kagbene kikɛ; sa maŋ shin nɛ n lar kebaawora fo mbraana kasonu to.

english_verse: I treasure your word above all else; it keeps me from sinning against you.
translation_verse: N ta fo mbra nna n wɔtɔ ma kagbene to, saŋɛ na so m maaŋ wora kulubi ŋ gbiti fo.

english_verse: I praise you, Lord! Teach me your laws.
translation_verse: O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, mee kpaŋ fo nna; ŋini ma fo mbraana na.

english_verse: With my own mouth, I tell others the laws that you have spoken.
translation_verse: Meeŋ bugi kɔnɔ ŋ kaŋɛ beko awɔrso fo mbraana nɛ fo sa na kikɛ be asheŋ.

english_verse: Obeying your instructions brings as much happiness as being rich.
translation_verse: Kebaa bɛ fo mbraana so bee fuli ma kagbene a chɔ kebaakɔ kedama damta.

english_verse: I will study your teachings and follow your footsteps.
translation_verse: Mee koya fo mbraana nna, nsaa mige fo keŋini to a keni nɛnɛ.

english_verse: Treat me with kindness, Lord, so that I may live and do what you say.
translation_verse: Wora fo kayɛrbi kelela; saŋɛ na so meeŋ baa wɔtɔ nsaa wora fo kamalga kasonu.

english_verse: Open my mind and let me discover the wonders of your Law.
translation_verse: Bugi ma nfɛra to nɛ n tiŋ m pin emamachisheŋ nɛ e wɔ fo mbra to.

english_verse: I live here as a stranger. Don't keep me from knowing your commands.
translation_verse: Efɔ e la ma ashi kasawule ere so; amoso sa maŋ ta fo mbraana ŋ ŋana ma so.

english_verse: What I want most and at all times is to honor your laws.
translation_verse: Kusɔ nɛ ma kagbene bee sha ga e la fanɛ ŋ ka beeŋ baa nyi fo mbraana na jemanɛ kikɛ.

english_verse: You punish those boastful, worthless nobodies who turn from your commands.
translation_verse: Fo e naa gberge kamoowuwuraana nɛ b maŋ la shɛŋ nseŋ kini kewora fo mbraana kasonu na kusoe.

english_verse: Don't let them sneer and insult me for following you.
translation_verse: Lara ma ashi bumo be katege nɛ kemɔmɔshia to; ŋkpal ŋ ka bɛ fo mbraana so so.

english_verse: I keep thinking about your teachings, Lord, even if rulers plot against me.
translation_verse: Bewurjipo shɛr a kre ma ŋkre lubi, ama ma ere bee fɛ fo mbraana be asheŋ nna.

english_verse: Your laws are my greatest joy! I follow their advice.
translation_verse: Fo mbraana e naa shin nɛ ma kagbene bee fuli ma ga; amo e naa ji ma asoe to.

english_verse: I am at the point of death. Let your teachings breathe new life into me.
translation_verse: A ka gbrɛ nɛ n wu n yɔ eshishɛr to; shin nɛ fo kamalga na e naŋ sa ma ŋkpa popɔr.

english_verse: When I told you my troubles, you answered my prayers. Now teach me your laws.
translation_verse: Ŋ ka kaŋɛ fo ma etɔrɔbi kikɛ na, fo nu ma kabɔrɛkule nna. Naniere ŋini ma fo atande.

english_verse: Help me to understand your teachings, and I will think about your marvelous deeds.
translation_verse: Chɛ ma to nɛ n tiŋ m pin fo mbraana to, saŋɛ na so meeŋ baa fɛ fo emamachisheŋ be asheŋ.

english_verse: I am overcome with sorrow. Encourage me, as you have promised to do.
translation_verse: Ma ebɔl to duŋi ma alegaiso nna; leŋ ma to fanɛ kananɛ fo nase kɔnɔ na.

english_verse: Keep me from being deceitful, and be kind enough to teach me your Law.
translation_verse: Shin nɛ m baa gelge kafulesheŋ; wu ma kuwɔr nseŋ ŋini ma fo mbra na.

english_verse: I am determined to be faithful and to respect your laws.
translation_verse: Ma ere yili kumo fanɛ meeŋ baa wɔ kashenteŋji be kebaawɔtɔ to nna; nsaa sa fo mbraana bunyaŋ.

english_verse: I follow your rules, Lord. Don't let me be ashamed.
translation_verse: O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, ma ere bɛ fo mbraana so nna; amoso sa maŋ shin nɛ n ji anishinyɔr.

english_verse: I am eager to learn all that you want me to do; help me to understand more.
translation_verse: N wora shiriya kenishipereso nna nɛ ŋ wora fo mbraana kasonu, ŋkpal manɛ so, feeŋ chɛ ma to nɛ n nya kepinto n ti so. Kekule Ebɔrɛ n fin kepinto be asheŋ

english_verse: Point out your rules, Lord, and I won't disobey even one of them.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, ŋini ma fo mbraana be kifi to, saŋɛ na so, meeŋ baa wora amo kasonu saŋkikɛ.

english_verse: Help me to understand your Law; I promise to obey it with all my heart.
translation_verse: Chɛ ma to nɛ m pin fo mbra to nseŋ wora kumo kasonu; saŋɛ na so, meeŋ ta ma kagbene kikɛ m bɛ kumo so.

english_verse: Direct me by your commands! I love to do what you say.
translation_verse: Ta fo mbraana na a ŋini ma ekpa, ŋkpal manɛ so, amo e naa fuli ma kagbene.

english_verse: Make me want to obey you, rather than to be rich.
translation_verse: Shin nɛ ma kagbene e kilgi a sha kebaawora fo mbraana kasonu a chɔ kebaasha kedamaya.

english_verse: Take away my foolish desires, and let me find life by walking with you.
translation_verse: Lara ma lakal ashi asheŋ fuloŋ so; nseŋ shin nɛ ma kebaawɔtɔ e baa du fanɛ kananɛ fo kamalga bee ŋini na.

english_verse: I am your servant! Do for me what you promised to those who worship you.
translation_verse: N la fo kayɛrbi nna. Wora kusɔ nɛ fo nase kɔnɔ n sa bekama nɛ baa ŋana fo na n sa ma alɛ gba.

english_verse: Your wonderful teachings protect me from the insults that I hate so much.
translation_verse: Baa kuŋ ma ashi ŋaba nɛ mee ŋana to; ŋkpal manɛ so, fo mbraana walɛ nna.

english_verse: I long for your teachings. Be true to yourself and let me live.
translation_verse: Mee sha kebaawora fo mbraana kasonu ga; Sa ma ŋkpa popɔr, ŋkpal fo ka la esa niŋiso so. Kebaa yirda Ebɔrɛ be mbraana be asheŋ

english_verse: Show me your love and save me, Lord, as you have promised.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, ŋini ma fo kasha nseŋ mɔlga ma, fanɛ kananɛ fo nase kɔnɔ na;

english_verse: Then I will have an answer for everyone who insults me for trusting your word.
translation_verse: saŋɛ na so meeŋ tiŋ n tuge bumo nɛ baa tege ma na be mmalga to; ŋkpal manɛ so, fo kamalga nɛ n yirda.

english_verse: I rely on your laws! Don't take away my chance to speak your truth.
translation_verse: Jemanɛ kikɛ sa maŋ kaŋ lara fo kashenteŋ be mmalga na ma kɔnɔ to; ŋkpal manɛ so, ma tama wɔ fo mbraana to nna.

english_verse: I will keep obeying your Law forever and ever.
translation_verse: Meeŋ baa wora fo mbra na kasonu, hale mbaanaayɔ.

english_verse: I have gained perfect freedom by following your teachings,
translation_verse: Ŋkpal ŋ ka bee wora fo mbraana kasonu so, n nya ma kumu nna a ji ma keparso.

english_verse: and I trust them so much that I tell them to kings.
translation_verse: Ma alɛ beeŋ baa malga fo mbraana be asheŋ a sa bewurjipo nsaa maa ŋana anishinyɔr.

english_verse: Don't forget your promise to me, your servant. I depend on it.
translation_verse: Baa nyiŋi kɔnɔ nɛ fo nase n sa ma, fo kayɛrbi na; ŋkpal manɛ so, ma tama deŋ kumo so nna.

english_verse: When I am hurting, I find comfort in your promise that leads to life.
translation_verse: Ashi ma etɔrɔ to gba, n daŋ nya kelolo nna ŋkpal fo kɔnɔ naseso ka sa ma ŋkpa so.

english_verse: Conceited people sneer at me, but I obey your Law.
translation_verse: Kamoowuwuraana bee wora ma eyurto nna, ama ma alɛ maŋ lar fo mbra kaman.

english_verse: I find true comfort, Lord, because your laws have stood the test of time.
translation_verse: O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, n nyiŋi fo mbra nɛ e wɔtɔ dra dra na kikɛ na; amo e naa bar ma kagbenewushi.

english_verse: I get furious when evil people turn against your Law.
translation_verse: M baŋ wu kumukpakpasowura ka bee wora a da fo mbra so, k bee kaa ma kagbene nna.

english_verse: No matter where I am, your teachings fill me with songs.
translation_verse: Kaplɛkama nɛ n wɔ, fo mbra be nshɛ nɛ mee boŋ.

english_verse: Even in the night I think about you, Lord, and I obey your Law.
translation_verse: Kanyɛso gba mee fɛ fo, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be asheŋ nna, nsaa wora fo mbra kasonu.

english_verse: You, Lord, are my choice, and I will obey you.
translation_verse: Fo, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e la ma kusɔ kikɛ. N nase kɔnɔ fanɛ meeŋ wora fo mmalga kasonu.

english_verse: With all my heart I beg you to be kind to me, just as you have promised.
translation_verse: Mee kule fo nna ashi ma kagbene to kikɛ fanɛ fo wu ma kuwɔr fanɛ kananɛ fo nase kɔnɔ na.

english_verse: I pay careful attention as you lead me, and I follow closely.
translation_verse: Ŋ keni ŋ gbagba be asheŋ woraso to nɛnɛ nseŋ nase kɔnɔ fanɛ meeŋ bɛ fo mbraana so.

english_verse: As soon as you command, I do what you say.
translation_verse: Meeŋ baa nya manaŋ a wora fo mbraana kasonu.

english_verse: Evil people may set a trap, but I obey your Law.
translation_verse: Hale nɛ kumukpakpasowuraana ta efɔl ŋ kre ma gba, m maaŋ teŋ fo mbra so.

english_verse: Your laws are so fair that I wake up and praise you in the middle of the night.
translation_verse: Mee koso kiidiso nna a kpaŋ fo, ŋkpal fo mbra niŋiso na so.

english_verse: I choose as my friends everyone who worships you and follows your teachings.
translation_verse: Ekama nɛ e bee shuŋ fo ŋko a wora fo mbraana kasonu na la n teri nna.

english_verse: I am your servant, Lord, and you have kept your promise to treat me with kindness.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, wora fo kayɛrbi kelela fanɛ kananɛ fo nase kɔnɔ ashi fo kamalga to na.

english_verse: Give me wisdom and good sense. I trust your commands.
translation_verse: Sa ma kanyiasheŋ nɛ nfɛra lela, ŋkpal manɛ so, fo mbraana nɛ n yirda.

english_verse: Once you corrected me for not obeying you, but now I do obey.
translation_verse: N daŋ wora n da so nna nɛ fo gberge ma kusoe, ama naniere bre n wora fo kamalga kasonu nna na.

english_verse: You are kindhearted, and you do good things, so teach me your laws.
translation_verse: Fo la esa lela nna nɛ fo asheŋ woraso kikɛ la asheŋ lela; amoso ŋini ma fo mbraana.

english_verse: My reputation is being ruined by conceited liars, but with all my heart I follow your teachings.
translation_verse: Kamoowuwuraana ku efɛ n deŋi ma a fin kejija ma ketre; ama ma kagbene kikɛ nɛ ŋ kɔ a bɛ fo mbraana na so.

english_verse: Those liars have no sense, but I find happiness in your Law.
translation_verse: B maa pin fo asheŋ to, ama ma ere be kagbene bee fuli fo mbra so nna.

english_verse: When you corrected me, it did me good because it taught me to study your laws.
translation_verse: Kasogberge nɛ n daŋ nya na daŋ chɛ ma to; k daŋ chɛ ma to nɛ ŋ koya fo mbraana.

english_verse: I would rather obey you than to have a thousand pieces of silver and gold.
translation_verse: Mbra nɛ fo ta n sa ma na kɔ kechɛto n sa ma a chɔ durnya to be amansherbi kikɛ. Ebɔrɛ be mbra ka bee ji asheŋ nɛnɛ be asheŋ

english_verse: You created me and put me together. Make me wise enough to learn what you have commanded.
translation_verse: Fo e to ma nseŋ bela ma eyur n chuge abar so; sa ma kanyiasheŋ nɛ ŋ koya fo mbraana na.

english_verse: Your worshipers will see me, and they will be glad that I trust your word.
translation_verse: Bumo nɛ baa bunyaŋ fo beeŋ wu ma nɛ bumo be ŋgbene e fuli bumo ŋkpal ŋ ka ta ma tama n wɔtɔ fo kamalga to so.

english_verse: Your decisions are correct, and you were right to punish me.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, n nyi fanɛ fo mbra niŋi nna; fo ekpa so nɛ fo gberge ma kusoe.

english_verse: I serve you, Lord. Comfort me with your love, just as you have promised.
translation_verse: Shin nɛ fo kasha nɛ k maa loge na e baa lolo ma, fanɛ kananɛ fo nase kɔnɔ n sa ma, fo kayɛrbi na.

english_verse: I love to obey your Law! Have mercy and let me live.
translation_verse: Wu ma kuwɔr n shin nɛ m baa wɔ ŋkpa to, ŋkpal fo mbra ka bee fuli ma kagbene so.

english_verse: Put down those proud people who hurt me with their lies, because I have chosen to study your teachings.
translation_verse: Shin nɛ kamoowuwuraana e ji anishinyɔr ŋkpal b kaa bee ku efɛ a deŋi ma so; ma ere beeŋ ta fo mbra n wɔtɔ kumu to a fɛ amo be asheŋ.

english_verse: Let your worshipers come to me, so they will learn to obey your rules.
translation_verse: Shin nɛ bekama nɛ baa bunyaŋ fo nsaa nyi fo mbraana na e ba ma kutɔ.

english_verse: Let me truly respect your laws, so I won't be ashamed.
translation_verse: Shin nɛ m baa sa fo mbraana bunyaŋ kashenteŋto, saŋɛ na so, m maaŋ ji anishinyɔr. Kesɔnyige be kabɔrɛkule be asheŋ

english_verse: I long for you to rescue me! Your word is my only hope.
translation_verse: N jo fo, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, nɛ fo sɔ ma n yige n ya gben; ama ma tama kraa wɔ fo kamalga to.

english_verse: I am worn out from waiting for you to keep your word. When will you have mercy?
translation_verse: N to kenishi a keni fo kɔnɔ naseso ekpa n ya gben. Saŋɛ mo nɛ feeŋ wu ma kuwɔr nseŋ chɛ ma to?

english_verse: My life is wasting away like a dried-up wineskin, but I have not forgotten your teachings.
translation_verse: M maaŋ naa kɔ tɔnɔ fanɛ yabra be kapuya bureso; ama ma alɛ kraa maŋ teŋ fo mbraana so.

english_verse: I am your servant! How long must I suffer? When will you punish those troublemakers?
translation_verse: Saŋɛ mo nɛ a daga fanɛ n jo n ya fo? Jemanɛ mo nɛ feeŋ gberge basa nɛ baa kɔrfɛ ma na kusoe?

english_verse: Those proud people reject your teachings, and they dig pits for me to fall in.
translation_verse: Kamoowuwuraana nɛ b maa wora fo mbra kasonu kur amaŋ nna n nase a jo ma nɛ n tɔr to.

english_verse: Your laws can be trusted! Protect me from cruel liars.
translation_verse: Esa beeŋ tiŋ n yirda fo mbraana kikɛ; basa bee ku efɛ nna a tɔrɔ ma, amoso chɛ ma to!

english_verse: They have almost killed me, but I have been faithful to your teachings.
translation_verse: A ka gbrɛbi nɛ b mɔ ma, ama ŋ kraŋ maŋ kplaŋ fo mbraana so.

english_verse: Show that you love me and let me live, so that I may obey your commands.
translation_verse: Ŋini ma fo kasha n shin nɛ m baa wɔ ŋkpa to; saŋɛ na so, meeŋ wora fo mbraana kikɛ kasonu. Keyirda Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be mbra na be asheŋ

english_verse: Our Lord, you are eternal! Your word will last as long as the heavens.
translation_verse: O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, fo kamalga wɔtɔ nna mbaanaayɔ; ebɔrɛso nɛ k wɔ hale nɛ mbre.

english_verse: You remain faithful in every generation, and the earth you created will keep standing firm.
translation_verse: Fo kashenteŋji malɛ wɔtɔ nna n sa kekurgeto kama to ebi. Fo e to kasawule n nase kumo be kakpa, nɛ k dese dindiŋ a maa fifir.

english_verse: All things are your servants, and the laws you made are still in effect today.
translation_verse: Asɔ kikɛ bee shuŋ fo nna fanɛ fo nyɛrbi; fo mbraana kraa shuŋ hale kabre gba.

english_verse: If I had not found happiness in obeying your Law, I would have died in misery.
translation_verse: Nɛ n daa maa nya kagbenefuli ashi fo mbraana to nna, ndafanɛ n wu ashi ma awurfoŋ to.

english_verse: I won't ever forget your teachings, because you give me new life when I follow them.
translation_verse: M maaŋ teŋ fo keŋini so kikɛ; ŋkpal manɛ so, amo nɛ fo bɔla so n sa ma ŋkpa nɛ n wɔtɔ.

english_verse: I belong to you, and I have respected your laws, so keep me safe.
translation_verse: Mɔlga ma, ŋkpal manɛ so, n la feya nna! Ma alɛ wora ania nna fanɛ meeŋ wora fo mbraana kasonu.

english_verse: Brutal enemies are waiting to ambush and destroy me, but I obey your rules.
translation_verse: Kumukpakpasowuraana bee jo ma nna nɛ b mɔ ma, ama meeŋ wɔtɔ lakal fo mbraana to n wora amo kasonu.

english_verse: I deeply love your Law! I think about it all day.
translation_verse: Mee sha fo mbraana na ga! Mee fɛ amo be asheŋ kachɛ lelemu kikɛ nna.

english_verse: Your laws never leave my mind, and they make me much wiser than my enemies.
translation_verse: Fo mbraana maa lar ma nfɛra to kikɛ, amo alɛ bee shin nɛ mee pin asheŋ to a chɔ ma doŋana nna.

english_verse: Thinking about your teachings gives me better understanding than my teachers,
translation_verse: Ŋ ka bee fɛ fo mbraana be asheŋ ga so, mee pin asheŋ a chɔ ma beŋinipoana kikɛ gba.

english_verse: and obeying your laws makes me wiser than those who have lived a long time.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal ŋ ka bee wora fo mbraana kasonu so, ŋ kɔ kanyiasheŋ ga a chɔ basakpar gba.

english_verse: I obey your word instead of following a way that leads to trouble.
translation_verse: Ŋ ka bee sha kelara ma kumu asheŋ lubi to so, mee wora fo mbraana kasonu nna.

english_verse: You have been my teacher, and I won't reject your instructions.
translation_verse: Ma alɛ maŋ yige fo mbraana n lɛ ŋkpal fo gbagba ka la ma eŋinipo so.

english_verse: Your teachings are sweeter than honey.
translation_verse: Fo mbraana bee wora ma ebel a chɔ mushoŋchu gba.

english_verse: Your laws are fair, and I have given my word to respect them all.
translation_verse: M bɔ ntaŋ n nase kɔnɔ nsaa yil kumo so fanɛ meeŋ wora fo mbra niŋisoana na kasonu.

english_verse: I am in terrible pain! Save me, Lord, as you have promised.
translation_verse: Awurfoŋ damta nɛ n ji! Amoso, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, shin nɛ m baa kraa wɔ ŋkpa to, fanɛ kananɛ fo kaŋɛ fanɛ feeŋ wora na.

english_verse: Accept my offerings of praise and teach me your laws.
translation_verse: O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, sɔ ma kapandi be sarga nseŋ ŋini ma fo mbraana na.

english_verse: I never forget your teachings, although my life is always in danger.
translation_verse: Jemanɛ kikɛ mee ta ma ŋkpa nna a pɛl, ama m maaŋ teŋ fo mbraana bre so kikɛ.

english_verse: Some merciless people are trying to trap me, but I never turn my back on your teachings.
translation_verse: Kumukpakpasowuraana sho ma ajigbelɛ nna, ama ma alɛ maŋ lar fo mbraana kaman kikɛ.

english_verse: They will always be my most prized possession and my source of joy.
translation_verse: Fo mbraana na la ma mpetɛsɔ nna mbaanaayɔ; amo e naa shin nɛ ma kagbene bee fuli ma.

english_verse: I have made up my mind to obey your laws forever, no matter what.
translation_verse: Ma ere yili kumo ma kagbene to fanɛ meeŋ wora fo mbraana kasonu hale n ya fo ma kaluwuachɛ.

english_verse: I hate anyone whose loyalty is divided, but I love your Law.
translation_verse: Ŋ kishi nfɛraanyɔnyɔwuraana be asheŋ ga; ama mee sha fo mbra bre be asheŋ.

english_verse: All you worthless people, get away from me! I am determined to obey the commands of my God.
translation_verse: Alubiworapoana, men shile ma so! Ma ere beeŋ wora ma Ebɔrɛ be mbraana kasonu.

english_verse: Be true to your word, Lord. Keep me alive and strong; don't let me be ashamed because of my hope.
translation_verse: Sa ma eleŋ fanɛ kananɛ fo nase kɔnɔ na nseŋ shin nɛ m baa wɔ ŋkpa to. Sa maŋ shin nɛ ma tama e to jiga nɛ n ji anishinyɔr.

english_verse: Keep me safe and secure, so that I will always respect your laws.
translation_verse: Baa keni ma so nɛ n nya ma kumu a wɔtɔ, nɛ jemanɛ kikɛ ma lakal e baa wɔ fo mbraana so.

english_verse: As far as you are concerned, evil people are garbage, and so I follow your rules.
translation_verse: Fee wu kumukpakpasowuraana fanɛ epi nna, amoso nɛ meeŋ bɛ fo keŋini so.

english_verse: I tremble all over when I think of you and the way you judge.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal kananɛ fo demuji be mbraana du so, kufu bee pɛ ma nna nɛ mee chicha.

english_verse: I did what was fair and right! Don't hand me over to those who want to mistreat me.
translation_verse: N wora kusɔ nɛ k daga nsaa walɛ; sa maŋ yige ma n sa bedoŋ.

english_verse: Take good care of me, your servant, and don't let me be harmed by those conceited people.
translation_verse: Jande keni fo kayɛrbi so nɛnɛ; sa maŋ shin nɛ kamoowuwuraana e nya ma ŋ kɔrfɛ.

english_verse: My eyes are weary from waiting to see you keep your promise to come and save me.
translation_verse: Ŋ keni fo kumɔlga nɛ fo nase kumo be kɔnɔ na ekpa hale nɛ ma anishi gben a besa.

english_verse: Show your love for me, your servant, and teach me your laws.
translation_verse: Ŋini fo kayɛrbi fo kasha nɛ k maa loge na, nseŋ ŋini ma fo mbraana na.

english_verse: Your laws mean more to me than the finest gold.
translation_verse: Mee sha fo mbraana a chɔ shuwa, mee sha amo a chɔ shuwa gbagba gba.

english_verse: I follow all your commands, but I hate anyone who leads me astray.
translation_verse: Mee bɛ fo mbraana kikɛ so nna, ŋ kishi ekpa lubi be yiri kikɛ be kebɔla so n wora asheŋ.

english_verse: Your teachings are wonderful, and I respect them all.
translation_verse: Fo mbraana la mamachi nna pasaa, amoso nɛ mee wora amo kasonu na.

english_verse: Understanding your word brings light to the minds of ordinary people.
translation_verse: Kebaapin fo mmalga to bee bugi nfɛra to nna nsaa sa basa nɛ b maŋ nyi asheŋ kanyiasheŋ.

english_verse: I honestly want to know everything you teach.
translation_verse: Mee sha kepere kenishi nna m pin kusɔ kama nɛ fee ŋini to.

english_verse: Think about me and be kind, just as you are to everyone who loves your name.
translation_verse: Naŋ laŋɛ fo nfɛra m ba ma so nseŋ wu ma kuwɔr, fanɛ kananɛ fee kaa wora bekama nɛ fee sha na.

english_verse: Keep your promise and don't let me stumble or let sin control my life.
translation_verse: Sa maŋ shin nɛ n tɔr fanɛ kananɛ fo nase kɔnɔ na, fo alɛ e sa maŋ shin nɛ kulubi e pɔɔ ma so.

english_verse: Protect me from abuse, so I can obey your laws.
translation_verse: Baa kuŋ ma nɛ basa e sa maŋ nya ma ŋ kɔrfɛ; saŋɛ na so meeŋ wora fo mbraana kasonu.

english_verse: Smile on me, your servant, and teach me your laws.
translation_verse: Mushe n wora ma, fo kayɛrbi, nseŋ ŋini ma fo mbraana na.

english_verse: When anyone disobeys you, my eyes overflow with tears.
translation_verse: Mee kaa shu anishichubi nna, ŋkpal basa ka maa wora fo mbraana kasonu so.

english_verse: Our Lord, you always do right, and your decisions are fair.
translation_verse: O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, fo niŋi nna nɛ fo mbraana malɛ bɔla ekpa.

english_verse: All your teachings are true and trustworthy.
translation_verse: Fo keŋini kikɛ la kashenteŋ nna nseŋ daga esa ka yirda amo.

english_verse: It upsets me greatly when my enemies neglect your teachings.
translation_verse: Jemanɛ kikɛ nɛ bedoŋ baŋ kplaŋ fo mbraana so, k bee chɔɔ ma to nna fanɛ edɛ.

english_verse: Your word to me, your servant, is like pure gold; I treasure what you say.
translation_verse: Fo kamalga du fanɛ shuwa nna n sa fo kayɛrbi; mee sha kumo nsaa keni kumo a bɔlɔ kenishi alegaiso.

english_verse: Everyone calls me a nobody, but I remember your laws.
translation_verse: Ekama maa ta ma a tre shɛŋ, ama ma alɛ maa teŋ fo mbraana so.

english_verse: You will always do right, and your teachings are true.
translation_verse: Fo kebaawɔtɔ niŋiso wɔtɔ nna mbaanaayɔ; nɛ fo mbra malɛ la kashenteŋ jemanɛ kikɛ.

english_verse: I am in deep distress, but I love your teachings.
translation_verse: Etɔrɔ nɛ kagbenejija damta wɔ ma to; ama fo mbraana bee sa ma kagbenefuli nna.

english_verse: Your rules are always fair. Help me to understand them and live.
translation_verse: Fo mbraana niŋi nna jemanɛ kikɛ, amoso chɛ ma to nɛ m pin amo to nsaa wɔ ŋkpa to.

english_verse: I pray to you, Lord! Please answer me. I promise to obey your laws.
translation_verse: O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, ma kagbene kikɛ nɛ ŋ kɔ a tre fo, nu ma ketre ere n shin nɛ n wora fo mbraana kasonu.

english_verse: I beg you to save me, so I can follow your rules.
translation_verse: Fo nɛ mee shu a tre; mɔlga ma nseŋ shin nɛ n wora fo mbraana kasonu.

english_verse: Even before sunrise, I pray for your help, and I put my hope in what you have said.
translation_verse: Pɔɛŋ nɛ epeŋi e pete gba, fo nɛ mee kule a fin kechɛto. N ta ma tama nna n deŋi fo kamalga naseso so.

english_verse: I lie awake at night, thinking of your promises.
translation_verse: N dese nna a keni kanyɛ lelemu kikɛ, a fɛ fo mmalga naseso be asheŋ.

english_verse: Show that you love me, Lord, and answer my prayer. Please do the right thing and save my life.
translation_verse: Ŋini ma fo kasha nɛ k maa loge na nseŋ nu ma kekule; wu ma kuwɔr nseŋ mɔlga ma ŋkpa fanɛ kananɛ fo mbraana bee ŋini na.

english_verse: People who disobey your Law have made evil plans and want to hurt me,
translation_verse: Basa nɛ b maa wora fo mbra kasonu kre bumo be ŋkre lubiana nna a fin ketɔrɔ ma.

english_verse: but you are with me, and all your commands can be trusted.
translation_verse: Ama fo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bre taga ma to nna, nɛ fo mbraana kikɛ la kashenteŋ.

english_verse: From studying your laws, I found out long ago you made them to last forever.
translation_verse: Ŋ koya fo mbraana na m pin to fanɛ dra kikɛ nɛ fo yili kumo fanɛ a baa wɔtɔ mbaanaayɔ.

english_verse: I have not forgotten your Law! Look at the trouble I am in, and rescue me.
translation_verse: Keni awurfoŋ nɛ mee ji so nseŋ mɔlga ma, ŋkpal manɛ so, m maŋ teŋ fo mbraana so.

english_verse: Be my defender and protector! Remember your promise and save my life.
translation_verse: Kɔ n sa ma nseŋ sɔ ma n yige, mɔlga ma fanɛ kananɛ fo nase kɔnɔ na.

english_verse: Evil people won't obey you, and so they have no hope of being saved.
translation_verse: Kumukpakpasowuraana maaŋ nya kumɔlga, ŋkpal b ka maa wora fo mbraana kasonu so.

english_verse: You are merciful, Lord! Please do the right thing and save my life.
translation_verse: O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, fo kuwɔrwu be kasha shi ga; jande wu ma kuwɔr nseŋ mɔlga ma.

english_verse: I have a lot of brutal enemies, but still I never turn from your laws.
translation_verse: Ŋ kɔ bedoŋ damta nɛ baa fin ma nɛ kulubi, ama m maa kini kebaawora fo mbraana kasonu.

english_verse: Those unfaithful people who refuse to obey you are disgusting to me.
translation_verse: Ŋ kishi basa kama nɛ b maŋ kɔ yirda n sa fo, ŋkpal manɛ so, b maa wora fo mbraana kasonu.

english_verse: Remember how I love your laws, and show your love for me by keeping me safe.
translation_verse: Keni kananɛ mee sha fo keŋini loŋ, O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, ŋini ma fo kasha nɛ k maa loge na nseŋ mɔlga ma.

english_verse: All you say can be trusted; your teachings are true and will last forever.
translation_verse: Fo mmalga kikɛ la kashenteŋ nna, nɛ fo mbraana nɛ a niŋi na wɔtɔ mbaanaayɔ. Keta kumu n to Ebɔrɛ be mbra so be asheŋ

english_verse: Rulers are cruel to me for no reason. But with all my heart I respect your words,
translation_verse: Kenyanyaŋɛso nɛ bewurjipo bee kɔ ma; ama ma ere bee sa fo kamalga bunyaŋ ashi ma kagbene to nna.

english_verse: I can't stand liars, but I love your Law.
translation_verse: Ŋ kishi efɛsheŋ ga; maa sha amo be asheŋ, ama mee sha fo mbra bre.

english_verse: I praise you seven times a day because your laws are fair.
translation_verse: Ale shunu nɛ mee kpaŋ fo karechɛ kikɛ, ŋkpal fo mbraana ka niŋi nsaa maŋ kɔ ŋkpɛato so.

english_verse: You give peace of mind to all who love your Law. Nothing can make them fall.
translation_verse: Bekama nɛ baa sha fo mbraana na bee nya kayurwushi gboŋgboŋi nna; shɛŋ shɛŋ maaŋ tiŋ n shin nɛ b fiti n tɔr kikɛ.

english_verse: You are my only hope for being saved, Lord, and I do all you command.
translation_verse: O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, mee jo fo nna, nɛ fo mɔlga ma nɛ m bɛ fo kanase so.

english_verse: I love and obey your laws with all my heart.
translation_verse: Mee wora fo keŋini kasonu nna, ŋkpal ŋ ka bee sha amo ga so.

english_verse: You know everything I do. You know I respect every law you have given.
translation_verse: Mee wora fo kanase nɛ keŋini kasonu nna; fo alɛ bee wu kusɔ nɛ mee wora kikɛ. Kekule Ebɔrɛ n fin kechɛto be asheŋ

english_verse: Please, Lord, hear my prayer and give me the understanding that comes from your word.
translation_verse: Jande Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, nu ma kabɔrɛkule; sa ma kepinto nɛ k shi fo kamalga to.

english_verse: Listen to my concerns and keep me safe, just as you have promised.
translation_verse: Nu ma kabɔrɛkule nseŋ mɔlga ma fanɛ kananɛ fo nase kɔnɔ na.

english_verse: If you will teach me your laws, I will praise you
translation_verse: Meeŋ bugi kɔnɔ ŋ kpaŋ fo, ŋkpal fo kaa bee ŋini ma fo mbraana so.

english_verse: and sing about your promise, because all your teachings are what they ought to be.
translation_verse: Meeŋ boŋ nshɛ a laŋɛ fo mbra be kaplɛa so; ŋkpal fo atande ka niŋi so.

english_verse: Be ready to protect me because I have chosen to obey your laws.
translation_verse: Wora shiriya n chɛ ma to, ŋkpal ŋ ka bee bɛ fo kusɔ nɛ fo yili so so.

english_verse: I am waiting for you to save me, Lord. Your Law makes me happy.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, fo nɛ mee jo nɛ fo mɔlga ma, ŋkpal manɛ so, fo mbra e naa fuli ma kagbene.

english_verse: Keep me alive, so I can praise you, and let me find help in your teachings.
translation_verse: Shin nɛ m baa wɔ ŋkpa to, saŋɛ na so meeŋ baa kpaŋ fo. Jande shin nɛ n nya kechɛto ashi fo keŋini to.

english_verse: I am your servant, but I have wandered away like a lost sheep. Please come after me, because I have not forgotten your teachings.
translation_verse: N la fo kayɛrbi nna nseŋ foe n luri to fanɛ kubolpɔ. Amoso jande fin ma, ŋkpal manɛ so, m maaŋ teŋ fo mbraana so kikɛ.

english_verse: “Come and save me, Lord, from deceitful liars!”
translation_verse: O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, mɔlga ma ashi befɛpo nɛ kafulewuraana be enɔ to.

english_verse: But I must live as a foreigner among the people of Meshech and in the tents of Kedar.
translation_verse: Ma kechena menyi to gba lubi nna, fanɛ ŋ ka chena Mɛshɛk be efuli so, kakpa wɔfɔ ŋko Kɛda be basa be ewajɛbu nɛ a maŋ taga to nfe na to.

english_verse: I have spent too much time living among people who hate peace.
translation_verse: N chena basa nɛ b kishi kayurwushi be asheŋ na to n chɛr ga!

english_verse: I am in favor of peace, but when I speak of it, all they want is war.
translation_verse: N la esa nɛ mee sha kayurwushi nna, ama m baa malga kayurwushi be asheŋ, kusɔ nɛ baa sha kikɛ e la kena.

english_verse: I look to the hills! Where will I find help?
translation_verse: N to kenishi ŋ keni abee so; Nnɛ nɛ ma kechɛto bee shi a ba?

english_verse: It will come from the Lord, who created heaven and earth.
translation_verse: Ma kechɛto bee shi Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ e to esoso nɛ kasawule na kutɔ nna.

english_verse: The Lord is your protector, and he won't go to sleep or let you stumble.
translation_verse: E maaŋ shin nɛ fo fɛrge n tɔr; Edi maa la fo ekumpo na.

english_verse: The protector of Israel doesn't doze or ever get drowsy.
translation_verse: Kashenteŋto edi maa la Israɛl be ekumpo na.

english_verse: The Lord is your protector, there at your right side to shade you from the sun.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e naa keni fo so; mo alɛ wɔ fo kutɔ nna a kuŋ fo saŋkama.

english_verse: You won't be harmed by the sun during the day or by the moon at night.
translation_verse: Kapiidi be epeŋi maaŋ tiŋ n doro fo, kanyɛso be kufɔl gba maaŋ tiŋ n wora fo shɛŋ.

english_verse: The Lord will protect you now and always wherever you go.
translation_verse: Fo keyɔ nɛ keba kikɛ to, mo e naaŋ baa kuŋ fo mbaanaayɔ.

english_verse: It made me glad when they said, “Let's go to the house of the Lord!”
translation_verse: Ma kagbene daŋ fuli nna ga ŋkpal b ka kaŋɛ ma le so: “An yɔ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na pe!”

english_verse: Jerusalem, we are standing inside your gates.
translation_verse: Naniere an yil Jerusalɛm be kadegboŋ na to be mbunagboŋ na ase nna.

english_verse: Jerusalem, what a strong and beautiful city you are!
translation_verse: B pɔr Jerusalɛm fanɛ kadegboŋ nɛ k tir abar to a walɛ kebita nna.

english_verse: Every tribe of the Lord obeys him and comes to you to praise his name.
translation_verse: K la kakpa nɛ Israɛl be eyiriana na bee wora Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kasonu nna, nsaa ba ndoŋ m baa kaa di mo epaŋ.

english_verse: David's royal throne is here where justice rules.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nɛ Israɛl be bewura bee chena a ji bumo be basa demu.

english_verse: Jerusalem, we pray that you will have peace, and that all will go well for those who love you.
translation_verse: Men kule kayurwushi n sa Jerusalɛm; saŋɛ na so, asheŋ beeŋ nite nɛnɛ n sa bekama nɛ b kɔ kasha n sa kumo na.

english_verse: May there be peace inside your city walls and in your palaces.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ e shin nɛ kayurwushi e baa wɔ kadegboŋ na to; e shin nɛ kayurwushi e baa wɔ ndoŋ be ewurkpaana.

english_verse: Because of my friends and my relatives, I will pray for peace.
translation_verse: Mee kule kayurwushi nna a sa Jerusalɛm ŋkpal ŋ kurgepoana nɛ nteriana so.

english_verse: And because of the house of the Lord our God, I will work for your good.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal Enyɛnpe anyi be Ebɔrɛ be lambu na so, nɛ mee kule Ebɔrɛ a fin kadegboŋ na be nɛnɛ na.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, I turn my eyes to you, on your throne in heaven.
translation_verse: O an Nyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, ma anishi yuu fo, nɛ fo kuwurputi wɔ ebɔrɛso na so nna.

english_verse: Servants look to their master, but we will look to you, until you have mercy on us.
translation_verse: Mbita bee keni bumo b bechepeana be anishito nna. Ama anyi ere bee keni fo, Enyɛnpe, anyi be Ebɔrɛ na, nɛ fo wu anyi kuwɔr nna.

english_verse: Please have mercy, Lord! We have been insulted more than we can stand,
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, wu anyi kuwɔr! An ji katege nɛ baa tege anyi na be kanyiti n chɛr ga.

english_verse: and we can't take more abuse from those proud, conceited people.
translation_verse: Kamoowuwuraana wora anyi eyurto, nseŋ fɛl anyi n chɛr nɛ an wora ania n ji kumo be kanyiti.

english_verse: “The Lord was on our side! Otherwise, the enemy attack
translation_verse: Jemanɛ nɛ an doŋana daa kɔ anyi na, e daa wɔ anyi kutɔ nna.

english_verse: would have killed us all, because it was furious.
translation_verse: B daa sha kemɔ anyi kikɛ nna m mur, ŋkpal b ka daŋ nya agbo ga so.

english_verse: Let's praise the Lord! He protected us from enemies who were like wild animals,
translation_verse: Men shin nɛ an di Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ e maŋ sa an doŋana ekpa, nɛ b we anyi m mur fanɛ kupuŋ to be asɔbɔya na epaŋ.

english_verse: The Lord made heaven and earth, and he is the one who sends us help.
translation_verse: Anyi be kechɛto bee shi Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ e to esoso nɛ kasawule na kutɔ nna.

english_verse: Everyone who trusts the Lord is like Mount Zion that cannot be shaken and will stand forever.
translation_verse: Bekama nɛ b yirda Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na, du fanɛ Zayɔn be kebee na nna ashi Jerusalɛm to, nɛ k maa gbuŋgbuŋ na nna. K yil nna mbaanaayɔ.

english_verse: Just as Jerusalem is protected by mountains on every side, the Lord protects his people by holding them in his arms now and forever.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e kulti mbe basa n wɔtɔ a kuŋ bumo, fanɛ kananɛ abee ana na kulti Jerusalɛm n wɔtɔ na.

english_verse: He won't let the wicked rule his people or lead them to do wrong.
translation_verse: E maaŋ shuli n shin nɛ kumukpakpasowuraana e ji kuwura mbe basa so, ŋko n fule bumo nɛ b wora alubi.

english_verse: Let's ask the Lord to be kind to everyone who is good and completely obeys him.
translation_verse: Men shin nɛ an kule Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ fanɛ e baa wora bekama nɛ baa wora alelasheŋ nsaa wora mbe mbraana kasonu nɛnɛ na kelela.

english_verse: When the Lord punishes the wicked, he will punish everyone else who lives an evil life. Pray for peace in Israel!
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na baa gberge kumukpakpasowuraana kusoe, e beeŋ gberge bekama nɛ b yige mbe ekpaana n lɛ gba kusoe. Kayurwushi e baa wɔ Israɛl be basa so!

english_verse: It seemed like a dream when the Lord brought us back to the city of Zion.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ka daŋ bɛta anyi n shi kenyaya to m ba Jerusalɛm to, k daŋ wora anyi nna fanɛ edare nɛ anyee ku.

english_verse: We celebrated with laughter and joyful songs. In foreign nations it was said, “The Lord has worked miracles for his people.”
translation_verse: Emushe nɛ kagbenefuli be nshɛ nɛ an daŋ ta n ji eyur. Ndoŋ nna nɛ efuli pɔtɛana be basa ji anyi be asheŋ ŋ kaŋɛ le: “Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ e wora asheŋgboŋ n sa mbe basa na.”

english_verse: And so we celebrated because the Lord had indeed worked miracles for us.
translation_verse: Kashenteŋto nɛ e wora asheŋgboŋ n sa anyi; nɛ anyi alɛ be ŋgbene fuli anyi alegaiso!

english_verse: Our Lord, we ask you to bless our people again, and let us be like streams in the Southern Desert.
translation_verse: O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, anyee kule fo nna nɛ fo naŋ bɛta n nɛfa anyi be basa nseŋ shin nɛ an baa du fanɛ keshishɛrsawule so be mbombi nɛ e bee bɔlɔ nchu a shile kafɛ kikɛ.

english_verse: We cried as we went out to plant our seeds. Now let us celebrate as we bring in the crops.
translation_verse: Shin nɛ bekama nɛ baa gben a du asɔduu so na, e teŋi amo nɛ kagbenefuli nseŋ ji eyur.

english_verse: We cried on the way to plant our seeds, but we will celebrate and shout as we bring in the crops.
translation_verse: Shin nɛ bekama nɛ baa gben a sulɔ bumo be asɔduu so a yɔ nɛ keduu to na, e ta kagbenefuli be nshɛ n ya teŋi amo n sulɔ m ba epe.

english_verse: Without the help of the Lord it is useless to build a home or to guard a city.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na baa maŋ chɛ to m pɔr kowu na, bepɔrpo bee gben jiga nna. Nɛ e baa maŋ kuŋ kadegboŋ na, bekumpo na bee kuŋ kumo jiga nna.

english_verse: It is useless to get up early and stay up late in order to earn a living. God takes care of his own, even while they sleep.
translation_verse: Kewule ŋ koso a shuŋ a fin kusɔ jiso hale nɛ saŋko e ya fo na gba la jiga nna; Ŋkpal manɛ so, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e naa sa basa nɛ e bee sha asɔ jemanɛ nɛ b dese a di gba.

english_verse: Children are a blessing and a gift from the Lord.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e naa sa basa mbia, nɛ mbia na e baa la nɛfa n sa bumo.

english_verse: Having a lot of children to take care of you in your old age is like a warrior with a lot of arrows.
translation_verse: Mbia nɛ esa beeŋ nya jemanɛ nɛ e kraa kɔ eleŋ na, du fanɛ enapo be akɔsɔ nna.

english_verse: The more you have, the better off you will be, because they will protect you when your enemies attack you in court.
translation_verse: Kagbenefuli la ekama nɛ e kɔ mbia damta na peya nna, ŋkpal manɛ so, baaŋ kuŋ mo, jemanɛ nɛ mo doŋana beeŋ tu mo a ji asheŋ ashi demujikpa na.

english_verse: The Lord will bless you if you respect him and obey his laws.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ nɛfa ekama nɛ e bee nu a sa mo nsaa wora asheŋ a bɛ mbe mbra be ekpa so na.

english_verse: Your fields will produce, and you will be happy— all will go well.
translation_verse: E beeŋ ji mbe kegben be tɔnɔ; asheŋ beeŋ baa nite nɛnɛ a sa mo nɛ mbe kagbene e fuli mo.

english_verse: Your wife will be as fruitful as a grapevine, and just as an olive tree is rich with olives, your home will be rich with healthy children.
translation_verse: Mbe eche beeŋ baa du fanɛ kedibisɔrso nɛ k bee sɔr ga ashi mbe laŋ to. Mbe mbia malɛ beeŋ baa du fanɛ ɔlif be ndibi popɔrbi m bɔlɔ laŋ.

english_verse: This is how the Lord will bless everyone who respects him.
translation_verse: Kananɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee nɛfa esa kama nɛ e bee nu a sa mo nna na.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will bless you from Zion and let Jerusalem prosper as long as you live.
translation_verse: Ma kabɔrɛkule e la fanɛ, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e shi Zayɔn be kebee na so n nɛfa fo ashi fo kebaawɔtɔ kikɛ to; nseŋ shin nɛ Jerusalɛm be kadegboŋ na e nyalɛ.

english_verse: May you live long enough to see your grandchildren. Let's pray for peace in Israel!
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ e sa fo ŋkpa tenteŋ nɛ fo chɛr nseŋ wu fo nanabiana kenishiso. Kayurwushi e baa wɔ Israɛl be basa so!

english_verse: Since the time I was young, enemies have often attacked! Let everyone in Israel say:
translation_verse: Ma kebia to kikɛ, bedoŋ baa kɔ ma nna! Amoso ekama nɛ e wɔ Israɛl e kaŋɛ le:

english_verse: “Since the time I was young, enemies have often attacked! But they have not defeated me,
translation_verse: “Ma kebia to kikɛ, bedoŋ baa kɔrfɛ ma nna! Ama bumo alɛ maŋ tiŋ m pɔ ma so.

english_verse: though my back is like a field that has just been plowed.”
translation_verse: Baa chaŋɛ a chaŋɛ ma kaman nna, fanɛ kananɛ baa baŋɛ mburbi kudɔsawule so na.

english_verse: The Lord always does right, and he has set me free from the ropes of those cruel people.
translation_verse: Ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ e niŋi kusɔ kama to na tuge ma ashi kumukpakpasowuraana be afɔl so.

english_verse: I pray that all who hate the city of Zion will be made ashamed and forced to turn and run.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ e shin nɛ bekama nɛ b kishi Jerusalɛm nɛ k yil Zayɔn be kebee so na e ji anishinyɔr nseŋ bɛta bumo be ayamu so n shile.

english_verse: May they be like grass on the flat roof of a house, grass that dries up as soon as it sprouts.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ e shin nɛ b wu nsaa maaŋ nya n daŋ fanɛ afitiri nɛ a kɔr ebuuso na.

english_verse: Don't let them be like wheat gathered in bundles.
translation_verse: Ekama maa ku amo ere a gama abar so a sulɔ fanɛ atembɔ.

english_verse: And don't let anyone who passes by say to them, “The Lord bless you! I give you my blessing in the name of the Lord.”
translation_verse: Esa kama malɛ nɛ e bɔla bumo ase a choŋ e sa maŋ kaŋɛ le: ‘Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ e nɛfa menyi! Ŋko mee nɛfa menyi ashi Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be ketre to nna!’ ”

english_verse: From a sea of troubles I cry out to you, Lord.
translation_verse: O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, tɔrɔ damta to nɛ n wɔ shu a tre fo.

english_verse: Won't you please listen as I beg for mercy?
translation_verse: Nu ma kekule, nseŋ wu ma kuwɔr n chɛ ma to!

english_verse: If you kept record of our sins, no one could last long.
translation_verse: Nɛ fo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na daa sibɛ alubi a nase nna, esa kikɛ daa maaŋ ji n lar fo demuji to.

english_verse: But you forgive us, and so we will worship you.
translation_verse: Ama fee ta anyi be alubi a paŋ anyi nna; saŋɛ na so kɔnɔ beeŋ mɔ anyi ashi fo anishito.

english_verse: With all my heart, I am waiting, Lord, for you! I trust your promises.
translation_verse: Ma kagbene kikɛ nɛ ŋ kɔ a jo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na! Ma tama kikɛ malɛ wɔ mbe kamalga na to nna.

english_verse: I wait for you more eagerly than a soldier on guard duty waits for the dawn. Yes, I wait more eagerly than a soldier on guard duty waits for the dawn.
translation_verse: Mee keni Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ekpa kenishipereso nna, fanɛ kananɛ esa nɛ e chena a da asɔ so bee keni karechɛ ekpa na. Kashenteŋto, mee keni mo ekpa a chɔ kananɛ esa nɛ e da asɔ so bee keni karechɛ ekpa na.

english_verse: Israel, trust the Lord! God is always merciful and has the power to save you.
translation_verse: Israɛlebi, men yirda Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na! Ŋkpal manɛ so, mbe kasha nɛ k maa chɛrga na maa loge kikɛ; mo alɛ kɔ eleŋ nɛ e tiŋ m mɔlga menyi.

english_verse: Israel, the Lord will save you from all your sins.
translation_verse: Israɛlebi, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ mɔlga menyi ashi menyi be alubi kikɛ to.

english_verse: But I have learned to feel safe and satisfied, like a young child in its mother's arms.
translation_verse: Ama ŋ koya keshin nɛ kayurwushi be kebaawɔtɔ e kukwe ma. Kananɛ kebia popɔrbi bee dese mo nio be enɔ to boeŋ na, nɛ ma kagbene gba dese ma to.

english_verse: People of Israel, you must trust the Lord now and forever.
translation_verse: O Israɛlebi, men ta menyi be tama n deŋi Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ so naniere hale mbaanaayɔ!

english_verse: Our Lord, don't forget David and how he suffered.
translation_verse: O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, baa nyiŋi Ewura Deevid nɛ awurfoŋ nɛ e ji na kikɛ be asheŋ.

english_verse: “I won't go home or crawl into bed
translation_verse: E yɛ: “M maaŋ yɔ epe, ŋko n ya dese ma gedo so;

english_verse: until I find a home for you, the mighty Lord God of Jacob.”
translation_verse: n ya fo saŋɛ nɛ meeŋ nya ekpa m pɔr bɔrɛlambu n sa Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ nɛ e la Jeekɔb be Ebɔrɛ na.”

english_verse: Then we said, “Let's go to the throne of the Lord and worship at his feet.”
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ an kaŋɛ le: Men shin nɛ an yɔ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na pe n ya gbir mbe aya ase m bunyaŋ mo.

english_verse: Come to your new home, Lord, you and the sacred chest with all its power.
translation_verse: O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, shin nɛ fo ŋkre be deka nɛ k yili n sa fo eleŋgboŋ na, e ba kaa wɔ fo bɔrɛlambu to mbaanaayɔ.

english_verse: Let victory be like robes for the priests; let your faithful people celebrate and shout.
translation_verse: Shin nɛ fo bɔrɛmatapoana e baa wora asheŋ niŋiso, nseŋ shin nɛ fo basa nɛ baa ji kashenteŋ a sa fo na e baa boŋ nshɛ nsaa ji eyur kagbenefuliso.

english_verse: You made a solemn promise to David, when you said, “I, the Lord, promise that someone in your family will always be king.
