translation_verse: Fo e daŋ bɔ ntaŋ n nase kɔnɔ n sa mo; kumo alɛ la kɔnɔ naseso nɛ feeŋ wora m bɔlɔ so nna. Fo yɛ: “Jemanɛ kikɛ meeŋ shin nɛ fo kaman to ebi e baa ji kuwura.

english_verse: You have gladly chosen Zion as your home, our Lord.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e lara Zayɔn be kebee ashi Jerusalɛm to, nɛ k baa la mbe echenakpa.

english_verse: You said, “This is my home! I will live here forever.
translation_verse: E yɛ: “Kakpa nɛ meeŋ baa wɔ mbaanaayɔ nde; kakpa nɛ meeŋ chena a ji kuwura nna na.

english_verse: I will bless Zion with food, and even the poor will eat until they are full.
translation_verse: Meeŋ nɛfa Jerusalɛm alegaiso, Kumo to be betirpo gba beeŋ baa nya a ji a moɛ.

english_verse: Victory will be like robes for the priests, and its faithful people will celebrate and shout.
translation_verse: Meeŋ nɛfa kusɔ kama nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana na beeŋ baa wora nɛ basa na malɛ e baa boŋ nshɛ kagbenefuliso.

english_verse: I will give mighty power to the kingdom of David. Each of my chosen kings will shine like a lamp
translation_verse: Meeŋ shin nɛ Deevid be kuwurji e nya eleŋgboŋ. Esa kama nɛ meeŋ lara m buu mo kuwura beeŋ baa nyɛkpɛ a fuli to fanɛ fitila na.

english_verse: and wear a sparkling crown. But I will disgrace their enemies.”
translation_verse: E beeŋ baa buu kuwurwuro nɛ k bee nyɛkpɛ. Ama meeŋ shin nɛ mo doŋana bre a ji anishinyɔr.”

english_verse: It is truly wonderful when the people of God live together in peace.
translation_verse: Kekurge koŋwule to be basa be kechena abar so kashaso nɛ kɔnɔkoŋwuleso walɛ ga.

english_verse: It is as beautiful as olive oil poured on Aaron's head and running down his beard and the collar of his robe.
translation_verse: K du fanɛ b ka daŋ duga ɔlif be ŋku n wurge bɔrɛmatapo Ɛɛrɔn be kumu so nɛ a gbelge to m bɔla mbe katɔl so m ba mbe piŋi be kubɔ to nna.

english_verse: It is like the dew from Mount Hermon, falling on Zion's mountains, where the Lord has promised to bless his people with life forevermore.
translation_verse: Kumo alɛ naa du fanɛ bunyaŋ ka shi Hɛɛmɔn be kebeegboŋ na so a wurge Jerusalɛm be abee so nna. Ndoŋ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ daŋ nase kɔnɔ fanɛ e beeŋ ta ŋkpa nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar n nɛfa mbe basa na.

english_verse: Everyone who serves the Lord, come and offer praises. Everyone who has gathered in his temple tonight,
translation_verse: Menyi nɛ men la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be nyɛrbi a shuŋ mo ashi mbe bɔrɛlambu to kanyɛso na e baa di mo epaŋ.

english_verse: lift your hands in prayer toward his holy place and praise the Lord.
translation_verse: Men maŋ menyi be enɔana so kabɔrɛkule to ashi Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be bɔrɛlambu to ŋ kpaŋ mo.

english_verse: The Lord is the Creator of heaven and earth, and I pray that the Lord will bless you from Zion.
translation_verse: Mee kule Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ e to esoso nɛ kasawule nna fanɛ e yili Zayɔn n nɛfa menyi!

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! You are his servants, so praise his name.
translation_verse: Men kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na! Menyi nɛ men la mbe nyɛrbi na e kpaŋ mbe ketre.

english_verse: All who serve in the temple of the Lord our God,
translation_verse: Menyi nɛ menyee shuŋ Enyɛnpe anyi be Ebɔrɛ na ashi mbe bɔrɛlambu to na e kpaŋ mbe ketre.

english_verse: come and shout praises. Praise the name of the Lord! He is kind and good.
translation_verse: Men kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na, ŋkpal e ka la esa lela so. Men boŋ nshɛ ŋ kpaŋ mbe ketre, ŋkpal k ka bee par mo so.

english_verse: He chose the family of Jacob and the people of Israel for his very own.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, mo e lara an nananyɛn Jeekɔb be kaman to ebi, nɛ b la Israɛl be basa na, fanɛ b baa la mo gbagba be basa.

english_verse: The Lord is much greater than any other god.
translation_verse: N nyi fanɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na shi ga a chɔ agbirana kikɛ.

english_verse: He does as he chooses in heaven and on earth and deep in the sea.
translation_verse: Kusɔ nɛ k par mo nɛ e bee wora ashi ebɔrɛso nɛ kasawule so nɛ teku be kechimbi to kikɛ nyam.

english_verse: The Lord makes the clouds rise from far across the earth, and he makes lightning to go with the rain. Then from his secret place he sends out the wind.
translation_verse: Mo e naa shin nɛ bɔrɛwɔlpa bee yili durnya be ekar a ka a dii a buu so; nsaa shin nɛ bɔrɛ bee ba nsaa nyɛkpɛ nɛ afu bee shi kakpa nɛ k wɔ a chela.

english_verse: The Lord killed the first-born of people and animals in the land of Egypt.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e daŋ mɔ Ijipt be efuli so be ewurkoŋ nɛ asɔbɔya be bibi juŋkparso kikɛ na.

english_verse: God used miracles and wonders to fight the king of Egypt and all of his officials.
translation_verse: Mo e daŋ bɔla emamachisheŋ nɛ alemaŋkarsheŋ so ŋ gberge Ijipt be ewura, Fɛɛro, nɛ mbe basa kikɛ kusoe na.

english_verse: He destroyed many nations and killed powerful kings,
translation_verse: E daŋ shin nɛ efuli damtaana mur nɛ bewura lempo wu nna.

english_verse: including King Sihon of the Amorites and King Og of Bashan. He conquered every kingdom in the land of Canaan
translation_verse: Loŋ be bewura na be beko e daa la: Amɔri be ewura nɛ baa tre Sihɔn na; nɛ Bashan be ewura nɛ baa tre Ɔg na nɛ Keenan be efuli so be bewuraana.

english_verse: The name of the Lord will be remembered forever, and he will be famous for all time to come.
translation_verse: O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, fo ketre wɔtɔ nna mbaanaayɔ, kekurgeto kikɛ to be basa beeŋ baa nyiŋi kumo.

english_verse: The Lord will bring justice and show mercy to all who serve him.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ maaŋ ji m bri mbe basa; e beeŋ wu bekama nɛ baa shuŋ mo na kuwɔr.

english_verse: Idols of silver and gold are made and worshiped in other nations.
translation_verse: Shuwa nɛ gbiti e la efuli pɔtɛana be agbirana; edimɛdi e ta enɔ n lɔŋɛ amo.

english_verse: They have a mouth and eyes, but they can't speak or see.
translation_verse: Agbirana na kɔ nnɔ nɛ anishi, amo alɛ maaŋ tiŋ m malga ŋko n wu shɛŋ.

english_verse: Everyone who makes idols and all who trust them will end up as helpless as their idols.
translation_verse: Bekama nɛ b lɔŋɛ agbirana ere ŋko n yirda amo beeŋ ki basa fuloŋ fanɛ amo.

english_verse: Everyone in Israel, come praise the Lord! All the family of Aaron
translation_verse: Israɛl be basa nɛ bɔrɛmatapo Ɛɛrɔn be kanaŋ to be basa kikɛ, men kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.

english_verse: and all the tribe of Levi, come praise the Lord! All of his worshipers, come praise the Lord.
translation_verse: Livai be kanaŋ to be basa nɛ bekama nɛ baa bunyaŋ Ebɔrɛ na, men kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.

english_verse: Praise the Lord from Zion! He lives here in Jerusalem. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Men kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ e chena Jerusalɛm to ashi Zayɔn be kebee na so na. Men kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na!

english_verse: Praise the God of all gods. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Men baa di ebɔrɛana kikɛ to be Ebɔrɛ na epaŋ; ŋkpal mbe kasha ka maa loge kikɛ so.

english_verse: With wisdom he made the sky. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Mo gbagba be kanyiasheŋ so nɛ e to esoso; mbe kasha nɛ k maa chɛrga na malɛ wɔtɔ nna mbaanaayɔ.

english_verse: The Lord stretched the earth over the ocean. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e to kasawule n deŋi nchuana so; mbe kasha nɛ k maa chɛrga na malɛ wɔtɔ nna mbaanaayɔ.

english_verse: He made the bright lights in the sky. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Mo e to epeŋi nɛ kufɔl; mbe kasha nɛ k maa chɛrga na malɛ wɔtɔ nna mbaanaayɔ.

english_verse: He lets the sun rule each day. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Mo e shin nɛ epeŋi bee lar karechɛso; mbe kasha nɛ k maa chɛrga na malɛ wɔtɔ nna mbaanaayɔ,

english_verse: He lets the moon and the stars rule each night. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Mo e naa shin nɛ kufɔl malɛ bee lar kanyɛso; mbe kasha nɛ k maa chɛrga na malɛ wɔtɔ nna mbaanaayɔ.

english_verse: The Lord led his people through the desert. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e daŋ juŋkpar mbe basa keshishɛrsawule so na; mbe kasha nɛ k maa chɛrga na malɛ wɔtɔ nna mbaanaayɔ.

english_verse: One of them was Sihon, king of the Amorites. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Bewuraana na be eko e daa la Amɔ be ewura, Sihɔn; Ebɔrɛ be kasha nɛ k maa chɛrga na malɛ wɔtɔ nna mbaanaayɔ;

english_verse: He gave their land to Israel, the people who serve him. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: E daŋ sɔ nsawule na nna n sa Israɛl be basa nɛ b la mbe nyɛrbi na fanɛ kapetɛsawule; mbe kasha nɛ k maa chɛrga na malɛ wɔtɔ nna mbaanaayɔ.

english_verse: He gives food to all who live. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Mo e naa sa kusɔ keniso kikɛ ajibi jiso; mbe kasha nɛ k maa chɛrga na malɛ wɔtɔ nna mbaanaayɔ.

english_verse: Beside the rivers of Babylon we thought about Jerusalem, and we sat down and cried.
translation_verse: An daŋ chena Babilɔn be elɔr na ase nna n nyiŋi Jerusalɛm be asheŋ nseŋ chena n shu ga.

english_verse: We hung our small harps on the willow trees.
translation_verse: An daŋ ta anyi be ejaŋjilaŋ n shiga ndibi nɛ a mata ndoŋ na so nna.

english_verse: Our enemies had brought us here as their prisoners; now they wanted us to sing and entertain them. They insulted us and shouted, “Sing about Zion!”
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, basa nɛ b pɛ anyi anya m ba ndoŋ na daŋ kaŋɛ anyi nna fanɛ an boŋ nshɛ n deŋi bumo anishito. B yɛ: “Men boŋ Jerusalɛm to be nshɛ na be kuko!”

english_verse: Here in a foreign land, how can we sing about the Lord?
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ an kaŋɛ bumo: “Nuso nɛ anyeeŋ tiŋ m boŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be kashɛ efuli pɔtɛ so?

english_verse: Jerusalem, if I forget you, let my right hand go limp.
translation_verse: O Jerusalɛm, nɛ ŋ kaŋ teŋ fo so, Ebɔrɛ e shin nɛ n sa maŋ naŋ tiŋ n laŋ alaŋsɔ kikɛ.

english_verse: Our Lord, punish the Edomites! On the day Jerusalem fell, they shouted, “Completely destroy the city! Tear down every building!”
translation_verse: O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, nyiŋi kusɔ nɛ Edɔmebi na wora kachɛ nɛ Jerusalɛmebi kɔ n tɔr na. B yɛ: ‘Men bure kadegboŋ na! Men mur kumo kikɛ kuraa!’

english_verse: Babylon, you are doomed! I pray the Lord's blessings on anyone who punishes you for what you did to us.
translation_verse: Babilɔnebi, menyeeŋ mur cheche! Ebɔrɛ e nɛfa basa nɛ baaŋ ka menyi kusɔ nɛ men wora anyi ere be kukɔ.

english_verse: May the Lord bless everyone who beats your children against the rocks!
translation_verse: Mo e naŋ nɛfa bekama nɛ baaŋ pɛ menyi be mbiwurbi ŋ ŋmɛa afalta so m mɔ!.”

english_verse: With all my heart I praise you, Lord. In the presence of angels I sing your praises.
translation_verse: Meeŋ ta ma kagbene kikɛ ŋ kpaŋ fo; O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ; meeŋ boŋ nshɛ ŋ kpaŋ fo ashi emalaika be anishito.

english_verse: I worship at your holy temple and praise you for your love and your faithfulness. You were true to your word and made yourself more famous than ever before.
translation_verse: Meeŋ bunyaŋ fo ashi fo bɔrɛlambu cheembi to, nseŋ kpaŋ fo ketre ŋkpal fo kasha nɛ k maa chɛrga na nɛ fo kashenteŋji so, ŋkpal manɛ so, fo maŋ fo ketre nɛ fo atande so a chɔ asɔ kikɛ.

english_verse: When I asked for your help, you answered my prayer and gave me courage.
translation_verse: Ŋ ka shu n tre fo, fo nu ma kekule nna nseŋ sa ma kenyɛn nɛ kagbene.

english_verse: All kings on this earth have heard your promises, Lord, and they will praise you.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, nɛ durnya to be bewuraana kikɛ nu fo nnɔ naseso, baaŋ kpaŋ fo.

english_verse: You are so famous that they will sing about the things you have done.
translation_verse: Baaŋ baa boŋ nshɛ a laŋɛ asɔ nɛ fo wora nɛ fo kemaŋkuragboŋ na be kaplɛa so.

english_verse: Though you are above us all, you care for humble people, and you keep a close watch on everyone who is proud.
translation_verse: Fo, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na wɔ esoso ga, ama kumubarasewuraana be asheŋ tir fo; kamoowuwuraana malɛ maaŋ tiŋ ŋ ŋana fo so.

english_verse: I am surrounded by trouble, but you protect me against my angry enemies. With your own powerful arm you keep me safe.
translation_verse: Nɛ etɔrɔ baŋ kulti ma n wɔtɔ gba, fo e naa kuŋ ma ashi bedoŋ nɛ b nya agbo n wɔtɔ ma be enɔ to. Fo gbagba be enɔ lempo na e naa shin nɛ mee nya ma kumu a ji.

english_verse: You, Lord, will always treat me with kindness. Your love never fails. You have made us what we are. Don't give up on us now!
translation_verse: Fo, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ wora m bɔlɔ kusɔ kama nɛ fo nase kumo be kɔnɔ so. Fo kasha nɛ k maa chɛrga na wɔtɔ nna mbaanaayɔ; amoso, jande sa maŋ kini anyi, fo basa n lɛ.

english_verse: You have looked deep into my heart, Lord, and you know all about me.
translation_verse: O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, fo e keni ma kagbene to, nseŋ pin ma nɛnɛ.

english_verse: You know when I am resting or when I am working, and from heaven you discover my thoughts.
translation_verse: Fo nyi jemanɛ nɛ mee wushi ŋko a shuŋ; n wɔ kufɔ a maŋ taga fo to gba fo nyi, fo nyi kusɔ nɛ k wɔ ma nfɛra to kikɛ.

english_verse: You notice everything I do and everywhere I go.
translation_verse: Fee wu kusɔ kama nɛ mee wora, ŋko kaplɛkama nɛ mee yɔ nna.

english_verse: Before I even speak a word, you know what I will say,
translation_verse: O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, pɔɛŋ nɛ kesheŋ e lar ma kɔnɔ to, nɛ fo tia nyi kumo.

english_verse: and with your powerful arm you protect me from every side.
translation_verse: Fo kulti ma kaba kama so nna n wɔtɔ, nseŋ ta fo enɔgboŋ na a kuŋ ma.

english_verse: I can't understand all of this! Such wonderful knowledge is far above me.
translation_verse: Kananɛ fo nyi ma na la mamachi nna; m maaŋ tiŋ m pin kumo to.

english_verse: Where could I go to escape from your Spirit or from your sight?
translation_verse: Nnɛ nɛ meeŋ tiŋ n shile fo Kiyoyu n yɔ; ŋko nnɛ nɛ meeŋ yɔ nɛ fo maaŋ wu ma?

english_verse: If I were to climb up to the highest heavens, you would be there. If I were to dig down to the world of the dead you would also be there.
translation_verse: M baŋ dii n yɔ ebɔrɛso chilili, fo wɔ ndoŋ; ma alɛ naŋ yɔ bubuni to ashi kasawule to gba, fo kraa wɔ ndoŋ gba.

english_verse: Even then your powerful arm would guide and protect me.
translation_verse: fo kraa beeŋ baa kɔ ma to, nsaa juŋkpar ma ashi ma kesheŋ wora kikɛ to.

english_verse: Or suppose I said, “I'll hide in the dark until night comes to cover me over.”
translation_verse: Nɛ m baŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ meeŋ ŋana tentembiri to, ŋko n shin nɛ kapa e ki kanyɛ m buu ma so gba,

english_verse: But you see in the dark because daylight and dark are all the same to you.
translation_verse: tentembiri kraa maŋ biri to n sa fo ere; kanyɛso malɛ du fanɛ kapaso nna n sa fo. Tentembiri nɛ kefulto kikɛ la kukoŋwule nna n sa fo ere.

english_verse: You are the one who put me together inside my mother's body,
translation_verse: Fo e to ma eyur ere kikɛ, nseŋ bela ma n chuge abar so ashi n nio be kakurgesha to.

english_verse: and I praise you because of the wonderful way you created me. Everything you do is marvelous! Of this I have no doubt.
translation_verse: Mee kpaŋ fo nna, ŋkpal manɛ so, kananɛ fo to ma na la mamachi nna nsaa keta kufu. Fo asheŋ woraso kɔ mamachi pasaa. M baa nyi kumo ma kagbene to nna geeŋ.

english_verse: Nothing about me is hidden from you! I was secretly woven together out of human sight,
translation_verse: Shɛŋ shɛŋ maŋ ŋana fo so a laŋɛ ma kaplɛa so! Jemanɛ nɛ ma awibi daa chuge abar so ashi n nio be kakurgesha to ashiri to na,

english_verse: but with your own eyes you saw my body being formed. Even before I was born, you had written in your book everything about me.
translation_verse: fo wu ma ndoŋ nna pɔɛŋ nɛ b kurge ma. Nchɛ nɛ meeŋ ji durnya to gba kikɛ dese fo kawɔl na to nna pɔɛŋ nɛ ma kebaawɔtɔ fara.

english_verse: Your thoughts are far beyond my understanding, much more than I could ever imagine.
translation_verse: O Ebɔrɛ, m maaŋ tiŋ m pin kusɔ nɛ k wɔ fo nfɛra to kikɛ! A shi m baŋ ma ketiŋ pin amo be kananɛ a sa so.

english_verse: I try to count your thoughts, but they outnumber the grains of sand on the beach. And when I awake, I will find you nearby.
translation_verse: Nɛ fanɛ ŋ karga fo nfɛra gba, e beeŋ baa chɔ teku ase be eshishɛr. M baŋ di n tiŋi kelaŋ so gba, ma nɛ fo e kraa la.

english_verse: How I wish that you would kill all cruel and heartless people and protect me from them!
translation_verse: O Ebɔrɛ, fo daa beeŋ shuli m mɔ kumukpakpasowuraana nna nseŋ kuŋ ma ashi bumo be kamɛaŋ to, k daa beeŋ par ma ga.

english_verse: They are always rebelling and speaking evil of you.
translation_verse: Baa kaa malga mmalga lubi a gbiti fo nna nsaa jija fo ketre.

english_verse: You know I hate anyone who hates you, Lord, and refuses to obey.
translation_verse: O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, ma alɛ gba kishi bekama nɛ b kishi fo nseŋ kini fo, n lar fo kaman na nna.

english_verse: They are my enemies too, and I truly hate them.
translation_verse: Yurkishi nawule nɛ ŋ kɔ a sa bumo; n ta bumo nna fanɛ ma doŋana.

english_verse: Look deep into my heart, God, and find out everything I am thinking.
translation_verse: O Ebɔrɛ, mige ma to ŋ keni, m pin ma kagbene to; wora ma ŋ keni m pin ma nfɛra fɛso.

english_verse: Don't let me follow evil ways, but lead me in the way that time has proven true.
translation_verse: Sa maŋ shin nɛ m baa bɔla ekpa lubiana so a wora asheŋ, ama baa juŋkpar ma ashi fo ekpa nɛ k dese mbaanaayɔ na so.

english_verse: They think up evil plans and always cause trouble.
translation_verse: Ŋkre lubi e wɔ bumo be ŋgbene to, nɛ baa bar kebagato karechɛ kikɛ.

english_verse: Their words bite deep like the poisonous fangs of a snake.
translation_verse: Bumo be nnɔ to be mmalga du fanɛ awɔ lubi be kubɔr ashi esa be eyur to nna.

english_verse: Protect me, Lord, from cruel and brutal enemies, who want to destroy me.
translation_verse: O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, baa kuŋ ma ashi kumukpakpasowuraana nɛ bedoŋ nyaŋnyaŋso nɛ baa fin ma kemur na be enɔ to.

english_verse: Those proud people have hidden traps and nets to catch me as I walk.
translation_verse: Kamoowuwuraana ŋana nna n sho ajigbelɛ nɛ ashewu ma ekpa to a fin ma nɛ b pɛ.

english_verse: You, Lord, are my God! Please listen to my prayer.
translation_verse: O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, fo e la ma Ebɔrɛ. Jande nu ma kekule nseŋ chɛ ma to!

english_verse: You have the power to save me, and you keep me safe in every battle.
translation_verse: O Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ, fo la ma emɔlgapo lempo, fo e naa kuŋ ma ashi kekɔ nɛ bedoŋ bee kɔ ma kikɛ to.

english_verse: Don't let the wicked succeed in doing what they want, or else they might never stop planning evil.
translation_verse: O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, sa maŋ kaŋ shin nɛ kumukpakpasowuraana e nya kusɔ nɛ baa sha. Nɛ mannɛ aloŋ b maaŋ yige kebaakre asheŋ lubi.

english_verse: They have me surrounded, but make them the victims of their own vicious lies.
translation_verse: Shin nɛ basa nɛ b kulti ma n wɔtɔ be mmalga lubi e laŋɛ n ji bumo.

english_verse: Dump flaming coals on them and throw them into pits where they can't climb out.
translation_verse: Shin nɛ kedɛmurmur e tɔr bumo be amu so. Ta bumo n lɛ edepɔmaŋ to nɛ b lar ŋ gben.

english_verse: Our Lord, I know that you defend the homeless and see that the poor are given justice.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, n nyi fanɛ fo e naa kɔ a sa betirpo, nsaa shin nɛ betentaŋasepo bee nya asɔ nɛ a daga bumo.

english_verse: Your people will praise you and will live with you because they do right.
translation_verse: Kashenteŋto, basa nɛ bumo be asheŋ woraso niŋi beeŋ baa wɔ fo kutɔ a kpaŋ fo ketre na.

english_verse: I pray to you, Lord! Please listen when I pray and hurry to help me.
translation_verse: O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, fo nɛ mee shu a tre; nya manaŋ m ba chɛ ma to! Jande nu ma kekule ere.

english_verse: Think of my prayer as sweet-smelling incense, and think of my lifted hands as an evening sacrifice.
translation_verse: Nu ma kekule fanɛ duwu be efɛa belbelso, nseŋ wu ma enɔana nɛ m maŋ so ere fanɛ kaaseso be sarga nɛ mee lara a sa fo.

english_verse: Don't let me want to do evil or waste my time doing wrong with wicked people. Don't let me even taste the good things they offer.
translation_verse: Baa lara ma kagbene ashi asheŋ lubi be kebaawora to nɛ ma kebaatu basa lubi a wora asheŋ gela gela to. Sa maŋ shin nɛ m baa tu bumo a ji bumo be kejigboŋana gba.

english_verse: Let your faithful people correct and punish me. My prayers condemn the deeds of those who do wrong, so don't let me be friends with any of them.
translation_verse: Shin nɛ fo basa niŋiso e baa ŋini ma ekpa; ŋ kaŋ wora n foe nɛ b gberge ma kusoe. M maaŋ shin nɛ basa lubi e maŋkura ma kikɛ, ŋkpal manɛ so, mee kule Ebɔrɛ nna a gbiti bumo.

english_verse: Everyone will admit that I was right when their rulers are thrown down a rocky cliff,
translation_verse: Jemanɛ nɛ bumo be bewuraana beeŋ shi abee be awɔlto n tɔr to na, nɛ basa beeŋ pin fanɛ asheŋ nɛ m malga na la kashenteŋ nna.

english_verse: and their bones lie scattered like crushed rocks on top of a grave.
translation_verse: Kananɛ baa baŋɛ ndibi to wurwurbi na nɛ bumo be awibi beeŋ buri to n dese nchaŋ be nnɔ ase.

english_verse: You are my Lord and God, and I look to you for safety. Don't let me be harmed.
translation_verse: Ama ma ere be anishi yuu fo Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na so nna, a fin fanɛ fo baa kuŋ ma nsaa maŋ shin nɛ n wu!

english_verse: Protect me from the traps of those violent people,
translation_verse: O Ebɔrɛ, baa kuŋ ma ashi ajigbelɛ nɛ basa lubi bee sho ma to.

english_verse: and make them fall into their own traps while you help me escape.
translation_verse: Shin nɛ bumo gbagba e tɔr bumo be ajigbelɛ to, nseŋ shin nɛ ma ere e bɔla amo ase n choŋ nɛ shɛŋ maŋ wora ma.

english_verse: I pray to you, Lord. I beg for mercy.
translation_verse: Mee shu a tre Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nna; a kule mo fanɛ e wu ma kuwɔr.

english_verse: I tell you all my worries and my troubles,
translation_verse: Mee ta ma nfubel kikɛ nna a bar mo; nsaa kaŋɛ mo ma etɔrɔ kikɛ be asheŋ.

english_verse: and whenever I feel low, you are there to guide me. A trap has been hidden along my pathway.
translation_verse: M baa pɔ aba kiyoyu to, mo e naa ŋini ma kusɔ nɛ k daga fanɛ n wora. Bedoŋ ŋana n sho ma kejigbelɛ ashi ekpa nɛ mee nite so nna.

english_verse: Even if you look, you won't see anyone who cares enough to walk beside me. There is no place to hide, and no one who really cares.
translation_verse: M baŋ keni ŋ kulti, mee wu fanɛ esa kikɛ maŋ wɔtɔ nɛ e chɛ ma to, esa kikɛ maŋ wɔtɔ nɛ e kuŋ ma. Ma asheŋ malɛ maŋ tir esa kikɛ.

english_verse: I pray to you, Lord! You are my place of safety, and you are my choice in the land of the living. Please answer my prayer. I am completely helpless.
translation_verse: Fo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na, nɛ mee kule nɛ fo chɛ ma to! Fo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e la ma ekumpo. Fo nawule nɛ mee fute a yigeso ashi ma kebaawɔtɔ to.

english_verse: Rescue me from this prison, so I can praise your name. And when your people notice your wonderful kindness to me, they will rush to my side.
translation_verse: Lara ma ashi ebesa nɛ kafɔŋ to; saŋɛ na so, meeŋ kpaŋ fo ashi fo basa be nshɛr to, ŋkpal kelela nɛ fo wora ma so.

english_verse: Listen, Lord, as I pray! You are faithful and honest and will answer my prayer.
translation_verse: Jande Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, nu ma kekule! Nu ma kushu nseŋ wu ma kuwɔr. Bɔla fo kashenteŋji nɛ kebaawɔtɔ niŋiso so n sɔ ma n yige.

english_verse: I am your servant. Don't try me in your court, because no one is innocent by your standards.
translation_verse: Sa maŋ ji ma, fo kayɛrbi demu; ŋkpal manɛ so, esa kikɛ be kebaawɔtɔ maŋ niŋi ashi fo anishito.

english_verse: My enemies are chasing me, crushing me in the ground. I am in total darkness, like someone long dead.
translation_verse: Bedoŋ bee ju ma nna a kulti nɛ mee tɔr a koso. Tentembiri mina to nɛ n wɔ, fanɛ esa nɛ e wu a dese nchaŋ to dra dra kikɛ na.

english_verse: I have given up hope, and I feel numb all over.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal loŋ so ma tama kikɛ loge nna, nɛ ma kagbene jija ma m baŋ so.

english_verse: I remember to think about the many things you did in years gone by.
translation_verse: Mee nyiŋi asheŋ nɛ fo wora nfɛ damta nɛ a choŋ na kikɛ nna nsaa fɛ amo be asheŋ.

english_verse: Then I lift my hands in prayer, because my soul is a desert, thirsty for water from you.
translation_verse: M maŋ ma enɔana so ashi kabɔrɛkule to a shoŋi fo nna, Kananɛ kasawule wɔlso bee sha nchu na nɛ ma kiyoyu gba bee shu a fin fo.

english_verse: Please hurry, Lord, and answer my prayer. I feel hopeless. Don't turn away and leave me here to die.
translation_verse: Jande Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, nu ma kabɔrɛkule manaŋ! Ma tama kikɛ loge. Sa maŋ pal kaman n sa ma. Nɛ mannɛ aloŋ meeŋ ya ti bumo nɛ b teŋ wu n yɔ bubuni to na so.

english_verse: Each morning let me learn more about your love because I trust you. I come to you in prayer, asking for your guidance.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal ŋ ka ta ma yirda n deŋi fo so so, shin nɛ m baa nyiŋi fo kasha nɛ k maa loge na be asheŋ kachipurso kikɛ. Mee kule fo nna nɛ fo ŋini ma ekpa nɛ meeŋ baa bɔla so a wora asheŋ.

english_verse: Please rescue me from my enemies, Lord! I come to you for safety.
translation_verse: O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, mɔlga ma ashi bedoŋ be enɔ to, ŋkpal manɛ so, fo kutɔ nɛ mee ba nsaa nya kekuŋ.

english_verse: You are my God. Show me what you want me to do, and let your gentle Spirit lead me in the right path.
translation_verse: Fo e la ma Ebɔrɛ. Ŋini ma kusɔ nɛ fee sha fanɛ n wora, nseŋ shin nɛ fo Kiyoyu nɛ e du boeŋ na e baa juŋkpar ma ekpa kikɛ so.

english_verse: Be true to your name, Lord, and keep my life safe. Use your saving power to protect me from trouble.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, baa kɔ a kuŋ ma fanɛ kananɛ fo nase kɔnɔ na. Bɔla fo kumɔlga be eleŋ na so m mɔlga ma ashi etɔrɔ to.

english_verse: I praise you, Lord! You are my mighty rock, and you teach me how to fight my battles.
translation_verse: Meeŋ kpaŋ fo, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ! Fo e la ma kefalta gboŋ. Fo alɛ e naa ŋini ma kananɛ meeŋ baa kɔ kena.

english_verse: You are my friend, my fortress, where I am safe. You are my shield, and you made me the ruler of our people.
translation_verse: Fo e la n teri shaso nɛ ma ekumpo lempo, Fo nɛ mee shile a mata nsaa nya ma kumu. Fo e la ma kebɛlso be kusɔ kuŋso, fo alɛ e shin nɛ mee ji kuwura anyi be basa so.

english_verse: Why do we humans mean anything to you, our Lord? Why do you care about us?
translation_verse: O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, wanɛ e la dimɛdi, nɛ fee keni a wu mo; nɛ mbe asheŋ tir fo le ere bre?

english_verse: We disappear like a breath; we last no longer than a faint shadow.
translation_verse: Dimɛdi baa du fanɛ afu futeso nna; mbe nchɛ bee choŋ nna fanɛ kiyoyul.

english_verse: Open the heavens like a curtain and come down, Lord. Touch the mountains and make them send up smoke.
translation_verse: O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, bugi esoso be kuwɔlpa fanɛ patisa ŋ gbelge m ba; Beta abeeana na, nɛ edishi e kaa amoso.

english_verse: Use your lightning as arrows to scatter my enemies and make them run away.
translation_verse: Shin nɛ bɔrɛ e nyɛkpɛ m pesaŋ fo doŋana to; To fo atanyembi m bar kebagato bumo to, nɛ b lara aya n shile.

english_verse: of those lying foreigners who never tell the truth.
translation_verse: Bumo e la befɔ nɛ b maa ji kashenteŋ nsaa ku efɛ a bɔ ntaŋ na.

english_verse: In praise of you, our God, I will sing a new song, while playing my harp.
translation_verse: O Ebɔrɛ, meeŋ boŋ kashɛ popɔr ŋ kpaŋ fo; meeŋ laŋ jaŋjilaŋ m boŋ kashɛ n sa fo.

english_verse: By your power, kings win wars, and your servant David is saved from deadly swords.
translation_verse: Fo e naa shin nɛ bewura bee kɔ a pɔɔ so, fo e naa kɔ a mɔlga fo kayɛrbi, Ewura Deevid ashi kena to.

english_verse: Won't you keep me safe from those lying foreigners who never tell the truth?
translation_verse: Jande kɔ m mɔlga ma alɛ gba ashi befɔ fɛpoana nɛ b maa ji kashenteŋ na be enɔ to.

english_verse: Let's pray that our young sons will grow like strong plants and that our daughters will be as lovely as columns in the corner of a palace.
translation_verse: An kule Ebɔrɛ fanɛ e shin nɛ anyi be mbrantiɛbia e baa du fanɛ ndibi nɛ a daŋ yili a kɔ eleŋ; nɛ anyi be bibiche malɛ e baa du fanɛ eshabɔrɛ nɛ b pɔr n ji kuwurlambu kebita na.

english_verse: May our barns be filled with all kinds of crops. May our fields be covered with sheep by the thousands,
translation_verse: Shin nɛ anyi be mpuro e bɔlɔ adɔjibi be yiri kikɛ nɛ anyi be mbolpɔ e kurge ga n salga n sɔ kaplɛkama,

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, you give these blessings to all who worship you.
translation_verse: Kagbenefuli la bekama nɛ le be asheŋ bee wora bumo to na peya nna. Kagbenefuli la bekama nɛ bumo be Ebɔrɛ la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na peya nna.

english_verse: I will praise you, my God and King, and always honor your name.
translation_verse: Meeŋ maŋ fo so nseŋ kpaŋ fo, ma Ebɔrɛ nɛ ma Ewura; Ma alɛ beeŋ maŋkura fo ketre saŋkama.

english_verse: I will praise you each day and always honor your name.
translation_verse: Meeŋ baa kpaŋ fo karechɛ kikɛ nsaa maŋkura fo ketre hale mbaanaayɔ.

english_verse: You are wonderful, Lord, and you deserve all praise, because you are much greater than anyone can understand.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na shi ga, nseŋ daga fanɛ b baa kpaŋ mo saŋkama. Ekama maaŋ tiŋ m pin mbe kishi na to.

english_verse: Each generation will announce to the next your wonderful and powerful deeds.
translation_verse: Kekurgeto kama to ebi beeŋ ji fo emamachisheŋ nɛ a bee mɔ kɔnɔ na be asheŋ n sa bumo be kaman to ebi.

english_verse: Everyone will talk about your fearsome deeds, and I will tell all nations how great you are.
translation_verse: Basa beeŋ baa malga fo asheŋgboŋ be asheŋ nsaa ber fo keshi be kubomboŋ a sa beko.

english_verse: They will celebrate and sing about your matchless mercy and your power to save.
translation_verse: Baaŋ baa ji fo alelasheŋ damta be asheŋ a sa beko nsaa boŋ nshɛ kagbenefuliso a laŋɛ fo asheŋ niŋiso be kaplɛa so.

english_verse: You are merciful, Lord! You are kind and patient and always loving.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na la eshapo nɛ e bee wu kuwɔr nna, mo alɛ maa nya agbo manaŋ manaŋ; mbe kasha maa chɛrga kikɛ.

english_verse: You are good to everyone, and you take care of all your creation.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee wora ekama kelela nsaa kɔ kashagboŋ a sa mbe asɔ to so kikɛ nna.

english_verse: All creation will thank you, and your loyal people will praise you.
translation_verse: O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, fo asɔ to so kikɛ beeŋ kpaŋ fo, nɛ fo basa kikɛ e di fo epaŋ.

english_verse: They will tell about your marvelous kingdom and your power.
translation_verse: Baaŋ baa ji fo kuwurji be kemaŋkura be asheŋ; bumo alɛ beeŋ baa malga fo eleŋgboŋ be asheŋ.

english_verse: Then everyone will know about the mighty things you do and your glorious kingdom.
translation_verse: Saŋɛ na so edimɛdi kikɛ beeŋ pin fo ashuŋgboŋ nɛ fo kuwurji be kemaŋkura nɛ kela be asheŋ.

english_verse: Everyone depends on you, and when the time is right, you provide them with food.
translation_verse: Asɔ futeso kikɛ bee keni fo anishito nna nɛ fo sa amo ajibi jemanɛ nɛ k daga.

english_verse: By your own hand you satisfy the desires of all who live.
translation_verse: Fo e naa bugi enɔ to a sa kusɔ futeso kikɛ kumo be asheŋ tirso yila yila so.

english_verse: and you are near to everyone whose prayers are sincere.
translation_verse: E wɔ bekama nɛ baa tre mo kagbene koŋwule so na kutɔ nna.

english_verse: You satisfy the desires of all your worshipers, and you come to save them when they ask for help.
translation_verse: Mo alɛ bee sa bekama nɛ baa bunyaŋ mo na asɔ nɛ a tir bumo nna nsaa nu bumo be kekule a mɔlga bumo ashi etɔrɔ to.

english_verse: You take care of everyone who loves you, but you destroy the wicked.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee kuŋ bekama nɛ baa sha mo na nna, ama kumukpakpasowuraana bre, e bee mur bumo nna.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord, and everyone will respect your holy name forever.
translation_verse: Jemanɛ kikɛ ma ere beeŋ kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na; ekama e sa mbe ketre cheembi na bunyaŋ mbaanaayɔ.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! With all that I am, I will shout his praises.
translation_verse: Men baa kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na! Meeŋ ta ma kagbene kikɛ ŋ kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na!

english_verse: I will sing and praise the Lord God as long as I live.
translation_verse: Meeŋ boŋ nshɛ ŋ kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na saŋɛ nɛ n wɔ ŋkpa to ere.

english_verse: Once they die and are buried, that will be the end of all their plans.
translation_verse: B baŋ wu baa bɛta a yɔ shishɛr to nna; Loŋ be kachɛ na bumo be ŋkre kikɛ bee ba ekar nna.

english_verse: The Lord God of Jacob blesses everyone who trusts him and depends on him.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ e la an nananyɛn Jeekɔb be Ebɔrɛ na bee nɛfa ekama nɛ e yirda mo nseŋ ta mbe kumu n to mo so na nna.

english_verse: God made heaven and earth; he created the sea and everything else. God always keeps his word.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ e to esoso nɛ kasawule; mo e to teku nɛ kumo to be asɔ kikɛ nyam. Jemanɛ kikɛ e bee wora a bɔlɔ mbe nnɔ naseso so nna.

english_verse: and heals blind eyes. He gives a helping hand to everyone who falls. The Lord loves good people
translation_verse: Mo koŋwule na e naa bugi etanpo be anishi. Mo e naa pɛ bumo nɛ b tɔr to a niŋi to a yili nsaa sha basa nɛ bumo be kebaawɔtɔ niŋi.

english_verse: and looks after strangers. He defends the rights of orphans and widows, but destroys the wicked.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e naa keni befɔ so, nsaa ji a chɛ amunibi nɛ bekulpoche to; ama kumukpakpasowuraana bre, e bee mur bumo nna.

english_verse: The Lord God of Zion will rule forever! Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, nɛ e la Jerusalɛm be Ebɔrɛ na, bee ji kuwura nna mbaanaayɔ! Men baa kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na!

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! Our God is kind, and it is right and good to sing praises to him.
translation_verse: Men baa kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na! Keboŋ nshɛ ŋ kpaŋ an Nyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na walɛ ga. Kekpaŋ mo wɔ ebel ga nseŋ daga loŋ.

english_verse: He renews our hopes and heals our bodies.
translation_verse: Mo e naa ti kagbenejijawuraana kagbene nsaa chɛ bumo be alɔana.

english_verse: He decided how many stars there would be in the sky and gave each one a name.
translation_verse: Mo e yili kananɛ achɛkpabi beeŋ ba sa awɔlpa so nseŋ nase amo be kekama ketre a tre kumo.

english_verse: Our Lord is great and powerful! He understands everything.
translation_verse: An Nyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na shi alegaiso nsaa kɔ eleŋ ga. Mo alɛ bee pin kusɔ kama to nna.

english_verse: The Lord helps the oppressed, but he smears the wicked in the dirt.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e naa chɛ bebɔlpo to, nsaa bar kumukpakpasowuraana kaseto.

english_verse: Celebrate and sing! Play your harps for the Lord our God.
translation_verse: Men boŋ nshɛ ŋ kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na; men laŋ ejaŋjilaŋ m boŋ nshɛ n sa anyi be Ebɔrɛ na.

english_verse: He fills the sky with clouds and sends rain to the earth, so that the hills will be green with grass.
translation_verse: Mo e naa shin nɛ abɔrɛwɔlpa bee salga to a buu kaplɛkama so; nɛ bɔrɛ bee ba kasawule so a shin nɛ afitiri bee kɔr abee so.

english_verse: He provides food for cattle and for the young ravens, when they cry out.
translation_verse: Mo e naa sa asɔbɔya kusɔ jiso nsaa bela ejɔnɔkoso fɔlbi jemanɛ kikɛ nɛ a shu n tre mo.

english_verse: The Lord doesn't care about the strength of horses or powerful armies.
translation_verse: Mannɛ egbaŋɛ be eleŋ nɛ benapo lempoana be asheŋ e naa par Ebɔrɛ nsaa fuli mbe kagbene.

english_verse: Everyone in Jerusalem, come and praise the Lord your God!
translation_verse: O Jerusalɛmebi, men kikɛ e maŋ Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na so nseŋ kpaŋ mo!

english_verse: He makes your city gates strong and blesses your people.
translation_verse: Mo e shin nɛ menyi be kadegboŋ be mbunagboŋ na kɔ eleŋ; mo alɛ e naa nɛfa menyi be basa.

english_verse: God lets you live in peace, and he gives you the very best wheat.

translation_verse: Men shin nɛ le be asɔ ere kikɛ e baa kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be ketre. Ŋkpal manɛ so, mo e malga eleŋso n to amo kikɛ kuraa.

english_verse: He made them to last forever, and nothing can change what he has done.

english_verse: Sea monsters and the deep sea, fire and hail, snow and frost, and every stormy wind, come praise the Lord!
translation_verse: Bɔrɛ be kenyɛkpɛ nɛ abɔrɛjembubi nɛ kunyɔlɔ nɛ awɔlpaana nɛ bɔrɛfugboŋana nɛ amo kikɛ bee nu a sa mo na e baa kpaŋ mo.

translation_verse: Kowu nɛ kupuŋ to be asɔbɔya be yiri kikɛ; asɔbɔya wurbi be yiri kikɛ nɛ mbuibi kikɛ e baa kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na!

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! Praise God in his temple. Praise him in heaven, his mighty fortress.
translation_verse: Men baa kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na! Men baa kpaŋ Ebɔrɛ ashi mbe bɔrɛlambu to! Men baa kpaŋ mo ebɔrɛso ashi mbe kakpa lempo na!

translation_verse: Men baa laŋ ŋkure a cha a kpaŋ mo, nsaa ta ejaŋjilaŋ nɛ nlopi gba a kpaŋ mo.

english_verse: Let every living creature praise the Lord. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Asɔ keniso kikɛ e baa kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na! Men baa kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na!

translation_verse: Israɛl be ewura Sɔlɔmɔn nɛ e la Deevid pibinyɛn na be aŋasa nde.

translation_verse: A bee sa benyiashempo kenyi nna a ti so, nsaa chɛ bekoyapo to nɛ baa tiŋ a lara asɔ nɛ a daga kewora;

translation_verse: Kabɔrɛŋana e la kenyi be sososo. Ewulpo e naa kini kanyiasheŋ be kekoya nɛ kebela be kasogberge.

translation_verse: Men nu nfe, kanyiasheŋ e wɔ agbembi so nɛ kebɛ to a tre awɔrso na.

translation_verse: “Ewulpo, fee sha fanɛ fo baa la ewulpo saŋkikɛ nna nsaa keni kenyi jiga a? Fo kini kenyi be kekoya nna a? Saŋɛ mo nɛ feeŋ fara a koya asheŋ?

english_verse: My child, you must follow and treasure my teachings and my instructions.
translation_verse: M pibinyɛn, baa koya asɔ nɛ mee ŋini fo nsaa nyiŋi asɔ nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ fo baa wora na saŋkikɛ.

english_verse: Keep in tune with wisdom and think what it means to have common sense.

translation_verse: Baa kɔ a fin kenyi nɛ asheŋ be kepinto.

translation_verse: Baa fin kenyi kenishipereso fanɛ kananɛ feeŋ fin gbiti nɛ yawu kpakpaso be asɔ nɛ a ŋana na.

english_verse: Then you will understand what it means to respect and to know the Lord God.

english_verse: They will help you live a long and prosperous life.
translation_verse: Asɔ nɛ mee ŋini fo na beeŋ sa fo ŋkpa tenteŋ, nɛ nɛfa.

english_verse: God and people will like you and hold you in high esteem.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so nɛ fo baa wora loŋ, fo asheŋ beeŋ baa bɔlɔ Ebɔrɛ nɛ dimɛdi kikɛ kenishi.

english_verse: With all your heart you must trust the Lord and not your own judgment.

translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, basa nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee sha nɛ e bee niŋi ekpa, fanɛ kananɛ etuto bee wora mo pibi shaso na.

translation_verse: Bekama nɛ b kɔ kanyiasheŋ na, be ŋgbene bee fuli bumo nna. Bumo be kanyiasheŋ bee sa bumo ŋkpa tenteŋ nna.

translation_verse: Sa maa kre fo kurgepo nɛ e yirda fo ŋkre lubi.

translation_verse: Ŋko ŋ ku asheŋ n deŋi esa kama, nɛ e maŋ wora fo kulubi kikɛ.

english_verse: “If you love Wisdom and don't reject her, she will watch over you.
translation_verse: Sa maŋ kplaŋ kanyiasheŋ so, nɛ k kuŋ fo, baa sha kumo, nɛ k baa keni fo so.

english_verse: The best thing about Wisdom is Wisdom herself; good sense is more important than anything else.
translation_verse: Kanyiasheŋ e chɔ kusɔ kama nyam, amoso fin kanyiasheŋ nɛ lakal.

english_verse: If you value Wisdom and hold tightly to her, great honors will be yours.
translation_verse: Baa sha kanyiasheŋ nɛ k ta fo ŋ ki esa gboŋ. Pɛ kumo to kpakpa nɛ k bar fo kemaŋkura.

english_verse: It will be like wearing a glorious crown of beautiful flowers.” The Right Way and the Wrong Way
translation_verse: Kumo e naŋ ki fanɛ kemaŋkura, be kuwurwuro m buu fo.

english_verse: My child, if you listen and obey my teachings, you will live a long time.
translation_verse: M pibinyɛn, kaŋ kusoe kenishipereso n nu kusɔ nɛ mee kaŋɛ fo ere, nseŋ nya ŋkpa tenteŋ.

english_verse: I have shown you the way that makes sense; I have guided you along the right path.
translation_verse: Ŋ ŋini fo kanyiasheŋ, nɛ kananɛ feeŋ baa kɔ kebaawɔtɔ niŋi so.

english_verse: Your road won't be blocked, and you won't stumble when you run.
translation_verse: Nɛ fo kɔ kanyiasheŋ, shɛŋ shɛŋ maaŋ kagle fo ekpa to. Fee shile gba fo maaŋ fiti n tɔr.

english_verse: Hold firmly to my teaching and never let go. It will mean life for you.
translation_verse: Baa nyiŋi asɔ nɛ fo koya na saŋkikɛ, nsaa kɔ amo to kpakpa, ŋkpal manɛ so kusɔ nɛ fo koya e la fo ŋkpa.

english_verse: Don't follow the bad example of cruel and evil people.
translation_verse: Sa maa yɔ mboŋ nɛ basa lubi bee yɔ, ŋko a koya basa lubi be aworbi.

english_verse: They can't sleep or rest until they do wrong or harm some innocent victim.
translation_verse: Basa lubi bre baŋ maŋ wora kulubi, b maaŋ tiŋ n di. B maaŋ tiŋ n di nɛ b maŋ wora kulubi ŋ gbiti esa ko.

english_verse: Their food and drink are cruelty and wickedness.
translation_verse: Asheŋ lubi nɛ kelantokɔ, du nna fanɛ ajibi nɛ nchu n sa bumo.

english_verse: The lifestyle of good people is like sunlight at dawn that keeps getting brighter until broad daylight.
translation_verse: Ama ekpa nɛ belelaworapo bɔ so na bre du nna fanɛ karechɛ so be epeŋi na. K bee fulto nna a ti so hale nɛ kare e ya chɛ nɛ kaboŋ e fulto parr.

english_verse: The lifestyle of the wicked is like total darkness, and they will never know what makes them stumble.
translation_verse: Ama belubiworapo bre be ekpa biri to nna fanɛ tentembiri plɔ. Baa fiti a tɔr, ama b maa wu asɔ nɛ baa fiti na.

english_verse: Knowing these teachings will mean true life and good health for you.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so a beeŋ sa esa kama nɛ e pin amo to ŋkpa nɛ alenfia.

english_verse: Carefully guard your thoughts because they are the source of true life.
translation_verse: Baa da fo nfɛra fɛso so, ŋkpal manɛ so amo e naa ŋini fo kebaawɔtɔ.

english_verse: Don't make a mistake by turning to the right or the left.
translation_verse: Baa gelge kulubi nsaa nite teteri, Sa maa kpele ekpa niŋiso na kikɛ.”

english_verse: My son, if you listen closely to my wisdom and good sense,
translation_verse: M pibinyɛn, bugi asoe nɛnɛ n nu ma kanyiasheŋ be mmalga nɛ a bee sa lakal ere.

english_verse: you will have sound judgment, and you will always know the right thing to say.
translation_verse: Amo e naaŋ sa fo da lela, nseŋ shin nɛ fo mmalga e baa ŋini fanɛ fo kɔ kenyi.

english_verse: The words of an immoral woman may be as sweet as honey and as smooth as olive oil.
translation_verse: Eche nɛ lar mo kul be kaman be kɔnɔpurbi beeŋ tiŋ a du mɔlmɔlbi fanɛ ŋku, nɛ kumo be kepipe e baa wɔ ebel fanɛ mushoŋchu na,

english_verse: But all that you really get from being with her is bitter poison and pain.
translation_verse: ama fo baŋ di mo n loge, ebesa nɛ n daa nyi nna e naa bɛ kumo so.

english_verse: If you follow her, she will lead you down to the world of the dead.
translation_verse: Fo bɛ mo so e beeŋ yɛr fo bubuni to, ŋkpal manɛ so ekpa nɛ e bɔ so na bee yɔ luwu to nna.

english_verse: She has missed the path that leads to life and doesn't even know it.
translation_verse: E maŋ bɔ ekpa nɛ k bee yɔ ŋkpa to na, ama mo alɛ maŋ nyi kumo be loŋ, ŋkpal manɛ so e maŋ kɔ epe.

english_verse: My son, listen to me and do everything I say.
translation_verse: Amoso m pibinyɛn, bugi asoe nɛnɛ n nu. Sa maŋ teŋ kusɔ nɛ mee kaŋɛ ere so.

english_verse: Stay away from a bad woman! Don't even go near the door of her house.
translation_verse: Baa gelge loŋ be beche na. Sa maa ji a taga bumo to kuraa.

english_verse: You will lose your self-respect and end up in debt to some cruel person for the rest of your life.
translation_verse: Nɛ mannɛ aloŋ, feeŋ paŋ fo bunyaŋ nɛ kemaŋkura, nɛ basa lubi e nya ekpa m mɔ Juwebi;

english_verse: Strangers will get your money and everything else you have worked for.
translation_verse: nɛ befɔ e ta asɔ lela nɛ fo gben n nya na kikɛ.

english_verse: When it's all over, your body will waste away, as you groan
translation_verse: Fo ŋkpa be lalaloge, feeŋ dese a shuto, nɛ fo eleŋ nɛ eyur kikɛ e fo amo be ekar.

english_verse: I paid no attention to my teachers,
translation_verse: N daa maŋ nu n sa ma beŋinipoana; n daŋ kplaŋ bumo so nna.

english_verse: and now I am disgraced in front of everyone.”
translation_verse: Kabre ma e ŋaba basa kikɛ be anishito na!

english_verse: You should be faithful to your wife, just as you take water from your own well.
translation_verse: Amoso shin nɛ fo laŋ to be ajibi e baa kukwe fo.

english_verse: And don't be like a stream from which just any woman may take a drink.
translation_verse: Mbia nɛ fo nɛ bejipoche beeŋ kurge na, maaŋ lar tɔnɔ n sa fo.

english_verse: Save yourself for your wife and don't have sex with other women.
translation_verse: Shin nɛ fo gbagba be mbia e daŋ n chɛ fo to, mannɛ basa pɔtɛ be mbia.

english_verse: Be happy with the wife you married when you were young.
translation_verse: Amoso shin nɛ fo kagbene e baa fuli fo kebiato be eche so. Shin nɛ mbe asheŋ e baa par fo.

english_verse: She is beautiful and graceful, just like a deer; you should be attracted to her and stay deeply in love.
translation_verse: E walɛ kebita nna a du shreembi fanɛ chibir na, amoso shin nɛ mbe kebita e baa sa fo kagbenefuli. Shin nɛ mbe kasha e baa bɔlɔ fo kenishi.

english_verse: The Lord sees everything, and he watches us closely.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee wu kusɔ kama nɛ fee wora. Kaplɛkama nɛ fee yɔ e bee wu fo.

english_verse: They get lost and die because of their foolishness and lack of self-control.
translation_verse: Loŋ be basa bee wu nna ŋkpal b ka maŋ kɔ kamootiŋ so. Bumo gbagba be kawulisheŋ e naa yɛr bumo nchaŋ to.”

english_verse: My child, suppose you agree to pay the debt of someone, who cannot repay a loan.
translation_verse: M pibinyɛn, nɛ fo nase kɔnɔ fanɛ feeŋ yili esa ko be katelamu ŋ ka mbe kukɔ bre,

english_verse: and you are now in the power of someone else. Here is what you should do: Go and beg for permission to call off the agreement.
translation_verse: M pibinyɛn, ŋkpal fo ka tɔr amodoŋwura be enɔ to so, kananɛ feeŋ wora n nya fo kumu nde. Nya manaŋ n ya kule amodoŋwura fanɛ e ta kukɔ na m paŋ fo.

english_verse: Do this before you fall asleep or even get sleepy.
translation_verse: Sa maŋ ta loŋ be kesheŋ na n wora ewɔji, ŋko ŋ kplaŋ kumo so a dese a di.

english_verse: Save yourself, just as a deer or a bird tries to escape from a hunter.
translation_verse: Wora ania n lar kesheŋ na to manaŋ, fanɛ kananɛ kusɔbɔya ŋko kabuibi nɛ e wɔ kejigbelɛ to bee wu ekpampo nsaa kɔ a fin kumɔlga kumo be kumu na.

english_verse: You lazy people can learn by watching an anthill.
translation_verse: Betɔlpo, men keni kananɛ atutulombi bee wora asheŋ so, ŋ koya kebaawɔtɔ.

english_verse: How long will you lie there doing nothing at all? When are you going to get up and stop sleeping?
translation_verse: Etɔlpo, nuso be ewushi nɛ fee sha nɛ fo wushi? Saŋɛ mo nɛ feeŋ tiŋi edi to ŋ koso n shuŋ?

english_verse: Sleep a little. Doze a little. Fold your hands and twiddle your thumbs.
translation_verse: Kusɔ nɛ etɔlpo bee kaa kaŋɛ e la fanɛ; shin nɛ n di gbrɛbi, ŋko shin nɛ n chena n wushi gbrɛbi.

english_verse: They are always thinking up something cruel and evil, and they stir up trouble.
translation_verse: Baa wora loŋ nna nsaa kɔ nfɛra lubi a kre asheŋ a bar kebagato basa to kaplɛkama.

english_verse: But they will be struck by sudden disaster and left without a hope.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal loŋ so tɔrɔ nɛ k bee yɛr basa kemur to na, beeŋ tɔr bumo so m mur bumo saŋɛ nɛ b maa tama kumo na.

english_verse: There are six or seven kinds of people the Lord doesn't like:
translation_verse: Asɔ ashunu nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kishi ga na nde:

english_verse: Those who are too proud or tell lies or murder,
translation_verse: Kamoowu nɛ kudonduloŋ fɛpo nɛ enɔ nɛ k bee mɔ basa nɛ b maŋ wora n da so,

english_verse: those who make evil plans or are quick to do wrong,
translation_verse: nɛ nfɛra fɛso lubi nɛ basa nɛ alubi be kewora maa choŋ bumo so

english_verse: those who tell lies in court or stir up trouble in a family.
translation_verse: nɛ shɛdajipo nɛ e bee ku efɛ a deŋi abar so nɛ edebɔrpo nɛ e bee ta beteri be amu a ŋmɛa abar. Kesakalea be asheŋ

english_verse: Their teaching will guide you when you walk, protect you when you sleep, and talk to you when you are awake.
translation_verse: Shin nɛ a baa ŋini fo ekpa; nsaa kuŋ fo kanyɛso. Saŋkama nɛ fo di n tiŋi, fo shin nɛ a baa ji fo asoeto.

english_verse: The Law of the Lord is a lamp, and its teachings shine brightly. Correction and self-control will lead you through life.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so fo nio nɛ fo tuto be keŋini du fanɛ kefulto nna n sa fo; nɛ bumo be kasogberge malɛ bee sa fo kebaawɔtɔ lela.

english_verse: They will protect you from the flattering words of someone else's wife.
translation_verse: Bumo be keŋini na e naaŋ kuŋ fo ashi esa pɔtɛ be eche be kayɛlga be mmalga belbelso to.

english_verse: Don't let yourself be attracted by the charm and lovely eyes of someone like that.
translation_verse: Sa maŋ kpal loŋ be beche be kebita so n yɛlga bumo; ŋko n shin nɛ bumo be kayɛlga so be kekeni fo, e shin nɛ fo sha bumo.

english_verse: A woman who sells her love can be bought for as little as the price of a meal. But making love to another man's wife will cost you everything.
translation_verse: Sakaleche be yawu maŋ fo bodobodo be amansherbi so, ama esa be eche be kasha beeŋ tiŋ n shin nɛ fo luri tɔrɔ gboŋgboŋi to.

english_verse: If you carry burning coals, you burn your clothes;
translation_verse: Esa beeŋ tiŋ n chɔɔ edɛ n wɔtɔ mbe kusɔbuuso to, nɛ kusɔbuuso na maaŋ chɔɔ a?

english_verse: if you step on hot coals, you burn your feet.
translation_verse: Ŋko esa beeŋ tiŋ n ta aya fuloŋ n nite ajanwulɛ so nɛ a maaŋ chɔɔ mo a?

english_verse: And if you go to bed with another man's wife, you pay the price.
translation_verse: To, loŋ koŋwule na nɛ k du n sa esa kama nɛ e di mo barkasa be eche. Esa kama nɛ e wora loŋ maaŋ paŋ kasogberge kikɛ.

english_verse: We don't put up with thieves, not even with one who steals for something to eat.
translation_verse: Basa maa sha beyu be asheŋ; hale eyu yuri ajibi n ji ŋkpal akoŋ so gba, nɛ b pɛ mo,

english_verse: But if you go to bed with another man's wife, you will destroy yourself by your own stupidity.
translation_verse: Enyɛn kama nɛ e bee sha mo braana be beche maŋ kɔ nfɛra nna na. Mo alɛ gbagba be kumu nɛ e baa jija na.

english_verse: because a jealous husband can be furious and merciless when he takes revenge.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so kedata be agbo lubi ga, nɛ enyɛn bee bishi kumo be kuwule a maa wu kuwɔr kuraa.

english_verse: He won't let you pay him off, no matter what you offer.
translation_verse: Sheŋ malɛ maa tiŋ a ka kedata be agbo be kukɔ. Kakɛ kama maŋ wɔtɔ a wushi kedata be agbo.

english_verse: My son, pay close attention and don't forget what I tell you to do.
translation_verse: M pibinyɛn, baa nyiŋi asɔ nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ fo na. Sa maŋ teŋ kusɔ nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ fo na so kikɛ.

english_verse: Keep them at your fingertips and write them in your mind.
translation_verse: Baa kɔ asɔ nɛ ŋ ŋini fo na to saŋkikɛ, n shin nɛ a baa wɔ fo kagbene to.

english_verse: Let wisdom be your sister and make common sense your closest friend.
translation_verse: Ta kanyiasheŋ ŋ ki fanɛ fo sipoche, nseŋ ta lakal malɛ ŋ ki fo teri kpakpaso.

english_verse: They will protect you from the flattering words of someone else's wife.
translation_verse: Amo e naŋ kuŋ fo ashi fo braana be beche, nɛ beche nɛ b kɔ kesakalea so be mmalga belbelso to. Sakaleche be asheŋ

english_verse: From the window of my house, I once happened to see
translation_verse: Kachako nɛ n jule ŋ keni ma ebu be tokuro to,

english_verse: She was dressed fancy like a woman of the street with only one thing in mind.
translation_verse: Nɛ kache na mɛato kesakalea so n lar n yɔ mo kutɔ. Mbe nfɛra daa yil kananɛ e beeŋ wora n nya kabrantiɛbia na n yɔ mbe laŋ to nna.

english_verse: She was one of those women who are loud and restless and never stay at home,
translation_verse: Eche na daŋ paŋ anishinyɔr nna, nsaa nite kubɔrbi so saŋkikɛ a malga awɔrso.

english_verse: who walk street after street, waiting to trap a man.
translation_verse: Saŋko e bee yili kebonfu ko to nna a jo, saŋko malɛ kubɔrbi so, saŋko malɛ kebɛ to.

english_verse: She grabbed him and kissed him, and with no sense of shame, she said:
translation_verse: E ka ya tu kebinyɛnbi na nɛ e pɛ mo to, m pepe mbe kɔnɔpurbi nseŋ keni mbe anishito diimbi ŋ kaŋɛ le:

english_verse: “I had to offer a sacrifice, and there is enough meat left over for a feast.
translation_verse: “Kabre nɛ m mɔ asɔbɔya n lara sarga; eblaŋ wɔ ma laŋ to.

english_verse: So I came looking for you, and here you are!
translation_verse: Amoso nɛ n lar a fin fo nseŋ keni n wu fo nfe!

english_verse: The sheets on my bed are bright-colored cloth from Egypt.
translation_verse: Ma alɛ ta ljipt be efuli so be ago peper be asɔ deseso nna n deŋi ma gedo so.

english_verse: And I have covered it with perfume made of myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.
translation_verse: Nseŋ ta etulale nɛ baa tre mir nɛ alowe nɛ Sinamɔn na ŋ ŋmenyaŋ kumo kikɛ so.

english_verse: My husband is traveling, and he's far away.
translation_verse: Ma kul maŋ wɔ epe, e yɔ kade wɔfɔ ko nna.

english_verse: He took a lot of money along, and he won't be back home before the middle of the month.”
translation_verse: E ta amansherbi damta nna n yɔ. Bɔkwe anyɔ pɔɛŋ e beeŋ ba.”

english_verse: And so, she tricked him with all of her sweet talk and her flattery.
translation_verse: Kache na ta mmalga belbelso nna, n fule mo, m pɛ mo nɛ e shuli n sa mo.

english_verse: At once he followed her like an ox on the way to be slaughtered, or like a fool on the way to be punished
translation_verse: Nseŋ bɛ mo so epul na to fanɛ kananɛ baa keta kusɔbɔya a yɔ nɛ b ya mɔ, ŋko kananɛ chibir bee shile a luri kejigbelɛ to nɛ k bee pɛ kumo,

english_verse: and killed with arrows. He was no more than a bird rushing into a trap, without knowing it would cost him his life.
translation_verse: nɛ b ya too ketanyembi n wɔtɔ kumo be kagbene to m mɔ na. Kebinyɛnbi na daa du nna fanɛ kabuibi nɛ e bee yɔ kejigbelɛ to. E daa maŋ nyi fanɛ kenishipere to nɛ e bee yɔ na.

english_verse: My son, pay close attention to what I have said.
translation_verse: Amoso, naniere, ma mbinyɛnsobi, men nu nfe. Men kaŋ kusoe n nu kusɔ nɛ mee kaŋɛ ere.

english_verse: Don't even think about that kind of woman or let yourself be misled by someone like her.
translation_verse: Men sa maŋ kaŋ shin nɛ men be ekama be kagbene e yɔ loŋ be eche so. Men sa maa sa loŋ be beche kashuli.

english_verse: Such a woman has caused the downfall and destruction of a lot of men.
translation_verse: Eche na shin nɛ benyɛn damta paŋ bumo be eyilikpa. Esa maaŋ tiŋ ŋ karga basa nɛ e shin nɛ b mur.

english_verse: Her house is a one-way street leading straight down to the world of the dead.
translation_verse: Fo baa yɔ mo pe, kumo ere luwu be ekpa nɛ fo bɔ na. Mo pe e la ekpa shimbi nɛ k bee yɔ luwu to.

english_verse: as she stands at the crossroads and on every hill.
translation_verse: K wɔ abee so nna nseŋ mata ekpakar nɛ ŋkpancheri.

english_verse: She stands by the city gate where everyone enters the city, and she shouts:
translation_verse: Kade be kabunagboŋ nɛ baa bɔla a luri kade to na ase nɛ k wɔ a tre a kaŋɛ:

english_verse: “I am calling out to each one of you!
translation_verse: “Dimɛdi kikɛ nɛ e wɔ kasawule so nɛ mee kaŋɛ na.

english_verse: Good sense and sound judgment can be yours.
translation_verse: Menyee wora abibisheŋ nna a? Men nya kenimufɛra. Men wuli nna ŋko? Men wora nfɛra.

english_verse: I always speak the truth and refuse to tell a lie.
translation_verse: Kashenteŋ nɛ mee ji, maa sha efɛ.

english_verse: Every word I speak is honest, not one is misleading or deceptive.
translation_verse: Kusɔ kama nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ la kashenteŋ nna, efɛ ŋko kafulesheŋ kikɛ maŋ wɔ kumo to.

english_verse: “If you have understanding, you will see that my words are just what you need.
translation_verse: K baŋ di efuli nna n sa esa kama nɛ e bee pin asheŋ to, nseŋ bugi to n sa esa nɛ e kɔ kenyi.

english_verse: Let instruction and knowledge mean more to you than silver or the finest gold.
translation_verse: Lara ma keŋini ere nseŋ yige gbiti. Baa fin kenyi a chɔ shuwa lela.

english_verse: Wisdom is worth much more than precious jewels or anything else you desire.” Wisdom Speaks
translation_verse: Kanyiasheŋ kɔ tɔnɔ a chɔ abitasɔ kikɛ. Dimɛdi be kusɔ shaso kikɛ maaŋ tiŋ n ta kumo be kumu m ber kanyiasheŋ.

english_verse: I am Wisdom—Common Sense is my closest friend; I possess knowledge and sound judgment.
translation_verse: Ma, kanyiasheŋ, e naa sa asheŋ be kepin to nɛ kenyi nɛ demu be keji nɛ kumo be ekpa so be nfɛra.

english_verse: If you respect the Lord, you will hate evil. I hate pride and conceit and deceitful lies.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be kesa bunyaŋ e la alubi be kekishi. Kamoowu nɛ ŋkpensheŋ, nɛ asheŋ lubi nɛ efɛ be mmalga maa par Ebɔrɛ kikɛ.

english_verse: I am strong, and I offer sensible advice and sound judgment.
translation_verse: Ma e naa kre ŋkre nsaa wora a bɔlɔ so na. Ma e naa pin asheŋ to, nsaa kɔ eleŋ na.

english_verse: By my power kings govern, and rulers make laws that are fair.
translation_verse: Ma e naa chɛ bewurjipo to nɛ baa keni bumo be efuliana so, nsaa chɛ bejuŋkparpo to nɛ baa wora mbra lela.

english_verse: I love everyone who loves me, and I will be found by all who honestly search.
translation_verse: Mee sha bumo nɛ baa sha ma nna. Esa kama nɛ e bee fin ma kenishipereso beeŋ wu ma.

english_verse: I can make you rich and famous, important and successful.
translation_verse: Ŋ kɔ kedamaya, nɛ kemaŋkura, nɛ anishito be keyɔ, nɛ kɔŋkɔŋ be keji be kebaawɔtɔ nna a sa basa.

english_verse: What you receive from me is more valuable than even the finest gold or the purest silver.
translation_verse: Kusɔ nɛ feeŋ nya ma kutɔ bɔ shuwa nɛ gbiti lela.

english_verse: and I give great riches to everyone who loves me.
translation_verse: Mee sa bumo nɛ baa sha ma kedamaya nna nsaa shin nɛ asɔ lela bee bɔlɔ bumo be nwu.

english_verse: From the beginning, I was with the Lord. I was there before he began
translation_verse: Ma nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na juŋkpar n to. Dradra na kikɛ nɛ e to ma.

english_verse: to create the earth. At the very first, the Lord gave life to me.
translation_verse: Sososo kikɛ nɛ e to ma. N wɔtɔ nna pɔɛŋ nɛ durnya fara.

english_verse: When I was born, there were no oceans or springs of water.
translation_verse: B kurge ma nna pɔɛŋ nɛ etekuana kikɛ fara. Ŋ ka fara nɛ nchu be abuye maŋ wɔtɔ.

english_verse: My birth was before mountains were formed or hills were put in place.
translation_verse: N wɔtɔ nna pɔɛŋ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ to abeegboŋ, n ta amo n yili amo be eyilikpa.

english_verse: It happened long before God had made the earth or any of its fields or even the dust.
translation_verse: N wɔtɔ nna pɔɛŋ nɛ Ebɔrɛ to kasawule, nɛ sososo nɛ shishɛr nɛ kasawule dɔso.

english_verse: I was there when the Lord put the heavens in place and stretched the sky over the surface of the sea.
translation_verse: N wɔtɔ nna pɔɛŋ, nɛ e ta awɔlpa n yili amo be kaboŋ, nseŋ yili kakpa nɛ esa be kenishi beeŋ tiŋ n wu n ya tar ashi teku so.

english_verse: I was with him when he placed the clouds in the sky and created the springs that fill the ocean.
translation_verse: N wɔtɔ nna pɔɛŋ nɛ e ta abɔrɛwɔlpa n wɔtɔ esoso, nseŋ bugi nchu n wɔtɔ teku to,

english_verse: I was there when he set boundaries for the sea to make it obey him, and when he laid foundations to support the earth.
translation_verse: nseŋ ponte ŋ kaŋɛ nchu na fanɛ a sa maŋ bɔlɔ n dii a chɔ kananɛ e kaŋɛ amo saŋɛ nɛ e tɔl durnya be gbaltɔlase na.

english_verse: I was right beside the Lord, helping him plan and build. I made him happy each day, and I was happy at his side.
translation_verse: N daa wɔ mo kutɔ nna fanɛ esa nɛ e nyi asɔ be kewora, nsaa chɛ mo to a lɔŋɛ asɔ nsaa du fanɛ kebibi. Ma kagbene bee fuli ma nna ashi mbe anishito, nɛ ma alɛ bee sa mo kagbenefuli kachɛ kama.

english_verse: I was pleased with his world and pleased with its people.
translation_verse: Ma kagbene fuli durnya so, nɛ basa nɛ b wɔ kumo to be asheŋ bee bɔlɔ ma kenishi ga.

english_verse: Pay attention, my children! Follow my advice, and you will be happy.
translation_verse: Naniere, mbifɔlbi, men kaŋ kusoe n nu, Men wora asɔ nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ ere nɛ a shin nɛ men be ŋgbene e fuli menyi.

english_verse: Listen carefully to my instructions, and you will be wise.
translation_verse: Men nu kusɔ nɛ mee ŋini menyi ere, nseŋ nya kanyiasheŋ. Men sa maŋ kplaŋ kumo so.

english_verse: Come to my home each day and listen to me. You will find happiness.
translation_verse: Bekama nɛ baa ba ma laŋ to m ba kaa chena ma kabuna to, a jo a nu ma mmalga na be ŋgbene beeŋ fuli bumo.

english_verse: By finding me, you find life, and the Lord will be pleased with you.
translation_verse: Bekama nɛ b nya ma, nya ŋkpa; nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ malɛ be kagbene fuli bumo so.

english_verse: But if you don't find me, you hurt only yourself, and if you hate me, you are in love with death.
translation_verse: Bekama nɛ b maŋ nya ma bre bee tɔrɔ bumo be amu nna. Ekama nɛ e kishi ma bee sha luwu nna na.”

english_verse: Wisdom has built her house with its seven columns.
translation_verse: Kanyiasheŋ pɔr kumo be ebu nna n yili eshabɔrɛ ashunu so.

english_verse: She has prepared the meat and set out the wine. Her feast is ready.
translation_verse: Nseŋ shin nɛ b mɔ kusɔbɔya n wora kejigboŋ; nseŋ ta asɔ nɛ amo be efɛa bee dufɛ viim n wɔtɔ nsa to n yili.

english_verse: She has sent her servant women to announce her invitation from the highest hills:
translation_verse: Nseŋ shuŋi mbe mbita fanɛ b ya yili kade be mboŋ jeŋgreŋ m ponte n tre basa ŋ kaŋɛ:

english_verse: All of you are welcome to my meat and wine.
translation_verse: “Men ba ji ma ajibi nseŋ nu nsa belbelso nɛ n wora n yili na.

english_verse: If you want to live, give up your foolishness and let understanding guide your steps.” True Wisdom
translation_verse: Men lar basa nɛ b maa pin asheŋ to manaŋ manaŋ na be katuŋ to nseŋ ji efute. Men shin nɛ asheŋ be kepin to e baa ŋini menyi ekpa.”

english_verse: Any bragger you correct will only hate you. But if you correct someone who has common sense, you will be loved.
translation_verse: Sa maŋ kaŋ fiɛ esa nɛ e bee puchi so, fo baŋ wora loŋ, e beeŋ kishi fo. Ama fo baŋ ŋini enyiashempo bre ekpa e beeŋ sa fo bunyaŋ.

english_verse: If you have good sense, instruction will help you to have even better sense. And if you live right, education will help you to know even more.
translation_verse: Kusɔ kama nɛ fo kaŋɛ enyiashempo, bee sa mo kanyiasheŋ nna a ti so. Kusɔ kama malɛ nɛ fo kaŋɛ basa nɛ baa wora asheŋ niŋiso, bee sa bumo kenyi nna a ti so.

english_verse: Respect and obey the Lord! This is the beginning of wisdom. To have understanding, you must know the Holy God.
translation_verse: Nɛ fee sha kanyiasheŋ, fo fara a ŋana Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ. Nɛ fo baa nyi Ebɔrɛ cheembi na, feeŋ baa pin asheŋ to.

english_verse: I am Wisdom. If you follow me, you will live a long time.
translation_verse: Kanyiasheŋ beeŋ shin nɛ fo ŋkpa e teŋi so.

english_verse: Good sense is good for you, but if you brag, you hurt yourself. A Foolish Invitation
translation_verse: Fo nyiasheŋ, feeŋ ji kumo be tɔnɔ; Fo kpal kamoowuso ŋ kini kanyiasheŋ feeŋ ji awurfoŋ.

english_verse: She sits in front of her house and on the highest hills in the town.
translation_verse: E bee chena mbe kabuna to ashi kaboŋ jeŋgreŋ nɛ baaŋ wu mo nna,

english_verse: She shouts to everyone who passes by,
translation_verse: a tre a kaŋɛ basa nɛ baa choŋ le:

english_verse: “If you are stupid, come on inside!” And to every fool she says,
translation_verse: “Basa nɛ b maa pin asheŋ to manaŋ manaŋ, e luri m ba.” Nsaa kaŋɛ bewulpo malɛ le:

english_verse: “Stolen water tastes best, and the food you eat in secret tastes best of all.”
translation_verse: “Keyuri nchu wɔ ebel, ama ajibi nɛ fo ŋana n ji e wɔ ebel a chɔ amo”

english_verse: None who listen to Stupidity understand that her guests are as good as dead.
translation_verse: Basa nɛ baa nu mbe kafulesheŋ maŋ nyi fanɛ bekama nɛ b luri mbe laŋ to kikɛ bee yɔ bubuni to nna.

english_verse: Here are some proverbs of Solomon: Children with good sense make their parents happy, but foolish children make them sad.
translation_verse: Ewura Sɔlɔmɔn be aŋasa nde: Kebia nyiashempo bee bar mo tuto nɛ mo nio kumu saŋɛ nna, ama kebia wulpo bre bee wɔtɔ bumo ebesa to nna.

english_verse: What you gain by doing evil won't help you at all. Obeying God is the only way to be saved from death.
translation_verse: Kapuni be kedamaya maa lar tɔnɔ a sa esa ama kashenteŋji bre bee mɔlga esa be ŋkpa nna.

english_verse: If you obey the Lord, you won't go hungry; if you are wicked, God won't let you have what you want.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ maaŋ shin nɛ basa lela e di akoŋ, Mo alɛ maaŋ shin nɛ alubiworapoana e nya kusɔ nɛ baa sha.

english_verse: At harvest season it's smart to work hard, but stupid to sleep.
translation_verse: Enyiashempo bee teŋi asɔ saŋɛ nɛ a bel nna, ama k la anishinyɔr nna fanɛ esa e baa dese a di kasɔteŋi be jemanɛ.

english_verse: Everyone praises good people, but evil hides behind the words of the wicked.
translation_verse: Basa lela bee nya nɛfa nna; ama nfɛra lubi e ŋana a wɔ esa lubi be mmalga be kaman.

english_verse: Good people are remembered long after they are gone, but the wicked are soon forgotten.
translation_verse: Basa lela be alela so nɛ baa nyiŋi bumo, ama b maa nyiŋi belubiwurapo bre kikɛ.

english_verse: If you have good sense, you will listen and obey; if all you do is talk foolishly, you will destroy yourself.
translation_verse: Basa nɛ b kɔ lakal bee sɔ kasotoji nna, ama basa nɛ baa malga kawuliso bre maa chɛr nsaa tɔr.

english_verse: You will be safe, if you always do right, but you will get caught, if you are dishonest.
translation_verse: Beshenteŋjipo bee nya kekuŋ nna, nɛ shɛŋ maa gbuŋgbuŋ bumo; ama kebirkɔnshiwura be asheŋ beeŋ lar efuli.

english_verse: The words of good people are a source of life, but evil hides behind the words of the wicked.
translation_verse: Esa lela be mmalga du fanɛ kebuye nna a sa ŋkpa, ama kamɔ be nfɛra lubi e ŋana a wɔ esa lubi be mmalga be kaman.

english_verse: Hatred stirs up trouble; love overlooks the wrongs that others do.
translation_verse: Kekishi bee bar kamɔrɔji nɛ kebagato nna, ama kasha bre bee kplaŋ aworandeso kikɛ so nna.

english_verse: If you have good sense, it will show when you speak. But if you are stupid, you will be beaten with a stick.
translation_verse: Esa be mmalga e naa ŋini fanɛ e la enyiashempo, ama ewulpo bre daga kasogberge nna.

english_verse: If you have good sense, you will learn all you can, but foolish talk will soon destroy you.
translation_verse: Enyiashempo bee fin kenyi nna a ti so saŋkikɛ, ama ewulpo be mmalga e naa da mo a lɛ.

english_verse: Great wealth can be a fortress, but poverty is no protection at all.
translation_verse: Kedamaya bee kuŋ damawuraana nna fanɛ kananɛ baa pɔr egbal a kuŋ kade na, ama ketir bre maa kuŋ betirpo.

english_verse: If you live right, the reward is a good life; if you are evil, all you have is sin.
translation_verse: Alela be kakɔka e la ŋkpa tenteŋ, ama alubi bre bee shin nɛ esa bee wora alubi nna a ti so.

english_verse: Accept correction, and you will find life; reject correction, and you will miss the road.
translation_verse: Basa nɛ baa shuli a sɔ keŋini be kasogberge beeŋ ji efute, ama bumo nɛ b maa shuli kewora n jija bre be lalaloge maa kaa walɛ.

english_verse: You can hide your hatred by telling lies, but you are a fool to spread lies.
translation_verse: Esa kama nɛ kekishi wɔ mo to la efɛpo nna. Ewulpo e naa ta b yɛ b yɛ a shuŋ.

english_verse: You will say the wrong thing if you talk too much— so be sensible and watch what you say.
translation_verse: Fo baa malga ga fo maa kra malga a foe. Nɛ fo nyi asheŋ fo maaŋ baa malga ga.

english_verse: The words of a good person are like pure silver, but the thoughts of an evil person are almost worthless.
translation_verse: Esa lela be mmalga du fanɛ gbiti nna, ama esa lubi maa sa esa nfɛra nɛ k kɔ tɔnɔ.

english_verse: Many are helped by useful instruction, but fools are killed by their own stupidity.
translation_verse: Esa lela be mmalga kɔ tɔnɔ nna n sa basa damta, ama kawuli beeŋ tiŋ m mɔ fo.

english_verse: When the Lord blesses you with riches, you have nothing to regret.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ e naa ta esa e ki damawura. Kepere kenishi n shuŋ maaŋ tiŋ n shin nɛ fo dii dama.

english_verse: Fools enjoy doing wrong, but anyone with good sense enjoys acting wisely.
translation_verse: Ewulpo nɛ alubi be kewora bee wora ebel. Kanyiasheŋ e naa par benyipo bre.

english_verse: What evil people dread most will happen to them, but good people will get what they want most.
translation_verse: Basa nɛ baa wora asheŋ niŋiso bee nya kusɔ nɛ baa sha nna, ama kusɔ nɛ belubiworapo bre maa sha nɛ baa nya ga.

english_verse: Those crooks will disappear when a storm strikes, but God will keep safe all who obey him.
translation_verse: Afugboŋ bee ba nna m ba kaa ber alubiworapoana a lɛ, ama beshenteŋjipo bre bee nya kumɔlga nna saŋkama.

english_verse: Having a lazy person on the job is like a mouth full of vinegar or smoke in your eyes.
translation_verse: Sa maŋ shin nɛ etɔlpo e wora shɛŋ n sa fo, mbe asheŋ wora so kikɛ du nna fanɛ fo ka ji dorobi nɛ anyi bee nyiri fo; ŋko edishi ka luri fo anishito nna.

english_verse: If you respect the Lord, you will live longer; if you keep doing wrong, your life will be cut short.
translation_verse: Wora Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kasonu nseŋ ji efute n chɛr. Kumu kpakpasowura bee wu nna nɛ mbe saŋɛ maŋ naŋ fo.

english_verse: If you obey the Lord, you will be happy, but there is no future for the wicked.
translation_verse: Basa lela be kanya bee bar kagbenefuli nna, ama belubiworapo bre maaŋ nya kusɔ nɛ baa tama kikɛ.

english_verse: The Lord protects everyone who lives right, but he destroys anyone who does wrong.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ bee kuŋ beshenteŋjipo nna, nsaa mur bumo nɛ baa wora alubi.

english_verse: Good people will stand firm, but the wicked will disappear from the land.
translation_verse: Basa nɛ baa wora asheŋ nɛ a niŋi bee nya kekuŋ saŋkikɛ nna, ama belubiworapo bre maaŋ ji efute n chɛr kasawule so.

english_verse: If you obey the Lord, you will always know the right thing to say. But no one will trust you if you tell lies.
translation_verse: Basa nɛ baa wora asheŋ nɛ a niŋi e nyi asheŋ lela nɛ a daga kemalga, ama asheŋ besaso nɛ belubiworapo bre bee malga saŋkama.

english_verse: The Lord hates anyone who cheats, but he likes everyone who is honest.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kishi kapuni be kasɔkarga ga. Kasɔkarga nɛ k bɔla ekpa e naa fuli mbe kagbene.

english_verse: Too much pride can put you to shame. It's wiser to be humble.
translation_verse: Kamoowuwuraana maa chɛr nsaa ji anishinyɔr. Kamubrase bre bee sa esa kanyiasheŋ nna.

english_verse: If you do the right thing, honesty will be your guide. But if you are crooked, you will be trapped by your own dishonesty.
translation_verse: Basa lela be kashenteŋji e naa kuŋ bumo. Basa nɛ esa maaŋ tiŋ n yirda bre gbagba be kebirkɔnshi e naa mur bumo.

english_verse: When God is angry, money won't help you. Obeying God is the only way to be saved from death.
translation_verse: Kedamaya maaŋ ba kɔ tɔnɔ n sa fo gbagba fo kaluwuachɛ, ama kashenteŋji bre beeŋ tiŋ m mɔlga fo ŋkpa.

english_verse: If you are truly good, you will do right; if you are wicked, you will be destroyed by your own sin.
translation_verse: Kashenteŋji bee shin nɛ kebaawɔtɔ bee ki pɔpɔtɔ nna a sa esa lela, ama belubiworapo bre gbagba e naa da bumo amu a lɛ.

english_verse: Honesty can keep you safe, but if you can't be trusted, you trap yourself.
translation_verse: Kecheembiya e naa mɔlga beshenteŋjipo, ama basa nɛ esa maaŋ tiŋ n yirda bre gbagba be kejimuni e naa ki kejigbelɛ a pɛ bumo.

english_verse: Trouble goes right past the Lord's people and strikes the wicked.
translation_verse: Basa cheembi bee nya kekuŋ ashi tɔrɔ nɛ k bee ba belubiworapo so na to nna.

english_verse: Dishonest people use gossip to destroy their neighbors; good people are protected by their own good sense.
translation_verse: Basa nɛ b maa ŋana Ebɔrɛ be mmalga beeŋ tiŋ n yɛr esa kemur to, ama basa cheembi be kanyiasheŋ be mmalga bee sa esa kumɔlga nna.

english_verse: Good people bring prosperity to their city, but deceitful liars can destroy a city.
translation_verse: Basa cheembi be nɛfa bee maŋ bumo be kade so nna, ama basa lubi bre be mmalga bee mur bumo be kade nna.

english_verse: It's stupid to say bad things about your neighbors. If you are sensible, you will keep quiet.
translation_verse: Ewulpo e naa ji beko be asheŋ, enyiashempo bre bee loto nna.

english_verse: A gossip tells everything, but a true friend will keep a secret.
translation_verse: Esheŋjipo kikɛ maŋ kɔ ashiri, ama feeŋ tiŋ n yirda esa nɛ basa bee sa yirda bre.

english_verse: A city without wise leaders will end up in ruin; a city with many wise leaders will be kept safe.
translation_verse: Efuli nɛ k maŋ kɔ bejuŋkparpo nyiashempo bee mur nna; ama besoetojipo damta bee kuŋ efuli nna.

english_verse: It's a dangerous thing to guarantee payment for someone's debts. Don't do it!
translation_verse: Nɛ fo yili kajinamu n sa esa nɛ fo maŋ nyi, feeŋ wora n daa nyi nna. Amoso sa maŋ ta fo kumu m baga nfɔl.

english_verse: The Lord hates sneaky people, but he likes everyone who lives right.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kishi nfɛra lubiwura ga, ama e bee sha bekama nɛ baa wora asheŋ lela bre ga.

english_verse: You can be sure of this: All crooks will be punished, but God's people won't.
translation_verse: K baa dese nna geeŋ fanɛ baaŋ gberge belubiworapo kusoe, ama bekama nɛ baa wora asheŋ niŋiso bre beeŋ gelge kasogberge.

english_verse: A beautiful woman who acts foolishly is like a gold ring on the snout of a pig.
translation_verse: Eche nɛ e walɛ kebita nsaa maŋ kɔ da du fanɛ shuwa be kepinibi nna ashi preku be kamuna to.

english_verse: Good people want what is best, but troublemakers hope to stir up trouble.
translation_verse: Asɔ kama nɛ basa lela bee fin bee ki asɔ lela nna. Ama belubiworapo bre baŋ nya asɔ k bee pɛ basa agbo nna.

english_verse: Sometimes you can become rich by being generous or poor by being greedy.
translation_verse: Kakɛ maa loge asɔ. Beko bee kɛ ga, bumo alɛ nsaa dii dama saŋkikɛ, nɛ beko malɛ kɔ miri ga nsaa la betirpo saŋkikɛ.

english_verse: Generosity will be rewarded: Give a cup of water, and you will receive a cup of water in return.
translation_verse: Fo baa bugi enɔ a kɛ feeŋ dii dama. Chɛ beko to nɛ beko malɛ e chɛ fo to.

english_verse: Charge too much for grain, and you will be cursed; sell it at a fair price, and you will be praised.
translation_verse: Basa bee sho bumo nɛ baa ti ajibi so a yili fanɛ amo be yawu e di pɔɛŋ nɛ b fa na kɔnɔ nna, nsaa chɔrɔ bekama nɛ baa fa amo saŋkikɛ na.

english_verse: Try hard to do right, and you will win friends; go looking for trouble, and you will find it.
translation_verse: Esa kama nɛ e bee fin asheŋ lela bee nya asheŋ lela nna, nɛ asheŋ lubi malɛ bee tu ekama nɛ e bee fin asheŋ lubi.

english_verse: Trust in your wealth, and you will be a failure, but God's people will prosper like healthy plants.
translation_verse: Bekama nɛ b ta bumo be tama n deŋi bumo be kanya so beeŋ gbaŋgbaŋ n tɔr fanɛ ketarso be afantaŋ, ama basa cheembi bre beeŋ baa purge afantaŋ popɔr fanɛ kechaliso be ndibi nna saŋkama.

english_verse: Fools who cause trouble in the family won't inherit a thing. They will end up as slaves of someone with good sense.
translation_verse: Bekama nɛ baa fin asheŋ lubi a ba bumo be laŋ to ebi so maaŋ nya kapetɛ n ji kikɛ. Bewulpo malɛ beeŋ baa la benyiashempo be anya nna saŋkama.

english_verse: Live right, and you will eat from the life-giving tree. And if you act wisely, others will follow.
translation_verse: Kecheembiya bee sa ŋkpa nna, ama kumu kpakpaso be kebaawɔtɔ bre bee mɔ nna.

english_verse: If good people are rewarded here on this earth, all who are cruel and mean will surely be punished.
translation_verse: Nɛ basa lela bee nya kelela be kakɔka durnya ere to, kumo ere kashenteŋto, basa lubi gba beeŋ nya kasogberge.

english_verse: To accept correction is wise, to reject it is stupid.
translation_verse: Ekama nɛ e bee sha keniŋi bee nya kenyi nna. Ama ekama nɛ e kishi keniŋi la ewulpo nna.

english_verse: The Lord likes everyone who lives right, but he punishes everyone who makes evil plans.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be kagbene bee fuli basa lela so nna, ama e maa sa bekama nɛ baa kre asheŋ lubi bre kashuli kikɛ.

english_verse: Sin cannot offer security! But if you live right, you will be as secure as a tree with deep roots.
translation_verse: Kumu kpakpaso be asheŋ woraso maa kuŋ esa, ama kecheembiya bre bee shin nɛ esa bee yili to kiŋkiŋ nna.

english_verse: A helpful wife is a jewel for her husband, but a shameless wife will make his bones rot.
translation_verse: Eche nɛ e kɔ da lela bee bar mo kul kamusaŋɛ nɛ kagbenefuli nna, ama eche nɛ e bee wɔtɔ mo kul anishinyɔr to bre du fanɛ kɔrtɔ lubi nna.

english_verse: Good people have kind thoughts, but you should never trust the advice of someone evil.
translation_verse: Beshenteŋjipo bee wora asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so nna, ama belubiworapo bre bee fule basa nna.

english_verse: Bad advice is a deadly trap, but good advice is like a shield.
translation_verse: Belubiworapo be mmalga bee bar kamɔ nna, ama basa cheembi bre be mmalga bee lara esa eyilikpa lubi to nna.

english_verse: Once the wicked are defeated, they are gone forever, but no one who obeys God will ever be thrown down.
translation_verse: Belubiworapo baŋ tɔr, bumo nɛ bumo kanaŋ kikɛ bee mur nna, ama basa cheembi bre be kanaŋ wɔtɔ nna mbaanaayɔ.

english_verse: Good sense is worthy of praise, but stupidity is a curse.
translation_verse: Esa be kanyiasheŋ e naa sa mo kechɔrɔ, nɛ kawulisheŋ malɛ bee shin nɛ baa keni esa jiga.

english_verse: It's better to be ordinary and have only one servant than to think you are somebody and starve to death.
translation_verse: Kebaa la ebɔlpo a shuŋ a ji bɔ keta fo kumu n yili eyilikpagboŋ nsaa di akoŋ.

english_verse: Good people are kind to their animals, but a mean person is cruel.
translation_verse: Basa lela bee keni bumo be asɔbɔya gba so nɛnɛ nna, ama basa lubi bre be shɛŋ maŋ wɔ bumo be asɔbɔya to.

english_verse: Hard working farmers have more than enough food; daydreamers are nothing more than stupid fools.
translation_verse: Bedɔpo nɛ b pere kenishi a shuŋ maaŋ paŋ kusɔ jiso kikɛ, ewulpo e naa jija saŋɛ a bɛ asheŋ fuloŋ so.

english_verse: An evil person tries to hide behind evil; good people are like trees with deep roots.
translation_verse: Belubiworapo bee kɔ nna a fin alubi be kewora, ama basa cheembi bre mur achin nna n yili fanɛ ndibi, a maa gbuŋgbuŋ to kikɛ.

english_verse: We trap ourselves by telling lies, but we stay out of trouble by living right.
translation_verse: Belubiworapo gbagba be mmalga e naa kilgi a kre bumo, ama beshenteŋjipo bre bee lara bumo be amu asheŋ to nna.

english_verse: We are rewarded or punished for what we say and do.
translation_verse: Feeŋ nya kusɔ kama nɛ fo wora ŋko ŋ kaŋɛ be tɔnɔ.

english_verse: Fools think they know what is best, but a sensible person listens to advice.
