translation_verse: Ewulpo nawule e naa fɛ fanɛ e kɔ kashenteŋ nna saŋkama. Enyiashempo bre bee kaŋ kusoe nna a nu kasotoji.

english_verse: Losing your temper is foolish; ignoring an insult is smart.
translation_verse: Ewulpo e naa nya agbo a puŋi kɔnɔ. Enyiashempo bre bee kplaŋ katege so nna.

english_verse: An honest person tells the truth in court, but a dishonest person tells nothing but lies.
translation_verse: Fo baŋ ji kashenteŋ, basa bee wora asheŋ a niŋi ekpa nna, ama efɛ bre bee shin nɛ basa bee wora asheŋ a gbɛto nna.

english_verse: Truth will last forever; lies are soon found out.
translation_verse: Efɛ maa chɛr nsaa fo ekar, ama kashenteŋ bre wɔtɔ nna mbaanaayɔ.

english_verse: Good people never have trouble, but troublemakers have more than enough.
translation_verse: Asheŋ lubi maa tiŋ a tu basa lela, ama belubiworapo bre maaŋ gelge tɔrɔ kikɛ.

english_verse: The Lord hates every liar, but he is the friend of all who can be trusted.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kishi befɛpo be asheŋ ga, ama mbe kagbene bee fuli bekama nɛ baa ji kashenteŋ so nna.

english_verse: Be sensible and don't tell everything you know— only fools spread foolishness everywhere.
translation_verse: Enyiashempo bee ta mbe kenyi nna a ŋana, ama ewulpo bre bee shin nɛ mbe kawuli bee di efuli nna.

english_verse: Work hard, and you will be a leader; be lazy, and you will end up a slave.
translation_verse: Basa nɛ baa pere kenishi a shuŋ e naŋ ji kuwura; ntɔl bre bee ta esa nna a ki kenya.

english_verse: Worry is a heavy burden, but a kind word always brings cheer.
translation_verse: Kafɔŋ beeŋ tiŋ n shin nɛ fo paŋ kagbenefuli, ama kamalga lela bee leŋ basa to nna.

english_verse: You are better off to do right, than to lose your way by doing wrong.
translation_verse: Basa cheembi bee ŋini bumo teriana ekpa lela nna, ama belubiworapo bre be ekpa bee yɛr bumo kefoe to nna.

english_verse: Anyone too lazy to cook will starve, but a hard worker is a valuable treasure.
translation_verse: Etɔlpo maa nya kusɔ nɛ e bee sha kikɛ, ama esa nɛ e bee pere kenishi a shuŋ bre beeŋ pɛ mbe anishi be kabuibi.

english_verse: Living right is a pathway that leads to life and away from death.
translation_verse: Kecheembiya be ekpa e kɔ ŋkpa, luwu maŋ wɔ kumo be ekpa to kikɛ.

english_verse: Children with good sense accept correction from their parents, but stubborn children ignore it completely.
translation_verse: Kebia nyiashempo kikɛ bee kaŋ kusoe nna a nu mo tuto be keŋini, ama kumukpakpasowura bre maa shuli a sɔ keŋini.

english_verse: You will be well rewarded for saying something kind, but all some people think about is how to be cruel and mean.
translation_verse: Basa lela be mmalga e naa ka bumo kukɔ, basa lubi bre be kusɔ nɛ baa sha e la kebaa tintiŋ basa a wɔtɔ alubi be kewora to.

english_verse: Keep what you know to yourself, and you will be safe; talk too much, and you are done for.
translation_verse: Esa nɛ e bee tiŋ a keta mbe kudonduloŋ beeŋ kuŋ mbe ŋkpa, ama esa nɛ mbe kɔnɔ maŋ kɔ kemɔrɛbi bee mur mbe kumu nna.

english_verse: No matter how much you want, laziness won't help a bit, but hard work will reward you with more than enough.
translation_verse: Etɔlpo bee yɛlga kusɔ gba, jiga nna, e maaŋ tiŋ n nya kumo, ama esa kama nɛ e bee pere kenishi a shuŋ bre beeŋ tiŋ n nya kusɔ kama nɛ e bee sha.

english_verse: A good person hates deceit, but those who are evil cause shame and disgrace.
translation_verse: Esa cheembi kikɛ kishi kafulesheŋ nna, ama basa lubi bre be aworbi bee bar bumo anishinyɔr nɛ nyɔmu nna.

english_verse: Live right, and you are safe! But sin will destroy you.
translation_verse: Kebaawora asheŋ niŋiso bee kuŋ esa niŋiso nna, ama alubi bre bee da basa lubi nna a lɛ.

english_verse: Some who have nothing may pretend to be rich, and some who have everything may pretend to be poor.
translation_verse: Basa ko bee ta bumo be amu nna fanɛ damawuraana, ama bumo alɛ maŋ kɔ shɛŋ. Beko malɛ bee ta bumo be amu nna fanɛ betirpo, bumo alɛ nsaa la damawuraana kashenteŋto.

english_verse: The rich may have to pay a ransom, but the poor don't have that problem.
translation_verse: Saŋko, damawuraana bee kaa ta bumo be kanya nna a kuŋ bumo be amu, ama betirpo bre maa kaa luri loŋ be asheŋ to.

english_verse: The lamp of a good person keeps on shining; the lamp of an evil person soon goes out.
translation_verse: Basa cheembi du fanɛ kefulto nɛ k bee nyaŋɛ nsaa nyɛkpɛ saŋkama nna, ama basa lubi bre du fanɛ fitila nɛ k bee mɔrɛ a shin nɛ k duŋ nna.

english_verse: Too much pride causes trouble. Be sensible and take advice.
translation_verse: Kamoowu bee bar esa tɔrɔ nna. Enyiashempo bre bee fin kasotoji nna.

english_verse: Money wrongly gained will disappear bit by bit; money earned little by little will grow and grow.
translation_verse: Ekpa lubi so be kanya maa chɛr nsaa loge. Ama esa kama nɛ e bee fin gbrɛgbrɛbi be kanya bee ti so saŋkama nna.

english_verse: Not getting what you want can break your heart, but a wish that comes true is a life-giving tree.
translation_verse: Tama nɛ k bee chɛr pɔɛŋ nsaa ba bee shin nɛ esa be aba bee pɔ mo nna, ama esa baa nya kusɔ nɛ e bee fin, k bee bar mo kagbenefuli nna.

english_verse: If you reject God's teaching, you will pay the price; if you obey his commands, you will be rewarded.
translation_verse: Esa nɛ e bee kini kasotoji lela bee wɔtɔ mbe kumu tɔrɔ to nna, ama emo nɛ e bee shuli a sɔ kasotoji bre bee nya kumo be tɔnɔ nna.

english_verse: Sensible instruction is a life-giving fountain that helps you escape all deadly traps.
translation_verse: Benyiashempo be keŋini du fanɛ ŋkpa be kebuye nna, a chɛ esa to nɛ e bee gelge luwu be kenishipere.

english_verse: Sound judgment is praised, but people without good sense are on the way to disaster.
translation_verse: Esa nɛ e bee nase asheŋ amo be edesekpa bee nya kemaŋkura nna, ama esa nɛ e paŋ lakal bre wɔ ekpa nɛ k bee yɔ kemur to so nna.

english_verse: If you have good sense, you will act sensibly, but fools act like fools.
translation_verse: Enyiashempo bee fɛ nfɛra nna pɔɛŋ nsaa wora asheŋ, ama ewulpo bre bee ta mbe kawulisheŋ nna a deŋi kelafa so.

english_verse: Whoever delivers your message can make things better or worse for you.
translation_verse: Kabɔ wulpo e naa bar kebagato, ama kabɔ nɛ e bee ji kashenteŋ bre bee bar kayurwushi nna.

english_verse: All who refuse correction will be poor and disgraced; all who accept correction will be praised.
translation_verse: Esa kama nɛ e bee kplaŋ keŋini so mo nɛ ketir nɛ anishinyɔr e naa baa la, ama ekama nɛ e bee shuli a sɔ keŋini bre bee nya kemaŋkura nna.

english_verse: It's a good feeling to get what you want, but only a stupid fool hates to turn from evil.
translation_verse: Kenya kusɔ nɛ esa bee sha wɔ ebel nna nsaa wushi kagbene. Bewulpo nawule e naa kini kechɛrga ashi alubi to.

english_verse: Wise friends make you wise, but you hurt yourself by going around with fools.
translation_verse: Esa kama nɛ e bee tu benyiashempo a nite bee ki enyiashempo nna, ama esa nɛ mo nɛ bewulpo bee wora asheŋ bre bee luri tɔrɔ to nna.

english_verse: You are in for trouble if you sin, but you will be rewarded if you live right.
translation_verse: Kumu lubi e ju a buu alubiworapoana so, ama basa nɛ baa wora asheŋ niŋiso bre be kakɔka la kumulela nna.

english_verse: If you obey God, you will have something to leave your grandchildren. If you don't obey God, those who live right will get what you leave.
translation_verse: Basa lela bee yige kapetɛ nna a yili bumo be kaman to ebi, ama belubiworapo bre bee fin asɔ nna a yili basa nɛ baa wora asheŋ niŋiso.

english_verse: Even when the land of the poor produces good crops, they get cheated out of what they grow.
translation_verse: Etirpo be kasawule beeŋ tiŋ n wora adɔjibi nɛnɛ, ama basa nɛ b maa ji kashenteŋ beeŋ puni n suge kanya na kikɛ ŋ ka mo.

english_verse: If you live right, you will have plenty to eat; if you don't live right, you will go away empty.
translation_verse: Basa niŋiso kɔ ajibi saŋkikɛ nna a ji, ama belubiworapo bre nɛ akoŋ e wɔ aya.

english_verse: A woman's family is held together by her wisdom, but it can be destroyed by her foolishness.
translation_verse: Eche nyiashempo bee koli kanaŋ nna, ama eche wulpo bre bee bure laŋ nna.

english_verse: By living right, you show that you respect the Lord; by being deceitful, you show that you despise him.
translation_verse: Basa nɛ bumo be asheŋ wora so niŋi bee ŋana Ebɔrɛ nna, ama esa kama nɛ e maa wora asheŋ niŋiso maa sa Ebɔrɛ bunyaŋ.

english_verse: Proud fools are punished for their stupid talk, but sensible talk can save your life.
translation_verse: Ewulpo be kamoowu be mmalga bee bar mo kasogberge nna, ama enyiashempo bre be kɔnɔ bee mɔlga mo nna.

english_verse: Without the help of an ox there can be no crop, but with a strong ox a big crop is possible.
translation_verse: Nɛ ana dɔso maŋ wɔtɔ, ajibi maŋ wɔtɔ. Ana dɔso be eleŋ e naa shin nɛ ajibi damta bee ba.

english_verse: An honest witness tells the truth; a dishonest witness tells nothing but lies.
translation_verse: Kashenteŋ be shɛdajipo maa fule, ama efɛ be shɛdajipo bre be kamalga kikɛ la efɛ nna.

english_verse: Make fun of wisdom, and you will never find it. But if you have understanding, knowledge comes easily.
translation_verse: Shiaworapo maaŋ tiŋ n nya kanyiasheŋ kikɛ ama lakalwura bre bee nya kenyi manaŋ manaŋ nna.

english_verse: Stay away from fools, or you won't learn a thing.
translation_verse: Sa maa tu bewulpo a wora asheŋ, ŋkpal manɛ so fo maaŋ tiŋ n nya kanyiasheŋ bumo kutɔ.

english_verse: Wise people have enough sense to find their way, but stupid fools get lost.
translation_verse: Enyiashempo be kanyiasheŋ e naa ŋini mo ekpa, ama ewulpo bre be kawuli bee fule mo nna n ya kaa lɛ.

english_verse: Fools don't care if they are wrong, but God is pleased when people do right.
translation_verse: Ewulpo nɛ asheŋ lubi maa fɔŋ, ama esa lela bre bee fin asheŋ be kelɔŋɛ nna.

english_verse: No one else can really know how sad or happy you are.
translation_verse: Esa pɔtɛ maaŋ tiŋ m pin kagbenefuli ŋko ebesa nɛ k wɔ esa be kagbene to.

english_verse: The tent of a good person stands longer than the house of someone evil.
translation_verse: Esa lubi be laŋ maa chɛr nsaa bure, ama esa lela bre be laŋ to be asheŋ bee yɔ anishito nna saŋkama.

english_verse: You may think you are on the right road and still end up dead.
translation_verse: Kebaawɔtɔ ko bee kaa duli kebaawɔtɔ lela nna, ama kumo be lalaloge bee yɛr esa luwu to nna.

english_verse: Sorrow may hide behind laughter, and happiness may end in sorrow.
translation_verse: Esa beeŋ tiŋ m mushe nɛ mbe kagbene maŋ fuli mo n loge. Kagbenefuli malɛ baŋ loge, kagbenejija e naa bɛ so.

english_verse: You harvest what you plant, whether good or bad.
translation_verse: Kusɔ kama nɛ esa duu, kulubi ŋko kelela, kumo nɛ e beeŋ teŋi.

english_verse: Don't be stupid and believe all you hear; be smart and know where you are headed.
translation_verse: Ewulpo e maa shika kasheŋ to, enyiashempo bre bee fɛ nfɛra nna pɔɛŋ nsaa wora asheŋ.

english_verse: Only a stupid fool is never cautious— so be extra careful and stay out of trouble.
translation_verse: Enyiashempo bee ŋana Ebɔrɛ nna nsaa gelge alubi, ewulpo bre du brembreŋ nna, e maa fɛ nfɛra pɔɛŋ nsaa wora asheŋ.

english_verse: Fools have quick tempers, and no one likes you if you can't be trusted.
translation_verse: Esa nɛ e bee nya agbo manaŋ manaŋ maa kraa wora a foe. Enyiashempo bre bee wushi eyur nna a wora asheŋ.

english_verse: The wicked will come crawling to those who obey God.
translation_verse: Belubiworapo e naaŋ jɔŋɛ belelaworapo ase n fin kechɛto ashi bumo kutɔ.

english_verse: You have no friends if you are poor, but you have lots of friends if you are rich.
translation_verse: Etirpo maŋ kɔ elopo, ama damawuraana bre kɔ beteri damta nna.

english_verse: It's wrong to hate others, but God blesses everyone who is kind to the poor.
translation_verse: Kekishi fo kurgepo la kulubi nna, ama Ebɔrɛ beeŋ nɛfa bekama nɛ baa chɛ betirpo to.

english_verse: It's a mistake to make evil plans, but you will have loyal friends if you want to do right.
translation_verse: Bumo nɛ baa kre asheŋ lubi beeŋ foe, ama bumo nɛ baa kre alelasheŋ beeŋ nya basa be kasha nɛ yirda.

english_verse: Hard work is worthwhile, but empty talk will make you poor.
translation_verse: Kepere kenishi n shuŋ bee bar tɔnɔ nna, ama k baa tase a malga nawule bre bee bar ketir nna.

english_verse: Wisdom can make you rich, but foolishness leads to more foolishness.
translation_verse: Benyiashempo beeŋ nya kedamaya be tɔnɔ, ama bewulpo bre be kawulisheŋ e naa shin nɛ basa bee pin fanɛ b la bewulpo.

english_verse: An honest witness can save your life, but liars can't be trusted.
translation_verse: Kashenteŋ be shɛdajipo bee mɔlga basa be ŋkpa nna, ama efɛ be shɛdajipo bre bee lar basa kaman nna.

english_verse: If you respect the Lord, you and your children have a strong fortress
translation_verse: Esa kama nɛ e bee ŋana Ebɔrɛ, mo nɛ mbe mbia beeŋ nya Ebɔrɛ be kekuŋ.

english_verse: and a life-giving fountain that keeps you safe from deadly traps.
translation_verse: Kabɔrɛŋana du fanɛ ŋkpa be kebuye nna; a kuŋ esa ashi luwu be ajigbelɛ to.

english_verse: Rulers of powerful nations are held in honor; rulers of weak nations are nothing at all.
translation_verse: Basa e la kuwura. Ewura nɛ e maŋ kɔ basa be kuwura maa ji eleŋ.

english_verse: It's smart to be patient, but it's stupid to lose your temper.
translation_verse: Enyitipo e la enyiashempo. Esa nɛ e bee nya agbo manaŋ manaŋ bee shin nɛ mbe kawulisheŋ bee dii efuli nna.

english_verse: It's healthy to be content, but envy can eat you up.
translation_verse: Kagbenewushi bee sa esa ŋkpa nna, ama kayurbesa bre du fanɛ kɔrtɔ lubi nna a ji esa.

english_verse: If you mistreat the poor, you insult your Creator; if you are kind to them, you show him respect.
translation_verse: Esa nɛ e bee mɛaŋ betirpo maa sa Ebɔrɛ nɛ e to bumo na bunyaŋ nna na, ama esa nɛ e bee wu betirpo kuwɔr bre bee bunyaŋ Ebɔrɛ nna.

english_verse: In times of trouble the wicked are destroyed, but even at death the innocent have faith.
translation_verse: Belubiworapo gbagba be asheŋ lubi e naa mur bumo, ama belelaworapo bre be alela e naa kuŋ bumo.

english_verse: Wisdom is found in the minds of people with good sense, but fools don't know it.
translation_verse: Kanyiasheŋ wɔ basa nɛ baa pin asheŋ to be ŋgbene to nna, ama bewulpo bre maŋ kɔ kumo.

english_verse: Doing right brings honor to a nation, but sin brings disgrace.
translation_verse: Kebaawora asheŋ niŋiso e naa sa efuli kemaŋkura, ama alubi bre bee shin nɛ efuli bee sipa nna.

english_verse: Kings reward servants who act wisely, but they punish those who act foolishly.
translation_verse: Nyɛrbi nyiashempo be asheŋ bee bɔlɔ bewura kenishi nna, ama nyɛrbi wulpo bre bee nya bewura be kasogberge nna.

english_verse: A kind answer soothes angry feelings, but harsh words stir them up.
translation_verse: Kɔnɔ belbelso bee ju agbo nna, ama kɔnɔ nyaŋnyaŋso bre bee kaa agbo nna.

english_verse: Words of wisdom come from the wise, but fools speak foolishness.
translation_verse: Enyiashempo be kamalga bee koli basa nna a ba mo kutɔ, ama kawulisheŋ e naa lar ewulpo bre be kɔnɔ to.

english_verse: Kind words are good medicine, but deceitful words can really hurt.
translation_verse: Kamalga lela bee sa basa ŋkpa nna, ama efɛ be mmalga bre bee mɔ esa be kiyoyu nna.

english_verse: Good people become wealthy, but those who are evil will lose what they have.
translation_verse: Basa nɛ baa wora asheŋ niŋiso e naa ji bumo be kanya be tɔnɔ. Ama tɔrɔ be saŋɛ belubiworapo bre bee paŋ bumo be kanya nna.

english_verse: Words of wisdom make good sense; the thoughts of a fool make no sense at all.
translation_verse: Benyiashempo be atuwebi e naa sa basa kenyi, mannɛ bewulpo peya.

english_verse: The Lord is disgusted by gifts from the wicked, but it makes him happy when his people pray.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kishi belubiworapo be sarga ga, ama basa lela bre be kabɔrɛkule bee bɔlɔ mo kenishi nna ga.

english_verse: The Lord is disgusted with all who do wrong, but he loves everyone who does right.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kishi belubiworapo be asheŋ wora so ga, ama e bee sha basa nɛ baa wora asheŋ lela bre ga.

english_verse: If you turn from the right way, you will be punished; if you refuse correction, you will die.
translation_verse: Kasogberge gboŋgboŋi bee jo ekama nɛ e maa bɔla ekpa niŋiso so a wora asheŋ na nna. Ekama nɛ e kini keŋini nsaa bɛ ekpa nɛ k maŋ niŋi na so beeŋ wu.

english_verse: If the Lord can see everything in the world of the dead, he can see in our hearts.
translation_verse: Luwu nɛ nchaŋ gba maaŋ tiŋ ŋ ŋana Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ so, a bishi dimɛdi be kagbene to be nfɛra.

english_verse: Those who sneer at others don't like to be corrected, and they won't ask help from someone with sense.
translation_verse: Esa nɛ e bee wora basa eyurto kikɛ maa sha keŋini, amoso mo alɛ maaŋ yɔ enyiashempo kutɔ n ya fin kasotoji.

english_verse: Anyone with good sense is eager to learn more, but fools are hungry for foolishness.
translation_verse: Enyiashempo kikɛ bee koya nna a ti so, ama kawulisheŋ e bɔlɔ bewulpo bre to.

english_verse: The poor have a hard life, but being content is as good as an endless feast.
translation_verse: Kebaawɔtɔ kpakpaso to nɛ betirpo wɔ saŋkama, ama esa nɛ asheŋ bee bɔlɔ kenishi bre be kebaawɔtɔ du fanɛ esa nɛ e bee ji kejigboŋ saŋkama nna.

english_verse: It's better to obey the Lord and have only a little, than to be very rich and terribly anxious.
translation_verse: Kebaa la etirpo nsaa ŋana Ebɔrɛ bɔ kedamaya nɛ tɔrɔ.

english_verse: A simple meal with love is better than a feast where there is hatred.
translation_verse: Kebaatu esa nɛ e bee sha fo a ji nchu nɛ nfɔl bɔ kebaatu bedoŋ n ji gbetɛgbetɛ.

english_verse: Losing your temper causes a lot of trouble, but staying calm settles arguments.
translation_verse: Esa nɛ e bee nya agbo manaŋ manaŋ kikɛ bee bar kolu nna, ama enyitipo bre bee kuŋ kolu nna.

english_verse: A lazy person refuses to clear a thorny path, but everyone who does right walks on a smooth road.
translation_verse: Etɔlpo be ekpa to e kɔ ewi, ama esa nɛ e bee wora alela bre be ekpa to du fanɛ kegbembi nna.

english_verse: Children with good sense make their parents happy, but foolish children despise them.
translation_verse: Kebia nyiashempo kikɛ bee bar mo tuto kagbenefuli nna, kebia wulpo e naa kplaŋ mo nio be keŋini so.

english_verse: Stupidity brings happiness to senseless fools, but everyone with good sense follows the straight path.
translation_verse: Kawulisheŋ bee fuli ewulpo kagbene nna, ama enyiashempo bre bee wora asheŋ niŋiso nna.

english_verse: Without good advice everything goes wrong— it takes careful planning for things to go right.
translation_verse: Ŋkre lela kikɛ bee shi kasotoji lela to nna. Kechena ŋ kre asheŋ nɛnɛ pɔɛŋ nseŋ wora e naa shin nɛ asheŋ bee nite nɛnɛ.

english_verse: Giving the right answer at the right time makes everyone happy.
translation_verse: Keshuli n wora kesheŋ saŋɛ nɛ k daga nɛ kananɛ k daga e naa bar kagbenefuli.

english_verse: All who are wise follow a road that leads upward to life and away from death.
translation_verse: Ekpa nɛ benyiashempo bɔ bee yɛr bumo ŋkpa to nna, mannɛ luwu to.

english_verse: The Lord destroys the homes of those who are proud, but he protects the property of widows.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee shin nɛ kamoowuwuraana be nwu bee ki alambure nna, ama e bee kuŋ bekulpoche bre be asɔ nna a sa bumo.

english_verse: The Lord hates evil thoughts, but kind words please him.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kishi nfɛra lubi ga, kamalga lela e naa fuli mo kagbene.

english_verse: Being greedy causes trouble for your family, but you protect yourself by refusing bribes.
translation_verse: Ekpa lubi so be kanya bee bar tɔrɔ kanaŋ to nna. Sa maa sɔ brɔbu nseŋ kuŋ fo kumu.

english_verse: Good people think before they answer, but the wicked speak evil without ever thinking.
translation_verse: Basa lela bee fɛ nfɛra nna pɔɛŋ nsaa tuge asheŋ to, ama basa lubi bre bee jujo nna a malga mmalga lubi pɔɛŋ nsaa fɛ amo be nfɛra.

english_verse: The Lord never even hears the prayers of the wicked, but he answers the prayers of all who obey him.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na maa nu basa lubi be kabɔrɛkule, basa nɛ baa wora asheŋ niŋiso peya nɛ E bee nu.

english_verse: A friendly smile makes you happy, and good news makes you feel strong.
translation_verse: Kenishitosaŋɛ bee bar kagbenefuli nna, nɛ baru lela bee shin nɛ esa be ŋkpa bee ba mo abar so.

english_verse: You hurt only yourself by rejecting instruction, but it makes good sense to accept it.
translation_verse: Esa kama nɛ e maa shuli a sɔ kasogberge maa sha mbe kumu nna na, ama esa kama nɛ e bee sɔ keŋini bee nya kanyiasheŋ nna a ti so.

english_verse: Showing respect to the Lord will make you wise, and being humble will bring honor to you.
translation_verse: Kabɔrɛŋana e naa sa esa kanyiasheŋ, nɛ kamoobarase malɛ bee sa esa kemaŋkura.

english_verse: We humans make plans, but the Lord has the final word.
translation_verse: Dimɛdi e wɔ afɛso ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ e wɔ aworbi.

english_verse: We may think we know what is right, but the Lord is the judge of our motives.
translation_verse: Dimɛdi beeŋ fɛ fanɛ mbe asheŋ woraso walɛ, ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nawule e nyi kusɔ nɛ k walɛ.

english_verse: Share your plans with the Lord, and you will succeed.
translation_verse: Ta kusɔ kama nɛ fee sha kewora m bɔɔ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ enɔ nɛ asheŋ e nite nɛnɛ n sa fo.

english_verse: The Lord has a reason for everything he does, and he lets evil people live only to be punished.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ e nyi kusɔ so so nɛ e lɔŋɛ kusɔ kama nɛ e lɔŋɛ; E wora belubiworapo gba nna a jo bumo be kemur be kachɛ.

english_verse: The Lord doesn't like anyone who is conceited— you can be sure they will be punished.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kishi esa nɛ e kɔ mpuchi ga. Kumo alɛ maŋ kɔ emɔrɔ fanɛ e beeŋ gberge loŋ be basa kusoe.

english_verse: If we truly love God, our sins will be forgiven; if we show him respect, we will keep away from sin.
translation_verse: Fo baa kɔ kasonu nɛ kashenteŋji, Ebɔrɛ beeŋ ta fo alubi m paŋ fo. Kabɔrɛŋana e naa shin nɛ esa bee ŋana kulubi.

english_verse: When we please the Lord, even our enemies make friends with us.
translation_verse: Esa be asheŋ woraso baa bɔlɔ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kenishi, E bee shin nna nɛ amodoŋwura nɛ mo doŋana gba bee chena kagbenewushi so.

english_verse: It's better to be honest and poor than to be dishonest and rich.
translation_verse: Kebɔla ekpa niŋiso so n nya asɔ gbrɛ bɔ kebirkɔshi so be kedamaya.

english_verse: We make our own plans, but the Lord decides where we will go.
translation_verse: Dimɛdi e wɔ afɛso, ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ e wɔ aworbi.

english_verse: The Lord watches to see if we are fair or if we cheat others.
translation_verse: Kashenteŋ be kasɔkarga nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ bee sha. E maa sha kapuni be kayawuji.

english_verse: An angry ruler can put you to death. So be wise! Don't make one angry.
translation_verse: Ewura be agbo du fanɛ luwu be kabɔ nna, enyiashempo e naŋ tiŋ n shin nɛ k wushi.

english_verse: When a ruler is happy and pleased with you, it's like refreshing rain, and you will live.
translation_verse: Ewura be kagbenefuli bee bar ŋkpa nna nɛ mbe kasha malɛ du fanɛ dɔchubɔrɛso be bɔrɛ.

english_verse: It's much better to be wise and sensible than to be rich.
translation_verse: Kanyiasheŋ nɛ kenyi bɔ shuwa nɛ gbiti.

english_verse: God's people avoid evil ways, and they protect themselves by watching where they go.
translation_verse: Basa lela bee gelge alubi be ekpa nna. Esa nɛ e da ekpa nɛ e bee bɔla so so beeŋ kuŋ mbe ŋkpa.

english_verse: You are better off to be humble and poor than to get rich from what you take by force.
translation_verse: Fo ki etirpo ŋkpal fo ka bar fo kumu ase so bɔ fo ka tu kamoowuwuraana m barga asɔ nɛ b suge to.

english_verse: Good judgment proves that you are wise, and if you speak kindly, you can teach others.
translation_verse: Enyiashempo e naa pin asheŋ to manaŋ manaŋ, nɛ kamalga lela malɛ bee chɛ to a shin nɛ esa be keŋini asheŋ bee nite nɛnɛ.

english_verse: Good sense is a fountain that gives life, but fools are punished by their foolishness.
translation_verse: Kanyiasheŋ bee sa benyiashempo ŋkpa nna, ama kawulisheŋ bre bee bar bewulpo kasogberge nna.

english_verse: You can persuade others if you are wise and speak sensibly.
translation_verse: Enyiashempo bee fɛ nfɛra nna pɔɛŋ nsaa malga, amoso mbe keŋini bee leŋ basa to nna a wɔtɔ kasheŋwora to.

english_verse: Kind words are like honey— they cheer you up and make you feel strong.
translation_verse: Kamalga lela du fanɛ mushoŋchu nna a wora basa ebel; nsaa sa eyur be alenfia.

english_verse: The hungrier you are, the harder you work.
translation_verse: Akoŋ e naa kaa shin nɛ basa bee pere kenishi a shuŋ.

english_verse: Worthless people plan trouble. Even their words burn like a flaming fire.
translation_verse: Belubiworapo e naa kre alubisheŋ, nɛ bumo be m malga malɛ du fanɛ ajanwulɛ a chɔɔ basa.

english_verse: Gossip is no good! It causes hard feelings and comes between friends.
translation_verse: Esa nɛ e bee ku asheŋ bee bar kebagato nna nɛ esa nɛ e bee sha ŋkuli malɛ bee ku beteri kpakpaso to.

english_verse: Don't trust violent people. They will mislead you to do the wrong thing.
translation_verse: Basa nɛ baa tintiŋ basa nɛ baa wora asheŋ na bee fule bumo braana nna a wɔtɔ asheŋ lubi to.

english_verse: When someone winks or grins behind your back, trouble is on the way.
translation_verse: Esa nɛ e bee ŋe basa anishi bee ku asheŋ nna, nɛ esa nɛ e duŋ kɔnɔwuro malɛ yil kulubi be kewora so.

english_verse: Gray hair is a glorious crown worn by those who have lived right.
translation_verse: Kumu fuful la kemankura be kuwurwuro nna, basa nɛ baa wora asheŋ niŋiso nawule e naa buu kumo.

english_verse: Controlling your temper is better than being a hero who captures a city.
translation_verse: Kanyiti be keji bɔ kenyɛn be keji. Enyitipo chɔ enapo nɛ e kɔ m pɔɔ nde damta so.

english_verse: We make our own decisions, but the Lord alone determines what happens.
translation_verse: Basa bee kaa bishiso nna a fin kananɛ baaŋ wora asheŋ, ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nawule e naa yili kusɔ kikɛ.

english_verse: A dry crust of bread eaten in peace and quiet is better than a feast eaten where everyone argues.
translation_verse: Ŋ kaa bee ji nchu nɛ nfɔl nawule nsaa kɔ kagbenewushi bɔ ŋ kaa bee ji ebel nsaa wɔ kagbenejija to saŋkama.

english_verse: A wise slave will be placed in charge of a no-good child, and that slave will be given the same inheritance that each child receives.
translation_verse: Kenya nyiashempo bee ji ebi wulpo so kuwura nna, nɛ mo nɛ bibi e barga kapetɛ to.

english_verse: Silver and gold are tested by flames of fire; our thoughts are tested by the Lord.
translation_verse: Edɛ nɛ baa ta a wora shuwa nɛ gbiti a keni a pin amo be kela; ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e naa wora dimɛdi be kagbene a keni.

english_verse: Troublemakers listen to troublemakers, and liars listen to liars.
translation_verse: Alubisheŋ bee wora belubiworapo ebel nna nɛ efɛ malɛ bee wora befɛpo ebel.

english_verse: By insulting the poor, you insult your Creator. You will be punished if you make fun of someone in trouble.
translation_verse: Fo baa wora betirpo eyurto, Ebɔrɛ nɛ E to bumo na nɛ fee wora eyurto na. Ebɔrɛ malɛ beeŋ gberge bekama nɛ bumo braana be awurfoŋ bee wora bumo ebel na kusoe.

english_verse: Grandparents are proud of their grandchildren, and children should be proud of their parents.
translation_verse: Benanabi du fanɛ kuwurwuro nna n sa bumo nanaana; nɛ mbia malɛ bee ji njɔŋ ŋkpal bumo kurgepoana so so.

english_verse: It sounds strange for a fool to talk sensibly, but it's even worse for a ruler to tell lies.
translation_verse: Kananɛ kamalga nɛ k bee lar anishi maaŋ tiŋ n shi ewulpo be kɔnɔ to na; aloŋ nɛ efɛ maŋ daga ewurjipo be kɔnɔ to.

english_verse: You will keep your friends if you forgive them, but you will lose your friends if you keep talking about what they did wrong.
translation_verse: Esa nɛ e bee ta asheŋ a paŋ bee nya beteri damta nna; ama esa nɛ e maa ta asheŋ a paŋ bre bee paŋ beteri nna.

english_verse: A sensible person accepts correction, but you can't beat sense into a fool.
translation_verse: Enyiashempo be kegbɛlɛ gba bee shin nɛ e bee koya asheŋ manaŋ manaŋ a chɔ ewulpo be kebri alɛ damta n ŋini mo asheŋ.

english_verse: Cruel people want to rebel, and so vicious attackers will be sent against them.
translation_verse: Kumu kpakpasowura kutɔ nɛ baa shuŋi belubiworapo nɛ b kɔ kusoe kpakpaso a kini kenu n sa na.

english_verse: A bear robbed of her cubs is far less dangerous than a stubborn fool.
translation_verse: Fo ka purgi buluŋ cheso nɛ k bee yɛla kenishi to a fin kumo pibi bɔ fo ka tu ewulpo a wora kawulisheŋ.

english_verse: You will always have trouble if you are mean to those who are good to you.
translation_verse: Fo baa ta kulubi a ka kelela be kukɔ, alubi maaŋ lar fo laŋ to kikɛ.

english_verse: The start of an argument is like a water leak— so stop it before real trouble breaks out.
translation_verse: Emɔrɔ be kefara du fanɛ nchu be gbi ka bee shin nɛ k futi nna. Lar kamɔrɔji to manaŋ pɔɛŋ nɛ k kurge asheŋ n sa fo.

english_verse: The Lord doesn't like those who defend the guilty or condemn the innocent.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kishi bumo nɛ baa malga a kuŋ belubiworapo, nɛ bumo nɛ baa ku asheŋ a deŋi basa nɛ b maŋ wora kulubi na ga.

english_verse: Why should fools have money for an education when they refuse to learn?
translation_verse: Amansherbi be kejija a laŋɛ ewulpo be kekoya so maŋ kɔ tɔnɔ, ŋkpal manɛ so ewulpo maaŋ tiŋ ŋ koya shɛŋ.

english_verse: A friend is there to help, in any situation, and relatives are born to share our troubles.
translation_verse: Beteri bee sha abar nna; nɛ bekurgepo malɛ bee cha abar to ashi tɔrɔ to.

english_verse: The wicked and the proud love trouble and keep begging to be hurt.
translation_verse: Elushapo kikɛ maa barga alubi be kewora. Fo baa puchi ga fee fin asheŋ nna a sa fo kumu.

english_verse: Dishonesty does you no good, and telling lies will get you in trouble.
translation_verse: Esa kama nɛ e maa ji kashenteŋ maaŋ yɔ anishito kikɛ. Efɛ bee bar esa tɔrɔ nna.

english_verse: It's never pleasant to be the parent of a fool and have nothing but pain.
translation_verse: Ebesa nɛ kagbenejija e naa mɔ ewulpo mo tuto.

english_verse: If you are cheerful, you feel good; if you are sad, you hurt all over.
translation_verse: Kebaa du wasawasa bee teŋi esa be ŋkpa so nna; ama saŋkama be kenishitogbir bee ku esa be ŋkpa so manaŋ manaŋ nna.

english_verse: Crooks accept secret bribes to keep justice from being done.
translation_verse: Edemujipo lubiana nɛ baa ŋana a sɔ brɔbu na maa tiŋ a ji demu nɛ kumo be ekpa so.

english_verse: Anyone with wisdom knows what makes good sense, but fools can never make up their minds.
translation_verse: Enyiashempo kikɛ bee pin kusɔ nɛ k daga kewora nna; ama ewulpo bre maa tiŋ a yili mbe nfɛra kukoŋwule.

english_verse: It isn't fair to punish the innocent and those who do right.
translation_verse: Esa nɛ e maŋ wora n jija maŋ daga kasogberge; nɛ esa nɛ e bee wora asheŋ nɛ a niŋi ekpa maŋ daga tɔrɔ.

english_verse: It makes a lot of sense to be a person of few words and to stay calm.
translation_verse: Enyiashempo maa malga ga. E bee wora asheŋ boeŋ boeŋ nna.

english_verse: It's selfish and stupid to think only of yourself and to sneer at people who have sense.
translation_verse: Kebaafɛ fo nawule be kumu so be asheŋ, nɛ kekini kesɔ esa pɔtɛ be nfɛra la kejimuni nɛ kawulisheŋ nna.

english_verse: Fools have no desire to learn, instead they would rather give their own opinion.
translation_verse: Ewulpo e naa kini asheŋ be kepin to, nsaa kaŋɛ fanɛ mo nawule be nfɛra e walɛ.

english_verse: Wrongdoing leads to shame and disgrace.
translation_verse: Kulubi nɛ anishinyɔr e wɔ aya. Alubiworapo kikɛ nɛ nyɔmɔ nna.

english_verse: Words of wisdom are a stream that flows from a deep fountain.
translation_verse: Enyiashempo be mmalga du fanɛ ketirbu chiŋgeliŋ to be nchu nɛ a bee bul a teŋi a shile eleŋso fanɛ kabombi nna.

english_verse: It's wrong to favor the guilty and keep the innocent from getting justice.
translation_verse: Alubiworapo maŋ daga kesɔ n yige ashi kasogberge to, esa nɛ e maŋ wora n jija malɛ maŋ daga kemɔn kashenteŋ.

english_verse: Foolish talk will get you into a lot of trouble.
translation_verse: Ewulpo be kudonduloŋ bee wɔtɔ mo asheŋ to nna, nɛ mbe kɔnɔ malɛ bee bar mo kebri.

english_verse: Saying foolish things is like setting a trap to destroy yourself.
translation_verse: Ewulpo be mmalga e naa ki fanɛ efɔl a kre mo, nɛ mbe atuwebi malɛ bee gberge mo a wɔtɔ asheŋ to.

english_verse: There's nothing so delicious as the taste of gossip! It melts in your mouth.
translation_verse: Ŋkuli wɔ ebel ga; nɛ basa bee sha kumo.

english_verse: Being lazy is no different from being a troublemaker.
translation_verse: Etɔlpo nɛ esa nɛ e bee jija asɔ kikɛ la kukoŋwule nna.

english_verse: The Lord is a mighty tower where his people can run for safety—
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ du fanɛ ketempreŋ kuŋso nna nɛ basa nɛ baa wora asheŋ niŋiso bee shile a yɔ mo kutɔ n ya kaa nya kekuŋ.

english_verse: Pride leads to destruction; humility leads to honor.
translation_verse: Kamoowu bee yɛr esa kemur to nna; ama kamoobarase bre bee sa esa kemaŋkura nna.

english_verse: Being cheerful helps when you are sick, but nothing helps when you give up.
translation_verse: Kagbenefuli bee chɛ to nna a sa esa alenfia ashi kulɔ to; fo baŋ paŋ kumo, kumo ere fo tama loge.

english_verse: Everyone with good sense wants to learn.
translation_verse: Enyiashempo kikɛ bela ase nna nɛ e koya asheŋ saŋkama.

english_verse: A gift will get you in to see anyone.
translation_verse: Kakɛ bee bugi ekpa nna a sa esa, nɛ e bee tiŋ a yɔ basagboŋ kutɔ.

english_verse: You may think you have won your case in court, until your opponent speaks.
translation_verse: Esa baŋ juŋkpar m malga ashi demujikpa, fee fɛ nna fanɛ mo e kɔ kashenteŋ ama mo barkasa gba baŋ malga nna.

english_verse: Drawing straws is one way to settle a difficult case.
translation_verse: Basa anyɔ baa gberge demu to nɛ k maa nya edesekpa, kesulgeso e naŋ ku demu na to.

english_verse: Making up with a friend you have offended is harder than breaking through a city wall.
translation_verse: Keyɔ eteri nɛ fo wora n da so kutɔ n ya fin kechɛto du kpakpa a chɔ kebure n luri kade nɛ b pɔr egbal ŋ kulti to.

english_verse: Make your words good— you will be glad you did.
translation_verse: Kɔnɔlelawura maa wora n daa nyi nna kikɛ.

english_verse: Words can bring death or life! Talk too much, and you will eat everything you say.
translation_verse: Atugebi beeŋ tiŋ m mɔ esa, ŋko n sa mo ŋkpa; Esa kama malɛ beeŋ nya mbe m malga be kakɔka.

english_verse: A man's greatest treasure is his wife— she is a gift from the Lord.
translation_verse: Fo baŋ nya eche fo nya kakɛ lela. Eche lela la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be kakɛ nna.

english_verse: The poor must beg for help, but the rich can give a harsh reply.
translation_verse: Etirpo bee kule nna pɔɛŋ nsaa nya kechɛto; ama damawura bre bee malga kanaŋkama nna.

english_verse: Some friends don't help, but a true friend is closer than your own family.
translation_verse: Beteri damta beeŋ tiŋ n jija esa be kebaawɔtɔ; ama eteri ko chɔ eniopibi.

english_verse: It's better to be poor and live right than to be a stupid liar.
translation_verse: Fo ka bee ji kashenteŋ nsaa la etirpo bɔ fo ka la ewulpo nɛ efɛpo.

english_verse: Willingness and stupidity don't go well together. If you are too eager, you will miss the road.
translation_verse: Kebaa sha kusɔ be kewora nsaa maa kɔ kumo be kenyi maŋ walɛ; kewora gerger n to kusɔ n da malɛ maŋ kɔ tɔnɔ.

english_verse: We are ruined by our own stupidity, though we blame the Lord.
translation_verse: Kawuli e naa yɛr basa ko tɔrɔ to nɛ baa pɔlɔ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ.

english_verse: The rich have many friends; the poor have none.
translation_verse: Damawura bee nya beteri saŋkama nna; ama etirpo bre mo teriana bee shile nna a ka mo.

english_verse: Everyone tries to be friends of those who can help them.
translation_verse: Ekama beeŋ ba sha keji esagboŋ, ŋko esa nɛ e beeŋ tiŋ n chɛ mo to keteri.

english_verse: If you are poor, your own relatives reject you, and your friends are worse. When you really need them, they are not there.
translation_verse: Etirpo maŋ kɔ eniopibi, a bishi eteri. Kanaŋ kamaso nɛ e pere kenishi a sha bumo baa shile nna a ka mo.

english_verse: Do yourself a favor by having good sense— you will be glad you did.
translation_verse: Esa kama nɛ e bee fin kanyiasheŋ bee sha mbe kumu nna na. Esa kama nɛ e pere kenishi ŋ koya, asheŋ beeŋ nite nɛnɛ n sa mo.

english_verse: It isn't right for a fool to live in luxury or for a slave to rule in place of a king.
translation_verse: Ewulpo maŋ daga kedamaya; Kenya malɛ maŋ daga keji ewurbi so kuwura.

english_verse: It's wise to be patient and show what you are like by forgiving others.
translation_verse: Kanyiti be keji la kanyiasheŋ nna. Esa baŋ wora fo kulubi nɛ fo kplaŋ mo so, k la kemaŋkura nna n sa fo.

english_verse: An angry king roars like a lion, but when a king is pleased, it's like dew on the crops.
translation_verse: Ewura be agbo du fanɛ buluŋ ka bee ponte to nna nɛ mbe kuwɔrwu malɛ du fanɛ bunyaŋ ka tɔr afitiri so.

english_verse: Foolish children bring disgrace to their fathers. A nagging wife goes on and on like the drip, drip, drip of the rain.
translation_verse: Kebia wulpo bee wɔtɔ mo tuto asheŋ to nna; Eche nɛ asheŋ maa bɔlɔ kenishi malɛ du nna fanɛ bɔrɛfurbi nɛ k maa teŋ manaŋ.

english_verse: You may inherit all you own from your parents, but a sensible wife is a gift from the Lord.
translation_verse: Esa beeŋ tiŋ n ji nwu nɛ amansherbi be kapetɛ; ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nawule e naa sa eche lela.

english_verse: If you are lazy and sleep your time away, you will starve.
translation_verse: Nɛ fo kɔ ntɔl nsaa dese a di, akoŋ e naa mɔ fo.

english_verse: Obey the Lord's teachings and you will live— disobey and you will die.
translation_verse: Bɛ Ebɔrɛ be mbra so nseŋ ji efute n chɛr. Fo kplaŋ amo so feeŋ wu manaŋ.

english_verse: Caring for the poor is lending to the Lord, and you will be well repaid.
translation_verse: Kekɛ etirpo kusɔ du fanɛ fo ka ta kumo m paŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nna; Ebɔrɛ beeŋ ka fo kumo be kukɔ.

english_verse: Correct your children before it's too late; if you don't punish them, trouble will come their way.
translation_verse: Ŋini fo mbia kusɔ nɛ k daga pɔɛŋ nɛ b daŋ; Fo baa maa gberge bumo kusoe a ŋini bumo asheŋ fee mɔ bumo ŋgblaŋto nna na.

english_verse: Pay attention to advice and accept correction, so you can live sensibly.
translation_verse: Esa nɛ e bee nu kasotoji nɛ keŋini, bee ki enyiashempo nna.

english_verse: We may make a lot of plans, but the Lord will do what he has decided.
translation_verse: Dimɛdi beeŋ tiŋ ŋ kre ŋkre; ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be aparsheŋ e naŋ wora.

english_verse: What matters most is loyalty. It's better to be poor than to be a liar.
translation_verse: Kusɔ nɛ dimɛdi bee fin e la kashenteŋji; K baa la etirpo bɔ k baa la efɛpo.

english_verse: Showing respect to the Lord brings true life— if you do it, you can relax without fear of danger.
translation_verse: Fo baa wora Ebɔrɛ kasonu feeŋ ji efute tenteŋ; Esa nɛ e bee ŋana Ebɔrɛ be kagbene bee dese mo nna; e maa lɔ kufu.

english_verse: Some people are too lazy to lift a hand to feed themselves.
translation_verse: Ajibi be keku n ji gba du betɔlpo ko so kpakpa nna.

english_verse: Stupid fools learn good sense by seeing others punished; a sensible person learns by being corrected.
translation_verse: Gberge kumukpakpasowura kusoe, nɛ esa nɛ e maŋ nyi e koya kebaawɔtɔ; Ama kefiɛ enyiashempo bre so bee sa mo lakal nna.

english_verse: Disgraceful children rob their father and chase their mother away.
translation_verse: Kebia nɛ e bee yuri mo tuto, nsaa ju mo nio ashi laŋ to bee ŋaba mbe kumu nna na.

english_verse: If you stop learning, you will forget what you already know.
translation_verse: Fo baŋ yige kebaa koya, feeŋ teŋ kusɔ nɛ fo nyi gba so.

english_verse: A lying witness makes fun of the court system, and criminals think crime is really delicious.
translation_verse: Efɛ be shɛdajipo bee kuŋ kashenteŋji ekpa nna; Asheŋ lubi bee wora alubiworapo ebel nna.

english_verse: A stupid fool should expect to be punished.
translation_verse: Kasogberge wɔtɔ nna ŋkpal basa kpeŋso so. Ewulpo kikɛ bee nya kebri nna.

english_verse: It isn't smart to get drunk! Drinking makes a fool of you and leads to fights.
translation_verse: Nsa bee ta esa nna a ki elushapo, a shin nɛ e bee nite a puchi. Esa kama nɛ nsa wɔ mo la ewulpo nna.

english_verse: An angry ruler is like a roaring lion— make either one angry, and you are dead.
translation_verse: Ewura be kanya agbo du fanɛ buluŋ ka nya agbo nna. Keshin nɛ ewura e nya agbo du fanɛ kapotɔ nna.

english_verse: It makes you look good when you avoid a fight— only fools love to quarrel.
translation_verse: Kebaa maa sha kolu bee sa esa kemaŋkura nna. Ewulpo e naa sha kamɔrɔji.

english_verse: If you are too lazy to plow, don't expect a harvest.
translation_verse: Edɔpo tɔlpo nɛ e maa dɔ saŋɛ nɛ k daga maa nya adɔjibi.

english_verse: Someone's thoughts may be as deep as the ocean, but if you are smart, you will discover them.
translation_verse: Dimɛdi be nfɛra fɛso du chiŋgeliŋ nna fanɛ ketirbu chiŋgeliŋ to be nchu na. Enyiashempo nawule e naa tiŋ a saŋ amo.

english_verse: There are many who say, “You can trust me!” But can they be trusted?
translation_verse: Basa damta bee tre bumo amu beshenteŋjipo nna, ama kashenteŋ be beshenteŋjipo maa tiŋ a nya.

english_verse: Good people live right, and God blesses the children who follow their example.
translation_verse: Esa nɛ e niŋi kikɛ be kebaawɔtɔ niŋi nna. Mbia nɛ baa koya mbe asheŋ woraso bee nya nɛfa nna.

english_verse: When rulers decide cases, they weigh the evidence.
translation_verse: Ewura baa tase a ji demu mbe anishi yuu alubiworapoana so nna.

english_verse: Can any of us really say, “My thoughts are pure, and my sins are gone”?
translation_verse: Wanɛ e naŋ tiŋ m puchi ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ mbe nfɛra walɛ nɛ e maŋ wora kulubi?

english_verse: Two things the Lord hates are dishonest scales and dishonest measures.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kishi kapuni be kasɔkarga nɛ kapuni be asɔ karga asɔ ga.

english_verse: The good or bad that children do shows what they are like.
translation_verse: Mbia be aworbi e naa ŋini basa nɛ baaŋ ba ki echefoso.

english_verse: If you sleep all the time, you will starve; if you get up and work, you will have enough food.
translation_verse: Fo baa sha edi ga fee ki etirpo nna, ama fo pere kenishi a shuŋ bre, fo maŋ paŋ fo kusɔ jiso.

english_verse: Sensible words are better than gold or jewels.
translation_verse: Kanyiasheŋ be kamalga bɔ shuwa nɛ yawu kpakpaso be abitasɔ.

english_verse: You deserve to lose your coat if you loan it to someone to guarantee payment for the debt of a stranger.
translation_verse: Esa baŋ ta mbe kusɔbuuso n nase tarma n ji kukɔ n sa efɔ, nɛ efɔ na baŋ maŋ tiŋ ŋ ka kukɔ na, fo sɔ amodoŋwura be kusɔbuuso na n tal to.

english_verse: The food you get by cheating may taste delicious, but it turns to gravel.
translation_verse: Ajibi be kepuni n ji wɔ ebel nna, ama amo be lalaloge du fanɛ shishɛr nna kɔnɔ to.

english_verse: Be sure you have sound advice before making plans or starting a war.
translation_verse: Fo baa bela ase nɛ fo kɔ kena, kumo ere fin kasotoji lela nɛ k chɛ fo to.

english_verse: Stay away from gossips— they tell everything.
translation_verse: Esheŋjipo kikɛ maŋ tiŋ ŋ keta ashiri, amoso baa gelge mo.

english_verse: Children who curse their parents will go to the land of darkness long before their time.
translation_verse: Esa nɛ e bee sho mo tuto nɛ mo nio kɔnɔ be ŋkpa maa teŋiso, k du nna fanɛ fitila ka duŋ tentembiri to epul to nna.

english_verse: Getting rich quick may turn out to be a curse.
translation_verse: Fo baa maŋ gben pɔɛŋ nseŋ dii dama, fo asɔ na maa chɛr nsaa mur.

english_verse: Don't try to get even. Trust the Lord, and he will help you.
translation_verse: Sa maa kɔ a fin kewora n tal esa nɛ e wora fo kulubi to. Shin nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ e bishi kuwule n sa fo.

english_verse: The Lord hates dishonest scales and dishonest weights. So don't cheat!
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kishi basa nɛ baa ta kapuni be asɔ karga asɔ a ber asɔ ga.

english_verse: How can we know what will happen to us when the Lord alone decides?
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ e nyi kananɛ dimɛdi be asheŋ bee nite. Nuso nɛ esa gbagba beeŋ tiŋ m pin kananɛ asheŋ beeŋ ba kaa du n sa mo.

english_verse: Don't fall into the trap of making promises to God before you think!
translation_verse: Fɛ nfɛra nɛnɛ pɔɛŋ nseŋ nase kɔnɔ n sa Ebɔrɛ. Nɛ fo baŋ maŋ tiŋ n wora m bɔlɔ fo kɔnɔ naseso so, k maŋ walɛ.

english_verse: A wise ruler severely punishes every criminal.
translation_verse: Ewura nyiashempo kikɛ bee gberge belubiworapo kusoe kenishipereso nna.

english_verse: Our inner thoughts are a lamp from the Lord, and they search our hearts.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be fitila bee wu dimɛdi be nfɛra, nɛ mbe kebaawɔtɔ to kikɛ nna.

english_verse: Rulers are protected by God's mercy and loyalty, but they must be merciful for their kingdoms to last.
translation_verse: Kashenteŋji nɛ kasha e naa shin nɛ bewura bee ji a chɛr.

english_verse: Young people take pride in their strength, but the gray hairs of wisdom are even more beautiful.
translation_verse: Mbifɔlbi be kemaŋkura e la bumo be eleŋ, nɛ benimu malɛ be kemaŋkura la bumo be emin fuful.

english_verse: A severe beating can knock all of the evil out of you!
translation_verse: Kenishipereso be kebri beeŋ tiŋ n lara esa ashi asheŋ lubi to.

english_verse: The Lord controls rulers, just as he determines the course of rivers.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ e naa ŋini Ewura be kagbene ekpa, fanɛ nchu be kubɔr na.

english_verse: We may think we are doing the right thing, but the Lord always knows what is in our hearts.
translation_verse: Dimɛdi be aworbi beeŋ tiŋ m par mo, ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ e nyi esa be kagbene to.

english_verse: Doing what is right and fair pleases the Lord more than an offering.
translation_verse: Kewora kusɔ nɛ k niŋi nɛ kashenteŋji bee par Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ a chɔ sarga be kelara.

english_verse: Evil people are proud and arrogant, but sin is the only crop they produce.
translation_verse: Ŋkpensheŋ nɛ kamoowu la alubi be asɔrso nna, nɛ belubiworapo bee sha amo ga.

english_verse: If you plan and work hard, you will have plenty; if you hurry to get rich, you will end up poor.
translation_verse: Kewushi eyur ŋ kre asheŋ pɔɛŋ nseŋ wora amo bee bar tɔnɔ nna, ama brembreŋ be kasheŋwora bee bar ketir nna.

english_verse: Cheating to get rich is a foolish dream and no less than suicide.
translation_verse: Kebirkɔshi be kanya maa chɛr nsaa mur, amo alɛ maa chɛr nsaa yɛr esa luwu to.

english_verse: You destroy yourself by being cruel and violent and refusing to live right.
translation_verse: Belubiworapo be kenyaŋɛto a fin basa be kemɔ e naa yɛr bumo kemur to ŋkpal b kaa maa sha kewora kusɔ nɛ k niŋi so.

english_verse: It's better to stay outside on the roof of your house than to live inside with a nagging wife.
translation_verse: Kechoŋi be awɔlto be kedese, bɔ fo nɛ eche elushapo kaa wɔ ebu to.

english_verse: Evil people want to do wrong, even to their friends.
translation_verse: Asheŋ lubi bee wora belubiworapo ebel nna, bumo alɛ maa wu bumo braana kuwɔr.

english_verse: An ignorant fool learns by seeing others punished; a sensible person learns by being instructed.
translation_verse: Alubiworapo be kasogberge bee ŋini ewulpo asheŋ nna. Enyiashempo kikɛ bee nya kenyi nna ashi kusɔ nɛ b ŋini mo to.

english_verse: God is always fair! He knows what the wicked do and will punish them.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ nɛ e niŋi na, nyi kusɔ nɛ k bee wora belubiworapoana pe. Mo alɛ e naŋ bar bumo kaseto.

english_verse: If you won't help the poor, don't expect to be heard when you cry out for help.
translation_verse: Fo baŋ kini kenu etirpo be kushu, fo alɛ gba beeŋ shu nɛ basa maaŋ tuge fo.

english_verse: A secret bribe will save you from someone's fierce anger.
translation_verse: Ashiri to be kakɛ beeŋ tiŋ n lɔŋɛ fo nɛ esa nɛ e nya agbo n wɔtɔ fo be kefɛato.

english_verse: When justice is done, good citizens are glad and crooks are terrified.
translation_verse: Asheŋ be keji nɛ amo be ekpa so bee sa belelaworapo kagbenefuli nna, nsaa shin nɛ belubiworapo malɛ bee nyɔŋkɔŋ to.

english_verse: If you stop using good sense, you will find yourself in the grave.
translation_verse: Esa nɛ e maa pin asheŋ to maa chɛr nsaa luri luwu to.

english_verse: Heavy drinkers and others who live only for pleasure will lose all they have.
translation_verse: Kɔnɔbel be kebaa sha ga nɛ kamooji nɛ kasanuu bee ta esa nna a ki etirpo.

english_verse: God's people will escape, but all who are wicked will pay the price.
translation_verse: Belelaworapo be etɔrɔ bee kilgi nna a ba belubiworapo so.

english_verse: It's better out in the desert than at home with a nagging, complaining wife.
translation_verse: Kiyi to chil be kechena bɔ ketu eche elushapo n chena.

english_verse: Be sensible and store up precious treasures— don't waste them like a fool.
translation_verse: Enyiashempo bee ji nna a ka a yili echefoso, ama ewulpo bre bee ji kusɔ nɛ e nya kikɛ nna a loge kachɛ koŋwule.

english_verse: If you try to be kind and good, you will be blessed with life and goodness and honor.
translation_verse: Esa kama nɛ e bee wora asheŋ nɛ a niŋi nsaa sha basa bee yɔ anishito nna, nsaa nya kemaŋkura nɛ kebaawɔtɔ lela.

english_verse: If you are proud and conceited, everyone will say, “You're a snob!”
translation_verse: Esa kama nɛ kamoowu nɛ ŋkpensheŋ bɔlɔ mo to, bee wora basa eyur to nna.

english_verse: If you want too much and are too lazy to work, it could be fatal.
translation_verse: Etɔlpo nɛ e maa sha kushuŋ, be asɔ shaso bee yɛr mo luwu to nna,

english_verse: The Lord despises the offerings of wicked people with evil motives.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kishi belubiworapo be sarga ga. Fɔŋfɔŋ saŋɛ nɛ b nya kumo ekpa lubi so na.

english_verse: If you tell lies in court, you are done for; only a reliable witness can do the job.
translation_verse: Efɛ be shɛda maaŋ tiŋ n yili kikɛ, kashenteŋ be shɛda nawule e naŋ yili.

english_verse: Wicked people bluff their way, but God's people think before they take a step.
translation_verse: Kenyɛn nɛ belubiworapo kɔ a wora asheŋ, ama basa nɛ baa wora asheŋ niŋiso bre bee fɛ nfɛra nna pɔɛŋ nsaa wora asheŋ.

english_verse: No matter how much you know or what plans you make, you can't defeat the Lord.
translation_verse: Dimɛdi be kanyiasheŋ kikɛ nɛ asheŋ be kepinto nɛ ŋkre kikɛ maaŋ tiŋ m pɔɔ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ so.

english_verse: Even if your army has horses ready for battle, the Lord will always win.
translation_verse: Kanaŋkama so nɛ fo bela ase; hale nɛ fo kena to be egbaŋɛ nɛ benapo wora shiriya gba, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e naŋ pɔɔ so.

english_verse: Teach your children right from wrong, and when they are grown they will still do right.
translation_verse: Ŋini kebia ekpa nɛ k daga fanɛ e bɔla so, saŋɛ na so, e kaŋ daŋ e maaŋ kpele ashi kumo so.

english_verse: The poor are ruled by the rich, and those who borrow are slaves of moneylenders.
translation_verse: Damawuraana e naa ji betirpo so kuwura, nɛ basa nɛ baa paŋ asɔ bee ki bumo nɛ b paŋ bumo kutɔ na be anya.

english_verse: Troublemakers get in trouble, and their terrible anger will get them nowhere.
translation_verse: Bekama nɛ baa duu alubi beeŋ nya amo be tɔnɔ. Bumo be agbo lubi e naŋ yɛr bumo kemur to.

english_verse: Arguments and fights will come to an end, if you chase away those who insult others.
translation_verse: Ju esa nɛ e bee wora basa eyurto n lar, nɛ kolu, nɛ katege, nɛ asheŋ wurbi e loge.

english_verse: The king is the friend of all who are sincere and speak with kindness.
translation_verse: Fo baa sha asheŋ niŋiso nsaa kɔ kamalga belbelso, kumo ere feeŋ tiŋ n ji ewura kenekpa.

english_verse: The Lord watches over everyone who shows good sense, but he frustrates the plans of deceitful liars.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be anishi yuu beshenteŋjipo kikɛ so nna, ama e maa sa befɛpo bre be malga kashuli.

english_verse: Don't be so lazy that you say, “If I go to work, a lion will eat me!”
translation_verse: Etɔlpo e naa kaŋɛ fanɛ buluŋ wɔ kowushina, amoso e maaŋ lar kowu nɛ buluŋ na e pɛ mo.

english_verse: The words of a bad woman are like a deep pit; if you make the Lord angry, you will fall right in.
translation_verse: Eche nɛ e bee lar mo kul kaman be mmalga du fanɛ kemaŋ chiŋgeliŋ nna, nɛ bumo nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be agbo wɔ so na bee tɔr kumo to.

english_verse: All children are foolish, but firm correction will make them change.
translation_verse: Kasogberge be kuchuchɔ e naa ju kawulisheŋ nɛ k bɔlɔ kebia to.

english_verse: Cheat the poor to make profit or give gifts to the rich— either way you lose. Thirty Wise Sayings
translation_verse: Basa nɛ baa puni betirpo a dii dama na, nɛ bumo nɛ baa kɛ damawuraana asɔ na, beeŋ ki betirpo. Benyiashempo be keŋini

english_verse: Here are some sayings of people with wisdom, so listen carefully as I teach.
translation_verse: Kaŋ kusoe n nu benyiashempo be mmalga ere, nsaa ta bumo be keŋini a wɔtɔ kagbene to.

english_verse: You will be glad that you know these sayings and can recite them.
translation_verse: Nɛ fee nyiŋi amo nsaa kute amo to, fo kagbene beeŋ fuli fo.

english_verse: I am teaching them today, so that you may trust the Lord.
translation_verse: Mee ŋini fo kesheŋ ere kabre nna, saŋɛ na so feeŋ ta fo yirda n wɔtɔ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na to.

english_verse: I have written thirty sayings filled with sound advice.
translation_verse: M maŋ sibɛ mmalgamu adesa n sa fo, nɛ a baa ŋini fo asheŋ nsaa sa fo lakal,

english_verse: You can trust them completely to give you the right words for those in charge of you. –
translation_verse: a shin nɛ fo baa tiŋ a pin asheŋ to, m ba kaa kute kusɔ nɛ b shuŋi fo fanɛ fo ya wora na be kashenteŋ a? Sososo

english_verse: The Lord is their defender, and what you do to them, he will do to you. –
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e naŋ chɛ bumo to, nseŋ tɔrɔ bekama nɛ b tɔrɔ bumo na n tal to. Kenyɔsopo

english_verse: Don't make friends with anyone who has a bad temper.
translation_verse: Saa maa ji basa nɛ baa nya agbo manaŋ manaŋ kenekpa,

english_verse: You might turn out like them and get caught in a trap. –
translation_verse: nɛ mannɛ aloŋ fo alɛ gba beeŋ ki kananɛ b du na nsaa maŋ naŋ tiŋ n chɛrga. Kesasopo

english_verse: Don't guarantee to pay someone else's debt.
translation_verse: Sa maa sɔ beko be akɔ a deŋi fo kumu,

english_verse: Don't move a boundary marker set up by your ancestors. –
translation_verse: Sa maa lɔŋɛ fo nɛ basa be egbaŋ to be kedulgijembu dra nɛ fo nananyɛnana yuu na a yuu. Kenusopo

english_verse: If you do your job well, you will work for a ruler and never be a slave.
translation_verse: Nɛ fo baa shuŋ fo kushuŋ nɛnɛ, bewura nɛ feeŋ baa shuŋ a sa mannɛ bebɔlpo.

english_verse: Don't accept an invitation to eat a selfish person's food, no matter how good it is.
translation_verse: Sa maa tu Miiriworaana a ji, ŋko a yɛlga mbe ajibi lela.

english_verse: When you are invited to eat with a king, use your best manners.
translation_verse: Ewura baŋ tre fo fanɛ fo ba tu mo n ji, fo koli fo kumu nɛnɛ.

english_verse: Don't go and stuff yourself! That would be just the same as cutting your throat.
translation_verse: Nɛ fee ji ga fo ku fo epun so,

english_verse: Don't be greedy for all of that fancy food! It may not be so tasty. –
translation_verse: nsaa maa fin fanɛ fo ji kusɔ nɛ k wɔ ndoŋ kikɛ. Mannɛ ajibi na kikɛ e deŋ fo. Keshunusopo

english_verse: People like that take note of how much you eat. They say, “Take all you want!” But they don't mean it.
translation_verse: E beeŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ fo ji kananɛ fee sha, ama kumo be loŋ maŋ shi mbe kagbene to.

english_verse: Give up trying so hard to get rich.
translation_verse: Sa maa mɔ fo kumu a fin kedii dama. Ba nyi fo eleŋ be ekar.

english_verse: Your money flies away before you know it, just like an eagle suddenly taking off. –
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so fo amansherbi beeŋ tiŋ n loge epul to, fanɛ kananɛ kusore beeŋ yili epul to n firgi n choŋ na. Keburwasopo

english_verse: Each bite will come back up, and all your kind words will be wasted. –
translation_verse: Feeŋ kwiɛ ajibi nɛ fo ji na kikɛ, nɛ kechɔrɔ nɛ fo chɔrɔ mo na e ki jiga. Kekpanusopo

english_verse: Don't talk to fools— they will make fun of you. –
translation_verse: Sa maŋ jija saŋɛ a ŋini ewulpo asheŋ. E maaŋ ta fo kanyiasheŋ be mmalga na n shuŋ. Kudusopo

english_verse: Don't move a boundary marker or take the land that belongs to orphans.
translation_verse: Sa maa lɔŋɛ egbaŋ to be kedulgijembu dra a yili, ŋko a dɔ a luri amunibi be kasawule to.

english_verse: Listen to me, my children! Be wise and have enough sense to follow the right path.
translation_verse: M pibi, nu nfe, ta kanyiasheŋ a bɛ ekpa niŋiso so.

english_verse: It will make you feel drowsy, and you will end up poor with only rags to wear. –
translation_verse: Ketir beeŋ pɛ besanuupo nɛ bejibishapo, baaŋ baa dese a di nna, nsaa buu asɔ farbi. Kuduashesopo

english_verse: Pay attention to your father, and don't neglect your mother when she grows old.
translation_verse: Baa nu fo tuto be mmalga, mo e kurge fo. Sa maŋ kplaŋ fo nio so ashi mbe mbel to.

english_verse: Invest in truth and wisdom, discipline and good sense, and don't part with them.
translation_verse: Jija amansherbi ŋ koya kashenteŋji nɛ kanyiasheŋ nɛ kamootiŋ. Sa maŋ yige amo n lɛ kikɛ.

english_verse: My son, pay close attention, and gladly follow my example.
translation_verse: M pibi baa kaŋ kusoe a nu ma mmalga, nsaa wora ma asheŋ woraso.

english_verse: they are waiting to attack you like a gang of robbers with victim after victim. –
translation_verse: Baa jo fo nna fanɛ eyu na, nɛ b da fo n lɛ alubiworapoana to. Kuduaburwasopo

english_verse: Who is always in trouble? Who argues and fights? Who has cuts and bruises? Whose eyes are red?
translation_verse: Wanɛ e naa luri asheŋ to saŋkama? Wanɛ e naa kɔ kolu saŋkama? Wanɛ e naa tɔr a margaso? Wanɛ be anishi e pere kpaw ŋkpal kasanuu so?

english_verse: Everyone who stays up late, having just one more drink.
translation_verse: Basa nɛ baa nuu nsa n ya kaa fo kiidiso na.

english_verse: Don't even look at that colorful stuff bubbling up in the glass! It goes down so easily,
translation_verse: Sa maŋ keni kananɛ nsa pere nsaa walɛ, ŋko a kpa edɛ glashi to, ŋko a wushi ebɔl to so.

english_verse: You will see weird things, and your mind will play tricks on you.
translation_verse: Nsa beeŋ tiŋ n shin nɛ fo anishi e baa kurge, nɛ fo nfɛra e baa wul fo to.

english_verse: You will feel tossed about like someone trying to sleep on a ship in a storm.
translation_verse: A bee wora fo fanɛ fo ka wɔ nchu so be kuloŋ to ashi teku so nna, nɛ afu bee ber fo a yɔ a ba na.

english_verse: You will be bruised all over, without even remembering how it all happened. And you will lie awake asking, “When will morning come, so I can drink some more?”
translation_verse: Feeŋ pira nɛ fo maŋ pin kananɛ fo wora m pira. Feeŋ baa dese a fin kananɛ feeŋ koso ŋ gben, ama nsaa fin kananɛ kare beeŋ cha nɛ fo naŋ nya nsa n nu.

english_verse: Don't let evil people worry you or make you jealous.
translation_verse: Sa maŋ shin nɛ belubiworapo be asheŋ e baa tir fo ŋko a besa fo.

english_verse: Don't be jealous of crooks or want to be their friends.
translation_verse: Sa maa besa belubiworapo eyur, ŋko a yɛlga kebaa tu bumo a wora asheŋ.

english_verse: All they think about and talk about is violence and cruelty. –
translation_verse: Asheŋ lubi nawule be asheŋ nɛ baa fɛ saŋkama. Bumo be mmalga kikɛ la kananɛ baaŋ wora kulubi nna. Adunyɔsopo

english_verse: They will soon be gone like the flame of a lamp that burns out. –
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so alubiworapo maŋ kɔ echefoso be tama. Mo alɛ beeŋ choŋ fanɛ kananɛ fitila beeŋ duŋ na. Adesa

english_verse: let good sense fill the rooms with priceless treasures. –
translation_verse: Kenyi malɛ e naa shin nɛ asɔ lela nɛ yawu kpakpaso be asɔ bee bɔlɔ laŋ. Adunyɔ nɛ kako

english_verse: My children, you must respect the Lord and the king, and you must not make friends with anyone who rebels against either of them.
translation_verse: M pibi, baa ŋana Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nsaa ŋana bewura gba, sa maa tu amukpakpaso wuraana a wora asheŋ.

english_verse: Battles are won by listening to advice and making a lot of plans. –
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so kasotoji lela nɛ kebela ase nɛnɛ e naa shin nɛ baa kɔ kena a pɔɔ so. Adunyɔ nɛ anyɔ

english_verse: Who knows what sudden disaster the Lord or a ruler might bring? More Sayings That Make Good Sense
translation_verse: Wanɛ e nyi tɔrɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ŋko ewura beeŋ sa bumo? Aŋasa ko gba nde

english_verse: Wisdom is too much for fools! Their advice is no good. –
translation_verse: Ewulpo maaŋ tiŋ m pin kanyiasheŋ be mmalga to. B baa malga kenishipere be mmalga ewulpo maŋ kɔ shɛŋ a kaŋɛ. Adunyɔ nɛ asa

english_verse: Here are some more sayings that make good sense: When you judge, you must be fair.
translation_verse: Kanyiasheŋ be mmalga ko gba nde: A maŋ daga demujipo ka bee kpɛa to.

english_verse: No one but troublemakers think up trouble.
translation_verse: Esa nɛ e bee kre alubisheŋ nɛ baa tre alubiworapo.

english_verse: Everyone hates senseless fools who think up ways to sin. –
translation_verse: Ewulpo be nfɛra fɛso kikɛ maŋ walɛ. Basa kishi ewulpo nɛ e bee wora basa eyur to ga. Adunyɔ nɛ ana

english_verse: If you let the guilty go free, people of all nations will hate and curse you.
translation_verse: Fo baŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ esa nɛ e wora n jija e kɔ kashenteŋ, basa beeŋ sho fo kɔnɔ, nɛ efuli pɔtɛ so ebi gba e kishi fo.

english_verse: Don't give up and be helpless in times of trouble. –
translation_verse: Kesɔ kapɔshi be tɔrɔ be jemanɛ bee shin nɛ esa be eleŋ bee kuso nna. Adunyɔ nɛ anu

english_verse: But if you punish the guilty, things will go well for you, and you will prosper.
translation_verse: Ama demujipo nɛ e bee gberge belubiworapo kusoe bre beeŋ nya nɛfa nna nɛ asheŋ e baa nite nɛnɛ a sa mo.

english_verse: Don't fail to rescue those who are doomed to die.
translation_verse: Sɔ bumo nɛ b gberge a yɔ nɛ b ya mɔ kenyanyaŋɛso na n yige.

english_verse: Don't say, “I didn't know it!” God can read your mind. He watches each of us and knows our thoughts. And God will pay us back for what we do. –
translation_verse: Nɛ fo kaŋɛ fanɛ k maŋ la fo asheŋ, Ebɔrɛ nɛ e nyi nfɛra nɛ aworbi na bre nyi kusɔ so so nɛ fee wora kusɔ kama. Mo alɛ e naŋ ka fo kusɔ kama nɛ fo wora be kukɔ. Adunyɔ nɛ ashe

english_verse: Giving an honest answer is a sign of true friendship.
translation_verse: Kashenteŋ be atuwebi e la kashenteŋ be keteri be tɔɔnɛ.

english_verse: Honey is good for you, my children, and it tastes sweet.
translation_verse: M pibi, baa ji mushoŋ ŋkpal manɛ so mushoŋ walɛ. Kananɛ mushoŋ wɔ ebel kudonduloŋ so na,

english_verse: Wisdom is like honey for your life— if you find it, your future is bright. –
translation_verse: loŋ nɛ kanyiasheŋ gba walɛ n sa fo kiyoyu. Fo baŋ nya kumo fo alɛ nya echefoso be tama nɛ k maaŋ loge kikɛ. Adunyɔ nɛ ashunu

english_verse: Get your fields ready and plant your crops before starting a home.
translation_verse: Nase kudɔ n du fo adɔjibi pɔɛŋ nsaa pɔr kowu.

english_verse: Don't be a cruel person who attacks good people and hurts their families.
translation_verse: Sa maa kɔ kumu kpakpaso fanɛ belubiworapo nɛ baa yuri basa lela be asɔ, ŋko a suge bumo be nwu na.

english_verse: Even if good people fall seven times, they will get back up. But when trouble strikes the wicked, that's the end of them. –
translation_verse: Basa niŋiso bee tɔr alɛ damta nsaa koso ama tɔrɔ baŋ ba alubiworapo bre so nɛ e tɔr kela koŋwule gba e maaŋ naŋ tiŋ n niŋi to kikɛ. Adunyɔ nɛ aburwa

english_verse: Don't accuse anyone who isn't guilty. Don't ever tell a lie
translation_verse: Sa maŋ kaŋ ji efɛ be shɛda ŋ gbiti fo barkasa ŋko ŋ ku efɛ ŋ deŋi mo.

english_verse: Don't be happy to see your enemies trip and fall down.
translation_verse: Sa maŋ shin nɛ fo doŋ be tɔrɔ e baa fuli fo kagbene. Fo doŋ baŋ fiti n tɔr, sa maa mushe.

english_verse: The Lord will find out and be unhappy. Then he will stop being angry with them. –
translation_verse: Mannɛ a loŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ beeŋ wu kumo be loŋ, nseŋ kilgi mbe tɔrɔ na m ba fo so. Adunyɔ nɛ akpanu

english_verse: or say to someone, “I'll get even with you!”
translation_verse: Sa maŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ: “Meeŋ wora mo n tal to.”

english_verse: I once walked by the field and the vineyard of a lazy fool.
translation_verse: Ŋ ka bɔla ewulpo tɔlpo be ndɔ nɛ mbe ndibi sɔrso be dɔkar,

english_verse: Thorns and weeds were everywhere, and the stone wall had fallen down.
translation_verse: nɛ afitiri nɛ ewi sɔ kudɔ na kikɛ, nɛ ajembu be egbal nɛ e pɔr ŋ kulti kumo na kikɛ tɔr.

english_verse: Sleep a little. Doze a little. Fold your hands and twiddle your thumbs.
translation_verse: Edi gbrɛbi, ewushi gbrɛbi nɛ enɔ be kefar n chena gbrɛbi,

english_verse: Suddenly poverty hits you and everything is gone!
translation_verse: nɛ ketir ba fo so fanɛ eyu na, nɛ asheŋ kikɛ e ki fo so kpakpa.

english_verse: Here are some more of Solomon's proverbs. They were copied by the officials of King Hezekiah of Judah.
translation_verse: Ewura Sɔlɔmɔn be aŋasa nɛ Ewura Hɛzekaya be ekrachi sibɛ na nde.

english_verse: Who can fully understand the thoughts of a ruler? They reach beyond the sky and go deep in the earth.
translation_verse: Wanɛ e naa tiŋ a pin ewura be nfɛra? Ewura be nfɛra du chiŋgeliŋ nna fanɛ kasawule be nchiŋ ŋko awɔlpa be kufɔ na.

english_verse: Silver must be purified before it can be used to make something of value.
translation_verse: Baa lara gbiti be eyurpi nna pɔɛŋ nsaa ta kumo a lɔŋɛ asɔ lela.

english_verse: Evil people must be removed before anyone can rule with justice.
translation_verse: Lara besoetojipo lubi ashi ewura kutɔ nɛ e ji kuwura ekpa niŋiso so.

english_verse: Don't try to seem important in the court of a ruler.
translation_verse: Sa maa maŋ fo kumu so ashi ewura be anishito, ŋko a ta fo kumu a yili basagboŋ be eyilikpa.

english_verse: It's better for the ruler to give you a high position than for you to be embarrassed in front of royal officials. Be sure you are right
translation_verse: Ewura gbagba ka ta fo n yili esagboŋ be eyilikpa bɔ fo gbagba ka ta fo kumu n yili ndoŋ nɛ e ŋaba fo.

english_verse: before you sue someone, or you might lose your case and be embarrassed.
translation_verse: Sa maa kuse a ta asheŋ a yɔ demujikpa. Mannɛ aloŋ b baŋ ji m bri fo anishinyɔr beeŋ pɛ fo.

english_verse: When you and someone else can't get along, don't gossip about it.
translation_verse: Nɛ fo nɛ fo barkasa bee ji emɔrɔ, fo sa maa lara mbe ashiri.

english_verse: Others will find out, and your reputation will then be ruined.
translation_verse: Mannɛ aloŋ basa beeŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ fo maŋ kɔ ashiri nsaa maŋ naa yirda fo.

english_verse: The right word at the right time is like precious gold set in silver.
translation_verse: Kemalga kamalga nɛ k daga saŋɛ nɛ k daga du nna fanɛ b ka ta shuwa m mata gbiti so na.

english_verse: Listening to good advice is worth much more than jewelry made of gold.
translation_verse: Kenu enyiashempo be kasotoji du fanɛ shuwa be akonde, ŋko abitasɔ nna.

english_verse: A messenger you can trust is just as refreshing as cool water in summer.
translation_verse: Kabɔ nɛ e bee ji kashenteŋ du fanɛ kebleŋ to be nchu wushiso nna.

english_verse: Broken promises are worse than rain clouds that don't bring rain.
translation_verse: Esa nɛ e bee nase kɔnɔ nsaa maa tia kumo du fanɛ kuwɔlpa nɛ k maa bar bɔrɛ nna.

english_verse: Don't visit friends too often, or they will get tired of it and start hating you.
translation_verse: Sa maa tir fo kurgepo to ga, mannɛ aloŋ fo asheŋ beeŋ fi mo nɛ e kishi fo.

english_verse: Telling lies about friends is like attacking them with clubs and swords and sharp arrows.
translation_verse: Keji efɛ be shɛda ŋ gbiti esa du nna fanɛ fo ka da mo kasaŋɛ ŋko ketanyembi ŋko ŋ ŋe mo kedibi nna.

english_verse: A friend you can't trust in times of trouble is like having a toothache or a sore foot.
translation_verse: Keta yirda n deŋi efɛpo so ashi awurfoŋ be saŋɛ du fanɛ fo ka na keya koŋwule so ŋko fo kenyi ka bee besa fo nna.

english_verse: If your enemies are hungry, give them something to eat. And if they are thirsty, give them something to drink.
translation_verse: Nɛ akoŋ kɔ fo doŋ fo sa mo ajibi nɛ e ji, nɛ achukoŋ kɔ mo fo sa mo nchu nɛ e nuu.

english_verse: This will be the same as piling burning coals on their heads. And the Lord will reward you.
translation_verse: Nɛ fo wora loŋ, kumo ere kedɛmurmur nɛ fo muu n deŋi mbe kumu so na. Ebɔrɛ malɛ beeŋ nɛfa fo.

english_verse: As surely as rain blows in from the north, anger is caused by cruel words.
translation_verse: Kananɛ kebɔrɛfito be afu bee bar bɔrɛ na, aloŋ nɛ ŋkuli bee bar agbo.

english_verse: It's better to stay outside on the roof of your house than to live inside with a nagging wife.
translation_verse: Kedese kuchoŋi be awɔlto bɔ ketu eche elushapo a wɔ ebu to.

english_verse: Good news from far away refreshes like cold water when you are thirsty.
translation_verse: Baru lela nɛ k shi kufɔ bee wushi kagbene nna, fanɛ kananɛ nchu wushiso bee wushi eyur na.

english_verse: When a good person gives in to the wicked, it's like dumping garbage in a stream of clear water.
translation_verse: Esa nɛ e bee wora asheŋ niŋiso baŋ yige mbe kumu to n sa esa lubi, e bee ki fanɛ nchu nɛ a fɔnɔto ŋko eboŋ nɛ b bɔ kumo kesa nna.

english_verse: Expecting snow in summer and rain in the dry season makes more sense than honoring a fool.
translation_verse: Ketarso be bɔrɛ kɔ tɔnɔ a chɔ kesa ewulpo bunyaŋ.

english_verse: A curse you don't deserve will take wings and fly away like a sparrow or a swallow.
translation_verse: Kɔnɔsho nɛ k maŋ bɛ ekpa so maaŋ tiŋ m pɛ esa. K du nna fanɛ mbuibi ka firgi a choŋ na.

english_verse: Horses and donkeys must be beaten and bridled— and so must fools.
translation_verse: Kananɛ baa ta kebarga nɛ chembi a keta gbaŋɛ nɛ kurma a shuŋ na, aloŋ nɛ ewulpo daga kuchuchɔ.

english_verse: Don't make a fool of yourself by answering a fool.
translation_verse: Fo baa tuge ewulpo to, baaŋ tre fo alɛ gba ewulpo.

english_verse: But if you answer any fools, show how foolish they are, so they won't feel smart.
translation_verse: Shin nɛ ewulpo e pin mbe kawulisheŋ, nɛ mannɛ aloŋ e beeŋ baa fɛ fanɛ e nyi asheŋ nna.

english_verse: Sending a message by a fool is like chopping off your foot just to spite yourself.
translation_verse: Keta kubɔya ŋ shuŋi ewulpo du nna fanɛ fo ka ku fo gbagba be aya so ŋko fo ka ji kɔrtɔ nna.

english_verse: A fool with words of wisdom is like an athlete with legs that can't move.
translation_verse: Ewulpo be keŋasa, du nna fanɛ bobi be aya na.

english_verse: Are you going to honor a fool? Why not shoot a slingshot with the rock tied tight?
translation_verse: Ewulpo be kesa bunyaŋ du nna fanɛ fo ka kre kejembu n wɔtɔ katebabu to nɛ fo to na.

english_verse: A thornbush waved around in the hand of a drunkard is no worse than a proverb in the mouth of a fool.
translation_verse: Ewulpo be keŋasa du nna fanɛ ewi ashi nsanuupo be enɔ to.

english_verse: It's no smarter to shoot arrows at every passerby than it is to hire a bunch of worthless nobodies.
translation_verse: Ewulpo nɛ e na chamcham a choŋ be kebir paa du nna fanɛ ekpampo ka bee to asɔbɔya a lɛ jijiga na.

english_verse: Dogs return to eat their vomit, just as fools repeat their foolishness.
translation_verse: Kananɛ jɔnɔ bee gbu nsaa bɛta a ji amo na, aloŋ nɛ bewulpo bee lɔŋɛ a tal bumo be kawulisheŋ to.

english_verse: There is more hope for a fool than for someone who says, “I'm really smart!”
translation_verse: Ewulpo bɔ esa nɛ e bee tre mbe kumu enyiashempo, mo alɛ nseŋ wuli.

english_verse: Don't be lazy and keep saying, “There's a lion outside!”
translation_verse: Etɔlpo e naa kaŋɛ fanɛ buluŋ wɔ ekpa to so e maaŋ yɔ ndɔ to.

english_verse: A door turns on its hinges, but a lazy person just turns over in bed.
translation_verse: Kananɛ kukuloŋ yil epul to a yɔ a ba na, aloŋ nɛ etɔlpo bee dese gedo so a kilgi a laŋɛ a dese.

english_verse: Some of us are so lazy that we won't lift a hand to feed ourselves.
translation_verse: Lɔma be keku m min gba du betɔlpo ko so gba kpakpa nna.

english_verse: A lazy person says, “I am smarter than everyone else.”
translation_verse: Etɔlpo kikɛ bee fɛ nna fanɛ e nyi asheŋ a chɔ basa damta.

english_verse: It's better to take hold of a mad dog by the ears than to take part in someone else's argument.
translation_verse: Keta fo kɔnɔ n wɔtɔ kolu nɛ k maŋ la feya to, du nna fanɛ fo ka bee gberge jɔnɔ nɛ e maŋ nyi fo be kusoe na.

english_verse: than to cheat someone and say, “I was only fooling!”
translation_verse: Kefule esa nseŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ fee pel mo nna, du nna fanɛ ebompo ka bee to atanyembi kpalakpala na.

english_verse: Where there is no fuel a fire goes out; where there is no gossip arguments come to an end.
translation_verse: Ndibi baa maŋ wɔ edɛ to edɛ na bee duŋ nna, aloŋ nɛ ŋkuli baa maŋ wɔtɔ kolu bee ku.

english_verse: Troublemakers start trouble, just as sparks and fuel start a fire.
translation_verse: Kananɛ ndibi nɛ ajanwulɛ bee shin nɛ edɛ bee nyɛrga na, aloŋ nɛ elushapo bee keta kolu to a chɛr.

english_verse: There is nothing so delicious as the taste of gossip! It melts in your mouth.
translation_verse: Ŋkuli wɔ ebel ga nɛ basa bee sha kumo.

english_verse: Hiding hateful thoughts behind smooth talk is like coating a clay pot with a cheap glaze.
translation_verse: Kamalga belbelso nɛ nfɛra lubi wɔ kumo be kaman du nna fanɛ b ka ta shuwa n fɛfa ebɔ be kusɔ so nɛ k bee nyɛkpɛ na.

english_verse: The pleasant talk of an enemy hides more evil plans
translation_verse: Esa lubi be kamalga belbelso so, b maa pin fanɛ e kɔ nfɛra lubi.

english_verse: than can be counted— so don't believe a word!
translation_verse: Kanaŋ kamaso nɛ esa lubi be kamalga wɔ ebel, sa maŋ kaŋ yirda mo.

english_verse: If you dig a pit, you will fall in; if you start a stone rolling, it will roll back on you.
translation_verse: Fo baa kur fo barkasa be kemaŋ, fo gbagba e naŋ kilgi n tɔr kumo to. Fo baa gbelti kejembu nɛ fo bɛa fo barkasa, k beeŋ kilgi m bɛa fo gbagba.

english_verse: Watch out for anyone who tells lies and flatters— they are out to get you.
translation_verse: Esa nɛ fo kishi nɛ fee ku efɛ a deŋi. Kefur esa kɔnɔ to nɛ k maŋ shi kagbene to du fanɛ fo ka mɔ mo ŋgblaŋ to nna.

english_verse: Don't brag about tomorrow! Each day brings its own surprises.
translation_verse: Sa maa puchi echefoso, ŋkpal manɛ so fo maŋ nyi kananɛ asheŋ beeŋ ba du echefo.

english_verse: Don't brag about yourself— let others praise you.
translation_verse: Shin nɛ basa pɔtɛ e baa kpaŋ fo, fo gbagba e sa maa kpaŋ fo kumu.

english_verse: Stones and sand are heavy, but trouble caused by a fool is a much heavier load.
translation_verse: Ewulpo be kewɔtɔ esa agbo to wɔgbɛ a chɔ e ka sulɔ ajembu nɛ leele.

english_verse: An angry person is dangerous, but a jealous person is even worse.
translation_verse: Esa nɛ e bee nya agbo manaŋ manaŋ lubi a chɔ, esa nɛ e bee kɔ kukɔrkɔ lubi.

english_verse: A truly good friend will openly correct you.
translation_verse: Keji esa kashenteŋ kpakpaso bɔ kebaa sha mo ŋgblaŋto.

english_verse: You can trust a friend who corrects you, but kisses from an enemy are nothing but lies.
translation_verse: Eteri lela be kefiɛso bɔ edoŋ ka lela fo so.

english_verse: If you have had enough to eat, honey doesn't taste good, but if you are really hungry, you will eat anything.
translation_verse: Fo baŋ ji m moɛ, mushoŋ gba maŋ naa wora fo keji, ama nɛ akoŋ kɔ fo feeŋ ji ajibi kama.

english_verse: When you are far from home, you feel like a bird without a nest.
translation_verse: Esa baŋ lar laŋ to, e du nna fanɛ kabuibi ka lar kesha to na.

english_verse: The sweet smell of incense can make you feel good, but true friendship is better still.
translation_verse: Tulale nɛ efɛa belbelso be duwu bee sa kagbenefuli nna, ama a maŋ fo eteri lela be kasotoji so.

english_verse: Don't desert an old friend of your family or visit your relatives when you are in trouble. A friend nearby is better than relatives far away.
translation_verse: Sa maŋ kplaŋ fo teri ŋko fo tuto mo teri so. Fo alɛ e sa maŋ yɔ fo niopibi nɛ e wɔ kufɔ kutɔ n ya kaa fin kechɛto tɔrɔ be saŋɛ. Eteri nɛ e taga fo to beeŋ tiŋ n chɛ fo to a chɔ fo niopibi nɛ e wɔ kufɔ.

english_verse: My child, show good sense! Then I will be happy and able to answer anyone who criticizes me.
translation_verse: M pibi ba kɔ kanyiasheŋ, nɛ kumo be loŋ e sa ma kagbenefuli nɛ n nya kɔnɔ n tuge esa kama nɛ e bee malga a gbiti ma to.

english_verse: Be cautious and hide when you see danger— don't be stupid and walk right into trouble.
translation_verse: Enyiashempo bee gelge asheŋ nna, ama esa nɛ e maa pin asheŋ to manaŋ manaŋ bre bee suse amo to nna.

english_verse: You deserve to lose your coat if you loan it to someone to guarantee payment for the debt of a stranger.
translation_verse: Esa baŋ ta mbe kusɔbuuso n nase tarma n ji kukɔ n sa efɔ, nɛ efɔ na baŋ maŋ tiŋ ŋ ka kukɔ na fo sɔ amodoŋwura be kusɔbuuso na n tal to.

english_verse: A loud greeting early in the morning is the same as a curse.
translation_verse: Awɔr be kecha n chɔrɔ esa chipurdidi beeŋ tiŋ a la tɔrɔ n sa esa nɛ fee chɔrɔ na ekpa ko so.

english_verse: The steady dripping of rain and the nagging of a wife are one and the same.
translation_verse: Eche elushapo du fanɛ bɔrɛfurbi nɛ k maa teŋ manaŋ nna.

english_verse: It's easier to catch the wind or hold olive oil in your hand than to stop a nagging wife.
translation_verse: Keshin nɛ e yige kolu du fanɛ kekuŋ afu ekpa nna, ŋko keta enɔ n jɔ ŋkuchu.

english_verse: Just as iron sharpens iron, friends sharpen the minds of each other.
translation_verse: Kananɛ baa ta kebɛlso a yee kebɛlso na, aloŋ nɛ beteri bee chɛrga abar be nfɛra.

english_verse: Take care of a tree, and you will eat its fruit; look after your master, and you will be praised.
translation_verse: Fo baŋ keni kedibisɔrso so nɛnɛ feeŋ ji kumo be asɔrso. Fo baŋ keta fo nyɛnpe nɛnɛ feeŋ baa nya kechɔrɔ saŋkama.

english_verse: You see your face in a mirror and your thoughts in the minds of others.
translation_verse: Kananɛ fee keni nchu kleŋklembi to a wu fo kumu na, aloŋ nɛ fo kagbene bee ŋini esa nɛ e la fo kashenteŋto.

english_verse: Death and the grave are never satisfied, and neither are humans.
translation_verse: Kananɛ luwu nɛ nchaŋ maa moɛ na, aloŋ nɛ dimɛdi maa nya asɔ a moɛ.

english_verse: Gold and silver are tested in a red-hot furnace, but we are tested by praise.
translation_verse: Kananɛ baa ta edɛ a keni a pin shuwa nɛ gbiti be kela na, aloŋ nɛ esa be kefur gba beeŋ tiŋ n shin nɛ fo pin mbe da.

english_verse: No matter how hard you beat a fool, you can't pound out the foolishness.
translation_verse: Kebri maaŋ tiŋ n ju kawuli ashi esa to.

english_verse: You should take good care of your sheep and goats,
translation_verse: Baa keni fo mbolpɔ nɛ mboe so nɛnɛ,

english_verse: because wealth and honor don't last forever.
translation_verse: ŋkpal manɛ so kanya nɛ kemaŋkura maaŋ baa wɔtɔ mbaanaayɔ.
