english_verse: After the hay is cut and the new growth appears and the harvest is over,
translation_verse: Fo baa kuya afitiri a sa fo asɔbɔya nɛ a bee laŋɛ a purge nɛnɛ,

english_verse: you can sell lambs and goats to buy clothes and land.
translation_verse: feeŋ nya mbɔlpo nɛ mboe n fa n tɔ asɔbuuso nɛ kasawule.

english_verse: From the milk of the goats, you can make enough cheese to feed your family and all your servants.
translation_verse: Fo alɛ nɛ fo mbia nɛ fo nyɛrbi beeŋ naŋ nya kenyipochu damta n nuu.

english_verse: Wicked people run away when no one chases them, but those who live right are as brave as lions.
translation_verse: Basa lubi bee shile nna nsaa gbɛ a keni fanɛ esa ko ka bee ju bumo na, ama basa nɛ baa wora asheŋ niŋiso bre bee nite kenyɛnso nna fanɛ buluŋ na.

english_verse: In time of civil war there are many leaders, but a sensible leader restores law and order.
translation_verse: Efuli be basa baa kɔ kumu kpakpaso, baa chɛrga bejuŋkparpo manaŋ manaŋ nna. Ama ejuŋkparpo nyiashempo bre bee ji kuwura nna a chɛr.

english_verse: When someone poor takes over and mistreats the poor, it's like a heavy rain destroying the crops.
translation_verse: Ejuŋkparpo nɛ e bee mɛaŋ betirpo, du nna fanɛ bɔrɛgboŋ nɛ k bee jija adɔjibi na.

english_verse: Criminals don't know what justice means, but all who respect the Lord understand it completely.
translation_verse: Belubiworapo maŋ nyi kananɛ baa wora asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so, mannɛ aloŋ nɛ bumo nɛ baa ŋana Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ bre du.

english_verse: It's better to be poor and live right, than to be rich and dishonest.
translation_verse: Kebaa la etirpo nsaa ji kashenteŋ bɔ kebaa la damawura fɛpo.

english_verse: It makes good sense to obey the Law of God, but you disgrace your parents if you make friends with worthless nobodies.
translation_verse: Enyiashempo e naa bɛ mbra so. Esa nɛ e bee ta basa nɛ b maa fɛ nfɛra pɔɛŋ nsaa wora asheŋ keteri, bee wɔtɔ mo tuto anishinyɔr to nna.

english_verse: If you make money by charging high interest rates, you will lose it all to someone who cares for the poor.
translation_verse: Esa kama nɛ e bee wɔtɔ basa nɛ b paŋ mo amansherbi nchu ga, be kapetɛ beeŋ yɔ esa nɛ e bee wu betirpo kuwɔr kutɔ.

english_verse: God cannot stand the prayers of anyone who disobeys his Law.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ maa nu esa nɛ e maa bɛ mbra so be kabɔrɛkule.

english_verse: By leading good people to sin, you dig a pit for yourself, but all who live right will have a bright future.
translation_verse: Esa kama nɛ e bee ŋin basa nɛ baa wora asheŋ nɛ a niŋi a wɔtɔ alubi to, beeŋ tɔr kejigbelɛ nɛ mo gbagba sho to, ama esa nɛ e maŋ kɔ alubi beeŋ ji kapetɛ lela.

english_verse: The rich think highly of themselves, but anyone poor and sensible sees right through them.
translation_verse: Damawuraana bee fɛ nna fanɛ b nyi asheŋ, ama etirpo nɛ e bee pin asheŋ to beeŋ tiŋ m pin fanɛ mannɛ damawuraana kikɛ e nyi asheŋ.

english_verse: When an honest person wins, it's time to celebrate; when crooks are in control, it's best to hide.
translation_verse: Esa lela baŋ ji kuwura basa bee ji eyur nna, ama esa lubi bre baŋ ji kuwura basa bee shile nna a ŋana.

english_verse: If you don't confess your sins, you will be a failure. But God will be merciful if you confess your sins and give them up.
translation_verse: Esa kama nɛ e bee ta mbe alubi a ŋana maaŋ yɔ anishito kikɛ, ama Ebɔrɛ beeŋ wu esa nɛ e bee bugi to a kaŋɛ mbe alubi nsaa tuba a lar amo to bre kuwɔr.

english_verse: The Lord blesses everyone who is afraid to do evil, but if you are cruel, you will end up in trouble.
translation_verse: Esa kama nɛ e bee ŋana Ebɔrɛ bee nya nɛfa nna, ama esa kama nɛ e kɔ kagbene kpakpaso bre bee luri asheŋ to nna.

english_verse: A ruler who mistreats the poor is like a roaring lion or a bear hunting for food.
translation_verse: Ewura lubi nɛ e bee tɔrɔ betirpo du nna fanɛ buluŋ nɛ e bee ponte to na, ŋko shishiri nɛ akoŋ kɔ.

english_verse: A heartless leader is a fool, but anyone who refuses to get rich by cheating others will live a long time.
translation_verse: Ewura nɛ e bee mɛaŋ mbe basa maa ji asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so, ama emo nɛ e maa sha kapuni bre beeŋ ji efute tenteŋ.

english_verse: Don't give help to murderers! Make them stay on the run for as long as they live.
translation_verse: Esa kama nɛ e mɔ esa, be nfɛra beeŋ baa ji a bri mo hale nɛ e ya wu. Mo alɛ maaŋ nya kechɛto kikɛ.

english_verse: Honesty will keep you safe, but everyone who is crooked will suddenly fall.
translation_verse: Kashenteŋji bee kuŋ esa nna, ama esa nɛ e maŋ niŋi bre bee tɔr manaŋ manaŋ nna.

english_verse: Work hard, and you will have a lot of food; waste time, and you will have a lot of trouble.
translation_verse: Edɔpo nɛ e pre kenishi a shuŋ beeŋ nya ajibi yɛlyɛla so, ama basa nɛ baa jija bumo be saŋɛ bre nɛ ketir e naa ba la saŋkama.

english_verse: God blesses his loyal people, but punishes all who want to get rich quick.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ beeŋ nɛfa bekama nɛ baa ji kashenteŋ, ama E beeŋ gberge bekama nɛ baa sha fanɛ b bɔla ekpa lubi so n dii dama manaŋ na kusoe.

english_verse: It isn't right to be unfair, but some people can be bribed with only a piece of bread.
translation_verse: Ŋkpɛato maŋ walɛ, ama brɔbu fimbi beeŋ tiŋ n shin nɛ basa ko e wora kusɔ nɛ k maŋ daga.

english_verse: Don't be selfish and eager to get rich— you will end up worse off than you can imagine.
translation_verse: Esa kama nɛ e bɔlɔ miri so n dii dama beeŋ ki etirpo.

english_verse: If you cheat your parents and don't think it's wrong, you are a common thief.
translation_verse: Esa kama nɛ e bee fɛ fanɛ, keyuri mo tuto ŋko mo nio maŋ la kulubi maŋ kɔr eyu pɔtɛ to.

english_verse: Selfish people cause trouble, but you will live a full life if you trust the Lord.
translation_verse: Bejimunipo bee baga asheŋ to nna, ama asheŋ beeŋ nite nɛnɛ n sa esa kama nɛ e ta mbe yirda n deŋi Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ so.

english_verse: Only fools would trust what they alone think, but if you live by wisdom, you will do all right.
translation_verse: Esa kama nɛ e ta mbe yirda n deŋi mo gbagba be kumu so la ewulpo nna, ama ekama nɛ e bee sɔ benyiashempo be mmalga, beeŋ nya kekuŋ.

english_verse: Giving to the poor will keep you from poverty, but if you close your eyes to their needs, everyone will curse you.
translation_verse: Esa kama nɛ e bee bugi enɔ a kɛ betirpo maaŋ fin shɛŋ ŋ gben, ama basa damta beeŋ sho ekama nɛ e bee kplaŋ betirpo so kɔnɔ.

english_verse: When crooks are in control, everyone tries to hide, but when they lose power, good people are everywhere.
translation_verse: Esa lubi baŋ ji kuwura basa bee shile nna a ŋana, ama b baaŋ gboŋi mo kuwura bre basa nɛ baa wora asheŋ nɛ a niŋi bee nya bumo be amu nna.

english_verse: If you keep being stubborn after many warnings, you will suddenly discover you have gone too far.
translation_verse: Fo baŋ wora kumu kpakpaso ŋ kini kenu kasokpele damta, k maaŋ chɛr nɛ fo mur.

english_verse: When justice rules a nation, everyone is glad; when injustice rules, everyone groans.
translation_verse: Asheŋ baa nyala a sa basa niŋiso basa kikɛ be ŋgbene bee fuli nna, ama basa lubi baa ji kuwura basa bee shuto nna.

english_verse: If you love wisdom your parents will be glad, but chasing after bad women will cost you everything.
translation_verse: Esa nɛ e bee sha kanyiasheŋ bee bar mo tuto kagbenefuli nna, ama esa nɛ e ju a buu e sakaleche so bre be kanya bee mur nna.

english_verse: An honest ruler makes the nation strong; a ruler who takes bribes will bring it to ruin.
translation_verse: Ewura nɛ e bee ji kashenteŋ be efuli kɔ eleŋ nna, ama emo nɛ e kɔ kejimuni nsaa sɔ brɔbu bre be efuli bee bure nna.

english_verse: Your sins will catch you, but everyone who lives right will sing and celebrate.
translation_verse: Belubiworapo be alubi e naa kilgi a pɛ bumo, ama basa nɛ baa wora asheŋ nɛ a niŋi bre bee boŋ kagbenefuli be nshɛ nna.

english_verse: The wicked don't care about the rights of the poor, but good people do.
translation_verse: Betirpo be kenya kashenteŋ be asheŋ tir ga n sa basa nɛ baa wora asheŋ niŋiso nna, ama belubiworapo bre be shɛŋ maŋ wɔ loŋ to.

english_verse: Sneering at others is a spark that sets a city on fire; using good sense can put out the flames of anger.
translation_verse: Basa nɛ baa wora basa eyurto bee bar kebagato kade to nna, ama benyiashempo bre bee shin nɛ agbo bee wushi nna.

english_verse: Be wise and don't sue a fool. You won't get satisfaction, because all the fool will do is sneer and shout.
translation_verse: Enyiashempo baŋ yɛr ewulpo ewurkpa, ewulpo na beeŋ ya kaa mushe chilchil n jija demu na.

english_verse: Don't be a fool and quickly lose your temper— be sensible and patient.
translation_verse: Ewulpo e naa nya agbo a puŋi kɔnɔ basa to, enyiashempo bre nya agbo gba fo maaŋ pin.

english_verse: A ruler who listens to lies will have corrupt officials.
translation_verse: Ewura nɛ e bee nu efɛ be beyaasepo bee ki basa lubi nna.

english_verse: The poor and all who abuse them must each depend on God for light.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ e naa sa etirpo nɛ esa nɛ e bee mɛaŋ mbe basa kikɛ anishi nɛ baa wu.

english_verse: Kings who are fair to the poor will rule a long time.
translation_verse: Ewura nɛ e bee ji betirpo be demu nɛ kumo be ekpa so beeŋ ji kuwura n chɛr.

english_verse: Correct your children, and they will be wise; children out of control disgrace their mothers.
translation_verse: Keŋini be kasogberge bee sa kebia kanyiasheŋ nna, ama kebia nɛ b yige nɛ e bee wora mbe kepar bee wɔtɔ mo nio anishinyɔr to nna.

english_verse: Crime increases when crooks are in power, but law-abiding citizens will see them fall.
translation_verse: Belubiworapo baa ji kuwura, alubi bee wora keshi nna, ama basa nɛ baa wora asheŋ niŋiso e naŋ wu bumo be ekar.

english_verse: If you correct your children, they will bring you peace and happiness.
translation_verse: Fo baa gberge fo mbia kusoe a ŋini bumo asheŋ baaŋ sa fo kasotowushi nɛ kagbenefuli.

english_verse: Even when servants are smart, it takes more than words to make them obey.
translation_verse: Kamalga nawule maaŋ tiŋ ŋ ŋini kayɛrbi ekpa. Hale e pin asheŋ to gba e maaŋ wora kusɔ nɛ k daga.

english_verse: There is more hope for a fool than for someone who speaks without thinking.
translation_verse: Ewulpo be asheŋ kɔ tama a chɔ esa nɛ e bee kuse a malga.

english_verse: Slaves that you treat kindly from their childhood will cause you sorrow.
translation_verse: Fo baŋ yili kayɛrbi be kebia to n di mo kefɛ, e beeŋ bar fo kebɔltofinfin kacha ko.

english_verse: A person with a quick temper stirs up arguments and commits a lot of sins.
translation_verse: Esa nɛ e bee nya agbo manaŋ manaŋ bee bar kebagato nna, nsaa wora a foe ekpa manaŋ manaŋ.

english_verse: Too much pride brings disgrace; humility leads to honor.
translation_verse: Kamoowu bee bar esa kaseto nna, ama kamoobarase bee sa esa kemaŋkura nna.

english_verse: If you take part in a crime you are your worst enemy, because even under oath you can't tell the truth.
translation_verse: Esa nɛ e bee tu eyu a yuri la mo gbagba be kumu so be edoŋ nna. Ŋkpal manɛ so, nɛ b bɔ ntaŋ n lɛ mo so gba e maaŋ tiŋ n ji kashenteŋ.

english_verse: Don't fall into the trap of being a coward— trust the Lord, and you will be safe.
translation_verse: Sa maŋ shin nɛ kusɔ nɛ basa bee fɛ a laŋɛ fo kaplɛa so e baa tir fo. Yirda Ebɔrɛ nɛ e baa kuŋ fo.

english_verse: Many try to make friends with a ruler, but justice comes from the Lord.
translation_verse: Esa kama bee sha fanɛ e ji ewura keteri nna, ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nawule e naa shin nɛ ewura bee wora asheŋ nɛ a niŋi.

english_verse: These are the sayings and the message of Agur son of Jakeh. Someone cries out to God, “I am completely worn out! How can I last?
translation_verse: Jake pibi Agɔr be kubɔya nde. Esa ko bee ponte a kaŋɛ Ebɔrɛ le: “Ma eleŋ loge, ma eleŋ loge.

english_verse: I am far too stupid to be considered human.
translation_verse: N duli kusɔbɔya a chɔ dimɛdi; M maŋ naa kɔ dimɛdi be nfɛra

english_verse: I never was wise, and I don't understand what God is like.”
translation_verse: M maŋ kɔ kanyiasheŋ, ma alɛ maŋ nyi shɛŋ a laŋɛ Ebɔrɛ be kaplɛa so.

english_verse: Has anyone gone up to heaven and come back down? Has anyone grabbed hold of the wind? Has anyone wrapped up the sea or marked out boundaries for the earth? If you know of any who have done such things, then tell me their names and their children's names.
translation_verse: Wanɛ e dii n yɔ Ebɔrɛ so m bɛta m ba? Wanɛ e tiŋ m pɛ afu n wɔtɔ enɔ to? Ŋko ŋ gbargbar nchu n wɔtɔ mbe kusɔbuuso to? Wanɛ e ta kasawule n yili kumo be eyilikpa? Loŋ be esa be ketre ŋko mo pibi be ketre e la nuso? Nɛ fo nyi, fo kaŋɛ ma.

english_verse: Everything God says is true— and it's a shield for all who come to him for safety.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ be kamalga kikɛ la kashenteŋ nna. E la kusɔ kuŋso nna n sa bekama nɛ baa shile a ba mo kutɔ m baa ka fin kekuŋ na.

english_verse: Don't change what God has said! He will correct you and show that you are a liar.
translation_verse: Sa maŋ ta shɛŋ n ti mbe m mmalga so, mannɛ aloŋ, e beeŋ fiɛ fo so n ta fo ŋ ki efɛpo.”

english_verse: There are two things, Lord, I want you to do for me before I die:
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, asɔ anyɔ nɛ mee kule fanɛ fo wora n sa ma pɔɛŋ nɛ n wu.

english_verse: Make me absolutely honest and don't let me be too poor or too rich. Give me just what I need.
translation_verse: Sa maŋ shin nɛ ŋ ki efɛpo Fo alɛ e sa maŋ shin nɛ m baa la etirpo ŋko damawura. Baa sa ma kacha kama be kusɔ jiso.

english_verse: If I have too much to eat, I might forget about you; if I don't have enough, I might steal and disgrace your name.
translation_verse: Saŋɛ na so maaŋ ki damawura nseŋ teŋ fo so ŋko nɛ ketir e shin nɛ n ya yuri n jija fo ketre.

english_verse: Don't tell a slave owner something bad about one of the slaves. That slave will curse you, and you will be in trouble.
translation_verse: Sa maa debɔr kayɛrbi a ŋini mo nyɛnpe, nɛ mannɛ aloŋ e beeŋ sho fo kɔnɔ nɛ fo ji awurfoŋ.

english_verse: Some people curse their father and even their mother;
translation_verse: Basa ko bee sho bumo tutoana kɔnɔ nna nsaa maa keni bumo nioana a bɔlɔ kenishi.

english_verse: others think they are perfect, but they are stained by sin.
translation_verse: Beko malɛ bee fɛ fanɛ baa wora asheŋ nɛ a niŋi nna ama alubi damta e bɔlɔ bumo to.

english_verse: Some people are stuck-up and act like snobs;
translation_verse: Basa ko bee wu bumo be amu nna a maa keni basa a bɔlɔ kenishi.

english_verse: others are so greedy that they gobble up the poor and homeless.
translation_verse: Basa ko be kebaawɔtɔ e la kebaa kɔ kumu kpakpaso a mɛaŋ betirpo nɛ bebɔlpo.

english_verse: Greed has twins, each named “Give me!” There are three or four things that are never satisfied:
translation_verse: Kejimuni la mborobicheso anyɔ nna. Bumo kikɛ be atre e la: ‘Ta n sa ma.’ Asɔ asa e wɔtɔ a maa moɛ. Asɔ ana malɛ e maa kaŋɛ fanɛ a kukwe loŋ.

english_verse: The world of the dead and a childless wife, the thirsty earth and a flaming fire.
translation_verse: Amo e la, nchaŋ, nɛ eche egbentepo, nɛ kasawule wɔlso, nɛ edɛ nɛ esa maaŋ naŋ tiŋ n duŋ.

english_verse: Don't make fun of your father or disobey your mother— crows will peck out your eyes, and buzzards will eat the rest of you.
translation_verse: Ejita e naŋ ji bekama nɛ baa fɛl bumo tutoana nsaa keni bumo nioana jiga na be eblaŋ kupuŋ to.

english_verse: There are three or four things I cannot understand:
translation_verse: Asɔ ana e naa wul ma nfɛra to a shin nɛ maa pin asheŋ to.

english_verse: How eagles fly so high or snakes crawl on rocks, how ships sail the ocean or people fall in love.
translation_verse: Amo e la, kananɛ kusore bee firgi, nɛ kananɛ kuwɔ bee gbeye ajembu so, nɛ kananɛ teku so be ekuloŋgboŋ bee wu a yɔ kakpa nɛ k bee yɔ, nɛ kananɛ enyɛn nɛ eche bee sha abar.

english_verse: An unfaithful wife says, “Sleeping with another man is as natural as eating.”
translation_verse: Eche nɛ e bee lar mo kul kaman be da e la keji nseŋ kpra kɔnɔ so ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ e maŋ wora kulubi.

english_verse: There are three or four things that make the earth tremble and are unbearable:
translation_verse: Asɔ ana nɛ kasawule maa tiŋ a nyiti nsaa kpal amoso a gbuŋgbuŋ to.

english_verse: A slave who becomes king, a fool who eats too much,
translation_verse: Amo e la, kenya ka ki ewura, nɛ ewulpo ka ji m moɛ,

english_verse: a hateful woman who finds a husband, and a slave who takes the place of the woman who owns her.
translation_verse: nɛ eche nɛ basa maa sha ka nya ekul, nɛ kebita nɛ e suge mo chepe mo kul.

english_verse: On this earth four things are small but very wise:
translation_verse: Asɔ fimfimbi ana e wɔ kasawule so a kɔ kanyiasheŋ ga.

english_verse: Ants, who seem to be feeble, but store up food all summer long;
translation_verse: Atutulombi maŋ kɔ eleŋ ama amo alɛ bee fin amo be ajibi a yili dɔchubɔrɛ so nna.

english_verse: badgers, who seem to be weak, but live among the rocks;
translation_verse: Kukukaka maŋ shi kumo alɛ bee tiŋ a futi kedibi a luri to.

english_verse: locusts, who have no king, but march like an army;
translation_verse: Elotɔr maŋ kɔ ewura, amo alɛ nsaa bɛ abar so kenimu kenimu so fanɛ esoji na.

english_verse: lizards, which can be caught in your hand, but sneak into palaces.
translation_verse: Ketigbolu maŋ la shɛŋ kumo alɛ bee nya ekpa a luri ewurkpa.

english_verse: Three or four creatures really strut around:
translation_verse: Asɔ ana e naa wora asheŋ fanɛ bewura, nsaa tia awurya.

english_verse: those proud roosters, those mountain goats, and those rulers who have no enemies.
translation_verse: nɛ kananɛ kaboelote bee nite, nɛ kananɛ koshinyɛn bee nite, nɛ ewura nɛ mbe benapo kulti mo.

english_verse: If you are foolishly bragging or planning something evil, then stop it now!
translation_verse: Nɛ fee puchi nsaa kɔ kumu kpakpaso nɛ kawuli a kre asheŋ lubi fo yige amo be kewora.

english_verse: If you churn milk you get butter; if you pound on your nose, you get blood— and if you stay angry, you get in trouble.
translation_verse: Fo bri kenyipochu to a beeŋ lar ŋku Fo ŋmɛa fo kamuna k beeŋ gbege n lar ŋklaŋ. Aloŋ nɛ fo wɔtɔ basa agbo to, kolu beeŋ ba.

english_verse: These are the sayings that King Lemuel of Massa was taught by his mother.
translation_verse: Kanyiasheŋ be mmalga nɛ Masa be ewura Lamwɛl mo nio ŋini mo nde.

english_verse: My son Lemuel, you were born in answer to my prayers, so listen carefully.
translation_verse: M pibi Lamwɛl, kabɔrɛkule so nɛ m bɔla n nya fo; amoso kaŋ kusoe n nu kusɔ nɛ mee shin nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ fo ere.

english_verse: Don't waste your life chasing after women! This has ruined many kings.
translation_verse: Sa maa ta fo eleŋ a jija a bɛ beche so. Beche ko bee da bewura nna a lɛ.

english_verse: Kings and leaders should not get drunk or even want to drink.
translation_verse: A maŋ daga bewura nɛ bejuŋkparpo ka bee nuu nsa a boo ŋko a sha nsa ga.

english_verse: Beer and wine are only for the dying or for those who have lost all hope.
translation_verse: Yige nsa n sa bumo nɛ b maŋ naa kɔ tama kikɛ nsaa yɔ kemur to na.

english_verse: Let them drink and forget how poor and miserable they feel.
translation_verse: Shin nɛ loŋ be basa e baa nuu nsa a boo a teŋ bumo be ketir nɛ awurfoŋ so.

english_verse: But you must defend those who are helpless and have no hope.
translation_verse: Baa malga a sa bumo nɛ b maa tiŋ a malga a kuŋ bumo be amu na nsaa kɔ a sa bepɔshipo.

english_verse: Be fair and give justice to the poor and homeless. In Praise of a Good Wife
translation_verse: Baa ji demu nɛ kumo be ekpa so a sa betirpo nɛ bumo nɛ b maŋ la shɛŋ na.

english_verse: A truly good wife is the most precious treasure a man can find!
translation_verse: Eche nɛ e kɔ da lela a tiŋ a wora asheŋ nɛnɛ maa tiŋ a nya. E bɔ shuwa nɛ gbiti.

english_verse: Her husband depends on her, and she never lets him down.
translation_verse: Mo kul bee yirda mo nna a maa fɔŋ shɛŋ shɛŋ so.

english_verse: She is good to him every day of her life,
translation_verse: Eche na be kebaawɔtɔ to kikɛ asheŋ lela nawule nɛ e bee wora mo kul.

english_verse: and with her own hands she gladly makes clothes.
translation_verse: E maa chena jiga. Saŋkama e bee fɛa nna a lue ewajɛ.

english_verse: She is like a sailing ship that brings food from across the sea.
translation_verse: E du fanɛ yawujipo nna a fin ajibi kaplɛkama a ba epe.

english_verse: She gets up before daylight to prepare food for her family and for her servants.
translation_verse: E bee wule a koso nna a wora ajibi a sa mbe laŋ to ebi pɔɛŋ nɛ kare bee cha, nsaa ŋini mbe mbita ashuŋ nɛ baaŋ baa shuŋ.

english_verse: She knows how to buy land and how to plant a vineyard,
translation_verse: Mo gbagba e naa nite a fin kasawule lela a tɔ nsaa ta mbe amansherbi a nase kudɔ.

english_verse: She knows when to buy or sell, and she stays busy until late at night.
translation_verse: E bee ji yawu nna a nya tɔnɔ nsaa shuŋ a fo kiidiso.

english_verse: She spins her own cloth,
translation_verse: Mo gbagba e naa fɛa jese a lue ewajɛ.

english_verse: Her family has warm clothing, and so she doesn't worry when it snows.
translation_verse: E maa fɔŋ awo so ŋkpal manɛ so mbe laŋ to ebi kikɛ kɔ awo to be asɔbuuso.

english_verse: She does her own sewing, and everything she wears is beautiful.
translation_verse: Mo gbagba e naa baa mbe asɔbuuso, nsaa buu asɔ lela fanɛ ago be ewajɛ.

english_verse: Her husband is a well-known and respected leader in the city.
translation_verse: Mo kul bee nya kemaŋkura nna nsaa tiŋ a luri kade be benimu to.

english_verse: She makes clothes to sell to the shop owners.
translation_verse: E bee lue ewajɛ nɛ eshata nna a fa a sa eyawujipo.

english_verse: She is strong and graceful, as well as cheerful about the future.
translation_verse: E kɔ eleŋ nna nsaa sa mbe kumu bunyaŋ; e maa fɔŋ echefoso be asheŋ so.

english_verse: Her words are sensible, and her advice is thoughtful.
translation_verse: E kɔ kanyiasheŋ nna nsaa fɛ nfɛra pɔɛŋ a malga.

english_verse: She takes good care of her family and is never lazy.
translation_verse: E bee keni mbe laŋ to ebi so nɛnɛ nna, mo alɛ maŋ kɔ ntɔl.

english_verse: Her children praise her, and with great pride her husband says,
translation_verse: Mbe mbia bee puchi mo so nna nɛ mo kul bee kpaŋ mo a kaŋɛ le:

english_verse: “There are many good women, but you are the best!”
translation_verse: “Beche damta bee wora asɔ ama fo peya chɔ bumo kikɛ.”

english_verse: Charm can be deceiving, and beauty fades away, but a woman who honors the Lord deserves to be praised.
translation_verse: Kebita bee loge, nɛ kela bee chɛrga, ama eche nɛ e bee sha Ebɔrɛ bre daga k baa fur nna.

english_verse: Show her respect— praise her in public for what she has done.
translation_verse: Shin nɛ loŋ be eche be asheŋ e baa bɔlɔ fo kenishi nɛ fo baa kpaŋ mo basa to.

english_verse: When the son of David was king in Jerusalem, he was known to be very wise, and he said:
translation_verse: Ewura Deevid pibinyɛn nɛ e la eŋinipo nseŋ daa la ewura ashi Jerusalɛm to na be mmalga nde.

english_verse: Nothing makes sense! Everything is nonsense. I have seen it all— nothing makes sense!
translation_verse: Eŋinipo na yɛ, kusɔ kama na la fuloŋ nna kebaawɔtɔ ere to. Kebaawɔtɔ maŋ kɔ kifito kikɛ.

english_verse: What is there to show for all of our hard work here on this earth?
translation_verse: Manɛ be tɔnɔ bre nɛ anyee nya kegben damta nɛ anyee gben ere to?

english_verse: People come, and people go, but still the world never changes.
translation_verse: Kenana ko beeŋ ba choŋ nɛ kenana ko malɛ e naŋ ba, ama durnya ere bre maaŋ chɛrga kikɛ.

english_verse: The sun comes up, the sun goes down; it hurries right back to where it started from.
translation_verse: Epeŋi bee pete nna nsaa tɔr nseŋ naa chambɔ a yɔ kakpa nɛ k bee pete na.

english_verse: The wind blows south, the wind blows north; round and round it blows over and over again.
translation_verse: Afu bee ber a yɔ kelargato to be kaseto be kaba so nsaa ber a yɔ kelargato be esoso be kaba so, a chambɔ loŋ a kulti.

english_verse: All rivers empty into the sea, but it never spills over; one by one the rivers return to their source.
translation_verse: Elɔrana bee shile e luri teku to, ama teku malɛ maa bɔlɔ kikɛ. Nchu na kraŋ naa bɛta nna a luri lɔr na be kakpa nɛ a fara na to nsaa shile a luri to a chambɔ a ba.

english_verse: All of life is far more boring than words could ever say. Our eyes and our ears are never satisfied with what we see and hear.
translation_verse: Kebaawɔtɔ kikɛ baa la kabapɔ nna nɛ k maŋ walɛ k malga. Anyi be anishi ere maa wu asheŋ a moɛ nɛ asoe malɛ gba maa nu asheŋ a moɛ.

english_verse: Everything that happens has happened before; nothing is new, nothing under the sun.
translation_verse: Kusɔ kama nɛ k bee wora naniere daŋ chɛr n wora dra dra kikɛ nna. Shɛŋ shɛŋ maŋ la asheŋ popɔr ashi kasawule ere so.

english_verse: No one who lived in the past is remembered anymore, and everyone yet to be born will be forgotten too. It Is Senseless To Be Wise
translation_verse: Esa kama maŋ wɔtɔ nseŋ naa nyiŋi kusɔ nɛ k wora n choŋ dra dra na. Esa kikɛ malɛ maaŋ naŋ nyiŋi kusɔ nɛ k beeŋ wora echefoso gba. Eŋinipo na be kusɔ nɛ e luri to nsaa nyi be asheŋ

english_verse: I said these things when I lived in Jerusalem as king of Israel.
translation_verse: Ma eŋinipo ere ka malga le be asheŋ ere kikɛ nɛ n daa la Israɛl be efuli so be ewura nna nsaa wɔ Jerusalɛm to.

english_verse: With all my wisdom I tried to understand everything that happens here on earth. And God has made this so hard for us humans to do.
translation_verse: N wora ania fanɛ meeŋ koya nseŋ pin kusɔ kama nɛ k bee wora durnya ere to. Ama Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ k ki kpakpa n sa anyi edimɛdi.

english_verse: If something is crooked, it can't be made straight; if something isn't there, it can't be counted.
translation_verse: Kusɔ kɔnto maa tiŋ a niŋi; b maa karga shɛŋ a ti asɔ nɛ e maŋ wɔtɔ so.

english_verse: I said to myself, “You are by far the wisest person who has ever lived in Jerusalem. You are eager to learn, and you have learned a lot.”
translation_verse: Nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ ma kumu le: “Naniere bre ŋ ki bunyaŋ be esagboŋ nna nsaa nyi asheŋ malɛ a chɔ esa kama nɛ e juŋkpar ma n ji kuwura ashi Jerusalɛm to. Amoso n nyi kusɔ nɛ baa tre kanyiasheŋ nɛ kenyi.”

english_verse: Then I decided to find out all I could about wisdom and foolishness. Soon I realized that this too was as senseless as chasing the wind.
translation_verse: N daŋ pere kenishi nna a shin nɛ m pin kebaawora asheŋ kanyiasheŋ so, mannɛ kawuliso. Ama n wu fanɛ afu nɛ mee ju a buu so.

english_verse: The more you know, the more you hurt; the more you understand, the more you suffer.
translation_verse: Fo baa nya kanyiasheŋ ga, kumo be jemanɛ malɛ nɛ fo kagbene bee jija fo ga. Kenyi be ga la tɔrɔ nna.

english_verse: I said to myself, “Have fun and enjoy yourself!” But this didn't make sense.
translation_verse: N daŋ yili kumo nna fanɛ meeŋ ji ma kumu nseŋ fin kusɔ nɛ k la kagbenefuli, ama n wu fanɛ amo kikɛ maŋ la shɛŋ.

english_verse: Laughing and having fun is crazy. What good does it do?
translation_verse: N lege to n wu fanɛ emushe la kawulisheŋ nna, nɛ ebel be keji malɛ maa sa shɛŋ.

english_verse: I wanted to find out what was best for us during the short time we have on this earth. So I decided to make myself happy with wine and find out what it means to be foolish, without really being foolish myself.
translation_verse: Ŋ ka daa sha kanyiasheŋ ga so, n daŋ yili kumo nna fanɛ meeŋ ta nsa be kenuu n ji ma kumu. N daa fɛ fanɛ ekpa nɛ basa beeŋ bɔla so n ji ŋkpa shiimbi nɛ b kɔ kasawule ere so nna na.

english_verse: I did some great things. I built houses and planted vineyards.
translation_verse: N wora asɔgboŋ damta. M pɔr nwu, nseŋ dɔ ndibisɔrso be adɔana.

english_verse: And I had pools where I could get water for the trees.
translation_verse: N daŋ kur atirbu nɛ baaŋ baa jɔ nchu amo to a wurge ndibi na so nna.

english_verse: I owned slaves, and their sons and daughters became my slaves. I had more sheep and goats than anyone who had ever lived in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: N daŋ tɔ anyache nɛ benyɛn kikɛ nna nɛ bumo alɛ gba bee kurge a ti so ashi ma laŋ to. Ma e daa kɔ asɔbɔya a chɔ esa kama nɛ e juŋkpar ma ashi Jerusalɛm be kade to.

english_verse: Foreign rulers brought me silver, gold, and precious treasures. Men and women sang for me, and I had many wives who gave me great pleasure.
translation_verse: N daŋ chala shuwa nɛ gbiti ashi nsawule pɔtɛ nɛ mee ji amo so kuwura na be bewura be ekpanjawu to nna. Bumo be benyɛn nɛ beche kikɛ daŋ boŋ nshɛ nna n deŋi ma anishi to nɛ n nya beche nɛ mee sha ndoŋ.

english_verse: I was the most famous person who had ever lived in Jerusalem, and I was very wise.
translation_verse: Jerusalɛm ka jɔŋɛ kikɛ m ba fo ma jemanɛ so, esa kama daa maŋ wɔtɔ nɛ mbe eyilikpa fo meya so, ma alɛ daa kɔ kanyiasheŋ malɛ gba.

english_verse: Then I thought about everything I had done, including the hard work, and it was simply chasing the wind. Nothing on earth is worth the trouble. Wisdom Comes from God
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ n fɛ kusɔ nɛ n wora na be nfɛra nɛ kananɛ m pere kenishi n shuŋ ga be asheŋ, ama kumo be loŋ malɛ daŋ maŋ daga. Amo kikɛ daa du fanɛ k baa ju a bɛ afu so nna nɛ kumo alɛ be loŋ malɛ la fuloŋ.

english_verse: I asked myself, “What can the next king do that I haven't done?” Then I decided to compare wisdom with foolishness and stupidity.
translation_verse: Kusɔ kama nɛ ewura kama nɛ e juŋkpar ma wora, ma alɛ gba tiŋ n wora kumo. Amoso n daŋ fara nna a fɛ kusɔ nɛ k la kanyiasheŋ nɛ kebalto nɛ kawulisheŋ.

english_verse: And I discovered that wisdom is better than foolishness, just as light is better than darkness.
translation_verse: Ade kikɛ be kaman nɛ m pin fanɛ “Kanyiasheŋ walɛ a chɔ kawulisheŋ fanɛ kananɛ kefulto walɛ a chɔ tentembiri na.

english_verse: Wisdom is like having two good eyes; foolishness leaves you in the dark. But wise or foolish, we all end up the same.
translation_verse: Enyiashempo bre nyi kakpa nɛ e bee yɔ, ama ewulpo bre maŋ nyi kakpa nɛ e bee yɔ.” Kumo be lalaloge, enyiashempo nɛ ewulpo kikɛ sasa nna.

english_verse: Finally, I said to myself, “Being wise got me nowhere! The same thing will happen to me that happens to fools. Nothing makes sense.
translation_verse: Kede be kaman nɛ n fɛ fanɛ ketre jija nɛ bewulpo bee nya na, beeŋ ba ma alɛ gba so. Amoso ma kebaa la enyiashempo bre be kifito e la manɛ? Nɛ n yɛ “K maŋ la shɛŋ.”

english_verse: This made me hate life. Everything we do is painful; it's just as senseless as chasing the wind.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal loŋ so kebaawɔtɔ nɛ n wɔtɔ ere daa maŋ naa la shɛŋ ŋ kutɔ ŋkpal manɛ so k maŋ bar ma tɔnɔ kikɛ ama asheŋ nawule. Kebaadu fanɛ kebaa ju a buu afu so nna.

english_verse: Suddenly I realized that others would someday get everything I had worked for so hard, then I started hating it all.
translation_verse: Asɔ kama nɛ n daŋ pere kenishi n fin durnya ere to na kikɛ daa maŋ la shɛŋ ŋ kutɔ ŋkpal ŋ ka beeŋ yige amo n sa esa nɛ e beeŋ ba ma kaman na so.

english_verse: Who knows if those people will be sensible or stupid? Either way, they will own everything I have earned by hard work and wisdom. It doesn't make sense.
translation_verse: Feeŋ tiŋ m pin fanɛ enyiashempo ŋko ewulpo e naaŋ baa la loŋ be esa a? Ama loŋ be esa e naaŋ ba ji kusɔ kama nɛ fo gben n nya na be tɔnɔ. Kusɔ kama nɛ n ta ma kanyiasheŋ n fin n nya durnya ere to kikɛ baa la fuloŋ nna.

english_verse: I thought about all my hard work, and I felt depressed.
translation_verse: Amoso ma kushuŋ damta nɛ n daŋ shuŋ na kikɛ daŋ ki kagbene jija nna n sa ma.

english_verse: When we use our wisdom, knowledge, and skill to get what we own, why do we have to leave it to someone who didn't work for it? This is senseless and wrong.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, fo ka beeŋ ta fo nfɛra nɛ kanyiasheŋ nɛ fo enɔ to be ku shuŋ be kenyi kikɛ n shuŋ n sa esa nɛ e maŋ gben bee ŋini asheŋ fuloŋ nna nɛ kumo alɛ be loŋ maŋ walɛ.

english_verse: What do we really gain from all of our hard work?
translation_verse: Mannɛ bre be tɔnɔ nɛ an baa nya kegben damta nɛ anyee gben ere to?

english_verse: Our bodies ache during the day, and work is torture. Then at night our thoughts are troubled. It just doesn't make sense.
translation_verse: Fo ka baa wɔ ŋkpa to ere bre kusɔ kama nɛ fee wora baa la fuloŋ nna. Kusɔ nɛ fee nya kumo to e baa la kagbene jija nɛ ebesa; hale kanyɛso gba fo maaŋ nya n di.

english_verse: The best thing we can do is to enjoy eating, drinking, and working. I believe these are God's gifts to us,
translation_verse: Kusɔ nɛ ekama baa wora e la kebaa ta mbe kanya a ji a nuu nsaa ji mbe kumu. Ama ade kikɛ be nfɛra nɛ n fɛ nseŋ wu fanɛ amo kikɛ bee shi Ebɔrɛ kutɔ nna.

english_verse: and no one enjoys eating and living more than I do.
translation_verse: Nuso bre nɛ esa beeŋ tiŋ a wɔtɔ a ji mbe kepar nsaa ji mbe kumu a ti so?

english_verse: If we please God, he will make us wise, understanding, and happy. But if we sin, God will make us struggle for a living, then he will give all we own to someone who pleases him. This makes no more sense than chasing the wind.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ bee ta kanyiasheŋ nɛ kenyi nɛ kagbenefuli nna a sa bekama nɛ baa wora mbe aparsheŋ. Ama belubiworapo bre, e bee shin nna nɛ baa shuŋ a nya asɔ a yili, nɛ bekama nɛ baa wora Ebɔrɛ be aparsheŋ na e ba ji amo be kapetɛ. Ade kikɛ la asheŋ fuloŋ nna. A du nna fanɛ kebaa ju a bɛ afu so.

english_verse: Everything on earth has its own time and its own season.
translation_verse: Kusɔ kama nɛ k bee wora durnya to kikɛ kɔ kumo be saŋɛ nɛ Ebɔrɛ yili nna.

english_verse: There is a time for birth and death, planting and reaping,
translation_verse: Mo e yili kakurge nɛ luwu be saŋɛ. Mo koŋwule na e yili kasɔdu nɛ kasɔteŋi be saŋɛ.

english_verse: There is also a time for love and hate, for war and peace. What God Has Given Us To Do
translation_verse: Mo e naa yili kasha nɛ kekishi be saŋɛ, nsaa yili kena nɛ kayurwushi malɛ gba be saŋɛ.

english_verse: What do we gain by all our hard work?
translation_verse: Manɛ be tɔnɔ bre nɛ anyee nya kegben damta nɛ anyee gben ere to?

english_verse: I have seen what difficult things God demands of us.
translation_verse: N nyi esulɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ ta n deŋi dimɛdi so.

english_verse: God makes everything happen at the right time. Yet none of us can ever fully understand all he has done, and he puts questions in our minds about the past and the future.
translation_verse: Mo e yili jemanɛ nɛ k daga n sa kusɔ kikɛ. Mo e sa anyi nfɛra nɛ anyee pin kusɔ nɛ k beeŋ wora echefoso. Amo nɛ amo kikɛ an kra maa pin mbe nfɛra chiŋgeliŋ na to a loge.

english_verse: I know the best thing we can do is to always enjoy life,
translation_verse: Kusɔ nɛ m pɛshɛ m pin fanɛ k walɛ n sa dimɛdi e la fanɛ esa ka kɔ kagbenefuli nsaa wora kelela.

english_verse: because God's gift to us is the happiness we get from our food and drink and from the work we do.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so ajibi nɛ anyee nya a ji nɛ nchu nɛ anyee nuu nɛ tɔnɔ kama nɛ anyee nya ashi anyi be ashuŋ to ere kikɛ la Ebɔrɛ be kakɛ nna.

english_verse: Everything God has done will last forever; nothing he does can ever be changed. God has done all this, so that we will worship him.
translation_verse: M baa nyi geeŋ fanɛ kusɔ kama nɛ Ebɔrɛ wora beeŋ baa wɔtɔ mbaanaayɔ. Fo maaŋ tiŋ n ta shɛŋ n ti kumo so, fo alɛ maaŋ naaŋ tiŋ n lara shɛŋ ashi kumo to. Ebɔrɛ wora loŋ nna saŋɛ na so anyeeŋ baa bunyaŋ mo.

english_verse: Everything that happens has happened before, and all that will be has already been— God does everything over and over again. The Future Is Known Only to God
translation_verse: Kusɔ kama nɛ k teŋ n wora kabre nɛ kumo nɛ k beeŋ wora echefoso kikɛ teŋ wora nna ŋ ku so. Ebɔrɛ shin nna nɛ loŋ be asheŋ koŋwule na kra wora hale kabre. Kebaa maa ji asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so be asheŋ

english_verse: Everywhere on earth I saw violence and injustice instead of fairness and justice.
translation_verse: Ŋ ka naŋ pɛshɛ asheŋ, nɛ n naŋ wu fanɛ, keji asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so maŋ naa shuŋ. Alubi nawule e naa ji eleŋ.

english_verse: So I told myself that God has set a time and a place for everything. He will judge everyone, both the wicked and the good.
translation_verse: Amoso kusɔ nɛ n fɛ ma kagbene to e la fanɛ: “Ebɔrɛ beeŋ ji basa niŋiso nɛ basa lubi kikɛ demu ŋkpal manɛ so kusɔ kama kɔ kumo be saŋɛ nna.

english_verse: I know God is testing us to show us that we are merely animals.
translation_verse: Asheŋ ere kikɛ be lalaloge nɛ n wu fanɛ Ebɔrɛ bee wora anyi nna a keni nɛ e ŋini anyi fanɛ anyi maŋ bɔ asɔbɔya.

english_verse: All living creatures go to the same place. We are made from earth, and we return to earth.
translation_verse: Asɔ futeso kikɛ bee yɔ kakpa koŋwule nna. Shishɛr to nɛ an shi, shishɛr malɛ to nɛ anyeeŋ naaŋ bɛta n yɔ.

english_verse: Who really knows if our spirits go up and the spirits of animals go down into the earth?
translation_verse: Wanɛ e nyi fanɛ anyi be ayoyu bee yɔ esoso nna nɛ asɔbɔya malɛ peya bee shir kasawule to?

english_verse: We were meant to enjoy our work, and that's the best thing we can do. We can never know the future.
translation_verse: Amoso kusɔ nɛ n naaŋ pɛshɛ m pin e la fanɛ a daga an ka bee ji anyi be kegben be tɔnɔ ŋkpal manɛ so anyi maaŋ tiŋ m pin echefoso be asheŋ.”

english_verse: I looked again and saw people being mistreated everywhere on earth. They were crying, but no one was there to offer comfort, and those who mistreated them were powerful.
translation_verse: Ade kikɛ be kaman nɛ n naŋ keni n wu fanɛ keji asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so maŋ naa wɔ durnya to. Basa nɛ b wɔ kamɛaŋ to na bee shu anishichubi nɛ esa kama maa chɛ bumo to, ŋkpal basa nɛ baa mɛaŋ bumo na ka kɔ eleŋ a chɔ bumo so.

english_verse: But those who have never been born are better off than anyone else, because they have never seen the terrible things that happen on this earth.”
translation_verse: Basa nɛ b maŋ naŋ kurge bumo na gba bɔ anyi, ŋkpal manɛ so, bumo be kenishi maŋ naŋ wu kananɛ kebaa maa ji asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so durnya ere to du.

english_verse: Fools will fold their hands and starve to death.
translation_verse: Ewulpo nawule e naa far mbe mbre a chena a maa sha kushuŋ nɛ akoŋ bee mɔ mo.

english_verse: Yet a very little food eaten in peace is better than twice as much earned from overwork and chasing the wind.
translation_verse: Ama fo ka nya gbrɛ n ji kayurwushiso bɔ fo ka nya ga nsaa maa ji a moɛ. K du nna fanɛ fo ka bee ju a pɛ afu na.

english_verse: Once again I saw that nothing on earth makes sense.
translation_verse: Ade kikɛ be kaman nɛ n naŋ wu asheŋ ko nɛ a maŋ kɔ kifito ashi kasawule ere so.

english_verse: For example, some people don't have friends or family. But they are never satisfied with what they own, and they never stop working to get more. They should ask themselves, “Why am I always working to have more? Who will get what I leave behind?” What a senseless and miserable life! It Is Better To Have a Friend
translation_verse: Kanyɛn ko e daa wɔtɔ; a maŋ kɔ ebi, mo alɛ daa maŋ kɔ ekurgepo kikɛ. E daŋ baa wɔ kushuŋ to nna saŋkama, ama mo alɛ be kenishi daa maa bɔlɔ kusɔ nɛ e bee nya so. Nɛ e yɛ: “Wanɛ bre so nɛ mee gben le saŋkama, nsaa maaŋ tiŋ n ta ma kegben n ji ma kumu gba ere?” Le be kesheŋ ere gba maŋ kɔ kifito, kumo alɛ nseŋ naa la kagbenejija ga be asheŋ!

english_verse: You are better having a friend than to be all alone, because then you will get more enjoyment out of what you earn.
translation_verse: Fo baa kɔ eteri, bɔ fo nawule ka wɔtɔ, ŋkpal manɛ so basa anyɔ e naŋ tiŋ n shuŋ nɛnɛ.

english_verse: If you fall, your friend can help you up. But if you fall without having a friend nearby, you are really in trouble.
translation_verse: Ekoŋwule baŋ tɔr, eko beeŋ niŋi mo to, ama fo nawule bre baa la nseŋ tɔr, k maaŋ ba walɛ kikɛ ŋkpal manɛ so esa maaŋ niŋi fo to.

english_verse: If you sleep alone, you won't have anyone to keep you warm on a cold night.
translation_verse: Awo to, basa nyɔ beeŋ tiŋ n dese m mata abar nsaa bel edɛ a pɛ abar, ama nuso nɛ esa koŋwule beeŋ tiŋ n wora loŋ?

english_verse: Someone might be able to beat up one of you, but not both of you. As the saying goes, “A rope made from three strands of cord is hard to break.”
translation_verse: Kolu nɛ esa koŋwule beeŋ kɔ n tɔr na, basa nyɔ bre beeŋ kɔ kumo m pɔɔ so. K beeŋ ba du kpakpa ga nɛ fo tiŋ n tuge kemamprɔŋ nɛ b ta efɔl asa m mɛa abar n wora to.

english_verse: I once saw everyone in the world follow a young leader who came to power after the king was gone.
translation_verse: Ŋ ka fɛ basa nɛ b wɔ durnya ere to kikɛ be asheŋ, nɛ m pin fanɛ kabrantiɛfɔlbi beeŋ shi bumo to m ba ji kuwura jemanɛ nɛ ewura na maŋ naa wɔtɔ.

english_verse: His followers could not even be counted. But years from now, no one will praise him—this makes no more sense than chasing the wind.
translation_verse: Ashere basa nɛ ewura bee juŋkpar na shibi ga n baŋ so ama kachɛ nɛ e kaŋ wu, ekama maaŋ baa wɔtɔ nɛ e lar ŋ kpaŋ mo. Ade kikɛ la asheŋ fuloŋ nna. A du nna fanɛ esa ka ju a bɛ afu so na.

english_verse: Be careful what you do when you enter the house of God. Fools go there to offer sacrifices, because all they do is sin. But it's best just to listen when you go to worship.
translation_verse: Baa da asheŋ nɛ fee wora ashi Ebɔrɛ be lambu to so. Fee yɔ ndoŋ nna nɛ fo ya nu kusɔ nɛ beŋinipo bee ŋini, mannɛ keya lara kawuliso be sarga fanɛ bewulpo nɛ b maŋ nyi alubi nɛ alela be mbarga na.

english_verse: Don't talk before you think or make promises to God without thinking them through. God is in heaven, and you are on earth, so don't talk too much.
translation_verse: Baa fɛ nfɛra pɔɛŋ nsaa malga, sa maa nya manaŋ a nase nnɔ Ebɔrɛ be anishito. Ebɔrɛ wɔ ebɔrɛso nna nɛ fo alɛ wɔ kasawule ere so, amoso sa maa malga ga.

english_verse: If you keep thinking about something, you will dream about it. If you talk too much, you will say the wrong thing.
translation_verse: Kananɛ kafɔŋ damta beeŋ tiŋ n shin nɛ esa e dese ŋ ku edare lubi na, loŋ koŋwule na nɛ esa nɛ e bee malga ga beeŋ tiŋ m malga kawulisheŋ be mmalga.

english_verse: It's better not to make a promise at all than to make one and not keep it.
translation_verse: Fo ka maŋ nase kɔnɔ kraa bɔ fo ka nase kɔnɔ e maŋ tiŋ n tia kumo.

english_verse: Don't let your mouth get you in trouble! And don't say to the worship leader, “I didn't mean what I said.” God can destroy everything you have worked for, so don't say something that makes God angry.
translation_verse: Sa maŋ shin nɛ fo kɔnɔ to be mmalga e shin nɛ fo wora kulubi, saŋɛ na so fo maaŋ yɔ Ebɔrɛ be bɔrɛmatapo kutɔ n ya kaŋɛ mo fanɛ fo daa pɛl nna. Manɛ nna nɛ fee wɔtɔ Ebɔrɛ agbo to? Manɛ nna nɛ fo shin nɛ Ebɔrɛ jija kusɔ nɛ fo gben n nya na ŋkpal fo kamalga so?

english_verse: Respect and obey God! Daydreaming leads to a lot of senseless talk.
translation_verse: Edare damta be kebaakuu nɛ mmalga damta be kebaa malga maŋ kɔ kifito. Amoso baa ŋana Ebɔrɛ nsaa sa mo bunyaŋ.

english_verse: Don't be surprised if the poor of your country are abused, and injustice takes the place of justice. After all, the lower officials must do what the higher ones order them to do.
translation_verse: Fo baŋ wu abane be ekrachi ka bee tɔrɔ mbe efuli so be betirpo nsaa ji bumo durmu, sa maŋ shin nɛ k baa chinchiŋ fo, ŋkpal manɛ so ekrachi wurbi na bee wora a bɛ bumo be benimu be nnɔ so nna.

english_verse: And since the king is the highest official, he benefits most from the taxes paid on the land.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal ewura ka la enimu ekama so so, mo e naa nya kasawule na so be elampo nɛ baa sɔ na kikɛ be galeŋga.

english_verse: If you love money and wealth, you will never be satisfied with what you have. This doesn't make a bit of sense.
translation_verse: Esa kama nɛ e bee sha amansherbi nɛ kedamaya ga, maa nya amansherbi a moɛ kikɛ. Asheŋ fuloŋ e la amo kikɛ.

english_verse: The more you have, the more everyone expects from you. Your money won't do you any good—others will just spend it for you.
translation_verse: Saŋɛ so nɛ fo dii dama na, loŋ be jemanɛ na so nɛ basa damta malɛ bee fin kechɛto fo kutɔ. Asheŋ nɛ damawura bee chena a fɛ saŋkama e la mbe kedamaya be asheŋ.

english_verse: If you have to work hard for a living, you can rest well at night, even if you don't have much to eat. But if you are rich, you can't even sleep.
translation_verse: Etirpo bre ji nɛ e maŋ ji gba, e bee dese kanyɛso a di nɛnɛ nna. Ama amansherbi wura bre, maa di a mata, ŋkpal mbe kedamaya so.

english_verse: Suddenly they lose everything in a bad business deal, then have nothing to leave for their children.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so amansherbi na kikɛ beeŋ loge ŋkpal b ka maŋ ta amo n shuŋ kushuŋ lela so. Bumo be mbia malɛ maaŋ nya kapetɛ kikɛ.

english_verse: They came into this world naked, and when they die, they will be just as naked. They can't take anything with them, and they won't have anything to show for all their work.
translation_verse: An ka ba durnya ere to anyi maŋ bar shɛŋ, anyi alɛ naa lar kumo to anyi maaŋ ta shɛŋ n yɔ.

english_verse: Besides all this, they are always gloomy at mealtime, and they are troubled, sick, and bitter.
translation_verse: Naniere bre tentembiri nɛ kebɔltofinfin nɛ kagbenejija nɛ agbo nɛ kulɔ be kebaawɔtɔ to nɛ an wɔ.

english_verse: What is the best thing to do in the short life God has given us? I think we should enjoy eating, drinking, and working hard. This is what God intends for us to do.
translation_verse: Kusɔ nɛ n wu e la fanɛ, kusɔ lela mo nɛ dimɛdi daga kewora an be ŋkpa shiimbi nɛ Ebɔrɛ ta n sa anyi durnya ere to e la fanɛ an baa ta kusɔ kama nɛ an gben n nya a ji eyur. Kusɔ nɛ k baŋ daga dimɛdi kikɛ nna na.

english_verse: Suppose you are very rich and able to enjoy everything you own. Then go ahead and enjoy working hard—this is God's gift to you.
translation_verse: Nɛ Ebɔrɛ baŋ shin nɛ fo dii dama nseŋ nya asɔ nseŋ naŋ sa fo ekpa fanɛ fo ji amo be ebel, kumo ere a daga fanɛ fo baa ji a chɔrɔ mo ŋkpal tɔnɔ nɛ fo shuŋ n nya so. K la Ebɔrɛ be kakɛ nna.

english_verse: God will keep you so happy that you won't have time to worry about each day.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal Ebɔrɛ ka sa fo kagbenefuliso, fo maŋ naa fɔŋ ŋkpa shiimbi nɛ anyee ji durnya ere to be asheŋ so.

english_verse: There is something else terribly unfair, and it troubles everyone on earth.
translation_verse: N dara m pin fanɛ keji asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so maŋ wɔ durnya ere to kikɛ kuraa.

english_verse: God may give you everything you want—money, property, and wealth. Then God doesn't let you enjoy it, and someone you don't even know gets it all. That's senseless and terribly unfair!
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ beeŋ tiŋ n sa esa ko kedamaya nɛ kemaŋkura nɛ asɔ nseŋ naŋ sa mo kusɔ kama gba nɛ e bee sha n ti so, ama mo alɛ maaŋ ji amo be ebel. Efɔ ko e naŋ ba ji amo be ebel. Kumo alɛ be loŋ la asheŋ fuloŋ nna a maŋ walɛ.

english_verse: You may live a long time and have a hundred children. But a child born dead is better off than you, unless you enjoy life and have a decent burial.
translation_verse: Esa beeŋ tiŋ a kɔ mbia kalfa nseŋ chɛr kasawule ere so ga, ama k maŋ tir nfɛ afanɛ nɛ e ji durnya ere to, e baa maŋ nya kagbenefuli ŋko kupuli lela mbe kaluwuachɛ kumo ere kebia nɛ b kurge nɛ e laŋɛ gba bɔ mo.

english_verse: That child will never live to see the sun or to have a name, and it will go straight to the world of darkness. But it will still find more rest than you,
translation_verse: E maŋ wu epeŋi be kefulto ŋko a nyi kusɔ nɛ baa tre ŋkpa gba, ama mo alɛ nya ewushi

english_verse: even if you live two thousand years and don't enjoy life. As you know, we all end up in the same place.
translation_verse: a chɔ esa nɛ e ji nfɛ ŋgboŋ anyɔ nsaa maŋ ji durnya ere to be ebel. Kashenteŋ nna fanɛ bumo kikɛ bee yɔ kakpa koŋwule bre nna.

english_verse: We struggle just to have enough to eat, but we are never satisfied.
translation_verse: Kegben nɛ anyee gben ere kikɛ, kusɔ nɛ anyeeŋ ji so nɛ anyee wora. Amo nɛ amo kikɛ anyi alɛ kra maa ji a moɛ.

english_verse: We may be sensible, yet we are no better off than a fool. And if we are poor, it still doesn't do us any good to try to live right.
translation_verse: Hale fo kɔ kanyiasheŋ gba, fo maŋ bɔ ewulpo. Nɛ an la betirpo gba, kumo be loŋ maa ŋini nna fanɛ anyi maaŋ tiŋ n wora kusɔ nɛ k daga.

english_verse: Everything that happens was decided long ago. We humans know what we are like, and we can't argue with God, because he is too strong for us.
translation_verse: Kusɔ kama nɛ k bee wora kabre ere daŋ chɛr wora dra dra kikɛ nna. Anyi edimɛdi nyi kusɔ nɛ k la anyi. Anyi alɛ maaŋ tiŋ n ji Ebɔrɛ emɔrɔ ŋkpal manɛ so e kɔ eleŋ a chɔ anyi ga.

english_verse: The more we talk, the less sense we make, so what good does it do to talk?
translation_verse: Esa baa malga ga, mbe mmalga maŋ naa kɔ kifito, amo alɛ maŋ kɔ kechɛto n sa esa kikɛ.

english_verse: A good reputation at the time of death is better than loving care at the time of birth.
translation_verse: Ketre lela bɔ tulale dufɛso; nɛ kaluwuachɛ malɛ bɔ kakurgeachɛ.

english_verse: It's better to go to a funeral than to attend a feast; funerals remind us that we all must die.
translation_verse: Fo ka yɔ keelibuna bɔ fo ka yɔ kejigboŋ to; ŋkpal manɛ so, k yɔ keeli to bee nyiŋi anyi nna fanɛ ekama beeŋ wu kachako.

english_verse: Choose sorrow over laughter because a sad face may hide a happy heart.
translation_verse: Kagbenejija bɔ emushe, k bee jija anishiakpa ama kumo alɛ be loŋ bee shin nɛ esa bee fɛ nfɛra.

english_verse: Correction from someone wise is better by far than praise from fools.
translation_verse: Eyiashempo baa kpele fo kusoe, k bɔ ewulpo ka bee boŋ nshɛ a kpaŋ fo.

english_verse: Foolish laughter is stupid. It sounds like thorns crackling in a fire.
translation_verse: Ewulpo be emushe du nna fanɛ ewi ka wɔ edɛ to a chɔɔ. K maŋ kɔ kifito kikɛ.

english_verse: Something completed is better than something just begun; patience is better than too much pride.
translation_verse: Kusɔ kama be lalaloge bɔ kumo be sososo. Kanyiti ka bɔ kamoowu be asheŋ

english_verse: Only fools get angry quickly and hold a grudge.
translation_verse: Bewulpo e naa nya agbo manaŋ manaŋ nsaa ta asheŋ a wɔtɔ kagbene to.

english_verse: It isn't wise to ask, “Why is everything worse than it used to be?”
translation_verse: K maŋ daga fanɛ fo baa kaŋɛ le: “Manɛ nna nɛ dra na bɔ kabre?” K maŋ la kanyiasheŋ be kamalga.

english_verse: Wisdom will protect you just like money; knowledge with good sense will lead you to life.
translation_verse: Kanyiasheŋ du fanɛ kusɔ kuŋso nna fanɛ kananɛ amansherbi gba du fanɛ kusɔ kuŋso na. Kanyiasheŋ be tɔnɔ kikɛ e la kananɛ k bee kuŋ esa nɛ e kɔ kumo na.

english_verse: Think of what God has done! If God makes something crooked, can you make it straight?
translation_verse: Fɛ kusɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ wora ere be asheŋ. Nɛ Ebɔrɛ baa maŋ niŋi kusɔ, wanɛ bre e naŋ tiŋ n niŋi kumo?

english_verse: When times are good, you should be cheerful; when times are bad, think about what it means. God makes them both to keep us from knowing what will happen next. Some of Life's Questions
translation_verse: Nɛ asheŋ baa nite nɛnɛ, shin nɛ fo kagbene e baa fuli fo, nɛ asheŋ maŋ naa nite nɛnɛ malɛ, ba nyi fanɛ Ebɔrɛ e naa sa ekpa nɛ asheŋ lela nɛ asheŋ lubi bee tu esa. Amoso ekama maŋ nyi kusɔ nɛ k beeŋ wora echefoso.

english_verse: I have seen everything during this senseless life of mine. I have seen good citizens die for doing the right thing, while criminals live and prosper.
translation_verse: Kebaawɔtɔ jiga nɛ n wɔtɔ ere to, nɛ n wu fanɛ basa lela ko bee wu bumo be alelasheŋ to nna nɛ basa lubi malɛ kɔ ŋkpa nsaa wɔ bumo be asheŋ lubi to.

english_verse: So don't destroy yourself by being too good or acting too smart!
translation_verse: Amoso sa maŋ shin nɛ kanyiasheŋ nɛ kenishibugi nɛ fo kɔ na e mur fo.

english_verse: Don't die before your time by being too evil or acting like a fool.
translation_verse: Sa maa kɔ kumu kpakpaso ŋko e la ewulpo saŋɛ na so fo maaŋ wu nɛ fo kachɛ maŋ naŋ fo.

english_verse: Keep to the middle of the road. You can do this if you truly respect God.
translation_verse: Baa nite teteri a yɔ. Fo baa kɔ bunyaŋ a sa Ebɔrɛ asheŋ beeŋ nyalɛ n sa fo.

english_verse: Wisdom will make you stronger than the ten most powerful leaders in your city.
translation_verse: Kusɔ nɛ esa nɛ e kɔ kanyiasheŋ beeŋ tiŋ n wora, bejuŋkparpo kudu maaŋ tiŋ n wora kumo n sa bumo be kade.

english_verse: Don't listen to everything that everyone says, or you might hear your servant cursing you.
translation_verse: Sa maa kaŋ kusoe a nu kusɔ kama nɛ basa bee malga, nɛ manɛ aloŋ, feeŋ nu fo kayɛrbi ka bee tege fo,

english_verse: Haven't you cursed many others?
translation_verse: ŋkpal manɛ so fo alɛ gba bee kaa tege beko.

english_verse: I told myself that I would be smart and try to understand all this, but it was too much for me.
translation_verse: Ŋ gbagba be kanyiasheŋ nɛ n ta m pin ade kikɛ ama amo alɛ kra chɔ ma so.

english_verse: So I decided to learn everything I could and become wise enough to discover what life is all about. At the same time, I wanted to understand why it's stupid and senseless to be an evil fool.
translation_verse: Amoso n daŋ yili kumo nna fanɛ meeŋ ta ma kanyiasheŋ n fin asheŋ kpakpaso ere kikɛ be edesekpa, saŋɛ na so meeŋ koya kananɛ kulubi nɛ kawulisheŋ du.

english_verse: Here is what I discovered: A bad woman is worse than death. She is a trap, reaching out with body and soul to catch you. But if you obey God, you can escape. If you don't obey, you are done for.
translation_verse: Ade kikɛ be kaman nɛ n naŋ wu fanɛ eche dalubiwura, lubi a chɔ luwu. E du nna fanɛ b ka so kejigbelɛ na. Mbe kasha nɛ e beeŋ sha fo na bee pɛ nna fanɛ kashewu; Nɛ mbe enɔ nɛ e beeŋ ta n deŋi fo so na malɛ du fanɛ ŋgbɛlɛbi. E maaŋ tiŋ n nya esa nɛ e bee wora Ebɔrɛ be aparsheŋ ama alubiworapo bre e bee pɛ mo nna manaŋ.

english_verse: With all my wisdom I have tried to find out how everything fits together,
translation_verse: Eŋinipo na yɛ: “Mee lege asheŋ ere to nna gbrɛgbrɛ a fin amo be edesekpa.”

english_verse: but so far I have not been able to. I do know there is one good man in a thousand, but never have I found a good woman.
translation_verse: N daŋ naa keni nna a fin atuwebi ko nɛ n sa ama ma alɛ maŋ nya. Meeŋ tiŋ n nya esa lela koŋwule benyɛn kagboŋ to, ama beche bre to maaŋ nya loŋ be esa.

english_verse: I did learn one thing: We were completely honest when God created us, but now we have twisted minds.
translation_verse: Asheŋ nɛ ŋ koya kikɛ nna na. Ebɔrɛ to anyi nɛnɛ nna nɛ anyi alɛ jija anyi be amu.

english_verse: Who is smart enough to explain everything? Wisdom makes you cheerful and gives you a smile. Obey the King
translation_verse: Enyiashempo nawule e kɔ nfɛra a pin asheŋ be afito to. Kanyiasheŋ e naa sa mo kagbenefuli nsaa shin nɛ e bee mushe. Kebaanu a sa ewura be asheŋ

english_verse: If you promised God that you would be loyal to the king, I advise you to keep that promise.
translation_verse: Fo baŋ nase kɔnɔ Ebɔrɛ be anishito fanɛ feeŋ baa nu a sa ewura, kumo ere a daga fanɛ fo baa wora loŋ.

english_verse: Don't quickly oppose the king or argue when he has already made up his mind.
translation_verse: Sa maa kuse a lar ewura be anishito ŋko a ji mo emɔrɔ ŋkpal manɛ so e beeŋ tiŋ n wora kusɔ kama nɛ e bee sha.

english_verse: The king's word is law. No one can ask him, “Why are you doing this?”
translation_verse: Ewura be kamalga du fanɛ b ka nase mbra nna, amoso esa kama maaŋ tiŋ n ji mbe kamalga emɔrɔ.

english_verse: If you obey the king, you will stay out of trouble. So be wise and learn what to do and when to do it.
translation_verse: Fo baa nu a sa ewura, asheŋ maa pɔɔ fo so. Enyiashempo malɛ kikɛ nyi kananɛ daga fanɛ e nu n sa ewura nɛ saŋɛ nɛ k daga e ka wora loŋ.

english_verse: Life is hard, but there is a time and a place for everything,
translation_verse: Kebaawɔtɔ du kpakpa, ama kusɔ kama kɔ kumo be saŋɛ nɛ kakpa nɛ k daga k ka wora.

english_verse: We cannot control the wind or determine the day of our death. There is no escape in time of war, and no one can hide behind evil.
translation_verse: Esa kama maŋ kɔ eleŋ luwu so ŋko nɛ e tiŋ n chɛrga mbe kaluwuachɛ. Luwu la kena nɛ esa kama maaŋ tiŋ n shile kumo nna, loŋ koŋwule na e la esa nɛ e bee wora alubi. Mbe alubi beeŋ ba dii efuli kachɛ ko. Kumukpakpasowura nɛ esa nɛ e niŋi be asheŋ

english_verse: I noticed all this and thought seriously about what goes on in the world. Why does one person have the power to hurt another? Who Can Understand the Ways of God?
translation_verse: N wu kananɛ asheŋ bee nite durnya ere to kikɛ, beko bee tɔrɔ bumo braana nna ŋkpal b ka kɔ eleŋ a chɔ bumo so.

english_verse: I saw the wicked buried with honor, but God's people had to leave the holy city and were forgotten. None of this makes sense.
translation_verse: N wu amukpakpaso wuraana ka wu nɛ b puli bumo bunyaŋ so, ama Ebɔrɛ bre be basa ka lar kade cheembi na to, epul to nɛ b teŋ bumo so. Kanyiasheŋ maŋ wɔ ade be kekama to.

english_verse: When we see criminals commit crime after crime without being punished, it makes us want to start a life of crime.
translation_verse: Kulubi be kasogberge baa maa ba manaŋ manaŋ, k bee shin nɛ basa be ŋgbene bee laŋɛ kulubi be kewora so nna.

english_verse: They commit hundreds of crimes and live a long time, in spite of the saying: Everyone who lives right and respects God will prosper,
translation_verse: Kumukpakpasowura beeŋ tiŋ n wora alubi kalfa nseŋ kraŋ ji efute n chɛr, ama n nyi fanɛ asheŋ beeŋ nite nɛnɛ n sa esa nɛ e bee ŋana Ebɔrɛ nsaa wora mo kasonu na.

english_verse: There is something else that doesn't make sense to me. Good citizens are treated as criminals, while criminals are honored as though they were good citizens.
translation_verse: Kusɔ ko nɛ kumo be kepin to du kpakpa kraa wora kasawule so. Kumo e la fanɛ basa niŋiso ka bee nya kasogberge nɛ k daga kumukpakpasowuraana, nɛ kumukpakpasowuraana bee nya kemaŋkura nɛ k daga basa niŋiso. Ma ere kutɔ kede gba maŋ kɔ kifito.

english_verse: So I think we should get as much out of life as we possibly can. There is nothing better than to enjoy our food and drink and have a good time. Then we can make it through this troublesome life that God has given us here on earth.
translation_verse: Ma ere so an baa ji anyi be amu, ŋkpal manɛ so, anyi be kebaawɔtɔ to be kagbenefuli kikɛ baa wɔ kebaaji a nuu nsaa ji eyur to nna. Kusɔ nɛ anyeeŋ tiŋ n wora kikɛ ashi kegben kama nɛ anyee gben kebaawɔtɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ sa anyi durnya ere to e baa la na.

english_verse: Day and night I went without sleep, trying to understand what goes on in this world.
translation_verse: Kapa nɛ kanyɛ mee gal edi nna a wora ania nɛ m pin kusɔ nɛ k bee wora durnya ere to.

english_verse: I saw everything God does, and I realized no one can really understand what happens. We may be very wise, but no matter how much we try or how much we claim to know, we cannot understand it all.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ n wu kusɔ kama nɛ Ebɔrɛ wora nseŋ pin to fanɛ esa kikɛ maaŋ tiŋ m pin asheŋ nɛ a bee wora ere to. Dimɛdi wora ania kanaŋkama, e maaŋ tiŋ m pin amo be afito. Hale enyiashempo kaŋɛ fanɛ e nyi asheŋ kanaŋkama gba, e maaŋ tiŋ m pin amo to.

english_verse: I thought about these things. Then I understood that God has power over everyone, even those who are wise and live right. Anything can happen to any one of us, and so we never know if life will be good or bad.
translation_verse: Kede be kaman nɛ n fɛ asheŋ ere kikɛ be asheŋ nseŋ wu fanɛ basa niŋiso nɛ benyiashempo kikɛ be asheŋ nɛ baa wora kasha so nɛ amo nɛ baa wora yurkishi so kikɛ bɔɔ Ebɔrɛ enɔ nna. Ekama maŋ nyi kusɔ nɛ k dese a jo mo.

english_verse: But exactly the same thing will finally happen to all of us, whether we live right and respect God or sin and don't respect God. Yes, the same thing will happen if we offer sacrifices to God or if we don't, if we keep our promises or are afraid to make them.
translation_verse: Kelamba koŋwule e dese n sa basa niŋiso nɛ kumukpakpasowuraana; basa lela nɛ basa lubi kikɛ. Kusɔ koŋwule e naaŋ wora basa nɛ baa ŋana Ebɔrɛ nsaa sa mo bunyaŋ nɛ bumo nɛ b maa ŋana mo kikɛ. Kusɔ nɛ k beeŋ wora basa nɛ baa lara esarga a sa Ebɔrɛ na, kumo e naŋ wora bumo nɛ b maa bɛ bumo be nnɔ naseso so na gba.

english_verse: It's terribly unfair for the same thing to happen to each of us. We are mean and foolish while we live, and then we die.
translation_verse: Kulubi nɛ k wɔ asheŋ kama nɛ e bee wora durnya to na e la fanɛ, kelamba koŋwule e dese n sa ekama. Asheŋ lubi nɛ ebonsheŋ e baŋ bɔlɔ edimɛdi be ŋgbene nɛ nfɛra to; amo alɛ kikɛ be kaman baa wu a yɔ bubuni to nna.

english_verse: As long as we are alive, we still have hope, just as a live dog is better off than a dead lion.
translation_verse: Ekama nɛ e kraa wɔ ŋkpa to kraa kɔ tama, fanɛ kananɛ jɔnɔ keniso kɔ tɔnɔ a chɔ buluŋ wuso na.

english_verse: We know we will die, but the dead don't know a thing. Nothing good will happen to them—they are gone and forgotten.
translation_verse: Kashenteŋto, basa nɛ b wɔ ŋkpa to nyi b ka beeŋ wu, ama basa nɛ b wu bre maŋ naa nyi shɛŋ. Kusɔ lela kikɛ maŋ naa wɔtɔ n sa bumo; bumo ere choŋ nna na, nɛ b teŋ bumo so.

english_verse: Their loves, their hates, and their jealous feelings have all disappeared with them. They will never again take part in anything that happens on this earth.
translation_verse: Kasha nɛ yurkishi nɛ kukɔrkɔ kama nɛ b daa kɔ kikɛ choŋ nna na. B maaŋ naŋ tiŋ n ti basa so n wora asheŋ kasawule ere so kikɛ.

english_verse: So be happy and enjoy eating and drinking! God decided long ago that this is what you should do.
translation_verse: Baa ji a nuu kagbenefuliso! Kusɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ yili dra kikɛ fanɛ fo baa wora nna na.

english_verse: Dress up, comb your hair, and look your best.
translation_verse: Baa buu asɔ fuful jemanɛ kikɛ nsaa saŋɛ kenishito a wora asheŋ kagbenefuliso

english_verse: Life is short, and you love your wife, so enjoy being with her. This is what you are supposed to do as you struggle through life on this earth.
translation_verse: Durnya to be kebaawɔtɔ maŋ kɔ tɔnɔ, amoso jemanɛ nɛ men wɔ ŋkpa nɛ Ebɔrɛ sa menyi to ere, fo nɛ fo eche nɛ fee sha na e baa ji menyi be amu nɛnɛ. Ŋkpal manɛ so, kusɔ nɛ k wɔtɔ n sa menyi ashi menyi be kegben kikɛ to nna na.

english_verse: Work hard at whatever you do. You will soon go to the world of the dead, where no one works or thinks or reasons or even knows anything.
translation_verse: Kushuŋ kama nɛ fo nya, baa shuŋ kumo nɛ fo eleŋ kikɛ, ŋkpal manɛ so, k maaŋ chɛr feeŋ yɔ bubuni to, kakpa nɛ kushuŋ nɛ kefɛ nfɛra nɛ kekre asheŋ nɛ kanyiasheŋ maŋ wɔ.

english_verse: Here is something else I have learned: The fastest runners and the greatest heroes don't always win races and battles. Wisdom, intelligence, and skill don't always make you healthy, rich, or popular. We each have our own share of misfortune.
translation_verse: N daŋ naŋ wu kusɔ ko malɛ gba durnya to n ti so. Kumo e la fanɛ, mannɛ basa nɛ baa shile ga e naa tiŋ a ji kɔŋkɔŋ ŋko belempo e naa tiŋ a kɔ a pɔɔ so jemanɛ kikɛ. Mannɛ kanyiasheŋ ŋko kenyi be ga e naa bar ajibi ŋko kedamaya ŋko ketregboŋ. Kumu lubi malɛ wɔtɔ nna n sa ekama.

english_verse: None of us know when we might fall victim to a sudden disaster and find ourselves like fish in a net or birds in a trap. Better To Be Wise than Foolish
translation_verse: Fo maaŋ tiŋ m pin jemanɛ nɛ fo peya bee ba. Kananɛ abulbi bee pɛ mbuibi ŋko ewule bee pɛ ekɔrɔtɔ epul to na, aloŋ nɛ asheŋ lubi bee ba edimɛdi gba so. Kanyiasheŋ ka bɔ kawulisheŋ be asheŋ

english_verse: Once I saw what people really think of wisdom, and it made an impression on me.
translation_verse: N daŋ naŋ wu kananɛ basa bee fɛ kanyiasheŋ be asheŋ nɛ k bɔlɔ ma kenishi ga.

english_verse: It happened when a powerful ruler surrounded and attacked a small city where only a few people lived. The enemy army was getting ready to break through the city walls.
translation_verse: Kadebi ko nɛ kumo to be basa daa maŋ shibi e daa wɔtɔ. Nɛ ewura lempo ko nɛ mbe benapo daŋ ba kulti kumo n wɔtɔ a shin nɛ b bure kumo be egbal n luri to ŋ kɔ kumo kena.

english_verse: But the city was saved by the wisdom of a poor person who was soon forgotten.
translation_verse: Etirpo ko daa wɔ kadebi na to a nyi asheŋ ga, nseŋ daŋ bɔla mbe kanyiasheŋ so m mɔlga kumo. Ama ekama daa maŋ naa nyiŋi mbe asheŋ.

english_verse: So I decided that wisdom is better than strength. Yet if you are poor, no one pays any attention to you, no matter how smart you are.
translation_verse: Amoso nɛ ma ere kaŋɛ fanɛ kanyiasheŋ bɔ eleŋ na. Ama esa kikɛ maa fɛ fanɛ etirpo nyi asheŋ ŋko a ta mbe kamalga a shuŋ.

english_verse: Words of wisdom spoken softly make much more sense than the shouts of a ruler to a crowd of fools.
translation_verse: Kewora enyiashempo be kamalga nɛ e beeŋ malga boeŋ na kasonu bɔ awɔr nɛ bewulpo be ewura bee chɛ na.

english_verse: Wisdom is more powerful than weapons, yet one mistake can destroy all the good you have done.
translation_verse: Kanyiasheŋ kɔ kechɛto a chɔ kena to be akɔsɔ, ama kulubi koŋwule bee jija alela damta nna.

english_verse: A few dead flies in perfume make all of it stink, and a little foolishness outweighs a lot of wisdom.
translation_verse: Kananɛ ashushombi bee wu a wɔtɔ tulale to nɛ amo be efɛa bee chɛrga na, aloŋ nɛ kawuli fimbi kikɛ bee jija esa be kanyiasheŋ nɛ kemaŋkura.

english_verse: Sensible thoughts lead you to do right; foolish thoughts lead you to do wrong.
translation_verse: Enyiashempo be kagbene bee laŋɛ kusɔ nɛ k daga be kewora so nna, ama ewulpo bre be kagbene bee laŋɛ asheŋ nɛ a gbɛto so nna.

english_verse: Fools show their stupidity by the way they live; it's easy to see they have no sense.
translation_verse: Ewulpo baa bɔ ekpa a nite gba, ekama bee pin fanɛ e maŋ kɔ nfɛra nɛ kanyiasheŋ kikɛ maŋ wɔ mo to.

english_verse: they let slaves ride on horses, but force slave owners to walk.
translation_verse: Ma ere wu anya ka chena egbaŋɛ so nɛ bewurbi bee nite aya so fanɛ anya.

english_verse: If you dig a pit, you might fall in; if you break down a wall, a snake might bite you.
translation_verse: Esa kama nɛ e kur kemaŋ n nase nsaa maŋ de so mo gbagba e naŋ tɔr kumo to. Esa kama malɛ nɛ e bure egbal dra n lɛ nsaa maa de so kana e naaŋ duŋ mo.

english_verse: You could even get hurt by chiseling a stone or chopping a log.
translation_verse: Esa kama nɛ e bee bure afalta ŋko a baŋɛ ndishaŋ to beeŋ tiŋ n doro mbe kumu.

english_verse: If you don't sharpen your ax, it will be harder to use; if you are wise, you'll know what to do.
translation_verse: Nɛ fo kekpanfu baa maa ji nɛ fo alɛ maŋ yee kumo, kumo ere eleŋ fuful nɛ feeŋ baa kɔ a ku kusɔ. Kenyi bre bee shin nɛ asheŋ bee nite nɛnɛ nsaa loge to nɛnɛ nna.

english_verse: The power to charm a snake does you no good if it bites you anyway.
translation_verse: Kuwɔ be keduŋ esa m mɔ pɔɛŋ nɛ edurpo e ba wora kudur m mɔ kuwɔ na maŋ kɔ kechɛto kikɛ.

english_verse: If you talk sensibly, you will have friends; if you talk foolishly, you will destroy yourself.
translation_verse: Enyiashempo be mmalga bee bar mo kemaŋkura nna, ama ewulpo bre be kɔnɔ to be mmalga e naa mur mo.

english_verse: Fools begin with nonsense, and their stupid chatter ends with disaster.
translation_verse: Ewulpo bee fara kawulisheŋ be mmalga nna, kumo be lalaloge nɛ a ya bar kebagato.

english_verse: Fools wear themselves out— they don't know enough to find their way home.
translation_verse: Ewulpo e naa shuŋ a gben a chul to nsaa maŋ naa nyi kananɛ e beeŋ naaŋ wora n yɔ epe.

english_verse: A country is in for trouble when its ruler is childish, and its leaders party all day long.
translation_verse: Asheŋ maaŋ nyalɛ n sa efuli kama nɛ kumo be ewura la kebia nɛ kumo be bejuŋkparpoana malɛ wɔtɔ a ji kejigboŋ karechɛ kikɛ.

english_verse: Some people are too lazy to fix a leaky roof— then the house collapses.
translation_verse: Etɔlpo be ebu be larbeŋ e naa bu a tɔr to nɛ ebu na bee dul mo so, kumo be lalaloge nɛ kowu na e tɔr kuraa.

english_verse: Eating and drinking make you feel happy, and money can buy everything you need.
translation_verse: Kebaa ji nsaa nuu bee shin nɛ esa be kagbene bee fuli mo nna, ama amansherbi nɛ e beeŋ nya pɔɛŋ tiŋ n wora amo kikɛ.

english_verse: Don't let yourself think about cursing the king; don't curse the rich, not even in secret. A little bird might hear and tell everything.
translation_verse: Sa maŋ kaŋ malga ŋ gbiti ewura ŋko n shoduu damawura, hale fo nfɛra to ŋko ashi fo ebu deseso to gba. Ŋkpal manɛ so, kabuibi ko beeŋ tiŋ n nu nseŋ ya kaŋɛ bumo kusɔ nɛ fo malga na kikɛ.

english_verse: Be generous, and someday you will be rewarded.
translation_verse: Baa ta fo asɔ a kɛ yilayilaso, kachako so feeŋ ji amo be tɔnɔ.

english_verse: Share what you have with seven or eight others, because you never know when disaster may strike.
translation_verse: Baa chige fo asɔ to a sa basa be yiri yiri damta, ŋkpal manɛ so, fo maaŋ tiŋ m pin jemanɛ nɛ kumu lubi beeŋ tu fo.

english_verse: No one can explain how a baby breathes before it is born. So how can anyone explain what God does? After all, God created everything.
translation_verse: Kananɛ fo maaŋ tiŋ m pin ekpa nɛ afu bee bɔla so a ba, ŋko kananɛ kebia bee wora a daŋ mo nio be epun to na, a loŋ nɛ fo maaŋ tiŋ m pin Ebɔrɛ nɛ e to kusɔ kikɛ na be kasheŋwora to.

english_verse: Plant your seeds early in the morning and keep working in the field until dark. Who knows? Your work might pay off, and your seeds might produce. Youth and Old Age
translation_verse: Baa wule a koso kachipurdidi n ya kaa duu fo asɔduu nsaa pere kenishi a shuŋ a tɔr epeŋi. Ŋkpal manɛ so fo maaŋ tiŋ m pin fanɛ kachipurso peya na ŋko kaaseso peya na e naaŋ wora n lar tɔnɔ n sa fo. Kenyiŋi fo etopo fo kebifɔlbi to be asheŋ

english_verse: Nothing on earth is more beautiful than the morning sun.
translation_verse: Shɛŋ maŋ walɛ kenishiso a chɔ kachipurso be epeŋi.

english_verse: Even if you have a very long life, you should try to enjoy each day, because darkness will come and will last a long time. Nothing makes sense.
translation_verse: Nfɛ kama nɛ esa beeŋ ji durnya ere to, e shin nɛ mbe kagbene e fuli amo be kekama so. Ama e baa nyiŋi fanɛ nfɛ nɛ e beeŋ ji luwu be kaman chɔ amo nɛ e beeŋ ji durnya to. Shɛŋ maŋ wɔtɔ nɛ esa beeŋ tiŋ n ta mbe yirda n to kumo so.

english_verse: Be cheerful and enjoy life while you are young! Do what you want and find pleasure in what you see. But don't forget that God will judge you for everything you do.
translation_verse: Kebifɔlbi, baa ji fo kumu kagbenefuliso, ŋkpal fo kebifɔlbi so. Baa wora fo kagbene be aparsheŋ kanaŋkama nɛ fee sha. Ama baa nyiŋi fanɛ Ebɔrɛ beeŋ yili kusɔ kama nɛ fo wora so n ji fo demu.

english_verse: Rid yourself of all worry and pain, because the wonderful moments of youth quickly disappear.
translation_verse: Sa maŋ shin kusɔ kama e baa fɔŋ fo ŋko a tɔrɔ fo ashi fo kagbene to, ŋkpal manɛ so, kebifɔlbiya nɛ kumo be asheŋ woraso maa chɛr nsaa choŋ.

english_verse: Keep your Creator in mind while you are young! In years to come, you will be burdened down with troubles and say, “I don't enjoy life anymore.”
translation_verse: Amoso baa nyiŋi fo etopo jemanɛ nɛ fo kraa la kebifɔlbi ere, pɔɛŋ nɛ asheŋ e baa wora fo so keshi ashi nfɛ nɛ a wɔ fo anishito ere to nɛ fo kaŋɛ le: “Kebaawɔtɔ maŋ naa wora ma ebel.”

english_verse: Someday the light of the sun and the moon and the stars will all seem dim to you. Rain clouds will remain over your head.
translation_verse: Loŋ be jemanɛ na, epeŋi nɛ kufɔl nɛ achɛkpabi maaŋ naa fuli to nɛnɛ a sa fo, ŋkpal fo anishi ka maa naa wu nɛnɛ so. Nɛ kewora fanɛ bɔrɛwɔlpa ka buu fo so jemanɛ kikɛ na.

english_verse: The noisy grinding of grain and the voices of singers will be shut out by your deaf ears, but even the song of a bird will keep you awake.
translation_verse: Loŋ be jemanɛ na fo asoe maa naa nu awɔr nɛ a bee chɛ kelɔnɛ so ŋko nshɛ nɛ beche beeŋ baa kɔr asɔ abo so nsaa boŋ na nɛnɛ. Mbuibi be kushu gba beeŋ gal fo edi.

english_verse: You will be afraid to climb up a hill or walk down a road. Your hair will turn as white as almond blossoms. You will feel lifeless and drag along like an old grasshopper. We each go to our eternal home, and the streets here are filled with those who mourn.
translation_verse: Feeŋ baa ŋana kedii kakpa jeŋgreŋ ŋko a nite ekpaana to be mboŋ nɛ e bee keta kufu. Fo emin beeŋ kilgi n fuli nɛ enite gba e baa nu fo; shɛŋ malɛ maaŋ naa yɛlga fo. Loŋ be jemanɛ na bee ŋini fanɛ anyi be ekama bee yɔ epe nɛ k wɔtɔ mbaanaayɔ na nna, nɛ basa e sɔ abɔrbi so a shu nli.

english_verse: The silver cord snaps, the golden bowl breaks; the water pitcher is smashed, and the pulley at the well is shattered.
translation_verse: Amoso baa nyiŋi fo etopo na pɔɛŋ nɛ fo efute nɛ k du fanɛ kajesebi na e tuge to ŋko a du fanɛ kapuya na e bure kuraa.

english_verse: Nothing makes sense. I have seen it all— nothing makes sense. Respect and Obey God
translation_verse: Eŋinipo na yɛ: “Shɛŋ shɛŋ maŋ kɔ kifi to! Shɛŋ maŋ kɔ tɔnɔ! Amo kikɛ la fuloŋ nna.” Kesa Ebɔrɛ bunyaŋ nseŋ wora mo kasonu be asheŋ

english_verse: I was a wise teacher with much understanding, and I collected a number of proverbs that I had carefully studied.
translation_verse: Ama ŋkpal eŋinipo na ka la enyiashempo so, e kraa ŋini basa asɔ nɛ mo ere nyi nna. E koya aŋasa nna nseŋ mige amo to nɛnɛ m pin amo be kashenteŋ kikɛ.

english_verse: Then I tried to explain these things in the best and most accurate way.
translation_verse: E wora ania fanɛ e beeŋ keni to n fin mmalgabi nɛ e bee wushi kagbene. Kusɔ nɛ e sibɛ na malɛ niŋi nna nsaa la kashenteŋ.

english_verse: Words of wisdom are like the stick a farmer uses to make animals move. These sayings come from a shepherd, and they are like nails that fasten things together.
translation_verse: Enyiashempo na be mmalga na du fanɛ mbolpɔkpapo be kekpabi nɛ e kɔ a kpa mbe mbolpɔ nna nɛ aŋasa na malɛ du fanɛ ayir nɛ e gbir nɛnɛ nna. Mmalga na shi Ebɔrɛ nɛ e la anyi kikɛ be ekpapo na kutɔ nna.

english_verse: My child, I warn you to stay away from any teachings except these. There is no end to books, and too much study will wear you out.
translation_verse: M pibi, baa da so nɛ fo maaŋ naŋ ta shɛŋ n ti mmalga ere so. Nwɔl be kasibɛ maaŋ kɔ ekar kikɛ, nɛ kekoya be alegai malɛ bee shin nɛ esa bee gben a bɛlɛ.

english_verse: Everything you were taught can be put into a few words: Respect and obey God! This is what life is all about.
translation_verse: Ade kikɛ be kaman, kusɔ koŋwule e ka nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ. Baa ŋana Ebɔrɛ nsaa bɛ mbe mbraana so. Ŋkpal manɛ so, loŋ so nɛ Ebɔrɛ to dimɛdi bomin.

english_verse: God will judge everything we do, even what is done in secret, whether good or bad.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ beeŋ yili kusɔ kama nɛ an wora so n ji anyi demu, hale asheŋ lubi ŋko asheŋ lela nɛ an wora ashiri to gba.

english_verse: This is Solomon's most beautiful song. She Speaks:
translation_verse: Sɔlɔmɔn be nshɛ to be kebelbelso. Sososo be kashɛ Eche shaso be kashɛ

english_verse: Kiss me tenderly! Your love is better than wine,
translation_verse: Pipe ma kɔnɔ kasha so; fo kasha bɔ nsa;

english_verse: and you smell so sweet. All the young women adore you; the very mention of your name is like spreading perfume. *
translation_verse: nɛ fo efɛa wɔ ebel ga. Fo ketre du viim nna fanɛ b ka chulgi tulale n wurge nna. Nɛ besuŋgurbi bee wu fo so.

english_verse: Hurry, my king! Let's hurry. Take me to your home. The Young Women Speak: We are happy for you! And we praise your love even more than wine. She Speaks: Young women of Jerusalem, it is only right that you should adore him.
translation_verse: Keta ma nɛ an nya manaŋ n yɔ; Ma ewura, keta ma n yɔ fo ebu to manaŋ. Ndoŋ nɛ anyi be ŋgbene beeŋ fuli anyi, nɛ an nuu nsa nseŋ ji anyi be amu. Nɛ beche bee sha fo, kumo be ekpa so nna.

english_verse: Don't stare at me just because the sun has darkened my skin. My brothers were angry with me; they made me work in the vineyard, and so I neglected my complexion.
translation_verse: Men sa maŋ mɛrge anishi n cha ma ŋkpal epeŋi ka chɔ ma nɛ m biri gbitigbiti so. N siponyɛnana e daŋ nya agbo n wora ma nseŋ shin nɛ n ya ka keni asɔrso nɛ baa tre greep na be ndɔ so. Nɛ m maŋ naa nya saŋɛ a sa ma eyur nɛ k ki loŋ na.

english_verse: My darling, I love you! Where do you feed your sheep and let them rest at noon? Don't let the other shepherds think badly of me. I'm not one of those women who shamelessly follow after shepherds. He Speaks:
translation_verse: N jipo, ŋini ma kakpa nɛ fee yɛr fo mbolpɔ nɛ baa ya kaa ji, nɛ kakpa nɛ baa dese a wushi kapaso. Ŋkpal manɛ so, k maŋ daga fanɛ n ya kaa na fo braana be mbolpɔ to a fin fo. Enyɛn na be kashɛ

english_verse: My dearest, if you don't know, just follow the path of the sheep. Then feed your young goats near the shepherds' tents.
translation_verse: Beche to be kebita, nɛ fo maŋ nyi ndoŋ gba fo bɛ mbolpɔ na be aya so. Keta fo mboebi n yɔ kejito a mata mbolpɔkpapoana na be ewajɛbu na ase.

english_verse: You move as gracefully as the pony that leads the chariot of the king.
translation_verse: N jipo, fee shin nɛ mee wora yireŋ yireŋ nna fanɛ egbaŋɛnyɛn nɛ a bee gberge ewura Fɛɛro be gbaŋɛturko na ka wu gbaŋɛche na.

english_verse: Earrings add to your beauty, and you wear a necklace of precious stones.
translation_verse: Akonde bee shin nɛ fo kebita bee lar alegaiso nna, nɛ fo kubɔtoshembi malɛ bee nyɛkpɛ fanɛ shuwa na.

english_verse: Let's make you some jewelry of gold, woven with silver. She Speaks:
translation_verse: Anyeeŋ ta shuwa nɛ gbiti n lɔŋɛ akonde n sa fo. Eche na be kashɛ

english_verse: My king, while you were on your couch, my aroma was a magic charm.
translation_verse: Ma kowurnyɛn ka tase mbe ejikpa nɛ ma tulale be efɛa ya ber mo.

english_verse: My darling, you are perfume between my breasts;
translation_verse: N jipo, fo du fanɛ tulale nna ashi ma anyipo be nfɛato.

english_verse: My darling, you are lovely, so very lovely— your eyes are those of a dove. She Speaks:
translation_verse: N jipo, fo kebita maŋ kɔ ebarkasa, fo anishi du fanɛ lepɔ be anishi nna. Eche na be kashɛ

english_verse: My love, you are handsome, truly handsome— the fresh green grass will be our wedding bed
translation_verse: N jipo fo walɛ keyɛrbi, m baŋ maŋ wu fo maaŋ teŋ n chena. Anyeeŋ dese afitiri bumbuŋ so kasha so fanɛ gedo nɛ an wora kejafɔ n dese so na;

english_verse: in the shade of cedar and cypress trees.
translation_verse: nɛ ndibi nɛ baa tre sida nɛ seprɛs na be kiyoyul e buu anyi so.

english_verse: I am merely a rose from the land of Sharon, a lily from the valley. He Speaks:
translation_verse: N du fanɛ ketoto nɛ baa tre rosi na nna ashi kakpa nɛ baa tre Sharɔn na ŋko ketoto nɛ baa tre lili nɛ k wɔ ketaŋɛ to na. Enyɛn na be kashɛ

english_verse: My darling, when compared with other young women, you are a lily among thorns. She Speaks:
translation_verse: Kananɛ ketotodibi lela bee kaa wea ewidibiana to na, loŋ gbagba chap nɛ n jipo du ashi besuŋgurbi to. Eche na be kashɛ

english_verse: And you, my love, are an apple tree among trees of the forest. Your shade brought me pleasure; your fruit was sweet.
translation_verse: Kananɛ mangodibi bee wea ndibi pɔtɛ to ashi kupo to na nɛ n jipo du ashi mbrantiɛbia to. Kumo be kiyoyul to be kechena wɔ ebel nna nɛ kumo kusɔrso bee wora ma kɔnɔ to ebel ga

english_verse: You led me to your banquet room and showered me with love.
translation_verse: Fo yɛr ma fo kejigboŋ be ebu to n ya ŋini ma fo kasha alegaiso.

english_verse: Put your left hand under my head and embrace me with your right arm.
translation_verse: N jipo be enɔ bena sɔ ma kumu to nna nɛ mbe enɔjiso malɛ bee lala ma so kasha so.
