english_verse: Young women of Jerusalem, promise me by the power of deer and gazelles never to awaken love before it is ready. Winter Is Past She Speaks:
translation_verse: Jerusalɛm be beche, men nase kɔnɔ n sa ma nseŋ bɔ chibir nɛ shantaŋ be ntaŋ fanɛ men maaŋ chuchɔl kasha nɛ kumo be saŋɛ maŋ naŋ fo. Kashɛ nyɔsopo Eche na be kashɛ

english_verse: I hear the voice of the one I love, as he comes leaping over mountains and hills
translation_verse: N nu n jipo be ebɔl! Mo e shi abee nɛ apreŋ so n shile a tɛto n gbelge to a ba ma kutɔ na.

english_verse: like a deer or a gazelle. Now he stands outside our wall, looking through the window
translation_verse: N jipo du nna fanɛ chibir na. Mo e yil egbal be kaman a jule a keni tokuro to a dara ebu to na. Enyɛn na be kashɛ

english_verse: and speaking to me. He Speaks: My darling, I love you! Let's go away together.
translation_verse: Le nɛ n jipo kaŋɛ ma: “Ma eshapo, niŋi to; ma kebita lela, ba nɛ an yɔ!

english_verse: Winter is past, the rain has stopped;
translation_verse: Kechali loge nna na, nɛ bɔrɛ ku.

english_verse: flowers cover the earth, it's time to sing. The cooing of doves is heard in our land.
translation_verse: Ndibi fara a wora atoto nɛ basa fara a lɔŋɛ asɔ to nsaa boŋ nshɛ kaplɛkama, nɛ elepɔ be kushu sɔ kiyi to.

english_verse: Fig trees are bearing fruit, while blossoms on grapevines fill the air with perfume. My darling, I love you! Let's go away together.
translation_verse: Ndibi nɛ baa tre figi na fara a sɔr, nɛ asɔrso nɛ baa tre greep na fara a futi nɛ amo be atoto be efɛa sɔ kaplɛkama. Amoso n jipo koso nɛ an yɔ; ma kebita lela, ba nɛ an yɔ!

english_verse: You are my dove hiding among the rocks on the side of a cliff. Let me see how lovely you are! Let me hear the sound of your melodious voice.
translation_verse: Fo du nna fanɛ lepɔ nɛ e ŋana kefalta to ashi kebeegboŋ so na. Shin nɛ n wu fo anishito; nseŋ nu fo ebɔl belbelso na.

english_verse: Our vineyards are in blossom; we must catch the little foxes that destroy the vineyards. She Speaks:
translation_verse: Shin nɛ an pɛ ejiŋkaamu wurbi nɛ baa jija anyi be asɔrso nɛ baa tre greep na be kudɔ na, ŋkpal manɛ so greep be asɔrso na bee futi nna. Eche na be kashɛ

english_verse: My darling, I am yours, and you are mine, as you feed your sheep among the lilies.
translation_verse: Ma eshapo la meya nna, nɛ ma alɛ gba la mo peya; Atoto nɛ baa tre lili na be kakpa nɛ e bee yɛr mbe asɔbɔya kejito.

english_verse: Pretend to be a young deer dancing on mountain slopes until daylight comes and shadows fade away.
translation_verse: N jipo du fanɛ chibir nna a wɔ kebee so hale nɛ kare e ya cha nɛ tentembiri e foe.”

english_verse: While in bed at night, I reached for the one I love with heart and soul. I looked for him, but he wasn't there.
translation_verse: Ŋ ka dese ma gedo so kanyɛso nɛ n jipo be asheŋ ba ma kagbene to; nɛ ŋ keni bena nɛ jiso m maŋ wu mo.

english_verse: So I searched through the town for the one I love. I looked on every street, but he wasn't there.
translation_verse: Nɛ ŋ koso n nite n kilgi to kade na kikɛ to; n nite kumo be abɔrbi kikɛ nɛ kumo be alɔnɛ kikɛ so n fin ma jipo, ama m maŋ wu mo.

english_verse: I even asked the guards patrolling the town, “Have you seen the one I love so much?”
translation_verse: Nɛ basa nɛ baa keni kade na so kanyɛso na shɛr ma to nɛ m bishi bumo: “Men wu n jipo a?”

english_verse: Right after that, I found him. I held him and would not let go until I had taken him to the home of my mother.
translation_verse: Ma nɛ bumo ka baŋ barga abar gbrɛ nɛ n wu ŋ jipo. Nɛ n far n chɛ mo kiŋkiŋ; M maŋ naŋ yige mo to. Kumo be kaman nɛ ŋ keta mo n yɔ n nio be ebu to; ebu nɛ b kurge ma kumo to na gbagba to.

english_verse: Young women of Jerusalem, promise me by the power of deer and gazelles, never to awaken love before it is ready. The Groom and the Wedding Party Their Friends Speak:
translation_verse: Jerusalɛm be beche, men nase kɔnɔ n sa ma nseŋ bɔ chibir nɛ shantaŋ be ntaŋ fanɛ men maaŋ chuchɔl kasha nɛ kumo be saŋɛ maŋ naŋ fo. Kashɛ Sasopo Eche na be kashɛ

english_verse: What do we see approaching from the desert like a cloud of smoke? With it comes the sweet smell of spices, including myrrh and frankincense.
translation_verse: Wanɛ e shi keshishɛrsawule so a ba fanɛ edishi ka bee kaa kululu loŋ, nɛ etulale kpakpaso fanɛ mɛr nɛ fraŋkinsensi nɛ eyawujipoana bee fa na be efɛa bɛ mo so loŋ?

english_verse: It is King Solomon carried on a throne, surrounded by sixty of Israel's best soldiers.
translation_verse: Sɔlɔmɔn nɛ b sulɔ mbe kekpata so a ba nɛ Israɛl be benapo kpakpaso adeshe bee kuŋ mo.

english_verse: The throne is made of trees from Lebanon.
translation_verse: Lebanɔn be ndibi lela nɛ ewura Sɔlɔmɔn ta n lɔŋɛ mbe kekpata na.

english_verse: Its posts are silver, the back is gold, and the seat is covered with purple cloth. You women of Jerusalem have taken great care to furnish the inside.
translation_verse: Gbiti nɛ e daŋ ta n wora kumo be ndibi tenteŋ na, nseŋ ta shuwa malɛ n wora kumo be kaseto be ndibi na. Wajɛ peper kunɔkunɔ nɛ e daŋ ta n ta kumo be kaseto. Jerusalɛm be mbichebi e daŋ lue kumo be epunto be asɔ kikɛ.

english_verse: My darling, you are lovely, so very lovely— as you look through your veil, your eyes are those of a dove. Your hair tosses about as gracefully as goats coming down from Gilead.
translation_verse: N jipo fo lar kebita nɛnɛ bre. Fo kebita maŋ kɔ ebarkasa. Keni kananɛ fo anishi walɛ nɛnɛ a wɔ shata to fanɛ lepɔ ka wɔ kesha to na. Nɛ fo emin bee gbungbuŋto fanɛ mboe ka shi Giliad be kebee so a gbelge to a ba na.

english_verse: Your teeth are whiter than sheep freshly washed; they match perfectly, not one is missing.
translation_verse: Fo anyii fuli nna parr fanɛ mbolpɔ nɛ b baŋ bɛr n ji kebita na. Amo kikɛ bɛ abar so nna yɛɛr. K kama maŋ gbaŋ.

english_verse: Your lips are crimson cords, your mouth is shapely; behind your veil are hidden beautiful rosy cheeks.
translation_verse: Fo kɔnɔpurbi nyɔ nna m pere kpeŋ fanɛ kechɛbi peper na; fo kɔnɔ be kapɔr walɛ. Fo ŋgbuŋ du kulkulbi nna a walɛ nsaa nyɛkpɛ fo shata to.

english_verse: Your neck is more graceful than the tower of David, decorated with thousands of warriors' shields.
translation_verse: Fo kubɔ du nna shirembi fanɛ ketempreŋ jeŋgreŋ nɛ ewura Deevid pɔr na. Kumo so nɛ b daa ta benapo be abɛlso be asɔkuŋso ŋgboŋto ŋgboŋto a shiga na.

english_verse: Your breasts are perfect; they are twin deer feeding among lilies.
translation_verse: Fo anyipo yil nna jɔŋjurɔmbi fanɛ echibir anyɔ ka lar kepla so a ji na.

english_verse: I will hasten to those hills sprinkled with sweet perfume and stay there till sunrise.
translation_verse: Meeŋ nya manaŋ n yɔ abee nɛ apreŋ nɛ a kɔ etulale nɛ asɔ dufɛso be efɛa na so pɔɛŋ nɛ kaboŋ e bugi to nɛ kare e chɛ.

english_verse: My darling, you are lovely in every way.
translation_verse: Fo baa walɛ kebita nna nɛnɛ; Ŋ jipo, fo kebita maŋ kɔ emɔrɔ kikɛ.

english_verse: My bride, together we will leave Lebanon! We will say goodbye to the peaks of Mount Amana, Senir, and Hermon, where lions and leopards live in the caves.
translation_verse: Ma kejafɔ, shin nɛ an lar Lebanɔn. An lar Lebanɔn be abeegboŋ nɛ baa tre Amana, nɛ Senir nɛ Hɛɛmɔn na to, Amo be alaŋ to nɛ ebuluŋ nɛ ebuful bee di na.

english_verse: My bride, my very own, you have stolen my heart! With one glance from your eyes and the glow of your necklace, you have stolen my heart.
translation_verse: Esipoche, ma kagbene pɛ fo ga; ma kagbene pɛ fo kashenteŋto nna. Ma nɛ fo be anishi ka baŋ wora abar anyɔ nɛ n wu kananɛ fo kubɔtoshembi bee nyɛkpɛ na nɛ ma kagbene laŋɛ fo so.

english_verse: Your love is sweeter than wine; the smell of your perfume is more fragrant than spices.
translation_verse: N jipo nɛ ma kejafɔ, fo kasha bee bɔlɔ ma kenishi ga. Fo kasha bɔ nsa, nɛ fo etulale be efɛa chɔ asɔ dufɛso kama.

english_verse: Your lips are a honeycomb; milk and honey flow from your tongue. Your dress has the aroma of cedar trees from Lebanon.
translation_verse: Ma kejafɔ, fo kɔnɔ be kepipe wɔ ebel nna fanɛ mushoŋ. Nɛ fo kudonduloŋ bee wora ma ebel, fanɛ mushoŋ nɛ kenyipochu na. Fo asɔbuuso to be efɛa wɔ ebel nna fanɛ Lebanɔn be ndibi nɛ baa tre sida na be efɛa.

english_verse: My bride, my very own, you are a garden, a fountain closed off to all others.
translation_verse: N sipoche nɛ ŋ jipo, fo du fanɛ kudɔbi nɛ b pɔr egbal ŋ kulti nna ŋko kebuye nɛ b ti so n yili n na.

english_verse: Your arms are vines, covered with delicious fruits and all sorts of spices— henna, nard,
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nɛ asɔduuso bee wora nɛnɛ nsaa sɔr asɔrso jiso lela nɛ baa tre pomegranates na, nɛ asɔrso dufɛso lela nɛ baa tre naad nɛ hena na;

english_verse: You are a spring in the garden, a fountain of pure water, and a refreshing stream from Mount Lebanon. She Speaks:
translation_verse: Fo du fanɛ kebuye nna ashi kudɔbi to, kakpa nɛ nchu lela bee bul na; ŋko kabombi nɛ k shi Lebanɔn be kebeegboŋ na so m ba shin nɛ kakpa wushi na nna. Eche na be kashɛ

english_verse: Let the north wind blow, the south wind too! Let them spread the aroma of my garden, so the one I love may enter and taste its delicious fruits.
translation_verse: Shin nɛ afu e ta ma kudɔbi na to be efɛa n ya ber ŋ jipo, nɛ n jipo e ba luri kumo to n daŋ kumo be asɔrso lela na ŋ keni.

english_verse: My bride, my very own, I come to my garden and enjoy its spices. I eat my honeycomb and honey; I drink my wine and milk. Their Friends Speak: Eat and drink until you are drunk with love. Another Dream She Speaks:
translation_verse: M ba ma kudɔbi to, ŋ jipo, nɛ ma kejafɔ. N chala ma etulale nɛ asɔ dufɛso Ŋ ji ma mushoŋkɔrfɔ nɛ mushoŋchu; nseŋ nuu ma nsa belbelso nɛ kenyipochu. Eche na be kashɛ Ji nseŋ nu kanaŋkama so nɛ fee sha; shin nɛ kasha e boo fo. Eche na be kashɛ

english_verse: I was asleep, but dreaming: The one I love was at the door, knocking and saying, “My darling, my very own, my flawless dove, open the door for me! My head is drenched with evening dew.”
translation_verse: Mee di nɛ ma kagbene maa di. Ŋ ku edare fanɛ n jipo ka ba ŋmɛa ma kukuloŋ. Enyɛn na be kashɛ N jipo nɛ ma eshapo, nɛ fo du fanɛ lepɔ, bugi ma nɛ n luri; ŋkpal manɛ so bunyaŋ tɔr ma so nna; nɛ ma kumu nɛ ma emin kikɛ pɔ. Eche na be kashɛ

english_verse: But I had already undressed and bathed my feet. Should I dress again and get my feet dirty?
translation_verse: Ma ere teŋ wora shiriya nɛ n dese nna, manɛ nna nɛ n naa ta ma asɔ a buu? N tiŋ n fɔr ma aya nna, n naaŋ shin nɛ a wora eyurpi a?

english_verse: Then my darling's hand reached to open the latch, and my heart stood still.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ n jipo ba pɛ kukuloŋ na to nɛ e bugi, nɛ ma kagbene fara a ku.

english_verse: When I rose to open the door, my hands and my fingers dripped with perfume.
translation_verse: Nɛ ŋ koso nɛ n bugi kukuloŋ na n sa mo, nɛ etulale bee chise ma enɔ nɛ ashilbi so a do kukuloŋ na be kelagatobi so.

english_verse: And I yearned for him while he spoke to me, but when I opened the door, my darling had disappeared. I searched and shouted, but I could not find him— there was no answer.
translation_verse: Ŋ ka bugi kukuloŋ na nɛ n jipo maŋ naa wɔtɔ; e tiŋ n yɔ, nɛ k tɔrɔ ma ga. Nɛ ŋ keni a fin mo, ama m maŋ wu mo. Nɛ n tre mo ama m maŋ nu mbe ebɔl.

english_verse: Then I was found by the guards patrolling the town and guarding the wall. They beat me up and stripped off my robe.
translation_verse: Nɛ basa nɛ baa keni kade na so na bee kulti m ba tu ma m bri ma, n doro ma nseŋ suge ma kusɔbuuso.

english_verse: Young women of Jerusalem, if you find the one I love, please say to him, “She is weak with desire.” Their Friends Speak:
translation_verse: Jerusalɛm be beche, meeŋ kaŋ wu n jipo, manɛ nɛ menyeeŋ kaŋɛ mo? Men kaŋɛ mo fanɛ kasha shin nɛ mee lɔ. Eche na be kashɛ

english_verse: Most beautiful of women, why is the one you love more special than others? Why do you ask us to tell him how you feel? She Speaks:

english_verse: He is handsome and healthy, the most outstanding among ten thousand.
translation_verse: N jipo walɛ keyɛrbi nna, nsaa kɔ eleŋ nɛnɛ. E wɔ basa ŋgboŋ kudu gba to feeŋ wu mo.

english_verse: His head is purest gold; his hair is wavy, black as a raven.
translation_verse: Mbe kumu du nna fanɛ shuwa, nɛ mbe emin du mɔlɔ mɔlɔ nseŋ biri gbiti gbiti fanɛ mɔmɔ na.

translation_verse: Jerusalɛmebi, menyi be bewuraana nɛ basa kikɛ du fanɛ Sodɔm nɛ Gomɔra be basa nna. Men kaŋ asoe n nu kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee kaŋɛ nseŋ wɔtɔ lakal kusɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ bee ŋini menyi to.

english_verse: “Your sacrifices mean nothing to me. I am sick of your offerings of rams and choice cattle; I don't like the blood of bulls or lambs or goats.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ yɛ: “Men tama fanɛ mee sha esarga nɛ menyee lara a sa ma ere kikɛ nna a? Mbolpɔ nɛ asɔbɔya pɔtɛ be eblaŋ be alela akpa nɛ menyee chɔɔ a lara esarga a sa ma na fi ma. Ma alɛ maŋ naa sha egbolu nɛ mbolpɔ nɛ mboe be ŋklaŋ gba.

english_verse: Your sacrifices are worthless, and your incense disgusting. I can't stand the evil you do on your New Moon Festivals or on your Sabbaths and other times of worship.
translation_verse: Esarga nɛ menyee bar na kikɛ maŋ kɔ tɔnɔ. Ŋ kishi eduwu nɛ menyee chɔɔ na be efɛa nna ga. Ma alɛ maa sha Kufɔl Popɔr nɛ Kewushiachɛ be nchɛgboŋana nɛ menyi be kabɔrɛshuŋ be nshɛrana be asheŋ. Men wora alubi nna n jija amo.

english_verse: I hate your New Moon Festivals and all others as well. They are a heavy burden I am tired of carrying.
translation_verse: Ŋ kishi menyi be Kufɔl Popɔr be Nchɛgboŋ nɛ nchɛ cheembiana kikɛ nna. A du fanɛ esulɔ gbɛgbɛso nɛ amo be kesulɔ shin nɛ ŋ gben nna.

english_verse: I, the Lord, invite you to come and talk it over. Your sins are scarlet red, but they will be whiter than snow or wool.
translation_verse: Ade be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ le: “Naniere, men shin nɛ an ji kesheŋ na. Kulubi shin nɛ men pere kpeŋ fanɛ ŋklaŋ, ama meeŋ fɔr menyi so nɛ men fuli parr a chɔ ateebi.

english_verse: If you willingly obey me, the best crops in the land will be yours.
translation_verse: Nɛ menyeeŋ baa wora ma kasonu bre, menyeeŋ baa nya asɔ lela kasawule ere so a ji.

english_verse: But if you turn against me, your enemies will kill you. I, the Lord, have spoken. The Lord Condemns Jerusalem
translation_verse: Ama nɛ men kplaŋ ma so bre, kumo ere menyeeŋ wu kena to. Ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na, e kaŋɛ na.” Kadegboŋ lubi na be asheŋ

english_verse: Jerusalem, you are like an unfaithful wife. Once your judges were honest and your people lived right; now you are a city full of murderers.
translation_verse: Menyi Jerusalɛmebi nɛ men daa ji kashenteŋ na, chɛrga nna a wora asheŋ fanɛ sakaleche. Basa nɛ b niŋi e daŋ bɔlɔ menyi be kadegboŋ to jemanɛ ko, ama naniere basa nɛ baa mɔ basa nawule e ka kumo to.

english_verse: Your leaders have rejected me to become friends of crooks; your rulers are looking for gifts and bribes. Widows and orphans never get a fair trial.
translation_verse: Menyi be bejuŋkparpoana kini fanɛ m maaŋ naa wɔ bumo nseŋ ya ji beyu keteri. B wɔtɔ nna a sɔ ŋkɛ nɛ asɔ basa kutɔ pɔɛŋ nsaa wora asheŋ a sa bumo. B maa kɔ a sa bemunibi ashi demujikpa, ŋko a nya asoe a nu asheŋ ashi bekulpoche kutɔ.

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the mighty ruler of Israel, and I make you a promise: You are now my enemy, and I will show my anger by taking revenge on you.
translation_verse: Amoso, naniere men nu kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpetale Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ lempo na bee kaŋɛ. E yɛ: “Meeŋ wora n tal menyi nɛ men la n doŋana ere to, nɛ menyi maaŋ naa wora asheŋ a tɔrɔ ma.

english_verse: I will punish you terribly and burn away everything that makes you unfit to worship me.
translation_verse: Meeŋ gberge menyi kusoe kenishipereso nɛ ebɔl e lar menyi. Meeŋ lara eyurpi menyi so fanɛ kananɛ baa ta edɛ a lara eyurpi ashi abɛlso to na.

english_verse: Jerusalem, I will choose judges and advisors like those you had before. Your new name will be “Justice and Faithfulness.” The Lord Will Save Jerusalem
translation_verse: Ma alɛ beeŋ sa menyi bewura nɛ besoetojipo nɛ b du fanɛ bumo nɛ men daa kɔ dra na. Ŋ kaŋ wora loŋ, baaŋ naa tre Jerusalɛm Kadegboŋ Niŋiso nɛ Kashenteŋji be Kakpa.”

english_verse: Jerusalem, you will be saved by showing justice; Zion's people who turn to me will be saved by doing right.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ka niŋi so, e beeŋ mɔlga Jerusalɛm nɛ esa kama nɛ e beeŋ tuba n lar alubi to ashi ndoŋ.

english_verse: Your strongest leaders will be like dry wood set on fire by their idols. No one will be able to help, as they all go up in flames.
translation_verse: Kananɛ edɛbi beeŋ tiŋ n shin nɛ afitiri wɔlso e chɔɔ m mur na nɛ menyi to be bejuŋkparpo lempoana gbagba be asheŋ lubi beeŋ mur bumo nɛ esa kikɛ maaŋ tiŋ n chɛ bumo to.

english_verse: In the future, the mountain with the Lord's temple will be the highest of all. It will reach above the hills; every nation will rush to it.
translation_verse: Lalaloge be nchɛ na to kebee nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be bɔrɛlambu na yil so na beeŋ ba ki abee kikɛ to be kejeŋgreŋ, nɛ efuli damtaana be basa e shile m ba kumo ase

english_verse: People of Israel, let's live by the light of the Lord. Following Sinful Customs
translation_verse: Naniere, Israɛlebi, men shin nɛ an baa wora asheŋ ashi Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be kefulto nɛ kebaanyi mbe kebaawɔtɔ to! Ŋkpensheŋ ka maaŋ naa wɔtɔ be asheŋ

english_verse: Our Lord, you have deserted your people, Israel, because they follow customs of nations from the east. They worship Philistine gods and are close friends of foreigners.
translation_verse: O Ebɔrɛ, fo kplaŋ Israɛlebi nɛ b la fo basa so, ŋkpal b ka yɔ efuli pɔtɛana nɛ a wɔ epeŋilarkpa be kaba so be bekpalpo kutɔ so. B daa luri Filisti be efuli so be belejipo so nna nseŋ daŋ naa tu nnyamase a ji keteri.

english_verse: Everywhere in the country they worship the idols they have made.
translation_verse: B daa shuŋ agbirana nɛ bumo gbagba lɔŋɛ ashi efuli na be kaplɛkama nna.

english_verse: And so, all of them will be ashamed and disgraced. Don't forgive them! A Day of Judgment
translation_verse: Amoso, bumo kikɛ beeŋ ŋaba nseŋ ji anishinyɔr. Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, sa maŋ ta m paŋ bumo!

english_verse: Every one of you, go hide among the rocks and in the ground, because the Lord is fearsome, marvelous, and glorious.
translation_verse: Bumo kikɛ beeŋ shile n ya ŋana abeelaŋ to ŋko n ya kur kasawule n luri to a fin keshile ŋ ŋana Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be agbo nɛ mbe eleŋgboŋ nɛ kemaŋkura so.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful has chosen a day when those who are proud and conceited will be put down.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na lara kachako nna n yili nɛ e bar bekama nɛ baa maŋ bumo be amu so nsaa wu bumo be amu na kaseto.

english_verse: The tall and towering cedars of Lebanon will be destroyed. So will the oak trees of Bashan,
translation_verse: Lebanɔn be efuli so be ndibi tenteŋ ga nɛ baa tre Sida na beeŋ mur. Aloŋ nɛ ndibi gboŋgboŋi nɛ a wɔ Bashan be efuli so gba beeŋ mur.

english_verse: all the seagoing ships, and every beautiful boat.
translation_verse: Teku so be ekuloŋgboŋ lela kikɛ beeŋ mur nchu to.

english_verse: When that day comes, everyone who is proud will be put down. Only the Lord will be honored.
translation_verse: Kachɛ na kaŋ fo, baaŋ bar esa kama nɛ e bee maŋ mbe kumu so nɛ ekama nɛ e bee fɛ fanɛ e shi ga kaseto. Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nawule e naaŋ nya kemaŋkura.

english_verse: Idols will be gone for good.
translation_verse: Agbirana maaŋ naa wɔtɔ kuraa.

english_verse: You had better hide in caves and holes— the Lord will be fearsome, marvelous, and glorious when he comes to terrify people on earth.
translation_verse: Jemanɛ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ shin nɛ durnya e gbuŋgbuŋ na, basa beeŋ shile n ya ŋana abeelaŋ to, ŋko n ya kur kasawule n luri to ŋ ŋana, a fin keshile ŋ ŋana Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be agbo nɛ mbe eleŋgboŋ nɛ kemaŋkura so.

english_verse: On that day everyone will throw to the moles and bats their idols of silver and gold they made to worship.
translation_verse: Kamɔnchɛ na kaŋ fo, ekama beeŋ ta mbe shuwa nɛ gbiti be agbirana nɛ e lɔŋɛ a shuŋ na n lɛ eshiboe nɛ ekɔŋkɔŋ.

english_verse: The Lord will be fearsome, marvelous, and glorious when he comes to terrify people on earth— they will hide in caves and in the hills.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋ ba nɛ e ba gbuŋgbuŋ kasawule na, basa beeŋ shile n ya ŋana amaŋ nɛ abeelaŋ to a fin keŋana Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be agbo nɛ eleŋgboŋ nɛ kemaŋkura so.

english_verse: Stop trusting the power of humans. They are all going to die, so how can they help?
translation_verse: Men yige kebaata yirda a wɔtɔ dimɛdi be eleŋ to. Dimɛdi kikɛ beeŋ wu. Amoso dimɛdi maaŋ tiŋ n chɛ menyi to?

english_verse: You will each be cruel to friends and neighbors. Young people will insult their elders; no one will show respect to those who deserve it.
translation_verse: Basa beeŋ baa kɔrfɛ abar. Mbifɔlbi maaŋ baa sa bumo be benimuana bunyaŋ. Basa jiga maaŋ naa bunyaŋ basa nɛ b daga bunyaŋ.

english_verse: Some of you will grab hold of a relative and say, “You still have a coat. Be our leader and rule this pile of ruins.”
translation_verse: Jemanɛ ko bee ba nɛ kanaŋ to be kabuna ko be basa e lara bumo gbagba to be esa nseŋ kaŋɛ mo le: “Fo e kɔ asɔbuuso, amoso ki anyi be ejuŋkparpo ashi tɔrɔ be jemanɛ ere to.”

english_verse: But the answer will be, “I can't do you any good. Don't make me your leader. There's no food or clothing left in my house.”
translation_verse: Ama amodoŋwura beeŋ kaŋɛ bumo le: “Mannɛ ma ere! M maŋ tiŋ n chɛ menyi to. Ma alɛ gba maŋ kɔ ajibi ŋko asɔbuuso. Men sa maŋ ta ma ŋ ki menyi be ejuŋkparpo!”

english_verse: Jerusalem and Judah, you rebelled against your glorious Lord— your words and your actions, made you stumble and fall.
translation_verse: Kashenteŋto, asheŋ maaŋ nyalɛ n sa Jerusalɛmebi! Juda be efuli so malɛ baa mur nna na! Kusɔ kama nɛ baa kaŋɛ ŋko a wora bee gbiti Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nna. Baa tege Ebɔrɛ ekama be anishito nna.

english_verse: The look on your faces shows that you are sinful as Sodom, and you don't try to hide it. You are in for trouble, and you have brought it all on yourselves. The Wrong Kind of Leaders
translation_verse: Kananɛ bumo be anishiakpaana du na e naa ji shɛda a gbiti bumo. Baa wora alubi nna a maŋ naa ta amo a ŋana fanɛ kananɛ kade nɛ baa tre Sodɔm na be basa daa wora na nna. Asheŋ maaŋ nyalɛ n sa bumo. Bumo alɛ gbagba e bar kumu lubi gboŋgboŋi bumo be amu so.

english_verse: Tell those who obey God, “You're very fortunate— you will be rewarded for what you have done.”
translation_verse: Kaŋɛ basa nɛ b niŋi na fanɛ asheŋ beeŋ nite nɛnɛ n sa bumo ere. Baaŋ nya bumo be kegben be tɔnɔ.

english_verse: Tell those who disobey, “You're in big trouble— what you did to others will come back to you.”
translation_verse: Ama asheŋ maaŋ nyalɛ n sa basa lubi na bre. Kusɔ nɛ b ta n wora basa ko na e naaŋ wora bumo alɛ gba naniere.

english_verse: Though you are God's people, you are ruled and abused by women and children. You are confused by leaders who guide you down the wrong path.
translation_verse: Mbifɔlbi nɛ beche e naa ji kuwura ma basa so nsaa kɔrfɛ bumo ga. Ma basa, menyi be bejuŋkparpoana maa juŋkpar menyi nɛnɛ, amoso menyi maŋ nyi ekpa nɛ menyeeŋ bɔla so n wora asheŋ. Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ka ji mbe basa demu be asheŋ

english_verse: He will even judge you rulers and leaders of his own nation. You destroyed his vineyard and filled your houses by robbing the poor.
translation_verse: E bee shin nɛ e ji mbe basa be benimuana nɛ bejuŋkparpoana demu nseŋ kaŋɛ le a laŋɛ bumo be kaplɛa so: “Men chɔɔ ma adɔjibi m mur nseŋ nyaŋ betirpo n suge asɔ m bɔlɔ menyi be elaŋana.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful says, “You have crushed my people and rubbed in the dirt the faces of the poor.” The Women of Jerusalem
translation_verse: Menyi alɛ maŋ kɔ ekpa nɛ men nyaŋ ma basa n wɔtɔ nsaa ta betirpo fanɛ b maŋ la shɛŋ ŋkpal bumo be ketir so. Ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na e kaŋɛ na.” Jerusalɛm to be beche be asheŋ

english_verse: The Lord says: The women of Jerusalem are proud and strut around, winking shamelessly. They wear anklets that jingle and call attention to the way they walk.
translation_verse: Kede be kaman, nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ le: “Keni kananɛ Jerusalɛm to be beche bee wu bumo be amu loŋ! Baa nite boeŋ boeŋ nna a keni a fin fanɛ benyɛn e baa wu bumo nsaa yɛlga bumo jemanɛ kikɛ. Baa nite nna nɛ bumo be anampase bee gbri.

english_verse: But I, the Lord, will cover their heads with sores, and I will uncover their private parts.
translation_verse: Amoso ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ gberge bumo kusoe nseŋ she bumo be amu kɔlikɔli.”

english_verse: When that day comes, I will take away from those women all the fine jewelry they wear on their ankles, heads, necks, ears, arms, noses, fingers, and on their clothes. I will remove their veils, their belts, their perfume, their magic charms, their royal robes, and all their fancy dresses, hats, and purses.
translation_verse: Kachako bee ba nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e suge Jerusalɛm to be beche be abitasɔ nɛ baa wɔtɔ bumo be aya so nɛ amu so nɛ abɔ to nɛ asoe to nɛ mbre so nɛ mmuna to nɛ ashilbi to na, nɛ bumo be asɔbuuso so kikɛ. E beeŋ suge bumo be eshata nɛ ekreso nɛ etulale nɛ a bee shin nɛ bumo be kebita bee gberge benyɛn a sa bumo na. Mo alɛ beeŋ naaŋ suge bumo be nle nɛ baa buu fanɛ bewurche na nɛ bumo be asɔbuuso lela nɛ nwuro nɛ enɔ to be ebagiwurbiana kikɛ.

english_verse: In place of perfume, there will be a stink; in place of belts, there will be ropes; in place of fancy hairdos, they will have bald heads. Instead of expensive clothes, they will wear sackcloth; instead of beauty, they will have ugly scars.
translation_verse: Beche na beeŋ baa ka dufɛ nyaŋnyaŋ ŋkpal b ka maaŋ naa gbiti etulale eyurana so so. B maaŋ naa nya a mɛa to a kre so. Baaŋ baa yige bumo be epiŋi nna nɛ a baa sha bumo so kanaŋkama loŋ. Bumo alɛ beeŋ she kɔlikɔli nseŋ buu asɔ farbi, nɛ bumo be kebita e terge nɛ anishinyɔr e pɛ bumo.

english_verse: When this happens, seven women will grab the same man, and each of them will say, “I'll buy my own food and clothes! Just marry me and take away my disgrace.” The Lord Will Bless His People Who Survive
translation_verse: Jemanɛ na kaŋ fo malɛ, beche ashunu beeŋ baa shil a buu enyɛn koŋwule so a kaŋɛ le: “Anyeeŋ tiŋ a bela nsaa buu anyi be amu, jande, fo ere e baŋ shuli nɛ an baa tre fo anyi kul, saŋɛ na so anyi maaŋ ji nyɔmɔ ŋkpal anyi ka maa kil so.” Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ka beeŋ nɛfa mbe basa nɛ baaŋ ka be asheŋ

english_verse: The time is coming when the Lord will make his land fruitful and glorious again, and the people of Israel who survive will take great pride in what the land produces.
translation_verse: To, jemanɛ ko bee ba nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e shin nɛ adɔjibi nɛ ndibi kikɛ e daŋ n nyalɛ a walɛ. Saŋɛ na so nɛ Israɛl be basa kama nɛ baaŋ ji efute na be ŋgbene e fuli kasawule na be adɔjibi so nɛ b baa puchi amo so.

english_verse: Everyone who is left alive in Jerusalem will be called special,
translation_verse: Baaŋ baa tre Jerusalɛm to be esa kama nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na shin nɛ e ji efute na esa cheembi.

english_verse: Then the Lord will cover the whole city and its meeting places with a thick cloud each day and with a flaming fire each night. God's own glory will be like a huge tent that covers everything.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e shin nɛ kuwɔlpa e baa buu kebee nɛ baa tre Zayɔn na nɛ bekama nɛ b gama ndoŋ na so kapaso nseŋ shin nɛ edishi nɛ edɛ wuloŋwuloŋ nɛ kefulto e baa buu kumo so kanyɛso. Ebɔrɛ be kemaŋkura beeŋ baa buu kadegboŋ na kikɛ so a kuŋ kumo.

english_verse: It will provide shade from the heat of the sun and a place of shelter and protection from storms and rain.
translation_verse: Mbe kemaŋkura beeŋ baa wora kiyoyul a buu kadegboŋ na so a kuŋ kumo ashi epeŋi be ebeldɛ so nseŋ shin nɛ k baa la kesɔnyige be kakpa a kuŋ basa ashi bɔrɛ nɛ afugboŋ to.

english_verse: My friend dug the ground, removed the stones, and planted the best vines. He built a watchtower and dug a pit in rocky ground for pressing the grapes. He hoped they would be sweet, but bitter grapes were all it produced.
translation_verse: N teri na daŋ pulgi kasawule na to nna, n tise kumo so be ajembu kikɛ pɔɛŋ; nseŋ duu afeelebi lela kumo so. Kumo be kaman nɛ e pɔr egbal a kuŋ amo, nseŋ pɔr ebu jeŋgreŋ ko nɛ baaŋ baa yili so a keni kudɔ na nseŋ kur kemaŋ nɛ baaŋ baa nyaŋ asɔrso na a wɔtɔ. E daa tama fanɛ asɔrso na beeŋ wora nɛnɛ nseŋ pere a wɔ ebel nna, ama amo kikɛ daa du nyaŋnyaŋ nna.

english_verse: What more could I have done for my vineyard? I hoped for sweet grapes, but bitter grapes were all that grew.
translation_verse: Kusɔ ko daga fanɛ n wora kudɔ na to nɛ m maŋ wora kumo a? Nɛ manɛ e ba nɛ ndibi na bee sɔr asɔrso nyaŋnyaŋso? Mannɛ asɔrso lela nɛ mee sha a?

english_verse: Now I will let you know what I am going to do. I will cut down the hedge and tear down the wall. My vineyard will be trampled and left in ruins.
translation_verse: Kusɔ nɛ meeŋ wora ma ndibi sɔrso be kudɔ na e la fanɛ, meeŋ lara kunji nɛ k kulti kumo na nseŋ bure egbal nɛ k bee kuŋ kumo na nna, nɛ kupuŋ to be asɔbɔya e ba ji ndibi sɔrso na nseŋ chichi amo so m mata kasawule.

english_verse: You are in for trouble! You take over house after house and field after field, until there is no room left for anyone else in all the land.
translation_verse: Asheŋ maaŋ nyalɛ n sa menyi! Menyi bee tɔ nwu nɛ nsawule damta a ti amo nɛ men chɛr a kɔ so nna. K maaŋ chɛr nɛ kakpa maaŋ naa wɔtɔ nɛ esa kikɛ e naaŋ ba chena so. Menyi nawule e naaŋ ka kasawule na so.

english_verse: But the Lord All-Powerful has made this promise to me: Those large and beautiful homes will be left empty, with no one to take care of them.
translation_verse: N daŋ nu Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na ka kaŋɛ le: “Nwu gboŋgboŋi lela ere kikɛ beeŋ ki alambure nɛ esa kikɛ maaŋ naa wɔ amo to.

english_verse: None of them are tired. They don't sleep or get drowsy, and they run without stumbling. Their belts don't come loose; their sandal straps don't break.
translation_verse: Bumo be ekama maa gben kikɛ; ekama malɛ maa fiti gba. Edi maa la bumo gba a bishi nɛ baa di. Bumo alɛ be ekreso maa yɔɔ nɛ bumo be asɛbta be efɔlana maa tuge kikɛ.

english_verse: You are in for trouble! The lies you tell are like ropes by which you drag along sin and evil.
translation_verse: Asheŋ maaŋ nyalɛ n sa menyi! Menyi maaŋ tiŋ n suge menyi be amu ashi menyi be alubi to.

english_verse: You are in for trouble! You get up early to start drinking, and you keep it up late into the night.
translation_verse: Asheŋ kraa maaŋ nyalɛ n sa menyi nɛ menyeeŋ koso n fara kasanuu kachipurdidi hale nɛ kaaseso e ya fo nɛ menyi kraa boo ere.

english_verse: At your drinking parties you have the music of stringed instruments, tambourines, and flutes. But you never even think about all the Lord has done,
translation_verse: Ejaŋjilaŋ nɛ echakachaka nɛ nlopi nɛ yabra nɛ menyee ta a ji menyi be amu ashi menyi be kasanuu be kejigboŋana to, ama menyi maa kaa fɛ asɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na wora be asheŋ.

english_verse: and so his people know nothing about him. That's why many of you will be dragged off to foreign lands. Your leaders will starve to death, and everyone else will suffer from thirst.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal loŋ so menyi maŋ nyi shɛŋ a laŋɛ mbe kaplɛa so. Amoso men doŋana beeŋ ba pɛ menyi be galeŋga ŋ ki anya katiŋ so n yɔ efuli pɔtɛ so. Akoŋ beeŋ mɔ menyi be bejuŋkparpoana nɛ achukoŋ e mɔ basa damta malɛ.

english_verse: The world of the dead has opened its mouth wide and is eagerly waiting for the leaders of Jerusalem and for its noisy crowds, especially for those who take pride in that city.
translation_verse: Bubuni wora shiriya nna m bela ase a jo Jerusalɛm to be bejuŋkparpoana na nɛ jimaŋ damta nɛ baa cha awɔr na, fɔŋfɔŋ bumo nɛ baa puchi kadegboŋ na so na.

english_verse: Its citizens have been put down, and its proud people have been brought to shame.
translation_verse: Nyɔmɔ beeŋ pɛ ekama. Bekama nɛ baa maŋ bumo be amu so na beeŋ ba kaseto.

english_verse: But the holy Lord God All-Powerful is praised, because he has shown who he is by bringing justice.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na bre bee wora kusɔ nɛ k daga nna a ŋini mbe keshi, nsaa ji mbe basa demu a lara mbe kecheembiya efuli.

english_verse: His people will be like sheep grazing in their own pasture, and they will take off what was left by others.
translation_verse: Ndegboŋana na be alambure to nɛ mbolpɔ fɔlbi nɛ mboe fɔlbi beeŋ ta ŋ ki amo be ejikpa a ji afitiri.

english_verse: And you are great at drinking and mixing drinks. But you are in for trouble.
translation_verse: Asheŋ maaŋ nyalɛ n sa menyi! Nsa be keta n wea abar to n nuu bre be kaplɛa so, men la egoni nna nɛ esa kikɛ maŋ fo menyi so!

english_verse: You will go up in flames like straw and hay! You have rejected the teaching of the holy Lord God All-Powerful of Israel. Now your roots will rot, and your blossoms will turn to dust.
translation_verse: Kananɛ atuweklaŋ nɛ afitiri bee wɔl nsaa ji edɛ na nɛ menyi alɛ gba beeŋ ji edɛ nɛ menyi be nliŋi e bɛ nɛ menyi be atoto malɛ e wɔl nɛ afu e gbaŋgbaŋ amo n lɛ! Ŋkpal manɛ so, men kini kesɔ Enyɛnpetale Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ cheembi na be keŋini na.

english_verse: You are the Lord's people, but you made him terribly angry, and he struck you with his mighty arm. Mountains shook, and dead bodies covered the streets like garbage. The Lord is still angry, and he is ready to strike you again. Foreign Nations Will Attack
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nya agbo ga nna n wɔtɔ mbe basa nsaa shin nɛ e gberge bumo kusoe kenishipereso. Abee beeŋ gbuŋgbuŋ nɛ basa e wu n dese agbembiana so fanɛ epi na. Ama amo nɛ amo kikɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be agbo kraa maaŋ wushi. E kraa beeŋ baa sha kegberge menyi kusoe n ti so.

english_verse: The Lord has signaled for the foreign nations to come and attack you. He has already whistled, and they are coming as fast as they can.
translation_verse: Kasogberge na be kaman, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ere beeŋ pal enɔ n tre efuli pɔtɛana nɛ a wɔ kufɔ kufɔ be basa nɛ b ba kɔ menyi kena. E beeŋ foŋ kafoli nna n tre bumo nɛ b nya manaŋ n shi durnya be lalaloge kikɛ m ba fanɛ afu na!

english_verse: Their arrows are sharp, and their bows are ready. The hoofs of their horses are hard as flint; the wheels of their war chariots turn as fast as a whirlwind.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman, bumo be akpaana du pɛlpɛlbi nna nɛ bumo alɛ wora shiriya a jo nɛ b to bumo be ata. Bumo be egbaŋɛ be alotobi du kpakpa fanɛ awarabi nna, nɛ bumo be kena to be egbaŋɛturko malɛ be aya bee kilgi to manaŋ manaŋ fanɛ kawuliwuli na.

english_verse: They roar and growl like fierce young lions as they grab their victims and drag them off where no one can rescue them.
translation_verse: Bumo be benapoana bee munto nna fanɛ ebuluŋ ka pɛ kusɔbɔya nsaa gbeye kumo a yɔ kakpa nɛ shɛŋ maaŋ tiŋ n suge kumo bumo kutɔ na.

english_verse: On the day they attack, they will roar like the ocean. And across the land you will see nothing but darkness and trouble, because the light of day will be covered by thick clouds.
translation_verse: Kachɛ nɛ baaŋ kre kena m ba na, baaŋ munto fanɛ teku ka bee kaa ketili a gbri na. Tentembiri nɛ kebagato beeŋ sɔ efuli na kikɛ so, ŋkpal manɛ so kuwɔlpa nɛ k biri to beeŋ buu kefulto nɛ k wɔtɔ kabre ere kikɛ so.

english_verse: In the year that King Uzziah died, I had a vision of the Lord. He was on his throne high above, and his robe filled the temple.
translation_verse: Kafɛ nɛ ewura Uzzaya wu na nɛ ŋ ku bɔrɛdare n wu Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nɛ e tase mbe kuwurputi so kemaŋkura nɛ bunyanso. Mbe kuwurpiŋi daŋ sɔ bɔrɛlambu na be kaplɛkama nna.

english_verse: Flaming creatures with six wings each were flying over him. They covered their faces with two of their wings and their bodies with two more. They used the other two wings for flying,
translation_verse: Nɛ asɔbɔya keniso nɛ baa suse so fanɛ edɛ be adondulombi na yili ŋ kulti mo. Bumo be ekama daa kɔ mbuibi be aba ashe nna. Asɔbɔya na be ekama daŋ ta mbe mbuibi be aba anyɔ nna m buu mbe anishiakpa so nseŋ ta anyɔ m buu mbe eyur so nseŋ ta anyɔ nɛ a ka na a firgi.

english_verse: as they shouted, “Holy, holy, holy, Lord All-Powerful! The earth is filled with your glory.”
translation_verse: Bumo alɛ daa ponte awɔrso nna a shoŋi abar a kaŋɛ le: “Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na nawule e du cheembi! Mbe kemaŋkura e bɔlɔ durnya kikɛ nyam to.”

english_verse: As they shouted, the doorposts of the temple shook, and the temple was filled with smoke.
translation_verse: Asɔbɔya keniso na be ebɔl be awɔr na daŋ shin nɛ bɔrɛlambu na be gbaltɔlase daa gbuŋgbuŋ nna, nɛ edishi malɛ sɔ kumo kikɛ to.

english_verse: Then I cried out, “I'm doomed! Everything I say is sinful, and so are the words of everyone around me. Yet I have seen the King, the Lord All-Powerful.”
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ le: “Tama maaŋ naa wɔtɔ n sa ma nna na! Asheŋ maaŋ nyalɛ n sa ma, ŋkpal manɛ so, kamalga kikɛ nɛ k beeŋ lar ma kɔnɔ to la kulubi nna. Ma alɛ nɛ basa nɛ bumo be mmalga kikɛ la alubi e wɔtɔ, ama ma alɛ wu Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na kenishiso.”

english_verse: One of the flaming creatures flew over to me with a burning coal that it had taken from the altar with a pair of metal tongs.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ asɔbɔya na be eko ta beterɛ n lara kejanwulɛbi ashi ebɔrɛso be bɔrɛsure na so n firgi ŋ gbelge to m ba

english_verse: It touched my lips with the hot coal and said, “This has touched your lips. Your sins are forgiven, and you are no longer guilty.”
translation_verse: beta ma kɔnɔpurbi nseŋ kaŋɛ le: “Kede beta fo kɔnɔpurbi nna na. Fo nya alubi be ketampaŋ nsaa maŋ naa la esa nɛ e wora n jija nna na.”

english_verse: After this, I heard the Lord ask, “Is there anyone I can send? Will someone speak for us?” “I'll go,” I answered. “Send me!”
translation_verse: Kede be kaman nɛ n nu Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ka kaŋɛ le: “Wanɛ nɛ meeŋ shuŋi? Wanɛ e naaŋ baa la anyi be kabɔ?” Nɛ n shuli ŋ kaŋɛ: “Meeŋ yɔ! Shuŋi ma!”

english_verse: Then the Lord told me to go and speak this message to the people: “You will listen and listen, but never understand. You will look and look, but never see.” The Lord also said,
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ e kaŋɛ ma fanɛ n ta kubɔya ere n ya sa mbe basa. E yɛ “Kanaŋkama nɛ men nu asheŋ gba, menyi maaŋ pin amo to. Kanaŋkama malɛ nɛ men keni asheŋ, menyi maaŋ pin kusɔ nɛ k bee wora na to.”

english_verse: Then I asked the Lord, “How long will this last?” The Lord answered: Until their towns are destroyed and their houses are deserted, until their fields are empty,
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ m bishi Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na le: “Jemanɛ mo nɛ kede beeŋ fo ekar?” Nɛ e kaŋɛ ma le: “Jemanɛ nɛ ndegboŋana na beeŋ mur nɛ amo to be nwuana e ka a yil fuloŋ nɛ amo to be adɔsawule e dese jiga na nɛ k beeŋ fo ekar.

english_verse: and I have sent them far away, leaving their land in ruins.
translation_verse: Meeŋ yɛr basa na kakpa wɔfɔ nseŋ shin nɛ kasawule na kikɛ e ki jiga a dese fuloŋ.

english_verse: If only a tenth of the people are left, even they will be destroyed. But just as stumps remain after trees have been cut down, some of my chosen ones will be left.
translation_verse: Basa kudu to be esa koŋwule gba ka kasawule na so, mo alɛ gba beeŋ mur. E beeŋ ki fanɛ kedibi gboŋgboŋi nɛ b ku n lɛ be keyimu.”

english_verse: When news reached the royal palace that Syria had joined forces with Israel, King Ahaz and everyone in Judah were so terrified that they shook like trees in a windstorm.
translation_verse: Juda be ewura ka daŋ nu fanɛ Siriya be efuli so be benapo ba ti Israɛl be benapo so, nɛ kufu pɛ ewura Ahaz nɛ mbe basa kikɛ ga nɛ baa chicha fanɛ afu ka bee ber ndibi so na.

english_verse: Then the Lord said to me: Take your son Shearjashub and go see King Ahaz. You will find him on the road near the cloth makers' shops at the end of the canal that brings water from the upper pool.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ anebi Aizaaya le: “Keta fo pibinyɛn nɛ baa tre Shiya Jashub nɛ kumo be kifito la Basa gbrɛbi e naaŋ bɛta m ba na, nɛ men yɔ ewura Ahaz kutɔ. Menyeeŋ ya wu mo ashi ekpa nɛ k dese m mata kɔrɛwuraana na be eshuŋkpa nɛ k wɔ nchu be kubɔr nɛ k shi esoso a ba kadegboŋ na be lalaloge to na ase.

english_verse: Tell Ahaz to stop worrying. There's no need for him to be afraid of King Rezin and King Pekah. They are very angry, but they are nothing more than a dying fire. Ahaz doesn't need to fear
translation_verse: Men kaŋ wu mo nɛ fo kaŋɛ mo fanɛ e shin nɛ mbe kagbene e dese mo. E saa maa ŋana ewura Rezin nɛ ewura Pɛka. B nya agbo ga bre, ama bumo alɛ baa du fanɛ ndibi anyɔ ka kɔ edɛ nsaa dese a duŋ gbrɛgbrɛbi nna.

english_verse: I, the Lord, promise that this will never happen.
translation_verse: Ama ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na e kaŋɛ fanɛ loŋ maaŋ wora kikɛ.

english_verse: Damascus is just the capital of Syria, and King Rezin rules only in Damascus. Samaria is just the capital of Israel, and King Pekah rules only in Samaria. But in less than
translation_verse: Israɛl be efuli na maŋ kɔ eleŋ a chɔ kumo be kadegboŋ nɛ baa tre Samɛria na, nɛ Samɛria malɛ maŋ kɔ eleŋ a chɔ ewura Pɛka. Nɛ Juda be ewura, Ahaz, nɛ mbe benimuana maŋ yirda ma bre, baaŋ kɔ n tɔr.” Immanuɛl be tɔɔnɛ be asheŋ

english_verse: Once again the Lord God spoke to King Ahaz. This time he said,
translation_verse: Kede be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naŋ ta kubɔya ere n ya sa ewura Ahaz.

english_verse: “Ask me for proof that my promise will come true. Ask for something to happen deep in the world of the dead or high in the heavens above.”
translation_verse: E yɛ: “Kule Enyɛnpe fo Ebɔrɛ na nɛ e sa fo tɔɔnɛ ko a ŋini fanɛ kusɔ nɛ e kaŋɛ na beeŋ wora m bɔlɔ so. K beeŋ tiŋ n shi kasawule be kechimbi to ŋko ebɔrɛso.”

english_verse: Then I said: Listen, every one of you in the royal family of David. You have already tried my patience. Now you are trying God's patience by refusing to ask for proof.
translation_verse: Nɛ Aizaaya malɛ kaŋɛ le: “Ewura Deevid be kamanebi, men kaŋ asoe n nu nfe. Menyee kaa wora edimɛdi a keni. Menyee sha kewora Ebɔrɛ gba nna ŋ keni a?

english_verse: But the Lord will still give you proof. A virgin is pregnant; she will have a son and will name him Immanuel.
translation_verse: To, kumo ere Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na gbagba e naaŋ sa anyi tɔɔnɛ. Kasuŋgurbia nɛ e maŋ nyi enyɛn ŋ ku so beeŋ di kedampo ŋ kurge ebinyɛn nseŋ nase mo ketre Immanuɛl. Kumo be kifito e la fanɛ Ebɔrɛ wɔ anyi kutɔ.

english_verse: Even before the boy is old enough to know how to choose between right and wrong, he will eat yogurt and honey, and the countries of the two kings you fear will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Ama pɔɛŋ nɛ loŋ be jemanɛ malɛ e fo, bewura anyɔ nɛ fee ŋana na be nsawule beeŋ mur a dese fuloŋ.

english_verse: But the Lord will make more trouble for your people and your kingdom than any of you have known since Israel broke away from Judah. He will even bring the king of Assyria to attack you. The Threat of an Invasion
translation_verse: Ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ shin nɛ etɔrɔ damta nɛ a chɔ etɔrɔ kama nɛ a daŋ ba menyi so, yili jemanɛ nɛ Israɛl nɛ Juda be kuwurji barga to m ba fo kabre na, e ba fo nɛ fo basa nɛ fo tuto be laŋ to ebi kikɛ so. E beeŋ shin nɛ efuli nɛ baa tre Asiriya na be ewura gba e ba kɔ menyi kena.

english_verse: They will settle everywhere—in the deep valleys and between the rocks, on every thornbush and all over the pastureland.
translation_verse: Baaŋ mel abar so n sɔ ataŋɛ chiŋgeliŋ to nɛ abeelaŋ to nɛ kupuŋ to kikɛ nɛ asɔbɔya be ejikpa kikɛ so n chena.

english_verse: The Lord will pay the king of Assyria to bring a razor from across the Euphrates River and shave your head and every hair on your body, including your beard.
translation_verse: Jemanɛ na kaŋ fo, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ ber wonjomu paa ashi lɔrgboŋ nɛ baa tre Yufreetes na be kaba ndoŋ m ba she menyi be ntɔl nɛ menyi be amu nɛ eyur so be afuibi. Mo e naaŋ baa la Asiriya be efuli so be ewurgboŋ na.

english_verse: Anyone who is able to save only one young cow and two sheep,
translation_verse: Ade be kaman, nɛ edɔpo ko kaŋ tiŋ n wora ania n nya mbe kena fɔlbi koŋwule ŋko mboe anyɔ ko n yige,

english_verse: You will go there to hunt with your bow and arrows, because the whole country will be covered with thornbushes.
translation_verse: Saŋɛ na so basa beeŋ baa ta ata nɛ atanyembi a luri amo to a mɔ asɔbɔya. Kashenteŋto, ewi nɛ egɔnnyaŋɛ beeŋ sɔ efuli na kikɛ so.

english_verse: The hills where you once planted crops will be overgrown with thorns and thistles. You will be afraid to go there, and your cattle, sheep, and goats will be turned loose on those hills.
translation_verse: Ewidibi be yiri yiri beeŋ kɔr n sɔ apreŋsawule kama nɛ men daa dɔ so nɛ esa kikɛ maaŋ naŋ yɔ amo so. A beeŋ ki mboŋ nɛ ana nɛ mbolpɔ beeŋ baa ji.”

english_verse: I will tell Uriah the priest and Zechariah son of Jeberechiah to serve as witnesses to this.”
translation_verse: Meeŋ kaŋɛ Yuriya nɛ e la bɔrɛmatapo na nɛ Zakareya nɛ e la Jeberekiya pibinyɛn na nɛ b baa la eshɛdajipo nɛ esa beeŋ tiŋ n yirda bumo a laŋɛ kumo be kaplɛa so.”

english_verse: The Lord spoke to me again and said:
translation_verse: Kede be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ ma le:

english_verse: These people have refused the gentle waters of Shiloah and have gladly gone over to the side of King Rezin and King Pekah.
translation_verse: “Basa ere kini kechubɔr nɛ baa tre Shilowa na be nchu nɛ a bee shile yɛlyɛlbi na, nseŋ yɔ ewura Rezin nɛ ewura Pɛka be kaba so nɛ kagbenefuli.

english_verse: Now I will send the king of Assyria against them with his powerful army, which will attack like the mighty Euphrates River overflowing its banks.
translation_verse: Ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na, beeŋ shin nɛ Asiriya be ewurgboŋ nɛ mbe benapo kikɛ e ba kɔ Juda be basa. Asiriyaebi na beeŋ ba buu bumo so fanɛ Lɔrgboŋ nɛ baa tre Yufreetes na ka bɔlɔ n dii kumo be kepla kikɛ so na.

english_verse: Enemy soldiers will cover Judah like a flood reaching up to your neck. But God is with us. He will spread his wings and protect our land.
translation_verse: Bedoŋ be benapo beeŋ ba sɔ Juda be efuli kikɛ so fanɛ lɔr to be nchu ka bɔlɔ n dii m muni kusɔ kama so na.” Ebɔrɛ wɔ anyi kutɔ! E parga mbe aba to fanɛ kabuibi nna, a kuŋ kasawule na.

english_verse: The Lord took hold of me with his powerful hand and said: I'm warning you! Don't act like these people.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bɔla mbe eleŋgboŋ so n fiɛ ma so fanɛ n sa maa wora asheŋ fanɛ kananɛ basa na bee wora na.

english_verse: Don't call something a rebellious plot, just because they do, and don't be afraid of something, just because they are.
translation_verse: E yɛ: “Sa maŋ kaŋ tre kusɔ kama nɛ basa ere bee tre ŋkre lubi fanɛ k la ŋkre lubi. Fo alɛ e sa maa ŋana kusɔ ko ŋkpal b ka bee ŋana kumo so.

english_verse: I am the one you should fear and respect. I am the holy God, the Lord All-Powerful!
translation_verse: Baa nyiŋi fanɛ ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na du cheembi nna. N nawule e daga fanɛ fo baa ŋana ga nsaa sa ma bunyaŋ.

english_verse: Run to me for protection. I am a rock that will make both Judah and Israel stumble and break their bones. I am a trap that will catch the people of Jerusalem—they will be captured and dragged away. Isaiah and His Followers
translation_verse: Basa damta beeŋ fiti kumo n tɔr m buri to nɛ bedamta e tɔr kejigbelɛ na to nɛ b pɛ bumo ŋ gberge bumo n yɔ.” Anebi Aizaaya nɛ mbe bebɛsopo be asheŋ

english_verse: My message and my teachings are to be sealed and given to my followers.
translation_verse: Menyi nɛ men la ma bebɛsopo ere daga fanɛ men baa kuŋ nsaa keta abɔya nɛ Ebɔrɛ ta n sa ma ere nɛnɛ.

english_verse: Someone may say to you, “Go to the fortunetellers who make soft chirping sounds or ask the spirits of the dead. After all, a nation ought to be able to ask its own gods
translation_verse: Ama basa beeŋ kaŋɛ menyi fanɛ men yɔ bekpalpo nɛ belejipo nɛ baa gbar a jugeto na kutɔ n ya bishi so n nu abɔya nɛ a wɔtɔ. Baaŋ kaŋɛ le: “Basa bee yili bumo nɛ b wɔ ŋkpa to be katelamu to nna a bishi abɔya ashi ayoyu nɛ bubuni kutɔ.”

english_verse: They will go around in great pain and will become so hungry that they will angrily curse their king and their gods. And when they try to find help in heaven
translation_verse: Baaŋ ta ebesa damta a nite a kulti nɛ akoŋ e pɛ bumo ga hale nɛ b shoduu bumo be ewura nɛ agbirana agbo so.

english_verse: But those who have suffered will no longer be in pain. The territories of Zebulun and Naphtali in Galilee were once hated. But this land of the Gentiles across the Jordan River and along the Mediterranean Sea will be greatly respected. War Is Over
translation_verse: Ama basa nɛ b daŋ ji awurfoŋ na maaŋ naa wɔ ebesa to. Zɛbyulɔn nɛ Naftali be eyiriana be nsawule daŋ ji nyɔmɔ nna, ama echefoso kemaŋkura beeŋ ba kebonfu nɛ k yili Teku nɛ baa tre Mɛditerenia na be epeŋilarkpa be kaba so n dese n ya fo lɔr nɛ baa tre Jɔɔdan na, hale n ta n ya fo Galili be kasawule nɛ nnyamase tase so na so ebi so.

english_verse: Those who walked in the dark have seen a bright light. And it shines upon everyone who lives in the land of darkest shadows.
translation_verse: Basa nɛ baa nite tentembiri to na wu kefultogboŋ ko. Kumo e la kebaanyi Ebɔrɛ na. Kefultogboŋ na lar nna n fulto n yuu ekama nɛ e wɔ kasawule nɛ k la luwu be tentembiri mina na so so.

english_verse: Our Lord, you have made your nation stronger. Because of you, its people are glad and celebrate like workers at harvest time or like soldiers dividing up what they have taken.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, fo shin nɛ fo basa wora keshi n ti so; fo alɛ nseŋ shin nɛ bumo be ŋgbene fuli bumo. Baa ji eyur kagbenefuliso ashi kusɔ nɛ fo wora to nna, fanɛ kananɛ basa nɛ b teŋi ayu be ŋgbene bee fuli bumo na, ŋko fanɛ basa nɛ b kɔ n suge asɔ kena to nsaa barga amo to na.

english_verse: The boots of marching warriors and the blood-stained uniforms have been fed to flames and eaten by fire. A Child Has Been Born
translation_verse: Benapo nɛ b bɛ abar so a nite be asɛbtagboŋ nɛ bumo be asɔbuuso nɛ ŋklaŋ gbiti na kikɛ beeŋ chɔɔ edɛ to m mur.

english_verse: A child has been born for us. We have been given a son who will be our ruler. His names will be Wonderful Advisor and Mighty God, Eternal Father and Prince of Peace.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ sa anyi ebi ko! E sa anyi ebinyɛn! Mo e naŋ baa la anyi be ewura. Baaŋ tre mo Mamachi be asoetojipo, nɛ Ebɔrɛ Lempo nɛ Etuto nɛ e wɔtɔ Mbaanaayɔ nɛ Kayurwushi be Ewurbi.

english_verse: His power will never end; peace will last forever. He will rule David's kingdom and make it grow strong. He will always rule with honesty and justice. The Lord All-Powerful will make certain that all of this is done. God Will Punish Israel
translation_verse: Mbe kuwurji be eleŋgboŋ beeŋ baa wora keshi a ti so; mbe kuwurji beeŋ baa kɔ kayurwushi jemanɛ kikɛ. E beeŋ ji kuwura fanɛ ewura Deevid be kanaŋ to be esa, nseŋ shin nɛ mbe eleŋgboŋ e baa yil kashenteŋ nɛ kusɔ nɛ k daga so. K beeŋ fara naniere hale mbaanaayɔ. Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na gbagba e naŋ shin nɛ ade kikɛ e wora. Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ka beeŋ gberge Israɛl kusoe be asheŋ

english_verse: and all of them knew it, including everyone in the capital city of Samaria. But they were proud and stubborn and said,
translation_verse: Bumo kikɛ, nɛ ekama nɛ e wɔ bumo be kadegboŋ nɛ baa tre Samɛria na nyi kumo be asheŋ. Ama b daŋ kpeŋ nna nsaa wu bumo be amu nseŋ daŋ kaŋɛ le:

english_verse: He sent the Arameans from the east and the Philistines from the west, and they swallowed up Israel. But even this did not stop him from being angry, so he kept on punishing them.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na daŋ shin nna nɛ Siriya be benapo shi epeŋilarkpa nɛ Filisti be benapo malɛ shi epeŋitɔrkpa m bela ase m ba kɔ Israɛl be basa kena m mur bumo. Ama amo nɛ amo kikɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be agbo kra maŋ wushi. E kraa shin nɛ e gberge bumo kusoe nna n ti so.

english_verse: The people of Israel still did not turn back to the Lord All-Powerful and worship him.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ be kasogberge nɛ e sa Israɛl be basa na be kaman, b kra maŋ tuba m bɛta m ba mo kutɔ.

english_verse: In one day he cut off their head and tail, their leaves and branches.
translation_verse: Amoso kachɛ koŋwule nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ ta ŋ gberge Israɛlebi na nɛ bumo be bejuŋkparpoana kusoe nseŋ mur bumo kikɛ kuraa.

english_verse: Their rulers and leaders were the head, and the lying prophets were the tail.
translation_verse: E beeŋ mur bumo be bewurjipoana nɛ bejuŋkparpoana nɛ anebiana nɛ b maa ji kashenteŋ na kikɛ.

english_verse: They had led the nation down the wrong path, and the people were confused.
translation_verse: Basa nɛ baa juŋkpar basa ere shin nɛ b foe ekpa nna nseŋ mel to kikɛ.

english_verse: The Lord was angry with his people and kept punishing them, because they had turned against him. They were evil and spoke foolishly. That's why he did not have pity on their young people or on their widows and orphans.
translation_verse: Amoso Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na maaŋ shin nɛ mbrantiɛfɔlbi na be ekama e nya n shile. Mo alɛ maaŋ wu bekulpoche nɛ amunibiana na be ekama kuwɔr. Ŋkpal manɛ so basa na kikɛ la amu kpakpaso wuraana nɛ b kini Ebɔrɛ nna. Bumo be malga kikɛ gba daa la asheŋ lubi be mmalga nna. Ama amo nɛ amo kikɛ, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be agbo kra maaŋ wushi. E kraa shin nɛ e gberge bumo kusoe n ti so nna.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful was angry and used the people as fuel for a fire that scorched the land. They turned against each other
translation_verse: Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na ka nya agbo so, mbe kasogberge bee chɔɔ nna fanɛ edɛ a mur basa na ashi kasawule na kikɛ so, nɛ k ki fanɛ ekama nɛ mbe kumu so be asheŋ nna na.

english_verse: like wild animals attacking and eating everyone around them, even their own relatives. But still they were not satisfied.
translation_verse: Basa bee fuu ajibi kama nɛ b wu kenishiso nna a ji ashi efuli na be kaplɛkama, ama akoŋ kraa mɔ bumo. B daa daŋɛ bumo be mbia gba nna a we!

english_verse: The tribes of Ephraim and Manasseh turned against each other, then joined forces to attack Judah. But the Lord was still angry and ready to punish the nation even more.
translation_verse: Manase be yiri to be basa nɛ Efrayim be yiri to be basa daa kɔ abar nna nseŋ naa chɛ abar to a kɔ Juda be yiri to be basa kena. Ama amo nɛ amo kikɛ, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be agbo kra maaŋ wushi. E kraa shin nɛ e gberge bumo kusoe nna n ti so.

english_verse: You people are in for trouble! You have made cruel and unfair laws
translation_verse: Asheŋ maaŋ nyalɛ n sa menyi! Menyee wora mbra nɛ a kɔ ŋkpɛato nna nsaa bɔla amoso a nyaŋ ma basa a wɔtɔ a tɔrɔ bumo.

english_verse: How will you escape being captured or killed? The Lord is still angry, and he isn't through with you yet! The Lord's Purpose and the King of Assyria
translation_verse: Baaŋ mɔ menyi kena to ŋko ŋ gberge menyi n yɔ kenyaya to. Ama amo nɛ amo kikɛ, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be agbo maaŋ wushi. E kraa beeŋ baa sha kegberge menyi kusoe n ti so. Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ka bɔla Asiriya be ewurgboŋ na so n wora asheŋ

english_verse: The Lord says: I am furious! And I will use the king of Assyria as a club
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ: “N ta Asiriya fanɛ kaprɛ nna nɛ ŋ gberge basa nɛ n nya agbo n wɔtɔ na kusoe.

english_verse: to beat down you godless people. I am angry with you, and I will send him to attack you. He will take what he wants and walk on you like mud in the streets.
translation_verse: N shuŋi Asiriyaebi nna fanɛ b ya kɔ efuli nɛ b kini ma n shin nɛ n nya agbo na kena. Ma e shuŋi bumo fanɛ b ya suge, nseŋ fuu bumo be asɔ eleŋso nsaa chichi bumo be basa so fanɛ agbembi so be depɔ na.”

english_verse: He has even bigger plans in mind, because he wants to destroy many nations.
translation_verse: Ama Asiriya be ewurgboŋ na malɛ daa kɔ mo gbagba be nfɛragboŋ mbe kumu to nna. E daa sha kemur efuli damtaana nna.

english_verse: The king of Assyria says: My army commanders are kings!
translation_verse: E daa puchi nna a kaŋɛ le: “Ma benapo be bejuŋkparpoana na be ekama la ewura nna!

english_verse: They have already captured the cities of Calno, Carchemish, Hamath, Arpad, Samaria, and Damascus.
translation_verse: Ma e kɔ m pɔɔ ndegboŋ nɛ baa tre Kalno nɛ Kaakɛmish nɛ Hamaf nɛ Apad so. Ma koŋwule na e kɔ m pɔɔ Samɛria nɛ Damaskɔs so.

english_verse: The gods of Jerusalem and Samaria are weaker than the gods of those powerful nations. And I will destroy Jerusalem, together with its gods and idols, just as I did Samaria.
translation_verse: Agbirana nɛ a wɔ Jerusalɛm nɛ Samɛria be ndegboŋ to na maŋ shi n fo amo nɛ a wɔ efuli lempoana na to so. Ma alɛ beeŋ mur Jerusalɛm nɛ agbirana kama nɛ a wɔ kumo to na fanɛ kananɛ n wora Samɛria na.”

english_verse: The Lord will do what he has planned against Jerusalem and Mount Zion. Then he will punish the proud and boastful king of Assyria,
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ: “Ŋ kaŋ loge kusɔ nɛ mee wora kebee nɛ baa tre Zayɔn na so nɛ Jerusalɛm to, meeŋ gberge Asiriya be efuli so be ewurgboŋ kusoe ŋkpal mbe mpuchi nɛ kamoowu kikɛ so.”

english_verse: who says: I did these things by my own power because I am smart and clever. I attacked kings like a wild bull, and I took the land and the treasures of their nations.
translation_verse: Asiriya be ewurgboŋ bee puchi nna a kaŋɛ le: “Ŋ gbagba be eleŋ so nɛ n wora ade kikɛ. Ma alɛ kɔ eleŋ nsaa nyi asheŋ nsaa kɔ kenyi ga. N du fanɛ gbolu kpenso nɛ e bee tɛ a yuu basa so nna a suge efuliana na be nsawule nɛ mpetɛsɔ na eleŋ so.

english_verse: I have conquered the whole world! And it was easier than taking eggs from an unguarded nest. No one even flapped a wing or made a peep.
translation_verse: Ma e kɔ m pɔɔ durnya kikɛ so na! Keshoŋi kabuibi be kesha to n lara afule gba du kpakpa a chɔ kekɔ kena m pɔɔ so. Efuliana na be kekama daa maŋ tiŋ ŋ kuŋ ma ekpa!”

english_verse: King of Assyria, can an ax or a saw overpower the one who uses it? Can a wooden pole lift whoever holds it?
translation_verse: Ama le nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ Asiriya be ewura na: “Kekpanfu ŋko kasaŋɛgboŋ beeŋ tiŋ ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ kumo e chɔ esa nɛ e bee keta kumo a shuŋ na a? Dimɛdi e naa keta kaprɛ ŋko kaprɛ e naa keta dimɛdi?”

english_verse: The mighty Lord All-Powerful will send a terrible disease to strike down your army, and you will burn with fever under your royal robes.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ shin nɛ kulɔ lubi e tɔr fo nɛ fo benapo so nseŋ shin nɛ fo eyur e bel edɛ fanɛ k ka bee suse ashi fo kuwurpiŋi to na.

english_verse: The holy God, who is the light of Israel, will turn into a fire, and in one day you will go up in flames, just like a thornbush.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ cheembi nɛ e la Israɛl be kefulto na beeŋ kilgi fanɛ edɛ n shin nɛ fo suse so kachɛ koŋwule fanɛ kupuŋ wɔlso na.

english_verse: The Lord will make your beautiful forests and fertile fields slowly rot.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ menyi be apo nɛ adɔsawule lelaana kikɛ e mur cheche fanɛ kananɛ kulɔ mɔso bee mur esa na.

english_verse: There will be so few trees that even a young child can count them. Only a Few Will Come Back
translation_verse: Ndibi nɛ a beeŋ ka na maaŋ naa shi. Kebibi gba beeŋ tiŋ ŋ karga amo. Basa nɛ baaŋ bɛta m ba na be asheŋ

english_verse: A time is coming when the survivors from Israel and Judah will completely depend on the holy Lord of Israel, instead of the nation that defeated them.
translation_verse: Jemanɛ ko bee ba nɛ Israɛl nɛ Juda be basa nɛ baaŋ ji efute na maaŋ naŋ ta bumo be amu n deŋi efuli nɛ k daŋ ka gbrɛ nɛ k mur na so. Baaŋ ta bumo be amu n deŋi Enyɛnpe, Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ cheembi na so nna.

english_verse: There were as many people as there are grains of sand along the seashore, but only a few will survive to come back to Israel's mighty God. This is because he has threatened to destroy their nation, just as they deserve.
translation_verse: Israɛlebi na daa shi nna ga fanɛ teku ase be eshishɛr, ama bumo to be gbrɛbi e naaŋ ji efute nseŋ bɛta m ba Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ lempo na kutɔ. Ŋkpal manɛ so, e daŋ yili kumo nna fanɛ e beeŋ mur bumo be efuli na, kumo be loŋ malɛ daga bumo nna.

english_verse: Now the Lord God All-Powerful says to his people in Jerusalem: The Assyrians will beat you with sticks and abuse you, just as the Egyptians did. But don't be afraid of them.
translation_verse: Ade kikɛ be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ mbe basa nɛ b wɔ Jerusalɛm to na le: “Asiriya be basa na beeŋ kɔrfɛ menyi fanɛ kananɛ Ijiptebi daŋ wora na. Ama men sa maa ŋana bumo.

english_verse: Soon I will stop being angry with you, and I will punish them for their crimes.
translation_verse: K maaŋ chɛr nɛ ma agbo e wushi nɛ ŋ gberge Asiriyaebi kusoe m mur bumo cheche ŋkpal bumo be asheŋ lubi so.

english_verse: I will beat the Assyrians with a whip, as I did the people of Midian near the rock at Oreb. And I will show the same mighty power that I used when I made a path through the sea in Egypt.
translation_verse: Ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na gbagba e naaŋ ta ma kuchuchɔ ŋ kuya bumo so, fanɛ kananɛ n daŋ wora Midian be efuli so ebi ashi kefalta nɛ k wɔ kakpa nɛ baa tre Ɔrɛb na. Ma alɛ beeŋ ŋini ma eleŋgboŋ nɛ n daŋ ŋini nseŋ shin nɛ ekpa dese Teku Peper na to ashi Ijipt be efuli so na.

english_verse: Then they will no longer rule your nation. All will go well for you, and your burden will be lifted.
translation_verse: Jemanɛ na kaŋ fo meeŋ shin nɛ men suge menyi be amu ashi Asiriya be eleŋgboŋ to nɛ b maaŋ naa ji menyi so kuwura a tɔrɔ menyi. Asheŋ beeŋ naŋ nyalɛ n sa menyi.”

english_verse: Enemy troops have reached the town of Aiath. They have gone through Migron, and they stored their supplies at Michmash,
translation_verse: Bedoŋ be benapo na daŋ ba kɔ n suge kade nɛ baa tre Ai na. B daŋ bɔla Migrɔn nna, nseŋ daŋ yige bumo be asɔ nɛ ajibi ashi kakpa nɛ baa tre Mikmash na,

english_verse: before crossing the valley and spending the night at Geba. The people of Ramah are terrified; everyone in Gibeah, the hometown of Saul, has run away.
translation_verse: pɔɛŋ nseŋ dii ketaŋɛ na n ya dese Gɛba ŋklade! Kufugboŋ ko daŋ tɔr basa nɛ b wɔ kade nɛ baa tre Rama na so nna, nɛ basa nɛ b wɔ Gibiya, nɛ k la Ewura Sɔɔl be kade to na, shile ŋ ka kade na.

english_verse: Loud crying can be heard in the towns of Gallim, Laishah, and sorrowful Anathoth.
translation_verse: Esa beeŋ tiŋ n nu basa ka bee shu awɔrso ashi nde nɛ baa tre Gallim nɛ Laisha nɛ Anatɔf nɛ kagbenejija tɔr so na to.

english_verse: Today the enemy will camp at Nob and shake a threatening fist at Mount Zion in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Kabre bedoŋ na wɔ kade nɛ baa tre Nɔb na to nna m bɔɔ enɔ a fiɛ to a teŋi a ŋini Zayɔn be kebee nɛ k wɔ Jerusalɛm na.

english_verse: With an ax, the glorious Lord will destroy every tree in the forests of Lebanon.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e naaŋ ku bumo n lɛ fanɛ kananɛ baa ta kekpanfu a ku ndibi ashi Lebanɔn be kupo to a lɛ na!

english_verse: Like a branch that sprouts from a stump, someone from David's family will someday be king.
translation_verse: Kananɛ keyimu bee purge afantaŋ popɔr nɛ a bee daŋ a ki kedibi na, aloŋ nɛ esa ko beeŋ shi ewura Deevid be kanaŋ to m ba ki ewura kachako so.

english_verse: The Spirit of the Lord will be with him to give him understanding, wisdom, and insight. He will be powerful, and he will know and honor the Lord.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be kiyoyu e naŋ sa mo kanyiasheŋ nɛ kashennyi nɛ kasheŋwora be kenyi nɛ e ta n ji kuwura mbe basa so nɛnɛ. E beeŋ baa nyi Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be aparsheŋ nsaa bunyaŋ mo.

english_verse: His greatest joy will be to obey the Lord. This king won't judge by appearances or listen to rumors.
translation_verse: Kusɔ nɛ k beeŋ baa fuli mo kagbene ga e naaŋ baa la kewora Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kasonu. Ewura ere maaŋ baa keni kananɛ esa du so, ŋko a yili b yɛ b yɛ so a ji demu.

english_verse: The poor and the needy will be treated with fairness and with justice. His word will be law everywhere in the land, and criminals will be put to death.
translation_verse: Kashenteŋ be ekpa so nɛ e beeŋ baa ji betirpo demu nsaa kɔ a kuŋ bumo nɛ b maaŋ tiŋ n wora shɛŋ n sa bumo be amu na. Kusɔ nɛ e beeŋ kaŋɛ kenishipereso na beeŋ ki mbra ashi efuli na kikɛ so; nɛ basa lubi malɛ e nya luwu be kasogberge.

english_verse: Leopards will lie down with young goats, and wolves will rest with lambs. Calves and lions will eat together and be cared for by little children.
translation_verse: Ekuntuŋ nɛ mbolpɔ beeŋ baa wɔ abar so kayurwushi so, nɛ ekarmɛ nɛ mboe fɔlbi e baa tu abar a dese. Anabi nɛ ebuluŋ be bibi beeŋ baa gama abar so a ji, nɛ mbiwurbi e baa keni bumo so nsaa kpa bumo a yɔ a ba.

english_verse: Cows and bears will share the same pasture; their young will rest side by side. Lions and oxen will both eat straw.
translation_verse: Eshishiri beeŋ baa tu abar a ji, nɛ bumo be bibi e baa tu abar a dese kayurwushiso. Saŋɛ na so nɛ ebuluŋ e baa ji afitiri fanɛ ana.

english_verse: Little children will play near snake holes. They will stick their hands into dens of poisonous snakes and never be hurt.
translation_verse: Mbiwurbi beeŋ baa pɛl ashi awɔ be amaŋ ase nɛ a maaŋ duŋ bumo. Baaŋ ta bumo be enɔana n wɔtɔ awɔ lubi be amaŋ to nɛ awɔ na maaŋ wora bumo shɛŋ.

english_verse: Nothing harmful will take place on the Lord's holy mountain. Just as water fills the sea, the land will be filled with people who know and honor the Lord. God's People Will Come Back Home
translation_verse: Kusɔ lubi kikɛ maaŋ naa wɔ Ebɔrɛ be kebee cheembi nɛ baa tre Zayɔn na so. Kananɛ nchu bɔlɔ teku to na, aloŋ nɛ basa nɛ b nyi nsaa bunyaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na gba beeŋ baa kaa shi kasawule na so. Ebɔrɛ be basa ka beeŋ bɛta m ba epe be asheŋ

english_verse: The time is coming when one of David's descendants will be the signal for the people of all nations to come together. They will follow his advice, and his own nation will become famous.
translation_verse: Jemanɛ ko bee ba nɛ ewura popɔr nɛ e beeŋ shi ewura Deevid be kuwurji be kabuna na e baa la tɔɔnɛ n sa efuliana na. Baaŋ baa gama abar so mbe kuwurade to nsaa sa mo bunyaŋ.

english_verse: When that day comes, the Lord will again reach out his mighty arm and bring home his people who have survived in Assyria, Egypt, Pathros, Ethiopia, Elam, Shinar, Hamath, and the land along the coast.
translation_verse: Loŋ be kachɛ na kaŋ fo, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ naŋ bɔla mbe eleŋgboŋ so m bɛta mbe basa nɛ b ka a wɔ efuliana nɛ baa tre Asiriya nɛ Ijipt nɛ Patrɔs nɛ Itiopia nɛ Ilam nɛ Babilɔn nɛ Hamaf nɛ teku ase be nsawule nɛ kepla so na m ba.

english_verse: He will give a signal to the nations, and he will bring together the refugees from Judah and Israel, who have been scattered all over the earth.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ maŋ tɔɔnɛ be tuta so ŋ ŋini efuliana na fanɛ e naa bɛta Israɛl nɛ Juda be basa nɛ b daŋ pesaŋ to a wɔ durnya be kaplɛkama na nna a ba.

english_verse: Israel will stop being jealous of Judah, and Judah will no longer be the enemy of Israel.
translation_verse: Israɛl be kuwurji maaŋ naa kɔ Juda be kuwurji kukɔrkɔ. Juda malɛ maaŋ naa la Israɛl mo doŋ.

english_verse: Instead, they will get together and attack the Philistines in the west. Then they will defeat the Edomites, the Moabites, and the Ammonites in the east. They will rule those people and take from them whatever they want.
translation_verse: Baaŋ chɛ abar to ŋ kɔ Filistiebi nɛ b wɔ epeŋitɔrkpa na nseŋ suge basa nɛ b wɔ epeŋilarkpa na be asɔ eleŋso. Bumo alɛ beeŋ kɔ m pɔɔ Edɔm nɛ Mowab be basa so, nseŋ shin nɛ Ammɔn be basa e wora bumo kasonu.

english_verse: The Lord will dry up the arm of the Red Sea near Egypt, and he will send a scorching wind to divide the Euphrates River into seven streams that anyone can step across.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e shin nɛ Teku Peper na be keyabi nɛ k mata Ijipt na e wɔlto nseŋ shin nɛ afu tushiso e ba shin nɛ lɔrgboŋ nɛ baa tre Yufreetes na gba e wɔlto ŋ ka mbombi wurbi ashunu nawule. Saŋɛ na so ekama beeŋ tiŋ n nite m bɔla kumo to n choŋ.

english_verse: Then for his people who survive, there will be a good road from Assyria, just as there was a good road for their ancestors when they left Egypt.
translation_verse: Ekpagboŋ lela beeŋ dese n shi Asiriya be efuli so n sa mbe basa Israɛlebi nɛ b ji efute nseŋ ka a wɔ ndoŋ na nɛ b bɔla so, fanɛ kananɛ ekpa lela daa dese n sa bumo nanaana jemanɛ nɛ b daŋ lar Ijipt be efuli so na.

english_verse: At that time you will say, “I thank you, Lord! You were angry with me, but you stopped being angry and gave me comfort.
translation_verse: Kachako bee ba nɛ basa e boŋ kashɛ ŋ kaŋɛ le: “Mee kpaŋ fo nna, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ! Fo daŋ nya agbo nna n wɔtɔ ma, ama fo yige fo kanya agbo na nsaa lɔlɔ ma.

english_verse: I trust you to save me, Lord God, and I won't be afraid. My power and my strength come from you, and you have saved me.”
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ e la ma emɔlgapo. Meeŋ ta ma yirda n wɔtɔ mo to nsaa maa ŋana kufu. Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e naa sa ma eleŋ; mo e mɔlga ma.

english_verse: At that time you will say, “Our Lord, we are thankful, and we worship only you. We will tell the nations how glorious you are and what you have done.
translation_verse: Kachako bee ba nɛ basa e boŋ kashɛ ŋ kaŋɛ le: “Ta kechɔrɔ n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na! Tre mo fanɛ e chɛ fo to! Kaŋɛ efuliana na kusɔ nɛ e wora! Kaŋɛ bumo kananɛ e shi be asheŋ!

english_verse: Because of your wonderful deeds we will sing your praises everywhere on earth.”
translation_verse: Boŋ kashɛ ŋ kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ŋkpal asheŋgboŋ nɛ e wora so. Shin nɛ durnya kikɛ e nu baru na.

english_verse: Sing, people of Zion! Celebrate the greatness of the holy Lord of Israel. God is here to help you.
translation_verse: Esa kama nɛ e wɔ Zayɔn to e boŋ kashɛ awɔrso; ŋkpal manɛ so, Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ cheembi na shi ga, nsaa wɔ mbe basa to a chɛ bumo to.”

english_verse: The Lord has commanded his very best warriors and his proud heroes to show how angry he is.
translation_verse: N tre ma benapo lempoana nɛ b yirda bumo be amu n lar nɛ b ya kɔ kena ŋ gberge basa nɛ n nya agbo n wɔtɔ na kusoe.

english_verse: Listen to the noisy crowds on the mountains! Kingdoms and nations are joining forces. The Lord All-Powerful is bringing together an army for battle.
translation_verse: Men kaŋ asoe n nu, awɔr ka bee gbri abee so fanɛ jimaŋ damta na! K du fanɛ efuliana nɛ kuwurgboŋana e naa gama abar so! Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na e naa gama benapo abar so nɛ b kɔ kena.

english_verse: From a distant land the Lord is coming fierce and furious— he brings his weapons to destroy the whole earth.
translation_verse: B shi efuli wɔfɔ wɔfɔ nɛ a wɔ durnya be lalaloge to nna a ba. Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na malɛ e kaa kagbene n ta mbe akɔsɔ a ba nɛ e ba mur Babilɔn be efuli kikɛ.

english_verse: I, the Lord, will show no mercy or pity when that time comes. In my anger I will destroy the earth and every sinner who lives on it.
translation_verse: Loŋ be kachɛ na kaŋ fo, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na maaŋ shu esa kikɛ so ŋko n wu esa kuwɔr. E beeŋ nya agbo ga nseŋ mur alubiworapoana n shin nɛ efuli na kikɛ e ki kiyitokpaŋ.

english_verse: Light will disappear from the stars in the sky; the dawning sun will turn dark, and the moon will lose its brightness.
translation_verse: Kefulto maaŋ naa wɔtɔ, ŋkpal manɛ so achɛkpabi nɛ a wɔ esoso na kikɛ beeŋ fulto ŋ gben nɛ epeŋi e pete nseŋ biri to nɛ kufɔl malɛ gba e fuli to ŋ gben.

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, am terribly angry— I will make the sky tremble and the earth shake loose.
translation_verse: Kachɛ nɛ ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ ŋini kananɛ ma agbo du na, meeŋ shin nɛ esoso e baga to nɛ kasawule e gbuŋgbuŋ m pulgi ashi kumo be epul to.

english_verse: Those men who are captured will be killed by a sword.
translation_verse: Bekama malɛ nɛ baaŋ pɛ na, baaŋ da bumo etokobi m mɔ.

english_verse: Their arrows will slaughter the young men; no pity will be shown to babies and children. The Lord Will Destroy Babylon
translation_verse: Bumo be ata nɛ atanyembi nɛ baaŋ ta m mɔ mbrantiɛfɔlbi. B maaŋ wu mbi popɔrbi kuwɔr ŋko n shu mbiwurbi so.

english_verse: The city of Babylon is glorious and powerful, the pride of the nation. But it will be like the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah after I, the Lord, destroyed them.
translation_verse: Babilɔn be kadegboŋ na e walɛ nsaa kɔ eleŋ a chɔ kadegboŋ kama. Kumo be basa bee puchi kumo so nna, ama ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ mur kumo fanɛ kananɛ m mur ndegboŋ nɛ b daa tre Sodɔm nɛ Gomɔra na!

english_verse: The Lord will have mercy on Israel and will let them be his chosen people once again. He will bring them back to their own land, and foreigners will join them as part of Israel.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ naaŋ wu mbe basa Israɛlebi nɛ e lara n sa mbe kumu na kuwɔr. E beeŋ shin nɛ b bɛta bumo m ba bumo gbagba be kasawule so, nɛ befɔ e tu bumo n chena ndoŋ fanɛ bumo alɛ gba ka la Israɛlebi na.

english_verse: Other nations will lead them home, and Israel will make slaves of them in the land that belongs to the Lord. Israel will rule over those who once governed and mistreated them. Death to the King of Babylonia!
translation_verse: Efuli pɔtɛana so be basa beeŋ chɛ Israɛl be basa to nɛ b bɛta n yɔ kasawule nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na sa bumo na so. Efuli pɔtɛ ebi na beeŋ ya kaa shuŋ Israɛlebi na fanɛ anya, nɛ Israɛlebi na e naa ji kuwura basa nɛ b daa kɔrfɛ bumo na so. Babilɔn be ewura ka beeŋ wu be asheŋ

english_verse: The Lord will set you free from your sorrow, suffering, and slavery.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ sɔ Israɛl be basa na n yige ashi ebesa nɛ awurfoŋ nɛ kenyaya to.

english_verse: Then you will make fun of the King of Babylonia by singing this song: That cruel monster is done for! He won't attack us again.
translation_verse: E kaŋ wora loŋ n loge nɛ bumo alɛ e wora Babilɔn be efuli so be ewura eyur to nseŋ kaŋɛ le: “Ewura nyaŋnyaŋso na e tɔr na! E maaŋ naŋ tiŋ ŋ kɔrfɛ esa kikɛ!”

english_verse: Now all the world is at peace; its people are celebrating with joyful songs.
translation_verse: Naniere durnya na kikɛ nya ewushi nɛ kayurwushi, nɛ ekama bee boŋ nshɛ kagbene fuli so.

english_verse: King of Babylonia, even the cypress trees and the cedars of Lebanon celebrate and say, “Since you were put down, no one comes along to chop us down.”
translation_verse: Ndibi kpakpaso fanɛ seprɛs nɛ Lebanɔn be efuli so be ndibi nɛ baa tre sida na, e ji eyur ŋkpal Babilɔn be ewura ka tɔr nɛ esa kama maŋ naa wɔtɔ nɛ e naa ku amo a lɛ na so.

english_verse: Each one of them will say, “Now you are just as weak as any of us!
translation_verse: E kaŋ ba bumo kutɔ baaŋ kaŋɛ mo le: “Naniere fo alɛ gba pɔ fanɛ anyi! Fo ki anyi to be eko nna na!

english_verse: Your pride and your music have ended here in the world of the dead. Worms are your blanket, maggots are your bed.”
translation_verse: Ejaŋjilaŋ nɛ b daa ta a boŋ nshɛ a maŋkura fo, ama naniere fo e ba bubuni to na. Ashushombi e ki fanɛ fo kusɔ dese so nɛ echɔnchɔŋ malɛ ki fanɛ keta m buu fo so na.”

english_verse: You said to yourself, “I'll climb to heaven and place my throne above the highest stars. I'll sit there with the gods far away in the north.
translation_verse: Fo daŋ kre fo kagbene to nna fanɛ feeŋ dii n yɔ ebɔrɛso n ya baŋ achɛkpabi nɛ a wɔ awɔlto so na n ya chena ndoŋ a ji kuwura. Fo daa fɛ fanɛ feeŋ chena fanɛ ewura nna ashi kebee nɛ k wɔ kelargato be esoso be kakpa nɛ baa shɛr na.

english_verse: I'll be above the clouds, just like God Most High.”
translation_verse: Fo yɛ feeŋ dii n yɔ awɔlpa be awɔlto n ya ki fanɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na.

english_verse: But now you are deep in the world of the dead.
translation_verse: Ama b gbelge fo n yɔ durnya be kaseto ashi bubuni to.

english_verse: Those who see you will stare and wonder, “Is this the man who made the world tremble and shook up kingdoms?
translation_verse: Bubuni nɛ baaŋ wu fo na beeŋ pɛ nnɔ ŋ keta a keni fo, nseŋ bishi le: “Kanyɛn nɛ e gbuŋgbuŋ durnya nseŋ shin nɛ bewurgboŋana bee chicha kufuso na nde a?

english_verse: Did he capture every city and make earth a desert? Is he the one who refused to let prisoners go home?”
translation_verse: Kanyɛn nɛ e mur ndegboŋ nseŋ shin nɛ durnya ki fanɛ kiyitokpaŋ na nde a? Mo e daŋ kini keshin nɛ basa nɛ b pɛ kena to na e nya ekpa n yɔ bumo peana na a?”

english_verse: But you will be left unburied, just another dead body lying underfoot like a broken branch. You will be one of many killed in battle and gone down to the deep rocky pit.
translation_verse: ama fo ere maŋ kɔ loŋ be ebu ere. B ta fo kebuni nna n lɛ nɛ k dese m bɛ. Esoji e wu kena to n deŋi fo kebuni so nɛ b ta fo nɛ bumo kikɛ n wɔtɔ kefalta be kemaŋ to nseŋ gbare eshishɛr n deŋi so n chichi so.

english_verse: You won't be buried with kings; you ruined your country and murdered your people. You evil monster! We hope that your family will be forgotten forever.
translation_verse: Fo ka shin nɛ efuli pɔtɛana ba mɔ fo basa nseŋ mur fo efuli so, b maaŋ puli fo fanɛ kananɛ baa puli bewuraana na. Fo kanaŋ lubi ere to be esa kama maaŋ ji efute a wɔ ŋkpa to.

english_verse: We will slaughter your sons to make them pay for the crimes of their ancestors. They won't take over the world or build cities anywhere on this earth.
translation_verse: Anyeeŋ teŋ fo mbinyɛnsobi so ŋkpal bumo nananyɛnana be alubi so. Bumo be ekama maaŋ ji kuwura ŋko m pɔr ndegboŋ durnya be kaplɛkama. Ebɔrɛ ka beeŋ mur Babilɔn be asheŋ

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful has promised to attack Babylonia and destroy everyone there, so that none of them will ever be remembered again.
translation_verse: Ade kikɛ be kaman, nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ le: “Meeŋ kɔ Babilɔn be efuli so be basa nseŋ mur esa kama nɛ e wɔ ndoŋ, nɛ basa maaŋ naŋ nyiŋi bumo be asheŋ kikɛ.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful has made this promise: Everything I have planned will happen just as I said.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na bɔ ntaŋ ŋ kaŋɛ le: “Kusɔ nɛ n yili ma kagbene to fanɛ meeŋ wora na gbagba nɛ meeŋ wora.

english_verse: I will wipe out every Assyrian in my country, and I will crush those on my mountains. I will free my people from slavery to the Assyrians.
translation_verse: Meeŋ mur Asiriya be efuli so be basa ashi ma kasawule nɛ k la Israɛl be fuli na so nseŋ chichi bumo so ashi ma abee so. Ma alɛ beeŋ mɔlga ma basa ashi bumo be etɔrɔ kikɛ nɛ bumo be kebaala Asiriyaebi be anya to.

english_verse: I have planned this for the whole world, and my mighty arm controls every nation.
translation_verse: Ŋkre nɛ ŋ kɔ n sa durnya to ebi nna na. Ma alɛ kraa shin nɛ ŋ gberge efuliana na kusoe nna.”

english_verse: This message came from the Lord in the year King Ahaz died:
translation_verse: Kafɛ nɛ Ewura Ahaz wu na nɛ kubɔya ere shi Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kutɔ m ba:

english_verse: If a messenger comes from a distant nation, you must say: “The Lord built Zion. Even the poorest of his people will find safety there.”
translation_verse: Nɛ fanɛ kabɔ ko shi Filisti be efuli so m ba menyi kutɔ, a daga fanɛ men kaŋɛ mo le: “Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e pɔr Zayɔn, nɛ mbe basa to be etirpo gba e nya a wɔ ndoŋ nɛ shɛŋ maaŋ tɔrɔ mo.”

english_verse: Everyone in Dibon has gone up to the temple and the shrines to cry and weep. All of Moab is crying. Heads and beards are shaved because of what happened at Nebo and Medeba.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ basa nɛ b wɔ kade nɛ baa tre Dibɔn na dii n yɔ kegbir ase ashi kebee so n ya shu ndoŋ. Mowab be basa daŋ shu kagbenejijaso nna ŋkpal ndegboŋ nɛ baa tre Nɛbo nɛ Mɛdiba na so. B daŋ she bumo be amu nɛ ntɔl kagbenejijaso gba nna.

english_verse: The streams of Nimrim and the grasslands have dried up. Every plant is parched.
translation_verse: Mbombi nɛ a wɔ kakpa nɛ baa tre Nimrim na wɔlto nna nɛ ndoŋ be afitiri kikɛ wɔl. Kefitiri bumbuŋ kikɛ maŋ naa wɔ eboŋkarana na.
