english_verse: The people of Moab are leaving, crossing over Willow Creek, taking everything they own and have worked for.
translation_verse: Basa na daa wora ania nɛ b tiŋ n ta bumo be asɔ ŋ ŋana n dii ketaŋɛ na nna.

english_verse: In the towns of Eglaim and of Beerelim and everywhere else in Moab mournful cries are heard.
translation_verse: Kagbenejija so be kushu baaŋ sɔ Mowab be kasawule kikɛ so nna nɛ esa beeŋ tiŋ n nu bumo be kushu ashi nde nɛ baa tre Eglaim nɛ Beerilim na to.

english_verse: The streams near Dimon are flowing with blood. But the Lord will bring even worse trouble to Dimon, because all in Moab who escape will be attacked by lions.
translation_verse: Lɔr nɛ k wɔ kade nɛ baa tre Dibɔn na be nchu kikɛ kilgi ŋ ki ŋklaŋ nna. Ebɔrɛ malɛ kraa kɔ kusɔ nɛ k chɔ loŋ nɛ e wora basa nɛ b wɔ ndoŋ nna. Kashenteŋto, luwu kraa wɔtɔ a jo basa kama nɛ b ka a wɔ Mowab be efuli so na.

english_verse: Send lambs as gifts to the ruler of the land. Send them across the desert from Sela to Mount Zion.
translation_verse: Mowab be basa nɛ b wɔ kiyi to be kadegboŋ nɛ baa tre Sela na ta mbolpɔ fɔlbi n shuŋi n ya sa Jerusalɛm be ewura nna.

english_verse: The women of Moab crossing the Arnon River are like a flock of birds scattered from their nests.
translation_verse: Mowab be beche nɛ baa dii lɔr nɛ baa tre Aanɔn na du fanɛ mbuibi nɛ b jija bumo be asha to nna.

english_verse: Let our people live in your country and find safety here.” Moab, your cruel enemies will disappear; they will no longer attack and destroy your land.
translation_verse: Men shin nɛ an chena menyi be kasawule so nɛ men baa kuŋ anyi ashi basa nɛ baa sha kemur anyi na kutɔ.” Mowabebi, men doŋana nɛ b maa wu kuwɔr nsaa kɔrfɛ menyi na maaŋ naa wɔtɔ. B maaŋ naaŋ kɔ menyi m mur menyi be efuli.

english_verse: Then a kingdom of love will be set up, and someone from David's family will rule with fairness. He will do what is right and quickly bring justice. Moab's Pride Is Destroyed
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman, Deevid be kaman to ebi to be eko beeŋ ba ki ewura nseŋ ta kashenteŋji nɛ kasha a keni basa so. E beeŋ nya manaŋ n wora kusɔ nɛ k daga nseŋ keni so n ji asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so.

english_verse: Now I mourn like Jazer for the vineyards of Sibmah. I shed tears for Heshbon and for Elealeh. There will be no more harvest celebrations
translation_verse: Naniere kananɛ mee shu anishichubi a sa Sibma be afeelebi na nɛ mee shu a sa Jaza gba peya. Ma anishichubi wurge nna ŋkpal shɛŋ ka maŋ naa wɔtɔ nɛ Hɛshbɔn nɛ Eliale be ndeana to ebi e teŋi nɛ bumo be ŋgbene fuli bumo so.

english_verse: or joyful and happy times, while bringing in the crops. Singing and shouting are gone from the vineyards. There are no joyful shouts where grapes were pressed. God has silenced them all.
translation_verse: Esa kama b kagbene maŋ fuli ŋkpal nsawule na ka maŋ naa wora adɔjibi ga na so. Esa kikɛ maa boŋ nshɛ ashi waindibi be adɔana to. Ekama maŋ naa nya afeelebi be asɔrso nɛ baa tre greeps na a wora nsa. Esa kama maŋ naa nu kagbenefuliso be awɔr gba kuraa.

english_verse: Deep in my heart I hurt for Moab and Kir-Heres.
translation_verse: Ebesa bee ji ma nna ashi ma kagbene to nɛ mee shu a sa Mowab nɛ Kir Hɛrɛs.

english_verse: It's useless for Moab's people to wear themselves out by going to their altars to worship and pray.
translation_verse: Mowab be basa bee gben jiga nna a yɔ bumo be agbir to ashi abee so nɛ agbirlambuana to n ya ka shuŋ amo. Tɔnɔ kikɛ maaŋ lar kumo to.

english_verse: The Lord has already said all of this about Moab.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na teŋ bɔ le be kubɔya ere a laŋɛ Mowab be kaplɛa so.

english_verse: Now he says, “The contract of a hired worker is good for three years, but Moab's glory and greatness won't last any longer than that. Only a few of its people will survive, and they will be left helpless.”
translation_verse: Ama naniere le nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ naaŋ laŋɛ a kaŋɛ: “Ta a ba nfɛ asa be jemanɛ to gbagba Mowab be kedama damta nɛ kumo be basa na kikɛ beeŋ mur. Basa gbrɛbi ko e naŋ ji efute ashi kumo be basa damta na kikɛ to, bumo alɛ maaŋ baa kɔ eleŋ nɛ b tiŋ n chɛ bumo be amu to.”

english_verse: The villages around Aroer will be deserted, with only sheep living there and no one to bother them.
translation_verse: Siriya be efuli so be ndegboŋ beeŋ ki nde nɛ ekama shile ka amo nɛ a dese fuloŋ. A beeŋ ki mbolpɔ nɛ ana be ejikpa nɛ esa kikɛ maaŋ baa ju amo a lar ndoŋ.

english_verse: Israel will lose its fortresses. The kingdom of Damascus will be destroyed; its survivors will suffer the same fate as Israel. The Lord All-Powerful has promised this. Sin and Suffering
translation_verse: Israɛl beeŋ paŋ kumo be ndegboŋana nɛ b pɔr egbal lempoana a kuŋ amo na nɛ Damaskɔs be kuwurgboŋ na malɛ e mur. Siriya be basa kama nɛ baaŋ ji efute na beeŋ ji anishinyɔr fanɛ Israɛl be basa. Ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na e kaŋɛ.”

english_verse: When that time comes, the glorious nation of Israel will be brought down; its prosperous people will be skin and bones.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ le: “Kachako bee ba nɛ Israɛl be kemaŋkura nɛ keshi e ba ekar nɛ kumo be damawuraana e ki betirpo nseŋ nyɔr ŋ ki awibi nawule.

english_verse: Israel will be like wheat fields in Rephaim Valley picked clean of grain.
translation_verse: Israɛl beeŋ ki fanɛ kudɔsawule nɛ b dɔ ayu n teŋi kumo so ashi ketaŋɛ nɛ baa tre Refaebi na to na.

english_verse: It will be like an olive tree beaten with a stick, leaving two or three olives or maybe four or five on the highest or most fruitful branches. The Lord God of Israel has promised this.
translation_verse: Basa gbrɛbi ko e naŋ ji efute nɛ Israɛl e ki fanɛ ɔlif be kedibi nɛ b chuge kumo so be asɔrso kikɛ nseŋ ka anyɔ ŋko asa ko ashi kumo be awɔlto ŋko asɔrso gbrɛbi ko ashi kumo be kaseto be ayabi so na. Ma, Enyɛnpe, Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na e kaŋɛ na.”

english_verse: At that time the people will turn and trust their Creator, the holy God of Israel.
translation_verse: Loŋ be kachɛ na kaŋ fo, basa beeŋ bɛta n yɔ bumo be etopo nɛ e la Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ cheembi na kutɔ n ya fin kechɛto.

english_verse: They have built altars and places for burning incense to their goddess Asherah, and they have set up sacred poles for her. But they will stop worshiping at these places.
translation_verse: B maaŋ naŋ ta bumo be yirda n deŋi agbirsure nɛ bumo gbagba pɔr na ŋko ndibi tenteŋ nɛ b yuu kakpa nɛ baa shuŋ kegbir cheso nɛ baa tre Ashira na, nsaa chɔɔ eduwu agbirsure so ndoŋ na so.

english_verse: Israel, you have forgotten the God who saves you, the one who is the mighty rock where you find protection. You plant the finest flowers to honor a foreign god.
translation_verse: Menyi Israɛlebi teŋ Ebɔrɛ nɛ e bee mɔlga menyi nsaa kuŋ menyi fanɛ kefalta gboŋ na so nna. Men dɔ atoto be adɔbi nna a shuŋ agbirana amo to.

english_verse: The plants may sprout and blossom that very same morning, but it will do you no good, because you will suffer endless agony. God Defends His People
translation_verse: Ama nɛ aduuso na kɔr n daŋ nseŋ purge kachɛ nɛ men duu amo na kikɛ gba, men kraa maaŋ teŋi shɛŋ amo so, ama etɔrɔ nɛ ebesa nɛ a maaŋ ku nɛ menyeeŋ nya. Ebɔrɛ ka beeŋ kɔ n sa mbe basa be asheŋ

english_verse: But even if they roar like a fearsome flood, God will give the command to turn them back. They will be like dust, or like a tumbleweed blowing across the hills in a windstorm.
translation_verse: Ama nɛ efuli lempoana bee ba eleŋso fanɛ atiligboŋ gba, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ ponte bumo so nɛ b bɛta fanɛ kalabɛr ka koso kebee ase ŋko kewabi nɛ kawuliwuli ta a yɔ na.

english_verse: In the evening their attack is fierce, but by morning they are destroyed. This is what happens to those who raid and rob us.
translation_verse: Baa kɔ kenishipereso nna a ta kufu a pɛ basa kaaseso, ama ta a ba kachipurso nɛ b mur nsaa maŋ naa wɔtɔ. Kusɔ nɛ k bee tu bekama nɛ baa ta eleŋsheŋ a kɔ a suge anyi be asɔ nna na.

english_verse: Egypt sends messengers up the Nile River on ships made of reeds. Send them fast to Ethiopia, whose people are tall and have smooth skin. Their land is divided by rivers; they are strong and brutal, feared all over the world.
translation_verse: Ijipt bee shuŋi mbɔ nna nɛ baa ta nchu so be ekuloŋ nɛ b ta agasa n lɔŋɛ a nite lɔrgboŋ nɛ baa tre Nail na so, fanɛ b nya manaŋ n yɔ Itiopia nɛ kumo be basa wɔ nteŋ nɛ bumo be kayurwule du mɔlmɔlbi na. Elɔr shibi nna ashi Itiopia ebi ere be kasawule so nɛ b kɔ eleŋ nseŋ lubi ga nɛ ekama bee ŋana bumo ashi durnya kikɛ to.

english_verse: Everyone on this earth, listen with care! A signal will be given on the mountains, and you will hear a trumpet.
translation_verse: Esa kama nɛ e wɔ durnya ere to, e nu nfe! Tɔɔnɛ be tuta ko beeŋ baa wɔ abee be awɔlto nɛ men wu kumo nseŋ nu kabel be kushu!

english_verse: The Lord said to me, “I will calmly look down from my home above— as calmly as the sun at noon or clouds in the heat of harvest season.”
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ ma le: “Meeŋ baa wɔ ma pe ashi ebɔrɛso nsaa keni kaseto boeŋ fanɛ kapiidi be epeŋi ŋko awɔlpa nɛ a bee lar kasɔteŋi be jemanɛ ketarso na.

english_verse: Ethiopians will be food for mountain vultures during the summer and for wild animals during the winter.
translation_verse: Itiopia be esoji na beeŋ ki keji n sa kebee so be ejita kechali so nsaa ki keji n sa kupuŋ to be asɔbɔya malɛ ketarso.”

english_verse: Those Ethiopians are tall and their skin is smooth. They are feared all over the world, because they are strong and brutal. But at that time they will come from their land divided by rivers, and they will bring gifts to the Lord All-Powerful, who is worshiped on Mount Zion.
translation_verse: Itiopia be basa ere la basa tenteŋ nɛ bumo be kayurwule du mɔlmɔlbi nna. Ekama bee ŋana bumo durnya ere to nna, ŋkpal b ka kɔ eleŋ ga nseŋ lubi so. Ama loŋ be jemanɛ kaŋ fo, baaŋ shi bumo be kasawule nɛ elɔr shibi kumo so na so n ta esarga m ba sa Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ nɛ baa shuŋ mo ashi Zayɔn be kebee so na.

english_verse: This is a message about Egypt: The Lord comes to Egypt, riding swiftly on a cloud. The people are weak from fear. Their idols tremble as he approaches and says,
translation_verse: Kubɔya nɛ k wɔtɔ a laŋɛ Ijipt be efuli be kaplɛa so nde. Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bɔla kuwɔlpa so nna a ba Ijipt be efuli so manaŋ manaŋ. Kufu pɛ Ijipt be agbirana nna nɛ a bee chicha mbe anishito, nɛ kumo be basa malɛ be ŋgbene jija bumo ga nɛ b paŋ kenyɛn.

english_verse: “Egypt will be discouraged when I confuse their plans. They will try to get advice from their idols, from the spirits of the dead, and from fortunetellers.
translation_verse: Ma alɛ beeŋ shin nɛ Ijiptebi be ŋkre e mel to nɛ bumo be ŋgbene e jija bumo nɛ b paŋ kenyɛn. Baaŋ ya fin kechɛto bumo be agbirana kutɔ nseŋ naaŋ yɔ belejipo kutɔ n ya bishi so a fin kenu kusɔ ko ashi bubuni kutɔ.

english_verse: I will put the Egyptians under the power of a cruel, heartless king. I, the Lord All-Powerful, have promised this.” Trouble along the Nile
translation_verse: Ma alɛ kraa beeŋ shin nɛ ewura nɛ e maa wu kuwɔr nsaa kute a wɔtɔ basa ebesa to na e ji kuwura bumo so. Ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na e kaŋɛ na.”

english_verse: The Nile River will dry up and become parched land.
translation_verse: Lɔrgboŋ nɛ k wɔ Ijipt be efuli so nɛ baa tre kumo Nail na beeŋ wɔlto m baŋɛ to.

english_verse: None of the cloth makers will know what to do, and they will turn pale.
translation_verse: Bekama malɛ nɛ baa lue ewajɛ lela na beeŋ ki chaam a wɔtɔ, a maaŋ naa nyi kusɔ nɛ baaŋ wora,

english_verse: Weavers will be confused; paid workers will cry and mourn. Egypt's Helpless Leaders
translation_verse: nɛ kagbenejija e tɔr basa nɛ baa lue kɔrɛ nɛ basa nɛ baa shuŋ a sɔ kakɔka so.

english_verse: The king's officials in Zoan are foolish themselves and give stupid advice. How can they say to him, “We are very wise, and our families go back to kings of long ago?”
translation_verse: Ijipt be ewura be benimuana nɛ b wɔ kadegboŋ nɛ baa tre Zowan na la bewulpo nna nsaa sa mo kawuliso be kasotoji. Amoso nuso nɛ baaŋ naŋ tiŋ n wora ŋ kaŋɛ ewura na le: “An nyi asheŋ ga. An shi dra dra na be bewura to be kanaŋ to nna!”

english_verse: Where are those wise men now? If they can, let them say what the Lord All-Powerful intends for Egypt.
translation_verse: Ijipt be ewura, nnɛ nɛ fo asoetojipo nyiashempoana na wɔ? Ashere baaŋ tiŋ ŋ kaŋɛ fo nfɛra nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na kɔ a laŋɛ Ijipt be kaplɛa so.

english_verse: The royal officials in Zoan and in Memphis are foolish and deceived. The leaders in every state have given bad advice to the nation.
translation_verse: Benimuana nɛ b wɔ Zowan nɛ Mɛmfis na la bewulpo nna. Bumo e daŋ daga fanɛ b juŋkpar efuli na, ama b sa basa kasotoji lubi nɛ k shin nɛ efuli na be basa foe ekpa.

english_verse: When the Lord All-Powerful punishes Egypt with his mighty arm, the Egyptians will become terribly weak and will tremble with fear.
translation_verse: Jemanɛ ko bee ba nɛ Ijipt be basa e paŋ kenyɛn fanɛ beche na. B baŋ wu fanɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee sha kegberge bumo kusoe nɛ kufugboŋ e tɔr bumo so nɛ b baa chicha.

english_verse: They will be so terrified of Judah that they will be frightened by the very mention of its name. This will happen because of what the Lord All-Powerful is planning against Egypt. The Lord Will Bless Egypt, Assyria, and Israel
translation_verse: Baaŋ fara a ŋana Judaebi ga. Hale nɛ b baŋ nu ketre Juda na gba, kufu bee pɛ bumo nna nɛ b baa chicha ŋkpal kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee kre a laŋɛ Ijipt be kaplɛa so so.

english_verse: The time is coming when Hebrew will be spoken in five Egyptian cities, and their people will become followers of the Lord. One of these cities will be called City of the Sun.
translation_verse: Loŋ be jemanɛ na kaŋ fo basa beeŋ baa gbar Hibruw be ŋgbar ashi Ijipt be efuli so be ndegboŋ anu to. Basa na beeŋ baa bɔ ntaŋ ashi Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na be ketre to. Ndegboŋ na be kuko be ketre e naŋ baa la Epeŋi be Kadegboŋ.

english_verse: In the heart of Egypt an altar will be set up for the Lord; at its border a shrine will be built to honor him.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ basa na e pɔr bɔrɛsure n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ashi Ijipt be kasawule so nseŋ naŋ yuu kanyiŋi be ajembu ashi Ijipt nɛ efuli pɔtɛana be egbaŋ to n sa mo.

english_verse: These will remind the Egyptians that the Lord All-Powerful is with them. And when they are in trouble and ask for help, he will send someone to rescue them from their enemies.
translation_verse: Ade kikɛ beeŋ baa nyiŋi Ijiptebi na fanɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na wɔ bumo kutɔ. Nɛ b kaŋ luri asheŋ to nseŋ kule Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na a fin kechɛto, e beeŋ shin nɛ esa ko e ba kɔ m mɔlga bumo ashi bumo doŋana be enɔ to.

english_verse: The Lord will show the Egyptians who he is, and they will know and worship the Lord. They will bring him sacrifices and offerings, and they will keep their promises to him.
translation_verse: Kede be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e lara mbe kumu ŋ ŋini Ijiptebi na, nɛ bumo alɛ e pin mo nsaa shuŋ mo. Baaŋ baa lara bumo be esarga nɛ ŋkɛ be yiri kikɛ a sa mo nsaa wora a bɔlɔ nnɔ nɛ b nase n sa mo so.

english_verse: After the Lord has punished Egypt, the people will turn to him. Then he will answer their prayers, and the Egyptians will be healed.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋ gberge Ijiptebi na kusoe n loge, baaŋ bɛta m ba mo kutɔ. Kumo be kaman nɛ e nu bumo be kabɔrɛkule nseŋ shin nɛ Ijiptebi na e nya kechɛ.

english_verse: At that time a good road will run from Egypt to Assyria. The Egyptians and the Assyrians will travel back and forth from Egypt to Assyria, and they will worship together.
translation_verse: Nɛ loŋ be jemanɛ na kaŋ fo, kegbembi lela gboŋgboŋi beeŋ dese n shi Ijipt n ya fo Asiriya. Saŋɛ na so efuli anyɔ ere be basa beeŋ baa yɔ abar be efuliana na so a ba nsaa tu abar a shuŋ Ebɔrɛ.

english_verse: Israel will join with these two countries. They will be a blessing to everyone on earth,
translation_verse: Israɛl beeŋ ti efuli anyɔ ere so, nɛ bumo nɛ Ijipt nɛ Asiriya e baa la nɛfa n sa durnya kikɛ.

english_verse: then the Lord All-Powerful will bless them by saying, “The Egyptians are my people. I created the Assyrians and chose the Israelites.”
translation_verse: Ade kikɛ be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na e nɛfa bumo nseŋ kaŋɛ le: “Ijiptebi la ma basa nna. Ma e to Asiriyaebi nseŋ lara Israɛlebi fanɛ ŋ gbagba be basa.”

english_verse: King Sargon of Assyria gave orders for his army commander to capture the city of Ashdod.
translation_verse: Asiriya be efuli so be ewurgboŋ nɛ baa tre Saagɔn na e daŋ kaŋɛ mbe benapo be ejuŋkparpo fanɛ e ya kɔ n sɔ Filistiebi be kadegboŋ nɛ baa tre Ashdɔd na.

english_verse: Everyone in these two countries will be led away naked and barefoot by the king of Assyria. Young or old, they will be taken prisoner, and Egypt will be disgraced.
translation_verse: Asiriya be ewurgboŋ na beeŋ delge basa nɛ e beeŋ pɛ kena to ashi efuli anyɔ na so n shin nɛ b nite aya fuloŋ n yɔ kenyaya to. Mbifɔlbi nɛ benimu kikɛ nɛ e beeŋ delge so n shin nɛ bumo be aperbi e baa dese, nɛ Ijiptebi e ŋaba.

english_verse: They will be confused and frustrated, because they depended on Ethiopia and bragged about Egypt.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ bekama nɛ b ta bumo be yirda n deŋi Itiopia so nseŋ daa puchi Ijipt so na be nfɛra mel to nɛ b pɔ aba.

english_verse: When this happens, the people who live along the coast will say, “Look what happened to them! We ran to them for safety, hoping they would protect us from the king of Assyria. But now, there is no escape for us.”
translation_verse: Loŋ be jemanɛ na kaŋ fo, basa nɛ b wɔ Filisti be efuli so be teku be ekarso na beeŋ kaŋɛ le: ‘Keni kusɔ nɛ k wora basa nɛ an ta anyi be amu to so fanɛ b baa kuŋ anyi ashi Asiriya be ewurgboŋ be enɔ to na! Nuso nɛ anyi alɛ beeŋ wora n nya anyi be amu?’ ”

english_verse: This is a message about a desert beside the sea: Enemies from a hostile nation attack like a whirlwind from the Southern Desert.
translation_verse: Kubɔya nɛ k wɔtɔ a laŋɛ Babilɔn be efuli so be kaplɛa so na nde. Kananɛ kawuliwuli bee koso kiyi to a choŋ na nɛ kumulubi gboŋgboŋi nɛ k bee bar kemur na beeŋ shi efuli nɛ kumo be asheŋ kɔ kufugboŋ na so m ba.

english_verse: I'm in terrible pain like a woman giving birth. I'm shocked and hurt so much that I can't hear or see.
translation_verse: Kusɔ nɛ n daŋ wu nseŋ nu bɔrɛdare na to na shin nna nɛ kufugboŋ ko nɛ ebesa fanɛ kakurge be ebesa luri ma to.

english_verse: Then I said, “My people, you have suffered terribly, but I have a message for you from the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel.” How Much Longer?
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ ma, Aizaaya kaŋɛ le: “Ma basa, Israɛlebi, men ji awurfoŋ fanɛ kananɛ baa bri adurbi kegoro so na, ama n teŋ kaŋɛ menyi baru lela nɛ n nu ashi Enyɛnpetale, Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na kutɔ.” Edɔm be kaplɛa so be kubɔya be asheŋ

english_verse: This is a message about Dumah: From the country of Seir, someone shouts to me, “Guard, how much longer before daylight?”
translation_verse: Kubɔya nɛ k wɔtɔ a laŋɛ efuli nɛ baa tre Edɔm na be kaplɛa so nde. Esa ko yili Edɔm be efuli so nna n tre ma m bishi le: “Ekenipo, saŋɛ mo nɛ kare beeŋ chɛ nɛ kaboŋ e fuli to?”

english_verse: From my guard post, I answered, “Morning will soon be here, but night will return. If you want to know more, come back later.”
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ mo: “K maaŋ chɛr nɛ kare e chɛ, ama kanyɛ kraa beeŋ naŋ biri. Nɛ fo kraa sha kenaŋ pin to n ti so, kumo ere fo naŋ bɛta m ba bishi to.” Areebia be kaplɛa so be kubɔya be asheŋ

english_verse: The Lord said to me: A year from now the glory of the people of Kedar will all come to an end, just as a worker's contract ends after a year.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ ma le: “Ta a ba fanɛ kafɛ be jemanɛ to gbagba, eyiri yiri nɛ b shi Areebia be kebonfu nɛ baa tre Kɛda na be kemaŋkura kikɛ beeŋ ba ekar, fanɛ kananɛ paawura be kushuŋ bee loge a ba ekar na.

english_verse: Only a few of their warriors will be left with bows and arrows. This is a promise that I, the Lord God of Israel, have made.
translation_verse: Bumo to be benapo nɛ baa ta ata a kɔ kena na e la basa nɛ b kɔ kenyɛn, ama bumo to be gbrɛbi e naaŋ ka a wɔ Kɛda be kebonfu to ndoŋ. Ma, Enyɛnpe Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na e kaŋɛ na.”

english_verse: Your city is filled with noisy shouts. Those who lie drunk in your streets were not killed in battle.
translation_verse: Awɔr e sɔ kadegboŋ na kikɛ to nɛ basa bee ji a nuu nsaa boŋ nshɛ a cha kaplɛkama. Menyi be basa nɛ b wu kena ere to ere be ekama maa kɔ kena nna nseŋ wu.

english_verse: Your leaders ran away, but they were captured without a fight. No matter how far they ran, they were found and caught.
translation_verse: Menyi be bejuŋkparpoana kikɛ daŋ cha abar nna a shile nɛ b ya pɛ bumo kaplɛkama nɛ b shile n yɔ na, nɛ bumo alɛ maŋ tiŋ ŋ kɔ gbrɛbi kama gba nɛ b suge bumo be amu.

english_verse: Then I said, “Leave me alone! Let me cry bitter tears. My people have been destroyed, so don't try to comfort me.”
translation_verse: Men yige ma nɛ n shu ga ŋkpal ma basa nɛ b wu na so. Men sa maŋ wora ania fanɛ menyeeŋ lɔlɔ ma.

english_verse: Your most beautiful valleys were covered with chariots; your cities were surrounded by cavalry troops.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ egbaŋɛturko ba sɔ Juda be ataŋɛ to be adɔsawule lela kikɛ so nɛ esoji nɛ b tase egbaŋɛ so ba yili Jerusalɛm be mbunagboŋ be anishito kikɛ.

english_verse: Then you built a large tank between the walls to store the water. But you refused to trust the God who planned this long ago and made it happen. A Time To Weep
translation_verse: men daŋ pɔr nchu be eyilikpa nna ashi kadegboŋ na to n sɔ nchu nɛ a shi kepa dra na to a ba na n yili. Ama men daŋ maŋ laŋɛ menyi be lakal Ebɔrɛ nɛ e kre ade kikɛ dra dra na kikɛ pɔɛŋ nɛ a bee wora ere bre so.

english_verse: When all of this happened, the Lord All-Powerful told you to weep and mourn, to shave your heads, and wear sackcloth.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na daŋ kaŋɛ menyi loŋ be kachɛ na fanɛ men baa shu anishichubi nsaa boŋ to awɔrso, nseŋ she menyi be amu m buu keeli be asɔbuuso.

english_verse: But instead, you celebrated by feasting on beef and lamb and by drinking wine, because you said, “Let's eat and drink today! Tomorrow we may die.”
translation_verse: Ama men daa maŋ nu n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nsaa ji eyur. Men daŋ mɔ mbolpɔ nɛ ana nna a ji nsaa nuu yabra. Ade kikɛ be kaman nɛ men kaŋɛ le: “Men shin nɛ an ji nseŋ nuu kabre! Ŋkpal manɛ so echefo nɛ an wu n choŋ.”

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful has spoken to me this solemn promise: “I won't forgive them for this, not as long as they live.” Selfish Officials Are Doomed
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na gbagba bɔ ntaŋ ŋ kaŋɛ ma le: “B maaŋ nya kulubi nɛ b wora ere be ketampaŋ ashi bumo be ŋkpa kikɛ to. Ma, Enyɛnpetale Ewurbɔrɛ na e kaŋɛ na.” Shebna be kasokpele be asheŋ

english_verse: Shebna, what gives you the right to have a tomb carved out of rock in this burial place of royalty? None of your relatives are buried here.
translation_verse: “Wanɛ nɛ fee fɛ fanɛ fo la? Manɛ e ba nɛ fo kur fo nchaŋ n nase kakpa nɛ baa puli bewura?

english_verse: You may be powerful, but the Lord is about to snatch you up and throw you away.
translation_verse: Feeŋ tiŋ a la esagboŋ a kɔ eleŋ ga, ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ fuu fo ŋ kpa n lɛ.

english_verse: He will roll you into a ball and throw you into a wide open country, where you will die and your chariots will be destroyed. You're a disgrace to those you serve.
translation_verse: E beeŋ bɔɔlɔ fo fanɛ bɔɔl ŋ kpa fo n lɛ efuli nɛ k shi ga so, kakpa nɛ feeŋ ya wu n dese m mata fo egbaŋɛturko nɛ fee puchi so na. Fo la ŋaba nna n sa fo nyɛnpe be laŋ to ebi.

english_verse: He will give your official robes and your authority to his servant Eliakim son of Hilkiah. Eliakim will be like a father to the people of Jerusalem and to the royal family of Judah.
translation_verse: nɛ n ta fo eshuŋkpa be piŋi nɛ kumo be kreso m mɛa mo to a ŋini basa fanɛ mo e sɔ fo so. Kumo be kaman nɛ e ki fanɛ etuto n sa Jerusalɛmebi kikɛ nɛ bekama nɛ b wɔ ewurkpa na.

english_verse: The Lord will put him in charge of the key that belongs to King David's family. No one will be able to unlock what he locks, and no one will be able to lock what he unlocks.
translation_verse: Ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ sa Eliakim eleŋ nɛ k bɛ ewura nɛ e shi Deevid be kanaŋ to peya so, saŋɛ na so kusɔ kama nɛ e yili, esa maaŋ tiŋ ŋ kini kumo; kusɔ kama malɛ nɛ e maŋ sa akpa, esa kikɛ maaŋ tiŋ n wora kumo.

english_verse: The Lord will make him as firm in his position as a tent peg hammered in the ground, and Eliakim will bring honor to his family.
translation_verse: Meeŋ shin nɛ e baa yil to kpakpa fanɛ b ka gbir keyir kasawule to na. E beeŋ baa la esa nɛ mbe kanaŋ to ebi kikɛ beeŋ bɔla so n nya kemaŋkura.

english_verse: His children and relatives will be supported by him, like pans hanging from a peg on the wall.
translation_verse: Ama mo kurgepoana nɛ mbe eyali kikɛ be kebaawɔtɔ beeŋ ba deŋ mo so nna fanɛ kananɛ baa ta mpuliya nɛ echeenshi a buu kelantaŋɛ to na!

english_verse: That peg is fastened firmly now, but someday it will be shaken loose and fall down. Then everything that was hanging on it will be destroyed. This is what the Lord All-Powerful has promised.
translation_verse: Naniere bre keyir na gbir kasawule to kpakpa nna na, ama kachako bee ba nɛ k gbuŋgbuŋ n tia n tɔr. Saŋɛ na so asɔ kama nɛ amo be egbɛ daa deŋ kumo so na gba beeŋ mur.” Kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ nna na.

english_verse: Your merchants sailed the seas, making you wealthy by trading with nation after nation. They brought back grain that grew along the Nile.
translation_verse: Men shuŋi basa Ijipt be efuli so nɛ b ya tɔ ayu n laŋɛ n fa, nseŋ tu efuliana nɛ a ka na n ji yawu be yiri kikɛ.

english_verse: Sidon, you are a mighty fortress built along the sea. But you will be disgraced like a married woman who never had children.
translation_verse: Sidɔn be kadegboŋ na du fanɛ kakpa lempo nɛ b pɔr n yili teku be ekarso nna. Ama fo alɛ beeŋ ji anishinyɔr fanɛ eche kilpo nɛ e maŋ kurge ŋ ku so na nna.

english_verse: When Egypt hears about Tyre, it will tremble.
translation_verse: Ijiptebi gba kaŋ nu fanɛ Tayɛ mur, k beeŋ chinchiŋ bumo nɛ kufu e pɛ bumo.

english_verse: All of you along the coast had better cry and sail far across the ocean.
translation_verse: Menyi nɛ men wɔ efuli nɛ baa tre Fenisha na e boŋ to awɔrso n shu ga nseŋ wora ania n shile n yɔ efuli nɛ baa tre Speen na!

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful planned it to bring shame and disgrace to those who are honored by everyone on earth.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na e daŋ kre kumo fanɛ e beeŋ shin nɛ bumo be mpuchi nɛ baa puchi ŋkpal kusɔ nɛ b tiŋ n wora so na e ba ekar nɛ e ŋaba bumo be bunyaŋwuraana.

english_verse: People of Tyre, your harbor is destroyed! You will have to become farmers just like the Egyptians. Tyre Will Be Forgotten
translation_verse: Tayɛebi, men ya kaa dɔ menyi be kasawule na so fanɛ kananɛ Ijiptebi bee dɔ Nail be lɔrgboŋ na be ekarso na, ŋkpal manɛ so, menyi maŋ naa kɔ kakpa nɛ men baa yili menyi be ekuloŋgboŋana.

english_verse: The Lord's hand has reached across the sea, upsetting the nations. He has given a command to destroy fortresses in the land of Canaan.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na teŋi mbe enɔ to m baŋ teku so n ya shin nɛ kufugboŋ tɔr efuliana na so. Mo alɛ yili kumo nna fanɛ Fenisha be efuli so be ndegboŋ nɛ b pɔr egbal lempoana ŋ kulti na kikɛ beeŋ mur.

english_verse: The Lord has said to the people of Sidon, “Your celebrating is over— you are crushed. Even if you escape to Cyprus, you won't find peace.”
translation_verse: Ade be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ Sidɔn be basa na le: “Menyi be kayurji na fo ekar. Menyi alɛ mur nna na. Hale nɛ men ŋana n shile n yɔ Saipres be kepla so gba, men kraa maaŋ nya kayurwushi ndoŋ.”

english_verse: You're gone and forgotten, you evil woman! So strut through the town, singing and playing your favorite tune to be remembered again.
translation_verse: Ta jaŋjilaŋ n nite ŋ kulti kade na kikɛ to, fo sakaleche nɛ b teŋ fo so ere! Baa laŋ kumo nsaa boŋ fo nshɛ nɛ fee sha ga na nɛ fo basa e naŋ nyiŋi fo asheŋ nseŋ bɛta m ba.

english_verse: but none of what is earned will be kept in the city. That money will belong to the Lord, and it will be used to buy more than enough food and good clothes for those who worship the Lord.
translation_verse: ama asɔ kama nɛ e beeŋ nya na be kekama maaŋ nya n yili kadegboŋ na to. Amansherbi na beeŋ baa la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na peya nɛ bekama nɛ baa shuŋ mo na e ta amo n tɔ ajibi damta nɛ asɔbuuso lela nɛ baa sha.

english_verse: The Lord is going to twist the earth out of shape and turn it into a desert. Everyone will be scattered,
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee sha kejija durnya kikɛ nna nɛ k dese fuloŋ fanɛ kiyitokpaŋ na. E beeŋ melgi durnya na m buu nseŋ pesaŋ kumo be basa to.

english_verse: The earth will be stripped bare and left that way. This is what the Lord has promised.
translation_verse: Durnya na beeŋ jija nseŋ mur kuraa. Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e kaŋɛ; kumo alɛ beeŋ wora loŋ.

english_verse: The earth is polluted because its people disobeyed the laws of God, breaking their agreement that was to last forever.
translation_verse: Edimɛdi jija durnya nna ŋkpal b ka kini kewora Ebɔrɛ be mbraana kasonu so. Bumo alɛ maŋ naa sa bumo nɛ Ebɔrɛ be kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre nɛ k daga fanɛ k baa wɔtɔ mbaanaayɔ na bunyaŋ.

english_verse: The earth is under a curse; its people are dying out because of their sins.
translation_verse: Amoso Ebɔrɛ sho durnya na kɔnɔ nna nɛ kumo to be basa bee wu ŋkpal bumo be alubi so.

english_verse: Grapevines have dried up: wine is almost gone— mournful sounds are heard instead of joyful shouts.
translation_verse: Ewaindibi bee wu nna nɛ yabra be asheŋ bee ki kpakpa. Esa kama nɛ mbe kagbene daa fuli mo wɔ kagbenejija to naniere nna.

english_verse: No one plays tambourines or stringed instruments; all noisy celebrating has come to an end.
translation_verse: Kagbenefuliso be nshɛ nɛ b daa laŋ ejaŋjilaŋ nɛ ŋkure a boŋ na kikɛ kuu.

english_verse: They no longer sing as they drink their wine, and it tastes sour.
translation_verse: Basa maŋ naa nuu yabra nsaa boŋ nshɛ kagbenefuliso. Yabra gba maŋ naa wora basa ebel

english_verse: Happy times have disappeared from the earth, and people shout in the streets, “We're out of wine!”
translation_verse: Kagbenefuli foe durnya to nɛ basa bee ponte to agbembi so a kaŋɛ le: “Anyi maŋ naa kɔ yabra! Anyi maŋ naa kɔ yabra!”

english_verse: Cities are destroyed; their gates are torn down.
translation_verse: Ndegboŋana na kikɛ mur nɛ amo be mbunagboŋana buri to n tɔr.

english_verse: And so, everyone in the east and those on the islands should praise the Lord, the God of Israel.
translation_verse: nɛ bumo nɛ b wɔ epeŋilarkpa na malɛ e kpaŋ mo. Basa nɛ b wɔ teku be ekarso na malɛ gba beeŋ fur Enyɛnpe, Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na.

english_verse: From all over the world songs of praise are heard for the God of justice. But I feel awful, terribly miserable. Can anyone be trusted? So many are treacherous! There's No Escape
translation_verse: Anyeeŋ nu b kaa bee boŋ nshɛ a kpaŋ Israɛl nɛ k la efuli niŋiso na ashi durnya be mboŋ wɔfɔ wɔfɔ kikɛ. Ama tama maŋ wɔtɔ n sa ma ere! Ma ere be asheŋ jija n loge nna na! Bedebɔrpo kraa wɔtɔ nna a debɔr basa, nɛ bumo be kedebɔre na malɛ bee daŋɛ so.

english_verse: Terror, traps, and pits are waiting for everyone.
translation_verse: Ekama e nu nfe! Kufugboŋ nɛ amaŋ chiŋgeliŋ nɛ ajigbelɛ dese a jo menyi.

english_verse: If you are terrified and run, you will fall into a pit; if you crawl out of the pit, you will get caught in a trap. The sky has split apart like a window thrown open. The foundations of the earth have been shaken;
translation_verse: Ekama nɛ e wora ania n shile kufugboŋ na beeŋ ya tɔr kemaŋ chiŋgeliŋ to, nɛ emo nɛ e gelge kemaŋ chiŋgeliŋ malɛ e ya tɔr kejigbelɛ to. Bɔrɛchu damta beeŋ shi awɔlpa so m ba kasawule so nɛ durnya be gbaltɔlase e gbuŋgbuŋ to.

english_verse: the earth is shattered, ripped to pieces.
translation_verse: Kasawule beeŋ pante m baŋɛ to kaplɛkama.

english_verse: It staggers and shakes like a drunkard or a hut in a windstorm. It is burdened down with sin; the earth will fall, never again to get up.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ durnya na e baa lente fanɛ esa nɛ e boo nsa na, ŋko afugboŋ kaa bee ber kubuu so na. Durnya be alubi pɔɔ kumo so. Amoso k beeŋ mur nsaa maaŋ naaŋ tiŋ ŋ koso kikɛ.

english_verse: On that day the Lord will punish the powers in the heavens and the kings of the earth.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ gberge esoso be eleŋana nɛ durnya to be bewuraana kusoe.

english_verse: He will put them in a pit and keep them prisoner. Then later on, he will punish them.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ beeŋ gbargbar bewuraana n wɔtɔ kemaŋ gboŋ koŋwule to fanɛ basa nɛ b wɔ kabuti to na. E beeŋ ti bumo so loŋ hale nɛ bumo be kasogberge be saŋɛ e ya fo ekar.

english_verse: Both the moon and sun will be embarrassed and ashamed. The Lord All-Powerful will rule on Mount Zion in Jerusalem, where he will show its rulers his wonderful glory.
translation_verse: Kufɔl beeŋ biri to nɛ epeŋi e nyaŋɛ ŋ gben, ŋkpal manɛ so, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na e la ewura. Zayɔn be kebee na so nɛ e beeŋ baa wɔ nsaa ji Jerusalɛm so kuwura nɛ basa na be benimuana e wu mbe kemaŋkura.

english_verse: You, Lord, are my God! I will praise you for doing the wonderful things you had planned and promised since ancient times.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, fo e la ma Ebɔrɛ; Meeŋ maŋkura fo nseŋ kpaŋ fo ketre. Fo e wora emamachisheŋ nɛ a bee mɔ kɔnɔ; fo alɛ e ta kashenteŋji n shin nɛ fo ŋkre nɛ fo wora dra na kikɛ bɔlɔ so.

english_verse: You have destroyed the fortress of our enemies, leaving their city in ruins. Nothing in that foreign city will ever be rebuilt.
translation_verse: Fo e shin nɛ ndegboŋana bure ŋ ki alambure nɛ amo be ekuŋkpa lempoana mur. Ewurkpaana nɛ an doŋana pɔr na mur hale mbaanaayɔ.

english_verse: You have been a place of safety for the poor and needy in times of trouble. Brutal enemies pounded us like a heavy rain or the heat of the sun at noon, but you were our shelter.
translation_verse: Betirpo nɛ basa nɛ b maaŋ tiŋ n chɛ bumo be amu to shile m ba buu fo etɔrɔ be jemanɛ nseŋ nya bumo be amu. Fo e kuŋ bumo ashi bɔrɛfugboŋ to nseŋ sa bumo kayul epeŋi nyaŋnyaŋso so. Bedoŋ nɛ b maa wu kuwɔr kre m ba fanɛ gbaŋgbaŋ to be afugboŋ,

english_verse: Those wild foreigners struck like scorching desert heat. But you were like a cloud, protecting us from the sun. You kept our enemies from singing songs of victory. The Lord Has Saved Us
translation_verse: ŋko ewule ashi kasawule wɔlso so nna. Ama fo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na shin nɛ an doŋana lo bumo be nnɔ; nseŋ shin nɛ basa nɛ b maa wu kuwɔr be awɔr kuu, fanɛ kananɛ awɔlpa to be epeŋi be ebeldɛ bee dugaso na. Ebɔrɛ ka bela kejigboŋ ase be asheŋ

english_verse: On this mountain the Lord All-Powerful will prepare for all nations a feast of the finest foods. Choice wines and the best meats will be served.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ bela ajibi lela nɛ asɔ nuuso belbelso be kejigboŋ ase n sa durnya to be efuliana kikɛ so ebi ashi kebee nɛ baa tre Zayɔn na so ashi Jerusalɛm.

english_verse: Here the Lord will strip away the burial clothes that cover the nations.
translation_verse: Kebee ere so nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ lara kagbenejija nɛ k du fanɛ awɔlpa a buu efuliana na kikɛ so na.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful will destroy the power of death and wipe away all tears. No longer will his people be insulted everywhere. The Lord has spoken!
translation_verse: Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ mur luwu mbaanaayɔ! E beeŋ kpra anishichubi ashi ekama be anishito nseŋ lara ŋaba nɛ mbe basa ji ashi durnya kikɛ to na ashi bumo so. Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na gbagba e kaŋɛ.

english_verse: The powerful arm of the Lord will protect this mountain. The Moabites will be put down and trampled on like straw in a pit of manure.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e naŋ kuŋ Zayɔn be kebee ere, ama e beeŋ chichi efuli nɛ baa tre Mowab na be basa so fanɛ ana ka chichi atuweklaŋ so n wɔtɔ depɔ to na.

english_verse: They will struggle to get out, but God will humiliate them no matter how hard they try.
translation_verse: Baaŋ wora ania fanɛ baaŋ lar depɔ na to, ama Ebɔrɛ beeŋ wora bumo eyurto n shin nɛ b lar ŋ gben.

english_verse: The walls of their fortresses will be knocked down and scattered in the dirt.
translation_verse: E beeŋ shin nɛ Mowabebi na be kumɔlga be kakpa lempoana be egbal jeŋgreŋana e bure n tɔr ŋ ki fanɛ eshishɛr.

english_verse: The time is coming when the people of Judah will sing this song: “Our city is protected. The Lord is our fortress, and he gives us victory.
translation_verse: Kachako bee ba nɛ basa e boŋ kashɛ ere ashi Juda be kasawule so: Anyi be kadegboŋ na kɔ eleŋ! Ebɔrɛ gbagba e naa kɔ a kuŋ kumo be egbalana!

english_verse: The Lord gives perfect peace to those whose faith is firm.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e naa sa basa nɛ bumo be yirda yil to kpakpa na kayurwushi gbagba.

english_verse: So always trust the Lord because he is forever our mighty rock.
translation_verse: Amoso an baa yirda Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na saŋkama, nɛ e baa la fanɛ kefalta a kuŋ anyi saŋkikɛ.

english_verse: God has put down our enemies in their mountain city and rubbed it in the dirt.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ bar an doŋana nɛ baa maŋ bumo be amu so na kaseto; nseŋ mur kadegboŋ lempo nɛ b daa wɔtɔ na, nseŋ shin nɛ kumo be egbalana bure n tɔr kasawule.

english_verse: Now the poor and abused trample all over that city.” The Lord Can Be Trusted
translation_verse: Naniere betirpo nɛ basa nɛ bedoŋ na daa kɔrfɛ na e naa chichi a chichi kakpa nɛ kadegboŋ na daa wɔ na so.

english_verse: Our Lord, you always do right, and you make the path smooth for those who obey you.
translation_verse: Kusɔ nɛ k daga nɛ fo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ bee wora jemanɛ kikɛ, nsaa shin nɛ ekpabi bee ki fanɛ kegbembi a sa basa nɛ baa wora fo kasonu.

english_verse: You are the one we trust to bring about justice; above all else we want your name to be honored.
translation_verse: Anyee bɛ fo aparsheŋ so nna nsaa ta anyi be tama a to fo so. Fo nawule be ketre nɛ anyee sha fanɛ k baa nya kemaŋkura ashi anyi be ŋgbene to.

english_verse: Throughout the night, my heart searches for you, because your decisions show everyone on this earth how to live right.
translation_verse: Kanyɛso kikɛ ma kagbene bee kɔ a fin fo nna. Fo baŋ ji durnya nɛ kumo be basa demu, bumo kikɛ beeŋ koya kebaawɔtɔ ŋini so.

english_verse: Even when the wicked are treated with mercy in this land of justice, they do wrong and are blind to your glory, our Lord.
translation_verse: Kuwɔr nɛ fo wu kumu kpakpasowuraana ere kikɛ be kaman, b kraa maŋ naŋ koya kewora kusɔ nɛ k daga. Basa nɛ b niŋi gba be kasawule so nfe b kraa wora asheŋ lubi nna nseŋ kini kewu fo, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be kemaŋkura.

english_verse: Your hand is raised and ready to punish them, but they don't see it. Put them to shame! Show how much you care for us and throw them into the fire intended for your enemies.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, fo doŋana maŋ nyi fanɛ feeŋ gberge bumo kusoe. Shin nɛ b wu fanɛ fee sha kebaachɛ fo basa to saŋkama nna, nɛ anishinyɔr e pɛ bumo. Shin nɛ edɛ nɛ fo bela ase a jo fo doŋana na e chɔɔ bumo m mur.

english_verse: You will give us peace, Lord, because everything we have done was by your power.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, fo e naaŋ sa anyi kedamaya nɛ kayurwushi, ŋkpal manɛ so, kusɔ kama nɛ anyee wora, fo eleŋ to nɛ anyee tiŋ a wora kumo.

english_verse: Others have ruled over us besides you, our Lord God, but we obey only you.
translation_verse: Beko gba daŋ ji kuwura anyi so n ti fo, Enyɛnpe anyi be Ebɔrɛ na so, ama fo nawule nɛ anyee wora kasonu.

english_verse: Those enemies are now dead and can never live again. You have punished them— they are destroyed, completely forgotten.
translation_verse: Bumo kikɛ wu naniere nsaa maaŋ naa wɔ ŋkpa to. Bumo be abuniyoyu maaŋ naŋ koso kikɛ, ŋkpal fo ka gberge bumo kusoe nseŋ mur bumo so. Esa maaŋ naŋ nyiŋi bumo kikɛ.

english_verse: Our nation has grown because of you, our Lord. We have more land than before, and you are honored. The Lord Gives Life to the Dead
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, fo e shin nɛ anyi be basa wora keshi, fo e kpalga anyi be efuli be egbaŋ kaba kama so; nɛ kumo be loŋ bar fo kemaŋkura.

english_verse: When you punished our people, they turned and prayed to you, our Lord.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, fo gberge fo basa kusoe, nɛ b ta kagbenejija nɛ kushu ŋ kule fo.

english_verse: Because of what you did to us, we suffered like a woman about to give birth.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal kusɔ nɛ fo wora anyi na so, an daŋ ji awurfoŋ fanɛ eche nɛ kakurge ta mo nna.

english_verse: But instead of having a child, our terrible pain produced only wind. We have won no victories, and we have no descendants to take over the earth.
translation_verse: An daa wɔ ebesa damta to nna fanɛ eche nɛ kakurge ta na, ama anyi alɛ daa maŋ kurge. An daa maŋ tiŋ ŋ kɔ m pɔɔ so kikɛ ashi anyi be kasawule so; anyi alɛ maŋ tiŋ n wora ŋko n nya shɛŋ n sa basa durnya to.

english_verse: Go inside and lock the doors, my people. Hide there for a little while, until the Lord is no longer angry. The Earth and the Sea Will Be Punished
translation_verse: Ma basa, men luri menyi be ebuana to nseŋ ti menyi be amu so n wɔtɔ. Men ŋana ndoŋ gbrɛbi, n ya fo fanɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be agbo ka beeŋ wushi.

english_verse: The Lord will come out to punish everyone on earth for their sins. And when he does, those who did violent crimes will be known and punished.
translation_verse: Keni, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ shi ebɔrɛso m ba gberge durnya to be basa kusoe ŋkpal bumo alubi so. Basa kama nɛ b mɔ ashiri to na be asheŋ beeŋ lar efuli nɛ b nya kumo be kasogberge.

english_verse: On that day, Leviathan, the sea monster, will squirm and try to escape, but the Lord will kill him with a cruel, sharp sword. Protection and Forgiveness The Lord said:
translation_verse: Kamɔnchɛ kaŋ fo, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ ta mbe tokobi nɛ k kɔ eleŋ ga na ŋ gberge kusɔbɔya gbeyeso gboŋgboŋi nɛ k wɔ teku to nɛ baa tre kumo Liviatan na kusoe m mɔ kumo.

english_verse: I, the Lord, will protect it and always keep it watered. I will guard it day and night to keep it from harm.
translation_verse: “Mee keni kudɔ na so nna nsaa wurge kumo so nchu jemanɛ kikɛ. Ma alɛ naa kuŋ kumo kapa nɛ kanyɛ nna nɛ esa kikɛ e sa maŋ tiŋ n tɔrɔ kumo.

english_verse: I am no longer angry. But if it produces thorns, I will go to war against it and burn it to the ground.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman, m maŋ naŋ nya agbo n wɔtɔ ndibi sɔrso be kudɔ na. Nɛ fanɛ ewi be yiri yiri kɔr kumo to gba, meeŋ tia amo kikɛ n chɔɔ m mur cheche.

english_verse: Yet if the vineyard depends on me for protection, it will become my friend and be at peace with me.
translation_verse: Ama nɛ ma basa bumo doŋana bee sha fanɛ m baa kuŋ bumo bre, b shin nɛ ma nɛ bumo e nya kayurwushi anyi be kefɛato.”

english_verse: I, the Lord, didn't punish and kill the people of Israel as fiercely as I punished and killed their enemies.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na maŋ naŋ gberge Israɛl be basa kusoe kenishipereso nseŋ mɔ bumo be basa fanɛ kananɛ e gberge bumo doŋana kusoe nseŋ mɔ bumo be basa na.

english_verse: There's only one way that Israel's sin and guilt can be completely forgiven: They must crush the stones of every pagan altar and place of worship. The Lord Will Bring His People Together
translation_verse: Ekpa koŋwule so nɛ Israɛlebi beeŋ tiŋ m bɔla so n nya bumo be alubi nɛ kewora n jija be ketampaŋ. A daga fanɛ b bure nnyamase be agbirsure nɛ b pɔr a chɔɔ eduwu amo so na nseŋ tia kegbirche nɛ baa tre Ashira na be ndibi tenteŋ nɛ b yuu na kikɛ n lɛ.

english_verse: Fortress cities are left like a desert where no one lives. Cattle walk through the ruins, stripping the trees bare.
translation_verse: Kadegboŋ nɛ k kɔ egbal kuŋso lempoana na e ki alambure fanɛ keshishɛrsawule nɛ ekama maŋ wɔ kumo to, a dese na. K ki ana be ejikpa nɛ kakpa nɛ baa dese a wushi nna.

english_verse: When broken branches fall to the ground, women pick them up to feed the fire. But these people are so stupid that the God who created them will show them no mercy.
translation_verse: Kumo to be ndibi be ayabi bee wɔl nna a buri a tɔr nɛ beche bee kil amo a puga edɛ. Ŋkpal basa na ka maŋ pin asheŋ to na so, Ebɔrɛ nɛ e to bumo na maaŋ wu bumo kuwɔr ŋko n shu bumo so.

english_verse: The time is coming when the Lord will shake the land between the Euphrates River and the border of Egypt, and one by one he will bring all of his people together.
translation_verse: Jemanɛ ko bee ba nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e yili Lɔrgboŋ nɛ baa tre Yufreetes na n ya fo Ijipt be egbaŋ to na ŋ gama mbe basa abar so fanɛ kananɛ baa beri ayu a chela to a deŋi abar so na.

english_verse: A loud trumpet will be heard. Then the people of Israel who were dragged away to Assyria and Egypt will return to worship the Lord on his holy mountain in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Kachɛ na kaŋ fo, kabel beeŋ shu awɔrso n tre Israɛlebi nɛ b pɛ n yɔ kenyaya to ashi Asiriya nɛ Ijipt be efuliana so na. Baaŋ bɛta m ba kaa shuŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na mbe kebee cheembi na so ashi Jerusalɛm to.

english_verse: The city of Samaria above a fertile valley is in for trouble! Its leaders are drunkards, who stuff themselves with food and wine. But they will be like flowers that dry up and wilt.
translation_verse: Asheŋ maaŋ nyalɛ n sa Israɛl be kuwurji na. Kadegboŋ nɛ baa tre Samɛria nɛ k dese ketaŋɛ nɛ k bee wora adɔjibi ga na be ekarso na wɔ asheŋ to pasaa. Kumo be bejuŋkparpoana la basa booso nsaa maŋ bumo be amu so, a sha kebaaji nsaa nuu nsa a boo ga. Baaŋ ki fanɛ atoto a wɔl m bolo nna.

english_verse: Only the Lord is strong and powerful! His mighty hand will strike them down with the force of a hailstorm or a mighty whirlwind or an overwhelming flood.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na teŋ nya esa ko nɛ e kɔ eleŋ nɛ yuku nseŋ wora shiriya nɛ e kɔ bumo. E la esa nɛ e beeŋ ba fanɛ bɔrɛfugboŋ nɛ kumo nɛ bɔrɛchu wea abar to a ba nɛ k ba buu kasawule so na nna.

english_verse: Every drunkard in Ephraim takes pride in Samaria, but it will be crushed.
translation_verse: Bejuŋkparpo booso na be kusɔ nɛ baa puchi so beeŋ mur nɛ basa e baa chichi kumo a choŋ.

english_verse: Samaria above a fertile valley will quickly lose its glory. It will be gobbled up like the first ripe fig at harvest season.
translation_verse: Bumo be kemaŋkura nɛ k bee terge na beeŋ foe fanɛ asɔrso nɛ a juŋkpar m bel kafɛ to, nɛ basa bee fuu amo a ji na.

english_verse: He will see that justice rules and that his people are able to defend their cities. Corrupt Leaders Will Be Punished
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ sa demujipoana kashenteŋji be nfɛra nseŋ sa kadegboŋ na be mbuna kenipoana kenyɛn be kagbene nɛ b baa tiŋ a kuŋ kadegboŋ na. Aizaaya nɛ Juda be anebi boosoana na be asheŋ

english_verse: Their tables are covered, completely covered, with their stinking vomit.
translation_verse: B kwiɛ n sɔ mbɛ nɛ b chena so na kikɛ nna nɛ ndoŋ kikɛ bee dufɛ ekwiɛ.

english_verse: You don't even listen— all you hear is senseless sound after senseless sound.
translation_verse: E bee wora ania nna nɛ e baa ŋini anyi nsibɛbi nɛ mmalgabi nɛ a maŋ kɔ afito.”

english_verse: So, the Lord will speak to his people in strange sounds and foreign languages.
translation_verse: Nɛ menyi maaŋ nu n sa ma, kumo ere Ebɔrɛ beeŋ shin nɛ befɔ nɛ baa gbar ŋgbar pɔtɛ e ŋini menyi asheŋ.

english_verse: He promised you perfect peace and rest, but you refused to listen.
translation_verse: E bee sha kesa menyi kikɛ ewushi nɛ kayurwushi nna, ama men kini kenu n sa mo.

english_verse: Now his message to you will be senseless sound after senseless sound. Then you will fall backwards, injured and trapped. False Security Is Fatal
translation_verse: Amoso nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee sha keŋini menyi nsibɛbi nɛ mmalgabi nɛ menyi maaŋ pin to na. Kumo be kaman keya kama nɛ menyeeŋ tia, menyeeŋ fiti n tɔr n doro nɛ b naŋ pɛ menyi fanɛ anya. Zayɔn be kebonfu to be kejembu na be asheŋ

english_verse: You rulers of Jerusalem do nothing but sneer; now you must listen to what the Lord says.
translation_verse: To, menyi basa kpeŋso nɛ menyee ji kuwura basa ere so ashi Jerusalɛm to na e kaŋ asoe n nu kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee kaŋɛ.

english_verse: Do you think you have an agreement with death and the world of the dead? Why do you trust in your lies to keep you safe from danger and the mighty flood?
translation_verse: Menyee ka kaŋɛ fanɛ menyi ere nɛ luwu wora kɔnɔ nna, nɛ menyi nɛ basa nɛ b wu n yɔ bubuni to be nnɔ wora kukoŋwule. Men yirda fanɛ jɛrbi kama nɛ k beeŋ ba maaŋ wora menyi shɛŋ ŋkpal efɛ nɛ kafule be kebaawɔtɔ nɛ men wɔtɔ na so.

english_verse: Morning, noon, and night an overwhelming flood will wash you away. The terrible things that happen will teach you this lesson:
translation_verse: Jɛrbi beeŋ gbelge menyi so kachipurso nɛ kapaso nɛ kanyɛso kikɛ nna fanɛ nchu ka bee bɔlɔ a ba na. Kubɔya popɔr kama malɛ nɛ k beeŋ shi Ebɔrɛ kutɔ m ba menyi kutɔ beeŋ ta kufugboŋ m pɛ menyi!

english_verse: So you had better stop sneering or you will be in worse shape than ever before. I heard the Lord All-Powerful threaten the whole country with destruction. All Wisdom Comes from the Lord
translation_verse: Men sa maŋ kaa mushe kasokpele nɛ mee sa menyi ere! Nɛ men kaŋ wora loŋ, k beeŋ baa du kpakpa n sa menyi nɛ men nya n lar asheŋ to. N nu fanɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na yili kumo nna fanɛ e beeŋ mur efuli na kikɛ. Ebɔrɛ be kanyiasheŋ be asheŋ

english_verse: Pay close attention to what I am saying.
translation_verse: Men nu kusɔ mee malga ere nseŋ wɔtɔ lakal kusɔ nɛ mee kaŋɛ menyi ere to.

english_verse: Farmers don't just plow and break up the ground.
translation_verse: Edɔpo kikɛ maŋ wɔtɔ a lɔŋɛ mbe kudɔ so jemanɛ kikɛ mbaanaayɔ.

english_verse: When a field is ready, they scatter the seeds of dill and cumin; they plant the seeds of wheat and barley in the proper places and sow other grains around the edges.
translation_verse: E baŋ lɔŋɛ so n dɔ n loge e bee ŋmenyaŋ epofantaŋ be aduuso nna. Kumo be kaman nɛ e duu aboyu nɛ ayu mbure so nseŋ duu aduuso pɔtɛ n wɔtɔ egbaŋ to.

english_verse: After dill and cumin have been harvested, the stalks are pounded, not run over with a wagon.
translation_verse: E maa ta ndibi gbɛgbɛso a beri ayu a bɛa amo to. Ndibi nɛ a kukwe nseŋ daga nɛ e bee ta a beri amo.

english_verse: Wheat and barley are pounded, but not beaten to pulp; they are run over with a wagon, but not ground to dust.
translation_verse: Mo alɛ maa beri ayu na nna hale nɛ a nia n luri eshishɛr to ŋko nɛ a bɛa to ŋ ki nyifu. E bee beri amo nna a lara bibi na ashi amimi na to.

english_verse: This wonderful knowledge comes from the Lord All-Powerful, who has such great wisdom.
translation_verse: Kanyiasheŋ ere kikɛ shi Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na kutɔ nna. Ebɔrɛ bee kre ŋkre kanyiasheŋ so nna, nɛ amo alɛ bee wora a bɔlɔ so jemanɛ kikɛ!

english_verse: Jerusalem, city of David, the place of my altar, you are in for trouble! Celebrate your festivals year after year.
translation_verse: Asheŋ maaŋ nyalɛ n sa Jerusalɛm, kakpa nɛ ma bɔrɛsure na wɔ nɛ k la kadegboŋ nɛ Deevid daŋ chena kumo to na! Kumo to be basa beeŋ tiŋ a ji bumo be nchɛgboŋ kafɛ kafɛ kikɛ.

english_verse: I will surround you and prepare to attack from all sides.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ beeŋ kre kena m ba kulti kadegboŋ na kikɛ n wɔtɔ ŋ kɔ kumo.

english_verse: From deep in the earth, you will call out for help with only a faint whisper.
translation_verse: Jerusalɛm beeŋ ki fanɛ kebuniyoyu ka wɔ nchaŋ to a wora ania nɛ e malga fanɛ ebɔl ka fɛa nseŋ shi kasawule to a malga nɛ k maa nu to na.

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, will come to your rescue with a thundering earthquake and a fiery whirlwind.
translation_verse: nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ bɔla bɔrɛfugboŋ nɛ kebembeŋ so ŋ kɔ n suge menyi n yige. E beeŋ shin nɛ afugboŋ nɛ edɛ wuloŋwuloŋ e ba.

english_verse: Be shocked and stunned, you prophets! Refuse to see. Get drunk and stagger, but not from wine.
translation_verse: Asheŋ beeŋ chinchiŋ menyi anebiana na nseŋ mɔ menyi kɔnɔ! Menyeeŋ buu anishi so fanɛ etanpo a wɔtɔ! Menyeeŋ boo a jante nɛ menyi maŋ nuu nsa!

english_verse: The Lord has said: “These people praise me with their words, but they never really think about me. They worship me by repeating rules made up by humans.
translation_verse: Ade be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ le: “Nnɔ fuloŋ nɛ basa ere kɔ a shuŋ ma nɛ bumo be ŋgbene malɛ maŋ wɔ ma so. Edimɛdi be mbra nɛ edaŋkare nɛ b bii n wɔtɔ amu to nawule nɛ baa bɛ so a shuŋ Ebɔrɛ.

english_verse: So once again I will do things that shock and amaze them, and I will destroy the wisdom of those who claim to know and understand.”
translation_verse: Amoso meeŋ wora asheŋ nɛ a beeŋ chinchiŋ bumo nseŋ chɔɔ bumo be ŋgbene to nɛ bumo be nnɔ e mɔ bumo. Bumo to be benyiashempo beeŋ ki bewulpo nɛ bumo be kashennyi e ki jiga.” Echefoso be tama be asheŋ

english_verse: You are in for trouble, if you try to hide your plans from the Lord! Or if you think what you do in the dark can't be seen.
translation_verse: Asheŋ maaŋ nyalɛ n sa bekama nɛ baa ta bumo be ŋkre a ŋana Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na so na! Baa wora asheŋ ŋgbalanto nna a fɛ fanɛ esa kikɛ maaŋ wu bumo ŋko m pin kusɔ nɛ baa wora na.

english_verse: You have it all backwards. A clay dish doesn't say to the potter, “You didn't make me. You don't even know how.” Hope for the Future
translation_verse: Baa melgi kusɔ kama na nna a buu. Epɔrpo nɛ ebɔ nɛ e kɔ a pɔr na, emo e bɔ? Kusɔ nɛ esa lɔŋɛ beeŋ tiŋ ŋ kaŋɛ esa na fanɛ: “Manɛ fo e lɔŋɛ ma a?” Ŋko ŋ kaŋɛ mo fanɛ “Fo maŋ nyi kusɔ nɛ fee wora ere a?”

english_verse: Soon the forest of Lebanon will become a field with crops, thick as a forest.
translation_verse: Aloŋ nɛ baa kaa kaŋɛ fanɛ k maaŋ chɛr, kupuŋ beeŋ ki kudɔsawule nɛ kudɔsawule malɛ e ki kupuŋ.

english_verse: The deaf will be able to hear whatever is read to them; the blind will be freed from a life of darkness.
translation_verse: Kachɛ na kaŋ fo, ekpawu beeŋ nu b kaa bee kraŋ kawɔl awɔrso nɛ etanpo, nɛ b wɔ tentembiri to, e bugi anishi a wu.

english_verse: The poor and the needy will celebrate and shout because of the Lord, the holy God of Israel.
translation_verse: Nɛ betirpo nɛ basa nɛ b du boeŋ e nya kagbenefuli nɛ Enyɛnpe, Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ cheembi na bee sa na.

english_verse: All who are cruel and arrogant will be gone forever. Those who live by crime will disappear,
translation_verse: Basa nɛ baa mɛaŋ beko nsaa keni Ebɔrɛ jiga na be ekar nna na. Alubiworapo kikɛ beeŋ mur loŋ be kachɛ na.

english_verse: The Lord who rescued Abraham has this to say about Jacob's descendants: “They will no longer be ashamed and disgraced.
translation_verse: Amoso kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe, Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ nɛ e mɔlga bumo nananyɛn Eebraham dra dra na ashi etɔrɔ to na kaŋɛ nde: “Menyi ma basa maaŋ naŋ ji anishinyɔr kikɛ, nyɔmɔ malɛ maaŋ naŋ mɔ menyi.

english_verse: When they see how great I have made their nation, they will praise and honor me, the holy God of Israel.
translation_verse: Men kaŋ wu mbia nɛ meeŋ sa menyi na pɔɛŋ nɛ menyeeŋ pin fanɛ ma e la Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ cheembi na. Saŋɛ na so menyeeŋ maŋkura ma nseŋ bunyaŋ ma.

english_verse: You trust Egypt for protection. So you refuse my advice and send messengers to Egypt to beg their king for help.
translation_verse: Ade be kaman, baa yɔ Ijipt be efuli so nna n ya kaa fin kechɛto a maa bishi ma shɛŋ. Baa sha fanɛ Ijipt e baa kuŋ bumo nna, amoso b ta bumo be yirda nna n wɔtɔ Ijipt be ewura to.

english_verse: The king's power reaches from the city of Zoan as far south as Hanes.
translation_verse: Juda be basa be mbɔ teŋ yɔ Ijipt be efuli so be ndegboŋ nɛ baa tre Zowan nɛ Hanes na,

english_verse: But Egypt can't protect you, and to trust that nation is useless and foolish.”
translation_verse: ama Ijiptebi na maaŋ tiŋ ŋ kuŋ bumo. Keyirda loŋ be efuli na la jiga nna nsaa la kawulisheŋ n ti so.”

english_verse: This is a message about the animals of the Southern Desert: “You people carry treasures on donkeys and camels. You travel to a feeble nation through a troublesome desert filled with lions and flying fiery dragons.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ be kubɔya nɛ e sa asɔbɔya nɛ a wɔ kiyi nɛ k wɔ Juda be efuli so be kelargato be kaseto be kaba so na nde: “Menyi basa ere bee ta ekurma nɛ enyɔma a sulɔ asɔ lela nɛ amo be yawu du kpakpa a bɔla efuli lubiana nɛ ebuluŋ nɛ awɔ lubi wɔ amoso to a yɔ efuli nɛ k maaŋ tiŋ n chɛ menyi to so.

english_verse: Egypt can't help you! That's why I call that nation a helpless monster.” Israel Refuses To Listen
translation_verse: Ijipt be kechɛto maŋ la shɛŋ. Amoso nɛ mee tre kumo ‘Kusɔ gbeyeso nɛ k du fanɛ laŋchaŋ a maaŋ tiŋ n wora shɛŋ na.’ ” Basa nɛ b maŋ kɔ kasonu be asheŋ

english_verse: They have turned against the Lord and can't be trusted. They have refused his teaching
translation_verse: B wɔtɔ nna a lar Ebɔrɛ kaman nsaa ku efɛ nsaa kini kebaanu a sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be keŋini.

english_verse: and have said to his messengers and prophets: Don't tell us what God has shown you and don't preach the truth. Just say what we want to hear, even if it's false.
translation_verse: Bumo alɛ bee kaŋɛ anebiana na nna fanɛ b baa lo bumo be nnɔ to. Kusɔ nɛ baa kaŋɛ bumo e la: “Men sa maa kaŋɛ anyi kusɔ nɛ k daga be asheŋ. Men baa kaŋɛ anyi asheŋ nɛ anyee sha kebaanu na, hale nɛ a maŋ la kashenteŋ gba.

english_verse: Stop telling us what God has said! We don't want to hear any more about the holy One of Israel.
translation_verse: Men yige kebaakaŋɛ anyi kusɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ be asheŋ! Anyi maŋ naa sha kenu shɛŋ a laŋɛ Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ cheembi na be kaplɛa so.”

english_verse: Now this is the answer of the holy One of Israel: “You rejected my message, and you trust in violence and lies.
translation_verse: Ama kusɔ nɛ Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ cheembi na kaŋɛ nde: “Men kplaŋ kusɔ nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ menyi so nseŋ ta menyi be yirda n deŋi kanyaŋ nɛ efɛsheŋ so.

english_verse: and shatter like a crushed bowl. There's not a piece left big enough to carry hot coals or to dip out water.” Trust the Lord
translation_verse: Men ki fanɛ kapuya nɛ k bure to kpachɛrkpachɛrbi nna nɛ kumo be kapɛlanfu kama maaŋ tiŋ n chɔ edɛ ŋko m jɔ nchu.”

english_verse: The holy Lord God of Israel had told all of you, “I will keep you safe if you turn back to me and calm down. I will make you strong if you quietly trust me.” Then you stubbornly
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpetale, Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ cheembi na kaŋɛ basa na le: “Men bɛta m ba kaa yirda ma nsaa du boeŋ. Aloŋ nɛ menyeeŋ nya eleŋ nɛ kekuŋgboŋ.” Ama men kini kewora loŋ!

english_verse: As few as five of them, or even one, will be enough to chase a thousand of you. Finally, all that will be left will be a few survivors as lonely as a flag pole on a barren hill. The Lord Will Show Mercy
translation_verse: Menyi to be basa kagboŋ beeŋ wu bedoŋ be enapo koŋwule nseŋ shile nɛ bumo be benapo anu e shin nɛ menyi kikɛ e shile. Kumo be lalaloge menyi to be basa gbrɛbi e naaŋ ka nsaa du fanɛ kedibi nɛ b ta tuta n chɛ m mata n yuu kebee be awɔlto na.

english_verse: People of Jerusalem, you don't need to cry anymore. The Lord is kind, and as soon as he hears your cries for help, he will come.
translation_verse: Men basa nɛ men wɔ Jerusalɛm to maaŋ naŋ shu kikɛ. Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na la ewɔrwupo nna nɛ men shu n tre mo fanɛ e chɛ menyi to, e beeŋ nu n sa menyi.

english_verse: The Lord has given you trouble and sorrow as your food and drink. But now you will again see the Lord, your teacher, and he will guide you.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ shin nɛ men luri jemanɛ kpakpaso to, ama mo gbagba e naaŋ ŋini menyi ekpa nɛ men bɔla so n lar kpakpa na to; nɛ men maaŋ naa kulti a fin mo gba.

english_verse: Whether you turn to the right or to the left, you will hear a voice saying, “This is the road! Now follow it.”
translation_verse: Nɛ fanɛ men foe ekpa a yɔ jisoso ŋko bena so gba, menyeeŋ nu mbe ebɔl menyi be kamanto ka bee kaŋɛ le: “Ekpa na nde. Men bɔla kumo so.”

english_verse: Then you will treat your idols of silver and gold like garbage; you will throw them away like filthy rags.
translation_verse: Saŋɛ na so nɛ men ta menyi be agbirana nɛ men ŋalga shuwa nɛ gbiti n wurge amo so na n ya lɛ fanɛ epi na nseŋ kaŋɛ le: “Men baa yɔ, anyi maŋ naa sha menyi.”

english_verse: The Lord will send rain to water the seeds you have planted—your fields will produce more crops than you need, and your cattle will graze in open pastures.
translation_verse: Ade be kaman, jemanɛ kikɛ nɛ men duu asɔ, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ shin nɛ bɔrɛchu e ba nɛ a kɔr n daŋ nseŋ wora nɛnɛ nɛ men teŋi. Men be asɔbɔya malɛ gba beeŋ nya ejikpa damta a ji.

english_verse: Even the oxen and donkeys that plow your fields will be fed the finest grain.
translation_verse: Egbolu nɛ ekurma nɛ men kɔ a dɔ menyi be adɔ na gba beeŋ baa nya afitiri bumbuŋ nɛ awɔlso lela ga a ji.

english_verse: On that day people will be slaughtered and towers destroyed, but streams of water will flow from high hills and towering mountains.
translation_verse: Kachɛ nɛ menyeeŋ kɔ n suge men doŋana be ebu lempoana nseŋ mɔ bumo be basa na, nɛ mbombi beeŋ shile abee nɛ apreŋ kikɛ so ŋ gbelge to.

english_verse: Then the Lord will bandage his people's injuries and heal the wounds he has caused. The moon will shine as bright as the sun, and the sun will shine seven times brighter than usual. It will be like the light of seven days all at once. Assyria Will Be Punished
translation_verse: Kufɔl beeŋ fuli to parr fanɛ epeŋi nɛ epeŋi malɛ e fuli to ale ashunu so n ti so, a du fanɛ nchɛnshunu be kefulto na. Kachɛ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ fɔr nseŋ kre mbe basa be achuu nseŋ chɛ bumo be alɔana na nɛ le beeŋ wora. Ebɔrɛ ka beeŋ gberge Asiriya kusoe be asheŋ

english_verse: The Lord is coming from far away with his fiery anger and thick clouds of smoke. His angry words flame up like a destructive fire;
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be eleŋgboŋ nɛ kemaŋkura shi kufɔ kufɔ a ba. Edɛ nɛ edishi e naa ŋini mbe agbo. E malga nɛ mbe kɔnɔ to be mmalga bee chɔ fanɛ edɛ na.

english_verse: he breathes out a flood that comes up to the neck. He sifts the nations and destroys them. Then he puts a bridle in every foreigner's mouth and leads them to doom.
translation_verse: E shin nɛ afu juŋkpar mo fanɛ nchugboŋ ka bu n sulɔ kusɔ kama a yɔ nna. Nchugboŋ na sulɔ efuliana na n yɔ kemur to nseŋ shin nɛ bumo be ŋkre lubiana kikɛ ba ekar.

english_verse: The Lord's people will sing as they do when they celebrate a religious festival at night. The Lord is Israel's mighty rock, and his people will be as happy as they are when they follow the sound of flutes to the mountain where he is worshiped.
translation_verse: Ama menyi, Ebɔrɛ be basa bre be ŋgbene beeŋ fuli menyi nɛ men baa boŋ nshɛ fanɛ kananɛ menyee wora nchɛgboŋ cheembiana be kanyɛso na. Menyi be ŋgbene beeŋ fuli menyi fanɛ basa nɛ b ta nlopi a boŋ nshɛ a yɔ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ e bee kuŋ Israɛl na be bɔrɛlambu to na.

english_verse: The Lord will get furious. His fearsome voice will be heard, his arm will be seen ready to strike, and his anger will be like a destructive fire, followed by thunderstorms and hailstones.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ shin nɛ ekama e nu mbe ebɔlgboŋ nɛ k kɔ kufu na nɛ mbe agbogboŋ nɛ k du fanɛ edɛ wuloŋ wuloŋ nɛ bɔrɛfugboŋ nɛ abɔrɛjembubi nɛ bɔrɛchu damta na be asheŋ.

english_verse: When the Assyrians hear the Lord's voice and see him striking with his iron rod, they will be terrified.
translation_verse: Jemanɛ nɛ Asiriya be basa beeŋ nu Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be ebɔl nseŋ wu mbe kasogberge be eleŋ na, kufu gboŋgboŋi beeŋ tɔr bumo so.

english_verse: He will attack them in battle, and each time he strikes them, it will be to the music of tambourines and harps.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be basa beeŋ baa laŋ ŋkure nɛ ejaŋjilaŋ a wɔtɔ mo jemanɛ nɛ e bee kɔ nsaa laŋɛ a kɔ Asiriya be basa na.

english_verse: Long ago the Lord got a place ready for burning the body of the dead king. The place for the fire is deep and wide, the wood is piled high, and the Lord will start the fire by breathing out flaming sulfur.
translation_verse: Dra dra na kikɛ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bela kakpa nɛ edɛgboŋ beeŋ chɔ Asiriya be ewurgboŋ m mɔ na ase n yili. Ndoŋ la kakpa chiŋgeliŋ nsaa wɔ mpar nna nɛ ndibi biti abar so kumo to. Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e naaŋ fute edɛ be adondulombi n wɔtɔ ndibi na to nɛ a suseso.

english_verse: You are in for trouble if you go to Egypt for help, or if you depend on an army of chariots or a powerful cavalry. Instead you should depend on and trust the holy Lord God of Israel.
translation_verse: Asheŋ maaŋ nyalɛ n sa bekama nɛ baa yɔ Ijipt be efuli so n ya kaa fin kechɛto na! Baa ta bumo be amu nna a deŋi Ijipt be benapo be egbaŋɛ nɛ egbaŋɛturko be keshi nɛ benapo lempo so. Ama b maa ta bumo be amu a deŋi Enyɛnpe, Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ cheembi na so ŋko a fin mbe kechɛto.

english_verse: The Lord isn't stupid! He does what he promises, and he can bring doom. If you are cruel yourself, or help those who are evil, you will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na malɛ nyi kusɔ nɛ e bee wora! Mo e naa sa ekpa nɛ jɛrbi bee ba. Kusɔ kama nɛ e kaŋɛ, kumo nɛ e bee wora. Mo e naa gberge basa lubi nɛ bumo be bekumpo kikɛ kusoe.

english_verse: The Egyptians are mere humans. They aren't God. Their horses are made of flesh; they can't live forever. When the Lord shows his power, he will destroy the Egyptians and all who depend on them. Together they will fall.
translation_verse: Ijiptebi na maŋ la Ebɔrɛ, edimɛdi e la bumo. Bumo be egbaŋɛ gba maŋ la kiyoyu to be asɔ nɛ a beeŋ baa wɔtɔ mbaanaayɔ. Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ baaŋ ŋini mbe eleŋgboŋ, efuli lempo bee mur nna nɛ efuli pɔso nɛ k bee chɛ to na e tɔr. Saŋɛ na so nɛ efuli anyɔ na kikɛ e mur.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful said to me, “I will roar and attack like a fearless lion not frightened by the shouts of shepherds trying to protect their sheep. That's how I will come down and fight on Mount Zion.
translation_verse: Ade be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ ma le: “Awɔr kama nɛ mbolpɔkpapo beeŋ wora maaŋ tiŋ n funti buluŋ nɛ e yige kusɔbɔya nɛ e pɛ na. Aloŋ koŋwule na nɛ shɛŋ maaŋ tiŋ n shin nɛ ma Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na, e yige kebaakuŋ Zayɔn be kebee na.

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, will protect Jerusalem like a mother bird circling over her nest.” Come Back to the Lord
translation_verse: Kananɛ kabuibi bee firgi a kulti kumo be kesha a kuŋ kumo be bibi na nɛ ma Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ kɔ ŋ kuŋ Jerusalɛm.”

english_verse: The time is coming when you will throw away your idols of silver and gold, made by your sinful hands.
translation_verse: Jemanɛ ko bee ba nɛ menyi kikɛ e ta agbir nɛ men ta shuwa nɛ gbiti n lɔŋɛ nseŋ bɔla amo so n wora alubi n da ma so na n lɛ.

english_verse: The Assyrians will be killed, but not by the swords of humans. Their young men will try to escape, but they will be captured and forced into slavery.
translation_verse: Saŋɛ na so Asiriya be basa beeŋ mur kena to nɛ mannɛ dimɛdi be eleŋ e mur bumo. Baaŋ shile kena nɛ bumo doŋana e pɛ bumo be mbrantiɛfɔlbi ŋ ki anya.

english_verse: Their fortress will fall when terror strikes; their army officers will be frightened and run from the battle. This is what the Lord has said, the Lord whose fiery furnace is built on Mount Zion.
translation_verse: Bumo be ewurgboŋ beeŋ lara keya n shile ŋkpal kufu so nɛ kufugboŋ e tɔr bumo be benapo be benimuana na so nɛ b shile ŋ ka bumo be kena to be etuuta n lɛ kaman.” Kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ baa shuŋ mo Jerusalɛm to nɛ mbe edɛ bee chɔɔ esarga ndoŋ na kaŋɛ nna na.

english_verse: They will be a place of safety from stormy winds, a stream in the desert, and a rock that gives shade from the heat of the sun.
translation_verse: Ewura na nɛ benimuana na beeŋ baa du fanɛ kusɔ kuŋ afu nɛ kakpa nɛ esa beeŋ shile n ya ŋana bɔrɛfu so nna. Bumo alɛ beeŋ baa du fanɛ mbombi ashi kiyi to nɛ kefaltagboŋ nɛ k bee kuŋ epeŋi a sa kayul.

english_verse: Then everyone who has eyes will open them and see, and those who have ears will pay attention.
translation_verse: Baaŋ bugi anishi a wu nseŋ bugi asoe a nu basa be asheŋ tirso.

english_verse: All who are impatient will take time to think; everyone who stutters will talk clearly.
translation_verse: Bumo alɛ beeŋ baa kɔ kanyiti, nsaa pin asheŋ to nseŋ naa wora asheŋ nɛ b kaŋɛ fanɛ baaŋ baa wora na.

english_verse: Fools will no longer be highly respected, and crooks won't be given positions of honor.
translation_verse: Ewura nɛ mbe benimuana maaŋ naŋ sa bewulpo bunyaŋ ŋko n sa basa jiga fanɛ beyu kemaŋkura be eyilikpa.

english_verse: Fools talk foolishness. They always make plans to do sinful things, to lie about the Lord, to let the hungry starve, and to keep water from those who are thirsty.
translation_verse: Bewulpo bee malga kawuli be mmalga nna nsaa kre asheŋ lubi be kewora be nia. Kusɔ kama nɛ baa wora ŋko a kaŋɛ la katege nna n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na. Bumo alɛ maa sa basa nɛ akoŋ kɔ ajibi ŋko basa nɛ achukoŋ kɔ nchu.

english_verse: Cruel people tell lies— they do evil things, and make cruel plans to destroy the poor and needy, even when they beg for justice.
translation_verse: Esa nɛ e maa ji kashenteŋ la esa lubi nna nsaa wora asheŋ lubi nawule. E bee kre kebɔla efɛ so nna m mur betirpo nseŋ kuŋ bumo ekpa nɛ b sa maŋ nya kusɔ nɛ k daga bumo.

english_verse: But helpful people can always be trusted to make helpful plans. Punishment for the Women of Jerusalem
translation_verse: Ama esa nɛ ekama bee sa bunyaŋ bre bee ji kashenteŋ nna nsaa yil kusɔ nɛ k niŋi so a wora asheŋ. Jerusalɛm to be beche be kasogberge be asheŋ

english_verse: Slap your breasts in sorrow because of what happened to the fruitful fields and vineyards,
translation_verse: Men ta kagbenejija a ber ŋgbene so ŋkpal nsawule lela nɛ a bee wora adɔjibi nɛ ndibi sɔrso kikɛ nɛnɛ na ka mur,

english_verse: The palace will be deserted, the crowded city empty. Fortresses and towers will forever become playgrounds for wild donkeys and pastures for sheep. God's Spirit Makes the Difference
translation_verse: Basa beeŋ shile n lar ewurkpa ŋ ka kumo fuloŋ nɛ basa be elaŋ nɛ ebu lempoana nɛ a daa kuŋ basa na kikɛ e ki alambure a dese hale mbaanaayɔ. Kumo be kaman nɛ ndoŋ e ki ekurma be epelkpa nɛ mbolpɔ be ejikpa.

english_verse: When the Spirit is given to us from heaven, deserts will become orchards thick as fertile forests.
translation_verse: Ama Ebɔrɛ kraa beeŋ naŋ sa anyi mbe kiyoyu. Nsawule pɔso na beeŋ naŋ ki nsawule lela nɛ a kɔ eleŋ nɛ adɔsawule e wora adɔjibi nɛnɛ ga.

english_verse: You will have God's blessing, as you plant your crops beside streams, while your donkeys and cattle roam freely about.
translation_verse: Ekama be kagbene beeŋ fuli mo ŋkpal bɔrɛchu damta nɛ adɔjibi beeŋ nya n wora nɛnɛ, nɛ ekurma nɛ ana malɛ gba e nya afitiri lela a ji nsaa nite yila yila so na so.

english_verse: You defeated my people. Now you're in for trouble! You've never been destroyed, but you will be destroyed; you've never been betrayed, but you will be betrayed. When you have finished destroying and betraying, you will be destroyed and betrayed in return.
translation_verse: Asheŋ maaŋ nyalɛ n sa an doŋana! B suge anyi be asɔ nseŋ naŋ debɔr anyi, ama esa kama maŋ naŋ suge bumo ere be asɔ ŋko debɔr bumo. Bumo be kasuge nɛ kedebɔr be jemanɛ beeŋ fo ekar nɛ beko malɛ e suge bumo be asɔ nseŋ debɔr bumo.

english_verse: Please, Lord, be kind to us! We depend on you. Make us strong each morning, and come to save us when we are in trouble.
translation_verse: Jande, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, wu anyi kuwɔr. Fo nɛ an ta anyi be tama n deŋi so. Baa kuŋ anyi karechɛ kama nsaa mɔlga anyi ashi etɔrɔ to.

english_verse: We attack our enemies like swarms of locusts; we take everything that belongs to them.
translation_verse: Saŋɛ na so anyeeŋ mel abar so fanɛ elotɔr n fuu bumo be asɔ n shile.

english_verse: You, Lord, are above all others, and you live in the heavens. You have brought justice and fairness to Jerusalem;
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e chɔ esa kikɛ nsaa ji kuwura kusɔ kama so. E beeŋ shin nɛ kashenteŋji nɛ asheŋ niŋiso be kebaawora e bɔlɔ Jerusalɛm to.

english_verse: you are the foundation on which we stand today. You always save us and give true wisdom and knowledge. Nothing means more to us than obeying you. The Lord Will Do Something
translation_verse: Mo nɛ anyee fute a yige so, ŋkpal e kaa bee mɔlga mbe basa jemanɛ kikɛ nsaa sa bumo kanyiasheŋ nɛ kashennyi damta so. Kebaaŋana Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nsaa nu a sa mo nɛ baaŋ baa sha kewora ga a chɔ kusɔ kikɛ.

english_verse: Listen! Our bravest soldiers are running through the streets, screaming for help. Our messengers hoped for peace, but came home crying.
translation_verse: Benapo nɛ b kɔ kenyɛn bee kɔ a fin kechɛto ashi kadegboŋ na be agbembi so nna. Anyi be mbɔ daa tama kayurwushi nna, ama kushu nɛ b ta m ba epe.

english_verse: No one travels anymore; every road is empty. Treaties are broken, and no respect is shown to any who keep promises.
translation_verse: Esa kikɛ daa maŋ naa yɔ enite to nɛ ekpaana na kikɛ dese fuloŋ. Basa maŋ naa wora a bɔlɔ kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre so. Bumo alɛ maaŋ naa sa esa kama nɛ e bee bɛ mbe nnɔ naseso so bunyaŋ.

english_verse: Fields are dry and barren; Mount Lebanon wilts with shame. Sharon Valley is a desert; the forests of Bashan and Carmel have lost their leaves.
translation_verse: Nsawule kikɛ wɔl a dese jiga. Lebanɔn be kupo na wɔl ŋ gbaŋgbaŋ afantaŋ nɛ Sharɔn be ketaŋɛ lela na ki fanɛ keshishɛrsawule. Ndibi nɛ a wɔ Bashan nɛ kebee nɛ baa tre Kamɛl na so gbaŋgbaŋ amo be afantaŋ. Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ka fiɛ mo doŋana so be asheŋ

english_verse: But the Lord says, “Now I will do something and be greatly praised.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ efuli pɔtɛana na le: “Naniere meeŋ wora kusɔ ko ŋ ŋini ma eleŋgboŋ.

english_verse: Your deeds are straw that will be set on fire by your very own breath.
translation_verse: Menyee kaa kre ŋkre fuloŋ nɛ kusɔ kama nɛ menyee wora bee to jiga. Ma kɔnɔ to be afu du fanɛ edɛ nɛ k beeŋ mur menyi nna.

english_verse: You will be burned to ashes like thorns in a fire.
translation_verse: Menyeeŋ chɔɔ ŋ ki nsunɔ fanɛ afitiri wɔlso ka ji edɛ na.

english_verse: Everyone, both far and near, come look at what I have done. See my mighty power!” Punishment and Rewards
translation_verse: Bekama nɛ b wɔ kufɔ ŋko n taga to, beeŋ nu kusɔ nɛ n wora nseŋ shuli so fanɛ ma eleŋgboŋ bee shuŋ kashenteŋto.”

english_verse: But there will be rewards for those who live right and tell the truth, for those who refuse to take money by force or accept bribes, for all who hate murder and violent crimes.
translation_verse: Nɛ menyee kaŋɛ nsaa wora kusɔ nɛ k daga bre, menyeeŋ ji n lar Ebɔrɛ be demuji to. Amoso men sa maŋ ta eleŋ nɛ men kɔ na a puni betirpo. Menyi alɛ e sa maa sɔ brɔbu. Men sa maa tu basa nɛ baa kre basa be kamɔ ŋko a wora asheŋ alubi na a wora asheŋ.

english_verse: They will live in a fortress high on a rocky cliff, where they will have food and plenty of water. The Lord Is Our King
translation_verse: Aloŋ e naaŋ shin nɛ men nya menyi be amu, nsaa du fanɛ basa nɛ b wɔ ebu lempo jeŋgreŋ nɛ k bee kuŋ basa na to. Menyi alɛ beeŋ naa nya a ji nsaa nuu yila yila so jemanɛ kikɛ. Echefoso be kemaŋkura be asheŋ

english_verse: With your own eyes you will see the glorious King; you will see his kingdom reaching far and wide.
translation_verse: Ade kikɛ be kaman, menyeeŋ naŋ wu ewura ko ka bee ji kuwura kemaŋkuraso ashi kasawule nɛ k dese n sɔ kaplɛkama a yɔ na so.

english_verse: Then you will ask yourself, “Where are those officials who terrified us and forced us to pay such heavy taxes?”
translation_verse: Saŋɛ na so nɛ men bishi menyi be amu le: “Nnɛ nɛ ekrachi nɛ b daa ta kufu a da anyi nsaa tintiŋ anyi nɛ anyee ka elampo damta na wɔ?”

english_verse: You will never again have to see the proud people who spoke a strange and foreign language you could not understand.
translation_verse: Menyi alɛ maaŋ naaŋ wu befɔ nɛ baa wu bumo be amu a fɛ fanɛ b shi ga nsaa gbar ŋgbar nɛ menyi maa nu na kenishiso kikɛ.

english_verse: Look to Mount Zion where we celebrate our religious festivals. You will see Jerusalem, secure as a tent with pegs that cannot be pulled up and fastened with ropes that can never be broken.
translation_verse: Men to anishi ŋ keni Zayɔn be kebee nɛ anyee ji anyi be nchɛgboŋ kumo so na. Menyeeŋ wu fanɛ Jerusalɛm la kakpa nɛ anyi beeŋ tiŋ n nya anyi be amu a wɔtɔ nna. K du fanɛ wajɛbu nɛ k yil a maa gbuŋgbuŋ nna. Kumo be ayir maa tia nɛ kumo be efɔlana malɛ gba maa tuge to kikɛ.

english_verse: Our wonderful Lord will be with us! There will be deep rivers and wide streams safe from enemy ships. The Lord Is Our Judge
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ lara mbe kemaŋkura ŋ ŋini anyi nɛ an chena m mata elɔr nɛ a wɔ nchiŋ nɛ mbombi nɛ e wɔ mpar na. Ama an doŋana be nchu so be ekuloŋgboŋ maaŋ nite nchuana na so.

english_verse: The Lord is our judge and our ruler; the Lord is our king and will keep us safe.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e la anyi be demujipo nɛ esa nɛ e bee ji kuwura anyi so. Mo e la anyi be ewura nɛ e bee kuŋ anyi nɛ an nya anyi be amu a wɔtɔ.

english_verse: But your nation is a ship with its rigging loose, its mast shaky, and its sail not spread. Someday even you that are lame will take everything you want from your enemies.
translation_verse: Ama asɔ nɛ efuli pɔtɛana ta n chɛ bumo be nchu so be ekuloŋgboŋ so na maŋ chɛ nɛnɛ a kɔ eleŋ; Ewajɛ nɛ b ta n chɛ ekuloŋgboŋ na so nɛ afu e baa ber amo a nite nchu so na maŋ parga to. Anyeeŋ suge bedoŋ be benapo be asɔ damta, hale nɛ ebobi gba e nya asɔ n sɔ bumo kutɔ.

english_verse: The Lord will forgive your sins, and none of you will say, “I feel sick.”
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ ta menyi be alubi m paŋ menyi, nɛ esa kama nɛ e wɔ anyi be kasawule so maaŋ naŋ fubel ŋ kaŋɛ le: “Mee lɔ nna!”

english_verse: Everyone of every nation, the entire earth, and all its creatures, come here and listen!
translation_verse: Menyi efuli kama so be basa e ba abar so nseŋ nu nfe! Durnya kikɛ nɛ kusɔ kama nɛ k wɔ kumo to e ba nfe m ba nu.

english_verse: The Lord is terribly angry with the nations; he has condemned them to be slaughtered.
translation_verse: Eyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nya agbo n wɔtɔ efuli pɔtɛana na nɛ amo be benapo kikɛ. Mo alɛ yili kumo fanɛ bumo kikɛ beeŋ mur.

english_verse: Their dead bodies will be left to rot and stink; their blood will flow down the mountains.
translation_verse: Baaŋ wu n dese m bɛa a dufɛ nɛ bumo be ŋklaŋ malɛ e shile abee so ŋ gbelge to fanɛ nchu na.

english_verse: Each star will disappear— the sky will roll up like a scroll. Everything in the sky will dry up and wilt like leaves on a vine or fruit on a tree. Trouble for Edom
translation_verse: Epeŋi nɛ kufɔl nɛ achɛkpabi kikɛ beeŋ foe basa be anishi so nɛ b bɔɔ awɔlpa fanɛ kelaŋ na. Kusɔ kama nɛ k wɔ awɔlpa so beeŋ tɔr to fanɛ afantaŋ ŋko asɔrso ka bolo kedibi so n chuge n tɔr to na.

english_verse: After the sword of the Lord has done what it wants to the skies above, it will come down on Edom, the nation that the Lord has doomed for destruction.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋ ta mbe tokobi n wora awɔlpa so be asɔ kusɔ nɛ e bee sha n loge, k beeŋ gbelge efuli nɛ baa tre Edɔm na be basa nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na yili kumo fanɛ baaŋ mur na so.

english_verse: The sword of the Lord is covered with blood from lambs and goats, together with fat from kidneys of rams. This is because the Lord will slaughter many people and make a sacrifice of them in the city of Bozrah and everywhere else in Edom.
