translation_verse: Bumo be ŋklaŋ beeŋ gbiti Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be tokobi na fanɛ kananɛ mbolpɔ fɔlbi nɛ mboe nɛ b ta n lara esarga be ŋklaŋ bee gbiti nsaŋɛbi na. Ŋkpal manɛ so, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ mɔ basa damta n ta bumo n lara sarga ashi kadegboŋ nɛ baa tre Bozra na nɛ Edɔm be efuli so be kaplɛkama.

english_verse: Edom's leaders are wild oxen. They are powerful bulls, but they will die with the others. Their country will be soaked with their own blood, and its soil made fertile with their own fat.
translation_verse: Basa na beeŋ wu n tɔr fanɛ egbolufɛlso nɛ egbolufɔlbi, nɛ bumo be ŋklaŋ e pere kasawule so nɛ nfɔ e sɔ kaplɛkama.

english_verse: The Lord has chosen the year and the day, when he will take revenge and come to Zion's defense.
translation_verse: Le be jemanɛ ere nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ kɔ n suge Zayɔn nseŋ sɔ kumo be basa be kɔnɔ ŋ kɔ bumo doŋana.

english_verse: Edom's streams will turn into tar and its soil into sulfur— then the whole country will go up in flames.
translation_verse: Mbombi nɛ a wɔ Edɔm be efuli so beeŋ kilgi ŋ ki fanɛ kootal nɛ eshishɛr na malɛ e ki fanɛ jɛrbi. Efuli na kikɛ beeŋ suse so fanɛ kootal ka bee chɔɔ edɛ to na.

english_verse: It will burn night and day and never stop smoking. Edom will be a desert, generation after generation; no one will ever travel through that land.
translation_verse: K beeŋ baa chɔɔ kapa nɛ kanyɛ nna, nɛ edishi malɛ e baa lar kumo to hale mbaanaayɔ. Edɔm beeŋ ki keshishɛrsawule a dese nfɛ damta nɛ esa maaŋ naŋ bɔla kumo to n choŋ kikɛ.

english_verse: Owls, hawks, and wild animals will make it their home. God will leave it in ruins, merely a pile of rocks. The End of Edom
translation_verse: Egbuŋgbula nɛ kupuŋ to be asɔbɔya be yiri yiri e naaŋ sɔ kasawule na kikɛ so a wɔtɔ. Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ shin nɛ k naaŋ ki kasawule fuloŋ n dese fanɛ kananɛ k daa du kasɔto be jemanɛ so na.

english_verse: Edom will be called “Kingdom of Nothing.” Its rulers will also be nothing.
translation_verse: Ewura maaŋ naa wɔtɔ a keni Edɔm be efuli na so. Bejuŋkparpoana gba maaŋ naa wɔtɔ a juŋkpar kumo be basa.

english_verse: Its palaces and fortresses will be covered with thorns; only wolves and ostriches will make their home there.
translation_verse: Ewi nɛ egɔnnyaŋɛ e naaŋ kɔr bumo be ewurkpaana nɛ nde nɛ b pɔr egbal ŋ kulti amo na kikɛ to. Saŋɛ na so ejiŋkaamu nɛ egbuŋgbula be yiri yiri beeŋ ba kaa wɔ amo to.

english_verse: Wildcats and hyenas will hunt together, demons will scream to demons, and creatures of the night will live among the ruins.
translation_verse: Kupuŋ to be asɔbɔya lubi fanɛ ekarmɛ nɛ ekuntuŋ beeŋ ba kaa nite a kulti kumo nɛ ayoyu lubiana e baa shu a tre abar ndoŋ. Kanyɛso be asɔ lubi beeŋ ta ndoŋ ŋ ki bumo be ewushikpa.

english_verse: In The Book of the Lord you can search and find where it is written, “The Lord brought together all of his creatures by the power of his Spirit. Not one is missing.”
translation_verse: To, keni Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be asɔ keniso be kawɔl na to ŋ kraŋ kusɔ nɛ k bee kaŋɛ. K yɛ: “Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e bɔla mbe Kiyoyu be eleŋgboŋ so m bar mbe asɔ toso abar so. Amo be kukoŋwule kama maŋ foe.”

english_verse: The Lord has decided where they each should live; they will be there forever, generation after generation.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ barga kasawule na to n sa bumo nseŋ sa ekama mbe kachige nɛ b baa wɔ ndoŋ nfɛ damta. Saŋɛ na so kasawule na beeŋ baa la bumo peya mbaanaayɔ.

english_verse: Thirsty deserts will be glad; barren lands will celebrate and blossom with flowers.
translation_verse: Kiyi be kagbene beeŋ fuli kumo, nɛ ndibi be atoto e purge ashi kasawule nɛ k dese jiga so.

english_verse: Deserts will bloom everywhere and sing joyful songs. They will be as majestic as Mount Lebanon, as glorious as Mount Carmel or Sharon Valley. Everyone will see the wonderful splendor of the Lord our God. God Changes Everything *
translation_verse: Kiyi beeŋ purge kaplɛkama nseŋ boŋ kagbenefuli be nshɛ. K beeŋ baa walɛ fanɛ Lebanɔn be abee nsaa kɔ eleŋ fanɛ kebee nɛ baa tre Kamɛl na, ŋko ketaŋɛ nɛ baa tre Sharɔn na be adɔsawule. Kumo be kaman nɛ ekama e wu Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be kemaŋkura, nɛ mbe keshi nɛ eleŋgboŋ.

english_verse: The blind will see, and the ears of the deaf will be healed.
translation_verse: Etanpo beeŋ naŋ nya anishi a wu, nɛ ekpawu e nya asoe a nu.

english_verse: Those who were lame will leap around like deer; tongues once silent will shout for joy. Water will rush through the desert.
translation_verse: Ebobi beeŋ nya aya a tɛ to a cha, nɛ eneemu a nya nnɔ a boŋ to kagbenefuliso Mbombi beeŋ fara a shile kiyi to;

english_verse: Scorching sand will turn into a lake, and thirsty ground will flow with fountains. Grass will grow in deserts, where packs of wild dogs once made their home. God's Sacred Highway
translation_verse: nɛ shishɛrpumpuŋ tushiso e ki apa, nɛ nsawule nɛ a wɔl a dese kikɛ e nya abuye amo so. Kakpa nɛ ejiŋkaamu daa wɔ na, beeŋ ki kakpa nɛ agasa nɛ achufitiri bee kɔr.

english_verse: A good road will be there, and it will be named “God's Sacred Highway.” It will be for God's people; no one unfit to worship God will walk on that road. And no fools can travel on that highway.
translation_verse: Kegbembi lela beeŋ ba dese ndoŋ, nɛ b baa tre kumo “Kecheembiya be ekpa.” K beeŋ baa la Ebɔrɛ be basa be ekpa. Esa nɛ e maa shuŋ Ebɔrɛ maaŋ nite kumo so. Bewulpo gba maaŋ nite loŋ be kegbembi na so.

english_verse: No lions or other wild animals will come near that road; only those the Lord has saved will travel there.
translation_verse: Ebuluŋ maaŋ baa wɔ ekpa na so, asɔbɔya nɛ a bee keta kufu maaŋ mata ekpa na gba. Basa nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kɔ n suge na e naaŋ bɔla ekpa na so n yɔ epe.

english_verse: The people the Lord has rescued will come back singing as they enter Zion. Happiness will be a crown everyone will always wear. They will celebrate and shout because all sorrows and worries will be gone far away.
translation_verse: Baaŋ ta kagbenefuli nɛ nshɛ n wora awɔr n ya luri Jerusalɛm to. Bumo alɛ be ŋgbene beeŋ fuli bumo mbaanaayɔ; ŋkpal manɛ so, kagbenejija nɛ kafɔŋ maaŋ naa wɔtɔ.

english_verse: Hezekiah claims the Lord will save you. But don't be fooled by him. Were any other gods able to defend their land against the king of Assyria?
translation_verse: Men sa maŋ shin nɛ ewura Hɛzekaya e fule menyi nɛ men baa fɛ fanɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ kɔ n suge menyi. Efuli ko be agbirana daŋ tiŋ m mɔlga amo be basa ashi Asiriya be ewurgboŋ na be enɔ to a?

english_verse: Then, in a voice loud enough for everyone to hear, he shouted out in Hebrew: Listen to what the great king of Assyria says!
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ e ponte awɔrso ŋ kaŋɛ le Hibruw be gbar to, saŋɛ na so, ekama nɛ e wɔ ndoŋ beeŋ nu: “Men nu kusɔ nɛ Asiriya be ewurgboŋ bee kaŋɛ menyi.

english_verse: What happened to the gods of Hamath, Arpad, and Sepharvaim? Were the gods of Samaria able to protect their land against the Assyrian forces?
translation_verse: Nnɛ nɛ basa nɛ b daa wɔ ndegboŋ nɛ baa tre Hamaf nɛ Appad nɛ Sefavaim na be agbirana naa wɔ naniere? Samɛria be efuli so be agbirana daa maŋ tiŋ ŋ kuŋ kasawule na ashi Asiriya be benapo be enɔ to.

english_verse: Three of the king's highest officials came out of Jerusalem to meet him. One of them was Hilkiah's son Eliakim, who was the prime minister. The other two were Shebna, assistant to the prime minister, and Joah son of Asaph, keeper of the government records.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Juda be benimu asa ko lar n ya shɛr mo to. Bumo e daa la Eliakim nɛ e la Hilkiya pibinyɛn nseŋ daa la esa nɛ e bɛ ewura so na, nɛ Shɛbna nɛ e la ewura be esibɛpo na, nɛ Jowa nɛ e la Asaf pibinyɛn nseŋ daa la esa nɛ e bee keni ewurkpa be asheŋ nɛ b sibɛ n nase so na.

english_verse: The Assyrian commander told them: I have a message for Hezekiah from the great king of Assyria. Ask Hezekiah why he feels so sure of himself.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Asiriya be benapo be ejuŋkparpo na kaŋɛ bumo fanɛ Asiriya be ewurgboŋ bee sha nna nɛ e pin kusɔ nɛ k shin nɛ ewura Hɛzekaya kɔ kenyɛn nseŋ yirda mbe kumu loŋ.

english_verse: Does he think he can plan and win a war with nothing but words? Who is going to help him, now that he has turned against the king of Assyria?
translation_verse: E bee fɛ fanɛ e beeŋ tiŋ n yili kɔnɔ to be mmalga nawule so ŋ kre kena nseŋ tiŋ ŋ kɔ m pɔɔ so a? Naniere e ka lar Asiriya be ewura kaman ere, wanɛ e naaŋ chɛ mo to?

english_verse: Is Hezekiah now depending on the Lord, your God? Didn't Hezekiah tear down all except one of the Lord's altars and places of worship? Didn't he tell the people of Jerusalem and Judah to worship at that one place?
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ Asiriya be benapo be ejuŋkparpo na naŋ kaŋɛ: “Menyee sha kekaŋɛ ma fanɛ Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na nawule nɛ men ta menyi be amu a to so a? Mannɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be ebɔrɛsure nɛ mboŋ nɛ baa shuŋ mo na nɛ Hɛzekaya kaŋɛ fanɛ b mur nseŋ ka kakpa koŋwule n sa basa nɛ b wɔ Juda be efuli so nɛ Jerusalɛm to nɛ b baa shuŋ Ebɔrɛ ndoŋ nawule na a?

english_verse: How could you even defeat our lowest ranking officer, when you have to depend on Egypt for chariots and cavalry?
translation_verse: Menyi maaŋ tiŋ n tu Asiriya be efuli so be enapo nɛ e maŋ kɔ eyilikpagboŋ gba ŋ kɔ, ama menyee tama fanɛ Ijiptebi beeŋ sa menyi egbaŋɛturko nɛ egbaŋɛ diipoana nɛ b ba chɛ menyi to ŋ kɔ a?

english_verse: Don't forget that it was the Lord who sent me here with orders to destroy your nation!
translation_verse: Men baa nyi fanɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e kaŋɛ ma fanɛ m ba kɔ m mur menyi be efuli na. Mo alɛ e chɛ ma to.”

english_verse: Eliakim, Shebna, and Joah said, “Sir, we don't want the people listening from the city wall to understand what you are saying. So please speak to us in Aramaic instead of Hebrew.”
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Eliakim nɛ Shɛbna nɛ Jowa kaŋɛ benapo be ejuŋkparpo na le: “Jande, ta Aramaik be ŋgbar to a malga anyi kutɔ. Amo nɛ anyee nu. Sa maa gbar Hibruw be ŋgbar to, ŋkpal manɛ so, basa nɛ b wɔ egbalana ere so kikɛ bee nu kusɔ nɛ anyee malga nna na.”

english_verse: The Assyrian army commander answered, “My king sent me to speak to everyone, not just to you leaders. These people will soon have to eat their own body waste and drink their own urine! And so will the three of you!”
translation_verse: Nɛ Asiriya be benapo be ejuŋkparpo na malɛ kaŋɛ le: “Menyee tama fanɛ menyi nɛ ewura na nawule nɛ anyi be ewurgboŋ shuŋi ma fanɛ m ba malga n sa a? Mannɛ loŋ nna, basa nɛ b chena egbalana na so na gba nɛ mee malga a sa. K maaŋ chɛr bumo alɛ gba beeŋ ji bumo gbagba be ejɔŋɛ nseŋ nuu bumo be ebɔnfɔl, fanɛ kananɛ menyi benimuana beeŋ wora na.”

english_verse: Don't trust him when he tells you that the Lord will protect you from the king of Assyria.
translation_verse: E kaŋ kaŋɛ menyi fanɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ kɔ m mɔlga menyi ashi Asiriya be ewurgboŋ be enɔ to, men sa maŋ yirda kusɔ nɛ e kaŋɛ na.

english_verse: for a while. Then he will come and take you away to a country just like yours, where you can plant vineyards and raise your own grain.
translation_verse: n ya fo fanɛ ewurgboŋ na ka beeŋ lɔŋɛ menyi n chena efuli nɛ k du fanɛ men gbagba be efuli ere so. Ndoŋ la kakpa nɛ ewaindibi wɔtɔ nna nɛ men baa ta a wora eyabra a nuu, nɛ ayu malɛ gba wɔtɔ nɛ men baa ta a wora ebodobodo a we.

english_verse: None of those gods kept their people safe from the king of Assyria. Do you think the Lord, your God, can do any better?
translation_verse: Agbirana na be kekama daŋ maŋ tiŋ ŋ kuŋ kumo be basa ashi Asiriya be ewura be enɔ to. Nɛ manɛ so nɛ menyi ere bee fɛ fanɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ tiŋ m mɔlga Jerusalɛm bre ashi mbe enɔ to?”

english_verse: Eliakim, Shebna, and Joah had been warned by King Hezekiah not to answer the Assyrian commander. So they tore their clothes in sorrow and reported to Hezekiah everything the commander had said.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ Eliakim nɛ Shɛbna nɛ Jowa ta kagbenejija ŋ kpɛa bumo be asɔbuuso to nseŋ ya bɔ kusɔ nɛ Asiriya be benapo be ejuŋkparpo kaŋɛ na be kubɔya n sa ewura Hɛzekaya.

english_verse: As soon as Hezekiah heard the news, he tore off his clothes in sorrow and put on sackcloth. Then he went into the temple of the Lord.
translation_verse: Ewura Hɛzekaya ka nu kubɔya nɛ Asiriya be benapo be ejuŋkparpo kaŋɛ na, nɛ mbe kagbene jija mo ga nɛ e kpɛa mbe asɔbuuso to nseŋ ta keeli be asɔbuuso m buu n yɔ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be bɔrɛlambu to.

english_verse: The kings of Hamath, Arpad, Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivvah have all disappeared. Hezekiah Prays (
translation_verse: Bewura nɛ b daa wɔ ndegboŋ nɛ baa tre Hamaf nɛ Apad nɛ Sefavaim nɛ Hena nɛ Iwa na kikɛ maŋ naa wɔtɔ. Bumo kikɛ mur!”

english_verse: Isaiah, these are difficult and disgraceful times. Our nation is like a woman too weak to give birth, when it's time for her baby to be born.
translation_verse: Kubɔya nɛ ewura Hɛzekaya ta n shuŋi bumo nɛ b ba sa ma nde: “Kabre la awurfoŋ be kachɛ nna n sa anyi, ŋkpal loŋ so an wɔ kasogberge nɛ ŋaba to nna. An du fanɛ eche nɛ e bee kurge a gben nsaa maŋ naa kɔ eleŋ nɛ e kaŋto ŋ kurge nna.

english_verse: Please pray for those of us who are left alive. The king of Assyria sent his army commander to insult the living God. Perhaps the Lord heard what he said and will do something, if you will pray.
translation_verse: Asiriya be ewurgboŋ shuŋi mbe benapo be ejuŋkparpo nna nɛ e ba tege Ebɔrɛ nɛ e bee sa ŋkpa na. Enyɛnpe fo Ebɔrɛ na e naaŋ nu katege ere kikɛ nseŋ gberge basa nɛ baa tege mo na kusoe. Amoso kule Ebɔrɛ n sa anyi be basa nɛ b kraa wɔ ŋkpa to na.”

english_verse: I told them that the Lord had this message for Hezekiah: I am the Lord. Don't worry about the insulting things that have been said about me by these messengers from the king of Assyria.
translation_verse: nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ bumo le: “Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ fanɛ men sa maa lɔ kufu ŋkpal kusɔ nɛ Asiriyaebi na kaŋɛ na so, fanɛ mo ere Ebɔrɛ na maaŋ tiŋ m mɔlga menyi na.

english_verse: I will upset him with rumors about what's happening in his own country. He will go back, and there I will make him die a violent death.
translation_verse: Asiriya be ewurgboŋ na beeŋ nu b yɛ b yɛ be kubɔya ko, nɛ k shin nɛ e bɛta n yɔ mo gbagba be efuli so nɛ b ya mɔ mo ndoŋ.” Asiriyaebi ka naŋ ta kafunti be kubɔya n shuŋi n ya sa Judaebi na be asheŋ (

english_verse: Meanwhile the commander of the Assyrian forces heard that his king had left the town of Lachish and was now attacking Libnah. So he went there.
translation_verse: Asiriya be benapo be ejuŋkparpo na ka nu fanɛ bumo be ewurgboŋ lar Lakish be kadegboŋ to n ya kaa kɔ Libna be kadegboŋ nɛ k mata ndoŋ na kena, nɛ e yɔ ndoŋ nɛ e ya bishi mo kusɔ nɛ e beeŋ wora.

english_verse: About this same time, the king of Assyria learned that King Tirhakah of Ethiopia was on his way to attack him. Then the king of Assyria sent some messengers with this note for Hezekiah:
translation_verse: Loŋ be jemanɛ na gbagba nɛ Asiriya be ewurgboŋ, Sennakerɛb, nu fanɛ Itiopia be ewura, Tɛhaka wɔ ekpa to a ba nɛ e ba kɔ mo kena. Ndoŋ nna nɛ ewurgboŋ Sennakerɛb shuŋi mbɔ fanɛ b ta kawɔlbi ko n ya sa Juda be ewura, Hɛzekaya.

english_verse: You have heard how we Assyrian kings have completely wiped out other nations. What makes you feel so safe?
translation_verse: Fo nu kananɛ anyi Asiriya be bewura mur efuli pɔtɛana ko cheche be asheŋ. Nɛ manɛ so nɛ fee fɛ fanɛ shɛŋ shɛŋ maaŋ tiŋ n wora fo ere?

english_verse: The Assyrian kings before me destroyed the towns of Gozan, Haran, Rezeph, and everyone from Eden who lived in Telassar. What good did their gods do them?
translation_verse: N nananyɛnana e daŋ mur ndegboŋ nɛ baa tre Gozan nɛ Haran nɛ Rezef, nseŋ mɔ Bɛtaden be basa nɛ b daa wɔ Tɛlassa na gba. Bumo be agbirana daŋ maŋ tiŋ m mɔlga bumo.

english_verse: After Hezekiah had read the note from the king of Assyria, he took it to the temple and spread it out for the Lord to see.
translation_verse: Ewura Hɛzekaya ka sɔ kawɔlbi na ashi mbɔ na kutɔ nɛ e kraŋ kumo nseŋ ta kumo n yɔ bɔrɛlambu na to n ya bugi kumo to n nase Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be anishito.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful of Israel, your throne is above the winged creatures. You created the heavens and the earth, and you alone rule the kingdoms of this world.
translation_verse: “Enyɛnpetale Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ, fo e chena fo kuwurputi so awɔlto nɛ emalaika nɛ baa tre chɛrubim na wɔ fo aya ase. Fo nawule e la Ebɔrɛ. Fo e to esoso nɛ kasawule nsaa ji kuwura durnya be kuwurjiana kikɛ so.

english_verse: Just look and see how Sennacherib has insulted you, the living God.
translation_verse: Keni kananɛ Asiriya be ewura, Sennakerɛb bee tege fo Ebɔrɛ nɛ fee sa ŋkpa na loŋ.

english_verse: It is true, our Lord, that Assyrian kings have turned nations into deserts.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, kashenteŋ nna fanɛ Asiriya be bewuraana mur efuli damtaana nseŋ shin nɛ amo be nsawule dese fuloŋ.

english_verse: As surely as I am the Lord, he will return by the way he came and will never enter Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ekpa nɛ e bɔla so m ba na nɛ e beeŋ naŋ bɔla so n yɔ nɛ e maŋ nya n luri kadegboŋ na to. Ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e kaŋɛ na.

english_verse: I went to Hezekiah and told him that the Lord God of Israel had said: Hezekiah, you prayed to me about King Sennacherib of Assyria. Now this is what I say to that king: The people of Jerusalem hate and make fun of you; they laugh behind your back.
translation_verse: nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na malga a laŋɛ mbe kabɔrɛkule na be kaplɛa so. E yɛ: “Sennakerɛb, Jerusalɛm be basa bee mushe fo nna nsaa fɛl fo a keni fo jiga.

english_verse: Sennacherib, you cursed, shouted and sneered at me, the holy One of Israel.
translation_verse: Wanɛ nɛ fo daa fɛ fanɛ fee tege nsaa wora eyurto na? Ma, Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ cheembi na nɛ fo daa maa sa bunyaŋ na.

english_verse: You let your officials insult me, the Lord. And here is what you have said about yourself, “I led my chariots to the highest heights of Lebanon's mountains. I went deep into its forest, cutting down the best cedar and cypress trees.
translation_verse: Fo daŋ shuŋi fo mbɔ nna nɛ b ba kaa puchi menyi ka daŋ ta menyi be egbaŋɛturko n dii n yɔ Lebanɔn be kebee be awɔlto n ya kɔ m pɔɔ so ashi ma Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be anishito. Men daa puchi fanɛ men daŋ tiŋ ŋ ku sida be ndibi tenteŋ nɛ seprɛs be ndibi lelaana n lɛ nna ashi kebee na so hale n ya fo kupo na be nferinto.

english_verse: Sennacherib, now listen to me, the Lord. I planned all of this long ago. And you don't even know that I alone am the one who decided that you would do these things. I let you make ruins of fortified cities.
translation_verse: Menyi maŋ pin to fanɛ ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e kre kumo loŋ dra na kikɛ nɛ naniere k wora m bɔlɔ so na. Ma e sa menyi eleŋ nɛ men tiŋ n shin nɛ ndegboŋ lempoana ki alambure na.

english_verse: Their people became weak, terribly confused. They were like wild flowers or like tender young grass growing on a flat roof or like a field of grain before it matures.
translation_verse: Basa nɛ b daa wɔ ndegboŋ na to daŋ maŋ naa kɔ eleŋ nna, ŋkpal kufu ka daŋ pɛ bumo nɛ eburma tɔr bumo so so. B daa du fanɛ kudɔ to be afitiri nna ŋko afitiri popɔrbi nɛ e kɔr ebu be esoso nɛ epeŋilarkpa be afu tushi so ber amo so nɛ e wu nna.

english_verse: I have seen your pride and the tremendous hatred you have for me. Now I will put a hook in your nose, a bit in your mouth, then I will send you back to where you came from.
translation_verse: N wu fo kamoowu nɛ agbogboŋ na kikɛ. Naniere meeŋ ta dariwa n wɔtɔ fo kamuna to nseŋ ta kebarga n wɔtɔ fo kɔnɔ to. Kumo be kaman nɛ n ta fo m bɔla ekpa nɛ fo bɔla so m ba na m bɛta n yɔ kakpa nɛ fo shi m ba.”

english_verse: Hezekiah, I will tell you what's going to happen. This year you will eat crops that grow on their own, and the next year you will eat whatever springs up where those crops grew. But the third year, you will plant grain and vineyards, and you will eat what you harvest.
translation_verse: Ade kikɛ be kaman nɛ anebi Aizaaya kaŋɛ ewura Hɛzekaya le: “Kusɔ nɛ k beeŋ wora be tɔɔnɛ nde. Kafɛ ere nɛ kafɛ a ba kikɛ menyi maaŋ dɔ n duu shɛŋ ama menyi alɛ beeŋ nya akɔrbua n teŋi n ji. Ama kafɛ nɛ k bɛ so kesasopo na bre, menyeeŋ dɔ n duu ayu n teŋi nseŋ duu ndibi sɔrso n nya amo be asɔrso n chuge n ji.

english_verse: Those who survive in Judah will be like a vine that puts down deep roots and bears fruit.
translation_verse: Basa nɛ baaŋ ji efute ashi Juda be efuli so na beeŋ purge fanɛ aduuso nɛ amo be achin yɔ kasawule to nɛ e wora nɛnɛ na.

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, will see to it that some who live in Jerusalem will survive.
translation_verse: Basa ko beeŋ ji efute ashi Jerusalɛm to nɛ Zayɔn be kebee so, ŋkpal manɛ so, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na gbagba e naŋ shin nɛ loŋ e wora.

english_verse: After this, King Sennacherib went back to Assyria and lived in the city of Nineveh.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Asiriya be ewurgboŋ, Sennakerɛb bɛta n yɔ mbe ewurkpa ashi Asiriya be efuli so be kadegboŋ nɛ baa tre Ninɛve na.

english_verse: One day he was worshiping in the temple of his god Nisroch, when his sons, Adrammelech and Sharezer, killed him with their swords. They escaped to the land of Ararat, and his son Esarhaddon became king.
translation_verse: Kachako e ka yɔ mbe kegbir be lambu to n ya kaa shuŋ mbe kegbir nɛ baa tre Nishrɔk na, nɛ mbe mbinyɛnsobi anyɔ nɛ baa tre bumo Adremalɛk nɛ Shareza na ta bumo be etokobi m mɔ mo ndoŋ. Kumo be kaman nɛ b shile n yɔ Ararat be kasawule so nɛ mo pibinyɛn nɛ baa tre Essahaddɔn na sɔ mo so ŋ ki ewura.

english_verse: You, Lord, will save me, and every day that we live we will sing in your temple to the music of stringed instruments. Isaiah's Advice to Hezekiah
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, fo e chɛ ma kulɔ. Amoso, anyeeŋ laŋ ejaŋjilaŋ m boŋ nshɛ ŋ kpaŋ fo. Anyi be kebaawɔtɔ to kikɛ, anyeeŋ boŋ nshɛ ŋ kpaŋ fo ashi fo bɔrɛlambu to.

english_verse: About this time, Hezekiah got sick and was almost dead. So I went in and told him, “The Lord says you won't ever get well. You are going to die, and so you had better start doing what needs to be done.”
translation_verse: Le be jemanɛ ere nɛ kulɔ ko pɛ ewura Hɛzekaya nɛ a daŋ ka gbrɛ nɛ e wu. Ndoŋ nna nɛ anebi Aizaaya nɛ e la Amɔz pibinyɛn na yɔ nɛ e ya bɔ mo so nseŋ kaŋɛ mo le: “Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ yɛ fo bela ase n lɔŋɛ fo kusɔ kama n yili nɛnɛ, ŋkpal manɛ so, fo maaŋ naŋ nya alenfia. Bela ase a jo luwu.”

english_verse: I thought I would never again see you, my Lord, or any of the people who live on this earth.
translation_verse: N daa maa tama fanɛ meeŋ naŋ wu fo, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na, ŋko basa nɛ b kraa wɔ ŋkpa to ashi durnya to kikɛ.

english_verse: “Don't forget that I have been faithful to you, Lord. I have obeyed you with all my heart, and I do whatever you say is right.” After this, he cried hard.
translation_verse: “Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, baa nyiŋi kananɛ n daŋ shuŋ fo kashenteŋ nɛ kagbene koŋwule so. Ma alɛ wora ania fanɛ meeŋ baa wora kusɔ kama nɛ fee sha.” Kumo be kaman nɛ e shu ga.

english_verse: Then the Lord sent me
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ naŋ kaŋɛ anebi Aizaaya

english_verse: with this message for Hezekiah: I am the Lord God, who was worshiped by your ancestor David. I heard you pray, and I saw you cry. I will let you live
translation_verse: fanɛ e naŋ bɛta n yɔ ewura Hɛzekaya kutɔ n ya kaŋɛ mo le: “Ma, Enyɛnpe, fo nananyɛn ewura Deevid be Ebɔrɛ na, nu fo kabɔrɛkule nseŋ wu fo anishichubi na. Meeŋ naŋ shin nɛ fo naŋ ji nfɛ kuduanu n ti so.

english_verse: There's nothing I can say in answer to you, since you are the one who has done this to me. My life has turned sour; I will limp until I die.
translation_verse: Manɛ nɛ meeŋ naŋ kaŋɛ? Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e wora ma loŋ. Kagbenejija nɛ ebesa damta e bɔlɔ ma kagbene to, hale m maaŋ tiŋ n di gba kuraa.

english_verse: while I protect you and your city from the king of Assyria.
translation_verse: Ma alɛ beeŋ kuŋ fo nɛ Jerusalɛm be kadegboŋ ere ashi Asiriya be ewurgboŋ kutɔ.”

english_verse: Do you see the shadow made by the setting sun on the stairway built for King Ahaz? I will make the shadow go back ten steps. Then the shadow went back ten steps. King Hezekiah's Song of Praise
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ shin nɛ kiyoyul nɛ k deŋ atemprembi nɛ ewura Ahaz pɔr na so na e bɛta kaman ateŋgreŋ kudu so.” Ndoŋ nna nɛ kiyoyul na bɛta kaman ateŋgreŋ kudu so, fanɛ kananɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ na.

english_verse: This is what Hezekiah wrote after he got well:
translation_verse: Ewura Hɛzekaya ka koso mbe kulɔ na to nɛ e sibɛ kapandi be kashɛ ere:

english_verse: I thought I would die during my best years and stay as a prisoner forever in the world of the dead.
translation_verse: Le nɛ n daa fɛ ashi ma kagbene to; jemanɛ nɛ ma kebaawɔtɔ daa yil to nɛnɛ na, nɛ n daa shin nɛ n wu n yɔ bubuni to; saŋɛ na so m maaŋ naa wɔ ŋkpa to.

english_verse: My life was taken from me like the tent that a shepherd pulls up and moves. You cut me off like thread from a weaver's loom; you make a wreck of me day and night.
translation_verse: Ma ŋkpa daŋ ku so nna nseŋ fo ekar, fanɛ mbolpɔkpapo be wajɛbu nɛ e bɔɔ na, ŋko fanɛ wajɛ nɛ b kraa lue nseŋ ku kumo so ashi kɔrɛ to na. N daa fɛ fanɛ Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ ma ŋkpa loge nna.

english_verse: Until morning came, I thought you would crush my bones just like a hungry lion; both night and day you make a wreck of me.
translation_verse: Amoso n daa shu nna a klade ŋkpal ebesa so! K daa du fanɛ buluŋ ka bee buri ma awibi to nna. N daa fɛ fanɛ Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ ma ŋkpa loge nna.

english_verse: I cry like a swallow; I mourn like a dove. My eyes are red from looking to you, Lord. I am in terrible trouble. Please come and help me.
translation_verse: N daa shu nna fanɛ kabɔrɛpɔpɔbi, nseŋ daa naa shu kuwɔr so fanɛ lepɔ na. N daŋ dese nna a keni fo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na anishito, hale nɛ ma anishi gben, a maŋ naa wu nɛnɛ. Jande, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, mɔlga ma ashi etɔrɔ ere kikɛ to.

english_verse: Your words and your deeds bring life to everyone, including me. Please make me healthy and strong again.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, fo nawule nɛ meeŋ baa wɔtɔ n sa. Chɛ ma kulɔ ere n shin nɛ n naŋ nya ŋkpa.

english_verse: It was for my own good that I had such hard times. But your love protected me from doom in the deep pit, and you turned your eyes away from my sins.
translation_verse: Ma nɛnɛ so nɛ fo shin nɛ asheŋ kpakpaso ere tu ma. Ama fo kasha kuŋ ma, nɛ m maŋ wu n yɔ bubuni to. Fo alɛ kpele fo anishi n lɛ ashi ma alubi so.

english_verse: No one in the world of the dead can thank you or praise you; none of those in the deep pit can hope for you to show them how faithful you are.
translation_verse: Esa kama nɛ e wɔ bubuni to maaŋ naŋ tiŋ ŋ kpaŋ fo; bubuni maaŋ naŋ tiŋ n yirda fo kashenteŋji.

english_verse: Only the living can thank you, as I am doing today. Each generation tells the next about your faithfulness.
translation_verse: Basa nɛ b wɔ ŋkpa to e naa kpaŋ fo, fanɛ kananɛ mee kpaŋ fo naniere na. Bekurgepo bee kaŋɛ bumo be mbia fo kashenteŋji be asheŋ.

english_verse: I had told King Hezekiah's servants to put some mashed figs on the king's open sore, and he would get well.
translation_verse: Pɔɛŋ nɛ ewura Hɛzekaya nya alenfia nseŋ boŋ kashɛ na, anebi Aizaaya daŋ kaŋɛ mo nna fanɛ e shin nɛ b kɔr kedibi nɛ baa tre figi na be afantaŋ m mata mbe kechuu bɔbɔ na so.

english_verse: Then Hezekiah asked for proof that he would again worship in the Lord's temple.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ ewura Hɛzekaya bishi le: “Manɛ e naaŋ ŋini fanɛ meeŋ naaŋ tiŋ n yɔ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be bɔrɛlambu to n ya shuŋ mo?”

english_verse: Hezekiah welcomed the messengers and showed them all the silver, the gold, the spices, and the fine oils that were in his storehouse. He even showed them where he kept his weapons. Nothing in his palace or in his entire kingdom was kept hidden from them.
translation_verse: Nɛ ewura Hɛzekaya keta mbɔ na kefɔ nseŋ ŋini bumo mbe shuwa nɛ gbiti nɛ eposɔ nɛ e kɔ efɛa belbelso a shin nɛ ajibi bee wora bel na nɛ ɔlif be ŋku lela nɛ etulale nɛ mbe benapo be akɔsɔ kikɛ. Shɛŋ shɛŋ daa maŋ naŋ ka ashi mbe ewurkpa ŋko mbe efuli na kikɛ so nɛ e maŋ ta ŋ ŋini mbɔ na.

english_verse: Merodach Baladan, the son of Baladan, was now king of Babylonia. And when he learned that Hezekiah was well, he sent messengers with letters and a gift for him.
translation_verse: Merodak Baladan nɛ e la Baladan pibinyɛn nseŋ daa la efuli nɛ baa tre Babilɔn be ewura na ka nu fanɛ ewura Hɛzekaya daŋ lɔ nseŋ nya alenfia, nɛ e shuŋi mbɔ nɛ b ta kawɔl nɛ kakɛ n ya sa mo.

english_verse: Then I told Hezekiah: I have a message for you from the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Aizaaya kaŋɛ ewura na le: “Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na gbagba kaŋɛ fanɛ,

english_verse: One day everything you and your ancestors have stored up will be taken to Babylonia. The Lord has promised that nothing will be left.
translation_verse: jemanɛ ko bee ba nɛ b ba sulɔ kusɔ kama nɛ k wɔ ewurkpa nfe nɛ asɔ kama nɛ fo nananyɛnana fin n yili hale m ba fo kabre na kikɛ n yɔ Babilɔn be efuli so. Shɛŋ shɛŋ maaŋ naŋ ka a wɔ nfe!

english_verse: Some of your own sons will be taken to Babylonia, where they will be disgraced and made to serve in the king's palace.
translation_verse: Baaŋ keta fo mbinyɛnsobi gbagba be beko n ya fɛl bumo nɛ b baa shuŋ Babilɔn be ewura be lambu to.”

english_verse: Hezekiah thought, “At least our nation will be at peace for a while.” So he told me, “The message you brought from the Lord is good.”
translation_verse: Ewura Hɛzekaya bre daa fɛ nna fanɛ mo ere be jemanɛ to kayurwushi beeŋ baa wɔ efuli na so, amoso le nɛ e daŋ kaŋɛ: “Kubɔya nɛ fo ta n shi Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kutɔ m ba sa ma ere walɛ.”

english_verse: Our God has said: “Encourage my people! Give them comfort.
translation_verse: Anyi be Ebɔrɛ na yɛ: “Meeŋ lolo ma basa, n shin nɛ bumo be ŋgbene e wushi!

english_verse: Speak kindly to Jerusalem and announce: Your slavery is past; your punishment is over. I, the Lord, made you pay double for your sins.”
translation_verse: Meeŋ leŋ Jerusalɛm be basa to. Kaŋɛ bumo fanɛ b ji awurfoŋ n chɛr ga. Naniere b nya bumo be alubi be ketampaŋ. N tiŋ ŋ gberge bumo kusoe ga ŋkpal bumo be alubi so.”

english_verse: Fill in the valleys; flatten every hill and mountain. Level the rough and rugged ground.
translation_verse: Men ti ataŋɛ nɛ amaŋ kikɛ, nseŋ dɛdɛ abeegboŋ nɛ abeebi kikɛ so. Men lɔŋɛ mboŋ nyaŋgraŋ, n shin nɛ amo kikɛ e dɛdɛ so.

english_verse: Then the glory of the Lord will appear for all to see. The Lord has promised this!”
translation_verse: Saŋɛ na so, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be keshi nɛ kemaŋkura beeŋ lar efuli nɛ basa kikɛ e wu kumo. Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na gbagba e nase kumo be kɔnɔ!”

english_verse: Flowers and grass fade away, but what our God has said will never change. Your God Is Here!
translation_verse: Kashenteŋto, afitiri bee bolo nna nɛ atoto malɛ bee chuge a tɔr, ama Ebɔrɛ be kamalga na bre wɔtɔ nna mbaanaayɔ.”

english_verse: There is good news for the city of Zion. Shout it as loud as you can from the highest mountain. Don't be afraid to shout to the towns of Judah: “Your God is here!”
translation_verse: Fo nɛ fo kɔ baru lela a ba Zayɔn na, e dii n yɔ kebee jeŋgreŋ na so. Fo nɛ fo kɔ baru lela a ba Jerusalɛm to na, bugi kɔnɔ m ponte awɔrso; maŋ kumo so nsaa maa lɔ kufu. Kaŋɛ nde nɛ a wɔ Juda be efuli so na le: “Menyi be Ebɔrɛ bee ba!”

english_verse: Look! The powerful Lord God is coming to rule with his mighty arm. He brings with him what he has taken in war, and he rewards his people.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na kɔ eleŋgboŋ a ba nɛ e ba ji kuwura basa so eleŋso. E keta basa nɛ e kɔ m mɔlga bumo na nna a ba, nɛ kumo be loŋ fuli mbe kagbene.

english_verse: The Lord cares for his nation, just as shepherds care for their flocks. He carries the lambs in his arms, while gently leading the mother sheep. Who Compares with God?
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee keni mbe efuli so nna, fanɛ kananɛ mbolpɔkpapo bee keni mbe mbolpɔ so na. E bee ta mbolpɔbi na nna a di ŋkɔŋ, nsaa juŋkpar mbolpɔ nioana na malɛ boeŋ boeŋ. Shɛŋ ka maŋ du fanɛ Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na be asheŋ

english_verse: Did any of you measure the ocean by yourself or stretch out the sky with your own hands? Did you put the soil of the earth in a bucket or weigh the hills and mountains on balance scales?
translation_verse: Esa kikɛ maaŋ tiŋ n ta mbe enɔ be epun to ŋ karga teku; ŋko n ta mbe enɔ ŋ karga awɔlpa. Esa maaŋ tiŋ n ta durnya to kikɛ be eshishɛr n wɔtɔ kurwa to; ŋko n ta abeegboŋ nɛ abeebi n deŋi kusɔ so ŋ karga amo be egbɛ.

english_verse: Has anyone told the Lord what he must do or given him advice?
translation_verse: Esa maaŋ tiŋ ŋ kaŋɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kusɔ nɛ k daga fanɛ e wora, ŋko ŋ ŋini mo kesheŋwora ŋko n ji mo asoe to.

english_verse: Did the Lord ask anyone to teach him wisdom and justice? Who gave him knowledge and understanding?
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na maa yɔ esa kikɛ kutɔ n ya kaa fin kanyiasheŋ ŋko kepinto ŋko kewora asheŋ nɛ e niŋi amodoŋwura kutɔ.

english_verse: To the Lord, all nations are merely a drop in a bucket or dust on balance scales; all of the islands are but a handful of sand.
translation_verse: Efuliana na maŋ la shɛŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ bre kutɔ, a du fanɛ nchu ka do bokiti nɛ nchu to nna; ŋko kalabɛr nɛ a deŋ kusɔ nɛ b kɔ a karga asɔ be egbɛ so nna. Aplasawule nɛ e wɔ kufɔ kufɔ na kikɛ du fanɛ enɔ be bɔlɔ be eshishɛr nna.

english_verse: The cattle on the mountains of Lebanon would not be enough to offer as a sacrifice to God, and the trees would not be enough for the fire.
translation_verse: Nɛ esa ta Lebanɔn be kupo to be asɔbɔya kikɛ n lara sarga n sa anyi be Ebɔrɛ na, a kraŋ maaŋ fo mo; kumo to be ndibi kikɛ gba maaŋ fo m puga sarga be edɛ.

english_verse: God thinks of the nations as far less than nothing.
translation_verse: Efuliana na kikɛ maŋ la shɛŋ n sa Ebɔrɛ, mo ere bee ta amo nna fanɛ asɔ fuloŋ.

english_verse: Who compares with God? Is anything like him?
translation_verse: Esa kikɛ maŋ du fanɛ Ebɔrɛ. Amoso esa maaŋ tiŋ ŋ ŋini kananɛ e du.

english_verse: Is an idol at all like God? It is made of bronze with a thin layer of gold, and decorated with silver.
translation_verse: E maŋ du fanɛ kegbir nɛ dimɛdi lɔŋɛ na nna, ŋko kegbir nɛ bɔyɛpo ŋalga shuwa ŋ gbiti nseŋ ta gbiti be kubɔtoshembi n ji kumo kebita na nna.

english_verse: Or special wood may be chosen because it doesn't rot— then skilled hands take care to make an idol that won't fall on its face. God Rules the Whole Earth
translation_verse: Esa nɛ e maaŋ tiŋ n nya shuwa ŋko gbiti n lɔŋɛ kegbir bee ku kedibi nɛ k maa tiŋ a bɛ manaŋ nna a lɔŋɛ kumo. E bee fin esa nɛ e nyi kashɛl nɛnɛ nna nɛ e shɛl kegbir nɛ k maaŋ melgi n tɔr nna.

english_verse: Don't you know? Haven't you heard? Hasn't it been clear since the time of creation?
translation_verse: Fo maŋ nyi a? B maŋ kaŋɛ fo dra dra na kikɛ a? Fo maŋ nu kananɛ durnya fara a?

english_verse: God is the one who rules the whole earth, and we that live here are merely insects. He spread out the heavens like a curtain or an open tent.
translation_verse: Esa nɛ e chena mbe kuwurputi so ashi durnya be esoso nɛ k baŋ awɔlpa so na e to durnya. Basa nɛ b wɔ kumo to na du fanɛ atutulombi mo kutɔ nna. Mo e parga kuwɔlpa to fanɛ patisa, ŋko fanɛ wajɛbu nɛ esa e chena to na.

english_verse: They are like flowers freshly sprung up and starting to grow. But when God blows on them, they wilt and are carried off like straw in a storm.
translation_verse: B du fanɛ asɔduuso popɔrbi nna nɛ b baŋ kraŋ duu amo nɛ a maŋ naŋ mur achin na nna. Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na baŋ shin nɛ afu ber m ba, baa wɔl nna nɛ afu na e ber bumo n ya lɛ fanɛ amimi na.

english_verse: The holy God asks, “Who compares with me? Is anyone my equal?”
translation_verse: Wanɛ bre nɛ esa beeŋ tiŋ n ta m ber Ebɔrɛ cheembi na? Esa mo e wɔtɔ a du fanɛ mo?

english_verse: Look at the evening sky! Who created the stars? Who gave them each a name? Who leads them like an army? The Lord is so powerful that none of the stars are ever missing. The Lord Gives Strength
translation_verse: Maŋ anishi so ŋ keni awɔlpa so! Wanɛ e to achɛkpabi nɛ fee wu ere? Mo ere Ebɔrɛ nɛ e bee juŋkpar amo fanɛ benapo be ejuŋkparpo na, e nyi kananɛ amo kikɛ sa nɛ amo be kekama be ketre! Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be yuku shi ga, nɛ achɛkpabi na be kekama maa foe mo so.

english_verse: You people of Israel say, “God pays no attention to us! He doesn't care if we are treated unjustly.” But how can you say that?
translation_verse: Israɛl be basa, manɛ nna nɛ menyee fubel a kaŋɛ fanɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na maŋ nyi menyi be etɔrɔ be asheŋ, ŋko mbe shɛŋ maŋ wɔ kapuni nɛ men wɔtɔ ere to?

english_verse: Don't you know? Haven't you heard? The Lord is the eternal God, Creator of the earth. He never gets weary or tired; his wisdom cannot be measured.
translation_verse: Menyi maŋ nyi a? Menyi alɛ maŋ naŋ nu a? Fanɛ Enyɛnpe na e la Ebɔrɛ nɛ e wɔtɔ mbaanaayɔ; mo e to durnya kikɛ. E maa shuŋ a gben ŋko a gben a chul to kikɛ. Esa kikɛ malɛ maaŋ tiŋ m pin mbe nfɛra to.

english_verse: Even young people get tired, then stumble and fall.
translation_verse: Basa fɔlbi gba bee kaa shuŋ a gben, nsaa fiti a tɔr.

english_verse: But those who trust the Lord will find new strength. They will be strong like eagles soaring upward on wings; they will walk and run without getting tired.
translation_verse: Ama bekama nɛ b yirda Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ nya eleŋ popɔr. Baaŋ ber atɛ to ŋ koso n firgi n yɔ awɔlto fanɛ ejɔnɔkoso; bumo alɛ beeŋ shile ga, ama b maaŋ gben a chul to; baaŋ nite ekpa tenteŋ, ama b maaŋ gben m bɛlɛ.

english_verse: He goes after them so quickly that his feet barely touch the ground— he doesn't even get hurt.
translation_verse: E daa ju a buu bumo so manaŋ manaŋ nna hale mbe aya daa maa beta kasawule gba! Mo alɛ daa maŋ nya doro kikɛ.

english_verse: Who makes these things happen? Who controls human events? I do! I am the Lord. I was there at the beginning; I will be there at the end.
translation_verse: Wanɛ e daŋ shin nɛ le wora? Wanɛ e yili edimɛdi be adrasheŋ n sa bumo? Ma Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ n wɔtɔ sososo na kikɛ na e wora loŋ! Ma, alɛ e naaŋ baa wɔtɔ hale mbaanaayɔ.

english_verse: Islands and foreign nations saw what I did and trembled as they came near. What Can Idols Do?
translation_verse: Basa nɛ b wɔ nsawule nɛ a wɔ kufɔ kufɔ so na wu kusɔ nɛ n wora; nɛ kufu pɛ bumo nɛ baa chicha. Amoso b gama abar so nna m ba ma kutɔ.

english_verse: Worshipers of idols comfort each other, saying, “Don't worry!”
translation_verse: Basa nɛ baa shuŋ agbirana bee lɔlɔ abar nna a kaŋɛ le: ‘Men sa maa fɔŋ so’

english_verse: Israel, you are my servant. I chose you, the family of my friend Abraham.
translation_verse: Israɛlebi, men la ma nyɛrbi nna. Ma e lara menyi. Menyi nɛ men la nteri Eebraham be kaman to ebi na nɛ n lara.

english_verse: From far across the earth I brought you here and said, “You are my chosen servant. I haven't forgotten you.”
translation_verse: Durnya be mboŋ wɔfɔ kikɛ nɛ n shi ŋ keta menyi m ba, nseŋ kaŋɛ menyi le: ‘Men la ma nyɛrbi nna.’ M maŋ kini menyi n lɛ.

english_verse: Don't be afraid. I am with you. Don't tremble with fear. I am your God. I will make you strong, as I protect you with my arm and give you victories.
translation_verse: Amoso men sa maa lɔ kufu. Ma nɛ menyi e wɔtɔ! Ma e la menyi be Ebɔrɛ. Men sa maŋ shin nɛ kufu e pɛ menyi nɛ men baa chicha! Meeŋ sa menyi eleŋ nseŋ chɛ menyi to. Ma alɛ beeŋ kuŋ menyi nseŋ mɔlga menyi.

english_verse: Everyone who hates you will be terribly disgraced; those who attack will vanish into thin air.
translation_verse: Bekama nɛ b kishi menyi beeŋ ji anishinyɔr lubi. Bumo nɛ baaŋ kɔ menyi kena beeŋ wu

english_verse: I am the Lord your God. I am holding your hand, so don't be afraid. I am here to help you.
translation_verse: Ma e la Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na. Ma e wɔtɔ menyi eleŋ nsaa kaŋɛ, ‘Men sa maa lɔ kufu; meeŋ chɛ menyi to.’ ”

english_verse: People of Israel, don't worry, though others may say, “Israel is only a worm!” I am the holy God of Israel, who saves and protects you.
translation_verse: Ade be kaman, nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ: “Israɛl be basa, men ka maŋ shi nsaa maa kɔ eleŋ ga ere gba, men sa maa lɔ kufu; meeŋ chɛ menyi to. Ma, nɛ n la Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ cheembi na e naa mɔlga menyi.

english_verse: I will let you be like a log covered with sharp spikes. You will grind and crush every mountain and hill until they turn to dust.
translation_verse: Meeŋ shin nɛ men ki fanɛ kedishiŋ nɛ k kɔ ewi nsaa du pɛlpɛlbi. Menyeeŋ bure abee to nɛ e ki shishɛrpumpuŋ.

english_verse: When the poor and needy are dying of thirst and cannot find water, I, the Lord God of Israel, will come to their rescue. I won't forget them.
translation_verse: Nɛ ma basa be ebɔl to wɔlto ŋkpal achukoŋ so, nɛ baa fin nchu nɛ b nuu nseŋ kule ma, ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ nu bumo be kekule. Ma, Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na, maaŋ kplaŋ bumo so kikɛ.

english_verse: I will make rivers flow on mountain peaks. I will send streams to fill the valleys. Dry and barren land will flow with springs and become a lake.
translation_verse: Meeŋ shin nɛ elɔr e baa shile abee be awɔlto nɛ abuye e pete a shile ataŋɛ to. Meeŋ shin nɛ keshishɛrsawule e ki fanɛ apa nɛ kasawule wɔlso e ki fanɛ kubuye e shile.

english_verse: I will fill the desert with all kinds of trees— cedars, acacias, and myrtles; olive and cypress trees; fir trees and pines.
translation_verse: Ma alɛ beeŋ shin nɛ ndibi nɛ baa tre sida nɛ akasia nɛ ɔlif na e kɔr keshishɛrsawule so. Ejaŋkilɛa nɛ ŋkɔbidibi nɛ echɛchɛdibi beeŋ kɔr nsawule jiga so ŋ ki apo.

english_verse: Come near me, you idols. Tell us about the past, and we will think about it. Tell us about the future, so we will know what is going to happen.
translation_verse: Men ba kaŋɛ ma kusɔ nɛ k beeŋ wora echefoso, saŋɛ na so nɛ k kaŋ wora, anyeeŋ pin kumo. Men bugi asheŋ nɛ a wora dra na to ŋ kaŋɛ ashi demujikpa, nseŋ kaŋɛ anyi amo be afito.

english_verse: Prove that you are gods by making your predictions come true. Do something good or evil, so we can be amazed and terrified.
translation_verse: Men naŋ kaŋɛ anyi asheŋ nɛ a beeŋ wora echefoso, aloŋ nɛ anyeeŋ pin fanɛ men la agbirana kashenteŋto! Men wora kesheŋ lela ko ŋko alemaŋkarsheŋ ko, n shin nɛ kufu e pɛ anyi nɛ kɔnɔ e mɔ anyi.

english_verse: You idols are nothing, and you are powerless. To worship you would be disgusting.
translation_verse: Menyi gbagba nɛ asɔ nɛ menyee wora kikɛ maŋ la shɛŋ. Basa nɛ baa shuŋ menyi na la basa nɛ mbushu pɛ bumo nna!

english_verse: I, the Lord, appointed a ruler in the north; now he comes from the east to honor my name. He tramples kings like mud, as potters trample clay.
translation_verse: Ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na lara esa ko nɛ e wɔ epeŋilarkpa. Men shin nɛ e shi kelargato be esoso m ba kɔ kena. E bee chichi bewura so nna fanɛ b ka la eshii, ŋko fanɛ kananɛ mpuliya be epɔrpo bee chichi ebɔ so na nna.

english_verse: I was the first to tell the people of Jerusalem, “Look, it's happening!” I was the one who announced this good news to Zion.
translation_verse: Ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e juŋkpar m bɔ baru na n sa Zayɔn. N daŋ shuŋi kabɔ Jerusalɛm to fanɛ e ya kaŋɛ le nna: ‘Menyi be basa bee ba! Baa ba epe nna!’

english_verse: They are nothing, and they can do nothing— they are merely a passing breeze.
translation_verse: Agbirana ere kikɛ du jiga pasaa! B maaŋ tiŋ n wora shɛŋ, Bumo alɛ kikɛ maŋ kɔ eleŋ.”

english_verse: Here is my servant! I have made him strong. He is my chosen one; I am pleased with him. I have given him my Spirit, and he will bring justice to the nations.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na yɛ: “Ma kenya nde, ma e naa sa mo eleŋ. Mo e la esa nɛ n lara, nɛ ma kagbene bee fuli mo so. N ta ma Kiyoyu nna n sa mo, nɛ e bar keji asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so ashi efuliana so.

english_verse: He won't shout or yell or call out in the streets.
translation_verse: E maaŋ ponte awɔrso ŋko m malga awɔrso ashi agbembi so.

english_verse: He won't break off a bent reed or put out a dying flame, but he will make sure that justice is done.
translation_verse: E maaŋ bu kejolobi nɛ k dɛlɛ to a yil ŋko n duŋ fitila nɛ k maa wu nɛnɛ. Ama e beeŋ shin nɛ keji asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so e baa la ekama peya.

english_verse: He won't quit or give up until he brings justice everywhere on earth, and people in foreign nations long for his teaching.
translation_verse: E maaŋ gben n yige to ŋko m pɔ aba; e beeŋ shin nɛ keji asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so e ba durnya to. Efuli pɔtɛ so be basa pere kenishi nna a jo mbe keŋini.”

english_verse: I am the Lord God. I created the heavens like an open tent above. I made the earth and everything that grows on it. I am the source of life for all who live on this earth, so listen to what I say.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ e to esoso nseŋ parga kumo to n sɔ kaplɛkama; mo e to kasawule nɛ asɔ kama nɛ e wɔ kumo so na kikɛ; mo e sa durnya to be basa kikɛ ŋkpa nɛ efute. Naniere kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee kaŋɛ mbe kayɛrbi nde:

english_verse: I chose you to bring justice, and I am here at your side. I selected you and sent you to bring light and my promise of hope to the nations.
translation_verse: “Ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e tre fo nseŋ sa fo eleŋ, nɛ fo shin nɛ keji asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so e ba durnya to. Fo so nɛ ma nɛ basa kikɛ beeŋ bɔla so n wora kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre. Fo so nɛ Ebɔrɛ be kebaanyi be kefulto beeŋ bɔla so m ba efuliana na to.

english_verse: You will give sight to the blind; you will set prisoners free from dark dungeons.
translation_verse: Fo e naaŋ shin nɛ etanpo be anishi e bugi; Feeŋ sɔ basa nɛ b wɔ tentembiri be kabuti to n yige.

english_verse: My name is the Lord! I won't let idols or humans share my glory and praise.
translation_verse: N nawule kpeŋ e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na. M maaŋ shuli nɛ agbir ŋko edimɛdi e sɔ kemaŋkura nɛ bunyaŋ nɛ e daga ma na.

english_verse: Everything has happened just as I said it would; now I will announce what will happen next. Sing Praises to the Lord
translation_verse: Asheŋ kama nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ a beeŋ wora na wora kashenteŋto. Naniere meeŋ naaŋ kaŋɛ fo asheŋ popɔr pɔɛŋ nɛ a fara a wora.” Keboŋ kashɛ ŋ kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be asheŋ

english_verse: For a long time, I, the Lord, have held my temper; now I will cry out and groan like a woman giving birth.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ yɛ: “Ŋ lo ma kɔnɔ n chɛr ga. M maŋ tuge ma basa shɛŋ. Ama naniere jemanɛ fo nɛ n wora kusɔ ko, nɛ mee shu to fanɛ eche nɛ kakurge ta mo na.

english_verse: I will destroy the mountains and what grows on them; I will dry up rivers and ponds.
translation_verse: Meeŋ mur abeebi nɛ abeegboŋ nseŋ shin nɛ ndibi nɛ afitiri e wɔl. Meeŋ shin nɛ elɔr nɛ mbombi e wɔl to nɛ apa e feeto.

english_verse: I will lead the blind on roads they have never known; I will guide them on paths they have never traveled. Their road is dark and rough, but I will give light to keep them from stumbling. This is my solemn promise.
translation_verse: Meeŋ juŋkpar etanpo m bɔla ekpaana nɛ b maŋ naŋ bɔla so ŋ ku so so. Meeŋ shin nɛ bumo be tentembiri e ki kefulto nseŋ shin nɛ ekpa lubi nɛ baa nite so e nyalɛ n sa bumo. Ma nnɔ naseso nna na, ma alɛ beeŋ wora m bɔlɔ amo kikɛ so nyam.

english_verse: Everyone who worships idols as though they were gods will be terribly ashamed. God's People Won't Obey
translation_verse: Bekama nɛ b yirda agbirana, nɛ bumo nɛ baa ta apɔrso fanɛ bumo be ebɔrɛana na, beeŋ ji anishinyɔr nseŋ ŋaba.” Ebɔrɛ be basa ka maa wora kasonu be asheŋ

english_verse: You people are deaf and blind, but the Lord commands you to listen and to see.
translation_verse: Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ le: “Ekpawu, men nu nfe! Menyi, etanpo malɛ e keni n wu nɛnɛ!

english_verse: No one is as blind or deaf as his messenger, his chosen servant,
translation_verse: Esa maŋ tan a chɔ ma kayɛrbi ŋko a la kpawu a chɔ ma kabɔ nɛ n shuŋi na.

english_verse: The Lord always does right, and so he wanted his Law to be greatly praised.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaa bee sha kumɔlga basa so, e bee keni mbe mbraana nɛ keŋini a bɔlɔ kenishi nna, mo alɛ nsaa sha mbe basa e baa bunyaŋ amo.

english_verse: But his people were trapped and imprisoned in holes with no one to rescue them. All they owned had been taken, and no one was willing to give it back.
translation_verse: Ama naniere mbe basa ki basa nɛ beko suge bumo be asɔ eleŋso nna, nseŋ ta bumo kikɛ n wɔtɔ emaŋ chiŋgeliŋ to ŋko n ti ebu nɛ esa kikɛ maaŋ tiŋ n lara bumo. Beko daŋ suge asɔ kama b daa kɔ nna nɛ esa kama malɛ daa maŋ wɔtɔ nɛ e kɔ n sɔ amo n sa bumo.

english_verse: He was furious with us and punished our nation with the fires of war. Still we paid no attention. We didn't even care when we were surrounded and scorched by flames.
translation_verse: Amoso nɛ e shin nɛ mbe agbogboŋ ba anyi so nseŋ shin nɛ kena lubi koso anyi so na. Mbe agbo daŋ suse fanɛ edɛ nna ashi Israɛl kikɛ to, ama an daa maŋ nyi kusɔ nɛ k daa wora na. Anyi alɛ daa maŋ koya shɛŋ kumo to.

english_verse: Descendants of Jacob, I, the Lord, created you and formed your nation. Israel, don't be afraid. I have rescued you. I have called you by name; now you belong to me.
translation_verse: Israɛl be basa, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ e to menyi na yɛ: “Men sa maa lɔ kufu, meeŋ mɔlga menyi. Ma e ti menyi be atre n tre menyi. Men la ma basa nna.

english_verse: When you cross deep rivers, I will be with you, and you won't drown. When you walk through fire, you won't be burned or scorched by the flames.
translation_verse: Nɛ men bɔla lɔr chiŋgeliŋ to gba, ma nɛ menyi e naaŋ baa la. Etɔrɔ nɛ e beeŋ ba menyi so maaŋ pɔɔ menyi so. Nɛ men bɔla edɛ to gba, a maaŋ chɔɔ menyi. Kechɔŋkeni kpakpaso kama nɛ k beeŋ ba menyi so maaŋ pɔɔ menyi so.

english_verse: I am the Lord, your God, the Holy One of Israel, the God who saves you. I gave up Egypt, Ethiopia, and the region of Seba in exchange for you.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, ma e la Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na. Ma, Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ cheembi na, e la menyi be emɔlgapo. Meeŋ kplaŋ Ijipt nɛ Itiopia nɛ kebonfu nɛ baa tre Seba na be asheŋ so nseŋ sɔ menyi n yige.

english_verse: To me, you are very dear, and I love you. That's why I gave up nations and people to rescue you.
translation_verse: Meeŋ kplaŋ efuli pɔtɛana na so nseŋ mɔlga menyi, ŋkpal menyi be asheŋ ka bee par ma ga so. Ma alɛ bee sha menyi nna nsaa maŋkura menyi.

english_verse: Don't be afraid! I am with you. From both east and west I will bring you together.
translation_verse: Men sa maa lɔ kufu! Ŋkpal manɛ so, ma nɛ menyi nna. Meeŋ yili epeŋilarkpa m ba choŋ epeŋitɔrkpa n ya bar menyi abar so.

english_verse: They are my people— I created each of them to bring honor to me.” The Lord Alone Is God The Lord said:
translation_verse: Men la ŋ gbagba be basa nna, nɛ n to menyi nɛ men baa kemaŋkura ma.” Israɛlebi ka la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be eshɛdajipoana be asheŋ

english_verse: Bring my people together. They have eyes and ears, but they can't see or hear.
translation_verse: Nɛ Ebɔrɛ naŋ kaŋɛ le: “Shin nɛ ma basa e gama abar so. B kɔ anishi, ama bumo alɛ maa wu; b kɔ asoe, bumo alɛ maa nu!

english_verse: My people, you are my witnesses and my chosen servant. I want you to know me, to trust me, and understand that I alone am God. I have always been God; there can be no others.
translation_verse: Menyi Israɛl be basa e la ma eshɛdajipoana; ma e lara menyi nɛ men baa la ma nyɛrbi, saŋɛ na so menyeeŋ pin ma nseŋ yirda ma nseŋ naŋ pin to fanɛ n nawule e la Ebɔrɛ. Ebɔrɛ kikɛ maŋ naa wɔtɔ n ti ma so. Ekama malɛ maaŋ naa wɔtɔ n ti ma so.

english_verse: I alone am the Lord; only I can rescue you.
translation_verse: N nawule kpeŋ e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na. Ma alɛ nawule e naaŋ tiŋ m mɔlga menyi.

english_verse: I promised to save you, and I kept my promise. You are my witnesses that no other god did this. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Ma e daŋ nase kɔnɔ fanɛ meeŋ mɔlga menyi, ma alɛ wora m bɔlɔ ma kɔnɔ naseso na so. Menyi e la ma eshɛdajipoana nsaa nyi fanɛ mannɛ efuli pɔtɛ ko be kegbir e mɔlga menyi. Ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ e kaŋɛ na.

english_verse: I am God now and forever. No one can snatch you from me or stand in my way. The Lord Will Prepare the Way
translation_verse: Ma e la Ebɔrɛ nɛ e wɔtɔ mbaanaayɔ na. Esa kikɛ maaŋ tiŋ ŋ gberge menyi n suge ma enɔ to; ŋko ŋ kuŋ ma ekpa nɛ m maaŋ tiŋ n wora kusɔ nɛ mee sha.” Israɛl be kelar Babilɔn be efuli so be asheŋ

english_verse: I, the Lord, will rescue you! I am Israel's holy God, and this is my promise: For your sake, I will send an army against Babylon to drag its people away, crying as they go.
translation_verse: Kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe, Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ cheembi nɛ e mɔlga bumo na kaŋɛ nde: “Meeŋ shuŋi benapo ko nɛ b ba kɔ Babilɔn be efuli so be basa kena nseŋ mɔlga menyi. Ma alɛ beeŋ buri kadegboŋ na be mbunagboŋ to, nseŋ shin nɛ benapo na e ta Babilɔn be basa n wɔtɔ bumo gbagba be ekuloŋgboŋ to n sulɔ bumo a yɔ nɛ b baa boŋ to a shu.

english_verse: I am the Lord, your holy God, Israel's Creator and King.
translation_verse: Ma e la Enyɛnpe, menyi be Ebɔrɛ cheembi na. Israɛl, mee to fo nsaa la fo ewura.”

english_verse: I am the one who cut a path through the mighty ocean.
translation_verse: Dra dra na kikɛ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nase ekpa teku peper na to n sa menyi ashi Ijipt be efuli so.

english_verse: I sent an army to chase you with chariots and horses; now they lie dead, unable to move. They are like an oil lamp with the flame snuffed out. Forget the Past The Lord said:
translation_verse: Mo e daŋ juŋkpar benapo lempoana n yɔ kemur to; b daa la benapo nɛ b kɔ egbaŋɛ nɛ egbaŋɛturko nna. B daŋ kɔ n tɔr nsaa maŋ naŋ tiŋ nɛ b koso kikɛ. B daŋ ki fanɛ fitila nɛ b foŋ kumo be edɛ n duŋ nna!

english_verse: I am creating something new. There it is! Do you see it? I have put roads in deserts, streams in thirsty lands.
translation_verse: Men baa keni kusɔ popɔr nɛ meeŋ wora na ekpa. K tea wora gba! Menyeeŋ tiŋ n wu kumo naniere! Meeŋ wora ekpa keshishɛrsawule so nseŋ shin nɛ men nya mbombi ashi kasawule wɔlso so.

english_verse: Every wild animal honors me, even jackals and owls. I provide water in deserts— streams in thirsty lands for my chosen people.
translation_verse: Jemanɛ ko bee ba nɛ n shin nɛ elɔr e baa shile keshishɛrsawule so, nɛ ma basa laraso e nya nchu a nuu. Saŋɛ na so asɔbɔya lubi beeŋ baa maŋkura ma, nɛ ejiŋkaamu nɛ egbuŋgbula kikɛ e baa di ma epaŋ.

english_verse: I, the Lord, said to Israel: You have become weary of me, but not from worshiping me.
translation_verse: Ade be kaman, nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ le: “Ama ma asheŋ gba menyi, Israɛl be basa, nna nɛ menyi maŋ naa shuŋ ma.

english_verse: You have not honored me by sacrificing sheep or other animals. And I have not burdened you with demands for sacrifices or sweet-smelling incense.
translation_verse: Menyi maŋ ta mbolpɔ n lara esarga chɔɔso n sa ma, ŋko n ta menyi be esarga m bunyaŋ ma. Ma alɛ maŋ yili menyi so a fin ayu be esarga ŋko efɛa belbelso be eduwu be esarga n shin nɛ ebɔl e lar menyi.

english_verse: You have not brought delicious spices for me or given me the best part of your sacrificed animals. Instead, you burden me down with your terrible sins.
translation_verse: Menyi maŋ tɔ efɛa belbelso be eduwu n sa ma ŋko n sa ma menyi be asɔbɔya be nfɔ gba. Ama menyi be alubi nɛ men bela n deŋi ma so; nseŋ shin nɛ menyi be aworandeso lar ma ebɔl.

english_verse: But I wipe away your sins because of who I am. And so, I will forget the wrongs you have done.
translation_verse: Ma, e naa ta menyi be alubi a paŋ menyi, ŋkpal esa nɛ e la ma so. Ma alɛ maŋ naa nyiŋi alubi nɛ men wora ŋ gbiti ma na.

english_verse: Your earliest ancestor and all your leaders rebelled against me.
translation_verse: Men nananyɛn sososo daŋ wora kulubi nna, nɛ menyi be bejuŋkparpoana malɛ lar ma kaman.

english_verse: That's why I don't allow your priests to serve me; I let Israel be destroyed and your people disgraced.
translation_verse: Amoso nɛ n daa maŋ shin nɛ menyi be bɔrɛmatapoana shuŋ ma ashi ma bɔrɛlambu to na. Ma alɛ e daŋ shin nɛ Israɛl be efuli mur nɛ menyi be basa ji anishinyɔr na.”

english_verse: People of Israel, I have chosen you as my servant.
translation_verse: Ade be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ le: “Israɛl be basa, ma e lara menyi fanɛ ma nyɛrbi.

english_verse: I am your Creator. You were in my care even before you were born. Israel, don't be terrified! You are my chosen servant, my very favorite.
translation_verse: Ma e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ e to menyi. Jemanɛ nɛ b kurge menyi kikɛ nɛ n chɛ menyi to. Men sa maa lɔ kufu, ŋkpal manɛ so, men la ma nyɛrbi nɛ ma basa laraso nɛ mee sha nna.

english_verse: I will bless the thirsty land by sending streams of water; I will bless your descendants by giving them my Spirit.
translation_verse: Meeŋ shin nɛ kasawule nɛ k wɔl a baŋɛ ŋ ki mbombi e shile kumo so. Meeŋ shin nɛ ma kiyoyu e gbelge menyi be mbia so nɛ ma nɛfa e ba menyi be kaman to ebi so.

english_verse: They will spring up like grass or like willow trees near flowing streams.
translation_verse: Baaŋ purge fanɛ afitiri nɛ a bee nya nchu nɛnɛ, ŋko ndibi nɛ a kɔ afantaŋ ga nsaa yil mbombi nɛ a bee shile ase.

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the first and the last, the one and only God. Israel, I have rescued you! I am your King.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ e bee ji kuwura Israɛl so nsaa kuŋ kumo na e kaŋɛ le: “Ma e la sososo nɛ lalaloge; n nawule e la Ebɔrɛ. Ma kaman, Ebɔrɛ kikɛ maŋ wɔtɔ.

english_verse: Can anyone compare with me? If so, let them speak up and tell me now. Let them say what has happened since I made my nation long ago, and let them tell what is going to happen.
translation_verse: Esa kikɛ maaŋ tiŋ n wora asɔ nɛ n wora ere. Esa kikɛ malɛ maaŋ tiŋ ŋ kaŋɛ kusɔ nɛ k beeŋ wora yili saŋɛ be sososo n ya fo kumo be lalaloge.

english_verse: Don't tremble with fear! Didn't I tell you long ago? Didn't you hear me? I alone am God— no one else is a mighty rock. Idols Can't Do a Thing The Lord said:
translation_verse: Men sa maa lɔ kufu, ma basa! Men nyi yili dra dra na kikɛ m ba fo mbre, ma e naa kaŋɛ asɔ nɛ e beeŋ baa wora kikɛ; menyi alɛ e la ma eshɛdajipoana. N nawule e la Ebɔrɛ, shɛŋ maŋ naa kɔ eleŋgboŋ fanɛ ma.” Agbirana ka maaŋ tiŋ n wora shɛŋ be asheŋ

english_verse: Those people who make idols are nothing themselves, and the idols they treasure are just as worthless. Worshipers of idols are blind, stupid, and foolish.
translation_verse: Bekama nɛ b lɔŋɛ agbirana maŋ la shɛŋ. Agbirana nɛ baa lɔŋɛ a fa yawu kpakpaso na maŋ kɔ tɔnɔ kikɛ. Basa nɛ baa shuŋ agbirana ere du fanɛ etanpo nɛ basa nɛ b maŋ kɔ kanyiasheŋ nna. Bumo alɛ beeŋ ji anishinyɔr ŋkpal loŋ so.

english_verse: Why make an idol or an image that can't do a thing?
translation_verse: Keta kebɛlso n lɔŋɛ kegbir a shuŋ kumo fanɛ Ebɔrɛ maŋ kɔ tɔnɔ kikɛ!

english_verse: Everyone who makes idols and all who worship them are mere humans, who will end up sadly disappointed. Let them face me in court and be terrified. Idols and Firewood
translation_verse: Esa kama nɛ e bee shuŋ kegbir nɛ basa nɛ baa lɔŋɛ agbirana na kikɛ la edimɛdi nna. Bumo alɛ kikɛ be lalaloge la ŋaba nna. Shin nɛ b ba yili ma anishi to nɛ n ji bumo demu nɛ fo keni. Baaŋ baa chicha nseŋ ji anishinyɔr.

english_verse: A metalworker shapes an idol by using a hammer and heat from the fire. In his powerful hand he holds a hammer, as he pounds the metal into the proper shape. But he gets hungry and thirsty and loses his strength.
translation_verse: Bɔyɛpo e naa ta kebɛlso a wɔtɔ edɛ to nsaa bɛa kumo a lɔŋɛ asɔ. Enɔ to nɛ e bee keta hama na a bɛa kebɛlso a lɔŋɛ kapɔrduli nɛ e bee sha na. Jemanɛ nɛ e bee shuŋ na, akoŋ nɛ achukoŋ kikɛ bee pɛ mo nna nɛ mo alɛ naa gben a ti so, a ŋini fanɛ dimɛdi e la mo.

english_verse: Some woodcarver measures a piece of wood, then draws an outline. The idol is carefully carved with each detail exact. At last it looks like a person and is placed in a temple.
translation_verse: Ndibi be eshɛlpo e naaŋ ku kedibi nseŋ chaŋ kusɔ nɛ e bee sha na be kapɔrduli n deŋi kumo so. Kumo be kaman nɛ e shɛl kedibi na nɛ k ki fanɛ dimɛdi be kapɔrduli gbagba n yili mbe laŋ to.

english_verse: Either cedar, cypress, oak, or any tree from the forest may be chosen. Or even a pine tree planted by the woodcarver and watered by the rain.
translation_verse: Eshɛlpo na beeŋ tiŋ n yɔ kupuŋ to n ya ku kakale ŋko kelera ŋko jaŋkelia be kedibi n shɛl. Mo alɛ beeŋ naŋ tiŋ n duu kedibi nseŋ jo nɛ bɔrɛ e ba n wurge kumo so nɛ k daŋ nɛ e ku kumo n shɛl.

english_verse: Some of the wood is used to make a fire for heating or for cooking. One piece is made into an idol, then the woodcarver bows down and worships it.
translation_verse: Ndibi nɛ edimɛdi kɔ a puga edɛ na be ako nɛ baa ku a lɔŋɛ agbirana. E beeŋ kpele kedibi na be ayabi m puga edɛ n wɔl gbaŋgbaŋ to nseŋ ta ako m puga edɛ n daŋɛ n ji. Kumo be kaman nɛ e ku kedibi na be kaba n lɔŋɛ kegbir a shuŋ kumo.

english_verse: Afterwards, he bows down to worship the wooden idol. “Protect me!” he says. “You are my god.”
translation_verse: Ade be kaman nɛ e ta ndibi nɛ a ka na n lɔŋɛ agbir nseŋ ya gbir m bunyaŋ kumo ŋ kaŋɛ: “Fo e la ma ebɔrɛ, mɔlga ma!”

english_verse: They don't have enough sense to say to themselves, “I made a fire with half of the wood and cooked my bread and meat on it. Then I made something worthless with the other half. Why worship a block of wood?”
translation_verse: Esa nɛ e bee lɔŋɛ agbir maŋ kɔ mbe kumu so be eleŋ ŋko nfɛra nɛ e tiŋ ŋ kaŋɛ le: “Ndibi na be ako nɛ n ta m puga edɛ n daŋɛ ajibi n ji nseŋ tɔ eblaŋ edɛ koŋwule na to n we na. Ndibi nɛ a ka na nɛ n ta n lɔŋɛ kegbir na. Amoso kedishiŋ fuloŋ nɛ mee gbir a bunyaŋ na!”

english_verse: How can anyone be stupid enough to trust something that can be burned to ashes? No one can save themselves like that. Don't they realize that the idols they hold in their hands are not really gods? The Lord Won't Forget His People
translation_verse: Esa nɛ e bee shuŋ agbir baa du fanɛ esa nɛ e bee muu nsunɔ a ji nna. Mbe kawulisheŋ na fule mo nna nɛ e ta mbe kumu n wɔtɔ kebaawɔtɔ ko to nɛ esa maaŋ naŋ tiŋ n chɛ mo to na. Ŋkpal manɛ so, e maaŋ shuli fanɛ kegbir nɛ e bee shuŋ na maŋ la Ebɔrɛ kikɛ. Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ka la etopo nɛ emɔlgapo be asheŋ

english_verse: People of Israel, you are my servant, so remember all of this. Israel, I created you, and you are my servant. I won't forget you.
translation_verse: Ade kikɛ be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ le: “Israɛl be basa, men baa nyiŋi fanɛ men la ma nyɛrbi nna. Mee to menyi nɛ men baa la ma nyɛrbi. Ma alɛ maaŋ teŋ menyi so kikɛ.

english_verse: Turn back to me! I have rescued you and swept away your sins as though they were clouds. Sing Praises to the Lord
translation_verse: Ma e fuge menyi be alubi fanɛ afu ka ber kuwɔlpa n ya lɛ na nna. Men bɛta m ba ma kutɔ. Ma e la esa nɛ e bee mɔlga menyi.”

english_verse: Tell the heavens and the earth to start singing! Tell the mountains and every tree in the forest to join in the song! The Lord has rescued his people; now they will worship him. The Lord Created Everything
translation_verse: Men kaŋɛ esoso nɛ kasawule kikɛ fanɛ a fara a boŋ nshɛ! Men naŋ kaŋɛ abee nɛ kupo to be ndibi kikɛ fanɛ amo alɛ gba e baa shuli nshɛ na so! Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na mɔlga mbe basa Israɛlebi, n shin nɛ mbe kemaŋkura dii efuli ashi Israɛl be efuli so.

english_verse: Israel, I am your Lord, the source of your life, and I have rescued you. I created everything from the sky above to the earth below.
translation_verse: “Ma e la, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, menyi be emɔlgapo na; Ma e la esa nɛ n to menyi. Ma e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ e to kusɔ kikɛ na. N nawule e parga kuwɔlpa to n sɔ esoso kikɛ. Ekama malɛ maŋ chɛ ma to n to durnya.

english_verse: I make liars of false prophets and fools of fortunetellers. I take human wisdom and turn it into nonsense.
translation_verse: Ma katiŋ to nɛ anebi fɛpoana bee ku efɛ a ki befɛpo, nɛ bekpalpo malɛ bee ki bewulpo. Emamachisheŋ nɛ mee wora e naa shin nɛ dimɛdi be kanyiasheŋ bee ki kawulisheŋ.

english_verse: I will make the message of my prophets come true. They are saying, “Jerusalem will be filled with people, and the Lord will rebuild the towns of Judah.”
translation_verse: Ama ma e naa shin nɛ ma anebiana be abɔya bee wora a bɔlɔ so kashenteŋto. Le nɛ baa kaŋɛ: ‘Basa beeŋ ba bɔlɔ Jerusalɛm to, nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na malɛ e lɔŋɛ nde bureso nɛ a wɔ Juda be efuli so na m pɔr.’

english_verse: I am the one who commands the sea and its streams to run dry.
translation_verse: Jemanɛ kikɛ nɛ mee sha fanɛ eteku nɛ mbombi kikɛ e wɔl to, mee malga kenishipereso nna nɛ a bee wɔl to.

english_verse: The Lord said to Cyrus, his chosen one: I have taken hold of your right hand to help you capture nations and remove kings from power. City gates will open for you; not one will stay closed.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e ta Sairus ŋ ki Pɛshiya be efuli so be ewura! E lara mo nna nɛ e kɔ m pɔɔ efuliana so nseŋ lara bewura ashi kuwurji to. Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ bugi ndegboŋ be mbunagboŋ kikɛ n sa mo nseŋ kaŋɛ mo le:

english_verse: I will give you treasures hidden in dark and secret places. Then you will know that I, the Lord God of Israel, have called you by name.
translation_verse: Ma alɛ beeŋ sa fo asɔ lela nɛ a ŋana ashiri be mboŋ, nɛ basa bee sha amo ga na. Saŋɛ na so feeŋ pin fanɛ ma e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na; nseŋ naŋ pin fanɛ Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na e ti fo ketre n tre fo.

english_verse: Cyrus, you don't even know me! But I have called you by name and highly honored you because of Israel, my chosen servant.
translation_verse: Ma e lara fo fanɛ fo chɛ ma anya, Israɛlebi to; bumo e la basa nɛ n lara n sa ma kumu. Jemanɛ nɛ fo maŋ nyi ma na gba, nɛ n shin nɛ fo nya kemaŋkura.

english_verse: Only I am the Lord! There are no other gods. I have made you strong, though you don't know me.
translation_verse: Ma e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na; Ebɔrɛ kikɛ maŋ naa wɔtɔ n ti ma so. Fo ka maŋ nyi ma ere gba, ŋ kraa beeŋ wora fo eleŋ to.

english_verse: Now everyone from east to west will learn that I am the Lord. No other gods are real.
translation_verse: N wora le nna nɛ basa kikɛ ashi durnya to e pin fanɛ ma e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na, nseŋ naŋ pin fanɛ Ebɔrɛ kikɛ maŋ naa wɔtɔ n ti ma so.

english_verse: I create light and darkness, happiness and sorrow. I, the Lord, do all this.
translation_verse: Ma e to kefulto nɛ tentembiri kikɛ. Ma e naa nɛfa nseŋ naa bar kumu lubi gboŋgboŋi basa so. Ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e naa wora ade kikɛ.

english_verse: Tell the heavens to send down justice like showers of rain. Prepare the earth for my saving power to sprout and produce justice that I, the Lord, create. The Lord's Mighty Power The Lord said:
translation_verse: Meeŋ shin nɛ kewora asheŋ niŋiso e shi ebɔrɛso m ba kasawule so fanɛ bɔrɛchu na, m ba shin nɛ kamooji nɛ kashenteŋji e sɔ kaplɛkama. Ma Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e naaŋ shin nɛ le e wora. Ebɔrɛ ka la kasɔto nɛ adrasheŋ be Enyɛnpe be asheŋ

english_verse: Israel, you have no right to argue with your Creator. You are merely a clay pot shaped by a potter. The clay doesn't ask, “Why did you make me this way? Where are the handles?”
translation_verse: Israɛl, fo maŋ kɔ ekpa nɛ fo tu fo etopo n ji emɔrɔ. Fo du fanɛ kapuliya nɛ mpuliya pɔrpo ta ebɔ m pɔr nna. Ebɔ na maa bishi epɔrpo na le: ‘Manɛ nɛ fee wora?’ Kapuliya na malɛ gba maa bile asheŋ a kaŋɛ fanɛ epɔrpo na maŋ nyi mbe kushuŋ.

english_verse: Children don't have the right to demand of their parents, “What have you done to make us what we are?”
translation_verse: Esa ko wɔtɔ nɛ e tiŋ m bishi basa nɛ b kurge mo le: ‘Manɛ nna nɛ men kurge ma kananɛ n du ere?’ ”

english_verse: I am the Lord, the Creator, the holy God of Israel. Do you dare question me about my own nation or about what I have done?
translation_verse: Kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe, Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ cheembi nɛ e to kusɔ kikɛ na kaŋɛ nde: “Menyi maŋ kɔ ekpa nɛ men bishi ma basa Israɛlebi be asheŋ ma kutɔ, ŋko ŋ kaŋɛ ma kusɔ nɛ k daga fanɛ n wora!

english_verse: I created the world and covered it with people; I stretched out the sky and filled it with stars.
translation_verse: Ma e to durnya nseŋ to edimɛdi be yiri yiri n wɔtɔ kumo to. Ma eleŋgboŋ so nɛ awɔlpa parga to n sɔ kaplɛkama nɛ epeŋi nɛ kufɔl nɛ achɛkpabi kikɛ wɔ kumo so na.

english_verse: I have done the right thing by placing Cyrus in power, and I will make the roads easy for him to follow. I am the Lord All-Powerful! Cyrus will rebuild my city and set my people free without being paid a thing. I, the Lord, have spoken. The Lord Alone Can Save
translation_verse: Ŋ gbagba e we n wɔtɔ ewura Sairus nɛ e koso a wora kusɔ nɛ mee sha nɛ asheŋ e nyalɛ. Meeŋ shin nɛ asheŋ e baa du pɔtɔ pɔtɔ n sa mo. Saŋɛ na so e beeŋ lɔŋɛ ma kadegboŋ nɛ baa tre Jerusalɛm na m pɔr, nseŋ sɔ ma basa n yige nɛ b nya bumo be amu. Esa kikɛ maŋ ber mo paa ŋko n sa mo kusɔ ko fanɛ e wora loŋ. Ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ e malga na.”

english_verse: My people, I, the Lord, promise that the riches of Egypt and the treasures of Ethiopia will belong to you. You will force into slavery those tall people of Seba. They will bow down and say, “The only true God is with you; there are no other gods.”
translation_verse: Kede be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ Israɛlebi na le: “Ijipt nɛ Itiopia be efuliana so be kedamaya beeŋ ki menyeya, nɛ Seba be efuli so be basa tenteŋ na e ki menyi be anya. Menyi beeŋ chɛ bumo ŋgbɛlɛbi ŋ gberge bumo m bɛ menyi be amu so. Baaŋ jɔŋɛ menyi ase nseŋ kaŋɛ le: ‘Ebɔrɛ wɔ menyi kutɔ, mo alɛ nawule e la Ebɔrɛ.’

english_verse: People of Israel, your God is a mystery, though he alone can save.
translation_verse: Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ nɛ e bee mɔlga mbe basa na la Ebɔrɛ nɛ esa maa wu mo kenishiso nna.

english_verse: Anyone who makes idols will be confused and terribly disgraced.
translation_verse: Bekama nɛ baa lɔŋɛ agbirana beeŋ ji anishinyɔr nseŋ ŋaba.

english_verse: But Israel, I, the Lord, will always keep you safe and free from shame. Everyone Is Invited
translation_verse: Ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na mɔlga Israɛl be basa bre, nɛ b kɔ m pɔɔ so mbaanaayɔ. Bumo be basa malɛ maaŋ ŋaba kikɛ.

english_verse: The Lord alone is God! He created the heavens and made a world where people can live, instead of creating an empty desert. The Lord alone is God; there are no others.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe na nawule e la Ebɔrɛ, mo e to ebɔrɛso nɛ durnya nɛ basa wɔ kumo to na. E maŋ to durnya nna nɛ k baa dese fuloŋ fanɛ kiyi.” Mo e kaŋɛ le na: “Ma e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, Ebɔrɛ kikɛ maŋ naa wɔtɔ n ti ma so.

english_verse: The Lord did not speak in a dark secret place or command Jacob's descendants to search for him in vain. The Lord speaks the truth, and this is what he says
translation_verse: Mannɛ ashiri to nɛ m malga ŋko n ta ma ŋkre ŋ ŋana. M maŋ kaŋɛ Israɛl be basa fanɛ, nɛ b fin ma b maaŋ wu ma a. Ma e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ e bee ji kashenteŋ na. Kusɔ nɛ k bɔla ekpa nɛ mee kaŋɛ.” Durnya to nɛ Babilɔn be agbirana be Enyɛnpe be asheŋ

english_verse: “Why don't you get together and meet me in court? Didn't I tell you long ago what would happen? I am the only God! There are no others. I bring about justice, and have the power to save.
translation_verse: Men ba demujikpa! Bekama nɛ baaŋ tiŋ m malga ŋ kuŋ bumo be amu na e to abar jina. Dra dra na kikɛ, wanɛ e tiŋ ŋ kaŋɛ kusɔ nɛ k beeŋ wora? Mannɛ ma Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ e mɔlga mbe basa na e tiŋ ŋ kaŋɛ a? Ebɔrɛ kikɛ maŋ naa wɔtɔ n ti ma so.

english_verse: “I invite the whole world to turn to me and be saved. I alone am God! No others are real.
translation_verse: Mee pla enɔ a tre durnya kikɛ to be basa nna, nɛ b kilgi m ba ma kutɔ nseŋ nya kumɔlga. N nawule kpeŋ e la Ebɔrɛ a wɔtɔ.

english_verse: I have made a solemn promise, one that won't be broken: Everyone will bow down and worship me.
translation_verse: Ma kɔnɔ naseso la kashenteŋ nna, kumo alɛ maa chɛrga. M bɔ ntaŋ n nase kɔnɔ fanɛ ekama beeŋ ba gbir ma kumuli nseŋ shuŋ ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.

english_verse: They will admit that I alone can bring about justice. Everyone who is angry with me will be terribly ashamed and will turn to me.
translation_verse: Bumo alɛ beeŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ n nawule kutɔ nɛ esa beeŋ tiŋ n nya kekɔmpɔɔso nɛ eleŋ. Ama bekama nɛ b kishi ma na bre beeŋ ŋaba.

english_verse: I, the Lord, will give victory and great honor to the people of Israel.”
translation_verse: Ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e naaŋ mɔlga Israɛl be basa kikɛ, nɛ bumo alɛ e maŋkura ma.”

english_verse: They are down on their knees to rescue the heavy load, but the images are still taken to a foreign country.
translation_verse: Agbirana na maaŋ tiŋ m mɔlga amo be amu. Amo nɛ bedoŋ kɔ n suge a yɔ efuli pɔtɛ so na. Babilɔn be agbirana be eleŋ fo ekar nna na!

english_verse: You survivors in Israel, listen to me, the Lord. Since the day you were born, I have carried you along.
translation_verse: Israɛl be basa, nɛ men la ma basa nɛ b ka a wɔ ŋkpa to, men nu nfe! Jemanɛ nɛ b kurge menyi m ba fo mbre na kikɛ nɛ mee keni menyi so.

english_verse: I will still be the same when you are old and gray, and I will take care of you. I created you. I will carry you and always keep you safe.
translation_verse: Ma e la menyi be Ebɔrɛ nsaa beeŋ keni menyi so n ya fo fanɛ menyi ka beeŋ ya bel n fuli amu. Ma e to menyi nsaa keni menyi so; meeŋ chɛ menyi to nseŋ kuŋ menyi nɛ shɛŋ shɛŋ maaŋ wora menyi.”

english_verse: Some people hire a goldsmith and give silver and gold to be formed into an idol for them to worship.
translation_verse: Basa ko bee ber ebɔyɛpo paa nna, a sa bumo shuwa nɛ gbiti fanɛ b lɔŋɛ agbirana n sa bumo nɛ b baa shuŋ amo.

english_verse: They carry the idol on their shoulders, then put it on a stand, but it cannot move. They call out to the idol when they are in trouble, but it doesn't answer, and it cannot help.
translation_verse: Baa kaa sulɔ agbirana na bumo be abatimu so nna n ya ka yili amo be eyilikpa nɛ e maa nite. Nɛ esa baŋ yɔ amo ase n ya malga amo kutɔ gba, a maaŋ tiŋ n tuge mo ŋko m mɔlga amodoŋwura ashi tɔrɔ kikɛ to.

english_verse: Now keep this in mind, you sinful people. And don't ever forget it. The Lord Alone Is God
translation_verse: Menyi, basa nɛ men lar ma kaman ere, men shin nɛ demu ere e baa wɔ menyi be nfɛra to, nɛ men baa nyiŋi kumo jemanɛ kikɛ.

english_verse: I alone am God! There are no other gods; no one is like me. Think about what happened many years ago.
translation_verse: Men baa nyiŋi kusɔ nɛ k wora dra na, nseŋ pin to fanɛ n nawule e la Ebɔrɛ. Ekama maŋ du fanɛ ma.

english_verse: From the very beginning, I told what would happen long before it took place. I kept my word
translation_verse: Pɔɛŋ nɛ kesheŋ kikɛ e wora, nɛ ma ere tiŋ n wu kumo ŋ kaŋɛ. N teŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ ma ŋkre beeŋ wora m bɔlɔ so, ma alɛ beeŋ wora kusɔ nɛ ŋ kre kewora kikɛ.

english_verse: and brought someone from a distant land to do what I wanted. He attacked from the east, like a hawk swooping down. Now I will keep my promise and do what I planned.
translation_verse: Mee tre esa ko nna nɛ e shi epeŋilarkpa, m ba manaŋ fanɛ kusore ka fuu kusɔ na. E beeŋ ba wora kusɔ nɛ mee sha n sa ma. Kusɔ nɛ ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ, e naaŋ wora.

english_verse: You people are stubborn and far from being safe, so listen to me.
translation_verse: Menyi, basa nɛ men be ŋgbene du kpakpa, nɛ menyi nɛ kumɔlga barga abar na e nu nfe!

english_verse: I will soon come to save you. I am not far away and will waste no time; I take pride in Israel and will save Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Meeŋ ba mɔlga menyi. Ma nɛ menyi maaŋ naŋ barga abar. M maaŋ naŋ chɛr nseŋ ba mɔlga menyi. Meeŋ mɔlga basa nɛ b wɔ Jerusalɛm to nseŋ shin nɛ Israɛl be efuli na e nya kemaŋkura.”

english_verse: You will suffer the shame of going naked, because I will take revenge, and no one can escape.
translation_verse: Basa beeŋ wu men be kesaria nseŋ wu kananɛ men ba kaseto n ji anishinyɔr. Meeŋ gberge Babilɔn be basa kikɛ kusoe ŋkpal bumo be alubi so, nɛ esa kikɛ maaŋ tiŋ ŋ kuŋ ma ekpa.”

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the holy God of Israel. I am their Savior.
translation_verse: “Ma e la Enyɛnpetale, Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ cheembi na; Ma e la bumo be Emɔlgapo.”

english_verse: I was angry with my people. So I let you take their land and bring disgrace on them. You showed them no mercy, but were especially cruel to those who were old.
translation_verse: N daŋ nya agbo n wora ma basa nna, nseŋ daŋ wora bumo fanɛ b ka maŋ naa la ma basa. Ŋkpal loŋ so nɛ n ta bumo m bɔɔ menyi enɔ, menyi alɛ daa maŋ wu bumo kuwɔr. Men daa ŋmenyaŋ bumo to be basakpar na gba nna.

english_verse: You thought that you would be queen forever. You didn't care what you did; it never entered your mind that you might get caught.
translation_verse: Men daa fɛ fanɛ menyeeŋ baa ji kuwura jemanɛ kikɛ nna. Menyi alɛ daa maŋ ta asheŋ ere n wɔtɔ kagbene to, ŋko n fɛ kananɛ amo kikɛ beeŋ loge to be asheŋ.

english_verse: You think that you alone are all-powerful, that you won't be a widow or lose your children. All you care about is pleasure, but listen to what I say.
translation_verse: Menyi alɛ daa naa fɛ fanɛ men shi ga nna a kɔ eleŋgboŋ fanɛ Ebɔrɛ, a wɔtɔ a ji menyi be amu jemanɛ kikɛ, a fɛ fanɛ esa kikɛ maŋ naa du fanɛ menyi. Menyi alɛ daa naa fɛ nna fanɛ menyi maaŋ tiŋ ŋ ki fanɛ ekulpoche ŋko esa nɛ e paŋ mbe mbia.

english_verse: You hid behind evil like a shield and said, “No one can see me!” You were fooled by your wisdom and your knowledge; you felt sure that you alone were in full control.
translation_verse: Men daŋ ta asheŋ lubi be kewora nna fanɛ kebɛlso be kusɔ kuŋkumuso a kaŋɛ le: ‘Esa kama maa wu anyi!’ Men be kanyiasheŋ nɛ kashennyi e fule menyi, nɛ men yirda fanɛ men nawule e baa la ashi durnya to, esa kikɛ maŋ naa du fanɛ menyi.

english_verse: You have worn yourself out, asking for advice from those who study the stars and tell the future month after month. Go ask them how to be saved from what will happen.
translation_verse: Dra dra men daa yɔ basa nɛ baa keni achɛkpabi nsaa kaŋɛ kusɔ nɛ k beeŋ wora echefoso kufɔl kikɛ na kutɔ n ya kaa fin kasotoji, ama k maŋ chɛ menyi to. To, men ya bishi bumo kananɛ menyeeŋ wora n nya kumɔlga a laŋɛ kusɔ nɛ k bee shin nɛ k wora ere be kaplɛa so.

english_verse: People who trust the stars are as helpless as straw in a flaming fire. No one can even keep warm, sitting by a fire that feeds only on straw.
translation_verse: Basa nɛ b yirda achɛkpabi baa du fanɛ atuweklaŋ nɛ abee ji edɛ nsaa maaŋ tiŋ m mɔlga amo be amu nna. Esa kama maaŋ tiŋ n ta atuweklaŋ m puga edɛ n daŋɛ ajibi. Atuweklaŋ maaŋ tiŋ n wɔl esa edɛ awo to n chɛr.

english_verse: These are the fortunetellers you have done business with all of your life. But they don't know where they are going, and they can't save you.
translation_verse: Bekpalpo nɛ menyee yɔ bumo kutɔ n ya kaa bishi so men be kebia to kikɛ m ba fo kabre na maŋ nyi kakpa nɛ baa yɔ gba, hale nɛ baa tiŋ a mɔlga menyi.”

english_verse: You call Jerusalem your home and say you depend on me, the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel.
translation_verse: Menyee puchi a kaŋɛ fanɛ men la Jerusalɛm, kadegboŋ cheembi na to be basa nsaa ta menyi be amu a to Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ nɛ e la Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na so nna.

english_verse: Long ago I announced what was going to be, then without warning, I made it happen.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ Israɛlebi na le: “Dra dra kikɛ nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ kusɔ nɛ k beeŋ wora; epul na to malɛ nɛ n shin nɛ loŋ wora.

english_verse: And I told you these things, so that when they happened you would not say, “The idols we worship did this.”
translation_verse: Amoso nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ menyi asheŋ ere dra dra kikɛ na, saŋɛ na so nɛ a kaŋ wora m bɔlɔ so, menyi maaŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ agbir nɛ menyee shuŋ na e shin nɛ a wora m bɔlɔ so.

english_verse: You have never been willing to listen to what I say; from the moment of your birth, I knew you would rebel. The Lord Warns Israel
translation_verse: N nyi menyi ka la basa nɛ esa maaŋ tiŋ n yirda, nseŋ naa la basa nɛ baa lar ma kaman, yili jemanɛ nɛ n ta menyi ŋ ki efuli n sa ma kumu na. Amoso nɛ menyi maŋ wora ania nɛ men nu kusɔ nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ menyi na.
