english_verse: I, the Lord, am true to myself; I will be praised for not punishing and destroying you.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal ŋ ka bee sha basa e kpaŋ ma ketre so, nɛ mee pɛ ma agbo nsaa maŋ mur menyi na.

english_verse: I tested you in hard times just as silver is refined in a heated furnace.
translation_verse: Awurfoŋ nɛ n ta n wora menyi ŋ keni, fanɛ kananɛ baa ta edɛ a lɔŋɛ gbiti so na.

english_verse: Israel, my chosen people, listen to me. I alone am the Lord, the first and the last.
translation_verse: Kede be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ naŋ kaŋɛ le: “Men nu nfe, menyi Israɛlebi nɛ men la ma basa nɛ n tre! N nawule e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ. Ma e la sososo nɛ lalaloge.

english_verse: With my own hand I created the earth and stretched out the sky. They obey my every command. The Lord Speaks to the Nations
translation_verse: Ŋ gbagba be enɔ nɛ n ta n to durnya, nseŋ shin nɛ awɔlpa parga to n sɔ kaplɛkama. Kusɔ kama nɛ m baŋ yili n sa amo, e bee nya manaŋ a wora ma kasonu epul to nna.

english_verse: Gather around me, all of you! Listen to what I say. Did any of your idols predict this would happen? Did they say that my friend would do what I want done to Babylonia?
translation_verse: Men kikɛ e gama abar so nseŋ nu nfe! Agbirana na be kekama maaŋ tiŋ n wu ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ esa nɛ n lara na e naaŋ kɔ Babilɔn be efuli kena, ŋko n wu ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ e beeŋ wora kusɔ nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ e wora na.

english_verse: I was the one who chose him. I have brought him this far, and he will be successful.
translation_verse: Ma e lara mo nseŋ n tre mo; ma alɛ beeŋ juŋkpar mo n shin nɛ e kɔ m pɔɔ so.

english_verse: Come closer and listen! I have never kept secret the things I have said, and I was here before time began. It Is Best To Obey the Lord By the power of his Spirit the Lord God has sent me
translation_verse: Men firgi n taga ma to naniere nseŋ nu nfe! Sososo na kikɛ nɛ m bugi to ŋ kaŋɛ kusɔ kama nseŋ shin nɛ ma mmalga kikɛ bɔlɔ so kashenteŋto.” Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na e bɔla mbe Kiyoyu be eleŋgboŋ so n shuŋi ma. Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be ŋkre nɛ e kɔ n sa mbe basa be asheŋ

english_verse: with this message: People of Israel, I am the holy Lord God, the one who rescues you. For your own good, I teach you, and I lead you along the right path.
translation_verse: Kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe, Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ cheembi, nɛ e mɔlga menyi na kaŋɛ nde: “Ma e la Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ, nɛ mee sha keŋini menyi asheŋ ŋkpal menyi be nɛnɛ so, nseŋ juŋkpar menyi ekpa nɛ menyeeŋ baa bɔla so a wora asheŋ.

english_verse: Your nation would be blessed with more people than there are grains of sand along the seashore. And I would never have let your country be destroyed.
translation_verse: Menyi be kaman to ebi beeŋ wora keshi fanɛ shishɛr, nɛ ma alɛ e shin nɛ b sa maŋ mur kikɛ

english_verse: He led us through the desert and made water flow from a rock to satisfy our thirst.
translation_verse: E juŋkpar anyi m bɔla keshishɛrsawule so nseŋ shin nɛ kefalta pante n lar nchu nɛ an nuu n tuge achukoŋ.

english_verse: But the Lord has promised that none who are evil will live in peace.”
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nase kɔnɔ fanɛ alubiworapoana maaŋ nya kayurwushi kikɛ.’ ”

english_verse: Everyone, listen, even you foreign nations across the sea. The Lord chose me and gave me a name before I was born.
translation_verse: Ekama e nu nfe! Menyi nɛ men wɔ efuli pɔtɛana nɛ a wɔ teku be kaba ndoŋ na gba, e nu nfe. Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e lara ma nɛ m baa la mbe kenya, nseŋ nase ma ketre pɔɛŋ nɛ b kurge ma.

english_verse: He made my words pierce like a sharp sword or a pointed arrow; he kept me safely hidden in the palm of his hand.
translation_verse: Mo e shin nɛ ma mmalga du fanɛ tokobi jiso ŋko ketanyembi pɛlpɛlbi. Mo e ta ma ŋ ŋana mo gbagba be enɔ be epun to.

english_verse: The Lord said to me, “Israel, you are my servant; and because of you I will be highly honored.”
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ ma le: “Israɛl, fo la ma kenya nna. Basa beeŋ bunyaŋ ma ga ŋkpal fo so.”

english_verse: I said to myself, “I'm completely worn out; my time has been wasted. But I did it for the Lord God, and he will reward me.”
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ le: “N shuŋ ŋ gben jiga. N ta ma eleŋ n shuŋ ga, ama ma alɛ maŋ nya shɛŋ. Kusɔ nɛ k daga fanɛ n nya kikɛ wɔ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be enɔ to nna. Mo e naaŋ ka ma kumo be kukɔ.”

english_verse: Even before I was born, the Lord God chose me to serve him and to lead back the people of Israel. So the Lord has honored me and made me strong.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ e lara ma n sa mbe kumu pɔɛŋ nɛ b kurge ma. Mo e lara ma fanɛ m baa la mbe kayɛrbi, saŋɛ na so meeŋ bɛta mbe basa Israɛlebi nɛ b pesaŋ to na m ba mo kutɔ. Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e shin nɛ n nya kemaŋkura; ma eleŋ bee shi mo kutɔ nna.

english_verse: Now the Lord says to me, “It isn't enough for you to be merely my servant. You must do more than lead back survivors from the tribes of Israel. I have placed you here as a light for other nations; you must take my saving power to everyone on earth.” The Lord Will Rescue His People
translation_verse: Kede be kaman, nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ naŋ kaŋɛ ma le: “Ma kenya, ŋ kɔ kushuŋgboŋ ko a sa fo. Mannɛ ma basa, Israɛlebi nɛ b ji efute na be kebɛta m ba bumo be eyilikpagboŋ na be kushuŋ nawule nɛ feeŋ shuŋ. Meeŋ shin nɛ efuli pɔtɛana so be basa e bɔla fo so m ba pin ma, saŋɛ na so meeŋ mɔlga bumo alɛ gba.”

english_verse: Israel, I am the holy Lord God, the one who rescues you. You are slaves of rulers and of a nation who despises you. Now this is what I promise: Kings and rulers will honor you by kneeling at your feet. You can trust me! I am your Lord, the holy God of Israel, and you are my chosen ones. The Lord Will Lead His People Home
translation_verse: Israɛl be basa, ma e la Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ cheembi na. Ma alɛ e la menyi be emɔlgapo! Men daa la anya nna n sa efuli pɔtɛana be bewura nɛ baa keni menyi jiga. Naniere kɔnɔ nɛ mee nase a sa menyi nde: “Bewurjipo nɛ kenimujiana beeŋ gbir m bunyaŋ menyi. Menyeeŋ tiŋ n yirda ma! Ŋkpal manɛ so, ma e la Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ nɛ menyi alɛ la ma basa laraso.” Kelɔŋɛ Jerusalɛm n yili kumo be eyilikpa dra be asheŋ

english_verse: This is what the Lord says: I will answer your prayers because I have set a time when I will help by coming to save you. I have chosen you to take my promise of hope to other nations. You will rebuild the country from its ruins, then people will come and settle there.
translation_verse: Ade be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ mbe basa le: “Menyi be kumɔlga be jemanɛ kaŋ fo, meeŋ wu menyi kuwɔr nseŋ nu menyi be kabɔrɛkule. Meeŋ kuŋ menyi nseŋ mɔlga menyi. Meeŋ shin nɛ men ta kɔnɔ nɛ n nase nɛ k kɔ tama na n ya sa efuli pɔtɛana so ebi. Ma alɛ beeŋ naŋ shin nɛ men bɛta m ba chena menyi be kasawule nɛ k dese jiga na so.”

english_verse: You will set prisoners free from dark dungeons to see the light of day. On their way home, they will find plenty to eat, even on barren hills.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ basa nɛ b wɔ kabuti to le: “Men lar kabuti to!” Ma alɛ beeŋ kaŋɛ bumo nɛ b wɔ tentembiri to le: “Men lar tentembiri na to m ba kefulto to!” Baaŋ baa du fanɛ mbolpɔ nɛ a bee ji abeemase nna.

english_verse: They won't go hungry or get thirsty; they won't be bothered by the scorching sun or hot desert winds. I will be merciful while leading them along to streams of water.
translation_verse: Akoŋ nɛ achukoŋ maaŋ naŋ pɛ bumo kikɛ. Epeŋi nɛ keshishɛrsawule so be ebeldɛ maaŋ naŋ tɔrɔ bumo. Ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ baa wu bumo kuwɔr nsaa juŋkpar bumo a yɔ mbombi ase.

english_verse: I will level the mountains and make roads.
translation_verse: “Meeŋ lɔŋɛ kegbembi abee to n sa ma basa nɛ b baa bɔla so a nite.

english_verse: Then my people will return from distant lands in the north and the west and from the city of Syene. The Lord's Mercy
translation_verse: Ma basa beeŋ shi kufɔ kufɔ m bɛta m ba epe. Baaŋ shi kelargato be esoso nɛ epeŋitɔrkpa be kaba so, nɛ kebonfu nɛ baa tre Aswan nɛ k wɔ kelargato be kaseto be kaba so na kikɛ m bɛta m ba epe.”

english_verse: Tell the heavens and the earth to celebrate and sing; command every mountain to join in the song. The Lord's people have suffered, but he has shown mercy and given them comfort.
translation_verse: Kaŋɛ asɔ nɛ a wɔ ebɔrɛso nɛ kasawule so kikɛ nɛ a baa boŋ nshɛ a ji amo be amu! Nseŋ shin nɛ abee gba e baa shuli so a boŋ nshɛ na! Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be basa ji awurfoŋ ga; mo alɛ naaŋ wu bumo kuwɔr.

english_verse: The people of Zion said, “The Lord has turned away and forgotten us.”
translation_verse: Le nɛ basa nɛ b wɔ Jerusalɛm to daŋ kaŋɛ: “Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na lar anyi be kaman nseŋ teŋ anyi so.”

english_verse: The Lord answered, “Could a mother forget a child who nurses at her breast? Could she fail to love an infant who came from her own body? Even if a mother could forget, I will never forget you.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ le: “Eche kurgepo beeŋ tiŋ n teŋ kebia nɛ mo gbagba sa mo kenyipo so a? Nɛ ebinio beeŋ tiŋ n teŋ mo kebia so gba, ma ere maaŋ teŋ menyi so kikɛ.

english_verse: “Your city will be built faster than it was destroyed— those who attacked it will retreat and leave.
translation_verse: Basa nɛ baaŋ lɔŋɛ fo egbalana m pɔr maaŋ chɛr nseŋ ba, nɛ basa nɛ b mur fo na e lar fo to n yɔ.

english_verse: Look around! You will see your people coming home. As surely as I live, I, the Lord, promise that your city with its people will be as lovely as a bride wearing her jewelry.” Jerusalem's Bright Future
translation_verse: Keni ŋ kulti fo! Feeŋ wu fo basa ka bɛta a ba epe. Ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ka baa wɔtɔ ere bre, feeŋ baa puchi fo basa so nsaa wu fo kumu, fanɛ kananɛ kejafɔche bee ta mbe abitasɔ a mea to nsaa ji kebita a ŋini basa na.

english_verse: Jerusalem is now in ruins! Nothing is left of the city. But it will be rebuilt and soon overcrowded; its cruel enemies will be gone far away.
translation_verse: Jerusalɛm be kadegboŋ daŋ bure nna a dese fuloŋ, ama naniere k beeŋ baa du fimbi ga a maaŋ tiŋ n sɔ basa nɛ baaŋ ba chena kumo to na. Basa nɛ b daŋ mur fo nseŋ yige fo n nase fuloŋ na beeŋ lar fo to n yɔ kufɔ kufɔ.

english_verse: Jerusalem is a woman whose children were born while she was in deep sorrow over the loss of her husband. Now those children will come and seek room in the crowded city,
translation_verse: Kachako, bee ba nɛ fo basa nɛ b kurge bumo ashi efuli pɔtɛana so na e ba kaŋɛ fo le: ‘Kasawule ere du fimbi ga n sa anyi. Anyee sha kakpagboŋ nɛ an chena so nna!’

english_verse: and Jerusalem will ask, “Am I really their mother? How could I have given birth when I was still mourning in a foreign land? Who raised these children? Where have they come from?”
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ fo alɛ e kaŋɛ fo kumu le: ‘Wanɛ e kurge mbia ere kikɛ n sa ma? N daŋ paŋ ma mbia nna nsaa maaŋ naŋ tiŋ ŋ kurge ebi. B daŋ pɛ ma kenya nna n yɔ efuli pɔtɛ so; wanɛ e bela mbia ere nɛ b daŋ? N nawule e daŋ ka a wɔtɔ; nnɛ nɛ mbia ere shi m ba?’ ”

english_verse: The Lord God says: “I will soon give a signal for the nations to return your sons and your daughters to the arms of Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ mbe basa le: “Meeŋ maŋ ma tuta so nɛ efuliana na be basa e wu kumo, nseŋ shin nɛ ma basa e bɛta m ba epe ashi bumo gbagba be kasawule so.

english_verse: The kings and queens of those nations where they were raised will come and bow down. They will take care of you just like a slave taking care of a child. Then you will know that I am the Lord. You won't be disappointed if you trust me.” The Lord Is on Our Side
translation_verse: Bewura beeŋ ki fanɛ betuto n sa fo; nɛ bewurche e ki fanɛ benio n sa fo. Baaŋ jɔŋɛ fo ase nseŋ bunyaŋ fo. Kumo be kaman nɛ b bar bumo be amu kaseto n sa fo. Saŋɛ na so, feeŋ pin fanɛ ma e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na. Esa kama nɛ e yirda ma, maaŋ ji anishinyɔr kikɛ.

english_verse: But the Lord has promised to fight on our side and to rescue our children from those strong and violent enemies.
translation_verse: Ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nase kɔnɔ fanɛ e beeŋ kɔ n sa anyi nseŋ sɔ anyi be mbia n yige ashi an doŋana nɛ baa suge basa be asɔ eleŋso be enɔ to.

english_verse: He will make those cruel people dine on their own flesh and get drunk from drinking their own blood. Then everyone will know that the Lord is our Savior; the powerful God of Israel has rescued his people.
translation_verse: Mo alɛ beeŋ shin nɛ bumo nɛ baa mɛaŋ menyi na gbagba e mɔ abar nsaa wora asheŋ fanɛ b ka boo na. Saŋɛ na so ekama beeŋ pin fanɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e la anyi be emɔlgapo. Bumo alɛ beeŋ naŋ pin fanɛ Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ lempo na e kɔ n sɔ mbe basa n yige.”

english_verse: I make the sky turn dark like the sackcloth you wear at funerals.” God's Servant Must Suffer
translation_verse: Meeŋ tiŋ n shin nɛ kuwɔlpa e buu so m biri to fanɛ ewajɛ lembir nɛ menyee buu ashi nlibuna na.” Ebɔrɛ be kayɛrbi ka beeŋ ji awurfoŋ be asheŋ

english_verse: he made me willing to listen and not rebel or run away.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e shin nɛ m pin asheŋ to a maŋ lar mo kaman ŋko n shile mo na.

english_verse: I let them beat my back and pull out my beard. I didn't turn aside when they insulted me and spit in my face.
translation_verse: Ŋ kilgi ma kaman nna n sa basa, nɛ baa beri, nseŋ kilgi ma ketaya n sa bumo, nɛ baa tia ma katɔl be afuibi. Ma alɛ maŋ kaŋɛ basa nɛ baa tege ma nsaa tu echɔl a wɔtɔ ma anishi to na fanɛ b yige.

english_verse: But the Lord God keeps me from being disgraced. So I refuse to give up, because I know God will never let me down.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na ka bee chɛ ma to so, bumo be katege maaŋ tiŋ n shin nɛ n ji anishinyɔr. Amoso mee leŋ ma kumu to nna, ma alɛ maa sa bumo kashuli. Ŋkpal manɛ so, n nyi fanɛ m maaŋ ji anishinyɔr.

english_verse: The Lord God will help me and prove I am innocent. My accusers will wear out like moth-eaten clothes.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na gbagba e naŋ malga n chɛ ma kɔnɔ n sa ma. Bekama nɛ baa wu ma kulubi nsaa malga a gbiti ma beeŋ mur fanɛ kananɛ kaŋkaŋ bee muu wajɛ a mur na.

english_verse: None of you respect the Lord or obey his servant. You walk in the dark instead of the light; you don't trust the name of the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Asheŋ beeŋ tiŋ ŋ ki kpakpa n sa menyi nɛ menyee bunyaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nsaa wora mbe kenya kasonu na. Ama men yirda Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ n ta menyi be amu n to mo so.

english_verse: Go ahead and walk in the light of the fires you have set. But with his own hand, the Lord will punish you and make you suffer.
translation_verse: Menyi kama nɛ menyee kre men braana kemur be nia na, menyi gbagba be ŋkre e naaŋ mur menyi. Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ gberge menyi kusoe n shin nɛ men ji awurfoŋ.

english_verse: If you want to do right and obey the Lord, follow Abraham's example. He was the rock from which you were chipped.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na yɛ: “Nɛ menyee sha kebaawora kusɔ nɛ k niŋi nsaa wora Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kasonu, kumo ere men baa keni menyi nananyɛn Eebraham so a wora asheŋ. Mo e du fanɛ kefalta nɛ men shi kumo to n lar na.

english_verse: Though Zion is in ruins, the Lord will bring comfort, and the city will be as lovely as the garden of Eden that he provided. Then Zion will celebrate; it will be thankful and sing joyful songs. The Lord's Victory Will Last
translation_verse: Ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ lolo basa nɛ b wɔ Jerusalɛm be alambure to na n wushi bumo kagbene. Jerusalɛm ka ki fanɛ keshishɛrsawule a dese ere gba, meeŋ shin nɛ k ki fanɛ kambɔl nɛ n daŋ nase kumo ketre Iden na. Saŋɛ na so kagbenefuli nɛ kagbenewushi beeŋ baa wɔ ndoŋ, nɛ basa e baa boŋ nshɛ a kpaŋ ma nsaa di ma epaŋ.”

english_verse: The Lord says: You are my people and nation! So pay attention to me. My teaching will cause justice to shine like a light for every nation.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ le: “Ma basa, men nu nfe! Men nu kusɔ nɛ mee kaŋɛ ere! Ma e naa ta ma keŋini a sa efuli pɔtɛana na; nɛ ma mbraana malɛ bee shin nɛ baa pin ma.

english_verse: Those who live across the sea are eagerly waiting for me to rescue them. I am strong and ready; soon I will come to save and to rule all nations.
translation_verse: Meeŋ nya manaŋ m ba mɔlga bumo; ŋkpal manɛ so, ma kekɔmpɔɔso be jemanɛ taga to. Efuliana nɛ a wɔ keplasawule so kufɔ kufɔ na bee keni ma ekpa nna; ŋkpal manɛ so, baa tama fanɛ meeŋ baa mɔlga bumo nseŋ ji kuwura bumo so nna.

english_verse: Look closely at the sky! Stare at the earth. The sky will vanish like smoke; the earth will wear out like clothes. Everyone on this earth will die like flies. But my victory will last; my saving power never ends.
translation_verse: Men to anishi ŋ keni awɔlpa nɛ kasawule kikɛ so! Awɔlpa beeŋ choŋ fanɛ edishi, nɛ kasawule e baŋɛ to fanɛ kusɔbuuso dra ka kpɛa to na. Basa kikɛ beeŋ wu n dese kasawule fanɛ ashushombi firgiso na. Ama ma kumɔlga beeŋ baa wɔtɔ mbaanaayɔ. Ma kekɔmpɔɔso maaŋ fo ekar kikɛ.

english_verse: If you want to do right and obey my teaching with all your heart, then pay close attention. Don't be discouraged when others insult you and say hurtful things.
translation_verse: Menyi nɛ men nyi kusɔ nɛ k daga kewora na e nu nfe! Menyi nɛ men kɔ ma keŋini menyi be ŋgbene to na gba e nu nfe! Men sa maa ŋana basa nɛ baa tege menyi nsaa kaŋɛ menyi asheŋbesaso na.

english_verse: They will be eaten away like a moth-eaten coat. But my victory will last; my saving power will never end. A Prayer for the Lord's Help
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, baaŋ foe menyi be anishi so fanɛ kaŋkaŋ ka ji wajɛ m mur nɛ esa maaŋ naŋ wu kumo na. Ama ma kumɔlga beeŋ baa wɔtɔ mbaanaayɔ. Nɛ ma kekɔmpɔɔso be eleŋ na malɛ e baa wɔtɔ saŋkama.”

english_verse: Didn't you dry up the deep sea and make a road for your people to follow safely across?
translation_verse: Fo e shin nɛ teku peper chiŋgeliŋ na baŋɛ to, nseŋ shin nɛ ekpa dese nchu na to n sa basa nɛ fo mɔlga na nɛ b bɔla to n dii.

english_verse: Now those you have rescued will return to Jerusalem, singing on their way. They will be crowned with great happiness, never again to be burdened with sadness and sorrow. The Lord Gives Hope
translation_verse: Naniere bre basa nɛ fo kɔ n suge na beeŋ bɛta n yɔ Jerusalɛm to nɛ kagbenewushi, baaŋ baa boŋ nshɛ kagbenefuliso nna a yɔ ndoŋ. Bumo be ŋgbene beeŋ fuli bumo mbaanaayɔ. Kagbenejija nɛ kebɔltofinfin maaŋ naŋ pɛ bumo.

english_verse: I am the Lord, the one who encourages you. Why are you afraid of mere humans? They dry up and die like grass.
translation_verse: Ade be kaman, nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ naŋ kaŋɛ le: “Ma e naa leŋ menyi to a wushi menyi kagbene. Nɛ manɛ nna nɛ menyee ŋana edimɛdi bomin? B maa chɛr nsaa wu a mur fanɛ afitiri.

english_verse: I spread out the heavens and laid foundations for the earth. But you have forgotten me, your Lord and Creator. All day long you were afraid of those who were angry and hoped to oppress you. Where are they now?
translation_verse: Men teŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ e to menyi nseŋ to esoso nɛ kasawule kikɛ na so nna a? Nɛ manɛ nna nɛ menyee ŋana kufu ŋkpal basa nɛ baa kɔrfɛ menyi nsaa sha kemur menyi agbo so na? Bumo be kanya agbo maaŋ tiŋ n wora menyi shɛŋ.

english_verse: Everyone crying out in pain will be quickly set free; they will be rescued from the power of death and never go hungry.
translation_verse: K maaŋ chɛr nɛ bekama nɛ b wɔ kabuti to, nɛ kebaawɔtɔ du bumo so kpakpa na e nya bumo be amu a ji. Baaŋ baa wɔtɔ n chɛr kebaawɔtɔ to, bumo alɛ maaŋ fin kusɔ jiso ŋ gben kikɛ.

english_verse: I will help them because I am your God, the Lord All-Powerful, who makes the ocean roar.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, ma e la Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na. Ma e naa shin nɛ teku bee baga to nsaa ku atili a wora awɔr. Ma ketre e la Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ!

english_verse: I have told you what to say, and I will keep you safe in the palm of my hand. I spread out the heavens and laid foundations for the earth. Now I say, “Jerusalem, your people are mine.” A Warning to Jerusalem
translation_verse: Ma e ŋini menyi kamalga nseŋ ta ma enɔana a kuŋ menyi. Ma nɛ n to esoso nɛ kasawule na e kaŋɛ basa nɛ b wɔ Jerusalɛm to fanɛ b la ma basa nna!” Jerusalɛmebi be awurfoŋ be ekar be asheŋ

english_verse: Jerusalem, wake up! Stand up! You've drunk too much from the cup filled with the Lord's anger. You have swallowed every drop, and you can't walk straight.
translation_verse: Jerusalɛm to ebi, men koso! Kasogberge nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nya agbo n shin nɛ k ba menyi so na shi ga. Kasogberge na shin nna nɛ menyee nite a lente fanɛ basa nɛ b boo nsa na.

english_verse: Not one of your many children is there to guide you or to offer a helping hand.
translation_verse: Esa kikɛ maŋ wɔtɔ nɛ e pɛ menyi enɔ to n juŋkpar menyi ŋko n chɛ menyi to.

english_verse: The Lord your God is angry, and on every street corner your children lie helpless, like deer trapped in nets.
translation_verse: Menyi be basa bee bɛlɛ nna a tɔr ashi kegbembi be kukɔlɔbi kama to. B ki fanɛ echibir nɛ bekpampo sho ajigbelɛ m pɛ nna. Bumo alɛ pin kananɛ Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ be agbo du kashenteŋto.

english_verse: You are in trouble and drunk, but not from wine. So pay close attention
translation_verse: Menyi Jerusalɛm to be basa nɛ menyee ji awurfoŋ nsaa nite a lente fanɛ men ka nuu nsa m boo na e nu nfe!

english_verse: to the Lord your God, who defends you and says, “I have taken from your hands the cup filled with my anger that made you drunk. You will never be forced to drink it again.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ nɛ e bee kuŋ menyi na e kaŋɛ le: “Mee lara kasogberge nɛ n nya agbo n shin nɛ k ba menyi so na nna na. M maaŋ naŋ gberge menyi kusoe n shin nɛ men baa nite a lente fanɛ basa nɛ b boo nsa na.

english_verse: Instead I will give it to your brutal enemies, who treated you like dirt and walked all over you.”
translation_verse: Ama meeŋ shin nɛ kasogberge na e ba basa nɛ b kɔrfɛ menyi nseŋ shin nɛ men dese agbembi so, nɛ baa chichi menyi so fanɛ shishɛr na so.”

english_verse: Jerusalem, wake up! Stand up and be strong. Holy city of Zion, dress in your best clothes. Those foreigners who ruined your sacred city won't bother you again.
translation_verse: Jerusalɛm to ebi, men tiŋi edi to! Men koso n yili ŋ kpeŋ menyi be eyur to! Ebɔrɛ be kade cheembi to ebi, men ta menyi be asɔbuuso lela m buu! Nnyamase nɛ b shi efuli pɔtɛana so na maaŋ naŋ luri menyi be kadegboŋ to n tɔrɔ menyi kikɛ.

english_verse: Zion, rise from the dirt! Free yourself from the rope around your neck. Suffering Will End
translation_verse: Jerusalɛm to ebi, men lar menyi be asheŋ lubi to! Men lar men be asheŋ lubi nɛ a du fanɛ efɔl ŋkre menyi be ebɔ to na to.

english_verse: The Lord says: My people, you were sold, but not for money; now you will be set free, but not for a payment.
translation_verse: Kede be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ mbe basa le: “Men ka daa la anya na, esa kikɛ daa maaŋ ka shɛŋ n tɔ menyi. Amoso, esa maaŋ ka shɛŋ nɛ men nya menyi be amu a ji.

english_verse: and now another nation has taken you prisoner for no reason at all. Your leaders groan with pain, and day after day my own name is cursed.
translation_verse: Naniere aloŋ e naaŋ wora ashi Babilɔn be efuli so gba. Men la anya nna, ama b maŋ ka shɛŋ n tɔ menyi. Bekama nɛ baa ji kuwura menyi so na bee puchi nna nsaa wu bumo be amu a wɔtɔ ma a keni ma jiga.

english_verse: My people, you will learn who I am and who is speaking because I am here. A Message of Hope for Jerusalem
translation_verse: Jemanɛ ko bee ba nɛ men pin fanɛ ma e la Ebɔrɛ nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ menyi asheŋ ere kikɛ pɔɛŋ nɛ a wora.”

english_verse: Everyone on guard duty, sing and celebrate! Look! You can see the Lord returning to Zion.
translation_verse: Bekama nɛ baa keni kadegboŋ na so a kuŋ kumo na, ber abar so nna a wora awɔr kagbenefuliso B wu fanɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bɛta a ba Jerusalɛm to nna.

english_verse: Jerusalem, rise from the ruins! Join in the singing. The Lord has given comfort to his people; he comes to your rescue.
translation_verse: Menyi Jerusalɛmebi nɛ menyi be kade daŋ bure a dese na, e baa wora awɔr kagbenefuliso! Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ kɔ m mɔlga mbe kadegboŋ nseŋ lolo mbe basa.

english_verse: The Lord has shown all nations his mighty strength; now everyone will see the saving power of our God. A Command To Leave Babylon
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ ta mbe eleŋgboŋ m mɔlga mbe basa ashi bumo doŋana be enɔ to, saŋɛ na so durnya to ebi kikɛ beeŋ wu kumo.

english_verse: Leave the city of Babylon! Don't touch anything filthy. Wash yourselves. Be ready to carry back everything sacred that belongs to the Lord.
translation_verse: Menyi kikɛ nɛ menyee sulɔ bɔrɛlambu na to be asɔ na, e lar kadegboŋ nɛ baa tre Babilɔn na to. Men sa maŋ kaŋ beta keyurpisɔ kikɛ n wora eyurpi daŋkare be ekpa so. Menyi alɛ e bɛr nchu a du farfarbi pɔɛŋ nseŋ lar ndoŋ.

english_verse: You won't need to run. No one is chasing you. The Lord God of Israel will lead and protect you from enemy attacks. The Suffering Servant
translation_verse: Ama men sa maŋ kuse n lar ndoŋ. Ŋkpal manɛ so, esa kama maa ju a buu menyi so. Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na e naaŋ baa juŋkpar menyi, nsaa kuŋ menyi kaba kama so ashi men doŋana be enɔ to. Kayɛrbi nɛ e bee ji awurfoŋ na be asheŋ

english_verse: Many were horrified at what happened to him. But everyone who saw him was even more horrified because he suffered until he no longer looked human.
translation_verse: Basa damta nɛ b wu mo be nnɔ daŋ mɔ bumo nna. Mbe kayurwule daŋ chɛrga nna ŋkpal awurfoŋ nɛ e ji so; e daŋ maŋ naŋ duli dimɛdi gba kuraa.

english_verse: Has anyone believed us or seen the mighty power of the Lord in action?
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ basa na malɛ bishi le: “Wanɛ e naaŋ yirda kubɔya nɛ anyee nu ere? Wanɛ e daŋ wu Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be eleŋgboŋ ka shuŋ le?

english_verse: Like a young plant or a root that sprouts in dry ground, the servant grew up obeying the Lord. He wasn't some handsome king. Nothing about the way he looked made him attractive to us.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na gbagba be keparso nɛ mbe kenya daŋ ki fanɛ kusɔduuso nɛ k mur achin kasawule wɔlso so. E daa maŋ walɛ keyɛrbi ŋko a la esagboŋ ko nɛ basa nyi mbe asheŋ ŋko a keni mo a bɔlɔ kenishi. Mbe kapɔr be shɛŋ daa maa par basa, nɛ k shin nɛ basa e baa firgi a taga mo to.

english_verse: He was hated and rejected; his life was filled with sorrow and terrible suffering. No one wanted to look at him. We despised him and said, “He is a nobody!”
translation_verse: Ekama daŋ keni mo jiga nna nseŋ kini mo n lɛ. Kagbenejija nɛ ebesa damta e daŋ bɔlɔ mo to, nɛ mo alɛ ji kanyiti nseŋ sɔ amo kikɛ n deŋi mbe kumu so. Ekama daa maa sha kewu mo kenishiso gba. B daŋ wu mo nna fanɛ esa jiga.

english_verse: He suffered and endured great pain for us, but we thought his suffering was punishment from God.
translation_verse: Ama e sɔ anyi be awurfoŋ nɛ ebesa kikɛ n deŋi mbe kumu so. Ade kikɛ to, an daa fɛ nna fanɛ Ebɔrɛ e naa gberge mo kusoe.

english_verse: He was wounded and crushed because of our sins; by taking our punishment, he made us completely well.
translation_verse: Anyi ere be asheŋ lubi so nɛ b beri mo nɛ e doro. Kasogberge nɛ e nya na so nɛ an nya kayurwushi nɛ mbe edoro na malɛ shin nɛ an nya kechɛ.

english_verse: All of us were like sheep that had wandered off. We had each gone our own way, but the Lord gave him the punishment we deserved.
translation_verse: Anyi kikɛ daa du fanɛ mbolpɔ nɛ b yeŋ n foe n luri to nna. Ekama daŋ sɔ mbe ekpa nna a yɔ. Ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na daŋ shin nna nɛ anyi be kasogberge ba mbe kenya so.

english_verse: He was painfully abused, but he did not complain. He was silent like a lamb being led to the butcher, as quiet as a sheep having its wool cut off.
translation_verse: Awurfoŋ nɛ ebesa damta daŋ ba mo so, ama e daŋ lo to boeŋ nna, a maŋ fubel. E daŋ lo to fanɛ kpakpafɔlbi nɛ b gberge a yɔ nɛ b ya mɔ nna. Mo alɛ nseŋ daa du fanɛ kubolpɔ nɛ baa kuya kumo be afuibi nɛ k dese boeŋ nna, e maŋ wora shɛŋ.

english_verse: He was condemned to death without a fair trial. Who could have imagined what would happen to him? His life was taken away because of the sinful things my people had done.
translation_verse: B daŋ pɛ mo nseŋ ji mo demu nɛ k maŋ niŋi. Kumo be kaman nɛ b kaŋɛ fanɛ e daga b mɔ mo; mbe asheŋ malɛ daa maŋ tir esa kikɛ. B daŋ mɔ mo nna ŋkpal anyi be basa be asheŋ lubi so.

english_verse: He wasn't dishonest or violent, but he was buried in a tomb among cruel, rich people.
translation_verse: E daŋ maŋ wora kulubi kikɛ ŋko ŋ ku efɛ ŋ ku so, ama b daŋ mɔ mo nna m puli mo kakpa nɛ baa puli alubiworapoana nɛ damawuraana.”

english_verse: The Lord decided his servant would suffer as a sacrifice to take away the sin and guilt of others. Now the servant will live to see his own descendants. He did everything the Lord had planned.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ le: “Ma keparso nɛ ma kenya bee ji awurfoŋ. Mbe luwu na la sarga nɛ k beeŋ bar alubi be ketampaŋ m ba sa basa pɔtɛ nna. Amoso e beeŋ naŋ wu mbe kaman to ebi kenishiso nsaa wɔ ŋkpa to n chɛr. Mo so nɛ kusɔ nɛ ŋ kre kikɛ beeŋ wora m bɔlɔ so nɛnɛ.

english_verse: By suffering, the servant will learn the true meaning of obeying the Lord. Although he is innocent, he will take the punishment for the sins of others, so that many of them will no longer be guilty.
translation_verse: Awurfoŋ nɛ e beeŋ ji na be kaman, e beeŋ naŋ nya kagbenewushi nseŋ pin fanɛ e maŋ gben jiga. Ma kenya nɛ e bee shuŋ ma kagbene koŋwuleso nɛ ma kagbene bee fuli mo so na e naaŋ sɔ basa galeŋga be kasogberge n deŋi mbe kumu so, nɛ ŋ kpal mo so n ta bumo be alubi m paŋ bumo.

english_verse: The Lord will reward him with honor and power for sacrificing his life. Others thought he was a sinner, but he suffered for our sins and asked God to forgive us.
translation_verse: Amoso meeŋ sa mo kemaŋkuragboŋ nɛ eleŋgboŋ. E shuli so n ta mbe kumu n lara sarga, nseŋ yili alubiworapoana damta be aya to ŋ kule alubi be ketampaŋ n sa bumo.”

english_verse: Sing and shout, even though you have never had children! The Lord has promised that you will have more children than someone married for a long time.
translation_verse: Jerusalɛm, fo daa du fanɛ egbentepo nna, ama naniere feeŋ tiŋ m boŋ nshɛ kagbenefuliso Naniere bre feeŋ nya mbia damta a chɔ eche kurgepo nɛ e kɔ ekul gba.

english_verse: Make your tents larger! Spread out the tent pegs; fasten them firmly.
translation_verse: Kpalga wajɛbu nɛ fo wɔtɔ to na, nseŋ teŋi amo be efɔlana so nseŋ naŋ lɔŋɛ kumo be ayir ŋ gbir nɛnɛ!

english_verse: You and your descendants will take over the land of other nations. You will settle in towns that are now in ruins.
translation_verse: Fo nɛ fo kaman to ebi beeŋ sɔ efuli pɔtɛana be nsawule ŋ ki menyeya; nseŋ pɔr n chena bumo be nde nɛ e bure a dese naniere na to.

english_verse: Don't be afraid or ashamed and don't be discouraged. You won't be disappointed. Forget how sinful you were when you were young; stop feeling ashamed for being left a widow.
translation_verse: Men sa maa ŋana kufu ŋko anishinyɔr. Menyi alɛ e sa maŋ pɔ aba kikɛ. Men teŋ menyi be kebifɔlbi to be asheŋ lubi na so. Men sa maŋ shin nɛ menyi be kebaawɔtɔ nɛ k du fanɛ ekulpoche be kebaawɔtɔ na e baa keta menyi nyɔmɔ.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful, the Holy God of Israel, rules all the earth. He is your Creator and husband, and he will rescue you.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so menyi be etopo na beeŋ baa la fanɛ ekul n sa menyi. Mo e la Enyɛnpetale, Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ cheembi na. E beeŋ mɔlga menyi. Mo e naa ji kuwura durnya kikɛ so na.

english_verse: You were like a young wife, brokenhearted and crying because her husband had divorced her. But the Lord your God says, “I am taking you back!
translation_verse: Menyi, Israɛlebi, du fanɛ eche fɔlbi nɛ mo kul kini mo nɛ e bee shu kagbenejijaso nna. Ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naŋ tre menyi m ba, nsaa kaŋɛ menyi le:

english_verse: I rejected you for a while, but with love and tenderness I will embrace you again.
translation_verse: “N daŋ kplaŋ menyi so jemanɛ gbrɛbi ko nna, ama ŋkpal ma kashagboŋ nɛ kushuso so, meeŋ naŋ bɛta n sɔ menyi.

english_verse: For a while, I turned away in furious anger. Now I will have mercy and love you forever! I, your protector and Lord, make this promise.” The Lord Promises Lasting Peace
translation_verse: N daŋ nya agbo nna m pal kaman n sa menyi jemanɛ gbrɛbi ko, ama meeŋ naaŋ wu menyi kuwɔr nseŋ sha menyi mbaanaayɔ. Kusɔ nɛ ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, nɛ n la menyi be emɔlgapo na bee kaŋɛ menyi nna na.”

english_verse: I once promised Noah that I would never again destroy the earth by a flood. Now I have promised that I will never again get angry and punish you.
translation_verse: “Nowa be jemanɛ na, ma Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na daŋ nase kɔnɔ fanɛ m maaŋ naŋ ta nchu m mur durnya. Mee nase kɔnɔ naniere nna fanɛ m maaŋ naŋ nya agbo ŋ gberge menyi kusoe.

english_verse: Every mountain and hill may disappear. But I will always be kind and merciful to you; I won't break my agreement to give your nation peace. The New Jerusalem
translation_verse: Abeegboŋ nɛ abeebi beeŋ tiŋ m bure n tɔr, ama kasha nɛ ŋ kɔ n sa menyi maaŋ loge kikɛ. Meeŋ bɛ kɔnɔ nɛ n naseso ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ meeŋ sa menyi kayurwushi na so mbaanaayɔ. Kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, nɛ mee sha menyi na kaŋɛ nna na.” Jerusalɛm popɔr na be asheŋ

english_verse: Jerusalem, you are sad and discouraged, tossed around in a storm. But I, the Lord, will rebuild your city with precious stones; for your foundation I will use blue sapphires.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na yɛ: “O Jerusalɛm be kadegboŋ nɛ fee ji awurfoŋ nsaa maa kɔ echɛtopo, nɛ esa nɛ e bee lolo fo; meeŋ ta yawu kpakpaso be ajembu lela n tɔl fo gbaltɔlase.

english_verse: I will teach your children and make them successful.
translation_verse: Ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na gbagba e naŋ ŋini fo basa asheŋ, nseŋ sa bumo kedama nɛ kayurwushi damta.

english_verse: I will never send anyone to attack your city, and you will make prisoners of those who do attack.
translation_verse: M maaŋ naŋ shin nɛ esa kikɛ e kɔ kena ashi fo kadegboŋ na to. Bekama nɛ baaŋ kɔ menyi kena maaŋ tiŋ m pɔɔ menyi so kikɛ.

english_verse: Don't forget that I created metalworkers who make weapons over burning coals. I also created armies that can bring destruction.
translation_verse: Ma e to bɔyɛpo nɛ e bee puga edɛ a ŋalga abɛlso a lɔŋɛ akɔsɔ. Ma alɛ e to enapo nɛ e bee ta akɔsɔ na a kɔ kena a mɔ basa.

english_verse: Weapons made to attack you won't be successful; words spoken against you won't hurt at all. My servants, Jerusalem is yours! I, the Lord, promise to bless you with victory.
translation_verse: Ama kekɔsɔ kama maaŋ tiŋ n wora fo shɛŋ. Fo alɛ beeŋ nya kusɔ ko ŋ kaŋɛ bekama nɛ baaŋ ku fo kɔnɔ. Meeŋ kɔ n sa ma anya nseŋ shin nɛ b kɔ m pɔɔ so.” Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ e kaŋɛ na.

english_verse: If you are thirsty, come and drink water! If you don't have any money, come, eat what you want! Drink wine and milk without paying a cent.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ yɛ: “Ekama nɛ achukoŋ kɔ mo e ba nuu nchu! Ekama nɛ e maŋ kɔ amansherbi gba e ba tɔ ajibi n ji! Men ba tɔ yabra nɛ kenyipochu n nuu nsaa maŋ ka shɛŋ!

english_verse: Why waste your money on what really isn't food? Why work hard for something that doesn't satisfy? Listen carefully to me, and you will enjoy the very best foods.
translation_verse: Manɛ nna nɛ menyee jija amansherbi asɔ nɛ a maŋ la ajibi so? Manɛ nna nɛ menyee shuŋ ga a fin asɔ nɛ a maaŋ chɛ menyi to? Men nu asɔ nɛ mee kaŋɛ menyi ere nseŋ wora amo nseŋ nya ajibi kikɛ to be alela n ji.

english_verse: I made him the leader and ruler of the nations; he was my witness to them.
translation_verse: Ma e daŋ shin nɛ e ki efuliana na be ejuŋkparpo nɛ ewura, nseŋ bɔla mo so ŋ ŋini bumo ma eleŋgboŋ.

english_verse: You will call out to nations you have never known. And they have never known you, but they will come running because I am the Lord, the holy God of Israel, and I have honored you. God's Words Are Powerful
translation_verse: To, menyeeŋ kela a tre efuli pɔtɛana nɛ menyi maŋ nyi bumo be basa gba fanɛ b ba ti menyi so, nɛ b shile m ba buu menyi! Ma, Enyɛnpe, Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ cheembi na e naaŋ shin nɛ ade kikɛ e wora m bɔlɔ so. Meeŋ shin nɛ men nya kemaŋkura nɛ bunyaŋ ashi basa kikɛ to.”

english_verse: Turn to the Lord! He can still be found. Call out to God! He is near.
translation_verse: Men fin Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nseŋ kule mo saŋɛ nɛ e taga menyi to ere.

english_verse: Give up your evil ways and your evil thoughts. Return to the Lord our God. He will be merciful and forgive your sins.
translation_verse: Kumu kpakpasowuraana, men lar menyi be asheŋ lubi to nseŋ chɛrga menyi be nfɛra lubi nɛ menyee fɛ na. Men bɛta m ba Enyɛnpe anyi be Ebɔrɛ na kutɔ, mo e la ewɔrwupo nsaa nya manaŋ a ta alubi a paŋ na.

english_verse: Just as the heavens are higher than the earth, my thoughts and my ways are higher than yours.
translation_verse: Kananɛ ebɔrɛso wɔ esoso a chɔ kasawule so na, aloŋ nɛ ma kasheŋwora nɛ nfɛra fɛso chɔ menyi peya.

english_verse: “Rain and snow fall from the sky. But they don't return without watering the earth that produces seeds to plant and grain to eat.
translation_verse: Ma mmalga du fanɛ bunyaŋ nɛ bɔrɛchu nɛ a bee shi awɔlpa to a ba, a shin nɛ kasawule so bee nya kayul nna. Kananɛ bunyaŋ nɛ bɔrɛchu bee shin nɛ basa bee nya a ji nsaa nya asɔduuso a du na,

english_verse: That's how it is with my words. They don't return to me without doing everything I send them to do.” God's People Will Celebrate
translation_verse: aloŋ nɛ ma kɔnɔ to be mmalga gba du. Kusɔ kama nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ, aloŋ gbagba e naa wora.

english_verse: When you are set free, you will celebrate and travel home in peace. Mountains and hills will sing as you pass by, and trees will clap.
translation_verse: Kagbenefuli nɛ menyeeŋ ta n lar Babilɔn be efuli so, nseŋ lar kadegboŋ na to nɛ kayurwushi. Abeegboŋ nɛ abeebi beeŋ baa boŋ nshɛ a sa menyi, nɛ ndibi malɛ e baa kpla enɔ a wɔtɔ.

english_verse: Cypress and myrtle trees will grow in fields once covered by thorns. And then those trees will stand as a lasting witness to the glory of the Lord.
translation_verse: Ndibi sɔrso beeŋ kɔr n yili mboŋ nɛ ewidibi daa yil, saŋɛ na so k beeŋ baa la tɔɔnɛ a dese mbaanaayɔ. Kumo alɛ beeŋ naa la kanyiŋi a laŋɛ kusɔ nɛ ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na wora be kaplɛa so.”

english_verse: The Lord said: Be honest and fair! Soon I will come to save you; my saving power will be seen everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ mbe basa le: “Men baa wora kusɔ nɛ k daga nseŋ bɔla ekpa, ŋkpal manɛ so, k maaŋ chɛr nɛ m ba mɔlga menyi.

english_verse: Then you will be like monuments in my temple with your names written on them. This will be much better than having children, because these monuments will stand there forever.
translation_verse: kumo ere baaŋ baa nyiŋi fo ketre ma bɔrɛlambu to nɛ ma basa to n chɛr a chɔ fo ka beeŋ baa kɔ mbia gba. Basa maaŋ teŋ fo so kikɛ.”

english_verse: Foreigners will follow me. They will love me and worship in my name; they will respect the Sabbath and keep our agreement.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ befɔ nɛ b ti mbe basa so a sha mo nsaa bɛ kewushiachɛ na so nseŋ naa bɛ mbe kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre na so kashenteŋto na le:

english_verse: I will bring them to my holy mountain, where they will celebrate in my house of worship. Their sacrifices and offerings will always be welcome on my altar. Then my house will be known as a house of worship for all nations.
translation_verse: “Meeŋ bar menyi ma kebee cheembi nɛ baa tre Zayɔn nɛ k wɔ Jerusalɛm na so m ba sa menyi kagbenewushi ashi ma bɔrɛlambu to. Ma alɛ beeŋ sɔ menyi be esarga nɛ menyeeŋ lara ashi ma bɔrɛsure so. Ma bɔrɛlambu beeŋ baa la kabɔrɛkule be kakpa n sa efuli kama so be basa.”

english_verse: I, the Lord, promise to bring together my people who were taken away, and let them join the others. God Promises To Punish Israel's Leaders
translation_verse: Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ nɛ e keta mbe basa Israɛlebi n shi kenyaya to ashi efuli pɔtɛ wɔfɔ so m ba na e nase kɔnɔ fanɛ e beeŋ bar basa pɔtɛ m ba ti bumo so. Ebɔrɛ ka beeŋ gberge Israɛl be bejuŋkparpo kusoe be asheŋ

english_verse: Come from the forest, you wild animals! Attack and gobble up your victims.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e kaŋɛ efuli pɔtɛana so ebi fanɛ b ba fanɛ kupuŋ to be asɔbɔya lubi m ba mur mbe basa.

english_verse: You leaders of Israel should be watchdogs, protecting my people. But you can't see a thing, and you never warn them. Dozing and daydreaming are all you ever do.
translation_verse: E yɛ: “Bejuŋkparpo nɛ b daga kekpele ma basa kusoe na kikɛ tan nna! B maŋ nyi shɛŋ. B du fanɛ njɔnɔ nɛ b maa gbu nna. Bumo peya e la kebaadese a di a ku edare. Baa sha edi nna ga!

english_verse: You stupid leaders are a pack of hungry and greedy dogs that never get enough. You are shepherds who mistreat your own sheep for selfish gain.
translation_verse: Bejuŋkparpo na du fanɛ njɔnɔ nɛ baa sha ajibi ga nna. B maa ji a moɛ kikɛ. Bumo alɛ maa pin asheŋ to nsaa wɔtɔ a wora asheŋ nɛ a bee par bumo nawule.

english_verse: You say to each other, “Let's drink till we're drunk! Tomorrow we'll do it again. We'll really enjoy ourselves.”
translation_verse: Kusɔ nɛ basa nɛ baa boo nsa bee kaŋɛ e la fanɛ men shin nɛ an ya nuu nsa m boo kananɛ anyee sha. Echefo peya e baa chɔ kabre peya!”

english_verse: God's faithful people are dragged off and killed, and no one even cares. Evil sweeps them away,
translation_verse: Basa niŋiso bee wu nɛ ekama malɛ be shɛŋ maŋ wɔtɔ bumo to. Ama nɛ b baŋ wu malɛ b maŋ naa luri alubi to.

english_verse: but in death they find peace for obeying God. The Lord Condemns Idolatry
translation_verse: Bekama nɛ b wɔ kebaawɔtɔ lela to bee nya kayurwushi nɛ ewushi ashi luwu to nna ŋkpal b ka daa wora Ebɔrɛ kasonu so.

english_verse: You people are unfaithful! You go to fortunetellers, and you worship idols. Now pay close attention!
translation_verse: Belubiworapoana ere, men ba nfe nɛ b ji menyi demu! Menyi nɛ bekpalpo nɛ kubojuajiwuraana nɛ esakale kikɛ la kukoŋwule nna.

english_verse: Who are you making fun of? Who are you sneering at? Look how your sins have made fools of you.
translation_verse: Wanɛ nɛ menyee wora eyurto? Wanɛ nɛ menyee mɛr kɔnɔ? Men keni, menyi be alubi shin nɛ men ki bewulpo nna.

english_verse: You have chosen to worship idols made of stone; you have given them offerings of wine and grain. Should I be pleased?
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman menyee ta elɔr be epun to be ajembu mɔlmɔlbi nna a ki agbir, nsaa ta nsa nɛ ajibi a lara esarga a sa amo. Menyee tama fanɛ kumo be loŋ bee par ma nna a?

english_verse: You have spread out your beds on the tops of high mountains, where you sacrifice to idols.
translation_verse: Menyee yɔ abee jeŋgreŋ so nna n ya kaa lara esarga nsaa di abar keche nɛ kenyɛn ndoŋ.

english_verse: You smear on olive oil and all kinds of perfume to worship the god Molech. You even seek advice from spirits of the dead.
translation_verse: Menyee gbiti ŋku nsaa wora etulale n ya kaa shuŋ kegbir nɛ baa tre Mɔlɛk na nna. Menyi alɛ bee shuŋi mbɔ mboŋ wɔfɔ, hale a yɔ bubuni to nna n ya kaa fin agbirana nɛ menyeeŋ baa shuŋ.

english_verse: Though you tired yourself out by running after idols, you refused to stop. Your desires were so strong that they kept you going.
translation_verse: Menyee gben ga a fin agbir popɔr, ama menyi alɛ maa gben a yige to. Menyee fɛ nna fanɛ menyi be agbirana nɛ amo be asheŋ bee nu ma agbo na e naa sa menyi eleŋ, amoso nɛ menyee sha amo na.

english_verse: Did you forget about me and become unfaithful because you were more afraid of someone else? Have I been silent so long that you no longer fear me?
translation_verse: Ade be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bishi le: “Nuso be agbir e shin nɛ kufu pɛ menyi, nɛ men kpal amo so a ku efɛ nseŋ teŋ ma so kuraa loŋ? Ŋkpal ŋ ka wora shruum n chɛr so nɛ men yige kebaabunyaŋ ma ere a?

english_verse: Ask your idols to save you when you are in trouble. Be careful though— it takes only a faint breath to blow them over. But if you come to me for protection, this land and my holy mountain will always belong to you. The Lord Helps the Helpless
translation_verse: Men kaa shu a fin kechɛto, men shin nɛ menyi be agbirana e mɔlga menyi! Ama afu fimbi e naŋ ber amo n lɛ. Bekama nɛ b yirda ma e naaŋ chena kasawule na so nseŋ shuŋ ma ashi ma bɔrɛlambu to ashi ma kebee cheembi na so.” Ebɔrɛ ka nase kechɛto nɛ kechɛ be kɔnɔ be asheŋ

english_verse: Our holy God lives forever in the highest heavens, and this is what he says: Though I live high above in the holy place, I am here to help those who are humble and depend only on me.
translation_verse: Ma e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ e wɔ ebɔrɛso nsaa wɔtɔ mbaanaayɔ na. N wɔ kakpa cheembi nɛ k wɔ esoso nna, ama ma alɛ nɛ basa nɛ b bar bumo be amu kaseto nseŋ ta bumo be amu n deŋi ma so na gba e wɔtɔ nɛ m baa chɛ bumo to.

english_verse: My people, I won't stay angry and keep on accusing you. After all, I am your Creator. I don't want you to give up in complete despair.
translation_verse: M maaŋ naaŋ nya agbo n wɔtɔ ma basa a wu bumo kulubi mbaanaayɔ. Ŋkpal manɛ so, ma e to bumo nsaa maa sha fanɛ bumo be aba e pɔ bumo.

english_verse: Your greed made me furious. That's why I punished you and refused to be found, while you kept returning to your old sinful ways.
translation_verse: N daŋ nya agbo ga nna n wora bumo ŋkpal bumo be alubi nɛ kejimuni be kebaawɔtɔ so, amoso nɛ n daŋ gberge bumo kusoe nseŋ daŋ kplaŋ bumo so na. Ama b kraŋ wora kusoe kpakpaso ŋ kini a wɔ bumo be asheŋ lubi na to.

english_verse: I know what you are like! But I will heal you, lead you, and give you comfort, until those who are mourning
translation_verse: N wu asheŋ nɛ b wora na kikɛ, ama ŋ kraa beeŋ chɛ bumo be alɔ. Ma alɛ beeŋ juŋkpar bumo nseŋ chɛ bumo to nseŋ naŋ lolo bekama nɛ baa shu nli na,

english_verse: start singing my praises. No matter where you are, I, the Lord, will heal you and give you peace.
translation_verse: nɛ b fara a boŋ nshɛ a kpaŋ ma. Meeŋ shin nɛ bekama nɛ b taga to nɛ bumo nɛ b wɔ kufɔ kufɔ kikɛ e nya kayurwushi. Ma e naaŋ chɛ ma basa be alɔ kikɛ!

english_verse: But I, the Lord, have promised that none who are evil will live in peace.
translation_verse: Ama ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nase kɔnɔ fanɛ belubiworapoana maaŋ nya kayurwushi kikɛ.”

english_verse: Shout the message! Don't hold back. Say to my people Israel: You've sinned! You've turned against the Lord.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ yɛ: “Boŋ to awɔrso ga ŋ kaŋɛ ma basa Israɛlebi na bumo be alubi be asheŋ!

english_verse: Day after day, you worship him and seem eager to learn his teachings. You act like a nation that wants to do right by obeying his laws. You ask him about justice, and say you enjoy worshiping the Lord.
translation_verse: Baa shuŋ ma karechɛ kikɛ nna a ŋini fanɛ b pere kenishi a sha kepin ma ekpa nseŋ wora ma mbraana kasonu fanɛ efuli nɛ k bee wora kusɔ nɛ k daga. B yɛ n sa bumo mbraana nɛ a maa kpɛa basa to nseŋ naa leŋ bumo to a kaŋɛ fanɛ bumo kebaashuŋ ma na bee wora bumo ebel nna.”

english_verse: Do you think the Lord wants you to give up eating and to act as humble as a bent-over bush? Or to dress in sackcloth and sit in ashes? Is this really what he wants on a day of worship?
translation_verse: Men baŋ kishi kikɛ, menyee ta menyi be amu nna a wɔtɔ awurfoŋ to. Menyi alɛ naa wora asheŋ nna fanɛ bebɔlpo, a kurgi amu a yuu to fanɛ ayu ka bel n chulgi na nseŋ naa buu nli to be asɔbuuso a dese nsunɔ to a ŋini men ka bar menyi be amu kaseto. Le nɛ menyee tre ekishi nɛ k bee par ma nna a?

english_verse: I'll tell you what it really means to worship the Lord. Remove the chains of prisoners who are bound unjustly. Free those who are abused!
translation_verse: Ekishi nɛ k bee par ma a ŋini menyee ka bee shuŋ ma kashenteŋto e la men ka beeŋ lara kanyaŋ nɛ kebaakɔrfɛ basa nɛ b maŋ wora shɛŋ nsaa wɔ kabuti to na nseŋ shin nɛ ekama e nya a wora asheŋ yila yila so.

english_verse: Then your light will shine like the dawning sun, and you will quickly be healed. Your honesty will protect you as you advance, and the glory of the Lord will defend you from behind.
translation_verse: Aloŋ nɛ ma kuwɔrwu beeŋ nyaŋɛ n yuu menyi so fanɛ kachipurso be epeŋi, nɛ menyi alɛ e naaŋ nya menyi be alɔ be kechɛ manaŋ manaŋ. Ma nɛ menyi beeŋ baa wɔtɔ nɛ m baa mɔlga menyi nsaa kuŋ menyi ekpa kama so.

english_verse: When you beg the Lord for help, he will answer, “Here I am!” Don't mistreat others or falsely accuse them or say something cruel.
translation_verse: Nɛ men baŋ kule ma kusɔ kama, meeŋ nu menyi be kekule. Nɛ men tre ma malɛ meeŋ shuli menyi be ketre na! Nɛ men yige kanyaŋ nɛ nfɛlso be kebaawɔtɔ nɛ mmalga lubi be kebaamalga

english_verse: Give your food to the hungry and care for the homeless. Then your light will shine in the dark; your darkest hour will be like the noonday sun.
translation_verse: nsaa sa basa nɛ akoŋ kɔ ajibi nseŋ naa chɛ bumo nɛ asheŋ tir bumo to, kumo ere kanyɛso beeŋ ki fanɛ kapiidi n sa menyi.

english_verse: The Lord will always guide you and provide good things to eat when you are in the desert. He will make you healthy. You will be like a garden that has plenty of water or like a stream that never runs dry.
translation_verse: Ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na malɛ beeŋ baa juŋkpar menyi nsaa sa menyi asɔ lela nɛ a beeŋ baa kukwe menyi jemanɛ kikɛ. Ma alɛ beeŋ baa sa menyi eleŋ nɛ alenfia a ti so. Menyi alɛ beeŋ baa du fanɛ kambɔl nɛ k bee nya nchu nɛnɛ ŋko kabombi nɛ k maa wɔlto kikɛ na nna.

english_verse: But first, you must start respecting the Sabbath as a joyful day of worship. You must stop doing and saying whatever you please on this special day.
translation_verse: Ade kikɛ be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naaŋ kaŋɛ le: “Nɛ men ta kewushiachɛ na fanɛ kachɛ cheembi a maa wora menyi gbagba be aparsheŋ fanɛ kebaayɔ nde ŋko a shuŋ kushuŋ be yiri kikɛ ŋko a malga mmalga jiga loŋ be kachɛ na,

english_verse: Then you will truly enjoy knowing the Lord. He will let you rule from the highest mountains and bless you with the land of your ancestor Jacob. The Lord has spoken!
translation_verse: menyeeŋ nya kagbenefuli nɛ k shi kebaashuŋ ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na to. Meeŋ shin nɛ men nya bunyaŋ ashi durnya be kaplɛkama nɛ menyi alɛ e naŋ ji kasawule nɛ n sa menyi nananyɛn Jeekɔb na be ebel. Ma Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ e kaŋɛ na!”

english_verse: Your sins are the roadblock between you and your God. That's why he doesn't answer your prayers or let you see his face.
translation_verse: Menyi be alubi e barga menyi nɛ men be Ebɔrɛ be kefɛato. Amoso nɛ e maa nu menyi be kabɔrɛkule na.

english_verse: Your talk is filled with lies and plans for violence; every finger on your hands is covered with blood.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, menyi be mmalga kikɛ la efɛsheŋ nna nɛ menyi be ŋkre kikɛ la kebagato nɛ kelantokɔ be asheŋ. Basa be kamɔ damta so, ŋklaŋ gbiti menyi be enɔana nna.

english_verse: You hurry off to do wrong or murder innocent victims. All you think about is sin; you leave ruin and destruction wherever you go.
translation_verse: Jemanɛ kikɛ asheŋ lubi nɛ menyee kre nsaa nya manaŋ a wora amo. Basa nɛ b maŋ wora shɛŋ be kemɔ maŋ du menyi so kpakpa. Basa nɛ asɔ be kejija n lɛ nɛ kemur nɛ menyee yige kaman ashi kaplɛkama nɛ men yɔ.

english_verse: You don't know how to live in peace or to be fair with others. The roads you make are crooked; your followers cannot find peace. The People Confess Their Sins
translation_verse: Menyi maŋ nyi kananɛ menyi nɛ beko beeŋ tiŋ n chena abar so nɛ kayurwushi, ŋko kananɛ baa ji kashenteŋ a sa basa pɔtɛ. Ekpaana nɛ menyee bɔla so a wora asheŋ kikɛ maŋ niŋi nɛ menyi be bebɛsopo malɛ maaŋ tiŋ n nya kayurwushi kebaawɔtɔ to kikɛ. Basa ka bugi to ŋ kaŋɛ bumo be alubi be asheŋ

english_verse: No one has come to defend us or to bring about justice. We hoped for a day of sunshine, but all we found was a dark, gloomy night.
translation_verse: Kede be kaman nɛ basa na kaŋɛ le: “Naniere nɛ an pin kusɔ nɛ k ba nɛ Ebɔrɛ maa mɔlga anyi ashi basa nɛ baa kɔrfɛ anyi na be enɔ to. An daa tama fanɛ anyeeŋ baa na kefulto to nna, ama tentembiri e kulti anyi n wɔtɔ

english_verse: We feel our way along, as if we were blind; we stumble at noon, as if it were night. We can see no better than someone dead.
translation_verse: nɛ anyee la a fin ekpa fanɛ etanpo. Kapiidi gba anyi maa wu ekpa to nsaa fiti fanɛ kanyɛso ŋko fanɛ an ka wɔ nchaŋ to na.

english_verse: We growl like bears and mourn like doves. We hope for justice and victory, but they escape us.
translation_verse: Anyee munto nna fanɛ eshishiri nsaa shu fanɛ ali na. Anyi alɛ daa tama fanɛ Ebɔrɛ beeŋ mɔlga anyi ashi kanyaŋ nɛ alubi to, ama loŋ maŋ wora.

english_verse: How often have we sinned and turned against you, the Lord God? Our sins condemn us! We have done wrong.
translation_verse: An wora alubi damta ŋ gbiti fo, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na. Anyi be alubi bee ji a bri anyi nna, nɛ anyi alɛ nyi amo kikɛ nyam be asheŋ.

english_verse: We have rebelled and refused to follow you. Our hearts were deceitful, and so we lied; we planned to abuse others and turn our backs on you.
translation_verse: An lar fo kaman nseŋ kini fo a maa shuŋ fo. Anyi alɛ kɔrfɛ beko ga nseŋ shile fo. Anyi be nfɛra fɛso gba la kafulesheŋ nna nɛ anyi be mmalga malɛ maŋ la kashenteŋ.

english_verse: Everyone tells lies; those who turn from crime end up ruined. The Lord Will Rescue His People When the Lord noticed that justice had disappeared, he became very displeased.
translation_verse: Kashenteŋji ka maŋ naa wɔtɔ so, bekama nɛ b yige asheŋ lubi be kewora na bee luri asheŋ to nna.” Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ka beeŋ mɔlga mbe basa be asheŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na b kagbene daa maŋ fuli mo ŋkpal keji asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so ka maŋ naa wɔtɔ so.

english_verse: Now the Lord will get furious and do to his enemies, both near and far, what they did to his people.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ gberge mo doŋana nɛ b wɔ kufɔ nɛ bumo nɛ b taga to kikɛ kusoe agbo so, ŋkpal kusɔ nɛ b wora mbe basa so.

english_verse: He will attack like a flood in a mighty windstorm. Nations in the west and the east will then honor and praise his wonderful name.
translation_verse: Yili epeŋilarkpa m ba choŋ epeŋitɔrkpa, ekama beeŋ baa ŋana Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nɛ mbe eleŋgboŋ nseŋ bunyaŋ mo. E beeŋ ba fanɛ lɔr to be nchu nɛ a bee shile eleŋso ŋko afugboŋ nɛ a bee ber eleŋso na.

english_verse: The Lord says: “My people, I promise to give you my Spirit and my message. These will be my gifts to you and your families forever. I, the Lord, have spoken.”
translation_verse: Ma alɛ bee nase kɔnɔ nna fanɛ meeŋ sa menyi ma Kiyoyu nɛ keŋini nɛ a baa wɔ menyi to mbaanaayɔ. Yili kabre a yɔ, menyeeŋ baa wora ma kasonu nsaa ŋini menyi be mbia nɛ kaman to ebi nɛ bumo alɛ gba e baa wora ma kasonu mbaanaayɔ.”

english_verse: Jerusalem, stand up! Shine! Your new day is dawning. The glory of the Lord shines brightly on you.
translation_verse: Jerusalɛmebi, men koso n nyɛkpɛ n fulto fanɛ epeŋi. Karechɛ popɔr bee chɛ menyi so nna na. Ŋkpal manɛ so, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be kemaŋkura nyaŋɛ n yuu menyi so nna!

english_verse: The earth and its people are covered with darkness, but the glory of the Lord is shining upon you.
translation_verse: Tentembiri beeŋ buu durnya nɛ kumo be basa kikɛ so. Ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be kemaŋkura be kefulto beeŋ nyaŋɛ n yuu menyi ere so a ŋini fanɛ e wɔ menyi kutɔ.

english_verse: Nations and kings will come to the light of your dawning day. Crowds Are Coming to Jerusalem The Lord said:
translation_verse: Efuli pɔtɛana be basa nɛ bewura kikɛ beeŋ ba menyi be karechɛ popɔr na be kefulto to.

english_verse: Open your eyes! Look around! Crowds are coming. Your sons are on their way from distant lands; your daughters are being carried like little children.
translation_verse: Men keni ŋ kulti kusɔ nɛ k bee wora ere. Menyi be basa bee gama abar so nna nɛ b bɛta m ba epe! Menyi be mbinyɛnsobi beeŋ shi kufɔ, kufɔ m ba, nɛ b keta menyi be mbichesobi enɔ to fanɛ mbibi m ba sa menyi.

english_verse: When you see this, your faces will glow; your hearts will pound and swell with pride. Treasures from across the sea and the wealth of nations will be brought to you.
translation_verse: Menyi alɛ beeŋ wu loŋ nɛ men be ŋgbene e fuli menyi ga. Kagbenefuli be ga beeŋ shin nɛ men baa chicha. Baaŋ sulɔ efuli pɔtɛana nɛ awɔ teku be kaba ndoŋ na be asɔ lela nɛ kanya m ba sa menyi.

english_verse: Your country will be covered with caravans of young camels from Midian and Ephah. The people of Sheba will bring gold and spices in praise of me, the Lord.
translation_verse: Enyɔma be ntuŋ damta beeŋ shi efuliana nɛ baa tre Midian nɛ Efa na so n sulɔ asɔ lela m ba sɔ menyi be efuli na kikɛ so. Beko beeŋ shi Shiba be kasawule so n sulɔ shuwa nɛ eduwu m ba kaa lara esarga a sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nsaa malga kusɔ nɛ e wora be asheŋ!

english_verse: Every sheep of Kedar will come to you; rams from Nebaioth will be yours as well. I will accept them as offerings and bring honor to my temple.
translation_verse: Baaŋ gama abonfu nɛ baa tre Kɛda nɛ Neboyot na be mbolpɔ kikɛ abar so m ba sa menyi fanɛ esarga. Ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na malɛ beeŋ sɔ amo fanɛ ma bɔrɛsure so be esarga, nseŋ shin nɛ ma bɔrɛlambu e nya kemaŋkura n ti so.

english_verse: What is that sailing by like clouds or like doves flying home?
translation_verse: Manɛ e naa choŋ zii fanɛ awɔlpa, ŋko fanɛ elepɔ ka mel abar so a firgi a yɔ asha to loŋ?

english_verse: On those distant islands your people are waiting for me, the Lord. Seagoing ships lead the way to bring them home with their silver and gold. I, the holy Lord God of Israel, do this to honor your people, so they will honor me. Jerusalem Will Be Rebuilt The Lord said:
translation_verse: Teku so be ekuloŋgboŋ nɛ e shi aplasawule wɔfɔ wɔfɔ so nna. Ebɔrɛ be basa nɛ e sulɔ a ba epe. Bumo alɛ keta bumo be shuwa nɛ gbiti nna a ba. Enyɛnpe Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ cheembi na e shin nɛ loŋ wora nɛ mbe basa e nya kemaŋkura. Saŋɛ na so baaŋ baa shuŋ mo nsaa bunyaŋ mo.

english_verse: Jerusalem, your city walls will be rebuilt by foreigners; their rulers will become your slaves. I punished you in my anger; now I will be kind and treat you with mercy.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ Jerusalɛmebi le: “Befɔ e naaŋ lɔŋɛ menyi be kadegboŋ be egbalana m pɔr, nɛ bumo be bewura e shuŋ menyi be basa. N daŋ nya agbo nna ŋ gberge menyi be basa kusoe, ama naniere meeŋ shu menyi so nseŋ wu menyi kuwɔr.

english_verse: Your gates will be open day and night to let the rulers of nations lead their people to you with all their treasures.
translation_verse: Kapa nɛ kanyɛ menyi be kadegboŋ na be mbunagboŋ beeŋ baa bugi a yili. Saŋɛ na so efuli pɔtɛana be bewura beeŋ juŋkpar bumo be basa n sulɔ bumo be asɔ lela kikɛ m ba sa menyi be basa.

english_verse: Any nation or kingdom that refuses to serve you will be wiped out.
translation_verse: Ama efuli ŋko kuwurji kama be basa nɛ b maaŋ shuŋ menyi be basa kikɛ beeŋ mur cheche kuraa.

english_verse: Wood from Lebanon's best trees will be brought to you— the pines, the firs, and the cypress trees. It will be used in my temple to make beautiful the place where I rest my feet.
translation_verse: Baaŋ ku Lebanɔn be efuli so be ndibi lela m ba lɔŋɛ menyi be kadegboŋ, Jerusalɛm be ebuana m pɔr nseŋ shin nɛ ma bɔrɛlambu e nyalɛ kebita. Saŋɛ na so ma kadegboŋ na gba beeŋ nya kemaŋkura.

english_verse: The descendants of enemies who hated and mistreated you will kneel at your feet. They will say, “You are Zion, the city of the Lord, the holy One of Israel.”
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman, men doŋana be kaman to ebi beeŋ baa jɔŋɛ menyi ase a sa menyi bunyaŋ. Bekama nɛ b daa keni menyi jiga beeŋ fara a bunyaŋ menyi, nsaa tre menyi be kadegboŋ na Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be Kadegboŋ; ŋko Zayɔn, Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ cheembi na be Kadegboŋ.

english_verse: You will drain the wealth of kings and foreign nations. You will know that I, the mighty Lord God of Israel, have saved and rescued you.
translation_verse: Efuli pɔtɛana be bewura nɛ bumo be basa beeŋ ta bumo be asɔ lela ŋ keni menyi be kadegboŋ na so, fanɛ kananɛ ebinio bee bela mbe mbia na. Saŋɛ na so nɛ men pin fanɛ ma, Enyɛnpetale Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na e mɔlga menyi nseŋ sɔ menyi n yige.

english_verse: I will bring bronze and iron in place of wood and stone; in place of bronze and iron, I will bring gold and silver. I will appoint peace and justice as your rulers and leaders.
translation_verse: Meeŋ sa menyi shuwa, mannɛ danyaŋ peper, ŋko gbiti, mannɛ kebɛlso be yiri kama, ŋko danyaŋ peper, mannɛ ndibi, ŋko abɛlso be yiri yiri, mannɛ ajembu. Menyi be bewura maaŋ naa kɔrfɛ menyi be basa. Ma alɛ beeŋ shin nɛ b baa ji kuwura ashi kashenteŋji nɛ kayurwushi be ekpa so.

english_verse: Violence, destruction, and ruin will never again be heard of within your borders. “Victory” will be the name you give to your walls; “Praise” will be the name you give to your gates.
translation_verse: Esa maaŋ naŋ nu nlu kikɛ be asheŋ efuli na so. Menyi be efuli na malɛ maaŋ naŋ mur kikɛ. Meeŋ baa kuŋ menyi ekpa kama so fanɛ egbal na. Saŋɛ na so menyi be basa beeŋ baa kpaŋ ma ŋkpal ŋ ka mɔlga bumo so.

english_verse: You won't need the light of the sun or the moon. I, the Lord your God, will be your eternal light and bring you honor.
translation_verse: Epeŋi nɛ kufɔl be kefulto be asheŋ maaŋ naa tir menyi. Ŋkpal manɛ so, ma Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be kemaŋkura be kefulto e naaŋ baa nyaŋɛ a yuu menyi so mbaanaayɔ.

english_verse: Your sun will never set or your moon go down. I, the Lord, will be your everlasting light, and your days of sorrow will come to an end.
translation_verse: Epeŋi nɛ kufɔl kikɛ maaŋ naŋ tɔr ashi Jerusalɛm to. Ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e naaŋ baa la kumo be kefulto mbaanaayɔ; saŋɛ na so menyi be kebɔltofinfin na kikɛ beeŋ fo ekar.

english_verse: Your people will live right and always own the land; they are the trees I planted to bring praise to me.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ menyi be basa kikɛ e chena kasawule na so nsaa wora kusɔ nɛ k niŋi mbaanaayɔ. B du fanɛ kedibi nɛ ŋ gbagba du ndoŋ nɛ n lara ma keshi ŋ ŋini ekama nna.

english_verse: Even the smallest family will be a powerful nation. I am the Lord, and when the time comes, I will quickly do all this.
translation_verse: Bumo to be kanaŋ fimbi kama beeŋ ki fanɛ efuli nɛ k kɔ eleŋ ga. Ma e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, nɛ jemanɛ na kaŋ fo meeŋ shin nɛ kusɔ nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ na kikɛ e wora manaŋ.”

english_verse: The Spirit of the Lord God has taken control of me! The Lord has chosen and sent me to tell the oppressed the good news, to heal the brokenhearted, and to announce freedom for prisoners and captives.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na be Kiyoyu wɔ ma so. E lara ma nna n nɛfa ma nɛ m bɔ baru lela na n sa betirpo, nseŋ chɛ bumo nɛ kagbenejija tɔr so na. Mo e shuŋi ma nɛ n ya bɔ kesɔnyige be baru n sa bumo nɛ b ki beko be anya, nseŋ sɔ bumo nɛ b wɔ kabuti to n yige.

english_verse: This is the year when the Lord God will show kindness to us and punish our enemies. The Lord has sent me to comfort those who mourn,
translation_verse: E shuŋi ma nna nɛ m ba kaŋɛ basa fanɛ, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be kumɔlga mbe basa nseŋ kɔ m pɔɔ bumo doŋana so be jemanɛ fo. Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na shuŋi ma nna nɛ m ba lolo bumo nɛ baa shu nli,

english_verse: especially in Jerusalem. He sent me to give them flowers in place of their sorrow, olive oil in place of tears, and joyous praise in place of broken hearts. They will be called “Trees of Justice,” planted by the Lord to honor his name.
translation_verse: fɔŋfɔŋ bumo nɛ baa shu nli Jerusalɛm to na. E yɛ, n sa basa kagbenefuli nɛ kagbenewushi; mannɛ kagbenejija damta. E yɛ, n sa bumo kapandi be nshɛ, mannɛ kebɔltofinfin. Baaŋ baa du fanɛ ndibi nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ gbagba duu nna. Bumo kikɛ beeŋ baa wora kusɔ nɛ k daga, nseŋ kpaŋ Ebɔrɛ ŋkpal kusɔ nɛ e wora so.

english_verse: Then they will rebuild cities that have been in ruins for many generations.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ b lɔŋɛ m pɔr ndegboŋ nɛ a bure n dese dra dra na kikɛ na.

english_verse: But they themselves will be priests and servants of the Lord our God. The treasures of the nations will belong to them, and they will be famous.
translation_verse: Ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be basa bre beeŋ baa la Ebɔrɛ be bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ mbe nyɛrbi nna. Efuli pɔtɛana na be kanya nɛ kedama beeŋ ki mbe basa peya nɛ bumo be ketre e dii nɛ b baa puchi amo so.

english_verse: They were terribly insulted and horribly mistreated; now they will be greatly blessed and joyful forever. The Lord Loves Justice
translation_verse: Bumo be anishinyɔr nɛ ŋaba beeŋ fo ekar. Baaŋ chena bumo gbagba be kasawule so nɛ bumo be kanya nɛ kedama e daŋɛ so ntuŋ anyɔ so. Bumo be kagbenewushi beeŋ baa wɔtɔ mbaanaayɔ.

english_verse: I, the Lord, love justice! But I hate robbery and injustice. My people, I solemnly promise to reward you with an eternal agreement.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee sha kebaawora asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so nna. Ama kasuge nɛ kapuni bre, e kishi amo. Mo e nase mbe basa kɔnɔ kashenteŋto fanɛ e beeŋ nɛfa bumo mbaanaayɔ na.

english_verse: Your descendants will be known in every nation. All who see them will realize that they have been blessed, by me, the Lord. Celebrate and Shout
translation_verse: Bumo be ketre beeŋ dii a chɔ efuli pɔtɛana peya. Ekama nɛ e wu bumo beeŋ pin fanɛ b la basa nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛfa nna.

english_verse: I celebrate and shout because of my Lord God. His saving power and justice are the very clothes I wear. They are more beautiful than the jewelry worn by a bride or groom.
translation_verse: Jerusalɛm bre bee ji eyur kagbenefuliso nna ŋkpal kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na wora so. K du fanɛ kejafɔche ka ta mbe kejafɔ to be asɔbuuso m buu mbe kejafɔachɛ na nna. Ebɔrɛ ta kumɔlga nɛ kekɔmpɔɔso m buu Jerusalɛm nna fanɛ piŋi.

english_verse: Jerusalem, I will speak up for your good. I will never be silent till you are safe and secure, sparkling like a flame.
translation_verse: Meeŋ malga n leŋ Jerusalɛmebi to. M maaŋ lo ma kɔnɔ kikɛ, ama b nya kumɔlga nna nɛ bumo be kekɔmpɔɔso e dii efuli fanɛ kabulpi nɛ k chɔɔ so kanyɛso nɛ ekama wu kumo na nna.

english_verse: Your great victory will be seen by every nation and king; the Lord will even give you a new name.
translation_verse: Efuli pɔtɛana na beeŋ wu kananɛ fo, Jerusalɛm kɔ m pɔɔ so! Bumo be bewura kikɛ beeŋ wu fo kemaŋkura. Feeŋ nya ketre popɔr nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ gbagba beeŋ sa na.

english_verse: You will be a glorious crown, a royal headband for the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Feeŋ baa du fanɛ kuwurwuro lela kebita n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.

english_verse: Your people will take the land, just as a young man takes a bride. The Lord will be pleased because of you, just as a husband is pleased with his bride.
translation_verse: Kananɛ kabrantiɛbia bee wora kasuŋgurbia nɛ e maŋ nyi enyɛn kejafɔ a ta mo a ki mbe eche na nɛ Ebɔrɛ nɛ e to fo na gba beeŋ kre fo kejafɔ nɛ fo ki mbe eche. Kananɛ kejafɔ mo kul be kagbene bee fuli mbe kejafɔ so na, nɛ Ebɔrɛ gba be kagbene beeŋ baa fuli fo so.

english_verse: The Lord has given his word and made this promise: “Never again will I give to your enemies the grain and grapes for which you struggled.
translation_verse: Le nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bɔ ntaŋ n nase kɔnɔ ŋ kaŋɛ: “M maaŋ naŋ ta fo ayu n sa fo doŋana fanɛ bumo be kusɔ jiso kikɛ; befɔ malɛ maaŋ naŋ nya yabra nɛ fo gben n wora na n nuu kikɛ.

english_verse: As surely as you harvest your grain and grapes, you will eat your bread with thankful hearts, and you will drink your wine in my temple.”
translation_verse: Ama fo nɛ fo dɔ ayu na n teŋi na e naaŋ ji amo nseŋ di Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ epaŋ ŋkpal amo so. Fo nɛ fo keni ndibi sɔrso na so nseŋ chuge amo be asɔrso na, e naaŋ nu amo be yabra ashi ma bɔrɛlambu be kelɔnɛ so.”

english_verse: Here is what the Lord has said for all the earth to hear: “Soon I will come to save the city of Zion and to reward you.
translation_verse: Kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee kaŋɛ nsaa sha fanɛ durnya to be basa kikɛ e nu nde: “Kaŋɛ basa nɛ b wɔ Jerusalɛm to fanɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee ba nɛ e ba mɔlga bumo. Men keni, basa nɛ e sɔ n yige na nɛ e kɔ a ba.”

english_verse: Then you will be called, ‘The Lord's Own People, The Ones He Rescued!’ Your city will be known as a good place to live and a city full of people.”
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ b baa tre menyi, “Ebɔrɛ be Basa Cheembi.” Ŋko Basa nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na mɔlga. Baaŋ baa tre Jerusalɛm “Kadegboŋ nɛ Ebɔrɛ mɔlga.” Ŋko “Kadegboŋ nɛ basa bɔlɔ kumo to.”

english_verse: Who is this coming from Bozrah in Edom with clothes stained red? Who is this hero marching in his glorious uniform? “It's me, the Lord! I have won the battle, and I can save you!”
translation_verse: Wanɛ e shi Edɔm be efuli so be kadegboŋ nɛ baa tre Bozra na ŋ kre to nɛnɛ m buu epiŋi peper a tia aya eleŋ so a ba ere? Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ e kɔ eleŋ ga nɛ e tiŋ m mɔlga basa na e naa ba nɛ e ba bɔ mbe kekɔmpɔɔso be kubɔya.

english_verse: What are those red spots? Your clothes look stained from trampling on grapes.
translation_verse: “Manɛ e ba nɛ mbe asɔbuuso pere fanɛ esa nɛ e nyaŋ asɔrso nɛ baa tre greeps na n wora yabra loŋ?”

english_verse: “I alone trampled the grapes! None of the nations helped. I trampled nations in my anger and stained my clothes with their blood.
translation_verse: Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ le: “Ma e nyaŋ efuliana na fanɛ asɔrso nɛ baa tre greeps na nɛ esa kikɛ maŋ chɛ ma to. N nya agbo nna n nyaŋ bumo fanɛ asɔrso, nɛ bumo be ŋklaŋ gbiti ma asɔbuuso.

english_verse: I did this because I wanted to take revenge— the time had come to rescue my people.
translation_verse: N wora loŋ nna nɛ m bishi kuwule n sa ma basa ashi bumo doŋana so a ŋini fanɛ jemanɛ fo nɛ m mɔlga bumo.

english_verse: No one was there to help me or to give support; my mighty arm won the battle, strengthened by my anger.
translation_verse: K daŋ chinchiŋ ma nna fanɛ esa kikɛ ka daa maŋ wɔtɔ nɛ e chɛ ma to ŋko n wɔtɔ ma enɔ. Amoso ma agbo e wɔtɔ ma eleŋ n shin nɛ ŋ gbagba kɔ m pɔɔ so.

english_verse: In my fury I trampled on nations and made them drunk; their blood poured out everywhere on earth.” The Lord's Goodness to His People
translation_verse: Agbo so nɛ n daŋ chichi efuli pɔtɛana na so m mata kasawule nseŋ farnyaŋ bumo to n lɛ nɛ bumo be ŋklaŋ lar n wurge kasawule.” Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ka wora Israɛl kelela be asheŋ

english_verse: I will tell about the kind deeds the Lord has done. They deserve praise! The Lord has shown mercy to the people of Israel; he has been kind and good.
translation_verse: Meeŋ malga Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be alelasheŋ be asheŋ nseŋ kpaŋ mo ŋkpal asɔ nɛ e bee wora a sa anyi so. E nɛfa Israɛl be basa ga nna ŋkpal mbe kuwɔrwu nɛ kasha nɛ k wɔtɔ jemanɛ kikɛ na so.

english_verse: The Lord rescued his people, and said, “They are mine. They won't betray me.”
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na daŋ mɔlga mbe basa nna nseŋ kaŋɛ le: “Kashenteŋto b la ma basa nna. B maaŋ ku efɛ n sa ma kikɛ.”

english_verse: It troubled the Lord to see them in trouble, and his angel saved them. The Lord was truly merciful, so he rescued his people. He took them in his arms and carried them all those years.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ka wu mbe basa ka wɔ etɔrɔ to nɛ k tɔrɔ mo ga nɛ e shuŋi mbe malaika nɛ e ba mɔlga bumo ashi awurfoŋ na to. Kashenteŋto Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee wu kuwɔr pasaa, amoso nɛ e kɔ n suge mbe basa na. Mbe enɔ to nɛ e keta bumo nfɛ damta nɛ a choŋ ere kikɛ na.

english_verse: Then the Lord's people turned against him and made his Holy Spirit sad. So he became their enemy and attacked them.
translation_verse: Ade be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be basa na lar mo kaman ŋ kilgi a kɔ mo nɛ mbe Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na be kagbene jija mo ga. Amoso Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ki bumo doŋ nna nseŋ kɔ bumo.

english_verse: But his people remembered what had happened during the time of Moses. Didn't the Lord bring them and their leaders safely through the sea? Didn't he give them his Holy Spirit?
translation_verse: Ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be basa naŋ nyiŋi asheŋ nɛ e wora bumo nananyɛn Mosis be jemanɛ nseŋ bishi le: “Nnɛ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ e daŋ mɔlga mbe basa be bejuŋkparpoana ashi teku peper na to dra dra na wɔ? Nnɛ nɛ Ebɔrɛ nɛ e ta mbe Kiyoyu n sa Mosis na wɔ?

english_verse: The glorious power of the Lord marched beside Moses. The Lord will be praised forever for dividing the sea.
translation_verse: Nnɛ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ e bɔla Mosis so n ta mbe eleŋ n wora asheŋgboŋ n shin nɛ teku peper barga to anyɔ nɛ ekpa dese kumo to nɛ mbe ketre dii mbaanaayɔ na wɔ?”

english_verse: His Spirit gave them rest, just as cattle find rest when led into a valley. The name of the Lord was praised for doing these things. A Prayer for Mercy and Help
translation_verse: Kananɛ baa kpa ana a yɔ keplasawule so nɛ a bee nya a wushi na aloŋ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be Kiyoyu sa bumo ewushi. E daŋ juŋkpar mbe basa nna nɛ mbe ketre bɔla bumo so n nya kemaŋkura. Kekule Ebɔrɛ n fin mbe kuwɔrwu nɛ kechɛto be asheŋ

english_verse: Please, Lord, look down from your holy and glorious home in the heavens and see what's going on. Have you lost interest? Where is your power? Show that you care about us and have mercy!
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, jande chena fo kuwurputigboŋ na so ashi fo kakpa cheembi nɛ k kɔ kemaŋkura na ŋ keni kusɔ nɛ k bee wora anyi. Fo shɛŋ maŋ naa wɔ anyi to nna a? Nnɛ nɛ fo eleŋgboŋ na wɔ? Ŋini anyi fanɛ anyi be asheŋ tir fo nseŋ wu anyi kuwɔr!

english_verse: Our ancestors Abraham and Jacob have both rejected us. But you are still our Father; you have been our protector since ancient times.
translation_verse: Fo e la an tuto. K wora fanɛ Eebraham nɛ Jeekɔb nɛ b la an nananyɛnana na maŋ naa nyiŋi anyi be asheŋ. Ama fo, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ fo la an tuto na e naa kuŋ anyi dra kikɛ hale m ba fo kabre.

english_verse: Why did you make us turn away from you, our Lord? Why did you make us want to disobey you? Please change your mind! We are your servants, your very own people.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, manɛ nna nɛ fo shin nɛ an foe n lar fo ekpa so n ta ŋkpensheŋ n shile fo? Jande bɛta m ba anyi kutɔ! An la fo nyɛrbi nɛ fo gbagba be basa nna.

english_verse: For a little while, your temple belonged to us; and now our enemies have torn it down.
translation_verse: Jemanɛ nɛ k choŋ na fo bɔrɛlambu na daa la fo basa peya nna, ama naniere an doŋana ba bure kumo kikɛ n lɛ nseŋ chichi kumo so.

english_verse: Rip the heavens apart! Come down, Lord; make the mountains tremble.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, bugi awɔlpa to nseŋ gbelge m ba nɛ kufu e pɛ abee nɛ a baa chicha.

english_verse: Be a spark that starts a fire causing water to boil. Then your enemies will know who you are; all nations will tremble because you are nearby.
translation_verse: A beeŋ baa chicha fanɛ nchu ka bɛ edɛ so a falte na. Lara fo eleŋgboŋ ŋ ŋini fo doŋana n shin nɛ kufu e pɛ efuli pɔtɛana na nɛ bumo alɛ gba e baa chicha fo anishito!

english_verse: You help all who gladly obey and do what you want, but sin makes you angry. Only by your help can we ever be saved.
translation_verse: Bekama nɛ baa ta kagbenefuli a wora fo kasonu nsaa wora asɔ nɛ fee sha na, fo alɛ bee chɛ bumo to nna. Ama kulubi bre bee shin nɛ fo kagbene bee kaa nna. Fo nawule e naaŋ tiŋ n chɛ anyi to n shin nɛ an nya kumɔlga.

english_verse: We are unfit to worship you; each of our good deeds is merely a filthy rag. We dry up like leaves; our sins are storm winds sweeping us away.
translation_verse: Anyi kikɛ wora alubi ŋ ku so. Hale anyi be asheŋ lela gba du fanɛ achɛbi krenso ashi fo kutɔ nna. Anyi be alubi so, an du fanɛ afantaŋ wɔlso nɛ afu ber amo n ya lɛ nna.

english_verse: No one worships in your name or remains faithful. You have turned your back on us and let our sins melt us away.
translation_verse: Esa kikɛ maŋ naa tre fo kabɔrɛkule to ŋko a fin fo kechɛto gba. Anyi be alubi so, fo ta fo kumu nna ŋ ŋana nseŋ kplaŋ anyi so.

english_verse: You, Lord, are our Father. We are nothing but clay, but you are the potter who molded us.
translation_verse: Ama fo, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e la an tuto. Anyi ere du fanɛ ebɔ nna nɛ fo alɛ du fanɛ mba nɛ mpuliya be epɔrpo. Fo e to anyi,

english_verse: Don't be so furious or keep our sins in your thoughts forever! Remember that all of us are your people.
translation_verse: amoso sa maŋ nya agbo ga n wɔtɔ anyi ŋko a nyiŋi anyi be alubi mbaanaayɔ. Baa nyiŋi fanɛ fo basa e la anyi kikɛ, amoso wu anyi kuwɔr.

english_verse: Every one of your towns has turned into a desert, especially Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Fo ndegboŋ cheembiana na be kekama ki fanɛ keshishɛrsawule nna. Jerusalɛm ki kelambure nna nɛ ekama maŋ naa wɔ kumo to.

english_verse: Zion's glorious and holy temple where our ancestors praised you has been destroyed by fire. Our beautiful buildings are now a pile of ruins.
translation_verse: Edɛ chɔɔ anyi be bɔrɛlambu nɛ k daa walɛ ga nsaa du cheembi nɛ an nanaana daa luri kumo to a bunyaŋ fo na m mur. Anyi be nwu lela nɛ an daa sha ga na kikɛ ki alambure m biti abar so a dese.

english_verse: When you see these things, how can you just sit there and make us suffer more?
translation_verse: O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, ade kikɛ maa gbuŋgbuŋ fo a? Ama feeŋ wora shruum ŋ kplaŋ anyi nɛ an baa wɔ kasogberge nɛ k shi m pɔɔ anyi so ere to a?

english_verse: All day long I have reached out to stubborn and sinful people going their own way.
translation_verse: Jemanɛ kikɛ ma ere wora shiriya nɛ n sɔ ma basa kpeŋso nɛ b sɔ bumo gbagba be ekpa a wɔtɔ a wora asheŋ lubi na nna.

english_verse: They keep making me angry by sneering at me, while offering sacrifices to idols in gardens and burning incense to them on bricks.
translation_verse: B paŋ nyɔmɔ nna a wɔtɔ a shin nɛ ma kagbene bee kaa. Ŋkpal manɛ so, b wɔtɔ nna a lara esarga a sa agbir ashi adɔbi to nsaa chɔɔ eduwu agbirsure nɛ b ta ebirkesi m pɔr so a sa amo.

english_verse: They spend their nights hiding in burial caves; they eat the meat of pigs, cooked in sauces made of stuff unfit to eat.
translation_verse: Kanyɛso malɛ baa yɔ nchaŋ ase nna n ya kaa bishi so a fin abuniyoyu be kechɛto. Bumo alɛ naa we epreku be eblaŋ nna nsaa fe asɔbɔya nɛ b ta n lara esarga n sa agbir be epochu.”

english_verse: I have written this down; I won't keep silent. I'll pay them back just as their sins deserve.
translation_verse: N tiŋ ŋ kre bumo be kasogberge nseŋ sibɛ kusɔ nɛ k beeŋ wora bumo n nase. M maaŋ kplaŋ kusɔ nɛ b wora na so, ama meeŋ ka bumo kukɔ

english_verse: I, the Lord, will make them pay for their sins and for those of their ancestors— they have disgraced me by burning incense on mountains.
translation_verse: ŋkpal bumo gbagba nɛ bumo nanaana be alubi so. B shuŋ agbir nseŋ chɔɔ eduwu n sa amo ashi abee so a malga a jija ma ketre. Amoso meeŋ keni bumo be asheŋ dra so ŋ gberge bumo kusoe kananɛ k daga bumo.

english_verse: I have chosen the people of Israel and Judah, and I will bless them with many descendants. They will settle here in this land of mountains, and it will be theirs.
translation_verse: Meeŋ nɛfa Israɛl nɛ Juda be basa nseŋ shin nɛ ma kasawule nɛ k kɔ abee na e ki bumo be kaman to ebi peya. Saŋɛ na so ma basa laraso nɛ baa shuŋ ma na beeŋ chena kumo so.

english_verse: My people will worship me. Then the coastlands of Sharon and the land as far as Achor Valley will turn into pastureland where cattle and sheep will feed and rest.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ b baa shuŋ ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ashi ndoŋ nsaa kpa bumo be mbolpɔ nɛ ana a yɔ Sharɔn be keplasawule nɛ k wɔ kasawule na be epeŋitɔrkpa be kaba so nɛ b ya ji afitiri lela nɛ Akɔ be Ketaŋɛ nɛ kumo alɛ wɔ epeŋilarkpa be kaba so na so.

english_verse: What will I, the Lord, do if any of you reject me and my holy mountain? What will happen to you for offering food and wine to the gods you call “Good Luck” and “Fate”?
