translation_verse: Ama asheŋ maaŋ baa du loŋ n sa menyi nɛ men kini ma nɛ ma kebee cheembi nɛ baa tre Zayɔn na nsaa shuŋ agbir nɛ baa tre Gad nɛ Meni na. Amo be afito la Kumulela nɛ Kela m ba.

english_verse: Your luck will end! I will see to it that you are slaughtered with swords. You refused to answer when I called out; you paid no attention to my instructions. Instead, you did what I hated, knowing it was wrong.
translation_verse: Menyi be kumulela beeŋ fo ekar nɛ m bugi ekpa n shin nɛ b ta etokobi m mɔ menyi. Ŋkpal manɛ so, ŋ ka tre menyi men kini keshuli nna; menyi alɛ maŋ naŋ wɔtɔ lakal kusɔ nɛ ŋ ŋini menyi na to. Ama asɔ nɛ ŋ kishi nɛ menyi alɛ nyi k ka la kulubi na nɛ men wora.”

english_verse: I, the Lord God, will give food and drink to my servants, and they will celebrate. But all of you sinners will go hungry and thirsty, overcome with disgrace.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ le: “Basa kama nɛ baa shuŋ ma nsaa wora ma kasonu na beeŋ nya n ji nseŋ nuu yilayilaso, ama akoŋ nɛ achukoŋ e naaŋ mɔ menyi alubiworapoana bre. Bumo be ŋgbene beeŋ fuli bumo ama menyi ere beeŋ ji anishinyɔr.

english_verse: My servants will laugh and sing, but you will be sad and cry out in pain.
translation_verse: Ma nyɛrbi beeŋ baa mushe nsaa boŋ nshɛ kagbenefuliso, ama menyi ere be ŋgbene beeŋ jija menyi nɛ men baa shu.

english_verse: I, the Lord God, promise to see that you are killed and that my chosen servants use your names as curse words. But I will give new names to my servants.
translation_verse: Ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ shin nɛ men wu nɛ ma basa laraso e ta menyi be atre a sho basa nnɔ. Ama meeŋ sa basa nɛ baa nu a sa ma na bre atre popɔr.

english_verse: I am God! I can be trusted. Your past troubles are gone; I no longer think of them. When you pray for someone to receive a blessing, or when you make a promise, you must do it in my name. I alone am the God who can be trusted. The Lord's New Creation
translation_verse: Esa kama nɛ e bee sha nɛfa ashi kasawule na so beeŋ kule Ebɔrɛ nɛ e bee ji kashenteŋ na nɛ e nɛfa mo. Ekama malɛ nɛ e bee sha kenase kɔnɔ e beeŋ nase kɔnɔ na kashenteŋji be Ebɔrɛ na be ketre to nna. Ŋkpal manɛ so, etɔrɔ dra na kikɛ choŋ nɛ n teŋ amo so.” Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be apɔrso popɔr be asheŋ

english_verse: I am creating new heavens and a new earth; everything of the past will be forgotten.
translation_verse: Ade kikɛ be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ le: “Mee to durnya nɛ ebɔrɛso popɔr nna. Asheŋ dra na kikɛ choŋ nɛ n teŋ amo so kuraa.

english_verse: I will celebrate with Jerusalem and all its people; there will be no more crying or sorrow in that city.
translation_verse: Ŋ gbagba be kagbene beeŋ fuli ma ŋkpal Jerusalɛm nɛ kumo be basa so. Kushu nɛ kebɔltofinfin maaŋ naa wɔ ndoŋ.

english_verse: No child will die in infancy; everyone will live a very long life. Anyone a hundred years old will be considered young, and to die younger than that will be considered a curse.
translation_verse: Mbi popɔrbi be luwu maaŋ naa wɔtɔ. Basa kikɛ beeŋ chena n fo bumo be nchɛ be ekar pɔɛŋ nseŋ wu. Basa nɛ b ji nfɛ kalfa gba beeŋ baa du fanɛ mbifɔlbi. Basa nɛ b maaŋ fo nfɛ kalfa pɔɛŋ nseŋ wu na, baaŋ wu bumo be luwu na fanɛ kɔnɔsho be luwu.

english_verse: Their work won't be wasted, and their children won't die of dreadful diseases. I will bless their children and their grandchildren.
translation_verse: Bumo be ashuŋ beeŋ nyalɛ n sa bumo nɛ bumo be mbia malɛ maaŋ naaŋ lɔ alɔ lubi n wu. Meeŋ nɛfa bumo nɛ bumo be kaman to ebi kikɛ.

english_verse: I will answer their prayers before they finish praying.
translation_verse: Pɔɛŋ nɛ baaŋ kule ma kusɔ kama gba nɛ n tiŋ n nu bumo be kekule.

english_verse: Wolves and lambs will graze together; lions and oxen will feed on straw. Snakes will eat only dirt! They won't bite or harm anyone on my holy mountain. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Ekuŋtuŋ nɛ mbolpɔ fɔlbi beeŋ tu abar a ji nɛ ebuluŋ e ji afitiri fanɛ ana. Awɔ beeŋ baa ji eshishɛr, amo alɛ maaŋ naa duŋ basa a mɔ. Kusɔ lubi kikɛ maaŋ naa wɔ ma kebee cheembi nɛ baa tre Zayɔn na so. Ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ e kaŋɛ na.”

english_verse: The Lord said: Heaven is my throne; the earth is my footstool. What kind of house could you build for me? In what place will I rest?
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ yɛ: “Ebɔrɛso e la ma kuwurjiakpa nɛ kasawule so malɛ la ma aya be kusɔ yiliso so. Nɛ nuso be ebu nɛ menyeeŋ naŋ pɔr n sa ma nɛ n naŋ chena to ŋko nnɛ nɛ meeŋ naŋ chena n wushi?

english_verse: I have made everything; that's how it all came to be. I, the Lord, have spoken. The people I treasure most are the humble— they depend only on me and tremble when I speak.
translation_verse: Ma e to durnya kikɛ nseŋ shin nɛ kusɔ kikɛ wɔtɔ. Basa nɛ bumo be asheŋ bee par ma nɛ mee keni bumo a bɔlɔ kenishi, e la basa nɛ baa bar bumo be amu kaseto nsaa tuba ashi bumo be alubi to ŋko bumo nɛ baa ŋana ma nsaa wora ma kasonu na.

english_verse: You refused to answer when I called out; you paid no attention to my instructions. Instead, you did what I hated, knowing it was wrong. Now I will punish you in a way you dread the most. The Lord Will Help Jerusalem
translation_verse: Amoso meeŋ gberge bumo kusoe n shin nɛ kusɔ nɛ baa ŋana e ba bumo so, ŋkpal manɛ so, ŋ ka tre bumo, ekama maŋ shuli ŋko n nu kusɔ nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ na. B kini kewora ma kasonu nna nsaa wɔtɔ a wora asɔ nɛ ŋ kishi.”

english_verse: If you tremble when the Lord speaks, listen to what he says: “Some of your own people hate and reject you because of me. They make fun and say, ‘Let the Lord show his power! Let us see him make you truly happy.’ But those who say these things will be terribly ashamed.”
translation_verse: Menyi nɛ menyee ŋana Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nsaa wora mo kasonu na e nu kusɔ nɛ e kaŋɛ. E yɛ: “Ŋkpal men ka bee ji kashenteŋ a sa ma so, menyi gbagba be basa ko kishi menyi nna a maa sha ketu menyi n wora shɛŋ. Baa wora menyi eyurto nna a kaŋɛ le: ‘Men shin nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e ŋini mbe eleŋgboŋ nseŋ mɔlga menyi, saŋɛ na so anyeeŋ wu fanɛ menyi be ŋgbene fuli menyi.’ Ama bumo gbagba beeŋ ji anishinyɔr!”

english_verse: Do you hear that noise in the city and those shouts coming from the temple? It is the Lord shouting as he punishes his enemies.
translation_verse: Men nu awɔr nɛ k shi kadegboŋ na nɛ bɔrɛlambu na to a ba! Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be bedoŋana be kasogberge be awɔr nɛ menyee nu na.

english_verse: Have you ever heard of a woman who gave birth to a child before having labor pains?
translation_verse: Men daŋ nu fanɛ eche bee kurge nna pɔɛŋ nsaa nu kakurge be ebesa a?

english_verse: Who ever heard of such a thing or imagined it could happen? Can a nation be born in a day or come to life in a second? Jerusalem is like a mother who gave birth to her children as soon as she was in labor.
translation_verse: Wanɛ e daŋ nu ŋko n wu loŋ ŋ ku so? Kachɛ koŋwule nɛ efuli bee ta a ki efuli nɛ basa wɔ kumo to ŋko epul to nɛ loŋ bee wora? Ama Jerusalɛm bre du fanɛ eche nɛ kakurge ta mo nɛ e kurge kebia epul na to nna.

english_verse: The Lord is the one who makes birth possible. And he will see that Zion has many more children. The Lord has spoken.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ: “Men sa maa fɛ fanɛ meeŋ shin nɛ ma basa be kakurgeachɛ e fo nɛ m maaŋ shin nɛ b tiŋ ŋ kurge bumo.”

english_verse: If you love Jerusalem, celebrate and shout! If you were in sorrow because of the city, you can now be glad.
translation_verse: Menyi kikɛ nɛ menyee sha Jerusalɛm be kadegboŋ be asheŋ, men tu kumo n ji eyur! Menyi nɛ menyi be ŋgbene jija ŋkpal kumo so na e tu kumo n ji eyur naniere!

english_verse: She will nurse and comfort you, just like your own mother, until you are satisfied. You will fully enjoy her wonderful glory.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, kumo be kemaŋkura nɛ kedamaya kikɛ beeŋ suse menyi alɛ gba fanɛ kananɛ kebibi bee nya a nyipo mo nio be anyipo na.

english_verse: The Lord has promised: “I will flood Jerusalem with the wealth of nations and make the city prosper. Zion will nurse you at her breast, carry you in her arms, and hold you in her lap.
translation_verse: Kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ naŋ kaŋɛ nde: “Meeŋ shin nɛ efuli pɔtɛana so be asɔ lela e ba bɔlɔ Jerusalɛm to nɛ k dii dama fanɛ kananɛ lɔr bee bɔlɔ nchu a dii kepla so na. Menyeeŋ baa du fanɛ kebia nɛ mo nio bee nyipo mo nsaa ŋini mo kasha na nna.

english_verse: I will comfort you there like a mother comforting her child.”
translation_verse: Kananɛ ebinio bee lolo mbe kebia na nɛ ma alɛ gba beeŋ baa lolo menyi ashi Jerusalɛm to.

english_verse: When you see this happen, you will celebrate; your strength will return faster than grass can sprout. Then everyone will know that the Lord provides help for his servants, but he is angry with his enemies.
translation_verse: Men kaŋ wu le ka bee wora, menyi be ŋgbene beeŋ fuli menyi nɛ men nya eleŋ nɛ alenfia. Aloŋ nɛ menyeeŋ pin fanɛ ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee chɛ basa nɛ baa wora ma kasonu na to nna; ma alɛ nsaa shin nɛ ma agbo bee ba n doŋana so.”

english_verse: The Lord will come down like a whirlwind with his flaming chariots. He will be furiously angry and punish his enemies with fire.
translation_verse: Keni, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kɔ edɛ nna a ba. E beeŋ ta mbe gbaŋɛturko nɛ k bee kpa edɛ na m bɔla kawuliwuli so m ba. E nya agbo nna ga a ba nɛ e ba ta edɛ ŋ gberge mo doŋana kusoe.

english_verse: The Lord's fiery sword will bring justice everywhere on this earth and execute many people. A Threat and a Promise
translation_verse: Edɛ nɛ tokobi nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kɔ ba nɛ e ba ji durnya to be basa kikɛ demu nɛ basa damta nɛ baaŋ ji n tɔr na e wu.

english_verse: Some of you get yourselves ready and go to a garden to worship a foreign goddess. You eat the meat of pigs, lizards, and mice. But I, the Lord, will destroy you for this.
translation_verse: Menyi to be beko bee bela ase nna a yɔ adɔbi to n ya kaa shuŋ efuli pɔtɛana so be agbir cheso. Menyi alɛ bee ji epreku nɛ eshiboe nɛ asɔ damta nɛ a la ekishi n sa menyi na nna. Ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ mur menyi ŋkpal loŋ so.

english_verse: I know everything you do and think! The time has now come to bring together the people of every language and nation and to show them my glory
translation_verse: N nyi asɔ nɛ menyee fɛ nsaa wora kikɛ! Naniere jemanɛ fo nɛ ŋ gama efuli pɔtɛana na be basa nɛ bumo nɛ baa gbar ŋgbar pɔtɛ na abar so nɛ b ba wu ma kemaŋkura,

english_verse: by proving what I can do. I will send the survivors to Tarshish, Pul, Lud, Meshech, Tubal, Javan, and to the distant islands. I will send them to announce my wonderful glory to nations that have never heard about me.
translation_verse: nseŋ pin fanɛ ma e naa gberge bumo kusoe. Ama meeŋ yige bumo be beko nseŋ yɛr bumo efuli pɔtɛana fanɛ Speen nɛ Libiya nɛ Tubal nɛ Griis nɛ nsawule nɛ a wɔ kufɔ kufɔ nɛ b maŋ naŋ nu ma asheŋ ŋko n wu ma keshi nɛ eleŋgboŋ na so. Baaŋ ya bɔ ma kemaŋkura nɛ keshi be kubɔya n sa ndoŋebi.

english_verse: They will bring your relatives from the nations as an offering to me, the Lord. They will come to Jerusalem, my holy mountain, on horses, chariots, wagons, mules, and camels. It will be like the people of Israel bringing the right offering to my temple.
translation_verse: Bumo alɛ beeŋ bɛta men kurgepoana ashi efuliana na so fanɛ kakɛ m ba sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na. Egbaŋɛ nɛ egbaŋɛturko nɛ ekurma nɛ enyɔma nɛ baaŋ dii m ba ma kebee cheembi so ashi Jerusalɛm to fanɛ kananɛ Israɛlebi bee ta bumo be ayu be esarga ekpa nɛ k daga so ashi ma bɔrɛlambu to na.

english_verse: I promise that some of them will be priests and others will be helpers in my temple. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ lara bumo be beko nɛ b baa la bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ beko malɛ e baa la bechɛtopo ashi ma bɔrɛlambu to.

english_verse: I also promise that you will always have descendants and will never be forgotten, just as the new heavens and the new earth that I create will last forever.
translation_verse: Ade be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naaŋ kaŋɛ le: “Kananɛ ebɔrɛso popɔr nɛ kasawule popɔr nɛ meeŋ to na beeŋ bɔla ma eleŋgboŋ so a wɔtɔ mbaanaayɔ na, nɛ menyi alɛ gba be ketre nɛ kaman to ebi beeŋ baa wɔtɔ mbaanaayɔ.

english_verse: On the first day of each month and on each Sabbath, everyone will worship me. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Kufɔl popɔr be kejigboŋ kikɛ be jemanɛ nɛ kewushiachɛ kikɛ nɛ men gama a shuŋ ma, efuli pɔtɛana so be basa gba beeŋ ba shuŋ ma ashi Jerusalɛm to.

english_verse: My people will go out and look at the dead bodies of those who turned against me. The worms there never die, the fire never stops burning, and the sight of those bodies will be disgusting to everyone.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ ma basa e lar kowu n ya wu basa nɛ b lar ma kaman ŋ kilgi a kɔ ma na be kebuniana. Ashushombi nɛ a beeŋ ji bumo na maaŋ wu kikɛ. Edɛ nɛ a beeŋ chɔɔ bumo m mur na malɛ gba maaŋ duŋ kikɛ. Bumo be asheŋ beeŋ keta ekama nɛ e beeŋ wu bumo kenishiso kejija.”

english_verse: My name is Jeremiah. I am a priest, and my father Hilkiah and everyone else in my family are from Anathoth in the territory of the Benjamin tribe. This book contains the things that the Lord told me to say.
translation_verse: Jɛremaya nɛ e la Hilkiya pibinyɛn nseŋ shi bɔrɛmatapoana be kanaŋ to ashi kade nɛ baa tre Anatɔf nɛ k wɔ Bɛnjamin be yiri to ebi be kasawule so na be mmalga nɛ e wɔ kawɔl ere to nde.

english_verse: The Lord first spoke to me in the thirteenth year that Josiah was king of Judah,
translation_verse: Josaya nɛ e la Ammɔn pibinyɛn ka daa ji Juda be efuli so be kuwura na be kafɛ kuduasasopo to nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na malga Jɛremaya kutɔ.

english_verse: and he continued to speak to me during the rule of Josiah's son Jehoiakim. The last time the Lord spoke to me was in the fifth month of the eleventh year that Josiah's son Zedekiah was king. That was also when the people of Jerusalem were taken away as prisoners. The Lord Chooses Jeremiah
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ Ebɔrɛ naŋ malga n sa mo jemanɛ nɛ Josaya wu nɛ mo pibinyɛn nɛ baa tre Jehowakim na sɔ mo so a ji kuwura na. Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kraŋ naŋ malga Jɛremaya kutɔ ale damta, hale n ya fo Josaya pibinyɛn nɛ baa tre Zɛdikaya na be kuwurji be saŋɛ be kafɛ kudukakosopo to be kufɔl nusopo na to. Loŋ be kufɔl na to nɛ bedoŋ daŋ ba kɔ m pɛ Jerusalɛm to be basa n yɔ kenyaya to ashi efuli pɔtɛ wɔfɔ wɔfɔ so. Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ka tre Jɛremaya be asheŋ

english_verse: The Lord said:
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na yɛ:

english_verse: “Jeremiah, I am your Creator, and before you were born, I chose you to speak for me to the nations.”
translation_verse: “Jɛremaya, pɔɛŋ nɛ n to fo n wɔtɔ fo nio be epun to nɛ e kurge fo, n lara fo nna n yili fanɛ ma anebi n sa efuliana so be basa.”

english_verse: “Don't say you're too young,” the Lord answered. “If I tell you to go and speak to someone, then go! And when I tell you what to say, don't leave out a word!
translation_verse: Ama kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ ma e la fanɛ: “Sa maŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ fo la kebifɔlbi gbagba nna, ama yɔ basa nɛ n shuŋi fo bumo kutɔ na n ya kaŋɛ bumo kusɔ kama nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ fo kenishipereso.

english_verse: I promise to be with you and keep you safe, so don't be afraid.”
translation_verse: Sa maa ŋana bumo, ŋkpal manɛ so, meeŋ baa wɔ fo kutɔ nsaa kuŋ fo. Ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ e kaŋɛ na!”

english_verse: The Lord reached out his hand, then he touched my mouth and said, “I am giving you the words to say,
translation_verse: Kede be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na teŋi mbe enɔ m beta ma kɔnɔpurbi nseŋ kaŋɛ ma le: “Nu nfe! Mee sa fo mmalga nɛ feeŋ baa malga nna na.

english_verse: and I am sending you with authority to speak to the nations for me. You will tell them of doom and destruction, and of rising and rebuilding again.”
translation_verse: Kabre mee sa fo eleŋ nna nɛ fo tiŋ a kaŋɛ efuliana na be basa fanɛ meeŋ lara bumo ashi to nseŋ mur bumo nɛ b maaŋ naa wɔtɔ kuraa. Kumo be kaman nɛ n naŋ lɔŋɛ m pɔr bumo be efuliana na n yili.” Ebɔrɛdare anyɔ be asheŋ

english_verse: The Lord showed me something in a vision. Then he asked, “What do you see, Jeremiah?” I answered, “A branch of almonds that ripen early.”
translation_verse: Ade be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na shin nɛ ŋ ku bɔrɛdare nɛ e bishi ma le: “Jɛremaya, manɛ nɛ fo wu?” Nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ mo le: “Kedibi nɛ baa tre amɔnd na be kesɔrso nɛ k bee bel a pere manaŋ nɛ n wu.”

english_verse: “That's right,” the Lord replied, “and I always rise early to keep a promise.”
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ: “Kashenteŋ nɛ fo ji, ŋkpal manɛ so, mee keni ma mmalga ekpa nna nɛ e wora m bɔlɔ so kashenteŋto.”

english_verse: Then the Lord showed me something else and asked, “What do you see now?” I answered, “I see a pot of boiling water in the north, and it's about to spill out toward us.”
translation_verse: Kede be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naŋ bishi ma le: “Manɛ nɛ fo naŋ wu n ti so?” Nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ mo le: “N wu nchu ka wɔ kapuliya to a bɛ edɛ so a falte ashi kelargato be esoso be kaba so. K gbɛto nna n shoŋi anyi be kaba so, a sha ketɔr nɛ shudɛ na e wurge.”

english_verse: Just watch while I send for the kings of the north. They will attack and capture Jerusalem and other towns, then set up their thrones at the gates of Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, mee pla enɔ a tre efuli pɔtɛana be basa nɛ b wɔ kelargato be esoso be kaba so na nna fanɛ b ba. Baaŋ ba kɔ n suge Jerusalɛm nɛ Juda be ndeana kikɛ. Kumo be kaman nɛ bumo be bewuraana e nase bumo be nwɔl nɛ nwurputi ashi Jerusalɛm be mbunagboŋ ase n chena so.

english_verse: I will punish my people, because they are guilty of turning from me to worship idols.
translation_verse: Meeŋ gberge ma basa kusoe ŋkpal b ka kini ma n lɛ nsaa shuŋ agbir a lara esarga a sa amo so.

english_verse: Jeremiah, get ready! Go and tell the people what I command you to say. Don't be frightened by them, or I will make you terrified while they watch.
translation_verse: Jɛremaya, wora shiriya n ya kaŋɛ basa na kusɔ kama nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ fo kenishipereso na. Sa maa ŋana bumo, nɛ mannɛ aloŋ meeŋ shin nɛ kufu nɛ k chɔ loŋ a pɛ fo jemanɛ nɛ feeŋ baa wɔ bumo to na.

english_verse: The Lord told me
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na daŋ kaŋɛ ma nna fanɛ

english_verse: and I, the Lord, will speak. I was never unfair to your ancestors, but they left me and became worthless by following worthless idols.
translation_verse: E yɛ: “Men nananyɛnana daa maŋ wu ma kulubi kikɛ, ama b daŋ lar ma kaman nseŋ shuŋ agbir nɛ e maŋ kɔ tɔnɔ nseŋ ki basa nɛ b maŋ kɔ tɔnɔ n sa ma.

english_verse: Your ancestors refused to ask for my help, though I had rescued them from Egypt and led them through a treacherous, barren desert, where no one lives or dares to travel.
translation_verse: Ŋ ka daŋ mɔlga bumo ashi Ijipt be efuli so nseŋ juŋkpar bumo m bɔla kasawule fuloŋ nɛ k la eshishɛr nɛ e biti abar so nawule nseŋ naa la kasawule wɔlso nɛ k kɔ kufu nɛ esa kikɛ maŋ wɔ kumo so ŋko a sha kenite kumo so na be kaman, men nananyɛnana be shɛŋ daa maŋ wɔ ma to.

english_verse: You will find that no nation has ever abandoned its gods even though they were false. I am the true and glorious God, but you have rejected me to worship idols.
translation_verse: Efuli kikɛ so be basa maŋ naŋ chɛrga bumo be agbirana. Bumo be agbirana na maŋ la Ebɔrɛ kashenteŋto gba. Ama ma ere be basa ta ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ m bar bumo kemaŋkura na n chɛr agbirana nɛ a maaŋ tiŋ n wora shɛŋ n sa bumo.

english_verse: You, my people, have sinned in two ways— you have rejected me, the source of life-giving water, and you've tried to collect water in cracked and leaking pits dug in the ground.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, ma basa wora kulubi ekpa ntuŋnyɔ so. B kini ma nseŋ shile ma nɛ mee sa ŋkpa na be nchu nna, nseŋ ya kur amaŋ nɛ nchu maa yili amo to a chɛr a fin nchu.

english_verse: Your own sins will punish you, because it was a bitter mistake for you to reject me without fear of punishment. I, the Lord All-Powerful, have spoken.
translation_verse: Menyi gbagba be asheŋ lubi e naŋ gberge menyi kusoe, nɛ menyi be kekini ma malɛ ji m bri menyi. Saŋɛ na so nɛ men pin fanɛ men be kekini kebaaji kashenteŋ a sa ma, Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na bee besa nsaa maŋ walɛ. Ma Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ e kaŋɛ na.”

english_verse: Long ago you left me and broke all ties between us, refusing to be my servant. Now you worship other gods by having sex on hilltops or in the shade of large trees.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ naŋ kaŋɛ le: “Israɛlebi, dra na kikɛ nɛ men kini ma kebaawɔ wɔ menyi. Menyi alɛ kini fanɛ men maaŋ wora ma kasonu ŋko n shuŋ ma. Men daa shuŋ agbirana ashi abeebi so nɛ ndibigboŋ nɛ e kɔ afantaŋ ga be afito nna, a fɛ fanɛ amo e naa sa menyi mbia.

english_verse: The Lord said: People of Israel, you are stained with guilt, and no soap or bleach can wash it away.
translation_verse: Nɛ men ta kɔya lela m bɛr ŋ gbiti menyi be eyur so nɛnɛ gba, ŋ kraa beeŋ wu alubi nɛ a shin nɛ men wora n jija ma anishito na ashi menyi so.

english_verse: You deny your sins and say, “We aren't unclean. We haven't worshiped Baal.” But think about what you do in Hinnom Valley. You run back and forth like young camels, as you rush to worship one idol after another.

english_verse: You are no better than animals, and you always want sex with someone else's wife.
translation_verse: Bumo nɛ asɔbɔya maŋ kɔr abar to. Ŋkpal manɛ so, b daa sha kebaadi bumo braana be eche jemanɛ kikɛ nna.

english_verse: Why shouldn't I punish the people of Judah?
translation_verse: Manɛ so nɛ m maaŋ gberge Juda be efuli so be basa kusoe?

english_verse: I will tell their enemies, “Go through my vineyard. Don't destroy the vines, but cut off the branches, because they are the people who don't belong to me.”
translation_verse: Meeŋ shin nɛ bedoŋ e ba ku ma basa be ndibi sɔrso n lɛ, ama b maaŋ mur ndibi sɔrso be adɔ na bre cheche. Meeŋ kaŋɛ bumo fanɛ b kpele ayabiana na n lɛ; ŋkpal manɛ so, loŋ be basa na maa sha kebaanyi ma.

english_verse: Their prophets lie and say, “The Lord won't punish us. We will have peace and plenty of food.”
translation_verse: Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be basa ku efɛ ŋ kaŋɛ le: “E maaŋ wora shɛŋ! Mo alɛ maaŋ shin nɛ kena ŋko akoŋ e ba anyi so.”

english_verse: People of Israel, I have made my decision. An army from a distant country will attack you. I've chosen an ancient nation, and you won't understand their language.
translation_verse: Israɛl be basa, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ shin nɛ efuli ko so be basa e shi kufɔ kufɔ m ba kɔ menyi kena. B la basa lempo nɛ b wɔtɔ dra dra kikɛ nna nɛ menyi alɛ maŋ nyi ŋgbar nɛ baa gbar.

english_verse: All of them are warriors, and their arrows bring death.
translation_verse: Bumo be benapo nɛ b kɔ ata a kɔ kena na la belempo nɛ b maa wu kuwɔr nna.

english_verse: This nation will eat your crops and livestock; they will leave no fruit on your vines or fig trees. And although you feel safe behind thick walls, your towns will be destroyed and your children killed. Israel Refused To Worship the Lord
translation_verse: Baaŋ ji menyi be adɔjibi m mur nseŋ mɔ menyi be mbia. Bumo alɛ beeŋ mur menyi be asɔbɔya nɛ ndibi sɔrso kikɛ. Bumo be benapo beeŋ bure menyi be ndeana nɛ men pɔr egbalana ŋ kulti a wɔ amo to nsaa fɛ fanɛ shɛŋ maaŋ tiŋ n wora menyi na kikɛ n lɛ.

english_verse: And the people who survive will ask, “Why did the Lord our God do such terrible things to us?” Then tell them: I am the Lord, but you abandoned me and worshiped other gods in your own land. Now you will be slaves in a foreign country.
translation_verse: Basa nɛ baaŋ ji efute kaŋ bishi le: ‘Manɛ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe, anyi be Ebɔrɛ na shin nɛ le be asheŋ lubi ere tu anyi?’ Nɛ fo kaŋɛ bumo fanɛ kananɛ b kini ma nseŋ shuŋ efuli pɔtɛana so be agbirana ashi bumo gbagba be kasawule so na, aloŋ nɛ baaŋ ya shuŋ basa pɔtɛ ashi efuli pɔtɛ so.” Ebɔrɛ ka kpele mbe basa kusoe be asheŋ

english_verse: Tell these things to each other, you people of Judah, you descendants of Jacob.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na yɛ: “Bɔ kubɔya ere n sa Juda be efuli so be basa nɛ b la bumo nananyɛn Jeekɔb be kaman to ebi na.

english_verse: that you should worship me with fear and trembling? I'm the one who made the shore to hold back the ocean. Waves may crash on the beach, but they can come no farther.
translation_verse: ma e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ a daga fanɛ men baa ta kufu nɛ kechicha chicha a bunyaŋ ma? Ma e ta eshishɛr ŋ kuŋ teku nɛ k maŋ tiŋ n dii amo so. Teku so beeŋ tiŋ ŋ kaa ketili n wora awɔr ga, ama kumo alɛ maaŋ tiŋ n dii eshishɛr na so.

english_verse: You stubborn people have rebelled and turned your backs on me.
translation_verse: Ama menyi ŋgbene kpakpasowuraana ere kini ma nseŋ pal kaman n sa ma.

english_verse: You refuse to say, “Let's worship the Lord! He's the one who sends rain in spring and autumn and gives us a good harvest.”
translation_verse: Men kini kekaŋɛ le: ‘Men shin nɛ an shuŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na! Mo e naa shin nɛ dɔchubɔrɛ so nɛ kpaŋchala so be bɔrɛ bee ba nɛ anyee nya a dɔ a teŋi kafɛ kikɛ na.’

english_verse: That's why I cannot bless you! *
translation_verse: Ama menyi be alubi so, men maŋ nya asɔ lela ere kikɛ.

english_verse: A hunter traps birds and puts them in a cage, but some of you trap humans and make them your slaves.
translation_verse: Basa nɛ baa wora asheŋ lubi wɔ ma basa to nna a pɛ bumo anya fanɛ kananɛ basa bee sho ashewu a pɛ mbuibi na.

english_verse: Look at the terrible things going on in this country. I am shocked!
translation_verse: Kesheŋ lubi ko nɛ k bee jija kagbene nsaa mɔ kɔnɔ wora kasawule na so.

english_verse: Prophets give their messages in the name of a false god, my priests don't want to serve me, and you—my own people— like it this way! But on the day of disaster, where will you turn for help?
translation_verse: Kumo e la fanɛ anebiana na kikɛ be mmalga la efɛ nna. Kusɔ nɛ b kaŋɛ malɛ nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana na kɔ a shuŋ nɛ ma basa malɛ bee sha kumo be loŋ. To, jɛrbi be jemanɛ kaŋ fo nɛ asheŋ ere kikɛ fo ekar, nnɛ nɛ menyeeŋ yɔ n ya nya kechɛto?”

english_verse: but shepherds will surround it and divided up, then let their flocks eat all the grass.
translation_verse: Bewura beeŋ ba yuu bumo be ewajɛbu n chena ŋ kulti kumo be kaplɛkama nɛ baa sha.

english_verse: Kings will tell their troops, “If we reach Jerusalem in the morning, we'll attack at noon. But if we arrive later,
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ b kaŋɛ bumo benapo na le: “An kaŋ fo Jerusalɛm to kachipurso, kapiidi nɛ anyeeŋ kɔ kumo kena. Ama nɛ an ka maŋ wule n fo bre,

english_verse: we'll attack after dark and destroy its fortresses.”
translation_verse: kanyɛso nɛ anyeeŋ kɔ kumo nseŋ bure kumo be kumɔlga be kakpa lempoana na!”

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful, and I will command these armies to chop down trees and build a ramp up to the walls of Jerusalem. People of Jerusalem, I must punish you for your injustice.
translation_verse: Kede be kaman, nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na e kaŋɛ bewura na fanɛ b ku ndibi n yuu ajaŋ m mata egbal nɛ k kulti Jerusalɛm na nɛ benapo na e dii so n luri kadegboŋ na to. Ŋkpal manɛ so, e yɛ: “Meeŋ gberge basa nɛ b wɔ kadegboŋ ere to kusoe ŋkpal b ka bee kɔrfɛ bumo braana na so.

english_verse: Evil pours from your city like water from a spring. Sounds of injustice and violence echo within your walls; victims are everywhere, wounded and dying.
translation_verse: Kananɛ ketirbu bee bul nchu na, aloŋ nɛ kulubi bee bul ashi Jerusalɛm to. Mee nu basa ka ta akɔsɔ a kɔ abar nseŋ naŋ nu kemur be asheŋ. N wu basa nɛ b doro na ka dese kaplɛkama ashi kadegboŋ na to.

english_verse: Your anger against Judah flames up inside me, and I can't hold it in much longer. The Lord's Anger Will Sweep Everyone Away The Lord answered: Don't hold back my anger! Let it sweep away everyone— the children at play and all adults, young and old alike.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, kananɛ fo nya agbo n wɔtɔ Juda be basa na nɛ ma alɛ gba nya agbo ma kagbene to n wɔtɔ bumo. K bee chɔɔ ma kagbene to nɛ m maaŋ naŋ tiŋ ŋ keta kumo gba.” Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ ma le: “Shin nɛ ma agbo e ba mbia nɛ b wɔ agbembi so nɛ mbifɔlbi nɛ baa shɛr abar so na so. Bedoŋ beeŋ pɛ bekul nɛ bumo be beche kikɛ nɛ basa nɛ b bel ga na n yɔ efuli pɔtɛana so.

english_verse: I'll punish the people of Judah and give to others their houses and fields, as well as their wives. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Meeŋ gberge Juda be basa kusoe nseŋ ta bumo be nwu nɛ adɔsawule nɛ bumo be beche n sa basa pɔtɛ.

english_verse: They should be ashamed of their disgusting sins, but they don't even blush. And so, when I punish Judah, they will end up on the ground, dead like everyone else. I, the Lord, have spoken. The People of Judah Rejected God's Way of Life
translation_verse: Ekishisheŋ nɛ baa wora na maa keta bumo nyɔmɔ. Kashenteŋto, anishinyɔr maŋ kɔ bumo gba; bumo alɛ be anishiakpa maa chɛrga a ŋini fanɛ kusɔ nɛ baa wora na be asheŋ tir bumo. Ŋkpal loŋ so, jemanɛ nɛ meeŋ gberge bumo kusoe na kaŋ fo, bumo alɛ gba beeŋ tɔr n wu fanɛ kananɛ beko daŋ tɔr n wu na. Bumo be ekar e naaŋ baa la na.” Israɛl ka kini Ebɔrɛ be ekpa be asheŋ

english_verse: I also sent prophets to warn you of danger, but when they sounded the alarm, you paid no attention.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na shuŋi anebiana fanɛ b ba kpele menyi kusoe a laŋɛ kenishipere nɛ k bee ba na be kaplɛa so, ama men kini kenu n sa kasokpele na.

english_verse: My people ignored me and rejected my laws. They planned to do evil, and now the evil they planned will happen to them.”
translation_verse: Bumo be ashiri to be ŋkre na so, meeŋ shin nɛ jɛrbi gboŋgboŋi e ba bumo so, nɛ k baa la kasogberge n sa bumo ŋkpal b ka kini ma keŋini nsaa maŋ wora ma mmalga kasonu so.

english_verse: People of Judah, you bring me incense from Sheba and spices from distant lands. You offer sacrifices of all kinds. But why bother? I hate these gifts of yours!
translation_verse: Ma shɛŋ maŋ wɔ eduwu nɛ baa ta a shi Shɛba be efuli so, ŋko asɔ nɛ e bee shin nɛ ajibi bee wora ebel nɛ baa ta a shi efuli wɔfɔ a bar ma na to. Bumo be esarga nɛ baa lara a sa ma na maa par ma, amoso m maaŋ sɔ amo.

english_verse: Its well-armed troops are cruel and never show mercy. Their galloping horses sound like ocean waves pounding on the shore. This army will attack you, lovely Jerusalem.”
translation_verse: B kɔ bumo be ata nɛ etokobi nna a ba. Bumo alɛ maŋ kɔ kushuso ŋko e wu kuwɔr. Egbaŋɛ nɛ baa dii na be aya bee gbri kasawule so nna fanɛ ketili ka bee kaa teku so na. B wora shiriya nna a ba nɛ b ba kɔ Jerusalɛmebi kena.”

english_verse: Then the people said, “Just hearing about them makes us tremble with fear, and we twist and turn in pain like a woman giving birth.”
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Jerusalɛm be basa na kaŋɛ le: “An nu bumo be asheŋ nɛ kufugboŋ tɔr anyi so nɛ anyi be eyur wu anyi. K shin nɛ kagbenejija tɔr anyi so nɛ anyee we anyii to fanɛ eche nɛ kakurge ta mo na.

english_verse: The Lord said, “Don't work in your fields or walk along the roads. It's too dangerous. The enemy is well armed
translation_verse: Anyee ŋana keyɔ ndɔana to ŋko n lar ndeana to gba nna n yɔ mboŋ ko, ŋkpal manɛ so, an doŋana kɔ akɔsɔ to nna a ba nɛ b ba kɔ anyi kena nɛ kufugboŋ sɔ efuli na be kaplɛkama.”

english_verse: and attacks without warning. So mourn, my people, as though your only child had died. Wear clothes made of sackcloth and roll in the ash pile.” The Lord's People Must Be Tested The Lord said:
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman, nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ naŋ kaŋɛ mbe basa le: “Men ta nli be asɔbuuso m buu nseŋ dese nsunɔ to a melti. Men baa shu kenishipereso fanɛ kananɛ menyee shu ebi koŋwule be luwu be keeli na. Ŋkpal manɛ so, basa nɛ baaŋ ba mur menyi na maaŋ chɛr nseŋ ba kɔ menyi kena.

english_verse: Silver can be purified in a fiery furnace, but my people are too wicked to be made pure, and so I have rejected them.
translation_verse: Esa beeŋ tiŋ n ta gbiti n wɔtɔ edɛ to ŋ ŋalga kumo to n lara kumo to be eyurpi, ama ma basa ere be kenyalɛso du kpakpa ga, ŋkpal bumo be amukpakpaso so. Amoso nɛ ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kini bumo n lɛ na.”

english_verse: But you have ignored me and become even more stubborn and sinful than your ancestors ever were! Slaughter Valley The Lord said:
translation_verse: Amo nɛ amo kikɛ men to be esa kikɛ m maa nu a sa ma. Menyi be ŋgbene bee wora kpakpa nna a ti so nɛ menyee kini ma nsaa lar ma kaman gba a chɔ men nananyɛnana na.

english_verse: The Lord told me to stand by the gate of the temple and tell the people who were going in that the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, had said: Pay attention, people of Judah! Change your ways and start living right, then I will let you keep on living in your own country.
translation_verse: Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ ma fanɛ n ya yili bɔrɛlambu na be kabuna ase nsaa kaŋɛ basa le: “Enyɛnpetale, Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na yɛ, men chɛrga menyi be kebaawɔtɔ nɛ asheŋ woraso nsaa wora asɔ nɛ e daga, nɛ n shin nɛ men baa kraa wɔ menyi gbagba be efuli ere so nfe.

english_verse: I will keep you safe only if you change your ways and are fair and honest with each other.
translation_verse: Nɛ menyeeŋ chɛrga menyi be kebaawɔtɔ nɛ kesheŋ wora, kumo ere ma alɛ maaŋ shin nɛ shɛŋ e wora menyi. Men baa ji kashenteŋ a sa abar nsaa maa kpɛa to.

english_verse: Then I will let you enjoy a long life in this land I gave your ancestors.
translation_verse: Nɛ men chɛrga menyi be kebaawɔtɔ nɛ kesheŋ wora, ma alɛ beeŋ shin nɛ men chena kasawule nɛ n ta n sa men nananyɛnana na so mbaanaayɔ.

english_verse: But just look at what is happening! You put your trust in worthless lies.
translation_verse: Ama men kini nseŋ ta menyi be yirda n wɔtɔ kafule be mmalga nɛ e maŋ kɔ tɔnɔ to.

english_verse: You steal and murder; you lie in court and are unfaithful in marriage. You worship idols and offer incense to Baal, when these gods have never done anything for you.
translation_verse: Men wɔtɔ nna a yuri, nsaa mɔ basa, nseŋ naa ji kubojua. Menyi alɛ naa ku efɛ nna a bɔ ntaŋ nseŋ naa lara esarga a sa kegbir nɛ baa tre Baal, a shuŋ agbirana nɛ men maŋ nyi ŋ ku so.

english_verse: And then you come into my temple and worship me! Do you think I will protect you so that you can go on sinning?
translation_verse: Menyi alɛ naa wora asheŋ nɛ ŋ kishi nna nsaa ba m ba kaa yili ma anishi to ashi ma bɔrɛlambu to a kaŋɛ le, ‘Sheŋ maaŋ wora anyi!’

english_verse: You are thieves, and you have made my temple your hideout. But I've seen everything you have done.
translation_verse: Menyee tama fanɛ ma bɔrɛlambu la beyu be eŋanakpa nna a? Mee wu kusɔ nɛ menyee wora na kikɛ.

english_verse: Go to Shiloh, where my sacred tent once stood. Take a look at what I did there. My people Israel sinned, and so I destroyed Shiloh!
translation_verse: Men yɔ kade nɛ baa tre Shilo nɛ n juŋkpar n lara fanɛ b baa shuŋ ma ndoŋ na n ya keni nɛ n kusɔ n wora ndoŋ. Ŋkpal ma basa Israɛlebi na ka wora alubi so, n daŋ mur kumo nna.

english_verse: While you have been sinning, I have been trying to talk to you, but you refuse to listen.
translation_verse: Menyi alɛ gba bee wora alubi nna na nɛ mee malga a sa menyi kapa nɛ kanyɛ, ama men maa nu a sa ma. M baŋ tre menyi gba menyi maa shuli ma so.

english_verse: Don't think this temple will protect you. Long ago I told your ancestors to build it and worship me here, but now I have decided to tear it down, just as I destroyed Shiloh.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal loŋ so, kusɔ n wora ashi Shilo na nɛ meeŋ wora ashi bɔrɛlambu nɛ n ta n sa menyi nɛ men nananyɛnana nɛ men ta menyi be yirda n deŋi so ere gba to.

english_verse: And as for you, people of Judah, I'm going to send you away from my land, just as I sent away the people of Ephraim and the other northern tribes. Punishment for Worshiping Other Gods
translation_verse: Meeŋ ju menyi n lar ma anishi to fanɛ kananɛ n daŋ ju men kurgepoana, Israɛl be nnaŋ kudu nɛ b daa wɔ kelargato be esoso be kaba so na. Ma Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e kaŋɛ.” Basa na be kusoe kpakpaso be asheŋ

english_verse: Do you see what the people of Judah are doing in their towns and in the streets of Jerusalem?
translation_verse: Fo maŋ wu kusɔ nɛ baa wora ashi Juda be efuli so be ndegboŋana to nɛ Jerusalɛm to be agbembi so nna a?

english_verse: Children gather firewood, their fathers build fires, and their mothers mix dough to bake bread for the goddess they call the Queen of Heaven. They even offer wine sacrifices to other gods, just to insult me.
translation_verse: Mbia bee kil ndibi nna nɛ benyɛn bee puga edɛ nɛ beche malɛ bee ta nyifu a to mansaŋ nɛ ekpakulo a sa kegbirche nɛ baa tre Ebɔrɛso be Ewurche na. Bumo alɛ naa ta nsa nna a to nchu a sa agbirana a shin nɛ ma kagbene bee kaa.

english_verse: But they are not only insulting me; they are also harming themselves by doing these shameful things.
translation_verse: Baa wɔtɔ ma agbo nna, ama bumo gbagba be amu nɛ baa tɔrɔ nsaa ŋaba na.

english_verse: And now, I, the Lord All-Powerful, will flood Judah with my fiery anger until nothing is left—no people or animals, no trees or crops. It Is Useless To Offer Sacrifices
translation_verse: Amoso, ma Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ shin nɛ ma kanya agbo e ba ma bɔrɛlambu so. K beeŋ gbelge basa nɛ asɔbɔya nɛ ndibi nɛ asɔduuso kikɛ so. Ma agbo beeŋ baa du fanɛ edɛ nɛ esa kikɛ maaŋ tiŋ n duŋ na nna.”

english_verse: The Lord told me to say to the people of Judah: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, but I won't accept sacrifices from you. So don't even bother bringing them to me. You might as well just cook the meat for yourselves.
translation_verse: Ade kikɛ be kaman, nɛ Enyɛnpetale, Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ Juda be basa na le: “Ma shɛŋ maŋ naa wɔ menyi be esarga to. Amoso men sa maŋ naa gben menyi be amu a bar amo m ba kaa sa ma. Ama nɛ men kaŋ bar amo malɛ, menyeeŋ tiŋ n daŋɛ eblaŋ na n we.

english_verse: At the time I brought your ancestors out of Egypt, I didn't command them to offer sacrifices to me.
translation_verse: Ŋ ka daŋ lara men nananyɛnana ashi Ijipt be efuli so na, n daa maŋ kaŋɛ bumo fanɛ b baa lara esarga be yiri kikɛ a sa ma.

english_verse: Instead, I told them, “If you listen to me and do what I tell you, I will be your God, you will be my people, and all will go well for you.”
translation_verse: N daŋ kaŋɛ bumo nna fanɛ b baa wora ma kasonu, saŋɛ na so meeŋ baa la bumo be Ebɔrɛ nɛ bumo alɛ e baa la ma basa. N daŋ kaŋɛ bumo nna fanɛ b baa wɔ kebaawɔtɔ nɛ n yili n sa bumo na to, saŋɛ na so asheŋ beeŋ baa nite nɛnɛ a sa bumo.

english_verse: But your ancestors refused to listen. They were stubborn, and whenever I wanted them to go one way, they always went the other.
translation_verse: Ama b daa maŋ nu n sa ma. Kusɔ nɛ bumo be ŋgbene kpakpaso kaŋɛ bumo nɛ b daa wora, nɛ kumo be loŋ shin nɛ bumo be kebaawɔtɔ jija n ti so.

english_verse: Ever since your ancestors left Egypt, I have been sending my servants the prophets to speak for me.
translation_verse: Yili jemanɛ nɛ men nananyɛnana lar Ijipt be efuli so m ba fo kabre, ŋ kraa shuŋi anebiana nɛ b la ma mbɔ men kutɔ nna.

english_verse: So you must say to them: People of Judah, I am the Lord your God, but you have refused to obey me, and you didn't change when I punished you. And now, you no longer even pretend to be faithful to me.
translation_verse: Amoso kaŋɛ bumo le: ‘Men la efuli nɛ k maa wora Enyɛnpe, kumo be Ebɔrɛ kasonu nsaa maŋ naa sɔ mbe keŋini nna. Kashenteŋji mur nɛ esa kikɛ maŋ naa ji kumo be asheŋ gba kuraa.’ Asheŋ lubi nɛ a bee wora Hinnɔm be Ketaŋɛ to be asheŋ

english_verse: Shave your head bald and throw away the hair. Sing a funeral song on top of a barren hill. You people have made me angry, and I have abandoned you.
translation_verse: Jerusalɛm be basa, men she men be amu so be emin, fanɛ basa nɛ baa shu nli na. Men baa boŋ nli to be nshɛ ashi abee be awɔlto; ŋkpal manɛ so, ma Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nya agbo nna nseŋ kini menyi nɛ men la ma basa na n lɛ.

english_verse: You have disobeyed me by putting your disgusting idols in my temple, and now the temple itself is disgusting to me.
translation_verse: Juda be basa wora kulubi ko. B ta agbirana nɛ ŋ kishi amo be asheŋ m ba ma bɔrɛlambu to nɛ k wora eyurpi daŋkare be ekpa so.

english_verse: At Topheth in Hinnom Valley you have built altars where you kill your children and burn them as sacrifices to other gods. I would never think of telling you to do this.
translation_verse: Bumo alɛ naŋ pɔr kegbirsure nɛ baa tre Tofɛf na ashi Hinnɔm be ketaŋɛ to, saŋɛ na so baaŋ baa chɔɔ bumo be mbia edɛ to a lara esarga kumo so. N daŋ maŋ yili loŋ n sa bumo fanɛ b baa wora. M maŋ naŋ fɛ kumo be asheŋ gba kuraa.

english_verse: So watch out! Someday that place will no longer be called Topheth or Hinnom Valley. It will be called Slaughter Valley, because you will bury your dead there until you run out of room,
translation_verse: Ŋkpal loŋ so, kachako bee ba nɛ b maaŋ naa tre kakpa na Tofɛf ŋko Hinnɔm be ketaŋɛ, ama baaŋ baa tre kumo Kamɔ be ketaŋɛ. Ndoŋ nɛ baŋ baa puli basa, ŋkpal kakpa ka maaŋ naa wɔtɔ nɛ b puli bubuni so.

english_verse: and then bodies will lie scattered on the ground. Birds and wild animals will come and eat, and no one will be around to scare them off.
translation_verse: Edimɛdi be kebuni beeŋ ki ajibi n sa mbuibi nɛ kupuŋ to be asɔbɔya lubi, nɛ esa kikɛ maaŋ baa wɔtɔ nɛ e baa ju amo.

english_verse: When I am finished with your land, there will be deathly silence in the empty ruins of Jerusalem and the towns of Judah—no happy voices, no sounds of parties or wedding celebrations.
translation_verse: Kasawule na beeŋ ki keshishɛrsawule. Meeŋ shin nɛ kagbenefuliso awɔr nɛ basa beeŋ baa wora na nɛ kejafɔ to be kayurji kikɛ e fo ekar ashi Juda be efuli so nɛ Jerusalɛm be agbembi so.”

english_verse: Then the bones of the dead kings of Judah and their officials will be dug up, along with the bones of the priests, the prophets, and everyone else in Jerusalem
translation_verse: Ade kikɛ be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ le: “Jemanɛ na kaŋ fo Juda be efuli so be bewura nɛ benimuana nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ anebiana nɛ b wu na nɛ basa nɛ b wɔ Jerusalɛm to na kikɛ be awibi beeŋ pulgi nchaŋ to a dese.

english_verse: who loved and worshiped the sun, moon, and stars. These bones will be scattered and left lying on the ground like trash, where the sun and moon and stars can shine on them.
translation_verse: Awibi na beeŋ baa dese nɛ epeŋi nɛ kufɔl nɛ achɛkpabi nɛ baa sha ga nseŋ ta amo ŋ ki agbir a shuŋ na kikɛ e baa nyaŋɛ a yuu amo so. Esa kama maaŋ gama amo abar so ŋko n laŋɛ amo m puli. E beeŋ baa dese kasawule fanɛ epi nna.

english_verse: Some of you people of Judah will be left alive, but I will force you to go to foreign countries, and you will wish you were dead. I, the Lord God All-Powerful, have spoken. The People Took the Wrong Road
translation_verse: Bekama nɛ baaŋ ji efute ashi mboŋ kama nɛ b pesaŋ to n yɔ na so beeŋ baa sha luwu a chɔ ŋkpa. Ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ e kaŋɛ na.” Kulubi nɛ kasogberge be asheŋ

english_verse: The Lord said: People of Jerusalem, when you stumble and fall, you get back up, and if you take a wrong road, you turn around and go back.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ ma fanɛ ŋ kaŋɛ mbe basa le: “Nɛ esa baŋ tɔr, e maŋ naa kpa a ŋini to nna a? Nɛ esa baŋ foe ekpa, e maŋ naa bɛta mbe ayamu so nna a?

english_verse: So why do you refuse to come back to me? Why do you hold so tightly to your false gods?
translation_verse: Ma basa, manɛ e baa nɛ men lar ma kaman nsaa maŋ naa sha kebɛta m ba ma kutɔ? Men far n chɛ menyi be agbirana nna nsaa maŋ naa sha kebɛta m ba ma kutɔ.

english_verse: Storks, doves, swallows, and thrushes all know when it's time to fly away for the winter and when to come back. But you, my people, don't know what I demand.
translation_verse: Etɔkɔrkɔ nyi jemanɛ nɛ a daga e bɛta m ba nɛ elepɔ nɛ abɔrɛpɔpɔbi nɛ etitibi gba nyi jemanɛ ka chɛrga nɛ a daga e naŋ yɔ efuli pɔtɛ so. Ama menyi, nɛ men la ma basa na, maŋ nyi mbra nɛ ŋ kɔ a keni menyi so.

english_verse: You say, “We are wise because we have the teachings and laws of the Lord.” But I say that your teachers have turned my words into lies!
translation_verse: Nuso nɛ menyeeŋ tiŋ ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ men nyi asheŋ nsaa nyi ma mbraana na? Mbraŋinipoana na chɛrga amo nna nɛ e ki efɛ men kutɔ.

english_verse: Your wise men have rejected what I say, and so they have no wisdom. Now they will be trapped and put to shame; they won't know what to do.
translation_verse: Menyi be benyiashempo ka kini ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be kamalga so, baaŋ ji anishinyɔr nseŋ wulto to e maaŋ naa nyi asheŋ.

english_verse: I'll give their wives and fields to strangers. Everyone is greedy and dishonest, whether poor or rich. Even the prophets and priests cannot be trusted.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal loŋ so meeŋ ta bumo be adɔsawule n sa basa pɔtɛ nɛ bumo be beche n sa benyɛn pɔtɛ. Menyi to be betirpo nɛ damawuraana kikɛ bee bɔla kapuni be ekpa so nna a fin amansherbi. Anebiana nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana gba bee puni basa nna.

english_verse: They should be ashamed of the way they live, but they don't even blush. And so, when I punish Judah, they will end up on the ground, dead like everyone else.
translation_verse: Ma basa, anishinyɔr daŋ pɛ menyi nna ŋkpal men ka wora ekishisheŋ ere so a? Anishinyɔr daŋ maŋ pɛ menyi. Menyi maŋ kɔ nyɔmɔ gba kuraa. Ŋkpal loŋ so, menyi alɛ gba beeŋ tɔr fanɛ kananɛ beko daŋ tɔr na. Jemanɛ nɛ meeŋ gberge menyi kusoe na nɛ menyi be kusɔ kama beeŋ fo ekar. Ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ e kaŋɛ na.

english_verse: I will wipe them out. They are vines without grapes; fig trees without figs or leaves. They have not done a thing that I told them! I, the Lord, have spoken. The People and Their Punishment
translation_verse: N daa sha kegama ma basa fanɛ kananɛ edɔpo bee chala mbe adɔjibi abar so nna, ama b du fanɛ kedibi sɔrso nɛ k maŋ kɔ asɔrso kumo so nɛ kumo be afantaŋ gba gbaŋgbaŋ n tɔr to na nna. Amoso nɛ n sa ekpa fanɛ basa pɔtɛ e ba sɔ kasawule na n chena so na.”

english_verse: The people of Judah say to each other, “What are we waiting for? Let's run to a town with walls and die there. We rebelled against the Lord, and we were sentenced to die by drinking poison.
translation_verse: Kede ba kama nɛ Ebɔrɛ be basa na kaŋɛ le: “Manɛ nna nɛ an chena shruum loŋ? Men shin nɛ an shile n yɔ ndegboŋ nɛ b pɔr egbalana ŋ kulti amo na to n ya wu n dese ndoŋ. Enyɛnpe anyi be Ebɔrɛ na teŋ n yili kumo fanɛ anyeeŋ wu. Mo alɛ teŋ n sa anyi kɔrtɔ fanɛ an nu n wu, ŋkpal an ka wora alubi n da mo so so.

english_verse: We had hoped for peace and a time of healing, but all we got was terror.
translation_verse: Anyi daa tama kayurwushi nɛ eyur be alenfia nna, ama kayurnyaŋ gboŋgboŋi e ba anyi so.

english_verse: The people complain, “Spring and summer have come and gone, but still the Lord hasn't rescued us.”
translation_verse: Nɛ basa na malɛ fubel ŋ kaŋɛ le: ‘Kasɔteŋi be jemanɛ choŋ, nɛ kechali malɛ gba choŋ, ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na maŋ naŋ mɔlga anyi.’ ”

english_verse: If medicine and doctors may be found in Gilead, why aren't my people healed?
translation_verse: Anyeeŋ tiŋ n nya adur nɛ bechɛpo ashi Giliad be efuli so. Ama manɛ nna nɛ ma basa maŋ nya kechɛ?

english_verse: I wish that my eyes were fountains of tears, so I could cry day and night for my people who were killed.
translation_verse: N daa yɛlga fanɛ ma kumu beeŋ baa la ketirbu nɛ ma anishi malɛ e baa la kubuye a bul anishichubi, saŋɛ na so meeŋ baa shu kapa nɛ kanyɛ a sa ma basa nɛ b mɔ na.

english_verse: I wish I could go into the desert and find a hiding place from all who are treacherous and unfaithful to God. The Lord Answers Jeremiah
translation_verse: N daa yɛlga kenya kakpa ashi keshishɛrsawule so, nɛ n lar ma basa to n ya chena ndoŋ. Ŋkpal manɛ so, bumo kikɛ maŋ kɔ kashenteŋji n sa Ebɔrɛ, bumo alɛ kikɛ la bedebɔrpo nawule nna.

english_verse: The Lord replied: Lies come from the mouths of my people, like arrows from a bow. With each dishonest deed their power increases, and not one of them will admit that I am God.
translation_verse: Jemanɛ kikɛ b wora shiriya nɛ b baa ku efɛ nna. Kapuni e naa ji kuwura kasawule na so, mannɛ kashenteŋ. Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ le: “Ma basa baŋ lar kulubi ko to baa luri kenyɔsopo to nna, bumo alɛ maŋ nyi fanɛ ma e la bumo be Ebɔrɛ na.”

english_verse: They wear themselves out, always looking for a new way to cheat their friends.
translation_verse: Baa gben bumo be amu nna a fin ekpa popɔr nɛ baŋ bɔla so m puni bumo teriana nna.

english_verse: Everyone takes advantage of everyone else, and no one will admit that I am God.
translation_verse: Ekama baa wɔtɔ nna a puni mo barkasa a ji nna. Ekama malɛ maa shuli so fanɛ ma e la Ebɔrɛ.

english_verse: And so I will purify the hearts of my people just as gold is purified in a furnace. I have no other choice.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal loŋ so nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ le; “Ma basa teŋ wora alubi n da ma so. Manɛ nɛ meeŋ wora bumo nɛ mannɛ kelɔŋɛ bumo so fanɛ kananɛ baa lɔŋɛ kebɛlso so na?

english_verse: Give me one good reason not to punish them as they deserve. I, the Lord All-Powerful, have spoken. Jeremiah Weeps for His People
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na bishi le: A maŋ daga fanɛ ŋ gberge bumo kusoe, ŋko m bishi efuli nɛ k du le ere kuwule a?”

english_verse: I weep for the pastureland in the hill country. It's so barren and scorched that no one travels there. No cattle can be found there, and birds and wild animals have all disappeared.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ le: “Meeŋ shu ŋkpal abee na nɛ asɔbɔya be ejikpa na so. Ŋkpal manɛ so, e wɔl nseŋ ki fanɛ keshishɛrsawule nna, nɛ esa kikɛ maŋ naa bɔla amo so a choŋ. Esa maaŋ naaŋ n nu kusɔbɔya be kushu ndoŋ, mbuibi nɛ kupuŋ to be asɔbɔya kikɛ shile amo so nna.”

english_verse: I heard the Lord reply, “When I am finished, Jerusalem and the towns of Judah will be piles of ruins where only jackals live.” Why the Land Was Destroyed
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ le: “Meeŋ shin nɛ Jerusalɛm e ki kelambure a dese, a la kakpa nɛ ejiŋkaamu beeŋ baa wɔ; nɛ Juda be efuli so be ndegboŋ e ki keshishɛrsawule, a la kakpa nɛ esa kama maaŋ naa wɔ.”

english_verse: So I, the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, promise them poison to eat and drink.
translation_verse: Amoso nɛ ma, Enyɛnpetale Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na nase kɔnɔ fanɛ meeŋ sa ma basa ajibi kekera nɛ b ji nseŋ sa bumo nchu nɛ kɔrtɔ wɔ amo to nɛ b nuu.

english_verse: I'll scatter them in foreign countries that they and their ancestors have never even heard of. Finally, I will send enemy soldiers to kill every last one of them. The Women Who Are Paid To Weep
translation_verse: Ma alɛ beeŋ shin nɛ b pesaŋ to n yɔ efuli pɔtɛana nɛ bumo ŋko bumo nananyɛnana maŋ naŋ nu amo be asheŋ ŋ ku so. Meeŋ naŋ shin nɛ benapo e ba kɔ bumo m mur bumo cheche.” Jerusalɛm to ebi ka shu n fin kechɛto be asheŋ

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful said, “Make arrangements now for the women who are paid to weep at funerals, especially the women who can cry the loudest.”
translation_verse: Ade be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ le: “Fɛ kusɔ nɛ k bee wora ere be asheŋ! Shuŋi n tre beche nɛ baa tiŋ a shu nli a karga nsaa tiŋ a boŋ awɔba ga na nɛ b ba.”

english_verse: The people answered, “Let them come quickly and cry for us, until our own eyes are flooded with tears.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ basa na kaŋɛ le: “Kaŋɛ beche na nɛ b nya manaŋ m boŋ awɔba n sa anyi; saŋɛ na so anyeeŋ shu m bure anishi.”

english_verse: Now those of us on Zion cry, ‘We are ruined! We can't stand the shame. Our homes have been destroyed, and we must leave our land.’
translation_verse: Naniere, le nɛ anyi nɛ an wɔ Zayɔn na bee shu a kaŋɛ: “An mur nna na! An ji nyɔmɔ pasaa! Anyi be nwu kikɛ mur, nɛ a daga fanɛ an lar anyi gbagba be kasawule so.”

english_verse: “We ask you women to pay attention to what the Lord says. We will teach you a funeral song that you can teach your daughters and friends:
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ le: “Beche, men nu kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ bee kaŋɛ, nseŋ laŋɛ menyi be lakal m ba mbe mmalga na so. Men ŋini menyi be bibiche kananɛ baa shu nli a karga, nɛ men teriana kananɛ baa boŋ awɔba.

english_verse: ‘We were in our fortress, but death sneaked in through our windows. It even struck down children at play and our strongest young men.’
translation_verse: Luwu bɔla anyi be etokuro to n luri mboŋ lempoana nɛ amo to be keluri du kpakpa na to. K mɔ anyi be mbia n lɛ agbembi so nseŋ mɔ anyi be mbifɔlbi n lɛ alɔnɛ so.

english_verse: “The Lord has told us the ground will be covered with dead bodies, like ungathered stalks of grain or manure in a field.” What the Lord Likes Best
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na teŋ kaŋɛ anyi fanɛ bubuni beeŋ dese kasawule na be kaplɛkama fanɛ b ka ŋele ayu n nase a jo keteŋi, ŋko fanɛ epi ka dese n sɔ kaplɛkama na.”

english_verse: If you feel you must brag, then have enough sense to brag about worshiping me, the Lord. What I like best is showing kindness, justice, and mercy to everyone on earth.
translation_verse: Bekama nɛ baa sha kepuchi, b baa puchi ŋkpal b ka bee shuŋ ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na so. Ŋkpal manɛ so, ma kasha maa chɛrga, kusɔ nɛ k bɔla ekpa nseŋ niŋi nɛ mee wora. Asɔ nɛ e bee par ma nna na. Ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ e kaŋɛ na.”

english_verse: The Lord said: Listen to me, you people of Israel. Don't follow the customs of those nations who become frightened when they see something strange happen in the sky.
translation_verse: E yɛ: “Men sa maa kute efuli pɔtɛana na be basa to a wora asheŋ. Menyi alɛ e sa maŋ shin nɛ asheŋ nɛ e bee wora awɔlpa so a ta kufu a da efuli pɔtɛana na be basa na, e baa ta kufu a da menyi alɛ gba.

english_verse: Their religion is worthless! They chop down a tree, carve the wood into an idol,
translation_verse: Basa ere be kabɔrɛshuŋ maŋ kɔ kechɛto kikɛ n sa bumo. Baa ku kupo to be ndibi nna a shɛl amo ŋ ki agbir.

english_verse: cover it with silver and gold, and then nail it down so it won't fall over.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ b ŋalga shuwa nɛ gbiti n wurge amo so nseŋ gbir amo anyembi n yili nɛ e sa maŋ melgi n tɔr kasawule.

english_verse: An idol is no better than a scarecrow. It can't speak, and it has to be carried, because it can't walk. Why worship an idol that can't help or harm you? Jeremiah Praises the Lord
translation_verse: Le be agbirana ere du fanɛ asɔ nɛ b ta n yili ndɔ to a ju mbuibi nna. E kɔ nnɔ, amo alɛ maa malga; e kɔ aya amo alɛ maa nite! Amoso baa sulɔ amo nna a nite. Men sa maa ŋana amo; ŋkpal manɛ so, e maaŋ tiŋ n wora menyi shɛŋ. Amo alɛ maaŋ tiŋ n wora kesheŋ lela kikɛ n sa menyi.”

english_verse: You are King of the nations. Everyone should worship you. No human anywhere on earth is wiser than you.
translation_verse: Fo e naa ji efuliana na kikɛ so kuwura. Ekama daga fanɛ e maŋkura fo ga nna. Ashi durnya ere to be kaplɛkama, dimɛdi kikɛ maŋ nyi asheŋ a chɔ fo.

english_verse: Idols are worthless, and anyone who worships them is a fool!
translation_verse: Agbirana maŋ kɔ tɔnɔ nɛ kechɛto kikɛ n sa basa. Esa kama nɛ e bee shuŋ amo la ewulpo nna.

english_verse: You, Lord, are the only true and living God. You will rule for all time. When you are angry the earth shakes, and nations are destroyed.
translation_verse: Ama fo, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na, e la Ebɔrɛ kashenteŋto. Fo e naa sa ŋkpa nsaa wɔ ŋkpa to na; fo alɛ e la ewura nɛ e wɔtɔ mbaanaayɔ na. Fo baŋ nya agbo, durnya kikɛ bee gbuŋgbuŋ to nna, nɛ efuliana bee mur.

english_verse: You told me to say that idols did not create the heavens and the earth, and that you, the Lord, will destroy every idol.
translation_verse: Fo yɛ ŋ kaŋɛ basa fanɛ, mannɛ agbirana e to ebɔrɛso nɛ kasawule; fo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na malɛ beeŋ mur kegbir kikɛ nɛ edimɛdi lɔŋɛ.

english_verse: With your wisdom and power you created the earth and spread out the heavens.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e bɔla mbe eleŋgboŋ so n to durnya; e bɔla mbe kanyiasheŋ so nna n to durnya nseŋ parga awɔlpa to m buu kaplɛkama so.

english_verse: The waters in the heavens roar at your command. You make clouds appear— you send the winds from your storehouse and make lightning flash in the rain.
translation_verse: Mo e naa malga nɛ awɔlto be nchuana bee baga to a gbri, mo alɛ e naa shin nɛ awɔlpa bee deŋi durnya be kaplɛkama. Mo e naa shin nɛ bɔrɛ bee ba nsaa nyɛkpɛ nɛ afu bee shi kakpa nɛ e yili kumo na a ba.

english_verse: Idols are merely a joke, and when the time is right, they will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Agbirana na maŋ kɔ tɔnɔ, a daga basa e wora amo eyurto nna nseŋ kini amo n lɛ. Kachɛ na kaŋ fo, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ mur amo kikɛ.

english_verse: But you, Israel's God, created all things, and you chose Israel to be your very own. Your name is the Lord All-Powerful. Judah Will Be Thrown from Its Land
translation_verse: Ama Ebɔrɛ nɛ an nananyɛn Jeekɔb daŋ shuŋ na bre maŋ du fanɛ agbirana na. Mo e to kusɔ kama nseŋ lara Israɛl be basa fanɛ b baa la mo gbagba be basa. Mbe ketre e la Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na. Kemurgboŋ nɛ k bee ba na be asheŋ

english_verse: The Lord said these troubles will lead to your capture, and he will throw you from this land like a rock from a sling.”
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee sha kelara menyi kasawule ere so nna na. E beeŋ shin nɛ men doŋana e ta kenishi m pere menyi nseŋ tintiŋ menyi n lar men be kasawule so. Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ e kaŋɛ na.”

english_verse: The people answered, “We are wounded and doomed to die. Why did we say we could stand the pain?
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ basa na kaŋɛ le: “Kumo ere anyeeŋ wu asheŋ pasaa! Anyi be awurfoŋ maaŋ loge kikɛ. An daa fɛ fanɛ anyeeŋ tiŋ n ji ebesa nɛ awurfoŋ na be kanyiti nna.

english_verse: Our homes are destroyed; our children are dead. No one is left to help us find shelter.”
translation_verse: Anyi be elaŋana mur; nɛ anyi be mbia wu ŋ ka anyi. Esa kikɛ maŋ naa wɔtɔ nɛ e chɛ anyi to n fin echenakpa.”

english_verse: I know, Lord, that we humans are not in control of our own lives.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, n nyi fanɛ anyi edimɛdi maŋ kɔ anyi be ŋkpa so be eleŋ.

english_verse: Correct me, as I deserve, but not in your anger, or I will be dead.
translation_verse: Ŋini fo basa akpa, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, ama sa maŋ kaŋ nyaŋ anyi ga ŋko ŋ gberge anyi kusoe kanya agbo so; nɛ mannɛ aloŋ anyeeŋ wu.

english_verse: Our enemies refuse to admit that you are God or to worship you. They have wiped out our people and left our nation lying in ruins. So get angry and sweep them away!
translation_verse: Shin nɛ fo agbo e laŋɛ efuliana nɛ b kini kesɔ fo fanɛ bumo be Ebɔrɛ a maa shuŋ fo na. Ŋkpal manɛ so, b mɔ fo basa m mur cheche n shin nɛ anyi be efuli bure a dese fuloŋ.

english_verse: The Lord God told me to say to the people of Judah and Jerusalem: I, the Lord, am warning you that I will put a curse on anyone who doesn't keep the agreement I made with Israel. So pay attention to what it says.
translation_verse: Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ ma fanɛ ŋ kaŋɛ Juda be efuli so nɛ Jerusalɛm be kade to be basa le: “Ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee kpele menyi kusoe nna fanɛ meeŋ shoduu esa kama nɛ e kini kebɛ kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre nɛ ma nɛ Israɛl be basa wora na so. Men shin nɛ menyi be lakal e baa wɔ kusɔ nɛ ŋkre na bee kaŋɛ so.

english_verse: My commands haven't changed since I brought your ancestors out of Egypt, a nation that seemed like a blazing furnace where iron ore is melted. I told your ancestors that if they obeyed my commands, I would be their God, and they would be my people.
translation_verse: K la kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre nɛ ma nɛ bumo nanaana wora nna jemanɛ nɛ n daŋ lara bumo ashi Ijipt be efuli so nɛ k daa du fanɛ edɛ wuloŋwuloŋ n sa bumo nɛ b daŋ ji awurfoŋ ga kumo to na nna. N daŋ yili kumo nna n sa bumo fanɛ b baa wora asheŋ nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ kenishipereso na, saŋɛ na so, baaŋ baa la ma basa nɛ ma alɛ e baa la bumo be Ebɔrɛ.

english_verse: Then the Lord told me to say to everyone on the streets of Jerusalem and in the towns of Judah: Pay attention to the commands in my agreement with you.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ ma le: “Yɔ Juda be ndeana to nɛ Jerusalɛm be agbembi so n ya ber kebomboŋ ŋ kaŋɛ basa na fanɛ b nu kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre na be asheŋ be kananɛ e kaŋɛ nseŋ wora amo kasonu.

english_verse: Ever since I brought your ancestors out of Egypt, I have been telling your people to obey me. But you and your ancestors
translation_verse: Baŋ yili jemanɛ nɛ n lara bumo nanaana Ijipt be efuli so hale m ba fo kabre, m baa kpele bumo kusoe nna fanɛ b baa wora ma kasonu.

english_verse: have always been stubborn. You have refused to listen, and instead you have done whatever your sinful hearts have desired. You have not kept the agreement we made, so I will make you suffer every curse that goes with it.
translation_verse: Ama b maŋ wora ma kasonu. Kusɔ nɛ b wora e la fanɛ, bumo be ekama kraa wɔ bumo be kagbene kpakpaso to nna a wora asheŋ lubi. N daŋ kaŋɛ bumo kenishipereso nna fanɛ b baa bɛ kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre na so, ama b kini kebɛ kumo so. Amoso nɛ n shin nɛ kasogberge nɛ e wɔ kumo to na ba bumo so na.”

english_verse: The Lord said to me: Jeremiah, the people of Judah and Jerusalem are plotting against me.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ ma le: “Juda be efuli so nɛ Jerusalɛm to be basa bee kre asheŋ lubi a laŋɛ ma kaplɛa so nna.

english_verse: They have sinned in the same way their ancestors did, by turning from me and worshiping other gods. The northern kingdom of Israel broke the agreement I made with your ancestors, and now the southern kingdom of Judah has done the same.
translation_verse: Kananɛ bumo nananyɛnana daŋ kini kenu ma mmalga nseŋ shuŋ agbir pɔtɛana nseŋ bɔla amo so n wora kulubi na nɛ bumo alɛ gba bee wora na. Juda nɛ Jerusalɛm to be basa kikɛ kini kewora m bɛ kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre nɛ ma nɛ bumo nanaana wora na so nna.

english_verse: Here is what I've decided to do. I will bring suffering on the people of Judah and Jerusalem, and no one will escape. They will beg me to help, but I won't listen to their prayers.
translation_verse: Amoso ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ shin nɛ b ji awurfoŋ ga. Nɛ b kaa shu a fin ma kechɛto, m maaŋ tuge bumo.

english_verse: Then they will offer sacrifices to their other gods and ask them for help. After all, the people of Judah have more gods than towns, and more shameful altars for Baal than there are streets in Jerusalem. But those gods won't be able to rescue the people of Judah from disaster.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, Juda be efuli so be kadegboŋ kikɛ to kɔ agbir nɛ Jerusalɛm to be kegbembi kikɛ ase kɔ kegbirsure nɛ baa lara esarga kumo so a sa kegbir nɛ baa tre Baal nɛ kumo be asheŋ bee nu agbo ga na.

english_verse: Jeremiah, don't pray for these people or beg me to rescue them. If you do, I won't listen, and I certainly won't listen if they pray!
translation_verse: Jɛremaya, sa maŋ kule Ebɔrɛ n sa basa ere ŋko ŋ kule ma fanɛ m mɔlga bumo. Nɛ b kaa ji awurfoŋ nseŋ kule ma, m maaŋ nu bumo be kekule na.”

english_verse: Then the Lord told me to say to the people of Judah: You are my chosen people, but you have no right to be here in my temple, doing such evil things. The sacrifices you offer me won't protect you from disaster, so stop celebrating.
translation_verse: Kede be kaman, nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ ma fanɛ ŋ kaŋɛ Juda be basa le: “Men la ma basa laraso nna, ama menyi maŋ kɔ ekpa nɛ men baa wɔ ma bɔrɛlambu to a wora asheŋ lubi lubi ere. Esarga nɛ menyee lara a sa ma ere maaŋ tiŋ ŋ kuŋ menyi ashi kemurgboŋ na to, amoso men yige kusɔ nɛ menyee wora ere.

english_verse: Once you were like an olive tree covered with fruit. But soon I will send a noisy mob to break off your branches and set you on fire.
translation_verse: Jemanɛ ko n daŋ ta bumo nna fanɛ kedibi nɛ baa tre ɔlif nɛ k kɔ asɔrso lela ga na, ama naniere meeŋ shin nɛ kakpa a gbri fanɛ bɔrɛ ka ponte na nɛ afantaŋ na e suse so nɛ ayabi na malɛ e buri n tɔr.

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful. You people of Judah were like a tree that I had planted, but you have made me angry by offering sacrifices to Baal, just as the northern kingdom did. And now I'm going to pull you up by the roots. The Plot To Kill Jeremiah *
translation_verse: Ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na e duu Israɛl nɛ Juda be basa fanɛ kedibi, ama naniere meeŋ shin nɛ kemur gboŋgboŋi e ba bumo so. Bumo gbagba e bar kumo be loŋ ŋkpal b ka wora kulubi so. B lara esarga nna n sa kegbir nɛ baa tre Baal na n shin nɛ ma kagbene kaa bumo so.” B ka kre Jɛremaya be kemɔ be asheŋ

english_verse: Some people plotted to kill me. And like a lamb being led to the butcher, I knew nothing about their plans.
translation_verse: Ade kikɛ be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na shin nɛ m pin nia lubi nɛ ndoŋana daa kre a laŋɛ ma kaplɛa so.

english_verse: I prayed, “Lord All-Powerful, you always do what is right, and you know every thought. So I trust you to help me and to take revenge.”
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ ŋ kule Ebɔrɛ ŋ kaŋɛ le: “Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ, fo e naa ji asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so. Fo alɛ nyi basa be ŋgbene nɛ nfɛra kikɛ to. N ta demu ere nna a wɔtɔ fo enɔ to. Amoso ka basa ere kumo be kukɔ n sa ma.”

english_verse: Then the Lord said: Jeremiah, some men from Anathoth say they will kill you, if you keep on speaking for me.
translation_verse: Anatɔf be kade to be basa daa sha kemɔ ma nna, nseŋ fiɛ ma so ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ n yige kebaabɔ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be kubɔya, nɛ mannɛ aloŋ baaŋ mɔ ma.

english_verse: But I will punish them. Their young men will die in battle, and their children will starve to death.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na malɛ kaŋɛ le: “Meeŋ gberge bumo kusoe! Bumo be mbrantiɛ beeŋ wu kena to nɛ akoŋ e mɔ bumo be mbia wurbi malɛ.

english_verse: And when I am finished, no one from their families will be left alive.
translation_verse: N teŋ yili jemanɛ nɛ kemurgboŋ na beeŋ ba Anatɔf be basa so, kumo alɛ kaŋ fo, bumo be ekama maaŋ ji efute.”

english_verse: You plant them like trees; you let them prosper and produce fruit. Yet even when they praise you, they don't mean it.
translation_verse: Fo e duu bumo fanɛ ndibi nɛ baa mur achin, nsaa daŋ a sɔr asɔrso. B baa malga fo asheŋ lela gba be asheŋ, k maa shi bumo be ŋgbene to.

english_verse: But you know, Lord, how faithful I've always been, even in my thoughts. So drag my enemies away and butcher them like sheep!
translation_verse: Ama, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, fo nyi ma nɛnɛ. Fee wu kusɔ nɛ mee wora nsaa nyi kananɛ mee sha fo. Amoso Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, gberge n doŋana n ya mɔ fanɛ mbolpɔ.

english_verse: How long will the ground be dry and the pasturelands parched? The birds and animals are dead and gone. And all of this happened because the people are so sinful. They even brag, “God can't see the sins we commit.” The Lord Answers Jeremiah
translation_verse: Nfɛ afanɛ nɛ ewule beeŋ baa wɔ anyi be kasawule so, nɛ kaplɛkama be afitiri e wu nsaa maaŋ naa wɔtɔ? Asɔbɔya nɛ mbuibi kikɛ bee wu nna ŋkpal anyi be basa be lubi so. Ba kaa puchi a kaŋɛ le nna: “Ebɔrɛ maa wu kusɔ nɛ anyee wora.”

english_verse: Jeremiah, if you get tired in a race against people, how can you possibly run against horses? If you fall in open fields, what will happen in the forest along the Jordan River?
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ le: “Jɛremaya, fo ketu edimɛdi n shile ka bee nu fo ere, feeŋ tiŋ n tu egbaŋɛ n shile nna ere a? Fo ka bee shile kakpa lela nsaa fiti a tɔr ere, feeŋ tiŋ n shile kupuŋ nɛ k dese m mata Jɔɔdan be lɔrgboŋ na to nna ere a?

english_verse: Even your own family has turned against you. They act friendly, but don't trust them. They're out to get you, and so is everyone else. The Lord Is Furious with His People
translation_verse: Fo kurgepoana nɛ fo kanaŋ to be basa kikɛ debɔr fo. B tu basa nɛ baa tɔrɔ fo ga na nna a tɔrɔ fo. Nɛ baa malga nɛnɛ a laŋɛ fo kaplɛa so gba, sa maŋ kaŋ yirda bumo.” Ebɔrɛ be kagbene ka jija mo ŋkpal mbe basa so be asheŋ

english_verse: I loved my people and chose them as my very own. But now I will reject them and hand them over to their enemies.
translation_verse: Kede be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ le: “Ŋ kini Israɛl be basa n lɛ nna. Ma alɛ kini efuli nɛ n lara n sa ma kumu n lɛ. Basa nɛ mee sha nɛ n ta m bɔɔ bumo doŋana enɔ.

english_verse: My people have turned against me and roar at me like lions. That's why I hate them.
translation_verse: Ma basa laraso e pal kaman n sa ma na. B ki fanɛ ebuluŋ nna a muni ma ashi kupo to, ŋkpal loŋ so nɛ n nya agbo n wɔtɔ bumo.

english_verse: My people are like a hawk surrounded and attacked by other hawks. Tell the wild animals to come and eat their fill.
translation_verse: Ma basa laraso ki fanɛ kabuibi nɛ e bee ji eblaŋ nɛ kumo braana ba kulti kumo n wɔtɔ nseŋ mɔ kumo a ji nna. Tre kupuŋ to be asɔbɔya lubi nɛ amo alɛ gba e ba ti so n ji kumo m moɛ.

english_verse: My people, you planted wheat, but because I was furious, I let only weeds grow. You wore yourselves out and gained only shame! The Lord Will Have Pity on Other Nations
translation_verse: Ma basa daŋ dɔ n duu ayu, ama afitiri nɛ b teŋi. B daŋ shuŋ ŋ gben ga, ama bumo alɛ maŋ nya shɛŋ kumo to. Ŋkpal ŋ ka daŋ nya agbo ga so, bumo be adɔjibi daŋ maŋ wora n sa bumo.” Enyɛnpe ka nase kɔnɔ n sa Israɛl be bechenashapoana be asheŋ

english_verse: The Lord said: I gave this land to my people Israel, but enemies around it have attacked and robbed it. So I will uproot them from their own countries just as I will uproot Judah from its land.
translation_verse: Ade kikɛ be kaman, nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ le: “Ŋ kɔ kusɔ ko nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ a laŋɛ Israɛl be bechenashapo lubi nɛ b mur kasawule nɛ n ta n sa ma basa Israɛlebi na be kaplɛa so. Meeŋ lara basa lubi ere bumo be efuliana so fanɛ kananɛ baa tia kusɔduuso na. Meeŋ kɔ n suge Juda be basa bumo be enɔ to.

english_verse: But later, I will have pity on these nations and bring them back to their own lands.
translation_verse: Kede be kaman, meeŋ naŋ wu efuliana ere kuwɔr nseŋ bɛta bumo n yɔ bumo gbagba be efuliana be nsawule so.

english_verse: They once taught my people to worship Baal. But if they admit I am the only true God, and if they let my people teach them how to worship me, these nations will also become my people.
translation_verse: Jemanɛ ko b daŋ ŋini ma basa kananɛ baa shuŋ kegbir nɛ baa tre Baal na nna. Ama nɛ b shuli so fanɛ ma e la kashenteŋ be Ebɔrɛ na nseŋ shin nɛ ma basa ŋini bumo kananɛ baaŋ baa shuŋ ma bre, meeŋ shin nɛ efuli pɔtɛana ere be basa gba e ki ma basa.

english_verse: However, if they don't listen to me, I will uproot them from their lands and completely destroy them. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Ama nɛ b kini kenu n sa ma, kumo ere meeŋ lara bumo efuliana na so nseŋ mur amo cheche. Ma Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ e kaŋɛ na.”

english_verse: The Lord told me, “Go and buy a pair of linen shorts. Wear them for a while, but don't wash them.”
translation_verse: Ade be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ ma fanɛ n ya tɔ wajɛchɛbi lela be dɔkɔri n dela. Kumo be kaman nɛ e naŋ kaŋɛ ma fanɛ n sa maŋ kaŋ ta kumo n wɔtɔ nchu to.

english_verse: So I bought a pair of shorts and put them on.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ n tɔ dɔkɔri n dela.

english_verse: “Take off the shorts. Go to Parah and hide the shorts in a crack between some large rocks.”
translation_verse: “Ta dɔkɔri na n yɔ Yufreetes be Lɔrgboŋ na ase n ya puli kefalta be kemaŋ to.”

english_verse: Some time later the Lord said, “Go back and get the shorts.”
translation_verse: Jemanɛ ko ka fo nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ fanɛ n ya lara edɔkɔri na ashi Yufreetes be Lɔrgboŋ na ase.

english_verse: I went back and dug the shorts out of their hiding place, but the cloth had rotted, and the shorts were ruined.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ n yɔ ndoŋ n ya wu fanɛ dɔkɔri na wu nsaa maŋ naa walɛ kedela.

english_verse: Jeremiah, I will use Babylonia to destroy the pride of the people of Judah and Jerusalem.
translation_verse: “Kananɛ meeŋ mur Juda nɛ Jerusalɛm be basa be kamoowu nɛ b kɔ na nna na.

english_verse: The people of Judah are evil and stubborn. So instead of listening to me, they do whatever they want and even worship other gods. When I am finished with these people, they will be good for nothing, just like this pair of shorts.
translation_verse: Le be basa lubi ere kini kewora ma kasonu. B wora bumo be amu nɛ ŋgbene kpakpa nna nseŋ kini kebaashuŋ ma n ya kaa shuŋ agbirana. Amoso baaŋ ki fanɛ dɔkɔri nɛ k wu nsaa maŋ naa kɔ tɔnɔ kikɛ na.

english_verse: These shorts were tight around your waist, and that's how tightly I held onto the kingdoms of Israel and Judah. I wanted them to be my people. I wanted to make them famous, so that other nations would praise and honor me, but they refused to obey me. Wine Jars The Lord said:
translation_verse: Kananɛ dɔkɔri bee yili esa be kashɛr to nɛnɛ na nɛ n daa sha Israɛl nɛ Juda be basa kikɛ e baa yil ma kaman. N daa sha fanɛ efuli kama so ebi e pin fanɛ b la ma basa nna, saŋɛ na so baaŋ baa kpaŋ ma nsaa maŋkura ma. Ama b kini kewora ma kasonu.” Yabra be mpuya be asheŋ

english_verse: Jeremiah, tell the people of Judah, “The Lord God of Israel orders you to fill your wine jars with wine.” They will answer, “Of course we fill our wine jars with wine! Why are you telling us something we already know?”
translation_verse: Ade kikɛ be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ ma le: “Jɛremaya, kaŋɛ Israɛl be basa na fanɛ b shin nɛ bumo be beche e wora yabra m bɔlɔ yabra be kapuya kikɛ so. Bumo alɛ beeŋ kaŋɛ fo fanɛ bumo alɛ gba nyi fanɛ a daga b wora yabra m bɔlɔ yabra be kapuya kikɛ so.

english_verse: Then say to them: I am the Lord, and what I'm going to do will make everyone in Judah and Jerusalem appear to be full of wine. And the worst ones will be the kings of David's family and the priests and the prophets.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ fo kaŋɛ bumo fanɛ ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ shin nɛ basa nɛ b wɔ kasawule ere so kikɛ e nuu yabra m boo. Bewura nɛ b shi Ewura Deevid be kanaŋ to nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ anebiana nɛ Jerusalɛm to be basa kikɛ beeŋ nuu amo m boo.

english_verse: Then I will smash them against each other like jars. I will have no pity on the young or the old, and they will all be destroyed. I, the Lord, have spoken. The People of Judah Will Be Taken Away
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ n ta bumo ŋ ŋmɛa abar fanɛ mpuya nɛ b bure. M maaŋ wu basakpar ŋko mbifɔlbi kikɛ kuwɔr. Bumo kikɛ beeŋ wu m mur. Ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ e kaŋɛ na.” B ka beeŋ pɛ Juda be basa anya n yɔ efuli pɔtɛ so be asheŋ

english_verse: People of Judah, don't be too proud to listen to what the Lord has said.
translation_verse: Juda be basa, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e naa malga na! E yɛ men bar menyi be amu kaseto nseŋ nu n sa mo.

english_verse: You hope for light, but God is sending darkness. Evening shadows already deepen in the hills. So return to God and confess your sins to him before you trip and fall.
translation_verse: Men baa maŋkura Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na; saŋɛ na so e maaŋ shin nɛ tentembiri e ba menyi so nɛ men baa nite a fiti a tɔr abee so. Men baa maŋkura mo, saŋɛ na so e maaŋ shin nɛ kefulto nɛ menyee tama na e ki tentembiri mina n sa menyi.

english_verse: If you are too proud to listen, I will weep alone. Tears will stream from my eyes when the Lord's people are taken away as prisoners.
translation_verse: Ama nɛ men kini kenu n sa ma bre, meeŋ kpal menyi be kamoowuso n shu ashiri to. Meeŋ shu kenishipereso nɛ anishichubi a lar ma anishi to ŋkpal b ka beeŋ pɛ menyi nɛ men la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be basa n yɔ efuli pɔtɛana so fanɛ anya so.

english_verse: The Lord told me to tell you that your king and his mother must surrender their thrones and remove their crowns.
translation_verse: Ade kikɛ be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ le: “Kaŋɛ ewura nɛ mo nio nɛ b koso bumo be nwurputi so nseŋ gbaŋ bumo be awurwuro lela n nase.

english_verse: Jerusalem, you were so proud of ruling the people of Judah. But where are they now? Look north, and you will see your enemies approaching.
translation_verse: Jerusalɛm, to kenishi ŋ keni, fo doŋana e shi kelargato be esoso be kaba so a ba na! Nnɛ nɛ basa nɛ fee keni so nsaa kpal bumo so a wu fo kumu na naa wɔ?

english_verse: You once trusted them to help, but now I'll let them rule you. What do you say about that? You will be in pain like a woman giving birth.
translation_verse: Nɛ basa nɛ fo tama fanɛ b la fo teriana kaŋ ba kɔ m pɔɔ fo so nsaa ji fo so kuwura, manɛ nɛ feeŋ kaŋɛ? Feeŋ baa wɔ ebesa to fanɛ eche nɛ kakurge ta mo na nna.

english_verse: Do you know why your clothes were torn off and you were abused? It was because of your terrible sins.
translation_verse: Fo kaŋ bishi fo kumu fanɛ manɛ e ba nɛ b delge ma so nseŋ pur ma ere? Feeŋ pin fanɛ fo asheŋ lubi so nɛ loŋ wora.

english_verse: Can you ever change and do what's right? Can people change the color of their skin, or can a leopard remove its spots? If so, then maybe you can change and learn to do right.
translation_verse: Edimɛdi beeŋ tiŋ n chɛrga bumo be kayurwule a? Karmɛ beeŋ tiŋ n chɛrga kumo be eyur so be chɛchɛrɛ na a? Nɛ baaŋ tiŋ n chɛrga bre, fo alɛ gba beeŋ tiŋ n chɛrga fo asheŋ lubi nawule na to nsaa wora asheŋ niŋiso.

english_verse: I will scatter you, just as the desert wind blows husks from grain tossed in the air.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ shin nɛ fo basa e pesaŋ to n sɔ kaplɛkama fanɛ kananɛ afu bee sulɔ amimi a yɔ kaplɛkama na.

english_verse: I won't change my mind. I, the Lord, have spoken. You rejected me and worshiped false gods. *
translation_verse: E yɛ kusɔ nɛ k beeŋ nya menyi nna na. Kusɔ nɛ e kre kewora fo basa nna na, ŋkpal b ka teŋ mo so nseŋ yirda agbirana nɛ e maŋ kɔ kashenteŋ so.

english_verse: You were married to me, but you were unfaithful. You even became a prostitute by worshiping disgusting gods on hilltops and in fields.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na gbagba e naŋ delge fo so n shin nɛ fo ji anishinyɔr.

english_verse: When there had been no rain for a long time, the Lord told me to say to the people:
translation_verse: Ewule ka daŋ yili jemanɛ tenteŋ ko nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ ma fanɛ ŋ kaŋɛ basa na le:

english_verse: Judah and Jerusalem weep as the land dries up.
translation_verse: “Juda be efuli so nɛ Jerusalɛm to ebi bee shu ŋkpal kasawule na ka wɔl a dese so.

english_verse: Rulers send their servants to the storage pits for water. But there's none to be found; they return in despair with their jars still empty.
translation_verse: Damawuraana shuŋi bumo be nyɛrbi nɛ mbita eboŋ to, nɛ b yɔ atirbu chiŋgeliŋ to nɛ b ya jɔ nchu, ama b maŋ nya nchu nɛ b jɔ. Ndoŋ nna nɛ aba pɔ bumo nɛ b bɛta nɛ mpuya fuloŋ.

english_verse: There has been no rain, and farmers feel sick as they watch cracks appear in the dry ground.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal bɔrɛ ka maa ba nɛ kasawule wɔl a dese so; bedɔpo be ŋgbene jija bumo ga nna nɛ b ta bumo be anishi a ŋana.

english_verse: A deer gives birth in a field, then abandons her newborn fawn and leaves in search of grass.
translation_verse: Kupuŋ to be echibir gba shile nna nseŋ ka bumo be bibi popɔrbi n lɛ, ŋkpal afitiri ka maŋ wɔtɔ nɛ b ji so.

english_verse: Wild donkeys go blind from starvation. So they stand on barren hilltops and sniff the air, hoping to smell green grass. The Lord's People Pray
translation_verse: Kupuŋ to be ekurma yili abeebi be awɔlto nna a fute yeŋayeŋa fanɛ ejiŋkaamu. B maŋ naa wu nɛnɛ gba, ŋkpal b ka maŋ naa nya afitiri a ji so.

english_verse: Did this disaster take you by surprise? Are you a warrior with your hands tied? You have chosen us, and your temple is here. Don't abandon us! The Lord's Answer
translation_verse: Manɛ nna nɛ fee wora asheŋ fanɛ esa nɛ asheŋ purgi loŋ, ŋko fanɛ enapo nɛ e maŋ kɔ eleŋ nɛ e tiŋ n chɛ esa to? Fo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na wɔ anyi kutɔ kashenteŋto nna! An la fo basa nna nɛ fo bɔrɛlambu wɔ anyi kutɔ nfe, amoso, sa maŋ kini anyi n lɛ.’ ”
