english_verse: I will punish Marduk, the god of Babylon, and make him vomit out everything he gobbled up. Then nations will no longer bring him gifts, and Babylon's walls will crumble. The Lord Offers Hope to His People
translation_verse: Meeŋ gberge Babilɔn be kegbir nɛ baa tre Maaduk na kusoe, nseŋ shin nɛ k laŋɛ asɔ nɛ k yuri na n sa amowuraana. Kumo be kaman efuli pɔtɛana be basa maaŋ naŋ bar ŋkɛ m ba bunyaŋ kumo. Nɛ Babilɔn be egbalana e bure n tɔr.”

english_verse: Get out of Babylon, my people, and run for your lives, before I strike the city in my anger!
translation_verse: Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ le: “Ma basa, Israɛlebi, men lar Babilɔn to; men shile m mɔlga menyi be amu pɔɛŋ nɛ ma agbo e gbelge kadegboŋ na so!

english_verse: Don't be afraid or lose hope, though year after year there are rumors of leaders fighting for control in the city of Babylon.
translation_verse: Kafɛ kikɛ menyee nu b yɛ b yɛ, fanɛ kebagato bee ba kasawule na so, ŋko ewurjipo ko beeŋ kɔ ewurjipo nyɔsopo kena. Ama men sa maa lɔ kufu ŋko a pɔ aba, ŋkpal b yɛ b yɛ ere so.

english_verse: The time will come when I will punish Babylon's false gods. Everyone there will die, and the whole nation will be disgraced,
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, jemanɛ ko bee ba, nɛ ŋ gberge Babilɔn be agbirana kusoe. Esa kama nɛ e wɔ efuli na so beeŋ wu, nɛ efuli na be basa kikɛ e ji anishinyɔr.

english_verse: when an army attacks from the north and brings destruction. Then the earth and the heavens and everything in them will celebrate.
translation_verse: Saŋɛ na so nɛ kusɔ kama nɛ k wɔ ebɔrɛso nɛ kasawule so kikɛ beeŋ wora awɔr kagbenefuliso, ŋkpal bedoŋ ka beeŋ shi kelargato be esoso be kaba so m ba kɔ Babilɔn m mur kumo so.

english_verse: Babylon must be overthrown, because it slaughtered the people of Israel and of many other nations.
translation_verse: Babilɔn gba daga fanɛ k bure, ŋkpal kumo be basa ka mɔ ma basa Israɛlebi nɛ durnya to be efuli damtaana be basa so.

english_verse: You feel ashamed and disgraced, because foreigners have entered my sacred temple.
translation_verse: Anishinyɔr nɛ nyɔmɔ kɔ menyi nna ŋkpal befɔ ka luri ma bɔrɛlambu be mboŋ cheembi to so ashi Jerusalɛm.

english_verse: Soon I will send a war to punish Babylon's idols and leave its wounded people moaning everywhere.
translation_verse: K maaŋ chɛr nɛ n ta kena ŋ gberge Babilɔn be efuli so be agbirana kusoe, nɛ kumo be basa e doro n dese kaplɛkama a tekeŋ.

english_verse: Although Babylon's walls reach to the sky, the army I send will destroy that city. I, the Lord, have spoken. Babylon Will Be Destroyed The Lord said:
translation_verse: Hale Babilɔn be egbalana dii n ya kaa chute awɔlpa nɛ kumo be mboŋ lempoana naŋ wora eleŋ n ti so gba, benapo nɛ meeŋ shuŋi na kraa beeŋ mur kadegboŋ na. Ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ e kaŋɛ na.” Babilɔn ka beeŋ mur be asheŋ

english_verse: Listen to the cries for help coming from Babylon. Everywhere in the country the sounds of destruction can be heard.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na yɛ: Men nu kushu nɛ k shi Babilɔn be kadegboŋ to a ba ere! K la kemur gboŋgboŋi nɛ k ba Babilɔn be kasawule be kaplɛkama so be basa be kushu nna.

english_verse: An enemy will attack and destroy Babylon. Its soldiers will be captured and their weapons broken, because I am a God who takes revenge against nations for what they do.
translation_verse: Bedoŋ na beeŋ ba kɔ Babilɔn be basa m mur bumo. Bedoŋ na beeŋ pɛ Babilɔnebi be benapo anya, nseŋ buri m buri bumo be akɔsɔ kikɛ to. Ŋkpal manɛ so, n la Ebɔrɛ nɛ mee gberge efuliana kusoe nna ŋkpal alubi nɛ b wora so.

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, the true King, promise that the officials and advisors, the governors and leaders, and the soldiers of Babylon will get drunk, fall asleep, and never wake up.
translation_verse: Ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ nɛ n la Ewura kashenteŋto na, bee nase kɔnɔ fanɛ meeŋ shin nɛ Babilɔn be benimuana nɛ benyiashempo nɛ bejuŋkparpo nɛ benapo kikɛ e boo, nseŋ dese n di a maaŋ naaŋ tiŋ ŋ koso kikɛ.

english_verse: The thick walls of that city will be torn down, and its huge gates burned. Everything that nation worked so hard to gain will go up in smoke. Jeremiah Gives Seraiah a Scroll
translation_verse: Babilɔn be kadegboŋ na be egbal danto na beeŋ bure n tɔr kasawule, nɛ kumo be mbunagboŋana na e ji edɛ. Kusɔ kama nɛ efuli na so be basa shuŋ ŋ gben n nya kikɛ beeŋ ji edɛ m mur. Ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ e kaŋɛ na. Jɛremaya ka sibɛ kubɔya n shoŋi Babilɔn be asheŋ

english_verse: During Zedekiah's fourth year as king of Judah, he went to Babylon. And Baruch's brother Seraiah went along as the officer in charge of arranging for places to stay overnight.
translation_verse: Ewura Zedekaya ka ji Juda be efuli so be kuwura be kafɛ nasopo to nɛ e yɔ Babilɔn be efuli so. Seraiya nɛ e la Neriya pibinyɛn nɛ Maaseia mo nanabi na daŋ shuŋi mo nna n yɔ. Seraiya ere daa la ewura Zedekaya be enimu nɛ e bee fin edesekpa nna a sa mo ashi mbe enite to.

english_verse: then pray, “Our Lord, you promised to destroy this place and make it into a desert where no people or animals will ever live.”
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ fo kule Ebɔrɛ ŋ kaŋɛ: ‘O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, fo e nase kɔnɔ fanɛ feeŋ mur efuli ere nseŋ shin nɛ k ki keshishɛrsawule nɛ edimɛdi ŋko asɔbɔya maaŋ naa wɔ kumo so kikɛ.’

english_verse: When you finish praying, tie the scroll to a rock and throw it in the Euphrates River. Then say,
translation_verse: Seraiya, nɛ fo kaŋ kule Ebɔrɛ n loge, fo kre kawɔl na m mata kejembugboŋ so nseŋ ta kumo n lɛ Lɔrgboŋ nɛ baa tre Yufreetes na to. Kumo be kaman nɛ fo kaŋɛ le:

english_verse: “This is how Babylon will sink when the Lord destroys it. Everyone in the city will die, and it won't have the strength to rise again.” The End of Jeremiah's Writing Jeremiah's writing ends here.
translation_verse: ‘Kananɛ kejembugboŋ ere nɛ kawɔl ere muni nchu ere to ere nɛ Babilɔn be efuli gba beeŋ muni nsaa maaŋ naŋ tiŋ n lar jemanɛ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ mur kumo na. Esa kama nɛ e wɔ kadegboŋ na to beeŋ wu nɛ efuli na maaŋ naŋ nya eleŋ ŋ koso kikɛ.’ ” Anebi Jɛremaya be kɔnɔ be ekar nna na.

english_verse: then his eyes were poked out. He was put in chains, then dragged off to Babylon and kept in prison until he died.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ ewura Nebukadneeza shin nɛ b chule Ewura Zɛdikaya be anishi nseŋ chɛ mo ŋgbɛlɛbi n ta mo n yɔ Babilɔn be efuli so n ya ti ebu hale n ya fo kachɛ nɛ e wu.

english_verse: After a year and a half, all the food in Jerusalem was gone. Then on the ninth day of the fourth month,
translation_verse: Bedoŋ na daŋ kulti kadegboŋ na nna n wɔtɔ hale n ya fo ewura Zɛdikaya be kuwurji be kafɛ kudukakosopo to. Loŋ be kafɛ na to be kufɔl nasopo na be kachɛ kpanusopo na nɛ Jerusalɛm to be ajibi kikɛ loge.

english_verse: Zedekiah was taken to Riblah in the land of Hamath, where Nebuchadnezzar put him on trial and found him guilty.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ b keta ewura Zɛdikaya n yɔ ewura Nebukadneeza kutɔ ashi kadegboŋ nɛ baa tre Ribla nɛ k wɔ Hamaf be kebonfu to nɛ ewura Nebukadneeza ji mo demu nseŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ e wora n jija.

english_verse: Jerusalem was captured during Nebuchadnezzar's nineteenth year as king of Babylonia. About a month later, Nebuchadnezzar's officer in charge of the guards arrived in Jerusalem. His name was Nebuzaradan,
translation_verse: Ewura Nebukadneeza ka ji Babilɔn be efuli so be kuwura be kafɛ kudu akpanu to be kufɔl nusopo to be kachɛ kudusopo na nɛ Nebuzaradan nɛ e la ewura be asoetojipo nɛ benapo nɛ baa kuŋ mo na be enimu na ba Jerusalɛm to,

english_verse: and he burned down the Lord's temple, the king's palace, and every important building in the city, as well as all the houses.
translation_verse: m ba chɔɔ bɔrɛlambu na nɛ ewurkpa na nɛ kadegboŋ na to be nwu kikɛ n lɛ. E daŋ chɔɔ kowu kama nɛ k kɔ ketre nna n lɛ.

english_verse: Then he ordered the Babylonian soldiers to break down the walls around Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ Nebuzaradan be benapo na da egbalana nɛ e kulti kadegboŋ na n lɛ.

english_verse: He led away the people left in the city, including everyone who had become loyal to Nebuchadnezzar, the rest of the skilled workers, and even some of the poor people of Judah.
translation_verse: Nɛ Nebuzaradan keta betirpo nɛ basa nɛ b nyi enɔ to be ashuŋ na nɛ bumo nɛ b daŋ shuli m bɛ ewura Nebukadneeza nseŋ kraa wɔ Jerusalɛm to na kikɛ n yɔ Babilɔn be efuli so.

english_verse: Nebuzaradan ordered his soldiers to go to the temple and take everything made of gold or silver, including bowls, fire pans, sprinkling bowls, pans, lampstands, dishes for incense, and the cups for wine offerings. The Babylonian soldiers took all the bronze things used for worship at the temple, including the pans for hot ashes, and the shovels, lamp snuffers, sprinkling bowls, and dishes for incense. The soldiers also took everything else made of bronze, including the two columns that stood in front of the temple, the large bowl called the Sea, the twelve bulls that held it up, and the movable stands. The soldiers broke these things into pieces so they could take them to Babylonia. There was so much bronze that it could not be weighed.
translation_verse: Nebuzaradan daŋ kaŋɛ mbe benapo nna fanɛ b yɔ bɔrɛlambu na to n ya ta asɔ nɛ b ta shuwa ŋko gbiti n lɔŋɛ na. Amo e la echeenshi nɛ asɔ chɔɔ edɛ nɛ ntishaŋ nɛ baa wɔtɔ nchu a ŋmanyaŋ asɔ so nɛ mba nɛ b kɔ a kɛ asɔ nɛ efitilatɔl nɛ duwu be echeenshibi nɛ ekurwa nɛ baa wɔtɔ yabra a lara sarga na. Babilɔn be benapo na daŋ ta danyaŋ be asɔ. Amo e la asɔ nɛ b kɔ a muu nsunɔ tushiso nɛ eshabɔl nɛ asɔ nɛ b kɔ a duŋ fitila na nɛ ntishaŋ nɛ baa wɔtɔ nchu a ŋmanyaŋ asɔ so nɛ eduwu be echeenshi nɛ b kɔ a shuŋ Ebɔrɛ ashi bɔrɛlambu na to na nna. Benapo nɛ baa kuŋ Babilɔn be ewura na be enimu na daŋ ta danyaŋ be asɔ ere gba nna n ti so. Amo e la eshabɔrɛ anyɔ nɛ a yil bɔrɛlambu na be anishito na nɛ katishaŋgboŋ nɛ baa tre Teku na nɛ egbolu kudu anyɔ nɛ katishaŋgboŋ na bɛ so na nɛ eturko nɛ ewura Sɔlɔmɔn daŋ shin nɛ b lɔŋɛ n yili bɔrɛlambu na to na. B daŋ maŋ tiŋ ŋ karga asɔ nɛ b ta na be egbɛ ŋkpal a kaa daa wɔgbɛ ga na so.

english_verse: Evil Merodach was kind to Jehoiachin and honored him more than any of the other kings held prisoner there.
translation_verse: E daŋ shu Juda be ewura Jehowachin so nna nseŋ sa mo kemaŋkura a chɔ bewura kama nɛ b pɛ m ba Babilɔn be efuli so na kikɛ.

english_verse: Jehoiachin was allowed to wear regular clothes instead of a prison uniform, and he even ate at the king's table every day.
translation_verse: E daŋ sa ewura Jehowachin ekpa nna nɛ e maŋ naa buu kabuti to be asɔbuuso nsaa buu amo nɛ e bee sha. Mo alɛ nɛ Babilɔn be ewura daa chena mbe ejikpa nna a ji karechɛ kikɛ.

english_verse: As long as Jehoiachin lived, he was paid a daily allowance to buy whatever he needed.
translation_verse: Ewura Jehowachin ka daa wɔ Babilɔn be efuli so na, Babilɔn be ewura daa sa mo amansherbi jiso karechɛ kikɛ nna, hale n ya fo kachɛ nɛ e wu.

english_verse: Jerusalem, once so crowded, lies deserted and lonely. This city that was known all over the world is now like a widow. This queen of the nations has been made a slave.
translation_verse: Jerusalɛm be kadegboŋ nɛ basa daŋ bɔlɔ kumo to na e dese fuloŋ naniere na! Kadegboŋ nɛ durnya kikɛ daa nyi kumo be asheŋ nsaa sa kumo bunyaŋ ga na e ki fanɛ ekulpoche na! Kadegboŋ nɛ efuliana kikɛ daa shuŋ a sa na, e ki somaŋji na!

english_verse: Each night, bitter tears flood her cheeks. None of her former lovers are there to offer comfort; her friends have betrayed her and are now her enemies.
translation_verse: Kanyɛso kikɛ, kumo to be basa bee shu nna nɛ anishichubi bee pɔ bumo be ŋgbuŋ. Kumo beshapo kikɛ maŋ naa wɔtɔ nɛ b lolo kumo n wushi kumo kagbene. Kumo teriana kikɛ lar kumo kaman nseŋ debɔr kumo, naniere b ki kumo be bedoŋ nna.

english_verse: The roads to Zion mourn because no one travels there to celebrate the festivals. The city gates are deserted; priests are weeping. Young women are raped; Zion is in sorrow!
translation_verse: Naniere esa kikɛ maŋ naa ba bɔrɛlambu nɛ k yil Zayɔn be kebeegboŋ so na to m ba kaa bunyaŋ Ebɔrɛ nchɛgboŋachɛ. Beche fɔlbi nɛ baa boŋ nshɛ ndoŋ na bee ji awurfoŋ nna, nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana na malɛ bee munto a shu. Kadegboŋ na be mbunagboŋana na ase wora shruum nɛ k wora fanɛ kebɔltofinfin ka pɛ Jerusalɛm na.

english_verse: Enemies now rule the city and live as they please. The Lord has punished Jerusalem because of her awful sins; he has let her people be dragged away.
translation_verse: Bedoŋ e naa ji kadegboŋ na so kuwura nsaa wɔ kumo to a wora bumo be kepar. Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e gberge Jerusalɛm be basa kusoe ŋkpal asheŋ lubi damta nɛ b wora na so. E shin nɛ bedoŋ pɛ bumo ŋ ki anya nna n yɔ efuli wɔfɔ so.

english_verse: Zion's glory has disappeared. Her leaders are like deer that cannot find pasture; they are hunted down till their strength is gone.
translation_verse: Jerusalɛm be kemaŋkura kikɛ loge. Kumo be bejuŋkparpoana ki fanɛ echibir nɛ akoŋ kɔ nɛ b maŋ naa kɔ eleŋ nɛ b shile ŋ ŋana bekpampo so nna.

english_verse: Her people recall the good life that once was theirs; now they suffer and are scattered. No one was there to protect them from their enemies who sneered when their city was taken.
translation_verse: Jerusalɛm be basa bee nyiŋi dra na be kebaawɔtɔ lela nɛ b daa kɔ be asheŋ. Jemanɛ nɛ bumo doŋana ba kɔ m pɔɔ bumo so na, esa kikɛ daa maŋ chɛ bumo to. Ŋkpal b ka kɔ n tɔr so, bumo doŋana daŋ mushe nseŋ wora bumo eyur to nna.

english_verse: Jerusalem's horrible sins have made the city a joke. Those who once admired her now hate her instead— she has been disgraced; she groans and turns away.
translation_verse: Jerusalɛm to be asheŋ lubi so, k ki kadegboŋ nɛ ekama bee keni jiga nna. Basa kama nɛ b daa sha kumo nsaa keni kumo a bɔlɔ kenishi, kikɛ kishi kumo be asheŋ naniere nna. Jerusalɛm be basa gbagba be asheŋ woraso shin nɛ k wora eyurpi daŋkare be ekpa so nna.

english_verse: Her sins had made her filthy, but she wasn't worried about what could happen. And when Jerusalem fell, it was so tragic. No one gave her comfort when she cried out, “Help! I'm in trouble, Lord! The enemy has won.”
translation_verse: Kumo to be asheŋ lubi na daŋ dii efuli nna, ama amo be asheŋ maŋ tir kumo be basa na. Jerusalɛm be kebure n tɔr na daŋ lubi ga. Esa kikɛ daa maŋ lolo kumo be basa na n ti bumo kagbene. Bedoŋ daŋ pɔɔ basa na so nna nɛ baa shu a kaŋɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na fanɛ e wu bumo kuwɔr.

english_verse: Zion's treasures were stolen. Jerusalem saw foreigners enter her place of worship, though the Lord had forbidden them to belong to his people.
translation_verse: Bedoŋ na daŋ suge bumo be yawu kpakpaso be asɔ kikɛ nna. Jerusalɛm be basa na daŋ wu befɔ na ka luri bumo be bɔrɛlambu nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ daa maŋ sa nnyamase ekpa fanɛ b luri kumo to na nna.

english_verse: Everyone in the city groans while searching for food; they trade their valuables for barely enough scraps to stay alive. Jerusalem Speaks: Jerusalem shouts to the Lord, “Please look and see how miserable I am!”
translation_verse: Jerusalɛm be basa na kikɛ daa fubel nna, jemanɛ nɛ b daa fin kusɔ jiso nɛ b ji na. B daa ta bumo be asɔ lela a chɛr ajibi nɛ baaŋ ji nseŋ nya ŋkpa nna. Le nɛ b daa kaŋɛ: “Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, keni awurfoŋ nɛ anyee ji.”

english_verse: No passerby even cares. Why doesn't someone notice my terrible sufferings? You were fiercely angry, Lord, and you punished me worst of all.
translation_verse: Esa kama nɛ e bɔla ndoŋ a choŋ baaŋ kaŋɛ mo le: “Keni, chɛ anyi to! Esa kikɛ maŋ naŋ ji awurfoŋ nɛ k fo awurfoŋ nɛ anyee ji ere so. Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e nya agbo n shin k ba anyi so.

english_verse: From heaven you sent a fire that burned in my bones; you set a trap for my feet and made me turn back. All day long you leave me in shock from constant pain.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e shin nɛ ebesa shi esoso m ba luri anyi be eyurana to a chɔɔ fanɛ edɛ na. K du fanɛ e ka sho kejigbelɛ m pɛ anyi nɛ an tɔr kasawule nna. Kumo be kaman nɛ e yige anyi n wɔtɔ ebesa nɛ k maa yige to.

english_verse: You have tied my sins around my neck, and they weigh so heavily that my strength is gone. You have put me in the power of enemies too strong for me.
translation_verse: Kewora fanɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na gama anyi be alubi kikɛ n chɛ n shiga anyi be abɔ so nna nɛ amo be egbɛ shin nɛ anyi be eleŋ kikɛ lar anyi to. E ta anyi m bɔɔ an doŋana nɛ b chɔ anyi eleŋ ga enɔ nna, nɛ anyi maŋ kɔ shɛŋ nɛ an wora bumo be anishito.

english_verse: You, Lord, have turned back my warriors and crushed my young heroes. Judah was a woman untouched, but you let her be trampled like grapes in a wine pit.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na wora anyi eyur to nna m mushe anyi be benapo lempoana. E shin nɛ benapo ba nna m ba mur anyi be mbrantiɛfɔlbi, nseŋ chichi anyi be basa so fanɛ kananɛ baa chichi greep be asɔrso so a wora yabra na.

english_verse: Because of this, I mourn, and tears flood my eyes. No one is here to comfort or to encourage me; we have lost the war— my people are suffering. The Prophet Speaks:
translation_verse: Amoso nɛ anyee shu anishichubi ga na. Esa kikɛ maaŋ tiŋ n lolo anyi n ti anyi kagbene, esa kikɛ malɛ maaŋ tiŋ n leŋ anyi to nɛ an naŋ nya kenyɛn. Ŋkpal manɛ so, an doŋana pɔɔ anyi so nɛ anyi maŋ naa kɔ shɛŋ kebaawɔtɔ to.

english_verse: Zion reaches out her hands, but no one offers comfort. The Lord has turned the neighboring nations against Jacob's descendants. Jerusalem is merely a filthy rag to her neighbors. Jerusalem Speaks:
translation_verse: An teŋi anyi be enɔana to nna a fin kechɛto, ama esa kikɛ maŋ chɛ anyi to. Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na tre efuliana nɛ a kulti anyi na nna nɛ b ba kɔ anyi kena kaba kama so. Baa keni anyi nna fanɛ basa jiga.

english_verse: The Lord was right, but I refused to obey him. Now I ask all of you to look at my sufferings— even my young people have been dragged away.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kɔ ekpa nɛ e wora loŋ, ŋkpal manɛ so, anyi maŋ wora mo kasonu nna. Kaplɛkama be basa, men nu nfe. Men keni ebesa nɛ anyee ji. An doŋana pɛ anyi be mbifɔlbi nna n yɔ kenyaya to ashi efuli wɔfɔ so.

english_verse: I called out to my lovers, but they betrayed me. My priests and my leaders died while searching the city for scraps of food.
translation_verse: An kela n tre basa nɛ anyi nɛ bumo kre fanɛ anyeeŋ baa chɛ abar to kena be jemanɛ, ama b kini keba chɛ anyi to. Bɔrɛmatapoana na nɛ bejuŋkparpoana na daŋ fin ajibi nɛ b ji kadegboŋ na to ŋ gben nseŋ wu n dese agbembi so.

english_verse: Won't you look and see how upset I am, our Lord? My stomach is in knots, and my heart is broken because I betrayed you. In the streets and at home, my people are slaughtered.
translation_verse: O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, keni awurfoŋ nɛ ebesa damta nɛ anyee ji ere! Anyi be ŋgbene jija anyi nna ga ŋkpal anyi be alubi so. Basa be kamɔ e sɔ agbembi so, nɛ anyi be elaŋana gba to.

english_verse: Everyone heard my groaning, but no one offered comfort. My enemies know of the trouble that you have brought on me, and it makes them glad. Hurry and punish them, as you have promised.
translation_verse: Ekama nu anyi ka bee munto a shu, ama esa kikɛ maŋ wɔtɔ nɛ e lolo anyi. An doŋana nyi etɔrɔ nɛ fo, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na, bar anyi so, nɛ bumo be ŋgbene fuli bumo ŋkpal loŋ so. Jande, nya manaŋ ŋ gberge bumo kusoe, fanɛ kananɛ fo nase kɔnɔ na.

english_verse: Don't let their evil deeds escape your sight. Punish them as much as you have punished me because of my sins. I never stop groaning— I've lost all hope!
translation_verse: Sa maŋ kplaŋ bumo be asheŋ lubi so n shin nɛ b nya bumo be amu n ji. Kananɛ fo baŋ gberge anyi kusoe ŋkpal anyi be alubi so na, gberge bumo alɛ gba kusoe ŋkpal bumo be alubi so. Anyee munto a shu kagbenejijaso nna. Anyi be tama kikɛ loge.”

english_verse: The Lord was angry! So he disgraced Zion though it was Israel's pride and his own place of rest. In his anger he threw Zion down from heaven to earth.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na daŋ nya agbo nna n shin nɛ Zayɔn be kebee nɛ k wɔ Jerusalɛm to na paŋ kumo be kemaŋkuragboŋ kikɛ. Kumo e daa la kakpa nɛ Israɛlebi daa puchi so nseŋ naa la kakpa nɛ mo gbagba be bɔrɛlambu wɔ. Ama kachɛ nɛ e nya agbo na, e daŋ bure kumo nna n lɛ kasawule.

english_verse: The Lord had no mercy! He destroyed the homes of Jacob's descendants. In his anger he tore down every walled city in Judah; he toppled the nation together with its leaders, leaving them in shame.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na daŋ maŋ wu ndekarso nɛ a wɔ Juda be efuli so na kikɛ kuwɔr nseŋ shin nɛ a mur. E daŋ shin nɛ mboŋ lempoana nɛ a daa kuŋ kasawule na kikɛ bure n tɔr nna, nseŋ shin nɛ efuli na nɛ bejuŋkparpoana kikɛ ji anishinyɔr.

english_verse: The Lord was so furiously angry that he wiped out the whole army of Israel by not supporting them when the enemy attacked. He was like a raging fire that swallowed up the descendants of Jacob.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na daŋ nya agbo nna ga, nseŋ daŋ shin nɛ Israɛl be basa paŋ bumo be eleŋ kikɛ. An doŋana ka ba anyi so, e daŋ kini kechɛ anyi to nna. Mbe agbo daŋ koso anyi so fanɛ edɛ nna a mur kusɔ kikɛ.

english_verse: He attacked like an enemy with a bow and arrows, killing our loved ones. He has burned to the ground the homes on Mount Zion.
translation_verse: E daa to anyi mbe atanyembi nna fanɛ edoŋ na. Nseŋ daŋ mɔ basa kama nɛ b daa bar anyi kagbenewushi nɛ kagbenefuli na. E daŋ shin nɛ mbe agbo ba fanɛ edɛ nna m ba chɔɔ anyi be nwu nɛ a wɔ Jerusalɛm to na n lɛ kasawule.

english_verse: The Lord was like an enemy! He left Israel in ruins with its palaces and fortresses destroyed, and with everyone in Judah moaning and weeping.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na daŋ mur Israɛl nna fanɛ edoŋ na, nseŋ daŋ shin nɛ kumo be mboŋ lempoana nɛ ewurkpaana ki alambure a dese. N naŋ shin nɛ kebɔltofinfin nɛ kushu naŋ wora keshi n ti so n sa Juda be efuli so be basa.

english_verse: He shattered his temple like a hut in a garden; he completely wiped out his meeting place, and did away with festivals and Sabbaths in the city of Zion. In his fierce anger he rejected our king and priests.
translation_verse: E daŋ shin nɛ mbe bɔrɛlambu nɛ anyee shuŋ mo kumo to na daŋ bure n tɔr nna fanɛ kudɔtobuu na. Nseŋ shin nɛ nchɛgboŋ nɛ kewushiachɛ na be keji ba ekar. Mbe agbogboŋ na so, e daŋ kini ewura na nɛ bɔrɛmatapo na gba nna n lɛ.

english_verse: The Lord abandoned his altar and his temple; he let Zion's enemies capture her fortresses. Noisy shouts were heard from the temple, as if it were a time of celebration.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na daŋ kini mbe bɔrɛsure nna n lɛ nseŋ daŋ lar mbe bɔrɛlambu cheembi to ŋ ka kumo. E daŋ sa bedoŋ ekpa nna nɛ b da Jerusalɛm be egbalana n lɛ, nseŋ daa wora awɔr a ŋini fanɛ b kɔ m pɔɔ kakpa nɛ an daa shuŋ Ebɔrɛ kagbenefuliso na so.

english_verse: The Lord had decided to tear down the walls of Zion stone by stone. So he started destroying and did not stop until walls and fortresses mourned and trembled.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na gbagba daŋ yili kumo mbe kagbene to fanɛ a daga egbalana nɛ a kulti Jerusalɛm na ka bure n tɔr. E ka fara kumo be kebure e maŋ naŋ yige kikɛ, a ŋini fanɛ e bee sha kumo be kemur cheche nna. Naniere kumo be mboŋ lempoana nɛ egbalana kikɛ bure a dese.

english_verse: Zion's gates have fallen facedown on the ground; the bars that locked the gates are smashed to pieces. Her king and royal family are prisoners in foreign lands. Her priests don't teach, and her prophets don't have a message from the Lord.
translation_verse: Jerusalɛm be mbunagboŋana tɔr a pul eshishɛr to nɛ ndibi nɛ baa ta a ber amo so na kikɛ buri to burburbi a dese. Ewura nɛ bewurbi nɛ b daa wɔ ndoŋ na kikɛ ki anya efuli wɔfɔ so nna. Bɔrɛmatapoana na maŋ naa ŋini mbraana na, anebiana na malɛ maŋ naa nu kubɔya kikɛ ashi Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kutɔ.

english_verse: Zion's leaders are silent. They just sit on the ground, tossing dirt on their heads and wearing sackcloth. Her young women can do nothing but stare at the ground.
translation_verse: Jerusalɛm be benimuana na daŋ buu nli be asɔbuuso a tase kasawule a maŋ naa kɔ shɛŋ nɛ b kaŋɛ abar, nseŋ wora eshishɛr ŋ gbiti bumo be amu to a ŋini bumo be kagbenejija nna. Nɛ bechefɔlbi na malɛ chena ŋ kurgi amu n yuu to a keni kasawule.

english_verse: My eyes are red from crying, my stomach is in knots, and I feel sick all over. My people are being wiped out, and children lie helpless in the streets of the city.
translation_verse: M baŋ shu nna m pere anishi hale nɛ ma epun to bee besa. Ma basa ka mur na shin nɛ ma kagbene jija ma hale nɛ m bɛlɛ. Mbi wurbi nɛ mbi popɔrbi kikɛ kreŋ a dese agbembi so ŋkpal esa kikɛ ka maŋ wɔtɔ nɛ e keni bumo so ashi kadegboŋ na to so.

english_verse: A child begs its mother for food and drink, then blacks out like a wounded soldier lying in the street. The child slowly dies in its mother's arms.
translation_verse: Akoŋ nɛ achukoŋ so, mbia bee shu nna a fin ajibi nɛ nchu bumo nioana kutɔ, bumo alɛ maa nya. Amoso baa kreŋ a tɔr nna fanɛ enapo ka doro kena to n tɔr na; nseŋ wu bumo nioana be enɔana to.

english_verse: Zion, how can I comfort you? How great is your pain? Lovely city of Jerusalem, how can I heal your wounds, gaping as wide as the sea?
translation_verse: O Jerusalɛmebi, manɛ nɛ ŋ kɔ nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ? Nuso bre nɛ meeŋ tiŋ n lɔlɔ menyi? Ŋkpal manɛ so, esa kikɛ maŋ naŋ ji awurfoŋ fanɛ kananɛ men ji ere. Jɛrbi nɛ men ji ere maŋ kɔ ekar fanɛ teku; tama be yiri kikɛ maŋ naa wɔtɔ n sa menyi.

english_verse: Those who pass by shake their heads and sneer as they make fun and shout, “What a lovely city you were, the happiest on earth, but look at you now!”
translation_verse: Basa nɛ b bɔla kadegboŋ na ase a choŋ bee fɛl menyi nna. Baa keni Jerusalɛm be alambure na nna nsaa fifi amu a mushe. Kumo be kaman nɛ b bishi le: “Kadegboŋ lela na nde a? Kadegboŋ nɛ durnya kikɛ daa puchi so na nde a?”

english_verse: Zion, your enemies curse you and snarl like wild animals, while shouting, “This is the day we've waited for! At last, we've got you!”
translation_verse: Menyi doŋana kikɛ bee mushe nna a wora menyi eyurto, nsaa gbɛlɛ menyi yurkishi so. Baa mɛr nnɔ nna nsaa kaŋɛ le: “An mur kumo! Kachɛ nɛ an baa jo na nna na!”

english_verse: Zion, deep in your heart you cried out to the Lord. Now let your tears overflow your walls day and night. Don't ever lose hope or let your tears stop.
translation_verse: Jerusalɛmebi, men shu ŋgbene to ŋ ŋini Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na. Kapa nɛ kanyɛ, men shin nɛ men be anishichubi e baa shile fanɛ lɔr na. Men shu hale nɛ men be ebɔl e ya fɛa!

english_verse: Get up and pray for help all through the night. Pour out your feelings to the Lord, as you would pour water out of a jug. Beg him to save your people, who are starving to death at every street crossing. Jerusalem Speaks:
translation_verse: Men koso n shu kanyɛ lelemu kikɛ ŋ ŋini Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nseŋ bugi ŋgbene ŋ kule mo nɛ e wu menyi be mbia nɛ akoŋ bee mɔ agbembi so be akɔlɔbi to kikɛ na kuwɔr!

english_verse: Think about it, Lord! Have you ever been this cruel to anyone before? Is it right for mothers to eat their children, or for priests and prophets to be killed in your temple?
translation_verse: O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, keni anyi a! Manɛ nna nɛ fee gberge anyi kusoe loŋ? A maŋ daga fanɛ bibinioana e baa daŋɛ bumo be mbi shaso a we! Ŋko nɛ basa e baa mɔ bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ anebiana na fo bɔrɛlambu gbagba to loŋ!

english_verse: My people, both young and old, lie dead in the streets. Because you were angry, my young men and women were brutally slaughtered.
translation_verse: Mbifɔlbi nɛ basakpar kikɛ e wu a dese agbembi so na, bedoŋ malɛ ta etokobi m mɔ mbrantiɛ nɛ besuŋgurbi. Kachɛ nɛ fo nya agbo na nɛ fo shin nɛ bedoŋ mɔ bumo nsaa maŋ wu bumo kuwɔr kikɛ.

english_verse: When you were angry, Lord, you invited my enemies like guests for a party. No one survived that day; enemies killed my children, my own little ones.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, fo kanya agbo so, fo kela n tre n doŋana nna fanɛ basa nɛ fo tre kejigboŋ to na. Esa kikɛ daa maŋ ji efute loŋ be kachɛ na. Bedoŋ na daŋ mɔ ma mbia nɛ m bela a sha bumo ga na nna.

english_verse: He chased me into a dark place, where no light could enter.
translation_verse: E daŋ ju ma n lɛ tentembiri plɔ to, kakpa nɛ kefulto kikɛ maŋ wɔ nna.

english_verse: I am the only one he punishes over and over again, without ever stopping.
translation_verse: Kashenteŋto, n nawule nɛ e gberge kusoe ale damta nsaa maŋ wu ma kuwɔr kikɛ.

english_verse: God caused my skin and flesh to waste away, and he crushed my bones.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ daŋ shin nɛ ma eyur so kikɛ wora achuu nɛ ma eyur be eblaŋ kikɛ bɛlge, nɛ ma awibi buri to nna.

english_verse: he forced me to sit in the dark like someone long dead.
translation_verse: E daŋ tintiŋ ma n chena tentembiri to fanɛ esa nɛ e wu dra dra kikɛ nna.

english_verse: God built a fence around me that I cannot climb over, and he chained me down.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ daŋ yuu kunji nɛ m maaŋ tiŋ n dii nna ŋ kulti ma n wɔtɔ, nseŋ naŋ chɛ ma ŋgbɛlɛbi n nase.

english_verse: Even when I shouted and prayed for help, he refused to listen.
translation_verse: Ŋ ka shu awɔrso ŋ kule mo fanɛ e chɛ ma to, e kini kenu ma kekule nna.

english_verse: God put big rocks in my way and made me follow a crooked path.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ daŋ ta afalta gboŋgboŋi n nase ma ekpa to nna, nɛ n daa nite a lente.

english_verse: God took careful aim and shot his arrows
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ daŋ ta mbe keta n yuu ma so nɛ e to ma nna.

english_verse: I am a joke to everyone— no one ever stops making fun of me.
translation_verse: Ŋ ki fanɛ kemɔmɔshia be kusɔ nna n sa ekama, saŋkikɛ basa bee mushe ma nsaa wora ma eyurto nna.

english_verse: God has turned my life sour.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ kebaawɔtɔ ki kekera n sa ma.

english_verse: He made me eat gravel and rubbed me in the dirt.
translation_verse: E ta ma anishi to ŋ gbiti kasawule, nɛ ajembu buri ma anyii.

english_verse: That's all I ever think about, and I am depressed.
translation_verse: Amo be asheŋ be kebaafɛ jemanɛ kikɛ na bee mɔ ma kiyoyu nna nsaa pɔ ma aba.

english_verse: Then I remember something that fills me with hope.
translation_verse: Ama nɛ m baŋ nyiŋi kusɔ koŋwule ko bre, k naa sa ma tama nna.

english_verse: The Lord's kindness never fails! If he had not been merciful, we would have been destroyed.
translation_verse: Kumo e la fanɛ, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be alelasheŋ maa loge! E daa maa wu kuwɔr nna, n dafanɛ anyi kikɛ mur.

english_verse: The Lord can always be trusted to show mercy each morning.
translation_verse: Esa beeŋ tiŋ n yirda Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na jemanɛ kikɛ nɛ e baa wu mo kuwɔr kachipurso kikɛ.

english_verse: Deep in my heart I say, “The Lord is all I need; I can depend on him!”
translation_verse: Kusɔ nɛ mee kaŋɛ ma kagbene to e la: “Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e baa la ma; mo nɛ meeŋ tiŋ n ta ma tama n to so!”

english_verse: The Lord is kind to everyone who trusts and obeys him.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na la esa nna n sa ekama nɛ e ta mbe yirda n wɔtɔ mo to nsaa wora mo kasonu.

english_verse: It is good to wait patiently for the Lord to save us.
translation_verse: Amoso, a daga fanɛ anyi e baa wora kanyiti a jo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nɛ e mɔlga anyi.

english_verse: When we are young, it is good to struggle hard
translation_verse: Jemanɛ nɛ an la mbifɔlbi na e daga fanɛ an koya le be kanyiti ere.

english_verse: and to sit silently alone, if this is what the Lord intends.
translation_verse: Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na tea sha fanɛ an ji awurfoŋ, kumo ere an nya kanyiti n chena shruum a jo mo.

english_verse: we can also learn from insults and hard knocks.
translation_verse: Hale nɛ b bri anyi nseŋ tege anyi gba, an sɔ kumo loŋ.

english_verse: He causes a lot of suffering, but he also has pity because of his great love.
translation_verse: Hale nɛ e shin nɛ awurfoŋ ba anyi so gba, e kraa kɔ kushuso n sa anyi ŋkpal mbe kasha ka shi ga so.

english_verse: The Lord doesn't enjoy sending grief or pain.
translation_verse: Anyi be kagbenejija nɛ keji ebesa maa par Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.

english_verse: or cheat anyone out of what is rightfully theirs. God Most High sees everything,
translation_verse: ŋko kepuni esa be kusɔ maa par mo. Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na bee wu kusɔ kama,

english_verse: and he knows when you refuse to give someone a fair trial.
translation_verse: mo alɛ nsaa nyi jemanɛ nɛ baa ji esa durmu ashi demuji to.

english_verse: No one can do anything without the Lord's approval.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na maŋ sa kusɔ akpa k maaŋ tiŋ n wora kikɛ.

english_verse: Good and bad each happen at the command of God Most High.
translation_verse: Kulubi nɛ kelela be ketiŋ wora kikɛ yil kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na yili so nna.

english_verse: We're still alive! We shouldn't complain when we are being punished for our sins.
translation_verse: Manɛ nna nɛ esa nɛ e kraa kɔ ŋkpa bee fubel a bele asheŋ jemanɛ nɛ e wɔ mbe alubi be kasogberge to?

english_verse: Instead, we should think about the way we are living, and turn back to the Lord.
translation_verse: Men shin nɛ an keni anyi be asheŋ woraso to nɛnɛ nseŋ naŋ bɛta m ba Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kutɔ.

english_verse: When we lift our hands in prayer to God in heaven, we should offer him our hearts and say,
translation_verse: Men shin nɛ an bugi anyi be ŋgbene n sa Ebɔrɛ nɛ e wɔ ebɔrɛso na nseŋ kaŋɛ mo le:

english_verse: “We've sinned! We've rebelled against you, and you haven't forgiven us!
translation_verse: An lar fo kaman n wora alubi!

english_verse: Anger is written all over you, as you pursue and slaughter us without showing pity.
translation_verse: Fo ka nya agbo so, fo maŋ wu anyi kuwɔr nseŋ ju m buu anyi so n ya mɔ anyi.

english_verse: You are behind a wall of clouds that blocks out our prayers.
translation_verse: K du fanɛ fo ka wɔ awɔlpa be egbal be kaman nna nɛ kabɔrɛkule maaŋ tiŋ m bɔl kumo to n fo fo kutɔ.

english_verse: My people are destroyed! Tears flood my eyes,
translation_verse: Mee shu anishichubi damta nna, ŋkpal ma basa ka mur so.

english_verse: I am horrified when I see what enemies have done to the young women of our city.
translation_verse: Nɛ m baŋ wu kusɔ nɛ bedoŋ wora anyi be kadegboŋ to be beche kikɛ na, ma kagbene bee jija ma ga nna.

english_verse: No one had reason to hate me, but I was hunted down like a bird.
translation_verse: N doŋana nɛ b kishi ma nɛ m maŋ wora shɛŋ na daŋ fe abulbi nna m pɛ ma fanɛ kabuibi na.

english_verse: Then they tried to kill me by tossing me into a pit and throwing stones at me.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ b ta ma n wɔtɔ ketirbu to, nseŋ bela ajembu a kpa ma ketirbu na to a fin kemɔ ma.

english_verse: From the bottom of the pit, I prayed to you, Lord.
translation_verse: Ketirbu na be kaseto ndoŋ nɛ n wɔ nseŋ shu n tre fo, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.

english_verse: I begged you to listen. “Help!” I shouted. “Save me!” You answered my prayer
translation_verse: Ŋ ka kule fo nɛ fo nu ma kabɔrɛkule.

english_verse: and came when I was in need. You told me, “Don't worry!”
translation_verse: Nseŋ kaŋɛ ma fanɛ n sa maa lɔ kufu.

english_verse: You saw them abuse me, Lord, so make things right.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, fo nyi kulubi nɛ b wora ma; amoso ji asheŋ na n chɛ ma to.

english_verse: All day long they attack with words and whispers.
translation_verse: Karechɛ kikɛ baa kuli ma nna a ji ma asheŋ nsaa kre ma nia lubi.

english_verse: No matter what they are doing, they keep on mocking me.
translation_verse: Kusɔ kama nɛ baa wora, baa boŋ nshɛ nna a wora ma eyurto.

english_verse: Pay them back for everything they have done, Lord!
translation_verse: O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, gberge bumo kusoe ŋkpal kusɔ nɛ b wora so.

english_verse: Put your curse on them and make them suffer.
translation_verse: Shoduu bumo nseŋ shin nɛ b ji awurfoŋ!

english_verse: Get angry and go after them until not a trace is left under the heavens.
translation_verse: Nyagbo n ju m buu bumo so m mur bumo kuraa nɛ b sa maŋ naa wɔ durnya to!”

english_verse: The purest gold is ruined and has lost its shine; jewels from the temple lie scattered in the streets.
translation_verse: Anyi be shuwa nɛ k bee nyɛkpɛ ga na kreŋ so nɛ ajembu nɛ b ta m pɔr bɔrɛlambu na pesaŋ to a dese agbembi so.

english_verse: These are Zion's people, worth more than purest gold; yet they are counted worthless like dishes of clay.
translation_verse: Jerusalɛm be mbrantiɛfɔlbi daa du fanɛ shuwa n sa anyi nna; ama naniere bumo e ki fanɛ ebɔ be mpuliya nɛ ekama bee keni jiga na.

english_verse: Babies are so thirsty that their tongues are stuck to the roof of the mouth. Children go begging for food, but no one gives them any.
translation_verse: Baa shin nɛ akoŋ nɛ achukoŋ bee mɔ bumo be mbi popɔrbi nna; mbia na bee ta enɔ to a kule ajibi nna, esa kikɛ malɛ maaŋ sa bumo ajibi nɛ b ji.

english_verse: All who ate expensive foods lie starving in the streets; those who grew up in luxury now sit on trash heaps.
translation_verse: Basa nɛ b daa ji ajibi lela nɛ amo be yawu du kpakpa ga na nɛ akoŋ bee mɔ a lɛ agbembi so na. Bumo nɛ b daa ji kedamaya na, e naa amuni so a fin ajibi jiso na.

english_verse: My nation was punished worse than the people of Sodom, whose city was destroyed in a flash without the help of human hands.
translation_verse: Ma basa be kasogberge chɔ basa nɛ b daa wɔ kadegboŋ nɛ baa tre Sodɔm, nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ mur kumo epul to dra dra na peya.

english_verse: Now they are blacker than tar, and no one recognizes them; their skin clings to their bones and is drier than firewood.
translation_verse: Ama naniere bumo e chɔɔ m biri fanɛ adundumbi a dese agbembi so, nɛ esa maaŋ naŋ tiŋ m pin bumo na. B daŋ nyɔr nna ŋ ki awibi nawule fanɛ ndibi wɔlso na.

english_verse: Life in the city is so bad that loving mothers have boiled and eaten their own children.
translation_verse: Kemurgboŋ nɛ k daŋ ba ma basa so na daŋ shin nɛ beche nɛ baa sha bumo be mbia ga gbagba daŋɛ bumo be mbia nɛ b wu nna n we ŋkpal akoŋ so.

english_verse: The Lord was so fiercely angry that he burned the city of Zion to the ground.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ka daŋ nya agbo ga so, e daŋ shin nɛ Jerusalɛm be kadegboŋ na ji edɛ nna m mur cheche.

english_verse: Not a king on this earth or the people of any nation believed enemies could break through her gates.
translation_verse: Ekama nɛ e wɔ kaplɛkama; hale efuli pɔtɛana so be bewuraana gba daa maŋ yirda fanɛ bedoŋ beeŋ tiŋ m bure Jerusalɛm be mbunagboŋana n luri kumo to ŋ kɔ.

english_verse: Jerusalem was punished because her prophets and her priests had sinned and caused the death of innocent victims.
translation_verse: Ama loŋ daŋ wora nna ŋkpal Jerusalɛm to be anebiana nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana na ka daŋ wora alubi nseŋ shin nɛ b mɔ basa nɛ b maŋ wora shɛŋ na so.

english_verse: Instead, everyone shouted, “Go away! Don't touch us! You're filthy and unfit to belong to God's people!” So they had to leave and become refugees. But foreign nations told them, “You can't stay here!”
translation_verse: Kusɔ nɛ basa bee kaŋɛ bumo nde: “Men shile anyi so! Men wora eyurpi nna. Men sa maŋ beta anyi ere!” Ŋkpal loŋ so efuli kama so nɛ b yɔ, ndoŋebi gba bee kini bumo nna.

english_verse: The Lord is the one who sent them scattering, and he has forgotten them. No respect or kindness will be shown to the priests or leaders.
translation_verse: Bumo be asheŋ daa maŋ naŋ tir Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na, amoso mo gbagba e daŋ shin nɛ b pesaŋ to n sɔ kaplɛkama. E daa maŋ naa sa anyi be anebiana nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana na bunyaŋ ŋko a wu bumo kuwɔr gba.

english_verse: They swooped down faster than eagles from the sky. They hunted for us in the hills and set traps to catch us out in the desert.
translation_verse: An doŋana na daa du fanɛ kusore ka bee fuu kusɔ na nna. B daa ju a buu anyi so kaplɛkama nna a fin anyi nɛ b pɛ. Abee so nɛ b daa kuŋ anyi a pɛ, ŋko pugi keshishɛrsawule so a jo anyi nɛ an ba purgi bumo nɛ b pɛ.

english_verse: The Lord's chosen leader was our hope for survival! We thought he would keep us safe somewhere among the nations, but even he was caught in one of their traps.
translation_verse: B daŋ pɛ ewura nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ gbagba lara n sa anyi nɛ an daa fute a yige mo so na nna. Mo e la ewura nɛ an daŋ yirda fanɛ e beeŋ baa kuŋ anyi ashi edoŋ kama nɛ e beeŋ ba kɔ anyi kena kutɔ.

english_verse: Foreigners and strangers have taken our land and our homes.
translation_verse: Anyi be kasawule laŋɛ basa pɔtɛ be enɔ to; nɛ befɔ sɔ anyi be nwu n chena to.

english_verse: We are like children whose mothers are widows.
translation_verse: An doŋana shin nɛ an ki amunibi, nɛ an nioana malɛ ki bekulpoche.

english_verse: The water we drink and the wood we burn cost far too much.
translation_verse: Naniere anyee ka nchu nɛ anyee nuu be kukɔ nna; nsaa tɔ ndibi puga edɛ yawu kpakpaso.

english_verse: We are terribly mistreated; we are worn out and can find no rest.
translation_verse: Basa nɛ baa ju anyi na baa ji anyi ayabi nna, an gben ama anyi alɛ maaŋ tiŋ n yili n wushi.

english_verse: We had to surrender to Egypt and Assyria because we were hungry.
translation_verse: Ijipt nɛ Asiriya be efuliana so nɛ an ya kaa kule ajibi nɛ anyeeŋ ji nseŋ nya ŋkpa a wɔtɔ.

english_verse: Our ancestors sinned, but they are dead, and we are left to pay for their sins.
translation_verse: An nananyɛnana e daŋ wora alubi, bumo alɛ maŋ naa wɔtɔ naniere. Anyi e wɔtɔ a ji bumo be alubi na be awurfoŋ.

english_verse: Slaves are now our rulers, and there is no one to set us free.
translation_verse: Basa nɛ anya bɔ bumo e naa ji anyi so kuwura. Esa kikɛ malɛ maŋ wɔtɔ nɛ e mɔlga anyi bumo be enɔ to.

english_verse: We are in danger from brutal desert tribes; we must risk our lives just to bring in our crops.
translation_verse: Anyee ta anyi be ŋkpa a kpa kelera nna pɔɛŋ nsaa nya ajibi jiso; ŋkpal basa nɛ baa mɔ basa ka sɔ efuli na be kaplɛkama so.

english_verse: On Zion and everywhere in Judah our wives and daughters are being raped.
translation_verse: B pur anyi be beche nɛ anyi be mbichesobi Zayɔn be kebee so ashi Jerusalɛm nɛ Juda be efuli so be ndeana to.

english_verse: Our rulers are strung up by their arms, and our nation's advisors are treated shamefully.
translation_verse: B pɛ anyi be bewuraana n ya chɛ efɔl; esa malɛ maa sa anyi be benimuana bunyaŋ.

english_verse: Young men are forced to do the work of slaves; boys must carry heavy loads of wood.
translation_verse: B nyaŋ anyi be mbrantiɛfɔlbi nɛ baa kɔr ayu abo so fanɛ anya, nɛ anyi be mbinyɛnsobi malɛ bee sulɔ ndibi gbɛgbɛso a jante.

english_verse: Our leaders are not allowed to decide cases in court, and young people no longer play music.
translation_verse: Basakpar maŋ naa chena kadegboŋ na be mbunagboŋana na ase a ji asheŋ. Mbifɔlbi malɛ gba maŋ naa boŋ nshɛ.

english_verse: Our hearts are sad; instead of dancing, we mourn.
translation_verse: Kagbenefuli maŋ naa wɔ anyi to kikɛ; anyi be epelana ki fanɛ nli nna nɛ anyee shu.

english_verse: Zion's glory has disappeared! And we are doomed because of our sins.
translation_verse: Asɔ nɛ an daa puchi so na be kekama maŋ naa wɔtɔ. Ŋkpal anyi ka wora alubi so, asheŋ maa nyalɛ a sa anyi.

english_verse: We feel sick all over and can't even see straight;
translation_verse: Anyi be eyur be kaplɛkama bee besa nna; anyi maŋ naa wu nɛnɛ ŋkpal anishichubi so.

english_verse: You will rule forever, Lord! You are King for all time.
translation_verse: Ama fo, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e la ewura mbaanaayɔ. Fo e naa ji kuwura hale n ya fo jemanɛ be lalaloge.

english_verse: Or do you despise us so much that you don't want us?
translation_verse: Ŋko fo kini anyi nna n lɛ mbaanaayɔ? Ama fo agbo maŋ kɔ ekar a?”

english_verse: I am Ezekiel—a priest and the son of Buzi. Five years after King Jehoiachin of Judah had been led away as a prisoner to Babylonia, I was living near the Chebar River among those who had been taken there with him. Then on the fifth day of the fourth month of the thirtieth year, the heavens suddenly opened. The Lord placed his hand upon me and showed me some visions.
translation_verse: Ma ketre e la Ezikɛl nɛ n la bɔrɛmatapo nsaa la kanyɛn nɛ baa tre Buzi na pibinyɛn. english_verse: I saw a windstorm blowing in from the north. Lightning flashed from a huge cloud and lit up the whole sky with a dazzling brightness. The fiery center of the cloud was as shiny as polished metal,

english_verse: and in that center I saw what looked like four living creatures. They were somewhat like humans,

english_verse: Their legs were straight, but their feet looked like the hoofs of calves and sparkled like bronze.

english_verse: Under each of their wings, these creatures had a human hand.

english_verse: The four creatures were standing back to back with the tips of their wings touching. They moved together in every direction, without turning their bodies.
translation_verse: B daŋ pal kaman nna n sa abar nseŋ parga bumo be aba na be anyɔ anyɔ to nɛ amo be nnɔso pɛ abar. Kaplɛkama malɛ nɛ baa yɔ, b pɛ abar to loŋ nna a yɔ, b maa kilgi bumo be eyurana.

english_verse: Each creature had the face of a human in front, the face of a lion on the right side, the face of a bull on the left, and the face of an eagle in back.
translation_verse: Anishito ana nɛ ekama kɔ na malɛ daa kɔr abar to nna. Bumo be anishito be kaba so daa la dimɛdi be anishito nna, nɛ jisoso be kaba so la buluŋ be anishito, nɛ bena so la gbolu be anishito nɛ kaman malɛ peya na la kusore be anishito.

english_verse: Two wings of each creature were spread out and touched the wings of the creatures on either side. The other two wings of each creature were folded against its body.
translation_verse: Asɔbɔya keniso na daŋ parga bumo be aba na be anyɔ anyɔ to nna nɛ a beta bumo braana nɛ b wɔ bumo be jisoso nɛ bena so na peya, nseŋ parga anyɔ anyɔ nɛ a ka malɛ to m buu bumo be eyurana so.

english_verse: The four living creatures went wherever the Spirit led them, and they moved together without turning their bodies, because each creature faced straight ahead.
translation_verse: Bumo be ekama be anishito daa keni mba ana na kikɛ nna, amoso bumo kikɛ beeŋ tiŋ m pɛ abar to n yɔ kaba kama so nɛ b maŋ kilgi.

english_verse: The creatures were glowing like hot coals, and I saw something like a flaming torch moving back and forth among them. Lightning flashed from the torch every time its flame blazed up.
translation_verse: Asɔbɔya keniso na daa du fanɛ mbulpi nɛ a bee suse nna a nite saŋkikɛ, nsaa nyɛrga a kpa edɛ fanɛ bɔrɛ ka bee nyɛkpɛ na.

english_verse: The creatures themselves moved as quickly as sparks jumping from a fire.
translation_verse: Bumo alɛ daa yɔ anishito nsaa bɛta kaman manaŋ manaŋ nna fanɛ bɔrɛ ka bee nyɛkpɛ na.

english_verse: I then noticed that on the ground beside each of the four living creatures was a wheel,
translation_verse: Ŋ ka bee keni asɔbɔya keniso ana na nɛ n wu fanɛ bumo be ekama kɔ kusɔ kulkulso fanɛ cheche be keya nɛ k yil kasawule nna m mata mo.

english_verse: shining like chrysolite. Each wheel was exactly the same and had a second wheel that cut through the middle of it,
translation_verse: Aya kulkulso ana na kikɛ daŋ duli abar nna nsaa kpa edɛ fanɛ yawu kpakpaso be ajembu nyɛkpɛso na, nɛ amo be kekama malɛ kɔ keya kulkulso nyɔsopo nɛ k kilgi n larga to ashi kumo be nferinto,

english_verse: The rims of the wheels were large and frightening, and they had eyes all the way around them.
translation_verse: Abɛlso kulkulso nɛ a wɔ asɔbɔya keniso na be aya kulkulso fanɛ cheche be aya na to na daa kɔ anishi ŋ kulti amo be kaplɛkama.

english_verse: The creatures controlled when and where the wheels moved—the wheels went wherever the four creatures went and stopped whenever they stopped. Even when the creatures flew in the air, the wheels were beside them.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal loŋ so, jemanɛ kikɛ nɛ asɔbɔya keniso na bee nite ŋko n yili ŋko a firgi gba nna, aya kulkulso na gba bee wora loŋ gbagba nna, ŋkpal manɛ so, asɔbɔya keniso na e naa keta amo a shuŋ.

english_verse: Above the living creatures, I saw something that was sparkling like ice, and it reminded me of a dome. Each creature had two of its wings stretched out toward the creatures on either side, with the other two wings folded against its body.
translation_verse: Asɔbɔya keniso ana na daa yil kuwɔlpa na be kaseto nna nseŋ parga bumo be mbuibi be aba ana na to be anyɔ nyɔ to n ya pɛ bumo braana peya to; nseŋ ta anyɔ anyɔ nɛ a ka malɛ m parga to m buu bumo be eyurana so.

english_verse: Whenever the creatures flew, their wings roared like an ocean or a large army or even the voice of God All-Powerful. And whenever the creatures stopped, they folded their wings against their bodies.
translation_verse: Asɔbɔya keniso na ka koso m bri aba to a firgi, nɛ n nu egbri fanɛ teku so be kewawa na, ŋko benapo damta ka na aya so na ŋko Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ be ebɔl na. B ka ya yili nɛ b bra bumo be mbuibi be aba na m buu bumo be eyurana so.

english_verse: I then saw what looked like a throne made of sapphire, and sitting on the throne was a figure in the shape of a human.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ ŋ wu kusɔ ko fanɛ kuwurputi nɛ b ta yawu kpakpaso be kejembu lela nɛ baa tre ‘Saffai’ na n lɔŋɛ, nseŋ naŋ wu esa ko ka duli dimɛdi nɛ e tase kuwurputi na so.

english_verse: From the waist up, it was glowing like metal in a hot furnace, and from the waist down it looked like the flames of a fire. The figure was surrounded by a bright light,
translation_verse: Nɛ yili mbe kashɛr ase a yɔ mbe kumu ase du fanɛ danyaŋ nɛ k wɔ edɛ be nferinto na nɛ mbe kashɛr ase a yɔ mbe aya ase malɛ du fanɛ edɛ be adondulombi. Kakpa kikɛ daŋ fulto parr nna ŋ kulti mo

english_verse: as colorful as a rainbow that appears after a storm. I realized I was seeing the brightness of the Lord's glory! So I bowed with my face to the ground, and just then I heard a voice speaking to me.
translation_verse: fanɛ kananɛ bɔrɛ bee mɔl nɛ kabɔrɛnyaŋgelambi bee lar kuwɔlpa so a fulto na. Ndoŋ nna nɛ m pin fanɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be kemaŋkura nɛ n wu na nseŋ ta enɔ m buu anishi so epul na to ŋ tɔr epun so. Kumo be kaman nɛ n nu ebɔl ko ka bee malga ma kutɔ.

english_verse: The Lord said, “Ezekiel, son of man, I want you to stand up and listen.”
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ ebɔl na kaŋɛ ma le: “Dimɛdi pibi, Ezikɛl, koso n yili. Mee sha kemalga fo kutɔ nna.”

english_verse: After he said this, his Spirit took control of me and lifted me to my feet. Then the Lord said:
translation_verse: Ebɔl na ka bee malga na nɛ Ebɔrɛ be Kiyoyu ba ma so n shin nɛ ŋ koso n yili nɛ k kaŋɛ le:

english_verse: Ezekiel, I am sending you to the people of Israel. They are just like their ancestors who rebelled against me and refused to stop.
translation_verse: “Dimɛdi pibi, mee shuŋi fo Israɛl be basa kutɔ nna. Ŋkpal manɛ so, kananɛ bumo tutoana kikɛ daŋ pal kaman n sa ma nseŋ kini kenu n sa ma na nɛ bumo alɛ gba bee wora hale nɛ mbre na.

english_verse: They are stubborn and hardheaded. But I, the Lord God, have chosen you to tell them what I say.
translation_verse: Basa nɛ mee shuŋi fo bumo kutɔ ere la ŋgbene kpakpaso nɛ kusoe kpakpa be basa nɛ b maa sa ma bunyaŋ nna. Ya kaŋɛ bumo kusɔ nɛ ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ.

english_verse: Those rebels may not even listen, but at least they will know that a prophet has come to them.
translation_verse: B kaŋ nu n sa fo ŋko ŋ kini kenu n sa fo ŋkpal b ka la ŋgbene kpakpaso be basa so gba baaŋ pin fanɛ anebi ko ba bumo kutɔ m ba malga bre.

english_verse: Ezekiel, don't rebel against me, as they have done. Instead, listen to everything I tell you. And now, Ezekiel, open your mouth and eat what I am going to give you.
translation_verse: Ama fo ere, dimɛdi pibi, nu kusɔ nɛ mee kaŋɛ fo ere, nsaa maŋ kini ma m pal kaman n sa ma fanɛ bumo. Amoso bugi kɔnɔ n sɔ kusɔ nɛ mee sa fo ere n ji fanɛ ajibi.”

english_verse: Just then, I saw a hand stretched out toward me. And in it was a scroll.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ ŋ keni nseŋ wu enɔ nɛ kawɔl sibɛso ko bɔɔ to a wɔ enɔ na to nɛ k teŋi n shoŋi ma.

english_verse: The hand opened the scroll, and both sides of it were filled with words of sadness, mourning, and grief.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ enɔ na bugi kawɔl sibɛso na to nɛ n wu fanɛ kushu nɛ kagbene jija be yiri kikɛ be asheŋ nɛ b sibɛ n deŋi kumo be mba anyɔ na kikɛ so.

english_verse: He handed me the scroll and said, “Eat this and fill up on it.” So I ate the scroll, and it tasted sweet as honey.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ e kaŋɛ ma: “Dimɛdi pibi, ta kawɔl sibɛso nɛ n sa fo ere n ji fanɛ ajibi m moɛ.” Nɛ n ta kumo n ji. K daa du belbel ma kɔnɔ to nna fanɛ mushoŋ.

english_verse: They are Israelites, not some strangers who speak a foreign language you can't understand. If I were to send you to foreign nations, they would listen to you.
translation_verse: N daŋ shuŋi fo efuligboŋ pɔtɛ be basa nɛ baa gbar ŋgbar nɛ a du kpakpa nɛ fo tiŋ m pin amo to gba, baaŋ nu n sa fo.

english_verse: But the people of Israel will refuse to listen, because they have refused to listen to me. All of them are stubborn and hardheaded,
translation_verse: Ama Israɛl be basa ere maŋ wora shiriya nɛ b nu n sa fo, ŋkpal manɛ so b maŋ wora shiriya nɛ b nu n sa ma so. Bumo kikɛ la kusoe kpakpaso nɛ kumu kpakpaso be basa nna.

english_verse: so I will make you as stubborn as they are.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal loŋ so, meeŋ shin nɛ fo kusoe nɛ kagbene e baa du kpakpa fanɛ bumo peya.

english_verse: Then go to the people who were brought here to Babylonia with you and tell them you have a message from me, the Lord God. Do this, whether they listen to you or not.
translation_verse: To, yɔ fo kurgepoana nɛ b pɛ menyi kikɛ n yɔ Babilɔn be efuli so na kutɔ n ya kaŋɛ bumo kusɔ nɛ ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ. Baaŋ nu ŋko b maaŋ nu, fo ere e ya kaŋɛ bumo.”

english_verse: The Spirit lifted me up, and as the glory of the Lord started to leave, I heard a loud, thundering noise behind me.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Ebɔrɛ be Kiyoyu maŋ ma so n yɔ esoso, nɛ n nu ebɔl ko ka bee ponte awɔrso fanɛ bɔrɛ ka ponte na ma kaman to a kaŋɛ le: “Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be kemaŋkura e baa nya bunyaŋ ashi ebɔrɛso!”

english_verse: It was the sound made by the creatures' wings as they brushed against each other, and by the rumble of the wheels beside them.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ n nu asɔbɔya keniso na be mbuibi be aba na ka bee fe abar nɛ asɔ kulkulso fanɛ cheche be aya nɛ a mata bumo na ka bee gbri fanɛ bɔrɛ ka bee ponte na.

english_verse: Then the Spirit carried me away. The Lord's power had taken complete control of me, and I was both annoyed and angry.

translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ m ba kakpa nɛ basa nɛ b pɛ anya n yɔ efuli pɔtɛ so na wɔ na ashi kebeebi nɛ baa tre ‘Tɛl Abib’ nɛ k dese m mata Lɔr nɛ baa tre Kɛba na ase na n ya tu bumo n chena nchɛ ashunu. english_verse: Seven days after I had seen the brightness of the Lord's glory, the Lord said:
translation_verse: Nchɛ ashunu na be kaman, nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ ma le:

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, I have appointed you to stand watch for the people of Israel. So listen to what I say, then warn them for me.
translation_verse: “Dimɛdi pibi, n lara fo nna nɛ fo baa keni Israɛl be basa so. Amoso nu kamalga nɛ ŋ kɔ nɛ n sa bumo ere nseŋ fɛa bumo so.

english_verse: When I tell wicked people they will die because of their sins, you must warn them to turn from their sinful ways so they won't be punished. If you refuse, you are responsible for their death.
translation_verse: Nɛ m baŋ kaŋɛ kumu kpakpasowura fanɛ e beeŋ wu ŋkpal mbe be alubi so, nɛ fo maaŋ fɛa mo so ŋko ji mo asoe to nɛ e lar asheŋ lubi na to m mɔlga mbe kumu, e beeŋ wu ŋkpal mbe alubi so, ama mbe luwu na be turju beeŋ baa bɛ fo.

english_verse: However, if you do warn them, and they keep on sinning, they will die because of their sins, and you will be innocent.
translation_verse: Ama nɛ fo fɛa mo so nɛ e kini kelar mbe asheŋ lubi na to, e beeŋ wu ŋkpal mbe alubi so, ama fo ere beeŋ nya fo kumu.

english_verse: Now suppose faithful people start sinning, and I decide to put stumbling blocks in their paths to make them fall. They deserve to die because of their sins. So if you refuse to warn them, I will forget about the times they were faithful, and I will hold you responsible for their death.
translation_verse: Kede be kaman, nɛ esa nɛ e bee wora alelasheŋ yige alelasheŋ be kewora nsaa wora alubi, nɛ n shin nɛ e luri kebaawɔtɔ kpakpaso ko to, nɛ fo maŋ fɛa mo so, e beeŋ wu ŋkpal mbe alubi so. M maaŋ nyiŋi mbe alelasheŋ nɛ e wora na be kukoŋwule gba. Ma alɛ beeŋ ta mbe luwu na m bɛ fo.

english_verse: But if you do warn them, and they listen to you and stop sinning, I will let them live. And you will be innocent. Ezekiel Cannot Talk

english_verse: His Spirit took control of me and lifted me to my feet. Then the Lord said: Go back and lock yourself in your house!
translation_verse: Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be Kiyoyu ba pɛ ma to ŋ niŋi to n yili nseŋ kaŋɛ ma le: “Yɔ epe n ya ti fo kumu so n wɔtɔ fo ebu to.

english_verse: and I will make you unable to talk or to warn those who have rebelled against me.
translation_verse: Ma alɛ beeŋ shin nɛ fo ki neemu a maaŋ naŋ tiŋ m malga n fɛa basa nɛ b kini ma nseŋ pal kaman n sa ma ere so.

english_verse: But the time will come, when I will tell you what to say, and you will again be able to speak my message. Some of them will listen; others will be stubborn and refuse to listen.
translation_verse: Ama kachɛ nɛ meeŋ malga fo kutɔ na kaŋ fo, meeŋ bugi fo kɔnɔ nɛ fo malga bumo kutɔ saŋɛ na so feeŋ kaŋɛ bumo kusɔ nɛ ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ. Beko beeŋ nu nɛ beko malɛ e kini kenu, ŋkpal manɛ so, b la basa nɛ b kini ma nseŋ pal kaman n sa ma nna.”

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, find a brick and sketch a picture of Jerusalem on it.
translation_verse: Nɛ Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ le: “Dimɛdi pibi Ezikɛl, ta ebɔ be kuboo paŋgelambi n nase fo anishito nseŋ wora kadegboŋ nɛ baa tre Jerusalɛm na be foto n deŋi kumo so.

english_verse: Then prepare to attack the brick as if it were a real city. Build a dirt mound and a ramp up to the top and surround the brick with enemy camps. On every side put large wooden poles as though you were going to break down the gate to the city.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ fo wora asɔ ŋ kulti kumo fanɛ b ka kre kena ŋ kulti kumo n wɔtɔ na. english_verse: Eat only a small loaf of bread each day
translation_verse: Feeŋ baa jɔ amo gbrɛgbrɛbi nna a wora ajibi kachɛ kama a ji,

translation_verse: nsaa nuu nchu malɛ kawiebi nuunchu be ebɔlɔ anyɔ anyɔ kachɛ kama.

english_verse: Use dried human waste to start a fire, then bake the bread on the coals where everyone can watch you.
translation_verse: Feeŋ baa ta dimɛdi be ebin wɔlso nna a puga edɛ a daŋɛ ajibi na kelɔnɛ so, kakpa nɛ esa kama beeŋ wu fo.’ ”

english_verse: When I scatter the people of Israel among the nations, they will also have to eat food that is unclean, just as you must do.
translation_verse: Ade kikɛ be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ le: “Kede bee ŋini kananɛ Israɛl be basa beeŋ ji ajibi nɛ baa kishi jemanɛ nɛ meeŋ pesaŋ bumo to n yɔ efuli pɔtɛana so na nna.”

english_verse: I said, “Lord God, please don't make me do that! Never in my life have I eaten food that would make me unacceptable to you. I've never eaten anything that died a natural death or was killed by a wild animal or that you said was unclean.”
translation_verse: Nɛ ma alɛ kaŋɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ le: “Loŋ maaŋ wora, ŋkpal manɛ so, m maŋ naŋ ji ma ekishi n jija ma kumu kikɛ. Yili ma kebia to kikɛ, m maŋ naŋ ji kusɔ wuso ŋko kusɔ nɛ kusɔbɔya pɛ n ji ŋ ka kikɛ. Ajibi nɛ a maŋ walɛ so maŋ naŋ luri ma kɔnɔ kikɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord replied, “Instead of human waste, I will let you bake your bread on a fire made from cow manure.

translation_verse: Asheŋ ere be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ: “Dimɛdi pibi, Ezikɛl, ta bɔrfɔ nɛ k bee ji n she fo kumu nɛ fo katɔl. Kumo be kaman nɛ fo ta kusɔ nɛ b kɔ a karga asɔ be egbɛ na m barga emin na to ntuŋ asa.

english_verse: After you attack the brick that stands for Jerusalem, burn one pile of your hair on the brick. Chop up the second pile and let the small pieces of hair fall around the brick. Throw the third pile into the wind, and I will strike it with my own sword.
translation_verse: Jemanɛ nɛ fo kre kena ŋ kulti Jerusalɛm be foto nɛ fo wora n deŋi kejembu paŋgelambi na so na kaŋ fo ekar, nɛ fo chɔɔ emin na be katuŋ koŋwule kade nɛ fo wora kumo be foto na to, nseŋ ta bɔrfɔ na ŋ kuya emin na be katuŋ nyɔsopo to ŋ kulti kade na.
