english_verse: Keep a few of the hairs and wrap them in the hem of your clothes.
translation_verse: Ama pɔɛŋ nɛ fo wora loŋ fo lara emin na be gbrɛbi n da fo piŋi be kɔnɔ.

english_verse: Then pull out a few of those hairs and throw them in the fire, so they will also burn. This fire will spread, destroying everyone in Israel.
translation_verse: Nseŋ lara amo be gbrɛbi n chɔɔ edɛ to a ŋini fanɛ edɛ beeŋ shi ndoŋ n suse m mur ekama Israɛl be efuli so.”

english_verse: I am the Lord God, and I have made Jerusalem the most important place in the world, and all other nations admire it.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ: “Jerusalɛm nɛ n ta n yili durnya kikɛ be nferinto nɛ efuliana kulti kumo ŋ wɔtɔ a keni kumo a yɛlga nna na.

english_verse: But the people of Jerusalem rebelled and refuse to obey me. They ignored my laws and have become even more sinful than the nations around them.
translation_verse: Ama Jerusalɛm to be basa lar ma kaman nseŋ kini kewora m bɛ ma mbraana nɛ ma atande so. B kplaŋ ma mbraana so nsaa wora alubi a chɔ efuliana nɛ a kulti bumo na gba.

english_verse: So tell the people of Jerusalem: I am the Lord God! You have refused to obey my laws and teachings, and instead you have obeyed the laws of the surrounding nations. You have become more rebellious than any of them!
translation_verse: Amoso kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee kaŋɛ Jerusalɛm be basa e la fanɛ, men kini kenu m bɛ ma mbraana nɛ ma atande so nseŋ ya ka bɛ efuliana nɛ e kulti menyi na be mbraana so. Men be ŋgbene ki kpakpa a chɔ bumo gba!

english_verse: for your sins. Your punishment will be more horrible than anything I've ever done or will ever do again.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal menyi be agbirana nɛ ŋ kishi ga ere kikɛ so, meeŋ wora menyi kusɔ nɛ m maŋ naŋ wora kikɛ, ma alɛ m maaŋ naŋ wora kumo kikɛ.

english_verse: Parents will be so desperate for food that they will eat their own children, and children will eat their parents. Those who survive this horror will be scattered in every direction.
translation_verse: Bekurgepo beeŋ kpal akoŋ so a mɔ bumo be mbia a we nɛ mbia e baa mɔ bumo bekurgepoana a we. Meeŋ gberge menyi kusoe hale nɛ bekama nɛ baaŋ ji efute gba na e pesaŋ to n yɔ mboŋ wɔfɔ.

english_verse: Your sins have disgusted me and made my temple unfit as a place to worship me. So I swear by my own life that I will cut you down and show you no pity.
translation_verse: Ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na, e naa bɔ ntaŋ a kaŋɛ fanɛ, ŋkpal men ka ta menyi be agbirana nɛ aworbi lubiana n shin nɛ ma bɔrɛlambu ki kakpa nɛ esa maaŋ naŋ tiŋ n shuŋ ma ndoŋ so, m maaŋ wu menyi kuwɔr ŋko n shu menyi so ŋko n shin nɛ men nya menyi be amu n ya ji kikɛ.

english_verse: A third of you will die here in Jerusalem from disease or starvation. Another third will be killed in war. And I will scatter the last third of you in every direction, then track you down and kill you.
translation_verse: Menyi to be ntuŋ asa to be katuŋ koŋwule beeŋ wu ŋkpal alɔ nɛ akoŋ so ashi Jerusalɛm to, nɛ katuŋ nyɔsopo e wu kena to. Katuŋ sasopo malɛ beeŋ pesaŋ to n sɔ kaplɛkama a shile nɛ n ta tokobi m bɛ bumo so a mɔ.

english_verse: You will feel my fierce anger until I have finished taking revenge. Then you will know that I, the Lord, was furious because of your disobedience.
translation_verse: Menyeeŋ ji awurfoŋ ga pɔɛŋ nɛ ma agbo e wushi. Ndoŋ nɛ menyeeŋ pin fanɛ kenishipereso nɛ ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na, daa malga menyi be asheŋ lubi be asheŋ na.

english_verse: will insult you and make fun of you, but they will also be shocked and terrified at what I did in my anger.
translation_verse: Menyeeŋ ki kemɔmɔshia nɛ katege be kusɔ nsaa la kefiɛso n sa efuliana nɛ a kulti menyi na nɛ menyi be asheŋ a chinchiŋ bumo.

english_verse: I will destroy your crops until you starve to death, and disasters will strike you like arrows.
translation_verse: Ma alɛ beeŋ naŋ shin nɛ akoŋ e mɔ menyi fanɛ b ka to menyi atanyembi m mɔ na. Kashenteŋto, meeŋ mur menyi be adɔjibi nɛ akoŋgboŋ a tɔr menyi so.

english_verse: Starvation and wild animals will kill your children. I'll punish you with horrible diseases, and your enemies will strike you down with their swords. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Akoŋ nɛ kupuŋ to be asɔbɔya beeŋ ba mur menyi be mbia nɛ men ki begbentepo. Meeŋ bɔla alɔ mɔso so nɛ men doŋana be kemɔ menyi so ŋ gberge menyi kusoe. Ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ e kaŋɛ na.”

english_verse: The Lord God said:
translation_verse: Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ ma le:

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, face the hills of Israel and tell them:
translation_verse: “Dimɛdi pibi, Ezikɛl, kilgi fo anishito n shoŋi Israɛl be abee nseŋ malga n sa amo

english_verse: Listen, you mountains and hills, and every valley and gorge! I, the Lord, am about to turn against you and crush all the places where foreign gods are worshiped.
translation_verse: ŋ kaŋɛ: ‘Israɛl be abee, men nu Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na be kubɔya.’ ” E yɛ: “Ŋ kɔ tokobi nna a ba abee nɛ agoŋgulombi nɛ amantaŋ nɛ ataŋɛ kikɛ so nɛ m ba mur mboŋ nɛ basa bee shuŋ agbirana na.

english_verse: Every altar will be smashed, and in front of the idols I will put to death the people who worship them.
translation_verse: Meeŋ bure agbirsure nɛ eduwusure na kikɛ nyam nseŋ mɔ basa nɛ b wɔ ndoŋ na kikɛ n nase bumo be agbirana be anishito.

english_verse: Dead bodies and bones will be lying around the idols and the altars.
translation_verse: Meeŋ pesaŋ Israɛl be basa be bubuni to ashi bumo be agbirana be anishito nseŋ pesaŋ bumo be awibi to ŋ kulti agbirsure na.

english_verse: Every town in Israel will be destroyed to make sure that each shrine, idol, and altar is smashed—everything the Israelites made will be a pile of ruins.
translation_verse: Israɛl be efuli so be nde kikɛ beeŋ mur nɛ bumo be agbirshuŋkpaana kikɛ e bure m bure. Kumo be kaman, nɛ bumo be kusɔ kama e ki fuloŋ.

english_verse: All over the country, your people will die. And those who survive will know that I, the Lord, did these things.
translation_verse: Menyi be basa beeŋ wu n dese kaplɛkama, nɛ menyi to be bumo nɛ baaŋ ji efute na e pin fanɛ ma, e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nseŋ shuŋ ma.

english_verse: I will let some of the people live through this punishment, but I will scatter them among the nations,
translation_verse: Ama meeŋ shin nɛ beko e ji efute nseŋ pesaŋ to n yɔ efuli pɔtɛana so.

english_verse: where they will be prisoners. And when they think of me, they will realize that they disgraced me by rebelling and by worshiping idols. They will hate themselves for the evil things they did,
translation_verse: Saŋɛ na so, bumo nɛ baaŋ ji efute na beeŋ fɛ ma asheŋ nseŋ nyiŋi kananɛ b lar ma kaman nsaa shuŋ agbirana nseŋ ta nyɔmɔ m pɛ ma na ashi efuliana nɛ baaŋ tintiŋ bumo n yɔ na so. Ndoŋ nɛ bumo gbagba be asheŋ beeŋ baa nu bumo gbagba agbo ŋkpal bumo asheŋ lubi lubi nɛ b wora so

english_verse: and they will know that I am the Lord and that my warnings must be taken seriously.
translation_verse: nɛ b pin fanɛ ma, e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na, ma alɛ maa funti jiga nna a kaŋɛ fanɛ meeŋ mur bumo be asɔ.”

english_verse: The Lord God then said: Ezekiel, beat your fists together and stomp your feet in despair! Moan in sorrow, because the people of Israel have done disgusting things and now will be killed by enemy troops, or they will die from starvation and disease.
translation_verse: Ade kikɛ be kaman, nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ: “Ezikɛl, ta fo enɔana n deŋi kumu nsaa shu a bri aya ase a boŋ to kagbenejijaso. Ŋkpal Israɛl be basa be aworbi lubi nɛ ŋ kishi ga na so, kena nɛ akoŋ nɛ alɔ mɔso e naŋ mur bumo.

english_verse: Those who live far away will be struck with deadly diseases. Those who live nearby will be killed in war. And the ones who are left will starve to death. I will let loose my anger on them!
translation_verse: Alɔ beeŋ mɔ bumo nɛ b wɔ kufɔ kufɔ nɛ bumo nɛ b taga to malɛ e wu kena to nɛ bumo nɛ baaŋ nya bumo be amu n ji efute malɛ e wu ŋkpal akoŋ so. Kananɛ ma agbogboŋ beeŋ gbelge bumo so nna na.

english_verse: These people used to offer incense to idols at altars built on hills and mountaintops and in the shade of large oak trees. But when they see dead bodies lying around those altars, they will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Jemanɛ nɛ bumo be basa beeŋ wu n dese abeebi nɛ abeegboŋ be awɔlto nɛ ndibi gboŋ be yiri nɛ a la bumo be agbirana be eshuŋkpaana nɛ baa chɔɔ duwu a sa bumo be agbirana kikɛ be afito na nɛ baaŋ pin fanɛ ma e la Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na.

english_verse: I will make their country a barren wasteland, from the Southern Desert to the town of Diblah in the north. Then they will know that I, the Lord, have done these things.
translation_verse: Kashenteŋto, meeŋ yili Keshishɛrsawule nɛ k wɔ kelargato be kaseto na m ba choŋ kade nɛ baa tre Dibla nɛ k wɔ kelargato be esoso be kaba so na m mur efuli na kikɛ,. Meeŋ mur kaplɛkama nɛ Israɛl be basa tase. Ndoŋ nɛ baaŋ pin fanɛ ma e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.”

english_verse: The Lord God said:
translation_verse: Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ ma le:

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, tell the people of Israel that I am saying: Israel will soon come to an end! Your whole country is about to be destroyed
translation_verse: “Dimɛdi pibi, Ezikɛl, kusɔ nɛ ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na bee kaŋɛ Israɛl be efuli so be basa e la fanɛ, lalaloge be jemanɛ na bee fo nɛ efuli na kikɛ nyam e mur.

english_verse: that I will show no pity. I will punish you for the evil you've done, and you will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: M maaŋ wu menyi kuwɔr ŋko n yige menyi nɛ men ta men be amu n ya ji. Abaanaaworasheŋ meeŋ gberge menyi kusoe ŋkpal men be eda lubi nɛ aworbi lubi nɛ ŋ kishi so. Ndoŋ nɛ menyeeŋ pin fanɛ ma e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.”

english_verse: And when it comes, your life will be over.
translation_verse: Kemur be saŋɛ na fo! K fo n loge. K beeŋ shin nɛ men mur.

english_verse: I will let loose my anger and punish you for the evil things you've done. You'll get what you deserve.
translation_verse: Meeŋ shin nɛ ma agbogboŋ e ba menyi so nɛ n ji menyi demu ŋkpal menyi be eda lubi so nseŋ gberge menyi kusoe ŋkpal menyi be aworbi lubi nɛ ŋ kishi na so.

english_verse: Your sins are so terrible, that you'll get no mercy from me. Then you will know that I, the Lord, have punished you.
translation_verse: M maaŋ wu menyi kuwɔr, ma alɛ maaŋ yige menyi nɛ men ta menyi be amu n ya ji. Meeŋ gberge menyi kusoe ŋkpal menyi be eda nɛ aworbi lubi so. Ndoŋ nɛ menyeeŋ pin fanɛ ma Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e naa gberge menyi kusoe na.”

english_verse: and people who sell property will never get it back, because all of you must be punished for your sins. And I won't change my mind!
translation_verse: Esa nɛ e fa mbe kasawule maaŋ naŋ tiŋ n sɔ kumo esa nɛ e tɔ kumo na kutɔ kikɛ, ŋkpal manɛ so kewuŋkaŋɛ nɛ k bee laŋɛ ekama b kaplɛa so na maaŋ naŋ chɛrga. Bumo be ekama maaŋ tiŋ m mɔlga mbe kumu ŋkpal bumo be alubi so.

english_verse: A signal has been blown on the trumpet, and weapons are prepared for battle. But no one goes to war, because in my anger I will strike down everyone in Israel. Israel Is Surrounded The Lord said to the people of Israel:
translation_verse: Hale nɛ b foŋ kabel fanɛ ekama e bela ase n yɔ kena to gba esa koŋwule gba maŋ lar n yɔ, ŋkpal manɛ so, ma kagbene kaa ekama so nna.

english_verse: War, disease, and starvation are everywhere! People who live in the countryside will be killed in battle, and those who live in towns will die from starvation or deadly diseases.
translation_verse: Kena nɛ alɔ nɛ akoŋ beeŋ sɔ kaplɛkama! Kena e naŋ mɔ ndekarso be basa nɛ akoŋ nɛ alɔ mɔso malɛ e mɔ ndegboŋ to be basa.

english_verse: Anyone who survives will escape into the hills, like doves who leave the valleys to find safety. All of you will moan because of your sins.
translation_verse: Bekama nɛ baaŋ ji efute na malɛ beeŋ shile n yɔ abee so fanɛ kufu ka pɛ elepɔ nɛ a firgi n shi ketaŋɛ to n yɔ kebee so na. Ndoŋ nɛ baaŋ ya shu ŋkpal bumo be alubi so.

english_verse: You will put on sackcloth to show your sorrow, but terror will overpower you. Shame will be written all over your faces, and you will shave your heads in despair.
translation_verse: Baaŋ ta ebɔtɛ ŋ ki asɔbuuso m buu a ŋini fanɛ bumo be ŋgbene jija bumo nna, nɛ kufugboŋ e tɔr bumo so. Anishinyɔr beeŋ pɛ bumo nseŋ shin nɛ ekama e she mbe kumu nɛ k baa la ŋaba n sa mo.

english_verse: Your silver and gold will be thrown into the streets like garbage, because those are the two things that led you into sin, and now they cannot save you from my anger. They are not even worth enough to buy food.
translation_verse: Baaŋ ta bumo be shuwa nɛ gbiti n lɛ agbembi so fanɛ asɔ jiga na, ŋkpal manɛ so, shuwa nɛ gbiti na maaŋ tiŋ m mɔlga bumo jemanɛ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be agbo beeŋ ba bumo so na. B maaŋ naŋ tiŋ n ta amo n tɔ ajibi gba n ji. Ŋkpal manɛ so, shuwa nɛ gbiti na e shin nɛ b tɔr kulubi to.

english_verse: You took great pride in using your beautiful jewelry to make disgusting idols of foreign gods. So I will make your jewelry worthless.
translation_verse: B daa puchi ŋkpal abitasɔ lela nɛ b kɔ so nna nseŋ ta amo ŋ wora agbirana nɛ amo be asheŋ bee nu agbo. Amoso meeŋ shin nɛ abitasɔ na e ki fuloŋ, nsaa maŋ naa kɔ tɔnɔ n sa bumo.

english_verse: They will break into my temple and leave it unfit as a place to worship me, but I will look away and let it happen.
translation_verse: Jemanɛ nɛ basa lubi beeŋ ba bure n luri ma bɔrɛlambu nɛ mee sha ga na to a jija kumo na, meeŋ kpele ma anishi fanɛ ŋ ka maŋ wu bumo na. Beyu ba luri n ya kaa yuri kumo to be asɔ gba, m maaŋ tuge bumo.

english_verse: Your whole country is in confusion! Murder and violence are everywhere in Israel,
translation_verse: “Basa be kamɔ nɛ keta akɔsɔ a kɔ a fin kusɔ nɛ esa bee sha tintiŋ so sɔ efuli na be kaplɛkama nna.

english_verse: so I will tell the most wicked nations to come and take over your homes. They will put an end to the pride you have in your strong army, and they will make your places of worship unfit to use.
translation_verse: Ma alɛ beeŋ shin nɛ efuliana nɛ b lubi a chɔ bekama na e ba sɔ bumo be nwu kikɛ. Kumo be kaman, nɛ n shin nɛ benapo lempo nɛ baa puchi so na e pɔ aba, ŋkpal efuliana ka beeŋ jija bumo be kabɔrɛshuŋ be mboŋ so.

english_verse: You will be terrified and will desperately look for peace—but there will be no peace.
translation_verse: Kufugboŋ kaŋ ba bumo so na nɛ baaŋ pere kenishi n fin kayurwushi, ama bumo alɛ maaŋ nya kumo.

english_verse: One tragedy will follow another, and you'll hear only bad news. People will beg prophets to give them a message from me. Priests will stop teaching my Law, and wise leaders won't be able to give advice.
translation_verse: Aleblawu bee ba nɛ ebaru lubi be abɔya a sɔ kaplɛkama. Basa beeŋ baa kule anebiana fanɛ b nu Ebɔrɛ be ebɔl ŋ kaŋɛ bumo kusɔ ko, nɛ b maaŋ nya. B maaŋ naŋ nya mbraana nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana daa ŋini na nɛ kasotoji nɛ benimuana na daa sa bumo na kikɛ.

english_verse: Even your king and his officials will lose hope and cry in despair. Your hands will tremble with fear. I will punish you for your sins and treat you the same way you have treated others. Then you will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Ewura beeŋ shu nɛ benimuana na e paŋ tama nɛ kufu e tɔr basa na kikɛ so nɛ b baa chicha. Bumo be aworbi so nɛ meeŋ gberge bumo kusoe nseŋ wora bumo kusɔ nɛ b ta n wora beko na. Ndoŋ nɛ baaŋ pin fanɛ ma, e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.”

english_verse: Six years after King Jehoiachin and the rest of us had been led away as prisoners to Babylonia, the leaders of Judah were meeting with me in my house. On the fifth day of the sixth month, the Lord God suddenly took control of me,
translation_verse: B ka pɛ anyi n tintiŋ anyi n yɔ Babilɔn be efuli so na be kafɛ shesopo na to be kufɔl shesopo be kachɛ nusopo na, nɛ ma nɛ Juda be benimuana chena ma nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na be eleŋgboŋ gbelge ma so ndoŋ epul to.

english_verse: and I saw something in the shape of a human. This figure was like fire from the waist down, and it was bright as polished metal from the waist up.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ ŋ keni nseŋ wu kusɔ ko ka du fanɛ dimɛdi be kaduli ka yil a kpa edɛ. Yili kumo be kashɛr ase m ba aya ase daa du fanɛ edɛ na, nɛ yili kumo be kashɛr ase n dii a yɔ kumo be kumu ase malɛ daa nyɛkpɛ fanɛ danyaŋ nɛ b fɛfa so na.

english_verse: It reached out what seemed to be a hand and grabbed my hair. Then in my vision the Lord's Spirit lifted me into the sky and carried me to Jerusalem. The Spirit took me to the north gate of the temple's inner courtyard, where there was an idol that disgusted the Lord and made him furious.
translation_verse: Nɛ k teŋi kusɔ ko to fanɛ enɔ na m pɛ ma emin to. Ndoŋ nna nɛ Ebɔrɛ be Kiyoyu maŋ ma so awɔlto ashi bɔrɛdare to n ta ma n yɔ Jerusalɛm to n ya yili bɔrɛlambu na be epunto be kelɔnɛ na be kabuna nɛ k bee laŋɛ kelargato be esoso be kaba so be kakpa nɛ basa na ta kegbir nɛ k bee shin nɛ Ebɔrɛ be kagbene bee kaa ga na n yili na.

english_verse: Then I saw the brightness of the glory of the God of Israel, just as I had seen it near the Chebar River.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nɛ ŋ wu Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na be kemaŋkura fanɛ kumo nɛ n daŋ wu jemanɛ nɛ n daa wɔ Lɔr nɛ baa tre Kɛba na ase na.

english_verse: God then said, “Do you see the terrible sins of the people of Israel? Their sins are making my holy temple unfit as a place to worship me. Yet you will see even worse things than this.”
translation_verse: Nɛ Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ ma le: “Dimɛdi pibi, fo wu kusɔ nɛ k bee wora nna na. Keni ekishisheŋ nɛ Israɛl be basa ere bee wora nfe, baa ju ma a lar ma bɔrɛlambu to a yɔ kufɔ kufɔ nna na. Ama fo kraa beeŋ wu ekishisheŋ nɛ a chɔ ade gba.”

english_verse: Next, I was taken to the entrance of the courtyard, where I saw a hole in the wall.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ e bar ma bɔrɛlambu na be kowushina be kelɔnɛ na be kabuna to m ba ŋini ma kemaŋ ko egbal na to,

english_verse: God said, “Make this hole bigger.” And when I did, I realized it was a doorway.
translation_verse: nseŋ kaŋɛ ma: “Dimɛdi pibi kpalga kemaŋ na to.” Nɛ ŋ kpalga kumo nseŋ wu fanɛ ndoŋ la kabuna nna.

english_verse: “Go in,” God said, “and see what horrible and evil things the people are doing.”
translation_verse: Nɛ e kaŋɛ ma: “Luri to n ya keni ekishisheŋ nɛ baa wora ndoŋ.”

english_verse: Inside, I saw that the walls were covered with pictures of reptiles and disgusting, unclean animals, as well as with idols that the Israelites were worshiping.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ n luri to n ya keni, nseŋ wu b ka wora awɔ nɛ asɔbɔya nɛ a maŋ walɛ keji be efoto n deŋi egbalana na so nɛ agbirana nɛ Israɛl be basa bee shuŋ ndoŋ.

english_verse: Seventy Israelite leaders were standing there, including Jaazaniah son of Shaphan. Each of these leaders was holding an incense burner, and the smell of incense filled the room.
translation_verse: Israɛl be basa na be benimuana na to be basa adushunu e daa yil ndoŋ. Shafan pibinyɛn, Jazaania gba daŋ ti bumo so. Bumo be ekama malɛ daa kɔ kusɔ nɛ b kɔ a chɔɔ duwu mbe enɔ nna nɛ edishi bee kaa kumo to.

english_verse: God said, “Ezekiel, do you see what horrible things Israel's leaders are doing in secret? They have filled their rooms with idols. And they say I can't see them, because they think I have already deserted Israel.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ ma le: “Dimɛdi pibi, fo wu kusɔ nɛ Israɛl be benimuana ere bee wora ashiri to nna na, ŋko? Bumo be ekama yil mbe kegbir ase nna na. B yɛ: ‘Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na maa wu anyi. Mo alɛ naŋ lar efuli na kaman nna.’ ”

english_verse: But I will show you something even worse than this.”
translation_verse: Nɛ e naŋ lɔŋɛ ŋ kaŋɛ: “Feeŋ naaŋ wu bumo nɛ baa wora ekishisheŋ nɛ a chɔ ade.”

english_verse: God asked me, “Can you believe what these women are doing? But now I want to show you something even worse.”
translation_verse: Nɛ e kaŋɛ ma: “Dimɛdi pibi, fo wu kusɔ nɛ beche ere bee wora ere a? Fo kraa beeŋ wu ekishisheŋ nɛ a chɔ ade.”

english_verse: God said, “Ezekiel, it's bad enough that the people of Judah are doing these disgusting things. But they have also spread violence and injustice everywhere in Israel and have made me very angry. They have disgraced and insulted me in the worst possible way.
translation_verse: Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ ma: “Dimɛdi pibi, fo wu kede a? Fo tama fanɛ k la kusɔ fɔmbi nna fanɛ Juda be basa ere kaa beeŋ baa wora asheŋ lubi lubi ere ashi nfe a? A daga fanɛ b baa ta akɔsɔ a kɔ a fin bumo be kepar tintiŋ so kaplɛkama a wora asheŋ nɛ a bee wɔtɔ ma agbo to jemanɛ kikɛ a? Keni kananɛ b ŋaba ma nsaa tege ma ekpa nɛ esa kikɛ maŋ naŋ ŋaba ŋko n tege ma loŋ.

english_verse: So in my fierce anger, I will punish them without mercy and refuse to help them when they cry out to me.”
translation_verse: Ŋkpal loŋ so, meeŋ gberge bumo kusoe agbo so. M maaŋ wu bumo kuwɔr ŋko n yige bumo nɛ b ta bumo be amu n ya ji. Hale nɛ b shu n tre ma gba m maaŋ nu nseŋ chɛ bumo to.”

english_verse: After that, I heard the Lord shout, “Come to Jerusalem, you men chosen to destroy the city. And bring your weapons!”
translation_verse: Ade be kaman nɛ n nu Ebɔrɛ ka ponte ŋ kaŋɛ: “Menyi nɛ b lara fanɛ men gberge kadegboŋ na to be basa kusoe na e ta menyi be akɔsɔ m bɔɔ enɔ m ba Jerusalɛm to.”

english_verse: I saw six men come through the north gate of the temple, each one holding a deadly weapon. A seventh man dressed in a linen robe was with them, and he was carrying things to write with. The men went into the temple and stood by the bronze altar.
translation_verse: Epul to nɛ benyɛn ashe ko shi bɔrɛlambu na be kabuna nɛ k wɔ kelargato be esoso be kaba so na m ba. Bumo be ekama daa bɔ kekɔsɔ enɔ to nna. Kanyɛn ko nɛ e daŋ buu piŋi lela nsaa kɔ kasibɛ be asɔ enɔ to gba daŋ ti bumo so nna. Bumo kikɛ ba luri bɔrɛlambu na to nna n ya yili danyaŋ be bɔrɛsure na ase.

english_verse: The brightness of God's glory then left its place above the statues of the winged creatures inside the temple and moved to the entrance. The Lord said to the man in the linen robe,
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na be kemaŋkura na lar asɔbɔya keniso nɛ a kɔ mbuibi be aba nɛ baa tre ‘chɛrubim’ na be kumu ase n yɔ bɔrɛlambu na be kabuna to. Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na tre kanyɛn nɛ e buu piŋi lela na nsaa kɔ kasibɛ be asɔ enɔ to na

english_verse: “Walk through the city of Jerusalem and mark the forehead of anyone who is truly upset and sad about the terrible things that are being done here.”
translation_verse: ŋ kaŋɛ mo le: “Yɔ Jerusalɛm be kadegboŋ na to n ya dulgi bekama nɛ asheŋ bee besa nɛ bumo be ŋgbene jija bumo ŋkpal ekishisheŋ nɛ a bee wora kade na to so na be nsɔto.” Nɛ kanyɛn na lar n yɔ nɛ e ya dulgi bumo.

english_verse: He turned to the other six men and said, “Follow him and put to death everyone who doesn't have a mark on their forehead. Show no mercy or pity! Kill men and women, parents and children. Begin here at my temple, but be sure not to harm those who are marked.” The men immediately killed the leaders who were standing there.
translation_verse: Men ya mɔ benyɛnnimu nɛ mbrantiɛ nɛ besuŋgurbi nɛ bechekpar nɛ mbi wurbi kikɛ ama men sa maŋ beta ekama nɛ e kɔ ndulgi mbe kasɔto na. Men fara ma bɔrɛlambu to a mɔ a yɔ.” Nɛ b ta benimuana nɛ b daa wɔ bɔrɛlambu na be anishito na n fara.

english_verse: Then the Lord said, “Pollute the temple by piling the dead bodies in the courtyards. Now get busy!” They left and started killing the people of Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Ebɔrɛ naŋ kaŋɛ bumo: “Men mɔ basa n lɛ bɔrɛlambu na be kelɔnɛ na so kikɛ n shin nɛ k jija. Men fara a mɔ!” Nɛ b lar n ya fara basa be kemɔ Jerusalɛm be kadegboŋ na kikɛ to.

english_verse: I was then alone, so I bowed down and cried out to the Lord, “Why are you doing this? Are you so angry with the people of Jerusalem that everyone must die?”
translation_verse: B ka fara kamɔ na a yɔ nɛ n nawule ka a yil, nseŋ kurgi kumu n yuu to m boŋ to ŋ kaŋɛ le: “Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ, ŋkpal fo ka nya agbo ga n wora Jerusalɛm to be basa so, fee sha nna nɛ fo mɔ Israɛl be basa nɛ b ka ere kikɛ a?”

english_verse: The Lord answered, “The people of Israel and Judah have done horrible things. Their country is filled with murderers, and Jerusalem itself is filled with violence. They think that I have deserted them, and that I can't see what they are doing.
translation_verse: Nɛ Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ ma le: “Israɛl nɛ Juda be basa be kulubi na shi m baŋ so. Basa be kemɔ e sɔ kasawule na kikɛ so nɛ ekishisheŋ malɛ sɔ Jerusalɛm be kade to kikɛ. Baa kaŋɛ nna fanɛ, ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kplaŋ efuli na so nna; ma alɛ maa wu asheŋ nɛ baa wora na.

english_verse: And so I will not have pity on them or forgive them. They will be punished for what they have done.”
translation_verse: Amoso m maaŋ wu bumo kuwɔr ŋko n shu bumo so kikɛ. Kananɛ b wora beko na nɛ ma alɛ gba beeŋ wora bumo.”

english_verse: Just then, the man in the linen robe returned and said, “I have done what you commanded.”
translation_verse: Ade kikɛ be kaman nɛ kanyɛn nɛ e daŋ buu piŋi lela na bɛta m ba kaŋɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na le: “N wora kusɔ nɛ fo kaŋɛ na n loge.”

english_verse: The Lord said to the man in the linen robe, “Walk among the four wheels beside the creatures and pick up as many hot coals as you can carry. Then scatter them over the city of Jerusalem.” I watched him as he followed the Lord's instructions.
translation_verse: Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ kanyɛn nɛ e buu piŋi lela na le: “Ya lara ajanwulɛ nɛ a kɔ edɛ ashi asɔ kulkulso nɛ a du fanɛ cheche be aya a wɔ asɔbɔya keniso na be akel to na n ya fari Jerusalɛm be kadegboŋ na kikɛ to.” Ndoŋ nna nɛ mee keni mo nɛ e bee yɔ.

english_verse: The winged creatures were standing south of the temple when the man walked among them. A cloud filled the inner courtyard,
translation_verse: Jemanɛ nɛ kanyɛn na bee yɔ na nɛ asɔbɔya keniso na yil a laŋɛ bɔrɛlambu na be kelargato be kaseto na nna, nɛ kuwɔlpa buu bɔrɛlambu na be epunto be kelɔnɛ na kikɛ so.

english_verse: and the brightness of the Lord's glory moved from above the creatures and stopped at the entrance of the temple. The entire temple was filled with his glory, and the courtyard was dazzling bright.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be kemaŋkura shi asɔbɔya keniso na be amu so n yɔ bɔrɛlambu na be kabuna to nɛ kuwɔlpa na sɔ bɔrɛlambu na to kikɛ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be kemaŋkura shin nɛ kelɔnɛ na kikɛ to fulto parr.

english_verse: The sound of the creatures' wings was as loud as the voice of God All-Powerful and could even be heard in the outer courtyard.
translation_verse: Esa nɛ e daa wɔ bɔrɛlambu na be kowushina be kelɔnɛ na gba so daa nu asɔbɔya keniso na be mbuibi be aba be egbri, ŋkpal manɛ so, a daa gbri nna fanɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ be ebɔl na.

english_verse: One of the four creatures reached its hand into the fire among them and gave him some of the hot coals. The man took the coals and left.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ asɔbɔya keniso na be ekoŋwule teŋi enɔ n shoŋi edɛ nɛ a dese bumo be nferinto na nseŋ lara ako n wɔtɔ kanyɛn na be enɔ to nɛ mo alɛ ta n lar n choŋ.

english_verse: I noticed again that each of the four winged creatures had what looked like human hands under their wings,
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ n naŋ wu fanɛ asɔbɔya keniso na be kekama daa kɔ kusɔ ko fanɛ dimɛdi be enɔ bumo be mbuibi be aba na be kekama be kaseto.

english_verse: and I saw the four wheels near the creatures. These wheels were shining like chrysolite.
translation_verse: Nɛ n naŋ keni n wu fanɛ aya kulkulso ana mata asɔbɔya keniso na nsaa nyɛkpɛ fanɛ yawu kpakpaso be ajembu nyɛkpɛso na.

english_verse: Each wheel was exactly the same and had a second wheel that cut through the middle of it,
translation_verse: Aya kulkulso ana na kikɛ duli abar nna nɛ kekama malɛ kɔ keya nyɔsopo nɛ k larga kumo to,

english_verse: so that they could move in any direction without turning. The wheels moved together whenever the creatures moved.
translation_verse: saŋɛ na so asɔbɔya keniso na baa yɔ kaplɛkama aya kulkulso na maŋ naa kilgi. Bumo be aya na kikɛ beeŋ tiŋ n yɔ kaplɛkama nɛ a maŋ kilgi.

english_verse: I also noticed that the wheels and the creatures' bodies, including their backs, their hands, and their wings, were covered with eyes.
translation_verse: Anishi daa wɔ asɔbɔya keniso na be eyur so kikɛ nna. Bumo be mman nɛ mbre nɛ mbuibi be aba so nɛ aya kulkulso ana na gba kikɛ so daa kɔ anishi nna.

english_verse: Each of the winged creatures had four faces: the face of a bull, the face of a human, the face of a lion, and the face of an eagle.
translation_verse: Asɔbɔya keniso na be ekama daa kɔ anishiakpa ana nna. Bumo be anishito daa la dimɛdi be anishiakpa nna nɛ bumo be jisoso daa la buluŋ be anishiakpa nɛ bumo be bena so la gbolu be anishiakpa nɛ bumo be kaman to daa la kusore be anishiakpa.

english_verse: These were the same creatures I had seen near the Chebar River. They controlled when and where the wheels moved—the wheels went wherever the creatures went and stopped whenever they stopped. Even when the creatures flew in the air, the wheels stayed beside them.
translation_verse: Nɛ asɔbɔya keniso na baaŋ yili aya na gba bee yili epul na to nna. Nɛ b baŋ naŋ koso malɛ amo alɛ gba bee koso nna, ŋkpal manɛ so, asɔbɔya keniso na e naa keta amo a wora asheŋ.

english_verse: Then I watched the brightness of the Lord's glory move from the entrance of the temple and stop above the winged creatures.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be kemaŋkura lar bɔrɛlambu na be kabuna ase n ya buu asɔbɔya keniso na be amu so.

english_verse: They spread their wings and flew into the air with the wheels at their side. They stopped at the east gate of the temple, and the Lord's glory was above them.
translation_verse: Ŋ ka keni nɛ n wu asɔbɔya keniso na ka parga bumo be aba to ŋ koso kasawule a firgi nɛ aya kulkulso na tu bumo a yɔ. B ka ya fo bɔrɛlambu na be kabuna nɛ k wɔ epeŋilarkpa be kaba so na nɛ b shir n yili gbrɛ, nɛ Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na be kemaŋkura kraa buu bumo so.

english_verse: I knew for sure that these were the same creatures I had seen beneath the Lord's glory near the Chebar River.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ m pin geeŋ fanɛ asɔbɔya keniso ere nɛ n daŋ wu Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na be kaseto na ashi Kɛba be lɔr ase na.

english_verse: They had four wings with hands beneath them, and they had the same four faces as those near the River. Each creature moved straight ahead without turning.
translation_verse: Bumo alɛ be anishiakpa daa du fanɛ amo nɛ n wu Kɛba be lɔr ase na gbagba nna. Ekama malɛ baaŋ niŋi nna a yɔ a maŋ naa kilgi.

english_verse: and I told them everything the Lord had shown me.
translation_verse: nɛ ŋ kute kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na lara ŋ ŋini ma na kikɛ n sa bumo.

english_verse: The Lord said, “Ezekiel, son of man, these men are making evil plans and giving dangerous advice to the people of Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ ma le: “Dimɛdi pibi, Ezikɛl, basa ere bee kre kulubi nsaa sa Jerusalɛm to be basa kasotoji lubi nna na.

english_verse: They say things like, ‘Let's build more houses. This city is like a cooking pot over a fire, and we are the meat, but at least the pot keeps us from being burned in the fire.’
translation_verse: Le nɛ kaa kaŋɛ: ‘K maaŋ chɛr nɛ an naa pɔr nwu. Kadegboŋ ere du fanɛ kapuliya nna a bɛ edɛ so nɛ anyi alɛ du fanɛ eblaŋ a wɔ kumo to, ama kanaŋkama nɛ asheŋ du k bee kuŋ anyi nɛ anyi maŋ wɔ edɛ to gbagba.’

english_verse: So, Ezekiel, condemn them!”
translation_verse: Amoso, dimɛdi pibi, malga ŋ gbiti bumo.”

english_verse: The Lord's Spirit took control of me and told me to tell these leaders: I, the Lord God, know what you leaders are saying.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be Kiyoyu kaŋɛ ma fanɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na yɛ: “Israɛl be basa, n nyi kusɔ nɛ menyee kaŋɛ nɛ asheŋ nɛ menyee kre menyi be nfɛra to kikɛ.

english_verse: You have murdered so many people that the city is filled with dead bodies!
translation_verse: Men mɔ basa damta Jerusalɛm to hale nɛ bubuni sɔ kumo be agbembi kikɛ so.”

english_verse: This city is indeed a cooking pot, but the bodies of those you killed are the meat. And so I will force you to leave Jerusalem,
translation_verse: “Amoso kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ e la fanɛ basa nɛ men mɔ n lɛ kaplɛkama na e ki eblaŋ nɛ kadegboŋ na malɛ ki kapuliya ama e beeŋ tintiŋ menyi n lar Jerusalɛm to.

english_verse: and I'll send armies to attack you, just as you fear.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal menyi kaa bee ŋana tokobi so, kumo nɛ meeŋ shin nɛ basa e ta m ba menyi so.

english_verse: Then you will be captured and punished by foreign enemies.
translation_verse: Meeŋ lara menyi kadegboŋ na to n ta menyi m bɔɔ befɔ enɔ nɛ b gberge menyi kusoe.

english_verse: You will be killed in your own country, but not before you realize that I, the Lord, have done these things.
translation_verse: Baaŋ kɔ menyi kena m mɔ menyi ashi menyi gbagba be efuli so. Ndoŋ nɛ ekama beeŋ pin fanɛ ma, e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.

english_verse: You leaders claim to be meat in a cooking pot, but you won't be protected by this city. No, you will die at the border of Israel.
translation_verse: Kadegboŋ ere maaŋ kuŋ menyi bejuŋkparpo na fanɛ kananɛ kapuliya bee kuŋ eblaŋ nɛ a wɔ kumo to na. Meeŋ ji menyi demu kaplɛkama nɛ men wɔ ashi Israɛl be efuli so nɛ men ji n tɔr.

english_verse: You will realize that while you were following the laws of nearby nations, you were disobeying my laws and teachings. And I am the Lord!
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nɛ menyeeŋ pin fanɛ ma e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ men kini k bɛ ma mbraana so nseŋ ya kaa bɛ efuli pɔtɛana nɛ a kulti menyi na be mbraana so na.”

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, the people living in Jerusalem claim that you and the other Israelites who were taken to Babylonia are too far away to worship me. They also claim that the land of Israel now belongs only to them.
translation_verse: “Dimɛdi pibi, le nɛ basa nɛ b wɔ Jerusalɛm to ere bee kaŋɛ a laŋɛ fo nɛ Israɛl be basa nɛ b yɛr Babilɔn be efuli so na be kaplɛa so. B yɛ, menyi ere maŋ naŋ taga Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ to a bishi nɛ men tiŋ n shuŋ mo. Amoso, Israɛl be kasawule na ki bumo nawule peya nna.

english_verse: But here is what I want you to tell the Israelites in Babylonia: It's true that I, the Lord God, have forced you out of your own country and made you live among foreign nations. But for now, I will be with you wherever you are, so that you can worship me.
translation_verse: Ama kusɔ nɛ mee sha fanɛ fo, Ezikɛl, e kaŋɛ Israɛl be basa nɛ b wɔ Babilɔn be efuli so na e la fanɛ, ma e shin nɛ b yɔ efuli pɔtɛ so kufɔ kufɔ n ya pesaŋ to a wɔtɔ na. Ama naniere, ma nɛ menyi e naŋ baa la ashi efuliana nɛ men wɔ amo so na.

english_verse: When that happens, I want you to clear the land of all those idols I hate so much.
translation_verse: B kaŋ bɛta m ba malɛ, baaŋ lara agbirana nɛ a la ekishisheŋ n sa ma na ashi mboŋ nɛ a wɔ na kikɛ.

english_verse: Then I will take away your stubbornness and make you eager to be completely faithful to me. You will want to obey me
translation_verse: Meeŋ lara bumo be ŋgbene nɛ a du kpakpa fanɛ ajembu na bumo to nseŋ sa bumo ŋgbene nɛ nfɛra popɔr, nɛ b maaŋ naa sha keshuŋ agbirana.

english_verse: and all my laws and teachings. You will be my people, and I will be your God.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nɛ baaŋ bɛ ma mbraana so nsaa wora asɔ nɛ mee ŋini bumo na. Baaŋ baa la ma basa nɛ ma alɛ e baa la bumo be Ebɔrɛ.

english_verse: But those who worship idols will be punished and get what they deserve. I, the Lord God, have spoken. The Lord's Glory Leaves Jerusalem
translation_verse: Ama meeŋ gberge bekama nɛ bumo be ŋgbene kraa wɔ bumo be agbirana nɛ ŋ kishi nɛ a la ekishisheŋ n sa ma na kusoe ŋkpal bumo be asheŋ lubi so. Ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ e kaŋɛ na.” Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be kemaŋkura ka lar Jerusalɛm to be asheŋ

english_verse: After the Lord had finished speaking, the winged creatures spread their wings and flew into the air, and the wheels were beside them. The brightness of the Lord's glory above them
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ asɔbɔya keniso na fara a firgi, nɛ aya kulkulso na wɔ bumo be akel to, nɛ Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na be kemaŋkura buu bumo so.

english_verse: Then in my vision, the Lord's Spirit lifted me up and carried me back to the other exiles in Babylonia. The vision faded away,
translation_verse: Nɛ Ebɔrɛ be Kiyoyu ta ma m bɛta m ba basa nɛ ma nɛ bumo daa wɔ Babilɔn be efuli so na kutɔ ashi bɔrɛdare na to. Ndoŋ nna nɛ bɔrɛdare nɛ n daa ku na loge,

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, you are living among rebellious people. They have eyes, but refuse to see; they have ears, but refuse to listen.
translation_verse: “Dimɛdi pibi, Ezikɛl, fo nɛ basa nɛ b pal kaman n sa ma e wɔtɔ. B kɔ anishi, bumo alɛ kini kewu asɔ nɛ mee ŋini bumo. B kɔ asoe, bumo alɛ kini kenu ma mmalga. Ŋkpal manɛ so b pal kaman nna n sa ma.

english_verse: So before it gets dark, here is what I want you to do. Pack a few things as though you were going to be taken away as a prisoner. Then go outside where everyone can see you and walk around from place to place. Maybe as they watch, they will realize what rebels they are.
translation_verse: Amoso, dimɛdi pibi, bela fo adiiku nseŋ wora fanɛ b ka nyaŋ fo a yɔ efuli pɔtɛ wɔfɔ so. Wora le pɔɛŋ nɛ epeŋi e tɔr. Kumo be kaman nɛ fo yɔ kakpa nɛ ekama beeŋ wu fo n ya kaa nite a yɔ a ba. B kaŋ wu fo kaa bee wora loŋ, ashere baaŋ pin fanɛ b la basa nɛ b pal kaman n sa ma nna.

english_verse: After you have done this, return to your house. Later that evening leave your house as if you were going into exile.
translation_verse: Fo kaŋ wora ade kikɛ n loge nɛ fo bɛta n yɔ fo laŋ to. Kaaseso kaŋ fo nɛ fo wora shiriya fanɛ feeŋ yɔ efuli pɔtɛ wɔfɔ.

english_verse: Dig through the wall of your house and crawl out, carrying the bag with you. Make sure everyone is watching.
translation_verse: Futi fo kowu be egbal jemanɛ nɛ baa keni fo n ta fo adiiku m bɔla kumo to m bɔl.

english_verse: Lift the bag to your shoulders, and with your face covered, take it into the darkness, so that you cannot see the land you are leaving. All this will be a warning for the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Shin nɛ b baa keni fo nɛ fo ta fo adiiku na n di keba nseŋ ta kusɔ m buu fo anishi so n lar n luri tentembiri to a yɔ, saŋɛ na so fo maaŋ wu m pin kakpa nɛ fee yɔ na. Kusɔ nɛ feeŋ wora na beeŋ baa la kusoe kpele n sa Israɛl be basa na.”

english_verse: I did everything the Lord had said. I packed a few things. Then as the sun was going down, and while everyone was watching, I dug a hole through one of the walls of my house. I pulled out my bag, then lifted it to my shoulders and left in the darkness.
translation_verse: Nɛ n wora kananɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ ma na. Epeŋi ka ya ka tɔr nɛ m bela ma adiiku nseŋ wora keyɔ efuli pɔtɛ so be shiriya. Kaase ka fo nɛ n ta enɔ ŋ kur n futi ma laŋ to be egbal nseŋ ta ma adiiku n di keba m bɔla ndoŋ n lar jemanɛ nɛ ekama bee keni ma na n choŋ.

english_verse: reminded me that those rebellious people didn't even ask what I was doing.
translation_verse: “Dimɛdi pibi, Israɛl be basa nɛ b pal kaman n sa ma na maŋ bishi fo kusɔ nɛ fo daa wora a?

english_verse: So he sent me back to tell them: The Lord God has a message for the leader of Jerusalem and everyone living there!
translation_verse: To, ya kaŋɛ bumo fanɛ kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ nde: ‘Kubɔya ere bee yɔ ejuŋkparpo nɛ e wɔ Jerusalɛm to na nɛ Israɛl be basa nɛ b wɔ ndoŋ na kikɛ nna.

english_verse: The leader of Jerusalem will lift his own bag to his shoulders at sunset and leave through a hole that the others have dug in the wall of his house. He will cover his face, so he can't see the land he is leaving.
translation_verse: Jerusalɛm be ejuŋkparpo na gbagba beeŋ shin nɛ b futi egbal n sa mo kaaseso belebela nɛ e bɔla kumo to n m bɔl n ta mbe adiiku n di keba a yɔ. E beeŋ ta kusɔ m buu mbe anishi so saŋɛ na so e maaŋ wu kasawule nɛ e bee yige a shile na.

english_verse: The Lord will spread out a net and trap him as he leaves Jerusalem. He will then be led away to the city of Babylon, but will never see that place, even though he will die there.
translation_verse: Ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ to kashewu m pɛ mo jemanɛ nɛ e bee lar Jerusalɛm to a shile na nseŋ yɛr mo kadegboŋ nɛ baa tre Babilɔn na to, ama e maaŋ wu kadegboŋ na kenishiso hale nɛ e ya wu ndoŋ.

english_verse: His own officials and troops will scatter in every direction, and the Lord will track them down and put them to death.
translation_verse: Ma alɛ beeŋ shin nɛ mbe benimuana nɛ mbe benapo nɛ b wɔ Jerusalɛm to na e pesaŋ to n sɔ kaplɛkama nɛ basa e bɛ so n fin bumo mɔ.

english_verse: The Lord will force the rest of the people in Jerusalem to live in foreign nations, where they will realize that he has done all these things.
translation_verse: Ŋ kaŋ shin nɛ bumo nɛ b ka na pesaŋ to n yɔ efuli pɔtɛ wɔfɔ so na nɛ baaŋ pin fanɛ ma, e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.

english_verse: Some of them will survive the war, the starvation, and the deadly diseases. That way, they will be able to tell foreigners how disgusting their sins were, and that it was the Lord who punished them in this way. A Sign of Fear
translation_verse: Ama meeŋ shin nɛ bumo be gbrɛbi ko e ji efute ashi kena nɛ akoŋ nɛ alɔ na to, saŋɛ na so baaŋ pin kananɛ bumo be ekishisheŋ nɛ b wora na be asheŋ daŋ nu ma agbo ga, nseŋ naŋ pin fanɛ ma e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nseŋ shuŋ ma ashi efuli pɔtɛana na so.’ ”

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, shake with fear when you eat, and tremble when you drink.
translation_verse: “Dimɛdi pibi, baa chicha jemanɛ nɛ fee ji ajibi nseŋ shin nɛ kufu e baa kɔ fo jemanɛ nɛ fee nuu nchu.

english_verse: Tell the people of Israel that I, the Lord, say that someday everyone in Jerusalem will shake when they eat and tremble when they drink. Their country will be destroyed and left empty, because they have been cruel and violent.
translation_verse: Kaŋɛ Israɛl be basa na fanɛ kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na bee kaŋɛ a sa Jerusalɛm to be basa nɛ b kra wɔ Israɛl be efuli so na e la fanɛ, baaŋ baa ji bumo be ajibi nɛ kafɔŋ nna nsaa nuu bumo nchu malɛ kufuso, ŋkpal manɛ so, bumo be efuli na nɛ kumo so be asɔ kikɛ beeŋ mur n dese fuloŋ ŋkpal bumo be amu kpakpaso nɛ asheŋ lubi so.

english_verse: Every town will lie in ruins, and the land will be a barren desert. Then they will know that I am the Lord. The Words of the Lord Will Come True
translation_verse: Ndegboŋ nɛ basa bɔlɔ amo to naniere kikɛ beeŋ mur nɛ efuli na kikɛ e ki kasawule a dese loŋ nɛ esa kikɛ maŋ wɔ kumo so. Ndoŋ nɛ baaŋ pin fanɛ ma e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.”

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, you've heard people in Israel use the saying, “Time passes, and prophets are proved wrong.”
translation_verse: “Dimɛdi pibi, manɛ so nɛ Israɛl be basa bee kaa kaŋɛ keŋasa ere: ‘Nchɛ na bee choŋ, nɛ kewuŋkaŋɛ malɛ maa wora a bɔlɔ so!’

english_verse: Now tell the people that I, the Lord, am going to prove that saying wrong. No one will ever be able to use it again in Israel, because very soon everything I have said will come true!
translation_verse: To, kaŋɛ bumo kusɔ nɛ ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na kɔ a kaŋɛ a laŋɛ kumo be kaplɛa so. Meeŋ shin nɛ keŋasa na e ba ekar nɛ b maaŋ naa bɔ kumo ashi Israɛl be efuli so. K maŋ chɛr nɛ kusɔ kama nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ kikɛ e wora m bɔlɔ so.

english_verse: The people will hear no more useless warnings and false messages.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, efɛ be ebɔrɛdare ŋko kafule be kewuŋkaŋɛ maaŋ naa wɔ Israɛl be basa to kikɛ.

english_verse: I will give them my message, and what I say will certainly happen. Warn those rebels that the time has come for them to be punished. I, the Lord, make this promise.
translation_verse: Ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e naŋ malga n sa bumo nɛ kusɔ nɛ meeŋ kaŋɛ na a wora. Menyi basa nɛ men pal kaman n sa ma ere bre be jemanɛ to, meeŋ wora kusɔ kama nɛ ŋ kpele menyi kumo be kusoe fanɛ meeŋ wora na. Ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ e kaŋɛ na.”

english_verse: Ezekiel, the people of Israel are also saying that your visions and messages are only about things in the future.
translation_verse: “Dimɛdi pibi, Israɛl be basa na bee fɛ nna fanɛ, fo ebɔrɛdare na nɛ kewuŋkaŋɛ na la echefoso be asheŋ nna.

english_verse: So tell them that my words will soon come true, just as I have warned. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Amoso kaŋɛ bumo kusɔ nɛ ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na bee kaŋɛ. Ma mmalga ere be kekama maaŋ chɛr nseŋ wora m bɔlɔ so. Kusɔ kama nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ beeŋ wora m bɔlɔ so. Ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ e kaŋɛ na.”

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, condemn the prophets of Israel who say they speak in my name, but who preach messages that come from their own imagination. Tell them it's time to hear my message.
translation_verse: “Dimɛdi pibi, malga ŋ gbiti Israɛl to be anebiana nɛ baa ta bumo gbagba be mmalga fanɛ kewuŋkaŋɛ na nɛ ekama e pin. Kaŋɛ bumo fanɛ b baa kaŋ kusoe a nu Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be kubɔya.”

english_verse: I, the Lord God, say those lying prophets are doomed! They don't see visions—they make up their own messages!
translation_verse: Kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na bee kaŋɛ nde: “Asheŋ maaŋ nyalɛ n sa anebi fɛpoana na. B maa ku ebɔrɛdare. Bumo gbagba be abɔya nɛ baa malga!

english_verse: Israel's prophets are no better than jackals that hunt for food among the ruins of a city.
translation_verse: Israɛl to be anebiana du fanɛ ejiŋkaamu nɛ e wɔ kadegboŋ nɛ k bure a dese to a fin kusɔ nɛ baaŋ ji nna.

english_verse: They don't warn the people about coming trouble or tell them how dangerous it is to sin against me.
translation_verse: B maa kpele basa na kusoe a laŋɛ tɔrɔ nɛ k bee ba ŋko a kaŋɛ bumo kananɛ kewora n da ma so beeŋ tiŋ n shin nɛ b wu be asheŋ.

english_verse: Those prophets lie by claiming they speak for me, but I have not even chosen them to be my prophets. And they still think their words will come true.
translation_verse: Bumo be ebɔrɛdare nɛ baa ku na kikɛ maŋ la kashenteŋ. Bumo be asheŋ nɛ baa kaŋɛ fanɛ a beeŋ wora na kikɛ la efɛ nna. Baa kaŋɛ nna fanɛ ma kubɔya nɛ baa malga, ama ma alɛ maaŋ shuŋi bumo. Amo nɛ amo kikɛ, baa sha fanɛ bumo be mmalga e baa la kashenteŋ nna.

english_verse: So I am going to punish those lying prophets for deceiving the people of Israel with false messages.
translation_verse: To, kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ bumo nde: “Menyi be mmalga la kafule nna nɛ menyi be ebɔrɛdare malɛ la efɛ. Amoso m maaŋ yige menyi kikɛ.

english_verse: I will turn against them and no longer let them belong to my people. They will not be allowed to call themselves Israelites or even to set foot in Israel. Then they will realize that I am the Lord God.
translation_verse: Meeŋ gberge menyi anebiana nɛ menyee ku efɛ be ebɔrɛdare nseŋ naa fule a kpal a malga asheŋ na kusoe. Menyi maŋ naŋ ti ma basa so, menyi alɛ be atre maŋ ti Israɛl be basa be atre so. Menyi maaŋ naŋ bɛta n yɔ menyi be kasawule so. Ndoŋ nɛ menyeeŋ pin fanɛ ma e la Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na.

english_verse: Those prophets refuse to be honest. They tell my people there will be peace, even though there's no peace to be found. They are like workers who think they can fix a shaky wall by covering it with paint.
translation_verse: Anebiana na bee fule a kaŋɛ ma basa nna fanɛ kayurwushi bee ba, jemanɛ nɛ kayurwushi maŋ wɔtɔ. Ma basa pɔr egbal pɔso, nɛ anebiana na ta asɔ nyɔɔso fuful n nyɔɔ egbalana na.

english_verse: But when I send rainstorms, hailstones, and strong winds, the wall will surely collapse.
translation_verse: Kaŋɛ anebiana na fanɛ bumo be egbal na beeŋ tɔr. Abɔrɛjembubi beeŋ tɔr kumo so nɛ afugboŋ e ber kumo so

english_verse: People will then ask the workers why the paint didn't hold it up.
translation_verse: nɛ k tɔr nɛ ekama e bishi menyi fanɛ asɔ fuful nɛ men ta n nyɔɔ egbal na be tɔnɔ e la manɛ?”

english_verse: That wall is the city of Jerusalem. And I, the Lord God, am so angry that I will send strong winds, rainstorms, and hailstones to destroy it.
translation_verse: To, egbal na e la Jerusalɛm be kadegboŋ na. Kusɔ nɛ ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ nde: “Meeŋ kaa agbo ga n shin nɛ afugboŋ nɛ bɔrɛgboŋ nɛ abɔrɛjembubi a bure egbal na.

english_verse: The lying prophets have tried to cover up the evil in Jerusalem, but I will tear down the city, all the way to its foundations. And when it collapses, those prophets will be killed, and everyone will know that I have done these things.
translation_verse: Mee kre kebure egbal nɛ men nyɔɔ n fuli na nɛ k bure cheche n tɔr nɛ kumo be gbaltɔlase nawule e ka a dese. Egbal na beeŋ tɔr menyi so m mɔ menyi kikɛ. Ndoŋ nɛ menyeeŋ pin fanɛ ma e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.

english_verse: The city of Jerusalem and its lying prophets will feel my fierce anger. Then I will announce that the city has fallen and that the lying prophets are dead,
translation_verse: Meeŋ shin nɛ ma agbogboŋ e gbelge egbal na nɛ basa nɛ b nyɔ kumo nɛ k fuli na kikɛ so. Saŋɛ na so nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ menyi fanɛ egbal na tɔr nɛ bumo nɛ b nyɔ kumo nɛ k fuli na kikɛ wu.

english_verse: because they promised my people peace, when there was no peace. I, the Lord God, have spoken. Women Who Wear Magic Charms The Lord said:
translation_verse: Israɛl be anebiana nɛ b ku ebɔrɛdare nseŋ wu ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ kayurwushi wɔ Jerusalɛm to jemanɛ nɛ kayurwushi maaŋ wɔ kumo to na nɛ n de na. Ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na e kaŋɛ na.”

english_verse: They charge my people a few handfuls of barley and a couple pieces of bread, and then give messages that are insulting to me. They use lies to sentence the innocent to death and to help the guilty go free. And my people believe them!
translation_verse: Men keni ma jiga ma basa be anishito, ŋkpal shiŋkafa nɛ ajibi gbrɛbi nɛ menyeeŋ nya so. Ma basa kaa bee nu efɛ so, men bɔla efɛ so m mɔ basa nɛ b daŋ maŋ daga luwu nseŋ shin nɛ bumo nɛ b daga luwu bre ji efute.”

english_verse: I hate the magic charms they use to trick people into believing their lies. I will rip those charms from their wrists and set free the people they have trapped like birds.
translation_verse: Amoso kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ nde: “Ŋ kishi menyi be ŋkilgi be adur be ebaŋɛ nɛ menyee bɔla so a fule ma basa nɛ baa yirda menyi be efɛsheŋ na ga. Ma alɛ beeŋ gberge amo n tuge ashi menyi be mbre so nseŋ shin nɛ basa nɛ men fule m pɛ fanɛ mbuibi na e nya bumo be amu.

english_verse: I will tear the scarves from their heads and rescue my people from their power once and for all. Then they will know that I am the Lord God.
translation_verse: Meeŋ kpɛa menyi be echimu na to nɛ ma basa e nya bumo be amu ashi menyi be eleŋ to. Ndoŋ nɛ menyeeŋ pin fanɛ ma, e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.

english_verse: They do things I would never do. They lie to good people and encourage them to do wrong, and they convince the wicked to ruin their own lives by not turning from sin.
translation_verse: Men bɔla efɛ so n shin nɛ basa lela nɛ m maŋ kre ketɔrɔ bumo pɔ aba nseŋ kuŋ basa lubi ekpa nɛ b maŋ lar bumo be asheŋ lubi to m mɔlga bumo be amu.

english_verse: I will no longer let these women give false messages and use magic, and I will free my people from their control. Then they will know that I, the Lord, have done these things.
translation_verse: Amoso menyi be efɛ be ebɔrɛdare nɛ kafule be ŋkpal na kikɛ fo ekar. Meeŋ mɔlga ma basa ashi men be eleŋ to nɛ men pin fanɛ ma e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.”

english_verse: One day, some of Israel's leaders came to me and asked for a message from the Lord.
translation_verse: Kachako nɛ Israɛl be benimuana na be beko ba chena ma anishi to a fin kubɔya nɛ k shi Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kutɔ.

english_verse: While they were there, the Lord said:
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ ma le:

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, these men have started worshiping idols, though they know it will cause them to sin even more. So I refuse to give them a message!
translation_verse: “Dimɛdi pibi, Ezikɛl, basa ere ta bumo be ŋgbene nna n wɔtɔ kagbirshuŋ to n shin nɛ k bee yɛr bumo kulubi to. A daga ŋ ka tuge bumo a?

english_verse: Tell the people of Israel that if they sin by worshiping idols and then go to a prophet to find out what I say, I will give them the answer their sins deserve.
translation_verse: Amoso kaŋɛ bumo kusɔ nɛ ma Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ. Kumo e la fanɛ Israɛl be esa kikɛ nɛ e ta mbe kagbene n wɔtɔ kagbirshuŋ to nseŋ shin nɛ k yɛr mo kulubi to, kumo be kaman nɛ e yɔ anebi kutɔ n ya kaa fin e nu ma kɔnɔ to be kamalga, ma Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ sa mo kubɔya nɛ k daga mo.

english_verse: When they hear my message, maybe they will see that they need to turn back to me and stop worshiping those idols.
translation_verse: Loŋ e naŋ shin nɛ Israɛl be basa nɛ b kini ma nseŋ ta bumo be ŋgbene n wɔtɔ kagbirshuŋ to na e kini agbirana na nseŋ bɛta m ba ma kutɔ.

english_verse: Now, Ezekiel, tell everyone in Israel: I am the Lord God. Stop worshiping those idols I hate so much and come back to me.
translation_verse: Amoso, Ezikɛl, kaŋɛ Israɛl be basa na kikɛ kusɔ nɛ ma Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ. Kumo e la fanɛ b tuba nseŋ yige bumo be agbirana nɛ amo be asheŋ bee nu agbo nɛ menyi be ekishisheŋ na!

english_verse: Suppose one of you Israelites or a foreigner living in Israel rejects me and starts worshiping idols. If you then go to a prophet to find out what I say, I will answer
translation_verse: Nɛ fanɛ Israɛl be esa ko ŋko efɔ ko nɛ e wɔ Israɛl be efuli so kini ma nseŋ ya kaa shuŋ agbir, kumo be kaman nɛ e yɔ anebi kutɔ n ya kaa fin ma kɔnɔ to be kamalga be kenu, ma Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ gbagba e naŋ tuge mo.

english_verse: by turning against you. I will make you a warning to anyone who might think of doing the same thing, and you will no longer belong to my people. Then you will know that I am the Lord and that you have sinned against me.
translation_verse: M maaŋ sa mo kashuli. Ma alɛ beeŋ gberge mo kusoe nɛ k baa la kefiɛso n sa ekama nɛ e daa fɛ kewora kusɔ nɛ e wora na. Kumo be kaman nɛ n lara mo ashi ma basa to saŋɛ na so nɛ men pin fanɛ ma e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.” Demuji nɛ k maŋ kɔ ŋgelge na be asheŋ

english_verse: If a prophet gives a false message, I am the one who caused that prophet to lie. But I will still reject him and cut him off from my people,
translation_verse: “Nɛ fanɛ anebi ko sa efɛ be kubɔya, ma Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e sa anebi na ekpa nɛ e ku efɛ. Ama ma alɛ kraa beeŋ kini anebi na nseŋ lara mo ashi ma basa Israɛlebi to.

english_verse: and anyone who goes to that prophet for a message will be punished in the same way.
translation_verse: Anebi na nɛ esa nɛ e yɔ mo kutɔ n ya bishi so na kikɛ beeŋ nya kasogberge koŋwule.

english_verse: I will do this, so that you will come back to me and stop destroying yourselves with these disgusting sins. So turn back to me! Then I will be your God, and you will be my people. I, the Lord God, make this promise. Judgment on a Sinful Nation
translation_verse: Meeŋ wora loŋ, saŋɛ na so, Israɛl be basa na maaŋ kini ma nseŋ ta bumo be amu n ya wɔtɔ asheŋ lubiana to. Baaŋ baa la ma basa, nɛ ma alɛ e baa la bumo be Ebɔrɛ.” Ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ e kaŋɛ na. Efuli lubi be demuji be asheŋ

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, suppose an entire nation sins against me, and I punish it by destroying the crops and letting its people and livestock starve to death.
translation_verse: “Dimɛdi pibi, nɛ efuli ko so be basa wora alubi n da ma so nsaa maŋ ji kashenteŋ n sa ma, nɛ n shin nɛ bumo be adɔjibi jija nɛ akoŋ tɔr m mɔ basa na nɛ bumo be asɔbɔya kikɛ,

english_verse: Even if Noah, Daniel, and Job were living in that nation, their faithfulness would not save anyone but themselves.
translation_verse: hale nɛ Nowa nɛ Danɛl nɛ Job, gba daŋ ti bumo so, bumo be alelasheŋ daa beeŋ tiŋ m mɔlga bumo gbagba nawule nna ama mannɛ basa na kikɛ.” Ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ e kaŋɛ na.

english_verse: Or suppose I punish a nation by sending wild animals to eat people and scare away every passerby, so that the land becomes a barren desert.
translation_verse: “Ŋko nɛ n shin nɛ asɔbɔya lubi yɔ efuli na so n ya mɔ kumo so be basa nna nɛ kasawule na ki kakpa ŋana so n sa bekama nɛ baa bɔla ndoŋ a choŋ ŋkpal asɔbɔya lubi na so,

english_verse: As surely as I live, I promise that even if these three men lived in that nation, their own children would not be spared. The three men would live, but the land would be an empty desert.
translation_verse: kashenteŋ nɛ ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ bee kaŋɛ menyi na fanɛ nɛ basa asa ere, Nowa nɛ Danɛl nɛ Job, gba daa wɔ efuli na so, b daa maaŋ tiŋ m mɔlga bumo be mbia gba. Bumo gbagba nawule e daa beeŋ nya kumɔlga nɛ kasawule na e ki kakpa fuloŋ a dese.

english_verse: Or suppose I send an enemy to attack a sinful nation and kill its people and livestock.
translation_verse: Ŋko nɛ fanɛ n shin nɛ bedoŋ kre kena n ya kɔ efuli nɛ kumo so be basa wora alubi nseŋ mɔ basa na nɛ bumo be asɔbɔya kikɛ gba,

english_verse: If these three men were in that nation when I punished it, not even their children would be spared. Only the three men would live.
translation_verse: kashenteŋ nɛ ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ bee kaŋɛ menyi na fanɛ nɛ basa asa na daa wɔ efuli na so gba, b daa maaŋ tiŋ m mɔlga bumo be mbia gba, ama bumo gbagba nawule e daa beeŋ nya kumɔlga.

english_verse: And suppose I am so angry that I send a deadly disease to wipe out the people and livestock of a sinful nation.
translation_verse: Ŋko nɛ fanɛ n nya agbo nna nseŋ shin nɛ kulɔ mɔso tɔr efuli na so a mɔ basa nɛ asɔbɔya kikɛ,

english_verse: Again, even if Noah, Daniel, and Job were living there, I, the Lord, promise that the children of these faithful men would also die. Only the three of them would be spared.
translation_verse: ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na bee kaŋɛ kashenteŋto na fanɛ, nɛ Nowa nɛ Danɛl nɛ Job gba daa wɔ efuli na so, b daa maaŋ tiŋ m mɔlga bumo be mbia. Bumo gbagba nawule e daa beeŋ nya kumɔlga ŋkpal bumo be alelasheŋ so.”

english_verse: I am the Lord God, and I promise to punish Jerusalem severely. I will send war, starvation, wild animals, and deadly disease to slaughter its people and livestock.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal ade kikɛ so, kusɔ nɛ ma Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na bee kaŋɛ e la fanɛ ekpa nɛ meeŋ bɔla kumo so ŋ gberge Jerusalɛm to be basa kusoe kenishipere so nde: “Meeŋ shin nɛ kena nɛ akoŋgboŋ nɛ asɔbɔya lubi nɛ kulɔ mɔso e ba mɔ basa nɛ asɔbɔya kikɛ.

english_verse: And those who survive will be taken from their country and led here to Babylonia. Ezekiel, when you see how sinful they are, you will know why I did all these things to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Nɛ esa ko kaŋ ji efute nseŋ mɔlga mbe mbia gba, baaŋ bar bumo Babilɔn be efuli so. Ezikɛl, nɛ fo wu kebaawɔtɔ lubi nɛ fo be basa kɔ na nɛ feeŋ pin kusɔ nɛ k ba nɛ m mur Jerusalɛm to be basa.

english_verse: You will be convinced that I, the Lord God, was right in doing what I did.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nɛ feeŋ pin geeŋ fanɛ ŋ kɔ ekpa nɛ n wora kusɔ nɛ n wora na.” Ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na e kaŋɛ na.

english_verse: Some time later, the Lord said:
translation_verse: Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ ma le:
