english_verse: You will be forced to live with the wild animals, away from people. For seven years you will eat grass, as though you were an ox, until you learn that God Most High is in control of all earthly kingdoms and that he is the one who chooses their rulers.
translation_verse: Baaŋ ju fo n lar edimɛdi to nɛ fo ya ka wɔ kupuŋ to be asɔbɔya to a ji afitiri fanɛ kena nfɛnshunu. Aloŋ nɛ feeŋ pin fanɛ Enyɛnpetale na e naa ji durnya ere kikɛ so kuwura, mo alɛ e naa lara esa kama nɛ e par mo a ki ewura.”

english_verse: This was no sooner said than done—I was forced to live like a wild animal; I ate grass and was unprotected from the dew. As time went by, my hair grew longer than eagle feathers, and my fingernails looked like the claws of a bird.
translation_verse: Nɛ mmalga na bɔlɔso epul na to. Ewura Nebukadneeza daŋ lar edimɛdi to nna n ya ka ji afitiri fanɛ kena. english_verse: Finally, I prayed to God in heaven, and my mind was healed. Then I said: “I praise and honor God Most High. God lives forever, and his kingdom will never end.
translation_verse: Nɛ ewura Nebukadneeza kaŋɛ le: “Nfɛnshunu na ka choŋ, nɛ ŋ keni esoso nɛ ma nfɛra ba abar so. Ndoŋ nna nɛ n di Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na epaŋ nseŋ ta kemaŋkura nɛ bunyaŋ n sa emo nɛ e wɔtɔ mbaanaayɔ na. Mo e naa ji kuwura mbaanaayɔ nɛ mbe kuwurji wɔtɔ saŋkama na.

english_verse: To him the nations are far less than nothing; God controls the stars in the sky and everyone on this earth. When God does something, we cannot change it or even ask why.”
translation_verse: Basa nɛ b wɔ durnya to maŋ la shɛŋ mo kutɔ. Emalaika nɛ b wɔ ebɔrɛso nɛ basa nɛ b wɔ kasawule so kikɛ wɔ mbe kaseto nna. Ekama maaŋ tiŋ m malga ŋ gbiti kusɔ nɛ e yili, ŋko m bishi kusɔ nɛ k ba nɛ e wora kusɔ ko.

english_verse: At that time my mind was healed, and once again I became the ruler of my glorious kingdom. My advisors and officials returned to me, and I had greater power than ever before.
translation_verse: Ma nfɛra ka naŋ ba abar so na, nɛ n naŋ nya ma bunyaŋ nɛ adelebigboŋ nɛ kemaŋkura nɛ ma kuwurji. Nɛ ma benimuana nɛ bewurabiana na kikɛ naŋ sɔ ma nseŋ ta ma n yili kuwurji be eyilikpa nɛ k chɔ ma eyilikpa dra na.

english_verse: That's why I say: “Praise and honor the King who rules from heaven! Everything he does is honest and fair, and he can shatter the power of those who are proud.”
translation_verse: Amoso ma Nebukadneeza bee di ewura nɛ e wɔ esoso na epaŋ nsaa maŋkura mo, a bunyaŋ mo naniere. Kusɔ kama nɛ e wora walɛ nna nsaa kɔ kashenteŋ. Mo alɛ beeŋ tiŋ m bar esa kama nɛ e bee maŋ mbe kumu so kaseto.”

english_verse: One evening, King Belshazzar gave a great banquet for a thousand of his highest officials, and he drank wine with them.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ ewura Bɛlshaaza malɛ ki Babilɔn be ewura. Kachako nɛ e wora kejigboŋ n tre mbe bewurbi, nɛ mo nɛ bumo kikɛ chena a nuu nsa.

english_verse: He got drunk and ordered his servants to bring in the gold and silver cups his father Nebuchadnezzar had taken from the temple in Jerusalem. Belshazzar wanted the cups, so that he and all his wives and officials could drink from them.
translation_verse: Saŋɛ nɛ baa nuu nsa na, nɛ Bɛlshaaza ponte ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ b ya ta shuwa nɛ gbiti be asɔnuunchu nɛ ntishaŋ nɛ mo tuto Nebukadneeza ta ashi Jerusalɛm be bɔrɛlambu to m ba na m ba, saŋɛ na so mo nɛ mbe bewurbi nɛ mbe beche nɛ mo jipoana beeŋ ta amo n nuu nsa.

english_verse: When the gold cups were brought in, everyone at the banquet drank from them and praised their idols made of gold, silver, bronze, iron, wood, and stone.
translation_verse: nsaa di bumo be agbir nɛ b ta shuwa nɛ gbiti nɛ danyaŋ nɛ abɛlso nɛ ndibi nɛ ajembu n lɔŋɛ na epaŋ.

english_verse: Suddenly a human hand was seen writing on the plaster wall of the palace. The hand was just behind the lampstand, and the king could see it writing.
translation_verse: Epul to nɛ dimɛdi be enɔ lar m ba kaa sibɛ kusɔ ko a deŋi ewura be lambu na be egbal na be kakpa nɛ b la nɛ efitila bee fulto a yuu kumo so na so. Ewura na gbagba daŋ wu enɔ na ka bee sibɛ.

english_verse: He was so frightened that his face turned pale, his knees started shaking, and his legs became weak.
translation_verse: Nɛ kufu pɛ mo alegaiso nɛ mbe anishito ki foleebi nɛ mbe amuli kikɛ fara a chicha nɛ e niŋi to ŋ gben.

english_verse: The king called in his advisors, who claimed they could talk with the spirits of the dead and understand the meanings found in the stars. He told them, “The man who can read this writing and tell me what it means will become the third most powerful man in my kingdom. He will wear robes of royal purple and a gold chain around his neck.”
translation_verse: Nɛ e ponte n shuŋi n tre ŋkilgiwuraana nɛ begba nɛ benyiashempoana. B ka ba na, nɛ ewura na kaŋɛ bumo le: “Ekama nɛ e tiŋ ŋ kraŋ kasibɛ ere nseŋ kaŋɛ ma kumo be kifito, meeŋ shin nɛ b ta awurpiŋi peper kunɔkunɔ m mɛa mo to nseŋ ta shuwa be jaagba n di mbe kubɔ to nɛ e ki esa nɛ e bɛ ma so esasopo ashi ma kuwura to.”

english_verse: All of King Belshazzar's highest officials came in, but not one of them could read the writing or tell what it meant,
translation_verse: Nɛ Ewura na be benyiashempo na kikɛ lar m ba kraŋ kasibɛ na ŋ gben. Amoso b maŋ tiŋ m pin kumo be kifito.

english_verse: and they were completely puzzled. Now the king was more afraid than ever before, and his face turned white as a ghost.
translation_verse: Nɛ ewura Bɛlshaaza be kagbene naŋ jija mo ga n ti so nɛ mbe anishito ki foleebi nɛ mo kikɛ kilgi n fuli. Mbe bewurbi gba maŋ naa nyi kusɔ nɛ baaŋ wora.

english_verse: When the queen heard the king and his officials talking, she came in and said: Your Majesty, I hope you live forever! Don't be afraid or look so pale.
translation_verse: Ewurche na ka nu ewura nɛ mbe beyaasepo ka bee cha awɔr nɛ e yɔ kakpa nɛ baa wora kejigboŋ na n ya kaŋɛ ewura na le: “Yiramu, Ebɔrɛ e teŋi fo kuwurji ere so! Jande sa maŋ shin nɛ fo kagbene a jija fo nɛ fo baa foleeto loŋ.

english_verse: In your kingdom there is a man who has been given special powers by the holy gods. When your father Nebuchadnezzar was king, this man was known to be as smart, intelligent, and wise as the gods themselves. Your father put him in charge of all who claimed they could talk with the spirits or understand the meanings in the stars or tell about the future.
translation_verse: Kanyɛn ko wɔ fo kasawule ere so a kɔ agbir cheembi na be kiyoyu mo to. Saŋɛ nɛ fo tuto daa la ewura na, nɛ loŋ be kanyɛn na ŋini fanɛ e kɔ kenyi nɛ nfɛra nɛ kanyiasheŋ fanɛ kananɛ agbirana na kɔ na. Ndoŋ nna nɛ fo tuto ewura Nebukadneeza shin nɛ e ki belejipoana nɛ begba nɛ benyiashempoana kikɛ be ewura.

english_verse: He also changed the man's name from Daniel to Belteshazzar. Not only is he wise and intelligent, but he can explain dreams and riddles and solve difficult problems. Send for Daniel, and he will tell you what the writing means.
translation_verse: E kɔ kenyi nɛ nfɛra ga nsaa kɔ kanyiasheŋ a tiŋ a kute edareana be afito, nsaa sa asheŋ bishiso kpakpaso gba be atuwebi. E bee tiŋ a bugi alemaŋkarsheŋ be ewulo to. Amoso shuŋi n tre le be kanyɛn ere. Mo e la Danɛl nɛ ewura na daŋ sa mo ketre Bɛlteshaaza na. E beeŋ kaŋɛ fo le be asheŋ ere kikɛ be afito.” Danɛl ka kute edare na be kifito be asheŋ

english_verse: I was told that the gods have given you special powers and that you are intelligent and very wise.
translation_verse: N nu fanɛ agbir cheembiana na be kiyoyu wɔ fo to, nɛ fee tiŋ a wora asheŋ manaŋ manaŋ nseŋ naa kɔ nfɛra nɛ kanyiasheŋ.

english_verse: Neither my advisors nor the men who talk with the spirits of the dead could read this writing or tell me what it means.
translation_verse: B daŋ bar benyiashempo nɛ ŋkilgiwuraana kikɛ nna fanɛ b ba kraŋ kasibɛ ere nseŋ kute kumo be kifito n sa ma, ama b maŋ tiŋ m pin kumo be kifito ŋ kute.

english_verse: But I have been told that you understand everything and that you can solve difficult problems. Now then, if you can read this writing and tell me what it means, you will become the third most powerful man in my kingdom. You will wear royal purple robes and have a gold chain around your neck.
translation_verse: Naniere nɛ n nu fanɛ fee tiŋ a pin ewulosheŋ to nsaa tiŋ a bugi alemaŋkarsheŋ be ewulo to. Fo baaŋ tiŋ ŋ kraŋ kasibɛ ere nseŋ kaŋɛ ma kumo be kifito, meeŋ shin nɛ b ta awurpiŋi peper kunɔkunɔ m mɛa fo to nseŋ ta shuwa be jaagba n di fo kubɔ to, nɛ fo ki esa nɛ e bɛ ma so esasopo ashi ma kuwura to.”

english_verse: Daniel answered: Your Majesty, I will read the writing and tell you what it means. But you may keep your gifts or give them to someone else.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Danɛl kaŋɛ le: “Yiramu, meeŋ kraŋ kasibɛ na nseŋ kaŋɛ fo kumo be kifito, ama baa kɔ fo ŋkɛ. Feeŋ tiŋ n ta amo ŋ kɛ esa ko.

english_verse: Sir, the Most High God made your father a great and powerful man and brought him much honor and glory.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na so nɛ fo tuto Nebukadneeza ki ewurgboŋ nseŋ nya bunyaŋ nɛ kemankuragboŋ.

english_verse: God did such great things for him that people of all nations and races shook with fear. Your father had the power of life or death over everyone, and he could honor or ruin anyone he chose.
translation_verse: E daŋ ji eleŋ ga nɛ efuli kama so ebi nɛ yiri kikɛ daa ŋana mo ga. E baaŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ b mɔ esa, baa mɔ mo nna. Mo alɛ naŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ b shin nɛ esa e ji efute e bee ji efute nna. E beeŋ tiŋ n shin nɛ esa e nya bunyaŋ ŋko ŋaba.

english_verse: His mind became like that of an animal, and he was forced to stay away from people and live with wild donkeys. Your father ate grass like an ox, and he slept outside where his body was soaked with dew. He was forced to do this until he learned that the Most High God rules all kingdoms on earth and chooses their kings.
translation_verse: Mbe nfɛra daŋ ba ki fanɛ kusɔbɔya peya nna nɛ b ju mo n lar edimɛdi to. Mo nɛ kupuŋ to be ekurma e daa wɔtɔ, nɛ e daa we afitiri fanɛ kena nsaa dese kowu nɛ bunyaŋ bee tɔr mo so ŋkpal shɛŋ shɛŋ ka maŋ buu mo so so. Nɛ e wu fanɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na kɔ eleŋ dimɛdi be kuwurji kikɛ so, nsaa kɔ ekpa nɛ e ta kuwurji na n sa esa kama nɛ e bee sha.

english_verse: King Belshazzar, you knew all of this, but you still refused to honor the Lord who rules from heaven.
translation_verse: Fo mo pibinyɛn, Bɛlshaaza ere nyi asheŋ ere kikɛ nseŋ kini kebar fo kumu kaseto.

english_verse: Instead, you turned against him and ordered the cups from his temple to be brought here, so that you and your wives and officials could drink wine from them. You praised idols made of silver, gold, bronze, iron, wood, and stone, even though they cannot see or hear or think. You refused to worship the God who gives you breath and controls everything you do.
translation_verse: Fo wora n da Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ e wɔ ebɔrɛso na so nna, ŋkpal fo ka ta shuwa be asɔnuunchu nɛ ntishaŋ nɛ fo tuto ta ashi Ebɔrɛ be bɔrɛlambu nɛ k wɔ Jerusalɛm na to nɛ fo nɛ bewurbiana nɛ fo beche, nɛ fo jipoana kikɛ ta amo a nuu nsa nsaa di agbirana nɛ b ta shuwa nɛ gbiti nɛ danyaŋ nɛ abɛlso, nɛ ndibi nɛ ajembu n lɔŋɛ na epaŋ so. Le be agbir ere maa wu ŋko a nu, amo alɛ maŋ nyi shɛŋ. Ama fo kini kebunyaŋ Ebɔrɛ nɛ kusɔ kama bɔɔ mo enɔ nɛ e kɔ eleŋ nɛ e tiŋ n shin nɛ fo ji efute ŋko n wu na bre.

english_verse: That's why he sent the hand to write this message on the wall.
translation_verse: Amoso nɛ Ebɔrɛ shuŋi enɔ na fanɛ k sibɛ le be mmalga ere egbal so na.

english_verse: Belshazzar gave a command for Daniel to be made the third most powerful man in his kingdom and to be given a purple robe and a gold chain.
translation_verse: Epul na to nɛ ewura Bɛlshaaza ponte ŋ kaŋɛ mbe nyɛrbi fanɛ b ta awurpiŋi peper kunɔkunɔ m ba mɛa Danɛl to, nseŋ ta shuwa be jaagba n di mbe kubɔto. Nseŋ ta mo ŋ ki esa sasopo nɛ e bɛ mo so ashi mbe kuwura to.

english_verse: That same night, the king was killed.
translation_verse: Loŋ be kanyɛso gbagba nɛ b mɔ Babilɔn be ewura Bɛlshaaza na.

english_verse: In order to make sure that his government was run properly, Darius put three other officials in charge of the governors. One of these officials was Daniel.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman, nɛ e lara Danɛl nɛ basa anyɔ ko fanɛ b baa keni egomena na so nɛ b baa wora ewura na be aparsheŋ efuli na so.

english_verse: And he did his work so much better than the other governors and officials that the king decided to let him govern the whole kingdom.
translation_verse: Nɛ Danɛl be kushuŋ bɔlɔ ewura na kenishi a chɔ mo braana na nɛ egomena na kikɛ. Ŋkpal loŋ so nɛ ewura na yili kumo fanɛ e beeŋ shin nɛ Danɛl e ki efuli na so kikɛ be ejuŋkparpo.

english_verse: The other men tried to find something wrong with the way Daniel did his work for the king. But they could not accuse him of anything wrong, because he was honest and faithful and did everything he was supposed to do.
translation_verse: Amoso Danɛl mo braana nɛ b ka na nɛ egomena na daa fin kananɛ baaŋ wora n nya kusɔ ko nna m malga, ŋ gbiti mo nna. Bumo alɛ daa maŋ nya shɛŋ, ŋkpal manɛ so Danɛl daa la kashenteŋjipo nna nsaa wora asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so.

english_verse: Finally, they said to one another, “We will never be able to bring any charge against Daniel, unless it has to do with his religion.”
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ b kaŋɛ abar le: “Anyi maaŋ tiŋ n nya shɛŋ n yili so ŋ ku asheŋ n deŋi Danɛl, ama an bɔla mbe kabɔrɛshuŋ so nna.”

english_verse: They all went to the king and said: “Your Majesty, we hope you live forever!
translation_verse: Amoso bumo kikɛ daŋ ya wu ewura na nna ŋ kaŋɛ mo le: “Ewura Dairus, Ebɔrɛ e teŋi fo kuwurji so!

english_verse: Order this to be written and then sign it, so it cannot be changed, just as no written law of the Medes and Persians can be changed.”
translation_verse: Amoso Yiramu shin nɛ b sibɛ le be mbra ere n wɔtɔ kawɔl to nɛ fo nyisi enɔ kumo so, saŋɛ na so k beeŋ ki Mɛdiebi nɛ Pɛshiyaebi be mbra, a maaŋ naŋ chɛrga kikɛ.”

english_verse: So King Darius made the law and had it written down.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Ewura Dairus shin nɛ b sibɛ mbra na.

english_verse: Daniel heard about the law, but when he returned home, he went upstairs and prayed in front of the window that faced Jerusalem. In the same way that he had always done, he knelt down in prayer three times a day, giving thanks to God.
translation_verse: Danɛl ka nu mbra na be asheŋ nɛ e yɔ epe. Mbe laŋ to be kuchoŋi be esoso be ebu be etokuro malɛ daŋ shoŋi Jerusalɛm be kaba so nna. Ndoŋ nna nɛ e gbir etokuro na ase a kule Ebɔrɛ fanɛ kananɛ e chɛr a wora na. E bee kaa gbir ndoŋ nna a kule Ebɔrɛ ale asa karechɛ kikɛ.

english_verse: The men who had spoken to the king watched Daniel and saw him praying to his God for help.
translation_verse: Basa nɛ b shin nɛ ewura wora mbra na ka wu Danɛl ka bee kule Ebɔrɛ na,

english_verse: The men then told the king, “That Jew named Daniel, who was brought here as a captive, refuses to obey you or the law that you ordered to be written. And he still prays to his god three times a day.”
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ b kaŋɛ ewura na le: “Basa nɛ b pɛ kena to ashi Juda m ba nfe na be emo nɛ baa tre Danɛl na bre maa bunyaŋ fo kuwura ŋko a bɛ mbra nɛ fo nase na so. Karechɛ kikɛ ale asa nɛ e bee kule Ebɔrɛ.”

english_verse: The king was really upset to hear about this, and for the rest of the day he tried to think how he could save Daniel.
translation_verse: Ewura na ka nu kumo be loŋ na nɛ mbe kagbene jija mo ga nɛ e wɔtɔ a fin kananɛ e beeŋ wora m mɔlga Danɛl. E daa fɛ kumo be nfɛra nna hale nɛ epeŋi ya tɔr.

english_verse: At sunset the men returned and said, “Your Majesty, remember that no written law of the Medes and Persians can be changed, not even by the king.”
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Danɛl mo doŋana naŋ bɛta m ba kaŋɛ ewura na le: “Yiramu, fo gbagba baa nyi fanɛ esa kama maaŋ tiŋ n chɛrga Mɛdiebi nɛ Pɛshiyaebi be mbra. Hale ewura gba maŋ kɔ ekpa nɛ e chɛrga kumo.”

english_verse: So Darius ordered Daniel to be brought out and thrown into a pit of lions. But he said to Daniel, “You have been faithful to your God, and I pray that he will rescue you.”
translation_verse: Amoso ewura na daŋ ponte ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ b ya pɛ Danɛl nna n ya lɛ ebuluŋ be kemaŋ to, nɛ b wora loŋ. Ama le nɛ ewura na daŋ kaŋɛ Danɛl: “Fo Ebɔrɛ nɛ fee shuŋ kashenteŋto na beeŋ mɔlga fo.”

english_verse: A stone was rolled over the pit, and it was sealed. Then Darius and his officials stamped the seal to show that no one should let Daniel out.
translation_verse: B daŋ ta kejembu nna n ti kemaŋ na be kɔnɔso nɛ ewura na nɛ mbe benimuana na ta bumo be tɔɔnɛ be abersobi ŋ dulgi kejembu na saŋɛ na so esa kama maaŋ tiŋ n shin nɛ b bugi Danɛl.

english_verse: All night long the king could not sleep. He did not eat anything, and he would not let anyone come in to entertain him.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ ewura na bɛta n yɔ ewurkpa n ya chena ŋklade. E daa maŋ ji shɛŋ ŋko n shin nɛ b wora epel ko n deŋi mo anishito.

english_verse: At daybreak the king got up and ran to the pit.
translation_verse: Kakpa ka bee kpaŋɛto na nɛ ewura na nya manaŋ n yɔ kemaŋ na ase.

english_verse: He was anxious and shouted, “Daniel, you were faithful and served your God. Was he able to save you from the lions?”
translation_verse: E ka fo ndoŋ, nɛ e ponte n tre: “Danɛl! Ebɔrɛ nɛ e wɔ ŋkpa to na b kayɛrbi, fo Ebɔrɛ nɛ fee shuŋ kashenteŋto na tiŋ m mɔlga fo ashi ebuluŋ na to a?”

english_verse: Daniel answered, “Your Majesty, I hope you live forever!
translation_verse: Nɛ Danɛl kaŋɛ le: “Yiramu, Ebɔrɛ e shin nɛ fo ji kuwura ere n chɛr.

english_verse: My God knew that I was innocent, and he sent an angel to keep the lions from eating me. Your Majesty, I have never done anything to hurt you.”
translation_verse: Ma Ebɔrɛ na shuŋi mbe malaika nna nɛ e ba ti ebuluŋ na be nnɔ nɛ b maŋ tiŋ n tɔrɔ ma. Yiramu! E wora loŋ nna ŋkpal e ka nyi fanɛ m maŋ wora kulubi kikɛ so.”

english_verse: The king was relieved to hear Daniel's voice, and he gave orders for him to be taken out of the pit. Daniel's faith in his God had kept him from being harmed.
translation_verse: Nɛ ewura na be kagbene fuli mo alegaiso nɛ e ponte ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ b ya gberge Danɛl n lara ebuluŋ be kemaŋ na to. Ndoŋ nna nɛ b ya gberge mo n lara nseŋ wu fanɛ mbe kaplɛkama maŋ doro, ŋkpal e ka yirda Ebɔrɛ na so.

english_verse: And the king ordered the men who had brought charges against Daniel to be thrown into the pit, together with their wives and children. But before they even reached the bottom, the lions ripped them to pieces.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ ewura na ponte ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ b ya pɛ basa nɛ b debɔr Danɛl na kikɛ, nseŋ ta bumo nɛ bumo b beche nɛ mbia kikɛ n lɛ ebuluŋ be kemaŋ na to. Ama pɔɛŋ nɛ b fo kemaŋ na be kaseto na, nɛ ebuluŋ na tiŋ ŋ kpɛa bumo kikɛ to n we.

english_verse: King Darius then sent this message to all people of every nation and race in the world: “Greetings to all of you!
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ ewura Dairus sibɛ kawɔl n sa efuliana nɛ eyiriana nɛ ŋgbar be yiri yiri nɛ a wɔ durnya to kikɛ ŋ kaŋɛ le: “Ebɔrɛ e nɛfa menyi!

english_verse: I command everyone in my kingdom to worship and honor the God of Daniel. He is the living God, the one who lives forever. His power and his kingdom will never end.
translation_verse: N yili mbra ashi ma efuli so kikɛ nna fanɛ ekama e baa ŋana Danɛl be Ebɔrɛ na nsaa sa mo bunyaŋ. Mo e la Ebɔrɛ nɛ e wɔ ŋkpa to na. Mo alɛ bee ji kuwura nna hale mbaanaayɔ. Mbe kuwurji maa ba nɛ kemur kikɛ. Mo alɛ be eleŋ maa loge kikɛ.

english_verse: He rescues people and sets them free by working great miracles. Daniel's God has rescued him from the power of the lions.”
translation_verse: Mo e naa mɔlga basa nsaa sɔ bumo a yige na. Mo e naa wora emamachisheŋ ashi ebɔrɛso nɛ kasawule so kikɛ. Mo e mɔlga Danɛl nɛ ebuluŋ maŋ tiŋ m mɔ mo ŋko n doro mo na.”

english_verse: All went well for Daniel while Darius was king, and even when Cyrus the Persian ruled.
translation_verse: Jemanɛ nɛ Dairus daa ji kuwura nɛ Sairus malɛ la Pɛshiya be efuli so be ewura na, kusɔ kama nɛ Danɛl daa wora, daa nite nɛnɛ nna.

english_verse: Daniel wrote: In the first year of King Belshazzar of Babylonia, I had some dreams and visions while I was asleep one night, and I wrote them down. The four winds were stirring up the mighty sea,
translation_verse: Kusɔ nɛ n daŋ wu ma bɔrɛdare na to nde. Afu daŋ shi durnya ere be abonfu ana ere kikɛ be kaba so nna a ber tekugboŋ na so nɛ k bee baga to.

english_verse: when suddenly four powerful beasts came out of the sea. Each beast was different.
translation_verse: Nɛ asɔbɔya gboŋgboŋi ana nɛ a kɔr abar to shi tekugboŋ na to n lar.

english_verse: The first was like a lion with the wings of an eagle. As I watched, its wings were pulled off. Then it was lifted to an upright position and made to stand on two feet, just like a human, and it was given a human mind.
translation_verse: Kumo nɛ k daŋ juŋkpar n lar na daa du fanɛ buluŋ nna nsaa kɔ atɛ fanɛ kajɔnɔkoso. Ŋ ka bee keni kumo na, nɛ n wu kumo be atɛ ka tia. Nɛ b maŋ kumo so n yili kumo be aya so fanɛ dimɛdi nseŋ ta dimɛdi be nfɛra n wɔtɔ kumo to.

english_verse: The second beast looked like a bear standing on its hind legs. It held three ribs in its teeth, and it was told, “Attack! Eat all the flesh you want.”
translation_verse: Kusɔbɔya nyɔsopo na malɛ daa du nna fanɛ shishiri nsaa yil kumo be mmantoya so. Akentibi asa daa fɛa kumo be kɔnɔ to nna, nɛ ebɔl ko kaŋɛ kumo le: “We eblaŋ na kanaŋkamaso nɛ fee sha!”

english_verse: The third beast was like a leopard—except that it had four wings and four heads. It was given authority to rule.
translation_verse: Kusɔbɔya sasopo na malɛ daa du fanɛ karmɛ nna nsaa kɔ atɛ ana kumo be kaman fanɛ kabuibi na nɛ amu ana. B daŋ shin nna nɛ k ji kuwura.

english_verse: The fourth beast was stronger and more terrifying than the others. Its huge teeth were made of iron, and what it didn't grind with its teeth, it smashed with its feet. It was different from the others, and it had horns on its head—ten of them.
translation_verse: Kusɔbɔya nasopo na daa kɔ eleŋ ga a chɔ bumo nɛ b ka na nɛ kumo be asheŋ kɔ kufu ga. K daa kɔ abɛlso be anyii bɛaŋbilaŋ bɛaŋbilaŋ nna a kpɛa kusɔ kama nɛ k tu to nsaa chichi amo nɛ a ka malɛ so a bɛa to. Kumo alɛ daa kɔr asɔbɔya nɛ a ka na kikɛ to nna nsaa kɔ alambɛ kudu ashi kumo be kumu so.

english_verse: Just as I was thinking about these horns, a smaller horn appeared, and three of the other horns were pulled up by the roots to make room for it. This horn had the eyes of a human and a mouth that spoke with great arrogance. Judgment Daniel wrote:
translation_verse: Ŋ ka bee keni kumo be alambɛ na, nɛ n wu kelambɛ fimbi ko ka lar amo to m ba tia alambɛ na be asa ashi amo be kakpa. Le be kelambɛbi ere daa kɔ dimɛdi be anishi nɛ kɔnɔ nna nsaa puchi. Esa nɛ e wɔtɔ mbaanaayɔ na be asheŋ

english_verse: Thrones were set up while I was watching, and the Eternal God took his place. His clothing and his hair were white as snow. His throne was a blazing fire with fiery wheels,
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ n wu b ka ta nwurputi n nase, nɛ esa nɛ e maŋ kɔ sososo nɛ lalaloge na chena nwurputi na be kuko so. Mbe piŋi daŋ fuli nna parr fanɛ kebɔrɛjembubi nɛ mbe emin malɛ du fanɛ ateebi. Mbe kuwurputi na daa suse edɛ nna nsaa deŋ kusɔ ko nɛ kumo be aya bel m pere fanɛ ajanwulɛ na so.

english_verse: and flames were dashing out from all around him. Countless thousands were standing there to serve him. The time of judgment began, and the books were opened.
translation_verse: Nɛ edɛ be adondulombi shi mo kutɔ a teŋi fanɛ lɔr na. Basa ŋgboŋto ŋgboŋto daa wɔ ndoŋ nna a shuŋ mo, nɛ ŋgboŋto malɛ be ŋgboŋto yil mbe anishito. Ndoŋ nna nɛ demu be keji fara, nɛ b bugi nwɔl to.

english_verse: I watched closely to see what would happen to this smaller horn because of the arrogant things it was saying. Then before my very eyes, the fourth beast was killed and its body destroyed by fire.
translation_verse: Ŋ kraa keni nna nsaa nu kelambɛbi na be mpuchi. Nseŋ wu b ka mɔ kusɔbɔya nasopo na n ta kumo n lɛ edɛ wuloŋ wuloŋ na to nɛ k chɔ m mur.

english_verse: The other three beasts had their authority taken from them, but they were allowed to live a while longer.
translation_verse: B daŋ sɔ asɔbɔya nɛ b ka na bre be eleŋ nna, nseŋ sa bumo ekpa fanɛ b baa wɔtɔ n ya fo saŋko.

english_verse: As I continued to watch the vision that night, I saw what looked like a son of man coming with the clouds of heaven, and he was presented to the Eternal God.
translation_verse: Bɔrɛdare na to nɛ n wu kusɔ ko fanɛ Nyigbasa pibinyɛn na. Awɔlpa daŋ kulti mo nna nɛ e gbelge m ba maŋ ma so n yɔ esa nɛ e maŋ kɔ sososo nɛ lalaloge na kutɔ.

english_verse: He was crowned king and given power and glory, so that all people of every nation and race would serve him. He will rule forever, and his kingdom is eternal, never to be destroyed. The Meaning of Daniel's Vision
translation_verse: B daŋ ta eleŋ nɛ bunyaŋ nɛ kuwurji be eleŋ nna m bɔɔ mo enɔ, saŋɛ na so efuliana kikɛ be basa nɛ eyiriana nɛ ŋgbarana be nnaŋ to kikɛ beeŋ shuŋ mo. Mbe eleŋ nɛ e kɔ na beeŋ baa wɔtɔ mbaanaayɔ nɛ mbe kuwurji malɛ maaŋ loge kikɛ. B ka ŋini bɔrɛdareana na be afito be asheŋ

english_verse: Daniel wrote: I was terrified by these visions, and I didn't know what to think.
translation_verse: Bɔrɛdare nɛ ma Danɛl daŋ ku na daŋ chinchiŋ ma ga nɛ ma kagbene jija ma.

english_verse: But God Most High will give his kingdom to his chosen ones, and it will be theirs forever and ever.”
translation_verse: Ama Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na e ta kuwurji na n sa mbe basa laraso nɛ k baa la bumo peya hale mbaanaayɔ.”

english_verse: I wanted to know more about the fourth beast, because it was so different and much more terrifying than the others. What was the meaning of its iron teeth and bronze claws and of its feet that smashed what the teeth and claws had not ground and crushed?
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ n wora ania nɛ m pin kusɔbɔya nasopo nɛ k maŋ du fanɛ asɔbɔya nɛ a ka na nɛnɛ. Kumo e la kusɔbɔya nɛ kumo be asheŋ kɔ kufu ga nɛ k bee ta kumo danyaŋ be akuti nɛ kebɛlso be anyii a kpɛa kusɔ kama to nsaa chichi amo so na.

english_verse: I also wanted to know more about all ten of those horns on its head. I especially wanted to know more about the one that took the place of three of the others—the horn that had eyes and spoke with arrogance and seemed greater than the others.
translation_verse: Ma alɛ daŋ naa sha kepin alambɛ kudu nɛ a wɔ kumo be kumu so na nɛ kelambɛ nɛ k lar kaman to n shin nɛ alambɛ na be asa tia n tɔr na be asheŋ nna. Loŋ be kelambɛ na e daa kɔ anishi nɛ kɔnɔ nsaa puchi ga nɛ kumo be asheŋ daa kɔ kufu a chɔ amo nɛ a ka na.

english_verse: While I was looking, this horn attacked God's chosen ones and was winning the battle.
translation_verse: Ŋ ka bee keni na, nɛ n wu kelambɛ na ka bee kɔ Ebɔrɛ be basa kena a pɔɔ bumo so.

english_verse: Then God Most High, the Eternal God, came and judged in favor of his chosen ones, because the time had arrived for them to be given the kingdom.
translation_verse: Nɛ emo nɛ e maŋ kɔ sososo nɛ lalaloge na ba ji n chɛ mbe basa laraso to ŋkpal saŋɛ ka fo nɛ e ta kuwurji na n sa bumo so.

english_verse: Then I was told by the one standing there: “The fourth beast will be a fourth kingdom to appear on earth. It will be different from all the others— it will trample the earth and crush it to pieces.
translation_verse: Kananɛ e daŋ bugi kumo to ŋ kaŋɛ ma nde: “Kusɔbɔya nasopo na yili nna a sa kuwurjigboŋ nasopo nɛ k beeŋ ba durnya ere to m ba kaa kɔr kuwurji kikɛ to. K beeŋ chichi durnya ere kikɛ so m buri kumo to cheche.

english_verse: All ten of those horns are kings who will come from this kingdom, and one more will follow. This horn will be different from the others, and it will conquer three other kings.
translation_verse: Alambɛ kudu na yili nna a sa bewura kudu nɛ baaŋ baa ji kuwurgboŋ. Bumo be kaman nɛ ewura ko malɛ e naŋ ba. Mo ere beeŋ ba kɔr bumo nɛ b juŋkpar na to, nseŋ ba ju bewura asa kuwura to.

english_verse: “This king will speak evil of God Most High, and he will be cruel to God's chosen ones. He will try to change God's Law and the sacred seasons. And he will be able to do this for a time, two times, and half a time.
translation_verse: E beeŋ malga ŋ gbiti Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na nseŋ mɛaŋ Ebɔrɛ be basa. E beeŋ wora ania fanɛ e beeŋ chɛrga bumo be kabɔrɛshuŋ be mbraana nɛ nchɛgboŋana, nseŋ ji Ebɔrɛ b basa so kuwura nfɛnsa nɛ bargato.

english_verse: But he will finally be judged, and his kingdom completely destroyed.
translation_verse: Nɛ b ji mo demu ashi ebɔrɛso n sɔ mbe eleŋ nseŋ mur mo cheche.

english_verse: “Then the greatest kingdom of all will be given to the chosen ones of God Most High. His kingdom will be eternal, and all others will serve and obey him.”
translation_verse: Baaŋ ta kasawule ere so be kuwurji kikɛ be eleŋ n sa Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na be basa. Bumo alɛ be kuwurji be eleŋ maaŋ loge kikɛ. Durnya ere to malɛ be bejuŋkparpo kikɛ beeŋ baa nu a sa bumo nsaa shuŋ bumo.”.

english_verse: That was what I saw and heard. I turned pale with fear and kept it all to myself.
translation_verse: Ma edare na nɛ kumo be kifito kikɛ be ekar nna na. Kufu daŋ pɛ ma ga nna hale nɛ n nyɔr ŋ ki foleebi nseŋ ta kusɔ kama n wɔtɔ ma kagbene to.

english_verse: Daniel wrote: In the third year of King Belshazzar of Babylonia, I had a second vision
translation_verse: Bɛlshaaza ka ki ewura be kafɛ sasopo to nɛ n naŋ ku bɔrɛdare ere malɛ.

english_verse: when I looked up and saw a ram standing there with two horns on its head—both of them were long, but the second one was longer than the first.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ, nɛ n wu kpakpa ko ka kɔ alambɛ tenteŋ anyɔ, nɛ kuko wɔ nteŋ nsaa la kepopɔr a chɔ kuko.

english_verse: The ram went charging toward the west, the north, and the south. No other animals were strong enough to oppose him, and nothing could save them from his power. So he did as he pleased and became even more powerful.
translation_verse: Nɛ kpakpa na yeŋ to a tɛto a yɔ epeŋitɔrkpa nɛ kelargato be esoso nɛ kelargato be kaseto be mba so. Kusɔbɔya malɛ kikɛ maŋ tiŋ n yili n tu kumo ŋ kɔ m pɔɔ kumo so. Amoso kumo be kepar nɛ k daa wora nsaa nya eleŋ ga a ti so.

english_verse: I kept on watching and saw a goat come from the west and charge across the entire earth, without even touching the ground. Between his eyes was a powerful horn,
translation_verse: Ŋ ka yil a fɛ kesheŋ ere be kifito be asheŋ, nɛ n wu kaboe ka shi epeŋitɔrkpa be kaba so a shile eleŋso hale nɛ mbe aya gba maŋ naa fo kasawule. Kumo alɛ daa kɔ kelambɛ gboŋgboŋi nna ashi kumo be anishi anyɔ na be nferinto.

english_verse: and with tremendous anger the goat started toward the ram that I had seen beside the river.
translation_verse: K daŋ yarase eleŋso nna n yɔ kpakpa nɛ n wu nɛ k yil nchu nɛ b kur na ase na kutɔ.

english_verse: The goat was so fierce that its attack broke both horns of the ram, leaving him powerless. Then the goat trampled on the ram, and no one could do anything to help.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ n wu k ka bee kɔ kpakpa na agbo so hale m buri kumo be alambɛ anyɔ na kikɛ. Kpakpa na daa maŋ naa kɔ eleŋ nɛ k kɔ n sɔ kumo be kumu nɛ kaboe na da kumo ase a chichi chichi kumo so. Esa kama malɛ daa maŋ wɔtɔ nɛ e mɔlga kumo.

english_verse: After this, the goat became even more powerful. But at the peak of his power, his mighty horn was broken, and four other mighty horns took its place—one pointing to the north and one to the east, one to the south and one to the west.
translation_verse: Kaboe na daa nya eleŋ nna ga a ti so. Ama kumo be eleŋ na ka fo ekar, nɛ kumo be kelambɛ na bu n tɔr. K ka bu na nɛ alambɛ tenteŋ ana ba tal kumo to. Amo be kuko daŋ kilgi nna n shoŋi kelargato be esoso be kaba so, nɛ kuko kilgi n shoŋi epeŋilarkpa be kaba so, nɛ kuko gba kilgi n shoŋi kelargato be kaseto be kaba so, nɛ kumo nɛ k ka malɛ kilgi n shoŋi epeŋitɔrkpa be kaba so.

english_verse: It became so strong that it attacked the stars in the sky, which were heaven's army. Then it threw some of them down to the earth and trampled on them.
translation_verse: Kumo be eleŋ daŋ wora keshi nna ga hale nɛ k tu esoso be achɛkpabi, nɛ e yili n sa ebɔrɛso be benapo na, ŋ kɔ kena nseŋ ta amo be ako n lɛ to kasawule n chichi amo so.

english_verse: Daniel wrote: I was trying to figure out the meaning of the vision, when someone suddenly appeared there beside me.
translation_verse: N daa wora ania nna nɛ m pin bɔrɛdare na be kifito, nɛ esa ko ba yili ma anishito epul to.

english_verse: And from beside the Ulai River, a voice like that of a human said, “Gabriel, help him understand the vision.”
translation_verse: Nɛ n nu ebɔl ka shi nchu nɛ b kur nɛ baa tre Ulai na ase a kaŋɛ le: “Geebriɛl, bugi to ŋ kaŋɛ mo kusɔ nɛ e wu na be kifito.”

english_verse: Gabriel came over, and I fell to the ground in fear. Then he said, “You are merely a human, but you need to understand that this vision is about the end of time.”
translation_verse: Geebriɛl ka ba yili kakpa nɛ n yil na, nɛ kufu pɛ ma alegaiso hale nɛ n tɔr kasawule. Nɛ e kaŋɛ ma le: “Dimɛdi e la fo ama k daga fo ka pin fanɛ bɔrɛdare ere bee ŋini durnya be lalaloge be asheŋ nna.”

english_verse: While he was speaking, I fell facedown in a deep sleep. But he lifted me to my feet
translation_verse: E ka bee malga na, nɛ n dese m mata kasawule fanɛ ŋ ka kreŋ na. Ama e daŋ pɛ ma to nna nɛ ŋ koso n yili ma aya so,

english_verse: and said: Listen, and I will tell you what will happen at the end of time, when God has chosen to show his anger.
translation_verse: nɛ e kaŋɛ le: “Kusɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ be agbo beeŋ wora nɛ n lara ŋ ŋini fo na. Bɔrɛdare na bee ŋini durnya ere be lalaloge be asheŋ nna.

english_verse: The two horns of the ram are the kings of Media and Persia,
translation_verse: Kpakpa nɛ k kɔ alambɛ anyɔ na yili nna a sa Midia nɛ Pɛshiya be efuli so be bewura.

english_verse: the goat is the kingdom of Greece, and the powerful horn between his eyes is the first of its kings.
translation_verse: Kaboe na yili nna a sa Griis be efuli so be kuwurji, nɛ kelambɛ gboŋgboŋi nɛ k yuu kumo be anishi anyɔ be nferinto na yili a sa Griis be efuli so be ewura sososo na.

english_verse: When these rulers have become as evil as possible, their power will end, and then a king who is dangerous and cannot be trusted will appear.
translation_verse: Loŋ be kuwurji ana na be lalaloge be saŋɛ kaŋ taga to, bumo be amu beeŋ ki kpakpa nɛ b daga kasogberge. Kumo be kaman nɛ ewura nyaŋnyaŋso kpeŋso ko nɛ e maa ji kashenteŋ e lar.

english_verse: He will gain strength, but not on his own, and he will cause terrible destruction. He will wipe out powerful leaders and God's people as well.
translation_verse: E beeŋ ba kaa kɔ eleŋ ga ama eleŋ na maaŋ ba shi mo gbagba kutɔ. E beeŋ jija asɔ damta nɛ k chinchiŋ basa. E beeŋ mur basa lempo nɛ Ebɔrɛ be basa gba kikɛ.

english_verse: His deceitful lies will make him so successful, that he will think he is really great. Suddenly he will kill many people, and he will even attack God, the Supreme Ruler. But God will crush him!
translation_verse: Ŋkpal mbe kafulesheŋ so, asheŋ beeŋ baa nyalɛ n sa mo nɛ e fara a wu mbe kumu fanɛ e bɔ basa damta. E beeŋ mur basa damta nseŋ koso a kɔ Ebɔrɛ nɛ e la bewura kikɛ to be ewura na. Ama Ebɔrɛ be eleŋ beeŋ ba mur mo cheche.

english_verse: This vision about the evenings and mornings is true, but these things won't happen for a long time, so don't tell it to others.
translation_verse: Bɔrɛdare nɛ fo wu a laŋɛ nchɛ ŋgboŋ anyɔ nɛ alfa asa be kaplɛa so ere beeŋ bɔlɔ so kashenteŋto, ama shin nɛ k ba la wulo to be kesheŋ, ŋkpal manɛ so, k beeŋ chɛr nna pɔɛŋ nseŋ wora.”

english_verse: After this, I was so worn out and weak that it was several days before I could get out of bed and go about my duties for the king. I was disturbed by this vision that made no sense to me.
translation_verse: Kesheŋ ere daŋ baŋ shin nna nɛ ŋ gben nseŋ dese n lɔ nchɛ damta. Kumo be kaman nɛ n naŋ bɛta n yɔ kushuŋ nɛ ewura sa ma na to. Bɔrɛdare na daŋ wul ma nfɛra to nna nɛ m maŋ tiŋ m pin kumo to kikɛ.

english_verse: Daniel wrote: Some years later, Darius the Mede, who was the son of Xerxes, had become king of Babylonia. And during his first year as king, I found out from studying the writings of the prophets that the Lord had said to Jeremiah, “Jerusalem will lie in ruins for
translation_verse: Mbe kuwura be kafɛ juŋkparso to nɛ n daa koya nwɔl cheembi na nsaa fɛ kananɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ anebi Jɛremaya fanɛ Jerusalɛm beeŋ mur nɛ esa kikɛ maa naa wɔ kumo to n ya fo nfɛ adushunu na be asheŋ.

english_verse: Then, to show my sorrow, I went without eating and dressed in sackcloth and sat in ashes. I confessed my sins and earnestly prayed to the Lord my God: Our Lord, you are a great and fearsome God, and you faithfully keep your agreement with those who love and obey you.
translation_verse: Ma kabɔrɛkule na to nɛ m bugi to ŋ kaŋɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na alubi nɛ ma basa wora ŋ kaŋɛ le: “Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ fo shibi nɛ anyee bunyaŋ fo nɛ fee ji kashenteŋ a sa fo ŋkre nɛ fo nase na nsaa ŋini bekama nɛ baa sha fo nsaa wora fo aparsheŋ na kasha saŋkama na,

english_verse: But we have sinned terribly by rebelling against you and rejecting your laws and teachings.
translation_verse: an wora alubi nsaa kɔ alubi ashi anyi be ŋgbene to. An wora amu kpakpaso n ya baŋ so nseŋ kini kebɛ fo mbra nɛ fo keŋini so.

english_verse: We have ignored the message your servants the prophets spoke to our kings, our leaders, our ancestors, and everyone else.
translation_verse: Anyi alɛ naŋ kini kenu n sa anebiana nɛ b la fo nyɛrbi m bɔla fo ketre so m malga n sa anyi be bejuŋkparpoana nɛ bewuraana nɛ an nananyɛnana nɛ anyi be efuli so ebi kikɛ na.

english_verse: Lord God, you are merciful and forgiving, even though we have rebelled against you
translation_verse: Kashenteŋ nna fanɛ an kini kenu n sa fo nseŋ wora kumu kpakpaso, ama fo kraa wu anyi kuwɔr nsaa ta anyi be alubi a paŋ anyi.

english_verse: Everyone in Israel has stubbornly refused to obey your laws, and so those curses written by your servant Moses have fallen upon us.
translation_verse: Israɛlebi kikɛ kini kenu n sa fo. B maŋ bɛ fo mbra na so. Amoso nɛ fo shin nɛ nnɔsho nɛ b sibɛ n nase fo kayɛrbi Mosis be mbra be kawɔl na to na, ba anyi so na.

english_verse: You warned us and our leaders that Jerusalem would suffer the worst disaster in human history, and you did exactly as you had threatened.
translation_verse: Kusɔ nɛ fo kaŋɛ fanɛ feeŋ wora anyi nɛ anyi be bejuŋkparpoana na bɔlɔ so. Fo gberge Jerusalɛm kusoe a chɔ kade kama kasawule ere so.

english_verse: We have not escaped any of the terrible curses written by Moses, and yet we have refused to beg you for mercy and to remind ourselves of how faithful you have always been.
translation_verse: Kasogberge nɛ k dese Mosis be mbra na to na ba anyi kikɛ so. Ama amo nɛ amo kikɛ an kraa maa wora fo aparsheŋ. Kumo e la fanɛ an maŋ yige alubi be kewora, anyi alɛ maa bɛ fo kashenteŋ na so.

english_verse: And when you finally punished us with this horrible disaster, that was also the right thing to do, because we deserved it so much.
translation_verse: O, an Nyɛnpe nɛ anyi be Ebɔrɛ, naniere bre fo gberge anyi kusoe. Kumo alɛ be loŋ walɛ, ŋkpal manɛ so kusɔ kama nɛ fo wora walɛ nna, anyi e maa nu a sa fo.

english_verse: Our Lord God, with your own mighty arm you rescued us from Egypt and made yourself famous to this very day, but we have sinned terribly.
translation_verse: O, Enyɛnpe anyi be Ebɔrɛ, fo ŋini eleŋ nna n lara fo basa ashi Ijipt be kasawule so dra na nɛ b kraa nyiŋi kumo hale kabre. Anyi e wora n jija nseŋ wora kulubi kashenteŋto.

english_verse: In the past, you treated us with such kindness, that we now beg you to stop being so terribly angry with Jerusalem. After all, it is your chosen city built on your holy mountain, even though it has suffered public disgrace because of our sins and those of our ancestors.
translation_verse: Dra na kikɛ nɛ fo kɔ n sa anyi, amoso sa maŋ nya agbo n wɔtɔ Jerusalɛm n chɛr ŋkpal manɛ so k la fo kadegboŋ nna ashi fo kebeegboŋ cheembi na so. Efuliana nɛ anyi nɛ bumo chena m mata abar na kikɛ bee keni Jerusalɛm nɛ fo basa jiga nna ŋkpal anyi nɛ an nananyɛnana be alubi so.

english_verse: I am your servant, Lord God, and I beg you to answer my prayers and bring honor to yourself by having pity on your temple that lies in ruins.
translation_verse: O Ebɔrɛ, jande, nu ma kabɔrɛkule ere nseŋ wu ma kuwɔr n shin nɛ fo bɔrɛlambu nɛ k bure na e naŋ lɔŋɛ n yili. Saŋɛ na so ekama beeŋ pin fanɛ fo e la Ebɔrɛ na.

english_verse: Forgive us! Hurry and do something, not only for your city and your chosen people, but to bring honor to yourself. The Seventy Weeks Daniel wrote:
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, nu anyi be kekule nseŋ ta an be alubi m paŋ anyi! Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, wora kusɔ ko n sa anyi naniere, saŋɛ na so fo ketre beeŋ nya kemaŋkura.” Geebriɛl ka kute bɔrɛdare na be kifito be asheŋ

english_verse: I was still confessing my sins and those of all Israel to the Lord my God, and I was praying for the good of his holy mountain,
translation_verse: N daa bugi to a kaŋɛ Enyɛnpe ma Ebɔrɛ na ma nɛ ma basa Israɛlebi be alubi nna nsaa kule mo fanɛ e naŋ lɔŋɛ m pɔr bɔrɛlambu cheembi na.

english_verse: when Gabriel suddenly came flying in at the time of the evening sacrifice. This was the same Gabriel I had seen in my vision,
translation_verse: Ŋ ka bee kule Ebɔrɛ na, nɛ malaika nɛ baa tre Geebriɛl nɛ n daŋ wu mo ashi ma bɔrɛdare sososo na to na, firgi a gbelge to a ba kakpa nɛ n wɔ na. Kumo be jemanɛ nɛ kaaseso be sarga be kelara fo.

english_verse: and he explained: Daniel, I am here to help you understand the vision.
translation_verse: Le nɛ e daŋ kaŋɛ ma: “M ba nfe nna nɛ m ba bugi bɔrɛdare na be kifito nɛnɛ n sa fo.

english_verse: For one week this foreigner will make a firm agreement with many people, and halfway through this week, he will end all sacrifices and offerings. Then the “Horrible Thing” that causes destruction will be put there. And it will stay there until the time God has decided to destroy this one who destroys.
translation_verse: Loŋ be ejuŋkparpo na nɛ basa damta beeŋ wora kɔnɔkoŋwule kpakpaso nfɛnshunu. Nfɛnshunu na be bargato baŋ ji n choŋ, e beeŋ shin nɛ b yige esarga nɛ etoto be kebaa lara. Baaŋ ta Edɔsopogboŋ na be kapɔrduli n yili bɔrɛlambu na be esoso nɛ k ba wɔ ndoŋ n ya fo saŋɛ nɛ emo nɛ e ta kumo n yili ndoŋ na be jemanɛ nɛ Ebɔrɛ yili n sa mo na beeŋ fo ekar.”

english_verse: In the third year of Cyrus the king of Persia, a message came to Daniel from God, and it was explained in a vision. The message was about a dreadful war, and it was true.
translation_verse: Sairus ka ji kuwura ashi Pɛshiya be kasawule so be kafɛ sasopo to nɛ Ebɔrɛ lara kubɔya ere n sa Danɛl nɛ mbe ketre ko bee ji Bɛlteshaaza na. Kubɔya na daa la kashenteŋ nna nsaa malga kenagboŋ ko be asheŋ. Kumo alɛ be kepin to daa du kpakpa nna. Bɔrɛdare to nɛ b daŋ bugi kumo to ŋ kaŋɛ mo.

english_verse: Daniel wrote: For three weeks I was in sorrow.
translation_verse: Kumo be jemanɛ na so nɛ n wɔtɔ a shu keeli bɔkwe asa kikɛ.

english_verse: I ate no fancy food or meat, I drank no wine, and I put no olive oil on my face or hair.
translation_verse: N daa maŋ ji ajibi gbɛgbɛso kikɛ ŋko n we eblaŋ ŋko n nuu asɔnuuso ŋko ŋ gbiti ŋku bɔkwe asa na kikɛ to.

english_verse: Then, on the twenty-fourth day of the first month, I was standing on the banks of the great Tigris River,
translation_verse: Kufɔl sososo to be nchɛ adunyɔ nɛ ana be kachɛ, nɛ n daa yil lɔrgboŋ nɛ baa tre Tigris na be kedeŋi so.

english_verse: when I looked up and saw someone dressed in linen and wearing a solid gold belt.
translation_verse: Ŋ ka maŋ kumu so, nɛ n wu esa ko ka buu ago be epiŋi fuful nseŋ chɛ shuwa malɛ be kreso kashɛr to.

english_verse: His body was like a precious stone, his face like lightning, his eyes like flaming fires, his arms and legs like polished bronze, and his voice like the roar of a crowd.
translation_verse: Mbe eyur daŋ baa kpa edɛ nna fanɛ digi, nɛ mbe anishiakpa malɛ fuli parr fanɛ bɔrɛ ka nyɛkpɛ na. Mbe anishi malɛ daa du nna fanɛ edɛ be adondulombi. Mbe enɔ nɛ mbe aya daa kpa edɛ nna fanɛ b ka fɔr danyaŋ so na, nɛ mbe ebɔl malɛ du fanɛ jimaŋ damta ka bee cha awɔr na.

english_verse: Although the people who were with me did not see the vision, they became so frightened that they scattered and hid.
translation_verse: N nawule e daŋ wu esa na ashi bɔrɛdare na to. Basa nɛ ma nɛ bumo daa la na bre daa maŋ wu mo, ama kufu daŋ pɛ bumo alegaiso nna nɛ b shile n ya ŋana.

english_verse: and at the sound of his voice, I fell facedown in a deep sleep.
translation_verse: Ŋ ka baŋ nu mbe ebɔl nɛ n tɔr kasawule epun so ŋ kreŋ

english_verse: and then said, “Daniel, your God thinks highly of you, and he has sent me. So stand up and pay close attention.” I stood trembling, while the angel said:
translation_verse: Nɛ malaika na kaŋɛ ma le: “Danɛl, Ebɔrɛ bee sha fo paa. Koso n yili ŋ kaŋ kusoe nɛnɛ n nu kusɔ nɛ mee sha nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ fo ere. B shuŋi ma fo kutɔ nna.” E ka bee malga le na kikɛ nɛ n yil a chicha.

english_verse: Daniel, don't be afraid! God has listened to your prayers since the first day you humbly asked for understanding, and he has sent me here.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ e kaŋɛ le: “Danɛl sa maa lɔ kufu, baŋ yili saŋɛ nɛ fo fara m bar fo kumu ase a fin kepin asheŋ to na, nɛ Ebɔrɛ nu fo kabɔrɛkule nseŋ shuŋi ma fo kutɔ

english_verse: Now I have come here to give you another vision about what will happen to your people in the future.
translation_verse: M ba nna nɛ m ba bugi asheŋ to n sa fo nɛ fo pin kusɔ nɛ k beeŋ wora fo basa kachako so, ŋkpal manɛ so bɔrɛdare na bee ŋini kachako so be asheŋ nɛ a beeŋ wora nna.”

english_verse: While this angel was speaking to me, I stared at the ground, speechless.
translation_verse: E ka bee malga na nɛ ma kɔnɔ duŋ nɛ mee keni kasawule.

english_verse: Then he appeared in human form and touched my lips. I said, “Sir, this vision has brought me great pain and has drained my strength.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ malaika nɛ e duli dimɛdi na, teŋi mbe enɔ m beta ma kɔnɔpurbi. Nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ mo le: “N Nyɛnpe, bɔrɛdare ere shin nɛ kufu pɛ ma nɛ ma eyur yɔ ma nɛ mee chicha a maaŋ tiŋ n yili ma aya so.

english_verse: I am merely your servant. How can I possibly speak with someone so powerful, when I am almost too weak to get my breath?”
translation_verse: N du fanɛ kenya ka yil mo nyɛnpe be anishito nna. Nuso nɛ meeŋ tiŋ m malga fo kutɔ? M maŋ naa kɔ eleŋ gba nɛ n fute.”

english_verse: The angel touched me a second time and said, “Don't be frightened! God thinks highly of you, and he intends this for your good, so be brave and strong.” At this, I regained my strength and replied, “Please speak! You have already made me feel much better.”
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ e kaŋɛ le: “Ebɔrɛ bee sha fo, amoso sa maa fɔŋ shɛŋ shɛŋ so ŋko a lɔ kufu.” E ka malga loŋ n loge, nɛ n nya eleŋ nseŋ kaŋɛ le: “Jande, kaŋɛ ma kusɔ nɛ fee sha kekaŋɛ, ŋkpal manɛ so fo shin nɛ n naŋ nya eleŋ.”

english_verse: You also need to know that I protected and helped Darius the Mede in his first year as king. The Angel's Message to Daniel Part One: The Four Kings and Their Successors
translation_verse: Dairus nɛ e la Mɛdi be esa na be kuwurji be kafɛ sososo to nɛ m ba kaa chɛ to a kuŋ mo.

english_verse: What I am going to tell you is certain to happen. Four kings will rule Persia, one after the other, but the fourth one will become much richer than the others. In fact, his wealth will make him so powerful that he will turn everyone against the kingdom of Greece.
translation_verse: Kusɔ nɛ mee shin nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ fo naniere malɛ la kashenteŋ nna. Bewura asa e kraa beeŋ ba ji kuwura ashi Pɛshiya be efuli so pɔɛŋ nɛ enasopo nɛ e kɔ dama a chɔ bumo kikɛ e ba bɛ so. Mbe kedamaya na beeŋ sa mo eleŋ ga hale nɛ e ta basa kikɛ nɛ Griis be efuli be basa be amu ŋ ŋmɛa abar.

english_verse: Then a mighty king will come to power and will be able to do whatever he pleases.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ ewura lempo ko malɛ e lar m ba ji eleŋ ga nseŋ wora kusɔ nɛ e bee sha.

english_verse: But suddenly his kingdom will be crushed and scattered to the four corners of the earth, where four more kingdoms will rise. But these won't be ruled by his descendants or be as powerful as his kingdom.
translation_verse: Ama k maaŋ chɛr nɛ mbe efuli na e bure m barga to n yɔ durnya ere be abonfu ana ere kikɛ to. Nɛ efuli popɔrana nɛ amo be bewura maŋ shi ewura lempo na be kanaŋ to e bɔla amo to n lar. Bewuraana na malɛ maaŋ baa kɔ eleŋ fanɛ mo.

english_verse: The king of the south will grow powerful. Then one of his generals will rebel and will rule an even larger kingdom.
translation_verse: Ijipt be efuli so be ewura na beeŋ ba kɔ eleŋ ga. Ama mbe benapo be benimu na be eko beeŋ ba kɔ eleŋ a chɔ mo n suge mbe efuli na be kuwurji nseŋ ji eleŋ ga.

english_verse: Years later the southern kingdom and the northern kingdom will make a treaty, and the daughter of the king of the south will marry the king of the north. But she will lose her power. Then she, her husband, their child, and the servants who came with her will all be killed. After this,
translation_verse: Ijipt be efuli so be ewura na baŋ ji kuwura na n ya fo saŋko, mo nɛ Siriya be efuli so be ewura beeŋ wora kɔnɔkoŋwule nɛ e ta mo pibiche n sa Siriya be efuli so be ewura na nɛ e kil. Ama loŋ be kɔnɔkoŋwule na maaŋ chɛr nɛ b mɔ mo pibiche na nɛ mo kul nɛ mbe kebia nɛ mbe mbita, nɛ b tu mo n yɔ ndoŋ na kikɛ.

english_verse: Then he will carry their idols to Egypt, together with their precious treasures of silver and gold, but it will be a long time before he attacks the northern kingdom again. Some years later
translation_verse: E beeŋ ta bumo be agbirana nɛ asɔ lela nɛ b ta shuwa nɛ gbiti n lɔŋɛ na kikɛ n yɔ Ijipt be kasawule so. Kede be kaman, baaŋ chena kagbenewushi so nfɛ damta pɔɛŋ,

english_verse: the king of the north will invade the southern kingdom, but he will be forced back to his own country.
translation_verse: nɛ Siriya be efuli so be ewura na e yɔ nɛ e ya kɔ n sɔ Ijipt be efuli so be ewura be efuli na, ama baaŋ tintiŋ mo nɛ e bɛta.

english_verse: The sons of the king of the north will gather a huge army that will sweep down like a roaring flood, reaching all the way to the fortress of the southern kingdom.
translation_verse: Siriya be efuli so be ewura na be mbinyɛnsobi beeŋ chala benapo damta n wora kena to be shiriya n lar fanɛ nchu ka bɔlɔ n sɔ kakpa a ba na, ŋ kɔ m ba fo bumo doŋana be egbal nɛ b pɔr ŋ kulti bumo be kade na.

english_verse: But this will make the king of the south angry, and he will defeat this large army from the north.
translation_verse: Ijipt be efuli so be ewura na beeŋ nya agbo ga n lar n ya kɔ Siriya be efuli so be ewura na kena n suge mbe benapo damta na kikɛ.

english_verse: The king of the south will feel proud because of the many thousands he has killed. But his victories won't last long,
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ kamoowu e luri Ijipt be efuli so be ewura na to, ŋkpal mbe kekɔmpɔɔso nɛ benapo damta nɛ e mɔ na so. Ama mannɛ saŋkama nɛ e beeŋ ba kɔ a pɔɔ so.

english_verse: because the king of the north will gather a larger and more powerful army than ever before. Then in a few years, he will start invading other countries.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, Siriya be efuli so be ewura na kraa beeŋ bɛta n ya koli benapo damta a chɔ bumo nɛ e daa kɔ na gba. Saŋɛ na so nfɛ damta kaŋ choŋ, mo nɛ benapo damta nɛ b kɔ akɔsɔ lempo beeŋ bɛta m ba kɔ bumo.

english_verse: At this time many of your own people will try to make this vision come true by rebelling against the king of the south, but their rebellion will fail.
translation_verse: Loŋ be saŋɛ na basa damta beeŋ kini kenu n sa Ijipt be efuli so be ewura na. Fo Danɛl be basa ko nɛ b kɔ amu kpakpaso gba beeŋ kini kenu n sa ewura na ŋkpal kewuŋkaŋɛ ere so, ama bumo alɛ beeŋ kɔ n tɔr.

english_verse: Then the army from the north will surround and capture a fortress in the south, and not even the most experienced troops of the southern kingdom will be able to make them retreat.
translation_verse: Amoso Siriya be efuli so be ewura na beeŋ shin nɛ benapo e pugi ŋ kulti kade nɛ b pɔr egbal ŋ kulti na ŋ kɔ kena n sɔ kumo. Ijipt be efuli so be benapo na maaŋ tiŋ n tu bumo ŋ kɔ kena, ŋkpal manɛ so, bumo be benapo lempo gba maaŋ naa kɔ eleŋ.

english_verse: In fact, he will decide to invade the south with his entire army. Then he will attempt to make peace by giving the king of the south a bride from the northern kingdom, but this won't be successful.
translation_verse: Ewura na beeŋ bela ase n ta mbe benapo kikɛ n ya kɔ kena a fin kedii m pugi efuli na kikɛ so. Kumo be kaman nɛ e baa fin fanɛ mo nɛ mo doŋana na e wora kɔnɔkoŋwule nseŋ ta mo pibiche n sa Ijipt be efuli so be ewura na fanɛ e kil. Ama amo nɛ amo kikɛ ŋkre na maaŋ tiŋ n nyalɛ kikɛ.

english_verse: Afterwards, this proud king of the north will invade and conquer many of the nations along the coast, but a military leader will defeat him and make him lose his pride.
translation_verse: Ade kikɛ be kaman, e beeŋ kɔ efuliana nɛ a chena teku ase na kena m pɔɔ amo be adamta so. Ama benapo be enimu ko beeŋ ba kɔ m pɔɔ mo so nɛ mbe ŋkpensheŋ na kikɛ e ba ekar. Kashenteŋto e beeŋ shin nɛ ewura na be ŋkpensheŋ e laŋɛ n ji mo.

english_verse: He will retreat to his fortresses in his own country, but on the way he will be defeated and never again be seen.
translation_verse: Ewura na beeŋ bɛta n yɔ mo gbagba be kasawule so be kumɔlga be mboŋ lempo, ama baaŋ kɔ m pɔɔ mo so nɛ mbe asheŋ a loge kuraa!

english_verse: The next king of the north will try to collect taxes for the glory of his kingdom. However, he will come to a sudden end in some mysterious way, instead of in battle or because of someone's anger. Part Two: The Evil King from the North
translation_verse: Mbe kaman, ewura ko malɛ beeŋ na ba, nseŋ ba shuŋi benapo be enimu ko fanɛ e ya mɛaŋ basa n sɔ bumo elampo saŋɛ na so mbe efuli beeŋ dii dama. Kumo alɛ maaŋ chɛr nɛ ewura na e wu m mur, ama mannɛ esa ko e naŋ kaa agbo m mɔ mo ŋko kena to nɛ baaŋ mɔ mo.” Kelargato be esoso be ewura lubi na be asheŋ

english_verse: The successor of this king of the north will be a worthless nobody, who doesn't even come from a royal family. He will suddenly appear and gain control of the kingdom by treachery.
translation_verse: Le nɛ malaika na kraŋ naŋ kaŋɛ: “Ewura nɛ e beeŋ naŋ ba ji Siriya be efuli so be kuwura na beeŋ baa la esa lubi ga. Mo alɛ maaŋ shi kuwurji be kanaŋ to. Kebirkɔnshi be ekpa so nɛ e beeŋ bɔla so n ta kena m ba purgi basa ŋ kɔ n sɔ eleŋ.

english_verse: Then he will destroy armies and remove God's chosen high priest.
translation_verse: E beeŋ mur benapo damta, n ta Ebɔrɛ be bɔrɛmatapo nimuso gba n ti so.

english_verse: He will make a treaty, but he will be deceitful and break it, even though he has only a few followers.
translation_verse: Mbe efuli maaŋ baa shi, ama e beeŋ bɔla kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre nɛ mo nɛ basa beeŋ wora so n fule efuli pɔtɛana be basa, nɛ kumo be loŋ e shin nɛ mbe eleŋ e baa ti so.

english_verse: Without warning, he will successfully invade a wealthy province, which is something his ancestors never did. Then he will divide among his followers all of its treasures and property. But none of this will last very long.
translation_verse: E beeŋ kɔ n sɔ efuli nɛ k kɔ dama nseŋ wora asheŋ nɛ mo nananyɛnana b ekama maŋ naŋ wora kikɛ. E beeŋ barga mbe asɔ nɛ e ya kɔ kena n suge na to n sa basa nɛ b bɛ mo so na. E beeŋ kre k ya kɔ efuliana be kumɔlga be mboŋ lempoana na kena, ama mo alɛ be saŋɛ maaŋ baa shibi.

english_verse: He will gather a large and powerful army, and with great courage he will attack the king of the south. The king of the south will meet him with a much stronger army, but he will lose the battle, because he will be betrayed
translation_verse: E beeŋ koso kenyɛnso n ta benapo damta n ya kɔ Ijipt be ewura kena, nɛ ewura na malɛ gba e keta mbe benapo lempo damta n ya tu mo ŋ kɔ. Ama Ijipt be efuli so be ewura na beeŋ kɔ n tɔr.

english_verse: The two kings will meet around a table and tell evil lies to each other. But their plans will fail, because God has already decided what will happen.
translation_verse: Bewura anyɔ na beeŋ baa bɔɔ enɔ a wɔtɔ kawie koŋwule to a ji, ama baaŋ baa kre abar nia lubi nna a fule abar. Bumo alɛ maaŋ nya kusɔ nɛ baa fin na, ŋkpal saŋɛ nɛ Ebɔrɛ yili kumo na ka maŋ naŋ fo so.

english_verse: Then the king of the north will return to his country with great treasures. But on the way, he will attack the religion of God's people and do whatever else he pleases.
translation_verse: Siriya be efuli so be ewura na beeŋ ta asɔ nɛ e muu kena to na kikɛ n yɔ epe. Mo alɛ beeŋ wora ania fanɛ e beeŋ mur Ebɔrɛ b basa be kabɔrɛshuŋ nseŋ wora kusɔ kama nɛ k par mo pɔɛŋ nseŋ bɛta n yɔ mbe kade to.

english_verse: At the time God has decided, the king of the north will invade the southern kingdom again, but this time, things will be different.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman, e beeŋ naŋ ba kɔ n sɔ Ijipt be efuli na, ama kumo alɛ beeŋ ba kɔr sososo be kena na to.

english_verse: Ships from the west will come to attack him, and he will be discouraged. Then he will start back to his own country and take out his anger on the religion of God's faithful people, while showing kindness to those who are unfaithful.
translation_verse: Romebi na beeŋ ta bumo be ekuloŋgboŋana m ba kɔ mo nɛ kufu e pɛ mo. Ndoŋ nna nɛ e kaa agbo a fin kemur Ebɔrɛ be basa be kabɔrɛshuŋ. Basa nɛ b kini kabɔrɛshuŋ na nɛ e beeŋ baa wu kuwɔr.

english_verse: He will send troops to pollute the temple and the fortress, and he will stop the daily sacrifices. Then he will set up that “Horrible Thing” that causes destruction.
translation_verse: Benapo na be beko beeŋ shin nɛ bɔrɛlambu na e sa maŋ naa du cheembi nseŋ shin nɛ b yige karechɛ kama be sarga be kebaa lara. Kumo be kaman nɛ b niŋi Edɔsopogboŋ na be kapɔrduli na to n yili n shin nɛ kusɔ kama e jija.

english_verse: The king will use deceit to win followers from those who are unfaithful to God, but those who remain faithful will do everything possible to oppose him.
translation_verse: Ewura na beeŋ bɔla kafule be ekpa so n nya bekama nɛ b teŋ kini bumo be kabɔrɛshuŋ na nɛ b bɛ mo so ama bekama nɛ baa bɛ Ebɔrɛ so na bre maaŋ shuli so n sa mo.

english_verse: Wise leaders will instruct many of the people. But for a while, some of these leaders will either be killed with swords or burned alive, or else robbed of their possessions and thrown into prison.
translation_verse: Bejuŋkparpo nyiashempoana na beeŋ ŋini basa damta asheŋ, nɛ b mɔ bumo be beko kena to ŋko nɛ b chɔɔ bumo m mɔ, n suge beko malɛ be asɔ nseŋ ti bumo ebu. Ama kumo be loŋ maaŋ chɛr.

english_verse: They will receive only a little help in their time of trouble, and many of their followers will be treacherous.
translation_verse: Jemanɛ nɛ baaŋ baa mɔ bumo na, Ebɔrɛ bre b basa beeŋ nya kechɛto gbrɛbi nɛ kebirkɔnshi wuraana damta e ti bumo so.

english_verse: Some of those who are wise will suffer, so that God will make them pure and acceptable until the end, which will still come at the time he has decided.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ beeŋ bɔla tɔrɔ nɛ benyiashempo juŋkparpoana na be beko beeŋ luri to na so n shin nɛ b fɔrso n nyalɛ so a jo lalaloge be saŋɛ nɛ k bee ba saŋɛ nɛ Ebɔrɛ yili na.

english_verse: This king will do as he pleases. He will proudly claim to be greater than any god and will insult the only true God. Indeed, he will be successful until God is no longer angry with his people.
translation_verse: Ewura na beeŋ wora kusɔ kama nɛ k par mo. E beeŋ maaŋ mbe kumu so a chɔ kegbir kikɛ, hale m ba ka wora fanɛ e chɔ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ gba. E beeŋ nya ekpa n wora loŋ n ya fo saŋɛ nɛ Ebɔrɛ beeŋ gberge mo kusoe. Ebɔrɛ malɛ beeŋ wora kusɔ kama nɛ e yili.

english_verse: This king will reject the gods his ancestors worshiped and the god preferred by women. In fact, he will put himself above all gods
translation_verse: Ewura na malɛ beeŋ kplaŋ kegbir nɛ mo nananyɛnana daŋ shuŋ na nɛ kegbir nɛ beche bee sha ga na so. E beeŋ kplaŋ agbir na b kekama so ŋkpal e ka bee fɛ fanɛ e chɔ amo so,

english_verse: and worship only the so-called god of fortresses, who was unknown to his ancestors. And he will honor it with gold, silver, precious stones, and other costly gifts.
translation_verse: Ama e beeŋ ta bunyaŋ n sa kegbir nɛ k bee kuŋ kumɔlga be mboŋ na. E beeŋ ta shuwa nɛ gbiti nɛ abitasɔ nɛ asɔ lela ko n ya sa kegbir nɛ mo nananyɛnana maŋ naŋ shuŋ kikɛ.

english_verse: With the help of this foreign god, he will capture the strongest fortresses. Everyone who worships this god will be put in a position of power and rewarded with wealth and land. Part Three: The Time of the End
translation_verse: Efuli pɔtɛ so be kegbir beeŋ chɛ mo to nɛ e kɔ m pɔɔ kumɔlga be mboŋ lempoana so. E beeŋ sa basa kama nɛ b bɛ mo so kemaŋkura nɛ eyilikpagboŋ nseŋ ta kasawule n sa bumo fanɛ bumo be kakɔka.

english_verse: At the time of the end, the king of the south will attack the kingdom of the north. But its king will rush out like a storm with war chariots, cavalry, and many ships. Indeed, his forces will flood one country after another,
translation_verse: Siriya be efuli so be ewura na be lalaloge be saŋɛ kaŋ taga to, Ijipt be efuli so be ewura na beeŋ ba kɔ mo kena, nɛ mo alɛ e ta egbaŋɛturko nɛ egbaŋɛdiipoana nɛ nchu so be ekuloŋgboŋ damta n tu mo ŋ kɔ kena na. Siriya be ewura beeŋ kɔ n sɔ efuli damtaana fanɛ kananɛ nchu bee bɔlɔ a sɔ kaplɛkama na.

english_verse: and when they reach the holy land, tens of thousands will be killed. But the countries of Edom and Moab and the ruler of Ammon will escape.
translation_verse: E beeŋ kɔ n sɔ kasawule nɛ Ebɔrɛ nase kɔnɔ fanɛ e beeŋ ta n sa Israɛl be basa na nseŋ mɔ basa ŋgboŋto ŋgboŋto, ama Edɔm nɛ Mowab bre be efuli so nɛ kusɔ kama nɛ k ka Ammɔn be efuli so na bre beeŋ nya kumɔlga.

english_verse: The king of the north will invade many countries, including Egypt,
translation_verse: E beeŋ kɔ n sɔ efuli damta, n ta Ijipt be kasawule gba n ti so.

english_verse: and he will take its rich treasures of gold and silver. He will also conquer Libya and Ethiopia.
translation_verse: E beeŋ suge Ijipt be kasawule so be shuwa nɛ gbiti nɛ kumo be asɔ lela kikɛ n yɔ. Mo alɛ beeŋ kɔ m pɔɔ Libiya nɛ Itiopia be efuliana gba kikɛ so.

english_verse: But he will be alarmed by news from the east and the north, and he will become furious and cause great destruction.
translation_verse: Ama baru beeŋ shi epeŋilarkpa nɛ kelargato be esoso be kaba so m ba funti mo, nɛ e nya agbo alegaiso ŋ kɔ m mɔ basa damta.

english_verse: After this, he will set up camp between the Mediterranean Sea and Mount Zion. Then he will be destroyed, and no one will be able to save him.
translation_verse: Kede be kaman nɛ e yuu bewura be wajɛbu gboŋgboŋi ashi Teku nɛ baa tre Mɛditerenia nɛ k wɔ epeŋitɔrkpa na nɛ kebee nɛ bɔrɛlambu na yil so na be kefɛato. Ama ndoŋ nɛ e beeŋ wu nɛ esa kama maŋ chɛ mo to.”

english_verse: Many of those who lie dead in the ground will rise from death. Some of them will be given eternal life, and others will receive nothing but eternal shame and disgrace.
translation_verse: Basa damta nɛ b wu na beeŋ naŋ tiŋi luwu to, nɛ bumo be beko e nya ŋkpa nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na, nɛ beko malɛ e ji awurfoŋ nɛ anishinyɔr hale mbaanaayɔ.

english_verse: Everyone who has been wise will shine as bright as the sky above, and everyone who has led others to please God will shine forever like the stars.
translation_verse: Ekama nɛ e kɔ kanyiasheŋ beeŋ baa nyɛkpɛ fanɛ epeŋi ashi awɔlpa to. Bekama malɛ nɛ b ŋini basa damta asheŋ nɛ a niŋi be kewora, beeŋ ba nyɛkpɛ fanɛ achɛkpabi mbaanaayɔ.”

english_verse: Daniel, I now command you to keep the message of this book secret until the end of time, even though many people will go everywhere, searching for the knowledge to be found in it. The End of Time
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ e naŋ kaŋɛ ma le: “Danɛl, da kawɔl na m buu so nseŋ ta tɔɔnɛ be kebersobi m ber kumo so hale nɛ durnya ere e ya fo kumo be ekar. Ama basa kraa beeŋ baa lege to a fin kepin asheŋ to.”

english_verse: Daniel wrote: I looked around and saw two other people—one on this side of the river and one on the other side.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ n wu basa anyɔ ko ka yil lɔrkar. Eko wɔ kaba ndoŋ nɛ eko malɛ wɔ kaba nfe.

english_verse: The angel who had spoken to me was dressed in linen and was standing upstream from them. So one of the two beside the river asked him, “How long before these amazing things happen?”
translation_verse: Nɛ basa na be eko bishi malaika nɛ e yil lɔr na be esoso be kaba so na le: “Saŋɛ mo nɛ mamachi be asheŋ ere beeŋ fo amo be ekar?”

english_verse: The angel then raised both hands toward heaven and said, “In the name of the God who lives forever, I solemnly promise that it will be a time, two times, and half a time. Everything will be over, when the suffering of God's holy people comes to an end.”
translation_verse: Nɛ malaika na maŋ mbe enɔ anyɔ so ŋ ŋini awɔlpa nseŋ nase kɔnɔ kpakpaso ashi Ebɔrɛ nɛ e wɔ ŋkpa to mbaanaayɔ na be ketre to ŋ kaŋɛ le: “K beeŋ ta nfɛ asa nɛ bargato pɔɛŋ nɛ Ebɔrɛ be basa be tɔrɔ nɛ baa ji na e loge na nɛ kusɔ kama e bɔlɔ so.”

english_verse: I heard what the angel said, but I didn't understand. So I asked, “Sir, how will it all end?” The angel in my vision then replied:
translation_verse: N daŋ nu kusɔ nɛ e kaŋɛ ama ma alɛ daa maŋ pin to. Ndoŋ nna nɛ m bishi mo le: “Jande, nuso nɛ asheŋ ere be lalaloge beeŋ ba ki?”

english_verse: Daniel, go about your business, because the meaning of this message will remain secret until the end of time.
translation_verse: Nɛ e kaŋɛ ma le: “Danɛl baa yɔ, ŋkpal manɛ so, a daga mmalga ere ka la wulo be mmalga nna n ya fo durnya be lalaloge.

english_verse: Many people will have their hearts and lives made pure and clean, but those who are evil will keep on being evil and never understand. Only the wise will understand.
translation_verse: Basa damta beeŋ lara alubi ashi bumo be ŋgbene to. Basa lubi bre maa ba nɛ b pin asheŋ to kikɛ, b kraa beeŋ lubi gba n ti so. Ama bekama nɛ b nyi asheŋ bre, beeŋ nya asheŋ be kepinto.

english_verse: So, Daniel, be faithful until the end! You will rest, and at the end of time, you will rise from death to receive your reward.
translation_verse: Amoso Danɛl, ji kashenteŋ n ya fo lalaloge be jemanɛ na. Fo wu gba, feeŋ tiŋi luwu to n sɔ fo kakɔka.”

english_verse: I am Hosea son of Beeri. When Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah were the kings of Judah, and when Jeroboam son of Jehoash was king of Israel, the Lord spoke this message to me. Hosea's Family
translation_verse: Saŋɛ so nɛ Uziya, nɛ Jotam nɛ Ahaz nɛ Hɛzekaya daa ji Juda be efuli so be kuwura, nɛ saŋɛ so nɛ Jehɔash malɛ pibinyɛn Jeroboam daa ji Israɛl be efuli so be kuwura na, nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ta kubɔya ere n sa Beeri pibinyɛn Hoziya. Hoziya be eche nɛ mbe mbia be asheŋ

english_verse: So I married Gomer the daughter of Diblaim, and we had a son.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Hoziya ya ta Diblaam pibiche nɛ baa tre Gooma na nɛ mo nɛ mo kurge ebinyɛn.

english_verse: Then the Lord said, “Hosea, name your son Jezreel, because I will soon punish the descendants of King Jehu of Israel for the murders he committed in Jezreel Valley. I will destroy his kingdom,
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ Hoziya le: “Nase fo kebia na be ketre Jizreel, ŋkpal manɛ so k maaŋ chɛr ko nɛ m ba gberge Jehu nɛ e la Israɛl be ewura na be kanaŋ to ebi kusoe, ŋkpal basa nɛ b mɔ ashi Jizreel be ketaŋɛ to na so. Meeŋ mur mbe kuwurji be kanaŋ,

english_verse: and in Jezreel Valley I will break the power of Israel.”
translation_verse: nseŋ jija Israɛl be benapo na be eleŋ.”

english_verse: But I am the Lord God of Judah, and I will have mercy and save Judah by my own power—not by wars and arrows or swords and cavalry.”
translation_verse: Ma Enyɛnpe nɛ n la Juda be Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ wu Juda be basa bre kuwɔr nseŋ mɔlga bumo. Mannɛ kena ŋko tokobi so ŋko ata nɛ amo be atanyembi so ŋko egbaŋɛ ŋko egbaŋɛdiipo so nɛ meeŋ bɔla so m mɔlga bumo.”

english_verse: After Gomer had stopped nursing Lo-Ruhamah, she had another son.
translation_verse: Gooma ka ku Lo-Ruhaama kenyipo, nɛ e naŋ di kedampo n kurge ebinyɛn.

english_verse: Someday it will be impossible to count the people of Israel, because there will be as many of them as there are grains of sand along the seashore. They are now called “Not My People,” but in the future they will be called “Children of the Living God.”
translation_verse: Kachako so Israɛl be basa beeŋ ba kaa du fanɛ teku ase be leele nɛ esa maaŋ tiŋ ŋ karga ŋko m ber na. Naniere bre Ebɔrɛ bee kaŋɛ bumo nna fanɛ b maŋ la mbe basa, ama saŋko beeŋ ba nɛ e kaŋɛ bumo le: “Ebɔrɛ nɛ e wɔ ŋkpa to na be mbia e la menyi!”

english_verse: Israel and Judah will unite and choose one leader. Then they will take back their land, and this will be a great day for Jezreel.
translation_verse: Israɛl be basa nɛ Juda be basa kraa beeŋ wora kɔnɔkoŋwule nseŋ lara ejuŋkparpo koŋwule nɛ e baa juŋkpar bumo. Loŋ be jemanɛ na so nɛ baaŋ fara a wu nɛfa bumo be kasawule so. Kachɛ nɛ baa tre Jizreel na beeŋ ba la kachɛgboŋ nna.

english_verse: So let your brothers be called “My People” and your sisters be called “Shown Mercy.” The Lord Promises To Punish Israel
translation_verse: Amoso tre fo braana Israɛlebi, Ebɔrɛ be basa nɛ basa nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ bee sha. Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ka nase kɔnɔ fanɛ E beeŋ gberge Israɛlebi kusoe be asheŋ

english_verse: Accuse! Accuse your mother! She is no longer my wife, and now I, the Lord, am not her husband. Beg her to give up prostitution and stop being unfaithful,
translation_verse: Mbia, men fiɛ men nio so. Kashenteŋ nna fanɛ e maŋ naa la ma eche nɛ ma alɛ maŋ naa la mo kul, ama men kaŋɛ mo nɛ e yige mbe kesakalea nɛ kebirkɔnshi be kebaawɔtɔ na.

english_verse: or I will strip her naked like the day she was born. I will make her barren like a desert, and she will die of thirst.
translation_verse: Nɛ e baa maŋ yige loŋ be asheŋ na, meeŋ shin nɛ e delge so kpotokpolo fanɛ kananɛ b kurge mo kpotokpolo na. Meeŋ shin nɛ e ki fanɛ keshishɛrsawule mo nɛ k maŋ kɔ tɔnɔ. Achukoŋ malɛ e naŋ mɔ mo.

english_verse: You children are the result of her unfaithfulness, and I'll show you no pity.
translation_verse: M maaŋ wu mbe mbia kuwɔr ŋkpal b ka la ayurbi so.

english_verse: Your mother was unfaithful. She was disgraceful and said, “I'll run after my lovers. Everything comes from them— my food and drink, my linen and wool, my olive oil and wine.”
translation_verse: Men nio daa maa ji kashenteŋ nna, amoso nɛ e paŋ anishinyɔr a kaŋɛ le na: “Meeŋ shile m bɛ ŋjipoana so, ŋkpal manɛ so, ma kusɔ kama shi bumo kutɔ nna. Ma ajibi nɛ ma nchu nɛ ma ewajɛ nɛ ɔlif be ŋku nɛ ma asɔ nuuso kikɛ bee shi bumo kutɔ nna.

english_verse: I, the Lord, will build a fence of thorns to block her path.
translation_verse: Amoso meeŋ ta ewidibi n yuu n chambɔ mo n wɔtɔ nseŋ pɔr egbal malɛ ŋ kuŋ mo nɛ e maaŋ naŋ nya ekpa n lar.

english_verse: She will run after her lovers, but not catch them; she will search, but not find them. Then she will say, “I'll return to my first husband. Life was better then.”
translation_verse: E beeŋ shile m bɛ mo jipoana so, ama mo alɛ maaŋ naŋ nya bumo. E beeŋ fin bumo, ama mo alɛ maaŋ wu bumo. Saŋɛ na so nɛ e kaŋɛ le: Meeŋ bɛta n yɔ ma kul dra kutɔ ŋkpal manɛ so ndoŋ be kebaawɔtɔ bɔ kakpa nɛ n wɔ naniere.

english_verse: She didn't know that her grain, wine, and olive oil were gifts from me, as were the gold and silver she used in worshiping Baal.
translation_verse: E daa maa pin fanɛ ma e sa mo ajibi nɛ asɔ nuuso nɛ ɔlif be ŋku nɛ shuwa nɛ gbiti nɛ e kilgi n ta amo a shuŋ Baal be kegbir na.

english_verse: So I'll hold back the harvest of grain and grapes. I'll take back my wool and my linen that cover her body.
translation_verse: Amoso kasɔteŋi be jemanɛ baŋ naŋ fo, m maaŋ naŋ sa mo ajibi nɛ asɔ nuuso nɛ asɔbuuso.

english_verse: Then I'll strip her naked in the sight of her lovers. No one can rescue her.
translation_verse: Meeŋ shin nɛ mo jipoana e wu asheŋ lubi nɛ e wora na kikɛ, nɛ esa kama malɛ maaŋ tiŋ n sɔ mo ashi ma enɔ to.

english_verse: I'll stop Israel's celebrations— no more New Moon Festivals, Sabbaths, or other feasts.
translation_verse: Meeŋ shin nɛ mbe kamooji na kikɛ e ba ekar, mbe kafɛ kafɛ nɛ kufɔl kufɔl nɛ kewushiachɛ kikɛ be kamooji na beeŋ ba ekar.

english_verse: She said, “My lovers gave me vineyards and fig trees as payment for sex.” Now I, the Lord, will ruin her vineyards and fig trees; they will become clumps of weeds eaten by wild animals.
translation_verse: Meeŋ mur mbe asɔrso nɛ baa tre greep nɛ figi be ndibi be ndɔ nɛ e yɛ mo jipoana ta n sa mo fanɛ mbe kakɔka na. Meeŋ shin nɛ mbe asɔrso nɛ baa tre greep na be adɔbi nɛ mbe figi be ndibi be adɔ na kikɛ e ki fanɛ kupuŋ; nɛ kupuŋ to be asɔbɔya e jija amo.

english_verse: I'll punish her for the days she worshiped Baal and burned incense to him. I'll punish her for the times she forgot about me and wore jewelry and rings to attract her lovers. I, the Lord, have spoken! The Lord Will Help Israel
translation_verse: Meeŋ gberge mo kusoe ŋkpal e kaa ta nchɛ damta n chɔɔ duwu m bunyaŋ Baal be kegbir so. Ma alɛ beeŋ naŋ gberge mo kusoe ŋkpal e ka teŋ ma so nseŋ ta mbe abitasɔ n wɔtɔ n lar a sha benyɛn so. Ma Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ e malga na. Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be kasha nɛ e kɔ n sa mbe basa be asheŋ

english_verse: Israel, I, the Lord, will lure you into the desert and speak gently to you.
translation_verse: Ma Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ gbagba beeŋ naaŋ kule Israɛlebi fanɛ b bɛta n tu ma m ba keshishɛrsawule so nɛ m malga kashaso bumo kutɔ.

english_verse: I promise from that day on, you will call me your husband instead of your master.
translation_verse: Yili kumo be kachɛ na a yɔ, menyeeŋ baa tre ma men kul nna, nɛ mannɛ men Nyɛnpe.

english_verse: I will no longer even let you mention the names of those pagan gods that you called “Master.”
translation_verse: Ma alɛ beeŋ lara kegbir nɛ baa tre Baal na be ketre ashi men be nnɔ to nɛ men maaŋ naŋ shu n tre kumo kikɛ.

english_verse: And I will agree to let you live in peace—you will no longer be attacked by wild animals and birds or by weapons of war.
translation_verse: Loŋ be saŋɛ na, meeŋ shin nɛ men baa wɔ kagbenewushi to nɛ kupuŋ to be asɔbɔya nɛ mbuibi ŋko kena to be adoŋsɔ gba maaŋ tiŋ n tɔrɔ menyi.

english_verse: I will accept you as my wife forever, and instead of a bride price I will give you justice, fairness, love, kindness,
translation_verse: Meeŋ shin nɛ fo Israɛl e naŋ ki fanɛ ma eche nɛ m baa ji kashenteŋ a sa fo. Ma alɛ beeŋ baa sha fo saŋkama nsaa wu fo kuwɔr nɛ fo baa la meya hale mbaanaayɔ.

english_verse: I will command the sky to send rain on the earth,
translation_verse: Loŋ be saŋɛ na kaŋ fo, meeŋ nu menyi be kabɔrɛkule nseŋ shin nɛ bɔrɛ e ba kasawule ere so.

english_verse: and it will produce grain, grapes, and olives in Jezreel Valley.
translation_verse: Nɛ aboyu nɛ asɔrso nɛ baa tre greep na nɛ ɔlif kikɛ e wora ashi Jizreel be ketaŋɛ na to.

english_verse: I will scatter the seeds and show mercy to Lo-Ruhamah. I will say to Lo-Ammi, “You are my people,” and they will answer, “You are our God.”
translation_verse: Meeŋ chɛ ma basa to nɛ b chena kasawule ere so n dii dama. Meeŋ ŋini bekama nɛ b maa sha na ma kasha. Nseŋ shin nɛ bekama nɛ b yɛ b maŋ la ma basa na e ki ma basa, nɛ bumo alɛ e shuli so a tre ma bumo be Ebɔrɛ.”

english_verse: Once again the Lord spoke to me. And this time he said, “Hosea, fall in love with an unfaithful woman who has a lover. Do this to show that I love the people of Israel, even though they worship idols and enjoy the offering cakes made with fruit.”
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ naŋ kaŋɛ ma Hoziya le: “Naŋ laŋɛ n ya kaa sha fo eche nɛ e la sakaleche a kɔ bejipo na. Baa sha mo fanɛ kananɛ ma alɛ gba bee sha Israɛlebi nɛ b shile ma n yaa ka shuŋ agbir, hale a lara asɔrso nɛ baa tre greep na be awɔlso be esarga a sa amo na.”

english_verse: Then I said, “Now you are mine! You will have to remain faithful to me, though it will be a long time before we sleep together.”
translation_verse: Nseŋ kaŋɛ mo fanɛ naniere bre fo ki meya, amoso yige kesakalea nsaa jo ma nɛ ma alɛ gba e baa ji kanyiti a jo mo.

english_verse: It will also be a long time before Israel has a king or before sacrifices are offered at the temple or before there is any way to get guidance from God.
translation_verse: Loŋ koŋwule na nɛ k beeŋ chɛr ga pɔɛŋ nɛ Israɛl be basa e nya ewura ŋko basa nɛ baaŋ ba juŋkpar bumo. K beeŋ chɛr pɔɛŋ nɛ b naaŋ bɔla esarga ŋko ajembu cheembi ŋko kabɔrɛmata be piŋi ŋko agbir so n fin Ebɔrɛ be nɛfa.

english_verse: But later, Israel will turn back to the Lord their God and to David their king. At that time they will come to the Lord with fear and trembling, and he will be good to them.
translation_verse: Ama saŋko bee ba nɛ Israɛl be basa e naaŋ baa kaa bɛ Enyɛnpe nɛ e la bumo be Ebɔrɛ na, nɛ ewura Deevid mo nanabi na so. Loŋ be jemanɛ na, baaŋ ta kufu nɛ kechicha chicha m ba Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kutɔ nɛ e sa bumo asɔ lela kama nɛ e kre n yili bumo na.

english_verse: And so your land is a desert. Every living creature is dying— people and wild animals, birds and fish. The Lord Warns the Priests
translation_verse: Ŋkpal loŋ so ewule lubi beeŋ yili menyi be kasawule ere so nɛ kusɔ kama nɛ k wɔ kumo so kikɛ e wu. Asɔbɔya nɛ mbuibi nɛ ekɔrɔtɔ kikɛ beeŋ wu.” Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ka kaŋɛ fanɛ bɔrɛmatapoana maŋ wora n nyalɛ be asheŋ

english_verse: Don't accuse just anyone! Not everyone is at fault. My case is against you, the priests.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ yɛ: “Esa kama wora kulubi, fɔŋfɔŋ bɔrɛmatapoana na.

english_verse: You and the prophets will stumble day and night; I'll silence your mothers.
translation_verse: Kapa nɛ kanyɛ, menyi nɛ menyi be anebiana na kikɛ bee fiti nna a tɔr. Ma alɛ beeŋ mur Israɛl nɛ e la men nio na.

english_verse: You priests have rejected me, and my people are destroyed by refusing to obey. Now I'll reject you and forget your children, because you have forgotten my Law.
translation_verse: Ma basa bee mur nna ŋkpal b ka kini ma so. Menyi bɔrɛmatapoana gba kini ma nseŋ kini ma keŋini gba n ti so. Ŋkpal loŋ so nɛ ma alɛ gba kini menyi na. M maaŋ naŋ wu menyi be mbinyɛnsobi gba fanɛ b la bɔrɛmatapoana.

english_verse: By adding more of you priests, you multiply the number of people who sin. Now I'll change your pride into shame.
translation_verse: Kananɛ bɔrɛmatapoana na bee wora kishi a ti so, loŋ koŋwule nɛ baa wora alubi a gbiti ma a ti so. Ŋkpal loŋ so, meeŋ shin nɛ men be kemaŋkura nɛ men kɔ na e ki anishinyɔr n sa menyi.

english_verse: You encourage others to sin, so you can stuff yourselves on their sin offerings.
translation_verse: Alubi nɛ ma basa bee wora na so nɛ menyeeŋ bɔla n dii dama. Amoso nɛ men shin nɛ baa wora alubi a ti so saŋkama na.

english_verse: That's why I will punish the people for their deeds, just as I will punish you priests.
translation_verse: Menyeeŋ nya kasogberge nɛ basa na beeŋ nya na gbagba. Meeŋ gberge menyi kusoe ŋkpal alubi nɛ menyee wora na so.

english_verse: and have been unfaithful to me, their Lord. God Condemns Israel's Idolatry My people, you are foolish because of too much pleasure and too much wine.
translation_verse: Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ yɛ: “Kasanuu be ga shin nɛ ma basa maŋ naa fɛ nfɛra!

english_verse: You expect wooden idols and other objects of wood to give you advice. Lusting for sex at pagan shrines has made you unfaithful to me, your God.
translation_verse: Agbir nɛ b ta ndibi n lɔŋɛ na to nɛ baa yɔ n ya kaa bishi so. Akpabi malɛ nɛ baa bɔla so a kaŋɛ bumo asheŋ. B kini ma nseŋ ta bumo be amu n ya sa agbir fanɛ kananɛ eche bee lar mo kul kaman a ji kesakalea na.
