english_verse: But I won't punish them. You men are to blame, because you go to prostitutes and offer sacrifices with them at pagan shrines. Your own foolishness will lead to your ruin.
translation_verse: Ama m maaŋ kpal loŋ so ŋ gberge bumo kusoe, ŋkpal manɛ so men gbagba bee ya ka sha agbirlambu to be esakaleche nna nɛ menyi nɛ bumo bee lara esarga a sa agbirana na. Ama le nɛ keŋasa ko bee kaŋɛ: ‘Esa nɛ e maŋ nyi asheŋ kikɛ la esa mur so nna.’ ”

english_verse: Israel, you are unfaithful, but don't lead Judah to sin. Stop worshiping at Gilgal or at sinful Bethel. And quit making promises in my name—the name of the living Lord.
translation_verse: “Menyi Israɛl be basa maa ji kashenteŋ a sa ma, ama men sa maŋ shin nɛ Judaebi gba e luri loŋ be kulubi koŋwule ere to. Men sa maŋ naa yɔ Gilgaal ŋko Bɛtavɛn n ya kaa bunyaŋ agbir ŋko a nase nnɔ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be ketre to.”

english_verse: You are nothing more than a stubborn cow— so stubborn that I, the Lord, cannot feed you like lambs in an open pasture.
translation_verse: Israɛlebi ki basa kpeŋso nna fanɛ ekurmanyɛn. Nuso gba nɛ meeŋ wora ŋ keta bumo n yɔ keji to ashi kupuŋ to fanɛ mbolpɔbi?

english_verse: You people of Israel are charmed by idols. Leave those people alone!
translation_verse: Agbir be eleŋ kre Israɛlebi na nna, amoso meeŋ kplaŋ bumo so nɛ b baa wora bumo be kepar.

english_verse: You get drunk, then sleep with prostitutes; you would rather be vulgar than lead a decent life.
translation_verse: B baŋ nuu nsa m boo ŋ koso, baa luri kesakalea be keji to nna. Bumo alɛ shuli anishinyɔr ka ji bumo a chɔ b ka nya bunyaŋ.

english_verse: And so you will be swept away in a whirlwind for sacrificing to idols.
translation_verse: Kawuliwuli beeŋ ta bumo n choŋ nɛ anishinyɔr e pɛ bumo ŋkpal b ka bee lara esarga a sa agbir so.

english_verse: At the place of worship you were a treacherous pit, and I will punish you.
translation_verse: Men ki fanɛ kejamaŋ chiŋgeliŋ nɛ basa bee tɔr to nna ashi kakpa nɛ baa bunyaŋ Ebɔrɛ na nna. Ma alɛ beeŋ gberge menyi kikɛ kusoe.

english_verse: Your evil deeds are the reason you won't return to me, your Lord God. And your constant craving for sex keeps you from knowing me.
translation_verse: Kulubi nɛ basa na wora na e shin nɛ b maaŋ naŋ tiŋ m bɛta m ba bumo be Ebɔrɛ kutɔ. Ŋkpal saŋkama be kesakalea nɛ baa ji na so b maŋ naa fɛ ma asheŋ.

english_verse: You have been unfaithful to me, your Lord; you have had children by prostitutes. So at the New Moon Festival, you and your crops will be destroyed. The Lord Warns Israel and Judah
translation_verse: B maŋ naa ji kashenteŋ a sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na. Bumo nɛ esakaleche e kurge mbia. Ŋkpal loŋ so bumo nɛ bumo be ndɔana kikɛ beeŋ mur kachɛ nɛ baaŋ ji bumo be kufɔl popɔr be kejigboŋ na. Juda nɛ Israɛl be kena be asheŋ

english_verse: Give a warning on the trumpet! Let it be heard in Gibeah, Ramah, and sinful Bethel. Benjamin, watch out!
translation_verse: Men foŋ kena to be kabel ŋ kpele Gibia nɛ Raama nɛ Bɛtavɛn be basa kikɛ kusoe, nɛ Bɛnjamin be basa malɛ e bela ase n yɔ kena to!

english_verse: I, the Lord, will punish and wipe out Israel. This is my solemn promise to every tribe of Israel.
translation_verse: Kasogberge bee ba, loŋ malɛ be kachɛ na nɛ Israɛl be basa beeŋ mur cheche. Israɛlebi, kesheŋ ere beeŋ wora kashenteŋto!

english_verse: Judah's leaders are like crooks who move boundary markers; that's why I will flood them with my anger.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ yɛ: “Ŋkpal Juda be bejuŋkparpoana ka puni Israɛlebi be kasawule so, ma kasogberge beeŋ ba bumo so fanɛ nchu ka bɔlɔ n sɔ kakpa kikɛ na.

english_verse: Israel was brutally crushed. They got what they deserved for worshiping useless idols.
translation_verse: Israɛl be basa luri tɔrɔ damta to nseŋ paŋ kasawule nɛ k la bumo peya na ŋkpal b ka ya kaa shuŋ agbir so.

english_verse: Now I, the Lord, will fill Israel with maggots and make Judah rot.
translation_verse: Meeŋ mur Israɛl be basa nseŋ jija Juda malɛ be basa.

english_verse: When Israel and Judah saw their sickness and wounds, Israel asked help from Assyria and its mighty king. But the king cannot cure them or heal their wounds.
translation_verse: Israɛlebi ka wu alɔ nɛ Judaebi malɛ wu edoro nɛ a wɔ bumo so na, nɛ Israɛlebi ya fin kechɛto ashi Asiriya be efuli so be ewurgboŋ na kutɔ, ama mo alɛ gba maŋ tiŋ n chɛ bumo be alɔ nɛ edoro na.

english_verse: So I'll become a fierce lion attacking Israel and Judah. I'll snatch and carry off what I want, and no one can stop me.
translation_verse: Meeŋ kɔ Israɛlebi nɛ Juda be basa fanɛ kananɛ buluŋ bee kɔ na. Ŋ gbagba e naŋ kpɛa bumo to n lɛ. M baa gbeye bumo a yɔ, esa kama maaŋ tiŋ n sɔ bumo.

english_verse: Then I'll return to my temple until they confess their guilt and worship me, until they are desperate and beg for my help.
translation_verse: Meeŋ kplaŋ ma basa so n ya fo saŋɛ nɛ baaŋ ji awurfoŋ ga ŋkpal bumo be alubi so, nseŋ ba kaa fin ma na. Ashere bumo be awurfoŋ na, e naŋ shin nɛ b fin ma.”

english_verse: Let's return to the Lord. He has torn us to shreds, but he will bandage our wounds and make us well.
translation_verse: Le nɛ basa na daa kaŋɛ: “Men shin nɛ an bɛta n yɔ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kutɔ! E doro anyi ga ama mo alɛ beeŋ chɛ anyi. E doro anyi ama mo alɛ beeŋ kre anyi be atamɛ, ŋko e maaŋ wora loŋ?

english_verse: In two or three days he will heal us and restore our strength that we may live with him.
translation_verse: Ta a yɔ nchɛnnyɔ ŋko nchɛnsa be kefɛato, e beeŋ ba chɛ anyi nseŋ naŋ sa anyi eleŋ saŋɛ na so anyi nɛ mo beeŋ baa wɔtɔ.

english_verse: Let's do our best to know the Lord. His coming is as certain as the morning sun; he will refresh us like rain renewing the earth in the springtime. The Lord Speaks to Israel and Judah
translation_verse: Men shin nɛ an wora ania m pin Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na. K baa la kashenteŋ nna geeŋ fanɛ e beeŋ ba. Mbe keba na beeŋ baa du fanɛ kananɛ epeŋi bee pete nna, ŋko kananɛ dɔchubɔrɛ so be bɔrɛ bee ba a wushi kasawule na nna.”

english_verse: That's why I slaughtered you with the words of my prophets. That's why my judgments blazed like the dawning sun.
translation_verse: Amoso nɛ n shuŋi ma anebiana menyi kutɔ fanɛ b ta ma kubɔya nɛ k la demuji nɛ kemur be baru na m ba sa menyi na. Kusɔ nɛ mee fin menyi kutɔ na baŋ di efuli nna naniere bre.

english_verse: At a place named Adam, you betrayed me by breaking our agreement.
translation_verse: Ma basa kini kebɛ kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre nɛ ma nɛ bumo nase n sa abar ashi kakpa nɛ baa tre Adam na so.

english_verse: Everyone in Gilead is evil; your hands are stained with the blood of victims.
translation_verse: Giliad la kadegboŋ nɛ basa lubi nɛ bemɔpo wɔ nna.

english_verse: You priests are like a gang of robbers in ambush. On the road to Shechem you murder and commit other horrible crimes.
translation_verse: Bɔrɛmatapoana ki fanɛ besugepo nɛ baa pugi kupuŋ to a jo basa a suge bumo be asɔ nna. Baa mɔ basa Shɛkɛm gba be ekpa to. Bumo alɛ bee kute nna a shuŋ le be ashuŋ lubi ere!

english_verse: I have seen a terrible thing in Israel— you are unfaithful and unfit to worship me.
translation_verse: N wu asheŋ nɛ a maŋ walɛ kekeni ashi Israɛl be efuli so kikɛ. Ma basa ta bumo be amu n wɔtɔ eyurpi to ŋkpal b ka bee shuŋ agbir so.

english_verse: People of Judah, your time is coming too. The Lord Wants To Help Israel I, the Lord, would like to make my nation prosper again
translation_verse: Ama ŋ kɔ kachɛ nɛ meeŋ gberge menyi Juda be basa bre kusoe, ŋkpal kusɔ nɛ menyee wora na so.”

english_verse: The king and his officials take great pleasure in their sin and deceit.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ yɛ: “Basa na bee bɔla bumo be ŋkre lubi so nna a fule ewura na nɛ mbe benimuana.

english_verse: On the day their king was crowned, his officials got him drunk, and he joined in their foolishness.
translation_verse: Kachɛ nɛ bumo be ewura bee ji eyur na nɛ b shin nɛ mo nɛ mbe benimuana na nuu nsa m boo a wora kawulisheŋ.

english_verse: The people of Israel have mixed with foreigners; they are a thin piece of bread scorched on one side.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ yɛ: “Israɛl be basa du nna fanɛ bodobodo nɛ k maŋ bel nna. Efuli pɔtɛana be basa kutɔ nɛ baa yɔ n ya kaa fin kechɛto.

english_verse: I am the Lord, their God, but in all of their troubles their pride keeps them from returning to me. No Help from Foreign Nations The Lord said:
translation_verse: Israɛl be basa be kamoowu e naa ji bumo na. Ama amo nɛ amo kikɛ, b maŋ bɛta m ba ma Enyɛnpe, bumo be Ebɔrɛ na kutɔ.

english_verse: But I will catch them in a net as hunters trap birds; I threatened to punish them, and indeed I will.
translation_verse: Meeŋ sho bumo keshewu m pɛ bumo fanɛ mbuibi. Meeŋ gberge bumo kusoe ŋkpal alubi nɛ baa wora na so.

english_verse: Trouble and destruction will be their reward for rejecting me. I would have rescued them, but they told me lies.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal b ka pal kaman n sa ma so bumo be lalaloge fo nna na. Bumo kikɛ beeŋ mur. N daa sha fanɛ m mɔlga bumo nna ama bumo be kananɛ baa bunyaŋ ma na, maŋ la kashenteŋ be bunyaŋ.

english_verse: They don't really pray to me; they just howl in their beds. They have rejected me for Baal and slashed themselves, in the hope that Baal will bless their crops.
translation_verse: B maa bugi ŋgbene a kule ma. Baa tɔr nna a gbelti a shu fanɛ kananɛ nnyamase bee wora na. B baa kule ma adɔjibi nɛ asɔnuuso gba; baa ta asɔ nna a chaŋɛ a chaŋɛ bumo be eyur fanɛ kananɛ nnyamase bee wora na. Kashenteŋto b la basa nɛ b kini ma nna.

english_verse: I taught them what they know, and I made them strong. Now they plot against me
translation_verse: Ma e bela bumo n shin nɛ b nya eleŋ, ama baa wu ma kulubi nna.

english_verse: Sound a warning! Israel, you broke our agreement and ignored my teaching. Now an eagle is swooping down to attack my land.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ yɛ: “Foŋ kabel! Ŋkpal ma basa ka kini kebɛ kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre nɛ ma nɛ bumo wora na, nɛ ma keŋini so so, bedoŋ chala a gbelge ma kasawule so nna fanɛ njɔnɔkoso na.

english_verse: Israel, you say, “We claim you, the Lord, as our God.”
translation_verse: Kashenteŋ nna fanɛ baa tre ma bumo be Ebɔrɛ nsaa kaŋɛ fanɛ ma basa e la bumo, nɛ b nyi ma,

english_verse: But your enemies will chase you for rejecting our good agreement.
translation_verse: ama b kini kusɔ nɛ k walɛ. Ŋkpal loŋ so, bumo doŋana beeŋ ju m buu bumo so.

english_verse: City of Samaria, I'm angry because of your idol in the shape of a calf. When will you ever be innocent again?
translation_verse: M maa sha gbolu nɛ Samɛria be kade to ebi ta shuwa n lɔŋɛ a shuŋ fanɛ kegbir na be asheŋ. N nya agbo alegaiso n wɔtɔ bumo. Saŋɛ mo gba nɛ baaŋ yige kebaa shuŋ agbir ere?

english_verse: Someone from Israel built that idol for you, but only I am God. And so it will be smashed to pieces.
translation_verse: Israɛl be esa nɛ e nyi enɔ to be kushuŋ e daŋ lɔŋɛ kegbir na, ama kumo alɛ maŋ la ma Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na! Amoso k beeŋ buri to le kpachɛrkpachɛrbi.

english_verse: If you scatter wind instead of wheat, you will harvest a whirlwind and have no wheat. Even if you harvest grain, enemies will steal it all.
translation_verse: Men baŋ maŋ du ayu nseŋ du afu, kawuliwuli nɛ menyeeŋ teŋi. Ayu baaŋ maŋ bel a maaŋ tiŋ n wul kude. Nɛ men baŋ teŋi ayu gba, bedoŋ beeŋ ba sɔ amo ŋ ka menyi.

english_verse: You are like a wild donkey that goes its own way. You've run off to Assyria and hired them as allies.
translation_verse: Men ki fanɛ kupuŋ to be kurma nɛ kumo gbagba wɔtɔ a kilgi to nna. Men shile n yɔ Asiriyaebi kutɔ nna n ya haya bumo fanɛ b baa kuŋ menyi.

english_verse: You can bargain with nations, but I'll catch you anyway. Soon you will suffer abuse by kings and rulers.
translation_verse: Ama meeŋ bar menyi abar so m ba gberge menyi kusoe. Kumo alɛ maaŋ chɛr nɛ Asiriya be efuli so be ewurgboŋ na e mɛaŋ menyi ga nɛ men luri ebesa to.

english_verse: Israel, you have built many altars where you offer sacrifices for sin. But these altars have become places for sin.
translation_verse: Menyi Israɛlebi pɔr ebɔrɛsure damta nna a lara alubi be esarga amo so, ama amo e ki kakpa nɛ menyee wora alubi ga.

english_verse: My instructions for sacrifices were written in detail, but you ignored them.
translation_verse: Mbra damta nɛ n sibɛ n sa menyi, ama men kini amo kikɛ nseŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ a la keŋini pɔtɛ nna.

english_verse: You sacrifice your best animals and eat the sacrificial meals, but I, the Lord, refuse your offerings. I will remember your sins and punish you. Then you will return to Egypt.
translation_verse: Men gbagba e naa we esarga nɛ menyeeŋ lara a sa ma na be eblaŋ. Ma Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be kagbene maŋ fuli menyi so ŋkpal loŋ so. Amoso meeŋ gberge menyi kusoe ŋkpal men be alubi so nseŋ naŋ bɛta menyi n yɔ Ijipt be kasawule so.

english_verse: Israel, I created you, but you forgot me. You and Judah built palaces and many strong cities. Now I will send fire to destroy your towns and fortresses.
translation_verse: Israɛlebi pɔr bewura be elaŋ damta nna nseŋ kplaŋ bumo be etopo na so. Nɛ Judaebi malɛ pɔr nde nseŋ pɔr egbal ŋ kulti amo. Meeŋ shin nɛ edɛ e ba chɔɔ bewura be elaŋ na nɛ nde nɛ b pɔr egbal ŋ kulti na kikɛ nyam.”

english_verse: Israel, don't celebrate or make noisy shouts like other nations. You have been unfaithful to your God. Wherever grain is threshed, you behave like prostitutes because you enjoy the money you receive.
translation_verse: Israɛlebi, men yige kebaaji eyur fanɛ nnyamase na. Men shile menyi be Ebɔrɛ nsaa maŋ naa ji kashenteŋ a sa mo kuraa. Kaplɛkama malɛ nɛ baa bri ayu, ndoŋ nɛ menyee wora menyi be amu fanɛ esakale na a shuŋ kegbir nɛ baa tre Baal na ŋkpal kusɔ nɛ menyee nya so!

english_verse: But you will run short of grain and wine,
translation_verse: Ama k maaŋ chɛr ko nɛ menyi maa naa kɔ ayu nɛ ɔlif be ŋku nɛ asɔnuuso belbelso.

english_verse: and you will have to leave the land of the Lord. Some of you will go to Egypt; others will go to Assyria and eat unclean food.
translation_verse: Israɛl malɛ be basa maa naa wɔ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be kasawule so. Beko beeŋ bɛta n yɔ Ijipt be efuli so, nɛ beko malɛ e yɔ Asiriya be efuli so n ya ka ji ajibi mo nɛ a la bumo be ekishi ashi ndoŋ.

english_verse: You won't be able to offer sacrifices of wine to the Lord. None of your sacrifices will please him— they will be unclean like food offered to the dead. Your food will only be used to satisfy your hunger; none of it will be brought to the Lord's temple.
translation_verse: Men maaŋ naŋ nya nsa belbelso n lara sarga n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na. Men be esarga kikɛ maaŋ bɔlɔ mo kenishi. Ŋkpal manɛ so a beeŋ baa du nna fanɛ keelibuna be ajibi na. Akoŋ so nɛ menyeeŋ kpal n ji amo, ama men maaŋ ta ajibi na be kekama n ya lara sarga ashi Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be lambu to.

english_verse: You will no longer be able to celebrate the festival of the Lord.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ malɛ be kachɛgboŋ nɛ menyee bunyaŋ mo na be saŋɛ kaŋ fo, nuso nɛ menyeeŋ wora?

english_verse: Even if you escape alive, you will end up in Egypt and be buried in Memphis. Your silver treasures will be lost among weeds; thorns will sprout in your tents.
translation_verse: Hale men baa shile a ŋana gba, Ijipt be efuli so nɛ menyeeŋ ya lar nɛ b puli menyi ashi bumo be kade nɛ baa tre Mɛmfis na to. Menyi be gbiti be ekpanjawu na beeŋ shir kupuŋ to nɛ afitiri e kɔr menyi be ewajɛbu to.

english_verse: Israel, the time has come. You will get what you deserve, and you will know it. “Prophets are fools,” you say. “And God's messengers are crazy.” Your terrible guilt has filled you with hatred.
translation_verse: Kasogberge be saŋɛ na kaŋ fo, nɛ menyeeŋ nya kusɔ nɛ k daga menyi. Israɛlebi men baa nyi kumo be loŋ. Men yɛ: “Anebi ere la ewulpo nna nɛ esa nɛ Ebɔrɛ be kiyoyu bɔlɔ mo to malɛ la ebompo. Menyi be alubi damta kurge yurkishi ashi menyi to.

english_verse: Israel, the Lord sent me to look after you. But you trap his prophets and flood his temple with your hatred.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ shuŋi ma nna fanɛ anebi nɛ m ba kpele mbe basa Israɛlebi kusoe, ama kaplɛkama nɛ m bɔla, menyee sho ma ajigbelɛ nna fanɛ kabuibi na. Anebiana ki basa bumo doŋana nna ashi Ebɔrɛ be lambu to.

english_verse: You are brutal and corrupt, as were the men of Gibeah. But God remembers your sin, and you will be punished. Sin's Terrible Results
translation_verse: Men wora alubi alegaiso nsaa puni fanɛ basa nɛ b daa wɔ Gibia na. Ebɔrɛ yɛ e beeŋ nyiŋi bumo be alubi nseŋ gberge bumo kusoe.” Israɛl be kulubi be kasogberge be asheŋ

english_verse: And so, Israel, your glory will fly away like birds— your women will no longer be able to give birth.
translation_verse: Amoso Israɛlebi be kemaŋkura beeŋ shile bumo so fanɛ kabuibi ka firgi n choŋ na. Bumo be beche gba maaŋ naŋ tiŋ n da adampu ŋ kurge mbia n sa bumo.

english_verse: Even if you do have children, I will take them all and leave you to mourn. I will turn away, and you will sink down in deep trouble.
translation_verse: Hale nɛ b kurge mbia gba, meeŋ shin nɛ mbia na kikɛ e wu. Nɛ m baŋ maŋ wora loŋ malɛ, meeŋ shin nɛ tɔrɔ damta e tu to bumo.”

english_verse: Israel, when I first met you, I thought of you as palm trees growing in fertile ground. Now you lead your people out, only to be slaughtered. Hosea's Advice
translation_verse: “Israɛl, ŋ ka tu fo sososo na, fo daa du fanɛ abii be ndibi nɛ b duu kasawule lela so nna. Ama naniere bre fo keta fo basa nna a yɔ nɛ b ya mɔ bumo.”

english_verse: Our Lord, do just one thing for your people— make their women unable to have children or to nurse their babies. The Lord's Judgment on Israel
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, manɛ bre nɛ feeŋ wora basa ere? Shin nɛ bumo beche e ki begbentepo, ŋko b sa maa kɔ kenyipochu nɛ bumo be mbia e nyipo. Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be demuji ka ba Israɛl so be asheŋ

english_verse: Israel, I first began to hate you because you did evil at Gilgal. Now I will chase you out of my house. No longer will I love you; your leaders betrayed me.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ yɛ: “Bumo be asheŋ lubi be kewora fara ashi Gilgaal nna. Ndoŋ nɛ ma alɛ fara n nya kekishi n sa bumo. Ma alɛ beeŋ ju bumo ashi ma kasawule ere so ŋkpal kulubi nɛ b wora na so. Ma kasha maŋ naa wɔ bumo so ŋkpal manɛ so bumo be bejuŋkparpoana kikɛ kini kenu n sa ma.

english_verse: Israel, you are a vine with dried-up roots and fruitless branches. Even if you had more children and loved them dearly, I would slaughter them all. Hosea Warns Israel
translation_verse: Israɛl be basa ki nna fanɛ kedibi nɛ kumo be nliŋi wɔl nɛ k maaŋ naŋ tiŋ n sɔr asɔrso. B maaŋ tiŋ ŋ kurge. Hale nɛ b kurge gba, meeŋ mɔ bumo be mbia nɛ baa sha ga na.” Anebi na ka malga Israɛl be asheŋ

english_verse: You were a healthy vine covered with grapes. But the more grapes you grew, the more altars you built; the better off you became, the better shrines you set up for pagan gods.
translation_verse: Israɛl be basa daa du nna fanɛ asɔrso nɛ baa tre greep na be kefeelebi. B baa dii dama baa pere kenishi nna a pɔr ebɔrɛsure damta. Bumo be adɔjibi baa wora nɛnɛ baa pere kenishi nna a lɔŋɛ kakpa nɛ baa shuŋ agbir na nɛnɛ.

english_verse: You are deceitful and disloyal. So you will pay for your sins, because the Lord will destroy your altars and images.
translation_verse: Ŋgbene kpakpasowuraana beeŋ ji bumo be alubi be tɔnɔ. Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ beeŋ bure bumo be ebɔrɛsure na nseŋ jija bumo be agbirjembu nɛ b yuu na gba.

english_verse: “We don't have a king,” you will say. “We don't fear the Lord. And what good are kings?”
translation_verse: Baaŋ kaŋɛ le: “Ŋkpal an ka maa ŋana Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na so nɛ an maŋ kɔ ewura na. Ama nɛ fanɛ an kɔ ewura gba, manɛ bre nɛ e beeŋ tiŋ n wora n sa anyi?”

english_verse: Israel, you break treaties and don't keep promises; you turn justice into poisonous weeds where healthy plants should grow.
translation_verse: Bumo be mmalga kikɛ la mmalga fuloŋ nna nɛ bumo be nnɔ naseso kikɛ la efɛ. Kashenteŋji loge nɛ efɛ sɔ kakpa a salga to fanɛ afitiri nɛ a bee mɔ adɔjibi na.

english_verse: All who live in Samaria tremble with concern for the idols at sinful Bethel. The idol there was the pride of the priests, but it has been put to shame; now everyone will cry.
translation_verse: Kufu beeŋ pɛ basa nɛ b wɔ Samɛria be kadegboŋ to na, nɛ b shu ga ŋkpal bumo be kegbir nɛ b ta shuwa m pɔr fanɛ gbolu na ka foe ashi Bɛtɛl so. Bumo nɛ agbirwuraana nɛ baa shuŋ kumo na beeŋ shu ga ŋkpal kumo so. Saŋɛ nɛ baaŋ marga kumo so be shuwa na nɛ baaŋ shu awɔrso ga.

english_verse: It will be taken to Assyria and given to the great king. Then Israel will be disgraced for worshiping that idol.
translation_verse: Baaŋ ta kegbir na n yɔ Asiriya be efuli so n ya sa ndoŋ be ewurgboŋ na fanɛ bumo be kakɛ. Saŋɛ na so anishinyɔr beeŋ pɛ Israɛl be basa, ŋkpal b ka bɛ agbir so so.

english_verse: Like a twig in a stream, the king of Samaria will be swept away.
translation_verse: Baaŋ ju Samɛria be ewura na n ya lɛ fanɛ kananɛ afu bee kpata ketuweklaŋ nɛ k foŋ nchu so a yɔ na.

english_verse: The altars at sinful Bethel will be destroyed for causing Israel to sin; they will be grown over with thorns and thistles. Then everyone will beg the mountains and hills to cover and protect them. The Lord Promises To Punish Israel
translation_verse: Avɛn be kebee be esoso be kakpa nɛ Israɛl be basa bee shuŋ agbir na kikɛ beeŋ mur, nɛ ewi nɛ afeelebi a kɔr n daŋ m buu bumo be ebɔrɛsureana na so. Ndoŋ nna nɛ b kaŋɛ le: “Abeegboŋ, men ta anyi ŋ ŋana! Abeebi, men bure m buu anyi so!” Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ka ji Israɛlebi demu be asheŋ

english_verse: Your sins have doubled, and you are rebellious. Now I have decided to send nations to attack and put you in chains.
translation_verse: Meeŋ ya kɔ basa lubi ere kena nseŋ gberge bumo kusoe. Efuli pɔtɛana beeŋ wora kɔnɔkoŋwule ŋ kɔ bumo kena nseŋ gberge bumo kusoe ŋkpal bumo be alubi damta so.

english_verse: Once you were obedient like a calf that loved to thresh grain. But I will put a harness on your beautiful neck; you and Judah must plow and cultivate the ground.
translation_verse: Saŋko, Israɛlebi daa kɔ kasonu nna fanɛ kena nɛ baa keta a bir ayu na, ama meeŋ ta kubɔ to be kebarga n deŋi mbe kubɔ lela na so n shin nɛ e shuŋ ashuŋ kpakpaso. Judaebi nɛ Israɛlebi kikɛ beeŋ keta ntekpa n dɔ.

english_verse: You have planted evil, harvested injustice, and eaten the fruit of your lies. You trusted your own strength and your powerful forces.
translation_verse: Ama men duu kulubi nseŋ nya kumo be kakɔka. Men ji menyi be kafule be tɔnɔ. Ŋkpal men ka ta men be yirda n deŋi menyi gbagba be eleŋ nɛ benapo damta nɛ men kɔ na so,

english_verse: So war will break out, and your fortresses will be destroyed. Your enemies will do to you what Shalman did to the people of Beth-Arbel— mothers and their children will be beaten to death against rocks.
translation_verse: kena beeŋ ku nɛ menyi nɛ men be kumɔlga be kakpa lempo e mur. Kumo be kemur na beeŋ baa du nna fanɛ kachɛ nɛ ewura Shalma ta kena m ba mur Bɛtabel be kade, nseŋ ta bibinioana nɛ bumo be mbia ŋ ŋmɛa ajembu m mɔ na nna.

english_verse: Bethel, this will be your fate because of your evil. Israel, at dawn your king will be killed.
translation_verse: Loŋ gbagba chap e naaŋ wora menyi, Bɛtɛl be basa, ŋkpal alubi damta nɛ men wora na so. Saŋɛ nɛ kena na beeŋ fara na nɛ Israɛl be ewura malɛ beeŋ wu.”

english_verse: When Israel was a child, I loved him, and I called my son out of Egypt.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ yɛ: “Jemanɛ so nɛ Israɛl wɔ Ijipt be efuli so fanɛ kebia na nɛ n tre mo n lar ndoŋ fanɛ m pibinyɛn shaso.

english_verse: But as the saying goes, “The more they were called, the more they rebelled.” They never stopped offering incense and sacrifices to the idols of Baal.
translation_verse: Ama saŋɛ nɛ m pere kenishi a tre bumo na, nɛ bumo alɛ pere kenishi a shile ma. Bumo alɛ maŋ yige sarga be kebaa lara nɛ duwu be kebaa chɔɔ a sa Baal be kegbir na.

english_verse: I took Israel by the arm and taught them to walk. But they would not admit that I was the one who had healed them.
translation_verse: Ma e pɛ Israɛlebi be enɔ to n ŋini bumo enite, ŋkeshin nɛ bumo alɛ maaŋ wu gba fanɛ ma e naa chɛ bumo to.

english_verse: I led them with kindness and with love, not with ropes. I held them close to me; I bent down to feed them.
translation_verse: Ŋ koli bumo m mata ma kumu kashaso, nseŋ maŋ bumo so m pɛga. N sa bumo ajibi nɛ b ji,

english_verse: But they rejected me, and so must return to Egypt; now Assyria will rule them.
translation_verse: Ama b kraŋ kini k ba ŋ kutɔ nseŋ bɛta n yɔ Ijipt be efuli so. Naniere, Asiriyaebi e naaŋ baa ji bumo so eleŋ.

english_verse: My people are determined to reject me for a god they think is stronger, but he can't help.
translation_verse: Ma basa baŋ yili kumo nna fanɛ baaŋ kini ma, nseŋ ya kaa bɛ agbir nɛ e maaŋ tiŋ n chɛ bumo to so.

english_verse: Israel, I can't let you go. I can't give you up. How could I possibly destroy you as I did the towns of Admah and Zeboiim? I just can't do it. My feelings for you are much too strong.
translation_verse: Ama m maaŋ tiŋ n yige Israɛlebi ŋko ŋ kplaŋ bumo so kikɛ. M maaŋ tiŋ n jija bumo fanɛ kananɛ n jija Adma nɛ Zeboyim be nde na. Ma kasha nɛ ŋ kɔ n sa bumo na shi ga.

english_verse: Israel, I won't lose my temper and destroy you again. I am the Holy God— not merely some human, and I won't stay angry.
translation_verse: M maaŋ naŋ kaa agbo m mur Israɛlebi kikɛ; ŋkpal manɛ so, n la Ebɔrɛ nna, mannɛ dimɛdi. N la Ebɔrɛ nɛ n du cheembi nna a wɔ bumo to. M maaŋ kaa agbo m ba bumo so kikɛ.

english_verse: I, the Lord, will roar like a lion, and my children will return, trembling from the west.
translation_verse: Ma basa baŋ nu ŋ ka ponte bumo doŋana so fanɛ buluŋ na, baaŋ shi epeŋitɔrkpa be kaba so n chicha kufuso m ba ŋ kutɔ.

english_verse: They will come back, fluttering like birds from Egypt or like doves from Assyria. Then I will bring them back to their homes. I, the Lord, have spoken! Israel and Judah Compared
translation_verse: Baaŋ shi Ijipt be efuli so m mel abar so m ba fanɛ mbuibi na. Nseŋ shi Asiriya be efuli so m ba fanɛ elɔpo na. Loŋ be saŋɛ na nɛ meeŋ bɛta bumo m ba chena bumo peana. Ma Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e kaŋɛ na.” Israɛl nɛ Juda ka ji n tɔr be asheŋ

english_verse: Israel is deceitful to me, their loyal and holy God; they surround me with lies, and Judah worships other gods.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ yɛ: “Israɛl be basa ta efɛ nɛ kafule nna ŋ kulti ma, nɛ Juda malɛ be basa kini kenu n sa ma nɛ n la kashenteŋ be Ebɔrɛ nsaa du cheembi na.

english_verse: All day long Israel chases wind from the desert; deceit and violence are found everywhere. Treaties are made with Assyria; olive oil is taken to Egypt. Israel and Judah Condemned
translation_verse: Kusɔ kama nɛ Israɛl be basa bee wora kapa nɛ kanyɛ na kikɛ ki kusɔ jiga nɛ kusɔ fuloŋ nna. Efɛ nɛ kebaa nyaŋɛto a wɔtɔ abar e wɔ bumo to. Bumo nɛ Asiriyaebi wora kɔnɔkoŋwule nna a ji yawu ashi Ijipt.”

english_verse: The Lord also brings charges against the people of Judah, the descendants of Jacob. He will punish them for what they have done.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kɔ asheŋ ko nɛ e malga ŋ gbiti Judaebi. E beeŋ gberge bumo kusoe ŋkpal kusɔ nɛ b wora so.

english_verse: Even before Jacob was born, he cheated his brother, and when he grew up, he fought against God.
translation_verse: Bumo nananyɛn Jeekɔb nɛ mo da Isɔɔ nɛ b daa la mborobi na daŋ kɔ emaŋ nna ashi bumo nio be epunto. Ama Jeekɔb ka ba daŋ nɛ mo nɛ Ebɔrɛ

english_verse: At Bethel, Jacob wrestled with an angel and won; then with tears in his eyes, he asked for a blessing, and God spoke to us there.
translation_verse: be malaika kɔ emaŋ nɛ Jeekɔb pɔɔ mo so nseŋ shu ŋ kule mo fanɛ e nɛfa mo. Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ malga mo kutɔ ndoŋ ashi Bɛtɛl.

english_verse: God's name is the Lord, the Lord God All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Mo e la Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ nɛ e daga bunyaŋ na.

english_verse: You say to yourself, “I'm rich! I earned it all on my own, without committing a sin.” The Lord Is Still the God of Israel
translation_verse: Men yɛ: ‘Damawuraana e la anyi nɛ an kɔ amansherbi nɛnɛ. Esa kama malɛ maaŋ tiŋ ŋ kaŋɛ anyi fanɛ an puni nna ŋ ki damawuraana.’

english_verse: Israel, I, the Lord, am still your God, just as I have been since the time you were in Egypt. Now I will force you to live in tents once again, as you did in the desert.
translation_verse: Ama ma nɛ n la men Nyɛnpe nɛ men be Ebɔrɛ nseŋ lara menyi ashi Ijipt be kasawule so na, beeŋ naŋ shin nɛ men chena ewajɛbu to fanɛ kananɛ men daŋ chena amo to pɔɛŋ nɛ m ba tu menyi keshishɛrsawule na so na.

english_verse: I spoke to the prophets— often I spoke in visions. And so, I will send my prophets with messages of doom.
translation_verse: M malga anebiana na kutɔ nseŋ shin nɛ b ku bɔrɛdare n wu asheŋ damta. M bɔla anebi koŋwule ana na so ŋ kpele ma basa kusoe.

english_verse: Gilead is terribly sinful and will end up ruined. Bulls are sacrificed in Gilgal on altars made of stones, but those stones will be scattered in every field.
translation_verse: Ade kikɛ be kaman nɛ b kraa shuŋ agbir ashi Giliad. Basa nɛ bumo alɛ bee shuŋ agbir na beeŋ wu. B ta egbolu n lara sarga ashi Gilgaal. Ndoŋ be ebɔrɛsure malɛ beeŋ bure to ŋ ki ajembu n deŋi abar so kululu ashi kupuŋ to.”

english_verse: Jacob escaped to Syria where he tended sheep to earn himself a wife.
translation_verse: An nananyɛn Jeekɔb daŋ shile nna n yɔ Mɛsopoteemia be efuli so n ya ka keni kanyɛn ko be mbolpɔ so pɔɛŋ nseŋ nya eche.

english_verse: I sent the prophet Moses to lead Israel from Egypt and to keep them safe.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ e shuŋi anebi Mosis fanɛ e ya mɔlga Israɛl be basa kenyaya to ashi Ijipt be kasawule so nseŋ keni bumo so nɛnɛ.

english_verse: Now you continue to sin by designing and making idols of silver in the shape of calves. You are told to sacrifice to these idols— yes, even to kiss them.
translation_verse: B daa wɔtɔ nna a wora alubi nsaa ta gbiti a lɔŋɛ agbir nɛ a duli anabi nna. Le nɛ b daa kaŋɛ: “Men lara sarga n sa agbir na.” Nuso malɛ nɛ esa beeŋ tiŋ n bunyaŋ agbir nɛ a du fanɛ anabi ere kashaso!

english_verse: And so, all of you will vanish like the mist or the dew of early morning, or husks of grain in the wind or smoke from a chimney.
translation_verse: Amoso bumo kikɛ beeŋ foe fanɛ kachipurso be kenyɔlɔ na ŋko kananɛ bunyaŋ bee tɔr nsaa kpata to kachipurdidi na. Baaŋ baa du fanɛ b ka bee chela asɔ kugooro so nɛ afu ta amo be amimi a yɔ ŋko kananɛ edishi bee bɔla tokuro to a lar kowu na nna.

english_verse: I, the Lord, have been your God since the time you were in Egypt. I am the only God you know, the only one who can save.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ yɛ: “Ma e la Enyɛnpe, men be Ebɔrɛ nɛ n lara menyi ashi Ijipt be kasawule so na. N nawule e la menyi be Ebɔrɛ nɛ men be emɔlgapo.

english_verse: I took care of you in a thirsty desert.
translation_verse: Ma e keni menyi so saŋɛ so nɛ men daa wɔ keshishɛrsawule tushiso na so na.

english_verse: Now I will attack like a lion, ambush you like a leopard,
translation_verse: Amoso meeŋ kɔ menyi fanɛ kananɛ buluŋ bee kɔ esa na. Meeŋ ŋana ekpa to kupuŋ to a jo menyi fanɛ karmɛ na.

english_verse: and rip you apart like a bear robbed of her cubs. I will gnaw on your bones, as though I were a lion or some other wild animal.
translation_verse: Meeŋ kɔ menyi nseŋ kpɛa menyi to cheche fanɛ shishiri nɛ kumo be bibi foe na. Meeŋ tɛ n yuu menyi so epul to fanɛ buluŋ na, nseŋ kpɛa menyi to m min fanɛ kupuŋ to be kusɔbɔya na.

english_verse: You wanted a king and rulers. Where is your king now? What cities have rulers?
translation_verse: Menyee kule fanɛ b sa menyi ewura nɛ bejuŋkparpo ashi menyi be nde to, ama baaŋ tiŋ m mɔlga menyi kashenteŋto a?

english_verse: In my anger, I gave you a king; in my fury, I took him away. Israel's Terrible Fate The Lord said:
translation_verse: Amoso n daŋ kaa agbo nna n sa menyi ewura nseŋ naŋ kaa agbo n lara mo ashi menyi to.

english_verse: You are like a senseless child who refuses to be born at the proper time.
translation_verse: Israɛl kraa kɔ ekpa nɛ e ji efute, ama e ki fanɛ kebia wulpo nɛ mbe kakurge fo nɛ e kini k lar nna.

english_verse: Should I, the Lord, rescue you from death and the grave? No! I call death and the grave to strike you like a plague. I refuse to show mercy.
translation_verse: M maaŋ lara bumo ashi bubuni to ŋko m mɔlga bumo ashi luwu to. Luwu nɛ nchaŋ kikɛ bee ŋmɛa bumo be kabuna. M maaŋ naŋ wu bumo kuwɔr kikɛ.

english_verse: No matter if you prosper more than the other tribes, I, the Lord, will wipe you out, just as a scorching desert wind dries up streams of water. I will take away your precious treasures.
translation_verse: Hale nɛ b dii dama a chɔ bumo kurgepoana gba, meeŋ shin nɛ afu tushiso e shi keshishɛrsawule na be epeŋilarkpa be kaba so m ba shin nɛ bumo be mbombi nɛ atirbu e wɔl to. Kumo be kaman nɛ afu na e jija bumo be asɔ lela nɛ b kɔ na.

english_verse: Samaria will be punished for turning against me. It will be destroyed in war— children will be beaten against rocks, and pregnant women will be ripped open.
translation_verse: A daga fanɛ Samɛriaebi ka nya kasogberge ŋkpal b ka kini k nu n sa ma so. Kumo be basa beeŋ wu kena to nɛ b ta bumo be mbi popɔrbi malɛ ŋ ŋmɛa kasawule m mɔ, nseŋ baŋɛ bumo be bedampoche malɛ to.”

english_verse: Israel, return! Come back to the Lord, your God. Sin has made you fall.
translation_verse: Israɛl be basa, men bɛta m ba men Nyɛnpe nɛ men be Ebɔrɛ kutɔ. Men be kulubi e shin nɛ men fiti n tɔr na.

english_verse: Assyria can't save us, and chariots can't help. So we will no longer worship the idols we have made. Our Lord, you show mercy to orphans.” The Lord Promises To Forgive
translation_verse: Asiriyaebi maaŋ tiŋ m mɔlga anyi. Kena to malɛ gba be egbaŋɛ maaŋ tiŋ ŋ kuŋ anyi. Anyi maaŋ naŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ anyi be agbirana na e la anyi be Ebɔrɛ. Fo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nawule e naŋ tiŋ n chɛ anyi to.” Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ka nase kɔnɔ fanɛ e beeŋ nɛfa Israɛl be asheŋ

english_verse: Israel, you have rejected me, but my anger is gone; I will heal you and love you without limit.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ yɛ: “Meeŋ shin nɛ ma basa e naŋ bɛta m ba ŋ kutɔ, nɛ n ta ma kagbene kikɛ n sha bumo; a maaŋ naŋ nya agbo n wɔtɔ bumo kikɛ.

english_verse: Your branches will spread with the beauty of an olive tree and with the aroma of Lebanon Forest.
translation_verse: Menyeeŋ ki fanɛ kedibi nɛ baa tre ɔlif nɛ k purge afantaŋ a walɛ na. Menyi beeŋ baa kɔ efɛa belbelso fanɛ ndibi nɛ baa tre sida nɛ a wɔ Lebanɔn na.

english_verse: You will rest in my shade, and your grain will grow. You will blossom like a vineyard and be famous as the wine from Lebanon.
translation_verse: Menyeeŋ luri ma kayul to n nya kekuŋ. Menyeeŋ purge afantaŋ nseŋ sɔr asɔrso fanɛ ndibi sɔrso na. Menyi alɛ be ketre beeŋ dii fanɛ Lebanɔn be nsa.

english_verse: Israel, give up your idols! I will answer your prayers and take care of you. I am that glorious tree, the source of your fruit.
translation_verse: Meeŋ nu ma basa Israɛlebi nɛ b maŋ naa shuŋ agbir na be kabɔrɛkule nsaa keni bumo so. Meeŋ shin nɛ b purge fanɛ kedibi nɛ kumo be afantaŋ maa gbaŋgbaŋ na. Ma so nɛ baaŋ bɔla n nya bumo be enɛfa kikɛ.” Lalaloge be kamalga be asheŋ

english_verse: If you are wise, you will know and understand what I mean. I am the Lord, and I lead you along the right path. If you obey me, we will walk together, but if you are wicked, you will stumble.
translation_verse: Benyiashempo beeŋ pin asheŋ ere be kifito nseŋ bɛ amo so. Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be ekpa niŋi nna. Basa nɛ bumo alɛ kɔ kebaawɔtɔ cheembi nawule e naa bɔla kumo so. Belubiworapo bre bee fiti nna a tɔr ŋkpal b ka kini kumo be kebɛso so.

english_verse: I am Joel the son of Pethuel. And this is the message the Lord gave to me. Locusts Cover the Land
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be kamalga nɛ k shi mo kutɔ m ba ma Jowɛl, nɛ n la Petuel pibinyɛn na kutɔ nde. Elotɔr be keba kasawule so be asheŋ

english_verse: Swarm after swarm of locusts has attacked our crops, eating everything in sight.
translation_verse: Elotɔr be ntuŋgboŋ nɛ ntuŋwurbi bɛ m bɛ abar so m ba ji adɔjibi kikɛ nyam.

english_verse: A powerful nation with countless troops has invaded our land. They have the teeth and jaws of powerful lions.
translation_verse: Efuli ko so ebi nɛ b shi ga, a du fanɛ elotɔr na ba kɔ m pɔɔ ma efuli so n sɔ kumo ŋ ki bumo peya. Loŋ be basa na kɔ anyii nna fanɛ buluŋ na.

english_verse: Offerings of grain and wine are no longer brought to the Lord's temple. His servants, the priests, are deep in sorrow.
translation_verse: Kebɔltofinfin pɛ bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ b wɔ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be bɔrɛlambu to a shuŋ na gba ŋkpal kuyu baŋɛto nɛ kusɔ nuuso kikɛ ka maŋ naa wɔtɔ nɛ b ta n lara sarga n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na so.

english_verse: Grapevines have dried up and so has every tree— figs and pomegranates, date palms and apples. All happiness has faded away. Return to God
translation_verse: Ndibi sɔrso be yiri yiri kikɛ bolo to nseŋ wɔl n wu kuraa; nɛ bomin kikɛ be kagbenefuli n loge kuraa. Kelar alubi to be saŋɛ ka fo be asheŋ

english_verse: Tell the leaders and people to come together at the temple. Order them to go without eating and to pray sincerely.
translation_verse: Naniere, a daga fanɛ men tre abar n shɛr ŋ kishi ekishi cheembi. Men tre bejuŋkparpoana na, nɛ bekama nɛ b wɔ kasawule ere so na n shɛr men Nyɛnpe be bɔrɛlambu to n shu n tre mo.

english_verse: We are in for trouble! Soon the Lord All-Powerful will bring disaster.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be kachɛ na taga to. Kachɛ nɛ e beeŋ bar kemur na. Kashenteŋto, kachɛ na maaŋ baa walɛ kuraa!

english_verse: Our food is already gone; there's no more celebrating at the temple of our God.
translation_verse: To, naniere gba an kɔ anishi nna a keni anyi be adɔ nɛ amo be ajibi bee jija. Kagbenefuli malɛ maŋ naa wɔ bɔrɛlambu to kuraa.

english_verse: Seeds dry up in the ground; no harvest is possible. Our barns are in bad shape, with no grain to store in them.
translation_verse: Asɔduuso malɛ wɔ shishɛr wɔlso to a wu. Asɔduuso kama malɛ maŋ naa wɔtɔ nɛ an ta n yili echefoso. Amoso mpuroana kikɛ yil a jija.

english_verse: I cry out to you, Lord. Grasslands and forests are eaten by the scorching heat.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, fo nɛ mee shu a tre na, ŋkpal manɛ so, asɔbɔya be afitiri jiso kikɛ wɔl n chɔɔ n fige to nyam.

english_verse: Wild animals have no water because of you; rivers and streams are dry, and pastures are parched.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal kusɔ nɛ fo wora so, mbombi kikɛ wɔlto nɛ kupuŋ to be asɔbɔya maŋ naŋ nya nchu nɛ b nuu nsaa fute yeŋayeŋa.

english_verse: Sound the trumpet on Zion, the Lord's sacred hill. Warn everyone to tremble! The judgment day of the Lord is coming soon.
translation_verse: Men foŋ kabel nseŋ ber kenishipereso be dewuro ashi Zayɔn, nɛ k la Ebɔrɛ be kebee cheembi na so. Judaebi, men baa chicha, ŋkpal manɛ so, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be kachɛ na be saŋɛ fo n loge.

english_verse: They roar over mountains like noisy chariots, or a mighty army ready for battle. They are a forest fire that feasts on straw.
translation_verse: B baa wɔ abee so a tɛ, bumo be egbri du fanɛ egbaŋɛturko be egbri nna, a shin nɛ kaplɛkama bee gbri waa fanɛ kananɛ edɛ bee chɔɔ afitiri wɔlso nɛ a bee gbri na. Baa pɛ abar a yɔ kena to nna.

english_verse: They make the earth tremble and the heavens shake; the sun and moon turn dark, and stars stop shining.
translation_verse: B baa ba, kasawule bee gbuŋgbuŋ nna nɛ awɔlpa bee wora fanɛ a ka bee chicha na, nɛ epeŋi nɛ kufɔl kikɛ malɛ e biri to tuum nɛ achɛkpabi e fuli to ŋ gben.

english_verse: The Lord God leads this army of countless troops, and they obey his commands. The day of his judgment is so terrible that no one can stand it. The Lord's Invitation
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee kaa ponte to nna a juŋkpar mbe benapo, nɛ b kɔ eleŋ nsaa shi nɛ esa maaŋ tiŋ ŋ karga bumo na, nɛ baa nu a sa mo. Yee, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be kachɛ na beeŋ lubi pasaa! Wanɛ e naaŋ nya ŋkpa loŋ be kachɛ na bre?

english_verse: The Lord said: It isn't too late. You can still return to me with all your heart. Start crying and mourning! Go without eating.
translation_verse: Ama naniere Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na yɛ: “Men lar men be alubi to m bugi men be ŋgbene n sa ma kashenteŋto nseŋ ta ekishi nɛ anishichubi nɛ ŋgbenejija be kushu m bɛta m ba ma kutɔ.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God. Perhaps I will change my mind and treat you with mercy. Then you will be blessed with enough grain and wine for offering sacrifices to me.
translation_verse: Nɛ men lar men be alubi to ashere Enyɛnpe, men be Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ chɛrga mbe nfɛra nseŋ nɛfa menyi nɛ men be adɔjibi e wora nɛnɛ ga. Loŋ nɛ menyeeŋ tiŋ n nya adɔjibi nɛ asɔ nuuso n lara sarga n sa mo.

english_verse: Sound the trumpet on Zion! Call the people together. Show your sorrow by going without food.
translation_verse: Men yili Zayɔn be kebee so n foŋ kabel n tre ekama m ba shɛr nseŋ yili kumo fanɛ ekama e kishi!

english_verse: Tell my servants, the priests, to cry inside the temple and to offer this prayer near the altar: “Save your people, Lord God! Don't let foreign nations make jokes about us. Don't let them laugh and ask, ‘Where is your God?’ ” The Lord Will Bless the Land
translation_verse: Men shin nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ baa shuŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e shɛr bɔrɛlambu na to be bɔrɛsure na be kabuna to n shu ŋ kule Ebɔrɛ ŋ kaŋɛ le: ‘Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, wu fo basa kuwɔr. Sa maŋ shin nɛ efuli pɔtɛana so ebi e wora anyi eyurto, nseŋ bishi anyi fanɛ, men be Ebɔrɛ na wɔ nnɛ naniere?’ ” Ebɔrɛ ka beeŋ shin nɛ nɛfa e naŋ ba kasawule na so be asheŋ

english_verse: The Lord was deeply concerned about his land and had pity on his people.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be kasawule be asheŋ tir mo ga nna, nɛ e wu mbe basa kuwɔr nseŋ nu bumo be kabɔrɛkule

english_verse: In answer to their prayers he said, “I will give you enough grain, wine, and olive oil to satisfy your needs. No longer will I let you be insulted by the nations.
translation_verse: ŋ kaŋɛ bumo le: “Naniere bre meeŋ sa menyi adɔjibi nɛ asɔ nuuso nɛ ɔlif be asɔrso be ŋku nɛ men ji m moɛ. Loŋ na efuli pɔtɛana so ebi maaŋ naŋ fɛl menyi nseŋ wora menyi eyurto.

english_verse: An army attacked from the north, but I will chase it into a scorching desert. There it will rot and stink from the Dead Sea to the Mediterranean.” The Lord works wonders
translation_verse: Meeŋ ju benapo be katuŋgboŋ, nɛ b shi kelarga to be esoso m ba fanɛ elotɔr na, ashi menyi to n ya lɛ keshishɛrsawule so kiyi to chil. Meeŋ ju bumo be bejuŋkparpoana n yɔ Teku Wuso na to nseŋ shin nɛ bumo be bemantopo na malɛ e yɔ Mɛditerenia be teku to, n ya wu mbɛ a dufɛ.”

english_verse: and wild animals to stop being afraid. Grasslands are green again; fruit trees and fig trees are loaded with fruit. Grapevines are covered with grapes.
translation_verse: Kupuŋ to be asɔbɔya, e sa maŋ naa lɔ kufu naniere ŋkpal kusɔ nɛ menyeeŋ ji so. Afitiri nɛ afantaŋ kikɛ purge nna jiliim n sɔ kaplɛkama. Naniere ndibi bee sɔr asɔrso nna nɛ figi nɛ greep be asɔrso kikɛ chase.

english_verse: People of Zion, celebrate in honor of the Lord your God! He is generous and has sent the autumn and spring rains in the proper seasons.
translation_verse: Zayɔnebi, men shin nɛ men be ŋgbene e fuli menyi ŋkpal kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe, men be Ebɔrɛ na wora n sa menyi na so. E sa menyi dɔchubɔrɛso be bɔrɛ nɛ bɔrɛchu lela nɛ a shin nɛ men be adɔjibi wora nɛnɛ fanɛ kananɛ a chɛr a wora na.

english_verse: Grain will cover your threshing places; jars will overflow with wine and olive oil. The Lord Will Rescue His People
translation_verse: Naniere mboŋ kama nɛ baa biri ayu na kikɛ beeŋ bɔlɔ nɛ mboŋ kama nɛ baaŋ nyaŋ asɔrso a wora greep be nsa ŋko ɔlif be ŋku na kikɛ e bɔlɔ a wurge.

english_verse: I, the Lord your God, will make up for the losses caused by those swarms and swarms of locusts I sent to attack you.
translation_verse: Meeŋ bɛta asɔ kama nɛ benapo nɛ b du fanɛ elotɔr damta na daŋ jija na kikɛ n sa menyi. Ma Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e daŋ shuŋi elotɔr na.

english_verse: My people, you will eat until you are satisfied. Then you will praise me for the wonderful things I have done. Never again will you be put to shame.
translation_verse: Naniere, menyeeŋ nya ajibi damta n ji m moɛ, nseŋ fara a di men Nyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ nɛ e wora emamachisheŋ n sa menyi na epaŋ. Kashenteŋto esa kama maaŋ naŋ fɛl ma basa.

english_verse: Israel, you will know that I stand at your side. I am the Lord your God— there are no other gods. Never again will you be put to shame. The Lord Will Work Wonders The Lord said:
translation_verse: Saŋɛ na so, menyi Israɛlebi beeŋ pin fanɛ ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e la men be Ebɔrɛ nsaa wɔ menyi kutɔ. Esa kama malɛ maaŋ naŋ tiŋ n fɛl ma basa. Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be kachɛ na be asheŋ

english_verse: Later, I will give my Spirit to everyone. Your sons and daughters will prophesy. Your old men will have dreams, and your young men will see visions.
translation_verse: Nɛ Ebɔrɛ naŋ kaŋɛ le: “Ade kikɛ be kaman, meeŋ shin nɛ ma kiyoyu e ba ekama so nɛ men be mbinyɛnsobi nɛ mbichesobi e fara a bɔ ma kubɔya na nɛ men be benyɛnnimubiana e ba ku edare nɛ men be mbrantiɛbi e baa ku bɔrɛdare.

english_verse: In those days I will even give my Spirit to my servants, both men and women.
translation_verse: Loŋ be saŋɛ kaŋ fo, meeŋ shin nɛ ma kiyoyu e ba ma nyɛrbi nɛ mbita kikɛ so.

english_verse: I will work wonders in the sky above and on the earth below. There will be blood and fire and clouds of smoke.
translation_verse: Kumo be kamɔnchɛ, meeŋ sa menyi kefiɛso be etɔɔnɛsheŋ nɛ e shi awɔlpa to nɛ kasawule so. Kumo be jemanɛ so, basa ko be ŋklaŋ beeŋ lar edɛ beeŋ suse n shin nɛ edishi e sɔ awɔlpa to kikɛ.

english_verse: Then I, the Lord will save everyone who faithfully worships me. I have promised there will be survivors on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem, and among them will be my chosen ones.
translation_verse: Ama Ebɔrɛ beeŋ mɔlga bekama nɛ b kule mo kechɛto fanɛ kananɛ e kaŋɛ na! E yɛ: ‘Basa nɛ b wɔ Zayɔn be kebee so nɛ Jerusalɛm to na bre beeŋ gelge loŋ be etɔrɔ na. Bekama nɛ n lara na bre beeŋ ji efute.’ ”

english_verse: Then in Judgment Valley I will bring together the nations that scattered my people Israel everywhere in the world, and I will bring charges against those nations. They divided up my land
translation_verse: Meeŋ gbargbar efuli pɔtɛana kikɛ so ebi m ba shɛr ketaŋɛ nɛ baa tre Jehoshafat na to n ji bumo demu ŋkpal asɔ lubi kama nɛ b wora ma basa na so. B pesaŋ Israɛlebi na to n wɔtɔ efuli pɔtɛana to nseŋ ta ma kasawule m barga to n sa abar.

english_verse: You people of Tyre and Sidon and you Philistines, why are you doing this? Are you trying to get even with me? I'll strike back before you know what's happened.
translation_verse: Tayaebi nɛ Sidɔnebi, nɛ menyi kama nɛ men wɔ Filisti be nsawule so na kikɛ; manɛ nɛ menyee sha kewora ma ere? Menyee sha kewora ma n tal to nna ŋko? To, nɛ k la loŋ bre, meeŋ juŋkpar n wora menyi pɔɛŋ nɛ men nya ekpa n wora ma n tal to.

english_verse: You've taken my prized possessions, including my silver and gold, and carried them off to your temples.
translation_verse: Men yuri ma shuwa nɛ gbiti nɛ ma yawu kpakpaso be asɔ n ya wɔtɔ men be agbirlambu to.

english_verse: You have dragged the people of Judah and Jerusalem from their land and sold them to the Greeks.
translation_verse: Men ta Juda be efuli so ebi nɛ Jerusalɛmebi n lar bumo gbagba be efuli so n yɔ kufɔ kufɔ n ya fa n sa Griik be efuli so ebi.

english_verse: But I'll make the people of Judah determined to come home, and what happened to them will happen to you.
translation_verse: Ama naniere, meeŋ lara bumo ashi mboŋ kama nɛ men daŋ yɛr bumo na. Kumo be kaman nɛ n wora menyi asheŋ kama nɛ men daŋ ta n wora bumo na gbagba chap.

english_verse: I'll hand over your sons and daughters to the people of Judah, and they will sell them to the Sabeans, who live far away. I, the Lord, have spoken! Judgment in Judgment Valley
translation_verse: Meeŋ shin nɛ b fa menyi alɛ gba be mbinyɛnsobi nɛ mbichesobi n sa Juda be efuli so ebi. Baaŋ fa bumo n sa Sabiaebi nɛ b wɔ kufɔ kufɔ na. Ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na e kaŋɛ na.”

english_verse: Say to the nations: “Get ready for war! Be eager to fight. Line up for battle and prepare to attack.
translation_verse: Nɛ Anebi Jowɛl kaŋɛ: “Men ta le be kubɔya ere n sa efuli pɔtɛana so ebi kikɛ fanɛ b bela ase ŋ kɔ kena. Ekama e tre mbe benapo ŋ gbargbar n shin nɛ b lar m wora shiriya.

english_verse: They are a field of ripe crops. Bring in the harvest! They are grapes piled high. Start trampling them now! If our enemy's sins were wine, every jar would overflow.
translation_verse: B kɔ amu kpakpaso ga nseŋ wora alubi a maa shu basa so. Amoso meeŋ ŋele bumo n lɛ fanɛ aboyu na nseŋ kɔr bumo to fanɛ kananɛ baa kɔr greep be asɔrso to a wora nsa a wɔtɔ kusɔ to nɛ a bee bɔlɔ a wurge na.”

english_verse: From the heart of Jerusalem the Lord roars like a lion, shaking the earth and sky. But the Lord is a fortress, a place of safety for his people Israel. God Will Bless His People
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ shi Zayɔn be kebeegboŋ na so m ponte to fanɛ buluŋ na nɛ mbe ebɔl shi Jerusalɛm to ŋ gbri m ba fanɛ bɔrɛ ka ponte na nɛ kasawule nɛ awɔlpa kikɛ gbuŋgbuŋ to. Ebɔrɛ beeŋ baa du fanɛ kebeegboŋ a kuŋ mbe basa Israɛlebi na bre.”

english_verse: On that day, fruitful vineyards will cover the mountains. And your cattle and goats that graze on the hills will produce a lot of milk. Streams in Judah will never run dry; a stream from my house will flow in Acacia Valley.
translation_verse: Loŋ be kachɛ na ndibi nɛ b kɔ amo be asɔrso a wora nsa na beeŋ wora keshi nɛ asɔbɔya e chase abee so. Juda be efuli so be mbombi malɛ maaŋ naŋ wɔlto kikɛ. Nchu beeŋ shi bɔrɛlambu na to n shile n ya kaa luri ndibi nɛ baa tre akasia nɛ a yil ketaŋɛ to na to.

english_verse: I am Amos. And I raised sheep near the town of Tekoa when Uzziah was king of Judah and Jeroboam son of Jehoash was king of Israel. Two years before the earthquake, the Lord gave me several messages about Israel,
translation_verse: Mmalaga nɛ Eemɔs nɛ e la mbolpɔkpapo nseŋ shi Tekua be kade to kaŋɛ fanɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ta n sa mo nfɛ anyɔ pɔɛŋ nɛ kasawule daŋ gbuŋgbuŋ na, nɛ jemanɛ nɛ Uziya daa la Juda be efuli so be ewura nɛ Jehɔash pibinyɛn Jeroboam malɛ daa ji Israɛl be efuli so be kuwura na nde.

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Syria for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They dragged logs with spikes over the people of Gilead.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na yɛ: “Damaskɔs be basa wora alubi n ya baŋ so. Amoso a ba naa wora shɛŋ, meeŋ gberge bumo kusoe ŋkpal b ka kɔrfɛ Giliad be basa fanɛ kananɛ gbaŋɛ bee gberge ŋgbuliŋ nyɛrɛnyɛrɛ a bri ayu na so.

english_verse: Now I will burn down the palaces and fortresses of King Hazael and of King Benhadad.
translation_verse: Meeŋ shin nɛ edɛ e ya chɔɔ lambu nɛ ewura Haziɛl pɔr na nɛ ewura Bɛnhadad be kumɔlga be mboŋ lempo na kikɛ cheche.

english_verse: I will break through the gates of Damascus. I will destroy the people of Wicked Valley and the ruler of Beth-Eden. Then the Syrians will be dragged as prisoners to Kir. I, the Lord, have spoken! Judgment on Philistia
translation_verse: Meeŋ bure kadegboŋ nɛ baa tre Damaskɔs na be mbunagboŋana na to kpachɛrkpachɛrbi nseŋ mur basa nɛ b wɔ Avɛn be kepla so na nɛ Bɛfadɛn be ejuŋkparpo na. Nseŋ shin nɛ b pɛ Siriya be basa fanɛ basa nɛ b ti ebu na n yɔ Kiir be efuli so kufɔ kufɔ.” Ma Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e malga na! Filisti be asheŋ

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Philistia for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They dragged off my people from town after town to sell them as slaves to the Edomites.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ yɛ: “Gaaza be basa wora alubi n ya baŋ so. Amoso a ba naa wora shɛŋ, meeŋ gberge bumo kusoe ŋkpal b ka ta efuli lelemu be basa ŋ ki anya n ya fa n sa Edɔmebi so.

english_verse: I will destroy the king of Ashdod and the ruler of Ashkelon. I will strike down Ekron, and that will be the end of the Philistines. I, the Lord, have spoken! Judgment on Phoenicia
translation_verse: Meeŋ mur Ashdɔd nɛ Ashkɛlɔn be nde to be bewuraana. Meeŋ jija Ekrɔn be kade cheche. Filisti be esa koŋwule gba maaŋ naaŋ ka a wɔtɔ.” Ma Enyɛnpetale na e malga na. Tayɛ be asheŋ

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Phoenicia for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They broke their treaty and dragged off my people from town after town to sell them as slaves to the Edomites.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ yɛ: “Tayɛ be basa wora alubi n ya baŋ so, amoso a ba naa wora shɛŋ, meeŋ gberge bumo kusoe. M maaŋ yige bumo kikɛ. B kplaŋ bumo be keteri be kɔnɔkoŋwule nɛ b nase n sa abar na be ŋkre so, nseŋ pɛ efuli lelemu be basa n yɔ Edɔm be kasawule so n ya fa.

english_verse: That's why I will send flames to burn down the city of Tyre along with its fortresses. Judgment on Edom
translation_verse: Amoso meeŋ shin nɛ edɛ e ba chɔɔ Tayɛ be kumɔlga be mboŋ nɛ a wɔ kumo be egbal nɛ b pɔr ŋ kulti kumo na so kikɛ cheche.” Edɔm be asheŋ

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Edom for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They killed their own relatives and were so terribly furious that they showed no mercy.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ yɛ: “Edɔm be basa wora alubi n ya baŋ so. Amoso abaanaaworashɛŋ meeŋ gberge bumo kusoe. B ju m buu bumo kurgepoana Israɛlebi so n ya mɔ bumo. B daŋ maŋ wu bumo kuwɔr ŋkpal bumo be asheŋ ka daa pɛ bumo agbo nɛ b nya agbo n wɔtɔ bumo ga so.

english_verse: Now I will send fire to wipe out the fortresses of Teman and Bozrah. Judgment on Ammon
translation_verse: Amoso meeŋ shin nɛ edɛ e ya chɔɔ Edɔm be efuli so be nde nɛ baa tre Teman na, nɛ Bozra be kumɔlga be mboŋ na kikɛ cheche.” Ammɔn be asheŋ

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Ammon for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. In Gilead they ripped open pregnant women, just to take the land.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ yɛ: “Ammɔn be basa wora alubi n ya baŋ so. Amoso abaanaaworashɛŋ meeŋ gberge bumo kusoe. M maaŋ yige bumo kikɛ. B ka daa kɔ a fin kasawule na, b daŋ baŋɛ bedampoche nɛ b daa wɔ Giliad na be epunana to nna.

english_verse: Ammon's king and leaders will be dragged away. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Baaŋ pɛ bumo be ewura nɛ mbe ekrachiana n yɔ kenyaya to ashi efuli wɔfɔ.” Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e malga na.

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Moab for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They made lime from the bones of the king of Edom.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ yɛ: “Mowab be basa be alubi damta so, meeŋ gberge bumo kusoe. B daa maŋ keni Edɔm be ewura be awibi m bɔlɔ kenishi nseŋ chɔɔ amo nɛ a ki nsunɔ.

english_verse: with its king and leaders. I, the Lord, have spoken! Judgment on Judah
translation_verse: Meeŋ mɔ Mowab be ewura nɛ mbe benimu kikɛ.” Ma Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e malga na. Juda be asheŋ

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Judah for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They have rejected my teachings and refused to obey me. They were led astray by the same false gods their ancestors worshiped.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ yɛ: “Juda be basa wora alubi n ya baŋ so, amoso abaanaaworashɛŋ meeŋ gberge bumo kusoe. B kplaŋ ma keŋini so nseŋ kini kebɛ ma mbra malɛ so. Agbir koŋwule nɛ bumo nananyɛnana daa shuŋ na e fule bumo nɛ b foe ekpa.

english_verse: Now I will send fire on Judah and destroy the fortresses of Jerusalem. Judgment on Israel
translation_verse: Ŋkpal loŋ so meeŋ shin nɛ edɛ e ba Juda be efuli so m ba chɔɔ Jerusalɛm be kumɔlga be mboŋ lempo kikɛ.” Ebɔrɛ b kasogberge ka ba Israɛl so be asheŋ

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Israel for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They sell honest people for money, and the needy are sold for the price of sandals.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ yɛ: “Israɛl be basa wora alubi n ya baŋ so, amoso abaanaaworashɛŋ meeŋ gberge bumo kusoe. Baa fa beshenteŋjipo a sɔ amansherbi nna, nsaa fa betirpo malɛ asɛbta katuŋ koŋwuleso be yawu.

english_verse: They smear the poor in the dirt and push aside those who are helpless. My holy name is dishonored, because fathers and sons sleep with the same young women.
translation_verse: B daa ŋin bepɔshipo nɛ basa nɛ b maaŋ tiŋ n chɛ bumo be amu to nna a lɛ kasawule a chichi bumo so nsaa maa ji betirpo be asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so. Ma ketre cheembi na jija nna ŋkpal mbia nɛ bumo tutoana ka bee di beche koŋwule so.

english_verse: They lie down beside altars on clothes taken as security for loans. And they drink wine in my temple, wine bought with the money they received from fines.
translation_verse: Epiŋi nɛ b ta n nase tarma n sa bumo na nɛ baa ta a nase bumo be agbir be mboŋ a dese so. Bumo be agbirlambu to nɛ baa chena a nuu nsa nɛ b sɔ ashi basa nɛ b ji bumo be akɔ na kutɔ.

english_verse: Israel, the Amorites were there when you entered Canaan. They were tall as cedars and strong as oaks. But I wiped them out— I destroyed their branches and their roots.
translation_verse: Ama ŋkpal bumo so, nɛ m mur Amɔriebi nɛ b daa wɔ nteŋ fanɛ ndibi tenteŋ nɛ baa tre Sida na, nsaa kɔ eleŋ malɛ fanɛ ndibi gboŋgboŋi lempo na. N daŋ mur bumo be ayabi nɛ achin kikɛ nna cheche.

english_verse: I had rescued you from Egypt, and for forty years I had led you through the desert. Then I gave you the land of the Amorites.
translation_verse: Ma e lara menyi ashi Ijipt be kasawule so dra dra na ŋ keta menyi n nite kiyi to nfɛ adena nseŋ sɔ Amɔriebi be kasawule n sa menyi.

english_verse: I chose some of you to be prophets and others to be Nazirites. People of Israel, you know this is true. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Ma e lara men be mbinyɛnsobi ko ŋ ki anebiana, nseŋ lara menyi b mbrantiafɔlbi ko malɛ nɛ b ki Nazarinebi. Israɛlebi, manɛ kashenteŋ nna a? Ma Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ e malga na.

english_verse: But you commanded the prophets not to speak their message, and you pressured the Nazirites into drinking wine.
translation_verse: Ama men nyaŋ Nazarinebi na nna nɛ baa nuu nsa nseŋ ju anebiana malɛ fanɛ b sa maŋ kaŋ malga abɔrɛsheŋ.

english_verse: No matter how fast you run, you won't escape. No matter how strong you are, you will lose your strength and your life.
translation_verse: Basa nɛ baa shile ga gba maaŋ tiŋ n shile n sɔ bumo be amu. Belempo beeŋ paŋ bumo be eleŋ nɛ benapo gba e mɔlga bumo be amu ŋ gben.

english_verse: Even if you are an expert with a bow and arrow, you will retreat. And you won't get away alive, not even if you run fast or ride a horse.
translation_verse: Basa nɛ b maa to ata a da gba beeŋ shile m bɛta kaman, nɛ basa nɛ baa shile ga gba e shile m mɔlga bumo be amu ŋ gben nɛ egbaŋɛdiipoana gba e dii egbaŋɛ m mɔlga bumo be amu ŋ gben.

english_verse: You may be brave and strong, but you will run away, stripped naked. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Kumo be kachɛ na, benapo lempo gba beeŋ ta bumo be akɔsɔ n lɛ nseŋ shile.” Ma Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ e malga na.

english_verse: People of Israel, I rescued you from Egypt. Now listen to my judgment against you.
translation_verse: Menyi Israɛlebi nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ lara ashi Ijipt be kasawule so dra dra na, e loto n nu kusɔ nɛ e malga ŋ gbiti menyi.

english_verse: Of all nations on earth, you are the only one I have chosen. That's why I will punish you because of your sins. The Work of a Prophet
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ yɛ: “Menyi nawule nɛ n lara ashi efuliana kikɛ so fanɛ men baa la meya, amoso nɛ meeŋ gberge menyi kusoe alegaiso ŋkpal menyi be alubi so na.” Anebi be kushuŋ be asheŋ

english_verse: Does a lion roar in the forest unless it has caught a victim? Does it growl in its den unless it is eating?
translation_verse: Fo daŋ nu buluŋ ka bee ponte kiyi to nɛ k maŋ wu kusɔbɔya a? Fo daŋ nu buluŋ fɔlbi ka wɔ kumo be edesekpa a munto nɛ k maŋ pɛ kusɔ ko a?

english_verse: How can anyone catch a bird without using a net? Does a trap spring shut unless something is caught?
translation_verse: Fo daŋ wu kejigbelɛ ka pɛ kabuibi nɛ manɛ kusɔ ko a yɛr kabuibi na kumo ase a? Fo daŋ wu kejigbelɛ ka to nɛ mannɛ kusɔ ko a tɔr kumo to a?

english_verse: Isn't the whole city frightened when the trumpet signals an attack? Isn't the Lord the one who brings disaster on a city?
translation_verse: Fo daŋ nu b ka foŋ kena to be kabel kade to nɛ kufu maŋ pɛ basa a? Fo daŋ wu jɛrbi ka ba kade to nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ maŋ nyi kumo be asheŋ a?

english_verse: Whatever the Lord God plans to do, he tells his servants, the prophets.
translation_verse: Kashenteŋto, Enyɛnpetale maa kre kusɔ ko be kewora nɛ e maŋ lara kumo ŋ ŋini mbe nyɛrbi nɛ b la anebiana na.

english_verse: Everyone is terrified when a lion roars— and ordinary people become prophets when the Lord God speaks. Samaria Is Doomed
translation_verse: Buluŋ baa ponte to, wanɛ nɛ kufu maaŋ pɛ? Enyɛnpetale na baŋ lara esa fanɛ e yili mbe katelamu to m malga wanɛ e la amodoŋwura nɛ e tiŋ ŋ kini? Samɛria be kemur be asheŋ

english_verse: Here is a message for the leaders of Philistia and Egypt— tell everyone to come together on the hills of Samaria. Let them see the injustice and the lawlessness in that city.
translation_verse: Kaŋɛ Ijipt nɛ Ashdɔd be bejuŋkparpoana na le: “Men shɛr abee nɛ a kulti Samɛria be kadegboŋ na so ŋ keni kananɛ asheŋ bee baga to nɛ kananɛ basa bee wora kusɔ nɛ baa sha ŋkpal mbra ka maŋ naa wɔtɔ so.”

english_verse: The Lord has said that they don't even know how to do right. They have become rich from violence and robbery.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ yɛ: “Koyu nɛ kebaa tintiŋ basa a sɔ bumo be asɔ nɛ basa ere bɔla so ŋ gbare asɔ m bɔlɔ ebuana. B maaŋ tiŋ n ji kashenteŋ kikɛ.”

english_verse: And so the Lord God has sworn that they will be surrounded. Enemies will break through their defenses and steal their treasures.
translation_verse: Amoso le nɛ Enyɛnpetale na kaŋɛ: “Bedoŋ beeŋ ba kulti menyi be efuli n wɔtɔ nseŋ jija men be kumɔlga be mboŋ lempo nseŋ m muu asɔ nɛ a wɔ amo to na kikɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord has promised that only a few from Samaria will escape with their lives and with some broken pieces of their beds and couches. It will be like when a shepherd rescues two leg bones and part of a sheep's ear from the jaws of a lion. The Altars at Bethel
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ yɛ: “Kananɛ buluŋ bee ji kubolpɔ nɛ mbolpɔkpapo e ya sɔ kumo be aya anyɔ nɛ kusoe n ya ŋini kubolpɔwura na, aloŋ nɛ baaŋ mɔlga Samɛriaebi nɛ b dese kedamaya be asɔ deseso so ere be basa gbrɛbi nɛ b nya kumɔlga na.”

english_verse: The Lord God All-Powerful told me to speak this message against Jacob's descendants:
translation_verse: Enyɛnpetale na yɛ: “Kaŋ kusoe n nu nfe, nseŋ kpele Israɛlebi nɛ b la Jeekɔb be kaman to ebi na kusoe.”

english_verse: When I, the Lord, punish Israel for their sins, I will destroy the altars at Bethel. Even the corners of the altar will be left in the dirt.
translation_verse: “Kachɛ nɛ meeŋ gberge Israɛl be basa kusoe ŋkpal bumo be alubi so na, nɛ meeŋ mur Bɛtɛl be kade to gba be ebɔrɛsureana. Ebɔrɛsureana na be abonfu kikɛ beeŋ bure n tɔr keshishɛrpumpuŋ to.

english_verse: I will tear down winter homes and summer homes. Houses decorated with ivory and all other mansions will be gone forever. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Meeŋ bure bumo be elaŋ nɛ baa dese to kebleŋ to nɛ amo nɛ baa dese to awo to na kikɛ. Bumo be elaŋana nɛ b ta asɔlnyii n ji kebita nɛ bumo be elaŋgboŋ kikɛ beeŋ bure. Ma Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e malga na.”

english_verse: You women of Samaria are fat cows! You mistreat and abuse the poor and needy, then you say to your husbands, “Bring us more drinks!”
translation_verse: Men nu nfe, menyi Samɛria be beche nɛ men danto durfɛ durfɛ fanɛ Bashan be efuli so be ana nɛ baa ji a moɛ ga na. Menyi e naa mɛaŋ betirpo nɛ betentaŋasepo nsaa nyaŋ menyi kulana fanɛ b baa sa menyi nsa na!

english_verse: I, the Lord God, have sworn by my own name that your time is coming. Not one of you will be left— you will be taken away by sharp hooks.
translation_verse: Le nɛ Enyɛnpetale cheembi na nase kɔnɔ ŋ kaŋɛ: “Kachako bedoŋ beeŋ ta akɔltobi ŋ gberge menyi n yɔ. Baaŋ pɛ menyi be ekama fanɛ kekɔltobi ka pɛ kɔrɔtɔ na.

english_verse: You will be dragged through holes in your city walls, and you will be thrown toward Harmon. I, the Lord, have spoken! Israel Refuses To Obey The Lord said:
translation_verse: Baaŋ gbeye menyi m bɔla men be kade be egbal na be kaba nɛ k bure na n ya lɛ kakpa nɛ baa tre Hɛɛmɔn be kaba so.” Ma Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ e malga na. Israɛl ka kini kekoya asheŋ be asheŋ

english_verse: Come to Bethel and Gilgal. Sin all you want! Offer sacrifices the next morning and bring a tenth of your crops on the third day.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpetale na yɛ: “Menyi Israɛlebi e yɔ Bɛtɛl n ya kaa wora alubi kanaŋkamaso nɛ menyee sha! Men yɔ Gilgaal gba n ya ka wora alubi ndoŋ a ta asɔbɔya a lara sarga kachipurso kikɛ nsaa lara sarga nɛ menyi be kudukudusopo nchɛ asa sa kikɛ.

english_verse: Bring offerings to show me how thankful you are. Gladly bring more offerings than I have demanded. You really love to do this. I, the Lord God, have spoken! How the Lord Warned Israel
translation_verse: Men ta men be bodobodo nɛ a kɔ yisi na m ba lara kechɔrɔ be sarga nsaa puchi ŋkpal esarga damta nɛ men bar na so ŋkpal manɛ so, loŋ nɛ menyee sha kebaa wora.

english_verse: I, the Lord, took away the food from every town and village, but still you rejected me.
translation_verse: Ma e shin nɛ akoŋ tɔr menyi be ndeana kikɛ to, ama amo nɛ amo kikɛ men kraŋ kini kebɛta m ba ma kutɔ.

english_verse: Three months before harvest, I kept back the rain. Sometimes I would let it fall on one town or field but not on another, and pastures dried up.
translation_verse: Saŋɛ so nɛ k daga men be asɔduuso ka nya bɔrɛ nɛnɛ na, nɛ mee pɛ bɔrɛ a keta. Ma e naa shin nɛ bɔrɛ bee ba. Ma alɛ e naa shin nɛ bɔrɛ bee ba kade ko to nsaa yige kuko, ŋko a ba ndɔ ko to a yige kuko nɛ k bee wɔl.

english_verse: People from two or three towns would go to a town that still had water, but it wasn't enough. Even then you rejected me. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Basa lar bumo be ndeana to n yɔ nde ko n ya kaa fin nchu nɛ b nuu ama b daa maŋ nya amo yɛlyɛla so ndoŋ. Amo nɛ amo kikɛ men kraŋ kini kebɛta m ba ŋ kutɔ.” Ma Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e malga na!

english_verse: I dried up your grain fields; your gardens and vineyards turned brown. Locusts ate your fig trees and olive orchards, but even then you rejected me. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Ma e shin nɛ afu tushiso jija menyi be adɔjibi nseŋ shin nɛ elotɔr malɛ jija menyi be ndɔana nɛ men be afeelebi nɛ baa tre greep na be ndɔana nɛ figidibi nɛ ɔlif be ndibi be ndɔana, ama amo nɛ amo kikɛ men kraŋ kini kebɛta m ba ŋ kutɔ. Ma Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e malga na!

english_verse: I did terrible things to you, just as I did to Egypt— I killed your young men in war; I let your horses be stolen, and I made your camp stink with dead bodies. Even then you rejected me. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Kulɔ lubi nɛ k bee mɔ nɛ n daŋ shin nɛ k ba Ijipt be efuli so ebi so dra dra na gbagba nɛ n shin nɛ k ba menyi alɛ gba so. Ma e mɔ men be mbifɔlbi kena to n shin nɛ b pɛ bumo be egbaŋɛ n choŋ, nɛ bubuni be efɛa sɔ menyi be echenakpa a dufɛ pumpuŋ a mɔ menyi. Ama amo nɛ amo kikɛ, men kraŋ kini kebɛ ma so.

english_verse: I destroyed many of you, just as I did the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah. You were a burning stick I rescued from the fire. But even then you rejected me. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Kananɛ m mur ndegboŋ nɛ baa tre Sodɔm nɛ Gomɔra dra dra na, nɛ m mur menyi alɛ gba be beko. Menyi bumo nɛ men nya men be amu na du fanɛ kedibi nɛ k bee chɔɔ nɛ b lara kumo edɛ to n lɛ nna. Ama amo nɛ amo kikɛ men kraŋ kini kebɛta m ba ma kutɔ. Ma Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e malga na.

english_verse: Now, Israel, I myself will deal with you. Get ready to face your God!
translation_verse: Amoso meeŋ gberge menyi Israɛlebi kusoe. Men wora shiriya a jo ma demuji.

english_verse: I created the mountains and the wind. I let humans know what I am thinking. I bring darkness at dawn and step over hills. I am the Lord God All-Powerful!
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ e to abeegboŋana nseŋ to afu. Mo e naa lara kusɔ nɛ k wɔ mbe nfɛra to a ŋini edimɛdi nsaa shin nɛ kapa bee ki kanyɛ. Mo e naa nite abeegboŋ be esoso na. Mbe ketre e la Enyɛnpetale na!

english_verse: Listen, nation of Israel, to my mournful message:
translation_verse: Israɛl be basa, men nu keeli nɛ mee shu ŋkpal menyi so ere.

english_verse: You, dearest Israel, have fallen, never to rise again— you lie deserted in your own land, with no one to help you up.
translation_verse: Ma eshapo lela Israɛl, tɔr a dese kasawule, a maŋ naŋ tiŋ nɛ e koso! Nɛ b kplaŋ mo so ashi mo gbagba be efuli so. Esa kama maŋ chɛ mo to nɛ e niŋito.

english_verse: The Lord God has warned, “From every ten soldiers only one will be left; from a thousand troops, only a hundred will survive.”
translation_verse: Enyɛnpetale na yɛ: “Israɛl be kade ko ka shuŋi benapo kagboŋ kena to, benapo kalfa nawule e bɛta m ba. Nɛ kuko malɛ shuŋi benapo kalfa kena to nɛ benapo kudu nawule bɛta m ba.”

english_verse: The Lord keeps saying, “Israel, turn back to me and you will live!
translation_verse: Le nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kra kaŋɛ Israɛl be basa: “Israɛlebi, men bɛta m ba ŋ kutɔ saŋɛ na so menyeeŋ nya ŋkpa.

english_verse: Turn back to the Lord, you descendants of Joseph, and you will live. If you don't, the Lord will attack like fire. Bethel will burn to the ground, and no one can save it.
translation_verse: Men bɛta n yɔ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kutɔ nseŋ nya ŋkpa. Men baa maŋ ba mo kutɔ, e beeŋ ta edɛ m mur menyi. Menyi Bɛtɛl be basa e naaŋ chɔɔ. Esa kama malɛ maaŋ tiŋ m mɔlga menyi kikɛ.

english_verse: You people are doomed! You twist the truth and trample on justice.
translation_verse: Menyeeŋ mur cheche, ŋkpal manɛ so menyee kilgi kashenteŋ nna a buu nsaa wɔtɔ a puni basa!

english_verse: But the Lord created the stars and put them in place. He turns darkness to dawn and daylight to darkness; he scoops up the ocean and empties it on the earth.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ e to achɛkpabi, Mo e to achɛkpabi be yiri yiri nɛ baa tre Pleeds nɛ Ɔriɔn na kikɛ. Mo e naa shin nɛ kanyɛ bee kilgi kapa, nɛ kapa malɛ bee kilgi kanyɛ. Mo e shin nɛ teku be nchuana bee ki bɔrɛ a ba kasawule so. Mbe ketre e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.

english_verse: God destroys mighty soldiers and strong fortresses. Choose Good Instead of Evil! The Lord said:
translation_verse: Mo e naa mur benapo lempo nɛ nde nɛ b pɔr egbal ŋ kulti na kikɛ.

english_verse: you abuse the poor and demand heavy taxes from them. You have built expensive homes, but you won't enjoy them; you have planted vineyards, but you will get no wine.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal men ka mɛaŋ betirpo nseŋ suge bumo be adɔjibi so, menyi alɛ gba maaŋ nya elaŋ lela nɛ men ta ajembu m pɔr na n luri to, ŋko n nya men be asɔrso nɛ baa tre greep na be yabra belbelso n nuu.

english_verse: I am the Lord, and I know your terrible sins. You cheat honest people and take bribes; you rob the poor of justice.
translation_verse: N nyi men be alubi damta nɛ menyee wora, nsaa nyi kananɛ menyee puni nsaa tɔrɔ basa lela. Menyee sɔ brɔbu nna nsaa ji betirpo durmu ashi demujikpa.

english_verse: Times are so evil that anyone with good sense will keep quiet.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal le be alubi ere so benyiashempo bee lo bumo be nnɔ nna.

english_verse: If you really want to live, you must stop doing wrong and start doing right. I, the Lord God All-Powerful, will then be on your side, just as you claim I am.
translation_verse: Men baa kɔ a fin kelela be kewora nseŋ yige alubi be kebaa wora, saŋɛ na so menyeeŋ baa kɔ ŋkpa, nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na e baa wɔ menyi kutɔ fanɛ kananɛ men kaŋɛ na.

english_verse: Choose good instead of evil! See that justice is done. Maybe I, the Lord All-Powerful, will be kind to what's left of your people. Judgment Is Coming
translation_verse: Men kishi kulubi, nsaa wora kelela. Men baa kɔ a fin asheŋ be keji nɛ amo be ekpa so ashi men be edemujikpa. Ashere Enyɛnpetale na beeŋ wu efuli ere be bekama nɛ b kraa wɔ ŋkpa to ere kuwɔr.

english_verse: This is what the Lord has sworn: Noisy crying will be heard in every town and street. Even farmers will be told to mourn for the dead, together with those who are paid to mourn.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpetale na yɛ: “Basa beeŋ baa boŋ to a shu kagbenejijaso ashi kade kikɛ be abɔrbi so. Baaŋ tre bedɔpo gba nɛ b ba ti basa nɛ b haya so n shu basa nɛ b wu be nli.

english_verse: Your vineyards will be filled with crying and weeping, because I will punish you. I, the Lord, have spoken! When the Lord Judges
translation_verse: Basa beeŋ baa boŋ to a shu ashi asɔrso nɛ baa tre greep na be ndɔana kikɛ to. Ade kikɛ malɛ beeŋ wora nna ŋkpal ma kasogberge ka bee ba menyi so so.” Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e malga na.

english_verse: You look forward to the day when the Lord comes to judge. But you are in for trouble! It won't be a time of sunshine; all will be darkness.
translation_verse: Asheŋ maaŋ nyalɛ n sa menyi nɛ menyee jo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be demujiachɛ na. Mannɛ be tɔnɔ nɛ loŋ be kachɛ na beeŋ kurge n sa menyi? Loŋ be kachɛ na beeŋ ba kaa la tentembiri nna n sa menyi, mannɛ kefulto.

english_verse: You will run from a lion, only to meet a bear. You will escape to your house, rest your hand on the wall, and be bitten by a snake.
translation_verse: Loŋ be kachɛ na beeŋ baa ka du fanɛ esa ka bee shile a ŋana buluŋ so nna nseŋ ya lar shishiri so! Ŋko esa ka ba laŋ to nɛ e ba wushi nseŋ ta mbe enɔ n deŋi egbal so nɛ kuwɔ e duŋ mo.

english_verse: The day when the Lord judges will be dark, very dark, without a ray of light. What the Lord Demands
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be demujiachɛ na, beeŋ baa la tentembiri nna mina mannɛ kefulto. Kefulto gbrɛ kama maaŋ ba wɔtɔ loŋ be kacha na.

english_verse: I, the Lord, hate and despise your religious celebrations and your times of worship.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ yɛ: “Ŋ kishi menyi be kabɔrɛshuŋ be kejigboŋana be asheŋ alegaiso.

english_verse: No more of your noisy songs! I won't listen when you play your harps.
translation_verse: Men yige men be awɔr fuloŋ be nshɛ na be keboŋ. Maa sha kenu men be ejaŋjilaŋ gba be kushu.

english_verse: Israel, for forty years you wandered in the desert, without bringing offerings or sacrifices to me.
translation_verse: Nfɛ adena kikɛ nɛ n juŋkpar menyi Israɛlebi ashi keshishɛrsawule na so dra dra na, n daŋ bishi menyi toto ŋko sarga ko a?

english_verse: Now you will have to carry the two idols you made— Sakkuth, the one you call king, and Kaiwan, the one you built in the shape of a star.
translation_verse: Ama naniere bre menyee sulɔ kegbir nɛ baa tre Sukɔf nɛ k la men be ewura na nɛ kegbir nɛ baa tre Keewan nɛ men pɔr fanɛ kechɛkpabi na a nite.

english_verse: Do you rulers in Jerusalem and in the city of Samaria feel safe and at ease? Everyone bows down to you, and you think you are better than any other nation. But you are in for trouble!
translation_verse: Asheŋ maaŋ nyalɛ n sa menyi nɛ shɛŋ shɛŋ maŋ tir menyi ashi Jerusalɛm, nɛ menyee fɛ fanɛ men nya kekuŋ ashi Samɛria be kade to ere. Asheŋ maaŋ nyalɛ n sa menyi Israɛl be efuli lempo be bunyaŋwuraana, nɛ basa bee kaa ba menyi kutɔ m ba kaa fin kechɛto na!

english_verse: You rich people lounge around on beds with ivory posts, while dining on the meat of your lambs and calves.
translation_verse: Asheŋ maaŋ nyalɛ n sa menyi nɛ menyee dese asɔchenaso tenteŋ nɛ b ta asɔlnyii m mata m mata so n ji amo kebita na to a we mbolpɔ nɛ ana fɔlbi be eblaŋ na.

english_verse: You sing foolish songs to the music of harps, and you make up new tunes, just as David used to do.
translation_verse: Kananɛ ewura Deevid ashi Jerusalɛm daa ta jaŋjilaŋ a laŋ a boŋ a wora nshɛ popɔr dra dra na, nɛ menyi alɛ gba bee sha kebaa wora.

english_verse: You drink all the wine you want and wear expensive perfume, but you don't care about the ruin of your nation.
translation_verse: Menyee nuu nsa kananɛ k par menyi nna, nsaa gbiti yawu kpakpaso be etulale, ama men kplaŋ men be efuli Israɛl nɛ k bure n loge na bre so.

english_verse: So you will be the first to be dragged off as captives; your good times will end.
translation_verse: Amoso menyi nɛ men doŋana beeŋ juŋkpar n tintiŋ n yɛr efuli pɔtɛ so kufɔ kufɔ nɛ men be ajigboŋ nɛ menyee wora nɛ kedese a wushi ere kikɛ e ba ekar.

english_verse: The Lord God All-Powerful has sworn by his own name: “You descendants of Jacob make me angry by your pride, and I hate your fortresses. And so I will surrender your city and possessions to your enemies.”
translation_verse: Le nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ewurgboŋ na kaŋɛ kenishipereso: “Israɛl be basa be kamoowu nɛ b kɔ na be asheŋ bee nu ma agbo alegaiso. Ŋ kishi bumo be nwu gboŋgboŋi nɛ b pɔr na ga. Ma alɛ beeŋ ta bumo be kadegboŋ na nɛ kusɔ kama nɛ k wɔ kumo to n sa bumo doŋana.”

english_verse: If only ten of you survive by hiding in a house you will still die.
translation_verse: Hale basa kudu gba ka kanaŋ na to, bumo alɛ gba beeŋ wu.

english_verse: As you carry out a corpse to prepare it for burial, your relative in the house will ask, “Are there others?” You will answer, “No!” Then your relative will reply, “Be quiet! Don't dare mention the name of the Lord.”
translation_verse: Esa nɛ e wu na mo kurgepo nɛ e la keeliwura na e naŋ ya lara kebuni na kowu. Kumo be kaman nɛ e bishi esa kama nɛ e ka laŋ na to le: “Fo nɛ esa ko e wɔtɔ a? Ndoŋ nna nɛ esa na e kaŋɛ le: ‘M-m!’ ” Kumo be kaman nɛ ekurgepo na e kaŋɛ le: “Men loto! Men shin nɛ an baa de kananɛ anyee ti an Nyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be ketre so.”

english_verse: At the Lord's command, houses great and small will be smashed to pieces.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na baŋ malga, elaŋgboŋana nɛ afimbiana kikɛ bee bure to nna kpachɛrkpachɛrbi.

english_verse: You celebrate the defeat of Lo-Debar and Karnaim, and you boast by saying, “We did it on our own.”
translation_verse: Menyee ji njɔŋ nna ŋkpal men ka kɔ m pɔɔ Lodiba be kade so so. Nsaa wu menyi be amu ŋkpal men ka kɔ n sɔ Karnayim so.

english_verse: The Lord God showed me that he is going to send locusts to attack your crops. It will happen after the king has already been given his share of the grain and before the rest of the grain has been harvested.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpetale e daŋ lara bɔrɛdare ere ŋ ŋini ma nseŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ e beeŋ shin nɛ elotɔr damta e ba ji menyi be adɔjibi. E yɛ saŋɛ nɛ menyee ta menyi be ayu be kachige n sa ewura na nɛ saŋɛ nɛ baa shin nɛ b teŋi ayu nɛ a ka na nɛ loŋ a wora.

english_verse: In my vision the locusts ate every crop in the land, and I said to the Lord, “Please forgive your nation. It's so weak. How can it survive?”
translation_verse: Elotɔr na ka ji kasawule ere so be adɔjibi kikɛ n loge na nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ le: “Enyɛnpetale, ta fo basa Israɛlebi be alubi m paŋ bumo! Nuso nɛ baaŋ wora n ji efute? B maŋ shibi bumo alɛ maŋ naa kɔ eleŋ.”

english_verse: Then the Lord felt sorry and answered, “I won't let it be destroyed.” A Vision of Fire
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ chɛrga mbe nfɛra nseŋ kaŋɛ le: “M maaŋ shin nɛ kusɔ nɛ fo wu ere e wora kikɛ.” Bɔrɛdare nɛ k la edɛ na be asheŋ

english_verse: The Lord showed me that he is going to send a ball of fire to burn up everything on earth, including the ocean.
translation_verse: Bɔrɛdare ere to Enyɛnpetale daŋ kaŋɛ nna fanɛ mbe demuji beeŋ ba mbe basa so, nɛ edɛ e ba chɔɔ kusɔ kama ashi kasawule ere so n ta tekugboŋ na gba n tiso.

english_verse: Again the Lord felt sorry and answered, “I won't let it be destroyed.” A Vision of a Measuring Line
translation_verse: Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ naŋ chɛrga mbe nfɛra ŋ kaŋɛ le: “Loŋ maaŋ wora kikɛ.” Efɔl nɛ b kɔ a karga egbal be keniŋi be bɔrɛdare be asheŋ
