english_verse: The Lord showed me a vision of himself standing beside a wall and holding a string with a weight tied to the end of it. The string and weight had been used to measure the straightness of the wall.
translation_verse: Ade be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ lara mo gbagba be kumu ŋ ŋini ma bɔrɛdare to. E daa yil m mata egbal nna nseŋ keta efɔl nɛ kusɔ gbɛgbɛsobi ko chɛ kumo be kɔnɔ a chul. Loŋ be efɔl na nɛ bepɔrpo bee ta asɔ kargaso a keni egbal be keniŋi.

english_verse: Then he asked, “Amos, what do you see?” “A measuring line,” I answered. The Lord said, “I'm using this measuring line to show that my people Israel don't measure up, and I won't forgive them any more.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ bishi ma le: “Eemɔs manɛ nɛ fo wu?” Nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ: “Efɔl nɛ baa ta a karga egbal be keniŋi na.” Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ: “N ta kumo nna a karga ma basa Israɛlebi fanɛ kananɛ baa karga egbal be keniŋi na. Ma alɛ maaŋ naaŋ ta m paŋ bumo kikɛ.

english_verse: Their sacred places will be destroyed, and I will send war against the nation of King Jeroboam.” Amos and Amaziah
translation_verse: Abee so be mboŋ nɛ basa daa shuŋ Ebɔrɛ na kikɛ beeŋ mur. Nɛ bumo be ebɔrɛlambuana kikɛ a ki alambure. Nɛ n shin nɛ Ewura Jeroboam be kuwurji malɛ e ba ekar.” Eemɔs nɛ Amaziya be asheŋ

english_verse: Amaziah the priest at Bethel sent this message to King Jeroboam of Israel, “Amos is plotting against you in the very heart of Israel. Our nation cannot put up with his message for very long.
translation_verse: Le be kubɔya nɛ Amaziya nɛ e la Bɛtɛl be bɔrɛmatapo na daŋ ta n sa Jeroboam nɛ e la Israɛl be ewura na. E yɛ: “Eemɔs bee kre menyi ŋkre lubi nna ashi Israɛlebi be kasawule so. Mbe mmalga gba nawule beeŋ tiŋ m mur efuli na kikɛ.”

english_verse: Here is what he is saying: ‘Jeroboam will be put to death, and the people will be taken to a foreign country.’ ”
translation_verse: Le nɛ e bee kaŋɛ: “Jeroboam beeŋ wu kena to nɛ b pɛ Israɛlebi na n tintiŋ bumo n yɔ efuli pɔtɛ ko so kufɔ kufɔ.”

english_verse: Then Amaziah told me, “Amos, take your visions and get out! Go back to Judah and earn your living there as a prophet.
translation_verse: Kede be kaman nɛ bɔrɛmatapo Amaziya kaŋɛ Eemɔs le: “Ta fo ebɔrɛdareana n shile anyi so! Bɛta n yɔ Juda be kasawule so n ya ka wora fo kenebiya be kushuŋ ndoŋ nsaa nya fo kusɔ jiso kumo to.

english_verse: Don't do any more preaching at Bethel. The king worships here at our national temple.”
translation_verse: Sa maŋ naa malga kewuŋkaŋɛ be asheŋ kikɛ ashi Bɛtɛl ŋkpal manɛ so ndoŋ nɛ efuli ere so kikɛ be nshɛrbu wɔ, nɛ bewura kikɛ bee shɛr kumo to.”

english_verse: I answered: I'm not a prophet! And I wasn't trained to be a prophet. I am a shepherd, and I take care of fig trees.
translation_verse: Nɛ Eemɔs malɛ kaŋɛ Amaziya le: “Ma ere maŋ la anebi, ŋko anebi pibi. N la mbolpɔkpapo nna nsaa keni efigidibi be ndɔ so.”

english_verse: But the Lord told me to leave my herds and preach to the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e lara ma ashi mbolpɔ be kebaa kpa be kushuŋ to ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ m baa malga mbe asheŋ a sa mbe basa Israɛlebi.

english_verse: And here you are, telling me not to preach!
translation_verse: Loto naniere n nu kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ bee kaŋɛ.

english_verse: Now, listen to what the Lord says about you: Your wife will become a prostitute in the city, your sons and daughters will be killed in war, and your land will be divided among others. You will die in a country of foreigners, and the people of Israel will be dragged from their homeland.
translation_verse: Kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ bee kaŋɛ fo Amaziya nde: “Fo eche beeŋ ki sakaleche ashi kade ere to nɛ b mɔ fo mbia kikɛ kena to. Baaŋ karga fo kasawule m barga kumo to n sa abar, nɛ fo gbagba malɛ e wu efuli pɔtɛ so. Nɛ b tintiŋ Israɛl be basa malɛ n yɔ efuli pɔtɛana so kufɔ kufɔ.” Kumo be kaman nɛ Eemɔs yige mo nseŋ yɔ.

english_verse: The Lord God showed me a basket of ripe fruit
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpetale na naŋ shin nɛ ŋ ku bɔrɛdare n wu asɔrso belso kelantaŋɛ be bɔlɔ,

english_verse: and asked, “Amos, what do you see?” “A basket of ripe fruit,” I replied. Then he said, “This is the end for my people Israel. I won't forgive them again.
translation_verse: nɛ e bishi ma le: “Eemɔs manɛ nɛ fo wu?” Nɛ n yɛ: “Asɔrso belso kelantaŋɛ be bɔlɔ nɛ n wu.” Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ naŋ kaŋɛ ma le: “Kananɛ asɔrso ere bel ere aloŋ nɛ ma basa Israɛlebi be ekar fo. M maaŋ ta bumo be alubi m paŋ bumo kikɛ.”

english_verse: Instead of singing in the temple, they will cry and weep. Dead bodies will be everywhere. So keep silent! I, the Lord, have spoken!” Israel Is Doomed The Lord said:
translation_verse: Enyɛnpetale yɛ: “Nshɛ nɛ baaŋ ba boŋ bɔrɛlambu to na beeŋ kilgi kushu. Bubuni beeŋ dese kaplɛkama nɛ kakpa kikɛ e wora shruum.” Israɛl be kemur be asheŋ

english_verse: You people crush those in need and wipe out the poor.
translation_verse: Menyi nɛ menyee ŋin betentaŋasepo nɛ efuli ere so be betirpo a lɛ a chichi so na e nu nfe.

english_verse: You say to yourselves, “How much longer before the end of the New Moon Festival? When will the Sabbath be over? Our wheat is ready, and we want to sell it now. We can't wait to cheat and charge high prices for the grain we sell. We will use dishonest scales
translation_verse: Menyi e naa kaŋɛ men be amu le na: “Saŋɛ mo nɛ kufɔl popɔr ere beeŋ wu nɛ an ya fa anyi be ayu. Saŋɛ mo nɛ kewushiachɛ na beeŋ choŋ nɛ an naaŋ fara a fa asɔ yawu kpakpaso nsaa puni a ta ekurwawurbi a karga asɔ?

english_verse: and mix dust in the grain. Those who are needy and poor don't have any money. We will make them our slaves for the price of a pair of sandals.”
translation_verse: Saŋɛ mo nɛ anyeeŋ baa ta amimi a wea ayu to a fa yawu kpakpaso nsaa tɔ betentaŋasepo nɛ betirpo kesebeta be yawu ŋ ki anyi be anya.”

english_verse: I, the Lord, won't forget any of this, though you take great pride in your ancestor Jacob.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe nɛ e la Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na bɔ ntaŋ ŋ kaŋɛ le: “M maaŋ teŋ bumo be asheŋ lubi nɛ b wora na kikɛ so.

english_verse: On that day, I, the Lord God, will make the sun go down at noon, and I will turn daylight into darkness.
translation_verse: Loŋ be kachɛ na, ma Enyɛnpetale beeŋ shin nɛ epeŋi a tɔr kapaso nɛ kanyɛ e biri kapiidi. Ma Enyɛnpetale na e malga na.

english_verse: Your festivals and joyful singing will turn into sorrow. You will wear sackcloth and shave your heads, as you would at the death of your only son. It will be a horrible day.
translation_verse: Meeŋ shin nɛ men be kejigboŋana e ki nli be kebaa shu nɛ menyi be kagbenefuli malɛ be nshɛ e ki kagbenejijaso be kushu. Meeŋ shin nɛ men she men be emin nseŋ buu kagbenejijaso be asɔbuuso a du fanɛ esa nɛ mbe kebia koŋwule nɛ e kɔ wu ŋ ka mo na. Loŋ be kachɛ na beeŋ baa la kachɛ lubi ga.

english_verse: You will search everywhere— from north to south, from east to west. You will go all over the earth, seeking a message from me, the Lord. But you won't find one.
translation_verse: Basa beeŋ shi kelargato be esoso be kaba so ŋ kilgi to n fin Ebɔrɛ be kamalga n ya fo epeŋilarkpa be kaba so. Baaŋ yɛla kenishi to n yɔ kaplɛkama n ya fin Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be kamalga na, bumo alɛ maaŋ wu kumo.

english_verse: You made promises to the goddess Ashimah at Samaria; you made vows to other gods at the shrines of Dan and Beersheba. So now you will fall and never get up.
translation_verse: Bekama nɛ baa bɔ agbir nɛ a wɔ Samɛria na nɛ kegbir nɛ k wɔ Dan na ŋko kegbir nɛ k wɔ Bɛshiba na, beeŋ tɔr a maaŋ naaŋ koso kikɛ.”

english_verse: I saw a vision of the Lord standing by the temple altar, and he said, “Shake the columns until the tops fall loose, and the doorposts crumble. Then make the pieces fall on the people below. I will take a sword and kill anyone who escapes.
translation_verse: N wu Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ka yil bɔrɛsure na ase ashi bɔrɛlambu na to nseŋ kaŋɛ le: “Gbuŋgbuŋ bɔrɛlambu na be eshabɔrɛ nɛ a sɔ kumo to ŋ keta na eleŋso nɛ kumo be esoso e bure n tɔr basa na be amu so. Meeŋ mɔ bumo be bumo nɛ b ka na malɛ kena to. Bumo be ekama maaŋ tiŋ n shile ŋ ŋana ma so.

english_verse: “If they dig deep into the earth or climb to the sky, I'll reach out and get them.
translation_verse: Hale b kur kemaŋ n luri to gba meeŋ gberge bumo n lar. B dii esoso n yɔ awɔlpa so gba, meeŋ gberge bumo m ba kaseto.

english_verse: If they escape to the peaks of Mount Carmel, I'll search and find them. And if they hide from me at the bottom of the ocean, I'll command a sea monster to bite them.
translation_verse: Hale b ŋana kebeegboŋ nɛ baa tre Kamɛl na be esoso gba, meeŋ fin bumo nseŋ pɛ bumo. Nɛ b ŋana tekugboŋ na be kaseto gba, meeŋ shin nɛ ebontojewu e duŋ bumo.

english_verse: I'll send a sword to kill them, wherever their enemies drag them off as captives. I'm determined to hurt them, not to help them.” His Name Is the Lord
translation_verse: Nɛ fanɛ bumo doŋana pɛ bumo ŋ ki anya n yɔ efuli pɔtɛ so kufɔ kufɔ gba, meeŋ shin nɛ b mɔ bumo ndoŋ. Mee shin nna nɛ m mur bumo, mannɛ kechɛ bumo to bre.”

english_verse: When the Lord God All-Powerful touches the earth, it melts, and its people mourn. God makes the earth rise and then fall, just like the Nile River.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpetale Ewurgboŋ baaŋ beta kasawule ere, k bee ŋalga nna, nɛ bekama nɛ b wɔ kumo so kikɛ, e baa shu nli. E bee shin nna nɛ kasawule bee dii a gbelge fanɛ kananɛ lɔrgboŋ nɛ baa tre Nail na bee dii a gbelge na ashi Ijipt be efuli so na.

english_verse: He built his palace in the heavens and let its foundations rest on the earth. He scoops up the ocean and empties it on the earth. His name is the Lord. The Lord Is God
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ pɔr mbe kowu nna ashi ebɔrɛso nɛ kasawule ere malɛ la kumo be gbaltɔlase. E bee gbargbar etekuana be nchu nna, a chulgi a wurge kasawule ere so. Mbe ketre e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na!

english_verse: Israel, I am the Lord God, and the Ethiopians are no less important to me than you are. I brought you out of Egypt, but I also brought the Philistines from Crete and the Arameans from Kir.
translation_verse: Le nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee kaŋɛ: “Kananɛ m baa fɛ menyi Israɛl be basa be asheŋ na, loŋ koŋwule na nɛ mee fɛ Itiopia be basa gba be asheŋ. Mannɛ ma e lara Filistiebi na ashi Kreet be kasawule nɛ nchu kulti n wɔtɔ na, nɛ Siriyaebi ashi Kiir fanɛ kananɛ n lara menyi ashi Ijipt be efuli so dra dra na a?

english_verse: My eyes have seen what a sinful nation you are, and I'll wipe you out. But I will leave a few of Jacob's descendants. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Ma Enyɛnpetale na bee wu kulubi nɛ Israɛl be efuli na bee wora, ma alɛ beeŋ mur bumo ashi kasawule ere so. Ama ŋkpal bumo nananyɛn Jeekɔb so meeŋ yige bumo be basa gbrɛbi.

english_verse: At my command, all of you will be sifted like grain. Israelites who remain faithful will be scattered among the nations. And the others will be trapped like trash in a sifter.
translation_verse: Meeŋ ponte nɛ b gbaŋgbaŋ Israɛl be basa fanɛ kananɛ baa gbaŋgbaŋ ayunyifu gbaŋgbande to a lara eyurpi amo to na. Meeŋ shin nɛ bumo be bumo nɛ baa ji kashenteŋ a sa ma e pesaŋ to n yɔ efuli pɔtɛana so.

english_verse: Some of you are evil, and you deny that you will ever get caught. But you will be killed. The Lord's Promise to Israel
translation_verse: Baaŋ mɔ bumo be bumo nɛ b la belubiworapo n wea ma basa to na kena to, fɔŋfɔŋ bumo nɛ baa kaŋɛ le na: ‘Ebɔrɛ maaŋ shin nɛ tɔrɔ kikɛ e ba anyi so.’ ” Ebɔrɛ ka beeŋ naŋ lɔŋɛ Israɛl n yili kumo be eyilikpa be asheŋ

english_verse: In the future, I will rebuild David's fallen kingdom. I will build it from its ruins and set it up again, just as it used to be.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ yɛ: “Kachako bee ba nɛ n naŋ lɔŋɛ Deevid be kuwurji nɛ k ki fanɛ kelambure na m pɔr n yili nɛnɛ. Meeŋ naŋ lɔŋɛ kumo be egbalana m pɔr fanɛ kananɛ k daa du dra na.

english_verse: Then you will capture Edom and the other nations that are mine. I, the Lord, have spoken, and my words will come true.
translation_verse: Saŋɛ na so menyi Israɛlebi na beeŋ kɔ n sɔ Edɔm be nsawule nɛ efuliana nɛ a daa la meya na kikɛ.” Ma Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ meeŋ shin nɛ loŋ e wora na e malga na.

english_verse: You will have such a harvest that you won't be able to bring in all of your wheat before plowing time. You will have grapes left over from season to season; your fruitful vineyards will cover the mountains.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na yɛ: “Saŋko beeŋ ba nɛ menyi be ayu e wora a chɔ kananɛ menyeeŋ tiŋ n teŋi amo, nɛ menyi be asɔrso nɛ baa tre greep na e sɔr a chɔ kananɛ menyeeŋ tiŋ n wora amo be nsa. Nɛ menyi be greep be asɔrso be adɔ e sɔ abeeana so kikɛ.

english_verse: I'll plant your roots deep in the land I have given you, and you won't ever be uprooted again. I, the Lord God, have spoken!
translation_verse: Meeŋ naŋ bɛta ma basa m ba kasawule nɛ n ta n sa bumo na so, nɛ bumo doŋana maaŋ naŋ tiŋ m pɔɔ bumo so kikɛ.” Ma Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e malga na.

english_verse: The Lord God gave Obadiah a message about Edom, and this is what we heard: “I, the Lord, have sent a messenger with orders for the nations to attack Edom.”
translation_verse: Kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ewurgboŋ na kaŋɛ a laŋɛ Edɔm be kaplɛa so nɛ an nu nde: “Men koso n shin nɛ an yɔ nɛ anyi nɛ Edɔmebi e ya kɔ abar kena.”

english_verse: The Lord said to Edom: I will make you the weakest and most despised nation.
translation_verse: Le nɛ Enyɛnpetale na kaŋɛ Edɔm: “Meeŋ shin nɛ fo ki epɔshipo nɛ ekama nyam e keni fo jiga.

english_verse: Everything you treasure most will be taken from you.
translation_verse: Menyi ere Isɔɔ be kanaŋ to ebi, baaŋ sensaŋ menyi be asɔ kikɛ n yɔ.

english_verse: Your allies can't be trusted. They will force you out of your own country. And your best friends will trick and trap you, even before you know it.
translation_verse: Men doŋana beeŋ tintiŋ menyi n yɔ efuli ere so be ekarso cheche, nɛ men teriana e fule menyi nseŋ pɔɔ menyi so. Bumo nɛ baa tu menyi a ji menyi be ajibi naniere beeŋ sho menyi ajigbelɛ, ama menyi alɛ maaŋ pin.”

english_verse: Warriors from the city of Teman will be terrified, and you descendants of Esau will be wiped out. The Lord Condemns Edom's Cruelty
translation_verse: O, Teman be benakɔpo, kufu beeŋ pɛ menyi tain, baaŋ ku ekama nɛ e wɔ lsɔɔ be abee so na to.

english_verse: You were cruel to your relatives, the descendants of Jacob. Now you will be destroyed, disgraced forever.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal menyi Edɔmebi ka diewu n ta kumu kpakpaso n shuŋ men kurgepoana Jeekɔb be kanaŋ to ebi kushuŋ lubi na so, anishinyɔr beeŋ ba menyi so. Menyi alɛ beeŋ mur kuraa.

english_verse: Why did you celebrate when such a dreadful disaster struck your relatives? Why were you so pleased when everyone in Judah was suffering?
translation_verse: A daa maŋ daga fanɛ men baa yil a mushe men niopibiana Jeekɔb be kanaŋ to ebi saŋɛ nɛ tɔrɔ nɛ kachɛ lubi tu bumo ashi bumo be kemur be saŋɛ so na.

english_verse: They are my people, and you were cruel to them. You went through their towns, sneering and stealing whatever was left.
translation_verse: A daa maŋ daga fanɛ men luri ma basa be kade to n ya kaa mushe bumo ashi bumo be etɔrɔ be kaplɛa so nseŋ suge bumo asɔ kachɛ lubi achɛ na.

english_verse: The day is coming when I, the Lord, will judge the nations. And, Edom, you will pay in full for what you have done.
translation_verse: Men nu nfe, kachɛ nɛ ma ere Enyɛnpetale na beeŋ ji efuli kama demu na taga to nna na. Asɔ nɛ menyi Edɔmebi wora ere beeŋ ba menyi alɛ gba so loŋ chap. Menyeeŋ teŋi kusɔ nɛ men du ere gbagba.

english_verse: I forced the people of Judah to drink the wine of my anger on my sacred mountain. Soon the neighboring nations must drink their fill— then vanish without a trace. Victory for Israel
translation_verse: Ma basa nɛ b tase ma kebee cheembi so ashi Jerusalɛm na ka nya kasogberge ere bre meeŋ gberge efuli pɔtɛana kikɛ gba kusoe a chɔ loŋ. Baaŋ nya kasoegberge a chɔ Jerusalɛm peya na, hale nɛ k yɛr bumo kemur to cheche. Israɛl ka beeŋ kɔ m pɔɔ so be asheŋ

english_verse: The Lord's people who escape will go to Mount Zion, and it will be holy. Then Jacob's descendants will capture the land of those who took their land.
translation_verse: Kumɔlga beeŋ baa wɔ Zayɔn be kebee bre so, nɛ basa ko e nya ekpa n shile ŋ ŋana. Ndoŋ beeŋ baa la kakpa cheembi nsaa la Jeekɔb be kanaŋ to be kasawule.

english_verse: The people of Israel who live in the Southern Desert will take the land of Edom. Those who live in the hills will capture Philistia, Ephraim, and Samaria. And the tribe of Benjamin will conquer Gilead.
translation_verse: Keshishɛrsawule so ebi na beeŋ ba sɔ menyi lsɔɔ be kanaŋ to ebi be abeesawule a wɔtɔ, nɛ basa nɛ b wɔ abee be kaseto na malɛ e ba Filistiebi be nsawule ŋ ki bumo peya. Israɛlebi beeŋ ba sɔ Efreimebi nɛ Samɛriaebi be nsawule, nɛ Bɛnjaminebi malɛ e ta Gilead.

english_verse: Those who return from captivity will control Phoenicia as far as Zarephath. Captives from Jerusalem who were taken to Sepharad will capture the towns of the Southern Desert.
translation_verse: Israɛl be benapo nɛ b pɛ n yɔ Keenan na beeŋ bɛta m ba kɔ n sɔ nsawule loŋ hale n ya fo Zarefat. Jerusalɛm be benapo nɛ b wɔ Sefarad naniere malɛ beeŋ ba kɔ n sɔ keshishɛrsawule be ndeana.

english_verse: Those the Lord has saved will live on Mount Zion and rule over Edom. Then the kingdom will belong to the Lord.
translation_verse: Zayɔn to be bekɔmpɔɔsopoana beeŋ ya kɔ Edɔm m pɔɔ kumo so nsaa ji kuwura kumo so. Enyɛnpetale malɛ gbagba e naaŋ ki bumo be ewura.”

english_verse: One day the Lord told Jonah, the son of Amittai,
translation_verse: Kachako nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ Amitai pibinyɛn Jona le:

english_verse: to go to the great city of Nineveh and say to the people, “The Lord has seen your terrible sins. You are doomed!”
translation_verse: “Yɔ kadegboŋ nɛ baa tre Ninɛve na to n ya fiɛ ndoŋebi so ŋ kaŋɛ bumo fanɛ n wu bumo be asheŋ lubi nɛ baa wora na kikɛ. Amoso asheŋ maaŋ nyalɛ n sa bumo kikɛ.”

english_verse: Instead, Jonah ran from the Lord. He went to the seaport of Joppa and found a ship that was going to Spain. So he paid his fare, then got on the ship and sailed away to escape.
translation_verse: Nɛ Jona kini nseŋ shile Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na. E daŋ yɔ kade ko nɛ baa tre Jɔpa nna n ya luri nchu so be kuloŋgboŋ ko nɛ k bee yɔ kadegboŋ ko nɛ baa tre Tashish ashi Speen be efuli so na to.

english_verse: But the Lord made a strong wind blow, and such a bad storm came up that the ship was about to be broken to pieces.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ afugboŋ ko koso teku na so. Nɛ bɔrɛchu nɛ afu wea abar to m ber kuloŋgboŋ nɛ Jona daa wɔ kumo to na so, nɛ k bee shin nɛ k baŋɛ to m mur nchu na to.

english_verse: The sailors were frightened, and they all started praying to their gods. They even threw the ship's cargo overboard to make the ship lighter. All this time, Jonah was down below deck, sound asleep.
translation_verse: Nɛ kufu pɛ kuloŋgboŋ na be befarpo na kikɛ ga nɛ b fara a shu a tre bumo be agbirana. Ndoŋ nna nɛ b lara kuloŋgboŋ na to be esulɔ n lɛ teku na to saŋɛ na so kumo be egbɛ beeŋ duga so ŋ ka ŋ kukwe. Jemanɛ ere so kikɛ nɛ Jona bre wɔ kuloŋgboŋ na be kaseto be ebu ko to a di kenishipereso.

english_verse: The ship's captain went to him and said, “How can you sleep at a time like this? Get up and pray to your God! Maybe he will have pity on us and keep us from drowning.”
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ kuloŋgboŋ na be befarpo na be enimu yɔ Jona kutɔ n ya kaŋɛ mo le: “Fo ere dese a di nna a? Koso a shu a tre fo Ebɔrɛ. Ashere e beeŋ mɔlga anyi, nɛ an sa maŋ mur.”

english_verse: Finally, the sailors got together and said, “Let's ask our gods to show us who caused all this trouble.” It turned out to be Jonah.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ befarpo na kikɛ kaŋɛ a bar le: “Men shin nɛ an to beri n fin esa nɛ tɔrɔ ere shi mbe kumu so m ba anyi so ere.” B ka to beri na nɛ k tɔr Jona so.

english_verse: They started asking him, “Are you the one who brought all this trouble on us? What business are you in? Where do you come from? What is your country? Who are your people?”
translation_verse: Nɛ b bishi mo le: “Kaŋɛ anyi, fo e shin nɛ le be tɔrɔ ere ba anyi so a? Manɛ be kushuŋ nɛ fee shuŋ? Nnɛ nɛ fo shi? Efuli mo so nɛ fo shi? Kanaŋ mo to be esa e la fo?”

english_verse: Jonah answered, “I'm a Hebrew, and I worship the Lord God of heaven, who made the sea and the dry land.”
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Jona kaŋɛ le: “N la Hibruw be esa nna. Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ e wɔ ebɔrɛso nseŋ to teku nɛ kasawule kikɛ na nɛ mee shuŋ.”

english_verse: When the sailors heard this, they were frightened, because Jonah had already told them he was running from the Lord. Then they said, “Do you know what you have done?”
translation_verse: B ka nu loŋ nɛ kufu pɛ bumo ga, ŋkpal manɛ so, Jona teŋ kaŋɛ bumo fanɛ e bee shile Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nna.

english_verse: The storm kept getting worse, until finally the sailors asked him, “What should we do with you to make the sea calm down?”
translation_verse: Teku na so be afu na daŋ baa wora eleŋ nna a ti so. Ndoŋ nna nɛ b bishi Jona le: “Nuso nɛ anyeeŋ wora fo nɛ teku ere e wora shruum n sa anyi?”

english_verse: Jonah told them, “Throw me into the sea, and it will calm down. I'm the cause of this terrible storm.”
translation_verse: Nɛ Jona kaŋɛ: “Men ta ma n lɛ teku na to, aloŋ beeŋ shin nɛ k wora shruum. M baa nyi geeŋ fanɛ ŋ ka wora n jija so nɛ le be afugboŋ lubi ere tu anyi na.”

english_verse: So they prayed to the Lord, “Please don't let us drown for taking this man's life. Don't hold us guilty for killing an innocent man. All of this happened because you wanted it to.”
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ b kule Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ŋ kaŋɛ le: “O, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, jande, sa maŋ shin nɛ an wu ŋkpal anyi ka bee shin nɛ an lara kanyɛn ere be ŋkpa so. Sa maŋ kaŋ ji anyi demu ŋkpal an ka mɔ esa nɛ e maŋ kɔ kulubi so. Ŋkpal manɛ so, fo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e naa wora kusɔ kikɛ fo keparso.”

english_verse: Then they threw Jonah overboard, and the sea calmed down.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ b lara Jona n lɛ teku na to, nɛ k wora shruum epul na to.

english_verse: The sailors were so terrified that they offered a sacrifice to the Lord and made all kinds of promises.
translation_verse: Le be kesheŋ ere daŋ shin nɛ befarpo na ŋana Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na alegaiso nna. Kumo be kaman nɛ b lara sarga nseŋ nase nnɔ n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.

english_verse: The Lord sent a big fish to swallow Jonah, and Jonah was inside the fish for three days and three nights.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ kɔrɔtɔgboŋ ko ba ta Jona m min, nɛ e ji nchɛ asa nɛ nnyɛ asa ashi kɔrɔtɔgboŋ na be epunto.

english_verse: From inside the fish, Jonah prayed to the Lord his God:
translation_verse: Jona wɔ kɔrɔtɔ na be epunto nna nseŋ kule mbe Ebɔrɛ nɛ e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na le:

english_verse: When I was in trouble, Lord, I prayed to you, and you listened to me. From deep in the world of the dead, I begged for your help, and you answered my prayer.
translation_verse: “Ma tɔrɔ to nɛ n shu n tre fo, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na, nɛ e nu ma kekule. N wɔ nchaŋ chiŋgeliŋ to nna nseŋ kule fo fanɛ fo chɛ ma to, nɛ fo alɛ nu ma kekule.

english_verse: You threw me down to the bottom of the sea. The water was churning all around; I was completely covered by your mighty waves.
translation_verse: Fo kpa ma nna n lɛ Teku be kechimbi be kaseto, nɛ nchu muni ma kikɛ so nsaa kaa atili ma kumu so.

english_verse: I thought I was swept away from your sight, never again to see your holy temple.
translation_verse: Nɛ n fɛ fanɛ fo ju ma fo anishito nna, nɛ m maaŋ naŋ wu fo bɔrɛlambu cheembi na kenishiso kikɛ.

english_verse: I was almost drowned by the swirling waters that surrounded me. Seaweed had wrapped around my head.
translation_verse: Nchu na daŋ muni ma nna a sha kemur ma nɛ teku to be afitiri kre ma kumu kikɛ.

english_verse: I had sunk down deep below the mountains beneath the sea. I knew that forever, I would be a prisoner there. But, you, Lord God, rescued me from that pit.
translation_verse: Ŋ ka daŋ muni n yɔ kasawule be kechimbi to na, n daŋ fɛ fanɛ ma ŋkpa be ekar fo nna na. Ama fo, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, nɛ fo la ma Ebɔrɛ na lara ma kemaŋ chiŋgeliŋ na to m bar ma ŋkpa to.

english_verse: When my life was slipping away, I remembered you— and in your holy temple you heard my prayer.
translation_verse: Ma ŋkpa kaa bee fo ekar na nɛ n nyiŋi fo, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na, nseŋ kule fo nɛ fo nu ma kekule ashi fo bɔrɛlambu cheembi na to.

english_verse: All who worship worthless idols turn from the God who offers them mercy.
translation_verse: Basa nɛ baa shuŋ agbir paŋ Ebɔrɛ be kuwɔrwu.

english_verse: But with shouts of praise, I will offer a sacrifice to you, my Lord. I will keep my promise, because you are the one with power to save.
translation_verse: Ama ma ere beeŋ boŋ nshɛ n di fo, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na, epaŋ nseŋ lara sarga n sa fo. Meeŋ wora m bɔlɔ ma kɔnɔ naseso so, ŋkpal manɛ so, fo e kɔ eleŋ a tiŋ a mɔlga.”

english_verse: The Lord commanded the fish to vomit up Jonah on the shore. And it did.
translation_verse: Ade be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ kɔrɔtɔ na ya gbu Jona n nase kedeŋi so ashi teku na be ekarso.

english_verse: Once again the Lord told Jonah
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ naŋ kaŋɛ Jona kela nyɔsopo le:

english_verse: to go to that great city of Nineveh and preach his message of doom.
translation_verse: “Yɔ kadegboŋ nɛ baa tre Ninɛve na to n ya bɔ kubɔya nɛ n sa fo na n sa ndoŋebi.”

english_verse: Jonah obeyed the Lord and went to Nineveh. The city was so big that it took three days just to walk through it.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Jona nu Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be kamalga na nseŋ yɔ Ninɛve. Ninɛve daa la kadegboŋ nɛ esa beeŋ ta nchɛ asa nna n nite kumo be kaba ko n ya fo kaba ko.

english_verse: After walking for a day, Jonah warned the people, “Forty days from now, Nineveh will be destroyed!”
translation_verse: Jona ka luri kade na to na nɛ e nite kachɛ koŋwule m bɔ le be kubɔya. E yɛ: “Yili kabre n ya fo nchɛ adena be kefɛato, Ninɛve beeŋ mur.”

english_verse: They believed God's message and set a time when they would go without eating to show their sorrow. Then everyone in the city, no matter who they were, dressed in sackcloth.
translation_verse: Ninɛveebi na ka nu kubɔya na nɛ b yirda Ebɔrɛ nseŋ yili kumo fanɛ ekama e kishi. Ndoŋ nna nɛ benimu nɛ mbia kikɛ ta kagbenejijaso be asɔbuuso m buu a ŋini fanɛ bumo be ŋgbene jija bumo.

english_verse: When the king of Nineveh heard what was happening, he also dressed in sackcloth; he left the royal palace and sat in dust.
translation_verse: Kubɔya na ka tu Ninɛve be ewura gba, nɛ e koso mbe kuwurputi so m bugi mbe kuwurpiŋi n nase, nseŋ ta kagbenejijaso be asɔbuuso m buu n ya chena nsunɔ to.

english_verse: When God saw that the people had stopped doing evil things, he had pity and did not destroy them as he had planned.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ ka wu kusɔ nɛ b wora na nɛ kananɛ b yige bumo be asheŋ lubi nɛ kebaawɔtɔ lubi na, nɛ e wu bumo kuwɔr nsaa maŋ naŋ shin nɛ b mur fanɛ kananɛ e daŋ yili na.

english_verse: So he prayed: Our Lord, I knew from the very beginning that you wouldn't destroy Nineveh. That's why I left my own country and headed for Spain. You are a kind and merciful God, and you are very patient. You always show love, and you don't like to punish anyone.
translation_verse: Nseŋ kule Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ŋ kaŋɛ le: “O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, mannɛ le nɛ n daŋ kaŋɛ saŋɛ nɛ n kra wɔ epe na a? Loŋ so nɛ n nya manaŋ n shile n yɔ Tarshish na. N nyi fo ka la kasha nɛ kuwɔrwu be Ebɔrɛ, nsaa maa nya agbo manaŋ manaŋ. Fee wora kelela nna saŋkama nseŋ wora shiriya nɛ fo ta alubi m paŋ. Fo alɛ maa kuse a bar kasogberge basa so.

english_verse: Now let me die! I'd be better off dead.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, shin nɛ n wu. Ŋ ka wu bɔ, ŋ ka kraa wɔ ŋkpa to.”

english_verse: The Lord replied, “What right do you have to be angry?”
translation_verse: Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ: “Nuso be ekpa nɛ fo kɔ nɛ fo nya agbo?”

english_verse: Jonah then left through the east gate of the city and made a shelter to protect himself from the sun. He sat under the shelter, waiting to see what would happen to Nineveh.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ Jona lar n ya chena kade na be ekarso ashi epeŋilarkpa be kaba so. E daŋ yuu kubuubi ko nna n chena kumo be kiyoyul to a jo nsaa keni kusɔ nɛ k beeŋ wora kade na to ebi.

english_verse: The Lord made a vine grow up to shade Jonah's head and protect him from the sun. Jonah was very happy to have the vine,
translation_verse: Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ kefeelebi ko kɔr ndoŋ m purge a wora kiyoyul m buu Jona so, saŋɛ na so, epeŋi maa naa ŋmɛa mo ga. Kefeelebi na be kiyoyul na daŋ shin nna nɛ Jona be kagbene fuli mo ga.

english_verse: but early the next morning the Lord sent a worm to chew on the vine, and the vine dried up.
translation_verse: Ama kumo be ŋklade kachipurdidi nɛ Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ kushushombi gboŋgboŋi ko ba ji kefeelebi na nɛ k bolo to.

english_verse: During the day the Lord sent a scorching wind, and the sun beat down on Jonah's head, making him feel faint. Jonah was ready to die, and he shouted, “I wish I were dead!”
translation_verse: Epeŋi ka lar nɛ Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ afu tushiso be kebembeŋ shi epeŋilarkpa m ber m ba Jona so nɛ e bɛlɛ. Ndoŋ nna nɛ e kaŋɛ le: “Ŋ ka wu bɔ ŋ ka kraa wɔ ŋkpa to.”

english_verse: But the Lord asked, “Jonah, do you have the right to be angry about the vine?” “Yes, I do,” he answered, “and I'm angry enough to die.”
translation_verse: Nɛ Ebɔrɛ bishi mo le: “Manɛ so nɛ fo kpal kefeelebi na so a nya agbo?” Nɛ Jona kaŋɛ: “Ŋ kpal kumo so n nya agbo, hale a sha fanɛ n wu gba nna na.”

english_verse: But the Lord said: You are concerned about a vine that you did not plant or take care of, a vine that grew up in one night and died the next.
translation_verse: Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ le: “Kefeelebi nɛ fo maŋ duu ŋko ŋ keni so nɛ k daŋ be asheŋ e tir fo na. Kachɛ koŋwule nɛ kumo gbagba ta ŋ kɔr n daŋ m purge nseŋ naŋ wu kachɛ koŋwule to gba.

english_verse: Mountains will melt beneath his feet like wax beside a fire. Valleys will vanish like water rushing down a ravine.
translation_verse: Abeegboŋ na beeŋ ŋalga ashi mbe aya to fanɛ ŋku bumbuŋ ka luri edɛ to ŋ ŋalga a shile a yɔ abee na be afito fanɛ nchu ka shi kebee so a chulgi a wurge kasawule so na.

english_verse: Samaria's idols will be smashed, and the wages of temple prostitutes will be destroyed by fire. Silver and gold from those idols will then be used by foreigners as payment for prostitutes. Judah Is Doomed
translation_verse: Samɛria to be agbirana kikɛ beeŋ bure to ŋ ki le burburbi. Nɛ edɛ e chɔɔ asɔ kama nɛ agbirlambu to be esakale kɔ na kikɛ. Efuli pɔtɛana so ebi beeŋ sulɔ kumo be agbirana be shuwa nɛ gbiti n ya sa esakale pɔtɛana mboŋ ko.”

english_verse: Because of this tragedy, I go barefoot and naked. My crying and weeping sound like howling wolves or ostriches.
translation_verse: “Ŋkpal ade kikɛ so, ma Maika beeŋ boŋto a shu nseŋ buu asɔfarbi a na aya fuloŋ. Meeŋ shu fanɛ kuntuŋ na nseŋ boŋto fanɛ tayetaye.

english_verse: Everyone in Maroth hoped for the best, but the Lord sent disaster down on Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Marofebi pesaŋ to a keni e fin esa nɛ e beeŋ mɔlga bumo ŋkpal Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ka shin nɛ Jerusalɛmebi ji jɛrbi damta so.

english_verse: Get the war chariots ready, you people of Lachish. You led Jerusalem into sin, just as Israel did.
translation_verse: Menyi nɛ men wɔ Lakish na e bela men be egbaŋɛ nɛ kena to be egbaŋɛturko ase. Men kute Israɛlebi to n wora alubi nseŋ ŋin Jerusalɛmebi gba n wɔtɔ alubi to.

english_verse: Now you will have to give a going-away gift to Moresheth. Israel's kings will discover that they cannot trust the town of Achzib.
translation_verse: Amoso menyi Judaebi e kela Moreshɛf Gaaf be kade to ebi na fanɛ menyee yɔ. Ŋkpal manɛ so Israɛl be bewura maaŋ naŋ nya kechɛto ashi Akzib be kade to.

english_verse: People of Mareshah, the Lord will send someone to capture your town. Then Israel's glorious king will be forced to hide in Adullam Cave.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ ta menyi nɛ men shi kade nɛ baa tre Mareshɛf na m bɔɔ bedoŋ enɔ nɛ b kɔ n sɔ menyi be kade nɛ Israɛl be benimuana kikɛ e shile n ya ŋana kebeelaŋ nɛ k wɔ Adulam na to.

english_verse: Doomed! You're doomed! At night you lie in bed, making evil plans. And when morning comes, you do what you've planned because you have the power.
translation_verse: Asheŋ maaŋ nyalɛ n sa bekama nɛ baa dese bumo be edesekpa a kre asheŋ lubi be kewora be ŋkre na. Kanyɛso nɛ baa kaa kre loŋ be asheŋ na, nɛ kare e chɛ nɛ b wora amo ŋkpal b ka kɔ eleŋ so.

english_verse: You grab any field or house that you want; you cheat families out of homes and land.
translation_verse: B baa sha nsawule ŋko nwu kama, baa suge amo eleŋso nna. Baa puni nna a suge basa be nwu ŋko mpetɛsɔ.

english_verse: But here is what the Lord says: “I am planning trouble for you. Your necks will be caught in a noose, and you will be disgraced in this time of disaster.”
translation_verse: Amoso kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ nde: “Mee kre keshin nɛ tɔrɔgboŋgboŋi e ba menyi so nna. Menyi alɛ maaŋ tiŋ ŋ gelge kumo n nya menyi be kumu n ji kikɛ. Menyeeŋ luri etɔrɔ to, saŋɛ na so menyi maaŋ naa nite a wu menyi be amu.

english_verse: When that happens, this sorrowful song will be sung about you: “Ruined! Completely ruined! The Lord has taken our land and given it to traitors.”
translation_verse: Kachɛ na kaŋ fo basa beeŋ baa boŋ nshɛ a wora menyi eyurto a kaŋɛ le: ‘Anyi ere mur cheche nna na! Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na suge anyi be kasawule n sa bedebɔrpo.’

english_verse: Descendants of Jacob, is it right for you to claim that the Lord did what he did because he was angry? Doesn't he always bless those who do right?
translation_verse: Menyi Israɛlebi nɛ men la Jeekɔb be kaman to ebi na kɔ ekpa nɛ men baa kaŋɛ fanɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nya agbo nna n wora kusɔ nɛ e wora ere? Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ maa kaa nɛfa bekama nɛ baa wora asheŋ niŋiso nna a?”

english_verse: You take over lovely homes that belong to the women of my nation. Then you cheat their children out of the inheritance that comes from the Lord.
translation_verse: Menyi alɛ bee kaa ju ma basa be beche a lar bumo be elaŋ nɛ baa sha ga na to nna nsaa suge bumo be mbia be enɛfa nɛ n sa bumo fanɛ a baa la bumo peya mbaanaayɔ na.

english_verse: Get out of here, you crooks! You'll find no rest here. You're not fit to belong to the Lord's people, and you will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Men koso a yɔ! Nfe maŋ la kakpa nɛ menyeeŋ chena n wushi. Ŋkpal manɛ so, menyi be alubi shin nɛ k wora eyurpi nseŋ ki kakpa nɛ k beeŋ mur.

english_verse: The only prophet you want is a liar who will say, “Drink and get drunk!” A Promise of Hope
translation_verse: Basa ere bee sha anebi nɛ e beeŋ ba kaa ku efɛ a kaŋɛ bumo le na nna: ‘Men baa nuu nsa a boo.’

english_verse: I, the Lord, promise to bring together the people of Israel who have survived. I will gather them, just as a shepherd brings sheep together, and there will be many.
translation_verse: Ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e naa nase kɔnɔ, fanɛ meeŋ naŋ bar ma basa Israɛlebi, nɛ baaŋ ji efute na abar so. Meeŋ gama bumo abar so fanɛ mbolpɔ ka wɔ kuluu to, saŋɛ na so basa beeŋ wora keshi n sɔ kasawule na so kikɛ.

english_verse: I will break down the gate and lead them out— then I will be their king.
translation_verse: Meeŋ bugi ekpa n sa ma basa nseŋ juŋkpar bumo n lar kenyaya nɛ b wɔtɔ ashi efuli pɔtɛana so m ba ki bumo be ewura.”

english_verse: Listen to me, you rulers of Israel! You know right from wrong,
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Maika kaŋɛ le: “Israɛlebi be bejuŋkparpo, men nu nfe! Men nyi kelela nɛ kulubi be mbarga,

english_verse: but you prefer to do evil instead of what is right. You skin my people alive. You strip off their flesh,
translation_verse: ama men kishi alela be kebaa wora nna nsaa sha alubi be kebaa wora. Men wɔtɔ nna a debɔr ma basa nsaa jija bumo be atre fanɛ kananɛ baa luu kusɔbɔya be kawɔl nsaa marga kumo be eblaŋ ashi awibi so na.

english_verse: break their bones, cook it all in a pot, and gulp it down.
translation_verse: K du fanɛ menyee luu ma basa be nwɔl nna, nsaa kpele bumo be eblaŋ nɛ awibi to a wɔtɔ mpuliya to a daŋɛ a we.

english_verse: Someday you will beg the Lord to help you, but he will turn away because of your sins.
translation_verse: Kachako menyeeŋ shu ŋ kule Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na, ama e maaŋ nu menyi be kekule. Ŋkpal menyi be alubi so, e beeŋ kpele mbe anishi nsaa maaŋ tuge menyi gba kuraa.

english_verse: You lying prophets promise security for anyone who gives you food, but disaster for anyone who refuses to feed you. Here is what the Lord says to you prophets:
translation_verse: Kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee kaŋɛ nde: ‘Anebiana ko wɔtɔ nna a fule a nase kayurwushi be kɔnɔ a sa basa nɛ baa sa bumo kusɔ jiso nsaa ta kena a funti bekama nɛ b maa wora loŋ na. Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee kaŋɛ loŋ be anebiana na nna fanɛ

english_verse: “You will live in the dark, far from the sight of the sun, with no message from me.
translation_verse: k beeŋ wora bumo kachako fanɛ kanyɛ ka biri nɛ b maŋ naa wu na. B maaŋ naaŋ tiŋ ŋ ku bɔrɛdare n fule ma basa kikɛ.

english_verse: But the Lord has filled me with power and his Spirit. I have been given the courage to speak about justice and to tell you people of Israel that you have sinned.
translation_verse: Ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ta mbe Kiyoyu nɛ mbe eleŋ na nna n wɔtɔ ma ere to, nseŋ shin nɛ n nya kenyɛn a ji asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so nsaa tiŋ a kaŋɛ Israɛl be basa bumo be alubi.

english_verse: So listen to my message, you rulers of Israel! You hate justice and twist the truth.
translation_verse: Men nu nfe, menyi Israɛl be bejuŋkparpo, nɛ men kishi kebaaji asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so nsaa ta kulubi a tre kelela.

english_verse: You leaders accept bribes for dishonest decisions. You priests and prophets teach and preach, but only for money. Then you say, “The Lord is on our side. No harm will come to us.”
translation_verse: Kadegboŋ na be bejuŋkparpoana bee sɔ asɔ basa kutɔ nna pɔɛŋ nsaa ji bumo be asheŋ a sa bumo. Bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ anebiana na malɛ bee sɔ amansherbi nna pɔɛŋ nsaa ŋini mbraana na ŋko a wu abɔrɛsheŋ a kaŋɛ basa. Kumo be kaman nɛ b kilgi ŋ kaŋɛ le: “Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na wɔ anyi kutɔ, amoso shɛŋ maaŋ tiŋ n wora anyi.”

english_verse: And so, because of you, Jerusalem will be plowed under and left in ruins. Thorns will cover the mountain where the temple now stands.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal bumo so, baaŋ pulgi Jerusalɛm to fanɛ kudɔsawule, nɛ k ki kade bureso m biti abar so a dese; nɛ Zayɔn be kebee nɛ bɔrɛlambu na yil so na malɛ e ki kupo.

english_verse: In the future, the mountain with the Lord's temple will be the highest of all. It will reach above the hills, and every nation will rush to it.
translation_verse: Lalaloge be nchɛ na to kebee nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be bɔrɛlambu na yil so na e naŋ ba ki abee kikɛ to be kejeŋgreŋ ga. K beeŋ baa du jeŋgreŋ a chɔ abee kikɛ nyam, nɛ efuliana na kikɛ be basa e shile m ba kumo ase

english_verse: People of many nations will come and say, “Let's go up to the mountain of the Lord God of Jacob and worship in his temple.” The Lord will teach us his Law from Jerusalem, and we will obey him.
translation_verse: m ba kaŋɛ le: “Men shin nɛ an dii n yɔ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be kebee na so, n ya luri Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na be bɔrɛlambu na to. E beeŋ ŋini anyi kusɔ nɛ e bee sha fanɛ an wora; nɛ an baa wora mbe aparsheŋ saŋkama. Ŋkpal manɛ so, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be keŋini bee shi Jerusalɛm nna; nɛ mo alɛ bee shi Zayɔn be kebee so a malga a sa mbe basa.”

english_verse: Everyone will find rest beneath their own fig trees or grape vines, and they will live in peace. This is a solemn promise of the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Loŋ be jemanɛ na, ekama na beeŋ chena mbe ndibi sɔrso be kudɔ to nɛ kayurwushi nɛ esa kikɛ maaŋ naa funti mo. Ŋkpal manɛ so, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na be kɔnɔ naseso nna na.

english_verse: Others may follow their gods, but we will always follow the Lord our God. The Lord Will Lead His People Home
translation_verse: Efuli kama so ebi bee bunyaŋ nsaa wora bumo be kegbir kasonu nna, ama anyi ere beeŋ baa bunyaŋ nsaa wora Enyɛnpe anyi be Ebɔrɛ na kasonu nna mbaanaayɔ. Israɛlebi ka beeŋ shi kenyaya to m bɛta m ba be asheŋ

english_verse: The Lord said: At that time I will gather my people— the lame and the outcasts, and all others into whose lives I have brought sorrow.
translation_verse: Kede be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ, “Jemanɛ ko bee ba nɛ ŋ gama basa nɛ ŋ gberge kusoe n shin nɛ b yɔ kenyaya to ashi efuli wɔfɔana so n ya ji awurfoŋ na abar so.

english_verse: Then the lame and the outcasts will belong to my people and become a strong nation. I, the Lord, will rule them from Mount Zion forever.
translation_verse: Meeŋ shin nɛ ma basa nɛ b shir kaman kasawule na so nsaa du fanɛ ebobi na e naŋ ki efuli lempo so ebi. Ma alɛ beeŋ baa wɔ Zayɔn be kebee na so nna a ji kuwura bumo so hale mbaanaayɔ.”

english_verse: Jerusalem, why are you crying? Don't you have a king? Have your advisors gone? Are you suffering like a woman in childbirth?
translation_verse: Jerusalɛmebi, manɛ so nɛ menyee shu awɔrso ŋko a ji awurfoŋ fanɛ eche nɛ kakurge ta mo? Menyi ka maŋ kɔ ewura ŋko menyi be asoetojipoana ka wu so nɛ menyee shu a?

english_verse: Keep on groaning with pain, you people of Jerusalem! If you escape from your city to the countryside, you will still be taken as prisoners to Babylonia. But later I will rescue you from your enemies.
translation_verse: Men baa shu nsaa kii nnɔ to fanɛ eche nɛ kakurge ta na, ŋkpal manɛ so, k maaŋ chɛr nɛ men lar kadegboŋ na to n yaa kaa wɔ kupuŋ to. Baaŋ pɛ menyi n yɔ kufɔ kufɔ Babilɔn be efuli so, ama ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na, beeŋ mɔlga menyi ashi men doŋana be enɔ to ndoŋ.

english_verse: Zion, because of your sins you are surrounded by many nations who say, “We can hardly wait to see you disgraced.”
translation_verse: Efuli damtaana gama abar so nna nɛ b kɔ menyi kena. B yɛ: “A daga fanɛ Jerusalɛm ka mur! Anyi be kenishi pere nna a fin kewu kumo be ŋaba.”

english_verse: Bethlehem Ephrath, you are one of the smallest towns in the nation of Judah. But the Lord will choose one of your people to rule the nation— someone whose family goes back to ancient times.
translation_verse: Ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na yɛ: “Bɛtlɛhɛm Efrata, fo la Juda be efuli so be ndewurbiana na be kuko nna, ama fo to nɛ meeŋ lara esa nɛ e beeŋ ba ji Israɛl be efuli so be kuwura. Dra dra na kikɛ nɛ mbe kanaŋ jɔŋɛ.”

english_verse: Like a shepherd taking care of his sheep, this ruler will lead and care for his people by the power and glorious name of the Lord his God. His people will live securely, and the whole earth will know his true greatness,
translation_verse: Ewura na kaŋ ba e beeŋ ta Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be eleŋ nɛ Ebɔrɛ na be ketre be kemaŋkura n ji kuwura mbe basa so. Mbe basa beeŋ nya kekuŋ gboŋgboŋi, ŋkpal manɛ so, mbe ketre beeŋ dii n yɔ durnya be efuli kama so

english_verse: because he will bring peace. Assyria Will Be Defeated Let Assyria attack our country and our palaces. We will counterattack, led by a number of rulers
translation_verse: nɛ e bar kayurwushi m ba sa bumo. Asiriya be efuli so be basa kaŋ ba kɔ m bure n luri anyi be mboŋ lempoana to, anyeeŋ shuŋi anyi be bejuŋkparpo lempoana nɛ b ya kɔ bumo.

english_verse: whose strong army will defeat the nation of Assyria. Yes, our leaders will rescue us, if those Assyrians dare to invade our land. The Survivors Will Be Safe
translation_verse: Anyi be bejuŋkparpo lempoana ere beeŋ keta benapo nɛ b kɔ eleŋ ga n ya kɔ m mɔlga anyi ashi Asiriyaebi nɛ baa shuŋ kegbir nɛ baa tre Nimrɔd na be enɔ to jemanɛ nɛ baaŋ ba bure n luri anyi be kasawule to na.

english_verse: A few of Jacob's descendants survived and are scattered among the nations. But the Lord will let them cover the earth like dew and rain that refreshes the soil.
translation_verse: Israɛl be basa nɛ baaŋ ji efute na beeŋ baa du fanɛ bunyaŋ ŋko bɔrɛchu nɛ k bee sa kayul nseŋ shi Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kutɔ a ba efuli damtaana so nna.

english_verse: At present they are scattered, but later they will attack, as though they were fierce lions pouncing on sheep. Their enemies will be torn to shreds, with no one to save them;
translation_verse: Ama bekama nɛ b shir a wɔ efuli pɔtɛana so na bre beeŋ ki fanɛ buluŋ nɛ e bee kɔ a fin kusɔ jiso ashi kiyi to na nna. E baŋ nya n luri mbolpɔ to e beeŋ baa tɛ nna a yuu bumo so nsaa kpɛa bumo to a we nɛ esa kikɛ malɛ maaŋ tiŋ n sɔ bumo n yige.

english_verse: they will be helpless, completely destroyed. Idols Will Be Destroyed in Israel
translation_verse: Israɛlebi na beeŋ kɔ m pɔɔ bumo doŋana so nseŋ mur bumo cheche.

english_verse: The Lord said: At that time I will wipe out your cavalry and chariots,
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na yɛ: “Jemanɛ na kaŋ fo, meeŋ suge menyi be egbaŋɛ nseŋ mur menyi be egbaŋɛturko.

english_verse: You will no longer worship the idols or stone images you have made— I will destroy them,
translation_verse: Ma alɛ beeŋ naŋ mur asɔ nɛ menyee ta a lɔŋɛ agbir a shuŋ na kikɛ, nɛ menyi maaŋ naŋ nya amo a shuŋ.

english_verse: I will become furious and take revenge on the nations that refuse to obey me.
translation_verse: Meeŋ nya agbo ga m bishi efuliana nɛ amo be basa kini kewora ma kasonu na kuwule.”

english_verse: Israel, I am bringing charges against you— I call upon the mountains and the earth's firm foundation to be my witnesses.
translation_verse: O abeegboŋ nɛ durnya be nsawule be egbaltɔlase nɛ a wɔtɔ mbaanaayɔ, men nu asheŋ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kɔ a semaŋ mbe basa Israɛlebi na.”

english_verse: My people, have I wronged you in any way at all? Please tell me.
translation_verse: E yɛ “Ma basa, manɛ nɛ n wora menyi? Men kaŋɛ ma, n la esulɔ nna n sa menyi a?

english_verse: I rescued you from Egypt, where you were slaves. I sent Moses, Aaron, and Miriam to be your leaders.
translation_verse: Ma e lara menyi nseŋ mɔlga menyi ashi kenyaya to ashi Ijipt be efuli so. Mosis nɛ Ɛɛrɔn nɛ Miriam nɛ n daŋ shuŋi fanɛ b ya juŋkpar menyi n lar ndoŋ.

english_verse: Don't forget the evil plans of King Balak of Moab or what Balaam son of Beor said to him. Remember how I, the Lord, saved you many times on your way from Acacia to Gilgal. True Obedience
translation_verse: Ma basa, men baa nyiŋi kusɔ nɛ Mowab be ewura Balak daŋ kre kewora menyi nɛ kusɔ nɛ Biyɔɔ pibinyɛn Balaam daŋ kaŋɛ mo a laŋɛ menyi be kaplɛa so na. Men naŋ nyiŋi asheŋ nɛ e wora saŋɛ nɛ men lar Shitim a yɔ Gilgaal na nseŋ nyiŋi kananɛ ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na mɔlga menyi ale damta.” Kashenteŋto be kasonu be asheŋ

english_verse: What offering should I bring when I bow down to worship the Lord God Most High? Should I try to please him by sacrificing calves a year old?
translation_verse: Manɛ bre nɛ meeŋ ta m ba Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ nɛ e wɔ ebɔrɛso na kutɔ m ba bunyaŋ mo? N ta egbolu lela ga nɛ a ji nfɛ koko m ba lara sarga chɔɔso n sa mo a?

english_verse: Will thousands of sheep or rivers of olive oil make God satisfied with me? Should I sacrifice to the Lord my first-born child as payment for my terrible sins?
translation_verse: N ta mbolpɔ ŋgboŋto ŋgboŋto ŋko ɔlif be ŋku nɛ e du fanɛ lɔr be bɔlɔ m ba mo kutɔ, k beeŋ par mo a? N ta ma wurkoŋnyɛn n lara sarga n sa mo ŋkpal ma alubi so a?

english_verse: The Lord God has told us what is right and what he demands: “See that justice is done, let mercy be your first concern, and humbly obey your God.” Cheating and Violence
translation_verse: Ayai, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na teŋ kaŋɛ anyi kusɔ nɛ k walɛ. Kusɔ nɛ e bee fin anyi kutɔ e la, kebaawora asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so nɛ kebaa ŋini kasha nsaa kɔ kamubrase a nu a sa mo.

english_verse: I am the Lord, and you are wise to respect my power to punish. So listen to my message for the city of Jerusalem:
translation_verse: Nu nfe! Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee kela a shoŋi Jerusalɛm be kadegboŋ na to ebi. E yɛ: “Men baa de kuwurkpabi na, nɛ esa nɛ e kɔ kumo to a ba na so.

english_verse: But I, the Lord, will punish you for cheating with weights and with measures.
translation_verse: Nuso nɛ meeŋ tiŋ n ta m paŋ bumo nɛ baa ta kapuni be ekurwa a ber asɔ a sa basa?

english_verse: You rich people are violent, and everyone tells lies.
translation_verse: Damawuraana na bee puni betirpo nna nɛ ekama malɛ bee ku efɛ.

english_verse: Because of your sins, I will wound you and leave you ruined and defenseless.
translation_verse: Amoso n teŋ fara nɛ m mur menyi nna ŋkpal menyi be asheŋ lubi so.

english_verse: You will eat, but still be hungry; you will store up goods, but lose everything— I, the Lord, will let it all be captured in war.
translation_verse: Menyeeŋ ji ajibi, ama menyi alɛ maaŋ moɛ. Menyeeŋ chala asɔ n yili, ama menyi alɛ maaŋ baa kɔ mpetɛ nɛ a yil. Ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ shin nɛ bedoŋ e ba kɔ n suge amo kikɛ.

english_verse: Jerusalem, this will happen because you followed the sinful example of kings Omri and Ahab. Now I will destroy you and your property. Then the people of every nation will make fun and insult you.
translation_verse: Le be asheŋ ere beeŋ ba menyi so nna ŋkpal men ka bɛ ewura Omri nɛ mo pibinyɛn, ewura Ehab be asheŋ lubi so so. Bumo be edaŋkare to nɛ men bee kute to. Amoso meeŋ shin nɛ men mur cheche nɛ ekama e baa tege nsaa mushe menyi fanɛ asɔ jiga na.”

english_verse: Don't trust anyone, not even your best friend, and be careful what you say to the one you love.
translation_verse: Sa maŋ kaŋ yirda fo echenashapo ŋko fo teri kikɛ. Baa de kusɔ nɛ fee kaŋɛ fo eche gba so.

english_verse: Sons refuse to respect their own fathers, daughters rebel against their own mothers, and daughters-in-law despise their mothers-in-law. Your family is now your enemy.
translation_verse: Jemanɛ mo nɛ an wɔ to ere, bibinyɛn bee keni bumo tutoana nna fanɛ bewulpo. Bibiche malɛ maa sa bumo nioana kashuli nɛ bechekilpo malɛ bee tu bumo shacheana a bile. Naniere esa gbagba be kanaŋ to ebi e la mo doŋana.

english_verse: But I trust the Lord God to save me, and I will wait for him to answer my prayer. The Nation Turns to God
translation_verse: Ama ma ere bee keni Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be anishito nna nseŋ ta tama a jo mo nɛ e mɔlga ma. Ma Ebɔrɛ na malɛ beeŋ nu ma kekule. Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ka beeŋ bar kumɔlga be asheŋ

english_verse: My enemies, don't be glad because of my troubles! I may have fallen, but I will get up; I may be sitting in the dark, but the Lord is my light.
translation_verse: N doŋana, men sa maŋ shin nɛ menyi be ŋgbene e fuli nɛ men baa ji njɔŋ ma so. Hale nɛ n tɔr gba, ŋ kraa beeŋ koso. Nɛ n chena tentembiri to gba, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e la ma kefulto.

english_verse: I have sinned against the Lord. And so I must endure his anger, until he comes to my defense. But I know that I will see him making things right for me and leading me to the light.
translation_verse: N wora alubi n da Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na so, amoso meeŋ wora kanyiti n ji mbe agbo be tɔrɔ n ya fo saŋɛ nɛ e beeŋ ba kɔ n sa ma. M baa nyi geeŋ fanɛ e beeŋ naŋ shin nɛ asheŋ a nyalɛ nɛ e juŋkpar ma m ba kefulto to.

english_verse: You, my enemies, said, “The Lord God is helpless.” Now each of you will be disgraced and put to shame. I will see you trampled like mud in the street. A Bright Future
translation_verse: Saŋɛ na so nɛ ma doŋana nɛ b kaŋɛ le: “Nnɛ nɛ Enyɛnpe fo Ebɔrɛ na wɔ?” An wu kusɔ nɛ e wora na nɛ nyɔmɔ e pɛ bumo. Ma anishi ere nɛ meeŋ ta n wu asheŋ ka beeŋ bri bumo. Hale naniere gba n wu fanɛ b ki fanɛ kebɔrbi so be depɔ nna nɛ basa bee chichi so.

english_verse: Towns of Judah, the day is coming when your walls will be rebuilt, and your boundaries enlarged.
translation_verse: O Jerusalɛmebi, saŋɛ fo nɛ b lɔŋɛ kadegboŋ na be egbalana m pɔr. Jemanɛ na kaŋ fo menyi be kasawule be egbaŋ beeŋ kpalga to n ti so.

english_verse: Those nations will suffer disaster because of what they did. Micah's Prayer and the Lord's Answer
translation_verse: Ama efuli pɔtɛana bre be nsawule beeŋ ki keshishɛrsawule ŋkpal bumo be basa be amukpakpaso so. Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be kashagboŋ nɛ e kɔ n sa Israɛl be asheŋ

english_verse: Lead your people, Lord! Come and be our shepherd. Grasslands surround us, but we live in a forest. So lead us to Bashan and Gilead, and let us find pasture as we did long ago.
translation_verse: O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, baa la fanɛ mbolpɔkpapo n sa fo basa laraso. Kashenteŋ nna fanɛ b pesaŋ to nna a wɔ kiyi to, ama kudɔsawule lela kulti bumo nna n wɔtɔ. Amoso shin nɛ b ya chena Bashan nɛ Giliad be nsawule lela so a nya a ji fanɛ kananɛ b daa nya a ji dra na.

english_verse: I, the Lord, will work miracles just as I did when I led you out of Egypt.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, yaŋ wora emamachisheŋ n sa anyi fanɛ kananɛ fo daŋ wora saŋɛ nɛ fo daŋ lara anyi ashi Ijipt be efuli so na.

english_verse: Nations will see this and be ashamed because of their helpless armies. They will be in shock, unable to speak or hear,
translation_verse: Efuli pɔtɛana nɛ baa puchi bumo be eleŋ so beeŋ wu asheŋ ere nɛ aba e pɔ bumo nɛ b lo bumo be nnɔ nseŋ ti bumo be asoe kagbenejijaso.

english_verse: because of their fear of me, your Lord and God. Then they will come trembling, crawling out of their fortresses like insects or snakes, lapping up the dust. No One Is Like God The people said:
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ b dese kasawule a gbeye fanɛ awɔ nsaa chicha kufuso a lar mboŋ lempoana nɛ b daa wɔtɔ to na. Bumo alɛ beeŋ kilgi kufuso m bɛta m ba Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kutɔ.

english_verse: Our God, no one is like you. We are all that is left of your chosen people, and you freely forgive our sin and guilt. You don't stay angry forever; you're glad to have pity
translation_verse: O Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ, Ebɔrɛ kikɛ maŋ naa wɔtɔ a du fanɛ fo. Fo e naa ta fo basa be alubi a paŋ bumo. Fo alɛ be agbo maa wɔtɔ a yɔ. Kuwɔrwu e naa fuli fo kagbene.

english_verse: and pleased to be merciful. You will trample on our sins and throw them in the sea.
translation_verse: Fo e naa wu anyi kuwɔr fanɛ kananɛ fo daa wora na. Fee chichi anyi be alubi so nna a ta amo a lɛ teku be kechimbi to.

english_verse: You will keep your word and be faithful to Jacob and to Abraham, as you promised our ancestors many years ago.
translation_verse: Feeŋ lara fo kashenteŋji nɛ kasha nɛ k maa loge na ŋ ŋini fo basa nɛ b la an nananyɛnana Eebraham nɛ Jeekɔb be kaman to ebi na, fanɛ kananɛ fo chɛr n nase kumo be kɔnɔ n sa bumo na.

english_verse: I am Nahum from Elkosh. And this is the message that I wrote down about Nineveh. The Fierce Anger of the Lord
translation_verse: Kubɔya ere la bɔrɛdare nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na shin nɛ Nahum, nɛ e shi kade nɛ baa tre Ɛlkɔsh na, ku a laŋɛ kadegboŋ nɛ baa tre Ninɛve na be kaplɛa so nna. Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ka nya agbo n wɔtɔ Ninɛve be asheŋ

english_verse: The Lord God demands loyalty. In his anger, he takes revenge on his enemies.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kishi kechamana ga, nsaa beeŋ gberge mo doŋana kusoe. E beeŋ bishi bumo kuwule agbo so.

english_verse: The Lord is powerful, yet patient; he makes sure that the guilty are always punished. He can be seen in storms and in whirlwinds; clouds are the dust from his feet.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kɔ eleŋ ga, mo alɛ maa nya agbo manaŋ manaŋ, ama mo alɛ maa yige bumo nɛ baa wora a de so nɛ baa ta bumo be amu a ji. Bɔrɛfugboŋ nɛ kawuliwuli so nɛ e bee bɔla a wora asheŋ; nɛ bɔrɛwɔlpa malɛ du fanɛ mbe aya to be kalabɛr.

english_verse: At the sight of the Lord, mountains and hills tremble and melt; the earth and its people shudder and shake.
translation_verse: Abeegboŋ bee gbuŋgbuŋ to Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be anishito nna, nɛ abeebi bee ŋalga mbe anishito. E baŋ lar a ba kasawule kikɛ bee gbuŋgbuŋ nna nɛ durnya nɛ kumo be basa kikɛ e baa chicha.

english_verse: Who can stand the heat of his furious anger? It flashes out like fire and shatters stones. The Power of Assyria Will Be Broken
translation_verse: E baŋ nya agbo, esa kikɛ maaŋ pete. Esa kikɛ maaŋ tiŋ ŋ gelge mbe agbogboŋ na. Mbe agbo du fanɛ edɛ nna a pante afalta nɛ a bee bure to a ki eshishɛr.

english_verse: The Lord is good. He protects those who trust him in times of trouble.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na walɛ; mo e naa kuŋ mbe basa tɔrɔ to, nsaa keni bekama nɛ b yirda mo so.

english_verse: But like a roaring flood, the Lord chases his enemies into dark places and destroys them.
translation_verse: Ama e bee mur mo doŋana bre nna fanɛ nchugboŋ ka jija asɔ na. Mo alɛ naa yɛr bumo nɛ baa ji mo emɔrɔ na luwu to nna.

english_verse: So don't plot against the Lord! He wipes out his enemies, and they never revive.
translation_verse: Amoso sa maa kre Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ŋkre kulubi! E bee mur mo doŋana cheche nna nɛ b maŋ naa nya ekpa a bɛta a ba.

english_verse: Assyria, one of your rulers has made evil plans against the Lord.
translation_verse: Esa ko nɛ e kɔ nfɛra lubi shi Ninɛve be kadegboŋ to m ba kaa kre Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ŋkre lubi.

english_verse: But the Lord says, “Assyria, no matter how strong you are, you will be cut down! My people Judah, I have troubled you before, but I won't do it again.
translation_verse: Ama kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee kaŋɛ mbe basa Israɛlebi nde. E yɛ: “Asiriyaebi be eleŋ nɛ bumo be keshi ere kikɛ be kaman baaŋ mur nɛ esa maaŋ naŋ wu bumo. N shin nɛ menyi, ma basa Israɛlebi, ji awurfoŋ, ama ma alɛ maaŋ naŋ wora loŋ kikɛ.

english_verse: Assyria, this is what else the Lord says to you: “Your name will be forgotten. I will destroy every idol in your temple, and I will send you to the grave, because you are worthless.”
translation_verse: Ketande nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nase a laŋɛ Asiriyaebi be kaplɛa so nde. E yɛ: “B maaŋ nya kaman to ebi nɛ baaŋ sɔ bumo so n shin nɛ basa e baa nyiŋi bumo a ti bumo be atre. Meeŋ mur bumo be agbirana nɛ a wɔ bumo be agbirlambuana to na. Ma alɛ beeŋ kur Asiriyaebi be nchaŋana n nase, ŋkpal manɛ so, b maŋ walɛ kikɛ.”

english_verse: Look toward the mountains, people of Judah! Here comes a messenger with good news of peace. Celebrate your festivals. Keep your promises to God. Your evil enemies are destroyed and will never again invade your country.
translation_verse: Judaebi, men keni, kabɔ ko kɔ baru lela n shi kebeegboŋ na so a ba! Kayurwushi be baru nɛ e kɔ a ba. Amoso men ji menyi be nchɛgboŋ nseŋ wora m bɔlɔ nnɔ nɛ men nase n sa Ebɔrɛ na so. Kumukpakpaso wuraana maaŋ naaŋ kɔ n sɔ menyi be kasawule kikɛ, ŋkpal manɛ so, b mur cheche kuraa.

english_verse: Judah and Israel are like trees with branches broken by their enemies. But the Lord is going to restore their power and glory. *
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ naa sha kelaŋɛ Israɛlebi be kemaŋkura nɛ b daa kɔ pɔɛŋ nɛ bumo doŋana ba kɔ n suge bumo be asɔ na n sa bumo.

english_verse: An officer gives a command. But his soldiers stumble, as they hasten to build a shelter to protect themselves against rocks thrown down from the city wall.
translation_verse: Benapo nimuso na ponte n tre benapo na; nɛ b shil a fiti a ba. Benapo na daa shil a yɔ egbal na ase nna nɛ b ya pɔr kusɔ nɛ k beeŋ baa kuŋ ajembu gbɛgbɛso nɛ bedoŋ beeŋ shi awɔlto ŋ gbelti n lɛ bumo so na.

english_verse: Nineveh is disgraced. The queen is dragged off. Her servant women mourn; they moan like doves, and they beat their breasts in sorrow.
translation_verse: B pɛ ewurche na kenya n yɔ efuli pɔtɛ so, nɛ mbe mbita bee shu fanɛ ali nsaa ber ŋgbene so kagbenejijaso.

english_verse: Enemy soldiers shout, “The city is full of treasure and all kinds of wealth. Steal her silver! Grab her gold!”
translation_verse: Nɛ bedoŋ be benapo na bee ponte a kaŋɛ: “Men baa muu eshuwa nɛ egbiti na! Ŋkpal manɛ so, kadegboŋ na to kɔ asɔ lela ga!”

english_verse: What happened to this city? They were safer there than powerful lions in a den, with no one to disturb them.
translation_verse: Naniere nnɛ nɛ Ninɛve nɛ k daa du fanɛ ebuluŋ be kelaŋ na naa wɔ? K daa du fanɛ kakpa nɛ ebuluŋ nyɛnso nɛ becheso kikɛ beeŋ lar ŋ ka bumo be bibi nɛ shɛŋ maaŋ wora bumo nna.

english_verse: These are the same lions that ferociously attacked their victims, then dragged away the flesh to feed their young.
translation_verse: Buluŋ na bee pɛ kusɔbɔya nɛ e nya nna, nseŋ gbeye kumo n ya sa mo barkasa nɛ bibi nɛ b ji m moɛ.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful is against you, Nineveh. God will burn your chariots and send an army to kill those young lions of yours. You will never again make victims of others or send messengers to threaten everyone on this earth.
translation_verse: Nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ: “Ninɛveebi, men ki ma doŋana nna na, meeŋ chɔɔ menyi be egbaŋɛturko nseŋ shin nɛ b mɔ menyi be benapo kena to. Ma alɛ beeŋ naŋ shin nɛ b sɔ asɔ nɛ men suge beko kutɔ na, ekama malɛ maaŋ tuge menyi be mbɔ kikɛ.”

english_verse: Doom to the crime capital! Nineveh, city of murder and treachery,
translation_verse: Asheŋ maaŋ nyalɛ n sa kadegboŋ nɛ bemɔpo nɛ befɛpo nɛ kapuni bɔlɔ kumo to na.

english_verse: You were nothing more than a prostitute using your magical charms and witchcraft to attract and trap nations.
translation_verse: Kasogberge nɛ k beeŋ ba Ninɛve so, ŋkpal kesakalea damta nɛ k bɔlɔ kumo to, nɛ kegbaya nɛ b ta m pɛ efuli damtaana so be basa ŋ ki bumo be anya na so.

english_verse: But I, the Lord All-Powerful, am now your enemy. I will pull up your skirt and let nations and kingdoms stare at your nakedness.
translation_verse: Ade be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ: “Ŋ ki fo, Ninɛve, mo doŋ nna na. Meeŋ delge fo so nɛ efuli pɔtɛana na e wu fo kesaria nɛ nyɔmɔ e pɛ fo.

english_verse: I will cover you with garbage, treat you like trash, and rub you in the dirt.
translation_verse: Meeŋ shin nɛ fo ki kusɔ jiga nɛ kusɔyurpi; nɛ kumo be loŋ e chinchiŋ basa, nseŋ pɛ bumo kufu.

english_verse: Everyone who sees you will turn away and shout, “Nineveh is done for! Is anyone willing to mourn or to give her comfort?” Nineveh's Fate Is Sealed
translation_verse: Bekama nɛ baaŋ wu fo beeŋ shile fo nseŋ kaŋɛ le: ‘Ninɛve e bure a dese na, wanɛ e naŋ shu n sa mo? Nnɛ nɛ meeŋ nya esa nɛ e lolo mo?’ ”

english_verse: Nineveh, do you feel safer than the city of Thebes? The Nile River was its wall of defense.
translation_verse: To, Ninɛve, fo maŋ bɔ Ijipt be efuli so be kadegboŋ nɛ baa tre Tebes, nɛ Nail be Lɔr na daa kuŋ kumo fanɛ egbal na.

english_verse: Thebes trusted the mighty power of Ethiopia and Egypt; the nations of Put and Libya were her allies.
translation_verse: Itiopia nɛ Ijipt be efuliana be eleŋ nɛ kade na daa fute a yige so. Libiya nɛ kasawule nɛ baa tre Put na e daa la kumo teriana nɛ a chɛ kumo to.

english_verse: But she was captured and taken to a foreign country. Her children were murdered at every street corner. The members of her royal family were auctioned off, and her high officials were bound in chains.
translation_verse: Ama bedoŋ daŋ ba kɔ Tebes nseŋ pɛ kumo be basa n yɔ efuli pɔtɛ so. B daŋ mɔ bumo be mbia nna n nase agbembi so be kukɔlɔ kama so. B daŋ to beri nna m barga bumo be benimugboŋ nɛ b ta ŋgbɛlɛbi ŋ kre na to n sa abar.

english_verse: Nineveh, now it's your turn! You will get drunk and try to hide from your enemy.
translation_verse: Ninɛve, fo alɛ gba beeŋ nuu nsa m boo m baŋ so nseŋ shile fo doŋana so n ya ŋana m mɔlga fo kumu.

english_verse: Your army is weak. Fire has destroyed the crossbars on your city gates; now they stand wide open to your enemy.
translation_verse: Fo benapo du fanɛ beche nna nɛ shɛŋ malɛ maa kuŋ fo kasawule na ashi fo doŋana be enɔ to. Edɛ beeŋ chɔɔ ndibi nɛ baa ta a ber fo mbunagboŋ so na.

english_verse: You will still go up in flames and be cut down by swords that will wipe you out like a field attacked by grasshoppers. So, go ahead and increase like a swarm of locusts!
translation_verse: Kanaŋkama nɛ men wora, edɛ e naŋ chɔɔ menyi m mɔ ŋko kena to nɛ menyeeŋ wu. Baaŋ mur menyi fanɛ kananɛ elotɔr bee ji asɔduu a mur na. Men salga fanɛ alonte ŋko elotɔr nna!

english_verse: More merchants are in your city than there are stars in the sky— but they are like locusts that eat everything, then fly away.
translation_verse: Menyi be eyawujipo wora keshi a chɔ achɛkpabi nɛ a wɔ awɔlto ere, ama bumo kikɛ beeŋ mur n choŋ fanɛ kananɛ elotɔr bee ji asɔ a mur nsaa firgi a yɔ na nna.

english_verse: Your guards and your officials are swarms of locusts. On a chilly day they settle on a fence, but when the sun comes out, they take off to who-knows-where.
translation_verse: Menyi be bekumpo nɛ ekrachi kikɛ du fanɛ elotɔr nɛ a mel abar so egbal so awo be kachɛ nna. Ama epeŋi baŋ lar, nɛ b firgi n choŋ. Esa kikɛ malɛ maa pin kakpa nɛ e bee firgi a yɔ.

english_verse: King of Assyria, your officials and leaders are sound asleep, while your people are scattered in the mountains. Yes, your people are sheep without a shepherd.
translation_verse: Asiriya be Ewurgboŋ, fo gomena be benimuana kikɛ wu, nɛ fo ekrachigboŋ dese a di nsaa maaŋ naaŋ tiŋi kikɛ! Fo basa pesaŋ to a wɔ abeegboŋ so. Esa kikɛ malɛ maŋ wɔtɔ nɛ e naŋ shin nɛ b bɛta m ba epe.

english_verse: You're fatally wounded. There's no hope for you. But everyone claps when they hear this news, because your constant cruelty has caused them pain.
translation_verse: Kudur kikɛ maŋ wɔtɔ nɛ k tiŋ n chɛ ebesa nɛ doro nɛ a wɔ fo to ere. Ekama nɛ e nu fo kemur be kubɔya ere, bee kpla enɔ kagbenefuliso nna ŋkpal ebesa nɛ b ji ŋkpal fo kumukpakpaso so.

english_verse: I am Habakkuk the prophet. And this is the message that the Lord gave me. Habakkuk Complains to the Lord
translation_verse: Kubɔya nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ lara ŋ ŋini anebi Habakuk nde. Habakuk ka fubel ŋ ŋini Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be asheŋ

english_verse: Our Lord, how long must I beg for your help before you listen? How long before you save us from all this violence?
translation_verse: O, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, ale afanɛ bre nɛ meeŋ kule fo pɔɛŋ nɛ fo nu nseŋ mɔlga ma ashi basa nɛ baa nyaŋɛto a wɔtɔ basa na be enɔ to?

english_verse: Why do you make me watch such terrible injustice? Why do you allow violence, lawlessness, crime, and cruelty to spread everywhere?
translation_verse: Manɛ nna nɛ fo shin nɛ n wu le be tɔrɔ ere? Nuso nɛ feeŋ tiŋ n nya kagbene a keni le be alubi ere? Kemur nɛ keŋkenshi be kebaawɔtɔ e kulti ma n wɔtɔ nɛ kebri nɛ katege malɛ sɔ kaplɛkama.

english_verse: Laws cannot be enforced; justice is always the loser; criminals crowd out honest people and twist the laws around. The Lord Answers Habakkuk
translation_verse: Mbra na maŋ kɔ eleŋ nɛ tɔnɔ kikɛ. Ekama malɛ maa ji asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so. Basa lubi e naa ji a bri basa niŋiso a shin nɛ kashenteŋji maŋ naa wɔtɔ. Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ka tuge Habakuk to be asheŋ

english_verse: How fearsome and frightening. Their only laws and rules are the ones they make up.
translation_verse: Bekama bee ŋana bumo nna nɛ bumo be asheŋ malɛ bee keta kufu ga. Bumo gbagba be mbraana nɛ atande nɛ baa bɛ so.

english_verse: Then suddenly they disappear like a gust of wind— those sinful people who worship their own strength. Habakkuk Complains Again
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ b choŋ fanɛ afu na. Bumo be eleŋ du fanɛ kegbir be eleŋ nna n sa bumo nɛ baa bunyaŋ kumo.” Habakuk ka fubel ŋ ŋini Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be asheŋ

english_verse: Holy Lord God, mighty rock, you are eternal, and we are safe from death. You are using those Babylonians to judge and punish others.
translation_verse: O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, fo la Ebɔrɛ nna sososo na kikɛ. Fo e la ma Ebɔrɛ nɛ fo du cheembi nsaa wɔtɔ mbaanaayɔ. Enyɛnpe, ma Ebɔrɛ nɛ ma ekumpo, fo e lara Babilɔnebi na n shin nɛ b nya eleŋ saŋɛ na so baaŋ gberge anyi kusoe.

english_verse: But you can't stand sin or wrong. So don't sit by in silence while they gobble up people who are better than they are.
translation_verse: Ama fo maaŋ tiŋ a keni nɛ kulubi e baa wora a yɔ. Fo anishi du cheembi ga nɛ a baa wu asheŋ lubi. Ama fo wora shruum a keni basa lubi nɛ b maŋ kɔ yirda ere nɛ baa mur basa nɛ b niŋi a chɔ bumo.

english_verse: The people you put on this earth are like fish or reptiles without a leader.
translation_verse: Fo shin nɛ edimɛdi ki fanɛ ekɔrɔtɔ ŋko nchu to be asɔ keniso nɛ a maŋ kɔ bejuŋkparpo na.

english_verse: Then an enemy comes along and takes them captive with hooks and nets. It makes him so happy
translation_verse: Babilɔnebi na bee pɛ edimɛdi nna fanɛ b ka ta edariwa ŋko ashewu m pɛ ekɔrɔtɔ n dii kedeŋi so nsaa cha awɔr kagbenefuliso na.

english_verse: that he offers sacrifices to his fishing nets, because they make him rich and provide choice foods.
translation_verse: Baa bunyaŋ bumo be ashewu nna nsaa lara esarga a sa amo, ŋkpal b ka bee bɔla ashewu na so a dii kedama nsaa nya ajibi lela a ji so.

english_verse: Will he keep hauling in his nets and destroying nations without showing mercy?
translation_verse: Ama b baa kraa mɔ basa fanɛ b ka bee to bumo ashewu na nsaa mur efuliana na a maa wu basa kuwɔr a?

english_verse: While standing guard on the watchtower, I waited for the Lord's answer, before explaining the reason for my complaint.
translation_verse: Meeŋ dii n yili egbal lempo jeŋgreŋ nɛ b pɔr ŋ kulti kadegboŋ na so a jo kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ tuge pɔɛŋ nɛ m bugi to ŋ kaŋɛ kusɔ nɛ k ba nɛ mee fubel.

english_verse: Then the Lord told me: “I will give you my message in the form of a vision. Write it clearly enough to be read at a glance.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ ma le: “Sibɛ kusɔ kama nɛ meeŋ lara ŋ ŋini fo n deŋi ajembu peŋgeleŋ peŋgelembi so nɛnɛ, saŋɛ na so basa beeŋ baa wu amo a kraŋ manaŋ manaŋ.

english_verse: At the time I have decided, my words will come true. You can trust what I say about the future. It may take a long time, but keep on waiting— it will happen!
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, kelaraŋŋini ere bee jo kumo be jemanɛ nna. Kusɔ nɛ k beeŋ wora lalaloge be nchɛ to na be asheŋ nɛ k bee ji. Kumo alɛ maaŋ baa la efɛsheŋ kikɛ. Kewora fanɛ k bee chɛr nna, ama baa kraa jo. Kanaŋ kama nɛ asheŋ du k beeŋ wora m bɔlɔ so.

english_verse: “I, the Lord, refuse to accept anyone who is proud. Only those who live by faith are acceptable to me.” Trouble for Evil People
translation_verse: Kubɔya na nde: ‘Bekama nɛ baa wora asheŋ lubi maaŋ ji efute, ama bekama nɛ bumo be kebaawɔtɔ niŋi na beeŋ baa wɔ ŋkpa to ŋkpal b ka bee ji kashenteŋ a sa Ebɔrɛ so.’ ” Asheŋ ka maaŋ nyalɛ n sa basa lubi be asheŋ

english_verse: Wine is treacherous, and arrogant people are never satisfied. They are no less greedy than death itself— they open their mouths as wide as the world of the dead and swallow everyone.
translation_verse: Kedamaya bre bee fule esa nna. Kejimuniwuraana bee wu bumo be amu nna ga, bumo alɛ maa wushi kikɛ. B du fanɛ luwu nɛ k maa mɔ a moɛ nna. Amoso b baŋ kɔ m pɔɔ efuli ko so n sɔ kumo, b naa yɔ kenyɔsopo so nna.

english_verse: You're doomed! You made your family rich at the expense of others. You even said to yourself, “I'm above the law.”
translation_verse: Asheŋ maaŋ nyalɛ n sa menyi ŋkpal men ka ta eleŋsheŋ n suge asɔ n shin nɛ menyi be nnaŋ to ebi dii dama nɛ tɔrɔ kikɛ maa ba menyi be elaŋ to ebi so so!

english_verse: But you will bring shame on your family and ruin to yourself for what you did to others.
translation_verse: Ama ŋkpal kusɔ nɛ men wora beko na so, menyeeŋ bar ŋaba menyi be nnaŋ to ebi so nseŋ shin nɛ kemur e ba menyi gbagba so.

english_verse: The very stones and wood in your home will testify against you.
translation_verse: Menyi be nwu be egbalana be ebirkesi nɛ eyɔri gba bee shu a gbiti menyi nna.

english_verse: Just as water fills the sea, the land will be filled with people who know and honor the Lord.
translation_verse: Ama kananɛ teku baŋ bɔlɔ nchu n sɔ kaplɛkama a dese na, aloŋ nɛ basa be kebaanyi Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be kemaŋkura be asheŋ beeŋ ba sɔ kasawule ere kikɛ so.

english_verse: What is an idol worth? It's merely a false god. Why trust a speechless image made from wood or metal by human hands?
translation_verse: Kegbir maŋ kɔ tɔnɔ kikɛ. Dimɛdi e pɔr ŋko n shɛl kumo. Efɛsheŋ nawule nɛ k bee ŋini. Nɛ manɛ so nɛ menyee yirda kusɔ nɛ b ta kebɛlso ŋko kedibi n lɔŋɛ nɛ k maa malga?

english_verse: What can you learn from idols covered with silver or gold? They can't even breathe. Pity anyone who says to an idol of wood or stone, “Get up and do something!”
translation_verse: Asheŋ maaŋ nyalɛ n sa menyi nɛ menyee kaŋɛ kedibi ŋko kejembu fanɛ k koso n sɔ nchu n nuu na. Kegbir beeŋ tiŋ n lara kesheŋ ko ŋ ŋini fo a? Baaŋ tiŋ n ta shuwa ŋko gbiti ŋ gbiti kumo, ama k kraa maŋ kɔ ŋkpa.

english_verse: Let all the world be silent— the Lord is present in his holy temple.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bre wɔ mbe bɔrɛlambu cheembi to nna, amoso ekama e wora shruum mbe anishito ashi kasawule ere so.

english_verse: This is my prayer:
translation_verse: Kabɔrɛkule nɛ anebi Habakuk kule nde.

english_verse: I know your reputation, Lord, and I am amazed at what you have done. Please turn from your anger and be merciful; do for us what you did for our ancestors.
translation_verse: O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, n nu kusɔ nɛ fo wora, nɛ k mɔ ma kɔnɔ nsaa keta ma kufu. Naniere naŋ wora asheŋgboŋ nɛ fo daŋ wora n sa an nanaana na, anyi alɛ gba be jemanɛ ere to. Hale nɛ fo nya agbo gba, fo baa nyiŋi fo kuwɔrwu na.

english_verse: You are the same Holy God who came from Teman and Paran to help us. The brightness of your glory covered the heavens, and your praises were heard everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Fo e la Ebɔrɛ cheembi nɛ fo shi kadegboŋ nɛ baa tre Tɛman ashi Edɔm be keshishɛrsawule so nɛ kebee nɛ baa tre Paran na so a ba na. Fo kela nɛ kemaŋkura parga to m buu esoso kikɛ so nna, nɛ fo kapandi malɛ sɔ kasawule so be kaplɛkama.

english_verse: Your glory shone like the sun, and light flashed from your hands, hiding your mighty power.
translation_verse: Fo kemaŋkura bee nyɛkpɛ nna fanɛ epeŋi, nɛ kumo be kefulto bee shi fo enɔana to, kakpa nɛ fo eleŋgboŋ ŋana a wɔ na.

english_verse: Dreadful diseases and plagues marched in front and followed behind.
translation_verse: Fo e naa shuŋi kulɔ nɛ e bee juŋkpar, nsaa ponte luwu so nɛ k bee bɛ kumo so na.

english_verse: When you stopped, the earth shook; when you stared, nations trembled; when you walked along your ancient paths, eternal mountains and hills crumbled and collapsed.
translation_verse: Fo baŋ shir n yili, kasawule bee gbuŋgbuŋ nna, fo alɛ baŋ gbɛ ŋ keni malɛ efuliana na bee chicha nna. Dradra be abeegboŋ nɛ abeebi kikɛ bure to n tɔr. Ama fo ere wɔtɔ nna mbaanaayɔ!

english_verse: The tents of desert tribes in Cushan and Midian were ripped apart.
translation_verse: N wu kufu ka pɛ Kushan be yiri to ebi, nɛ Midia be yiri to be basa malɛ bee chicha.

english_verse: Your arrows were ready and obeyed your commands. You split the earth apart with rivers and streams;
translation_verse: Fo daŋ bela fo keta ase nna nseŋ wora shiriya nɛ fo to fo atanyembi. Fo ta elɔr nɛ mbombi m baŋɛ kasawule to.

english_verse: mountains trembled at the sight of you; rain poured from the clouds; ocean waves roared and rose.
translation_verse: Abeegboŋana na ka wu fo nɛ a gbuŋgbuŋ to; nɛ bɔrɛchu shi awɔlpa so n wurge to. Ndoŋ nna nɛ echɛtabo baga to, nɛ amo to be nchu bɔlɔ n dii kepla.

english_verse: The sun and moon stood still, while your arrows and spears flashed like lightning.
translation_verse: Jemanɛ nɛ fo atanyembi nɛ akpaana bee kpa edɛ a firgi a choŋ na, nɛ epeŋi nɛ kufɔl malɛ daa yil diim awɔlto.

english_verse: to rescue your people and save your chosen one. You crushed a nation's ruler and stripped his evil kingdom of its power.
translation_verse: Fo lar m ba nna nɛ fo ba mɔlga fo basa, nɛ fo ewura laraso. Fo ŋmɛa amukpakpasowuraana be ejuŋkparpo n lɛ, nseŋ mur basa nɛ b bɛ mo so na cheche.

english_verse: His troops had come like a storm, hoping to scatter us and glad to gobble us up. To them we were refugees in hiding— but you smashed their heads with their own weapons.
translation_verse: Mbe benapo daŋ yarase fanɛ bɔrɛfugboŋ nna m ba, a tama fanɛ baaŋ pesaŋ anyi to nseŋ mur anyi nɛ bumo be ŋgbene e fuli bumo. Bumo ere kutɔ an la basa jiga nɛ baa shile a ŋana bumo so nna. Ama bumo gbagba be akɔsɔ nɛ fo ta m bure bumo be amu to.

english_verse: Then your chariots churned the waters of the sea. Habakkuk's Response to God's Message
translation_verse: Fo gbagba be egbaŋɛ nɛ fo ta n fɔnɔ teku be nchuana to nɛ e kaa kupɔpɔ.

english_verse: When I heard this message, I felt weak from fear, and my lips quivered. My bones seemed to melt, and I stumbled around. But I will patiently wait. Someday those vicious enemies will be struck by disaster. Trust in a Time of Trouble
translation_verse: Ŋ ka nu ade kikɛ be asheŋ nɛ kufu pɛ ma; hale nɛ ma kɔnɔ bee chicha. Ma eyur daŋ yuri ma nna nɛ awo dii ma nɛ n fara a fiti a fiti jijiga. Ama meeŋ ji kanyiti n jo kachɛ nɛ Ebɔrɛ beeŋ gberge efuli nɛ k bee kɔ anyi kena na kusoe.

english_verse: Fig trees may no longer bloom, or vineyards produce grapes; olive trees may be fruitless, and harvest time a failure; sheep pens may be empty, and cattle stalls vacant—
translation_verse: Hale nɛ figi be ndibi maŋ sɔr gba, nɛ afeelebi nɛ baa tre greeps na maŋ kɔ asɔrso; hale nɛ ɔlif be ndibi maŋ sɔr shɛŋ, nɛ adɔsawule maŋ wora ajibi gba; hale nɛ kubolpɔ koŋwule gba maŋ naa wɔtɔ, nɛ kena koŋwule maŋ naa wɔ kenalu to gba,

english_verse: but I will still celebrate because the Lord God is my Savior.
translation_verse: ŋ kraa beeŋ shin nɛ ma kagbene e fuli ma, ŋkpal Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ka la ma emɔlgapo so.

english_verse: The Lord gives me strength. He makes my feet as sure as those of a deer, and he helps me stand on the mountains. To the music director: Use stringed instruments.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na e naa sa ma eleŋ, nsaa shin nɛ mee mur aya fanɛ shantaŋ, a tiŋ a nite abee to.

english_verse: I am Zephaniah, the son of Cushi, the grandson of Gedaliah, the great-grandson of Amariah, and the great-great-grandson of Hezekiah. When Josiah son of Amon was king of Judah, the Lord gave me this message. Judgment on Judah
translation_verse: Jemanɛ nɛ Ammɔn pibinyɛn Josaya daa la Juda be ewura na, nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ta kubɔya ere n sa Zefanaiya nɛ e la Kushi pibinyɛn na. Kushi mo tuto e daa la Gedaliya nɛ mo alɛ mo tuto daa la ewura Hɛzekaya pibinyɛn Amariya. Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be demujiachɛ na be asheŋ

english_verse: I, the Lord, now promise to destroy everything on this earth—
translation_verse: Le nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na daŋ kaŋɛ: “Meeŋ shin nɛ kusɔ kikɛ e mur kasawule so.

english_verse: people and animals, birds and fish. Everyone who is evil will crash to the ground, and I will wipe out the entire human race.
translation_verse: Ma alɛ beeŋ mur edimɛdi nɛ asɔbɔya nɛ mbuibi nɛ ekɔrɔtɔ kikɛ. Meeŋ bar basa lubi kaseto nseŋ mur nyiŋgbasa kikɛ kasawule ere so. Esa kikɛ maaŋ pete. Ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e kaŋɛ na.

english_verse: I will reach out to punish Judah and Jerusalem— nothing will remain of the god Baal; nothing will be remembered of his pagan priests.
translation_verse: Meeŋ gberge Jerusalɛm to nɛ Juda be efuli so be basa kikɛ kusoe. Meeŋ mur kegbir nɛ baa tre Baal na be kushuŋ kikɛ ashi ndoŋ nɛ ekama maaŋ naaŋ nyiŋi kegbirwura nɛ e daa keni kumo so na gba kuraa.

english_verse: Be silent! I am the Lord God, and the time is near. I am preparing to sacrifice my people and to invite my guests.
translation_verse: Men wora shruum ashi Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na be anishito, ŋkpal manɛ so, mbe demujiachɛ na taga to. E bela ase nɛ e ta mbe basa n lara sarga nseŋ kela n tre bedoŋ fanɛ b ba kɔ Juda kena n suge bumo be asɔ eleŋ so.

english_verse: On that day I will punish national leaders and sons of the king, along with all who follow foreign customs.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ le: “Loŋ be kachɛ na, meeŋ gberge efuli na be benimuana na nɛ ewura be bibinyɛn nɛ bekama nɛ baa bɛ befɔ be edaŋkaresheŋ so na kikɛ kusoe.”

english_verse: I will punish worshipers of pagan gods and cruel palace officials who abuse their power.
