translation_verse: Meeŋ gberge bekama nɛ baa shuŋ nnyamase be agbir nɛ bekama nɛ baa yuri nsaa mɔ basa a sɔ asɔ a bɔlɔ bumo be agbir be ebuana na kusoe.

english_verse: I'll search Jerusalem with lamps and punish those people who sit there unworried while thinking, “The Lord won't do anything, good or bad.”
translation_verse: Kumo be jemanɛ so, meeŋ chɔɔ fitila so n nite ŋ keni Jerusalɛm to n fin bekama nɛ asheŋ maŋ tir bumo nɛ baa kaŋɛ fanɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na maaŋ wora kulubi ŋko kelela na, nseŋ gberge bumo kusoe.

english_verse: Their possessions will be taken, their homes left in ruins. They won't get to live in the houses they build, or drink wine from the grapes in their own vineyards. A Terrible Day
translation_verse: Basa pɔtɛ beeŋ suge bumo be asɔ lela kikɛ nseŋ bure bumo be nwu. B maaŋ nya n chena nwu nɛ bumo gbagba pɔr to ŋko n nya bumo be ndibisɔrso be asɔrso nɛ baa tre greeps na be nsa n nuu.”

english_verse: The great day of the Lord is coming soon, very soon. On that terrible day, fearsome shouts of warriors will be heard everywhere.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be kachɛgboŋ na taga to. K fo n loge gba kuraa! K beeŋ baa la kachɛ lubi nɛ benapo lempo nɛ b kɔ kenyɛn ga gba beeŋ baa boŋ to a shu kenishipereso nna.

english_verse: It will be a time of anger— of trouble and torment, of disaster and destruction, of darkness and despair, of storm clouds and shadows,
translation_verse: Kamɔnchɛ na beeŋ baa la agbo lubi nɛ etɔrɔ nɛ kayurnyaŋ damta nɛ ebesa nɛ kemur nɛ tentembiri mina nɛ awɔlpa be kebuuso be kachɛ nna.

english_verse: Not even your silver or gold can save you on that day when I, the Lord, am angry. My anger will flare up like a furious fire scorching the earth and everyone on it.”
translation_verse: Kachɛ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be agbogboŋ na beeŋ gbelge bumo so na, eshuwa nɛ egbiti nɛ b kɔ na kikɛ gba maaŋ tiŋ m mɔlga bumo. Mbe agbo na beeŋ koso fanɛ edɛ m mur kasawule kikɛ. Nɛ esa kama nɛ e wɔ durnya to be kebaawɔtɔ e ba ekar epul to.

english_verse: You disgraceful nation, gather around,
translation_verse: Kanishinyɔrpaŋ be efuli be basa ere, men ba abar so

english_verse: before it's too late. The Lord has set a time when his fierce anger will strike like a storm and sweep you away.
translation_verse: pɔɛŋ nɛ afu e foŋ menyi n ya lɛ fanɛ afɔfɔ ŋko pɔɛŋ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be agbogboŋ na e kaa alegaiso m ba menyi so.

english_verse: To you people of Philistia who live along the coast, the Lord has this to say: “I am now your enemy, and I'll wipe you out!”
translation_verse: Asheŋ maaŋ nyalɛ n sa menyi Filistiebi nɛ men chena teku ase na. Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na tiŋ n ji menyi demu nseŋ ji m bri menyi. E beeŋ mur menyi nɛ menyi to be ekoŋwule gba maaŋ ka.

english_verse: The Lord God hasn't forgotten those survivors in Judah, and he will help them— his people will take your land to use for pasture. And when evening comes, they will rest in houses at Ashkelon. Judgment on Moab and Ammon *
translation_verse: Juda be efuli so be basa nɛ baaŋ ji efute na beeŋ sɔ menyi be kasawule n chena so. Baaŋ baa kpa bumo be mbolpɔ a yɔ keji to ndoŋ nsaa di nwu nɛ a wɔ Ashkɛlɔn na to. Enyɛnpe bumo be Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ baa wɔ bumo kutɔ nseŋ shin nɛ b naŋ dii dama.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, said: I've heard Moab and Ammon insult my people and threaten their nation.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ le: “N nu Mowab nɛ Ammɔn be basa ka bee tege nsaa wora ma basa eyurto a ji njɔŋ fanɛ baaŋ sɔ bumo be kasawule.

english_verse: This is how Moab and Ammon will at last be repaid for their pride— and for sneering at the nation that belongs to me, the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Kusɔ nɛ k beeŋ ba Mowab nɛ Ammɔn be basa so ŋkpal bumo be kamoowu nɛ kebaatege nsaa wora Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na be basa eyurto so nna na.

english_verse: I will fiercely attack. Then every god on this earth will shrink to nothing, and everyone of every nation will bow down to me, right where they are. Judgment on Ethiopia
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be asheŋ beeŋ pɛ bumo kufu, jemanɛ nɛ e beeŋ mur kasawule na so be agbirana kikɛ na. Efuliana nɛ a wɔ teku ase kikɛ be basa beeŋ bunyaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ashi bumo gbagba be nsawule so.

english_verse: People of Ethiopia, the sword of the Lord will slaughter you! Judgment on Assyria
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be tokobi na beeŋ mɔ Itiopia be basa gba. Demuji nɛ k beeŋ ba Asiriya be efuli so be asheŋ

english_verse: Herds of wild animals will live in its rubble; all kinds of desert owls will perch on its stones and hoot in the windows. Noisy ravens will be heard inside its buildings, stripped bare of cedar.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ beeŋ ki asɔbɔya be yiri kikɛ be edesekpa. Egbuŋgbula be yiri kikɛ beeŋ baa jɔŋɛ egbal bure so na so nsaa shu a wɔtɔ etokuro to. Baaŋ gboŋi sida be ndibi nɛ b ta m buu nwu na so na kikɛ.

english_verse: Jerusalem's prophets are proud and not to be trusted. The priests have disgraced the place of worship and abused God's Law.
translation_verse: Kumo be anebiana malɛ daa kɔ ŋkpensheŋ be kebaawɔtɔ nna nɛ basa maaŋ tiŋ n yirda bumo. Nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana malɛ bee ta eyurpi a yɔ kakpa cheembi nɛ baa bunyaŋ Ebɔrɛ, nsaa bɔla mbe mbra na so a nya bumo be aparsheŋ.

english_verse: All who do evil are shameless, but the Lord does right and is always fair. With the dawn of each day, God brings about justice.
translation_verse: Ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kraa wɔ kadegboŋ na to a wora kusɔ nɛ k daga, nsaa ji asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so karechɛ kikɛ. Basa nɛ b maŋ niŋi na bre maa ŋana anishinyɔr nsaa wɔtɔ a wora alubi saŋkama.

english_verse: The Lord wiped out nations and left fortresses crumbling in the dirt. Their streets and towns were reduced to ruins and emptied of people.
translation_verse: Le nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ: “M mur efuli damtaana nseŋ bure amo be ndegboŋana be egbalana nɛ ebulempo jeŋgreŋana kikɛ. Esa kama maŋ naa wɔ ndegboŋ na to. Basa malɛ gba maŋ naa nite amo be abɔrbi so nɛ kakpa kikɛ wora shruum.

english_verse: God felt certain that Jerusalem would learn to respect and obey him. Then he would hold back from punishing the city and not wipe it out. But everyone there was eager to start sinning again. Nations Will Turn to the Lord
translation_verse: N daa nyi fanɛ kumo be loŋ beeŋ shin nɛ ma basa e ta bunyaŋ n sa ma nseŋ sɔ kasogberge nɛ n sa bumo na nna, ama k maŋ chɛr ko nɛ b naŋ bɛta a wora alubi nɛ a chɔ amo nɛ b daa wora dra na gba.

english_verse: The Lord said: Just wait for the day when I accuse you nations. I have decided on a day, when I will bring together every nation and kingdom and punish them all in my fiery anger. I will become furious and destroy the earth.
translation_verse: Menyi ere e jo a keni kachɛ nɛ meeŋ wu efuliana na kulubi nseŋ ji amo demu na. N tiŋ n yili kumo fanɛ meeŋ gama efuliana na nɛ kuwurjiana kikɛ abar so nseŋ shin nɛ ma agbo nɛ k bee suse fanɛ edɛ na e ba bumo so. Meeŋ nya agbo ga m mur durnya ere kikɛ.

english_verse: I will purify each language and make those languages acceptable for praising me. Then, with hearts united, everyone will serve only me, the Lord.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ n chɛrga basa nɛ b wɔ efuliana na so be ŋgbene nɛ b naa bunyaŋ ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nawule.

english_verse: From across the rivers of Ethiopia, my scattered people, my true worshipers, will bring offerings to me.
translation_verse: Ma basa nɛ b pesaŋ to nɛ bumo nɛ baa bunyaŋ ma kashenteŋto beeŋ shi hale Itiopia be efuli so be elɔrana be mba ndoŋ m bar esarga m ba sa ma.

english_verse: When that time comes, you won't rebel against me and be put to shame. I'll do away with those who are proud and arrogant. Never will any of them strut around on my holy mountain.
translation_verse: Jemanɛ na kaŋ fo, anishinyɔr maaŋ pɛ menyi nɛ men la ma basa ŋkpal men ka daŋ kini ma nseŋ lar ma kaman na so. Ŋkpal manɛ so, meeŋ ju bekama nɛ b kɔ kamoowu nɛ ŋkpensheŋ be kebaawɔtɔ ashi menyi to, saŋɛ na so menyi maaŋ naŋ kini ma nseŋ lar ma kaman ashi ma kebee cheembi na so.

english_verse: But I, the Lord, won't destroy any of your people who are truly humble and turn to me for safety.
translation_verse: Bekama nɛ b du boeŋ nsaa bar bumo be amu ase kashenteŋto na bre, m maaŋ ju bumo, ŋkpal b ka ta bumo be yirda n deŋi ma so so.

english_verse: The people of Israel who survive will live right and refuse to tell lies. They will eat and rest with nothing to fear. A Song of Celebration
translation_verse: Israɛl be basa nɛ b ka na bre maaŋ wora kulubi, bumo alɛ maaŋ ku efɛ ŋko a na a fule basa. Asheŋ beeŋ baa nite nɛnɛ a sa bumo nɛ shɛŋ maaŋ naa fɔŋ bumo. Esa kikɛ maaŋ naŋ tiŋ n ta kufu n da bumo. Kagbenefuli be kashɛ be asheŋ

english_verse: Everyone in Jerusalem and Judah, celebrate and shout with all your heart!
translation_verse: Israɛlebi, men baa boŋ nshɛ awɔrso kagbenefuliso! Jerusalɛmebi, menyi alɛ gba e baa ji eyur kagbenefuliso!

english_verse: Zion, your punishment is over. The Lord has forced your enemies to turn and retreat. Your Lord is King of Israel and stands at your side; you don't have to worry about any more troubles.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na shin nɛ menyi be kasogberge fo ekar. E shin nɛ men doŋana bɛta ashi menyi so. Mo alɛ e la Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ nɛ e wɔ menyi kutɔ na, men sa maŋ naa ŋana kufu kusɔ ko so.

english_verse: Jerusalem, the time is coming, when it will be said to you: “Don't be discouraged or grow weak from fear!
translation_verse: Jemanɛ ko bee ba nɛ b kaŋɛ Jerusalɛmebi le: ‘Men sa maa ŋana kufu! Menyi alɛ e sa maŋ pɔ aba ŋko a yil chaam ŋkpal kufu so!

english_verse: The Lord your God wins victory after victory and is always with you. He celebrates and sings because of you, and he will refresh your life with his love.” The Lord's Promise to His People
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na wɔ men kutɔ, mbe eleŋgboŋ na e naa kɔ a pɔɔ so a sa menyi. Menyi be asheŋ bee bɔlɔ mo kenishi ga, nɛ mbe kasha bee sa menyi ŋkpa popɔr. Mbe kagbene bee fuli menyi so nna nɛ e bee boŋ nshɛ kagbenefuliso.’

english_verse: I will punish those who mistreat you. I will bring together the lame and the outcasts, then they will be praised, instead of despised, in every country on earth.
translation_verse: Jemanɛ na kaŋ fo, meeŋ gberge bekama nɛ b kɔrfɛ menyi na kusoe. Ma alɛ beeŋ mɔlga ebobi nseŋ gama basa nɛ b pesaŋ to na abar so. Meeŋ shin nɛ bumo be nyɔmɔ e ki bunyaŋ n sa bumo, nɛ durnya kikɛ e baa kpaŋ bumo.

english_verse: I will lead you home, and with your own eyes you will see me bless you with all you once owned. Then you will be famous everywhere on this earth. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Loŋ be jemanɛ na, meeŋ gama menyi be basa abar so m bar bumo epe. Ma alɛ beeŋ shin nɛ menyi be ketre e dii durnya kikɛ to, nseŋ shin nɛ men naŋ dii dama.’ ” Ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ e kaŋɛ na!

english_verse: On the first day of the sixth month of the second year that Darius was king of Persia, the Lord told Haggai the prophet to speak his message to the governor of Judah and to the high priest. So Haggai told Governor Zerubbabel and High Priest Joshua
translation_verse: Ewurgboŋ Dariɔs ka ji Pɛshiya be efuli so be kuwura be kafɛ nyɔsopo to be kufɔl shesopo be kachɛ juŋkparso to, nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ bɔla anebi Heegai so m malga. Kubɔya na daa yɔ Juda be efuli so be gomena, Zerubabel nɛ e la Shealtiɛl pibinyɛn na nɛ bɔrɛmatapo nimuso Joshuwa, nɛ e la Jehozadak pibinyɛn na kutɔ nna.

english_verse: You harvest less than you plant, you never have enough to eat or drink, your clothes don't keep you warm, and your wages are stored in bags full of holes.
translation_verse: Men duu asɔ damta, ama asɔ gbrɛbi nɛ men teŋi. Menyee ji ga, ama menyi alɛ maa moɛ. Menyee nuu nchu ga, ama a maa tuge menyi achukoŋ. Menyee buu asɔbuuso, ama men kraa shu awo. Beshumpo bee shuŋ a nya kakɔka, ama k du fanɛ b kaa bee ta amo a wɔtɔ ekɔlgu nɛ a futi to nna.”

english_verse: But first, go to the hills and get wood for my temple, so I can take pride in it and be worshiped there.
translation_verse: Men dii n yɔ abee so n ya ku ndibi m ba lɔŋɛ ma bɔrɛlambu m pɔr, nɛ ma kagbene e fuli ma nɛ basa e naa bunyaŋ ma kananɛ k daga fanɛ b baa bunyaŋ ma.

english_verse: You expected much, but received only a little. And when you brought it home, I made that little disappear. Why have I done this? It's because you hurry off to build your own houses, while my temple is still in ruins.
translation_verse: Men daa tama keteŋi asɔ damta nna, ama asɔ gbrɛbi nɛ men nya n teŋi. Menyi alɛ ka naŋ bar asɔ nɛ men teŋi na epe, nɛ n shin nɛ afu ba ber amo n yɔ. Manɛ so nɛ n wora loŋ? Ŋkpal ma bɔrɛlambu ka bure a dese nɛ men pere kenishi a pɔr menyi be nwuana so.

english_verse: That's also why the dew doesn't fall and your harvest fails.
translation_verse: Amoso nɛ bɔrɛ maa ba nɛ shɛŋ maŋ tiŋ ŋ kɔr na.

english_verse: And so, at my command everything will become barren—your farmland and pastures, your vineyards and olive trees, your animals and you yourselves. All your hard work will be for nothing.
translation_verse: Ma e shin nɛ ewule ba adɔsawule nɛ abee nɛ ndibi sɔrso be adɔ so nɛ kusɔ kama nɛ k bee shi kasawule to nɛ edimɛdi nɛ asɔbɔya kikɛ so, nɛ menyi be kegben kikɛ to jiga na. B ka wora Ebɔrɛ be kamalga kasonu be asheŋ

english_verse: Zerubbabel and Joshua, together with the others who had returned from exile in Babylonia, obeyed the Lord's message spoken by his prophet Haggai, and they started showing proper respect for the Lord.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Zerubabel nɛ Joshuwa nɛ basa nɛ b shi kenyaya to ashi Babilɔn be efuli so m bɛta m ba na kikɛ wora kubɔya nɛ Enyɛnpe bumo be Ebɔrɛ na ta m bɔla anebi Heegai so n sa bumo na kasonu ŋkpal b ka bee ŋana Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na so.

english_verse: Haggai then told them that the Lord had promised to be with them.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ anebi Heegai kaŋɛ basa na le: “Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nase kɔnɔ ŋ kaŋɛ le: ‘Meeŋ baa wɔ menyi kutɔ.’ ”

english_verse: On the twenty-first day of the next month, the Lord told Haggai the prophet to speak this message to Governor Zerubbabel, High Priest Joshua, and everyone else:
translation_verse: Loŋ be kafɛ nyɔsopo na be kufɔl shunusopo be kachɛ adunyɔ nɛ kako na nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naŋ bɔla anebi Heegai so ŋ kaŋɛ Zerubabel nɛ e la Juda be efuli so be gomena nɛ Joshuwa nɛ e la bɔrɛmatapo nimuso na nɛ basa na kikɛ le:

english_verse: But cheer up! Because I, the Lord All-Powerful, will be here to help you with the work,
translation_verse: Ama ekama e sa maŋ pɔ aba. Menyi ere e baa shuŋ kushuŋ na de, ŋkpal manɛ so, n wɔ menyi kutɔ.

english_verse: just as I promised your ancestors when I brought them out of Egypt. Don't worry. My Spirit is right here with you.
translation_verse: Kɔnɔ koŋwule be ŋkre nɛ ma nɛ men nanaana daŋ kre jemanɛ nɛ b daŋ lar Ijipt be efuli so na nɛ ŋ kraa bɛ so na. Ma alɛ be Kiyoyu kraa wɔ menyi to, amoso men sa maa lɔ kufu.

english_verse: Soon I will again shake the heavens and the earth, the sea and the dry land.
translation_verse: K maaŋ chɛr, meeŋ naŋ gbuŋgbuŋ ebɔrɛso nɛ kasawule so nɛ teku nɛ kasawule wɔlso kikɛ.

english_verse: I will shake the nations, and their treasures will be brought here. Then the brightness of my glory will fill this temple.
translation_verse: Meeŋ baga efuliana na kikɛ to n shin nɛ b bar asɔ lela nɛ baa sha ga na nfe, nɛ ma kemaŋkura e bɔlɔ bɔrɛlambu ere kikɛ to.

english_verse: All silver and gold belong to me,
translation_verse: Durnya to be shuwa nɛ gbiti kikɛ la meya nna.

english_verse: and I promise that this new temple will be more glorious than the first one. I will also bless this city with peace. The Past and the Future
translation_verse: Bɔrɛlambu popɔr ere beeŋ lar kebita a chɔ kedra na, nɛ n shin nɛ ma basa e nya kayurwushi nɛ kedamaya nfe ashi.” Ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na e malga na. Dra na nɛ echefoso be asheŋ

english_verse: to ask the priests for their opinion on the following matters:
translation_verse: “Bishi bɔrɛmatapoana na atuwebi nɛ b kɔ a laŋɛ asheŋ bishiso nɛ mee sha kebishi ere be kaplɛa so:

english_verse: Suppose meat ready to be sacrificed to God is being carried in the folds of someone's clothing, and the clothing rubs against some bread or stew or wine or olive oil or any other food. Would those foods that were touched then become acceptable for sacrifice? “Of course not,” the priests answered.
translation_verse: Nɛ fanɛ esa pɛ mbe piŋi tenteŋ be kɔnɔso m bɔɔ eblaŋ nɛ k du cheembi ŋkpal b ka ta kumo n lara sarga n sa Ebɔrɛ so, nɛ piŋi tenteŋ na beta bodobodo ŋko ajibi daŋɛso ŋko yabra ŋko ajibi pɔtɛ ko, loŋ beeŋ tiŋ n shin nɛ amo alɛ gba e ki cheembi a?” Ndoŋ nna nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana na kaŋɛ: “Ayai, loŋ maaŋ tiŋ n wora.”

english_verse: Then Haggai said, “Suppose someone has touched a dead body and is considered unacceptable to worship God. If that person touches these foods, would they become unclean?” “Of course they would,” the priests answered.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Heegai bishi bumo, “Nɛ fanɛ esa wora eyurpi ŋkpal e ka beta ebuni so nseŋ beta ajibi, loŋ be ajibi na gba wora eyurpi a?” Nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana na kaŋɛ, “Mm, a wora eyurpi.”

english_verse: But from now on, things will get better. Before you started laying the foundation for the temple,

translation_verse: e kaŋɛ Zerubabel nɛ e la Juda be efuli so be gomena na le: “Mee sha kegbuŋgbuŋ ebɔrɛso nɛ kasawule so kikɛ nna.

english_verse: On the twenty-fourth day of Shebat, which was the eleventh month of that same year, the Lord spoke to me in a vision during the night: In a valley among myrtle trees, I saw someone on a red horse, with riders on red, brown, and white horses behind him.

english_verse: The angel who was sent to explain was there, and so I asked, “What do these mean?” His answer was, “These horns are the nations that scattered the people of Judah, Israel, and Jerusalem, and took away their freedom.” Then the Lord showed me four blacksmiths, and I asked, “What are they going to do?” He replied, “They are going to terrify and crush those horns.”

english_verse: This time I saw someone holding a measuring line,

english_verse: And so, he will put you in the power of your slaves, and they will raid and rob you. Then you will know that I am a prophet of the Lord All-Powerful.

translation_verse: B ka bugi kelantaŋɛ na be buuso nɛ b ta epal n lɔŋɛ na nɛ n wu fanɛ eche ko e daa tase kumo to!

english_verse: “This woman represents evil,” the angel explained. Then he threw her back into the basket and slammed the heavy cover down tight.
translation_verse: Nɛ malaika na kaŋɛ: “Kache ere yili n sa kumu kpakpaso nna.” Kumo be kaman nɛ e naŋ ŋin kelantaŋɛ na be buuso m buu so kpakpa.

english_verse: Right after this I saw two women coming through the sky with wings outstretched like a stork in the wind. Suddenly they lifted the basket into the air,
translation_verse: Ŋ ka naŋ maŋ kumu so ŋ keni esoso nɛ n wu beche anyɔ ko nɛ b kɔ tɔkɔrkɔ be atɛ lempo ka firgi m ba ŋ kutɔ m ba fuu kelantaŋɛ na n firgi a yɔ.

english_verse: and I asked the angel, “Where are they taking the basket?”
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ m bishi malaika nɛ e daa malga ŋ kutɔ na le: “Nnɛ nɛ b kɔ kelantaŋɛ na a yɔ?”

english_verse: “To Babylonia,” he answered, “where they will build a house for the basket and set it down inside.”
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ e kaŋɛ: “Babilɔn be efuli so nɛ b kɔ kumo a yɔ nɛ b ya pɔr lambu n ta kumo n wɔtɔ nɛ basa e baa bunyaŋ kumo ndoŋ.”

english_verse: Finally, I looked up and saw four chariots coming from between two bronze mountains.
translation_verse: Kede be kaman nɛ n naŋ ku bɔrɛdare ko gba n wu egbaŋɛturko ana ko ka shi danyaŋ be abee anyɔ ko be kefɛato a ba.

english_verse: The first chariot was pulled by red horses, and the second by black horses;
translation_verse: Gbaŋɛ peper e daa gberge sososo be gbaŋɛturko na nɛ gbaŋɛ lembir malɛ daa gberge kenyɔsopo na.

english_verse: the third chariot was pulled by white horses, and the fourth by spotted gray horses.
translation_verse: Egbaŋɛ fuful e daa gberge gbaŋɛturko sasopo na nɛ egbaŋɛ muchɛr muchɛr malɛ daa gberge kenasopo na. Egbaŋɛ na kikɛ daa gberge amo eleŋso nna.

english_verse: “Sir,” I asked the angel. “What do these stand for?”
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ m bishi malaika na: “Gafrache, egbaŋɛturko ere be kifito a?”

english_verse: Then he explained, “These are the four winds of heaven, and now they are going out, after presenting themselves to the Lord of all the earth.
translation_verse: Nɛ e kaŋɛ: “A yili nna n sa ayoyu ana nɛ a shi Ebɔrɛ nɛ e la Enyɛnpe durnya kikɛ so na kutɔ m ba na.”

english_verse: The chariot with black horses goes toward the north, the chariot with white horses goes toward the west, and the one with spotted horses goes toward the south.”
translation_verse: Egbaŋɛ lembir na daa gberge gbaŋɛturko na nna a yɔ Babilɔn be efuli so nɛ k wɔ kelargato be esoso be kaba so na, nɛ egbaŋɛ fuful na malɛ daa yɔ epeŋitɔrkpa be kaba so nɛ bemuchɛr muchɛr na malɛ daa yɔ kelargato be kaseto be kaba so.

english_verse: The horses came out eager to patrol the earth, and the angel told them, “Start patrolling the earth.” When they had gone on their way,
translation_verse: Egbaŋɛ lempoana na ka daŋ lar m ba na b daa fin keyɔ durnya be efuli kama so kenishipereso nna. Ndoŋ nna nɛ malaika na kaŋɛ egbaŋɛ na le: “Meeŋ ya nite ŋ kulti durnya be efuli kikɛ so!” Nɛ b nu nseŋ yɔ.

english_verse: he shouted to me, “Those that have gone to the country in the north will do what the Lord's Spirit wants them to do there.” The Chosen Leader
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ malaika na boŋ to ŋ kaŋɛ ma “Egbaŋɛ nɛ a yɔ Babilɔn be efuli so nɛ k wɔ kelargato be esoso be kaba so na e shin nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be agbo wushi.” Joshuwa be kuwurwuro be asheŋ

english_verse: Heldai, Tobijah, and Jedaiah have returned from Babylonia. Collect enough silver and gold from them to make a crown. Then go with them to the house of Josiah son of Zephaniah and put the crown on the head of the high priest Joshua son of Jehozadak.
translation_verse: “Sɔ shuwa nɛ gbiti be ŋkɛ ashi Helda nɛ Tobija nɛ Jedaya nɛ b la basa nɛ b shi Babilɔn be efuli so m bɛta na kutɔ n wora kuwurwuro. Kumo be kaman nɛ fo nɛ bumo e yɔ Josaya nɛ e la Zefanaiya pibinyɛn na pe n ya ta kuwurwuro na m buu bɔrɛmatapo nimuso Joshuwa nɛ e la Jehozadak pibinyɛn na.

english_verse: Tell him that I, the Lord All-Powerful, say, “Someone will reach out from here like a branch and build a temple for me. I will name him ‘Branch,’ and he will rule with royal honors. A priest will stand beside his throne, and the two of them will be good friends.
translation_verse: Mo e naŋ pɔr kumo n nya kemaŋkura fanɛ ewura na nseŋ ji mbe basa so kuwura. Mo nɛ bɔrɛmatapo ko beeŋ wora kɔnɔkoŋwule n chɛ abar to n shuŋ kayurwushiso.’

english_verse: This crown will be kept in my temple as a reminder and will be taken care of by Heldai, Tobijah, Jedaiah, and Josiah.”
translation_verse: Kuwurwuro na beeŋ baa la kanyiŋi be kusɔ bɔrɛlambu na to n sa Heldai nɛ Tobija nɛ Jedaya nɛ Josaya nɛ e la Zefanaiya pibinyɛn na.”

english_verse: When people from distant lands come and help build the temple of the Lord All-Powerful, you will know that the Lord is the one who sent me. And this will happen, if you truly obey the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Basa beeŋ shi efuli wɔfɔ so m ba chɛ to n lɔŋɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be bɔrɛlambu na m pɔr. B kaŋ lɔŋɛ kumo m pɔr n loge na nɛ feeŋ pin fanɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na e shuŋi ma. Fo baa wora Enyɛnpe fo Ebɔrɛ na be mbraana kikɛ kasonu, ade kikɛ beeŋ wora m bɔlɔ so ashi fo kebaawɔtɔ to.

english_verse: On the fourth day of Chislev, the ninth month of the fourth year that Darius was king of Persia, the Lord again spoke to me.
translation_verse: Ewurgboŋ Dariɔs ka ji Pɛshiya be efuli so be kuwura be kafɛ nasopo to be kufɔl kpanusopo nɛ baa tre Keslɛv na be kachɛ nasopo to nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ta kubɔya n sa ma, Zakareya.

english_verse: It happened after the people of Bethel had sent Sharezer with Regem-Melech and his men to ask the priests in the Lord's temple and the prophets to pray for them. So they prayed, “Should we mourn and go without eating during the fifth month, as we have done for many years?”
translation_verse: nseŋ naŋ bishi bɔrɛmatapoana na nɛ anebiana na le be kesheŋ bishiso ere: “An baa kraa shu nli nsaa kishi kufɔl nusopo na to fanɛ kananɛ an wora nfɛ damta ŋkpal b ka daŋ bure bɔrɛlambu na so a?”

english_verse: It was then that the Lord All-Powerful told me to say to everyone in the country, including the priests: For
translation_verse: E yɛ: “Kaŋɛ efuli na so ebi nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana na fanɛ mannɛ ma ere be kemaŋkura so nɛ b daa kishi nsaa shu nli kufɔl nusopo nɛ keshunusopo na to nfɛ adushunu nɛ a choŋ na.

english_verse: And when you eat and drink, isn't it for your own enjoyment?
translation_verse: B ka daa ji a nuu na bre ma so nɛ b daa wora loŋ a?”

english_verse: So once again, I, the Lord All-Powerful, tell you, “See that justice is done and be kind and merciful to one another!
translation_verse: E yɛ: “Dra dra na kikɛ nɛ n ta atande ere n sa ma basa ŋ kaŋɛ bumo le: ‘Men baa wora asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so, men baa la basa nsaa wora kelela nsaa wu abar kuwɔr.

english_verse: Don't mistreat widows or orphans or foreigners or anyone who is poor, and stop making plans to hurt each other.”
translation_verse: Men sa maa kɔrfɛ bekulpoche nɛ amunibi nɛ befɔ nɛ b chena menyi to nɛ betentaŋasepo. Menyi alɛ e sa maa fɛ nfɛra lubi a laŋɛ men braana be kaplɛa so ashi menyi be ŋgbene to.’ ”

english_verse: But everyone who heard those prophets, stubbornly refused to obey. Instead, they turned their backs on everything my Spirit had commanded the earlier prophets to preach. So I, the Lord, became angry
translation_verse: nseŋ wora bumo be ŋgbene kpakpa fanɛ awarabi nsaa maa kaŋ asoe a nu mmalga nɛ ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na be Kiyoyu bɔla anebi juŋkparsoana so n ta n sa bumo na ŋko a bɛ ma mbra so. Amoso n daŋ nya agbo nna ga n wɔtɔ bumo.

english_verse: and said, “You people paid no attention when I called out to you, and now I'll pay no attention when you call out to me.”
translation_verse: Ŋkpal b ka daŋ kini kenu n sa ma jemanɛ nɛ n daa malga bumo kutɔ na so, nɛ ma alɛ gba maŋ nu bumo be kekule.

english_verse: That's why I came with a whirlwind and scattered them among foreign nations, leaving their lovely country empty of people and in ruins.
translation_verse: N daŋ pesaŋ bumo to nna n ya lɛ efuli pɔtɛana so fanɛ kananɛ afugboŋ bee pesaŋ asɔ to n ya kaa lɛ na, nɛ bumo be kasawule lela na dese fuloŋ nɛ esa kikɛ daa maŋ naa wɔ kumo so.

english_verse: I will return to Jerusalem and live there on Mount Zion. Then Jerusalem will be known as my faithful city, and Zion will be known as my holy mountain.
translation_verse: Meeŋ naŋ bɛta m ba chena Zayɔn be kebee na so ashi Jerusalɛm to. Aloŋ nɛ ekama beeŋ pin fanɛ Jerusalɛm la ma beyirdapo be kadegboŋ nna nɛ Zayɔn malɛ la ma kebee cheembi.

english_verse: Very old people with walking sticks will once again sit around in Jerusalem,
translation_verse: Basa belso nɛ baa keta akpabi a nite beeŋ naa gama a chena abar so ashi Jerusalɛm to

english_verse: while boys and girls play in the streets.
translation_verse: nɛ mbinyɛnsobi nɛ bechesobi malɛ e sɔ agbembi so a pel.

english_verse: This may seem impossible for my people who are left, but it isn't impossible for me, the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ: Basa nɛ baaŋ ka efuli na so beeŋ baa fɛ fanɛ loŋ maaŋ tiŋ n wora, ama kumo be kewora maŋ du ma so kpakpa.

english_verse: I will save those who were taken to lands in the east and the west,
translation_verse: Meeŋ mɔlga ma basa ashi efuliana nɛ a wɔ epeŋilarkpa nɛ epeŋitɔrkpa na

english_verse: and I will bring them to live in Jerusalem. They will be my people, and I will be their God, faithful to bring about justice.
translation_verse: nseŋ bɛta bumo m ba chena Jerusalɛm to. Baaŋ ba kaa la ma basa nɛ ma alɛ e baa la bumo be Ebɔrɛ nsaa ji kuwura bumo so kashenteŋ nɛ kumo be ekpa so.”

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful! So don't give up. Think about the message my prophets spoke when the foundation of my temple was laid.
translation_verse: Kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ nde: “Mmalga nɛ ma anebiana na daŋ malga jemanɛ nɛ b daa tɔl ma bɔrɛlambu na be gbaltɔlase na nɛ menyee nu na, amoso men baa kɔ kenyɛn nsaa maa pɔ aba.

english_verse: My people, only a few of you are left, and I promise not to punish you as I did before.
translation_verse: Ama naniere bre, m maaŋ naŋ gberge menyi basa gbrɛbi nɛ men ka ere kusoe fanɛ kananɛ n daŋ wora bedarapo na jemanɛ nɛ k choŋ na.

english_verse: Instead, I will make sure that your crops are planted in peace and your vineyards are fruitful, that your fields are fertile, and the dew falls from the sky.
translation_verse: Meeŋ shin nɛ men dɔ n duu menyi be asɔduuso kayurwushiso. Menyi be afeelebi nɛ e bee sɔr asɔrso nɛ baa tre greeps na beeŋ sɔr nɛnɛ, nɛ bɔrɛ e ba ga nɛ men be kasawule e wora adɔjibi nɛnɛ. Ma efuli so be basa nɛ baaŋ ji efute na nɛ meeŋ nɛfa le be ekpa so.

english_verse: People of Judah and Israel, you have been a curse to the nations, but I will save you and make you a blessing to them. So don't be afraid or lose courage.
translation_verse: Efuli pɔtɛana be basa bee shoduu menyi Juda nɛ Israɛl be efuliana so ebi nna, ama meeŋ mɔlga menyi nseŋ shin nɛ men ki nɛfa be basa. Men baa kɔ kenyɛn nsaa maa lɔ kufu.”

english_verse: When your ancestors made me angry, I decided to punish you with disasters, and I didn't hold back.
translation_verse: Ade be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ: “Men nanaana ka daŋ shin nɛ n nya agbo na, n daŋ kre fanɛ meeŋ shin nɛ b ji jɛrbi nna nseŋ shin nɛ loŋ wora.

english_verse: Now you no longer need to be afraid. I have decided to treat Jerusalem and Judah with kindness.
translation_verse: Ama naniere mee kre kenɛfa Jerusalɛm to nɛ Juda be efuli so ebi nna. Amoso men sa maa lɔ kufu.

english_verse: But you must be truthful with each other, and in court you must give fair decisions that lead to peace.
translation_verse: Asɔ nɛ a daga fanɛ men baa wora e la kebaaji abar kashenteŋ nsaa ji asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so ashi menyi be demujikpaana saŋɛ na so kayurwushi beeŋ baa wɔ menyi to.

english_verse: Don't ever plan evil things against others or tell lies under oath. I, the Lord, hate such things. A Time of Celebration
translation_verse: Men sa maa kre kebaawora abar kulubi. Men sa maa bɔ ntaŋ a ji efɛ be eshɛda. Ŋ kishi le be alubiana ere kikɛ nna.”

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful told me to say:
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ ma fanɛ ŋ kaŋɛ le.

english_verse: People of Judah, I, the Lord, demand that whenever you go without food as a way of worshiping me, it should become a time of celebration. No matter if it's the fourth month, the fifth month, the seventh month, or the tenth month, you should have a joyful festival. So love truth and live at peace.
translation_verse: E yɛ: “Ekishi nɛ menyee kishi kufɔl nasopo nɛ kenusopo nɛ keshunusopo nɛ kudusopo to na beeŋ ki kayurji nɛ kagbenefuli be nchɛgboŋ n sa Juda be efuli so ebi. Amoso a daga fanɛ men baa sha kashenteŋ nɛ kayurwushi.”

english_verse: Those of one town will go to another and say, “We're going to ask the Lord All-Powerful to treat us with kindness. Come and join us.”
translation_verse: Bumo nɛ b shi kadegboŋ koŋwule to beeŋ kaŋɛ abar le: ‘Anyee yɔ nna nɛ an ya bunyaŋ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na nseŋ kule mo nɛ e nɛfa anyi. Amoso men ba nɛ an yɔ!’

english_verse: Many people from strong nations will come to Jerusalem to worship me and to ask me to treat them with kindness.
translation_verse: Basa damta beeŋ shi efuligboŋana so m ba Jerusalɛm to m ba bunyaŋ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na nseŋ kule mo fanɛ e nɛfa bumo.

english_verse: When this happens, ten people from nations with different languages will grab a Jew by his clothes and say, “Let us go with you. We've heard that God is on your side.” I, the Lord All-Powerful, have spoken!
translation_verse: Loŋ be jemanɛ na so, eyiri pɔtɛ nɛ efuli pɔtɛana so be basa kudu beeŋ pɛ Israɛl be esa koŋwule be kale to nsaa kaŋɛ mo le: Shin nɛ an bɛ fo so a yɔ, ŋkpal manɛ so, an nu fanɛ Ebɔrɛ wɔ men kutɔ nna.”

english_verse: This is a message from the Lord: His eyes are on everyone, especially the tribes of Israel. So he pronounces judgment against the cities of Hadrach and Damascus.
translation_verse: Kubɔya nɛ k shi Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kutɔ nde: E yɛ, mbe anishi yuu edimɛdi kikɛ so nna, fɔŋfɔŋ eyiri yiri nɛ b wɔ Israɛl be efuli so na. Mo alɛ naŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ mbe demuji na beeŋ ba Hadrak nɛ kadegboŋ nɛ baa tre Damaskɔs na ashi Siriya be efuli so na so.

english_verse: Judgment will also fall on the nearby city of Hamath, as well as on Tyre and Sidon, whose people are clever.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman mbe demuji beeŋ ba Hamaf be kade nɛ k mata Hadrak na gba so. Nde nɛ baa tre Tayɛ nɛ Sidɔn nɛ amo to be basa nyi kasheŋ wora ga na gba maaŋ lar demuji na to.

english_verse: Tyre has built a fortress and piled up silver and gold, as though they were dust or mud from the streets.
translation_verse: Tayɛ be basa pɔr ebu lempo jeŋgreŋ ko a kuŋ bumo be amu nna nseŋ gbare shuwa nɛ gbiti m biti abar so fanɛ eshishɛr na!

english_verse: A mob of half-breeds will settle in Ashdod, and the Lord himself will rob Philistia of pride.
translation_verse: Eyiri bubɔrɔ e naŋ ba sɔ Ashdɔd be kade na n chena, nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na gbagba e shin nɛ Filistiebi na e ŋaba a maaŋ naa tiŋ m puchi kikɛ.

english_verse: No longer will the Philistines eat meat with blood in it or any unclean food. They will become part of the people of our God from the tribe of Judah. And God will accept the people of Ekron, as he did the Jebusites.
translation_verse: Filistiebi na maaŋ naa we eblaŋ nɛ a kraa kɔ ŋklaŋ amo to ŋko a ji ajibi nɛ baa kishi. Bekama nɛ baaŋ ji efute na beeŋ ki ma basa a du fanɛ Juda be yiri to be kabuna ko be basa. Ekrɔnebi malɛ beeŋ ki ma basa fanɛ kananɛ Jebusiebi ki na.

english_verse: God says, “I will stand guard to protect my temple from those who come to attack. I know what's happening, and no one will mistreat my people ever again.” The Lord Tells about the Coming King
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ yɛ: “Meeŋ baa kuŋ ma kasawule nɛ benapo nɛ baa kulti a mɔ basa na maaŋ nya kumo so m bɔla choŋ. M maaŋ sa kumukpakpasowuraana ekpa nɛ b naa kɔrfɛ ma basa. N wu awurfoŋ nɛ ma basa ji na kikɛ.” Zayɔn be ewura popɔr na be asheŋ

english_verse: Everyone in Jerusalem, celebrate and shout! Your king has won a victory, and he is coming to you. He is humble and rides on a donkey; he comes on the colt of a donkey.
translation_verse: Ekama nɛ e wɔ Jerusalɛm to e baa ji eyur nsaa wora awɔr kagbenefuliso! Ŋkpal manɛ so menyi be ewura kɔ m pɔɔ so nsaa ba menyi kutɔ; e du boeŋ nna nseŋ dii kurmafɔlbi a ba.

english_verse: I, the Lord, will take away war chariots and horses from Israel and Jerusalem. Bows that were made for battle will be broken. I will bring peace to nations, and your king will rule from sea to sea. His kingdom will reach from the Euphrates River across the earth. The Lord Promises To Rescue Captives
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na yɛ: “Meeŋ lara kena to be egbaŋɛturko nɛ egbaŋɛ ashi Israɛl be efuli so nɛ Jerusalɛm to. Ata nɛ b lɔŋɛ ŋkpal kena so na beeŋ buri to. Meeŋ bar kayurwushi efuliana na so, nɛ menyi be ewura e yili teku ko ase a ji kuwura n ya fo teku nyɔsopo ase. Mbe kuwurji beeŋ shi Yufreetes be Lɔr na ase n ya fo durnya be ekar kikɛ.” Kenaŋ laŋɛ Ebɔrɛ be basa m ba be asheŋ

english_verse: When I made a sacred agreement with you, my people, we sealed it with blood. Now some of you are captives in waterless pits, but I will come to your rescue
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na yɛ: “Ŋkpal ma nɛ menyi be kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre nɛ b ta esarga be ŋklaŋ m mɔ kumo so na so, meeŋ lara menyi be basa ashi kenyaya nɛ k du fanɛ kemaŋ chiŋgeliŋ nɛ k maŋ kɔ nchu na to.

english_verse: and offer you hope. Return to your fortress, because today I will reward you with twice what you had.
translation_verse: Men bɛta m ba menyi be kumɔlga be kakpa lempo na nseŋ nya tama. Ŋkpal manɛ so, kabre meeŋ laŋɛ asɔ nɛ men daa kɔ na be ntuŋ anyɔso n sa menyi.

english_verse: I will use Judah as my bow and Israel as my arrow. I will take the people of Zion as my sword and attack the Greeks. The Lord Will Protect His People
translation_verse: Meeŋ ta Judaebi fanɛ enapo be keta na, nseŋ ta Israɛlebi malɛ fanɛ ma atanyembi.” Ma alɛ beeŋ naŋ ta Zayɔn be basa fanɛ ma tokobi, ŋ kɔ Griikebi kena.

english_verse: Like a cloud, the Lord God will appear over his people, and his arrows will flash like lightning. God will sound his trumpet and attack in a whirlwind from the south.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ ba buu mbe basa so fanɛ bɔrɛwɔlpa, nseŋ to mbe atanyembi fanɛ bɔrɛ ka nyɛkpɛ na. Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ beeŋ foŋ mbe kabel nseŋ bɔla bɔrɛfu to n shi kelargato be kaseto m ba.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful will protect his people, and they will trample down the sharpshooters and their slingshots. They will drink and get rowdy; they will be as full as a bowl at the time of sacrifice.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ baa kuŋ mbe basa, nɛ b kɔ m pɔɔ bumo doŋana so m mur bumo. Baaŋ baa wora awɔr kena to fanɛ basa boo so nseŋ shin nɛ ŋklaŋ e lar bumo doŋana be eyurana so a shile fanɛ kananɛ bɔrɛmatapo bee chulgi sarga be asɔbɔya be ŋklaŋ a wurge bɔrɛsure na so na.

english_verse: The Lord God will save them on that day, because they are his people, and they will shine on his land like jewels in a crown.
translation_verse: Kamɔnchɛ na Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e naŋ mɔlga mbe basa fanɛ kananɛ mbolpɔkpapo bee mɔlga mbe mbolpɔ ashi kenishipere to na. Baaŋ baa nyɛkpɛ mbe kasawule so fanɛ kuwurwuro so be amaŋkanibi na.

english_verse: How lovely they will be. Young people will grow there like grain in a field or grapes in a vineyard.
translation_verse: Baaŋ baa walɛ kebita kashenteŋto! Mbifɔlbi beeŋ daŋ a kɔ eleŋ nɛnɛ ŋkpal b ka beeŋ nya aboyu damta a ji nsaa nya yabra popɔr a nuu so.

english_verse: I, the Lord, am the one who sends storm clouds and showers of rain to make fields produce. So when the crops need rain, you should pray to me.
translation_verse: Men kule Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bɔrɛchu kechali so. Mo e naa shin nɛ bɔrɛ bee mɔl a ba, a shin nɛ kasawule so bee nya kayul nɛ asɔduu bee kɔr a wora nɛ edimɛdi bee nya a ji.

english_verse: You can't believe idols and fortunetellers, or depend on the hope you receive from witchcraft and interpreters of dreams. But you have tried all of these, and now you are like sheep without a shepherd.
translation_verse: Basa bee yɔ agbir to nɛ bekpalpo kutɔ nna, ama asheŋ fuloŋ nɛ efɛsheŋ nɛ baa nya ashi bumo kutɔ. Beko bee kute edare be afito, ama bumo alɛ bee fule basa nna a sa bumo kagbenewushi fuloŋ. Ŋkpal loŋ so basa bee nite a kulti fanɛ mbolpɔ foeso nna. Asheŋ maa nyalɛ a sa bumo ŋkpal b ka maŋ kɔ esa nɛ e bee keni bumo so so.

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, am fiercely angry with you leaders, and I will punish you. I care for my people, the nation of Judah, and I will change this flock of sheep into charging war horses.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na yɛ: “N nya agbo nna n wora befɔ nɛ baa ji kuwura ma basa so nsaa shin nɛ ŋ gberge bumo kusoe. Juda be efuli so be basa na la ma basa nna, nɛ ma Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ baa keni bumo so. Baaŋ baa du fanɛ ma kena to be egbaŋɛ lempo nna.

english_verse: From this flock will come leaders who will be strong like cornerstones and tent pegs and weapons of war.
translation_verse: Bewura nɛ bejuŋkparpo nɛ gomena be ekrachi nimuso nɛ b kɔ eleŋ beeŋ shi Juda be yiri to n lar.

english_verse: They will join in the fighting, and together they will trample their enemies like mud. They will fight, because I, the Lord, will be on their side. And they will crush the enemy cavalry.
translation_verse: Juda be basa beeŋ sɔ kelempo fanɛ benapo nɛ b kɔ m pɔɔ bumo doŋana so nsaa chichi bumo so fanɛ ekpa to be depɔ na. Ŋkpal Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ka wɔ bumo kutɔ so, baaŋ kɔ m pɔɔ bedoŋ nɛ b dii egbaŋɛ a kɔ gba so.

english_verse: I will strengthen the kingdoms of Judah and Israel. And I will show mercy because I am the Lord, their God. I will answer their prayers and bring them home. Then it will seem as though I had never rejected them.
translation_verse: Meeŋ sa Juda be basa eleŋ, nseŋ mɔlga Israɛl be basa. Meeŋ wu bumo kuwɔr nseŋ bɛta bumo kikɛ m ba epe. Baaŋ baa du fanɛ basa nɛ m maŋ naŋ kini ŋ ku so nna. Ma e la Enyɛnpe bumo be Ebɔrɛ na; ma alɛ beeŋ nu bumo be kabɔrɛkule.

english_verse: Israel will be like a tribe of warriors celebrating with wine. When their children see this, they will also be happy because of me, the Lord.
translation_verse: Israɛl be basa na beeŋ baa kɔ eleŋ fanɛ benapo, nsaa kɔ kagbenefuli fanɛ eyabra nuupo. Bumo be kaman to ebi beeŋ baa nyiŋi kekɔmpɔɔso ere nɛ bumo be ŋgbene a fuli ŋkpal kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na wora so.

english_verse: I will give a signal for them to come together because I have rescued them. And there will be as many as ever before.
translation_verse: Meeŋ tre ma basa m ba gama abar so, ma alɛ beeŋ mɔlga bumo nseŋ shin nɛ b wora keshi a du fanɛ kananɛ b daa sa na.

english_verse: I will bring them home from Egypt and Assyria, then let them settle as far as Gilead and Lebanon, until the land overflows with them.
translation_verse: Meeŋ ya keta bumo n shi Ijipt nɛ Asiriya be efuliana so m ba epe, nɛ b ba chena bumo gbagba be kasawule so. Meeŋ shin nɛ b chena Giliad nɛ Lebanɔn be nsawule gba so, n sɔ amo kikɛ so.

english_verse: My people will go through an ocean of troubles, but I will overcome the waves and dry up the deepest part of the Nile. Assyria's great pride will be put down, and the power of Egypt will disappear.
translation_verse: B kaŋ bɔla bumo be etɔrɔbi nɛ e du fanɛ teku ere to a choŋ, ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ yɔɔ atili na nseŋ shin nɛ Nail be lɔr nɛ k wɔ Ijipt be efuli so na be kechimbi to be nchu e feeto. Meeŋ shin nɛ Asiriyaebi be kamoowugboŋ na e ba kaseto, nɛ Ijiptebi e paŋ bumo be eleŋgboŋ na.

english_verse: I'll strengthen my people because of who I am, and they will follow me. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Meeŋ naŋ wɔtɔ ma basa eleŋ to, nɛ b baa bunyaŋ ma nsaa wora ma kasonu. Ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e malga na!”

english_verse: Lebanon, open your gates! Let the fire come in to destroy your cedar trees.
translation_verse: Lebanɔnebi men bugi menyi be mbuna, nɛ edɛ e chɔɔ menyi be ndibi nɛ baa tre sida na!

english_verse: Cry, you cypress trees! The glorious cedars have fallen and are rotting. Cry, you oak trees of Bashan! The dense forest has been chopped down.
translation_verse: Seprɛs be ndibi, men baa shu nsaa boŋ to ŋkpal manɛ so, sida be ndibi tɔr; kemaŋkura be ndibi na kikɛ mur! Bashan be ndibigboŋ, men baa shu nsaa boŋ to; ŋkpal b ka ku kupogboŋ na to be ndibi damta na kikɛ n lɛ so!

english_verse: Listen! Shepherds are crying. Their glorious pastures have been ruined. Listen! Lions are roaring. The forests of the Jordan Valley are no more to be found. Worthless Shepherds
translation_verse: Men nu mbolpɔkpapoana ka bee shu awɔrso; ŋkpal bumo be mbolpɔ be ejikpa lela na ka mur so! Men nu ebuluŋ ka bee munto; ŋkpal Jɔɔdan be lɔrkar be kupogboŋ lela na ka mur so! Mbolpɔkpapo anyɔ ko be asheŋ

english_verse: The Lord my God said to me: Tend those sheep doomed for slaughter!
translation_verse: Kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe ma Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ ma nde: “Ta fo kumu ŋ ki fanɛ mbolpɔkpapo nɛ baa shin nɛ b mɔ mbe mbolpɔ.

english_verse: The people who buy and butcher them go unpunished, while everyone who sells them says, “Praise the Lord! I'm rich.” Not even their shepherds have pity on them.
translation_verse: Basa nɛ b tɔ bumo na bee mɔ bumo nna nsaa ta bumo be amu a ji. Nɛ basa nɛ baa fa mbolpɔ na malɛ bee kaŋɛ le: ‘Mee di Ebɔrɛ epaŋ ŋkpal ŋ ka dii dama so!’ Mbolpɔkpapoana na gbagba maa shu mbolpɔ na so.”

english_verse: Tend those sheep because I, the Lord, will no longer have pity on the people of this earth. I'll turn neighbor against neighbor and make them slaves of a king. They will bring disaster on the earth, and I'll do nothing to rescue any of them.
translation_verse: Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ le: “M maaŋ naŋ shu ekama so ashi durnya ere to. Ŋ gbagba beeŋ ta basa na m bɔɔ bumo braana nɛ bewurjipoana enɔ nɛ b mur durnya ere cheche nɛ m maaŋ mɔlga kumo ashi bumo be enɔ to.”

english_verse: So I became a shepherd of those sheep doomed to be slaughtered by the sheep dealers. And I gave names to the two sticks I used for tending the sheep: One of them was named “Mercy” and the other “Unity.”
translation_verse: Ŋkpal loŋ so nɛ ŋ ki mbolpɔ nɛ b kɔ a yɔ nɛ b ya mɔ na be ekenipo, nseŋ ta akpabi anyɔ ŋ keta a kpa bumo na. N daa tre kuko ‘Kushuso’ nsaa tre kuko malɛ ‘Kɔnɔkoŋwule’ nna.

english_verse: In less than a month, I became impatient with three shepherds who didn't like me, and I got rid of them.
translation_verse: Kufɔl koŋwule to nɛ n nya agbo n ju mbolpɔkpapo asa ko nɛ b daŋ kishi ma asheŋ ga na.

english_verse: Then I said, “I refuse to be your shepherd. Let the sheep that are going to die, go on and die, and those that are going to be destroyed, go on and be destroyed. Then let the others eat one another alive.”
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ mbolpɔ na le: “M maaŋ naa la menyi be ekenipo. Bumo nɛ baaŋ wu, b wu. Bumo nɛ baaŋ mur malɛ e mur. Bumo nɛ baaŋ ka malɛ e baa pɛ abar a we.”

english_verse: On that same day, I broke the stick named “Mercy” to show that the Lord had canceled his agreement with all people.
translation_verse: Kumo be kamɔnchɛ nɛ m bu kekpabi nɛ mee tre ‘Kushuso’ na to, a ŋini fanɛ kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ efuliana na kikɛ kre na ku to.

english_verse: I told them, “Pay me my wages, if you think you should; otherwise, forget it.” So they handed me my wages, a measly
translation_verse: Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ ma le: “Ta amo n ya wɔtɔ bɔrɛlambu na be lɔkɔ na to.” Ndoŋ nna nɛ n ta gbiti be ndarbi adesa nɛ b fɛ fanɛ amo e daga ma na n ya wɔtɔ bɔrɛlambu be lɔkɔ na to.

english_verse: Then I broke the stick named “Unity” and canceled the ties between Judah and Israel.
translation_verse: Kede be kaman nɛ n naŋ bu kekpabi nyɔsopo nɛ mee tre ‘kɔnɔkoŋwule’ na to, nɛ Juda nɛ Israɛl be kekurgeji ku to.

english_verse: Next, the Lord said to me, “Act like a shepherd again—this time a worthless shepherd.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ ma le: “Naŋ laŋɛ ŋ ki mbolpɔkpapo nɛ e maŋ kɔ tɔnɔ kikɛ na.

english_verse: Once more I am going to let a worthless nobody rule the land—one who won't care for the strays or search for the young or heal the sick or feed the healthy. He will just dine on the fattest sheep, leaving nothing but a few bones.”
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so n lara mbolpɔkpapo ko fanɛ e ba kaa keni ma mbolpɔ so, ama mo shɛŋ maaŋ baa wɔ bumo nɛ baaŋ foe na to ŋko nɛ e nite n fin bewurbi na ŋko n chɛ bumo nɛ baa lɔ na ŋko ŋ kpa bumo nɛ b kɔ alenfia na n yɔ keji to. Ama bedanso na nɛ e beeŋ baa mɔ a we a ka awibi.

english_verse: You worthless shepherd, deserting the sheep! I hope a sword will cripple your arm and blind your right eye.
translation_verse: Asheŋ maaŋ nyalɛ n sa loŋ be mbolpɔkpapo jiga nɛ e yige mbe mbolpɔ n lɛ na! Mbe eleŋ kikɛ beeŋ mur ashi kena to. Mbe kabre beeŋ wu, nɛ mbe jisoso be kenishi malɛ e tan!”

english_verse: This is a message from the Lord about Israel: I am the Lord! I stretched out the heavens; I put the earth on its foundations and gave breath to humans.
translation_verse: Kubɔya nɛ k shi Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kutɔ a laŋɛ Israɛl be kaplɛa so na nde. Mo e to esoso nseŋ tɔl durnya n yili kumo be gbaltɔlase so, nseŋ sa dimɛdi ŋkpa na.

english_verse: I have decided that Jerusalem will become a bowl of wine that makes the neighboring nations drunk. And when Jerusalem is attacked, Judah will also be attacked.
translation_verse: E yɛ: “N yili kumo nna fanɛ Jerusalɛm e ki fanɛ yabra kurwa nɛ efuliana nɛ a mata kumo na e nuu m boo. Kananɛ baaŋ kre kena m ba kulti Jerusalɛm n wɔtɔ na, aloŋ nɛ baaŋ wora Juda be efuli na kikɛ so.

english_verse: But I will turn Jerusalem into a heavy stone that crushes anyone who tries to lift it. When all nations on earth surround Jerusalem,
translation_verse: Ama loŋ be jemanɛ na kaŋ fo, meeŋ shin nɛ Jerusalɛm e ki fanɛ kejembu gbɛgbɛso, nɛ efuli kama so ebi maaŋ tiŋ n fifir kumo. Bekama nɛ b wora ania nɛ b fifir kumo beeŋ doro bumo be amu.

english_verse: I will blind every horse and make them panic, and every rider will be confused. But at the same time, I will watch over Judah.
translation_verse: Loŋ be kachɛ na meeŋ shin nɛ kufugboŋ ko e tɔr gbaŋɛ kikɛ so nɛ eboŋ e tɔr amo be bediipoana so. Ma e naaŋ baa keni Juda be basa so. Meeŋ shin nɛ bumo doŋana be egbaŋɛ e tan.

english_verse: Then every clan in Judah will realize that I, the Lord All-Powerful, am their God, and that I am the source of their strength.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ Juda be efuli so be mbunaana na be basa e kaŋɛ bumo be amu le: ‘Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na e naa sa mbe basa nɛ b wɔ Jerusalɛm to na eleŋ.’

english_verse: At that time I will let the clans of Judah be like a ball of fire in a wood pile or a fiery torch in a hay stack. Then Judah will send the surrounding nations up in smoke. And once again the city of Jerusalem will be filled with people.
translation_verse: Jemanɛ na kaŋ fo, meeŋ shin nɛ Juda be efuli so be benimuana na e ki fanɛ edɛ ashi kupo to ŋko aboyu nɛ a wɔl a yil to. Baaŋ mur efuliana nɛ e kulti bumo na kikɛ. Ama shɛŋ maaŋ wora basa nɛ b wɔ Jerusalɛm be kadegboŋ na to na bre.

english_verse: But I will first give victory to Judah, so the kingdom of David and the city of Jerusalem in all of their glory won't be thought of more highly than Judah itself.
translation_verse: Ma Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na e naŋ shin nɛ Juda be benapo e juŋkpar ŋ kɔ m pɔɔ so, saŋɛ na so kemaŋkura nɛ ewura Deevid be kaman to ebi nɛ basa nɛ b wɔ Jerusalɛm to beeŋ nya na maaŋ baa chɔ Juda be efuli so be basa nɛ b ka na peya.

english_verse: I, the Lord God, will protect Jerusalem. Even the weakest person there will be as strong as David, and David's kingdom will rule as though my very own angel were its leader.
translation_verse: Loŋ be jemanɛ na, ma Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e naaŋ baa kuŋ bekama nɛ b wɔ Jerusalɛm to, nseŋ shin nɛ bumo to be bepɔshipo gba e baa kɔ eleŋ fanɛ ewura Deevid. Ewura Deevid be kamanebi beeŋ baa juŋkpar bumo fanɛ Ebɔrɛ be malaika gbagba na.

english_verse: I am determined to wipe out every nation that attacks Jerusalem. Mourning for the One Pierced with a Spear
translation_verse: Ma alɛ beeŋ mur efuli kama nɛ k beeŋ wora ania fanɛ k beeŋ kɔ Jerusalɛm kena.

english_verse: I, the Lord, will make the descendants of David and the people of Jerusalem feel deep sorrow and pray when they see the one they pierced with a spear. They will mourn and weep for him, as parents weep over the death of their only child or their first-born.
translation_verse: Ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ shin nɛ kuwɔrwu nɛ kabɔrɛkule be kiyoyu e gbelge m ba ewura Deevid be kamanebi nɛ basa nɛ b wɔ Jerusalɛm to na kikɛ so. Baaŋ to kenishi n wu esa nɛ b da mo kekpa m mɔ na nseŋ shu mbe keeli fanɛ kananɛ baa shu ebi koŋwule be keeli na, nseŋ wora kuwɔr be asheŋ fanɛ esa nɛ e paŋ mbe wurkoŋnyɛn na.

english_verse: On that day the people of Jerusalem will mourn as much as everyone did for Hadad Rimmon on the flatlands near Megiddo.
translation_verse: Kushu nɛ k beeŋ baa wɔ Jerusalɛm to loŋ be kamɔnchɛ na beeŋ baa shi pasaa. K beeŋ baa du fanɛ b ka daa shu Hadad Rimɔn be keeli ashi Megido be keplasawule so na nna.

english_verse: In the future there will be a fountain, where David's descendants and the people of Jerusalem can wash away their sin and guilt.
translation_verse: Nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ naŋ kaŋɛ: “Jemanɛ ko bee ba nɛ kebuye ko e ba kaa bul nchu n fɔr ewura Deevid be kaman to ebi nɛ Jerusalɛm to be basa be alubi nɛ eyurpisheŋ kikɛ n lɛ.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful says: When that time comes, I will get rid of every idol in the country, and they will be forgotten forever. I will also do away with their prophets and those evil spirits that control them.
translation_verse: Jemanɛ na kaŋ fo, meeŋ mur agbirana be atre kasawule na so nɛ esa maaŋ naa nyiŋi amo be asheŋ gba kuraa. Ma alɛ beeŋ lara anebi fɛpoana na nɛ eyurpisheŋ be kiyoyu gba kasawule na so.

english_verse: If any such prophets ever appear again, their own parents must warn them that they will die for telling lies in my name—the name of the Lord. If those prophets don't stop speaking, their parents must then kill them with a sword.
translation_verse: Esa kama kaŋ naa kaŋɛ fanɛ mo ere bee wu abɔrɛsheŋ to nna a kaŋɛ, mo tuto nɛ mo nio gbagba e naŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ e daga luwu, ŋkpal e ka ku efɛ ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be kamalga nɛ e bee malga so. Nɛ e kraŋ kini a malga mo nio nɛ mo tuto gbagba e naaŋ da mo tokobi m mɔ.

english_verse: Those prophets will be ashamed of their so-called visions, and they won't deceive anyone by dressing like a true prophet.
translation_verse: Loŋ be jemanɛ na kaŋ fo, anebi kikɛ maaŋ naa puchi mbe ebɔrɛdare so ŋko a wora anebi be aworbi ŋko a buu anebi be epiŋi a fule basa.

english_verse: Instead, they will say, “I'm no prophet. I've been a farmer all my life.”
translation_verse: Ama kusɔ nɛ e beeŋ kaŋɛ e la fanɛ, ‘Ma ere maŋ la anebi. Ma kebia to kikɛ edɔpo e la ma hale m ba fo kabre.’

english_verse: And if any of them are asked why they are wounded, they will answer, “It happened at the house of some friends.” A Wounded Shepherd and Scattered Sheep
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ esa naŋ bishi mo le: Nɛ manɛ e kpɛa fo eyur so le ere? E beeŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ, ‘N teri ko be laŋ to nɛ n nya amo.’ ” B ka mɔ mbolpɔkpapo nɛ mbolpɔ pesaŋ to be asheŋ

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful said: My sword, wake up! Attack my shepherd and friend. Strike down the shepherd! Scatter the little sheep, and I will destroy them.
translation_verse: Kede be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ: “Tokobi, koso ŋ kɔ mbolpɔkpapo nɛ e bee shuŋ a sa ma na m mɔ mo nɛ mbolpɔ na e yeŋ to m pesaŋ to. Saŋɛ na so meeŋ nya ŋ kɔ ma basa.

english_verse: Nowhere in the land will more than a third of them be left alive.
translation_verse: Kasawule na so be basa na be ntuŋ asa to be ntuŋ anyɔ beeŋ wu m mur nɛ katuŋ koŋwule nawule e ka.

english_verse: Then I will purify them and put them to the test, just as gold and silver are purified and tested. They will pray in my name, and I will answer them. I will say, “You are my people,” and they will reply, “You, Lord, are our God!”
translation_verse: Katuŋ koŋwule nɛ b ka na gba, meeŋ wora bumo ŋ keni nseŋ lɔŋɛ bumo so fanɛ kananɛ baa ta shuwa ŋko gbiti a wɔtɔ edɛ to a lɔŋɛ amo so na. Kumo be kaman pɔɛŋ nɛ baaŋ kule ma nɛ n nu n sa bumo nseŋ kaŋɛ bumo fanɛ b la ma basa nna, nɛ bumo alɛ e bugi to ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na, e la bumo be Ebɔrɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord will have his day. And when it comes, everything that was ever taken from Jerusalem will be returned and divided among its people.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be demujiachɛ na bee ba. Kamɔnchɛ na nɛ baaŋ muu Jerusalɛm to be asɔ m barga to n sa abar ashi menyi gbagba be anishito.

english_verse: But first, he will bring many nations to attack Jerusalem—homes will be robbed, women raped, and half of the population dragged off, though the others will be allowed to remain.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e naŋ gama efuli pɔtɛana na abar so nɛ b ba kɔ Jerusalɛm kena. Baaŋ pɔ kadegboŋ na so nseŋ luri elaŋ to m muu asɔ nseŋ pur beche. Baaŋ pɛ basa na be bargato ŋ ki anya n yɔ efuli pɔtɛana so, ama b maaŋ lara bumo nɛ baaŋ ka na bre kadegboŋ na to.

english_verse: Then you people will escape from the Lord's mountain, through this valley, which reaches to Azal. You will run in all directions, just as everyone did when the earthquake struck in the time of King Uzziah of Judah. Afterwards, the Lord my God will appear with his holy angels.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ men bɔla ketaŋɛ nɛ kebee na baŋɛ to anyɔ n dese n ya fo kakpa nɛ baa tre Azɛl na n shile. Kananɛ men nanaana daŋ shile saŋɛ nɛ kasawule daŋ gbuŋgbuŋ Juda be ewura Uziya be jemanɛ so na gbagba chap nɛ menyi alɛ gba beeŋ shile m mɔlga menyi be amu. Kumo be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nɛ mbe emalaika kikɛ e ba.

english_verse: It will be a bright day that won't turn cloudy or cold.
translation_verse: Loŋ be kachɛ na kaŋ fo, kefulto ŋko awo ŋko kenyɔlɔ maaŋ baa wɔtɔ.

english_verse: Then there will be only one Lord who rules as King and whose name is worshiped everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Loŋ be jemanɛ na, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e naaŋ baa ji durnya kikɛ so kuwura. Mo nawule be ketre nɛ ekama beeŋ baa nyi nsaa bunyaŋ mo nawule fanɛ Ebɔrɛ.

english_verse: Here is what the Lord will do to those who attack Jerusalem: While they are standing there, he will make their flesh rot and their eyes fall from their sockets and their tongues drop out.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ shin nɛ kulɔ lubi e tɔr efuli pɔtɛana be basa nɛ baa kɔ Jerusalɛm kena na so. Bumo be eyurana nɛ anishi nɛ adonduloŋ kikɛ beeŋ bɛ a bɛlge nɛ b kraa keni.

english_verse: until even the people of Judah turn against those in Jerusalem. This same terrible disaster will also strike every animal nearby, including horses, mules, camels, and donkeys. Finally, everything of value in the surrounding nations will be collected and brought to Jerusalem—gold, silver, and piles of clothing.
translation_verse: Kulɔ lubi koŋwule na beeŋ tɔr Jerusalɛmebi bumo doŋana be egbaŋɛ nɛ ekurmafɔlbi nɛ enyɔma nɛ asɔbɔya be yiri yiri kikɛ nɛ b kɔ ashi bumo be keeyi to so.

english_verse: Afterwards, the survivors from those nations that attacked Jerusalem will go there each year to worship the King, the Lord All-Powerful, and to celebrate the Festival of Shelters.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ basa nɛ baaŋ ji efute ashi efuli pɔtɛana nɛ b daŋ kɔ Jerusalɛm kena na e baa yɔ Jerusalɛm to kafɛ kikɛ n ya kaa bunyaŋ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na fanɛ bumo be ewura nsaa ji Abuu to be Kachɛgboŋ na.

english_verse: No rain will fall on the land of anyone in any country who refuses to go to Jerusalem to worship the King, the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Bɔrɛ maaŋ naŋ ba efuli kama so ebi nɛ b kini keyɔ Jerusalɛm to n ya bunyaŋ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na fanɛ bumo be ewura, be kasawule so kikɛ.

english_verse: This horrible disaster will strike the Egyptians and everyone else who refuses to go there for the celebration.
translation_verse: Kasogberge nɛ k beeŋ ba Ijipt be efuli nɛ efuli pɔtɛana nɛ a kini keji Abuu to be Kachɛgboŋ na so nna na.

english_verse: At that time the words “Dedicated to the Lord” will be engraved on the bells worn by horses. In fact, every ordinary cooking pot in Jerusalem will be just as sacred to the Lord All-Powerful as the bowls used at the altar. Any one of them will be acceptable for boiling the meat of sacrificed animals, and there will no longer be a need to sell special pots and bowls.
translation_verse: Baaŋ ta mpuliya daŋɛso kikɛ ashi Jerusalɛm to nɛ Juda be efuli so kikɛ m bɔɔ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na enɔ nɛ e wora amo cheembi. Basa nɛ baa lara esarga na beeŋ ta amo a daŋɛ esarga be eblaŋ. Jemanɛ na kaŋ fo, eyawujipo maaŋ naa wɔ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na be bɔrɛlambu na to.

english_verse: I am Malachi. And this is the message that the Lord gave me for Israel. The Lord's Love for Israel
translation_verse: Kubɔya nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ta n sa kanyɛn ko nɛ baa tre Malakai fanɛ e sa Israɛl be basa nde. Kasha nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kɔ n sa Israɛl be asheŋ

english_verse: Israel, I, the Lord, have loved you. And yet you ask in what way have I loved you. Don't forget that Esau was the brother of your ancestor Jacob, but I chose Jacob
translation_verse: E yɛ: “Israɛlebi, saŋkama, ma kasha wɔ menyi so nna ga.” Ama le nɛ bumo alɛ daŋ kaŋɛ: “Ekpa mo so nɛ fo ŋini anyi kasha?” Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ: “Isɔɔ nɛ Jeekɔb la esa nɛ mo sipo nna, ama Jeekɔb nɛ mbe kaman to ebi nɛ n lara a sha ga,

english_verse: instead of Esau. And I turned Esau's hill country into a barren desert where jackals roam.
translation_verse: nsaa maa sha Isɔɔ nɛ mbe kaman to ebi malɛ be asheŋ nseŋ mur bumo be abee so be efuli na nɛ k ki ejiŋkaamu pe.”

english_verse: Esau's descendants may say, “Although our nation Edom is in ruins, we will rebuild it.” But I, the Lord All-Powerful, promise to tear down whatever they build. Then everyone will know that I will never stop being angry with them as long as they are so sinful.
translation_verse: Hale nɛ Isɔɔ be kaman to ebi nɛ b la Edɔm be efuli so ebi na kaŋɛ le gba: “Anyi be nde kikɛ mur, ama anyi alɛ beeŋ naŋ lɔŋɛ m pɔr amo.” Ma Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na malɛ beeŋ kaŋɛ bumo le: “Nɛ men lɔŋɛ m pɔr amo gba meeŋ naŋ bure amo nɛ basa e baa tre ndoŋ ‘Belubiworapoana be efuli nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be agbo wɔ kumo so mbaanaayɔ.’ ”

english_verse: Israel, when you see this, you will shout, “The Lord's great reputation reaches beyond our borders.” Judgment against Priests
translation_verse: Israɛl be basa beeŋ wu kumo nseŋ kaŋɛ le: “Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be eleŋ bee ji a baŋ Israɛl be efuli gba so nna!” Enyɛnpe na ka maŋ sa bɔrɛmatapoana kashuli be asheŋ

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, have something to say to you priests. Children respect their fathers, and servants respect their masters. I am your father and your master, so why don't you respect me? You priests have insulted me, and now you ask, “How did we insult you?”
translation_verse: Le nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ daŋ kaŋɛ bɔrɛmatapoana na: “Kebia bee bunyaŋ mo tuto nna nɛ kayɛrbi malɛ bee sa mo nyɛnpe bunyaŋ. N la men tuto nna, nɛ manɛ e ba nɛ menyi maa bunyaŋ ma? N la men nyɛnpe nna, nɛ manɛ e ba nɛ menyi maa sa ma bunyaŋ? Men keni ma jiga, ama menyi alɛ kraa bishi fanɛ nuso nɛ an keni fo jiga?

english_verse: You embarrass me by offering worthless food on my altar. Then you ask, “How have we embarrassed you?” You have done it by saying, “What's so great about the Lord's altar?”
translation_verse: Ŋkpal men ka ta ajibi nɛ a maŋ daga keta n lara sarga n deŋi ma bɔrɛsure so so. Kede be kaman nɛ men bishi: ‘Ekpa mo so nɛ an maŋ sa fo bunyaŋ?’ Men ka maŋ keni ma bɔrɛsure m bɔlɔ kenishi so.

english_verse: But isn't it wrong to offer animals that are blind, lame, or sick? Just try giving those animals to your governor. That certainly wouldn't please him or make him want to help you.
translation_verse: Men ka bee ta asɔbɔya nɛ b tan ŋko asɔbɔya nɛ baa lɔ ŋko bumo nɛ bumo be ayaana wu a lara sarga a sa ma na, men fɛ fanɛ loŋ walɛ a? Men ta loŋ be asɔbɔya n ya sa men be gomena e beeŋ kini amo, mo alɛ maaŋ chɛ menyi to.”

english_verse: I am the Lord God All-Powerful, and you had better try to please me. You have sinned. Now see if I will have mercy on any of you.
translation_verse: Nɛ menyi bɔrɛmatapoana kule Ebɔrɛ fanɛ e wu anyi kuwɔr e beeŋ nu menyi be kekule a? Nɛ k baŋ ba loŋ, kumo ere menyi e bar kumo.

english_verse: I wish someone would lock the doors of my temple, so you would stop wasting time building fires on my altar. I am not pleased with you priests, and I refuse to accept any more of your offerings.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpetale yɛ: “Men be eko daŋ ti ma bɔrɛlambu na be akuloŋ k daa beeŋ par ma. Saŋɛ na so men maaŋ baa jija saŋɛ a lara esarga chɔɔso fuloŋ a deŋi ma bɔrɛsure so, ŋkpal manɛ so ma kagbene maŋ fuli menyi so. Hale men ta men be esarga m ba sa ma gba, meeŋ kini amo.

english_verse: From dawn until dusk my name is praised by every nation on this earth, as they burn incense and offer the proper sacrifices to me.
translation_verse: Durnya ere to be basa damta beeŋ bunyaŋ ma. Baaŋ baa chɔɔ duwu a sa ma nsaa lara esarga nɛ a bee bɔlɔ kenishi a sa ma. Bumo kikɛ bee bunyaŋ ma ketre gboŋ na nna.

english_verse: But even you priests insult me by saying, “There's nothing special about the Lord's altar, and these sacrifices are worthless.”
translation_verse: Ama menyi ere jija ma ketre nna ŋkpal men ka maa tre ma bɔrɛsure na shɛŋ nsaa ta ajibi nɛ men maa sha gba a lara sarga a deŋi kumo so so.

english_verse: You get so disgusted that you even make vulgar signs at me. And for an offering, you bring stolen animals or those that are lame or sick. Should I accept these?
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman le nɛ men kraa kaŋɛ: ‘Ebɔl lar anyi ere nna.’ Men wɔtɔ gba nna a kpa mmuna to a wɔtɔ ma. Kayu be asɔbɔya nɛ asɔbɔya nɛ b la ebobi nɛ asɔbɔya nɛ baa lɔ nɛ men ta a lara sarga a sa ma. Men fɛ fanɛ meeŋ shuli n sɔ amo nna a?

english_verse: Instead of offering the acceptable animals you have promised, you bring me those that are unhealthy. I will punish you for this, because I am the great King, the Lord All-Powerful, and I am worshiped by nations everywhere.
translation_verse: Kɔnɔsho e baa wɔ ekama nɛ e bee puni nsaa ta asɔbɔya nɛ a maŋ daga m ba kaa lara sarga a sa ma, saŋɛ so nɛ e nase kɔnɔ fanɛ e beeŋ ta kusɔbɔya lela nɛ k wɔ mbe asɔbɔya to m ba lara sarga n sa ma na so. Ŋkpal manɛ so ma e la Enyɛnpetale Ewurgboŋ, nɛ efuli kama so ebi bee ŋana ma.”

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, have something else to say to you priests.
translation_verse: Le nɛ Enyɛnpetale daŋ kaŋɛ bɔrɛmatapoana na: “Ŋ kɔ le be kenishipere be kamalga ere nna a sa menyi bɔrɛmatapoana ere:

english_verse: You had better take seriously the need to honor my name. Otherwise, when you give a blessing, I will turn it into a curse. In fact, I have already done this, because you haven't taken to heart your duties as priests.
translation_verse: Men shin nɛ menyi be asheŋ woraso e baa sa ma bunyaŋ. Men baa maa nu kusɔ nɛ mee kaŋɛ menyi, meeŋ shin nɛ kɔnɔsho a pɛ menyi. Asɔ kama nɛ a la nɛfa n sa menyi na gba, meeŋ sho amo kɔnɔ. Kashenteŋto, n tiŋ n sho amo kɔnɔ gba, ŋkpal men ka maŋ ta ma mmalga kenishipereso so.”

english_verse: I will punish your descendants and rub your faces in the manure from your animal sacrifices, and then be done with you.
translation_verse: Meeŋ gberge men be mbia kusoe nseŋ ta asɔbɔya nɛ menyee ta a lara esarga na be ebin ŋ gbiti menyi be anishito. Kumo be kaman nɛ ma nɛ menyi maa naa kɔ shɛŋ.

english_verse: I blessed him with a full life, as I had promised, and he kept his part of the agreement by honoring me and respecting my name.
translation_verse: N daŋ nase kɔnɔ nna fanɛ meeŋ sa bumo ŋkpa nɛ kebaawɔtɔ lela. Ma alɛ daŋ wora loŋ nna, saŋɛ na so baaŋ ta bunyaŋ n sa ma. Kumo be saŋɛ na malɛ b daa sa ma bunyaŋ nna nsaa ŋana ma.

english_verse: He taught the truth and never told lies, and he led a lot of people to turn from sin, because he obeyed me and lived right.
translation_verse: Kashenteŋ nɛ kebaawɔtɔ niŋiso be asheŋ nɛ b daa fɛ, manɛ asheŋ lubi. Ma nɛ bumo daa wɔ abar so kagbene wushiso nna. Mannɛ asheŋ nɛ e niŋi nawule nɛ b daa wora, ama b daŋ chɛ basa damta gba to nɛ b yige alubi be kebaawora.

english_verse: You priests should be eager to spread knowledge, and everyone should come to you for instruction, because you speak for me, the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Menyi bɔrɛmatapoana e daga men ka bee malga Ebɔrɛ be asheŋ nɛ basa e baa ba men kutɔ nɛ men ŋini bumo Ebɔrɛ be asheŋ nɛ b pin mo nɛnɛ, ŋkpal manɛ so menyi so nɛ Enyɛnpetale bee bɔla a malga a sa basa.

english_verse: But you have turned your backs on me. Your teachings have led others to do sinful things, and you have broken the agreement I made with your ancestor Levi.
translation_verse: Ama menyi bɔrɛmatapoana na kini kashenteŋ be ekpa na naniere. Men be keŋini gba shin nɛ basa damta bee wora alubi nna. Men jija kɔnɔ naseso be ŋkre nɛ ma nɛ menyi nananyɛn Livai nase n sa abar na.

english_verse: So I caused everyone to hate and despise you, because you disobeyed me and failed to treat all people alike. A Broken Agreement
translation_verse: “Amoso nɛ n shin nɛ Israɛl be basa kplaŋ menyi so ŋkpal men ka maa wora ma kasonu, nsaa kpɛa to a ŋini ma basa asheŋ so na.” Basa na ka maa ji kashenteŋ a sa Ebɔrɛ be asheŋ

english_verse: Don't you know that we all have God as our Father? Didn't the one God create each of us? Then why do you cheat each other by breaking the agreement God made with your ancestors?
translation_verse: Mannɛ etuto koŋwule nɛ anyi kikɛ kɔ a? Ŋko mannɛ Ebɔrɛ koŋwule e to anyi a? Nɛ manɛ e ba nɛ anyee kini kebɛ nnɔ nɛ an nase n sa abar na so? Manɛ e ba nɛ anyee kplaŋ ŋkre nɛ Ebɔrɛ nɛ an nananyɛnana kre na so?

english_verse: You people in Judah and Jerusalem have been unfaithful to the Lord. You have disgraced the temple that he loves, and you have committed the disgusting sin of marrying the worshipers of other gods.
translation_verse: Menyi Judaebi na kikɛ maŋ ji kashenteŋ n sa Ebɔrɛ, menyi alɛ nseŋ naŋ wora ekishisheŋ ashi Jerusalɛm nɛ efuli na kikɛ so. Men wora mbushusheŋ a jija bɔrɛlambu nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ bee sha ga na. Men be benyɛn ta beche nɛ baa shuŋ efuli pɔtɛ so be agbir.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will no longer let those who are guilty belong to his people, even if they eagerly decide to offer the Lord a gift.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e lara le be basa ere ashi Israɛlebi to, nsaa maŋ shin nɛ b ti bumo so m ba lara sarga nɛ efuli na kikɛ bee lara a sa mo Enyɛnpetale na.

english_verse: And what else are you doing? You cry noisily and flood the Lord's altar with your tears, because he isn't pleased with your offerings and refuses to accept them.
translation_verse: Kusɔ nɛ men naŋ wora e la fanɛ, menyee shu a gbiti Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be bɔrɛsure na nna. Menyee boŋ to nna a shu ŋkpal e ka maŋ naa sɔ menyi be ŋkɛ nɛ menyee ta a bar mo na so.

english_verse: And why isn't God pleased? It's because he knows that each of you men has been unfaithful to the wife you married when you were young. You promised that she would be your partner, but now you have broken that promise.
translation_verse: Menyee bishi kusɔ nɛ k ba nɛ e maŋ naa sɔ menyi be ŋkɛ. Ŋkpal e ka pin fanɛ men kini men be kebrantiɛ to be beche so. Men nase kɔnɔ fanɛ bumo e naaŋ baa la menyi be beche kilso. Men nase kɔnɔ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be anishito fanɛ menyeeŋ baa ji kashenteŋ a sa bumo, ama men kini kebɛ loŋ be kɔnɔ naseso na so.

english_verse: Didn't God create you and your wife to become like one person? And why did he do this? It was so you would have children, and then lead them to become God's people. Don't ever be unfaithful to your wife.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ maŋ ta menyi nna m ber abar so nɛ men ki kukoŋwule a? Manɛ so nɛ e wora loŋ? E daŋ wora loŋ nna saŋɛ na so menyeeŋ kurge mbia nɛ b la Ebɔrɛ be basa kashenteŋto. Amoso k maŋ daga ekama ka kini mbe eche.

english_verse: The Lord God All-Powerful of Israel hates anyone who is cruel enough to divorce his wife. So take care never to be unfaithful!
translation_verse: Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na yɛ: “Ŋ kishi kakilgboŋi be asheŋ ga. Ŋ kishi esa ka beeŋ ta eche nseŋ naŋ kini mo. Men baa ji kashenteŋ a sa menyi be beche!” Demuji be kachɛ na ka taga to be asheŋ

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, will send my messenger to prepare the way for me. Then suddenly the Lord you are looking for will appear in his temple. The messenger you desire is coming with my promise, and he is on his way. A Day of Change
translation_verse: Enyɛnpetale na yɛ: “Meeŋ shuŋi ma kabɔ nɛ e ya lɔŋɛ ekpa n yili ma. Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ menyee fin na e ba mbe lambu to epul to. Ma kabɔ nɛ menyee jo na beeŋ ba bɔ ma kɔnɔ nase nɛ ma nɛ menyi kre na be kubɔya na n sa menyi.”

english_verse: On the day the Lord comes, he will be like a furnace that purifies silver or like strong soap in a washbasin. No one will be able to stand up to him.
translation_verse: Kachɛ nɛ e beeŋ ba na wanɛ e naŋ tiŋ m ba mbe anishito? E kaŋ lar a ba, wanɛ bre e naŋ pete? E beeŋ baa du fanɛ kɔya nɛ b kɔ a fɔr asɔ nna ŋko edɛ nɛ baa ta a ŋalga abɛlso a lara eyurpi nna.

english_verse: and the offerings of the people of Judah and Jerusalem will please him, just as they did in the past. Don't Cheat God
translation_verse: Nɛ kumo be loŋ e shin nɛ Juda nɛ Jerusalɛm be basa be esarga nɛ b ta a bar Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e baa par mo fanɛ kananɛ a daa du dra na.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful said: I'm now on my way to judge you. And I will quickly condemn all who practice witchcraft or cheat in marriage or tell lies in court or rob workers of their pay or mistreat widows and orphans or steal the property of foreigners or refuse to respect me.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpetale yɛ: “Mee ba nɛ m ba ji ŋkilgiwuraana nɛ basa nɛ baa ji kesakalea nɛ bumo nɛ baa ji efɛ be eshɛda nɛ bekama nɛ baa puni bumo be beshumpo kakɔka to na nɛ bumo nɛ baa tɔrɔ bekulpoche nɛ amunibi nɛ befɔ nɛ bumo nɛ b maŋ kɔ bunyaŋ n sa ma na demu.” Kebaa ka kudukudusopo be asheŋ

english_verse: Descendants of Jacob, I am the Lord All-Powerful, and I never change. That's why you haven't been wiped out,
translation_verse: Ma e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ maa chɛrga kikɛ na. Amoso menyi nɛ men la Jeekɔb be kaman to ebi na maaŋ mur cheche.

english_verse: even though you have ignored and disobeyed my laws ever since the time of your ancestors. But if you return to me, I will return to you. And yet you ask, “How can we return?”
translation_verse: Men nananyɛnana be jemanɛ so kikɛ nɛ men kplaŋ ma mbra so hale kabre. Men bɛta m ba ŋ kutɔ nɛ ma alɛ gba e bɛta m ba menyi kutɔ. Ama kusɔ nɛ menyee bishi e la fanɛ, ‘Nuso nɛ anyeeŋ wora m ba fo kutɔ?’

english_verse: You people are robbing me, your God. And, here you are, asking, “How are we robbing you?” You are robbing me of the offerings and of the ten percent that belongs to me.
translation_verse: Kusɔ nɛ mee bishi menyi e la fanɛ, k daga dimɛdi ka bee yuri Ebɔrɛ a? Ayai, loŋ maŋ daga, ama menyi alɛ bee yuri ma. Men yɛ: ‘Nuso nɛ anyee yuri fo?’ Menyi be esarga nɛ men be kudukudusopo nɛ a la meya na to nɛ menyee yuri ma.

english_verse: That's why your whole nation is under a curse.
translation_verse: Kɔnɔsho wɔ menyi kikɛ so ŋkpal manɛ so efuli na kikɛ bee yuri ma nna.

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful, and I challenge you to put me to the test. Bring the entire ten percent into the storehouse, so there will be food in my house. Then I will open the windows of heaven and flood you with blessing after blessing.
translation_verse: Men ta menyi be kudukudusopo kikɛ m ba Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be lambu to, saŋɛ na so ajibi damta beeŋ baa wɔ ndoŋ. Men wora ma ŋ keni, nɛ m bugi Ebɔrɛso be etokuro n chulgi enɛfa be yiri yiri alegaiso n sa menyi nɛ menyi maaŋ nya kakpa gba n yili amo.

english_verse: I will also stop locusts from destroying your crops and keeping your vineyards from producing.
translation_verse: M maaŋ shin nɛ asɔfirgisobi e jija menyi be adɔjibi saŋɛ na so menyi be afeelebi nɛ a bee sɔr asɔrso nɛ baa tre greep na beeŋ sɔr nɛnɛ.

english_verse: Everyone of every nation will talk about how I have blessed you and about your wonderful land. I, the Lord All-Powerful, have spoken!
translation_verse: Nɛ efuli kama so ebi e malga kananɛ n nɛfa menyi be asheŋ ŋkpal men be kasawule ka beeŋ baa la kakpa nɛ k daga kechena so. Ebɔrɛ be kuwɔrwu be kɔnɔ naseso be asheŋ

english_verse: You have said horrible things about me, and yet you ask, “What have we said?”
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe na yɛ, “Men ku asheŋ lubi damta n deŋi ma, ama le nɛ menyee bishi, ‘Manɛ be asheŋ nɛ an ku n deŋi fo?’

english_verse: Here is what you have said: “It's foolish to serve the Lord God All-Powerful. What do we get for obeying God and from going around looking sad?
translation_verse: Men yɛ, ‘K la kawulisheŋ nna fanɛ esa ka beeŋ baa shuŋ Ebɔrɛ, ŋko a wora kusɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ bee sha ŋko a kaŋɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ fanɛ e bee kule mo alubi be ketampaŋ. Manɛ be tɔnɔ nɛ e bee nya kumo to?

english_verse: See how happy those arrogant people are. Everyone who does wrong is successful, and when they put God to the test, they always get away with it.” Faithfulness Is Rewarded
translation_verse: Naniere bre, ŋkpensheŋ wuraana na nɛ anyeeŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ baa nya nɛfa. Belubiworapoana gba bee wora Ebɔrɛ nna a keni nsaa ta bumo be amu a ji.’ ”

english_verse: All those who truly respected the Lord and honored his name started discussing these things, and when God saw what was happening, he had their names written as a reminder in his book.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ bekama nɛ baa ŋana Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee malga kumo be asheŋ nɛ Enyɛnpe na nu kusɔ nɛ b kaŋɛ na kikɛ nseŋ shin nɛ b sibɛ bumo nɛ baa ŋana mo nsaa sa mo bunyaŋ na be atre n wɔtɔ kawɔl to n nase kanyiŋi so.

english_verse: Then the Lord All-Powerful said: You people are precious to me, and when I come to bring justice, I will protect you, just as parents protect an obedient child.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpetale na yɛ: “Baaŋ baa la ma basa. Kachɛ nɛ ŋ gbagba beeŋ ba ji asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so na meeŋ kuŋ bumo fanɛ kananɛ etuto bee kuŋ ebi nɛ e kɔ kasonu n sa mo na.

english_verse: Then everyone will once again see the difference between those who obey me by doing right and those who reject me by doing wrong.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nɛ ma basa beeŋ pin basa niŋiso nɛ basa lubi na be mbarga, nseŋ naŋ pin basa nɛ baa shuŋ ma nɛnɛ nɛ bumo nɛ b maa shuŋ ma na be mbarga.”

english_verse: The day of judgment is certain to come. And it will be like a red-hot furnace with flames that burn up proud and sinful people, as though they were straw. Not a branch or a root will be left. I, the Lord All-Powerful, have spoken!
translation_verse: Enyɛnpetale na yɛ: “Kachako bee ba nɛ basa nɛ b kpeŋ nɛ belubiworapoana kikɛ e chɔɔ fanɛ atuweklaŋ. Kumo be kachɛ na baaŋ chɔɔ m mur cheche nɛ bumo be kusɔ kama maaŋ ka.

english_verse: But for you that honor my name, victory will shine like the sun with healing in its rays, and you will jump around like calves at play.

translation_verse: Kagbenefuli la bekama nɛ baa shu nli na peya nna, ŋkpal manɛ so, baaŋ ba nya kagbenewushi.

english_verse: God blesses those people who are humble. The earth will belong to them!
translation_verse: Kagbenefuli la bekama nɛ b maŋ kɔ keŋkenshi na peya nna, ŋkpal manɛ so, durnya ere beeŋ ba kaa la bumo peya.

english_verse: God blesses those people who are merciful. They will be treated with mercy!
translation_verse: Kagbenefuli la kuwɔrwupoana peya nna, ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ beeŋ wu bumo alɛ gba kuwɔr.

translation_verse: Kagbenefuli la bekama nɛ kulubi kama maŋ wɔ bumo be ŋgbene to na peya nna, ŋkpal manɛ so, baaŋ wu Ebɔrɛ.

english_verse: You are the light for the whole world. A city built on top of a hill cannot be hidden,
translation_verse: Men la fanɛ kefulto nna durnya ere to. Kadegboŋ kama nɛ k chena kebee so maa ŋana kikɛ.

english_verse: But I tell you not to swear by anything when you make a promise! Heaven is God's throne, so don't swear by heaven.
translation_verse: Ama ma e kaŋɛ menyi na fanɛ men sa maa bɔ gba kuraa. Men sa maa bɔ ebɔrɛso, ŋkpal manɛ so, ndoŋ la Ebɔrɛ be kuwurputiakpa nna.

english_verse: The earth is God's footstool, so don't swear by the earth. Jerusalem is the city of the great king, so don't swear by it.
translation_verse: Menyi alɛ e sa maa bɔ kasawule, ŋkpal manɛ so, k la Ebɔrɛ be keyaputi ase nna. Men sa maa bɔ Jerusalɛm gba, ŋkpal manɛ so, ndoŋ la Ewurgboŋ na be kade nna.

english_verse: You are the salt for everyone on earth. But if salt no longer tastes like salt, how can it make food salty? All it is good for is to be thrown out and walked on.
translation_verse: Men du fanɛ nfɔl nna durnya ere to. Ama nɛ fanɛ nfɔl malɛ be ebel baŋ lar amo to, nuso nɛ baaŋ naŋ tiŋ n wora amo ebel? Loŋ be nfɔl na maŋ naŋ daga shɛŋ she keta n lɛ nɛ basa e chichi amo so.

english_verse: and no one lights a lamp and puts it under a clay pot. Instead, it is placed on a lampstand, where it can give light to everyone in the house.
