english_verse: Don't suppose I came to do away with the Law and the Prophets. I did not come to do away with them, but to give them their full meaning.
translation_verse: Men sa maa fɛ fanɛ m ba na nɛ m ba kpra mbra dra nna nɛ asɔ nɛ anebiana na kaŋɛ na. M maŋ ba nna nɛ m ba kpra amo, m ba nna nɛ m ba shin nɛ a bɔla so.

english_verse: You know our ancestors were told, “Do not murder” and “A murderer must be brought to trial.”
translation_verse: Menyee kaa nu fanɛ dra na le nɛ b daa kaŋɛ: “Men sa maŋ kaŋ mɔ. Ekama nɛ e mɔ mo barkasa, baaŋ yɛr mo demujipowura be anishito.”

english_verse: But I promise you if you are angry with someone, you will have to stand trial. If you call someone a fool, you will be taken to court. And if you say that someone is worthless, you will be in danger of the fires of hell.
translation_verse: Ama ma e kaŋɛ menyi na fanɛ ekama nɛ e nya agbo n wora mo barkasa a wɔtɔ gba, baaŋ yɛr mo demujipowura be anishito. Ekama nɛ e tege mo barkasa, baaŋ yɛr mo nshɛrwuraana nɛ baa tre Sanhedrinebi be anishito. Nɛ ekama malɛ nɛ e kaŋɛ mo barkasa le: ‘Ewulpo ere!’ Amodoŋwura wora kulubi n daga Setani be edɛ to be keluri.

english_verse: leave your gift there in front of the altar. Make peace with that person, then come back and offer your gift to God.
translation_verse: a daga fo ka yige fo kakɛ na nseŋ ya wu mo nɛ men lɔŋɛ abar pɔɛŋ nɛ fo bar fo kakɛ na m ba kɛ Ebɔrɛ.

english_verse: Before you are dragged into court, make friends with the person who has accused you of doing wrong. If you don't, you will be handed over to the judge and then to the officer who will put you in jail.
translation_verse: Nɛ fanɛ esa kaŋɛ fanɛ fo wora kusɔ ko n da mo so nsaa yɛr fo kɔɔti to, fo nya manaŋ n shin nɛ men lɔŋɛ abar ekpa to nɛ e sa maŋ ta fo m bɔɔ sheriajipo enɔ nɛ mo alɛ e ta fo n sa kabutikenipo nɛ mo alɛ e ta fo n ti ebu.

english_verse: I promise you will not get out until you have paid the last cent you owe. Marriage
translation_verse: Kashenteŋto nɛ mee kaŋɛ menyi na fanɛ nɛ fo baa maŋ tiŋ ŋ ka fo kukɔ na kikɛ, fo maaŋ lar kabuti na to kikɛ.

english_verse: You have been taught that a man who divorces his wife must write out divorce papers for her.
translation_verse: Basa daŋ naa kaŋɛ le gba: ‘A daga fanɛ esa kama nɛ e gboŋi mo nɛ mbe eche be kakil, e sa eche na kakilgboŋi be kawɔl.’

english_verse: You know our ancestors were told, “Don't use the Lord's name to make a promise unless you are going to keep it.”
translation_verse: Menyi alɛ kraŋ naa nu fanɛ dra na le nɛ b daa kaŋɛ nnɔ naseso be asheŋ: “Men sa maa sa Enyɛnpe nnɔ jiga nsaa maa bɛ nnɔ na so. Fo kama nɛ fo nase kɔnɔ n sa Enyɛnpe, fo bɛ kumo so.”

english_verse: But I tell you not to try to get even with a person who has done something to you. When someone slaps your right cheek, turn and let that person slap your other cheek.
translation_verse: Ama ma e kaŋɛ menyi na fanɛ, nɛ esa lubi ko wora menyi kulubi, men sa maŋ wora mo kulubi n tal to. Nɛ esa baŋ kpa fo jisoso be ketaya etaŋ, fo naŋ kilgi fo bena so be ketaya gba n sa mo.

english_verse: If a soldier forces you to carry his pack one kilometer, carry it two kilometers.
translation_verse: Esa kama malɛ nɛ e tintiŋ fo fanɛ fo nite mayɛl koŋwule be ekpa, fo tu mo n nite emayɛl anyɔ.

english_verse: When people ask you for something, give it to them. When they want to borrow money, lend it to them. Love (Luke
translation_verse: Nɛ esa kule fo kusɔ ko, fo sa mo, nɛ esa ko malɛ bee sha kepaŋ kusɔ ko fo kutɔ, fo sa maŋ mɔn mo. Bedoŋ be kesha be asheŋ (Luuk

english_verse: You have heard people say, “Love your neighbors and hate your enemies.”
translation_verse: Menyee kaa nu fanɛ dra na le nɛ b daa kaŋɛ: ‘Baa sha fo teri nsaa kishi fo doŋ.’

english_verse: But I tell you to love your enemies and pray for anyone who mistreats you.
translation_verse: Ama ma e kaŋɛ menyi na fanɛ men baa sha men doŋana nsaa kule Ebɔrɛ a sa bumo nɛ baa tɔrɔ menyi na,

english_verse: Then you will be acting like your Father in heaven. He makes the sun rise on both good and bad people. And he sends rain for the ones who do right and for the ones who do wrong.
translation_verse: saŋɛ na so menyeeŋ baa la men Tuto nɛ e wɔ ebɔrɛso na be mbia. english_verse: If you love only those people who love you, will God reward you for this? Even tax collectors love their friends.

english_verse: If you greet only your friends, what's so great about this? Don't even unbelievers do that?
translation_verse: Ŋko nɛ men wɔtɔ a chɔrɔ men kurgepoana nawule, manɛ be kelela nɛ menyee wora a chɔ basa pɔtɛ? Men maŋ nyi fanɛ loŋ nɛ nnyamase gba bee wora a?

english_verse: When you do good deeds, don't try to show off. If you do, you won't get a reward from your Father in heaven.
translation_verse: “Men baa da so nɛ men maa shuŋ men be kabɔrɛshuŋana basa be anishito nɛ b baa wu menyi. Nɛ mannɛ aloŋ, men maaŋ nya kechɔrɔ kikɛ ashi men Tuto nɛ e wɔ ebɔrɛso na kutɔ.

english_verse: When you pray, don't be like those show-offs who love to stand up and pray in the synagogues and on the street corners. They do this just to look good. I can assure you that they already have their reward.
translation_verse: Nɛ men baa kule Ebɔrɛ, men sa maa kule fanɛ kananɛ kebirkɔnshiwuraana bee kule na. Ŋkpal manɛ so, bumo ere bee kaa sha fanɛ b baa yil nshɛrbuana to nɛ ŋkpancheriana to nna a kule Ebɔrɛ nɛ basa e wu bumo. Kashenteŋ nɛ mee kaŋɛ menyi na, b teŋ nya bumo be kechɔrɔ kikɛ.

english_verse: When you pray, go into a room alone and close the door. Pray to your Father in private. He knows what is done in private and will reward you.
translation_verse: Ama fo kama nɛ fee sha kekule Ebɔrɛ, fo luri fo ebu to n ti kabuna nseŋ kule fo Tuto nɛ basa maa wu na. Nɛ fo Tuto nɛ e bee wu kusɔ nɛ basa bee wora wulo to na e chɔrɔ fo.

english_verse: When you pray, don't talk on and on as people do who don't know God. They think God likes to hear long prayers.
translation_verse: Nɛ menyi alɛ naa kule Ebɔrɛ, men sa maa bela mmalga fuloŋ a deŋi abar so fanɛ kananɛ nnyamase bee wora na. Ŋkpal manɛ so, baa tama fanɛ mmalga damta na so Ebɔrɛ beeŋ nu bumo be kabɔrɛkule.

english_verse: Don't be like them. Your Father knows what you need even before you ask.
translation_verse: Men sa maa du fanɛ bumo, ŋkpal manɛ so, men Tuto bee kaa nyi kusɔ nɛ k daga menyi nna pɔɛŋ nɛ men kule mo.

english_verse: You should pray like this: Our Father in heaven, help us to honor your name.
translation_verse: Men baa kule mo le: ‘An Tuto nɛ fo wɔ ebɔrɛso, shin nɛ fo ketre cheembi na e baa nya bunyaŋ,

translation_verse: n shin nɛ fo Kuwurgboŋ na e ba, n shin nɛ basa e baa wora fo aparsheŋ durnya ere to fanɛ kananɛ k du ebɔrɛso na.

english_verse: If you forgive others for the wrongs they do to you, your Father in heaven will forgive you.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, nɛ menyee ta basa be alubi nɛ baa wora menyi a paŋ bumo, men Tuto nɛ e wɔ ebɔrɛso na gba beeŋ ta menyi be alubi m paŋ menyi.

english_verse: But if you don't forgive others, your Father will not forgive your sins. Worshiping God by Going without Eating
translation_verse: Ama nɛ men maa ta bumo be alubi a paŋ bumo, men Tuto nɛ e wɔ ebɔrɛso na gba maaŋ ta m paŋ menyi. Ekishi be asheŋ

translation_verse: Ama nɛ men baŋ kishi, men fɔr men be anishito ŋ gbiti men be amu ŋku.

translation_verse: Saŋɛ na so basa maaŋ wu fanɛ men kishi she men Tuto nɛ basa maa wu na nawule, nɛ men Tuto Ebɔrɛ nɛ e bee wu kusɔ nɛ basa bee wora wulo to na e chɔrɔ menyi. Ebɔrɛso be ekpanjawu be asheŋ (Luuk

english_verse: But more than anything else, put God's work first and do what he wants. Then the other things will be yours as well.

translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, kakpa nɛ fo kpanjawu wɔ, ndoŋ nɛ fo kagbene malɛ gba wɔ. Eyur be kefulto be asheŋ (Luuk

translation_verse: Ama nɛ fo anishi baa maŋ walɛ, tentembiri e naaŋ baŋ bɔlɔ fo eyur na kikɛ to. Amoso, nɛ kefulto nɛ k wɔ fo to na baa la tentembiri, kumo ere tentembiri gbagba nna pasaa! Ebɔrɛ nɛ asɔ be asheŋ (Luuk

translation_verse: Esa koŋwule maaŋ tiŋ a shuŋ a sa benyɛnpe anyɔ. Nɛ e baŋ maŋ kishi bumo be eko nsaa sha eko, e beeŋ bugi kagbene a shuŋ eko nsaa wora eko malɛ emurpi. Fo maaŋ tiŋ n ta fo kagbene kikɛ a bɛ amansherbi so nseŋ tiŋ n ta kagbene koŋwule na a bɛ Ebɔrɛ so.

english_verse: Don't worry and ask yourselves, “Will we have anything to eat? Will we have anything to drink? Will we have any clothes to wear?”
translation_verse: Amoso, men sa maa fɔŋ so a kaŋɛ le: ‘Manɛ nɛ anyeeŋ ji ŋko manɛ nɛ anyeeŋ nuu ŋko manɛ nɛ anyeeŋ buu?’

english_verse: Look at the birds in the sky! They don't plant or harvest. They don't even store grain in barns. Yet your Father in heaven takes care of them. Aren't you worth much more than birds?
translation_verse: Men keni mbuibi ka wɔ esoso a firgi na, b maa duu shɛŋ, bumo alɛ maa teŋi shɛŋ ŋko a chala asɔ a wɔtɔ mpuro to, ŋkeshin nɛ men Tuto nɛ e wɔ ebɔrɛso na malɛ bee sa bumo asɔ jiso. Men keni, men maŋ bɔ bumo a?

translation_verse: Nɛ manɛ so nɛ menyee fɔŋ asɔbuuso so? Men keni kananɛ kupuŋ to be afitiri be atoto bee daŋ a walɛ loŋ, ama amo alɛ maa shuŋ shɛŋ ŋko a lue amo gbagba be asɔbuuso,

english_verse: But I tell you that Solomon with all his wealth wasn't as well clothed as one of them.
translation_verse: ŋkeshin nɛ men baa nyi fanɛ Ewura Sɔlɔmɔn gba e daa kɔ kemaŋkura nɛ asɔ ga ere daa maa kɔ asɔbuuso nɛ a walɛ n fo atoto ere so.

english_verse: God gives such beauty to everything that grows in the fields, even though it is here today and thrown into a fire tomorrow. God will surely do even more for you! Why do you have such little faith?
translation_verse: O, menyi be yirda du fimbi pasaa. Nɛ Ebɔrɛ bee keni afitiri nɛ feeŋ wu kabre, ŋklade n fin amo ndoŋ ŋ gben ŋkpal b ka chɔɔ amo so ere so a sa amo amo be kela, nɛ menyi ere ka bɔ amo ere nɛ e maaŋ sa asɔbuuso a?

english_verse: Only people who don't know God are always worrying about such things. Your Father in heaven knows you need all of these.
translation_verse: Loŋ be asɔ ere kikɛ nɛ basa nɛ b maŋ nyi Ebɔrɛ na bee yela kenishi to a fin. Ama men Tuto Ebɔrɛ nɛ e wɔ ebɔrɛso na nyi a ka daga fanɛ men nya loŋ be asɔ na kikɛ.

english_verse: You can see the speck in your friend's eye, but you don't notice the log in your own eye.
translation_verse: Manɛ e ba nɛ fee wu kaduubi nɛ k wɔ fo niopibi be kenishi to nsaa kplaŋ kedishaŋ nɛ k wɔ fo gbagba be kenishi to so

translation_verse: Nuso nɛ feeŋ wora n nya kagbene ŋ kaŋɛ fo niopibi: ‘Shin nɛ n lara kaduubi fo kenishi to n sa fo’, nɛ kedishaŋ wɔ fo gbagba be kenishi to?

english_verse: You're nothing but show-offs! First, take the log out of your own eye; then you can see how to take the speck out of your friend's eye.
translation_verse: Kebirkɔnshiwura ere, a daga fanɛ fo lara kedishaŋ nɛ k wɔ fo gbagba be kenishi to na pɔɛŋ nseŋ tiŋ n wu nɛnɛ n lara kaduubi ashi fo barkasa be kenishi to.

english_verse: As bad as you are, you still know how to give good gifts to your children. But your heavenly Father is even more ready to give good things to people who ask.
translation_verse: To, nɛ menyi ere ka la basa lubi le nsaa nyi asɔ lela be kebaata a sa men be mbia, nɛ men Tuto Ebɔrɛ nɛ e wɔ ebɔrɛso na ai? Mo ere maaŋ shuli n sa bekama nɛ b kule mo asɔ lela a?

english_verse: Would any of you give your hungry child a stone, if the child asked for some bread?
translation_verse: Menyi nɛ men la betuto ere be emo pibi e naaŋ kule mo bodobodo nɛ e ta kejembu n sa mo?

english_verse: Ask, and you will receive. Search, and you will find. Knock, and the door will be opened for you.
translation_verse: Men kule nseŋ nya, men fin nseŋ wu, men ŋmɛa kabuna nɛ b bugi n sa menyi.

english_verse: Everyone who asks will receive. Everyone who searches will find. And the door will be opened for everyone who knocks.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, ekama nɛ e kule beeŋ nya, ekama nɛ e fin beeŋ wu nɛ ekama malɛ nɛ e ŋmɛa kabuna, baaŋ bugi n sa mo.

english_verse: Would you give your child a snake if the child asked for a fish?
translation_verse: Ŋko nɛ e kule fo kɔrɔtɔ, feeŋ shuli n ta kuwɔ n sa mo a?

english_verse: Treat others as you want them to treat you. This is what the Law and the Prophets are all about. The Narrow Gate (Luke
translation_verse: Amoso, kusɔ kama nɛ menyee sha fanɛ basa e baa wora a sa menyi, menyi alɛ gba e baa wora loŋ a sa bumo. Kusɔ nɛ anebi Mosis be mbra na nɛ anebiana nɛ b ka na be keŋini na bee ŋini nna na. Kabunabi be asheŋ (Luuk

english_verse: Anyone who hears and obeys these teachings of mine is like a wise person who built a house on solid rock.
translation_verse: Amoso, ekama nɛ e nu ma mmalga ere nsaa bɛ amo so du fanɛ enyiashempo nɛ e pɔr mbe ebu n yili kefalta so nna.

english_verse: But the gate to life is very narrow. The road that leads there is so hard to follow that only a few people find it. A Tree and Its Fruit (Luke
translation_verse: Ama ekpa nɛ k bee yɔ ŋkpa to na maŋ kpalga to nɛ kumo be kabuna malɛ maŋ shi. Basa nɛ baa nya kumo a nite to na malɛ maŋ shi. Kedibi nɛ kumo be asɔrso be asheŋ (Luuk

english_verse: Watch out for false prophets! They dress up like sheep, but inside they are wolves who have come to attack you.
translation_verse: Men baa de anebi fɛpoana so. Baa kaa wɔ mbolpɔ be nwɔl to nna a ba men kutɔ, ama ekuntuŋ lubi gbagba nna na.

english_verse: You can tell what they are by what they do. No one picks grapes or figs from thornbushes.
translation_verse: Bumo be asheŋ woraso to nɛ menyeeŋ pin bumo. Ewidibi so nɛ baa chuge apɔl a? Ŋko baa chuge elemu ashi gbaŋgbanturbidibi so nna a?

english_verse: A good tree produces good fruit, and a bad tree produces bad fruit.
translation_verse: Kedibi lempo kama bee sɔr asɔrso lela nna nɛ kedibi pɔso kama malɛ bee sɔr asɔrso lubi.

english_verse: A good tree cannot produce bad fruit, and a bad tree cannot produce good fruit.

translation_verse: Ama b daa maŋ kɔ mbia, ŋkpal manɛ so, Elizabɛt daa la egbentepo nna, mo alɛ nɛ mo kul Zakareya kikɛ daŋ bel nna.

english_verse: All at once an angel from the Lord appeared to Zechariah at the right side of the altar.
translation_verse: E wɔ ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe be malaika ba mo kutɔ epul na to m ba yili bɔrɛsure nɛ e daa chɔɔ duwu kumo so na be jisoso.

english_verse: Zechariah was confused and afraid when he saw the angel.
translation_verse: Zakareya ka wu mo nɛ kufu pɛ mo n wul mo to.

english_verse: But the angel told him: Don't be afraid, Zechariah! God has heard your prayers. Your wife Elizabeth will have a son, and you must name him John.
translation_verse: Nɛ malaika na kaŋɛ mo: “Zakareya, sa maa lɔ kufu. Ebɔrɛ nu fo kekule na, amoso, fo eche Elizabɛt beeŋ kurge fo ebinyɛn nɛ men nase mo ketre Jɔn.

english_verse: His birth will make you very happy, and many people will be glad.
translation_verse: Fo kagbene beeŋ fuli n wora fo ebel ga nɛ kebia na be kakurge na be asheŋ e wora basa damta ebel ga.

english_verse: Your son will be a great servant of the Lord. He must never drink wine or beer, and the power of the Holy Spirit will be with him from the time he is born.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, e beeŋ ba kaa la esagboŋ Enyɛnpe be anishito. Yili jemanɛ nɛ e wɔ mo nio be epun to, Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na e naaŋ bɔlɔ mo to. E ba koso e maaŋ nuu nsa be yiri kikɛ.

english_verse: John will lead many people in Israel to turn back to the Lord their God.
translation_verse: E beeŋ shin nɛ Israɛlebi be bedamta e kilgi m ba Enyɛnpe bumo be Ebɔrɛ kutɔ.

english_verse: He will go ahead of the Lord with the same power and spirit that Elijah had. And because of John, parents will be more thoughtful of their children. And people who now disobey God will begin to think as they ought to. This is how John will get people ready for the Lord.
translation_verse: E beeŋ ba kaa la kenya nɛ e beeŋ juŋkpar Enyɛnpe na a kɔ eleŋ nɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ nɛ anebi Elaija daŋ nya na. E beeŋ bar betuto nɛ bibi abar so n shin nɛ amukpakpasowuraana e fara a fɛ basa cheembi be nfɛra. E beeŋ chala basa n sa Enyɛnpe n shin nɛ b bela ase a jo mo.”

english_verse: Zechariah said to the angel, “How will I know this is going to happen? My wife and I are both very old.”
translation_verse: Nɛ Zakareya kaŋɛ malaika na: “Ma nɛ ma eche kikɛ bel, nɛ nuso nɛ meeŋ wora m pin fanɛ k la kashenteŋ nna?”

english_verse: The angel answered, “I am Gabriel, God's servant, and I was sent to tell you this good news.
translation_verse: Nɛ malaika na kaŋɛ mo: “Ma e la Geebriɛl, emo nɛ e yil Ebɔrɛ kutɔ saŋkama na. Nɛ Ebɔrɛ shuŋi ma nɛ m ba bɔ le be baru n sa fo.

english_verse: You have not believed what I have said. So you will not be able to say a thing until all this happens. But everything will take place when it is supposed to.”
translation_verse: Ama fo maŋ yirda kubɔya na, kumo alɛ be saŋɛ kaŋ fo, loŋ e naaŋ wora. Ŋkpal fo ka maŋ yirda ma kubɔya ere so, fo maaŋ naŋ tiŋ m malga. Feeŋ ki neemu yili kabre n ya fo kachɛ nɛ ma kamalga ere beeŋ bɔla ekpa.”

english_verse: The crowd was waiting for Zechariah and kept wondering why he was staying in the temple so long.
translation_verse: Saŋɛ ere so kikɛ nɛ Zakareya be kechɛr bɔrɛlambu na to na bee chinchiŋ basa nɛ b yil kowu a jo mo na.

english_verse: When he did come out, he could not speak, and they knew he had seen a vision. He motioned to them with his hands, but did not say a thing.
translation_verse: E ka baŋ lar, e maŋ tiŋ m malga bumo kutɔ nɛ b pin fanɛ Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ e wu kusɔ ko bɔrɛlambu na to. Mbe enɔana nɛ e daŋ ta a ŋini asheŋ ŋkpal e ka maŋ tiŋ m malga na so.

english_verse: When Zechariah's time of service in the temple was over, he went home.
translation_verse: Zakareya be kushuŋ ashi bɔrɛlambu na to be jemanɛ ka ba choŋ nɛ e yɔ epe.

english_verse: Soon after this, his wife was expecting a baby, and for five months she did not leave the house. She said to herself,
translation_verse: K maŋ chɛr ko nɛ mbe eche Elizabɛt di kedampo nseŋ ŋana mbe kumu afɔl anu a wɔ laŋ to.

english_verse: “What the Lord has done for me will keep people from looking down on me.” An Angel Tells about the Birth of Jesus
translation_verse: E yɛ: “Naniere bre Enyɛnpe chɛ ma to ŋ ŋini ma mbe kasha nseŋ lara ma anishinyɔr basa to.” B ka malga b ka beeŋ kurge Yesu be asheŋ

english_verse: One month later God sent the angel Gabriel to the town of Nazareth in Galilee
translation_verse: Elizabɛt be kedampo be kufɔl shesopo to nɛ Ebɔrɛ shuŋi malaika Geebriɛl Galili be kade ko to nɛ baa tre Nazarɛt.

english_verse: with a message for a virgin named Mary. She was engaged to Joseph from the family of King David.
translation_verse: Kasuŋgurbia ko nɛ b daŋ yili kumo fanɛ mo nɛ Josɛf, Ewura Deevid be kanaŋ to be esa, daŋ ba kil nna nɛ e daŋ bar kubɔya ko. Kebichebi na be ketre e daa la Mɛɛri.

english_verse: The angel greeted Mary and said, “You are truly blessed! The Lord is with you.”
translation_verse: Le nɛ malaika na daŋ ba kaŋɛ mo: “Kumulelawura, fo kechɔrɔ nde. Ebɔrɛ yɛ e wɔ fo kutɔ.”

english_verse: Mary was confused by the angel's words and wondered what they meant.
translation_verse: Malaika na be kamalga daŋ wul Mɛɛri to ga nseŋ chinchiŋ mo nɛ e fara a pin mbe kechɔrɔ na be kifito a gben.

english_verse: Then the angel told Mary, “Don't be afraid! God is pleased with you,
translation_verse: Nɛ malaika na kaŋɛ mo: “Mɛɛri, sa maa lɔ kufu, ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ bee sha kenɛfa fo nna.

english_verse: and you will have a son. His name will be Jesus.
translation_verse: Feeŋ di kedampo ŋ kurge ebinyɛn n nase mo ketre Yesu.

english_verse: He will be great and will be called the Son of God Most High. The Lord God will make him king, as his ancestor David was.
translation_verse: E beeŋ ba kaa la esagboŋ nɛ b baa tre mo Ewurgboŋ Ebɔrɛ Pibinyɛn. Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ beeŋ shin nɛ e ji kuwura nɛ mo nana Deevid daŋ ji na.

english_verse: He will rule the people of Israel forever, and his kingdom will never end.”
translation_verse: E beeŋ ba ki Jeekɔb be kanaŋ to be Ewura mbaanaayɔ. Mbe kuwura maaŋ loge kikɛ.”

english_verse: Mary asked the angel, “How can this happen? I am not even married!”
translation_verse: Nɛ Mɛɛri bishi malaika na: “M maŋ nyi enyɛn nɛ nuso nɛ le be kusɔ beeŋ tiŋ n wora?”

english_verse: The angel answered, “The Holy Spirit will come down to you, and God's power will come over you. So your child will be called the holy Son of God.
translation_verse: Nɛ malaika na shuli so ŋ kaŋɛ: “Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na e naaŋ gbelge fo so nɛ Ebɔrɛ be eleŋ e ba buu fo so. Amoso, baaŋ tre kebia cheembi nɛ feeŋ kurge na Ebɔrɛ Pibinyɛn.

english_verse: Your relative Elizabeth is also going to have a son, even though she is old. No one thought she could ever have a baby, but in three months she will have a son.
translation_verse: Fo kurgepo Elizabɛt nɛ b yɛ e la egbentepo na gba di kedampo mbe mbel to, kumo be afɔl ashe nde.

english_verse: Mary said, “I am the Lord's servant! Let it happen as you have said.” And the angel left her. Mary Visits Elizabeth
translation_verse: Nɛ Mɛɛri kaŋɛ: “N la Ebɔrɛ be kenya nna, shin nɛ kusɔ nɛ fo malga ere e wora ma loŋ.” Nɛ malaika na yɔ ŋ ka mo. Mɛɛri ka yɔ Elizabɛt be kechɔrɔ to be asheŋ

english_verse: A short time later Mary hurried to a town in the hill country of Judea.
translation_verse: K maŋ chɛr ko nɛ Mɛɛri bela ase n nya manaŋ n yɔ kebee so be kade ko to, Judiya be efuli so.

english_verse: She went into Zechariah's home, where she greeted Elizabeth.
translation_verse: E ya luri Zakareya pe nna n chɔrɔ Elizabɛt.

english_verse: When Elizabeth heard Mary's greeting, her baby moved within her. The Holy Spirit came upon Elizabeth.
translation_verse: Elizabɛt ka nu Mɛɛri be kechɔrɔ na nɛ mbe kebia na kilgi mbe epun to nɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na bɔlɔ Elizabɛt to kikɛ.

english_verse: Then in a loud voice she said to Mary: God has blessed you more than any other woman! He has also blessed the child you will have.
translation_verse: Nɛ e malga eleŋso ŋ kooba ŋ kaŋɛ: “Kumulelawura, beche kikɛ to fo e nya nɛfa ga. Nɛfa malɛ e baa la kebia nɛ feeŋ kurge na peya.

english_verse: As soon as I heard your greeting, my baby became happy and moved within me.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, ŋ ka nu fo kechɔrɔ nɛ kebia na kilgi ma epun to kagbenefuliso

english_verse: The Lord has blessed you because you believed that he will keep his promise. Mary's Song of Praise
translation_verse: Fo ka yirda fanɛ Ebɔrɛ be kubɔya nɛ e bar fo na beeŋ bɔla ekpa na so so nɛ e nɛfa fo kagbenefuliso nna.”

english_verse: Mary said: With all my heart I praise the Lord,
translation_verse: Nɛ Mɛɛri kaŋɛ: “Mee ta ma kagbene kikɛ a di Ebɔrɛ epaŋ.

english_verse: and I am glad because of God my Savior.
translation_verse: Ma kagbene fuli ŋkpal Ebɔrɛ ma Emɔlgapo so,

english_verse: God cares for me, his humble servant. From now on, all people will say God has blessed me.
translation_verse: ŋkpal e ka wu ma alɛ ebɔlpo, mbe kenya kuwɔr so. Yili kabre mbaanaayɔ basa kikɛ beeŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ n nya nɛfa,

english_verse: God All-Powerful has done great things for me, and his name is holy.
translation_verse: ŋkpal asɔgboŋ nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ wora n sa ma ere so.

english_verse: The Lord has used his powerful arm to scatter those who are proud.
translation_verse: E teŋi mbe enɔgboŋ to n jija kamoowuwuraana be ejina kikɛ n lɛ.

english_verse: God drags strong rulers from their thrones and puts humble people in places of power.
translation_verse: E gbelge bewurgboŋ ashi bumo be nwurputi so m ba kaseto nseŋ maŋ bebɔlpo so.

english_verse: God gives the hungry good things to eat, and sends the rich away with nothing.
translation_verse: E sa bumo nɛ akoŋ bee mɔ na asɔ lela ga nseŋ shin nɛ damawuraana bɛta n yɔ nɛ enɔfuloŋ.

english_verse: God helps his servant Israel and is always merciful to his people.
translation_verse: E shin nɛ mbe kɔnɔ nɛ e nase n sa an nanaana na bɔla so nseŋ ba mbe kenya Israɛl be kechɛto to.

english_verse: The Lord made this promise to our ancestors, to Abraham and his family forever!
translation_verse: E nyiŋi kewu Eebraham nɛ mbe kanaŋ kikɛ kuwɔr mbaanaayɔ.”

english_verse: Mary stayed with Elizabeth about three months. Then she went back home. The Birth of John the Baptist
translation_verse: Mɛɛri daŋ ji fanɛ afɔl asa Elizabɛt kutɔ nseŋ naŋ bɛta n yɔ epe. B ka kurge Jɔn kabɔrɛbɛrpo be asheŋ

english_verse: When Elizabeth's son was born,
translation_verse: Elizabɛt be kakurgeachɛ ka fo nɛ e kurge ebinyɛn.

english_verse: her neighbors and relatives heard how kind the Lord had been to her, and they too were glad.
translation_verse: Mbe bechenashapoana nɛ mo kurgepoana ka nu mamachi be kelela nɛ Enyɛnpe wora mo na nɛ bumo kikɛ be ŋgbene fuli bumo.

english_verse: Eight days later they did for the child what the Law of Moses commands. They were going to name him Zechariah, after his father.
translation_verse: Kebi na ka fo nchɛ aburwa nɛ b ba ku mo kututu nsaa shin nɛ b nase mo mo tuto be ketre Zakareya.

english_verse: But Elizabeth said, “No! His name is John.”
translation_verse: Nɛ mo nio kaŋɛ: “Ayai, mbe ketre e la Jɔn.”

english_verse: The people argued, “No one in your family has ever been named John.”
translation_verse: Nɛ b kaŋɛ mo: “Fo kurgepo malɛ kikɛ maa ji ketre na ai!”

english_verse: So they motioned to Zechariah to find out what he wanted to name his son.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ b wora enɔ m bishi kebia na mo tuto ketre nɛ e bee sha nɛ e nase kebia na.

english_verse: Zechariah asked for a writing tablet. Then he wrote, “His name is John.” Everyone was amazed.
translation_verse: Nɛ Zakareya ŋini n shin nɛ b bar mo kusɔ sibɛso nɛ e sibɛ ŋ kaŋɛ: “Mbe ketre e la Jɔn.” Nɛ k chinchiŋ bumo ga.

english_verse: All the neighbors were frightened because of what had happened, and everywhere in the hill country people kept talking about these things.
translation_verse: Kufu daŋ pɛ mbe bechenashapoana kikɛ ga nɛ asheŋ nɛ a wora na be baru sɔ Judiya be kebee be efuli na so kikɛ.

english_verse: Everyone who heard about this wondered what this child would grow up to be. They knew the Lord was with him. Zechariah Praises the Lord
translation_verse: Ekama nɛ e nu kumo be asheŋ fɛ kumo be nfɛra nseŋ kaŋɛ: “Nuso be esa nɛ kebia ere yɛ e ba ki.” K daŋ baŋ fuli nna fanɛ Ebɔrɛ be eleŋ daa wɔ mo to. Zakareya be kewuŋkaŋɛ be kamalga be asheŋ

english_verse: The Holy Spirit came upon Zechariah, and he began to speak:
translation_verse: Nɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na bɔlɔ Jɔn mo tuto Zakareya to nɛ e wu le be kubɔya ŋ kaŋɛ:

english_verse: Praise the Lord, the God of Israel! He has come to save his people.
translation_verse: “Men shin nɛ an di Enyɛnpe, Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ epaŋ. Mo e ba mbe basa be kechɛto to m ba sɔ bumo n yige.

english_verse: Our God has given us a mighty Savior from the family of David his servant.
translation_verse: E sa anyi Emɔlgapo lempo nɛ e shi Deevid mbe kenya be kanaŋ to.

english_verse: Long ago the Lord promised by the words of his holy prophets
translation_verse: Dra na kikɛ nɛ e shin nɛ mbe anebi cheembiana kaŋɛ le:

english_verse: to save us from our enemies and from everyone who hates us.
translation_verse: ‘E nase kɔnɔ fanɛ e beeŋ mɔlga anyi ashi an doŋana nɛ basa nɛ b kishi anyi kikɛ be eleŋ to.’

english_verse: God said he would be kind to our people and keep his sacred promise.
translation_verse: E yɛ e beeŋ wu an nanaana kuwɔr n nyiŋi mbe kɔnɔ naseso cheembi na.

english_verse: He told our ancestor Abraham
translation_verse: E nase kɔnɔ n sa an nana Eebraham

english_verse: that he would rescue us from our enemies. Then we could serve him without fear,
translation_verse: nseŋ bɔ fanɛ e beeŋ mɔlga anyi ashi an doŋana kutɔ

english_verse: You, my son, will be called the prophet of God Most High. You will go ahead of the Lord to get everything ready for him.
translation_verse: Fo, m pibi, baaŋ tre fo Ebɔrɛ Enyɛnpetale be anebi. Feeŋ juŋkpar mo, Enyɛnpe na, n lɔŋɛ mbe ekpa n sa mo

english_verse: You will tell his people that they can be saved when their sins are forgiven.
translation_verse: ŋ ŋini mbe basa kananɛ baaŋ nya bumo be alubi be ketampaŋ bumo. Baaŋ nya kumɔlga.

english_verse: God's love and kindness will shine upon us like the sun that rises in the sky.
translation_verse: An be Ebɔrɛ la kuwɔrwupowura a du cheembi nna,

english_verse: On us who live in the dark shadow of death this light will shine to guide us into a life of peace.
translation_verse: e beeŋ shin nɛ an fara a nya kumɔlga naniere nseŋ nyaŋɛ kefulto ashi ebɔrɛso n yuu bumo nɛ b wɔ tentembiri to nsaa ŋana luwu na so kikɛ n shin nɛ an bɔla kagbenewushi be ekpa to.”

english_verse: As John grew up, God's Spirit gave him great power. John lived in the desert until the time he was sent to the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Nɛ kebia na daŋ eyur to a kɔ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na be eleŋ ga. Kiyi to nɛ e daa wɔ n ya fo jemanɛ nɛ e fara a bɔ mbe kubɔya a sa Israɛlebi na.

english_verse: About that time Emperor Augustus gave orders for the names of all the people to be listed in record books.
translation_verse: Kumo be jemanɛ na nɛ Ewura Ɔgastes kaŋɛ fanɛ b karga mbe efuli so be basa kikɛ.

english_verse: At this time a man named Simeon was living in Jerusalem. Simeon was a good man. He loved God and was waiting for him to save the people of Israel. God's Spirit came to him
translation_verse: Kanyɛn ko malɛ daa wɔ Jerusalɛm nɛ baa tre mo Simiɔn. E daa la esa lela nna a bunyaŋ Ebɔrɛ nsaa jo jemanɛ nɛ Israɛlebi beeŋ nya kumɔlga. Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na daa wɔ mo to.

english_verse: These first records were made when Quirinius was governor of Syria.
translation_verse: Saŋɛ na Kwirinias e daa la Siriya be gomena, mbe jemanɛ to be basa be kekarga be sososo e daa la na.

english_verse: Everyone had to go to their own hometown to be listed.
translation_verse: Ewura Ɔgastes ka kaŋɛ loŋ nɛ ekama yɔ mbe kade to gbagba to nɛ b ya sibɛ mbe ketre.

english_verse: So Joseph had to leave Nazareth in Galilee and go to Bethlehem in Judea. Long ago Bethlehem had been King David's hometown, and Joseph went there because he was from David's family.
translation_verse: Nɛ Josɛf malɛ gba lar Nazarɛt, Galili be efuli so n yɔ Judiya be efuli so be kade ko to nɛ baa tre Bɛtlɛhɛm, kakpa nɛ b kurge Ewura Deevid na. Josɛf daŋ yɔ ndoŋ nna ŋkpal e ka daŋ shi Deevid be kanaŋ to so.

english_verse: Mary was engaged to Joseph and traveled with him to Bethlehem. She was soon going to have a baby,
translation_verse: Mo nɛ Mɛɛri nɛ b daŋ kre kumo fanɛ baaŋ ta abar na e daŋ yɔ nɛ b ya sibɛ bumo be atre.

english_verse: she gave birth to her first-born son. She dressed him in baby clothes and laid him on a bed of hay, because there was no room for them in the inn. The Shepherds
translation_verse: Asɔbɔya be edikpa to nɛ b daa wɔ, ŋkpal manɛ so, ebu kikɛ daa maŋ naa wɔ befɔ be kowu na to. Ndoŋ nɛ e kurge mbe wurkoŋ, ebinyɛn n ta ewajɛ m mea mo nseŋ ta mo n nase asɔbɔya na be deka jiso to. Mbolpɔkpapo nɛ emalaika be asheŋ

english_verse: That night in the fields near Bethlehem some shepherds were guarding their sheep.
translation_verse: Mbolpɔkpapoana ko daa wɔ efuli na so kiyi to be kakpa ko a keni bumo be mbolpɔ kanyɛso.

english_verse: All at once an angel came down to them from the Lord, and the brightness of the Lord's glory flashed around them. The shepherds were frightened.
translation_verse: Epul na to nɛ Enyɛnpe be malaika lar bumo so nɛ Enyɛnpe be kemaŋkura nyaŋɛ m buu bumo so nɛ kufu pɛ bumo ga.

english_verse: But the angel said, “Don't be afraid! I have good news for you, which will make everyone happy.
translation_verse: Nɛ malaika na kaŋɛ bumo: “Men sa maa lɔ kufu, ŋkpal manɛ so, baru lela nɛ k beeŋ sa basa kikɛ kagbenefuli nɛ m bar menyi.

english_verse: This very day in King David's hometown a Savior was born for you. He is Christ the Lord.
translation_verse: Kabre be kachɛ ere b kurge men be Emɔlgapo Kristo Enyɛnpe ashi Deevid be kade to.

english_verse: You will know who he is, because you will find him dressed in baby clothes and lying on a bed of hay.”
translation_verse: Kusɔ nɛ k beeŋ ŋini menyi kumo nde: Menyeeŋ wu b ka ta ewajɛ m mea kebia na n nase asɔbɔya be deka jiso to, asɔbɔya be edikpa to.”

english_verse: Suddenly many other angels came down from heaven and joined in praising God. They said:
translation_verse: Epul na to nɛ emalaika damta ba ti emo na so a boŋ nshɛ a di Ebɔrɛ epaŋ a kaŋɛ:

english_verse: After the angels had left and gone back to heaven, the shepherds said to each other, “Let's go to Bethlehem and see what the Lord has told us about.”
translation_verse: Emalaika na ka yige bumo m bɛta n yɔ esoso nɛ mbolpɔkpapoana na kaŋɛ abar: “Men shin nɛ an yɔ Bɛtlɛhɛm n ya keni kusɔ nɛ k wora nɛ Enyɛnpe shin nɛ an pin ere.”

english_verse: They hurried off and found Mary and Joseph, and they saw the baby lying on a bed of hay.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ b nya manaŋ n ya wu Mɛɛri nɛ Josɛf nɛ kebia na dese asɔbɔya be deka jiso to asɔbɔya be edikpa.

english_verse: When the shepherds saw Jesus, they told his parents what the angel had said about him.
translation_verse: Mbolpɔkpapoana na ka wu kebia na nɛ b kaŋɛ Mɛɛri nɛ Josɛf kusɔ nɛ malaika na kaŋɛ bumo kebia na be asheŋ.

english_verse: But Mary kept thinking about all this and wondering what it meant.
translation_verse: Mɛɛri malɛ daŋ ta asheŋ ere kikɛ nna n wɔtɔ mbe kagbene to a fɛ amo be nfɛra.

english_verse: As the shepherds returned to their sheep, they were praising God and saying wonderful things about him. Everything they had seen and heard was just as the angel had said.
translation_verse: Nɛ mbolpɔkpapoana na bɛta a boŋ nshɛ a di Ebɔrɛ epaŋ a yɔ ŋkpal asɔ nɛ b nu nseŋ wu na kikɛ so. Kusɔ nɛ malaika na daŋ malga na gbagba e daŋ wora chap. B ka nase Yesu mbe ketre be asheŋ

english_verse: Eight days later Jesus' parents did for him what the Law of Moses commands. And they named him Jesus, just as the angel had told Mary when he promised she would have a baby. Simeon Praises the Lord

translation_verse: Jɔn be mbɔ na ka bɛta n yɔ nɛ Yesu fara a malga Jɔn be asheŋ a kaŋɛ jimaŋ na: “Men ka daŋ yɔ Jɔn kutɔ kiyi to na, manɛ nɛ men daŋ tama keyawu? Men daŋ yɔ nna nɛ men ya wu kefitiri be keyɛlbi nɛ afu wɔtɔ a ber a dɛlɛ to na nna ŋko?

translation_verse: Manɛ nɛ men daŋ lar n yɔ nɛ men ya keni? Men daŋ yɔ nna nɛ men ya keni kanyɛn ko ka buu damaso be asɔbuuso ŋko? Kashenteŋto basa nɛ baa kaa buu loŋ be asɔbuuso a wɔ dama to na bee kaa wɔ ewurkpaana nna.

english_verse: No one ever born on this earth is greater than John. But whoever is least important in God's kingdom is greater than John.
translation_verse: Kede be kaman nɛ Yesu naŋ kaŋɛ: “Mee kaŋɛ menyi nna fanɛ Jɔn chɔ durnya to be bomin kikɛ, ama Ebɔrɛ be kuwura na to be ekekarso gba chɔ mo.”

translation_verse: Basa nɛ b daŋ nu mbe kamalga na kikɛ nɛ elamposɔpoana na sɔ Jɔn kabɔrɛbɛrpo be kabɔrɛbɛr na ŋ ŋini kananɛ b shuli fanɛ ekpa nɛ Ebɔrɛ nase na e la kashenteŋ.

english_verse: But the Pharisees and the experts in the Law of Moses refused to obey God and be baptized by John.
translation_verse: Ama kananɛ Efarisiana nɛ mbraŋinipoana na kini kesɔ Jɔn be kabɔrɛbɛr ere ŋini kananɛ b kplaŋ Ebɔrɛ be kɔnɔ naseso nna na.

english_verse: Jesus went on to say: What are you people like? What kind of people are you?
translation_verse: Nɛ Yesu naŋ kaŋɛ: “Manɛ nɛ meeŋ ta mbreebi m ber? Manɛ nɛ b duli?

english_verse: You are like children sitting in the market and shouting to each other, “We played the flute, but you would not dance! We sang a funeral song, but you would not cry!”
translation_verse: B du fanɛ mbia ka tase kelɔnɛ so ntuŋ so nna nɛ katuŋ ko to ebi bishi kuko to ebi le ere: ‘Manɛ e ba nɛ an laŋ ŋkure kejafɔ to n sa menyi nɛ men kini kecha? Nɛ manɛ e ba nɛ an shu keeli to n sa menyi nɛ men kini kechɛ anyi to n shu?’

english_verse: John the Baptist did not go around eating and drinking, and you said, “John has a demon in him!”
translation_verse: Men du fanɛ mbia ere nna, ŋkpal manɛ so, Jɔn kabɔrɛbɛrpo ka ba kaa kishi, mo alɛ ŋkaa maa nuu nsa be yiri kikɛ, le nɛ men kaŋɛ: ‘Kiyoyu lubi e wɔ mo to.’

english_verse: But because the Son of Man goes around eating and drinking, you say, “Jesus eats and drinks too much! He is even a friend of tax collectors and sinners.”
translation_verse: Nɛ ma, Nyiŋgbasa Pibinyɛn ba kaa ji nsaa nuu nɛ men naa kaŋɛ le: ‘Men keni kanyɛn ere, ajibishapo nɛ nsanuupo nɛ lamposɔpoana nɛ alubiworapoana bumo teri e la mo.’

translation_verse: Ama benyiashempo malɛ kikɛ e naa ŋini kanyiasheŋ ka kɔ kashenteŋ.” B ka chulgi tulale n wurge Yesu so be asheŋ

english_verse: A Pharisee invited Jesus to have dinner with him. So Jesus went to the Pharisee's home and got ready to eat.
translation_verse: Farisinyɛn ko daŋ tre Yesu n yɔ mo pe nɛ mo nɛ mo ya ji ajibi. Nɛ Yesu yɔ mbe kowu na to n ya chena a ji.

translation_verse: Farisinyɛn nɛ e daŋ tre Yesu fanɛ e ba ji ajibi na ka wu loŋ nɛ e kaŋɛ mbe kumu: “Nɛ kanyɛn ere baa la anebi gbagba nna, e beeŋ pin esa nɛ e la kache nɛ e bee beta mo ere, e beeŋ pin kebaawɔtɔ lubi nɛ e wɔ to.”

english_verse: Jesus said to the Pharisee, “Simon, I have something to say to you.” “Teacher, what is it?” Simon replied.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ mo: “Saimɔn, mee sha nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ fo kusɔ ko.” Nɛ Saimɔn kaŋɛ: “To, kaŋɛ ma Enyɛnpe.”

translation_verse: Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ: “Benyɛn anyɔ ko e daŋ ji amansherbipampo ko be kukɔ. Eko be kukɔ daa la pɔŋ alfa anu nɛ eko malɛ peya daa la pɔŋ adunu.

translation_verse: Nɛ Yesu bishi mo: “Fo ketre?” Nɛ e kaŋɛ: “Ma ketre e la jimaŋ.” Ŋkpal manɛ so, ayoyu lubi damta e daŋ luri mo to.

translation_verse: Kede be kaman nɛ Yesu naŋ kaŋɛ le: “N Tuto ta kusɔ kama nna m bɔɔ ma enɔ. Esa kama maŋ nyi esa nɛ e la Ebinyɛn na she Etuto na, esa kikɛ malɛ maŋ naa nyi Etuto na she Ebinyɛn na nɛ bumo nɛ Ebinyɛn na bee sha keta Etuto na ŋ ŋini na nawule.”

english_verse: Jesus then turned to his disciples and said to them in private, “You are really blessed to see what you see!
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ Yesu kilgi ŋ kaŋɛ mbe bebɛsopo na wuloso: “Kagbenefuli la menyeya nna ŋkpal asɔ nɛ menyee wu ere so.

english_verse: Jesus answered, “What is written in the Scriptures? How do you understand them?”
translation_verse: Nɛ Yesu bishi mo: “Manɛ nɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na bee ŋini? Nuso nɛ feeŋ kute asɔ nɛ a bee ŋini na be afito?”

english_verse: Jesus said, “You have given the right answer. If you do this, you will have eternal life.”
translation_verse: Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ mo: “Kashenteŋ nɛ fo ji, amoso, baa wora asheŋ nɛ fo malga ere nseŋ nya ŋkpa.”

english_verse: But the man wanted to show that he knew what he was talking about. So he asked Jesus, “Who are my neighbors?”
translation_verse: Ama mbraŋinipo na daa sha na fanɛ e malga n lar nseŋ kpal loŋ so m bishi Yesu: “Esa mo e la m barkasa?”

english_verse: Jesus replied: As a man was going down from Jerusalem to Jericho, robbers attacked him and grabbed everything he had. They beat him up and ran off, leaving him half dead.
translation_verse: Nɛ Yesu naŋ kaŋɛ mo: “Kanyɛn ko e daŋ lar Jerusalɛm a yɔ Jɛriko nɛ beyu ya nyaŋ mo n suge mbe asɔbuuso nseŋ bri mo m bɛlɛ to. Kumo be kaman nɛ b yige mo loŋ n nase nseŋ shile n choŋ.

english_verse: A priest happened to be going down the same road. But when he saw the man, he walked by on the other side.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ bɔrɛmatapo ko ba bɔla ekpa na so a choŋ nseŋ wu mo ŋ gelge boeŋ n choŋ ŋ ka mo.

english_verse: Later a temple helper came to the same place. But when he saw the man who had been beaten up, he also went by on the other side.
translation_verse: Kanyɛn na dese loŋ nɛ Livainyɛn ko malɛ ba bɔla ndoŋ a choŋ n wu mo nseŋ gelge mo m pɛ mbe ekpa n choŋ ŋ ka mo ndoŋ.

english_verse: A man from Samaria then came traveling along that road. When he saw the man, he felt sorry for him
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Samɛria be kanyɛn ko malɛ wɔ mbe enite to m ba tu kanyɛn na m ba wu mo nɛ kuwɔr pɛ mo ga.

english_verse: and went over to him. He treated his wounds with olive oil and wine and bandaged them. Then he put him on his own donkey and took him to an inn, where he took care of him.
translation_verse: Nɛ e yɔ n ya pɛ mo to n wora ŋku nɛ nsa ko n wɔtɔ mbe achuu to nseŋ kre mbe achuuana na. Kumo be kaman nɛ e ta mo n chena mo gbagba be kediiso so n ta mo n yɔ befɔ be ebu ko to n ya keni mo so.

english_verse: The next morning he gave the innkeeper two silver coins and said, “Please take care of the man. If you spend more than this on him, I will pay you when I return.”
translation_verse: Kumo be ŋklade nɛ e lara gbiti be ndarbi anyɔ n sa befɔ be ebukenipo na nseŋ kaŋɛ mo: ‘Baa keni mo so nɛ ŋ ka naŋ ya bɛta m ba nɛ fo jija amansherbi ko n ti so, meeŋ ka fo.’ ”

english_verse: Then Jesus asked, “Which one of these three people was a real neighbor to the man who was beaten up by robbers?”
translation_verse: Keŋasa ere be kaman nɛ Yesu bishi kanyɛn na: “Basa asa nɛ b tu kanyɛn nɛ beyu na daŋ bri na be emo e la kanyɛn na mo barkasa?”

english_verse: The expert in the Law of Moses answered, “The one who showed pity.” Jesus said, “Go and do the same!” Martha and Mary
translation_verse: Nɛ mbraŋinipo na kaŋɛ le: “Emo nɛ e wu mo kuwɔr n chɛ mo to na.” Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ mo: “To, fo alɛ gba e baa yɔ n ya kaa wora loŋ.” Mɛɛri nɛ Maata be asheŋ

english_verse: The Lord and his disciples were traveling along and came to a village. When they got there, a woman named Martha welcomed him into her home.
translation_verse: Yesu nɛ mbe bebɛsopo wɔ bumo be enite na to loŋ m ba fo kadebi ko nɛ kache ko nɛ baa tre Maata shin nɛ b ba luri mo pe.

english_verse: She had a sister named Mary, who sat down in front of the Lord and was listening to what he said.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Maata mo sipocheso mo nɛ baa tre Mɛɛri na ya kaa tase Enyɛnpe na be anishito a nu mbe kamalga.

english_verse: Martha was worried about all that had to be done. Finally, she went to Jesus and said, “Lord, doesn't it bother you that my sister has left me to do all the work by myself? Tell her to come and help me!”
translation_verse: Maata be kafɔketa be ashuŋ daŋ wora mo keshi ga nɛ e kpal loŋ so m ba kaŋɛ Enyɛnpe na le: “Kananɛ n sipo Mɛɛri yige ma nɛ ashuŋ ere maŋ tir fo a? Kaŋɛ mo nɛ e ba chɛ ma to.”

english_verse: The Lord answered, “Martha, Martha! You are worried and upset about so many things,
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe na kaŋɛ Maata: “Maata Maata, sa maŋ shin nɛ asheŋ damta e tir fo a jija fo kagbene.

english_verse: but only one thing is necessary. Mary has chosen what is best, and it will not be taken away from her.”
translation_verse: Kusɔ koŋwule e baŋ daga, kumo alɛ nɛ Mɛɛri lara na. Esa kikɛ maaŋ tiŋ n sɔ kumo ŋ ka mo.”

english_verse: So I tell you to ask and you will receive, search and you will find, knock and the door will be opened for you.
translation_verse: Amoso, mee kaŋɛ menyi nna na: Men kule nseŋ nya, men fin nseŋ wu, men ŋmɛa kabuna nɛ b bugi n sa menyi.

english_verse: As bad as you are, you still know how to give good gifts to your children. But your heavenly Father is even more ready to give the Holy Spirit to anyone who asks. Jesus and the Ruler of Demons (Matthew
translation_verse: Nɛ menyi ere ka la basa lubi le nsaa nyi asɔ lela be kebaata a sa menyi be mbia, nɛ Etuto nɛ e wɔ ebɔrɛso na a? Mo ere maaŋ shuli n sa bekama nɛ b kule mo Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na a?” Yesu nɛ Biyɛlzibel be asheŋ (Matiu

english_verse: And suppose your friend answers, “Don't bother me! The door is bolted, and my children and I are in bed. I cannot get up to give you something.”
translation_verse: Nɛ fanɛ fo teri na wɔ mbe ebu to nseŋ kaŋɛ: ‘Sa maŋ tɔrɔ ma, ŋkpal manɛ so, n teŋ ti ma kabuna so nɛ ma nɛ ma mbia dese, ma alɛ maaŋ naŋ tiŋ ŋ koso n sa fo kusɔ kama.’

english_verse: Which one of you fathers would give your hungry child a snake if the child asked for a fish?
translation_verse: Menyi nɛ men la betuto ere be emo pibi e naaŋ kule mo kɔrɔtɔ nɛ e ta kuwɔ n sa mo?

english_verse: So Jesus told them, “Pray in this way: ‘Father, help us to honor your name. Come and set up your kingdom.
translation_verse: Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ bumo: “Nɛ men baa kule Ebɔrɛ, men baa kaŋɛ le: ‘Etuto, shin nɛ fo ketre cheembi na e baa nya bunyaŋ n shin nɛ fo kuwurgboŋ na e ba.

english_verse: Forgive our sins, as we forgive everyone who has done wrong to us. And keep us from being tempted.’ ”
translation_verse: Ta anyi be alubi m paŋ anyi, ŋkpal manɛ so, anyi alɛ gba ta m paŋ ekama nɛ e wora n da anyi so. Sa maŋ shin nɛ an luri kechɔŋkeni to.’ ”

english_verse: Everyone who asks will receive, everyone who searches will find, and the door will be opened for everyone who knocks.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, ekama nɛ e kule beeŋ nya, ekama nɛ e fin beeŋ wu nɛ ekama malɛ nɛ e ŋmɛa kabuna, baaŋ bugi n sa mo.

english_verse: Just as Jonah was a sign to the people of Nineveh, the Son of Man will be a sign to the people of today.
translation_verse: Kananɛ anebi Jona daŋ baa la Ninɛveebi be tɔɔnɛ na nɛ ma, Nyiŋgbasa Pibinyɛn gba beeŋ baa la mbreebi be tɔɔnɛ.

english_verse: While Jesus was still talking, a woman in the crowd spoke up, “The woman who gave birth to you and nursed you is blessed!”
translation_verse: Yesu ka malga kesheŋ ere nɛ jimaŋ na to be kache ko kaŋɛ mo: “Kache nɛ e kurge fo nɛ fo nyipo mo n daŋ ere nu ebel bre.”

english_verse: Jesus forced a demon out of a man who could not talk. And after the demon had gone out, the man started speaking, and the crowds were amazed.
translation_verse: Kachako Yesu ju neemu be kiyoyu lubi ashi kanyɛn ko to. Kiyoyu lubi na ka baŋ yɔ nɛ kanyɛn na fara a malga nɛ k chinchiŋ jimaŋ na ga.

english_verse: Others wanted to put Jesus to the test. So they asked him to show them a sign from God.
translation_verse: Basa na be beko daa sha kewora mo nna ŋ keni nseŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ e shin nɛ kemamachisheŋ ko e shi ebɔrɛso m ba ŋini fanɛ Ebɔrɛ wɔ mbe kaman a.

english_verse: Jesus knew what they were thinking, and he said: A kingdom where people fight each other will end up in ruin. And a family that fights will break up.
translation_verse: Nɛ Yesu pin bumo be nfɛra nseŋ kaŋɛ bumo: “Ewura kama nɛ mbe basa barga to a kɔ abar kena, kuwura na maaŋ chɛr ŋkeŋ tɔr. Kakurge koŋwule to ebi baŋ barga to a kɔ abar kena, kakurge na bee jija nna.

english_verse: If Satan fights against himself, how can his kingdom last? Yet you say that I force out demons by the power of Beelzebul.
translation_verse: Amoso, nɛ Setani barga mbe kumu to a kɔ mo gbagba be kumu kena, nuso nɛ mbe kuwura na beeŋ wora a wɔtɔ? Menyi yɛ Biyɛlzibel e naa sa ma eleŋ nɛ ŋ kɔ a ju mbuibi lubi ashi basa to.

english_verse: If I use his power to force out demons, whose power do your own followers use to force them out? They are the ones who will judge you.
translation_verse: Ama nɛ fanɛ loŋ e naa shin nɛ mee ju mbuibi lubi na kashenteŋto, nɛ wanɛ malɛ e naa sa menyi be bebɛsopoana eleŋ nɛ baa tiŋ a ju amo ashi basa to? To, menyi gbagba be bebɛsopo na e naa ŋini fanɛ men maŋ kɔ kashenteŋ.

english_verse: When a strong man arms himself and guards his home, everything he owns is safe.
translation_verse: Nɛ elempo kɔ mbe kena to be asɔ a wɔtɔ a keni mo gbagba be kowu so, shɛŋ maaŋ wora mbe asɔ.

english_verse: You Pharisees are in for trouble! You love the front seats in the synagogues, and you like to be greeted with honor in the market.
translation_verse: Farisiebi, asheŋ maaŋ nyalɛ n sa menyi nɛ menyee sha kebaachena bunyanso be mbɛ so ashi nshɛrbuana to nseŋ naa sha nɛ basa e baa tu menyi kebɛ to a chɔrɔ menyi bunyanso na.

english_verse: A teacher of the Law of Moses spoke up, “Teacher, you said cruel things about us.”
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ mbraŋinipoana na be eko kaŋɛ mo: “Eŋinipo, kananɛ fee malga le ere, fee tege anyi alɛ gba nna na.”

english_verse: When an evil spirit leaves a person, it travels through the desert, looking for a place to rest. But when it doesn't find a place, it says, “I will go back to the home I left.”
translation_verse: Kiyoyu lubi baŋ lar esa to, e na kiyi to nna a fin ewushikpa. E baŋ fin kakpa ŋ gben, le nɛ e bee kaŋɛ mbe kumu: ‘Meeŋ naŋ bɛta n yɔ ma kowu dra nɛ n lar na to.’

english_verse: When it gets there and finds the place clean and fixed up,
translation_verse: E baŋ bɛta m ba wu fanɛ b lɔŋɛ kowu na nɛnɛ n yili,

english_verse: it goes off and finds seven other evil spirits even worse than itself. They all come and make their home there, and that person ends up in worse shape than before. Being Really Blessed
translation_verse: e bee lar nna n ya keta mbuibi lubi ashunu nɛ b lubi a chɔ mo m ba ti mbe kumu so a wɔ ndoŋ. Saŋɛ na so amodoŋwura be kebaawɔtɔ bee lubi nna a ti so a chɔ kebaawɔtɔ nɛ e daa kɔ sososo na.” Kagbenefuli gbagba be asheŋ

english_verse: Jesus replied, “That's true, but the people who are really blessed are the ones who hear and obey God's message!” A Sign from God (Matthew
translation_verse: Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ: “Ayai, bumo nɛ baaŋ nu ebel e la bumo nɛ baa nu abɔrɛsheŋ na nsaa wora amo.” B ka kule Yesu fanɛ e wora kemamachisheŋ be asheŋ (Matiu

english_verse: The Pharisee was surprised that he did not wash his hands before eating.
translation_verse: Farisinyɛn na ka wu fanɛ Yesu maŋ fɔr mbe enɔana kananɛ k daga na pɔɛŋ nsaa ji nɛ k chinchiŋ mo ga.

english_verse: You Pharisees are in for trouble! You give God a tenth of the spices from your gardens, such as mint and rue. But you cheat people, and you don't love God. You should be fair and kind to others and still give a tenth to God.
translation_verse: Farisiebi, asheŋ maaŋ nyalɛ n sa menyi, ŋkpal manɛ so, menyee kaa lara menyi be eposɔ fanɛ ashiibi nɛ egabu nɛ amo nɛ a ka na kikɛ gba so be asɔ kudukudusopo a sa Ebɔrɛ, ama men kini keji asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so, menyi alɛ maa sha Ebɔrɛ. Le be asɔ ere e daga fanɛ men baa wora nsaa maa gal amo nɛ a ka na gba a lɛ.

english_verse: As crowds were gathering around Jesus, he said: You people of today are evil! You keep looking for a sign from God. But what happened to Jonah is the only sign you will be given.
translation_verse: Basa na ka mel ŋ kulti Yesu loŋ nɛ e naŋ fara a kaŋɛ: “Mbreebi be alubi shi bumo to bre. B kaŋɛ fanɛ n wora mamachi be kesheŋ ko ŋ ŋini fanɛ Ebɔrɛ wɔ ma kaman, ama b maaŋ nya shɛŋ n wu she anebi Jona be mamachi be kesheŋ na.

english_verse: When the judgment comes, the Queen of the South will stand there with you and condemn you. She traveled a long way to hear Solomon's wisdom, and yet here is something far greater than Solomon.
translation_verse: Demujiachɛ Bɔrɛfito be Ewurche beeŋ yili n ji m bri mbreebi, ŋkpal manɛ so, e yili kaboŋ wɔfɔ durnya ere to n nite n ya nu Ewura Sɔlɔmɔn be kashennyi be kesheŋ ŋini. Ama ma e kaŋɛ menyi na fanɛ esa ko wɔ nfe a chɔ Ewura Sɔlɔmɔn.

english_verse: The people of Nineveh will also stand there with you and condemn you. They turned to God when Jonah preached, and yet here is something far greater than Jonah. Light (Matthew
translation_verse: Demujiachɛ na Ninɛveebi beeŋ yili n ji m bri mbreebi, ŋkpal manɛ so, anebi Jona ka daŋ bɔ kubɔya na n sa bumo na b daŋ lar bumo be alubi to. Ama ma e kaŋɛ menyi na fanɛ esa ko wɔ nfe a chɔ anebi Jona.” Eyur be kefulto be asheŋ (Matiu

english_verse: No one lights a lamp and then hides it or puts it under a clay pot. A lamp is put on a lampstand, so everyone who comes into the house can see the light.
translation_verse: Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ: “B maa chɔɔ fitila so nsaa ta kumo a ŋana ŋko a ta katishaŋ a buu kumo so. Fitila be eyilikpa nɛ baa ta kumo a yili nɛ basa nɛ baa luri ebu na to na e nya kefulto.

english_verse: Your eyes are the lamp for your body. When your eyes are good, you have all the light you need. But when your eyes are bad, everything is dark.
translation_verse: Fo anishi e la fo eyur be kefulto. Fo anishi baa walɛ, kefulto malɛ bee bɔlɔ fo eyur kikɛ to nna. Ama nɛ fo anishi baa maŋ walɛ, tentembiri e naaŋ baŋ bɔlɔ fo eyur na kikɛ to.

english_verse: You fools! Didn't God make both the outside and the inside?
translation_verse: Bewulpo ere, mannɛ esa nɛ e wora kamanto na gbagba e wora epun to na gba a?

english_verse: Yes, you are really in for trouble. You build monuments to honor the prophets your own people murdered long ago.
translation_verse: Asheŋ maaŋ nyalɛ n sa menyi, ŋkpal manɛ so, men nanaana mɔ anebiana na nɛ menyi alɛ pɔr asɔ n yuu bumo be nchaŋana so.

english_verse: When Jesus finished speaking, a Pharisee invited him home for a meal. Jesus went and sat down to eat.
translation_verse: Yesu ka malga n loge nɛ Farisinyɛn ko tre mo fanɛ e ba mo pe nɛ b ji ajibi nɛ Yesu yɔ n ya chena nɛ e ji.

english_verse: So the Lord said to him: You Pharisees clean the outside of cups and dishes, but on the inside you are greedy and evil.
translation_verse: Nɛ Enyɛnpe kaŋɛ mo: “O Farisiebi, men baa du fanɛ kananɛ menyee fɔr mba nɛ nwiebi be mmanto a yige amo be epunana to na nna. Men baŋ duli basa lela nna, ama kejimuni nɛ alubi e baŋ bɔlɔ menyi to.

english_verse: If you would only give what you have to the poor, everything you do would please God.
translation_verse: Kusɔ nɛ k daga kewora e la men ka bee ta asɔ ashi menyi be ekpanjawu to a kɛ betirpo nɛ kusɔ kama e nyalɛ n sa menyi.

english_verse: But you are in for trouble! You are like unmarked graves that people walk on without even knowing it.
translation_verse: Asheŋ maaŋ nyalɛ n sa menyi, ŋkpal manɛ so, men du fanɛ nchaŋ nɛ b maŋ dulgi nɛ basa maŋ nyi nsaa nite amo so na nna.”

english_verse: Jesus replied: You teachers are also in for trouble! You load people down with heavy burdens, but you won't lift a finger to help them carry the loads.
translation_verse: Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ: “Asheŋ maaŋ nyalɛ n sa menyi mbraŋinipoana ere gba, ŋkpal kananɛ menyee kre esulɔ gbɛgbɛso a sa basa, ama menyi alɛ gbagba maaŋ shuli n ta keshilbi koŋwule gba ŋ gbuŋgbuŋ esulɔ na to so.

english_verse: You must think that was the right thing for your people to do, or else you would not have built monuments for the prophets they murdered.
translation_verse: Le e naa ŋini fanɛ men shuli fanɛ asɔ nɛ men nanaana daŋ wora na daŋ bɔla ekpa, ŋkpal manɛ so, b mɔ anebiana na nɛ menyi alɛ pɔr asɔ n yuu bumo be nchaŋana so.

english_verse: Because of your evil deeds, the Wisdom of God said, “I will send prophets and apostles to you. But you will murder some and mistreat others.”
translation_verse: Ŋkpal ade so nɛ Ebɔrɛ ta mbe kanyiasheŋ ŋ kaŋɛ: ‘Meeŋ shuŋi anebiana nɛ beshuŋipoana bumo kutɔ, ama baaŋ mɔ bumo to be beko nseŋ tɔrɔ beko malɛ.’

english_verse: You people living today will be punished for all the prophets who have been murdered since the beginning of the world.
translation_verse: Amoso, anebiana nɛ b lar nɛ baa mɔ a mɔ bumo jemanɛ nɛ durnya fara na kikɛ m ba fo mbre be luwu be turju beeŋ bɛ mbreebi.

english_verse: This includes every prophet from the time of Abel to the time of Zechariah, who was murdered between the altar and the temple. You people will certainly be punished for all of this.
translation_verse: Kumo e la fanɛ, baŋ fara jemanɛ nɛ b mɔ Ebel na m ba fo Zakareya nɛ b mɔ bɔrɛsure na nɛ bɔrɛlambu be nferinto na achɛ nɛ n de na. Ma e kaŋɛ menyi na fanɛ kashenteŋto, asheŋ na kikɛ be kasogberge beeŋ ba mbreebi ere so.

english_verse: You teachers of the Law of Moses are really in for trouble! You carry the keys to the door of knowledge about God. But you never go in, and you keep others from going in.
translation_verse: Mbraŋinipoana, asheŋ maaŋ nyalɛ n sa menyi, ŋkpal manɛ so, men ta kashenteŋ be kepin na be ekpa ŋ ŋana basa so, menyi alɛ gbagba maŋ bɛ loŋ be ekpa na so nseŋ naa kuŋ basa nɛ b daa sha kebɛ kumo so na ekpa.”

english_verse: Jesus was about to leave, but the teachers and the Pharisees wanted to get even with him. They tried to make him say what he thought about other things,
translation_verse: Yesu ka lar ndoŋ nɛ Efarisiana na nɛ mbraŋinipoana na fara a wu mo kulubi agboso

english_verse: As thousands of people crowded around Jesus and were stepping on each other, he told his disciples: Be sure to guard against the dishonest teaching of the Pharisees! It is their way of fooling people.
translation_verse: Basa ŋgboŋ damta ko ka shɛr ndoŋ hale n ya kaa chichi abar so nɛ Yesu fara a kaŋɛ mbe bebɛsopo le: “Men baa de Efarisiana na be yiisi so, kumo e la fanɛ bumo be kebirkɔnshi be asheŋ.

english_verse: God gives such beauty to everything that grows in the fields, even though it is here today and thrown into a fire tomorrow. Won't he do even more for you? You have such little faith!
translation_verse: O yirdabiwuraana, nɛ Ebɔrɛ bee keni afitiri nɛ feeŋ wu kabre ŋ klade n fin amo ndoŋ ŋ gben ŋkpal b ka chɔɔ amo so ere so a sa amo amo be kela, nɛ menyi ere ka bɔ amo ere nɛ e maaŋ sa asɔbuuso a?

english_verse: But put God's work first, and these things will be yours as well. Treasures in Heaven (Matthew
translation_verse: Amoso, men ta Ebɔrɛ be kuwura na be kasha n juŋkpar men be kebaawɔtɔ to nɛ e shin nɛ men nya asɔ na n ti so.” Kebaakɔ asɔ ebɔrɛso be asheŋ (Matiu

english_verse: My friends, don't be afraid of people. They can kill you, but after that, there is nothing else they can do.
translation_verse: N teriana, mee kaŋɛ menyi nna na fanɛ men sa maa ŋana basa nɛ baaŋ tiŋ m mɔ menyi be eyur ere ŋkaa maaŋ naŋ tiŋ n wora menyi shɛŋ.

english_verse: Even the hairs on your head are counted. So don't be afraid! You are worth much more than many sparrows. Telling Others about Christ (Matthew
