translation_verse: Nɛ Jɔn kaŋɛ bumo: “Nchu nɛ ŋ kɔ a bɛr basa kabɔrɛbɛr, ama esa ko yil menyi to nfe nɛ men maŋ nyi mo.

english_verse: Even though I came first, I am not good enough to untie his sandals.”
translation_verse: Mo e la esa nɛ e wɔ ma kaman a ba na, esa nɛ m maŋ fo mbe aya to be shishɛr gba so na.”

english_verse: John said this as he was baptizing east of the Jordan River in Bethany. The Lamb of God
translation_verse: Bɛtani nɛ asheŋ ere kikɛ wora ashi Jɔɔdan be lɔr be kaba ndoŋ, kakpa nɛ Jɔn daa bɛr basa kabɔrɛbɛr na. Ebɔrɛ be Kpakpafɔlbi be asheŋ

english_verse: The next day, John saw Jesus coming toward him and said: Here is the Lamb of God who takes away the sin of the world!
translation_verse: Asheŋ ere ka wora ŋ klade nɛ Jɔn wu Yesu ka bee ba mo kutɔ nɛ e kaŋɛ basa le: “Men keni, Ebɔrɛ be Kpakpafɔlbi nɛ k bee lara durnyaebi be alubi ashi bumo to a lɛ na.

english_verse: He is the one I told you about when I said, “Someone else will come, who is greater than I am, because he was alive before I was born.”
translation_verse: Mo nɛ n daa de saŋɛ nɛ n daŋ kaŋɛ le na fanɛ: ‘Kanyɛn ko wɔ ma kaman a ba na, ŋkpal manɛ so, e daŋ ma kebaawɔtɔ ashi Ebɔrɛ be anishito.’

english_verse: I didn't know who he was. But I came to baptize you with water, so that everyone in Israel would see him.
translation_verse: Ma ere gbagba daa maŋ nyi mo, ama kusɔ nɛ k ba nɛ m ba kaa ta nchu a bɛr basa kabɔrɛbɛr na e la fanɛ Israɛlebi e wu mo nseŋ pin mo.”

english_verse: I was there and saw the Spirit come down on him like a dove from heaven. And the Spirit stayed on him.
translation_verse: Kede be kaman nɛ Jɔn ji le be shɛda ŋ kaŋɛ: “N wu Kiyoyu na ka shi ebɔrɛso ŋ gbelge m ba fanɛ lepɔ m ba shir a wɔ mo so.

english_verse: Before this I didn't know who he was. But the one who sent me to baptize with water had told me, “You will see the Spirit come down and stay on someone. Then you will know that he is the one who will baptize with the Holy Spirit.”
translation_verse: Nɛ fanɛ esa nɛ e shuŋi ma fanɛ m ba ta nchu m bɛr basa kabɔrɛbɛr na daa maŋ ŋini ma mo, ma alɛ gba daa maaŋ pin mo. Le nɛ e daŋ kaŋɛ ma: ‘Esa nɛ feeŋ wu Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na ka beeŋ ba gbelge mo so n shir a wɔ mo to na e la esa nɛ e beeŋ shin nɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na e gbelge basa so.’

english_verse: I saw this happen, and I tell you that he is the Son of God. The First Disciples of Jesus
translation_verse: Ma alɛ wu nsaa ji shɛda fanɛ mo e la Ebɔrɛ Pibinyɛn na.” Yesu be beshuŋipo juŋkparsoana be asheŋ

english_verse: The next day, John was there again, and two of his followers were with him.
translation_verse: Kumo be ŋklade Jɔn nɛ mbe bebɛsopo anyɔ ko naa yil kakpa koŋwule na.

english_verse: When he saw Jesus walking by, he said, “Here is the Lamb of God!”
translation_verse: Nɛ e wu Yesu ka bee choŋ nɛ e kaŋɛ: “Men keni Ebɔrɛ be Kpakpafɔlbi na.”

english_verse: John's two followers heard him, and they went with Jesus.
translation_verse: Bebɛsopo anyɔ na ka nu kusɔ nɛ e kaŋɛ na nɛ b ta m bɛ Yesu so.

english_verse: When Jesus turned and saw them, he asked, “What do you want?” They answered, “Rabbi, where do you live?” The Hebrew word “Rabbi” means “Teacher.”
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Yesu gbɛ ŋ keni nɛ b bɛ mo so nɛ e bishi bumo: “Manɛ nɛ menyee fin?” Nɛ b bishi mo: “Rabai, nnɛ nɛ fo wɔ?” Rabai be kifito e la eŋinipo.

english_verse: Jesus replied, “Come and see!” It was already about four o'clock in the afternoon when they went with him and saw where he lived. So they stayed on for the rest of the day.
translation_verse: Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ bumo: “Men ba keni.” Ndoŋ nna nɛ b ya wu kakpa nɛ e wɔ nseŋ shir mo kutɔ ndoŋ hale nɛ epeŋi ya tɔr, ŋkpal manɛ so, k daa la fanɛ kaaseso kerfi ana be saŋɛ nna.

english_verse: One of the two men who had heard John and had gone with Jesus was Andrew, the brother of Simon Peter.
translation_verse: Basa anyɔ nɛ b daŋ nu kusɔ nɛ Jɔn daŋ kaŋɛ nseŋ bɛ Yesu so na be eko e daa la Andru, Saimɔn Pita mo sipo na.

english_verse: The first thing Andrew did was to find his brother and tell him, “We have found the Messiah!” The Hebrew word “Messiah” means the same as the Greek word “Christ.”
translation_verse: Kusɔ nɛ Andru daŋ baŋ fara n wora e la fanɛ e daŋ fin mo da Saimɔn nna ŋ kaŋɛ mo le: “An wu Mesaya na.” Kumo e la fanɛ Kristo na.

english_verse: Andrew brought his brother to Jesus. And when Jesus saw him, he said, “Simon son of John, you will be called Cephas.” This name can be translated as “Peter.” Jesus Chooses Philip and Nathanael
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ e bar Saimɔn Yesu kutɔ nɛ mo alɛ keni Saimɔn nseŋ kaŋɛ le: “Fo e la Saimɔn nɛ fo tuto bee ji Jɔn na ŋko? Naniere baaŋ baa tre fo Sifas.” Kumo be kifito e la kefalta nɛ kumo koŋwule na la Pita. Yesu ka tre Filip nɛ Nataniɛl be asheŋ

english_verse: The next day Jesus decided to go to Galilee. There he met Philip, who was from Bethsaida, the hometown of Andrew and Peter. Jesus said to Philip, “Follow me.”
translation_verse: Filip daŋ shi Bɛtsaida be kade to nna, kakpa koŋwule nɛ Andru nɛ Pita gba shi na.

english_verse: Philip then found Nathanael and said, “We have found the one that Moses and the Prophets wrote about. He is Jesus, the son of Joseph from Nazareth.”
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ Filip malɛ wu Nataniɛl nseŋ kaŋɛ mo le: “An wu esa nɛ anebi Mosis sibɛ mbe asheŋ ashi mbra be kawɔl na to na. Mo koŋwule na be asheŋ nɛ anebiana na kikɛ sibɛ na. Mo e la Nazarɛt be Yesu, Josɛf pibi na.”

english_verse: When Jesus saw Nathanael coming toward him, he said, “Here is a true descendant of our ancestor Israel. And he isn't deceitful.”
translation_verse: Yesu ka wu Nataniɛl ka bee ba mo kutɔ nɛ e kaŋɛ mo le: “Kashenteŋto, Israɛl be esa gbagba nde nɛ efɛsheŋ kikɛ maŋ wɔ mo to.”

english_verse: “How do you know me?” Nathanael asked. Jesus answered, “Before Philip called you, I saw you under the fig tree.”
translation_verse: Nɛ Nataniɛl bishi mo: “Nnɛ nɛ fo nyi ma?” Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ mo: “Fo ka daa wɔ figi be kedibi na be kifi to pɔɛŋ nɛ Filip tre fo na kikɛ nɛ n wu fo.”

english_verse: Nathanael said, “Rabbi, you are the Son of God and the King of Israel!”
translation_verse: Nɛ Nataniɛl kaŋɛ mo le: “Rabai, kashenteŋto, fo e la Ebɔrɛ Pibinyɛn na. Fo e la Israɛl be efuli so be Ewura na.”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Did you believe me just because I said that I saw you under the fig tree? You will see something even greater.
translation_verse: Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ mo: “Ŋ ka kaŋɛ fo fanɛ n wu fo figi be kedibi na be kifi to na so so nɛ fo yirda ere a? Fo kraa beeŋ wu asheŋ nɛ a chɔ kede ere gba.”

english_verse: I tell you for certain you will see heaven open and God's angels going up and coming down on the Son of Man.”
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ e kaŋɛ bumo kikɛ: “Kashenteŋ nɛ mee kaŋɛ menyi na fanɛ menyeeŋ wu ebɔrɛso ka bugi nɛ Ebɔrɛ be emalaika bee dii a gbelge a ba ma, Nyiŋgbasa Pibinyɛn so.”

english_verse: Three days later Mary, the mother of Jesus, was at a wedding feast in the village of Cana in Galilee.
translation_verse: Filip nɛ Nataniɛl ka ba Yesu kutɔ be nchɛnnyɔ be kaman nɛ esa ko bee kre kejafɔ ashi Keena be kade to ashi Galili, nɛ Yesu mo nio gba yɔ ndoŋ.

english_verse: Jesus and his disciples had also been invited and were there.
translation_verse: B daŋ tre Yesu nɛ mbe bebɛsopo gba kejafɔ na to nna nɛ b yɔ.

english_verse: When the wine was all gone, Mary said to Jesus, “They don't have any more wine.”
translation_verse: B wɔ ndoŋ nna nɛ kejafɔ na to be yabra belbelso ya loge nɛ Yesu mo nio kaŋɛ mo: “Keni, bumo be yabra belbelso na maŋ naa wɔtɔ.”

english_verse: Jesus replied, “Mother, my time hasn't yet come! You must not tell me what to do.”
translation_verse: Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ: “Kache manɛ, fee sha keŋini ma asheŋ be kewora nna a? Ma saŋɛ maŋ naŋ fo.”

english_verse: Mary then said to the servants, “Do whatever Jesus tells you to do.”
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Yesu mo nio kilgi ŋ kaŋɛ laŋ na to be nyɛrbi le: “Kusɔ kama nɛ e yɛ men wora, men wora.”

english_verse: At the feast there were six stone water jars that were used by the people for washing themselves in the way that their religion said they must. Each jar held about
translation_verse: Juwebi daa kɔ eyur be kefɔrso be daŋkare be kabɔrɛbɛso ko nna, amoso, mpuya ashe e daa yil ndoŋ. Mpuya na be kekama daa beeŋ tiŋ n sɔ nchu fanɛ egalɔn adunyɔ ŋko adesa.

english_verse: Jesus told the servants to fill them to the top with water. Then after the jars had been filled,
translation_verse: Loŋ be mpuya na be asheŋ nɛ Yesu daŋ kaŋɛ nyɛrbi na le: “Men jɔ nchu m bɔlɔ amo felɛlɛ.” Ndoŋ nna nɛ b jɔ nchu na m bɔlɔ amo.

english_verse: he said, “Now take some water and give it to the man in charge of the feast.” The servants did as Jesus told them,
translation_verse: B ka loge nɛ e kaŋɛ bumo: “To, naniere men jɔ amo be ako n ya sa kejafɔ be kejigboŋ ere to be enimu na.” Nchu na daŋ kilgi yabra belbelso nna.

english_verse: and the man in charge drank some of the water that had now turned into wine. He did not know where the wine had come from, but the servants did. He called the bridegroom over
translation_verse: B ka jɔ amo n yɔ nɛ enimu na nuu ŋ keni. Nyɛrbi nɛ b daŋ jɔ nchu na daa nyi kakpa nɛ le be yabra belbelso na daŋ shi, ama enimu na bre daa maŋ nyi. Amoso, e daŋ tre kejafɔ mo kul na nna n lar ekarso n ya kaŋɛ mo le:

english_verse: and said, “The best wine is always served first. Then after the guests have had plenty, the other wine is served. But you have kept the best until last!”
translation_verse: “Keni, yabra belbelso lela nɛ ekama yaa fara a bar nɛ basa bee nuu bumo be keparso pɔɛŋ nɛ baa bar amo nɛ a maŋ wɔ ebel fanɛ ade na kaman. Nɛ manɛ e ba nɛ fo ere yaŋ ta alela na n yili loŋ m ba kaa chige amo naniere?”

english_verse: But Jesus was talking about his body as a temple.
translation_verse: Ama mannɛ bɔrɛlambu be ebu na gbagba nɛ Yesu daa de. Mbe eyur nɛ e daa de.

english_verse: Not long before the Jewish festival of Passover, Jesus went to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: A ka ba ka gbrɛbi nɛ Juwebi be Kebansonchoŋ be daŋkare be kejigboŋ be saŋɛ e fo nɛ Yesu yɔ Jerusalɛm.

english_verse: So he took some rope and made a whip. Then he chased everyone out of the temple, together with their sheep and cattle. He turned over the tables of the moneychangers and scattered their coins.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ e ta amamprɔŋ n wora kuchuchɔ n ju basa na kikɛ nɛ mbolpɔ nɛ ana na kikɛ nseŋ melgi eteebɔl na kikɛ m buu nɛ bumo be amansherbiana na tɔr m pesaŋ to.

english_verse: The disciples then remembered that the Scriptures say, “My love for your house burns in me like a fire.”
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ mbe bebɛsopoana nyiŋi abɔrɛsibɛ na ka bee kaŋɛ fanɛ: “Kasha nɛ fo kɔ a sha fo pe ere shi ma to ga hale a chɔɔ ma to fanɛ edɛ na.”

english_verse: “Destroy this temple,” Jesus answered, “and in three days I will build it again!”
translation_verse: Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ bumo le: “Men jija bɔrɛlambu ere ŋ keni nɛ n naŋ pɔr kumo nchɛ nsa to.”

english_verse: There he found people selling cattle, sheep, and doves in the temple. He also saw moneychangers sitting at their tables.
translation_verse: E ka fo ndoŋ nɛ e yɔ bɔrɛlambu na to nɛ basa ko wɔ kumo to be kelɔnɛ so a fa ana nɛ mbolpɔ nɛ ali nɛ beko malɛ tase bumo be eteebɔl ase a chɛr amansherbi.

english_verse: Jesus said to the people who had been selling doves, “Get those doves out of here! Don't make my Father's house a marketplace.”
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ e kilgi ŋ kaŋɛ alifapoana na le: “Men ta amo n lar nfe. Men sa maŋ ta n Tuto pe a ki kebɛ.”

english_verse: And when he was raised from death, his disciples remembered what he had told them. Then they believed the Scriptures and the words of Jesus. Jesus Knows What People Are Like
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ daŋ tiŋi Yesu ashi luwu to nna pɔɛŋ nɛ bebɛsopo na nyiŋi kusɔ nɛ e daŋ kaŋɛ na. Ndoŋ nna nɛ b wora abɔrɛsibɛ na nɛ mmalga nɛ Yesu daŋ malga na yirda.

english_verse: In Jerusalem during Passover many people put their faith in Jesus, because they saw him work miracles.
translation_verse: Yesu ka daa wɔ Jerusalɛm, Kebansonchoŋ be kejigboŋ be saŋɛ na, basa damta daŋ yirda mo nna ŋkpal emamachi be ashuŋ nɛ b daŋ wu e ka wora so.

english_verse: But Jesus knew what was in their hearts, and he would not let them have power over him.
translation_verse: Ama Yesu daa maŋ ta mbe kumu m bɔɔ esa kama enɔ, ŋkpal manɛ so, e nyi dimɛdi kikɛ to nɛnɛ nyam.

english_verse: There was a man named Nicodemus who was a Pharisee and a Jewish leader.
translation_verse: Kanyɛn ko e daa wɔtɔ nɛ baa tre mo Nikodimɔs. E daa la Farisi nna nseŋ daa la Juwebi be bejuŋkparpoana na be eko.

english_verse: One night he went to Jesus and said, “Rabbi, we know that God has sent you to teach us. You could not work these miracles, unless God were with you.”
translation_verse: Kachako kiidiso nɛ e yɔ Yesu kutɔ n ya kaŋɛ mo le: “Rabai, mamachi be asheŋ nɛ fee wora ere e shin nɛ an pin fanɛ fo ka la eŋinipo nɛ e shi Ebɔrɛ kutɔ m ba, ŋkpal manɛ so, nɛ Ebɔrɛ maŋ wɔ esa to, e maaŋ tiŋ n wora asɔ nɛ fee wora ere.”

english_verse: Jesus replied, “I tell you for certain that you must be born from above before you can see God's kingdom!”
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ mo le: “Kashenteŋ nɛ mee kaŋɛ fo na fanɛ, nɛ esa baa maŋ nya kakurge nyɔsopo na, e maaŋ wu Ebɔrɛ be kuwura na kikɛ.”

english_verse: Jesus answered: I tell you for certain that before you can get into God's kingdom, you must be born not only by water, but by the Spirit.
translation_verse: Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ mo: “Kashenteŋ nɛ mee kaŋɛ fo na fanɛ nɛ b baa maŋ bɔla nchu nɛ Kiyoyu na so ŋ kurge esa, e maaŋ tiŋ n luri Ebɔrɛ be kuwura na to.

english_verse: Humans give life to their children. Yet only God's Spirit can change you into a child of God.
translation_verse: Dimɛdi e naa kurge dimɛdi nɛ Kiyoyu na malɛ bee bar kiyoyu na be kakurge.

english_verse: Don't be surprised when I say that you must be born from above.
translation_verse: Sa maŋ shin nɛ k baa chinchiŋ fo ŋkpal ŋ ka kaŋɛ fo fanɛ: A daga fanɛ b ka naŋ kurge menyi kela nyɔsopo so.

english_verse: Only God's Spirit gives new life. The Spirit is like the wind that blows wherever it wants to. You can hear the wind, but you don't know where it comes from or where it is going.
translation_verse: An ta fanɛ afu le. Kaplɛkama nɛ afu bee sha, ndoŋ nɛ a bee ber a yɔ. Feeŋ tiŋ n nu amo be egbri, ama fo maaŋ tiŋ m pin kakpa nɛ a shi ŋko kakpa nɛ a bee yɔ. To, loŋ gbagba malɛ nɛ k du n sa esa kama nɛ e nya kakurge ashi Kiyoyu na kutɔ.”

english_verse: Jesus replied: How can you be a teacher of Israel and not know these things?
translation_verse: Nɛ Yesu bishi mo le: “Fo baa la Israɛlebi be eŋinipo ŋkaa maa pin le be asheŋ ere to a?

english_verse: I tell you for certain we know what we are talking about because we have seen it ourselves. But none of you will accept what we say.
translation_verse: Kashenteŋ nɛ mee kaŋɛ fo na fanɛ kusɔ nɛ an nyi be asheŋ nɛ anyee malga nsaa ji kusɔ nɛ an wu na malɛ be shɛda, ama men kraa maŋ yirda shɛda nɛ anyee ji a sa menyi.

english_verse: If you don't believe when I talk to you about things on earth, how can you possibly believe if I talk to you about things in heaven?
translation_verse: Keni, durnya ere to be asheŋ nɛ m malga n sa menyi nɛ menyi maŋ yirda amo na. To, nɛ ŋ kaŋ malga ebɔrɛso be asheŋ n sa menyi, nuso nɛ menyeeŋ wora n yirda amo?

english_verse: No one has gone up to heaven except the Son of Man, who came down from there.
translation_verse: Esa kama maŋ naŋ yɔ ebɔrɛso she emo nɛ e shi ndoŋ m ba na nawule, mo e la ma, Nyiŋgbasa Pibinyɛn na.

english_verse: And the Son of Man must be lifted up, just as the metal snake was lifted up by Moses in the desert.
translation_verse: Kananɛ anebi Mosis daŋ kre danyaŋ be kabulpi nɛ k du fanɛ kuwɔ ashi kiyi to m mata kedibi nseŋ maŋ kumo so n yili na, loŋ gbagba na nɛ a daga fanɛ b maŋ Nyiŋgbasa Pibinyɛn na gba so.

english_verse: Then everyone who has faith in the Son of Man will have eternal life.
translation_verse: Saŋɛ na so ekama nɛ e yirda mo beeŋ nya ŋkpa nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na.

english_verse: God loved the people of this world so much that he gave his only Son, so that everyone who has faith in him will have eternal life and never really die.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ daŋ sha durnya ere ga so nna nɛ e ta mo Pibinyɛn koŋwule n sa durnya fanɛ nɛ esa kama nɛ e yirda mo, e maaŋ shir, ama e beeŋ nya ŋkpa nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na.

english_verse: God did not send his Son into the world to condemn its people. He sent him to save them!
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ maŋ shin nɛ mo Pibinyɛn na ba durnya to nna fanɛ e ba ji kumo demu. Ebɔrɛ shin nna nɛ e ba ki durnya be emɔlgapo.

english_verse: No one who has faith in God's Son will be condemned. But everyone who doesn't have faith in him has already been condemned for not having faith in God's only Son.
translation_verse: Esa kama malɛ nɛ e yirda mo, Ebɔrɛ maaŋ ji mo demu, ama emo nɛ e maŋ yirda mo bre, Ebɔrɛ teŋ ji mo demu, ŋkpal e ka maŋ yirda Ebɔrɛ Pibinyɛn koŋwule na so.

english_verse: The light has come into the world, and people who do evil things are judged guilty because they love the dark more than the light.
translation_verse: Ekpa nɛ demu be keji na beeŋ bɔla so nde fanɛ: Kefulto na ba durnya ere to, ama ŋkpal basa be ashuŋ shunso ka lubi so, baa sha tentembiri a chɔ kefulto na.

english_verse: People who do evil hate the light and won't come to the light, because it clearly shows what they have done.
translation_verse: Alubiworapo kikɛ maa sha kefulto. E maaŋ shuli n luri kefulto to, ŋkpal manɛ so, e maa sha mbe asheŋ lubi na ka lar efuli.

english_verse: But everyone who lives by the truth will come to the light, because they want others to know that God is really the one doing what they do. Jesus and John the Baptist
translation_verse: Ama esa kama nɛ e bee wora asheŋ a bɔla ekpa, bee luri kefulto to nna nɛ ekama e wu fanɛ kesheŋ nɛ e wora na, Ebɔrɛ nɛ e nu n sa nseŋ wora kumo.” Jɔn kabɔrɛbɛrpo ka ji Yesu be shɛda be asheŋ

english_verse: Later, Jesus and his disciples went to Judea, where he stayed with them for a while and was baptizing people.
translation_verse: Asheŋ ere be kaman nɛ Yesu nɛ mbe bebɛsopo yɔ Judiya be kasawule so nɛ mo nɛ bumo ya ji nchɛnnyɔ ndoŋ nseŋ bɛr basa kabɔrɛbɛr.

english_verse: John's followers got into an argument with a Jewish man about a ceremony of washing.
translation_verse: Kachako Juwnyɛn ko nɛ Jɔn be bebɛsopo ko nya emɔrɔ ŋkpal eyur so be kefɔr be daŋkare be kabɔrɛbɛso so.

english_verse: They went to John and said, “Rabbi, you spoke about a man when you were with him east of the Jordan. He is now baptizing people, and everyone is going to him.”
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Jɔn be bebɛsopo yɔ mo kutɔ n ya kaŋɛ mo le: “Eŋinipo, fo nyiŋi kanyɛn nɛ fo nɛ mo daa la ashi Jɔɔdan be lɔr be kaba ndoŋ na ŋko? Kanyɛn nɛ fo daŋ ji mbe shɛda na. Keni, e wɔtɔ a bɛr basa kabɔrɛbɛr nɛ basa kikɛ shile a yɔ mo kutɔ.”

english_verse: John replied: No one can do anything unless God in heaven allows it.
translation_verse: Nɛ Jɔn kaŋɛ bumo: “Nyiŋgbasa maaŋ tiŋ n nya shɛŋ mo gbagba be kumu so ama Ebɔrɛ e baŋ sa mo kumo.

english_verse: You surely remember how I told you that I am not the Messiah. I am only the one sent ahead of him.
translation_verse: Menyi alɛ gba beeŋ tiŋ n ji shɛda ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ ŋ ka daŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ: ‘Mannɛ ma e la Mesaya na, ama b shuŋi ma nna fanɛ n juŋkpar mo m ba.’

english_verse: At a wedding the groom is the one who gets married. The best man is glad just to be there and to hear the groom's voice. That's why I am so glad.
translation_verse: Kejafɔ mo kul e wɔ eche nɛ baa kre kejafɔ na. Kejafɔ mo teri na bre bee kaa yil nna nseŋ kaŋ kusoe a jo saŋɛ nɛ e beeŋ nu mo teri kejafɔ mo kul na be ebɔl nɛ mbe kagbene e fuli mo ga. Le e naa shin nɛ kagbenefuli bee bɔlɔ ma alɛ gba to.

english_verse: Jesus must become more important, while I become less important. The One Who Comes from Heaven
translation_verse: A daga fanɛ Yesu na be ketre e baa dii nɛ ma ere peya e baa yɔ kaseto.” Esa nɛ e shi ebɔrɛso na be asheŋ

english_verse: God's Son comes from heaven and is above all others. Everyone who comes from the earth belongs to the earth and speaks about earthly things. The one who comes from heaven is above all others.
translation_verse: Esa nɛ e shi ebɔrɛso na e chɔ ekama. Emo nɛ e shi kasawule so nfe la kasawule ere so be esa nna nɛ e bee malga kasawule ere so be asheŋ. Ama emo nɛ e shi ebɔrɛso na bre e chɔ ekama nyam.

english_verse: He speaks about what he has seen and heard, and yet no one believes him.
translation_verse: Kusɔ nɛ e wu nɛ kusɔ nɛ e nu be asheŋ be shɛda nɛ e bee ji, ama basa maa sha kesɔ loŋ be shɛda na.

english_verse: But everyone who does believe him has shown that God is truthful.
translation_verse: Esa kama malɛ nɛ e sɔ loŋ be shɛda na gbagba bee ji shɛda nna fanɛ Ebɔrɛ ka la kashenteŋ be Ebɔrɛ.

english_verse: The Son was sent to speak God's message, and he has been given the full power of God's Spirit.
translation_verse: Emo nɛ Ebɔrɛ shuŋi na bee malga Ebɔrɛ be mmalga nna, ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ mbe Kiyoyu na bɔlɔ mo to felɛlɛ.

english_verse: Everyone who has faith in the Son has eternal life. But no one who rejects him will ever share in that life, and God will be angry with them forever.
translation_verse: Esa kama nɛ e yirda Ebinyɛn na kɔ ŋkpa nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na, ama esa kama nɛ e kini Ebinyɛn na, maaŋ wu ŋkpa na, ama Ebɔrɛ be agbo e naaŋ baa wɔ mo so.

english_verse: This time he had to go through Samaria,
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ k ba fanɛ e bɔla Samɛria be kasawule so n choŋ.

english_verse: “You are a Jew,” she replied, “and I am a Samaritan woman. How can you ask me for a drink of water when Jews and Samaritans won't have anything to do with each other?”
translation_verse: Nɛ Samɛriache na bishi mo: “To, fo la Juw nna nɛ ma alɛ la Samɛriache, nɛ nuso nɛ fee wora a kule ma nchu nuuso?” [Kache na daŋ kaŋɛ loŋ nna, ŋkpal manɛ so, Juwebi nɛ Samɛriaebi maŋ kɔ shɛŋ bumo be nferinto.]

english_verse: “Sir,” the woman said, “you don't even have a bucket, and the well is deep. Where are you going to get this life-giving water?
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ kache na bishi mo: “To, Ebunyampo, fo maŋ kɔ shɛŋ nfe nɛ fo jɔ nchu ketirbu ere to, ketirbu ere malɛ wɔ nchiŋ nna nɛ nnɛ nɛ feeŋ nya nchu nɛ a bee sa ŋkpa na?

english_verse: Our ancestor Jacob dug this well for us, and his family and animals got water from it. Are you greater than Jacob?”
translation_verse: An nananyɛn Jeekɔb e ta ketirbu ere n sa anyi, mo alɛ nɛ mbe mbia nɛ mbe asɔbɔya kikɛ nuu kumo to be nchu, amoso, fo yɛ fo ŋini fanɛ fo chɔ mo nna ŋko nuso?”

english_verse: But no one who drinks the water I give will ever be thirsty again. The water I give will become in that person a flowing fountain that gives eternal life.”
translation_verse: ama esa kama nɛ e nuu nchu nɛ meeŋ sa mo na maaŋ naŋ shu achukoŋ kikɛ. Kashenteŋto, nchu nɛ meeŋ sa amodoŋwura na beeŋ baa wɔ mo to a bul fanɛ ketirbu na a sa mo ŋkpa nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na.”

english_verse: The woman replied, “Sir, please give me a drink of that water! Then I won't get thirsty and have to come to this well again.”
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ kache na kaŋɛ mo: “Ebunyampo, kumo ere fo sa ma loŋ be nchu na nɛ achukoŋ e sa maŋ naŋ pɛ ma kikɛ nɛ n sa maŋ naa ba m ba kaa jɔ nchu.”

english_verse: Jesus told her, “Go and bring your husband.”
translation_verse: Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ mo: “Ya tre fo kul m ba nfe.”

english_verse: The woman answered, “I don't have a husband.” “That's right,” Jesus replied, “you're telling the truth. You don't have a husband. You have already been married five times, and the man you are now living with isn't your husband.”
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, bekul anu nɛ fo kil ŋ ku so, nɛ enyɛn mo nɛ fo nɛ mo kraa wɔtɔ ere malɛ gba maŋ la fo kul. Amoso, kusɔ nɛ fo baŋ kaŋɛ ere la kashenteŋ nna.”

english_verse: The woman said, “Sir, I can see that you are a prophet.
translation_verse: Nɛ kache na kaŋɛ: “Ebunyampo, n wu fanɛ fo la anebi nna.

english_verse: My ancestors worshiped on this mountain, but you Jews say Jerusalem is the only place to worship.”
translation_verse: Kebee ere so nɛ an nanaana daa bunyaŋ Ebɔrɛ, ama menyi ere Juwebi kaŋɛ fanɛ kakpa nɛ k daga an ka bunyaŋ Ebɔrɛ e la Jerusalɛm.”

english_verse: Jesus said to her: Believe me, the time is coming when you won't worship the Father either on this mountain or in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ mo: “Kache manɛ, yirda ma kamalga ere fanɛ saŋko beeŋ ba fo nɛ basa maaŋ naa bunyaŋ Etuto na kebee ere so, bumo alɛ maaŋ naa bunyaŋ Etuto na Jerusalɛm to gba.

english_verse: You Samaritans don't really know the one you worship. But we Jews do know the God we worship, and by using us, God will save the world.
translation_verse: Esa nɛ men maŋ nyi nɛ menyi Samɛriaebi bee bunyaŋ, ama anyi ere nyi esa nɛ anyee bunyaŋ, ŋkpal manɛ so, Juwebi so nɛ Ebɔrɛ beeŋ bɔla m mɔlga basa.

english_verse: But a time is coming, and it is already here! Even now the true worshipers are being led by the Spirit to worship the Father according to the truth. These are the ones the Father is seeking to worship him.
translation_verse: Ama saŋko beeŋ ba fo, k teŋ fo gba nɛ basa e bɔla Ebɔrɛ be Kiyoyu be eleŋ so a bunyaŋ Etuto na kashenteŋto. Bumo nɛ b kɔ le be bunyaŋ ere nɛ Etuto na bee fin.

english_verse: God is Spirit, and those who worship God must be led by the Spirit to worship him according to the truth.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ la Kiyoyu nna nɛ a daga fanɛ bumo nɛ baa bunyaŋ mo e baa bɔla mbe Kiyoyu be eleŋ so a bunyaŋ mo kashenteŋto.”

english_verse: The woman said, “I know that the Messiah will come. He is the one we call Christ. When he comes, he will explain everything to us.”
translation_verse: Nɛ kache na kaŋɛ Yesu le: “Ma alɛ gba nyi fanɛ kachako Mesaya nɛ baa tre Kristo na beeŋ ba, mo alɛ kaŋ ba, e beeŋ bugi kusɔ kama to n sa anyi.”

english_verse: “I am that one,” Jesus told her, “and I am speaking to you now.”
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ: “Ma nɛ mee malga fo kutɔ ere e la mo na.”

english_verse: The disciples returned about this time and were surprised to find Jesus talking with a woman. But none of them asked him what he wanted or why he was talking with her.
translation_verse: Kumo be saŋɛ na so nɛ Yesu be bebɛsopo shi kade to m bɛta m ba nɛ e bee malga kache na kutɔ nɛ k chinchiŋ bumo ga. Ama bumo alɛ be ekama maŋ tiŋ m bishi kache na: “Manɛ nɛ fee sha?” Ŋko m bishi Yesu: “Manɛ e ba nɛ fee malga kache na kutɔ?”

english_verse: The woman left her water jar and ran back into town, where she said to the people,
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ kache na yige mbe kusɔjɔnchu ndoŋ nseŋ kilgi n yɔ kade to n ya kaŋɛ basa le:

english_verse: “Come and see a man who told me everything I have ever done! Could he be the Messiah?”
translation_verse: “Kadeebi, men ba keni kanyɛn nɛ e tiŋ ŋ kaŋɛ ma kusɔ nɛ ŋ koso n wora kikɛ, shere Kristo na nna.”

english_verse: Everyone in town went out to see Jesus.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ b lar kade na to m pɛ Yesu kutɔ be keyɔ be ekpa.

english_verse: But Jesus told them, “I have food you don't know anything about.”
translation_verse: Ama le nɛ Yesu daŋ kaŋɛ bumo: “Ŋ kɔ kejibi ko nɛ n ji nɛ men maŋ nyi kumo be asheŋ.”

english_verse: His disciples started asking each other, “Has someone brought him something to eat?”
translation_verse: Nɛ bebɛsopo na bishi abar: “Ŋko esa ko e bar mo ajibi ŋko nuso?”

english_verse: Jesus said: My food is to do what God wants! He is the one who sent me, and I must finish the work that he gave me to do.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ bumo le: “Ma ajibi e la kewora esa nɛ e shuŋi ma na be aparsheŋ nɛ keloge mbe kushuŋ.

english_verse: You may say there are still four months until harvest time. But I tell you to look, and you will see that the fields are ripe and ready to harvest.
translation_verse: Mannɛ menyi basa e naa kaa kaŋɛ fanɛ: ‘A ka afɔl ana nɛ kasɔteŋi be jemanɛ e fo’ na a? Ma e kaŋɛ menyi na fanɛ men bugi menyi be anishi ŋ keni kananɛ adɔana du. Asɔ kikɛ daŋ bel nna m pere a jo keteŋi.

english_verse: Even now the harvest workers are receiving their reward by gathering a harvest that brings eternal life. Then everyone who planted the seed and everyone who harvests the crop will celebrate together.
translation_verse: Men keni asɔteŋipo na tea nya mbe kakɔka, mo alɛ bee teŋi asɔ nna a yili ŋkpa nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na be jemanɛ, saŋɛ na so, eduupo na nɛ eteŋipo na kikɛ be ŋgbene beeŋ fuli bumo.

english_verse: So the saying proves true, “Some plant the seed, and others harvest the crop.”
translation_verse: Basa ka bee kaa malga loŋ be kesheŋ na malɛ fanɛ: ‘Esa ko e naa duu nɛ eko malɛ bee teŋi na’, la kashenteŋ nna.

english_verse: I am sending you to harvest crops in fields where others have done all the hard work.
translation_verse: N daŋ shuŋi menyi nna nɛ men ya teŋi asɔ nɛ men gbagba maŋ dɔ. Beko e dɔ nɛ menyi ere bee ji amo be tɔnɔ na.”

english_verse: A lot of Samaritans in that town put their faith in Jesus because the woman had said, “This man told me everything I have ever done.”
translation_verse: Kade na to be Samɛriaebi damta daŋ yirda Yesu nna ŋkpal kache na be shɛda nɛ e daŋ ji ŋ kaŋɛ le na so, e yɛ: “E kaŋɛ ma kusɔ nɛ n wora kikɛ.”

english_verse: They came and asked him to stay in their town, and he stayed on for two days.
translation_verse: Amoso, Samɛriaebi na ka ba mo kutɔ, nɛ b ba kule mo fanɛ e ya chena bumo kutɔ nɛ e ya ji nchɛnnyɔ ndoŋ.

english_verse: Many more Samaritans put their faith in Jesus because of what they heard him say.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ basa damta ko malɛ gba naŋ yirda mo n ti so ŋkpal mbe mmalga na so.

english_verse: They told the woman, “We no longer have faith in Jesus just because of what you told us. We have heard him ourselves, and we are certain that he is the Savior of the world!” Jesus Heals an Official's Son (Matthew
translation_verse: Nɛ bumo gbagba kaŋɛ kache na: “Naniere bre, mannɛ fo ka kaŋɛ anyi so nɛ an yirda, an gbagba nu mmalga na nseŋ pin fanɛ kashenteŋto kanyɛn ere e la durnya ere be Emɔlgapo.” Yesu ka bɛta n yɔ Galili be asheŋ

english_verse: Jesus had said, “Prophets are honored everywhere, except in their own country.” Then two days later he left
translation_verse: Mo ere Yesu gbagba e daŋ chɛr ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ: “Anebi kama maŋ kɔ bunyaŋ mo gbagba be basa to.”

english_verse: While Jesus was in Galilee, he returned to the village of Cana, where he had turned the water into wine. There was an official in Capernaum whose son was sick.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Yesu yaŋ yɔ Keena ashi Galili, kakpa nɛ e daŋ keta nchu ŋ ki yabra belbelso na. E ka yɔ nɛ abane be krachi nimuso ko pibinyɛnsobi ko dese Kapɛɛniam a lɔ.

english_verse: And when the man heard that Jesus had come from Judea, he went and begged him to keep his son from dying.
translation_verse: Kanyɛn na ka nu fanɛ Yesu shi Judiya m ba Galili nɛ e yɔ mo kutɔ n ya kule mo fanɛ e yɔ Kapɛɛniam n ya chɛ mo pibinyɛn nɛ e daa sha nɛ e wu na n sa mo.

english_verse: Jesus told the official, “You won't have faith unless you see miracles and wonders!”
translation_verse: Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ mo le: “Nɛ men be ekama baa maŋ wu mamachi be etɔɔnɛsheŋ, men maa yirda kikɛ.”

english_verse: Jesus then said, “Your son will live. Go on home to him.” The man believed Jesus and started back home.
translation_verse: Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ mo: “Baa yɔ, fo pibi na maaŋ wu.” Ndoŋ nna nɛ kanyɛn na yirda Yesu be kamalga na nseŋ choŋ.

english_verse: Some of the official's servants met him along the road and told him, “Your son is better!”
translation_verse: E kraa wɔ epe be ekpa to nna a yɔ nɛ mbe anya shɛr mo ekpa to ŋ kaŋɛ mo fanɛ mbe kebia na nya alenfia.

english_verse: He asked them when the boy got better, and they answered, “The fever left him yesterday at one o'clock.”
translation_verse: E ka bishi bumo saŋɛ mo nɛ mbe kebia na fara a nya alenfia nɛ b kaŋɛ mo: “Ndre kapaso kerfi koŋwule nɛ mbe kayurbeldɛ na yige mo.”

english_verse: The boy's father realized that at one o'clock the day before, Jesus had told him, “Your son will live!” So the man and everyone in his family put their faith in Jesus.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ etuto na nyiŋi fanɛ kumo be saŋɛ na so gbagba nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ le na: “Fo pibi na maaŋ wu.” Ndoŋ nna nɛ mo nɛ mbe kowu to ebi kikɛ yirda Yesu.

english_verse: This was the second miracle that Jesus worked after he left Judea and went to Galilee.
translation_verse: Kesheŋ ere e daa la mamachi be tɔɔnɛsheŋ nyɔsopo nɛ Yesu daŋ shi Judiya m ba Galili m ba wora.

english_verse: Later, Jesus went to Jerusalem for another Jewish festival.
translation_verse: Yesu ka wora nchɛnnyɔ nɛ e yɔ Juwebi be kabɔrɛbɛso be daŋkare ko be Kejigboŋ to ashi Jerusalɛm.

english_verse: In the city near the sheep gate was a pool with five porches, and its name in Hebrew was Bethzatha.
translation_verse: Kepa ko malɛ kɔ adɛdɛ anu a wɔ Jerusalɛm a mata kakpa nɛ baa tre Mbolpɔ be Kabuna na. Hibruwebi be ŋgbar to kepa na nɛ baa tre Betɛsda.

english_verse: Beside the pool was a man who had been sick for
translation_verse: Kanyɛn ko malɛ daŋ dese nfɛ adesa nɛ aburwa a lɔ nsaa wɔ ndoŋ.

english_verse: You have not believed his message, because you refused to have faith in the one he sent.
translation_verse: Mbe kamalga na malɛ gba maa chena menyi to, ŋkpal manɛ so, men maŋ yirda esa nɛ e shuŋi mo na.

english_verse: When Jesus saw the man and realized that he had been crippled for a long time, he asked him, “Do you want to be healed?”
translation_verse: Yesu ka wu mo nɛ e dese ndoŋ nseŋ pin e ka dese ndoŋ n chɛr nɛ e bishi mo le: “Fee sha kenya alenfia a?”

english_verse: The man answered, “Sir, I don't have anyone to put me in the pool when the water is stirred up. I try to get in, but someone else always gets there first.”
translation_verse: Nɛ elɔpo na kaŋɛ mo le: “Ebunyampo, m maŋ kɔ esa kikɛ nɛ e chɛ ma to nɛ n luri nchu ere to, saŋkama nɛ b baga amo to. Ma alɛ baŋ wora ania a sha keluri amo to nɛ esa ko teŋ daŋ ma keluri to.”

english_verse: Jesus told him, “Pick up your mat and walk!”
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ mo: “Niŋi to ŋ koso m bɔɔ fo kelaŋ to a nite.”

english_verse: Right then the man was healed. He picked up his mat and started walking around. The day on which this happened was a Sabbath.
translation_verse: Epul na to nɛ kanyɛn na nya alenfia nseŋ bɔɔ mbe kelaŋ to n fara a nite.

english_verse: When the Jewish leaders saw the man carrying his mat, they said to him, “This is the Sabbath! No one is allowed to carry a mat on the Sabbath.”
translation_verse: Amo be kamɔnchɛ malɛ daa la kewushiachɛ nna, amoso, Juwebi be benimu na ka wu kanyɛn na nɛ b kaŋɛ mo le: “Kabre la kewushiachɛ nna. Anyi be mbra na malɛ maa sa ekpa fanɛ fo di fo kelaŋ a na.”

english_verse: But he replied, “The man who healed me told me to pick up my mat and walk.”
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ e kaŋɛ bumo le: “Kanyɛn nɛ e chɛ ma na e kaŋɛ ma fanɛ: ‘Bɔɔ fo kelaŋ to a nite.’ ”

english_verse: They asked him, “Who is this man that told you to pick up your mat and walk?”
translation_verse: Nɛ b bishi mo: “Esa mo malɛ e kaŋɛ fo fanɛ fo bɔɔ fo kelaŋ to a na?”

english_verse: But he did not know who Jesus was, and Jesus had left because of the crowd.
translation_verse: Kanyɛn nɛ e daŋ nya alenfia na daa maŋ nyi amodoŋwura, ŋkpal manɛ so, jimaŋ damta ko e daa wɔ ndoŋ nɛ Yesu daŋ lar bumo to n choŋ.

english_verse: Later, Jesus met the man in the temple and told him, “You are now well. But don't sin anymore or something worse might happen to you.”
translation_verse: Saŋko ba choŋ nna pɔɛŋ nɛ Yesu ya wu mo bɔrɛlambu na to be kelɔnɛ so nseŋ kaŋɛ mo le: “Keni, fo naŋ nya alenfia nna na, yige alubi be kebaawora. Nɛ mannɛ aloŋ, kusɔ nɛ k lubi a chɔ fo kulɔ na beeŋ nya fo.”

english_verse: The man left and told the leaders that Jesus was the one who had healed him.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ kanyɛn na ya kaŋɛ Juwebi be benimuana na fanɛ Yesu e daŋ chɛ mo na.

english_verse: They started making a lot of trouble for Jesus because he did things like this on the Sabbath.
translation_verse: Amoso, Juwebi na daŋ fara nna a tɔrɔ Yesu, ŋkpal e ka daŋ wora le be asheŋ kewushiachɛ na so.

english_verse: But Jesus said, “My Father has never stopped working, and this is why I keep on working.”
translation_verse: Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ bumo: “Saŋkikɛ n Tuto bee shuŋ nna, amoso, a daga fanɛ ma alɛ gba e baa shuŋ loŋ.”

english_verse: Now the leaders wanted to kill Jesus for two reasons. First, he had broken the law of the Sabbath. But even worse, he had said God was his Father, which made him equal with God. The Son's Authority
translation_verse: Le be kamalga ere malɛ e daŋ naŋ shin nɛ Juwebi na nyaŋɛ to n ti so a sha kemɔ Yesu na, ŋkpal manɛ so, mannɛ fanɛ e daa jija kewushiachɛ na nawule nna, ama e daa tre Ebɔrɛ mo Tuto gbagba nna a ti so a ŋini fanɛ mo nɛ Ebɔrɛ ka la kukoŋwule. Ebinyɛn na be eleŋ be asheŋ

english_verse: Jesus told the people: I tell you for certain the Son cannot do anything on his own. He can do only what he sees the Father doing, and he does exactly what he sees the Father do.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ bumo le: “Kashenteŋ nɛ mee ji menyi na fanɛ ma, Ebɔrɛ Pibinyɛn na maa tiŋ a wora shɛŋ ŋ gbagba be kumu so kikɛ. Kusɔ nɛ mee wu n Tuto na ka bee wora nawule nɛ ma alɛ gba bee wora. Kusɔ nɛ Etuto na bee wora, kumo nɛ ma, Ebinyɛn na gba bee wora.

english_verse: The Father loves the Son and has shown him everything he does. The Father will show him even greater things, and you will be amazed.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, Etuto na bee sha ma, Ebinyɛn na ga. Amoso, kusɔ kama nɛ e bee wora, e bee ŋini ma kumo nna. Mo alɛ kraa beeŋ ŋini ma asɔ nɛ a chɔ ade ere nɛ men be nnɔ e mɔ menyi.

english_verse: Just as the Father raises the dead and gives life, so the Son gives life to anyone he wants to.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, kananɛ Etuto na bee tiŋi basa luwu to a sa bumo ŋkpa na, loŋ gbagba nna nɛ ma, Ebinyɛn na bee sa basa nɛ mee sha ŋkpa.

english_verse: The Father doesn't judge anyone, but he has made his Son the judge of everyone.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman, Etuto na maa ji esa kama demu, e ta demu be keji kikɛ nna m bɔɔ ma, Ebinyɛn na enɔ,

english_verse: The Father wants all people to honor the Son as much as they honor him. When anyone refuses to honor the Son, this is the same as refusing to honor the Father who sent him.
translation_verse: saŋɛ na so, ekama beeŋ bunyaŋ ma, Ebinyɛn na fanɛ kananɛ baa bunyaŋ Etuto na. Ekama malɛ nɛ e maa bunyaŋ ma, Ebinyɛn na maa bunyaŋ Etuto nɛ e shuŋi ma na gba nna na.

english_verse: I tell you for certain that everyone who hears my message and has faith in the one who sent me has eternal life and will never be condemned. They have already gone from death to life.
translation_verse: Ma e kaŋɛ menyi kashenteŋto na fanɛ esa kama nɛ e nu ma mmalga ere nseŋ yirda esa nɛ e shuŋi ma na kɔ ŋkpa nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na, mo alɛ maaŋ ji n tɔr, ama e teŋ lar luwu to m ba luri ŋkpa to.

english_verse: I tell you for certain the time will come, and it is already here, when all of the dead will hear the voice of the Son of God. And those who listen to it will live!
translation_verse: Ma e kaŋɛ menyi kashenteŋto na fanɛ saŋko beeŋ ba fo, saŋɛ na teŋ fo gba fanɛ bubuni beeŋ nu ma, Ebɔrɛ Pibinyɛn na be ebɔl, ekama malɛ nɛ e nu kumo beeŋ nya ŋkpa a wɔtɔ.

english_verse: The Father has the power to give life, and he has given that same power to the Son.
translation_verse: Kananɛ ŋkpa shi Etuto na to na, loŋ gbagba na nɛ e shin nɛ ŋkpa bee shi Ebinyɛn na gba to.

english_verse: And he has given his Son the right to judge everyone, because he is the Son of Man.
translation_verse: Mo alɛ sa Ebinyɛn na ekpa nna nɛ e ji basa demu ŋkpal ebi na ka la Nyiŋgbasa Pibinyɛn na so.

english_verse: Don't be surprised! The time will come when all of the dead will hear the voice of the Son of Man,
translation_verse: Men sa maŋ shin nɛ kesheŋ ere e baa chinchiŋ menyi, ŋkpal manɛ so, saŋko beeŋ ba fo nɛ basa nɛ b wɔ bumo be nchaŋana to na kikɛ e nu Ebinyɛn na be ebɔl

english_verse: and they will come out of their graves. Everyone who has done good things will rise to life, but everyone who has done evil things will rise and be condemned.
translation_verse: nseŋ lar bumo be nchaŋana na to nɛ bumo nɛ b wora alelasheŋ na e tiŋi a wɔ ŋkpa to nɛ bumo nɛ b wora alubisheŋ na malɛ e tiŋi n luri kasogberge to.

english_verse: I cannot do anything on my own. The Father sent me, and he is the one who told me how to judge. I judge with fairness, because I obey him, and I don't just try to please myself. Witnesses to Jesus
translation_verse: Ma alɛ gbagba maaŋ tiŋ n wora shɛŋ ma kumu so. Kusɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ bee kaŋɛ ma be demu nɛ mee ji, amoso, ma demu be keji kɔ kashenteŋ nna, ŋkpal manɛ so, mannɛ ŋ gbagba be aparsheŋ nɛ mee wora, esa nɛ e shuŋi ma na be aparsheŋ nɛ mee wora.

english_verse: If I speak for myself, there is no way to prove I am telling the truth.
translation_verse: Nɛ m baŋ ji ŋ gbagba be kumu so be shɛda, kumo ere ma shɛda na maŋ la shɛda kpakpaso.

english_verse: But there is someone else who speaks for me, and I know what he says is true.
translation_verse: Ama esa pɔtɛ ko wɔtɔ a ji ma shɛda a sa basa nɛ ma alɛ nyi amodoŋwura be loŋ be shɛda na ka bɔla ekpa.

english_verse: You sent messengers to John, and he told them the truth.
translation_verse: Men gbagba e shuŋi mbɔ Jɔn kutɔ, mo alɛ ji kashenteŋ na be shɛda n sa menyi.

english_verse: I don't depend on what people say about me, but I tell you these things so that you may be saved.
translation_verse: Mannɛ fanɛ dimɛdi be shɛda nɛ mee sha, ama m malga kesheŋ ere nna nɛ men tiŋ n nya kumɔlga.

english_verse: John was a lamp that gave a lot of light, and you were glad to enjoy his light for a while.
translation_verse: Jɔn daa du fanɛ fitila nɛ k chɔɔ so nna a sa basa kefulto nɛ men daŋ shuli n wu kefulto na be ebel gbrɛbi.

english_verse: But something more important than John speaks for me. I mean the things that the Father has given me to do! All of these speak for me and prove that the Father sent me.
translation_verse: Ama ŋ kɔ shɛda kpakpaso a chɔ Jɔn be shɛda na. Ŋkpal manɛ so, ashuŋ nɛ mee shuŋ ere, amo nɛ Etuto na sa fanɛ n shuŋ na e naa ji ma shɛda a ŋini fanɛ Etuto na e shuŋi ma.

english_verse: The Father who sent me also speaks for me, but you have never heard his voice or seen him face to face.
translation_verse: Etuto nɛ e shuŋi ma na malɛ gba bee ji ma shɛda nna a sa basa. Menyi maŋ naŋ nu mbe ebɔl ŋko n wu mbe anishito.

english_verse: but you refuse to come to me for eternal life.
translation_verse: Ama menyi alɛ maa sha keba ŋ kutɔ m ba nya ŋkpa na.

english_verse: I don't care about human praise,
translation_verse: M maa fin kechɔrɔ ashi basa kutɔ.

english_verse: but I do know that none of you love God.
translation_verse: Ama n nyi menyi, men maŋ kɔ kasha a sha Ebɔrɛ menyi be ŋgbeneana to.

english_verse: I have come with my Father's authority, and you have not welcomed me. But you will welcome people who come on their own.
translation_verse: N Tuto be ketre nɛ n ta m ba nɛ men kini ma na, ama nɛ esa pɔtɛ ko baŋ ta mo gbagba be eleŋ m ba, menyeeŋ sɔ amodoŋwura na.

english_verse: How could you possibly believe? You like to have your friends praise you, and you don't care about praise that the only God can give!
translation_verse: Menyee sha kebaanya mbo abar kutɔ, ama men maa wora ania a fin mbo ashi Ebɔrɛ koŋwule na kutɔ nɛ nuso nɛ menyeeŋ wora n yirda?

english_verse: Don't think that I will be the one to accuse you to the Father. You have put your hope in Moses, yet he is the very one who will accuse you.
translation_verse: Ama men sa maa fɛ bre fanɛ ma e naaŋ yili Ebɔrɛ be anishito ŋ ŋini mo menyi be alubi. Ayai, esa nɛ e beeŋ shin nɛ menyi be alubi e dii efuli e la anebi Mosis nɛ men ta menyi be tama kikɛ n deŋi so na.

english_verse: Moses wrote about me, and if you had believed Moses, you would have believed me.
translation_verse: Nɛ men daŋ yirda Mosis be mmalga kenishipereso nna, men daa beeŋ yirda ma, ŋkpal manɛ so, ma asheŋ nɛ e daŋ sibɛ n sa menyi na.

english_verse: But if you don't believe what Moses wrote, how can you believe what I say?
translation_verse: Ama men ka maŋ yirda kusɔ nɛ e sibɛ na bre, nuso nɛ menyeeŋ wora n yirda asheŋ nɛ mee malga?”

english_verse: The disciples gathered them up and filled twelve large baskets with what was left over from the five barley loaves.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ b tise n tise ayunyifu be bodobodo nɛ basa na daŋ we ŋ ka na m bɔlɔ nlantaŋɛ kuduanyɔ.

english_verse: The disciples wanted to take him into the boat, but suddenly the boat reached the shore where they were headed. The Bread That Gives Life
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ b daa sha keta mo ekuloŋ na to, epul na malɛ to nɛ ekuloŋ na teŋ fo kedeŋiso. Basa na ka fin Yesu be asheŋ

english_verse: They replied, “What miracle will you work, so that we can have faith in you? What will you do?
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ b bishi mo: “To, nɛ nuso be mamachi be kesheŋ nɛ feeŋ wora n sa anyi nɛ an wu nseŋ yirda fo? Manɛ nɛ feeŋ wora?

english_verse: No one can come to me, unless the Father who sent me makes them want to come. But if they do come, I will raise them to life on the last day.
translation_verse: Esa kama maaŋ tiŋ m ba ma kutɔ ama Etuto nɛ e shuŋi ma na baŋ bar mo ŋ kutɔ nna, ma alɛ beeŋ tiŋi amodoŋwura ashi luwu to lalaloge be kachɛ na.

english_verse: “There is a boy here who has five small loaves of barley bread and two fish. But what good is that with all these people?”
translation_verse: “Kebia ko wɔ nfe a kɔ ayunyifu be ebodobodo anu nɛ ekɔrɔtɔ anyɔ, ama manɛ nɛ a beeŋ tiŋ n wora n sa basa damta ere?”

english_verse: They got into a boat and started across for Capernaum. Later that evening Jesus had still not come to them,
translation_verse: n ya luri ekuloŋ ko to n dii kepagboŋ na a yɔ Kapɛɛniam, kepagboŋ na be kaba ndoŋ. B ta loŋ hale nɛ kaboŋ ya kaa pɛ anishi nɛ Yesu maŋ naŋ ba bumo kutɔ.

english_verse: A large crowd had seen him work miracles to heal the sick, and those people went with him.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ jimaŋ damta ko muu m bɛ mo so ŋkpal kechɛ basa be alɔ be emamachisheŋ damta nɛ b daŋ wu e ka daa wora na so so.

english_verse: It was almost time for the Jewish festival of Passover, and Jesus went up on a mountain with his disciples and sat down.
translation_verse: Kumo be kamɔnchɛ nɛ Juwebi be Kebansonchoŋ be daŋkare be kejigboŋ bee taga to.

english_verse: Philip answered, “Don't you know that it would take almost a year's wages just to buy only a little bread for each of these people?”
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Filip kaŋɛ mo le: “Cha, pɔŋ alfa anyɔ gba be bodobodo maaŋ fo basa ere kikɛ nɛnɛ.”

english_verse: Andrew, the brother of Simon Peter, was one of the disciples. He spoke up and said,
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ mbe bebɛsopo na be emo nɛ baa tre Andru, Saimɔn Pita mo sipo na kaŋɛ:

english_verse: Jesus took the bread in his hands and gave thanks to God. Then he passed the bread to the people, and he did the same with the fish, until everyone had plenty to eat.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Yesu ta ebodobodo na nseŋ di Ebɔrɛ epaŋ nseŋ fara a sa basa nɛ b daŋ chena ndoŋ na. Loŋ koŋwule na nɛ e daŋ ta kɔrɔtɔ na gba n wora. Kanaŋkamaso nɛ ekama daa beeŋ tiŋ n we nɛ e we m moɛ.

english_verse: The people ate all they wanted, and Jesus told his disciples to gather up the leftovers, so that nothing would be wasted.
translation_verse: Basa na kikɛ ka baŋ we m moɛ nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ mbe bebɛsopo na: “Men tise n tise ejiŋka na nsaa maŋ shin nɛ shɛŋ shɛŋ e to jiga.”

english_verse: Jesus realized that they would try to force him to be their king. So he went up on a mountain, where he could be alone. Jesus Walks on the Water (Matthew
translation_verse: Yesu ka pin fanɛ b daa sha kebaata mo katinso nna m buu mo kuwura nɛ e bɔl bumo to n naŋ lar mo nawule n yɔ kebeebi ko so. Yesu ka nite nchu so be asheŋ (Matiu

english_verse: The people who had stayed on the east side of the lake knew that only one boat had been there. They also knew that Jesus had not left in it with his disciples. But the next day
translation_verse: Kumo be ŋklade nɛ jimaŋ nɛ b daŋ shir a wɔ kepagboŋ na be kaba ndoŋ na wu fanɛ ekuloŋ koŋwule e ka ndoŋ nseŋ naŋ pin fanɛ mannɛ Yesu nɛ mbe bebɛsopo e yɔ, bumo nawule e daŋ yɔ.

english_verse: Don't work for food that spoils. Work for food that gives eternal life. The Son of Man will give you this food, because God the Father has given him the right to do so.”
translation_verse: Men sa maa kɔ a fin ajibi nɛ a bee jija ere, men baa kɔ a fin ajibi nɛ a bee sa ŋkpa nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na. Ma, Nyiŋgbasa Pibinyɛn e naa sa loŋ be ajibi na, ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ Etuto na e ŋini fanɛ mbe kenyi wɔ ma so.”

english_verse: One of the prophets wrote, “God will teach all of them.” And so everyone who listens to the Father and learns from him will come to me.
translation_verse: Anebiana na be nsibɛ na to bee kaŋɛ fanɛ: ‘Ebɔrɛ beeŋ ŋini basa kikɛ asheŋ.’ Ekama nɛ e bee nu kusɔ nɛ Etuto na bee kaŋɛ nseŋ naa koya asheŋ ashi mo kutɔ bee ba ŋ kutɔ nna.

english_verse: They started arguing with each other and asked, “How can he give us his flesh to eat?”
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Juwebi na fara a bile asheŋ agboso a kaŋɛ: “Nuso nɛ le be esa bee wora a sa anyi mbe eyur nɛ an we?”

english_verse: That evening, Jesus' disciples went down to the lake.
translation_verse: Kaase ka fo nɛ mbe bebɛsopo na malɛ yɔ kepagboŋ na ase

english_verse: and a strong wind was making the water rough.
translation_verse: B wɔ nchu na so nna nɛ afugboŋ ko fara a ber a baga nchu na to.

english_verse: When the disciples had rowed for five or six kilometers, they saw Jesus walking on the water. He kept coming closer to the boat, and they were terrified.
translation_verse: B ka far ekuloŋ na loŋ fanɛ emayɛl asa ŋko ana n yɔ anishito nɛ b wu Yesu nɛ e na nchu na so a ba ekuloŋ na akpa nɛ kufu pɛ bumo ga.

english_verse: But he said, “I am Jesus! Don't be afraid!”
translation_verse: Nɛ e kaŋɛ bumo le: “Ma nna, men sa maa lɔ kufu.”

english_verse: some boats from Tiberias sailed near the place where the crowd had eaten the bread for which the Lord had given thanks.
translation_verse: Taibɛrias be ekuloŋ ko malɛ daŋ ba kaa yil kepagboŋ na be ekarso a mata kakpa nɛ Yesu daŋ di Ebɔrɛ epaŋ nseŋ sa basa na ajibi na.

english_verse: They saw that Jesus and his disciples had left. Then they got into the boats and went to Capernaum to look for Jesus.
translation_verse: Amoso, jimaŋ na ka maŋ wu Yesu ŋko mbe bebɛsopo ndoŋ na nɛ b luri ekuloŋana na to a yɔ Kapɛɛniam nɛ b ya fin Yesu. Yesu ka la ŋkpa be bodobodo be asheŋ

english_verse: They found him on the west side of the lake and asked, “Rabbi, when did you get here?”
translation_verse: B ka ya wu mo kepagboŋ na be kaba ere so ndoŋ nɛ b bishi mo: “Eŋinipo, saŋɛ mo nɛ fo fo nfe?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “I tell you for certain that you are not looking for me because you saw the miracles, but because you ate all the food you wanted.
translation_verse: Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ bumo le: “Ma e kaŋɛ menyi kashenteŋto na fanɛ, mannɛ emamachisheŋ nɛ men wu na so nɛ menyee fin ma, ama men ka we ebodobodo na ŋ kukwe kananɛ menyee sha na so e shin nɛ menyee fin ma na.

english_verse: “What exactly does God want us to do?” the people asked.
translation_verse: Nɛ b bishi mo: “To, nɛ manɛ nɛ anyeeŋ wora n tiŋ n shuŋ Ebɔrɛ be ashuŋ?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “God wants you to have faith in the one he sent.”
translation_verse: Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ bumo le: “Ebɔrɛ be kushuŋ e la keyirda esa nɛ e shuŋi na.”

english_verse: For example, when our ancestors were in the desert, they were given manna to eat. It happened just as the Scriptures say, ‘God gave them bread from heaven to eat.’ ”
translation_verse: An nanaana daŋ ji ajibi nɛ baa tre manna na nna ashi kiyi to, loŋ malɛ nɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ fanɛ: ‘Ebɔrɛ daŋ shin nɛ bodobodo shi ebɔrɛso nna m ba sa bumo nɛ b we.’ ”

english_verse: Jesus then told them, “I tell you for certain that Moses wasn't the one who gave you bread from heaven. My Father is the one who gives you the true bread from heaven.
translation_verse: Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ bumo: “Men keni, kashenteŋ nɛ mee kaŋɛ menyi na fanɛ mannɛ Mosis e daŋ sa menyi ebɔrɛso be bodobodo na. N Tuto e naa sa menyi kashenteŋ be bodobodo nɛ k bee shi ebɔrɛso na.

english_verse: And the bread that God gives is the one who came down from heaven to give life to the world.”
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ be bodobodo na e la bodobodo nɛ k shi ebɔrɛso m ba kaa sa durnya ŋkpa na.”

english_verse: The people said, “Sir, give us this bread and don't ever stop!”
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ b kaŋɛ Yesu le: “Ebunyampo, kumo ere, yili kabre a yɔ, baa sa anyi loŋ be bodobodo na.”

english_verse: Jesus replied: I am the bread that gives life! No one who comes to me will ever be hungry. No one who has faith in me will ever be thirsty.
translation_verse: Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ bumo: “Ma e la loŋ be bodobodo nɛ k bee sa ŋkpa na. Ekama nɛ e ba ŋ kutɔ, akoŋ maaŋ pɛ mo kikɛ nɛ ekama nɛ e yirda ma, achukoŋ malɛ maaŋ pɛ mo.

english_verse: I have told you already that you have seen me and still do not have faith in me.
translation_verse: Ama n teŋ kaŋɛ menyi kumo fanɛ men wu ma, ama menyi alɛ kraa maŋ yirda.

english_verse: Everything and everyone that the Father has given me will come to me, and I won't turn any of them away.
translation_verse: Esa kama nɛ n Tuto na ta m bɔɔ ma enɔ beeŋ ba ŋ kutɔ nɛ ekama malɛ nɛ e ba ŋ kutɔ, m maaŋ ju mo n lɛ kikɛ.

english_verse: I didn't come from heaven to do what I want! I came to do what the Father wants me to do. He sent me,
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, n shi ebɔrɛso nna m ba nɛ m ba wora esa nɛ e shuŋi ma na be aparsheŋ, mannɛ ŋ gbagba be aparsheŋ so e shin nɛ m ba.

english_verse: and he wants to make certain that none of the ones he has given me will be lost. Instead, he wants me to raise them to life on the last day.
translation_verse: Esa nɛ e shuŋi ma na malɛ be aparsheŋ nde fanɛ n sa maŋ kaŋ paŋ basa nɛ e ta m bɔɔ ma enɔ na kikɛ be ekama, ama e yili kumo nna fanɛ n tiŋi bumo ashi luwu to lalaloge be kachɛ na.

english_verse: My Father wants everyone who sees the Son to have faith in him and to have eternal life. Then I will raise them to life on the last day.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, n Tuto be aparsheŋ e la fanɛ esa kama nɛ e wu ma, Nyiŋgbasa Pibinyɛn na nseŋ yirda, amodoŋwura beeŋ nya ŋkpa nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na nɛ n tiŋi mo ashi luwu to lalaloge be kachɛ na.”

english_verse: The people started grumbling because Jesus had said he was the bread that had come down from heaven.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Juwebi na fara a malga a gbiti mo ŋkpal e ka kaŋɛ fanɛ: “Ma e la bodobodo nɛ k shi ebɔrɛso m ba na” so.

english_verse: They were asking each other, “Isn't he Jesus, the son of Joseph? Don't we know his father and mother? How can he say that he has come down from heaven?”
translation_verse: B yɛ: “Mannɛ mo e la Yesu, Josɛf pibi na a? To, an nyi mo tuto nɛ mo nio nɛ a ji nuso nna nɛ e bee kaŋɛ mbe kumu fanɛ: ‘Ebɔrɛso nɛ n shi m ba?’ ”

english_verse: The only one who has seen the Father is the one who has come from him. No one else has ever seen the Father.
translation_verse: Ama mannɛ fanɛ esa daŋ wu Etuto na kenishiso nna. Emo nɛ e shi Ebɔrɛ na kutɔ na nawule e wu Etuto na.

english_verse: I tell you for certain that everyone who has faith in me has eternal life.
translation_verse: Ma e kaŋɛ menyi kashenteŋto na fanɛ ekama nɛ e yirda ma kɔ ŋkpa nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na.

english_verse: I am the bread that gives life!
translation_verse: Ma e la bodobodo nɛ k bee sa ŋkpa na.

english_verse: Your ancestors ate manna in the desert, and later they died.
translation_verse: Men nananyɛnana daŋ we manna kiyi to ŋkeshin nɛ bumo alɛ daŋ wu.

english_verse: But the bread from heaven has come down, so that no one who eats it will ever die.
translation_verse: Ama bodobodo nɛ k shi ebɔrɛso m ba nɛ esa e we a maaŋ wu na nde.

english_verse: I am that bread from heaven! Everyone who eats it will live forever. My flesh is the life-giving bread I give to the people of this world.
translation_verse: Ma e la bodobodo nɛ k bee sa ŋkpa n shi ebɔrɛso na. Esa kama nɛ e we le be bodobodo ere beeŋ baa wɔtɔ mbaanaayɔ. Bodobodo mo nɛ meeŋ ta n sa basa na e la ma eyur ere nɛ ŋ kɔ a sa durnya nɛ k nya ŋkpa na.”

english_verse: Jesus answered: I tell you for certain that you won't live unless you eat the flesh and drink the blood of the Son of Man.
translation_verse: Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ bumo: “Ma e kaŋɛ menyi kashenteŋto na fanɛ nɛ men baa maŋ we Nyiŋgbasa Pibinyɛn na be eyur na nseŋ nuu mbe ŋklaŋ na, men maaŋ nya ŋkpa.

english_verse: But if you do eat my flesh and drink my blood, you will have eternal life, and I will raise you to life on the last day.
translation_verse: Esa kama nɛ e bee we ma eyur na nsaa nuu ma ŋklaŋ na kɔ ŋkpa nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na. Ma alɛ beeŋ tiŋi mo ashi luwu to lalaloge be kachɛ na,

english_verse: My flesh is the true food, and my blood is the true drink.
translation_verse: ŋkpal manɛ so, ma eyur ere la ajibi gbagba nna nɛ ma ŋklaŋ malɛ la asɔnuuso gbagba.

english_verse: If you eat my flesh and drink my blood, you are one with me, and I am one with you.
translation_verse: Esa kama malɛ nɛ e we ma eyur ere nseŋ nuu ma ŋklaŋ wɔ ma to nna nɛ ma alɛ gba wɔ mo to.

english_verse: The living Father sent me, and I have life because of him. Now everyone who eats my flesh will live because of me.
translation_verse: Kananɛ Etuto nɛ e bee sa ŋkpa na baŋ shuŋi ma nɛ n wɔ ŋkpa to ŋkpal Etuto na so na, loŋ koŋwule na nɛ esa kama nɛ e we ma eyur na malɛ gba beeŋ baa wɔ ŋkpa to ŋkpal ma so.

english_verse: The bread that comes down from heaven isn't like what your ancestors ate. They died, but whoever eats this bread will live forever.
translation_verse: Bodobodo nɛ k shi ebɔrɛso m ba na nde. An nananyɛnana daŋ we manna nna, ama b wu. Ama esa kama nɛ e we le be bodobodo beeŋ baa wɔ ŋkpa to hale mbaanaayɔ.”

english_verse: Jesus was teaching in a synagogue in Capernaum when he said these things. The Words of Eternal Life
translation_verse: Yesu daa wɔ Kapɛɛniam be nshɛrbu to nna a ŋini basa abɔrɛsheŋ nseŋ malga kesheŋ ere. Bebɛsopo damta ka shile Yesu be asheŋ

english_verse: Many of Jesus' disciples heard him and said, “This is too hard for anyone to understand.”
translation_verse: Mbe bebɛsopo damta ko ka nu kesheŋ nɛ e malga na nɛ b kaŋɛ abar le: “Cha, keŋini ere bre la kesheŋ kpakpaso nna, wanɛ e naaŋ tiŋ n sɔ kumo?”

english_verse: What if you should see the Son of Man go up to heaven where he came from?
translation_verse: To, nɛ men daŋ wu ma, Nyiŋgbasa Pibinyɛn ka bɛta a yɔ ebɔrɛso, kakpa nɛ n daa wɔ na ai?

english_verse: The Spirit is the one who gives life! Human strength can do nothing. The words that I have spoken to you are from that life-giving Spirit.
translation_verse: Kiyoyu na bee sa ŋkpa nna, ama eyur ere bre maaŋ tiŋ n wora shɛŋ. Mmalga nɛ m malga n sa menyi ere e naa shin nɛ menyee nya Kiyoyu nɛ e bee sa ŋkpa na.

english_verse: But some of you refuse to have faith in me.” Jesus said this, because from the beginning he knew who would have faith in him. He also knew which one would betray him.
translation_verse: Ama menyi to be beko maŋ yirda.” Yesu daŋ kaŋɛ loŋ nna, ŋkpal manɛ so, sososo na kikɛ e daa nyi bumo nɛ b maŋ yirda nɛ emo nɛ e beeŋ debɔr mo.

english_verse: Then Jesus said, “You cannot come to me, unless the Father makes you want to come. That is why I have told these things to all of you.”
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ e naŋ kaŋɛ le: “Amoso nɛ n daŋ kaŋɛ menyi fanɛ esa kama maaŋ tiŋ m ba ŋ kutɔ ama Etuto na e naaŋ shin nɛ amodoŋwura na e ba na.”

english_verse: Jesus then asked his twelve disciples if they also were going to leave him.
translation_verse: Nɛ Yesu kilgi m bishi bebɛsopo kuduanyɔ na le: “Menyi alɛ gba bee sha keyɔ nna ŋko?”

english_verse: Simon Peter answered, “Lord, there is no one else that we can go to! Your words give eternal life.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Saimɔn Pita kaŋɛ mo: “Enyɛnpe, fo e kɔ ŋkpa nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na be mmalga.

english_verse: We have faith in you, and we are sure that you are God's Holy One.”
translation_verse: To, nɛ wanɛ malɛ kutɔ nɛ anyeeŋ naŋ yɔ? Anyi ere yirda nsaa nyi fanɛ fo e la Ebɔrɛ be Esa cheembi na.”

english_verse: Jesus told his disciples, “I chose all twelve of you, but one of you is a demon!”
translation_verse: Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ: “Kashenteŋto, ma e lara menyi basa kuduanyɔ ere, ama menyi to be eko la alubipo nna.”

english_verse: Jesus was talking about Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot. He would later betray Jesus, even though he was one of the twelve disciples.
translation_verse: Judas, Saimɔn Iskareɔt pibi nɛ e daa de na, ŋkpal manɛ so, bebɛsopo kuduanyɔ na to be eko e daa la mo, ama mo e daa shin nɛ e ba debɔr Yesu kacha ko.

english_verse: Jesus decided to leave Judea and to start going through Galilee because the leaders of the people wanted to kill him.
translation_verse: Ade be kaman nɛ Yesu shir a wɔ Galili be efuli so be nde nawule to a nite a maa sha kenite Judiya bre to, ŋkpal manɛ so, ndoŋ be Juwebi be benimuana na daa fin mo nna nɛ b mɔ.

english_verse: and Jesus' brothers said to him, “Why don't you go to Judea? Then your disciples can see what you are doing.
translation_verse: nɛ Yesu mo siponyɛnsoana kaŋɛ mo le: “A daŋ daga fo ka lar nfe nna n yɔ Judiya nɛ fo bebɛsopo e ya wu fo asheŋ woraso.

english_verse: No one does anything in secret, if they want others to know about them. So let the world know what you are doing!”
translation_verse: B yɛ: ‘Esa kama nɛ e bee sha nɛ basa e baa nyi mbe asheŋ maa ŋana a wora asheŋ.’ Amoso, fo ka baa wora asheŋ ere, shin nɛ durnya e wu fo.”

english_verse: Even Jesus' own brothers had not yet become his followers.
translation_verse: Kede e naa ŋini fanɛ hale mo siponyɛnsoana gba daa maŋ yirda mo.

english_verse: Jesus answered, “My time hasn't yet come, but your time is always here.
translation_verse: Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ bumo le: “Ma saŋɛ maŋ naŋ fo, ama menyi ere, saŋɛ kikɛ walɛ nna n sa menyi.

english_verse: The people of this world cannot hate you. They hate me, because I tell them that they do evil things.
translation_verse: Durnya maaŋ tiŋ ŋ kishi menyi ere, ama ma ere, k kishi ma nna ŋkpal ŋ ka bee kaŋɛ fanɛ kumo be asheŋ woraso maŋ walɛ so.

english_verse: Go on to the festival. My time hasn't yet come, and I am not going.”
translation_verse: Men baa yɔ Kejigboŋ be nshɛr na to. Ma ere maa yɔ, ŋkpal manɛ so, ma saŋɛ maŋ naŋ fo.”

english_verse: Jesus said this and stayed on in Galilee. Jesus at the Festival of Shelters
translation_verse: E ka kaŋɛ loŋ n loge nɛ e shir a wɔ Galili. Yesu ka yɔ Abuu to be Kebaawɔ be daŋkare be kejigboŋ to be asheŋ

english_verse: After Jesus' brothers had gone to the festival, he went secretly, without telling anyone.
translation_verse: Ama mo siponyɛnsoana na ka choŋ Kejigboŋ na to n loge nɛ Yesu malɛ gba yɔ, ama wulo to nɛ e daŋ ŋana n yɔ.

english_verse: During the festival the leaders of the people looked for Jesus and asked, “Where is he?”
translation_verse: Ama saŋɛ na so nɛ Juwebi na malɛ wɔ Kejigboŋ na to a fin mo a bishi le: “To, nnɛ nɛ kanyɛn na wɔ?”

english_verse: The crowds even got into an argument about him. Some were saying, “Jesus is a good man,” while others were saying, “He is lying to everyone.”
translation_verse: Jimaŋ na to be bedamta daŋ baa wɔtɔ nna a kuli a malga mbe asheŋ. Beko yɛ: “Esa lela nna.” Nɛ beko malɛ kaŋɛ: “Ayai, e bee fule basa nna.”

english_verse: But the people were afraid of their leaders, and none of them talked in public about him.
translation_verse: Ama ekama daa maŋ nya kagbene m bugi to m malga mbe asheŋ, ŋkpal manɛ so, b daa ŋana Juwebi be benimuana na nna.

english_verse: When the festival was about half over, Jesus went into the temple and started teaching.
translation_verse: Kejigboŋ na to be asheŋ woraso na daŋ kraa wɔ nferinto nna a yɔ nɛ Yesu koso n yɔ bɔrɛlambu na to n ya fara a ŋini basa abɔrɛsheŋ.

english_verse: The leaders were surprised and said, “How does this man know so much? He has never been taught!”
translation_verse: Mbe keŋini na daŋ chinchiŋ Juwebi na ga nɛ b bishi abar: “Nnɛ nɛ kanyɛn ere nya le be keŋini ere, ŋkpal manɛ so, e maŋ koya ko?”

english_verse: Jesus replied: I am not teaching something I thought up. What I teach comes from the one who sent me.
translation_verse: Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ bumo: “Ma keŋini maŋ la meya nna. K shi esa nɛ e shuŋi ma na kutɔ nna.

english_verse: If you really want to obey God, you will know if what I teach comes from God or from me.
translation_verse: Esa kama nɛ e bee sha kewora Ebɔrɛ be aparsheŋ beeŋ pin fanɛ asɔ nɛ mee ŋini ere shi Ebɔrɛ kutɔ nna ŋko ŋ gbagba be eleŋ nɛ ŋ kɔ a ŋini amo.

english_verse: If I wanted to bring honor to myself, I would speak for myself. But I want to honor the one who sent me. This is why I tell the truth and not a lie.
translation_verse: Esa kama nɛ e kɔ mo gbagba be eleŋ a malga asheŋ, bee fin mo gbagba be kemaŋkura nna na. Ama esa kama nɛ e bee fin kemaŋkura a sa esa nɛ e shuŋi mo la kashenteŋwura nna nɛ efɛsheŋ kikɛ maŋ wɔ mo so.

english_verse: Didn't Moses give you the Law? Yet none of you obey it! So why do you want to kill me?
translation_verse: Mannɛ anebi Mosis e daŋ sa menyi mbra na ŋko? Ama men be ekama maa bɛ mbra na so. Nɛ manɛ e ba nɛ menyee sha kemɔ ma?”

english_verse: The crowd replied, “You're crazy! What makes you think someone wants to kill you?”
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ jimaŋ na kaŋɛ mo le: “Fo kɔ kiyoyu lubi fo to. Wanɛ e naa sha kemɔ fo?”

english_verse: Jesus answered: I worked one miracle, and it amazed you.
translation_verse: Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ bumo: “Men keni, n wora mamachi be kesheŋ koŋwule nɛ k chinchiŋ menyi ga.

english_verse: Moses commanded you to circumcise your sons. But it wasn't really Moses who gave you this command. It was your ancestors, and even on the Sabbath you circumcise your sons
translation_verse: Ama ŋkpal Mosis ka sa menyi mbra fanɛ men baa ku atutu so, menyee ku menyi be mbiana nna kewushiachɛ. Ama kashenteŋto, mannɛ Mosis e daŋ sa menyi mbra na, men nananyɛnana e nase kumo.

english_verse: in order to obey the Law of Moses. Why are you angry with me for making someone completely well on the Sabbath?
translation_verse: To, nɛ menyee tiŋ a ku menyi be mbia atutu kewushiachɛ na, saŋɛ na so men maaŋ tɔr Mosis be mbra na, manɛ e ba nɛ menyee nya agbo a wora ma ŋkpal ŋ ka chɛ esa lelemu na kewushiachɛ so?

english_verse: Some of the people from Jerusalem were saying, “Isn't this the man they want to kill?
translation_verse: Saŋɛ ere so nɛ Jerusalɛm to be basa ko fara a bishi abar le: “Mannɛ kanyɛn ere nɛ baa fin nɛ b mɔ na a?

english_verse: Yet here he is, speaking for everyone to hear. And no one is arguing with him. Do you suppose the authorities know he is the Messiah?
translation_verse: To, mo e yil a malga basa kikɛ to na nɛ esa kama malɛ maa tuge shɛŋ. Ŋko Juwebi be benimuana na wu kumo naniere nna fanɛ mo e la Kristo na a?

english_verse: But how could that be? No one knows where the Messiah will come from, but we know where this man comes from.”
translation_verse: Kusɔ koŋwule nde fanɛ nɛ Mesaya na kaŋ ba, esa kama maaŋ pin kakpa nɛ e shi m ba, ama kanyɛn ere bre, an nyi kakpa nɛ e shi.”

english_verse: As Jesus was teaching in the temple, he shouted, “Do you really think you know me and where I came from? I didn't come on my own! The one who sent me is truthful, and you don't know him.
translation_verse: Saŋɛ na nɛ Yesu kraa ŋini abɔrɛsheŋ ashi bɔrɛlambu na to nseŋ ba kaŋɛ awɔrso le: “Kashenteŋ nna nɛ men nyi ma nsaa nyi kakpa nɛ n shi. Ama mannɛ ŋ gbagba be kumu so so nɛ n wɔ nfe, esa nɛ e shuŋi ma na la Kashenteŋwura nna. Men maŋ nyi mo.

english_verse: But I know the one who sent me, because I came from him.”
translation_verse: Ama ma ere nyi mo, ŋkpal manɛ so, mo kutɔ nɛ n shi. Mo alɛ e shuŋi ma.”

english_verse: Some of the people wanted to arrest Jesus right then. But no one even laid a hand on him, because his time had not yet come.
translation_verse: E ka malga le ere nɛ b yɛlga kepɛ mo ndoŋ, ama esa kama maŋ tiŋ n ta enɔ m beta mo, ŋkpal manɛ so, mbe saŋɛ daa maŋ naŋ fo.

english_verse: A lot of people in the crowd put their faith in him and said, “When the Messiah comes, he surely won't perform more miracles than this man has done!” Officers Sent To Arrest Jesus
translation_verse: Le be nfɛra e daa wɔ basa na to, ama jimaŋ na to be bedamta malɛ daŋ yirda mo nseŋ bishi abar le: “Menyee tama fanɛ Mesaya na kaŋ ba, e beeŋ ba wora emamachisheŋ damta mo nɛ a chɔ amo nɛ kanyɛn ere bee wora ere a?” B ka shuŋi basa nɛ b ya pɛ Yesu be asheŋ

english_verse: When the Pharisees heard the crowd arguing about Jesus, they got together with the chief priests and sent some temple police to arrest him.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ asheŋ nɛ basa na bee kuli a kaŋɛ Yesu be asheŋ na tɔr Efarisiana na be asoe to. Nɛ bɔrɛmatapowuraana nɛ Efarisiana na shuŋi bɔrɛlambu to be bekumpo fanɛ b ya pɛ Yesu m ba.

english_verse: But Jesus told them, “I will be with you a little while longer, and then I will return to the one who sent me.
translation_verse: Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ le: “Ma nɛ menyi maaŋ naa wɔtɔ n chɛr. Meeŋ yɔ esa nɛ e shuŋi ma na kutɔ.

english_verse: You will look for me, but you won't find me. You cannot go where I am going.”
translation_verse: Menyeeŋ fin ma, ama men maaŋ naŋ wu ma. Kakpa nɛ ma alɛ beeŋ baa wɔ na, menyi alɛ maaŋ tiŋ n yɔ ndoŋ.”

english_verse: The people asked each other, “Where can he go to keep us from finding him? Is he going to some foreign country where our people live? Is he going there to teach the Greeks?
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Juwebi be benimuana na fara a bishi abar le: “To, nnɛ nɛ kanyɛn ere bee sha keyɔ nɛ anyi ere maaŋ tiŋ n wu mo ere? Ŋko e bee yɔ an peebi nɛ b wɔ Griikebi to na nna nɛ e ya kaa ŋini bumo abɔrɛsheŋ?

english_verse: What did he mean by saying that we will look for him, but won't find him? Why can't we go where he is going?” Streams of Life-Giving Water
translation_verse: E yɛ: ‘Menyeeŋ fin ma, ama men maaŋ wu ma’, nseŋ naŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ: ‘Menyi maaŋ tiŋ n yɔ kakpa nɛ meeŋ ya kaa wɔ na.’ ” Nchu nɛ a bee sa ŋkpa na be asheŋ

english_verse: On the last and most important day of the festival, Jesus stood up and shouted, “If you are thirsty, come to me and drink!
translation_verse: Kejigboŋ na be nshɛr na be lalaloge be kachɛ, kumo be kachɛgboŋ na ka fo nɛ Yesu niŋi to n yili ŋ kaŋɛ awɔrso: “Esa kama nɛ achukoŋ kɔ mo, e ba ŋ kutɔ m ba nuu.

english_verse: Have faith in me, and you will have life-giving water flowing from deep inside you, just as the Scriptures say.”
translation_verse: Esa kama nɛ e yirda ma, nchu nɛ a bee sa ŋkpa na e naaŋ ba lar mo to fanɛ kananɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ na.”

english_verse: Jesus was talking about the Holy Spirit, who would be given to everyone that had faith in him. The Spirit had not yet been given to anyone, since Jesus had not yet been given his full glory. The People Take Sides
translation_verse: Yesu daŋ malga le nna a ŋini Kiyoyu nɛ bumo nɛ baaŋ yirda mo na beeŋ ba nya kachako na be asheŋ. Amo be saŋɛ na so malɛ kikɛ nɛ b maŋ naŋ shin nɛ Kiyoyu na ba, ŋkpal manɛ so, saŋɛ na so b maŋ naŋ maŋ Yesu so n sa mo kemaŋkura.

english_verse: When the crowd heard Jesus say this, some of them said, “He must be the Prophet!”
translation_verse: Basa na ka nu mbe mmalga na nɛ bumo be beko kaŋɛ le: “Kashenteŋto, kanyɛn ere e la Anebi na.”

english_verse: Others said, “He is the Messiah!” Others even said, “Can the Messiah come from Galilee?
translation_verse: Nɛ beko malɛ kaŋɛ: “Mesaya na nna.” Ndoŋ nna nɛ beko malɛ bishi: “Nuso nɛ Mesaya na bee wora ashi Galili?

english_verse: The Scriptures say that the Messiah will come from the family of King David. Doesn't this mean that he will be born in David's hometown of Bethlehem?”
translation_verse: Abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ fanɛ Ewura Deevid be kanaŋ to nɛ Mesaya na beeŋ shi nɛ b kurge mo ashi Bɛtlɛhɛm, kade nɛ Ewura Deevid daŋ shi na.”

english_verse: The people started taking sides against each other because of Jesus.
translation_verse: Amoso, basa na daŋ barga to nna ŋkpal Yesu so.

english_verse: Some of them wanted to arrest him, but no one laid a hand on him. The Leaders Refuse To Have Faith in Jesus
translation_verse: Beko daa sha kepɛ mo m mɔ, ama esa kikɛ daa maŋ ta enɔ m beta mo. Kananɛ Juwebi be bejuŋkparpo maŋ kɔ yirda be asheŋ

english_verse: When the temple police returned to the chief priests and Pharisees, they were asked, “Why didn't you bring Jesus here?”
translation_verse: Ade kikɛ be kaman nɛ bɔrɛlambu to be bekumpo na bɛta n yɔ bɔrɛmatapowuraana nɛ Efarisiana na kutɔ nɛ b bishi bekumpo na: “Manɛ e ba nɛ men maŋ bar mo?”

english_verse: They answered, “No one has ever spoken like this man!”
translation_verse: Nɛ bekumpo na kaŋɛ bumo le: “Kananɛ kanyɛn na bee malga na, esa kikɛ maŋ naŋ malga loŋ.”

english_verse: The Pharisees said to them, “Have you also been fooled?
translation_verse: Nɛ Efarisiana na bishi bekumpo na: “E fule menyi alɛ gba nna a?

english_verse: Not one of the chief priests or the Pharisees has faith in him.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman, men daŋ wu Juwebi be ejuŋkparpo kama ŋko Farisi kama ka yirda mo a?

english_verse: And these people who don't know the Law are under God's curse anyway.”
translation_verse: To, jimaŋ na to ebi ka maŋ nyi Mosis be mbra na so so nɛ baa yirda mo na, bumo alɛ wɔ kɔnɔso to nna so.”

english_verse: Nicodemus was there at the time. He was a member of the council, and was the same one who had earlier come to see Jesus. He said,
translation_verse: Nikodimɔs nɛ e daŋ yɔ n ya wu Yesu kachako na daa la bumo be eko nna nɛ e bishi mo braana le:

english_verse: “Our Law doesn't let us condemn people before we hear what they have to say. We cannot judge them before we know what they have done.”
translation_verse: “Anyi be mbra na wɔtɔ fanɛ an kaŋɛ fanɛ esa daga kasogberge nɛ anyi alɛ maŋ nu kusɔ nɛ amodoŋwura kɔ nɛ e kaŋɛ nseŋ naŋ bishi m pin to pɔɛŋ nsaa ji mo demu a?”

english_verse: Then they said, “Nicodemus, you must be from Galilee! Read the Scriptures, and you will find that no prophet is to come from Galilee.” A Woman Caught in Sin
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ mo braana na bishi mo le: “Fo alɛ gba shi Galili nna a? Kraŋ abɔrɛsibɛ na, feeŋ wu fanɛ anebi kikɛ maa lar Galili.” Kache nɛ b pɛ kesakalea to na be asheŋ

english_verse: Everyone else went home,
translation_verse: Ade be kaman nɛ ekama yɔ mo pe.

english_verse: but Jesus walked out to the Mount of Olives.
translation_verse: Nɛ Yesu malɛ yɔ Ɔlifs be kebee so.

english_verse: Then early the next morning he went to the temple. The people came to him, and he sat down and started teaching them.
translation_verse: Kare ka bee chɛ nɛ e naŋ ba bɔrɛlambu na to nɛ basa na kikɛ shɛr ŋ kulti mo nɛ e kilgi n chena a ŋini bumo abɔrɛsheŋ.

english_verse: The Pharisees and the teachers of the Law of Moses brought in a woman who had been caught in bed with a man who wasn't her husband. They made her stand in the middle of the crowd.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ mbraŋinipoana na nɛ Efarisiana na bar kache ko b ka pɛ kesakalea to m ba shin nɛ e yili jimaŋ na be anishito nɛ b kaŋɛ Yesu le:

english_verse: Then they said, “Teacher, this woman was caught sleeping with a man who isn't her husband.
translation_verse: “Eŋinipo, b pɛ kache ere kesakalea to nna geeŋ.

english_verse: The Law of Moses teaches that a woman like this should be stoned to death! What do you say?”
translation_verse: Mbra na malɛ to Mosis kaŋɛ anyi fanɛ an kpa loŋ be beche na ajembu m mɔ. To, nɛ nuso nɛ fo alɛ kaŋɛ?”

english_verse: They asked Jesus this question, because they wanted to test him and bring some charge against him. But Jesus simply bent over and started writing on the ground with his finger.
translation_verse: B daŋ bar le be kesheŋ bishiso ere nna nɛ b ba lute mo kɔnɔ n nya kusɔ ko n yili so n wu mo kulubi. Ama Yesu daŋ kilgi nna m murgi n ta mbe keshilbi n fara a sibɛ kasawule so.

english_verse: They kept on asking Jesus about the woman. Finally, he stood up and said, “If any of you have never sinned, then go ahead and throw the first stone at her!”
translation_verse: B ka kraa wɔtɔ a bishi mo na nɛ e niŋi to n yili ŋ kaŋɛ bumo: “Menyi be ekama nɛ e maŋ kɔ kulubi e fara ŋ kpa kache ere kejembu.”

english_verse: Once again he bent over and began writing on the ground.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ e naŋ murgi a sibɛ kasawule so.

english_verse: The people left one by one, beginning with the oldest. Finally, Jesus and the woman were there alone.
translation_verse: Yesu ka kaŋɛ loŋ na nɛ bumo nɛ b nu na fara a yɔ kukoko to. Benimu e daŋ fara loŋ hale nɛ Yesu nawule ya ka nɛ kache na malɛ kraa yil ndoŋ.

english_verse: Jesus stood up and asked her, “Where is everyone? Isn't there anyone left to accuse you?”
translation_verse: Nɛ Yesu niŋi to m bishi mo: “Kache manɛ, b wɔ nnɛ? Esa kama maŋ ka nɛ e kaŋɛ fanɛ fo daga kasogberge a?”

english_verse: “No sir,” the woman answered. Then Jesus told her, “I am not going to accuse you either. You may go now, but don't sin anymore.” Jesus Is the Light for the World
translation_verse: Nɛ kache na kaŋɛ Yesu: “Ebunyampo, esa kama maŋ ka.” Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ mo: “To, ma alɛ gba maaŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ fo daga kasogberge. Baa yɔ, ama sa maŋ naa wora alubi.”] Yesu ka la durnya be kefulto be asheŋ

english_verse: Once again Jesus spoke to the people. This time he said, “I am the light for the world! Follow me, and you won't be walking in the dark. You will have the light that gives life.”
translation_verse: Yesu ka naŋ ya malga basa na kutɔ nɛ e kaŋɛ bumo le: “Ma e la durnya be kefulto. Esa kama nɛ e bɛ ma so maaŋ nite tentembiri to kikɛ, ama e beeŋ baa kɔ kefulto nɛ k bee sa ŋkpa.”

english_verse: The Pharisees objected, “You are the only one speaking for yourself, and what you say isn't true!”
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Efarisiana kaŋɛ mo: “Too, fo kumu so be shɛda nɛ fee ji na, amoso, asheŋ nɛ fee malga ere maŋ la kashenteŋ.”

english_verse: Jesus replied: Even if I do speak for myself, what I say is true! I know where I came from and where I am going. But you don't know where I am from or where I am going.
translation_verse: Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ bumo: “Hale nɛ n ji ma kumu so be shɛda gba, asɔ nɛ mee malga ere kɔ kashenteŋ, ŋkpal manɛ so, n nyi kakpa nɛ n shi m ba nseŋ naa nyi kakpa nɛ mee yɔ, ama menyi ere maŋ nyi kakpa nɛ n shi m ba nɛ kakpa nɛ mee yɔ.

english_verse: You judge in the same way that everyone else does, but I don't judge anyone.
translation_verse: Dimɛdi be ekpa so nɛ menyee bɔla a ji esa demu, ma ere maa ji esa kama demu.

english_verse: If I did judge, I would judge fairly, because I would not be doing it alone. The Father who sent me is here with me.
translation_verse: Hale nɛ n ji esa demu gba, ma demuji daa beeŋ baa kɔ ekpa, ŋkpal manɛ so, mannɛ n nawule nna, ma nɛ Etuto nɛ e shuŋi ma na nna.

english_verse: I am one of my witnesses, and the Father who sent me is the other one.
translation_verse: Ŋ gbagba bee ji ma kumu so be shɛda nɛ Etuto nɛ e shuŋi ma na malɛ gba bee ji ma shɛda.”

english_verse: “Where is your Father?” they asked. “You don't know me or my Father!” Jesus answered. “If you knew me, you would know my Father.”
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ basa na bishi mo: “Nnɛ nɛ fo tuto wɔ?” Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ bumo: “Men maŋ nyi ma, menyi alɛ maŋ nyi n Tuto gba. Men daa nyi ma nna, men daa beeŋ baa nyi n Tuto gba.”
