translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Efarisiana na nɛ bɔrɛmatapowuraana na shɛr kɔɔtiebi nɛ b daa tre Sanhedrinebi na ŋ kaŋɛ: “Men keni emamachisheŋ damta nɛ kanyɛn ere bee wora ere, nuso nɛ anyeeŋ wora?

english_verse: If we don't stop him now, everyone will put their faith in him. Then the Romans will come and destroy our temple and our nation.”
translation_verse: An baŋ yige mo nɛ e wɔtɔ a wora le be asheŋ ere, ekama beeŋ yirda mo nɛ Romebi na e ba m ba jija anyi be bɔrɛlambu ere nseŋ ta anyi be efuli ere kikɛ n ti so.”

english_verse: One of the council members was Caiaphas, who was also high priest that year. He spoke up and said, “You people don't have any sense at all!
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ bumo be eko nɛ baa tre Kayafas nɛ e daa la bɔrɛmatapo nimuso amo be kafɛ na kaŋɛ le: “Men maŋ nyi shɛŋ.

english_verse: Don't you know it is better for one person to die for the people than for the whole nation to be destroyed?”
translation_verse: Men maŋ nyi fanɛ nɛ esa koŋwule wu n sa basa, loŋ bɔ n sa menyi a chɔ efuli ere kikɛ ka mur a?”

english_verse: From that day on, the council started making plans to put Jesus to death.
translation_verse: Amoso, baŋ yili kumo be kachɛ na a yɔ nɛ basa na kre Yesu be kemɔ be nia.

english_verse: Because of this plot against him, Jesus stopped going around in public. He went to the town of Ephraim, which was near the desert, and he stayed there with his disciples.
translation_verse: Amoso, Yesu daa maŋ naa bugi to a nite Juwebi na to. E daŋ lar bumo to nna n yɔ kadebi mo nɛ baa tre Efrayim na nna ashi kasawule nɛ k mata keshishɛrsawule so na nɛ mo nɛ mbe bebɛsopo ya kaa wɔ ndoŋ.

english_verse: It was almost time for Passover. Many of the Jewish people who lived out in the country had come to Jerusalem to get themselves ready for the festival.
translation_verse: Saŋɛ na so nɛ Juwebi be Kebansonchoŋ be kejigboŋ be saŋɛ bee fo nɛ basa damta shi ndewurbiana na to n juŋkpar n yɔ nɛ b ya fɔr bumo be amu so pɔɛŋ nɛ Kebansonchoŋ be kachɛ na gbagba e fo.

english_verse: They looked around for Jesus. Then when they were in the temple, they asked each other, “You don't think he will come here for Passover, do you?”
translation_verse: Basa na daa wɔ ndoŋ nna a fin Yesu nseŋ ya yili bɔrɛlambu na akpa a bishi abar le: “Nuso nɛ fee fɛ, fo tama fanɛ e maaŋ ba Kejigboŋ ere to nna kuraa ŋko nuso?”

english_verse: The chief priests and the Pharisees told the people to let them know if any of them saw Jesus. This is how they hoped to arrest him.
translation_verse: Saŋɛ na malɛ so bɔrɛmatapowuraana na nɛ Efarisiana na sa ebɔl fanɛ esa kama nɛ e nyi kakpa nɛ Yesu daa wɔ, amodoŋwura e ba kaŋɛ bumo nɛ b nya mo m pɛ.

english_verse: If you serve me, you must go with me. My servants will be with me wherever I am. If you serve me, my Father will honor you.
translation_verse: Esa kama nɛ e bee shuŋ ma, e baa bɛ ma so nɛ kaplɛkama malɛ nɛ n wɔ, ndoŋ nɛ ma kenya gba beeŋ baa wɔ. N Tuto malɛ beeŋ bunyaŋ esa kama nɛ e bee shuŋ ma.” Yesu ka malga mbe luwu be asheŋ

english_verse: they took palm branches and went out to greet him. They shouted, “Hooray! God bless the one who comes in the name of the Lord! God bless the King of Israel!”
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ b fɛta n fɛta abii be ayabi n lar n yɔ nɛ b ya tu mo nsaa ponte a kaŋɛ: “Hosana, nɛfa la esa nɛ e shi Enyɛnpe be ketre to a ba na peya nna. Nɛfa la mo, Israɛl be Ewura na peya nna.”

english_verse: Jesus found a donkey and rode on it, just as the Scriptures say,
translation_verse: Saŋɛ ere so nɛ Yesu fin kurmafɔlbi ko n chena kumo so nɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na e bɔla ekpa. A yɛ:

english_verse: Mary took a very expensive bottle of perfume and poured it on Jesus' feet. She wiped them with her hair, and the sweet smell of the perfume filled the house.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Mɛɛri ta amansherbi damta be tulale dufɛso be kɔlbagboŋ ko m ba ta amo n wurge Yesu be aya so nseŋ gbir n ta mbe emin m melti tulale na ŋ gbiti amo n wɔtɔ Yesu be aya so. Ndoŋ nna nɛ tulale na be efɛa sɔ ebu na kikɛ to verr.

english_verse: A lot of people came when they heard that Jesus was there. They also wanted to see Lazarus, because Jesus had raised him from death.
translation_verse: Asheŋ ere ka bee wora ere nɛ Juwebi na be bedamta nu fanɛ Yesu ba Bɛtani nseŋ ba nɛ b ba keni mo. Mannɛ Yesu malɛ gba nawule so nɛ b daŋ ba, b daŋ ba nna nɛ b ba keni Lazɔrɔs nɛ Yesu tiŋi luwu to na.

english_verse: A disciple named Judas Iscariot was there. He was the one who was going to betray Jesus, and he asked,
translation_verse: Ama mbe bebɛsopo na to be emo nɛ b daa tre Judas Iskareɔt nɛ e daa beeŋ debɔr Yesu na bishi le:

english_verse: Jesus replied, “Leave her alone! She has kept this perfume for the day of my burial.
translation_verse: Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ bumo le: “Men yige mo. Kusɔ nɛ e daa beeŋ wora ma ma kepuliachɛ nna na.

english_verse: You will always have the poor with you, but you won't always have me.” A Plot To Kill Lazarus
translation_verse: Saŋkama menyi nɛ betirpo e naaŋ baa la, ama ma ere nɛ menyi maaŋ baa la saŋkama.”

english_verse: So the chief priests made plans to kill Lazarus.
translation_verse: Amoso, bɔrɛmatapowuraana na daa kre Lazɔrɔs gba be kemɔ nna.

english_verse: Philip from Bethsaida in Galilee was there too. So they went to him and said, “Sir, we would like to meet Jesus.”
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ b ba Filip nɛ e daŋ shi Bɛtsaida nɛ k wɔ Galili na kutɔ m ba kaŋɛ mo le: “Kowurnyɛn, jande, anyee sha kewu Yesu nna.”

english_verse: But the Pharisees said to each other, “There is nothing we can do! Everyone in the world is following Jesus.” Some Greeks Want To Meet Jesus
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Efarisiana na kaŋɛ abar le: “Men keni, an maaŋ tiŋ n wora shɛŋ nna na, ŋkpal manɛ so, durnya kikɛ e muu a bɛ mo so na.” Griikebi ko ka ba kaa fin Yesu be asheŋ

english_verse: So Father, bring glory to yourself. A voice from heaven then said, “I have already brought glory to myself, and I will do it again!”
translation_verse: N Tuto, maŋkura fo ketre. Ndoŋ nna nɛ ebɔl shi ebɔrɛso ŋ kaŋɛ: “N teŋ maŋkura kumo, ama meeŋ naŋ maŋkura kumo.”

english_verse: “The Lord has blinded the eyes of the people, and he has made the people stubborn. He did this so that they could not see or understand, and so that they would not turn to the Lord and be healed.”
translation_verse: “N tan bumo be anishiana nseŋ ti bumo be ŋgbeneana, nɛ mannɛ aloŋ, bumo be anishiana beeŋ bugi asheŋ be kewuto nɛ bumo be ŋgbene e bugi asheŋ be kepinto nɛ b ba ma kutɔ nɛ n lara bumo ashi bumo be kebaawɔtɔ na to n sa bumo kebaawɔtɔ popɔr.”

english_verse: The next day a large crowd was in Jerusalem for Passover. When they heard that Jesus was coming for the festival,
translation_verse: Kumo be ŋklade nɛ jimaŋ damta nɛ k ba Kejigboŋ na to na nu fanɛ Yesu lar m pɛ Jerusalɛm be ekpa nɛ e yɔ ndoŋ.

english_verse: “People of Jerusalem, don't be afraid! Your King is now coming, and he is riding on a donkey.”
translation_verse: “O Zayɔn, sa maa lɔ kufu, keni fo Ewura e dii kurmafɔlbi a ba na.”

english_verse: A crowd had come to meet Jesus because they had seen him call Lazarus out of the tomb. They kept talking about him and this miracle.
translation_verse: Basa damta na daŋ lar n yɔ mo kutɔ nna ŋkpal mamachi be kesheŋ nɛ b daŋ nu e ka daŋ wora na so.

english_verse: Philip told Andrew. Then the two of them went to Jesus and told him. The Son of Man Must Be Lifted Up
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Filip ya kaŋɛ Andru nɛ bumo benyɔ ya kaŋɛ Yesu.

english_verse: Jesus said: The time has come for the Son of Man to be given his glory.
translation_verse: Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ bumo le: “Naniere bre jemanɛ nɛ ma, Nyiŋgbasa Pibinyɛn beeŋ nya kemaŋkura na fo.

english_verse: I tell you for certain that a grain of wheat that falls on the ground will never be more than one grain unless it dies. But if it dies, it will produce lots of wheat.
translation_verse: Ma e kaŋɛ menyi kashenteŋto na fanɛ kuyubi baa maŋ tɔr shishɛr to n wu, k beeŋ baa la keduusobi koŋwule nna saŋkikɛ. Ama nɛ fanɛ k baŋ tɔr shishɛr to ŋ kɔr pɔɛŋ nseŋ wu, k bee bar asɔrso damta nna.

english_verse: If you love your life, you will lose it. If you give it up in this world, you will be given eternal life.
translation_verse: Esa kama nɛ e bee sha mbe ŋkpa ga beeŋ paŋ kumo, ama ekama nɛ e maa ta mbe ŋkpa ere a tre shɛŋ durnya ere to, beeŋ nya mbe ŋkpa nɛ kebaawɔ ŋkpa ere to mbaanaayɔ.

english_verse: Now I am deeply troubled, and I don't know what to say. But I must not ask my Father to keep me from this time of suffering. In fact, I came into the world to suffer.
translation_verse: Naniere ma kagbene maŋ dese ma, ama nuso nɛ meeŋ wora? Ŋ kaŋɛ n Tuto fanɛ: ‘Etuto, mɔlga ma ashi le be kenishipere ere to,’ ŋko nuso? Ayai, m maaŋ wora loŋ, ŋkpal manɛ so, loŋ so nɛ m ba nɛ m ba ji saŋɛ ere so be awurfoŋ.

english_verse: When the crowd heard the voice, some of them thought it was thunder. Others thought an angel had spoken to Jesus.
translation_verse: Jimaŋ nɛ k daa wɔ ndoŋ na ka nu ebɔl na be egbri na nɛ beko kaŋɛ fanɛ bɔrɛ e ponte to nɛ beko malɛ kaŋɛ fanɛ malaika e malga mo kutɔ.

english_verse: Then Jesus told the crowd, “That voice spoke to help you, not me.
translation_verse: Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ bumo le: “Menyi so nɛ ebɔl na lar na, mannɛ ma so.

english_verse: This world's people are now being judged, and the ruler of this world is already being thrown out!
translation_verse: Naniere bre keji durnya ere demu be saŋɛ fo, naniere nɛ kegboŋi durnya ere to be ejuŋkparpo na ashi mbe kejuŋkpar na to na fo.

english_verse: If I am lifted up above the earth, I will make everyone want to come to me.”
translation_verse: Ama nɛ b kaŋ maŋ ma so ashi kasawule ere so bre, meeŋ bar basa kikɛ ŋ kutɔ.”

english_verse: Jesus was talking about the way he would be put to death.
translation_verse: E daŋ malga le nna a ŋini luwu mo nɛ e daa beeŋ wu be asheŋ.

english_verse: The crowd said to Jesus, “The Scriptures teach that the Messiah will live forever. How can you say that the Son of Man must be lifted up? Who is this Son of Man?”
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ jimaŋ na kaŋɛ mo le: “Anyee nu ashi anyi be mbra na to fanɛ Mesaya na beeŋ ba kaa wɔ ŋkpa to mbaanaayɔ nɛ a ji nuso nna nɛ fee kaŋɛ: ‘Baaŋ maŋ Nyiŋgbasa Pibinyɛn na so’? Wanɛ nɛ fee tre Nyiŋgbasa Pibinyɛn na?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “The light will be with you for only a little longer. Walk in the light while you can. Then you won't be caught walking blindly in the dark.
translation_verse: Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ bumo: “Kefulto na maaŋ naŋ chɛr menyi kutɔ. Amoso, men ka kraa kɔ kumo menyi to ere bre, men baa na kumo to, saŋɛ na so, tentembiri maaŋ luri menyi to. Esa kama nɛ e na tentembiri to maa pin kakpa nɛ e bee yɔ.

english_verse: Have faith in the light while it is with you, and you will be children of the light.” The People Refuse To Have Faith in Jesus After Jesus had said these things, he left and went into hiding.
translation_verse: Men ka kraa kɔ kefulto ere bre, men ta menyi be yirda n wɔtɔ kumo to, saŋɛ na so menyeeŋ baa la kefulto be basa.” E ka malga n loge nɛ e lar basa na to n ya ŋana. Juwebi ka maŋ kɔ yirda be asheŋ

english_verse: He had worked a lot of miracles among the people, but they were still not willing to have faith in him.
translation_verse: Yesu daŋ wora emamachisheŋ damta ere kikɛ bumo be anishito, ama bumo alɛ daa maŋ yirda mo.

english_verse: This happened so that what the prophet Isaiah had said would come true, “Lord, who has believed our message? And who has seen your mighty strength?”
translation_verse: Loŋ be kesheŋ na malɛ daŋ wora nna nɛ anebi Aizaaya be kamalga nɛ e daŋ malga na e bɔla ekpa. Le nɛ e daŋ bishi Ebɔrɛ: “Enyɛnpe, wanɛ e yirda kubɔya nɛ an bɔ na? Nɛ basa mo nɛ Enyɛnpe ŋini mbe eleŋ na?”

english_verse: The people could not have faith in Jesus, because Isaiah had also said,
translation_verse: Ŋkpal loŋ so, b daa maŋ tiŋ n yirda, ŋkpal manɛ so, loŋ malɛ nɛ Aizaaya kaŋɛ kakpa ko na fanɛ Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ:

english_verse: Isaiah said this, because he saw the glory of Jesus and spoke about him.
translation_verse: Anebi Aizaaya daŋ kaŋɛ le nna ŋkpal e ka daŋ wu Yesu be kemaŋkura nseŋ malga mbe asheŋ na so.

english_verse: Even then, many of the leaders put their faith in Jesus, but they did not tell anyone about it. The Pharisees had already given orders for the people not to have anything to do with anyone who had faith in Jesus.
translation_verse: Ŋkeshin nɛ benimu na to gba be bedamta daŋ yirda Yesu, ama ŋkpal Efarisiana so, b daa maa sha kebugi to ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ b yirda mo ŋkpal b ka daa maa sha fanɛ b ju bumo ashi nshɛrbuana na to be keluri to so.

english_verse: And besides, the leaders liked praise from others more than they liked praise from God. Jesus Came To Save the World
translation_verse: Bumo alɛ ka daa sha mbo ashi basa kutɔ a chɔ Ebɔrɛ kutɔ na so e shin nɛ b daa wora loŋ. Kusɔ nɛ k bar Yesu be asheŋ

english_verse: In a loud voice Jesus said: Everyone who has faith in me also has faith in the one who sent me.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Yesu malga awɔrso ŋ kaŋɛ le: “Esa baŋ yirda ma, mannɛ ma nawule nɛ e yirda, ama emo nɛ e shuŋi ma na gba nɛ e yirda.

english_verse: And everyone who has seen me has seen the one who sent me.
translation_verse: E baŋ keni ma, e bee wu esa nɛ e shuŋi ma na nna.

english_verse: I am the light that has come into the world. No one who has faith in me will stay in the dark.
translation_verse: M ba durnya to nna fanɛ kefulto na, saŋɛ na so, ekama nɛ e yirda ma, maaŋ shir a wɔ tentembiri to.

english_verse: I am not the one who will judge those who refuse to obey my teachings. I came to save the people of this world, not to be their judge.
translation_verse: Ama ekama nɛ e nu ma mmalga ŋkaa maa ta amo a wɔtɔ mo to, m maa kaŋɛ fanɛ e daga kasogberge, ŋkpal manɛ so, m maŋ ba na nɛ m ba ji durnya demu. M ba na nɛ m ba mɔlga durnya.

english_verse: But everyone who rejects me and my teachings will be judged on the last day by what I have said.
translation_verse: Esa kama nɛ e bee kini ma a maa sɔ ma mmalga na kɔ esa nɛ e beeŋ ji mo demu. Mmalga nɛ m malga na gbagba e naaŋ ki amodoŋwura be demujipo lalaloge be kachɛ na.

english_verse: I don't speak on my own. I say only what the Father who sent me has told me to say.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, mannɛ ŋ gbagba be eleŋ to so nɛ m malga, Etuto nɛ e shuŋi ma na e nase kusɔ nɛ meeŋ kaŋɛ nɛ kananɛ meeŋ kaŋɛ kumo n sa ma.

english_verse: I know that his commands will bring eternal life. This is why I tell you exactly what the Father has told me.
translation_verse: N nyi mbe kamalga naseso ka bee bar ŋkpa nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na, amoso, kusɔ kama nɛ m malga baa la kusɔ nɛ Etuto na kaŋɛ fanɛ ŋ kaŋɛ nna.”

english_verse: It was before Passover, and Jesus knew that the time had come for him to leave this world and to return to the Father. He had always loved his followers in this world, and he loved them to the very end.
translation_verse: K ka ba ka kachɛ koŋwule nɛ Kebansonchoŋ be kejigboŋ na e fo nɛ Yesu pin fanɛ mbe kelar durnya ere to n yɔ Etuto na kutɔ na be jemanɛ fo, e daŋ sha mbe basa ashi durnya to, n sha bumo loŋ n ya fo ekar.

english_verse: Even before the evening meal started, the devil had made Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot, decide to betray Jesus.
translation_verse: B ka tase ejikpa a shin nɛ b ji kanyɛso be ajibi nɛ alubipo na malɛ teŋ yili kumo Judas Iskareɔt, Saimɔn pibi be kagbene to fanɛ e debɔr Yesu.

english_verse: Jesus knew he had come from God and would go back to God. He also knew that the Father had given him complete power.
translation_verse: Yesu daa nyi Etuto na ka daŋ ta eleŋ kikɛ m bɔɔ mo ere Yesu na enɔ nseŋ naa nyi e ka shi Ebɔrɛ kutɔ m ba nseŋ naa bɛta a yɔ mo kutɔ.

english_verse: So during the meal Jesus got up, removed his outer garment, and wrapped a towel around his waist.
translation_verse: Amoso, Yesu daŋ koso ajibi na akpa nna n yili nseŋ gbaŋ mbe piŋi n nase nseŋ ta bɔrdeba n chɛ kashɛr.

english_verse: He put some water into a large bowl. Then he began washing his disciples' feet and drying them with the towel he was wearing.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ e chulgi nchu n wɔtɔ katishaŋ to nseŋ fara a fɔr mbe bebɛsopoana na be aya so nsaa ta bɔrdeba nɛ e ta n chɛ kashɛr na a melti bumo be ayaana.

english_verse: But when he came to Simon Peter, this disciple asked, “Lord, are you going to wash my feet?”
translation_verse: E wora loŋ m ba fo Saimɔn Pita nɛ e bishi mo: “Enyɛnpe, fo yɛ fo fɔr ma aya so a?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “You don't really know what I am doing, but later you will understand.”
translation_verse: Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ mo le: “Naniere bre fo maŋ nyi kusɔ nɛ mee wora ere, ama k maaŋ chɛr nɛ fo pin to.”

english_verse: “You will never wash my feet!” Peter replied. “If I don't wash you,” Jesus told him, “you don't really belong to me.”
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Pita kaŋɛ: “Ayai, fo maa ba nɛ fo ba fɔr ma aya so kuraa.” Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ mo: “Nɛ m baŋ maŋ fɔr fo so, ma nɛ fo maaŋ baa kɔ shɛŋ.”

english_verse: Peter said, “Lord, don't wash just my feet. Wash my hands and my head.”
translation_verse: Nɛ Saimɔn Pita kaŋɛ mo: “Kumo ere, Enyɛnpe, sa maŋ fɔr ma aya so nawule, fɔr ma enɔana nɛ ma kumu so gba n ti so.”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “People who have bathed and are clean all over need to wash just their feet. And you, my disciples, are clean, except for one of you.”
translation_verse: Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ mo: “Esa nɛ e teŋ bɛr nchu maŋ naa bɛr ai, she mbe aya nawule nɛ e beeŋ fɔr so. Menyi alɛ nyalɛ so nna, ama mannɛ menyi kikɛ nyam bre e nyalɛ so.”

english_verse: Jesus knew who would betray him. That is why he said, “except for one of you.”
translation_verse: E daa nyi esa nɛ e daa shin nɛ e debɔr mo, amoso nɛ e daŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ mannɛ bumo kikɛ nyam e daŋ nyalɛ so na.

english_verse: After Jesus had washed his disciples' feet and had put his outer garment back on, he sat down again. Then he said: Do you understand what I have done?
translation_verse: E ka fɔr n fɔr bumo be ayaana na so n loge nɛ e ta mbe asɔ m buu nseŋ bɛta n yɔ mbe echenakpa n ya chena m bishi bumo le: “Men pin kusɔ nɛ n wora menyi ere to a?

english_verse: You call me your teacher and Lord, and you should, because that is who I am.
translation_verse: Menyee kaa tre ma Eŋinipo nɛ Enyɛnpe, kashenteŋ nɛ menyi alɛ bee ji, ŋkpal manɛ so, n la Eŋinipo nɛ Enyɛnpe nna.

english_verse: I have set the example, and you should do for each other exactly what I have done for you.
translation_verse: N wora loŋ nna ŋ ŋini menyi nna na fanɛ men baa wora kananɛ n wora menyi ere.

english_verse: I tell you for certain that servants are not greater than their master, and messengers are not greater than the one who sent them.
translation_verse: Kashenteŋ nɛ mee ji menyi na fanɛ kenya maŋ chɔ mo nyɛnpe, kabɔ kama malɛ maŋ chɔ esa nɛ e shuŋi mo na.

english_verse: I am not talking about all of you. I know the ones I have chosen. But what the Scriptures say must come true. And they say, “The man who ate with me has turned against me!”
translation_verse: E yɛ: “Mannɛ menyi kikɛ nɛ n de. N nyi bumo nɛ n lara. Ama ade kikɛ wora nna nɛ kananɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na kaŋɛ le na e bɔla ekpa, a kaŋɛ: ‘Esa nɛ e ji ma ajibi gbagba kilgi nna n tu ma.’

english_verse: I am telling you this before it all happens. Then when it does happen, you will believe who I am.
translation_verse: Mee kaŋɛ menyi nna na a yili pɔɛŋ nɛ k ba wora, saŋɛ na so, nɛ k ba wora, menyeeŋ pin fanɛ ma e la Esa nɛ e bee ba na.

english_verse: So the disciple leaned toward Jesus and asked, “Lord, which one of us are you talking about?”
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ ebɛsopo na firgi n taga to Yesu nseŋ bishi mo: “Enyɛnpe, wanɛ nna?”

english_verse: After Jesus had said these things, he was deeply troubled and told his disciples, “I tell you for certain that one of you will betray me.”
translation_verse: Yesu ka malga kesheŋ ere n loge nɛ mbe kagbene jija mo ga nɛ e bugi to ŋ kaŋɛ bumo le: “Ma e kaŋɛ menyi kashenteŋto na fanɛ menyi be eko beeŋ debɔr ma.”

english_verse: Jesus' favorite disciple was sitting next to him at the meal,
translation_verse: Bebɛsopo na be emo nɛ Yesu daa sha na daŋ chena nna m mata mo.

english_verse: and Simon motioned for this disciple to find out which one Jesus meant.
translation_verse: Nɛ Saimɔn Pita wora ebɛsopo na enɔ fanɛ e bishi Yesu bumo to be emo nɛ e de.

english_verse: But because Judas was in charge of the money, some of them thought that Jesus had told him to buy something they needed for the festival. Others thought that Jesus had told him to give some money to the poor.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal Judas ka daa keni katuŋ na be amansherbi so so, bumo be beko daa fɛ fanɛ Yesu daa kaŋɛ mo nna fanɛ e ya tɔ Kejigboŋ na to be asɔ nɛ baaŋ baa sha m ba ŋko fanɛ e ta kusɔ ko n ya sa betirpo.

english_verse: Judas took the piece of bread and went out. It was already night. The New Command
translation_verse: Judas ka baŋ sɔ bodobodo na nɛ e lar epul na to. Kanyɛ daŋ biri nna nɛ e lar. Kamalga naseso popɔr be asheŋ

english_verse: Then, after God is given glory because of him, God will bring glory to him, and God will do it very soon.
translation_verse: Nɛ fanɛ Ebɔrɛ malɛ baŋ bɔla ma so n nya kemaŋkura, kumo ere Ebɔrɛ beeŋ maŋkura ma, Ebinyɛn na ashi mo to. Mo alɛ beeŋ naŋ maŋkura ma epul ere to.

english_verse: My children, I will be with you for only a little while longer. Then you will look for me, but you won't find me. I tell you just as I told the people, “You cannot go where I am going.”
translation_verse: Ma mbia, m maaŋ baa wɔ menyi kutɔ n chɛr. Menyeeŋ fin ma, ama fanɛ kananɛ ŋ kaŋɛ Juwebi na nɛ mee kaŋɛ menyi alɛ gba na fanɛ kakpa nɛ mee yɔ na, men maaŋ tiŋ m ba ndoŋ.

english_verse: Simon Peter asked, “Lord, where are you going?” Jesus answered, “You can't go with me now, but later on you will.”
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Saimɔn Pita bishi mo: “Enyɛnpe, nnɛ nɛ fee yɔ?” Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ mo: “Fo maaŋ tiŋ m bɛ ma so naniere n yɔ kakpa nɛ mee yɔ ere, ama kachako feeŋ bɛ ma so n yɔ.”

english_verse: Peter asked, “Lord, why can't I go with you now? I would die for you!”
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Pita naŋ bishi mo: “Enyɛnpe, manɛ e ba nɛ m maaŋ tiŋ m bɛ fo so naniere n yɔ? Meeŋ tiŋ ŋkpal fo so gba n wu.”

english_verse: “Would you really die for me?” Jesus asked. “I tell you for certain before a rooster crows, you will say three times that you don't even know me.”
translation_verse: Nɛ Yesu bishi mo: “Fo yɛ feeŋ tiŋ ŋkpal ma so n wu ŋko? Keni, ma e kaŋɛ fo kashenteŋto na fanɛ pɔɛŋ nɛ koshinyɛn e boŋ kanyɛ ere, feeŋ chɛ ale asa fanɛ fo maŋ nyi ma.”

english_verse: Jesus said to his disciples, “Don't be worried! Have faith in God and have faith in me.
translation_verse: Yesu yɛ: “Men sa maŋ shin nɛ men be ŋgbene e baa jija menyi. Men yirda n Tuto Ebɔrɛ, men baa yirda ma alɛ gba.

english_verse: There are many rooms in my Father's house. I wouldn't tell you this, unless it was true. I am going there to prepare a place for each of you.
translation_verse: Ebu damtaana wɔ n Tuto na pe, nɛ mannɛ aloŋ e daa la, n daŋ kaŋɛ menyi. Ma alɛ bee yɔ ndoŋ nna na nɛ n ya kaa lɔŋɛ kaboŋ a yili menyi.

english_verse: You know the way to where I am going.”
translation_verse: Men nyi kakpa nɛ mee yɔ na be ekpa.”

english_verse: Thomas said, “Lord, we don't even know where you are going! How can we know the way?”
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Tɔmas bishi mo: “Enyɛnpe, anyi maŋ nyi kakpa nɛ fee yɔ na nɛ nuso nɛ anyeeŋ wora m pin ekpa na?”

english_verse: “I am the way, the truth, and the life!” Jesus answered. “Without me, no one can go to the Father.
translation_verse: Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ mo: “Ma e la ekpa na nɛ kashenteŋ nɛ ŋkpa na, esa kama maaŋ tiŋ n yɔ Etuto na kutɔ ama e bɔla ma so nna.”

english_verse: If you had really known me, you would have known the Father. But from now on, you do know him, and you have seen him.”
translation_verse: Nɛ e naŋ kaŋɛ bumo le: “Nɛ men daa nyi ma nna, menyi daa beeŋ baa nyi n Tuto na gba. Baŋ yili kabre a yɔ menyi alɛ tea nyi mo hale n teŋ wu mo gba.”

english_verse: Philip said, “Lord, show us the Father. That is all we need.”
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Filip kaŋɛ mo le: “Enyɛnpe, ŋini anyi Etuto na nɛ kusɔ kama e kukwe anyi.”

english_verse: Jesus replied: Philip, I have been with you for a long time. Don't you know who I am? If you have seen me, you have seen the Father. How can you ask me to show you the Father?
translation_verse: Nɛ Yesu bishi mo: “Filip, fo maŋ nyi ma a? Ma nɛ menyi kikɛ e baa wɔtɔ n chɛr le nɛ fo maŋ nyi ma a? Esa kama nɛ e wu ma, wu Etuto na nna na nɛ manɛ e ba nɛ fo kaŋɛ fanɛ: ‘Ŋini anyi Etuto na’?

english_verse: Don't you believe that I am one with the Father and that the Father is one with me? What I say isn't said on my own. The Father who lives in me does these things.
translation_verse: Fo maŋ nyi fanɛ n wɔ Etuto na to nna nɛ Etuto na malɛ gba wɔ ma to a? Men baa nyi fanɛ mmalga nɛ mee malga ere maŋ la ŋ gbagba peya, Etuto nɛ e wɔ ma to na e naa shuŋ mbe kushuŋ.

english_verse: Have faith in me when I say that the Father is one with me and that I am one with the Father. Or else have faith in me simply because of the things I do.
translation_verse: Ŋ ka kaŋɛ fanɛ n wɔ Etuto na to nɛ Etuto na malɛ gba wɔ ma to ere, men yirda ma, nɛ mannɛ aloŋ gba nna, men keni emamachisheŋ nɛ mee wora so n yirda fanɛ kashenteŋ nɛ mee ji na.

english_verse: I tell you for certain that if you have faith in me, you will do the same things I am doing. You will do even greater things, now that I am going back to the Father.
translation_verse: Ma e kaŋɛ menyi kashenteŋto na fanɛ esa kama nɛ e ta mbe yirda n deŋi ma so, beeŋ wora asɔ nɛ mee kaa wora ere. E beeŋ wora asɔ nɛ a chɔ ade gba, ŋkpal ŋ ka bee yɔ Etuto na kutɔ so.

english_verse: Ask me, and I will do whatever you ask. This way the Son will bring honor to the Father.
translation_verse: Kusɔ kama malɛ nɛ men ta ma ketre na ŋ kule, meeŋ wora kumo, saŋɛ na so ma, Ebinyɛn na beeŋ bar Etuto na kemaŋkura.

english_verse: I will do whatever you ask me to do. The Holy Spirit Is Promised
translation_verse: Kusɔ kama nɛ men ta ma ketre na ŋ kule, meeŋ wora kumo n sa menyi.” Yesu ka nase kɔnɔ fanɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na beeŋ ba be asheŋ

english_verse: Jesus said to his disciples: If you love me, you will do as I command.
translation_verse: Nɛ men baa sha ma, menyeeŋ baa bɛ ma mmalga naseso so.

english_verse: Then I will ask the Father to send you the Holy Spirit who will help you and always be with you.
translation_verse: Meeŋ kule Etuto na nɛ e naaŋ sa menyi Echɛtopo ko,

english_verse: The Spirit will show you what is true. The people of this world cannot accept the Spirit, because they don't see or know him. But you know the Spirit, who is with you and will keep on living in you.
translation_verse: mo e la kashenteŋ be Kiyoyu na, nɛ e ba kaa wɔ menyi kutɔ mbaanaayɔ. Durnya ere to ebi maaŋ tiŋ n sɔ loŋ be Echɛtopo na, ŋkpal manɛ so, b maaŋ tiŋ n wu mo, bumo alɛ maŋ naa nyi mo. Ama menyi ere nyi mo, ŋkpal manɛ so, e beeŋ ba kaa wɔ menyi kutɔ nseŋ naa wɔ menyi be ŋgbeneana to.

english_verse: I won't leave you like orphans. I will come back to you.
translation_verse: M maaŋ yige menyi n to fanɛ amunibi. Meeŋ naŋ ba menyi kutɔ.

english_verse: In a little while the people of this world won't be able to see me, but you will see me. And because I live, you will live.
translation_verse: A ka gbrɛbi nɛ durnya ere to ebi maaŋ naŋ wu ma, ama menyi ere beeŋ wu ma, ma alɛ ka wɔ ŋkpa to ere, menyi alɛ gba beeŋ baa wɔ ŋkpa to.

english_verse: Then you will know I am one with the Father. You will know you are one with me, and I am one with you.
translation_verse: Kachɛ na kaŋ fo, menyeeŋ pin ŋ ka wɔ n Tuto na to nɛ menyi alɛ wɔ ma to nɛ ma alɛ gba wɔ menyi to.

english_verse: If you love me, you will do what I have said, and my Father will love you. I will also love you and show you what I am like.
translation_verse: “Esa kama nɛ e kɔ ma mmalga naseso nsaa wora asɔ nɛ a bee kaŋɛ na e la esa nɛ e bee sha ma. Esa kama malɛ nɛ e bee sha ma, n Tuto gba beeŋ sha mo nɛ ma alɛ gba e sha mo nseŋ lara ma kumu ŋ ŋini mo.”

english_verse: The other Judas, not Judas Iscariot, then spoke up and asked, “Lord, what do you mean by saying that you will show us what you are like, but you will not show the people of this world?”
translation_verse: Nɛ Judas, mannɛ Judas Iskareɔt, bishi mo: “Enyɛnpe, nuso nɛ feeŋ lara fo kumu ŋ ŋini anyi ŋkaa maaŋ lara fo kumu ŋ ŋini durnya ere to ebi bre?”

english_verse: Jesus replied: If anyone loves me, they will obey me. Then my Father will love them, and we will come to them and live in them.
translation_verse: Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ mo le: “Esa kama nɛ e bee sha ma beeŋ ta ma mmalga n wɔtɔ mbe kagbene to. N Tuto malɛ gba beeŋ baa sha mo nɛ ma nɛ n Tuto na kikɛ e ba mo kutɔ m ba ta mo ŋ ki anyi be kowu.

english_verse: But anyone who doesn't love me, won't obey me. What they have heard me say doesn't really come from me, but from the Father who sent me.
translation_verse: Esa kama nɛ e maa sha ma, maa ta ma mmalga a wɔtɔ mbe kagbene to. Mmalga nɛ menyee nu ere malɛ maŋ la meya nna, n Tuto nɛ e shuŋi ma na peya nna.

english_verse: I have told you these things while I am still with you.
translation_verse: Ŋ kraa wɔ menyi kutɔ nna nsaa malga asheŋ ere kikɛ na.

english_verse: But the Holy Spirit will come and help you, because the Father will send the Spirit to take my place. The Spirit will teach you everything and will remind you of what I said while I was with you.
translation_verse: Ama Echɛtopo na, mo e la Kiyoyu Cheeŋ nɛ n Tuto beeŋ shuŋi ma ketre to na kaŋ ba, e beeŋ ŋini menyi kusɔ kama nseŋ nyiŋi menyi asɔ nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ menyi kikɛ.

english_verse: I give you peace, the kind of peace only I can give. It isn't like the peace this world can give. So don't be worried or afraid.
translation_verse: Kagbenewushi nɛ mee yige a sa menyi na, kagbenewushi nɛ k shi ŋ gbagba kutɔ. Kumo alɛ mannɛ fanɛ kananɛ durnya bee sa kumo na nɛ ŋ kɔ kumo a sa menyi. Amoso, men sa maŋ shin nɛ menyi be ŋgbene e baa jija menyi ŋko nɛ kufu e baa kɔ menyi.

english_verse: You have already heard me say I am going and I will also come back to you. If you really love me, you should be glad I am going back to the Father, because he is greater than I am.
translation_verse: Men teŋ nu ŋ ka kaŋɛ menyi fanɛ: ‘Mee yɔ nna nɛ n naŋ bɛta m ba menyi kutɔ’. Nɛ men daa sha ma nna, k daa beeŋ wora menyi ebel ŋkpal ŋ ka bee yɔ n Tuto na kutɔ so, ŋkpal manɛ so, Etuto na e chɔ ma.

english_verse: I am telling you this before I leave, so when it does happen, you will have faith in me.
translation_verse: Ŋ kaŋɛ menyi kesheŋ ere naniere nna na pɔɛŋ nɛ loŋ e ba wora, saŋɛ na so, nɛ k ba wora, menyeeŋ yirda.

english_verse: I cannot speak with you much longer, because the ruler of this world is coming. But he has no power over me.
translation_verse: M maaŋ naŋ malga menyi kutɔ n chɛr, ŋkpal manɛ so, durnya ere to be ejuŋkparpo na bee ba.

english_verse: I obey my Father, so everyone in the world might know that I love him. It is time for us to go now.
translation_verse: E maŋ kɔ eleŋ ma so, ama a daga durnya ere ka pin fanɛ mee sha Etuto na, amoso nɛ mee wora kusɔ nɛ e bee kaŋɛ ma kikɛ na. Men niŋi to nɛ an koso nfe n choŋ.”

english_verse: Jesus said to his disciples: I am the true vine, and my Father is the gardener.
translation_verse: Yesu yɛ: “N du fanɛ kedibi sɔrso gbagba nna nɛ n Tuto malɛ la ndibi sɔrso na be ekenipo.

english_verse: He cuts away every branch of mine that doesn't produce fruit. But he trims clean every branch that does produce fruit, so that it will produce even more fruit.
translation_verse: Keyabi kama nɛ k chɔɔ ma so ŋkaa maa sɔr shɛŋ, e bee ku kumo nna a lɛ nɛ keyabi kama malɛ nɛ k bee sɔr e bee lɔŋɛ kumo so nna nɛ k tiŋ n sɔr ga n ti so.

english_verse: You are already clean because of what I have said to you.
translation_verse: Men teŋ nyalɛ so ŋkpal kamalga nɛ m malga n sa menyi na so.

english_verse: Stay joined to me, and I will stay joined to you. Just as a branch cannot produce fruit unless it stays joined to the vine, you cannot produce fruit unless you stay joined to me.
translation_verse: Men baa wɔ ma to nɛ ma alɛ gba e baa wɔ menyi to. Kedibi be keyabi kama nawule maaŋ tiŋ n sɔr asɔrso ama k baa chɔɔ kedibi na gbagba so nna. Menyi alɛ gba maaŋ tiŋ n nya asɔrso kama ama men baa wɔ ma to nna.

english_verse: I am the vine, and you are the branches. If you stay joined to me, and I stay joined to you, then you will produce lots of fruit. But you cannot do anything without me.
translation_verse: Ma e la kedibi sɔrso na nɛ menyi alɛ la kumo be ayabi. Nɛ esa baa wɔ ma to nɛ ma alɛ gba baa wɔ mo to, amodoŋwura beeŋ nya asɔrso damta, ama nɛ m baa maa wɔ men be asheŋ to, men maaŋ tiŋ n wora shɛŋ.

english_verse: If you don't stay joined to me, you will be thrown away. You will be like dry branches that are gathered up and burned in a fire.
translation_verse: Esa kama nɛ e maŋ wɔ ma to du fanɛ kedibi be keyabi nɛ b ku ashi kedibi gbagba so nna n lɛ nɛ k bee wɔl na nna. Ayabi mo nɛ a du loŋ malɛ, baa muu amo nna n wɔtɔ edɛ to nɛ a chɔɔ.

english_verse: Stay joined to me and let my teachings become part of you. Then you can pray for whatever you want, and your prayer will be answered.
translation_verse: Nɛ men baa wɔ ma to nɛ ma mmalga gba wɔ menyi to, men kule kusɔ kama nɛ menyee sha nɛ men nya kumo.

english_verse: I have loved you, just as my Father has loved me. So remain faithful to my love for you.
translation_verse: Kananɛ Etuto na sha ma na gbagba nɛ ma alɛ gba sha menyi. Men baa wɔ ma kasha na to.

english_verse: If you obey me, I will keep loving you, just as my Father keeps loving me, because I have obeyed him.
translation_verse: Nɛ men baa bɛ ma mmalga naseso so, menyeeŋ baa wɔ ma kasha to fanɛ kananɛ mee bɛ Etuto na be mmalga naseso so nsaa wɔ mbe kasha to na.

english_verse: Now I tell you to love each other, as I have loved you.
translation_verse: Ma kamalga naseso nde: ‘Men baa sha abar fanɛ kananɛ mee sha menyi na.’

english_verse: The greatest way to show love for friends is to die for them.
translation_verse: Kasha kama maŋ naa chɔ le be kasha ere fanɛ esa ka beeŋ ta mbe ŋkpa n sa mo teriana.

english_verse: And you are my friends, if you obey me.
translation_verse: Nɛ men baa wora asɔ nɛ mee kaŋɛ menyi, kumo ere n teriana e la menyi.

english_verse: Servants don't know what their master is doing, and so I don't speak to you as my servants. I speak to you as my friends, and I have told you everything my Father has told me.
translation_verse: M maŋ naa tre menyi ma anya, ŋkpal manɛ so, kenya maa pin mo nyɛnpe be asheŋ woraso to. Naniere bre mee tre menyi n teriana nna, ŋkpal manɛ so, kusɔ kama nɛ ŋ koya ashi n Tuto na kutɔ, m maŋ ta amo ŋ ŋana menyi so.

english_verse: You did not choose me. I chose you and sent you out to produce fruit, the kind of fruit that will last. Then my Father will give you whatever you ask for in my name.
translation_verse: Mannɛ menyi e lara ma, ma e lara menyi nseŋ kaŋɛ menyi fanɛ men ya nya asɔrso nɛ a beeŋ baa wɔtɔ a yɔ. Saŋɛ na so, Etuto na beeŋ sa menyi kusɔ kama nɛ men ta ma ketre ŋ kule mo.

english_verse: If the people of this world hate you, just remember that they hated me first.
translation_verse: “Nɛ durnya ere baŋ kishi menyi, men baa nyi fanɛ ma nɛ k fara ŋ kishi pɔɛŋ nseŋ ba kaa kishi menyi na.

english_verse: If you belonged to the world, its people would love you. But you don't belong to the world. I have chosen you to leave the world behind, and this is why its people hate you.
translation_verse: Nɛ men daa la durnya ere peya nna, k daa beeŋ baa sha menyi fanɛ kumo be basa gbagba. Ama n lara menyi ashi durnya ere to nna nɛ men maŋ naa la kumo be basa, amoso nɛ k kishi menyi na.

english_verse: Remember how I told you that servants are not greater than their master. So if people mistreat me, they will mistreat you. If they do what I say, they will do what you say.
translation_verse: Men baa nyiŋi kananɛ n daŋ kaŋɛ menyi na fanɛ: ‘Kenya maŋ chɔ mo nyɛnpe’. Nɛ durnya ere to ebi baŋ tɔrɔ ma, kumo ere baaŋ tɔrɔ menyi alɛ gba. Nɛ b baŋ ta ma mmalga n wɔtɔ bumo be ŋgbene to, baaŋ ta menyi alɛ gba peya n wɔtɔ bumo be ŋgbene to.

english_verse: People will do to you exactly what they did to me. They will do it because you belong to me, and they don't know the one who sent me.
translation_verse: Asheŋ ere kikɛ nɛ baaŋ wora menyi ŋkpal men ka la meya so, ŋkpal manɛ so, b maŋ nyi esa nɛ e shuŋi ma na.

english_verse: If I had not come and spoken to them, they would not be guilty of sin. But now they have no excuse for their sin.
translation_verse: Kumo alɛ nɛ n daa maŋ ba nna m ba malga n sa bumo, b daa maaŋ tɔr alubi be ntaŋ, ama naniere b maaŋ tiŋ n ji n lar.

english_verse: Everyone who hates me also hates my Father.
translation_verse: Esa kama nɛ e kishi ma, kishi n Tuto gba nna.

english_verse: I have done things no one else has ever done. If they had not seen me do these things, they would not be guilty. But they did see me do these things, and they still hate me and my Father too.
translation_verse: Nɛ fanɛ n daa maŋ wora emamachisheŋ nɛ esa kikɛ maŋ naŋ wora ere bumo to nna, b daa maaŋ tɔr alubi be ntaŋ, ama naniere b wu emamachisheŋ ere kikɛ, bumo alɛ kraa kishi ma nɛ n Tuto na kikɛ.

english_verse: This is why the Scriptures are true when they say, “People hated me for no reason.”
translation_verse: Ama kumo alɛ du loŋ nna nɛ kusɔ nɛ k wɔ bumo be mbra na to na e bɔla. K yɛ: ‘B kishi ma nna kenyanyaŋɛso’.

english_verse: I will send you the Spirit who comes from the Father and shows what is true. The Spirit will help you and will tell you about me.
translation_verse: Ama Echɛtopo nɛ meeŋ shin nɛ e shi Etuto na kutɔ m ba menyi kutɔ na, mo e la kashenteŋ be Kiyoyu nseŋ shi Etuto na kutɔ na kaŋ ba, e beeŋ ji ma shɛda.

english_verse: Then you will also tell others about me, because you have been with me from the beginning.
translation_verse: Ama a daga fanɛ menyi alɛ gba ka ji shɛda na, ŋkpal manɛ so, ma nɛ menyi e baa la sososo na kikɛ.”

english_verse: I am telling you these things, so that you will not turn away.
translation_verse: Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ mbe bebɛsopo na le: “Ŋ kaŋɛ menyi asheŋ ere nna nɛ men sa maŋ kaŋ foe ekpa.

english_verse: You will be chased out of the synagogues. And the time will come when people will kill you and think they are doing God a favor.
translation_verse: Basa beeŋ ba kaa ju menyi ashi nshɛrbuana na to be keluri to. Saŋko beeŋ ba fo nɛ esa kama nɛ e mɔ menyi beeŋ baa fɛ fanɛ Ebɔrɛ nɛ e bee shuŋ.

english_verse: They will do these things because they don't know either the Father or me.
translation_verse: Bumo alɛ beeŋ wora loŋ nna ŋkpal b ka maŋ nyi Etuto ŋko ma so.

english_verse: I am saying this to you now, so that when the time comes, you will remember what I have said. The Work of the Holy Spirit I was with you at the first, and so I didn't tell you these things.
translation_verse: Ŋ kaŋɛ menyi kesheŋ ere nna, saŋɛ na so, jemanɛ nɛ baaŋ wora asheŋ na kaŋ fo, menyeeŋ nyiŋi fanɛ n chɛr ŋ kaŋɛ menyi. Ŋ ka wɔ menyi kutɔ na so so nɛ n daa maŋ kaŋɛ menyi kesheŋ ere sososo na.” Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na be kushuŋ be asheŋ

english_verse: But now I am going back to the Father who sent me, and none of you asks me where I am going.
translation_verse: Ama naniere bre mee bɛta a yɔ esa nɛ e shuŋi ma na kutɔ nna ŋkeshin nɛ menyi alɛ be ekama maŋ bishi ma fanɛ: ‘Nnɛ nɛ fee yɔ?’

english_verse: You are very sad from hearing all of this.
translation_verse: Ama ŋkpal ŋ ka kaŋɛ menyi kesheŋ ere so so, kagbenejija luri nna m bɔlɔ menyi to.

english_verse: But I tell you I am going to do what is best for you. This is why I am going away. The Holy Spirit cannot come to help you until I leave. But after I am gone, I will send the Spirit to you.
translation_verse: Kashenteŋ malɛ nɛ mee kaŋɛ menyi na fanɛ menyi be kechɛto so nɛ mee yɔ na, ŋkpal manɛ so, nɛ m baa maŋ yɔ, Echɛtopo na maaŋ ba menyi kutɔ. Ama nɛ m baŋ yɔ bre, meeŋ shuŋi mo nɛ e ba menyi kutɔ.

english_verse: The Spirit will come and show the people of this world the truth about sin and God's justice and the judgment.
translation_verse: Mo alɛ kaŋ ba, e beeŋ ŋini durnyaebi kananɛ baa fɛ alubi be asheŋ nɛ Ebɔrɛ be anishito be alelasheŋ be asheŋ nɛ mbe kasogberge be asheŋ. E beeŋ ŋini bumo fanɛ b foe amo be kenyi be ekpa.

english_verse: The Spirit will show them that they are wrong about sin, because they didn't have faith in me.
translation_verse: E beeŋ ŋini bumo fanɛ b foe alubi be kenyi be ekpa, ŋkpal b ka maŋ yirda ma, Yesu Kristo so,

english_verse: They are wrong about God's justice, because I am going to the Father, and you won't see me again.
translation_verse: nseŋ naŋ ŋini bumo fanɛ b foe alelasheŋ be kenyi be ekpa, ŋkpal ŋ ka bee yɔ Etuto na kutɔ nɛ men maaŋ naŋ wu ma so.

english_verse: And they are wrong about the judgment, because God has already judged the ruler of this world.
translation_verse: Mo alɛ beeŋ naŋ ŋini bumo fanɛ b foe kasogberge be kenyi be ekpa, ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ teŋ gboŋi durnya ere to be ejuŋkparpo na ashi mbe kejuŋkpar na to.

english_verse: I have much more to say to you, but right now it would be more than you could understand.
translation_verse: Ŋ kraa kɔ asɔ damta nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ menyi, ama nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ amo naniere, a beeŋ wora keshi n sa menyi.

english_verse: The Spirit shows what is true and will come and guide you into the full truth. The Spirit doesn't speak on his own. He will tell you only what he has heard from me, and he will let you know what is going to happen.
translation_verse: Ama nɛ mo ere, kashenteŋ be Kiyoyu na kaŋ ba, e beeŋ ŋini menyi kashenteŋ be ekpa kikɛ. E maaŋ ta mo gbagba be kumu so be eleŋ m malga, asɔ nɛ e beeŋ nu nawule be asheŋ nɛ e beeŋ malga nseŋ kaŋɛ basa asɔ nɛ a beeŋ ba be asheŋ.

english_verse: The Spirit will bring glory to me by taking my message and telling it to you.
translation_verse: E beeŋ bar ma kemaŋkura, ŋkpal manɛ so, e beeŋ ta asɔ nɛ ŋ kɔ nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ menyi na m malga n sa menyi.

english_verse: Everything the Father has is mine. This is why I have said that the Spirit takes my message and tells it to you. Sorrow Will Turn into Joy
translation_verse: Asɔ nɛ n Tuto na kɔ na kikɛ la meya nna. Amoso nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ Kiyoyu na beeŋ ta asɔ nɛ ŋ kɔ nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ menyi na m malga n sa menyi na. Kagbenewushi nɛ kagbenejija be asheŋ

english_verse: Jesus told his disciples, “For a little while you won't see me, but after a while you will see me.”
translation_verse: “A ka gbrɛbi nɛ men maaŋ naŋ wu ma nɛ a naŋ wora gbrɛbi nɛ men wu ma.”

english_verse: They said to each other, “What does Jesus mean by saying that for a little while we won't see him, but after a while we will see him? What does he mean by saying he is going to the Father?
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ mbe bebɛsopo na be beko fara a bishi abar: “Manɛ bre nɛ e de nsaa malga le be asheŋ ere fanɛ: ‘A ka gbrɛbi nɛ men maaŋ naŋ wu ma nɛ a naŋ wora gbrɛ nɛ men naŋ wu ma’ ere ŋko nɛ manɛ malɛ nɛ e naa de fanɛ: ‘Ŋkpal ŋ ka bee yɔ n Tuto na kutɔ na so’ ere?”

english_verse: What is this ‘little while’ that he is talking about? We don't know what he means.”
translation_verse: B yɛ: “To, a ka gbrɛbi, a ka gbrɛbi ere be kifito bre e baa la nuso? Anyi maŋ nyi kusɔ nɛ e bee malga ere be kifito.”

english_verse: Jesus knew they had some questions, so he said: You are wondering what I meant when I said that for a little while you won't see me, but after a while you will see me.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Yesu pin b ka bee sha kebishi kesheŋ na be kifito nseŋ fara m bishi bumo: “Menyee bishi abar nuso nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ: ‘A ka gbrɛbi nɛ men maaŋ naŋ wu ma nɛ a naŋ wora gbrɛbi nɛ men naŋ wu ma’ na be kifito nna ŋko?

english_verse: I tell you for certain that you will cry and be sad, but the world will be happy. You will be sad, but later you will be happy.
translation_verse: Ma e kaŋɛ menyi kashenteŋto na fanɛ menyi ere beeŋ boŋ to nseŋ shu anishichubi, ama durnya ere to ebi bre be ŋgbene beeŋ fuli bumo. Kashenteŋ nna fanɛ menyi be ŋgbene bee jija menyi, ama menyi be kagbenejija na beeŋ ba ki kagbenefuli.

english_verse: When a woman is about to give birth, she is in great pain. But after it is all over, she forgets the pain and is happy, because she has brought a child into the world.
translation_verse: K du fanɛ eche ka bee sha kekurge nna. Mbe saŋɛ baŋ fo nɛ e luri kakurge be ebesa to, mbe kagbene bee jija mo nna, ama nɛ e baŋ kurge ebi na e bee teŋ mbe ebesa na so nna, ŋkpal manɛ so, mbe kagbene bee fuli mo nna ŋkpal e ka kurge ebi n wɔtɔ durnya ere to so.

english_verse: You are now very sad. But later I will see you, and you will be so happy that no one will be able to change the way you feel.
translation_verse: To, loŋ nɛ k du n sa menyi alɛ gba. Naniere bre, men be ŋgbene jija menyi nna, ama a wora gbrɛ, meeŋ naŋ wu menyi nɛ menyi be ŋgbene e fuli menyi nɛ esa kikɛ malɛ maaŋ tiŋ n lara loŋ be kagbenefuli na ashi menyi to.

english_verse: When that time comes, you won't have to ask me about anything. I tell you for certain the Father will give you whatever you ask for in my name.
translation_verse: Loŋ be saŋɛ na ba fo, men maaŋ naŋ kule ma shɛŋ. Ma e kaŋɛ menyi kashenteŋto na fanɛ n Tuto na beeŋ sa menyi kusɔ kama nɛ men ta ma ketre ŋ kule mo.

english_verse: You have not asked for anything in this way before, but now you must ask in my name. Then it will be given to you, so you will be completely happy.
translation_verse: Hale m ba fo mbre, men maŋ naŋ ta ma ketre ŋ kule shɛŋ. Men kule nseŋ nya nɛ menyi be ŋgbene e fuli menyi m baŋ so.

english_verse: I have used examples to explain to you what I have been talking about. But the time will come when I will speak to you plainly about the Father and will no longer use examples like these.
translation_verse: Kashenteŋto, aŋasa to nɛ m bɔla m malga asheŋ na, ama saŋko bee ba nɛ m maaŋ naŋ ta aŋasa m malga asheŋ n sa menyi, meeŋ bugi asheŋ to filifili ŋ kaŋɛ menyi n Tuto na be asheŋ.

english_verse: You will ask the Father in my name, and I won't have to ask him for you.
translation_verse: Amo be saŋɛ na ba fo, menyeeŋ ta ma ketre ŋ kule Ebɔrɛ. M maa kaŋɛ nna fanɛ ma e naaŋ yili menyi be katelamu to ŋ kule mo n sa menyi.

english_verse: God the Father loves you because you love me, and you believe I have come from him.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, Etuto na gbagba bee sha menyi ŋkpal men ka bee sha ma nseŋ yirda fanɛ n shi Ebɔrɛ na kutɔ na so.

english_verse: I came from the Father into the world, but I am leaving the world and returning to the Father.
translation_verse: N Tuto na kutɔ nɛ n shi m ba durnya ere to, ma alɛ nseŋ naa lar durnya ere to a yɔ Etuto na kutɔ.”

english_verse: The disciples said, “Now you are speaking plainly to us! You are not using examples.
translation_verse: E ka malga le ere n loge nɛ mbe bebɛsopo na kaŋɛ le: “Too, naniere bre fo maŋ naa malga aŋasa to, fee bugi asheŋ to nna filifili a kaŋɛ.

english_verse: At last we know that you understand everything, and we don't have any more questions. Now we believe you truly have come from God.”
translation_verse: Naniere nɛ an pin fanɛ fo nyi kusɔ kikɛ. Amoso, nɛ esa maŋ bishi fo asheŋ nɛ a wɔ mbe kagbene to gba, fo nyi amo. Loŋ malɛ e shin nɛ an yirda fanɛ Ebɔrɛ na kutɔ nɛ fo shi.”

english_verse: Jesus replied: Do you really believe me?
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Yesu bishi bumo: “Naniere bre men yirda nna na ŋko?

english_verse: The time will come and is already here when all of you will be scattered. Each of you will go back home and leave me by myself. But the Father will be with me, and I won't be alone.
translation_verse: Ama men baa nyiŋi fanɛ saŋko beeŋ ba fo, k teŋ fo gba nɛ menyi kikɛ e pesaŋ to nɛ ekama e yɔ mo gbagba pe. Menyeeŋ yige n nawule n to, ama mannɛ n nawule e wɔtɔ, ŋkpal manɛ so, n Tuto wɔ ŋ kutɔ nna.

english_verse: I have told you this, so that you might have peace in your hearts because of me. While you are in the world, you will have to suffer. But cheer up! I have defeated the world.
translation_verse: Ŋ kaŋɛ menyi asheŋ ere nna, saŋɛ na so, menyeeŋ bɔla ma so n nya kagbenewushi. Menyeeŋ nya tɔrɔ durnya ere to, ama men baa kɔ kagbene, ma e pɔɔ durnya ere so.”

english_verse: After Jesus had finished speaking to his disciples, he looked up toward heaven and prayed: Father, the time has come for you to bring glory to your Son, in order that he may bring glory to you.
translation_verse: Yesu ka malga asheŋ ere n loge nɛ e maŋ kumu so ŋ keni ebɔrɛso nseŋ kule Ebɔrɛ ŋ kaŋɛ: “Etuto, saŋɛ na fo. Maŋkura ma, fo Pibinyɛn na nɛ ma, fo Pibinyɛn na malɛ e maŋkura fo.

english_verse: And you gave him power over all people, so he would give eternal life to everyone you give him.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, fo e daŋ sa ma eleŋ dimɛdi kikɛ so fanɛ n sa bekama nɛ fo ta m bɔɔ ma enɔ na kikɛ ŋkpa nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na.

english_verse: Eternal life is to know you, the only true God, and to know Jesus Christ, the one you sent.
translation_verse: Nɛ basa malɛ baa nyi fo, Ebɔrɛ nɛ fo nawule la kashenteŋ be Ebɔrɛ na nseŋ naa nyi ma, Yesu Kristo nɛ fo shuŋi na, kumo ere baaŋ baa kɔ ŋkpa nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na.

english_verse: I have brought glory to you here on earth by doing everything you gave me to do.
translation_verse: M maŋkura fo kasawule ere to, ŋkpal manɛ so, n wora kushuŋ nɛ fo ta m bɔɔ ma enɔ fanɛ n wora na kikɛ.

english_verse: Now, Father, give me back the glory I had with you before the world was created.
translation_verse: To, naniere, n Tuto, ta kemaŋkura nɛ n daa kɔ fo kutɔ pɔɛŋ nɛ durnya jɔŋɛ na m maŋkura ma fo anishito naniere.”

english_verse: You have given me some followers from this world, and I have shown them what you are like. They were yours, but you gave them to me, and they have obeyed you.
translation_verse: N ta fo asheŋ ŋ ŋini basa nɛ fo lara durnya ere to m bɔɔ ma enɔ na. B daa la feya nna nɛ fo ta bumo m bɔɔ ma enɔ nɛ b ta fo kamalga na n wɔtɔ bumo be ŋgbene to.

english_verse: They know that you gave me everything I have.
translation_verse: Naniere b pin fanɛ kusɔ kama nɛ fo sa ma bee shi fo kutɔ nna.

english_verse: I told my followers what you told me, and they accepted it. They know I came from you, and they believe you are the one who sent me.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, n ta mmalga nɛ fo ta n sa ma na n sa bumo nɛ b sɔ. B pin geeŋ fanɛ fo kutɔ nɛ n shi, bumo alɛ nseŋ naŋ yirda fanɛ fo e shuŋi ma.

english_verse: I am praying for them, but not for those who belong to this world. My followers belong to you, and I am praying for them.
translation_verse: Bumo nɛ mee kule a sa na, m maa kule a sa durnya ere to ebi, bumo nɛ fo ta m bɔɔ ma enɔ na nɛ mee kule a sa, ŋkpal manɛ so, b la feya nna.

english_verse: All I have is yours, and all you have is mine, and they will bring glory to me.
translation_verse: Basa kama nɛ ŋ kɔ la feya nna, nɛ ekama nɛ fo alɛ kɔ la meya nna. Bumo alɛ to nɛ mee bɔla a nya kemaŋkura.

english_verse: Holy Father, I am no longer in the world. I am coming to you, but my followers are still in the world. So keep them safe by the power of the name you have given me. Then they will be one with each other, just as you and I are one.
translation_verse: To, naniere mee ba fo kutɔ nna na, a ka gbrɛbi nɛ n lar durnya to, ama bumo ere kraa wɔ durnya to nna. Etuto cheembi, ta fo ketre be eleŋ na a keni bumo so, ketre mo nɛ fo sa ma na nɛ n de na, saŋɛ na so baaŋ baa la kukoŋwule fanɛ kananɛ ma nɛ fo la kukoŋwule na.

english_verse: While I was with them, I kept them safe by the power you have given me. I guarded them, and not one of them was lost, except the one who had to be lost. This happened so that what the Scriptures say would come true.
translation_verse: Ŋ ka daa wɔ bumo kutɔ na fo ketre nɛ fo sa ma na be eleŋ na nɛ n daa ta a keni bumo so nsaa kuŋ bumo ashi kulubi to. Bumo be ekama maŋ foe ekpa she emo nɛ e chɛr a beeŋ foe na, saŋɛ na so abɔrɛsibɛ na be kamalga na beeŋ bɔlɔ.

english_verse: I am on my way to you. But I say these things while I am still in the world, so my followers will have the same complete joy that I do.
translation_verse: Naniere mee ba fo kutɔ nna na, ama ma alɛ kraa wɔ durnya ere to nna nsaa kaŋɛ asheŋ ere kikɛ na, saŋɛ na so baaŋ nya kagbenefuli nɛ mee sa na m baŋ so.

english_verse: I have told them your message. But the people of this world hate them, because they don't belong to this world, just as I don't.
translation_verse: N ta fo kamalga nna n sa bumo nɛ durnya ere e kishi bumo ŋkpal b ka maŋ wɔ durnya ere be basa to na so fanɛ kananɛ m maŋ wɔ durnya ere be basa to na.

english_verse: Father, I don't ask you to take my followers out of the world, but keep them safe from the evil one.
translation_verse: M maa kule fo nna fanɛ fo lara bumo ashi durnya ere to, kusɔ nɛ mee kule fo e la fanɛ fo baa kuŋ bumo ashi alubipo na kutɔ.

english_verse: I am sending them into the world, just as you sent me.
translation_verse: Kananɛ fo shuŋi ma durnya ere to na nɛ ma alɛ gba bee shuŋi a shuŋi bumo kumo to.

english_verse: I have given myself completely for their sake, so they may belong completely to the truth.
translation_verse: Bumo alɛ so mee lara ma kumu nna a yili a sa fo, saŋɛ na so bumo alɛ gba beeŋ lara bumo be amu n yili n sa fo kashenteŋto.

english_verse: I am not praying just for these followers. I am also praying for everyone else who will have faith because of what my followers will say about me.
translation_verse: Mannɛ bede nawule nɛ mee kule fo a sa. Mee kule fo nna a sa bumo nɛ baaŋ ba nu bede ere be kamalga nseŋ yirda ma na gba nna fanɛ

english_verse: I want all of them to be one with each other, just as I am one with you and you are one with me. I also want them to be one with us. Then the people of this world will believe that you sent me.
translation_verse: fo shin nɛ bumo kikɛ e baa la kukoŋwule. Etuto, fanɛ kananɛ n wɔ fo to nɛ fo alɛ wɔ ma to na, loŋ nɛ mee kule fo fanɛ fo shin nɛ b baa wɔ anyi to nɛ durnya e yirda fanɛ fo e shuŋi ma durnya ere to.

english_verse: I have honored my followers in the same way you honored me, in order that they may be one with each other, just as we are one.
translation_verse: N sa bumo kemaŋkura nna fanɛ kananɛ fo sa ma kemaŋkura na nɛ b baa la kukoŋwule fanɛ kananɛ ma nɛ fo la kukoŋwule na.

english_verse: I am one with them, and you are one with me, so they may become completely one. Then this world's people will know that you sent me. They will know that you love my followers as much as you love me.
translation_verse: Nɛ m baa wɔ bumo to nɛ fo alɛ baa wɔ ma to, saŋɛ na so, baaŋ baa la kukoŋwule chap, nɛ durnya ere e pin fanɛ fo e shuŋi ma nseŋ naŋ pin fanɛ kananɛ fee sha ma na nɛ fee sha loŋ be basa na gba.

english_verse: Father, I want everyone you have given me to be with me, wherever I am. Then they will see the glory you have given me, because you loved me before the world was created.
translation_verse: “Etuto, mee sha fanɛ bumo nɛ fo ta m bɔɔ ma enɔ na e ba kaa wɔ kakpa nɛ meeŋ ya kaa wɔ na n tiŋ n wu ma kemaŋkura nɛ fo sa ma ŋkpal fo ka fara a sha ma pɔɛŋ nɛ durnya jɔŋɛ na so.

english_verse: Good Father, the people of this world don't know you. But I know you, and my followers know that you sent me.
translation_verse: Etuto nɛ e la Elelapo, kashenteŋ nna fanɛ durnya ere to ebi maŋ nyi fo, ama ma ere nyi fo nɛ bede malɛ gba nyi fanɛ fo e shuŋi ma.

english_verse: I told them what you are like, and I will tell them even more. Then the love you have for me will become part of them, and I will be one with them.
translation_verse: N ta fo ŋ ŋini bumo, ma alɛ kraa beeŋ baa wora loŋ, saŋɛ na so, kasha nɛ fo kɔ a sa ma na beeŋ baa wɔ bumo to nɛ ma alɛ gba e baa wɔ bumo to.”

english_verse: One of the high priest's servants was there. He was a relative of the servant whose ear Peter had cut off, and he asked, “Didn't I see you in the garden with that man?”
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ bɔrɛmatapo nimuso na be anya na be eko nɛ e daa la kenya mo nɛ Pita daŋ ŋe mbe kusoe n chuge na be esa na bishi Pita le: “Mannɛ fo nɛ kanyɛn na nɛ n wu kupo na to nna a?”

english_verse: Jesus again asked, “Who are you looking for?” “We are looking for Jesus from Nazareth,” they answered.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ e naŋ laŋɛ m bishi bumo: “Wanɛ nɛ menyee fin?” Nɛ b yɛ: “Nazarɛt be Yesu na.”

english_verse: This time Jesus replied, “I have already told you that I am Jesus. If I am the one you are looking for, let these others go.
translation_verse: Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ bumo: “N teŋ kaŋɛ menyi fanɛ ma nna na, ama nɛ ma nɛ men baa fin bre, men shin nɛ bede bre e baa yɔ.”

english_verse: Then everything will happen, just as I said, ‘I did not lose anyone you gave me.’ ”
translation_verse: E daŋ kaŋɛ loŋ nna nɛ mmalga nɛ e daŋ malga saŋko fanɛ: “Etuto, bumo nɛ fo ta m bɔɔ ma enɔ na be ekama maŋ foe ma enɔ to” na e bɔla.

english_verse: Simon Peter had brought along a sword. He pulled it out and struck at Malchus, the servant of the high priest, cutting off his right ear.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Saimɔn Pita nɛ e daa yil ndoŋ a kɔ tokobi to na pe kumo ŋ ŋe bɔrɛmatapo nimuso be kenya ko be jisoso be kusoe n chuge. Kenya na be ketre e daa la Malkes.

translation_verse: Ama Pita bre daŋ shir a yil kabuna to nna ashi kowu. Ndoŋ nna nɛ ebɛsopo nɛ mo nɛ bɔrɛmatapo nimuso na nyi abar na naŋ lar kowu n ya malga kebichebi nɛ e daa yil kabuna to a de so na kutɔ nseŋ keta Pita n luri laŋ na to.

translation_verse: Saŋɛ ere malɛ so nɛ bɔrɛmatapo nimuso na wɔtɔ a bishi Yesu mbe bebɛsopo nɛ mbe keŋini be asheŋ.

translation_verse: B daŋ kraŋ kre Yesu loŋ nna nɛ Anas shin nɛ b yɛr mo bɔrɛmatapo nimuso Kayafas kutɔ. Pita ka naŋ lar Yesu kaman be asheŋ (Matiu

english_verse: It was early in the morning when Jesus was taken from Caiaphas to the building where the Roman governor stayed. But the crowd waited outside. Any of them who had gone inside would have become unclean and would not be allowed to eat the Passover meal.
translation_verse: Juwebi na ka bar Yesu Kayafas pe nɛ b naŋ keta mo n lar ndoŋ n yɔ Romebi be gomena be lambu to. english_verse: Pilate came out and asked, “What charges are you bringing against this man?”
translation_verse: Amoso, Gomena Pailat daŋ lar nna m ba bumo kutɔ m ba bishi bumo le: “Nuso be kulubi nɛ men wu kanyɛn ere so?”

english_verse: They answered, “He is a criminal! That's why we brought him to you.”
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ b kaŋɛ Pailat: “E daa maŋ la alubiworapo nna, an daa maaŋ ta mo m ba bɔɔ fo enɔ.”

english_verse: Pilate then went back inside. He called Jesus over and asked, “Are you the king of the Jews?”
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Pailat naŋ bɛta n luri mbe lambu to nseŋ tre Yesu n ya bishi mo le: “Fo e la Juwebi be Ewura na a?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Are you asking this on your own or did someone tell you about me?”
translation_verse: Nɛ Yesu bishi mo: “Fo gbagba be nfɛra to nɛ kesheŋ ere shi ŋko basa ko e malga ma asheŋ ŋ ŋini fo?”

english_verse: “You know I'm not a Jew!” Pilate said. “Your own people and the chief priests brought you to me. What have you done?”
translation_verse: Nɛ Pailat bishi mo: “N la Juw nna a? Fo gbagba be basa nɛ fo bɔrɛmatapowuraana e ta fo m bɔɔ ma enɔ. Manɛ nɛ fo wora?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “My kingdom doesn't belong to this world. If it did, my followers would have fought to keep me from being handed over to our leaders. No, my kingdom doesn't belong to this world.”
translation_verse: Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ mo le: “Ma kuwurji maŋ la durnya ere to peya. Nɛ k daa la durnya ere to peya nna, ma anya daa beeŋ kɔ n sɔ ma ashi Juwebi ere be enɔ to, ama ma kuwura na malɛ shi kaboŋ pɔtɛ nna.”

english_verse: “So you are a king,” Pilate replied. “You are saying that I am a king,” Jesus told him. “I was born into this world to tell about the truth. And everyone who belongs to the truth knows my voice.”
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Pailat bishi mo: “Kumo ere, ewura e la fo nna ŋko?” Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ mo: “Kumo nɛ fo baa kaŋɛ na. Kesheŋ nɛ mee sha kekaŋɛ ere so nɛ b kurge ma. Kumo koŋwule na malɛ so nɛ m ba durnya ere to fanɛ m ba malga kashenteŋ na be asheŋ. Esa kama malɛ nɛ e wɔ kashenteŋ na to bee nu nna a sa ma.”

english_verse: Pilate asked Jesus, “What is truth?” Jesus Is Sentenced to Death (Matthew
translation_verse: Nɛ Pailat bishi mo: “Manɛ e la kashenteŋ?” B ka yɛ Yesu daga luwu be asheŋ (Matiu

english_verse: And since I usually set a prisoner free for you at Passover, would you like for me to set free the king of the Jews?”
translation_verse: Ama menyi be daŋkare ko bee ŋini fanɛ a daga fanɛ Kebansonchoŋ be kejigboŋ be jemanɛ kikɛ to n lara menyi be keparso be esa ashi kabuti to n sa menyi. Amoso, menyee sha fanɛ n yige Juwebi be ewura na n sa menyi a?”

english_verse: Pilate gave orders for Jesus to be beaten with a whip.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Pailat ta Yesu n shin nɛ b kuya mo so.

english_verse: The soldiers made a crown out of thorn branches and put it on Jesus. Then they put a purple robe on him.
translation_verse: Nɛ esoji na ta ewidibi be ayabi n wora kuwurwuro m buu mbe kumu so. Kumo be kaman nɛ b ta kusɔbuuso peper kunɔkunɔ ko m buu mo

english_verse: They came up to him and said, “Hey, you king of the Jews!” They also hit him with their fists.
translation_verse: nsaa yɔ a yɔ mo kutɔ n ya kaa kaŋɛ mo le: “Ebɔrɛ e sa Juwebi be Ewura na ŋkpa tenteŋ,” nseŋ kpa ŋ kpa mo etaŋ.

english_verse: Once again Pilate went out. This time he said, “I will have Jesus brought out to you again. Then you can see for yourselves that I have not found him guilty.”
translation_verse: Ade kikɛ be kaman nɛ Pailat naŋ lar ŋ kaŋɛ Juwebi na le: “Men keni, meeŋ ta mo m bar menyi nɛ men pin fanɛ ma ere maŋ wu kusɔ lubi kikɛ mo so nɛ k daga mbe kasogberge.”

english_verse: Jesus came out, wearing the crown of thorns and the purple robe. Pilate said, “Here is the man!”
translation_verse: Yesu ka buu kuwurwuro na nɛ kusɔbuuso peper kunɔkunɔ na m ba lar nɛ Pailat kaŋɛ basa na le: “To, mo nde!”

english_verse: When the chief priests and the temple police saw him, they yelled, “Nail him to a cross! Nail him to a cross!” Pilate told them, “You take him and nail him to a cross! I don't find him guilty of anything.”
translation_verse: Bɔrɛmatapowuraana na nɛ bumo be bekumpo na ka baŋ wu mo nɛ b ponte ŋ kaŋɛ: “Gbir mo m mata kedibi largato so, gbir mo m mata kedibi largato so!” Ndoŋ nna nɛ Pailat kaŋɛ bumo: “Men gbagba e keta mo n ya gbir m mata kedibi largato so, ŋkpal manɛ so, ma ere maŋ wu kulubi mo so nɛ esa beeŋ kpal kumo so ŋ gberge mo kusoe.”

english_verse: The crowd replied, “He claimed to be the Son of God! Our law says that he must be put to death.”
translation_verse: Nɛ Juwebi na naŋ kaŋɛ mo: “An kɔ mbra ko nɛ k bee ŋini fanɛ a daga kanyɛn ere ka wu ŋkpal e ka bee tre mbe kumu Ebɔrɛ Pibinyɛn so.”

english_verse: When Pilate heard this, he was terrified.
translation_verse: Pailat ka nu loŋ na nɛ kufu naŋ pɛ mo n ti so.

english_verse: He went back inside and asked Jesus, “Where are you from?” But Jesus did not answer.
translation_verse: Nɛ e naŋ bɛta n luri mbe lambu to n ya bishi Yesu: “Nnɛ nɛ fo shi?” Ama Yesu daa maŋ tuge mo.

english_verse: “Why won't you answer my question?” Pilate asked. “Don't you know I have the power to let you go free or to nail you to a cross?”
translation_verse: Nɛ Pailat bishi mo: “Fo la ma to nna a? Fo maŋ nyi fanɛ ŋ kɔ eleŋ nɛ n tiŋ n shin nɛ b gbir fo m mata kedibi largato so ŋko?”

english_verse: Jesus replied, “If God had not given you the power, you couldn't do anything at all to me. But the one who handed me over to you did something even worse.”
translation_verse: Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ mo le: “Nɛ Ebɔrɛ daa maŋ sa fo eleŋ ma so nna, fo daa maaŋ baa kɔ eleŋ ma so. Esa nɛ e ta ma m bɔɔ fo enɔ ere malɛ be kulubi e shi a chɔ feya.”

english_verse: Then Pilate wanted to set Jesus free. But the crowd again yelled, “If you set this man free, you are no friend of the Emperor! Anyone who claims to be a king is an enemy of the Emperor.”
translation_verse: Pailat ka nu kesheŋ na nɛ e wora ania nɛ e shin nɛ Yesu e nya mbe kumu a yɔ, ama Juwebi na daa maŋ shuli nsaa ponte a kaŋɛ le: “Fo baŋ shin nɛ kanyɛn ere nya mbe kumu n yɔ jiga, kumo ere mannɛ fo teri e la Ewurgboŋ Siza, ŋkpal manɛ so, esa kama nɛ e bee tre mbe kumu ewura bee kɔ Ewurgboŋ Siza be eleŋ nna na.”

english_verse: When Pilate heard this, he brought Jesus out. Then he sat down on the judge's bench at the place known as “The Stone Pavement.” In Aramaic this pavement is called “Gabbatha.”
translation_verse: Pailat ka nu loŋ na nɛ e keta Yesu n lar lambu na to m ba kelɔnɛ so m ba chena demujipowura be echenakpa nɛ baa tre Demuji be Guŋgɔni na. Juwebi be ŋgbar to baa tre kumo Gabata.

english_verse: It was about noon on the day before Passover, and Pilate said to the crowd, “Look at your king!”
translation_verse: Kebansonchoŋ be Kebelaseachɛ e daa la nɛ kumo be saŋɛ malɛ daa la kapiidi. Amo be saŋɛ na nɛ Pailat kaŋɛ Juwebi na: “Menyi be ewura nde.”

english_verse: Then Pilate handed Jesus over to be nailed to a cross. Jesus Is Nailed to a Cross (Matthew
translation_verse: Ade kikɛ be kaman nɛ Pailat ta mo m bɔɔ bumo enɔ fanɛ b ya gbir mo m mata kedibi largato so. B ka gbir Yesu m mata kedibi largato so be asheŋ (Matiu

english_verse: So the chief priests went to Pilate and said, “Why did you write that he is King of the Jews? You should have written, ‘He claimed to be King of the Jews.’ ”
translation_verse: Bɔrɛmatapowuraana na ka wu kasibɛ na loŋ na nɛ b ya kaŋɛ Pailat: “Sa maŋ shin nɛ b sibɛ fanɛ Juwebi be Ewura, shin nɛ b sibɛ fanɛ kanyɛn ere kaŋɛ fanɛ mo e la Juwebi be Ewura na.”

english_verse: When Jesus saw his mother and his favorite disciple with her, he said to his mother, “This man is now your son.”
translation_verse: Yesu ka wu mo nio ndoŋ nseŋ naŋ wu ebɛsopo nɛ e daa sha ga na gba ka yil n taga to ndoŋ nɛ e kaŋɛ mo nio le: “Kache manɛ, keni fo pibi nde.”

english_verse: Pilate ordered the charge against Jesus to be written on a board and put above the cross. It read, “Jesus of Nazareth, King of the Jews.”
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Pailat shin nɛ b sibɛ kasibɛ ŋ gbir m mata mbe kedibi largato na so a kaŋɛ le: “NAZARƐT BE YESU NƐ E LA JUWEBI BE EWURA NA NDE.”

english_verse: The words were written in Hebrew, Latin, and Greek. The place where Jesus was taken wasn't far from the city, and many of the people read the charge against him.
translation_verse: Juwebi na be bedamta daŋ kraŋ kasibɛ na, ŋkpal manɛ so, kakpa nɛ b daŋ gbir Yesu m mata kedibi largato so na daŋ mata kade to nna, kumo be kaman b daŋ sibɛ kesheŋ na Juwebi be ŋgbar to nɛ Romebi be ŋgbar to nɛ Griikebi be ŋgbar to nna.

english_verse: But Pilate told them, “What is written will not be changed!”
translation_verse: Nɛ Pailat kaŋɛ bumo: “Kusɔ nɛ n shin nɛ b sibɛ nɛ b sibɛ na.”

english_verse: The soldiers said to each other, “Let's not rip it apart. We will gamble to see who gets it.” This happened so the Scriptures would come true, which say, “They divided up my clothes and gambled for my garments.” The soldiers then did what they had decided.
translation_verse: Esoja na ka ta kumo nɛ b kaŋɛ abar le: “Men sa maŋ shin nɛ an kpɛa kumo to. Men shin nɛ an to beri ŋ keni emo nɛ e beeŋ nya kumo.” B daŋ wora loŋ nna nɛ kusɔ nɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ fanɛ: “B daŋ barga ma asɔbuuso to nna n sa abar nseŋ to beri a fin ma piŋi” na e bɔla. Amoso, kusɔ nɛ esoji na daŋ wora nna na.

english_verse: Jesus' mother stood beside his cross with her sister and Mary the wife of Clopas. Mary Magdalene was standing there too.
translation_verse: Yesu mo nio nɛ mo niokar nɛ Mɛɛri nɛ e daa la Kliopas be eche na nɛ Mɛɛri Magdalin daŋ ba yili nna n taga kedibi largato na to.

english_verse: But when they came to Jesus, they saw he was already dead, and they did not break his legs.
translation_verse: Ama b ka ba Yesu kutɔ nɛ e teŋ wu, amoso, b daa maŋ buri mo ere be aya.

english_verse: In the place where Jesus had been nailed to a cross, there was a garden with a tomb that had never been used.
translation_verse: Kudɔbi ko daa wɔ kakpa nɛ b daŋ gbir Yesu m mata kedibi largato so na nɛ kebeelaŋ be nchaŋ popɔr ko nɛ b daa maŋ naŋ ta ebuni kama n nase to malɛ daa wɔ kudɔbi na to.

english_verse: Jesus knew that he had now finished his work. And in order to make the Scriptures come true, he said, “I am thirsty!”
translation_verse: Asheŋ ere kikɛ ka wora n choŋ nɛ Yesu pin loŋ nsaa sha fanɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na e bɔlɔ so nɛ e kaŋɛ le: “Achukoŋ kɔ ma.”

english_verse: A jar of cheap wine was there. Someone then soaked a sponge with the wine and held it up to Jesus' mouth on the stem of a hyssop plant.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ b ta kiche m pɔlɔ nsa nyannyanso ko ka daa wɔ kusɔ to a yil ndoŋ to nseŋ ta hisɔp be kedibi m maŋ kiche na so n yɔ Yesu be kɔnɔ ase.

english_verse: kilograms of spices made from myrrh and aloes. This was the same Nicodemus who had visited Jesus one night.
translation_verse: Yesu ka pipe nsa nyannyanso na nɛ e kaŋɛ: “Asheŋ loge.” E ka kaŋɛ le ere n loge nɛ e kur mbe kumu n yuu nseŋ wu.

english_verse: The next day would be both a Sabbath and the Passover. It was a special day for the Jewish people, and they did not want the bodies to stay on the crosses during this day. So they asked Pilate to break the men's legs and take their bodies down.
translation_verse: Kumo be kachɛ na daa la Kebelaseachɛ nna nɛ kumo be ŋklade malɛ daa la Kewushiachɛgboŋ ko. Ŋkpal Juwebi na malɛ ka daa maa sha basa nɛ b daŋ gbir m mata ndibi na so be eyurana na ka shir a wɔ ndibi largatoana na so ŋkpal kewushiachɛ na so, b daŋ ya kaŋɛ Pailat nna fanɛ e shin nɛ b buri m buri basa na be aya nseŋ lara n lara bumo be eyurana na ndibi largatoana na so.

english_verse: One of the soldiers stuck his spear into Jesus' side, and blood and water came out.
translation_verse: Esoja na be ekoŋwule nawule e daŋ baŋ ta kekpa n da Yesu be kekel so n futi, nɛ ŋklaŋ nɛ nchu kleŋklembi ko lar epul na to.

english_verse: We know this is true, because it was told by someone who saw it happen. Now you can have faith too.
translation_verse: Esa nɛ e daŋ wu kesheŋ na e malga kumo be asheŋ, saŋɛ na so menyi alɛ gba beeŋ yirda. Kusɔ nɛ e malga na la kashenteŋ nna. Nɛ mo alɛ gba nyi e ka bee ji kashenteŋ.

english_verse: All this happened so that the Scriptures would come true, which say, “No bone of his body will be broken”
translation_verse: B ka daa maŋ buri Yesu be aya na daŋ wora loŋ nna nɛ abɔrɛsibɛ nɛ a bee kaŋɛ fanɛ: “Mbe kuwibi kama maaŋ bu to” na e bɔlɔ so.

english_verse: and “They will see the one in whose side they stuck a spear.” Jesus Is Buried (Matthew
translation_verse: Abɔrɛsibɛ na to be kaboŋ ko gba bee kaŋɛ fanɛ: “Baaŋ keni emo nɛ b ta kusɔ n da na.” Yesu be kepuli be asheŋ (Matiu

english_verse: The tomb was nearby, and since it was the time to prepare for the Sabbath, they were in a hurry to put Jesus' body there.
translation_verse: Amoso, ŋkpal kumo be kachɛ na ka daa la Juwebi be Kebelaseachɛ nɛ ŋkpal nchaŋ na ka taga to na so, b daŋ ta Yesu nna n nase kumo to.

english_verse: Joseph from Arimathea was one of Jesus' disciples. He had kept it secret though, because he was afraid of the Jewish leaders. But now he asked Pilate to let him have Jesus' body. Pilate gave him permission, and Joseph took it down from the cross.
translation_verse: Ade be kaman nɛ Josɛf nɛ e daŋ shi Arimatiya na ba kule Pailat fanɛ e shin nɛ e lara Yesu be kebuni na. Josɛf ere daa la Yesu be ebɛsopo na, ama wulo to nɛ e daa bɛ mo so, ŋkpal manɛ so, e daa ŋana Juwebi be benimuana na nna. Ndoŋ nna nɛ Pailat sa ekpa fanɛ e ya ta Yesu be eyur na nɛ e yɔ n ya ta kumo.

english_verse: The two men wrapped the body in a linen cloth, together with the spices, which was how the Jewish people buried their dead.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ bumo, basa anyɔ na ta etulale na n wɔtɔ kesaŋɛ lela ko to nseŋ ta kumo m mea Yesu be eyur na, ŋkpal manɛ so, loŋ nɛ Juwebi bee wora bubuni a puli.

english_verse: Thomas replied, “You are my Lord and my God!”
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Tɔmas kaŋɛ Yesu le: “N Nyɛnpe nɛ ma Ebɔrɛ!”

english_verse: On Sunday morning while it was still dark, Mary Magdalene went to the tomb and saw that the stone had been rolled away from the entrance.
translation_verse: Kewushiachɛ na ka ji ŋ klade Alediachɛ kare ka maŋ naŋ chɛ n loge nɛnɛ nɛ Mɛɛri Magdalin yɔ nchaŋ na akpa n ya wu fanɛ kejembu nɛ b daŋ ta ŋ kuŋ nchaŋ na be kɔnɔ so na maŋ naŋ kuŋ kɔnɔ na so.

english_verse: The disciple who got there first then went into the tomb, and when he saw it, he believed.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ ebɛsopo mo nɛ e daŋ juŋkpar n fo nchaŋ na akpa na malɛ gba luri to n ya wu asɔ na nseŋ yirda.

english_verse: Although Thomas the Twin was one of the twelve disciples, he wasn't with the others when Jesus appeared to them.
translation_verse: Yesu ka daŋ ba bebɛsopo na kutɔ na nɛ Tɔmas, bumo kuduanyɔ na to be emo nɛ baa tre Kaborobi na bre maŋ wɔtɔ.

english_verse: and saw two angels inside. They were dressed in white and were sitting where Jesus' body had been. One was at the head and the other was at the foot.
translation_verse: n wu emalaika anyɔ ka buu asɔ fuful a tase kakpa nɛ Yesu be kebuni na daa dese na. Eko daa tase kakpa nɛ Yesu be kumu ase daa wɔ na nɛ eko malɛ tase aya ase.

english_verse: She ran to Simon Peter and to Jesus' favorite disciple and said, “They have taken the Lord from the tomb! We don't know where they have put him.”
translation_verse: E ka wu loŋ na nɛ e kilgi n shile m ba Saimɔn Pita nɛ ebɛsopo nɛ Yesu daa sha na kutɔ m ba kaŋɛ bumo le: “B ta Enyɛnpe ashi nchaŋ na to, anyi alɛ maŋ nyi kakpa nɛ b ta mo n wɔtɔ.”

english_verse: Peter and the other disciple started for the tomb.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Pita nɛ ebɛsopo mo na pɛ nchaŋ na akpa be ekpa.

english_verse: They ran side by side, until the other disciple ran faster than Peter and got there first.
translation_verse: Bumo benyɔ na kikɛ daa shile nna, ama ebɛsopo mo na daŋ shile nna n sɔ kejuŋkpar n ya fo ndoŋ pɔɛŋ nɛ Pita fo.

english_verse: He bent over and saw the strips of linen cloth lying inside the tomb, but he did not go in.
translation_verse: Ama e daa maŋ luri nchaŋ na to, e daŋ murgi nawule nna ŋ keni to n wu kesaŋɛ na ka dese.

english_verse: When Simon Peter got there, he went into the tomb and saw the strips of cloth.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Saimɔn Pita nɛ e daa wɔ kaman na ba m ba luri nchaŋ na to.

english_verse: He also saw the piece of cloth that had been used to cover Jesus' face. It was rolled up and in a place by itself.
translation_verse: Mo alɛ gba daŋ wu kesaŋɛ na ka dese ndoŋ nseŋ naŋ wu kumo nɛ b daŋ ta m mea Yesu be kumu na gba ka dese. K daa maŋ dese m mata kesaŋɛ mo na nseŋ daŋ bɔɔ to a dese kumo nawule.

english_verse: The angels asked Mary, “Why are you crying?” She answered, “They have taken away my Lord's body! I don't know where they have put him.”
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ b bishi Mɛɛri le: “Kache manɛ, manɛ e ba nɛ fee shu?” Nɛ e kaŋɛ bumo: “B ta n Nyɛnpe nna, ma alɛ maŋ nyi kakpa nɛ b ta mo n wɔtɔ.”

english_verse: Jesus asked her, “Why are you crying? Who are you looking for?” She thought he was the gardener and said, “Sir, if you have taken his body away, please tell me, so I can go and get him.”
translation_verse: Nɛ Yesu bishi mo: “Kache manɛ, manɛ e ba nɛ fee shu, wanɛ nɛ fee fin?” Mɛɛri daa nyi fanɛ kudɔbi na be ekenipo nna nɛ e kaŋɛ: “Ebunyampo, jande, nɛ fo ta mo nna, fo ŋini ma kakpa nɛ fo ta mo n nase.”

english_verse: Jesus told her, “Don't hold on to me! I have not yet gone to the Father. But tell my disciples I am going to the one who is my Father and my God, as well as your Father and your God.”
translation_verse: Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ mo: “Sa maŋ pɛ ma to, ŋkpal manɛ so, m maŋ naŋ bɛta n yɔ esoso Etuto na kutɔ. Ama yɔ n niopibiana na kutɔ n ya kaŋɛ bumo fanɛ mee bɛta nna a yɔ esoso n Tuto nɛ men Tuto nɛ ma Ebɔrɛ nɛ menyi be Ebɔrɛ kutɔ.”

english_verse: and showed them his hands and his side. When the disciples saw the Lord, they became very happy.
translation_verse: E ka malga loŋ n loge nɛ e ta mbe enɔana nɛ mbe kekel ŋ ŋini bumo amo be amaŋana na. Bebɛsopo na ka wu Enyɛnpe na nɛ bumo be ŋgbene fuli bumo ga.

english_verse: The disciples were afraid of the Jewish leaders, and on the evening of that same Sunday they locked themselves in a room. Suddenly, Jesus appeared in the middle of the group. He greeted them
translation_verse: Alediachɛ na be kaaseso nɛ bebɛsopo na kikɛ shɛr kaboŋ koŋwule nseŋ ti mbuna ŋkpal b ka daa ŋana Juwebi be benimuana na so so, nɛ Yesu ba yili bumo to nseŋ kaŋɛ bumo le: “Kagbenewushi e baa wɔ menyi to.”

english_verse: After Jesus had greeted them again, he said, “I am sending you, just as the Father has sent me.”
translation_verse: Nɛ Yesu naŋ kaŋɛ bumo: “Kagbenewushi e baa wɔ menyi to. Kananɛ Etuto na shuŋi ma na nɛ ma alɛ gba bee shuŋi menyi na.”

english_verse: Then he breathed on them and said, “Receive the Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Kede be kaman nɛ e gberge afu n wɔtɔ bumo so nseŋ kaŋɛ le: “Men sɔ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na.”

english_verse: If you forgive anyone's sins, they will be forgiven. But if you don't forgive their sins, they will not be forgiven.” Jesus and Thomas
translation_verse: Kede be kaman nɛ e naŋ kaŋɛ bumo le: “Bekama nɛ men ta bumo be alubi m paŋ beeŋ nya amo be ketampaŋ nɛ bekama malɛ nɛ men maŋ ta m paŋ, maaŋ nya ketampaŋ.” Yesu nɛ Tɔmas be asheŋ

english_verse: So they told him, “We have seen the Lord!” But Thomas said, “First, I must see the nail scars in his hands and touch them with my finger. I must put my hand where the spear went into his side. I won't believe unless I do this!”
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ bebɛsopo na kaŋɛ mo fanɛ b wu Enyɛnpe na nɛ e kaŋɛ bumo le: “M ba maŋ wu anyembi na be amaŋ na mbe enɔana to nseŋ ta ma keshilbi n wɔtɔ kakpa nɛ anyembi na daŋ luri na nseŋ naŋ ta ma enɔ n wɔtɔ mbe kekel na to ŋ keni, m maaŋ yirda kesheŋ ere.”

english_verse: A week later the disciples were together again. This time, Thomas was with them. Jesus came in while the doors were still locked and stood in the middle of the group. He greeted his disciples
translation_verse: Kumo be bɔkwe be kaman nɛ mbe bebɛsopo na naŋ shɛr a wɔ ebu to nɛ Tɔmas gba wɔ bumo to kamɔnchɛ. B daŋ ber mbuna na kikɛ so nna, ama Yesu daŋ ba yili bumo to nna nseŋ kaŋɛ bumo le: “Kagbenewushi e baa wɔ menyi to.”

english_verse: and said to Thomas, “Put your finger here and look at my hands! Put your hand into my side. Stop doubting and have faith!”
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ e kaŋɛ Tɔmas le: “Tɔmas, ta fo keshilbi n wɔtɔ ma nfe, keni ma enɔana so. Teŋi fo enɔ to n ta n wɔtɔ ma kekel to ŋ keni. Yirda nsaa maa wora shikashika.”

english_verse: Jesus said, “Thomas, do you have faith because you have seen me? The people who have faith in me without seeing me are the ones who are really blessed!” Why John Wrote His Book
translation_verse: Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ mo: “Fo ka wu ma so nɛ fo yirda na, ama nɛfa la bekama nɛ b maŋ wu nseŋ yirda na peya nna.”

english_verse: Jesus worked many other miracles for his disciples, and not all of them are written in this book.
translation_verse: Yesu daŋ wora emamachisheŋ damta mbe bebɛsopoana na be anishito nɛ b maŋ sibɛ amo n wɔtɔ kawɔl ere to.

english_verse: But these are written so that you will put your faith in Jesus as the Messiah and the Son of God. If you have faith in him, you will have true life.
translation_verse: Ama b sibɛ ade ere nna nɛ men yirda fanɛ Yesu e la Mesaya na, Ebɔrɛ Pibinyɛn na, nɛ menyi alɛ yirda loŋ, men beeŋ nya ŋkpa ashi mbe ketre na to.

english_verse: Simon Peter, Thomas the Twin, Nathanael from Cana in Galilee, and the brothers James and John, were there, together with two other disciples.
translation_verse: Kachako Saimɔn Pita nɛ Tɔmas, emo nɛ baa tre Kaborobi na, nɛ Nataniɛl nɛ e shi Keena nɛ k wɔ Galili na nɛ Zɛbedi be mbia anyɔ na nɛ bebɛsopo anyɔ ko daa la.
