english_verse: Simon Peter said, “I'm going fishing!” The others said, “We will go with you.” They went out in their boat. But they didn't catch a thing that night.
translation_verse: Nɛ Saimɔn Pita kaŋɛ bumo le: “Ma ere bee yɔ ekɔrɔtɔ be kepɛ to nna.” Nɛ bumo nɛ b ka na malɛ kaŋɛ mo: “Anyeeŋ tu fo n yɔ.” Ndoŋ nna nɛ bumo kikɛ lar n ya luri ekuloŋ to, ama kumo be kamɔnchɛ be kanyɛso na b daa maŋ nya shɛŋ m pɛ.

english_verse: Early the next morning Jesus stood on the shore, but the disciples did not realize who he was.
translation_verse: Kare ka chɛ nɛ Yesu ba kaa yil eboŋ na be ekarso, ama bebɛsopo na daa maŋ pin fanɛ Yesu e daa la.

english_verse: So he told them, “Let your net down on the right side of your boat, and you will catch some fish.” They did, and the net was so full of fish that they could not drag it up into the boat.
translation_verse: Nɛ e kaŋɛ bumo: “Men lɛ menyi be keshewu na n wɔtɔ ekuloŋ na be jisoso, menyeeŋ nya ako m pɛ.” Ndoŋ nna nɛ b lɛ keshewu na n wɔtɔ ndoŋ a maŋ tiŋ nɛ b gberge keshewu na n wɔtɔ ekuloŋ na to ŋkpal ekɔrɔtɔ damta nɛ b daŋ pɛ na so.

english_verse: Jesus' favorite disciple told Peter, “It's the Lord!” When Simon heard it was the Lord, he put on the clothes he had taken off while he was working. Then he jumped into the water.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ ebɛsopo nɛ Yesu daa sha na kaŋɛ Pita: “Enyɛnpe nna.” Saimɔn Pita ka baŋ nu fanɛ Enyɛnpe nna nɛ e ta mbe kusɔbuuso m mea to, ŋkpal manɛ so, e daŋ lara kumo nna n nase nseŋ tɛ n luri nchu na to.

english_verse: When the disciples got out of the boat, they saw some bread and a charcoal fire with fish on it.
translation_verse: B ka ya fo kedeŋi so nɛ b wu ajanwulɛ ndoŋ nɛ kɔrɔtɔ deŋ amo so nɛ bodobodo malɛ dese.

english_verse: Jesus told his disciples, “Bring some of the fish you just caught.”
translation_verse: Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ bumo: “Men ta ekɔrɔtɔ nɛ men pɛ naniere na be ako m ba.”

english_verse: Jesus said, “Come and eat!” But none of the disciples dared ask who he was. They knew he was the Lord.
translation_verse: Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ bumo: “Men ba ber kɔnɔ.” Saŋɛ ere so kikɛ nɛ bebɛsopo na be ekama maŋ tiŋ n nya kagbene m bishi mo: “Wanɛ e la fo?” Ŋkpal manɛ so, b daa nyi Enyɛnpe ka la.

english_verse: Jesus took the bread in his hands and gave some of it to his disciples. He did the same with the fish.
translation_verse: Nɛ Yesu ya ta bodobodo na n sa bumo nseŋ ta kɔrɔtɔ na malɛ gba n wora loŋ gbagba.

english_verse: This was the third time Jesus appeared to his disciples after he was raised from death. Jesus and Peter
translation_verse: Yesu ka daŋ tiŋi ashi luwu to nseŋ ta mbe kumu ŋ ŋini mbe bebɛsopo na, kede e daa la mbe kela sasopo. Yesu nɛ Pita be asheŋ

english_verse: When Jesus and his disciples had finished eating, he asked, “Simon son of John, do you love me more than the others do?” Simon Peter answered, “Yes, Lord, you know I do!” “Then feed my lambs,” Jesus said.
translation_verse: B ka ji n loge nɛ Yesu bishi Saimɔn Pita le: “Saimɔn, Jɔn pibinyɛn, fee sha ma kashenteŋto a chɔ bede ere a?” Nɛ Pita kaŋɛ mo: “Mm Enyɛnpe, fo nyi ŋ ka bee sha fo.” Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ mo: “Baa keni ma mbolpɔbi so.”

english_verse: Jesus asked a second time, “Simon son of John, do you love me?” Peter answered, “Yes, Lord, you know I love you!” “Then take care of my sheep,” Jesus told him.
translation_verse: Nɛ Yesu naŋ bishi mo kela nyɔsopo: “Saimɔn, Jɔn pibinyɛn, fee sha ma kashenteŋto a?” Nɛ Pita naŋ shuli ŋ kaŋɛ: “Mm Enyɛnpe, fo nyi ŋ ka bee sha fo.” Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ mo: “Baa keni ma mbolpɔ so.”

english_verse: Jesus asked a third time, “Simon son of John, do you love me?” Peter was hurt because Jesus had asked him three times if he loved him. So he told Jesus, “Lord, you know everything. You know I love you.” Jesus replied, “Feed my sheep.
translation_verse: Kela sasopo nɛ Yesu naŋ bishi Pita: “Saimɔn, Jɔn pibinyɛn fee sha ma a?” Ndoŋ nna nɛ Pita be kagbene jija mo, ŋkpal Yesu ka bishi kela sasopo fanɛ: “Fee sha ma?” Amoso, le nɛ e daŋ kaŋɛ Yesu: “Enyɛnpe, fo nyi kusɔ kama, fo nyi ŋ ka bee sha fo.” Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ mo: “Baa keni ma mbolpɔ so.”

english_verse: I tell you for certain that when you were a young man, you dressed yourself and went wherever you wanted to go. But when you are old, you will hold out your hands. Then others will wrap your belt around you and lead you where you don't want to go.”
translation_verse: Kede be kaman nɛ e naŋ kaŋɛ mo le: “Kashenteŋ nɛ mee kaŋɛ fo na fanɛ fo ka daa la kabrantiɛbia na, fo gbagba e daa kre so a yɔ kaplɛkama nɛ fo daa sha, ama nɛ fo ba bel, feeŋ teŋi fo enɔana to nɛ esa pɔtɛ e kre fo to n yɛr fo kakpa nɛ fo maa sha keyɔ.”

english_verse: Jesus said this to tell how Peter would die and bring honor to God. Then he said to Peter, “Follow me!” Jesus and His Favorite Disciple
translation_verse: Yesu daŋ kaŋɛ le nna a ŋini luwu mo nɛ Pita daa beeŋ wu m maŋkura Ebɔrɛ na. Kumo be kaman nɛ e kaŋɛ Pita: “Bɛ ma so.”

english_verse: Peter turned and saw Jesus' favorite disciple following them. He was the same one who had sat next to Jesus at the meal and had asked, “Lord, who is going to betray you?”
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Pita gbɛ ŋ keni kaman nɛ ebɛsopo mo nɛ Yesu bee sha na e bɛ bumo so. Ebɛsopo ere e la emo nɛ e daŋ dese m mata Yesu ejikpa nseŋ daŋ bishi Yesu fanɛ: “Enyɛnpe, wanɛ e naa shin nɛ e debɔr fo?”

english_verse: When Peter saw this disciple, he asked Jesus, “Lord, what about him?”
translation_verse: Pita ka wu mo na nɛ e bishi Yesu le: “Enyɛnpe nɛ ede malɛ?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “What is it to you, if I want him to live until I return? You must follow me.”
translation_verse: Nɛ Yesu bishi Pita: “Nɛ mee sha fanɛ e baa wɔ ŋkpa to hale nɛ n ya ba bre, k nya fo nnɛ nna? Fo ere e bɛ ma so de!”

english_verse: So the rumor spread among the other disciples that this disciple would not die. But Jesus did not say he would not die. He simply said, “What is it to you, if I want him to live until I return?”
translation_verse: Ŋkpal le so, k daŋ sɔ Yesu be bebɛsopo na kikɛ to nna fanɛ ebɛsopo mo na bre maaŋ wu. Ama mannɛ aloŋ malɛ nɛ Yesu daŋ kaŋɛ. E daŋ kaŋɛ nna fanɛ: “Nɛ mee sha fanɛ e baa wɔ ŋkpa to hale nɛ n ya ba bre, k nya fo nnɛ nna?”

english_verse: This disciple is the one who told all of this. He wrote it, and we know he is telling the truth.
translation_verse: Amo be ebɛsopo na e malga asheŋ ere, mo alɛ nseŋ naŋ sibɛ amo n nase na. Anyi alɛ nyi mbe shɛda na ka la kashenteŋ.

english_verse: Jesus did many other things. If they were all written in books, I don't suppose there would be room enough in the whole world for all the books.
translation_verse: Yesu daŋ wora asheŋ damta ko gba n ti so, nɛ b daŋ sibɛ amo be kekama nna n nase, mee tama fanɛ durnya kikɛ gba daa maaŋ tiŋ n nya kakpa n sɔ loŋ be nwɔl na.

english_verse: until he was taken up to heaven. But before he was taken up, he gave orders to the apostles he had chosen with the help of the Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Ama pɔɛŋ nɛ Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ e yɔ ebɔrɛso na, Yesu daŋ bɔla Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na so nna ŋ ŋini basa nɛ e daŋ lara nɛ b baa la mbe beshuŋipo na ŋ kaŋɛ bumo asɔ nɛ a daga fanɛ b baa wora.

english_verse: While he was still with them, he said: Don't leave Jerusalem yet. Wait here for the Father to give you the Holy Spirit, just as I told you he has promised to do.
translation_verse: Kachako bumo kikɛ ba shɛr nɛ e sa bumo le be ebɔl: “Men sa maŋ kaŋ lar Jerusalɛm to. Men baa jo kakɛ nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ n Tuto yɛ e beeŋ sa na.

english_verse: John baptized with water, but in a few days you will be baptized with the Holy Spirit. Jesus Is Taken to Heaven
translation_verse: Nchu nɛ Jɔn kabɔrɛbɛrpo daŋ ta m bɛr basa kabɔrɛbɛr, ama Ebɔrɛ beeŋ shin nɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na e gbelge menyi so nchɛnnyɔ ere to be kefɛato.” Yesu ka yɔ ebɔrɛso be asheŋ

english_verse: While the apostles were still with Jesus, they asked him, “Lord, are you now going to give Israel its own king again?”
translation_verse: Kachako beshuŋipo na nɛ Yesu ka shɛr nɛ b bishi mo: “Enyɛnpe, naniere bre, feeŋ ta kuwurji na m bɛta n sa Israɛlebi a?”

english_verse: Jesus said to them, “You don't need to know the time of those events that only the Father controls.
translation_verse: Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ bumo: “N Tuto nawule be enɔ to nɛ kusɔ kama nɛ kumo be jemanɛ wɔ. Amo be asheŋ maŋ la asɔ nɛ a daga men ka pin.

english_verse: But the Holy Spirit will come upon you and give you power. Then you will tell everyone about me in Jerusalem, in all Judea, in Samaria, and everywhere in the world.”
translation_verse: Ama men baa nyi fanɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na kaŋ gbelge menyi so, menyeeŋ baa kɔ eleŋ menyi to a malga ma asheŋ a sa basa ashi Jerusalɛm to nɛ Judiya kikɛ to nɛ Samɛria to nɛ durnya ere kikɛ nyam to.”

english_verse: After Jesus had said this and while they were watching, he was taken up into a cloud. They could not see him,
translation_verse: Yesu ka malga kesheŋ ere n loge nɛ Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ e fara a yɔ ebɔrɛso nɛ baa keni mo hale nɛ kuwɔlpa ko ya buu mo so nɛ b maŋ naŋ wu mo.

english_verse: but as he went up, they kept looking up into the sky. Suddenly two men dressed in white clothes were standing there beside them.
translation_verse: Bumo be anishi kraa yuu awɔlpa na so nna nɛ benyɛn anyɔ ko nɛ b daa la emalaika buu epiŋi fuful m ba yili bumo kutɔ epul na to

english_verse: They said, “Why are you men from Galilee standing here and looking up into the sky? Jesus has been taken to heaven. But he will come back in the same way you have seen him go.” Someone To Take the Place of Judas
translation_verse: nseŋ bishi bumo: “Galiliebi, manɛ e ba nɛ men yil a keni esoso loŋ? Yesu koŋwule nɛ Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ e lar menyi kutɔ a yɔ ebɔrɛso ere beeŋ naŋ bɛta loŋ gbagba chap m ba kananɛ men wu mo nɛ e bee yɔ ebɔrɛso ere.” Esa nɛ e sɔ Judas so be asheŋ

english_verse: The Mount of Olives was about a kilometer from Jerusalem. The apostles who had gone there were Peter, John, James, Andrew, Philip, Thomas, Bartholomew, Matthew, James the son of Alphaeus, Simon, known as the Eager One, and Judas the son of James. After the apostles returned to the city, they went upstairs to the room where they had been staying.
translation_verse: B ka fo Jerusalɛm nɛ b dii n yɔ esoso be ebu be ebu ko to nɛ b daa sha keji nchɛnnyɔ kumo to na. Bumo e daa la: Pita nɛ Jɔn nɛ Jeems nɛ Andru nɛ Filip nɛ Tɔmas nɛ Baatɔlomiu nɛ Matiu nɛ Jeems, Alfias pibi nɛ Saimɔn Zɛlɔt nɛ Judas, Jeems pibi.

english_verse: The apostles often met together and prayed with a single purpose in mind. The women and Mary the mother of Jesus would meet with them, and so would his brothers.
translation_verse: Bumo kikɛ nɛ beche na nɛ Mɛɛri, Yesu mo nio nɛ Yesu koŋwule na mo sipoana daa wɔtɔ nna a shɛr kɔnɔkoŋwuleso a kule Ebɔrɛ.

english_verse: He said: My friends, long ago by the power of the Holy Spirit, David said something about Judas, and what he said has now happened. Judas was one of us and had worked with us, but he brought the mob to arrest Jesus.
translation_verse: Anyi to be eko e daa la Judas, ŋkpal manɛ so, Yesu daŋ lara mo nna nɛ mo alɛ gba e baa wɔ anyi be kushuŋ na to.

english_verse: Then Judas bought some land with the money he was given for doing that evil thing. He fell headfirst into the field. His body burst open, and all his insides came out.
translation_verse: Kasawule ko nɛ Judas daŋ ta mbe nia be amansherbi nɛ e nya na n tɔ. Ndoŋ malɛ nɛ e daŋ ta kapo n tɔr epun so m pante epun nɛ apumbi lar nɛ e wu.

english_verse: When the people of Jerusalem found out about this, they called the place Akeldama, which in the local language means “Field of Blood.”
translation_verse: Basa nɛ b daa wɔ Jerusalɛm to na kikɛ daŋ nu kumo be asheŋ nseŋ sa kasawule na ketre: Akɛldama. Bumo be ŋgbar to, kumo be kifito e la: Kakpa nɛ ŋklaŋ lar n wurge.”

english_verse: So we need someone else to help us tell others that Jesus has been raised from death. He must also be one of the men who was with us from the very beginning. He must have been with us from the time the Lord Jesus was baptized by John until the day he was taken to heaven.
translation_verse: A daga fanɛ e baa la basa nɛ anyi nɛ bumo daa la saŋkama, saŋɛ nɛ anyi nɛ Yesu daa wɔtɔ, yili saŋɛ nɛ Jɔn daa malga mbe kabɔrɛbɛr be asheŋ na n ya fo kachɛ nɛ Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ Yesu lar anyi kutɔ n yɔ ebɔrɛso na be eko.”

english_verse: Then they all prayed, “Lord, you know what everyone is like! Show us the one you have chosen
translation_verse: Nɛ b kule Ebɔrɛ ŋ kaŋɛ: “Enyɛnpe, fo nyi basa kikɛ be ŋgbene to, amoso, ŋini anyi basa anyɔ ere be emo nɛ feeŋ lara

english_verse: to be an apostle and to serve in place of Judas, who got what he deserved.”
translation_verse: nɛ e baa la fo eshuŋipo a shuŋ kushuŋ nɛ Judas daa shuŋ nseŋ yige kumo n yɔ kakpa nɛ k daga mo na.”

english_verse: They drew names, and Matthias was chosen to join the group of the eleven apostles.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ b to beri nɛ Matayas ji. Ndoŋ nna nɛ b shin nɛ e ti beshuŋipo kudukako na so.

english_verse: On the day of Pentecost all the Lord's followers were together in one place.
translation_verse: Kachɛgboŋ nɛ baa tre Pɛntekɔst na ka fo nɛ beyirdapoana na kikɛ shɛr kakpa koŋwule.

english_verse: Suddenly there was a noise from heaven like the sound of a mighty wind! It filled the house where they were meeting.
translation_verse: Epul to nɛ awɔr shi ebɔrɛso ŋ gbri m ba bɔla ebu nɛ b daa tase to na kikɛ to fanɛ afugboŋ ko na.

english_verse: The Holy Spirit took control of everyone, and they began speaking whatever languages the Spirit let them speak.
translation_verse: Nɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na ba bɔlɔ bumo kikɛ to nɛ b fara a gbar ŋgbar nɛ bumo gbagba maa nu kanaŋkamaso nɛ Kiyoyu na daŋ shin nɛ b malga.

english_verse: And when they heard this noise, a crowd gathered. But they were surprised, because they were hearing everything in their own languages.
translation_verse: B ka nu awɔr na nɛ jimaŋ damta ko shɛr ndoŋ. K daŋ chinchiŋ bumo kikɛ ga ŋkpal bumo be ekama ka nu beyirdapoana na ka bee gbar bumo be ŋgbar so.

english_verse: They were excited and amazed, and said: Don't all these who are speaking come from Galilee?
translation_verse: K daŋ wul bumo to nseŋ chinchiŋ bumo ga nɛ b bishi abar: “Mannɛ Galili nɛ basa nɛ baa malga le ere kikɛ shi a?

english_verse: Then why do we hear them speaking our very own languages?
translation_verse: Nɛ manɛ e ba nɛ anyi be ekama bee nu basa ere ka bee gbar anyi be efuli so be ŋgbar?

english_verse: Some of us are from Parthia, Media, and Elam. Others are from Mesopotamia, Judea, Cappadocia, Pontus, Asia,
translation_verse: To, Paatia nɛ Midia nɛ Ilam nɛ Mɛsopoteemia nɛ Judiya nɛ Kapadosia nɛ Pɔntes nɛ Eeshia,

english_verse: Crete, and Arabia. Some of us were born Jews, and others of us have chosen to be Jews. Yet we all hear them using our own languages to tell the wonderful things God has done.
translation_verse: Anyi be beko malɛ shi Rom nna a la Juwebi nɛ nnyamase nɛ b tuba a bɛ Juwebi be kabɔrɛbɛso na so na. Anyi be beko malɛ shi Kriit nɛ Areebia nna ŋkeshin nɛ anyi alɛ kikɛ bee nu b ka bee malga anyi be ŋgbarana to a kaŋɛ asheŋgboŋ nɛ Ebɔrɛ wora.”

english_verse: Everyone was excited and confused. Some of them even kept asking each other, “What does all this mean?”
translation_verse: K daŋ wul bumo kikɛ to ga nɛ b wɔtɔ a bishi abar: “Kede be kifito e la nuso?”

english_verse: Others made fun of the Lord's followers and said, “They are drunk.” Peter Speaks to the Crowd
translation_verse: Nɛ basa na be beko wora beyirdapoana na eyurto ŋ kaŋɛ: “Basa ere boo nna na.” Pita be kamalga be asheŋ

english_verse: Peter stood with the eleven apostles and spoke in a loud and clear voice to the crowd: Friends and everyone else living in Jerusalem, listen carefully to what I have to say!
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Pita nɛ beshuŋipo kudukako na niŋi to n yili nɛ Pita fara a kaŋɛ jimaŋ na awɔrso: “M peebi Juwebi nɛ menyi nɛ men wɔ Jerusalɛm to ere kikɛ, men kaŋ kusoe n nu asɔ nɛ a wora na kikɛ be kifito.

english_verse: You are wrong to think that these people are drunk. After all, it is only nine o'clock in the morning.
translation_verse: Men sa maa fɛ fanɛ basa ere boo nna. B maŋ boo, ŋkpal manɛ so, chipurso, kerfi akpanu e kraa la nna.

english_verse: But this is what God told the prophet Joel to say,
translation_verse: Ama men baa nyi fanɛ asheŋ nɛ a wora ere be asheŋ nɛ anebi Jowɛl daŋ sibɛ fanɛ Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ:

english_verse: “When the last days come, I will give my Spirit to everyone. Your sons and daughters will prophesy. Your young men will see visions, and your old men will have dreams.
translation_verse: ‘Le nɛ meeŋ wora lalaloge be nchɛ na to: Meeŋ shin nɛ ma Kiyoyu e ba basa kikɛ to. Menyi be mbrantiɛbi beeŋ ku bɔrɛdareana nɛ menyi be benyɛnnimu e ku abɔrɛsheŋ be edareana nɛ menyi be mbinyɛnbi nɛ mbichebi e wu abɔrɛsheŋ ŋ kaŋɛ.

english_verse: In those days I will give my Spirit to my servants, both men and women, and they will prophesy.
translation_verse: Kashenteŋto, saŋɛ na so meeŋ shin nɛ ma Kiyoyu na e ba ma nyɛrbi nɛ ma mbita gba kikɛ to nɛ b wu abɔrɛsheŋ ŋ kaŋɛ.

english_verse: “I will work miracles in the sky above and wonders on the earth below. There will be blood and fire and clouds of smoke.
translation_verse: Meeŋ wora emamachisheŋ ebɔrɛso nɛ Ebɔrɛ be asheŋ ŋiniso kasawule so. Baaŋ wu ŋklaŋ nɛ edɛ nɛ edishi damta.

english_verse: The sun will turn dark, and the moon will be as red as blood before the great and wonderful day of the Lord appears.
translation_verse: Nɛ epeŋi e biri to gbrum, nɛ kufɔl malɛ e pere to kpaiŋ fanɛ ŋklaŋ. Amo kikɛ beeŋ wora nna pɔɛŋ nɛ Enyɛnpe be kachɛgboŋ na e fo.

english_verse: Then the Lord will save everyone who asks for his help.”
translation_verse: Saŋɛ na so ekama nɛ e tre Enyɛnpe na beeŋ nya kumɔlga.’

english_verse: Now, listen to what I have to say about Jesus from Nazareth. God proved he sent Jesus to you by having him work miracles, wonders, and signs. All of you know this.
translation_verse: Israɛlebi, men nu nfe, Ebɔrɛ ŋini menyi fanɛ Nazarɛt be Yesu na shi mo kutɔ nna, ŋkpal e ka bɔla Yesu na so n wora emamachisheŋ nɛ Ebɔrɛ be etɔɔnɛsheŋ nɛ asheŋ ŋiniso damta menyi be anishito nfe so. Menyi gbagba baa nyi amo be asheŋ.

english_verse: God had already planned and decided that Jesus would be handed over to you. So you took him and had evil men put him to death on a cross.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ gbagba be kasha nɛ kashennyi so nɛ e daŋ yili kumo saŋɛ na kikɛ fanɛ baaŋ ta Yesu m bɔɔ menyi enɔ. Menyi shin nɛ basa lubi gbir mo m mata kedibi largato so m mɔ.

english_verse: But God set him free from death and raised him to life. Death could not hold him in its power.
translation_verse: Ama Ebɔrɛ naŋ shin nɛ e tiŋi luwu na to n sɔ mo luwu be ebesa to n yige, ŋkpal manɛ so, luwu daa maŋ tiŋ n shin nɛ e ka kumo be enɔ to kikɛ.

english_verse: What David said are really the words of Jesus, “I always see the Lord near me, and I will not be afraid with him at my right side.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so le nɛ Deevid daŋ malga mbe asheŋ ŋ kaŋɛ: ‘Mee wu Enyɛnpe saŋkama ma anishito, ŋkpal manɛ so, e wɔ ma kutɔ nna a chɛ ma to nɛ basa e sa maŋ tiŋ n tɔrɔ ma.

english_verse: Because of this, my heart will be glad, my words will be joyful, and I will live in hope.
translation_verse: Amoso, ma kagbene kikɛ fuli ma nna nɛ ma mmalga gba la kagbenefuli be mmalga. Nɛ ma alɛ bomin e tiŋ a kɔ kusɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ beeŋ wora n sa ma be tama.

english_verse: The Lord won't leave me in the grave. I am his holy one, and he won't let my body decay.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, fo Ebɔrɛ maaŋ shin nɛ n wu nɛ ma kiyoyu e yɔ luwu to. Fo maaŋ shin nɛ fo kenya nɛ e bee bɛ fo so nɛ kagbene koŋwule e wu m bɛ.

english_verse: He has shown me the path to life, and he makes me glad by being near me.”
translation_verse: Fo ŋini ma ekpaana nɛ meeŋ bɔla so n nya Ebɔrɛ be ŋkpa. Fo alɛ ka wɔ ma kutɔ so, ma kagbene fuli ma ga.’

english_verse: My friends, it is right for me to speak to you about our ancestor David. He died and was buried, and his tomb is still here.
translation_verse: Ŋ kurgepoana, men shin nɛ m bugi to ŋ kaŋɛ menyi an nana Deevid be asheŋ. E daŋ wu nna nɛ b puli mo, hale mbre an kraa wu mbe nchaŋ kade ere to.

english_verse: But David was a prophet, and he knew that God had made a promise he would not break. He had told David someone from his own family would someday be king.
translation_verse: E daa la anebi nna a nyi Ebɔrɛ be kɔnɔ nɛ e nase n sa mo fanɛ e beeŋ shin nɛ mo ere Deevid be kanaŋ to ebi be eko e ki ewura fanɛ Deevid gbagba.

english_verse: David knew this would happen, and so he told us Christ would be raised to life. He said God would not leave him in the grave or let his body decay.
translation_verse: Deevid malɛ ka daa nyi kusɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ daa sha kewora na so nɛ e daŋ malga Kristo na be ketiŋi luwu to be asheŋ saŋɛ nɛ e daŋ kaŋɛ: ‘Ebɔrɛ daa maŋ shin nɛ e ka luwu to, e daa maŋ shin nɛ e wu m bɛ.’

english_verse: All of us can tell you that God has raised Jesus to life!
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ Yesu koŋwule ere tiŋi luwu to nɛ anyi wu kumo be loŋ be kashenteŋ.

english_verse: Jesus was taken up to sit at the right side of God, and he was given the Holy Spirit, just as the Father had promised. Jesus is also the one who has given the Spirit to us, and this is what you are now seeing and hearing.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ e tiŋi luwu to n ya chena mbe jisoso, ebunyampo be kakpa nseŋ shin nɛ e nya Kiyoyu Cheeŋ nɛ Etuto na nase kɔnɔ fanɛ e beeŋ sa na. Asɔ nɛ menyee wu nsaa nu naniere malɛ kikɛ la mbe kakɛ nna.

english_verse: David didn't go up to heaven. So he wasn't talking about himself when he said, “The Lord told my Lord to sit at his right side,
translation_verse: Deevid gbagba daa maŋ yɔ ebɔrɛso fanɛ Yesu, ama le nɛ e daŋ kaŋɛ: ‘Enyɛnpe na kaŋɛ n Nyɛnpe le: Chena ma jisoso nfe

english_verse: until he made my Lord's enemies into a footstool for him.”
translation_verse: hale nɛ n ya ta fo doŋana m bɔɔ fo enɔ.’

english_verse: Everyone in Israel should then know for certain that God has made Jesus both Lord and Christ, even though you put him to death on a cross.
translation_verse: To, menyi, Israɛlebi kikɛ men baa nyi geeŋ fanɛ Yesu koŋwule nɛ men gbir m mata kedibi largato so na nɛ Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ e ki Enyɛnpe nɛ Kristo na.”

english_verse: When the people heard this, they were very upset. They asked Peter and the other apostles, “Friends, what should we do?”
translation_verse: Basa na ka nu asɔ nɛ Pita malga na kikɛ nɛ bumo be ŋgbene kaa nɛ b bishi Pita nɛ mo braana beshuŋipoana na: “An kurgepoana, nuso nɛ anyeeŋ wora?”

english_verse: Peter said to them, “Turn to God and be baptized, every one of you, in the name of Jesus Christ for the forgiveness of your sins, and you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Nɛ Pita kaŋɛ bumo: “Men be ekama e lar mbe alubi to, kumo be kaman nɛ e shin nɛ b bɛr mo kabɔrɛbɛr Yesu Kristo be ketre to nɛ Ebɔrɛ e ta mbe alubi m paŋ mo nseŋ sa mo Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na.

english_verse: Peter told them many other things as well. Then he said, “I beg you to save yourselves from what will happen to all these evil people.”
translation_verse: Kesheŋ ere nɛ Pita daŋ kaŋɛ bumo nseŋ ta le be mmalga ŋ kaŋɛ bumo kenishipereso: “Men mɔlga menyi be amu ashi kasogberge nɛ k bee ba le be basa lubi ere so na to.”

english_verse: They spent their time learning from the apostles, and they were like family to each other. They also broke bread and prayed together. Life among the Lord's Followers
translation_verse: Bumo nɛ beshuŋipo na e daa la saŋkama nɛ baa koya asɔ ashi beshuŋipo na kutɔ nsaa ba bumo be nshɛrbuana to nɛ bumo kikɛ ba kaa bɔ enɔ kɔnɔkoŋwuleso a wɔtɔ kawie koŋwule to nsaa kule Ebɔrɛ kɔnɔkoŋwuleso. Beyirdapoana be kebaawɔtɔ be asheŋ

english_verse: Everyone was amazed by the many miracles and wonders that the apostles worked.
translation_verse: Beshuŋipoana na daŋ wora emamachisheŋ nɛ Ebɔrɛ be asheŋ ŋiniso damta n shin nɛ ekama kooba kufuso ga.

english_verse: All the Lord's followers often met together, and they shared everything they had.
translation_verse: Beyirdapoana na kikɛ daŋ baa wɔ abar so nna kɔnɔkoŋwuleso nsaa bar bumo be asɔ kakpa koŋwule m ba kaa chɛ abar to.

english_verse: They would sell their property and possessions and give the money to whoever was in need.
translation_verse: Saŋko baa fa bumo be ekpanjawu to be asɔ nna a ta amo be amansherbi a chige a sa bumo to be ekama kanaŋkamaso nɛ a daga ekama ka nya.

english_verse: Day after day they met together in the temple. They broke bread together in different homes and shared their food happily and freely,
translation_verse: Karechɛ kama malɛ b daa shɛr bɔrɛlambu na to nna kɔnɔkoŋwuleso nseŋ naa shɛr abarana pe nchɛ nchɛ a ji ajibi kagbenewushiso nɛ kɔnɔkoŋwuleso nsaa di Ebɔrɛ epaŋ.

english_verse: while praising God. Everyone liked them, and each day the Lord added to their group others who were being saved.
translation_verse: Bumo be asheŋ daŋ bɔlɔ kade na to ebi kikɛ kenishi ga. Karechɛ kama malɛ Enyɛnpe Yesu daa mɔlga basa pɔtɛ nna a ti bumo so.

english_verse: The time of prayer was about three o'clock in the afternoon, and Peter and John were going into the temple.
translation_verse: Kachako Pita nɛ Jɔn ka bee yɔ bɔrɛlambu na to kapaso kerfi asa, jemanɛ nɛ basa daa yɔ n ya kaa bunyaŋ Ebɔrɛ bumo be kabɔrɛkule to na

english_verse: A man who had been born lame was being carried to the temple door. Each day he was placed beside this door, known as the Beautiful Gate. He sat there and begged from the people who were going in.
translation_verse: nɛ kanyɛn ko nɛ e daa la bobi mbe kakurgeachɛ kikɛ na wɔ bɔrɛlambu na be kabuna nɛ b daa tre Kabuna Lela na akpa. Kachɛ kama b daa sulɔ mo nna a ba kabuna na akpa nɛ e ba kaa kule basa nɛ b daa luri bɔrɛlambu na to na amansherbi.

english_verse: The man saw Peter and John entering the temple, and he asked them for money.
translation_verse: E ka wu Pita nɛ Jɔn ka bee luri bɔrɛlambu na to nɛ e kule bumo fanɛ b sa mo kusɔ ko.

english_verse: But they looked straight at him and said, “Look up at us!”
translation_verse: Nɛ b keni mbe anishito nɛ Pita kaŋɛ mo: “Keni anyi so.”

english_verse: The man stared at them and thought he was going to get something.
translation_verse: Nɛ e keni bumo boeŋ a tama kenya kusɔ ko.

english_verse: But Peter said, “I don't have any silver or gold! But I will give you what I do have. In the name of Jesus Christ from Nazareth, get up and start walking.”
translation_verse: Nɛ Pita kaŋɛ mo: “M maŋ kɔ kubo, ama meeŋ sa fo kusɔ nɛ ŋ kɔ. Nazarɛt be Yesu Kristo be eleŋ to so, niŋi to n nite!”

english_verse: Peter then took him by the right hand and helped him up. At once the man's feet and ankles became strong,
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Pita pɛ mbe enɔ to n chɛ mo to nɛ e niŋi to epul na to nɛ mbe aya nya eleŋ.

english_verse: and he jumped up and started walking. He went with Peter and John into the temple, walking and jumping and praising God.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ e tɛ to n yuu mbe aya so nseŋ fara a nite a kilgi to. Kumo be kaman nɛ mo nɛ Pita nɛ Jɔn luri bɔrɛlambu na to nɛ e bee nite nsaa tɛ to a di Ebɔrɛ epaŋ.

english_verse: Everyone saw him walking around and praising God.
translation_verse: Jimaŋ na kikɛ daŋ wu e ka na nsaa di Ebɔrɛ epaŋ.

english_verse: They knew he was the beggar who had been lying beside the Beautiful Gate, and they were completely surprised. They could not imagine what had happened to the man. Peter Speaks in the Temple
translation_verse: B ka pin fanɛ mo e daa tase bɔrɛlambu na be kabuna nɛ baa tre Kabuna Lela na akpa na nɛ bumo be nnɔ mɔ bumo ŋkpal kusɔ nɛ k wora mo na so. Pita be kamalga ashi bɔrɛlambu to be asheŋ

english_verse: While the man kept holding on to Peter and John, the whole crowd ran to them in amazement at the place known as Solomon's Porch.
translation_verse: Basa na ka wu kananɛ kanyɛn na far n chɛ Pita nɛ Jɔn na nɛ k chinchiŋ bumo kikɛ ga nɛ b shile n yɔ bumo kutɔ ashi kakpa nɛ b daa tre Sɔlɔmɔn be kedɛdɛ na.

english_verse: Peter saw that a crowd had gathered, and he said: Friends, why are you surprised at what has happened? Why are you staring at us? Do you think we have some power of our own? Do you think we were able to make this man walk because we are so religious?
translation_verse: Pita ka wu bumo nɛ e kaŋɛ bumo: “Israɛlebi, manɛ e ba nɛ kesheŋ ere bee chinchiŋ menyi nɛ menyee keni anyi loŋ? Menyee tama fanɛ anyi gbagba be eleŋ ŋko anyi be kelela so so nɛ an tiŋ n chɛ kanyɛn ere nɛ e bee nite le ere a?

english_verse: The God that Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and our other ancestors worshiped has brought honor to his Servant Jesus. He is the one you betrayed. You turned against him when he was being tried by Pilate, even though Pilate wanted to set him free.
translation_verse: An nananyɛnana Eebraham nɛ Aizek nɛ Jeekɔb nɛ anyi be kanaŋ to ebi kikɛ be Ebɔrɛ na e sa mbe Kenya Yesu kemaŋkura. Mo nɛ men daŋ ta m bɔɔ belempo enɔ nseŋ kini mo Pailat be anishito, saŋɛ nɛ Pailat gbagba daa sha keyige mo na.

english_verse: You rejected Jesus, who was holy and good. You asked for a murderer to be set free,
translation_verse: Esa cheembi nɛ Esa Lela e daa la mo ama men kini mo nseŋ kule Pailat fanɛ e sɔ emɔpo n yige n sa menyi.

english_verse: and you killed the one who leads people to life. But God raised him from death, and all of us can tell you what he has done.
translation_verse: Amoso, men mɔ esa nɛ e bee sa basa Ebɔrɛ be ŋkpa. Ama Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ e tiŋi luwu na to nɛ anyi gbagba ji kumo be loŋ be shɛda.

english_verse: You see this man, and you know him. He put his faith in the name of Jesus and was made strong. Faith in Jesus made this man completely well while everyone was watching.
translation_verse: Mo, Yesu koŋwule na be eleŋ e chɛ bobinyɛn ere na. Kusɔ nɛ men wu nseŋ nu ere tiŋ n wora nna ŋkpal keyirda mbe ketre na so so. Keyirda Yesu na e tiŋ n chɛ mo menyi kikɛ be anishito le ere na.

english_verse: My friends, I am sure you and your leaders didn't know what you were doing.
translation_verse: To, ŋ kurgepoana, n nyi fanɛ kusɔ nɛ menyi nɛ menyi be benimuana wora Yesu na daa la kamaanyi be kusɔ nna.

english_verse: But God had his prophets tell that his Messiah would suffer, and now he has kept this promise.
translation_verse: Dra na kikɛ nɛ Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ anebiana kikɛ wu ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ mbe Kristo na beeŋ ba ji awurfoŋ, kumo nɛ e shin nɛ k bɔla ekpa le ere na.

english_verse: So turn to God! Give up your sins, and you will be forgiven.
translation_verse: Amoso, men lar menyi be alubi to nseŋ bɛta m ba Ebɔrɛ kutɔ nɛ e kpra menyi be alubi kikɛ n lɛ.

english_verse: Then the time will come when the Lord will give you fresh strength. He will send you Jesus, his chosen Messiah.
translation_verse: Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ e shin nɛ ewushi e shi mo kutɔ m ba menyi be ayoyu to nɛ e shin nɛ Yesu nɛ e la Kristo nɛ Ebɔrɛ teŋ lara n sa menyi na e ba menyi kutɔ.

english_verse: Moses said, “The Lord your God will choose one of your own people to be a prophet, just as he chose me. Listen to everything he tells you.
translation_verse: Anebi Mosis le daŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ: ‘Menyi be Ebɔrɛ Enyɛnpe beeŋ shin nɛ anebi e ba menyi kutɔ fanɛ kananɛ e daŋ shin nɛ m ba na. E beeŋ ba kaa la menyi be efuli ere so be esa nna. E kaŋ ba, men baa nu a sa mo kusɔ kama to.

english_verse: No one who disobeys this prophet will be one of God's people any longer.”
translation_verse: Ekama nɛ e kini kenu kusɔ nɛ anebi na beeŋ kaŋɛ menyi, baaŋ lara mo Ebɔrɛ be basa to n shin nɛ e mur.’

english_verse: You are really the ones God told his prophets to speak to. And you were given the promise God made to your ancestors. He said to Abraham, “All nations on earth will be blessed because of someone from your family.”
translation_verse: Nnɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ shin nɛ mbe anebiana nase na la menyi alɛ gba peya nna. Le nɛ e daŋ kaŋɛ Eebraham: ‘Fo kanaŋ to nɛ meeŋ bɔla n nɛfa durnya ere to be basa kikɛ.’

english_verse: God sent his chosen Son to you first, because God wanted to bless you and make each one of you turn away from your sins.
translation_verse: Amoso nɛ Ebɔrɛ lara mbe kenya Yesu n shin nɛ e ba menyi kutɔ pɔɛŋ m ba nɛfa menyi a shin nɛ menyi kikɛ bee lar menyi be alubi to na.”

english_verse: The apostles were still talking to the people, when some priests, the captain of the temple guard, and some Sadducees arrived.
translation_verse: Pita nɛ Jɔn daa maŋ naŋ malga n sa basa na n loge nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana na be beko nɛ bɔrɛlambu na to be bekumpoana be enimu nɛ Esadusiana na be beko ba bumo kutɔ.

english_verse: These men were angry because the apostles were teaching the people that the dead would be raised from death, just as Jesus had been raised from death.
translation_verse: B daŋ nya agbo nna ŋkpal beshuŋipo anyɔ na ka daa ŋini basa na fanɛ Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ Yesu tiŋi luwu to so. Yesu be ketiŋi na malɛ e naa ŋini fanɛ basa nɛ b wu na kikɛ beeŋ ba tiŋi luwu to.

english_verse: It was already late in the afternoon, and they arrested Peter and John and put them in jail for the night.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ b pɛ bumo n ya ti ebu nɛ b klade ŋkpal kaboŋ ka daŋ jija to na so.

english_verse: But a lot of people who had heard the message believed it. So by now there were about
translation_verse: Ama jimaŋ na to be bedamta nɛ b nu kubɔya na yirda kumo, nɛ beyirdapoana na kikɛ fo fanɛ basa ŋgboŋ anu.

english_verse: The next morning the leaders, the elders, and the teachers of the Law of Moses met in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Kumo be ŋklade nɛ Juwebi be bejuŋkparpoana na nɛ benimuana na nɛ mbraŋinipoana na shɛr Jerusalɛm to be kakpa ko.

english_verse: The high priest Annas was there, as well as Caiaphas, John, Alexander, and other members of the high priest's family.
translation_verse: Bumo nɛ bɔrɛmatapo nimuso Anas nɛ Kayafas nɛ Jɔn nɛ Alɛkzaanda nɛ beko nɛ bumo alɛ gba daŋ shi bɔrɛmatapo nimuso na be kanaŋ to na kikɛ e daa la.

english_verse: They brought in Peter and John and made them stand in the middle while they questioned them. They asked, “By what power and in whose name have you done this?”
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ b bar beshuŋipo na m ba shin nɛ b yili bumo be anishito nɛ b bishi bumo: “Nuso nɛ men wora n chɛ bobinyɛn na? Eleŋ mo nɛ men kɔ ŋko wanɛ be ketre nɛ men ta n wora kumo?”

english_verse: Peter was filled with the Holy Spirit and told the nation's leaders and the elders:
translation_verse: Nɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na luri m bɔlɔ Pita to nɛ e kaŋɛ: “Israɛlebi be bejuŋkparpoana nɛ benimuana,

english_verse: You are questioning us today about a kind deed in which a man who could not walk was healed.
translation_verse: menyee bishi anyi kabre be kachɛ ere kelela nɛ an wora bobinyɛn ere nɛ kananɛ a ji nɛ e nya alenfia.

english_verse: But there is something we must tell you and everyone else in Israel. This man is standing here completely well because of the power of Jesus Christ from Nazareth. You put Jesus to death on a cross, but God raised him to life.
translation_verse: To, menyi kikɛ nɛ Israɛlebi kikɛ baa nyi fanɛ Nazarɛt be Yesu Kristo nɛ men gbir m mata kedibi largato so m mɔ na nɛ Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ e tiŋi luwu na to na be ketre be eleŋ to so nɛ kanyɛn ere nya alenfia mo kikɛ nyam a yil menyi be anishito le ere na.

english_verse: He is the stone you builders thought was worthless, and now he is the most important stone of all.
translation_verse: Abɔrɛsibɛ na ka bee kaŋɛ fanɛ: ‘Kejembu mo nɛ menyi bepɔrpo keni jiga na e ba ki ajembu kikɛ be kelela’ na bee malga Yesu be asheŋ nna na.

english_verse: Only Jesus has the power to save! His name is the only one in all the world that can save anyone.
translation_verse: Yesu na nawule so nɛ anyeeŋ tiŋ n nya kumɔlga. Ebɔrɛ maŋ ta esa kikɛ be ketre durnya ere to n sa basa nɛ b bɔla kumo so n nya kumɔlga she Yesu Kristo nawule peya.”

english_verse: The officials were amazed to see how brave Peter and John were, and they knew that these two apostles were only ordinary men and not well educated. The officials were certain these men had been with Jesus.
translation_verse: Nshɛrwuraana na ka wu kananɛ Pita nɛ Jɔn daŋ malga kenyɛnso nsaa la basa fuloŋ a maŋ nyi kawɔl nseŋ tiŋ n wora loŋ na, k daŋ chinchiŋ bumo ga. Ndoŋ nna nɛ b nyiŋi bumo nɛ Yesu ka daa la.

english_verse: But they could not deny what had happened. The man who had been healed was standing there with the apostles.
translation_verse: Bumo alɛ ka wu kanyɛn nɛ e nya alenfia na ka yil Pita nɛ Jɔn kutɔ na so, b paŋ kenaŋ malga ŋ gbiti bumo.

english_verse: The officials commanded them to leave the council room. Then the officials said to each other,
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ b shin nɛ Pita nɛ Jɔn nɛ kanyɛn na lar kɔɔti na to nseŋ fara a malga demu na be asheŋ

english_verse: “What can we do with these men? Everyone in Jerusalem knows about this miracle, and we cannot say it didn't happen.
translation_verse: a bishi abar: “Nuso nɛ anyeeŋ wora basa anyɔ ere? Jerusalɛm ere to be esa kama nyi fanɛ bumo e wora kemamachisheŋ gboŋ na, anyi maaŋ tiŋ n chɛ kumo be loŋ.

english_verse: But to keep this thing from spreading, we will warn them never again to speak to anyone about the name of Jesus.”
translation_verse: Ama kananɛ anyeeŋ wora nɛ kesheŋ ere e sa maŋ naŋ sɔ kakpa n ti so e la, an ka beeŋ fiɛ bumo so fanɛ b sa maŋ naŋ ta Yesu be ketre m malga asheŋ n sa esa kikɛ.”

english_verse: So they called the two apostles back in and told them they must never, for any reason, teach anything about the name of Jesus.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ b naŋ tre Pita nɛ Jɔn m ba ndoŋ m ba kaŋɛ bumo fanɛ b sa maŋ kaŋ naŋ malga ŋko ŋ ŋini basa Yesu be asheŋ kikɛ.

english_verse: Peter and John answered, “Do you think God wants us to obey you or to obey him?
translation_verse: Nɛ Pita nɛ Jɔn bishi bumo: “Menyi ere kutɔ, kenu n sa menyi nɛ kenu n sa Ebɔrɛ, kumo e bɔla ekpa?

english_verse: We cannot keep quiet about what we have seen and heard.”
translation_verse: Anyi ere maaŋ tiŋ n yige kemalga kusɔ nɛ anyi gbagba wu nseŋ nu be asheŋ.”

english_verse: The officials could not find any reason to punish Peter and John. So they threatened them and let them go. The man who was healed by this miracle was more than
translation_verse: Kanyɛn nɛ le be mamachisheŋ daŋ chɛ na daa chɔ nfɛ adena. Beyirdapoana na ka kule Ebɔrɛ kenyɛn be asheŋ

english_verse: As soon as Peter and John had been set free, they went back and told the others everything the chief priests and the leaders had said to them.
translation_verse: Basa na ka baŋ yige Pita nɛ Jɔn nɛ b bɛta n yɔ bumo braana beyirdapoana na kutɔ n ya kaŋɛ bumo kusɔ nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana na nɛ benimuana na kaŋɛ bumo.

english_verse: When the rest of the Lord's followers heard this, they prayed together and said: Master, you created heaven and earth, the sea, and everything in them.
translation_verse: B ka nu kesheŋ na nɛ bumo kikɛ kule Ebɔrɛ kɔnɔkoŋwuleso ŋ kaŋɛ: “Enyɛnpe nɛ Etopo nɛ e to esoso nɛ kasawule nɛ nchuana nɛ asɔ nɛ a wɔ amo to na kikɛ,

english_verse: And by the Holy Spirit you spoke to our ancestor David. He was your servant, and you told him to say: “Why are all the Gentiles so furious? Why do people make foolish plans?
translation_verse: fo e daŋ malga saŋɛ nɛ fo daŋ shin nɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na shin nɛ an nananyɛn Deevid, fo kenya wu m bishi: ‘Manɛ e ba nɛ nnyamase na daŋ diewu loŋ? Manɛ e ba nɛ b daŋ kre bumo nia fuloŋ loŋ?

english_verse: The kings of earth prepare for war, and the rulers join together against the Lord and his Messiah.”
translation_verse: Durnya ere to ebi be bewura bela ase nɛ kadewuraana shɛr nɛ b kɔ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ mbe Kristo na kena.’

english_verse: Here in Jerusalem, Herod and Pontius Pilate got together with the Gentiles and the people of Israel. Then they turned against your holy Servant Jesus, your chosen Messiah.
translation_verse: Kumo alɛ kashenteŋ nna, ŋkpal manɛ so, Hɛrɔd nɛ Pɔnshes Pailat nɛ nnyamase nɛ Israɛlebi daŋ shɛr kadegboŋ ere to ŋ kre Yesu nɛ e la fo Ebɔrɛ be Kenya cheembi nseŋ naa la emo nɛ fo lara fanɛ e baa la Kristo na be nia.

english_verse: Lord, listen to their threats! We are your servants. So make us brave enough to speak your message.
translation_verse: Naniere Enyɛnpe, fo nu kananɛ b fiɛ anyi so nna na, amoso, sa anyi, fo anya kenyɛn nɛ an tiŋ m bɔ fo kubɔya na n sa basa.

english_verse: Show your mighty power, as we heal people and work miracles and wonders in the name of your holy Servant Jesus.
translation_verse: Ŋini fo eleŋ n chɛ belɔpo nseŋ naŋ shin nɛ an tiŋ m bɔla Yesu Kristo, fo Kenya na be ketre so n wora kashenteŋ be etɔɔnɛsheŋ nɛ emamachisheŋ.”

english_verse: The group of followers all felt the same way about everything. None of them claimed that their possessions were their own, and they shared everything they had with each other.
translation_verse: Nfɛra koŋwule nɛ beyirdapoana na kikɛ daa kɔ. Bumo be ekama daa maa kaŋɛ fanɛ mbe asɔ la mo nawule peya nna. Kusɔ kama nɛ ekama daa kɔ b daa ta nna a barga to a sa abar.

english_verse: In a powerful way the apostles told everyone that the Lord Jesus was now alive. God greatly blessed his followers,
translation_verse: Nɛ beshuŋipoana na malga kenyɛnso n ji Enyɛnpe Yesu be ketiŋi luwu to na be shɛda n sa basa nɛ Ebɔrɛ nɛfa bumo kikɛ ga.

english_verse: and no one went in need of anything. Everyone who owned land or houses would sell them and bring the money
translation_verse: Shɛŋ shɛŋ daa maŋ tir bumo be ekama. Bumo to be nsawulewuraana ŋko nwuwuraana daa fa amo nna

english_verse: Ananias and his wife Sapphira also sold a piece of property.
translation_verse: Kanyɛn ko malɛ nɛ b daa tre Ananiyas daŋ fa mo nɛ mbe eche Safaira be kusɔ ko ŋ kaŋɛ mbe eche

english_verse: But they agreed to cheat and keep some of the money for themselves. So when Ananias took the rest of the money to the apostles,
translation_verse: nseŋ lara amansherbi na be ako n yili nseŋ ta amo nɛ a ka n ya bɔɔ beshuŋipo na enɔ.

english_verse: Peter said, “Why has Satan made you keep back some of the money from the sale of the property? Why have you lied to the Holy Spirit?
translation_verse: Nɛ Pita bishi mo: “Ananiyas, manɛ e ba nɛ fo shin nɛ Setani ba fo kagbene to m ba shin nɛ fo lara fo kudɔ na be amansherbi nɛ fo nya na so nseŋ ta ade m ba nɛ fo ba fule Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na?

english_verse: The property was yours before you sold it, and even after you sold it, the money was still yours. What made you do such a thing? You didn't lie to people. You lied to God!”
translation_verse: Kusɔ nɛ fo fa na daa maa la feya nna nɛ fo fa kumo n nya amansherbi na a? Nɛ a ji nuso nɛ kusɔ nɛ fo wora ere be nfɛra ba fo kagbene to? Mannɛ enyiŋgbasa nɛ fo fule, Ebɔrɛ nɛ fo fule!”

english_verse: As soon as Ananias heard this, he dropped dead, and everyone who heard about it was frightened.
translation_verse: Ananiyas ka baŋ nu kesheŋ ere nɛ e tɔr n wu epul na to nɛ kufu pɛ bekama nɛ b nu kumo be asheŋ na ga.

english_verse: Some young men came in and wrapped up his body. Then they took it out and buried it.
translation_verse: Nɛ mbrantiɛbi ba ta asɔ m mea mo nseŋ ta mo n ya puli.

english_verse: Three hours later Sapphira came in, but she did not know what had happened to her husband.
translation_verse: Ta a ba fanɛ awa asa to nɛ mbe eche ba, ama e daa maŋ nyi kusɔ nɛ k wora.

english_verse: Peter asked her, “Tell me, did you sell the property for this amount?” “Yes,” she answered, “that's the amount.”
translation_verse: Nɛ Pita bishi mo: “Kaŋɛ ma, amansherbi nɛ fo nɛ fo kul fa menyi be kusɔ na n nya na kikɛ nde a?” Nɛ e shuli so ŋ kaŋɛ: “Mm, amo kikɛ nyam nna na.”

english_verse: Then Peter said, “Why did the two of you agree to test the Lord's Spirit? The men who buried Ananias are by the door, and they will carry you out!”
translation_verse: Nɛ Pita bishi mo: “Manɛ e ba nɛ fo nɛ fo kul wora kɔnɔkoŋwule a sha kewora Enyɛnpe be Kiyoyu na ŋ keni? Basa nɛ b puli fo kul e wɔ kabuna to na, bumo alɛ beeŋ ta fo alɛ gba loŋ.”

english_verse: At once she fell at Peter's feet and died. When the young men came back in, they found Sapphira lying there dead. So they carried her out and buried her beside her husband.
translation_verse: Epul na to nɛ e tɔr Pita be anishito ndoŋ n wu. Nɛ mbrantiɛbi na ba wu mo nɛ e wu a dese nɛ b sulɔ mo n lar n ya puli m mata mo kul.

english_verse: The church members were afraid, and so was everyone else who heard what had happened. Peter's Unusual Power
translation_verse: Kufu daŋ pɛ asɔriebi na kikɛ nɛ bekama nyam nɛ b daŋ nu kesheŋ ere na ga. Emamachisheŋ damta be kewora be asheŋ

english_verse: The apostles worked many miracles and wonders among the people. All of the Lord's followers often met in the part of the temple known as Solomon's Porch.
translation_verse: Beshuŋipo na daŋ wora emamachisheŋ nɛ kashenteŋ be etɔɔnɛsheŋ damta basa na to. Beyirdapoana na kikɛ daa shɛr Sɔlɔmɔn be Kedɛdɛ na to nna kɔnɔkoŋwuleso.

english_verse: No one outside their group dared join them, even though everyone liked them very much.
translation_verse: Basa pɔtɛana nɛ b daa maŋ yirda na be ekama daa ŋana keyaa tu beyirdapoana na nna n shɛr, ama bumo alɛ kikɛ nyam daa sa beyirdapoana na bunyaŋ ga.

english_verse: Many men and women started having faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Saŋkama malɛ basa damta, beche nɛ benyɛn nɛ b daŋ yirda Enyɛnpe na daa ti beyirdapo na so nna.

english_verse: Then sick people were brought out to the road and placed on mats. It was hoped that Peter would walk by, and his shadow would fall on them and heal them.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal kusɔ nɛ beshuŋipo na daa wora na so, basa daa sulɔ belɔpo nna a lar abɔrbiana so n ya kaa nase egedo nɛ ekelaŋ so nɛ Pita e ba kaa choŋ nɛ mbe kiyoyul nawule gba e baŋ tɔr bumo be beko so.

english_verse: A lot of people living in the towns near Jerusalem brought those who were sick or troubled by evil spirits, and they were all healed. Trouble for the Apostles
translation_verse: Nɛ jimaŋ damtaana shi ndewurbi nɛ a taga to Jerusalɛm na m bar bumo be belɔpo nɛ bekama nyam nɛ b kɔ mbuibi lubi bumo to na, nɛ bumo kikɛ nya alenfia. B ka tɔrɔ beshuŋipo na be asheŋ

english_verse: They arrested the apostles and put them in the city jail.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ b pɛ beshuŋipo na n ti ebu.

english_verse: But that night an angel from the Lord opened the doors of the jail and led the apostles out. The angel said,
translation_verse: Ama kumo be kanyɛso nɛ Enyɛnpe be malaika ba bugi kabuti na be mbuna nseŋ bar bumo kowu m ba kaŋɛ bumo:

english_verse: “Go to the temple and tell the people everything about this new life.”
translation_verse: “Men yɔ bɔrɛlambu na to n ya yili m bɔ kebaawɔtɔ popɔr ere be asheŋ kikɛ n sa basa.”

english_verse: So they went into the temple before sunrise and started teaching. The high priest and his men called together their council, which included all of Israel's leaders. Then they ordered the apostles to be brought to them from the jail.
translation_verse: Beshuŋipo na ka nu loŋ nɛ b yɔ bɔrɛlambu na to karechɛso n ya fara a ŋini basa abɔrɛsheŋ na. Nɛ bɔrɛmatapo nimuso na nɛ mo braana tre Juwebi be benimuana na kikɛ fanɛ bumo, nshɛrwuraana na kikɛ nyam e ba shɛr. Kumo be kaman nɛ b shuŋi fanɛ b ya lara beshuŋipo na kabuti to m ba.

english_verse: The temple police who were sent to the jail did not find the apostles. They returned and said,
translation_verse: Ama mbɔ na ka yɔ kabuti na to, b maŋ ya wu beshuŋipo na nseŋ bɛta n ya kaŋɛ nshɛrwuraana na:

english_verse: “We found the jail locked tight and the guards standing at the doors. But when we opened the doors and went in, we didn't find anyone there.”
translation_verse: “An ka yɔ kabuti na akpa nɛ kumo be akuloŋ kikɛ ti nna m ber so kpakpa nɛ bekumpoana na kikɛ yil mbunaana na to a de so, ama an ka bugi ebu na nɛ esa kikɛ maŋ wɔtɔ.”

english_verse: The captain of the temple police and the chief priests listened to their report, but they did not know what to think about it.
translation_verse: Bɔrɛlambu na to be bekumpo be enimu na nɛ bɔrɛmatapowuraana na ka nu kesheŋ nɛ k wora na nɛ k chinchiŋ bumo ga nɛ b fara a fɛ kusɔ nɛ kesheŋ na beeŋ ba ki.

english_verse: Just then someone came in and said, “Now those men you put in jail are in the temple, teaching the people!”
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ kanyɛn ko ba kaŋɛ bumo: “Men nu nfe, basa nɛ men ti ebu na yil bɔrɛlambu na to a ŋini basa.”

english_verse: The captain went with some of the temple police and brought the apostles back. But they did not use force. They were afraid that the people might start throwing stones at them.
translation_verse: Nɛ enimu na shin nɛ mo nɛ mbe beshumpo na naŋ ya bar beshuŋipo na. B daa maŋ ta katiŋ m pɛ bumo, ŋkpal manɛ so, b daa lɔ kufu nna fanɛ basa na beeŋ kpa bumo ajembu m mɔ.

english_verse: When the apostles were brought before the council, the high priest said to them,
translation_verse: Nɛ b bar beshuŋipo na m ba yili nshɛrwuraana na be anishito nɛ bɔrɛmatapo nimuso na kaŋɛ bumo:

english_verse: “We told you plainly not to teach in the name of Jesus. But look what you have done! You have been teaching all over Jerusalem, and you are trying to blame us for his death.”
translation_verse: “An fiɛ menyi so fanɛ men sa maŋ kaŋ ta kanyɛn na be ketre ŋ ŋini esa kusɔ kama, ama men keni kusɔ nɛ men wora. Menyi shin nɛ menyi be keŋini ere sɔ Jerusalɛm ere to kikɛ a sha keta kanyɛn na be luwu na be turju n deŋi anyi.”

english_verse: Peter and the apostles replied: We don't obey people. We obey God.
translation_verse: Nɛ Pita nɛ mo braana beshuŋipo na kaŋɛ: “Ebɔrɛ e daga an ka nu n sa, mannɛ enyiŋgbasa.

english_verse: You killed Jesus by nailing him to a cross. But the God our ancestors worshiped raised him to life
translation_verse: An nanaana be Ebɔrɛ e daŋ shin nɛ Yesu nɛ men daŋ gbir mo m mata kedibi largato so m mɔ na tiŋi luwu na to.

english_verse: and made him our Leader and Savior. Then God gave him a place at his right side, so that the people of Israel would turn back to him and be forgiven.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ e tiŋi luwu to n yɔ mbe jisoso, ebunyampo be kakpa fanɛ Ejuŋkparpo nɛ Emɔlgapo nɛ Israɛlebi e tiŋ n nya ekpa n lar bumo be alubi to nɛ Ebɔrɛ e ta m paŋ bumo.

english_verse: We are here to tell you about all this, and so is the Holy Spirit, who is God's gift to everyone who obeys God.
translation_verse: Amo be eshɛdajipo e la anyi nɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ nɛ e la Ebɔrɛ be kakɛ nɛ e kɔ a sa bekama nɛ baa nu a sa mo na.”

english_verse: When the council members heard this, they became so angry they wanted to kill the apostles.
translation_verse: Nshɛrwuraana na ka nu loŋ nɛ b nya agbo ga nseŋ yili kumo fanɛ baaŋ shin nɛ b mɔ beshuŋipo na.

english_verse: But one of the members was the Pharisee Gamaliel, a highly respected teacher. He ordered the apostles to be taken out of the room for a little while.
translation_verse: Ama Gameelial, basa na to be Farisinyɛn ko nɛ e daa la mbraŋinipo nsaa la esa nɛ basa kikɛ daa sa bunyaŋ na koso n yili nseŋ shin nɛ b keta beshuŋipo na n lar ekarso gbrɛ

english_verse: Then he said to the council: Men of Israel, be careful what you do with these men.
translation_verse: nseŋ kaŋɛ nshɛrwuraana na: “Israɛlebi, men baa de kusɔ nɛ menyee sha kewora basa ere na so.

english_verse: Later, when the people of our nation were being counted, Judas from Galilee showed up. A lot of people followed him, but he was killed, and all his followers were scattered.
translation_verse: Kede be kaman nɛ Judas Galili be esa na ba lar, jemanɛ nɛ efuli ere so ebi daa karga bumo be basa na n shin nɛ basa damta daŋ ba kaa bɛ mo alɛ gba so. Ama b ka mɔ mo alɛ gba nɛ mbe bebɛsopoana na kikɛ pesaŋ to.

english_verse: So I advise you to stay away from these men. Leave them alone. If what they are planning is something of their own doing, it will fail.
translation_verse: Amoso, mee kaŋɛ menyi nna na fanɛ men sa maŋ wora basa ere shɛŋ. Men yige bumo boeŋ, ŋkpal manɛ so, nɛ nyiŋgbasa gbagba e ta mbe nfɛra ŋ jɔŋɛ bumo be kushuŋ ere, k maaŋ chɛr nseŋ mur.

english_verse: But if God is behind it, you cannot stop it anyway, unless you want to fight against God. The council members agreed with what he said,
translation_verse: Ama nɛ kashenteŋ nɛ k shi Ebɔrɛ kutɔ, men maaŋ tiŋ m pɔɔ bumo so kikɛ. Nɛ menyi alɛ gbagba maŋ de so, menyeeŋ baa wora a da Ebɔrɛ so.”

english_verse: and they called the apostles back in. They had them beaten with a whip and warned them not to speak in the name of Jesus. Then they let them go.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ nshɛrwuraana na nu Gameelial be kamalga na. Nɛ b tre beshuŋipo na m ba shin nɛ b kuya bumo so nseŋ fiɛ bumo so fanɛ b sa maŋ kaŋ naŋ ta Yesu be ketre m malga kikɛ. Kumo be kaman nɛ b sa bumo ekpa nɛ b yɔ.

english_verse: The apostles left the council and were happy, because God had considered them worthy to suffer for the sake of Jesus.
translation_verse: Nɛ beshuŋipo na lar nshɛrwuraana na kutɔ nɛ kagbenefuli ŋkpal Ebɔrɛ ka shin nɛ bumo alɛ tiŋ n ji awurfoŋ ŋkpal Yesu be ketre na so so.

english_verse: Every day they spent time in the temple and in one home after another. They never stopped teaching and telling the good news that Jesus is the Messiah.
translation_verse: Kachɛ kama malɛ b daa luri bɔrɛlambu na to nɛ basa peana nna ŋ kraa ŋini nsaa bɔ baru lela na a sa basa a kaŋɛ fanɛ Yesu e la Kristo na.

english_verse: A lot of people were now becoming followers of the Lord. But some of the ones who spoke Greek started complaining about the ones who spoke Aramaic. They complained that the Greek-speaking widows were not given their share when the food supplies were handed out each day.
translation_verse: Saŋko kananɛ bebɛsopoana na daŋ baa wora keshi a ti so na nɛ kɔnɔgberge tɔr Juwebi nɛ b daa malga Griik to na nɛ bumo nɛ b daa la ndetobia gbagba na so. Juwebi nɛ b daa malga Griik to na e daa kaŋɛ fanɛ bumo na daa gal bumo be bekulpocheana nna a lɛ a maa sa bumo karechɛ kama be kasɔchige be kechɛto na.

english_verse: The twelve apostles called the whole group of followers together and said, “We should not give up preaching God's message in order to serve at tables.
translation_verse: Nɛ beshuŋipo kuduanyɔ na tre bebɛsopoana na kikɛ nyam m ba kaŋɛ bumo: “A maŋ daga an ka yige kebaabɔ Ebɔrɛ be kubɔya na nsaa wɔtɔ a wora keji be kasɔchige be asheŋ.

english_verse: My friends, choose seven men who are respected and wise and filled with God's Spirit. We will put them in charge of these things.
translation_verse: Amoso, bekurgepoana, men lara menyi to be basa ashunu nɛ ekama nyi Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na nɛ kanyiasheŋ ka bɔlɔ bumo to nɛ an shin nɛ b baa keni le be kushuŋ na so

english_verse: We can spend our time praying and serving God by preaching.”
translation_verse: nɛ anyi alɛ e baa wɔ kabɔrɛkule kpakpaso to nseŋ naa bɔ kubɔya na.”

english_verse: This suggestion pleased everyone, and they began by choosing Stephen. He had great faith and was filled with the Holy Spirit. Then they chose Philip, Prochorus, Nicanor, Timon, Parmenas, and also Nicolaus, who worshiped with the Jewish people in Antioch.
translation_verse: Kusɔ nɛ beshuŋipo na daŋ kaŋɛ na daŋ par beyirdapoana na kikɛ ga nɛ b lara Stiven. E daa la esa nɛ yirda nɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na daŋ bɔlɔ mo to nna. B daŋ lara Filip nɛ Prɔkɔres nɛ Nikeenɔɔ nɛ Taimɔn nɛ Paamɛnas nɛ Nikolaws nɛ e daŋ shi Antiɔk n daa la kanyamase nseŋ daŋ ba tuba a bɛ Juwebi be kabɔrɛbɛso so pɔɛŋ m ba ki eyirdapo na.

english_verse: These men were brought to the apostles. Then the apostles prayed and placed their hands on the men to show they had been chosen to do this work.
translation_verse: Bumo nɛ beyirdapoana na daŋ lara m bɔɔ beshuŋipo na enɔ nɛ b ta bumo be enɔana n deŋi n deŋi bumo nɛ b lara na so ŋ kule Ebɔrɛ n sa bumo.

english_verse: God's message spread, and many more people in Jerusalem became followers. Even a large number of priests put their faith in the Lord. Stephen Is Arrested
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ be kubɔya daŋ baa sɔ kakpa kikɛ nna nɛ Jerusalɛm be bebɛsopoana baa wora keshi a ti so nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana na be bedamta ba yirda.

english_verse: But some men from Cyrene and Alexandria were members of a group who called themselves “Free Men.” They started arguing with Stephen. Some others from Cilicia and Asia also argued with him.
translation_verse: Ama nshɛrbu nɛ b daa tre “Basa nɛ b sɔ bumo be amu n yige be Nshɛrbu na” to ebi be beko daŋ ba ji Stiven emɔrɔ. Bumo be beko daŋ shi Sairini nɛ Alɛkzaandria nna. Bumo nɛ Silisia nɛ Eeshia be Juwebi ko e daŋ ba fara a ji Stiven emɔrɔ.

english_verse: But they were no match for Stephen, who spoke with the great wisdom that the Spirit gave him.
translation_verse: Ama b daa maŋ tiŋ n ji m bri mo ŋkpal eleŋgboŋ nɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na daŋ sa mo nɛ e malga so.

english_verse: So they talked some men into saying, “We heard Stephen say terrible things against Moses and God!”
translation_verse: Nɛ b kpal loŋ so n sa basa ko amansherbi nseŋ we n wɔtɔ bumo fanɛ b kaŋɛ le: “An nu e ka bee malga a da Mosis nɛ Ebɔrɛ so.”

english_verse: They turned the people and their leaders and the teachers of the Law of Moses against Stephen. Then they all grabbed him and dragged him in front of the council.
translation_verse: Le nɛ b daŋ wora n nyaŋɛ basa na nɛ benimuana na nɛ mbraŋinipoana na to nɛ b ba nyaŋ Stiven n yɔ nshɛrwuraana na kutɔ

english_verse: Some men agreed to tell lies about Stephen, and they said, “This man keeps on saying terrible things about this holy temple and the Law of Moses.
translation_verse: nseŋ shin nɛ basa ko ba ku efɛ n deŋi mo ŋ kaŋɛ: “Saŋkama kanyɛn ere bee malga a gbiti anyi be bɔrɛlambu cheembi na nɛ Mosis be mbra nna.

english_verse: We have heard him claim that Jesus from Nazareth will destroy this place and change the customs Moses gave us.”
translation_verse: An nu e ka bee kaŋɛ fanɛ Nazarɛt be Yesu na beeŋ bure bɔrɛlambu na nseŋ chɛrga edaŋkaresheŋ nɛ Mosis sa anyi na kikɛ.”

english_verse: Then all the council members stared at Stephen. They saw that his face looked like the face of an angel.
translation_verse: Nshɛrwuraana nɛ b daa tase nshɛr na to na kikɛ daŋ ta bumo be anishi nna n yuu Stiven so n wu mbe anishiakpa ka du fanɛ malaika peya.

english_verse: The high priest asked Stephen, “Are they telling the truth about you?”
translation_verse: Nɛ bɔrɛmatapo nimuso na bishi Stiven: “Kashenteŋ nɛ baa ji ere a?”

english_verse: Stephen answered: Friends, listen to me. Our glorious God appeared to our ancestor Abraham while he was still in Mesopotamia, before he had moved to Haran.
translation_verse: Nɛ Stiven kaŋɛ: “N daana nɛ n tutoana, men nu nfe. Ebɔrɛ nɛ e daga kemaŋkura na e daŋ ba an nananyɛn Eebraham kutɔ, saŋɛ nɛ e daa wɔ Mɛsopoteemia pɔɛŋ m ba kaa n yɔ Haran be kade to na

english_verse: God told him, “Leave your country and your relatives and go to a land that I will show you.”
translation_verse: m ba kaŋɛ mo: ‘Lar fo basa kutɔ nɛ fo efuli ere so n yɔ efuli nɛ meeŋ ŋini fo ere so.’

english_verse: Then Abraham left the land of the Chaldeans and settled in Haran. After his father died, Abraham came and settled in this land where you now live.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ e lar Kaldiya be efuli na so n ya kaa wɔ Haran. Eebraham mo tuto ka ba wu nɛ Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ e kaa m ba efuli nɛ men wɔ ere so.

english_verse: God didn't give him any part of it, not even a square meter. But God did promise to give it to him and his family forever, even though Abraham didn't have any children.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ daa maŋ sa Eebraham kasawule na be gbrɛ nyitiibi kikɛ gba fanɛ k baa la mo peya. Ama Ebɔrɛ daŋ nase kɔnɔ n sa Eebraham fanɛ e beeŋ ta kasawule na n sa mo nɛ mbe kaman to ebi kikɛ. Saŋɛ na so nɛ Eebraham daa maa kɔ mbia.

english_verse: God said Abraham's descendants would live for a while in a foreign land. There they would be slaves and would be mistreated
translation_verse: Le nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ kaŋɛ mo: ‘Fo kaman to ebi beeŋ ba kaa wɔ efuli pɔtɛ ko so, kakpa nɛ baaŋ baa la anya nɛ b tɔrɔ bumo ga nfɛ alfa ana.

english_verse: But he also said, “I will punish the nation that makes them slaves. Then later they will come and worship me in this place.”
translation_verse: Ama meeŋ gberge basa nɛ fo kaman to ebi beeŋ shuŋ na kusoe pɔɛŋ n shin nɛ fo basa na e lar efuli na so m ba nfe m ba kaa bunyaŋ ma.’

english_verse: God said to Abraham, “Every son in each family must be circumcised to show you have kept your agreement with me.” So when Isaac was eight days old, Abraham circumcised him. Later, Isaac circumcised his son Jacob, and Jacob circumcised his twelve sons.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ mo nɛ Eebraham nase kɔnɔ nɛ e kaŋɛ Eebraham fanɛ mbe kaman to ebi e baa ku atutu a ŋini fanɛ b sɔ kɔnɔ naseso na. Amoso, b ka kurge Aizek mbe kachɛ burwasopo nɛ Eebraham ku mo kututu nɛ Aizek malɛ ba ku Jeekɔb peya nɛ Jeekɔb malɛ ku mbe mbia, basa kuduanyɔ nɛ b juŋkpar Israɛlebi be kanaŋ kuduanyɔ na be atutu.

english_verse: These men were our ancestors. Joseph was also one of our famous ancestors. His brothers were jealous of him and sold him as a slave to be taken to Egypt. But God was with him
translation_verse: Bejuŋkparpo ere daŋ kurge bumo sipo Josɛf yurkishi nna n ta mo n fa n shin nɛ e ki kenya ashi Ijipt be efuli so. Ama Ebɔrɛ daa maŋ yige mo n to.

english_verse: and rescued him from all his troubles. God made him so wise that the Egyptian king Pharaoh thought highly of him. The king even made Joseph governor over Egypt and put him in charge of everything he owned.
translation_verse: E daŋ lara mo ashi mbe etɔrɔ kikɛ to nseŋ sa mo kanyiasheŋ nɛ kebaawɔtɔ nɛ a par Ijipt be ewura Fɛɛro ga nɛ Fɛɛro shin nɛ Josɛf ki efuli na so be gomena nɛ mbe kowu to ebi kikɛ so be enimu.

english_verse: Everywhere in Egypt and Canaan the grain crops failed. There was terrible suffering, and our ancestors could not find enough to eat.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ akoŋgboŋ ko tɔr Ijipt nɛ Keenan be efuliana kikɛ so m bar awurfoŋ damta ga nɛ an nanaana fin ajibi kanaŋkama ŋ gben.

english_verse: But when Jacob heard there was grain in Egypt, he sent our ancestors there for the first time.
translation_verse: Nɛ Jeekɔb ba nu fanɛ ajibi wɔ Ijipt be efuli so nseŋ shuŋi mbe mbia, an nananyɛnana ndoŋ. Kede to e daa la bumo be sososo be keyɔ ndoŋ.

english_verse: It was on their second trip that Joseph told his brothers who he was, and the king learned about Joseph's family.
translation_verse: B ka naŋ bɛta n yɔ kela nyɔsopo to nɛ Josɛf shin nɛ mo daana na pin mo, kumo be kaman nɛ Fɛɛro ba pin Josɛf be basa.

english_verse: His father went to Egypt and died there, just as our ancestors did.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Jeekɔb kaa n yɔ Ijipt be efuli so, ndoŋ nɛ mo nɛ an nanaana kikɛ ya wu n wu n loge

english_verse: Later their bodies were taken back to Shechem and placed in the tomb that Abraham had bought from the sons of Hamor.
translation_verse: nɛ b ta bumo n yɔ Shɛkɛm n ya puli kebeelaŋ ko nɛ Eebraham daŋ tɔ ashi Hamɔ be kanaŋ to ebi kutɔ na to.

english_verse: Finally, the time came for God to do what he had promised Abraham. By then the number of our people in Egypt had greatly increased.
translation_verse: Ama kɔnɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ nase n sa Eebraham na be jemanɛ ka ba taga to, k bɔla ekpa nɛ anyi be basa nɛ b daa wɔ Ijipt na malɛ wora keshi n ti so.

english_verse: Another king was ruling Egypt, and he didn't know anything about Joseph.
translation_verse: Jemanɛ na nɛ ewura popɔr ko nɛ e daa maŋ nyi Josɛf, ji Ijipt be efuli na so be kuwura.

english_verse: He tricked our ancestors and was cruel to them. He even made them leave their babies outside, so they would die.
translation_verse: Mo e daŋ fule anyi be basa nseŋ tɔrɔ an nanaana ga n tintiŋ bumo n shin nɛ b ta bumo be mbi popɔrbi n ya nase nde na be ntamaŋ to nɛ b wu.

english_verse: During this time Moses was born. He was a very beautiful child, and for three months his parents took care of him in their home.
translation_verse: Amo be jemanɛ nɛ b kurge kayɛrbi Mosis ŋ keni mo so epe afɔl asa pɔɛŋ

english_verse: Then when they were forced to leave him outside, the king's daughter found him and raised him as her own son.
translation_verse: nseŋ ta mo n ya nase kaboŋ ko nɛ e wu nɛ Fɛɛro pibiche ya ta mo n ya ki mo peya ŋ keni mo so nɛ e daŋ.

english_verse: Moses was given the best education in Egypt. He was a strong man and a powerful speaker.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nɛ b ŋini mo Ijipt be kanyiasheŋ kikɛ nɛ e ba ki esagboŋ ashi mbe kamalga nɛ mbe asheŋ woraso kikɛ to.

english_verse: One day he saw an Egyptian mistreating one of them. So he rescued the man and killed the Egyptian.
translation_verse: E ka yɔ nɛ e ya wu Ijipt be esa ko ka bee tɔrɔ Israɛl be esa ko nɛ e ya chɛ Israɛl be esa na to n sɔ mbe kɔnɔ m mɔ Ijipt be esa na.

english_verse: Moses thought the rest of his people would realize God was going to use him to set them free. But they didn't understand.
translation_verse: E daa nyi fanɛ mo peebi na daa beeŋ pin fanɛ mo nɛ Ebɔrɛ daa sha keshin nɛ e sɔ bumo n yige, ama b daa maŋ pin kumo be loŋ.

english_verse: The next day Moses saw two of his own people fighting, and he tried to make them stop. He said, “Men, you are both Israelites. Why are you so cruel to each other?”
translation_verse: Kumo be ŋklade nɛ e wu Israɛlebi be benyɔ ka bee bile nɛ e yɔ nɛ e ya wora ania m barga bumo to ŋ kaŋɛ: ‘Men nu nfe, men la basa koŋwule nna nɛ manɛ e ba nɛ menyee wora a da abar so le?’

english_verse: But the man who had started the fight pushed Moses aside and asked, “Who made you our ruler and judge?
translation_verse: Nɛ emo nɛ e daŋ wora n jija na ŋin Mosis n yili ekarso nseŋ bishi mo: ‘Wanɛ e ta fo ŋ ki anyi be enimu nɛ anyi be demujipo?

english_verse: Are you going to kill me, just as you killed that Egyptian yesterday?”
translation_verse: Fo yɛ fo mɔ ma alɛ gba nna fanɛ kananɛ ndre fo mɔ Ijipt be kanyɛn na nna a?’

english_verse: When Moses heard this, he ran away to live in the country of Midian. His two sons were born there.
translation_verse: Mosis ka nu loŋ nɛ e shile Ijipt be efuli na so n ya kaa wɔ Midian be efuli so. Ndoŋ nɛ e kurge mbinyɛnbi anyɔ.

english_verse: Forty years later, an angel appeared to Moses from a burning bush in the desert near Mount Sinai.
translation_verse: Mosis ka wɔ Midian be efuli na so kumo be nfɛ adena be kaman nɛ malaika lar mo so kiyi to ashi kupumbi chɔɔso ko to. Ndoŋ daŋ mata Sainai be kebee na so nna.

english_verse: Moses was surprised by what he saw. He went closer to get a better look, and the Lord said,
translation_verse: Kusɔ nɛ Mosis daŋ wu na daŋ chinchiŋ mo ga nɛ e firgi n taga to nɛ e keni nseŋ nu Enyɛnpe be ebɔl ka bee kaŋɛ:

english_verse: “I am the God who was worshiped by your ancestors, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.” Moses started shaking all over and didn't dare to look at the bush.
translation_verse: ‘Ma e la fo nanaana be Ebɔrɛ na, Eebraham nɛ Aizek nɛ Jeekɔb be Ebɔrɛ.’ Nɛ kufu pɛ Mosis ga nɛ e chicha a maŋ naŋ tiŋ nɛ e keni kakpa na.

english_verse: The Lord said to him, “Take off your sandals, because the place where you are standing is holy.
translation_verse: Nɛ Enyɛnpe kaŋɛ mo: ‘Lara fo asɛbta na, ŋkpal manɛ so, kakpa nɛ fo yil ere la kasawule cheeŋ nna.

english_verse: With my own eyes I have seen the suffering of my people in Egypt. I have heard their groans and have come down to rescue them. Now I am sending you back to Egypt.”
translation_verse: N wu kekɔrfɛ nɛ tɔrɔ damta nɛ ma basa wɔ Ijipt be efuli so a nya. N nu bumo be kushu m ba nɛ m ba mɔlga bumo. Nu nfe, meeŋ shuŋi fo Ijipt.’

english_verse: This was the same Moses that the people rejected by saying, “Who made you our leader and judge?” God's angel had spoken to Moses from the bush. And God had even sent the angel to help Moses rescue the people and be their leader.
translation_verse: Mosis koŋwule ere nɛ Israɛlebi daŋ kini nseŋ bishi mo: ‘Wanɛ e ta fo ŋ ki anyi be enimu nɛ anyi be demujipo?’ Mo nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ bɔla malaika nɛ e daŋ wu kupumbi chɔɔso na to na so n shuŋi fanɛ Israɛl be enimu nɛ emɔlgapo na.

english_verse: In Egypt and at the Red Sea and in the desert, Moses rescued the people by working miracles and wonders for
translation_verse: Mo e daŋ juŋkpar bumo n wora emamachisheŋ nɛ kashenteŋ be etɔɔnɛsheŋ damta ashi Ijipt nɛ Teku Peper na to nɛ jemanɛ nɛ b daa wɔ kiyi to nfɛ adena na kikɛ.

english_verse: Moses is the one who told the people of Israel, “God will choose one of your people to be a prophet, just as he chose me.”
translation_verse: Mo, Mosis koŋwule na e daŋ kaŋɛ Israɛlebi: ‘Ebɔrɛ beeŋ sa menyi anebi fanɛ kananɛ e shuŋi ma na, e beeŋ ba kaa la menyi to be eko nna.’

english_verse: Moses brought our people together in the desert, and the angel spoke to him on Mount Sinai. There he was given these life-giving words to pass on to us.
translation_verse: Mosis koŋwule na nɛ Israɛlebi nɛ b daŋ shɛr kiyi to na e daa la ndoŋ. Mo nɛ an nanaana nɛ malaika nɛ e daŋ malga mo kutɔ ashi Sainai be kebee na so e daa la. Mo nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ ta mbe kubɔya nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na n sa nɛ e ba sa anyi.

english_verse: But our ancestors refused to obey Moses. They rejected him and wanted to go back to Egypt.
translation_verse: Ama an nanaana daŋ kini kenu n sa Mosis nseŋ kplaŋ mo so nseŋ naa yɛlga kenaŋ bɛta n yɔ Ijipt be efuli so.

english_verse: Then they made an idol in the shape of a calf. They offered sacrifices to the idol and were pleased with what they had done.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ b pɔr kegbir ko fanɛ kenabi nseŋ mɔ asɔ n wora kejigboŋ n lɔŋɛ kumo a bunyaŋ kusɔ nɛ bumo gbagba pɔr na.

english_verse: God turned his back on his people and left them. Then they worshiped the stars in the sky, just as it says in the Book of the Prophets, “People of Israel, you didn't offer sacrifices and offerings to me during those
translation_verse: Nɛ Ebɔrɛ pal kaman n sa bumo n shin nɛ baa bunyaŋ achɛkpabi fanɛ kananɛ anebiana na daŋ sibɛ ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ: ‘Israɛlebi, mannɛ ma nɛ men daŋ mɔ asɔbɔya kiyi na to nfɛ adena n sa na.

english_verse: Instead, you carried the tent where the god Molech is worshiped, and you took along the star of your god Rephan. You made those idols and worshiped them. So now I will have you carried off beyond Babylonia.”
translation_verse: Kegbir Molɛk be wajɛbu nɛ men daŋ keta n ti menyi be kegbir pɔrso Rɛfam nɛ k duli kechɛkpabi na so. Amo agbir anyɔ na nɛ men daŋ lɔŋɛ a bunyaŋ. Amoso, meeŋ shin nɛ b lara menyi ashi menyi be efuli ere so n yɔ kufɔ kufɔ, Babilɔn be kaman.’

english_verse: The tent where our ancestors worshiped God was with them in the desert. This was the same tent that God had commanded Moses to make. And it was made like the model that Moses had seen.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ be wajɛbu nɛ k daa ŋini fanɛ Ebɔrɛ wɔ an nanaana kutɔ na nɛ bumo e daa la kiyi to. Kananɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ ŋini Mosis fanɛ e wora kumo na gbagba chap nɛ e daŋ wora kumo.

english_verse: Later it was given to our ancestors, and they took it with them when they went with Joshua. They carried the tent along as they took over the land from those people that God had chased out for them. Our ancestors used this tent until the time of King David.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman, an nanaana nɛ bumo tutoana daŋ ta wajɛbu na n sa na, daŋ keta kumo, saŋɛ nɛ bumo nɛ Joshuwa daa la na nna n yɔ efuliana nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ ju amo to be basa n lɛ nɛ an nanaana sɔ bumo be nsawule na kikɛ so. Ndoŋ nɛ wajɛbu na daŋ ba kaa shir a wɔ hale n ya fo Ewura Deevid be jemanɛ.

english_verse: He pleased God and asked him if he could build a house of worship for the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Mbe asheŋ daŋ bɔlɔ Ebɔrɛ kenishi ga nɛ e kule Ebɔrɛ fanɛ e shin nɛ e pɔr ebu n sa mo ere, Jeekɔb be Ebɔrɛ na.

english_verse: And it was finally King Solomon who built a house for God.
translation_verse: Ama Ewura Sɔlɔmɔn e daŋ ba pɔr kumo.

english_verse: But the Most High God doesn't live in houses made by humans. It is just as the prophet said, when he spoke for the Lord,
translation_verse: Ama Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ pe maŋ la nyiŋgbasa be nwu pɔrso fanɛ kananɛ anebiana kaŋɛ fanɛ Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ na:

english_verse: “Heaven is my throne, and the earth is my footstool. What kind of house will you build for me? In what place will I rest?
translation_verse: ‘Ebɔrɛso e la ma kuwurjiakpa nɛ kasawule so la ma aya be kusɔ yiliso so. Nɛ nuso be ebu nɛ menyeeŋ pɔr n sa ma? Nnɛ nɛ meeŋ baa wɔ a wushi?

english_verse: Is there one prophet that your ancestors didn't mistreat? They killed the prophets who told about the coming of the One Who Obeys God. And now you have turned against him and killed him.
translation_verse: Anebi mo nɛ men nanaana maŋ tɔrɔ! B mɔ Ebɔrɛ be mbɔ nɛ b daŋ wu ŋ kaŋɛ dra na kikɛ fanɛ Ebɔrɛ be Kenya cheembi beeŋ ba na. Kabre menyi alɛ debɔr mo nseŋ mɔ mo.

english_verse: Angels gave you God's Law, but you still don't obey it. Stephen Is Stoned to Death
translation_verse: Menyi nɛ emalaika daŋ bar Ebɔrɛ be mbra na, ama men kini kebɛ mbra na so.” B ka kpa Stiven ajembu m mɔ be asheŋ

english_verse: When the council members heard Stephen's speech, they were angry and furious.
translation_verse: Nshɛrwuraana na ka nu kusɔ nɛ Stiven bee kaŋɛ na nɛ b nya agbo ga n we anyi to agboso.

english_verse: But Stephen was filled with the Holy Spirit. He looked toward heaven, where he saw our glorious God and Jesus standing at his right side.
translation_verse: Nɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na luri m bɔlɔ Stiven to nɛ e maŋ kumu so ŋ keni ebɔrɛso n wu Ebɔrɛ be kemaŋkura nɛ Yesu yil Ebɔrɛ be jisoso, ebunyampo be kakpa.

english_verse: Then Stephen said, “I see heaven open and the Son of Man standing at the right side of God!”
translation_verse: Nɛ e kaŋɛ basa na: “Men keni, n wu ebɔrɛso ka bugi nɛ Nyiŋgbasa Pibinyɛn yil Ebɔrɛ be jisoso.”

english_verse: The council members shouted and covered their ears. At once they all attacked Stephen
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ b ponte eleŋso ga nseŋ ti bumo be asoe nseŋ yarase epul na to kɔnɔkoŋwuleso

english_verse: and dragged him out of the city. Then they started throwing stones at him. The men who had brought charges against him put their coats at the feet of a young man named Saul.
translation_verse: n ya gberge mo n lar kadegboŋ na to ŋ kpa mo ajembu m mɔ. Kabrantiɛbia ko nɛ b daa tre Sɔɔl kutɔ nɛ eshɛdajipoana na daŋ yige bumo be asɔbuuso nɛ e bee keni so.

english_verse: As Stephen was being stoned to death, he called out, “Lord Jesus, please welcome me!”
translation_verse: B daŋ kraa wɔ kekpa Stiven ajembu to nna nɛ e kule Enyɛnpe le: “Enyɛnpe Yesu, shin nɛ ma kiyoyu e ba fo kutɔ.”

english_verse: He knelt down and shouted, “Lord, don't blame them for what they have done.” Then he died.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ e gbir nseŋ kaŋɛ awɔrso: “Enyɛnpe, ta bumo be kulubi ere m paŋ bumo.” Kede be kaman nɛ e wu.

english_verse: Saul started making a lot of trouble for the church. He went from house to house, arresting men and women and putting them in jail. The Good News Is Preached in Samaria
translation_verse: Ama Sɔɔl malɛ daa kɔ a fin kemur beyirdapoana na kikɛ nna nyam. E daa nite basa peana nna a nyaŋ beyirdapoana na, benyɛn nɛ beche kikɛ a lar n ya kaa ti ebu. B ka bɔ baru lela na n sa Samɛriaebi be asheŋ

english_verse: The Lord's followers who had been scattered went from place to place, telling the good news.
translation_verse: Beyirdapo na nɛ b daŋ pesaŋ to na daŋ yɔ kaplɛkama nna n ya kaa bɔ kubɔya na.

english_verse: Philip went to the city of Samaria and told the people about Christ.
translation_verse: Filip daŋ yɔ Samɛria nna n ya bɔ Yesu Kristo na be asheŋ n sa ndoŋebi.

english_verse: They crowded around Philip because they were eager to hear what he was saying and to see him work miracles.
translation_verse: Jimaŋana na ka nu Filip be kamalga nseŋ wu emamachisheŋ nɛ e wora na nɛ b bugi asoe n nu mbe kamalga kɔnɔkoŋwuleso.

english_verse: Many people with evil spirits were healed, and the spirits went out of them with a shout. A lot of paralyzed and lame people were also healed.
translation_verse: B daŋ wu mbuibi lubiana ka boŋ to awɔrso n lar basa damta to nseŋ naŋ wu eyurwusowuraana nɛ ebobi damta gba ka nya alenfia.

english_verse: Everyone in that city was very glad because of what was happening.
translation_verse: Amoso, kagbenefuli daŋ bɔlɔ Samɛria be kade na to kikɛ nna.

english_verse: For some time a man named Simon had lived there and had amazed the people of Samaria. He practiced witchcraft and claimed to be somebody great.
translation_verse: Jemanɛ na so malɛ kikɛ nɛ kanyɛn ko nɛ baa tre Saimɔn daa kɔ ŋkilgi be kudur a wɔ Samɛria be kade na to a wora emamachisheŋ a shin nɛ Samɛriaebi na be nnɔ daa mɔ bumo ga. E daa tre mbe kumu esagboŋ ko nna.

english_verse: Everyone, rich and poor, crowded around him. They said, “This man is the power of God called ‘The Great Power.’ ”
translation_verse: Nɛ kade na to be basa kikɛ, benimu nɛ mbia daa bugi asoe a nu asɔ nɛ e bee kaŋɛ. Le nɛ b daa kaŋɛ: “Kanyɛn ere e la Ebɔrɛ be eleŋ nɛ baa tre Eleŋgboŋ na.”

english_verse: For a long time, Simon had used witchcraft to amaze the people, and they kept crowding around him.
translation_verse: Saŋɛ nɛ e daŋ fara a wora emamachisheŋ ŋana so damta na daa maŋ taga to, amoso, b daŋ bugi bumo be asoe kikɛ nna n nu kusɔ kikɛ nɛ e daŋ kaŋɛ bumo.

english_verse: But when they believed what Philip was saying about God's kingdom and about the name of Jesus Christ, they were all baptized.
translation_verse: Ama b ka yirda Filip be baru lela nɛ e bee bɔ a kaŋɛ Ebɔrɛ be kuwura na nɛ Yesu Kristo be ketre be asheŋ na, nɛ b bɛr bumo kabɔrɛbɛr, beche nɛ benyɛn kikɛ.

english_verse: The apostles in Jerusalem heard that some people in Samaria had accepted God's message, and they sent Peter and John.
translation_verse: Beshuŋipo nɛ b daa wɔ Jerusalɛm to nseŋ nu fanɛ Samɛriaebi yirda Ebɔrɛ be kubɔya na nɛ b shuŋi Pita nɛ Jɔn bumo kutɔ.

english_verse: When the two apostles arrived, they prayed that these people would be given the Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: B ka yɔ nɛ b ya kule Ebɔrɛ n sa ndoŋ be beyirdapoana na fanɛ b nya Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na,

english_verse: Before this, the Holy Spirit had not been given to any of them, though some of them had been baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.
translation_verse: ŋkpal manɛ so, saŋɛ na nɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na maŋ naŋ gbelge bumo be ekama so. Enyɛnpe Yesu be ketre to nawule nɛ b daŋ bɛr bumo kabɔrɛbɛr.

english_verse: Peter and John then placed their hands on everyone who had faith in the Lord, and they were given the Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Nɛ Pita nɛ Jɔn ta bumo be enɔana n deŋi n deŋi bumo so nɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na gbelge bumo so.

english_verse: Simon noticed that the Spirit was given only when the apostles placed their hands on the people. So he brought money
translation_verse: Saimɔn ka wu beshuŋipo na ka ta bumo be enɔana n deŋi n deŋi basa na so nɛ b nya Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na nɛ e ta amansherbi m ba kaŋɛ Pita nɛ Jɔn:

english_verse: and said to Peter and John, “Let me have this power too! Then anyone I place my hands on will also be given the Holy Spirit.”
translation_verse: “Men sɔ nseŋ sa ma eleŋ na nɛ esa kama nɛ ma alɛ ta ma enɔ n deŋi mo so e nya Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na.”

english_verse: Peter said to him, “You and your money will both end up in hell if you think you can buy God's gift!
translation_verse: Nɛ Pita kaŋɛ mo: “Fo nɛ fo amansherbi ere beeŋ mur, ŋkpal fo ka bee fɛ ketɔ Ebɔrɛ be kakɛ so.

english_verse: You don't have any part in this, and God sees that your heart isn't right.
translation_verse: Fo maŋ kɔ shɛŋ anyi be kushuŋ ere to, ŋkpal manɛ so, fo kagbene maŋ bɔla ekpa ashi Ebɔrɛ kutɔ.

english_verse: Get rid of these evil thoughts and ask God to forgive you.
translation_verse: Amoso, lar le be nfɛra lubi ere to nseŋ kule Enyɛnpe na nɛ e ta fo nfɛra fɛso lubi ere m paŋ fo.

english_verse: I can see that you are jealous and bound by your evil ways.”
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, n wu yurkishi lubi ka bɔlɔ fo to nɛ alubi nyaŋ fo kpakpa a wɔtɔ.”

english_verse: Simon said, “Please pray to the Lord, so that what you said won't happen to me.”
translation_verse: Nɛ Saimɔn kaŋɛ Pita nɛ Jɔn: “Jande, men kule Ebɔrɛ n sa ma nɛ asheŋ nɛ men malga ere be kekama e sa maŋ wora ma.”
