english_verse: After Peter and John had preached about the Lord, they returned to Jerusalem. On their way they told the good news in many villages of Samaria. Philip and an Ethiopian Official
translation_verse: Pita nɛ Jɔn ka ji bumo be shɛda nseŋ bɔ Enyɛnpe be kubɔya na n loge nɛ b bɛta n yɔ Jerusalɛm. B ka daa wɔ ekpa to a yɔ b daŋ bɔ baru lela na nna n sa Samɛria be ndewurbiebi damta. Filip nɛ Itiopia be krachigboŋ be asheŋ

english_verse: The Lord's angel said to Philip, “Go south along the desert road that leads from Jerusalem to Gaza.”
translation_verse: Nɛ Enyɛnpe be malaika ko kaŋɛ Filip: “Ta a ba kapaso, bela ase ŋ koso n yɔ ekpa nɛ k shi Jerusalɛm a yɔ Gaaza na.” Basa maŋ naa nite ekpa na so ga.

english_verse: So Philip left. An important Ethiopian official happened to be going along that road in his chariot. He was the chief treasurer for Candace, the Queen of Ethiopia. The official had gone to Jerusalem to worship
translation_verse: Nɛ Filip bela ase n yɔ. Saŋɛ na so nɛ Itiopia be krachigboŋ ko wɔ ekpa na to a yɔ epe.

english_verse: The Spirit told Philip to catch up with the chariot.
translation_verse: Nɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na kaŋɛ Filip: “Nite n yɔ gbaŋɛturko ere akpa n ya tu kumo.”

english_verse: Philip ran up close and heard the man reading aloud from the book of Isaiah. Philip asked him, “Do you understand what you are reading?”
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Filip shile n yɔ n ya nu e ka bee kraŋ anebi Aizaaya be kawɔl nɛ e bishi mo: “Fee pin kusɔ nɛ fee kraŋ ere to a?”

english_verse: The official answered, “How can I understand unless someone helps me?” He then invited Philip to come up and sit beside him.
translation_verse: Nɛ krachigboŋ na bishi mo: “Esa baa maŋ ŋini ma, nuso nɛ ma alɛ beeŋ tiŋ m pin amo to?” Kumo be kaman nɛ e kule Filip fanɛ e dii gbaŋɛturko na n tu mo n chena.

english_verse: The man was reading the passage that said, “He was led like a sheep on its way to be killed. He was silent as a lamb whose wool is being cut off, and he did not say a word.
translation_verse: Abɔrɛsibɛ na to be kakpa nɛ e daa kraŋ na nde: “E daa du fanɛ kubolpɔ nɛ b kɔ a yɔ nɛ b ya teŋ nna. E daa du fanɛ kpakpafɔlbi nɛ baa ku kumo be afuibi nɛ k la to boeŋ nna. E daa maŋ kaŋɛ shɛŋ.

english_verse: He was treated like a nobody and did not receive a fair trial. How can he have children, if his life is snatched away?”
translation_verse: B daŋ fɛl mo ga nseŋ kini keji mo demu nɛ kumo be ekpa so. Wanɛ e naaŋ tiŋ m pin mbe jemanɛ na to ebi be alubi to? Ŋkpal manɛ so, b bar mbe durnya ere to be ŋkpa ekar.”

english_verse: The official said to Philip, “Tell me, was the prophet talking about himself or about someone else?”
translation_verse: Nɛ krachigboŋ na bishi Filip: “Kaŋɛ ma esa nɛ anebi ere bee malga mbe asheŋ ere, mo gbagba be asheŋ ŋko esa pɔtɛ?”

english_verse: So Philip began at this place in the Scriptures and explained the good news about Jesus.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Filip fara abɔrɛsibɛ be kakpa nɛ kanyɛn na daa kraŋ na gbagba m bɔ Yesu be baru lela na n sa mo.

english_verse: As they were going along the road, they came to a place where there was some water. The official said, “Look! Here is some water. Why can't I be baptized?”
translation_verse: [Nɛ Filip kaŋɛ mo: “Fo baŋ yirda nɛ fo kagbene kikɛ, meeŋ bɛr fo kabɔrɛbɛr na.” Nɛ e shuli so ŋ kaŋɛ: “N yirda fanɛ Yesu Kristo e la Ebɔrɛ Pibinyɛn na.”]

english_verse: He ordered the chariot to stop. Then they both went down into the water, and Philip baptized him.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ e shin nɛ gbaŋɛturko na yili nɛ bumo benyɔ na, Filip nɛ krachigboŋ na luri nchu na to nɛ Filip bɛr mo kabɔrɛbɛr na.

english_verse: After they had come out of the water, the Lord's Spirit took Philip away. The official never saw him again, but he was very happy as he went on his way.
translation_verse: B ka bee lar nchu na to nɛ Enyɛnpe be Kiyoyu na ba ta Filip ndoŋ nɛ krachigboŋ na maŋ naŋ wu mo nseŋ la to m pɛ ekpa a yɔ nɛ kagbenefuli.

english_verse: Philip later appeared in Azotus. He went from town to town, all the way to Caesarea, telling people about Jesus.
translation_verse: Azotas nɛ Filip daŋ wu fanɛ Kiyoyu na yɛr mo nɛ e yɔ nde na kikɛ to n ya kaa bɔ baru lela na n ya fo Sizariya.

english_verse: Now get up and go into the city, where you will be told what to do.”
translation_verse: Niŋi to n yɔ kade to nɛ b ŋini fo kusɔ nɛ k daga nɛ fo wora.”

english_verse: I will show him how much he must suffer for worshiping in my name.”
translation_verse: Ma alɛ gbagba beeŋ ŋini mo tɔrɔ nɛ a daga e ka ji n sa ma.”

english_verse: When Saul arrived in Jerusalem, he tried to join the followers. But they were all afraid of him, because they did not believe he was a true follower.
translation_verse: Sɔɔl ka yɔ Jerusalɛm n ya kaa sha keba bebɛsopo na to, b daa maŋ yirda fanɛ e la ebɛsopo nseŋ daa ŋana mo.

english_verse: and he has seen a vision. He saw a man named Ananias coming to him and putting his hands on him, so he could see again.”
translation_verse: E bee kule Ebɔrɛ nseŋ wu kanyɛn ko ashi mbe bɔrɛdare to nɛ baa tre Ananiyas ka ba luri n ta mbe enɔana n deŋi mbe kumu so nɛ e naŋ bɛta a wu.”

english_verse: Suddenly something like fish scales fell from Saul's eyes, and he could see. He got up and was baptized.
translation_verse: Epul na to nɛ kusɔ ko fanɛ kɔrɔtɔ be afɔfɔ lar Sɔɔl be anishito n tɔr nɛ e naŋ fara a wu ŋ koso nɛ b bɛr mo kabɔrɛbɛr.

english_verse: Saul kept on threatening to kill the Lord's followers. He even went to the high priest
translation_verse: Saŋɛ ere so kikɛ nɛ Sɔɔl wɔtɔ a kɔ a fin kemur Enyɛnpe be bebɛsopoana na.

english_verse: and asked for letters to the leaders of the synagogues in Damascus. He did this because he wanted to arrest and take to Jerusalem any man or woman who had accepted the Lord's Way.
translation_verse: E daŋ yɔ bɔrɛmatapo nimuso kutɔ nna n ya kule mo nwɔl nɛ a beeŋ tiŋ ŋ ŋini Damaskɔs be nshɛrbu to be Juwebi na esa nɛ e la mo. Loŋ na e beeŋ tiŋ m pɛ ndoŋebi be ekama, benyɛn nɛ beche nɛ baa bɛ Enyɛnpe be ekpa na so, n yɔ Jerusalɛm.

english_verse: He fell to the ground and heard a voice saying, “Saul! Saul! Why are you so cruel to me?”
translation_verse: Nɛ e tɔr kasawule nseŋ nu ebɔl ka bee bishi mo: “Sɔɔl, Sɔɔl, manɛ e ba nɛ fee tɔrɔ ma?”

english_verse: “Who are you?” Saul asked. “I am Jesus,” the Lord answered. “I am the one you are so cruel to.
translation_verse: Nɛ Sɔɔl bishi mo: “Fo wanɛ Enyɛnpe?” Nɛ ebɔl na kaŋɛ: “Ma Yesu nɛ fee tɔrɔ na.

english_verse: The men with Saul stood there speechless. They had heard the voice, but they had not seen anyone.
translation_verse: Basa nɛ bumo nɛ Sɔɔl daa yɔ na be nnɔ daŋ mɔ bumo ga nɛ b kilgi a yil cham. B daŋ nu ebɔl na, ama bumo alɛ daa maŋ wu esa kama.

english_verse: Saul got up from the ground, and when he opened his eyes, he could not see a thing. Someone then led him by the hand to Damascus,
translation_verse: Sɔɔl ka niŋi to m bugi mbe anishi e daa maŋ tiŋ n wu shɛŋ. Ndoŋ nna nɛ b pɛ mbe enɔ to ŋ keta mo n luri Damaskɔs to.

english_verse: and for three days he was blind and did not eat or drink.
translation_verse: Nchɛ nsa nɛ e maa tiŋ a wu, jemanɛ na malɛ kikɛ so nɛ e maa ji ŋko a nuu shɛŋ.

english_verse: A follower named Ananias lived in Damascus, and the Lord spoke to him in a vision. Ananias answered, “Lord, here I am.”
translation_verse: Ebɛsopo ko daa wɔ Damaskɔs to nɛ baa tre mo Ananiyas. Mo nɛ Enyɛnpe daŋ bɔla mbe bɔrɛdare to ŋ kaŋɛ: “Ananiyas.” Nɛ Ananiyas shuli ŋ kaŋɛ: “Ma nde Enyɛnpe.”

english_verse: The Lord said to him, “Get up and go to the house of Judas on Straight Street. When you get there, you will find a man named Saul from the city of Tarsus. Saul is praying,
translation_verse: Nɛ Enyɛnpe kaŋɛ mo: “Bela ase n yɔ kubɔrbi niŋiso to n ya luri Judas pe m bishi kanyɛn nɛ e shi Taases nɛ baa tre mo Sɔɔl na be asheŋ.

english_verse: Ananias replied, “Lord, a lot of people have told me about the terrible things this man has done to your followers in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Nɛ Ananiyas kaŋɛ: “Enyɛnpe, basa damta kaŋɛ ma kanyɛn ere be asheŋ fanɛ kananɛ e tɔrɔ fo basa ashi Jerusalɛm.

english_verse: Now the chief priests have given him the power to come here and arrest anyone who worships in your name.”
translation_verse: Mo alɛ kule ekpa ashi bɔrɛmatapowuraana na kutɔ nna m ba Damaskɔs nfe nɛ e ba pɛ bekama nɛ baa bɛ fo so na nna.”

english_verse: The Lord said to Ananias, “Go! I have chosen him to tell foreigners, kings, and the people of Israel about me.
translation_verse: Nɛ Enyɛnpe kaŋɛ: “Fo ere e yɔ de, ŋkpal manɛ so, ma e lara mo nɛ e baa shuŋ ma n shin nɛ nnyamase nɛ bewura nɛ Israɛlebi e pin ma.

english_verse: Ananias left and went into the house where Saul was staying. Ananias placed his hands on him and said, “Saul, the Lord Jesus has sent me. He is the same one who appeared to you along the road. He wants you to be able to see and to be filled with the Holy Spirit.”
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Ananiyas yɔ kowu na to n ya ta mbe enɔana n deŋi Sɔɔl so nseŋ kaŋɛ: “Ekurgepo Sɔɔl, Enyɛnpe Yesu gbagba, emo nɛ fo wu ekpa to na e shuŋi ma. Mo e shuŋi ma nɛ fo naa tiŋ a wu nɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na e tiŋ n luri fo to.”

english_verse: Then he ate and felt much better. Saul Preaches in Damascus For several days Saul stayed with the Lord's followers in Damascus.
translation_verse: Kede be kaman nɛ e ji n naŋ nya mbe eleŋ. Sɔɔl ka bɔ kubɔya na ashi Damaskɔs be asheŋ Ndoŋ nna nɛ Sɔɔl wora nchɛnnyɔ ashi Damaskɔs be bebɛsopo na kutɔ

english_verse: Soon he went to the synagogues and started telling people that Jesus is the Son of God.
translation_verse: nseŋ yɔ nshɛrbuana to epul na to n ya fara a bɔ kubɔya na a kaŋɛ Yesu be asheŋ a kaŋɛ: “Mo e la Ebɔrɛ Pibinyɛn na.”

english_verse: Everyone who heard Saul was amazed and said, “Isn't this the man who caused so much trouble for those people in Jerusalem who worship in the name of Jesus? Didn't he come here to arrest them and take them to the chief priests?”
translation_verse: K daŋ chinchiŋ bekama nɛ b nu kumo na ga nɛ b bishi abar: “Mannɛ kanyɛn ere e daa wɔ Jerusalɛm a mɔ bekama nɛ baa ti ketre ere yirdaso na a? Kumo be kaman, mannɛ kepɛ loŋ be basa n ya bɔɔ bɔrɛmatapowuraana na enɔ so so nɛ e ba nfe a?”

english_verse: but he found out about it. He learned that they were guarding the gates of the city day and night in order to kill him.
translation_verse: Nɛ Sɔɔl nu kesheŋ nɛ b daa sha kewora na. Kapa nɛ kanyɛ malɛ kikɛ b daa wɔ kade na to be mbunaana na to nna a fin kenya mo m mɔ.

english_verse: Then one night his followers let him down over the city wall in a large basket. Saul in Jerusalem
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ kanyɛso ko, Sɔɔl be bebɛsopo ta mo n wɔtɔ kelantaŋɛ gboŋ ko to m bɔla kade na be egbal so n ta mo ŋ gbelge to. Sɔɔl ka ba Jerusalɛm be asheŋ

english_verse: Then Barnabas helped him by taking him to the apostles. He explained how Saul had seen the Lord and how the Lord had spoken to him. Barnabas also said when Saul was in Damascus, he had spoken bravely in the name of Jesus.
translation_verse: Nɛ Baanabas ba mbe kechɛto to m ba keta mo n yɔ beshuŋipo na kutɔ n ya bugi asheŋ to ŋ kaŋɛ bumo kananɛ Sɔɔl daŋ wu Enyɛnpe na ekpa to nɛ Enyɛnpe na malga mo kutɔ. Kede be kaman nɛ e naŋ kaŋɛ bumo kananɛ Sɔɔl daŋ bɔ kubɔya na Yesu be ketre to kenyɛnso ashi Damaskɔs.

english_verse: Saul moved about freely with the followers in Jerusalem and told everyone about the Lord.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Sɔɔl tu bumo a wɔtɔ nsaa nite Jerusalɛm kikɛ to a bɔ kubɔya na Enyɛnpe be ketre to kenyɛnso.

english_verse: He was always arguing with the Jews who spoke Greek, and so they tried to kill him.
translation_verse: Mo nɛ Juwebi nɛ b daa malga Griik to na gba daŋ malga n ji emɔrɔ nɛ b kre bumo be nia a kɔ a fin kemɔ mo.

english_verse: But the followers found out about this and took Saul to Caesarea. From there they sent him to the city of Tarsus.
translation_verse: Bekurgepoana na ka nu kumo be asheŋ nɛ b keta Sɔɔl n yɔ Sizariya n ya shin nɛ e yɔ Taases.

english_verse: The church in Judea, Galilee, and Samaria now had a time of peace and kept on worshiping the Lord. The church became stronger, as the Holy Spirit encouraged it and helped it grow. Peter Heals Aeneas
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ asɔriebi nɛ b daa wɔ Judiya na nɛ Galili nɛ Samɛria na lar bumo be etɔrɔ na to n nya kagbenewushi gbrɛ. Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na e daŋ shin nɛ b daŋ yɔ anishito nseŋ wora keshi n ti so a wɔ Enyɛnpe be kebunyaŋ be kebaawɔtɔ to. Pita ka yɔ Lida nɛ Jɔpa be asheŋ

english_verse: While Peter was traveling from place to place, he visited the Lord's followers who lived in the town of Lydda.
translation_verse: Pita gba daŋ yɔ mboŋ damta. Kachako e yɔ nɛ e ya chɔrɔ Ebɔrɛ be bebɛsopo ashi Lida

english_verse: There he met a man named Aeneas, who for eight years had been sick in bed and could not move.
translation_verse: n ya tu kanyɛn ko nɛ baa tre Eeneeyas ndoŋ. E daa la eyurwusowura nna a dese kakpa koŋwule nfɛ burwa.

english_verse: Peter said to Aeneas, “Jesus Christ has healed you! Get up and make up your bed.” At once he stood up.
translation_verse: Nɛ Pita kaŋɛ mo: “Eeneeyas, Yesu Kristo e naa chɛ fo na. Niŋi to m bɔɔ fo kusɔ deseso na to.” Epul na to nɛ Eeneeyas niŋi to.

english_verse: Many people in the towns of Lydda and Sharon saw Aeneas and became followers of the Lord. Peter Brings Dorcas Back to Life
translation_verse: Lida nɛ Shɛrɔn be basa kikɛ daŋ wu mo nseŋ ki Enyɛnpe be bebɛsopo.

english_verse: In Joppa there was a follower named Tabitha. Her Greek name was Dorcas, which means “deer.” She was always doing good things for people and had given much to the poor.
translation_verse: Kache ko daa la eyirdapo a wɔ Jɔpa nɛ baa tre mo Tabita. Mbe Griik tre e la Dɔɔkas. Kumo be kifito e la Chibir. Kelela nɛ e daa wɔtɔ a wora saŋkama nsaa chɛ betirpo to.

english_verse: But she got sick and died, and her body was washed and placed in an upstairs room.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ kulɔ ko ba pɛ mo nɛ e wu nɛ b ber mo nseŋ ta mo n nase esoso be ebu ko to.

english_verse: Joppa wasn't far from Lydda, and the followers heard that Peter was there. They sent two men to say to him, “Please come with us as quickly as you can!”
translation_verse: Jɔpa nɛ Lida daa maŋ wɔ kufɔ, amoso, beyirdapo nɛ b daa wɔ Jɔpa na ka nu fanɛ Pita wɔ Lida nɛ b shuŋi basa anyɔ ko mo kutɔ fanɛ b ya kaŋɛ mo le: “Jande, wora ania n yeŋi so m ba anyi kutɔ.”

english_verse: At once, Peter went with them. The men took Peter upstairs into the room. Many widows were there crying. They showed him the coats and clothes that Dorcas had made while she was still alive.
translation_verse: Nɛ Pita bela ase n tu bumo n yɔ. E ka fo ndoŋ nɛ b keta mo n yɔ esoso be ebu na to nɛ bekulpocheana na kikɛ ba kulti mo a shu nsaa ta nle nɛ asɔbuuso nɛ Dɔɔkas daŋ lue saŋɛ nɛ e daa maŋ naŋ wu na a ŋini Pita.

english_verse: After Peter had sent everyone out of the room, he knelt down and prayed. Then he turned to the body of Dorcas and said, “Tabitha, get up!” The woman opened her eyes, and when she saw Peter, she sat up.
translation_verse: Nɛ Pita shin nɛ bumo kikɛ lar ebu na to nɛ e gbir ŋ kule Ebɔrɛ nseŋ kilgi ŋ kaŋɛ ebuni na: “Tabita, koso!” E ka bugi mbe anishi n wu Pita nɛ e niŋi to n chena.

english_verse: He took her by the hand and helped her to her feet. Peter called in the widows and the other followers and showed them that Dorcas had been raised from death.
translation_verse: Nɛ Pita pɛ mbe enɔ to n chɛ mo to nɛ e niŋi to nseŋ tre beyirdapo na nɛ bekulpocheana na m ba ta mo ŋkpa to m bɔɔ bumo enɔ.

english_verse: Everyone in Joppa heard what had happened, and many of them put their faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Kumo be baru daŋ sɔ Jɔpa to kikɛ nɛ basa damta yirda Enyɛnpe na.

english_verse: Peter stayed on for a while in Joppa in the house of a man named Simon, who made leather.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ Pita chena nwɔlgbitipo ko nɛ b daa tre Saimɔn pe ashi Jɔpa be kade na to n wora nchɛnnyɔ.

english_verse: One afternoon at about three o'clock, Cornelius had a vision. He saw an angel from God coming to him and calling him by name.
translation_verse: Kachako kapaso, fanɛ kerfi asa be jemanɛ nɛ e ku bɔrɛdare ko n wu Ebɔrɛ be malaika geeŋ ka ba kaŋɛ mo: “Kɔɔnilias.”

english_verse: Cornelius was surprised and stared at the angel. Then he asked, “What is this all about?” The angel answered, “God has heard your prayers and knows about your gifts to the poor.
translation_verse: Nɛ e ta mbe anishi n yuu malaika na so kufuso nseŋ bishi mo: “Manɛ nna, n nyɛnpe?” Nɛ malaika na kaŋɛ: “Ebɔrɛ nu fo kabɔrɛkuleana nseŋ naŋ wu fo kelela be kewora na nsaa shin nɛ e wora asɔ nɛ fee kule na.

english_verse: Now send some men to Joppa for a man named Simon Peter.
translation_verse: Shuŋi basa Jɔpa nɛ b ya tre kanyɛn ko nɛ baa tre Saimɔn Pita na.

english_verse: He is staying with Simon the leather maker, who lives in a house near the sea.”
translation_verse: E wɔ Saimɔn nwɔlgbitipo nɛ e wɔ a mata teku na pe.”

english_verse: He explained everything to them and sent them off to Joppa.
translation_verse: m ba kaŋɛ bumo kusɔ nɛ k wora na kikɛ nseŋ shuŋi bumo Jɔpa.

english_verse: The next day about noon these men were coming near Joppa. Peter went up on the roof of the house to pray
translation_verse: Kumo be ŋklade b ka ya taga to Jɔpa nɛ Pita malɛ dii kuchoŋi kapaso be jemanɛ nɛ e ya kule Ebɔrɛ.

english_verse: and became very hungry. While the food was being prepared, he fell sound asleep and had a vision.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ akoŋ pɛ mo ga nɛ e yɛlga keji.

english_verse: In it were all kinds of animals, reptiles, and birds.
translation_verse: Nɛ asɔbɔya be yiri kikɛ nɛ asɔ gbeyeso nɛ kupuŋ to be mbuibi wɔ kumo to.

english_verse: A voice said to him, “Peter, get up! Kill these and eat them.”
translation_verse: Nɛ e nu ebɔl ko ka bee kaŋɛ: “Pita, koso m mɔ n we!”

english_verse: But Peter said, “Lord, I can't do that! I've never eaten anything that is unclean and not fit to eat.”
translation_verse: Nɛ Pita kaŋɛ: “Akai, Enyɛnpe, ŋkpal manɛ so, m maŋ naŋ ji kusɔ kama nɛ k maŋ walɛ so nɛ anyi Juwebi bee kishi kikɛ.”

english_verse: The voice spoke to him again, “When God says that something can be used for food, don't say it isn't fit to eat.”
translation_verse: Nɛ ebɔl na naŋ kaŋɛ mo: “Sa maa tre kusɔ nɛ k la kusɔ lela Ebɔrɛ kutɔ kusɔ nɛ k maŋ walɛ so.”

english_verse: This happened three times before the sheet was suddenly taken back to heaven.
translation_verse: Ela asa nɛ e daŋ ku le be bɔrɛdare koŋwule ere pɔɛŋ nɛ b gberge kusɔ na n naŋ yɔ ebɔrɛso.

english_verse: Peter was still wondering what all this meant, when the men sent by Cornelius came and stood at the gate. They had found their way to Simon's house
translation_verse: Loŋ be bɔrɛdare nɛ Pita daŋ ku na be kifito be kepin daŋ chinchiŋ mo ga. Jemanɛ ere so nɛ basa nɛ Kɔɔnilias daŋ shuŋi na wu kowu nɛ Saimɔn daa wɔ to na m ba kaa yil kumo be kabuna to

english_verse: and were asking if Simon Peter was staying there.
translation_verse: m bishi awɔrso: “Nfe nɛ kafɔnyɛn ko nɛ baa tre Saimɔn Pita wɔ na a?”

english_verse: While Peter was still thinking about the vision, the Holy Spirit said to him, “Three men are here looking for you.
translation_verse: Pita daŋ kraa pin bɔrɛdare nɛ e ku na be kifito nna a gben nɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na kaŋɛ mo: “Nu nfe, benyɛn asa ko bee fin fo.

english_verse: Hurry down and go with them. Don't worry, I sent them.”
translation_verse: Amoso, koso m bela ase ŋ gbelge n ya shuli n tu bumo n yɔ, ŋkpal manɛ so, ma e shuŋi bumo.”

english_verse: Peter went down and said to the men, “I am the one you are looking for. Why have you come?”
translation_verse: Nɛ Pita gbelge n ya kaŋɛ basa na: “Ma nɛ menyee fin na. Manɛ e bar menyi?”

english_verse: They answered, “Captain Cornelius sent us. He is a good man who worships God and is liked by the Jewish people. One of God's holy angels told Cornelius to send for you, so he could hear what you have to say.”
translation_verse: Nɛ b kaŋɛ: “Kɔɔnilias, benapo be enimu na e shuŋi anyi. E la esa lela nna a bunyaŋ Ebɔrɛ nsaa la Juwebi kikɛ be ebunyampo. Ebɔrɛ be malaika ko e ba kaŋɛ mo fanɛ e shin nɛ fo ba mo pe m ba shin nɛ e nu kusɔ nɛ feeŋ kaŋɛ mo.”

english_verse: Peter invited them to spend the night. The next morning, Peter and some of the Lord's followers in Joppa left with the men who had come from Cornelius.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Pita shin nɛ b luri m ba di ŋ klade. Nɛ e bela ase nɛ mo nɛ bumo nɛ Jɔpa be bekurgepoana ko yɔ.

english_verse: The next day they arrived in Caesarea where Cornelius was waiting for them. He had also invited his relatives and close friends.
translation_verse: Kumo be ŋklade nɛ e fo Sizariya kakpa nɛ Kɔɔnilias nɛ mbe basa nɛ mo teriana gbagba nɛ e daŋ tre na daa wɔ a jo mo na.

english_verse: When Peter arrived, Cornelius greeted him. Then he knelt at Peter's feet and started worshiping him.
translation_verse: Pita ka daŋ baa sha nɛ e luri nɛ Kɔɔnilias shɛr mo to ŋ gbir mbe anishito.

english_verse: But Peter took hold of him and said, “Stand up! I am nothing more than a human.”
translation_verse: Nɛ Pita kaŋɛ mo: “Niŋi to n yili, ŋkpal manɛ so, ma alɛ gba la nyiŋgbasa nna.”

english_verse: As Peter entered the house, he was still talking with Cornelius. Many people were there,
translation_verse: E ka koso nɛ mo nɛ Pita malga abar kutɔ loŋ hale n ya luri ebu na to nɛ Pita ya wu basa damta nɛ b shɛr na.

english_verse: and Peter said to them, “You know that we Jews are not allowed to have anything to do with other people. But God has shown me that he doesn't think anyone is unclean or unfit.
translation_verse: Nɛ e kaŋɛ bumo: “Menyi alɛ gba baa nyi geeŋ fanɛ Juwebi be mbraana na ka bee ŋini fanɛ Juw be esa e sa maŋ kaŋ ya chɔrɔ ŋko n shin nɛ mo nɛ kanyamase e ba abar so kikɛ. Ama Ebɔrɛ ŋini ma fanɛ n sa maa ta dimɛdi pɔtɛ kama fanɛ eyurpiwura fanɛ kananɛ anyi Juwebi bee tre nnyamase na.

english_verse: I agreed to come here, but I want to know why you sent for me.”
translation_verse: Amoso nɛ n nu menyi be ketre a maŋ ji emɔrɔ nseŋ ba na. Ama men kaŋɛ ma kusɔ nɛ k ba nɛ men shuŋi n tre ma.”

english_verse: Cornelius answered: Four days ago at about three o'clock in the afternoon I was praying at home. Suddenly a man in bright clothes stood in front of me.
translation_verse: Nɛ Kɔɔnilias kaŋɛ: “Kachɛnawase be kapaso, kerfi asa, saŋɛ ere so nɛ mee kule Ebɔrɛ ashi ma pe nɛ kanyɛn ko buu asɔ fuful m ba yili ma anishito nseŋ kaŋɛ ma:

english_verse: He said, “Cornelius, God has heard your prayers, and he knows about your gifts to the poor.
translation_verse: ‘Kɔɔnilias, Ebɔrɛ nu fo kabɔrɛkule na nseŋ naŋ wu fo alelasheŋ na.

english_verse: Now send to Joppa for Simon Peter. He is visiting in the home of Simon the leather maker, who lives near the sea.”
translation_verse: Shuŋi esa Jɔpa nɛ e ya tre kanyɛn ko nɛ baa tre Saimɔn Pita na. E wɔ Saimɔn nwɔlgbitipo nɛ e wɔ a mata teku na pe.’

english_verse: I sent for you at once, and you have been good enough to come. All of us are here in the presence of the Lord God, so that we can hear what he has to say.
translation_verse: Kumo so nɛ n shuŋi epul na to fanɛ b ya tre fo nɛ fo alɛ shuli m ba na. Ebɔrɛ malɛ be anishito nɛ anyi kikɛ tase nfe a jo kusɔ kama nɛ Enyɛnpe na kɔ a sha nɛ fo kaŋɛ anyi na.” Pita be kamalga be asheŋ

english_verse: Peter then said: Now I am certain that God treats all people alike.
translation_verse: Nɛ Pita fara mbe kamalga ŋ kaŋɛ: “Naniere nɛ m pin kashenteŋto fanɛ Ebɔrɛ maa kpɛa to.

english_verse: God is pleased with everyone who worships him and does right, no matter what nation they come from.
translation_verse: Esa kama nɛ e bee ŋana mo nsaa wora asɔ nɛ a bee bɔla ekpa nɛ e bee sɔ.

english_verse: This is the same message that God gave to the people of Israel, when he sent Jesus Christ, the Lord of all, to offer peace to them.
translation_verse: E maa keni yiri nɛ k la mo. Men nyi kubɔya nɛ e sa Israɛlebi a kaŋɛ baru lela na be asheŋ fanɛ anyeeŋ tiŋ n nya kagbenewushi Ebɔrɛ kutɔ ashi Yesu Kristo nɛ e la basa kikɛ be Enyɛnpe na to be asheŋ.

english_verse: You surely know what happened everywhere in Judea. It all began in Galilee after John had told everyone to be baptized.
translation_verse: Kabɔrɛbɛr nɛ Jɔn daŋ bɔ kumo be kubɔya na be kaman men nyi kusɔgboŋ nɛ k daŋ fara Galili to n wora n yɔ Judiya kikɛ to na be asheŋ.

english_verse: God gave the Holy Spirit and power to Jesus from Nazareth. He was with Jesus, as he went around doing good and healing everyone who was under the power of the devil.
translation_verse: Men nyi Nazarɛt be Yesu na be asheŋ nɛ kananɛ Ebɔrɛ lara mo nseŋ shin nɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na nɛ eleŋ ba mo so. E daŋ yɔ kaplɛkama n ya wora kelela nseŋ chɛ basa damta nɛ b daa wɔ Setani be enɔ to na, ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ daa wɔ mo to.

english_verse: We all saw what Jesus did both in Israel and in the city of Jerusalem. Jesus was put to death on a cross.
translation_verse: An la asheŋ nɛ a wora ashi Jerusalɛm to nɛ Juwebi be efuli so nɛ k ka na kikɛ be eshɛdajipoana nna. B daŋ gbir mo m mata kedibi largato so nna m mɔ mo.

english_verse: But three days later, God raised him to life and let him be seen.
translation_verse: Ama kumo be nchɛ asa to nɛ Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ e tiŋi luwu na to n ta mbe kumu ŋ ŋini anyi.

english_verse: Not everyone saw him. He was seen only by us, who ate and drank with him after he was raised from death. We were the ones God chose to tell others about him.
translation_verse: Mannɛ basa kikɛ e daŋ wu mo she anyi, bumo nɛ Ebɔrɛ lara fanɛ an baa la mbe eshɛdajipoana na. Ebɔrɛ ka shin nɛ e tiŋi luwu to na be kaman anyi nɛ mo daŋ ji nseŋ nuu.

english_verse: God told us to announce clearly to the people that Jesus is the one he has chosen to judge the living and the dead.
translation_verse: Mo e kaŋɛ anyi fanɛ an baa bɔ baru lela na a sa basa a bugi to a kaŋɛ fanɛ mo e la emo nɛ Ebɔrɛ lara fanɛ e baa la basa keniso nɛ bumo nɛ b wu be demujipo na.

english_verse: Every one of the prophets has said that all who have faith in Jesus will have their sins forgiven in his name.
translation_verse: Anebiana kikɛ daŋ malga mbe asheŋ ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ ekama nɛ e yirda mo, e beeŋ nya mbe alubi be ketampaŋ ashi mbe ketre na be eleŋ to.” Nnyamase ka nya Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na be asheŋ

english_verse: While Peter was still speaking, the Holy Spirit took control of everyone who was listening.
translation_verse: Pita daŋ kraa malga nna nɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na gbelge m ba bumo nɛ b daa nu kubɔya na so.

english_verse: Some Jewish followers of the Lord had come with Peter, and they were surprised that the Holy Spirit had been given to Gentiles.
translation_verse: Juwebi be beyirdapoana nɛ b daŋ tu Pita n shi Jɔpa m ba na ka wu Ebɔrɛ ka ta mbe Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na ŋ kɛ nnyamase na malɛ n shin nɛ e gbelge bumo so na, nɛ k chinchiŋ bumo ga.

english_verse: Now they were hearing Gentiles speaking unknown languages and praising God. Peter said,
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, b daŋ nu kananɛ b daŋ gbar ŋgbar nɛ bumo gbagba maa nu nseŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ Ebɔrɛ e la durnya be Enyɛnpetale.

english_verse: “These Gentiles have been given the Holy Spirit, just as we have! I am certain that no one would dare stop us from baptizing them.”
translation_verse: Nɛ Pita kaŋɛ: “Basa ere gba nya Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na fanɛ anyi. Amoso, esa mo e naaŋ tiŋ ŋ kuŋ bumo ekpa fanɛ b sa maŋ ta nchu m bɛr bumo kabɔrɛbɛr na?”

english_verse: Peter ordered them to be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ, and they asked him to stay on for a few days.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ e shin nɛ b bɛr bumo kabɔrɛbɛr ashi Yesu Kristo be ketre to. Kumo be kaman nɛ b shin nɛ mo nɛ bumo chena kade na to n wora nchɛnnyɔ.

english_verse: The apostles and the followers in Judea heard that Gentiles had accepted God's message.
translation_verse: Beshuŋipo na nɛ Judiya be efuli na so kikɛ be bekurgepo na daŋ nu nnyamase na malɛ gba ka sɔ Ebɔrɛ be kubɔya na.

english_verse: So when Peter came to Jerusalem, some of the Jewish followers started arguing with him. They wanted Gentile followers to be circumcised, and
translation_verse: Ama Pita ka bɛta m ba Jerusalɛm nɛ bumo nɛ b yirda katutuku be keŋini na ba fara a ji mo emɔrɔ

english_verse: they said, “You stayed in the homes of Gentiles, and you even ate with them!”
translation_verse: a bishi mo kusɔ nɛ k ba nɛ e yɔ asoliwuraana pe hale n ya kaa tu bumo a ji.

english_verse: Then Peter told them exactly what had happened:
translation_verse: Nɛ Pita kaŋɛ bumo kananɛ asheŋ na kikɛ nyam fara nɛ kananɛ a ji. E yɛ:

english_verse: I was in the town of Joppa and was praying when I fell sound asleep and had a vision. I saw heaven open, and something like a huge sheet held by its four corners came down to me.
translation_verse: “Kachako n wɔ Jɔpa a kule Ebɔrɛ nseŋ ku bɔrɛdare n wu kusɔ peŋgeleŋ ko fanɛ wajɛ nɛ kumo be ekarso be nnɔ ana kɔ kumo to ashi ebɔrɛso a ba m ba yili m mata ma.

english_verse: When I looked in it, I saw animals, wild beasts, reptiles, and birds.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ ŋ keni kumo to nɛnɛ n wu kowu nɛ kupuŋ to be asɔbɔya nɛ asɔ gbeyeso nɛ kupuŋ to be mbuibi.

english_verse: I heard a voice saying to me, “Peter, get up! Kill these and eat them.”
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ n nu ebɔl ko ka bee kaŋɛ: ‘Pita, niŋi to ŋ koso m mɔ n we.’

english_verse: But I said, “Lord, I can't do that! I've never taken a bite of anything that is unclean and not fit to eat.”
translation_verse: Nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ: ‘Akai, Enyɛnpe, kejibi nɛ k maŋ walɛ so nɛ anyi Juwebi bee kishi maŋ naŋ luri ma kɔnɔ to kikɛ.’

english_verse: The voice from heaven spoke to me again, “When God says that something can be used for food, don't say it isn't fit to eat.”
translation_verse: Nɛ ebɔl na naŋ shi ebɔrɛso ŋ kaŋɛ: ‘Sa maa tre kusɔ nɛ k la kusɔ lela Ebɔrɛ kutɔ kusɔ nɛ k maŋ walɛ so.’

english_verse: This happened three times before it was all taken back into heaven.
translation_verse: Kusɔ na wora loŋ ale asa pɔɛŋ nɛ b gberge kumo kikɛ n naŋ bɛta n yɔ ebɔrɛso.

english_verse: Suddenly three men from Caesarea stood in front of the house where I was staying.
translation_verse: Epul na malɛ to nɛ mbɔ asa shi Sizariya m ba kowu nɛ n daa wɔ na to.

english_verse: The Holy Spirit told me to go with them and not to worry. Then six of the Lord's followers went with me to the home of a man
translation_verse: Nɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na kaŋɛ ma fanɛ n yeŋi so n shuli n tu bumo n yɔ. Ma nɛ bekurgepo ashe nɛ b shi Jɔpa ere e daŋ yɔ Sizariya n ya yɔ Kɔɔnilias pe.

english_verse: who told us that an angel had appeared to him. The angel had ordered him to send to Joppa for someone named Simon Peter.
translation_verse: Nɛ e kaŋɛ anyi kananɛ e wu malaika mo pe nɛ e kaŋɛ: ‘Shuŋi esa ko Jɔpa nɛ e ya tre kanyɛn ko nɛ baa tre Saimɔn Pita

english_verse: Then Peter would tell him how he and everyone in his house could be saved.
translation_verse: nɛ e ba kaŋɛ fo asheŋ, nɛ fo nɛ fo kowu to ebi kikɛ e nya kumɔlga.’

english_verse: After I started speaking, the Holy Spirit was given to them, just as the Spirit had been given to us at the beginning.
translation_verse: Ŋ ka fara a malga nɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na gbelge bumo so fanɛ kananɛ e daŋ gbelge anyi so sososo na.

english_verse: I remembered that the Lord had said, “John baptized with water, but you will be baptized with the Holy Spirit.”
translation_verse: Saŋɛ na so nɛ n nyiŋi kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe daŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ: ‘Nchu nɛ Jɔn daŋ ta m bɛr basa kabɔrɛbɛr, ama Ebɔrɛ beeŋ shin nɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na e gbelge menyi so.’

english_verse: God gave those Gentiles the same gift that he gave us when we put our faith in the Lord Jesus Christ. So how could I have gone against God?
translation_verse: K baŋ fuli nna fanɛ Kiyoyu koŋwule nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ sa anyi jemanɛ nɛ an fara n yirda Enyɛnpe Yesu Kristo na nɛ e sa nnyamase ere na, nɛ manɛ be eleŋ nɛ ma alɛ kɔ nɛ n tiŋ n ju Ebɔrɛ ashi kusɔ nɛ e bee sha kewora to?”

english_verse: When they heard Peter say this, they stopped arguing and started praising God. They said, “God has now let Gentiles turn to him, and he has given life to them!” The Church in Antioch
translation_verse: B ka nu kamalga na nɛ b yige bumo be kebaraso na nseŋ di Ebɔrɛ epaŋ ŋ kaŋɛ: “Kumo ere, Ebɔrɛ sa nnyamase gba ekpa nɛ b tiŋ n lar bumo be alubi to n nya ŋkpa na.” Antiɔk be asɔriebi be asheŋ

english_verse: Some of the Lord's followers had been scattered because of the terrible trouble that started when Stephen was killed. They went as far as Phoenicia, Cyprus, and Antioch, but they told the message only to the Jews.
translation_verse: Tɔrɔ nɛ k daŋ ba jemanɛ nɛ b mɔ Stiven na daŋ shin nɛ beyirdapoana na pesaŋ to nna n yɔ mboŋ damta. Beko daŋ yɔ hale Fenisha nɛ Saipres nɛ Antiɔk n ya kaa bɔ Kristo be kubɔya na a sa Juwebi nawule.

english_verse: Some of the followers from Cyprus and Cyrene went to Antioch and started telling Gentiles the good news about the Lord Jesus.
translation_verse: Beyirdapoana nɛ b daŋ shi Saipres nɛ Sairini na be beko malɛ daŋ yɔ Antiɔk nna n ya bɔ Enyɛnpe Yesu be baru lela na be kubɔya na n sa nnyamase malɛ.

english_verse: The Lord's power was with them, and many people turned to the Lord and put their faith in him.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe be eleŋ ka daa wɔ bumo to na so, basa damta daŋ yirda bumo be kubɔya na nseŋ fara a bɛ Enyɛnpe na so.

english_verse: News of what was happening reached the church in Jerusalem. Then they sent Barnabas to Antioch.
translation_verse: Jerusalɛm be asɔriebi na ka nu kumo be baru nɛ b shuŋi Baanabas Antiɔk.

english_verse: When Barnabas got there and saw how God had blessed them with undeserved grace, he was very glad. So he begged them to remain faithful to the Lord with all their hearts.
translation_verse: E ka ba ndoŋ m ba wu kananɛ Ebɔrɛ nɛfa basa na nɛ mbe kagbene fuli mo ga nɛ e leŋ bumo kikɛ to fanɛ b bugi bumo be ŋgbene kikɛ kashenteŋto a nu a sa Enyɛnpe na.

english_verse: Barnabas was a good man of great faith, and he was filled with the Holy Spirit. Many more people turned to the Lord.
translation_verse: Baanabas daa la esa ga a kɔ yirda nɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na bɔlɔ mo to. Ŋkpal loŋ so, basa damta daŋ ba pin Ebɔrɛ bumo be ŋgbene to.

english_verse: Barnabas went to Tarsus to look for Saul.
translation_verse: Kede be kaman nɛ Baanabas yɔ Taases nɛ e ya fin Sɔɔl.

english_verse: He found Saul and brought him to Antioch, where they met with the church for a whole year and taught many of its people. There in Antioch the Lord's followers were first called Christians.
translation_verse: E ka wu mo nɛ e bar mo Antiɔk nɛ bumo benyɔ na ba ji kafɛ lelemu asɔriebi na kutɔ nsaa ŋini basa damta ko abɔrɛsheŋ na. Antiɔk nɛ b daŋ fara n tre bebɛsopoana na Kristoebi.

english_verse: During this time some prophets from Jerusalem came to Antioch.
translation_verse: Jemanɛ na so nɛ anebiana ko shi Jerusalɛm n yɔ Antiɔk.

english_verse: One of them was Agabus. Then with the help of the Spirit, he told that there would be a terrible famine everywhere in the world. And it happened when Claudius was Emperor.
translation_verse: Bumo to be eko e daa la Agabes, mo e daŋ bɔla Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na be eleŋ to n wu ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ akoŋgboŋ beeŋ tɔr durnya kikɛ to. Ewurgboŋ Klawdias be jemanɛ na nɛ akoŋgboŋ na daŋ tɔr.

english_verse: So they appointed Barnabas and Saul to take their gifts to the church leaders in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: B ka wora toto na n loge nɛ b ta amansherbi na n shuŋi Baanabas nɛ Sɔɔl nɛ b ya sa ndoŋ be asɔriebi be benimuana na.

english_verse: At that time King Herod caused terrible suffering for some members of the church.
translation_verse: Jemanɛ ere so nɛ Ewura Hɛrɔd daŋ fara a tɔrɔ asɔriebi na be beko.

english_verse: He ordered soldiers to cut off the head of James, the brother of John.
translation_verse: Mo e daŋ shin nɛ b ta tokobi ŋ ŋe Jɔn mo sipo Jeems m mɔ na.

english_verse: When Herod saw that this pleased the Jewish people, he had Peter arrested during the Festival of Thin Bread.
translation_verse: E ka pin fanɛ k par Juwebi na nɛ e naŋ shin nɛ b pɛ Pita malɛ. Kejigboŋ nɛ baa tre Bodobodo nɛ a maŋ kɔ yiisi be Kejigboŋ na be jemanɛ nɛ e daŋ wora kumo.

english_verse: He put Peter in jail and ordered four squads of soldiers to guard him. Herod planned to put him on trial in public after the festival.
translation_verse: B ka pɛ Pita nɛ b ta mo n ya ti ebu n shin nɛ benapo ana be ntuŋ ana so bee keni mo so. Kebansonchoŋ be kejigboŋ na be kaman nɛ Hɛrɔd daa sha keji mo demu basa kikɛ be anishito.

english_verse: While Peter was being kept in jail, the church never stopped praying to God for him. Peter Is Rescued
translation_verse: Amoso nɛ b daŋ shin nɛ Pita daŋ kraa wɔ kabuti to na. Ama jemanɛ na so nɛ asɔriebi na malɛ wɔ kabɔrɛkule kpakpaso to a sa Pita. Malaika ka shin nɛ Pita lar kabuti to be asheŋ

english_verse: The night before Peter was to be put on trial, he was asleep and bound by two chains. A soldier was guarding him on each side, and two other soldiers were guarding the entrance to the jail.
translation_verse: Kachɛ nɛ Hɛrɔd daa sha kelara Pita kabuti to m ba ji mo demu basa kikɛ be anishito na be kanyɛso b ta ŋgbɛlɛbi anyɔ ŋ kre Pita n nase bekumpo anyɔ ko be nferinto nɛ e dese a di nɛ bekumpo ko malɛ yil ebu na be kabuna a de so.

english_verse: Suddenly an angel from the Lord appeared, and light flashed around in the cell. The angel poked Peter in the side and woke him up. Then he said, “Quick! Get up!” The chains fell off his hands,
translation_verse: Epul na to nɛ Enyɛnpe be malaika ko ba yili ndoŋ nɛ kefulto ko nyaŋɛ n fuli ebu na to nɛ malaika na beta Pita be kekel so n tiŋi mo nseŋ kaŋɛ mo: “Yeŋi so ŋ koso.” Epul na to nɛ ŋgbɛlɛbi na lar mbe enɔana to n tɔr.

english_verse: and the angel said, “Get dressed and put on your sandals.” Peter did what he was told. Then the angel said, “Now put on your coat and follow me.”
translation_verse: Nɛ malaika na kaŋɛ mo: “Lɔŋɛ fo kreso n chɛ nseŋ lɔŋɛ fo asɛbta n wɔtɔ.” Ndoŋ nna nɛ Pita wora loŋ nɛ malaika na naŋ kaŋɛ mo: “Ta fo piŋi m buu nseŋ bɛ ma so.”

english_verse: They went past the two groups of soldiers, and when they came to the iron gate to the city, it opened by itself. They went out and were going along the street, when all at once the angel disappeared.
translation_verse: B daŋ ya baŋ sososo be bekumpo be eyilikpa na so n ya baŋ kenyɔsopo so pɔɛŋ nseŋ ta n yɔ abɛlso be kabuna nɛ k bee bugi a yɔ kade na to na nɛ kabuna na gbagba bugi nɛ b lar m bɔla kubɔrbi ko so nɛ malaika na yige Pita epul na to nseŋ yɔ.

english_verse: Peter now realized what had happened, and he said, “I am certain that the Lord sent his angel to rescue me from Herod and from everything the Jewish leaders planned to do to me.”
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Pita pin kusɔ nɛ k wora mo na nseŋ kaŋɛ: “Naniere nɛ m pin kashenteŋto fanɛ Enyɛnpe e shuŋi mbe malaika nɛ e ba lara ma ashi Hɛrɔd be eleŋ nɛ asɔ nɛ Juwebi na daa fɛ na kikɛ to.”

english_verse: Then Peter went to the house of Mary the mother of John whose other name was Mark. Many of the Lord's followers had come together there and were praying.
translation_verse: E ka pin kumo be loŋ nɛ e yɔ Jɔn Maak mo nio Mɛɛri pe. Kumo be jemanɛ na nɛ basa damta ko shɛr ndoŋ a kule Ebɔrɛ.

english_verse: Peter knocked on the gate, and a servant named Rhoda came to answer.
translation_verse: Nɛ Pita ya ŋmɛa ebu na be kabuna nɛ kebichebi ko nɛ baa tre Roda ba nɛ e ba keni esa nɛ e la.

english_verse: When she heard Peter's voice, she was too excited to open the gate. She ran back into the house and said Peter was standing there.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ e pin Pita be ebɔl nɛ mbe kagbene fuli mo ga nɛ e yige kabuna na be kebugi nseŋ nya manaŋ m bɛta n ya kaŋɛ ekama fanɛ Pita e yil kabuna to na.

english_verse: “You are crazy!” everyone told her. But she kept saying it was Peter. Then they said, “It must be his angel.”
translation_verse: Nɛ b bishi mo: “Fee lɔ nna a?” Nɛ e kraa kaŋɛ bumo fanɛ kashenteŋ nna.

english_verse: But Peter kept on knocking, until finally they opened the gate. They saw him and were completely amazed.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ b kaŋɛ: “Mbe malaika nna.” Jemanɛ ere so malɛ kikɛ nɛ Pita kraa yil a ŋmɛa. Kumo be kaman nɛ b ba bugi kabuna na n wu mo nɛ k chinchiŋ bumo ga.

english_verse: Peter motioned for them to keep quiet. Then he told how the Lord had led him out of jail. He also said, “Tell James and the others what has happened.” After that, he left and went somewhere else.
translation_verse: Nɛ e wora bumo enɔ fanɛ b lo to nseŋ kaŋɛ bumo kananɛ Enyɛnpe lara mo ashi kabuti na to. Kumo be kaman nɛ e kaŋɛ bumo: “Men kaŋɛ Jeems nɛ bekurgepo nɛ b ka na.” E ka kaŋɛ bumo loŋ n loge nɛ e yige bumo nseŋ yɔ kakpa ko.

english_verse: The next morning the soldiers who had been on guard were terribly worried and wondered what had happened to Peter.
translation_verse: Kare ka chɛ nɛ kebagato gboŋ ko tɔr bekumpo na to nɛ b fara a bishi abar: “Manɛ e wora Pita na?”

english_verse: Herod ordered his own soldiers to search for him, but they could not find him. Then he questioned the guards and had them put to death. After this, Herod left Judea to stay in Caesarea for a while. Herod Dies
translation_verse: Nɛ Hɛrɔd sa kɔnɔ fanɛ basa e fin mo, nɛ b fin mo ŋ gben. Nɛ e shin nɛ b bishi bekumpo na mbe asheŋ nɛnɛ nseŋ shin nɛ b mɔ bumo. Kumo be kaman nɛ Hɛrɔd shi Jerusalɛm n yɔ Sizariya n ya wora nchɛnnyɔ ndoŋ. Hɛrɔd be luwu be asheŋ

english_verse: Herod and the people of Tyre and Sidon were very angry with each other. But their country got its food supply from the region that he ruled. So a group of them went to see Blastus, who was one of Herod's high officials. They convinced Blastus that they wanted to make peace between their cities and Herod,
translation_verse: Hɛrɔd ka nya agbo ga n wora Tayɛ nɛ Saidɔn ebi so, b daŋ wora kɔnɔkoŋwule nna n shuŋi bumo to be basa ko Hɛrɔd kutɔ. Ama kumo ere be pɔɛŋ, b daŋ wule nna nɛ bumo nɛ Blastes nɛ e daa la ewura na be kowu to be enimu na wora kɔnɔkoŋwule n yili, ŋkpal manɛ so, ewura na be efuli na so ebi kutɔ nɛ bumo be efuli so ebi daa nya bumo be ajibi.

english_verse: and a day was set for them to meet with him. Herod came dressed in his royal robes. He sat down on his throne and made a speech.
translation_verse: Hɛrɔd be kachɛgboŋ ko nɛ e lara mbe kuwurpiŋi m buu nseŋ chena mbe kuwurputi so nseŋ malga n sa basa na.

english_verse: The people shouted, “You speak more like a god than a man!”
translation_verse: Nɛ basa na malga eleŋso ŋ kaŋɛ: “Mannɛ nyiŋgbasa e naa malga ere. Ebɔrɛ ko nna.”

english_verse: At once an angel from the Lord struck him down because he took the honor that belonged to God. Later, Herod was eaten by worms and died.
translation_verse: Epul na to nɛ Enyɛnpe be malaika ba ta kulɔ n lɛ Hɛrɔd so ŋkpal e ka maŋ ta kemaŋkura na n sa Ebɔrɛ so. Ashushombi e daŋ ji mbe eyur nɛ e wu.

english_verse: And after Barnabas and Saul had done the work they were sent to do, they went back to Jerusalem with John, whose other name was Mark.
translation_verse: Baanabas nɛ Sɔɔl ka loge bumo be kushuŋ nɛ b keta Jɔn Maak nɛ mo nɛ bumo lar Jerusalɛm to m bɛta n yɔ.

english_verse: The church at Antioch had several prophets and teachers. They were Barnabas, Simeon, also called Niger, Lucius from Cyrene, Manaen, who was Herod's close friend, and Saul.
translation_verse: Anebiana nɛ beŋinipo ko daa wɔ Antiɔk be asɔriebi na to. Bumo be atreana e daa la Baanabas nɛ Saimɔn, emo nɛ baa tre esa lembir na nɛ Sairini be Lisias nɛ Maneeyen, emo nɛ b daŋ bela mo nɛ Gomena Hɛrɔd na nɛ Sɔɔl.

english_verse: While they were worshiping the Lord and going without eating, the Holy Spirit told them, “Appoint Barnabas and Saul to do the work for which I have chosen them.”
translation_verse: Saŋko b ka bee bunyaŋ Enyɛnpe nsaa kishi nɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na kaŋɛ bumo: “Men lara Baanabas nɛ Sɔɔl n sa ma nɛ b shuŋ kushuŋ nɛ n lara bumo fanɛ b ba shuŋ ere.”

english_verse: Everyone prayed and went without eating for a while longer. Next, they placed their hands on Barnabas and Saul to show that they had been appointed to do this work. Then everyone sent them on their way. Barnabas and Saul in Cyprus
translation_verse: Nɛ b kishi nseŋ kule Ebɔrɛ n ta bumo be enɔana n deŋi basa anyɔ na so nseŋ shin nɛ b yɔ. Baanabas nɛ Sɔɔl ka ba Saipres be asheŋ

english_verse: After Barnabas and Saul had been sent by the Holy Spirit, they went to Seleucia. From there they sailed to the island of Cyprus.
translation_verse: Kiyoyu na ka shuŋi Baanabas nɛ Sɔɔl na nɛ b yɔ Sɛlyusia n ya yili ndoŋ n luri ekuloŋgboŋ to m bɔla nchu so n yɔ Saipres be kepla so.

english_verse: Barnabas and Saul went all the way to the city of Paphos on the other end of the island, where they met a Jewish man named Bar-Jesus. He practiced witchcraft and was a false prophet.
translation_verse: B nite kepla na so loŋ hale n ya fo Pafɔs. Ndoŋ nɛ b ya tu ŋkilgiwura ko nɛ baa tre Baa Jizes. E daa la Juw nna a tre mbe kumu anebi.

english_verse: He also worked for Sergius Paulus, who was very smart and was the governor of the island. Sergius Paulus wanted to hear God's message, and he sent for Barnabas and Saul.
translation_verse: Kepla na so be Gomena Sɛjes Pɔɔles mo teri e daa la mo. Sɛjes Pɔɔles ere daa la enyiashempo nna ga. Ndoŋ nna nɛ gomena na tre Baanabas nɛ Sɔɔl ŋkpal kenu abɔrɛsheŋ na so.

english_verse: But Bar-Jesus, whose other name was Elymas, was against them. He even tried to keep the governor from having faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Nɛ Elimas, ŋkilgiwura ere, Baa Jizes na be Griik tre be kifito e daa la loŋ na, ba kaa kuŋ bumo ekpa a fin kekuŋ gomena na ekpa nɛ e sa maŋ yirda Yesu.

english_verse: Then Saul, better known as Paul, was filled with the Holy Spirit. He looked straight at Elymas
translation_verse: Nɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na luri m bɔlɔ Sɔɔl, mo koŋwule e la Pɔɔl na to nɛ e keni ŋkilgiwura na be anishito nseŋ kaŋɛ:

english_verse: and said, “You son of the devil! You are a liar, a crook, and an enemy of everything that is right. When will you stop speaking against the true ways of the Lord?
translation_verse: “Setani pibi ere. Fo la kelela be yiri kikɛ be edompo nna. Kafule be kulubi be yiri kikɛ e baŋ bɔlɔ fo to nɛ saŋkama fee kɔ a fin keta Enyɛnpe be nshenteŋ ŋ ki efɛ.

english_verse: The Lord is going to punish you by making you completely blind for a while.” Suddenly the man's eyes were covered by a dark mist, and he went around trying to get someone to lead him by the hand.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe malɛ beeŋ gberge fo kusoe naniere nɛ fo tan a maaŋ naŋ tiŋ n wu efuli hale n ya fo saŋko.” Epul na to nɛ k wora Elimas na fanɛ kumɔɔ lembir ko ka ba buu mbe anishi kikɛ so nɛ e fara a nite a kulti a laa a fin esa nɛ e beeŋ pɛ mbe enɔ to.

english_verse: When the governor saw what had happened, he was amazed at this teaching about the Lord. So he put his faith in the Lord. Paul and Barnabas in Antioch of Pisidia
translation_verse: Gomena na ka daŋ wu kusɔ nɛ k wora na nɛ e yirda. Enyɛnpe be asheŋ nɛ b daa ŋini na daŋ chinchiŋ mo ga. Pɔɔl nɛ Baanabas ka yɔ Pisidia be Antiɔk be asheŋ

english_verse: Paul and the others left Paphos and sailed to Perga in Pamphylia. But John left them and went back to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Pɔɔl nɛ mo braana luri ekuloŋgboŋ to ashi Pafɔs n ta n ya fo Pɛga nɛ k wɔ Pamfilia na. Nɛ Jɔn Maak ba yige bumo ndoŋ nseŋ bɛta n yɔ Jerusalɛm.

english_verse: The rest of them went on from Perga to Antioch in Pisidia. Then on the Sabbath they went to the synagogue and sat down.
translation_verse: Nɛ bumo alɛ lar Pɛga n ta n yɔ Pisidia be Antiɔk. Kewushiachɛ ka fo nɛ b yɔ ndoŋ be nshɛrbu to n ya chena.

english_verse: After the reading of the Law and the Prophets, the leaders sent someone over to tell Paul and Barnabas, “Friends, if you have anything to say that will help the people, please say it.”
translation_verse: Esa ko ka kraŋ Mosis be mbraana na nɛ anebiana be nwɔl na be mboŋ ko n loge nɛ nshɛrbu na to be benimuana na shuŋi kabɔ bumo kutɔ ŋ kaŋɛ: “Bekurgepoana, nɛ men kɔ kamalga nɛ menyeeŋ ta ŋ leŋ basa ere to, men baa malga.”

english_verse: Paul got up. He motioned with his hand and said: People of Israel, and everyone else who worships God, listen!
translation_verse: Nɛ Pɔɔl niŋi to n yili n wora bumo enɔ fanɛ b lo to nseŋ fara mbe kamalga. “M braana Israɛlebi nɛ menyi kikɛ nɛ men la nnyamase a wɔ nfe a bunyaŋ Ebɔrɛ ere, men nu nfe.

english_verse: The God of Israel chose our ancestors, and he let our people prosper while they were living in Egypt. Then with his mighty power he led them out,
translation_verse: Israɛlebi be Ebɔrɛ e daŋ lara an nanaana Juwebi n shin nɛ b wora keshi ga saŋɛ nɛ b daa la befɔ a wɔ Ijipt be kasawule so na.

english_verse: He destroyed seven nations in the land of Canaan and gave their land to our people.
translation_verse: Keenan be kasawule so be efuli ashunu nɛ e shin nɛ a mur nseŋ ta kasawule na kikɛ n sa mbe basa na.

english_verse: Later, God removed Saul and let David rule in his place. God said about him, “David the son of Jesse is the kind of person who pleases me most! He does everything I want him to do.”
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ ka gboŋi mo kuwura na to nɛ e shin nɛ Deevid ki bumo be ewura. Le nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ malga Deevid be asheŋ: ‘N wu fanɛ Jɛsi pibi Deevid be kaduli gbagba nɛ mee sha na. Mo e la emo nɛ e beeŋ wora kusɔ kama nɛ mee sha fanɛ e wora na.’

english_verse: God promised that someone from David's family would come to save the people of Israel, and this one is Jesus.
translation_verse: Yesu nɛ Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ e ki Israɛlebi be emɔlgapo a bɔla mbe kɔnɔ nɛ e daŋ nase na daŋ shi Deevid be kanaŋ to nna.

english_verse: But before Jesus came, John was telling everyone in Israel to turn back to God and be baptized.
translation_verse: Pɔɛŋ nɛ Yesu fara mbe kushuŋ na, Jɔn daŋ kaŋɛ Israɛlebi na kikɛ nna fanɛ b lar bumo be alubi to nɛ b bɛr bumo kabɔrɛbɛr.

english_verse: Then, when John's work was almost done, he said, “Who do you people think I am? Do you think I am the Promised One? He will come later, and I am not good enough to untie his sandals.”
translation_verse: Jɔn ka daa sha keloge mbe kushuŋ nɛ e bishi basa na: ‘Wanɛ nɛ menyee tama fanɛ n la? Mannɛ ma e la emo nɛ menyee jo na. Ama ma kaman esa ko beeŋ ba a chɔ ma ga, m maŋ fo mbe aya to be shishɛr gba so.’

english_verse: Now listen, you descendants of Abraham! Pay attention, all of you Gentiles who are here to worship God! Listen to this message about how to be saved, because it is for everyone.
translation_verse: Ŋ kurgepoana, Eebraham mo nanabiana nɛ menyi nɛ men la nnyamase a wɔ nfe a bunyaŋ Ebɔrɛ ere kikɛ, anyi kikɛ nɛ b ta le be kumɔlga be kubɔya ere n sa.

english_verse: The people of Jerusalem and their leaders didn't realize who Jesus was. And they didn't understand the words of the prophets they read each Sabbath. So they condemned Jesus just as the prophets had said.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, basa nɛ bumo nɛ bumo be benimu wɔ Jerusalɛm to ere daa maŋ nyi fanɛ mo e la emɔlgapo na, bumo alɛ daa maŋ pin anebiana be mmalga nɛ b sibɛ n nase nɛ b baa kraŋ amo kewushiachɛ kama na gba to. Ama bumo alɛ daŋ shin nɛ b mɔ Yesu n shin nɛ anebiana be mmalga na bɔla ekpa.

english_verse: They did exactly what the Scriptures said they would. Even though they couldn't find any reason to put Jesus to death, they still asked Pilate to have him killed. After Jesus had been put to death, he was taken down from the cross and placed in a tomb.
translation_verse: B ka wora asɔ nɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na kaŋɛ fanɛ baaŋ wora mo na n loge, nɛ b lara mo kedibi largato na so n ta mo n wɔtɔ kejembulaŋ kurso ko to.

english_verse: But God raised him from death!
translation_verse: Nɛ Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ e tiŋi luwu na to.

english_verse: Then for many days Jesus appeared to his followers who had gone with him from Galilee to Jerusalem. Now they are telling our people about him.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nchɛ damta ko nɛ e bee lar bumo nɛ mo nɛ bumo daŋ shi Galili m ba Jerusalɛm na so nɛ baa wu mo. Bumo e la mbe eshɛdajipoana a sa Israɛlebi kabre na.

english_verse: that he has kept this promise to us. It is just as the second Psalm says about Jesus, “You are my son because today I have become your Father.”
translation_verse: Nshɛ be Kawɔl be kashɛ nyɔsopo malɛ to nɛ baa kaŋɛ loŋ: ‘Fo e la m Pibinyɛn. Kabre ŋ ki fo Tuto.’

english_verse: God raised Jesus from death and will never let his body decay. It is just as God said, “I will make to you the same holy promises that I made to David.”
translation_verse: Le malɛ nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ malga ketiŋi mo luwu to nɛ e maaŋ naŋ bɛta n wu kikɛ na be asheŋ ŋ kaŋɛ: ‘Meeŋ ta nɛfa cheembi nɛ n nase kɔnɔ kashenteŋto fanɛ meeŋ sa Deevid na n sa fo.’

english_verse: And in another psalm it says, “God will never let the body of his Holy One decay.”
translation_verse: Abɔrɛsibɛ na malɛ kraa kaŋɛ kakpa ko fanɛ: ‘Fo maaŋ shin nɛ fo kenya nɛ e bee bɛ fo so nɛ kagbene koŋwule e wu m bɛ.’

english_verse: When David was alive, he obeyed God. Then after he died, he was buried in the family grave, and his body decayed.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, Deevid be jemanɛ na, e daŋ wora Ebɔrɛ be aparsheŋ nna nseŋ wu nɛ b ta mo m puli m mata mo nanaana nɛ e bɛ.

english_verse: But God raised Jesus from death, and his body did not decay.
translation_verse: Ama emo nɛ Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ e tiŋi luwu to na maŋ bɛ.

english_verse: My friends, the message is that Jesus can forgive your sins! The Law of Moses could not set you free from all your sins.
translation_verse: Ŋ kurgepoana, men kikɛ e baa nyi geeŋ fanɛ Yesu nawule so nɛ b bɔ alubi be ketampaŋ be kubɔya na a sa menyi.

english_verse: But everyone who has faith in Jesus is set free.
translation_verse: Men baa nyi fanɛ ekama nɛ e yirda mo, b sɔ mo ashi kulubi be yiri kikɛ to n yige.

english_verse: “Look, you people who make fun of God! Be amazed and disappear. I will do something today that you won't believe, even if someone tells you about it!”
translation_verse: ‘Menyi nɛ menyee fɛl kusɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ na, men nu nfe. Menyeeŋ kooba nseŋ wu. Meeŋ wora kusɔ ko menyi be ŋkpa ere to, ama esa bugi kumo to n sa menyi gba, men maaŋ yirda kumo.’ ”

english_verse: As Paul and Barnabas were leaving the synagogue, the people begged them to say more about these same things on the next Sabbath.
translation_verse: Pɔɔl nɛ Baanabas ka bee lar nshɛrbu na to nɛ basa na kule bumo fanɛ b naŋ bɛta m ba kewushiachɛ nɛ k naa ba m ba kaŋɛ bumo asheŋ na be ako n ti so.

english_verse: After the service, many Jews and a lot of Gentiles who worshiped God went with them. Paul and Barnabas begged them all to remain faithful to God, who had treated them with undeserved grace.
translation_verse: Basa na ka lar nshɛr na to n yɔ nɛ Juwebi damta nɛ nnyamase nɛ b tuba a bɛ Juwebi be kabɔrɛbɛso so na be bedamta ba buu Pɔɔl nɛ Baanabas so nɛ b malga n leŋ bumo to fanɛ b baa kraa yirda a kɔ Ebɔrɛ be kelela na to kpakpa.

english_verse: The next Sabbath almost everyone in town came to hear the message about the Lord.
translation_verse: Kewushiachɛ nɛ k naŋ bɛ so ka fo kade na to ebi be galeŋga e ba nɛ b ba nu Enyɛnpe be kubɔya na.

english_verse: When the Jewish people saw the crowds, they were very jealous. They insulted Paul and spoke against everything he said.
translation_verse: Juwebi na ka wu jimaŋ na nɛ yurkishi luri m bɔlɔ bumo to nɛ b malga ŋ gbiti kusɔ nɛ Pɔɔl daa malga na nseŋ tege mo.

english_verse: But Paul and Barnabas bravely said: We had to tell God's message to you before we told it to anyone else. But you rejected the message! This proves that you don't deserve eternal life. Now we are going to the Gentiles.
translation_verse: Ama Pɔɔl nɛ Baanabas daŋ kplaŋ bumo so nna nsaa malga kenyɛnso a kaŋɛ: “Menyi nɛ b daŋ yili kumo fanɛ b fara m malga Ebɔrɛ be kamalga na n sa, ama men ka kini kumo nsaa ta menyi be amu fanɛ men maŋ daga Ebɔrɛ be ŋkpa nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na bre so, anyeeŋ yige menyi nseŋ yɔ nnyamase kutɔ.

english_verse: The Lord has given us this command, “I have placed you here as a light for the Gentiles. You are to take the saving power of God to people everywhere on earth.”
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, le be mbra nɛ Enyɛnpe sa anyi: ‘Fo nɛ n lara nɛ fo baa la kefulto a sa nnyamase. Fo so nɛ Ebɔrɛ beeŋ bɔla m mɔlga durnya kikɛ.’ ”

english_verse: This message made the Gentiles glad, and they praised what they had heard about the Lord. Everyone who had been chosen for eternal life then put their faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Nnyamase na ka nu loŋ nɛ bumo be ŋgbene fuli bumo ga nɛ b yɛ Enyɛnpe be kubɔya na wɔ ebel. Nɛ bumo nɛ Ebɔrɛ lara fanɛ b nya Ebɔrɛ be ŋkpa nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na ki beyirdapo.

english_verse: The message about the Lord spread all over this region.
translation_verse: Nɛ Enyɛnpe be kubɔya na sɔ nde na be kaplɛkama nyam.

english_verse: But the Jewish leaders went to some of the important men in the town and to some respected women who were religious. They turned them against Paul and Barnabas and started making trouble for them. They even chased them out of this part of the country.
translation_verse: Nɛ Juwebi na we n wɔtɔ kadegboŋ na to be benimu nɛ bebunyampocheana nɛ baa bunyaŋ Ebɔrɛ na nɛ b fara a tɔrɔ Pɔɔl nɛ Baanabas n ju bumo bumo be kasawule so.

english_verse: Paul and Barnabas shook the dust from that place off their feet and went on to the city of Iconium.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ beshuŋipoana na gbaŋgbaŋ bumo be aya to be shishɛr n lɛ bumo a ŋini fanɛ b wora bumo kusha nseŋ yɔ Ikoniam.

english_verse: But the Lord's followers in Antioch were very happy and were filled with the Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Nɛ kagbenefuli nɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na bɔlɔ Antiɔk be bebɛsopo na to ga.

english_verse: Paul and Barnabas spoke in the synagogue in Iconium, just as they had done at Antioch, and many Jews and Gentiles put their faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Kusɔ nɛ k daŋ wora Antiɔk na koŋwule na e daŋ wora Ikoniam gba. Pɔɔl daŋ yɔ ndoŋ be Juwebi be nshɛrbu to nna n ya bɔ kubɔya na kenyɛnso nɛnɛ ga nɛ Juwebi damta ko nɛ nnyamase damta ko ba ki beyirdapo.

english_verse: But the Jews who did not have faith in him made the other Gentiles angry and turned them against the Lord's followers.
translation_verse: Nɛ Juwebi nɛ b kini Yesu na we n wɔtɔ nnyamase na nɛ b fara a kishi bekurgepoana na.

english_verse: Paul and Barnabas stayed there for a while, having faith in the Lord and bravely speaking his message. The Lord gave them the power to work miracles and wonders, and he showed that their message about his gift of undeserved grace was true.
translation_verse: Beshuŋipo na daŋ chɛr ndoŋ ga a malga Enyɛnpe na be asheŋ kenyɛnso, nɛ e sa bumo eleŋ nɛ b wora emamachisheŋ nɛ Ebɔrɛ be etɔɔnɛsheŋ damta ŋ ŋini fanɛ bumo be kubɔya nɛ k bee kute mbe kuwɔr be kakɛ na be asheŋ na la kashenteŋ nna.

english_verse: The people of Iconium did not know what to think. Some of them believed the Jewish group, and others believed the apostles.
translation_verse: Nɛ kadegboŋ na to ebi barga to nɛ beko bɛ Juwebi na so nɛ beko malɛ bɛ beshuŋipo na so.

english_verse: Finally, some Gentiles and Jews, together with their leaders, decided to make trouble for Paul and Barnabas and to stone them to death.
translation_verse: Nɛ nnyamase na nɛ Juwebi nɛ bumo be benimuana gba kre ketɔrɔ nɛ kekpa beshuŋipo na ajembu m mɔ be nia.

english_verse: But when the two apostles found out what was happening, they escaped to the region of Lycaonia. They preached the good news there in the towns of Lystra and Derbe and in the nearby countryside. Paul and Barnabas in Lystra
translation_verse: n ya kaa bɔ baru lela na a sa ndoŋebiana. B ka kpa Pɔɔl ajembu nɛ e bɛlɛ ashi Listra be asheŋ

english_verse: In Lystra there was a man who had been born with paralyzed feet and had never been able to walk.
translation_verse: Kanyɛn ko daa wɔ Listra nɛ mbe aya daŋ wu hale mbe kebiato kikɛ. E daa maŋ naŋ nite ŋ ku so.

english_verse: The man was listening to Paul speak, when Paul saw that he had faith in Jesus and could be healed. So he looked straight at the man
translation_verse: Pɔɔl ka bee bɔ kubɔya na nɛ e wu kananɛ kanyɛn na kaŋ kusoe a nu kamalga na nɛ kananɛ e kɔ yirda a beeŋ tiŋ n nya kechɛ. Nɛ Pɔɔl keni mo diimbi nseŋ malga awɔrso ŋ kaŋɛ: “Niŋi to n teŋ to n yili fo aya so.”

english_verse: and shouted, “Stand up!” The man jumped up and started walking around.
translation_verse: Nɛ kanyɛn na tɛ to ŋ koso a nite a kilgi to.

english_verse: When the crowd saw what Paul had done, they yelled out in the language of Lycaonia, “The gods have turned into humans and have come down to us!”
translation_verse: Jimaŋ na ka wu kusɔ nɛ Pɔɔl wora na nɛ b fara a wora awɔr bumo be ŋgbar Laikonia to a kaŋɛ: “Anyi be ebɔrɛana e ki enyiŋgbasa n shi ebɔrɛso ŋ gbelge m ba anyi kutɔ na.”

english_verse: The people then gave Barnabas the name Zeus, and they gave Paul the name Hermes, because he did the talking.
translation_verse: Ketre nɛ b daŋ nase Baanabas e daa la Zius, bumo be kegbir ko be ketre nseŋ nase Pɔɔl malɛ Hɛmes, bumo be kegbir ko malɛ be ketre, ŋkpal manɛ so mo e daa malga.

english_verse: The temple of Zeus was near the entrance to the city. Its priest and the crowds wanted to offer a sacrifice to Barnabas and Paul. So the priest brought some bulls and flowers to the city gates.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ kegbirwura nɛ e daa keni kegbir Zius be kelɔŋɛ be ebu nɛ k daa wɔ kade na be ekarso na so na ta egbolu nɛ atoto m ba kabuna na to. Mo nɛ jimaŋ na daa sha kemɔ amo nna n lara sarga n sa beshuŋipo na.

english_verse: In times past, God let each nation go its own way.
translation_verse: Saŋɛ na e daŋ yige basa kikɛ nna fanɛ b baa bɛ bumo gbagba be aparsheŋ be ekpaana so.

english_verse: But he showed he was there by the good things he did. God sends rain from heaven and makes your crops grow. He gives food to you and makes your hearts glad.
translation_verse: Ama jemanɛ kikɛ, mo alɛ bee wora asɔ lela damta nna a ŋini menyi esa nɛ e la mo. Mo e naa sa menyi bɔrɛchu nɛ adɔjibi jemanɛ nɛ a daga. Mo e naa sa menyi ajibi jiso nsaa shin nɛ kagbenefuli bee bɔlɔ menyi to.”

english_verse: Even after Paul and Barnabas had said all this, they could hardly keep the people from offering a sacrifice to them.
translation_verse: Kamalga ere be kaman gba, keju basa na ashi sarga na be kelara n sa bumo to daa du kpakpa.

english_verse: Some Jewish leaders from Antioch and Iconium came and turned the crowds against Paul. They hit him with stones and dragged him out of the city, thinking he was dead.
translation_verse: Juwebi ko daŋ shi Pisidia be Antiɔk nɛ Ikoniam m ba kilgi jimaŋ na be ŋgbene nseŋ kpa Pɔɔl ajembu ŋ gbɛ mo n lar kade na to n ya lɛ a tama fanɛ e wu na.

english_verse: But when the Lord's followers gathered around Paul, he stood up and went back into the city. The next day he and Barnabas went to Derbe. Paul and Barnabas Return to Antioch in Syria
translation_verse: Ama beyirdapoana na ka ba chala ŋ kulti mo nɛ e koso n niŋi to m bɛta n luri kade na to. Kumo be ŋklade nɛ mo nɛ Baanabas yɔ Dɛbi. Pɔɔl nɛ Baanabas ka naŋ bɛta n yɔ Siriya be Antiɔk be asheŋ

english_verse: Paul and Barnabas preached the good news in Derbe and won some people to the Lord. Then they went back to Lystra, Iconium, and Antioch in Pisidia.
translation_verse: Pɔɔl nɛ Baanabas daŋ bɔ baru lela na n sa Dɛbiebi n shin nɛ basa damta ki bebɛsopo ndoŋ.

english_verse: Paul and Barnabas chose some leaders for each of the churches. Then they went without eating and prayed that the Lord would take good care of these leaders who had trusted in the Lord.
translation_verse: Asɔri kama to, b daa lara benimu nna a sa kumo to be basa nseŋ daa ta kabɔrɛkule nɛ ekishi a ta basa na kikɛ a bɔɔ Enyɛnpe nɛ bumo be yirda daa wɔ so na enɔ.

english_verse: Paul and Barnabas went on through Pisidia to Pamphylia,
translation_verse: B ka bɔla Pisidia be kasawule so m ba lar nɛ b ba Pamfilia

english_verse: where they preached in the town of Perga. Then they went down to Attalia
translation_verse: m ba bɔ kubɔya na ashi Pɛga nseŋ yɔ Atalia

english_verse: and sailed to Antioch in Syria. It was there that they had been placed in God's care for the work they had now completed.
translation_verse: n ya yili ndoŋ n luri ekuloŋgboŋ ko to m bɛta n yɔ Antiɔk kakpa nɛ b daŋ yili n ta bumo m bɔɔ Ebɔrɛ enɔ nɛ e baa keni bumo so ashi kushuŋ nɛ b daa loge na to.

english_verse: After arriving in Antioch, they called the church together. They told the people what God had helped them do and how he had made it possible for the Gentiles to believe.
translation_verse: B ka ba Antiɔk nɛ b shɛr asɔriebi na kikɛ ŋ kaŋɛ bumo asɔ nɛ bumo nɛ Ebɔrɛ wora kikɛ nɛ kananɛ e bugi ekpa n sa nnyamase gba nɛ b yirda.

english_verse: Then they stayed there with the followers for a long time.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ b chena bebɛsopo na kutɔ kade na to n chɛr ga.

english_verse: Some people came from Judea and started teaching the Lord's followers that they could not be saved, unless they were circumcised as Moses had taught.
translation_verse: Basa ko daŋ shi Judiya m ba Antiɔk m ba fara a ŋini bekurgepoana le be asheŋ a kaŋɛ: “B baa maŋ ku fo kututu fanɛ kananɛ Mosis be mbra na bee ŋini na, Ebɔrɛ maaŋ mɔlga fo kikɛ.”

english_verse: This caused trouble, and Paul and Barnabas argued with them about this teaching. So it was decided to send Paul and Barnabas and a few others to Jerusalem to discuss this problem with the apostles and the church leaders. The Church Leaders Meet in Jerusalem
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ b kpal loŋ so n ji Pɔɔl nɛ Baanabas emɔrɔ kpakpaso ga nseŋ yili kumo fanɛ Pɔɔl nɛ Baanabas nɛ Antiɔk be basa na be beko e yɔ Jerusalɛm nɛ bumo nɛ beshuŋipo na nɛ benimuana na e ya malga demu na be asheŋ.

english_verse: The men who were sent by the church went through Phoenicia and Samaria, telling how the Gentiles had turned to God. This news made the Lord's followers very happy.
translation_verse: Asɔriebi na ka keta bumo n lar ekpa m bɛta nɛ b bɔla Fenisha nɛ Samɛria ŋ kaŋɛ ndoŋ be asɔriebiana kananɛ nnyamase gba fara a bɛ Ebɔrɛ so nɛ kumo be loŋ be baru na fuli bekurgepoana na kikɛ be ŋgbene ga.

english_verse: When the men arrived in Jerusalem, they were welcomed by the church, including the apostles and the leaders. They told them everything God had helped them do.
translation_verse: B ka ba Jerusalɛm nɛ asɔriebi na nɛ beshuŋipo na nɛ benimuana na sɔ bumo nɛnɛ nɛ b kaŋɛ bumo asɔ nɛ bumo nɛ Ebɔrɛ wora kikɛ nyam.

english_verse: But some Pharisees had become followers of the Lord. They stood up and said, “Gentiles who have faith in the Lord must be circumcised and told to obey the Law of Moses.”
translation_verse: Nɛ beyirdapoana na be beko nɛ b shi Efarisiana na be katuŋ to na niŋi to n yili ŋ kaŋɛ: “A daga fanɛ b ku bumo atutu ŋkeŋ shin nɛ b baa nu a sa Mosis be mbraana na.”

english_verse: The apostles and church leaders met to discuss this problem about Gentiles.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ beshuŋipo na nɛ benimuana na shɛr nɛ b keni demu na to.

english_verse: They had talked it over for a long time, when Peter got up and said: My friends, you know that God decided long ago to let me be the one from your group to preach the good news to the Gentiles. God did this so they would hear and obey him.
translation_verse: B daŋ keni kumo to loŋ nɛ Pita ya niŋi to n yili ŋ kaŋɛ: “Ŋ kurgepoana, men nyi fanɛ ma nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ lara menyi to dra na kikɛ fanɛ n ya bɔ baru lela na be kubɔya na n sa nnyamase nɛ b nu nseŋ yirda.

english_verse: He knows what is in everyone's heart. And he showed he had chosen the Gentiles, when he gave them the Holy Spirit, just as he had given his Spirit to us.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ nɛ e nyi basa kikɛ be ŋgbene kikɛ na malɛ e sa bumo Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na fanɛ kananɛ e daŋ wora n sa anyi na, a ŋini fanɛ nnyamase gba beeŋ tiŋ ŋ ki beyirdapo.

english_verse: God treated them in the same way that he treated us. They put their faith in him, and he made their hearts pure.
translation_verse: E maŋ ŋini fanɛ an kɔr bumo to. Bumo be yirda so nɛ e ta bumo be alubi m paŋ bumo.

english_verse: Now why are you trying to make God angry by placing a heavy burden on these followers? This burden was too heavy for us or our ancestors.
translation_verse: Nɛ manɛ e ba nɛ menyee ta le be kesheŋ kpakpaso nɛ an nanaana maŋ tiŋ ŋko an gbagba maaŋ tiŋ n wora a deŋi beyirdapo ere so nɛ men wora Ebɔrɛ ŋ keni?

english_verse: But we believe that we will be saved by the gift of undeserved grace from our Lord Jesus Christ, just as the Gentiles are.
translation_verse: Akai, loŋ maŋ nyalɛ. An yirda fanɛ Enyɛnpe Yesu be kuwɔr be kakɛ na so nɛ an nya kumɔlga. Loŋ malɛ e la bumo alɛ gba.”

english_verse: Everyone kept quiet and listened as Barnabas and Paul told how God had given them the power to work a lot of miracles and wonders for the Gentiles.
translation_verse: Pɔɔl nɛ Baanabas ka bee kute Ebɔrɛ be etɔɔnɛsheŋ nɛ emamachisheŋ damta nɛ Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ b wora nnyamase na to be asheŋ ere nɛ basa na kikɛ la to boeŋ a nu.

english_verse: After they had finished speaking, James said: My friends, listen to me!
translation_verse: B ka malga n loge nɛ Jeems malɛ ta ŋ kaŋɛ: “Bekurgepoana, men nu ma kutɔ nfe.

english_verse: Simon Peter has told how God first came to the Gentiles and made some of them his own people.
translation_verse: Naniere nɛ Saimɔn kute kananɛ Ebɔrɛ fara n sha nnyamase na n lara bumo to be basa nɛ baaŋ baa la mo peya.

english_verse: “I, the Lord, will return and rebuild David's fallen house. I will build it from its ruins and set it up again.
translation_verse: ‘Kede be kaman meeŋ naŋ bɛta m ba m ba bar Deevid be kanaŋ ŋkpa to n naŋ pɔr kanaŋ na be alambure na m bɛ abar so.

english_verse: Then other nations will turn to me and be my chosen ones. I, the Lord, say this.
translation_verse: Nɛ basa pɔtɛ nɛ b ka na kikɛ nɛ nnyamase nɛ n lara ŋ ki meya na kikɛ e ba fin ma.

english_verse: And so, my friends, I don't think we should place burdens on the Gentiles who are turning to God.
translation_verse: Nɛ Jeems naŋ kaŋɛ: “Ma ere kutɔ an sa maŋ tɔrɔ nnyamase nɛ b fara nɛ b bɛ Ebɔrɛ so ere.

english_verse: We should simply write and tell them not to eat anything that has been offered to idols. They should be told not to eat the meat of any animal that has been strangled or that still has blood in it. They must also not commit any terrible sexual sins.
translation_verse: Ama a daga fanɛ an sibɛ kawɔl ŋ kaŋɛ bumo fanɛ b sa maa ji ajibi nɛ a maŋ walɛ so ŋkpal a ka la kalɔŋɛ be ajibi so. An kaŋɛ bumo fanɛ b baa gelge kubojuaji nsaa maa ji ŋklaŋ ŋko kusɔbɔya kama nɛ b maŋ teŋ.

english_verse: We must remember that the Law of Moses has been preached in city after city for many years, and every Sabbath it is read in our synagogues. A Letter to Gentiles Who Had Faith in the Lord
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, basa ka fara a kraŋ Mosis be mbra na ashi nshɛrbuana to kewushiachɛ kama na nɛ kananɛ b malga amo be asheŋ kade kama to na chɛr ga kabre.” B ka sibɛ kawɔl n sa nnyamase na be asheŋ

english_verse: The apostles, the leaders, and all the church members decided to send some men to Antioch along with Paul and Barnabas. They chose Silas and Judas Barsabbas, who were two leaders of the Lord's followers.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ beshuŋipo na nɛ benimuana na nɛ asɔriebi na kikɛ wora kɔnɔkoŋwule fanɛ b lara katuŋ na to be basa ko n shuŋi bumo nɛ Pɔɔl nɛ Baanabas Antiɔk. Judas nɛ baa tre Baasabas na nɛ Sailas nɛ b daŋ lara. Bumo benyɔ na daa la basa nɛ bekurgepoana na kikɛ daa sa bunyaŋ nna.

english_verse: They wrote a letter that said: We apostles and leaders send friendly greetings to all of you Gentiles who are followers of the Lord in Antioch, Syria, and Cilicia.
translation_verse: Le be kawɔl nɛ b daŋ ta n shuŋi mbɔ na: “Beshuŋipo na nɛ benimuana na bee chɔrɔ menyi nnyamase nɛ men la bekurgepoana a wɔ Antiɔk nɛ Siriya nɛ Silisia to na.

english_verse: We have heard that some people from here have terribly upset you by what they said. But we did not send them!
translation_verse: An nu kananɛ anyi to be beko ya malga asheŋ ko a tɔrɔ menyi n shin nɛ menyi be ŋgbene jija menyi ga, ama men baa nyi fanɛ mannɛ anyi e shuŋi bumo fanɛ b ya kaŋɛ menyi loŋ.

english_verse: So we met together and decided to choose some men and to send them to you along with our good friends Barnabas and Paul.
translation_verse: Amoso nɛ an shɛr n wora kɔnɔkoŋwule n lara anyi to be beko n shuŋi bumo menyi kutɔ na.

english_verse: We are also sending Judas and Silas, who will tell you in person the same things that we are writing.
translation_verse: Menyeeŋ nu asheŋ koŋwule nɛ anyee sibɛ ere gbagba ashi Judas nɛ Sailas nɛ anyee shuŋi ere be kɔnɔ to.

english_verse: But you should not eat anything offered to idols. You should not eat any meat that still has the blood in it or any meat of any animal that has been strangled. You must also not commit any terrible sexual sins. If you follow these instructions, you will do well. We send our best wishes.
translation_verse: Men sa maa ji nlɔŋɛjibi, men sa maa ji ŋklaŋ, men sa maa we kusɔbɔya kama nɛ b maŋ teŋ. Kumo nɛ k ka na e la fanɛ men baa gelge kubojuaji. Men baa gelge asheŋ ere, asheŋ beeŋ nyalɛ n sa menyi. Ebɔrɛ e chɛ menyi to.”

english_verse: The four men left Jerusalem and went to Antioch. Then they called the church members together and gave them the letter.
translation_verse: Kede be kaman nɛ b sa mbɔ na ekpa nɛ b yɔ Antiɔk n ya shɛr beyirdapoana na kikɛ n ta kawɔl na n sa bumo.

english_verse: When the letter was read, everyone was pleased and greatly encouraged.
translation_verse: Basa na ka kraŋ kawɔl na nɛ bumo be ŋgbene fuli bumo ga ŋkpal kananɛ kubɔya na leŋ bumo to na so.

english_verse: Judas and Silas were prophets, and they spoke a long time, encouraging and helping the Lord's followers.
translation_verse: Judas nɛ Sailas nɛ bumo alɛ gba daa la anebiana na daŋ malga n chɛr ga a ŋini bekurgepoana na asheŋ n leŋ bumo to.

english_verse: The men from Jerusalem stayed on in Antioch for a while. And when they left to return to the ones who had sent them, the followers wished them well.
translation_verse: B ka wora nchɛnnyɔ ndoŋ nɛ bekurgepoana na sa bumo ekpa nɛ b bɛta n yɔ nɛ kagbenewushi bumo nɛ b shuŋi bumo na kutɔ.

english_verse: But Paul and Barnabas stayed on in Antioch, where they and many others taught and preached about the Lord. Paul and Barnabas Go Their Separate Ways
translation_verse: Nɛ Pɔɔl nɛ Baanabas wora nchɛnnyɔ ashi Antiɔk nɛ bumo nɛ bebɛsopoana na be bedamta ŋini basa abɔrɛsheŋ m bɔ Enyɛnpe be kubɔya na n sa bumo. Pɔɔl nɛ Baanabas ka barga to be asheŋ

english_verse: Sometime later Paul said to Barnabas, “Let's go back and visit the Lord's followers in the cities where we preached his message. Then we will know how they are doing.”
translation_verse: B wɔtɔ loŋ nɛ kachako Pɔɔl ba kaŋɛ Baanabas: “Shin nɛ an naŋ ya bɔɔ nde nɛ an daŋ ya bɔ Enyɛnpe be kubɔya n sa na to ebi be bekurgepoana na so ŋ keni kananɛ baa bɛ so.”

english_verse: Barnabas wanted to take along John, whose other name was Mark.
translation_verse: Nɛ Baanabas yɛ b keta Jɔn Maak n ti bumo be amu so a yɔ.

english_verse: Paul and Barnabas argued, then each of them went his own way. Barnabas took Mark and sailed to Cyprus,
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ b ji kumo be emɔrɔ ga m barga to. Nɛ Baanabas keta Maak n luri ekuloŋgboŋ ko to m bɔla nchu so n yɔ Saipres.

english_verse: but Paul took Silas and left after the followers had placed them in God's care.
translation_verse: Nɛ Pɔɔl malɛ ta Sailas, nɛ bekurgepoana na ta bumo m bɔɔ Ebɔrɛ enɔ nɛ e baa keni bumo so. Kumo be kaman nɛ b yɔ.

english_verse: Paul and Silas went back to Derbe and Lystra, where there was a follower named Timothy. His mother was also a follower. She was Jewish, and his father was Greek.
translation_verse: Pɔɔl ta loŋ n ya fo Dɛbi n lar ndoŋ n yɔ Listra n ya tu ebɛsopo ko nɛ baa tre Timoti ndoŋ. Mo nio gba daa la eyirdapo nna a la Juw nɛ mo tuto malɛ daa la Griik.

english_verse: The Lord's followers in Lystra and Iconium said good things about Timothy,
translation_verse: Timoti daa kɔ ketre ga ashi bekurgepoana nɛ b daa wɔ Listra nɛ Ikoniam na kikɛ nyam kutɔ.

english_verse: and Paul wanted him to go with them. But Paul first had him circumcised, because all the Jewish people around there knew that Timothy's father was Greek.
translation_verse: Pɔɔl ka daa sha keketa Timoti n yɔ so e ku mo kututu nna. E daŋ wora loŋ nna ŋkpal ndoŋ be basa na kikɛ ka daa nyi Timoti mo tuto ka la Griik so.

english_verse: As Paul and the others went from city to city, they told the followers what the apostles and leaders in Jerusalem had decided, and they urged them to follow these instructions.
translation_verse: Kade kama to nɛ b daŋ yɔ b daa kaŋɛ beyirdapoana na asɔ nɛ beshuŋipo nɛ benimuana nɛ b wɔ Jerusalɛm na wora kɔnɔkoŋwule n yili na nna nsaa kaŋɛ bumo fanɛ b baa bɛ loŋ be mbraana na so.

english_verse: The churches became stronger in their faith, and each day more people put their faith in the Lord. Paul's Vision in Troas
translation_verse: Amoso, asɔriebi na daa naŋ nya keyirda be eleŋ nna nseŋ naa wora keshi kachɛ kama malɛ gba a ti so. Pɔɔl ka ku bɔrɛdare ashi Trowas be asheŋ

english_verse: Paul and his friends went through Phrygia and Galatia, but the Holy Spirit would not let them preach in Asia.
translation_verse: B ka naŋ lar Listra nɛ b bɔla Frijia nɛ Galeesha be efuliana so be egbaŋ to, ŋkpal manɛ so, Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na daa maŋ shin nɛ b bɔ kubɔya na ashi Eeshia be efuli so.

english_verse: After they arrived in Mysia, they tried to go into Bithynia, but the Spirit of Jesus would not let them.
translation_verse: B ka fo Maisiya be efuli be ekar to a sha keyɔ Bitinia be efuli so nɛ Yesu be Kiyoyu na maŋ sa bumo ekpa.

english_verse: So they went on through Mysia until they came to Troas.
translation_verse: Nɛ b bɔla Maisiya to n yɔ Trowas.

english_verse: During the night, Paul had a vision of someone from Macedonia who was standing there and begging him, “Come over to Macedonia and help us!”
translation_verse: Kumo be kamɔnchɛ be kanyɛso nɛ Pɔɔl ku bɔrɛdare ko n wu Masɛdonia be kanyɛn ko ka yil a kule mo: “Dii a ba Masɛdonia nfe m ba chɛ anyi to!”

english_verse: After Paul had seen the vision, we began looking for a way to go to Macedonia. We were sure that God had called us to preach the good news there. Lydia Becomes a Follower of the Lord
translation_verse: Pɔɔl ka ku le be bɔrɛdare na nɛ an bela ase manaŋ manaŋ m pɛ Masɛdonia be ekpa, ŋkpal manɛ so, an daŋ yili kumo nna fanɛ Ebɔrɛ e tre anyi fanɛ an ya bɔ baru lela na n sa ndoŋebi. Libiya ka ki ebɛsopo ashi Filipai be asheŋ

english_verse: We sailed straight from Troas to Samothrace, and the next day we arrived in Neapolis.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ an yili Trowas n luri ekuloŋgboŋ ko to m bɔla nchu so n ta n yɔ Samɔtrees ŋ klade n yili ndoŋ n yɔ Niyapɔlis.

english_verse: From there we went to Philippi, which is a Roman colony in the first district of Macedonia. We spent several days in Philippi.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nɛ an ya yili n nite n yɔ Filipai, Masɛdonia be efuli so be kadegboŋ juŋkparso ko. Romebi e daŋ jɔŋɛ kumo ere gba a wɔ ndoŋ. An daŋ wora nchɛnnyɔ kade na to.

english_verse: Then on the Sabbath we went outside the city gate to a place by the river, where we thought there would be a Jewish meeting place for prayer. We sat down and talked with the women who came.
translation_verse: Kewushiachɛ ka fo nɛ an lar kade na to n yɔ lɔr ko ase kakpa nɛ an daa tama Juwebi be kabɔrɛkulekpa beeŋ baa wɔ.

english_verse: Then after she and her family were baptized, she kept on begging us, “If you think I really do have faith in the Lord, come stay in my home.” Finally, we accepted her invitation. Paul and Silas Are Put in Jail
translation_verse: B daŋ bɛr mo nɛ mbe laŋ to ebi kikɛ kabɔrɛbɛr nna. Le nɛ e daŋ ba kaŋɛ anyi: “Nɛ men baa nyi fanɛ n la Enyɛnpe na be eyirdapo kashenteŋto nna, men ba kaa wɔ ma pe.” Le nɛ e daŋ ta n shin nɛ an yɔ. B ka ti Pɔɔl nɛ Sailas ebu be asheŋ
