translation_verse: Ama baŋ yili Adam be jemanɛ na m ba fo Mosis be jemanɛ to be basa kikɛ, luwu pɔɔ ekama so, hale bumo nɛ b maŋ wora n da Ebɔrɛ be kɔnɔ so geeŋ fanɛ kananɛ Adam daŋ wora na gba. Adam e daa la esa nɛ e daa ba na be kaduli.

english_verse: There is a lot of difference between Adam's sin and God's gift. That one sin led to punishment. But God's gift made it possible for us to be acceptable to him, even though we have sinned many times.
translation_verse: Kusɔ nɛ k lar kakɛ na malɛ gba be kaman naa chɔ kusɔ nɛ k lar esa koŋwule be kulubi na be kaman, ŋkpal manɛ so, Adam ka baŋ wora kulubi koŋwule na n loge nɛ kewora n da so be nfɛra ba. Ama alubi damta malɛ be kewora ka ba nɛ Ebɔrɛ be kuwɔr be kakɛ shin nɛ kejinlar Ebɔrɛ be anishito malɛ ba.

english_verse: Death ruled like a king because Adam had sinned. But that cannot compare with what Jesus Christ has done. God has treated us with undeserved grace, and he has accepted us because of Jesus. And so we will live and rule like kings.
translation_verse: Kashenteŋ nna fanɛ esa koŋwule be kulubi so nɛ luwu ba kaa ji kuwura basa so, ama kusɔ nɛ esa koŋwule, Yesu Kristo wora na chɔ kumo ga. Ekama malɛ nɛ e sɔ Ebɔrɛ be kuwɔr be kakɛ damta na nɛ mbe alelasheŋ be kakɛ na, beeŋ bɔla Kristo so a wɔ ŋkpa to a ji kuwura.

english_verse: Everyone was going to be punished because Adam sinned. But because of the good thing that Christ has done, God accepts us and gives us the gift of life.
translation_verse: Amoso, kananɛ esa koŋwule be kulubi na baŋ shin nɛ basa kikɛ tɔr Ebɔrɛ be ntaŋ n nya kasogberge na, loŋ koŋwule na nɛ esa koŋwule be kelela koŋwule nɛ e wora na bee sɔ basa kikɛ a yige a sa bumo ŋkpa.

english_verse: Adam disobeyed God and caused many others to be sinners. But Jesus obeyed him and will make many people acceptable to God.
translation_verse: Nɛ kananɛ esa koŋwule be kasomaanu shin nɛ basa kikɛ ki alubiworapoana na koŋwule na nɛ esa koŋwule mo na be kasonu beeŋ shin nɛ basa damta e ki belelapo Ebɔrɛ be anishito.

english_verse: The Law came, so that the full power of sin could be seen. Yet where sin was powerful, God's gift of undeserved grace was even more powerful.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ bar mbra na nna nɛ basa be alubi e wora keshi n ti so, ama kanaŋkamaso malɛ nɛ alubi bee wora keshi a ti so, saŋɛ na so nɛ Ebɔrɛ malɛ bee shin nɛ mbe kuwɔr be kakɛ bee wora keshi a ti so a chɔ loŋ.

english_verse: Sin ruled by means of death. But God's gift of grace now rules, and God has accepted us because of Jesus Christ our Lord. This means that we will have eternal life.
translation_verse: Amoso, kananɛ alubi baŋ bɔla luwu so ŋ ŋini amo be eleŋ na, loŋ koŋwule na nɛ Ebɔrɛ be kuwɔr be kakɛ na bee bɔla alelasheŋ so a ŋini kumo be eleŋ m bɔla an Nyɛnpe Yesu Kristo so a kɔ anyi a yɔ ŋkpa nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar to.

english_verse: What should we say? Should we keep on sinning, so that God's gift of undeserved grace will show up even better?
translation_verse: To, naniere, nuso nɛ anyeeŋ kaŋɛ? Fanɛ an baa wɔtɔ a wora alubi nɛ Ebɔrɛ be kuwɔr be kakɛ na malɛ e baa wora keshi a ti so ŋko?

english_verse: No, we should not! If we are dead to sin, how can we go on sinning?
translation_verse: Kaarɛ, loŋ maŋ daga, ŋkpal manɛ so, alubi be kewora be kaplɛa so, an wu nna, amoso, nuso nɛ anyeeŋ wora ŋ kraa wɔ amo be kewora be kebaawɔtɔ to?

english_verse: Don't you know that all who share in Christ Jesus by being baptized also share in his death?
translation_verse: Ŋko men maŋ nyi fanɛ anyi kikɛ nɛ b bɛr kabɔrɛbɛr ŋkpal Yesu Kristo so ere, b bɛr anyi nna n wɔtɔ mbe luwu na to a?

english_verse: When we were baptized, we died and were buried with Christ. We were baptized, so we would live a new life, as Christ was raised to life by the glory of God the Father.
translation_verse: Anyi nɛ mo alɛ nɛ b puli saŋɛ nɛ b bɛr anyi kabɔrɛbɛr a ŋini fanɛ anyi nɛ mo koŋwule na e luri mbe luwu na to na, saŋɛ na so, kananɛ Etuto na baŋ ta mbe eleŋgboŋ n shin nɛ Kristo na tiŋi luwu to na, anyi alɛ gba beeŋ nya kebaawɔtɔ popɔr a wɔtɔ.

english_verse: We know that the persons we used to be were nailed to the cross with Jesus. This was done, so our sinful bodies would no longer be the slaves of sin.
translation_verse: Anyi alɛ nyi fanɛ anyi be kebaawɔtɔ dra na nɛ Yesu nɛ b daŋ mɔ kedibi largato na so na, saŋɛ na so alubi be eleŋ nɛ k bee ji da dra na so eleŋ na beeŋ mur nɛ an sa maŋ naa la alubi be anya.

english_verse: We know sin doesn't have power over dead people.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, esa baŋ wu, kumo ere e nya mbe kumu ashi alubi be eleŋ to.

english_verse: As surely as we died with Christ, we believe we will also live with him.
translation_verse: Nɛ anyi nɛ Kristo na e wu, kumo ere an yirda fanɛ anyi nɛ mo e naaŋ baa wɔ ŋkpa to.

english_verse: We know that death no longer has any power over Christ. He died and was raised to life, never again to die.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, an nyi fanɛ Kristo ka baŋ tiŋi luwu to ere bre, e maaŋ naŋ wu kikɛ. Luwu maŋ naa kɔ mbe eleŋ.

english_verse: When Christ died, he died for sin once and for all. But now he is alive, and he lives only for God.
translation_verse: Mbe luwu be kaplɛa so, kela koŋwule pati nɛ e wu m pɔɔ alubi be eleŋ so, mbe ŋkpa malɛ be kaplɛa so, e wɔ kumo to nna ŋkpal Ebɔrɛ so.

english_verse: In the same way, you must think of yourselves as dead to the power of sin. But Christ Jesus has given life to you, and you live for God.
translation_verse: Loŋ koŋwule na e daga fanɛ menyi alɛ gba e baa ta menyi be amu fanɛ men wu nna nɛ alubi maŋ naa ji menyi so eleŋ, ama men bɔla Kristo Yesu so nna a kɔ ŋkpa a wɔtɔ ŋkpal Ebɔrɛ so.

english_verse: Don't let sin rule your body. After all, your body is bound to die, so don't obey its desires
translation_verse: Amoso, men sa maŋ naa shin nɛ alubi e baa pɔɔ menyi be eyurana nɛ a beeŋ wu ere so nɛ men baa nu a sa amo be ayɛlgasɔ lubiana.

english_verse: Don't let sin keep ruling your lives. You are ruled by God's undeserved grace and not by the Law. Slaves Who Do What Pleases God
translation_verse: A maŋ daga alubi ka ji menyi so kuwura, ŋkpal manɛ so, men maŋ naa wɔ mbra na to. Ebɔrɛ be kakɛ na be kebaawɔtɔ to nɛ men wɔ. Alelasheŋ be anya be asheŋ

english_verse: What does all this mean? Does it mean we are free to sin, because we are ruled by God's gift of undeserved grace and not by the Law? Certainly not!
translation_verse: To, naniere, nuso nɛ anyeeŋ kaŋɛ? Fanɛ ŋkpal an ka maŋ naa wɔ mbra na to nsaa wɔ Ebɔrɛ be kuwɔr be kakɛ be kebaawɔtɔ to so an baa wora alubi a? Kaarɛ, loŋ maŋ daga.

english_verse: Don't you know that you are slaves of anyone you obey? You can be slaves of sin and die, or you can be obedient slaves of God and be acceptable to him.
translation_verse: Men maŋ nyi fanɛ men baŋ ta menyi be amu m bɔɔ esa enɔ fanɛ amodoŋwura be anya, men ki mbe anya kashenteŋto a? Menyeeŋ tiŋ a la alubi nɛ a beeŋ shin nɛ men wu na be anya, menyi alɛ beeŋ naŋ tiŋ a la kasonu nɛ kumo be lalaloge beeŋ shin nɛ men ki belelapo Ebɔrɛ be anishito na be anya.

english_verse: You used to be slaves of sin. But I thank God that with all your heart you followed the example set forth in the teaching you received.
translation_verse: Ama anyee chɔrɔ Ebɔrɛ ga, ŋkpal manɛ so, saŋko men daa la alubi be anya nna, ama naniere, men ta menyi be ŋgbene kikɛ m bɛ kashenteŋ be keŋiniana nɛ men nya na kikɛ so.

english_verse: Now you are set free from sin and are slaves who please God.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ shin nna nɛ men nya menyi be amu ashi alubi be eleŋ to nseŋ ba ki alelasheŋ be anya.

english_verse: I am using these everyday examples, because in some ways you are still weak. You used to let the different parts of your body be slaves of your evil thoughts. But now you must make every part of your body serve God, so that you will belong completely to him.
translation_verse: Enyiŋgbasa be nfɛra be kaplɛa so nɛ mee ber kesheŋ ere a sa menyi nna, ŋkpal manɛ so, loŋ e naaŋ shin nɛ men pin amo to. Saŋko men daŋ ta menyi be amu kikɛ nna nyam ŋ ki kusɔjigaya nɛ dalubisheŋ be anya a wɔtɔ a wora asheŋ nɛ a maŋ daga. Naniere loŋ koŋwule na e daga fanɛ men naŋ ta menyi be amu kikɛ nyam ŋ ki alelasheŋ be anya a wɔtɔ a wora asheŋ nɛ a daga a du cheembi.

english_verse: When you were slaves of sin, you didn't have to please God.
translation_verse: Men ka daa la alubi be anya na, menyi nɛ alelasheŋ daa maŋ kɔ shɛŋ.

english_verse: But what good did you receive from the things you did? All you have to show for them is your shame, and they lead to death.
translation_verse: Men ka daa wora asheŋ nɛ amo be asheŋ bee pɛ menyi anishinyɔr ere, manɛ be tɔnɔ nɛ men daŋ nya amo to? Loŋ be asheŋ na be tɔnɔ e la luwu.

english_verse: Now you have been set free from sin, and you are God's slaves. This will make you holy and will lead you to eternal life.
translation_verse: Ama naniere men ka nya menyi be amu ashi alubi to m ba ki Ebɔrɛ be anya ere bre, tɔnɔ mo nɛ menyee nya e la kebaawɔtɔ cheembi, kumo alɛ be lalaloge e la ŋkpa nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na.

english_verse: Sin pays off with death. But God's gift is eternal life given by Jesus Christ our Lord.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, asheŋ lubi be kakɔka e la luwu, ama Ebɔrɛ be kagbene koŋwuleso be kakɛ e la ŋkpa nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na ashi an Nyɛnpe Yesu Kristo to.

english_verse: to marry someone else. However, if she goes off with another man while her husband is still alive, she is said to be unfaithful.
translation_verse: Amoso, nɛ mo kul na kraa wɔ ŋkpa to nɛ e ya kil enyɛn pɔtɛ, e ki bojua. Ama nɛ mo kul na baŋ wu bre, kumo ere mbra sa ekpa fanɛ e naŋ kil, e maŋ ki bojua.

english_verse: That is how it is with you, my friends. You are now part of the body of Christ and are dead to the power of the Law. You are free to belong to Christ, who was raised to life so we could serve God.
translation_verse: Ŋ kurgepoana, loŋ nɛ k du n sa menyi alɛ gba, ŋkpal manɛ so, mbra na be kaplɛa so, menyi alɛ gba wu nna ŋkpal men ka la Kristo be eyur na be kaba ko so. Naniere malɛ, men la mo koŋwule nɛ Ebɔrɛ tiŋi mo ashi luwu to nɛ an tiŋ a la basa nɛ b kɔ tɔnɔ ashi Ebɔrɛ be kushuŋ to na peya nna.

english_verse: When we thought only of ourselves, the Law made us have sinful desires. It made every part of our bodies into slaves who are doomed to die.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, saŋɛ nɛ anyi be kebaawɔtɔ dra nɛ k daa wɔ anyi nɛ mbra na daa shin nɛ eyur to be ayɛlgasɔ daa kɔ anyi to a shuŋ na, luwu nɛ an daa kɔ tɔnɔ a sa.

english_verse: But the Law no longer rules over us. We are like dead people, and it cannot have any power over us. Now we can serve God in a new way by obeying his Spirit, and not in the old way by obeying the written Law. The Battle with Sin
translation_verse: Ama naniere bre mbra na maŋ naa ji kuwura anyi so, ŋkpal manɛ so, kusɔ nɛ k daŋ nyaŋ anyi a wɔtɔ na be kaplɛa so, an wu nna naniere. Anyi maŋ naa shuŋ ekpa dra nɛ k la mbra nɛ b sibɛ n nase na, ekpa popɔr nɛ k la Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na peya na nɛ an naa shuŋ. Mbra nɛ kulubi be asheŋ

english_verse: Does this mean that the Law is sinful? Certainly not! But if it had not been for the Law, I would not have known what sin is really like. For example, I would not have known what it means to want something that belongs to someone else, unless the Law had told me not to do this.
translation_verse: To, naniere, nuso nɛ anyeeŋ kaŋɛ? An kaŋɛ fanɛ mbra na gbagba lubi nna ŋko? Kaarɛ, anyi maaŋ tiŋ ŋ kaŋɛ loŋ kuraa. Ŋkpal manɛ so, mbra na e shin nɛ m pin kusɔ nɛ k la kulubi. Nɛ mbra na daa maŋ kaŋɛ le nna: “Sa maŋ yɛlga fo barkasa be kusɔ,” n daa maaŋ pin loŋ be kayɛlga be asheŋ to.

english_verse: It was sin that used this command as a way of making me have all kinds of desires. But without the Law, sin is dead.
translation_verse: Ntaŋ malɛ so nɛ alubi nya ekpa n shin nɛ ayɛlgasɔ be yiri kikɛ nyam kaa, ŋkpal manɛ so, kakpa nɛ mbra maŋ wɔtɔ alubi malɛ gba wu nna a dese.

english_verse: Before I knew about the Law, I was alive. But as soon as I heard that command, sin came to life,
translation_verse: Ŋ gbagba daa wɔ ŋkpa to nna a maŋ nyi mbra saŋko, ama ŋ ka ba pin ntaŋ na nɛ alubi malɛ nya ŋkpa ma to

english_verse: and I died. The very command that was supposed to bring life to me, instead brought death.
translation_verse: nɛ n wu, nɛ ntaŋ nɛ k daŋ daga fanɛ k bar ŋkpa na bar luwu m ba sa ma.

english_verse: Sin used this command to trick me, and because of it I died.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, ntaŋ na so nɛ alubi nya ekpa n fule ma. Amoso, ntaŋ na so nɛ alubi bɔla m mɔ ma.

english_verse: Am I saying something good caused my death? Certainly not! It was sin that killed me by using something good. Now we can see how terrible and evil sin really is.
translation_verse: To, kede bee ŋini fanɛ kusɔ lela e bar luwu ŋko? Cha, mannɛ aloŋ nna kuraa. Kulubi e bɔla kusɔ lela so m bar ma luwu nɛ kumo be da lubi gbagba e lar efuli. Amoso, ntaŋ na so nɛ esa bee wu kananɛ kulubi baŋ lubi kashenteŋto.

english_verse: We know that the Law is spiritual. But I am merely a human, and I have been sold as a slave to sin.
translation_verse: An nyi mbra na ka la abɔrɛsheŋ, ama ma ere la nyiŋgbasa nna nɛ alubi kɔ ma fanɛ kenya.

english_verse: In fact, I don't understand why I act the way I do. I don't do what I know is right. I do the things I hate.
translation_verse: Amoso, ma ere gbagba maa pin ma asheŋ woraso to, ŋkpal manɛ so, asɔ nɛ mee sha kewora, amo nɛ m maa wora nsaa wora asɔ nɛ ŋ kishi.

english_verse: Although I don't do what I know is right, I agree that the Law is good.
translation_verse: Nɛ ma alɛ baa wɔtɔ a wora asɔ nɛ m maa sha kebaawora, kumo ere mee ŋini fanɛ mbra na kɔ kashenteŋ nna na.

english_verse: So I am not the one doing these evil things. The sin that lives in me is what does them.
translation_verse: Amoso, mannɛ ma gbagba e naa wora kesheŋ na, kulubi nɛ k wɔ ma to na e naa wora kumo.

english_verse: I know that my selfish desires won't let me do anything that is good. Even when I want to do right, I cannot.
translation_verse: M baa nyi kelela kikɛ ka maŋ wɔ ma to, ma kagbene lubi ere to nɛ n de na. Ŋkpal manɛ so, kelela be kewora be kasha wɔ ma to, ama ma alɛ maaŋ tiŋ n wora kumo.

english_verse: And so, if I don't do what I know is right, I am no longer the one doing these evil things. The sin that lives in me is what does them.
translation_verse: To, naniere k ka baa la fanɛ kusɔ nɛ m maa sha nɛ mee wora ere, kumo ere mannɛ ma e naa wora kumo na, kulubi nɛ k wɔ ma to na e naa wora kumo.

english_verse: The Law has shown me that something in me keeps me from doing what I know is right.
translation_verse: Amoso, k du fanɛ le be kebaawɔtɔ e baa wɔtɔ fanɛ nɛ m baa sha kewora kelela nɛ kulubi teŋ ba sɔ kejuŋkpar.

english_verse: With my whole heart I agree with the Law of God.
translation_verse: Ma kagbene bre gbagba bee sha Ebɔrɛ be mbra na.

english_verse: But in every part of me I discover something fighting against my mind, and it makes me a prisoner of sin that controls everything I do.
translation_verse: Ama ma alɛ bee wu mbra pɔtɛ ko ka wɔ ma eyur to a shuŋ. Mbra ko nna nɛ k bee kɔ mbra nɛ ma nfɛra bee sha na nsaa ta ma a ki alubi be mbra nɛ k wɔ ma eyur to a shuŋ na be kabutipo.

english_verse: What a miserable person I am. Who will rescue me from this body that is doomed to die?
translation_verse: Yee, nuso bre be asheŋ e nya ma le? Nɛ wanɛ malɛ e naaŋ mɔlga ma ashi le be eyur nɛ k kɔ ma a yɔ luwu to ere?

english_verse: Thank God! Jesus Christ will rescue me. So with my mind I serve the Law of God, although my selfish desires make me serve the law of sin.
translation_verse: Mee chɔrɔ Ebɔrɛ ga fanɛ mo e naaŋ bɔla an Nyɛnpe Yesu Kristo so m mɔlga ma. Kusɔ nɛ k baa wɔtɔ kikɛ nde fanɛ ma ere gbagba be nfɛra to n la Ebɔrɛ be mbra na be kenya nna, ama ma kagbene lubi ere bre to n la kulubi be mbra be kenya nna.

english_verse: If you belong to Christ Jesus, you won't be punished.
translation_verse: Bumo nɛ b wɔ Kristo Yesu to naniere bre, kejimbri be kasogberge maŋ naa wɔ bumo so.

english_verse: The Holy Spirit will give you life that comes from Christ Jesus and will set you free from sin and death.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, ŋkpa be Kiyoyu na be mbra bɔla Yesu Kristo so n shin nɛ n nya ma kumu ashi kulubi nɛ luwu be mbra to.

english_verse: The Law of Moses cannot do this, because our selfish desires make the Law weak. But God set you free when he sent his own Son to be like us sinners and to be a sacrifice for our sin. God used Christ's body to condemn sin.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, kusɔ nɛ mbra na daa maaŋ tiŋ n wora ŋkpal dimɛdi be kapɔr lubi ere ka maŋ kɔ eleŋ na so, Ebɔrɛ bre wora kumo. E shuŋi mo Pibinyɛn gbagba nna n ji m bri kulubi nɛ k wɔ dimɛdi be eyur to na. Mo Pibinyɛn na ta eyur fanɛ dimɛdi be alubi be eyur ere nna m ba lara kulubi ashi to.

english_verse: He did this, so that we would do what the Law commands by obeying the Spirit instead of our own desires.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ wora loŋ nna nɛ alelasheŋ nɛ mbra na bee sha na e nya n wora anyi to nɛnɛ ashi anyi nɛ an maŋ naa wɔ alubi be eyur be kebaawɔtɔ to nsaa wɔ Kiyoyu na be kebaawɔtɔ to na to.

english_verse: If our minds are ruled by our desires, we will die. But if our minds are ruled by the Spirit, we will have life and peace.
translation_verse: Keshin nɛ kapɔr lubi ere e baa wɔ fo nfɛra bee yɛr fo luwu to nna nɛ keshin nɛ Kiyoyu na e baa wɔ fo nfɛra malɛ bee yɛr fo ŋkpa nɛ kagbenewushi to.

english_verse: If we follow our desires, we cannot please God.
translation_verse: Bumo nɛ b wɔ bumo be kapɔr lubi na be keŋini to maaŋ tiŋ m par Ebɔrɛ kikɛ.

english_verse: You are no longer ruled by your desires, but by God's Spirit, who lives in you. People who don't have the Spirit of Christ in them don't belong to him.
translation_verse: Ama naniere bre, mannɛ asɔ nɛ menyi be kapɔr lubiana bee ŋini menyi na to nɛ men wɔ, asɔ nɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na bee ŋini menyi na to nɛ men wɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ be Kiyoyu na baa wɔ menyi to nna na, ŋkpal manɛ so, esa kama nɛ e maŋ kɔ Kristo be Kiyoyu na maŋ la Kristo na peya.

english_verse: But Christ lives in you. So you are alive because God has accepted you, even though your bodies must die because of your sins.
translation_verse: Amoso, nɛ Kristo baa wɔ menyi to, hale nɛ menyi be eyurana ere beeŋ wu ŋkpal alubi so gba, menyi be ayoyu bre kɔ ŋkpa nna, ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ nase kumo fanɛ menyi la belelapo nna mbe anishito.

english_verse: If you do, you will die. But you will live, if by the help of God's Spirit you say “No” to your desires.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, nɛ men baa bɛ menyi be kapɔr lubiana ere be keŋini so, menyeeŋ wu, ama nɛ men baŋ bɔla Kiyoyu na so n jija kapɔr lubi ere be ashuŋ lubi na, menyeeŋ nya ŋkpa.

english_verse: Only those people who are led by God's Spirit are his children.
translation_verse: Bekama nɛ Ebɔrɛ be Kiyoyu na bee juŋkpar bumo na kikɛ la Ebɔrɛ be mbia nna.

english_verse: His Spirit lets us know that together with Christ we will be given what God has promised. We will also share in the glory of Christ, because we have suffered with him. A Wonderful Future for God's People
translation_verse: To, nɛ anyi alɛ baa la mbia bre, kumo ere anyeeŋ nya enɛfa nɛ e kɔ a jo mbe basa na. Kumo be kaman nɛ anyi nɛ Kristo e naaŋ nya kusɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ kɔ a sa mo na, ŋkpal manɛ so, nɛ an baa tu Yesu a ji mbe awurfoŋ na fanɛ kananɛ e daŋ ji na, anyi alɛ beeŋ naŋ tu mo n nya mbe kemaŋkura na. Kachako so be kemaŋkura na be asheŋ

english_verse: I am sure what we are suffering now cannot compare with the glory that will be shown to us.
translation_verse: M baa nyi geeŋ fanɛ tɔrɔ mo nɛ anyee nya naniere maaŋ tiŋ n fo kemaŋkura nɛ Ebɔrɛ beeŋ bugi to n sa anyi na kikɛ so kuraa.

english_verse: In fact, all creation is eagerly waiting for God to show who his children are.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ be kepɔrso kikɛ nyam malɛ baa jɔŋ kumo be aya so nna a jo saŋɛ nɛ Ebɔrɛ beeŋ lara mbe mbia efuli na.

english_verse: Meanwhile, creation is confused, but not because it wants to be confused. God made it this way in the hope
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, b yili kumo nna fanɛ kepɔrso kikɛ e sa maa kɔ tɔnɔ kikɛ, mannɛ ŋkpal kepɔrso na gbagba be keparso, ama ŋkpal Ebɔrɛ nɛ e yili kumo loŋ na be katiŋ so.

english_verse: We know that all creation is still groaning and is in pain, like a woman about to give birth.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so an baa nyi fanɛ yili kulubi be sososo na m ba fo mbre, kepɔrso kikɛ bee shu ebesa nɛ k du fanɛ kakurge to be ebesa na to nna.

english_verse: The Spirit makes us sure about what we will be in the future. But now we groan silently, while we wait for God to show that we are his children. This means that our bodies will also be set free.
translation_verse: Mannɛ asɔtoso na gba nawule, anyi nɛ an nya Kiyoyu nɛ e la Ebɔrɛ be kakɛ juŋkparso na gba bee shu to nna nsaa jo saŋɛ nɛ Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ ta anyi ŋ ki mbe mbia n shin nɛ an nya anyi be amu kikɛ nyam na.

english_verse: However, we hope for something we have not yet seen, and we patiently wait for it.
translation_verse: Ama nɛ an baa tama kusɔ nɛ anyi maŋ naŋ wu bre, kumo ere, kanyiti nɛ an kɔ a jo kumo.

english_verse: In certain ways we are weak, but the Spirit is here to help us. For example, when we don't know what to pray for, the Spirit prays for us in ways that cannot be put into words.
translation_verse: Loŋ koŋwule na malɛ nɛ Kiyoyu na bee ba m ba kaa chɛ anyi mo nɛ an maŋ kɔ eleŋ ashi yirda na to na to. Anyi maŋ nyi kananɛ k daga fanɛ an kule Ebɔrɛ gba, ama Kiyoyu na gbagba e naa bugi kagbene a kule kabɔrɛkule nɛ k bee mɔ kɔnɔ a sa anyi.

english_verse: All of our thoughts are known to God. He can understand what is in the mind of the Spirit, as the Spirit prays for God's people.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ nɛ e bee wu basa be ŋgbene to na e nyi Kiyoyu na be nfɛra. Kiyoyu na malɛ e naa bɔla ekpa nɛ k bee par Ebɔrɛ so a kule mo a sa mbe basa.

english_verse: We know that God is always at work for the good of everyone who loves him. They are the ones God has chosen for his purpose,
translation_verse: Anyi alɛ nyi fanɛ asɔ kikɛ to, Ebɔrɛ bee wora asheŋ nna nɛ a bee ba abar so m ba kaa ki asɔ lela a sa mbe beshapo nɛ e tre m ba mo kutɔ fanɛ b ba kaa wora mbe aparsheŋ na.

english_verse: and he has always known who his chosen ones would be. He had decided to let them become like his own Son, so his Son would be the first of many children.
translation_verse: Bumo nɛ e chɛr a nyi koŋwule na nɛ e lara n yili fanɛ b baa du fanɛ mo Pibinyɛn na, saŋɛ na so, Ebinyɛn na beeŋ baa la bekurgepo damtaana na to be ejuŋkparso.

english_verse: What can we say about all this? If God is on our side, can anyone be against us?
translation_verse: To, asheŋ nɛ an nu ere kikɛ be kaman, nuso nɛ anyeeŋ kaŋɛ? Nɛ Ebɔrɛ baa wɔ anyi be kaman, wanɛ e naaŋ tiŋ m pɔɔ anyi so?

english_verse: God did not keep back his own Son, but he gave him for us. If God did this, won't he freely give us everything else?
translation_verse: Esa nɛ e maŋ mɔn anyi mo gbagba Pibinyɛn nseŋ ta mo m bɔɔ basa enɔ ŋkpal anyi kikɛ so na, manɛ nna nɛ e maaŋ bugi kagbene n sa anyi kusɔ kikɛ n ti mo Pibi so?

english_verse: If God says his chosen ones are acceptable to him, can anyone bring charges against them?
translation_verse: Nɛ wanɛ e naaŋ tiŋ n wu Ebɔrɛ be basa kulubi, ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ gbagba e kaŋɛ fanɛ b ji n lar.

english_verse: Or can anyone condemn them? No indeed! Christ died and was raised to life, and now he is at God's right side, speaking to him for us.
translation_verse: Esa ko malɛ naa wɔtɔ nna nɛ e tiŋ n ji m bri bumo a? Kristo Yesu e la emo nɛ e wu, mo alɛ nseŋ naa la emo nɛ Ebɔrɛ tiŋi ashi luwu to nɛ e ya kaa tase Ebɔrɛ be jisoso, ebunyampo be kakpa a kule Ebɔrɛ a sa anyi na.

english_verse: It is exactly as the Scriptures say, “For you we face death all day long. We are like sheep on their way to be butchered.”
translation_verse: Loŋ malɛ nɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ na fanɛ: “Ŋkpal fo so nɛ an wɔ kenishipere nɛ k kɔ anyi a yɔ luwu to kachɛ kama na. An ki fanɛ mbolpɔ nɛ b kɔ a yɔ nɛ b ya teŋ nna.”

english_verse: I am a follower of Christ, and the Holy Spirit is a witness to my conscience. So I tell the truth and I am not lying when I say
translation_verse: Asɔ nɛ n wɔ Kristo to a kaŋɛ ere la kashenteŋ nna, m maa fule nna nɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na malɛ bee ŋini ma ashi ma kagbene to fanɛ m maa fule nna.

english_verse: I would gladly be placed under God's curse and be separated from Christ for the good of my own people.
translation_verse: Nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ kpal bumo so, ma yiri to ebi gbagba nɛ n de na, n so ma gbagba kɔnɔ nseŋ lara ma ashi Kristo be kebaawɔtɔ to gba, n daa beeŋ baa sha loŋ.

english_verse: They are the descendants of Israel, and they are also God's chosen people. God showed them his glory. He made agreements with them and gave them his Law. The temple is theirs and so are the promises that God made to them.
translation_verse: Ma basa Israɛlebi nɛ n de na. Bumo nɛ Ebɔrɛ ta ŋ ki mbe mbia n shin nɛ b nya mbe kemaŋkura na n ti so. E nase kebaawɔtɔ koŋwuleso be kɔnɔ n sa bumo nseŋ sa bumo mbra na nɛ bɔrɛlambu na to be kabɔrɛshuŋ na nɛ b nya Ebɔrɛ be nnɔ naseso n ti so.

english_verse: They have those famous ancestors, who were also the ancestors of the Christ. I pray that God, who rules over all, will be praised forever! Amen.
translation_verse: B shi benananyɛngboŋana na be kanaŋ to nna. Dimɛdi malɛ be kaplɛa so Kristo na shi bumo to nna. Epaŋ be kedi e baa la Ebɔrɛ nɛ e chɔ kusɔ kama kuwura na peya. Amɛn.

english_verse: It cannot be said that God broke his promise. After all, not all of the people of Israel are the true people of God.
translation_verse: Kede maa ŋini fanɛ Ebɔrɛ be kɔnɔ naseso na maŋ tiŋ m bɔla ekpa nna, ŋkpal manɛ so, mannɛ Israɛl be efuli so ebi kikɛ e la Ebɔrɛ be basa laraso.

english_verse: In fact, when God made the promise to Abraham, he meant only Abraham's descendants by his son Isaac. God was talking only about Isaac when he promised
translation_verse: To, kede e naa ŋini fanɛ mannɛ eyur ere to be kakurge e naa ta basa a ki Ebɔrɛ be mbia she bumo nɛ b bɔla Ebɔrɛ be kɔnɔ naseso na to n nya kakurge na nawule e la Eebraham be kaman to ebi kashenteŋto.

english_verse: Sarah, “At this time next year I will return, and you will already have a son.”
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, le nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ nase kɔnɔ n sa Eebraham ŋ kaŋɛ: “Jemanɛ na gbagba kaŋ fo, meeŋ bɛta m ba nɛ Sɛɛra e nya ebinyɛn.”

english_verse: Don't forget what happened to the twin sons of Isaac and Rebekah.
translation_verse: Kede malɛ be kaman Rebɛka gba be mbinyɛnbi anyɔ na gba daa kɔ etuto koŋwule nna, mo e la an nananyɛn Aizek na.

english_verse: Even before they were born or had done anything good or bad, the Lord told Rebekah that her older son would serve the younger one. The Lord said this to show he makes his own choices and it wasn't because of anything either of them had done.
translation_verse: “Enimuso beeŋ ba shuŋ ebibiso na.” Loŋ e naaŋ tiŋ ŋ ŋini kusɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ yili na fanɛ mbe kelara bumo be eko na daŋ shi mbe keparso be ketre to nna, mannɛ ŋkpal kusɔ nɛ b daŋ wora so.

english_verse: That's why the Scriptures say that the Lord liked Jacob more than Esau.
translation_verse: Loŋ malɛ nɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ na fanɛ Ebɔrɛ yɛ: “N lara Jeekɔb nna nseŋ kini Isɔɔ.”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses that he has pity and mercy on anyone he wants to.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, le nɛ e daŋ kaŋɛ anebi Mosis: “Esa nɛ mee sha kewu kuwɔr, nɛ mee wu kuwɔr nsaa shu a sa esa nɛ mee shu a sa.”

english_verse: In the Scriptures the Lord says to the king of Egypt, “I let you become king, so that I could show you my power and be praised by all people on earth.”
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, le nɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ fanɛ Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ ewura Fɛɛro: “M maŋ fo so nna ŋkpal le so nɛ m bɔla fo so ŋ ŋini ma eleŋ nseŋ shin nɛ durnya kikɛ e pin ma asheŋ.”

english_verse: Everything depends on what God decides to do, and he can either have pity on people or make them stubborn. God's Anger and Mercy
translation_verse: Amoso, nɛ Ebɔrɛ baa sha kewu esa kuwɔr, e beeŋ wu mo kuwɔr nɛ e naa sha keshin nɛ esa be kumu e baa du kpakpa, e beeŋ shin nɛ k baa du loŋ. Ebɔrɛ be agbo nɛ mbe kuwɔr be asheŋ

english_verse: But, my friend, I ask, “Who do you think you are to question God? Does the clay have the right to ask the potter why he shaped it the way he did?
translation_verse: Ama fo alɛ dimɛdi e la wanɛ nɛ fo tiŋ m malga n ji Ebɔrɛ emɔrɔ le? Kusɔ pɔrso beeŋ tiŋ ŋ kaŋɛ kumo be epɔrpo le: “Manɛ e ba nɛ fo pɔr ma le” a?

english_verse: God wanted to show his anger and reveal his power against everyone who deserved to be destroyed. But instead, he patiently put up with them.
translation_verse: To, loŋ koŋwule na nɛ Ebɔrɛ wora. Mbe demuso be agbo nɛ mbe eleŋ nɛ e daa sha kelara ŋ ŋini basa. Ama e daŋ ji basa nɛ mbe demuso be agbo daa wɔ bumo so nɛ b daga kasogberge na kanyiti.

english_verse: He did this by showing how glorious he is when he has pity on the people he has chosen to share in his glory.
translation_verse: Mo alɛ daa sha nna nɛ basa e wu mbe kemaŋkuragboŋ nɛ e shin nɛ k ba anyi nɛ mbe kuwɔr na chɛr a ba anyi so so nna. Anyi nɛ e bela ase n yili nɛ an nya mbe kemaŋkura na.

english_verse: just as the Lord says in the book of Hosea, “Although they are not my people, I will make them my people. I will treat with love those nations that have never been loved.
translation_verse: Le nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ bɔla anebi Hoziya so ŋ kaŋɛ: “Basa nɛ b daa maŋ la meya na, naniere meeŋ tre bumo ma basa. Efuli nɛ n daa maa sha na, naniere meeŋ tre kumo ma eshapo.”

english_verse: “Once they were told, ‘You are not my people.’ But in that very place they will be called children of the living God.”
translation_verse: “Kakpa nɛ ma Ebɔrɛ daŋ kaŋɛ bumo le: ‘Mannɛ ma basa e la menyi’ na koŋwule na nɛ meeŋ naŋ tre bumo ma, Ebɔrɛ nɛ n wɔ ŋkpa to na be mbia.”

english_verse: And this is what the prophet Isaiah said about the people of Israel, “The people of Israel are as many as the grains of sand along the beach. But only a few who are left will be saved.
translation_verse: Le nɛ anebi Aizaaya bee kaŋɛ Israɛlebi be asheŋ awɔrso: “Nɛ Israɛlebi baa shi fanɛ teku ase be ajembubi gba, bumo to be gbrɛbi e naaŋ nya kumɔlga.

english_verse: The Lord will be quick and sure to do on earth what he has warned he will do.”
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ maaŋ chɛr nseŋ ji durnya ere demu nɛ asheŋ e loge.”

english_verse: Isaiah also said, “If the Lord All-Powerful had not spared some of our descendants, we would have been destroyed like the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah.” Israel and the Good News
translation_verse: Kumo alɛ baa du fanɛ kananɛ Aizaaya daŋ chɛr ŋ kaŋɛ le nna: “Nɛ Enyɛnpetale daa maŋ yige kaman to ebi ko nna n sa anyi, anyi daa beeŋ ki fanɛ kananɛ Sodɔm nɛ Gomɔra be nde daŋ ki na.” Israɛl be baru lela be asheŋ

english_verse: What does all of this mean? It means that the Gentiles were not trying to be acceptable to God, but they found that he would accept them if they had faith.
translation_verse: To, naniere, nuso nɛ anyeeŋ kaŋɛ? Kumo kikɛ nde fanɛ saŋɛ na nnyamase daa maa fin bumo nɛ Ebɔrɛ be nferinto be kelela, ama naniere bre b bɔla yirda so n nya loŋ be kebaawɔtɔ.

english_verse: It also means that the people of Israel were not acceptable to God. And why not? It was because they were trying to be acceptable by obeying the Law instead of by having faith in God. The people of Israel fell over the stone that makes people stumble,
translation_verse: To, nɛ manɛ e ba nɛ bumo alɛ maŋ nya loŋ be kebaawɔtɔ na? Kusɔ nɛ k ba e la fanɛ b daa maŋ ta yirda n fin bumo nɛ Ebɔrɛ be nferinto be kelela na, b daŋ ta ashuŋ shunso nna a fin kumo. Amoso, b daŋ fiti kejembu nɛ basa bee fiti kumo so na nna.

english_verse: just as God says in the Scriptures, “Look! I am placing in Zion a stone to make people stumble and fall. But those who have faith in that one will never be disappointed.”
translation_verse: Kumo be asheŋ nɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ fanɛ Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ le na: “Men keni, kejembu nɛ n ta n nase Zayɔn nɛ k bee shin nɛ basa bee fiti kumo na, kumo e la fanɛ kefalta nɛ baaŋ fiti n tɔr na. Ama ekama nɛ e yirda mo Yesu na bre maaŋ ji anishinyɔr kikɛ.”

english_verse: Dear friends, my greatest wish and my prayer to God is for the people of Israel to be saved.
translation_verse: Ŋ kurgepoana, kusɔ nɛ m baa sha ga nsaa kule kumo be Ebɔrɛ e la fanɛ ma basa Israɛlebi e nya kumɔlga.

english_verse: But Christ makes the Law no longer necessary for those who become acceptable to God by faith. Anyone Can Be Saved
translation_verse: Kristo malɛ e bar mbra na ekar, saŋɛ na so, ekama nɛ e yirda, Ebɔrɛ beeŋ shin nɛ mo nɛ amodoŋwura e nyalɛ.

english_verse: Moses said a person could become acceptable to God by obeying the Law. He did this when he wrote, “If you want to live, you must do all the Law commands.”
translation_verse: Le malɛ be asheŋ nɛ anebi Mosis daŋ kaŋɛ saŋɛ nɛ e daŋ malga kebaabɛ mbra na so a sha keki elelapo Ebɔrɛ be anishito na be asheŋ na fanɛ: “Ekama nɛ e bee wora kusɔ nɛ mbra na bee ŋini malɛ gba beeŋ baa wɔ mbra na be kebaawɔtɔ to nna na.”

english_verse: But people whose faith makes them acceptable to God will never ask, “Who will go up to heaven to bring Christ down?”
translation_verse: Ama le nɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ kebɔla yirda so a ki elelapo Ebɔrɛ be anishito be asheŋ: “Sa maŋ bishi fo kumu fanɛ: ‘Wanɛ e naaŋ dii n yɔ ebɔrɛso?’ Kumo e la fanɛ n ya bar Kristo.

english_verse: Neither will they ask, “Who will go down into the world of the dead to raise him to life?”
translation_verse: Fo alɛ e sa maŋ bishi le gba: ‘Wanɛ e naaŋ gbelge n yɔ durnya be kaseto?’ Kumo e la fanɛ n ya bar Kristo ashi bubuni to.”

english_verse: All who are acceptable because of their faith simply say, “The message is as near as your mouth or your heart.” And this is the same message we preach about faith.
translation_verse: Kusɔ nɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na naa kaŋɛ e la: “Ebɔrɛ be kamalga baŋ taga menyi to nna. K baa wɔ menyi be nnɔ to nɛ menyi be ŋgbene to nna.” Yirda na be baru nɛ anyee bɔ a sa basa na.

english_verse: So you will be saved, if you honestly say, “Jesus is Lord,” and if you believe with all your heart that God raised him from death.
translation_verse: Nɛ fo baŋ bugi kɔnɔ n ji shɛda ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ Yesu e la Enyɛnpe na nseŋ yirda fanɛ Ebɔrɛ tiŋi mo ashi luwu to, feeŋ nya kumɔlga.

english_verse: The Scriptures say no one who has faith will be disappointed,
translation_verse: Loŋ malɛ nɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ na fanɛ: “Esa kama nɛ e yirda mo maa ji anishinyɔr kikɛ.”

english_verse: no matter if that person is a Jew or a Gentile. There is only one Lord, and he is generous to everyone who asks for his help.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ be anishito Juw nɛ kanyamase maŋ kɔr abar to, Enyɛnpe na e la ekama nyam be Enyɛnpe, nɛ ekama malɛ nɛ e shu n tre mo, e beeŋ bugi kagbene n nɛfa amodoŋwura.

english_verse: How can people have faith in the Lord and ask him to save them, if they have never heard about him? And how can they hear, unless someone tells them?
translation_verse: Ama nuso nɛ baaŋ wora n shu n tre esa nɛ b maŋ yirda? Nɛ nuso malɛ nɛ baaŋ wora n yirda emo nɛ baaŋ shu n tre na nɛ esa pɔtɛ baa maŋ kaŋɛ bumo mbe asheŋ? Ŋko nɛ esa pɔtɛ baa maŋ bɔ kubɔya na n sa bumo, nuso nɛ baaŋ wora n nu?

english_verse: And how can anyone tell them without being sent by the Lord? The Scriptures say it is a beautiful sight to see even the feet of someone coming to preach the good news.
translation_verse: Nɛ nuso malɛ nɛ baaŋ wora m bɔ kubɔya na nɛ Ebɔrɛ baa maŋ shuŋi bumo? Loŋ malɛ nɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ na fanɛ: “K la mamachi be kesheŋ nna n sa basa nɛ b kɔ kubɔya na nna a ba.”

english_verse: Yet not everyone has believed the message. For example, the prophet Isaiah asked, “Lord, has anyone believed what we said?”
translation_verse: Ama mannɛ Israɛlebi kikɛ e sɔ baru lela na, ŋkpal manɛ so, le nɛ anebi Aizaaya daŋ bishi Enyɛnpe na: “Enyɛnpe, wanɛ e yirda anyi be kubɔya na?”

english_verse: But am I saying that the people of Israel did not hear? No, I am not! The Scriptures say, “The message was told everywhere on earth. It was announced all over the world.”
translation_verse: Ama kesheŋ bishiso nɛ ŋ kɔ nde: “Kashenteŋ nna fanɛ b maŋ nu kubɔya na a?” Cha, b nu. Loŋ malɛ nɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ na fanɛ: “Bumo be ebɔl fo kasawule ere so be kaplɛkama nɛ bumo be mmalga yɔ durnya ere be ekar kikɛ.”

english_verse: Did the people of Israel understand or not? Moses answered this question when he told that the Lord had said, “I will make Israel jealous of people who are a nation of nobodies. I will make them angry with people who don't understand a thing.”
translation_verse: Mee sha fanɛ n naŋ bishi fanɛ: “Israɛlebi daa maŋ pin to a?” Anebi Mosis gbagba e juŋkpar n sa kebishi ere be kifito ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ le nɛ Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ: “Meeŋ shin nɛ kayurbesa e luri menyi to ŋkpal basa nɛ bumo be efuli so maŋ la shɛŋ na so, meeŋ shin nɛ men nya agbo n wɔtɔ efuli ko nɛ kumo be basa wuli.”

english_verse: Isaiah was fearless enough to tell that the Lord had said, “I was found by people who were not looking for me. I appeared to the ones who were not asking about me.”
translation_verse: Ama anebi Aizaaya ji kenyɛn a chɔ loŋ ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ le nɛ Ebɔrɛ yɛ: “Basa nɛ b daa maa fin ma e bante ma nɛ n lara ma kumu ŋ ŋini basa nɛ b daa maa bishi ma asheŋ.”

english_verse: And Isaiah said about the people of Israel, “All day long the Lord has reached out to people who are stubborn and refuse to obey.”
translation_verse: Le nɛ e kaŋɛ fanɛ Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ Israɛlebi malɛ be asheŋ: “M bugi enɔ to nna saŋkikɛ nɛ n sɔ menyi, nɛ menyi be asoe maa nu asheŋ nɛ men wɔtɔ a ji ma eleŋ emɔrɔ na.”

english_verse: Am I saying that God has turned his back on his people? Certainly not! I am one of the people of Israel, and I myself am a descendant of Abraham from the tribe of Benjamin.
translation_verse: To, kusɔ nɛ mee sha nɛ m bishi e la fanɛ, Ebɔrɛ kini mbe basa nna ŋko? Kaarɛ, ma alɛ gba la Israɛl be efuli so be esa nna n shi Eebraham be kanaŋ to a la Bɛnjamin be yiri to be esa.

english_verse: God did not turn his back on his chosen people. Don't you remember reading in the Scriptures how Elijah complained to God about the people of Israel?
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ maŋ kini mbe basa nɛ e lara dra dra na kikɛ kuraa. Men nyi kusɔ nɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ ashi kakpa nɛ a bee malga anebi Elaija be asheŋ fanɛ kananɛ e ta kenishipere ŋ kule Ebɔrɛ ŋ gbiti Israɛlebi na ŋko? E yɛ:

english_verse: He said, “Lord, they killed your prophets and destroyed your altars. I am the only one left, and now they want to kill me.”
translation_verse: “Enyɛnpe, b mɔ fo anebiana nseŋ da fo bɔrɛsureana n lɛ. Naniere n nawule e ka nɛ baa sha kemɔ ma alɛ gba.”

english_verse: This means that only a chosen few of the people of Israel found what all of them were searching for. And the rest of them were stubborn,
translation_verse: To, naniere manɛ e naa wɔtɔ? Kusɔ nɛ k wɔtɔ e la fanɛ kusɔ nɛ Israɛlebi daŋ pere kenishi a fin na, b fin kumo ŋ gben, ama Ebɔrɛ be basa laraso na bre nya kumo nɛ basa nɛ b ka malɛ nya amu kpakpaso.

english_verse: It is the same way now. God treated the people of Israel with undeserved grace, and so a few of them are still his followers.
translation_verse: Naniere be jemanɛ ere gba, loŋ koŋwule nna fanɛ mo ere Ebɔrɛ lara basa gbrɛbi ko nna n sa mbe kumu ŋkpal mbe kuwɔr be kakɛ so.

english_verse: This happened because of God's undeserved kindness and not because of anything they have done. It could not have happened except for God's gift of undeserved grace.
translation_verse: K ka baa la kuwɔr be kakɛ be asheŋ ere bre, k maŋ naa la ashuŋ shunso be asheŋ, nɛ k daa la ashuŋ shunso be asheŋ nna, kumo ere Ebɔrɛ be kuwɔr be kakɛ na daa maaŋ naa la kuwɔr be kakɛ.

english_verse: just as the Scriptures say, “God made them so stupid that their eyes are blind, and their ears are still deaf.”
translation_verse: Loŋ malɛ nɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ na fanɛ: “Ebɔrɛ sa bumo kebalto nɛ anishi nɛ a maa wu nɛ asoe nɛ a maa nu nna hale m ba fo mbre.”

english_verse: Then David said, “Turn their meals into bait for a trap, so that they will stumble and be given what they deserve.
translation_verse: Ewura Deevid malɛ yɛ: “Ebɔrɛ e shin nɛ b gelge ŋ gben nɛ b so m pɛ bumo ashi bumo be ejikpa. Ebɔrɛ e shin nɛ b tɔr nseŋ shin nɛ b gberge bumo kusoe.

english_verse: Blindfold their eyes! Don't let them see. Bend their backs beneath a burden that will never be lifted.” Gentiles Will Be Saved
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ e shin nɛ bumo be anishi buu so nɛ b sa maŋ nya n wu nseŋ shin nɛ bumo be nshɛr e kɔnto hale mbaanaayɔ.”

english_verse: Do I mean that the people of Israel fell, never to get up again? Certainly not! Their failure made it possible for the Gentiles to be saved, and this will make the people of Israel jealous.
translation_verse: Men shin nɛ n naŋ bishi kesheŋ ere fanɛ Israɛlebi daŋ fiti nna n tɔr ŋ koso ŋ gben ŋko? Ayai, mannɛ aloŋ nna kuraa. Ama ŋkpal bumo be alubi so nɛ nnyamase nya kumɔlga nɛ bumo be kebaawɔtɔ na yɛlga Israɛlebi.

english_verse: But if the rest of the world's people were helped so much by their sin and loss, they will be helped even more by their full return.
translation_verse: Juwebi be alubi so nɛ durnyaebi nya nɛfa gboŋgboŋi nɛ bumo be kabɔrɛŋana wuso malɛ gba bar nnyamase nɛfa gboŋgboŋi. Nɛ kananɛ k la loŋ ere, nɛ Juwebi kikɛ na ba ti so, kumo ere nɛfa nɛ k beeŋ ba na beeŋ ba kaa shi pasaa. Nnyamase be kumɔlga be asheŋ

english_verse: I am now speaking to you Gentiles, and as long as I am an apostle to you, I will take pride in my work.
translation_verse: To, naniere, menyi nnyamase nɛ mee malga a sa na. Ŋ ka baa la nnyamase be eshuŋipo ere bre, meeŋ baa puchi ma kushuŋ na so.

english_verse: I hope in this way to make some of my own people jealous enough to be saved.
translation_verse: Shere mee wora loŋ, meeŋ tiŋ n shin nɛ kayɛlga e pɛ ma basa nɛ loŋ e tiŋ n shin nɛ bumo be beko e nya kumɔlga.

english_verse: When Israel rejected God, the rest of the people in the world were able to turn to him. So when God makes friends with Israel, it will be like bringing the dead back to life.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ ka daŋ kini bumo na so, durnyaebi nɛ b ka na nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ ba abar so nna. To, nɛ naniere Ebɔrɛ naŋ sɔ bumo, nuso nɛ asheŋ beeŋ baa du? Kumo ere bubuni beeŋ nya ŋkpa nna na.

english_verse: If part of a batch of dough is made holy by being offered to God, then all of the dough is holy. If the roots of a tree are holy, the rest of the tree is holy too.
translation_verse: Nɛ esa baŋ ta bodobodo be kaba n lara kanya popɔr be sarga n sa Ebɔrɛ, kumo ere bodobodo na gba kikɛ la Ebɔrɛ peya nna na. Nɛ esa malɛ naŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ Ebɔrɛ e wɔ kedibi be nliŋi, kumo ere mo koŋwule na e kraa wɔ kedibi na kikɛ gba.

english_verse: You Gentiles are like branches of a wild olive tree made to be part of a cultivated olive tree. You have taken the place of some branches that were cut away from it. And because of this, you enjoy the blessings that come from being part of that cultivated tree.
translation_verse: B ka fɛta ɔlifs be kedibi fɛaso be keyabi nɛ k bee nya kekeni nseŋ ta menyi nɛ men du fanɛ ɔlifs be kukɔrbua n yuu n chɔga ɔlifs be kedibi na so nɛ menyee nu kedibi na be ebel ere,

english_verse: But don't think you are better than the branches that were cut away. Just remember you are not supporting the roots of this tree. Its roots are supporting you.
translation_verse: men sa maa puchi ŋkpal men ka la ayabi na so, ŋkpal manɛ so, men baa nyiŋi fanɛ mannɛ menyi e kɔ nliŋi na to, amo e kɔ menyi to.

english_verse: That's true enough. But they were cut away because they did not have faith, and you are where you are because you do have faith. So don't be proud, but be afraid.
translation_verse: To, kashenteŋ nna fanɛ b daŋ fɛta bumo nɛ b daa la kedibi na be ayabi gbagba na nna n lɛ ŋkpal b ka maŋ kɔ yirda so, ama yirda so nɛ menyi ere yil kpakpa na. Amoso, men sa maa wu menyi be amu, men baa kɔ kabɔrɛŋana a wɔtɔ.

english_verse: If God cut away those natural branches, couldn't he do the same to you?
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ ka baa maŋ yige m paŋ Juwebi nɛ b du fanɛ ayabi gbagba na, e maaŋ yige m paŋ menyi alɛ gba.

english_verse: Now you see both how kind and how hard God can be. He was hard on those who fell, but he was kind to you. And he will keep on being kind to you, if you keep on trusting in his kindness. Otherwise, you will be cut away too.
translation_verse: To, loŋ e daga men ka keni m pin kananɛ Ebɔrɛ be kelela nɛ mbe nyaŋnyaŋ du. E ŋini basa nɛ b foe kashenteŋ be ekpa na so na kananɛ e du nyaŋnyaŋ nseŋ ŋini menyi alɛ mbe kelela nɛ men kraŋ baa wɔ mbe kelela na to nna na. Nɛ mannɛ aloŋ, e beeŋ ku menyi n lɛ fanɛ kananɛ e daŋ ku ayabi gbagba na n lɛ na.

english_verse: If those other branches will start having faith, they will be made a part of that tree again. God has the power to put them back.
translation_verse: Ama nɛ Juwebi na chɛrga bumo be nfɛra nseŋ fara a yirda, kumo ere Ebɔrɛ beeŋ naŋ bɛta bumo n wɔtɔ kakpa nɛ b daa yil na, ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ beeŋ naŋ tiŋ n wora loŋ.

english_verse: After all, it wasn't natural for branches to be cut from a wild olive tree and to be made part of a cultivated olive tree. So it is much more likely that God will join the natural branches back to the cultivated olive tree. The People of Israel Will Be Brought Back
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, nɛ Ebɔrɛ baŋ tiŋ ŋ ku fo ashi ɔlifs be kekɔrbuadibi be kapɔr to nseŋ ta fo n yuu n wɔtɔ ɔlifs be kedibi nɛ k nya kebela a maŋ daga fo nɛ kumo ka luri abar to na, kumo ere ayabi dra nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ ku n lɛ na maaŋ baa du mo so kpakpa hale gbrɛbi kama kuraa fanɛ ayabi na ka beeŋ naŋ tiŋ m ba chuge amo be kedibi gbagba so ŋko? Ebɔrɛ be kuwɔr nɛ e kɔ a sa basa kikɛ be asheŋ

english_verse: My friends, I don't want you Gentiles to be too proud of yourselves. So I will explain the mystery of what has happened to the people of Israel. Some of them have become stubborn, and they will stay like that until the complete number of you Gentiles has come in.
translation_verse: Ŋ kurgepoana, kashenteŋ be wulo ko wɔtɔ nɛ mee sha fanɛ men pin kumo, saŋɛ na so men maaŋ ta menyi be amu fanɛ basa nyiashempo. Kumo nde fanɛ kumu kpakpaso be kebaawɔtɔ nɛ k ba Israɛlebi so na maŋ ba nna nɛ k ba kaa wɔtɔ mbaanaayɔ, kumo be ekar e la saŋɛ nɛ nnyamase nɛ baaŋ nya kumɔlga na kikɛ ya loge nyam.

english_verse: In this way all of Israel will be saved, as the Scriptures say, “From Zion someone will come to rescue us. Then Jacob's descendants will stop being evil.
translation_verse: Amoso, Israɛlebi kikɛ beeŋ nya kumɔlga fanɛ kananɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ fanɛ Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ le na: “Emɔlgapo na beeŋ shi Zayɔn m ba lara edalubisheŋ kikɛ ashi Jeekɔb be kaman to ebi to.”

english_verse: This is what the Lord has promised to do when he forgives their sins.”
translation_verse: “Ŋ kaŋ lara bumo be alubi ashi bumo to, meeŋ nase kɔnɔ ashi ma nɛ bumo be kebaawɔtɔ be kaplɛa so.”

english_verse: The people of Israel are treated as God's enemies, so the good news can come to you Gentiles. But they are still the chosen ones, and God loves them because of their famous ancestors.
translation_verse: Baru lela na be kaplɛa so, bumo nɛ Ebɔrɛ ki bedoŋ nna ŋkpal menyi nnyamase so, ama Ebɔrɛ be kelara bumo so na be kaplɛa so, b la mo teriana nna ŋkpal benananyɛngboŋana na so.

english_verse: God doesn't take back the gifts he has given or disown the people he has chosen.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ be kakɛ nɛ mbe ketre esa a sa mbe kumu maa chɛrga.

english_verse: At one time you Gentiles rejected God. But now Israel has rejected God, and you have been shown mercy.
translation_verse: An ta fanɛ menyi nnyamase le, saŋɛ na men daa maa nu a sa Ebɔrɛ, ama naniere e bee wu menyi kuwɔr nna ŋkpal Juwebi ka maa nu a sa mo so.

english_verse: All people have disobeyed God, and that's why he treats them as prisoners. But he does this, so that he can have mercy on all of them.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ yige basa kikɛ nna n wɔtɔ kasomaanu be kebaawɔtɔ to, saŋɛ na so nɛ e wu bumo kikɛ kuwɔr. Kananɛ Pɔɔl bee chɔrɔ Ebɔrɛ be asheŋ

english_verse: Who can measure the wealth and wisdom and knowledge of God? Who can understand his decisions or explain what he does?
translation_verse: Kashenteŋto, Ebɔrɛ be alelasheŋ shi pasaa. Mbe nfɛra nɛ mbe kashennyi shi kashenteŋto. Wanɛ e naaŋ tiŋ m pin asheŋ nɛ e bee yili to ŋ kute ŋko m pin mbe asheŋ woraso to?

english_verse: Has anyone loaned something to the Lord that must be repaid?”
translation_verse: Nɛ wanɛ malɛ e daŋ paŋ mo kusɔ ko nɛ e fin ŋ ka amodoŋwura?”

english_verse: Everything comes from the Lord. All things were made because of him and will return to him. Praise the Lord forever! Amen.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, mo e pɔr kusɔ kikɛ, mo alɛ to nɛ kusɔ kikɛ bɔla a wɔ ŋkpa to a sa mo. Kemaŋkura e baa wɔ Ebɔrɛ so mbaanaayɔ. Amɛn.

english_verse: Dear friends, God is good. So I beg you to offer your bodies to him as a living sacrifice, pure and pleasing. That's the most sensible way to serve God.
translation_verse: To, ŋ kurgepoana, ŋkpal Ebɔrɛ be kuwɔr be kakɛ damta nɛ e wu anyi na so, mee kule menyi nna nɛ men ta menyi be amu n sa Ebɔrɛ fanɛ sarga nɛ k wɔ ŋkpa to a du cheembi a par Ebɔrɛ. Menyi be kabɔrɛshuŋ nɛ men kɔ a di Ebɔrɛ epaŋ nna na.

english_verse: Don't be like the people of this world, but let God change the way you think. Then you will know how to do everything that is good and pleasing to him.
translation_verse: Men sa maa ta menyi be ŋgbene a wɔtɔ durnya ere to ebi be asheŋ to, men shin nɛ Ebɔrɛ e chɛrga menyi be ŋgbene n sa menyi nɛ men nya nfɛra popɔr. Saŋɛ na so nɛ menyeeŋ tiŋ m pin kusɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ bee sha, kumo e la fanɛ alelasheŋ, mbe aparsheŋ nɛ asɔ nɛ a daga.

english_verse: I realize God has treated me with undeserved grace, and so I tell each of you not to think you are better than you really are. Use good sense and measure yourself by the amount of faith that God has given you.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal Ebɔrɛ be kuwɔr be kakɛ nɛ e sa ma so, mee kaŋɛ menyi be ekama nna fanɛ e sa maa maŋ mbe kumu so a chɔ kananɛ e baa du. Ama men baa fɛ bebɔlpo be nfɛra a sa menyi be amu a kɔ loŋ be nfɛra na a yuu kananɛ yirda nɛ Ebɔrɛ sa ekama na sa so.

english_verse: A body is made up of many parts, and each of them has its own use.
translation_verse: Mba damta e chɔɔ esa be eyur so, ama amo alɛ be kekama nɛ kumo be kushuŋ.

english_verse: That's how it is with us. There are many of us, but we each are part of the body of Christ, as well as part of one another.
translation_verse: To, loŋ koŋwule na nɛ anyi nɛ Yesu be kefɛato du. An shi, ama an la eyur koŋwule nna ashi mo to nɛ ekama malɛ wɔ mo barkasa to.

english_verse: If we can serve others, we should serve. If we can teach, we should teach.
translation_verse: Fo kama nɛ fo kakɛ la fo braana be kebaashuŋ, fo baa shuŋ bumo. Nɛ k naa la keŋini, fo baa ŋini.

english_verse: If we can encourage others, we should encourage them. If we can give, we should be generous. If we are leaders, we should do our best. If we are good to others, we should do it cheerfully. Rules for Christian Living
translation_verse: Nɛ kumo alɛ naa la basa be keleŋto, fo baa wora loŋ. Ekama malɛ nɛ e bee barga mbe kanya to a sa beko e baa bugi kagbene a wora loŋ. Ekama nɛ e la ejuŋkparpo e baa shuŋ ga nɛ emo nɛ mo alɛ naa wu basa kuwɔr e baa bugi kagbene a wora loŋ.

english_verse: Be sincere in your love for others. Hate everything that is evil and hold tight to everything that is good.
translation_verse: Men shin nɛ menyi be kasha e baa la kashenteŋ be kasha. Men baa kishi alubisheŋ nsaa far a chɛ alelasheŋ.

english_verse: Love each other as brothers and sisters and honor others more than you do yourself.
translation_verse: Men baa kɔ bekurgepo be kasha a sha abar nsaa juŋkpar a bunyaŋ abar.

english_verse: Never give up. Eagerly follow the Holy Spirit and serve the Lord.
translation_verse: Men baa shuŋ ga nsaa maa wora ntɔl. Men baa bugi menyi be ŋgbene kikɛ to a shuŋ Enyɛnpe kashenteŋto.

english_verse: Let your hope make you glad. Be patient in time of trouble and never stop praying.
translation_verse: Men shin nɛ menyi be tama e baa sa menyi kagbenefuli nɛ men baa ji kanyiti ashi menyi be etɔrɔ to nsaa kule Ebɔrɛ saŋkama.

english_verse: Ask God to bless everyone who mistreats you. Ask him to bless them and not to curse them.
translation_verse: Men baa nɛfa basa nɛ baa kpal menyi be kebɛso so a tɔrɔ menyi na, men baa nɛfa bumo nsaa maa so bumo kɔnɔ.

english_verse: When others are happy, be happy with them, and when they are sad, be sad.
translation_verse: Men baa tu bumo nɛ bumo be ŋgbene fuli a shin nɛ menyi be ŋgbene e baa fuli nsaa tu bumo nɛ baa shu malɛ a shu.

english_verse: Be friendly with everyone. Don't be proud and feel that you know more than others. Make friends with ordinary people.
translation_verse: Men baa kɔ kɔnɔkoŋwule be kebaawɔtɔ a sa abar. Men sa maa maŋ menyi be amu so, ama men baa bar menyi be amu kaseto a shuli a shuŋ bebɔlpo be ashuŋ a maa fɛ fanɛ men la benyiashempo.

english_verse: Don't mistreat someone who has mistreated you. But try to earn the respect of others,
translation_verse: Men sa maa bɛta kulubi a ka kulubi be kukɔ. Men baa wora ania a sha basa kikɛ nsaa wora bumo kelela.

english_verse: and do your best to live at peace with everyone.
translation_verse: Men baa wora ania kanaŋkamaso nɛ menyeeŋ tiŋ nɛ menyi nɛ basa kikɛ e baa wɔ kagbenewushi be kebaawɔtɔ to.

english_verse: The Scriptures also say, “If your enemies are hungry, give them something to eat. And if they are thirsty, give them something to drink. This will be the same as piling burning coals on their heads.”
translation_verse: Kusɔ nɛ k daga fanɛ men baa wora nde, nɛ akoŋ baa kɔ fo doŋ, fo sa mo ajibi, nɛ achukoŋ malɛ naa kɔ mo, fo sa mo kusɔnuuso nɛ e nuu. Nɛ fo baŋ wora loŋ, feeŋ ta anishinyɔr m pɛ edoŋ na.

english_verse: Obey the rulers who have authority over you. Only God can give authority to anyone, and he puts these rulers in their places of power.
translation_verse: A daga fanɛ ekama e baa nu a sa mbe efuli so be abane be bejuŋkparpo, ŋkpal manɛ so, abane kikɛ maŋ wɔtɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ maŋ ta eleŋ m bɔɔ kumo enɔ. Mo Ebɔrɛ koŋwule na malɛ e jɔŋɛ abane kama.

english_verse: Rulers are a threat to evil people, not to good people. There is no need to be afraid of the authorities. Just do right, and they will praise you for it.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, basa nɛ baa wora kelela maa ŋana abane be bejuŋkparpo. Bumo nɛ baa wora alubi e naa ŋana bumo. Men maa sha fanɛ men baa ŋana abane be ejuŋkparpo kama ŋko? To, kumo ere, men baa wora asɔ nɛ a daga nɛ enimu na e baa sa menyi mbo.

english_verse: After all, they are God's servants, and it is their duty to help you. If you do something wrong, you ought to be afraid, because these rulers have the right to punish you. They are God's servants who punish criminals to show how angry God is.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, e la Ebɔrɛ be kenya nna ŋkpal fo kelela so. Ama nɛ fo baa wora alubi bre, baa lɔ kufu, ŋkpal manɛ so, enimu na maa keta mbe tokobi na jiga nna. E la Ebɔrɛ be kenya nna nɛ e baa keni asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so a sa basa a gberge alubiworapoana kusoe.

english_verse: But you should obey the rulers because you know it is the right thing to do, and not just because of God's anger.
translation_verse: Amoso, a daga fanɛ men baa bar menyi be amu kaseto a sa bejuŋkparpoana, mannɛ ŋkpal kasogberge nawule so, ama ŋkpal kananɛ menyi be ŋgbene to be nfɛra bee yili menyi so so.

english_verse: You must also pay your taxes. The authorities are God's servants, and it is their duty to take care of these matters.
translation_verse: To, loŋ koŋwule na malɛ gba so e shin nɛ a daga fanɛ men baa ka elampo na, ŋkpal manɛ so, benimuana na la Ebɔrɛ be anya nna a kɔ bumo be saŋɛ kikɛ a keni abane be asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so.

english_verse: Let love be your only debt! If you love others, you have done all that the Law demands.
translation_verse: Men sa maŋ ji esa kikɛ be kukɔ she abar be kasha nawule be kukɔ, ŋkpal manɛ so, esa kama nɛ e bee sha mo barkasa dimɛdi bɛ mbra na so n loge.

english_verse: In the Law there are many commands, such as, “Be faithful in marriage. Do not murder. Do not steal. Do not want what belongs to others.” But all of these are summed up in the command that says, “Love others as much as you love yourself.”
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ be mbraana nɛ a bee kaŋɛ le na: “Men sa maa ji kubojua nɛ men sa maa mɔ nɛ men sa maa yuri nɛ men sa maa yɛlga abar be asɔ,” nɛ mbraana nɛ a ka na kikɛ wɔ le be mbra ere to nna: “Baa sha fo barkasa dimɛdi fanɛ fo gbagba be kumu.”

english_verse: No one who loves others will harm them. So love is all that the Law demands. The Day When Christ Returns
translation_verse: Fo kama nɛ fee sha fo barkasa dimɛdi, fo maaŋ wora mo kulubi. Amoso, kesha fo barkasa bee ŋini kebɛ mbra na kikɛ so nna na.

english_verse: You know what sort of times we live in, and so you should live properly. It is time to wake up. You know that the day when we will be saved is nearer now than when we first put our faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Men baa wora loŋ a nyi jemanɛ mo nɛ an wɔ ere to be asheŋ. Jemanɛ mo nɛ k daga fanɛ men tiŋi ashi menyi be edi to na fo, ŋkpal manɛ so, naniere anyi be kumɔlga be kachɛ na taga to a chɔ saŋɛ nɛ an daŋ fara n yirda Yesu Kristo na.

english_verse: Night is almost over, and day will soon appear. We must stop behaving as people do in the dark and be ready to live in the light.
translation_verse: Kanyɛ na biri n chɛr ga, naniere a ka gbrɛ nɛ kare e chɛ. Amoso, men shin nɛ an yige tentembiri to be ashuŋ shunso n lɛ nseŋ ta akɔsɔ na a wɔ kefulto to a kɔ.

english_verse: So behave properly, as people do in the day. Don't go to wild parties or get drunk or be vulgar or indecent. Don't quarrel or be jealous.
translation_verse: Men shin nɛ an baa bii kebaawɔtɔ lela nɛ k daga basa nɛ b wɔ kapaso be kefulto be kebaawɔtɔ na to. An sa maŋ naa wɔ kasanuu be nshɛr jijigaana to nɛ kusɔjigaya ŋko amɔmɔshiasheŋ be kebaawɔtɔ to nɛ nlu ŋko kayurbesa be kebaawɔtɔ to.

english_verse: Let the Lord Jesus Christ be as near to you as the clothes you wear. Then you won't try to satisfy your selfish desires.
translation_verse: Ama men ta Enyɛnpe Yesu Kristo be akɔsɔ na a kuŋ menyi be amu fanɛ asɔbuuso na nseŋ yige kebaade menyi be kapɔr lubiana ere be aparsheŋ so nɛ a sa maŋ kaŋ shin nɛ menyi be ayɛlgasɔ e ka menyi to.

english_verse: Welcome all the Lord's followers, even those whose faith is weak. Don't criticize them for having beliefs that are different from yours.
translation_verse: Men baa sɔ ekama nɛ e maŋ kɔ eleŋ ashi yirda na to na a wɔtɔ menyi to, ama menyi nɛ mo e sa maa ji emɔrɔ a yɔ mbe asheŋ fɛso be kaplɛa so.

english_verse: Some think it is all right to eat anything, while those whose faith is weak will eat only vegetables.
translation_verse: Esa ko bee kaa yirda fanɛ e beeŋ tiŋ n ji kusɔ kikɛ be epo, ama emo nɛ mbe yirda maŋ kɔ eleŋ bre bee ji afantaŋ nawule be epo nna.

english_verse: What right do you have to criticize someone else's servants? Only their Lord can decide if they are doing right, and the Lord will make sure that they do right.
translation_verse: Manɛ be ekpa nɛ fo alɛ kɔ nɛ fo tiŋ n ji esa pɔtɛ be kayɛrbi demu? Mo nyɛnpe gbagba be anishito nɛ e beeŋ tiŋ n ji n lar ŋko n ji n tɔr, mo alɛ beeŋ ji n lar malɛ, ŋkpal manɛ so, Enyɛnpe beeŋ tiŋ n shin nɛ e ji n lar.

english_verse: Some of the Lord's followers think one day is more important than another. Others think all days are the same. But each of you should make up your own mind.
translation_verse: An ta fanɛ nchɛ le. Esa ko kutɔ nchɛ ko la nchɛgboŋ nna, ama esa ko malɛ kutɔ nchɛ kikɛ sasa nna. A daga fanɛ ekama e baa pin mbe kagbene to geeŋ fanɛ le be kesheŋ ere e daga ŋ ka wora ŋko n sa maŋ wora.

english_verse: Whether we live or die, it must be for the Lord. Alive or dead, we still belong to the Lord.
translation_verse: Amoso, nɛ an baa wɔ ŋkpa to ŋko an wu gba, an wɔ Enyɛnpe na be enɔ to nna.

english_verse: This is because Christ died and rose to life, so that he would be the Lord of the dead and of the living.
translation_verse: Loŋ so nɛ Kristo na wu nseŋ naŋ lar luwu to m ba na, saŋɛ na so e beeŋ baa la basa nɛ b wu nɛ bumo nɛ b kraa wɔ ŋkpa to be Enyɛnpe.

english_verse: Why do you criticize other followers of the Lord? Why do you look down on them? The day is coming when God will judge all of us.
translation_verse: To, nɛ a ji nuso nna nɛ fee wu fo barkasa kulubi? Nɛ fo alɛ, manɛ e ba nɛ fee keni fo barkasa a bɔl? Ŋkpal manɛ so, kachako an kikɛ beeŋ yili Ebɔrɛ be demuji be echenakpa nɛ e ji anyi demu.

english_verse: And so, each of us must give an account to God for what we do. Don't Cause Problems for Others
translation_verse: Amoso, kachako anyi be ekama beeŋ kaŋɛ Ebɔrɛ asheŋ nɛ an wora kikɛ nyam nɛ kusɔ nɛ k ba nɛ an wora amo. Kesa maŋ shin nɛ fo barkasa e tɔr be asheŋ

english_verse: The Lord Jesus has made it clear to me that God considers all foods fit to eat. But if you think some foods are unfit to eat, then for you they are not fit.
translation_verse: Ŋ ka wɔ Enyɛnpe Yesu to so m baa nyi nna geeŋ fanɛ kejibi kikɛ gbagba maŋ lubi so, ama nɛ esa kama baa ta kejibi kama fanɛ kejibi lubi, kumo ere k beeŋ baa la kejibi lubi n sa amodoŋwura kashenteŋto.

english_verse: If you are hurting others by the foods you eat, you are not guided by love. Don't let your appetite destroy someone Christ died for.
translation_verse: Nɛ kusɔ kama malɛ nɛ fee ji nɛ k bee tɔrɔ fo niopibi be nfɛra, kumo ere mannɛ kasha be kesheŋ nɛ fee wora na. Sa maŋ kaŋ shin nɛ fo niopibi nɛ Kristo wu n sa na e foe ekpa ŋkpal kusɔ nɛ fee ji so.

english_verse: Don't let your right to eat bring shame to Christ.
translation_verse: Sa maŋ shin nɛ kusɔ nɛ fee tre kusɔ lela e nya ketre lubi fanɛ k maŋ walɛ so.

english_verse: God's kingdom isn't about eating and drinking. It is about pleasing God, about living in peace, and about true happiness. All this comes from the Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ be kuwura na to be asheŋ maŋ la kebaaji nɛ kebaanuu be asheŋ nna. K la alelasheŋ nɛ kagbenewushi nɛ kagbenefuli nɛ a bee shi Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na kutɔ na be kebaawɔtɔ be asheŋ nna.

english_verse: Don't let your appetite destroy what God has done. All foods are fit to eat, but it is wrong to cause problems for others by what you eat.
translation_verse: Sa maŋ kpal ajibi so n jija Ebɔrɛ be kushuŋ. Kejibi kama walɛ so nna, ama a maŋ daga fanɛ esa kikɛ ka ji kejibi kama nɛ k bee shin nɛ esa pɔtɛ bee foe ekpa na.

english_verse: It is best not to eat meat or drink wine or do anything else that causes problems for other followers of the Lord.
translation_verse: Nɛ fo nyi fanɛ fo we eblaŋ ko ŋko n nuu nsa ŋko n wora kusɔ kama nɛ k beeŋ shin nɛ fo niopibi e foe ekpa bre, fo ka maŋ wora amo be kekama bɔ.

english_verse: But if you do have doubts about what you eat, you are going against your beliefs. And you know that is wrong, because anything you do against your beliefs is sin.
translation_verse: Nɛ esa baa shin nɛ e ji kejibi kama nsaa wora shikashika nseŋ ji kumo, amodoŋwura wora n da so ashi Ebɔrɛ be anishito, ŋkpal manɛ so, e maŋ kɔ yirda kesheŋ nɛ e bee wora na to nna na. Kusɔ kama malɛ nɛ fo maŋ ta yirda n wora kumo la kulubi nna.

english_verse: If our faith is strong, we should be patient with the Lord's followers whose faith is weak. We should try to please them instead of ourselves.
translation_verse: A daga fanɛ anyi, bumo nɛ an kɔ eleŋ yirda na to na e baa chɛ bepɔshipo na to a keni bumo be asheŋ nɛ a bee pɔɔ bumo so to. An sa maa wɔtɔ a de anyi gbagba be aparsheŋ so.

english_verse: Even Christ did not try to please himself. But as the Scriptures say, “The people who insulted you also insulted me.”
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, Kristo gba daa maŋ de mo gbagba be aparsheŋ so, ama loŋ nɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ fanɛ e bee kaŋɛ le na: “Katege nɛ basa tege menyi na kikɛ laŋɛ ma kumu so.”

english_verse: God is the one who makes us patient and cheerful. I pray that he will help you live at peace with each other, as you follow Christ.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ nɛ e bee sa anyi kanyiti nsaa leŋ anyi to na e shin nɛ men nya kagbene koŋwuleso be kebaawɔtɔ a wɔ abar so a bɛ Kristo Yesu so.

english_verse: Then all of you together will praise God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ. The Good News Is for Jews and Gentiles
translation_verse: Saŋɛ na so menyi kikɛ beeŋ ta ebɔl koŋwule n di Ebɔrɛ an Nyɛnpe Yesu Kristo mo Tuto na epaŋ. Nnyamase ka bee maŋkura Ebɔrɛ be asheŋ

english_verse: Honor God by accepting each other, as Christ has accepted you.
translation_verse: To, men baa sɔ abar fanɛ kananɛ Kristo sɔ menyi na nɛ Ebɔrɛ e nya kemaŋkura.

english_verse: I tell you that Christ came as a servant of the Jews to show that God has kept the promises he made to their famous ancestors. Christ also came,
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, ma e kaŋɛ menyi na fanɛ Kristo ki Juwebi be kenya nna ŋkpal Ebɔrɛ be kashenteŋ na so, saŋɛ na so, e beeŋ shin nɛ nnɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ nase n sa benananyɛngboŋana na e bɔla ekpa.

english_verse: so that the Gentiles would praise God for being kind to them. It is just as the Scriptures say, “I will tell the nations about you, and I will sing praises to your name.”
translation_verse: Loŋ e naaŋ shin nɛ nnyamase e maŋkura Ebɔrɛ ŋkpal mbe kuwɔr so fanɛ kananɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ le na: “Ŋkpal le so meeŋ baa wɔ nnyamase to a di fo Ebɔrɛ epaŋ. Meeŋ boŋ nshɛ n dele fo ketre.”

english_verse: The Scriptures also say to the Gentiles, “Come and celebrate with God's people.”
translation_verse: Le nɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na kraŋ naa kaŋɛ: “Nnyamase, men tu Ebɔrɛ be basa laraso n shin nɛ menyi be ŋgbene e fuli menyi.”

english_verse: Again the Scriptures say, “Praise the Lord, all you Gentiles. All you nations, come and worship him.”
translation_verse: Amo koŋwule na kraŋ naa kaŋɛ le: “Menyi nnyamase kikɛ, men di Enyɛnpe na epaŋ, nɛ menyi basa yiri kikɛ men boŋ nshɛ n di mo epaŋ.”

english_verse: Isaiah says, “Someone from David's family will come to power. He will rule the nations, and they will put their hope in him.”
translation_verse: Ade malɛ gba kikɛ be kaman le nɛ anebi Aizaaya yɛ: “Jɛsi be kenanabi beeŋ ba kachako m ba lar n ji nnyamase so kuwura nɛ b ta bumo be tama kikɛ n deŋi mo so.”

english_verse: I pray that God, who gives hope, will bless you with complete happiness and peace because of your faith. And may the power of the Holy Spirit fill you with hope. Paul's Work as a Missionary
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ nɛ e bee sa anyi tama na e shin nɛ kagbenefuli nɛ kagbenewushi e bɔlɔ menyi to ashi menyi be keyirda mo ere to, saŋɛ na so menyi be tama beeŋ bɔla Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na be eleŋ to m bɔlɔ menyi to felɛlɛ n ya kaa wurge. Ekpa nɛ Pɔɔl kɔ n tiŋ n sibɛ le be asheŋ ere be asheŋ

english_verse: My friends, I am sure that you are very good and that you have all the knowledge you need to teach each other.
translation_verse: Ŋ kurgepoana, ma alɛ gba baa nyi geeŋ fanɛ alelasheŋ e baŋ bɔlɔ menyi alɛ gbagba to nseŋ naa nyi fanɛ men kɔ kanyiasheŋ kikɛ nɛ men gbagba e tiŋ ŋ ŋini abar asheŋ.

english_verse: He chose me to be a servant of Christ Jesus for the Gentiles and to do the work of a priest in the service of his good news. God did this so that the Holy Spirit could make the Gentiles into a holy offering, pleasing to him.
translation_verse: Mee shuŋ nna fanɛ bɔrɛmatapo a wɔtɔ a bɔ baru lela nɛ a shi Ebɔrɛ kutɔ na nna a sa nnyamase, saŋɛ na so, baaŋ baa du fanɛ kakɛ nɛ k bee par mo ere Ebɔrɛ nɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na lara m bɔɔ mo enɔ na.

english_verse: Because of Christ Jesus, I can take pride in my service for God.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal kɔnɔkoŋwule nɛ k wɔ ma nɛ Kristo Yesu be kefɛato so mee puchi nna ŋkpal ŋ ka bee shuŋ Ebɔrɛ so.

english_verse: In fact, all I will talk about is how Christ let me speak and work, so that the Gentiles would obey him.
translation_verse: Meeŋ baa kɔ kenyɛn nawule a malga asheŋ nɛ Kristo na wora ashi ma to nɛ loŋ e tiŋ n shin nɛ m bɔla mmalga nɛ ashuŋ shunso to n shin nɛ nnyamase e ba kaa nu a sa Ebɔrɛ.

english_verse: Indeed, I will tell how Christ worked miracles and wonders by the power of the Holy Spirit. I have preached the good news about him all the way from Jerusalem to Illyricum.
translation_verse: Kiyoyu na be eleŋ to nɛ m bɔla n shin nɛ b wu etɔɔnɛ nɛ emamachisheŋ. Amoso, baŋ yili Jerusalɛm be kade to n ta ŋ kulti n ya fo Ilirikem kikɛ m bɔ Kristo be baru lela na nɛnɛ n sa basa.

english_verse: It is just as the Scriptures say, “All who haven't been told about him will see him, and those who haven't heard about him will understand.” Paul's Plan To Visit Rome
translation_verse: Kusɔ nɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ le na nɛ m baa sha: “Basa nɛ b daa maŋ kaŋɛ mbe asheŋ n sa na beeŋ wu mo kenishiso nɛ bumo nɛ b daa maŋ nu mbe asheŋ na e pin to.”

english_verse: Now there is nothing left for me to do in this part of the world, and for years I have wanted to visit you.
translation_verse: Ama naniere ŋ ka maŋ naa kɔ kakpa ashi nsawule ere so nfe nɛ n shuŋ ere nɛ ŋkpal kananɛ ŋ kɔ nfɛ damta nɛ a choŋ ere kikɛ nɛ n wu menyi ere so,

english_verse: So I plan to stop off on my way to Spain. Then after a short, but refreshing, visit with you, I hope you will quickly send me on.
translation_verse: n yili kumo nna fanɛ ŋ kaa yɔ Speen be efuli so, meeŋ wu menyi. Ŋ kaŋ wu menyi m moɛ gbrɛ nɛ n shin nɛ men chɛ ma to ashi ma enite na to.

english_verse: I am now on my way to Jerusalem to deliver the money that the Lord's followers in Macedonia and Achaia collected for God's needy people.
translation_verse: Masɛdonia nɛ Akaya be efuliana so be asɔriana e yili kumo bumo gbagba be keparso n to amansherbi be toto nɛ n ta n ya sa Ebɔrɛ be basa nɛ b la betirpo a wɔ Jerusalɛm be asɔri to na.

english_verse: This is something they really wanted to do. But sharing their money with the Jews was also like paying back a debt, because the Jews had already shared their spiritual blessings with the Gentiles.
translation_verse: Bumo gbagba e yili kumo loŋ n wora. Kumo alɛ kashenteŋto bre, a daga b ka chɛ loŋ be betirpo na to, ŋkpal manɛ so, kananɛ nnyamase baŋ bɔla Juwebi so n nya abɔrɛsheŋ be nɛfa na koŋwule na a daga fanɛ nnyamase gba ka ta bumo be durnya ere to be asɔ be ako a chɛ Juwebi to.

english_verse: After I have safely delivered this money, I will visit you and then go on to Spain.
translation_verse: Amoso, m baŋ ta le be toto ere n sa bumo nseŋ shuŋ ma kushuŋ na n loge, meeŋ pɛ Speen be efuli so be ekpa nseŋ gbɛ n chɔrɔ menyi.

english_verse: And when I do arrive in Rome, I know it will be with the full blessings of Christ.
translation_verse: M baa nyi fanɛ ŋ kaŋ ba menyi kutɔ ma nɛ Kristo be nɛfa kikɛ nyam e naaŋ ba menyi to.

english_verse: My friends, by the power of the Lord Jesus Christ and by the love that comes from the Holy Spirit, I beg you to pray sincerely with me and for me.
translation_verse: Amoso, ŋ kurgepoana, mee kpal Enyɛnpe Yesu Kristo so nɛ kasha nɛ Kiyoyu na bee sa na so a kule menyi fanɛ men tu ma a kule Ebɔrɛ kpakpa a sa ma.

english_verse: Pray that God will protect me from the unbelievers in Judea, and that his people in Jerusalem will be pleased with what I am doing.
translation_verse: Men baa kule Ebɔrɛ fanɛ Judiya be efuli so be basa nɛ b maŋ kɔ yirda na maaŋ ya wora ma shɛŋ nseŋ naŋ kule mo fanɛ kushuŋ nɛ mee yɔ nɛ n ya shuŋ Jerusalɛm ere beeŋ par Ebɔrɛ be basa ndoŋ.

english_verse: Ask God to let me come to you and have a pleasant and refreshing visit.
translation_verse: Saŋɛ na so nɛ k la Ebɔrɛ be kepar nɛ m ba menyi kutɔ nɛ kagbenefuli, nɛ ma nɛ menyi kikɛ be keba abar so e leŋ anyi to.

english_verse: I pray that God, who gives peace, will be with all of you. Amen.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ nɛ kagbenewushi kikɛ bee shi mo kutɔ na e baa wɔ menyi kikɛ to. Amɛn.

english_verse: I have good things to say about Phoebe, who is a leader in the church at Cenchreae.
translation_verse: An sipoche Fibi nna na nɛ mee ta mo a ŋini menyi. E bee chɛ Kɛŋkriya be asɔriebi to nna.

english_verse: Welcome her in a way that is proper for someone who has faith in the Lord and is one of God's own people. Help her in any way you can. After all, she has proved to be a respected leader for many others, including me.
translation_verse: Men sɔ mo menyi to fanɛ esa nɛ e la Enyɛnpe na peya, nɛ kechɛto kama nɛ e bee sha menyi kutɔ, men chɛ mo to kananɛ k daga bebɛsopo ka wora, ŋkpal manɛ so, e la esa nɛ e chɛ basa damta to nna n ta ma alɛ gba n ti so.

english_verse: Give my greetings to Priscilla and Aquila. They have not only served Christ Jesus together with me,
translation_verse: Mee chɔrɔ Prisila nɛ Akwila nɛ b la m braana Kristo be beshumpo na.

english_verse: but they have even risked their lives for me. I am grateful for them and so are all the Gentile churches.
translation_verse: B daŋ kpal ma so nna n ta bumo be amu ŋ kpa kelara. Mee chɔrɔ bumo ga ŋkpal loŋ so, mannɛ n nawule gba malɛ e naa chɔrɔ bumo. Nnyamase be asɔriebiana na kikɛ gba bee chɔrɔ bumo ga.

english_verse: Greet the church that meets in their home. Greet my dear friend Epaenetus, who was the first person in Asia to have faith in Christ.
translation_verse: Mee chɔrɔ asɔriebi nɛ baa shɛr le be basa koŋwule ere pe na gba. Mee chɔrɔ n teri lela Epainites nɛ e baŋ juŋkpar m ba ta mbe yirda n deŋi Kristo so ashi Eeshia be kasawule so na gba.

english_verse: Greet Mary, who has worked so hard for you.
translation_verse: Mee chɔrɔ Mɛɛri nɛ e shuŋ ga n sa menyi na.

english_verse: Greet my relatives Andronicus and Junia, who were in jail with me. They are highly respected by the apostles and were followers of Christ before I was.
translation_verse: Mee chɔrɔ Andrɔnikes nɛ Junias nɛ b la n niopibi Juwebiana nɛ ma nɛ bumo daa wɔ kabuti to na. B la basa nɛ b kɔ ketre nna ashi beshuŋipoana na to, bumo alɛ pin Kristo nna pɔɛŋ nɛ m ba pin mo.

english_verse: Greet Ampliatus, my dear friend whose faith is in the Lord.
translation_verse: Mee chɔrɔ Ampliyates nɛ mee sha ga ashi Enyɛnpe to nna.

english_verse: Greet Urbanus, who serves Christ along with us. Greet my dear friend Stachys.
translation_verse: Mee chɔrɔ Ebaanes nɛ e la m barkasa Kristo be eshumpo na nsaa chɔrɔ n teri lela Staakis gba.

english_verse: Greet Herodion, who is a relative of mine. Greet Narcissus and the others in his family, who have faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Mee chɔrɔ n niopibi Juwnyɛn nɛ baa tre Hɛrodiɔn na nseŋ naa chɔrɔ Naasises be kowu to ebi nɛ b la Enyɛnpe peya na.

english_verse: Greet Tryphaena and Tryphosa, who work hard for the Lord. Greet my dear friend Persis. She also works hard for the Lord.
translation_verse: Mee chɔrɔ Traifina nɛ Traifosa nɛ b la beche nɛ baa shuŋ ga ashi Enyɛnpe be kushuŋ na to na. Mee chɔrɔ n teri lela Pɛɛsis nɛ mo alɛ gba la eche n shuŋ ga Enyɛnpe be kushuŋ na to na.

english_verse: Greet Rufus, that special servant of the Lord, and greet his mother, who has been like a mother to me.
translation_verse: Mee chɔrɔ Rufes nɛ Enyɛnpe lara n sa mbe kumu na nseŋ naa chɔrɔ mo nio nɛ e ta ma alɛ gba ŋ ki mo pibi na gba.

english_verse: Greet Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas, and Hermas, as well as our friends who are with them.
translation_verse: Mee chɔrɔ Asiŋkrites nɛ Flɛgɔn nɛ Hɛmes nɛ Patrɔbas nɛ Hɛmas nɛ bekurgepoana nɛ b wɔ bumo kutɔ na kikɛ.

english_verse: Greet Philologus, Julia, Nereus and his sister, and Olympas, and all of God's people who are with them.
translation_verse: Mee chɔrɔ Filɔlɔges nɛ Julia nɛ Neria nɛ mo sipoche nɛ Ɔlimpas nɛ Ebɔrɛ be basa nɛ bumo nɛ bumo wɔtɔ na kikɛ.

english_verse: Be sure to give each other a warm greeting. All of Christ's churches greet you.
translation_verse: Men ta kasha cheembi m pipe abar be ŋgbuŋ kechɔrɔso. Kristo be asɔriebiana na kikɛ bee chɔrɔ menyi. Pɔɔl be kamalga be ekar be asheŋ ŋiniso be asheŋ

english_verse: My friends, I beg you to watch out for anyone who causes trouble and divides the church by refusing to do what all of you were taught. Stay away from them!
translation_verse: Ŋ kurgepoana, mee fiɛ menyi so nna fanɛ men baa de basa nɛ baa shin nɛ kebarga to bee ba basa to nseŋ naa lar keŋini nɛ men daŋ nya na be kaman a wɔtɔ a bar asheŋ ko m ba kaa kagle basa yirda be ekpa na so. Amoso, men baa gelge bumo.

english_verse: They want to serve themselves and not Christ the Lord. Their flattery and fancy talk fool people who don't know any better.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, mannɛ an Nyɛnpe Yesu Kristo na nɛ loŋ be basa na bee shuŋ na, bumo gbagba be epunana nɛ baa shuŋ a sa. Kɔnɔ belbelso nɛ ŋkpaŋ fuloŋ nɛ b kɔ a fule basa nɛ b maŋ nyi asheŋ to.

english_verse: I am glad that everyone knows how well you obey the Lord. But still, I want you to understand what is good and not have anything to do with evil.
translation_verse: Naniere esa kama nu menyi be kasonu be asheŋ, amoso, ma kagbene fuli ma ga ŋkpal menyi so. Ama mee sha fanɛ men baa kɔ kanyiasheŋ a yɔ kelela be kaplɛa so nna nsaa maa nyi shɛŋ a yɔ alubi be kaplɛa so.

english_verse: Then God, who gives peace, will soon crush Satan under your feet. I pray that our Lord Jesus will be kind to you.
translation_verse: K maaŋ chɛr ko nɛ Ebɔrɛ nɛ kagbenewushi kikɛ bee shi mo kutɔ na e jija Setani be eleŋ kikɛ n shin nɛ e gbir menyi kumuli. An Nyɛnpe Yesu Kristo be kuwɔr be kakɛ e baa wɔ menyi to.

english_verse: Timothy, who works with me, sends his greetings, and so do my relatives, Lucius, Jason, and Sosipater.
translation_verse: Timoti nɛ e la m barkasa eshumpo na nɛ Lusias nɛ Jeesɔn nɛ Sosipata nɛ b la n niopibi Juwebi na bee chɔrɔ menyi.

english_verse: I, Tertius, also send my greetings. I am a follower of the Lord, and I wrote this letter.
translation_verse: Ma Tɛɛshes nɛ Pɔɔl malga asheŋ ere n shin nɛ n sibɛ amo kawɔl ere to ere bee chɔrɔ menyi ashi Enyɛnpe na to.

english_verse: Gaius welcomes me and the whole church into his home, and he sends his greetings. Erastus, the city treasurer, and our dear friend Quartus send their greetings too. Paul's Closing Prayer
translation_verse: [An Nyɛnpe Yesu Kristo be kuwɔr be kakɛ e baa wɔ menyi kikɛ to. Amɛn.] Pɔɔl be lalaloge be kechɔrɔ be asheŋ

english_verse: Praise God! He can make you strong by means of my good news, which is the message about Jesus Christ. For ages and ages this message was kept secret,
translation_verse: Kemaŋkura e baa wɔ Ebɔrɛ nɛ e beeŋ shin nɛ men baa kɔ menyi be yirda na to a yil kpakpa ŋkpal baru lela nɛ m bɔ n sa menyi m malga Kristo be kubɔya na be asheŋ na so nɛ ŋkpal kashenteŋ be wulo nɛ k daŋ ŋana dra dra na kikɛ so.

english_verse: but now at last it has been told. The eternal God commanded his prophets to write about the good news, so that all nations would obey and have faith.
translation_verse: Naniere bre, ŋkpal asɔ nɛ anebiana na sibɛ n nase na so so, kashenteŋ na dii efuli nna. Ŋkpal Ebɔrɛ nɛ e wɔ ŋkpa to na saŋkikɛ be kusɔ nɛ e yili na so, kusɔ kama bugi to nna n dese a sa efuli kama so ebi, saŋɛ na so, baaŋ yirda nseŋ nu n sa Ebɔrɛ.

english_verse: And now, because of Jesus Christ, we can praise the only wise God forever! Amen.
translation_verse: Kemaŋkura e baa la Ebɔrɛ nɛ kanyiasheŋ kikɛ la mo nawule peya ashi Yesu Kristo to na mbaanaayɔ. Amɛn.

english_verse: To God's church in Corinth. Christ Jesus chose you to be his very own people, and you worship in his name, as we and all others do who call him Lord.
translation_verse: Bumo e la basa nɛ Ebɔrɛ lara fanɛ b ba kaa la mbe basa a wɔ Kristo Yesu to na. Bumo koŋwule na nɛ basa kama nɛ b wɔ kaplɛkama a ti an Nyɛnpe Yesu Kristo be ketre na, mo e la bumo Nyɛnpe nɛ an Nyɛnpe na nɛ b tre nɛ b ba kaa la basa cheembi a wɔtɔ.

english_verse: My prayer is that God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace!
