translation_verse: Kuwɔr be kakɛ nɛ kagbenewushi mo nɛ a shi an Tuto kutɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Yesu Kristo kutɔ na e baa wɔ menyi kutɔ. Pɔɔl ka bee chɔrɔ Ebɔrɛ ŋkpal basa be yirda so be asheŋ

english_verse: I never stop thanking my God for treating you with undeserved grace by giving you Christ Jesus,
translation_verse: Saŋkikɛ mee chɔrɔ Ebɔrɛ nna ŋkpal mbe kuwɔr be kakɛ mo nɛ e bɔla Kristo Yesu so n wu menyi na so.

english_verse: Now you are certain that everything we told you about our Lord Christ Jesus is true.
translation_verse: Kristo be asheŋ nɛ an daŋ ji amo be shɛda na bɔlɔ menyi to naniere,

english_verse: God can be trusted, and he chose you to be partners with his Son, our Lord Jesus Christ. Taking Sides
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ mo nɛ e tre menyi fanɛ menyi nɛ mo Pibinyɛn Yesu Kristo an Nyɛnpe e baa kɔ kebaawɔtɔ koŋwule na la esa nɛ esa beeŋ tiŋ n yirda nna. Asɔri na to be kebargato be asheŋ

english_verse: My dear friends, as a follower of our Lord Jesus Christ, I beg you to get along with each other. Don't take sides. Always try to agree in what you think.
translation_verse: Ŋ kurgepoana, mee ta an Nyɛnpe Yesu Kristo be ketre nna a kule menyi fanɛ men kikɛ e baa kɔ kɔnɔkoŋwule a wɔ abar so, saŋɛ na so kebarga to kikɛ maaŋ baa wɔ menyi to. Men baa kɔ nfɛra koŋwule nsaa wora asheŋ ekpa koŋwuleso.

english_verse: Several people from Chloe's family have already reported to me that you keep arguing with each other.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, ŋ kurgepoana, basa ko ashi Klowe pe bugi to ŋ kaŋɛ ma fanɛ menyi to be beko wɔtɔ nna a kɔ abar nlu.

english_verse: Has Christ been divided up? Was I nailed to a cross for you? Were you baptized in my name?
translation_verse: B barga Kristo to nna a mɔ Pɔɔl kedibi largato so nna n sa menyi a? Ŋko b bɛr menyi kabɔrɛbɛr nna ashi Pɔɔl be ketre to a? Ayai, loŋ be asheŋ ere kikɛ maŋ wora.

english_verse: I thank God that I didn't baptize any of you except Crispus and Gaius.
translation_verse: K par ma ga fanɛ ŋ ka maŋ bɛr men be ekama kabɔrɛbɛr she Krispes nɛ Gayes nawule,

english_verse: Not one of you can say that you were baptized in my name.
translation_verse: saŋɛ na so, men be ekama maaŋ tiŋ ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ ma ketre to nɛ b bɛr mo kabɔrɛbɛr.

english_verse: I did baptize the family of Stephanas, but I don't remember if I baptized anyone else.
translation_verse: N nyiŋi fanɛ ŋ ka bɛr Stɛfanas nɛ mbe kowu to ebi gba, ama bede be buushi m maŋ naŋ nyiŋi ŋ ka bɛr esa kama kabɔrɛbɛr n naŋ ti so.

english_verse: The message about the cross doesn't make any sense to lost people. But for those of us who are being saved, it is God's power at work.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, luwu mo nɛ Kristo wu kedibi largato so be kubɔya na la kawulisheŋ nna n sa basa nɛ b wɔ kemur be ekpa to na. Ama anyi nɛ an wɔ kumɔlga be ekpa to ere bre, loŋ be kubɔya na la Ebɔrɛ be eleŋ nna.

english_verse: As God says in the Scriptures, “I will destroy the wisdom of all who claim to be wise. I will confuse those who think they know so much.”
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ fanɛ Ebɔrɛ bee kaŋɛ fanɛ: “Meeŋ jija benyiashempo be kanyiasheŋ nseŋ ta benyiashempo be kenyi ŋ ki jiga.”

english_verse: What happened to those wise people? What happened to those experts in the Scriptures? What happened to the ones who think they have all the answers? Didn't God show that the wisdom of this world is foolish?
translation_verse: To, nɛ kenya la loŋ, nnɛ nɛ benyiashempo ŋko nwɔlnyipoana ŋko durnya ere to be kanyiashenfinpowuraana naa yil? Ebɔrɛ maŋ ŋini fanɛ durnya ere to be kanyiasheŋ la kawulisheŋ nna a?

english_verse: God was wise and decided not to let the people of this world use their wisdom to learn about him. Instead, God chose to save only those who believe the foolish message we preach.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ daŋ bɔla mbe kanyiasheŋ so nna n yili kumo fanɛ edimɛdi e sa maŋ ta bumo gbagba be kanyiasheŋ so m ba pin mo. Ama mo ere gbagba be keparso nɛ e yili kumo fanɛ e beeŋ bɔla kubɔya mo nɛ anyeeŋ bɔ n sa basa nɛ baa tre kawulisheŋ be mmalga ere so m mɔlga bekama nɛ b yirda na.

english_verse: But we preach that Christ was nailed to a cross. Most Jews have problems with this, and most Gentiles think it is foolish.
translation_verse: Ama anyi ere, Kristo mo nɛ b daŋ gbir m mata kedibi largato so na be asheŋ be kubɔya nɛ anyee bɔ a sa basa. Loŋ be kubɔya na malɛ la kusɔ nɛ k bee kagle Juwebi ekpa nna nsaa la kawulisheŋ a sa Nnyamase malɛ.

english_verse: Our message is God's power and wisdom for the Jews and the Greeks that he has chosen.
translation_verse: Ama bumo, Juwebi nɛ Griikebi nɛ Ebɔrɛ tre na bre kikɛ, kubɔya na la Kristo mo nɛ e la Ebɔrɛ be eleŋ nɛ mbe kanyiasheŋ na nna.

english_verse: Even when God is foolish, he is wiser than everyone else, and even when God is weak, he is stronger than everyone else.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, kusɔ nɛ k bee ŋini Ebɔrɛ be kawulisheŋ kɔ kanyiasheŋ a chɔ edimɛdi be kanyiasheŋ. Kusɔ nɛ kumo alɛ bee ŋini Ebɔrɛ be kapɔshi basa be anishito kɔ eleŋ a chɔ edimɛdi be eleŋ.

english_verse: My dear friends, remember what you were when God chose you. The people of this world didn't think that many of you were wise. Only a few of you were in places of power, and not many of you came from important families.
translation_verse: Ŋ kurgepoana, men baa nyiŋi basa nɛ men daa la pɔɛŋ nɛ Ebɔrɛ tre menyi na. Edimɛdi be anishito menyi be bedamta daa maŋ la benyiashempo. Men be bedamta daa maŋ la bejuŋkparpo basa be anishito, bedamta malɛ daa maŋ shi kuwurji be kanaŋ kama to.

english_verse: But God chose the foolish things of this world to put the wise to shame. He chose the weak things of this world to put the powerful to shame.
translation_verse: Ama Ebɔrɛ lara durnya ere to be asɔ wuliso nna nɛ e ta anishinyɔr m pɛ benyiashempo. E lara durnya ere to be asɔ pɔso nna nɛ anishinyɔr e pɛ belempo.

english_verse: What the world thinks is worthless, useless, and nothing at all is what God has used to destroy what the world considers important.
translation_verse: E lara durnya ere to be asɔ bɔlpo nna nɛ asɔ nɛ basa bee keni jiga na nna nɛ asɔ nɛ a maŋ la shɛŋ na, saŋɛ na so e beeŋ ta durnya ere to be asɔ lela na ŋ ki asɔ fuloŋ

english_verse: God did all this to keep anyone from bragging to him.
translation_verse: nɛ esa kikɛ e sa maŋ tiŋ m puchi ashi Ebɔrɛ be anishito.

english_verse: So if you want to brag, do what the Scriptures say and brag about the Lord.
translation_verse: Loŋ malɛ nɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na kaŋɛ na fanɛ: “Esa kama nɛ e bee sha kepuchi, e baa puchi Enyɛnpe na so.”

english_verse: Friends, when I came and told you the mystery that God had shared with us, I didn't use big words or try to sound wise.
translation_verse: Ŋ kurgepoana, ŋ ka daŋ ba menyi kutɔ nɛ m ba kaŋɛ menyi wulo be asɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ bugi to na, n daa maŋ ta kɔnɔ belbelso nɛ kenyisha be kanyiasheŋ be mmalga n tu menyi.

english_verse: In fact, while I was with you, I made up my mind to speak only about Jesus Christ, who had been nailed to a cross.
translation_verse: N daŋ yili kumo nna fanɛ ŋ ka daa wɔ menyi kutɔ na, n daa maŋ nyi shɛŋ she Yesu Kristo nawule nɛ luwu mo nɛ e wu kedibi largato so na be asheŋ.

english_verse: When I talked with you or preached, I didn't try to prove anything by sounding wise. I simply let God's Spirit show his power.
translation_verse: Ma alɛ daa maŋ ta kanyiasheŋ nɛ mmalga belbelso nna nɛ n nya menyi. Ama ŋ ka daŋ malga m bɔ kubɔya na, Ebɔrɛ be Kiyoyu be eleŋ daŋ dii efuli nna.

english_verse: That way you would have faith because of God's power and not because of human wisdom.
translation_verse: Saŋɛ na so men be yirda maaŋ baa yil dimɛdi be kanyiasheŋ so. Ebɔrɛ be eleŋ so nɛ k beeŋ baa yil. Ebɔrɛ be kanyiasheŋ be asheŋ

english_verse: We do use wisdom when speaking to people who are mature in their faith. But it isn't the wisdom of this world or of its rulers, who will soon disappear.
translation_verse: Ama anyee kaa malga kanyiashenso be mmalga nna ashi bumo nɛ b kɔ kenimufɛra to bre, ama mannɛ kanyiasheŋ mo nɛ k shi durnya ere to nna. Kumo alɛ maŋ naa shi bumo nɛ b kɔ eleŋ durnya ere to nɛ a bee mur na kutɔ.

english_verse: The rulers of this world didn't know anything about this wisdom. If they had known about it, they would not have nailed the glorious Lord to a cross.
translation_verse: Basa nɛ b kɔ eleŋ durnya ere to daa maŋ nyi le be kanyiasheŋ ere, ŋkpal manɛ so, nɛ b daa nyi kumo nna, b daa maaŋ gbir an Nyɛnpe mo nɛ e kɔ kemaŋkura na m mata kedibi largato so.

english_verse: But it is just as the Scriptures say, “What God has planned for people who love him is more than eyes have seen or ears have heard. It has never even entered our minds!”
translation_verse: Ama abɔrɛsibɛ na malɛ bee kaŋɛ fanɛ: “Esa kikɛ maŋ naŋ wu ŋko n nu ŋko n fɛ m pin kusɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ bela ase n yili basa nɛ baa sha mo na.”

english_verse: God's Spirit has shown you everything. His Spirit finds out everything, even what is deep in the mind of God.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ bɔla mbe Kiyoyu so nna n lara asheŋ ere ŋ ŋini anyi. Ebɔrɛ be Kiyoyu na malɛ e naa wu asheŋ to nɛnɛ hale Ebɔrɛ be wulo to be asheŋ.

english_verse: You are the only one who knows what is in your own mind, and God's Spirit is the only one who knows what is in God's mind.
translation_verse: Esa kikɛ maa pin esa kama be nfɛra to she esa na wura gbagba be kiyoyu e nyi mo to. Loŋ koŋwule na malɛ nɛ esa kikɛ maaŋ tiŋ m pin Ebɔrɛ be nfɛra to she Ebɔrɛ be Kiyoyu na nawule.

english_verse: But God has given us his Spirit. This is why we don't think the same way that the people of this world think. This is also why we can recognize the blessings God has given us.
translation_verse: Kiyoyu mo nɛ anyi ere nya na maŋ la durnya ere to peya nna. E shi Ebɔrɛ kutɔ nna, saŋɛ na so, anyeeŋ pin asɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ ta ŋ kɛ anyi na kikɛ nyam.

english_verse: Every word we speak was taught to us by God's Spirit, not by human wisdom. And this same Spirit helps us teach spiritual things to spiritual people.
translation_verse: Amoso, anyi maa malga mmalga mo nɛ edimɛdi ta bumo be kanyiasheŋ ŋ ŋini. Mmalga mo nɛ Kiyoyu na ŋini nɛ an kɔ a bugi Kiyoyu na to be nshenteŋ a sa basa nɛ b kɔ Kiyoyu na.

english_verse: People who are guided by the Spirit can make all kinds of judgments, but they cannot be judged by others.
translation_verse: Ama Kiyoyu to be esa bre bee tiŋ a pin asheŋ kama to nna, ama esa kama maaŋ tiŋ m pin loŋ be esa na be asheŋ to.

english_verse: The Scriptures ask, “Has anyone ever known the thoughts of the Lord or given him advice?” But we understand what Christ is thinking.
translation_verse: Loŋ malɛ nɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ na fanɛ: “Wanɛ e nyi Enyɛnpe na be nfɛra to? Wanɛ e naaŋ tiŋ ŋ ŋini mo asheŋ?” Ama anyi ere, Kristo be nfɛra wɔ anyi be ŋgbene to nna.

english_verse: My friends, you are acting like the people of this world. That's why I could not speak to you as spiritual people. You are like babies as far as your faith in Christ is concerned.
translation_verse: Ŋ kurgepoana, n daa maŋ tiŋ m malga menyi kutɔ fanɛ basa nɛ Ebɔrɛ be Kiyoyu bee juŋkpar na. N daa malga menyi kutɔ nna fanɛ durnya ere to be basa nɛ baa bɛ bumo gbagba be aparsheŋ so. N daa malga menyi kutɔ nna fanɛ bumo nɛ b la mbia ashi Kristo be asheŋ to.

english_verse: So I had to treat you like babies and feed you milk. You could not take solid food, and you still cannot,
translation_verse: Kusɔ nɛ n daŋ sa menyi na daa du fanɛ kenyipo nna, mannɛ ajibi nyiŋgriŋ e daa la, ŋkpal manɛ so, men daa maŋ naŋ fo loŋ be ajibi na, hale mbre gba men maŋ naŋ fo amo.

english_verse: because you are not yet spiritual. You are jealous and argue with each other. This proves you are not spiritual and you are acting like the people of this world.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, men kraa wɔtɔ nna fanɛ eyur to be basa a wora abar kayurbesa be asheŋ nsaa bile. To, men maŋ nyi fanɛ nɛ men baa wɔtɔ a wora loŋ men kraa du fanɛ eyur ere to be basa nna nsaa wɔtɔ a wora asheŋ fanɛ basa fuloŋ a?

english_verse: Some of you say you follow me, and others claim to follow Apollos. Isn't this how ordinary people behave?
translation_verse: Nɛ men wɔtɔ a kaŋɛ abar fanɛ: “Pɔɔl nɛ ma ere bee bɛ so,” nɛ ede malɛ e kaŋɛ: “Apɔlɔs nɛ ma ere bee bɛ so,” loŋ maa ŋini fanɛ basa fuloŋ e baa la menyi ere a?

english_verse: The one who plants is just as important as the one who waters. And each one will be paid for what they do.
translation_verse: Esa nɛ e bee duu nɛ emo nɛ e bee wurge so nchu na kikɛ sasa nna. Kananɛ ekama malɛ bee shuŋ mbe kushuŋ so nɛ baaŋ yili ŋ ka mo kukɔ.

english_verse: Apollos and I work together for God, and you are God's garden and God's building. Only One Foundation
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ mo braana beshumpo e la anyi nɛ menyi alɛ du fanɛ mbe kasawule nseŋ naa du fanɛ mbe ebu nɛ e bee pɔr.

english_verse: God treated me with undeserved grace and let me become an expert builder. I laid a foundation on which others have built. But we must each be careful how we build,
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ be kuwɔr be kakɛ mo nɛ e sa ma na e shin nɛ n tiŋ n nase ebu na be gbaltɔlase na fanɛ epɔrpo nyipo na n sa basa nɛ baa pɔr a yili so. Ama a daga fanɛ ekama e baa de kananɛ e bee pɔr kumo so.

english_verse: Whatever we build on this foundation will be tested by fire on the day of judgment. Then everyone will find out if we have used gold, silver, and precious stones, or wood, hay, and straw.
translation_verse: Kachako kanaŋkamaso nɛ ekama be kushuŋ du, k beeŋ lar efuli. Kumo be kamɔnchɛ na e naaŋ ŋini kusɔ kama, ŋkpal manɛ so, edɛ e naaŋ wora kusɔ kama ŋ keni nɛ ekama e pin ekama be kushuŋ to.

english_verse: But if it is destroyed by the fire, we will lose everything. Yet we ourselves will be saved, like someone escaping from flames.
translation_verse: Ama nɛ fanɛ kusɔ na baŋ chɔɔ bre, e beeŋ tɔr. Mo ere gbagba beeŋ nya kumɔlga, ama kumo alɛ beeŋ baa du fanɛ esa nɛ e bɔla edɛ to nna n shile n lar n nya mbe kumu.

english_verse: All of you surely know you are God's temple and his Spirit lives in you.
translation_verse: Men maŋ nyi fanɛ men la Ebɔrɛ be lambu nna nɛ Ebɔrɛ be Kiyoyu wɔ menyi to a?

english_verse: Together you are God's holy temple, and God will destroy anyone who destroys his temple.
translation_verse: Ekama nɛ e jija Ebɔrɛ be lambu, Ebɔrɛ beeŋ jija amodoŋwura gba, ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ be lambu la lambu cheembi nna, menyi alɛ e la loŋ be lambu na.

english_verse: Don't fool yourselves! If any of you think you are wise in the things of this world, you will have to become foolish before you can be truly wise.
translation_verse: Ekama e sa maŋ kaa fule mbe kumu, menyi to be ekama nɛ e bee fɛ mbe kumu to fanɛ e la enyiashempo nna durnya ere be kaplɛa so, e ki ewulpo, saŋɛ na so e beeŋ ki enyiashempo.

english_verse: This is because God considers the wisdom of this world to be foolish. It is just as the Scriptures say, “God catches the wise when they try to outsmart him.”
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, durnya ere to be kanyiasheŋ la kawulisheŋ nna ashi Ebɔrɛ be anishito. Loŋ nɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na malɛ bee kaŋɛ na fanɛ: “Ebɔrɛ bee kaa ta benyiashempo gbagba be kanyiasheŋ be aworbiana nna a pɛ bumo.”

english_verse: The Scriptures also say, “The Lord knows that the plans made by wise people are useless.”
translation_verse: Abɔrɛsibɛ na kraŋ naa kaŋɛ kaboŋ ko fanɛ: “Enyɛnpe na nyi benyiashempo be nfɛra ka la nfɛra fuloŋ.”

english_verse: So stop bragging about what anyone has done. Paul and Apollos and Peter all belong to you. In fact, everything is yours, including the world, life, death, the present, and the future. Everything belongs to you,
translation_verse: Pɔɔl ŋko Apɔlɔs ŋko Sifas ŋko durnya ŋko ŋkpa ŋko luwu ŋko asheŋ nɛ a bee wora naniere ŋko amo nɛ a beeŋ wora echefoso kikɛ nyam la menyeya nna.

english_verse: and you belong to Christ, and Christ belongs to God.
translation_verse: Nɛ menyi alɛ la Kristo peya nɛ Kristo malɛ la Ebɔrɛ peya.

english_verse: Think of us as servants of Christ who have been given the work of explaining God's mysterious ways.
translation_verse: Kananɛ k daga fanɛ men baa ta anyi e la fanɛ an la Kristo be anya nna nɛ Ebɔrɛ ta mbe ewulosheŋ m bɔɔ anyi enɔ.

english_verse: And since our first duty is to be faithful to the one we work for,
translation_verse: Kusɔ nɛ k baŋ daga esa nɛ b ta nɛ e baa keni asɔ so e la fanɛ e sa maa lar mo nyɛnpe kaman.

english_verse: it doesn't matter to me if I am judged by you or even by a court of law. In fact, I don't judge myself.
translation_verse: Ma ere kutɔ nɛ menyi ŋko durnya to be kɔɔti kama to ebi bee ji ma demu, k maŋ tir ma. Ma ere gbagba maa ji ma kumu demu.

english_verse: I don't know of anything against me, but this doesn't prove I am right. The Lord is my judge.
translation_verse: Kashenteŋ nna fanɛ m maŋ wu kulubi kikɛ ma so, ama kumo be loŋ maa shin nɛ mee ji a lar. Enyɛnpe e naa ji ma demu.

english_verse: Friends, I have used Apollos and myself as examples to teach you the meaning of the saying, “Follow the rules.” I want you to stop saying one of us is better than the other.
translation_verse: Ŋ kurgepoana, m malga asheŋ ere nna n ta ma nɛ Apɔlɔs be asheŋ m ber ŋkpal men be kechɛto so. N wora loŋ nna nɛ men pin kusɔ nɛ basa bee kaŋɛ fanɛ: “Sa maŋ kaŋ wora asheŋ m baŋ kusɔ nɛ b sibɛ n nase na so.” Men be ekama e sa maŋ kaa puchi esa ko so nsaa kishi eko.

english_verse: What is so special about you? What do you have that you were not given? And if it was given to you, how can you brag?
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, wanɛ e la fo nɛ fee fɛ fanɛ fo bɔ fo niopibiana? Mannɛ Ebɔrɛ e kɛ fo asɔ nɛ fo kɔ ere kikɛ a? To, nɛ manɛ e ba nɛ fee puchi fanɛ asɔ nɛ fo kɔ ere maŋ la kakɛ nna?

english_verse: Are you already satisfied? Are you now rich? Have you become kings while we are still nobodies? I wish you were kings. Then we could have a share in your kingdom.
translation_verse: Menyee fɛ fanɛ naniere men tea kɔ kusɔ kikɛ nɛ menyee sha ŋko? Men teŋ dii dama ŋko? Men ki bewura ŋ ka anyi. Nɛ men daa la bewura kashenteŋto k daa beeŋ par ma paa! Saŋɛ na so anyi alɛ gba daa beeŋ tu menyi a la bewura.

english_verse: It seems to me that God has put us apostles in the worst possible place. We are like prisoners on their way to death. Angels and the people of this world just laugh at us.
translation_verse: K bee wora ma nna fanɛ Ebɔrɛ ta anyi beshuŋipo nna m bɛ ekama be kaman nɛ an baa du fanɛ basa nɛ b ji n tɔr n daga kewu kelɔnɛ so na. B yili anyi kefulto so nna geeŋ, emalaika nɛ basa kikɛ be anishito, kumo e la fanɛ durnya kikɛ be anishito.

english_verse: Because of Christ we are thought of as fools, but Christ has made you wise. We are weak and hated, but you are powerful and respected.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal Kristo so, an la bewulpo nna, ama menyi ere la benyiashempo nna ashi Kristo to. Anyi ere maŋ kɔ eleŋ, ama menyi ere kɔ! B kishi anyi nna, ama baa bunyaŋ menyi ere nna!

english_verse: Even today we go hungry and thirsty and don't have anything to wear except rags. We are mistreated and don't have a place to live.
translation_verse: Hale m ba fo kabre, anyi nɛ akoŋ nɛ achukoŋ e na, anyi nɛ asɔ farbi e na, baa bri anyi nɛ anyi maŋ kɔ epeana a wɔtɔ.

english_verse: We work hard with our own hands, and when people abuse us, we wish them well. When we suffer, we are patient.
translation_verse: Anyi gbagba be enɔana nɛ an kɔ a shuŋ ga. Basa baŋ so anyi kɔnɔ, anyee nɛfa bumo nna, b baŋ tɔrɔ anyi, anyee ji kumo be loŋ be kanyiti nna.

english_verse: When someone curses us, we answer with kind words. Until now we are thought of as nothing more than the trash and garbage of this world.
translation_verse: B baŋ tege anyi, anyee malga bumo kutɔ kashaso nna. Hale m ba fo kabre an du fanɛ durnya ere to be eyurpi nna, kumo be kumuni.

english_verse: I am not writing to embarrass you. I want to help you, just as parents help their own dear children.
translation_verse: M maa sibɛ asɔ ere nna a sa menyi nɛ n ta anishinyɔr m pɛ menyi, ama mee sibɛ amo nna nɛ n niŋi menyi ekpa ŋkpal men ka la ma mbia shaso so.

english_verse: Ten thousand people may teach you about Christ, but I am your only father. You became my children when I told you about Christ Jesus,
translation_verse: Kashenteŋ nna fanɛ hale nɛ men kɔ basa nɛ baa ŋini menyi Kristo be asheŋ damta fanɛ kagboŋ gba, menyi maŋ kɔ betuto damta bre, ŋkpal manɛ so, Kristo Yesu to, ma e daŋ bɔla baru lela na so ŋ ki menyi tuto.

english_verse: and I want you to be like me.
translation_verse: Amoso, mee kule menyi nna fanɛ men baa kute ma to.

english_verse: This is why I sent Timothy to you. I love him like a son, and he is a faithful servant of the Lord. Timothy will tell you what I do to follow Christ and how it agrees with what I always teach about Christ in every church.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal loŋ so, mee shuŋi Timoti men kutɔ nna. E la m pibi shaso nna nɛ esa nɛ meeŋ tiŋ n yirda ashi Enyɛnpe be kaplɛa so. E beeŋ nyiŋi menyi kananɛ ma kebaawɔtɔ du ashi Kristo Yesu to fanɛ kananɛ mee ŋini amo kaplɛkama ashi asɔri kama to na.

english_verse: Some of you think I am not coming for a visit, and so you are bragging.
translation_verse: Menyi be beko bee wu menyi be amu nna a fɛ fanɛ shere m maaŋ naŋ ba menyi kutɔ,

english_verse: But if the Lord lets me come, I will soon be there. Then I will find out if the ones who are doing all this bragging really have any power.
translation_verse: ama nɛ Enyɛnpe na shuli, m maaŋ naŋ chɛr nseŋ ba menyi kutɔ. Ma alɛ kaŋ ba, meeŋ pin eleŋ nɛ basa nɛ baa wu bumo be amu ere kɔ, mannɛ bumo be mmalga nawule.

english_verse: God's kingdom isn't just a lot of words. It is power.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ be kuwura na be asheŋ baa maa la kamalga nna, k la eleŋ nna.

english_verse: What do you want me to do when I arrive? Do you want me to be hard on you or to be kind and gentle?
translation_verse: Kumo nɛ menyeeŋ baa sha, ŋ ka beeŋ ta kasogberge m ba tu menyi ŋko ŋ ka beeŋ ta kasha nɛ kebaawɔtɔ nɛ k du boeŋ m ba tu menyi?

english_verse: I have heard terrible things about some of you. In fact, you are behaving worse than Gentiles. A man is even sleeping with his own stepmother.
translation_verse: Basa wɔtɔ nna a kaŋɛ fanɛ kesakalea be keji wɔ menyi to nna, kesakalea mo nɛ b maa ji bumo nɛ b maŋ nyi Ebɔrɛ gba to, kumo e la fanɛ menyi to be eko kɔ mo tuto be eche nna a sha.

english_verse: I am with you only in my thoughts. But in the name of our Lord Jesus I have already judged this man, as though I were with you in person. So when you meet together and the power of the Lord Jesus is with you, I will be there too.
translation_verse: Men kaŋ ba shɛr an Nyɛnpe Yesu Kristo be ketre to nɛ ma alɛ wɔ menyi to ashi kiyoyu na to nɛ Yesu Kristo be eleŋ wɔ menyi to na,

english_verse: You must then hand that man over to Satan. His body will be destroyed, but his spirit will be saved when the Lord Jesus returns.
translation_verse: men ta loŋ be esa na m bɔɔ Setani enɔ, saŋɛ na so, mbe eyur beeŋ jija nɛ mbe kiyoyu bre e nya kumɔlga kachɛ nɛ Enyɛnpe beeŋ ba na.

english_verse: Stop being proud! Don't you know how a little yeast can spread through the whole batch of dough?
translation_verse: Kananɛ menyee puchi ere maŋ walɛ kuraa. Men maŋ nyi keŋasa mo nɛ k bee kaŋɛ fanɛ: Yiisi gbrɛbi baŋ luri nyifu to a bee shin nɛ nyifu na kikɛ bee tiŋ fɔŋgrɔŋ nna a?

english_verse: Get rid of the old yeast! Then you will be like fresh bread made without yeast, and this is what you are. Our Passover lamb is Christ, who has already been sacrificed.
translation_verse: To, loŋ nɛ kulubi gba du. Amoso, men lara kulubi kikɛ menyi to nɛ k maaŋ tiŋ n sɔ kaplɛkama. Loŋ e naaŋ shin nɛ men ki basa popɔr. Kashenteŋ malɛ nna fanɛ men la basa cheembi nna, ŋkpal manɛ so, Yesu Kristo wu n sa anyi. Mo e la emo nɛ baa tre Kebansonchoŋ be Kpakpafɔlbi nɛ b ta n lara sarga na.

english_verse: So don't celebrate the festival by being evil and sinful, which is like serving bread made with yeast. Be pure and truthful and celebrate by using bread made without yeast.
translation_verse: Amoso, men shin nɛ an ji Kebansonchoŋ be kejigboŋ na kumo be ekpa so, nɛ kekishi nɛ kulubi kama e sa maa wɔ anyi to, ama kelela nɛ kashenteŋ beeŋ baa wɔ anyi to.

english_verse: In my other letter I told you not to have anything to do with immoral people.
translation_verse: Kawɔl mo nɛ n daŋ juŋkpar n sibɛ menyi na to, ŋ kaŋɛ menyi fanɛ menyi nɛ basa kama nɛ b kɔ kesakalea be kebaawɔtɔ e sa maa to jina kikɛ.

english_verse: But I wasn't talking about the people of this world. You would have to leave this world to get away from everyone who is immoral or greedy or who cheats or worships idols.
translation_verse: Mannɛ basa nɛ b maŋ nyi Kristo nsaa kɔ kesakalea ŋko a la kejimuniwuraana na ŋko beyu ŋko agbirshumpoana nɛ n daa de. Nɛ mannɛ aloŋ nna menyeeŋ lar durnya ere to nna kuraa ai.

english_verse: God judges everyone else. The Scriptures say, “Chase away any of your own people who are evil.”
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ e naaŋ ji basa nɛ b maŋ wɔ asɔri na to demu. Kusɔ nɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ e la fanɛ: “Men ju alubiworapo kama ashi menyi to.”

english_verse: When one of you has a complaint against another, do you take your complaint to a court of sinners? Or do you take it to God's people?
translation_verse: Nɛ menyi to be ekama nɛ ekurgepo ko nya kamalga, nuso nɛ amodoŋwura beeŋ wora n nya kagbene n yɛr ekurgepo na demujipowuraana mo nɛ b maŋ nyi Ebɔrɛ be anishito nseŋ kini keyɛr kesheŋ na Ebɔrɛ be basa laraso be anishito?

english_verse: Don't you know that God's people will judge the world? And if you are going to judge the world, can't you settle small problems?
translation_verse: Men maŋ nyi fanɛ Ebɔrɛ be basa e naaŋ ba ji durnya to ebi kikɛ demu kachako a? To, nɛ menyi ka beeŋ ba ji durnya ere to ebi kikɛ demu, men maaŋ tiŋ n ji le be asheŋ wurbi ere bre a?

english_verse: Don't you know we will judge angels? And if this is so, we can surely judge everyday matters.
translation_verse: Men maŋ nyi fanɛ anyi e naaŋ ba ji emalaika demu a? Nɛ an ka beeŋ tiŋ n ji emalaika demu, kebaawɔtɔ ere to be asheŋ bre maŋ bɛ n sulge a?

english_verse: I say this to your shame. Aren't any of you wise enough to act as a judge between one follower and another?
translation_verse: Ŋ kaŋɛ menyi kesheŋ ere nna nɛ anishinyɔr e pɛ menyi. Ama esa kikɛ maŋ wɔ menyi to a nyi asheŋ nɛ e tiŋ n shin nɛ kesheŋ nɛ k wɔ bekurgepo anyɔ be nferinto e nya edesekpa a?

english_verse: When one of you takes another to court, all of you lose. It would be better to let yourselves be cheated and robbed.
translation_verse: Men ka baa kɔ asheŋ menyi to ere e naa ŋini fanɛ men tɔr kashenteŋto pasaa. Men daa maaŋ tiŋ n shuli kejija nna n sa abar ŋkaa maaŋ yɛr abar demujikpa a? Keshuli n shin nɛ b puni menyi maŋ bɔ keyɛr abar demujikpa a?

english_verse: Don't you know that evil people won't have a share in the blessings of God's kingdom? Don't fool yourselves! No one who is immoral or worships idols or is unfaithful in marriage or is a pervert or behaves like a homosexual
translation_verse: Men maŋ nyi fanɛ mannɛ basa lubi e naaŋ ba nya Ebɔrɛ be kuwura na to n luri ŋko? Men sa maŋ shin nɛ esa kikɛ e fule menyi. Kesakaleawuraana kikɛ ŋko bumo nɛ baa shuŋ agbirana ŋko bumo nɛ baa kil nsaa ji kesakalea ŋko benyɛn mo nɛ baa di abar keche nɛ kenyɛn kikɛ maaŋ nya Ebɔrɛ be kuwura na to n luri kikɛ.

english_verse: will share in God's kingdom. Neither will any thief or greedy person or drunkard or anyone who curses and cheats others.
translation_verse: Beyu ŋko kejimuniwuraana ŋko nsanuupoana ŋko bumo nɛ baa tege bumo braana ŋko besugepoana maaŋ nya Ebɔrɛ be kuwura na to n luri kikɛ.

english_verse: Some of you used to be like that. But now the name of our Lord Jesus Christ and the power of God's Spirit have washed you and made you holy and acceptable to God. Honor God with Your Body
translation_verse: Loŋ nɛ menyi be beko daa du, ama naniere bre Ebɔrɛ fɔr menyi so ashi kulubi to nseŋ lara menyi nɛ men ki mbe basa. Men bɔla Enyɛnpe Yesu Kristo be ketre so nɛ an be Ebɔrɛ be Kiyoyu na so n ji n lar. Kusɔ nɛ k daga fanɛ ebɛsopo e baa kɔ mbe eyur a wora be asheŋ

english_verse: You also say, “Food is meant for our bodies, and our bodies are meant for food.” But I tell you that God will destroy them both. We are not supposed to do indecent things with our bodies. We are to use them for the Lord who is in charge of our bodies.
translation_verse: Esa ko malɛ beeŋ naŋ kaŋɛ le: “Ajibi e wɔ epun nɛ epun malɛ gba wɔ ajibi.” Kashenteŋ nna, ama baa nyiŋi fanɛ kachako Ebɔrɛ beeŋ mur amo kikɛ. A maŋ daga fanɛ dimɛdi e baa ta mbe eyur a wora kesakaleasheŋ, k daga fanɛ e baa ta kumo nna a shuŋ Enyɛnpe na nɛ Enyɛnpe na malɛ e baa shuŋ eyur na.

english_verse: God will raise us from death by the same power he used when he raised our Lord to life.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ e tiŋi Enyɛnpe ashi luwu to, mo alɛ beeŋ ta mbe eleŋ n tiŋi anyi alɛ gba ashi luwu to.

english_verse: Don't you know that your bodies are part of the body of Christ? Is it right for me to join part of the body of Christ to a prostitute? No, it isn't!
translation_verse: Men maŋ nyi fanɛ men be eyurana ere la Kristo gbagba be mba ko nna ŋko? To, k daga fanɛ n ta Kristo to be mba ko n ya chɔga sakaleche be eyur so a? Kuraa, loŋ maaŋ nya kikɛ.

english_verse: Don't you know that a man who does that becomes part of her body? The Scriptures say, “The two of them will be like one person.”
translation_verse: Men maŋ nyi fanɛ esa kama nɛ e ta mbe eyur a wɔtɔ sakaleche to, bumo benyɔ na bee ki eyur koŋwule nna a? Ŋkpal manɛ so, abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ fanɛ: “Enyɛn kama nɛ e ta mbe kaba n wɔtɔ eche to, mo nɛ eche na bee ki kukoŋwule nna.”

english_verse: But anyone who is joined to the Lord is one in spirit with him.
translation_verse: Ekama malɛ nɛ e ta mbe kumu n wɔtɔ Enyɛnpe na to, mbe kiyoyu nɛ Enyɛnpe na peya bee ki kukoŋwule nna.

english_verse: Don't be immoral in matters of sex. That is a sin against your own body in a way no other sin is.
translation_verse: Amoso, men baa gelge kesakalea be keji. Kulubi kama nɛ esa wora, e maa wora kumo a gbiti mbe eyur, ama ekama nɛ e bee ji kesakalea bee ji kumo nna a gbiti mo gbagba be eyur nna na.

english_verse: You surely know that your body is a temple where the Holy Spirit lives. The Spirit is in you and is a gift from God. You are no longer your own.
translation_verse: Men maŋ nyi fanɛ men be eyur ere la Kiyoyu Cheeŋ mo nɛ Ebɔrɛ ta mo n sa menyi nɛ e wɔ menyi to na be lambu nna a? Men maŋ wɔ men gbagba be amu nna.

english_verse: God paid a great price for you. So use your body to honor God.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, kukɔ damta nɛ Ebɔrɛ ka n tɔ menyi. Amoso, men ta men be eyurana ere a maŋkura Ebɔrɛ.

english_verse: Now I will answer the questions you asked in your letter. You asked, “Is it best for people not to marry?”
translation_verse: To, naniere men shin nɛ n sa menyi asheŋ nɛ men sibɛ ma na be afito. Nɛ esa baa maŋ ta eche, loŋ walɛ.

english_verse: A wife belongs to her husband instead of to herself, and a husband belongs to his wife instead of to himself.
translation_verse: Eche na be eyur maŋ la mo gbagba peya nna, ekul na e wɔ kumo. Loŋ koŋwule na nɛ enyɛn na gba be eyur maŋ la mo gbagba peya, eche na e wɔ kumo.

english_verse: In my opinion that is what should be done, though I don't know of anything the Lord said about this matter.
translation_verse: Asheŋ nɛ mee kaŋɛ ere maa ŋini fanɛ mee sa menyi mbra nna fanɛ men luri kakil to, ama m baa kaŋɛ nna fanɛ nɛ men wora loŋ, k maŋ lubi.

english_verse: My advice for the unmarried and for widows is that it is acceptable for them to remain single, just as I am.
translation_verse: Kusɔ nɛ ŋ kɔ nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ egbawu nɛ bekulponyɛnana nɛ bekulpocheana nde fanɛ nɛ b maŋ luri kakil to nsaa wɔtɔ le fanɛ ma gbagba e bɔ.

english_verse: But if you don't have enough self-control, then go ahead and get married. After all, it is better to marry than to burn with desire.
translation_verse: Ama nɛ fanɛ b maaŋ tiŋ bumo be amu, b luri kakil to, ŋkpal manɛ so, esa ka luri kakil to bɔ keche nɛ kenyɛn be kedi be kasha ka wɔ mo to a chɔɔ mo to.

english_verse: I instruct married couples to stay together, and this is exactly what the Lord himself taught. A wife who leaves her husband
translation_verse: Le be mbra ere malɛ nɛ mee ta a sa kakilwuraana, mannɛ ma e naa sa bumo, Enyɛnpe e naa sa bumo, a maŋ daga fanɛ eche ka yige mo kul.

english_verse: I don't know of anything else the Lord said about marriage. All I can do is to give you my own advice. If your wife isn't a follower of the Lord, but is willing to stay with you, don't divorce her.
translation_verse: Basa nɛ b ka malɛ kikɛ, le nɛ ŋ kɔ a kaŋɛ bumo, ma e naa kaŋɛ, mannɛ Enyɛnpe, fanɛ ekurgepo kama nɛ e kɔ eche mo nɛ e maŋ la eyirdapo, nɛ eche na bee sha mo nɛ mbe kebaawɔtɔ, ekurgepo na e sa maŋ kaŋ kini mo.

english_verse: If your husband isn't a follower, but is willing to stay with you, don't divorce him.
translation_verse: Eche kama malɛ nɛ e kɔ ekul mo nɛ e maŋ la eyirdapo, nɛ ekul na bee sha mo nɛ mbe kebaawɔtɔ, eche na e sa maŋ kaŋ kini mo.

english_verse: If your husband or wife isn't a follower of the Lord and decides to divorce you, then you should agree to it. You are no longer bound to that person. After all, God chose you and wants you to live at peace.
translation_verse: Ama nɛ fanɛ emo nɛ e maŋ yirda na gbagba lar bre, fo shin nɛ e baa yɔ. Loŋ be asheŋ na bre be mbra maa pɛ enyɛn mo nɛ e la eyirdapo ŋko eche mo nɛ e la eyirdapo. Ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ tre anyi nna nɛ an ba kaa wɔ kagbenewushi to.

english_verse: In every church I tell the people to stay as they were when the Lord Jesus chose them and God called them to be his own. Now I say the same thing to you.
translation_verse: Kusɔ nɛ k baa wɔtɔ e la fanɛ ekama e baa kɔ kebaawɔtɔ mo nɛ Enyɛnpe na ta n sa mo pɔɛŋ nɛ Ebɔrɛ tre mo na a yil to kpakpa. Kusɔ nɛ n sibɛ n nase a sa asɔriana na kikɛ nna na.

english_verse: Being circumcised or uncircumcised isn't really what matters. The important thing is to obey God's commands.
translation_verse: Nɛ b ku esa ŋko b maŋ ku mo, k maŋ la shɛŋ. Kusɔ nɛ k tir e la fanɛ men baa bɛ Ebɔrɛ be mmalga naseso so.

english_verse: So don't try to change what you were when God chose you.
translation_verse: Kanaŋkama nɛ ekama daa du pɔɛŋ nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ tre mo, e baa kraa du loŋ.

english_verse: Are you a slave? Don't let that bother you. But if you can win your freedom, you should.
translation_verse: Fo daa la kenya nna pɔɛŋ nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ tre fo ŋko? Sa maŋ shin nɛ k tir fo. Ama nɛ fo nya fo kumu be kesɔnyige be ekpa bre, fo lar kenyaya na to.

english_verse: When the Lord chooses slaves, they become his free people. And when he chooses free people, they become slaves of Christ.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, ekama nɛ e daa la kenya pɔɛŋ nɛ Enyɛnpe tre mo la Enyɛnpe be esa sɔnyigeso nna. Nɛ ekama malɛ nɛ e daa wɔ mbe kumu pɔɛŋ nɛ Ebɔrɛ tre mo e ki Kristo be kenya nna na.

english_verse: God paid a great price for you. So don't become slaves of anyone else.
translation_verse: Men baa nyi fanɛ kukɔ damta nɛ Ebɔrɛ ka n tɔ menyi. Amoso, men sa maŋ ki edimɛdi be anya.

english_verse: I don't know of anything the Lord said about people who have never been married. But I will tell you what I think. And you can trust me, because the Lord has treated me with kindness.
translation_verse: To, naniere men shin nɛ an keni bumo nɛ b maŋ naŋ luri kakil to na be asheŋ to. Enyɛnpe maŋ ta kamalga naseso nɛ k bee yɔ bumo be kaplɛa so n sa ma, ama meeŋ kaŋɛ menyi kusɔ nɛ ma nɛ n la esa nɛ baaŋ tiŋ n yirda ŋkpal Enyɛnpe na be kuwɔr so na gbagba be nfɛra bee kaŋɛ ma.

english_verse: We are now going through hard times, and I think it is best for you to stay as you are.
translation_verse: Ma nfɛra bee wora ma nna fanɛ ŋkpal naniere be kebaawɔtɔ nyaŋgraŋ ere so, esa maŋ luri kakil to, k bɔ.

english_verse: If you are married, stay married. If you are not married, don't try to get married.
translation_verse: Ekama nɛ e kɔ eche e sa maŋ kaŋ fin kakilgboŋi. Enyɛn kama malɛ nɛ e maŋ kɔ eche, e sa maŋ kaŋ fin eche n ta.

english_verse: It isn't wrong to marry, even if you have never been married before. But those who marry will have a lot of trouble, and I want to protect you from this.
translation_verse: Ama nɛ fo ta eche, mannɛ kulubi nɛ fo wora. Kasuŋgurbia kama malɛ nɛ e kil maŋ wora kulubi nna. Ama basa kama nɛ b luri kakil to beeŋ nya etɔrɔ ashi kebaawɔtɔ ere to, kumo alɛ be loŋ to nɛ mee sha kumɔlga menyi ashi to na.

english_verse: My friends, what I mean is that the Lord will soon come, and it won't matter if you are married or not.
translation_verse: Ŋ kurgepoana, kusɔ nɛ n de e la fanɛ, saŋɛ maŋ naa shi. Amoso, bekama nɛ b kɔ beche e baa wɔtɔ fanɛ bumo nɛ b maŋ kɔ beche.

english_verse: It won't make any difference how much good you are getting from this world or how much you like it. This world as we know it is now passing away.
translation_verse: Bekama malɛ nɛ b wɔ durnya ere to be asɔ be asheŋ woraso to, b baa wora amo ŋkaa maa shin nɛ amo be asheŋ e bɔlɔ bumo to, ŋkpal manɛ so, durnya ere be kananɛ k du ere bee choŋ nna na.

english_verse: But a married man has more worries. He must worry about the things of this world, because he wants to please his wife.
translation_verse: Ama enyɛn mo nɛ e kɔ eche bre be nfɛra wɔ durnya ere to be asheŋ to so nna nɛ e bee fɛ kananɛ e beeŋ wora n wora mbe eche be aparsheŋ

english_verse: So he is pulled in two directions. Unmarried women and women who have never been married worry only about pleasing the Lord, and they keep their bodies and minds pure. But a married woman worries about the things of this world, because she wants to please her husband.
translation_verse: nɛ mbe nfɛra bee wora mo anyɔnyɔ. Eche nɛ e maŋ kɔ ekul ŋko eche mo nɛ e maŋ nyi enyɛn be nfɛra wɔ Enyɛnpe be asheŋ to so nna nɛ e bee fɛ kananɛ e beeŋ wora n wora a du cheembi ashi mbe eyur nɛ mbe kiyoyu to be asheŋ. Ama eche kilpo be nfɛra wɔ durnya ere to be asheŋ to so nna a fɛ kananɛ e beeŋ wora n wora mo kul be aparsheŋ.

english_verse: What I am saying is for your own good—it isn't to limit your freedom. I want to help you to live right and to love the Lord above all else.
translation_verse: Men be kechɛto so so nɛ mee kaŋɛ asheŋ ere na, m maa sha fanɛ n nyaŋ menyi nna. M baa sha fanɛ men baa wora asɔ nɛ a niŋi nsaa bɔla ekpa nna a kɔ kagbene koŋwule be kasha a shuŋ Enyɛnpe ŋkaa maŋ naŋ ka mba ko.

english_verse: But suppose you are engaged to someone old enough to be married, and you want her so much that all you can think about is getting married. Then go ahead and marry. There is nothing wrong with that.
translation_verse: Enyɛn kama nɛ e bee fɛ fanɛ e maa wora asheŋ nɛ a daga mo nɛ mo jipo be nferinto nɛ eche na malɛ gba bee bel nɛ enyɛn na wu fanɛ a daga fanɛ e ta eche na, men shin nɛ e wora kusɔ nɛ e bee sha, mannɛ kulubi nna, men shin nɛ b ta abar.

english_verse: It is perfectly all right to marry, but it is better not to get married at all.
translation_verse: Amoso, esa kama nɛ e ta mo jipo wora kusɔ lela nna, ama emo nɛ e maŋ ta mo jipo, wora nɛnɛ a chɔ loŋ.

english_verse: A wife should stay married to her husband until he dies. Then she is free to marry again, but only to a man who is a follower of the Lord.
translation_verse: Eche kilpo mo kul baa wɔ ŋkpa to, e maŋ wɔ mbe kumu enyɛn na be kaman, ama nɛ enyɛn na baŋ wu bre e kɔ ekpa nɛ e kil enyɛn kama nɛ e bee sha, ama a daga fanɛ amo be kanyɛn na e baa la Enyɛnpe na peya.

english_verse: However, I think I am obeying God's Spirit when I say she would be happier to stay single.
translation_verse: Ma ere kutɔ, nɛ e chena loŋ e beeŋ baa kɔ kagbenefuli a chɔ e ka naŋ kil, ma alɛ bee tama fanɛ ŋ kɔ Ebɔrɛ be Kiyoyu na.

english_verse: In your letter you asked me about food offered to idols. All of us know something about this subject. But knowledge makes us proud of ourselves, while love makes us helpful to others.
translation_verse: To, naniere men shin nɛ an keni nlɔŋɛjibiana be asheŋ to. An nyi fanɛ an kikɛ kɔ kanyiasheŋ fanɛ kananɛ menyee kaŋɛ na. Kanyiasheŋ malɛ e naa shin nɛ esa bee maŋ mbe kumu so nɛ kasha malɛ bee shin nɛ esa bee yɔ anishito.

english_verse: In fact, people who think they know so much don't know anything at all.
translation_verse: Esa baa fɛ fanɛ e nyi kusɔ ko, kumo ere e maŋ naŋ pin kusɔ na to fanɛ kananɛ k daga fanɛ e baa nyi kumo.

english_verse: But God has no doubts about who loves him.
translation_verse: Ama ekama nɛ e bee sha Ebɔrɛ, kumo ere Ebɔrɛ nyi amodoŋwura.

english_verse: Even though food is offered to idols, we know that none of the idols in this world are alive. After all, there is only one God.
translation_verse: To, naniere an keni nlɔŋɛjibiana be asheŋ to. An baa nyi fanɛ kegbir la kusɔ nɛ k maŋ kɔ ŋkpa kumo to nna a wɔtɔ, anyi alɛ nseŋ naa nyi fanɛ Ebɔrɛ koŋwule e wɔtɔ, ekama maŋ naŋ ti mo so.

english_verse: Many things in heaven and on earth are called gods and lords, but none of them really are gods or lords.
translation_verse: Hale nɛ asɔ damta wɔ ebɔrɛso nɛ kasawule nɛ basa bee ta amo fanɛ bumo be ebɔrɛana gba, kumo alɛ la kashenteŋ nna fanɛ le be ebɔrɛ damtaana nɛ benyɛnpe damtaana wɔtɔ,

english_verse: We have only one God, and he is the Father. He created everything, and we live for him. Jesus Christ is our only Lord. Everything was made by him, and by him life was given to us.
translation_verse: ama anyi ere kutɔ Ebɔrɛ koŋwule e baa wɔtɔ, mo e la Etuto mo nɛ kusɔ kikɛ shi mo kutɔ, mo alɛ so nɛ an wɔtɔ na. Enyɛnpe koŋwule, Yesu Kristo na malɛ e wɔtɔ, mo nɛ Ebɔrɛ bɔla mo so n to kusɔ kikɛ mo alɛ nsaa sa anyi ŋkpa na.

english_verse: Not everyone knows these things. In fact, many people have grown up with the belief that idols have life in them. So when they eat meat offered to idols, they are bothered by a weak conscience.
translation_verse: Anyi alɛ nyi le be asheŋ ere, ama mannɛ ekama e kɔ le be kanyiasheŋ ere bre. Hale mbre, agbirshuŋ baŋ luri basa be nfɛra to nna ga nɛ baa fɛ fanɛ nɛ baa ji nlɔŋɛjibi, kegbir gbagba be ajibi nɛ baa ji. Bumo alɛ be nfɛra ka maŋ kɔ eleŋ so a maa dese bumo nsaa wora bumo fanɛ b luri eyurpi to nna na.

english_verse: But food doesn't bring us any closer to God. We are no worse off if we don't eat, and we are no better off if we do.
translation_verse: Ama ajibi maaŋ tiŋ n yɛr anyi Ebɔrɛ be anishito. Nɛ an baa maŋ ji, anyi maa paŋ shɛŋ Ebɔrɛ kutɔ nɛ anyi alɛ naŋ ji, anyi maa nya shɛŋ.

english_verse: Don't cause problems for someone with a weak conscience, just because you have the right to eat anything.
translation_verse: Ama men baa da so nɛ le be kamooji mo nɛ men kɔ ere e sa maŋ shin nɛ bumo nɛ b maŋ kɔ eleŋ yirda na to na e tɔr alubi to.

english_verse: You know all this, and so it doesn't bother you to eat in the temple of an idol. But suppose a person with a weak conscience sees you and decides to eat food that has been offered to idols.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, esa nɛ e maŋ kɔ eleŋ baŋ wu fo nɛ fo kɔ le be kanyiasheŋ ere ka tase kegbir ko be lambu to a ji nɛ amodoŋwura na be nfɛra maŋ kɔ eleŋ, kusɔ nɛ e wu na maaŋ leŋ mo to nɛ e baa ji nlɔŋɛjibi a?

english_verse: When you sin by hurting a follower with a weak conscience, you sin against Christ.
translation_verse: Nɛ fo alɛ baa wora kulubi a da fo niopibiana so le a doro bumo be ŋgbene pɔsoana, fee wora kulubi nna a da Kristo so nna na.

english_verse: So if I hurt one of the Lord's followers by what I eat, I will never eat meat as long as I live.
translation_verse: Amoso, nɛ ajibi baa la asɔ nɛ a bee shin nɛ n niopibi bee tɔr, kumo ere m maaŋ naŋ we eblaŋ kikɛ, saŋɛ na so m maaŋ shin nɛ n niopibi na e tɔr.

english_verse: Others may think that I am not an apostle, but you are proof that I am an apostle to you.
translation_verse: Nɛ m maŋ la beko be eshuŋipo gba, emɔrɔ maŋ wɔtɔ fanɛ n la menyi alɛ be eshuŋipo. Ŋkpal manɛ so, menyi e la ma kebaa la eshuŋipo be tɔɔnɛ ashi Enyɛnpe na to.

english_verse: that Barnabas and I have the right to our food and drink.
translation_verse: Anyi maŋ kɔ ekpa fanɛ basa e sa anyi ajibi nɛ asɔnuuso nna ŋkpal anyi be kushuŋ ere so a?

english_verse: We each have the right to marry one of the Lord's followers and to take her along with us, just as the other apostles and the Lord's brothers and Peter do.
translation_verse: Ma alɛ maŋ kɔ ekpa nna nɛ ŋ kil ebɛsopoche ko n ta mo m bɛ anyi so fanɛ kananɛ Enyɛnpe mo sipoana nɛ Sifas nɛ beshuŋipo mo nɛ b ka na bee wora na a?

english_verse: Are we the only ones who have to support ourselves by working at another job?
translation_verse: Ŋko ma nɛ Baanabas nawule e daga fanɛ an baa shuŋ a ji?

english_verse: Do soldiers pay their own salaries? Don't people who raise grapes eat some of what they grow? Don't shepherds get milk from their own goats?
translation_verse: Soja mo gbagba e naa ka mo gbagba be kumu ashi kushuŋ na to? Esa mo e naa duu ndibi sɔrso nɛ a baa wora nɛ e maaŋ ji amo be asɔrso na? Esa mo e naaŋ baa keni ana so ŋkaa maaŋ baa nyaŋ amo kenyipo?

english_verse: I am not saying this on my own authority. The Law of Moses tells us not to muzzle an ox when it is grinding grain. But was God concerned only about an ox?
translation_verse: B sibɛ anebi Mosis be mbra na to fanɛ: “Sa maŋ kaŋ kre kena mo nɛ k bee shuŋ ajibi to be kɔnɔ.” To, ana be asheŋ e tir Ebɔrɛ a?

english_verse: No, he wasn't! He was talking about us. This was written in the Scriptures so that all who plow and all who grind the grain will look forward to sharing in the harvest.
translation_verse: Mannɛ anyi nawule so e shin nɛ e daŋ malga loŋ a? Kashenteŋto, anyi so nɛ e daŋ shin nɛ b sibɛ loŋ na, ŋkpal manɛ so, edɔpo nɛ eteŋipo kikɛ daga fanɛ b baa tama kenya adɔjibi na be ako.

english_verse: When we told the message to you, it was like planting spiritual seed. So we have the right to accept material things as our harvest from you.
translation_verse: Nɛ an bar abɔrɛsheŋ m baa wɔtɔ menyi to fanɛ kananɛ eduupo bee duu asɔ duuso na, k la tɔrɔ gboŋgboŋi nna ga fanɛ an nya asɔ ashi menyi kutɔ a?

english_verse: If others have the right to do this, we have an even greater right. But we haven't used this right of ours. We are willing to put up with anything to keep from causing trouble for the message about Christ.
translation_verse: Nɛ beko baa kɔ ekpa fanɛ b baa nya le be kechɛto ashi menyi kutɔ, a maŋ daga fanɛ an baa kɔ loŋ be ekpa a chɔ bumo a? Ama anyi alɛ daa maŋ ŋini loŋ be ekpa nɛ an kɔ na. An daŋ ji kanyiti ashi kusɔ kama to nna, saŋɛ na so anyi maaŋ shin nɛ shɛŋ shɛŋ e kagle Kristo be baru lela na ekpa.

english_verse: Don't you know that people who work in the temple make their living from what is brought to the temple? Don't you know that a person who serves at the altar is given part of what is offered?
translation_verse: Men maŋ nyi fanɛ basa nɛ baa shuŋ bɔrɛlambu to bee nya bumo be keji nna ashi bɔrɛlambu na to nɛ bumo nɛ baa shuŋ bɔrɛsure akpa na malɛ gba bee nya bumo be kachige ashi asɔ nɛ baa ta a lara esarga na to a?

english_verse: In the same way, the Lord wants everyone who preaches the good news to make a living from preaching this message.
translation_verse: To, loŋ koŋwule na nna nɛ Enyɛnpe nase kumo fanɛ a daga fanɛ bumo nɛ baa bɔ Baru Lela na e baa nya bumo be kusɔ jiso ashi baru lela na be kebɔ to.

english_verse: But I have never used these privileges of mine, and I am not writing this because I want to start now. I would rather die than have someone rob me of the right to take pride in this.
translation_verse: Ama ma alɛ daa maŋ ŋini ekpa nɛ ŋ kɔ ana ere be kekama, ma alɛ maŋ naa sibɛ naniere nna a sa menyi nɛ n nya loŋ be kechɛto na. Cha, nɛ n wu gba k bɔ ŋ ka shin nɛ esa e nya ekpa m mɔn ma ashi kepuchi to.

english_verse: I don't have any reason to brag about preaching the good news. Preaching is something God told me to do, and if I don't do it, I am doomed.
translation_verse: Ama m maŋ kɔ ekpa bre nɛ ŋ kpal ŋ ka bee bɔ Baru Lela na so m puchi, ŋkpal manɛ so, k la katiŋ nna fanɛ m bɔ Baru Lela na. Nɛ ma alɛ maŋ bɔ Baru Lela na, asheŋ maaŋ nyalɛ n sa ma kikɛ.

english_verse: If I preach because I want to, I will be paid. But even if I don't want to, it is still something God has sent me to do.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, nɛ fanɛ mee wora loŋ nna ŋkpal ma alɛ gbagba be keparso, n daa beeŋ baa kɔ kakɔka, ama nɛ k maŋ la fanɛ ŋ gbagba be kepar be asheŋ so nɛ mee wora kumo, kumo ere kusɔ nɛ b ta m bɔɔ ma enɔ nɛ mee wora.

english_verse: What pay am I given? It is the chance to preach the good news free of charge and not to use the privileges that are mine because I am a preacher.
translation_verse: To, nɛ manɛ e la ma tɔɔnɛ? Kumo nde jia: Mee bɔ kubɔya na nna nɛ n tiŋ n ta kumo n sa basa ŋkaa maaŋ sɔ bumo shɛŋ, saŋɛ na so m maaŋ ta ekpa mo nɛ ŋ kɔ ana ere a ji ashi kushuŋ na to.

english_verse: I am not anyone's slave. But I have become a slave to everyone, so I can win as many people as possible.
translation_verse: N wɔ ma kumu nna a maŋ la esa kikɛ be kenya, ama n ta ma kumu nna ŋ ki kenya a sa ekama, saŋɛ na so meeŋ nya basa damta n ti so nɛ b ba pin Ebɔrɛ.

english_verse: And when I am with people who are not ruled by the Law, I forget about the Law to win them. Of course, I never really forget about the law of God. In fact, I am ruled by the law of Christ.
translation_verse: Nɛ ma nɛ bumo nɛ b maŋ wɔ anebi Mosis be mbra na to baa la n wɔtɔ nna fanɛ esa nɛ e maŋ wɔ mbra na to, mannɛ fanɛ m maa bɛ Ebɔrɛ be kɔnɔ so nna, n wɔ Kristo be mbra to nna, saŋɛ na so meeŋ nya bumo nɛ b maŋ wɔ mbra na to gba n wɔtɔ Yesu be kebɛso to n ti so.

english_verse: I do all this for the good news, because I want to share in its blessings. A Race and a Fight
translation_verse: Mee wora asheŋ ere kikɛ nna ŋkpal baru lela na so so, saŋɛ na so, ma alɛ gba beeŋ nya kumo be enɛfa na be ako.

english_verse: You know that many runners enter a race, and only one of them wins the prize. So run to win!
translation_verse: Men maŋ nyi fanɛ eshile kikɛ to beshilepo na kikɛ bee shile nna, ama esa koŋwule e naa kaa ji kɔŋkɔŋ a? Men baa shile nɛnɛ, saŋɛ na so menyeeŋ nya kɔŋkɔŋ n ji.

english_verse: I keep my body under control and make it my slave, so I won't lose out after telling the good news to others.
translation_verse: Ama mee kaa kɔrfɛ ma eyur nna a shin nɛ k bee nu a sa ma, nɛ mannɛ aloŋ, meeŋ bɔ kubɔya na n sa basa nɛ ma alɛ gbagba e paŋ kɔŋkɔŋ na be keji.

english_verse: Friends, I want to remind you that all our ancestors walked under the cloud and went through the sea.
translation_verse: Bekurgepoana, mee sha fanɛ men pin fanɛ kuwɔlpa daŋ juŋkpar an tutoana kikɛ nna nɛ bumo kikɛ daŋ bɔla teku na so n choŋ.

english_verse: All of them also ate the same spiritual food
translation_verse: Bumo kikɛ daŋ ji kejibi koŋwule mo nɛ k daŋ shi Ebɔrɛ kutɔ na,

english_verse: and drank the same spiritual drink, which flowed from the spiritual rock that followed them. That rock was Christ.
translation_verse: nseŋ daŋ nuu asɔnuuso koŋwule mo nɛ a daŋ shi Ebɔrɛ kutɔ na. Kefalta mo nɛ kumo nɛ bumo daa na na kutɔ nɛ b daŋ nuu amo. Kefalta na e la Kristo na.

english_verse: But most of them did not please God. So they died, and their bodies were scattered all over the desert.
translation_verse: Ama bumo be galeŋga be asheŋ daa maŋ par Ebɔrɛ, amoso, e daŋ shin nɛ bumo be eyurana pesaŋ m pesaŋ to nna n dese kiyi na to.

english_verse: They worshiped idols, just as the Scriptures say, “The people sat down to eat and drink. Then they got up to dance around.” So don't worship idols.
translation_verse: Men sa maŋ kaa la agbirshumpoana fanɛ kananɛ bumo be beko daa la na. Loŋ malɛ nɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ na fanɛ: “Basa na daŋ chena nna n ji nseŋ nuu nseŋ koso n cha.”

english_verse: And don't try to test Christ, as some of them did and were later bitten by poisonous snakes.
translation_verse: A maŋ daga fanɛ an wora Enyɛnpe na ŋ keni fanɛ kananɛ bumo be beko daŋ wora nɛ awɔ daŋ duŋ n duŋ bumo m mɔ na.

english_verse: Don't even grumble, as some of them did and were killed by the destroying angel.
translation_verse: Men sa maa bile asheŋ fanɛ kananɛ bumo be beko daŋ wora nɛ malaika mɔpo na daŋ mur bumo na.

english_verse: These things happened to them as a warning to us. All this was written in the Scriptures to teach us who live in these last days.
translation_verse: Asheŋ ere kikɛ daŋ wora bumo nna nɛ an pin kusɔ nɛ k wɔtɔ. B sibɛ amo n nase malɛ nna nɛ a baa fiɛ anyi so, ŋkpal manɛ so, jemanɛ mo nɛ an wɔtɔ ere bee fo durnya be ekar nna na.

english_verse: Even if you think you can stand up to temptation, be careful not to fall.
translation_verse: Amoso, ekama nɛ e bee fɛ fanɛ e yil kpakpa na e baa da so nsaa maŋ kaŋ tɔr.

english_verse: My friends, you must keep away from idols.
translation_verse: Amoso ma beshapo, men baa gelge kagbirshuŋ.

english_verse: I am speaking to you as people who have enough sense to know what I am talking about.
translation_verse: Mee malga menyi kutɔ nna fanɛ benyiashempo, amoso, men gbagba e fɛ asheŋ nɛ mee malga ere be nfɛra ŋ keni.

english_verse: By sharing in the same loaf of bread, we become one body, even though there are many of us.
translation_verse: Bodobodo na bee kaa la kukoŋwule nna nɛ anyi basa damta bee tu abar a we kumo, amoso, an la eyur koŋwule to ebi nna.

english_verse: Aren't the people of Israel sharing in the worship when they gather around the altar and eat the sacrifices offered there?
translation_verse: Men fɛ Israɛlebi be asheŋ ŋ keni. Men maŋ nyi fanɛ bekama nɛ b ji esarga mo nɛ b lara n sa Ebɔrɛ ashi bɔrɛsure na so wɔ bumo nɛ Ebɔrɛ be kɔnɔkoŋwuleso be kebaawɔtɔ to nna ŋkpal bɔrɛsure na so a?

english_verse: Am I saying that either the idols or the food sacrificed to them is anything at all?
translation_verse: To, nuso nɛ mee ber ere, fanɛ kalɔŋɛjibi e la kusɔ ko ŋko kegbir bre e la kusɔ ko?

english_verse: No, I am not! This food is really sacrificed to demons and not to God. I don't want you to have anything to do with demons.
translation_verse: Ayai, kusɔ nɛ mee ŋini e la fanɛ esarga mo nɛ basa nɛ b maŋ nyi Ebɔrɛ bee kaa lara na, la asɔ nɛ baa ta a sa alizinaana nna, mannɛ Ebɔrɛ nɛ baa ta a sa. Ma alɛ maa sha fanɛ menyi nɛ alizinaana e baa kɔ kɔnɔkoŋwule a wora asheŋ.

english_verse: You cannot drink from the cup of demons and still drink from the Lord's cup. You cannot eat at the table of demons and still eat at the Lord's table.
translation_verse: Men maaŋ tiŋ n nuu asɔnuuso ashi Enyɛnpe be kawiebi na to nseŋ naŋ tiŋ n nuu alizinaana peya to. Men maaŋ tiŋ n nya kakpa n chena Enyɛnpe be ejikpa n ji nseŋ naŋ nya kakpa n chena alizinaana be ejikpa n ji.

english_verse: We would make the Lord jealous if we did this. And we are not stronger than the Lord. Always Honor God
translation_verse: Ŋko anyee sha fanɛ an wɔtɔ Enyɛnpe kayurbesa to nna ŋ keni? Anyi e chɔ mo eleŋ a? Kananɛ eyirdapo wɔ mbe kumu be asheŋ

english_verse: However, when you buy meat in the market, go ahead and eat it. Keep your conscience clear by not asking where the meat came from.
translation_verse: Kusɔ kama nɛ baa fa eblaŋ be kebɛ to, men ji nsaa maa bishi asheŋ ŋkpal shika be nfɛra nɛ men kɔ so.

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “The earth and everything in it belong to the Lord.”
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so: “Kasawule ere nɛ kusɔ kama nɛ k wɔ kumo so ere kikɛ la Enyɛnpe na peya nna.”

english_verse: If an unbeliever invites you to dinner, and you want to go, then go. Eat whatever you are served. Don't cause a problem for someone's conscience by asking where the food came from.
translation_verse: Nɛ esa nɛ e maŋ la eyirdapo tre fo fanɛ fo ba ji nɛ fo shuli n yɔ, ya ji kusɔ kama nɛ b ta n yili fo anishito nsaa maŋ bishi asheŋ ŋkpal shika be nfɛra mo nɛ fo kɔ so.

english_verse: But if you are told it has been sacrificed to idols, don't cause a problem by eating it. I don't mean a problem for yourself, but for the one who told you. Why should my freedom be limited by someone else's conscience?
translation_verse: Esa nɛ e kaŋɛ fo na be shika nɛ n de na, mannɛ fo alɛ gbagba peya, ŋkpal manɛ so, manɛ so nɛ mee shin nɛ esa pɔtɛ be shika be nfɛra bee keni ma kamooji be asheŋ to?

english_verse: If I give thanks for what I eat, why should anyone accuse me of doing wrong?
translation_verse: Nɛ m baŋ chɔrɔ Ebɔrɛ ŋkpal ma ajibi so, manɛ so nɛ esa naa malga a gbiti ma ŋkpal ajibi mo nɛ n chɔrɔ Ebɔrɛ nsaa ji so so?

english_verse: When you eat or drink or do anything else, always do it to honor God.
translation_verse: Amoso, nɛ fee ji ŋko fee nuu nna ŋko kusɔ kama nɛ fee wora, wora amo kikɛ nɛ Ebɔrɛ e nya kemaŋkura.

english_verse: Don't cause problems for Jews or Greeks or anyone else who belongs to God's church.
translation_verse: Sa maŋ kaŋ shin nɛ fo kebaawɔtɔ e shin nɛ Juw be esa kama ŋko Griik be esa kama ŋko Ebɔrɛ be asɔri na to be ekama e tɔr.

english_verse: You must follow my example, as I follow the example of Christ. Rules for Worship
translation_verse: Amoso, men baa kute ma to fanɛ kananɛ mee kute Kristo to na. Kebaabuu kumu so ashi asɔri to be asheŋ

english_verse: I am proud of you, because you always remember me and obey the teachings I gave you.
translation_verse: Saŋkikɛ mee chɔrɔ menyi nna ŋkpal men ka bee nyiŋi ma kusɔ kama to nɛ kananɛ men baa kɔ keŋini mo nɛ n ta n sa menyi na to so.

english_verse: Now I want you to know that Christ is the head of all men, and a man is the head of a woman. But God is the head of Christ.
translation_verse: Ama mee sha nna nɛ men pin fanɛ enyɛn kama be kumu e la Kristo, nɛ eche malɛ be kumu la enyɛn nɛ Kristo malɛ be kumu la Ebɔrɛ.

english_verse: This means that any man who prays or prophesies with something on his head brings shame to his head.
translation_verse: Amoso, enyɛn kama nɛ e bee ta kusɔ a buu mbe kumu so nsaa kule Ebɔrɛ ŋko nsaa wu abɔrɛsheŋ to a malga basa to bee ŋaba mbe kumu nna na.

english_verse: But any woman who prays or prophesies without something on her head brings shame to her head. In fact, she may as well shave her head.
translation_verse: Ama eche kama malɛ nɛ e bee kule Ebɔrɛ ŋko a wu abɔrɛsheŋ to a malga basa to nsaa maa ta shɛŋ a chɛ kumu bee ŋaba mbe kumu nna na. K baa du fanɛ b ka kpasa mbe kumu nna.

english_verse: A woman should wear something on her head. It is a disgrace for a woman to shave her head or cut her hair. But if she refuses to wear something on her head, let her cut off her hair.
translation_verse: Nɛ eche baa maa ta shɛŋ a chɛ kumu, kumo ere a daga fanɛ e shin nɛ b she mo. Ama nɛ fanɛ keshɛ eche na ŋko kekpesa mo so bee keta mo anishinyɔr bre, kumo ere amo be kache na e baa ta kusɔ a chɛ mbe kumu.

english_verse: Men were created to be like God and to bring honor to God. This means a man should not wear anything on his head. Women were created to bring honor to men.
translation_verse: A maŋ daga enyɛn bre ka ta kusɔ ko m buu mbe kumu so, ŋkpal manɛ so, e la Ebɔrɛ be kaduli nɛ Ebɔrɛ be kemaŋkura nna. Ama eche bre la enyɛn be kemaŋkura nna.

english_verse: It was the woman who was made from a man, and not the man who was made from a woman.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, mannɛ enyɛn e shi eche to, eche e shi enyɛn to.

english_verse: He wasn't created for her. She was created for him.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ malɛ maŋ pɔr enyɛn nna n sa eche, e pɔr eche nna n sa enyɛn.

english_verse: And so, because of this, and also because of the angels, a woman ought to wear something on her head, as a sign of her authority.
translation_verse: Amoso, a daga fanɛ eche e baa ta kusɔ a chɛ mbe kumu a ŋini fanɛ e wɔ mo kul be kaseto nna ŋkpal emalaika so.

english_verse: As far as the Lord is concerned, men and women need each other.
translation_verse: Ama men baa nyiŋi fanɛ Enyɛnpe na to, nɛ enyɛn maŋ wɔtɔ, eche maŋ la shɛŋ, nɛ eche malɛ maŋ wɔtɔ, enyɛn maŋ la shɛŋ.

english_verse: It is true that the first woman came from a man, but all other men have been given birth by women. Yet God is the one who created everything.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, kananɛ eche baŋ shi enyɛn to na, loŋ koŋwule na nɛ eche bee kurge enyɛn. Ama kusɔ kama malɛ shi Ebɔrɛ kutɔ nna.

english_verse: Ask yourselves if it is proper for a woman to pray without something on her head.
translation_verse: Menyi alɛ gbagba e keni kesheŋ ere to, a daga fanɛ eche e baa kule Ebɔrɛ basa to ŋkaa maŋ ta shɛŋ n chɛ kumu a?

english_verse: This is how things are done in all of God's churches, and this is why none of you should argue about what I have said. Rules for the Lord's Supper
translation_verse: To, kusɔ nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ ere, nɛ esa kama nɛ e bee sha keji kumo emɔrɔ, kusɔ nɛ mee kaŋɛ amodoŋwura e la fanɛ kusɔ nɛ anyi nɛ Ebɔrɛ be asɔriana na to ebi kikɛ bee bɛ so nna na. Enyɛnpe be daŋkarejibi be asheŋ

english_verse: Your worship services do you more harm than good. I am certainly not going to praise you for this.
translation_verse: Le be kesheŋ ŋini ere bre to, m maŋ kɔ kechɔrɔ kama a sa menyi, ŋkpal manɛ so, men be nshɛrana to kejija e wɔtɔ, kelɔŋɛ maŋ wɔtɔ.

english_verse: I am told you can't get along with each other when you worship, and I am sure that some of what I have heard is true.
translation_verse: Kusɔ nɛ k juŋkpar nde: N nu fanɛ men baŋ shɛr fanɛ asɔri, men kɔ kebargatoana nna menyi to, ma alɛ yirda kumo ashi ekpa ko so.

english_verse: You are bound to argue with each other, but it is easy to see which of you have God's approval.
translation_verse: Kumo alɛ la kashenteŋ nna fanɛ menyeeŋ baa kɔr abar to, saŋɛ na so, loŋ beeŋ shin nɛ basa e pin bumo nɛ b yil to nɛnɛ.

english_verse: You even start eating before everyone gets to the meeting, and some of you go hungry, while others get drunk.
translation_verse: ŋkpal manɛ so, men ka bee kaa ji na, ekama baa ji mo peya nna a maŋ naa jo esa kama. Amoso, beko wɔ akoŋ to nna nɛ beko malɛ nuu nsa m boo.

english_verse: The Lord meant that when you eat this bread and drink from this cup, you tell about his death until he comes.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, saŋkama nɛ menyee we bodobodo ere nsaa nuu kawiebi ere to be asɔ, menyee kute Enyɛnpe na be luwu be asheŋ to nna na hale n ya fo saŋɛ nɛ e beeŋ ya ba na.

english_verse: If you fail to understand that you are the body of the Lord, you will condemn yourselves by the way you eat and drink.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, ekama nɛ e ji kejibi na nseŋ nuu asɔnuuso na ashi kawiebi na to nsaa maŋ nyi kusɔ nɛ eyur na bee ŋini, bee ji nna nsaa nuu kasogberge a sa mbe kumu nna na.

english_verse: After the meal, Jesus took a cup of wine in his hands and said, “This is my blood, and with it God makes his new agreement with you. Drink this and remember me.”
translation_verse: B ka ji n loge nɛ e ta kawiebi na malɛ n wora kananɛ e daŋ wora na ŋ kaŋɛ: “Kawiebi ere e la Ebɔrɛ nɛ dimɛdi be ŋkre popɔr ŋkpal ma ŋklaŋ so na. Men baa wora loŋ saŋkikɛ nɛ menyee nuu asɔrso be asɔnuuso ashi kumo to na a nyiŋi ma.”

english_verse: I have already told you what the Lord Jesus did on the night he was betrayed. And it came from the Lord himself. He took some bread in his hands.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, kusɔ nɛ n nya ashi Enyɛnpe kutɔ nɛ ma alɛ gba bee ta a sa menyi na fanɛ: Kanyɛ mo nɛ b daŋ debɔr Enyɛnpe Yesu na, e daŋ ta bodobodo nna

english_verse: Then after he had given thanks, he broke it and said, “This is my body, which is given for you. Eat this and remember me.”
translation_verse: n chɔrɔ Ebɔrɛ n loge nseŋ bu kumo to nseŋ kaŋɛ: “Ma eyur nɛ ŋ kɔ a sa menyi nde, men baa wora kesheŋ ere a nyiŋi ma.”

english_verse: But if you eat the bread and drink the wine in a way that isn't worthy of the Lord, you sin against his body and blood.
translation_verse: Amoso, ekama nɛ e we Enyɛnpe be bodobodo na nseŋ nuu asɔrso be asɔnuuso na ekpa nɛ k maŋ daga so, wora alubi nna ŋ gbiti Enyɛnpe be eyur nɛ mbe ŋklaŋ na nna na.

english_verse: This is why many of you are sick and weak and why a lot of others have died.
translation_verse: Amoso nɛ menyi to be bedamta maŋ kɔ eleŋ nsaa lɔ nɛ menyi be beko malɛ gba wu na.

english_verse: If we carefully judge ourselves, we won't be punished.
translation_verse: Ama nɛ an baŋ keni anyi gbagba be ŋgbene to nɛnɛ bre, anyi maaŋ luri demuji kama to.

english_verse: But when the Lord judges and punishes us, he does it to keep us from being condemned with the rest of the world.
translation_verse: Ama nɛ Enyɛnpe na baŋ sa anyi kasogberge n niŋi anyi ekpa, e bee wora loŋ nna, saŋɛ na so, e maaŋ ta anyi n ti durnyaebi so m mur.

english_verse: My dear friends, you should wait until everyone gets there before you start eating.
translation_verse: Amoso, ŋ kurgepoana, men baŋ ba nɛ men ba tu abar n ji, men baa jo abar.

english_verse: If you really are hungry, you can eat at home. Then you won't condemn yourselves when you meet together. After I arrive, I will instruct you about the other matters.
translation_verse: Ekama nɛ akoŋ kɔ, amodoŋwura e ji epe, saŋɛ na so, men baŋ ba shɛr abar so, kumo be lalaloge maaŋ bar kasogberge. To, asheŋ nɛ a ka na bre, ŋ kaŋ ba, meeŋ ŋini menyi amo alɛ be afito.

english_verse: I want you to remember that before you became followers of the Lord, you were led in all the wrong ways by idols that cannot even talk.
translation_verse: Men nyi fanɛ saŋɛ nɛ men daa maŋ nyi Ebɔrɛ na, Setani e daŋ fuli menyi ekpa kama nɛ men daŋ bɔla so nɛ men bɛ agbir nɛ a la asɔ wuso na so.

english_verse: Now I want you to know that if you are led by God's Spirit, you will say that Jesus is Lord, and you will never curse Jesus.
translation_verse: Amoso, mee sha fanɛ men pin fanɛ esa kikɛ nɛ e kɔ Ebɔrɛ be Kiyoyu na maaŋ tiŋ ŋ kaŋɛ le: “Kɔnɔso e baa wɔ Yesu so!” Esa kikɛ malɛ maaŋ tiŋ ŋ kaŋɛ: “Yesu e la Enyɛnpe” ama Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na e shin nɛ e kaŋɛ loŋ.

english_verse: There are different kinds of spiritual gifts, but they all come from the same Spirit.
translation_verse: Kiyoyu to be ŋkɛ be nnaŋ to e wɔtɔ, ama Kiyoyu koŋwule na e naa sa amo kikɛ.

english_verse: There are different ways to serve the same Lord,
translation_verse: Ashuŋ be nnaŋ to damta nɛ Enyɛnpe ta m bɔɔ mbe basa enɔ, ama Enyɛnpe koŋwule e wɔtɔ.

english_verse: and we can each do different things. Yet the same God works in all of us and helps us in everything we do.
translation_verse: Ekpa be nnaŋ to damtaana so nɛ basa bee bɔla a shuŋ, ama Ebɔrɛ koŋwule na e kɔ amo a wɔ basa to a shuŋ.

english_verse: The Spirit has given each of us a special way of serving others.
translation_verse: Kiyoyu na bee bɔla ekpa pɔtɛana so nna a lara mbe kumu a ŋini ekama nɛ mbe basa kikɛ e nya kechɛto,

english_verse: Some of us can speak with wisdom, while others can speak with knowledge, but these gifts come from the same Spirit.
translation_verse: Kiyoyu na bee kaa sa esa ko kanyiasheŋ be kamalga be kakɛ nna ŋkaa sa eko malɛ nfɛra mo nɛ a shi mo gbagba kutɔ nɛ e malga be kakɛ.

english_verse: To others the Spirit has given great faith or the power to heal the sick
translation_verse: Kiyoyu koŋwule na malɛ gbagba e naa sa eko malɛ yirda fanɛ Ebɔrɛ beeŋ wora kusɔ ko be kakɛ nseŋ sa esa ko malɛ kakɛ nɛ e baa chɛ basa.

english_verse: But it is the Spirit who does all this and decides which gifts to give to each of us. One Body with Many Parts
translation_verse: Ade malɛ kikɛ Kiyoyu koŋwule na gbagba e naa sa amo, mo e naa sa basa ŋkɛ na be kekama kanaŋkamaso nɛ e bee sha. Eyur koŋwule nɛ kumo be mba damta be asheŋ

english_verse: Some of us are Jews, and others are Gentiles. Some of us are slaves, and others are free. But God's Spirit baptized each of us and made us part of the body of Christ. Now we each drink from that same Spirit.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, Kiyoyu koŋwule na e shin nɛ anyi kikɛ, Juwebi ŋko Griikebi, anya ŋko bumo nɛ b wɔ bumo be amu kikɛ nyam bɔla kabɔrɛbɛr so ŋ ki eyur koŋwule to ebi nyam nɛ anyi kikɛ ba nya Kiyoyu koŋwule na.

english_verse: Our bodies don't have just one part. They have many parts.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, eyur na maŋ la kaba koŋwule nna, mba damta nna.

english_verse: Suppose a foot says, “I'm not a hand, and so I'm not part of the body.” Wouldn't the foot still belong to the body?
translation_verse: Nɛ eyur be keya baŋ kaŋɛ le: “Ŋkpal ŋ ka maŋ la enɔ so so, m maŋ la eyur na be kaba,” loŋ maaŋ tiŋ n shin nɛ k sa maŋ naa la eyur na be kaba.

english_verse: Or suppose an ear says, “I'm not an eye, and so I'm not part of the body.” Wouldn't the ear still belong to the body?
translation_verse: Nɛ kusoe baŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ: “Ŋkpal ŋ ka maŋ la kenishi so, m maŋ la eyur na be kaba,” loŋ maaŋ tiŋ n shin nɛ k sa maŋ naa la eyur na be kaba.

english_verse: If our bodies were only an eye, we couldn't hear a thing. And if they were only an ear, we couldn't smell a thing.
translation_verse: To, nɛ eyur ere kikɛ daa la kenishi nna, nnɛ nɛ kenu daa beeŋ baa wɔ? Ŋko nɛ eyur ere kikɛ daa la kusoe nna, nnɛ nɛ efɛa be kenu daa beeŋ baa wɔ?

english_verse: But God has put all parts of our body together in the way that he decided is best.
translation_verse: Ama kananɛ k du ere Ebɔrɛ ta eyur be kaba kama nna n wɔtɔ eyur na to kananɛ e bee sha fanɛ a baa du.

english_verse: A body isn't really a body, unless there is more than one part.
translation_verse: Nɛ amo kikɛ daa la kaba koŋwule nna, nuso nɛ eyur na daa beeŋ baa du?

english_verse: It takes many parts to make a single body.
translation_verse: Ama kananɛ k du ere, mba damta e wɔtɔ, ama eyur koŋwule malɛ nna.

english_verse: That's why the eyes cannot say they don't need the hands. That's also why the head cannot say it doesn't need the feet.
translation_verse: Kenishi maaŋ tiŋ ŋ kaŋɛ enɔ le: “M maa sha fo kechɛto.” Kumu malɛ maaŋ tiŋ ŋ kaŋɛ ayadra le: “M maa sha men be kechɛto.”

english_verse: In fact, we cannot get along without the parts of the body that seem to be the weakest.
translation_verse: Ama nɛ fo keni to, feeŋ wu fanɛ eyur ere be mba nɛ a pɔ ga a chɔ mba nɛ a ka na e daga anyi.

english_verse: We take special care to dress up some parts of our bodies. We are modest about our personal parts,
translation_verse: Mba mo nɛ anyee kaa fɛ fanɛ a maŋ la shɛŋ na malɛ nɛ anyee kaa ta bunyaŋ damta a sa. Mba mo nɛ a maŋ walɛ kenishiso na malɛ nɛ anyee kaa keni so nɛnɛ.

english_verse: but we don't have to be modest about other parts. God put our bodies together in such a way that even the parts that seem the least important are valuable.
translation_verse: An be mba mo nɛ a walɛ kenishiso na bre maŋ daga le be kekeniso ere. Ebɔrɛ gbagba e ta eyur be mba kikɛ n chɔga abar so nɛ e ta bunyaŋ n sa mba mo nɛ a maŋ kɔ bunyaŋ amo gbagba be amu so na.

english_verse: He did this to make all parts of the body work together smoothly, with each part caring about the others.
translation_verse: Saŋɛ na so kebarga to kama maaŋ baa wɔ eyur na to, ama mbaana na kikɛ beeŋ baa kɔ kagbene koŋwule a keni abar so.

english_verse: If one part of our body hurts, we hurt all over. If one part of our body is honored, the whole body will be happy.
translation_verse: Eyur na be kaba koŋwule baa wu ebesa, eyur na kikɛ bee wu ebesa nna, kaba koŋwule malɛ baa nya bunyaŋ, mba na kikɛ bee nya kagbenefuli nna.

english_verse: Together you are the body of Christ. Each one of you is part of his body.
translation_verse: To, menyi e la Kristo be eyur na nsaa la kumo be mba kukoko to.

english_verse: First, God chose some people to be apostles and prophets and teachers for the church. But he also chose some to work miracles or heal the sick or help others or be leaders or speak different kinds of languages.
translation_verse: Asɔri na to, basa nɛ Ebɔrɛ juŋkpar n lara e la beshuŋipo, bumo nɛ b bɛ so e la abɔrɛsheŋ be bewuŋkaŋɛpo, besasopo e la beŋinipo, n ta emamachishumpoana m bɛ so, n ta bechɛpo nɛ bechɛtopo nɛ bumo nɛ baa keni ashuŋ be asheŋ to so m bɛ so nseŋ ta bumo nɛ baa gbar ŋgbar mo nɛ bumo gbagba maa nu m bɛ so.

english_verse: Not everyone is an apostle. Not everyone is a prophet. Not everyone is a teacher. Not everyone can work miracles.
translation_verse: Bumo kikɛ e la beshuŋipo a? Bumo kikɛ e la abɔrɛsheŋ be bewuŋkaŋɛpo a? Bumo kikɛ e la beŋinipo a? Bumo kikɛ e naa shuŋ emamachishuŋ a?

english_verse: Not everyone can heal the sick. Not everyone can speak different kinds of languages. Not everyone can tell what these languages mean.
translation_verse: Bumo kikɛ e kɔ kechɛ be kakɛ a? Bekama e naa gbar ŋgbar nɛ bumo gbagba maa nu a? Bekama e naa kute ŋgbar nɛ bumo gbagba maa nu be afito a? Ayai, mannɛ bumo kikɛ e naa wora loŋ.

english_verse: I want you to desire the best gifts. So I will show you a much better way.
translation_verse: Amoso, men baa ta men be ŋgbene kikɛ a fin ŋkɛ mo nɛ a walɛ ga na. Ma alɛ beeŋ ŋini menyi ekpa mo nɛ k beeŋ yɛr menyi anishito n ti so.

english_verse: What if I could speak all languages of humans and even of angels? If I did not love others, I would be nothing more than a noisy gong or a clanging cymbal.
translation_verse: Nɛ m baa tiŋ a gbar basa nɛ emalaika gba be ŋgbar ŋkaa maa kɔ kasha, kumo ere m baa du fanɛ kakure bureso nna ŋko awɔr fuloŋ.

english_verse: What if I could prophesy and understand all mysteries and all knowledge? And what if I had faith that moved mountains? I would be nothing, unless I loved others.
translation_verse: Hale nɛ m baa kɔ abɔrɛsheŋ be kewuŋkaŋɛ be kakɛ nsaa tiŋ a pin ewulosheŋ kikɛ nɛ kanyiasheŋ kikɛ to nsaa kɔ yirda kikɛ ma to a tiŋ a tia abee ŋkaa maa kɔ kasha bre, m maŋ la shɛŋ.

english_verse: What if I gave away all that I owned and let myself be burned alive? I would gain nothing, unless I loved others.
translation_verse: Nɛ m baa tiŋ a ta kusɔ nɛ ŋ kɔ a kɛ basa ŋkaa beeŋ naŋ tiŋ n ta ma eyur n sa fanɛ b chɔɔ edɛ ŋkpal ma yirda so, ma alɛ ŋkaa maa kɔ kasha bre, kumo ere m maŋ nya tɔnɔ kikɛ.

english_verse: Love rejoices in the truth, but not in evil.
translation_verse: Kasha wɔ esa to, mbe kagbene maa fuli mo ŋkpal kulubi so, kashenteŋ e naa fuli mbe kagbene.

english_verse: Love never fails! Everyone who prophesies will stop, and unknown languages will no longer be spoken. All that we know will be forgotten.
translation_verse: Kasha maa loge kikɛ. Ama kewuŋkaŋɛana bre nɛ ŋgbar pɔtɛana be kegbar nɛ kanyiasheŋ bre kikɛ beeŋ ba choŋ.

english_verse: We don't know everything, and our prophecies are not complete.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, anyi be kanyiasheŋ ere nɛ anyi be kewuŋkaŋɛ ere maŋ naŋ bɔlɔ so n loge.

english_verse: But what is perfect will someday appear, and what isn't perfect will then disappear.
translation_verse: Ama kusɔ nɛ k bɔlɔ so kaŋ ba, kusɔ nɛ k maŋ bɔlɔ so beeŋ choŋ.

english_verse: When we were children, we thought and reasoned as children do. But when we grew up, we quit our childish ways.
translation_verse: Ŋ ka daa la kebia, n daa malga fanɛ kebia nna a fɛ nfɛra fanɛ kebia a pin asheŋ to fanɛ kebia. Ama ŋ ka ba ki enimu nɛ n yige mbibisheŋ ma asheŋ to.

english_verse: Now all we can see of God is like a cloudy picture in a mirror. Later we will see him face to face. We don't know everything, but then we will, just as God completely understands us.
translation_verse: Naniere bre anyee wu asɔ nna lii fanɛ an ka bee keni digi to na. Ama saŋko anyeeŋ wu kusɔ kama kenishiso nɛnɛ. Naniere n nyi asheŋ to gbrɛbi nna, ama saŋko meeŋ pin kusɔ kama to nɛnɛ n loge fanɛ kananɛ Ebɔrɛ nyi ma to na.

english_verse: For now there are faith, hope, and love. But of these three, the greatest is love.
translation_verse: Ama asheŋ ere kikɛ to asɔ nɛ a beeŋ baa wɔtɔ e la, yirda nɛ tama nɛ kasha, ama amo alɛ kikɛ be kejuŋkparso e la kasha.

english_verse: Love should be your guide. Be eager to have the gifts that come from the Holy Spirit, especially the gift of prophecy.
translation_verse: Amoso, men baa kɔ a fin kasha nseŋ ta menyi be ŋgbene kikɛ n fin ŋkɛ mo nɛ a shi Kiyoyu na kutɔ na, fɔnfɔŋ kewu abɔrɛsheŋ ŋ kaŋɛ be kakɛ na.

english_verse: If you speak languages that others don't know, God will understand what you are saying, though no one else will know what you mean. You will be talking about mysteries that only the Spirit understands.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, esa kama nɛ e bee gbar ŋgbar mo nɛ e maa nu na, maa gbar amo nna a sa basa, Ebɔrɛ nɛ e bee gbar amo a sa, ŋkpal manɛ so, esa kama maa nu amo. E bee bɔla Kiyoyu na to nna a malga wuloso be mmalga.

english_verse: But when you prophesy, you will be understood, and others will be helped. They will be encouraged and made to feel better.
translation_verse: Ama esa kama nɛ e bee wu abɔrɛsheŋ na to a kaŋɛ bre bee malga nna a sa basa a chɛ bumo to nɛ b baa yɔ anishito nsaa leŋ bumo to a wushi bumo kagbene.

english_verse: My friends, what good would it do, if I came and spoke unknown languages to you and didn't explain what I meant? How would I help you, unless I told you what God had shown me or gave you some knowledge or prophecy or teaching?
translation_verse: Ŋ kurgepoana, nɛ m baŋ ba menyi kutɔ m ba kaa gbar ŋgbar mo nɛ m maa nu ŋkaa maŋ bar menyi kelaraŋŋini ko ŋko kanyiasheŋ ko ŋko kewu abɔrɛsheŋ ŋ kaŋɛ ŋko keŋini ko, mannɛ be tɔnɔ nɛ menyeeŋ nya?

english_verse: If a bugle call isn't clear, how would you know to get ready for battle?
translation_verse: Ŋko nɛ fanɛ akarma maŋ laŋ ntempeni kananɛ k daga, nuso nɛ basa bee wora a bela ase a yɔ kena to?

english_verse: This is how it is when you speak unknown languages. If no one can understand what you are talking about, you will only be talking to the wind.
translation_verse: To, loŋ nɛ k du n sa menyi. Nɛ men baa maŋ gbar ŋgbar mo nɛ basa bee nu, nuso nɛ esa beeŋ wora m pin kusɔ nɛ menyee kaŋɛ? Nɛ b baa maa pin amo to, kumo ere fee malga a sa afu nna na.

english_verse: But if I don't understand the language that someone is using, we will be like foreigners to each other.
translation_verse: Ama nɛ fanɛ m baa maa nu ŋgbar mo nɛ esa bee malga, kumo ere esa nɛ e bee malga amo la efɔ nna ma kutɔ nɛ ma alɛ la efɔ mo kutɔ.

english_verse: When we speak languages that others don't know, we should pray for the power to explain what we mean.
translation_verse: Amoso, ekama nɛ e bee gbar ŋgbar mo nɛ e maa nu, e baa kule Ebɔrɛ fanɛ e shin nɛ e baa tiŋ a kute amo be afito.

english_verse: For example, if I use an unknown language in my prayers, my spirit prays but my mind is useless.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, nɛ m baa kule Ebɔrɛ ŋgbar mo nɛ m maa nu to, ma kiyoyu e naa kule, ama ma nfɛra bre maa wora shɛŋ shɛŋ.

english_verse: Then what should I do? There are times when I should pray with my spirit, and times when I should pray with my mind. Sometimes I should sing with my spirit, and at other times I should sing with my mind.
translation_verse: To, naniere, nuso nɛ meeŋ baa wora? Meeŋ baa ta ma kiyoyu a kule Ebɔrɛ nseŋ naa ta ma nfɛra gba a kule Ebɔrɛ. Meeŋ baa ta ma kiyoyu a boŋ nshɛ nseŋ naa ta ma nfɛra gba a boŋ amo.

english_verse: Suppose some strangers are in your worship service, when you are praising God with your spirit. If they don't understand you, how will they know to say, “Amen”?
translation_verse: Nɛ fee ta fo kiyoyu a chɔrɔ Ebɔrɛ, nuso nɛ esa pɔtɛ mo nɛ e ba asɔri na to ŋkaa maa nu ŋgbar na bee wora a shuli ‘Amɛn’ a wɔtɔ fo kechɔrɔ na to? Ŋkpal manɛ so, e maŋ nyi kusɔ nɛ fee kaŋɛ.

english_verse: You may be worshiping God in a wonderful way, but no one else will be helped.
translation_verse: Shere fo kabɔrɛchɔrɔ na beeŋ baa kɔ kifito ga, ama esa pɔtɛ na maaŋ nya kechɛto kama n yɔ anishito.

english_verse: I thank God that I speak unknown languages more than any of you.
translation_verse: Mee chɔrɔ Ebɔrɛ ga fanɛ mee gbar ŋgbar mo nɛ m maa nu a chɔ menyi be ekama.

english_verse: But words that make sense can help the church. This is why in church I would rather speak five words that make sense than to speak
translation_verse: Ama nɛ m baa wɔ asɔri to mee kaa sha kemalga mmalga anu mo nɛ basa beeŋ tiŋ n nu to nna nɛ n ta amo ŋ ŋini basa na asɔ, a chɔ ŋ ka gbar mmalga ŋgboŋ kudu mo nɛ a wɔ ŋgbar mo nɛ b maa nu to.

english_verse: My friends, stop thinking like children. Think like mature people and be as innocent as tiny babies.
