translation_verse: Ŋ kurgepoana, men sa maa fɛ nfɛra fanɛ mbia. Alubi bre be kewora be kaplɛa so men baa la mbia, ama men be nfɛra bre to, men baa la basa kpar.

english_verse: In the Scriptures the Lord says, “I will use strangers who speak unknown languages to talk to my people. They will speak to them in foreign languages, but still my people won't listen to me.”
translation_verse: Abɔrɛsibɛ na malɛ e naa kaŋɛ loŋ fanɛ Enyɛnpe na yɛ: “Meeŋ bɔla basa nɛ b kɔ ŋgbar pɔtɛana nɛ befɔ be nnɔana to m malga n sa basa ere, ama nɛ n wora loŋ gba, b maaŋ nu n sa ma.”

english_verse: Suppose everyone in your worship service started speaking unknown languages, and some outsiders or some unbelievers come in. Won't they think you are crazy?
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, nɛ asɔri na to ebi kikɛ ba shɛr nɛ ekama nyam bee gbar ŋgbar nɛ b maa nu ana nɛ esa pɔtɛ ŋko bumo nɛ b maŋ la beyirdapo ba luri nshɛr na to, b maaŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ menyee lɔ eboŋ nna a?

english_verse: But suppose all of you are prophesying when those unbelievers and outsiders come in. They will realize that they are sinners, and they will want to change their ways because of what you are saying.
translation_verse: Ama nɛ fanɛ asɔri na to ebi kikɛ bee wu abɔrɛsheŋ na to a kaŋɛ nɛ emo nɛ e maŋ la eyirdapo ŋko esa pɔtɛ ba luri nshɛr na to, asheŋ nɛ e bee nu na kikɛ beeŋ shin nɛ e keni mbe asheŋ to n shin nɛ e wu mbe alubi.

english_verse: They will tell what is hidden in their hearts. Then they will kneel down and say to God, “We are certain that you are with these people.” Worship Must Be Orderly
translation_verse: Mbe wulo to be nfɛra beeŋ lar n dii efuli nɛ e gbir n dese kasawule m maŋ Ebɔrɛ so ŋ kaŋɛ le: “Kashenteŋto, Ebɔrɛ wɔ menyi kutɔ nfe.” Asɔri to be asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so be asheŋ

english_verse: My friends, when you meet to worship, you must do everything for the good of everyone there. That's how it should be when someone sings or teaches or tells what God has said or speaks an unknown language or explains what the language means.
translation_verse: To, ŋ kurgepoana, naniere manɛ e naŋ ka nɛ an kaŋɛ? Men baŋ ba shɛr asɔri to, eko beeŋ baa kɔ kapandi be kashɛ ŋko keŋini ko ŋko kelaraŋŋini be kesheŋ ko ŋko ŋgbar nɛ e maa nu be kegbar ŋko amo be kifito be kekute. A daga fanɛ men baa wora ade kikɛ nɛ asɔriebi na e nya kechɛto n yɔ anishito.

english_verse: No more than two or three of you should speak unknown languages during the meeting. You must take turns, and someone should always be there to explain what you mean.
translation_verse: Nɛ basa baa shin nɛ b gbar ŋgbar mo nɛ b maa nu, men shin nɛ k baa la fanɛ basa anyɔ ŋko b baa shi ga, b baa la basa asa ŋ gbar amo kukoko to nɛ esa ko malɛ e kute amo be afito.

english_verse: If no one can explain, you must keep silent in church and speak only to yourself and to God.
translation_verse: Nɛ esa nɛ e beeŋ tiŋ ŋ kute ŋgbar na be afito maŋ wɔtɔ, egbarpo na e lo mbe kɔnɔ asɔri na to nseŋ malga mo gbagba be kumu to nɛ Ebɔrɛ kutɔ.

english_verse: If someone sitting there receives a message from God, the speaker must stop and let the other person speak.
translation_verse: Ama nɛ abɔrɛsheŋ be ewuŋkaŋɛpo kama nɛ e bee malga nɛ kelaraŋŋini be kubɔya ko shi Ebɔrɛ kutɔ m ba esa ko nɛ e tase nshɛr na to na kutɔ, ewuŋkaŋɛpo na e lo to.

english_verse: Let only one person speak at a time, then all of you will learn something and be encouraged.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, men kikɛ beeŋ tiŋ n wu abɔrɛsheŋ to ŋ kaŋɛ kukoko to, saŋɛ na so ekama beeŋ koya kusɔ ko nseŋ nya keleŋto.

english_verse: A prophet should be willing to stop and let someone else speak.
translation_verse: Abɔrɛsheŋ be bewuŋkaŋɛpoana gbagba e wɔ bumo be kewuŋkaŋɛ be ayoyu.

english_verse: God wants everything to be done peacefully and in order. When God's people meet in church,
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ maŋ la kebagato be Ebɔrɛ nna, kagbenewushi be Ebɔrɛ e la mo.

english_verse: If there is something they want to know, they can ask their husbands when they get home. It is disgraceful for women to speak in church.
translation_verse: Kusɔ kama nɛ baa sha kepinto, b bishi bumo kulana epe, ŋkpal manɛ so, k la anishinyɔr be kesheŋ nna fanɛ eche e baa malga asɔri to.

english_verse: God's message did not start with you people, and you are not the only ones it has reached.
translation_verse: Cha, menyi kutɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ be kamalga na fara ŋko menyi nawule kutɔ nɛ k yɔ?

english_verse: If you think of yourself as a prophet or a spiritual person, you will know I am writing only what the Lord has commanded.
translation_verse: Ekama nɛ e bee fɛ fanɛ abɔrɛsheŋ be ewuŋkaŋɛpo e la mo ŋko fanɛ e la kiyoyu to be esa nna e baa nyi fanɛ kusɔ nɛ mee sibɛ a sa menyi ere la kamalga naseso mo nɛ k shi Enyɛnpe kutɔ nna.

english_verse: So don't pay attention to anyone who ignores what I am writing.
translation_verse: Nɛ e baŋ kplaŋ le be kesheŋ ere so, baaŋ kplaŋ mo alɛ gba so.

english_verse: My friends, be eager to prophesy and don't stop anyone from speaking languages that others don't know.
translation_verse: Amoso, ŋ kurgepoana, men baa kɔ a fin kewu abɔrɛsheŋ ŋ kaŋɛ, menyi alɛ e sa maa kuŋ ŋgbar mo nɛ amo be begbarpo maa nu amo be kegbar ekpa ashi menyi to.

english_verse: But do everything properly and in order.
translation_verse: Ama a daga fanɛ men baa wora kusɔ kama nɛnɛ ekpa niŋiso so.

english_verse: My friends, I want you to remember the message I preached and that you believed and trusted.
translation_verse: Naniere, ŋ kurgepoana, mee sha fanɛ n nyiŋi menyi baru lela mo nɛ n daŋ bɔ n sa menyi nɛ men sɔ a yil kumo to na be asheŋ nna.

english_verse: You will be saved by this message, if you hold firmly to it. But if you don't, your faith was all for nothing.
translation_verse: Baru lela na so nɛ menyee nya kumɔlga, nɛ men baa kɔ kumo to kpakpa nna na, ama men daŋ yirda jiga nna.

english_verse: I told you the most important part of the message exactly as it was told to me. This part is: Christ died for our sins, as the Scriptures say.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, kusɔ nɛ n daŋ nya nɛ ma alɛ gba daŋ ta m bɔɔ menyi enɔ fanɛ kusɔ nɛ k juŋkpar e la fanɛ: Kristo wu nna ŋkpal anyi be alubi so fanɛ kananɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ na fanɛ

english_verse: He was buried, and three days later he was raised to life, as the Scriptures say.
translation_verse: b daŋ puli mo, ama e tiŋi ashi luwu na to kumo be kachɛ sasopo to fanɛ kananɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ na.

english_verse: After this, he appeared to more than five hundred other followers. Most of them are still alive, but some have died.
translation_verse: Amo be kaman nɛ e lar bekurgepo mo nɛ b chɔ basa alfa anu so ashi kaboŋ koŋwule. Bumo be galeŋga kraa wɔ ŋkpa to kabre, ama beko bre wu.

english_verse: He also appeared to James, then to all of the apostles.
translation_verse: E daŋ lar Jeems gba so nseŋ naŋ lar beshuŋipoana na kikɛ so.

english_verse: Finally, he appeared to me, even though I am like someone who was born at the wrong time.
translation_verse: Ade kikɛ nyam be kaman nɛ e lar ma alɛ so, k daa du fanɛ b ka kurge ma saŋɛ gela nna.

english_verse: I am the least important of all the apostles. In fact, I caused so much trouble for God's church that I don't even deserve to be called an apostle.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, ma e la beshuŋipoana na kikɛ be emantopo, a maŋ daga fanɛ b ka tre ma eshuŋipo gba, ŋkpal manɛ so, n tɔrɔ Ebɔrɛ be asɔri.

english_verse: But God treated me with undeserved grace! He made me what I am, and his grace wasn't wasted. I worked much harder than any of the other apostles, although it was really God's grace at work and not me.
translation_verse: Ama ŋkpal Ebɔrɛ be kuwɔr be kakɛ so nɛ n du kananɛ n du ere na, mo alɛ be kuwɔr be kakɛ mo nɛ k ba ma so ere maŋ la jiga nna. Ama nɛ fo keni to, ma e shuŋ ga a chɔ bumo kikɛ, mannɛ ma gbagba bre, Ebɔrɛ be kuwɔr be kakɛ na e wɔ ma to a shuŋ.

english_verse: But it doesn't matter if I preached or if they preached. All of you believed the message just the same. God's People Will Be Raised to Life
translation_verse: Amoso, nɛ ma kutɔ nɛ kamalga na daŋ shi ŋko bumo kutɔ nɛ k daŋ shi, kusɔ nɛ anyee ta a sa menyi nna na, kumo alɛ nɛ men yirda na. Bubuni be ketiŋi luwu to be asheŋ

english_verse: If we preach that Christ was raised from death, how can some of you say the dead will not be raised to life?
translation_verse: Ama nɛ fanɛ baa bɔ Kristo be baru na a kaŋɛ fanɛ e tiŋi luwu to, nuso nɛ men be beko bee wora a kaŋɛ fanɛ ketiŋi luwu to maŋ wɔtɔ?

english_verse: If they won't be raised to life, Christ himself wasn't raised to life.
translation_verse: Nɛ fanɛ ketiŋi luwu to maŋ wɔtɔ, kumo ere Kristo gba maŋ tiŋi luwu to.

english_verse: And if Christ wasn't raised to life, our message is worthless, and so is your faith.
translation_verse: Nɛ fanɛ Kristo malɛ baa maŋ tiŋi luwu to, kumo ere, anyi be kubɔya nɛ anyee bɔ na, maŋ kɔ kifito, nɛ men be yirda gba maŋ kɔ kifito.

english_verse: If the dead won't be raised to life, we have told lies about God by saying he raised Christ to life, when he really did not.
translation_verse: Kumo be buushi, nɛ k baa la kashenteŋ nna fanɛ bubuni maa tiŋi luwu to bre, kumo ere anyee ku efɛ nna a deŋi Ebɔrɛ ŋkpal an ka ji shɛda fanɛ Ebɔrɛ tiŋi Kristo ashi luwu to, nɛ mo alɛ maŋ tiŋi mo ashi luwu na to so so.

english_verse: So if the dead won't be raised to life, Christ wasn't raised to life.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so nɛ bubuni baa maa tiŋi ashi luwu to bre, kumo ere Kristo gba maŋ tiŋi luwu to.

english_verse: Unless Christ was raised to life, your faith is useless, and you are still living in your sins.
translation_verse: Nɛ Kristo malɛ daa maŋ tiŋi ashi luwu na to, kumo ere, men be yirda na daa maaŋ baa kɔ tɔnɔ nɛ menyi alɛ kraa wɔ men be alubi to

english_verse: And those people who died after putting their faith in him are completely lost.
translation_verse: nɛ bumo nɛ b daŋ yirda Kristo pɔɛŋ nseŋ wu na malɛ foe bumo be alubi to kuraa.

english_verse: If our hope in Christ is good only for this life, we are worse off than anyone else.
translation_verse: Nɛ fanɛ durnya ere to be kebaawɔtɔ to nawule so nna nɛ an kɔ tama Kristo to, kumo ere a daga fanɛ basa ka shu anyi so a chɔ basa kikɛ nyam.

english_verse: But Christ has been raised to life! And he makes us certain that others will also be raised to life.
translation_verse: Ama kashenteŋ malɛ nna fanɛ Kristo juŋkpar bumo nɛ b wu na kikɛ n tiŋi luwu to.

english_verse: Just as we will die because of Adam, we will be raised to life because of Christ.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, esa koŋwule so nɛ luwu bɔla m ba durnya to, esa koŋwule malɛ so nɛ ketiŋi luwu to gba ba durnya to.

english_verse: Adam brought death to all of us, and Christ will bring life to all of us.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, kananɛ ekama beeŋ wu ŋkpal e ka shi Adam to so na, loŋ koŋwule na nɛ Ebɔrɛ beeŋ sa ekama nɛ e shi Kristo to na ŋkpa.

english_verse: But we must each wait our turn. Christ was the first to be raised to life, and his people will be raised to life when he returns.
translation_verse: Ama ekama nɛ mbe saŋɛ nna, sososo Kristo nɛ e la ejuŋkparso na e tiŋi, mo alɛ kaŋ naŋ ba, bumo nɛ b la mo peya na e naaŋ tiŋi m bɛ so.

english_verse: Then after Christ has destroyed all powers and forces, the end will come, and he will give the kingdom to God the Father.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ e mur kuwurji kikɛ nɛ kenimuji kikɛ nɛ eleŋana kikɛ nɛ durnya be ekar na e fo nɛ e ta kuwura na m bɔɔ Ebɔrɛ Etuto na enɔ.

english_verse: and the last enemy he destroys will be death.
translation_verse: Edoŋ mo nɛ Ebɔrɛ beeŋ mur lalaloge e la luwu.

english_verse: When the Scriptures say he will put everything under his power, they don't include God. It was God who put everything under the power of Christ.
translation_verse: Loŋ malɛ nɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ na fanɛ: “Ebɔrɛ ta kusɔ kama m bɔɔ mo enɔ,” ama kananɛ k bee kaŋɛ fanɛ kusɔ kama ere maa ŋini fanɛ Ebɔrɛ mo nɛ e bee ta kusɔ kama a bɔɔ Kristo enɔ na gba ti kusɔ kama na so nna.

english_verse: After everything is under the power of God's Son, he will put himself under the power of God, who put everything under his Son's power. Then God will mean everything to everyone.
translation_verse: Nɛ kusɔ kama malɛ baa wɔ mo ere Ebɔrɛ be enɔ to, kumo ere Ebinyɛn na malɛ gbagba beeŋ baa wɔ Ebɔrɛ nɛ e ta kusɔ kama n wɔtɔ mbe enɔ to na be enɔ to, saŋɛ na so Ebɔrɛ beeŋ baa la kusɔ kikɛ a sa esa kikɛ.

english_verse: If the dead are not going to be raised to life, what will people do who are being baptized for them? Why are they being baptized for those dead people?
translation_verse: Basa ko wɔtɔ nɛ baa bɛr bumo kabɔrɛbɛr ŋkpal basa nɛ b wu so. To, nɛ fanɛ basa maa tiŋi luwu to kuraa, manɛ e ba nɛ basa bee yili bubuni be katelamu to a shin nɛ baa bɛr bumo kabɔrɛbɛr?

english_verse: And why do we always risk our lives
translation_verse: To, nɛ anyi alɛ ai? Manɛ e ba nɛ anyee luri kenishipere to le saŋkama ere?

english_verse: and face death every day? The pride that I have in you because of Christ Jesus our Lord is what makes me say this.
translation_verse: Ŋ kurgepoana, mee kaŋɛ menyi nna fanɛ kachɛ kama mee wu nna. Kede malɛ baa kɔ kashenteŋ nna fanɛ kananɛ mee wu ma kumu ŋkpal men ka la Kristo Yesu, an Nyɛnpe peya na so.

english_verse: Don't fool yourselves. Bad friends will destroy you.
translation_verse: Men sa maŋ kaŋ fule men be amu. Beteri lubi e naa jija da lela.

english_verse: Be sensible and stop sinning. You should be embarrassed that some people still don't know about God. What Our Bodies Will Be Like
translation_verse: Men naŋ bɛta n nya nfɛra nsaa maŋ naa wora alubi kashenteŋto. Menyi be beko maŋ nyi Ebɔrɛ. Kesheŋ nɛ mee kaŋɛ menyi ere la men be anishinyɔr nna. Ketiŋi luwu to be eyur na be asheŋ

english_verse: Some of you have asked, “How will the dead be raised to life? What kind of bodies will they have?”
translation_verse: Ama shere esa ko beeŋ bishi: “Nuso nɛ bubuni bee tiŋi ashi luwu to? Nuso be eyur nɛ baaŋ ba kaa kɔ?”

english_verse: Don't be foolish. A seed must die before it can sprout from the ground.
translation_verse: Ewulpo ere, fo maŋ nyi fanɛ kusɔ nɛ fo duu na gbagba maa wora, ama k baŋ wu nna pɔɛŋ nseŋ kɔr n wora a?

english_verse: This is because God gives everything the kind of body he wants it to have.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ malɛ e naa sa keduuso na kedibi mo nɛ e bee sha, keduuso kama malɛ nɛ kumo be yiri to be kedibi.

english_verse: People, animals, birds, and fish are each made of flesh, but none of them are alike.
translation_verse: Mannɛ eyur kama e la kukoŋwule. Edimɛdi peya kɔr asɔbɔya peya to nɛ mbuibi peya kɔr ekɔrɔtɔ malɛ gba peya to.

english_verse: Everything in the heavens has a body, and so does everything on earth. But each one is very different from all the others.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛso be eyurana malɛ gba wɔtɔ nɛ kasawule so malɛ gba peya wɔtɔ. Ebɔrɛso be eyurana na malɛ be kela kɔr kasawule so be eyurana be kela to.

english_verse: The sun isn't like the moon, the moon isn't like the stars, and each star is different.
translation_verse: Kananɛ epeŋi bee fuli to kɔr kananɛ kufɔl nɛ achɛkpabiana bee fuli to to. Achɛkpabiana malɛ gba to amo be kefulto kɔr abar to.

english_verse: That's how it will be when our bodies are raised to life. These bodies will die, but the bodies that are raised will live forever.
translation_verse: To, kananɛ k beeŋ baa du saŋɛ nɛ bubuni bee tiŋi ashi luwu to nna na. Eyur mo nɛ baa ta a puli na la kusɔ nɛ k bee bɛ nna, kumo nɛ Ebɔrɛ bee tiŋi ashi luwu to na bre maa bɛ.

english_verse: The first man was named Adam, and the Scriptures tell us that he was a living person. But Jesus, who may be called the last Adam, is a life-giving spirit.
translation_verse: Loŋ malɛ nɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ na fanɛ: “Sososo be Adam na daŋ ki kusɔ futeso nna,” nɛ lalaloge be Adam na malɛ daŋ ki ŋkpasapo be Kiyoyu.

english_verse: We see that the one with a spiritual body did not come first. He came after the one who had a physical body.
translation_verse: Mannɛ fanɛ kiyoyu to be asheŋ e juŋkpar m ba, durnya ere to be asheŋ e juŋkpar m ba, amo alɛ be kaman pɔɛŋ nɛ kiyoyu to be asheŋ ba.

english_verse: The first man was made from the dust of the earth, but the second man came from heaven.
translation_verse: Sososo be esa na daŋ shi kasawule ere so nna, shishɛr to be esa. Esa nyɔsopo na bre shi ebɔrɛso nna.

english_verse: Everyone on earth has a body like the body of the one who was made from the dust of the earth. And everyone in heaven has a body like the body of the one who came from heaven.
translation_verse: Bumo nɛ b shi durnya ere to na du fanɛ emo nɛ b ta shishɛr m pɔr na nna, bumo nɛ b la ebɔrɛso peya na du fanɛ emo nɛ e shi ebɔrɛso m ba na nna.

english_verse: Just as we are like the one who was made out of earth, we will be like the one who came from heaven.
translation_verse: Kananɛ an daŋ baa kɔ shishɛr be esa na be kaduli anyi so na, loŋ koŋwule na nɛ anyeeŋ ba kaa kɔ esa nɛ e shi ebɔrɛso na gba be kaduli.

english_verse: My friends, I want you to know that our bodies of flesh and blood will decay. This means they cannot share in God's kingdom, which lasts forever.
translation_verse: Bekurgepoana, mee kaŋɛ menyi nna na fanɛ kusɔ nɛ b ta eyur nɛ ŋklaŋ n wora maaŋ tiŋ n nya Ebɔrɛ be kuwura na to n luri, kusɔ nɛ k bee bɛ malɛ kikɛ maaŋ tiŋ n nya kakpa nɛ luwu maŋ wɔtɔ n luri.

english_verse: I will explain a mystery to you. Not every one of us will die, but we will all be changed.
translation_verse: Men keni nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ menyi wulo to be kesheŋ ko fanɛ mannɛ anyi kikɛ e naaŋ wu, ama anyi kikɛ beeŋ chɛrga.

english_verse: It will happen suddenly, quicker than the blink of an eye. At the sound of the last trumpet the dead will be raised. We will all be changed, so we will never die again.
translation_verse: K beeŋ wora epul to nna manaŋ fanɛ kenishi ka ŋe to na, saŋɛ nɛ lalaloge be kabel na beeŋ shu na. Kabel na kaŋ shu, bubuni beeŋ tiŋi n nya kiyoyu to be eyur nɛ a maaŋ naŋ mur na, saŋɛ na malɛ nɛ anyi kikɛ bee chɛrga na.

english_verse: The bodies we now have are weak and can die. But they will be changed into bodies that are eternal. Then the Scriptures will come true, “Death has lost the battle!
translation_verse: Amoso, nɛ eyur nɛ k bee mur ere baŋ ki eyur mo nɛ k maa mur na nɛ eyur nɛ k bee wu ere malɛ ki eyur nɛ k maa wu na, kumo ere kusɔ nɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ na bee bɔla ekpa nna na fanɛ: “Naniere luwu mur. Kekɔmpɔɔso e ka.

english_verse: Sin is what gives death its sting, and the Law is the power behind sin.
translation_verse: Kulubi so nɛ luwu kɔ eleŋ a doro anyi, mbra na malɛ so nɛ kulubi kɔ eleŋ anyi so.

english_verse: But thank God for letting our Lord Jesus Christ give us the victory!
translation_verse: Ama anyee chɔrɔ Ebɔrɛ ga ŋkpal manɛ so, mo e naa bɔla an Nyɛnpe Yesu Kristo so a shin nɛ anyee kɔ a pɔɔ so.

english_verse: When you collect money for God's people, I want you to do exactly what I told the churches in Galatia to do.
translation_verse: To, naniere men shin nɛ an keni keto toto n sa Ebɔrɛ be basa na be asheŋ to. Men baa wora kananɛ ŋ kaŋɛ Galeeshaebi be asɔriana fanɛ b baa wora na.

english_verse: That is, each Sunday each of you must put aside part of what you have earned. If you do this, you won't have to take up a collection when I come.
translation_verse: Alediachɛ kama, men be ekama e ta amansherbi kanaŋkamaso nɛ e beeŋ tiŋ n nase, saŋɛ na so men maaŋ baa jo nɛ m ba pɔɛŋ nɛ men naa wora toto na.

english_verse: Choose some followers to take the money to Jerusalem. I will send them on with the money and with letters which show that you approve of them.
translation_verse: Ma alɛ kaŋ ba meeŋ ta nwɔl mo nɛ a bee ŋini basa nɛ men lara na n shuŋi loŋ be basa na nɛ b ta menyi be kakɛ na n yɔ Jerusalɛm.

english_verse: If you think I should go along, they can go with me. Paul's Travel Plans
translation_verse: Nɛ k kaŋ daga fanɛ ma alɛ gba e yɔ, kumo ere baaŋ tu ma n yɔ. Asɔ nɛ Pɔɔl bee sha kewora be asheŋ

english_verse: After I have gone through Macedonia, I hope to see you
translation_verse: Mee fɛ kebɔla Masɛdonia be efuli so nna. Ma alɛ kaŋ yɔ ndoŋ, meeŋ ba chɔrɔ menyi.

english_verse: and visit with you for a while. I may even stay all winter, so that you can help me on my way to wherever I will be going next.
translation_verse: Shere meeŋ wora nchɛnnyɔ menyi kutɔ, fo maŋ de so gba meeŋ baa wɔ ndoŋ awo be jemanɛ ere to kikɛ gba, saŋɛ na so kumo be kaman menyeeŋ chɛ ma to ashi ma enite to kaplɛkama nɛ meeŋ yɔ.

english_verse: If the Lord lets me, I would rather come later for a longer visit than to stop off now for only a short visit.
translation_verse: M maa sha fanɛ m baa choŋ naniere le nseŋ wu menyi. Mee fɛ nna fanɛ nɛ Enyɛnpe shuli nɛ n nya saŋɛ, meeŋ chena menyi kutɔ n wora nchɛnnyɔ.

english_verse: I will stay in Ephesus until Pentecost,
translation_verse: Ama ŋ kraa beeŋ baa wɔ Ɛfeses nfe n ya fo Pɛntekɔst be saŋɛ,

english_verse: because there is a wonderful opportunity for me to do some work here. But there are also many people who are against me.
translation_verse: ŋkpal manɛ so, kushuŋ lela gboŋgboŋi be ekpa bugi nna n sa ma nɛ n shuŋ, ama basa nɛ b maa sa ma kashuli malɛ shi.

english_verse: When Timothy arrives, give him a friendly welcome. He is doing the Lord's work, just as I am.
translation_verse: Timoti kaŋ ba, men keta mo nɛnɛ nsaa maŋ shin nɛ kufu e pɛ mo fanɛ efɔ, ŋkpal manɛ so, mo alɛ gba bee shuŋ Enyɛnpe na be kushuŋ nna fanɛ ma.

english_verse: Don't let anyone mistreat him. I am looking for him to return to me together with the other followers. So when he leaves, send him off with your blessings.
translation_verse: Amoso, esa kama e sa maŋ kaŋ kini mo. Men chɛ mo to nɛ e nya ekpa n lar ndoŋ kagbenewushiso m ba ŋ kutɔ nfe. Mo nɛ bekurgepoana na nɛ mee keni ekpa na.

english_verse: I have tried hard to get our friend Apollos to visit you with the other followers. He doesn't want to come just now, but he will come when he can. Personal Concerns and Greetings
translation_verse: An kurgepo Apɔlɔs bre be asheŋ, n leŋ mo to ga fanɛ e tu bekurgepo mo na n ya bɔɔ menyi so, ama k daa maŋ wɔ mbe nfɛra to kuraa fanɛ e yɔ menyi kutɔ naniere. E kaŋ nya ekpa, e beeŋ ba. Pɔɔl be ŋkela be mmalga be asheŋ

english_verse: Keep alert. Be firm in your faith. Stay brave and strong.
translation_verse: Men baa da so a yil men be yirda na to kpakpa a kɔ kenyɛn nseŋ naa kɔ eleŋ.

english_verse: You know that Stephanas and his family were the first in Achaia to have faith in the Lord. They have done all they can for God's people. My friends, I ask you
translation_verse: Bekurgepoana, men nyi fanɛ Stɛfanas nɛ mbe kowu to ebi e la bekurgepo juŋkparsoana ashi Akaya be kasawule so, bumo alɛ ta bumo be amu kikɛ nna a shuŋ Ebɔrɛ be basa laraso.

english_verse: to obey leaders like them and to do the same for all others who work hard with you.
translation_verse: Amoso, mee kule menyi nna fanɛ men baa nu a sa le be basa nɛ bekama malɛ gba nɛ b luri loŋ be kushuŋ na to a wɔtɔ a shuŋ kumo na.

english_verse: I was glad to see Stephanas and Fortunatus and Achaicus. Having them here was like having you.
translation_verse: Stɛfanas nɛ Fɔɔchunates nɛ Akaikɔs ka ba, ma kagbene fuli ma ga, ŋkpal manɛ so, men ka maŋ wɔ nfe ere, bumo e ba tal to.

english_verse: They made me feel much better, just as they made you feel better. You should appreciate people like them.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, b leŋ ma to nseŋ leŋ menyi alɛ gba to loŋ. Loŋ be basa na daga fanɛ men baa sa bumo bunyaŋ. Lalaloge be kechɔrɔ be asheŋ

english_verse: Greetings from the churches in Asia. Aquila and Priscilla, together with the church that meets in their house, send greetings in the name of the Lord.
translation_verse: Asɔriana to ebi nɛ b wɔ Eeshia be kasawule so nfe ere kikɛ bee chɔrɔ menyi. Akwila nɛ Prisila nɛ asɔriebi nɛ baa shɛr bumo pe na kikɛ bugi kagbene a chɔrɔ menyi ga ashi Enyɛnpe to.

english_verse: All the Lord's followers send their greetings. Give each other a warm greeting.
translation_verse: Bekurgepoana nɛ b wɔ nfe na kikɛ bee chɔrɔ menyi. Men ta kagbenefuli be kechɔrɔ cheembi n chɔrɔ abar.

english_verse: I pray that God will put a curse on everyone who doesn't love the Lord. And may the Lord come soon.
translation_verse: Ekama nɛ e maa sha Enyɛnpe na, kɔnɔso e baa wɔ amodoŋwura na so. An Nyɛnpe e naaŋ bɛta m ba.

english_verse: I pray the Lord Jesus will be kind to you.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Yesu be kuwɔr be kakɛ e baa wɔ menyi so.

english_verse: I love everyone who belongs to Christ Jesus.
translation_verse: Ma kasha e baa wɔ menyi kikɛ so ashi Kristo Yesu to. Amɛn.

english_verse: From Paul, chosen by God to be an apostle of Jesus Christ, and from Timothy, who is also a follower. To God's church in Corinth and to all of God's people in Achaia.
translation_verse: Kawɔl ere shi ma Pɔɔl nɛ m bɔla Ebɔrɛ be keparso so a la Kristo Yesu be eshuŋipo na nɛ an kurgepo Timoti kutɔ nna a yɔ Ebɔrɛ be asɔriebi nɛ b wɔ Kɔrint be kade to nɛ Ebɔrɛ be basa nɛ b wɔ Griis be kasawule so kikɛ na kutɔ.

english_verse: I pray that God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! Paul Gives Thanks
translation_verse: An Tuto Ebɔrɛ nɛ Enyɛnpe Yesu Kristo e sa menyi kuwɔr be kakɛ nɛ kagbenewushi. Pɔɔl ka bee di Ebɔrɛ epaŋ be asheŋ

english_verse: Praise God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ! The Father is a merciful God, who always gives us comfort.
translation_verse: Men shin nɛ an baa chɔrɔ Ebɔrɛ, an Nyɛnpe Yesu Kristo mo Tuto na. Mo e la Etuto nɛ e kɔ kuwɔr nseŋ naa la esa nɛ keleŋto kikɛ bee shi mo kutɔ na.

english_verse: We share in the terrible sufferings of Christ, but also in the wonderful comfort he gives.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, kananɛ an baa tu Kristo a ji mbe awurfoŋ damta na, loŋ koŋwule na nɛ anyee bɔla Kristo so a nya keleŋto damta gba.

english_verse: We suffer in the hope that you will be comforted and saved. And because we are comforted, you will also be comforted, as you patiently endure suffering like ours.
translation_verse: Nɛ an baŋ ji awurfoŋ, menyi be keleŋto nɛ kumɔlga so so nɛ an ji loŋ be awurfoŋ na. Nɛ an baa nya keleŋto, kumo ere, menyi alɛ gba beeŋ nya loŋ be keleŋto nna na. Kumo alɛ e naa shin nɛ menyee nya eleŋ nɛ men tiŋ n nyiti awurfoŋ koŋwule nɛ anyee ji na.

english_verse: You never disappoint us. You suffered as much as we did, and we know that you will be comforted as we were.
translation_verse: Tama mo nɛ anyi alɛ kɔ menyi so na maa gbuŋgbuŋ to, ŋkpal manɛ so, an nyi fanɛ kananɛ men baa tu anyi a ji an be awurfoŋ na, loŋ koŋwule na malɛ nɛ men naa tu anyi a nya anyi be keleŋto gba.

english_verse: My friends, I want you to know what a hard time we had in Asia. Our sufferings were so horrible and so unbearable that death seemed certain.
translation_verse: Bekurgepoana, anyee sha fanɛ men pin kekɔrfɛ mo nɛ b kɔrfɛ anyi ashi Eeshia be kasawule so nna. Kashenteŋto, asheŋ nɛ b daŋ ta n tu anyi na daŋ wora anyi egbɛ ga n ya kaa pɔɔ anyi so, nɛ an daa fɛ fanɛ anyi be ŋkpaana loge durnya to.

english_verse: In fact, we felt sure we were going to die. But this made us stop trusting in ourselves and start trusting God, who raises the dead to life.
translation_verse: Kashenteŋto, an daa fɛ anyi be ŋgbene to nna fanɛ b ta luwu be mbra nna n ji m bri anyi. Ama le be kesheŋ ere daŋ ba loŋ nna nɛ an sa maŋ kaa yirda anyi gbagba be amu, ama anyeeŋ baa yirda Ebɔrɛ nɛ e bee tiŋi basa ashi luwu to na.

english_verse: God saved us from the threat of death, and we are sure that he will do it again and again.
translation_verse: Loŋ be kenishipere lubi be asheŋ na to nɛ e daŋ mɔlga anyi ashi to, mo alɛ beeŋ naŋ mɔlga anyi. An ta anyi be tama nna n deŋi mo so fanɛ e beeŋ naŋ lɔŋɛ m mɔlga anyi

english_verse: just as you already partly understand us. Then when our Lord Jesus returns, you can be as proud of us as we are of you.
translation_verse: Kumo e la fanɛ menyeeŋ pin fanɛ menyeeŋ tiŋ ŋkpal anyi so n ji njɔŋ fanɛ kananɛ anyeeŋ kpal menyi so n ji njɔŋ Enyɛnpe Yesu be kachɛ na.

english_verse: I was so sure of your pride in us that I had planned to visit you first of all. In this way you would have the blessing of two visits from me—
translation_verse: Ŋkpal ŋ ka daŋ baa nyi kesheŋ ere geeŋ so, n daŋ yili kumo nna fanɛ meeŋ ba chɔrɔ menyi pɔɛŋ, saŋɛ na so menyeeŋ nu ebel ale anyɔ.

english_verse: once on my way to Macedonia and again on my return from there. Then you could send me on to Judea.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, n daŋ yili kumo nna fanɛ ŋ kaa yɔ Masɛdonia, meeŋ bɔɔ menyi so. Ma alɛ naŋ ya shi Masɛdonia a bɛta a choŋ nɛ m ba shin nɛ men chɛ ma to nɛ n yɔ Judiya.

english_verse: Do you think I couldn't make up my mind about what to do? Or do I seem like someone who says “Yes” or “No” simply to please others?
translation_verse: To, kananɛ n daŋ fɛ kewora ere na daa la alefashaso be kusɔ nna a? Ŋko n fɛ asheŋ nɛ meeŋ wora nna fanɛ durnya ere to be esa a kaŋɛ fanɛ mm, mm, nseŋ naa yili epul na malɛ to a kaŋɛ m-m, m-m?

english_verse: God can be trusted, and so can I, when I say our answer to you has always been “Yes” and never “No.”
translation_verse: Kananɛ Ebɔrɛ maa chɛrga kɔnɔ na, loŋ koŋwule na nɛ anyi alɛ gba be kamalga maŋ la mm nɛ m-m be kamalga.

english_verse: This is because Jesus Christ the Son of God is always “Yes” and never “No.” And he is the one Silas, Timothy, and I told you about.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ Pibinyɛn Yesu Kristo na nɛ ma nɛ Sailas nɛ Timoti bɔ mbe kubɔya n sa menyi na daa maa kaŋɛ mm nseŋ naŋ kilgi ŋ kaŋɛ m-m epul na to, saŋkikɛ mm e daa wɔ mo to.

english_verse: Christ says “Yes” to all God's promises. This is why we have Christ to say “Amen” for us to the glory of God.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ be nnɔ naseso baa sha a baa shi kanaŋkamaso, amo kikɛ la mm be mmalga nna ashi Kristo to. Amoso, mo so nɛ anyee bɔla a shuli ‘Amɛn’ a ta kemaŋkura a sa Ebɔrɛ.

english_verse: And so God makes it possible for you and us to stand firmly together with Christ. God is also the one who chose us
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ koŋwule na malɛ e naa shin nɛ anyi nɛ menyi kikɛ bee yili kpakpa ashi Kristo to. Mo e nɛfa anyi n yili

english_verse: and put his Spirit in our hearts to show that we belong only to him.
translation_verse: nseŋ ta mbe kenya be ndulgi n dulgi anyi nseŋ ta mbe Kiyoyu n wɔtɔ anyi be ŋgbene to a ŋini fanɛ mo e wɔ anyi.

english_verse: We are not bosses who tell you what to believe. We are working with you to make you glad, because your faith is strong.
translation_verse: Men baa nyi fanɛ mannɛ fanɛ anyee sha keŋini menyi kenimu nna ashi yirda na to, ama kusɔ nɛ anyee wora e la fanɛ anyee tu menyi nna a wora asheŋ ŋkpal men be kenya kagbenefuliso so. Yirda malɛ so nɛ men yil kpakpa na.

english_verse: I have decided not to make my next visit with you so painful.
translation_verse: Amoso, n yili kumo ma kagbene to nna fanɛ m maaŋ naŋ ba bɔɔ menyi so n naŋ sa menyi kagbenejija.

english_verse: If I make you feel bad, who would be left to cheer me up, except the people I had made to feel bad?
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, nɛ m baŋ jija men be ŋgbene, wanɛ e naa wɔtɔ n naŋ ti menyi nɛ n jija men be ŋgbene na so nɛ e naŋ leŋ ma to?

english_verse: The reason I want to be happy is to make you happy. I wrote as I did because I didn't want to visit you and be made to feel bad, when you should make me feel happy.
translation_verse: N daŋ sibɛ kawɔl na n sa menyi nna, saŋɛ na so, ŋ kaŋ ba, menyi basa nɛ baaŋ shin nɛ ma kagbene e fuli ma na maaŋ jija ma kagbene, ŋkpal manɛ so, m baa kɔ menyi kikɛ be yirda fanɛ ma kagbenefuli la menyi kikɛ be kagbenefuli nna.

english_verse: At the time I wrote, I was suffering terribly. My eyes were full of tears, and my heart was broken. But I didn't want to make you feel bad. I only wanted to let you know how much I cared for you. Forgiveness
translation_verse: Tɔrɔgboŋ nɛ kagbenejija to nɛ n daa wɔ n ta anishichubi damta n sibɛ menyi kawɔl na nɛ n shin nɛ men pin kananɛ mee sha menyi kikɛ nɛnɛ, mannɛ fanɛ n jija menyi be ŋgbene. Ketampaŋ alubiworapo be asheŋ

english_verse: I don't want to be hard on you. But if one of you has made someone feel bad, I am not really the one who has been made to feel bad. Some of you are the ones.
translation_verse: Nɛ esa baŋ bar kagbenejija anyi to, mannɛ ma kagbene nɛ amodoŋwura jija, ama nɛ fo keni to, menyi kikɛ be ŋgbene nɛ e jija. M maa sha fanɛ n ta kenishipere ga n tu amodoŋwura na.

english_verse: Most of you have already pointed out the wrong that person did, and this is punishment enough for what was done.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, kasogberge nɛ amodoŋwura na teŋ nya ashi basa galeŋga kutɔ kukwe.

english_verse: When people sin, you should forgive and comfort them, so they won't give up in despair.
translation_verse: Naniere kusɔ nɛ k daga fanɛ men baa wora e la fanɛ men ta m paŋ mo nseŋ leŋ mo to, saŋɛ na so mbe kagbenejija damta na maaŋ pɔɔ mo so.

english_verse: You should make them sure of your love for them.
translation_verse: Amoso, men jande, men ŋini mo fanɛ menyee sha mo kashenteŋto.

english_verse: I also wrote because I wanted to test you and find out if you would follow my instructions.
translation_verse: Amoso nɛ n daŋ sibɛ menyi kawɔl na nɛ n wora menyi ŋ keni ŋko men kɔ kasonu ashi kusɔ kama to a.

english_verse: I have done this to keep Satan from getting the better of us. We all know what goes on in his mind.
translation_verse: Saŋɛ na so, Setani maaŋ nya anyi, ŋkpal manɛ so, an nyi mbe nfɛra. Pɔɔl be kagbene ka kaa Trowas be kade to be asheŋ

english_verse: When I went to Troas to preach the good news about Christ, I found that the Lord had already prepared the way.
translation_verse: Ŋ ka daŋ ba Trowas be kade to nɛ m ba bɔ Kristo be baru lela na, n wu fanɛ kashenteŋto Enyɛnpe bugi kushuŋ na be ekpa.

english_verse: But I was worried when I didn't find my friend Titus there. So I left the other followers and went on to Macedonia.
translation_verse: Ama ma kagbene daa maŋ dese ma kuraa ŋkpal ŋ ka daa maŋ tu an kurgepo Taites na so. Amoso, n daŋ kela ndoŋebi na nna nseŋ yɔ Masɛdonia. Kebɔla Kristo to a kɔ eleŋ be asheŋ

english_verse: I am grateful that God always makes it possible for Christ to lead us to victory. God also helps us spread the knowledge about Christ everywhere, and this knowledge is like the smell of perfume.
translation_verse: Ama anyee chɔrɔ Ebɔrɛ ga, ŋkpal manɛ so, mo e naa shin nɛ anyee tu Kristo a nite kekɔmpɔɔso be ekpa so nseŋ naa bɔla anyi so a shin nɛ Kristo be kenyi bee sɔ kaplɛkama fanɛ efɛa belbelso na.

english_verse: In fact, God thinks of us as a perfume that brings Christ to everyone. For people who are being saved, this perfume has a sweet smell and leads them to a better life. But for people who are lost, it has a bad smell and leads them to a horrible death. No one really has what it takes to do this work.
translation_verse: Bumo nɛ baa mur na, k la fanɛ kɔrtɔ lubi nna a mɔ, ama bumo nɛ baa nya kumɔlga na bre, k la fanɛ efɛa belbelso nna a bar ŋkpa. To, nɛ wanɛ e naaŋ tiŋ n wora le be kesheŋ ere?

english_verse: A lot of people try to get rich from preaching God's message. But we are God's sincere messengers, and by the power of Christ we speak our message with God as our witness.
translation_verse: Anyi alɛ maŋ du fanɛ basa damta nɛ b kɔ Ebɔrɛ be kawɔl to na a fin kenya tɔnɔ ko n ji na nna. Anyi ere, Ebɔrɛ e shuŋi anyi, amoso, nfɛra niŋiso nɛ an kɔ a malga asheŋ Kristo be ketre to ashi Ebɔrɛ be anishito.

english_verse: Are we once again bragging about ourselves? Do we need letters to you or from you to tell others about us? Some people do need letters telling about them.
translation_verse: To, kede bee ŋini fanɛ an naŋ fara nna a kpaŋ anyi be amu nna ŋko? Ŋko a daga fanɛ anyi alɛ gba ka naŋ nya eleŋ be nwɔl nna nɛ an ta n yɔ men kutɔ fanɛ kananɛ beko bee wora na a?

english_verse: But you are our letter, and you are in our hearts for everyone to read and understand.
translation_verse: Menyi gbagba e la anyi be kawɔl nɛ b sibɛ n deŋi an be ŋgbeneana so nɛ basa kikɛ e baa wu nsaa kraŋ amo.

english_verse: You are like a letter written by Christ and delivered by us. But you are not written with pen and ink or on tablets made of stone. You are written in our hearts by the Spirit of the living God.
translation_verse: Menyi alɛ gba bee ŋini fanɛ men la kawɔl nna n shi Kristo kutɔ a la anyi be kushuŋ ere be tɔnɔ. Mannɛ kleembi nɛ b ta n sibɛ amo, bumo alɛ maŋ sibɛ amo n deŋi ajembu so, ama Ebɔrɛ nɛ e wɔ ŋkpa to be Kiyoyu nɛ b ta n sibɛ amo dimɛdi be ŋgbene so.

english_verse: We are sure about all this. Christ makes us sure in the very presence of God.
translation_verse: Le be tama ere nɛ an bɔla Kristo so a kɔ ashi Ebɔrɛ be anishito.

english_verse: We don't have the right to claim that we have done anything on our own. God gives us what it takes to do all we do.
translation_verse: Ama mannɛ fanɛ an gbagba ka kɔ eleŋ ko fanɛ an gbagba e wora kushuŋ na, Ebɔrɛ kutɔ nɛ anyi be eleŋ na bee shi.

english_verse: He makes us worthy to be the servants of his new agreement that comes from the Holy Spirit and not from a written Law. After all, the Law brings death, but the Spirit brings life.
translation_verse: Mo e shin nɛ an ki kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre popɔr be beshumpo, k la kiyoyu to be kesheŋ nna, mannɛ mbra to be kasibɛ be kesheŋ, ŋkpal manɛ so, mbra to be kasibɛ na bee bar luwu nna nɛ Kiyoyu na malɛ bee sa ŋkpa. Kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre popɔr na be kemaŋkura na be asheŋ

english_verse: The Law of Moses brought only the promise of death, even though it was carved on stones and given in a wonderful way. Still the Law made Moses' face shine so brightly the people of Israel could not look at it, even though it was a fading glory.
translation_verse: B daŋ sibɛ mbra na n deŋi ajembu so nna. Saŋɛ nɛ anebi Mosis daŋ ta amo n sa Israɛlebi na nɛ Ebɔrɛ be kemaŋkura lar efuli hale n shin nɛ Mosis be anishiakpa daa kpa edɛ nɛ Israɛlebi daa maŋ tiŋ ŋ keni mo. Nɛ kumo be kekpa edɛ na malɛ ka daa beeŋ ba loge gba nde!

english_verse: If something that brings the death sentence is glorious, won't something that makes us acceptable to God be even more glorious?
translation_verse: Nɛ fanɛ kushuŋ nɛ k bee ji a bri basa baa kɔ kemaŋkura kumo to, kumo ere, kushuŋ nɛ k bee ji a mɔlga basa na beeŋ baa kɔ kemaŋkura a chɔ loŋ.

english_verse: In fact, the new agreement is so wonderful that the Law is no longer glorious at all.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, nɛ an ta le be kemaŋkura ere m ber sososo peya na, sososo peya na maaŋ baa la shɛŋ.

english_verse: The Law was given with a glory that faded away. But the glory of the new agreement is much greater, because it will never fade away.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, nɛ kusɔ nɛ k maaŋ chɛr ŋkeŋ loge daa kɔ kemaŋkura kumo to, kumo ere kusɔ nɛ k maaŋ loge bre be kemaŋkura beeŋ baa chɔ loŋ ga.

english_verse: This wonderful hope makes us feel like speaking freely.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal an ka kɔ le be tama ere so, an kɔ kenyɛn nɛ an baa wora asheŋ.

english_verse: We are not like Moses. His face was shining, but he covered it to keep the people of Israel from seeing the brightness fade away.
translation_verse: Anyi maŋ du fanɛ Mosis nɛ e daŋ ta kusɔ kuŋso ŋ kuŋ mbe anishiakpa nɛ Israɛlebi e sa maŋ wu kananɛ mbe anishiakpa be kekpa edɛ daa chɛrga nsaa loge na.

english_verse: The people were stubborn, and something still keeps them from seeing the truth when the Law is read. Only Christ can take away the covering that keeps them from seeing.
translation_verse: Ama kashenteŋto bumo be ŋgbeneana daŋ ti nna a du kpakpa, hale kabre b baŋ kraŋ kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre dra na, kusɔ kuŋso na kraa wɔtɔ nna, ŋkpal manɛ so, Kristo nawule so nɛ kusɔ kuŋso na bee lar ashi to.

english_verse: with a covering that is removed only for those who turn to the Lord.
translation_verse: Ama nɛ esa baŋ kilgi n ta mbe kumu n sa Enyɛnpe bre, kusɔ kuŋso na bee lar nna ashi to.

english_verse: The Lord and the Spirit are one and the same, and the Lord's Spirit sets us free.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe e la Kiyoyu na, kaplɛkama malɛ nɛ Enyɛnpe be Kiyoyu malɛ wɔ, ndoŋ nɛ kamooji wɔ.

english_verse: God has been kind enough to trust us with this work. This is why we never give up.
translation_verse: To, ŋkpal Ebɔrɛ ka wu anyi kuwɔr n sa anyi le be kushuŋ ere so, anyi maa pɔ aba.

english_verse: We don't do shameful things that must be kept secret. And we don't try to fool anyone or twist God's message around. God is our witness that we speak only the truth, so others will be sure we can be trusted.
translation_verse: Naniere, an yige wulo to be asheŋ nɛ anishinyɔr be ekpaana. Anyi maa ta kafule a wora asheŋ, anyi alɛ maa chɛrga Ebɔrɛ be kamalga na. Ama kashenteŋ nɛ an lara n dii efuli. Loŋ malɛ, ekama be nfɛra fɛso beeŋ ŋini mo fanɛ an walɛ nna ashi Ebɔrɛ be anishito.

english_verse: If there is anything hidden about our message, it is hidden only to someone who is lost.
translation_verse: Hale nɛ kusɔ kuŋso buu anyi be baru lela nɛ anyi bɔ ere so gba, k wora loŋ nna n sa basa nɛ baa mur bumo be alubi to na.

english_verse: The god who rules this world has blinded the minds of unbelievers. They cannot see the light, which is the good news about our glorious Christ, who shows what God is like.
translation_verse: Bumo alɛ maŋ yirda nna, ŋkpal manɛ so, durnya ere to be ebɔrɛ na e tan bumo be anishiana, saŋɛ na so b maaŋ baa wu Kristo nɛ e la Ebɔrɛ be kaduli gbagba na be kemaŋkura be baru lela na be kefulto na.

english_verse: We are not preaching about ourselves. Our message is that Jesus Christ is Lord. He also sent us to be your servants.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, mannɛ anyi gbagba be asheŋ be baru nɛ anyee bɔ, Yesu Kristo be baru nɛ anyee bɔ a kaŋɛ fanɛ mo e la Enyɛnpe na nɛ anyi alɛ la men be beshumpo ŋkpal Yesu so.

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “God commanded light to shine in the dark.” Now God is shining in our hearts to let you know that his glory is seen in Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ mo nɛ e kaŋɛ fanɛ: “Men shin nɛ kefulto e shi tentembiri to n lar n nyaŋɛ,” koŋwule na e naa shin nɛ mbe kefulto bee nyaŋɛ anyi be ŋgbeneana to a bar anyi Ebɔrɛ be kemaŋkura be kanyiasheŋ be kefulto nɛ k bee nyaŋɛ Kristo be anishito na.

english_verse: We are like clay jars in which this treasure is stored. The real power comes from God and not from us.
translation_verse: Ama anyi, bumo nɛ an kɔ le be kanya ere du fanɛ mba nna a ŋini fanɛ eleŋ nɛ k chɔ kekama na la Ebɔrɛ peya nna, mannɛ anyeya.

english_verse: We often suffer, but we are never crushed. Even when we don't know what to do, we never give up.
translation_verse: Saŋɛ damta baa nyaŋ anyi nna, ama anyi alɛ maa bɛa to. Saŋko anyee wulto to, ama anyi alɛ maa wulto to cheche.

english_verse: In times of trouble, God is with us, and when we are knocked down, we get up again.
translation_verse: Baa tɔrɔ anyi, ama Ebɔrɛ maa kini anyi. Baa ŋmɛa anyi a lɛ, ama anyi alɛ maa mur.

english_verse: We face death every day because of Jesus. Our bodies show what his death was like, so his life can also be seen in us.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, saŋkikɛ, anyi nɛ an wɔ ŋkpa to ere nɛ luwu maŋ wɔ kufɔ ŋkpal Yesu so, saŋɛ na so basa beeŋ wu mbe ŋkpa malɛ gba ashi anyi be eyurana nɛ luwu bee pɔɔ amo so ere to.

english_verse: This means that death is working in us, but life is working in you.
translation_verse: Amoso, luwu wɔ anyi to nna a shuŋ nɛ ŋkpa malɛ gba wɔ menyi to a shuŋ.

english_verse: In the Scriptures it says, “I spoke because I had faith.” We have this same kind of faith. So we speak
translation_verse: Abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ fanɛ Ewura Deevid kaŋɛ: “N yirda nna so nɛ m malga.” To, loŋ be yirda be kiyoyu koŋwule na nɛ anyi alɛ gba kɔ a yirda nsaa malga na.

english_verse: because we know that God raised the Lord Jesus to life. And just as God raised Jesus, he will also raise us to life. Then he will bring us into his presence together with you.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, an nyi fanɛ esa nɛ e tiŋi Enyɛnpe Yesu luwu to na beeŋ tiŋi anyi alɛ gba nɛ Yesu na nseŋ ta anyi nɛ menyi kikɛ n yɔ mo gbagba be anishito.

english_verse: All of this has been done for you, so more and more people will know how kind God is and will praise and honor him. Faith in the Lord
translation_verse: Menyi alɛ be kechɛto so nɛ ade malɛ kikɛ du loŋ na, saŋɛ na so Ebɔrɛ malɛ be kuwɔr be kakɛ beeŋ baa salga to a tu basa damta a ti so nɛ b baa kɔ kechɔrɔ be kabɔrɛkule damta a ti so a sa Ebɔrɛ nɛ e nya kemaŋkura.

english_verse: We never give up. Our bodies are gradually dying, but we ourselves are being made stronger each day.
translation_verse: Amoso, an maa pɔ aba. Anyi be eyur so bre bee nya kapɔshi nna a ti so, anyi be ayoyu bre to bee wora eleŋ nna kapa nɛ kanyɛ a ti so.

english_verse: These little troubles are getting us ready for an eternal glory that will make all our troubles seem like nothing.
translation_verse: Kabre nawule be etɔrɔbi ere beeŋ kaŋ bar anyi kemaŋkuragboŋ nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar nsaa bɔ etɔrɔ ere ga.

english_verse: Things that are seen don't last forever, but things that are not seen are eternal. This is why we keep our minds on the things that cannot be seen.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, anyi be nfɛra yuu asɔ nɛ esa maaŋ tiŋ n wu kenishiso na nna, mannɛ asɔ nɛ basa bee wu kenishiso. Kusɔ nɛ anishi malɛ bee wu maa chɛr ko, ama kusɔ nɛ basa maaŋ tiŋ n wu kenishiso bre wɔtɔ nna mbaanaayɔ.

english_verse: Our bodies are like tents that we live in here on earth. But when these tents are destroyed, we know that God will give each of us a place to live. These homes will not be buildings someone has made, but they are in heaven and will last forever.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, an baa nyi fanɛ eyur mo nɛ k du fanɛ wajɛbu nɛ an wɔ kumo to durnya ere to ere baŋ jija, an kɔ kowu ashi Ebɔrɛ kutɔ, ebu nɛ b maŋ ta enɔ m pɔr kumo nɛ k wɔ ebɔrɛso mbaanaayɔ.

english_verse: While we are here on earth, we sigh because we want to live in that heavenly home.
translation_verse: Naniere bre an wɔtɔ nna a shu to nsaa jo anyi be ebɔrɛso be kowu nɛ baaŋ ta m buu anyi fanɛ kusɔbuuso na kenishipereso.

english_verse: We want to put it on like clothes and not be naked.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, nɛ an baŋ buu kusɔbuuso na, an maaŋ naŋ delge so a wɔtɔ.

english_verse: These tents we now live in are like a heavy burden, and we groan. But we don't do this just because we want to leave these bodies that will die. It is because we want to change them for bodies that will never die.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, an ka kraa wɔ eyur mo nɛ k du fanɛ wajɛbu ere to bre, anyee shu to nna nsaa wɔ kafɔŋ to, ŋkpal manɛ so, an maa sha fanɛ an delge so. Anyee sha fanɛ an buu anyi be ebɔrɛso be kusɔbuuso nna, saŋɛ na so ŋkpa beeŋ mur kusɔ nɛ k beeŋ wu na kikɛ nyam.

english_verse: God is the one who makes all this possible. He has given us his Spirit to make us certain he will do it.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ e bela anyi ase n yili le be kesheŋ ere nseŋ ta mbe Kiyoyu n sa anyi nɛ e baa la asɔ nɛ e kɔ a sa anyi kikɛ be tɔɔnɛ.

english_verse: So always be cheerful! As long as we are in these bodies, we are away from the Lord.
translation_verse: Amoso, saŋkikɛ anyi maa pɔ aba, ŋkpal manɛ so, an nyi fanɛ an ka baa wɔ epe ashi anyi be eyur ere to ere, anyi nɛ Enyɛnpe na wɔ kufɔ.

english_verse: But we live by faith, not by what we see.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, yirda nɛ an kɔ a na, mannɛ anishi fuful.

english_verse: But whether we are at home with the Lord or away from him, we still try our best to please him.
translation_verse: Ama kusɔ nɛ an baŋ yili e la fanɛ anyeeŋ baa wora mbe aparsheŋ. K maŋ tir ŋko an wɔ epe nfe ashi anyi be eyur ere to ŋko an wɔ kufɔ nna.

english_verse: After all, Christ will judge each of us for the good or the bad that we do while living in these bodies. Bringing People to God
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, kachako an kikɛ beeŋ yili Kristo be anishito nɛ e ji anyi demu. Ekama beeŋ nya kusɔ nɛ k daga mo ŋkpal kusɔ nɛ amodoŋwura wora ashi mbe eyur ere to so, kelela ŋko kulubi. Kenamba abar so be kubɔya be asheŋ

english_verse: We know what it means to respect the Lord, and we encourage everyone to turn to him. God himself knows what we are like, and I hope you also know what kind of people we are.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal anyi alɛ ka nyi kusɔ nɛ baa tre Ebɔrɛ be kaŋana na so, anyee wora ania nna ga a chɛ basa to nɛ b pin kusɔ nɛ k wɔtɔ. Ebɔrɛ e nyi kananɛ an du nɛnɛ nɛ ma alɛ bee tama fanɛ loŋ nɛ menyi alɛ gba nyi anyi ashi men be ŋgbene to.

english_verse: We are not trying once more to brag about ourselves. But we want you to be proud of us, when you are with those who are not sincere and brag about what others think of them.
translation_verse: To, kede bee ŋini fanɛ an naa sha kekpaŋ anyi be amu nna n sa menyi ŋko? Ayai, kusɔ nɛ anyee wora e la fanɛ anyee sa menyi ekpa nna nɛ men kpal anyi so n ji njɔŋ. Saŋɛ na so, menyeeŋ tiŋ n nya kusɔ ko ŋ kaŋɛ basa nɛ baa keni dimɛdi be eyilikpa nawule so a ji njɔŋ nsaa maa keni kusɔ nɛ k wɔ kagbene to na.

english_verse: If we seem out of our minds, it is between God and us. But if we are in our right minds, it is for your good.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, nɛ an baa maa kɔ nfɛra, keshuŋ Ebɔrɛ so nɛ anyi maŋ kɔ nfɛra, nɛ anyi alɛ naa kɔ anyi be nfɛra kleembi, menyi so nɛ an kɔ amo.

english_verse: We are ruled by Christ's love for us. We are certain that if one person died for everyone else, then all of us have died.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, Kristo be kasha e kɔ anyi a wora asheŋ ŋkpal an ka baa nyi geeŋ fanɛ esa koŋwule e yili ekama be katelamu to n wu so so. Kumo e la fanɛ ekama malɛ e wu.

english_verse: And Christ did die for all of us. He died so we would no longer live for ourselves, but for the one who died and was raised to life for us.
translation_verse: Mo alɛ wu nna n sa ekama, saŋɛ na so, bumo nɛ b wɔ ŋkpa to na maaŋ naa wɔtɔ ŋkpal bumo gbagba be amuana so, ama baaŋ baa wɔtɔ nna ŋkpal esa nɛ e kpal bumo so n wu nɛ Ebɔrɛ tiŋi mo luwu na to na so.

english_verse: We are careful not to judge people by what they seem to be, though we once judged Christ in this way.
translation_verse: Amoso, naniere mannɛ dimɛdi be kaplɛa so nɛ an naa bɔla so a keni kananɛ esa du. Saŋko bre, loŋ nɛ an daa keni Kristo na, ama naniere bre anyi maŋ naa keni mo loŋ.

english_verse: Anyone who belongs to Christ is a new person. The past is forgotten, and everything is new.
translation_verse: Amoso, nɛ esa kama baa wɔ Kristo na to, kepɔrso popɔr e la mo, asheŋ dra na kikɛ choŋ nɛ asheŋ popɔr ba.

english_verse: God has done it all! He sent Christ to make peace between himself and us, and he has given us the work of making peace between himself and others.
translation_verse: Le be asheŋ ere malɛ kikɛ shi Ebɔrɛ nɛ e bɔla Kristo so n shin nɛ anyi nɛ mo ere Ebɔrɛ naŋ nyalɛ nseŋ ta mo nɛ basa be kenyalɛ be kushuŋ m bɔɔ anyi enɔ na kutɔ nna.

english_verse: What we mean is that God was in Christ, offering peace and forgiveness to the people of this world. And he has given us the work of sharing his message about peace.
translation_verse: Kumo e la fanɛ Kristo so nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ bɔla ŋ kplaŋ durnya be alubi so nseŋ shin nɛ mo nɛ basa naŋ nyalɛ. Ama kananɛ e bee shin nɛ mo nɛ basa bee nyalɛ be kubɔya nɛ e ta m bɔɔ anyi enɔ.

english_verse: We were sent to speak for Christ, and God is begging you to listen to our message. We speak for Christ and sincerely ask you to make peace with God.
translation_verse: Amoso, anyi e la Ebɔrɛ be katelamushuŋipoana a du fanɛ basa nɛ Ebɔrɛ bee bɔla bumo so a kule menyi nsaa fiɛ menyi so. Amoso, anyee ta Kristo be ketre nna a kule menyi ga fanɛ: Men shin nɛ menyi nɛ Ebɔrɛ e naaŋ nyalɛ.

english_verse: Christ never sinned! But God treated him as a sinner, so Christ could make us acceptable to God.
translation_verse: Anyi so nɛ Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ mo ere, esa nɛ e maŋ nyi kulubi na ki kulubi, saŋɛ na so mo so nɛ anyeeŋ ki Ebɔrɛ be anishito be belelapo.

english_verse: We work together with God, and we beg you to make good use of God's gift of undeserved grace.
translation_verse: Naniere anyi nɛ Ebɔrɛ ka bee shuŋ ere, anyee kule nsaa fiɛ menyi so nna fanɛ men sa maa sɔ Ebɔrɛ be kuwɔr be kakɛ na kenyanyaŋɛso.

english_verse: In the Scriptures God says, “When the time came, I listened to you, and when you needed help, I came to save you.” That time has come. This is the day for you to be saved.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ bee kaŋɛ fanɛ: “Ma kepar be kachɛ nɛ n nu men be ebɔl, nseŋ naŋ chɛ menyi to kumɔlgaachɛ na.” To, ma alɛ e naa kaŋɛ menyi na fanɛ naniere e la Ebɔrɛ be kepar be kachɛ, kabre e la kumɔlga be kachɛ na.

english_verse: We don't want anyone to find fault with our work, and so we try hard not to cause problems.
translation_verse: An maa sha esa kama ka wu anyi be kushuŋ ere kulubi, amoso, anyi maa sha keta shɛŋ shɛŋ ŋ kagle esa kama ekpa.

english_verse: But in everything and in every way we show we truly are God's servants. We have always been patient, though we have had a lot of trouble, suffering, and hard times.
translation_verse: Ama kusɔ kama nɛ anyee wora, anyee ta kanyitigboŋ nna a nyiti etɔrɔ nɛ kebaawɔtɔ kpakpaso nɛ kekɔrfɛ ŋkpal an ka la Ebɔrɛ be beshumpo na so.

english_verse: We have been beaten, put in jail, and hurt in riots. We have worked hard and have gone without sleep or food.
translation_verse: B daŋ kebri anyi n ti anyi ebu n shɛr agboso ŋ kulti anyi, an shuŋ m baŋ anyi be amu so ŋ gal edi nseŋ di akoŋ malɛ gba.

english_verse: But we have kept ourselves pure and have been understanding, patient, and kind. The Holy Spirit has been with us, and our love has been real.
translation_verse: An bɔla an be kebaawɔtɔ nɛ k maŋ kɔ eyurpi so nɛ anyi be kanyiasheŋ so nɛ anyi be kanyitiso nɛ anyi be kebaala basa so ŋ ŋini fanɛ an la Ebɔrɛ be beshumpo nna ashi Kiyoyu Cheeŋ nɛ kashenteŋ be kasha to.

english_verse: We have spoken the truth, and God's power has worked in us. In all our struggles we have said and done only what is right.
translation_verse: Amo alɛ nseŋ naŋ shi kashenteŋ be kamalga nɛ Ebɔrɛ be eleŋ to. An kɔ Ebɔrɛ be anishito be alelasheŋ nna fanɛ akɔsɔ a ta bena nɛ jiso a kɔ.

english_verse: Whether we were honored or dishonored or praised or cursed, we always told the truth about ourselves. But some people said we did not.
translation_verse: Basa bee bunyaŋ anyi nsaa ŋaba anyi, baa tege anyi nsaa chɔrɔ anyi, baa tre anyi befɛpo nɛ anyi alɛ bee ji kashenteŋ.

english_verse: We are unknown to others, but well known to you. We seem to be dying, and yet we are still alive. We have been punished, but never killed,
translation_verse: B yɛ basa maŋ nyi anyi nɛ basa damta malɛ nyi anyi nɛnɛ, b yɛ anyee wu nna, ama anyi alɛ baa wɔ ŋkpa to nna a yɔ, baa gberge anyi kusoe, ama anyi alɛ maa wu.

english_verse: and we are always happy, even in times of suffering. Although we are poor, we have made many people rich. And though we own nothing, everything is ours.
translation_verse: An wɔ kagbenejija to, ama an be ŋgbene malɛ baa fuli anyi nna saŋkikɛ. Betirpo e la anyi, ama saŋkikɛ anyi alɛ bee wɔtɔ basa dama to nna. Anyi maŋ kɔ shɛŋ, anyi alɛ nsaa kɔ asɔ kikɛ.

english_verse: Friends in Corinth, we are telling the truth when we say there is room in our hearts for you.
translation_verse: Kɔrintebi, an bugi to nna m malga asheŋ ere n sa menyi na nɛ anyi alɛ be ŋgbene malɛ baŋ bugi n sa menyi.

english_verse: We are not holding back on our love for you, but you are holding back on your love for us.
translation_verse: Anyi maa ta anyi be kasha a ŋana menyi so, menyi ere e naa ta menyeya a ŋana anyi so.

english_verse: I speak to you as I would speak to my own children. Please make room in your hearts for us. The Temple of the Living God
translation_verse: Naniere mee malga nna a sa menyi fanɛ ma mbia gbagba fanɛ men baa kɔ kasha koŋwule mo nɛ an kɔ a sa menyi na a sa anyi alɛ gba. Men bugi men be ŋgbene kikɛ to. Kananɛ k maŋ daga fanɛ b baa wea nnyamase be asheŋ to be asheŋ

english_verse: Stay away from people who are not followers of the Lord! Can someone who is good get along with someone who is evil? Are light and darkness the same?
translation_verse: Men sa maŋ shin nɛ menyi nɛ bumo nɛ b maŋ la bebɛsopo e baa gama a wora asheŋ fanɛ men kurgepoana, ŋkpal manɛ so, manɛ e wɔ kelela nɛ kulubi be nferinto? Ŋko nuso nɛ kefulto nɛ tentembiri bee wora asheŋ abar so?

english_verse: Is Christ a friend of Satan? Can people who follow the Lord have anything in common with those who don't?
translation_verse: Nuso nɛ Kristo nɛ alubipo Beelial na bee wora a kɔ kɔnɔkoŋwule a wɔtɔ? Manɛ e wɔ ebɛsopo nɛ emo nɛ e maŋ la ebɛsopo be nferinto?

english_verse: Do idols belong in the temple of God? We are the temple of the living God, as God himself says, “I will live with these people and walk among them. I will be their God, and they will be my people.”
translation_verse: Manɛ be ŋkre e wɔ Ebɔrɛ be lambu nɛ agbirana be nferinto? Ŋkpal manɛ so, anyi e la Ebɔrɛ nɛ e wɔ ŋkpa to na be lambu. Kumo be asheŋ nɛ Ebɔrɛ malɛ gba kaŋɛ na fanɛ: “Meeŋ baa wɔ bumo to nsaa na bumo to a la bumo be Ebɔrɛ nɛ bumo alɛ e baa la ma basa.

english_verse: The Lord also says, “Leave them and stay away! Don't touch anything that isn't clean. Then I will welcome you
translation_verse: Amoso ma, Enyɛnpe na e naa yɛ menyi na fanɛ men lara men be amu ashi bumo to a kɔr to. Men sa maŋ kaa beta kusɔ kama nɛ k kɔ eyurpi nɛ n sɔ menyi.

english_verse: and be your Father. You will be my sons and my daughters, as surely as I am God, the All-Powerful.”
translation_verse: Ma, Enyɛnpetale e naa yɛ menyi na fanɛ meeŋ baa la men tuto nɛ menyi alɛ e baa la ma mbinyɛnsoana nɛ mbichesoana.”

english_verse: My friends, God has made us these promises. So we should stay away from everything that keeps our bodies and spirits from being clean. We should honor God and try to be completely like him. The Church Makes Paul Happy
translation_verse: N teri shasoana, ŋkpal an ka kɔ le be nnɔ nasesoana ere kikɛ so, men shin nɛ an fɔr kusɔ kama nɛ k bee sa dimɛdi be eyur nɛ mbe kiyoyu eyurpi n lɛ ŋkeŋ shin nɛ an baa pere kenishi a sha kebaaki cheembi nɛnɛ a wɔ Ebɔrɛ be kaŋana be kebaawɔtɔ to. Pɔɔl be kagbenefuli be asheŋ

english_verse: Make a place for us in your hearts! We haven't mistreated or hurt anyone. We haven't cheated anyone.
translation_verse: Men shin nɛ an be asheŋ e baa wɔ men be ŋgbene to. Anyi maŋ wora esa kikɛ kulubi, anyi maŋ jija esa kama, anyi alɛ maŋ naŋ ta esa kama n nyalɛ.

english_verse: I am not saying this to be hard on you. But, as I have said before, you will always be in our thoughts, whether we live or die.
translation_verse: M maŋ malga kesheŋ nɛ m malga ere nna nɛ n wu menyi kulubi, ŋkpal manɛ so, n teŋ kaŋɛ menyi fanɛ men be asheŋ wɔ anyi be ŋgbene to ga, amoso, anyeeŋ tiŋ a wɔtɔ ŋko n wu n sa menyi.

english_verse: I trust you completely. I am always proud of you, and I am greatly encouraged. In all my trouble I am still very happy.
translation_verse: Ma yirda shi menyi so ga nɛ mee ji njɔŋ ga ŋkpal menyi so. Ma kagbene kikɛ baa dese ma nna, hale anyi be kekɔrfɛ ere kikɛ to, ma kagbene baŋ fuli ma nna parr.

english_verse: After we came to Macedonia, we didn't have any chance to rest. We were faced with all kinds of problems. We were troubled by enemies and troubled by fears.
translation_verse: Hale an ka ba Masɛdonia, anyi be eyurana ere maŋ nya ewushi kikɛ. Anyi nɛ kekɔrfɛ e daa la kaplɛkama, anyi nɛ basa be nlu malɛ e daa la nɛ kufu malɛ daŋ bɔlɔ anyi be ŋgbene to.

english_verse: But God cheers up people in need, and this is what he did when he sent Titus to us.
translation_verse: Ama Ebɔrɛ nɛ e bee wushi kagbenejijawuraana na, wushi anyi be ŋgbene ŋkpal Taites ka ba so.

english_verse: Of course, we were glad to see Titus, but what really made us glad is the way you cheered him up. He told how sorry you were and how concerned you were about me. And this made me even happier.
translation_verse: Ama mannɛ mbe keba nawule so, mbe kubɔya nɛ e bar m ba kaŋɛ kananɛ men leŋ mo to na gba wushi anyi be ŋgbene n ti so. E kaŋɛ anyi kananɛ men baa sha kewu ma be asheŋ, kananɛ men be ŋgbene jija menyi ga be asheŋ nɛ kananɛ men yili ma kaman ŋ kɔ n sa ma be asheŋ. Ade kikɛ so ma kagbene baŋ naŋ fuli ma nna n ti so.

english_verse: I don't feel bad anymore, even though my letter hurt your feelings. I did feel bad at first, but I don't now. I know that the letter hurt you for a while.
translation_verse: Hale nɛ kawɔl nɛ n sibɛ na daŋ jija men be ŋgbene gba, m maa kaŋɛ fanɛ n daa nyi m maŋ sibɛ kumo. Saŋko bre k daŋ wora ma kanaŋ ko, ŋkpal manɛ so, n wu fanɛ kawɔl na daŋ jija men be ŋgbene, kumo alɛ saŋɛ gbrɛbi ko nɛ k daŋ ta menyi.

english_verse: Now I am happy, but not because I hurt your feelings. It is because God used your hurt feelings to make you turn back to him, and none of you were harmed by us.
translation_verse: Ama naniere ma kagbene fuli ma nna, mannɛ men be ŋgbene ka daŋ jija na so, ama ma kagbene fuli ma nna ŋkpal men be kagbenejija na ka shin nɛ men lar men be alubi to so. Amoso, men be kagbenejija na daa la kusɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ yili nna, amoso, menyi maŋ paŋ shɛŋ ashi ekpa kama so ŋkpal anyi so.

english_verse: When God makes you feel sorry enough to turn to him and be saved, you don't have anything to feel bad about. But when this world makes you feel sorry, it can cause your death.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, kagbenejija mo nɛ k bee par Ebɔrɛ bee bar kagbenechɛrga nna a yɛr esa kumɔlga to, k maa bar ‘n daa nyi’. Ama durnya ere to be kagbenejija bre bee bar luwu nna.

english_verse: When I wrote you, it wasn't to accuse the one who was wrong or to take up for the one who was hurt. I wrote, so God would show you how much you do care for us.
translation_verse: Amoso, kashenteŋ nna nɛ n sibɛ menyi kawɔl na, ama mannɛ esa nɛ e wora n da so na so ŋko esa nɛ b wora n da mo so na so nɛ n daŋ sibɛ kumo, n daŋ sibɛ kumo nna nɛ men pin ashi Ebɔrɛ be anishito fanɛ kananɛ men be ŋgbene wɔ anyi so.

english_verse: And we were greatly encouraged. Although we were encouraged, we felt even better when we saw how happy Titus was, because you had shown he had nothing to worry about.
translation_verse: To, kusɔ nɛ k baŋ leŋ anyi to ga nna na. Ama kusɔ nɛ k ti anyi be keleŋto ere so e la fanɛ anyi be ŋgbene fuli anyi ga ŋkpal Taites be kagbenefuliso Mbe kagbene baŋ fuli mo nna ŋkpal men kikɛ ka daŋ wushi mo kagbene so.

english_verse: We had told him how much we thought of you, and you did not disappoint us. Just as we have always told you the truth, so everything we told him about you has also proved to be true.
translation_verse: N daŋ ji men be njɔŋ n sa mo, kashenteŋto malɛ, men maŋ ta anishinyɔr m mɔ ma. Men nyi fanɛ saŋkikɛ kashenteŋ nɛ anyee malga a sa menyi. Kumo koŋwule na nɛ njɔŋ mo nɛ n ji n sa Taites na bɔla ekpa na.

english_verse: Titus loves all of you very much, especially when he remembers how you obeyed him and how you trembled with fear when you welcomed him.
translation_verse: Mo gbagba malɛ be kasha nɛ e kɔ a sa menyi baa ti so nna ŋkpal kananɛ e bee nyiŋi menyi kikɛ be kasonu so nɛ kananɛ men daŋ ta kufu nɛ kechicha chicha n sɔ mo na so.

english_verse: It makes me really glad to know I can depend on you.
translation_verse: K par ma ga fanɛ meeŋ tiŋ n yirda menyi ashi ekpa kama so.

english_verse: My friends, we want you to know that the churches in Macedonia have shown others God's gift of undeserved grace.
translation_verse: To, an kurgepoana, naniere anyee sha fanɛ men pin kuwɔr be kakɛ mo nɛ Ebɔrɛ sa Masɛdonia be asɔriana na be asheŋ nna.

english_verse: They gave as much as they could afford and even more, simply because they wanted to.
translation_verse: Ma alɛ e kaŋɛ menyi kashenteŋto na fanɛ b sa kananɛ b tiŋ hale n ya baŋ kananɛ bumo be eleŋ sa gba so.

english_verse: They even asked and begged us to let them have the joy of giving their money for God's people.
translation_verse: Bumo gbagba be kasha so nɛ b kule anyi ga fanɛ baa sha fanɛ bumo alɛ gba e nya ekpa nna n tiŋ n chɛ Ebɔrɛ be basa to.

english_verse: And they did more than we had hoped. They gave themselves first to the Lord and then to us, just as God wanted them to do.
translation_verse: B wora m baŋ kusɔ nɛ an daa tama so, ŋkpal manɛ so, kusɔ nɛ k juŋkpar e la fanɛ b ta bumo be amu n sa Enyɛnpe na nseŋ naŋ bɔla Ebɔrɛ be eleŋ so n ta bumo be amu m bɔɔ anyi alɛ gba enɔ.

english_verse: Titus was the one who got you started doing this good thing, so we begged him to help you finish what you had begun.
translation_verse: Amoso, an kule Taites mo nɛ e teŋ fara le be kushuŋ ere na ga nna fanɛ e baa kraa wɔ kumo to loŋ a chɛ menyi to n ya loge men be le be kasha be kushuŋgboŋ ere.

english_verse: You do everything better than anyone else. You have stronger faith. You speak better and know more. You are eager to give, and you love us better. Now you must give more generously than anyone else.
translation_verse: Men juŋkpar ekama nna ashi kusɔ kama to, ashi yirda to nɛ mmalga to nɛ kanyiasheŋ to nɛ kagbene koŋwule be kebaawɔtɔ to nɛ kasha mo nɛ men kɔ a sha anyi na so. Amoso, anyee sha fanɛ men baa kɔ kakɛ be kagbene ashi le be kasha be kushuŋ ere to.

english_verse: I am not ordering you to do this. I am simply testing how real your love is by comparing it with the concern that others have shown.
translation_verse: Mannɛ fanɛ mee nase kamalga ko nna a sa menyi, ama mee wora menyi nna a keni nsaa ta men be kasha a ber basa ko be kagbene koŋwule be kebaawɔtɔ so nɛ m pin fanɛ men be kasha na la kashenteŋ peya nna a.

english_verse: You know our Lord Jesus Christ treated us with undeserved grace by giving up all his riches, so you could become rich.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, men nyi Kristo, Enyɛnpe Yesu be kuwɔr be kakɛ na be asheŋ, fanɛ e ka la damawura, ama menyi so nɛ e ki etirpo, saŋɛ na so menyeeŋ bɔla mbe ketir so ŋ ki damawuraana.

english_verse: I think you should finish what you started. If you give according to what you have, you will prove you are as eager to give as you were to think about giving.
translation_verse: To, naniere mee sha fanɛ men baa kɔ to nna n ya loge kumo. Kananɛ men baŋ bugi kagbene n yili kumo fanɛ menyeeŋ wora kesheŋ na, men naŋ ta loŋ be kagbene n loge kumo. Kusɔ kama malɛ nɛ men kɔ, men ta n wora kumo.

english_verse: It doesn't matter how much you have. What matters is how much you are willing to give from what you have.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, nɛ esa baŋ bugi kagbene n yili kumo fanɛ e beeŋ sa, kumo ere kusɔ nɛ amodoŋwura kɔ so nɛ Ebɔrɛ beeŋ yili n sɔ loŋ be kakɛ na, mannɛ kusɔ nɛ e maŋ kɔ so.

english_verse: I am not trying to make life easier for others by making life harder for you. But it is only fair
translation_verse: Men baa nyi fanɛ mannɛ fanɛ anyee sha ketɔrɔ menyi nna n shin nɛ beko bre e nu ebel. Ayai, kusɔ nɛ anyee sha e la fanɛ menyi kikɛ e baa sasa.

english_verse: for you to share with them when you have so much, and they have so little. Later, when they have more than enough, and you are in need, they can share with you. Then everyone will have a fair share,
translation_verse: Naniere bre menyi e kɔ ga nɛ men tiŋ n chɛ bumo nɛ b maŋ kɔ to, ama saŋko nɛ a tir menyi, bumo alɛ gba beeŋ lara bumo be kanya damta to n chɛ menyi to, saŋɛ na so men kikɛ sasa nna na.

english_verse: just as the Scriptures say, “Those who gathered too much had nothing left. Those who gathered only a little had all they needed.” Titus and His Friends
translation_verse: Fanɛ kananɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ na fanɛ: “Ekama nɛ e chala ga na maŋ nya m baŋ mbe kumu so, nɛ ekama malɛ nɛ e chala gbrɛbi nya nɛ a kukwe mo.” Keshuŋi Taites Kɔrint be asheŋ

english_verse: I am grateful that God made Titus care as much about you as we do.
translation_verse: Mee chɔrɔ Ebɔrɛ ga ŋkpal e ka ta kagbene koŋwule be kasha mo nɛ an kɔ a sa menyi na n wɔtɔ Taites be kagbene to so.

english_verse: When we begged Titus to visit you, he said he would. He wanted to because he cared so much for you.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, mannɛ fanɛ e baŋ sɔ kusɔ nɛ an kaŋɛ na nawule nna, ama mo gbagba be keparso nɛ e yili kumo kagbene koŋwuleso fanɛ e beeŋ yɔ menyi kutɔ.

english_verse: With Titus we are also sending one of the Lord's followers who is well known in every church for spreading the good news.
translation_verse: Esa nɛ anyee shuŋi n ti mo so e la ekurgepo mo nɛ e kɔ ketre ashi asɔriana na kikɛ to ŋkpal mbe baru lela na be kebɔ so.

english_verse: The churches chose this follower to travel with us while we carry this gift that will bring praise to the Lord and show how much we hope to help.
translation_verse: Ade malɛ be kaman mo nɛ asɔriana na kikɛ lara fanɛ e tu anyi n nite anyi be kasha be kushuŋ be enite nɛ anyee nite ere to nɛ an maŋkura Enyɛnpe gbagba na nseŋ naŋ ŋini ekama kananɛ an bugi kagbene a chɛ basa to.

english_verse: We don't want anyone to find fault with the way we handle your generous gift.
translation_verse: Anyee wora ania nna nɛ esa kama e sa maŋ kaŋ wu anyi kulubi ashi kakɛ gboŋgboŋi ere be kushuŋ to.

english_verse: We are also sending someone else with Titus and the other follower. We approve of this man. In fact, he has already shown us many times that he wants to help. And now he wants to help even more than ever, because he trusts you so much.
translation_verse: Esa nɛ an naŋ shuŋi n ti bumo so e la an kurgepo mo nɛ an wora ale damta ŋ keni n wu fanɛ e kɔ kagbene koŋwule be kasha ashi asheŋ damta to nna. Mo alɛ be loŋ be kagbene koŋwule be kebaawɔtɔ na naŋ wora keshi nna n ti so ŋkpal mbe yirdagboŋ nɛ k wɔ menyi so na so.

english_verse: Titus is my partner, who works with me to serve you. The other two followers are sent by the churches, and they bring honor to Christ.
translation_verse: Taites bre, m barkasa nna nɛ ma nɛ mo bee shuŋ nɛ an chɛ menyi to. Ama bekurgepo mo nɛ b tu mo a yɔ na bre, asɔriana na be katelamu to nɛ b yil a yɔ menyi kutɔ na a sa Kristo na kemaŋkura.

english_verse: Treat them in such a way that the churches will see your love and will know why we bragged about you.
translation_verse: Amoso, men ŋini bumo kasha, saŋɛ na so asɔriana na kikɛ beeŋ wu kumo geeŋ nseŋ pin fanɛ mannɛ jiga nna nɛ anyee puchi menyi so.

english_verse: I don't need to write you about the money you plan to give for God's people.
translation_verse: Kashenteŋto, naniere a maŋ naŋ daga ŋ ka naŋ sibɛ menyi ŋ kaŋɛ kechɛ Ebɔrɛ be basa to be kushuŋ ere be asheŋ.

english_verse: I know how eager you are to give. And I have proudly told the Lord's followers in Macedonia that you people in Achaia have been ready for a whole year. Now your desire to give has made them want to give.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, n nyi kananɛ men bugi kagbene a sha kechɛto, ma alɛ bee ji men be loŋ be njɔŋ a sa Masɛdoniaebi a kaŋɛ bumo fanɛ kafɛnde kikɛ nɛ menyi nɛ men wɔ Akaya ere fara n wora shiriya. Loŋ be kagbene koŋwule be kushuŋ malɛ sa galeŋga nfɛra nɛ b fara a wora kusɔ ko.

english_verse: This is why I am sending Titus and the two others to you. I want you to be ready, just as I promised. This will prove we were not wrong to brag about you.
translation_verse: To, mee shuŋi bekurgepo ere men kutɔ nna, saŋɛ na so anyi be njɔŋ mo nɛ anyee ji men be asheŋ kesheŋ ere to na maaŋ baa la mmalga fuloŋ nɛ men wora shiriya fanɛ kananɛ ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ menyeeŋ wora na.

english_verse: Some followers from Macedonia may come with me, and I want them to find that you have the money ready. If you don't, I would be embarrassed for trusting you to do this. But you would be embarrassed even more.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, nɛ mannɛ aloŋ nna nɛ Masɛdoniaebi ko tu anyi m ba men kutɔ m ba wu fanɛ men maŋ wora shiriya, anishinyɔr beeŋ pɛ anyi ga ŋkpal an ka ji men be njɔŋ ga le so, esa malɛ maŋ naa ji menyi gbagba be anishinyɔr be asheŋ.

english_verse: So I have decided to ask Titus and the others to spend some time with you before I arrive. This way they can arrange to collect the money you have promised. Then you will have the chance to give because you want to, and not because you feel forced to.
translation_verse: Amoso nɛ n wu fanɛ a daga fanɛ n shin nɛ bekurgepoana ere e juŋkpar ma n yɔ men kutɔ n ya shin nɛ men bela men be kakɛ gboŋgboŋi nɛ men nase kɔnɔ fanɛ menyeeŋ sa na n yili. Saŋɛ na so, kakɛ na beeŋ baa yil fanɛ kashaso be kakɛ, mannɛ fanɛ kanyaŋso be kakɛ.

english_verse: Remember this saying, “A few seeds make a small harvest, but a lot of seeds make a big harvest.”
translation_verse: Men baa nyiŋi fanɛ esa kama nɛ e bee duu asɔ miiriso, beeŋ teŋi miiriso be asɔ nna nɛ esa kama malɛ nɛ e bee duu asɔ damaso beeŋ teŋi asɔ damaso nna.

english_verse: Each of you must make up your own mind about how much to give. But don't feel sorry that you must give and don't feel you are forced to give. God loves people who love to give.
translation_verse: Kanaŋkama nɛ ekama fɛ mbe kagbene to fanɛ e beeŋ sa, e sa nsaa maa shin nɛ k naa besa mo ŋko a wora fanɛ b kaa bee tintiŋ mo na, ŋkpal manɛ so, esa nɛ e bee sa kagbenefuliso nɛ Ebɔrɛ bee sha.

english_verse: God can bless you with everything you need, and you will always have more than enough to do all kinds of good things for others.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ e naaŋ tiŋ n sa menyi asɔ a chɔ kananɛ menyee sha, saŋɛ na so saŋkikɛ menyeeŋ baa kɔ kusɔ kama nɛ menyee sha ekpa kama so nseŋ naa kɔ amo yɛlyɛla so a yɔ kushuŋ lela kama be ekpa so.

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “God freely gives his gifts to the poor, and always does right.”
translation_verse: Loŋ malɛ nɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ na fanɛ: “Mo e naa bugi kagbene a sa betirpo asɔ, mbe kelela malɛ maŋ kɔ ekar.”

english_verse: God gives seed to farmers and provides everyone with food. He will increase what you have, so you can give even more to those in need.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ nɛ e bee sa bedɔpo asɔ duuso nɛ baa duu nseŋ naa sa menyi kusɔ jiso koŋwule na e naaŋ sa menyi asɔ duuso kikɛ n shin nɛ a wora keshi n ti so nseŋ shin nɛ men nya kasɔteŋi damta ashi men be kelela to.

english_verse: You will be blessed in every way, and you will be able to keep on being generous. Then many people will thank God when we deliver your gift.
translation_verse: Ekpa kama so, e beeŋ shin nɛ men baa la damawuraana a sha kebaakɛ basa asɔ saŋkikɛ, saŋɛ na so basa damta beeŋ baa chɔrɔ Ebɔrɛ ŋkpal men be kakɛ mo nɛ baa nya ashi anyi be enɔ to so so.

english_verse: What you are doing is much more than a service that supplies God's people with what they need. It is something that will make many others thank God.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, kushuŋ nɛ menyee wora ere maa sa Ebɔrɛ be basa asɔ nɛ a daga bumo nawule nna, ama ekpa damtaana so gba nɛ k bee shin nɛ basa bee bɔla a chɔrɔ Ebɔrɛ.

english_verse: The way in which you have proved yourselves by this service will bring honor and praise to God. You believed the message about Christ, and you obeyed it by sharing generously with God's people and with everyone else.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal menyi alɛ be kushuŋ lela nɛ men shuŋ ŋ ŋini basa nɛ men la ere so, basa beeŋ chɔrɔ Ebɔrɛ ŋkpal men ka ta kasonu n ti men be shɛda mo nɛ menyee ji a kaŋɛ Kristo be baru lela na be asheŋ na so nɛ kananɛ menyee sha kebaakɛ bumo nɛ basa kama men be kanya to be asɔ na so.

english_verse: Now they are praying for you and want to see you, because God used you to bless them so very much.
translation_verse: Amoso, b baa kule Ebɔrɛ a sa menyi, bumo be nfɛra wɔ menyi so nna ŋkpal Ebɔrɛ be kuwɔr be kakɛgboŋ damta nɛ Ebɔrɛ ta n sa menyi na so.

english_verse: Thank God for his gift that is too wonderful for words!
translation_verse: Anyee chɔrɔ Ebɔrɛ ga ŋkpal mbe kakɛ gboŋgboŋi nɛ esa maaŋ tiŋ n ji kumo be asheŋ ere so.

english_verse: Do you think I am a coward when I am with you and brave when I am far away? Well, I ask you to listen, because Christ himself was humble and gentle.
translation_verse: Ma, Pɔɔl gbagba nɛ b yɛ: “E baa wɔ men kutɔ e la bawala nna, ama nɛ e baa wɔ kufɔ e bee ŋini mbe kenyɛn nna”, mee kule menyi nna ŋkpal Kristo be kebaala esa nɛ bawala so fanɛ:

english_verse: Some people have said we act like the people of this world. So when I arrive, I expect I will have to be firm and forceful in what I say to them. Please don't make me treat you that way.
translation_verse: Men jande, men sa maŋ shin nɛ ŋ kaŋ ba nɛ m ba ŋini menyi ma kenyɛn fanɛ kananɛ m baa nyi geeŋ fanɛ meeŋ ŋini basa nɛ baa fɛ fanɛ durnya ere to be ekpaana so nɛ an kɔ a wora asheŋ na.

english_verse: We live in this world, but we don't act like its people
translation_verse: Kashenteŋ nna fanɛ durnya ere to nɛ an wɔ, ama mannɛ durnya ere to be kena nɛ anyee kɔ.

english_verse: or fight our battles with the weapons of this world. Instead, we use God's power that can destroy fortresses. We destroy arguments
translation_verse: Asɔ nɛ an kɔ a kɔ na maŋ la durnya ere to be akɔsɔ. A la Ebɔrɛ be akɔsɔ lempoana nɛ b kɔ a jija asɔ lempoana na nna.

english_verse: and every bit of pride that keeps anyone from knowing God. We capture people's thoughts and make them obey Christ.
translation_verse: Amo nɛ an kɔ a jija emɔrɔana nɛ kamoowu be kusɔ kama nɛ k bee kuŋ esa kepin Ebɔrɛ be ekpa nseŋ naa kɔ amo a pɔɔ nfɛra fɛso lubiana so a shin nɛ a bee nu a sa Kristo.

english_verse: And when you completely obey him, we will punish anyone who refuses to obey.
translation_verse: Nɛ men baa maa tɔr kasonu be kaplɛa so, anyi alɛ gba wora shiriya fanɛ anyeeŋ gberge kasomaanuwuraana kama kusoe.

english_verse: You judge by appearances. If any of you think you are the only ones who belong to Christ, then think again. We belong to Christ as much as you do.
translation_verse: Asheŋ be kaman nɛ menyi ere bee keni, ama esa kama nɛ e baa nyi geeŋ fanɛ e la Kristo peya nna, amodoŋwura na e baa nyi fanɛ kananɛ e baa la Kristo peya na, loŋ nɛ anyi alɛ gba la mo peya.

english_verse: Maybe I brag a little too much about the authority that the Lord gave me to help you and not to hurt you. Yet I am not embarrassed to brag.
translation_verse: Hale nɛ m puchi eleŋ nɛ Enyɛnpe sa anyi fanɛ an ta a chɛ menyi to nɛ men baa yɔ anishito, mannɛ fanɛ an ta n jija menyi na so n ti so gba, k maaŋ pɛ ma anishinyɔr kikɛ.

english_verse: And I am not trying to scare you with my letters.
translation_verse: M maa sha fanɛ k baa du fanɛ ŋ kɔ ma nwɔl nna a funti menyi.

english_verse: Some of you are saying, “Paul's letters are harsh and powerful. But in person, he is a weakling and has nothing worth saying.”
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, loŋ nɛ beko bee kaŋɛ fanɛ: “Mbe mmalga nɛ a wɔ mbe nwɔl to wɔ egbɛ nsaa kɔ eleŋ, ama fo wu mo gbagba kenishiso, e maŋ la elempo, mbe kɔnɔ to be mmalga malɛ maŋ kɔ shɛŋ.”

english_verse: Those people had better understand that when I am with you, I will do exactly what I say in my letters.
translation_verse: Men shin nɛ loŋ be basa na e baa nyi fanɛ asheŋ nɛ an baa malga nwɔl to saŋɛ nɛ an maŋ wɔtɔ na koŋwule na nɛ anyeeŋ wora saŋɛ nɛ an wɔtɔ gba.

english_verse: We won't brag about something we don't have a right to brag about. We will only brag about the work God has sent us to do, and you are part of that work.
translation_verse: Ama anyi ere maaŋ ji njɔŋ m baŋ kananɛ k daga so. Kakpa nɛ Ebɔrɛ sa anyi eleŋ n ya fo nɛ anyee tar nɛ an tiŋ n fo menyi.

english_verse: We are not bragging more than we should. After all, we did bring the message about Christ to you.
translation_verse: Nɛ an daa maŋ fo menyi, an be keji njɔŋ daa maaŋ baa kɔ ekpa. Ama anyi alɛ ta Kristo be baru lela na n fo menyi.

english_verse: We don't brag about what others have done, as if we had done those things ourselves. But I hope as you become stronger in your faith, we will be able to reach many more of the people around you. That has always been our goal.
