translation_verse: Anyi alɛ maa kpal kushuŋ mo nɛ basa pɔtɛ shuŋ so nna a puchi a baŋ anyi be amu so. Anyi be tama kikɛ e baa la fanɛ nɛ men be yirda baa wora keshi a yɔ anishito, kakpa nɛ an wɔ menyi to a shuŋ na malɛ beeŋ baa wora keshi a ti so.

english_verse: Then we will be able to preach the good news in other lands where we cannot take credit for work someone else has already done.
translation_verse: Saŋɛ na so, anyeeŋ tiŋ m bɔ kubɔya na nsawule mo nɛ a wɔ men be anishitoana na so. Ŋkpal manɛ so, anyi maa sha kepuchi kushuŋ kama nɛ b teŋ wora esa ko be kakpa so.

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “If you want to brag, then brag about the Lord.”
translation_verse: Kumo alɛ nɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ na fanɛ: “Esa kama nɛ e bee puchi, e puchi Enyɛnpe nawule so.”

english_verse: You may brag about yourself, but the only approval that counts is the Lord's approval.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, mannɛ esa nɛ e bee chɔrɔ mbe kumu e kɔ ekpa, ama esa nɛ Enyɛnpe bee chɔrɔ e kɔ ekpa.

english_verse: But now I fear that you will be tricked, just as Eve was tricked by that lying snake. I am afraid that you might stop thinking about Christ in an honest and sincere way.
translation_verse: Ama men be asheŋ bee keta ma kufu fanɛ nɛ men maŋ de so, kananɛ kusɔkpaŋ na daŋ ta mbe nambara n fule Hawa na, loŋ koŋwule na nɛ e beeŋ lara men be nfɛra ashi kagbene koŋwule be Kristo be kasha cheembi to.

english_verse: We told you about Jesus, and you received the Holy Spirit and accepted our message. But you let some people tell you about another Jesus. Now you are ready to receive another spirit and accept a different message.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, esa baŋ ba men kutɔ m ba malga Yesu pɔtɛ ko nɛ e maŋ la Yesu mo nɛ an malga mbe asheŋ na malɛ be asheŋ ŋko nɛ men baŋ nya kiyoyu pɔtɛ ko nɛ e maŋ la emo nɛ men daŋ nya na nna ŋko baru lela pɔtɛ ko nna nɛ k maŋ la kumo nɛ men daŋ sɔ na, menyee sɔ kumo nna manaŋ manaŋ.

english_verse: I think I am as good as any of those super apostles.
translation_verse: Ma alɛ bee tama fanɛ men be beshuŋipo mo nɛ baa tre beshuŋipogboŋana ere maŋ chɔ ma gbrɛ kama gba.

english_verse: I may not speak as well as they do, but I know as much. And this has already been made perfectly clear to you.
translation_verse: Hale nɛ m maŋ la esa nɛ e nyi kamalga to gba, kanyiasheŋ bre, ŋ kɔ kumo, anyi alɛ bɔla ekpa kama so n lara le be kanyiasheŋ ere ŋ ŋini menyi ashi kusɔ kama to.

english_verse: I robbed other churches by taking money from them to serve you.
translation_verse: Asɔriana ko nɛ n daŋ suge a wɔtɔ a shuŋ menyi, ŋkpal manɛ so, n daa nya kechɛto nna ashi bumo kutɔ.

english_verse: Even when I was in need, I still didn't bother you. In fact, some of the Lord's followers from Macedonia brought me what I needed. I have not been a burden to you in the past, and I will never be a burden.
translation_verse: Saŋɛ nɛ n daa wɔ menyi kutɔ na nɛ k ba fanɛ n daa sha kusɔ ko, m maŋ dese menyi so, ŋkpal manɛ so, bekurgepo mo nɛ b daŋ shi Masɛdonia na e daa sa ma kumo. N daa maa sha fanɛ n dese menyi so ekpa kama so, ma alɛ maaŋ dese menyi so kikɛ.

english_verse: As surely as I speak the truth about Christ, no one in Achaia can stop me from bragging about this.
translation_verse: Kananɛ Kristo be kashenteŋ baa wɔ ma to ere bre, esa kama maŋ wɔ Akaya be kasawule so kikɛ nɛ e lo ma kɔnɔ fanɛ n sa maŋ ji njɔŋ mo nɛ mee ji ere.

english_verse: And it isn't because I don't love you. God himself knows how much I do love you.
translation_verse: Manɛ e ba nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ loŋ ere? Ŋ ka maa sha menyi so a? Ayai, Ebɔrɛ gba nyi ŋ ka bee sha menyi!

english_verse: I plan to go on doing just what I have always done. Then those people won't be able to brag about doing the same things we are doing.
translation_verse: Ma alɛ beeŋ baa kraa wɔtɔ a wora asɔ nɛ mee wora ere, saŋɛ na so, meeŋ kuŋ bumo nɛ baa fin ekpa nɛ b puchi ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ anyi nɛ bumo bee shuŋ nna a sasa na ekpa.

english_verse: Anyway, they are no more than false apostles and dishonest workers. They only pretend to be apostles of Christ.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, loŋ be basa na la beshuŋipo fɛpoana nna nseŋ naa la beshumpo nɛ baa fule basa nɛ b wɔtɔ a ta bumo be amu fanɛ Kristo be beshuŋipoana na.

english_verse: And it is no wonder. Even Satan tries to make himself look like an angel of light.
translation_verse: Kumo alɛ maŋ la mamachi be kesheŋ ko nna, ŋkpal manɛ so, Setani gba bee kaa wora mbe kumu fanɛ kefultoso be malaika.

english_verse: So why does it seem strange for Satan's servants to pretend to do what is right? Someday they will get exactly what they deserve. Paul's Sufferings for Christ
translation_verse: Amoso, nɛ mbe anya gba bee wora bumo be amu fanɛ Ebɔrɛ be anishito be alelasheŋ be anya, k maŋ la ashenfɔ. Bumo be lalaloge be tɔnɔ beeŋ ba shi bumo be aworbi to nna. Pɔɔl ka bee puchi mbe etɔrɔ be asheŋ

english_verse: I don't want any of you to think I am a fool. But if you do, then let me be a fool and brag a little.
translation_verse: Men shin nɛ n naŋ lɔŋɛ ŋ kaŋɛ menyi fanɛ ekama e sa maŋ kaŋ tre ma ewulpo kikɛ. Nɛ ekama nɛ e tre ma loŋ gba, amodoŋwura e baa kɔ ma to loŋ, saŋɛ na so meeŋ nya ekpa gbrɛ m puchi.

english_verse: When I do all this bragging, I do it as a fool and not for the Lord.
translation_verse: Men baa nyi fanɛ kusɔ nɛ mee kaŋɛ naniere maŋ la kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe na bee kaŋɛ fanɛ ŋ kaŋɛ, ŋkpal manɛ so, mee puchi nna a malga fanɛ ewulpo.

english_verse: Yet if others want to brag about what they have done, so will I.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, kananɛ basa damta baa kɔ durnya be asɔ a puchi na, loŋ koŋwule na nɛ ma alɛ gba beeŋ puchi.

english_verse: And since you are so smart, you will gladly put up with a fool.
translation_verse: Menyi ere ka la benyiashempoana na so, menyee tiŋ a nyiti bewulpo.

english_verse: In fact, you let people make slaves of you and cheat you and steal from you. Why, you even let them strut around and slap you in the face.
translation_verse: Kashenteŋto, menyee tiŋ a nyiti ekama nɛ e bee ta menyi fanɛ anya ŋko ekama nɛ e bee ji menyi so ŋko emo nɛ e bee dese kasawule a nya menyi ŋko emo nɛ e bee keni menyi a bɔl ŋko emo nɛ e bee kpa menyi etaŋ.

english_verse: I am ashamed to say we are too weak to behave in such a way. If they can brag, so can I, but it is a foolish thing to do.
translation_verse: Kashenteŋto, n shuli kejija fanɛ anyi ere ka daa maŋ tiŋ n nya kagbene n wora loŋ. Ama kusɔ kama nɛ esa kama beeŋ tiŋ n nya kagbene m puchi kumo so, mee malga fanɛ ewulpo nna na, ma alɛ gba beeŋ tiŋ n nya kagbene m puchi loŋ!

english_verse: Are they Hebrews? So am I. Are they Jews? So am I. Are they from the family of Abraham? Well, so am I.
translation_verse: Mannɛ Hibruwebi e la bumo a? To, eko e la ma alɛ gba. Mannɛ Israɛlebi e la bumo a? To, eko e la ma alɛ gba. Mannɛ Eebraham mo nanabiana e la bumo a? To, eko e la ma alɛ gba.

english_verse: Are they servants of Christ? I am a fool to talk this way, but I serve him better than they do. I have worked harder and have been put in jail more times. I have been beaten with whips more and have been in danger of death more often.
translation_verse: Mannɛ Kristo be anya e la bumo a? Keni ŋ kaa bee malga fanɛ ebompo loŋ, ama ma loŋ be kenyaya chɔ bumo peya. N shuŋ ga a chɔ bumo be ekama nɛ b ti ma ebu a chɔ bumo be ekama, b kuya ma so a chɔ bumo be ekama, saŋɛ damta ma alɛ bee taga luwu to a chɔ bumo be ekama.

english_verse: Five times my own people gave me
translation_verse: Ela anu nɛ Juwebi sa ma ale adesa nɛ akpanu be kekuyaso na.

english_verse: Three times the Romans beat me with a big stick, and once my enemies stoned me. I have been shipwrecked three times, and I even had to spend a night and a day in the sea.
translation_verse: Ela asa nɛ b ta bulala ŋ kuya ma so ŋ kpa ma ajembu kela koŋwule, ale asa nɛ n daa shin nɛ n ji nchu ekuloŋ to, kela koŋwule nɛ n ji kachɛ lelemu nɛ kanyɛ lelemu teku so.

english_verse: During my many travels, I have been in danger from rivers, robbers, my own people, and foreigners. My life has been in danger in cities, in deserts, at sea, and with people who only pretended to be the Lord's followers.
translation_verse: Saŋkikɛ enite to nɛ m baa wɔ a luri kachuji be kenishipere to a luri beyu to a luri kenishipere to ashi m braana Juwebi nɛ nnyamase to a luri kenishipere to ashi ndegboŋana to, a luri kenishipere to kiyi to a luri kenishipere to etekuana so nsaa luri kenishipere to bekurgepo fɛpoana to.

english_verse: I have worked and struggled and spent many sleepless nights. I have gone hungry and thirsty and often had nothing to eat. I have been cold from not having enough clothes to keep me warm.
translation_verse: Saŋkikɛ ma nɛ kegben nɛ kebaawɔtɔ kpakpaso e wɔtɔ. Saŋɛ damta ma nɛ kadigal nna, akoŋ mɔ ma nɛ achukoŋ pɛ ma. Saŋɛ damta m maŋ kɔ ajibi nɛ n ji saŋko nɛ n dese awo to saŋko m maaŋ ba kɔ asɔbuuso.

english_verse: Besides everything else, each day I am burdened down, worrying about all the churches.
translation_verse: Nɛ m maŋ naŋ ti asɔ ko gba n ti so, kachɛ kama be kafɔŋ nɛ ŋ kɔ a sa asɔriana kikɛ na shi ma so ga.

english_verse: When others are weak, I am weak too. When others are tricked into sin, I get angry.
translation_verse: Wanɛ e la epɔsopo nɛ m maaŋ tu amodoŋwura n luri mbe kapɔshi na to ŋko wanɛ e naaŋ tɔr alubi to nɛ ma kagbene maaŋ jija na?

english_verse: If I have to brag, I will brag about how weak I am.
translation_verse: Nɛ k ba fanɛ m puchi, asɔ nɛ a bee ŋini ma kapɔshi so nɛ mee puchi.

english_verse: God, the Father of our Lord Jesus, knows I am not lying. And God is to be praised forever!
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Yesu na be Ebɔrɛ nɛ mo Tuto nɛ e daga epaŋ be kedi saŋkikɛ na nyi fanɛ m maa fule nna.

english_verse: The governor of Damascus at the time of King Aretas had the city gates guarded, so he could capture me.
translation_verse: Ŋ ka daa wɔ Damaskɔs na, gomena mo nɛ e daa wɔ Ewura Aritas be kaseto na daŋ shin nɛ bekumpo ya kuŋ kade na be mbunaakpa nna fanɛ b pɛ ma.

english_verse: I have to brag. There is nothing to be gained by it, but I must brag about the visions and other things that the Lord has shown me.
translation_verse: A daga fanɛ m baa puchi hale nɛ k maŋ kɔ tɔnɔ gba. Ama naniere bre meeŋ malga ebɔrɛdareana nɛ kewuŋkaŋɛana nɛ Enyɛnpe sa na be asheŋ.

english_verse: I am planning to visit you for the third time. But I still won't make a burden of myself. What I really want is you, and not what you have. Children are not supposed to save up for their parents, but parents are supposed to take care of their children.
translation_verse: Ma keba mo nɛ n wora shiriya nɛ m ba bɔɔ menyi so ere e naa ti ma kela sasopo so, ma alɛ maa ba nna nɛ m ba kaa dese menyi so. Ŋkpal manɛ so, mannɛ menyi be asɔ nɛ mee sha, menyi gbagba nɛ mee sha, ŋkpal manɛ so, mannɛ mbia e naa ji a ka a yili bumo nawuraana, ama bumo nawuraana bre e naa ji a ka a yili bumo.

english_verse: But he was taken up into paradise, where he heard things too wonderful to tell.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nɛ e ya nu asheŋ nɛ a maŋ daga dimɛdi ka malga, asheŋ nɛ dimɛdi maaŋ tiŋ n ji amo be asheŋ.

english_verse: I will brag about that man, but not about myself, except to say how weak I am.
translation_verse: Meeŋ puchi ŋkpal le be esa so, ama m maaŋ puchi ŋkpal ma ere gbagba so she ma kapɔshi nawule be asheŋ so.

english_verse: Yet even if I did brag, I would not be foolish. I would simply be speaking the truth. But I will try not to say too much. That way, none of you will think more highly of me than you should because of what you have seen me do and say.
translation_verse: Hale nɛ n daa sha kepuchi gba n daa maaŋ baa la ewulpo, ŋkpal manɛ so, kashenteŋ nɛ n daa beeŋ baa ji. Ŋkeshin nɛ ma alɛ maaŋ wora loŋ, ŋkpal manɛ so, m maa sha fanɛ esa kama e baa fɛ nfɛragboŋ ko a sa ma a chɔ kananɛ e beeŋ bɔla ma aworbi nɛ ma mmalga to so n fɛ ma asheŋ.

english_verse: Of course, I am now referring to the wonderful things I saw. One of Satan's angels was sent to make me suffer terribly, so that I would not feel too proud.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal kananɛ k beeŋ wora nɛ n sa maŋ kpal kewuŋkaŋɛ damta gboŋana mo nɛ n nya na so ŋ kpaŋ ma kumu so so, Ebɔrɛ sa ma ebesa ko nna, k la Setani be kabɔ nna nɛ e bee tɔrɔ ma. Saŋɛ na so, m maaŋ baa nya ekpa a maŋ ma kumu so m baŋ so.

english_verse: Three times I begged the Lord to make this suffering go away.
translation_verse: Ela asa nɛ ŋ kule Enyɛnpe fanɛ e lara loŋ be ebesa na ashi ma to.

english_verse: But he replied, “My gift of undeserved grace is all you need. My power is strongest when you are weak.” So if Christ keeps giving me his power, I will gladly brag about how weak I am.
translation_verse: Ama e maŋ lara kumo nseŋ kaŋɛ ma le: “Ma kuwɔr be kakɛ kukwe fo, ŋkpal manɛ so, fo kapɔshi to nɛ ma eleŋ bee dii efuli nɛnɛ.” Amoso, meeŋ baa kɔ ma kapɔshi ere a ji njɔŋ kagbenefuliso a ti so, saŋɛ na so, Kristo be eleŋ beeŋ baa wɔ ma so.

english_verse: Yes, I am glad to be weak or insulted or mistreated or to have troubles and sufferings, if it is for Christ. Because when I am weak, I am strong. Paul's Concern for the Lord's Followers at Corinth
translation_verse: Amoso, ŋkpal Kristo so ma kagbene bee fuli ma kapɔshi to nna nɛ kategeana to nɛ kebaawɔtɔ kpakpasoana to nɛ etɔrɔana to nɛ ŋgbenejijaana to. Ŋkpal manɛ so, kapɔshi baa wɔ ma to, kumo ere ŋ kɔ eleŋ nna na. Kananɛ Kɔrintebi na be asheŋ wɔ Pɔɔl be kagbene to be asheŋ

english_verse: I have been making a fool of myself. But you forced me to do it, when you should have been speaking up for me. I may be nothing at all, but I am as good as those super apostles.
translation_verse: Mee wora asheŋ fanɛ ewulpo nna, ama menyi e shin nɛ ŋ ki loŋ. Menyi e daŋ daga fanɛ men baa chɔrɔ ma. Ŋkpal manɛ so, nɛ m maŋ la shɛŋ gba, beshuŋipo nɛ menyee tre beshuŋipogboŋ ere maŋ bɔ ma.

english_verse: When I was with you, I was patient and worked all the powerful miracles and signs and wonders of a true apostle.
translation_verse: Asɔ nɛ a bee ŋini fanɛ esa la eshuŋipo nɛ n daŋ ta kanyiti kikɛ n wora menyi to na. Asɔ na e la etɔɔnɛshuŋ nɛ emamachisheŋ nɛ asheŋ purgiase.

english_verse: You missed out on only one blessing the other churches received. That is, you didn't have to support me. Forgive me for doing you wrong.
translation_verse: To, nɛ manɛ be kechɛto nɛ asɔriebi pɔtɛana nɛ b ka na daŋ nya nɛ menyi ere maŋ nya? Kusɔ nɛ k baa wɔtɔ e la fanɛ ma ere gbagba daa maŋ dese menyi so. Kumo alɛ be kulubi nɛ mee kule menyi fanɛ men ta m paŋ ma.

english_verse: You agree that I wasn't a burden to you. Maybe that's because I was trying to catch you off guard and trick you.
translation_verse: Shere menyeeŋ shuli fanɛ n daa maŋ dese menyi so, ama eko beeŋ tiŋ ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ n daŋ bɔla kanyiasheŋ be ekpa ko so nna n ta efɛ m pɛ menyi.

english_verse: Were you cheated by any of those I sent to you?
translation_verse: N daŋ bɔla basa nɛ n shuŋi menyi kutɔ na be ekama so n ji menyi so a?

english_verse: I urged Titus to visit you, and I sent another follower with him. But Titus didn't cheat you, and we felt and behaved the same way he did.
translation_verse: Taites nɛ n daŋ kule fanɛ e yɔ menyi kutɔ nseŋ shuŋi ekurgepo mo na fanɛ e shuŋi mo n yɔ. To, menyee fɛ fanɛ Taites e daŋ ji menyi so nna ŋko nuso? Ma nɛ Taites kikɛ maŋ kɔ nfɛra koŋwule nɛ kebaawɔtɔ koŋwule nna a?

english_verse: Have you been thinking all along that we have been defending ourselves to you? Actually, we have been speaking to God as followers of Christ. But, my friends, we did it all for your good.
translation_verse: Shere men baa wɔtɔ nna a fɛ fanɛ anyee malga nna a sa menyi a kuŋ anyi be amu. Ayai, mannɛ aloŋ nna. Kananɛ Kristo bee sha fanɛ an malga nɛ anyee malga ashi Ebɔrɛ be anishito. Kusɔ kama malɛ nɛ anyee wora, men be keyɔ anishito so nɛ anyee wora kumo.

english_verse: I am afraid when I come, we won't be pleased with each other. I fear that some of you may be arguing or jealous or angry or selfish or gossiping or insulting each other. I even fear that you may be proud and acting like a mob.
translation_verse: K bee wora ma nna fanɛ ŋ kaŋ ba men kutɔ meeŋ ba wu fanɛ mannɛ kananɛ mee sha fanɛ men baa du na nɛ men du, nɛ menyi alɛ gba e wu fanɛ mannɛ kananɛ menyee sha fanɛ m baa du na nɛ n du n sa menyi. Mee lɔ kufu nna fanɛ shere meeŋ ba wu nlu nɛ kayurbesaana nɛ agboana ka bee kaa nɛ kejimuniana nɛ kategeana nɛ ŋkuli nɛ kamoowu nɛ kebarga to menyi to.

english_verse: I am afraid God will make me ashamed when I visit you again. I will feel like crying because many of you have never given up your old sins. You are still doing things that are immoral, indecent, and shameful.
translation_verse: Mee lɔ kufu nna fanɛ ŋ kaŋ ba, ma Ebɔrɛ beeŋ shin nɛ m bar ma kumu kaseto men be anishito nɛ ma kagbene e jija ma ŋkpal basa damta nɛ b wora alubi dra dra na kikɛ nsaa maŋ lar bumo be loŋ be kesakalea be asheŋ na to nɛ kusɔ jigaya be kulubi na to nɛ bumo be eyurpishuŋ nɛ b daŋ wora na kikɛ to so.

english_verse: I am on my way to visit you for the third time. And as the Scriptures say, “Any charges must be proved true by at least two or three witnesses.”
translation_verse: Ŋ ka bee ba nɛ m ba bɔɔ menyi so ere e ti so kela sasopo. Abɔrɛsibɛ na malɛ e naa kaŋɛ loŋ fanɛ a daga fanɛ kesheŋ kama, basa anyɔ ŋko besa e ji kumo be shɛda pɔɛŋ nɛ k nya edesekpa.

english_verse: During my second visit I warned you that I would punish you and anyone else who doesn't stop sinning. I am far away from you now, but I give you the same warning.
translation_verse: Naniere mee sha kenaŋ n fiɛ menyi nɛ men daŋ kewora alubi na so nna nɛ bekama malɛ nɛ b ka na so. Ma kebɔɔ menyi so nyɔsopo to nɛ n daŋ wora loŋ men be anishito, ama naniere m maŋ wɔ menyi to, ma alɛ nseŋ kraa sa menyi kumo. Kumo e la fanɛ, nɛ ŋ kaŋ ba kede to, m maaŋ yige ekama.

english_verse: This should prove to you that I am speaking for Christ. When he corrects you, he won't be weak. He will be powerful!
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, men yɛ menyee sha kepin fanɛ Kristo e naa malga ma to. E maŋ la epɔsopo a shuŋ menyi to, e la elempo nna.

english_verse: Although he was weak when he was nailed to the cross, he now lives by the power of God. We are weak, just as Christ was. But you will see that we will live by the power of God, just as Christ does.
translation_verse: Kashenteŋto, kapɔshi to nɛ b daŋ gbir mo kedibi largato so, ama Ebɔrɛ be eleŋ nɛ e kɔ a wɔ ŋkpa to naniere. Loŋ nɛ anyi alɛ gba la bepɔshipo mo to, ama ŋkpal Ebɔrɛ be eleŋ so, an tu Kristo na nna a wɔ ŋkpa to nɛ an shuŋ menyi.

english_verse: Test yourselves and find out if you really are true to your faith. If you pass the test, you will discover that Christ is living in you. But if Christ isn't living in you, you have failed.
translation_verse: Men keni men be ŋgbene to ŋ keni ŋko men maŋ wɔ yirda na to a? Men wora men be amu ŋ keni. Men maŋ nyi Yesu Kristo ka wɔ menyi to a? Nɛ mannɛ aloŋ, men tɔr nna na.

english_verse: I hope you will discover we have not failed.
translation_verse: Mee tama fanɛ menyeeŋ pin fanɛ anyi ere maŋ tɔr.

english_verse: We pray you will stop doing evil things. We don't pray like this to make ourselves look good, but to get you to do right, even if we are failures.
translation_verse: Anyee kule Ebɔrɛ nna fanɛ men sa maŋ kaŋ wora n da so kikɛ. Mannɛ ŋkpal basa ka beeŋ wu fanɛ anyee ji kɔŋkɔŋ so, ama fanɛ menyi e wora kusɔ nɛ k bɔla ekpa, hale nɛ k ba kaa du fanɛ an tɔr gba.

english_verse: Even though we are weak, we are glad that you are strong, and we pray you will do even better.
translation_verse: Nɛ anyi maŋ kɔ eleŋ nɛ menyi ere kɔ eleŋ, anyi be ŋgbene bee fuli anyi nna. Anyi alɛ bee kule Ebɔrɛ fanɛ e shin nɛ men ba ki basa cheembi.

english_verse: I am writing these things to you before I arrive. This way I won't have to be hard on you when I use the authority the Lord has given me. I was given this authority, so I could help you and not destroy you.
translation_verse: Amoso nɛ m maŋ wɔ menyi kutɔ nsaa sibɛ menyi na, saŋɛ na so, ŋ kaŋ ba, m maaŋ ta ma eleŋ nɛ Enyɛnpe ta n sa ma fanɛ n ta a chɛ menyi to nɛ men baa yɔ anishito na, mannɛ fanɛ n ta kumo n jija menyi a ŋmenyaŋ menyi na.

english_verse: Goodbye, my friends. Do better and pay attention to what I have said. Try to get along and live peacefully with each other. Now I pray that God, who gives love and peace, will be with you.
translation_verse: To, bekurgepoana, Ebɔrɛ e chɛ menyi to. Men baa kɔ a fin kebaawɔtɔ niŋiso. Men baa du fanɛ kananɛ ŋ kule menyi na nsaa kɔ kɔnɔkoŋwule a wɔtɔ nseŋ naa wɔ kagbenewushi to, nɛ kasha nɛ kagbenewushi be Ebɔrɛ na e baa wɔ menyi to.

english_verse: Give each other a warm greeting. All God's people send their greetings.
translation_verse: Men ta kegbumpipe cheembi be kechɔrɔ a chɔrɔ abar.

english_verse: I pray that God the Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace!
translation_verse: An Tuto Ebɔrɛ na nɛ Enyɛnpe Yesu Kristo na e sa menyi Ebɔrɛ be kuwɔr be kakɛ nɛ kagbenewushi.

english_verse: Christ obeyed God our Father and gave himself as a sacrifice for our sins to rescue us from this evil world.
translation_verse: Mo Yesu Kristo na e kpal kumɔlga anyi ashi alubi be jemanɛ be kebaawɔtɔ ere to so n nu n sa anyi be Ebɔrɛ nɛ Etuto na n ta mbe kumu n lara anyi alubi be kewora be eleŋ to.

english_verse: God will be given glory forever and ever. Amen. The Only True Message
translation_verse: Kemaŋkura e baa wɔ Ebɔrɛ na so hale mbaanaayɔ. Amɛn. Baru lela nɛ kebaawɔtɔ na be asheŋ

english_verse: I am shocked that you have so quickly turned from God, who chose you with his gift of undeserved grace. You have believed another message,
translation_verse: Men be asheŋ bee chinchiŋ ma kashenteŋto pasaa, ŋkpal kananɛ men tea yige Ebɔrɛ nɛ e bɔla Kristo be kuwɔr be kakɛ na so n tre menyi na a to nsaa sɔ baru pɔtɛ nɛ basa ko bee tre baru lela na.

english_verse: when there is really only one true message. But some people are causing you trouble and want to make you turn away from the good news about Christ.
translation_verse: Kashenteŋto bre, baru lela kama maŋ naa wɔtɔ n ti anyeya ere so, ama ŋkpal basa ko ka wɔtɔ a wul menyi to a sha kechɛrga Kristo be baru lela na so e shin nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ loŋ na.

english_verse: I pray that God will punish anyone who preaches anything different from our message to you! It doesn't matter if that person is one of us or an angel from heaven.
translation_verse: Ama nɛ anyi alɛ gba ŋko malaika gba shi ebɔrɛso m ba malga baru pɔtɛ ko nɛ k kɔr kumo nɛ an daŋ malga n sa menyi na to, Ebɔrɛ e yɛr mo Setani be edɛ to.

english_verse: I have said it before, and I will say it again. I hope God will punish anyone who preaches anything different from what you have already believed.
translation_verse: An teŋ kaŋɛ kumo, ama meeŋ naŋ laŋɛ ŋ kaŋɛ kumo n ti so fanɛ nɛ esa kama naŋ malga baru pɔtɛ kama nɛ k naa kɔr kumo nɛ men daŋ nu n sɔ na to, Ebɔrɛ e yɛr amodoŋwura Setani be edɛ to.

english_verse: I am not trying to please people. I want to please God. Do you think I am trying to please people? If I were doing that, I would not be a servant of Christ. How Paul Became an Apostle
translation_verse: To, kananɛ m malga le ere maa ŋini ŋ ka bee sha kenya ketre basa kutɔ, ama Ebɔrɛ nawule kutɔ. Ŋko basa nɛ mee sha fanɛ n wora asheŋ nɛ a par bumo a? Cha, nɛ n daa sha kebaawora basa be aparsheŋ nna n daa maaŋ tiŋ a la Kristo be kenya. Kananɛ Pɔɔl ki eshuŋipo be asheŋ

english_verse: My friends, I want you to know that no one made up the message I preach.
translation_verse: Ŋ kurgepoana mee sha fanɛ ŋ kaŋɛ menyi nna fanɛ baru lela nɛ mee malga na maŋ la kusɔ nɛ k shi dimɛdi gbagba kutɔ nna.

english_verse: It wasn't given or taught to me by some mere human. My message came directly from Jesus Christ when he appeared to me.
translation_verse: Mannɛ nyiŋgbasa ko kutɔ nɛ n nya kumo ŋko ŋ koya kumo. Yesu Kristo e lara kumo efuli n sa ma.

english_verse: You know how I used to live as a Jew. I was cruel to God's church and even tried to destroy it.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so men daŋ nu kebaawɔtɔ dra nɛ n daa kɔ a wɔtɔ saŋɛ nɛ n daa wɔ Juwebi be kabɔrɛbɛso na to na. Men nyi kananɛ n daŋ pere kenishi n tɔrɔ Ebɔrɛ be asɔriebi, n daa sha kemur bumo nna.

english_verse: I was a much better Jew than anyone else my own age, and I obeyed every law our ancestors had given us.
translation_verse: Ma sara Juwebiana be bedamta to ma e daŋ fara nɛ n sɔ kejuŋkpar ashi Juwebi be kabɔrɛbɛso na to nseŋ daŋ naŋ pere kenishi n wɔtɔ an nanaana be asheŋ ŋiniso nɛ b yige n sa anyi na to ga.

english_verse: to show me his Son, so I would announce his message to the Gentiles. I didn't talk this over with anyone.
translation_verse: Mo alɛ ka naŋ yili kumo mbe kagbene to n lara mo Pibinyɛn ŋ ŋini ma nɛ n tiŋ m bɔ baru lela n sa nnyamase, m maŋ yɔ esa kama kutɔ epul na to n ya bishi asheŋ to m pin.

english_verse: I didn't say a word, not even to the men in Jerusalem who were apostles before I was. Instead, I went at once to Arabia, and afterwards I returned to Damascus.
translation_verse: Ma alɛ maŋ naŋ yɔ Jerusalɛm n ya wu basa nɛ b daa la beshuŋipo pɔɛŋ nɛ ma alɛ ba ki eko na. Areebia be efuli so nɛ n daŋ baŋ juŋkpar n yɔ pɔɛŋ nseŋ bɛta n yɔ Damaskɔs be kade to.

english_verse: Three years later I went to visit Peter in Jerusalem and stayed with him for
translation_verse: Ŋ ka yɔ Damaskɔs na be nfɛ asa be kaman nɛ n yɔ Jerusalɛm nɛ n ya wu Pita. Nchɛ kuduanu nɛ n daŋ ji mo kutɔ ndoŋ,

english_verse: The only other apostle I saw was James, the Lord's brother.
translation_verse: ama n daa maŋ wu beshuŋipo na be bekama n naŋ ti so she Enyɛnpe mo sipo Jeems nawule.

english_verse: And in the presence of God I swear I am telling the truth.
translation_verse: Kashenteŋ nɛ mee sibɛ a ji menyi Ebɔrɛ be anishito na, m maa fule nna.

english_verse: Later, I went to the regions of Syria and Cilicia.
translation_verse: Kede be kaman nɛ n naŋ yɔ Siriya nɛ Silisia be efuliana so.

english_verse: But no one who belonged to Christ's churches in Judea had ever seen me in person.
translation_verse: Saŋɛ na so, Judiya be efuli so be asɔriana na to ebi nɛ b wɔ Kristo to na maŋ naŋ wu ma kenishiso ŋ ku so.

english_verse: They had only heard that the one who had been cruel to them was now preaching the message that he had once tried to destroy.
translation_verse: Kusɔ nɛ b daŋ baa nyi kikɛ e la kusɔ nɛ b daa nu fanɛ: Kanyɛn nɛ e daa tɔrɔ anyi na naa wɔtɔ nna a malga yirda koŋwule na be asheŋ a sa basa.

english_verse: And because of me, they praised God.
translation_verse: Amoso, b daŋ di Ebɔrɛ epaŋ nna ŋkpal ma so.

english_verse: Fourteen years later I went to Jerusalem with Barnabas. I also took along Titus.
translation_verse: Nfɛ kuduana be kaman nɛ ma nɛ Baanabas naŋ bɛta n yɔ Jerusalɛm. N daŋ keta Taites nna n ti so n yɔ.

english_verse: But I went there because God had told me to go, and I explained the good news I had been preaching to the Gentiles. Then I met privately with the ones who seemed to be the most important leaders. I wanted to make sure my work in the past and my future work would not be for nothing.
translation_verse: N daŋ yɔ nna, ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ e daŋ lara ŋ ŋini ma fanɛ n yɔ. Bumo nɛ b daa la fanɛ benimuana na nɛ n daŋ shɛr wulo to ŋ kaŋɛ bumo baru lela nɛ mee malga a sa nnyamase na be asheŋ, ŋkpal manɛ so, n daa maa sha fanɛ kushuŋ nɛ n fara na e to jiga nɛ kananɛ ŋ kraa wɔ kumo to ere malɛ gba maaŋ baa la kusɔ jiga.

english_verse: Titus went to Jerusalem with me. He was a Greek, but still he wasn't forced to be circumcised.
translation_verse: Amo be saŋɛ na nɛ Taites wɔ ŋ kutɔ nɛ b nyi e ka la Griik be esa, ama bumo alɛ daa maŋ tintiŋ mo nɛ e ku kututu.

english_verse: We went there because of those who pretended to be followers and had sneaked in among us as spies. They had come to take away the freedom Christ Jesus had given us, and they were trying to make us their slaves.
translation_verse: Ama kesheŋ na daŋ ba koso, ŋkpal manɛ so, bekurgepo fɛpo ko daŋ luri anyi to nna n daŋ fin kekeni anyi be kamooji nɛ an kɔ Kristo Yesu to na to nɛ b nya n jija kumo nseŋ ta anyi ŋ ki anya.

english_verse: But we wanted you to have the true message. This is why we didn't give in to them, not even for a second.
translation_verse: An daa maŋ shuli gbrɛ kama gba n sa bumo, saŋɛ na so menyeeŋ baa kɔ baru lela na be kashenteŋ na to a wɔtɔ.

english_verse: Some of them were supposed to be important leaders, but I didn't care who they were. God doesn't have any favorites! None of these so-called special leaders added anything to my message.
translation_verse: Bumo nɛ b daa du fanɛ benimuana na bre, kanaŋkama nɛ b daa du daa maŋ la shɛŋ ŋ kutɔ, Ebɔrɛ malɛ gba maa kpɛa basa to, b maŋ ta shɛŋ n ti ma kubɔya na so.

english_verse: God, who had sent Peter on a mission to the Jews, was now using me to preach to the Gentiles.
translation_verse: Kananɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ sa Pita eleŋ n shin nɛ e ki eshuŋipo n sa Juwebi na gbagba gbiiŋ nɛ e sa ma eleŋ nɛ ŋ ki eshuŋipo n sa nnyamase.

english_verse: James, Peter, and John realized that God had given me the message about his gift of undeserved grace. And these men are supposed to be the backbone of the church. They even gave Barnabas and me a friendly handshake. This was to show that we would work with Gentiles and that they would work with Jews.
translation_verse: Jeems nɛ Pita nɛ Jɔn nɛ ekama daa nyi b ka la benimu na, e daŋ shuli n sa ma nɛ Baanabas fanɛ an baa la bumo braana beshuŋipo ŋkpal kananɛ b daŋ wu Ebɔrɛ be kuwɔr be kakɛ nɛ e daŋ sa ma na so. B daŋ shuli nna fanɛ an yɔ nnyamase kutɔ nɛ bumo alɛ yɔ Juwebi kutɔ.

english_verse: They only asked us to remember the poor, and this was something I had always been eager to do. Paul Corrects Peter at Antioch
translation_verse: Kusɔ nɛ b daŋ baŋ kaŋɛ n ti so e la fanɛ an baa kraa chɛ betirpo to, loŋ malɛ gbagba nɛ n daa baŋ pere kenishi a wora. Kananɛ Pɔɔl fiɛ Pita so be asheŋ

english_verse: But when I saw they were not really obeying the truth that is in the good news, I corrected Peter in front of everyone and said: Peter, you are a Jew, but you live like a Gentile. So how can you force Gentiles to live like Jews?
translation_verse: Ŋ ka wu fanɛ kesheŋ nɛ b wora na maŋ bɔla kashenteŋ be baru lela na be ekpa so nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ Pita le ashi bebɛsopo na kikɛ be anishito: “To, Juw e la fo nɛ fo daa wɔ nfe fanɛ kanyamase, mannɛ fanɛ Juw. Nɛ nuso nɛ feeŋ wora n tintiŋ nnyamase nɛ b baa wɔtɔ a bɛ Juwebi be edaŋkaresheŋ so?” Kananɛ nnyamase nɛ Juwebi gba bee nya kumɔlga be asheŋ

english_verse: We are Jews by birth and are not sinners like Gentiles.
translation_verse: Anyi nɛ b kurge Juwebi gbagba, mannɛ nnyamase nɛ Juwebi bee tre alubiworapoana ere,

english_verse: When we Jews started looking for a way to please God, we discovered that we are sinners too. Does this mean that Christ is the one who makes us sinners? No, it doesn't!
translation_verse: Ama kananɛ anyee sha kebɔla Kristo to n ji n lar Ebɔrɛ be anishito ere nɛ k ba fanɛ anyi alɛ gba la alubiworapoana nna, loŋ beeŋ tiŋ ŋ ŋini fanɛ Kristo na e naa shin nɛ alubi be kewora bee nya eleŋ a ti so a? Kaarɛ, mannɛ aloŋ nna.

english_verse: But if I tear down something and then build it again, I prove that I was wrong at first.
translation_verse: Nɛ m baŋ fara a pɔr kusɔ nɛ n daŋ da n lɛ, kumo ere k bee ŋini fanɛ n la mbrafɛlpo nna na.

english_verse: It was the Law itself that killed me and freed me from its power, so I could live for God. I have been nailed to the cross with Christ.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, mbra na be kaplɛa so, n wu nna, mbra na mɔ ma, saŋɛ na so nɛ m baa wɔ ŋkpa to a sa Ebɔrɛ.

english_verse: I have died, but Christ lives in me. And I now live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me and gave his life for me.
translation_verse: Ma nɛ Kristo nɛ b daŋ gbir m mata kedibi largato so, amoso, mannɛ ŋ gbagba e naa wɔtɔ, Kristo e wɔ ma to. Kebaawɔtɔ nɛ ŋ kɔ a wɔtɔ ere, keyirda Ebɔrɛ Pibinyɛn nɛ e sha ma n ta mbe kumu n sa ma na to nɛ n wɔ.

english_verse: I don't turn my back on God's gift of undeserved grace. If we can be acceptable to God by obeying the Law, it was useless for Christ to die.
translation_verse: M maa keni Ebɔrɛ be kuwɔr be kakɛ na nna jiga, ŋkpal manɛ so, nɛ b daa bɛ mbra na so nna a ji a lar Ebɔrɛ be anishito, dafanɛ Kristo be luwu na daa maŋ kɔ kifito.

english_verse: You stupid Galatians! I told you exactly how Jesus Christ was nailed to a cross. Has someone now put an evil spell on you?
translation_verse: Ama menyi Galeeshaebi paŋ nfɛra pasaa! Wanɛ e wora menyi bre? To, men be anishito gbagba nɛ b bugi Yesu Kristo be kewu kedibi largato na so na be asheŋ n sa menyi. To nɛ mannɛ nna?

english_verse: I want to know only one thing. How were you given God's Spirit? Was it by obeying the Law of Moses or by hearing about Christ and having faith in him?
translation_verse: Kusɔ koŋwule nɛ m baa sha kebishi menyi nde: Men ka daŋ nya Ebɔrɛ be Kiyoyu na, mbra na so nɛ men daŋ bɛ so n nya Kiyoyu na ŋko baru lela na nɛ men daŋ nu nseŋ yirda pɔɛŋ n nya Kiyoyu na a?

english_verse: How can you be so stupid? Do you think that by yourself you can complete what God's Spirit started in you?
translation_verse: Manɛ e ba nɛ men paŋ nfɛra loŋ? To, Kiyoyu be eleŋ to nɛ men fara men be kabɔrɛbɛso ere nseŋ naa sha fanɛ men bɔla men gbagba be asheŋ woraso to n loge asheŋ a?

english_verse: Have you gone through all of this for nothing? Is it all really for nothing?
translation_verse: Asheŋ nɛ men be kenishi wu na kikɛ ki jiga nna ere ŋko? Cha, mannɛ fanɛ k ka la kusɔ jiga nna bre.

english_verse: God gives you his Spirit and works miracles in you. But does he do this because you obey the Law of Moses or because you have heard about Christ and have faith in him?
translation_verse: Men ka bee bɛ mbra na so so nɛ Ebɔrɛ bee sa menyi mbe Kiyoyu na nsaa wora emamachisheŋ menyi to nna ŋko men ka bee nu baru lela na nsaa yirda kumo na so nɛ e bee wora loŋ a?

english_verse: And so, you should understand that everyone who has faith is a child of Abraham.
translation_verse: Amoso, men baa nyi fanɛ basa kama nɛ b yirda Ebɔrɛ e la Eebraham mo nanabiana.

english_verse: Long ago the Scriptures said God would accept the Gentiles because of their faith. This is why God told Abraham the good news that all nations would be blessed because of him.
translation_verse: Abɔrɛsibɛ na malɛ wu kumo nna n yili fanɛ Ebɔrɛ ka beeŋ kpal nnyamase be yirda so n shin nɛ b ji n lar mbe anishito so so nseŋ wule m bɔ baru lela na n sa Eebraham fanɛ: “Fo so nɛ Ebɔrɛ beeŋ bɔla n nɛfa durnya ere to ebi kikɛ.”

english_verse: This means everyone who has faith will share in the blessings given to Abraham because of his faith.
translation_verse: Amoso, bumo nɛ b kɔ yirda na nɛ Ebɔrɛ bee ta a ti Eebraham nɛ e la yirdawura na so a nɛfa.

english_verse: Anyone who tries to please God by obeying the Law is under a curse. The Scriptures say, “Everyone who doesn't obey everything in the Law is under a curse.”
translation_verse: Bumo nɛ b ta bumo be nfɛra n wɔtɔ mbra na be kebɛso na to na wɔ kɔnɔso to nna na, ŋkpal manɛ so, le nɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ: “Ebɔrɛ be kɔnɔso wɔ ekama nɛ e maa bɛ mbra na be kawɔl na so nɛnɛ saŋkikɛ na so nna.”

english_verse: But Christ rescued us from the Law's curse, when he became a curse in our place. This is because the Scriptures say that anyone who is nailed to a tree is under a curse.
translation_verse: Ama Kristo sɔ anyi ashi kɔnɔso nɛ mbra na bee bar na to nna n yige. E yili anyi be katelamu to nna n shin nɛ b so mo gbagba kɔnɔ n sa anyi, ŋkpal manɛ so, le nɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ: “Ebɔrɛ be kɔnɔso wɔ esa kama nɛ baa ta a shiga kedibi so nna.”

english_verse: And because of what Jesus Christ has done, the blessing promised to Abraham was taken to the Gentiles. This happened so that by faith we would be given the promised Holy Spirit. The Law and the Promise
translation_verse: E sɔ anyi nna n yige nɛ nɛfa nɛ Ebɔrɛ ta n sa Eebraham na e bɔla Yesu Kristo so m ba nnyamase so, saŋɛ na so anyeeŋ nya Kiyoyu Cheeŋ nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ nase kɔnɔ fanɛ e beeŋ sa na. Mbra na nɛ kɔnɔ naseso na be asheŋ

english_verse: That is how it is with the promises God made to Abraham and his descendant. The promises were not made to many descendants, but only to one, and that one is Christ.
translation_verse: Eebraham nɛ mbe kamanto be esa nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ nase nnɔ na n sa. Abɔrɛsibɛ na maa kaŋɛ fanɛ fo Eebraham nɛ fo kaman to ebi, kumo e la fanɛ, a ber bumo fanɛ basa damta. Abɔrɛsibɛ na yɛ: “Nɛ fo kamanto be esa”, a ŋini fanɛ esa koŋwule nɛ Ebɔrɛ de na. Mo e la Kristo na.

english_verse: If we have to obey the Law in order to receive God's blessings, those blessings don't really come to us because of God's promise. But God was kind to Abraham and made him a promise.
translation_verse: Amoso, nɛ mbra na be kebɛso so nɛ esa bee bɔla a nya Ebɔrɛ be nɛfa na bre, kumo ere mannɛ kɔnɔ naseso na so nɛ yirda na naa deŋ so na. Ama ŋkpal kuwɔr be kakɛ na so nɛ e daŋ bɔla mbe kɔnɔ naseso na so n ta nɛfa na n sa Eebraham.

english_verse: What is the use of the Law? It was given later to show that we sin. But it was only supposed to last until the coming of that descendant who was given the promise. In fact, angels gave the Law to Moses, and he gave it to the people.
translation_verse: To, nɛ manɛ be tɔnɔ nɛ mbra na malɛ daa kɔ? B daŋ ta kumo nna n ti so nɛ k ŋini kusɔ nɛ k baa la kulubi nsaa wɔtɔ loŋ nɛ Eebraham be kamanto be esa nɛ b nase kɔnɔ na n sa na e ya ba. Emalaika so nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ bɔla n shin nɛ nyiŋgbasa, anebi Mosis nna na yili Ebɔrɛ nɛ basa be nferinto m bar mbra na.

english_verse: There is only one God, and the Law did not come directly from him. Slaves and Children
translation_verse: Nɛ esa baa la esa koŋwule, ematapo maŋ kɔ tɔnɔ n sa mo. Ebɔrɛ malɛ la esa koŋwule nna. Mbra na be kifito be asheŋ

english_verse: Does the Law disagree with God's promises? No, it doesn't! If any law could give life to us, we could become acceptable to God by obeying that law.
translation_verse: To, ama an kaŋɛ fanɛ mbra na nɛ Ebɔrɛ be nnɔ nasesoana maa kukwe nna ŋko? Ayai, mannɛ loŋ nna kuraa. Ŋkpal manɛ so, nɛ mbra ko daŋ ba na m ba kaa tiŋ a sa ŋkpa, kumo ere basa daa beeŋ bɔla mbra na so ŋ ki belelapo Ebɔrɛ be anishito.

english_verse: But the Scriptures say that sin controls everyone, so that God's promises will be for anyone who has faith in Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Ama abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ fanɛ durnya kikɛ wɔ alubi be enɔ to nna, amoso, basa nɛ b yirda beeŋ nya kakɛ nɛ Ebɔrɛ nase kɔnɔ fanɛ e beeŋ sa na ŋkpal b ka bee yirda Yesu Kristo so.

english_verse: The Law controlled us and kept us under its power until the time came when we would have faith.
translation_verse: Pɔɛŋ nɛ yirda ere be jemanɛ na fo, mbra na daŋ nyaŋ anyi nna a wɔtɔ fanɛ ebutipoana nɛ an baa wɔtɔ loŋ hale pɔɛŋ nɛ le be yirda be jemanɛ be kefo ere ba lar efuli ere.

english_verse: In fact, the Law was to be our teacher until Christ came. Then we could have faith and be acceptable to God.
translation_verse: Amoso, mbra na e daa wɔ anyi a ŋini anyi kebaawɔtɔ hale le pɔɛŋ nɛ Kristo ba, saŋɛ na so anyeeŋ bɔla yirda to n ji n lar Ebɔrɛ be anishito.

english_verse: But once a person has learned to have faith, there is no more need to have the Law as a teacher.
translation_verse: Naniere, yirda be jemanɛ ere ka ba ere bre, mbra na maŋ naa wɔ anyi.

english_verse: All of you are God's children because of your faith in Christ Jesus.
translation_verse: Yirda so nɛ men kikɛ la Ebɔrɛ be mbia ashi Kristo Yesu to.

english_verse: And when you were baptized, it was as though you had put on Christ in the same way you put on new clothes.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, b daŋ bɛr menyi kabɔrɛbɛr nna nɛ men baa wɔ Kristo Yesu to n shin nɛ naniere men ta Kristo be edasheŋ ŋ ki menyeya na.

english_verse: Faith in Christ Jesus is what makes each of you equal with each other, whether you are a Jew or a Greek, a slave or a free person, a man or a woman.
translation_verse: Amoso, Ebɔrɛ be anishito Juw maŋ kɔr kanyamase to, kenya maŋ kɔr esa nɛ e wɔ mbe kumu to, benyɛn maŋ kɔr beche to, men kikɛ la kukoŋwule nna ashi Kristo Yesu to.

english_verse: So if you belong to Christ, you are now part of Abraham's family, and you will be given what God has promised.
translation_verse: Nɛ men baa la Kristo peya bre, kumo ere Eebraham be kaman to ebi e la menyi nɛ menyi alɛ nya kakɛ nɛ Ebɔrɛ nase kɔnɔ a sa mbe mbia na.

english_verse: This is because children are placed in the care of guardians and teachers until the time their parents have set.
translation_verse: E kraŋ baa la kebibi, basa e naa keni mo so nsaa wora mbe asheŋ loŋ nɛ kachɛ nɛ mo tuto yili na e ya fo.

english_verse: This is how it was with us. We were like children ruled by the powers of this world.
translation_verse: To, anyi alɛ gba ka daa du fanɛ mbibi abɔrɛsheŋ to na, loŋ e daa la. An daa la durnya ere to be sososo be asɔ ŋiniso be anya nna.

english_verse: But when the time was right, God sent his Son, and a woman gave birth to him. His Son obeyed the Law,
translation_verse: Ama jemanɛ nɛ k daga na ka ba fo nɛ Ebɔrɛ shuŋi mo Pibinyɛn nɛ e bɔla durnya be eche to n lar a wɔ mbra na to na

english_verse: so he could set us free from the Law, and we could become God's children.
translation_verse: nɛ e ba sɔ bumo nɛ b wɔ mbra na to na n yige, saŋɛ na so nɛ an ki Ebɔrɛ be mbia gbagba.

english_verse: Now that we are his children, God has sent the Spirit of his Son into our hearts. And his Spirit tells us that God is our Father.
translation_verse: Kusɔ nɛ k bee ŋini fanɛ men la Ebɔrɛ be mbia nde: Mo ere Ebɔrɛ koŋwule na shuŋi mo Pibinyɛn be Kiyoyu na anyi be ŋgbene to, Kiyoyu na e naa tre Ebɔrɛ ‘Aba’, kumo e la fanɛ n Tuto na.

english_verse: You are no longer slaves. You are God's children, and you will be given what he has promised. Paul's Concern for the Galatians
translation_verse: Amoso, naniere men maŋ naa la anya, men ki Ebɔrɛ be mbia nna. Menyi alɛ ka ki loŋ ere so, asɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ kɔ a sa mbe mbia na malɛ gba kikɛ ki menyeya. Pɔɔl be kafɔŋ nɛ e kɔ a sa Galeeshaebi be asheŋ

english_verse: I am afraid I have wasted my time working with you.
translation_verse: Men be asheŋ bee ku ma kagbene nna nɛ mee fɛ fanɛ shere ŋ gben menyi so jiga nna na.

english_verse: My friends, I beg you to be like me, just as I once tried to be like you. Did you mistreat me
translation_verse: Ŋ kurgepoana, mee kule menyi nna fanɛ men baa du fanɛ ma, ŋkpal manɛ so, ma alɛ gba baŋ ba ki fanɛ menyi nna. Dra na men daa maŋ wora ma kulubi kama, ama naniere bre menyee wora.

english_verse: when I first preached to you? No you didn't, even though you knew I had come there because I was sick.
translation_verse: Men nyi fanɛ kulɔ ka daŋ pɔɔ ma so so e shin nɛ m bɔ baru lela na n sa menyi sososo na.

english_verse: My illness must have caused you some trouble, but you didn't hate me or turn me away because of it. You welcomed me as though I were one of God's angels or even Christ Jesus himself.
translation_verse: Kulɔ na daa la kechɔŋkeni gboŋgboŋi nna n sa menyi, ama men maŋ keni ma jiga ŋko ŋ kini ma. Men daŋ sɔ ma nna fanɛ ŋ ka la malaika ŋko fanɛ Kristo Yesu gbagba na.

english_verse: Where is that good feeling now? I am sure if it had been possible, you would have taken out your own eyes and given them to me.
translation_verse: Naniere, manɛ e wora men be kagbenefuli nɛ men daŋ nya na? Nɛ esa bishi ma, n daa beeŋ tiŋ ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ nɛ k daa la kewora kusɔ ko nna gba, men daa beeŋ chule men be anishi gba n sa ma.

english_verse: Am I now your enemy, just because I told you the truth?
translation_verse: To, naniere bre ŋ ki men doŋ nna ŋkpal ŋ ka ji menyi kashenteŋ so ŋko?

english_verse: Those people may be paying you a lot of attention, but it isn't for your good. They only want to keep you away from me, so you will pay them a lot of attention.
translation_verse: Basa nɛ anyee malga bumo be asheŋ ere bee wora fanɛ men be asheŋ ka wɔ bumo to ga nna, ama nfɛra nɛ a wɔ bumo be loŋ be asheŋ woraso na be kaman na maŋ walɛ. Kusɔ nɛ baa sha e la fanɛ kananɛ baaŋ wora m barga ma nɛ menyi abar to nɛ bumo ere be asheŋ e baa wɔ menyi to.

english_verse: It is always good to give your attention to something worthwhile, even when I am not with you.
translation_verse: Keshin nɛ asheŋ e baa wɔ menyi to walɛ nɛ asheŋ na baa la alelasheŋ nna na a wɔ menyi to saŋkikɛ, mannɛ saŋɛ nɛ n wɔ men kutɔ nawule.

english_verse: Some of you would like to be under the rule of the Law of Moses. But do you know what the Law says?
translation_verse: Men shin nɛ m bishi menyi nɛ menyee sha kebaata mbra na a juŋkpar menyi be amu na le: Men maa nu kusɔ nɛ mbra na bee kaŋɛ nna a?

english_verse: In the Scriptures we learn that Abraham had two sons. The mother of one of them was a slave, while the mother of the other one had always been free.
translation_verse: A yɛ: “Eebraham daa kɔ mbinyɛnbi anyɔ nna nɛ ekoŋwule daa la kenyache pibi nɛ eko malɛ daa la eche nɛ e maŋ la kenya pibi.”

english_verse: The son of the slave woman was born in the usual way. But the son of the free woman was born because of God's promise.
translation_verse: Eyur be kasha so nɛ b daŋ bɔla m ba abar so ŋ kurge kenyache pibi na nseŋ bɔla Ebɔrɛ be kɔnɔ naseso so malɛ m ba abar so ŋ kurge emo na malɛ.

english_verse: All of this has another meaning as well. Each of the two women stands for one of the agreements God made with his people. Hagar, the slave woman, stands for the agreement that was made at Mount Sinai. Everyone born into her family is a slave.
translation_verse: Anyeeŋ tiŋ ŋ koya kesheŋ ko ashi le be adrasheŋ ere to. Beche anyɔ na du fanɛ kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre anyɔ nna. Amo be kuko shi Sainai be kebee na so nna nɛ kumo be kaplɛa so be mbia la anya. To, Heega peya nna na.

english_verse: But our mother is the city of Jerusalem in heaven above, and she isn't a slave.
translation_verse: Ama ebɔrɛso be Jerusalɛm na bre maŋ wɔ kenyaya to. To, loŋ be Jerusalɛm ere du fanɛ an nio nna.

english_verse: The Scriptures say about her, “You have never had children, but now you can be glad. You have never given birth, but now you can shout. Once you had no children, but now you will have more children than a woman who has been married for a long time.”
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, le nɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ: “Fo egbentepo nɛ fo maŋ naŋ kurge ŋ ku so, fo alɛ ŋkaa maŋ naŋ nya kakurge be ebesa ere, baa kɔ kagbenefuli nseŋ bugi kɔnɔ n wora kagbenefuliso be awɔr. Ŋkpal manɛ so, eche nɛ b kini na beeŋ nya bibi a chɔ emo nɛ e kɔ ekul a wɔtɔ na.”

english_verse: My friends, you were born because of this promise, just as Isaac was.
translation_verse: Amoso, menyi ŋ kurgepoana, men la Ebɔrɛ be kɔnɔ naseso be mbia nna fanɛ kananɛ Aizek daa la na.

english_verse: But the child who was born in the natural way made trouble for the child who was born because of the Spirit. The same thing is happening today.
translation_verse: Amo be saŋɛ na ebinyɛn nɛ b daŋ bɔla eyur be kasha so m ba abar so ŋ kurge na, daa wɔtɔ nna a tɔrɔ ebinyɛn nɛ b daŋ bɔla Ebɔrɛ be kɔnɔ naseso so m ba abar so ŋ kurge na nna. Hale mbre, loŋ malɛ e kraa la.

english_verse: My friends, we are children of the free woman and not of the slave.
translation_verse: Ŋ kurgepoana, anyi maŋ la kenyache na be mbia, an la eche nɛ e maŋ la kenya na be mbia nna.

english_verse: Christ has set us free! This means we are really free. Now hold on to your freedom and don't ever become slaves of the Law again.
translation_verse: Kebaawɔ anyi be amu so nɛ Kristo shin nɛ an nya anyi be amu. Amoso, naniere men baa yil kpakpa nsaa maŋ shin nɛ b naŋ ta menyi ŋ ki anya.

english_verse: And if you try to please God by obeying the Law, you have cut yourself off from Christ and his gift of undeserved grace.
translation_verse: Menyi, bumo nɛ menyee wora ania a sha kebɛ mbra na so n ji n lar Ebɔrɛ be anishito ere, barga men be amu ashi Kristo na kutɔ nna na. Men lar kuwɔr be kakɛ be kebaawɔtɔ to.

english_verse: If you are a follower of Christ Jesus, it makes no difference whether you are circumcised or not. All that matters is your faith that makes you love others.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, nɛ an baa wɔ Kristo to, emo nɛ e ku kututu nɛ emo nɛ e maŋ ku kututu maŋ kɔr abar to. Kusɔ koŋwule nɛ k baa tir e la yirda nɛ k bee bɔla kasha so a shuŋ.

english_verse: You were doing so well until someone made you turn from the truth.
translation_verse: To, men daa bɛ ekpa na so nna nɛnɛ nɛ wanɛ e naaŋ ba kaa kagle menyi ashi kashenteŋ be kebɛso be ekpa na to?

english_verse: And that person was certainly not sent by the one who chose you.
translation_verse: Le be kafɛrachɛrga ere maŋ shi Ebɔrɛ nɛ e tre menyi na kutɔ.

english_verse: A little yeast can change a whole batch of dough,
translation_verse: Yiisi gbrɛbi ko e naa kaa luri nyifu to a shin nɛ amo kikɛ bee tiŋ fɔŋgrɔŋ.

english_verse: but you belong to the Lord. This makes me certain you will do what I say, instead of what someone else tells you to do. Whoever is causing trouble for you will be punished.
translation_verse: Ama ŋ kraa kɔ tama ashi Enyɛnpe na to fanɛ men maaŋ chɛrga men be nfɛra n yɔ kakpa ko. Ma alɛ nseŋ naa nyi fanɛ Ebɔrɛ beeŋ gberge esa nɛ e kɔ menyi a wɔ kebagato to ere kusoe, e bee sha e baa du kanaŋkama.

english_verse: My friends, if I still preach that people need to be circumcised, why am I in so much trouble? The message about the cross would no longer be a problem, if I told people to be circumcised.
translation_verse: Bekurgepoana, menyee tama fanɛ n daŋ kraa malga katutuku be kamalga nna, meeŋ baa nya tɔrɔ le a? Nɛ n daa wora loŋ nna, dafanɛ Kristo be kedibi largato be kubɔya na daa maaŋ naa fɛl basa.

english_verse: I wish everyone who is upsetting you would not only get circumcised, but would cut off much more!
translation_verse: Alako basa nɛ baa tɔrɔ menyi ere daa beeŋ baŋ ku bumo be atutu kikɛ gba nna n lɛ kuraa. Kebaakɔ kebaawɔtɔ ashi Kiyoyu na to be asheŋ

english_verse: My friends, you were chosen to be free. So don't use your freedom as an excuse to do anything you want. Use it as an opportunity to serve each other with love.
translation_verse: Ŋ kurgepoana, Ebɔrɛ tre menyi ere nna nɛ men ba kaa wɔ men be amu. Ama men sa maŋ kaŋ shin nɛ le be kamoowɔ ere e sa menyi ekpa nɛ men shin nɛ men be eyur to be ayɛlgasɔ e baa wɔ menyi. Ama men shin nɛ kasha e baa shin nɛ men baa shuŋ abar.

english_verse: All the Law says can be summed up in the command to love others as much as you love yourself.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, mbraana na kikɛ wɔ mbra nɛ k bee kaŋɛ le: “Sha fo barkasa dimɛdi fanɛ fo kumu” na to nna.

english_verse: But if you keep attacking each other like wild animals, you had better watch out or you will destroy yourselves. God's Spirit and Our Own Desires
translation_verse: Ama nɛ men baa wɔtɔ a bile a wɔtɔ abar ebesa to bre, men baa da so, nɛ mannɛ aloŋ menyeeŋ mur abar cheche.

english_verse: If you are guided by the Spirit, you won't obey your selfish desires.
translation_verse: Amoso, mee kaŋɛ menyi nna na fanɛ men baa wɔ Kiyoyu na be kebaawɔtɔ to nsaa maa wora kapɔr lubi ere be ayɛlgasheŋ.

english_verse: The Spirit and your desires are enemies of each other. They are always fighting each other and keeping you from doing what you feel you should.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, kapɔr lubi ere be ayɛlgasɔ maa kukwe Kiyoyu na be ayɛlgasɔ nɛ Kiyoyu na malɛ be ayɛlgasɔ maa kukwe kapɔr lubi ere be ayɛlgasɔ. Loŋ be asɔ anyɔ na la bedoŋ nna nɛ kumo alɛ bee ŋini fanɛ men maaŋ tiŋ n wora kusɔ kama nɛ menyee sha.

english_verse: But if you obey the Spirit, the Law of Moses has no control over you.
translation_verse: Nɛ Kiyoyu na baa juŋkpar menyi, kumo ere men maŋ naa wɔ mbra na to.

english_verse: People's desires make them give in to immoral ways, filthy thoughts, and shameful deeds.
translation_verse: Kapɔr lubi ere be asheŋ woraso malɛ baŋ dii efuli nna. Amo nde: Kesakaleasheŋ nɛ eyurpisheŋ nɛ asheŋ jiga be ashuŋ

english_verse: They worship idols, practice witchcraft, hate others, and are hard to get along with. People become jealous, angry, and selfish. They not only argue and cause trouble, but they are
translation_verse: nɛ agbirshunsheŋ nɛ kegbaya nɛ kekishi nɛ nlusheŋ nɛ abar be asɔ be kebaayɛlga nɛ kanya agbo nɛ nfɛragboŋ be kebaafɛ nɛ amu be kebarga a wɔ ntuŋ so be kebaawɔtɔ.

english_verse: envious. They get drunk, carry on at wild parties, and do other evil things as well. I told you before, and I am telling you again: No one who does these things will share in the blessings of God's kingdom.
translation_verse: Kayurbesa, kasanuu jijiga nɛ amo be nfɛra lubiana n ta asheŋ lubi damta ko malɛ gba n ti so. N chɛr n fiɛ menyi so, ama men shin nɛ n naŋ lɔŋɛ ŋ kaŋɛ menyi fanɛ bekama nɛ baa wora le be asheŋ ere maaŋ luri Ebɔrɛ be kuwura na to kikɛ.

english_verse: gentle, and self-controlled. There is no law against behaving in any of these ways.
translation_verse: nɛ kebaa bar kumu kaseto nɛ kamootiŋ. Mbra na maa pɛ basa nɛ b wɔ le be asheŋ ere to.

english_verse: God's Spirit has given us life, and so we should follow the Spirit.
translation_verse: Naniere Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na e sa anyi ŋkpa, amoso, men shin nɛ e baa juŋkpar anyi.

english_verse: But don't be conceited or make others jealous by claiming to be better than they are.
translation_verse: Men sa maŋ shin nɛ an baa kɔ kamoowu ŋko a ta abar a wɔtɔ agbo to ŋko a besa abar eyur.

english_verse: My friends, you are spiritual. So if someone is trapped in sin, you should gently lead that person back to the right path. But watch out, and don't be tempted yourself.
translation_verse: Ŋ kurgepoana, nɛ men be ekama baŋ tɔr kulubi to, menyi nɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na bee juŋkpar na e bar men be amu kaseto n chɛ mo to nɛ e lar alubi na to. Ama nɛ menyee wora loŋ, men baa de men be amu so nɛ menyi alɛ gbagba e sa maŋ luri kechɔŋkeni to n tɔr.

english_verse: You obey the law of Christ when you offer each other a helping hand.
translation_verse: Men baa chɛ abar to ashi men be asheŋ tirso to, loŋ na menyeeŋ baa bɛ Kristo be mbra na so.

english_verse: If you think you are better than others, when you really aren't, you are wrong.
translation_verse: Nɛ ekama nɛ e bee fɛ fanɛ e la esagboŋ ko nna, mo alɛ ŋkaa maa la shɛŋ, bee fule mo gbagba be kumu nna na.

english_verse: Do your own work well, and then you will have something to be proud of. But don't compare yourself with others.
translation_verse: Ekama e baa keni mo gbagba be asheŋ woraso to a nyi kananɛ a du, nɛ a baa walɛ, e chɔrɔ mbe kumu. Ama e sa maa ta mbe asheŋ woraso a kesar esa pɔtɛ peya so.

english_verse: We each must carry our own load.
translation_verse: Ekama e baa de mo gbagba be asheŋ woraso so.

english_verse: Share every good thing you have with anyone who teaches you what God has said.
translation_verse: Ekama nɛ e bee nya abɔrɛsheŋ na be keŋini malɛ gba e baa kɔ mbe asɔ lela be ako a chɛ mbe eŋinipo na to.

english_verse: You cannot fool God, so don't make a fool of yourself! You will harvest what you plant.
translation_verse: Men sa maŋ kaŋ fule men be amu. Esa maaŋ tiŋ n wora Ebɔrɛ eyurto. Kusɔ kama nɛ esa baŋ duu, kumo gbagba nɛ e beeŋ ba teŋi kacha ko.

english_verse: Don't get tired of helping others. You will be rewarded when the time is right, if you don't give up.
translation_verse: Amoso, men sa maŋ shin nɛ kelela be kewora e baa gben menyi, ŋkpal manɛ so, nɛ an baa maŋ pɔ aba nsaa kɔ to loŋ, kachako anyeeŋ nya kelela be kewora be asɔ.

english_verse: We should help people whenever we can, especially if they are followers of the Lord. Final Warnings
translation_verse: Amoso, kananɛ an kraŋ baa kɔ ekpa naniere bre, men shin nɛ an baa wora basa kikɛ kelela, fɔnfɔŋ bumo nɛ b la an braana beyirdapo na. Lalaloge be kefiɛso nɛ kechɔrɔ be asheŋ

english_verse: You can see what big letters I make when I write with my own hand.
translation_verse: Naniere men wu kasibɛbi gboŋgboŋi ere ŋko? To, ŋ gbagba be enɔ to be kasibɛ nɛ ŋ kɔ a sa menyi nna na.

english_verse: They are circumcised, but they don't obey the Law of Moses. All they want is to brag about having you circumcised.
translation_verse: To, bumo nɛ b ku atutu na gba maa bɛ mbra na so, ama bumo alɛ nsaa sha fanɛ men ku atutu, saŋɛ na so baaŋ nya ekpa n ji njɔŋ ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ men bɛ loŋ be kesheŋ na so.

english_verse: But I will never brag about anything except the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ. Because of his cross, the world is dead as far as I am concerned, and I am dead as far as the world is concerned.
translation_verse: Ama ma ere, kaarɛ gba fanɛ ŋ ka beeŋ ji njɔŋ ko she an Nyɛnpe Yesu Kristo be luwu nɛ e wu kedibi largato na so nawule so, nɛ durnya maŋ naa la shɛŋ ma anishito.

english_verse: It doesn't matter if you are circumcised or not. All that matters is that you are a new person.
translation_verse: Nɛ esa maŋ kɔ kusholi ŋko e kɔ, k maŋ tir kuraa, kusɔ nɛ k tir e la kebaakɔ kebaawɔtɔ popɔr na.

english_verse: If you follow this rule, you will belong to God's true people. God will treat you with undeserved kindness and will bless you with peace.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ be kagbenewushi nɛ mbe kuwɔr e baa wɔ bekama nɛ baa bɛ le be kesheŋ ere so n ti Ebɔrɛ be basa kikɛ so.

english_verse: On my own body are scars that prove I belong to Christ Jesus. So I don't want anyone to bother me anymore.
translation_verse: Ade kikɛ be kaman, esa kama e sa maŋ naŋ bar ma tɔrɔ kikɛ, ŋkpal manɛ so, Yesu be ndulgi wɔ ma eyur so nna.

english_verse: My friends, I pray that the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you! Amen.
translation_verse: Ŋ kurgepoana, an Nyɛnpe Yesu Kristo be kuwɔr be kakɛ na e baa wɔ men kikɛ so nyam. Amɛn.

english_verse: From Paul, chosen by God to be an apostle of Christ Jesus. To God's people who live in Ephesus and are faithful followers of Christ Jesus.
translation_verse: Kawɔl ere shi ma Pɔɔl nɛ n la Kristo Yesu be eshuŋipo ŋkpal Ebɔrɛ be keparso na kutɔ nna a yɔ menyi, Ebɔrɛ be basa nɛ men wɔ Ɛfeses be kade to a bugi epunto a bɛ Kristo Yesu so na kutɔ.

english_verse: I pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! Christ Brings Spiritual Blessings
translation_verse: An Tuto Ebɔrɛ nɛ Enyɛnpe Yesu Kristo e sa menyi kuwɔr be kakɛ nɛ kagbenewushi. Nɛfa nɛ anyee nya ashi Yesu Kristo to be asheŋ

english_verse: Praise the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ for the spiritual blessings that Christ has brought us from heaven!
translation_verse: Men shin nɛ an chɔrɔ an Nyɛnpe Yesu Kristo be Ebɔrɛ nɛ e la mo Tuto na ga, ŋkpal manɛ so, e bɔla Kristo so n nɛfa anyi n ta abɔrɛsheŋ be kakɛ be yiri kikɛ ashi ebɔrɛso n sa anyi.

english_verse: Before the world was created, God had Christ choose us to live with him and to be his holy and innocent and loving people.
translation_verse: Kashenteŋto, pɔɛŋ nɛ Ebɔrɛ to durnya ere gba, e lara anyi nna fanɛ an baa la mo peya ashi Kristo to, saŋɛ na so anyeeŋ baa du cheembi a maa kɔ kulubi kikɛ mbe anishito.

english_verse: God treated us with undeserved grace because of the Son he dearly loves, and so we should praise God.
translation_verse: Men shin nɛ an baa di Ebɔrɛ epaŋ ŋkpal mbe le be mamachi be kuwɔr be kakɛ nɛ e bɔla mo Pibinyɛn shaso so n ta ŋ kɛ anyi na so.

english_verse: and by what Christ has done, God has shown us his own mysterious ways.
translation_verse: nseŋ naŋ bugi wulo be kesheŋ naseso nɛ e yili fanɛ e beeŋ bɔla Kristo so n shin nɛ loŋ e wora na n sa anyi.

english_verse: Then when the time is right, God will do all he has planned, and Christ will bring together everything in heaven and on earth.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ be kusɔ nɛ e nase nɛ e wora amo jemanɛ na gbagba kaŋ fo na e la fanɛ e beeŋ bar kepɔrso kikɛ abar so, amo nɛ a wɔ esoso nɛ kasawule so kikɛ nyam nɛ Kristo e baa la amo kikɛ be kumu.

english_verse: He did this so we Jews would bring honor to him and be the first ones to have hope because of him.
translation_verse: Men shin nɛ anyi nɛ an juŋkpar n nya tama ashi Kristo to na e baa la bumo nɛ bumo be kebaawɔtɔ bee di Ebɔrɛ epaŋ nsaa maŋkura mo.

english_verse: Christ also brought you the truth, which is the good news about how you can be saved. You put your faith in Christ and were given the promised Holy Spirit to show you belong to God.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal kusɔ nɛ e wora na so, menyi alɛ gba ka daŋ nu kashenteŋ be kubɔya nɛ k bee bar menyi kumɔlga na, men yirda Kristo, nɛ Ebɔrɛ ta mbe ndulgi n dulgi menyi na. Kiyoyu Cheeŋ nɛ e nase kɔnɔ fanɛ e beeŋ sa na nɛ e ta n sa a ŋini fanɛ e dulgi anyi.

english_verse: The Spirit also makes us sure we will be given what God has stored up for his people. Then we will be set free, and God will be honored and praised. Paul's Prayer
translation_verse: Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na e la anyi be tɔɔnɛ a sa anyi tama fanɛ anyeeŋ nya kusɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ nase kɔnɔ fanɛ e beeŋ sa mbe basa na fanɛ bekama nɛ b la mo peya beeŋ nya bumo be amu nsaa la bumo nɛ bumo be kebaawɔtɔ bee di Ebɔrɛ epaŋ nsaa maŋkura mo. Pɔɔl be kabɔrɛkule be asheŋ

english_verse: So I never stop being grateful for you, as I mention you in my prayers.
translation_verse: nsaa nyiŋi menyi ashi ma kabɔrɛkuleana to a kule an Nyɛnpe Yesu Kristo be Ebɔrɛ, Etuto nɛ kemaŋkura wɔ mo so ga na,

english_verse: I ask the glorious Father and God of our Lord Jesus Christ to give you his Spirit. The Spirit will make you wise and let you understand what it means to know God.
translation_verse: fanɛ e sa menyi Kiyoyu mo nɛ e beeŋ shin nɛ men baa kɔ kanyiasheŋ nseŋ naŋ lara Ebɔrɛ ŋ ŋini menyi nɛ men pin mo kashenteŋto.

english_verse: My prayer is that light will flood your hearts and you will understand the hope given to you when God chose you. Then you will discover the glorious blessings that will be yours together with all God's people.
translation_verse: Ma alɛ nseŋ kraŋ naa kule Ebɔrɛ fanɛ e shin nɛ men bugi men be ŋgbene to n tiŋ m pin tama mo nɛ men nya ŋkpal e ka tre menyi na so to, nseŋ naa pin mamachi be enɛfagboŋ nɛ e nase kɔnɔ fanɛ e beeŋ sa mbe basa na to.

english_verse: I want you to know about the great and mighty power that God has for us followers. It is the same wonderful power he used
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ men naŋ pin mbe eleŋgboŋ nɛ k wɔ anyi nɛ an yirda ere to.

english_verse: when he raised Christ from death and let him sit at his right side in heaven.
translation_verse: Le be eleŋ ere nɛ eleŋ damta nɛ e ta n tiŋi Kristo ashi luwu to nseŋ ta mo n chena mbe jisoso, ebunyampo be kakpa ashi ebɔrɛso na.

english_verse: There Christ rules over all forces, authorities, powers, and rulers. He rules over all beings in this world and will rule in the future world as well.
translation_verse: Kristo na e naa ji kuwura koŋwule esoso be kenimuji kikɛ nɛ kejuŋkpar kikɛ nɛ eleŋana kikɛ nɛ kenyɛnpeji kikɛ so. Mo e chɔ eleŋana kikɛ nɛ amo be adelebiana kikɛ ashi jemanɛ ere to nɛ kumo nɛ k bee ba na kikɛ to.

english_verse: God has put all things under the power of Christ, and for the good of the church he has made him the head of everything.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ ta kusɔ kikɛ nna n wɔtɔ mbe enɔ to nseŋ lara mo fanɛ e baa la kusɔ kikɛ be kumu a sa asɔri na.

english_verse: The church is the body of Christ and is filled with Christ who completely fills everything.
translation_verse: Asɔri na e la Kristo be eyur na. Mo e naa shin nɛ kusɔ kama bee bɔla so a loge nɛnɛ ashi ekpa kama so.

english_verse: In the past you were dead because you sinned and fought against God.
translation_verse: To, menyi alɛ gba du fanɛ basa nɛ b wu nna ŋkpal men ka daŋ foe ekpa a wɔtɔ a wora alubi na so.

english_verse: You followed the ways of this world and obeyed the devil. He rules the world, and his spirit has power over everyone who doesn't obey God.
translation_verse: Loŋ be kebaawɔtɔ to nɛ men daa wɔ saŋɛ nɛ men daa bɛ durnya ere be asheŋ woraso so nseŋ daa bɛ esoso be eleŋana be ewura so, mo e la kiyoyu nɛ e wɔ basa nɛ b maa nu a sa Ebɔrɛ na to a shuŋ naniere na.

english_verse: Once we were also ruled by the selfish desires of our bodies and minds. We had made God angry, and we were going to be punished like everyone else.
translation_verse: Loŋ malɛ nɛ anyi kikɛ gba daa du saŋko a wɔ amo to a wora anyi be kapɔr lubi ere be aparsheŋ nsaa wora kumo be ayɛlgasɔ a fɛ kumo be nfɛra. Ŋkpal anyi be kapɔr lubi ere so anyi alɛ gba daa du fanɛ ekama nna a wɔ Ebɔrɛ be demuji be agbo to.

english_verse: But God was merciful! We were dead because of our sins, but God loved us so much he made us alive with Christ, and God's gift of undeserved grace is what saves you.
translation_verse: e tiŋi anyi nɛ Kristo nna m bar anyi ŋkpa to saŋɛ nɛ an daa wɔ kasomaanu be luwu to na. Ebɔrɛ malɛ be kuwɔr be kakɛ so nɛ men nya kumɔlga.

english_verse: God raised us from death to life with Christ Jesus, and he has given us a place beside Christ in heaven.
translation_verse: E tiŋi anyi nɛ Kristo nna nseŋ shin nɛ anyi nɛ mo chena ebɔrɛso ashi mo koŋwule Kristo Yesu na to.

english_verse: God did this so in the future world he could show how truly good and kind he is to us because of what Christ Jesus has done.
translation_verse: E wora loŋ nna nɛ e ŋini jemanɛ kama nɛ k bee ba to ebi fanɛ kananɛ e ta mbe kuwɔr be kakɛgboŋ damtaana nɛ e bɔla mbe kasha so n sa anyi na ŋ kɛ anyi ashi Kristo Yesu to.

english_verse: You were saved by faith in God, who treats us much better than we deserve. This is God's gift to you, and not anything you have done on your own.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ be kuwɔr be kakɛ so e shin nɛ men bɔla yirda so n nya kumɔlga, mannɛ men gbagba be ashuŋ shunso so nɛ men nya kumo. K la Ebɔrɛ be kakɛ nna.

english_verse: It isn't something you have earned, so there is nothing you can brag about.
translation_verse: Mannɛ ashuŋ shunso so nɛ baa nya kumo, saŋɛ na so esa kama maaŋ nya ekpa m puchi.

english_verse: God planned for us to do good things and to live as he has always wanted us to live. This is why he sent Christ to make us what we are. United by Christ
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, an la mbe apɔrso nna nɛ e sa anyi kebaawɔtɔ popɔr ashi Kristo Yesu to nseŋ ta anyi n wɔtɔ kelela be asheŋ nɛ mo ere Ebɔrɛ na yili kumo dra dra na kikɛ to fanɛ an ba kaa shuŋ na. Kananɛ an la kukoŋwule Kristo to be asheŋ

english_verse: Don't forget that you are Gentiles. In fact, you used to be called “uncircumcised” by those who take pride in being circumcised.
translation_verse: Amoso, men baa nyiŋi fanɛ menyi nɛ b kurge nnyamase nɛ bumo nɛ edimɛdi ta enɔana ŋ ku bumo atutu nɛ bumo koŋwule na bee tre menyi asoliwuraana ere, fanɛ menyi nɛ Kristo na daŋ barga abar nna.

english_verse: At that time you did not know about Christ. You were foreigners to the people of Israel, and you had no part in the promises God had made to them. You were living in this world without hope and without God,
translation_verse: Men daa la befɔ nna ashi Israɛl be efuli so ebi to. Menyi alɛ be shɛŋ daa maŋ wɔ nnɔkoŋwule nɛ a wɔ Ebɔrɛ nɛ Israɛlebi be nferinto na to, ŋkpal mbe nnɔ naseso nɛ e nase n sa mbe basa na so. Men daa wɔ durnya ere to nna a maŋ kɔ tama kikɛ, menyi alɛ daa maa ta Ebɔrɛ a wɔtɔ men be asheŋ to.

english_verse: and you were far from God. But Christ offered his life's blood as a sacrifice and brought you near God.
translation_verse: Ama naniere ashi Kristo to, menyi nɛ saŋko men daa maŋ taga Ebɔrɛ to na, Ebɔrɛ bɔla Kristo be luwu na so nna n shin nɛ men ba taga mo to.

english_verse: Christ has made peace between Jews and Gentiles, and he has united us by breaking down the wall of hatred that separated us. Christ gave his own body
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, mo gbagba e la anyi be kagbenewushi nɛ esa nɛ e bee bar anyi basa yiri ntuŋ anyɔ abar so. E jija kebarga to nɛ k daa wɔ anyi nɛ basa be nferinto na, kumo e la kekishi be kebarga to na.

english_verse: to destroy the Law of Moses with all its rules and commands. He even brought Jews and Gentiles together as though we were only one person, when he united us in peace.
translation_verse: E ta mbe kumu ŋ kpra Juwebi be mbra na nɛ kumo be ntaŋana nɛ loŋ e shin nɛ basa yiri ntuŋ anyɔ na e ba abar so m ba ki basa koŋwule, saŋɛ na so e beeŋ bar kagbenewushi bumo to.

english_verse: On the cross Christ did away with our hatred for each other. He also made peace between us and God by uniting Jews and Gentiles in one body.
translation_verse: Loŋ na basa anyɔ na beeŋ ki basa koŋwule nɛ bumo nɛ Ebɔrɛ malɛ e nyalɛ ŋkpal kedibi largato na so, saŋɛ na so malɛ e beeŋ shin nɛ kebarga to na e loge.

english_verse: Christ came and preached peace to you Gentiles, who were far from God, and peace to us Jews, who were near God.
translation_verse: Le be kagbenewushi be baru lela ere nɛ e ba bɔ n sa menyi nɛ men daa maŋ taga mo to na nɛ bumo nɛ b taga mo to na kikɛ.

english_verse: And because of Christ, all of us can come to the Father by the same Spirit.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, mo so nɛ anyi nɛ bumo kikɛ bee bɔla a nya ekpa a yɔ Ebɔrɛ na kutɔ ashi Kiyoyu koŋwule na to.

english_verse: You Gentiles are no longer strangers and foreigners. You are citizens with everyone else who belongs to the family of God.
translation_verse: Amoso, menyi nnyamase maŋ naa la befɔ n shi efuli ko so. Naniere menyi nɛ Ebɔrɛ be basa la kukoŋwule nna a la kakpa koŋwule so ebi nseŋ naa la Ebɔrɛ be kowu to ebi be basa.

english_verse: You are like a building with the apostles and prophets as the foundation and with Christ as the most important stone.
translation_verse: Men du fanɛ egbal be kaba nna nɛ kumo be kifi la beshuŋipo nɛ anebiana na, nɛ Kristo Yesu malɛ gbagba la kumo be gbaltɔlase.

english_verse: Christ is the one who holds the building together and makes it grow into a holy temple for the Lord.
translation_verse: Mo e kɔ ebu na be kaplɛkama to a shin nɛ k wɔ abar so a yɔ anishito a ti so a ki bɔrɛlambu cheembi ashi Enyɛnpe na to.

english_verse: And you are part of that building Christ has built as a place for God's own Spirit to live.
translation_verse: Menyi alɛ gba, baa pɔr menyi nna a wɔtɔ mo to nɛ men ba ki ebu nɛ Ebɔrɛ beeŋ bɔla Kiyoyu na to a wɔ to na.

english_verse: Christ Jesus made me his prisoner, so I could help you Gentiles.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal le so nɛ ma Pɔɔl la Kristo Yesu be kabutipo ŋkpal menyi nnyamase so.

english_verse: You have surely heard about God's gift of undeserved grace in choosing me to help you.
translation_verse: Ma alɛ baa nyi geeŋ fanɛ men nu fanɛ Ebɔrɛ bɔla mbe kuwɔr be kakɛ so nna n sa ma kushuŋ na ŋkpal men be kelela so.

english_verse: In fact, this letter tells you a little about how God has shown me his mysterious ways.
translation_verse: Kumo e la wulo be kesheŋ naseso nɛ Ebɔrɛ bugi to ŋ ŋini ma na, kumo be asheŋ nɛ n teŋ sibɛ gbrɛ n sa menyi na.

english_verse: As you read the letter, you will also find out how well I really do understand the mystery about Christ.
translation_verse: Nɛ menyi alɛ baŋ kraŋ kawɔl ere, menyeeŋ pin kananɛ ma nfɛra sa ashi Kristo be wulo be kesheŋ ere be kaplɛa so.

english_verse: No one knew about this mystery until God's Spirit told it to his holy apostles and prophets.
translation_verse: Saŋɛ na be esa kikɛ daa maŋ nyi le be wulo be kesheŋ nɛ e bɔla Kiyoyu na to m bugi to ŋ ŋini mbe beshuŋipo cheembiana nɛ mbe anebiana ere.

english_verse: And the mystery is this: Because of Christ Jesus, the good news has given the Gentiles a share in the promises God gave to the Jews. God has also let the Gentiles be part of the same body.
translation_verse: Wulo na nde fanɛ baru lela na so nɛ nnyamase nɛ Juwebi kikɛ beeŋ gama n nya Ebɔrɛ be enɛfa na. B la eyur koŋwule to be mba nna ŋ gama a kɔ Ebɔrɛ be nnɔ naseso nɛ Ebɔrɛ bɔla Kristo Yesu so n nase na.

english_verse: God treated me with kindness. His power worked in me, and it became my job to spread the good news.
translation_verse: Le be baru lela ere be kenya nɛ Ebɔrɛ bɔla mbe kuwɔr be kakɛ so n ta ma ŋ ki na. Mbe eleŋ na so nɛ e bɔla n wora loŋ.

english_verse: I am the least important of all God's people. But God was kind and chose me to tell the Gentiles that because of Christ there are blessings that cannot be measured.
translation_verse: Kashenteŋto nna fanɛ m maŋ fo Ebɔrɛ be basa to be ekekarso gba kuraa, ama Ebɔrɛ ta le be kuwɔr be kakɛ ere nna n sa ma nɛ m bɔ Kristo be enɛfa damta be baru lela na n sa nnyamase

english_verse: Then God would use the church to show the powers and authorities in the spiritual world that he has many different kinds of wisdom.
translation_verse: Saŋɛ na so e beeŋ bɔla asɔriebi na to n shin nɛ mbe kashennyi damta e dii efuli n sa esoso be kenimujipoana nɛ bejuŋkparpo ashi ebɔrɛso.

english_verse: God did this according to his eternal plan. And he was able to do what he had planned because of all Christ Jesus our Lord had done.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ wora loŋ nna ŋkpal mbe kesheŋ naseso nɛ e bɔla an Nyɛnpe Kristo Yesu so n wora dra dra na kikɛ so.

english_verse: Christ now gives us courage and confidence, so we can come to God by faith.
translation_verse: Mo to nɛ keyirda mo so nɛ anyeeŋ tiŋ m ba Ebɔrɛ be anishito a maa wora shikashika kikɛ.

english_verse: This is why you should not be discouraged when I suffer for you. After all, it will bring honor to you. Christ's Love for Us
translation_verse: Amoso, mee kule menyi nna fanɛ men sa maa pɔ aba ŋkpal ŋ ka bee wu tɔrɔ a sa menyi so so, men be kelela so nɛ loŋ be asheŋ bee nya ma. Kristo be kasha be asheŋ

english_verse: I kneel in prayer to the Father.
translation_verse: Amoso nɛ mee gbir Etuto

english_verse: All beings in heaven and on earth receive their life from him.
translation_verse: nɛ ebɔrɛso nɛ kasawule so be kebɛso be kakurge kikɛ bee nya kumo be ketre ashi mo to na kumuli na.

english_verse: God is wonderful and glorious. I pray that his Spirit will make you become strong followers
translation_verse: Mee kule mo fanɛ e keni mbe kemaŋkura damta nɛ e kɔ na to m bɔla mbe Kiyoyu na to a ta eleŋ n leŋ menyi to ashi men be ŋgbeneana to

english_verse: and that Christ will live in your hearts because of your faith. Stand firm and be deeply rooted in his love.
translation_verse: nɛ Kristo e tiŋ m bɔla men be yirda so a wɔ men be ŋgbeneana to. Ma alɛ nseŋ naa kule mo fanɛ e shin nɛ men tɔl to m pɛ kasha to a yil kpakpa fanɛ nliŋi na.

english_verse: I pray that you and all God's people will understand what is called wide or long or high or deep.
translation_verse: Saŋɛ na so menyi, n ta Ebɔrɛ be basa kikɛ n ti so, beeŋ nya nfɛra m pin kananɛ Ebɔrɛ be kasha wɔ mpar nɛ kananɛ k wɔ nteŋ nɛ kananɛ k du jeŋgreŋ nɛ kananɛ k du chiŋgeliŋ.

english_verse: I want you to know all about Christ's love, although it is too wonderful to be measured. Then your lives will be filled with all that God is.
translation_verse: Kashenteŋto esa ba maaŋ tiŋ m pin mbe kasha na to n ya loge, ama kumo nɛ mee kule mo fanɛ e shin nɛ men ba pin nɛ k tiŋ n shin nɛ Ebɔrɛ e bɔlɔ men be kebaawɔtɔ kikɛ to nyam.

english_verse: I pray that Christ Jesus and the church will forever bring praise to God. His power at work in us can do far more than we dare ask or imagine. Amen.
translation_verse: Kemaŋkura koŋwule na e baa la mo peya ashi asɔri na to nɛ Kristo Yesu to jemanɛ kikɛ to naniere hale mbaanaayɔ. Amɛn.

english_verse: As a prisoner of the Lord, I beg you to live in a way that is worthy of the people God has chosen to be his own.
translation_verse: Ma Pɔɔl nɛ n wɔ kabuti to ŋkpal Enyɛnpe so na e naa leŋ menyi to a kaŋɛ menyi fanɛ men baa kɔ kebaawɔtɔ nɛ k maa ji ketre nɛ Ebɔrɛ tre menyi na emɔrɔ.

english_verse: Always be humble and gentle. Patiently put up with each other and love each other.
translation_verse: Saŋkikɛ men baa bar men be amu ase a du boeŋ nsaa kɔ kanyiti a chɛ abar to a ŋini kasha nɛ k wɔ menyi to na.

english_verse: Try your best to let God's Spirit keep your hearts united. Do this by living at peace.
translation_verse: Men baa wora ania ga a kɔ kɔnɔkoŋwuleso be kebaawɔtɔ be kagbenewushi nɛ k bee shi Kiyoyu na kutɔ nsaa bar menyi abar so na to kpakpa.

english_verse: All of you are part of the same body. There is only one Spirit of God, just as you were given one hope when you were chosen to be God's people.
translation_verse: Eyur koŋwule nɛ Kiyoyu koŋwule e wɔtɔ fanɛ kananɛ tama koŋwule nɛ Ebɔrɛ tre menyi m ba wɔtɔ kumo to na gba wɔtɔ na.

english_verse: We have only one Lord, one faith, and one baptism.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe koŋwule nɛ yirda koŋwule nɛ kabɔrɛbɛr koŋwule e wɔtɔ.

english_verse: There is one God who is the Father of all people. Not only is God above all others, but he works by using all of us, and he lives in all of us.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ koŋwule nɛ e la ekama mo tuto nsaa la esa nɛ e chɔ ekama nɛ emo nɛ e bɔla ekama to a shuŋ nsaa wɔ ekama to na e wɔtɔ.

english_verse: As the Scriptures say, “When he went up to the highest place, he led away many prisoners and gave gifts to people.”
translation_verse: Amoso nɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ le na fanɛ: “E ka daŋ dii n yɔ esoso na, e daŋ yɛr anya nna nseŋ kɛ basa ŋkɛana.”

english_verse: When it says, “he went up,” it means that Christ had been deep in the earth.
translation_verse: Ama kekaŋɛ fanɛ e daŋ dii n yɔ esoso maŋ naa kɔ kifito n naŋ ti kede so fanɛ e daŋ gbelge nna m ba kasawule so be kaseto pɔɛŋ.

english_verse: This also means that the one who went deep into the earth is the same one who went into the highest heaven, so he would fill the whole universe.
translation_verse: Amoso, mo koŋwule nɛ e daŋ gbelge m ba na e naŋ dii n yɔ kufɔ a chɔ esoso be kaplɛkama, saŋɛ na so mbe kebaawɔtɔ be asheŋ beeŋ sɔ kaplɛkama verr.

english_verse: This will continue until we are united by our faith and by our understanding of the Son of God. Then we will be mature, just as Christ is, and we will be completely like him.
translation_verse: Loŋ na an kikɛ beeŋ baa wɔ abar so ashi anyi be yirda nɛ anyi be kananɛ an nyi Ebɔrɛ Pibinyɛn na loŋ hale nɛ an ya kaa kɔ kebɛso na to be kenimufɛra n duli Kristo gbagba kusɔ kama to.

english_verse: Love should always make us tell the truth. Then we will grow in every way and be more like Christ, the head
translation_verse: Ama anyeeŋ baa la basa nɛ baa ji abar kashenteŋ kashaso, loŋ na nɛ anyeeŋ yɔ anishito ashi kebɛso na to n duli Kristo nɛ e la an be kumu na ekpa kama so nyam.

english_verse: Their minds are in the dark, and they are stubborn and ignorant and have missed out on the life that comes from God. They no longer have any feelings about what is right,
translation_verse: Alubi tegsi bumo nna n shin nɛ bumo be ŋgbene biri to tuum a maŋ naa pin asheŋ to ŋkpal bumo be ŋgbene kpakpaso nɛ kemaa nyi nɛ k bee ji kuwura bumo so na so. Naniere bumo nɛ ŋkpa nɛ Ebɔrɛ bee sa na barga abar cheche.

english_verse: But this isn't what you were taught about Jesus Christ. He is the truth, and you heard about him and learned about him.
translation_verse: M baa nyi men ka daŋ nu mbe asheŋ nɛ b naŋ ŋini menyi kashenteŋ nɛ k wɔ mo koŋwule Kristo to na.

english_verse: You were told that your foolish desires will destroy you and that you must give up your old way of life with all its bad habits.
translation_verse: Amoso, men lara men be kapɔr dra nɛ k daa wɔ men be kebaawɔtɔ to n jija ŋkpal efɛ be ayɛlgasɔ na so ashi to.

english_verse: Let the Spirit change your way of thinking
translation_verse: A daga fanɛ men be ŋgbene nɛ nfɛra kikɛ ka ki asɔ popɔr nyam.

english_verse: and make you into a new person. You were created to be like God, and so you must please him and be truly holy. Rules for the New Life
translation_verse: Men luri kapɔr popɔr nɛ Ebɔrɛ pɔr nɛ k du fanɛ mo gbagba be kapɔr a yɔ kashenteŋ be alelasheŋ nɛ kebaawɔtɔ cheembi be kaplɛa so na to.

english_verse: We are part of the same body. Stop lying and start telling each other the truth.
translation_verse: Amoso, men be ekama e lara efɛsheŋ ashi mbe kebaawɔtɔ to nsaa malga kashenteŋ be mmalga a sa mo braana, ŋkpal manɛ so, an kikɛ la eyur koŋwule to be mba nna.

english_verse: and don't give the devil a chance.
translation_verse: Sa maŋ kaŋ sa alubipo na ekpa kikɛ.
