english_verse: If you are a thief, quit stealing. Be honest and work hard, so you will have something to give to people in need.
translation_verse: Ekama nɛ e daa yuri e yige kayu na naniere nseŋ fara a ta mbe enɔana a wora asheŋ lela a shuŋ, saŋɛ na so e beeŋ nya kusɔ nɛ k daga n tiŋ n chɛ bumo nɛ b maŋ kɔ to.

english_verse: Don't make God's Spirit sad. The Spirit makes you sure that someday you will be free from your sins.
translation_verse: Menyi alɛ e sa maa jija Ebɔrɛ be Kiyoyu Cheeŋ nɛ Ebɔrɛ ta n dulgi menyi n yili kesɔnyigeachɛ na.

english_verse: Stop being bitter and angry and mad at others. Don't yell at one another or curse each other or ever be rude.
translation_verse: Men lara ŋgbene nɛ a maa yige asheŋ a paŋ na menyi to, nseŋ lara kenyaŋɛto nɛ agbo nɛ kaponte nɛ katege nɛ kekishiso be nfɛra be yiri kikɛ menyi to.

english_verse: Do as God does. After all, you are his dear children.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal men ka la Ebɔrɛ be mbia shaso so, men wora ania a du fanɛ mo gbagba.

english_verse: Being greedy, indecent, or immoral is just another way of worshiping idols. You can be sure people who behave in this way will never be part of the kingdom that belongs to Christ and to God. Living as People of Light
translation_verse: Men baa nyi kesheŋ ere geeŋ fanɛ esa kama nɛ e kɔ kesakalea be kebaawɔtɔ ŋko eyurpisheŋ ŋko esa kama nɛ e kɔ kejimuni maaŋ luri Kristo nɛ Ebɔrɛ be kuwura na to. Kejimuni du fanɛ kagbirshuŋ nna.

english_verse: So don't have anything to do with anyone like that.
translation_verse: Men sa maŋ kaŋ tu bumo a wora loŋ be asheŋ.

english_verse: You used to be like people living in the dark, but now you are people of the light because you belong to the Lord. So act like people of the light
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, dra na menyi alɛ gba daa wɔ tentembiri to nna, ama naniere bre men wɔ kefulto to nna ashi Enyɛnpe na to. Amoso, men baa wɔtɔ fanɛ basa nɛ b wɔ kefulto to.

english_verse: as you try to please the Lord.
translation_verse: Men baa wora ania a pin asɔ nɛ a bee par Ebɔrɛ.

english_verse: Don't take part in doing those worthless things that are done in the dark. Instead, show how wrong they are.
translation_verse: Men shin nɛ men be asheŋ e sa maa wɔ tentembiri be chilchil be asheŋ woraso to, ama men baa lara loŋ be asheŋ na efuli.

english_verse: It is disgusting even to talk about what is done in the dark.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, kemalga asheŋ nɛ basa ŋana a wora ere be asheŋ gba kɔ anishinyɔr nna.

english_verse: Light shows up everything, just as the Scriptures say, “Wake up from your sleep and rise from death. Then Christ will shine on you.”
translation_verse: Amoso nɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ le na fanɛ: “Edipo koso, niŋi to ŋ koso ashi luwu to nɛ Kristo e nyaŋɛ kefulto n yuu fo so.”

english_verse: Act like people with good sense and not like fools.
translation_verse: Amoso, men baa de men be kebaawɔtɔ so nɛnɛ fanɛ benyiashempo, mannɛ fanɛ bewulpo.

english_verse: These are evil times, so make every minute count.
translation_verse: Saŋɛ lubi to nɛ an wɔ na, amoso, men sa maa jija saŋɛ gbrɛbi kikɛ nɛ men nya.

english_verse: Don't be stupid. Instead, find out what the Lord wants you to do.
translation_verse: Amoso, men sa maa la bewulpo. Men baa wora ania a pin kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe bee sha fanɛ an baa wora.

english_verse: Always use the name of our Lord Jesus Christ to thank God the Father for everything. Wives and Husbands
translation_verse: Saŋkikɛ men baa chɔrɔ Ebɔrɛ Etuto na ŋkpal kusɔ kikɛ so ashi an Nyɛnpe Yesu Kristo be ketre to. Beche kilpo nɛ bekulana be asheŋ

english_verse: A wife should put her husband first, as she does the Lord.
translation_verse: Beche kilpo, men baa bar men be amu kaseto a sa men kulana fanɛ kananɛ menyee wora a sa Enyɛnpe na.

english_verse: A husband is the head of his wife, as Christ is the head and the Savior of the church, which is his own body.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, ekul na e la mbe eche be kumu fanɛ kananɛ Kristo la asɔri be kumu nɛ k la mbe eyur nɛ e la kumo be emɔlgapo na.

english_verse: A husband should love his wife as much as Christ loved the church and gave his life for it.
translation_verse: Benyɛn, men baa sha men be becheana fanɛ kananɛ Kristo sha asɔri na nseŋ ta mbe kumu n sa kumo na.

english_verse: He made the church holy by the power of his word, and he made it pure by washing it with water.
translation_verse: E wora loŋ nna nɛ e ta asɔri na m bɔɔ Ebɔrɛ enɔ nseŋ bɔla Ebɔrɛ be kamalga so n fɔr kumo fanɛ kachubɛr na.

english_verse: In the same way, a husband should love his wife as much as he loves himself. A husband who loves his wife shows he loves himself.
translation_verse: To, kananɛ k daga fanɛ benyɛn e baa wora nna na, kumo e la fanɛ b baa sha bumo be beche fanɛ kananɛ baa sha bumo gbagba be amu na. Enyɛn kama nɛ e bee sha mbe eche bee sha mo gbagba be kumu nna na.

english_verse: None of us hate our own bodies. We provide for them and take good care of them, just as Christ does for the church,
translation_verse: Esa malɛ kikɛ maŋ naŋ kishi mo gbagba be eyur. Kusɔ nɛ e bee wora e la fanɛ e bee kaa sa kumo ajibi nna nsaa keni kumo so fanɛ kananɛ Kristo bee wora a sa asɔri na.

english_verse: because we are each part of his body.
translation_verse: Anyi alɛ la mbe eyur na be mba ko nna.

english_verse: As the Scriptures say, “A man leaves his father and mother to get married, and he becomes like one person with his wife.”
translation_verse: Loŋ malɛ nɛ enyɛn nɛ mbe eche du. Amoso nɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ le na: “Ŋkpal le so, enyɛn beeŋ yige mo nio nɛ mo tuto nseŋ ya far n chɛ mbe eche nɛ bumo benyɔ na e ki kukoŋwule.”

english_verse: This is a great mystery, but I understand it to mean Christ and his church.
translation_verse: Loŋ be kesheŋ ere malɛ la wulo be kashenteŋgboŋ nna n sa anyi, ama kashenteŋto, Kristo nɛ asɔri na be kaplɛa so nɛ mee malga.

english_verse: So each husband should love his wife as much as he loves himself, and each wife should respect her husband.
translation_verse: Ama a daga fanɛ men be ekama gba e baa sha mbe eche fanɛ kananɛ e bee sha mo gbagba be kumu, nɛ eche kama malɛ e baa bunyaŋ mo kul.

english_verse: Children, you belong to the Lord, and you do the right thing when you obey your parents. The first commandment with a promise says,
translation_verse: Mbia, men baa nu a sa basa nɛ b kurge menyi, ŋkpal Enyɛnpe na so, ŋkpal manɛ so, loŋ e daga.

english_verse: Slaves, you must obey your earthly masters. Show them great respect and be as loyal to them as you are to Christ.
translation_verse: Anya, men baa nu a sa men be durnya ere to be benyɛnpe a ŋana bumo a chicha. Men baa ta kagbene koŋwule a wora kumo fanɛ Kristo gbagba nɛ menyee shuŋ.

english_verse: Try to please them at all times, and not just when you think they are watching. You are slaves of Christ, so with your whole heart you must do what God wants you to do.
translation_verse: Saŋkikɛ men baa nu a sa bumo, mannɛ fanɛ nɛ b wu menyi nɛ men nya ketre bumo kutɔ so, ama men baa ta men be ŋgbene kikɛ a wora asɔ nɛ a bee par Ebɔrɛ nɛ men baa du fanɛ Kristo be anya.

english_verse: Gladly serve your masters, as though they were the Lord himself, and not simply people.
translation_verse: Men baa ta men be ŋgbene kikɛ a shuŋ men be ashuŋ a nyi fanɛ Enyɛnpe nɛ menyee shuŋ, mannɛ dimɛdi nɛ menyee shuŋ

english_verse: You know that you will be rewarded for any good things you do, whether you are slaves or free.
translation_verse: a nyi fanɛ kelela kama nɛ esa wora, Enyɛnpe na beeŋ sa mo kumo be tɔnɔ, nɛ amodoŋwura wɔ mbe kumu ŋko e la kenya gba, k maŋ tir.

english_verse: Slave owners, you must treat your slaves with this same respect. Don't threaten them. They have the same Master in heaven that you do, and he doesn't have favorites. The Fight against Evil
translation_verse: Benyɛnpe, menyi alɛ gba e baa wora menyi be anya loŋ. Men sa maa funti a funti bumo, ŋkpal manɛ so, menyi alɛ gba nyi fanɛ esa nɛ e wɔ ebɔrɛso a la menyi nɛ anya na kikɛ be Enyɛnpe na maŋ kɔ ŋkpɛato. Ebɔrɛ be akɔsɔ be keta be asheŋ

english_verse: Finally, let the mighty strength of the Lord make you strong.
translation_verse: Ade kikɛ be kaman, men baa kɔ eleŋ Enyɛnpe na nɛ mbe eleŋgboŋ na to.

english_verse: Put on all the armor that God gives, so you can defend yourself against the devil's tricks.
translation_verse: Men baa ta Ebɔrɛ be akɔsɔ kikɛ nyam a buu a kre to, saŋɛ na so menyeeŋ tiŋ n yili n tu Setani na be kafulesheŋ ana.

english_verse: We are not fighting against humans. We are fighting against forces and authorities and against rulers of darkness and powers in the spiritual world.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, mannɛ anyi nɛ edimɛdi e naa kɔ, ama anyi nɛ esoso be kenimujipoana nɛ bejuŋkparpoana nɛ tentembiri to be durnya ere to be eleŋana nɛ esoso be ayoyu lubiana e naa kɔ.

english_verse: So put on all the armor that God gives. Then when that evil day comes, you will be able to defend yourself. And when the battle is over, you will still be standing firm.
translation_verse: Amoso, men ta Ebɔrɛ be akɔsɔ naniere m buu ŋ kre to, saŋɛ na so kachɛ lubi na kaŋ tu menyi, menyeeŋ tiŋ n nya aya n yili. Nɛ menyi alɛ baŋ tiŋ n wora kusɔ kama, menyeeŋ nya n yili to kpakpa.

english_verse: Be ready! Let the truth be like a belt around your waist, and let God's justice protect you like armor.
translation_verse: Amoso, men yili to nɛnɛ n ta kashenteŋ ŋ kre kashɛr to kpakpa fanɛ kreso nseŋ ta alelasheŋ malɛ fanɛ kebɛlso be kekpaŋkale.

english_verse: Your desire to tell the good news about peace should be like shoes on your feet.
translation_verse: Nɛ men baa sha kebaabɔ kagbenewushi be baru lela na fanɛ loŋ be kasha ka la asɛbta a wɔ men be aya to na.

english_verse: Let your faith be like a shield, and you will be able to stop all the flaming arrows of the evil one.
translation_verse: Saŋkikɛ men baa kɔ yirda to fanɛ kebɛlso be kusɔ kuŋkumuso. Yirda na nɛ menyeeŋ tiŋ n ta n duŋ Setani be atanyembi nɛ a bɛl m pere fanɛ ajanwulɛbi nɛ e kɔ a tu menyi na.

english_verse: Let God's saving power be like a helmet, and for a sword use God's message that comes from the Spirit.
translation_verse: Men baa shin nɛ kumɔlga na e baa la menyeya a kuŋ menyi fanɛ kebɛlso be kekpaŋwuro nseŋ naa ta kiyoyu na be tokobi nɛ k la Ebɔrɛ be kamalga na gba a kɔ.

english_verse: Pray that I will be given the message to speak and that I may fearlessly explain the mystery about the good news.
translation_verse: Men baa kule Ebɔrɛ a sa ma alɛ gba fanɛ saŋkama nɛ m bugi kɔnɔ nɛ m malga abɔrɛsheŋ na, Ebɔrɛ beeŋ sa ma mmalga nɛ m bugi baru lela na be wulo na to be asheŋ kenyɛnso n sa basa.

english_verse: I was sent to do this work, and this is the reason I am in jail. So pray that I will be brave and will speak as I should. Final Greetings
translation_verse: Baru lela na malɛ be katelamuyilipo e la ma nɛ n wɔ kabuti to na. Men baa kule Ebɔrɛ a sa ma nɛ m baa tiŋ a kɔ kenyɛn a bɔ baru lela na a sa basa fanɛ kananɛ k daga fanɛ m baa wora. Lalaloge be kechɔrɔ be mmalga be asheŋ

english_verse: I pray that God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will give peace, love, and faith to every follower!
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ Etuto na nɛ Enyɛnpe Yesu Kristo e sa bekurgepoana na kagbenewushi nɛ kasha nɛ yirda.

english_verse: May God be kind to everyone who keeps on loving our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ be kuwɔr be kakɛ e baa wɔ bekama nyam nɛ b kɔ kasha nɛ k maa loge a sha an Nyɛnpe Yesu Kristo na so.

english_verse: From Paul and Timothy, servants of Christ Jesus. To all God's people who belong to Christ Jesus at Philippi and to all your bishops and deacons.
translation_verse: Kawɔl ere shi ma Pɔɔl nɛ Timoti nɛ an la Kristo Yesu be anya na kutɔ nna. K bee yɔ menyi kikɛ nɛ men la Ebɔrɛ be basa ashi Yesu Kristo to nɛ men be asɔriana to be bejuŋkparpoana nɛ bechɛtopoana nɛ men kikɛ wɔ Filipai be kade to na kutɔ nna.

english_verse: I pray that God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! Paul's Prayer for the Church in Philippi
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ an Tuto na nɛ Enyɛnpe Yesu Kristo na e sa menyi kuwɔr be kakɛ nɛ kagbenewushi. Pɔɔl be kabɔrɛkule be asheŋ

english_verse: Every time I think of you, I thank my God.
translation_verse: Saŋkama nɛ n nyiŋi menyi be asheŋ, mee chɔrɔ ma Ebɔrɛ nna.

english_verse: And whenever I mention you in my prayers, it makes me happy.
translation_verse: Saŋkama malɛ ashi ma kabɔrɛkule nɛ mee kule a sa menyi kikɛ to, ŋ kɔ kagbenefuli nna a kule a sa menyi kikɛ,

english_verse: This is because you have taken part with me in spreading the good news from the first day you heard about it.
translation_verse: ŋkpal kananɛ men chɛ ma to ashi baru lela na be kebɔ be kushuŋ na to so baŋ yili kachɛ sososo nɛ n yɔ men kutɔ na m ba fo mbre.

english_verse: God is the one who began this good work in you, and I am certain that he won't stop before it is complete on the day that Christ Jesus returns.
translation_verse: Amoso, m baa nyi fanɛ Ebɔrɛ nɛ e baŋ fara le be kushuŋ lela menyi to ere beeŋ shin nɛ k baa wɔ menyi to loŋ n ya loge nɛnɛ kachɛ nɛ Kristo Yesu beeŋ naŋ ba na.

english_verse: You have a special place in my heart. So it is only natural for me to feel the way I do. All of you have helped in the work God has given me, as I defend the good news and tell about it here in jail.
translation_verse: Saŋkama men be asheŋ baa wɔ ma kagbene to nna, amoso, k baŋ dii efuli nna fanɛ meeŋ baa fɛ le be nfɛra ere a yɔ men be kaplɛa so. Ŋkpal manɛ so, men kikɛ tu ma nna n nya kuwɔr be kakɛ nɛ Ebɔrɛ sa ma naniere ashi ma kabuti ere to nɛ saŋɛ nɛ n daa wɔ ma kumu a wɔtɔ a kɔ a fin baru lela na be kelela nseŋ naa malga a ŋini basa fanɛ kashenteŋ wɔ Kristo to na.

english_verse: God himself knows how much I want to see you. He knows I care for you in the same way Christ Jesus does.
translation_verse: Ŋ ka kaŋɛ fanɛ men kikɛ be asheŋ wɔ ma kagbene to ere, Ebɔrɛ e la ma shɛdajipo fanɛ kasha damta nɛ ŋ kɔ a sa menyi na kikɛ la Kristo Yesu be kasha nna.

english_verse: My dear friends, I want you to know that what has happened to me has helped to spread the good news.
translation_verse: Ŋ kurgepoana mee sha men ka pin fanɛ asheŋ nɛ a nya ma na kilgi nna n chɛ ma to nɛ baru lela na be kebɔ na yɔ anishito.

english_verse: The Roman guards and all the others know I am here in jail because I serve Christ.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, naniere k baŋ dii efuli ewurkpa be bekumpo kutɔ nɛ bekama nɛ b wɔ nfe ere kutɔ nna fanɛ Kristo na so e shin nɛ n wɔ kabuti ere to.

english_verse: Some are preaching about Christ because they are jealous and envious of us. Others are preaching because they want to help.
translation_verse: Kashenteŋ nna fanɛ basa nɛ baa bɔ kubɔya na be beko bee bɔ kumo nna ŋkpal kayurbesa nɛ kolusha so, ama beko bugi bumo be ŋgbene kikɛ nna a bɔ kumo kelela so.

english_verse: But the ones who are jealous of us are not sincere. They just want to cause trouble for me while I am in jail.
translation_verse: Ama bumo na bre maa bugi ŋgbene a bɔ Kristo na be asheŋ, kajɛ be ketresha so nɛ baa bɔ kubɔya na a fɛ fanɛ nɛ b wora loŋ baaŋ shin nɛ n nya tɔrɔ n ti so ashi ma kabuti ere to.

english_verse: because I know that your prayers and the help that comes from the Spirit of Christ Jesus will keep me safe.
translation_verse: Kashenteŋto, meeŋ shin nɛ ma kagbene e fuli ma, ŋkpal manɛ so, m baa nyi fanɛ ŋkpal men be kabɔrɛkule so nɛ Yesu Kristo be Kiyoyu na be eleŋ to so meeŋ nya ma kumu n lar kabuti ere to.

english_verse: I honestly expect and hope I will never do anything to be ashamed of. Whether I live or die, I always want to be as brave as I am now and bring honor to Christ.
translation_verse: Kusɔ nɛ m baa sha ga nsaa tama e la fanɛ m maaŋ pɔ aba ashi ma kushuŋ to, ama saŋkama, fɔnfɔŋ naniere meeŋ baa kɔ kenyɛn nɛnɛ, saŋɛ na so nɛ n wu nna ŋko n wɔ ŋkpa to nna meeŋ ta ma eyur ere kikɛ m bar Yesu Kristo bunyaŋ.

english_verse: If I live, it will be for Christ, and if I die, I will gain even more.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, ma ere kutɔ n wɔ ŋkpa ere to nna ŋkpal Kristo so, nɛ ma alɛ naaŋ wu nna, luwu na la nɛfa nna.

english_verse: It is a hard choice to make. I want to die and be with Christ, because this would be much better.
translation_verse: M baŋ ki nna cham a wɔ asɔ anyɔ na to be nferinto, ŋkpal manɛ so, kusɔ nɛ mee sha e la kelar durnya ere to n ya kaa wɔ Kristo kutɔ, kusɔ nɛ k baa bɔ malɛ nna na.

english_verse: But I know that all of you still need me. This is why I am sure I will stay on to help you grow and be happy in your faith.
translation_verse: M baa kɔ kumo be yirda nna nɛnɛ, amoso, n nyi ma nɛ menyi ka beeŋ baa wɔtɔ nɛ n tiŋ n chɛ menyi to nɛ men yɔ anishito ashi yirda na nɛ kagbenefuli to n ti so.

english_verse: Then, when I visit you again, you will have good reason to take great pride in Christ Jesus because of me.
translation_verse: Saŋɛ na so, ŋ ka naŋ ba men kutɔ menyeeŋ bɔla Kristo Yesu so n nya ekpa m puchi n ti so ŋkpal ma so.

english_verse: Above all else, you must live in a way that brings honor to the good news about Christ. Then, whether I visit you or not, I will hear that all of you think alike. I will know that you are working together and are struggling side by side to get others to believe the good news.
translation_verse: Amoso, kusɔ kama nɛ k la gba, men baa kɔ men be amu to nɛnɛ a du fanɛ kananɛ Kristo be baru lela na bee ŋini na. Saŋɛ na so, nɛ m ba wu menyi nna ŋko n wɔ kufɔ nna nsaa nu menyi be asheŋ, n nyi men ka yil to nɛnɛ kɔnɔkoŋwuleso a kɔ fanɛ esa koŋwule ŋkpal yirda nɛ k shi baru lela na to na so.

english_verse: Be brave when you face your enemies. Your courage will show them that they are going to be destroyed, and it will show you that you will be saved. God will make all of this happen,
translation_verse: Menyi alɛ e sa maa ŋana men doŋana. Men baa kɔ kenyɛn ashi kusɔ kama nɛ baa wora menyi to nɛ loŋ e tiŋ ŋ ŋini bumo fanɛ baaŋ shin nɛ menyi ere e ji n lar ŋkpal Ebɔrɛ ka sa menyi kumɔlga so.

english_verse: and he has blessed you. Not only do you have faith in Christ, but you suffer for him.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, mannɛ fanɛ Ebɔrɛ sa menyi ekpa nna fanɛ men yirda Kristo na nawule, ama e ta tɔrɔ gba nna n ti yirda na so n sa menyi ŋkpal Kristo koŋwule na so.

english_verse: You saw me suffer, and you still hear about my troubles. Now you must suffer in the same way.
translation_verse: To, menyi alɛ gba tu mo nna a kɔ nna na. Kekɔ koŋwule nɛ men daŋ wu ŋ ka kɔ dra dra na koŋwule na nɛ ŋ kraa kɔ nɛ menyee nu kumo be asheŋ na.

english_verse: Now make me completely happy! Live in harmony by showing love for each other. Be united in what you think, as if you were only one person.
translation_verse: men baa kɔ loŋ be nfɛra koŋwule na a ŋini abar kasha koŋwule na nsaa la basa koŋwule ashi men be ayoyu nɛ nfɛra to nɛ loŋ e fuli ma kagbene nɛnɛ m baŋ so.

english_verse: and think the same way that Christ Jesus thought:
translation_verse: A daga fanɛ men be nfɛra e baa du fanɛ Kristo Yesu be nfɛra na.

english_verse: Christ was truly God. But he did not try to remain equal with God.
translation_verse: Mo nɛ Ebɔrɛ la kukoŋwule nna saŋkikɛ, ama e daa maŋ ta tintiŋ ŋ kɔ n fin fanɛ mo nɛ Ebɔrɛ e baa sasa.

english_verse: Then God gave Christ the highest place and honored his name above all others.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal loŋ so Ebɔrɛ maŋ mo so nna ga n yɔ kakpa nɛ k chɔ kusɔ kikɛ nseŋ sa mo ketre mo nɛ k chɔ ketre kikɛ nyam.

english_verse: So at the name of Jesus everyone will bow down, those in heaven, on earth, and under the earth.
translation_verse: Nseŋ yili kumo fanɛ kumuli kikɛ nɛ k wɔ ebɔrɛso nɛ kasawule so nɛ durnya nɛ k wɔ kaseto beeŋ gbir m bunyaŋ Yesu be ketre na.

english_verse: And to the glory of God the Father everyone will openly agree, “Jesus Christ is Lord!” Lights in the World
translation_verse: Ekama beeŋ gbir loŋ nseŋ bugi kɔnɔ basa kikɛ to ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ Yesu Kristo e la Enyɛnpe na nɛ Ebɔrɛ Etuto na e nya kemaŋkura. Kebaanyaŋɛ a fuli to ashi durnya ere to be asheŋ

english_verse: My dear friends, you always obeyed when I was with you. Now that I am away, you should obey even more. So work with fear and trembling to discover what it really means to be saved.
translation_verse: Amoso, n teri shasoana, men baa kraa nu a sa ma fanɛ kananɛ men chɛr a wora na, mannɛ fanɛ saŋɛ nɛ n wɔ menyi kutɔ nawule, ama saŋɛ nɛ m maŋ wɔ menyi kutɔ gba a chɔ ŋ ka wɔ men kutɔ. Men baa ta kagbene ŋana asheŋ ŋ kraa kɔ a fin men be kumɔlga kikɛ be kenya.

english_verse: God is working in you to make you willing and able to obey him.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ e wɔ menyi to a shuŋ saŋkikɛ a shin nɛ menyee sha Ebɔrɛ nsaa tiŋ a nu a sa mo gbagba be aparsheŋ.

english_verse: Then you will be the pure and innocent children of God. You live among people who are crooked and evil, but you must not do anything they can say is wrong. Try to shine as lights among the people of this world,
translation_verse: Saŋɛ na so esa kama maaŋ wu kulubi kikɛ menyi so, ama menyeeŋ baa du cheembi a la Ebɔrɛ be mbia lela nɛ b wea nfɛralubiwuraana nɛ asheŋlubiwuraana to a wɔ durnya ere to. Men baa wɔ bumo to loŋ a du fanɛ achɛkpabi a fuli to a nyɛkpɛ a sa bumo,

english_verse: as you hold firmly to the message that gives life. Then on the day when Christ returns, I can take pride in you. I can also know that my work and efforts were not useless.
translation_verse: nsaa kɔ ŋkpa be kamalga na to kpakpa. Loŋ malɛ e naaŋ shin nɛ n ji njɔŋ kachɛ nɛ Kristo beeŋ naŋ bɛta m ba na nɛ loŋ malɛ e ŋini fanɛ m maŋ shile kebɛso na to jiga ŋko m pere kenishi n shuŋ jiga.

english_verse: Your faith in the Lord and your service are like a sacrifice offered to him. And my own blood may have to be poured out with the sacrifice. If this happens, I will be glad and rejoice with you.
translation_verse: Nɛ fanɛ b lara ma ŋklaŋ ere ma to n chulgi amo n wurge n ti men be yirda nɛ men kɔ a deŋi Ebɔrɛ so fanɛ sarga na so gba, k par ma. Ma alɛ beeŋ tu menyi a kɔ kagbenefuli.

english_verse: I want to be encouraged by news about you. So I hope the Lord Jesus will soon let me send Timothy to you.
translation_verse: Nɛ Enyɛnpe Yesu malɛ shuli, mee tama fanɛ k maaŋ chɛr nɛ n shuŋi Timoti menyi kutɔ, saŋɛ na so e beeŋ ya bar ma men be baru nɛ ma kagbene e fuli ma.

english_verse: The others think only about what interests them and not about what concerns Christ Jesus.
translation_verse: Bumo nɛ b ka na kikɛ be ekama wɔtɔ nna a de mo gbagba nawule be asheŋ so, ekama maŋ de Kristo be asheŋ so.

english_verse: I hope to send him to you, as soon as I find out what is going to happen to me.
translation_verse: Amoso, mee ta mo fanɛ ŋ kaŋ ba kaa wu kananɛ ma asheŋ ere bee nite, meeŋ shuŋi mo menyi kutɔ manaŋ.

english_verse: And I feel sure the Lord will also let me come soon.
translation_verse: Ma alɛ naa kɔ yirda Enyɛnpe so fanɛ k maaŋ chɛr nɛ ma ere gbagba e ba.

english_verse: I think I ought to send my dear friend Epaphroditus back to you. He is a follower and a worker and a soldier of the Lord, just as I am. You sent him to look after me,
translation_verse: Mee fɛ nna fanɛ a daga fanɛ n naŋ shin nɛ Epafrodaites e bɛta n yɔ menyi kutɔ. E la ŋ kurgepo nɛ m barkasa eshumpo nɛ m barkasa ekɔpo nɛ mo koŋwule na naa la men be kabɔ nɛ men shuŋi mo fanɛ e ba kaa chɛ ma to ashi ma asheŋ tirso to na.

english_verse: but now he is eager to see you. He is worried, because you heard he was sick.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, e baŋ pere kenishi nna a sha kenaŋwu menyi kikɛ. Kumo be kaman, mbe kagbene baŋ jija mo nna ŋkpal men ka nu fanɛ e daa lɔ so.

english_verse: In fact, he was very sick and almost died. But God was kind to him, and also to me, and he kept me from being burdened down with sorrow.
translation_verse: Kashenteŋ malɛ nna fanɛ e ka daa lɔ, hale nɛ k daŋ ka gbrɛ nɛ e wu. Ama Ebɔrɛ wu mo kuwɔr nseŋ wu ma alɛ gba kuwɔr n ti so n shin nɛ e maŋ wu nɛ n sa maŋ nya ŋgbenejija n deŋi abar so.

english_verse: Now I am more eager than ever to send Epaphroditus back again. You will be glad to see him, and I won't have to worry any longer.
translation_verse: Amoso, naniere k baa wɔ ma kagbene to nna nɛnɛ n ti so fanɛ n shin nɛ e ba menyi kutɔ. Saŋɛ na so, men kaŋ wu mo, men be ŋgbene beeŋ naŋ dese menyi nɛ ma alɛ gbagba be kafɔŋ e lar ma to.

english_verse: He almost died working for Christ, and he risked his own life to do for me what you could not.
translation_verse: E daŋ ta mbe kumu nna a sha kesa ma kechɛto nɛ menyi ere gbagba daa maaŋ tiŋ n sa ma.

english_verse: Finally, my dear friends, be glad that you belong to the Lord. It doesn't bother me to write the same things to you that I have written before. In fact, it is for your own good.
translation_verse: Ŋ kurgepoana, ma lalaloge be kamalga nde fanɛ Enyɛnpe e sa menyi kagbenefuli nɛnɛ. Kashenteŋto, ma kenaŋ n sibɛ asheŋ koŋwule ere gbagba n sa menyi maŋ tir ma, kumo be loŋ malɛ e naaŋ chɛ menyi to gba.

english_verse: Watch out for those people who behave like dogs! They are evil and want to do more than just circumcise you.
translation_verse: Men baa de basa nɛ b du fanɛ njɔnɔ na so. Bumo e naa wora alubi nsaa wɔtɔ a sha eyur ere be keku na.

english_verse: But we are the ones who are truly circumcised, because we worship by the power of God's Spirit and take pride in Christ Jesus. We don't brag about what we have done,
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, anyi e la kashenteŋ be katutukuebi a bɔla Ebɔrɛ be Kiyoyu na so a bunyaŋ mo nsaa ji anyi be ŋkpa nɛ an kɔ ashi Kristo Yesu to ere be njɔŋ. Anyi nɛ anyee wora asheŋ ere maa ta anyi be yirda a wɔtɔ eyur ere be kedulgi to.

english_verse: I was circumcised when I was eight days old, and I am from the nation of Israel and the tribe of Benjamin. I am a true Hebrew. As a Pharisee, I strictly obeyed the Law of Moses.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, b kurge ma Israɛl be efuli so be esa nna nɛ n shi Bɛnjamin be kanaŋ to. N la Hibruw kashenteŋto nna, ŋkpal manɛ so, n tuto nɛ n nio kikɛ la Hibruwebi nna. B ka kurge ma be kachɛ burwasopo to nɛ b ku ma kututu, mbra na be kaplɛa so n daa la Farisi nna.

english_verse: And I was so eager I even made trouble for the church. I did everything the Law demands in order to please God.
translation_verse: Keshuŋ Ebɔrɛ malɛ be asheŋ daŋ pere ma kenishi ga hale nɛ n daa wɔtɔ a tɔrɔ asɔri to ebi. Mbra na malɛ be kebɛso be kulubi kikɛ daa maŋ wɔ ma to.

english_verse: But Christ has shown me that what I once thought was valuable is worthless.
translation_verse: Ama naniere bre, asɔ nɛ a daa kɔ tɔnɔ ma kutɔ na kikɛ, m maŋ naa tre amo shɛŋ ŋkpal Kristo Yesu so.

english_verse: and to know that I belong to him. I could not make myself acceptable to God by obeying the Law of Moses. God accepted me simply because of my faith in Christ.
translation_verse: Ama mannɛ fanɛ ŋ gbagba ka bɔla mbra na so a kɔ alelasheŋ Ebɔrɛ be anishito so. M bɔla Kristo so nna n nya alelasheŋ Ebɔrɛ be anishito. Yirda nɛ baa ta a nya amo ashi mo koŋwule na kutɔ.

english_verse: so that somehow I also may be raised to life. Running toward the Goal
translation_verse: Saŋɛ na so kachako Ebɔrɛ beeŋ tiŋi ma alɛ gba ashi luwu to. Kepere kenishi n yɔ anishito be asheŋ

english_verse: I have not yet reached my goal, and I am not perfect. But Christ has taken hold of me. So I keep on running and struggling to take hold of the prize.
translation_verse: M maa ŋini fanɛ n teŋ nya asɔ nɛ ma anishi yuu so ere nna ŋko fanɛ n teŋ ki esa cheembi nna, ama m baa pere kenishi nna a kɔ to a yɔ anishito a fin kenya ma tɔnɔ, kumo alɛ so nɛ Kristo Yesu teŋ sɔ ma n sa mbe kumu na.

english_verse: I run toward the goal, so I can win the prize of being called to heaven. This is the prize God offers because of what Christ Jesus has done.
translation_verse: Amoso, m baŋ niŋi tinini nna a yɔ nɛ n ya ji ŋkpa be tɔnɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ kpal kumo so a bɔla Kristo Yesu so a tre basa esoso fanɛ b ba sɔ na.

english_verse: All of us who are mature should think in this same way. And if any of you think differently, God will make it clear to you.
translation_verse: A daga fanɛ anyi nɛ an kɔ kebɛso ere to be kenimufɛra ere e baa kɔ asheŋ nɛ n teŋ kaŋɛ ere be nfɛra loŋ. Ama nɛ fo kama nɛ fo nfɛra kɔr le be asheŋ ere be ako to, Ebɔrɛ beeŋ bugi amo alɛ gba to n sa fo.

english_verse: But we must keep going in the direction that we are now headed.
translation_verse: Kusɔ nɛ k tir e la fanɛ men shin nɛ an ba kraa wɔtɔ a bɛ asɔ nɛ an chɛr a bɛ so na so.

english_verse: My friends, I want you to follow my example and learn from others who closely follow the example we set for you.
translation_verse: Ŋ kurgepoana, men chala a kute ma kebaawɔtɔ to nsaa pɛshɛ bekama nɛ baa bɛ kebɛso na so fanɛ kananɛ an nase na.

english_verse: I often warned you that many people are living as enemies of the cross of Christ. And now with tears in my eyes, I warn you again
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, loŋ koŋwule na gbagba nɛ mee kaa kaŋɛ menyi nsaa sha kenaŋ n lɔŋɛ n ta anishichubi ŋ kaŋɛ menyi n ti so na fanɛ basa damta be kebaawɔtɔ du fanɛ b ka bee kishi Kristo be kedibi largato na be asheŋ nna.

english_verse: that they are headed for hell! They worship their stomachs and brag about the disgusting things they do. All they can think about are the things of this world.
translation_verse: Bumo be ekar la kemur nna, ŋkpal manɛ so, bumo be epunana e la bumo be Ebɔrɛ nɛ bumo be kemaŋkura malɛ la anishinyɔr be asɔ. Kashenteŋto, bumo be ŋgbene kikɛ wɔ durnya ere to be asɔ to nna.

english_verse: But we are citizens of heaven and are eagerly waiting for our Savior to come from there. Our Lord Jesus Christ
translation_verse: Ama anyi ere, ebɔrɛso be basa e la anyi nɛ an baa jɔŋ anyi be aya so a jo anyi be Emɔlgapo, Enyɛnpe Yesu Kristo nɛ e shi ebɔrɛso m ba.

english_verse: Dear friends, I love you and long to see you. Please keep on being faithful to the Lord. You are my pride and joy. Paul Encourages the Lord's Followers
translation_verse: Amoso, ŋ kurgepoana, mee sha men be asheŋ ga nsaa sha kewu menyi. Menyi e naa shin nɛ ma kagbene bee fuli ma, menyi alɛ nseŋ naa la ma kegben be tɔnɔ. N teriana, amoso nɛ a daga fanɛ men baa kɔ Enyɛnpe na to a yil kpakpa na.

english_verse: Euodia and Syntyche, you belong to the Lord, so I beg you to stop arguing with each other.
translation_verse: Yuodia nɛ Sintiki, men jande, mee kule menyi nna fanɛ men wora ania n lɔŋɛ abar a wɔtɔ fanɛ besipoche nɛ b la Enyɛnpe na peya.

english_verse: And, my true partner, I ask you to help them. These women have worked together with me and with Clement and with the others in spreading the good news. Their names are now written in the book of life.
translation_verse: Mee kule fo, ma kagbene koŋwuleso be echɛtopo fanɛ fo chɛ bumo beche anyɔ na to, ŋkpal manɛ so, b chɛ ma to n shuŋ baru lela na be kebɔ be kushuŋ na ga. Bumo nɛ Klɛment nɛ m braana beshumpo nɛ bumo be atre wɔ Ebɔrɛ be ŋkpa be kawɔl na to na kikɛ nna.

english_verse: Always be gentle with others. The Lord will soon be here.
translation_verse: Men shin nɛ ekama nyam e baa wu kananɛ men du boeŋ, ŋkpal manɛ so, Enyɛnpe na be keba taga to.

english_verse: Don't worry about anything, but pray about everything. With thankful hearts offer up your prayers and requests to God.
translation_verse: Men sa maa fɔŋ kusɔ kama so men be kebaawɔtɔ to, ama kusɔ kama to men baa kaŋɛ Ebɔrɛ men be asheŋ tirso be asheŋ a kule mo fanɛ e chɛ menyi to nsaa chɔrɔ mo.

english_verse: Then, because you belong to Christ Jesus, God will bless you with peace that no one can completely understand. And this peace will control the way you think and feel.
translation_verse: Nɛ men wora loŋ, kagbene wushi nɛ k bee shi Ebɔrɛ kutɔ a ba nsaa chɔ kananɛ dimɛdi beeŋ fɛ na beeŋ shin nɛ men be ŋgbene nɛ men be nfɛra e nya edesekpa ashi Kristo Yesu to.

english_verse: You know the teachings I gave you, and you know what you heard me say and saw me do. So follow my example. And God, who gives peace, will be with you. Paul Gives Thanks for the Gifts He Was Given
translation_verse: Men baa kraa wora asɔ nɛ men koya ashi ma kutɔ nɛ amo nɛ ŋ ŋini menyi na nɛ amo nɛ men nu ŋko n wu ŋ ka wora na kikɛ. Saŋɛ na so Ebɔrɛ nɛ kagbenewushi wɔ mo to na beeŋ baa wɔ menyi to. Pɔɔl be kechɔrɔ Filipaiebi be asheŋ

english_verse: The Lord has made me very grateful that at last you have thought about me once again. Actually, you were thinking about me all along, but you didn't have any chance to show it.
translation_verse: Ma kagbene bee fuli ma ga ashi Enyɛnpe to fanɛ men ka naŋ lɔŋɛ n fara nɛ men chɛ ma to so. Kashenteŋto, ma asheŋ wɔ men be ŋgbene to, ama ekpa nɛ men maŋ nya nɛ men ŋini kumo be loŋ.

english_verse: I know what it is to be poor or to have plenty, and I have lived under all kinds of conditions. I know what it means to be full or to be hungry, to have too much or too little.
translation_verse: N nyi kusɔ nɛ k la ketir nseŋ naa nyi kusɔ nɛ k la kanya damta malɛ gba. Ŋ koya amo kikɛ be asheŋ nna, amoso, kaplɛkama nɛ n yɔ saŋkikɛ, kusɔ nɛ ŋ kɔ bee kukwe ma nna. Nɛ m moɛ nna ŋko nɛ akoŋ kɔ ma nna ŋko nɛ fanɛ ŋ kɔ ga nna ŋko gbrɛbi gba nna, a bee kukwe ma nna.

english_verse: It was good of you to help me when I was having such a hard time.
translation_verse: Ama mee chɔrɔ menyi ga ŋkpal kananɛ men chɛ ma to ashi ma etɔrɔ na to so.

english_verse: My friends at Philippi, you remember what it was like when I started preaching the good news in Macedonia. After I left there, you were the only church that became my partner by giving blessings and by receiving them in return.
translation_verse: Menyi Filipaiebi malɛ gba baa nyi geeŋ fanɛ ŋ ka lar Masɛdonia be efuli so, saŋɛ nɛ n daŋ baŋ fara a bɔ baru lela na a sa basa na, menyi nawule e daa la asɔriebi nɛ b daŋ chɛ ma to ashi kesa nɛ kesɔ to.

english_verse: Even when I was in Thessalonica, you helped me more than once.
translation_verse: Hale ŋ ka daa wɔ Tɛsalɔnika be kade to, men daŋ yɛr ma kechɛto.

english_verse: I am not trying to get something from you, but I want you to receive the blessings that come from giving.
translation_verse: Mannɛ fanɛ mee sha kechɛto nna so nɛ mee malga le ere, ama nɛfa nɛ mee sha fanɛ Ebɔrɛ e ta n ti menyi so so.

english_verse: I have been paid back everything, and with interest. I am completely satisfied with the gifts you sent with Epaphroditus. They are like a sweet-smelling offering or like the right kind of sacrifice that pleases God.
translation_verse: Men teŋ sa ma kusɔ kama nɛ k daga hale a chɔ kananɛ mee sha gba. Ŋ ka wu men be kakɛ nɛ Epafrodaites bar na, a bɔlɔ ma kenishi tain. K du fanɛ sarga lela nna, nɛ k bee par Ebɔrɛ nɛ kumo be efɛa wɔ ebel ga.

english_verse: I pray that God will take care of all your needs with the wonderful blessings that come from Christ Jesus!
translation_verse: Ma Ebɔrɛ kɔ dama nɛnɛ, mo alɛ beeŋ bɔla Kristo Yesu so n sa menyi men be asheŋ tirso kikɛ nyam.

english_verse: May God our Father be praised forever and ever. Amen. Final Greetings
translation_verse: Kemaŋkura e baa wɔ Ebɔrɛ an Tuto na so mbaanaayɔ. Amɛn. Lalaloge be kechɔrɔ be asheŋ

english_verse: Give my greetings to all who are God's people because of Christ Jesus. The Lord's followers here with me send you their greetings.
translation_verse: Mee chɔrɔ Ebɔrɛ be basa nɛ b la Kristo Yesu peya na kikɛ. Bekurgepo nɛ b wɔ ŋ kutɔ nfe ere bee chɔrɔ menyi.

english_verse: All of God's people send their greetings, especially those in the service of the Emperor.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ be basa nɛ b wɔ nfe ere kikɛ, fɔnfɔŋ bumo nɛ b shi Romebi be ewurgboŋ pe na bee chɔrɔ menyi.

english_verse: I pray that our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless your life!
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Yesu Kristo be kuwɔr be kakɛ e baa wɔ men kikɛ so nyam.

english_verse: From Paul, chosen by God to be an apostle of Christ Jesus, and from Timothy, who is also a follower.
translation_verse: Kawɔl ere shi ma Pɔɔl nɛ n la Yesu Kristo be eshuŋipo ŋkpal Ebɔrɛ be keparso nɛ an kurgepo Timoti kutɔ nna

english_verse: To God's people who live in Colossae and are faithful followers of Christ. I pray that God our Father will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! A Prayer of Thanks
translation_verse: a yɔ menyi nɛ men la Ebɔrɛ peya a wɔ Kɔlɔsi nseŋ naa la an kurgepoana nɛ basa nɛ b maŋ kɔ kɔnɔleŋi ashi Yesu Kristo to na kutɔ. An Tuto Ebɔrɛ e sa menyi mbe kuwɔr be kakɛ na nɛ kagbenewushi. Kabɔrɛkule nɛ kechɔrɔ be asheŋ

english_verse: Each time we pray for you, we thank God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Saŋkama nɛ anyee kule Ebɔrɛ a sa menyi, anyee chɔrɔ Ebɔrɛ, an Nyɛnpe Yesu mo Tuto na nna,

english_verse: We have heard of your faith in Christ and of your love for all God's people,
translation_verse: ŋkpal manɛ so, an nu kananɛ men kraa yirda Yesu Kristo nɛ kananɛ men kraa sha bumo nɛ b la Ebɔrɛ peya kikɛ

english_verse: from our good friend Epaphras. He works together with us for Christ and is a faithful worker for you.
translation_verse: Epafras, an barkasa kebɔrɛnya shaso ŋini menyi kananɛ Ebɔrɛ kɛ basa mbe kuwɔr be kakɛ na. Mo e la Yesu Kristo be eshumpo kagbene koŋwuleso a yil an be katelamu to nna.

english_verse: He is also the one who told us about the love that God's Spirit has given you. The Person and Work of Christ
translation_verse: Mo e kaŋɛ anyi kananɛ menyee sha Ebɔrɛ be basa ashi Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na to.

english_verse: We have not stopped praying for you since the first day we heard about you. In fact, we always pray that God will show you everything he wants you to do and that you may have all the wisdom and understanding his Spirit gives.
translation_verse: Kumo so nɛ saŋkama nɛ anyee kule Ebɔrɛ a sa menyi, yili jemanɛ nɛ an nu men be asheŋ na. Anyee kule mo nna fanɛ e shin nɛ men baa pin asɔ nɛ e bee sha nɛnɛ, kumo e la fanɛ nɛ men nya kashennyi m pin kusɔ nɛ e bee sha ashi Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na to.

english_verse: Then you will live a life that honors the Lord, and you will always please him by doing good deeds. You will come to know God even better.
translation_verse: Loŋ nɛ menyeeŋ baa kɔ kebaawɔtɔ nɛ k daga Enyɛnpe na be basa ka kɔ nɛ men be asheŋ e baa par mo nɛnɛ nɛ men baa wora kelela be yiri kikɛ m baa pin Ebɔrɛ nɛnɛ a ti so.

english_verse: His glorious power will make you patient and strong enough to endure anything, and you will be truly happy.
translation_verse: An be kabɔrɛkule e la fanɛ Ebɔrɛ e sa menyi eleŋgboŋ ashi mbe eleŋgboŋ na to nɛ men baa nyiti awurfoŋ kikɛ kagbenefuliso a chɔrɔ Etuto na ga,

english_verse: I pray that you will be grateful to God for letting you have part in what he has promised his people in the kingdom of light.
translation_verse: ŋkpal manɛ so, mo e shin nɛ men daga kenya asɔ nɛ e kɔ a sa mbe basa na be ako ashi ebɔrɛso, kakpa nɛ kefulto wɔ na.

english_verse: God rescued us from the dark power of Satan and brought us into the kingdom of his dear Son,
translation_verse: An Tuto na sɔ anyi ashi Setani be tentembiri be kuwurji to n yige nseŋ ta anyi n wɔtɔ mo Pibinyɛn shaso na be kuwurji to.

english_verse: Christ is exactly like God, who cannot be seen. He is the first-born Son, superior to all creation.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ Pibi na du fanɛ Ebɔrɛ nɛ basa maaŋ tiŋ n wu kikɛ na nna. Mo e la kusɔtoso kikɛ be enimu,

english_verse: Everything was created by him, everything in heaven and on earth, everything seen and unseen, including all forces and powers, and all rulers and authorities. All things were created by God's Son, and everything was made for him.
translation_verse: ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ mo Pibi to asɔ kikɛ, amo nɛ a wɔ ebɔrɛso nɛ amo nɛ a wɔ kasawule so, amo nɛ basa beeŋ tiŋ n wu nɛ amo nɛ basa maaŋ tiŋ n wu, kuwurjiana nɛ eleŋana, esoso be kenimujipoana nɛ bejuŋkparpoana. Ebi na e to amo kikɛ nɛ b baa bunyaŋ mo.

english_verse: He is the head of his body, which is the church. He is the very beginning, the first to be raised from death, so that he would be above all others.
translation_verse: ŋkpal manɛ so, mo e la ejuŋkparpo nɛ e tiŋi luwu to ashi bumo nɛ b wu na kikɛ to.

english_verse: You used to be far from God. Your thoughts made you his enemies, and you did evil things.
translation_verse: Saŋɛ na menyi nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ barga abar nna nɛ men daa la mo doŋana, ŋkpal men be nfɛra nɛ asheŋ lubi so.

english_verse: But his Son became a human and died. So God made peace with you, and now he lets you stand in his presence as people who are holy and faultless and innocent.
translation_verse: Ama naniere, Etuto na shin nɛ menyi nɛ mo naŋ nyalɛ ŋkpal Yesu be luwu nɛ e wu na so. Kumo e naaŋ shin nɛ men baa du cheembi nɛ esa kikɛ e sa maŋ tiŋ n wu menyi alubi ŋko n ji men be kebaawɔtɔ emɔrɔ jemanɛ nɛ Yesu Kristo beeŋ yɛr menyi Ebɔrɛ kutɔ na.

english_verse: But you must stay deeply rooted and firm in your faith. You must not give up the hope you received when you heard the good news. It was preached to everyone on earth, and I myself have become a servant of this message. Paul's Service to the Church
translation_verse: Kananɛ Yesu Kristo beeŋ yɛr menyi Ebɔrɛ kutɔ nna na, nɛ men baŋ yirda baru lela na a maa chɛrga men be ŋgbene nsaa tama asɔ nɛ men nu baru lela na to nna na. Baru lela na nɛ baa malga a sa basa kama nɛ ma Pɔɔl gba ki kumo be emalgapo na. Kushuŋ nɛ Pɔɔl bee shuŋ a sa asɔri na be asheŋ

english_verse: I am glad I can suffer for you. I am pleased also that in my own body I can continue the suffering of Christ for his body, the church.
translation_verse: Naniere ma kagbene fuli ma ŋkpal awurfoŋ nɛ mee ji ŋkpal menyi so na so. Awurfoŋ nɛ Yesu Kristo kaŋɛ fanɛ meeŋ ji na be tɔrɔ nɛ mee ji a bɔlɔ mbe tɔrɔ na so na ŋkpal mbe asɔriebi, bumo nɛ baa tre Yesu Kristo be eyur na so.

english_verse: God's plan was to make me a servant of his church and to send me to preach his complete message to you.
translation_verse: M ba ki asɔriebi na be eshumpo nna, ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ e lara ma fanɛ n chɛ menyi to nseŋ bɔ Ebɔrɛ be kubɔya na n sa basa kikɛ.

english_verse: For ages and ages this message was kept secret from everyone, but now it has been explained to God's people.
translation_verse: Kubɔya na daa la wulo be kubɔya nna, kumo alɛ be saŋɛ na Ebɔrɛ daa maŋ bugi kumo to ŋ kaŋɛ basa, ama naniere e bugi kumo to ŋ kaŋɛ mbe basa.

english_verse: God did this because he wanted you Gentiles to understand his wonderful and glorious mystery. And the mystery is that Christ lives in you, and he is your hope of sharing in God's glory.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ daa sha keŋini bumo kananɛ e ŋini mbe wulo be eleŋgboŋ basa kikɛ to nna, kumo e la fanɛ, Yesu Kristo wɔ menyi to, kumo so nɛ men kɔ tama fanɛ menyeeŋ nu Ebɔrɛ be kemaŋkura na be ebel na.

english_verse: We announce the message about Christ, and we use all our wisdom to warn and teach everyone, so all of Christ's followers will grow and become mature.
translation_verse: Yesu Kristo be asheŋ nɛ anyee malga a sa basa kikɛ a fiɛ ekama so nsaa ŋini bumo kanyiashenso nɛ an shin nɛ ekama e pin Yesu Kristo nɛnɛ.

english_verse: This is why I work so hard and use the mighty power he gives me.
translation_verse: Kede so nɛ m baa mɔ ma kumu a ta eleŋ nɛ Yesu Kristo bee sa ma a shuŋ na.

english_verse: I want you to know what a struggle I am going through for you, for God's people at Laodicea, and for all of those followers who have never met me.
translation_verse: Mee kaŋɛ menyi kesheŋ ere nna ŋkpal ŋ ka bee sha men ka pin kananɛ mee mɔ ma kumu a sa menyi nɛ bumo nɛ b wɔ Laodisiya nɛ bumo nɛ b maŋ naŋ wu ma kikɛ na,

english_verse: I do it to encourage them. Then as their hearts are joined together in love, they will be wonderfully blessed with complete understanding. And they will truly know Christ. Not only is he the key to God's mystery,
translation_verse: saŋɛ na so meeŋ leŋ menyi to nɛ men baa kɔ kasha a wɔ abar so nsaa kɔ kenyi kikɛ nyam. Kumo e la fanɛ nɛ men ba pin mbe wulo na kikɛ.

english_verse: I tell you these things to keep you from being fooled by fancy talk.
translation_verse: Mee kaŋɛ menyi ade kikɛ nna nɛ men sa maŋ shin nɛ esa kikɛ e tiŋ n ta efɛ be kamɔrɔji n shin nɛ men foe ekpa.

english_verse: Even though I am not with you, I keep thinking about you. I am glad to know that you are living as you should and your faith in Christ is strong. Christ Brings Real Life
translation_verse: M baa maa wɔ menyi kutɔ geeŋ, ama men be asheŋ wɔ ma kagbene to ga. Ma kagbene malɛ fuli ma ga ŋkpal ŋ ka nyi men ka kɔ men be amu nɛnɛ nsaa yirda Yesu Kristo na kagbene koŋwuleso. Keshin nɛ Kristo e bɔlɔ fo to be asheŋ

english_verse: Plant your roots in Christ and let him be the foundation for your life. Be strong in your faith, just as you were taught. And be grateful.
translation_verse: a yil fanɛ kananɛ nliŋi bee pɛ ndibi to a yil na ŋ kraa pin mbe asheŋ a ti so m baa yirda kashenteŋ na kikɛ nyam, fanɛ kananɛ b ŋini menyi na nɛ men baa wɔtɔ a chɔrɔ Ebɔrɛ.

english_verse: Don't let anyone fool you by using senseless arguments. These arguments may sound wise, but they are only human teachings. They come from the powers of this world and not from Christ.
translation_verse: Men baa da so nɛ ekama e sa maŋ kaŋ ta efɛ nɛ kanyiasheŋ fuloŋ n fule menyi m bɛ mbe kumu so, kumo e la fanɛ nyiŋgbasa be edaŋkaresheŋ nɛ a maŋ kɔ shɛŋ nsaa la sososo be asɔ ŋiniso na nɛ a maŋ shi Yesu Kristo na kutɔ na,

english_verse: And you are fully grown because you belong to Christ, who is over every power and authority.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal menyi nɛ Yesu Kristo nɛ e la eleŋ be yiri kikɛ be enimu na ka ki kukoŋwule so, men kɔ ŋkpa kikɛ.

english_verse: And when you were baptized, it was the same as being buried with Christ. Then you were raised to life because you had faith in the power of God, who raised Christ from death.
translation_verse: B ka daŋ bɛr menyi kabɔrɛbɛr na, k du fanɛ b ka puli menyi nɛ Yesu Kristo nna. Menyi nɛ mo malɛ e naŋ tiŋi nɛ menyi nɛ mo naŋ tiŋ n nya Ebɔrɛ be ŋkpa ŋkpal men ka yirda Ebɔrɛ nɛ e tiŋi Yesu Kristo luwu to na be eleŋ to so.

english_verse: You were dead, because you were sinful and were not God's people. But God let Christ make you alive, when he forgave all our sins.
translation_verse: Men ka daŋ wu ŋkpal men be alubi nɛ men be kebaawɔtɔ lubi na so, jemanɛ nɛ men daa maŋ nyi Ebɔrɛ na, Ebɔrɛ tiŋi menyi nɛ Yesu Kristo na luwu to n sa menyi ŋkpa n ta anyi be alubi m paŋ anyi.

english_verse: There Christ defeated all powers and forces. He let the whole world see them being led away as prisoners when he celebrated his victory.
translation_verse: E ka wu kedibi largato na so na, e sɔ esoso be eleŋana nɛ kenimujipoana na kikɛ be eleŋ m pɔɔ bumo so ŋ ŋaba bumo ŋ ŋini durnya.

english_verse: Don't let anyone tell you what you must eat or drink. Don't let them say you must celebrate the New Moon festival, the Sabbath, or any other festival.
translation_verse: Amoso, men sa maŋ shin nɛ ekama e wu menyi kulubi ŋkpal kusɔ jiso ŋko kusɔnuuso so ŋko ŋkpal men ka maa bunyaŋ nchɛgboŋ ŋko kufɔl popɔr ŋko kewushiachɛ so.

english_verse: Don't be cheated by people who make a show of acting humble and who worship angels. They brag about seeing visions. But it is all nonsense, because their minds are filled with selfish desires.
translation_verse: Men sa maŋ shin nɛ esa kikɛ e kute n wu menyi kulubi a kaŋɛ fanɛ men baa koya bunyaŋ a bunyaŋ emalaika a ta kamoowu fuloŋ ŋkpal asɔ nɛ a lar mo so nɛ e wu amo na so. Mbe nfɛra lubi na so nɛ e kɔ loŋ be kamoowu fuloŋ na.

english_verse: They are no longer part of Christ, who is the head of the whole body. Christ gives the body its strength, and he uses its joints and muscles to hold it together, as it grows by the power of God. Christ Brings New Life
translation_verse: Mo alɛ nɛ Yesu Kristo nɛ e la an be enimu na maŋ la kukoŋwule. Yesu Kristo na e la an be enimu a shin nɛ Ebɔrɛ be basa bee nya Ebɔrɛ be kenyi a ti so a du kananɛ Ebɔrɛ bee sha a wɔ abar so fanɛ kananɛ awibichɛkpa nɛ achin bee pɛ esa be eyur a kukwe abar so na.

english_verse: You died with Christ. Now the forces of the universe don't have any power over you. Why do you live as if you had to obey such rules as,
translation_verse: Ŋkpal menyi nɛ Yesu Kristo ka wu nɛ men maŋ naa tuge durnya ere to be edaŋkaresheŋ be keŋini na so, men sa maŋ naa tuge basa be amu to be mbraana fanɛ men ka kraa wɔ men be kebaawɔtɔ dra na to na.

english_verse: After these things are used, they are no longer good for anything. So why be bothered with the rules that humans have made up?
translation_verse: Kusɔ jiso kikɛ nɛ esa ji kumo, kumo be asheŋ baŋ loge nna na. Loŋ nɛ nyiŋgbasa be mbraana nɛ amo be keŋini gba du.

english_verse: Obeying these rules may seem to be the smart thing to do. They appear to make you love God more and to be very humble and to have control over your body. But they don't really have any power over our desires.
translation_verse: Mbraana ere du fanɛ a ka kɔ kanyiasheŋ nna, baa nase bumo gbagba be kabɔrɛshuŋ ko a kaŋɛ fanɛ basa e baa koya le nɛ le be ebunyaŋsheŋ ŋko b baa tɔrɔ bumo be eyur, ama kanyiasheŋ kikɛ maŋ wɔ le be asheŋ ŋiniso na to, ŋkpal manɛ so, amo be kekama maaŋ tiŋ n shin nɛ nyiŋgbasa e yige kulubi be kebaawora.

english_verse: You have been raised to life with Christ. Now set your heart on what is in heaven, where Christ rules at God's right side.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal menyi nɛ Kristo ka tiŋi luwu to na so, men shin nɛ men be ŋgbene e baa wɔ ebɔrɛso be asɔ so. Ndoŋ nɛ Yesu Kristo chena, Ebɔrɛ be jisoso, ebunyampo be kakpa na.

english_verse: Christ gives meaning to your life, and when he appears, you will also appear with him in glory.
translation_verse: Amoso, saŋɛ nɛ Yesu Kristo nɛ e la an be ŋkpa na kaŋ lara mbe kumu ŋ ŋini durnya na, menyi alɛ gba beeŋ lar n nya mbe kemaŋkura. Kebaawɔtɔ popɔr na be asheŋ

english_verse: Don't be controlled by your body. Kill every desire for the wrong kind of sex. Don't be immoral or indecent or have evil thoughts. Don't be greedy, which is the same as worshiping idols.
translation_verse: Amoso, men yige men be kebaawɔtɔ dra nɛ kumo be asheŋ lubi na, men yige kacheji kpalakpala nɛ kubojuaji nɛ asheŋ jiga nɛ kayɛlga fuloŋ, men sa maa yɛlga alubi, men yige kejimuni. Kejimuni du fanɛ kagbirshuŋ nna.

english_verse: God is angry with people who disobey him by doing these things.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ malɛ beeŋ gberge bumo nɛ b maa nu mbe kɔnɔ nsaa wɔtɔ a wora le be asheŋ na kusoe.

english_verse: And this is exactly what you did, when you lived among people who behaved in this way.
translation_verse: Menyi alɛ gba nɛ bumo e daa wora asheŋ na, jemanɛ nɛ men daa wɔ asheŋ lubi to na.

english_verse: But now you must stop doing such things. You must quit being angry, hateful, and evil. You must no longer say insulting or cruel things about others.
translation_verse: Ama naniere, men yige asheŋ lubi be kebaawora n yige kebaakɔ agbo, kebaanya agbo kenyɛnso, kebaala basa lubi, basa be kebaakuli nɛ kusɔ jigaya be kamalga.

english_verse: And stop lying to each other. You have given up your old way of life with its habits.
translation_verse: Men sa maa fule abar, ŋkpal manɛ so, men lar men be kebaawɔtɔ dra nɛ k daa shin nɛ menyee wora alubi na to

english_verse: Each of you is now a new person. You are becoming more and more like your Creator, and you will understand him better.
translation_verse: n nya kebaawɔtɔ popɔr lela nɛ Ebɔrɛ to nsaa wɔtɔ a lɔŋɛ kumo nɛ k ba kaa du fanɛ mo gbagba peya na nɛ men baa pin mo nɛnɛ.

english_verse: It doesn't matter if you are a Greek or a Jew, or if you are circumcised or not. You may even be a barbarian or a Scythian, and you may be a slave or a free person. Yet Christ is all that matters, and he lives in all of us.
translation_verse: Loŋ na bumo nɛ b kɔ kebaawɔtɔ popɔr na maaŋ naa kɔ ŋkpɛato a kaŋɛ fanɛ eko la kanyamase nɛ eko malɛ la Juwebi be esa, ŋko ede ku, ede bre maŋ ku kututu, ede la efɔ, ede la edɔtopo, ŋko ede la kenya nɛ ede wɔ mbe kumu. Yesu Kristo na nawule e la bumo be kusɔ kama.

english_verse: Put up with each other, and forgive anyone who does you wrong, just as Christ has forgiven you.
translation_verse: Men baa kɔ kanyiti a kɔ abar to a ta abar be asheŋ a paŋ abar. Kananɛ Enyɛnpe na ta m paŋ menyi na, menyi alɛ gba e baa ta a paŋ abar.

english_verse: Love is more important than anything else. It is what ties everything completely together.
translation_verse: Ade kikɛ be buushi men ta kasha n wɔtɔ men be ŋgbene to, kasha e naa sa anyi kikɛ kɔnɔkoŋwule.

english_verse: Each one of you is part of the body of Christ, and you were chosen to live together in peace. So let the peace that comes from Christ control your thoughts. And be grateful.
translation_verse: Men shin nɛ kagbenewushi nɛ Yesu Kristo bee sa na e baa wɔ menyi to, ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ lara menyi nna nɛ men baa kɔ kagbenewushi abar so, ŋkpal men ka la kukoŋwule na so. Men baa chɔrɔ Ebɔrɛ.

english_verse: Let the message about Christ completely fill your lives, while you use all your wisdom to teach and instruct each other. With thankful hearts, sing psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs to God.
translation_verse: Men bɛ kubɔya nɛ Yesu Kristo sa anyi na so saŋkama, men baa kɔ kanyiasheŋ a ŋini abar a leŋ abar to a boŋ Ebɔrɛ be kawɔl to be nshɛ nɛ Ebɔrɛ be basa be kapandi be nshɛ nɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na bee ŋini na a di Ebɔrɛ epaŋ men be ŋgbene to.

english_verse: Whatever you say or do should be done in the name of the Lord Jesus, as you give thanks to God the Father because of him. Some Rules for Christian Living
translation_verse: Kusɔ kama nɛ k shi men be nnɔ to ŋko nɛ menyee wora, men shin nɛ amo kikɛ e daga esa nɛ e yil Yesu Kristo be katelamu to be kushuŋ nɛ men baa chɔrɔ Ebɔrɛ Etuto na ŋkpal Yesu Kristo so. Bebɛsopo be kowu to be kebaawɔtɔ be asheŋ

english_verse: A wife must put her husband first. This is her duty as a follower of the Lord.
translation_verse: Beche kilpo, men baa ta men be amu a sa men kulana kananɛ k daga ŋkpal men ka la Enyɛnpe na peya so.

english_verse: A husband must love his wife and not abuse her.
translation_verse: Bekulana, men baa sha men be beche, men sa maa nyaŋ bumo.

english_verse: Parents, don't be hard on your children. If you are, they might give up.
translation_verse: Betuto nɛ benio, men sa maa ŋmenyaŋ men be mbia ga nɛ bumo be aba e baa pɔ bumo.

english_verse: Slaves, you must always obey your earthly masters. Try to please them at all times, and not just when you think they are watching. Honor the Lord and serve your masters with your whole heart.
translation_verse: Anya, men baa bunyaŋ men nyɛnpeana kusɔ kama to, mannɛ fanɛ men ya kaa shuŋ nɛ baa keni menyi so nawule ŋkpal men ka baa sha men be asheŋ e baa par bumo so, ama men baa kɔ kagbene koŋwule a shuŋ ŋkpal men ka bee bunyaŋ Enyɛnpe Yesu Kristo na so.

english_verse: Do your work willingly, as though you were serving the Lord himself, and not just your earthly master.
translation_verse: Kusɔ kama nɛ menyee wora, men baa wora kumo nɛ kagbene koŋwule a nyi fanɛ Enyɛnpe na nɛ menyee shuŋ a sa, mannɛ nyiŋgbasa nawule

english_verse: In fact, the Lord Christ is the one you are really serving, and you know he will reward you.
translation_verse: a nyi fanɛ Enyɛnpe na beeŋ ka menyi n sa menyi kusɔ kama nɛ e kaŋɛ fanɛ e beeŋ sa menyi ebɔrɛso na.

english_verse: But Christ has no favorites! He will punish evil people, just as they deserve.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Yesu Kristo na nɛ menyee shuŋ, ŋkpal manɛ so, ekama nɛ e wora alubi, Ebɔrɛ beeŋ ka mo amo be kukɔ a maa kɔ ŋkpɛato.

english_verse: Slave owners, be fair and honest with your slaves. Don't forget that you have a Master in heaven.
translation_verse: Benyɛnpeana, men baa kɔ men be anya to kpakpa a keni bumo so nɛnɛ nsaa nyi fanɛ menyi alɛ gba kɔ Enyɛnpe ebɔrɛso. Asheŋ ŋiniso nɛ a naŋ ti so be asheŋ

english_verse: Be pleasant and hold their interest when you speak the message. Choose your words carefully and be ready to give answers to anyone who asks questions. Final Greetings
translation_verse: Men shin nɛ men be kelejima e baa wɔ ebel saŋkama a kɔ kanyiasheŋ kumo to nɛ men pin kananɛ a daga men ka bee tuge basa be mmalga. Lalaloge be kechɔrɔ be asheŋ

english_verse: Tychicus is the dear friend, who faithfully works and serves the Lord with us, and he will give you the news about me.
translation_verse: An kurgepo shaso Tikikes nɛ e la m barkasa kebɔrɛnya a shuŋ Ebɔrɛ kagbene koŋwuleso na beeŋ sa menyi ma baru.

english_verse: I am sending him to cheer you up by telling you how we are getting along.
translation_verse: Amoso nɛ mee shuŋi mo menyi kutɔ nɛ e ya shin nɛ men pin anyi be kebaawɔtɔ be asheŋ nɛ men be ŋgbene e wushi menyi na.

english_verse: Onesimus, the dear and faithful follower from your own group, is coming with him. The two of them will tell you everything that has happened here.
translation_verse: Mo nɛ Onisimɔs nɛ e la menyi be eko nsaa la ekurgepo shaso kagbene koŋwuleso na nɛ an shuŋi. Baaŋ kaŋɛ menyi kusɔ kama nɛ k bee wora nfe.

english_verse: Aristarchus is in jail with me. He sends greetings to you, and so does Mark, the cousin of Barnabas. You have already been told to welcome Mark, if he visits you.
translation_verse: Aristaakes nɛ ma nɛ mo kikɛ wɔ kabuti to nfe ere bee chɔrɔ menyi. Maak, Baanabas mo kurgepo na gba bee chɔrɔ menyi. N daŋ ŋini menyi kananɛ menyeeŋ wora mo. E kaŋ ba ndoŋ, men keni mo so nɛnɛ.

english_verse: Jesus, who is known as Justus, sends his greetings. These three men are the only Jewish followers who have worked with me for the kingdom of God. They have given me much comfort.
translation_verse: Jizes nɛ baa tre Jɛstes na gba bee chɔrɔ menyi. Bumo basa asa na nawule e la Juwebi be basa nɛ b nyi Yesu Kristo bumo be ŋgbene to nɛ ma nɛ bumo bee shuŋ nfe a malga Ebɔrɛ be kuwura na to be asheŋ. B shin nɛ ma kagbene wushi ma ga.

english_verse: Your own Epaphras, who serves Christ Jesus, sends his greetings. He always prays hard that you may fully know what the Lord wants you to do and that you may do it completely.
translation_verse: Epafras nɛ e la Yesu Kristo be eshumpo nsaa la menyi yiri koŋwule na bee chɔrɔ menyi. Saŋkama e bee bugi mbe kagbene to nna a kule Ebɔrɛ a sa menyi nɛ men baa kɔ men be yirda na to kpakpa nɛ men be abɔrɛsheŋ be kenyi e baa wora keshi a ti so nsaa nyi kusɔ kama nɛ Ebɔrɛ bee sha a maa kɔ yalayala.

english_verse: I have seen how much trouble he has gone through for you and for the followers in Laodicea and Hierapolis.
translation_verse: Mee malga Epafras be asheŋ nna, ŋkpal manɛ so, mee sha keji shɛda nna fanɛ e ka bee mɔ mbe kumu a shuŋ menyi Laodisiyaebi nɛ Hiɛrapɔlisebi.

english_verse: Our dear doctor Luke sends you his greetings, and so does Demas.
translation_verse: Luuk nɛ e la dɔkta nɛ anyee sha mo na bee chɔrɔ menyi. Diimas gba bee chɔrɔ menyi.

english_verse: Give my greetings to the followers at Laodicea, especially to Nympha and the church that meets in her home.
translation_verse: Men chɔrɔ bekurgepoana nɛ b wɔ Laodisiya be kade to na. Men chɔrɔ Nimfa nɛ asɔriebi nɛ baa shɛr mbe laŋ to na gba.

english_verse: After this letter has been read to your people, be sure to have it read in the church at Laodicea. And you should read the letter that I have sent to them.
translation_verse: Men kaŋ kraŋ kawɔl ere n sa abar n loge, men shin nɛ esa ko e kraŋ kumo n sa Laodisiya be asɔriebi na gba. Ma kawɔl nɛ n sibɛ n sa Laodisiyaebi na, menyi Kɔlɔsiebi gba e ya sɔ kumo m ba kraŋ.

english_verse: Remind Archippus to do the work that the Lord has given him to do.
translation_verse: Men kaŋɛ Akipes le: “Baa de kushuŋ nɛ fo sɔ ŋkpal fo ka la Enyɛnpe peya na so na so a wora kumo.”

english_verse: I am signing this letter myself: PAUL. Don't forget that I am in jail. I pray that God will be kind to you.
translation_verse: Ma Pɔɔl gbagba e naa sibɛ kechɔrɔ ere na. Men baa nyiŋi ma men be kabɔrɛkule to ŋkpal ŋ ka wɔ kabuti to so. Ebɔrɛ e baa kɛ menyi mbe kuwɔr be kakɛ na. Amɛn.

english_verse: From Paul, Silas, and Timothy. To the church in Thessalonica, the people of God the Father and of the Lord Jesus Christ. I pray that God will be kind to you and will bless you with peace!
translation_verse: Kawɔl ere shi ma Pɔɔl nɛ Sailas nɛ Timoti kutɔ nna a yɔ Tɛsalɔnika be asɔriebi nɛ b la Ebɔrɛ an Tuto nɛ Enyɛnpe Yesu Kristo peya na kutɔ. Ebɔrɛ be kuwɔr be kakɛ nɛ kagbenewushi e baa la menyi peya. Tɛsalɔnikaebi na be kebaawɔtɔ nɛ yirda be asheŋ

english_verse: We thank God for you and always mention you in our prayers. Each time we pray,
translation_verse: Saŋkama anyee chɔrɔ Ebɔrɛ nna ŋkpal menyi kikɛ so a nyiŋi menyi an be kabɔrɛkule to.

english_verse: My dear friends, God loves you, and we know he has chosen you to be his people.
translation_verse: An kurgepoana, Ebɔrɛ be basa shaso, an nyi Ebɔrɛ ka lara menyi nɛ men ki mo peya,

english_verse: When we told you the good news, it was with the power and assurance that come from the Holy Spirit, and not simply with words. You knew what kind of people we were and how we helped you.
translation_verse: ŋkpal manɛ so, baru lela nɛ an bar menyi na maŋ la kafule be mmalga nna, ama amo nɛ eleŋ nɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na nɛ kashenteŋ nɛ k maŋ kɔ yalayala kikɛ nna. Saŋɛ nɛ an daa wɔ menyi kutɔ na, men nyi kananɛ an be kebaawɔtɔ daa du. Menyi so nɛ an daa du loŋ na.

english_verse: So, when you accepted the message, you followed our example and the example of the Lord. You suffered, but the Holy Spirit made you glad.
translation_verse: Men kute anyi nɛ Enyɛnpe na to, ŋkpal manɛ so, men sɔ kubɔya na awurfoŋ damta to nɛ kagbenefuli nɛ k shi Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na kutɔ.

english_verse: You became an example for all the Lord's followers in Macedonia and Achaia.
translation_verse: Amoso, men be kebaawɔtɔ ki Masɛdonia nɛ Akaya be bebɛsopo kikɛ be tɔnɔ nɛ baa keni so a wora asheŋ.

english_verse: And because of you, the Lord's message has spread everywhere in those regions. Now the news of your faith in God is known all over the world, and we don't have to say a thing about it.
translation_verse: Mannɛ Masɛdonia nɛ Akaya nawule nɛ Enyɛnpe be kubɔya na shi men kutɔ n yɔ, ama kananɛ men yirda Ebɔrɛ na be baru sɔ kaplɛkama, amoso, anyi ere maŋ naa kɔ shɛŋ a kaŋɛ.

english_verse: They also tell how you are waiting for his Son Jesus to come from heaven. God raised him from death, and on the day of judgment Jesus will save us from God's anger.
translation_verse: nɛ e shin nɛ e tiŋi luwu to na fanɛ e shi ebɔrɛso m ba. Mo koŋwule Yesu na e naa mɔlga anyi ashi Ebɔrɛ be agbo nɛ k bee ba na to.

english_verse: My friends, you know our time with you wasn't wasted.
translation_verse: Bekurgepoana, men gbagba nyi fanɛ anyi be kebɔɔso nɛ an bɔɔ menyi so na maŋ la kebɔɔso fuloŋ.

english_verse: As you remember, we had been mistreated and insulted at Philippi. But God gave us the courage to tell you the good news about him, even though many people caused us trouble.
translation_verse: Men nyi kananɛ b tɔrɔ anyi n tege anyi ashi Filipai pɔɛŋ nɛ an ba menyi kutɔ ashi Tɛsalɔnika. Kɔnɔgberge damta daa wɔtɔ, ama anyi be Ebɔrɛ sa anyi kenyɛn nɛ an bɔ kubɔya lela nɛ k shi mo kutɔ na n sa menyi.

english_verse: We didn't have any hidden motives when we won you over, and we didn't try to fool or trick anyone.
translation_verse: Anyi be kubɔya nɛ an kɔ a leŋ menyi to na maŋ shi efɛ to ŋko kusɔ jigaya be nfɛra to ŋko kafule to.

english_verse: But as apostles, we could have demanded help from you. After all, Christ is the one who sent us. We chose to be like children or like a mother nursing her baby.
translation_verse: Ama saŋɛ nɛ an daa wɔ menyi kutɔ na, an daa du boeŋ nna fanɛ kananɛ ebinio bee keni mbe mbia so a lɔlɔ bumo na.

english_verse: We cared so much for you, and you became so dear to us, that we were willing to give our lives for you when we gave you God's message.
translation_verse: Mannɛ fanɛ baru lela nɛ k shi Ebɔrɛ kutɔ na nawule nɛ an daŋ bugi kagbene n sa menyi, ama an daŋ ta an be amu kikɛ gba nna n sa menyi kashaso, ŋkpal manɛ so, men be asheŋ daa wɔ an be ŋgbene to ga.

english_verse: My dear friends, you surely haven't forgotten our hard work and hardships. You remember how night and day we struggled to make a living, so we could tell you God's message without being a burden to anyone.
translation_verse: Bekurgepoana, m baa nyi fanɛ menyee nyiŋi kananɛ an mɔ anyi be amu n shuŋ saŋɛ nɛ an daa wɔ men kutɔ a malga Ebɔrɛ be baru lela na a sa menyi na ŋko? Kapa nɛ kanyɛ kikɛ nɛ an daa shuŋ, ŋkpal manɛ so, an daa maa sha keshin nɛ men be ekama e baa wɔ kegben to.

english_verse: Both you and God are witnesses that we were pure and honest and innocent in our dealings with you followers of the Lord.
translation_verse: Menyi nɛ Ebɔrɛ e la an be eshɛdajipoana. An daa maŋ ta da lubi n tu menyi nɛ men yirda na, anyi be da daa du cheembi a kɔ kashenteŋ nna.

english_verse: You also know we did everything for you that parents would do for their own children.
translation_verse: Men nyi fanɛ an daa ŋini menyi be ekama nna fanɛ kananɛ etuto bee ŋini mbe mbia na.

english_verse: We begged, encouraged, and urged each of you to live in a way that would honor God. He is the one who chose you to share in his own kingdom and glory.
translation_verse: An daa leŋ menyi to a lɔlɔ menyi nseŋ daa kaŋɛ menyi kananɛ menyeeŋ baa wora nɛ menyi be kebaawɔtɔ e baa par Ebɔrɛ nɛ e bee tre menyi a ba mbe kuwura nɛ kemaŋkura na to na.

english_verse: We always thank God that you believed the message we preached. It came from him, and it isn't something made up by humans. You accepted it as God's message, and now he is working in you.
translation_verse: Saŋkama anyee chɔrɔ Ebɔrɛ ga ŋkpal kananɛ men sɔ Ebɔrɛ be kubɔya nɛ an daŋ bar menyi na so. Men sɔ kubɔya na fanɛ Ebɔrɛ peya. Kashenteŋ malɛ nna fanɛ Ebɔrɛ be kubɔya nna, kumo alɛ e wɔ menyi beyirdapo to a shuŋ na.

english_verse: My friends, you did just like God's churches in Judea and like the other followers of Christ Jesus there. And so, you were mistreated by your own people, in the same way they were mistreated by their people.
translation_verse: Ŋ kurgepoana, kusɔ nɛ k wora menyi na koŋwule na e wora bumo nɛ baa bɛ Ebɔrɛ so a wɔ Judiya na gba. Bumo e la bumo nɛ b la Yesu Kristo peya na. Kananɛ men be efuli so ebi bee tɔrɔ menyi na nɛ Juwebi na ta n tu bebɛsopo nɛ b wɔ Judiya to na gba.

english_verse: Those evil people killed the Lord Jesus and the prophets, and they even chased us away. God doesn't like what they do and neither does anyone else.
translation_verse: Juwebi koŋwule na e mɔ Enyɛnpe Yesu nɛ anebiana na nseŋ tɔrɔ anyi alɛ. Bumo be asheŋ maa par Ebɔrɛ kikɛ. Bumo nɛ basa kikɛ malɛ maŋ wɔ ebel.

english_verse: They keep us from speaking his message to the Gentiles and from leading them to be saved. They have always gone too far with their sins. Now God has finally become angry and will punish them. Paul Wants To Visit the Church Again
translation_verse: Kumɔlga be kubɔya nɛ an daŋ bar nnyamase na gba, Juwebi na daa maa sha an ka bɔ kumo n sa nnyamase na. Loŋ so, bumo be asheŋ lubi daa ti so nna saŋkama. Naniere malɛ Ebɔrɛ be agbo kaa bumo so. Kananɛ Pɔɔl bee sha keyaa bɔɔ bumo so be asheŋ

english_verse: My friends, we were kept from coming to you for a while, but we never stopped thinking about you. We were eager to see you and tried our best to visit you in person.
translation_verse: Bekurgepoana, b ka daŋ barga anyi ashi men kutɔ na an daŋ barga menyi eyur to, ama an be ŋgbene bre to anyi nɛ menyi e daa la. Anyi be kenishi daŋ pere menyi so ga nɛ an yɛlga ga fanɛ an naŋ wu menyi.

english_verse: We really wanted to come. I myself tried several times, but Satan always stopped us.
translation_verse: An daa naa sha kenaŋ bɛta n yɔ menyi kutɔ nna, ama Setani maŋ yige anyi kikɛ. Ma Pɔɔl gbagba fin ekpa kanaŋkama ŋ gben.

english_verse: You alone are our glory and joy!
translation_verse: Kashenteŋto, menyi e la anyi be kemaŋkura nɛ kagbenefuli.

english_verse: and send our friend Timothy to you. He works with us as God's servant and preaches the good news about Christ. We wanted him to make you strong in your faith and to encourage you.
translation_verse: An shuŋi mo nna fanɛ e ya leŋ menyi to nseŋ chɛ menyi to nɛ men baa wɔ men be yirda na to. Loŋ e naaŋ shin nɛ men be ekama e sa maŋ foe ekpa ŋkpal etɔrɔ ere so.

english_verse: We didn't want any of you to be discouraged by all these troubles. You knew we would have to suffer,
translation_verse: Menyi alɛ gba nyi fanɛ etɔrɔ na gba la asɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ yili fanɛ a wora nna.

english_verse: because when we were with you, we told you this would happen. And we did suffer, as you well know.
translation_verse: Anyi nɛ menyi ka daa wɔtɔ, an chɛr ŋ kaŋɛ menyi fanɛ baaŋ tɔrɔ anyi. Loŋ malɛ gbagba nɛ men wu a ka wora na.

english_verse: At last, when I could not wait any longer, I sent Timothy to find out about your faith. I hoped Satan had not tempted you and made all our work useless.
translation_verse: Amoso, nɛ m ba gben n shuŋi Timoti nɛ e ya keni ŋko men kraa kɔ men be yirda na to ŋko Setani chɔ menyi ŋ keni n shin nɛ an be kushuŋ ki kushuŋ fuloŋ a.

english_verse: Timothy has now come back from his visit with you and has told us about your faith and love. He also said that you always have happy memories of us and that you want to see us as much as we want to see you.
translation_verse: Timoti ka shi menyi kutɔ m ba, mo alɛ bar anyi menyi be yirda nɛ kasha be kubɔya lela. E kaŋɛ anyi men ka bee nyiŋi an be asheŋ a fin kewu anyi fanɛ kananɛ anyee fin kewu menyi na.

english_verse: My friends, even though we have a lot of trouble and suffering, your faith makes us feel better about you.
translation_verse: Bekurgepoana, ŋkpal menyi so an be awurfoŋ nɛ tɔrɔ kikɛ maŋ tir anyi. Men be yirda e daŋ leŋ anyi to.

english_verse: Your strong faith in the Lord is like a breath of new life.
translation_verse: Naniere nɛ men kɔ Enyɛnpe na to kpakpa nɛ kagbene koŋwule, anyeeŋ baa wɔ ŋkpa to be kebaawɔtɔ lela to ŋkpal menyi so.

english_verse: How can we possibly thank God enough for all the happiness you have brought us?
translation_verse: Naniere anyeeŋ tiŋ n chɔrɔ Ebɔrɛ ŋkpal menyi so. Anyee chɔrɔ anyi be Ebɔrɛ na ŋkpal kagbenefuli nɛ e sa anyi ŋkpal menyi so na so.

english_verse: Day and night we sincerely pray that we will see you again and help you to have an even stronger faith.
translation_verse: Kapa nɛ kanyɛ anyee bugi anyi be ŋgbene to nna a kule Ebɔrɛ fanɛ e shin nɛ an gbagba e wu menyi n sa menyi yirda na be kusɔ nɛ k ka.

english_verse: May the Lord make your love for each other and for everyone else grow by leaps and bounds. This is how our love for you has grown.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe na e shin nɛ men be abar be kasha nɛ basa kikɛ be kasha e baa wora keshi menyi to a ti so n ya fo kananɛ anyee sha menyi na.

english_verse: Finally, my dear friends, since you belong to the Lord Jesus, we beg and urge you to live as we taught you. Then you will please God. You are already living that way, but try even harder.
translation_verse: Bekurgepoana, an shin nɛ men pin kebaawɔtɔ nɛ k bee par Ebɔrɛ. Loŋ malɛ be kebaawɔtɔ to nɛ men chɛr a wɔ to na, ama anyee kule menyi Enyɛnpe Yesu be ketre to fanɛ men pere kenishi n nya kebaawɔtɔ nɛ k bee par Ebɔrɛ saŋkama a ti so.

english_verse: Remember the instructions we gave you as followers of the Lord Jesus.
translation_verse: Men nyi kasheŋ ŋini nɛ an daŋ bɔla Enyɛnpe Yesu be eleŋ to n sa menyi na.

english_verse: God wants you to be holy, so don't be immoral in matters of sex.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ be kusɔ nɛ e bee sha nde: E bee sha men ka bee gelge abojuasheŋ nna nɛnɛ a du cheembi.

english_verse: Don't be a slave of your desires or live like people who don't know God.
translation_verse: Men sa maa kɔ kayɛlga fuloŋ be kacheta fanɛ kananɛ nnyamase nɛ b maŋ nyi Ebɔrɛ bee wora na.

english_verse: You must not cheat any of the Lord's followers in matters of sex. Remember, we warned you that he punishes everyone who does such things.
translation_verse: Amoso, ekama e sa maŋ kaŋ wora kulubi kikɛ ŋ gbiti mo barkasa ŋko m puni mo. An chɛr m malga le be kamalga kenishipereso n sa menyi fanɛ ekama nɛ e wora le be asheŋ, Enyɛnpe na beeŋ gberge mo kusoe.

english_verse: So if you don't obey these rules, you are not really disobeying us. Instead, you are disobeying God, who gives you his Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Amoso, ekama nɛ e kini keŋini ere, mannɛ nyiŋgbasa nɛ e kini, ama Ebɔrɛ nɛ e bee sa menyi mbe Kiyoyu na nɛ e kini.

english_verse: We don't have to write you about the need to love each other. God has taught you to do this,
translation_verse: Kananɛ menyeeŋ baa sha men braana beyirdapo bre maŋ naŋ daga an ka naŋ sibɛ ŋ kaŋɛ menyi kumo be asheŋ. Ebɔrɛ teŋ ŋ ŋini menyi gbagba kananɛ menyeeŋ baa sha abar.

english_verse: and you already have shown your love for all his people in Macedonia. But, my dear friends, we ask you to do even more.
translation_verse: Kashenteŋ nɛ menyee ŋini beyirdapo nɛ b wɔ Masɛdonia kikɛ na men be kasha. Amoso, an kurgepoana, men pere kenishi n nya kasha nɛ k beeŋ baa chɔ kumo nɛ men kɔ ere.

english_verse: Try your best to live quietly, to mind your own business, and to work hard, just as we taught you to do.
translation_verse: Ekama e pere kenishi a fin kananɛ e beeŋ baa du boeŋ a maa luri basa be asheŋ to nsaa keni mbe kumu so fanɛ kananɛ an daŋ kaŋɛ menyi na.

english_verse: Then you will be respected by people who are not followers of the Lord, and you won't have to depend on anyone. The Lord's Coming
translation_verse: Loŋ nɛ bumo nɛ b maa bɛ Ebɔrɛ so na beeŋ bunyaŋ menyi. Enyɛnpe be kebɛta m ba be asheŋ

english_verse: My friends, we want you to understand how it will be for those followers who have already died. Then you won't grieve over them and be like people who don't have any hope.
translation_verse: Bekurgepoana, anyee sha men ka pin beyirdapo nɛ b wu na be asheŋ nɛ men be ŋgbene e sa maŋ kaŋ jija menyi fanɛ basa nɛ b maŋ kɔ tama na.

english_verse: We believe Jesus died and was raised to life. We also believe that when God brings Jesus back again, he will bring with him all who had faith in Jesus before they died.
translation_verse: An kɔ yirda fanɛ Yesu wu n tiŋi luwu to. Amoso, an nyi fanɛ Ebɔrɛ beeŋ shin nɛ Yesu nɛ basa nɛ b yirda mo pɔɛŋ nseŋ wu na e ba.

english_verse: Our Lord Jesus told us that when he comes, we won't go up to meet him ahead of his followers who have already died.
translation_verse: Kusɔ nɛ anyee kaŋɛ menyi ere la Enyɛnpe na be keŋini nna fanɛ kachɛ nɛ Enyɛnpe na beeŋ ba na, anyi nɛ an kraa wɔ ŋkpa to ere maaŋ juŋkpar bumo nɛ b wu na n yɔ ebɔrɛso.

english_verse: With a loud command and with the shout of the chief angel and a blast of God's trumpet, the Lord will return from heaven. Then those who had faith in Christ before they died will be raised to life.
translation_verse: Kumo be kamɔnchɛ menyeeŋ nu kaponte nɛ malaika nimuso be ebɔl nɛ Ebɔrɛ be kabel be kushu, saŋɛ na so nɛ Enyɛnpe na gbagba e shi ebɔrɛso m ba. Bumo nɛ b yirda Yesu Kristo pɔɛŋ nseŋ wu na e naaŋ juŋkpar n tiŋi luwu to.

english_verse: Next, all of us who are still alive will be taken up into the clouds together with them to meet the Lord in the sky. From that time on we will all be with the Lord forever.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman, baaŋ chala anyi nɛ an yirda nseŋ kraa wɔ ŋkpa to na n ti bumo nɛ b yirda pɔɛŋ nseŋ wu na so nɛ an kikɛ e ya tu Enyɛnpe na awɔlpa to, nɛ anyi nɛ Enyɛnpe na e baa wɔtɔ saŋkama mbaanaayɔ.

english_verse: Encourage each other with these words.
translation_verse: Amoso, men baa kɔ mmalga ere to a leŋ abar to.

english_verse: I don't need to write you about the time or date when all this will happen.
translation_verse: Bekurgepoana, a maŋ daga esa ka naŋ sibɛ ŋ kaŋɛ menyi jemanɛ nɛ saŋɛ nɛ asheŋ ere beeŋ wora,

english_verse: You surely know that the Lord's return will be as a thief coming at night.
translation_verse: ŋkpal manɛ so, menyi ere gbagba baa nyi fanɛ Enyɛnpe be kachɛ na beeŋ ba fanɛ kananɛ eyu bee ba kanyɛso na.

english_verse: People will think they are safe and secure. But destruction will suddenly strike them like the pains of a woman about to give birth. And they won't escape.
translation_verse: Saŋɛ nɛ basa ya kaa kaŋɛ: “Naniere bre kaboŋ nyalɛ nɛ kagbenewushi ba,” epul na malɛ to nɛ kemur be tɔrɔ beeŋ tɔr bumo so fanɛ kananɛ kakurge be ebesa bee purgi edampoche na. Bumo be ekama maaŋ lar.

english_verse: My dear friends, you don't live in darkness, and so that day won't surprise you like a thief.
translation_verse: Ama bekurgepoana, menyi alɛ maŋ wɔ tentembiri to, amoso, men sa maŋ shin nɛ kachɛ na e purgi menyi fanɛ eyu.

english_verse: You belong to the light and live in the day. We don't live in the night or belong to the dark.
translation_verse: Menyi kikɛ la kefulto to be basa nna, kapaso be basa. Anyi maŋ la kanyɛ ŋko tentembiri to be basa.

english_verse: But we belong to the day. So we must stay sober and let our faith and love be like a suit of armor. Our firm hope that we will be saved is our helmet.
translation_verse: Amoso, a daga fanɛ an baa du boeŋ a maa boo nsa. An baa shin nɛ yirda nɛ kasha e baa buu anyi so fanɛ kebɛlso be kekpaŋkale nseŋ naa shin nɛ anyi be kumɔlga be tama malɛ gba e baa buu anyi so fanɛ kebɛlso be kekpaŋwuro.

english_verse: God doesn't intend to punish us, but wants us to be saved by our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ maŋ lara anyi nna nɛ e ta mbe agbo n lɛ anyi so, ama e lara anyi nna nɛ an baa nya kumɔlga ashi Enyɛnpe Yesu Kristo to.

english_verse: Christ died for us, so we could live with him, whether we are alive or dead when he comes.
translation_verse: Yesu na e wu n sa anyi, loŋ na e kaŋ ya bɛta m ba nɛ an wu ŋko an kraa keni, anyi nɛ mo beeŋ baa wɔtɔ.

english_verse: This is why you must encourage and help each other, just as you are already doing. Final Instructions and Greetings
translation_verse: Amoso, men baa leŋ abar to a chɛ abar to fanɛ kananɛ men chɛr a wora na. Lalaloge be asheŋ ŋiniso nɛ kechɔrɔ be asheŋ

english_verse: My friends, we ask you to be thoughtful of your leaders who work hard and tell you how to live for the Lord.
translation_verse: Bekurgepoana, anyee kule menyi fanɛ men baa bunyaŋ bumo nɛ b wɔ menyi to a shuŋ na, bumo nɛ Ebɔrɛ lara nɛ b baa la menyi be benimuana a ŋini menyi na.

english_verse: Show them great respect and love because of their work. Try to get along with each other.
translation_verse: Men baa sa bumo bunyaŋ nɛ kasha kpakpaso ŋkpal kushuŋ nɛ baa shuŋ na so. Men baa kɔ kɔnɔkoŋwule abar so.

english_verse: My friends, we beg you to warn anyone who isn't living right. Encourage anyone who feels left out, help all who are weak, and be patient with everyone.
translation_verse: Anyee kule menyi bekurgepoana, men fiɛ betɔlpoana na so nseŋ leŋ befupo to n chɛ bepɔshipo malɛ gba to a ji bumo kikɛ kanyiti.

english_verse: Don't be hateful to people, just because they are hateful to you. Rather, be good to each other and to everyone else.
translation_verse: Men baa da so nɛ men be ekama e sa maŋ kaŋ ta kulubi ŋ ka kulubi be kukɔ, ama saŋkama men baa wora abar nɛ basa kikɛ kelela.

english_verse: Always be joyful
translation_verse: Men baa kɔ kagbenefuli saŋkama

english_verse: and never stop praying.
translation_verse: a kule Ebɔrɛ saŋkama.

english_verse: Whatever happens, keep thanking God because of Jesus Christ. This is what God wants you to do.
translation_verse: Men baa chɔrɔ Ebɔrɛ kebaawɔtɔ kama nɛ men wɔtɔ to, ŋkpal manɛ so, kusɔ nɛ e bee sha nɛ men baa wora Yesu Kristo to nna na.

english_verse: Don't turn away God's Spirit
translation_verse: Men sa maŋ kuŋ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na ekpa.

english_verse: Put everything to the test. Accept what is good
translation_verse: Men baa wora asɔ kikɛ a keni, kusɔ kama nɛ k walɛ, men baa kɔ kumo to kpakpa

english_verse: and don't have anything to do with evil.
translation_verse: m barga menyi be amu ashi kulubi be yiri kikɛ to.

english_verse: I pray that God, who gives peace, will make you completely holy. And may your spirit, soul, and body be kept healthy and faultless until our Lord Jesus Christ returns.
