translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ nɛ e bee sa kagbenewushi na e wora menyi cheembi n shin nɛ menyi be amu kikɛ nɛ kiyoyu nɛ kagbene nɛ eyur e lar kulubi kikɛ to jemanɛ nɛ anyi nɛ Enyɛnpe Yesu Kristo beeŋ ya ba na.

english_verse: The one who chose you can be trusted, and he will do this.
translation_verse: Emo nɛ e tre menyi na beeŋ wora le be asheŋ, ŋkpal manɛ so, e la emo nɛ esa beeŋ tiŋ n yirda nna.

english_verse: Friends, please pray for us.
translation_verse: Bekurgepoana, men baa kule Ebɔrɛ a sa anyi alɛ gba.

english_verse: Give the Lord's followers a warm greeting.
translation_verse: Men ta kegbumpipe cheembi n chɔrɔ bekurgepoana na kikɛ.

english_verse: In the name of the Lord I beg you to read this letter to all his followers.
translation_verse: Mee kule menyi ashi Enyɛnpe na be eleŋ to fanɛ men kraŋ kawɔl ere nɛ bekurgepoana na kikɛ e nu.

english_verse: I pray that our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you!
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Yesu Kristo be kuwɔr be kakɛ na e baa la menyeya.

english_verse: From Paul, Silas, and Timothy. To the church in Thessalonica, the people of God our Father and of the Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Kawɔl ere shi ma Pɔɔl nɛ Sailas nɛ Timoti kutɔ nna a yɔ Tɛsalɔnika be asɔriebi nɛ b la Ebɔrɛ an Tuto nɛ Enyɛnpe Yesu Kristo peya na kutɔ.

english_verse: I pray that God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! When Christ Returns
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ Etuto na nɛ Enyɛnpe Yesu Kristo e sa menyi mo ere Ebɔrɛ na be kuwɔr be kakɛ nɛ kagbenewushi. Kristo be keba be kachɛ be demu be keji be asheŋ

english_verse: My dear friends, we always have good reason to thank God for you, because your faith in God and your love for each other keep growing all the time.
translation_verse: Bekurgepoana, a daga an ka bee chɔrɔ Ebɔrɛ saŋkama ŋkpal menyi so. An kɔ ekpa nɛ an chɔrɔ mo ŋkpal kananɛ men be yirda bee wora keshi a ti so so. Kananɛ men be ekama bee sha mo braana na gba bee ti so.

english_verse: This is why we brag about you to all of God's churches. We tell them how patient you are and how you keep on having faith, even though you are going through a lot of trouble and suffering.
translation_verse: Amoso nɛ anyi gbagba wɔ Ebɔrɛ be asɔriana to a ji njɔŋ ŋkpal menyi so na. Men be yirda nɛ kanyiti nɛ men kɔ a wɔ awurfoŋ nɛ tɔrɔ damta ere to so nɛ anyee ji njɔŋ loŋ na.

english_verse: All this shows that God judges fairly and is making you fit to share in his kingdom for which you are suffering.
translation_verse: Kede ere e naaŋ ŋini Ebɔrɛ be demu be keji ka du cheembi, ŋkpal manɛ so, ade kikɛ e shin nɛ men daga mbe kuwura nɛ men kpal kumo so a ji awurfoŋ na.

english_verse: It is only right for God to punish everyone who is causing you trouble,
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ bee wora asɔ nɛ amo be ekpa so nna. Basa nɛ baa tɔrɔ menyi ere, e beeŋ shin nɛ tɔrɔ e ba bumo so.

english_verse: but he will give you relief from your troubles. God will do the same for us, when the Lord Jesus comes from heaven with his powerful angels
translation_verse: Mo e naaŋ sa anyi nɛ menyi nɛ menyee ji awurfoŋ ere ewushi kachɛ nɛ Enyɛnpe Yesu beeŋ lara mbe kumu ŋ ŋini durnya saŋɛ nɛ mo nɛ mbe emalaika lempo beeŋ shi ebɔrɛso m ba nɛ edɛ chɔɔso

english_verse: and with a flaming fire. Our Lord Jesus will punish anyone who doesn't know God and won't obey his message.
translation_verse: m ba gberge basa nɛ b maŋ nyi Ebɔrɛ nɛ bumo nɛ b maa bɛ an Nyɛnpe Yesu be baru lela na so kusoe.

english_verse: Their punishment will be eternal destruction, and they will be kept far from the presence of our Lord and his glorious strength.
translation_verse: Baaŋ nya kemur be kasogberge mbaanaayɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ e barga bumo ashi mo kutɔ nɛ mbe eleŋ be kemaŋkuragboŋ na to.

english_verse: This will happen on the day when the Lord returns to be praised and honored by all who have faith in him and belong to him. This includes you, because you believed what we said.
translation_verse: Kachɛ nɛ e beeŋ ba nya kemaŋkura nɛ bunyaŋ ashi mbe basa nɛ b yirda mo na kutɔ na, menyi alɛ gba beeŋ ti loŋ be basa na so ŋkpal men ka yirda kubɔya nɛ an daŋ bɔ n sa menyi na so.

english_verse: God chose you, and we keep praying that God will make you worthy of being his people. We pray for God's power to help you do all the good things you hope to do and your faith makes you want to do.
translation_verse: Amoso nɛ anyee kule anyi be Ebɔrɛ saŋkama a sa menyi fanɛ e shin nɛ men be kebaawɔtɔ e baa du fanɛ kananɛ e tre menyi fanɛ men ba kaa kɔ na. Anyee kule mo fanɛ e ta mbe eleŋ na n shin nɛ men be kelela be kasha na e wora kashenteŋ n shin nɛ men be yirda be kushuŋ na e bɔlɔ so nyam.

english_verse: Then, because of the undeserved grace of God and our Lord Jesus Christ, you will bring honor to the name of our Lord Jesus, and he will bring honor to you.
translation_verse: Loŋ nɛ an Nyɛnpe Yesu be ketre beeŋ nya kemaŋkura menyi kutɔ, nɛ menyi alɛ gba e bɔla an Nyɛnpe Yesu Kristo nɛ an be Ebɔrɛ be kuwɔr be kakɛ so n nya kemaŋkura ashi mo kutɔ.

english_verse: When our Lord Jesus returns, we will be gathered up to meet him. So I ask you, my friends,
translation_verse: To, bekurgepoana, an Nyɛnpe Yesu Kristo be kebɛta m ba na nɛ anyi be kechala a wɔ mo kutɔ na malɛ be asheŋ nde:

english_verse: not to be easily upset or disturbed by people who claim the Lord has already come. They may say they heard this directly from the Holy Spirit, or from someone else, or even that they read it in one of our letters.
translation_verse: Anyee kule menyi nna fanɛ men sa maŋ kaŋ shin nɛ men be nfɛra e wul menyi to ŋko n shin nɛ kananɛ basa ko bee kaŋɛ fanɛ Enyɛnpe be kachɛ na teŋ ba na e baa jija men be ŋgbene. Shere esa ko e kaŋɛ fanɛ e wu kumo loŋ nna ŋko esa ko e malga abɔrɛsheŋ ŋ kaŋɛ loŋ ŋko basa e naa kaŋɛ fanɛ anyi e sibɛ kumo anyi be kawɔl to.

english_verse: But don't be fooled! People will rebel against God. Then before the Lord returns, the wicked one who is doomed to be destroyed will appear.
translation_verse: Men sa maŋ kaŋ shin nɛ esa kama e bɔla ekpa kikɛ so n fule menyi, ŋkpal manɛ so, Enyɛnpe be kachɛ na maaŋ ba ama kenyaŋɛto m buu Ebɔrɛ na ba na nɛ alubipo nɛ mbe kelamba la edɛ to be keluri na lar na pɔɛŋ.

english_verse: Don't you remember I told you this while I was still with you?
translation_verse: Men maŋ nyiŋi fanɛ ŋ ka daa wɔ menyi kutɔ ŋ kaŋɛ menyi asheŋ ere kikɛ a?

english_verse: You already know what is holding this wicked one back until it is time for him to come.
translation_verse: Naniere menyi alɛ gba nyi kusɔ nɛ k bee shin nɛ alubipo na maaŋ tiŋ m ba, ama mbe jemanɛ na ya fo nna nɛ e lar efuli.

english_verse: His mysterious power is already at work, but someone is holding him back. And the wicked one won't appear until this someone is out of the way.
translation_verse: Daŋga be asheŋ lubi be kewora na bre teŋ fara, ama asɔ nɛ a beeŋ wora na be eleŋ gbagba maŋ naŋ lar efuli she emo nɛ e bee kuŋ amo ekpa na lar ashi to nna.

english_verse: Then he will appear, but the Lord Jesus will kill him simply by breathing on him. He will be completely destroyed by the Lord's glorious return.
translation_verse: Kachɛ na kaŋ fo, alubipo na beeŋ ba lara mbe kumu efuli nɛ Enyɛnpe Yesu e fute mbe kɔnɔ to be afu m mɔ mo n shin nɛ mo ere Yesu be kemaŋkura be keba na e mur alubipo na.

english_verse: When the wicked one appears, Satan will pretend to work all kinds of miracles, wonders, and signs.
translation_verse: Alubipo na beeŋ bɔla Setani be eleŋ to n wora efɛ be edaŋga nɛ emamachisheŋ damta.

english_verse: Lost people will be fooled by his evil deeds. They could be saved, but they will refuse to love the truth and accept it.
translation_verse: E beeŋ bar efɛ be edalubisheŋ damta m ba fule bumo nɛ baaŋ mur na. Baaŋ wu kasogberge be luwu na ŋkpal b ka kini kashenteŋ nɛ baaŋ bɔla kumo so n nya kumɔlga na so.

english_verse: All of them will be punished, because they would rather do evil than believe the truth. Be Faithful
translation_verse: Bekama malɛ nɛ b maŋ yirda kashenteŋ na nseŋ ta alubi ŋ ki bumo be aparsheŋ na kikɛ beeŋ mur. Kananɛ Ebɔrɛ lara Tɛsalɔnikaebi nɛ b nya kumɔlga be asheŋ

english_verse: My friends, the Lord loves you, and it is only natural for us to thank God for you. God chose you to be the first ones to be saved. His Spirit made you holy, and you put your faith in the truth.
translation_verse: Bekurgepoana, a daga an ka chɔrɔ Ebɔrɛ saŋkama ŋkpal menyi nɛ Enyɛnpe bee sha na so. Ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ fara nna n lara menyi nɛ men nya kumɔlga ashi Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na to nseŋ ki Ebɔrɛ be basa cheembi a wɔ keyirda kashenteŋ na to.

english_verse: God used our preaching as his way of inviting you to share in the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Baru lela nɛ an malga n sa menyi na to nɛ Ebɔrɛ bɔla n tre menyi. E tre menyi nna nɛ menyi alɛ e ba nya an Nyɛnpe Yesu Kristo be kemaŋkura na.

english_verse: My friends, this is why you must remain faithful and follow closely what we taught you in person and by our letters.
translation_verse: Amoso, bekurgepoana, men baa kɔ men be amu to kpakpa a kɔ kashenteŋ nɛ an ta abɔrɛsheŋ be kemalga nɛ kawɔl be kesibɛ ŋ ŋini menyi na to kpakpa.

english_verse: God our Father loves us. He treats us with undeserved grace and has given us eternal comfort and a wonderful hope. We pray that our Lord Jesus Christ and God our Father
translation_verse: An Nyɛnpe Yesu Kristo gbagba nɛ Ebɔrɛ an Tuto nɛ e sha anyi nseŋ bɔla mbe kuwɔr be kakɛ so a leŋ anyi to mbaanaayɔ nsaa sa anyi tama lela na

english_verse: will encourage you and help you always to do and say the right thing.
translation_verse: e baa leŋ menyi to nɛnɛ nsaa sa menyi eleŋ nɛ men baa wora asheŋ lela kikɛ nsaa malga mmalga lela.

english_verse: Finally, our friends, please pray for us. This will help the message about the Lord to spread quickly, and others will respect it, just as you do.
translation_verse: Ade kikɛ be buushi, bekurgepoana, men baa kule Ebɔrɛ a sa anyi nɛ Enyɛnpe be kubɔya na e nya manaŋ n sɔ kakpa kikɛ n nya kemaŋkura fanɛ kananɛ k daŋ wora menyi kutɔ na.

english_verse: Pray that we may be kept safe from worthless and evil people. After all, not everyone has faith.
translation_verse: Men baa kule Ebɔrɛ a sa anyi nɛ e baa pete anyi basa lubi be yiri kikɛ to. Ŋkpal manɛ so, mannɛ basa kikɛ e kɔ yirda.

english_verse: But the Lord can be trusted to make you strong and protect you from harm.
translation_verse: Ama Enyɛnpe bre maa chɛrga mbe asheŋ to kikɛ. E beeŋ sa menyi eleŋ nseŋ pete menyi ashi kulubi to.

english_verse: He has made us sure that you are obeying what we taught you and that you will keep on obeying.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe na so an yirda menyi a nyi men ka bee wora ŋ kraa beeŋ wora asɔ nɛ anyee kaŋɛ menyi.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will guide you to be as loving as God and as patient as Christ. Warnings against Laziness
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe na e ŋini menyi be ŋgbene Ebɔrɛ be kasha nɛ Kristo be kanyiti na. Betɔlpo be asheŋ

english_verse: My dear friends, in the name of the Lord Jesus, I beg you not to have anything to do with any of your people who loaf around and refuse to obey the instructions we gave you.
translation_verse: Bekurgepoana, naniere anyee fiɛ menyi so Enyɛnpe Yesu Kristo be ketre to fanɛ men baa gelge ekurgepo kikɛ nɛ e wɔ ntɔl be kebaawɔtɔ to a maa bɛ keŋini nɛ an sa menyi na so.

english_verse: You surely know that you should follow our example. We didn't waste our time loafing,
translation_verse: Menyi gbagba e baa nyi a ka daga men ka bee kute anyi to. An ka daa wɔ menyi kutɔ, an daa maŋ kɔ ntɔl.

english_verse: and we didn't accept food from anyone without paying for it. We didn't want to be a burden to any of you, so night and day we worked as hard as we could.
translation_verse: An daa maŋ ji ekama be kejibi a maŋ ka mo, ama kapa nɛ kanyɛ an daa mɔ an be amu nna a shuŋ nɛ an sa maŋ bɔ ekama kukɔ.

english_verse: We had the right not to work, but we wanted to set an example for you.
translation_verse: Mannɛ fanɛ an daa maa kɔ kumo be ekpa nna, ama an daa maŋ wora loŋ nna nɛ men wu anyi be kebaawɔtɔ na ŋ kute anyi to.

english_verse: We also gave you this rule: If you don't work, you don't eat.
translation_verse: Anyi nɛ menyi ka daa wɔtɔ na gba, an chɛr ŋ kaŋɛ menyi fanɛ: “Ekama nɛ e maŋ shuŋ, men sa maŋ shin nɛ e ji.”

english_verse: Now we learn that some of you just loaf around and won't do any work, except the work of a busybody.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, an nu fanɛ men be beko wɔ ntɔl be kebaawɔtɔ to nna a maa shuŋ shɛŋ nsaa wɔtɔ a kilgi to fanɛ menyi ka bee shuŋ na.

english_verse: So, for the sake of our Lord Jesus Christ, we ask and beg these people to settle down and start working for a living.
translation_verse: Anyee kaŋɛ nsaa fiɛ le be basa so Enyɛnpe Yesu Kristo be ketre to fanɛ b ta bumo be amu boeŋ a wora bumo be ashuŋ a bela bumo gbagba be amu.

english_verse: Dear friends, you must never become tired of doing right.
translation_verse: Bekurgepoana, men sa maŋ shin nɛ kelela be kewora e baa gben menyi.

english_verse: Be on your guard against any followers who refuse to obey what we have written in this letter. Put them to shame by not having anything to do with them.
translation_verse: Nɛ ekama nɛ e kini kewora kusɔ nɛ anyee kaŋɛ menyi kawɔl ere to ere, men baa de amodoŋwura so a gelge mo nɛ anishinyɔr e pɛ mo.

english_verse: Don't consider them your enemies. Instead, speak kindly to them as you would to any other follower. Final Prayer
translation_verse: Men sa maŋ ta mo ŋ ki men doŋ, ama men fiɛ mo so fanɛ ekurgepo. Lalaloge be mmalga be asheŋ

english_verse: I pray that the Lord, who gives peace, will always bless you with peace. May the Lord be with all of you.
translation_verse: To, kagbenewushi be Enyɛnpe na gbagba e sa menyi kagbenewushi saŋkama ashi kusɔ kama to. Enyɛnpe na e baa wɔ menyi kikɛ to.

english_verse: I pray that our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to all of you.
translation_verse: An Nyɛnpe Yesu Kristo be kuwɔr be kakɛ na e baa wɔ menyi kikɛ so.

english_verse: From Paul. God our Savior and Christ Jesus commanded me to be an apostle of Christ Jesus, who gives us hope.
translation_verse: Kawɔl ere shi ma Pɔɔl nɛ n la Kristo Yesu be eshuŋipo ŋkpal Ebɔrɛ an be Emɔlgapo be keparso nɛ Kristo Yesu nɛ an be tama wɔ mo so na kutɔ nna

english_verse: Timothy, because of our faith, you are like a son to me. I pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind and merciful to you. May they bless you with peace! Warning against False Teaching
translation_verse: a yɔ fo Timoti nɛ fo la m pibi kashenteŋto ashi yirda na to na kutɔ. Ebɔrɛ Etuto na nɛ Kristo Yesu an Nyɛnpe e baa sa fo kuwɔr be kakɛ nɛ kuwɔr nɛ kagbenewushi. Befɛpo ŋinipo be asheŋ

english_verse: When I was leaving for Macedonia, I asked you to stay on in Ephesus and warn certain people there to stop spreading their false teachings.
translation_verse: Ŋ ka daa yɔ Masɛdonia, ŋ kaŋɛ fo fanɛ fo shir a wɔ Ɛfeses. Mee sha fanɛ fo baa kraa wɔ ndoŋ ŋkpal basa nɛ b wɔ ndoŋ a ŋini keŋini pɔtɛ nɛ a daga fo ka ju bumo loŋ to na so.

english_verse: You needed to warn them to stop wasting their time on senseless stories and endless lists of ancestors. Such things only cause arguments. They don't help anyone to do God's work that can only be done by faith.
translation_verse: Shin nɛ b lar ablɔmbi fuloŋ nɛ kakurge to be mmalga tenteŋana na to. Loŋ be mmalga bee bar emɔrɔ nna a maa ŋini kabɔrɛbɛso nɛ k bee shi yirda to na.

english_verse: You must teach people to have genuine love, as well as a good conscience and true faith.
translation_verse: Anyi ere be keŋini ere be kumu e la kasha nɛ k shi kagbene cheembi nɛ nfɛra lela nɛ yirda kpakpaso to na nna.

english_verse: There are some who have given up these for nothing but empty talk.
translation_verse: Basa ko bre lar le be asheŋ ere to n foe a wɔ emɔrɔ fuloŋana to.

english_verse: They want to be teachers of the Law of Moses. But they don't know what they are talking about, even though they think they do.
translation_verse: Baa sha kebaala mbra na be beŋinipo nna, ama b maa pin bumo gbagba be mmalga na nɛ asɔ nɛ b kɔ a malga kenyiso na to.

english_verse: We know the Law is good, if it is used in the right way.
translation_verse: An nyi fanɛ mbra na la kusɔ lela nna nɛ esa baa bɛ kumo so nɛ kumo be ekpa so nna na.

english_verse: The Law was written for people who are sexual perverts or who live as homosexuals or are kidnappers or liars or won't tell the truth in court. It is for anything else that opposes the correct teaching
translation_verse: Mo alɛ naŋ bar mbra na nna ŋkpal kesakaleawuraana nɛ benyɛn nɛ bumo gbagba kɔ abar a di na nɛ bumo nɛ baa yuri basa a fin kasɔji na nɛ befɛpo nɛ basa nɛ b maa yɛ asheŋ a wora na nɛ bumo nɛ baa wora asheŋ nɛ a maa bɛ kashenteŋ be keŋini na so kuraa na kikɛ so.

english_verse: of the good news the glorious and wonderful God has given me. Being Thankful for God's Kindness
translation_verse: Le nɛ nɛfa be Ebɔrɛ na be baru lela nɛ kemaŋkura wɔ kumo to nɛ b ta m bɔɔ ma enɔ na bee ŋini. Pɔɔl ka bee chɔrɔ Ebɔrɛ be asheŋ

english_verse: I used to say terrible and insulting things about him, and I was cruel. But Christ had mercy on me because I didn't know what I was doing, and I had not yet put my faith in him.
translation_verse: Ama e wu ma kuwɔr, ŋkpal manɛ so, ŋ ka daa maŋ yirda na so e shin nɛ n wora kawulisheŋ na.

english_verse: Christ Jesus our Lord treated me with undeserved grace and has greatly blessed my life with faith and love just like his own.
translation_verse: An Nyɛnpe bugi kagbene n wu ma kuwɔr ga nseŋ sa ma yirda nɛ kasha ashi Kristo Yesu to.

english_verse: “Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners.” This saying is true, and it can be trusted. I was the worst sinner of all!
translation_verse: Le be kamalga ere la kashenteŋ nna, kumo alɛ maŋ kɔ emɔrɔ kikɛ fanɛ: Kristo Yesu ba durnya to nna nɛ e ba mɔlga basa ashi bumo be alubi to, ma alɛ be alubi e shi a chɔ ekama peya.

english_verse: But since I was worse than anyone else, God had mercy on me and let me be an example of the endless patience of Christ Jesus. He did this so that others would put their faith in Christ and have eternal life.
translation_verse: Ama Ebɔrɛ wu ma, alubiworapoana be ejuŋkparpo na kuwɔr nɛ e ŋini durnyaebi kananɛ Kristo Yesu be kanyiti ka shi nɛ b yirda mo nseŋ nya ŋkpa nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na.

english_verse: I pray that honor and glory will always be given to the only God, who lives forever and is the invisible and eternal King! Amen.
translation_verse: Bunyaŋ nɛ epaŋ be kedi e baa wɔ Ewurgboŋ nɛ e wɔ ŋkpa to saŋkikɛ na nɛ mo koŋwule nɛ e la kashenteŋ be Ebɔrɛ nɛ esa kikɛ maaŋ tiŋ n ta kenishi fuful n wu mo kikɛ na so mbaanaayɔ. Amɛn.

english_verse: Timothy, my son, the instructions I am giving you are based on what some prophets once said about you. If you follow these instructions, you will fight like a good soldier.
translation_verse: M pibi Timoti, mee ta asheŋ nɛ ŋ ŋini fo ere nna a bɔla mmalga nɛ anebiana na daŋ wu ŋ kaŋɛ fo asheŋ na so a bɔɔ fo enɔ. Baa ta amo a wɔtɔ fo kagbene to nsaa kɔ yirda nɛ nfɛra lela a ki fo akɔsɔ a kɔ yirda be kena lela na.

english_verse: You will be faithful and have a clear conscience. Some people have made a mess of their faith because they didn't listen to their consciences.
translation_verse: Basa ko bre kplaŋ le be akɔsɔ ere so nseŋ foe yirda be ekpa na so cheche.

english_verse: Two of them are Hymenaeus and Alexander. I have given these men over to the power of Satan, so they will learn not to oppose God.
translation_verse: Loŋ be basa na be beko e la Haimɛneeyes nɛ Alɛkzaanda nɛ n ta m bɔɔ Setani enɔ nɛ b pin fanɛ k daga b ka lar kebaamalga a gbiti Ebɔrɛ to.

english_verse: First of all, I ask you to pray for everyone. Ask God to help and bless them all, and tell God how thankful you are for each of them.
translation_verse: To, kusɔ nɛ mee sha kejuŋkpar ŋ kaŋɛ e la fanɛ a daga fanɛ bebɛsopo e baa kule Ebɔrɛ a sa basa kikɛ. B baa kaŋɛ Ebɔrɛ basa be asheŋ tirso be asheŋ nsaa kule mo asɔ a sa bumo nseŋ naa chɔrɔ mo a sa bumo a ti so.

english_verse: Pray for kings and others in power, so we may live quiet and peaceful lives as we worship and honor God.
translation_verse: B baa wora asheŋ ere a sa basa kikɛ, fɔnfɔŋ bewura nɛ basa nɛ b wɔ kenimu be yiri kikɛ to na. Loŋ e naaŋ shin nɛ an baa wɔ abɔrɛsheŋ be kebaawɔtɔ to boeŋ nɛ bunyaŋ nsaa kɔ kagbenewushi.

english_verse: This kind of prayer is good, and it pleases God our Savior.
translation_verse: Le be asɔ la asɔ lela nna

english_verse: God wants everyone to be saved and to know the whole truth, which is,
translation_verse: nsaa par Ebɔrɛ nɛ e mɔlga anyi nsaa sha fanɛ basa kikɛ e nya kumɔlga nseŋ pin kashenteŋ be keŋini na.

english_verse: There is only one God, and Christ Jesus is the only one who can bring us to God. Jesus was truly human, and he gave himself to rescue all of us.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ koŋwule nɛ enyiŋgbasa nɛ Ebɔrɛ be nferinto be ematapo koŋwule nɛ baa tre Kristo Yesu Nyiŋgbasa na nawule e wɔtɔ.

english_verse: This is why God chose me to be a preacher and an apostle of the good news. I am telling the truth. I am not lying. God sent me to teach the Gentiles about faith and truth.
translation_verse: Amoso nɛ Ebɔrɛ lara ma fanɛ m baa la eshuŋipo nɛ nnyamase be eŋinipo a bɔ yirda nɛ kashenteŋ be kubɔya na. M maa fule nna, kashenteŋ nɛ mee ji.

english_verse: I want everyone everywhere to lift innocent hands toward heaven and pray, without being angry or arguing with each other.
translation_verse: Mee sha nna fanɛ kaplɛkama benyɛn nɛ b maa ta bumo be enɔana a shuŋ alubi e baa maŋ amo so kabɔrɛkule to nsaa maa keta kanya agbo ŋko a kini keyirda fanɛ Ebɔrɛ bee nu kabɔrɛkule.

english_verse: I would like for women to wear modest and sensible clothes. They should not have fancy hairdos, or wear expensive clothes, or put on jewelry made of gold or pearls.
translation_verse: Mee sha nna fanɛ beche malɛ e baa nyi asheŋ nsaa buu asɔ nɛ a bee kukwe a yulge bumo so nɛnɛ. B sa maa kre bumo be amu kenyishaso ŋko a buu yawu kpakpaso be asɔbuuso ŋko a wɔtɔ shuwa nɛ yawu kpakpaso be abitasɔ nsaa wu bumo be amu kamoowuso.

english_verse: Women who claim to love God should do helpful things for others,
translation_verse: Asɔ nɛ a daga b ka wora nɛ basa e wu e la alelasheŋ nɛ a daga beche nɛ b yɛ baa bunyaŋ Ebɔrɛ.

english_verse: and they should learn by being quiet and paying attention.
translation_verse: A daga fanɛ beche e baa yɔɔ bumo be amu a lo to boeŋ a nu keŋini.

english_verse: They should be silent and not be allowed to teach or to tell men what to do.
translation_verse: Ma alɛ maŋ sa ekpa fanɛ eche kama e baa ŋini benyɛn abɔrɛsheŋ ŋko e baa kɔ eleŋ benyɛn so. Ama a daga fanɛ e baa lo mbe kɔnɔ boeŋ.

english_verse: After all, Adam was created before Eve,
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, Adam nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ pɔr pɔɛŋ nseŋ pɔr Hawa.

english_verse: and the man Adam wasn't the one who was fooled. It was the woman Eve who was completely fooled and sinned.
translation_verse: Mannɛ Adam malɛ nɛ Setani daŋ juŋkpar n fule, eche na nɛ Setani daŋ fule nɛ e tɔr alubi to.

english_verse: But women will be saved by having children, if they stay faithful, loving, holy, and modest.
translation_verse: Ama nɛ eche baa wɔtɔ a kurge nsaa yirda Ebɔrɛ nseŋ naa sha basa a kɔ kanyiasheŋ a wɔ kebaawɔtɔ cheembi to nsaa du boeŋ a wɔtɔ, e beeŋ nya kumɔlga.

english_verse: It is true that anyone who desires to be a church official wants to be something worthwhile.
translation_verse: Le be kamalga ere maŋ kɔ emɔrɔ fanɛ esa kama nɛ e yili kumo mbe kagbene to fanɛ e beeŋ ki asɔri to be ejuŋkparpo lara ashuŋ kikɛ to be kelela.

english_verse: They must not be heavy drinkers or troublemakers. Instead, they must be kind and gentle and not love money.
translation_verse: E sa maa nuu nsa ga ŋko a la esa brembreŋ, ama a daga fanɛ e baa du boeŋ nsaa maa la elushapo ŋko a ta mbe kagbene a wɔtɔ amansherbi to.

english_verse: Church officials must be in control of their own families, and they must see that their children are obedient and always respectful.
translation_verse: Ama a daga fanɛ e baa tiŋ a keni mbe eche nɛ mbia so nsaa tiŋ a shin nɛ mbe mbia e baa nu a sa mo bunyanso.

english_verse: If they don't know how to control their own families, how can they look after God's people?
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, esa nɛ e maŋ nyi kananɛ e beeŋ keni mo gbagba be kowu to ebi so, nuso nɛ e beeŋ wora ŋ keni Ebɔrɛ be asɔri to ebi so?

english_verse: They must not be new followers of the Lord. If they are, they might become proud and be doomed along with the devil.
translation_verse: Esa nɛ e la asɔri to be ejuŋkparpo na daga e ka chɛr kebɛso na to nna, nɛ mannɛ aloŋ, e beeŋ luri kamoowu to nɛ Ebɔrɛ e ji mo kumo be demu fanɛ kananɛ Setani daŋ wora nɛ Ebɔrɛ gberge mo kusoe na.

english_verse: Finally, they must be well-respected by people who are not followers. Then they won't be trapped and disgraced by the devil. Church Officers
translation_verse: A daga fanɛ loŋ be enimu e baa kɔ ketre basa pɔtɛ nɛ b maŋ wɔ asɔri to na to, nɛ mannɛ aloŋ, e beeŋ nya ketre lubi nseŋ tɔr Setani be kejigbelɛ to n wora alubi. Asɔri to be bechɛtopo be asheŋ

english_verse: Church officers should be serious. They must not be liars, heavy drinkers, or greedy for money.
translation_verse: A daga fanɛ asɔri to be bechɛtopo gba e baa kɔ da lela nsaa maa la besheŋjipo ŋko nsanuupoana ŋko a kɔ kejimuni.

english_verse: And they must have a clear conscience and hold firmly to what God has shown us about our faith.
translation_verse: A daga fanɛ b baa kɔ kashenteŋ be wulo nɛ Ebɔrɛ bugi to ŋ ŋini na to kpakpa nɛ nfɛra lela.

english_verse: They must first prove themselves. Then if no one has anything against them, they can serve as officers.
translation_verse: Pɔɛŋ nɛ b ki bechɛtopo asɔri to, a daga basa ka keni bumo be kebaawɔtɔana to nɛnɛ ŋ keni ŋko loŋ be kenimu daga bumo a.

english_verse: Women must also be serious. They must not gossip or be heavy drinkers, and they must be faithful in everything they do.
translation_verse: Bumo be beche gba e baa kɔ da lela nsaa maa ji bumo braana be asheŋ. A daga fanɛ b baa fɛ nfɛra dede a la beshenteŋjipo.

english_verse: Church officers must be faithful in marriage. They must be in full control of their children and everyone else in their home.
translation_verse: A daga fanɛ asɔri to be bechɛtopo e baa la beche koko wuraana nsaa tiŋ a shin nɛ bumo be beche nɛ mbia e baa nu a sa bumo nɛnɛ.

english_verse: Those who serve well as officers will earn a good reputation and will be highly respected for their faith in Christ Jesus. The Mystery of Our Religion
translation_verse: Nɛ bechɛtopo baa shuŋ bumo be ashuŋ nɛnɛ, basa bee sa bumo bunyaŋ nna nɛ b baa tiŋ a kaŋɛ basa kenyɛnso fanɛ b yirda Kristo Yesu kashenteŋ. Wulogboŋ na be asheŋ

english_verse: I hope to visit you soon. But I am writing these instructions,
translation_verse: K maaŋ naŋ chɛr ko nɛ m ba wu fo, ama mee sibɛ asɔ ere nna a sa fo,

english_verse: so if I am delayed, you will know how everyone who belongs to God's family ought to behave. After all, the church of the living God is the strong foundation of truth.
translation_verse: saŋɛ na so ŋ kaŋ maŋ naŋ tiŋ m ba manaŋ, kawɔl ere beeŋ ŋini fo kebaawɔtɔ nɛ k daga fanɛ anyi nɛ an la Ebɔrɛ be kanaŋ to ebi nɛ baa tre ŋkpa to be Ebɔrɛ be asɔri na ka wora. Asɔri na e kɔ kashenteŋ be keŋini na to nsaa keni kumo so.

english_verse: Here is the great mystery of our religion: Christ came as a human. The Spirit proved that he pleased God, and he was seen by angels. Christ was preached to the nations. People in this world put their faith in him, and he was taken up to glory.
translation_verse: Kashenteŋto, esa kikɛ maaŋ tiŋ ŋ kaŋɛ anyi be keŋini ere nɛ Ebɔrɛ lara ŋ ŋini ere maŋ la keŋinigboŋ, ŋkpal manɛ so, k bee ŋini esa nɛ e ta nyiŋgbasa be eyur nna n shi ebɔrɛso m ba durnya to be asheŋ. Mo nɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na daŋ kaŋɛ anyi fanɛ e maŋ kɔ kulubi na, emalaika daŋ wu mo nɛ basa bɔ mbe kubɔya nnyamase to nɛ durnya to be basa yirda mo. Mo koŋwule na nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ shin nɛ e luri to n yɔ kemaŋkura be ŋkpa na to.

english_verse: God's Spirit clearly says that in the last days many people will turn from their faith. They will be fooled by evil spirits and by teachings that come from demons.
translation_verse: Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na baŋ kaŋɛ geeŋ fanɛ lalaloge be nchɛ ere to basa ko beeŋ lar kashenteŋ be keŋini ere to nsaa nu a sa efɛ be mbuibi lubi a wɔtɔ a koya amo be keŋini.

english_verse: They will also be fooled by the false claims of liars whose consciences have lost all feeling. These liars
translation_verse: Le be keŋini ere shi kebirkɔnshi be befɛpo nɛ nfɛra lubi deŋ bumo na kutɔ nna.

english_verse: What God has said and your prayer will make it fit to eat. Paul's Advice to Timothy
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ be kamalga na nɛ kabɔrɛkule na nɛfa kumo nɛ k ki kusɔ lela Ebɔrɛ be anishito. Yesu Kristo be kenya be asheŋ

english_verse: If you teach these things to other followers, you will be a good servant of Christ Jesus. You will show you have grown up on the teachings about our faith and on the good instructions you have obeyed.
translation_verse: Nɛ fo ŋini bekurgepoana na asheŋ ere, feeŋ baa la Kristo Yesu be kenya lela a kɔ yirda be mmalga nɛ keŋini lela nɛ fo bɛ so na be eleŋ.

english_verse: Don't have anything to do with worthless, senseless stories. Work hard to be truly religious.
translation_verse: Baa gelge chilchil be mmalga nɛ edaŋkare be mmalga nɛ a maa bunyaŋ Ebɔrɛ nseŋ ŋini fo kumu abɔrɛsheŋ be kebaawɔtɔ.

english_verse: We have put our hope in the living God, who is the Savior of everyone, but especially of those who have faith. This is why we work and struggle so hard.
translation_verse: Anyee shuŋ ga a maŋ kɔ kachena ŋkpal an ka ta anyi be yirda n wɔtɔ Ebɔrɛ nɛ e kɔ ŋkpa nsaa la basa kikɛ be Emɔlgapo, fɔnfɔŋ bumo nɛ b yirda mo na to so.

english_verse: Teach these things and tell everyone to do what you say.
translation_verse: Ŋini basa asɔ ere nseŋ kaŋɛ bumo kenishipereso fanɛ b baa bɛ amo so.

english_verse: Don't let anyone make fun of you, just because you are young. Set an example for other followers by what you say and do, as well as by your love, faith, and purity.
translation_verse: Sa maŋ shin nɛ esa kama e fɛl fo ŋkpal fo ka la kabrantiɛbia so, ama shin nɛ beyirdapo na e keni fo kebaawɔtɔ to ŋ koya asɔ ashi fo mmalga nɛ fo da to nɛ fo kasha nɛ fo yirda nɛ kananɛ fo maŋ kɔ kusɔ jigaya be nfɛra to.

english_verse: Until I arrive, be sure to keep on reading the Scriptures in worship, and don't stop preaching and teaching.
translation_verse: Pɔɛŋ nɛ m ba, baa kraŋ abɔrɛsibɛ na a sa asɔri to ebi a leŋ bumo to nsaa ŋini bumo abɔrɛsheŋ na.

english_verse: Use the gift you were given when the prophets spoke and the group of church leaders blessed you by placing their hands on you.
translation_verse: Loŋ na fo maaŋ gal kusɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ ta m bɔɔ fo enɔ fanɛ fo wora saŋɛ nɛ basa wu fo asheŋ ŋ kaŋɛ nɛ benimu daŋ ta enɔana n deŋi fo so ŋ kule Ebɔrɛ n sa fo na n lɛ.

english_verse: Remember these things and think about them, so everyone can see how well you are doing.
translation_verse: Baa wora asɔ ere nseŋ ta fo kagbene kikɛ n wɔtɔ amo to nɛ basa kikɛ e wu kananɛ fo abɔrɛsheŋ be kenyi bee wora keshi a ti so.

english_verse: Be careful about the way you live and about what you teach. Keep on doing this, and you will save not only yourself, but the people who hear you.
translation_verse: Baa de so a keni fo kumu nɛ fo abɔrɛsheŋ be keŋini na so nɛnɛ. Baa wora asɔ ere, ŋkpal manɛ so, loŋ e naaŋ mɔlga fo nɛ bumo nɛ baa nu fo mmalga na.

english_verse: Don't correct an older man. Encourage him, as you would your own father. Treat younger men as you would your own brother,
translation_verse: Sa maŋ kaa ponte enyɛnnimu so, ama baa malga mo kutɔ a leŋ mo to fanɛ kananɛ feeŋ wora fo tuto kurgeso. Baa leŋ mbrantiɛbia to fanɛ kananɛ feeŋ wora fo sipoana gbagba.

english_verse: and treat older women as you would your own mother. Show the same respect to younger women that you would to your sister.
translation_verse: Baa leŋ bechenimu to fanɛ kananɛ feeŋ wora fo nio kurgeso. Baa leŋ besuŋgurbi to fanɛ kananɛ feeŋ wora fo sipocheana gbagba nsaa maa kɔ kusɔ jigaya be nfɛra.

english_verse: Take care of any widow who is really in need.
translation_verse: Baa bunyaŋ bekulpoche nɛ b maŋ kɔ bechɛtopo na.

english_verse: But if a widow has children or grandchildren, they should learn to serve God by taking care of her, as she once took care of them. This is what God wants them to do.
translation_verse: Ama ekulpoche kama nɛ e kɔ mbia ŋko benanabi, a daga fanɛ mbe mbia na nɛ mo nanabiana na ka pin fanɛ bumo e daga b ka nu n sa Ebɔrɛ ŋ keni bumo gbagba be kanaŋ to be esa so. Loŋ na kelela nɛ baa wora a tal bumo nioana nɛ bumo tutoana nɛ bumo nanaana na to na, kumo alɛ be loŋ e naa par Ebɔrɛ.

english_verse: A widow who is really in need is one who doesn't have any relatives. She has faith in God, and she keeps praying to him night and day, asking for his help.
translation_verse: Ekulpoche gbagba nɛ e maŋ kɔ esa kikɛ nɛ e bee keni mo so be tama wɔ Ebɔrɛ so nna fanɛ e baa chɛ mo to. Mo alɛ baa wɔtɔ nna a kule Ebɔrɛ kapa nɛ kanyɛ fanɛ Ebɔrɛ e chɛ mo to.

english_verse: A widow who thinks only about having a good time is already dead, even though she is still alive.
translation_verse: Ama ekulpoche nɛ e ta mbe nfɛra n wɔtɔ ebel be keji to wu nna nsaa wɔ basa to na.

english_verse: People who don't take care of their relatives, and especially their own families, have given up their faith. They are worse than someone who doesn't have faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Ama eche kama nɛ e maa keni mo kurgepoana so, fɔnfɔŋ basa nɛ b mata mo na, yige kebaakɔ anyi be yirda na to nna na. Esa nɛ e maŋ yirda Yesu Kristo na malɛ gba bɔ loŋ be esa.

english_verse: For a widow to be put on the list of widows, she must be at least
translation_verse: Ekulpoche nɛ e chɔ nfɛ adeshe, mo alɛ nseŋ naa la eche nɛ e kil kela koŋwule ŋ ku so, nɛ esa nɛ ekama nyi e ka la alelashenworapo

english_verse: She must also be well-known for doing all sorts of good things, such as raising children, giving food to strangers, welcoming God's people into her home, helping people in need, and always making herself useful.
translation_verse: nɛ emo nɛ e tiŋ ŋ keni mbe mbia so nɛnɛ nɛ b daŋ, nɛ emo nɛ e la esa, nɛ emo nɛ e bar mbe kumu kaseto n sa Ebɔrɛ be bebɛsopo ŋko n chɛ awurfoŋ ŋko tɔrɔ be mbia to nseŋ wora kelela be yiri kikɛ, ber mo n wɔtɔ bekulpoche nɛ b daga kechɛto na to.

english_verse: Don't put young widows on the list. They may later have a strong desire to get married. Then they will turn away from Christ
translation_verse: Sa maŋ kaŋ ber bekulpoche nɛ b maŋ la beche kpar n wɔtɔ bumo nɛ b daga kechɛto na to, ŋkpal manɛ so, nɛ benyɛn be kayɛlga baŋ ba pɛ bumo nɛ b naa sha kekil, baa lar Yesu Kristo be kebɛso na to nna,

english_verse: Besides, they will become lazy and get into the habit of going from house to house. Next, they will start gossiping and become busybodies, talking about things that are none of their business.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman b wɔtɔ nna a jija bumo be saŋɛ a na basa pe, kumo alɛ be buushi nɛ b fara a ji asheŋ nsaa luri basa be asheŋ to a wɔtɔ a malga mmalga nɛ a maŋ nya bumo.

english_verse: I would prefer that young widows get married, have children, and look after their families. Then the enemy won't have any reason to say insulting things about us.
translation_verse: Amoso, ma ere kutɔ, a daga fanɛ bekulpoche nɛ b maŋ la beche kpar ka kil ŋ kurge mbia nseŋ keni bumo be nwu so nsaa maa wora asheŋ kama nɛ a beeŋ shin nɛ edompo kama e nya ekpa n wu bumo kulubi.

english_verse: Look what's already happened to some of the young widows! They have turned away to follow Satan.
translation_verse: Mee malga asheŋ ere nna, ŋkpal manɛ so, bekulpoche ko nɛ b maŋ la beche kpar teŋ foe kashenteŋ be ekpa na so nsaa bɛ Setani so.

english_verse: If a woman who is a follower has any widows in her family, she should help them. This will keep the church from having that burden, and then the church can help widows who are really in need. Church Leaders
translation_verse: A daga fanɛ ebɛsopo kama nɛ e kɔ bekulpoche mbe kanaŋ to ka bee keni bumo so nsaa maŋ baŋ yige bumo n sa asɔri to ebi. Nɛ le be bekulpoche bee nya kechɛto bumo kurgepoana kutɔ, asɔri na to ebi beeŋ tiŋ ŋ keni bekulpoche gbagba so. Fo nɛ benimu be asheŋ

english_verse: Church leaders who do their job well deserve to be paid twice as much, especially if they work hard at preaching and teaching.
translation_verse: Asɔri to be benimu nɛ baa juŋkpar bumo be basa nɛnɛ daga b ka bunyaŋ bumo ga, fɔnfɔŋ bumo nɛ baa bɔ kubɔya na nɛ bumo nɛ baa ŋini abɔrɛsibɛ na.

english_verse: It is just as the Scriptures say, “Don't muzzle an ox when you are using it to grind grain.” You also know the saying, “Workers are worth their pay.”
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ: “A maŋ daga esa ka kre kena nɛ e bee shuŋ ajibi akpa be kɔnɔ,” nɛ “A daga eshumpo ka nya mbe kakɔka.”

english_verse: Don't listen to any charge against a church leader, unless at least two or three people bring the same charges.
translation_verse: Esa koŋwule baŋ ba kaŋɛ fo enimu ko be kulubi be asheŋ, sa maŋ nu n sa mo epul na to she eshɛdajipoana wora benyɔ ŋko besa nna.

english_verse: But if any of the leaders should keep on sinning, they must be corrected in front of the whole group, as a warning to everyone else.
translation_verse: Benimu nɛ b wɔ alubi to na, fiɛ bumo so asɔri to ebi na kikɛ be anishito nɛ kufu e pɛ bumo nɛ b ka na.

english_verse: In the presence of God and Christ Jesus and their chosen angels, I order you to follow my instructions! Be fair with everyone, and don't have any favorites.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ nɛ Kristo Yesu nɛ emalaika nɛ b lara n yili na be anishito nɛ n yil a kaŋɛ fanɛ fo nu n sa le be keŋiniana ere nsaa maŋ kpal fo ka nyi esa ko be kebaawɔtɔ so a ji mo ŋkpɛatoso be demu.

english_verse: Don't be too quick to accept people into the service of the Lord by placing your hands on them. Don't sin because others do, but stay close to God.
translation_verse: Sa maa nya manaŋ a ta fo enɔ a deŋi esa kikɛ so a ta mo a bɔɔ Ebɔrɛ enɔ kabɔrɛkule to. Fo alɛ e sa maŋ kaŋ luri basa pɔtɛ be alubi to ŋko kusɔ jigaya be kebaawɔtɔ to.

english_verse: Stop drinking only water. Take a little wine to help your stomach trouble and the other illnesses you often have.
translation_verse: Sa maŋ naa nuu nchu nawule, baa nuu waindibi be nsa gba gbrɛgbrɛ nɛ a baa chɛ fo epun to be alɔ.

english_verse: Some people get caught in their sins almost at once, even before the time of judgment. But other people's sins don't show up until later.
translation_verse: Basa ko be alubi baŋ fuli nna geeŋ a juŋkpar bumo a yɔ kasogberge to. Beko malɛ be alubi bee ŋana nna loŋ pɔɛŋ n ya lar efuli kacha ko.

english_verse: It is the same with good deeds. Some are easily seen, but none of them can be hidden.
translation_verse: Loŋ koŋwule na nɛ basa bee wu alelasheŋ gba ka fuli a dese geeŋ, hale amo nɛ a ŋana naniere gba beeŋ lar efuli so kacha ko.

english_verse: If you are a slave, you should respect and honor your owner. This will keep people from saying bad things about God and about our teaching.
translation_verse: A daga fanɛ anya kikɛ e baa sa bumo nyɛnpeana bunyaŋ kikɛ nɛ k daga nɛ basa pɔtɛ e sa maŋ nya ekpa m malga kulubi kikɛ ŋ gbiti Ebɔrɛ be ketre ŋko anyi be keŋini na.

english_verse: If any of you slaves have owners who are followers, you should show them respect. After all, they are also followers of Christ, and he loves them. So you should serve and help them the best you can. False Teaching and True Wealth These are the things you must teach and tell the people to do.
translation_verse: Anya nɛ bumo nyɛnpeana la beyirdapo e sa maŋ kpal b ka la bumo to ebi so a fɛl bumo. Bumo e daga fanɛ b bugi kagbene n shuŋ gba nɛnɛ, ŋkpal manɛ so, beyirdapo nɛ beshapo e naa ji bumo be kushuŋ be tɔnɔ. Ŋini basa asheŋ ere kikɛ nseŋ leŋ bumo to nɛ b bɛ amo so. Befɛpo nɛ kashenteŋ be dama be asheŋ

english_verse: Those people who disagree are proud of themselves, but they don't really know a thing. Their minds are sick, and they like to argue over words. They cause jealousy, disagreements, unkind words, evil suspicions,
translation_verse: Loŋ be esa bee kaa ta mbe kasha kikɛ nna a wɔtɔ emɔrɔ be keji to nsaa kpal mmalga so a bile. Asheŋ ere kikɛ malɛ e naa bar yurkishi nɛ kolu nɛ basa be kebaatege abar nɛ kebirkɔnshi be kebaawora abar basa to

english_verse: and nasty quarrels. They have wicked minds and have missed out on the truth. These people think religion is supposed to make you rich.
translation_verse: nɛ basa be kebaaji abar emɔrɔ fanɛ bumo nɛ b maŋ kɔ nfɛra a maŋ naa nyi kashenteŋ be ekpa na ŋkpal b ka bee tama fanɛ abɔrɛsheŋ to nɛ baaŋ bɔla n nya amansherbi so.

english_verse: And religion does make your life rich, by making you content with what you have.
translation_verse: Ama esa nɛ e wɔ abɔrɛsheŋ na be kebaawɔtɔ to nsaa shin nɛ asɔ nɛ e kɔ bee bɔlɔ mbe kenishi a kukwe mo na nawule e la damawura.

english_verse: We didn't bring anything into this world, and we won't take anything with us when we leave.
translation_verse: An ka bee ba durnya ere to an maŋ bar shɛŋ, anyi alɛ naa lar kumo to, anyi maaŋ tiŋ n ta shɛŋ n lar.

english_verse: So we should be satisfied just to have food and clothes.
translation_verse: Amoso, nɛ an baa kɔ ajibi nɛ asɔbuuso, a kukwe anyi.

english_verse: People who want to be rich fall into all sorts of temptations and traps. They are caught by foolish and harmful desires that drag them down and destroy them.
translation_verse: Ama basa nɛ baa sha kedii dama bee luri kechɔŋkeni to nna n tɔr kawulisheŋ nɛ ayɛlgasɔ damta be kejigbelɛ to nɛ a doro bumo m mur bumo.

english_verse: The love of money causes all kinds of trouble. Some people want money so much they have given up their faith and caused themselves a lot of pain. Fighting a Good Fight for the Faith
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, amansherbi be kasha ga to nɛ kulubi be yiri kikɛ bee shi. Ŋkpal amansherbi be kasha ga so basa ko foe yirda be ekpa na so n luri kagbenejija damta to. Asɔ nɛ Pɔɔl ta m bɔɔ Timoti enɔ be asheŋ

english_verse: Timothy, you belong to God, so keep away from all these evil things. Try your best to please God and to be like him. Be faithful, loving, dependable, and gentle.
translation_verse: Ama fo ere ka la Ebɔrɛ be esa ere, baa gelge le be asɔ ere kikɛ nsaa kɔ a fin alelasheŋ nɛ abɔrɛsheŋ be kebaawɔtɔ nɛ yirda nɛ kasha nɛ awurfoŋ to be kanyiti nsaa du boeŋ.

english_verse: Fight a good fight for the faith and claim eternal life. God offered it to you when you clearly told about your faith, while so many people listened.
translation_verse: Pere kenishi a kɔ yirda to be kolu lela na. Baa kɔ ŋkpa nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar nɛ b tre fo n wɔtɔ kumo to saŋɛ nɛ fo yili basa damta to n ji fo shɛda na to.

english_verse: Now I ask you to make a promise. Make it in the presence of God, who gives life to all, and in the presence of Christ Jesus, who openly told Pontius Pilate about his faith.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ nɛ e bee sa kusɔ kikɛ ŋkpa nɛ Yesu Kristo nɛ e yili Gomena Pɔnshes Pailat be anishito n ji shɛda lela na be anishito nɛ n yil a kaŋɛ fo fanɛ fo baa nu a sa asɔ nɛ ŋ ŋini fo na kikɛ

english_verse: Promise to obey completely and fully all that you have been told until our Lord Jesus Christ returns.
translation_verse: nsaa maŋ shin nɛ kulubi be yiri kikɛ e gbiti amo n chɛrga amo hale nɛ an Nyɛnpe Yesu Kristo e naaŋ ya lar m ba.

english_verse: The glorious God is the only Ruler, the King of kings and Lord of lords. At the time that God has already decided, he will send Jesus Christ back again.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ, bewura to be Ewura nɛ benyɛnpe to be Enyɛnpe nɛ durnya kikɛ be Ekenipo koŋwule nɛ e kɔ nɛfa na malɛ e naaŋ shin nɛ Yesu Kristo be kenamba na e fo jemanɛ na gbagba.

english_verse: Only God lives forever! And he lives in light that no one can come near. No human has ever seen God or ever can see him. God will be honored, and his power will last forever. Amen.
translation_verse: Mo nawule kpeŋ e maa wu kikɛ nsaa wɔ kefulto parrbi nɛ esa kikɛ maaŋ tiŋ ŋ keni kumo kikɛ na to. Esa kama malɛ maŋ naŋ wu mo ŋ ku so, ekama malɛ maaŋ tiŋ n wu mo kikɛ. Bunyaŋ nɛ kuwurji nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar e baa wɔ mo so. Amɛn. Damawura be asheŋ

english_verse: Instruct them to do as many good deeds as they can and to help everyone. Remind the rich to be generous and share what they have.
translation_verse: Ŋini bumo fanɛ b baa wora kelela nsaa la basa a bugi ŋgbene a sa basa bumo be asɔ na be ako.

english_verse: This will lay a solid foundation for the future, so they will know what true life is like.
translation_verse: Le be asheŋ ere e naaŋ shin nɛ b nya asɔ nɛ baaŋ fute n yige so kachako so. Nɛ baa wora loŋ, baaŋ nya ŋkpa gbagba na.

english_verse: Timothy, guard what God has placed in your care! Don't pay any attention to godless and stupid talk that sounds smart but really isn't.
translation_verse: Timoti, baa de kusɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ ta m bɔɔ fo enɔ na so nɛnɛ nsaa gelge chilchil be emɔrɔ be mmalga nɛ a maa par Ebɔrɛ nɛ efɛ be keŋini nɛ baa tre kashennyi be keŋini na.

english_verse: Some people have even lost their faith by believing this talk. I pray that the Lord will be kind to all of you!
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, basa ko ka kaŋɛ fanɛ b kɔ le be kashennyi na maŋ naa wɔ yirda na to. Ebɔrɛ e sa menyi kikɛ mbe kuwɔr be kakɛ na.

english_verse: From Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus. God himself chose me to be an apostle, and he gave me the promised life that Jesus Christ makes possible.
translation_verse: Kawɔl ere shi ma Pɔɔl nɛ n la Kristo Yesu be eshuŋipo ŋkpal Ebɔrɛ be keparso nɛ ŋkpal kɔnɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ nase ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ e beeŋ sa basa nɛ b yirda Kristo Yesu ŋkpa na so kutɔ nna

english_verse: Timothy, you are like a dear child to me. I pray that God our Father and our Lord Christ Jesus will be kind and merciful to you and will bless you with peace! Do Not Be Ashamed of the Lord
translation_verse: a yɔ fo, m pibi shaso Timoti kutɔ. Ebɔrɛ Etuto nɛ Kristo Yesu an Nyɛnpe na e sa fo kuwɔr be kakɛ nɛ kuwɔr nɛ kagbenewushi. Kabɔrɛchɔrɔ nɛ keleŋ n wɔtɔ yirda na to be asheŋ

english_verse: Night and day I mention you in my prayers. I am always grateful for you, as I pray to the God my ancestors and I have served with a clear conscience.
translation_verse: Mee chɔrɔ Ebɔrɛ nɛ ŋ kɔ nfɛra lela a shuŋ fanɛ kananɛ n nananyɛnana shuŋ mo na. Saŋkama, kapa nɛ kanyɛ nɛ n nyiŋi fo asheŋ, mee di mo epaŋ nna.

english_verse: I remember how you cried, and I want to see you, because this would make me truly happy.
translation_verse: M baŋ nyiŋi fo anishichubi na be asheŋ, m baa sha kewu fo nna nɛ ma kagbene e fuli ma.

english_verse: I also remember the genuine faith of your mother Eunice. Your grandmother Lois had the same sort of faith, and I am sure you have it as well.
translation_verse: Mee kaa nyiŋi kagbene koŋwuleso be yirda nɛ fo kɔ. Yirda koŋwule nɛ fo nanache Lowis nɛ fo nio Yunis daa kɔ na gbagba chap nɛ m baa nyi fanɛ fo alɛ gba kɔ na.

english_verse: So I ask you to make full use of the gift God gave you when I placed my hands on you. Use it well.
translation_verse: Amoso nɛ mee nyiŋi fo fanɛ fo shin nɛ kakɛ nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ ta n wɔtɔ fo to saŋɛ nɛ n daŋ ta ma enɔana n deŋi fo so kabɔrɛkule to na e baa wora keshi a nyɛrga a ti so fanɛ edɛ na.

english_verse: God's Spirit doesn't make cowards out of us. The Spirit gives us power, love, and self-control.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, Kiyoyu nɛ Ebɔrɛ sa anyi na maŋ la kufu peya nna, k la eleŋ nɛ kasha nɛ kamootiŋ be kiyoyu nna.

english_verse: Don't be ashamed to speak for our Lord. And don't be ashamed of me, just because I am in jail for serving him. Use the power that comes from God and join with me in suffering for telling the good news.
translation_verse: Amoso, sa maŋ shin nɛ keji an Nyɛnpe na be shɛda be asheŋ ŋko ma nɛ n wɔ kabuti to ŋkpal mo so ere be asheŋ e baa wora fo anishinyɔr kikɛ. Ama fo alɛ gba e baa bɔla eleŋ nɛ Ebɔrɛ sa fo na so a shuli a ji awurfoŋ ŋkpal baru lela na so.

english_verse: God saved us and chose us to be his holy people. We did nothing to deserve this, but God planned it because he is so kind. Even before time began God planned for Christ Jesus to show kindness to us.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ mɔlga anyi nna nseŋ tre anyi fanɛ an ba ki mbe basa ŋkpal kusɔ nɛ mo gbagba yili nɛ mbe kuwɔr be kakɛ so, mannɛ kusɔ nɛ an wora so, Kristo Yesu so nɛ e bɔla n wu anyi kuwɔr pɔɛŋ nɛ kusɔ kikɛ fara dra dra na kikɛ.

english_verse: Now Christ Jesus has come to offer us God's gift of undeserved grace. Christ our Savior defeated death and brought us the good news. It shines like a light and offers life that never ends.
translation_verse: Ama naniere le be kesheŋ ere lar efuli ŋkpal anyi be Emɔlgapo Kristo Yesu be keba na so. Mo e bar luwu be eleŋ kikɛ ekar nseŋ bɔla baru lela na so ŋ ŋini anyi ŋkpa nɛ k maa loge na.

english_verse: My work is to be a preacher, an apostle, and a teacher.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ lara ma nna fanɛ m baa la baru lela na be emalgapo nɛ eshuŋipo nɛ eŋinipo.

english_verse: This is why I am suffering now. But I am not ashamed! I know the one I have faith in, and I am sure he can guard until the last day what he has trusted me with.
translation_verse: Kumo alɛ so nɛ mee ji le be awurfoŋ ere na. Ama kumo alɛ maŋ kɔ ma anishinyɔr, ŋkpal manɛ so, n nyi esa nɛ n yirda, ma alɛ maa ji kumo emɔrɔ fanɛ e beeŋ tiŋ ŋ keni kusɔ kama nɛ e ta m bɔɔ ma enɔ so hale n ya fo kachɛ na.

english_verse: Now follow the example of the correct teaching I gave you, and let the faith and love of Christ Jesus be your model.
translation_verse: Baa kɔ kashenteŋ be mmalga nɛ ŋ ŋini fo na to kpakpa a bɛ amo so nɛ yirda nɛ kasha nɛ a wɔ Kristo Yesu to na.

english_verse: You have been trusted with a wonderful treasure. Guard it with the help of the Holy Spirit, who lives within us.
translation_verse: Baa kɔ asheŋ lela nɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ nɛ e wɔ anyi to na ta m bɔɔ fo enɔ na to kpakpa.

english_verse: You know that everyone in Asia has turned against me, especially Phygelus and Hermogenes.
translation_verse: Fo nyi fanɛ Eeshia be efuli so ebi kikɛ hale Figɛles nɛ Hɛmɔjines gba yige ma n to ŋko?

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will be kind to the family of Onesiphorus. He often cheered me up and wasn't ashamed of me when I was put in jail.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe e baa wu Onɛsifɔres be kowu to ebi kuwɔr, ŋkpal manɛ so, e leŋ ma to ale damta. E daa maŋ wora ma kabuti ere be anishinyɔr kikɛ,

english_verse: Then after he arrived in Rome, he searched everywhere until he found me.
translation_verse: mo alɛ ka baŋ ba Rom nɛ e kɔ n fin ma loŋ hale n ya wu ma.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord Jesus will ask God to show mercy to Onesiphorus on the day of judgment. You know how much he helped me in Ephesus.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe e shin nɛ e nya kuwɔr ashi mo kutɔ kachɛ na. Fo alɛ gba nyi asɔ damta nɛ e wora n sa ma ashi Ɛfeses.

english_verse: Timothy, my child, you must let Christ Jesus make you strong by his gift of undeserved grace.
translation_verse: Amoso, fo ere m pibi, baa wɔ eleŋ nɛ k bee shi Yesu Kristo kutɔ a ba ŋkpal mbe kuwɔr be kakɛ na so to

english_verse: You have often heard me teach. Now I want you to tell these same things to followers who can be trusted to tell others.
translation_verse: nseŋ ta mmalga nɛ fo nu ŋ ka bugi to m malga basa damta be anishito na m bɔɔ basa nɛ fo yirda fanɛ bumo alɛ beeŋ tiŋ ŋ ŋini beko enɔ.

english_verse: As a good soldier of Christ Jesus you must endure your share of suffering.
translation_verse: Fo alɛ gba e baa kɔ kagbene a shuli a tu anyi a ji awurfoŋ fanɛ Yesu Kristo be soja lela.

english_verse: No one wins an athletic contest without obeying the rules.
translation_verse: Eshilepo kama malɛ nɛ e maa bɛ eshile na be mbraana so maaŋ tiŋ n ji shɛŋ eshile na to.

english_verse: And farmers who work hard are the first to eat what grows in their field.
translation_verse: Baa kraa nyiŋi fanɛ edɔpo nɛ e bee shuŋ kushuŋ na ga na gbagba nawule e kɔ ekpa nɛ e tiŋ n fara a ji mbe adɔjibi popɔr.

english_verse: If you keep in mind what I have told you, the Lord will help you understand completely.
translation_verse: Baa fɛ le be asheŋ nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ fo ere be asheŋ nɛ Enyɛnpe e chɛ fo to nɛ fo pin kusɔ kama to.

english_verse: Keep your mind on Jesus Christ! He was from the family of David and was raised from death, just as my good news says.
translation_verse: Baa nyiŋi baru lela nɛ ŋ kɔ a malga fanɛ Kristo Yesu nɛ e shi Ewura Deevid be kanaŋ to wu n tiŋi na.

english_verse: And because of this message, I am locked up in jail and treated like a criminal. But God's good news isn't locked in jail,
translation_verse: Baru lela na malɛ so nɛ mee ji awurfoŋ ere hale a wɔ ŋgbuliŋ to fanɛ esa nɛ e wora kulubi ko na. Ama esa malɛ kikɛ maaŋ tiŋ n wɔtɔ Ebɔrɛ be kamalga bre kegbuleŋ.

english_verse: and so I am willing to put up with anything. Then God's special people will be saved and given eternal glory because they belong to Christ Jesus.
translation_verse: Amoso nɛ mee ji awurfoŋ ere be kanyiti ŋkpal Ebɔrɛ be basa laraso na so nɛ bumo alɛ gba e tiŋ m bɔla Kristo Yesu so n nya kumɔlga nɛ kemaŋkura nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na.

english_verse: Here is a true message: “If we died with Christ, we will live with him.
translation_verse: Le be kamalga ere la kashenteŋ nna fanɛ, nɛ kashenteŋ nna fanɛ anyi nɛ mo e daŋ wu, kumo ere anyi nɛ mo malɛ e naaŋ baa wɔ ŋkpa to.

english_verse: If we don't give up, we will rule with him. If we deny that we know him, he will deny that he knows us.
translation_verse: Nɛ anyi maŋ pɔ aba nseŋ kraa ji kanyiti, anyi nɛ mo e naaŋ ji kuwura basa so. Ama nɛ an kini mo, mo alɛ gba beeŋ kini anyi.

english_verse: If we are not faithful, he will still be faithful. Christ cannot deny who he is.” An Approved Worker
translation_verse: Nɛ anyi ere kɔ nnɔkilgi gba, mo ere maŋ kɔ kɔnɔkilgi, ŋkpal manɛ so, e maaŋ tiŋ n wora asheŋ n da mbe da so. Ebɔrɛ be eshumpo lela be asheŋ

english_verse: Don't let anyone forget these things. And with God as your witness, you must warn them not to argue about words. These arguments don't help anyone. In fact, they ruin everyone who listens to them.
translation_verse: Baa ŋini fo basa asheŋ ere nseŋ fiɛ bumo so kpakpa Ebɔrɛ be anishito fanɛ b lar mmalga koko be emɔrɔana be nlu to, ŋkpal manɛ so, loŋ be nlu maŋ kɔ kechɛto kikɛ amo to, a bee mur basa nɛ baa nu amo nna.

english_verse: Do your best to win God's approval as a worker who doesn't need to be ashamed and who teaches only the true message.
translation_verse: Wora ania ga n ta fo kumu m bɔɔ Ebɔrɛ enɔ a shuŋ mo nɛnɛ. Baa la esa nɛ e bee ŋini kashenteŋ be mmalga na kumo be ekpa so. Loŋ na fo maaŋ luri kushuŋ na be anishinyɔr to.

english_verse: That sort of talk is like a sore that won't heal. And Hymenaeus and Philetus have been talking this way
translation_verse: Keŋini nɛ basa wɔtɔ a ŋini na du fanɛ ketamɛ lubi nna a nyɛrga a sɔ esa be eyur kikɛ so. Le be beŋinipoana ere be beko e la Haimɛneeyes nɛ Failites.

english_verse: by teaching that the dead have already been raised to life. This is far from the truth, and it is destroying the faith of some people.
translation_verse: B foe kashenteŋ be ekpa na so ŋkpal b ka wɔtɔ a ŋini fanɛ basa be ketiŋi luwu to be jemanɛ na choŋ na so so. Baa wul basa ko to ashi bumo be yirda na to nna na.

english_verse: But the foundation God has laid is solid. On it is written, “The Lord knows who his people are. So everyone who worships the Lord must turn away from evil.”
translation_verse: Ama kusɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ tɔl n yili maŋ kɔ kegbuŋgbuŋ kikɛ. Kasibɛ nɛ a deŋ kumo so malɛ nde: “Enyɛnpe na nyi basa nɛ b la mo peya.” Kusɔ nɛ k naŋ ti so e la: “Esa kama nɛ e kaŋɛ fanɛ e la Enyɛnpe peya, e lar alubi be kewora to.”

english_verse: This is also how it is with people. The ones who stop doing evil and make themselves pure will become special. Their lives will be holy and pleasing to their Master, and they will be able to do all kinds of good deeds.
translation_verse: To, esa kama malɛ nɛ e lara mbe kumu ashi asheŋ jiga to, kumo ere e beeŋ baa la esa nɛ Enyɛnpe na bee lara nna nɛ e shuŋ kenishipereso be ashuŋ. Amodoŋwura mo Nyɛnpe beeŋ baa fute a yige mo so nseŋ ta kushuŋ lela kikɛ m bɔɔ mo enɔ.

english_verse: Run from temptations that capture young people. Always do the right thing. Be faithful, loving, and easy to get along with. Worship with people whose hearts are pure.
translation_verse: Amoso, baa gelge kebrantiɛ to be ayɛlgasɔ nsaa ta fo nfɛra a wɔtɔ alelasheŋ nɛ yirda nɛ kasha nɛ kagbenewushi to nɛ fo nɛ bumo nɛ b kɔ kagbene koŋwule cheembi a kule Ebɔrɛ na e baa wɔ loŋ be kebaawɔtɔ to.

english_verse: Stay away from stupid and senseless arguments. These only lead to trouble,
translation_verse: Baa gelge kawuliso nɛ chilchil be emɔrɔ fuloŋ, ŋkpal manɛ so, fo nyi a ka bee bar nlu.

english_verse: and God's servants must not be troublemakers. They must be kind to everyone, and they must be good teachers and very patient.
translation_verse: A maŋ daga Enyɛnpe malɛ be kenya ka bee kɔ nlu. A daga fanɛ e baa la esa basa kikɛ kutɔ nseŋ naa la eŋinipo lela nɛ e kɔ kanyiti

english_verse: Be humble when you correct people who oppose you. Maybe God will lead them to turn to him and learn the truth.
translation_verse: a wɔtɔ a yɔɔ mbe kumu nsaa ŋini basa nɛ baa ji mo emɔrɔ asheŋ amo be ekpa so. Nɛ e bee wora loŋ, shere Ebɔrɛ beeŋ bugi ekpa n sa bumo nɛ b tuba m bɛ kashenteŋ be ekpa na so

english_verse: They have been trapped by the devil, and he makes them obey him, but God may help them escape.
translation_verse: nseŋ nya nfɛra n lar Setani be kejigbelɛ nɛ e ta m pɛ bumo n shin nɛ baa nu a sa mo na to.

english_verse: You can be certain that in the last days there will be some very hard times.
translation_verse: Baa nyi fanɛ lalaloge be nchɛ na to, tɔrɔ damta beeŋ tɔr basa so.

english_verse: People will love only themselves and money. They will be proud, stuck-up, rude, and disobedient to their parents. They will also be ungrateful, godless,
translation_verse: Kumo be jemanɛ na so, basa beeŋ baa sha bumo nawule be amu nɛ amansherbi nsaa kɔ mpuchi damta nɛ kamoowu. Baaŋ baa kɔ nfɛl nsaa kini kenu n sa bumo tutoana nɛ bumo nioana nsaa la ebutuli a wɔtɔ a kplaŋ abɔrɛsheŋ so.

english_verse: heartless, and hateful. Their words will be cruel, and they will have no self-control or pity. These people will hate everything good.
translation_verse: Basa maaŋ ba kaa kɔ kasha nseŋ lar kuwɔr to nsaa kɔ efɛ be eshɛda. Baaŋ ba kaa wɔtɔ a diewu, bumo alɛ nsaa la basa ŋana so nseŋ ba kaa kishi kelela be yiri kikɛ.

english_verse: They will be sneaky, reckless, and puffed up with pride. Instead of loving God, they will love pleasure.
translation_verse: Baaŋ ba kaa la bedebɔrpoana nɛ basa brembreŋ nseŋ ta kamoowu m bɔlɔ bumo to nsaa sha durnya ere to be ebel a chɔ Ebɔrɛ.

english_verse: Even though they will make a show of being religious, their religion won't be real. Don't have anything to do with such people.
translation_verse: Baaŋ ba kaa kɔ abɔrɛsheŋ na ketreso nsaa kini amo be eleŋ. Baa gelge loŋ be basa!

english_verse: Some men fool whole families, just to get power over those women who are slaves of sin and are controlled by all sorts of desires.
translation_verse: Bumo to be beko e naa ŋana a luri basa peana a pɔɔ beche nɛ b maa tiŋ a keta bumo be amu so na. Loŋ be beche, alubi e nyaŋ bumo ŋ keta nɛ ayɛlgasɔ be yiri kikɛ kɔ bumo to a wora kusɔ kama.

english_verse: These women always want to learn something new, but they never can discover the truth.
translation_verse: Loŋ be beche beeŋ nu kusɔ kikɛ nɛ esa kikɛ bee kaŋɛ bumo, ama bumo alɛ maa tiŋ a nya kusɔ kama be ekpa be kanyiasheŋ.

english_verse: Just as Jannes and Jambres opposed Moses, these people are enemies of the truth. Their minds are sick, and their faith isn't real.
translation_verse: Kananɛ Janes nɛ Jambres daa maŋ nu n sa Mosis na gbagba chap nɛ le be benyɛn ere gba maa nu a sa kashenteŋ na. Bumo be nfɛra maŋ walɛ nɛ bumo be yirda malɛ la yirda fuloŋ.

english_verse: But they won't get very far with their foolishness. Soon everyone will know the truth about them, just as Jannes and Jambres were found out. Paul's Last Instructions to Timothy
translation_verse: Bumo alɛ nɛ bumo be eda na maaŋ fo koshipe, ŋkpal manɛ so, bumo be alubi na beeŋ lar efuli nɛ ekama e wu amo fanɛ kananɛ Janes nɛ Jambres be asheŋ daŋ ki na. Asheŋ nɛ Pɔɔl ta a bɔɔ Timoti enɔ be asheŋ

english_verse: Timothy, you know what I teach and how I live. You know what I want to do and what I believe. You have seen how patient and loving I am, and how in the past I put up with
translation_verse: Ama fo ere nyi ma keŋini na kikɛ nɛ ma da nɛ ma kebaawɔtɔ be kifi to. Fo alɛ naŋ wu ma yirda nɛ ma kanyiti nɛ ma kasha nɛ kananɛ ŋ kɔ tɔrɔ be kanyiti.

english_verse: trouble and suffering in the cities of Antioch, Iconium, and Lystra. Yet the Lord rescued me from all those terrible troubles.
translation_verse: Fo alɛ kraa naa nyi etɔrɔ nɛ awurfoŋ nɛ n nya ashi Antiɔk nɛ Ikoniam nɛ Listra be asheŋ. N nyiti amo nɛ Enyɛnpe malɛ lara ma amo kikɛ to.

english_verse: In fact, anyone who belongs to Christ Jesus and wants to live right will have trouble from others.
translation_verse: Kashenteŋto, esa kama nɛ e bugi kagbene a sha kebɛ Kristo Yesu so, baaŋ tɔrɔ amodoŋwura.

english_verse: But evil people who pretend to be what they are not will become worse than ever, as they fool others and are fooled themselves.
translation_verse: Ama basa lubi nɛ kebirkɔnshiwuraana bre, baa wɔtɔ nna a wora alubi a ti so nsaa fule beko nɛ Setani bee fule bumo alɛ gbagba.

english_verse: Keep on being faithful to what you were taught and to what you believed. After all, you know who taught you these things.
translation_verse: Ama fo ere, baa kɔ asɔ nɛ fo koya nseŋ yirda na to kpakpa nsaa nyiŋi esa nɛ fo koya amo mo kutɔ na.

english_verse: Since childhood, you have known the Holy Scriptures that are able to make you wise enough to have faith in Christ Jesus and be saved.
translation_verse: Baa nyiŋi kananɛ fo kebiato kikɛ nɛ fo pin abɔrɛsibɛ cheembi nɛ a beeŋ tiŋ n sa fo kanyiasheŋ nɛ k beeŋ tiŋ n shin nɛ fo bɔla keyirda Kristo Yesu so n nya kumɔlga na.

english_verse: Everything in the Scriptures is God's Word. All of it is useful for teaching and helping people and for correcting them and showing them how to live.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ e wɔ abɔrɛsibɛ ere kikɛ be kaman nɛ amo alɛ walɛ keta ŋ ŋini kashenteŋ na nɛ keta n fiɛ bumo nɛ baa wora a jija so nɛ keta n lara esa kewora n foe to nɛ keta ŋ ŋini esa kebaawɔtɔ lela.

english_verse: The Scriptures train God's servants to do all kinds of good deeds.
translation_verse: Ade kikɛ e naaŋ shin nɛ Ebɔrɛ be esa e tiŋ m bela ase ŋ kre to nɛnɛ n shuŋ kushuŋ lela kikɛ.

english_verse: When Christ Jesus comes as king, he will be the judge of everyone, whether they are living or dead. So with God and Christ as witnesses, I command you
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ nɛ Kristo Yesu nɛ e beeŋ ji bumo nɛ baaŋ baa wɔ ŋkpa to nɛ bumo nɛ b wu na demu be anishito nɛ n yil nsaa kpal mbe kenamba na nɛ mbe kuwura na so a kaŋɛ fo fanɛ

english_verse: to preach God's message. Do it willingly, even if it isn't the popular thing to do. You must correct people and point out their sins. But also cheer them up, and when you instruct them, always be patient.
translation_verse: fo baa bɔ kubɔya na a sa basa. Kelela ŋko kulubi to kikɛ baa sha kebaabɔ kubɔya na a sa basa a shin nɛ b baa wu kananɛ kashenteŋ na baa dese geeŋ. Baa ta kubɔya na a fiɛ basa so ŋko a leŋ bumo to nsaa kɔ kanyiti a ŋini bumo abɔrɛsheŋ na.

english_verse: The time is coming when people won't listen to good teaching. Instead, they will look for teachers who will please them by telling them only what they are itching to hear.
translation_verse: Saŋko beeŋ fo nɛ basa maaŋ naŋ nu kashenteŋ be keŋini na nsaa wɔtɔ a bɛ bumo gbagba be ayɛlgasɔ so. Baaŋ baa chala beŋinipo damta nɛ b baa ŋini bumo asɔ nɛ baa sha kebaanu.

english_verse: They will turn from the truth and eagerly listen to senseless stories.
translation_verse: Baaŋ ti bumo be asoe n sa kashenteŋ na nseŋ bugi amo a nu edaŋkaresheŋ be ablɔmbi nɛ a maŋ kɔ kifi.

english_verse: But you must stay calm and be willing to suffer. You must work hard, telling the good news and to do your job well.
translation_verse: Fo ere, baa kɔ fo kumu to nɛnɛ kusɔ kama to. Baa ji tɔrɔ be kanyiti nsaa wora kushuŋ nɛ k daga fanɛ baru lela be emalgapo kaa bee wora. Baa shuŋ kushuŋ nɛ Ebɔrɛ ta m bɔɔ fo enɔ na kikɛ nyam.

english_verse: Now the time has come for me to die. My life is like a drink offering being poured out on the altar.
translation_verse: Ma ere, jemanɛ nɛ baaŋ ta ma n lara sarga na fo nɛ jemanɛ nɛ meeŋ lar durnya ere to na fo n loge.

english_verse: I have fought well. I have finished the race, and I have been faithful.
translation_verse: Ŋ kɔ kolu lela na n loge nseŋ shile eshile na n loge, ma alɛ nseŋ naŋ keta yirda na m ba fo ekar.

english_verse: So a crown will be given to me for pleasing the Lord. He judges fairly, and on the day of judgment he will give a crown to me and to everyone else who wants him to appear with power. Personal Instructions
translation_verse: Naniere bre ma kejinlar be kakɛ e ka a jo ma nɛ n sɔ. Kumo be kamɔnchɛ Enyɛnpe nɛ e maa ji demu a puni na beeŋ ta kumo ŋ kɛ ma. Mannɛ n nawule, ama e beeŋ ta kumo ŋ kɛ bekama nɛ b kɔ kasha a jo mbe kelar m ba na gba n ti so. Pɔɔl gbagba be mmalga nɛ e kɔ a sa Timoti be asheŋ

english_verse: Come to see me as soon as you can.
translation_verse: Timoti, wora ania m ba ŋ kutɔ.

english_verse: Demas loves the things of this world so much that he left me and went to Thessalonica. Crescens has gone to Galatia, and Titus has gone to Dalmatia.
translation_verse: Diimas bre luri durnya to be ayɛlgasɔ to nseŋ shile ma n yɔ Tɛsalɔnika. Krɛsent yɔ Galeesha nɛ Taites malɛ yɔ Dalmeesha.

english_verse: Only Luke has stayed with me. Mark can be very helpful to me, so please find him and bring him with you.
translation_verse: Luuk nawule e wɔ ŋ kutɔ. Fo kaa ba, fo shin nɛ fo nɛ Maak e ba, ŋkpal manɛ so, e kɔ kechɛto ga ma kushuŋ na to.

english_verse: I sent Tychicus to Ephesus.
translation_verse: N shuŋi Tikikes Ɛfeses.

english_verse: When you come, bring the coat I left at Troas with Carpus. Don't forget to bring the scrolls, especially the ones made of leather.
translation_verse: Fo kaa ba, ta ma piŋi nɛ n yige Kaapes kutɔ ashi Trowas na. Ta ebuku na, fɔnfɔŋ amo nɛ b ta kusɔbɔya be kawɔl n lɔŋɛ na.

english_verse: Alexander, the metalworker, has hurt me in many ways. But the Lord will pay him back for what he has done.
translation_verse: Alɛkzaanda bɔyɛpo shuŋ ma ashuŋ lubi damta ga. Enyɛnpe bee ka mo mbe ashuŋ na be kukɔ.

english_verse: Alexander opposes what we preach, so you had better watch out for him.
translation_verse: Fo alɛ gba e baa de mo so, ŋkpal manɛ so, e daa maŋ sa anyi be kubɔya na kashuli hale gbrɛ kikɛ.

english_verse: When I was first put on trial, no one helped me. In fact, everyone deserted me. I hope it won't be held against them.
translation_verse: Kachɛ nɛ n fara m malga nɛ m mɔlga ma kumu na, ekama shile ma nna. Ebɔrɛ e ta m paŋ bumo.

english_verse: But the Lord stood beside me. He gave me the strength to tell his full message, so that all Gentiles would hear it. And I was kept safe from hungry lions.
translation_verse: Ama Enyɛnpe bre maŋ shile ma, e sa ma eleŋ nna nɛ n tiŋ m bɔ kubɔya na kikɛ nyam n sa nnyamase na kikɛ nseŋ nya ŋ gelge ebuluŋ be nnɔ to be keluri.

english_verse: The Lord will always keep me from being harmed by evil, and he will bring me safely into his heavenly kingdom. Praise him forever and ever! Amen. Final Greetings
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe malɛ beeŋ lara ma ashi kulubi kikɛ to nseŋ yɛr ma mbe ebɔrɛso be kuwura to. Kemaŋkura e baa wɔ mo so hale mbaanaayɔ. Amɛn. Lalaloge be kechɔrɔ be asheŋ

english_verse: Give my greetings to Priscilla and Aquila and to the family of Onesiphorus.
translation_verse: Chɔrɔ Priska nɛ Akwila nɛ Onɛsifɔres be kowu to ebi n sa ma.

english_verse: Erastus stayed at Corinth. Trophimus was sick when I left him at Miletus.
translation_verse: Irastes shir a wɔ Kɔrint nɛ n yige Trɔfimes malɛ Mailites, ŋkpal manɛ so, e daa lɔ nna.

english_verse: Do your best to come before winter. Eubulus, Pudens, Linus, and Claudia send you their greetings, and so do the rest of the Lord's followers.
translation_verse: Wora ania m ba pɔɛŋ nɛ kechali e fo. Yubeles nɛ Pudɛns nɛ Laines nɛ Klawdia nɛ bekurgepoana nɛ b ka na kikɛ bee chɔrɔ fo.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will bless your life and will be kind to you.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe e baa kɔ fo kiyoyu to. Ebɔrɛ be kuwɔr be kakɛ e baa wɔ menyi so.

english_verse: Then they will have the hope of eternal life God promised long ago. And God never tells a lie!
translation_verse: nɛ kumo be tama wɔ kenya ŋkpa nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na to na. Kumo be kɔnɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ nase pɔɛŋ nɛ kusɔ kikɛ fara na. Mo alɛ maa ku efɛ kikɛ.

english_verse: So, at the proper time, God our Savior gave this message and told me to announce what he had said.
translation_verse: Jemanɛ nɛ mo ere Ebɔrɛ an be Emɔlgapo na gbagba bee sha na nɛ e bugi mbe kubɔya na to n sa basa nseŋ yili kumo fanɛ kubɔya na be kebɔ n sa basa be kushuŋ e baa la meya.

english_verse: Titus, because of our faith, you are like a son to me. I pray that God our Father and Christ Jesus our Savior will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! What Titus Was To Do in Crete
translation_verse: Mee sibɛ kawɔl ere nna a sa fo Taites, m pibi kashenteŋto ashi yirda koŋwule nɛ an kɔ na to. Ebɔrɛ be kuwɔr be kakɛ nɛ kagbenewushi nɛ a shi Ebɔrɛ Etuto nɛ an be Emɔlgapo Kristo Yesu kutɔ na e baa wɔ fo to. Taites be kushuŋ ashi Kriit be asheŋ

english_verse: I left you in Crete to do what had been left undone and to appoint leaders for the churches in each town. As I told you,
translation_verse: N daŋ yige fo Kriit nna nɛ fo wora asheŋ nɛ a daŋ ka kewora na nna. Asheŋ nɛ n daŋ ta m bɔɔ fo enɔ na e daa la fanɛ kade kama be asɔri to, fo lara benimu n sa ndoŋebi.

english_verse: There are many who don't respect authority, and they fool others by talking nonsense. This is especially true of some Jewish followers.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, amuleŋwuraana damta nɛ bumo be efɛ nɛ mmalga fuloŋ shi ndoŋ ga, fɔnfɔŋ bebɛsopo nɛ b shi Juwebi be kanaŋ to na.

english_verse: But you must make them be quiet. They are after money, and they upset whole families by teaching what they should not.
translation_verse: A daga fanɛ fo shin nɛ bumo kikɛ e lo bumo be nnɔ to, ŋkpal manɛ so, baa shin nɛ nwuchu lelemu bee bure nseŋ kpal amansherbi so a wɔtɔ a ŋini anishinyɔr be asheŋ nɛ a maŋ daga.

english_verse: It is like one of their own prophets once said, “The people of Crete always tell lies. They are greedy and lazy like wild animals.”
translation_verse: Bumo gbagba to be eko nɛ baa tre anebi na e daŋ kaŋɛ le: “Saŋkama Kriitebi la befɛpo nɛ asɔbɔya lubi nɛ ajibishapo tɔlpoana nna.”

english_verse: This surely is a true saying. And you should be hard on such people, so you can help them grow stronger in their faith.
translation_verse: Kashenteŋ be kamalga nna, amoso, baa fiɛ bumo so kenishipereso nɛ b baa wɔ kashenteŋ be yirda na to.

english_verse: Don't pay any attention to any of those senseless Jewish stories and human commands. These are made up by people who won't obey the truth.
translation_verse: Shin nɛ b sa maŋ naa nu a sa Juwebi be adrasheŋ be ablɔmbi nɛ mbra nɛ a shi basa nɛ b kini kashenteŋ na kutɔ na.

english_verse: Everything is pure for someone whose heart is pure. But nothing is pure for an unbeliever with a dirty mind. That person's mind and conscience are destroyed.
translation_verse: Basa nɛ b du cheembi, kusɔ kama malɛ du cheembi nna bumo kutɔ, ama bekama nɛ b maŋ du cheembi bumo alɛ nsaa maŋ kɔ yirda na, shɛŋ shɛŋ maŋ du cheembi bumo kutɔ. Bumo be ŋgbene nɛ bumo be nfɛra fɛso kikɛ maŋ lar so.

english_verse: Such people claim to know God, but their actions prove they really don't. They are disgusting. They won't obey God, and they are too worthless to do anything good.
translation_verse: B yɛ b nyi Ebɔrɛ, bumo alɛ nsaa kini mo ashi bumo be kebaawɔtɔ nɛ asheŋ woraso to. Bumo be alubisheŋ nɛ bumo be amuleŋ maŋ kɔ ebarkasa, b maŋ walɛ kelela be kusɔ kama be kewora.

english_verse: Tell the older men to have self-control and to be serious and sensible. Their faith, love, and patience must never fail.
translation_verse: Kaŋɛ benyɛnnimuana na fanɛ b sa maa du brembreŋ. B baa kɔ nfɛra nsaa tiŋ bumo be amu nseŋ naa kɔ kashenteŋ be yirda na nɛ kasha nɛ kanyiti.

english_verse: Tell the older women to behave as those who love the Lord should. They must not gossip about others or be slaves of wine. They must teach what is proper,
translation_verse: Loŋ koŋwule na e daga fo ka kaŋɛ bechekparana na fanɛ b baa kɔ kebaawɔtɔ cheembi. A maŋ daga fanɛ b baa la emalaŋfiki ŋko n shin nɛ kasanuu e baa pɔɔ bumo so.

english_verse: Each of the younger women must be sensible and kind, as well as a good homemaker, who puts her own husband first. Then no one can say insulting things about God's message.
translation_verse: nɛ kananɛ baaŋ baa tiŋ a keta bumo be amu a maŋ kɔ kulubi nsaa maa kɔ ntɔl epe nsaa la basa a wɔtɔ a nu a sa bumo kulana nɛ esa kikɛ e sa maŋ nya ekpa m malga kulubi kikɛ ŋ gbiti kubɔya nɛ k shi Ebɔrɛ kutɔ na.

english_verse: Tell the young men to have self-control in everything.
translation_verse: Loŋ koŋwule na e daga fo ka kaŋɛ mbrantiɛbiana na fanɛ b baa tiŋ bumo be amu.

english_verse: Use clean language that no one can criticize. Do this, and your enemies will be too ashamed to say anything against you.
translation_verse: Shin nɛ kusɔ kama nɛ fee malga e baa kɔ kashenteŋ nɛ anishinyɔr e ji edoŋ kama nɛ e sa maŋ nya kulubi kikɛ m malga ŋ gbiti anyi.

english_verse: or steal from them. They must be completely honest and trustworthy. Then everyone will show great respect for what is taught about God our Savior. God's Kindness and the New Life
translation_verse: A daga fanɛ b baa ŋini fanɛ saŋkama b la anya lela nna a maŋ kɔ kebirkɔnshi a wora asheŋ. Loŋ na Ebɔrɛ, anyi be Emɔlgapo be asheŋ ŋiniso na beeŋ nya mbo ashi asheŋ nɛ baa wora kikɛ to.

english_verse: God has shown us undeserved grace by coming to save all people.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ mbe kuwɔr be kakɛ nɛ k bee bar kumɔlga basa kikɛ so na lar efuli.

english_verse: He taught us to give up our wicked ways and our worldly desires and to live decent and honest lives in this world.
translation_verse: Le be kuwɔr be kakɛ ere e naa ŋini anyi fanɛ an yige kabɔrɛfɛl nɛ durnya to be ayɛlgasɔ nsaa wɔ kamootiŋ nɛ kashenteŋ nɛ kabɔrɛŋana be kebaawɔtɔ to anyi be jemanɛ ere to.

english_verse: We are filled with hope, as we wait for the glorious return of our great God and Savior Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: An baa wɔ amo to nsaa jo kachɛ nɛ b nɛfa nɛ anyi be tama wɔ kumo so na. Kumo be kamɔnchɛ nɛ an be Ebɔrɛ Gboŋ, Emɔlgapo Yesu Kristo na be kemaŋkura beeŋ lar efuli.

english_verse: He gave himself to rescue us from everything evil and to make our hearts pure. He wanted us to be his own people and to be eager to do right.
translation_verse: E ta mo gbagba be kumu n sa anyi nɛ e tiŋ m mɔlga anyi ashi alubisheŋ kikɛ to nseŋ ta anyi ŋ ki basa cheembi nɛ an baa la mo nawule peya m bugi kagbene a wɔtɔ a sha kebaawora alelasheŋ.

english_verse: Teach these things, as you use your full authority to encourage and correct people. Make sure you earn everyone's respect.
translation_verse: Baa ŋini asheŋ ere a leŋ basa na to nsaa ta fo kejuŋkpar be eleŋ kikɛ na a fiɛ bumo so. Sa maŋ shin nɛ esa kikɛ e fɛl fo.

english_verse: Remind your people to obey the rulers and authorities and not to be rebellious. They must always be ready to do something helpful
translation_verse: Baa nyiŋi fo basa nɛ b baa ta bumo be amu a sa basa nɛ baa keni bumo so nɛ bumo be efuli so be bewuraana nsaa shuli a wora ashuŋ lela kikɛ.

english_verse: We used to be stupid, disobedient, and foolish, as well as slaves of all sorts of desires and pleasures. We were evil and jealous. Everyone hated us, and we hated everyone.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, saŋko anyi alɛ gba daŋ wuli nna a kɔ kumuleŋ nɛ ashuŋ lubi. An daa la anyi be eyurana be ayɛlgasɔ nɛ ebel be yiri kikɛ be anya nna. An daa wɔ kayurbesa be nfɛra lubi to nna a kishi beko nɛ beko malɛ daŋ kishi anyi.

english_verse: He saved us because of his mercy, and not because of any good things we have done. God washed us by the power of the Holy Spirit. He gave us new birth and a fresh beginning.
translation_verse: E mɔlga anyi nna ŋkpal mo gbagba ka bee wu kuwɔr na so. E bɔla kabɔrɛbɛr nɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ bee bɔla kumo so a sa anyi kakurge popɔr nɛ kebaawɔtɔ popɔr na so nna m mɔlga anyi.

english_verse: God sent Jesus Christ our Savior to give us his Spirit.
translation_verse: E bɔla Yesu Kristo, an be Emɔlgapo so n shin nɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na ba buu anyi so nyam.

english_verse: Jesus treated us much better than we deserve. He made us acceptable to God and gave us the hope of eternal life.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal mbe kuwɔr be kakɛ na so e kpra anyi be alubi ashi anyi so nɛ ŋkpa nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar nɛ anyee tama na e ki anyeya.

english_verse: This message is certainly true. These teachings are useful and helpful for everyone. I want you to insist that the people follow them, so that all who have faith in God will be sure to do good deeds.
translation_verse: Kesheŋ ere la kashenteŋ nna. Mee sha fanɛ fo ta kenishipere nna n wɔtɔ le be asheŋ ere to nɛ bumo nɛ b ba yirda Ebɔrɛ na e baa wɔ ashuŋ lela be kebaawɔtɔ to. Le be mmalga ere la kashenteŋ nna nɛ a beeŋ chɛ basa to.

english_verse: But don't have anything to do with stupid arguments about ancestors. And stay away from disagreements and quarrels about the Law of Moses. Such arguments are useless and senseless.
translation_verse: Ama baa gelge kawuliso be emɔrɔ nɛ kekurgeso be mmalga nɛ nlu. Fo alɛ e sa maŋ naŋ kpal mbra na so a wɔ kɔnɔgberge to, ŋkpal manɛ so, amo kikɛ la asheŋ fuloŋ nna a maŋ kɔ tɔnɔ.

english_verse: You know their minds are twisted, and their own sins show how guilty they are. Personal Instructions and Greetings
translation_verse: Baa nyi fanɛ loŋ be esa be nfɛra maŋ walɛ. Alubi nɛ e wɔtɔ a wora nɛ alubi na malɛ gba bee ŋini e ka maŋ kɔ kashenteŋ. Lalaloge be keŋini be asheŋ

english_verse: I plan to send Artemas or Tychicus to you. After he arrives, please try your best to meet me at Nicopolis. I have decided to spend the winter there.
translation_verse: Ŋ kaŋ shuŋi Aatemas ŋko Tikikes fo kutɔ, wora ania m ba ma kutɔ ashi Nikɔpɔlis, ŋkpal manɛ so, ndoŋ nɛ mee sha fanɛ m baa wɔ awo be jemanɛ ere to.

english_verse: When Zenas the lawyer and Apollos get ready to leave, help them as much as you can, so they won't have need of anything.
translation_verse: Wora ania n chɛ Zinas demujipo na to nɛ Apɔlɔs to nɛ b nya bumo be enite na be ekpa nseŋ naŋ nya kusɔ kama nɛ k daga fanɛ b nya.

english_verse: Greetings to you from everyone here. Greet all of our friends who share in our faith. I pray that the Lord will be kind to all of you!
translation_verse: Bekama nɛ b wɔ ma kutɔ nfe ere bee chɔrɔ fo. Chɔrɔ bekama nɛ baa sha anyi ashi yirda na to na. Ebɔrɛ be kuwɔr be kakɛ e baa wɔ menyi kikɛ so.

english_verse: From Paul, who is in jail for serving Christ Jesus, and from Timothy, who is like a brother because of our faith. Philemon, you work with us and are very dear to us. This letter is to you
