translation_verse: Kawɔl ere shi ma, Pɔɔl nɛ n wɔ kabuti to ŋkpal Kristo Yesu so nɛ an kurgepo Timoti kutɔ nna a yɔ an teri lela nɛ an barkasa eshumpo Failimɔn

english_verse: and to the church that meets in your home. It is also to our dear friend Apphia and to Archippus, who serves the Lord as we do.
translation_verse: nɛ an sipoche Apfia nɛ Akipes nɛ e la an barkasa soja na nɛ asɔriebi nɛ baa shɛr fo Failimɔn pe na kutɔ.

english_verse: I pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! Philemon's Love and Faith
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ be kuwɔr be kakɛ nɛ kagbenewushi nɛ k shi Ebɔrɛ an Tuto nɛ Enyɛnpe Yesu Kristo kutɔ na e baa wɔ menyi so. Kabɔrɛkule nɛ kechɔrɔ be asheŋ

english_verse: Philemon, each time I mention you in my prayers, I thank God.
translation_verse: Saŋkama mee nyiŋi menyi kabɔrɛkule to nna nsaa chɔrɔ Ebɔrɛ ŋkpal menyi so.

english_verse: I hear about your faith in our Lord Jesus and about your love for all God's people.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, mee nu kasha nɛ yirda nɛ men kɔ a sa Enyɛnpe Yesu nɛ beyirdapoana na kikɛ be asheŋ.

english_verse: As you share your faith with others, I pray they may come to know all the blessings Christ has given us.
translation_verse: Ma alɛ naa kule Ebɔrɛ fanɛ kananɛ menyee malga men be yirda be asheŋ a sa basa na beeŋ shin nɛ men nya kanyiasheŋ n ti so nseŋ pin asɔ lela damta nɛ an bɔla Kristo so a kɔ na kikɛ nyam.

english_verse: My friend, your love has made me happy and has greatly encouraged me. It has also cheered the hearts of God's people. Paul Speaks to Philemon about Onesimus
translation_verse: Ekurgepo, kasha nɛ fo kɔ na leŋ ma to ga n shin nɛ ma kagbene fuli ma ga, ŋkpal manɛ so, fo leŋ beyirdapoana na to. Pɔɔl ka kule n sa Onisimɔs be asheŋ

english_verse: But I would rather ask you to do it simply because of love. Yes, as someone in jail for Christ,
translation_verse: ama kasha so nɛ ma Pɔɔl bel le nseŋ naa wɔ kabuti to ŋkpal Kristo Yesu so

english_verse: I beg you to help Onesimus! He is like a son to me because I led him to Christ here in jail.
translation_verse: a kule fo a sa m pibi Onisimɔs nɛ ŋ ki mo tuto abɔrɛsheŋ na be kaplɛa so ashi kabuti ere to nfe na.

english_verse: Before this, he was useless to you, but now he is useful both to you and to me.
translation_verse: Saŋɛ na e daa maa kɔ tɔnɔ kikɛ a sa fo, ama naniere bre e kɔ tɔnɔ a sa ma nɛ fo kikɛ kashenteŋto.

english_verse: I would like to keep him here with me, where he could take your place in helping me while I am here in prison for preaching the good news.
translation_verse: N daa beeŋ baa sha fanɛ e yili fo katelamu to nfe a shuŋ ma kabuti nɛ n wɔ to ŋkpal baru lela na so ere.

english_verse: But I won't do anything unless you agree to it first. I want your act of kindness to come from your heart, and not be something you feel forced to do.
translation_verse: Ama m maa sha kelar fo kaman n wora kusɔ nɛ k maaŋ par fo nɛ fo gbagba be kelela e ki fanɛ tintiŋ be kusɔ, ama kusɔ nɛ k shi fo gbagba be kagbene to.

english_verse: Perhaps Onesimus was taken from you for a little while so you could have him back for good,
translation_verse: Shere kumo so nɛ e daŋ lar fo kutɔ nchɛnnyɔ na nɛ e naŋ ya bɛta m ba kaa wɔ fo kutɔ mbaanaayɔ.

english_verse: but not as a slave. Onesimus is much more than a slave. To me he is a dear friend, but to you he is even more, both as a person and as a follower of the Lord.
translation_verse: Naniere e maŋ naa la kenya, e chɔ kenya. E ki ma nɛ fo kikɛ be ekurgepo shaso naniere. Mee sha mo ga, ama kasha nɛ feeŋ baa kɔ a sa mo beeŋ baa shi a chɔ meya ere, ŋkpal manɛ so, e la fo kenya nna nseŋ naa yirda Enyɛnpe na.

english_verse: If you consider me a friend because of Christ, then welcome Onesimus as you would welcome me.
translation_verse: Amoso, nɛ fo baa nyi fanɛ ma nɛ fo la kukoŋwule nna, kumo ere fo sɔ mo fanɛ kananɛ fo daa beeŋ sɔ ma gbagba.

english_verse: If he has cheated you or owes you anything, charge it to my account.
translation_verse: Nɛ fanɛ e wora fo kulubi ko nna ŋko n ji fo kukɔ, fo ta kumo be kukɔ na n deŋi ma.

english_verse: My dear friend and follower of Christ our Lord, please cheer me up by doing this for me.
translation_verse: Amoso, ekurgepo, jande kpal Enyɛnpe na so n wora ma kelela. Leŋ ma to fanɛ fo kurgepo ashi Kristo to.

english_verse: Please get a room ready for me. I hope your prayers will be answered, and I can visit you.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman, lɔŋɛ ebu ko n yili ma, ŋkpal manɛ so, ŋ kɔ tama fanɛ Ebɔrɛ beeŋ nu men kikɛ be kabɔrɛkule nseŋ lara ma n sa menyi. Ŋkela be kechɔrɔ be asheŋ

english_verse: Epaphras is also here in jail for being a follower of Christ Jesus. He sends his greetings,
translation_verse: Epafras nɛ e la m barkasa kabutipo ŋkpal Kristo Yesu so na bee chɔrɔ fo.

english_verse: and so do Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, and Luke, who work together with me.
translation_verse: Maak gba nɛ Aristaakes nɛ Diimas nɛ Luuk nɛ bumo kikɛ la m braana beshumpo na bee chɔrɔ fo.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you!
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Yesu Kristo be kuwɔr be kakɛ e baa wɔ men be ayoyu to.

english_verse: Long ago in many ways and at many times God's prophets spoke his message to our ancestors.
translation_verse: Dra na Ebɔrɛ daŋ bɔla anebiana so nna m malga ale damta ashi ekpa damtaana so n sa an nananyɛnana.

english_verse: But now at last, God sent his Son to bring his message to us. God created the universe by his Son, and everything will someday belong to the Son.
translation_verse: Ama naniere, lalaloge be nchɛ ere bre to mo Pibinyɛn so nɛ e bɔla m malga n sa anyi. Mo Pibinyɛn na so nɛ e to esoso nɛ kasawule kikɛ. Ebi na malɛ nɛ e lara fanɛ mo e naaŋ ba kaa wɔ kusɔ kikɛ.

english_verse: God's Son has all the brightness of God's own glory and is like him in every way. By his own mighty word, he holds the universe together. After the Son had washed away our sins, he sat down at the right side of the glorious God in heaven.
translation_verse: Ebi na nɛ Ebɔrɛ be kemaŋkura bɔla mo so n nyaŋɛ n dii efuli fanɛ kefulto na. Mo e la Ebɔrɛ be da be kaduli gbagba chap nsaa ta mbe kamalga nɛ k kɔ eleŋ ga na a kɔ durnya ere to. Mo alɛ ka daŋ kpra basa be alubi ashi bumo to n loge na, e ya chena ebɔrɛso Enyɛnpetale be jisoso nna, ebunyampo be kakpa. Ebinyɛn na ka chɔ emalaika kikɛ be asheŋ

english_verse: He had become much greater than the angels, and the name he was given is far greater than any of theirs. God's Son Is Greater than Angels
translation_verse: Ebinyɛn na malɛ baa chɔ emalaika kikɛ nna fanɛ kananɛ ketre nɛ Ebɔrɛ sa mo na malɛ gba chɔ bumo be atreana na.

english_verse: God has never said to any of the angels, “You are my Son, because today I have become your Father!” Neither has God said to any of them, “I will be his Father, and he will be my Son!”
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, malaika mo malɛ nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ kaŋɛ le: “M Pibinyɛn e la fo. Kabre ŋ ki fo Tuto”? Ŋko kede be kaman, malaika mo malɛ nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ: “Meeŋ baa la mo Tuto nɛ mo alɛ gba e baa la m Pibinyɛn”?

english_verse: When God brings his first-born Son into the world, he commands all of his angels to worship him.
translation_verse: Ade be kaman, Ebɔrɛ ka daa sha kebar mo Pibinyɛn juŋkparso na durnya to na, le nɛ e daŋ kaŋɛ: “A daga fanɛ Ebɔrɛ be emalaika kikɛ ka bunyaŋ mo.”

english_verse: And when God speaks about the angels, he says, “I change my angels into wind and my servants into flaming fire.”
translation_verse: Le nɛ mo alɛ naŋ malga mbe emalaika koŋwule na be asheŋ ŋ kaŋɛ: “Ma, Ebɔrɛ bee shin nɛ ma emalaika bee wora fanɛ afu nna nɛ ma anya malɛ bee wora fanɛ edɛ a chɔɔ wuloŋwuloŋ.”

english_verse: But God says about his Son, “You are God, and you will rule as King forever! Your royal power brings about justice.
translation_verse: Ama Ebinyɛn na bre be asheŋ, le nɛ Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ: “O Ebɔrɛ, fo kuwura beeŋ baa wɔtɔ mbaanaayɔ. Kashenteŋ malɛ nɛ feeŋ baa kɔ a ji kuwura fo basa so ashi fo kuwura na to.

english_verse: You loved justice and hated evil, and so I, your God, have chosen you. I appointed you and made you happier than any of your friends.”
translation_verse: Fo sha asheŋ nɛ a bɔla ekpa Ebɔrɛ be anishito nseŋ kishi alubisheŋ, amoso nɛ Ebɔrɛ, fo Ebɔrɛ na lara fo nseŋ ta fo ŋ ki ejuŋkparpo na. Kagbenefuliso be ŋku nɛ e ta ŋ gbiti fo m bunyaŋ fo a chɔ fo braana.”

english_verse: The Scriptures also say, “In the beginning, Lord, you were the one who laid the foundation of the earth and created the heavens.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ koŋwule na e naŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ: “Faraŋko na fo, Enyɛnpe na e to kasawule nseŋ ta fo gbagba be enɔana n wora esoso.

english_verse: They will all disappear and wear out like clothes, but you will last forever.
translation_verse: Kachako esa maaŋ naŋ wu amo kikɛ, ama fo alɛ beeŋ ka a wɔtɔ. Amo kikɛ beeŋ ki adra fanɛ asɔbuuso na.

english_verse: You will roll them up like a robe and change them like a garment. But you are always the same, and you will live forever.”
translation_verse: Feeŋ bɔɔ amo to fanɛ piŋi na nɛ a chɛrga fanɛ asɔbuuso. Ama fo alɛ maa chɛrga kikɛ, fo alɛ maa bel kikɛ.”

english_verse: God never said to any of the angels, “Sit at my right side until I make your enemies into a footstool for you!”
translation_verse: To, nɛ malaika mo malɛ nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ kaŋɛ le: “Ba chena ma jisoso nfe hale nɛ n ya ta fo doŋana nɛ b ba gbir fo kumuli”?

english_verse: We must give our full attention to what we were told, so we won't drift away.
translation_verse: Amoso, a daga fanɛ an ka bugi asoe to nɛnɛ n nu asɔ, nɛ an nu na, saŋɛ na so, an maaŋ firgi n foe ekpa n choŋ.

english_verse: So if we refuse this great way of being saved, how can we hope to escape? The Lord himself was the first to tell about it, and people who heard the message proved to us that it was true.
translation_verse: To, nɛ an baŋ kplaŋ le be kumɔlga gboŋgboŋi ere so, nuso nɛ anyeeŋ wora ŋ gelge kasogberge? Enyɛnpe gbagba e daŋ fara m bɔ kumɔlga na be kubɔya n sa basa, nɛ bumo nɛ b daŋ nu kumo mo kutɔ na malɛ ŋini anyi fanɛ k la kashenteŋ nna.

english_verse: God himself showed that his message was true by working all kinds of powerful miracles and wonders. He also gave his Holy Spirit to anyone he chose to. The One Who Leads Us To Be Saved
translation_verse: Kumo alɛ be buushi, Ebɔrɛ gba bee bɔla etɔɔnɛsheŋ nɛ emamachisheŋ nɛ Ebɔrɛ be eleŋ be nnaŋ to be aworbi to nɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na be ŋkɛana nɛ e bee chige to a sa basa ashi mo gbagba be keparso na to a ji shɛda fanɛ kumɔlga na la kashenteŋ nna. Yesu ka ki fanɛ dimɛdi be asheŋ

english_verse: We know that God did not put the future world under the power of angels.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ malɛ maŋ ta durnya nɛ k beeŋ ba kachako so nɛ anyeeŋ malga kumo be asheŋ ere m bɔɔ emalaika enɔ.

english_verse: Somewhere in the Scriptures someone says to God, “What makes you care about us humans? Why are you concerned for weaklings such as we?
translation_verse: Ama esa ko malga kesheŋ ere abɔrɛsibɛ na to be kakpa ko fanɛ: “Manɛ e baa la dimɛdi nɛ mbe asheŋ wɔ fo Ebɔrɛ be kagbene to ere, ŋko manɛ e baa la dimɛdi be kusɔ kurgeso nɛ fo Ebɔrɛ bee keni mo so ere?

english_verse: You made us lower than the angels for a while. Yet you have crowned us with glory and honor.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, saŋɛ gbrɛbi ko fo daŋ shin nɛ emalaika daa chɔ mo nna. Keni, fo ta kemaŋkura nɛ bunyaŋ m buu mo fanɛ kuwura na,

english_verse: And you have put everything under our power!” God has put everything under our power and has not left anything out of our power. But we still don't see it all under our control.
translation_verse: nseŋ ta kusɔ kikɛ m bɔɔ mo enɔ.” Kekaŋɛ fanɛ Ebɔrɛ ta kusɔ kikɛ m bɔɔ mo enɔ ere bee ŋini fanɛ shɛŋ shɛŋ maŋ ti asɔ na so. Naniere bre, anyi maŋ naa wu kusɔ kama ka bee nu a sa mo.

english_verse: What we do see is Jesus, who for a little while was made lower than the angels. Because of God's gift of undeserved grace, Jesus died for everyone. And now that Jesus has suffered and died, he is crowned with glory and honor!
translation_verse: Ama Yesu bre, an wu b ka ta kemaŋkura nɛ bunyaŋ m buu mo fanɛ kuwura. Ama saŋɛ gbrɛbi ko Ebɔrɛ daŋ shin nɛ emalaika daa chɔ mo nna ŋkpal luwu be awurfoŋ nɛ e ji na so, saŋɛ na so, e beeŋ wu n sa basa kikɛ ŋkpal Ebɔrɛ be kakɛ so.

english_verse: Everything belongs to God, and all things were created by his power. So God did the right thing when he made Jesus perfect by suffering, as Jesus led many of God's children to be saved and to share in his glory.
translation_verse: Kumo alɛ baŋ fuli nna a dese fanɛ Ebɔrɛ nɛ asɔ kikɛ wɔtɔ ŋkpal mo so nseŋ naa wɔtɔ a sa mo na e shin nɛ Yesu bɔla awurfoŋ to ŋ ki esa cheembi, saŋɛ na so emo nɛ e yɛr bumo kumɔlga to na beeŋ bar basa damta nɛ b ba tu mo a ji mbe kemaŋkura be ebel na be ako.

english_verse: Jesus and the people he makes holy all belong to the same family. This is why he isn't ashamed to call them his brothers and sisters.
translation_verse: Basa nɛ b lara nɛ b ki Ebɔrɛ be basa na nɛ bumo be elarapo Yesu kikɛ shi kanaŋ koŋwule to nna. Amoso nɛ ketre bumo mo niopibiana maa wora mo anishinyɔr na.

english_verse: He even said to God, “I will tell them your name and sing your praises when they come together to worship.”
translation_verse: Loŋ malɛ so e shin nɛ e kaŋɛ fanɛ: “Ebɔrɛ, meeŋ malga fo asheŋ n sa n niopibiana, nseŋ di fo epaŋ ashi nshɛr to ebi na kikɛ be anishito.”

english_verse: He also said, “I will trust God.” Then he said, “Here I am with the children God has given me.”
translation_verse: Mo koŋwule na e kaŋɛ le: “Meeŋ yirda mo.” Kumo be kaman nɛ e naŋ kaŋɛ le: “Ma nɛ basa nɛ Ebɔrɛ ta m bɔɔ ma enɔ na kikɛ nde.”

english_verse: We are people of flesh and blood. This is why Jesus became one of us. He died to destroy the devil, who had power over death.
translation_verse: Kumo alɛ ŋkpal basa na ka kɔ dimɛdi be eyur nɛ ŋklaŋ na so mo gbagba sɔ bumo be kapɔr koŋwule na nna, saŋɛ na so e beeŋ bɔla luwu to m mur esa nɛ e kɔ luwu be eleŋ na. Mo e la Setani na.

english_verse: But he also died to rescue all of us who live each day in fear of dying.
translation_verse: Saŋɛ na malɛ so, e beeŋ sɔ basa nɛ b la luwu be kenya be anya ashi bumo be kebiato na kikɛ n yige.

english_verse: Jesus clearly did not come to help angels, but he did come to help Abraham's descendants.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, k baŋ fuli nna geeŋ fanɛ mannɛ emalaika nɛ e bee chɛ to, Eebraham mo nanabiana nɛ e bee chɛ to.

english_verse: He had to be one of us, so he could serve God as our merciful and faithful high priest and sacrifice himself for the forgiveness of our sins.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal le malɛ so, a daga fanɛ mo gbagba e ki fanɛ mo niopibiana ashi ekpa kama so, saŋɛ na so, e beeŋ baa la bumo be kuwɔrwupo be bɔrɛmatapo nɛ basa beeŋ tiŋ n yirda ashi Ebɔrɛ be anishito. Nɛ mo alɛ wora loŋ, basa beeŋ nya bumo be alubi be ketampaŋ bumo.

english_verse: And now that Jesus has suffered and was tempted, he can help anyone else who is tempted.
translation_verse: To, naniere, ŋkpal mo gbagba ka luri kechɔŋkeni to n lar nseŋ ji amo be awurfoŋ na so, e beeŋ tiŋ n chɛ bumo nɛ baa luri kechɔŋkeni to na to.

english_verse: My friends, God has chosen you to be his holy people. So think about Jesus, the one we call our apostle and high priest!
translation_verse: Amoso, n niopibi larasoana nɛ men la bumo nɛ Ebɔrɛ tre a yɔ ebɔrɛso na, men ta menyi be anishi n yuu Yesu nɛ e la anyi be yirda ere be eshuŋipo nɛ bɔrɛmatapo nimuso na so ŋ keni kananɛ e du.

english_verse: Jesus was faithful to God, who appointed him, just as Moses was faithful in serving all God's people.
translation_verse: E daa maŋ lar esa nɛ e shuŋi mo na kaman fanɛ kananɛ anebi Mosis daŋ bugi kagbene n shuŋ Ebɔrɛ be kowu to ebi kikɛ na.

english_verse: But Jesus deserves more honor than Moses, just as the builder of a house deserves more honor than the house.
translation_verse: Ama Yesu e chɔ anebi Mosis bunyaŋ ga fanɛ kananɛ ebupɔrpo chɔ ebu na gbagba bunyaŋ na.

english_verse: Of course, every house is built by someone, and God is really the one who built everything.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, esa e naa pɔr ebu fanɛ kananɛ Ebɔrɛ malɛ bee pɔr kusɔ kikɛ nyam na.

english_verse: But Christ is the Son in charge of God's people. And we are those people, if we keep on being brave and don't lose hope. A Rest for God's People
translation_verse: Ama Kristo bre bugi kagbene nna fanɛ Ebɔrɛ Pibinyɛn a keni Ebɔrɛ be kowu to ebi so. Nɛ anyi alɛ baa kɔ anyi be kenyɛn na nɛ tama nɛ anyee puchi kumo so na to kpakpa, kumo ere an la Ebɔrɛ na be kowu to ebi nna na. Kenambɛta kaman be asheŋ

english_verse: It is just as the Holy Spirit says, “If you hear God's voice today,
translation_verse: To, loŋ malɛ nɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na bee kaŋɛ na fanɛ: “Men baŋ nu Ebɔrɛ be ebɔl kabre,

english_verse: “Then God got tired of them and said, ‘You people never show good sense, and you don't understand what I want you to do.’
translation_verse: Amoso nɛ n daŋ nya agbo n wɔtɔ bumo saŋɛ na ebi nseŋ kaŋɛ le na fanɛ: ‘Saŋɛ na kikɛ bumo be ŋgbene bee foe ekpa nna nɛ b maa pin ma ekpaana be asheŋ.’

english_verse: God became angry and told the people, ‘You will never enter my place of rest!’ ”
translation_verse: Amoso, n daŋ ta agbo nna m bɔ ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ: ‘B maaŋ luri ma kewushi na to kikɛ.’ ”

english_verse: You must encourage one another each day. And you must keep on while there is still a time that can be called “today.” If you don't, then sin may fool some of you and make you stubborn.
translation_verse: Nɛ saŋɛ baa wɔtɔ nɛ baa tre kabre be saŋɛ, men baa leŋ abar to, saŋɛ na so, alubi be kafulesheŋ kama maaŋ shin nɛ menyi be ekama be kagbene e ki kpakpa.

english_verse: We were sure about Christ when we first became his people. So let's hold tightly to our faith until the end.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, nɛ an baa kɔ anyi be sososo be tama na to kpakpa n ya fo ekar, kumo ere anyi nɛ Kristo e kɔ kachige koŋwule.

english_verse: Who were those people that heard God's voice and rebelled? Weren't they the same ones that came out of Egypt with Moses?
translation_verse: To, nɛ basa mo e koso a kɔ mbe eleŋ na? Mannɛ basa nɛ anebi Mosis daŋ juŋkpar n lar Ijipt be efuli so na e daa la a?

english_verse: And who did God say would never enter his place of rest? Weren't they the ones that disobeyed him?
translation_verse: To, nɛ basa mo nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ bɔ ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ b maaŋ luri mbe kewushi na to na? Mannɛ bumo nɛ b daa maŋ nu n sa Ebɔrɛ na a?

english_verse: We see that those people did not enter the place of rest because they did not have faith.
translation_verse: To, an wu fanɛ b ka daa maŋ tiŋ n luri Ebɔrɛ be kewushi na to na yirda nɛ b daa maŋ kɔ so.

english_verse: The promise to enter the place of rest is still good, and we must take care that none of you miss out.
translation_verse: Amoso, ŋkpal Ebɔrɛ be kewushi na to be keluri be kɔnɔ naseso na ka kraa dese so, men shin nɛ an baa da so nɛ kumo be saŋɛ kaŋ fo, b maaŋ wu anyi be ekama ka paŋ keluri kumo to.

english_verse: We have heard the message, just as they did. But they failed to believe what they heard, and the message did not do them any good.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, kananɛ baru lela na daŋ ba anyi to nɛ an nu kumo na gbagba na nɛ bumo alɛ gba daŋ nya kumo. Ama kumo alɛ daa maŋ wora bumo shɛŋ, ŋkpal manɛ so, b ka daŋ nu kumo na, b daa maŋ ta yirda n sɔ kumo.

english_verse: Only people who have faith will enter the place of rest. It is just as the Scriptures say, “God became angry and told the people, ‘You will never enter my place of rest!’ ” God said this, even though everything has been ready from the time of creation.
translation_verse: To, naniere anyi nɛ an yirda ere e naa luri Ebɔrɛ be kewushi na to na. Loŋ malɛ nɛ Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ na fanɛ: “N daŋ nya agbo nna nseŋ bɔ ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ: ‘B maaŋ luri ma kewushi na to kikɛ.’ ” Ama baŋ yili saŋɛ nɛ e to durnya na kikɛ m ba fo kabre mbe kushuŋ loge.

english_verse: In fact, somewhere the Scriptures say that by the seventh day, God had finished his work, and so he rested.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, loŋ nɛ e malga kakpa ko ŋ kaŋɛ kachɛ shunusopo na be asheŋ fanɛ: “Ndoŋ nna nɛ Ebɔrɛ wushi kachɛ shunusopo na ashi mbe ashuŋ na kikɛ to nyam.”

english_verse: We also read that he later said, “You people will never enter my place of rest!”
translation_verse: Kumo alɛ nɛ e naŋ kaŋɛ nfe na fanɛ: “B maaŋ luri ma kewushi na to.”

english_verse: This means that the promise to enter is still good, because those who first heard about it disobeyed and did not enter.
translation_verse: Bumo nɛ b daŋ fara n nu baru lela na daa maŋ luri kewushi na to ŋkpal b ka daa maŋ kɔ kasonu so, ama basa ko kraa wɔtɔ nɛ b nya kewushi na to n luri.

english_verse: Much later God told David to make the promise again, just as I have already said, “If you hear his voice today, don't be stubborn!”
translation_verse: Amoso, e naŋ yili kachako n tre kumo kabre. Kumo be kaman pɔɛŋ nɛ e naŋ ba bɔla Ewura Deevid so ŋ kaŋɛ kesheŋ nɛ an teŋ kraŋ fanɛ: “Kabre nɛ men baŋ nu Ebɔrɛ be ebɔl, men sa maŋ wora menyi be amu kpakpa na.”

english_verse: If Joshua had really given the people rest, there would not be any need for God to talk about another day of rest.
translation_verse: Kede e naa ŋini fanɛ nɛ Joshuwa daŋ shin nɛ b luri kewushi na to nna, Ebɔrɛ daa maaŋ naŋ malga kachako malɛ be asheŋ.

english_verse: But God has promised us a Sabbath when we will rest, even though it has not yet come.
translation_verse: Amoso, k bee ŋini fanɛ kewushi ko nɛ kachɛ shunusopo peya na kraa jo Ebɔrɛ be basa nna na.

english_verse: On that day God's people will rest from their work, just as God rested from his work.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, esa kama nɛ e luri Ebɔrɛ be kewushi to bee wushi ashi mo gbagba be ashuŋ to fanɛ kananɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ wushi ashi mbe ashuŋ to na.

english_verse: We should do our best to enter the place of rest, so none of us will disobey and miss going there, as they did.
translation_verse: Amoso, men shin nɛ an wora ania ga n luri kewushi na to nɛ esa kama maaŋ ta kasomaanu m bɛ bedarapo na be aya so n foe ekpa.

english_verse: God's word is alive and powerful! It is sharper than any double-edged sword. His word can cut through our spirits and souls and through our joints and marrow, until it discovers the desires and thoughts of our hearts.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ be kamalga na kɔ ŋkpa nɛ eleŋ nna a ji a chɔ tokobi jinnɔnyɔ. K bee tiŋ a ku a barga nfɛra nɛ kiyoyu to nseŋ naa tiŋ a barga awibichɛkpa nɛ nfɔ to, ŋ gbrɛ a tiŋ a ji basa be nfɛra to be asɔ shaso nɛ bumo be ŋgbene to be nfɛra fɛsoana demu.

english_verse: We have a great high priest, who has gone into heaven, and he is Jesus the Son of God. This is why we must hold on to what we have said about him.
translation_verse: An ka kɔ bɔrɛmatapo nimuso nɛ baa tre mo Yesu, Ebɔrɛ Pibinyɛn, nɛ e yɔ Ebɔrɛ gbagba be anishito na so, men shin nɛ an baa kɔ anyi be yirda nɛ anyee ji kumo be shɛda na be asheŋ to kpakpa.

english_verse: So whenever we are in need, we should come bravely before the throne of our merciful God. There we will be treated with undeserved grace, and we will find help.
translation_verse: Amoso, naniere, men shin nɛ an nya kagbene m ba Ebɔrɛ na be kuwurputiakpa, kakpa nɛ kuwɔr be kakɛ wɔ na. Ndoŋ nɛ Ebɔrɛ beeŋ wu anyi kuwɔr nɛ an nya kuwɔr be kakɛ mo nɛ k beeŋ chɛ anyi to saŋɛ nɛ k daga na.

english_verse: Every high priest is appointed to help others by offering gifts and sacrifices to God because of their sins.
translation_verse: Bɔrɛmatapo nimuso kikɛ, mo braana edimɛdi to nɛ baa lara mo nɛ e bee yili bumo be katelamu to a shuŋ Ebɔrɛ nsaa bar Ebɔrɛ ŋkɛana nɛ esarga ŋkpal alubiana so.

english_verse: This is why he must offer sacrifices for his own sins and for the sins of others.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal loŋ so Ebɔrɛ nase kumo nna fanɛ e lara sarga. Mannɛ ŋkpal basa pɔtɛ be alubi nawule so, ama ŋkpal mo alɛ gbagba peya gba so.

english_verse: But no one can have the honor of being a high priest simply by wanting to be one. Only God can choose a priest, and God is the one who chose Aaron.
translation_verse: Esa kama maaŋ tiŋ n ta le be bunyaŋ be kushuŋ ere n sa mo gbagba be kumu. Ebɔrɛ nawule e naaŋ tre esa n ta loŋ be kushuŋ m bɔɔ mo enɔ fanɛ kananɛ e daŋ tre Ɛɛrɔn na nɛ e daŋ juŋkpar ŋ ki bɔrɛmatapo nimuso na.

english_verse: This is how it was with Christ. He became a high priest, but not just because he wanted the honor of being one. It was God who told him, “You are my Son, because today I have become your Father!”
translation_verse: To, loŋ nɛ Kristo gba daa maŋ ta bɔrɛmatapo nimuso be keki na be bunyaŋ n sa mbe kumu. Ebɔrɛ nɛ e daŋ kaŋɛ mo fanɛ: “M Pibinyɛn e la fo, amoso, kabre ŋ ki fo Tuto”

english_verse: In another place, God says, “You are a priest forever just like Melchizedek.”
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ e naŋ kaŋɛ kakpa ko fanɛ: “Feeŋ baa la bɔrɛmatapo nsaa wɔtɔ mbaanaayɔ fanɛ bɔrɛmatapo nɛ e shi Mɛlkizedɛk be kanaŋ to.”

english_verse: God had the power to save Jesus from death. And while Jesus was on earth, he begged God with loud crying and tears to save him. He truly worshiped God, and God listened to his prayers.
translation_verse: Yesu ka daa wɔ ŋkpa to durnya ere to na e daa ta kushu nɛ anishichubi nna a wɔ kabɔrɛkule to nseŋ daa kaŋɛ Ebɔrɛ nɛ e daa beeŋ tiŋ m mɔlga mo ashi luwu to na mbe asheŋ tirso. Ebɔrɛ malɛ daŋ nu mbe kekule na ŋkpal mbe kabɔrɛŋana so.

english_verse: Jesus is God's own Son, but still he had to suffer before he could learn what it really means to obey God.
translation_verse: Kashenteŋto mo e daa la Ebinyɛn na, ama e daŋ bɔla mbe tɔrɔ to nna ŋ koya kusɔ nɛ k la kasonu.

english_verse: This is because God chose him to be a high priest like Melchizedek. Warning against Turning Away
translation_verse: Nɛ Ebɔrɛ malɛ ta mo ŋ ki bɔrɛmatapo nimuso ashi Mɛlkizedɛk be ekpa so. Kebaade kefoe ekpa so be asheŋ

english_verse: Much more could be said about this subject. But it is hard to explain, and all of you are slow to understand.
translation_verse: Le be demu ere to an kɔ asɔ damta nɛ an malga, ama kekaŋɛ menyi asheŋ na nɛ men pin amo to du kpakpa nna ŋkpal men ka maŋ naa pin asheŋ na to manaŋ manaŋ na so.

english_verse: By now you should have been teachers, but once again you need to be taught the simplest things about what God has said. You need milk instead of solid food.
translation_verse: A daŋ daga fanɛ men baa la beŋinipo naniere, ama hale mbre she esa e naaŋ laŋɛ ŋ ŋini menyi kashenteŋ be abɔrɛsheŋ be sososo na, men maa pin to. A daŋ daga fanɛ men baa tiŋ a ji ajibi gbɛgbɛso naniere, ama kenyipo nɛ menyi alɛ kraa nuu na.

english_verse: People who live on milk are like babies who don't really know what is right.
translation_verse: Esa kama malɛ nɛ e kraa nuu kenyipo kraa la kebibi nna na, e maŋ naŋ pin Ebɔrɛ be anishito be alelasheŋ be keŋini to.

english_verse: Solid food is for mature people who have been trained to know right from wrong.
translation_verse: Ama ajibi gbɛgbɛso bre la basa kpar nɛ bumo gbagba koya nsaa nyi kelela nɛ kulubi to na peya nna.

english_verse: We must try to become mature and start thinking about more than just the basic things we were taught about Christ. We shouldn't need to keep talking about why we ought to turn from deeds that bring death and why we ought to have faith in God.
translation_verse: Amoso, men shin nɛ an baa yige sososo be asheŋ nɛ a bee kute Kristo na to nseŋ yɔ anishito n ya luri kenimufɛra be kebaawɔtɔ to. A maŋ naŋ daga an ka naŋ fara sososo be keŋiniana na a ŋini fanɛ an ka naa tɔl kelar aworbi nɛ a maŋ kɔ tɔnɔ Ebɔrɛ be anishito na to kikɛ.

english_verse: And we shouldn't need to keep teaching about baptisms or about the laying on of hands or about people being raised from death and the future judgment.
translation_verse: A maŋ daga fanɛ an naa ŋini keyirda Ebɔrɛ be asheŋ ŋko n naa ŋini menyi kabɔrɛbɛrana be keŋini nɛ enɔana be kebaata a deŋi basa so ŋko basa be ketiŋi luwu to be asheŋ nɛ demuji be kasogberge nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na be asheŋ kuraa.

english_verse: But what about people who turn away after they have already seen the light and have received the gift from heaven and have shared in the Holy Spirit? What about those who turn away after they have received the good message of God and the powers of the future world? There is no way to bring them back. What they are doing is the same as nailing the Son of God to a cross and insulting him in public!
translation_verse: Ade malɛ kikɛ nɛ b nyi nseŋ foe ekpa na. Amoso, kenaŋ bɛta bumo m ba kelar bumo be alubi to maaŋ tiŋ n wora, ŋkpal manɛ so, bumo ere naa gbir Ebɔrɛ Pibinyɛn na nna a mata kedibi largato na so nna na n naa ŋaba mo basa kikɛ be anishito.

english_verse: A field is useful to farmers, if there is enough rain to make good crops grow. In fact, God will bless such a field.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, kasawule kama nɛ k bee nu bɔrɛchu nɛ a bee kaa tɔr kumo so nsaa sɔr asɔrso nɛ a daga a sa basa nɛ b duu asɔ kumo so na bee nya Ebɔrɛ be nɛfa nna.

english_verse: But land that produces only thornbushes is worthless. It is likely to fall under God's curse, and in the end it will be set on fire.
translation_verse: Ama kasawule kama nɛ k bee kɔr ewidibiana nɛ ajinjɛ nawule la kasawule jiga nna, nɛ kumo alɛ maŋ de so, k beeŋ nya kɔnɔso nɛ kumo be kaman b chɔɔ kumo edɛ.

english_verse: My friends, we are talking this way. But we are sure that you are doing those really good things people do when they are being saved.
translation_verse: Ŋ kurgepo shasoana, kashenteŋ nna nɛ anyee kaŋɛ le be asheŋ ere, ama menyi ere, an kɔ yirda fanɛ asheŋ lela wɔ menyi to.

english_verse: God is always fair. He will remember how you helped his people in the past and how you are still helping them. You belong to God, and he won't forget the love you have shown his people.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ maŋ la esa nɛ e maa wora asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so nna nɛ e teŋ menyi be kushuŋ na so nseŋ naŋ teŋ kechɛto nɛ men kpal kasha mo nɛ men kɔ a sha mo na so n chɛ mbe basa to nseŋ kraa chɛ bumo to na so.

english_verse: We wish each of you would always be eager to show how strong and lasting your hope really is.
translation_verse: To, loŋ gbagba na nɛ anyee sha fanɛ menyi be ekama e baa kraa pere kenishi a du n ya fo ekar na, saŋɛ na so, asɔ nɛ menyee tama na beeŋ bɔla ekpa.

english_verse: Then you would never be lazy. You would be following the example of those who had faith and were patient until God kept his promise to them. God's Promise Is Sure
translation_verse: Anyi maa sha fanɛ men ki betɔlpo, ama anyee sha fanɛ men baa kute bumo nɛ b ta yirda nɛ kanyiti n nya kusɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ nase kɔnɔ ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ e beeŋ sa na to. Ebɔrɛ be kɔnɔ naseso nɛ k maa chɛrga na be asheŋ

english_verse: Then after Abraham had been very patient, he was given what God had promised.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Eebraham ji kanyiti loŋ n ya nya kusɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ yɛ e beeŋ wora na.

english_verse: When anyone wants to settle an argument, they make a vow by using the name of someone or something greater than themselves.
translation_verse: Nɛ basa baa bɔ ntaŋ, esa nɛ e chɔ bumo be ketre nɛ baa kaa ti a bɔ ntaŋ na a ji kashenteŋ a mɔ emɔrɔ kama nɛ k wɔ bumo be nfɛra to.

english_verse: So when God wanted to prove for certain his promise to his people could not be broken, he made a vow.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ daa sha keŋini basa nɛ baaŋ nya kusɔ nɛ e nase kɔnɔ ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ e beeŋ wora na fanɛ e maaŋ chɛrga mbe kɔnɔ naseso na kikɛ, amoso nɛ e bɔ ntaŋ n sa bumo na.

english_verse: God cannot tell lies! And so his promises and vows are two things that can never be changed. We have run to God for safety. Now his promises should greatly encourage us to take hold of the hope that is right in front of us.
translation_verse: Naniere an nya asɔ anyɔ nɛ a maaŋ tiŋ n chɛrga, ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ maaŋ tiŋ ŋ ku efɛ kikɛ. Asɔ anyɔ na so nɛ anyi nɛ an shuli m mata Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ nya kagbene a kɔ kumɔlga be tama nɛ k wɔ anishito na to kpakpa.

english_verse: This hope is like a firm and steady anchor for our souls. In fact, hope reaches behind the curtain and into the most holy place.
translation_verse: Le be tama ere e shin nɛ anyi be yirda nɛ k wɔ anyi be ŋgbene to na bee wora eleŋ nɛnɛ a yili fanɛ kananɛ baa chɛ ekuloŋ a muni na a jo saŋɛ nɛ anyeeŋ nya n luri acheembiana to be kakpa cheembi to na.

english_verse: Jesus has gone there ahead of us, and he is our high priest forever, just like Melchizedek.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nɛ Kristo kpal anyi so n juŋkpar anyi n ya kaa wɔ na. Mo koŋwule na e ki bɔrɛmatapo nimuso ashi Mɛlkizedɛk be ekpa so.

english_verse: Melchizedek was both king of Salem and priest of God Most High. He was the one who went out and gave Abraham his blessing, when Abraham returned from killing the kings.
translation_verse: Mɛlkizedɛk nɛ anyee malga mbe asheŋ ere daa la Seelɛm be ewura nna nseŋ daŋ naa la Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ be bɔrɛmatapo. Kachako Eebraham ya mɔ bewura ko ashi kena to nseŋ bɛta a yɔ epe nɛ Mɛlkizedɛk ya tu mo ekpa to nseŋ nɛfa mo.

english_verse: Then Abraham gave him a tenth of everything he had. The meaning of the name Melchizedek is “King of Justice.” But since Salem means “peace,” he is also “King of Peace.”
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Eebraham sa Mɛlkizedɛk kusɔ kama nɛ e daŋ nya na be kudukudusopo. Kusɔ nɛ k juŋkpar Mɛlkizedɛk be asheŋ to e la fanɛ mbe ketre be kifito e la Ebɔrɛ be anishito be alelasheŋ be ewura. Kede malɛ be kaman Seelɛm be ewura e la mo, kumo e la fanɛ kagbenewushi be ewura.

english_verse: We are not told he had a father or mother or ancestors or beginning or end. He is like the Son of God and will be a priest forever.
translation_verse: Esa maŋ nyi mo nio nɛ mo tuto be asheŋ ŋko mbe kanaŋ to be asheŋ. Esa malɛ maŋ naa nyi mbe kakurgeachɛ be jemanɛ ŋko saŋɛ mo nɛ e wu. E du fanɛ Ebɔrɛ Pibinyɛn nna a la bɔrɛmatapo mo nɛ e wɔtɔ mbaanaayɔ.

english_verse: Notice how great Melchizedek was! Our famous ancestor Abraham gave him a tenth of what he had taken from his enemies.
translation_verse: Nɛ fo keni to feeŋ pin fanɛ Mɛlkizedɛk daa la esagboŋ nna pasaa, ŋkpal manɛ so, an nananyɛn Eebraham gba daŋ sa mo mbe kena to be kanya kikɛ be kudukudusopo nna.

english_verse: The Law teaches that even Abraham's descendants must give a tenth of what they possess. And they are to give this to their own relatives, who are the descendants of Levi and are priests.
translation_verse: Anebi Mosis be mbra na malɛ e daŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ a daga fanɛ Livai be kanaŋ to ebi nɛ b ki bɔrɛmatapoana na e baa sɔ bumo peebi Israɛlebi kudukudusopo ŋkeshin nɛ bumo alɛ gba la Eebraham mo nanabiana nna.

english_verse: Although Melchizedek wasn't a descendant of Levi, Abraham gave him a tenth of what he had. Then Melchizedek blessed Abraham, who had been given God's promise.
translation_verse: Mɛlkizedɛk daa maŋ shi Livai be kanaŋ to, ama mo alɛ daŋ sɔ asɔ be kudukudusopo ashi Eebraham kutɔ nseŋ nɛfa mo Eebraham koŋwule nɛ Ebɔrɛ ta mbe nnɔ naseso n sa na.

english_verse: Everyone agrees a person who gives a blessing is greater than the one who receives the blessing.
translation_verse: Ekama malɛ baa nyi geeŋ fanɛ esa nɛ e bee nɛfa mo barkasa e chɔ emo nɛ e bee nya nɛfa na ŋko?

english_verse: Priests are given a tenth of what people earn. But all priests die, except Melchizedek, and the Scriptures teach that he is alive.
translation_verse: Nɛ fo keni to feeŋ wu fanɛ bɔrɛmatapoana na bre be kaplɛa so, basa nɛ baa wu e naa sɔ kudukudusopo na, ama Mɛlkizedɛk bre, esa nɛ abɔrɛsibɛ bee kaŋɛ fanɛ e wɔ ŋkpa to na e daŋ sɔ kudukudusopo na.

english_verse: Levi's descendants are now the ones who receive a tenth from people. We could even say that when Abraham gave Melchizedek a tenth, Levi also gave him a tenth.
translation_verse: Amoso, esa beeŋ tiŋ ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ Livai nɛ e bee sɔ kudukudusopo na gba bɔla Eebraham so nna ŋ ka mbe kudukudusopo nna na.

english_verse: Even though the Law of Moses says the priests must be descendants of Levi, those priests cannot make anyone perfect. So there needs to be a priest like Melchizedek, rather than one from the priestly family of Aaron.
translation_verse: Nɛ fanɛ esa daŋ baŋ tiŋ m bɔla Livai be kanaŋ to be bɔrɛmatapoana na be ekpa so nna n nya kebaawɔtɔ cheembi loŋ malɛ be ekpa so nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ ta mbra na n sa basa, a ji nuso nna nɛ a daŋ naŋ daga fanɛ bɔrɛmatapo pɔtɛ ka naŋ ba kaa du fanɛ Mɛlkizedɛk be ekpa so, mannɛ bɔrɛmatapo nimuso Ɛɛrɔn be ekpa so?

english_verse: And when the rules for selecting a priest are changed, the Law must also be changed.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, nɛ b baŋ chɛrga bɔrɛmatapoana na be keji ekpa, kumo ere, a daga b ka chɛrga mbra na gba.

english_verse: The person we are talking about is our Lord, who came from a tribe that had never had anyone to serve as a priest at the altar.
translation_verse: Esa nɛ asheŋ ere bee ji mbe asheŋ ere malɛ shi kanaŋ pɔtɛ to nna, esa kama maŋ naŋ lar kanaŋ na to n shuŋ bɔrɛsure na akpa kikɛ.

english_verse: Everyone knows he came from the tribe of Judah, and Moses never said priests would come from that tribe.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, k baŋ fuli nna fanɛ Juda be kanaŋ to nɛ an Nyɛnpe na lar. Mosis malɛ maŋ malga shɛŋ ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ kanaŋ na ti bɔrɛmatapoana na so.

english_verse: All of this becomes clearer, when someone who is like Melchizedek is appointed to be a priest.
translation_verse: Kusɔ nɛ an naa kaŋɛ ere malɛ gba e naa bugi ashuŋ na to nɛnɛ gba kuraa fanɛ bɔrɛmatapo popɔr ko malɛ fanɛ Mɛlkizedɛk naŋ lar.

english_verse: That person wasn't appointed because of his ancestors, but because his life can never end.
translation_verse: Mo ere, mannɛ dimɛdi be ekpaana so nɛ e bɔla ŋ ki bɔrɛmatapo, ŋkpa nɛ esa maaŋ tiŋ n jija so nɛ e bɔla ŋ ki.

english_verse: The Scriptures say about him, “You are a priest forever, just like Melchizedek.”
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ fanɛ Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ Yesu fanɛ: “Feeŋ baa la bɔrɛmatapo mbaanaayɔ Mɛlkizedɛk be ekpa so.”

english_verse: because the Law cannot make anything perfect. At the same time, we are given a much better hope, and it can bring us close to God.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, Mosis be mbra na daa maŋ tiŋ n ta shɛŋ ŋ ki cheembi. Ama naniere tama popɔr naŋ ba nɛ an bɔla kumo so n firgi n taga Ebɔrɛ to.

english_verse: God himself made a promise when this priest was appointed. But he did not make a promise like this when the other priests were appointed. The promise he made is, “I, the Lord, promise that you will be a priest forever! And I will never change my mind!”
translation_verse: Ama Yesu bre, ntaŋ so nɛ e daŋ bɔla ŋ ki bɔrɛmatapo saŋɛ nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ: “Ma, Enyɛnpe bɔ ntaŋ, ma alɛ maaŋ chɛrga ma nfɛra fanɛ feeŋ baa la bɔrɛmatapo mbaanaayɔ na.”

english_verse: But Jesus will never die, and so he will be a priest forever!
translation_verse: Ama Yesu bre wɔtɔ nna mbaanaayɔ, amoso, esa kikɛ maŋ naa sɔ mo so ashi kabɔrɛmata be kushuŋ na to.

english_verse: He is forever able to save the people he leads to God, because he always lives to speak to God for them.
translation_verse: Amoso, e beeŋ tiŋ m mɔlga basa nɛ baa bɔla mo so a yɔ Ebɔrɛ kutɔ naniere nɛ saŋkama, ashi bumo be alubi to, ŋkpal manɛ so, saŋkikɛ e wɔtɔ nna a kule Ebɔrɛ a sa anyi.

english_verse: Jesus is the high priest we need. He is holy and innocent and faultless, and not at all like us sinners. Jesus is honored above all beings in heaven,
translation_verse: Amoso, mo e la bɔrɛmatapo nimuso nɛ e beeŋ tiŋ ŋ keni anyi be asheŋ to nɛnɛ n sa anyi. Mo e du cheembi nɛ shɛŋ maŋ gbiti mo, kulubi kama malɛ maŋ wɔ mo to. Ebɔrɛ lara mo nna nɛ e maŋ wɔ alubiworapoana to nseŋ maŋ mo so n yɔ esoso a chɔ awɔlpa so.

english_verse: and he is better than any other high priest. Jesus doesn't need to offer sacrifices each day for his own sins and then for the sins of the people. He offered a sacrifice once for all, when he gave himself.
translation_verse: Mo alɛ maŋ du fanɛ bɔrɛmatapo nimusoana nɛ b daa wɔtɔ a lara esarga kachɛ kama ŋkpal bumo gbagba be alubi so pɔɛŋ nseŋ daa lara esarga ŋkpal basa pɔtɛ malɛ be alubi so na. Mo ere, sarga koŋwule kpeiŋ nɛ e baŋ lara n sa basa kikɛ saŋɛ nɛ e daŋ ta mbe kumu n sa fanɛ sarga na.

english_verse: The Law appoints priests who have weaknesses. But God's promise, which came later than the Law, appoints his Son. And he is the perfect high priest forever.
translation_verse: Basa nɛ asheŋ ere gben bumo nɛ mbra na bre daa lara nɛ baa ki bɔrɛmatapo nimusoana. Ebɔrɛ be ntaŋ nɛ k bɛ mbra na so m ba na bre lara Ebinyɛn nɛ e ki cheembi mbaanaayɔ na nna.

english_verse: What I mean is we have a high priest who sits at the right side of God's great throne in heaven.
translation_verse: Kusɔ nɛ anyee malga ere kikɛ nde fanɛ an kɔ bɔrɛmatapo nimuso mo nɛ e chena Ebɔrɛ be jisoso ashi mbe kemaŋkuragboŋ be kuwurputi ase ebɔrɛso.

english_verse: He also serves as the priest in the most holy place inside the real tent there in heaven. This tent of worship was set up by the Lord, not by humans.
translation_verse: Mo koŋwule na e naa shuŋ mbe kabɔrɛmata be kushuŋ ashi mboŋ cheembiana to be kakpa cheembi to na, ndoŋ e la kashenteŋ be wajɛlambu nɛ Enyɛnpe gbagba yuu na. Mannɛ nyiŋgbasa gbagba e ta enɔ n wora kumo.

english_verse: If he were here on earth, he would not be a priest at all, because here the Law appoints other priests to offer sacrifices.
translation_verse: Nɛ e daa wɔ kasawule ere so nna e daa maaŋ ki bɔrɛmatapo kikɛ, ŋkpal manɛ so, basa nɛ baa ta ŋkɛana a bar Ebɔrɛ mbra na be ekpa so tea wɔtɔ.

english_verse: But the tent where they serve is just a copy and a shadow of the real one in heaven. Before Moses made the tent, he was told, “Be sure to make it exactly like the pattern you were shown on the mountain!”
translation_verse: Le be basa ere shuŋ kakpa cheembi nɛ k du fanɛ ebɔrɛso be kakpa cheembi be kiyoyu na to, ŋkpal manɛ so, anebi Mosis ka daa shin nɛ e yuu wajɛlambu cheembi na, le nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ ŋini mo kumo be asheŋ ŋ kaŋɛ: “Nyiŋi n wora kusɔ kama nɛ k bɛ kakpa cheembi be kaduli mo nɛ n daŋ ŋini fo ashi kebee na so na so.”

english_verse: If the first agreement with God had been all right, there would not have been any need for another one.
translation_verse: To, nɛ fanɛ shɛŋ daa maa kɔ Ebɔrɛ nɛ dimɛdi be nferinto be kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre dra na nna, dafanɛ kepopɔr kama daa maaŋ naŋ bɛ so n lar.

english_verse: But the Lord found fault with it and said, “I tell you the time will come, when I will make a new agreement with the people of Israel and the people of Judah.
translation_verse: Ama Ebɔrɛ daŋ wu kulubi mbe basa Israɛlebi so nna nseŋ daŋ kaŋɛ le fanɛ: “Ma Enyɛnpe e naa kaŋɛ le na fanɛ saŋko bee fo nɛ n nase kɔnɔ naseso popɔr ashi ma nɛ ma basa Israɛlebi nɛ Juda be kanaŋ to ebi be nferinto.

english_verse: It won't be like the agreement that I made with their ancestors, when I took them by the hand and led them out of Egypt. They broke their agreement with me, and I stopped caring about them!
translation_verse: Ma Enyɛnpe na naŋ kaŋɛ: Loŋ be kɔnɔ naseso na maaŋ baa du fanɛ kumo nɛ n nase n sa bumo nananyɛnana kachɛ nɛ m pɛ bumo be enɔana n lara bumo ashi Ijipt be kasawule so na. Ŋkpal b ka daa maŋ ji bumo be amu kashenteŋ m bɛ ma kɔnɔ naseso so n ya fo ekar na so, m pal ma kaman nna n sa bumo.

english_verse: “But now I tell the people of Israel this is my new agreement: ‘The time will come when I, the Lord, will write my laws on their minds and hearts. I will be their God, and they will be my people.
translation_verse: Ma, Enyɛnpe na naŋ kaŋɛ: Amo be saŋɛ na be kaman le be kɔnɔ naseso ere nɛ meeŋ nase n sa Israɛlebi fanɛ: Meeŋ ta ma mbraana n wɔtɔ bumo be nfɛraana to nseŋ sibɛ amo n deŋi bumo be ŋgbeneana so. Meeŋ baa la bumo be Ebɔrɛ nɛ bumo alɛ e baa la ma basa.

english_verse: Not one of them will have to teach another to know me, their Lord.’ “All of them will know me, no matter who they are.
translation_verse: Saŋɛ na baŋ fo, bumo be ekama maaŋ kaŋɛ mo barkasa ŋko ŋ kaŋɛ mbe efuli so be esa kama fanɛ: ‘Pin Enyɛnpe na.’ Ŋkpal manɛ so, baŋ yili bumo be ebibiso n ya fo bumo be ejuŋkparpo, ekama nyam beeŋ baa nyi ma.

english_verse: I will treat them with kindness, even though they are wicked. I will forget their sins.”
translation_verse: Meeŋ ta bumo be alubisheŋ m paŋ bumo ŋkaa maaŋ naŋ nyiŋi bumo be alubi na kikɛ.”

english_verse: When the Lord talks about a new agreement, he means that the first one is out of date. And anything that is old and useless will soon disappear.
translation_verse: To, kananɛ e bee tre kɔnɔ naseso ere kusɔ popɔr ere bee ŋini fanɛ e ta sososo peya na nna ŋ ki kedra na. Kusɔ kama malɛ nɛ k chɛr bee dra to nna a maŋ naa chɛr ko nsaa choŋ kuraa.

english_verse: The first part of the tent was called the holy place, and a lampstand, a table, and the sacred loaves of bread were kept there.
translation_verse: B daŋ yuu wajɛlambu nna, nɛ kumo be ebu juŋkparso nɛ baa tre kakpa cheembi na daa kɔ patisa. Ndoŋ nɛ fitila na nɛ teebɔl na nɛ bodobodo nɛ b kɔ a sa Ebɔrɛ na kikɛ daa wɔ na.

english_verse: The gold altar for burning incense was in this holy place. The gold-covered sacred chest was also there, and inside it were three things. First, there was a gold jar filled with manna. Then there was Aaron's walking stick that sprouted. Finally, there were the flat stones with the Ten Commandments written on them.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nɛ shuwa be bɔrɛsure nɛ baa chɔɔ duwu kumo so na wɔ. Ndoŋ koŋwule na nɛ kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre be deka nɛ duwu mata m mata kumo kikɛ so na daa wɔ nɛ shuwa be kapuya nɛ k kɔ manna na. Ɛɛrɔn be kekpabi nɛ k bee purge afantaŋ na nɛ ajembu anyɔ nɛ b sibɛ mbraana na n deŋi so na malɛ kikɛ daa wɔ deka na to nna.

english_verse: On top of the chest were the glorious creatures with wings opened out above the place of mercy. Now isn't the time to go into detail about these things.
translation_verse: Asɔ pɔrso anyɔ ko nɛ baa tre chɛrubim nɛ a daa ŋini fanɛ Ebɔrɛ be kemaŋkura wɔ ndoŋ na daa yuu deka na be kumu so nna m parga to m buu kakpa nɛ baa tre kuwɔr be kakpa na. Ama anyi maaŋ tiŋ m malga m malga asheŋ ere to n luri to n loge.

english_verse: But this is how everything was when the priests went each day into the first part of the tent to do their duties.
translation_verse: To, kananɛ asheŋ na daa du m bɛ abar so nna na nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana na daa luri a luri ebu juŋkparso na to n ya kaa shuŋ bumo be ashuŋana saŋkama nseŋ daa lar.

english_verse: However, only the high priest could go into the second part of the tent, and he went in only once a year. Each time he carried blood to offer for his sins and for any sins that the people had committed without meaning to.
translation_verse: Ama bɔrɛmatapo nimuso na nawule e daa luri ebu nyɔsopo na to kela koŋwule kafɛ kama to. Mo alɛ gba daa maaŋ tiŋ n luri ndoŋ ama e ta ŋklaŋ nna n luri n ya lara mo gbagba be alubi so be sarga nseŋ naŋ yili basa na be katelamu to n lara sarga ŋkpal bumo be alubi nɛ b wora a maŋ de so na so.

english_verse: All of this is the Holy Spirit's way of saying no one could enter the most holy place while the tent was still the place of worship.
translation_verse: Ade kikɛ nɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na kɔ a ŋini geeŋ fanɛ ekpa mo nɛ esa beeŋ bɔla so n yɔ acheembiana to be kakpa cheembi na to na daa maŋ naŋ bugi n sa basa ŋkpal ebu juŋkparso na ka daŋ kraa yil na so.

english_verse: These rules are merely about such things as eating and drinking and ceremonies for washing ourselves. And rules about physical things will last only until the time comes to change them for something better.
translation_verse: Asɔ na be asheŋ la asɔ jiso nɛ asɔ nuusoana nɛ daŋkare be eyurana so be kefɔr nna. Amo alɛ nseŋ naa la eyur so be atande nɛ a baa wɔtɔ n ya fo jemanɛ nɛ Ebɔrɛ beeŋ shin nɛ asɔ kikɛ e naŋ bɔla ekpa na. Yesu Kristo be ŋklaŋ be asheŋ

english_verse: Christ came as the high priest of the good things that are now here. He also went into a much better tent that wasn't made by humans and that doesn't belong to this world.
translation_verse: Ama naniere bre Kristo ki alelasheŋ nɛ a ba na be bɔrɛmatapo nimuso nna. E bɔla lambu nɛ k shibi a chɔ wajɛlambu dra na to nna m ba. Kede bre, mannɛ nyiŋgbasa e pɔr kumo, kumo e la fanɛ mannɛ durnya ere to be kusɔ e la kumo.

english_verse: Then Christ went once for all into the most holy place and freed us from sin forever. He did this by offering his own blood instead of the blood of goats and bulls.
translation_verse: E ka daŋ luri lambu na to kela koŋwule pati na, mannɛ mboe nɛ anabi be ŋklaŋ nɛ e daŋ ta n luri ndoŋ. Mo gbagba be ŋklaŋ nɛ e daŋ ta n luri acheembiana to be kakpa cheembi na to n ya nya kesɔnyige be kebaawɔtɔ nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na n sa anyi.

english_verse: According to the Law of Moses, those people who become unclean are not fit to worship God. Yet they will be considered clean, if they are sprinkled with the blood of goats and bulls and with the ashes of a sacrificed calf.
translation_verse: Nɛ kananɛ b daŋ ta mboeana nɛ egboluana be ŋklaŋ nɛ ana fɔlbi be nsunɔ ŋ ŋmenyaŋ n wurge basa nɛ b daa kɔ eyurpi bumo so na so nɛ a lar bumo so nɛ b nyalɛ so ere,

english_verse: But Christ was sinless, and he offered himself as an eternal and spiritual sacrifice to God. This is why his blood is much more powerful and makes our consciences clear. Now we can serve the living God and no longer do things that lead to death.
translation_verse: kumo ere, kusɔ nɛ Yesu be ŋklaŋ na bre beeŋ tiŋ n wora shi pasaa. Ŋkpal manɛ so, e bɔla Kiyoyu nɛ e wɔ ŋkpa to saŋkama na so nna n ta mo gbagba be kumu nɛ k maŋ kɔ kulubi kikɛ na n lara sarga n sa Ebɔrɛ. Mbe ŋklaŋ na e naa fɔr anyi be ŋgbeneana to be nfɛra fɛsoana ashi amo be aworbi jiga to na, saŋɛ na so anyeeŋ tiŋ n shuŋ Ebɔrɛ nɛ e wɔ ŋkpa to na.

english_verse: In fact, making an agreement of this kind is like writing a will. This is because the one who makes the will must die before it is of any use.
translation_verse: Kaplɛkama nɛ esa nase mbe luwu be kaman be aparsheŋ be kɔnɔ, mbe luwu be kaman nɛ kesheŋ nɛ e kaŋɛ na beeŋ tiŋ n wora, mannɛ saŋɛ nɛ e kraa wɔ ŋkpa to na.

english_verse: In other words, a will doesn't go into effect as long as the one who made it is still alive.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, esa baa maŋ naŋ wu, mbe luwu be kaman be kɔnɔ naseso maaŋ tiŋ n shuŋ ama e baŋ wu nna.

english_verse: Moses told the people all the Law said they must do. Then he used red wool and a hyssop plant to sprinkle the people and the book of the Law with the blood of bulls and goats and with water.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, an ta fanɛ Mosis le. E ka daŋ kaŋɛ basa na kikɛ mbra na be ntaŋana na kikɛ n loge, e daŋ ta ateebi nɛ b nyɔɔ kepeper nna ŋ kre kedibi ko nɛ baa tre hisɔp na so. Kumo be kaman nɛ e naŋ ta kumo n nyɔɔ anabiana be ŋklaŋ to nɛ nchu to nseŋ ta ŋ ŋmenyaŋ n wurge basa na kikɛ nɛ mbra be kawɔl na so

english_verse: He told the people, “With this blood God makes his agreement with you.”
translation_verse: nseŋ kaŋɛ le: “Kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre be mbra nɛ Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ fanɛ men baa bɛ kumo so na nna na.”

english_verse: The Law says that almost everything must be sprinkled with blood, and no sins can be forgiven unless blood is offered. Christ's Great Sacrifice
translation_verse: Kashenteŋto malɛ, mbra na bee ŋini fanɛ ŋklaŋ nɛ baa ta a fɔr asɔ be galeŋga so, nɛ ŋklaŋ malɛ baa maŋ lar, Ebɔrɛ be keta alubi m paŋ basa maŋ wɔtɔ. Kristo be sarga nawule ka bee ta alubi a paŋ be asheŋ

english_verse: These things are only copies of what is in heaven, and so they had to be made holy by these ceremonies. But the real things in heaven must be made holy by something better.
translation_verse: Asɔ ere la ebɔrɛso be kaduli be asɔ nna nɛ a daga b ka bɔla le be aworbi ere so n fɔr amo so. Ama ebɔrɛso be asɔ bre gbagba, esarga nɛ k chɔ ade peyaana ere nawule e naaŋ tiŋ n fɔr amo so.

english_verse: This is why Christ did not go into a tent made by humans and was only a copy of the real one. Instead, he went into heaven and is now there with God to help us.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, mannɛ lambu cheembi nɛ dimɛdi gbagba daŋ wora nɛ k daŋ duli lambu cheembi gbagba na to nɛ Kristo daŋ luri. Ebɔrɛso gbagba nɛ e daŋ luri n ya kaa yil naniere anyi be katelamu to a shuŋ Ebɔrɛ be anishito.

english_verse: Christ did not have to offer himself many times. He wasn't like a high priest who goes into the most holy place each year to offer the blood of an animal.
translation_verse: Mo nawule e maŋ du fanɛ bɔrɛmatapo nimusoana nɛ b daa ta ŋklaŋ nɛ a maŋ la bumo gbagba peyaana a luri acheembiana to be kakpa cheembi kafɛ kafɛ a lar na. Mo ere daa maŋ luri n ta mbe kumu n lara sarga ale damta.

english_verse: If he had offered himself every year, he would have suffered many times since the creation of the world. But instead, near the end of time he offered himself once and for all, so he could be a sacrifice that does away with sin.
translation_verse: Nɛ mannɛ aloŋ nna e daa beeŋ yili kasɔto be jemanɛ na kikɛ n ji tɔrɔ ale damta loŋ m ba fo kabre. Ama kumo alɛ, kela koŋwule pati nɛ e lar efuli so saŋɛ nɛ jemanɛ kama to be ekar beeŋ fo na nseŋ ta mo gbagba be kumu n lara sarga nɛ k kpra alubi ashi basa kikɛ so.

english_verse: So Christ died only once to take away the sins of many people. But when he comes again, it will not be to take away sin. He will come to save everyone who is waiting for him.
translation_verse: To, loŋ koŋwule na nɛ b daŋ ta Kristo gba n lara sarga kela koŋwule pati nɛ e kpra basa damta be alubi ashi bumo so. Mo alɛ beeŋ naŋ bɛta kela nyɔsopo n lar m ba, ama kede bre, mannɛ alubi be kekpara so nɛ e bee ba, e kɔ kumɔlga nna a ba nɛ e ba sa bumo nɛ baa jo mo na kikɛ.

english_verse: The Law of Moses is like a shadow of the good things to come. This shadow isn't the good things themselves, because it cannot free people from sin by the sacrifices offered year after year.
translation_verse: Kashenteŋto, mbra na daa la kashenteŋ be asɔ nɛ a bee ba na be nduliana nawule nna, k maŋ la asɔ na gbagba. Amo be kaplɛa so, esarga koŋwule na nɛ baa lara a lara kafɛ kikɛ, amoso, le be mbra ere maŋ tiŋ n ta esa kama nɛ e ba Ebɔrɛ kutɔ ŋ ki esa cheembi kikɛ.

english_verse: If there were worshipers who already have their sins washed away and their consciences made clear, there would not be any need to go on offering sacrifices.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, nɛ fanɛ loŋ be esarga na daa tiŋ a lara basa be alubi ashi bumo to nna, dafanɛ b daa maŋ naŋ lara esargaana ere, ŋkpal manɛ so, b daŋ lar bumo be alubi na to kela koŋwule pati a maŋ naa kɔ alubi be nfɛra bumo to kikɛ.

english_verse: But the blood of bulls and goats cannot take away sins. It only reminds people of their sins from one year to the next.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, egbolu nɛ mboe be ŋklaŋ maaŋ tiŋ n lara esa be alubi ashi mo to kikɛ.

english_verse: When Christ came into the world, he said to God, “Sacrifices and offerings are not what you want, but you have given me my body.
translation_verse: Amoso, Kristo ka daŋ ba durnya to na, le nɛ e daŋ malga Ebɔrɛ be asheŋ ŋ kaŋɛ: “Mannɛ esarga nɛ ŋkɛana nɛ fo daa sha, ama eyur nɛ fo wora n sa ma na.

english_verse: No, you are not pleased with animal sacrifices and offerings for sin.”
translation_verse: Mannɛ fanɛ asɔbɔya nɛ b chɔɔ n lara esarga nɛ esarga nɛ a bee kule alubi be ketampaŋ nɛ fee sha.

english_verse: Then Christ said, “And so, my God, I have come to do what you want, as the Scriptures say.”
translation_verse: Ade so nɛ n daŋ kaŋɛ fo le na: ‘Ebɔrɛ, ma nde nɛ n wora fo aparsheŋ fanɛ kananɛ b sibɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na to a kaŋɛ ma asheŋ na.’ ”

english_verse: Well, it was to do away with offerings and sacrifices and to replace them. This is what he meant by saying to God, “I have come to do what you want.”
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ e naŋ kaŋɛ le: “Ebɔrɛ, ma nde nɛ n wora fo aparsheŋ.” Kede e naa ŋini fanɛ e lara esarga dra na nna ashi to nseŋ ta kepopɔr na n tal to.

english_verse: The priests do their work each day, and they keep on offering sacrifices that can never take away sins.
translation_verse: Kachɛ kama bɔrɛmatapo kama na yil mbe kushuŋ to nna a lara a lara esarga koŋwule gbiiŋ nɛ a maaŋ tiŋ n lara esa be alubi mo to kikɛ na.

english_verse: But Christ offered himself as a sacrifice that is good forever. Now he is sitting at God's right side,
translation_verse: Ama mo Yesu ere, sarga koŋwule pati nɛ e lara ŋkpal alubi so nɛ k bee kukwe a sa saŋkikɛ. Kumo be kaman nɛ e chena Ebɔrɛ be jisoso, ebunyampo be kakpa na.

english_verse: and he will stay there until his enemies are put under his power.
translation_verse: Naniere e bee jo nna nɛ Ebɔrɛ e ya ta mo doŋana n shin nɛ b gbir mo kumuli.

english_verse: By his one sacrifice he has forever set free from sin the people he brings to God.
translation_verse: Amoso, sarga koŋwule nɛ e baŋ ta n shin nɛ basa nɛ baa ki cheembi na bee ki basa cheembi na mbaanaayɔ.

english_verse: “When the time comes, I will make an agreement with them. I will write my laws on their minds and hearts.
translation_verse: “Ade be kaman kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre nɛ ma nɛ bumo beeŋ kre na nde: ‘Meeŋ ta ma mbraana n wɔtɔ bumo be ŋgbeneana to nseŋ sibɛ amo n deŋi bumo be nfɛraana so.’ ”

english_verse: Then I will forget about their sins and no longer remember their evil deeds.”
translation_verse: Kede be kaman nɛ e naŋ kaŋɛ le: “M maaŋ naŋ nyiŋi bumo be alubi nɛ edalubisheŋ kikɛ.”

english_verse: My friends, the blood of Jesus gives us courage to enter the most holy place
translation_verse: Amoso, bekurgepoana, naniere bre ekpa baŋ bugi pal nna n dese nɛ an luri acheembiana to be kakpa cheembi na to ŋkpal Yesu be ŋklaŋ na so.

english_verse: by a new way that leads to life! And this way takes us through the curtain that is Christ himself.
translation_verse: Mo e bugi ekpa popɔr, ŋkpa be ekpa n sa anyi. E bɔla patisa na to nna, kumo e la fanɛ mbe eyur na to nna n wora loŋ.

english_verse: We have a great high priest who is in charge of God's house.
translation_verse: Amoso, kananɛ an kɔ bɔrɛmatapogboŋ nɛ e bee keni Ebɔrɛ be kowu so ere,

english_verse: So let's come near God with pure hearts and a confidence that comes from having faith. Let's keep our hearts pure, our consciences free from evil, and our bodies washed with clean water.
translation_verse: men shin nɛ an ta kashenteŋ be ŋgbene nɛ yirda nɛ k maŋ kɔ shikashika nɛ ŋgbene mo nɛ b fɔr amo be nfɛra fɛso lubi n lɛ na nɛ eyurana nɛ b ta nchu mo nɛ a maŋ kɔ eyurpi amo to n fɔr na n firgi n taga Ebɔrɛ to.

english_verse: We must hold tightly to the hope we say is ours. After all, we can trust the one who made the agreement with us.
translation_verse: Men shin nɛ an baa kɔ anyi be shɛda na to kpakpa nsaa maa gbuŋgbuŋ to, ŋkpal manɛ so, esa nɛ e nase kɔnɔ n sa anyi na maa yɛ asheŋ a chɛrga kɔnɔ kikɛ.

english_verse: We should keep on encouraging each other to be thoughtful and to do helpful things.
translation_verse: Men shin nɛ an baa nyiŋi a leŋ abar to a wɔtɔ kasha nɛ aworbi lela to.

english_verse: Some people have given up the habit of meeting for worship, but we must not do that. We should keep on encouraging each other, especially since you know that the day of the Lord's coming is getting closer.
translation_verse: Men sa maŋ shin nɛ an baa kini kebaatu abar a shɛr fanɛ kananɛ basa ko bee kaa wora na. Ama men shin nɛ an baa leŋ abar to, fɔnfɔŋ kananɛ men wu lalaloge be kachɛ na ka bee fo le ere so.

english_verse: They are God's enemies, and all they can look forward to is a terrible judgment and a furious fire.
translation_verse: Kusɔ nɛ k baŋ ka n daga kaŋana e la fanɛ b baa tama kasogberge nɛ edɛ wuloŋwuloŋ nɛ a beeŋ chɔɔ Ebɔrɛ mo doŋana kikɛ m mur na.

english_verse: If two or more witnesses accused someone of breaking the Law of Moses, that person could be put to death.
translation_verse: Esa kama nɛ e keni anebi Mosis be mbra na jiga nɛ basa anyɔ baŋ ji kumo be loŋ be shɛda, amodoŋwura bee wu nna, kuwɔr maŋ wɔtɔ n sa mo.

english_verse: But it is much worse to dishonor God's Son and to disgrace the blood of the promise that made us holy. And it is just as bad to insult the Holy Spirit, who shows us mercy.
translation_verse: To, nɛ kananɛ k du le ere nɛ esa bee keni Ebɔrɛ Pibinyɛn na jiga ŋko a ta Ebɔrɛ be kɔnɔkoŋwule na be ŋkre be ŋklaŋ nɛ baa ta amo a fɔr basa so nɛ baa ki cheembi na fanɛ kusɔ nɛ k maŋ la shɛŋ ŋko a tege kuwɔr be kakɛ be Kiyoyu na bre, amodoŋwura be kasogberge beeŋ baa shi ga a chɔ Mosis be mbra na peya.

english_verse: It is a terrible thing to fall into the hands of the living God!
translation_verse: Kashenteŋto, shɛŋ shɛŋ maŋ naŋ lubi a chɔ esa be ketɔr Ebɔrɛ nɛ e wɔ ŋkpa to na be enɔ to kikɛ.

english_verse: Sometimes you were abused and mistreated in public, and at other times you shared in the sufferings of others.
translation_verse: Men nyiŋi saŋko b ka daa bugi to a tege menyi nseŋ daa tɔrɔ menyi nɛ saŋko malɛ b daa wora basa nɛ men daa maŋ lar bumo kaman na loŋ ŋko?

english_verse: You were kind to people in jail. And you gladly let your possessions be taken away, because you knew you had something better, something that would last forever.
translation_verse: Men daŋ tu basa nɛ b ti ebuana n ji awurfoŋ nɛ saŋɛ nɛ b daŋ ba suge menyi be asɔ na gba, men daŋ ta kagbenefuli n nyiti loŋ be kesheŋ na gba ŋkpal men ka daa nyi fanɛ men kɔ kusɔ nɛ k chɔ asɔ na ga nsaa maŋ kɔ ekar na so.

english_verse: Learn to be patient, so you will please God and be given what he has promised.
translation_verse: A daga fanɛ men baa kɔ kanyiti a kɔ to n tiŋ n wora Ebɔrɛ be aparsheŋ n nya kusɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ nase kɔnɔ fanɛ e beeŋ sa na.

english_verse: As the Scriptures say, “God is coming soon! It won't be very long.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, loŋ nɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ na fanɛ: “A ka gbrɛbi nɛ esa nɛ e bee ba na e ba, e maaŋ chɛr.

english_verse: The people God accepts will live because of their faith. But he isn't pleased with anyone who turns back.”
translation_verse: Ama ma basa nɛ b maŋ kɔ alubi ashi ma, Ebɔrɛ be anishito na bre beeŋ baa kɔ yirda a wɔtɔ. Ama nɛ bumo be ekama baŋ laŋɛ kaman bre, amodoŋwura be asheŋ maaŋ par ma.”

english_verse: We are not like those people who turn back and get destroyed. We will keep on having faith until we are saved.
translation_verse: Ama anyi maŋ la basa nɛ baa bɛta kaman a mur na nna, an la basa nɛ baa yirda nna a nya kumɔlga.

english_verse: Faith makes us sure of what we hope for and gives us proof of what we cannot see.
translation_verse: To, manɛ e la yirda? Yirda la kebaanyi geeŋ fanɛ anyeeŋ nya asɔ nɛ anyee tama na nseŋ naa nyi fanɛ asɔ nɛ anyi maaŋ tiŋ n wu kenishiso na kikɛ wɔtɔ nna kashenteŋto.

english_verse: It was their faith that made our ancestors pleasing to God.
translation_verse: Le be yirda ere so nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ kpaŋ bedrapo na.

english_verse: Because of our faith, we know that the world was made at God's command. We also know that what can be seen was made out of what cannot be seen.
translation_verse: Yirda so nɛ an pin fanɛ kamalga nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ ta n to esoso nɛ kasawule kikɛ. Amoso, asɔ nɛ anyee wu ere shi kusɔ nɛ esa daa maŋ wu kenishiso nna.

english_verse: Because Abel had faith, he offered God a better sacrifice than Cain did. God was pleased with him and his gift, and even though Abel is now dead, his faith still speaks for him.
translation_verse: Yirda so nɛ Ebel daŋ lara sarga lela n sa Ebɔrɛ a chɔ Keen peya. Kumo alɛ so nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ kpaŋ mo fanɛ elelapo ashi mo ere Ebɔrɛ be anishito, ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ gbagba daŋ sɔ mbe ŋkɛana na. Yirda malɛ so nɛ Ebel wu nseŋ kraa malga na.

english_verse: Because Noah had faith, he was warned about something that had not yet happened. He obeyed and built a boat that saved him and his family. In this way the people of the world were judged, and Noah was given the blessings that come to everyone who pleases God.
translation_verse: Yirda so nɛ Nowa daŋ nu Ebɔrɛ be kɔnɔ a yɛ asheŋ nɛ a daa beeŋ ba kachako so nɛ esa maŋ naŋ wu na. Ebɔrɛ ka daŋ kaŋɛ loŋ na e daŋ nu n sa mo nseŋ gbir kuloŋgboŋ nɛ mo nɛ mbe kanaŋ luri m mɔlga bumo be amu. Ŋkpal loŋ na so durnyaebi daa maŋ nya kashenteŋ, kumo be kaman nɛ e nya yirda be tɔnɔ, kumo e la fanɛ e ki elelapo Ebɔrɛ be anishito.

english_verse: Abraham had faith and obeyed God. He was told to go to the land that God had said would be his, and he left for a country he had never seen.
translation_verse: Eebraham be yirda so nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ tre mo nɛ e daŋ nu n sa mo nseŋ daŋ lar mbe kade to n yɔ kakpa nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ e beeŋ sa mo na. E daŋ lar mbe efuli so, ama e daa maŋ nyi kakpa nɛ e daa yɔ.

english_verse: Because Abraham had faith, he lived as a stranger in the promised land. He lived there in a tent, and so did Isaac and Jacob, who were later given the same promise.
translation_verse: Yirda so nɛ e daŋ ya kaa wɔ efuli mo nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ nase kɔnɔ fanɛ e beeŋ sa mo na so fanɛ efɔ na. Mo nɛ Aizek nɛ Jeekɔb nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ sa bumo alɛ gba kɔnɔ naseso koŋwule na, e daŋ ya kaa wɔ wajɛbu to fanɛ befɔ na.

english_verse: Even when Sarah was too old to have children, she had faith that God would do what he had promised, and she had a son.
translation_verse: Yirda e daŋ shin nɛ mbe eche Sɛɛra daŋ bel nseŋ daŋ nya eleŋ n di kedampo, ŋkpal manɛ so, e daŋ baa nyi geeŋ fanɛ esa nɛ e daŋ sa mo loŋ be kɔnɔ naseso na daa beeŋ wora kusɔ nɛ e daŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ e beeŋ wora na.

english_verse: Her husband Abraham was almost dead, but he became the ancestor of many people. In fact, there are as many of them as there are stars in the sky or grains of sand along the seashore.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal le be yirda ere so nɛ basa damta daŋ shi enyɛn koŋwule nɛ e daa maŋ naa kɔ eleŋ nseŋ daa du fanɛ esa nɛ e teŋ wu na to. Naniere b shi fanɛ achɛkpabi mo nɛ a wɔ awɔlpa to na nna. Esa malɛ maaŋ tiŋ ŋ karga bumo fanɛ kananɛ b maaŋ tiŋ ŋ karga teku ase be ajembubi na.

english_verse: Every one of those people died. But they still had faith, even though they had not received what they had been promised. They were glad just to see these things from far away, and they agreed that they were only strangers and foreigners on this earth.
translation_verse: Yirda to nɛ basa ere kikɛ daa wɔ nseŋ wu nɛ b maŋ naŋ nya asɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ nase kɔnɔ fanɛ e beeŋ sa na. B daŋ to kenishi nna n yɔ kufɔ n wu amo n sɔ amo a nyi fanɛ b shi efuli pɔtɛ so nna a la befɔ kasawule ere so.

english_verse: When people talk this way, it is clear they are looking for a place to call their own.
translation_verse: Basa nɛ baa tre bumo be amu le ere bee ŋini nna geeŋ fanɛ bumo gbagba be efuli so nɛ baa fin na.

english_verse: If they had been talking about the land where they had once lived, they could have gone back at any time.
translation_verse: Mannɛ efuli mo nɛ b daŋ shi na be asheŋ nɛ b daa fɛ, ŋkpal manɛ so, ekpa daa wɔtɔ nɛ b daŋ naŋ tiŋ m bɛta n yɔ ndoŋ.

english_verse: But they were looking forward to a better home in heaven. This is why God wasn't ashamed for them to call him their God. He even built a city for them.
translation_verse: Ama kashenteŋto, efuli mo nɛ k bɔ ade kikɛ ere nɛ b daa fin. Kumo e la fanɛ ebɔrɛso be efuli na. Amoso nɛ ketre Ebɔrɛ bumo be Ebɔrɛ na maa keta Ebɔrɛ anishinyɔr na, ŋkpal manɛ so, mo e pɔr kadegboŋ na n yili bumo.

english_verse: Abraham had been promised that Isaac, his only son, would continue his family. But when Abraham was tested, he had faith and was willing to sacrifice Isaac,
translation_verse: Le nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ kaŋɛ mo pibi be asheŋ: “Aizek to nɛ feeŋ bɔla n nya kaman to ebi na.”

english_verse: because he was sure that God could raise people to life. This was just like getting Isaac back from death.
translation_verse: Eebraham daa nyi Ebɔrɛ ka kɔ eleŋ nɛ e tiŋ n tiŋi bubuni ashi luwu to, kumo ere anyeeŋ tiŋ ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ Aizek daŋ wu nna nseŋ naŋ ba Eebraham be enɔ to.

english_verse: Isaac had faith, and he promised blessings to Jacob and Esau.
translation_verse: Yirda so nɛ Aizek koŋwule ere malɛ daŋ nɛfa mbe mbia, Jeekɔb nɛ Isɔɔ a yili kachako na.

english_verse: Later, when Jacob was about to die, he leaned on his walking stick and worshiped. Then because of his faith he blessed each of Joseph's sons.
translation_verse: Yirda so nɛ Jeekɔb daa shin nɛ e wu nseŋ daŋ nɛfa n nɛfa Josɛf be mbia na. E daa yirgi mbe kekpabi so nna nseŋ daa bunyaŋ Ebɔrɛ.

english_verse: And right before Joseph died, he had faith that God would lead the people of Israel out of Egypt. So he told them to take his bones with them.
translation_verse: Yirda so nɛ Josɛf daa shin nɛ e wu nseŋ daŋ malga Israɛlebi be kelar Ijipt to be asheŋ nseŋ kaŋɛ kusɔ nɛ baaŋ ta mbe kebuni n wora na be asheŋ.

english_verse: Because Moses' parents had faith, they kept him hidden until he was three months old. They saw that he was a beautiful child, and they were not afraid to disobey the king's orders.
translation_verse: Yirda so nɛ Mosis mo nio nɛ mo tuto daŋ ta mo ŋ ŋana afɔl asa na. B daŋ wu fanɛ kayɛrbi e daa la mo nseŋ daa maŋ ŋana kekplaŋ Ijipt be ewura na be ntaŋ na so.

english_verse: Then after Moses grew up, his faith made him refuse to be called the king's grandson.
translation_verse: Yirda so nɛ Mosis daŋ ba daŋ nseŋ daa maŋ shuli fanɛ b tre mo ewura Fɛɛro pibi na.

english_verse: He chose to be mistreated with God's people instead of having the good time that sin could bring for a little while.
translation_verse: Ketu Ebɔrɛ be basa na a wɔ tɔrɔ to daŋ par mo a chɔ kedaa wɔ alubi be ebel to nchɛnnyɔ ko.

english_verse: Moses knew that the treasures of Egypt were not as wonderful as what he would receive from suffering for the Messiah, and he looked forward to his reward.
translation_verse: E daa sha kekpal Mesaya na so n ji anishinyɔr ga a chɔ keji Ijipt be damaso be asɔ na, ŋkpal manɛ so, mbe anishi daa yuu tɔnɔ mo nɛ e daa beeŋ nya kachako na so nna.

english_verse: Because of his faith, Moses left Egypt. Moses had seen the invisible God and wasn't afraid of the king's anger.
translation_verse: Yirda so nɛ e daŋ lar Ijipt to nseŋ daa maŋ ŋana ewura na be agbo na. E daa kɔ mbe yirda na to nna kpakpa fanɛ e ka wu esa nɛ b maa wu kenishiso na.

english_verse: His faith also made him celebrate Passover. He sprinkled the blood of animals on the doorposts, so that the first-born sons of the people of Israel would not be killed by the destroying angel.
translation_verse: Yirda so nɛ e daŋ fara Kebansonchoŋ be kejigboŋ nseŋ daŋ shin nɛ b ta ŋklaŋ ŋ gbiti mbunaana nɛ malaika murpo na e sa maŋ beta Israɛlebi be kowu kama to be kebinyɛnbi juŋkparso na.

english_verse: Because of their faith, the people walked through the Red Sea on dry land. But when the Egyptians tried to do it, they were drowned.
translation_verse: Yirda so nɛ Israɛlebi na daŋ tiŋ m bɔla teku peper na to n nite n lar fanɛ kasawule wɔlso na, ama Ijiptebi na ka ba kaa sha kenite loŋ n choŋ nɛ b ji nchu.

english_verse: God's people had faith, and when they had walked around the city of Jericho for seven days, its walls fell down.
translation_verse: Yirda so nɛ Jɛriko be kade to be egbalana daŋ tɔr saŋɛ nɛ Israɛlebi daŋ nite ŋ kulti kumo nchɛnshunu na be kaman na.

english_verse: Rahab had been a prostitute, but she had faith and welcomed the spies. So she wasn't killed with the people who disobeyed.
translation_verse: Sakaleche Reehab be yirda so nɛ Israɛlebi daa maŋ mɔ mo n ti basa nɛ b daa maŋ kɔ kasonu ana so na, ŋkpal manɛ so, Reehab daŋ sɔ bumo nɛ b daŋ yɔ kade na be kebɔɔso ŋ keni na so nna nɛnɛ.

english_verse: and put out raging fires and escaped from the swords of their enemies. Although they were weak, they were given the strength and power to chase foreign armies away.
translation_verse: B daa la bepɔshipo nna, ama b daŋ ki belempo. B daa kɔ eleŋ ashi kena to n daŋ tiŋ m pɔɔ befɔ be esoji so nɛ b shile n choŋ.

english_verse: Some women received their loved ones back from death. Many of these people were tortured, but they refused to be released. They were sure they would get a better reward when the dead are raised to life.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal yirda so, beche ko be bubuni daŋ tiŋi ashi luwu to nna n sa bumo. Le be basa ere be beko daŋ kini kesɔ kamooji be kebaawɔtɔ nna nseŋ shuli n shin nɛ b tɔrɔ bumo, saŋɛ na so baaŋ ba tiŋi luwu to n luri ŋkpa nɛ k bɔ na to.

english_verse: Others were made fun of and beaten with whips, and some were chained in jail.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal yirda so b daŋ wora beko eyurto nna nseŋ kuya bumo so nseŋ daŋ pɛ bede malɛ ŋ kre n ta bumo n ti ebuana.

english_verse: Still others were stoned to death or sawed in two or killed with swords. Some had nothing but sheep skins or goat skins to wear. They were poor, mistreated, and tortured.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal yirda so, b daŋ kpa beko ajembu m mɔ nseŋ daŋ chaŋɛ bede to ntuŋnyɔso nseŋ ta tokobi m mɔ bede malɛ. Ŋkpal yirda koŋwule na so beko daŋ dela mbolpɔ be nwɔl nɛ mboe be nwɔl nna a wɔ ketir to nɛ tɔrɔ nɛ nfɛlso be kekɔrfɛ to.

english_verse: The world did not deserve these good people, who had to wander in deserts and on mountains and had to live in caves and holes in the ground.
translation_verse: Le be basa ere kikɛ, durnya be kelela daa maŋ fo bumo peya so, amoso bumo be beko daa na kiyi to nna nɛ abeeana so nɛ abeelaŋana to nɛ amaŋana to nna.

english_verse: All of them pleased God because of their faith! But still they died without being given what had been promised.
translation_verse: Kashenteŋto, bede kikɛ daŋ nya mbo, ŋkpal bumo be yirda so, ama bumo alɛ be ekama daa maŋ nya kusɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ nase kɔnɔ fanɛ e beeŋ sa na.

english_verse: This was because God had something better in store for us. And he did not want them to reach the goal of their faith without us.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ daa kɔ kusɔ nɛ k bɔ kede ere gba nna n nase anyi. Mbe kusɔ nɛ e daŋ yili e la fanɛ anyi nɛ bumo be kegama nawule to nɛ baaŋ fɔr so n nyalɛ so.

english_verse: Such a large crowd of witnesses is all around us! So we must get rid of everything that slows us down, especially the sin that just won't let go. And we must be determined to run the race that is ahead of us.
translation_verse: To, naniere a daga fanɛ anyi, bumo nɛ le be eshɛda ere kulti anyi ere ka ta asɔ kama nɛ a bee kagle anyi ekpa ashi kebɛso na to na nɛ alubi mo nɛ a mar anyi so kpakpa na n lɛ nseŋ ta kenishipere n shile eshile nɛ k dese a jo anyi ere kanyitiso.

english_verse: We must keep our eyes on Jesus, who leads us and makes our faith complete. He endured the shame of being nailed to a cross, because he knew later on he would be glad he did. Now he is seated at the right side of God's throne!
translation_verse: Men shin nɛ an ta anyi be anishi n yuu Yesu nɛ e la anyi be yirda ere be ejuŋkparpo nɛ esa nɛ e bee shin nɛ yirda bee yili to nɛnɛ a fo kumo be ekar na so. Mo e daŋ kpal kachako so be kagbenefuli mo nɛ k jo mo na so a maŋ ta kewu kedibi largato so be luwu na n tre shɛŋ nseŋ ji kumo nseŋ ya kaa tase Ebɔrɛ be kuwurputi be jisoso na.

english_verse: So keep your mind on Jesus, who put up with many insults from sinners. Then you won't get discouraged and give up.
translation_verse: Men fɛ kananɛ e maŋ ta kekishi damta mo nɛ alubiworapoana daŋ ta n tu mo na kikɛ n tre shɛŋ na be asheŋ ŋ keni, saŋɛ na so men maaŋ pɔ aba n shin nɛ menyi be ŋgbene e baa jija menyi.

english_verse: But you have forgotten that the Scriptures say to God's children, “When the Lord punishes you, don't make light of it, and when he corrects you, don't be discouraged.
translation_verse: Men teŋ keleŋto be mmalga nɛ Ebɔrɛ bee malga a sa menyi fanɛ mbe mbia na so a? E yɛ: “M pibi, sa maŋ ta kananɛ Enyɛnpe niŋi fo ekpa na fanɛ kusɔ fɔmbi nsaa maa pɔ aba ŋkpal e ka gberge fo kusoe so.

english_verse: The Lord corrects the people he loves and disciplines those he calls his own.”
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, esa kama nɛ ma, Enyɛnpe na bee sha nɛ mee niŋi ekpa nsaa gberge ekama nɛ mee tre m pibi kusoe.”

english_verse: Our human fathers correct us for a short time, and they do it as they think best. But God corrects us for our own good, because he wants us to be holy, as he is.
translation_verse: An tuto kurgesoana daŋ niŋi n niŋi anyi ekpaana kananɛ b daa fɛ fanɛ k walɛ nɛnɛ n sa bumo nchɛnnyɔ ko nna, ama Ebɔrɛ bre bee niŋi anyi ekpa nna ŋkpal anyi gbagba be kechɛto so, saŋɛ na so nɛ an tiŋ n tu mo n nya mbe kebaawɔtɔ cheembi na.

english_verse: It is never fun to be corrected. In fact, at the time it is always painful. But if we learn to obey by being corrected, we will do right and live at peace.
translation_verse: Ama kashenteŋ bre, saŋɛ nɛ b baa niŋi esa ekpa, mbe kagbene bee jija mo nna. Ama keniŋi na be kaman ekama nɛ e bii keniŋi na be kifito daŋ nya alelasheŋ be kebaawɔtɔ be kagbenefuli be tɔnɔ nna. Asɔ niŋiso be kefiɛso be asheŋ

english_verse: Now stand up straight! Stop your knees from shaking
translation_verse: Amoso, men koso n wora menyi be enɔ pɔsoana nɛ amuli chichasoana ere eleŋto.

english_verse: and walk a straight path. Then lame people will be healed, instead of getting worse. Warning against Turning from God
translation_verse: Men lɔŋɛ ekpa niŋiso nɛ menyee bɔla so na, saŋɛ na so, menyi to be bumo nɛ b maŋ kɔ eleŋ na maaŋ foe ekpa, ama baaŋ baa kɔ eleŋ.

english_verse: Try to live at peace with everyone! Live a clean life. If you don't, you will never see the Lord.
translation_verse: Men wora ania nɛ menyi nɛ basa kikɛ e baa wɔ ebel nɛ men baa kɔ kebaawɔtɔ cheembiana, ŋkpal manɛ so, esa kama maaŋ wu Ebɔrɛ na ama amodoŋwura baa kɔ kebaawɔtɔ cheembi nna.

english_verse: Make sure no one misses out on God's wonderful kindness. Don't let anyone become bitter and cause trouble for the rest of you.
translation_verse: Men baa de so nɛ ekama e sa maŋ kaŋ lar Ebɔrɛ be kuwɔr be kakɛ na to nseŋ naa de so nɛ kekishi be nfɛra kama e sa maŋ luri menyi to n wul basa damta to n jija bumo be kebaawɔtɔ.

english_verse: You have not come to a place like Mount Sinai that can be seen and touched. There is no flaming fire or dark cloud or storm
translation_verse: Men baa nyiŋi fanɛ men maŋ ba kebee mo nɛ baaŋ tiŋ m beta na ase nɛ edɛ wuloŋwuloŋ daa wɔ kumo so na. Ndoŋ nɛ tentembiri daŋ sɔ kakpa nɛ kaboŋ daŋ wora gbrum nɛ kumo be kaman nɛ afugboŋ ko daŋ ba na.

english_verse: because they could not obey its commands. They were even told to kill any animal that touched the mountain.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, b daa maaŋ tiŋ ŋ keta kamalga mo nɛ k daŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ: “Hale nɛ kusɔbɔya gba beta kebee ere, b kpa mo ajembu m mɔ” na.

english_verse: The sight was so frightening that Moses said he shook with fear.
translation_verse: Kashenteŋto, kakpa na kikɛ daŋ ba ki kanaŋ ko nna hale nɛ Mosis gba kaŋɛ: “Kufu pɛ ma nna nɛ mee chicha.”

english_verse: You have now come to Mount Zion and to the heavenly Jerusalem. This is the city of the living God, where thousands and thousands of angels have come to celebrate.
translation_verse: Ama menyi ere ba Zayɔn be kebee na so, ebɔrɛso be Jerusalɛm nɛ k la Ebɔrɛ nɛ e wɔ ŋkpa to be kade to na. Ndoŋ nɛ emalaika ŋgboŋto ŋgboŋto wɔ na.

english_verse: Here you will find all of God's dearest children, whose names are written in heaven. And you will find God himself, who judges everyone. Here also are the spirits of those good people who have been made perfect.
translation_verse: Men ba Ebɔrɛ be ewurkoŋ nyɛnsoana nɛ Ebɔrɛ sibɛ bumo be atre n nase ebɔrɛso na be kagbenefuliso be nshɛr to nna na. Men ba Ebɔrɛ nɛ e la basa kikɛ be demujipo na kutɔ nna nseŋ naŋ ba belelapo nɛ e ta bumo be ayoyu ŋ ki cheembi na kutɔ nna na.

english_verse: And Jesus is here! He is the one who makes God's new agreement with us, and his sprinkled blood says much better things than the blood of Abel.
translation_verse: Men ba Yesu nɛ e la kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre popɔr be elɔŋɛpo nsaa la esa nɛ b ta mbe ŋklaŋ ŋ ŋmenyaŋ n wurge nɛ ŋklaŋ na bee ji kusɔ nɛ k chɔ Ebel be ŋklaŋ na be asheŋ peya na kutɔ.
