english_verse: Make sure you obey the one who speaks to you. The people did not escape, when they refused to obey the one who spoke to them at Mount Sinai. Do you think you can possibly escape, if you refuse to obey the one who speaks to you from heaven?
translation_verse: Men baa de so nsaa maŋ kaŋ kini kenu esa nɛ e bee malga na be mmalga na. Basa nɛ b daŋ kini kenu durnya ere to be ebɔl nɛ k daŋ fiɛ bumo so na daa maŋ tiŋ ŋ gelge bumo be kasogberge. Nɛ ebɔl ka shi ebɔrɛso ba fiɛ anyi ere so nɛ an kini kenu, nuso nɛ anyeeŋ wora ŋ gelge kumo be kasogberge!

english_verse: When God spoke the first time, his voice shook only the earth. This time he has promised to shake the earth once again, and heaven too.
translation_verse: Amo be jemanɛ na mbe ebɔl daŋ gbuŋgbuŋ kasawule nna, ama naniere bre e nase kɔnɔ nna ŋ kaŋɛ le: “Kela koŋwule nɛ meeŋ naŋ gbuŋgbuŋ kasawule, ama mannɛ fanɛ kasawule nawule, meeŋ gbuŋgbuŋ ebɔrɛso gba n ti so.”

english_verse: The words “once again” mean that these created things will someday be shaken and removed. Then what cannot be shaken will last.
translation_verse: Kananɛ e kaŋɛ ere ŋini fanɛ e beeŋ tia asɔ nɛ b to nɛ a beeŋ tiŋ ŋ gbuŋgbuŋ to na nna na. E beeŋ wora loŋ nɛ asɔ nɛ a maaŋ tiŋ ŋ gbuŋgbuŋ to na e ka.

english_verse: We should be grateful we were given a kingdom that cannot be shaken. And in this kingdom we please God by worshiping him and by showing him great honor and respect.
translation_verse: Amoso, men shin nɛ an baa chɔrɔ Ebɔrɛ ŋkpal an ka beeŋ nya kuwura mo nɛ k maaŋ tiŋ ŋ gbuŋgbuŋ to na n luri to so. Men shin nɛ an baa bɔla ekpa mo nɛ k bee par Ebɔrɛ so a ta kabɔrɛŋana nɛ kufu a bunyaŋ mo.

english_verse: Keep being concerned about each other as the Lord's followers should.
translation_verse: Men ba kraa wɔtɔ a sha abar fanɛ keniopibiana ashi Kristo to.

english_verse: Be sure to welcome strangers into your home. By doing this, some people have welcomed angels as guests, without even knowing it.
translation_verse: Men nyiŋi a sɔ befɔ ashi men peana, ŋkpal manɛ so, beko daŋ wora loŋ n sɔ emalaika bumo peana a maŋ pin b ka la emalaika.

english_verse: Remember the Lord's people who are in jail and be concerned for them. Don't forget those who are suffering, but imagine you are there with them.
translation_verse: Men baa nyiŋi bumo nɛ b wɔ kabuti to na fanɛ menyi nɛ bumo kikɛ nɛ b ti ebu na nseŋ naa nyiŋi bumo nɛ baa tɔrɔ nfɛlso na fanɛ menyi alɛ gba ka bee ji loŋ be tɔrɔ na.

english_verse: Have respect for marriage. Always be faithful to your partner, because God will punish anyone who is immoral or unfaithful in marriage.
translation_verse: A daga fanɛ ekama e baa bunyaŋ kakil nsaa maŋ ta eyurpi a wɔ kakil to, ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ beeŋ gberge bekama nɛ b kɔ kesakalea nɛ bekama nɛ b wɔtɔ a kɔ kusɔjigaya be kebaawɔtɔ kusoe.

english_verse: Don't fall in love with money. Be satisfied with what you have. The Lord has promised that he will not leave us or desert us.
translation_verse: Men lara menyi be ŋgbeneana ashi kemansherbisha to nseŋ shin nɛ asɔ nɛ men kɔ na e baa kukwe menyi, ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ fanɛ: “M maaŋ yige menyi kikɛ, ma alɛ maaŋ kplaŋ menyi so kikɛ.”

english_verse: This should make you feel like saying, “The Lord helps me! Why should I be afraid of what people can do to me?”
translation_verse: Amoso, menyeeŋ tiŋ m puchi ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ: “Enyɛnpe e la ma echɛtopo, m maaŋ baa lɔ kufu. Manɛ nɛ nyiŋgbasa beeŋ tiŋ n wora ma?”

english_verse: Don't forget about your leaders who taught you God's message. Remember what kind of lives they lived and try to have faith like theirs.
translation_verse: Men baa nyiŋi menyi be benimuana nɛ b daŋ malga abɔrɛsheŋ n sa menyi na n fɛ kananɛ bumo be lalaloge be kebaawɔtɔ daŋ ba kaa du nsaa kute bumo be yirda na to.

english_verse: Jesus Christ never changes! He is the same yesterday, today, and forever.
translation_verse: Ndere nɛ kabre nɛ saŋkikɛ, Yesu Kristo wɔ ŋkpa to nna mbaanaayɔ. E maa chɛrga kikɛ.

english_verse: Don't be fooled by any kind of strange teachings. It is better to receive strength from God's gift of undeserved grace than to depend on certain foods. After all, these foods don't really help the people who eat them.
translation_verse: Men sa maŋ shin nɛ keŋini be nnaŋ to nɛ a wɔtɔ ere e fule menyi kikɛ nɛ men foe ekpa. Ebɔrɛ be kuwɔr be kakɛ e daga kebaaleŋ menyi be ŋgbeneana to, mannɛ edaŋkaresheŋ be ekpaana be ajibi nɛ a maŋ kɔ tɔnɔ n sa basa nɛ b ji amo na.

english_verse: But we have an altar where even the priests who serve in the place of worship have no right to eat.
translation_verse: An kɔ anyi be bɔrɛsure mo nɛ bumo nɛ baa shuŋ wajɛlambu na akpa na maŋ kɔ ekpa nɛ b ji bɔrɛsure na so be sargajibi na.

english_verse: This is why we should go outside the camp to Jesus and share in his disgrace.
translation_verse: Amoso, men shin nɛ an lar keeyi na to n yɔ mo kutɔ n ya tu mo n ji mbe ŋaba nɛ b ŋaba mo na.

english_verse: On this earth we don't have a city that lasts forever, but we are waiting for such a city.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, nfe ere, anyi maŋ kɔ kade mo nɛ k baa wɔtɔ mbaanaayɔ, kade mo nɛ k beeŋ ba na be ekpa nɛ anyee keni.

english_verse: But don't forget to help others and to share your possessions with them. This too is like offering a sacrifice that pleases God.
translation_verse: Menyi alɛ e sa maŋ teŋ kebaawora kelela nɛ kebaata menyi be asɔana a chɛ abar to so, ŋkpal manɛ so, loŋ be esarga e naa par Ebɔrɛ.

english_verse: Obey your leaders and do what they say. They are watching over you, and they must answer to God. So don't make them sad as they do their work. Make them happy. Otherwise, they won't be able to help you at all.
translation_verse: Men baa nu a sa menyi be bejuŋkparpoana nsaa sɔ bumo be atande. Bumo e naa keni menyi be ayoyu so fanɛ basa nɛ Ebɔrɛ beeŋ ba bishi bumo menyi be asheŋ. Men baa nu a sa bumo nɛ b tiŋ n shuŋ bumo be ashuŋ kagbenefuliso, mannɛ kagbenejijaso, ŋkpal manɛ so, keshuŋ ashuŋ kagbenejijaso maaŋ chɛ menyi to kuraa.

english_verse: God gives peace, and he raised our Lord Jesus Christ from death. Now Jesus is like a Great Shepherd whose blood was used to make God's eternal agreement with his flock.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ bɔla ŋklaŋ nɛ a bee ti kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na so n tiŋi an Nyɛnpe Yesu nɛ e la mbolpɔkenipogboŋ nɛ e bee keni mbe mbolpɔ so na ashi luwu to.

english_verse: I pray God will make you ready to obey him and that you will always be eager to do right. May Jesus help you do what pleases God. To Jesus Christ be glory forever and ever! Amen.
translation_verse: Kagbenewushi be Ebɔrɛ na e shin nɛ kusɔ lela kama nɛ k walɛ keta n shuŋ mbe kushuŋ na e bɔla menyi to. Ma alɛ naa kule mo fanɛ e bɔla Kristo so n wora kusɔ nɛ k bee par mo ashi anyi to. Kemaŋkura e baa la Yesu Kristo na peya mbaanaayɔ. Amɛn. Lalaloge be mmalga be asheŋ

english_verse: My friends, I have written only a short letter to encourage you, and I beg you to pay close attention to what I have said.
translation_verse: Ŋ kurgepoana, mee kule menyi nna fanɛ men ji kanyiti n nu ma keleŋto be kamalga ere, ŋkpal manɛ so, kawɔl ere ŋ ka sibɛ menyi ere baa maŋ shi ko.

english_verse: By now you surely must know that our friend Timothy is out of jail. If he gets here in time, I will bring him with me when I come to visit you.
translation_verse: Mee sha fanɛ men pin fanɛ b lara an kurgepo Timoti ashi kabuti to. Amoso, nɛ e kaŋ wule m ba nfe, ma nɛ mo e naaŋ ba wu menyi.

english_verse: Please give my greetings to your leaders and to the rest of the Lord's people. His followers from Italy send you their greetings.
translation_verse: Men chɔrɔ menyi be bejuŋkparpoana nɛ Ebɔrɛ be basa kikɛ. Bekurgepo mo nɛ b shi Itali na bee chɔrɔ menyi.

english_verse: I pray that God will be kind to all of you!
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ be kuwɔr be kakɛ e baa wɔ menyi kikɛ so.

english_verse: From James, a servant of God and of our Lord Jesus Christ. Greetings to the twelve tribes scattered all over the world. Faith and Wisdom
translation_verse: Kawɔl ere shi ma Jeems nɛ n la Ebɔrɛ nɛ Enyɛnpe Yesu Kristo be kenya na kutɔ nna a yɔ menyi Israɛlebi be nnaŋ kuduanyɔ nɛ men pesaŋ to a wɔ durnya kikɛ to na kutɔ. Mee chɔrɔ menyi kikɛ. Yirda nɛ kanyiasheŋ be asheŋ

english_verse: My friends, be glad, even if you have a lot of trouble.
translation_verse: Ŋ kurgepoana, saŋkama nɛ men baŋ luri kechɔŋkeni be yiri kikɛ to, men shin nɛ men be ŋgbene e baa fuli menyi.

english_verse: But you must learn to endure everything, so you will be completely mature and not lacking in anything.
translation_verse: Men baa shin nɛ men be kechɔŋkeni be eleŋ e baa yɔ anishito a wora keshi saŋkama a ti so nɛ men be eda e ba kaa walɛ nɛnɛ a maa paŋ kelela kikɛ.

english_verse: But when you ask for something, you must have faith and not doubt. Anyone who doubts is like an ocean wave tossed around in a storm.
translation_verse: Ama fo kama nɛ fo kule mo kusɔ kama, fo yirda fanɛ e beeŋ sa fo kumo nsaa maa wora shikashika, ŋkpal manɛ so, esa kama nɛ e bee kule Ebɔrɛ asɔ nsaa wora shikashika, du fanɛ afugboŋ ka bee kaa ketili nchu so a yɔ a ba na nna.

english_verse: If you are that kind of person, you can't make up your mind, and you surely can't be trusted. So don't expect the Lord to give you anything at all. Poor People and Rich People
translation_verse: ŋkpal manɛ so, nfɛranyɔnyɔwura be asheŋ woraso kikɛ maa lar anishi. Keshin nɛ fo kagbene e baa fuli fo be asheŋ

english_verse: Any of God's people who are poor should be glad he thinks so highly of them.
translation_verse: Ekurgepo kama nɛ e maŋ la shɛŋ basa kutɔ e shin nɛ mbe kagbene e baa fuli mo fanɛ mbe ketre dii Ebɔrɛ be anishito.

english_verse: scorched by the burning heat of the sun. The flowers lose their blossoms, and their beauty is destroyed. This is how the rich will disappear, as they go about their business. Trials and Temptations
translation_verse: Epeŋi e naa kaa nyaŋɛ le nyaŋnyaŋ a chɔɔ keduuso nɛ k bee wɔl a jija kumo be atoto be kela nsaa gbete a tɔr. To, loŋ gbagba chap e naa wora damawura. E bee kaa wɔ mbe ashuŋ to nna nɛ luwu e ba tu mo. Kewora esa ŋ keni be asheŋ

english_verse: God will bless you, if you don't give up when your faith is being tested. He will reward you with a glorious life, just as he rewards everyone who loves him.
translation_verse: Ekama nɛ e pɔɔ kechɔŋkeni so, kagbenefuli beeŋ baa wɔ mo to, ŋkpal manɛ so, Setani baŋ chɔ mo ŋ keni ŋ gben. Ebɔrɛ beeŋ sa mo mbe ŋkpa nɛ e nase kɔnɔ fanɛ e beeŋ sa bekama nɛ baa sha mo na.

english_verse: Our desires make us sin, and when sin is finished with us, it leaves us dead.
translation_verse: Kulubi malɛ baŋ ba wora keshi, kumo be lalaloge e la luwu.

english_verse: Don't be fooled, my dear friends.
translation_verse: Ŋ kurgepo shasoana, men sa maŋ fule men be amu.

english_verse: Every good and perfect gift comes down from the Father who created all the lights in the heavens. He is always the same and never makes dark shadows by changing.
translation_verse: Kelela be yiri kikɛ nɛ kakɛ lela kikɛ bee shi ebɔrɛso nna a ba. Ebɔrɛ nɛ e to kefulto na kutɔ nɛ asɔ na kikɛ bee shi a ba. Ebɔrɛso be kefulto bee kaa chɛrga a bar tentembiri, ama Ebɔrɛ bre maa chɛrga kikɛ.

english_verse: He wanted us to be his own special people, and so he sent the true message to give us new birth. Hearing and Obeying
translation_verse: Mo gbagba e yili kumo fanɛ e bɔla mbe kashenteŋ be kamalga na to n shin nɛ an ki mbe kepɔrso kikɛ be basa juŋkparso. Kebaanu nsaa wora be asheŋ

english_verse: If you are angry, you cannot do any of the good things God wants done.
translation_verse: ŋkpal manɛ so, mannɛ kanya agbo so nɛ esa bee bɔla a wora alelasheŋ nɛ a bee par Ebɔrɛ.

english_verse: Obey God's message! Don't fool yourselves by just listening to it.
translation_verse: Ama men baa la benupo nɛ baa nu a wora nsaa maa nu kamalga na jiga a fule men be amu.

english_verse: If you hear the message and don't obey it, you are like people who stare at themselves in a mirror
translation_verse: Nɛ men baa nu kamalga na nsaa maa wora asɔ nɛ k bee ŋini na, men du fanɛ esa nɛ e keni digi to n wu mbe kumu

english_verse: and forget what they look like as soon as they leave.
translation_verse: nseŋ ta digi na n nase nseŋ teŋ kananɛ mbe anishiakpa du epul na to na nna.

english_verse: But you must never stop looking at the perfect law that sets you free. God will bless you in everything you do, if you listen and obey, and don't just hear and forget.
translation_verse: Ama nɛ esa baa ta mbe nfɛra kikɛ a wɔtɔ Ebɔrɛ be mbraana nɛ a maŋ kɔ kulubi amo to kikɛ nsaa tiŋ a lara basa alubi to na to a maa teŋ asɔ nɛ e koya na so nsaa kɔ amo to kpakpa a wora asɔ nɛ a bee ŋini na, Ebɔrɛ beeŋ nɛfa amodoŋwura.

english_verse: If you think you are being religious, but can't control your tongue, you are fooling yourself, and your religion is useless.
translation_verse: Esa kama nɛ e yɛ e bee bɛ Ebɔrɛ so nsaa maa de mmalga nɛ a bee lar mbe kɔnɔ to so bee fule mbe kumu nna, nɛ mbe kebɛso na malɛ la kebɛso fuloŋ.

english_verse: Religion that pleases God the Father must be pure and spotless. You must help needy orphans and widows and not let this world make you evil.
translation_verse: Kashenteŋ nɛ kagbene koŋwuleso be kebɛso nɛ Ebɔrɛ Etuto na bee sha fanɛ basa e baa kɔ e la kebaachɛ amunibi nɛ bekulpocheana nɛ b wɔ awurfoŋ to to nsaa de mo gbagba be kumu so nɛ durnya to ebi be alubi e sa maŋ jija mo.

english_verse: My friends, if you have faith in our glorious Lord Jesus Christ, you won't treat some people better than others.
translation_verse: Ŋ kurgepoana, ŋkpal men ka yirda an Nyɛnpe Yesu Kristo nɛ kemaŋkuragboŋ wɔ mo so na so, men sa maa kɔ ŋkpɛato.

english_verse: Suppose a rich person wearing fancy clothes and a gold ring comes to one of your meetings. And suppose a poor person dressed in worn-out clothes also comes.
translation_verse: An ta fanɛ basa anyɔ ko e ba men be nshɛr to nɛ eko la damawura m buu asɔ lela nseŋ wɔtɔ eshuwa be mpinibi ashilbi to, nɛ emo na malɛ la etirpo nseŋ buu asɔ farbi,

english_verse: You must not give the best seat to the one in fancy clothes and tell the one who is poor to stand at the side or sit on the floor.
translation_verse: nɛ men sa damawura na bunyaŋ ga nseŋ kaŋɛ mo le: “Ba chena kabɛ lela ere so nfe,” kumo be kaman nɛ men kilgi ŋ kaŋɛ etirpo na malɛ le: “Choŋ n yili ndoŋ ere,” ŋko “Ya chena ekarso ndoŋ ere.”

english_verse: This is the same as saying that some people are better than others, and you would be acting like a crooked judge.
translation_verse: Le be mmalga ere maŋ walɛ, ŋkpal manɛ so, nfɛra lubi so nɛ men yil a kpɛa to na.

english_verse: My dear friends, pay attention. God has given a lot of faith to the poor people in this world. God has also promised them a share in his kingdom that he will give to everyone who loves him.
translation_verse: Ŋ kurgepo shasoana, men baa nyi fanɛ basa nɛ b maŋ kɔ shɛŋ basa be anishito na nɛ Ebɔrɛ lara fanɛ b yirda Yesu Kristo nseŋ ki damawuraana ashi Ebɔrɛ be anishito nseŋ nya n luri mbe kuwura mo nɛ e nase kɔnɔ fanɛ e beeŋ sa basa nɛ baa sha mo na to.

english_verse: You mistreat the poor. But isn't it the rich who boss you around and drag you off to court?
translation_verse: Ama le be basa ere nɛ menyi ere bee fɛl ŋkeshin nɛ mannɛ damawuraana e naa kaa tɔrɔ menyi nsaa nyaŋ menyi a yɔ edemujikpaana na a?

english_verse: You will do all right, if you obey the most important law in the Scriptures. It is the law that commands us to love others as much as we love ourselves.
translation_verse: Le nɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ: “Baa sha fo barkasa fanɛ kananɛ fee sha fo kumu.” Le be mbra ere shi Ebɔrɛ be kuwura na to nna m ba, nɛ fo kama nɛ fo bɛ kumo so, fo wora nɛnɛ.

english_verse: But if you treat some people better than others, you have done wrong, and the Scriptures teach that you have sinned.
translation_verse: Ama nɛ fo kpal kananɛ basa du so a bunyaŋ bumo nsaa fɛl beko, kulubi nɛ fee wora na, Ebɔrɛ malɛ kutɔ fo tɔr ntaŋ.

english_verse: If you obey every law except one, you are still guilty of breaking them all.
translation_verse: Nɛ esa kaŋɛ fanɛ e bee bɛ Ebɔrɛ be mbraana na kikɛ so nseŋ wora n da amo to be kukoŋwule gba so, amodoŋwura tɔr Ebɔrɛ be ntaŋana kikɛ.

english_verse: The same God who told us to be faithful in marriage also told us not to murder. So even if you are faithful in marriage, but murder someone, you still have broken God's Law.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ koŋwule nɛ e kaŋɛ fanɛ: “Men sa maa kɔ kesakalea” na koŋwule na e kaŋɛ le: “Men sa maa mɔ abar.” Amoso, nɛ esa maŋ tɔr kesakalea be ntaŋ gba nseŋ mɔ esa, e tɔr Ebɔrɛ be ntaŋana na kikɛ.

english_verse: Do this, because on the day of judgment there will be no pity for those who have not had pity on others. But even in judgment, God is merciful! Faith and Works
translation_verse: Esa nɛ e maa wu mo braana kuwɔr, kachɛ nɛ Ebɔrɛ bee ji amodoŋwura demu e maaŋ wu mo alɛ gba kuwɔr. Ama esa nɛ e bee wu basa kuwɔr, Ebɔrɛ beeŋ wu amodoŋwura kuwɔr a chɔ loŋ. Yirda nɛ asheŋ woraso be asheŋ

english_verse: My friends, what good is it to say you have faith, when you don't do anything to show you really do have faith? Can this kind of faith save you?
translation_verse: Ŋ kurgepoana, esa baŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ e yirda Ebɔrɛ nsaa maa wora yirda be ashuŋ shunso, manɛ be kifi e wɔ mbe yirda na to? Ebɔrɛ beeŋ kpal le be yirda so m mɔlga mo a?

english_verse: If you know someone who doesn't have any clothes or food,
translation_verse: An ta fanɛ fo barkasa ebɛsopo kɔ asɔ farbi nna a buu, mo alɛ maŋ naa kɔ kusɔ jiso nɛ e ji,

english_verse: you shouldn't just say, “I hope all goes well for you. I hope you will be warm and have plenty to eat.” What good is it to say this, unless you do something to help?
translation_verse: nɛ fo wu mo nseŋ kaŋɛ mo le: “Ebɔrɛ e chɛ fo to nseŋ sa fo asɔbuuso lela nɛ ajibi,” fo alɛ maŋ chɛ mo to n sa mo asɔ nɛ a daga, mannɛ asheŋ fuloŋ nɛ fo wora ere a?

english_verse: Suppose someone disagrees and says, “It is possible to have faith without doing kind deeds.” I would answer, “Prove that you have faith without doing kind deeds, and I will prove that I have faith by doing them.”
translation_verse: Nɛ menyi to be ekama kaŋɛ ma fanɛ esa ko wɔtɔ a kɔ yirda nɛ eko malɛ wɔtɔ a kɔ yirda be ashuŋ shunso, meeŋ kaŋɛ amodoŋwura fanɛ e ŋini ma kananɛ esa beeŋ wora ŋ kini yirda be ashuŋ shunso be kewora nsaa bɛ Ebɔrɛ so nɛ kashenteŋ. Kumo be kaman nɛ ma alɛ e bɔla ma ashuŋ shunso so ŋ ŋini mo kananɛ kashenteŋ be yirda du.

english_verse: You surely believe there is only one God. That's fine. Even demons believe this, and it makes them shake with fear.
translation_verse: Fo yirda fanɛ Ebɔrɛ koŋwule e wɔtɔ. To, fo wora nɛnɛ, ama baa nyi fanɛ mbuibi lubi gba bee shuli fanɛ Ebɔrɛ koŋwule e wɔtɔ nɛ kumo alɛ bee keta bumo kufu nɛ baa chicha.

english_verse: This is what the Scriptures mean by saying, “Abraham had faith in God, and God accepted him.” That's how Abraham became God's friend.
translation_verse: Loŋ malɛ e naa shin nɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na be kɔnɔ bee bɔlɔ fanɛ Eebraham yirda Ebɔrɛ nɛ Ebɔrɛ yili kumo fanɛ e maŋ kɔ kulubi mo to na. Amoso nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ tre mo mo teri na.

english_verse: You can now see that we please God by what we do and not only by what we believe.
translation_verse: To, le e naa ŋini fanɛ esa be ashuŋ shunso so nɛ Ebɔrɛ bee yili kumo fanɛ esa na maŋ kɔ kulubi mo to, mannɛ amodoŋwura be yirda nawule so.

english_verse: My friends, we should not all try to become teachers. In fact, teachers will be judged more strictly than others.
translation_verse: Ŋ kurgepoana, men be bedamta e sa maa kɔ a fin fanɛ men ki beŋinipoana, ŋkpal manɛ so, asheŋ nɛ Ebɔrɛ beeŋ yili so n ji anyi beŋinipo demu shi a chɔ basa pɔtɛ peya.

english_verse: All of us do many wrong things. But if you can control your tongue, you are mature and able to control your whole body.
translation_verse: An kikɛ bee kaa wora a foe ekpa. Amoso, esa nɛ mo ere maa malga a foe ekpa, kumo ere kulubi kikɛ maŋ wɔ mo to nɛ mo alɛ bee tiŋ a pɔɔ kulubi be yiri kikɛ so ashi mbe kebaawɔtɔ to.

english_verse: It takes strong winds to move a large sailing ship, but the captain uses only a small rudder to make it go in any direction.
translation_verse: An naŋ ta fanɛ ekuloŋgboŋ nɛ afugboŋ bee kaa kɔ a na nchu so na. Kebaŋɛ nɛ katɛrɛ bee kaa ta a niŋi kumo a yɔ kaplɛkama nɛ e bee sha.

english_verse: Our tongues are small too, and yet they brag about big things. It takes only a spark to start a forest fire!
translation_verse: To, loŋ gbagba chap nɛ esa be kudonduloŋ du. K maŋ shi, ama kumo alɛ bee ji asɔgboŋ be njɔŋ ga. Ekama nyi kananɛ edɛ be kudondulombi ka bee tiŋ a chɔɔ kupuŋgboŋ ŋko?

english_verse: All kinds of animals, birds, reptiles, and sea creatures can be tamed and have been tamed.
translation_verse: Basa bee tiŋ a bela nseŋ tiŋ m bela kupuŋ to be asɔbɔya nɛ mbuibi nɛ asɔ gbeyeso nɛ nchu to be asɔ keniso kikɛ,

english_verse: But our tongues get out of control. They are restless and evil, and always spreading deadly poison.
translation_verse: ama esa kama maaŋ tiŋ m pɔɔ kudonduloŋ bre so. K bee juge asheŋ to ga nsaa kɔ kɔrtɔ lubi nɛ k bee bar luwu.

english_verse: My dear friends, with our tongues we speak both praises and curses. We praise our Lord and Father, and we curse people who were created to be like God, and this isn't right.
translation_verse: Kɔnɔ koŋwule na to nɛ epaŋ be kedi be mmalga nɛ katege be mmalga kikɛ bee shi. Ŋ kurgepoana, loŋ maŋ daga kikɛ.

english_verse: Can clean water and dirty water both flow from the same spring?
translation_verse: Kebuye koŋwule maa pete nchu lela kleŋklembi nɛ nchu bɛso.

english_verse: Can a fig tree produce olives or a grapevine produce figs? Does fresh water come from a well full of salt water? Wisdom from Above
translation_verse: Ŋ kurgepoana, menyi alɛ gba baa nyi mangodibi ka maaŋ tiŋ n sɔr apɔl nseŋ naa nyi kapibidibi ka maaŋ tiŋ n sɔr emaŋgo ŋko? Loŋ koŋwule na nɛ esa maaŋ tiŋ n nya nchu belbelso ashi nchu kerkra to. Ebɔrɛso be kanyiasheŋ be asheŋ

english_verse: Are any of you wise or sensible? Then show it by living right and by being humble and wise in everything you do.
translation_verse: Menyi to be emo e kɔ kanyiasheŋ nsaa nyi ashuŋ to? Amodoŋwura e ta mbe kebaawɔtɔ lela a du boeŋ nsaa wora asheŋ nɛ a daga.

english_verse: But if your heart is full of bitter jealousy and selfishness, don't brag or lie to cover up the truth.
translation_verse: Ama fo kama nɛ fo la kumukpakpasowura nsaa kɔ yurkishi a fɛ fo nawule be asheŋ so, kumo ere fo sa maa ji njɔŋ a ku efɛ a kaŋɛ fanɛ fo kɔ kanyiasheŋ.

english_verse: This kind of wisdom doesn't come from above. It is earthly and selfish and comes from the devil himself.
translation_verse: Mannɛ ebɔrɛso nɛ loŋ be kanyiasheŋ shi, durnya ere to nɛ k shi a la basa be nfɛra lubiana be asheŋ nɛ a shi ayoyu lubi kutɔ.

english_verse: Whenever people are jealous or selfish, they cause trouble and do all sorts of cruel things.
translation_verse: Kaplɛkama nɛ yurkishi wɔ nɛ basa bee fɛ bumo nawule be asheŋ so, kɔnɔkoŋwule maŋ wɔ ndoŋ she kulubi be yiri kikɛ.

english_verse: When peacemakers plant seeds of peace, they will harvest justice.
translation_verse: Bumo nɛ b kɔ kagbenewushi e naa bar kagbenewushi basa to nɛ kumo alɛ be lalaloge la alelasheŋ be kewora.

english_verse: Why do you fight and argue with each other? Isn't it because you are full of selfish desires that fight to control your body?
translation_verse: Manɛ e naa bar ana? Manɛ e naa bar nlu nɛ a wɔ menyi to na malɛ? Kusɔ nɛ k bee bar amo nde: Men be nyɛlga lubi e naa kaa kɔ menyi to a leŋ menyi a wɔtɔ nlu na to.

english_verse: You want something you don't have, and you will do anything to get it. You will even kill! But you still cannot get what you want, and you won't get it by fighting and arguing. You should pray for it.
translation_verse: Kumo e la fanɛ asɔ ko nɛ menyee kaa kɔ a fin kenishipereso a gben nsaa kpal loŋ so a sha kemɔ men braana. Menyee kaa yɛlga men braana gba be asɔ ŋkaa maa nya nsaa kpal loŋ so a kɔ nlu nɛ ana. Men ka maa kule Ebɔrɛ so e shin nɛ men maŋ kɔ asɔ nɛ menyee sha na.

english_verse: Yet even when you do pray, your prayers are not answered, because you pray just for selfish reasons.
translation_verse: Menyee kaa kule Ebɔrɛ asɔ saŋko malɛ ŋkaa maa nya amo, ŋkpal manɛ so, nfɛra lubi nɛ men kɔ a kule amo a sha fanɛ men ta amo n wora men gbagba be kejimuni be aparsheŋ.

english_verse: You people aren't faithful to God! Don't you know if you love the world, you are God's enemies? And if you decide to be a friend of the world, you make yourself an enemy of God.
translation_verse: Basa nɛ esa maaŋ tiŋ n yirda ere! Men maŋ nyi fanɛ nɛ esa baa la Ebɔrɛ mo teri, amodoŋwura malɛ nɛ durnya ere to be asɔ maa ji a kra abar ŋko? To, esa kama nɛ e bee ta mbe kasha a wɔtɔ durnya ere be asɔ to, bee ta mbe kumu nna a ki Ebɔrɛ mo doŋ na.

english_verse: Do you doubt the Scriptures that say, “God truly cares about the Spirit he has put in us”?
translation_verse: Ŋko menyee tama fanɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na ka bee kaŋɛ fanɛ: “Ebɔrɛ be kenishi pere kiyoyu nɛ e ta n wɔtɔ anyi to na so ga na,” maŋ kɔ kifi nna a?

english_verse: In fact, God treats us with even greater kindness, just as the Scriptures say, “God opposes everyone who is proud, but he blesses all who are humble with undeserved grace.”
translation_verse: K kɔ kifi, ama Ebɔrɛ be kuwɔr e shi ga. Abɔrɛsibɛ na malɛ e naa kaŋɛ loŋ fanɛ: “Ebɔrɛ maa shuli a sa kamoowuwuraana, basa nɛ b maŋ kɔ kamoowu nɛ e bee wu kuwɔr.”

english_verse: Come near to God, and he will come near to you. Clean up your lives, you sinners. Purify your hearts, you people who can't make up your mind.
translation_verse: Men firgi n taga to Ebɔrɛ nɛ e firgi n taga to menyi. Alubiworapoana nɛ nfɛraanyɔnyɔwuraana ere, men lara men be enɔana nɛ ŋgbene ashi alubi be kewora to.

english_verse: Be humble in the Lord's presence, and he will honor you. Saying Cruel Things about Others
translation_verse: Men baa yɔɔ men be amu Ebɔrɛ be anishito nɛ e maŋ menyi so.

english_verse: My friends, don't say cruel things about others! If you do, or if you condemn others, you are condemning God's Law. And if you condemn the Law, you put yourself above the Law and refuse to obey either it
translation_verse: Ŋ kurgepoana, men sa maa ji abar be asheŋ a wu abar kulubi. Ekama nɛ e ji mo barkasa be asheŋ n wu mo kulubi e bee ji mbra na be asheŋ a wu kumo kulubi nna na. Fo kama malɛ nɛ fo wu mbra na kulubi, kumo ere fo maŋ naa nu a sa mbra na nna na, ama fo ki esa nɛ e bee ji kumo demu.

english_verse: or God who gave it. God is our judge, and he can save or destroy us. What right do you have to condemn anyone? Warning against Bragging
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ nawule e la esa nɛ e bee nase mbra na, mo alɛ nawule e la kumo be Demujipo. Mo nawule e naaŋ tiŋ m mɔ nseŋ naaŋ tiŋ n sa ŋkpa. Nɛ fo alɛ nyiŋgbasa e la wanɛ nɛ fo tiŋ n ji fo barkasa demu? Kebaaji njɔŋ be asheŋ

english_verse: You should know better than to say, “Today or tomorrow we will go to the city. We will do business there for a year and make a lot of money!”
translation_verse: Menyi nɛ menyee kaa kaŋɛ le: “Kabre ŋko echefo anyeeŋ yɔ le nɛ le be kade to n ya chena ndoŋ kafɛ n ji yawu n dii dama na” e nu nfe.

english_verse: What do you know about tomorrow? How can you be so sure about your life? It is nothing more than mist that appears for only a little while before it disappears.
translation_verse: Men maŋ nyi kusɔ nɛ k beeŋ wora echefo gba. Manɛ e la men be ŋkpaana ere? Men be ŋkpaana ere du fanɛ kenyɔlɔ nna, a maa chɛr nseŋ naa yɔ epul na to.

english_verse: You should say, “If the Lord lets us live, we will do these things.”
translation_verse: Kusɔ nɛ k daga fanɛ men baa kaŋɛ e la: “Nɛ Ebɔrɛ shuli nɛ ŋkpa kraa wɔtɔ, anyeeŋ wora le nɛ le.”

english_verse: Yet you are stupid enough to brag, and it is wrong to be so proud.
translation_verse: Ama menyi ka maa kaŋɛ loŋ ere, menyee wu men be amu nna na nsaa ji njɔŋ. Loŋ malɛ maŋ walɛ.

english_verse: If you don't do what you know is right, you have sinned.
translation_verse: Fo kama malɛ nɛ fo nyi kusɔ nɛ k daga nsaa maŋ wora kumo, fo wora kulubi nna na.

english_verse: You rich people should cry and weep! Terrible things are going to happen to you.
translation_verse: To, damawuraana, men nu nfe. Men baa boŋ to a shu ŋkpal alemaŋkar be tɔrɔ nɛ k bee ba menyi so na so.

english_verse: Your treasures have already rotted, and moths have eaten your clothes.
translation_verse: Men be ekpanjawu to be asɔ teŋ fara a jija nɛ elala fara a ji men be asɔbuuso.

english_verse: You refused to pay the people who worked in your fields, and now their unpaid wages are shouting out against you. The Lord All-Powerful has surely heard the cries of the workers who harvested your crops.
translation_verse: Basa nɛ men shin nɛ b dɔ menyi, men kini keka bumo nɛ baa shu a ŋini basa kikɛ, bumo nɛ men ber paa nɛ b teŋi men be asɔ na gba be eyur nyaŋ bumo nɛ baa shu, bumo be kushu na malɛ luri Ebɔrɛ be asoe to.

english_verse: While here on earth, you have thought only of filling your own stomachs and having a good time. But now you are like fat cattle on their way to be butchered.
translation_verse: Asɔ lela nɛ ebel be keji to nɛ men baa wɔ durnya ere to. Men daŋ nna a du fanɛ ana nɛ b bela nɛ a daŋ nɛ b kɔ a yɔ nɛ b ya mɔ na nna.

english_verse: You have condemned and murdered innocent people, who couldn't even fight back. Be Patient and Kind
translation_verse: Men wu basa cheembi kulubi nseŋ mɔ bumo. Bumo alɛ maŋ nya kɔnɔ m bugi. Tama be asheŋ

english_verse: Be patient like those farmers and don't give up. The Lord will soon be here!
translation_verse: To, menyi alɛ gba e baa kɔ kanyiti loŋ a yil to nɛnɛ, ŋkpal manɛ so, an Nyɛnpe be kenaŋ bɛta mba be saŋɛ na bee taga to.

english_verse: Don't grumble about each other or you will be judged, and the judge is right outside the door.
translation_verse: Ŋ kurgepoana, men sa maa bile asheŋ a sa abar nɛ Ebɔrɛ e kaŋɛ fanɛ men wora kulubi. Men keni, a ka gbrɛbi nɛ an kikɛ be Demujipo na e tu anyi.

english_verse: In fact, we praise the ones who endured the most. You remember how patient Job was and how the Lord finally helped him. The Lord did this because he is so merciful and kind.
translation_verse: Basa nɛ b daŋ ji loŋ be kanyiti a yil to na nɛ anyee kaŋɛ fanɛ b wɔ nɛfa to. Job le, men nu kananɛ e daŋ ji kanyiti tɔrɔ to, nɛ amo be kaman kananɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ shin nɛ e nu ebel na ŋko? Kashenteŋto, an Nyɛnpe bee shu anyi so ga nsaa wu anyi kuwɔr.

english_verse: If you are having trouble, you should pray. And if you are feeling good, you should sing praises.
translation_verse: Nɛ tɔrɔ kɔ menyi to be ekama, e kule Ebɔrɛ nɛ e chɛ mo to. Nɛ ekama malɛ nɛ kagbenefuli wɔ mo to, e boŋ nshɛ n di Ebɔrɛ epaŋ.

english_verse: If you are sick, ask the church leaders to come and pray for you. Ask them to put olive oil on you in the name of the Lord.
translation_verse: Nɛ menyi to be ekama malɛ bee lɔ, e shuŋi n tre asɔri to be benimu nɛ b ba bɔla an Nyɛnpe be ketre so n duga ŋku n do mo so nseŋ kule Ebɔrɛ n sa amodoŋwura.

english_verse: If you have faith when you pray for sick people, they will get well. The Lord will heal them, and if they have sinned, he will forgive them.
translation_verse: Nɛ b baŋ kule Ebɔrɛ yirdaso, elɔpo na beeŋ nya eleŋ. Enyɛnpe beeŋ chɛ mo nɛ e niŋi to nɛ alubi kama malɛ nɛ e wora, Ebɔrɛ beeŋ ta m paŋ mo.

english_verse: If you have sinned, you should tell each other what you have done. Then you can pray for one another and be healed. The prayer of an innocent person is powerful, and it can help a lot.
translation_verse: Amoso, men baa bugi men be alubiana to a kaŋɛ abar nsaa kule Ebɔrɛ a sa abar nɛ Ebɔrɛ e baa chɛ menyi be alɔana. Kashenteŋto, kabɔrɛkule kama nɛ k shi esa nɛ kulubi maŋ wɔ mo to, bee tiŋ a wora asheŋgboŋ ga ŋkpal eleŋ nɛ Ebɔrɛ ta n wɔtɔ kumo to so.

english_verse: Elijah was just as human as we are, and for three and a half years his prayers kept the rain from falling.
translation_verse: An ta fanɛ Elaija. E daa la nyiŋgbasa nna fanɛ anyi nseŋ daŋ ta kenishipere ŋ kule Ebɔrɛ fanɛ bɔrɛ e sa maŋ ba nɛ bɔrɛ maŋ ba kasawule na so nfɛ asa nɛ bargato.

english_verse: My friends, if any followers have wandered away from the truth, you should try to lead them back.
translation_verse: Ŋ kurgepoana nɛ menyi to be ekama baŋ foe kashenteŋ be kebɛso be ekpa na so nɛ eko chɛ amodoŋwura to n naŋ ŋini mo ekpa na

english_verse: If you turn sinners from the wrong way, you will save them from death, and many of their sins will be forgiven.
translation_verse: esa nɛ e chɛ mo to na e baa nyi fanɛ esa kama nɛ e chɛ alubiworapo to nɛ e lar mbe alubi na to mɔlga amodoŋwura be kiyoyu ashi luwu to nseŋ shin nɛ Ebɔrɛ kpra alubi damta n lɛ.

english_verse: God the Father decided to choose you as his people, and his Spirit has made you holy. You have obeyed Jesus Christ and are sprinkled with his blood. I pray that God will be kind to you and will keep on giving you peace! A Real Reason for Hope
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ Etuto na bɔla mbe kanyiasheŋ so nna a nyi kusɔ kama nseŋ lara bumo n naŋ bɔla Kiyoyu na to n ta bumo ŋ ki basa cheembi nɛ b baa nu a sa Yesu Kristo nɛ e ta mbe ŋklaŋ n fɔr bumo so na. Ebɔrɛ be kuwɔr be kakɛ nɛ kagbenewushi e baa wora keshi menyi to a ti so. Tama mo nɛ k wɔtɔ saŋkikɛ na be asheŋ

english_verse: Praise God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ. God is so good, and by raising Jesus from death, he has given us new life and a hope that lives on.
translation_verse: Anyee di Ebɔrɛ nɛ e la an Nyɛnpe Yesu Kristo mo Tuto na epaŋ. Ŋkpal mbe kuwɔrgboŋ so e shin nɛ an nya ŋkpa popɔr ŋkpal Yesu Kristo ka tiŋi luwu to na so.

english_verse: You have faith in God, whose power will protect you until the last day. Then he will save you, just as he has always planned to do.
translation_verse: Loŋ be enɛfa na la menyi nɛ Ebɔrɛ kpal men be yirda so n ta mbe eleŋ a keni menyi so a jo saŋɛ nɛ kumɔlga beeŋ lar efuli lalaloge be jemanɛ na peya nna.

english_verse: Your faith will be like gold that has been tested in a fire. And these trials will prove that your faith is worth much more than gold that can be destroyed. They will show that you will be given praise and honor and glory when Jesus Christ returns.
translation_verse: Le be kechɔŋkeni ere bee ba menyi so nna nɛ a ba keni ŋko menyi be yirda na kɔ eleŋ a. Men baa nyi fanɛ hale shuwa nɛ k bee jija ere gba, baa kaa ta edɛ a wora kumo a keni. To, loŋ koŋwule na e daga fanɛ men be yirda mo nɛ k chɔ shuwa na gba, b ka chɔ kumo ŋ keni ŋko k beeŋ tiŋ n yili a. Saŋɛ na so baaŋ di menyi epaŋ nseŋ sa menyi kemaŋkura nɛ bunyaŋ kacha nɛ Ebɔrɛ beeŋ lara Yesu Kristo ŋ ŋini na.

english_verse: You have never seen Jesus, and you don't see him now. But still you love him and have faith in him, and no words can tell how glad and happy
translation_verse: Men maŋ naŋ wu mo nna na pɔɛŋ ŋkaa sha mo na. Men maŋ naŋ wu mo naniere, ama menyi alɛ yirda mo nsaa kɔ kagbenefuli damta nɛ esa maaŋ tiŋ n ji kumo be asheŋ nɛ kemaŋkura wɔ kumo to na e bɔlɔ menyi to nna.

english_verse: you are to be saved. This is why you have faith.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, men be ayoyu be kumɔlga nɛ k la men be yirda ere be tɔnɔ na nɛ menyee nya.

english_verse: Some prophets told how God would treat you with undeserved grace, and they searched hard to find out more about the way you would be saved.
translation_verse: Le be kumɔlga ere be asheŋ nɛ anebiana na daŋ pere kenishi ŋ keni to nɛnɛ n fin nseŋ daŋ wu loŋ be kuwɔr be kakɛ mo nɛ k beeŋ ki menyeya ere be asheŋ ŋ kaŋɛ na.

english_verse: The Spirit of Christ was in them and was telling them how Christ would suffer and would then be given great honor. So they searched to find out exactly who Christ would be and when this would happen.
translation_verse: Kristo be Kiyoyu mo nɛ e daa wɔ bumo to na daŋ wu Kristo be etɔrɔ nɛ kemaŋkura mo nɛ k beeŋ lar etɔrɔ na be kaman na nna ŋ kaŋɛ bumo nɛ b wora ania a fin saŋɛ nɛ asheŋ na kikɛ beeŋ wora.

english_verse: But they were told that they were serving you and not themselves. They preached to you by the power of the Holy Spirit, who was sent from heaven. And their message was only for you, even though angels would like to know more about it. Chosen To Live a Holy Life
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ daŋ lara nna ŋ ŋini anebiana na fanɛ mannɛ bumo gbagba so nɛ b daa shuŋ, ama menyi so nɛ b daŋ shuŋ fanɛ kananɛ b daŋ malga asheŋ nɛ naniere menyee nu Baru Lela na be mbɔ ka kɔ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ nɛ b shi ebɔrɛso n shuŋi na be eleŋ a bɔ kubɔya na. Le be asheŋ ere la asɔ nɛ emalaika gba daa beeŋ baa sha kepinto nna. Kebaadu cheembi be asheŋ

english_verse: Behave like obedient children. Don't let your lives be controlled by your desires, as they used to be.
translation_verse: Kananɛ naniere men la kasonu be mbia ere bre, men sa maŋ naŋ shin nɛ men be ayɛlgasɔ nɛ men daa kɔ saŋɛ nɛ men daa maŋ nyi Ebɔrɛ be ekpa na e naa wɔ menyi.

english_verse: Always live as God's holy people should, because God is the one who chose you, and he is holy.
translation_verse: Ama men baa du cheembi kusɔ kama nɛ menyee wora to fanɛ kananɛ emo nɛ e tre menyi na du na.

english_verse: That's why the Scriptures say, “I am the holy God, and you must be holy too.”
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ fanɛ Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ: “Men baa du cheembi, ŋkpal manɛ so, n du cheembi nna.”

english_verse: You say that God is your Father, but God doesn't have favorites! He judges all people by what they do. So you must honor God while you live as strangers here on earth.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal men ka bee tre esa nɛ e bee ji dimɛdi kikɛ be aworbi demu ŋkaa maa kpɛa mo to na men Tuto ere so, a daga fanɛ men baa wɔ durnya ere to fanɛ befɔ a ŋana Ebɔrɛ.

english_verse: You were rescued from the useless way of life you learned from your ancestors. But you know you were not rescued by such things as silver or gold that don't last forever.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, men nyi fanɛ mannɛ asɔ nɛ a beeŋ tiŋ n jija fanɛ egbiti nɛ eshuwa nɛ b daŋ ta n sɔ menyi ashi men be kebaawɔtɔ fuloŋ mo nɛ men nya ashi men nanaana kutɔ na n yige.

english_verse: Christ was chosen even before the world was created, but because of you, he did not come until these last days.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ lara mo nna pɔɛŋ nseŋ to durnya ere, ama lalaloge be nchɛ ere to nɛ e lara mo ŋ ŋini ŋkpal menyi so.

english_verse: And when he did come, it was to lead you to have faith in God, who raised him from death and honored him in a glorious way. This is why you have put your faith and hope in God.
translation_verse: Mo so nɛ men ta men be yirda n wɔtɔ Ebɔrɛ mo nɛ e tiŋi mo ashi luwu to nseŋ maŋkura mo na, amoso, men be yirda nɛ tama wɔ Ebɔrɛ na to nna.

english_verse: You obeyed the truth, and your souls were made pure. Now you sincerely love each other. But you must keep on loving with all your heart.
translation_verse: Naniere bre men ka nu n sa kashenteŋ na nɛ b fɔr men be ŋgbeneana to nɛ men nyalɛ so a kɔ kashenteŋ be kasha a sha men kurgepoana ere, men baa ta men be ŋgbene kikɛ a sha abar kagbene koŋwuleso.

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “Humans wither like grass, and their glory fades like wild flowers. Grass dries up, and flowers fall to the ground.
translation_verse: Loŋ malɛ nɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ fanɛ: “Basa kikɛ du fanɛ kefitiri nna nɛ bumo be kemaŋkura malɛ kikɛ du fanɛ kefitiri na be ketoto. Kefitiri na bee kaa wɔl nna nɛ ketoto na e chuge n tɔr,

english_verse: But what the Lord has said will stand forever.” Our good news to you is what the Lord has said.
translation_verse: ama Enyɛnpe be kamalga na bre wɔtɔ nna mbaanaayɔ.” Loŋ be kamalga na e la baru lela mo nɛ b daŋ bɔ n sa menyi na.

english_verse: Stop being hateful! Quit trying to fool people, and start being sincere. Don't be jealous or say cruel things about others.
translation_verse: Amoso, men lara alubi kikɛ ashi menyi to. Men sa maŋ naa ku efɛ ŋko a kɔ kebirkɔnshi ŋko yurkishi ŋko katege be mmalga.

english_verse: Be like newborn babies who are thirsty for the pure spiritual milk that will help you grow and be saved.
translation_verse: Men baa sha kashenteŋ be abɔrɛsheŋ na ga fanɛ kananɛ mbi popɔrbi bee sha kenyipo na, saŋɛ na so menyeeŋ bɔla amo so n yɔ anishito ashi men be kumɔlga ere to.

english_verse: You have already found out how good the Lord really is.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, naniere men da Enyɛnpe be kebaawɔtɔ ŋ keni m pin fanɛ e walɛ.

english_verse: And now you are living stones being used to build a spiritual house. You are also a group of holy priests, and with the help of Jesus Christ you will offer sacrifices that please God.
translation_verse: Men shin nɛ b ta menyi alɛ gba fanɛ ajembu nɛ a kɔ ŋkpa nɛ b ta m pɔr na nɛ men ki Ebɔrɛ be ebu a la bɔrɛmatapo cheembiana a bɔla Yesu Kristo so a lara kiyoyu to be esarga nɛ a bee par Ebɔrɛ.

english_verse: It is just as God says in the Scriptures, “Look! I am placing in Zion a choice and precious cornerstone. No one who has faith in this one will be disappointed.”
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ fanɛ Ebɔrɛ bee kaŋɛ le nna: “Men keni, kejembu nɛ n lara nɛ k la ma kenishi nɛ n ta n nase Zayɔn to na, k la kebonfu to be gbaltɔlasejembu nna nɛ esa kama malɛ nɛ e yirda mo maaŋ ji anishinyɔr kikɛ.”

english_verse: You are followers of the Lord, and this stone is precious to you. But it isn't precious to those who refuse to follow him. They are the builders who tossed aside the stone that turned out to be the most important one of all.
translation_verse: Loŋ be kejembu ere la tɔnɔ be kusɔ gboŋgboŋi nna ga n sa menyi nɛ men yirda ere, ama bumo nɛ b maŋ yirda na bre, abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ fanɛ: “Kejembu mo nɛ bepɔrpo keni jiga na e ba ki ajembu to kikɛ be kelela ga na.”

english_verse: They disobeyed the message and stumbled and fell over this stone, because they were doomed.
translation_verse: Baa fiti a tɔr nna ŋkpal b ka maŋ yirda kamalga na so, kusɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ malɛ yili bumo nna na.

english_verse: But you are God's chosen and special people. You are a group of royal priests and a holy nation. God has brought you out of darkness into his marvelous light. Now you must tell all the wonderful things he has done. The Scriptures say,
translation_verse: Ama menyi ere la kanaŋ mo nɛ Ebɔrɛ lara nna nɛ men baa la bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ b shi kuwurji be kanaŋ to nseŋ naa la kanaŋ cheembi to ebi nɛ b la Ebɔrɛ be basa gbagba nɛ men ba kute esa nɛ e tre menyi ashi tentembiri to a yɔ mo gbagba be mamachi be kefulto to na be asheŋgboŋ be asheŋ n sa basa.

english_verse: “Once you were nobody. Now you are God's people. At one time no one had mercy on you. Now God has treated you with kindness.” Live as God's Servants Should
translation_verse: Saŋko men daa maŋ la Ebɔrɛ be basa, ama naniere men la mbe basa nna. Saŋko Ebɔrɛ daa maŋ wu menyi kuwɔr, ama naniere men nya mbe kuwɔr. Ebɔrɛ be anya be asheŋ

english_verse: Dear friends, you are foreigners and strangers on this earth. So I beg you not to surrender to those desires that fight against you.
translation_verse: N teri lelaana, mee kule menyi nna fanɛ men baa gelge ayɛlgasɔ lubiana nɛ a wɔ men be eyurana to a kɔ men be ayoyuana kena, a na fanɛ befɔ nɛ benitepo ashi durnya ere to.

english_verse: Always let others see you behaving properly, even though they may still accuse you of doing wrong. Then on the day of judgment, they will honor God by telling the good things they saw you do.
translation_verse: Men baa kɔ da lela a wɔ basa nɛ b maŋ la bebɛsopo na to, saŋɛ na so nɛ b kaa malga a gbiti menyi fanɛ alubiworapoana, baaŋ wu men be alelasheŋ nseŋ ta kemaŋkura n sa Ebɔrɛ kachɛ nɛ e beeŋ ba na.

english_verse: You must also obey governors, because they are sent by the Emperor to punish criminals and to praise good citizens.
translation_verse: ŋko mbe beyaasepo mo nɛ ewurgboŋ na bee kaa shuŋi fanɛ b ya kaa gberge alubiworapoana kusoe nsaa sa alelashenworapoana na mbo.

english_verse: You are free, but still you are God's servants, and you must not use your freedom as an excuse for doing wrong.
translation_verse: Men baa wɔtɔ fanɛ basa nɛ b wɔ bumo be amu a ji, ama men sa maa kɔ loŋ be kamooji na a buu kulubi kama so. Men baa kɔ kebaawɔtɔ mo nɛ k du fanɛ Ebɔrɛ be anya peya a wɔtɔ.

english_verse: Respect everyone and show special love for God's people. Honor God and respect the Emperor. The Example of Christ's Suffering
translation_verse: Men baa sa basa kikɛ bunyaŋ nsaa sha bekurgepoana na kikɛ. Men baa ŋana Ebɔrɛ nsaa bunyaŋ men be efuli so be ewurgboŋ na. Kananɛ Kristo be awurfoŋ la keŋini be asheŋ

english_verse: Servants, you must obey your masters and always show respect to them. Do this, not only to those who are kind and thoughtful, but also to those who are cruel.
translation_verse: Anya, men baa nu a sa men nyɛnpeana nsaa sa bumo bunyaŋ kikɛ nɛ k daga, mannɛ bumo nɛ b la benyɛnpe lela nsaa shu basa so na nawule, bumo nɛ b du nyaŋnyaŋ na gba ti so.

english_verse: God will bless you, even if others treat you unfairly for being loyal to him.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, nɛ men baa ji kasogberge be ebesa mo nɛ k maŋ daga ŋkpal men ka bee fɛ Ebɔrɛ be asheŋ so, menyeeŋ nya nɛfa damta.

english_verse: After all, God chose you to suffer as you follow in the footsteps of Christ, who set an example by suffering for you.
translation_verse: Kashenteŋto malɛ, loŋ so nɛ Ebɔrɛ tre menyi, ŋkpal manɛ so, loŋ nɛ Kristo gba ji tɔrɔ m bugi loŋ be ekpa na n nase fanɛ men bɛ mbe aya so.

english_verse: Christ did not sin or ever tell a lie.
translation_verse: E daa maŋ wora kulubi kikɛ, kafulesheŋ malɛ kikɛ daa maŋ lar mbe kɔnɔ to.

english_verse: Although he was abused, he never tried to get even. And when he suffered, he made no threats. Instead, he had faith in God, who judges fairly.
translation_verse: B daŋ tege mo, ama mo alɛ daa maŋ laŋɛ katege n sa bumo. B daŋ tɔrɔ mo, ama e daa maŋ nyaŋɛ to n tu bumo. Ama e daŋ ta mbe kumu nna m bɔɔ esa nɛ e bee ji asheŋ amo be ekpa so na enɔ.

english_verse: Christ carried the burden of our sins. He was nailed to the cross, so we would stop sinning and start living right. By his cuts and bruises you are healed.
translation_verse: Mo ere gbagba e ta mbe eyur n ta an be alubi n yɔ kedibi largato na so nɛ an baa la basa nɛ b wu alubi be kaplɛa so nsaa wɔtɔ ŋkpal alelasheŋ so. Mbe eyur be kemurgi so nɛ men nya kechɛ.

english_verse: You had wandered away like sheep. Now you have returned to the one who is your shepherd and protector.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, men daa du fanɛ mbolpɔ ka yeŋ to nna, ama naniere bre, men bɛta m ba men be ayoyu be Ekpapo nɛ Ekenipo kutɔ.

english_verse: If you are a wife, you must put your husband first. Even if he opposes our message, you will win him over by what you do. No one else will have to say anything to him,
translation_verse: Beche, menyi alɛ gba e baa nu a sa men kulana, saŋɛ na so nɛ bumo be ekama maŋ yirda kamalga na, nɛ men maŋ malga n sa bumo gba, baaŋ wu men be kebaawɔtɔ nseŋ ba yirda.

english_verse: because he will see how you honor God and live a pure life.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, baaŋ wu kananɛ men du cheembi nɛ kananɛ men be kabɔrɛŋana be kebaawɔtɔ du.

english_verse: Don't depend on things like fancy hairdos or gold jewelry or expensive clothes to make you look beautiful.
translation_verse: Men sa maŋ shin nɛ men be kebita e baa shi eyur so be kelɔŋɛ fanɛ amu be kekre ŋko eshuwa be abitasɔ be kewɔtɔ nɛ asɔbuuso lela be kebaabuu to.

english_verse: Be beautiful in your heart by being gentle and quiet. This kind of beauty will last, and God considers it very special.
translation_verse: A daga fanɛ men be kela e baa shi men be ŋgbene to gbagba to, kumo e la fanɛ men baa kɔ ŋgbene nɛ a du boeŋ a maa gbri. Loŋ be kela na e maa terge kikɛ nsaa walɛ ashi Ebɔrɛ be anishito.

english_verse: Long ago those women who worshiped God and put their hope in him made themselves beautiful by putting their husbands first.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, loŋ nɛ dra na be beche mo nɛ b daa du cheembi nseŋ daŋ ta bumo be tama n wɔtɔ Ebɔrɛ to na daa ji bumo be kebita nseŋ daa nu a sa bumo kulana.

english_verse: For example, Sarah obeyed Abraham and called him her master. You are her true children, if you do right and don't let anything frighten you.
translation_verse: An ta fanɛ Sɛɛra le, e daŋ nu n sa mo kul Eebraham nseŋ daŋ tre mo mo nyɛnpe. To, nɛ menyi alɛ gba baa wora asheŋ nɛ a daga ŋkaa maa lɔ kufu, menyeeŋ baa la mbe mbichesoana.

english_verse: If you are a husband, you should be thoughtful of your wife. Treat her with honor, because she isn't as strong as you are, and she shares with you in the gift of life. Then nothing will stand in the way of your prayers. Suffering for Doing Right
translation_verse: Bekul, loŋ koŋwule na a daga fanɛ menyi alɛ gba e baa kɔ kushuso ashi menyi nɛ men be beche be kebaawɔtɔana to nsaa bunyaŋ bumo a ta bumo fanɛ men braana mo nɛ b maŋ kɔ eleŋ, bumo alɛ ŋkaa beeŋ tu menyi n nya Ebɔrɛ be ŋkpa be kakɛ na. Men baa wora loŋ nɛ shɛŋ shɛŋ e sa maŋ kagle men be kabɔrɛkuleana ekpa nɛ a fo Ebɔrɛ ŋ gben. Keji awurfoŋ ŋkpal kelela be kewora so be asheŋ

english_verse: Finally, all of you should agree and have concern and love for each other. You should also be kind and humble.
translation_verse: Kusɔ nɛ k baa wɔtɔ kikɛ e la fanɛ men kikɛ e baa kɔ kɔnɔkoŋwule a wɔ abar so. Men baa shu abar so a kɔ keniopibi be kasha a sha abar nsaa la basa nseŋ naa bar men be amu kaseto.

english_verse: Don't be hateful and insult people just because they are hateful and insult you. Instead, treat everyone with kindness. You are God's chosen ones, and he will bless you. The Scriptures say,
translation_verse: Men sa maa laŋɛ kulubi a ka kulubi ŋko a laŋɛ katege a ka katege. Ama kusɔ nɛ k daga e la fanɛ men baa nɛfa basa nɛ baa wora menyi loŋ be alubiana, ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ ka tre menyi na, nɛfa nɛ e nase kɔnɔ fanɛ e beeŋ sa menyi.

english_verse: “Do you really love life? Do you want to be happy? Then stop saying cruel things and quit telling lies.
translation_verse: Kumo alɛ nɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ na fanɛ: “Esa kama nɛ e bee sha ŋkpa nsaa sha kewu nchɛ lela, kumo ere, amodoŋwura e sa maŋ shin nɛ mbe kɔnɔ e baa malga asheŋ lubi ŋko ku efɛ.

english_verse: Give up your evil ways and do right, as you find and follow the road to peace.
translation_verse: A daga fanɛ amodoŋwura e baa lar alubi to nsaa wora alela. A daga fanɛ e baa fin kagbenewushi nsaa bɛ kumo so saŋkikɛ.

english_verse: The Lord watches over everyone who obeys him, and he listens to their prayers. But he opposes everyone who does evil.”
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, Enyɛnpe be anishi wɔ belelapo kikɛ so nna, mo alɛ nsaa kaŋ kusoe a nu bumo be kabɔrɛkule, ama bekama nɛ baa wora alubi bre, e bee pal kaman nna a sa bumo.”

english_verse: Can anyone really harm you for being eager to do good deeds?
translation_verse: Nɛ men baŋ pere kenishi a sha kelela be kebaawora, wanɛ e naaŋ tiŋ n tɔrɔ menyi?

english_verse: Even if you have to suffer for doing good things, God will bless you. So stop being afraid and don't worry about what people might do.
translation_verse: Hale nɛ men wora kelela nɛ b kpal loŋ so n tɔrɔ menyi gba, nɛfa la menyeya nna. Men sa maa ŋana bumo be kafunti, menyi alɛ e sa maŋ naa shin nɛ men be ŋgbene e baa ku.

english_verse: Honor Christ and let him be the Lord of your life. Always be ready to give an answer when someone asks you about your hope.
translation_verse: Ama men baa sa Kristo bunyaŋ fanɛ Enyɛnpe ashi men be ŋgbene to. Men baa wora shiriya saŋkikɛ a jo esa kama nɛ e beeŋ ba bishi menyi tama mo nɛ men kɔ ere be kifito, nɛ men kaŋɛ mo.

english_verse: Give a kind and respectful answer and keep your conscience clear. This way you will make people ashamed for saying bad things about your good conduct as a follower of Christ.
translation_verse: Ama men baa kɔ amu be kebar kaseto nɛ bunyaŋ a wora loŋ nsaa maŋ shin nɛ kesheŋ lubi e baa wɔ men be nfɛra fɛsoana to, saŋɛ na so anishinyɔr beeŋ pɛ bekama nɛ baa malga asheŋ lubi a gbiti menyi ŋkpal men ka la Kristo be basa a wora alelasheŋ na so.

english_verse: Christ died once for our sins. An innocent person died for those who are guilty. Christ did this to bring you to God, when his body was put to death and his spirit was made alive.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, Kristo gba wu kela koŋwule nna pati, ŋkpal basa be alubi so, esa nɛ e maŋ kɔ kulubi e wu n sa basa lubi na, saŋɛ na so e beeŋ yɛra menyi Ebɔrɛ kutɔ. B daŋ mɔ mbe eyur, ama Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ e nya ŋkpa ashi mbe Kiyoyu na to.

english_verse: They had disobeyed God while Noah was building the boat, but God had been patient with them. Eight people went into that boat and were brought safely through the flood.
translation_verse: Ayoyu na la basa nɛ b daŋ kini kenu n sa Ebɔrɛ saŋɛ mo nɛ e daŋ ji bumo kanyiti jemanɛ mo nɛ Nowa daa gbir kuloŋgboŋ mo nɛ basa aburwa nawule daŋ luri to n nya kumɔlga ashi nchu na to na.

english_verse: Those flood waters were like baptism that now saves you. But baptism is more than just washing your body. It means turning to God with a clear conscience, because Jesus Christ was raised from death.
translation_verse: Loŋ be nchu na daa la kabɔrɛbɛr nɛ k bee mɔlga menyi naniere be kaduli nna, ama k maŋ la kusɔ nɛ k bee fɔr eyur to be alubi a lɛ. K la nfɛra niŋiso be kɔnɔ naseso mo nɛ esa bee nase nna a sa Ebɔrɛ. Yesu Kristo be ketiŋi luwu to na to nɛ k bee bɔla a mɔlga menyi.

english_verse: Christ is now in heaven, where he sits at the right side of God. All angels, authorities, and powers are under his control.
translation_verse: Mo, Yesu Kristo koŋwule na e yɔ ebɔrɛso n ya kaa tase Ebɔrɛ be jisoso, kakpa nɛ ebunyampo bee chena, a ji emalaika kikɛ nɛ bejuŋkparpoana kikɛ nɛ eleŋana kikɛ so kuwura na.

english_verse: Christ suffered here on earth. Now you must be ready to suffer as he did, because suffering shows that you have stopped sinning.
translation_verse: To, ŋkpal Kristo ka ji tɔrɔ mbe eyur to so, menyi alɛ gba e leŋ menyi be amu to a kɔ loŋ be kagbene, ŋkpal manɛ so, ekama nɛ e ji tɔrɔ mbe eyur to lar alubi to nna na.

english_verse: It means you have turned from your own desires and want to obey God for the rest of your life.
translation_verse: Nɛ loŋ malɛ baŋ wora, loŋ be esa na maŋ naa kɔ mbe durnya ere to be kebaawɔtɔ a wɔ edimɛdi be ayɛlgasɔ lubiana to, ama Ebɔrɛ be aparsheŋ to nɛ e kɔ mbe kebaawɔtɔ a wɔ.

english_verse: You have already lived long enough like people who don't know God. You were immoral and followed your evil desires. You went around drinking and partying and carrying on. In fact, you even worshiped disgusting idols.
translation_verse: Naniere bre a daga fanɛ men ka pin fanɛ asɔ nɛ nnyamase bee sha kewora nɛ menyi alɛ gba daa wora amo na be kewora kukwe. Asɔ nɛ men daa wora saŋɛ na e daa la kusɔjigaya be aworbi nɛ kesakalea be kayɛlga be aworbi nɛ kasanuu nɛ keshɛr abar n ji nseŋ boo ana be kebaawɔtɔ nɛ kushuŋ jiga fanɛ kagbirshuŋ be aworbi.

english_verse: Now your former friends wonder why you have stopped running around with them, and they curse you for it.
translation_verse: Naniere k bee chinchiŋ bumo nna, ŋkpal men ka maŋ naa tu bumo a wora loŋ be asheŋ jiga na so. Amoso nɛ baa tege menyi na.

english_verse: The good news has even been preached to the dead, so that after they have been judged for what they have done in this life, their spirits will live with God.
translation_verse: To, amoso nɛ b daŋ bɔ baru lela na n sa basa nɛ b maŋ naa wɔ ŋkpa to naniere na, saŋɛ na so, dimɛdi be kaplɛa so, baaŋ ji bumo demu, ama Ebɔrɛ bre be kaplɛa so, baaŋ baa wɔ ŋkpa to ashi kiyoyu na to. Kebaakeni Ebɔrɛ be ŋkɛana so be asheŋ

english_verse: Everything will soon come to an end. So be serious and be sensible enough to pray.
translation_verse: Asɔ kikɛ be ekar be jemanɛ na bee taga to nna na, amoso, men baa kɔ nfɛra niŋiso nsaa tiŋ men be amu, saŋɛ na so menyeeŋ tiŋ ŋ kule Ebɔrɛ nɛnɛ.

english_verse: Most important of all, you must sincerely love each other, because love wipes away many sins.
translation_verse: Ade kikɛ be kaman, men baa sha abar kashenteŋto, ŋkpal manɛ so, kasha e naa buu alubi damta so.

english_verse: Welcome people into your home and don't grumble about it.
translation_verse: Men baa sɔ abar men peana nsaa maa muni to.

english_verse: Each of you has been blessed with one of God's many wonderful gifts to be used in the service of others. So use your gift well.
translation_verse: Kiyoyu Cheeŋ be kakɛ kama nɛ ekama kɔ, e baa ta loŋ be kakɛ na a shuŋ mo braana fanɛ kenya lela nɛ b ta Ebɔrɛ be kuwɔr be kakɛ damtaana m bɔɔ mo enɔ.

english_verse: If you have the gift of speaking, preach God's message. If you have the gift of helping others, do it with the strength that God supplies. Everything should be done in a way that will bring honor to God because of Jesus Christ, who is glorious and powerful forever. Amen. Suffering for Being a Christian
translation_verse: Ekama nɛ e bee malga e shin nɛ mbe mmalga na e baa la fanɛ Ebɔrɛ be mmalga gbagba, nɛ ekama malɛ nɛ e bee shuŋ mo braana e baa ta eleŋ mo nɛ Ebɔrɛ bee sa mo na a wora loŋ, saŋɛ na so, kusɔ kama to, Ebɔrɛ beeŋ bɔla Yesu Kristo so n nya epaŋ be kedi. Kemaŋkura nɛ eleŋ e baa la mo peya mbaanaayɔ. Amɛn. Keji awurfoŋ ŋkpal Yesu so be asheŋ

english_verse: Be glad for the chance to suffer as Christ suffered. It will prepare you for even greater happiness when he makes his glorious return.
translation_verse: Ama men shin nɛ men be ŋgbene e baa fuli menyi parr fanɛ men ka bee ji Yesu be tɔrɔ na be ako, saŋɛ na so men be ŋgbene beeŋ fuli menyi saŋɛ nɛ mbe kemaŋkura beeŋ lar efuli na.

english_verse: Count it a blessing when you suffer for being a Christian. This shows that God's glorious Spirit is with you.
translation_verse: Nɛ b baŋ tege menyi ŋkpal men ka la Kristo be bebɛsopo so, kumo ere nɛfa la menyeya nna, ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ be Kiyoyu nɛ e kɔ kemaŋkura na e wɔ menyi to.

english_verse: But you deserve to suffer if you are a murderer, a thief, a crook, or a busybody.
translation_verse: Men sa maŋ shin nɛ tɔrɔ e baa ba menyi to be ekama so ŋkpal e ka la emɔpo ŋko eyu ŋko alubiworapo ŋko esa nɛ e bee luri basa be asheŋ to so.

english_verse: God has already begun judging his own people. And if his judgment begins with us, imagine how terrible it will be for those who refuse to obey his message. The Scriptures say,
translation_verse: Demu be kejiachɛ na taga to, Ebɔrɛ malɛ be kowu to ebi to nɛ k bee fara. Nɛ k baŋ fara anyi to bre, nuso nɛ asheŋ beeŋ ba kaa du n sa basa nɛ b maa nu a sa Ebɔrɛ be baru lela na?

english_verse: “If good people barely escape, what will happen to sinners and to others who don't respect God?”
translation_verse: Nɛ asheŋ baa du kpakpa n sa elelapo nɛ e nya kumɔlga, nuso nɛ a beeŋ ba kaa du n sa bɔrɛkinipo nɛ alubiworapo!

english_verse: Church leaders, I am writing to encourage you. I too am a leader, as well as a witness to Christ's suffering, and I will share in his glory when it is shown to us.
translation_verse: To, naniere a ka menyi to be bejuŋkparpo nɛ b du fanɛ kananɛ ma alɛ gba la men barkasa ejuŋkparpo ere nsaa la esa nɛ n la Kristo be tɔrɔ be shɛdajipo nseŋ naa la esa nɛ meeŋ tu bumo nɛ baaŋ nya kemaŋkura na saŋɛ nɛ k lar efuli na.

english_verse: Just as shepherds watch over their sheep, you must watch over everyone God has placed in your care. Do it willingly in order to please God, and not simply because you think you must. Let it be something you want to do, instead of something you do merely to make money.
translation_verse: Mee kule menyi nna fanɛ men baa keni Ebɔrɛ be basa nɛ b wɔ men be enɔ to a du fanɛ mbolpɔ na so. Men sa maŋ ta bumo be kekeniso na fanɛ katiŋ be kusɔ. Men baa bugi ŋgbene a keni bumo so fanɛ kananɛ Ebɔrɛ bee sha fanɛ men baa du na. Men sa maŋ baa wɔtɔ a kɔ kajɛso a fin kakɔka, men baa bugi kagbene a sha kebaashuŋ basa.

english_verse: Don't be bossy to those people who are in your care, but set an example for them.
translation_verse: Men sa maa ŋini bumo nɛ Ebɔrɛ ta m bɔɔ menyi enɔ na kenimu, men baa la basa nɛ mbolpɔbi na beeŋ tiŋ ŋ keni so n wora asheŋ.

english_verse: Then when Christ the Chief Shepherd returns, you will be given a crown that will never lose its glory.
translation_verse: Saŋɛ na so, Ekenipo Nimuso na kaŋ ya lar m ba, menyeeŋ nya kemaŋkurawuro mo nɛ k maa terge kikɛ na.

english_verse: All of you young people should obey your elders. In fact, everyone should be humble toward everyone else. The Scriptures say, “God opposes proud people, but he helps everyone who is humble.”
translation_verse: Mbrantiɛ, loŋ koŋwule na nɛ a daga fanɛ men baa nu a sa benyɛnnimuana. Men ta kumu be kebar kaseto m mea to fanɛ wajɛ a wɔtɔ a sa abar, ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ maa sa kamoowuwuraana kashuli, ama bumo nɛ baa bar bumo be amu kaseto bre, e bee wu bumo kuwɔr nna.

english_verse: Be humble in the presence of God's mighty power, and he will honor you when the time comes.
translation_verse: Amoso, men baa bar men be amu kaseto a wɔtɔ Ebɔrɛ be enɔgboŋana to nɛ e maŋ menyi so mo gbagba be saŋɛ.

english_verse: God cares for you, so turn all your worries over to him.
translation_verse: Men ta men be asheŋ tirso kikɛ a lɛ mo so, ŋkpal manɛ so, men be asheŋ wɔ mbe kagbene to ga.

english_verse: Be on your guard and stay awake. Your enemy, the devil, is like a roaring lion, sneaking around to find someone to attack.
translation_verse: Men baa da so n shin nɛ men be nfɛra e baa niŋi, ŋkpal manɛ so, men doŋ alubipo na wɔtɔ nna a kilgi to fanɛ buluŋ a fin esa nɛ e beeŋ mur.

english_verse: But you must resist the devil and stay strong in your faith. You know that all over the world the Lord's followers are suffering just as you are.
translation_verse: Men baa kɔ men be yirda to kpakpa a tu mo nsaa maa sa mo kashuli, ŋkpal manɛ so, menyi alɛ gba nyi fanɛ loŋ nɛ men braana bebɛsopo ashi durnya ere to be kaplɛkama gba bee nya tɔrɔ.

english_verse: But God shows undeserved kindness to everyone. That's why he appointed Christ Jesus to choose you to share in his eternal glory. You will suffer for a while, but God will make you complete, steady, strong, and firm.
translation_verse: Ama nɛ men baŋ ji tɔrɔ ere gbrɛbi m ba lar, kuwɔr be kakɛ kikɛ be Ebɔrɛ nɛ e bee tre menyi fanɛ men ba tu Kristo nɛ men gama n nya mbe kemaŋkura mo nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na gbagba beeŋ naŋ shin nɛ kusɔ kama e nyalɛ n sa menyi nseŋ wɔtɔ menyi eleŋ to n shin nɛ men baa yil to nɛnɛ a maa gbuŋgbuŋ to kikɛ.

english_verse: God will be in control forever! Amen. Final Greetings
translation_verse: Eleŋ e baa la mo peya hale mbaanaayɔ. Amɛn. Lalaloge be kechɔrɔ be asheŋ

english_verse: Silvanus helped me write this short letter, and I consider him a faithful follower of the Lord. I wanted to encourage you and tell you how kind God really is, so you will keep on having faith in him.
translation_verse: Ekurgepo Silvanes mo nɛ n nyi fanɛ meeŋ tiŋ n yirda na so so nɛ mee bɔla a sibɛ menyi kawɔlbi ere na. N sibɛ kumo nna gbrɛbi loŋ nɛ n leŋ menyi to nseŋ naŋ ji shɛda ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ kuwɔr be kakɛ mo nɛ k shi Ebɔrɛ kutɔ kashenteŋ na nna na. Men baa yil kumo to kpakpa.

english_verse: Greetings from the Lord's followers in Babylon. They are God's chosen ones. Mark, who is like a son to me, sends his greetings too.
translation_verse: Babilɔn be asɔri nɛ k du fanɛ men sipoche na be basa nɛ Ebɔrɛ lara menyi nɛ bumo kikɛ na bee chɔrɔ menyi. M pibi Maak gba bee chɔrɔ menyi.

english_verse: Give each other a warm greeting. I pray that God will give peace to everyone who belongs to Christ.
translation_verse: Men baa ta kasha be kegbuŋ be kepipeso be kechɔrɔ a chɔrɔ abar. Kagbenewushi e baa wɔ menyi nɛ men wɔ Kristo to na kikɛ so.

english_verse: From Simon Peter, a servant and an apostle of Jesus Christ. To everyone who shares with us in the privilege of believing that our God and Savior Jesus Christ will do what is just and fair.
translation_verse: Kawɔl ere shi ma, Saimɔn Pita nɛ n la Yesu Kristo be kenya nɛ mbe eshuŋipo na kutɔ nna a yɔ menyi nɛ men bɔla Yesu Kristo an be Ebɔrɛ nɛ an be Emɔlgapo be kananɛ e niŋi ekpa so so n nya yirda koŋwule nɛ anyi alɛ gba kɔ na kutɔ. Anyi be yirda na maŋ kɔ ebarkasa kikɛ.

english_verse: I pray that God will be kind to you and will let you live in perfect peace! May you keep learning more and more about God and our Lord Jesus. Living as the Lord's Followers
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ e bɔla men be kebaanyi mo nɛ Yesu an Nyɛnpe na so n shin nɛ mbe kuwɔr be kakɛ nɛ kagbenewushi e baa la menyeya m bɔlɔ menyi to kiŋkiŋ. Ebɔrɛ be ketre nɛ mbe kelara esa be asheŋ

english_verse: We have everything we need to live a life that pleases God. It was all given to us by God's own power, when we learned he had invited us to share in his wonderful goodness.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ bɔla mbe eleŋ so n sa anyi kusɔ kama nɛ k daga fanɛ an baa kɔ n tiŋ a wɔ kabɔrɛŋana be kebaawɔtɔ nɛ k daga to. Anyi be kebaanyi emo nɛ e bɔla mo gbagba be kemaŋkura nɛ mbe kelela so n tre anyi na so nɛ e wora loŋ.

english_verse: God made great and marvelous promises, so his nature would become part of us. Then we could escape our evil desires and the corrupt influences of this world.
translation_verse: Ade malɛ kikɛ so nɛ e bɔla n sa anyi mbe nnɔ naseso gboŋana nɛ a maŋ kɔ abraana kikɛ na, saŋɛ na so menyeeŋ bɔla amo so ŋ gelge kafulesheŋ nɛ k wɔ durnya ere to ŋkpal kumo be ayɛlgasɔ so nseŋ ba tu Ebɔrɛ a kɔ mbe kapɔr na.

english_verse: If you keep growing in this way, it will show that what you know about our Lord Jesus Christ has made your lives useful and meaningful.
translation_verse: To, nɛ men baa kɔ asɔ ere nsaa kɔ amo to ga menyi to, a beeŋ shin nɛ men baa du wurɛwurɛbi a kɔ tɔnɔ ashi kananɛ men nyi Enyɛnpe Yesu Kristo na to.

english_verse: But if you don't grow, you are like someone who is nearsighted or blind, and you have forgotten that your past sins are forgiven.
translation_verse: Esa kama nɛ e maŋ kɔ loŋ be asɔ na tan nna na, mo alɛ maa wu a yɔ kufɔ, mo alɛ nseŋ naŋ teŋ so fanɛ Ebɔrɛ kpra mbe alubi nɛ a daa wɔ mo so na kikɛ ashi mo so.

english_verse: My friends, you must do all you can to show God has really chosen and selected you. If you keep on doing this, you won't stumble and fall.
translation_verse: Amoso, ŋ kurgepoana, men baa wora ania ga kebaawɔtɔ ere to a ti so n shin nɛ men be ketre nɛ kelara nɛ Ebɔrɛ lara menyi na e baa dii efuli men be kebaawɔtɔ to. Nɛ menyi alɛ baa wora loŋ be asheŋ na men maaŋ tɔr kikɛ.

english_verse: Then our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ will give you a glorious welcome into his kingdom that will last forever.
translation_verse: Saŋɛ na so baaŋ bugi ekpa pawu n sa menyi nɛ men luri an Nyɛnpe nɛ an be Emɔlgapo Yesu Kristo be kuwura nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na to. Abɔrɛsibɛ be kewuŋkaŋɛ be asheŋ

english_verse: You are holding firmly to the truth you were given. But I am still going to remind you of these things.
translation_verse: N nyi men ka nyi asɔ ere kikɛ, ma alɛ nseŋ naa nyi men ka yil kashenteŋ nɛ men kɔ naniere na to kpakpa, ama saŋkikɛ meeŋ baa nyiŋi menyi asheŋ ere kikɛ.

english_verse: In fact, I think I should keep on reminding you until I leave this body.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, mee fɛ fanɛ ŋ ka kraa wɔ eyur ere to ere bre, a daga fanɛ m baa nyiŋi menyi asheŋ na kikɛ a leŋ menyi to.

english_verse: And our Lord Jesus Christ has already told me that I will soon leave it behind.
translation_verse: N nyi fanɛ k maaŋ naŋ chɛr nɛ ŋ gbaŋ ma eyur ere n lɛ, kumo alɛ be loŋ nɛ an Nyɛnpe Yesu Kristo bugi to ŋ ŋini ma na.

english_verse: This is why I am doing my best to make sure that each of you remembers all of this after I am gone. The Message about the Glory of Christ
translation_verse: Ama pɔɛŋ nɛ n wu, meeŋ wora ania ga n fin ekpa mo nɛ menyeeŋ baa bɔla so a nyiŋi asɔ nɛ n nase menyi ere saŋkikɛ.

english_verse: When we told you about the power and the return of our Lord Jesus Christ, we were not telling clever stories someone had made up. But with our own eyes we saw his true greatness.
translation_verse: Men baa nyi fanɛ mannɛ dimɛdi be kanyiashenso be nfɛra fɛso be ablɔmbi so nɛ an daa bɛ saŋɛ nɛ an daŋ kaŋɛ menyi an Nyɛnpe Yesu Kristo be eleŋ nɛ mbe keba be asheŋ na. An daŋ wu kemaŋkura na kenishiso.

english_verse: God, our great and wonderful Father, truly honored him by saying, “This is my own dear Son, and I am pleased with him.”
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ Etuto na daŋ sa mo bunyaŋ nɛ kemaŋkura na saŋɛ nɛ ebɔl na daŋ shi Kemaŋkuraana kikɛ to be kakpa m ba kaŋɛ le na: “Ŋ gbagba Pibinyɛn shaso nɛ ma kagbene fuli mo so nde.”

english_verse: We were there with Jesus on the holy mountain and heard this voice speak from heaven.
translation_verse: Ebɔl na ka daŋ shi ebɔrɛso m ba saŋɛ nɛ anyi nɛ mo daa la kebee cheembi na so na, anyi alɛ gba daŋ nu kumo.

english_verse: All of this makes us even more certain that what the prophets said is true. So you should pay close attention to their message, as you would to a lamp shining in some dark place. You must keep on paying attention until daylight comes and the morning star rises in your hearts.
translation_verse: Amoso, anyee yirda asheŋ nɛ anebiana wu ŋ kaŋɛ ana an be ŋgbene to a ti so. Nɛ men baa bɛ amo so fanɛ fitila ka bee sa kefulto tentembiri be kakpa to na, menyeeŋ baa wora asɔ. Men baa kɔ to loŋ hale nɛ kachɛ na e ya kaa fo nɛ karechɛso be kechɛkpabi na e ya nyaŋɛ kefulto n wɔtɔ men be ŋgbene to.

english_verse: But you need to realize that no one alone can understand any of the prophecies in the Scriptures.
translation_verse: Ade kikɛ nyam be kaman, men baa nyi fanɛ esa kama maaŋ tiŋ n ta mo gbagba be nfɛra ŋ kute abɔrɛsibɛ be kewuŋkaŋɛ kama.

english_verse: The prophets did not think these things up on their own, but they were guided by the Spirit of God.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, abɔrɛsheŋ wuŋkaŋɛ kama maŋ naŋ shi dimɛdi be katiŋ so m ba, ama Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na e daŋ ta basa nɛ b malga baru nɛ k shi Ebɔrɛ kutɔ na.

english_verse: Sometimes false prophets spoke to the people of Israel. False teachers will also sneak in and speak harmful lies to you. But these teachers don't really belong to the Master who paid a great price for them, and they will quickly destroy themselves.
translation_verse: Kananɛ anebi fɛpoana daŋ lar n luri dra na to ebi to na, loŋ koŋwule na nɛ beŋinipo fɛpoana beeŋ lar n luri menyi to. Baaŋ ŋana m bar efɛ be keŋiniana nɛ a bee mur basa nseŋ kini Enyɛnpe nɛ e sɔ bumo n yige na, saŋɛ na so n ta kemur purgiase m bar bumo be amu.

english_verse: Many people will follow their evil ways and cause others to tell lies about the true way.
translation_verse: Basa damta beeŋ bɛ bumo be anishinyɔr be asheŋ so n shin nɛ basa e malga ŋ gbiti kashenteŋ be ekpa na.

english_verse: They will be greedy and cheat you with smooth talk. But long ago God decided to punish them, and God doesn't sleep.
translation_verse: Beŋinipoana ere beeŋ bɔla bumo be kajɛ so n ta bumo gbagba be ablɔmbi n ta menyi n nyalɛ. Bumo alɛ be kasogberge dese n chɛr a jo bumo nɛ bumo be esa nɛ e beeŋ mur bumo na maa di.

english_verse: God did not have pity on the angels that sinned. He had them tied up and thrown into the dark pits of hell until the time of judgment.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, nɛ Ebɔrɛ maŋ yige emalaika mo nɛ b daŋ wora alubi na gba nseŋ daŋ yɛra bumo kemaŋ nɛ baa tre abis to na nɛ b ya kaa kɔ bumo to tentembiri to mina a jo demujiachɛ na,

english_verse: And during Noah's time, God did not have pity on the ungodly people of the world. He destroyed them with a flood, though he did save eight people, including Noah, who preached the truth.
translation_verse: ŋko nɛ e daa maŋ yige saŋɛ na be durnyaebi nseŋ daŋ bar nchu m ba sɔ durnya kikɛ nɛ kumo to be basa lubi mur nseŋ daŋ lara Nowa nɛ e daa la Ebɔrɛ be anishito be alelashemmalgapo na nɛ basa ashunu ko na, e beeŋ yige le be beŋinipo fɛpoana ere a?

english_verse: God punished the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah by burning them to ashes, and this is a warning to anyone else who wants to sin.
translation_verse: Ŋko nɛ e daŋ wu Sodɔm nɛ Gomɔra be nde na to ebi be alubi nseŋ daŋ chɔɔ amo edɛ nyam n ta kusɔ nɛ k daŋ wora bumo na a ŋini kusɔ nɛ k beeŋ ba wora bɔrɛkinipoana na, e beeŋ yige le be befɛpo ere bre a?

english_verse: Lot lived right and was greatly troubled by the terrible way those wicked people were living. He was a good man, and day after day he suffered because of the evil things he saw and heard. So the Lord rescued him.
translation_verse: ŋkpal manɛ so, e ka daa la esa lela nseŋ daa wɔ bumo to kapa nɛ kanyɛ na so, mbe kagbene daa maŋ dese mo ŋkpal asɔ jiga nɛ e daa wu nɛ amo nɛ e daa nu so.

english_verse: This shows that the Lord knows how to rescue godly people from their sufferings and to punish evil people while they wait for the day of judgment.
translation_verse: Amoso, men baa nyi fanɛ Enyɛnpe na nyi kananɛ e bee lara bɔrɛshapoana ashi bumo be kechɔŋkeniana to nseŋ naa nyi kananɛ e beeŋ baa kɔ bɔrɛkinipoana nɛ e kɔ a wɔ kasogberge to a jo demujiachɛ na,

english_verse: The Lord is especially hard on people who disobey him and don't think of anything except their own filthy desires. They are reckless and proud and are not afraid of cursing the glorious beings in heaven.
translation_verse: fɔnfɔŋ bumo nɛ b wɔtɔ a bɛ bumo be eyurana be nyɛlga lubiana so nsaa kini Ebɔrɛ be eleŋ na so. Loŋ be basa na nya kagbene nna a wɔtɔ a wu bumo be amu nsaa tege bebunyampoana nɛ b wɔ ebɔrɛso na ŋkaa maa ŋana,

english_verse: Although angels are more powerful than these evil beings, even the angels don't dare to accuse them to the Lord.
translation_verse: ŋkeshin nɛ emalaika gba e baa chɔ beŋinipo fɛpoana na eleŋ nɛ kemaŋkura ga ere maa wu bebunyampoana na kulubi nsaa tege bumo Enyɛnpe na be anishito.

english_verse: These people are no better than senseless animals that live by their feelings and are born to be caught and killed. They speak evil of things they don't know anything about. But their own corrupt deeds will destroy them.
translation_verse: Ama loŋ be basa ere bee malga a gbiti asheŋ nɛ b maa pin to nna. B du fanɛ asɔbɔya nna a maŋ kɔ nfɛra a wora asheŋ. B kurge bumo nna nɛ b baa pɛ nsaa jija bumo. To, loŋ nɛ beŋinipoana na gba beeŋ mur fanɛ asɔbɔya na.

english_verse: They have done evil, and they will be rewarded with evil. They think it is fun to have wild parties during the day. They are immoral, and the meals they eat with you are spoiled by the shameful and selfish way they carry on.
translation_verse: Tɔrɔ mo nɛ baa bar ere, Ebɔrɛ beeŋ ta tɔrɔ ŋ ka bumo. Kusɔ nɛ k la ebel bumo kutɔ e la kewora kusɔ kama nɛ bumo be eyurana bee sha kapaso parr. Bumo be asheŋ la anishinyɔr nɛ ŋaba nna nɛ baa tu menyi a ji a wɔtɔ a nu bumo be kafulesheŋ be ebel na.

english_verse: All they think about is having sex with someone else's husband or wife. There is no end to their wicked deeds. They trick people who are easily fooled, and their minds are filled with greedy thoughts. But they are headed for trouble!
translation_verse: Kesakaleasheŋ e baŋ bɔlɔ bumo be nfɛraana to, bumo alɛ maa wora alubi a gben kikɛ. Bumo e naa fule basa nɛ b maa kra ketɔr a wɔtɔ asheŋ jiga to, bumo alɛ nseŋ naa la kejimuni be bejuŋkparpo. B wɔ Ebɔrɛ be kɔnɔso to nna.

english_verse: They have left the true road and have gone down the wrong path by following the example of the prophet Balaam. He was the son of Beor and loved what he got from being a crook.
translation_verse: B yige ekpa niŋiso na nseŋ foe m bɔla Biyɔɔ pibi Balaam nɛ e daŋ sha kebɔlɔ alubi so n dii dama na be ekpa.

english_verse: These people are like dried up water holes and clouds blown by a windstorm. The darkest part of hell is waiting for them.
translation_verse: Le be basa ere du fanɛ abombi nɛ a maŋ kɔ nchu nna ŋko kenyɔlɔ nna nɛ afugboŋ bee kpata a yɔ. Ebɔrɛ kɔ tentembiri nna le mina a jo bumo.

english_verse: They brag out loud about their stupid nonsense. And by being vulgar and crude, they trap people who have barely escaped from living the wrong kind of life.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, njɔŋ be mmalga fuloŋ e naa lar bumo be nnɔ to, bumo alɛ nseŋ naa kɔ anishinyɔr be kayɛlgasɔ ashi bumo be eyurana to a pɛ basa nɛ b baŋ fara a sha kelara bumo be amu basa nɛ b wɔ kafule to.

english_verse: They promise freedom to everyone. But they are merely slaves of filthy living, because people are slaves of whatever controls them.
translation_verse: Baa kaŋɛ basa pɔtɛ fanɛ baaŋ nya kamooji nɛ bumo gbagba wɔ kafule be kenyaya to. Kusɔ kama malɛ nɛ k bee pɔɔ esa so, kumo e la amodoŋwura mo nyɛnpe.

english_verse: When they learned about our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ, they escaped from the filthy things of this world. But they are again caught up and controlled by these filthy things, and now they are in worse shape than they were at first.
translation_verse: Bekama nɛ b daŋ pin an Nyɛnpe nɛ an be Emɔlgapo Yesu Kristo na pɔɛŋ ŋkeŋ nya n lar durnya ere to be kebaawɔtɔ bɛso ere be aworbi to, kumo be kaman nɛ loŋ be asheŋ na naŋ pɛ bumo m pɔɔ bumo so, loŋ be basa be kebaawɔtɔ naa lubi nna ga a chɔ bumo be faraŋko be kebaawɔtɔ na.

english_verse: They would have been better off if they had never known about the right way. Even after they knew what was right, they turned their backs on the holy commandments they were given.
translation_verse: Nɛ b daa maŋ pin Ebɔrɛ be anishito be alelasheŋ be ekpa nna, k daa beeŋ baa bɔ bumo so a chɔ b ka ba pin kumo nseŋ naŋ pal kaman n sa Ebɔrɛ be kamalga naseso cheembi nɛ e daŋ ta n sa bumo na.

english_verse: What happened to them is just like the true saying, “A dog will come back to lick up its own vomit. A pig that has been washed will roll in the mud.”
translation_verse: Bumo be loŋ be kebaawɔtɔ na e naa ŋini aŋasa mo nɛ a bee kaŋɛ le na ka la kashenteŋ, a yɛ: “Jɔnɔ ka naa bɛta a yɔ kumo be ekwiɛ to,” ŋko: “B ka bɛr preku nɛ k naa bɛta n ya kaa milti depɔ to.”

english_verse: what God's prophets said would happen. You must never forget what the holy prophets taught in the past. And you must remember what the apostles told you our Lord and Savior has commanded us to do.
translation_verse: Mee sha fanɛ men nyiŋi mmalga nɛ anebi cheembiana na daŋ malga dra na nɛ kamalga nɛ an Nyɛnpe nɛ an be Emɔlgapo daŋ bɔla men be beshuŋipoana so m malga n nase na.

english_verse: But first you must realize that in the last days some people won't think about anything except their own selfish desires. They will make fun of you
translation_verse: Kusɔ nɛ k daga fanɛ men fara m pin e la fanɛ, lalaloge be nchɛ na to befɛpo beeŋ ba kaa wora basa shia nsaa bɛ bumo gbagba be nyɛlga lubiana so.

english_verse: and say, “Didn't your Lord promise to come back? Yet the first leaders have already died, and the world hasn't changed a bit.”
translation_verse: Baaŋ kaŋɛ le: “Mannɛ mo e nase kumo fanɛ e beeŋ naŋ ba na a? To, nɛ e wɔ nnɛ? An tutoana ka baŋ wu kikɛ, asheŋ baa du kananɛ a du yili durnya be faraŋko na kikɛ nna.”

english_verse: They will say this because they want to forget that long ago the heavens and the earth were made at God's command. The earth came out of water and was made from water.
translation_verse: Ama le be basa ere bee kute nna a kini kepin fanɛ dra na Ebɔrɛ daŋ malga nna nɛ esosoana nɛ kasawule daŋ fara kebaawɔtɔ. Nchu nɛ e daŋ ta nseŋ naŋ bɔla amo so ŋ jɔŋɛ kasawule.

english_verse: Later it was destroyed by the waters of a mighty flood.
translation_verse: Nchu malɛ so nɛ e daŋ bɔla n jija saŋɛ na be durnya nɛ k mur.

english_verse: But God has commanded the present heavens and earth to remain until the day of judgment. Then they will be set on fire, and ungodly people will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Kamalga koŋwule na so nɛ naniere be esosoana nɛ kasawule ere wɔtɔ a jo edɛ be keta m mur kumo na. A bee jo demujiachɛ nna, kachɛ nɛ bɔrɛkinipoana beeŋ mur na.

english_verse: The Lord isn't slow about keeping his promises, as some people think he is. In fact, God is patient, because he wants everyone to turn from sin and no one to be lost.
