translation_verse: Amoso, Enyɛnpe na maŋ wushi ashi mbe kɔnɔ nɛ e nase fanɛ e beeŋ wora na to nna fanɛ kananɛ basa ko bee fɛ esa be kewushi na nna. Kanyiti nɛ e bee ji menyi a maa sha fanɛ esa kikɛ e mur, ama e bee sha fanɛ ekama e lar mbe alubi to nna.

english_verse: The day of the Lord's return will surprise us like a thief. The heavens will disappear with a loud noise, and the heat will melt the whole universe. Then the earth and everything on it will be seen for what they are.
translation_verse: Ama Enyɛnpe be kachɛ na beeŋ purgi basa nna fanɛ eyu na. Kumo be kachɛ na, esosoana beeŋ ta awɔr chilili n foe basa be anishito. Esoso be asɔana beeŋ chɔɔ edɛ m mur. Nɛ kasawule nɛ asɔ nɛ a wɔ kumo so ere kikɛ e dii efuli.

english_verse: You should look forward to the day when God judges everyone, and you should try to make it come soon. On that day the heavens will be destroyed by fire, and everything else will melt in the heat.
translation_verse: a keni Ebɔrɛ be kachɛ na ekpa n shin nɛ k ba manaŋ. Kumo be kachɛ na, esosoana beeŋ chɔɔ edɛ m mur nɛ kuwuloŋ na e ŋalga esoso be asɔana na.

english_verse: But God has promised us a new heaven and a new earth, where justice will rule. We are really looking forward to this!
translation_verse: Ama mbe kɔnɔ nɛ e nase na so nɛ anyee keni esoso popɔrana na nɛ kasawule popɔr na ekpa, ndoŋ nɛ Ebɔrɛ be anishito be alelasheŋ wɔ na.

english_verse: Don't forget that the Lord is patient because he wants people to be saved. This is also what our dear friend Paul said when he wrote you with the wisdom God had given him.
translation_verse: Men baa nyi men be ŋgbene to fanɛ Enyɛnpe be kanyiti e la kumɔlga fanɛ kananɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ sa an niopibi Pɔɔl kanyiasheŋ nɛ e sibɛ menyi na.

english_verse: Paul talks about these same things in all his letters, but part of what he says is hard to understand. Some ignorant and unsteady people even destroy themselves by twisting what he said. They do the same thing with other Scriptures too.
translation_verse: Mbe nwɔl malɛ kikɛ to loŋ nɛ e bee malga a kaŋɛ loŋ be asheŋ. Ama asɔ ko wɔ mbe nwɔlana na to nna a maa tiŋ a pin to nɛ basa nɛ b maŋ nyi ŋkaa maa tiŋ a yil to kpakpa na bee bɔla ekpa nɛ k maŋ niŋi so a ŋini asheŋ gbɛto fanɛ kananɛ baa ta abɔrɛsibɛ nɛ a ka na a wora na. Loŋ malɛ, bumo gbagba be amu so nɛ baa bar kemur na.

english_verse: My dear friends, you have been warned ahead of time! So don't let the errors of evil people lead you down the wrong path and make you lose your balance.
translation_verse: Ama n teri lelaana, menyi ere tea nyi asheŋ ere kikɛ, amoso, men baa da so nɛ mbrakinipoana be alubi e sa maŋ shin nɛ men foe ekpa n lar kakpa lela nɛ men yil ere so n tɔr.

english_verse: Let the gift of undeserved grace and the understanding that come from our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ help you keep on growing. Praise Jesus now and forever! Amen.
translation_verse: Ama men baa wɔtɔ a yɔ anishito ashi an Nyɛnpe nɛ an be Emɔlgapo Yesu Kristo be kuwɔr be kakɛ na nɛ kashennyi na to. Kemaŋkura e baa la mo peya naniere nɛ saŋkikɛ mbaanaayɔ. Amɛn.

english_verse: The Word that gives life was from the beginning, and this is the one our message is about. Our ears have heard, our eyes have seen, and our hands have touched this Word.
translation_verse: Yesu Kristo nɛ baa tre Kamalga nɛ k bee sa ŋkpa nsaa wɔtɔ durnya be sososo kikɛ na be asheŋ nɛ anyee sibɛ a sa menyi na. E malga nɛ an nu nseŋ wu mo kenishiso ŋ keni mo nseŋ ta an be enɔana m beta mo.

english_verse: The one who gives life appeared! We saw it happen, and we are witnesses to what we have seen. Now we are telling you about this eternal life that was with the Father and appeared to us.
translation_verse: Le be ŋkpa ere ka ba lar efuli nɛ an wu kumo, amoso nɛ anyee ji kumo be shɛda a sa menyi a kaŋɛ menyi ŋkpa nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar ere be asheŋ na. K daa wɔ Ebɔrɛ na kutɔ nna pɔɛŋ nɛ b lara kumo efuli n sa anyi.

english_verse: We are telling you what we have seen and heard, so you may share in this life with us. And we share in it with the Father and with his Son Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Asɔ nɛ an wu nseŋ nu nɛ anyee ta a kaŋɛ menyi alɛ gba na, saŋɛ na so menyeeŋ tu anyi a wɔ kɔnɔkoŋwule be kebaawɔtɔ mo nɛ anyi nɛ Etuto Ebɔrɛ nɛ mo Pibinyɛn Yesu Kristo kɔ na to.

english_verse: We are writing to tell you these things, because this makes us truly happy. God Is Light
translation_verse: Anyi alɛ naa sibɛ kawɔl ere nna nɛ anyi be ŋgbene e fuli anyi parr. Kebaana kefulto to be asheŋ

english_verse: Jesus told us God is light and doesn't have any darkness in him. Now we are telling you.
translation_verse: Baru mo nɛ an nu ashi Ebɔrɛ Pibinyɛn na kutɔ nsaa bɔ kumo a sa menyi na nde fanɛ Ebɔrɛ la kefulto nna nɛ tentembiri malɛ kikɛ maŋ wɔ mo to kuraa.

english_verse: If we say we share in life with God and keep on living in the dark, we are lying and are not living by the truth.
translation_verse: To, nɛ anyee kaŋɛ fanɛ anyi nɛ Ebɔrɛ kɔ kɔnɔkoŋwule be kebaawɔtɔ nsaa na tentembiri to, efɛ nɛ anyee ku na, anyi alɛ nsaa maŋ naa wɔ kashenteŋ be kebaawɔtɔ to.

english_verse: But if we live in the light, as God does, we share in life with each other. And the blood of his Son Jesus washes all our sins away.
translation_verse: Ama nɛ fanɛ an baa na kefulto to fanɛ kananɛ e wɔ kefulto to na bre, kumo ere anyi nɛ an braana beeŋ baa kɔ kɔnɔkoŋwule be kebaawɔtɔ nɛ mo Pibinyɛn Yesu be ŋklaŋ nɛ a lar saŋɛ nɛ e wu na e baa fɔr kulubi kikɛ nyam ashi anyi be ŋgbene to.

english_verse: If we say we have not sinned, we are fooling ourselves, and the truth isn't in our hearts.
translation_verse: Nɛ an baŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ an maŋ kɔ kulubi bre, anyee fule anyi be amu nna nɛ kashenteŋ malɛ maŋ wɔ anyi to kuraa.

english_verse: If we say we have not sinned, we make God a liar, and his message isn't in our hearts.
translation_verse: Nɛ an baŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ an maŋ wora alubi bre, kumo ere anyee tre Ebɔrɛ efɛpo nna na nɛ mbe kamalga na malɛ maŋ wɔ anyi to.

english_verse: My children, I am writing this so you won't sin. But if you do sin, Jesus Christ always does the right thing, and he will speak to the Father for us.
translation_verse: Ma mbi shasoana, mee sibɛ kawɔl ere nna a sa menyi nɛ men sa maŋ wora alubi. Ama nɛ k ba fanɛ ekama nɛ e ba wora kulubi bre, an kɔ ematapo ashi anyi nɛ Ebɔrɛ Etuto na be nferinto. Mo e la Yesu Kristo, esa nɛ e la esa lela Ebɔrɛ be anishito na.

english_verse: When we obey God, we are sure we know him.
translation_verse: Nɛ an baa bɛ Ebɔrɛ be mmalga naseso so bre, kumo ere an baa nyi geeŋ fanɛ an nyi mo.

english_verse: But if we claim to know him and don't obey him, we are lying and the truth isn't in our hearts.
translation_verse: Esa kama nɛ e bee kaŋɛ fanɛ: “Ma ere nyi mo,” mo alɛ nsaa maa bɛ Ebɔrɛ na be mmalga naseso so, amodoŋwura la efɛpo nna nɛ kashenteŋ na malɛ maŋ wɔ mo to.

english_verse: We truly love God only when we obey him as we should, and then we know we belong to him.
translation_verse: Ama esa kama nɛ e bee bɛ Ebɔrɛ na be mmalga naseso so, amodoŋwura e la esa nɛ Ebɔrɛ be kasha bɔlɔ mo to felɛlɛ kashenteŋto Loŋ malɛ nɛ anyee ta a pin fanɛ an ka wɔ Ebɔrɛ to.

english_verse: If we say we are his, we must follow the example of Christ. The New Commandment
translation_verse: Ekama malɛ nɛ e bee kaŋɛ fanɛ e wɔ Ebɔrɛ na to, a daga fanɛ amodoŋwura e baa wora asheŋ fanɛ kananɛ Yesu daa wora na. Mbra popɔr na be asheŋ

english_verse: My dear friends, I am not writing to give you a new commandment. It is the same one you were first given, and it is the message you heard.
translation_verse: N teri shasoana, mannɛ kamalga naseso popɔr nɛ mee sibɛ a sa menyi, kedra nna. Kumo alɛ nɛ men nya sososo kikɛ na. Kamalga naseso dra na e la kubɔya mo nɛ men teŋ nu na.

english_verse: But it really is a new commandment, and you know its true meaning, just as Christ does. You can see the darkness fading away and the true light already shining.
translation_verse: Ama kamalga naseso mo nɛ mee sibɛ a sa menyi ere malɛ du fanɛ kepopɔr nna. Menyi nɛ Kristo be kebaawɔtɔ malɛ to nɛ baa wu kumo be loŋ be kashenteŋ na, ŋkpal manɛ so, tentembiri na bee choŋ nna nɛ kashenteŋ be kefulto na tea fuli to.

english_verse: If we claim to be in the light and hate someone, we are still in the dark.
translation_verse: Esa kama nɛ e bee kaŋɛ fanɛ e wɔ kefulto na to, mo alɛ nsaa kishi mo niopibi, kraa wɔ tentembiri to nna na.

english_verse: If we hate others, we are living and walking in the dark. We don't know where we are going, because we can't see in the dark.
translation_verse: Ama ekama nɛ e bee kishi mo niopibi wɔ tentembiri to nna na, mo alɛ nsaa na tentembiri to. E maŋ nyi kakpa nɛ e bee yɔ, ŋkpal manɛ so, tentembiri na e naa shin nɛ e maa wu.

english_verse: Children, I am writing you, because your sins have been forgiven in the name of Christ.
translation_verse: Ma mbi shasoana, mee sibɛ nna a sa menyi ŋkpal Ebɔrɛ ka ta menyi be alubi m paŋ menyi ŋkpal Yesu so na.

english_verse: Parents, I am writing you, because you have known the one who was there from the beginning. Young people, I am writing you, because you have defeated the evil one.
translation_verse: Mee sibɛ nna a sa menyi betutoana ŋkpal men ka nyi mo ere esa nɛ e wɔ ŋkpa to sososo kikɛ na so. Mee sibɛ nna a sa menyi mbrantiɛbia ŋkpal men ka pɔɔ alubipo na so so.

english_verse: Children, I am writing you, because you have known the Father. Parents, I am writing you, because you have known the one who was there from the beginning. Young people, I am writing you, because you are strong. God's message is firm in your hearts, and you have defeated the evil one.
translation_verse: Mee sibɛ nna a sa menyi mbia ŋkpal men ka nyi etuto na so. Mee sibɛ nna a sa menyi betutoana ŋkpal men ka nyi mo ere esa nɛ e wɔ ŋkpa to sososo kikɛ na so. Mee sibɛ nna a sa menyi mbrantiɛbia ŋkpal men ka kɔ eleŋ nɛ Ebɔrɛ be kamalga na wɔ menyi to nɛ men pɔɔ alubipo na so so. Durnya be kasha be asheŋ

english_verse: Don't love the world or anything that belongs to the world. If you love the world, you cannot love the Father.
translation_verse: Men sa maa sha durnya ere ŋko kusɔ kama nɛ k la durnya ere peya. Esa kama nɛ e bee sha durnya ere maŋ kɔ kasha a sa Etuto Ebɔrɛ na.

english_verse: Our foolish pride comes from this world, and so do our selfish desires and our desire to have everything we see. None of this comes from the Father.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, asɔ nɛ a la durnya ere to be asɔ fanɛ asɔ nɛ dimɛdi be kapɔr lubi ere bee sha nɛ asɔ nɛ basa bee wu nsaa yɛlga nɛ durnya ere to be kamoowusheŋ kikɛ nyam maŋ shi Etuto na kutɔ, a la durnya ere to be asɔ nna.

english_verse: The world and the desires it causes are disappearing. But if we obey God, we will live forever. The Enemy of Christ
translation_verse: Durnya ere malɛ nɛ kumo be ayɛlgasɔ kikɛ nyam bee choŋ nna, ama esa kama nɛ e bee wora Ebɔrɛ na be aparsheŋ bre wɔ ŋkpa to nna mbaanaayɔ. Kristo mo doŋ be asheŋ

english_verse: Children, this is the last hour. You heard that the enemy of Christ would appear at this time, and many of Christ's enemies have already appeared. So we know the last hour is here.
translation_verse: Ma mbi shasoana, lalaloge be saŋɛ na bee fo nna na. Men daŋ nu fanɛ Kristo mo doŋ beeŋ ba, naniere malɛ Kristo mo doŋana damta ba, amoso nɛ an pin fanɛ lalaloge be jemanɛ na fo.

english_verse: These people came from our own group, yet they were not really part of us. If they had been part of us, they would have stayed with us. But they left, which proves they did not belong to our group.
translation_verse: Le be basa ere daŋ shi anyi be katuŋ to nna, ama kashenteŋto, b daa maŋ la anyi to be basa, amoso nɛ b lar anyi to n yɔ na. Nɛ b daa la anyi to be basa nna b daa maaŋ lar. Ama bumo be kelar anyi to na e naa ŋini fanɛ mannɛ bumo be ekama e la anyi to be eko.

english_verse: Christ, the Holy One, has blessed you, and now all of you understand.
translation_verse: Ama menyi ere, Yesu Kristo ta Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na nna n wɔtɔ menyi to nɛ menyi kikɛ e pin kashenteŋ na.

english_verse: I did not need to write you about the truth, since you already know it. You also know that liars do not belong to the truth.
translation_verse: Mannɛ fanɛ men ka maŋ nyi kashenteŋ na so e shin nɛ mee sibɛ asɔ ere a sa menyi, ama menyi ka nyi kumo so nseŋ naa nyi fanɛ efɛ kikɛ maŋ wɔ kashenteŋ na to so nɛ mee sibɛ amo a sa menyi.

english_verse: And a liar is anyone who says Jesus isn't truly Christ. Anyone who says this is an enemy of Christ and rejects both the Father and the Son.
translation_verse: Esa mo malɛ e baa la efɛpo nɛ mannɛ esa nɛ e bee kaŋɛ fanɛ mannɛ Yesu e la Kristo, Ebɔrɛ be esa laraso na. Loŋ be esa e la Kristo mo doŋ na, emo nɛ e bee kini Ebɔrɛ Etuto na nɛ Ebinyɛn na kikɛ na.

english_verse: If we reject the Son, we reject the Father. But if we say we accept the Son, we have the Father.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, ekama nɛ e bee kini Ebinyɛn na maŋ kɔ Etuto na nna na, nɛ ekama malɛ nɛ e bee sɔ Ebinyɛn na kɔ Etuto na gba.

english_verse: Keep thinking about the message you first heard, and you will always be one in your heart with the Son and with the Father.
translation_verse: Ama menyi ere e shin nɛ kusɔ nɛ men nu sososo kikɛ na e shir a wɔ menyi to. Nɛ kusɔ nɛ men nu sososo kikɛ na baa wɔ menyi to bre, kumo ere menyi alɛ gba beeŋ baa wɔ Ebinyɛn na nɛ Etuto na to.

english_verse: I am writing to warn you about those people who are misleading you.
translation_verse: Mee sibɛ asɔ ere nna a sa menyi nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ menyi basa nɛ baa sha kefule menyi na be asheŋ.

english_verse: But Christ has blessed you with the Holy Spirit. Now the Spirit stays in you, and you don't need any teachers. The Spirit is truthful and teaches you everything. So stay one in your heart with Christ, just as the Spirit has taught you to do. Children of God
translation_verse: Ama menyi ere, Yesu Kristo ta Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na nna n wɔtɔ menyi to nɛ e shir a wɔ menyi to. A maŋ daga fanɛ men naŋ nya esa ko nɛ e ŋini menyi, ŋkpal manɛ so, mbe Kiyoyu na e naa ŋini menyi asɔ kikɛ. Kusɔ kama malɛ nɛ e bee ŋini la kashenteŋ nna, mannɛ efɛ. Amoso, men baa bɛ Kiyoyu na be keŋini so nseŋ shir a wɔ Kristo na to. Ebɔrɛ be mbia be asheŋ

english_verse: Children, stay one in your hearts with Christ. Then when he returns, we will have confidence and won't have to hide in shame.
translation_verse: To, naniere ma mbi shasoana, men baa kraa wɔ mo to, saŋɛ na so, e kaŋ ba, anyi maaŋ baa shika to kikɛ, anyi alɛ maaŋ naŋ ji anishinyɔr mbe anishito ŋkpal menyi so.

english_verse: Think how much the Father loves us. He loves us so much that he lets us be called his children, as we truly are. But since the people of this world did not know who Christ is, they don't know who we are.
translation_verse: Men keni kananɛ Etuto na sha anyi loŋ n shin nɛ baa tre anyi mbe mbia, kumo alɛ maŋ kɔ emɔrɔ malɛ fanɛ an ka la mbe mbia. Amoso nɛ durnyaebi maa pin anyi to na. Ebɔrɛ nɛ b maŋ pin to pɔɛŋ.

english_verse: My dear friends, we are already God's children, though what we will be hasn't yet been seen. But we do know when Christ returns, we will be like him, because we will see him as he truly is.
translation_verse: N teri shasoana, naniere an la Ebɔrɛ be mbia nna na, ama kananɛ anyeeŋ ba kaa du kachako so bre e maŋ naŋ lar efuli. Kusɔ nɛ an baa nyi kikɛ e la fanɛ Kristo kaŋ ba lar efuli, anyeeŋ baa du fanɛ mo gbagba nna, ŋkpal manɛ so, anyeeŋ wu mo kananɛ e baa du.

english_verse: Everyone who sins breaks God's law, because sin is the same as breaking God's law.
translation_verse: Esa kama nɛ e bee wora alubi bee wora nna a da Ebɔrɛ malɛ gba so na, ŋkpal manɛ so, kewora kulubi la ketɔr Ebɔrɛ be ntaŋ nna.

english_verse: You know Christ came to take away our sins. He isn't sinful,
translation_verse: Men nyi Kristo ka ba nɛ e ba ta basa be alubi n lɛ n sa bumo. Kulubi kikɛ malɛ maŋ wɔ mo to.

english_verse: and people who stay one in their hearts with him won't keep on sinning. If they do keep on sinning, they don't know Christ, and they have never seen him.
translation_verse: Amoso, esa kama malɛ nɛ e shir a wɔ mo to maa wora alubi. Esa kama nɛ e baa wɔtɔ a wora alubi bre maŋ naŋ wu mo ŋko m pin mo Yesu na nna na.

english_verse: Anyone who keeps on sinning belongs to the devil. He has sinned from the beginning, but the Son of God came to destroy all that he has done.
translation_verse: Esa kama malɛ nɛ e bee wora asheŋ lubi la alubipo na peya nna, ŋkpal manɛ so, durnya be sososo na kikɛ nɛ alubipo na wɔtɔ a wora alubi m ba fo mbre. To, loŋ malɛ so nɛ Ebɔrɛ Pibinyɛn na lar m ba nɛ e ba jija alubipo na be ashuŋ.

english_verse: God's children cannot keep on being sinful. His life-giving power lives in them and makes them his children, so they cannot keep on sinning.
translation_verse: Esa kama nɛ e la Ebɔrɛ pibi maa wora alubi. Ŋkpal Ebɔrɛ be kapɔr gbagba ka wɔ mo to so nɛ ŋkpal Ebɔrɛ ka la mo Tuto na so so, e maaŋ tiŋ n shir a wɔ alubi to a wora amo.

english_verse: You can tell God's children from the devil's children, because those who belong to the devil refuse to do right or to love each other. Love Each Other
translation_verse: To, loŋ malɛ nɛ anyee ta a pin Ebɔrɛ be mbia nɛ bumo nɛ bumo alɛ la alubipo na be mbia. Esa kama nɛ e bee wora asɔ nɛ a maa niŋi, maŋ la Ebɔrɛ pibi. Ekama malɛ gba nɛ e maa sha mo niopibi, maŋ la Ebɔrɛ pibi. Kebaasha abar be asheŋ

english_verse: From the beginning you were told we must love each other.
translation_verse: Kubɔya ere nɛ men daŋ nu sososo kikɛ na fanɛ a daga fanɛ an baa sha abar.

english_verse: Don't be like Cain, who belonged to the devil and murdered his own brother. Why did he murder him? He did it because his brother was good, and he was evil.
translation_verse: A maŋ daga fanɛ an baa du fanɛ Keen nɛ e daa la alubipo na peya nseŋ bri mo sipo m mɔ na. Nɛ manɛ e daŋ ba nɛ e daŋ bri mo m mɔ? Kusɔ nɛ k daŋ ba e la fanɛ mbe asheŋ woraso daa maa niŋi nna nɛ mo sipo bre peya daa niŋi.

english_verse: My friends, don't be surprised if the people of this world hate you.
translation_verse: Amoso, n niopibiana, nɛ durnya ere to ebi kishi menyi, men sa maŋ shin nɛ k baa chinchiŋ menyi.

english_verse: Our love for each other proves we have gone from death to life. But if you don't love each other, you are still under the power of death.
translation_verse: Esa kama nɛ e maa sha mo braana kraa wɔ luwu to nna na. Ama anyi ere nyi fanɛ an lar luwu to m ba luri ŋkpa to nna, ŋkpal manɛ so, anyee sha an niopibiana.

english_verse: If you hate each other, you are murderers, and we know murderers do not have eternal life.
translation_verse: Esa kama nɛ e kishi mo niopibi la emɔpo nna, menyi alɛ nyi fanɛ emɔpo kikɛ maŋ kɔ ŋkpa nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na mo to.

english_verse: We know what love is because Jesus gave his life for us. This is why we must give our lives for each other.
translation_verse: Le nɛ an bɔla m pin kusɔ nɛ k la kasha. Yesu Kristo e shin nɛ b lara mbe ŋkpa ashi mo to n sa anyi. Amoso, a daga fanɛ anyi alɛ gba ka ta anyi be ŋkpaana n sa an niopibiana.

english_verse: If we have all we need and see one of our own people in need, we must have pity on that person, or else we cannot say we love God.
translation_verse: Ama esa kama nɛ e kɔ durnya ere to be asɔ nseŋ wu fanɛ mo niopibi daga kechɛto, mo alɛ nseŋ ti mbe kagbene a maŋ chɛ mo to, nuso nɛ Ebɔrɛ be kasha bee wora a chena esa na wura to? Kristo mo doŋana be asheŋ

english_verse: Children, you show love for others by truly helping them, and not merely by talking about it.
translation_verse: Ma mbi shasoana, men sa maŋ shin nɛ an baa kɔ mmalga ŋko nnɔ nawule a sha basa, men shin nɛ an baa kɔ aworbi nɛ kashenteŋ a sha basa.

english_verse: When we love others, we know we belong to the truth, and we feel at ease in the presence of God.
translation_verse: Loŋ nɛ anyeeŋ pin an ka wɔ kashenteŋ na to nɛ saŋkama malɛ nɛ an be ŋgbene bee ji a bri anyi, anyeeŋ wushi amo ashi Ebɔrɛ be anishito.

english_verse: But even if we don't feel at ease, God is greater than our feelings, and he knows everything.
translation_verse: Anyi alɛ beeŋ tiŋ n wora ade kikɛ nna, ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ e chɔ anyi be ŋgbene, mo alɛ nseŋ naa nyi kusɔ kama.

english_verse: Dear friends, if we feel at ease in the presence of God, we will have the courage to come near him.
translation_verse: Beshapo, nɛ an be ŋgbene baa maa ji a bri anyi, kumo ere anyi maa shika to Ebɔrɛ be anishito.

english_verse: He will give us whatever we ask, because we obey him and do what pleases him.
translation_verse: Anyi alɛ naa tiŋ a nya kusɔ kama nɛ anyee kule mo ŋkpal an ka bee bɛ mbe mmalga naseso so so nsaa wora asɔ nɛ a bee par mo na so.

english_verse: God wants us to have faith in his Son Jesus Christ and to love each other. This is also what Jesus taught us to do.
translation_verse: Mbe kamalga naseso na malɛ nde fanɛ, a daga fanɛ an ka yirda mo Pibinyɛn Yesu Kristo be ketre na nsaa sha abar fanɛ kananɛ e yili anyi fanɛ an baa wora na.

english_verse: If we obey God's commandments, we will stay one in our hearts with him, and he will stay one with us. The Spirit he has given us is proof that we are one with him.
translation_verse: Bekama malɛ nɛ baa bɛ mbe mmalga nasesoana na so shir a wɔ mo to nna nɛ mo alɛ gba wɔ bumo to. To, kananɛ anyee wora a pin fanɛ e wɔ anyi to nde: Mbe Kiyoyu nɛ e ta n sa anyi na so so nɛ an pin loŋ.

english_verse: Dear friends, don't believe everyone who claims to have the Spirit of God. Test them all to find out if they really do come from God. Many false prophets have already gone out into the world,
translation_verse: N teri shasoana, men sa maa yirda basa kama nɛ baa kaŋɛ fanɛ Ebɔrɛ be Kiyoyu wɔ bumo to. Men baa wora bumo a keni ŋko ayoyu mo nɛ b kɔ na shi Ebɔrɛ kutɔ nna ŋko a maŋ shi mo kutɔ, ŋkpal manɛ so, anebi fɛpo damtaana lar n luri durnya to.

english_verse: But when someone doesn't say this about Jesus, you know this person has a spirit that doesn't come from God and is the enemy of Christ. You knew this enemy was coming into the world and now is already here.
translation_verse: Ama kiyoyu kama nɛ e maa ji Yesu be asheŋ be shɛda, loŋ be kiyoyu maŋ shi Ebɔrɛ kutɔ. Loŋ be kiyoyu na e la edoŋ na be kiyoyu mo nɛ men nu fanɛ e bee ba na. Mo e teŋ ba durnya ere to na.

english_verse: Children, you belong to God, and you have defeated these enemies. God's Spirit is in you and is more powerful than the one who is in the world.
translation_verse: Ama menyi ere, ma mbi shasoana, men la Ebɔrɛ be basa nna m pɔɔ loŋ be anebi fɛpoana so, ŋkpal manɛ so, esa nɛ e wɔ menyi to na e chɔ emo nɛ e wɔ durnya ere to na.

english_verse: These enemies belong to this world, and the world listens to them, because they speak its language.
translation_verse: Durnya ere to be basa e la bumo, amoso, durnya ere to be mmalga nɛ baa malga nɛ durnya ere to ebi malɛ bee nu bumo be mmalga na.

english_verse: We belong to God, and everyone who knows God will listen to us. But the people who don't know God won't listen to us. This is how we can tell the Spirit that speaks the truth from the one that tells lies.
translation_verse: Anyi ere la Ebɔrɛ be basa nna, ekama malɛ nɛ e nyi Ebɔrɛ bee nu anyi be mmalga nna. Ama ekama malɛ nɛ e maŋ la Ebɔrɛ peya maa nu kusɔ nɛ anyee kaŋɛ. Loŋ malɛ nɛ anyee ta a pin kashenteŋ be Kiyoyu na nɛ efɛ be kiyoyu na to. Ebɔrɛ be kasha nɛ anyi be kasha be asheŋ

english_verse: My dear friends, we must love each other. Love comes from God, and when we love each other, it shows we have been given new life. We are now God's children, and we know him.
translation_verse: N teri shasoana, men shin nɛ an baa sha abar, ŋkpal manɛ so, kasha shi Ebɔrɛ kutɔ nna. Esa kama nɛ e kɔ kasha la Ebɔrɛ pibi nna na, mo alɛ nsaa nyi Ebɔrɛ.

english_verse: God is love, and anyone who doesn't love others has never known him.
translation_verse: Ama ekama nɛ e maŋ kɔ kasha maŋ nyi Ebɔrɛ, ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ e la kashawura.

english_verse: God showed his love for us when he sent his only Son into the world to give us life.
translation_verse: Kananɛ Ebɔrɛ ŋini anyi mbe kasha nde: E shuŋi mo Pibinyɛn koŋwule nna durnya ere to fanɛ an bɔla mo so n nya ŋkpa.

english_verse: Real love isn't our love for God, but his love for us. God sent his Son to be the sacrifice by which our sins are forgiven.
translation_verse: Kede nɛ baa tre kasha gbagba na, mannɛ anyi gbagba be kasha nɛ an ta n sha Ebɔrɛ, mo e sha anyi nseŋ shuŋi mo Pibinyɛn fanɛ e ba wu m mata be luwu nɛ k shin nɛ an nya alubi be ketampaŋ.

english_verse: Dear friends, since God loved us this much, we must love each other.
translation_verse: N teri shasoana, ŋkpal kananɛ Ebɔrɛ sha anyi ere so, a daga fanɛ anyi alɛ gba e baa sha abar.

english_verse: No one has ever seen God. But if we love each other, God lives in us, and his love is truly in our hearts.
translation_verse: Esa kama maŋ naŋ wu Ebɔrɛ kenishiso, ama nɛ an baa sha abar bre, kumo ere Ebɔrɛ wɔ anyi to nɛ mbe kasha malɛ bɔlɔ anyi to felɛlɛ kashenteŋto.

english_verse: God has given us his Spirit. This is how we know we are one with him, just as he is one with us.
translation_verse: Kananɛ anyee wora a pin fanɛ an wɔ mo to nɛ mo alɛ gba wɔ anyi to nde: E ta mo gbagba be Kiyoyu nna n sa anyi.

english_verse: God sent his Son to be the Savior of the world. We saw his Son and are now telling others about him.
translation_verse: Anyi alɛ wu nseŋ ji kumo be shɛda fanɛ Etuto na shuŋi mo Pibinyɛn fanɛ e ba kaa la durnya ere to be Emɔlgapo.

english_verse: God stays one with everyone who openly says Jesus is the Son of God. This is how we stay one with God
translation_verse: Ekama nɛ e bee bugi to a kaŋɛ basa fanɛ Yesu e la Ebɔrɛ Pibinyɛn na, Ebɔrɛ e wɔ amodoŋwura to nɛ mo alɛ gba wɔ Ebɔrɛ to.

english_verse: and are sure God loves us. God is love. If we keep on loving others, we will stay one in our hearts with God, and he will stay one with us.
translation_verse: Anyi alɛ gba ba pin nseŋ yirda kasha mo nɛ Ebɔrɛ kɔ a sa anyi na. Ebɔrɛ e la kashawura. Ekama malɛ nɛ e wɔ kasha be kebaawɔtɔ to, wɔ Ebɔrɛ to nna na nɛ Ebɔrɛ malɛ gba wɔ amodoŋwura to.

english_verse: If we truly love others and live as Christ did in this world, we won't be worried about the day of judgment.
translation_verse: Kasha malɛ bɔlɔ anyi to nna felɛlɛ, saŋɛ na so demujiachɛ na anyi maaŋ shika to, ŋkpal manɛ so, anyi be kebaawɔtɔ durnya ere to nɛ kananɛ Kristo du na la kukoŋwule nna.

english_verse: A real love for others will chase those worries away. The thought of being punished is what makes us afraid. It shows we have not really learned to love.
translation_verse: Kakpa nɛ kasha wɔ, kufu maŋ wɔtɔ. Kashenteŋ be kasha bee ju kufu nna, ŋkpal manɛ so, nɛ an kraŋ baa ŋana fanɛ Ebɔrɛ beeŋ gberge anyi kusoe, kumo ere anyi maa sha mo nɛnɛ nna na. Amoso, esa nɛ e bee lɔ kufu, kasha maŋ naŋ bɔlɔ mo to felɛlɛ nna na.

english_verse: We love because God loved us first.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ e daŋ kesha anyi so shin nɛ anyi alɛ kɔ kasha na.

english_verse: But if we say we love God and don't love each other, we are liars. We cannot see God. So how can we love God, if we don't love the people we can see?
translation_verse: Esa kama nɛ e bee kaŋɛ le: “Mee sha Ebɔrɛ,” mo alɛ nsaa kishi mo niopibi la efɛpo nna, ŋkpal manɛ so, esa nɛ e bee wu mo niopibi ŋkaa maaŋ tiŋ n sha mo, maaŋ tiŋ n sha Ebɔrɛ mo nɛ e maŋ naŋ wu kikɛ na.

english_verse: The commandment that God has given us is: “Love God and love each other!”
translation_verse: To, le be kamalga naseso ere nɛ e ta m bɔɔ anyi enɔ fanɛ, esa kama nɛ e bee sha Ebɔrɛ e baa sha mo niopibi gba.

english_verse: If we believe Jesus is truly Christ, we are God's children. Everyone who loves the Father will also love his children.
translation_verse: Esa kama nɛ e yirda fanɛ Yesu e la Kristo na la Ebɔrɛ pibi nna nɛ ekama malɛ nɛ e bee sha esa nɛ e kurge ebi na beeŋ baa sha ebi na gba.

english_verse: If we love and obey God, we know we will love his children.
translation_verse: Nɛ an baa sha Ebɔrɛ nsaa bɛ mbe mmalga naseso so bre, loŋ nɛ anyeeŋ pin an ka bee sha Ebɔrɛ be mbia gba.

english_verse: We show our love for God by obeying his commandments, and they are not hard to follow.
translation_verse: Kesha Ebɔrɛ malɛ e la kebɛ mbe mmalga nasesoana so, amo alɛ maŋ du kpakpa.

english_verse: Every child of God can defeat the world, and our faith is what gives us this victory.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, esa kama nɛ e la Ebɔrɛ pibi bee pɔɔ durnya ere so nna. Eleŋ mo nɛ k bee pɔɔ durnya so e la anyi be yirda.

english_verse: No one can defeat the world without having faith in Jesus as the Son of God. Who Jesus Is
translation_verse: Wanɛ e naaŋ tiŋ m pɔɔ durnya ere so nɛ mannɛ esa nɛ e yirda fanɛ Yesu e la Ebɔrɛ Pibinyɛn na? Bumo nɛ b ji shɛda ŋ kaŋɛ Yesu be asheŋ

english_verse: Water and blood came out from the side of Jesus Christ. It wasn't just water, but water and blood. The Spirit tells about this, because the Spirit is truthful.
translation_verse: Yesu ere e la emo nɛ e daŋ yili kabɔrɛbɛr be nchu nɛ mbe luwu be ŋklaŋ so m ba na. Mannɛ nchu na malɛ nawule so nɛ e daŋ yili so m ba, nchu na nɛ ŋklaŋ na kikɛ so nɛ e daŋ yili so m ba.

english_verse: In fact, there are three who tell about it.
translation_verse: Kiyoyu na malɛ e la shɛdajipo na, ŋkpal manɛ so, Kiyoyu na e la kashenteŋ na.

english_verse: They are the Spirit, the water, and the blood, and they all agree.
translation_verse: Eshɛdajipo asa e wɔtɔ. Kiyoyu na wɔtɔ nɛ nchu na wɔtɔ nɛ ŋklaŋ na gba wɔtɔ. Kɔnɔkoŋwule nɛ amo alɛ kikɛ kɔ.

english_verse: We believe what people tell us. But we can trust what God says even more, and God is the one who has spoken about his Son.
translation_verse: Anyi maa kplaŋ dimɛdi be shɛda so, ama an nyi fanɛ Ebɔrɛ be shɛda e chɔ dimɛdi peya, ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ be shɛda na nɛ e ta a ji mo Pibinyɛn be asheŋ.

english_verse: If we have faith in God's Son, we have believed what God has said. But if we don't believe what God has said about his Son, it is the same as calling God a liar.
translation_verse: Esa kama malɛ nɛ e yirda Ebɔrɛ Pibinyɛn na kɔ loŋ be shɛda na mbe kagbene to. Ama ekama nɛ e maŋ yirda Ebɔrɛ ta mo Ebɔrɛ na ŋ ki efɛpo nna na ŋkpal amodoŋwura na ka maŋ yirda shɛda mo nɛ e bee ji mo Pibinyɛn na be asheŋ na so.

english_verse: God has also said he gave us eternal life and this life comes to us from his Son.
translation_verse: Shɛda na malɛ nde fanɛ, Ebɔrɛ sa anyi ŋkpa nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar nɛ loŋ be ŋkpa na wɔ mo Pibinyɛn na to.

english_verse: And so, if we have God's Son, we have this life. But if we don't have the Son, we don't have this life. Knowing about Eternal Life
translation_verse: Esa kama nɛ e kɔ Ebinyɛn na kɔ ŋkpa na, ama ekama nɛ e maŋ kɔ Ebɔrɛ Pibinyɛn na maŋ kɔ ŋkpa na. Ŋkpa nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na be asheŋ

english_verse: All of you have faith in the Son of God, and I have written to let you know you have eternal life.
translation_verse: Menyi bumo nɛ men yirda Ebɔrɛ Pibinyɛn be ketre na nɛ mee sibɛ asɔ ere a sa na nɛ men baa nyi fanɛ men kɔ ŋkpa nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na.

english_verse: And if we know God listens when we pray, we are sure our prayers have already been answered.
translation_verse: To, nɛ an baa nyi fanɛ kusɔ kama nɛ anyee kule mo e bee nu an be kekule, kumo ere an nyi fanɛ kusɔ kama nɛ anyee kule mo anyeeŋ nya kumo.

english_verse: Suppose you see one of our people commit a sin that isn't a deadly sin. You can pray, and this person will be given eternal life. But the sin must not be one that is deadly.
translation_verse: Esa kama nɛ e wu mo niopibi ka bee wora kulubi nɛ k maŋ la luwu be kulubi, amodoŋwura e kule Ebɔrɛ nɛ e sa mo ŋkpa. Basa nɛ bumo be alubi maa yɛr bumo luwu to na nɛ n de na. Kulubi ko wɔtɔ a yɛr esa luwu to, mannɛ loŋ be kulubi na be kabɔrɛkule nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ amodoŋwura na e kule.

english_verse: Everything that is wrong is sin, but not all sins are deadly.
translation_verse: Kewora n jija kikɛ la kulubi nna, ama kulubi ko wɔtɔ ŋkaa maa yɛr esa luwu to.

english_verse: We are sure God's children do not keep on sinning. God's own Son protects them, and the devil cannot harm them.
translation_verse: An baa nyi fanɛ Ebɔrɛ pibi kama maa shir a wɔ alubi to a wora amo, ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ Pibinyɛn e naa kuŋ mo nɛ alubipo na e sa maŋ tiŋ n doro mo.

english_verse: We are certain we come from God and the rest of the world is under the power of the devil.
translation_verse: Anyi alɛ naa nyi fanɛ an ka la Ebɔrɛ peya, ama durnya ere bre kikɛ wɔ alubipo na be enɔ to nna.

english_verse: We know that Jesus Christ the Son of God has come and has shown us the true God. And because of Jesus, we now belong to the true God who gives eternal life.
translation_verse: Anyi alɛ nseŋ naa nyi Ebɔrɛ Pibinyɛn na ka ba m ba sa anyi nfɛra nɛ an pin kashenteŋ be Ebɔrɛ na, anyi alɛ wɔ mo kashenteŋ be Ebɔrɛ na to nna, hale mo Pibinyɛn Yesu Kristo na to. Mo e la kashenteŋ be Ebɔrɛ na, nɛ ŋkpa nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na.

english_verse: Children, you must stay away from idols.
translation_verse: Ma mbi shasoana, men baa gelge agbir.

english_verse: We love you because the truth is now in our hearts, and it will be there forever.
translation_verse: ŋkpal kashenteŋ be keŋini na ka wɔ anyi to, kumo alɛ ŋkaa beeŋ shir a wɔ anyi to mbaanaayɔ na so.

english_verse: I pray that God the Father and Jesus Christ his Son will be kind and merciful to us! May they give us peace and truth and love. Truth and Love
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ Etuto na nɛ Yesu Kristo nɛ e la Etuto na Pibinyɛn na sa anyi kuwɔr be kakɛ nɛ kuwɔr nɛ kagbenewushi n shin nɛ an nya kashenteŋ be kasha. Kashenteŋ nɛ kasha be asheŋ

english_verse: I was very glad to learn that some of your children are obeying the truth, as the Father told us to do.
translation_verse: Kowurche, ŋ ka pin fanɛ fo mbia ko wɔ kashenteŋ be kebaawɔtɔ na to fanɛ kananɛ Ebɔrɛ Etuto na nase na, ma kagbene fuli ma paa.

english_verse: Dear friend, I am not writing to tell you and your children to do something you have not done before. I am writing to tell you to love each other, which is the first thing you were told to do.
translation_verse: Naniere malɛ mee kule fo nna fanɛ fo shin nɛ an kikɛ e baa sha abar be asheŋ, kumo alɛ maŋ la kamalga naseso popɔr ko nna nɛ mee sibɛ a sa fo, kumo nɛ an nya sososo na kikɛ na nna.

english_verse: Many liars have gone out into the world. These deceitful liars are saying Jesus Christ did not have a truly human body. But they are liars and the enemies of Christ.
translation_verse: Befɛpo damta mo nɛ b maa yirda fanɛ Yesu Kristo ba durnya ere to nna fanɛ dimɛdi, lar n luri durnya to. Loŋ be basa na be ekama e la efɛpo nɛ Kristo mo doŋ na.

english_verse: So be sure not to lose what we have worked for. If you do, you won't be given your full reward.
translation_verse: Amoso, men baa de so n sa maŋ paŋ kusɔ nɛ men kpal kumo so n shuŋ na, ama men wora ania n nya men be tɔnɔ kikɛ nyam.

english_verse: Don't keep changing what you were taught about Christ, or else God will no longer be with you. But if you hold firmly to what you were taught, both the Father and the Son will be with you.
translation_verse: Esa kama nɛ e maa shir a wɔ Kristo be keŋini na to nsaa ta asheŋ a ti amo so, maŋ kɔ Ebɔrɛ mo to. Ama ekama nɛ e shir a wɔ Kristo be keŋini na to, kɔ Etuto na nɛ Ebinyɛn na kikɛ mo to.

english_verse: If people won't agree to this teaching, don't welcome them into your home or even greet them.
translation_verse: Esa kama nɛ e ba men kutɔ nsaa maŋ bar le be keŋini ere, men sa maŋ chɔrɔ mo ŋko n sɔ mo n wɔtɔ men peana,

english_verse: Greeting them is the same as taking part in their evil deeds. Final Greetings
translation_verse: ŋkpal manɛ so, ekama nɛ e chɔrɔ mo bee chɛ mo to a wora mbe ashuŋ lubi na nna na. Lalaloge be kechɔrɔ be mmalga be asheŋ

english_verse: I have much more to tell you, but I don't want to write it with pen and ink. I want to come and talk to you in person, because this will make us really happy.
translation_verse: Ŋ kraa kɔ asɔ damta nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ menyi, ama m maa sha kesibɛ amo kawɔl to. Kusɔ nɛ mee tama e la fanɛ meeŋ ba bɔɔ menyi so nɛ ma nɛ menyi e chena m malga, saŋɛ na so an kikɛ be ŋgbene beeŋ fuli anyi parr.

english_verse: Greetings from the children of your very special sister.
translation_verse: Fo sipo cheso nɛ Ebɔrɛ lara na gba be mbia bee chɔrɔ fo.

english_verse: From the church leader. To my dear friend Gaius. I love you because we follow the truth,
translation_verse: Kawɔl ere shi ma nɛ baa tre Enimu na kutɔ nna a yɔ n teri kpakpaso Gayes nɛ mee sha kashenteŋto ga na kutɔ.

english_verse: dear friend, and I pray all goes well for you. I hope you are as strong in body, as I know you are in spirit.
translation_verse: N teri shaso, ma kabɔrɛkule nɛ ŋ kɔ a kule a sa fo e la fanɛ Ebɔrɛ e shin nɛ kusɔ kama e baŋ nyalɛ n sa fo nɛ fo baa kɔ eyur be alenfia fanɛ kananɛ fo kɔ eleŋ fo kiyoyu to na.

english_verse: It makes me very happy when the Lord's followers come by and speak openly of how you obey the truth.
translation_verse: Bekurgepo ko ka ba kaŋɛ ma kananɛ fo kɔ kagbene koŋwule a bɛ kashenteŋ be keŋini na so nɛ kananɛ fo baa wɔ kashenteŋ na be kebaawɔtɔ to, ma kagbene fuli ma ga.

english_verse: Nothing brings me greater happiness than to hear that my children are obeying the truth. Working Together
translation_verse: Shɛŋ shɛŋ maa fuli ma kagbene a chɔ kebaanu fanɛ ma mbia wɔ kashenteŋ na be kebaawɔtɔ na to. Gayes ka nya kechɔrɔ be asheŋ

english_verse: Dear friend, you have always been faithful in helping other followers of the Lord, even the ones you didn't know before.
translation_verse: N teri shaso, kananɛ fo ta kagbene koŋwule a wora ashuŋ a sa bekurgepoana na ŋkeshin nɛ b la befɔ gba nna na, esa beeŋ tiŋ n fute n yige fo so.

english_verse: They have told the church about your love. They say you were good enough to welcome them and to send them on their mission in a way God's servants deserve.
translation_verse: B ba ji fo kasha be asheŋ asɔri ere to nfe. Jande chɛ bumo to nɛ b naŋ nya bumo be enite na to be ekpa a yɔ fanɛ kananɛ asheŋ daga Ebɔrɛ be anishito.

english_verse: When they left to tell others about the Lord, they decided not to accept help from anyone who wasn't a follower.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, Kristo be ketre na so nɛ b lar a wɔ bumo be enite na to a maa sɔ shɛŋ ashi bumo nɛ b maŋ yirda Yesu na kutɔ.

english_verse: We must support people like them, so we can take part in what they are doing to spread the truth.
translation_verse: Amoso, loŋ be basa e daga fanɛ anyi alɛ e baa chɛ bumo to, saŋɛ na so anyi nɛ bumo beeŋ baa chɛ abar to kashenteŋ be keŋini be kushuŋ na to. Dayɔtrefis nɛ Demitrias be asheŋ

english_verse: I wrote to the church. But Diotrephes likes to be the number-one leader, and he won't pay any attention to us.
translation_verse: N sibɛ kusɔ ko n shoŋi asɔriebi na, ama Dayɔtrefis nɛ e baa sha kejuŋkpar ga ashi bumo to na maa sha kenu n sa anyi.

english_verse: So if I come, I will remind him of how he has been attacking us with gossip. Not only has he been doing this, but he refuses to welcome any of the Lord's followers who come by. And when other church members want to welcome them, he puts them out of the church.
translation_verse: Amoso, ŋ kaŋ ba, meeŋ lara asheŋ nɛ e bee wora na kikɛ efuli. Meeŋ malga mbe mmalga lubi nɛ e kɔ a na a ji ma asheŋ na kikɛ. Ade malɛ be buushi, mo gbagba kini kesɔ bekurgepoana na, mo alɛ nsaa maa sa bumo nɛ baa sha kechɛ bumo to na ekpa nseŋ naa wɔtɔ a ju loŋ be basa na ashi asɔri to.

english_verse: Dear friend, don't imitate the evil deeds of others, but follow the example of people who do kind deeds. They are God's children, but those who are always doing evil have never seen God.
translation_verse: N teri shaso, sa maa kute asheŋ lubi to, baa kute asheŋ lela to. Esa kama nɛ e bee wora alela la Ebɔrɛ peya nna, ama ekama nɛ e bee wora alubi maŋ naŋ wu Ebɔrɛ.

english_verse: Everyone speaks well of Demetrius, and so does the true message that he teaches. I also speak well of him, and you know what I say is true. Final Greetings
translation_verse: Demitrias bre, ekama bee malga mbe kebaawɔtɔ lela be asheŋ nɛ loŋ be kebaawɔtɔ na malɛ nɛ kashenteŋ be keŋini na maa lar abar kaman. Anyi alɛ gba bee ji mbe kebaawɔtɔ lela be shɛda nɛ fo alɛ nyi anyi be shɛda ka la kashenteŋ. Lalaloge be kechɔrɔ be asheŋ

english_verse: I have much more to say to you, but I don't want to write it with pen and ink.
translation_verse: Ŋ kraa kɔ asɔ damta nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ menyi, ama m maa sha kesibɛ amo kawɔl to.

english_verse: I hope to see you soon, and then we can talk in person.
translation_verse: Ŋ kɔ tama fanɛ k maaŋ chɛr nɛ n wu fo, saŋɛ na so anyeeŋ chena m malga abar kutɔ.

english_verse: I pray that God will bless you with peace! Your friends send their greetings. Please give a personal greeting to each of our friends.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ e sa menyi kagbenewushi. Fo teriana na kikɛ bee chɔrɔ fo. Chɔrɔ an teriana na kikɛ kukoko to n sa ma.

english_verse: From Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ and the brother of James. To all who are chosen and loved by God the Father and are kept safe by Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Kawɔl ere shi ma Juud, Jeems mo sipo nɛ n la Yesu Kristo be kenya na kutɔ nna a yɔ bumo nɛ Ebɔrɛ Etuto na bee sha nseŋ tre bumo m ba kaa keni bumo so ŋkpal Yesu Kristo so na kutɔ.

english_verse: I pray that God will greatly bless you with mercy, peace, and love! False Teachers
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛ e wu menyi kuwɔr nseŋ sa menyi kagbenewushi nɛ kasha nɛ a baa wɔ menyi to a ti so saŋkikɛ. Beŋinipo fɛpoana be asheŋ

english_verse: My dear friends, I really wanted to write you about God's saving power at work in our lives. But instead, I must write and ask you to defend the faith that God has once for all given to his people.
translation_verse: Ma beshapo, k daa wɔ ma kagbene to nna ga fanɛ n sibɛ ŋ kaŋɛ menyi kumɔlga mo nɛ an kikɛ kɔ na be asheŋ, ama n naŋ wu fanɛ a daga fanɛ n sibɛ menyi ŋ kule menyi ga fanɛ men baa wora ania a kɔ a sa abɔrɛsheŋ mo nɛ an yirda nɛ Ebɔrɛ ta kela koŋwule pati m bɔɔ mbe basa laraso enɔ na.

english_verse: Some godless people have sneaked in among us and are saying, “God treats us much better than we deserve, and so it is all right to be immoral.” They even deny we must obey Jesus Christ as our only Master and Lord. But long ago the Scriptures warned that these godless people were doomed.
translation_verse: Mee kaŋɛ le nna, ŋkpal manɛ so, basa ko mo nɛ b maa nu a sa Ebɔrɛ ŋana n nyia n luri menyi to a sha kechɛrga Ebɔrɛ be kuwɔr be kakɛ nɛ e kɔ a sa anyi na be kifito, saŋɛ na so baaŋ nya ekpa a wora kulubi kama nɛ baa sha. Baa kini Yesu Kristo gbagba mo nɛ mo nawule la an Nyɛnpe mo nɛ e bee ji anyi so kuwura na. Dra na malɛ kikɛ nɛ b sibɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na to a kaŋɛ fanɛ Ebɔrɛ beeŋ gberge loŋ be basa na kikɛ kusoe.

english_verse: You also know about the angels who didn't do their work and left their proper places. God chained them with everlasting chains and is now keeping them in dark pits until the great day of judgment.
translation_verse: Men baa nyiŋi emalaika mo nɛ b daa maŋ shuli a wɔ kakpa nɛ Ebɔrɛ daa sha fanɛ b baa wɔ na be asheŋ. B daŋ shile ndoŋ nna ŋkpal k ka daa maŋ bɔlɔ bumo kenishi so. Naniere b ta ŋgbɛlɛbi mo nɛ esa maaŋ tiŋ n tuge kikɛ nna ŋ kre bumo n wɔtɔ tentembiri be kakpa a jo kachɛgboŋ mo nɛ Ebɔrɛ beeŋ ji bumo demu na.

english_verse: We should also be warned by what happened to the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah and the nearby towns. Their people became immoral and committed all sorts of sexual sins. Then God made an example of them and punished them with eternal fire.
translation_verse: Men baa nyiŋi nde mo nɛ baa tre Sodɔm nɛ Gomɔra nɛ nde mo nɛ a daŋ taga amo to na gba be asheŋ. Ndoŋebi gba daa wora kesakalea be asheŋ nɛ alubi kama nɛ a maŋ daga dimɛdi ka wora nna. B wɔ edɛ mo nɛ a maa duŋ kikɛ na to nɛ k bee ŋini anyi kananɛ Ebɔrɛ beeŋ gberge bekama nɛ baa wora asheŋ fanɛ loŋ be basa na kusoe.

english_verse: The people I am talking about are behaving just like those dreamers who destroyed their own bodies. They reject all authority and insult angels.
translation_verse: Loŋ koŋwule na malɛ nɛ bumo nɛ b luri menyi to na du. B wɔtɔ nna a ku edare nsaa wora alubi a gbiti bumo gbagba be eyurana, baa kini Ebɔrɛ be eleŋ nsaa tege emalaika mo nɛ b kɔ kemaŋkura ashi ebɔrɛso na.

english_verse: Even Michael, the chief angel, didn't dare to insult the devil, when the two of them were arguing about the body of Moses. All Michael said was, “The Lord will punish you!”
translation_verse: Hale Maikel mo nɛ e la emalaika kikɛ be ejuŋkparpo na daa maŋ shoduu Setani saŋɛ nɛ mo nɛ mo daa ji emɔrɔ ŋkpal anebi Mosis be eyur so na. E daa maŋ maŋ mbe kumu so n tege Setani, kusɔ nɛ e daŋ kaŋɛ e la: “Ebɔrɛ e fiɛ fo so!”

english_verse: Now they are in for real trouble. They have followed Cain's example and have made the same mistake that Balaam did by caring only for money. They have also rebelled against God, just as Korah did. Because of all this, they will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Cha, asheŋ maaŋ nyalɛ n sa bumo kikɛ, ŋkpal manɛ so, ekpa nɛ Keen daŋ ta na nɛ b bɛ so na. Ŋkpal amansherbi so b luri alubi to fanɛ kananɛ Balaam daŋ wora na. B daŋ ji kenimu kikɛ emɔrɔ fanɛ kananɛ Koora daŋ wora na, amoso, bumo alɛ gba beeŋ mur fanɛ mo.

english_verse: Enoch was the seventh person after Adam, and he was talking about these people when he said: Look! The Lord is coming with thousands and thousands of holy angels
translation_verse: Le malɛ be basa ere be asheŋ nɛ Inɔk nɛ e la esa nɛ e yili Adam be jemanɛ na so m bɛ so esa shunusopo na daŋ wu ŋ kaŋɛ na fanɛ: “Men keni Enyɛnpe nɛ mbe emalaika ŋgboŋ to ŋgboŋ to ba

english_verse: to judge everyone. He will punish all those ungodly people for all the evil things they have done. The Lord will surely punish those ungodly sinners for every evil thing they have ever said about him.
translation_verse: nɛ e ba ji basa kikɛ demu. E beeŋ ji m bri bɔrɛkinipoana kikɛ ŋkpal alubi mo nɛ b wora ŋ gbiti Ebɔrɛ ashi le be kabɔrɛkini be ekpa so kikɛ so nɛ mmalga lubiana nɛ bɔrɛkinipo lubipo ere malga ŋ gbiti mo Ebɔrɛ na kikɛ so so.”

english_verse: These people grumble and complain and live by their own selfish desires. They brag about themselves and flatter others to get what they want. More Warnings
translation_verse: Saŋkikɛ le be basa ere wɔtɔ nna a bile asheŋ a wu basa pɔtɛ kulubi. Baa bɛ bumo gbagba be ayɛlgasɔ lubiana so nna a wɔtɔ a puchi nsaa ta mmalga belbelso a fule basa pɔtɛ, saŋɛ na so baaŋ nya kusɔ nɛ baa sha. Kefiɛso be mmalga be asheŋ

english_verse: My dear friends, remember the warning you were given by the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Ama menyi ere, n teri lelaana, men baa nyi asɔ nɛ an Nyɛnpe Yesu Kristo be beshuŋipoana na daŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ a beeŋ wora na.

english_verse: They told you that near the end of time, selfish and godless people would start making fun of God.
translation_verse: B daŋ kaŋɛ menyi fanɛ: “Lalaloge be nchɛ na kaŋ fo, basa beeŋ lar n wora menyi eyurto, basa nɛ baaŋ ba kaa bɛ bumo gbagba be kabɔrɛkiniso be ayɛlgasɔ lubiana so.”

english_verse: And now these people are already making you turn against each other. They think only about this life, and they don't have God's Spirit.
translation_verse: Le be basa ere e naa bar kebarga to basa to na, durnya to be basa nɛ b maŋ kɔ Ebɔrɛ be Kiyoyu na.

english_verse: Dear friends, keep building on the foundation of your most holy faith, as the Holy Spirit helps you to pray.
translation_verse: Ama menyi ere, n teri lelaana, men baa wora ania ga a chɛ abar to a yɔ anishito ashi abɔrɛsheŋ cheembi nɛ men yirda ga na to nsaa kule Ebɔrɛ ashi Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na to.

english_verse: And keep in step with God's love, as you wait for our Lord Jesus Christ to show how kind he is by giving you eternal life.
translation_verse: Men baa kɔ men be amu a wɔ Ebɔrɛ be kasha to a jo saŋɛ nɛ an Nyɛnpe Yesu Kristo beeŋ wu anyi kuwɔr n shin nɛ anyi nɛ mo e baa wɔtɔ mbaanaayɔ na.

english_verse: Be helpful to all who may have doubts.
translation_verse: Men baa wu bumo nɛ baa shika to na kuwɔr.

english_verse: Rescue any who need to be saved, as you would rescue someone from a fire. Then with fear in your own hearts, have mercy on everyone who needs it. But hate even the clothes of those who have been made dirty by their filthy deeds. Final Prayer
translation_verse: Men baa mɔlga beko a suge bumo ashi edɛ to, men baa wu beko malɛ kuwɔr nsaa ŋana bumo be alubiana a de so nɛ a sa maŋ kaŋ gbiti menyi. Kedi Ebɔrɛ epaŋ be mmalga be asheŋ

english_verse: Offer praise to God our Savior because of our Lord Jesus Christ! Only God can keep you from falling and make you pure and joyful in his glorious presence. Before time began and now and forever, God is worthy of glory, honor, power, and authority. Amen.
translation_verse: Mo nawule e la Ebɔrɛ. Mo e mɔlga anyi ŋkpal an Nyɛnpe Yesu Kristo so, mo alɛ e naa kɔ eleŋ kikɛ nɛ kusɔ kikɛ to pɔɛŋ nɛ saŋkikɛ fara. Mo alɛ beeŋ baa kraa kɔ amo to saŋkikɛ mbaanaayɔ. Amoso, men baa sa mo kemaŋkura nɛ bunyaŋ nɛ eleŋ nɛ kenimuji saŋkama. Amɛn.

english_verse: This is what God showed to Jesus Christ, so that he could tell his servants what must happen soon. Christ then sent his angel with the message to his servant John.
translation_verse: Yesu Kristo be asɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ sa mo nɛ e lara ŋ ŋini mbe anya nde. A la asɔ nɛ a maaŋ chɛr nseŋ wora nna nɛ e shuŋi mbe kabɔ fanɛ e ba lara amo ŋ ŋini ma, mbe kenya Jɔn

english_verse: And John told everything he had seen about God's message and about what Jesus Christ had said and done.
translation_verse: nɛ ma alɛ ji asɔ nɛ n wu na kikɛ be shɛda, amo e la fanɛ Ebɔrɛ be kamalga nɛ asɔ nɛ Yesu Kristo malga na kikɛ be asheŋ.

english_verse: From John to the seven churches in Asia. I pray that you will be blessed with kindness and peace from God, who is and was and is coming. May you receive kindness and peace from the seven spirits before the throne of God.
translation_verse: Kawɔl ere shi ma Jɔn kutɔ nna a yɔ asɔri ashunu mo nɛ a wɔ Eeshia be kasawule so na kutɔ. Kuwɔr be kakɛ nɛ kagbenewushi e shi esa nɛ e daa wɔtɔ nseŋ kraa wɔtɔ ŋkeŋ naa ba na nɛ ayoyu ashunu mo nɛ a wɔ mbe kuwurputi be anishito na kutɔ a la menyeya.

english_verse: May kindness and peace be yours from Jesus Christ, the faithful witness. Jesus was the first to conquer death, and he is the ruler of all earthly kings. Christ loves us, and by his blood he set us free from our sins.
translation_verse: Loŋ be kuwɔr be kakɛ koŋwule na nɛ kagbenewushi na e shi Yesu Kristo nɛ e la shɛdajipo nɛ esa beeŋ tiŋ n yirda na, mo alɛ nseŋ juŋkpar bubuni kikɛ n tiŋi luwu to nseŋ naa la kasawule ere so be bewura be esa nɛ e bee ji bumo so kuwura na kutɔ m ba. E bee sha anyi nna ga nseŋ bɔla mbe ŋklaŋ so na n sɔ anyi ashi alubi to n yige,

english_verse: He lets us rule as kings and serve God his Father as priests. To him be glory and power forever and ever! Amen.
translation_verse: nseŋ ta anyi ŋ ki mbe kuwura to ebi nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ an baa shuŋ mbe Ebɔrɛ nɛ Etuto na. Kemaŋkura nɛ eleŋ e baa la Yesu Kristo peya saŋkikɛ mbaanaayɔ. Amɛn.

english_verse: Look! He is coming with the clouds. Everyone will see him, even the ones who stuck a sword through him. All people on earth will weep because of him. Yes, it will happen! Amen.
translation_verse: Men keni mo nɛ awɔlpa kulti a ba na, kenishi kama malɛ beeŋ wu mo n ta bumo nɛ b ta kusɔ n da mo m mɔ na n ti so nɛ kasawule ere so be basa kikɛ e shu ŋkpal mo so. Kumo be loŋ bre maŋ kɔ emɔrɔ. Amɛn.

english_verse: The Lord God says, “I am Alpha and Omega, the one who is and was and is coming. I am God All-Powerful!” A Vision of the Risen Lord
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na yɛ: “Ma e la Alfa nɛ Omega, Enyɛnpetale mo nɛ e daa wɔtɔ nseŋ kraa wɔtɔ nseŋ naa ba na.” Kewuŋkaŋɛ na be sososo be asheŋ

english_verse: I am John, a follower together with all of you. We suffer because Jesus is our king, but he gives us the strength to endure. I was sent to Patmos Island, because I had preached God's message and had told about Jesus.
translation_verse: Kachako b shin nɛ ma Jɔn, men kurgepo nɛ an kikɛ bee ji awurfoŋ nsaa la kuwura na to be basa a kɔ kanyiti a yil to ŋkpal Yesu so na ya kaa wɔ kepla nɛ baa tre Patmɔs na so ŋkpal ŋ ka daŋ malga Ebɔrɛ be kamalga na nseŋ daŋ ji Yesu be shɛda so.

english_verse: On the Lord's day the Spirit took control of me, and behind me I heard a loud voice that sounded like a trumpet.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe be kachɛ ko mbe kiyoyu koso ma kikɛ to nɛ n nu ebɔl ka wora awɔr ma kamanto fanɛ kabel na.

english_verse: The voice said, “Write in a book what you see. Then send it to the seven churches in Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia, and Laodicea.”
translation_verse: Ebɔl na yɛ: “Sibɛ asɔ nɛ feeŋ wu ere n wɔtɔ kawɔl to nseŋ ta kawɔl na n sa nɛ b ya sa asɔri ashunu na. Asɔriana nɛ a wɔ Ɛfeses nɛ Smɛɛna nɛ Pɛɛgamem nɛ Tayataira nɛ Saadis nɛ Filadɛlfia nɛ Laodisiya na.”

english_verse: When I turned to see who was speaking to me, I saw seven gold lampstands.
translation_verse: Ŋ ka nu asheŋ ere nɛ ŋ kilgi nɛ ŋ keni ebɔl na wura nseŋ wu shuwa be kefitilatɔl ashunu.

english_verse: There with the lampstands was someone who seemed to be the Son of Man. He was wearing a robe that reached down to his feet, and a gold cloth was wrapped around his chest.
translation_verse: Shuwa be kefitilatɔl ashunu na malɛ to n wu esa ko fanɛ dimɛdi pibinyɛnso ka buu piŋi nɛ k gbelge n ya fo mbe ayadra so nɛ shuwa be kreso paŋgelambi ko ŋ kre mbe nteto.

english_verse: His head and his hair were white as wool or snow, and his eyes looked like flames of fire.
translation_verse: Mbe kumu nɛ emin daŋ fuli nna parr fanɛ ateebi ŋko abɔrɛjembubi nɛ mbe anishi malɛ daa du fanɛ edɛ be adondulombi.

english_verse: His feet were glowing like bronze being heated in a furnace, and his voice sounded like the roar of a waterfall.
translation_verse: Mbe ayadra daa du fanɛ katishaŋ peper nna a kpa edɛ fanɛ b ka lara amo edɛ to m bel amo na nɛ mbe ebɔl malɛ daa gbri fanɛ nchu damta ka bee shile na.

english_verse: He held seven stars in his right hand, and a sharp double-edged sword was coming from his mouth. His face was shining as bright as the sun at noon.
translation_verse: E daa kɔ achɛkpabi ashunu nna mbe enɔjiso to nɛ tokobi jinnɔnyɔ jiso ko shi mbe kɔnɔ to n lar. Mbe anishiakpa malɛ daa kpa edɛ nna fanɛ epeŋi ka bee nyaŋɛ ga na.

english_verse: When I saw him, I fell at his feet like a dead person. But he put his right hand on me and said: Don't be afraid! I am the first, the last,
translation_verse: Ŋ ka wu mo na nɛ n tɔr mbe anishito fanɛ ŋ ka wu na. Ndoŋ nna nɛ e ta mbe enɔjiso n deŋi ma so nseŋ kaŋɛ: “Sa maa lɔ kufu, ma e la Faraŋko nɛ Lalaloge,

english_verse: and the living one. I died, but now I am alive forever, and I have the keys to death and the world of the dead.
translation_verse: ma e la emo nɛ e wɔ ŋkpa to na. N daŋ wu nna, ama naniere n tiŋi nna a wɔ ŋkpa to mbaanaayɔ. Ma alɛ e kɔ luwu nɛ bubuni to be kakpa be eleŋ.

english_verse: Write what you have seen and what is and what will happen after these things.
translation_verse: Amoso, sibɛ asɔ nɛ fo wu ere, asɔ nɛ a wɔtɔ naniere nɛ amo nɛ a beeŋ wora kachako so na n nase.

english_verse: I will explain the mystery of the seven stars you saw at my right side and the seven gold lampstands. The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches, and the lampstands are the seven churches.
translation_verse: Achɛkpabi ashunu nɛ fo wu ma enɔjiso to na nɛ shuwa be kefitilatɔl ashunu na be wulo na be afito nde: Achɛkpabi ashunu na e la asɔri ashunu na be emalaika nɛ kefitilatɔl ashunu na malɛ la asɔri ashunu na.”

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Ephesus: I am the one who holds the seven stars in my right hand, and I walk among the seven gold lampstands. Listen to what I say.
translation_verse: E yɛ: “Sibɛ kawɔl ere n sa Ɛfeses be kade to be asɔri be malaika na ŋ kaŋɛ mo le: ‘Mmalga ere shi esa nɛ e kɔ achɛkpabi ashunu mbe enɔjiso to nsaa na shuwa be kefitilatɔl ashunu na to na kutɔ nna.

english_verse: I know everything you have done, including your hard work and how you have endured. I know you won't put up with anyone who is evil. When some people pretended to be apostles, you tested them and found out they were liars.
translation_verse: N nyi men be aworbi kikɛ a nyi kananɛ men shuŋ ga nseŋ naa nyi kananɛ men kɔ kanyiti a yil to. N nyi kananɛ menyi nɛ basa lubi maaŋ tiŋ n chena nsaa nyi fanɛ men wora basa nɛ b yɛ b la beshuŋipoana, bumo alɛ ŋkaa maŋ la na ŋ keni n wu fanɛ befɛpo e la bumo.

english_verse: You have endured and gone through hard times because of me, yet you have not given up.
translation_verse: N nyi kananɛ men kɔ kanyiti a yil to nɛ kananɛ menyee ji tɔrɔ ŋkpal ma ketre so, menyi alɛ ŋkaa maa pɔ aba.

english_verse: But I do have something against you! And it is this: You don't have as much love as you used to.
translation_verse: Ama kusɔ lubi nɛ n wu menyi so nde fanɛ men lɛ men be sososo be kasha na.

english_verse: Think about where you have fallen from, and then turn back and do as you did at first. If you don't turn back, I will come and take away your lampstand.
translation_verse: Men keni ketɔr gboŋgboŋi nɛ men tɔr na. Men lar men be alubi to nseŋ naa wora asheŋ nɛ men daa wora sososo na. Nɛ men baa maŋ lar men be alubi na to, meeŋ ba menyi kutɔ m ba ta men be kefitilatɔl ashi kumo be eyilikpa.

english_verse: But there is one thing you are doing right. You hate what the Nicolaitans are doing, and so do I.
translation_verse: Ama kusɔ nɛ k walɛ menyi e la fanɛ men kishi katuŋ nɛ baa tre Nikolawsebi na be asheŋ fanɛ kananɛ ma alɛ gba kishi kumo be asheŋ na.

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. I will let everyone who wins the victory eat from the life-giving tree in God's wonderful garden. The Letter to Smyrna
translation_verse: Ekama nɛ e kɔ asoe, e baa nu asɔ nɛ Kiyoyu na bee kaŋɛ asɔriana na. Ekama nɛ e kɔ m pɔɔ so, meeŋ sa mo ekpa nɛ e ji ŋkpa be kedibi nɛ k wɔ Ebɔrɛ be kakpa lela nɛ baa tre ndoŋ Paradisi to na be kusɔrso na.’ ” Kubɔya nɛ k yɔ Smɛɛna be kade to be asɔri to be asheŋ

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Smyrna: I am the first and the last. I died, but now I am alive! Listen to what I say.
translation_verse: Kede be kaman nɛ e naŋ kaŋɛ: “Sibɛ kawɔl ere n sa Smɛɛna be kade to be asɔri be malaika na ŋ kaŋɛ mo le: ‘Mmalga ere shi emo nɛ e la sososo nɛ lalaloge nseŋ daŋ wu n naŋ tiŋi a wɔ ŋkpa to na kutɔ nna.

english_verse: I know how much you suffer and how poor you are, but you are rich. I also know the cruel things being said about you by people who claim to be God's people. But they are not really God's people. They are a group that belongs to Satan.
translation_verse: N nyi men be etɔrɔ nsaa nyi men be ketir be asheŋ, ama kashenteŋ bre, damawuraana e la menyi. Ma alɛ kraŋ naa nyi mmalga lubi mo nɛ basa nɛ baa tre bumo be amu Juwebi, bumo alɛ ŋkaa maŋ la na bee malga a gbiti menyi, ama bumo alɛ la Setani be katuŋ to be basa nna.

english_verse: Don't worry about what you will suffer. The devil will throw some of you into jail, and you will be tested and made to suffer for ten days. But if you are faithful until you die, I will reward you with a glorious life.
translation_verse: Men sa maŋ kaa ŋana asheŋ nɛ a bee shin nɛ a ba menyi so ere. Mee kaŋɛ menyi nna na fanɛ alubipo na beeŋ shin nɛ b ta menyi be beko n ti ebu nɛ e wora menyi ŋ keni nɛ men ji tɔrɔ nchɛ kudu. Ama men baa yil to kpakpa loŋ n ya kaa fo luwu to be keluri to gba nɛ n sa menyi ŋkpa be kuwurwuro na.

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. Whoever wins the victory will not be hurt by the second death. The Letter to Pergamum
translation_verse: Ekama nɛ e kɔ asoe e baa nu asɔ nɛ Kiyoyu na bee kaŋɛ asɔriana na. Ekama nɛ e kɔ m pɔɔ so, luwu nyɔsopo na maaŋ doro mo kikɛ.’ ” Kubɔya nɛ k yɔ Pɛɛgamem be kade to be asɔri to be asheŋ

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Pergamum: I am the one who has the sharp double-edged sword! Listen to what I say.
translation_verse: Nɛ e naŋ kaŋɛ: “Sibɛ kawɔl ere n sa Pɛɛgamem be kade to be asɔri be malaika na ŋ kaŋɛ mo le: ‘Mmalga ere shi emo nɛ e kɔ tokobi jinnɔnyɔ jiso to na kutɔ nna.

english_verse: I know you live where Satan has his throne. But you have kept true to my name. Right there where Satan lives, my faithful witness Antipas was taken from you and put to death. Even then you did not give up your faith in me.
translation_verse: N nyi kakpa nɛ men wɔ ere be asheŋ, kakpa nɛ Setani baa tase gbagba. Ŋkeshin nɛ menyi alɛ maa lar ma ketre na kaman. Men maŋ lar men be yirda nɛ men kɔ ma so na kaman kikɛ, hale ma shɛdajipo nɛ esa beeŋ tiŋ n yirda na Antipas nɛ b daŋ mɔ men be kadegboŋ na to, kakpa nɛ Setani baa wɔ na be jemanɛ na kikɛ.

english_verse: I do have a few things against you. Some of you are following the teaching of Balaam. Long ago he told Balak to teach the people of Israel to eat food that had been offered to idols and to be immoral.
translation_verse: Ama asɔ lubi gbrɛbi nɛ n wu menyi so nde: Men kɔ basa ko menyi to ndoŋ nɛ baa bɛ Balaam be keŋini so, Balaam mo nɛ e daŋ ŋini Balak kananɛ e beeŋ fule Israɛlebi nɛ b ji nlɔŋɛjibi nseŋ naŋ fule bumo n wɔtɔ kesakalea be keji to na.

english_verse: Now some of you are following the teaching of the Nicolaitans.
translation_verse: Beko malɛ gba wɔ menyi to a bɛ katuŋ nɛ baa tre Nikolawsebi na be keŋini so.

english_verse: Turn back! If you don't, I will come quickly and fight against these people. And my words will cut like a sword.
translation_verse: Amoso, men lar loŋ be alubi na to, nɛ mannɛ aloŋ, m maaŋ chɛr nseŋ ba menyi kutɔ m ba ta ma kɔnɔ to be tokobi m ba kɔ bumo.

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. To everyone who wins the victory, I will give some of the hidden food. I will also give each one a white stone with a new name written on it. No one will know that name except the one who is given the stone. The Letter to Thyatira
translation_verse: Ekama nɛ e kɔ asoe e baa nu asɔ nɛ Kiyoyu na bee kaŋɛ asɔriana na. Ekama nɛ e kɔ m pɔɔ so, meeŋ sa mo manna ŋana so na be ako. Kumo be kaman nɛ n naŋ sa mo kejembu fuful mo nɛ b sibɛ kumo so ketre popɔr mo nɛ esa nɛ e bee sɔ kejembu na nawule nyi na.’ ” Kubɔya nɛ k yɔ Tayataira be kade to be asɔri to be asheŋ

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Thyatira: I am the Son of God! My eyes are like flames of fire, and my feet are like bronze. Listen to what I say.
translation_verse: Nɛ e naŋ kaŋɛ: “Sibɛ kawɔl ere n sa Tayataira be kade to be asɔri be malaika na ŋ kaŋɛ mo le: ‘Mmalga ere shi Ebɔrɛ Pibinyɛn mo nɛ mbe anishi du fanɛ edɛ be adondulombi nɛ mbe ayadra malɛ bee kpa edɛ fanɛ katishaŋ peper na kutɔ nna.

english_verse: I know everything about you, including your love, your faith, your service, and how you have endured. I know you are doing more now than you have ever done before.
translation_verse: N nyi men be aworbi nɛ men be kasha nɛ yirda, nɛ kananɛ menyee shuŋ beko nseŋ naa nyi kanyiti nɛ men kɔ a yil to. Ma alɛ naa nyi fanɛ naniere menyee wora asheŋ ga a chɔ kananɛ men daa wora sososo na.

english_verse: But I still have something against you because of that woman Jezebel. She calls herself a prophet, and you let her teach and mislead my servants to do immoral things and to eat food offered to idols.
translation_verse: Ama kusɔ nɛ n wu menyi so e la fanɛ, men sa kache Jɛzebel mo nɛ e bee tre mbe kumu abɔrɛsheŋ be ewuŋkaŋɛpo na ekpa nna nɛ e wɔtɔ a ŋini nsaa shin nɛ ma anya bee luri kesakalea be keji to nseŋ naa shin nɛ baa ji nlɔŋɛjibi.

english_verse: I gave her a chance to turn from her sins, but she did not want to stop doing these immoral things.
translation_verse: N sa mo saŋɛ nɛ e lar mbe alubi to, ama e maa sha kelar mbe kesakalea na to.

english_verse: I am going to strike down Jezebel. Everyone who does these immoral things with her will also be punished, if they don't stop.
translation_verse: Amoso, meeŋ ta kulɔ n lɛ mo so nɛ e dese kelaŋ so ŋkeŋ shin nɛ bumo nɛ baa tu mo a ji kesakalea na malɛ e nu ebesa ga ama b baŋ lar bumo be alubi na to nna.

english_verse: I will even kill her followers. Then all the churches will see that I know everyone's thoughts and feelings. I will treat each of you as you deserve.
translation_verse: Ma alɛ beeŋ naŋ shin nɛ mbe mbia e wu n wu nɛ asɔriana na kikɛ to ebi e pin fanɛ ma e la esa nɛ e bee mige ŋgbene nɛ nfɛraana to a wu amo to na. Ma alɛ beeŋ ka ekama be kusɔ nɛ e wora kikɛ be kukɔ.

english_verse: Some of you in Thyatira don't follow Jezebel's teaching. You don't know anything about what her followers call the “deep secrets of Satan.” So I won't burden you down with any other commands.
translation_verse: Ama menyi Tayatairaebi nɛ men ka ŋkaa maa bɛ loŋ be keŋini na so nseŋ maŋ naŋ bii asɔ nɛ beko bee tre Setani be wulo be keŋini chiŋgeliŋana na so na bre, m maaŋ naŋ ta kegben kama n ti menyi so.

english_verse: But until I come, you must hold firmly to the teaching you have.
translation_verse: Ama men baa kɔ asɔ nɛ men tea kɔ ere to hale nɛ n ya ba.

english_verse: I will give power over the nations to everyone who wins the victory and keeps on obeying me until the end.
translation_verse: Esa kama nɛ e kɔ m pɔɔ so ŋkaa kɔ ma aworbi na to n ya fo lalaloge na, meeŋ sa amodoŋwura eleŋ nɛ k bee ji efuliana so

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches.
translation_verse: Amoso, ekama nɛ e kɔ asoe e baa nu asɔ nɛ Kiyoyu na bee kaŋɛ asɔriana na.’ ”

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Sardis: I have the seven spirits of God and the seven stars. Listen to what I say. I know what you are doing. Everyone may think you are alive, but you are dead.
translation_verse: Nɛ e kaŋɛ: “Sibɛ kawɔl ere n sa Saadis be kade to be asɔri be malaika na ŋ kaŋɛ mo le: ‘Mmalga ere shi esa nɛ e kɔ Ebɔrɛ be ayoyu ashunu nɛ achɛkpabi ashunu na to na kutɔ nna. N nyi men be aworbi kikɛ, n nyi men ka kɔ ketre basa kutɔ fanɛ men wɔ ŋkpa to nna, ama men wu nna a wɔtɔ.

english_verse: Wake up! You have only a little strength left, and it is almost gone. So try to become stronger. I have found that you are not completely obeying God.
translation_verse: Men tiŋi ashi loŋ be kebaawɔtɔ na to nseŋ wɔtɔ men be kabɔrɛbɛso na be mboŋ nɛ a ka a shin nɛ a mur na eleŋ to, nɛ mannɛ aloŋ, amo alɛ gba beeŋ mur kuraa. Ŋkpal manɛ so, m maŋ wu men be aworbi ka walɛ a bɔlɔ ma Ebɔrɛ be kenishi.

english_verse: Remember the teaching you were given and heard. Hold firmly to it and turn from your sins. If you don't wake up, I will come when you least expect it, just as a thief does.
translation_verse: Amoso, men baa nyiŋi asɔ nɛ men daŋ sɔ nseŋ nu na kikɛ. Men baa bɛ amo so nseŋ lar alubi to. Nɛ men baŋ maŋ tiŋi men be loŋ be kebaawɔtɔ na to, meeŋ ba fanɛ eyu nɛ men maaŋ pin saŋɛ nɛ meeŋ purgi menyi.

english_verse: A few of you in Sardis have not dirtied your clothes with sin. You will walk with me in white clothes, because you are worthy.
translation_verse: Men kraa kɔ basa gbrɛbi ko ashi Saadis to nɛ eyurpi kama maŋ gbiti bumo be asɔbuuso na. Bumo alɛ beeŋ tu ma n nite m buu asɔ fuful, ŋkpal manɛ so, b daga loŋ.

english_verse: Everyone who wins the victory will wear white clothes. Their names will not be erased from the book of life, and I will tell my Father and his angels that they are my followers.
translation_verse: Ekama nɛ e kɔ m pɔɔ so beeŋ buu asɔ fuful fanɛ bumo. M maaŋ kpra mbe ketre ashi ŋkpa be kawɔl na to kikɛ, ama meeŋ ji mbe shɛda n sa n Tuto nɛ mbe emalaika.

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. The Letter to Philadelphia
translation_verse: Ekama nɛ e kɔ asoe e baa nu asɔ nɛ Kiyoyu na bee kaŋɛ asɔriana na.’ ” Kubɔya nɛ k yɔ Filadɛlfia be kade to be asɔri to be asheŋ

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Philadelphia: I am the one who is holy and true, and I have the keys that belonged to David. When I open a door, no one can close it. And when I close a door, no one can open it. Listen to what I say.
translation_verse: Nɛ e kaŋɛ: “Sibɛ kawɔl ere n sa Filadɛlfia be kade to be asɔri be malaika na ŋ kaŋɛ mo le: ‘Mmalga ere shi ma, emo nɛ e du cheembi nsaa la kashenteŋwura nsaa kɔ Ewura Deevid be sɔfi to na kutɔ nna. Kusɔ nɛ m bugi, esa kikɛ maaŋ tiŋ n ti kumo, kusɔ kama malɛ nɛ n ti, esa kikɛ maaŋ tiŋ m bugi kumo.

english_verse: I know everything you have done. And I have placed before you an open door no one can close. You were not very strong, but you obeyed my message and did not deny you are my followers.
translation_verse: N nyi men be aworbi. Men nu nfe, m bugi kabuna mo nɛ esa kikɛ maaŋ tiŋ n ti na n yili menyi. N nyi men ka maŋ kɔ eleŋ ga, ama men ta ma mmalga n wɔtɔ men be ŋgbene to ŋkaa maŋ lar ma ketre na kaman.

english_verse: Now you will see what I will do with those people who belong to Satan's group. They claim to be God's people, but they are liars. I will make them come and kneel down at your feet. Then they will know that I love you.
translation_verse: Men nu nfe, basa nɛ b wɔ Setani be katuŋ to, befɛpo na, bumo e wɔtɔ a tre bumo be amu Juwebi, bumo alɛ maŋ la na, meeŋ shin nɛ b ba gbir men be anishito n shin nɛ b pin fanɛ ma e sha menyi.

english_verse: I am coming soon. So hold firmly to what you have, and no one will take away the crown you will be given as your reward.
translation_verse: M maaŋ naŋ chɛr nseŋ ba, men baa kɔ kusɔ nɛ men tea kɔ to na to kpakpa nɛ esa kikɛ e sa maŋ tiŋ n sɔ men be kekɔmpɔɔso be tɔnɔ.

english_verse: Everyone who wins the victory will be made into a pillar in the temple of my God, and they will stay there forever. I will write on each of them the name of my God and the name of his city. It is the new Jerusalem my God will send down from heaven. I will also write on them my own new name.
translation_verse: Ekama nɛ e kɔ m pɔɔ so, meeŋ ta mo ŋ ki ma Ebɔrɛ be lambu to be shabɔrɛ. Mo alɛ maaŋ naŋ lar kumo to kikɛ nɛ n sibɛ ma Ebɔrɛ be ketre nɛ ma Ebɔrɛ be kadegboŋ be ketre n deŋi mo so. Kade na e la Jerusalɛm popɔr nɛ k bee shi ma Ebɔrɛ kutɔ ashi ebɔrɛso a ba na. Ma alɛ beeŋ naŋ sibɛ ma ketre popɔr n deŋi mo so.

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. The Letter to Laodicea
translation_verse: Ekama nɛ e kɔ asoe, e baa nu asɔ nɛ Kiyoyu na bee kaŋɛ asɔriana na.’ ” Kubɔya nɛ k yɔ Laodisiya be kade to be asɔri to be asheŋ

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Laodicea: I am the one called Amen! I am the faithful and true witness and the source of God's creation. Listen to what I say.
translation_verse: Nɛ e naŋ kaŋɛ: “Sibɛ kawɔl ere n sa Laodisiya be kade to be asɔri be malaika na ŋ kaŋɛ mo le: ‘Mmalga ere shi ma nɛ n la Amɛn nɛ kashenteŋ be shɛdajipo nɛ baaŋ tiŋ n yirda na nɛ n la Ebɔrɛ be kepɔrso kikɛ be gbaltɔlase na kutɔ nna.

english_verse: I know everything you have done, and you are not cold or hot. I wish you were either one or the other.
translation_verse: N nyi men be aworbi kikɛ fanɛ men la basa nɛ men maŋ wushi, menyi alɛ maŋ naa tushi. Men daŋ baa la basa nɛ b wushi ŋko bumo nɛ baa tushi, k daa beeŋ baa kɔ kifito.

english_verse: But since you are lukewarm and neither cold nor hot, I will spit you out of my mouth.
translation_verse: Ama ŋkpal men ka du yulɛyulɛbi fanɛ nchu a maa tushi, menyi alɛ maŋ naŋ wushi na so, meeŋ luu menyi ashi ma kɔnɔ to n lɛ.

english_verse: You claim to be rich and successful and to have everything you need. But you don't know how bad off you really are. You are pitiful, poor, blind, and naked.
translation_verse: Men yɛ: An dii dama n nya kusɔ kama nyam nɛ anyee sha, anyi maŋ naa sha shɛŋ. Ama menyi alɛ maŋ nyi fanɛ men la awurfoŋwuraana nɛ basa nɛ bumo be asheŋ kɔ kuwɔr nɛ betirpo nɛ betanpo nɛ basa delgeso nna.

english_verse: Buy your gold from me. It has been refined in a fire, and it will make you rich. Buy white clothes from me. Wear them and you can cover up your shameful nakedness. Buy medicine for your eyes, so you will be able to see.
translation_verse: Amoso, mee sa menyi nfɛra nna fanɛ men tɔ shuwa mo nɛ a maŋ kɔ saŋgre kikɛ amo to ŋ kutɔ, saŋɛ na so menyeeŋ dii dama. Men tɔ asɔbuuso fuful gba ashi ŋ kutɔ m buu men be anishinyɔr be eyurkpaŋ na so nseŋ tɔ kudur malɛ gba n fɔr men be anishiana so n tiŋ a wu.

english_verse: I correct and punish everyone I love. So make up your minds to turn away from your sins.
translation_verse: Ma ere, basa nɛ mee sha nɛ mee fiɛ so nsaa ŋini bumo ekpa, amoso, men yeŋi so n lar men be alubi to.

english_verse: Listen! I am standing and knocking at your door. If you hear my voice and open the door, I will come in and we will eat together.
translation_verse: Men nu nfe, n yil kabuna to nna a ŋmɛa, ekama nɛ e nu ma ebɔl nseŋ bugi kabuna n sa ma, meeŋ luri mo kutɔ n tu mo n ji nɛ mo alɛ gba e tu ma n ji.

english_verse: Everyone who wins the victory will sit with me on my throne, just as I won the victory and sat with my Father on his throne.
translation_verse: Esa kama nɛ e kɔ m pɔɔ so, meeŋ sa mo ekpa nɛ e tu ma n chena ma kuwurputi so fanɛ kananɛ ŋ kɔ m pɔɔ so nseŋ chena n Tuto kutɔ ashi mbe kuwurputi so na.

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches.
translation_verse: Ekama nɛ e kɔ asoe, e baa nu asɔ nɛ Kiyoyu na bee kaŋɛ asɔriana na.’ ”

english_verse: After this, I looked and saw a door that opened into heaven. Then the voice that had spoken to me at first and that sounded like a trumpet said, “Come up here! I will show you what must happen next.”
translation_verse: Ade kikɛ be kaman nɛ ŋ keni nɛ kabuna bugi a yil ebɔrɛso. Nɛ ebɔl mo nɛ n daŋ juŋkpar n nu nɛ k bee malga ŋ kutɔ fanɛ kabel na kaŋɛ ma le: “Dii m ba nfe nɛ ŋ ŋini fo asɔ nɛ a beeŋ wora asheŋ ere kikɛ be kaman.”

english_verse: Right then the Spirit took control of me, and there in heaven I saw a throne and someone sitting on it.
translation_verse: Epul na to nɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na koso ma kikɛ to nɛ ŋ keni n wu kuwurputi ebɔrɛso nɛ esa ko tase kumo so.

english_verse: Twenty-four other thrones were in a circle around that throne. And on each of these thrones there was an elder dressed in white clothes and wearing a gold crown.
translation_verse: Nwurputi adunyɔ nɛ ana ko malɛ gba daŋ chambɔ ŋ kulti kuwurputi mo na nɛ bejuŋkparpo adunyɔ nɛ ana chena n chena amo so. B daŋ buu asɔ fuful nna nseŋ buu shuwa be nwurwuro.

english_verse: Flashes of lightning and roars of thunder came out from the throne in the center of the circle. Seven torches, which are the seven spirits of God, were burning in front of the throne.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ bɔrɛ shi kuwurputi na akpa a ponte to a gbri le gbrugbru nsaa nyɛkpɛ palpal nɛ efitila ashunu yil kuwurputi na be anishito a suse. Ndia ashunu na e la Ebɔrɛ be ayoyu ashunu na.

english_verse: Also in front of the throne was something that looked like a glass sea, clear as crystal. Around the throne in the center were four living creatures covered front and back with eyes.
translation_verse: Kusɔ ko malɛ daa du fanɛ digi a dese fanɛ teku kuwurputi koŋwule na be anishito a wu to kleembi. Asɔbɔya keniso ana ko malɛ gba daa yil kuwurputi na be mboŋ ana nna nsaa kɔ anishi amo be anishito nɛ amo be mmanto be kaplɛkama.

english_verse: The first creature was like a lion, the second one was like a bull, the third one had the face of a human, and the fourth was like a flying eagle.
translation_verse: Sososo be kusɔbɔya keniso na daa du fanɛ buluŋ nna nɛ kenyɔsopo daa du fanɛ kena nɛ kesasopo daa kɔ anishiakpa fanɛ nyiŋgbasa nɛ kenasopo malɛ daa du fanɛ kusore ka bee firgi.

english_verse: Each of the four living creatures had six wings, and their bodies were covered with eyes. Day and night they never stopped singing, “Holy, holy, holy is the Lord, the all-powerful God, who was and is and is coming!”
translation_verse: Asɔbɔya keniso ana na be kekama daa kɔ atɛ ashe nna nɛ anishi malɛ sɔ bumo be eyurana kikɛ so hale bumo be atɛana to kikɛ. Kapa nɛ kanyɛ b daa maa lo to kikɛ, b daŋ baa boŋ le nna: “Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ e la cheembi cheembi cheembi. Mo e daa wɔtɔ nseŋ kraa wɔtɔ ŋkeŋ naa ba na.”

english_verse: The living creatures kept praising, honoring, and thanking the one who sits on the throne and who lives forever and ever.
translation_verse: Saŋkama malɛ asɔbɔya keniso na bee sa esa nɛ e tase kuwurputi na so na nsaa wɔ ŋkpa to mbaanaayɔ na kemaŋkura nɛ bunyaŋ nɛ kechɔrɔ nna.

english_verse: “Our Lord and God, you are worthy to receive glory, honor, and power. You created all things, and by your decision they are and were created.”
translation_verse: “An Nyɛnpe nɛ an be Ebɔrɛ, fo e daga kenya kemaŋkura nɛ bunyaŋ nɛ eleŋ, ŋkpal manɛ so, fo e to kusɔ kikɛ, fo alɛ be keparso nɛ b to kusɔ kama nɛ k wɔ ŋkpa to.”

english_verse: In the right hand of the one sitting on the throne I saw a scroll that had writing on the inside and on the outside. And it was sealed in seven places.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ n wu kawɔl sibɛso ka wɔ esa nɛ e daŋ chena kuwurputi na so be enɔjiso so. Kasibɛ e daŋ bɔlɔ kumo be anishito nɛ kamanto kikɛ nɛ b ta tɔɔnɛ be kebersobi ashunu m pɛ kumo.

english_verse: I saw a mighty angel ask with a loud voice, “Who is worthy to open the scroll and break its seals?”
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nɛ n wu malaika lempo ko ka bee ponte awɔrso a bishi le: “Wanɛ e daga nɛ e tiŋ m bu m bu kawɔl sibɛso be tɔɔnɛ be abersobi ashunu na?”

english_verse: No one in heaven or on earth or under the earth was able to open the scroll or look inside it.
translation_verse: Ama esa kikɛ daa maŋ wɔ ebɔrɛso ŋko kasawule so ŋko kasawule be kaseto nɛ e tiŋ m bugi kawɔl sibɛso na ŋko nɛ e tiŋ ŋ keni kumo to gba.

english_verse: I cried hard because no one was found worthy to open the scroll or look inside it.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ n shu ga ŋkpal esa kikɛ ka daa maŋ wɔtɔ nɛ e daga nɛ e tiŋ m bugi kawɔl sibɛso na ŋko nɛ e tiŋ ŋ keni kumo to na so.

english_verse: Then one of the elders said to me, “Stop crying and look! The one who is called both the ‘Lion from the Tribe of Judah’ and ‘King David's Great Descendant’ has won the victory. He will open the scroll and its seven seals.”
translation_verse: Ŋ ka bee shu na nɛ bejuŋkparpoana na be eko kaŋɛ ma: “Sa maa shu, keni Juda be kanaŋ to be buluŋ, Ewura Deevid mo Nanabigboŋ na kɔ m pɔɔ so ŋkaa beeŋ tiŋ m bu m bu abersobi ashunu na nseŋ tiŋ m bugi kawɔl sibɛso na.”

english_verse: Then I looked and saw a Lamb standing in the center of the throne surrounded by the four living creatures and the elders. The Lamb looked as if it had once been killed. It had seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven spirits of God, sent out to all the earth.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ n wu Kpakpafɔlbi ka yil kuwurputi na akpa be nferinto nɛ asɔbɔya keniso ana na nɛ bejuŋkparpo na kulti kumo. Kpakpafɔlbi na daa du fanɛ b ka mɔ mo nna. E daa kɔ alambɛ ashunu nɛ anishi ashunu nɛ a la Ebɔrɛ be ayoyu ashunu nɛ e shuŋi amo m ba kasawule ere so na nna.

english_verse: The Lamb went over and took the scroll from the right hand of the one who sat on the throne.
translation_verse: Mo e daŋ ba esa nɛ e daŋ chena kuwurputi na so na kutɔ m ba sɔ kawɔl sibɛso na ashi mbe enɔjiso to.

english_verse: Then they sang a new song, “You are worthy to receive the scroll and open its seals, because you were killed. And with your own blood you bought for God people from every tribe, language, nation, and race.
translation_verse: Nɛ b boŋ kashɛ popɔr ko a kaŋɛ: “Fo e daga nɛ fo ta kawɔl sibɛso na nseŋ tiŋ m bu m bu kumo be tɔɔnɛ be abersobi na, ŋkpal manɛ so, fo nɛ b daŋ mɔ nɛ fo ta fo ŋklaŋ n tɔ basa n sa Ebɔrɛ ashi yiri kama to ebi to nɛ ŋgbar kikɛ to ebi to nɛ basa kama to ebi to nɛ efuli kama so ebi to na.
