english_verse: You let them become kings and serve God as priests, and they will rule on earth.”
translation_verse: Fo ta bumo ŋ ki an be Ebɔrɛ be kuwura to ebi nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ b baa shuŋ mo nɛ b ba ji kuwura kasawule so.”

english_verse: As I looked, I heard the voices of a large number of angels around the throne and the voices of the living creatures and of the elders. There were millions and millions of them,
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ n naŋ keni nseŋ nu emalaika damtaana nɛ ŋgboŋ to be ŋgboŋ kudu be ebɔlana. B daŋ kulti kuwurputi na nna nɛ asɔbɔya keniso ana nɛ bejuŋkparpo na

english_verse: and they were saying in a loud voice, “The Lamb who was killed is worthy to receive power, riches, wisdom, strength, honor, glory, and praise.”
translation_verse: nsaa boŋ le awɔrso a kaŋɛ: “Kpakpafɔlbi nɛ b mɔ na e daga nɛ e nya eleŋ nɛ dama nɛ kanyiasheŋ nɛ kuwibi to be eleŋ nɛ bunyaŋ nɛ kemaŋkura nɛ epaŋ be kedi.”

english_verse: Then I heard all beings in heaven and on the earth and under the earth and in the sea offer praise. Together, all of them were saying, “Praise, honor, glory, and strength forever and ever to the one who sits on the throne and to the Lamb!”
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ n nu kusɔtoso kikɛ nɛ k wɔ ebɔrɛso nɛ kasawule so nɛ kasawule be kaseto nɛ etekuana so nɛ amo nɛ a wɔ amo to kikɛ verr ka bee boŋ a kaŋɛ le: “Kapandi nɛ bunyaŋ nɛ kemaŋkura nɛ eleŋ e baa la emo nɛ e tase mbe kuwurputi so na nɛ Kpakpafɔlbi na peya mbaanaayɔ.”

english_verse: The four living creatures said “Amen,” while the elders knelt down and worshiped.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ asɔbɔya keniso ana na kikɛ shuli ŋ kaŋɛ: “Amɛn.” Nɛ bejuŋkparpoana na gbir n dese kasawule m maŋ mo so.

english_verse: At the same time I saw the Lamb open the first of the seven seals, I heard one of the four living creatures shout with a voice like thunder. It said, “Come out!”
translation_verse: Nɛ n wu Kpakpafɔlbi na ka bu tɔɔnɛ be abersobi ashunu na be kuko to nseŋ nu asɔbɔya keniso ana na be kuko ka ta ebɔl ŋ kaŋɛ awɔrso fanɛ bɔrɛ be egbri ŋ kaŋɛ: “Ba!”

english_verse: Then I saw a white horse. Its rider carried a bow and was given a crown. He had already won some victories, and he went out to win more.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ ŋ keni nɛ gbaŋɛ fuful e yil. Kumo be ediipo daa kɔ keta to nna nɛ b ta kuwurwuro n sa mo nɛ e dii gbaŋɛ na n lar ndoŋ fanɛ ekɔmpɔɔsopo nɛ e ya kɔ m pɔɔ so.

english_verse: When the Lamb opened the second seal, I heard the second living creature say, “Come out!”
translation_verse: Kpakpafɔlbi na ka naŋ bu tɔɔnɛ be kebersobi nyɔsopo na to nɛ n nu kusɔbɔya keniso nyɔsopo ka tre: “Ba!”

english_verse: Then another horse came out. It was fiery red. And its rider was given the power to take away all peace from the earth, so people would slaughter one another. He was also given a big sword.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ gbaŋɛ ko malɛ naŋ lar m ba m pere le kpaw. B daŋ sa kumo be ediipo eleŋ nna fanɛ e lara kagbenewushi ashi kasawule so nɛ basa e baa mɔ abar. B daŋ ta tokobi gboŋgboŋi ko nna n sa mo.

english_verse: When the Lamb opened the third seal, I heard the third living creature say, “Come out!” Then I saw a black horse, and its rider had a balance scale in one hand.
translation_verse: Kpakpafɔlbi na ka bu tɔɔnɛ be kebersobi sasopo na to nɛ n nu kusɔbɔya keniso sasopo na ka tre: “Ba!” Ndoŋ nna nɛ ŋ keni nɛ gbaŋɛ lembir ko e yil. Kumo be ediipo daa kɔ kusɔ nɛ b kɔ a ta egbɛ na nna ashi mbe enɔ to.

english_verse: I heard what sounded like a voice from somewhere among the four living creatures. It said, “A liter of wheat will cost you a whole day's wages! Three liters of barley will cost you a day's wages too. But don't ruin the olive oil or the wine.”
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ n nu kusɔ ko ka shi asɔbɔya keniso ana na to ŋ gbri m ba fanɛ ebɔl na a kaŋɛ le: “Ta aboyu be kurwa be bargato malɛ be bargato nɛ amo be yawu la lebra be kachɛ koŋwule be kakɔka na nseŋ ta gari be kurwa be bargato malɛ be bargato asa n sɔ lebra be kachɛ koŋwule be kakɔka. Ama sa maŋ kaŋ tɔrɔ ŋku na nɛ yabra belbelso na bre.”

english_verse: When the Lamb opened the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth living creature say, “Come out!”
translation_verse: Kpakpafɔlbi na ka bu tɔɔnɛ be kebersobi nasopo na to nɛ n nu kusɔbɔya keniso nasopo na ka kaŋɛ: “Ba!”

english_verse: Then I saw a pale green horse. Its rider was named Death, and Death's Kingdom followed close behind. They were given power over one fourth of the earth, and they could kill its people with swords, famines, diseases, and wild animals.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ ŋ keni nɛ gbaŋɛ peperbi ko yil. Kumo be ediipo nɛ b daa tre Luwu, nɛ emo nɛ b daa tre Bubuni be Kakpa na malɛ bɛ mo so. B daŋ sa bumo eleŋ nɛ baaŋ ta m mɔ kasawule so be kenasopo na nna nɛ b ta tokobi m mɔ nseŋ naŋ bar akoŋ nɛ alɔ nɛ asɔbɔya lubiana.

english_verse: When the Lamb opened the fifth seal, I saw under the altar the souls of everyone who had been killed for speaking God's message and telling about their faith.
translation_verse: Nɛ Kpakpafɔlbi na bu tɔɔnɛ be kebersobi nusopo na nɛ n wu basa nɛ b mɔ ŋkpal b ka daŋ malga Ebɔrɛ be kamalga na so nɛ ŋkpal shɛda mo nɛ b ji na so na be ayoyu ashi bɔrɛsure na be kaseto.

english_verse: They shouted, “Master, you are holy and faithful! How long will it be before you judge and punish the people of this earth who killed us?”
translation_verse: Nɛ b ponte awɔrso ga m bishi: “Enyɛnpe Lempo nɛ fo du cheembi nsaa kɔ kashenteŋ, nuso be kechɛr nɛ fo kraa shin nɛ fo chɛr ga pɔɛŋ nseŋ ji kasawule ere so be basa demu m bishi anyi be luwu be kuwule?”

english_verse: Then each of those who had been killed was given a white robe and told to rest for a little while. They had to wait until the complete number of the Lord's other servants and followers would be killed.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ b ta epiŋi fuful n sa bumo be ekama nseŋ kaŋɛ bumo fanɛ b baa kraa jo gbrɛ pɔɛŋ nɛ bumo braana anya nɛ bumo kurgepoana mo nɛ basa beeŋ mɔ fanɛ kananɛ b daŋ mɔ bumo alɛ gba na nyam e ya ba abar so.

english_verse: When I saw the Lamb open the sixth seal, I looked and saw a great earthquake. The sun turned as dark as sackcloth, and the moon became red as blood.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ n naŋ keni n wu Kpakpafɔlbi na ka naŋ bu tɔɔnɛ be kebersobi shesopo na to nɛ kasawule be kebembeŋgboŋ ko gbuŋgbuŋ kasawule ga nɛ epeŋi kilgi m biri to a du fanɛ fusa lembir na nɛ kufɔl malɛ pere to le kpaiŋ fanɛ ŋklaŋ na.

english_verse: The stars in the sky fell to earth, just like figs shaken loose by a windstorm.
translation_verse: Nɛ achɛkpabi mo nɛ a wɔ awɔlpa so na tɔr kasawule yɛɛr fanɛ afugboŋ ka bee gbaŋgbaŋ mpoli bumbuŋ a lɛ na.

english_verse: Then the sky was rolled up like a scroll, and all mountains and islands were moved from their places.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ awɔlpa na fara a foe ma anishito fanɛ b ka bee bɔɔ kelaŋ to na, nɛ kebee kikɛ nɛ kepla kikɛ tia ashi amo be eyilikpaana.

english_verse: The kings of the earth, its famous people, and its military leaders hid in caves or behind rocks on the mountains. They hid there together with the rich and the powerful and with all the slaves and free people.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ kasawule so be bewurgboŋ nɛ bumo nɛ baa ji kuwura beko so nɛ esoji be benimu nɛ damawuraana nɛ belempo nɛ basa kikɛ, anya nɛ bumo nɛ b wɔ bumo be amu kikɛ ŋana abeelaŋana nɛ abee be afaltagboŋana to.

english_verse: Then they shouted to the mountains and the rocks, “Fall on us! Hide us from the one who sits on the throne and from the anger of the Lamb.
translation_verse: Ade be kaman nɛ b fara a tre abeegboŋana na nɛ afaltaana na fanɛ a ka la enyiŋgbasa a kaŋɛ amo le: “Men tɔr anyi so n ta anyi ŋ ŋana esa nɛ e tase mbe kuwurputi so na nɛ Kpakpafɔlbi na be agbo so.

english_verse: That terrible day has come! God and the Lamb will show their anger, and who can face it?”
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, kachɛgboŋ nɛ k la bumo be agbo be kachɛ na fo nɛ wanɛ malɛ e naaŋ tiŋ n yili bumo be anishito?”

english_verse: After this I saw four angels. Each one was standing on one of the earth's four corners. The angels held back the four winds, so that no wind would blow on the earth or on the sea or on any tree. These angels had also been given the power to harm the earth and the sea. Then I saw another angel come up from where the sun rises in the east, and he was ready to put the mark of the living God on people. He shouted to the four angels,
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ n naŋ wu malaika ko ka shi bɔrɛfito a ba nsaa kɔ Ebɔrɛ mo nɛ e wɔ ŋkpa to na be tɔɔnɛ be kebersobi to. Nɛ e tre emalaika ana nɛ b ta eleŋ m bɔɔ bumo enɔ na fanɛ b tɔrɔ kasawule ere nɛ eteku na awɔrso

english_verse: “Don't harm the earth or the sea or any tree! Wait until I have marked the foreheads of the servants of our God.”
translation_verse: ŋ kaŋɛ bumo le: “Men sa maŋ tɔrɔ kasawule ere ŋko teku ŋko ndibi pɔɛŋ nɛ an ya ta tɔɔnɛ be abersobi n dulgi Ebɔrɛ be anya kikɛ be nsɔto.”

english_verse: and said, “Amen! Praise, glory, wisdom, thanks, honor, power, and strength belong to our God forever and ever! Amen!”
translation_verse: ŋ kaŋɛ le: “Amɛn. Kapandi nɛ kemaŋkura nɛ kanyiasheŋ nɛ kechɔrɔ nɛ bunyaŋ nɛ eleŋ nɛ kuwibi to be eleŋ e baa la an be Ebɔrɛ na peya mbaanaayɔ. Amɛn.”

english_verse: After this, I saw a large crowd with more people than could be counted. They were from every race, tribe, nation, and language, and they stood before the throne and before the Lamb. They wore white robes and held palm branches in their hands,
translation_verse: Ade be kaman nɛ ŋ keni n wu jimaŋ damta ko nɛ esa kikɛ maaŋ tiŋ ŋ karga bumo ka yil kuwurputi na nɛ Kpakpafɔlbi na be anishito. B daŋ shi efuli kama so nɛ yiri kama to nɛ basa kama to nɛ ŋgbar kama to nna m buu epiŋi fuful nseŋ daŋ keta abii be ayabiana.

english_verse: as they shouted, “Our God, who sits upon the throne, has the power to save his people, and so does the Lamb.”
translation_verse: Nɛ b boŋ to awɔrso ŋ kaŋɛ le: “Kumɔlga kikɛ shi an be Ebɔrɛ nɛ e tase mbe kuwurputi so nɛ Kpakpafɔlbi na kutɔ nna.”

english_verse: The angels who stood around the throne knelt in front of it with their faces to the ground. The elders and the four living creatures knelt there with them. Then they all worshiped God
translation_verse: Saŋɛ ere malɛ kikɛ nɛ emalaika na kikɛ yili ŋ kulti kuwurputi na nɛ bejuŋkparpoana na nɛ asɔbɔya keniso ana na. Ndoŋ nna nɛ b gbir nseŋ dese kasawule kuwurputi na be anishito m maŋ Ebɔrɛ so

english_verse: One of the elders asked me, “Do you know who these people are that are dressed in white robes? Do you know where they come from?”
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ bejuŋkparpoana na be eko bishi ma: “Nuso be basa e la basa nɛ b buu epiŋi fuful ere nɛ nnɛ nɛ b shi?”

english_verse: “Sir,” I answered, “you must know.” Then he told me: “These are the ones who have gone through the great suffering. They have washed their robes in the blood of the Lamb and have made them white.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ mo le: “Ebunyampo, fo e nyi.” Nɛ e kaŋɛ ma: “Bumo e la basa nɛ b ji n lar tɔrɔgboŋ to na nseŋ fɔr bumo be epiŋi n ta amo n wɔtɔ Kpakpafɔlbi na be ŋklaŋ to nɛ a fuli parr na.

english_verse: And so they stand before the throne of God and worship him in his temple day and night. The one who sits on the throne will spread his tent over them.
translation_verse: Amoso, b baa wɔ Ebɔrɛ be kuwurputi be anishito a shuŋ mo kapa nɛ kanyɛ ashi mbe bɔrɛlambu to nna nɛ mo koŋwule nɛ e tase mbe kuwurputi so na malɛ bee ta mbe kebaawɔtɔ a kuŋ bumo.

english_verse: They will never hunger or thirst again, and they won't be troubled by the sun or any scorching heat.
translation_verse: Akoŋ maaŋ naŋ pɛ bumo, achukoŋ malɛ gba maaŋ pɛ bumo. Epeŋi maaŋ mɔ bumo, ebeldɛ malɛ gba maaŋ mɔ bumo.

english_verse: “The Lamb in the center of the throne will be their shepherd. He will lead them to streams of life-giving water, and God will wipe all tears from their eyes.”
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, Kpakpafɔlbi nɛ e wɔ kuwurputi na be nferinto na e naaŋ ki bumo be ekpapo n yɛr bumo mboŋ nɛ ŋkpa be nchuana bee bul nɛ Ebɔrɛ malɛ e kpra anishichubi kikɛ ashi bumo be anishiana to.”

english_verse: When the Lamb opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven for about half an hour.
translation_verse: Kpakpafɔlbi na ka bu tɔɔnɛ be kebersobi shunusopo na to nɛ kakpa wora shruum fanɛ awa be bargato ashi ebɔrɛso.

english_verse: I noticed that the seven angels who stood before God were each given a trumpet.
translation_verse: Nɛ n wu emalaika ashunu mo nɛ b yil Ebɔrɛ be anishito na nɛ b ta mbel ashunu m bɔɔ bumo enɔ.

english_verse: Another angel, who had a gold container for incense, came and stood at the altar. This one was given a lot of incense to offer with the prayers of God's people on the gold altar in front of the throne.
translation_verse: Nɛ malaika ko malɛ ka kɔ shuwa be kusɔjɔduwu to m ba yili bɔrɛsure na akpa. B daŋ ta duwu damta ko nna fanɛ e ta n wea Ebɔrɛ be basa be kabɔrɛkuleana to n ta m ba deŋi shuwa be bɔrɛsure na so ashi kuwurputi na be anishito.

english_verse: Then the smoke of the incense, together with the prayers of God's people, went up to God from the hand of the angel.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ duwu na be edishi nɛ Ebɔrɛ be basa be kabɔrɛkuleana na shi malaika nɛ e yil Ebɔrɛ be anishito na be enɔ to n dii n yɔ.

english_verse: After this, the angel filled the incense container with fire from the altar and threw it on the earth. Thunder roared, lightning flashed, and the earth shook. The Trumpets
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ malaika na ta shuwa be kusɔjɔduwu na n lara edɛ ashi bɔrɛsure na to m bɔlɔ kumo n ta edɛ na ŋ kpa n wurge kasawule so. E ka wora loŋ na nɛ bɔrɛ ponte ŋ gbri n nyɛkpɛ pɛlpɛl nɛ kasawule gbuŋgbuŋ to.

english_verse: When the first angel blew his trumpet, hail and fire mixed with blood were thrown down on the earth. A third of the earth, a third of the trees, and a third of all green plants were burned.
translation_verse: Malaika juŋkparso na ka foŋ mbe kabel nɛ abɔrɛjembubi nɛ edɛ wea ŋklaŋ to m ba wurge kasawule so nɛ kasawule be ntuŋ nsa be katuŋ koŋwuleso chɔɔ nɛ ndibi kikɛ be ntuŋ nsa be katuŋ koŋwuleso chɔɔ nɛ kefitiri bumbuŋ kama chɔɔ.

english_verse: When the second angel blew his trumpet, something like a great fiery mountain was thrown into the sea. A third of the sea turned to blood,
translation_verse: Nɛ malaika nyɔsopo na malɛ foŋ mbe kabel nɛ kusɔ ko fanɛ kebee gboŋgboŋi lar a suse edɛ le wuloŋwuloŋ n ya tɔr teku to nɛ teku na be ntuŋ nsa be katuŋ koŋwuleso kilgi ŋklaŋ.

english_verse: a third of the living creatures in the sea died, and a third of the ships were destroyed.
translation_verse: Nɛ asɔ keniso mo nɛ a wɔ teku na to na be ntuŋ nsa be katuŋ koŋwuleso wu nɛ ekuloŋgboŋ be ntuŋ nsa be katuŋ koŋwuleso mur.

english_verse: When the third angel blew his trumpet, a great star fell from heaven. It was burning like a torch, and it fell on a third of the rivers and on a third of the springs of water.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ malaika sasopo na malɛ foŋ mbe kabel nɛ kechɛkpabi gboŋgboŋi ko shi awɔlpa so a suse fanɛ kabulpi na m ba tɔr elɔrana nɛ mbombiana be ntuŋ nsa be katuŋ koŋwuleso to.

english_verse: The name of the star was Bitter, and a third of the water turned bitter. Many people died because the water was so bitter.
translation_verse: Kechɛkpabi na be ketre e la Kerkra. K ka tɔr nchuana na to na nɛ amo be ntuŋ nsa be katuŋ koŋwuleso ki kerkra nɛ basa damta nu amo nseŋ wu ŋkpal a ka ki kerkra na so.

english_verse: When the fourth angel blew his trumpet, a third of the sun, a third of the moon, and a third of the stars were struck. They each lost a third of their light. So during a third of the day there was no light, and a third of the night was also without light.
translation_verse: Ade be kaman nɛ malaika nasopo na malɛ foŋ mbe kabel nɛ kusɔ ko ŋmɛa epeŋi be mba asa be kaba koŋwuleso nɛ kufɔl be mba asa be kaba koŋwuleso nɛ achɛkpabi be ntuŋ nsa be katuŋ koŋwuleso, saŋɛ na so, kefulto be ntuŋ nsa be katuŋ koŋwuleso ki m biri to nɛ karechɛ be ntuŋ nsa be katuŋ koŋwuleso nɛ kanyɛso be ntuŋ nsa be katuŋ koŋwuleso kikɛ paŋ kefulto.

english_verse: Then I looked and saw a lone eagle flying across the sky. It was shouting, “Trouble, trouble, trouble to everyone who lives on earth! The other three angels are now going to blow their trumpets.”
translation_verse: Nɛ n naŋ keni n wu kusore ka wɔ esoso kumu so a firgi nsaa tre awɔrso a kaŋɛ: “Asheŋ maaŋ nyalɛ, asheŋ maaŋ nyalɛ, asheŋ maaŋ nyalɛ n sa basa nɛ b wɔ kasawule ere so kikɛ ŋkpal mbel be kushu mo nɛ emalaika asa mo nɛ b ka na bee shin nɛ b foŋ nɛ a wora na so.”

english_verse: When the fifth angel blew his trumpet, I saw a star fall from the sky to earth. It was given the key to the tunnel that leads down to the deep pit.
translation_verse: Nɛ malaika nusopo foŋ mbe kabel nɛ n wu kechɛkpabi ka shi awɔlpa so m ba tɔr kasawule nɛ b ta kemaŋ nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na nɛ baa tre kumo Abis na be esɔfi n sa kumo.

english_verse: As it opened the tunnel, smoke poured out like the smoke of a great furnace. The sun and the air turned dark because of the smoke.
translation_verse: Kechɛkpabi na ka bugi kemaŋ nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na nɛ edishi lar fanɛ a ka shi edɛgboŋ ko to na. Nɛ epeŋi nɛ awɔlpa kikɛ biri to ŋkpal edishi mo nɛ a shi kemaŋ na to so.

english_verse: Locusts came out of the smoke and covered the earth. They were given the same power that scorpions have.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ elotɔr malɛ shi edishi na to m ba kasawule so a kɔ eleŋ a duŋ a besa fanɛ kasawule so be nna.

english_verse: The locusts were told not to harm the grass on the earth or any plant or any tree. They were to punish only those people who did not have God's mark on their foreheads.
translation_verse: B daŋ kaŋɛ loŋ be elotɔr na nna fanɛ b sa maŋ wora kasawule so be afitiri ŋko asɔ duuso ŋko kedibi kikɛ shɛŋ she basa nɛ b daa maa kɔ Ebɔrɛ be tɔɔnɛ be kebersobi bumo be nsɔto so na.

english_verse: The locusts were allowed to make them suffer for five months, but not to kill them. The suffering they caused was like the sting of a scorpion.
translation_verse: B daa maŋ sa bumo eleŋ na nna nɛ b mɔ basa na, ama b daŋ sa bumo eleŋ na nna nɛ b tɔrɔ bumo afɔl anu. Ebesa mo nɛ b daa beeŋ nu na malɛ daa du fanɛ kana ka duŋ esa na nna.

english_verse: In those days people will want to die, but they will not be able to. They will hope for death, but it will escape from them.
translation_verse: Amo be jemanɛ na basa beeŋ fin luwu ŋ gben, baaŋ yɛlga luwu, ama luwu beeŋ shile bumo.

english_verse: Their hair was like a woman's long hair, and their teeth were like those of a lion.
translation_verse: Bumo be eminana daa du fanɛ beche be emin nna nɛ bumo be anyii malɛ daa du fanɛ ebuluŋ be anyii.

english_verse: On their chests they wore armor made of iron. Their wings roared like an army of horse-drawn chariots rushing into battle.
translation_verse: Bumo be ŋgbene so be asɔ kuŋso daa du fanɛ abɛlso peya nna nɛ bumo be atɛana to be egbri daa du fanɛ egbaŋɛ damta nɛ egbaŋɛturko ka bee shile a luri kena to na nna.

english_verse: Their tails were like a scorpion's tail with a stinger that had the power to hurt someone for five months.
translation_verse: B daa kɔ ndu nɛ mboŋ duŋsoana nna fanɛ nna peyaana. Ndu na malɛ to nɛ b daa kɔ eleŋ mo nɛ k bee tiŋ a tɔrɔ basa afɔl anu na.

english_verse: Their king was the angel in charge of the deep pit. In Hebrew his name was Abaddon, and in Greek it was Apollyon.
translation_verse: Bumo be ewura mo nɛ e daa ji kuwura bumo so daa la kemaŋ nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar nɛ baa tre kumo Abis na to be malaika nna nɛ Hibruwebi bee tre mo Abadɔn nɛ Griikebi malɛ bee tre mo Apɔliɔn.

english_verse: The first horrible thing has now happened! But wait. Two more horrible things will happen soon.
translation_verse: ‘Asheŋ maaŋ nyalɛ n sa basa’ juŋkparso be saŋɛ na choŋ, naniere a ka ‘asheŋ maaŋ nyalɛ n sa basa’ nyɔsopo be saŋɛ nɛ k ba.

english_verse: Then the sixth angel blew his trumpet. I heard a voice speak from the four corners of the gold altar that stands in the presence of God.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ malaika shesopo na foŋ mbe kabel nɛ n nu ebɔl ka shi shuwa be bɔrɛsure mo nɛ k daa yil Ebɔrɛ be anishito na n lar. Asɔ ana ko daa yuu a yuu kumo so fanɛ kumo be alambɛ

english_verse: The voice spoke to this angel and said, “Release the four angels who are tied up beside the great Euphrates River.”
translation_verse: ŋ kaŋɛ malaika shesopo nɛ e daa kɔ kabel to na le: “Shin nɛ emalaika ana mo nɛ b kre lɔrgboŋ nɛ baa tre Yufreetes akpa na e nya bumo be amu n yɔ.”

english_verse: The four angels had been prepared for this very hour and day and month and year. Now they were set free to kill a third of all people.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ b lara emalaika ana nɛ b daŋ ta bumo n yili awa ere to gbagba nɛ kabre be kachɛ ere gbagba nɛ kufɔl ere gbagba to nɛ kafɛ ere gbagba to na fanɛ b mɔ dimɛdi be kepɔrso to be ntuŋ nsa be katuŋ koŋwuleso.

english_verse: One third of all people were killed by the three terrible troubles caused by the fire, the smoke, and the sulfur.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ kɔnɔso be etɔrɔ be asɔ asa na, amo e la edɛ nɛ edishi nɛ jɛrbi nɛ a shi amo be nnɔ na to m mɔ edimɛdi be ntuŋ nsa be katuŋ koŋwuleso na.

english_verse: The people who lived through these terrible troubles did not turn away from the idols they had made, and they did not stop worshiping demons. They kept on worshiping idols that were made of gold, silver, bronze, stone, and wood. Not one of these idols could see, hear, or walk.
translation_verse: Edimɛdi mo nɛ asɔ na daa maŋ mɔ nɛ b daŋ ka na daa maŋ lar bumo be alubi mo nɛ b daŋ ta bumo be enɔana n wora na to, bumo alɛ daa maŋ yige kebaashuŋ alizinaana nɛ eshuwa nɛ egbiti nɛ ntishaŋana be agbirana nɛ ajembu nɛ ndibi mo nɛ a maaŋ tiŋ n nu ŋko n tiŋ n wu asɔ ŋko n nite na to.

english_verse: No one stopped murdering or practicing witchcraft or being immoral or stealing.
translation_verse: Bumo alɛ maŋ naŋ lar bumo be kamɔ nɛ ŋkilgi nɛ kesakaleasheŋ nɛ bumo be kayu to.

english_verse: I saw another powerful angel come down from heaven. This one was covered with a cloud, and a rainbow was over his head. His face was like the sun, his legs were like columns of fire,
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ n naŋ wu malaika lempo ko malɛ gba ka shi ebɔrɛso a ba nɛ kuwɔlpa mea mo kikɛ so nɛ kabɔrɛnyaŋgelambi ko chambɔ mbe kumu so. Mbe anishiakpa daa du fanɛ epeŋi nna nɛ mbe aya daa du fanɛ edɛ ka lara adondulombi nɛ a du fanɛ eshabɔrɛ na.

english_verse: and with his hand he held a little scroll that had been unrolled. He stood there with his right foot on the sea and his left foot on the land.
translation_verse: E daa kɔ kawɔl sibɛsobi ko to nna nɛ k bugi a wɔ mbe enɔ to nseŋ ta mbe keya jiso n yuu teku so nseŋ ta mbe bena be keya malɛ n yuu kasawule so

english_verse: Then he shouted with a voice that sounded like a growling lion. Thunder roared seven times.
translation_verse: nseŋ wora awɔr ko fanɛ buluŋ ka munto na. E ka wora awɔr na nɛ bɔrɛ be egbri ashunu na sɔ n shuli so.

english_verse: After the thunder stopped, I was about to write what it had said. But a voice from heaven shouted, “Keep it secret! Don't write these things.”
translation_verse: Bumo alɛ ka baŋ shuli so na nɛ n daa shin nɛ n sibɛ nseŋ naŋ nu ebɔl ka shi ebɔrɛso ŋ kaŋɛ ma: “Ta tɔɔnɛ be kebersobi m ber asɔ nɛ bɔrɛ be egbri ashunu na ka kaŋɛ na nsaa maŋ sibɛ asheŋ na n nase.”

english_verse: The angel I had seen standing on the sea and the land then held his right hand up toward heaven.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ malaika mo nɛ n daŋ wu nɛ e yil teku nɛ kasawule so na maŋ mbe enɔjiso so n yɔ ebɔrɛso

english_verse: He made a promise in the name of God who lives forever and who created heaven, earth, the sea, and every living creature. The angel said, “You won't have to wait any longer.
translation_verse: nseŋ bɔ esa nɛ e wɔ ŋkpa to mbaanaayɔ na, emo nɛ e to ebɔrɛso nɛ asɔ nɛ a wɔ kumo to na kikɛ nseŋ to kasawule nɛ asɔ nɛ a wɔ kumo to na kikɛ nseŋ naŋ to teku nɛ asɔ nɛ a wɔ kumo to na kikɛ nseŋ kaŋɛ le: “K maaŋ naŋ chɛr nɛ saŋɛ na e fo.

english_verse: God told his secret plans to his servants the prophets, and it will all happen by the time the seventh angel sounds his trumpet.”
translation_verse: Ama saŋɛ nɛ malaika shunusopo na beeŋ foŋ mbe kabel na, Ebɔrɛ beeŋ shin nɛ mbe wulo be kesheŋ naseso na e fo kumo be ekar n lar efuli fanɛ kananɛ e daŋ kaŋɛ mbe anya nɛ b la anebiana na.”

english_verse: Once again the voice from heaven spoke to me. It said, “Go and take the open scroll from the hand of the angel standing on the sea and the land.”
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ n naŋ nu ebɔl mo nɛ k daŋ shi ebɔrɛso m ba nɛ n nu kumo na ka naŋ kaŋɛ ma le: “Choŋ n ya deŋi kawɔl sibɛsobi mo nɛ k bugi to a deŋ malaika mo nɛ e yil teku nɛ kasawule so na be enɔ to.”

english_verse: When I went over to ask the angel for the little scroll, the angel said, “Take the scroll and eat it! Your stomach will turn sour, but the taste in your mouth will be sweet as honey.”
translation_verse: Nɛ n yɔ malaika na kutɔ n ya kaŋɛ mo fanɛ e ta kawɔl sibɛsobi na n sa ma nɛ e kaŋɛ ma: “Ta kumo n we. K beeŋ ki kerkra fo epun to, ama fo kɔnɔ to bre, k beeŋ wora ebel fanɛ mushoŋ.”

english_verse: I took the little scroll from the hand of the angel and ate it. The taste was sweet as honey, but my stomach turned sour.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ n deŋi kawɔl sibɛsobi na ashi malaika na be enɔ to n ta n we. K daŋ baŋ wora ma kɔnɔ to ebel nna fanɛ mushoŋ, ama ŋ ka ta kumo m min nɛ ma epun to wora ma kerkra.

english_verse: Then some voices said, “Keep on telling what will happen to the people of many nations, races, and languages, and also to kings.”
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ b naŋ kaŋɛ ma le: “A daga fanɛ fo naŋ lɔŋɛ n wu abɔrɛsheŋ ŋ kaŋɛ basa damta nɛ efuliana so ebi damta nɛ ŋgbarana to ebi damta nɛ bewura damta be asheŋ.”

english_verse: But don't measure the courtyard outside the temple building. Leave it out. It has been given to those people who don't know God, and they will trample all over the holy city for
translation_verse: Ama sa maŋ ta kusɔ kargaso na ŋ karga lambu na be laŋ na bre, ŋkpal manɛ so, b ta ndoŋ nna n sa nnyamase, bumo alɛ beeŋ nɔkɔr kadegboŋ cheembi na to afɔl adena nɛ anyɔ.

english_verse: These two witnesses are the two olive trees and the two lampstands that stand in the presence of the Lord who rules the earth.
translation_verse: Eshɛdajipo anyɔ na e la Ɔlif be ndibi anyɔ nɛ kefitilatɔl anyɔ mo nɛ amo kikɛ yil Enyɛnpe mo nɛ e wɔ kasawule ere na be anishito na.

english_verse: Any enemy who tries to harm them will be destroyed by the fire that comes out of their mouths.
translation_verse: Nɛ ekama baa sha ketɔrɔ bumo, edɛ beeŋ shi bumo be nnɔ to m ba mur bumo doŋana. Kananɛ esa kama nɛ e beeŋ baa sha ketɔrɔ bumo beeŋ wu nna na.

english_verse: They have the power to lock up the sky and to keep rain from falling while they are prophesying. And whenever they want to, they can turn water to blood and cause all kinds of terrible troubles on earth.
translation_verse: Basa anyɔ ere beeŋ baa kɔ eleŋ nɛ b tiŋ n shin nɛ bɔrɛ e sa maŋ shi awɔlpa so m ba, saŋɛ nɛ baaŋ baa wu abɔrɛsheŋ a kaŋɛ na kikɛ. Bumo alɛ nseŋ naa kɔ eleŋ nɛ b tiŋ n shin nɛ nchuana e ki ŋklaŋ nseŋ naŋ tiŋ n ta tɔrɔ be yiri kama saŋɛ damta kama nɛ baa sha n lɛ kasawule so.

english_verse: After the two witnesses have finished preaching God's message, the beast that lives in the deep pit will come up and fight against them. It will win the battle and kill them.
translation_verse: B kaŋ ji bumo be shɛda n loge, kusɔbɔya lubi mo nɛ e shi kakpa nɛ baa tre Abis na beeŋ ba kɔ bumo kena m pɔɔ bumo so nseŋ mɔ bumo

english_verse: Their bodies will be left lying in the streets of the same great city where their Lord was nailed to a cross. And this city is spiritually like the city of Sodom or the country of Egypt.
translation_verse: nɛ bumo be eyurana e baa dese kadegboŋ na to be kubɔrbi ko so. Kade na du fanɛ Sodɔm nɛ Ijipt nna, amoso, Sodɔm nɛ Ijipt nɛ b nase kumo, kakpa koŋwule mo nɛ b daŋ kegbir bumo Nyɛnpe kedibi largato so na.

english_verse: For three and a half days the people of every nation, tribe, language, and race will stare at the bodies of these two witnesses and refuse to let them be buried.
translation_verse: Basa beeŋ shi basa kama to nɛ yiri kama to nɛ ŋgbar kama to nɛ efuliana so ebi to ŋ keni bumo be eyurana ka dese nchɛ asa nɛ bargato nseŋ kini keshin nɛ b puli amo.

english_verse: Everyone on earth will celebrate and be happy. They will give gifts to each other, because of what happened to the two prophets who caused them so much trouble.
translation_verse: Kasawule so be basa be ŋgbene beeŋ fuli bumo ŋkpal basa anyɔ na be luwu so. Baaŋ ji bumo be amuana nseŋ kɛ ŋ kɛ abar asɔ ŋkpal kananɛ anebi anyɔ na daŋ bar kasawule ere so ebi tɔrɔ nsaa maŋ naa wɔtɔ na so.

english_verse: But three and a half days later, God will breathe life into their bodies. They will stand up, and everyone who sees them will be terrified.
translation_verse: Nchɛ nsa nɛ bargato na be kaman nɛ ŋkpa be efute shi Ebɔrɛ kutɔ m ba luri bumo to nɛ b niŋi to nɛ kufu pɛ basa na be ekama nɛ e wu bumo na ga.

english_verse: The witnesses then heard a loud voice from heaven, saying, “Come up here.” And while their enemies were watching, they were taken up to heaven in a cloud.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ b nu ebɔl ka shi ebɔrɛso ŋ kaŋɛ bumo: “Men dii a ba nfe.” Ndoŋ nna nɛ b luri awɔlpa to a yɔ ebɔrɛso nɛ bumo doŋana yil a keni bumo.

english_verse: At that same moment there was a terrible earthquake that destroyed a tenth of the city. Seven thousand people were killed, and the rest were frightened and praised the God who rules in heaven.
translation_verse: Amo be saŋɛ na malɛ gbagba to nɛ kasawule be kebembeŋgboŋ ko ba beeŋ ndoŋ nɛ kadegboŋ na to be ntuŋ kudu be katuŋ koŋwuleso tɔr nɛ kebembeŋ na mɔ basa ŋgboŋ ashunu. Nɛ kufu pɛ basa nɛ b daŋ ka na nɛ b sa Ebɔrɛ nɛ e wɔ ebɔrɛso na kemaŋkura.

english_verse: The second horrible thing has now happened! And the third one will be here soon. The Seventh Trumpet
translation_verse: ‘Asheŋ maaŋ nyalɛ n sa basa’ nyɔsopo be saŋɛ na choŋ nna na, a ka gbrɛbi nɛ kesasopo e ba. Kabel shunusopo na be asheŋ

english_verse: At the sound of the seventh trumpet, loud voices were heard in heaven. They said, “Now the kingdom of this world belongs to our Lord and to his Chosen One! And he will rule forever and ever!”
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ malaika shunusopo na foŋ mbe kabel nɛ awɔr damtaana chɛ ashi ebɔrɛso a kaŋɛ le: “Eleŋ mo nɛ k bee ji kuwura durnya ere so na ki an Nyɛnpe nɛ mbe Kristo peya, mo alɛ beeŋ ji kuwura na mbaanaayɔ.”

english_verse: They said, “Lord God All-Powerful, you are and you were, and we thank you. You used your great power and started ruling.
translation_verse: a kaŋɛ le: “Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ mo nɛ e daa wɔtɔ nseŋ kraa wɔtɔ na, anyee chɔrɔ fo ga fanɛ fo ta fo eleŋgboŋ na n shuŋ nseŋ fara nɛ fo ji kuwura naniere.

english_verse: When the nations got angry, you became angry too! Now the time has come for the dead to be judged. It is time for you to reward your servants the prophets and all your people who honor your name, no matter who they are. It is time to destroy everyone who has destroyed the earth.”
translation_verse: Efuli so ebi daŋ nya agbo nna, ama fo agbo be saŋɛ nɛ baaŋ ji bubuni demu na fo, saŋɛ nɛ feeŋ ka fo anya kukɔ, fo anebiana nɛ fo basa kikɛ, bekama nɛ baa ŋana fo ketre, bewurbi nɛ begboŋi nyam be saŋɛ na fo. Saŋɛ na fo nɛ fo mur basa nɛ baa jija kasawule ere na.”

english_verse: The door to God's temple in heaven was then opened, and the sacred chest could be seen inside the temple. I saw lightning and heard roars of thunder. The earth trembled and huge hailstones fell to the ground.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Ebɔrɛ be lambu nɛ k wɔ ebɔrɛso na bugi nɛ an wu mbe kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre be deka ashi mbe lambu na to. Nɛ bɔrɛ nyɛkpɛ palpal m ponte to ŋ gbri n wɔtɔ nɛ kasawule gbuŋgbuŋ to nɛ abɔrɛjembubi gbɛgbɛsoana ko ba tɔr.

english_verse: She was about to give birth, and she was crying because of the great pain.
translation_verse: E daŋ di kedampo nna n fara nɛ e kurge nɛ k bee besa mo nɛ e bee shu awɔrso.

english_verse: Something else appeared in the sky. It was a huge red dragon with seven heads and ten horns, and a crown on each of its seven heads.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ tɔɔnɛ be kusɔ ko malɛ naŋ lar ebɔrɛso. Kusɔ gbeyeso peper gboŋgboŋi ko nna nɛ k daa du fanɛ laŋchaŋ n daa kɔ amu ashunu nɛ alambɛ kudu nɛ nwurwuro ashunu malɛ wɔ mbe amu so.

english_verse: With its tail, it dragged a third of the stars from the sky and threw them down to the earth. Then the dragon turned toward the woman, because it wanted to eat her child as soon as it was born.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ kusɔ na ta kumo be kodu ŋ kpata achɛkpabi be ntuŋ nsa be katuŋ koŋwuleso ashi awɔlpa so m ba lɛ kasawule. Kumo be kaman nɛ kusɔ gbeyeso na kilgi a yil kache nɛ e di kedampo na be anishito nɛ kache na e kurge nɛ e ta kebia na n we epul na to.

english_verse: The woman gave birth to a son, who would rule all nations with an iron rod. The boy was snatched away. He was taken to God and placed on his throne.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ kache na kurge ebinyɛn mo nɛ e beeŋ ba ta kagbene kpakpaso n ji efuli kama so ebi kuwura. Kache na ka kurge kebia na nɛ b ba fuu kebia na epul na to n yɔ Ebɔrɛ nɛ mbe kuwurputi ase.

english_verse: The woman ran into the desert to a place that God had prepared for her. There she would be taken care of for
translation_verse: Nɛ kache na malɛ shile n luri kiyi to be kakpa nɛ Ebɔrɛ lɔŋɛ n yili mo fanɛ e baa wɔ ndoŋ a nya kekeniso nchɛ kagboŋ nɛ alfa anyɔ nɛ adeshe na. B ka kɔ kena ashi ebɔrɛso be asheŋ

english_verse: A war broke out in heaven. Michael and his angels were fighting against the dragon and its angels.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ kena ku ebɔrɛso. Malaika nɛ baa tre Maikel na nɛ mbe emalaika nɛ kusɔ gbeyeso na nɛ mbe emalaika e daa kɔ abar.

english_verse: But the dragon lost the battle. It and its angels were forced out of their places in heaven
translation_verse: Ama kusɔ gbeyeso na nɛ mbe emalaika be eleŋ daa maŋ fo Maikel nɛ mbe emalaika peya so, amoso, b daa maŋ naŋ nya kakpa ebɔrɛso n chena.

english_verse: and were thrown down to the earth. Yes, that old snake and his angels were thrown out of heaven! That snake, who fools everyone on earth, is known as the devil and Satan.
translation_verse: B daŋ ta kusɔ gbeyeso gboŋgboŋi na nna n lɛ kasawule so. Mo e la kusɔkpaŋ dra nɛ baa tre alubipo ŋko Setani mo nɛ e bee fule durnya kikɛ na. B daŋ ta mo nɛ mbe kaman to ebi kikɛ nna n lɛ kasawule.

english_verse: Then I heard a voice from heaven shout, “Our God has shown his saving power, and his kingdom has come! God's own Chosen One has shown his authority. Satan accused our people in the presence of God day and night. Now he has been thrown out!
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ n nu ebɔl ko awɔrso ashi ebɔrɛso ka bee kaŋɛ le: “Naniere bre Ebɔrɛ ŋini mbe eleŋ fanɛ mo e la Ewurgboŋ na nɛ mbe kumɔlga na ba. Naniere bre mbe Kristo na ŋini mbe eleŋ, ŋkpal manɛ so, b ta an niopibiana be alubiwupo mo nɛ e bee wu bumo kulubi kapa nɛ kanyɛ ashi Ebɔrɛ be anishito na n lɛ kasawule.

english_verse: “Our people defeated Satan because of the blood of the Lamb and the message of God. They were willing to give up their lives.
translation_verse: Kpakpafɔlbi na be ŋklaŋ na nɛ bumo be shɛda be kamalga na nɛ b ta m pɔɔ mo so, ŋkpal manɛ so, b daa maŋ sha bumo be amu ga hale saŋɛ nɛ b daa shin nɛ b luri luwu to gba na.

english_verse: “The heavens should rejoice, together with everyone who lives there. But pity the earth and the sea, because the devil was thrown down to the earth. He knows his time is short, and he is very angry.”
translation_verse: Amoso, ebɔrɛsoana nɛ menyi nɛ men wɔ amo to na kikɛ, men shin nɛ men be ŋgbene e fuli menyi. Ama asheŋ maaŋ nyalɛ n sa kasawule nɛ etekuana bre, ŋkpal manɛ so, alubipo na gbelge n yɔ menyi kutɔ nɛ agbo damta, ŋkpal manɛ so, e nyi mbe saŋɛ ka maŋ naa shi.” Kusɔ gbeyeso nɛ kache na be asheŋ

english_verse: When the dragon realized it had been thrown down to the earth, it tried to make trouble for the woman who had given birth to a son.
translation_verse: Kusɔ gbeyeso na ka wu fanɛ b ta mo n lɛ kasawule so nɛ e ta m bɛ kache mo nɛ e daŋ kurge ebiyɛn na so.

english_verse: But the woman was given two wings like those of a huge eagle, so she could fly into the desert. There she would escape from the snake and be taken care of for a time, two times, and half a time.
translation_verse: Ama b daŋ sa kache na kusoregboŋ be atɛ anyɔ nna fanɛ e ta n firgi n shile kusɔkpaŋ na n yɔ kiyi to, mbe kakpa, fanɛ b ya kaa keni mo so nfɛ asa nɛ bargato.

english_verse: But the earth helped her and swallowed the water that had come from the dragon's mouth.
translation_verse: Ama kasawule e daŋ chɛ kache na to m bugi kumo be kɔnɔ to n ta lɔr mo nɛ kusɔ gbeyeso na daŋ fuu ashi kumo be kɔnɔ to na n nuu.

english_verse: This made the dragon terribly angry with the woman. So it started a war against the rest of her children. They are the people who obey God and are faithful to what Jesus did and taught.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ kusɔ gbeyeso na diewu ga n wora kache na nseŋ kilgi m bɛta n yɔ nɛ e ya kɔ kache na be kaman to ebi nɛ b ka na kena. Bumo e la basa nɛ baa ta Ebɔrɛ be mmalga naseso a wɔtɔ bumo be ŋgbene to nsaa ji Yesu be shɛda na.

english_verse: The dragon stood on the beach beside the sea.
translation_verse: Nɛ kusɔ gbeyeso na kilgi a yil teku ase be shishɛr so.

english_verse: I looked and saw a beast coming up from the sea. This one had ten horns and seven heads, and a crown was on each of its ten horns. On each of its heads were names that were an insult to God.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ n naŋ wu kusɔbɔya gboŋgboŋi ko ka shi teku to a lar a kɔ alambɛ kudu nɛ amu ashunu nɛ nwurwuro kudu wɔ mbe alambɛana na so. Amu na malɛ be kekama so b daŋ sibɛ ketre mo nɛ k bee ji Ebɔrɛ emɔrɔ nna n deŋi kumo so.

english_verse: The beast I saw had the body of a leopard, the feet of a bear, and the mouth of a lion. The dragon handed over its own power and throne and great authority to this beast.
translation_verse: Kusɔbɔya mo nɛ n daŋ wu na daa du fanɛ karmɛ nna nɛ mbe aya malɛ daa du fanɛ shishiri be aya nɛ mbe kɔnɔ malɛ daa du fanɛ buluŋ be kɔnɔ. Kusɔ gbeyeso na daŋ sa kusɔbɔya na mo gbagba be eleŋ nɛ mbe kuwurputi nɛ eleŋ damta nna.

english_verse: One of its heads seemed to have been fatally wounded, but now it was well. Everyone on earth marveled at this beast,
translation_verse: Kusɔbɔya na be amu na be kuko daa du fanɛ k ka daŋ nya doro mo nɛ k beeŋ tiŋ m mɔ mo nna, ama b daŋ chɛ loŋ be doro na, nɛ mamachi pɛ durnya kikɛ nɛ b bɛ kusɔbɔya na so.

english_verse: and they worshiped the dragon who had given its authority to the beast. They also worshiped the beast and said, “No one is like this beast! No one can fight against it.”
translation_verse: Basa daa maŋ kusɔ gbeyeso na so nna ŋkpal e ka daŋ ta mbe eleŋ n sa kusɔbɔya na so nseŋ maŋ kusɔbɔya na gba so nseŋ bishi le: “Wanɛ malɛ e naa du fanɛ kusɔbɔya ere? Wanɛ e naaŋ tiŋ ŋ kɔ mo kena?”

english_verse: The beast cursed God, and it cursed the name of God. It even cursed the place where God lives, as well as everyone who lives in heaven with God.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ e bugi mbe kɔnɔ a malga a gbiti Ebɔrɛ nseŋ ta mmalga lubi n jija mbe ketre nɛ kakpa nɛ e wɔ nɛ bumo nɛ b wɔ ebɔrɛso na kikɛ.

english_verse: It was allowed to fight against God's people and defeat them. It was also given authority over the people of every tribe, nation, language, and race.
translation_verse: B daŋ sa mo ekpa nna fanɛ e kɔ Ebɔrɛ be basa kena m pɔɔ bumo so. B daŋ naŋ sa mo eleŋ yiri kama to ebi so nɛ basa kama to ebi so nɛ ŋgbar kama to ebi so nɛ efuli kama so ebi so nna.

english_verse: The beast was worshiped by everyone whose name wasn't written before the time of creation in the book of the Lamb who was killed.
translation_verse: Basa nɛ b wɔ kasawule ere so kikɛ beeŋ ba maŋ kusɔbɔya na so. Loŋ be basa na e la bekama nɛ b maŋ sibɛ bumo be atre n wɔtɔ Kpakpafɔlbi nɛ b daŋ mɔ durnya be sososo na kikɛ be kawɔl na to na.

english_verse: If you have ears, then listen!
translation_verse: Ekama nɛ e kɔ asoe e nu.

english_verse: If you are doomed to be captured, you will be captured. If you are doomed to be killed by a sword, you will be killed by a sword. This means God's people must learn to endure and be faithful!
translation_verse: Ekama nɛ k dese fanɛ e yɔ kenyaya to, e beeŋ yɔ kenyaya to. Ekama nɛ k dese fanɛ tokobi nɛ baaŋ ta m mɔ mo, tokobi nɛ baaŋ ta m mɔ mo. Kede e naa ŋini fanɛ a daga fanɛ Ebɔrɛ be basa e baa kɔ kanyiti nɛ yirda. Kusɔbɔya nɛ k shi kasawule so n lar na be asheŋ

english_verse: I now saw another beast. This one came out of the ground. It had two horns like a lamb, but spoke like a dragon.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ n naŋ wu kusɔbɔya ko ka shi kasawule so n lar. E daa kɔ alambɛ anyɔ nna fanɛ Kpakpafɔlbi peya, ama mo alɛ daa malga nna fanɛ kusɔ gbeyeso gboŋgboŋi nɛ k du fanɛ laŋchaŋ na nna.

english_verse: It worked for the beast whose fatal wound had been healed. And it used all its authority to force the earth and its people to worship that beast.
translation_verse: E daŋ ta kusɔbɔya juŋkparso na be eleŋ kikɛ nna n wora asheŋ ashi mbe anishito nseŋ shin nɛ kasawule nɛ kumo be basa e maŋ kusɔbɔya juŋkparso nɛ b daŋ chɛ mbe doro mo nɛ k daa beeŋ tiŋ m mɔ mo na so.

english_verse: It worked mighty miracles, and while people watched, it even made fire come down from the sky.
translation_verse: E daŋ wora emamachisheŋ gboŋgboŋi nna hale n shin nɛ edɛ shi ebɔrɛso m ba kasawule nɛ ekama wu amo.

english_verse: This second beast fooled people on earth by working miracles for the first one. Then it talked them into making an idol in the form of the beast that did not die after being wounded by a sword.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal emamachisheŋ mo nɛ b daŋ sa mo eleŋ fanɛ e wora ashi kusɔbɔya juŋkparso na be anishito so, e daŋ fule durnya ere to ebi nna. E daŋ kaŋɛ bumo nɛ b wɔ durnya ere to kikɛ fanɛ b pɔr kaduli nɛ k baa la bunyaŋ a sa kusɔbɔya mo nɛ b daŋ ta tokobi n doro ama nɛ e kraa wɔtɔ na.

english_verse: It was allowed to put breath into the idol, so it could speak. Everyone who refused to worship the idol of the beast was put to death.
translation_verse: B daŋ sa kusɔbɔya nyɔsopo na eleŋ nna fanɛ e fute ŋkpa n wɔtɔ kusɔbɔya juŋkparso na be kaduli to, saŋɛ na so, e beeŋ malga nseŋ shin nɛ b mɔ bekama nɛ b kini kemaŋ mo so na.

english_verse: All people were forced to put a mark on their right hand or forehead. Whether they were powerful or weak, rich or poor, free people or slaves,
translation_verse: Kusɔbɔya na daŋ tintiŋ ekama nna, bewurbi nɛ begboŋi kikɛ, damawuraana nɛ betirpo, anya nɛ bumo nɛ b wɔ bumo be amu fanɛ ekama e nya ndulgi mbe enɔjiso so ŋko mbe kɔsɔto so.

english_verse: they all had to have this mark, or else they could not buy or sell anything. This mark stood for the name of the beast and for the number of its name.
translation_verse: Saŋɛ na so, esa kikɛ maaŋ tiŋ n tɔ shɛŋ ŋko n fa kusɔ ko ama amodoŋwura baa kɔ ndulgi mo nɛ k la kusɔbɔya na be ketre na nna ŋko mbe ketre be lamba nna.

english_verse: You need wisdom to understand the number of the beast! But if you are smart enough, you can figure this out. Its number is
translation_verse: Kede bre la kanyiasheŋ be asheŋ nna. Ekama malɛ nɛ e kɔ nfɛra e pin kusɔbɔya na be lamba na to, ŋkpal manɛ so, k la dimɛdi be lamba nna. Lamba na e la alfa ashe nɛ adeshe nɛ ashe.

english_verse: And a new song was being sung in front of God's throne and in front of the four living creatures and the elders. No one could learn that song, except the
translation_verse: Nɛ b boŋ kashɛ popɔr ashi kuwurputi na be anishito nɛ asɔbɔya keniso ana nɛ bejuŋkparpo na be anishito. Esa kikɛ daa maaŋ tiŋ ŋ koya kashɛ na she basa ŋgboŋ kalfa nɛ ŋgboŋ adena nɛ ŋgboŋ ana mo nɛ b sɔ n yige kasawule so na.

english_verse: All of these are pure virgins, and they follow the Lamb wherever he leads. They have been rescued to be presented to God and the Lamb as the most precious people on earth.
translation_verse: Bumo e la basa nɛ b maŋ di beche n jija bumo be amu na, b daa maŋ nyi beche. Kaplɛkama nɛ Kpakpafɔlbi na bee yɔ, b bɛ mo so nna. B daŋ sɔ bumo ashi edimɛdi to nna n yige n shin nɛ b du fanɛ asɔrso juŋkparso mo nɛ baaŋ ta n lara sarga n sa Ebɔrɛ nɛ Kpakpafɔlbi na.

english_verse: They never tell lies, and they are innocent. The Messages of the Three Angels
translation_verse: Efɛsheŋ kama daa maŋ shi bumo be nnɔ to n lar kikɛ, kulubisheŋ kama daa maŋ do bumo be ekama so. Emalaika asa na be asheŋ

english_verse: I saw another angel. This one was flying across the sky and had the eternal good news to announce to the people of every race, tribe, language, and nation on earth.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ n naŋ wu malaika ko ka wɔ esoso kumu so a firgi nsaa kɔ baru lela nɛ k wɔtɔ mbaanaayɔ na to nɛ e bɔ kumo n sa basa nɛ b wɔ kasawule ere so n sa efuli kama so ebi nɛ yiri kama to ebi nɛ ŋgbar kama to ebi nɛ basa kama to ebi.

english_verse: The angel shouted, “Worship and honor God! The time has come for him to judge everyone. Kneel down before the one who created heaven and earth, the oceans, and every stream.”
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ e kaŋɛ awɔrso fanɛ: “Men baa ŋana Ebɔrɛ nsaa maŋkura mo, ŋkpal manɛ so, mbe demuji be saŋɛ na fo naniere. Men baa maŋ emo nɛ e to ebɔrɛso nɛ kasawule nɛ teku nɛ mbombiana kikɛ na so.”

english_verse: A second angel followed and said, “The great city of Babylon has fallen! This is the city that made all nations drunk and immoral. Now God is angry, and Babylon has fallen.”
translation_verse: Kede be kaman nɛ n naŋ wu malaika nyɔsopo ka ta m bɛ ejuŋkparso na so a kaŋɛ le: “E tɔr, Babilɔn be kade lempo na tɔr. E shin nɛ efuli kikɛ so ebi nuu mbe kesakalealubisheŋ be nsa na.”

english_verse: Finally, a third angel came and shouted: Here is what will happen if you worship the beast and the idol and have the mark of the beast on your hand or forehead.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ malaika sasopo ta m bɛ bumo so a kaŋɛ awɔrso le: “Ekama nɛ e bee maŋ kusɔbɔya na nɛ mbe kaduli na so nseŋ nya mbe ndulgi mbe kɔsɔto so ŋko mbe enɔ so,

english_verse: You will have to drink the wine that God gives to everyone who makes him angry. You will feel his mighty anger, and you will be tortured with fire and burning sulfur, while the holy angels and the Lamb look on.
translation_verse: amodoŋwura beeŋ nuu Ebɔrɛ be agboso be nsa nɛ b maŋ ta shɛŋ n cha amo to na nseŋ duga amo n wɔtɔ Ebɔrɛ be agbo be kawiebi to na gba. Baaŋ ta edɛ nɛ jɛrbi n wɔtɔ mo ebesa to, emalaika cheembiana na nɛ Kpakpafɔlbi na be anishito.

english_verse: If you worship the beast and the idol and accept the mark of its name, you will be tortured day and night. The smoke from your torture will go up forever and ever, and you will never be able to rest.
translation_verse: Edɛ mo nɛ a bee sa bumo ebesa na be edishi baa wɔtɔ nna mbaanaayɔ. Kapa nɛ kanyɛ bumo nɛ baa maŋ kusɔbɔya na nɛ mbe kaduli na so ŋko ekama nɛ e nya mbe ketre be lamba na daa maa kɔ ewushi kikɛ.”

english_verse: Then I heard a voice from heaven say, “Put this in writing. From now on, the Lord will bless everyone who has faith in him when they die.” The Spirit answered, “Yes, they will rest from their hard work, and they will be rewarded for what they have done.” The Earth Is Harvested
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ n nu ebɔl ka shi ebɔrɛso ŋ kaŋɛ ma le: “Sibɛ le n nase: Kagbenefuli la bekama nɛ b wɔ Enyɛnpe to nseŋ wu naniere mbaanaayɔ na peya nna.” Nɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na kaŋɛ: “Kashenteŋto, baaŋ wushi ashi bumo be kegben ere to, ŋkpal manɛ so, bumo be aworbi beeŋ ba bɛ bumo so n yɔ.” Kasawule be kasɔteŋi na be asheŋ

english_verse: I looked and saw a bright cloud, and someone who seemed to be the Son of Man was sitting on the cloud. He wore a gold crown on his head and held a sharp sickle in his hand.
translation_verse: Ŋ ka naŋ keni nɛ n wu kuwɔlpa fuful ko nɛ esa ko malɛ du fanɛ nyiŋgbasa pibinyɛn na ka tase ndoŋ a kɔ shuwa be kuwurwuro mbe kumu so nɛ loji jiso ko malɛ wɔ mbe enɔ to.

english_verse: Another angel with a sharp sickle then came out of the temple in heaven.
translation_verse: Nɛ malaika ko malɛ ba shi ebɔrɛso be bɔrɛlambu na to n lar, mo alɛ gba a kɔ loji jiso to.

english_verse: After this, an angel with power over fire came from the altar and shouted to the angel who had the sickle. He said, “All grapes on earth are ripe! Harvest them with your sharp sickle.”
translation_verse: Bede malɛ kikɛ be kaman nɛ malaika ko malɛ nɛ e daa kɔ edɛ be eleŋ shi bɔrɛsure na akpa m ba tre emo nɛ e daa kɔ loji jiso na to na awɔrso ŋ kaŋɛ mo le: “Ta fo loji jiso na ŋ ku kasawule so be waindibi be asɔrso na, ŋkpal manɛ so, asɔrso na bel.”

english_verse: The angel swung his sickle on earth and cut off its grapes. He threw them into a pit where they were trampled on as a sign of God's anger.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ malaika na fili mbe loji na to m ba kasawule so n chala kumo be waindibi be asɔrso na nseŋ ta amo ŋ kpa n wɔtɔ Ebɔrɛ be agbo be kusɔ nyaŋasɔrso na to.

english_verse: After this, I looked at the sky and saw something else that was strange and important. Seven angels were bringing the seven last terrible troubles. When these are ended, God will no longer be angry.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ n naŋ wu alemaŋkar be kesheŋ ko awɔlpa so. K daa la mamachi be kesheŋ gboŋ ko nna. Emalaika ashunu nɛ etɔrɔ ashunu mo nɛ a daa la lalaloge be etɔrɔ na e daa la, ŋkpal manɛ so, amo be kaman nɛ Ebɔrɛ be agbo bee wushi.

english_verse: Then I saw something that looked like a glass sea mixed with fire, and people were standing on it. They were the ones who had defeated the beast and the idol and the number that tells the name of the beast. God had given them harps,
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ n wu kusɔ ko ka du fanɛ digi nɛ edɛ be weato a dese fanɛ teku nɛ basa nɛ b daŋ kɔ kusɔbɔya na nɛ mbe kaduli na nɛ mbe ketre be lamba na m pɔɔ so na yil m mata teku na. B daa yil nna a kɔ ejaŋjilaŋ ko nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ ta n sa bumo na to.

english_verse: and they were singing the song his servant Moses and the Lamb had sung. They were singing, “Lord God All-Powerful, you have done great and marvelous things. You are the ruler of all nations, and you do what is right and fair.
translation_verse: B daa yil nna a kɔ amo a boŋ anebi Mosis, Ebɔrɛ be kenya na be kashɛ nɛ Kpakpafɔlbi na be kashɛ a kaŋɛ: “Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ, Enyɛnpe fo asheŋ woraso kɔ mamachi pasaa! Fo nɛ fo la efuli kama be Ewura na, fo ekpa niŋi nsaa kɔ kashenteŋ amo to pasaa!

english_verse: Lord, who doesn't honor and praise your name? You alone are holy, and all nations will come and worship you, because you have shown that you judge with fairness.”
translation_verse: O, Enyɛnpe, wanɛ e wɔtɔ ŋkaa maaŋ ŋana fo nsaa maaŋ sa fo ketre na kemaŋkura? Ŋkpal manɛ so, fo nawule e du cheembi. Efuli kama so ebi malɛ kikɛ beeŋ ba kachako m ba maŋ fo so, ŋkpal manɛ so, fo demuji niŋisoana na lar efuli.”

english_verse: After this, I noticed something else in heaven. The sacred tent used for a temple was open.
translation_verse: Kede be kaman nɛ ŋ keni n wu shɛda be wajɛbu na be bɔrɛlambu ka bugi a yil ebɔrɛso.

english_verse: And the seven angels who were bringing the terrible troubles were coming out of it. They were dressed in robes of pure white linen and wore belts made of pure gold.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ emalaika ashunu ko nɛ etɔrɔ ashunu ko shi bɔrɛlambu na to n lar. B daŋ buu m buu asɔbuuso lela nna nɛ a walɛ so n fuli le parrbi nseŋ ta shuwa be kreso peŋgeleŋ peŋgelembi ko ŋ kre bumo be ntetoana so.

english_verse: One of the four living creatures gave each of the seven angels a bowl made of gold. These bowls were filled with the anger of God who lives forever and ever.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ asɔbɔya keniso ana na be eko ta shuwa be ntishaŋ ashunu mo nɛ Ebɔrɛ mo nɛ e wɔ ŋkpa to mbaanaayɔ na be agbo daŋ bɔlɔ m bɔlɔ amo na n sa emalaika ashunu na.

english_verse: The temple quickly filled with smoke from the glory and power of God. No one could enter it until the seven angels had finished pouring out the seven last troubles.
translation_verse: Ade be kaman nɛ edishi shi Ebɔrɛ be kemaŋkura to nɛ mbe eleŋ to n sɔ bɔrɛlambu na kikɛ to nɛ esa kikɛ malɛ daa maŋ tiŋ n luri bɔrɛlambu na to hale nɛ emalaika ashunu na be etɔrɔ ashunu na ya loge.

english_verse: From the temple I heard a voice shout to the seven angels, “Go and empty the seven bowls of God's anger on the earth.”
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ n nu ebɔl ko ka shi ebɔrɛso be bɔrɛlambu na to m ba malga awɔrso a kaŋɛ a kaŋɛ emalaika ashunu na le: “Men ya chulgi Ebɔrɛ be agbo nɛ k bɔlɔ ntishaŋ ashunu na to n wurge kasawule so.”

english_verse: The first angel emptied his bowl on the earth. At once ugly and painful sores broke out on everyone who had the mark of the beast and worshiped the idol.
translation_verse: Nɛ malaika juŋkparso na ta mbe katishaŋ nɛ agbo na n chulgi n wurge kasawule so nɛ achuu lubi besaso ko ba basa nɛ b kɔ kusɔbɔya na be ndulgi nɛ bumo nɛ b maŋ kumo be kaduli so na so.

english_verse: The second angel emptied his bowl on the sea. At once the sea turned into blood like that of a dead person, and every living thing in the sea died.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ malaika nyɔsopo na ta mbe katishaŋ nɛ agbo na n chulgi n wurge teku so nɛ nchu na ki fanɛ dimɛdi mo nɛ e wu be ŋklaŋ nɛ kusɔ keniso kama nɛ k daa wɔ teku na to na wu.

english_verse: The third angel emptied his bowl into the rivers and streams. At once they turned to blood.
translation_verse: Malaika nyɔsopo na be kaman nɛ esasopo na malɛ ta mbe katishaŋ nɛ agbo na n chulgi n wurge elɔrana nɛ mbombiana so nɛ a kilgi ŋklaŋ.

english_verse: Then I heard the angel, who has power over water, say, “You have always been, and you always will be the holy God. You had the right to judge in this way.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ n nu malaika mo nɛ e daa kɔ nchuana na be eleŋ na ka kaŋɛ le: “Fo nɛ fo daa wɔtɔ nseŋ kraa wɔtɔ na, wora asheŋ m bɔla ekpa ashi le be demuji ere to.

english_verse: They poured out the blood of your people and your prophets. So you gave them blood to drink as they deserve!”
translation_verse: Ŋkpal b ka mɔ fo basa laraso nɛ anebiana n lara bumo be ŋklaŋ so, fo alɛ gba ta ŋklaŋ n sa bumo nɛ b nuu. Kusɔ nɛ k baŋ daga bumo nna na.”

english_verse: After this, I heard the altar shout, “Yes, Lord God All-Powerful, your judgments are honest and fair.”
translation_verse: Nɛ n nu ebɔl ka shi bɔrɛsure na akpa ŋ kaŋɛ: “Enyɛnpetale Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, fo demuji kɔ kashenteŋ nseŋ niŋi pasaa.”

english_verse: The fourth angel emptied his bowl on the sun, and it began to scorch people like fire.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ malaika nasopo na ta mbe katishaŋ nɛ agbo na n chulgi n wurge epeŋi so nɛ k nya eleŋ n chɔɔ basa fanɛ edɛ.

english_verse: Everyone was scorched by its great heat, and all of them cursed the name of God who had power over these terrible troubles. But no one turned to God and praised him.
translation_verse: Edɛ damta na daŋ chɔɔ basa ga nɛ b malga ŋ gbiti Ebɔrɛ mo nɛ e kɔ etɔrɔ na be eleŋ na be ketre nseŋ kini kelar bumo be alubi to m maŋkura mo.

english_verse: The fifth angel emptied his bowl on the throne of the beast. At once darkness covered its kingdom, and its people began biting their tongues in pain.
translation_verse: Malaika nasopo na be kaman nɛ enusopo na malɛ ta mbe katishaŋ nɛ agbo na n chulgi n wurge kusɔbɔya na be kuwurputi so, nɛ mbe kakpa nɛ e bee ji kuwura kikɛ ki tentembiri gbrum nɛ basa duŋ bumo be adonduloŋ ebesa so ga

english_verse: And because of their painful sores, they cursed the God who rules in heaven. But still they did not stop doing evil things.
translation_verse: nseŋ malga ŋ gbiti Ebɔrɛ nɛ e wɔ ebɔrɛso na. B daŋ wora loŋ nna ŋkpal bumo be ebesa na nɛ bumo be achuuana na so so, ama b daŋ kini kelar bumo be alubi mo nɛ b daŋ wora na bre to.

english_verse: The sixth angel emptied his bowl on the great Euphrates River, and it completely dried up to make a road for the kings from the east.
translation_verse: Nɛ malaika shesopo na malɛ ta mbe katishaŋ nɛ agbo na n chulgi n wurge lɔrgboŋ nɛ baa tre Yufreetes na so nɛ kumo be nchu kikɛ feeto nɛ k wɔl n lɔŋɛ ekpa a dese a jo bewura mo nɛ b shi bɔrɛfito na.

english_verse: An evil spirit that looked like a frog came out of the mouth of the dragon. One also came out of the mouth of the beast, and another out of the mouth of the false prophet.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ n wu ayoyu lubi asa ko ka du fanɛ etaŋgbaga n shi kusɔ gbeyeso na nɛ kusɔbɔya juŋkparso na nɛ anebi fɛpo na be nnɔ to n lar.

english_verse: These evil spirits had the power to work miracles. They went to every king on earth, to bring them together for a war against God All-Powerful. But that will be the day of God's great victory.
translation_verse: A la mbuibi lubiana be ayoyu nna a wora emamachisheŋ a yɔ durnya ere kikɛ be bewura kutɔ n ya kaa chala bumo a jo Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ be kachɛgboŋ be kena na.

english_verse: Remember Christ says, “When I come, it will surprise you like a thief! But God will bless you, if you are awake and ready. Then you won't have to walk around naked and be ashamed.”
translation_verse: “Men nu nfe, meeŋ ba menyi to fanɛ eyu. Kagbenefuli baa la ekama nɛ e maa di, mo alɛ nsaa kɔ mbe asɔbuuso to na peya nna, saŋɛ na so, e maaŋ delge so n nite nɛ anishinyɔr e pɛ mo.”

english_verse: Those armies came together in a place that in Hebrew is called Armagedon.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ ayoyu na bar bewura abar so ashi kakpa nɛ Hibruwebi bee tre Aamagɛdɔn na.

english_verse: As soon as the seventh angel emptied his bowl in the air, a loud voice from the throne in the temple shouted, “It's done!”
translation_verse: Nɛ malaika shunusopo na ta mbe katishaŋ nɛ agbo na n chulgi n wurge esoso nɛ ebɔl ko shi bɔrɛlambu na to awɔrso ŋ kaŋɛ: “Asheŋ na wora.”

english_verse: The great city of Babylon split into three parts, and the cities of other nations fell. So God made Babylon drink from the wine cup filled with his anger.
translation_verse: Nɛ kadegboŋ na barga to ntuŋ nsa so nɛ durnya to be ndegboŋ kama mur. Nɛ Ebɔrɛ nyiŋi Babilɔn lempo nseŋ ta katishaŋ mo nɛ k bɔlɔ mbe agbo damta be nsa na n sa fanɛ e nuu.

english_verse: Every island ran away, and the mountains disappeared.
translation_verse: Esa daa maŋ naa wu kebeegboŋ kama, nɛ kepla kama malɛ daŋ foe.

english_verse: One of the seven angels who had emptied the bowls came over and said to me, “Come on! I will show you how God will punish that shameless prostitute who sits on many oceans.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ emalaika ashunu mo nɛ b daa kɔ ntishaŋ ashunu na be eko ba ŋ kutɔ m ba kaŋɛ ma: “Ba nɛ ŋ ŋini fo kananɛ baaŋ gberge sakalechegboŋ na kusoe. Mo e chena nchu damtaana so na.

english_verse: Every king on earth has slept with her, and her shameless ways are like wine that has made everyone on earth drunk.”
translation_verse: Kasawule ere so be bewurgboŋ nɛ sakalechegboŋ na ji abar kesakalea so nɛ durnya ere to be basa malɛ nuu mbe kesakalea be nsa m boo.”

english_verse: With the help of the Spirit, the angel took me into a desert, where I saw a woman sitting on a red beast. The beast was covered with names that were an insult to God, and it had seven heads and ten horns.
translation_verse: Kede be kaman nɛ malaika na keta ma kiyoyu to n yɔ kiyi to, ndoŋ nɛ n ya wu kache ko nɛ e tase kusɔbɔya peper ko so nɛ b sibɛ kabɔrɛtegeso be atre n deŋi kusɔbɔya na kikɛ so. Kusɔbɔya na daa kɔ amu ashunu nɛ alambɛ kudu nna.

english_verse: The woman was dressed in purple and scarlet robes, and she wore jewelry made of gold, precious stones, and pearls. In her hand she held a gold cup filled with the filthy and nasty things she had done.
translation_verse: Kache na daŋ buu jilmaso be wajɛ peper kunɔkunɔ nɛ wajɛ peper soo nna nɛ shuwa nɛ ajembubi lela nɛ amo be yawu du kpakpa na nɛ abitasɔ kikɛ wɔ mo so a nyɛkpɛ palpal. E daa kɔ shuwa be kawiebi mo nɛ k bɔlɔ alemaŋkar be alubi be asɔ nɛ kesakalea be eyurpi to nna.

english_verse: On her forehead a mysterious name was written: I AM THE GREAT CITY OF BABYLON, THE MOTHER OF EVERY IMMORAL AND FILTHY THING ON EARTH.
translation_verse: Le be wulo be ketre ere nɛ b daŋ sibɛ n deŋi mbe kasɔto so: “Babilɔn lempo, kesakaleajipoana bumo nio nɛ emo nɛ kasawule so be alemaŋkar be alubi kikɛ shi mo kutɔ.”

english_verse: I could tell that the woman was drunk on the blood of God's people who had given their lives for Jesus. This surprising sight amazed me,
translation_verse: N daŋ wu fanɛ kache na daŋ nuu Ebɔrɛ be basa laraso be ŋklaŋ nɛ bumo nɛ b daŋ ji Yesu be shɛda na be ŋklaŋ nna m boo. Ŋ ka wu mo nɛ k wora ma kanaŋ ko ga.

english_verse: and the angel said: Why are you so amazed? I will explain the mystery about this woman and about the beast she is sitting on, with its seven heads and ten horns.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ malaika na kaŋɛ ma: “Manɛ e ba nɛ kesheŋ ere wora fo kanaŋ ko loŋ? Meeŋ bugi kache na nɛ kusɔbɔya nɛ e bee dii nɛ e kɔ amu ashunu nɛ alambɛ kudu na be wulo be kesheŋ na to ŋ ŋini fo.

english_verse: The beast you saw is one that used to be and no longer is. It will come back from the deep pit, but only to be destroyed. Everyone on earth whose names were not written in the book of life before the time of creation will be amazed. They will see this beast that used to be and no longer is, but will be once more.
translation_verse: Kusɔbɔya mo nɛ fo wu na daa wɔ ŋkpa to nna, ama naniere e maŋ naa wɔ ŋkpa to. A ka gbrɛbi nɛ e shi kemaŋ nɛ baa tre Abis na to n lar nɛ b mur mo. Basa nɛ b wɔ durnya ere to nɛ b maŋ sibɛ bumo be atre n wɔtɔ ŋkpa be kawɔl na to saŋɛ nɛ durnya ere fara kikɛ na kaŋ wu kusɔbɔya na, bumo be nnɔ beeŋ mɔ bumo, ŋkpal manɛ so, e daa wɔ ŋkpa to nna, ama naniere e maŋ naa wɔtɔ, ama mo alɛ kraa beeŋ naŋ ba.

english_verse: Anyone with wisdom can figure this out. The seven heads that the woman is sitting on stand for seven hills. These heads are also seven kings.
translation_verse: Kede bre la kagbene mo nɛ k kɔ kanyiasheŋ be demu nna. Amu ashunu na la abeebi ashunu mo nɛ kache na tase so nna, nɛ amo alɛ la bewurgboŋ ashunu.

english_verse: Five of the kings are dead. One is ruling now, and the other one has not yet come. But when he does, he will rule for only a little while.
translation_verse: Bumo be benu maŋ naa wɔtɔ nɛ ekoŋwule kraa wɔtɔ nɛ a ka ekoŋwule nɛ e lar. Mo alɛ kaŋ ba, a daga fanɛ e chena gbrɛbi.

english_verse: You also saw a beast that used to be and no longer is. That beast is one of the seven kings who will return as the eighth king, but only to be destroyed.
translation_verse: Kusɔbɔya mo nɛ e daa wɔ ŋkpa to ŋkaa maŋ naa wɔtɔ na e la ewura burwasopo. E la beshunu mo nɛ b fara m ba na to be eko nna a yɔ nɛ e ya mur.

english_verse: The ten horns you saw are ten more kings, who have not yet come into power, and they will rule with the beast for only a short time.
translation_verse: Alambɛ kudu mo nɛ fo wu na la bewurgboŋ kudu ko nna nɛ b maŋ naŋ fara a ji kuwura, ama baaŋ nya ekpa n tu kusɔbɔya na n ji kuwura awa koŋwule.

english_verse: They all think alike and will give their power and authority to the beast.
translation_verse: Bumo basa kudu na kikɛ kɔ nfɛra koŋwule nna a kɔ bumo be eleŋ nɛ ekpa nɛ b kɔ kikɛ a sa kusɔbɔya na.

english_verse: These kings will go to war against the Lamb. But he will defeat them, because he is Lord over all lords and King over all kings. His followers are chosen and special and faithful.
translation_verse: Baaŋ kɔ Kpakpafɔlbi na kena, ama Kpakpafɔlbi na beeŋ pɔɔ bumo so, mo e la benyɛnpe to be Enyɛnpe nɛ bewura to be Ewura na. Saŋɛ na so, mo nɛ mbe basa treso nɛ bumo koŋwule na la basa laraso nseŋ naa la mbe bebɛsopo mo nɛ b maa lar mo kaman na beeŋ baa wɔtɔ.”

english_verse: The ten horns and the beast will start hating the shameless woman. They will strip off her clothes and leave her naked. Then they will eat her flesh and throw the rest of her body into a fire.
translation_verse: Kusɔbɔya na nɛ alambɛ kudu mo nɛ fo wu na beeŋ kishi sakaleche na. Baaŋ sɔ kusɔ kama nɛ e kɔ ŋ ka mo eyurkpaŋ n yili. Baaŋ we mo nseŋ ta edɛ m mur mo.

english_verse: God is the one who made these kings all think alike and decide to give their power to the beast. And they will do this until what God has said comes true.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ ta kusɔ nɛ e bee sha nɛ k wora na n wɔtɔ bumo be ŋgbene to nɛ baa sha kewora loŋ. Bumo kikɛ beeŋ nya kɔnɔkoŋwule n ta bumo be eleŋ n sa kusɔbɔya na nɛ e ji kuwura loŋ hale nɛ Ebɔrɛ be kɔnɔ e ya bɔla.

english_verse: The woman you saw is the great city that rules over all kings on earth.
translation_verse: Kache mo nɛ fo wu na e la kadegboŋ mo nɛ k bee ji kuwura kasawule so be bewura so na.”

english_verse: I saw another angel come from heaven. This one had great power, and the earth was bright because of his glory.
translation_verse: Kede be kaman nɛ n wu malaika ko ka shi ebɔrɛso a ba. E daa kɔ eleŋ ga nɛ mbe kananɛ e bee kpa edɛ na malɛ daŋ fuli to n sɔ kasawule so be kaplɛkama.

english_verse: The angel shouted, “Fallen! Powerful Babylon has fallen and is now the home of demons. It is the den of every filthy spirit and of all unclean birds, and every dirty and hated animal.
translation_verse: E ka bee ba na nɛ e ponte eleŋso ŋ kaŋɛ: “K tɔr, Babilɔn be kade lempo tɔr! Babilɔn ki alizinaana be kowu nɛ ayoyu lubiana kikɛ be eŋanakpa nɛ mbuibi jiga mo nɛ basa kishi kikɛ be eŋanakpa.

english_verse: Babylon's evil and immoral wine has made all nations drunk. Every king on earth has slept with her, and every merchant on earth is rich because of her evil desires.”
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, efuli kama so ebi nuu mbe kesakalealubisheŋ be nsa na. Kasawule ere so be bewurgboŋ tu mo n ji kesakalea nɛ durnya to be yawujipoana na malɛ bɔla mbe dama be kebaawɔtɔ to n dii dama.”

english_verse: Then I heard another voice from heaven shout, “My people, you must escape from Babylon. Don't take part in her sins and share her punishment.
translation_verse: N daŋ naŋ nu ebɔl ko ka shi ebɔrɛso ŋ kaŋɛ: “Ma basa, men lar mbe asheŋ to, saŋɛ na so men maaŋ tu mo n luri mbe alubi na to, saŋɛ na so men maaŋ nya mbe etɔrɔ na be kekama.

english_verse: Her sins are piled as high as heaven. God has remembered the evil she has done.
translation_verse: Ŋkpal manɛ so, mbe alubi dii n deŋi abar so nna n ya fo ebɔrɛso nɛ Ebɔrɛ malɛ bee nyiŋi mbe alubi na kikɛ.

english_verse: Treat her as she has treated others. Make her pay double for what she has done. Make her drink twice as much of what she mixed for others.
translation_verse: Men wora mo kananɛ e wora menyi na gbagba chap. Men laŋɛ kusɔ kama nɛ e wora menyi na ŋ ka mo loŋ be ale anyɔ. Men shin nɛ mbe kawiebi nɛ e ta n wora nsa n sa menyi na e bɔlɔ a kɔ eleŋ ale anyɔ a chɔ amo nɛ e sa menyi na.

english_verse: That woman honored herself with a life of luxury. Reward her now with suffering and pain. “Deep in her heart Babylon said, ‘I am the queen! Never will I be a widow or know what it means to be sad.’
translation_verse: Men sa mo tɔrɔ nɛ kagbenejija ga nɛ a fo fanɛ kananɛ e daŋ sa mbe kumu kemaŋkura nɛ dama na, ŋkpal manɛ so, le nɛ e wɔtɔ a kaŋɛ mbe kumu: ‘Ewurche e la ma nɛ n tase. M maŋ la ekulpoche, kagbenejija maaŋ tu ma kikɛ.’

english_verse: And so, in a single day she will suffer the pain of sorrow, hunger, and death. Fire will destroy her dead body, because her judge is the powerful Lord God.”
translation_verse: Ŋkpal loŋ so, mbe etɔrɔ kikɛ beeŋ tu mo kachɛ koŋwule. A beeŋ baa la luwu nɛ kushu nɛ akoŋ. Edɛ beeŋ ji mo, ŋkpal manɛ so, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ e bee ji mo demu na la elempo nna.”

english_verse: Every king on earth who slept with her and shared in her luxury will mourn. They will weep, when they see the smoke from that fire.
translation_verse: Kasawule so be bewura mo nɛ b ji kesakalea nseŋ naŋ tu mo n ji mbe dama na kaŋ wu edɛ mo nɛ a bee chɔɔ mo na be edishi, baaŋ boŋ to n shu anishichubi ŋkpal mo so.

english_verse: Her sufferings will frighten them, and they will stand at a distance and say, “Pity that great and powerful city! Pity Babylon! In a single hour her judgment has come.”
translation_verse: Ebesa mo nɛ e beeŋ ji na be asheŋ beeŋ pɛ bumo kufu nɛ b yili kufɔ nseŋ kaŋɛ: “O fo, kadegboŋ ere, asheŋ nya fo, asheŋ nya fo. O Babilɔn, eleŋ be kadegboŋ, awa koŋwule nawule to nɛ fo ta n nya fo kasogberge na.”

english_verse: Every merchant on earth will mourn, because there is no one to buy their goods.
translation_verse: Kasawule so be yawujipoana malɛ gba beeŋ boŋ to nseŋ shu ŋkpal mo so, ŋkpal esa kikɛ ka maaŋ naŋ tɔ bumo be asɔ so.

english_verse: Babylon, the things your heart desired have all escaped from you. Every luxury and all your glory will be lost forever. You will never get them back.
translation_verse: Baaŋ kaŋɛ mo le: “Asɔ lela mo nɛ fo daŋ ta fo kagbene n wɔtɔ fanɛ fo nya na kikɛ choŋ nna na. Fo dama nɛ fo kemaŋkura na kikɛ foe, esa kama malɛ maaŋ naŋ wu asɔ na kikɛ.”

english_verse: The merchants had become rich because of her. But when they saw her sufferings, they were terrified. They stood at a distance, crying and mourning.
translation_verse: Eyawujipoana nɛ b fa asɔ na m bɔla fo so n ji yawu n dii dama na beeŋ ŋana mbe tɔrɔ na nseŋ yili kufɔ m boŋ to n shu anishichubi.

english_verse: Yet in a single hour her riches disappeared.” Every ship captain and passenger and sailor stood at a distance, together with everyone who does business by traveling on the sea.
translation_verse: Ekuloŋgboŋ be katɛrɛ nimuso kikɛ nɛ bekama nɛ b wɔ ekuloŋgboŋ to a nite teku so, befarpoana na kikɛ nɛ bekama nyam nɛ baa bɔla nchu so a ji na kikɛ beeŋ yili kufɔ

english_verse: When they saw the smoke from her fire, they shouted, “This was the greatest city ever!”
translation_verse: n shu awɔrso ŋkpal b ka wu edɛ mo nɛ a bee chɔɔ mo na be edishi so ŋ kaŋɛ: “Cha, kade mo malɛ e daŋ naŋ fo kadegboŋ ere so?”

english_verse: They cried loudly, and in their sorrow they threw dust on their heads, as they said, “Pity the great city of Babylon! Everyone who sailed the seas became rich from her treasures. But in a single hour the city was destroyed.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ b ta shishɛr n wurge bumo be amuana so ŋkeŋ boŋ to n shu anishichubi ŋ kaŋɛ: “O kadegboŋ, asheŋ nya fo, asheŋ nya fo. Kadegboŋ ere to nɛ bekama nɛ b kɔ ekuloŋgboŋana a shuŋ tekuana so na bɔla mbe dama so n dii dama, ŋkeshin nɛ awa koŋwule to nɛ e mur kuraa!

english_verse: A powerful angel then picked up a huge stone and threw it into the sea. The angel said, “This is how the great city of Babylon will be thrown down, never to rise again.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ malaika lempo ko maŋ kejembu ko so, kumo nɛ kuboogboŋ sasa n ta kumo ŋ kpa n wɔtɔ teku to nseŋ kaŋɛ: “Loŋ nɛ baaŋ ta Babilɔn be kadegboŋ n lɛ kasawule so eleŋso nɛ ekama maaŋ naŋ wu kumo kikɛ.

english_verse: The music of harps and singers and of flutes and trumpets will no longer be heard. No workers will ever set up shop in that city, and the sound of grinding grain will be silenced forever.
translation_verse: Esa maaŋ naŋ nu ejaŋjilaŋlampoana be asheŋ ŋko nshɛbompoana be asheŋ ŋko nlopifompoana be asheŋ ŋko mbelfompoana be asheŋ fo to kikɛ. Esa maaŋ naŋ wu basa nɛ baa shuŋ a ji yawu kama fo to. Esa malɛ maŋ naŋ nu kubo kikɛ be egbri fo to.

english_verse: Lamps will no longer shine anywhere in Babylon, and couples will never again say wedding vows there. Her merchants ruled the earth, and by her witchcraft she fooled all nations.
translation_verse: Esa maaŋ naŋ wu fitila be kefulto fo to kikɛ ŋko n naŋ nu kejafɔ bumo kulana nɛ kejafɔana be ebɔlana ashi fo to. Fo yawujipoana e daa la durnya ere to kikɛ be bejuŋkparpo, fo alɛ be ŋkilgi e daŋ shin nɛ durnya kikɛ foe ekpa.”

english_verse: On the streets of Babylon is found the blood of God's people and of his prophets, and everyone else.”
translation_verse: Mo, Babilɔn na to nɛ b daŋ wu anebiana nɛ Ebɔrɛ be basa laraso nɛ bekama nyam nɛ b daŋ mɔ kasawule ere so na be ŋklaŋ.

english_verse: After this, I heard what sounded like a lot of voices in heaven, and they were shouting, “Praise the Lord! To our God belongs the glorious power to save,
translation_verse: Ade be kaman nɛ n nu kusɔ ko fanɛ jimaŋ damta ko be ebɔlana ka shi ebɔrɛso a boŋ to awɔrso a kaŋɛ le: “Halleluya. Kumɔlga nɛ kemaŋkura nɛ eleŋ la an be Ebɔrɛ na peya nna.

english_verse: because his judgments are honest and fair. That filthy prostitute ruined the earth with shameful deeds. But God has judged her and made her pay the price for murdering his servants.”
translation_verse: Mo alɛ be demuji kɔ kashenteŋ nna nseŋ niŋi. E gberge sakalechegboŋ mo nɛ e ta mbe kesakaleasheŋ n jija kasawule ere na kusoe. E bishi mo kuwule ŋkpal mbe anya be ŋklaŋ so.”

english_verse: Then the crowd shouted, “Praise the Lord! Smoke will never stop rising from her burning body.”
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ basa na naŋ boŋ to ŋ kaŋɛ: “Halleluya. Edishi mo nɛ a bee shi mo to a lar na bee dii nna mbaanaayɔ.”

english_verse: From the throne a voice said, “If you worship and fear our God, give praise to him, no matter who you are.”
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ ebɔl shi kuwurputi na akpa ŋ kaŋɛ: “Menyi nɛ men la mbe anya na, men di an be Ebɔrɛ na epaŋ, menyi nɛ men ŋana mo na kikɛ, bewurbi nɛ begboŋi kikɛ, men di mo epaŋ.”

english_verse: Then I heard what seemed to be a large crowd that sounded like a roaring flood and loud thunder all mixed together. They were saying, “Praise the Lord! Our Lord God All-Powerful now rules as king.
translation_verse: Mmalga ere be kaman nɛ n nu kusɔ ko ka gbri fanɛ jimaŋ damta ka wora awɔr na. Awɔr na daŋ naa gbri fanɛ nchu damta ka bee shile nna nseŋ daŋ naa gbri fanɛ bɔrɛ ka bee ponte to a boŋ to a kaŋɛ le: “Halleluya. Ŋkpal manɛ so, an Nyɛnpetale Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e wɔ kuwura a ji.

english_verse: So we will be glad and happy and give him praise. The wedding day of the Lamb is here, and his bride is ready.
translation_verse: Men shin nɛ anyi be ŋgbene e fuli anyi n dese nɛ an sa mo kemaŋkura. Ŋkpal manɛ so, Kpakpafɔlbi be kejafɔachɛ na fo nɛ mbe kejafɔ malɛ gba bela ase n loge.

english_verse: She will be given a wedding dress made of pure and shining linen. This linen stands for the good things God's people have done.”
translation_verse: E nya wajɛ fuful lela nyɛkpɛso nɛ k walɛ so nɛ e buu. Kusɔbuuso lela na e naa yili fanɛ Ebɔrɛ be basa laraso be alelasheŋ be aworbi.”

english_verse: Then the angel told me, “Put this in writing. God will bless everyone who is invited to the wedding feast of the Lamb.” The angel also said, “These things God has said are true.”
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ malaika na kaŋɛ ma le: “Sibɛ n nase fanɛ: Kagbenefuli la bumo nɛ b tre fanɛ b ba Kpakpafɔlbi na be kejafɔ be kejigboŋ to na.” Kumo be kaman nɛ e kaŋɛ le n ti so: “Ade la Ebɔrɛ be kashenteŋ be mmalga nna.”

english_verse: I knelt at the feet of the angel and began to worship him. But the angel said, “Don't do that! I am a servant, just like you and everyone else who tells about Jesus. Don't worship anyone but God. Everyone who tells about Jesus does it by the power of the Spirit.” The Rider on the White Horse
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ ŋ gbir n dese kasawule mbe anishito nɛ m maŋ mo so nɛ e kaŋɛ ma: “A maŋ daga fanɛ fo wora loŋ, ŋkpal manɛ so, n la fo barkasa kenya nna fanɛ fo nɛ fo niopibiana nɛ b bɛ Yesu be shɛda be ekpa so na, Ebɔrɛ e daga fanɛ fo baa maŋ mo so.” Ŋkpal manɛ so, kashenteŋ mo nɛ Yesu lara ŋ ŋini na e la Kiyoyu mo nɛ e bee leŋ anebiana na to. Gbaŋɛ fuful be ediipo na be asheŋ

english_verse: I looked and saw heaven was open, and a white horse was there. Its rider was called Faithful and True, and he is always fair when he judges or goes to war.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ n wu ebɔrɛso ka bugi nɛ gbaŋɛ fuful yil. Kumo be ediipo be ketre e la Kebaayɛawora nɛ Kashenteŋ. Ekpa niŋiso nɛ e bee bɔla a ji demu nsaa kɔ kumo a kɔ kena.

english_verse: He had eyes like flames of fire, and he was wearing a lot of crowns. His name was written on him, but he was the only one who knew what the name meant.
translation_verse: Mbe anishi daa du fanɛ edɛ nɛ a bee suse nna wuloŋwuloŋ nɛ nwurwuro damta malɛ wɔ mbe kumu so. B daŋ sibɛ ketre ko nna n deŋi mo so nɛ mo nawule kpeŋ nyi kumo.

english_verse: The rider wore a robe that was covered with blood, and he was known as “The Word of God.”
translation_verse: Mbe kusɔbuuso naŋ nyɔɔ ŋklaŋ nna nɛ mbe ketre daa la Ebɔrɛ be Kamalga.

english_verse: He was followed by armies from heaven that rode on white horses and were dressed in pure white linen.
translation_verse: Ebɔrɛso be benapo daŋ buu wajɛ fuful lela nɛ a walɛ so n fuli parr nna n dii egbaŋɛ fuful m bɛ mo so.

english_verse: From his mouth a sharp sword went out to attack the nations. He will rule them with an iron rod and will show the fierce anger of God All-Powerful by trampling the grapes in the pit where wine is made.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ tokobi jiso ko mo nɛ e beeŋ ta ŋ ŋe efuliana so ebi n nase lar mbe kɔnɔ to. E beeŋ ta kagbene kpakpaso n ji kuwura bumo so. Mo gbagba e naaŋ nyaŋ asɔ nɛ a wɔ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ be agbo be kusɔ nyaŋasɔrso na to.

english_verse: On the part of the robe that covered his thigh was written, “KING OF KINGS AND Lord OF LordS.”
translation_verse: Ketre mo nɛ k daa deŋ mbe piŋi nɛ mbe kebembi so e la: “BEWURA TO BE EWURA NƐ BENYƐNPE TO BE ENYƐNPE.”

english_verse: I then saw an angel standing on the sun, and he shouted to all the birds flying in the sky, “Come and join in God's great feast!
translation_verse: Nɛ n wu malaika ko ka yil epeŋi so nseŋ malga awɔrso ŋ kaŋɛ mbuibi nɛ a bee firgi kumu so na kikɛ le: “Men ba. Men shɛr Ebɔrɛ be kejigboŋ na ase

english_verse: I also saw the beast and all kings of the earth come together. They fought against the rider on the white horse and against his army.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ n wu kusɔbɔya na nɛ kasawule ere so be bewura nɛ bumo be benapo ka shɛr m ba nɛ b ba kɔ gbaŋɛ na be ediipo na nɛ mbe benapo kena.

english_verse: But the beast was captured and so was the false prophet. This is the same prophet who had worked miracles for the beast, so he could fool everyone who had the mark of the beast and worshiped the idol. The beast and the false prophet were thrown alive into a lake of burning sulfur.
translation_verse: Nɛ b pɛ kusɔbɔya na n ta anebi fɛpo mo nɛ e daŋ wora emamachisheŋ damta kusɔbɔya na be anishito na n ti so. Emamachisheŋ na nɛ e daŋ ta n fule bumo nɛ b daŋ nya kusɔbɔya na be ndulgi na nseŋ maŋ mbe kaduli so na. B daŋ ta kusɔbɔya na nɛ anebi fɛpo na nna ŋ kpa n wɔtɔ edɛ mo nɛ jɛrbi wɔ amo to a chɔɔ na to nna nɛ b kraa keni.

english_verse: But the rest of their army was killed by the sword that came from the mouth of the rider on the horse. Then birds stuffed themselves on the dead bodies.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ b ta tokobi mo nɛ k daŋ shi gbaŋɛ na be ediipo na be kɔnɔ to n lar m mɔ bumo nɛ b daŋ ka na kikɛ nɛ mbuibi ba ji bumo be eyurana m moɛ ŋ kini.

english_verse: I saw thrones, and sitting on those thrones were the ones who had been given the right to judge. I also saw the souls of the people who had their heads cut off because they had told about Jesus and preached God's message. They were the same ones who had not worshiped the beast or the idol, and they had refused to let its mark be put on their foreheads or hands. They will come to life and rule with Christ for
translation_verse: Nɛ n naŋ wu kuwurputiana nɛ bumo nɛ b daa tase amo so na kikɛ. B daŋ sa bumo ekpa nna fanɛ b ji basa demu.
