Ma alɛ daŋ naŋ wu basa nɛ b daŋ mɔ ŋkpal b ka daŋ ji Yesu be shɛda so nɛ ŋkpal b ka daŋ malga Ebɔrɛ be kamalga na so na be ayoyu. Bumo alɛ daa maŋ maŋ kusɔbɔya na ŋko mbe kaduli na so, bumo alɛ daa maŋ naa kɔ mbe ndulgi na bumo be nsɔto so ŋko bumo be enɔana so. B daŋ naŋ nya ŋkpa nna n tu Kristo n ji kuwura nfɛ kagboŋ.

english_verse: These people are the first to be raised to life, and they are especially blessed and holy. The second death has no power over them. They will be priests for God and Christ and will rule with them for
translation_verse: Ketiŋi luwu to juŋkparso nna na. Kagbenefuli nɛ kebaawɔtɔ cheembi la bekama nɛ b ti bumo nɛ baaŋ tiŋi luwu be ketiŋi juŋkparso na to so. Luwu nyɔsopo na maŋ kɔ eleŋ bumo so. Baaŋ ki Ebɔrɛ nɛ Kristo be bɔrɛmatapoana, bumo alɛ beeŋ tu mo n ji kuwura nfɛ kagboŋ. Setani be kemur be asheŋ

english_verse: He will fool the countries of Gog and Magog, which are at the far ends of the earth, and their people will follow him into battle. They will have as many followers as there are grains of sand along the beach,
translation_verse: Nɛ e lar n fule efuliana so ebi ashi kasawule so be abonfu ana kikɛ, bumo e la Gɔg nɛ Magɔg ebi na n shɛr bumo nɛ b kɔ kena. Bumo be keshi daa sa fanɛ teku ase be shishɛr.

english_verse: and they will march all the way across the earth. They will surround the camp of God's people and the city God loves. But fire will come down from heaven and destroy the whole army.
translation_verse: Nɛ b yili kasawule be mparto be kaba ko n nite m ba choŋ kaba ko ŋ kulti Ebɔrɛ be basa laraso n wɔtɔ bumo be kakpa, kumo e la kadegboŋ shaso na. Ama edɛ daŋ shi esoso nna m ba mur basa nɛ b daŋ kulti Ebɔrɛ be basa n wɔtɔ na.

english_verse: Then the devil who fooled them will be thrown into the lake of fire and burning sulfur. He will be there with the beast and the false prophet, and they will be in pain day and night forever and ever. The Judgment at the Great White Throne
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ b ta alubipo mo nɛ e daŋ fule bumo na n lɛ n wɔtɔ edɛ mo nɛ jɛrbi wɔ amo to a chɔɔ na be kepa to, kakpa nɛ b daŋ ta kusɔbɔya na nɛ anebi fɛpo na n lɛ to na. Baaŋ tɔrɔ bumo ga kapa nɛ kanyɛ mbaanaayɔ. B ka ji bumo nɛ b wu na demu be asheŋ

english_verse: I saw a great white throne with someone sitting on it. Earth and heaven tried to run away, but there was no place for them to go.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ n naŋ wu kuwurputigboŋ fuful ko nɛ esa nɛ e daa tase kumo so. Nɛ kasawule nɛ awɔlpa foe mbe anishito a maŋ naa kɔ kakpa ndoŋ.

english_verse: I also saw all the dead people standing in front of that throne. Every one of them was there, no matter who they had once been. Several books were opened, and then the book of life was opened. The dead were judged by what those books said they had done.
translation_verse: Nɛ n wu bubuni, begboŋi nɛ bewurbi kikɛ nɛ b yil kuwurputi na akpa nɛ b bugi nwɔl. Amo be kaman nɛ b bugi kawɔl ko malɛ, kumo e la ŋkpa be kawɔl na. Nɛ b bɔla nwɔlana na to ŋ keni n wu asɔ nɛ ebuni kama daŋ wora n yili amo so n ji mo demu.

english_verse: The sea gave up the dead people who were in it, and death and its kingdom also gave up their dead. Then everyone was judged by what they had done.
translation_verse: Nɛ etekuana shin nɛ basa nɛ b daŋ wu amo to na lar nɛ luwu nɛ bubuni be kakpa malɛ gba shin nɛ basa nɛ b daŋ wu a wɔ amo to na malɛ gba lar nɛ b yili asɔ nɛ ekama daŋ wora so n ji mo demu.

english_verse: Afterwards, death and its kingdom were thrown into the lake of fire. This is the second death.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ b ta luwu nɛ bubuni be kakpa malɛ n lɛ n wɔtɔ edɛ be kepa to. Edɛ be kepa na e la luwu nyɔsopo na.

english_verse: Anyone whose name wasn't written in the book of life was thrown into the lake of fire.
translation_verse: Esa kama nɛ b daa maŋ sibɛ mbe ketre n wɔtɔ ŋkpa be kawɔl na to, b ta mo nna n lɛ edɛ be kepa na to.

english_verse: I saw a new heaven and a new earth. The first heaven and the first earth had disappeared, and so had the sea.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ n wu ebɔrɛso popɔr nɛ kasawule popɔr, ŋkpal manɛ so, ebɔrɛso dra na nɛ kasawule dra na daa maŋ naa wɔtɔ nɛ etekuana malɛ gba daa maŋ naa wɔtɔ.

english_verse: I heard a loud voice shout from the throne: God's home is now with his people. He will live with them, and they will be his own. Yes, God will make his home among his people.
translation_verse: Kumo be kaman nɛ n nu ebɔl ko awɔrso ka shi kuwurputi na akpa ŋ kaŋɛ: “Naniere bre, basa to e ki kakpa nɛ Ebɔrɛ ba nɛ e ba kaa wɔ. Mo nɛ basa beeŋ ba kaa wɔtɔ nɛ b baa la mbe basa. Ebɔrɛ gbagba e naaŋ ba kaa wɔ bumo to a la bumo be Ebɔrɛ.

english_verse: He will wipe all tears from their eyes, and there will be no more death, suffering, crying, or pain. These things of the past are gone forever.
translation_verse: E beeŋ kpra anishichubi kikɛ ashi bumo be anishito, luwu maaŋ naa wɔtɔ, luwu so be kagbenejija nɛ kushu maaŋ naa wɔtɔ, ebesa malɛ gba maaŋ naa wɔtɔ, ŋkpal manɛ so, amo be saŋɛ nɛ sososo be asheŋ kikɛ beeŋ choŋ.”

english_verse: Everything is finished! I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end. I will freely give water from the life-giving fountain to everyone who is thirsty.
translation_verse: Nɛ e naŋ kaŋɛ: “K teŋ wora. Ma e la Alfa nɛ Omega, Faraŋko nɛ Lalaloge. Ekama nɛ achukoŋ kɔ mo, meeŋ jɔ nchu ashi ŋkpa be kebuye to n sa mo nɛ e nuu ŋkaa maaŋ ka shɛŋ.

english_verse: All who win the victory will be given these blessings. I will be their God, and they will be my people.
translation_verse: Ekama nɛ e kɔ m pɔɔ so beeŋ nya ade kikɛ, nɛ m baa la amodoŋwura be Ebɔrɛ nɛ mo alɛ e baa la m pibi.

english_verse: But I will tell you what will happen to cowards and to everyone who is unfaithful or dirty-minded or who murders or is sexually immoral or uses witchcraft or worships idols or tells lies. They will be thrown into that lake of fire and burning sulfur. This is the second death. The New Jerusalem
translation_verse: Ama befupo bre nɛ bumo nɛ b maa yirda na nɛ basa jiga nɛ bemɔpo nɛ kesakaleasheŋ wuraana nɛ bumo nɛ baa wora ŋ kilgi nɛ agbirshumpoana nɛ befɛpo kikɛ bre kikɛ be kaboŋ e la edɛ be kepa nɛ jɛrbi wɔ kumo to a chɔɔ na to. Ndoŋ be luwu e la luwu nyɔsopo na.” Jerusalɛm popɔr na be asheŋ

english_verse: I saw one of the seven angels who had the bowls filled with the seven last terrible troubles. The angel came to me and said, “Come on! I will show you the one who will be the bride and wife of the Lamb.”
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ emalaika ashunu mo nɛ b daa kɔ ntishaŋ ashunu nɛ a daŋ bɔlɔ lalaloge be etɔrɔ ashunu na be eko ba ŋ kutɔ m ba kaŋɛ ma le: “Ba nɛ ŋ ŋini fo kejafɔ na, Kpakpafɔlbi na be eche na.”

english_verse: Then with the help of the Spirit, he took me to the top of a very high mountain. There he showed me the holy city of Jerusalem coming down from God in heaven.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ e ta ma kiyoyu to n yɔ kebee gboŋgboŋi jeŋgreŋ ko so n ya ŋini ma kadegboŋ cheembi na, kumo e la Jerusalɛm na nɛ k shi Ebɔrɛ kutɔ ashi ebɔrɛso a ba.

english_verse: The glory of God made the city bright. It was dazzling and crystal clear like a precious jasper stone.
translation_verse: Nɛ kadegboŋ na kikɛ sɔ Ebɔrɛ be kemaŋkura a nyɛkpɛ so palpal fanɛ kejembubi mo nɛ baa tre jaspa nɛ k bee wu to fanɛ abɔrɛjembubi na.

english_verse: The city had a high and thick wall with twelve gates, and each one of them was guarded by an angel. On each of the gates was written the name of one of the twelve tribes of Israel.
translation_verse: Kade na daa kɔ egbal gboŋgboŋi ko nna nsaa kɔ mbuna kuduanyɔ nɛ emalaika kuduanyɔ yil a keni amo so. B daŋ sibɛ Israɛl be nnaŋ kuduanyɔ na be ekama be ketre nna n deŋi kabuna kama so.

english_verse: Three of these gates were on the east, three were on the north, three more were on the south, and the other three were on the west.
translation_verse: Mbuna asa e daa wɔ epeŋilarkpa be kaba so nɛ mbuna asa wɔ kelargato be esoso be kaba so nɛ mbuna asa wɔ kelargato be kaseto be kaba so nɛ mbuna asa wɔ epeŋitɔrkpa be kaba so.

english_verse: The city was built on twelve foundation stones. On each of the stones was written the name of one of the Lamb's twelve apostles.
translation_verse: Kadegboŋ na be egbal daa kɔ egbaltɔlase kuduanyɔ nɛ gbaltɔlase kama malɛ daa kɔ Kpakpafɔlbi na be beshuŋipo kuduanyɔ na be ekoŋwule kama be ketre.

english_verse: The angel who spoke to me had a gold measuring stick to measure the city and its gates and its walls.
translation_verse: Malaika mo nɛ e daŋ malga ŋ kutɔ na daa kɔ shuwa be kekpabi nɛ b kɔ a karga asɔ enɔ to nna nɛ e ta ŋ karga kadegboŋ na nɛ kumo be mbuna nɛ kumo be egbal.

english_verse: The city was shaped like a cube, because it was just as high as it was wide. When the angel measured the city, it was about
translation_verse: Kade na kikɛ daŋ bonte nna a dese nɛ kumo be nteŋ nɛ mparto kikɛ sasa. Malaika na ka ta mbe kekpabi na ŋ karga kade na, kumo be nteŋ daa wɔ emayɛl kagboŋ nɛ alfa anu nɛ kumo be mparto nɛ kumo be jeŋgreŋ malɛ gba kikɛ daa sa loŋ.

english_verse: The wall was built of jasper, and the city was made of pure gold, clear as crystal.
translation_verse: Jaspa be ajembu nɛ b daŋ ta m pɔr egbal na nseŋ ta shuwa gbagba malɛ nɛ a bee wu to fanɛ digi n wora kadegboŋ na malɛ kikɛ.

english_verse: the fifth was onyx, the sixth was carnelian, the seventh was chrysolite, the eighth was beryl, the ninth was topaz, the tenth was chrysoprase, the eleventh was jacinth, and the twelfth was amethyst.
translation_verse: Sardɔniksi nɛ b daŋ ta n wora gbaltɔlase nusopo nseŋ ta sardie n wora keshesopo na n ta krisolit n wora keshunusopo na. Kuburwasopo na peya e la berɛl, kekpanusopo e la kejembu mo nɛ baa tre topas na, kudusopo peya e la krisoprasi nɛ kudukakosopo peya la jasinɛf. Kejembu kuduanyɔsopo mo nɛ b daŋ ta n wora gbaltɔlase kuduanyɔsopo na nɛ baa tre ametiste.

english_verse: Each of the twelve gates was a solid pearl. The streets of the city were made of pure gold, clear as crystal.
translation_verse: Mbuna kuduanyɔ na daa la asɔ nɛ baa tre apɛl na nna. Pɛɛl koŋwule nɛ b daŋ ta n lɔŋɛ kabuna na be kekama. Kadegboŋ na be kubɔrbi daa la shuwa gbagba nna a wu to fanɛ digi.

english_verse: I did not see a temple there. The Lord God All-Powerful and the Lamb were its temple.
translation_verse: N daa maŋ wu bɔrɛlambu kama kadegboŋ na to, ŋkpal manɛ so, Enyɛnpetale Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ Kpakpafɔlbi na e la ndoŋ be bɔrɛlambu.

english_verse: And the city did not need the sun or the moon. The glory of God was shining on it, and the Lamb was its light.
translation_verse: Epeŋi be kenyaŋɛ ŋko kufɔl be kefulto ndoŋ be asheŋ daa maŋ tir kadegboŋ na to ebi kikɛ, ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ be kemaŋkura e daa nyaŋɛ a yuu kade na so nɛ Kpakpafɔlbi na malɛ la kumo be fitila.

english_verse: Nations will walk by the light of that city, and kings will bring their riches there.
translation_verse: Kumo be kefulto nɛ efuliana so ebi beeŋ wu n nite nɛ kasawule ere so be bewurgboŋana e bar bumo be kemaŋkura kumo to.

english_verse: Its gates are always open during the day, and night never comes.
translation_verse: Ndoŋ be mbuna maa ti kikɛ, ŋkpal manɛ so, kanyɛ maa biri ndoŋ kikɛ.

english_verse: The glorious treasures of nations will be brought into the city.
translation_verse: Baaŋ bar efuliana so be kemaŋkura nɛ amo be bunyaŋ kade na to.

english_verse: But nothing unworthy will be allowed to enter. No one who is dirty-minded or who tells lies will be there. Only those whose names are written in the Lamb's book of life will be in the city.
translation_verse: Eyurpi be kusɔ kikɛ maaŋ luri ndoŋ kikɛ. Esa kama malɛ gba nɛ e bee wora anishinyɔrsheŋ ŋko a fule, e maaŋ luri ndoŋ kikɛ. Bumo nɛ b sibɛ bumo be atre n wɔtɔ Kpakpafɔlbi na be ŋkpa be kawɔl na to na nawule e naaŋ luri ndoŋ.

english_verse: The angel showed me a river that was crystal clear, and its waters gave life. The river came from the throne where God and the Lamb were seated.
translation_verse: Malaika na daŋ ŋini ma ŋkpa be lɔr be nchu gba nɛ a bee wu to fanɛ abɔrɛjembubi ashi Ebɔrɛ nɛ Kpakpafɔlbi be kuwurputiakpa

english_verse: Then it flowed down the middle of the city's main street. On each side of the river are trees that grow a different kind of fruit each month of the year. The fruit gives life, and the leaves are used as medicine to heal the nations.
translation_verse: a shile a bɔla kadegboŋ na be kubɔrbi be nferinto so. Ŋkpa be kedibi daa yil lɔr na be kaba kama so nna a sɔr kumo be asɔrso ale kuduanyɔ, kumo e la fanɛ kufɔl kikɛ to nɛ kumo be asɔrso. Kedibi na be afantaŋ e la efuliana be kechɛ be asɔ.

english_verse: God's curse will no longer be on the people of that city. He and the Lamb will be seated there on their thrones, and its people will worship God
translation_verse: Kusɔ kama nɛ Ebɔrɛ so kɔnɔ maaŋ naa wɔ ndoŋ. Ebɔrɛ nɛ Kpakpafɔlbi na be kuwurputi e naaŋ baa wɔ ndoŋ nɛ mbe anya e baa maŋ mo so.

english_verse: and will see him face to face. God's name will be written on the foreheads of the people.
translation_verse: Baaŋ wu mbe anishiakpa nɛ mbe ketre malɛ e baa deŋ bumo be nsɔtoana so.

english_verse: Never again will night appear, and no one who lives there will ever need a lamp or the sun. The Lord God will be their light, and they will rule forever. The Coming of Christ
translation_verse: Kanyɛ maaŋ naa wɔ ndoŋ. Fitila be kefulto ŋko epeŋi be kefulto be asheŋ maaŋ naŋ tir bumo, ŋkpal manɛ so, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ e naaŋ baa sa bumo kefulto. Bumo alɛ beeŋ ji kuwura mbaanaayɔ.

english_verse: Then I was told: These words are true and can be trusted. The Lord God controls the spirits of his prophets, and he is the one who sent his angel to show his servants what must happen very soon.
translation_verse: Nɛ malaika na kaŋɛ ma le: “Mmalga ere la kashenteŋ nna nɛ baaŋ tiŋ n yirda amo. Amo alɛ so nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ malɛ ta mbe Kiyoyu na n sa mbe anebi nseŋ shuŋi mbe malaika fanɛ e ba ŋini mbe anya asɔ nɛ a maaŋ naŋ chɛr nseŋ wora na kikɛ.

english_verse: Remember, I am coming soon! God will bless everyone who pays attention to the message of this book.
translation_verse: Yesu yɛ: ‘Men keni, m maaŋ naŋ chɛr nseŋ ba. Kagbenefuli beeŋ baa la ekama nɛ e bee ta mmalgawuŋkaŋɛ nɛ a wɔ kawɔl ere to ere a wɔtɔ mbe kagbene to peya nna.’ ”

english_verse: My name is John, and I am the one who heard and saw these things. Then after I had heard and seen all this, I knelt down and began to worship at the feet of the angel who had shown it to me.
translation_verse: Ma Jɔn e nu nseŋ wu asɔ ere kikɛ. Ma alɛ ka daŋ nu amo nseŋ wu amo nɛ ŋ gbir n dese kasawule malaika mo nɛ e daa ŋini ma asɔana na be anishito nɛ m maŋ mo so

english_verse: But the angel said, Don't do that! I am a servant, just like you. I am the same as a follower or a prophet or anyone else who obeys what is written in this book. God is the one you should worship.
translation_verse: nɛ e kaŋɛ ma le: “A maŋ daga fanɛ fo wora loŋ. Ma alɛ gba la fo nɛ fo niopibiana anebiana nɛ bumo nɛ baa ta kawɔl ere to be mmalga a wɔtɔ bumo be ŋgbene to na bumo barkasa kenya nna. Ebɔrɛ e daga fanɛ fo baa maŋ mo so.”

english_verse: Don't keep the prophecies in this book a secret. These things will happen soon.
translation_verse: Kede be kaman nɛ e kaŋɛ ma: “Sa maŋ kaŋ ta le be mmalgawuŋkaŋɛ ere ŋ ŋana wulo to, ŋkpal manɛ so, jemanɛ na bee taga to.

english_verse: Evil people will keep on being evil, and everyone who is dirty-minded will still be dirty-minded. But good people will keep on doing right, and God's people will always be holy.
translation_verse: Esa kama nɛ e bee wora alubi e baa kraa wora amo, ekama malɛ nɛ e kɔ eyurpi mo to e baa kraa du loŋ. Ekama nɛ e bee wora alela e baa kraa wora alela na nɛ ekama malɛ nɛ e du cheembi e baa kraa du cheembi loŋ.”

english_verse: Then I was told: I am coming soon! And when I come, I will reward everyone for what they have done.
translation_verse: E yɛ: “Keni nfe, m maaŋ naŋ chɛr nseŋ ba. Ma alɛ kɔ ma kakɔka nna a ba nɛ m ba yili kanaŋkama nɛ ekama shuŋ so ŋ ka mo.

english_verse: I am Alpha and Omega, the first and the last, the beginning and the end.
translation_verse: Ma e la Alfa nɛ Omega, Faraŋko nɛ Lalaloge nɛ Ejuŋkparpo nɛ Emantopo na.

english_verse: God will bless all who have washed their robes. They will each have the right to eat fruit from the tree that gives life, and they can enter the gates of the city.
translation_verse: Kagbenefuli la bekama nɛ b fɔr bumo be epiŋi nɛ a lar so nseŋ nya ekpa nɛ b ji ŋkpa be kedibi na be asɔrso nseŋ naŋ nya m bɔla mbuna to na n luri kadegboŋ na to na peya nna.

english_verse: But outside the city will be dogs, witches, immoral people, murderers, idol worshipers, and everyone who loves to tell lies and do wrong.
translation_verse: Bumo nɛ b la njɔnɔ nɛ basa nɛ baa wora ŋ kilgi nɛ kesakaleawuraana nɛ bemɔpo nɛ agbirshumpoana nɛ esa kama nɛ e bee sha nsaa bɛ efɛsheŋ kama so na nawule e maŋ wɔ kadegboŋ na to.

english_verse: I am Jesus! And I am the one who sent my angel to tell all of you these things for the churches. I am David's Great Descendant, and I am also the bright morning star.
translation_verse: Ma Yesu e shuŋi ma malaika nɛ e ba ta le be shɛda be kubɔya ere m bɔ n sa asɔriana na. N la Ewura Deevid be kanaŋ to be Ejuŋkparpo nna nseŋ naa la mo Nanabi nɛ kachipurso be Nyanwuleji fuliso parr nna.”

english_verse: The Spirit and the bride say, “Come!” Everyone who hears this should say, “Come!” If you are thirsty, come! If you want life-giving water, come and take it. It's free!
translation_verse: Ndoŋ nna nɛ Kiyoyu na nɛ kejafɔ na kaŋɛ: “Ba.” Ekama malɛ gba nɛ e nu loŋ e kaŋɛ: “Ba.” Ekama nɛ achukoŋ kɔ mo e ba, ekama malɛ nɛ e bee sha e ba sɔ ŋkpa be nchu na n nuu ŋkaa maaŋ ka shɛŋ.

english_verse: Here is my warning for everyone who hears the prophecies in this book: If you add anything to them, God will make you suffer all the terrible troubles written in this book.
translation_verse: Mee fiɛ ekama nɛ e nu kewuŋkaŋɛ ere be mmalga mo nɛ a wɔ kawɔl ere to ere so nna fanɛ ekama nɛ e ta kusɔ kama n ti amo so, Ebɔrɛ beeŋ ta etɔrɔ mo nɛ b malga amo be asheŋ kawɔl ere to ere n ti amodoŋwura so.

english_verse: If you take anything away from these prophecies, God will not let you have part in the life-giving tree and in the holy city described in this book.
translation_verse: Ekama malɛ nɛ e lara mmalga ashi abɔrɛsheŋ wuŋkaŋɛ be kawɔl ere to, Ebɔrɛ beeŋ lara mbe kachigeso ashi ŋkpa be kedibi be asɔrso na to nseŋ naŋ lara mbe kachigeso ashi kadegboŋ cheembi nɛ b malga kumo nɛ ŋkpa be kedibi sɔrso be kananɛ a du be asheŋ ashi kawɔl ere to na.

english_verse: The one who has spoken these things says, “I am coming soon!” So, Lord Jesus, please come soon!
translation_verse: Esa nɛ e bee ji asheŋ ere be shɛda e naa kaŋɛ fanɛ: “Kashenteŋto, m maaŋ naŋ chɛr nseŋ ba.” Amɛn, Enyɛnpe Yesu, ba naniere!

english_verse: I pray that the Lord Jesus will be kind to all of you.
translation_verse: Enyɛnpe Yesu be kuwɔr be kakɛ e baa wɔ Ebɔrɛ be basa kikɛ so. Amɛn.
